第1章 开局遇bug

“一只虫子飞进来，

打断他的翅膀，

戳瞎他的眼睛，

让他再也飞不起来。

神说要挖出他的心脏，

抽出他的骨头，

老虎不听话，给他埋了坑。

虫子孵化爬出坑，

吃掉一个又一个，

吃掉一个又一个。”

几个NPC小鬼在距离神殿不远的拱门边上一边唱着诡异的儿歌一边玩耍。

伏向军越听越烦躁，站在残破的神殿阶梯前，不住抬头往神殿里面张望。

我老大呢？

我那么大一个老大到哪儿去了？

一个又一个只穿着简单粗布背心和中短裤的兽人赤脚从神殿出生池走出来。

中间还夹杂了几只纯兽形。

伏向军与这些玩家全都确定过眼神，都不是他老大！

明明他老大跟他说过，他就在这批申请通过的玩家当中。

难道是现实中有事情耽搁了？

他可是花了整整一百银买了一张专门回新手村的许可券！

目前为止，这个游戏中能拥有一百银达鲁的玩家都是富豪。

“这就是我们出生的神殿？好一个老破小！”

“额滴娘！不敢相信，震惊俺三年！我以为都是广告营销骗人的，没想到……卧槽，我真的没穿越？其实这里是真实世界吧？”

“这天！这地！这空气！MGD！”

“我竟然有蛋？！”

“我康康我康康！”

“滚！”

“那边是不是有NPC小兽人？真的好逼真。”

“游戏面板呢？为什么我找不到游戏面板？”

“游戏面板就是跟着你一起出生的一本B5皮质笔记本，你不会扔掉了吧？那玩意丢失重补要花二十银！”

“就是这个？这就是游戏面板？”

有人伸手从粗布背心的大口袋里掏出一本皮壳陈旧的笔记本，满脸不可思议和不可置信。

“对，就是它！”

“这么……朴素？没有光脑，好歹也来块手表啊。”

“前面是不是就是我们的新手村？”

从神殿出来往南边走，大约两三百米的距离就有一座村庄。

村庄和神殿之间残留的石砖路上，有一道像是石造拱门的残留建筑物。

这道顶上缺了一大块的拱门像是把村庄和神殿分成了两个世界。

本地人，绝不会穿过这道拱门往神殿方向走，包括不懂事的孩子在内。

正在村里忙事情的本地兽人们看着一个又一个穿着类似的兽人越过那道拱门走进他们村子，那表情就像看到一具具复活的尸体从坟地里爬了出来并正准备入侵他们村子。

新人玩家热情地向这些NPC打招呼，希望能接到一些任务。

结果这些兽人有孩子的抓孩子、没孩子的抓亲人，一个个迅速转身就跑回去自家房屋，还把自家大门紧紧关上。

“这是肿么回事？”

“老玩家呢？为什么看不到老玩家？”

“我刚才好像看到一个。”

新人玩家们一头雾水，到处寻找老玩家，希望能得到老玩家一些指点。

眼看神殿出生池再也没有新玩家出来。

伏向军决定下线联系他老大。

如果他老大故意鸽他，他一定要对方赔他一百银！

电话铃声响了一遍又一遍，没有人接。

伏向军皱起眉头，搞不清楚他老大是不方便接电话，还是出了什么事情。

说来，今天上游戏前，他眼皮就一直跳。

伏向军打开自家大门走向隔壁。

大门虚掩。

伏向军迅速从腰侧掏出枪，小心推开门。

一路安静。

直到书房。

书房地上趴着一具脑袋被射穿的尸体。

头顶吊扇在呼呼地吹。

他老大坐在老旧的沙发上，头上戴着游戏头盔，胳膊、心脏和太阳穴等位置都贴着监测芯片，头靠沙发椅背，两手搁扶手上，人一动不动。

这一刻，伏向军心跳超过一百八。

伏向军深吸气，快步走近沙发，伸出手指查探老大鼻息。

有气，活的！

再看旁边的监测机器，心跳、血压、脑电波，貌似一切正常。

脑电波比做梦时稍微活跃一些。

伏向军吐了口气，虽然不明白他老大为什么没有出现在天残谷新手村，也不明白对方为什么不接电话——游戏头盔设置了手机来电提醒。

先处理尸体吧。

身在战区，还干着销售军火的买卖，就得习惯这种事。

不过他老大也是越来越心大，干掉暗杀者，还能在有暗杀者尸体的房间里继续玩他的游戏。

就算他们马上要离开这里，也不能这样随便啊。

他真的觉得他老大应该去看看心理医生了。

游戏世界。

商非凡推测自己很可能遇到了游戏中的bug。

他的游戏面板卡住了。

在震惊过游戏世界的真实感后，他就开始寻找游戏面板，想要搞清楚现在的状况。

这个游戏没办法选择自己的种族，更没办法让玩家自己捏脸。

用游戏宣传的话来说就是分配到什么样的身体和天赋，全看个人运气，主打的就是真实。

他想要了解自己现在的情况，可不就只能查看游戏面板了吗。

……他没有在身体周围找到那本B5笔记本，明明论坛里说了会随身摆放。

说好来新手村带他熟悉游戏的伏向军也没有出现，同样也没有看到其他玩家。

无奈，他只能呼唤游戏面板。

万没想到他只是在脑中随意喊了喊，游戏面板竟然真的出现！

就闪了一下，出现了半个界面，就卡住。

活像网速太慢，刷页面只刷出来一半，然后死活就不动。

但他游戏中的身体依旧可以动弹，周围环境也是活的，风在吹，草在动，鼻端更能嗅到野草味、尘土味、野兽粪便味、还有某些物体腐烂的臭味等复杂信息。

所以完全可以判断网速没有问题，有问题的是游戏系统。

他想下线保平安，但这奇妙的感觉又让他有点上头。

实际上，他刚刚试过，他已经没办法下线。

既然如此……那就继续玩呗。

他没想到自己真的能变成野兽。

这可真的是百分百的真实体感，他完完全全感受到了自己变成兽体后的不协调。

圆滚滚胖乎乎的小虎崽子表情严肃，撑起短短的四肢，迈出左边前腿，想要尝试往前走两步。

刚迈出两步，就后脚绊前脚，骨碌碌滚出半米远，撞到什么物体才停下来。

小虎崽无力地趴在地上，低头看自己大大的厚实的爪爪。

比猫爪要大得多的虎爪，却让他连路都走不稳。

周围环境在他刚睁开眼时就已经观察过了。

他看得最清楚的就是头顶蓝天和周围比他身体高得多的杂草丛。

他想找一块高地看清楚周围情况，但撑起四肢走路成了第一道难关。

小虎崽再次撑起身体，他一定要尽快学会走路。

砰，左前脚再次碰到了障碍物。

小虎崽瞪大眼睛，不太熟练地伸爪拨开挡住视线的茂密草丛。

一块皮甲出现在他眼前。

皮甲包裹着一条手臂，手臂很结实。

Chapter 1: Encountering a Bug Right at the Start (Part 1)

"A bug flies in,

Break its wings,

Poking out its eyes,

So it can never fly again.

God says to dig out its heart,

Pull out its bones,

The tiger doesn't listen, so they dug a pit to bury it.

The bug hatches and crawls out of the pit,

Eating one after another,

Eating one after another."

A few NPC urchins by the arched gateway not far from the temple played while chanting a bizarre nursery rhyme.

Fu Xiangjun grew more and more irritable the more he listened. Standing before the dilapidated temple steps, he kept raising his head to peer inside the temple.

Where is my boss?

Where did such a big boss of mine go?

Orcs wearing simple coarse-cloth vests and mid-shorts walked barefoot out of the temple's birth pool one after another.

Mixed among them were even a few in pure beast forms.

Fu Xiangjun exchanged confirming glances with all of these players, and none of them was his boss!

Clearly, his boss had told him that he was among this batch of approved players.

Could something have delayed him in reality?

He had spent a full hundred silver coins just to buy a specialized entry permit back to the新手村 (novice village)!

Up until now, players in this game who could possess a hundred silver Daru were wealthy tycoons.

"Is this the temple where we were born? Such a rundown piece of junk!"

"Oh, mother dearest! Unbelievable, I'm shocked for three whole years! I thought all the advertising and marketing were scams, but I never expected... Holy cow, did I really not transmigrate? Is this actually the real world?"

"This sky! This ground! This air! MGD!"

"I actually have eggs?!"

"Let me take a look, let me take a look!"

"Get lost!"

"Is that a little NPC orc over there? It's so lifelike."

"Where is the game panel? Why can't I find the game panel?"

"The game panel is a B5 leather-bound notebook that spawns along with you. You didn't throw it away, did you? Replacing that thing if lost costs twenty silver!"

"This is it? This is the game panel?"

Someone reached out from the large pocket of their coarse-cloth vest and pulled out a notebook with a worn leather cover, their face full of disbelief and incredulity.

"Right, that's it!"

"So... plain? No optical brain, the least they could do is give us a watch."

"Is that our novice village ahead?"

Walking south from the temple for about two or three hundred meters, there was a village.

On the residual stone-paved path between the village and the temple stood a remnant structure resembling a stone arched gateway.

This arch, missing a large chunk at the top, seemed to separate the village and the temple into two distinct worlds.

The locals would absolute never cross this archway to walk toward the temple, including ignorant children.

Local orcs busy with work in the village watched as one similarly dressed orc after another crossed that archway and walked into their village, expressions on their faces resembling those who had just seen a succession of resurrected corpses crawl out of a graveyard and prepare to invade their settlement.

Newbie players enthusiastically greeted these NPCs, hoping to trigger some quests.

As a result, those orcs with children grabbed their children, and those without children grabbed their relatives, turning around in a flash to run back to their own homes and slamming their front doors tightly shut.

"What's going on here?"

"Where are the veteran players? Why aren't any veteran players to be seen?"

"I think I saw one just now."

The newbie players were utterly baffled, searching everywhere for veteran players in hopes of getting some pointers.

Seeing that no new players were emerging from the temple birth pool anymore, Fu Xiangjun decided to log off and contact his boss.

If his boss deliberately stood him up, he would definitely make the guy compensate him one hundred silver!

The phone ringtone sounded again and again, but no one answered.

Fu Xiangjun frowned, unable to figure out whether his boss was inconveniently unable to answer the phone or if something had happened.

Come to think of it, his eyelid had been twitching nonstop before he logged into the game today.

Fu Xiangjun opened his front door and headed next door.

The door was ajar.

Fu Xiangjun swiftly drew his gun from his waist, cautiously pushing the door open.

Silence all the way.

Until the study.

On the study floor lay a corpse with a bullet hole through its head.

The ceiling fan overhead whirred loudly.

His boss sat in an old sofa, wearing a gaming helmet on his head, with monitoring chips attached to his arms, heart, temples, and other locations. His head rested against the sofa back, both hands placed on the armrests, completely motionless.

At that moment, Fu Xiangjun's heart rate exceeded 180.

Fu Xiangjun took a deep breath, walked briskly up to the sofa, and reached out a finger to check his boss's breathing.

There was breath, he was alive!

Looking at the monitoring machine beside him, his heart rate, blood pressure, and brainwaves all seemed completely normal.

His brainwaves were just slightly more active than when dreaming.

Fu Xiangjun let out a breath, though he couldn't understand why his boss hadn't appeared in the Tiancan Valley novice village, nor why he didn't answer his phone—the gaming helmet was configured with a mobile call alert.

Let's deal with the corpse first.

Living in a war zone and dealing in arms sales meant one had to get used to this sort of thing.

Still, his boss was getting bolder by the day; after taking out an assassin, he could still continue playing his game in a room with the assassin's corpse.

Even if they were about to leave this place, they couldn't be so casual about it.

He really felt his boss should go see a psychiatrist.

Inside the game world.

Shang Feifan deduced that he had likely encountered a bug in the game.

His game panel was stuck.

After being shocked by the realism of the game world, he had started searching for the game panel to figure out his current situation.

This game didn't allow players to choose their own race, nor did it allow them to customize their appearance.

In the words of the game's promotional pitch, what kind of body and talent you were assigned depended entirely on personal luck, with its core feature being absolute realism.

If he wanted to understand his current condition, wouldn't he have to check the game panel?

...He didn't find that B5 notebook anywhere around his body, even though the forum had clearly stated it would be kept on his person.

Fu Xiangjun, who had promised to come to the novice village and show him the ropes, had not appeared, nor could he see any other players.

Helplessly, he could only call upon the game panel.

Little did he expect that when he merely shouted it casually in his mind, the game panel would actually appear!

It flashed, displayed half of the interface, and then froze.

It looked exactly like a network speed so slow that loading a webpage only brought up half of it before stubbornly refusing to budge any further.

Yet his in-game body could still move, the surrounding environment was alive—the wind was blowing, the grass was swaying, and his nose could catch complex information like wild grass odors, dust, beast feces, and the stench of rotting matter.

Thus, it was entirely safe to judge that the network speed was fine; the problem lay with the game system.

He wanted to log off to ensure his safety, but this wondrous sensation also made him a bit high.

In fact, as he had just tried, he could no longer log off.

Since that was the case... he might as well keep playing.

He hadn't expected that he could actually turn into a beast.

This truly was one-hundred-percent realistic sensory feedback; he completely experienced the lack of coordination after transforming into a beastly form.

The round, plump little tiger cub wore a solemn expression, bracing its short limbs and stepping out its front-left leg, trying to take a couple of steps forward.

No sooner had it stepped two paces than its back foot tripped over its front foot, rolling head over heels for half a meter before crashing into some object and coming to a stop.

The little tiger cub lay limply on the ground, lowering its head to look at its large, thick paws.

Tiger paws vastly larger than cat paws, yet they made it impossible for him to even walk steadily.

He had already observed the surrounding environment when he first opened his eyes.

What he saw most clearly was the blue sky overhead and the clumps of weeds surrounding him that were much taller than his body.

He wanted to find high ground to get a clear view of the surroundings, but bracing his limbs to walk became his first major hurdle.

The little tiger cub braced his body once more; he was determined to learn how to walk as quickly as possible.

Thud, his front-left foot struck an obstacle again.

The little tiger cub widened his eyes, clumsily extending a paw to brush aside the dense patch of weeds blocking his vision.

A piece of leather armor appeared before his eyes.

The leather armor wrapped around an arm, and the arm was very sturdy.

chunks.chineseText:
手臂连接着身体，身体被杂草淹没，看不清楚全貌。

手臂下面似乎还压着一根白色棍子，露出的一点看起来像是手杖的把头。

腐臭味和血腥味传入鼻端。

经验告诉小虎崽，这条手臂九成九属于一个死人。

杂草丛，辽阔的天空，天空中偶尔掠过的猛禽，表明这里很可能是荒郊野外。

在这种地方出现一个死人，还是刚死不久还带着血腥味的死人……

他需要尽快离开这片地。

比他身体高很多的草丛隐藏了他小虎崽的身躯，这也是天空中的猛禽暂时没有发现他的原因。

但这并不能保证那些食肉猛禽一直不会发现他。

偏偏这里还出现一具散发着血腥味的尸体。

不止天上的猛禽会注意这里，周围如果有嗅觉敏锐的野兽，也会很快找到这里。

他可不想刚进游戏就被当做一块肉给叨了。

屋漏偏逢连夜雨！

天空猛禽在盘旋，似乎发现这里有食物。

……早知今天上游戏前应该先看下黄历。

天空猛禽突然俯冲而下。

肾上腺素疯狂上升，一股能量突然从小小的虎崽身体中爆发。

一只骨骼分明、肌肉结实有力的大手猛地抓住压在死人手臂下的手杖手柄，抽出，用力甩向俯冲而下的猛禽。

猛禽发出厉叫，也不知被砸中什么部位，吓得落荒而逃。

几枚羽毛从天空慢慢飘落。

草丛中，一具原始有力的身体半蹲着，身体的主人惊讶地看向自己的双手。

他变成人体了？

质量守恒定律呢？

牛顿棺材板压不住了。

商非凡和牛顿不熟，棺材板压不住就压不住吧。

他不但变成人形，脑袋上还顶着一对毛茸茸的圆耳朵，屁股后面还有一条粗壮长尾巴。

可惜没有镜子，他看不到自己长什么样，但那极具美感的人鱼腰线和清清楚楚的八块腹肌，以及肌肉隆起的有力大腿，足以让商非凡满意。

出门不裸奔，文明你我他。

“这位异乡兄弟，大家都是落难人。我商非凡承诺为你下葬，让你尸体不至于被野兽禽鸟糟蹋。作为交换，我将取用你的衣裤鞋袜和随身用品为报酬。”

商非凡摘了三根野草，握在手心里，对着尸体拱手拜了三拜。

“如果你不同意，就请让草原的风吹动这三根草。三秒之内不动，我就当你同意。”

商非凡背对风口，盯着手中野草，等了三秒，野草一动不动。

商非凡很礼貌地对尸体道谢，弯腰把野草放到尸体眉心间。

搞完迷信活动，商非凡就开始扒尸体衣服。

得到：

不合身粗布衣裤一套，残破度4。

不合身半长束腰皮甲一件，残破度3。

不合脚皮靴一双，残旧度7。

另有钱袋一个，共计一银达鲁六百七十五铜达铢。

以及一封信。

经验告诉小虎崽，这条手臂九成九属于一个死人。

杂草丛，辽阔的天空，天空中偶尔掠过的猛禽，表明这里很可能是荒郊野外。

在这种地方出现一个死人，还是刚死不久还带着血腥味的死人……

他需要尽快离开这片地。

比他身体高很多的草丛隐藏了他小虎崽的身躯，这也是天空中的猛禽暂时没有发现他的原因。

但这并不能保证那些食肉猛禽一直不会发现他。

偏偏这里还出现一具散发着血腥味的尸体。

不止天上的猛禽会注意这里，周围如果有嗅觉敏锐的野兽，也会很快找到这里。

他可不想刚进游戏就被当做一块肉给叨了。

屋漏偏逢连夜雨！

天空猛禽在盘旋，似乎发现这里有食物。

……早知今天上游戏前应该先看下黄历。

天空猛禽突然俯冲而下。

肾上腺素疯狂上升，一股能量突然从小小的虎崽身体中爆发。

一只骨骼分明、肌肉结实有力的大手猛地抓住压在死人手臂下的手杖手柄，抽出，用力甩向俯冲而下的猛禽。

猛禽发出厉叫，也不知被砸中什么部位，吓得落荒而逃。

几枚羽毛从天空慢慢飘落。

草丛中，一具原始有力的身体半蹲着，身体的主人惊讶地看向自己的双手。

他变成人体了？

质量守恒定律呢？

牛顿棺材板压不住了。

商非凡和牛顿不熟，棺材板压不住就压不住吧。

他不但变成人形，脑袋上还顶着一对毛茸茸的圆耳朵，屁股后面还有一条粗壮长尾巴。

可惜没有镜子，他看不到自己长什么样，但那极具美感的人鱼腰线和清清楚楚的八块腹肌，以及肌肉隆起的有力大腿，足以让商非凡满意。

出门不裸奔，文明你我他。

“这位异乡兄弟，大家都是落难人。我商非凡承诺为你下葬，让你尸体不至于被野兽禽鸟糟蹋。作为交换，我将取用你的衣裤鞋袜和随身用品为报酬。”

商非凡摘了三根野草，握在手心里，对着尸体拱手拜了三拜。

“如果你不同意，就请让草原的风吹动这三根草。三秒之内不动，我就当你同意。”

商非凡背对风口，盯着手中野草，等了三秒，野草一动不动。

商非凡很礼貌地对尸体道谢，弯腰把野草放到尸体眉心间。

搞完迷信活动，商非凡就开始扒尸体衣服。

得到：

不合身粗布衣裤一套，残破度4。

不合身半长束腰皮甲一件，残破度3。

不合脚皮靴一双，残旧度7。

另有钱袋一个，共计一银达鲁六百七十五铜达铢。

以及一封信。
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第2章 一封信和任务 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第2章 一封信和任务

【我和拉斐尔（血迹）先生有（血迹）殊关系。

（血迹）天后就是我和他约定见面的日子。

他说他会把接头信物交给我。

天气很糟糕，莫约山谷的天气一贯如此，布满灰尘的阴霾总是笼罩在这座山谷的每一处。

街边奔跑的赤脚小鬼总是试图摸我的口袋，瘫在路边的醉汉也总是随时会抓住（血迹）裤脚，为此我不得不买了一根更为结实的手杖。

不是为了揍他们，只是为了让他们知道我不好惹。

据说现在从手杖中抽出一把（血迹）是（血迹）

（大片血迹）

生活环境糟糕，赚钱不容易，想吃顿美食都是奢望，但想到过两天我就可以（血迹）拉斐尔先生，我就感到生活仍旧（大片血迹）】

这是他从死者内衬布衣口袋里摸出来的一封信。

这张纸记载的内容与其说是信件，不如说更像是日记的一部分。

记录在纸上的明明不是他认识的任何一种文字，但他看懂了。

商非凡正要收起信件，忽然觉得信封某处厚度有点不对劲，正要仔细检查。

“叮咚”，游戏系统上线。

“叮咚，叮咚……”

游戏面板一上线，就一口气给商非凡发布了五个任务。

【任务一：按照和死者约定，掩埋死者尸体。奖励贡献点1点。】

【任务二：找回骨杖。这是你的武器，找到它就是你的奖励。】

【任务三：调查死者死因，找出杀死死者的凶手。奖励贡献点5点。】

【任务四：与信中所指的拉斐尔先生见面，取得接头信物。奖励贡献点10点。】

【任务五：长效阶段型任务，拓展地图。每收录和拓展十平方千米的地图，根据地形险要度和当地危险程度，最低奖励贡献点1点，最高奖励10点。】

一股冷风吹来。

商非凡深吸气。

果然是游戏世界，在玩家身边出现的任何东西都有可能是任务提示。

也许他出生在这里，并不是游戏bug，而是某种奇遇设定？

否则哪能那么巧就碰上一具尸体，不但给他送来新手衣裤、新手武器和一袋钱币，还带来数个任务。

商非凡抬头向远处看，他刚才用骨杖砸鸟，骨杖似乎是落在了那个方向？

枯黄的野草有他腰高，找起东西来很费劲。

好在他对骨杖落在哪里还有印象，否则真要跟大海捞针一样，还不知道要找到什么时候去。

即使如此，他也花了半个多小时才找到骨杖。

任务二顺利完成。

骨杖做工不算精致，但看起来很结实，长度大约一米二，直径两厘米左右，颜色偏白。

想到信中内容，商非凡心中一动，握住手柄左右转了转。

刷，手杖手柄与杖身分离，抽出来一柄骨剑。

不错。

有了武器防身，商非凡继续琢磨信封。

片刻，商非凡手指轻巧又稳定地撕开了信封一角。

里面露出一枚比塑料卡片还要薄的骨片。

商非凡抽出骨片。

只见这枚骨片做工十分精致，不但厚度极薄，四个角也打磨得十分圆润，分正反两面。

正面有几行文字信息，掺杂一些简单花纹。

骨片上的文字和信中所写文字一样，都是象形文，神似楔形文和钟鼎文的结合体。

对此，商非凡很是佩服游戏开发商，为了让游戏世界更真实，竟然开发出了一种新的语言体系。

骨片背面是几个象形图案交织在一起，看起来就像某个组织的图徽。

骨片上端正中间还穿了一个孔，想来是为了方便穿绳子配挂。

“诺曼霍希尔，黑森林城第九局，三级特别调查官。”商非凡轻轻念出骨片正面上的信息。

这显然是一枚类似身份证的身份骨牌。

商非凡收起这枚身份骨牌。

原本打算直接掩埋了尸体——这是游戏世界，他就没想要保护现场再报案。

但现在游戏系统给他发布了任务，让他调查死者死因，还要找到凶手，他就不得不多花一些心力去观察死者和周围留下的痕迹。

商非凡大脑开始回忆他刚开始看到这具尸体全貌时的模样。

再看死者伤口和身上留下的其他痕迹。

商非凡拨开草丛顺着血迹走了一段，又退回来。

这里不是第一现场，死者确实是一路奔逃过来，逃到这里，因为血流过多，昏倒，然后就再也没有醒来。

确定自己再没有遗漏其他线索，商非凡最后又仔细看了一遍这具尸体的样貌。

这是一名单从外表特征无法判断其种族的兽人。

他的耳朵看起来更像是虫翅，裸-露出来的手臂上也有像是虫族肢体的利刺，但他的嘴巴周围却长了猫一样的胡须。

对方的死因是心口被利刃戳中，利刃没有留在心口，这兽人与其说是心脏受伤而死，不如说是流血过多而死。

可惜游戏面板暂时没有开通拍照功能。

商非凡用骨剑挖了一个一米多的深坑。

这个深度，一般野兽应该无法再把尸体刨出来。

商非凡在动手时，发现他这具身体力气极大。

原本他力气就很大，而这具兽人身体的力量要比他真实身体拥有的力量更大得多。

商非凡特意看了下自己的数据面板。

血脉天赋：力大无穷，2级，19/100

伏向军告诉他，很多老玩家的血脉天赋都是力气大，初始值都能接近2级。1级初始值满点为10点。

而他的力量初始值直接跳过1级，达到了2级。

力气大在游戏初期用处比较多，但到后期这就是一个弟弟天赋。

但到目前为止，还没有哪个玩家开出第二个血脉天赋。

商非凡也没嫌弃自己烂大街的血脉天赋。

大力出奇迹，力气大利用好了，不比其他血脉天赋差到哪里。

就是这个血脉天赋似乎有点耗费能量，挖完一个坑，他就饿了。

掩埋好尸体，找来几块石头堆叠做了个标记。

任务一完成，1点贡献点顺利到账。

现实世界。

“嗨，老大，醒醒！”伏向军轻拍商非凡肩膀。

商非凡没动。

“老大？听到我声音了吗？”伏向军弯腰对着商非凡耳边啪啪打响指。

但他老大仍旧保持着原来姿势。

伏向军脸色改变：糟了，出事了。他该怎么办？带老大去医院吗？可为什么这些监测生理特征的仪器都没有警示反应？

游戏世界内，商非凡脑中再次传来提示音，游戏商城上线。

看来这个版本新增加了不少东西，怪不得刚才卡了好一会儿。

之前老玩家们还在问游戏商城什么时候会上线，不少老玩家都喊着他们愿意氪金买装备、氪金抽卡、氪金买命，让游戏商不要心疼他们的钱包，该宰就宰。

游戏商大约就顺水推舟了，商城一推出，接下来就要搞游戏币和现实币的兑换了吧。

不过全息游戏，玩家们确实更愿意花钱。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 1: Encountering a Bug Right at the Start (Part 2)

The arm connected to a body, but the body was submerged in weeds, making its full appearance unclear.

Beneath the arm seemed to be pinning a white stick, with the exposed tip looking like the pommel of a cane.

The stench of rot and the smell of blood wafted into his nostrils.

Experience told the little tiger cub that this arm belonged to a dead person nine times out of ten.

The patches of weeds and the boundless sky, along with the raptors occasionally skimming across the heavens, indicated that this was most likely the desolate wilderness.

For a dead body to appear in such a place—and a corpse that had just died recently and still carried the scent of blood at that...

He needed to leave this area as quickly as possible.

The grass, which grew much taller than his body, concealed the little tiger cub's form, which was the only reason the raptors in the sky hadn't spotted him yet.

However, this offered no guarantee that those carnivorous birds of prey wouldn't notice him eventually.

To make matters worse, a corpse exuding the scent of blood had appeared right here.

Not only would the raptors in the sky pay attention to this place, but if there were beasts with acute senses of smell nearby, they would also track it down very soon.

He had no desire to be pecked apart like a piece of meat right after entering the game.

Misfortunes never come singly!

A raptor in the sky was circling, seemingly having discovered food down below.

...If he had known today, he should have checked the almanac before logging into the game.

The raptor in the sky suddenly dove downward.

Adrenaline surged wildly, and a sudden burst of energy erupted from deep within the tiny tiger cub's body.

A pair of distinct-boned, firmly muscled, and powerful hands abruptly seized the handle of the cane pinned beneath the dead man's arm, pulled it out, and swung it with all his might toward the diving raptor.

The raptor let out a sharp cry, struck by something—who knows where—and fled in terrified panic.

A few feathers drifted slowly down from the sky.

Amidst the weeds, a primitive and powerful body crouched halfway, its owner staring in astonishment at his own hands.

He had turned into a human form?

What happened to the law of conservation of mass?

Newton's coffin lid was about to burst open.

Shang Feifan wasn't well-acquainted with Newton; if the coffin lid wouldn't stay down, then let it pop.

Not only had he transformed into a human shape, but he also sported a pair of fluffy round ears atop his head, and a thick, long tail swished behind his buttocks.

Pity there was no mirror, so he couldn't see what he looked like, but that aesthetically pleasing mermaid line, the crystal-clear eight-pack abs, and the muscular, powerful thighs were enough to satisfy Shang Feifan.

No naked running when going out, civilization relies on you, me, and everyone.

"Brother from another land, we are all fellow travelers in distress. I, Shang Feifan, promise to bury you so that your corpse won't be defiled by beasts and birds. In exchange, I will take your clothes, pants, shoes, socks, and personal belongings as my reward."

Shang Feifan plucked three stalks of wild grass, held them in his palm, cupped his fists at the corpse, and bowed three times.

"If you disagree, please let the wind of the prairie blow these three grass stalks. If they don't move within three seconds, I'll take it that you agree."

Shang Feifan turned his back to the wind, staring at the wild grass in his hand. After waiting three seconds, the grass didn't stir at all.

Shang Feifan politely thanked the corpse, bent down, and placed the grass between the corpse's brows.

Having finished his superstitious ritual, Shang Feifan began stripping the corpse.

Acquired:

A set of ill-fitting coarse-cloth clothes and trousers, damage level 4.

An ill-fitting semi-long cinched leather armor, damage level 3.

A pair of ill-fitting leather boots, worn level 7.

Additionally, a money pouch containing a total of one silver Daru and six hundred seventy-five copper Dazhu.

And a letter.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第2章 一封信和任务 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
比如身上穿的衣服都是血迹，还有破洞，如果在普通游戏中，换不换都无所谓，但在近乎百分百的真实体感下，谁不想换一套更干净、更舒服、更好看、更有用的衣服？

至少让商非凡选的话，如果现在就能氪金，他也愿意氪金买一套合身干净的新衣裤和鞋子穿上。

饥饿的感觉很难受，他的精力值在迅速下降，从满值100点下降到了67点。生命值还是满点。

商非凡迅速点开游戏商城页面，就见里面分了很多子版块。分别为装备、武器、食品、生活用品、药物、材料、特殊物品、天赋技能、职业技能共九个大类。

点开所有版块，通扫了一遍发现，一个贡献点竟然只能买材料，不但份额极少，还是矿物、石头、沙子之类。

非常值得注意的一点是，食品和食材都非常贵，竟然就没有一个贡献点能买到的食物！

商非凡最终什么都没买，关上商城页面，找到地图探索项目，选择始终打开。

瞬间，他目力所及范围的地形化成简易标准地图出现在他脑海中。

地图还很亲切地标上了东西南北和坐标。

目前地图用处不大，但全息游戏的乐趣之一不就是探索未知吗？

风很冷，草枯黄。

这片草原显然已经进入秋末。

商非凡以前因为工作需要在北方草原上待过一段时间，那里秋季特别短，当你发现周围野草开始枯黄，也许一觉醒来气温就会狂降二三十度，隔天就会下大雪。

新手村……那个莫约山谷距离这里应该不会太远。

伏向军跟他说的那个天残谷新手村大概只是新手村之一，谁规定游戏内测时只能使用一个新手村？

也许他这批新玩家就被分配到了不同的新手村中。

商非凡望向西北方，那里是距离这里最近的山脉，能清楚看到山体，其他方向的山脉都要遥远得多。

莫约山谷，既然是山谷，肯定要有山。

再，按照死者的出血程度，他受伤的地方距离这里不会超过一个小时的路程。

综合以上理由，商非凡提着骨杖，迈步向西北方走去。

值得庆幸的是，也许这片原野靠近人类聚集地，一路上商非凡都没有碰见特别难对付的中大型野兽。

走着走着，他就看到了明显被人和车辆踩踏出来的熟路。

作者有话说：

商非凡：一本正经玩游戏中
chunks.englishText:
For instance, his current clothes were torn and smeared with blood. In an ordinary game, changing out of them wouldn't matter much, but under a nearly one-hundred-percent realistic sensory experience, who wouldn't want to swap into a cleaner, more comfortable, better-looking, and more useful set of attire?

At least, if Shang Feifan had the choice—and if microtransactions were enabled right now—he would willingly pay out of pocket for a set of well-fitting, clean new clothes, pants, and shoes.

The sensation of hunger was deeply uncomfortable. His energy bar was dropping rapidly, having plummeted from a full 100 points down to 67. His HP, however, remained full.

Shang Feifan quickly opened the in-game shop interface, finding it divided into nine main sub-categories: Equipment, Weapons, Food, Daily Supplies, Medicine, Materials, Special Items, Talent Skills, and Class Skills.

Browsing through all the categories, a thorough scan revealed that a single contribution point could only purchase basic materials—and in meager quantities at that, consisting mostly of minerals, stones, sand, and similar raw elements.

Crucially, food and ingredients were exceedingly expensive; there wasn't a single food item available for just one contribution point!

In the end, Shang Feifan bought nothing. He closed the shop interface, opened the map exploration feature, and set it to remain active at all times.

Instantly, the terrain within his line of sight was converted into a simplified standard map that projected directly into his mind.

The map even thoughtfully marked cardinal directions—North, South, East, and West—along with precise coordinates.

For now, the map wasn't of much use, but wasn't exploring the unknown one of the core joys of a full-immersion game?

The wind blew cold, and the grass was yellow and withered.

This expanse of grassland had clearly entered late autumn.

Having spent time working on the northern steppes in the real world, Shang Feifan knew autumn there was exceptionally brief. The moment you noticed the surrounding wild grass turning yellow, you might wake up the next morning to a temperature drop of twenty to thirty degrees, followed by heavy snowfall the very next day.

The novice village... that place called Moyue Valley shouldn't be too far from here.

Tiancan Valley, which Fu Xiangjun had mentioned as a novice village, was likely just one among many. Who said a game closed beta could only utilize a single starting location?

Perhaps his batch of new players had been distributed across different beginner villages.

Shang Feifan looked toward the northwest. That was the nearest mountain range, its outlines clearly visible, whereas the mountains in other directions were far more distant.

Moyue Valley—since it was a valley, there had to be mountains.

Furthermore, judging by the deceased man's blood loss, the site where he sustained his injuries was no more than an hour's walk from here.

Combining these reasons, Shang Feifan grabbed his bone staff and set off toward the northwest.

Fortunately, perhaps because this stretch of wilderness lay close to a human settlement, Shang Feifan encountered no particularly formidable medium or large wild beasts along the way.

As he walked, a well-beaten dirt road—clearly trampled by travelers and carts—gradually came into view.

**Author's Note:**
*Shang Feifan: Playing the game with utmost seriousness.*

chunks.chineseText:
第3章 报案

天近黄昏，莫约山谷位于北边的谷口出现一名旅人。

旅人身材高大，身穿染血的皮甲，手里还握着一根骨杖。

旅人步伐很稳，有着一张让人印象深刻的面孔，气质稳重大气，染血的皮甲让他更像是从战场归来的勇士，而不是争强斗胜、以抢劫为生的游民。

正在谷口酒馆门口搓绳子的老年兽人抬头，浑浊的眼睛扫过旅人全身，友好地对旅人点了点头。

商非凡手指点到太阳穴位置，做了个摘帽的动作，头微点，回礼。

三辆挂着大大车厢的兽车从旅人身边擦过，停在酒馆门口。

“老莫头，好久不见，今天的推荐晚餐是什么？”领头的兽车上跳下来一名长耳粗尾兽人。

老年兽人放下绳子：“是你们啊，老样子，还是煮鼠兔肉。今年你们来的是不是比往年要稍迟一点？”

“又是鼠兔肉？”第二辆兽车上的长耳兽人一脸吃腻的表情。

“老莫头你的记忆真好。没错，今年我们村秋收比较迟，也就迟了十来天才出发。”领头的长耳兽人示意同伴把兽车停到老莫头指定的位置上。

老莫头皱眉：“秋收迟了？那收获怎么样？今年你们的粮食不会涨价吧？”

领头长耳兽人叹了口气，“我们也不想涨价，但今年雨水太少，收成大不如往年。如果你们镇不能吃下我们的粮食，我们就只能去下一个镇子看看。该死的虫族诅咒！”

“该死的虫族诅咒！”老莫头朝地上重重吐了口口水，站起身：“你们先去吃饭休息。我去找镇长，让他亲自和你们谈。”

长耳兽人点头，他们也想就在莫约山谷把带来的三车粮食卖掉，早落袋早安心。

商非凡停下脚步，看向酒馆招牌。

酒馆就叫莫约山谷酒馆，招牌上还有一个大大的带把酒杯。

领头的长耳兽人警惕地打量旅人。

虽然很少有兽人会在镇子中抢劫，但不怕一万就怕万一。

长耳兽人更担心这个独行兽人只是踩盘子的，进镇只是打探情况，一旦摸清楚商人的货物和出发时间，就会和同伴在镇子外埋伏他们。

尤其这名兽人的皮甲上全是血迹，也不知道是来自野外野兽虫鸟，还是和人争斗所致。

商非凡感觉到几个长耳兽人的暗中打量，没管。

他正在惊叹这个兽人世界似乎与他想象的有点不一样。

他以为兽人世界会更原始，实际上游戏商少数流出到论坛上的天残谷新手村画面也偏原始风。

可他现在看到的镇子也许很古老，但和原始还是有一段距离的。

镇子外面的道路还只是人与兽车自然踩踏出来的土道，但进入镇子后就能看到用石砖铺成的整齐道路。

镇子上的房屋也大多都用石头建造，造型古朴，用料扎实，看着就很坚固。

作为文明的象征之一，这里的房屋顶用的也是类似瓦片的石片。

再看那几名长耳兽人驾驶的兽车，拉车的兽模样很像是原始牛种，这且不说，重点是那三辆像是用金属做出来的车辆，无论车轮还是车轴，做的都很有技术含量。

这个世界显然已经发现金属的冶炼方法，布、皮、石、骨、金属，只是他们的用材之一。

总体而言，这镇子的风格和发展水准都很像是西洲中古世纪，单论文明程度也许还超过一些。

“日安，这位先生。您看起来很面生，是这附近的人吗？”领头的长耳兽人试探着和商非凡打招呼。

“日安，我来这里报案。”

“报案？”

听说商非凡要报案，来卖粮食的长耳兽人特别热情地主动带他进入酒馆，找到酒馆老板。

酒馆老板又吩咐自家儿子去找治安官报信。

商非凡就留在酒馆点了酒馆老板大力推荐的煮鼠兔肉，外加一碗不知道是什么蔬菜熬制出来的浓汤，和一大块坚硬的麦饼，还有一大杯麦酒。

在点餐端上来之前，商非凡习惯地打量酒馆环境和里面的客人，包括老板一家。

可能到了该用晚餐的时间，酒馆里人不算少，几乎每个人的桌上、手上都有麦酒。

有人在打量他，但更多人只是扫过他就继续和朋友交谈喝酒。

这里应该不是一个很偏僻以及闭塞的小镇，这里的人已经习惯外来者。商非凡心想。

商非凡目光落到了酒馆最角落的位置，那里坐着一个单独的客人。

看外貌，很年轻，最多不会超过二十岁，脸颊有着这个年纪年轻人特有的青涩。

对方也点了一杯麦酒，但更像是做个样子，桌上摆放着一本皮质笔记本，年轻的兽人正在笔记本上书写着什么。

商非凡也不知道自己为什么会被这个年轻兽人吸引，他就是忍不住盯着对方看。

年轻兽人大约是感觉到这股难以忽视的视线，抬起头，目光正好与商非凡相对。

平静，甚至称得上古井不波的目光，就像是经历过很多，又像是经年在寺庙修行的老年僧人。

商非凡对年轻兽人举杯示意。

年轻兽人也举起酒杯，但只是在嘴唇边碰了碰，就放回桌子上。

商非凡喝了口麦酒，心想这应该是个有故事的人。

除了这个年轻兽人，还有那来卖粮食的长耳兽人们，其他客人都像是本地人。

有好几个客人都认识长耳兽人，询问他们今年粮价如何。

长耳兽人可能怕惹起众怒，回答得含含糊糊，只说他们村受灾严重。

只从这句话，客人们也听出今年粮价不会便宜，一个个都在咒骂，但不是骂长耳兽人，而是每个人都会骂一句“这该死的虫族诅咒”。

酒馆老板娘也是店里的服务员，端着大盘子把商非凡的点餐送上。

“镇上有医生，他那里有自己制作、效果很好的伤药，我们镇生病受伤都会找他。”老板娘放下餐盘上的食物说道。

商非凡抬手轻轻按了按皮甲胸前被利刃戳出来的破口：“谢谢，这不是我的衣服。”

老板娘并不太惊讶地：“哦，变身时没来得及脱衣服是吧。你的行李呢？”

“丢了。遇到一点事。”

“和你要报的案子有关？”

商非凡摇摇头，“那是另外一个故事。”

“好吧，你们这些人总是喜欢遮遮掩掩。你看起来像是从大城市来的。”老板娘抱着餐盘站在一边没走。

商非凡看出老板娘的打算，顺着她的意思回答：“我从黑森林城过来办点事。”

“你是税务官吗？”

商非凡摇头。

“征兵官？”

“当然不是。”

老板娘笑了，“那么我们莫约山谷镇欢迎你。一杯麦酒算本店请客，饭钱还是要付的，一百二十达铢。”

“谢了。”商非凡解下钱袋，从里面找出一百面值和十面值的铜达铢硬币，递给老板娘。

鼠兔肉滋味一言难尽，蔬菜浓汤意外地比较好喝，而那块坚硬得可以用来给兽人拔牙的麦饼必须泡到浓汤里面食用。

为了保持体力，商非凡没有半点浪费，吃一口汤泡饼，再吃一口鼠兔肉。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 3: Reporting a Crime

As dusk approached, a traveler appeared at the northern entrance of Moyue Valley.

The traveler was tall, clad in blood-stained leather armor, and held a bone staff in his hand.

He walked with a steady stride, possessing a memorable face and a calm, dignified demeanor. The blood-drenched leather armor made him resemble a warrior returning from a battlefield rather than a roaming brigand living off plunder and violence.

An elderly beastman twisting rope outside the valley entrance tavern raised his head. His cloudy eyes swept over the traveler, and he gave a friendly nod.

Shang Feifan raised two fingers to his temple in a gesture mimicking the tip of a hat, nodding slightly in return.

Three beast-drawn wagons with large wooden cabins brushed past the traveler, pulling up in front of the tavern.

"Old Mo, long time no see! What's today's dinner special?" A beastman with long ears and a thick tail leaped down from the leading wagon.

The elderly beastman laid down his rope. "Ah, it's you lot. Same as usual—stewed pika meat. Aren't you arriving a bit later than previous years?"

"Pika meat again?" The long-eared beastman on the second wagon pulled a face of sheer boredom.

"Your memory is as sharp as ever, Old Mo. That's right—our village's autumn harvest was delayed this year, so we set out about ten days late," the lead long-eared beastman replied, gesturing for his companions to park the wagons in the spot Old Mo indicated.

Old Mo frowned. "A delayed harvest? How are the yields? You aren't raising your grain prices this year, are you?"

The lead beastman sighed. "We don't want to raise prices either, but there was too little rain this year. The yield is far worse than previous years. If your town can't take all our grain, we'll have to try the next town over. Curse this damn Insectoid Curse!"

"Curse this damn Insectoid Curse!" Old Mo spat heavily onto the ground, then stood up. "Go inside, eat, and rest first. I'll fetch the town mayor so he can negotiate with you personally."

The long-eared beastman nodded. They, too, hoped to sell off their three wagonloads of grain right here in Moyue Valley—cashing out early meant peace of mind.

Shang Feifan paused, casting a glance at the tavern sign.

It was named simply *Moyue Valley Tavern*, featuring a large icon of a handle-fitted ale tankard on its sign.

The lead long-eared beastman appraised the traveler with a wary gaze.

Although beastmen rarely committed robbery inside town limits, one could never be too careful.

The long-eared beastman worried this lone traveler was merely a scout scouting the area. Once he mapped out the merchants' cargo and departure time, he might regroup with companions outside town to lay an ambush.

Especially since the man's leather armor was drenched in blood—there was no telling whether it came from wild beasts and monsters in the wilderness, or from a violent clash with other travelers.

Shang Feifan felt the secretive gazes of the long-eared beastmen but paid them no mind.

He was currently marveling at how this beastman world seemed somewhat different from what he had imagined.

He had assumed the beastman world would be far more primitive; in fact, the few screenshots of Tiancan Valley released on the game forums by developers had leaned heavily toward a primitive aesthetic.

Yet the town before him, while ancient, was a far cry from primitive.

Though the paths outside town were merely dirt roads formed by human foot traffic and beast-drawn carts, the moment one stepped into the town proper, neat roads paved with stone bricks met the eye.

Most of the buildings in town were constructed from stone, boasting an archaic design, solid materials, and a remarkably sturdy appearance.

As a symbol of civilization, the roofs were covered in stone tiles similar to clay roof tiles.

Looking at the wagons driven by the long-eared beastmen, the draught beasts pulling them closely resembled an ancient breed of wild cattle. That aside, the key detail was that the three wagons appeared to be constructed with metal components—both the wheels and axles demonstrated impressive technical craftsmanship.

This world had clearly discovered metal smelting; cloth, leather, stone, bone, and metal were all among their utilized materials.

Overall, the town's style and level of development strongly resembled Western medieval times, perhaps even surpassing it in terms of civilization.

"Good day, sir. You look unfamiliar—are you from around here?" the lead long-eared beastman offered a tentative greeting.

"Good day. I am here to report a crime."

"Report a crime?"

Upon hearing that Shang Feifan was here to report a crime, the grain-selling beastman warmly escorted him inside the tavern to find the owner.

The tavern owner then instructed his son to inform the constable.

Shang Feifan remained in the tavern and ordered the owner's highly recommended stewed pika meat, alongside a bowl of thick vegetable soup made from an unknown plant, a large chunk of rock-hard wheat bread, and a massive mug of ale.

Before his order was served, Shang Feifan habitually surveyed the tavern environment and its patrons, including the owner's family.

As it was dinner time, the tavern was fairly crowded. Almost everyone had a mug of ale on their table or in hand.

A few glanced at him, but most merely swept their eyes over him before resuming their drinks and chatter with friends.

*This doesn't seem like an isolated or closed-off town; the people here are accustomed to outsiders,* Shang Feifan thought.

Shang Feifan's gaze settled on the farthest corner of the tavern, where a lone patron sat.

Judging by his appearance, he was very young—at most under twenty years old—with the subtle greenness typical of youth still clinging to his features.

The young man had also ordered a mug of ale, though it seemed more like a prop. On the table lay a leather-bound notebook, in which the young beastman was writing.

Shang Feifan didn't know why he was drawn to this young beastman, but he couldn't help staring.

Sensing the unignorable gaze, the young beastman raised his head, his eyes meeting Shang Feifan's.

It was a calm, almost placid look—reminiscent of someone who had seen much, or an elderly monk who had meditated in a temple for decades.

Shang Feifan raised his mug toward the young beastman in a toast.

The young beastman lifted his own mug in response, but merely let it touch his lips before setting it back down.

Taking a sip of ale, Shang Feifan thought to himself that this was likely a person with a story to tell.

Apart from this young beastman and the grain-selling travelers, the other patrons appeared to be locals.

Several patrons recognized the long-eared beastmen and inquired about this year's grain prices.

Fearing public outcry, the long-eared beastman answered vaguely, merely stating that their village had suffered severe crop damage.

From that sentence alone, the patrons deduced that grain prices would not be cheap this year. One after another, they began cursing—not at the long-eared beastman, but each muttering the same phrase: "That damn Insectoid Curse!"

The tavern owner's wife, who also served as the waitress, brought over Shang Feifan's order on a large tray.

"We have a doctor in town," she said as she set down the food. "He crafts his own medicine, and it's very effective. Whenever anyone in town gets sick or injured, we go to him."

Shang Feifan raised his hand to gently press against the puncture hole in the chest of his leather armor. "Thank you, but these aren't my clothes."

The owner's wife didn't look overly surprised. "Ah, didn't have time to take off your clothes before shapeshifting, huh? Where's your luggage?"

"Lost. I ran into some trouble."

"Does it have to do with the crime you're reporting?"

Shang Feifan shook his head. "That's another story."

"Fair enough. You lot always love being tight-lipped. You look like you came from a big city." The owner's wife stood beside the table holding her tray, making no move to leave.

Shang Feifan saw through her intentions and played along: "I came from Black Forest City to take care of some matters."

"Are you a tax collector?"

Shang Feifan shook his head.

"A recruitment officer?"

"Of course not."

The owner's wife smiled. "Well then, welcome to Moyue Valley Town. The mug of ale is on the house, but you still have to pay for the meal—one hundred and twenty Dazhun."

"Thanks." Shang Feifan unfastened his coin purse, picked out a hundred-denomination copper Dazhun coin and two ten-denomination ones, and handed them to her.

The stewed pika meat tasted... complicated. The thick vegetable soup was surprisingly delicious, while the rock-hard wheat bread—tough enough to pull a beastman's tooth out—had to be soaked in the soup to be edible.

To maintain his stamina, Shang Feifan wasted nothing, alternating between a bite of soup-soaked bread and a piece of pika meat.

chunks.chineseText:
麦酒酒味很淡，完全可以当水喝。

“你就是说要报案的旅人？”

商非凡转头，看到了一名身体强壮、拥有长三角形尖直耳朵、脸上有天生兽纹的兽人。

该兽人大约三十岁到四十岁之间，胸前戴着一枚非常显眼的徽章，腰间插着一把长刀，目光锐利。

“这是我们镇治安官安德烈，你有什么事都可以跟他说。”酒馆老板跟商非凡介绍。又对治安官介绍商非凡：“对，他就是说要报案的旅人。”

“诺曼霍希尔，来自黑森林城。”商非凡伸出手。

治安官安德烈目光怪异地看向他那只手。

“不用在意，我只是想要告诉你，我手上没有武器。”商非凡非常自然地收回手。

“我们这里并不禁止携带武器，只要你不主动伤人。你说的死者在哪里？把你看到的情况详细说一说。”治安官安德烈在商非凡对面坐下。

商非凡刚描述了死者外貌。

刚刚坐下的治安官竟然脸色丕变，腾地站起：“你说的死者是虫人？！该死的，你为什么不早说？”

商非凡心里一堆问号，嘴上却说：“所以我一来就报案了。”

“你应该直接把他的尸体就地烧毁，或者留给野兽吞噬也可以，而不是把他埋起来！”

“保留尸体可以留下更多线索。因为途中遇到野兽攻击，我失去了行李。遇到死者时，我答应他会为他查明死因，以换取他身上的衣物和皮靴。”

治安官面色略微缓和了一些。如果死者不是虫人的话，这个诺曼霍希尔的行为会获得任何一名兽人的赞赏。

在一边偷听的酒馆老板儿子插嘴：“你为什么不把死者的尸体带回镇子？”

同样在竖耳偷听的酒馆老板一拍儿子脑袋：“别犯蠢了！这位客人都说死者的死亡地点距离镇子有一个小时的行程。虽然镇子外面的野兽不算多，但带着一具新鲜尸体步行穿过荒野，这不是在明摆着让野兽来吃大餐吗？”

酒馆老板儿子一吐舌头，被老板娘叫到一边帮忙。

治安官安德烈看向外面天色，皱眉：“天快黑了。我们得尽快把那具尸体挖出来处理掉，绝对不能让那具尸体在大地里过夜。”

商非凡实在好奇：“为什么不能在大地里过夜？”

治安官再次流出怪异神色：“我知道黑森林城，那确实是一座大城市。那里距离我们这里也很遥远，但你们那里难道没有类似的说法吗？”

商非凡：什么说法？

酒馆老板在一边好心说明：“我们这儿有个铁规矩，就是绝不能让虫人的尸体埋进大地里，否则会留下诅咒。”

治安官面向整个酒馆，提高声音：“诸位，有个虫人死在了镇外荒野，还被埋进了大地里。我需要四名志愿民兵跟我一起去荒野挖掘尸体并处理。现在，愿意跟我一起去荒野的人请站出来！”

“什么？竟然有虫人死在荒野，还被人埋了？那人是蠢货吗？”

“我看是故意想要祸害我们镇子！”

“是不是跟那个报案人有关？”

“你傻了，如果对方想要害我们镇子，他有必要特地来跟我们说这件事吗？”

酒馆内的兽人们议论纷纷。

治安官不得不又询问了一遍谁愿意跟他一起去荒野。

商非凡以为大家都不愿意在晚上跑出去冒险，结果看到一堆兽人刷刷站起来。

“要不了那么多人，六个人足够了。”治安官点了四个人名字。

被点到名字的四个兽人一脸骄傲地越众而出。

“诺曼霍希尔是吧？要麻烦你给我们带路了。”治安官看向商非凡。

商非凡喝掉最后一口麦酒，放下酒杯，站起：“走吧。”

作者有话说：

商非凡：见面不识
chunks.englishText:
The ale was mild, weak enough to be drunk like water.

"Are you the traveler who wants to report a crime?"

Shang Feifan turned his head to see a powerfully built beastman with long, sharply triangular straight ears and natural beast markings on his face.

The beastman appeared to be between thirty and forty years old. A prominent badge was pinned to his chest, a long blade was sheathed at his waist, and his eyes were sharp.

"This is our town's constable, Andre. You can tell him whatever you need," the tavern owner introduced to Shang Feifan. He then turned to the constable: "Yes, he's the traveler who said he wanted to report a crime."

"Norman Horshill, from Black Forest City," Shang Feifan said, extending a hand.

Constable Andre looked at the extended hand with a peculiar expression.

"Don't mind it. I just wanted to show you that my hands are unarmed," Shang Feifan said, retracting his hand naturally.

"Carrying weapons isn't prohibited here, so long as you don't initiate an attack," Constable Andre said, taking a seat opposite Shang Feifan. "Where is the deceased? Describe what you saw in detail."

Shang Feifan had only just finished describing the deceased's appearance.

The constable, who had just sat down, suddenly underwent a dramatic change of expression. He burst to his feet. "The deceased you're talking about is a Bug-man?! Damn it, why didn't you say so earlier?!"

A flood of questions filled Shang Feifan's mind, but he maintained a calm front: "That's why I came straight to report it upon my arrival."

"You should have burned his corpse on the spot! Or left it for wild beasts to devour! Anything but burying him!"

"Preserving the body leaves behind more clues. Because I was attacked by wild beasts on the way, I lost my luggage. When I found the deceased, I promised him I would investigate his cause of death in exchange for his clothes and leather boots."

The constable's expression softened slightly. If the deceased hadn't been a Bug-man, Norman Horshill's actions would have earned the praise of any beastman.

Eavesdropping nearby, the tavern owner's son chimed in, "Why didn't you bring the corpse back to town?"

The tavern owner, who was also listening intently, smacked his son on the head. "Don't be stupid! The guest already said the death site was an hour's journey from town. Even if beasts are scarce outside town, walking through the wilderness carrying a fresh corpse—isn't that practically begging wild beasts to come feast?"

The owner's son stuck out his tongue and was called away by the owner's wife to help.

Constable Andre looked out at the darkening sky, his brow furrowed. "Night is falling fast. We must dig up that corpse and process it immediately. We absolutely cannot let that body spend the night buried in the earth!"

Shang Feifan was genuinely curious. "Why can't it spend the night in the earth?"

The constable gave him that strange look once more. "I know Black Forest City—it's indeed a metropolis, far from our lands. But don't you have similar sayings over there?"

Shang Feifan thought: *What sayings?*

The tavern owner kindly explained from the side: "We have an ironclad rule here: a Bug-man's corpse must never be buried in the earth, or it will leave behind a curse."

Constable Andre turned to face the entire tavern, raising his voice: "Everyone! A Bug-man has died in the wilderness outside town, and someone buried his body in the earth! I need four volunteer militia to come with me to the wilderness, dig up the corpse, and dispose of it. Now, who is willing to step forward?"

"What? A Bug-man died in the wild and got buried? Is that guy an idiot?"

"Sounds to me like someone intentionally trying to bring ruin upon our town!"

"Does it have anything to do with that guy who reported it?"

"Are you stupid? If he wanted to harm our town, why would he come out of his way to tell us about it?"

The beastmen in the tavern erupted into clamorous discussion.

The constable had to ask a second time who was willing to head out into the wilderness with him.

Shang Feifan had assumed no one would want to take the risk of venturing outside at night, but to his surprise, a crowd of beastmen stood up in unison.

"We don't need that many—six people total is enough," the constable said, selecting four names.

The four beastmen whose names were called stepped forward proudly from the crowd.

"Norman Horshill, was it? We'll have to trouble you to lead the way," the constable said, looking at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan finished the last gulp of his ale, set down the mug, and stood up. "Let's go."

**Author's Note:**
*Shang Feifan: Meeting without knowing who's who.*

第4章 你想睡他？

就在刚刚，商非凡收到了新的任务要求。

【任务六：你收到治安官安德烈的请求，为其带路寻找死者掩埋地点。奖励贡献点1点。】

治安官不仅要求大家带上武器和铁锹，还带上了一个罐子。

六名兽人提着油灯在荒野中快速穿行，

跟来的兽人们夜间视力都不错，并对镇子附近荒野地形十分熟悉，行走速度都很快。

商非凡按照游戏地图提示，很容易就找到了他掩埋死者的地点。

治安官安德烈赞：“你记忆真好。”

一路过来，除了小心荒野中的野兽，商非凡几乎都没怎么停顿，还避开了几个藏在草丛中的坑洞。

跟来的兽人也都对商非凡表示赞赏，识路和记路更快的兽人总是更受欢迎，这不但代表出外狩猎会有更大收获，也是提升求生率的要素之一。

“我的工作让我需要经常外出，记路是我的必备技能。”他有游戏地图作弊，还不如承认他有这方面的能力。

治安官点点头，环视众人一圈：“开始挖吧。”

并不是所有兽人都参与挖掘，两名兽人手提油灯、握着武器背对大家，分两个方向面向荒野，他们将负责警戒。

四个兽人带着铁铲一同挖掘，很快就把死者尸体给挖了出来。

“就是他吗？”治安官与商非凡确认。

商非凡看向尸体。

有点怪异，如果他记忆没有出错，死者的外表似乎产生了一些变化，他身上的虫族特征更加明显了一些。

但从面貌看，这确实就是他之前埋下去的尸体。

这不禁让商非凡生出，想要看看尸体埋上一夜后会变成什么样的好奇心。

“就是他。”

叮咚。任务六完成，1点贡献点到手。

“尸体不能带回去，就地焚烧。”治安官这句话是看着商非凡说的。

【任务七：你收到治安官安德烈的请求，请帮忙一起处理死者尸体。奖励贡献点1点。】

商非凡当然表示同意。

治安官抬头看天：“今晚会下雨，大家速度快点。”

兽人们在四周散开，两两同行，捡拾干草和枯萎的灌木枝子，投掷到他们挖出的坑洞中，浇上灯油。

治安官带着商非凡一起清理尸坑周围的野草，弄出一个小小的隔离带。

尸体重新被放回坑中。

治安官亲自在尸体上浇了灯油。

轰！火焰爆燃。

怎么会突然爆出这么大的火焰？

技能？

商非凡暗中观察几名兽人，猜测让火势变大的技能是谁发出。

看来看去，他怀疑是治安官。

因为治安官就是点火者，其他四名兽人只是看着。

也许有技能加成的作用，本应该焚烧很久的尸体很快就烧成了一块块碎骨。

商非凡现在才知道治安官为什么还特地带了个罐子过来，用来收敛死者骨灰。

当大家带着骨灰罐回到镇中时，天空果然下起了淅淅沥沥的小雨。

跟来的兽人民兵们像是完成了什么大事一样，一个个高高兴兴地扛着武器和铁锹，各自归家。

“你说要调查死者的死因？”酒馆门口，治安官转头询问商非凡。

商非凡：“我承诺过。”

治安官神情严肃：“明天上午你来治安亭找我，不要自己随便调查。”

商非凡：“你们不认识死者吗？没有见过他？”

挖掘出尸体时，他特意观察过治安官和跟来的兽人民兵的表情，他们都像是不认识死者。

可根据死者留下的那封信，他明明来过莫约山谷镇，还在这里购买了一把带骨剑的骨杖。

治安官摇头：“没有，他的面容很陌生。我们镇子不算大，如果有陌生人过来，尤其是有虫人混血儿过来，我们一定会记住。”

商非凡：“这里会排斥具有虫人特征的兽人吗？”

英俊的治安官目光不善：“你想我说什么？我们这里是个小地方，我们是有自己的一些规矩，但我们并不迷信。”

“但这片地界确实不喜欢有虫人特征的兽人，对么？”

治安官反应很快：“你是想说死者来过我们镇，但他做了伪装，所以我们才没有认出他？”

商非凡摊手。

治安官若有所思：“你说的这个……可能性也有。”

治安官思考片刻，看商非凡：“现在天晚了，你也忙碌到现在，有什么事明天再说。如果你担心凶手得知消息，之前我们在酒馆说要找人挖尸体，凶手如果还在镇上，他肯定已经知道情况。但晚上没有人敢随便离开镇子，我会让人留意明天一大早想要离开镇子的人。”

商非凡：“如果是镇子里的人呢？”

治安官发出一声轻嗤：“我知道你想说什么。我们镇子偏远归偏远，但我们有我们的行事准则。”

治安官顿了顿：“我们不会包庇任何一名凶手，不管他是谁。”

莫约山谷酒馆也是镇上唯一的旅馆。

商非凡在酒馆老板儿子的介绍下，选了一间最边上的客房。

酒馆客房通通不带卫浴间，卫浴设施就在楼道两端，酒馆老板一家打扫得很勤快，哪怕就在卫浴间对面的客房也没有很明显的味道，一晚五十铜达铢。

刚打开客房门，商非凡就看到他隔壁的隔壁邻居打开门从房间里走出。

年轻兽人端着一个盆，盆里摆着换洗衣物和洗漱用具。

“你好。”商非凡不知道这里晚上要怎么打招呼，就对年轻兽人笑了笑。

年轻兽人对商非凡轻轻点头，快步走向对面卫浴间，推开门走了进去。

“那是镇长的侄子。”酒馆老板儿子小安东悄声说道。

商非凡也压低声音：“镇长侄子怎么不住在镇长家里？”

小安东靠近商非凡，指着自己的脑袋，用更小的声音说：“因为我们的镇长夫人这里有病，镇长把他的儿女都送到他父母家里了，自然也不可能留下自己的侄子。”

“他叫什么名字？”

“你怀疑他是凶手吗？”小安东人小鬼大地问。

商非凡低笑，揉了揉小家伙的脑袋：“别胡扯。我就是随便问问。”

“那你想睡他？”

“喂！”

小安东嘿嘿笑：“别掩饰了，这在我们兽人中很常见，好多人娶不到老婆，就只好找同性兽人。尤其是你们虎族，我们都知道母老虎特别凶！”

商非凡啼笑皆非：“我没那个意思，我就是觉得他的气质很特殊，不像是……”

“不像是普通兽人对吧？我爸爸说他身份很高贵。”小安东还不太理解高贵的含义，就是觉得这个词很炫。

“高贵又卑贱的可怜私生子。”小安东学他妈妈的口吻，还叹了口气。

商非凡：“……你知道的真多。”

小安东得意：“那是当然，镇上没有人比我知道得更多。你不是想要调查凶手吗？我可以帮你。一天只要五十铜达铢。”

商非凡看着顶多十岁的小不点，赛给他一枚十达铢的铜币，给小孩转了个方向：“我要休息了，你也早点睡吧，小心想太多长不高。”

小安东回头，对商非凡扮了个鬼脸。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 4: Do You Want to Sleep with Him? (Part 1)

Just moments ago, Shang Feifan had received a new mission prompt.

[Mission 6: You have received a request from Sheriff Andre to guide him in finding the burial site of the deceased. Reward: 1 Contribution Point.]

The sheriff had instructed everyone to bring weapons and shovels, along with an empty jar.

Six beastmen carrying oil lamps moved swiftly through the wilderness.

The beastmen who tagged along all possessed decent night vision and were thoroughly familiar with the wilderness terrain near the town, allowing them to travel at a brisk pace.

Following the prompts on his in-game map, Shang Feifan easily located the spot where he had buried the dead man.

Sheriff Andre praised him, "Your memory is truly exceptional."

Along the way, aside from keeping a wary eye out for beasts in the wilderness, Shang Feifan had hardly paused, even deftly navigating around several hidden pits concealed in the tall grass.

The accompanying beastmen also expressed their admiration for Shang Feifan. A beastman who could recognize and remember paths quickly was always more popular; this not only meant a greater haul during hunting expeditions, but it was also one of the key factors in increasing survival rates.

"My work requires me to go out frequently, so remembering paths is an essential skill for me," he said. With the in-game map acting as a cheat, he might as well just admit to having this ability.

The sheriff nodded, sweeping his gaze across the group. "Start digging."

Not all the beastmen participated in the excavation. Two beastmen holding oil lamps and gripping weapons stood back-to-back with the others, facing outward in opposite directions toward the wilderness to serve as lookouts.

Four beastmen set to work together with shovels, quickly unearthing the corpse.

"Is this him?" the sheriff asked, confirming with Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan looked at the corpse.

It felt a bit strange. If his memory served him correctly, the deceased's appearance seemed to have undergone some changes, with the Zerg characteristics on his body appearing somewhat more pronounced.

Yet from his facial features, this was indeed the corpse he had buried earlier.

This naturally stirred up a bit of curiosity in Shang Feifan, making him wonder what a body would look like after being buried for a night.

"It's him."

*Ding-dong.* Mission 6 complete, and 1 Contribution Point secured.

"The body cannot be taken back. Burn it on the spot." The sheriff delivered this order while looking straight at Shang Feifan.

[Mission 7: You have received a request from Sheriff Andre to help dispose of the deceased's corpse. Reward: 1 Contribution Point.]

Naturally, Shang Feifan agreed.

The sheriff looked up at the sky. "It's going to rain tonight. Everyone, move quickly."

The beastmen dispersed in pairs, gathering dry grass and withered shrub branches, tossing them into the pit they had dug, and pouring lamp oil over the top.

The sheriff and Shang Feifan cleared away the wild grass around the burial pit, carving out a small firebreak.

The corpse was placed back into the pit.

The sheriff personally poured lamp oil over the body.

*Whoosh!* The flames erupted violently.

How could such a massive blaze burst out so suddenly?

A skill?

Shang Feifan secretly observed the several beastmen, trying to guess whose skill had caused the fire to flare up with such intensity.

After looking around, his suspicions fell upon the sheriff.

Because the sheriff was the one who lit the fire, while the other four beastmen merely stood by and watched.

Perhaps aided by some skill bonus, the corpse—which should have taken a long time to burn—was rapidly reduced to piles of fragmented bones.

Only now did Shang Feifan understand why the sheriff had deliberately brought along a jar: to collect the deceased's ashes.

By the time everyone returned to the town carrying the urn of ashes, a light, drizzling rain had indeed begun to fall from the sky.

The accompanying beastman militiamen, as though having accomplished some monumental task, cheerfully hoisted their weapons and shovels and headed off to their respective homes.

"You said you wanted to investigate the cause of death?" At the entrance of the tavern, the sheriff turned to question Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan replied, "I gave my word."

The sheriff's expression turned stern. "Come to the security post to find me tomorrow morning. Do not go investigating on your own whim."

Shang Feifan asked, "Don't you recognize the dead man? Have you never seen him before?"

When they were unearthing the corpse, he had deliberately observed the expressions of the sheriff and the accompanying beastman militiamen; they had all acted as though they didn't know the deceased.

Yet according to the letter left behind by the deceased, he had clearly visited Moyue Valley Town and even purchased a bone staff set with a bone sword here.

The sheriff shook his head. "No, his face is completely unfamiliar. Our town isn't large; if a stranger were to come by—especially a Zerg-blood mix—we would certainly remember."

Shang Feifan asked, "Does this place discriminate against beastmen with Zerg traits?"

The handsome sheriff's gaze turned unfriendly. "What are you trying to make me say? We are a small place here, and we have our own rules, but we aren't superstitious."

"But this region truly dislikes beastmen with Zerg traits, doesn't it?"

The sheriff was quick to react. "Are you trying to say the deceased came to our town, but he disguised himself, which is why we didn't recognize him?"

Shang Feifan spread his hands.

The sheriff fell into deep thought. "What you're saying... that possibility exists."

After pondering for a moment, the sheriff looked at Shang Feifan. "It's late now, and you've been busy until this hour. We'll discuss anything else tomorrow. If you're worried the killer might catch wind of this, well, we openly talked about finding people to dig up the corpse at the tavern earlier. If the killer is still in town, they certainly already know the situation. But no one dares to leave the town casually at night; I'll have people keep an eye on anyone wanting to leave the town early tomorrow morning."

Shang Feifan asked, "What if it's someone from within the town?"

The sheriff let out a soft scoff. "I know what you're trying to say. Remote as our town may be, we have our own code of conduct."

The sheriff paused. "We will not shield any killer, no matter who they are."

The Moyue Valley Tavern was also the only inn in town.

Under the guidance of the tavern owner's son, Shang Feifan chose a guest room right at the end of the hall.

The tavern's guest rooms did not come with attached bathrooms; the washroom facilities were located at both ends of the hallway. However, the tavern owner's family kept the place meticulously clean—even the guest room directly opposite the washroom had no noticeable odor. It cost fifty copper Dazhu per night.

Just as he unlocked his guest room door, Shang Feifan saw his neighbor two doors down open their door and step out into the hallway.

A young beastman was carrying a basin, which held a change of clothes and washing utensils.

"Hello." Shang Feifan wasn't sure how people greeted each other here at night, so he simply smiled at the young beastman.

The young beastman nodded slightly to Shang Feifan, hurried over to the opposite washroom, pushed open the door, and stepped inside.

"That's the mayor's nephew," Little Anton whispered softly.

Shang Feifan also lowered his voice. "Why doesn't the mayor's nephew live at the mayor's house?"

Little Anton leaned closer to Shang Feifan, pointed at his own head, and spoke in an even quieter whisper, "Because our mayor's wife has something wrong up here. The mayor sent all his children to live with their grandparents, so naturally he couldn't keep his nephew around either."

"What's his name?"

"Do you suspect he's the killer?" Little Anton asked with an air of precocious maturity.

Shang Feifan chuckled softly and ruffled the little fellow's hair. "Stop talking nonsense. I was just asking casually."

"Then do you want to sleep with him?"

"Hey!"

Little Anton giggled. "Don't try to hide it. That's very common among us beastmen. A lot of men can't find wives, so they have no choice but to find same-sex partners. Especially you tiger folk—we all know tigresses are extra fierce!"

Shang Feifan was caught between laughter and tears. "I didn't mean it like that. I just thought his temperament was quite unique, not quite like..."

"Not like an ordinary beastman, right? My dad says his status is very noble." Little Anton didn't quite understand the meaning of noble; he just thought it sounded like a very cool word.

"A noble yet lowly, pitiful illegitimate child." Little Anton parroted his mother's tone and even let out a sigh.

Shang Feifan: "...You really know a lot."

Little Anton looked pleased with himself. "Of course! No one in town knows more than I do. Don't you want to investigate the killer? I can help you. It's only fifty copper Dazhu a day."

Looking at the little tyke who was at most ten years old, Shang Feifan pressed a ten-Dazhu copper coin into his hand, turned the child around in the opposite direction, and said, "I need to rest. You should go to sleep early too; be careful not to stunt your growth by thinking too much."

Little Anton turned his head and made a funny face at Shang Feifan.

chunks.chineseText:
“他叫虎不帅。晚安，诺曼先生。”

“晚安，小安东先生。”

商非凡走进自己客房关上房门，还找了把椅子抵住门把手，穿着皮靴躺到床上选择下线。

现实世界。

“老大！你终于醒了！”

商非凡刚睁开眼睛就听到伏向军庆幸的大叫声。

商非凡摘掉头上的游戏头盔：“那么激动干什么？”

伏向军又气又急：“我怎么可能不激动？你知道我多担心你吗？这个破游戏肯定有问题，我怎么叫你都叫不醒，我就害怕你从此变成植物人。我原本想要给你断电、摘掉你的头盔，又害怕这样做会伤害你的大脑。我想叫医生，又怕医生变杀手。我想送你去医院，又怕外面有人盯梢。我还担心暗杀者朝我们发射火-箭筒，直接把这层楼给炸了……”

“所以你给我转移了地点？”

“用你设置的内部电梯，还有你挖掘的地下通道，我们现在在隔壁楼。感谢我的机智和你的风险预设吧，对方虽然没有发射火-箭筒，但投掷了炸-弹。一层楼都给炸没了！”

商非凡笑：“玩得还挺大。”

伏向军：“干他？”

商非凡：“我已经退役。不过……我是不是还没有给往日的某些合作商赠送离别礼物？”

伏向军笑起来：“我可以帮你快递。”

商非凡摇摇头：“礼物还是亲手送更有诚意。”

商非凡站起来走进厨房，拿了一瓶水拧开瓶盖一口气喝了半瓶。

伏向军跟到厨房，询问商非凡，为什么没有生在出生池。

商非凡就简单描述了他当时的情况，包括在游戏面板上线前不能下线。

“我要投诉这个破游戏！”伏向军气。

商非凡：“你忘了这只是内测？我们在申请获得游戏账号前，游戏商可是给我们发了长长的协议条款，我记得上面就有一条‘内测期间只保证玩家的生命安全和大脑安全，但不保证没有异常情况出现’。”

“那就这么算了？”伏向军郁闷。

“看游戏商后期能否解决这个bug吧。”

“那我们在这之前先不要上这个游戏了。”伏向军担心。

“这游戏挺有意思的，真的很像是穿越到另一个真实世界，那里的环境、还有NPC，完全不像是程序编写出来的。”商非凡有一点强迫症，那么多任务还没完成，答应的事情也没做到，他会难受。

伏向军打开冰箱，从里面拿出鸡蛋和牛排：“晚上吃炒鸡蛋和煎牛排？”

商非凡表示自己不挑。

“吃完就撤。这里也不安全。”伏向军更想要现在就走。

“嗯。”

伏向军一边搅拌鸡蛋，一边忍不住抱怨：“我说老大你也太心大了吧？明知有人要杀你，对方还派了暗杀者过来，你还能继续玩游戏？”

商非凡洗手给牛排做按摩：“不是有你在吗？你在新手村没看到我，肯定会联系我。如果联系不上，一定会过来查看。等你发现尸体，再发现我情况特殊，必然会在一边守着，直到我醒来，或者想办法把我安全带走。”

伏向军翻了个白眼：“我不可能永远跟着你，你已经申请退役，我的工作必然也会跟着调整。”

商非凡给牛排撒上作料：“你对自己日后事业有什么计划吗？”

伏向军：“你知道的，我原本是想……谁想到你会申请退役！”

商非凡：“累了。就是想要过过自己的生活。”

伏向军不信，并认定商非凡在密谋着什么。但他老大嘴巴太紧，他不想说的事情，谁都别想问出来。

商非凡：我就真的只是想要回归普通平凡但安全安定的生活而已。

作者有话说：

商非凡：这时我看他的目光是纯洁的。
chunks.englishText:
"His name is Hu Bushuai. Good night, Mr. Norman."

"Good night, Master Little Anton."

Shang Feifan walked into his guest room, closed the door, wedged a chair under the door handle for extra security, and lay down on the bed wearing his leather boots to log off.

Real World.

"Boss! You're finally awake!"

The moment Shang Feifan opened his eyes, he heard Fu Xiangjun's relieved shout.

Shang Feifan took off the gaming helmet from his head. "Why so excited?"

Fu Xiangjun was both exasperated and anxious. "How could I not be excited? Do you know how worried I was about you? There's definitely something wrong with this crappy game. No matter how much I called you, you wouldn't wake up. I was terrified you'd turn into a vegetable. I originally wanted to cut the power and pull off your helmet, but I was afraid doing so would damage your brain. I wanted to call a doctor, but I was afraid the doctor might turn out to be an assassin. I wanted to send you to the hospital, but I was afraid someone was watching us from outside. I was even worried an assassin would fire a rocket launcher at us and blow this entire floor straight to kingdom come..."

"So you relocated us?"

"Using the internal elevator you set up, plus the escape tunnel you dug, we're in the building next door now. Praise my quick thinking and your risk-assessment presets. Even though they didn't use a rocket launcher, they tossed a bomb. An entire floor got blown to smithereens!"

Shang Feifan smiled. "You guys really play for keeps."

Fu Xiangjun asked, "Take them out?"

Shang Feifan replied, "I've already retired. But... haven't I failed to send farewell gifts to certain former business partners?"

Fu Xiangjun grinned. "I can help you courier them."

Shang Feifan shook his head. "Gifts show more sincerity when delivered in person."

Shang Feifan got up, walked into the kitchen, picked up a bottle of water, unscrewed the cap, and drank half of it in one go.

Fu Xiangjun followed him into the kitchen, asking why Shang Feifan hadn't spawned at the birth pool.

Shang Feifan briefly described his situation at the time, including how logging out was prohibited before the game interface went live.

"I'm going to report this lousy game!" Fu Xiangjun fumed.

Shang Feifan reminded him, "Did you forget this is just a closed beta? Before we applied for our game accounts, the gaming company sent us a lengthy terms-of-service agreement. I remember one clause explicitly stated: 'During the closed beta, only the players' physical and neurological safety is guaranteed; abnormal occurrences are not guaranteed.'"

"So we're just going to let it go like this?" Fu Xiangjun was depressed.

"Let's see if the game developers can fix this bug later on."

"Then let's not play this game for a while before that happens," Fu Xiangjun worried aloud.

"This game is quite interesting. It really feels like being transported to another true-to-life world; the environment and the NPCs don't feel like they were written by code at all." Shang Feifan had a bit of obsessive-compulsive disorder. With so many uncompleted missions left and promises unkept, he would feel deeply unsettled.

Fu Xiangjun opened the refrigerator and pulled out eggs and steaks. "Scrambled eggs and pan-seared steak for dinner?"

Shang Feifan indicated he wasn't picky.

"We're pulling out as soon as we finish eating. It's not safe here anymore." Fu Xiangjun wanted to leave right this instant.

"Mhm."

As Fu Xiangjun beat the eggs, he couldn't help but grumble, "I must say, Boss, you are way too laid-back. Knowing someone wants you dead, and that they even sent an assassin after you, you're *still* able to keep playing games?"

Shang Feifan washed his hands and massaged seasonings into the steaks. "Aren't you here? If you didn't see me in the新手村 (novice village), you would've contacted me for sure. If you couldn't reach me, you definitely would've come to check. Once you found the body and realized my situation was abnormal, you'd naturally stand guard by my side until I woke up, or figure out a way to take me away safely."

Fu Xiangjun rolled his eyes. "I can't follow you around forever. You've already applied for retirement, and my work will inevitably change as a result."

Shang Feifan sprinkled spices over the steaks. "Do you have any plans for your future career?"

Fu Xiangjun replied, "You know what I originally wanted to do... Who could've guessed you'd apply for retirement!"

Shang Feifan answered, "I'm tired. I just want to live my own life."

Fu Xiangjun didn't believe him for a second, convinced that Shang Feifan was plotting something. But his boss's lips were sealed tight; when there was something he didn't want to say, nobody could pry it out of him.

Shang Feifan: *I really just want to return to an ordinary, peaceful, and safe life.*

Author's Notes:

Shang Feifan: *At this moment, my gaze toward him was utterly pure.*

chunks.chineseText:
第5章 虫子的呓语

游戏世界。

半夜，商非凡的客房里忽然响起呓语声，就像是有人在说梦话，又像是虫子在闷叫。

呓语声含糊不清，不断重复几个单词。

床上，商非凡的兽人身躯闭着眼睛，毫无所觉。

一只又一只灰色虫子从窗户缝隙里钻入房间，飞到虎兽人身上。

慢慢的，皮甲上凡是有血迹的地方全都被灰色虫子占满。

隔壁的隔壁，年轻兽人翻身坐起，竖起耳朵仔细听，随后穿上鞋子和外衣，打开房门。

走道里很安静。

今天留宿的客人只有来卖粮食的几个长耳兽人，以及他、和那个自称来自黑森林城的虎兽人。

年轻兽人悄步往前，贴到隔壁门扉上仔细听，觉得不是，又走到隔壁的隔壁。

“吱吱……滋滋……虫人骨灰……荒蓟草……蛋黄……”

年轻兽人不确定自己有没有听错，人经常会产生幻听，听到某些重复不断的声音时更容易产生像是某种词语的错觉。

年轻兽人把耳朵贴到门扉上，试图听得更清楚。

“吱吱……滋滋……骨灰……草……蛋黄……诅……”

他越想听得清楚却越听不清楚。

耳孔里有什么热的东西流出来，年轻兽人抬手一抹，他的耳朵流血了。

现实世界。

刚刚亲自给昔日某个合作商送去一份大礼的商非凡坐上破旧的白色面包车，随手抹掉脸上血迹，拿起游戏头盔戴上，这次他没有再用仪器监测自己的生理数据。

开车的伏向军从后视镜中看到这一幕，无奈地摇摇头，略微加快了车速。

他们得在中午十二点前赶到海湾码头，在那里乘坐货轮离开。

不远处的豪宅庄园火光冲天，本区的人都知道那座庄园属于谁，没有人敢过去查看情况。

这里也没有警察，只有那个庄园主统领的非法武装组织。

轰隆！轰隆！更大的爆炸接连响起，那是庄园里的军火库炸了。

远处山林里，上百名身穿战斗服、手持各种枪支的当地土著看着远处庄园大火，他们不少人身上还带着血迹和伤，但脸上都露出了快意的神情。

领头者非常可惜庄园里被焚烧掉的军火和财富，好在有人为这次行动赠送了他们一批武器弹药。

现在这个本地最大毒瘤终于去除，他们也许也可以建立起属于自己的正常秩序。

商非凡在游戏世界的客房里刚睁开眼睛，就觉得有点不对劲，猛地弹身坐起。

沙。

一堆灰色的虫尸落在地上和床单上。

商非凡低头看自己胸前，上面还粘着一些虫尸。

捏起一只虫尸仔细看。

虫子很小，有点像是螟虫。

就这么一堆虫尸，至少有几百只。

昨晚发生了什么？

为什么他下线后还有异常情况出现？

商非凡很好奇下线后他在游戏中的身体是怎样一个情况。

游戏论坛里有老玩家说除非把游戏身体送回出生点，否则放在哪里都不安全。之前就有老玩家在野外露营下线，等他重新上游戏，就被宣告已经死亡——他的游戏身体被野兽吃了。

老玩家们为此向游戏商抗议过。

游戏策划对此的回复是：随着地图扩展，以后会按照一定范围开安全区，担心自己下线后的身体出问题，可以选择在安全区下线。

现在前两批老玩家就在建造离开出生池后以后的第一个安全区。

而商非凡这批新玩家在新手村屡屡碰壁后也会被引到第一个安全区，开始搬砖挖矿建造房屋赚游戏币的苦力生涯。

伏向军说商非凡这种情况很特殊，就他所知，游戏商并没有开第二个新手村，如果开了，论坛上一定会有说明。

另外，也没有哪个玩家说游戏系统直接出现在他们脑子里，都是一本B5皮质笔记本。

伏向军为此还特地上游戏论坛看了，最新的游戏更新中也没有提及游戏系统有更改。

伏向军问商非凡要不要找游戏策划问一问情况。

商非凡想了想，摇头。

“不管这是游戏策划特意设定，还是游戏AI运行自然产生的bug，你不觉得这种‘特殊’很有意思吗？”

伏向军愁眉苦脸：“特殊也代表危险。这还是全世界第一款全息游戏，一上来就百分百真实体感，还能多人联网互动。我们都商讨过，这种技术根本不是现在科技能支持的。”

“不说全息技术，就只是硬件方面，游戏开发商得有量子计算机才能支持这么庞大的运算，多人联网得保证超高速网络连接，还有超大服务器以及超供能系统，这甚至涉及到核聚能和量子信号传递。缺少一个都不可能支持这么一个百分百真实还极为庞大的全息游戏世界。”

伏向军又指指自己的大脑：“而且人类大脑是最神秘也是现在医学最难掌握的领域。什么样的游戏商能用一个游戏头盔就让人类大脑产生百分百的真实体感，还能和他人互动？这里面涉及到的可不止是全息技术，还有医学的神经接驳方面。”

“所以才需要我们这些小白鼠亲自试一试，查明到底是怎么一回事。正好我退役后也没什么事，玩玩游戏也挺好的。”商非凡拍拍伏向军的肩膀，让他安心。

伏向军哪可能安心，但就如商非凡所说，这全息游戏总要有人去探探路。偏偏这游戏的玩家账号还特别难申请到，他能申请到游戏账号就已经是撞大运。商非凡也能申请上，也不知道是不是他瞎填的资料特别吸引游戏策划。

这游戏背后的开发者和运营者也非常神秘，到现在都还没有哪个组织摸到对方底细，就连服务器在哪里都不知道。

原本进入这个游戏的试验者应该在完全安全的监测环境中进入游戏，但……谁让他们身在战区呢。

游戏世界。

商非凡把那些虫尸全都收集到一起，堆放在床单上。

五分钟后，被喊上来的酒馆老板娘盯着床单上的一堆虫尸，表情特别难看。

“我们酒馆客房环境你也看到了，我们每天都打扫得很干净，根本不可能招来这么多虫子。”

小安东从他妈妈身边挤出一个脑袋：“我知道！这一定是虫族的诅咒！因为诺曼先生焚烧了正在转变的虫人的尸体。”

“别胡扯！”酒馆老板娘敲儿子脑门，又推儿子：“你去找羊大婶，让她亲自过来一趟，快去！”

小安东正要离开，他妈又拉住他，叮嘱：“顺便去问问治安官和昨晚去处理尸体的梅勒他们，问他们有没有发现虫尸。”

“好勒！”小安东麻利地跑走。

“这些虫尸先留着，等羊大婶来了，看她怎么说。”老板娘叹了口气，招呼商非凡下去吃早饭，又去挨个敲门询问其他客人有没有发现大量虫子。

几个长耳兽人开门，纷纷摇头，表示房间很干净，他们昨晚睡得很好。

商非凡感觉到有谁在看自己，转头就看到了抓着门框正用奇怪神色看他的年轻兽人虎不帅。

“早安。”

“早安。”虎不帅对商非凡礼貌点头。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 5: The Murmurs of Insects (Part 1)

Game World.

In the dead of night, muttering sounds suddenly echoed in Shang Feifan's guest room, sounding like someone talking in their sleep, or perhaps insects buzzing and humming in a muffled drone.

The murmurs were indistinct and vague, repeatedly chanting a few specific words.

On the bed, Shang Feifan's beastman avatar lay with his eyes closed, completely unaware.

One by one, gray insects crawled out from the cracks in the window, flew into the room, and landed on the tiger beastman's body.

Gradually, every single place on his leather armor bearing bloodstains became entirely covered by the gray insects.

Two doors down, the young beastman sat up in bed, perked up his ears to listen intently, and then slipped into his shoes and outer garments before pushing open his door.

The hallway was quiet.

The guests staying overnight today were merely a few long-eared beastmen who had come to sell grain, along with himself and that tiger beastman who claimed to hail from Black Forest City.

The young beastman stepped forward quietly, pressed his ear against the door panel of the adjacent room to listen closely, decided it wasn't coming from there, and moved on to the next door down.

"Squeak... buzz... Zerg bone ash... wild thistle... egg yolk..."

The young beastman wasn't sure if he had misheard. People frequently suffered from auditory hallucinations; when exposed to continuous, repetitive sounds, they were even more prone to illusions resembling certain words.

The young beastman pressed his ear harder against the wooden door, trying to listen more clearly.

"Squeak... buzz... bone ash... grass... egg yolk... cur..."

The harder he tried to listen clearly, the less he could understand.

Something warm trickled out of his ear canal. The young beastman raised a hand to wipe it—his ear was bleeding.

Real World.

Shang Feifan, who had just personally delivered a generous "gift" to a certain former business partner, climbed into a beat-up white van, casually wiped the bloodstains off his face, and picked up the gaming helmet to put it on. This time, he didn't bother using any equipment to monitor his physiological vitals.

Fu Xiangjun, who was driving, caught this scene in the rearview mirror, gave a helpless sigh, and slightly increased the vehicle's speed.

They needed to reach the Bay Dock before noon and board a cargo ship to leave.

Not far away, a luxury mansion estate was engulfed in towering flames. Everyone in this district knew who that estate belonged to, and no one dared to go over and investigate.

There were no police here—only the illegal armed militia commanded by that estate's master.

*Boom! Boom!* Even louder explosions rang out consecutively; it was the estate's munitions depot blowing up.

In the distant mountain forest, over a hundred local natives wearing combat fatigues and gripping various firearms watched the distant manor burn. Many of them still bore bloodstains and injuries, yet their faces revealed looks of unadulterated satisfaction.

The leader felt a tinge of regret over the munitions and wealth incinerated within the estate, but fortunately, someone had gifted them a batch of weapons and ammunition for this operation.

Now that this largest local cancer had finally been eradicated, perhaps they could also build a normal order of their own.

In the game world, the moment Shang Feifan opened his eyes in his guest room, he felt something was amiss and abruptly bolted upright.

*Rustle.*

A pile of gray insect carcasses tumbled onto the floor and the bedsheets.

Shang Feifan looked down at his chest, where more insect carcasses still clung to his clothes.

He pinched one of the insect corpses between his fingers to inspect it closely.

The bug was very small, somewhat resembling a grain borer.

Just this single pile of insect remains numbered at least several hundred.

What had happened last night?

Why did abnormal events still occur even after he logged off?

Shang Feifan was quite curious about what state his in-game body assumed after he logged off.

Old players on the game forums claimed that unless you returned your game body to the spawn point, leaving it anywhere was unsafe. Previously, an old player had logged off while camping in the wild, only to be declared dead upon logging back in—his in-game body had been devoured by beasts.

Veteran players had protested to the game developers over this.

The game planners' response had been: As the map expands, safe zones will be established within certain perimeters in the future. If you are worried about your body having issues after logging off, you can choose to log out inside a safe zone.

Right now, the first two batches of veteran players were building the very first safe zone outside the initial birth pool.

Meanwhile, Shang Feifan and his batch of new players would also be guided to this first safe zone after repeatedly running into walls in the novice village, beginning a grueling coolie lifestyle of carrying bricks, digging mines, constructing houses, and earning in-game currency.

Fu Xiangjun had remarked that Shang Feifan's situation was extremely unusual. As far as he knew, the developers hadn't opened a second novice village; if they had, there definitely would have been an announcement on the forums.

Additionally, no other player had reported the game system appearing directly inside their minds—everyone else received a B5 leather-bound notebook.

To verify this, Fu Xiangjun had even specially checked the game forums, and the latest game update made no mention of any changes to the game system.

Fu Xiangjun had asked Shang Feifan if he wanted to contact the game planners and ask what was going on.

Shang Feifan thought about it and shook his head.

"Whether this is a deliberate setting by the game planners or a bug naturally generated by the game's AI operation, don't you think this kind of 'specialness' is quite interesting?"

Fu Xiangjun wore a worried expression. "Special also means dangerous. This is the world's very first holographic game, featuring 100% realistic sensory immersion right out of the gate, complete with multiplayer online networking. We've all discussed this: such technology simply cannot be supported by current-day tech."

"Forget the holographic technology; just looking at the hardware side alone, the game developer would need a quantum computer to support computations of this magnitude. Multiplayer networking requires guaranteed ultra-high-speed internet connections, massive servers, and super power-supply systems—this even touches upon nuclear fusion and quantum signal transmission. Lacking even one of these makes supporting such a 100% realistic and extraordinarily massive holographic game world impossible."

Fu Xiangjun then pointed to his own head. "Besides, the human brain is the most mysterious and medically elusive domain today. What kind of game developer can use a mere gaming helmet to make the human brain generate 100% realistic sensory immersion and allow interaction with others? What's involved here goes far beyond holographic technology; it even touches upon medical neural interfacing."

"That's precisely why guinea pigs like us are needed to test it out firsthand and figure out what's really going on. Since I've already retired and have nothing special to do, playing a game is quite nice." Shang Feifan patted Fu Xiangjun's shoulder to reassure him.

How could Fu Xiangjun possibly be at ease? Yet, as Shang Feifan had said, someone had to scout the path for this holographic game. Unfortunately, the game's player accounts were exceptionally difficult to apply for; managing to secure one was already a stroke of sheer luck for him. As for Shang Feifan getting approved as well, who knew if it was because his randomly filled-out application details had specifically caught the game planner's fancy.

The developers and operators behind this game were also unfathomably mysterious; to this day, no organization had managed to trace their background, and nobody even knew where the servers were located.

Ordinarily, test subjects entering this game should have done so within a completely secure, monitored environment, but... well, who told them to be caught right in the middle of a war zone.

Game World.

Shang Feifan gathered all those insect carcasses together and piled them onto the bedsheet.

Five minutes later, the tavern proprietress, who had been summoned upstairs, stared at the mound of dead bugs on the bedsheet with an exceptionally grim expression.

"You've seen the condition of our guest rooms; we clean them thoroughly every day. There's simply no way it would attract this many bugs."

Little Anton squeezed his head out from beside his mother. "I know! This must be a Zerg curse! Because Mr. Norman burned the corpse of a Zerg in transformation!"

"Stop talking nonsense!" The tavern proprietress knocked her son on the forehead, then shoved him. "Go find Auntie Yang and ask her to come over in person. Hurry up!"

Just as Little Anton was about to leave, his mother pulled him back and instructed, "By the way, go ask the sheriff and Meler and the others who went to handle the corpse last night if they found any insect carcasses."

"You got it!" Little Anton scurried off nimbly.

"Keep these bug corpses for now. Let's see what Auntie Yang has to say when she gets here." The proprietress sighed, invited Shang Feifan downstairs for breakfast, and then went around knocking on doors one by one to ask the other guests if they had discovered any large quantities of insects.

Several long-eared beastmen opened their doors and shook their heads successively, stating that their rooms were very clean and they had slept quite well last night.

Shang Feifan sensed someone watching him, turned his head, and saw the young beastman Hu Bushuai clutching the doorframe and gazing at him with a strange expression.

"Morning."

"Morning." Hu Bushuai nodded politely back to Shang Feifan.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡直接问：“你昨晚有发现什么吗？我看你的表情像是我昨晚砸了一夜墙。”

虎不帅嘴角动了动，像是在笑，犹豫了一会儿，他才说道：“我听到一点呢喃声，像是从你房间里传出来的。”

“哦？你听到我在说梦话？”商非凡走近年轻兽人。

虎不帅摇头：“不是你的声音，更像是……虫子在说话。”

“虫子会说话？”

虎不帅：“不是，我是说……听起来像。”

“它们说什么了？”商非凡很好奇。

虎不帅见老板娘和长耳兽人都下楼了，但还是把声音压得低低的：“像是在反复念几个词语。”

“什么词语？”

“虫人骨灰、荒蓟草、蛋黄、诅咒。我只听到了这几个单词，其他词语很是模糊，无法分辨。”

商非凡懵：“这是什么？”

虎不帅抬头看比他高大半个头的虎兽人：“你听过神血天赋激发仪式吗？”

没有。游戏论坛完全没有这方面的说明。商非凡：“能详细说说吗？”

虎不帅斟酌着说：“这只是一种传闻，你应该也听过。传说我们兽人曾经都有非常强大的神血天赋，但从异世而来的虫族吞噬了我们的神血，导致我们现在能觉醒神血天赋的人极少，很多人都只能借用炼金工具才能使用特别能力，但就算如此，威力也很小。”

商非凡脸上表情没有任何变化：“这个传说和神血天赋激发仪式有什么关系？”

虎不帅疑惑地看商非凡：“你真不知道这件事？这件事知道的人虽然不多，但……”我以为你知道。

商非凡指指自己的脑袋：“我途中遇到攻击，被敲中脑袋，导致我遗忘了一些事情。这些记忆也许以后我能想起来，但现在它们就是不出现，我也没办法。”

虎不帅：我觉得你在说谎，但我不想戳破你。

“好吧，这件事也不算什么秘密。这个镇子上知道的人就有不少。”

虎不帅下定决心，告诉面前的虎兽人：“传说每杀死一个虫族，就有机会听到虫族死后灵魂的呓语，它们有一定可能性会吐露出激发神血天赋的配方和仪式，但不保证完整，也不保证一定就能激发。而且虫族怎么会有那样的好心？它们死后灵魂说出来的呓语更可能导致兽人发疯，而不是帮助兽人激发神血天赋。”

商非凡脑中闪过一道灵光：“杀死虫人或虫人混血儿呢？”

虎不帅摇头：“虫人是虫人，虫族是虫族，你不能把两者混淆起来。”

商非凡：“但杀死虫人，再把他们埋到土壤里，就有可能会让他们的尸体虫族化，进而再杀死那个虫族化的虫子，是不是也有可能听到它死后的灵魂呓语？”

虎不帅懂了：“你是说杀死那个虫人混血的凶手就是为了把他的尸体埋到大地里，进而得到激发神血天赋的配方和仪式？”

“很有可能不是吗？而且昨晚你还听到了虫子的呓语。”

虎不帅皱眉，“不对。那个虫人混血儿尸体还没有完全转变，昨晚的呓语应该和他没有关系。况且你也不是杀他的凶手……你不是吧？”

商非凡当然摇头：“我不是。”

“所以我们首先可以排除昨晚的呓语声和那名死去的虫人混血有关。”虎不帅说。

“那昨晚为什么有虫子跑到我房间对我呓语，还死了那么多。另外，你又为什么能听见虫子的呓语声？”商非凡盯住年轻兽人的眼睛。

虎不帅避开他的目光，低声说：“这种情况还有一种可能，就是……虫族主动献祭。”

“什么意思？”

“意思就是你身上的虫族血脉非常浓郁，不是虫人血脉，是虫族血脉。这种情况就有可能让虫族对你主动献祭，帮你激发神血天赋。”

作者有话说：

商非凡：我有一种预感……
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan asked directly, "Did you notice anything last night? From the look on your expression, it's as if I spent the whole night punching the wall."

Hu Bushuai's lips twitched, as if trying to smile, but after a moment of hesitation, he said, "I heard some murmuring sounds, as though they were coming from your room."

"Oh? You heard me talking in my sleep?" Shang Feifan walked closer to the young Orc.

Hu Bushuai shook his head. "It wasn't your voice. It sounded more like... bugs talking."

"Bugs can talk?"

Hu Bushuai: "No, I mean... it sounded like it."

"What were they saying?" Shang Feifan was extremely curious.

Seeing that the tavern proprietress and the long-eared Orc had both gone downstairs, Hu Bushuai kept his voice very low. "It was like they were repeating a few words over and over."

"What words?"

"Insect-man ash, wild thistle, egg yolk, curse. I only caught those few words; the rest were too blurred to make out."

Shang Feifan was baffled. "What are these?"

Hu Bushuai looked up at the tiger Orc who stood half a head taller than him. "Have you ever heard of the Divine Blood Talent Awakening Ritual?"

He hadn't. The game forums contained absolutely no information on this topic. "Could you elaborate?" Shang Feifan asked.

Hu Bushuai weighed his words before replying, "It's merely a rumor, though you've likely heard of it. Legend has it that we Orcs once all possessed immensely powerful divine blood talents, but the Zerg from another world devoured our divine blood. As a result, very few of us can awaken those talents today. Most people have to rely on alchemical tools to use special abilities, and even then, their power is negligible."

Shang Feifan's expression remained completely unchanged. "What does this legend have to do with the Divine Blood Talent Awakening Ritual?"

Hu Bushuai looked at Shang Feifan in confusion. "You really don't know about this? Although not many people know, still..." *I thought you knew.*

Shang Feifan tapped his own head. "I was attacked on the way here and took a blow to the head, which caused me to forget quite a few things. These memories might come back to me later, but for now, they just won't surface. There's nothing I can do."

Hu Bushuai: *I think you're lying, but I don't feel like exposing you.*

"Well, it's not much of a secret anyway. Quite a few people in this town know about it."

Making up his mind, Hu Bushuai told the tiger Orc before him, "Legend says that every time you kill a Zerg, there is a chance to hear the murmurs of the Zerg's soul after its death. There is a certain possibility that they will spit out the recipe and ritual for awakening divine blood talents, though there's no guarantee it will be complete, nor that it will definitely work. Besides, why would the Zerg be so kind? The soul murmurs they utter after death are far more likely to drive an Orc mad than to help them awaken a divine blood talent."

A flash of insight crossed Shang Feifan's mind. "What about killing an insect-man or a half-breed insect-man?"

Hu Bushuai shook his head. "An insect-man is an insect-man, and a Zerg is a Zerg. You can't confuse the two."

Shang Feifan: "But if you kill an insect-man and then bury their body in the soil, could that cause their corpse to undergo a Zerg transformation? And if you then kill that Zerg-transformed bug, would it be possible to hear the soul murmurs of its death?"

Hu Bushuai understood. "You're saying the murderer who killed that insect-man half-breed did so precisely to bury his corpse in the earth, thereby obtaining the recipe and ritual to awaken the divine blood talent?"

"Isn't that highly probable? Besides, you heard the murmurs of the bugs last night, didn't you?"

Hu Bushuai frowned. "No, that's not right. That insect-man half-breed's corpse hasn't completely transformed yet; the murmurs from last night shouldn't have anything to do with him. Furthermore, you aren't the one who killed him... are you?"

Naturally, Shang Feifan shook his head. "I am not."

"So, first of all, we can rule out the possibility that the murmurs from last night are connected to the dead insect-man half-breed," Hu Bushuai said.

"Then why did bugs run into my room and murmur last night, and why did so many of them die? And why on earth could you hear the bugs' murmurs?" Shang Feifan stared straight into the young Orc's eyes.

Hu Bushuai averted his gaze and lowered his voice. "There is one other possibility for this kind of situation, and that is... active Zerg sacrifice."

"What do you mean?"

"It means the Zerg bloodline within you is extremely potent—not an insect-man bloodline, but a true Zerg bloodline. In such a situation, it's possible for the Zerg to proactively sacrifice themselves to you in order to help you awaken your divine blood talent."

Author's Note:

Shang Feifan: I have a hunch...

chunks.chineseText:
第6章 这是诅咒

商非凡觉得他需要去和土著兽人好好了解一下这个世界的大背景，这是游戏论坛上完全没有提到的内容。

游戏商告诉玩家的游戏世界背景说是一个比较原始的兽人世界，也是一个开放型的庞大游戏世界，玩家们可以在这个兽人世界想做什么就做什么。

打天下也可以，行商也可以，只观赏这个世界的风景也行，或者想要帮助这个世界的兽人发展也是一条游戏线。

在这之前，为了保障玩家们的安全，得先建立属于玩家的安全区和玩家势力，这就是现在绝大多数玩家们在做的事情。

当然，任何游戏都有一条故事主线。

这个游戏也有。

玩家们都出生于天残谷神殿出生池，一出生就是天残。

包括天残谷新手村里的土著兽人也是天残。

何谓天残？

就是天生不能在兽体和人体之间自由转换的兽人。

除此之外，还有天生有各种残缺的兽人也被叫做天残。

这些天残兽人受到正常兽人歧视，很多都会被亲人遗弃，不知从什么时候开始，各地出现了很多个天残谷、天残村。这些地方专门收留天残，别人也会特意把天残孩童送到这里。

而游戏的故事主线就是天残兽人们想要为自己争出一片天下，想要让普通兽人知道天残并不可悲、也不弱小，想要建立让天残也能幸福生活的兽人政权。

领头者就是天残谷谷主，据说他的身世也很奇异，是一名被遗弃的兽族王子。但他觉醒了据说只有王族纯血才能觉醒的血脉技能，还拜了一位博学的老师学到了大量知识，他同情其他天残的遭遇，想要做些什么。
