Shang Feifan fell into deep thought. After a moment, he said, "It seems a major turning point likely occurred in your life five years ago. Do you know what that turning point was?"

Hu Bushuai hesitated for a brief second. Remembering that the original's attempted murder five years ago was hardly a secret among the upper echelons of the royal city's high nobility, he said, "Five years ago, I suffered an extremely severe injury and almost died."

"Because of your status?"

Hu Bushuai didn't answer, but his silence gave Shang Feifan the answer.

Shang Feifan's gaze abruptly turned fierce, though it reverted in a split second the moment Hu Bushuai looked over.

"I invited you to come along to search for the scattered pieces of the God of Nature not as an excuse to tie you down," Shang Feifan said to Hu Bushuai with utmost solemnity. "Rather, I suspect that others are also searching for the God of Nature's power. If I have a way to find you, other people will inevitably find a way to find you as well."

Hu Bushuai almost blurted out: *Are there other transmigrators out there too?*

Shang Feifan continued, "Therefore, we must speed up and snatch all the power of the God of Nature before anyone else does. Then we can negotiate with the God of Nature: if They can spare your life and ensure your innate ability doesn't vanish or weaken, we can return the power They lost inside your body. Otherwise..."

Hu Bushuai realized this guy was dead serious. He genuinely intended to negotiate with the most primordial ancient god of this world. And if negotiations broke down, he planned to strong-arm the deity's divine power right out of Them.

Shang Feifan was already plotting: "I know you're worried about Moyue Town, so we'll head back to Moyue Town first to check on the situation there. Once things stabilize over there, we'll set off to search for the God of Nature's power."

Hu Bushuai: "..."

"If you don't trust me, we can recruit a few more hands and form an exploration team." Shang Feifan spoke in a purely businesslike tone, as though he had completely forgotten about his earlier confession.

"No exploration team." Hu Bushuai had no desire to join any small squads anymore, especially ones under the banner of adventuring.

"Then it'll just be the three of us. Fewer people make things easier to handle," Shang Feifan said briskly, secretly rejoicing inside.

Hu Bushuai looked up at this man, then looked at him again. How did he feel like he had once again been talked into circles by this guy in just a few short sentences? Clearly, he had already resolved to part ways with him and just keep a silent watch from afar.

"We'll head back tomorrow," Hu Bushuai finally decided. The business he needed to handle was wrapping up within these few days, and staying behind now was just to prop up Shang Feifan's grand money-making scheme. Since Shang Feifan wanted to leave, then they would leave.

Shang Feifan's heart bloomed with joy. "Alright."

That night, Hu Bushuai returned to his rented courtyard to rest.

Shang Feifan chased Ah Dai away to go foster bonds with his unhandsome dad, then flopped onto the bed and instantly logged back into the real world.

Fu Xiangjun logged off relatively late this time. Removing his gaming helmet, he wandered over, intending to chat with Lao Shang about that bizarre quest their guild had accepted, only to find his boss browsing some weird queries on the internet.

"What are you looking at?" Fu Xiangjun leaned over in curiosity.

With the expression of a scholar researching an academic paper, Shang Feifan stared intently at the computer screen. "I'm checking my romance fortune. I need to see what my love luck looks like for tomorrow, this week, this month, this year, and next year."

"Romance fortune?"

"Yeah. What the hell? Why is Scorpio's love luck this month so rough? As expected, Chinese zodiac horoscopes are way more accurate." Shang Feifan swiftly switched the page back to a fortune-telling website's zodiac prediction page for the current and coming years.

Upon seeing the prophetic remark—[The predestined person appears; a step into the marital halls is possible]—Shang Feifan whipped out his phone and snapped a picture of the computer screen. He needed photographic evidence. If it turned out to be wrong, he was going to smash this website to pieces!

As for the astrological horoscopes... the love forecasts there were absolute garbage; he decided he wouldn't look at astrological horoscopes for the rest of the month!

Fu Xiangjun asked suggestively, "Did you hook up with some female player?"

"No, I fell in love with an NPC." After snapping the photo, Shang Feifan patronized the fortune-telling site's online mall, purchasing a string of red agate bracelets according to the recommendations on the prophecy page.

It was said this thing could smooth out his romance luck and help him and his beloved achieve physical and spiritual union even faster.

Having finished his daily superstitious rituals, Shang Feifan closed his computer and turned around. "How's the search for the server address going?"

Fu Xiangjun assumed Shang Feifan was only joking about falling in love with an NPC. Although quite a few players had developed feelings for in-game NPCs lately, everyone knew they were just lines of data; very few genuinely fell in love and dated 2D paper dolls.

"We didn't find it. The one we tracked earlier was a fake—just a smoke screen put out by the game developers. After getting tipped off this time, the other party should be even more vigilant and hide deeper," Fu Xiangjun reported briefly.

"Who's leading the team responsible for tracking the game developers and server addresses?"

"I didn't ask in detail. Do you want to know? I can go ask around for you."

Shang Feifan pondered for a moment. "No need. I'll find another route to investigate myself."

Suddenly, Shang Feifan rubbed his temples.

Fu Xiangjun asked with heightened sensitivity, "What's wrong?"

A look of bewilderment appeared on Shang Feifan's face. "I think I heard sounds from inside the game."

"What?!"

chunks.chineseText:
第56章 虫毒散播者

“你确定不是幻听？”伏向军追问。

商非凡皱眉，应该不是幻听，他真的听到了声音，有点遥远，一开始不太清晰，但那个声音挑动他的神经，让他下意识就不想忽略。

脑中声音一声又一声，逐渐变得清晰。

商非凡变色，腾地站起。

是虎不帅的声音！

对方在喊他的名字，语音非常焦急。

商非凡来不及跟伏向军解释，也暂时不去思考为什么会出现这样的情况，他一个飞步走到平时戴游戏头盔的仰躺式沙发，迅速拿起头盔套上。

“醒醒！商非凡你醒醒！见鬼，你爸爸怎么睡得这么死沉？”而且睡觉还不脱衣服，这是什么怪癖？

“爸爸睡觉就这样。”阿呆跳到床上，焦急地在老商肚子上蹦跳。

虎不帅等不及了，飞快跑进洗浴室，端了一盆冷水出来，往商非凡脸上一泼。

商非凡啪地睁开眼睛。

叮咚。

【任务五十五，请查清摩罗城现阶段发生了什么事，查明罪魁祸首的身份。奖励5点贡献点。】

商非凡还没搞清楚状况。

虎不帅大喜又气：“你终于醒了！快起来，我们得快点离开。城里出事了！”

商非凡抹去脸上水滴，从床上翻身坐起，一边快速穿鞋一边问：“出了什么事？”

虎不帅飞速说：“不可直说不可描绘的可怕东西出现了，它在横穿整个摩罗城，凡是它经过的地方，就会有虫毒弥漫。这个时代凡是感染虫毒的人大多都来源于此。被感染虫毒的人有人会当场死亡，有人会昏迷一段时间后异变且失去理智，醒来后就会攻击所有活人。现在整个摩罗城的活人和生物都在逃跑，就是男爵府也不例外。”

商非凡满头雾水，“怎么会突然冒出这么一个可怕存在？”

“不知道！那东西出现的地点、时间都没有规律，它想来就来想走就走，但凡是它出现的地方，那个地方就会倒大霉。我们得快点离开，我们的房子就在它过来的方向上！”虎不帅紧急催促。

商非凡这时才听到门外传来的噪杂声，还有一声又一声大钟敲击的巨大响声，钟声非常急促。

钟声下，夹杂着喊叫声和哭嚎声，还有车轮压过路面和人类奔跑的声音。

感觉整个城市都乱了。

好在他们早就商量好明天就会离开，租金也只付到明天，两人的行李也早就收拾好，商非凡有了雕像广场后就把那里当自己的储物空间，这时候他都不用收拾，穿上鞋子带上阿呆和狰爷就能离开。

狰爷也在院子里，平常很稳的狰爷今晚显得特别毛躁，如果不是还挂记着两个伙伴，它早就跑了。

看到商非凡他们出来，狰爷立刻用爪子发出急促的敲击声。

“来了！”商非凡迅速抱着阿呆跳到狰爷背上。

虎不帅也跟着上来。

“走！”

狰爷收到商非凡可以走的信号，长腿一用力，就原地弹跳起来，爬上屋檐飞快往城市外逃跑。

等上了屋顶，商非凡就看得更清楚了。

原本还算安定繁华的摩罗城全乱了，

到处都是火把和灯光，到处都是乱跑的人群，到处都是喊声。屋顶上也出现了数不清的巨虫和它们驮着的兽人与物品，这些巨虫坐骑形成一条洪流，全都在背着一个方向逃跑。

城里街道上跑满了各种动物，速度不行的兽人就还是任性。

小孩子哇哇乱哭，很多兽人都拖家带口，有的人还拖着车子，车子上装着他们一家的重要财物。

更多兽人简装出行，顶多背个包、夹着自家孩子就跑了出来。

城卫似乎想要组织起有效撤退，引导人们有序离开，但逃跑的城民太多，人们又太惊慌，没有多少人听指挥，整座城市都变得乱糟糟。

最可怕的是这时候还有人趁火打劫！

贵族和富豪们得到消息最快，他们也是最先行动的。

眼看贵族和富豪们弃家出逃，有些抱着富贵险中求想法的兽人竟然冲进了没有防守的富豪和贵族家中，到处搜刮值钱的东西。

有些还没来得及走的小富户则遭到了抢劫。

甚至出现了由几个人乃至十几个人组成的小型团队，专门找富贵人家下手。

商非凡头脑清晰，但是他完全不知道这是怎么回事。

他就是躺下睡了个觉，怎么就变天了？

摩罗城的人跟商非凡一样，他们全都被打得措手不及。

如果不是巡逻城卫发现情况不妙及时敲响战争来袭的警钟，摩罗城的居民还不知道有多少人会被卷入虫毒感染。

夜晚原本关闭的四座城门全部打开，但逃亡的城民太多，把城门给堵死了。

于是巨虫就往城墙上爬，随身携带物品不多的兽人也全都选择变身，城墙上爬满了各种动物，天空飞过一片片鸟人。

大家都在想方设法用最快速度逃离摩罗城。

狰爷嫌弃前面有大堆巨虫挡道，导致它无法提速，只能夹杂在洪流中被裹挟着往外跑。

十来只巨大禽鸟从城中某处升起。

商非凡眼尖，看到了那些巨大禽鸟的背上似乎有很多未成年。

虎不帅也看到了那十几只飞向城外的巨大禽鸟，他脸上明显松了口气。

商非凡突有所感，下意识看向摩罗城西北方。

那里和混乱的摩罗城就像是割裂了开来，一片死寂和黑暗。

“就是那边。我听到警钟声就出去看了。我听到的声音告诉我，那边的人死了很多很多，但也有很多人正在异变。”虎不帅脸色苍白。

商非凡从一片火光和灯光中看到了一条宽阔的黑暗带，黑暗带从西北方起头，往东南方推进。

看黑暗带前进的速度，已经到达他们刚才逃出来的第九街小院。

“它讨厌光亮？”商非凡低喃。

“嗯？”虎不帅一下没反应过来。

商非凡：“那东西所过之处，所有房屋街道都会变得一片漆黑，灯光火光全消失了。它是讨厌光亮，还是讨厌火焰？”

虎不帅大约从没有想过这个问题，愣了愣才说：“也许。”

虎不帅随即就像是想起了某个重要线索，大声说：“对！你说的对！那东西从不在白天出现，它都是夜晚或雨天出现！天，为什么之前没有人发现这个问题？”

商非凡淡定脸：“也许不是没有人发现，只是恐惧让发现者不敢说出口。或许也有其他不能说明的原因。”

“这东西有具体形象吗？”商非凡转而问道。

狰爷突然加快速度，他们快到城门口了。

狰爷瞄见一个空档，立刻跳起来，越过其他巨虫，跳到那个空档，再从那个空档发力，跳到了城墙上。

商非凡三人身体和地面呈现九十度直角，这种情况他们也不方便再交谈。

商非凡一把抓住站在他一边不太稳当的虎不帅，把人圈到怀里。

不等虎不帅抵抗，就低沉喝道：“抱紧我！”

……特殊情况特殊对待。虎不帅只能抱紧面前的雄性兽人。
chunks.englishText:
**Chapter 56: The Disseminator of Insect Venom**

"Are you sure it wasn't auditory hallucinations?" Fu Xiangjun pressed.

Shang Feifan frowned. It shouldn't be an auditory hallucination; he genuinely heard a voice. It sounded somewhat distant and indistinct at first, but that voice plucked at his nerves, making him subconsciously unwilling to ignore it.

The voice in his mind echoed again and again, gradually growing clearer.

Shang Feifan's expression changed as he sprang abruptly to his feet.

It was Hu Bushuai's voice!

The other party was calling his name, and the tone was extremely frantic.

Shang Feifan had no time to explain to Fu Xiangjun, nor did he pause to wonder why such a situation had occurred. He strode in a flying step over to the reclining sofa where he usually wore his gaming helmet, picked it up swiftly, and strapped it on.

"Wake up! Shang Feifan, wake up! Damn it, how can your dad sleep so deeply?" And he didn't even take off his clothes to sleep—what kind of weird habit was that?

"Dad always sleeps like this." Ah Dai hopped onto the bed, jumping anxiously up and down on Lao Shang's stomach.

Hu Bushuai couldn't wait any longer. He sprinted into the washroom, fetched a basin of cold water, and splashed it straight onto Shang Feifan's face.

Shang Feifan snapped his eyes wide open.

*Ding-dong.*

[Quest 55: Please investigate what has happened in the current stage of Moluo City and identify the culprit behind it. Reward: 5 contribution points.]

Shang Feifan still hadn't figured out the situation.

Overjoyed and exasperated, Hu Bushuai urged, "You're finally awake! Get up quickly; we need to leave at once. Something's happened in the city!"

Wiping the water droplets from his face, Shang Feifan sat up from the bed, quickly slipping into his shoes as he asked, "What happened?"

Hu Bushuai rattled off at top speed, "A terrifying entity that defies description and depiction has appeared. It is cutting straight across the entire Moluo City, and wherever it passes, insect venom fills the air. Most of the people infected with insect venom in this era originate from this. Some infected individuals die on the spot, while others fall into a coma for a period before mutating and losing their minds; once they wake up, they attack all living beings. Right now, all living creatures and beings in Moluo City are fleeing—the Baron's estate is no exception."

Shang Feifan was utterly bewildered. "How did such a terrifying existence pop up out of nowhere?"

"I don't know! The location and time of that thing's appearance have no pattern whatsoever; it comes and goes as it pleases, but wherever it appears, that place suffers terrible misfortune. We have to leave immediately—our house is right in the direction it's coming from!" Hu Bushuai urged with utmost urgency.

Only then did Shang Feifan hear the commotions echoing from outside, interspersed with the massive, frantic tolling of heavy bells.

Beneath the sound of the bells were overlapping cries, weeping, the screech of cart wheels rolling over pavement, and the sound of humans running.

It felt as though the entire city had plunged into chaos.

Fortunately, they had already agreed to leave tomorrow, and their rent was only paid through tomorrow; both of their belongings were already packed. Since Shang Feifan possessed the Statue Plaza, he treated it as his personal storage space, meaning he didn't even need to pack this time—he could just put on his shoes, grab Ah Dai and Lord Zhen, and take off.

Lord Zhen was also in the courtyard. The usually steady Lord Zhen appeared exceptionally high-strung tonight; if it weren't for lingering concern for its two companions, it would have already bolted.

Seeing Shang Feifan and the others emerge, Lord Zhen immediately began scratching the ground with its claws to produce a rapid, rhythmic tapping sound.

"We're coming!" Shang Feifan swiftly scooped up Ah Dai and leaped onto Lord Zhen's back.

Hu Bushuai climbed up right behind him.

"Let's move!"

Receiving Shang Feifan's signal to go, Lord Zhen flexed its long legs, sprang up from the spot, scrambled onto the eaves of the roof, and fled at high speed toward the city limits.

Once up on the rooftops, Shang Feifan gained a much clearer view.

Moluo City, which had been relatively stable and prosperous, was in total disarray.

Torches and lights were everywhere, crowds were running amok everywhere, and shouts echoed from every direction. Countless giant insects carrying beastmen and supplies had also appeared on the rooftops, forming a surging torrent as they fled in the opposite direction of a single focal point.

All sorts of animals stampeded through the city streets, while beastmen lacking speed simply resorted to shifting into their beast forms.

Small children wailed loudly. Many beastmen dragged their entire families along, some pulling carts laden with their household's vital valuables.

Even more beastmen traveled light, fleeing with at most a backpack tucked under their arms or a child clutched to their chests.

The city guards seemed to want to organize an orderly retreat and guide citizens out, but too many townspeople were fleeing, and everyone was far too panicked; hardly anyone listened to orders, throwing the entire city into utter disorder.

What was most terrifying was that there were people taking advantage of the chaos to loot!

The nobles and wealthy elite received news the fastest and acted first.

Seeing the rich and powerful abandon their homes to flee, some beastmen harboring thoughts of seeking fortune amidst danger actually broke into unguarded mansions to ransack valuables everywhere.

Some smaller affluent households that hadn't managed to escape in time were targeted by robbers.

There even emerged small squads consisting of a dozen or so individuals who specifically preyed upon wealthy households.

Shang Feifan had a clear head, but he had no clue what was going on.

He had simply lain down to take a nap—how did the world flip upside down?

The people of Moluo City were caught just as off guard as Shang Feifan.

If the patrolling city guards hadn't spotted that the situation was turning south and sounded the war alarm in time, there was no telling how many more Moluo residents would have been sucked into insect venom infections.

All four city gates, normally shut at night, were flung wide open. However, the fleeing townspeople were so numerous that the gates became completely choked.

Consequently, giant insects began scaling the city walls, and beastmen carrying minimal luggage chose to transform. The city walls were crawling with various beasts, while a sheet of avian beastmen soared across the sky.

Everyone was racking their brains to escape Moluo City at maximum speed.

Lord Zhen expressed its disgust as a massive clump of giant insects blocked the path ahead, preventing it from accelerating. It could only squeeze into the torrent and be swept along toward the outside.

A dozen massive avian beasts rose into the air from somewhere within the city.

With his sharp eyes, Shang Feifan noticed that the backs of those huge flying birds seemed to carry many juveniles.

Hu Bushuai also spotted those dozen giant avian beasts flying toward the outskirts, and a look of obvious relief washed over his face.

Struck by a sudden premonition, Shang Feifan subconsciously looked toward the northwest of Moluo City.

That area felt completely severed from the chaotic Moluo City—it was a stretch of deathly silence and pitch-black darkness.

"It's over there. I went out to look as soon as I heard the alarm bell. The voice I heard told me that a huge number of people died over there, but many are also undergoing mutations right now," Hu Bushuai said with a pale face.

Amidst the sea of firelight and illumination, Shang Feifan spotted a broad strip of darkness. The dark zone originated from the northwest and was advancing southeastward.

Judging by the pace of the dark zone's advance, it had already reached the Ninth Street courtyard they had just escaped from.

"It hates light?" Shang Feifan murmured.

"Huh?" Hu Bushuai didn't process it for a second.

Shang Feifan continued, "Wherever that thing passes, all houses and streets turn pitch black, and all lights and flames vanish completely. Does it hate light, or does it hate fire?"

Hu Bushuai had probably never considered this question. He blanked for a moment before saying, "Perhaps."

Instantly, as if recalling a crucial clue, Hu Bushuai spoke up loudly, "Right! You're right! That thing never appears during the day; it only comes out at night or when it rains! Heavens, why didn't anyone notice this before?"

Shang Feifan maintained a calm expression. "Maybe it wasn't that no one noticed, but rather that fear kept those who found out too terrified to speak of it. Perhaps there are other unmentionable reasons as well."

"Does this thing have a concrete appearance?" Shang Feifan asked, shifting topics.

Lord Zhen suddenly picked up its pace; they were approaching the city gates.

Spotting a gap, Lord Zhen leaped instantly, vaulting past other giant insects to land in that vacancy. Using the momentum, it pushed off and bounded right up onto the city wall.

The bodies of the three of them formed a ninety-degree angle with the ground, making conversation rather inconvenient under the circumstances.

Shang Feifan grabbed Hu Bushuai, who was standing somewhat unsteadily beside him, and pulled him directly into his arms.

Before Hu Bushuai could resist, Shang Feifan barked in a deep voice, "Hold on tight!"

...Special circumstances called for special treatment. Hu Bushuai had no choice but to hug the male beastman in front of him tightly.

商非凡两手抓着系在骨刺上的缰绳，把自己牢牢固定在狰爷的背脊上。

阿呆被塞进网兜里，他现在是最稳当的一个，不管狰爷怎么跳动翻滚，他都不会掉出来。

狰爷跑跳得越发自由奔放，只要找到一点空隙，它就能穿插进去，再迅速借位离开。

很快，狰爷就翻越到了城墙顶上，然后一个冲刺就来了一个信仰之跃！

后面，惊恐的叫喊声越来越大。

那条黑暗带正在迅速扩张，那看不见的东西似乎知道猎物在逃亡，它也加快了行进速度。

狰爷跳到城门外面，不停脚地一路狂奔。

离开城门这一片，路面不再拥挤，人们逃亡四面八方。

“往东南走！”商非凡给出指令。

虽然不知道那不可描述的东西是否也会一路行向东南，但商非凡暂时还不打算更改目的地。

莫约镇就在摩罗城的东南方向。

狰爷没反对，往东南方向撒腿狂奔。

“不用担心，它不会追上来，它每次出现的时间都很短，最多半个小时，只是它的行进速度很快，每次出现，尤其是出现在人类聚集地点就会搞出大型灾难。”虎不帅提高声音说。

商非凡看到附近同行的人越来越少，就让狰爷略微放慢了速度，并调整方向，试图回到大路上。

夜晚的野外并不比现在的摩罗城安全到哪里，他们得回归到大路上，不能直接在荒野中穿行。

但现在两人总算可以重新交谈，商非凡就把他之前的问题又问了一遍。

虎不帅见狰爷重新跑起直路，迅速松开双手，往外走一步，抓住骨刺上的另一根缰绳。

商非凡：“……”早知就不多系那一根缰绳。

虎不帅定了定心神，回答：“从来没有活人见过它的实体，加上流传中的不可直说不可描述，导致见过的人也会闭紧嘴巴。”

“就从来没有人想要去查查？那东西可是在散播虫毒。”商非凡眼望前方，假装自己很专心的在逃跑。

“当然有人想要去查。实际上特别调查局的工作之一就是专门调查这些会在兽人大陆出现的古怪事件。特别调查局的调查人员也是所有公职人员中牺牲人数最高的，所以调查员必须能力强大，同时他们的社会地位也相对比较高。”

“所以查出什么了吗？”

虎不帅给了商非凡一个你自己想的眼神。

商非凡接收到，懂了。这是查了，但什么都没查出来。

虎不帅迟疑了一会儿，科普：“像这样的可怕存在不止一个，它们统一被称为邪神阴影。我们今晚遇到的这一个会散播虫毒，还有专门摧毁庄稼的，喜欢放火的，喜欢吃小孩的，喜欢在外面游荡杀人的。在我离开王城时，王城和附近几座附属城也发生了一些古怪又血腥的案件，案件中的受害人全都失去了心脏，特别调查局的人怀疑是挖心者干的。”

“你们还给那些邪神阴影取了名字？”

“为了分辨和方便称呼。今晚这个就被叫做虫毒散播者。”

叮咚一声响，系统提醒他任务五十五完成。

商非凡：这大概是他目前为止完成最轻松且获利最高的一个任务了。

虽然不知道这个虫毒散播者为什么会突然出现，但商非凡有个强烈直觉，那东西的出现必定有它的目的，应该不是专门为了给兽人们散播虫毒。

而昨天发生过什么特别的事情？

商非凡不知道其他人，他自然就理所当然地想到了他昨天上午验证自然之神散落力量的事。

但这里有个问题，如果那虫毒散播者或其他邪神阴影者能查知到自然之神散落的力量，为什么虎不帅直到现在都安然无恙？

会不会想要感知到自然之神的力量，必须先激活这个力量？

比如他昨天用寻宝罗盘查验虎不帅，其实就是一个激活自然之神力量且把其引出来的过程？

“五年前，你说你受到重伤那一次，王城和附近附城有没有发生什么奇怪的事情？”

虎不帅是个很敏感的人，他一听商非凡的问话就迅速反应过来：“你认为是我引来了邪神阴影者？”

“不是你。是自然之神散落的力量。这也只是我一个猜测。”商非凡没好气地说：“不要什么事都往自己身上揽。我只是在做一些推测，通过你的回答，我可以排除一些条件。”

虎不帅抿了抿嘴唇：“五年前我重伤，在家养了半年伤，几乎没怎么出门。我家人也没怎么跟我说外面的事。不过……”

虎不帅深吸气：“后来因为某些原因，我调查了一些邪神阴影者的案件。五年前，我重伤那一天，王城曾经出现日蚀。但不是正常的自然日蚀，是天空突然就变黑了，就像被浓重的阴影笼罩。那天，王城死了不少人，但王城每天都在死人，谁也不知道那天那些人的死是否和非正常日蚀有关。”

“另外，约半年前，我再次受重伤，然后……挖心者就出现了。”

虎不帅冷静下来，“假设我每次受到重伤，藏在我身体里的那位神的力量就会泄露出一点，而邪神阴影者正在寻找那位神散落的力量，那么它们为什么不直接找到我头上？”

“也许缺乏精准定位的手段，只能找到一个大概范围。”商非凡推测。

“那你昨天的验证，也让那份神之力泄露了一点出来？这才会引来虫毒散播者？”

“我说了这只是我一个猜测。”商非凡不想虎不帅钻牛角尖，“我们现在还不知道那些邪神阴影者是否真的是为那位神的力量而来。也许那根本就是某个或某些信仰邪神的兽人们搞出来的邪恶祭祀仪式，从而引来了这些邪神阴影者。”

虎不帅很想问问原身母亲，你到底有没有把那位神的散落力量放到原身身体里？如果放了，你知不知道那是神灵的力量？

可惜原身母亲已经去世，他想问也找不到人问。

“停下来。”虎不帅突然道。

商非凡示意狰爷速度放慢，看向虎不帅：“你不会想要掉头吧？”

虎不帅冷静地说：“我不会进入摩罗城找死，但我想要知道摩罗城现在怎样了，以及逃出来多少人，还有那位彘庞男爵是否有应对手段。你不需要跟我一起回去，你只要在这里把我放下来。摩罗城逃出来的人必然会逐渐集中到一起，他们不会轻易放弃他们的家园，我要去那个营地。”

商非凡：“我们一起找那个营地，然后等待摩罗城的后续消息。不要拒绝，你今晚可是救了我的命。我睡觉比较死，如果不是你硬喊醒我，我百分百会感染虫毒，说不定现在已经死了，不死也会变异成怪物。”

叮咚。

【任务五十六，你不放心你的伙伴虎不帅，想要帮助他查清楚虫毒散播者出现在摩罗城的真正原因。查明后，奖励一次类玩家数据面板的高精度扫描及一份数据分析报告。注，可用在非玩家身上。】

商非凡：“……”这个狗狗祟祟的系统懂他。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan grabbed the reins tied to the bone spikes with both hands, firmly securing himself to the back of the Fierce Beast.

A-Dai was stuffed into a net bag, making him the most stable one of the lot; no matter how the Fierce Beast leaped or tumbled, he wouldn't fall out.

The Fierce Beast ran and jumped with increasing freedom and audacity. Whenever it found the slightest gap, it would wedge itself through, then swiftly leverage its position to clear the area.

Before long, the Fierce Beast scrambled up to the top of the city wall, and with a single dash, took a leap of faith!

Behind them, the panicked cries grew louder and louder.

That strip of darkness was rapidly expanding, and whatever unseen thing lurked within seemed to know its prey was fleeing, accelerating its pace as well.

The Fierce Beast vaulted outside the city gate and bolted forward without stopping.

Once away from the vicinity of the city gate, the road was no longer congested, and people were fleeing in all directions.

"Head southeast!" Shang Feifan issued the command.

Though he didn't know whether that indescribable entity would also head southeast all the way, Shang Feifan had no intention of changing his destination for the time being.

Moyue Town was located to the southeast of Moluo City.

The Fierce Beast didn't object, stretching its legs and galloping frantically toward the southeast.

"Don't worry, it won't catch up. Every time it appears, its duration is very short—at most half an hour. It's just that its movement speed is extremely fast, and every time it manifests, especially around human gatherings, it triggers massive disasters," Hu Bushuai raised his voice to say.

Seeing that fewer and fewer people were traveling alongside them, Shang Feifan had the Fierce Beast slow down slightly and adjust its course, attempting to return to the main road.

The wilderness at night was no safer than Moluo City at the moment; they had to get back onto the main thoroughfare and couldn't travel directly through the untamed wilds.

Now that the two of them could finally converse again, Shang Feifan repeated his previous question.

Seeing the Fierce Beast running in a straight line once more, Hu Bushuai quickly released his grip, took a step outward, and grabbed another rein attached to the bone spikes.

Shang Feifan: "..." Had he known, he wouldn't have tied that extra rein.

Hu Bushuai steadied his composure and replied, "No living person has ever laid eyes on its physical entity. Coupled with the rumors that it must not be spoken of or described, those who have seen it keep their mouths tightly shut."

"Hasn't anyone ever wanted to investigate? That thing is spreading pestilent poison." Shang Feifan gazed ahead, pretending to be utterly absorbed in escaping.

"Of course people have wanted to investigate. In fact, one of the duties of the Special Investigation Bureau is precisely to look into these bizarre occurrences that manifest across the Beastman Continent. The investigators of the Special Investigation Bureau also suffer the highest casualty rate among all public officials, which is why investigators must possess formidable capabilities while enjoying relatively high social standing."

"So, did they find anything?"

Hu Bushuai gave Shang Feifan a look that clearly said, *figure it out yourself*.

Shang Feifan caught the meaning and understood. They had investigated, but turned up absolutely nothing.

Hu Bushuai hesitated for a moment before offering a bit of popular science: "Terrifying entities like this aren't solitary; collectively, they are known as the Shadows of Evil Gods. The one we encountered tonight spreads pestilent poison, but there are others that specifically destroy crops, love to set fires, like to devour young children, and enjoy roaming the outside world to murder people. When I left the Royal City, some bizarre and bloody cases also occurred in the Royal City and several nearby vassal cities. The victims in all those cases had their hearts ripped out. The Special Investigation Bureau suspects it's the work of the Heart-Ripper."

"You guys even give names to those Shadows of Evil Gods?"

"For distinction and convenience of reference. Tonight's specimen is called the Pestilence Spreader."

With a pleasant ding, a system notification reminded him that Quest Fifty-Five was complete.

Shang Feifan: This was probably the easiest and most lucrative quest he had completed so far.

Although he didn't know why the Pestilence Spreader had suddenly appeared, Shang Feifan had a strong intuition that the entity's emergence must have a purpose, and it likely wasn't just there to randomly scatter pestilence among the beastmen.

So, what special events had occurred yesterday?

Shang Feifan didn't know about anyone else, so his thoughts naturally turned to his test of the scattered power of the God of Nature yesterday morning.

Yet, a problem arose here: if the Pestilence Spreader or other Shadows of Evil God could detect the scattered power of the God of Nature, why had Hu Bushuai remained safe and sound until now?

Could it be that to perceive the power of the God of Nature, that power had to be activated first?

For example, when he used the Treasure-Hunting Compass to examine Hu Bushuai yesterday, was that actually a process of activating the power of the God of Nature and drawing it out?

"Five years ago, during the time you said you sustained severe injuries, did anything strange happen in the Royal City and the surrounding vassal cities?"

Hu Bushuai was a very sensitive person; the moment he heard Shang Feifan's question, he reacted swiftly: "You think I brought the Shadow of Evil God here?"

"Not you. The scattered power of the God of Nature. This is just a guess of mine anyway," Shang Feifan said, slightly exasperated. "Don't go taking the blame for everything. I'm merely deducing; through your answers, I can eliminate certain conditions."

Hu Bushuai pressed his lips together: "I was severely injured five years ago and spent half a year recovering at home, hardly stepping outside at all. My family didn't tell me much about what was happening outside either. However..."

Hu Bushuai took a deep breath: "Later on, due to certain reasons, I investigated some cases involving the Shadows of Evil Gods. Five years ago, on the day I was heavily injured, a solar eclipse occurred in the Royal City. But it wasn't a normal natural eclipse; the sky suddenly turned pitch black, as if shrouded in a heavy, ominous shadow. Quite a few people died in the Royal City that day, but people die in the Royal City every single day; no one knows whether the deaths on that day were connected to the abnormal eclipse."

"Additionally, about half a year ago, I was severely injured once more, and then... the Heart-Ripper appeared."

Hu Bushuai calmed down. "Assuming that every time I am heavily injured, the power of that deity hidden within my body leaks out just a fraction, and the Shadows of Evil Gods are searching for the scattered power of that deity, then why don't they come directly after me?"

"Perhaps they lack the means for precise positioning and can only locate a general range," Shang Feifan surmised.

"Then your verification yesterday also caused that divine power to leak out a little bit? Is that what attracted the Pestilence Spreader?"

"I said this is just a guess," Shang Feifan didn't want Hu Bushuai to obsess over a dead end. "We still don't know whether those Shadows of Evil Gods are truly coming for the power of that deity. Perhaps it was simply an evil sacrificial ritual orchestrated by some beastmen who worship evil gods, which in turn attracted these Shadows of Evil Gods."

Hu Bushuai desperately wanted to ask the original host's mother: *Did you or did you not put the scattered power of that deity into the original host's body? If you did, did you know that was the power of a deity?*

Pity that the original host's mother had already passed away; even if he wanted to ask, he had no one to turn to.

"Stop," Hu Bushuai suddenly said.

Shang Feifan signaled the Fierce Beast to slow its pace and looked at Hu Bushuai: "You surely don't want to turn back?"

Hu Bushuai said calmly, "I won't enter Moluo City to court death, but I want to know what Moluo City is like now, how many people escaped, and whether that Baron Zhipang has any countermeasures. You don't need to come back with me; you just need to drop me off here. The people who escaped from Moluo City will inevitably congregate together eventually; they won't easily abandon their homeland. I'm going to that camp."

Shang Feifan: "We'll find that camp together and then await subsequent news from Moluo City. Don't refuse; you saved my life tonight. I'm a heavy sleeper, and if you hadn't rudely woken me up, I would have been one hundred percent infected by the pestilent poison. I'd probably be dead by now, and if not dead, mutated into a monster."

Ding dong.

[Quest Fifty-Six: You are uneasy about your companion Hu Bushuai and wish to help him uncover the true reason behind the appearance of the Pestilence Spreader in Moluo City. Upon finding out, reward: one high-precision scan using the quasi-player data panel and one data report. Note: Can be used on non-players.]

Shang Feifan: ...This sneaky system really understood him.

“狰爷，我们去找兽人最多的地方。”商非凡对狰爷发出明确指示。

狰爷停下脚步，似乎在分辨周围的危险程度，又像是在通过风寻找哪里兽人的气息最浓郁。

虎不帅已经知道跟商非凡争执某些事没有用，他也争不过这个人。就抬起手腕：“回头，往西边走。我听到那里传来大量兽人的声音。”

狰爷原地转了一圈，做出了同样选择。

商非凡揉了揉额头。今天发生的事都是又急又怪，从他在现实世界听到虎不帅的声音开始，他就感到他的人生貌似正在拐向一条未知的充满诡异的道路。

但……这样似乎更有意思？

商非凡神情舒展，笑了。

沿着大路奔跑了大约十来分钟后，商非凡几个就看到了一个巨大的、人声鼎沸的营地。

chunks.chapterTitle: 第57章 不讲卫生的下场 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第57章 不讲卫生的下场

商非凡忽然脚尖示意狰爷停下。

虎不帅也几乎在同时抓住了他的手臂：“不要过去，有问题。”

狰爷停下。

他们现在距离那个营地并不远，只有百米不到，但他们和那个营地之间正好有一片比较稀疏的树林挡住，对方目前还没有发现他们。

“你听到了什么？”商非凡是通过经验感觉到那个营地气氛不对，不像是逃难者营地。

虎不帅侧耳细听：“他们在祷告。他们在祭拜一个……”

随着听到的内容越多，虎不帅看向商非凡的神色就变得越发古怪。

商非凡被他看毛了：“怎么了？他们在祭拜什么？”

虎不帅：“……他们在祭拜一个邪神。”

商非凡挑眉：“祭拜邪神就祭拜邪神，可你为什么要用看邪神的眼神看我？”

虎不帅眼神不变，“我就是觉得你的嘴挺灵的。”

“灵？”商非凡突然想到大约一刻钟之前他说的一段话，好像是提到了邪神崇拜者。

不过：“我只是说了引来虫毒散播者的有可能是一帮祭祀邪神的迷信兽人，没说我们会这么快遇到他们。如果摩罗城的灾难真与他们有关，那他们出现在这里就是必然，跟我的嘴没有任何关系。”

商非凡坚决不承认自己是乌鸦嘴，他只是诅咒系学徒，每次诅咒还得付出一定代价，哪可能说什么就是什么。

虎不帅很想堵住他的嘴：“你觉得摩罗城外不到三十里的地方突然出现这么一大群邪神信徒正常吗？”

“所以你觉得他们就是引来虫毒散播者的人？”商非凡笑：“这不很好？正好说明你不是这场灾难的引子。”

虎不帅承认自己确实松了口气，但是：“我们现在还不知道这群人到底是不是引来虫毒散播者的根源，也不知道他们聚集在这里的目的。”

商非凡：“去查查看就知道了。”

“嗯。”虎不帅松开缰绳，从狰爷背部跳下。

商非凡看到虎不帅藏进树林的阴影里，一点点靠近那个营地，在心里叹了口气。拍拍狰爷，嘱咐它：“跑远点，我相信你避开危险的能力，帮我照顾好阿呆，没听到我的召唤不要来找我们。”

又对阿呆说：“小孩子晚上就该好好睡觉，现在闭眼睡觉。我没找你，就不准从狰爷身上下来，除非遇到紧急情况。”

阿呆点头。

商非凡也从狰爷身上跳下来，快速跟上虎不帅。

狰爷掉头就离开了这个满是兽人的营地，它不喜欢这里。如果不是老商非让它过来，它只会远远避开这群兽人。

虎不帅看到商非凡跟过来，也没意外，这个人嘴里说着不想惹麻烦，实际好奇心贼重，而且天不怕地不怕，似乎笃定不管发生什么事他都能应对一样。

商非凡拨开草丛。

从他们这里往营地看，能看到几百个兽人围成一个四五重的大圈，集体向圆圈中心竖立的一座雕像跪拜，同时口中大声念着什么。念一句就拜一下，非常整齐且有节奏感。

但与他们发出的巨大音量相比，他们嘴巴里就像是含了一口水，念出的词语让人听不清楚。

不说这些人的举动有多么怪异，只营地里那些散发出冷色光芒的蓝光油灯，就怎么看怎么诡异。

叮咚。

商非凡接到了新任务，调查面前的营地，看这群兽人在干什么，奖励3个贡献点。

“他们在祷告什么？祭拜的是哪个邪神？”商非凡贴近虎不帅的耳朵，轻声问。

虎不帅偏头拉开距离，装作在仔细聆听，过了一会儿才低声回答：“没有哪一个，因为不可直视、不可言说，所有的邪神都没有名字，祂们统一被叫做邪神。但在信仰崇拜邪神的迷失者中，他们通常称那些邪神为厄穆克拉索，这是古鸟人族语，翻译过来就是恐惧之神的意思。”

“恐惧之神？”商非凡想到了他遇到的那个商队老人说的故事。

之前吞噬掉整个强盗窝的怪物就是恐惧之神的奴仆，他也因此被带入一个诡异空间，后来莫名其妙又进入了雕像广场，见到了那尊自然之神的雕像，这才接到主线任务。

难道说兽人口中传播的恐惧之神就是那些外来邪神的具象物？

只是外来邪神的存在只有少数身份特别或机缘巧合的兽人才能知道，绝大多数普通兽人只把恐惧之神当做一个本土兽人在迷信观念下创造出来的非正神存在。

那么那个恐惧之神奴仆是不是也是邪神阴影者之一？

“你听过恐惧之神的奴仆吗？”商非凡又低声问。

虎不帅调动脑中记忆：“你说的是不是一个喜欢在活尸城一带游荡的恐怖传说之主？”

“对，它是那一带的固定……”商非凡差点把“野外boss”这个词说出来。

虎不帅没注意商非凡没说完的话是什么，只接口：“那边的传说很多，因为经常有商队在那里消失，导致去那边的商队也越来越少。现在那边都快成为无人地带。”

商非凡摇头：“那里有人，那里有一个天残谷。”

虎不帅有点惊讶：“我不知道，我以为那里就是一片荒野，基本没什么人居住。我记得那一带的领主就因为嫌弃自家领地太荒凉太危险，就一直住在黑森林城，领地那边似乎只每年派人过去看看。”

商非凡：怪不得那边成了玩家大本营。

“我怀疑那个恐惧之神奴仆有可能也是一个邪神阴影者，只不过它固定在那一片出现。如果它真的也是邪神阴影者，那么根据恐惧之神奴仆的来历传说，我推测其他邪神阴影者也不是凭空出现，而是被人为创造出来的。”

虎不帅冷不丁问：“你见过那个恐惧之神奴仆？”

商非凡：“没见到，但是遇到过，侥幸逃脱。”

虎不帅很想知道商非凡遇到恐惧之神奴仆的详细经过，但是他又怕自己的态度让商非凡误会，就忍住没问。

商非凡却主动跟他提到：“我在遇到那个恐惧之神奴仆后，被绑架到一个很古怪的地方。与我一起的还有一群强盗和被强盗抓住的倒霉蛋，他们当时都被一根绳子窜连在一起，神色木楞，跟被迷魂一样。”

商非凡具体描述了押队的兽人模样，又描述了他看到的那座古城。

说完，他就故意停下。

虎不帅眼睛看向那片营地，硬是没往下问。

商非凡戳他胳膊：“你怎么不问我，那些人都被迷魂，我是怎么清醒过来、又是怎么逃脱的？”

虎不帅神色淡然：“每个人都有自己的秘密，你不用告诉我那么详细。”

商非凡：看中的对象有点难搞。

“那你有没有听过那种外形的兽人和那种模样的古城池？”山不来就我，我来就山。

虎不帅摇头：“很陌生。”

他已经记下来，打算回去查查看。

大约觉得自己说话太硬，虎不帅又弥补：“所以你觉得在摩罗城出现的这个虫毒散播者也是被人为创造出来的？”

chunks.chapterTitle: 第57章 不讲卫生的下场 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡：“只是怀疑。虫毒散播者最初是什么时候出现？”

这点又问到了虎不帅的知识盲点，不禁自嘲：“看来我需要找人补充一下这方面的信息。”

“一起学习，共同进……”

“嘘！”虎不帅抬起手指。

有人往这边走过来了。

营地里的祷告似乎告一段落，原本像是在办大型喊唱会的营地突然就安静下来。

最中心的兽人移开身体，亮出他背后的一口大锅。

大锅里不知道放了什么，那领头的兽人拿起一个巨大的勺子，从大锅里舀出什么，示意周围的小头领每人喝一口，再传给下面的人。

所有人都在喝勺子里的物品。喝完了就把勺子传递回去，让那领头兽人继续舀。

走过来的兽人不是巡逻者，他们蹲到现在就没看到有兽人来巡逻。

对方很急，似乎憋久了，小跑着过来。

淅淅沥沥。

两人被迫观赏了一名雄性兽人的放水仪式。

对方释放完就快速跑回去喝神之恩赐了，半点没有发现就藏在半米远处灌木丛后的两个不速之客。

“他穿的是短裙！”商非凡小声说。

虎不帅还以为商非凡要问那些邪神信徒喝的是什么，结果……这人的关注点就是和别人不一样！

“很多地方的兽人都还保持这种穿衣风格，因为方便。”虎不帅无奈，还是解说道。

短裙只要一扯就能变身，还不用特意在裤子后面开一个洞，造价上也比成套的衣服便宜。无论从性价比还是从方便程度来说，都是短裙更受兽人欢迎。

“可那是短裙，不是兽皮裙。”商非凡只觉得眼睛疼。

他看过男人穿裙子，但那是民族风格，裙子也都很长，大多过膝。哪像刚才的兽人，那根本就是齐根超短裙！

“兽皮很贵。石布做的衣服便宜。”虎不帅幽幽说。

商非凡：“……你也有这样的小短裙吗？”

虎不帅拒绝回答。

商非凡很自觉地换了一个话题：“刚才那个兽人身上有纹身，你见过类似的吗？有没有什么特殊含义？”

虎不帅还真没怎么特别调查过邪神信徒，商非凡现在问他的问题都是他的知识盲区。

商非凡又道：“他们喝完那巫药汤好像在整队，你觉得他们打算干什么？”

虎不帅再次把手指放到嘴唇边，他正在听那个邪神信徒头领的说话。

商非凡也竖起耳朵。

但他的听力远不如虎不帅这样的听力天赋者，相隔这么远，他只能看到营地里的大致动静，听不清他们在说什么。

“他们要捕猎。”虎不帅神色难看。

“捕猎？”

“捕捉祭品。献祭给他们的神。”虎不帅补充。

“他们的捕猎对象是？”

“你觉得呢？”虎不帅的眼神已经彻底变冷。

商非凡冷静地说：“逃出来的摩罗城居民太多，逃跑时也没有一个统一方向，我们就算去通知，也通知不了所有人。”

虎不帅也知道这点，为此他只打算重点通知某些必须通知的人。

商非凡迅速说：“你去找彘庞男爵，看能不能利用你的身份，逼迫也好威胁也好，让他派兵来围剿这些邪神信徒。摩罗城的城卫兵八成以上应该都在他身边。只要他还想当他的城主，他应该也不想丧失大量劳动力。要快，趁这些邪神信徒开拔前。我在这里想办法拖延一会儿时间。”

刚说完这段话，系统就给他又发布了一个任务，就是拖延时间，直到有人来阻止这些邪神信徒出发去捕猎祭品，成功后奖励十点贡献点。

看，他都会自己给自己创造任务了。

虎不帅见商非凡这么快就想到目前难题的最佳解决办法，有点惊讶。正好他也有这个意思，但是……

“不用担心我，我有办法自保。我还没泡到你，怎么会舍得现在就牺牲自己。”商非凡对虎不帅眨了眨眼。

虎不帅木然脸。

商非凡就跟不知道自己说了什么话一样，神色顶顶自然地说：“我去召唤狰爷，让他带你……”

“不用。”虎不帅轻声说：“我有办法更快找到彘庞男爵他们。”

说完，虎不帅就猫腰往树林外走，很快就跑不见。

商非凡摸摸嘴唇，把注意力转向不远处的营地。

那群邪神信徒人数很多，目测不下于五百人，除非他架着坦克和机枪过去，否则想要拦住这些人就是痴人做梦。

直接闯，没可能。

那就只能另想办法拖延。

商非凡翻了翻自己的技能库，看来看去似乎也只有诅咒这个技能比较好用。

就是不知道这种针对多数人的大面积诅咒需要付出多少代价。

这笔生意好像有点亏啊。

商非凡用资本家的目光挑剔地打量那个营地，就带这么点东西？差评！

不想自己付出莫大代价的商非凡悄悄摸近那片营地。

他不贪，只要抓几个祭品就可以——想要抓别人当祭品的人自然也要有自己也变成祭品的觉悟。

在靠近营地后，商非凡从雕像广场摸出一袋鹅卵石。

这袋鹅卵石是他在经过一片溪流滩时特意捡的，捡了很多。

这些鹅卵石都有他的巴掌大，溜圆，掂到手里还很有份量。

特别适合他这种天赋能力为“力大无穷”还自带准星的人。

商非凡举起一枚鹅卵石，瞄准营地正中间一名兽人，手臂后仰，手腕用力一甩。

啪！

鹅卵石正正击中那名兽人的额头。

血花迸溅，那兽人连惨叫都没发出来就昏了过去。

那兽人倒下，周围的兽人这才发现异常，顿时，圆圈中心出现了一点骚乱。

要的就是你的乱！

商非凡手腕用力投掷出第二枚鹅卵石。

啪！又一名邪神信徒倒下。

商非凡迅速转换位置，投掷出第三枚鹅卵石。

当第二个兽人倒下时，那些邪神信徒就发现不对劲了，领头的人大喊：“有人偷袭！各自躲避！”

还有人在喊：“找到偷袭者！”

“啊啊啊！”第三个兽人有了提防，脑袋晃了一下，没被砸晕，但也被砸得头破血流大声惨叫。

偷袭的鹅卵石越来越多，营地里不断响起兽人的惨叫和大骂。

原本整齐的营地也变得混乱起来，几百名邪神信徒各自找地方躲避——他们想回击，但是找不到敌人也没用！

也有兽人被头领命令拎着武器出来找寻偷袭者。

而不论是躲避的兽人还是出来找偷袭者的兽人，都没有注意到有伙伴就这么消失掉。

商非凡一共弄到五名兽人，把他们用绳索捆绑起来，拖到已经画好的诅咒阵中，把人放到献祭位，一边看着向这边靠近的邪神信徒，一边快速念出咒语。

“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯，您的信徒正在向您献上祭品，请您诅咒那些不信仰您的邪神信徒，惩罚他们，让他们全都食物中毒腹痛拉肚子到无法行动吧。”

让你们乱喝东西还不讲卫生共用一个勺子。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan: "It's just a suspicion. When did the insect poison spreaders first appear?"

This hit another of Hu Bushuai's blind spots, making him chuckle self-deprecatingly. "Looks like I'll need to find someone to fill me in on that."

"We can learn together and make prog—"

"Shh!" Hu Bushuai raised a finger.

Someone was approaching.

The prayer in the camp seemed to have drawn to a close. The campsite, which had previously sounded like a massive concert, suddenly fell quiet.

The beastman in the very center moved aside, revealing a massive cauldron behind him.

It was unclear what was inside the cauldron. The chief beastman picked up a huge ladle, scooped something out of the cauldron, and gestured for the surrounding minor leaders to take a sip each before passing it down the ranks.

Everyone was drinking from the ladle. Once finished, they passed the ladle back so the chief beastman could scoop out more.

The beastman walking over was not a patroller; they hadn't seen a single guard on patrol since they began crouching here.

He was in a great hurry, looking like he'd been holding it in for a long time, trotting over quickly.

*Pitter-patter.*

The two were forced to witness a male beastman's draining ceremony.

Once he finished relieving himself, he hurried back to drink the "Divine Grace," entirely failing to notice the two uninvited guests hidden in the bushes barely half a meter away.

"He's wearing a short skirt!" Shang Feifan whispered.

Hu Bushuai had assumed Shang Feifan was going to ask what those evil god cultists were drinking, but instead... this guy's focus was truly unlike anyone else's!

"Beastmen in many regions still stick to this style of clothing because it's convenient," Hu Bushuai explained helplessly.

A short skirt could easily be pulled up when transforming without needing to cut a tailhole in pants, and it was cheaper to make than a full outfit. Whether in terms of cost-effectiveness or convenience, short skirts were much more popular among beastmen.

"But that's a miniskirt, not an animal hide kilt," Shang Feifan said, feeling his eyes burn.

He had seen men wear skirts before, but those were ethnic garments, long and mostly past the knees. Nothing like the beastman just now—that was practically a thigh-high ultra-miniskirt!

"Animal hides are expensive. Clothing made of stone-cloth is cheap," Hu Bushuai said dryly.

Shang Feifan: "...Do you have a little short skirt like that too?"

Hu Bushuai declined to answer.

Shang Feifan tactfully switched topics: "The beastman just now had tattoos on him. Have you seen anything similar? Does it have any special meaning?"

Hu Bushuai genuinely hadn't investigated evil god cultists in detail; all the questions Shang Feifan asked fell into his knowledge blind spots.

Shang Feifan added, "After drinking that witch-soup, they seem to be assembling in formation. What do you think they're planning to do?"

Hu Bushuai placed a finger to his lips once more, listening intently to the evil god cult leader speaking.

Shang Feifan perked up his ears as well.

However, his hearing was far inferior to someone like Hu Bushuai, who possessed innate hearing talents. At such a distance, he could only observe the general activity in the camp, unable to make out what they were saying.

"They're going to hunt," Hu Bushuai said, his expression grim.

"Hunt?"

"Catch sacrifices. To offer to their god," Hu Bushuai added.

"Their targets are...?"

"What do you think?" Hu Bushuai's eyes turned icy cold.

Shang Feifan said calmly, "Too many residents escaped from Molo City, and they scattered in all directions. Even if we go to warn them, we won't be able to reach everyone."

Hu Bushuai knew this as well, which was why he only planned to notify certain essential individuals.

Shang Feifan quickly said, "Go find Baron Zhi Pang. See if you can use your status—whether through pressure or threats—to make him send troops to eradicate these cultists. Over eighty percent of Molo City's guard force should be with him. As long as he still wants to be city lord, he won't want to lose a massive labor force. Hurry, before these cultists march out. I'll stay here and find a way to buy some time."

Just as he finished saying this, the system issued him another quest: Delay time until reinforcements arrive to stop the evil god cultists from setting off to hunt sacrifices. Success reward: 10 Contribution Points.

Look at that, he was learning to generate quests for himself.

Hu Bushuai was slightly surprised to see Shang Feifan devise the optimal solution to their dilemma so quickly. It happened to align with his own thoughts, but...

"Don't worry about me, I have ways to stay safe. I haven't even wooed you yet—how could I bear to sacrifice myself now?" Shang Feifan winked at Hu Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai gave him a deadpan look.

As if completely unaware of what he had just blurted out, Shang Feifan said with total composure, "I'll summon Master Zheng to carry you..."

"No need," Hu Bushuai whispered. "I have a faster way to find Baron Zhi Pang and the others."

With that, Hu Bushuai crouched low and headed toward the outer tree line, disappearing in moments.

Shang Feifan touched his lips and turned his attention back to the nearby camp.

The cultists were numerous, visibly no fewer than five hundred. Unless he brought over a tank and a machine gun, stopping them head-on was a pipe dream.

A direct assault was impossible.

In that case, he could only think of another way to delay them.

Shang Feifan browsed his skill library. Looking through it, only the Curse skill seemed practical.

He just didn't know how steep a price a wide-area curse targeted at a large crowd would cost.

This deal felt like a net loss.

Shang Feifan critically sized up the camp with the eye of a ruthless capitalist. *They only brought this little stuff? One star review!*

Unwilling to pay a hefty price himself, Shang Feifan quietly crept closer to the camp.

He wasn't greedy; he only needed to kidnap a few sacrifices. Anyone planning to hunt others for sacrifices naturally had to be prepared to become sacrifices themselves.

After approaching the camp, Shang Feifan pulled out a bag of cobbles from the Statue Plaza.

This bag of cobbles was something he had specifically picked up while passing a riverbank stream, gathering quite a lot.

Each cobble was the size of his palm, round and smooth, carrying a satisfying heft in his hand.

Extremely suited for someone like him whose innate ability was "Herculean Strength" combined with built-in aiming crosshairs.

Shang Feifan raised a cobble, aimed at a beastman right in the center of the camp, drew his arm back, and snapped his wrist forward.

*Thwack!*

The cobble struck the beastman squarely on the forehead.

Blood spattered, and before the beastman could even utter a scream, he was knocked out cold.

Only when the beastman collapsed did the surrounding cultists notice something amiss. Instantly, a small commotion erupted at the center of the ring.

*Chaos is exactly what I want!*

Shang Feifan snapped his wrist and hurled a second cobble.

*Thwack!* Another cultist fell.

Shang Feifan rapidly shifted positions and threw a third cobble.

When the second beastman went down, the cultists realized something was wrong. Their leader bellowed, "Ambush! Take cover!"

Others shouted, "Find the attacker!"

"Arghhh!" The third beastman had been on guard and jerked his head slightly; he wasn't knocked unconscious, but his skull was cracked open, bleeding profusely as he shrieked in pain.

More and more cobbles flew in from the ambush, and screams and curses continuously echoed across the camp.

The originally orderly camp devolved into chaos. Hundreds of cultists scattered to find shelter—they wanted to counterattack, but without finding the enemy, it was useless!

Some beastmen were ordered by their leaders to grab weapons and search for the sniper.

Yet whether taking shelter or searching for the attacker, none of the beastmen noticed that several of their comrades were quietly vanishing.

Shang Feifan secured five beastmen in total, tied them up with ropes, dragged them into the prepared curse array, and set them onto the sacrifice positions. Eyeing the cultists approaching his location, he rapidly chanted the incantation:

"O supreme and magnificent existence, Conizerus, God of Curses! Your believer presents these sacrifices to You. Please curse those evil god cultists who do not believe in You—punish them, strike them with food poisoning, abdominal cramps, and diarrhea until they are rendered completely immobile!"

*That's what you get for drinking random stuff, neglecting hygiene, and sharing a single ladle.*

chunks.chineseText:
第58章 诅咒的效果

虎不帅紧赶慢赶带着彘庞男爵亲自统帅的城卫军向邪神信徒的营地赶去。

他十分担心商非凡能不能拖住那些邪神信徒，那可不是几个几十个兽人，而是几百个！

好吧，他担心商非凡受伤。

是他执意要掉头找人，结果就那么不巧地碰上邪神信徒聚会，虽然这也让他们提前得知这些人想要追捕摩罗城逃出居民当祭品的阴谋，但是……

虎不帅不想把任何一个人牵扯到与他有关的负面事务中，不管对方是谁。

幸好彘庞男爵虽然有着贵族的通病，但他至少是个还算头脑清醒的贵族。就如商非凡所说，他逃出摩罗城只是仓促下的无奈之举，作为一名领主，他绝不想轻易放弃自己的领土和领民。

彘庞可以不珍惜领民，可以把领民都当蝼蚁看，但他也深知如果没有这些领民，他就是光杆领主。一座繁华的城市必须要有人去创造和当基础。

所以当彘庞男爵听虎不帅说摩罗城的灾难并不是随机的倒霉事件，而是人为。且那些在背后搞鬼的人还想捕捉更多的出逃城民当做他们献给邪神的祭品后，彘庞男爵气炸了！

他恐惧邪神阴影者，但一群邪神信徒？

只要他们还是活生生的兽人，他就没有怕的！

必须去围剿！

必须去干死他们！

彘庞男爵当即就让长子彘圭原地留守，亲自带领七成的城卫军杀向邪神信徒营地。

虎不帅有没有可能说谎？

这是不是一个调虎离山之计？

彘庞男爵是有怀疑，他为此也做了一些准备，但本意他还是愿意冒这个险。不为其他，就是为了报仇！

他那么大那么繁华那么好的一座摩罗城，现在已经毁了一半！

他怎么可能不恨不想报复？

他更想知道那些邪神信徒的行为到底是自发，还是被什么人指使。

虎不帅在天空飞，一只巨大禽鸟驮着他，这是他召唤来的帮手。

下面彘庞男爵骑在巨虫坐骑身上，率领五千城卫杀气腾腾地狂奔。

“到了！过了小树林就是！”虎不帅在天空投掷下火把之路，指挥巨鸟俯冲而下。

这时他们也不怕惊动那些邪神信徒，抢的就是一个快字。

彘庞男爵抓住一把一头点燃的长矛，站在巨虫背脊上，身体后仰，用力投掷出点燃的长矛，一声爆喝：“冲！杀！”

数千支点燃的长矛齐齐飞向邪神信徒营地。

这就是第一波攻击，先把他们的阵脚打乱。

点燃的长矛不仅可以伤人，还可以充当火把。当邪神信徒的营地一片火光时，他们就会看不清不远处奔袭而来的大军。

虎不帅第一个发现不对劲。

这个营地……

彘庞男爵率领的大军已经越过小树林迅速杀到。

嗯？！

彘庞男爵第一反应就是他们会不会中了埋伏。

但这像是埋伏吗？

到处都是抱着肚子哎哟叫的兽人，有人就蹲在地上不起来。

噗呲噼里啪啦的释放声不时响起，伴随着极度难闻的臭味。

落下的五千支长矛扎死扎伤了不少人，很多兽人都在哀嚎，还有兽人被长矛上的火焰点着，拼命在地上打滚灭火。

有的兽人挣扎着站起来想要逃跑。

还有人大喊着“敌人来了”。

更有许多兽人嘴里念叨着“厄穆克拉索赐我力量”，提起身边武器就要杀向彘庞男爵和他的城卫军。

这些兽人跑动中还不住排泄，那种情形怎么看怎么诡异又疯狂。

彘庞男爵下意识捂住鼻子，他身后的城卫军们也是表情扭曲，纷纷抬手捂住口鼻，这里真他妈太臭了！

巨鸟驮着虎不帅盘旋在低空不肯落下，甚至想要立刻离开这处蔓延着可怕味道的场所。

虎不帅在寻找商非凡。

“这是怎么回事？”彘庞男爵提高声音。

虎不帅在半空回复：“是我的伙伴，应该是他想办法拖住了这些邪神信徒。”

不过商非凡做得也太好了吧？

这何止是拖住，简直就是把整个邪神信徒群都给团灭了！

五百人一起拉肚子，且止都止不住，是人都知道这不正常。

彘庞男爵那边脸色扭曲了一会儿，他以为过来会有一场势均力敌的厮杀，他都做好了亲自出手的准备，没想到……

看到那些边拉还边向他们冲过来的邪神信徒，彘庞男爵手掌高举用力下斩！

领头的城卫军将领不顾臭气，高喝：“杀！一个不留！”

五千城卫军立即冲向邪神信徒的营地，见人就杀，如砍瓜切菜一般。

彘庞男爵没动，他退到了最后方。他在等待手下杀穿这个营地，等有人为他带来俘虏。

虎不帅还在半空盘旋寻找商非凡。

这人跑哪儿去了？

时间拉回。

商非凡赶在那些跑出来的邪神信徒看到他之前，念完了他的诅咒。

诅咒之神一如既往地给力，在他最后一个字刚落下不到两秒，地上的咒阵就瞬间变成黑灰，连同那五个充当祭品的邪神信徒一起。

商非凡就看到那几个奔他而来的兽人突然就捂住肚子，一个个脸色狰狞，全都是忍的。

几个兽人又坚强地夹腿跑了两步，一个兽人抬手指向他，嘴里喊着什么，他们已经发现他了！

就在他们发出吼声，拔腿冲刺过来时。

噗噗噗！

臭气弥漫。

这几个奔过来的兽人全都没能控制住括约肌。

商非凡对这几个兽人笑笑，还对他们挥了挥手，施施然地离开。

“偷袭者在这儿！”发现他的兽人狂叫，每叫一声就喷一下，到最后直接蹲地上了。

那几个兽人想要追上来，但绞痛的肚子根本不给他们机会。

他们现在只想赶紧蹲下来。

这几个兽人只是开始，等商非凡再次靠近那个营地，就听到了连串的奔放声。

商非凡掏出一条布巾系到脸上，同时把自己的嗅觉给降到最低值。

这诅咒效果绝了！想来这次的祭品让那位诅咒之神很是满意？

他不知道这些邪神信徒的杀伤力如何，但他们显然已经没有多少战斗力，如果他们能边拉边战，那他也只能喊牛逼。

营地里，众邪神信徒乱成一团。

先是有人在各个方向投掷鹅卵石伤了好些人，紧接着大家就开始闹起腹痛，而且是无法忍耐需要立刻排放的急性腹痛，邪神信徒的头领被搞得焦头烂额。

他宁可有兽人大军直接杀过来，跟他们正面硬刚！

“卑鄙无耻的小人！尽使用这些低劣下流的卑劣手段！有种你给我出来！”

只允许自己干卑劣事，不允许别人干同类事的头领怒骂。

商非凡借着阴影灵活地跳到一辆大车的顶部，趴下，等待机会。

“伟大的、不容侵犯的厄穆克拉索啊，请惩罚我们的敌人，请用您的神力毁灭他！”头领一边祷告，一边大声诅咒。

“我们是不是该离开？”一名兽人捂着肚子，脸色苍白地问。

头领脸色狰狞至极，他在强忍：“治疗祭司呢？他没办法吗？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 58: The Effect of the Curse

Hu Bushuai rushed as fast as he could, leading the city guard personally commanded by Baron Zhi Pang toward the cultist camp.

He was deeply worried about whether Shang Feifan could delay those evil god cultists. It wasn't just a few or a few dozen beastmen—there were hundreds!

Alright, he was worried Shang Feifan would get hurt.

It was his insistence on doubling back to search for people that had led to them accidentally stumbling upon the cultist gathering. Although this had allowed them to discover the conspiracy to hunt down Molo City's escaped refugees for sacrifices, still...

Hu Bushuai didn't want to involve anyone in negative affairs related to himself, no matter who they were.

Fortunately, although Baron Zhi Pang possessed the common flaws of nobility, he was at least a relatively clear-headed noble. Just as Shang Feifan had said, fleeing Molo City was merely a hasty necessity; as a lord, he definitely didn't want to give up his territory and subjects easily.

Zhi Pang might not cherish his subjects and might view them as mere ants, but he knew full well that without these subjects, he would be a lord in name only. A prosperous city required people to build and sustain its foundation.

Therefore, when Baron Zhi Pang heard from Hu Bushuai that Molo City's catastrophe was no random misfortune but human work, and that the orchestrators behind the scenes intended to capture more fleeing citizens as sacrifices to their evil god, Baron Zhi Pang blew his top!

He feared the shadowy presence of an evil god, but a group of cultists?

As long as they were living, breathing beastmen, he had nothing to fear!

They had to be encircled and wiped out!

He had to destroy them!

Baron Zhi Pang immediately ordered his eldest son, Zhi Gui, to stay behind and guard their base, while he personally led seventy percent of the city guard to charge toward the cultist camp.

Was it possible Hu Bushuai was lying?

Was this a trick to lure the tiger away from the mountain?

Baron Zhi Pang had harbored suspicions and made certain preparations, but at heart, he was willing to take the risk. For nothing else than revenge!

His city—so grand, prosperous, and wonderful—was now half-destroyed!

How could he not feel hatred? How could he not want payback?

More than that, he wanted to know whether those cultists' actions were spontaneous or masterminded by someone else.

Hu Bushuai flew through the sky, carried by a massive bird he had summoned as an assistant.

Below, Baron Zhi Pang rode atop a giant insect mount, leading five thousand guards galloping furiously with murder in their eyes.

"We're here! Just past the small wood!" Hu Bushuai tossed down a path of lit torches from above and commanded the giant bird to swoop down.

At this point, they weren't afraid of alerting the cultists; speed was paramount.

Baron Zhi Pang grabbed a spear with its tip ablaze, stood atop the giant insect's back, leaned back, and hurled the flaming spear forward with all his might, bellowing, "Charge! Kill!"

Thousands of ignited spears soared in unison toward the cultist camp.

This was the opening volley, designed to shatter their lines.

The burning spears not only injured targets but also acted as torches. When the cultist camp erupted in flames, they wouldn't be able to clearly see the massive army charging in from nearby.

Hu Bushuai was the first to notice something wrong.

This camp...

The army led by Baron Zhi Pang rushed through the small wood and arrived instantly.

Huh?!

Baron Zhi Pang's initial reaction was whether they had fallen into an ambush.

Does this look like an ambush?

Everywhere were beastmen clutching their stomachs and groaning in agony; some squatted on the ground, refusing to get up.

Spattering, bursting sounds of explosive release echoed periodically, accompanied by an utterly foul, wretched stench.

The five thousand falling spears impaled and wounded many; numerous beastmen wailed, while others set ablaze by the spear flames rolled frantically on the ground to extinguish the fire.

Some beastmen struggled to stand, attempting to flee.

Others were shouting, "The enemy is here!"

Many more mumbled, "Emukraso grant me strength," grabbing nearby weapons to charge Baron Zhi Pang and his city guard.

These beastmen were constantly defecating as they ran, creating a scene that looked bizarrely surreal and utterly insane.

Baron Zhi Pang instinctively covered his nose. Behind him, the city guards wore contorted expressions, raising their hands to cover their noses and mouths. *Dammit, it stinks too badly here!*

The giant bird carrying Hu Bushuai hovered low, refusing to land, looking ready to flee this place drenched in horror and stench immediately.

Hu Bushuai searched around for Shang Feifan.

"What's going on here?" Baron Zhi Pang raised his voice.

Hu Bushuai replied from mid-air, "It's my partner. He must have found a way to hold up these cultists."

Though... didn't Shang Feifan do *too* good a job?

This was way beyond delaying them—he had practically wiped out the entire cult single-handedly!

Five hundred people suffering from uncontrollable diarrhea simultaneously—anyone with a brain could tell this was abnormal.

Baron Zhi Pang's expression twitched for a moment. He had expected a fiercely contested battle and was even prepared to step into the fray himself. He never expected...

Seeing those cultists charging toward them while literally defecating on the run, Baron Zhi Pang raised his palm high and brought it down forcefully!

Ignoring the stench, the leading guard general bellowed, "Kill! Leave none alive!"

Five thousand city guards charged into the cultist camp, slaying everyone in sight like chopping vegetables.

Baron Zhi Pang didn't move; he retreated to the rear. He waited for his men to slaughter their way through the camp and bring him prisoners.

Hu Bushuai continued hovering in the sky, searching for Shang Feifan.

Where on earth did that guy go?

*Rewind time.*

Shang Feifan finished chanting his curse right before the cultists who rushed out could spot him.

The God of Curses was as reliable as ever. Less than two seconds after his last syllable fell, the curse array on the ground instantly dissolved into black ash, along with the five cultists serving as sacrifices.

Shang Feifan saw the beastmen sprinting toward him suddenly clutch their bellies, their faces twisting in extreme agony as they tried desperately to hold it in.

A few beastmen stoically squeezed their legs together and stumbled forward two more paces. One beastman raised a finger at him, shouting something—they had spotted him!

Just as they roared and broke into a final sprint toward him—

*Pfft, pfft, pfft!*

A foul odor wafted out.

None of these rushing beastmen managed to control their sphincters.

Shang Feifan smiled at the beastmen, gave them a polite wave, and leisurely strolled away.

"The ambusher is here!" shouted the beastman who had spotted him, squirting with every shout until he finally squatted down on the spot.

Those beastmen wanted to pursue, but their twisted, cramping intestines gave them no chance.

All they wanted now was to squat down immediately.

These beastmen were only the beginning. When Shang Feifan approached the camp again, he heard a continuous chorus of explosive release.

Shang Feifan pulled out a cloth band to tie around his face, simultaneously turning his sense of smell down to minimum.

*This curse effect is insane! Guess the God of Curses was thoroughly satisfied with the sacrifice this time?*

He didn't know how strong these cultists were in combat, but they clearly had little fighting capacity left. If they could battle while actively defecating, he would have no choice but to tip his hat in respect.

Inside the camp, the cultists were in complete disarray.

First, someone hurled cobbles from various directions, injuring quite a few people. Immediately afterward, everyone began suffering from abdominal cramps—acute, unbearable stomach pains requiring instant relief. The cult leader was driven absolutely frantic.

He would have preferred an army of beastmen charging in to clash with them head-on!

"Despicable, shameless coward! Resorting to such low, filthy tactics! Come out if you dare!"

The leader—who allowed himself to commit atrocious acts but condemned others for doing similar deeds—roared in fury.

Taking advantage of the shadows, Shang Feifan nimbly leapt onto the top of a large wagon, lay flat, and bided his time.

"O great and inviolable Emukraso! Please punish our enemy! Destroy him with Your divine power!" the leader prayed while loudly cursing.

"Should... should we leave?" a beastman asked, clutching his stomach with a pale face.

The leader's expression was hideously contorted as he held it in with all his might. "Where is the healing priest?! Can't he do anything?!"

chunks.chineseText:
“他在准备药物，但需要止泻药的人太多了。他也没有带那么多药材！”

“他不能直接治疗吗！让他过来！”他要忍不住了。

“治疗祭司也在拉肚子……他连自己都治不好，他说这不是普通的拉肚子。”

“该死的虫族诅咒！这到底是怎么回事？”

“会不会是我们喝的信徒甘露……”

“闭嘴！那不可能！那是神的恩赐！”头领暴怒。

另一名兽人痛苦道：“我们向厄穆克拉索乞求吧，祂的神力一定能治好我们。”

“拜神！”头领断然决定，随后一指刚才说错话的兽人：“他不敬厄穆克拉索，今天我们的遭遇就是神给予的惩罚和提醒！为了平息神的怒火，为了消除我们的痛苦，把这个叛徒献祭给厄穆克拉索。”

“不——！克里斯，我可是你亲……啊！”兽人脑袋低垂，被打晕了过去。

围在头领附近的几个兽人眼睛一亮，捂着肚子转身又从人群中拖出几个兽人，把他们拖到了营地中间的雕像跟前。

那几个被拖出来的兽人有人不但没有恐惧，反而荣耀一脸地高喊：“献身！献身！向伟大的厄穆克拉索献身！让我们一起成为厄穆克拉索的一部分！”

但也有人哭得眼泪鼻涕一把抓，但他们不敢反抗，甚至不敢求饶，反而跟着喊口号。

商非凡见过很多狂信者和邪-教徒，对这种场面特别平常心。

不管是什么教派，洗脑能力都一流。有些人信教就是能信到走火入魔，不但能献祭自己的爱人和血脉至亲，就是献祭自己也不在话下。

商非凡没管那些在搞邪祟牌迷信活动的兽人，他在看那尊雕像。

那似乎是一尊用木头雕刻出来的雕像，整体颜色偏黑，也许是夜晚和冷色灯光的缘故，雕像的脸部五官扭曲又阴森，无论从哪个角度看都看不到它完整的五官。

如果你盯着雕像的头脸稍微看久一点，就会感到心悸、心里发慌，就好像被什么邪恶给盯上了。

商非凡没有感到恐惧，但他有个奇怪的感觉，他觉得那尊雕像像是活的。

当他看向它时，它也在看向他。

“……”

嗯？商非凡凝神，他好像听到那尊雕像在跟他说话？

商非凡下意识警觉，他想到自己在雕像广场听到的那些杂音。如果没有诅咒之神的保护，他可能就死在那些杂音的刺激下。

商非凡守住自己的心神，不让自己去仔细聆听那尊雕像发出的声音，也不再看向那尊雕像。

商非凡还不知道他轻松挪开目光，且能不听雕像声音的举动，让某个存在有多么惊讶。

真正的注目降临。

商非凡一无所知。

那边的活人献祭活动搞到一半就崩了。

包括头领在内的所有邪神信徒全都拉得身娇体软满身芬芳，憋得越久释放得就越厉害。

偏偏他们还都穿着小短裙。

这倒是方便他们可以直接蹲在地上，但是也有人直接喷射出去……

头领还在坚持，硬是把所有祭品都给拉到雕像面前宰杀，用他们头颅的血浇灌那尊雕像。

那雕像染上鲜血，鲜血却没有落地，而是全被那尊雕像给吸收掉。

头领还跪在雕像面前念叨一些商非凡听不清楚的祷告语。

雕像突然动了一下。

商非凡：艹！

接着，那尊雕像散发出诡异的蓝色光芒，慢慢向四周扩散。

那些兽人全都瞪直了眼睛，跟看到神迹一样，脸上疯狂的神情和拉肚子的痛苦纠结到一起，互相拉扯。

“厄穆克拉索！”

“厄穆克拉索！”

“厄穆克拉索——！”

声音越来越大，加入呼喊的兽人越来越多，他们高举双臂，似乎遗忘了拉肚子的痛苦，也不顾地上脏臭，直接跪倒，喊一声拜一下。

商非凡心觉不妙，本能让他一个猛蹿，蹿到那个雕像面前，伸手碰到雕像的同时，就把雕像送进了雕像空间。

营地里的邪神信徒一下没反应过来，甚至还有人傻愣愣地看向商非凡。

戴着面巾的商非凡收起那尊雕像，没有丝毫停顿，又风一般地冲出营地。

“不——！抓住他！他带走了厄穆克拉索的雕像！抓住他！”头领伸手迟了一步，没有抓到商非凡，当即狂喊。

谁也没想到有人会突然冲出来把他们的雕像给弄没了。

正常来说，偷袭者想要趁他们病要他们命，也应该是从外围袭杀他们才对。

所有兽人都拉得爬不起来，他们就算启动也追不上那逃跑兽人的背影。有几个人好不容易站起来，也跑不出几步。

头领克里斯发疯狂怒，也不知从哪里憋出一股力量，提起武器就冲了出去，他一定要把雕像给抢回来，再杀死那个渎神者！

商非凡跑得飞快，他速度不如力量，但对比拉肚子拉到体虚的邪神信徒头领，他就是奔跑的草原狼。

一口气跑出两公里远。

商非凡突然掉头，加速冲向向他追来的邪神信徒头领。

克里斯震惊，他以为要追丢这个混蛋了，怎么这个混蛋竟然掉头向他冲击过来？

不好！

对方是故意把他引得远离营地，现在对方感到足够安全就反过来把他当做了猎物。

克里斯终于反应过来，抬手就释放攻击。

一道电光直射出去。

商非凡身体往地上一倒，一个标准的滑铲，躲过电光的同时，也把克里斯给铲飞了出去。

克里斯发出惨叫。

“我的腿！”

克里斯顾不上再次攻击，伸手去抓自己的脚踝。

他的脚踝已经变形，被铲断了！

商非凡滑铲倒地又迅速挺身跳起，就在克里斯摸向自己断掉的脚踝时，商非凡跳起，屈膝落下，膝盖重重压住克里斯的胸膛，又一拳击打在克里斯的鼻梁上。

克里斯惨叫着抬手想要回击。

唰！工兵铲的铲头划过克里斯的手腕。

血液喷溅，克里斯的右手腕掉在了地上。

商非凡丢开工兵铲，用拳头对着克里斯的胃部和脾脏部位连续击打数次。

克里斯被打得再也没有反击之力，这位邪神信徒头领也会疼也会恐惧。

他不知道这是从哪里冒出来的杀神，明明对方也没有使出什么特殊手段，但对方光是速度和力道就十分可怕。而且对方明显非常善于搏击术，动作干净利落，几乎没有一丝多余动作。

商非凡把这个邪神信徒头领打到干呕痉挛，这才放过他。

随后他掏出一卷绳子，把这个兽人的四肢和脖颈等部位用一种看起来十分别扭的姿势给捆绑起来。

这个姿势可以保证无论对方怎么扭动挣扎，都用不上力，更无法挣脱。

商非凡拿出一个水囊，拧开盖子，把里面的冷水泼向兽人的脸。

克里斯呻-吟着恢复了一点神智。

商非凡扒开他的眼皮看了看，又用力按了下他断掉的鼻梁。

“啊——！”这次克里斯是真清醒过来。

商非凡也不管兽人那断掉的手腕还在喷血，就直接进入拷问环节。
chunks.englishText:
"He's preparing medicine, but far too many people need antidiarrheals! He didn't bring that many medicinal ingredients!"

"Can't he just heal us directly?! Tell him to get over here!" He could barely hold it in much longer.

"The healing priest is having diarrhea too... He can't even heal himself! He says this isn't normal diarrhea."

"Damned Zerg curse! What on earth is going on?"

"Could it be the Believer's Nectar we drank...?"

"Shut up! Impossible! That is a divine blessing from God!" the leader roared in rage.

Another beastman said in pain, "Let us pray to Emuklaso. His divine power will surely heal us."

"Pray to God!" the leader declared decisively, then pointed at the beastman who had just spoken out of line. "He blasphemed Emuklaso! Our suffering today is a divine punishment and warning from God! To appease God's wrath and end our agony, sacrifice this traitor to Emuklaso!"

"No—! Chris, I'm your own blood... ah!" The beastman's head slumped forward as he was knocked unconscious.

The eyes of several beastmen surrounding the leader lit up. Clutching their stomachs, they turned and dragged a few more beastmen out of the crowd, pulling them up to the statue at the center of the camp.

Among those dragged out, some showed no fear at all. Instead, their faces shone with fanatical glory as they shouted, "Sacrifice! Sacrifice! Offer yourselves to the great Emuklaso! Let us all become part of Emuklaso!"

Others wept hysterically, tears and snot streaming down their faces, yet they dared not resist or even beg for mercy—they could only chant the slogans along with the rest.

Shang Feifan had seen plenty of fanatics and cultists, so he remained completely unfazed by such a scene.

No matter the sect, their brainwashing capabilities were always top-tier. Some people became so hopelessly obsessed with religious devotion that they wouldn't hesitate to sacrifice their lovers, blood relatives, or even themselves.

Shang Feifan paid no mind to the beastmen engaged in their sinister superstitious ritual. His gaze was fixed on that statue.

It appeared to be a wooden statue, darkish in color. Perhaps owing to the night air and the cold light, the features on its face were twisted and eerie; no matter the angle, one could never get a full, clear view of its facial features.

If you stared at the statue's face for even a little too long, your heart would palpitate with a creeping panic, as if some evil entity were glaring down at you.

Shang Feifan felt no fear, but he had a strange sensation—he felt as though the statue was alive.

When he looked at it, it was looking back at him.

"..."

Hm? Shang Feifan focused his mind. Did he just hear the statue speaking to him?

Instantly on guard, Shang Feifan remembered the strange static noise he had heard back at the Statue Square. If not for the protection of the God of Curses, he might have perished under the mental assault of those noises.

Shang Feifan guarded his mind tightly, refusing to listen closely to the sound emanating from the statue or look at it any longer.

Shang Feifan had no idea how astounded a certain entity was by his ability to casually avert his gaze and block out the statue's voice.

A true gaze descended.

Shang Feifan remained blissfully unaware.

Meanwhile, the human sacrifice ritual collapsed halfway through.

Every single evil god follower, including their leader, had suffered such severe diarrhea that their limbs were limp and they reeked of "fragrance"—the longer they held it in, the more explosive the release.

To make matters worse, they were all wearing short skirts.

While this made it convenient for them to squat right where they were, some ended up blasting it straight out...

The leader persevered, forcing himself to drag all the sacrifices before the statue, slaughtering them and drenching the statue in blood from their severed heads.

As the blood coated the statue, not a single drop fell to the ground; it was all absorbed by the statue itself.

The leader remained kneeling before the statue, chanting prayers that Shang Feifan could not hear clearly.

Suddenly, the statue twitched.

Shang Feifan: *Fuck!*

Then, the statue radiated an eerie blue light that slowly expanded outward.

The beastmen's eyes went wide as if witnessing a divine miracle. The fanatical mania on their faces twisted together with the agony of their diarrhea.

"Emuklaso!"

"Emuklaso!"

"Emuklaso—!"

Their voices grew louder and louder as more beastmen joined in the chanting. Raising their arms, they seemed to forget the stomach-wrenching pain and ignored the filth and stench on the ground, falling to their knees and kowtowing with every shout.

Sensing imminent danger, instinct kicked in. Shang Feifan darted forward like a pouncing predator, lunged in front of the statue, touched it, and instantly banished it into his Statue Space.

The evil god cultists in the camp failed to react immediately; some even stared blankly at Shang Feifan.

Wearing his face scarf, Shang Feifan stashed the statue away and, without missing a beat, sprinted out of the camp like a gust of wind.

"No—! Catch him! He stole the statue of Emuklaso! Catch him!" The leader reached out a second too late, failing to grab Shang Feifan, and screamed hysterically.

Nobody had expected someone to charge out of nowhere and make off with their sacred statue.

Normally, if an ambusher wanted to kick them while they were down, they should have picked them off from the perimeter.

All the beastmen were so weakened by diarrhea that they couldn't even stand up. Even if they tried to run, they couldn't possibly catch up with the fleeing figure. A few managed to stagger up, only to collapse after a couple of steps.

Driven into a frenzy of rage, the leader, Chris, somehow mustered a sudden burst of strength. Grabbing his weapon, he charged out. He had to reclaim the statue and slaughter that blasphemer!

Shang Feifan ran at breakneck speed. Though his speed wasn't as high as his strength, compared to a cult leader drained by severe diarrhea, he was like a steppe wolf in full stride.

He sprinted two kilometers in a single breath.

Then, Shang Feifan suddenly whipped around and charged straight back at the pursuing cult leader!

Chris was stunned. He thought he was about to lose the bastard, so why was the bastard turning around and rushing at him?!

Oh no!

The bastard had intentionally lured him far away from the camp! Now that the attacker felt safe enough, he was turning the tables and treating him like prey!

Realization dawning, Chris raised his hand and unleashed an attack.

A bolt of lightning shot forth.

Shang Feifan dropped low, executing a textbook slide. Slipping under the lightning bolt, he sent Chris flying into the air with his slide.

Chris shrieked in agony.

"My leg!"

Unable to launch another attack, Chris grabbed at his ankle.

His ankle was grotesquely deformed—snapped clean in two!

Shang Feifan popped back up from the ground in one fluid motion. As Chris reached for his broken ankle, Shang Feifan leaped, coming down knee-first heavily onto Chris's chest, while slamming a fist right into the bridge of his nose.

Screaming in agony, Chris raised an arm to counterattack.

*Swish!* The edge of an entrenching shovel sliced across Chris's wrist.

Blood sprayed everywhere as Chris's right hand flew off, hitting the ground.

Tossing the entrenching shovel aside, Shang Feifan delivered a series of brutal punches to Chris's stomach and spleen.

Chris was beaten into utter helplessness. Even a cult leader of an evil god felt pain and terror.

He had no idea where this god of slaughter had sprung from. The stranger hadn't used any extravagant abilities, yet his raw speed and strength were terrifying. Moreover, he was clearly a master of hand-to-hand combat, his movements crisp, efficient, and devoid of wasted motion.

Shang Feifan beat the cult leader until he was dry-heaving and convulsing before finally stopping.

He then produced a roll of rope and bound the beastman's limbs and neck in an awkward, restrictive posture.

This position ensured that no matter how the target writhed or struggled, they couldn't exert any force, making escape impossible.

Shang Feifan took out a canteen, unscrewed the cap, and splashed cold water over the beastman's face.

Chris groaned, regaining a sliver of consciousness.

Shang Feifan pried his eyelids open to inspect them, then pressed firmly down on his broken nose.

"AAAAGH—!" This time, Chris was completely snapped awake.

Ignoring the beastman's severed wrist that was still spouting blood, Shang Feifan launched right into the interrogation.

chunks.chineseText:
“我有一些问题要问你，你最好如实回答，这样你也能快点去见厄穆克拉索。”

商非凡拍拍兽人的脸，按住他断掉的鼻梁：“你也可以编假话骗我，或者当一个英雄闭紧你的嘴巴，不过这样我保证你的痛苦会不断延长。与其受一堆罪再开口，还不如一开始就交代，这才是聪明人的做法。你说呢？”

克里斯痛苦地发出低嚎，生理眼泪不受控制地往外疯狂涌出。

这到底是哪里来的魔鬼！

我和他比，到底谁才是恶人！

“我不会说！我什么都不会说！你这个魔鬼，厄穆克拉索会惩罚你！厄穆克拉索的荣耀和光辉永远笼罩我！厄穆克拉索——！”

克里斯眼睛睁到极大，呼吸戛然而止。

商非凡：“……”

竟然就这么死了？

商非凡不可置信地查探对方的鼻息和心跳。

没错，就是死了。

商非凡检查又检查，最后不得不接受这个事实。

“这些邪神信徒，尤其是头领，果然有些诡异在身上。”

商非凡低喃，转头就去找那只被他砍掉的手腕。

这个兽人的攻击就是从他那只手腕发出，但不是通过他的手，而是通过他戴在手指上的……

商非凡从断手的手指上拔下一个指套。

“炼金武器？”可惜他鉴定术未开。

商非凡也不知道这个指套要怎么用，戴到自己手上没有任何特殊反应。

也许该输入能量？比如精神力或其他什么……

商非凡正想尝试，他的眼角余光忽然瞥见倒在地上的兽人尸体似乎有了什么古怪变化。

商非凡走近那具尸体，低头看。

没错，这具尸体在变异。

他身上出现了越来越多的虫族特征。

等等！这具尸体并没有埋入大地，更没有过上一夜，为什么他的尸体也开始出现虫族变异？

是立刻烧掉这具尸体，还是等其变异结束？

商非凡几乎没怎么犹豫，就决定等这具尸体变异结束。

他要亲眼看着这具尸体的全变异过程。
chunks.englishText:
"I have a few questions for you. You'd better answer truthfully so you can go see Emuklaso sooner."

Shang Feifan patted the beastman's cheek and pressed down on his broken nose. "You could lie to me, or play the hero and keep your mouth shut, but I guarantee that will only prolong your agony. Rather than suffering a mountain of torture before spilling your guts anyway, wouldn't it be smarter to just talk from the start? What do you say?"

Chris groaned in torment, tears overflowing uncontrollably from his eyes.

Where on earth did this devil come from?!

Between him and me, who's the real evil one here?!

"I won't talk! I won't say a word! You devil, Emuklaso will punish you! The glory and radiance of Emuklaso envelope me forever! Emuklaso—!"

Chris's eyes bulged wide, and his breathing abruptly ceased.

Shang Feifan: "..."

He actually died just like that?

Disbelieving, Shang Feifan checked his breath and pulse.

Indeed, he was dead.

Shang Feifan checked again and again, finally having to accept reality.

"These cultists of evil gods, especially their leaders, really do have something bizarre going on with them."

Shang Feifan muttered, turning around to look for the hand he had severed.

The beastman's attack had originated from that wrist, but not through his hand—rather, through what he wore on his finger...

Shang Feifan pulled a finger sleeve off the severed hand's finger.

"An alchemy weapon?" Unfortunately, he hadn't unlocked his Appraisal skill.

Shang Feifan didn't know how to use the finger sleeve either. Putting it on his own hand produced no special reaction.

Perhaps it required an input of energy? Like mental power or something else...

Shang Feifan was about to give it a try when out of the corner of his eye, he noticed a strange change occurring in the corpse lying on the ground.

Shang Feifan walked over to the body and looked down.

Sure enough, the corpse was mutating.

More and more Zerg characteristics were appearing on its body.

Wait! This corpse hadn't been buried in the ground, nor had a night passed—why was it already undergoing Zerg mutation?

Should he burn the body immediately, or wait until the mutation finished?

With hardly a second thought, Shang Feifan decided to wait until the mutation completed.

He wanted to witness the full process of this corpse's mutation with his own eyes.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第59章 变异虫尸的溃散能量 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第59章 变异虫尸的溃散能量

整个变异过程看起来就像是几千万年的进化压缩在了短短十几分钟内。

或者不该叫做进化？

异变？

未知方向的基因干扰？

不管这个过程叫什么，商非凡亲眼看到一个只是具有兽人耳朵和尾巴的人类异变成了一只体长约两米的…虫兽。

虫子和野兽的结合体，看不出丝毫人类痕迹。

除了原本的兽体四肢，又长出了两只属于虫族的前肢，背部也出现了甲虫类的翅膀，头部则变得尖锐，头顶还有触须，嘴巴变成可以分开的上下颚，眼睛鼓出还多出两只。

变化最大的是躯干部位，像是刺猬，但竖起来的尖刺全都是坚硬锋利的骨刺。

它的腹部也裂成了两半，就好像从脖颈到小腹长出了一张竖着的嘴巴。

嘴巴里自然有牙齿，一排又一排，又尖又长又密集。

这绝对是一只食肉怪物！

突然！

这异变怪物的胸膛开始起伏。

它竟然重新活了过来！

啪！

怪物睁开了闭合的眼睛。

里面露出的也是虫类瞳孔。

怪物的大脑似乎还有一部分记忆，看到商非凡的同时，眼中立刻流露出强烈恨意。

怪物用力扑向商非凡。

砰！

怪物的半身砸在地上。

它身上还捆着绳索，肢体、躯干、翅膀和头颈全都被拘束住。

怪物拼命挣扎，嘴里还发出了蛐蛐一样激烈的鸣叫声。

忽然，怪物的身体肌肉一阵抖动，它尽力收缩背部肌肉，再用力一崩。

噗噗噗！

一连十几根骨刺激射而出，刺向商非凡。

商非凡手一抬，一张铁板竖立在面前。这是他用来做铁板烧的厨具，必要时也可以拿来当盾牌。

哚哚哚。十来根骨刺竟然全部扎入一厘米后的铁板。

商非凡在看到怪物身体肌肉不正常抖动时，就猜出它可能会有所行动，这也让他提前一步拿出了铁板。

不管是喷毒液还是喷骨刺，这张铁板都能抵挡一下。

现在铁板效果还不错。

商非凡正要举着铁板靠近怪物。

那怪物猛地昂起头，嘴里发出尖锐的鸣叫，拼命向一个方向挣扎。

商非凡：？

与此同时，邪神信徒营地。

对于数百名拉肚子拉到没力气反抗的邪神信徒，城卫军们几乎没费什么力气，就把人砍得七七八八。

要不是为了留几个俘虏好拷问口供，他们一个活人都不会留下。

可就在他们控制住十来个俘虏，想要把他们拖到男爵面前时，这十来个俘虏有大半突然高喊：“厄穆克拉索！厄穆克拉索会惩罚你！厄穆克拉索的荣耀和光辉永远笼罩我！让我成为您的一部分——！”

高喊的兽人在喊完后就全都在一瞬间咽气。

城卫军们傻眼了。

发生了什么事？

“注意那几个还活着的！别让他们自杀！”头领迅速喊道。

但来不及了。

剩下的几个活口也不知道是不是受到刺激还是蛊惑，也同时喊起厄穆克拉索的名字。

看守的城卫军有一个动作最快，扯下自己的汗巾一把塞进距离他最近的邪神信徒嘴里。

其他城卫军看到同伴的动作，立刻仿照，但除了一个最慢喊话的，其他邪神信徒俘虏也都在喊完口号后神秘死亡。

这下好了，俘虏竟然只剩下两个。

问题是他们必须堵着俘虏的嘴，才能避免他们神秘死亡。可想要他们招供，总得让他们说话吧？

城卫军们也想不出好办法，干脆就把这两个人拖到男爵面前，让男爵来决定。

但就在他们把仅余的两个俘虏拖到男爵面前时，还在低空盘旋的虎不帅突然大声警告：“小心！那些死去的兽人都在变化！”

彘庞男爵顾不得拷问口供，他用布巾捂住口鼻，靠近那些被杀死的邪神信徒，很快就发现他们身上的异变。

“虫族诅咒？！”

“见鬼！变异速度怎么会这么快？”

彘庞男爵可没有那份好奇心，他平生受到的教育和接收过的常识都让他立即下达了一个命令：“快把这些尸体全都烧了！一个都不要留，全都烧成灰！”

“如果来不及焚烧尸体，就先把他们脑袋砍了，要彻底砍下来！”虎不帅给出建议。

彘庞男爵一挥手。

城卫军们也看到了死去邪神信徒的变化，不用头领要求，就开始集中火力焚烧这些变异中的尸体。

五千名城卫军大约有二十多人的手指尖喷出火焰，有的人火焰强盛，有的人虚弱。有的人火焰温度高，有的人火焰温度和烟头差不多。

但不管施法者是谁，这些放火者的手指都套着指套、戒指之类的炼金物品。

其他没有特别天赋的城卫军则负责砍脑袋和查缺补漏，一边弄来燃烧物，同时检查附近有没有逃出的邪神信徒，一边把那些砍过脑袋的尸体全都集中到一处，方便同伴焚烧。

还有人在检查营地，查看那些邪神信徒带来的物品。

“男爵阁下，请城卫军们加快速度！这些死尸的变异速度太快！”虎不帅再次警告。

最糟糕的是，虎不帅发现那些被砍掉脑袋的尸体并没有停止变异，反而造成脑袋和身体各变异各的。

这一幕实在太诡异。

彘庞男爵也亲眼看到，他也不至于在这时候拉胯，立刻命令手下加快焚烧尸体的速度。

虎不帅没能找到商非凡，只能先落到彘庞男爵身边。

那只承载他的巨鸟放下虎不帅就飞跑了，他实在受不住这里的臭味！

“我需要更多情报。”彘庞男爵脸色阴沉。

这位身材和面容都十分削瘦，加上嘴角边深刻的两条法令纹，给人有些微的刻薄感。

虎不帅：“我目前知道的和阁下一样多，甚至没有阁下多。”

虎不帅语音一顿：“从男爵阁下带出来的车辆数目和人手就可以看出，阁下应该是在警钟鸣响前就收拾好了东西。”

虎不帅不带任何批判和不满，就很平淡地：“阁下也是第一批逃出摩罗城的贵族，阁下还带着城卫军一起逃了。”

彘庞男爵也没有丝毫被挑衅的怒意，“你想说什么？说我留下城卫军会帮助更多城民逃出来？不，那只会让我损失更多人手。”

“阁下不用担心，我不会越线管你是怎么管理和对待你的领地和领民。”虎不帅眼神冰冷，“我只是想要知道阁下提前知道了什么消息，是谁传递给你，以及阁下是否知道虫毒散播者出现在摩罗城的原因。”

彘庞男爵皮笑肉不笑：“你说你不会越线，那么请问，你现在又是用什么身份在问我话？我记得你已经不是宫廷侍卫，就算你还是，没有王命，你也不能……”

彘庞男爵突然收声。

他看到了虎不帅刚刚亮出来的一枚骨牌。

那是一枚黑色骨牌。

代表着特别调查局的身份。

更让彘庞男爵忌惮的是，虎不帅手中的黑色骨牌上还有两条金线。

该死的！谁说这家伙的母亲死去后就失去虎王宠爱，不得不狼狈离开王城？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 59: Dissipating Energy of the Mutated Insect Corpse

The entire mutation process looked like tens of millions of years of evolution compressed into a mere dozen minutes.

Or perhaps it shouldn't be called evolution?

Mutation?

Genetic interference toward an unknown direction?

Whatever the process was called, Shang Feifan watched with his own eyes as a humanoid who merely had beastman ears and a tail transformed into a... insectoid beast roughly two meters long.

A hybrid of insect and beast, devoid of any human trace.

In addition to its original beast limbs, two insectoid forelimbs had sprouted. Beetle-like wings emerged on its back, while its head grew sharp with antennae at the crown. Its mouth had become split upper and lower jaws, and two additional bulged eyes had popped out.

The torso saw the most radical change; it resembled a hedgehog, but the erect quills were all hard, sharp bone spurs.

Its abdomen had split down the middle as well, as if a vertical mouth had grown from its neck all the way down to its lower abdomen.

Naturally, this mouth bristled with teeth—row upon row of sharp, long, densely packed fangs.

This was undeniably a carnivorous monster!

Suddenly!

The chest of the mutated monster began to rise and fall.

It had actually come back to life!

*Snap!*

The monster opened its closed eyes.

Revealing pupils characteristic of insects inside.

A fraction of memory seemed to linger in the monster's brain; the moment it saw Shang Feifan, intense hatred flashed in its eyes.

The monster lunged violently at Shang Feifan.

*Bang!*

Half of the monster's body slammed onto the ground.

The rope was still bound around it, restraining its limbs, torso, wings, head, and neck.

The monster struggled frantically, letting out harsh, cricket-like chirps from its mouth.

Suddenly, the muscles across the monster's body quivered. It contracted its back muscles as much as possible, then violently snapped them outward.

*Pfft-pfft-pfft!*

More than a dozen bone spurs shot out like projectiles toward Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan raised his hand, deploying an iron plate right in front of him. This was a cooking utensil he used for teppanyaki, but in times of need, it served quite well as a shield.

*Thump, thump, thump.* The dozen bone spurs actually embedded themselves into the centimeter-thick iron plate.

Seeing the abnormal twitching in the monster's muscles, Shang Feifan had anticipated a sudden attack, allowing him to pull out the iron plate a step ahead.

Whether it spat venom or shot bone spurs, this iron plate could block the assault.

The iron plate had proven its worth nicely.

Just as Shang Feifan was about to hold the iron plate and advance toward the monster...

The monster suddenly threw its head back, emitting a piercing screech while straining desperately in one direction.

Shang Feifan: ?

Meanwhile, at the cult camp.

Facing hundreds of evil god cultists who were too weak from diarrhea to resist, the City Guard barely exerted any effort to slaughter most of them.

If not to spare a few captives for interrogation, they wouldn't have left a single soul alive.

Yet just as they restrained a dozen captives and were about to drag them before the Baron, more than half of them suddenly screamed at the top of their lungs: "Emuklaso! Emuklaso will punish you! The glory and radiance of Emuklaso envelope me forever! Let me become a part of You—!"

The moment they finished shouting, the beastmen breathed their last all at once.

The City Guards were dumbfounded.

What on earth just happened?

"Watch the ones still alive! Don't let them commit suicide!" the commander shouted urgently.

But it was too late.

Whether triggered or bewitched, the remaining survivors simultaneously began chanting Emuklaso's name.

One quick-thinking guard pulled off his sweat-towel and stuffed it straight into the mouth of the cultist nearest to him.

Seeing this, the other guards immediately copied him, but except for the slowest to speak, all the other cultist captives died mysteriously after shouting their slogans.

Great—now they were down to just two captives.

The problem was, they had to keep the captives gagged to prevent them from dying mysteriously. But if they wanted a confession, they needed them to speak!

Unable to come up with a solution, the guards simply dragged the two survivors before the Baron, leaving the decision to him.

But as they dragged the remaining two captives before the Baron, Hu Bushuai, who was still circling at low altitude, barked a loud warning: "Watch out! The dead beastmen are transforming!"

Baron Zhipang set aside the interrogation. Covering his mouth and nose with a cloth, he approached the slain cultists and quickly noticed the mutation taking place on their bodies.

"The Zerg curse?!"

"Dammit! How is the mutation happening so fast?!"

Baron Zhipang lacked any such curiosity. His lifelong education and common knowledge impelled him to issue an immediate order: "Burn all these corpses at once! Leave none behind—burn them all to ash!"

"If there's no time to burn them immediately, chop off their heads first—sever them completely!" Hu Bushuai advised.

Baron Zhipang waved his hand in assent.

Having witnessed the transformation of the dead cultists, the guards needed no further pushing from their commander and began focusing their fire to burn the mutating corpses.

Among the five thousand guards, around twenty had flames spurting from their fingertips. Some produced roaring fire, others weak flickers; some generated high heat, while others yielded embers barely hotter than a cigarette butt.

Yet regardless of the caster, every arsonist wore an alchemical item like a finger sleeve or ring on their hand.

The rest of the guards, lacking such talents, took charge of decapitation and mop-up duties. They gathered flammables, checked the perimeter for fleeing cultists, and piled the decapitated bodies together for easier incineration.

Others searched the camp, inspecting the belongings brought by the cultists.

"Baron, tell your guards to hurry! The mutation speed of these corpses is too fast!" Hu Bushuai warned again.

Worst of all, Hu Bushuai noticed that decapitating the bodies hadn't halted the mutation; instead, the heads and bodies were now mutating independently!

The scene was utterly grotesque and surreal.

Baron Zhipang saw it with his own eyes as well. Refusing to stumble at such a critical moment, he immediately ordered his men to speed up the burning.

Having failed to find Shang Feifan, Hu Bushuai could only land beside Baron Zhipang for now.

The giant bird carrying him dumped Hu Bushuai and flew off instantly, unable to endure the unbearable stench here!

"I need more information," Baron Zhipang said, his face dark.

He was quite gaunt in stature and face, with deep nasolabial folds etched beside his mouth, giving him a slightly harsh and mean demeanor.

Hu Bushuai: "Right now, I know as much as you do—perhaps even less."

Hu Bushuai paused before continuing: "Judging by the number of carriages and personnel you brought out, Baron, you must have packed your belongings before the warning bell even rang."

Free of critique or resentment, Hu Bushuai remarked in a flat tone, "You were among the very first nobles to flee Molo City, and you even fled with the City Guard in tow."
