Baron Zhipang showed no rage at the provocation either. "What are you trying to say? That leaving the guards behind would have helped more citizens escape? No, that would have only cost me more men."

"Don't worry, Baron. I won't overstep my bounds to tell you how to govern or treat your fief and subjects," Hu Bushuai said, his eyes cold. "I simply want to know what news you received in advance, who passed it to you, and whether you know why the disseminators of the Zerg poison appeared in Molo City."

Baron Zhipang offered a fake smile. "You say you won't overstep, so tell me—in what capacity are you questioning me right now? As I recall, you are no longer a royal guard. Even if you were, without a royal decree, you cannot—"

Baron Zhipang abruptly cut himself off.

He saw the bone tablet Hu Bushuai had just flashed before him.

It was a black bone tablet.

Signifying an identity within the Special Investigation Bureau.

What intimidated Baron Zhipang even more was that the black bone tablet in Hu Bushuai's hand bore two gold lines.

*Dammit! Who said this guy lost the Tiger King's favor after his mother died and was forced to flee the royal capital in disgrace?!*

chunks.chapterTitle: 第59章 变异虫尸的溃散能量 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
给出一枚自由行商令不算，还给出了一枚带有金线的特调官身份牌，这叫失去宠爱？

这他妈根本就是偏爱吧！

彘庞男爵脑中在一瞬间转过很多念头，他甚至想到虎不帅会离开王城并不是被迫，而是出于虎王想要保护他、想要让他避开因为继承权而掀起的王位争夺龙卷风。

虎王的身体还很好，他的年龄也还没有到老年衰弱期。

而只要虎王不死，谁也不知道这个私生子会有怎样发展。

现在得罪虎不帅显然非常不智。

“失礼。”彘庞男爵退后一步，右手握拳按在胸口，对虎不帅微微低头。

他是在向王室血脉和一级特别调查官行礼，毕竟他只是一个地方小贵族。

“我会把这里的情况如实上报，也请男爵阁下能给出实话。我想你也不希望我在后面的调查中查出来阁下说的内容与调查内容不符。”虎不帅手掌一翻，收起黑色骨牌。

彘庞男爵调整心情，“我确实提前得知一些消息，但并没有确定。我的管家只是出于谨慎才提前做了一些准备，比如收拾我的财物。”

“在此，不得不说拥有一名优秀的管家对于一名家大业大的繁忙者来说，实在是一件幸事。”

“至于城卫军那边，我也只是先给统领透了一点气，让他心里有数。也因为这样，城卫才会在发现不对后及时敲响警钟，通知全城城民逃跑。”

彘庞男爵看向虎不帅：“我想你应该能理解，在没有确证消息属实下，我不可能通知全城，命令他们放弃自己的家园和财产，一起撤离摩罗城。那只会让整个城市动乱，并带来大型灾难。”

虎不帅没有给出回应。

彘庞男爵看这位油盐不进，只好继续透露：“给我消息的是我的小儿子彘献，他从王城那边派人送了急信回来，说是王城的附属城之一黑森林城发生了大型灾难，虫毒散播者出现，导致黑森林城出现极大的人口伤亡。”

虎不帅的神情终于改变：“什么时候的事？”

为什么他完全没有收到相关消息？

他虽然离开王城，但不代表他就完全脱离了王城。

否则他也不会提前知道有人特意来莫约镇找他。

“就在昨天上午，来送信的是速雀族，为了传递这封急信，他累得当时就瘫在我面前。”

“黑森林城的灾难发生在四天前的晚上。”

“彘献告诉我，宫廷预言师预测这样的灾难还会在其他地方出现，而预言师点出的可能地点中就有摩罗城。”

“原本我儿子不可能知道这么秘密的情报，但……他到了王城后和三王子走得比较近，三王子也比较器重他。当三王子得知摩罗城有可能被邪神阴影者侵略时，就及时通知了彘献，还为他联系了速度最快的速雀族。”

虎不帅听到这里，问：“按照正常程序，如果宫廷预言师有预警，王城会以最快速度通知相应地方的领主。”

彘庞男爵：“王城的预警应该还在路上。我儿子只是太担心我和摩罗城，才会加急又加急的先把消息传递回来。现在，我也确实因为他送的消息比王城那边的报信者速度更快，才能稍微做了一些准备，不至于损失更大。”

彘庞男爵又意有所指地看向那些正在忙着焚烧尸体的城卫军：“如果我没有把城卫军带出来，现在也没办法配合你剿灭这些邪神信徒。如果无法剿灭这些邪神信徒，恐怕这些疯狂的恶徒会给逃出来的摩罗城人带来更大灾难。”

虎不帅压制自己的怒火，“如果是宫廷预言师给出的预警，就不能算没有经过确证的不实消息。”

彘庞男爵只好说出实话：“我是打算公布，让大家先一步做好准备。但我得到消息是在昨天上午，在公布消息前，我必然要先做好稳住整座摩罗城的准备，这些准备至少也要一两天。我也没想到虫毒散播者会来得那么快……”

虎不帅一看彘庞男爵的神情就知道这家伙当时在想什么。

无非是想利用预警给自己带来更多好处，把灾难变成利益。

比如说彘庞男爵可以只通知与他关系好的城中权贵，或者借此就把某些敌对者坑死。

让敌对者死在虫毒散播者和强盗、地痞流氓等人手中，不会有任何人怀疑。

同时这位男爵还想先保证自己和自身财产的安全，更不想有人借预警灾难给他找事。

就如这位男爵所说，他没有做好“万全”准备前，就绝不会轻易向整个摩罗城透漏灾难即将来临的消息。

自私自利，毫无领主担当，只把领民当工具当奴隶当蝼蚁，却从没有把领民当成自己的责任。

不过这种现象也不止一个摩罗城，实际上整个虎国的贵族领主都差不多是这个德性。

而这些贵族和领主们是哪里来的呢？

他们可不是从大繁华纪传承下来的。

这些人的祖辈绝大多数都是经历过大战纪、战乱纪和毒雾纪，在这三个纪元中占山为王的地方霸主。

而这些人之所以能成为地方霸主，除了他们本身的能力，更多的还是因为他们够脏、够狠、够毒，简称毫无人性。

这里面贩卖人口的、做人体实验的、当黑矿主黑农场主的，比比皆是。

之后的各国国王为了尽快结束战争，也为了笼络这些地方霸主，才会给他们贵族的名头，把他们占领的地盘封赐给他们。

原本各国国王是想等到休养生息以后，再慢慢收拾这些地方霸主，可这些地方霸主也不是傻子，干等一国之主腾出手来收拾他们，他们也早早拉帮结拜，甚至是结交拥有继承权的王室继承人，以此来和一国之主抗衡。

对比其他国家，虎国前后三位国王算是做得比较不错的，他们把一些特别难啃的大地方霸主都给解决了，也利用各种威逼利诱的手段，迫使那些中小地方霸主乖乖听话，强行在全国推行虎国法律，以特别调查官来监督他们。

是的，一开始特别调查局不是用来调查特殊以及诡异的案件，而是用来监督和调查各地领主的不法行为。

这也是各地领主十分忌惮特别调查官的原因。

虎不帅平复怒火，告诉自己，不能操之过急。

想想虎王在手握重权下都不能随便收拾这些地方领主，他只不过……

“啊——！”

营地内突然传出数声惊叫。

有城卫军大喊：“这些尸体……这些怪物活了！它们又活了！”

没有焚烧完的尸体异变结束，变成了各种各样外形稀奇古怪的虫兽，这些虫兽睁开眼睛就开始攻击周围活人。

虎不帅和彘庞男爵也无法再交谈下去。

彘庞男爵趁机摆脱虎不帅，大声命令城卫军统领，命他们杀光那些异变虫兽。

虎不帅也拿出武器，冲了过去。

这时候消灭变异怪物才是第一位，其他都得向后靠。

商非凡也在杀怪。

他没有用诅咒技能，而是就用他的大力气，举着盾牌、拿着工兵铲把那变异虫兽铲成了一段又一段。
chunks.englishText:
Not only had he been granted a Free Merchant Token, but he had also been given a Special Investigator identity badge laced with gold thread. And they called this falling out of favor?

This was fucking blatant favoritism!

In an instant, countless thoughts flashed through Baron Zhi Pang's mind. He even began to suspect that Hu Bushuai’s departure from the royal capital was not an exile at all, but a protective measure by the Tiger King to shield him from the tempestuous war of succession brewing over the throne.

The Tiger King was still in his prime, far from the frailty of old age.

And as long as the Tiger King drew breath, there was no telling how far this bastard son might rise.

Offending Hu Bushuai now would be the height of folly.

"Forgive my rudeness," Baron Zhi Pang said, taking a step back. He pressed his right fist to his chest and bowed his head slightly to Hu Bushuai.

He was paying respects to the royal bloodline and a First-Class Special Investigator. After all, he was merely a minor local noble.

"I will report the situation here truthfully, and I expect the truth from you as well, Lord Baron. I doubt you would want my subsequent investigation to uncover discrepancies in your story." Hu Bushuai flipped his palm, stowing away the black bone token.

Baron Zhi Pang composed himself. "I did indeed receive some advance warning, but nothing was confirmed. My butler merely made some preparations out of an abundance of caution, such as packing up my valuables."

"In times like these, I must say, having an exceptional butler is truly a blessing for a busy man with vast estates to manage."

"As for the city guard, I merely gave the commander a quiet heads-up so he would be prepared. It was precisely because of this that the guards were able to sound the alarm immediately when things went awry, warning the citizens to flee."

Baron Zhi Pang looked at Hu Bushuai. "I am sure you can understand that without verified proof, I could not possibly notify the entire city and order them to abandon their homes and property to evacuate Moluo City. That would have only incited mass panic and triggered an even greater catastrophe."

Hu Bushuai remained silent, offering no response.

Seeing that the young man was completely unyielding, Baron Zhi Pang had no choice but to reveal more. "The news came from my youngest son, Zhi Xian. He dispatched a messenger from the royal capital with an urgent letter, stating that a massive disaster had struck Black Forest City—one of the capital's vassal cities. An Insect-Plague Spreader had appeared, resulting in catastrophic casualties."

Hu Bushuai’s expression finally shifted. "When did this happen?"

Why hadn't he received any word of this?

Although he had left the capital, it did not mean he was entirely cut off from its intelligence network.

Otherwise, he wouldn't have known in advance that someone was coming to Moyue Town specifically to find him.

"Just yesterday morning. The messenger was of the Swift Sparrow tribe. To deliver this urgent missive, he pushed himself so hard that he collapsed right in front of me."

"The disaster in Black Forest City occurred four nights ago."

"Zhi Xian told me that the Court Seers predicted similar disasters would strike other locations, and Moluo City was among the potential targets they identified."

"Normally, my son would never have been privy to such classified intelligence. However... since arriving at the capital, he has grown quite close to the Third Prince, who holds him in high regard. When the Third Prince learned that Moluo City might fall prey to the Evil God Shadowers, he immediately informed Zhi Xian and even secured the services of the fastest Swift Sparrow messenger for him."

Hearing this, Hu Bushuai asked, "By standard protocol, if the Court Seers issue a warning, the capital is supposed to notify the respective local lords with the utmost urgency."

Baron Zhi Pang replied, "The official warning from the capital is likely still on the way. My son was simply so worried about me and Moluo City that he sent the message ahead with double-haste. And indeed, because his message outpaced the capital's official herald, I was able to make some preparations and mitigate our losses."

Baron Zhi Pang cast a pointed look at the city guards who were busy burning the corpses. "If I hadn't mobilized the city guard, we wouldn't be here to help you wipe out these cultists of the Evil God. And if we didn't eliminate them, these mad zealots would surely have brought an even greater catastrophe upon the refugees fleeing Moluo City."

Hu Bushuai suppressed his rising anger. "If the warning came from the Court Seers, it can hardly be dismissed as unverified rumor."

Baron Zhi Pang was forced to admit the truth. "I did intend to make it public and allow everyone to prepare. But I only received the news yesterday morning. Before making such an announcement, I had to ensure I could maintain order in Moluo City, which would take at least a day or two. I never expected the Insect-Plague Spreader to strike so quickly..."

One look at Baron Zhi Pang's expression was all Hu Bushuai needed to know exactly what had been going through the man's head.

The baron had simply wanted to exploit the warning for his own gain, turning a looming disaster into a profitable opportunity.

He could have selectively warned only the wealthy elites who were aligned with him, or used the impending chaos to eliminate his political rivals.

If his enemies died at the hands of the Insect-Plague Spreader, bandits, or opportunistic thugs, no one would ever suspect foul play.

At the same time, the baron wanted to secure his own life and fortune first, and he certainly didn't want the panic of a warning to disrupt his affairs.

Just as the baron had implied, until he had made "flawless" preparations, he would never have easily revealed the impending doom to the people of Moluo City.

He was utterly selfish, devoid of any sense of duty as a lord. To him, his subjects were merely tools, slaves, and ants—never a responsibility to protect.

Yet, this was not unique to Moluo City. In truth, almost all the noble lords of the Tiger Kingdom shared this despicable nature.

And where had these nobles and lords come from?

They were not the refined descendants of the Great Prosperity Era.

The vast majority of their ancestors were local warlords who had seized power during the Great War Era, the Era of Chaos, and the Poison Mist Era, ruling over their respective territories like mountain kings.

These men had risen to power not just through sheer capability, but because they were exceptionally ruthless, cunning, and cruel—in short, utterly devoid of humanity.

Among their ranks, human traffickers, mad scientists performing human experimentation, and ruthless owners of illegal mines and slave plantations were a dime a dozen.

To bring a swift end to the wars and win over these local tyrants, the kings of the various nations had granted them noble titles, officially enfeoffing them with the lands they had seized.

The kings had originally planned to bide their time, letting their kingdoms recover before slowly stripping these local tyrants of their power. But the warlords were no fools. Rather than waiting for their sovereigns to turn on them, they formed alliances, built factions, and even curried favor with royal heirs to counter the crown's authority.

Compared to other nations, the three successive kings of the Tiger Kingdom had done a commendable job. They had eliminated the most stubborn of the great warlords and used a combination of threats and incentives to force the minor and mid-sized lords into submission. They had enforced the laws of the Tiger Kingdom nationwide and established the Special Investigators to keep them in check.

Indeed, the Special Investigation Bureau had not been created to solve bizarre and supernatural cases; its original purpose was to monitor and investigate the illicit activities of local lords.

This was precisely why the local lords feared and loathed the Special Investigators so deeply.

Hu Bushuai suppressed his anger, reminding himself not to act with undue haste.

Even the Tiger King, with all his supreme authority, could not easily purge these local lords. He, on the other hand, was merely—

"Ah—!"

Several sharp screams suddenly echoed from the camp.

A city guard shrieked, "The corpses... these monsters are alive! They've come back to life!"

The unburned corpses had completed their mutation, transforming into bizarre, grotesque insectoid beasts. The moment they opened their eyes, they lunged at the living.

Hu Bushuai and Baron Zhi Pang could no longer continue their conversation.

Seizing the chance to escape Hu Bushuai, Baron Zhi Pang barked orders to the city guard commander, commanding them to slaughter the mutated beasts.

Hu Bushuai drew his weapon and charged forward.

Eradicating the mutated monsters was the absolute priority; everything else would have to wait.

Shang Feifan was also in the fray, slaying the beasts.

Eschewing his curse skills, he relied solely on his monstrous physical strength. Raising his shield, he swung his entrenching shovel, hacking the mutated insect beasts into bloody segments.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第59章 变异虫尸的溃散能量 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
可怜那变异虫兽身体还被绳索捆缚着，唯一的反抗就是弹射身上的骨刺。

但这些骨刺弹射完了也没办法马上就长出来，除非它能及时吸收大量能量。但它被捆着啊！

等到身上骨刺弹射了七七八八，变异虫兽也被工兵铲铲成了几十块。

那几十块尸体有些部位还在不屈地颤动。

【是否吸收这些变异虫尸的能量？】

商非凡的右眼视界中突然跳出这么一句提醒。

商非凡：“吸收？我能吸收这玩意？”

【你之前已经吸收融合了虫母九分之一的心脏碎片，经过推测，你也可以吸收这些变异虫尸的能量。】

只是推测？

有没有危险？

但商非凡只问出：“只能吸收死掉的虫尸的能量？活的不行？”

【虫尸死后能量溃散，才好吸收。】

“吸收虫尸的能量对我有什么好处和坏处？”

【因为你之前选择吸收虫母心脏来提升自己的天赋技能，为此，以后你吸收虫尸能量也能帮助提升你的天赋技能等级。】

很好！这个可以有。

他正愁不知道如何提升自己的天赋技能，虽然玩家只要等级提升就会相应提升自己的技能。但能比别的玩家多一条技能提升通道不是更爽？

“坏处呢？”

【有一定可能你会向虫族异变，甚而受到虫母精神力影响。】

“能解决吗？”

【请善用你的精神力修炼法，以及加强对诅咒之神的信念。】

商非凡：“……我保证是最虔诚的诅咒之神狂信徒。具体怎么吸收？”

【直接接触，想着吸收溃散的能量。请善用精神力修炼法。】

商非凡当即就把手放到了尸体碎块上，同时运行精神力修炼法，并专心想“我要吸收所有溃散的虫尸能量”。

一股……商非凡找不出适合的形容词，他能感觉到有能量通过他的手涌入他的身体，但他无法形容那是热流还是冷流，或者像是被电击一样。

就是那种“我知道有能量进入我身体，我能感觉到。但不要问我能量是气体是电流是磁场还是其他什么。”

这种感觉只能意会无法言传。

吸收虫尸能量的过程很快，商非凡还没爽够，地上的虫尸就全都变成了灰烬，比高温焚烧销毁还要彻底。

商非凡迅速打开自己的技能面板，查看他的技能数据。

神血天赋之【力大无穷】：39.001/100

神血天赋之【恶咒】：39.001/100

商非凡惊讶，他的天赋技能点数怎么一下增加了10点之多？

理智告诉他，这不可能是吸收一具变异虫尸溃散能量的结果。

果然，他很快就在玩家日志记录中找到了天赋技能点一下增加这么多的真正原因。

原来是他的贡献点总点数超过了一百点，一次性给他增加了10点技能点。

之前商非凡就怀疑他的等级提升很可能与他赚到的贡献点数有关，现在这条记录更验证了他的想法。

“麻烦下次增加技能点数能通知一下吗？这么悄无声息，你不觉得很没有牌面？”

游戏系统毫无反应。

商非凡也无所谓，只要有实惠就行。

他推测贡献点数很可能每达到一百点就会给他增加一定的技能点数。

目前他赚到的贡献点总数是102点，用的只剩下27点。

吸收一只变异虫尸的溃散能量增加0.001技能点，虽然少了点，但只要有足够的变异虫尸，提升起来似乎也不慢？

反正是白赚的。

商非凡转头就看向邪神信徒营地方向。

这个变异了，剩下那几百个情况又怎样呢？

只要一想到那四五百个邪神信徒都是潜在的可吸收能量，商非凡就心头火热。

这个游戏玩到现在终于有点感觉。
chunks.englishText:
The pitiful mutated insect beast remained tightly bound by the ropes, its sole means of resistance reduced to firing the bone spurs lining its body.

Yet, once these spurs were spent, they could not regrow immediately unless it could absorb a massive influx of energy. But it was bound hand and foot!

By the time most of its bone spurs had been depleted, the mutated insect beast had already been hacked into dozens of pieces by the entrenching shovel.

Even severed into dozens of fragments, certain parts of the carcass still twitched with unyielding vitality.

[Do you wish to absorb the energy of these mutated insect carcasses?]

A prompt suddenly flashed across the right field of Shang Feifan's vision.

Shang Feifan muttered, "Absorb? I can absorb this stuff?"

[You have previously absorbed and integrated one-ninth of the Broodmother's heart fragment. By deduction, you are also capable of absorbing the energy of these mutated insect carcasses.]

*Just a deduction?*

*Is there any danger?*

But Shang Feifan only voiced aloud: "Can I only absorb the energy of dead carcasses? Not living ones?"

[Once the insect dies, its energy begins to dissipate, making it easier to absorb.]

"What are the benefits and drawbacks of absorbing this energy?"

[Because you previously chose to absorb the Broodmother's heart to enhance your innate talent skills, absorbing the energy of insect carcasses will henceforth also help raise your innate talent skill levels.]

Excellent! This was exactly what he needed.

He had been racking his brains over how to upgrade his innate talent skills. While players naturally improved their skills as they leveled up, having an additional avenue of growth compared to everyone else was an undeniable advantage.

"And the drawbacks?"

[There is a certain probability that you will undergo insectoid mutation, or even fall under the mental influence of the Broodmother.]

"Can that be prevented?"

[Please make proper use of your Mental Power Cultivation Method, and strengthen your faith in the God of Curses.]

Shang Feifan: "...I swear I am the most devout fanatic of the God of Curses. How exactly do I absorb it?"

[Establish direct contact and focus your intent on absorbing the dissipating energy. Please make proper use of your Mental Power Cultivation Method.]

Without hesitation, Shang Feifan placed his hand upon the severed carcass fragments. At the same time, he circulated his Mental Power Cultivation Method, focusing his mind entirely on a single thought: *I want to absorb all the dissipating energy of this insect corpse.*

A sensation... Shang Feifan could find no words to describe it. He could feel a surge of energy flooding into his body through his hand, yet he could not define whether it was a warm current, a cold draft, or something akin to an electric shock.

It was simply a feeling of: *I know energy is entering my body, and I can feel it. But do not ask me if this energy is a gas, an electric current, a magnetic field, or something else entirely.*

It was a sensation that could only be experienced, defying any attempt at verbal description.

The absorption process was incredibly swift. Before Shang Feifan could even fully savor the sensation, the carcass fragments on the ground crumbled into fine ash—a destruction far more absolute than any high-temperature incineration.

Shang Feifan quickly pulled up his skill panel to check his stats.

Divine Blood Talent [Infinite Strength]: 39.001/100

Divine Blood Talent [Vile Curse]: 39.001/100

Shang Feifan was stunned. How had his talent skill points suddenly surged by a whopping 10 points?

Reason told him that this could not possibly be the result of absorbing the dissipating energy of a single mutated insect carcass.

Sure enough, he quickly located the true reason behind this massive jump in his player logs.

As it turned out, his total contribution points had crossed the hundred-point threshold, granting him a one-time bonus of 10 skill points.

Shang Feifan had previously suspected that his leveling speed was tied to the contribution points he amassed, and this log entry thoroughly validated his theory.

"Could you at least notify me the next time you award skill points? Doing it so quietly... don't you think it lacks a bit of flair?"

The game system offered no response.

Shang Feifan did not mind; as long as he reaped the practical benefits, he was content.

He hypothesized that he would likely receive a set amount of skill points for every hundred contribution points he accumulated.

Currently, his total lifetime contribution points stood at 102, though he only had 27 left to spend.

Absorbing the dissipating energy of a single mutated carcass yielded a mere 0.001 skill points. It was a minuscule amount, but if he had enough mutated carcasses, wouldn't his growth rate still be incredibly rapid?

After all, it was pure profit.

Shang Feifan turned his gaze toward the camp of the Heretic God's cultists.

If this one had mutated, what about the remaining hundreds?

At the thought of those four to five hundred cultists representing a massive pool of potential energy waiting to be harvested, a fiery anticipation ignited in Shang Feifan's chest.

After playing for so long, this game was finally starting to get interesting.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第60章 怨气的使用方法 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第60章 怨气的使用方法

商非凡返回邪神信徒营地时，城卫军正陷于和变异虫兽的厮杀中。

也幸亏他们抢先焚烧了不少邪神信徒的尸体，但仅剩下的这些也足够让他们头疼。

更让他们感到不可思议的是，那些被他们砍了头颅的尸体竟然长成了两个不同的虫兽。

甚至有些被他们砍断的四肢也单独变成了诡异的虫兽。

这些重新复活的变异虫兽一个个杀伤力极大，它们看到兽人就会攻击，全都是失去理智的疯狂模样。

“分割！把它们全都分割开来，单数小队攻击，双数小队辅助！”城卫军统领大吼下令。

命令一层层下达。

原本有些混乱的城卫军在千夫长、百夫长、十夫长的要求下，很快就形成了有攻有守的围剿阵势。

数量上百的虫兽被分割成一个个独立的小圈，五十人为一个大组，大约十个城卫军共同对付一只虫兽，其他城卫军则在一边防备并准备轮换，战队医疗也随时做好拖出受伤者并治疗的准备。

幸好这些已经异变结束的虫兽被分尸后没有再进行分裂变异，否则彘庞男爵很可能会不顾虎不帅在一边监战也要逃跑。

虎不帅见城卫军的攻势变得有条不紊，消灭那百来个变异虫兽也只是时间问题，就转头去搜索四周有没有漏网跑掉的异变虫兽。

“不帅！”

“商非凡！你跑哪儿去了？”

两人看到彼此，迅速接近。

“千万小心，那些邪神信徒死亡后很可能会异变……”商非凡看到了战场。

“已经异变了！”虎不帅接口。

“那是城卫军？”

“是。彘庞男爵也来了。”

“我们过去帮他们。”商非凡积极地向营地冲去。

虎不帅大受触动：这人似乎比他想象得更加热心和善良，不但愿意冒着生命危险留下来以一对五百，现在脱离危险还要跑回来帮忙。

商非凡双眼特别亮。

全是能量！全是升级的养分！

冲冲冲！

都是我的！

吃独食的感觉真的太好了！

【发现虫尸焚烧余烬，能量尚未散光，是否吸收？】

收收收！

蚊子腿再小也是肉。

商非凡拐了个弯，跑向营地一角焚烧尸体的焦尸堆。

那里火焰还在焚烧。

虎不帅看到商非凡跑向那边，也跟过去，好奇：“你在做什么？”

商非凡手掌接触焦尸，严肃地说：“这些尸体光焚烧还不能彻底消除虫毒，得用特殊方法。”

虎不帅皱起眉头，“这些尸体和变异虫兽会扩散虫毒？”

“对。”

虎不帅看到商非凡手掌接触的焦尸转眼就变成一堆黑灰，比高温焚烧还要彻底。

这是什么能力？

能彻底消除虫毒，难道是治愈系、光明系血脉天赋？

但瞧商非凡施法的模样又不像是这两类职业。

虎不帅也没有多想，只要能力用对地方，管它是什么天赋。

“我把那些死掉的虫尸尸体带过来给你处理。”

这样也可以节省商非凡在营地里跑来跑去的时间。

之前商非凡说要帮忙，他还担心他冒然插手，反而会扰乱城卫军的阵型，变成帮倒忙，这也是他脱离战斗的原因。

现在他只觉得自己再次小瞧了商非凡。

这个人能以一己之力拖住五百个邪神信徒，又怎么会做出不自量力和扰乱友军的糊涂事。

“帮大忙了。”商非凡巴不得如此。

彘庞男爵那边也发现虎不帅身边多了一个人。

虎不帅一来到摩罗城，他就得到消息，并派人调查他身边那些人的底细。

比起已经离开的莫约镇镇民，彘庞男爵更在意商非凡，因为商非凡在治安局那边亮出身份，他也是特别调查官。

那时他还想着这个特别调查官跑到他们摩罗城是想调查什么事，是否和他有关。还想到这人在明，会不会还有人在暗中调查。

当看到特别调查官和虎不帅走到一起，他还奇怪两个人到底是什么关系，同时暗中警惕。

没想到虎不帅也有特别调查官的身份，职位还更高。

不过这也解开了彘庞男爵的一个疑惑，两个人都是特别调查官，那么就不怪他们认识并同行。

另外，之前他警惕特别调查官前来摩罗城的原因，现在则松了口气。众所周知，特别调查局主要负责的就是与邪神阴影者有关的案件。

也许这两人在王城那边也得到了某些消息，顺着线索寻找过来，只是没想到他们没能把线头及时抓出来，就让邪神阴影者先搞出事来。

同时这也能解释虎不帅为什么能发现这个邪神信徒的营地。必然是早就盯着了。

彘庞男爵想了很多，但他并没有过去找商、虎两人。贵族们不论地位高低，都不太喜欢接触特别调查局的人。

他也有很好的借口，他需要待在一边督战。期间如果发现不对，他就命令城卫军保护他撤退。

+0.001，+0.001，+0.001……

一连串的数值在右眼视界中飘过。

商非凡宛如听到游戏系统在用这种方式回答他：增加技能点数通知你了，别再哔哔了！

“你这样会不会太消耗内存？其实你可以在我吸收完以后直接给个总数。”商非凡充满关心地关怀。

游戏系统沉默。

但那一个个飘浮的数值消失了。

商非凡快速眨动眼睛，视界总算清晰。

他发现通过这种方式吸收虫兽的残余能量，不仅能提升自己的天赋技能点数，还能锻炼他的精神力。

之前他并不怎么会使用精神力，虽然现实世界的人都知道这么一个词，但这始终是一个概念。现实世界并没有谁真正的掌握精神力并会使用，更不要说提升。

游戏世界就是游戏世界，竟然能让身体实际感受到精神力的存在。

商非凡点赞。

他甚至想到这种精神力修炼法在现实世界能不能使用。

随即莞尔，他这算不算玩游戏玩到走火入魔？

不但看上了游戏中一个NPC，还想着要把游戏世界中的技能搬到现实中。

嘲笑自己的同时，商非凡脑中又闪过“他在现实世界听到游戏世界虎不帅声音”的事。

这事要怎么解释？

商非凡眼神微微改变，看着地上那些变异虫兽尸体，貌似在认真地“祛除虫毒”，实际上在想些什么只有他自己知道。

彘庞男爵看到虎不帅不断地进入营地，拖拽出那些虫兽尸体，运到另一个人身边。

“你在干什么？”彘庞男爵终于忍不住，操纵巨虫坐骑跑到两人身边询问。

虎不帅仰头说：“这些死掉的变异虫兽会散播虫毒，必须彻底消灭。”

彘庞男爵居高临下地看商非凡：“他是祛毒师？还是……”

虎不帅：“他是特别调查官，专门负责处理这些事情。”

言下之意，你就别多问了。

彘庞男爵当即记住商非凡的脸。这种能力很有用，任何势力都会很欢迎拥有这种天赋的兽人。

“他能不能驱散大地中的虫族诅咒？”彘庞男爵冷不丁问。
chunks.englishText:
**Chapter 60: Utilizing Resentment**

When Shang Feifan returned to the cultist camp, the city guards were already locked in a chaotic, bloody melee with the mutated insect beasts.

Fortunately, they had preemptively burned a large portion of the cultists' corpses, but the remaining few were still proving to be an immense headache.

What baffled them even more was that the decapitated corpses actually regenerated, splitting and growing into two distinct, separate insect beasts.

Even severed limbs wriggled and morphed independently, transforming into bizarre, grotesque insect beasts.

These resurrected abominations possessed terrifying lethality. Driven by pure, mindless madness, they lunged at any beastman in sight.

"Isolate them! Divide them into smaller groups! Odd-numbered squads attack, even-numbered squads support!" the commander of the city guard roared, his voice booming over the din of battle.

The orders cascaded down the ranks.

Under the strict coordination of the decurions, centurions, and chiliarchs, the chaotic guards quickly rallied, organizing themselves into a tight, defensive-offensive encirclement.

Over a hundred insect beasts were isolated into small, self-contained pockets. Fifty men formed a grand unit, with roughly ten guards teaming up to suppress a single beast. The remaining guards stood vigilant on the periphery, ready to rotate in, while the field medics remained on high alert to drag out and treat the wounded.

Fortunately, once these fully mutated beasts were dismembered, they did not undergo further division and mutation. Otherwise, Baron Zhi Pang would likely have fled the scene immediately, completely disregarding the fact that Hu Bushuai was supervising the battle nearby.

Seeing that the guards' offensive had fallen into a steady, methodical rhythm and that wiping out the hundred-odd beasts was only a matter of time, Hu Bushuai scanned the perimeter, searching for any stragglers that might have slipped through the dragnet.

"Bushuai!"

"Shang Feifan! Where on earth did you go?"

Spotting each other, the two quickly closed the distance.

"Be extremely careful. Once those cultists die, they are highly likely to mutate..." Shang Feifan warned, his eyes falling upon the chaotic battlefield.

"They already have!" Hu Bushuai cut in.

"Are those the city guards?"

"Yes. Baron Zhi Pang brought them."

"Let's go help." Shang Feifan charged toward the camp with eager enthusiasm.

Hu Bushuai was deeply moved. *This man is far more warm-hearted and righteous than I imagined,* he thought. Not only had Shang Feifan risked his life to hold off five hundred cultists alone, but now that he was safe, his first instinct was to rush back into the fray to help.

Meanwhile, Shang Feifan's eyes were gleaming with an intense, predatory light.

*Energy! It's all pure energy! The perfect nourishment to level up!*

*Charge, charge, charge!*

*It's all mine!*

*Keeping all the spoils to myself feels absolutely amazing!*

**[Detected: Smoldering embers of insect carcasses. Residual energy has not fully dissipated. Absorb?]**

*Absorb, absorb, absorb!*

*Even the smallest scrap of meat is still food!*

Shang Feifan veered off course, sprinting toward a pile of charred corpses burning in a corner of the camp.

The flames were still crackling merrily.

Seeing Shang Feifan dash toward the fire, Hu Bushuai followed close behind, asking in confusion, "What are you doing?"

Placing his palm against a charred corpse, Shang Feifan said with a solemn expression, "Simply burning these corpses isn't enough to completely eradicate the insect toxin. It requires a specialized technique."

Hu Bushuai frowned. "Do these corpses and mutated beasts spread the toxin?"

"Yes."

Before Hu Bushuai's eyes, the charred corpse beneath Shang Feifan's palm crumbled into a pile of fine black ash in an instant—a disintegration far more thorough than any high-temperature cremation.

*What kind of ability is this?*

*To completely eradicate the toxin... could it be a Healing or Light-attribute bloodline talent?*

Yet, looking at the way Shang Feifan channeled his power, it bore no resemblance to either of those classes.

Shaking the thought from his head, Hu Bushuai decided not to overthink it. As long as the power was put to good use, it didn't matter what kind of talent it was.

"I'll bring the dead insect carcasses over for you to process."

This would save Shang Feifan the trouble of running all over the camp.

Earlier, when Shang Feifan had offered to help, Hu Bushuai had worried that a reckless intervention would disrupt the guards' formation and do more harm than good—which was why he had pulled back in the first place.

Now, he realized he had underestimated Shang Feifan once again.

How could a man capable of holding off five hundred cultists single-handedly ever commit such a foolish, short-sighted blunder?

"That would be a massive help," Shang Feifan said, secretly ecstatic. This was exactly what he wanted.

Over on the other side of the battlefield, Baron Zhi Pang noticed that another figure had joined Hu Bushuai.

The moment Hu Bushuai had arrived in Molo City, the Baron had received word and dispatched men to investigate the backgrounds of everyone in his entourage.

Compared to the townsfolk of Moyue Town who had already departed, Baron Zhi Pang was far more interested in Shang Feifan. After all, Shang Feifan had revealed his identity at the Security Bureau—he, too, was a Special Investigator.

At the time, the Baron had wondered what this Special Investigator was doing in Molo City, and whether the investigation had anything to do with his own dealings. He had even worried that while Shang Feifan acted as a decoy in the light, there might be others digging in the dark.

When he saw the Special Investigator and Hu Bushuai together, he had wondered about their relationship, remaining deeply suspicious.

He had never expected that Hu Bushuai was also a Special Investigator, and one of a much higher rank at that.

Still, this cleared up one of his doubts. Since both were Special Investigators, it made perfect sense that they knew each other and traveled together.

Furthermore, the anxiety he had felt regarding their presence in Molo City was now completely alleviated. It was common knowledge that the Special Investigation Bureau primarily handled cases involving the shadows of the evil gods.

Perhaps these two had caught wind of something back in the Royal Capital and followed the trail here, only to be caught off guard when the cultists made their move first.

This also explained how Hu Bushuai had located the cultist camp so quickly. He must have been keeping tabs on them for a long time.

Baron Zhi Pang turned these thoughts over in his mind, but he made no move to approach the duo. Nobles, regardless of status, loathed dealing with the Special Investigation Bureau.

Besides, he had a perfect excuse: he had to remain on the sidelines to oversee the battle. If anything went awry, he would immediately order the guards to cover his retreat.

*+0.001, +0.001, +0.001...*

A continuous stream of numbers drifted across the right side of his field of vision.

Shang Feifan could almost hear the game system grumbling in response: *I've notified you of the skill point increases, now stop nagging!*

"Isn't this a bit of a memory hog? Honestly, you could just give me a lump sum once I'm done absorbing," Shang Feifan suggested, his tone dripping with mock concern.

The game system remained silent.

However, the floating numbers instantly vanished.

Shang Feifan blinked rapidly, his vision finally clearing up.

He realized that absorbing the residual energy of the insect beasts in this manner did more than just raise his talent skill points—it was also refining his mental strength.

Previously, he had no idea how to wield mental strength. Although people in the real world were familiar with the term, it had always remained an abstract concept. No one in the real world had ever truly mastered or utilized mental strength, let alone trained it.

Yet, this game world was truly extraordinary; it actually allowed his physical form to tangibly perceive the existence of mental strength.

Shang Feifan gave it a mental thumbs-up.

He couldn't help but wonder: *Could this mental cultivation method be used in the real world?*

He smiled wryly at the thought. Was he starting to lose his mind from playing this game too much?

Not only had he fallen for an in-game NPC, but now he was actually contemplating bringing virtual skills into reality.

Yet, even as he mocked himself, the memory of hearing Hu Bushuai's voice in the real world flashed through his mind.

How could that possibly be explained?

A subtle shift occurred in Shang Feifan's gaze. Though he appeared to be diligently "purging the insect toxin" from the carcasses on the ground, only he knew what thoughts were truly swirling in his mind.

Baron Zhi Pang watched as Hu Bushuai repeatedly ventured into the camp, dragging out the carcasses of the insect beasts and hauling them over to the other man.

"What are you doing?" Baron Zhi Pang finally lost his patience. Steering his giant insect mount, he rode over to the duo to demand an explanation.

Hu Bushuai looked up and replied, "These dead mutated beasts will spread the insect toxin. They must be completely eradicated."

Baron Zhi Pang looked down at Shang Feifan from atop his mount. "Is he a Purger? Or..."

"He is a Special Investigator," Hu Bushuai said flatly. "This is his area of expertise."

The subtext was clear: *Mind your own business.*

Baron Zhi Pang immediately memorized Shang Feifan's face. Such an ability was incredibly useful; any faction would eagerly welcome a beastman with a talent like this.

"Can he cleanse the Insectoid Curse from the earth?" Baron Zhi Pang asked abruptly.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第60章 怨气的使用方法 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
虎不帅脸色冰冷：“如果他能，你以为他会出现在这里，还是一个人？”

拥有这种能力的兽人不说数量极少，只要发现一个那都是王庭最重视的存在，不说藏起来，那出行也绝对会重重保护。

彘庞男爵毫不尴尬地笑了笑，操纵巨虫坐骑走向一边，同时对待命的城卫军统领下令，让城卫军把杀死的变异虫尸尸体运送到商非凡身边。

这显然是一个示好举动。

虎不帅也不用来来回回奔跑，还要注意城卫军和变异虫兽的打斗。

虎不帅见此，乐得轻松。

商非凡更是高兴，什么都不用做，就有能量白送上门，这种好事到哪里找！

于是，五千城卫军辛辛苦苦杀变异虫兽，杀完了还要把变异虫兽的尸体屁颠颠地送到商非凡面前，而商非凡只要用手接触那些尸体，一个劲吸吸吸就行。

一个小时后，最后一只变异虫兽被消灭。

城卫军开始打扫战场。

尸体是不用担心了，全都已经被商非凡吸成了灰烬，风一吹就没。

城卫军要搜查的是邪神信徒们留下的行李。

商非凡也很快把最后一只虫尸吸干，和虎不帅一起走向营地中。

途中听到系统提示拖延任务完成，10点贡献点到账，就顺手打开自己的数据面板查看。

只看重要的。

贡献点数：总计112点，结余37点。

玩家等级：11级

生命值：1100

能量值：1100

特殊能量值（怨气）：3897（+1+1-1……）

精神力值：45/100

智慧：8.2/10

敏捷值：21/100

力量值和血脉天赋（力大无穷）合并：39.5/100

血脉天赋（恶咒）：39.5/100

幸运值：0

另外他的职业技能栏还多了一个新技能：虫族（虫毒）感知力，敏锐。

从数据上来看，五百只变异虫兽尸体只给他增加了0.5的技能点。

如果要先把这些虫兽全都杀死，才能吸取它们的尸体能量，这样的增加技能点方式无疑性价比超低。

但想到这0.5个技能点几乎是白送的，商非凡决定暂时不对系统表达他的意见。

商非凡比较好奇的是特殊能量值（怨气），这玩意数值很高，就是不知道有什么用处。后面括号里的数值还在不断变动，这是表示他一直在被动吸收和消耗怨气？

“怨气有什么用？”商非凡低声问。

“嗯？”虎不帅转头看他。

商非凡对他笑，“没什么。我在自言自语，奇怪这些邪神信徒为什么会在死后变成虫兽。”

虎不帅：说谎！我明明听到你在说华夏语。

虎不帅心里激动得不行。这真的是他的老乡！

不过对方是在对谁说话？

系统？

不怪乎虎不帅会这样想，他也是看过不少小说和电影的人。他都能魂穿两次，为什么同样穿越过来的老乡不能身带系统或随身老爷爷？

实际上在商非凡说他身怀收集自然之神散落力量的任务时，虎不帅就怀疑他身上藏着什么，比如一个快要完蛋的衰弱的神灵的些微意识之类。

虎不帅心里明白，表面假装什么都不知道，还想着要为这个老乡打好掩饰。

商非凡右眼视界飘出一句话：【怨气，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯的最爱。】

商非凡立马反应过来：“所以怨气可以用来作为诅咒的代偿能量？”

【想要知道怨气的详细用法，请仔细感悟诅咒祭司的初级技能书。】

商非凡莫名从右眼的显示文字中察觉到未知存在的一股怨气。

商非凡干咳。

玩游戏嘛，谁会那么认真地去看技能书的内容？

好吧，认真玩游戏的人会看，想要提升自己技能，想要玩得更好的玩家都会看，还会仔细研究。

商非凡默默地打开诅咒祭司的技能书，决定从头到尾好好地再阅读一遍。

虽然这本技能书的内容一开始就灌入他的大脑，但灌入不代表能融会贯通，他不去想，那些内容也不会自己浮现。

这么仔细一阅读，他才发现怨气原来对诅咒祭司那么重要，不仅是施法的重要能源，更是保护诅咒祭司的保护罩。

伤害诅咒祭司的存在会被怨气附着，也会更容易被诅咒祭司的技能击中。

怨气还能充当标记、签名使用。

除此之外，与怨气有关的术法很多，比如利用怨气让敌人做噩梦、产生幻视幻听等，都是诅咒祭司的初级技能，诅咒祭司并不是只会诅咒。

这也是他突然就开始吸收怨气的原因。

偏偏他坐拥宝山却不自知，白存了那么多怨气，却一直没有使用过。

商非凡：“……”我都错过了什么？

感谢右眼提醒！

对方大概也是忍受不了了。

右眼融合的破碎玻璃球和游戏系统相辅相成，但仔细感受就能发现它们是两种不同的独立AI。

前者和诅咒之神有关。

后者就不知道背后藏着谁了。

商非凡微微挑眉。他怎么会突然想到游戏系统背后藏着谁这个问题？

是他想得太多，还是这个游戏世界古怪到让他的直觉在不断发出警报声……

“商非凡？商非凡！商……”

“你可以叫我的名字。”商非凡回神。

虎不帅：“商先生，你能感觉到这个营地内还有虫毒残留吗？另外，你可以消灭变异虫尸的虫毒，那摩罗城中被虫毒散播者散播的虫毒，你是否有办法解决？后面这个问题是彘庞男爵的请教。”

我们有必要这么生疏吗？商非凡给了虎不帅一个幽怨的眼神。

虎不帅回以坚定目光：我们就是这么不熟。

“没办法。稍等。”商非凡环视整个营地。

他正在按照右眼提示善用他的诅咒祭司技能：观察怨气。

同时感知虫毒残留。

精神力原来是这样使用？

这东西简直就是最好的扫描仪！

更让他惊喜的是，他的右眼视界会在他扫描的同时，直接亮出数据。

他现在就是一具真正的人体扫描仪。

一通百通，开窍的商非凡终于知道这个游戏要怎么玩了。

这真的和键盘游戏不一样，不是按个键就能释放技能，游戏系统也不会把所有技能都放在你大脑中，得你自己去感悟、去使用、去不断练习，才能真正使用出来。

但等真的能使用出来，这感觉真的……酷毙！

这一瞬间，商非凡有种自己无所不能之感。

当然，这只是假象。他只是有了新手玩家共有的新手期错觉：一棒子打死一只野鸡，就觉得自己天下无敌。

整个营地都弥漫了大量怨气。

这些怨气正在往他身体涌来。

商非凡现在知道这些怨气的真正作用以及利弊，也就放开了吸收。

原本商非凡不主动吸收，这些怨气就在快速涌入他身体，当他有意识地开始主动吸收后，这些怨气简直跟潮水一样疯狂涌来。

怨气也可以藏入精神海，但最好能和自己原本的精神力分开。
chunks.englishText:
Hu Bushuai’s face turned cold. "If he could, do you think he’d be showing up here—and alone at that?"

Beastmen with such capabilities were exceptionally rare. Once discovered, they became the highest priority of the Royal Court—if not hidden away entirely, they would at least be heavily guarded wherever they went.

Baron Zhi Pang chuckled without a trace of embarrassment, maneuvering his giant insect mount to the side. At the same time, he issued orders to the waiting City Guard commander, instructing them to haul the carcasses of the slain mutated insects directly over to Shang Feifan.

This was clearly a gesture of goodwill.

It saved Hu Bushuai from having to run back and forth while keeping an eye on the battle between the City Guard and the mutated insects.

Seeing this, Hu Bushuai was glad for the break.

Shang Feifan was even happier. Free energy delivered right to his doorstep without him lifting a finger—where else could one find such a sweet deal?

And so, five thousand City Guards worked tirelessly to slaughter the mutated insects, only to eagerly lug the dead bodies back to Shang Feifan once they were done. Meanwhile, all Shang Feifan had to do was touch the corpses and continuously absorb, absorb, absorb.

An hour later, the last mutated insect was wiped out.

The City Guard began cleaning up the battlefield.

The corpses were no longer an issue; every last one had been drained into ash by Shang Feifan, disappearing with the breeze.

What the City Guard needed to search through were the belongings left behind by the evil god's cultists.

Shang Feifan quickly drained the final insect corpse and walked into the camp alongside Hu Bushuai.

Along the way, he heard a system notification announcing the completion of the delay task and the credit of 10 Contribution Points, so he casually opened his status panel to check.

He only looked at the key stats.

Contribution Points: Total 112, Remaining Balance 37.

Player Level: Level 11

HP: 1100

Energy: 1100

Special Energy (Resentment): 3897 (+1 +1 -1...)

Mental Power: 45/100

Intelligence: 8.2/10

Agility: 21/100

Strength & Bloodline Talent (Herculean Might) Combined: 39.5/100

Bloodline Talent (Vile Curse): 39.5/100

Luck: 0

In addition, a new skill had appeared in his class skill column: Insect Race (Insect Venom) Perception: Acute.

Looking at the numbers, five hundred mutated insect corpses had only granted him 0.5 skill points.

If he had to kill all these insect beasts before absorbing their energy, this method of gaining skill points was undoubtedly horribly inefficient.

However, considering those 0.5 skill points were practically handed to him for free, Shang Feifan decided to withhold his complaints from the system for now.

What piqued Shang Feifan's curiosity was the Special Energy (Resentment). The number was quite high, but he didn't know what it was used for. The values in the parentheses were constantly fluctuating—did that mean he was continuously absorbing and consuming Resentment passively?

"What is Resentment used for?" Shang Feifan asked in a low voice.

"Hmm?" Hu Bushuai turned to look at him.

Shang Feifan smiled at him. "Nothing. Just talking to myself. I was wondering why these evil god cultists turn into insect beasts after dying."

Hu Bushuai: *Liar! I clearly heard you speaking Huaxia language.*

Hu Bushuai’s heart surged with excitement. *He really is my fellow countryman!*

*But who was he talking to?*

*A system?*

It was no wonder Hu Bushuai thought this way—he was someone who had read plenty of web novels and watched plenty of movies. If he could soul-transmigrate twice, why couldn't a fellow transmigrator come equipped with a system or a grandpas-in-a-ring trope?

In fact, when Shang Feifan claimed he had a task to collect the scattered power of the Nature God, Hu Bushuai had already suspected he was hiding something—like a faint wisp of consciousness from a dying, weakened deity.

Understanding the situation in his heart, Hu Bushuai feigned total ignorance on the surface, secretly resolving to help cover for his fellow countryman.

A line of text drifted across Shang Feifan's right-eye vision: 【Resentment: The favorite of Konizeus, God of Curses.】

Shang Feifan immediately caught on. "So Resentment can be used as a surrogate energy source for curses?"

【If you wish to know the detailed applications of Resentment, please study the beginner skill book for Curse Priests carefully.】

Shang Feifan inexplicably detected a faint trace of resentment coming from the unknown entity behind the text in his right eye.

Shang Feifan cleared his throat awkwardly.

*Come on, who reads skill books so thoroughly when playing a game?*

Well, hardcore gamers would. Players who wanted to improve their skills and perform better would read and study every detail.

Shang Feifan silently opened the Curse Priest skill book, deciding to read it properly from start to finish.

Although the contents of the skill book had been directly imprinted into his brain from the start, imprinting didn't mean mastery. If he didn't actively think about it, the information wouldn't surface on its own.

After studying it carefully, he realized how vital Resentment was to a Curse Priest. It was not only a core energy source for casting spells, but also a protective shroud for the caster.

Any entity that harmed a Curse Priest would be clinging with Resentment, making them far easier targets for the Priest's spells.

Resentment could also be used as a marker or a signature.

Beyond that, there were many spells related to Resentment, such as subjecting enemies to nightmares or triggering visual and auditory hallucinations—all of which were beginner skills. Curse Priests were far more than just curser-machines.

That explained why he had suddenly started absorbing Resentment in the first place.

And yet, sitting on a goldmine without realizing it, he had hoarded so much Resentment without ever spending a single drop.

Shang Feifan: "..." *What on earth have I been missing out on?*

*Thank goodness for the right-eye reminder!*

The entity behind it had probably reached its limit of patience.

The shattered glass sphere fused into his right eye and the game system complemented each other, but a closer feel revealed they were two distinct, independent AIs.

The former was connected to the God of Curses.

As for the latter, who knew who was pulling the strings behind it.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow slightly. *Why did I suddenly start thinking about who's behind the game system?*

*Am I overthinking, or is this game world so strange that my instincts are constantly ringing alarm bells...?*

"Shang Feifan? Shang Feifan! Shang..."

"You can just call me by my name," Shang Feifan said, snapping back to reality.

Hu Bushuai said, "Mr. Shang, can you sense if there's any remaining insect venom in this camp? Also, since you can destroy the venom in the mutated corpses, do you have a way to resolve the venom spread by the poison dispersers in Molo City? The latter question is on behalf of Baron Zhi Pang."

*Do we really need to be so distant?* Shang Feifan gave Hu Bushuai a resentful look.

Hu Bushuai returned a firm gaze: *Yes, we really are that unfamiliar.*

"No way for now. Hold on," Shang Feifan said, surveying the entire camp.

He was following his right eye's prompt to make proper use of his Curse Priest skill: Observing Resentment.

Simultaneously, he sensed for remnants of insect venom.

*So this is how Mental Power is used?*

*This thing is literally the ultimate scanner!*

To his surprise and delight, his right-eye vision directly displayed data as he scanned.

He was practically a human radar now.

Once he got the hang of it, everything clicked. Shang Feifan finally understood how this game was meant to be played.

It was completely different from keyboard games. You couldn't just press a button to cast a spell, nor would the game system dump every operational detail into your brain. You had to comprehend, experiment, and practice continuously to truly master a skill.

But once you actually pulled it off, the feeling was... totally awesome!

In that instant, Shang Feifan felt omnipotent.

Of course, it was an illusion—the classic novice delusion shared by beginner players who, upon clubbing a single wild pheasant to death, believed themselves invincible under the heavens.

The entire camp was saturated with a vast amount of Resentment.

This Resentment was surging toward his body.

Now that Shang Feifan understood its actual functions, pros, and cons, he unreservedly welcomed the absorption.

Even without his active effort, the Resentment had been pouring into him rapidly. Now that he actively drew it in, it rushed over like a raging tide.

Resentment could be stored in the spiritual sea, but it was best kept separate from one's original Mental Power.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第60章 怨气的使用方法 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
这是为了避免自己的精神力被怨气污染，导致自己利用怨气不成，反而把自己祸害成一个活生生的怨鬼。

不过诅咒祭司的精神力天生压制怨气，只要他不故意把自己玩死，这些怨气就伤害不了他。

只是商非凡没有发现，随着他吸收怨气数量不断增多，他的眼眸正在从茶黑色转向暗红。

怨气快速变少，虫毒就变得显眼起来。

虫毒有，但不多。

只可惜他可以感知到虫毒存在，却无法吸收和驱散。

这玩意就像是某种可怕病菌，传染性超强，还能直接修改基因。

但虫毒想要感染兽人和其他生物，需要的量很大。

现在营地里残留的这点虫毒不会对兽人造成任何影响，就是不知道这种虫毒是会慢慢被自然消解，还是会一直存留。

如果虫族诅咒和虫毒有关，那么这种虫毒可能比核污染的自然消解时间还要漫长。

盯！

商非凡的目光落到了之前雕像竖立的地点。

那里有一股不同寻常的能量在徘徊。

浓郁的怨气，夹杂着另一种商非凡无法查知的能量。

“你发现了什么？”虎不帅顺着他的目光看过去。

商非凡目光凝重，“告诉彘庞男爵，让他的人离那处远一点，如果他们不想变成邪神信徒的话。”

他不但看到了，他还听到了一点声音。

那声音像是在诱惑他，但他听不清那声音在说什么，像是那声音被什么干扰了。

虎不帅把商非凡的话传给彘庞男爵。

唰！正在搜索营地的城卫军全都远远离开了商非凡指出的地点。

彘庞男爵更是拒绝靠近。

虎不帅想要和商非凡一起过去查看，被商非凡按住。

“老实在这儿待着！我不叫你，你就不准过去。”

虎不帅：“……”

商非凡堂而皇之地凭空摸出一把工兵铲，走到雕像竖立的地点，一铲子挖了下去。
chunks.englishText:
This was to prevent one's Mental Power from being contaminated by Resentment, which could lead to becoming a living specter of vengeance instead of successfully harnessing the energy.

However, a Curse Priest's Mental Power naturally suppressed Resentment. As long as he didn't deliberately court death, the Resentment couldn't harm him.

Yet, Shang Feifan failed to notice that as he absorbed greater quantities of Resentment, his tea-black eyes were gradually shifting to a deep, dark red.

As the Resentment thinned out quickly, the insect venom became prominent.

Insect venom was present, but in small quantities.

Unfortunately, while he could perceive its presence, he had no way to absorb or cleanse it.

The substance was like a terrifying pathogen—highly contagious and capable of directly rewriting genetic code.

However, infecting Beastmen or other creatures required a significant dosage.

The trace amount left in the camp wouldn't affect the Beastmen. What remained unclear was whether the venom would gradually degrade naturally or persist indefinitely.

If the Insect Curse was tied to this venom, its natural degradation time might be even longer than nuclear radiation.

Shang Feifan's eyes locked onto the spot where the statue had previously stood.

An unusual energy was lingering there.

Dense Resentment, mingled with another form of energy that Shang Feifan could not identify.

"What did you find?" Hu Bushuai looked in the same direction.

Shang Feifan's expression turned grave. "Tell Baron Zhi Pang to have his men stay far away from that spot—unless they want to become cultists of the evil god."

Not only did he see it, but he also heard a faint sound.

It sounded like a voice attempting to entice him, but he couldn't make out the words, as though the audio was distorted by interference.

Hu Bushuai relayed Shang Feifan's warning to Baron Zhi Pang.

*Whoosh!* The City Guard searching the camp immediately backed far away from the spot Shang Feifan pointed out.

Baron Zhi Pang flat-out refused to get anywhere near it.

Hu Bushuai made to go check it out with Shang Feifan, but Shang Feifan held him back.

"Stay put! Don't come over unless I call you."

Hu Bushuai: "..."

Unabashedly pulling an entrenching shovel out of thin air, Shang Feifan walked over to where the statue had been erected and plunged the shovel deep into the dirt.

chunks.chineseText:
第61章 惊人发现

砰！

商非凡第二铲子下去，铲下土壤突然爆炸。

大量黑烟喷出，那黑烟在半空形成一个古怪的形状，咻地就向远处逃去。

商非凡就算有所警醒，也只来得及往旁边滚倒。他刚才下铲子时并没有感知到危险！

而就在他滚倒的同时，一个身影猛地扑过来覆盖住他。

毛茸茸的身体把他覆盖得严严实实。

大量砂土和不明物体四散落下。

爆炸并不算猛烈，不像是要特意炸死挖坑的人，而是土壤里面有什么东西冲了出来。

城卫军们慢了一步，冲上来保护住彘庞男爵也迅速往四周撤离躲避。

商非凡睁大眼睛看着覆盖在他身上的巨大毛茸茸，眼里盛满惊讶。

那是一只成年体型的猛虎，雪白的毛皮中夹杂着些微的黑色纹路。

这些黑色纹路并不像普通虎兽身上的花纹，更像是一种神秘的符纹。

额头黑色的“天”字型纹路特别霸气！

商非凡下意识伸手，抓住了一把皮毛。

厚实，温暖，还很润泽，比真正的老虎皮毛好摸多了，更不要说气味。

白虎的身体覆盖住他时，他就从对方的气息知道那是虎不帅。

能变身的兽人简直就是绒毛控的最爱！

“我不知道你竟然会这么在意我。”商非凡低喃。

啪！

一条粗壮的白色虎尾抽中商非凡的手。

白虎直起四肢。

商非凡的手舍不得地从白虎腰部皮毛挪开。

他真的好想一把抱上去，把整个脸都埋进白虎的皮毛里。

“受伤了吗？”白虎发出人声。

商非凡怀味地搓了搓手指，从地上利落跳起，“没事，小伤。”

“有东西逃掉了。”商非凡又可惜地说。

白虎：“人没事就好。这次主要是没经验。”

商非凡看向黑烟逃走的方向，右眼视界出现一个小地图，地图上亮起一个红色的亮点。

那亮点不断远离，小地图也跟着不断改变。

这是他第一次用怨气标记某物。

黑烟喷出来时，比他脑子更快的是他的反射神经，他几乎没用大脑思考，就把怨气给附着在了黑烟上。

这就是一种直觉，那时候他并不知道黑烟是“活”的，会逃跑。

“看看坑里有什么。”商非凡走到被他铲开又自我炸开的坑边，半蹲探头往里看。

坑不算深，也就不到一米。

商非凡直接跳下去。

“小心！”白虎担心。

商非凡拂开浮土，从坑里挖出一口长宽高约三十厘米的正方形箱子。

彘庞男爵重新靠过来，“还有东西剩下？”

他以为刚才的爆炸把可能有的线索都炸没了。

“这个箱子很结实。”商非凡把箱子放到坑边，从坑里跳出来。

城卫军看向彘庞男爵，用眼神询问要不要他们把箱子拿过来。

彘庞男爵微微抬手。

这种事就不要抢先了。先让虎不帅他们看看情况。

彘庞男爵又下意识看向虎不帅变身的白虎。

白虎不稀奇，但不是每一只白虎额头上都会有“天”字图案。

每一只虎兽额头的花纹都不一样，哪怕是类似的图案也会有些微不同，就像世界上没有完全相同的两片叶子。

重点是当代虎王的额头也有一个“天”字形图案，偏偏他的几个孩子，没有一个额头继承“天”字形图案。

彘庞男爵忍不住暗想，如果我是父亲，我也会在意和我拥有类似独特特征的孩子。

白虎没有变为人形，他感到箱子表面的花纹有点眼熟，绕着箱子走了两圈：“炼金箱子。需要秘法打开。”

商非凡抱起箱子轻轻晃了晃：“不算重，里面有东西。我来看看怎么打开。”

“你会开炼金箱？”彘庞男爵忍不住问。

商非凡发现箱子没有卡扣，就像是那种机关箱，严丝合缝。

他很自然地抬头问：“你们谁会开？”

彘庞男爵身边走出一人，这人穿着城卫军的衣服，却介绍自己说：“我是一名炼金学徒。”

商非凡让出位置：“你请。”

那名自称炼金学徒的城卫军看向彘庞男爵。

彘庞男爵对他点点头。

对方走到坑边，没有直接接过箱子，而是示意商非凡先把箱子放下。

等商非凡放下箱子后，他才半跪在地上查看那口箱子。

商非凡走到白虎身边，右手蠢蠢欲动地摸向白虎的背。

白虎似乎在看那口箱子，看得很入神，没有第一时间躲开商非凡的手。

商非凡暗想：我也算是得到了一点点信任了吧？

不，也许更多。刚刚不帅可是那么快就变身扑过来，用身体保护他！

那样的不帅，帅到家了！

商非凡感叹：不帅啊不帅，你这就是典型地明着拒绝我，暗中狠狠勾搭我。你这让我怎么愿意放开你？

“你见过类似的箱子？”商非凡低声问白虎。他感觉到白虎投向那口箱子的专注。

虎不帅自己也在疑惑。

一开始他只是觉得这口箱子的外表花纹让他感到有点眼熟，也没多想。

但等他仔细看向这口箱子时，已经沉没到记忆最深处的过去一角被触动。

他绝对见过这口箱子！

可回溯这辈子短短五年的记忆，他可以非常确定地告诉自己：他这辈子还是第一次见到这口箱子。

排除这辈子的记忆，那就是上辈子。

箱子的花纹很特殊，每个世界每个文明都有自己独特的风采，这种花纹属于上辈子的世界，一个拥有魔法师和战斗师的世界。

“这是我家族的族纹……”

虎不帅脑中忽然冒出一句话，随着这句话，他的脑中也逐渐浮现出一幅清晰的画面。

说话的人声音微微低沉，单手抚摸着一口箱子。

那口箱子表面的花纹和面前这口箱子的花纹一点点重叠……

不可能！

虎不帅用力摇头。

肯定是他记错了。

这是两个完全不同的世界，另一个世界的箱子怎么可能会出现在这个世界？

这一定是某种巧合。

可是……

虎不帅没有动，他不希望任何人看出他的震动。

商非凡感觉到虎不帅忽然生出的焦躁。而他刚才的问题，不帅并没有回答他。

那名炼金学徒观察了那口箱子好一会儿，还上手尝试了一番，最终摇头。

“这是密纹箱，想要打开，必须把上面的纹路按照规律重新排列。一般来说只要错上两三步就会彻底锁死这口箱子，甚至导致箱子自爆。”

炼金学徒城卫军对彘庞男爵回禀：“也许要带给我老师，才能找出破解方法。”

彘庞男爵没有立刻说话，而是看向商和虎两人，他虽然贵为摩罗城城主，但这口箱子的归属并不是他能决定。除非这箱子里的东西重要珍贵到他不惜得罪虎王和特别调查局的程度。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 61: An Astonishing Discovery

*BANG!*

As Shang Feifan struck with his second shovel, the dirt beneath blew up without warning.

A thick plume of black smoke erupted, coalescing into a bizarre shape in midair before zipping off into the distance.

Even though Shang Feifan had been on alert, he only managed to dive to the side. He hadn't sensed any danger when digging!

Just as he rolled onto the ground, a figure pounced over, completely covering him.

A massive, furry body shielded him thoroughly.

Sand, soil, and unidentified debris rained down all around.

The explosion wasn't particularly powerful; rather than an intent to kill the digger, it was more like something bursting forth from beneath the soil.

The City Guards were a step too slow; rushing over to protect Baron Zhi Pang, they swiftly retreated to take cover.

Shang Feifan stared with wide eyes at the massive fluffball shielding him, his gaze filled with astonishment.

It was a fully grown tiger, its snow-white fur intermingled with subtle black markings.

These black stripes didn't resemble ordinary tiger patterns; they looked more like mysterious runic symbols.

The black markings on its forehead formed the character "天" (Heaven), emanating an imposing aura!

Shang Feifan subconsciously reached out and grabbed a handful of fur.

It was thick, warm, and supple—far better to touch than real tiger fur, to say nothing of the scent.

The moment the white tiger covered him, he had known from the scent that it was Hu Bushuai.

*Shifter Beastmen are an absolute dream come true for fluff lovers!*

"I didn't realize you cared about me so much," Shang Feifan whispered.

*PAP!*

A thick white tiger tail smacked Shang Feifan's hand.

The white tiger pushed itself up on all fours.

Shang Feifan reluctantly pulled his hand away from the white tiger's waist fur.

He wanted so badly to wrap his arms around it and bury his face in that plush white coat.

"Are you hurt?" The white tiger spoke in a human voice.

Shang Feifan savored the lingering sensation, rubbing his fingers together before jumping up deftly. "I'm fine, just minor stuff."

"Something escaped," Shang Feifan added regretfully.

The white tiger replied, "As long as you're safe. We just lacked experience this time."

Shang Feifan looked in the direction the black smoke had fled. A mini-map popped up in his right-eye vision, displaying a glowing red blip.

The blip moved continuously farther away, and the mini-map adjusted accordingly.

This was his first time using Resentment to mark something.

When the black smoke blasted out, his reflexes had acted faster than his brain. Without even thinking, he had attached Resentment to the smoke.

It was sheer instinct; at the time, he hadn't known the black smoke was "alive" and would flee.

"Let's see what's in the pit." Shang Feifan walked to the edge of the pit he had dug and which had subsequently detonated, crouching down to peer inside.

The hole wasn't deep—less than a meter down.

Shang Feifan hopped straight in.

"Be careful!" the white tiger warned out of concern.

Brushing aside loose soil, Shang Feifan unearthed a square box measuring roughly thirty centimeters in length, width, and height.

Baron Zhi Pang approached again. "There's still something left?"

He had assumed the explosion destroyed any possible clues.

"This box is very sturdy." Shang Feifan set the box on the edge of the pit and climbed out.

The City Guards glanced at Baron Zhi Pang, asking with their eyes if they should fetch the box.

Baron Zhi Pang raised his hand slightly.

*No need to jump ahead. Let Hu Bushuai and his companion check it out first.*

Baron Zhi Pang subconsciously looked at the white tiger Hu Bushuai had transformed into.

White tigers weren't unheard of, but not every white tiger bore the character "天" on its forehead.

Every tiger beast had distinct forehead markings; even similar patterns possessed subtle differences, much like no two leaves in the world were identical.

More importantly, the current Tiger King had the "天" character mark on his forehead, yet none of his known children had inherited it.

Baron Zhi Pang couldn't help thinking: *If I were the father, I too would care about a child who shares such a unique trait.*

The white tiger didn't revert to human form. Sensing that the engraved patterns on the box looked familiar, he circled it twice. "An alchemy chest. It requires a secret method to open."

Shang Feifan picked up the chest and shook it gently. "Not too heavy, but there's something inside. Let me see how to open it."

"You know how to open an alchemy chest?" Baron Zhi Pang couldn't resist asking.

Shang Feifan noticed the box lacked latches or locks; it was like a puzzle box, seamlessly fitted together.

He naturally looked up and asked, "Does any of you know how to open it?"

A figure stepped out from beside Baron Zhi Pang. Dressed in the uniform of the City Guard, he introduced himself, "I am an alchemy apprentice."

Shang Feifan yielded his spot. "After you."

The City Guard claiming to be an alchemy apprentice looked toward Baron Zhi Pang.

Baron Zhi Pang gave him a nod.

The apprentice walked over to the pit. Instead of taking the chest directly, he signaled for Shang Feifan to set it down first.

Only after Shang Feifan put the chest down did he kneel on one knee to examine it.

Shang Feifan walked over to the white tiger's side, his right hand itching to pet the tiger's back.

The white tiger seemed engrossed in looking at the chest and didn't immediately dodge Shang Feifan's hand.

Shang Feifan thought: *Guess I've gained a bit of trust, haven't I?*

*No, maybe more than a bit. Bushuai transformed and pounced over so quickly just now to shield me with his own body!*

*That Bushuai back there was cool as hell!*

Shang Feifan sighed internally: *Bushuai, oh Bushuai, you're the classic case of rejecting me on the outside while flirting aggressively on the inside. How am I supposed to let go of you like this?*

"Have you seen a box like this before?" Shang Feifan asked the white tiger softly, sensing his focused gaze on the chest.

Hu Bushuai was perplexed himself.

At first, he had merely thought the outer patterns looked somewhat familiar and hadn't dwelt on it.

However, as he stared closely at the chest, a long-buried corner from the deepest recesses of his past memory was stirred.

He had absolutely seen this chest before!

Yet searching back through his brief five years in this life, he could say with utter certainty: this was the first time he had ever laid eyes on this box in his current life.

Excluding this lifetime's memories left only his previous life.

The patterns on the box were very specific. Every world and civilization possessed its own unique flair; these engravings belonged to his previous world—a world of mages and combatants.

*"This is my family's emblem..."*

A phrase suddenly popped into Hu Bushuai's mind, accompanied by a clear image forming in his memory.

The speaker's voice was slightly deep, one hand resting gently on a chest.

The patterns on that chest slowly overlapped with the ones on the chest before him...

*Impossible!*

Hu Bushuai shook his head vigorously.

*I must be misremembering.*

*These are two completely different worlds. How could a box from another world appear here?*

*It has to be some kind of coincidence.*

*And yet...*

Hu Bushuai remained still, refusing to let anyone notice his inner shock.

Shang Feifan felt the sudden burst of anxiety in Hu Bushuai. And Bushuai hadn't answered his previous question.

The alchemy apprentice examined the chest for quite a while, even attempting a few hands-on tests, before ultimately shaking his head.

"This is a Secret Rune Chest. To open it, the patterns on the surface must be rearranged according to a specific sequence. Generally, making even two or three wrong moves will completely lock the box—or even trigger a self-destruction."

The apprentice turned to report to Baron Zhi Pang, "Perhaps I need to bring it to my master to find a way to unlock it."

Baron Zhi Pang didn't speak immediately. Instead, he looked at Shang and Hu. Although he was the lord of Molo City, the ownership of this chest was not his to decide—unless the contents inside were so crucial and valuable that he wouldn't mind offending both the Tiger King and the Special Investigation Bureau.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡耳中忽然听到一道声音在他耳边低声道：“山纹为上，水纹为下。先向右推动左下角的三角图案，再向右滑动最下面的横纹图案。第三步，向左滑动最上面的横纹。第四步，用力按压箱盖顶端最中间。箱子就会打开。”

开箱步数不多，但不知道的人折腾死都不一定能打开。

商非凡没问虎不帅怎么知道开箱方法，而是直接拿过箱子，按照对方所述操作。

啪嗒。

随着一声清脆的机关响声，箱盖自动弹开。

彘庞男爵皱眉：这是搞什么？刚才还一副打不开的样子，现在却当着我的面轻轻松松打开？

商、虎两人都无意解释自己的行为。

一个压根就不在乎一个游戏NPC的想法，一个现在心神剧震，根本想不到太多。

没人知道虎不帅这时有多震惊。

他只是尝试了一下。

箱子竟然真的打开了。

他都惊讶他竟然还能记得箱子的打开步骤，都过去那么多年。

可当那一段记忆翻滚上来时，他才发现他并没有真正忘却，只是假装自己都已经忘记。

可能这也是修炼了精神力的唯一不好之处了，有些记忆真的是想忘都无法忘干净。

偏偏他也不想对自己施展记忆消除术。不是珍惜那些记忆，而是希望自己记住经验，不要再重蹈覆辙。

此时，所有靠近箱子的人都被打开的箱子吸引，想要知道箱子里装了什么。

商非凡距离箱子最近，在箱子打开的瞬间，他身前就立起了一块铁板。

虽然他的直觉告诉他，这口箱子并没有什么危险。

箱子自动弹开，果然没有冒出什么幺蛾子。

商非凡仍旧举着铁板，用工兵铲头轻轻挑起箱盖。

……确定安全，这才看向箱子里面。

商非凡从附近的大车上找了一块布，套在手上，单手把箱子里面的东西托出来，那表情……真不太好看。

那是一只被剥了皮的小型犬类生物。

虎不帅只瞄了一眼，就知道那不是野兽，是兽人幼崽，被剥了皮毛的兽人幼崽。

“这是献祭？”彘庞男爵声音阴沉。

“那么多邪神信徒聚集在这里，他们会只献祭一个幼崽？”城卫军统领忍不住说。

虎不帅脑中忽然有什么闪过，他想变回人形，但看到那堆情急下散落在地面的衣裤鞋袜……都脏了，他没有洁癖，但也不想把这身衣服重新穿上身。

无奈下，他只好指挥商非凡：“把他放到箱子上。用刀剖开小兽的腹部，看里面是不是塞了什么东西。”

商非凡照做。

小兽的腹部肌肉完整，并没有缝合痕迹，但等商非凡剖开腹部，却从里面找出来一块不属于小兽的骨头。

那块骨头看着像是头盖骨的一部分，一看就不是幼兽的头盖骨。头盖骨上还有诡异的紫红色纹路。

虎不帅看到这块掏出来的头盖骨，闭了闭眼睛。

没错了，这是他上辈子那个世界特有的黑魔法，也被叫做黑巫术。

“如果我所料不错，摩罗城最初出现虫毒散播者的地方，也能挖出一具尸体，不过不是幼兽，而是成年兽人的尸体。”

彘庞男爵眉头狠皱：“这是什么邪恶的术法吗？”

虎不帅没有回答这个问题，只是对商非凡说：“我们去摩罗城。必须把成年兽人的尸体挖出来，否则摩罗城势必还会出事。”

他也不说让商非凡离开的话了，这家伙绝对不会听他的，还不如一起行动。

商非凡自然没有异议。

彘庞男爵也需要回城，但他想要等虫毒散播者离开，等城里的虫毒解决后。

虎不帅没有强求彘庞男爵，只对他说：“我们会回去摩罗城查看。逃走的城民还处在危险中，还需要阁下你把逃散的城民聚集起来。”

彘庞男爵：“当然。这是我的职责。”

他也不可能眼睁睁看着那么多人口和人才流失。

实际上，他已经派人去集中那些逃出的城民。

“这口箱子，还有里面的尸体，我带走了。这个你们不好处理。”虎不帅指了指箱子。

“好！”彘庞男爵看到箱子里诡异的幼崽尸体时就想远离，哪会想要占为己有，这会儿虎不帅说他来处理，他巴不得呢。

商非凡和虎不帅当即就提着箱子离开了这个臭烘烘的邪神信徒营地。

虎不帅让商非凡帮他把钱袋和武器和装碎物的袋子捡起来带走，衣裤鞋袜他都不要了。

商非凡多了个心眼，他把虎不帅不要的衣裤鞋袜等也全都收拾起来，打算等会儿在路边找个地方烧掉。

学了诅咒才知道，很多随身物品最好不要随便乱丢。

路上，虎不帅显然有点心不在焉。

商非凡眼馋地看着巨大白虎，要是他能骑上去……

还是召唤狰爷吧！

虎不帅这会儿也感觉不到商非凡觊觎的目光，他整个脑子都很乱。

箱子上的花纹还能说是巧合。

可打开箱子的方法又算什么？

好吧，就当是炼金箱的开箱方法也有相同的时候。

但为什么会出现上个世界特有的黑巫术，子母怨咒？

而且这个子母怨咒的承载体还装在那口箱子里！

虎不帅最想不通的是，绘制有那个人家族族纹的炼金箱为什么会出现在这个世界，出现后又为什么会装着黑巫术的载体？

难道那个人……那个人的家族的某个人也来到了这个世界？

对方不但是炼金师，还修习了黑巫术？

可他一直以为这个世界不能施展魔法，这是个异能世界，没有魔力，只有其他能量。

可如果子母怨咒没能施展成功，又怎么会成功召唤出虫毒散播者？

而这又产生一个新问题。

为什么黑巫术可以召唤邪神阴影者？

难道……！

虎不帅脑中产生了一个极为可怕的猜测。

他在猜测这个兽人世界传说中的外来邪神会不会就是来自他上一个世界——那些外来邪神压根不是什么邪神，只是几个实力极为强大、差一步就能成神的圣级魔导师。

据他所知，有几个圣级魔导师为了寻求能跨出最后一步的方法，都已经走火入魔，什么疯狂事都干得出来。

这似乎也能解释为什么他的灵魂会被原身母亲召唤到这个世界，因为这个世界和他上一个世界的界壁已经被打破。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan suddenly heard a voice whispering in his ear, "Mountain patterns on top, water patterns below. First, push the triangular pattern in the bottom-left corner to the right, then slide the bottommost horizontal stripe to the right. Step three: slide the topmost horizontal stripe to the left. Step four: press firmly down on the exact center of the lid's top. The box will open."

The steps to open the box weren't many, but anyone who didn't know the secret could struggle until their death without opening it.

Shang Feifan didn't ask Hu Bushuai how he knew the method. He simply took the box and executed the steps as described.

*Clack.*

With a crisp click of a mechanism, the lid popped open automatically.

Baron Zhi Pang frowned: *What is this game? A moment ago it looked completely impossible to open, and now he opens it effortlessly right in front of my face?*

Neither Shang nor Hu had any intention of explaining their actions.

One simply didn’t care what a game NPC thought, while the other was currently in a state of profound shock, incapable of thinking about anything else.

No one knew just how shaken Hu Bushuai was at this moment.

He had merely given it a try.

And the box had actually opened.

He was astonished that he could still remember the sequence after so many years.

Yet, as that flood of memories surged back to the surface, he realized he had never truly forgotten—he had merely pretended to forget.

Perhaps this was the sole drawback of cultivating mental strength: certain memories simply could not be scrubbed clean, no matter how much one wished to forget.

Yet he refused to perform a memory-erasure spell on himself. Not because he cherished those memories, but because he wanted to keep the lesson alive, ensuring he would never repeat the same mistake.

At that moment, everyone near the chest was drawn to it, eager to see what was hidden inside.

Being closest to the box, the moment it popped open, Shang Feifan immediately raised an iron plate in front of himself as a shield.

Even though his instincts told him the chest posed no danger.

The lid swung open automatically, and indeed, no traps or bizarre tricks were triggered.

Shang Feifan kept the iron plate raised while using the head of an entrenching shovel to gently lift the lid all the way.

...Once he confirmed it was safe, he finally looked inside.

Shang Feifan found a piece of cloth on a nearby cart, wrapped it around his hand, and lifted the item out with one hand. His expression... was truly unpleasant.

It was a small, skinned canine creature.

Hu Bushuai only needed a single glance to know it wasn't a beast—it was a beastman cub. A beastman cub stripped of its fur and skin.

"Is this a sacrifice?" Baron Zhi Pang asked, his voice dark and heavy.

"With so many Evil God cultists gathered here, would they sacrifice just a single cub?" the commander of the city guard couldn't help but interject.

Something flashed through Hu Bushuai's mind. He wanted to shift back into human form, but seeing his clothes, pants, shoes, and socks scattered on the dirty ground from his hasty transformation earlier... they were all filthy. He wasn't a neat freak, but he certainly didn't want to put those dirty clothes back on.

Left with no choice, he could only instruct Shang Feifan: "Place it on top of the chest. Slice open the cub's abdomen and see if something is stuffed inside."

Shang Feifan obeyed.

The cub's abdominal muscles were intact, with no signs of stitching. Yet when Shang Feifan sliced open the stomach, he extracted a bone that clearly didn't belong to the little creature.

The bone looked like a segment of a skull—definitely not from a young cub. Etched upon the skull fragment were strange, purplish-red runes.

Seeing the skull fragment pulled from the belly, Hu Bushuai closed his eyes.

There was no mistaking it. This was black magic unique to his previous world—also known as black witchcraft.

"If my guess is correct, at the original site in Moro City where the Insect Poison Spreader appeared, we'll also be able to dig up a corpse—except it won't be a cub, but an adult beastman."

Baron Zhi Pang scowled deeply. "Is this some kind of evil spell?"

Hu Bushuai didn't answer the question. He simply turned to Shang Feifan and said, "We're going to Moro City. We must dig up the adult beastman's corpse, or Moro City will inevitably suffer another catastrophe."

He didn't bother telling Shang Feifan to leave anymore—the guy would never listen anyway, so they might as well move together.

Naturally, Shang Feifan had no objections.

Baron Zhi Pang also needed to return to the city, but he wanted to wait until the Insect Poison Spreader departed and the insect toxin inside the city was resolved.

Hu Bushuai didn't press the baron. He merely said, "We will go back to Moro City to investigate. The fled citizens are still in danger, so we will need Your Excellency to gather the scattered populace."

Baron Zhi Pang replied, "Of course. That is my duty."

He couldn't stand by and watch so much population and talent slip away either.

In truth, he had already dispatched men to rally the fleeing citizens.

"This chest and the corpse inside—I'm taking them. They'll be difficult for you to deal with," Hu Bushuai said, pointing at the box.

"Very well!" Baron Zhi Pang had wanted to stay far away from the uncanny cub corpse ever since seeing it. He had no desire to claim it for himself, so when Hu Bushuai offered to dispose of it, he couldn't be happier.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai immediately grabbed the chest and departed from the foul, reeking cultist camp.

Hu Bushuai asked Shang Feifan to pick up his coin pouch, weapons, and bag of miscellaneous items, abandoning his discarded clothes, pants, shoes, and socks.

Shang Feifan was extra cautious. He packed up all the abandoned clothing items Hu Bushuai left behind, intending to find a spot by the road later to burn them.

Only after studying curses did he realize that personal belongings shouldn't be discarded carelessly.

On the road, Hu Bushuai was clearly distracted.

Shang Feifan eyed the massive white tiger with envy. *If only I could ride on its back...*

*Better stick to summoning Lord Zheng!*

Hu Bushuai didn't even notice Shang Feifan's covetous gaze; his mind was in complete turmoil.

The patterns on the box could still be dismissed as a coincidence.

But what about the method to open it?

Fine, let's say alchemy chests sometimes shared identical opening mechanisms.

But why would a black witchcraft spell unique to his previous world—the Mother-Child Grudge Curse—appear here?

And why was the medium for this Mother-Child Grudge Curse housed right inside that alchemy box?!

What perplexed Hu Bushuai the most was why an alchemy box engraved with that person's family crest would appear in this world—and why, upon appearing, it carried the vessel of a black witchcraft spell?

Could it be that that person... or someone from that person's family had also transmigrated to this world?

And that individual was not only an alchemist, but had also cultivated black witchcraft?

Yet he had always assumed this world was devoid of magic—that it was an ability-based world without mana, possessing only other forms of energy.

However, if the Mother-Child Grudge Curse hadn't been cast successfully, how could it have summoned the Insect Poison Spreader?

And that spawned yet another question.

Why could black witchcraft summon the Evil God's Shadows?

Could it be...?!

A horrifying conjecture sprouted in Hu Bushuai's mind.

He speculated whether the legendary outer Evil Gods of this beastman world actually originated from his previous world—that those outer Evil Gods weren't evil gods at all, but rather several absurdly powerful Archmages who were just one step away from godhood.

As far as he knew, several Archmages had succumbed to obsession in their desperate quest for that final step, becoming unhinged enough to commit any madness imaginable.

This also seemed to explain why his soul had been summoned to this world by his original body's mother—because the boundary wall between this world and his previous world had already been ruptured.

chunks.chineseText:
第62章 重回摩罗城

天空蒙蒙发亮，已经到了黑夜与白日交替的时刻。

远远的就能看到摩罗城好几处冒出了火光，还有冲天而起的黑烟。

狰爷把两人送到城门口，没进去，带着阿呆再次远离摩罗城。

如果不是商非凡要求，狰爷才不会重返这个鬼地方。

它是被划分到虫类没错，但它也不想感染虫毒，变成失去自我、只知道疯狂嗜杀的怪物。

这个世界有三种虫，一种是和兽人一样拥有两种形态的虫人族，一种是虫人族异变后失去理智的虫族，还有一种则是普通的虫类。

有意思的是，普通虫类对于虫毒的抵抗力要比兽人们好，可这并不代表普通虫类不会感染虫毒，相反，它们一旦感染虫毒，会异变成非常可怕的虫族怪物，杀伤力巨大。

有兽人研究，虫毒对于兽人来说，是异变。但对于虫类来说，则是进化，只是进化的代价太大。

为此虫类对于虫毒的感应天生就比兽人更加敏感，一旦某地出现虫类大量出逃的现象，那就要小心了。

实际上摩罗城今晚出现虫毒散播者之前的一分钟，城中就有大量虫子在疯狂逃离。

就因为有虫子的这场异动，才会让得到消息的城卫军们能及时反应，在虫毒散播者刚刚出现就敲响警钟。

虎不帅进城后就找了个空房子进去换上衣服。

衣裤鞋袜由商非凡友情提供。

对于商非凡能凭空拿出东西这点，虎不帅什么都没问。

上一世他也是拥有过空间手镯的人。

这一世的兽人世界也有空间储物工具，不过因为能炼制空间储物工具的高级炼金师极少，导致这东西在兽人世界异常稀少和珍贵，只有身份贵重且家底厚实的大贵族和大富豪才可能拥有。

其他人不是说没有机会获得空间储物工具，但这样的幸运者真的是极少极少，比中大乐透的几率还低。

据虎不帅所知，虎王就有一条空间腰带。

甚至这条空间腰带已经成了每一代虎王的象征，只有虎王才能佩戴。

传说王室的大半财富以及很多失传的大繁华纪宝贝，都被藏在那条空间腰带里。得到那条腰带，相当于拥有了可以兴建一个国家的财力和知识传承。

虎王的几个孩子为了王位斗得跟彼此不是一个爹妈生的更像是血海深仇的仇人，何尝不是因为眼红那条空间腰带以及里面暗藏的庞大财富。

商非凡看到虎不帅穿着他买的衣裤鞋袜，心里小小荡漾。

他的衣服鞋子，虎不帅穿着有点大，不过这时候也只能凑合。

“没人了。”虎不帅看着昏暗的城市轻声说。

有人也躲起来了。

比起他们刚逃出来那会儿，这会儿的摩罗城就像是一座死城。

城门口再没有拥堵挤压的城民，四个城门全都敞开着，一眼望过去，道路空空荡荡。

只地面大量垃圾和少量发黑的血迹，才昭示出这座城市之前发生了什么。

“你确定吗？如果你跟我一起过去，很可能会被感染虫毒。”虎不帅轻声问商非凡。

商非凡：“你呢？你不怕感染吗？”

虎不帅眼眸微垂：“我有短时间自保的办法。”

“我也一样。”商非凡小小扯谎。

他并不知道自己能不能抵抗虫毒感染，他依仗的是他的玩家身体，想着大不了感染了就放弃这具身体重生。

再说他心中还有一个不太确定的推测，他的直觉告诉他，虫毒对他来说也许不是毒，而是养料。

证据就是他能吸收变异虫尸溃散的能量。他还融合吸收了虫母九分之一的心脏。

虫母是什么？

那不就是虫毒制造的源头？

虫母自身都无法抵抗虫毒感染，那不是搞笑吗？

既然虫母能抵抗虫毒感染甚至能变废为宝，那虫母的心脏必然也可以。

当然，现在这只是商非凡的推测，他到底能不能抵抗虫毒，还得实际试过才知道。

虎不帅不想这个老乡出事，但看他言之凿凿、一脸自信，猜想他可能有什么依仗，最终还是和对方并肩走向摩罗城的西北方。

虫毒散播者一开始就是出现在那边。

那里也是摩罗城最贫穷的贫民区，一向以脏乱差出名，似乎所有城市的贫民区都有着这么一个特质。

那里不管出现什么稀奇古怪的人、做出什么稀奇古怪的事，都不会引来太多人注意。就算有人看到，看到的人也只会当没看到。

在那里生活的人都秉持着“多一事不如少一事”的漠然态度。

如果有人在那里杀人，看到的当地人不会想着去报给治安官、更不会想着去阻止，他们只会等行凶者杀完人以后冲过去摸尸。

甚至只要你胆子大，尸体都能扛走卖钱。

“虫毒感染者多长时间会变异？”商非凡问。

路上太-安静了，安静到让人心里发慌。

但商非凡说话不是为了打发不安，他只是想和虎不帅说话。

虎不帅不知在想什么，被商非凡碰了碰手臂，才回过神：“变异？哦，一般是死亡后几分钟到十二个小时内。所以碰到虫毒散播者，最佳的处理时间就是前三个小时。超过这个时间，虫毒感染者数量会不断增多，自然也会越来越难对付。”

商非凡抓住重点：“你是说虫毒感染者会先死一遍？”

虎不帅诧异：“你不是已经看到了吗？那些邪神信徒就是全都先被杀死，死后才开始异变。他们就都是被虫毒感染。”

“他们不知道自己被虫毒感染了吗？”

“应该不知道。那些邪神信徒再疯狂，也不至于自己去主动感染虫毒。不管是谁，大家都认定死后变异，灵魂也会消失。”

商非凡想到那些邪神信徒喝的汤，怀疑虫毒来源就是那些汤水。

“虫毒有潜伏期吗？就是被感染后不会立刻死亡，而是遇到某种特定条件后，比如死亡后才会被激活。”

虎不帅点头：“没错。根据特别调查局收集到的信息，虫毒感染分为两种，一种是能让受感染者快速死亡，然后转变。一种则是潜伏在被感染者体内，等到被感染者死亡后才会发挥作用。”

商非凡想得更多一点：“也许虫毒只有一种，它只能让尸体异变。让兽人们和其他生物死亡的方式，则是另一种。否则那些邪神阴影者根本无需出现。”

虎不帅脚步顿住，过了一会儿才说道：“你说的对。那些邪神阴影者并不是为了散播虫毒才出现，它们出现就是为了杀死兽人。”

“以及散播恐怖。”商非凡追加。

在战区待了很多年的商非凡太知道散播恐怖的威力。

当你把恐惧深植人心的时候，就算只是报出名字，都能让弱者无力反抗也不敢反抗。

比如伤人杀人就会坐牢会判死刑，就是一种成功的恐惧植入，效果就是让人们不敢轻易犯罪。

邪神阴影者的出现也拥有同样效果，给人们深植邪神的强大和不可战胜以及诡异的特性，让兽人们从一开始就失去抵抗心，遇到邪神阴影者就想着逃跑。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 62: Return to Moro City

The sky was dimly brightening; twilight was giving way to dawn as night transitioned into day.

From afar, plumes of thick black smoke and pillars of fire could be seen rising from several locations across Moro City.

Lord Zheng delivered the two to the city gates but refused to enter, taking Ah Dai with it as it once again distanced itself from Moro City.

If Shang Feifan hadn't requested it, Lord Zheng would never have returned to this wretched place.

It was categorized among the insectoid species, true, but it had no desire to contract the insect toxin and turn into a mindless, bloodthirsty monster.

There were three categories of insects in this world: the Insectkin, who possessed two forms much like the Beastmen; the Zerg, who were mutated Insectkin that had lost all reason; and ordinary insects.

Interestingly enough, ordinary insects possessed better resistance to the insect toxin than Beastmen did. However, this did not mean ordinary insects were immune. On the contrary, once they were infected, they mutated into terrifying insectoid monsters capable of immense devastation.

According to Beastman researchers, the insect toxin was a mutation for Beastmen. But for insects, it represented an evolution—albeit one with far too steep a price.

Because of this, insects were naturally far more sensitive to the toxin than Beastmen. Whenever a massive exodus of insects occurred in a region, one had to tread with extreme caution.

In fact, one minute before the Insect Poison Spreader appeared in Moro City tonight, swarms of insects had been fleeing frantically throughout the city.

It was precisely because of this unusual insect movement that the informed city guards were able to react in time, sounding the alarm the moment the Insect Poison Spreader materialized.

After entering the city, Hu Bushuai found an empty house and went inside to change his clothes.

The clothes, pants, shoes, and socks were generously provided by Shang Feifan.

Hu Bushuai didn't ask a single question about Shang Feifan's ability to produce items out of thin air.

In his previous life, he had also owned a spatial bracelet.

The Beastman world of this lifetime also possessed spatial storage tools. However, because high-level alchemists capable of crafting them were exceedingly rare, such items were extraordinarily scarce and precious in this world, reserved almost exclusively for high nobility and wealthy tycoons with vast fortunes.

It wasn't that ordinary people had zero chance of obtaining a spatial storage tool, but such fortunate individuals were exceedingly rare—rarer than winning the mega lottery.

As far as Hu Bushuai knew, the Tiger King possessed a spatial belt.

In fact, this spatial belt had become the symbol of every generation's Tiger King, wearable only by the king himself.

Legend had it that more than half of the royal family's wealth and numerous lost treasures from the Era of Great Prosperity were stored inside that spatial belt. Obtaining it was equivalent to acquiring the wealth and intellectual heritage required to found an entire nation.

The Tiger King's children fought so fiercely over the throne—looking less like siblings born of the same parents and more like sworn enemies with blood feuds—largely because they coveted that spatial belt and the monumental fortune hidden within.

Seeing Hu Bushuai wearing the clothes, pants, shoes, and socks he had purchased, Shang Feifan felt a small ripple of gratification in his heart.

His clothes and shoes were a bit too big for Hu Bushuai, but under the circumstances, they just had to make do.

"No one's left," Hu Bushuai whispered, gazing out at the dim city.

Those who remained were hiding.

Compared to when they had first fled, Moro City now resembled a ghost town.

The city gates were no longer jammed with fleeing citizens; all four gates stood wide open, and as far as the eye could see, the streets were completely deserted.

Only the piles of litter on the ground and scattered patches of dried, blackened blood bore witness to what had transpired here earlier.

"Are you sure?" Hu Bushuai asked Shang Feifan softly. "If you come with me, you might very well get infected by the insect toxin."

Shang Feifan countered, "What about you? Aren't you afraid of getting infected?"

Hu Bushuai lowered his eyes slightly. "I have a method to protect myself temporarily."

"Same here," Shang Feifan told a tiny lie.

He didn't actually know if he could resist the infection. He was relying on his player body, reasoning that if he got infected, he could just abandon this body and respawn.

Besides, he harbored an unconfirmed theory in his mind. His intuition told him that the insect toxin might not be a poison to him, but rather nourishment.

The proof was that he could absorb the dispersed energy from mutated insect corpses. He had even integrated and absorbed one-ninth of a Mother Insect's heart.

And what was a Mother Insect?

Wasn't it the very origin of the insect toxin?

If the Mother Insect itself couldn't resist its own toxin, wouldn't that be ridiculous?

Since the Mother Insect could resist the toxin and even turn waste into treasure, its heart surely possessed the same capability.

Of course, this was currently just Shang Feifan's conjecture; whether he could actually withstand the toxin would only be known after a real test.

Hu Bushuai didn't want his fellow transmigrator to get hurt, but seeing how confident and certain he appeared, he assumed the man had some trump card. In the end, he walked shoulder-to-shoulder with him toward the northwestern district of Moro City.

That was where the Insect Poison Spreader had first appeared.

It was also Moro City's poorest slum, notorious for being filthy, chaotic, and run-down—a trait common to slums in almost every city.

No matter what strange people appeared there or what bizarre things were done, it rarely drew attention. Even if someone saw something, they would pretend they hadn't.

The inhabitants there maintained an indifferent attitude of "less trouble is better than more."

If someone committed murder there, the locals who witnessed it wouldn't dream of reporting it to the constables, let alone trying to stop it. They would simply wait for the killer to finish, then rush forward to loot the corpse.

If you were bold enough, you could even carry the corpse off to sell for money.

"How long does it take for someone infected by the insect toxin to mutate?" Shang Feifan asked.

The road was eerie and quiet—so quiet that it made one feel uneasy.

However, Shang Feifan wasn't speaking to dispel his unease; he simply wanted to talk with Hu Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai had been lost in thought. Snapping back to reality after Shang Feifan nudged his arm, he replied, "Mutate? Oh, usually anywhere from a few minutes to twelve hours after death. That's why the optimal window to deal with an Insect Poison Spreader is within the first three hours. Past that, the number of infected will continuously multiply, naturally making them harder and harder to deal with."

Shang Feifan caught the key point: "Are you saying the infected have to die first?"

Hu Bushuai looked surprised. "Didn't you see it already? All those Evil God cultists were killed first before their corpses began to mutate. They were all infected by the insect toxin."

"Did they not know they were infected?"

"They probably didn't. No matter how insane those cultists are, they wouldn't voluntarily infect themselves. Everyone believes that mutating after death destroys the soul as well."

Shang Feifan recalled the broth those cultists had been drinking and suspected that the soup was the source of the toxin.

"Does the toxin have an incubation period? Like, being infected doesn't cause immediate death, but it gets activated under specific conditions—such as after death?"

Hu Bushuai nodded. "Correct. According to information gathered by the Special Investigation Bureau, insect toxin infection falls into two categories: one causes rapid death followed by transformation, while the other remains dormant inside the body and only takes effect once the host dies."

Shang Feifan thought deeper: "Maybe there's only one kind of toxin, and it only mutates corpses. The method used to kill Beastmen and other creatures is something else entirely. Otherwise, there would be no need for the Evil God's Shadows to appear at all."

Hu Bushuai paused in his tracks. After a moment, he said, "You're right. Those Evil God's Shadows didn't appear to spread the toxin—they appeared to kill Beastmen."

"And to spread terror," Shang Feifan added.

Having spent many years in war zones, Shang Feifan understood the true power of sowing terror all too well.

When fear was deeply ingrained in people's hearts, merely speaking a name was enough to leave the weak powerless and terrified to resist.

For example, instilling the fear that hurting or killing someone leads to prison or execution was a successful form of fear implantation, designed to prevent people from casually committing crimes.

The appearance of the Evil God's Shadows served the exact same purpose: instilling deep within people the terrifying, invincible, and uncanny nature of the Evil Gods, depriving the Beastmen of their will to fight from the start so that their only instinct upon encountering a Shadow was to flee.
