"Of course there is. The most basic is cultivating your mental power. In fact, because of the lack of natural energy, the proportion of mental power cultivation has greatly increased nowadays. Many powerful beastmen possess extremely formidable mental power.

Additionally, there is the use of alchemical tools to expand one's perception, absorption, and application of natural energy. This is also the most common method of cultivation."

A trace of complex emotion that was hard to decipher flickered in Hu Bushuai's eyes. "During the Great War Era, especially before the mid-Great Prosperity Era, the beastmen of that time could easily perceive a vast amount of natural energy, and could absorb and apply it with relative ease. But after the Great War Era, as the Zerg curse spread, natural energy became extremely difficult to perceive."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第65章 学习炼金和附魔 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡得出总结：“换句话说，就是虫族诅咒或者说弥漫整个兽人世界的虫毒破坏了这个世界的自然能量，但并没有让其成分改变，只是让自然能量从旺盛变得稀少，导致兽人世界的超凡体系也遭到极大破坏。”

虎不帅：“……”老乡你知道你的言辞暴露了多少吗？很多用词兽人世界就不是这么用的。

商非凡还在分析：“我觉得比起稀少，更像是变成难以调动的惰性能量，否则就算有炼金器具辅助吸收也没用。”

商非凡依据科学，脑洞大开：“你看原本的自然能量是不是就像水一样的液体，随便舀。但掺杂了虫毒后就变成了胶一样的半固体，这时候兽人们只靠精神力就很难从胶状体中把自然能量给单独拉扯出来。而炼金器具起到的作用就是扎入这个胶状能量中，对其进行分解和稀释，好便于吸收。这就是工具的好处。”

虎不帅：“……确实。”

商非凡思维跳跃到原话题，举起骨片：“假设这个附魔传承是真的，我觉得它就是真的，因为它确实引动了某种能量。但这种能量比起自然能量还要固执和懒惰，强拉硬拽都拉拽不到多少，而且还留不住。那么我们能不能给它换一种能量？”

虎不帅：你以为我没想过吗，我也想过用兽人世界的自然能量来代替魔力，但可能我真的不是研究型人才，琢磨好几年也没能琢磨出来。

商非凡的大脑正在超高速运转，“能量殊途同归，不管哪种能量，只要经过转换，都可以应用在终端上。能量无法顺利进入终端，原因有很多，比如功率不匹配、接口不适配、线路搭接错误……”

商非凡目光落到骨片上，“这个就是典型的电压不匹配。220V电器要怎么在110V的电压环境下使用？就算能用也会如小牛拖重车。”

这些专有名词，商非凡都是用华夏语说的，他以为虎不帅听不懂。如果对方问，他就打算用这是家乡土话来掩护。

在旁边听得清清楚楚的虎不帅：“……”

商非凡摸下巴：“如果能给这个附魔骨片增加一个能量转换器，也许它就能正常吸收兽人世界的能量并能使用。附魔也不一定非要是魔力。”

“要么我们试试？”商非凡眼睛亮晶晶地说。

虎不帅决定把不擅长的事交给擅长的人：“要怎么试？”

商非凡用非常肯定的语气说：“附魔和炼金知识结合。”

虎不帅挑眉：“你会炼金？”

商非凡心里说“不会，但我马上就会了。”嘴上则不太谦虚地说：“会一点。”

他的贡献点总点数已经达到298点，扣除使用掉的点数，还结余183点。

游戏商城中炼金师的职业技能书初级需要100贡献点。

他虽然很想找个炼金师教他炼金，好节省下这一百贡献点，但这不是一时半会找不到嘛。

而且貌似这个世界的炼金师都比较敝帚自珍，对学徒掏出压箱底知识的极少，更少有在收徒初期就教出真正的炼金知识，总是以磨练的名义让学徒打杂。

炼金学徒想要学习到真正的炼金知识得花很长时间。

如此一来，他就算找到一个炼金师，也不一定能很快掌握初级炼金术。

利弊衡量下，还不如直接从游戏商城购买职业技能书来得快。

钱吗，赚来不就是要花的吗。

如果只赚不花，那赚钱还有什么意义？

更何况这一百点还是花在刀刃上。

商非凡想定，毫不犹豫地就从商城里购买了炼金师初级技能书。

一本金光闪闪的皮质书悬浮在商非凡眼前。

“学习。”商非凡小声下令。

书籍当即就非常形象地化作一道金光飞入他脑中。

消化知识需要一点时间，商非凡暂时把注意力都转移到接收这些基础炼金知识上。

“商非凡？”虎不帅举起手掌对商非凡挥了挥。

商非凡对他眨眨眼睛，表示自己还在，又打了个手势，表示自己需要想一点事情。

虎不帅见他没事，也就不再管他，只暗中注意这个人的动静。

他怀疑商非凡正在跟他的随身老爷爷对话。

商非凡花了半个小时接收了初级炼金知识，让他对炼金有了入门级的了解。

但也只是初步了解，并没有达到消化的程度。

想要彻底消化他接收到的知识，他还得进行大量实操和自我领悟。

不管怎样，他现在也不再是炼金门外汉。

当拥有基础炼金知识的他再次看向被附魔的骨片时，就看出了更多门道。

附魔和炼金知识在某方面有一定重合，但又不完全相同。

炼金更像是把一堆原材料组成一个具有某种功能的完整器具。

附魔则是给与物品附加某个临时或永远的增强效果或特殊效果。

比如炼金可以炼制出一个空间戒指，而附魔则是给这个空间戒指附上生命力加10点的特殊加成。

“我教你附魔怎么样？”虎不帅突然说道。

商非凡抬头，半点没有不好意思地说：“好啊。需要我教学费吗？”

虎不帅心里想着这人脸皮真厚，也不客气了：“我只有一个条件，当你研究出如何让附魔和炼金知识结合，让附魔成为现实，你需要把相关的关键知识教给我。”

“当然！你不提，我也会教给你。”商非凡回报：“你想学炼金吗？”

没想到虎不帅竟然摇头：“贪多嚼不烂，我只要知道如何让附魔成功就可以。”

商非凡有了动力，学起来就更主动更快。

谁还没有一个在喜欢的对象前开屏炫耀的想法呢？

虎不帅也是说教就教，教起来半点没有藏私。

他做过很多年的魔法学校老师，教起来特别得心应手，知识点说得清清楚楚，从简单到复杂，从容易到复杂，只要不是太笨的学生就不会理解混乱。

叮咚。

【检测到你正在学习法德尔大陆的附魔知识，游戏商城自动添加魔法相关传承。】

不等商非凡反应，游戏商城页面就自动在他面前打开。

这系统简直就是生怕他不会好好利用游戏商城，恨不得一天提醒他八百遍。

但，“你这个商城所有物品定价都贵得要死，尤其是知识类。我现在贡献点那么少，想消费也消费不了啊。”

商非凡摊手，“不考虑打个折吗？虽然购物节已经过了，但活动可以无休止，每一天都可以打折。一折就很好。实在不行，两折也可以考虑。”

系统沉默。

商城页面啪地关闭。

商非凡丝毫不在意系统的冷漠无情，他比较在意的是系统提到的“法德尔大陆”。

是大陆，不是世界。

这说明什么？
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan summarized, "In other words, the Zerg curse—or the insect poison spreading across the Beastman World—has damaged this world's natural energy. However, it didn't change its fundamental composition; it merely reduced the once-abundant natural energy into a scarce commodity, causing severe damage to the Beastman World's supernatural power system."

Hu Bushuai: "..." *Fellow countryman, do you realize how much your vocabulary is giving you away? A lot of these terms aren't used like this in the Beastman World at all.*

Shang Feifan continued his analysis. "I think rather than becoming scarce, it's more like it turned into an inert energy that's difficult to channel. Otherwise, even with the help of alchemy tools, absorbing it wouldn't work."

Drawing on science, Shang Feifan let his imagination run wild. "Look, wasn't the original natural energy like liquid water—easy to scoop up at will? But after being mixed with the insect poison, it turned into a semi-solid gel. At this point, the beastmen find it very difficult to pull out natural energy from this gel-like mass relying on willpower alone. The role of alchemy tools is to pierce into this gel-like energy, breaking it down and diluting it so it can be absorbed. This is the advantage of using tools."

Hu Bushuai: "...Indeed."

Shang Feifan's mind jumped back to the original topic, and he held up the bone fragment. "Assuming this enchantment legacy is real—and I believe it is, because it truly stirred up a kind of energy—this energy is even more stubborn and lazy than natural energy. You can hardly pull out any of it no matter how hard you drag, and you can't retain it either. So, could we swap it out for a different kind of energy?"

Hu Bushuai thought: *Do you think I haven't considered that? I wanted to replace mana with the natural energy of the Beastman World too, but maybe I'm really not research material. I pondered it for years and still couldn't figure it out.*

Shang Feifan's brain was spinning at super high speeds. "All paths lead to the same goal when it comes to energy. No matter what kind of energy it is, as long as it's converted, it can be applied to the terminal. There are many reasons why energy fails to enter the terminal smoothly—such as mismatched wattage, incompatible interfaces, or incorrect wiring..."

Shang Feifan's gaze fell upon the bone fragment. "This is a classic case of voltage mismatch. How do you use a 220V appliance in a 110V environment? Even if it works, it'll be like a calf pulling a heavy cart."

Shang Feifan spoke these specialized terms in the Huaxia language, assuming Hu Bushuai wouldn't understand. If the other asked, he intended to cover it up by saying it was local slang from his hometown.

Hu Bushuai, listening crystal clear beside him: "..."

Shang Feifan rubbed his chin. "If we can add an energy converter to this enchanted bone fragment, maybe it will be able to normally absorb and use the energy of the Beastman World. Enchantment doesn't necessarily have to use mana, either."

"Why don't we give it a try?" Shang Feifan asked, his eyes shining brightly.

Hu Bushuai decided to hand over what he wasn't good at to someone who was: "How should we try it?"

Shang Feifan said in a very firm tone, "By combining enchantment and alchemy."

Hu Bushuai raised an eyebrow. "You know alchemy?"

In his heart, Shang Feifan thought, *No, but I will in a moment.* Outwardly, however, he said with modest pride, "I know a little."

His total Contribution Points had reached 298. After deducting what he had used, he still had a balance of 183 points.

In the Game Shop, the beginner professional skill book for Alchemists cost 100 Contribution Points.

Although he really wanted to find an alchemist to teach him alchemy to save these hundred Contribution Points, he couldn't find one right away.

Besides, it seemed that the alchemists in this world were quite secretive and kept their knowledge to themselves. Very few would reveal their prized knowledge to apprentices, and even fewer would teach real alchemy knowledge in the early stages of apprenticeship. They always made apprentices do menial chores in the name of tempering them.

An alchemy apprentice would have to spend a long time to learn true alchemy knowledge.

Weighing the pros and cons, it was faster to purchase the professional skill book directly from the Game Shop.

Money—wasn't earning it meant for spending anyway?

If you only earned without spending, what was the point of making money?

Not to mention, these hundred points were being spent right on the mark.

Once Shang Feifan made up his mind, he purchased the beginner Alchemist skill book from the shop without hesitation.

A gleaming, golden leather book floated before Shang Feifan's eyes.

"Learn," Shang Feifan ordered in a low voice.

The book instantly transformed into a ray of golden light and flew into his brain, vividly depicted.

Digesting the knowledge took a little time, so Shang Feifan temporarily shifted his attention to receiving this fundamental alchemy knowledge.

"Shang Feifan?" Hu Bushuai raised his hand and waved it in front of Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan blinked at him to show he was still there, then made a gesture indicating he needed to think about something.

Seeing that he was fine, Hu Bushuai stopped bothering him, only keeping an eye on his movements secretly.

He suspected that Shang Feifan was talking to the portable old master residing with him.

It took Shang Feifan half an hour to receive the basic alchemy knowledge, giving him an entry-level understanding of alchemy.

However, it was only a preliminary understanding and hadn't reached full digestion.

To completely digest the knowledge he had received, he would still need to conduct a lot of practical operations and gain self-comprehension.

Regardless, he was no longer an alchemy novice.

When he, now possessing basic alchemy knowledge, looked at the enchanted bone fragment again, he saw much more beneath the surface.

Enchantment and alchemy knowledge overlapped in certain aspects, but they were not completely identical.

Alchemy was more like assembling a pile of raw materials into a complete item with a specific function.

Enchantment was applying a temporary or permanent enhancement or special effect to an item.

For example, alchemy could craft a spatial ring, while enchantment could grant this spatial ring a special bonus of +10 Vitality.

"How about I teach you enchantment?" Hu Bushuai suddenly said.

Shang Feifan looked up, not feeling embarrassed at all. "Sure! Do I need to pay tuition?"

Hu Bushuai thought to himself how thick-skinned this guy was, and didn't hold back either: "I only have one condition. When you figure out how to combine enchantment and alchemy to make enchantment a reality, you need to teach me the relevant key knowledge."

"Of course! Even if you didn't bring it up, I would teach you," Shang Feifan replied. "Do you want to learn alchemy?"

Unexpectedly, Hu Bushuai shook his head. "Biting off more than one can chew. I only need to know how to make enchantment succeed."

With motivation, Shang Feifan learned even more actively and quickly.

Who wouldn't want to show off like a peacock in front of the person they liked?

Hu Bushuai taught as soon as he said he would, holding nothing back.

He had been a magic school teacher for many years, so teaching came naturally to him. He explained key points clearly, moving from simple to complex, from easy to difficult. As long as a student wasn't too stupid, they wouldn't get confused.

*Ding-dong.*

[System detected that you are learning the enchantment knowledge of the Fadel Continent. Magic-related inheritances have been automatically added to the Game Shop.]

Before Shang Feifan could react, the Game Shop page automatically opened before him.

This system was terrified he wouldn't use the Game Shop properly, practically wishing it could remind him eight hundred times a day.

However, "All the items in your shop are ridiculously expensive, especially knowledge-based ones. My Contribution Points are so few right now; even if I want to shop, I can't afford it."

Shang Feifan spread his hands. "How about considering a discount? Even though the shopping festival is over, promotions can be endless—every day can be a discount day. A ninety percent discount would be great. If that's really not possible, an eighty percent discount would do."

The system remained silent.

The shop page snapped shut.

Shang Feifan didn't care about the system's cold indifference at all. What he cared more about was the "Fadel Continent" mentioned by the system.

It said continent, not world.

What did this imply?

chunks.chineseText:
第66章 不帅爷爷

“你知道法德尔大陆吗？”商非凡问的时候并没有想太多，他就是随口一问。

哪想到虎不帅听后瞳孔地震，吓得差点原地跳起，脱口而出：“你怎么知道法德尔大陆？！”

有情况！商非凡迅速锁住不帅的眼睛，“听别人说的。我记得你跟我说过这世上有兽人大陆，还有虫人族发现及占领的虫人大陆。除了这两个大陆以外，是不是还有其他大陆？”

虎不帅没有说话，他心神震荡得太厉害，一时脑中思绪错综复杂，也压根不知道该怎么回答。

商非凡怎么可能知道法德尔大陆的名称？

难道他也是从法德尔大陆过来？

不，不可能！

商明明是老乡，应该是来自地球才对。

但一个从地球穿越过来的老乡又怎么会知道法德尔大陆？

难道商非凡也跟他一样，是二次穿越？

可为什么会有这种情况出现？

商非凡又为什么会出现在他身边？

他到底抱有什么目的？

他来到兽人大陆真的只是因为原身母亲召唤？

虎不帅越想越复杂，只觉得脑子都要炸了。

不要胡思乱想，稳住！

你有什么好让人谋求的？

这一切都是巧合！

虎不帅这时压根想不到暴露与否，他本能地连续深呼吸，想要让自己变成滚粥的脑袋冷静下来。

商非凡的问题真的是问得太猝不及防。

他上一世所在世界叫法德尔，所待的大陆就叫法德尔大陆。

法德尔翻译过来就是天柱的意思。

前生，他一辈子都在法德尔大陆打转，他听到看到学到的地理知识中，法德尔只有一片大陆，大陆外面就是海洋。

有传说在那无尽海域中有像森林一样的无数巨柱矗立在海中，那些巨柱顶天立地，宛如天然围墙，越过那些巨柱就能看到世界尽头，世界尽头下则是无尽深渊。

法德尔之名就来源于那无数看不到顶端的巨柱。

虎不帅曾经很想去看看那些巨柱，但传说越靠近那些巨柱就越危险，不但周边海水形成天然的灭世级水系魔法阵，天柱林周围更是生活着一种被称为海中魔龙的怪兽，一出生就是魔导师级别，这些魔龙就像是天柱林的守卫者，不允许任何生物闯入天柱林。

就算能侥幸闯过天柱林外面的重重关卡进入天柱林里面，天柱林本身也不会放过闯入者，传说天柱林区域内电闪雷鸣暴风不绝，最可怕的是里面还有随机出现的空间裂缝，碰到就会被割裂。

总之你没有圣级魔导师的水准，根本别想越过天柱林。

虎不帅魔法学得还行，在魔法学校教学时已经迈入高级魔法师行列，但高级魔法师之上还有初中高三个级别的魔导师，之后才是圣级。

实力太低，虎不帅只能打消自己前往天柱林的游览之心，老老实实待在学校教课。

虽然不知道天柱林另外一边是什么样，但法德尔大陆足够巨大，巨大到操纵时速六十公里的飞艇围着最外沿要飞上整整三个月才能绕完一圈。

如此巨大的大陆，别说普通人，很多魔法师一辈子都没走完整个大陆。

所以虎不帅从没有怀疑过法德尔大陆之外还有其他大陆，他魂穿来到兽人大陆，就一直以为兽人大陆和法德尔大陆分属两个不同世界。

“你知道法德尔大陆。”这是肯定句。

虎不帅勉强收敛心神，定定神，表情异常认真地问：“你是从哪里听到过法德尔大陆的名字。这对我很重要，希望你不要隐瞒我。”

商非凡听到不帅声音都变得略微沙哑，莫名感到一丝心疼。

“你是不是在法德尔大陆遇到过不好的事情？”

“……能先回答我的问题吗？”

商非凡举手投降，“是给我发布任务的存在告诉我的。”

“寻找自然之神散落力量的任务？”

“对。”

虎不帅眼中闪过不解、疑惑、混乱……，最终化为平静：“我知道了。”

你知道了？你知道了什么？这次轮到商非凡摸不着头脑。

“我确实知道法德尔大陆，但我一直以为法德尔大陆存在于另一个世界。”虎不帅说出这句话时，抬起头，看向商非凡的眼睛。

刚刚他想通了。有些事说出来也不会天塌地陷，相反他一味隐瞒，才会让他看不清真相。

商非凡惊讶：“另一个世界？你以为法德尔大陆和兽人大陆不是存在于同一个世界？”

这个游戏世界设定如此复杂吗？

该不会这个游戏野心很大，想要搞出位面大战？

虎不帅点头：“据我所知，法德尔大陆是一个魔法盛行的世界。而兽人大陆连魔力都没有，这里靠的是血脉天赋和……科技。如果这两个大陆同处于一个世界，为什么兽人大陆感知不到魔力？”

商非凡已经九成肯定虎不帅一定去过那个法德尔大陆，否则他说话不会是这种口吻。

他甚至已经想到不帅的附魔知识并不是他从哪个废墟捡来的，而就是从法德尔大陆学来。

一个去过法德尔大陆、学过魔法，又回到兽人大陆的兽人。他还不知道法德尔大陆和兽人大陆同处于同一个世界，以为是两个不同世界。

请问，什么样的情况会造成不帅这样的认知？

“你是不是拥有上辈子的记忆？”

商非凡的问话差点把虎不帅的冷静吓裂。

虎不帅忍不住在心里吼：这人怎么这么敏锐？脑洞怎么这么大？

商非凡也就是不知道虎不帅心里在想什么，如果知道，他就会告诉他：因为我在玩游戏啊。重要NPC身世复杂不是铁打的套路设定吗？

反正是游戏，想怎么设定就怎么设定，完全不用考虑现实。

现实中穿越不可能，但游戏世界别说穿越，就是平行宇宙大战也只是平常。

“你不用担心，我不会把你的事情说出去。穿越也没什么大不了的。”商非凡是真心这么想。

虎不帅：“……是吗？”

商非凡心念一转，觉得这是个走入不帅内心，取得对方更多信任的好时机，就开口：“其实我也是穿越来的。”

虎不帅：“……”你就这么简单地说出来了？

商非凡往不帅身边挪近一点，语气轻松：“之前我说自己失忆就是为了掩饰我是穿越者的事实。因为我对这个世界的背景和常识确实一点都不了解。”

虎不帅：“……”

商非凡对不帅眨眨眼：“我以为我要严守这个秘密一辈子，没想到你也是。我们俩真的很有缘，也很般配，你觉得呢？”

虎不帅：“……”

商非凡轻轻碰碰虎不帅的手臂，就跟小孩子的试探一样：“我真的很喜欢你，考虑考虑我吧。”

他是看出来了，对不帅就得用直球，委婉只会浪费他们彼此的人生。

虎不帅往旁边挪动，声音沙哑：“我们能谈正事吗？”

“我现在就在跟你谈正事，我们的人生大事。再也没有比这个更正的正事了。”商非凡委屈。

虎不帅冷脸：“离我远一点！我们还没这么熟。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 66: Grandpa Bushuai

"Do you know about the Fadel Continent?" Shang Feifan didn't think too much when asking; it was just a casual inquiry.

Who could have expected that upon hearing this, Hu Bushuai's pupils dilated in shock, nearly jumping on the spot as he blurted out, "How do you know about the Fadel Continent?!"

There was a story here! Shang Feifan swiftly locked eyes with Bushuai. "I heard it from someone else. I remember you told me that this world has a Beastman Continent, as well as an Insectoid Continent discovered and occupied by the Insectoid race. Besides these two continents, are there other continents?"

Hu Bushuai didn't speak. His mind was in such immense turmoil that for a moment, his thoughts were tangled and chaotic, and he didn't know how to answer at all.

How could Shang Feifan possibly know the name of the Fadel Continent?

Could he also have come from the Fadel Continent?

No, impossible!

Shang was clearly a fellow countryman; he should be from Earth.

But how could a fellow countryman who transmigrated from Earth know about the Fadel Continent?

Could Shang Feifan be like him, someone who had transmigrated a second time?

Why would such a situation occur?

And why did Shang Feifan appear by his side?

What purpose was he harboring?

Did he really come to the Beastman Continent solely because he was summoned by his original body's mother?

The more Hu Bushuai thought about it, the more complex it became, until he felt like his head was about to explode.

*Don't overthink things, keep calm!*

*What do you even have that someone would want to scheme for?*

*This is all a coincidence!*

At this moment, Hu Bushuai couldn't care less about whether he was exposed or not. Instinctively, he took several deep breaths, trying to cool down his brain, which felt like boiling porridge.

Shang Feifan's question was far too sudden.

The world he lived in during his previous life was called Fadel, and the continent he stayed on was the Fadel Continent.

Fadel translated to "Sky Pillar."

In his past life, he spent his entire existence on the Fadel Continent. In the geographical knowledge he heard, saw, and learned, Fadel had only one continent, surrounded by the ocean.

Legend had it that in those endless sea waters stood countless giant pillars that looked like a forest. These giant pillars reached up to the sky and down to the earth like natural walls. Crossing those giant pillars, one could see the end of the world, and below the end of the world lay an endless abyss.

The name Fadel originated from those countless giant pillars whose tops could not be seen.

Hu Bushuai had once really wanted to see those giant pillars, but legends said that the closer one got to them, the more dangerous it became. Not only did the surrounding seawater form a natural, apocalyptic water-element magic circle, but around the Sky Pillar Forest lived a kind of monster called the Ocean Magic Dragon, which was at the Archmage level at birth. These magic dragons acted like guardians of the Sky Pillar Forest, forbidding any living creature from breaking in.

Even if one was lucky enough to break through the layers of obstacles outside the Sky Pillar Forest and enter inside, the Sky Pillar Forest itself would not spare intruders. Legend had it that within the Sky Pillar Forest area, lightning flashed, thunder roared, and violent storms raged endlessly. Most terrifying of all were the randomly appearing spatial rifts—touching one meant being shredded to pieces.

In short, unless you reached the level of a Saint Archmage, you couldn't even dream of crossing the Sky Pillar Forest.

Hu Bushuai's magic studies were decent; while teaching at the magic school, he had already entered the ranks of High Mages. However, above High Mages were three ranks of Archmages—Junior, Intermediate, and Senior—followed by Saint level.

Since his strength was too low, Hu Bushuai could only abandon his desire to visit the Sky Pillar Forest and honestly stay at the school to teach.

Although he didn't know what it was like on the other side of the Sky Pillar Forest, the Fadel Continent was vast enough—so vast that piloting an airship at sixty kilometers per hour around its outermost edge would take three full months to complete a single lap.

On such a massive continent, let alone ordinary people, many mages never traversed the entire continent in their lifetime.

Therefore, Hu Bushuai had never doubted whether there were other continents beyond the Fadel Continent. When his soul transmigrated to the Beastman Continent, he had always assumed that the Beastman Continent and the Fadel Continent belonged to two different worlds.

"You know about the Fadel Continent." It was a statement of fact.

Hu Bushuai barely managed to regain his composure. Steadying his mind, he asked with an unusually serious expression, "Where did you hear the name of the Fadel Continent? This is very important to me. I hope you won't hide it from me."

Hearing Bushuai's voice turn slightly hoarse, Shang Feifan felt an inexplicable pang of distress.

"Did you encounter bad things on the Fadel Continent?"

"...Can you answer my question first?"

Shang Feifan raised his hands in surrender. "The entity that gave me the quests told me."

"The quest to find the scattered power of the God of Nature?"

"Yes."

Disbelief, doubt, and confusion flashed across Hu Bushuai's eyes... before finally settling into calmness. "I understand."

*You understand? What do you understand?* Now it was Shang Feifan's turn to be baffled.

"I indeed know about the Fadel Continent, but I always thought it existed in another world," Hu Bushuai said, looking up directly into Shang Feifan's eyes.

Just now, he had figured it out. Speaking some things out wouldn't cause the sky to fall. On the contrary, blindly hiding them would only keep him from seeing the truth.

Shang Feifan was surprised. "Another world? You thought the Fadel Continent and the Beastman Continent didn't exist in the same world?"

Was this game's world-building really that complex?

Could it be that this game had grand ambitions and wanted to stage an inter-dimensional war?

Hu Bushuai nodded. "As far as I know, the Fadel Continent is a world where magic flourishes. Yet the Beastman Continent doesn't even have mana; it relies on bloodline talents and... technology. If these two continents are in the same world, why can't mana be sensed in the Beastman Continent?"

Shang Feifan was ninety percent certain that Hu Bushuai had definitely been to the Fadel Continent; otherwise, he wouldn't speak in such a tone.

He even realized that Bushuai's enchantment knowledge wasn't picked up from some ruin, but learned directly from the Fadel Continent.

A beastman who had been to the Fadel Continent, learned magic, and returned to the Beastman Continent. Yet he didn't know that the Fadel Continent and the Beastman Continent belonged to the same world, thinking they were two different worlds instead.

Excuse me, what kind of situation could lead to Bushuai having such a realization?

"Do you... possess memories of a past life?"

Shang Feifan's question nearly shattered Hu Bushuai's composure once again.

Hu Bushuai couldn't help roaring in his heart: *How is this guy so sharp? How does his mind jump so far?*

If Shang Feifan knew what Hu Bushuai was thinking, he would tell him: *Because I'm playing a game! Isn't a complex backstory for an important NPC an ironclad trope?*

Since it was a game anyway, it could be set up however the developers wanted, without needing to consider reality at all.

Transmigration was impossible in reality, but in a game world, let alone transmigration, even a battle between parallel universes was commonplace.

"You don't need to worry, I won't tell anyone about your affairs. Transmigrating isn't that big of a deal." Shang Feifan genuinely thought so.

Hu Bushuai: "...Is that so?"

Shang Feifan's mind turned, thinking this was a great opportunity to step into Bushuai's inner world and gain more of his trust. He spoke up: "Actually, I'm a transmigrator too."

Hu Bushuai: "..." *You just said it so casually?*

Shang Feifan moved a bit closer to Bushuai and said in a light tone, "Earlier, I said I had amnesia just to cover up the fact that I'm a transmigrator. Because I really don't understand the background and common knowledge of this world at all."

Hu Bushuai: "..."

Shang Feifan blinked at Bushuai. "I thought I'd have to guard this secret my whole life, but to think you are one too. We really are fated, and we make a great match. What do you think?"

Hu Bushuai: "..."

Shang Feifan gently nudged Hu Bushuai's arm, like a child probing tentatively. "I really like you. Give me some consideration, won't you?"

He could see it now: with Bushuai, he had to use a direct approach. Being indirect would only waste both of their lives.

Hu Bushuai shifted to the side, his voice hoarse: "Can we talk about proper business?"

"I'm talking about proper business right now—the major affair of our lives. There's no business more proper than this," Shang Feifan said aggrievedly.

Hu Bushuai put on a cold face: "Stay away from me! We aren't that close yet."

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡没动，“你受过情伤？”

虎不帅的表情开裂了。

商非凡看清不帅的神情变化，确定了：“怪不得你的眼神总给我一种历尽千帆的感觉。能跟我聊聊你上一世的故事吗？有些事说出来，会轻松很多哦。”

虎不帅：“……滚！”

商非凡笑：“那我给你说说我的故事？”

虎不帅腾地站起，抬脚就向地下室仓库大门走。

商非凡跟着站起，一把抓住不帅的手，把他往身边一拉。

虎不帅脚步踉跄，差点撞到商非凡的怀里。

商非凡伸手稳住他。

虎不帅脸爆红，又尴尬又生气，用力一推商非凡，想要把人推开。

结果人不但没有推开，反而和他靠得更近。

“你在怕什么？怕自己再次动心？怕自己再次被背叛被伤害？嗯？”

低沉的声音就吐在他耳边，滚热的气息几乎要燎伤他的耳朵。

“你怎么就没想过我是失去了情投意合的爱侣，才会心灰意冷。”虎不帅说出这句话就后悔，他怎么会说出这么没脑子的话！

商非凡笑起来，轻轻碰触不帅的脸颊，一触即离：“你果然比别人多了一世的记忆。”

虎不帅冷笑：错！我已经活了三世，年龄加起来足够做你曾爷爷。

虎不帅眼睛一亮，他想到怎么打消对方口花花的办法了。

“你说的没错，我确实拥有比别人更多的记忆，加上我上辈子的年龄，我足够做你曾祖父。别看我现在拥有一身年轻的皮，但我的心就是老人。你喜欢我，就像是喜欢上一个披着年轻人皮的老年人。你闻到过老年人身上特有的老人臭吗？你知道老年人心里是怎么想年轻人的吗？”

快，让我看到你恶心的神情。虎不帅迫不及待。

商非凡……对不帅竖起拇指：“这个方法好。你让我脑中都出现画面了。”

虎不帅骄傲：“出现画面就对了。年轻人，不要被表面的表象蒙蔽双眼，如果你真这么做了，将来一定会后悔。”

他不知道怎么讨人喜欢，但如何让年轻人讨厌，当过老师的他还是有一定心得的。

商非凡定定看了不帅好一会儿，噗嗤低笑。

慢慢的，笑声越来越大。

虎不帅虎着脸：笑屁笑！有什么好笑的？

商非凡抓住不帅的手，摇了摇：“宝贝，你真可爱~”

虎不帅震惊地睁大眼睛。

商非凡叹息一般：“你这样，真的让我很想亲亲你啊。”

虎不帅身体下意识后仰。

“哈哈哈！”商非凡大笑，一把抱住不帅，又快速松开：“宝贝，你怎么能这么……你真是让我越来越喜欢了。”

虎不帅气得脑门都能煎鸡蛋：“你这个人！你这个……”

“我怀疑法德尔大陆和兽人大陆就在同一个星球上。并不是不同世界，也不是不同位面。”商非凡忽然一本正经地说。

虎不帅被他的跳跃思维搞得神经错乱，一时没跟上。

商非凡拉着他，想让他坐下聊。

虎不帅硬挺挺地站着。

商非凡握住他的手……被打开，也不在意，就靠得很近地说：“至于你说的魔力不流通的问题，在同一个世界也不是不可能。”

游戏设定嘛，只要圈住那片大陆的魔力不流通到其他地方不就行了？

说不定等以后世界地图打开，魔力就能流通。

都是设定套路！

“这就像有些生物只能在某个特定环境生长一样。这种特定环境的某个或某些物质就是不流动的。还有冰山只在最冷的地方出现，蚊虫则喜欢集中在湿热地带。造成冷热带的是太阳。那有没有可能，造成魔力不流通的也有可能是太阳或其他天体？”

商非凡的话打开了虎不帅的思路，也逐渐让他混乱的大脑重新稳定下来。

“法德尔大陆的事我们可以暂时放一边，以后如果通道打开了，我们再考虑那个大陆也不迟。现在我们先把注意力放在兽人大陆。我们的首要任务还是寻找自然之神散落的力量，想法恢复兽人大陆的自然生机。”

“我们？”虎不帅拒绝。

商非凡声音很低很温柔，像是在故意诱惑人：“我都把我的最大秘密告诉你了。你可不能甩开我。”

“我知道你什么秘密？你又说了什么？”明明是你从我这里挖到的秘密更多！

商非凡低笑：“宝贝，你已经知道我是穿越过来的外来者，还知道我身携重要任务，更知道我这么这么喜欢你……”

“闭嘴！”虎不帅又气得脑门发烫：“别叫我宝贝！难听死了。”

商非凡忍笑：“好的，不帅爷爷。”

虎不帅用力瞪。瞪了一秒，破功。

“你笑了。”

“没有！”

“你笑了。”

“没有！”

“你……”

“闭嘴！”

商非凡再次伸手，轻轻握住虎不帅的手，“不帅爷爷，不要生气了好不好。祖孙恋也是很常见的事。”

“你！你这个！”虎不帅想骂脏话。他真的是给这人的厚脸皮打败了。

这人真的是什么都敢说！

祖孙恋？他到底是怎么说出口的？

商非凡笑眯眯：“你上辈子真的有个爱得死去活来，你不惜为他心灰意冷的恋人？”

这声音怎么听着有亿点点危险？

虎不帅颈后汗毛竖立起来。

“你问这个干什么？”

“不干什么。就随便问问。”

“我为什么要告诉你？”虎不帅忽然“灵机一动”，脑子抽了，张口说：“其实我不止谈过一个，我谈过好几个。每个都很刻骨铭心爱得死去活来！”

商非凡：“嗯。”

虎不帅：就这？你这个嗯到底什么意思。

商非凡慢腾腾地问：“那你的这些前任爱你吗？他们有另外找人吗？”

虎不帅顿觉自己心脏被小刀子戳了好几下：“……哦，我每次到后面都会被甩。所以你是想捡别人不要的破烂吗？”

商非凡生气又心疼，捏住不帅的脸：“不准这么说你自己。”

虎不帅打开他的手，冷冷地：“事实就是如此。别喜欢我，我不值得，也不配。”

商非凡不知道不帅是在说气话，还是真的被伤到不敢再接受别人的感情，乃至于如此贬低自己。

“宝贝，如果你想听我夸你，我可以说上一个小时都不会重复。但你显然也不会听得进去，因为你已经走入牛角尖，对自己认知不足，就像被人抛弃的小狗，总觉得问题都在自己身上。”

虎不帅沉默，不是他觉得商非凡说得对，就是单纯不想回应。

商非凡笑，就是笑意中没有半点温度：“我不知道你喜欢的都是什么人，只能说你很没眼光。要么你就是太好骗。你知道好人很容易引起坏人觊觎的吧？你这样的就很容易被坏人当做目标。”

虎不帅……发现自己竟然生不出多少怒意。其实上辈子那两段感情对他来说都是过去的事，他也不觉得那两个人有什么大错，就是感情走到尽头而已。他伤心，但也不会埋怨，更不至于怨恨。

“你是好人？”不帅还是忍不住讽刺了一句。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan didn’t move. "Have you been hurt in love before?"

Hu Bushuai’s composure fractured.

Catching the subtle shift in Bushuai's expression, Shang Feifan became certain. "No wonder your eyes always carry a look of having weathered countless storms. Care to tell me about your past life? Sometimes, getting things off your chest makes you feel a lot lighter."

Hu Bushuai snapped, "...Get lost!"

Shang Feifan chuckled. "Then how about I tell you my story instead?"

Hu Bushuai shot up from his seat and marched straight toward the door of the basement storehouse.

Shang Feifan stood up in tandem, catching Bushuai’s hand in a swift grasp and pulling him back toward his side.

Stumbling, Hu Bushuai nearly crashed directly into Shang Feifan’s chest.

Shang Feifan reached out to steady him.

Bushuai’s face flushed crimson from a volatile mix of embarrassment and fury. He shoved violently against Shang Feifan’s chest, trying to push him away.

Yet instead of being pushed back, the man leaned even closer.

"What are you afraid of? Afraid your heart will flutter again? Afraid you'll be betrayed and hurt all over again? Hmm?"

The deep, low voice brushed right against his ear, the scalding breath hot enough to set his skin ablaze.

"Has it ever crossed your mind that maybe I became disheartened because I lost a lover I was deeply devoted to?" The moment the words left his mouth, Hu Bushuai regretted them. Why on earth had he said something so utterly mindless!

Shang Feifan smiled, his fingertips brushing lightly against Bushuai’s cheek before pulling away just as quickly. "You really do possess the memories of a past life."

Bushuai sneered internally: *Wrong! I’ve lived three lives. Combined, my age is more than enough to be your great-grandfather.*

Suddenly, Bushuai’s eyes brightened. An idea struck him—a surefire way to kill this man’s silver-tongued teasing once and for all.

"You're right. I do carry more memories than ordinary people. Tally up my years from before, and I could easily be your great-grandfather. Don't let this fresh, young hide fool you; beneath the surface, my soul is an old man's. You liking me is no different from falling for a decrepit geezer draped in young skin. Have you ever smelled that peculiar odor old people give off? Do you have any idea what old folks actually think of youngsters?"

*Come on, show me that look of disgust,* Hu Bushuai urged eagerly in his heart.

Shang Feifan... gave him a slow thumbs-up. "Not bad. You've actually painted quite the vivid picture in my head."

Bushuai raised his chin, puffed with pride. "Good, it should be vivid. Young man, don't let superficial appearances blind you. Pursue this, and you'll definitely regret it down the line."

He didn't know how to win people over, but having worked as a teacher, he certainly knew a thing or two about making himself repulsive to the younger generation.

Shang Feifan stared at Bushuai for a long while before bursting into a quiet chuckle.

Gradually, his laughter grew louder and louder.

Hu Bushuai scowled darkly. *What's so damn funny? What's there to laugh about?*

Shang Feifan took Bushuai’s hand and gave it a playful sway. "Babe, you’re just too adorable~"

Bushuai’s eyes flew wide in sheer shock.

Shang Feifan let out what sounded like a dreamy sigh. "Acting like this... you really make me want to kiss you."

Bushuai reflexively leaned back.

"Hahaha!" Shang Feifan burst into hearty laughter, pulling Bushuai into a swift, fierce embrace before letting go just as quickly. "Babe, how can you be so... You really make me like you more and more."

Bushuai was so furious his forehead could have fried an egg. "You! You bastard—"

"I suspect the Fadel Continent and the Beastman Continent are on the very same planet. They aren't different worlds, nor are they separate planes of existence," Shang Feifan stated abruptly, completely shifting gears with a deadpan expression.

His erratic leap in logic left Bushuai momentarily reeling, his mind unable to keep up.

Shang Feifan took his hand again, gently coaxing him to sit back down and talk.

Bushuai remained standing, stiff as an iron board.

Shang Feifan tried to clasp his hand, only to be slapped away. Unfazed, he simply leaned close and continued, "As for the issue of mana being unable to circulate between them, that's not impossible even within the same world."

*It's like game mechanics,* Shang Feifan thought. *As long as you wall off a continent's mana from spilling elsewhere, it works, doesn't it?*

Maybe once the world map expanded later on, mana would naturally begin to flow.

It was all classic world-building tropes!

"Think about it: just like certain creatures can only thrive in specific environments where particular elements remain static. Glaciers only form in the coldest reaches, while swarms of mosquitoes cluster in humid tropics. It's the sun that dictates these climate zones. So, could it be possible that the barrier preventing mana from circulating is also governed by the sun, or perhaps other celestial bodies?"

Shang Feifan’s words opened a fresh train of thought for Hu Bushuai, gradually steadying his jumbled mind.

"We can set the matter of the Fadel Continent aside for now. Once a passage opens in the future, it won't be too late to deal with it then. For now, our focus must stay on the Beastman Continent. Our primary task remains gathering the scattered power of the God of Nature and figuring out how to restore the continent's natural vitality."

"'Our'?" Hu Bushuai rejected the notion instantly.

Shang Feifan’s voice dropped low and tender, deliberately laced with sultry allure. "I've already shared my greatest secret with you. You can't just toss me aside now."

"What secret of yours do I even know? What did you actually say?" *Clearly, you're the one who dug far more secrets out of me!*

Shang Feifan let out a soft laugh. "Babe, you already know I'm an outworlder who transmigrated here, you know I carry an important mission, and above all, you know just how deeply, passionately I like you..."

"Shut up!" Hu Bushuai barked, his forehead burning with fresh indignation. "Stop calling me 'babe'! It's sickening."

Suppressing his amusement, Shang Feifan replied, "Understood, Grandpa Bushuai."

Hu Bushuai glared daggers at him. He held the fierce glare for exactly one second before his expression cracked.

"You smiled."

"I did not!"

"You did."

"I said, I did not!"

"You—"

"Shut your mouth!"

Shang Feifan reached out once more, gently enveloping Bushuai’s hand in his own. "Grandpa Bushuai, don't be mad anymore, all right? Cross-generational romance across a few decades isn't unheard of, after all."

"You! You shameless—!" Bushuai was on the verge of swearing aloud. He had truly met his match in this man's utter thick-skinned audacity.

There was literally nothing this rogue wouldn't dare say!

*Cross-generational romance? How did those words even pass his lips without shame?!*

Shang Feifan smiled faintly, his eyes narrowing. "In your past life, did you truly have a lover whom you loved to death—so much that you became completely disillusioned after losing them?"

Why did his tone suddenly sound an infinitesimal fraction... dangerous?

The fine hairs on the back of Hu Bushuai’s neck stood on end.

"Why are you asking?"

"Nothing in particular. Just curious."

"Why should I tell you?" In a sudden, ill-advised spark of "inspiration," Bushuai’s brain short-circuited, and he blurted out, "Actually, I didn't just have one. I've had several! Every single one was an unforgettable, earth-shattering, die-for-each-other kind of love!"

Shang Feifan replied calmly, "Oh."

Hu Bushuai blinked. *That's it? What the hell is that supposed to mean?*

Shang Feifan asked languidly, "And did these exes of yours love you back? Did they end up finding someone else?"

Hu Bushuai instantly felt several invisible daggers plunge straight into his heart. "...Well, in the end, I was dumped every single time. So, are you that eager to scavenge the trash nobody else wanted?"

A mix of irritation and heartache flashed through Shang Feifan. He reached over and pinched Bushuai’s cheek firmly. "Don't you dare talk about yourself that way."

Bushuai slapped his hand away, his tone turning frigid. "It's the cold, hard truth. Don't waste your affection on me. I'm not worth it, and I don't deserve it."

Shang Feifan couldn't tell if Bushuai was simply venting in anger or if he was genuinely so scarred that he dared not accept another person's affection, belittling himself to such an extent.

"Babe, if you want praise, I could sing your virtues for an hour straight without repeating a single word. But clearly, none of it would get through to you right now. You've backed yourself into a dead-end corner, completely blind to your own worth. You're just like an abandoned puppy, convinced that every failure was your own fault."

Bushuai fell silent. It wasn't that he agreed with Shang Feifan; he simply didn't want to dignify the statement with a response.

Shang Feifan smiled, though the curve of his lips held not a shred of warmth. "I have no idea what kind of people you fell for, but I can only conclude your taste is atrocious. Either that, or you're far too gullible. You know good people always draw the greed of wicked ones, right? Someone like you makes an all-too-easy target."

Hu Bushuai... found that his anger had surprisingly dissipated. In truth, those two relationships from his past life were ancient history. He didn't even harbor any real resentment toward either of them; the feelings had simply run their course. He had grieved, but he didn't cast blame, let alone hold grudges.

"And you're supposed to be a good person?" Bushuai couldn't resist a biting retort.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡竟然很诚实地说：“我不是好人。在某种意义上，我很坏，特别坏。在某些人眼里，我就是天大的恶人。”

每一个武器商都不会是好人。

他们卖出的每一颗子弹都在杀人。

当然，你也可以反过来看，他们帮助他人杀人的同时也在救人。

“但我喜欢你。”也会珍惜你，哪怕你只是一段数据。

商非凡发现自己真的喜欢上了一段数据，他是真的没想到他会遇到这样的事情……他一定要把游戏商找出来，这个游戏他必须要插一手，无论付出什么样的代价。

“他们刚开始也很喜欢我，表现得比你还疯狂、还深情。”虎不帅破罐子破摔。

商非凡：老子要杀了那些王八蛋。

“我性格很无趣，我也不会主动争取，我也不知道该怎么经营好自己的感情，和我在一起时间长了，你会觉得味同嚼蜡，说不定还会觉得疲累。你说的不错，我是内耗型。而我性格已定，基本改不过来。我真的不知道你为什么会喜欢我，如果你只是为了自然之神的力量，我答应会给你，只是要迟一段时间，我还有些事没有做完。”

虎不帅抬手，制止商非凡说话，继续说道：“放心，我还没傻到要为了你的任务献身。所以你要等的时间会比较长。如果你有办法在不伤害我生命的情况下取出自然之神的力量，那最好。”

“最后，我认真地拜托你，请你尊重我，不要动不动就对我说喜欢。我真的不喜欢这样。”虎不帅脸色异常认真。

这种性格确实很劝退，但商非凡喜欢。只能说什么锅配什么盖，看对眼了，王八也是天仙。

商非凡点点头：“行，我们先不谈感情。那你能告诉我，你上辈子是怎么死的吗？老死、病死、被人杀死，还是自杀？”

虎不帅：“……我们去打怪吧。外面还有那么多怪物在，我们休息的也差不多了。”

商非凡掰过他的脸，笃定地：“你不是正常死亡。”

虎不帅用力打开那只手，气得口不择言：“对我礼貌点。孙子！”

商非凡眼眸变得暗红：“我给你报仇。”

“用不着！”虎不帅按住额头，头疼：“我不是被人杀死，我就是自然死亡。我……艹！我们不要再说我的事了好不好？你这样，我真的……很难和你相处下去。”

商非凡看着不知所措的不帅，到底不舍得：“我们去杀怪，等你什么时候想跟我说你的故事，你再说。”

虎不帅大大松了口气：“对，我们先去杀怪。天，我们到底是怎么扯到这里的？”

商非凡张嘴。

“住口！别再说了。”虎不帅立刻喊停。

去他妈的法德尔大陆！去他妈的穿越！去他妈的老乡！

他现在什么都不想再想，就想杀怪！

虎不帅脑子彻底被某人给搅乱。

今天实在有太多让他猝不及防的事情发生。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan unexpectedly answered with complete honesty, "I am not a good person. In a sense, I am bad—exceptionally bad. In some people's eyes, I am the ultimate villain."

No arms dealer could ever be considered a good person.

Every bullet they sold killed someone.

Of course, you could also look at it the other way: while helping others kill, they were also saving lives.

"But I like you." *And I will cherish you, even if you are just a string of data.*

Shang Feifan realized he had genuinely fallen for a piece of data. He truly hadn't expected something like this to happen to him... He had to hunt down the game developers. He had to get his hands on this game, no matter the cost.

"They liked me a lot at the beginning too—acted even crazier and more affectionate than you," Tiger Not-Handsome said, tossing all caution to the wind in sheer resignation.

Shang Feifan: *I'm going to kill those bastards.*

"My personality is utterly boring," Tiger Not-Handsome continued. "I never take the initiative, nor do I know how to manage a relationship. If you spend too much time with me, you'll find me completely bland, maybe even exhausting. You were right—I am the type to drain myself internally. And my personality is set in stone; it's practically impossible to change. I truly don't know why you like me. If you're only doing this for the power of the God of Nature, I promise to give it to you. It will just take some time—I still have unfinished business."

Tiger Not-Handsome raised a hand to stop Shang Feifan from interrupting, and added, "Don't worry, I'm not stupid enough to sacrifice my life for your quest. So you'll have to wait a while. If you have a way to extract the God of Nature's power without harming my life, that would be ideal."

"Lastly, I am asking you in all seriousness: please respect me. Don't throw around words like 'like' at every turn. I really don't appreciate it." Tiger Not-Handsome's expression was exceptionally grave.

This kind of personality was indeed enough to turn anyone away, but Shang Feifan liked it. It was simply a case of every pot finding its cover—when two people clicked, even a turtle looked like a heavenly immortal.

Shang Feifan nodded. "Alright, let's set feelings aside for now. But can you tell me how you died in your past life? Old age, illness, murder, or suicide?"

Tiger Not-Handsome: "...Let me go fight monsters. There are still so many monsters outside, and we've rested long enough."

Shang Feifan grabbed his chin, turning his face toward him, and said with absolute certainty, "You didn't die a natural death."

Tiger Not-Handsome slapped his hand away with force, blurting out angrily in his frustration, "Show some manners, brat!"

Shang Feifan's eyes flickered with a dark red glint. "I'll avenge you."

"No need!" Tiger Not-Handsome pressed a hand to his forehead, feeling a thumping headache. "I wasn't murdered! I died of natural causes! I... fuck! Can we stop talking about my past already? If you keep this up, I really... won't be able to stay around you."

Looking at the overwhelmed Not-Handsome, Shang Feifan ultimately couldn't bear to push him further. "We'll go hunt monsters. Whenever you feel like telling me your story, you can tell me then."

Tiger Not-Handsome let out a massive sigh of relief. "Right, let's go hunt monsters first. Heavens, how on earth did we even get onto this topic?"

Shang Feifan opened his mouth to speak.

"Shut it! Don't say another word!" Tiger Not-Handsome barked instantly.

To hell with the Fader Continent! To hell with transmigrating! To hell with fellow Earthlings!

Right now, he didn't want to think about a single thing—he just wanted to slaughter monsters!

Tiger Not-Handsome's mind had been thrown into complete disarray by a certain someone.

Too many unexpected things had happened today, catching him entirely off guard.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第67章 账号删除和三十级更新 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第67章 账号删除和三十级更新

三天中，商非凡也在休息时间下线过几次，期间遇到老伏。

老伏告诉他一件事，说他的玩家等级已经引起玩家们注意，很多人都在叫喊他开挂，还有人在游戏论坛举报，说他升级速度不正常。

商非凡为此特意查看了那个玩家等级榜单。

脑载系统吸收了笔记本系统后，就兼并了笔记本系统的一些功能。

这个玩家等级榜单被脑载系统放到了犄角旮旯，不特意去找压根不会注意。

商非凡查看榜单后才发现目前的玩家等级都在十级到十二级之间，只有他一个人一骑绝尘，不但突破了二十级的大关，更一路就要冲到三十级。

着实显眼了一点。

“这何止是一点？”伏向军怪叫。

“你到底干什么了？怎么会突然升级那么快？”

商非凡把摩罗城的变故告诉伏向军。

“真好。我就说你找到了一个怪物很多的杀怪点。”伏向军满脸羡慕：“那些怪物大概都是什么等级？”

“刚异变的大约七八级左右，杀起来比较容易。异变超过五分钟的就已经达到十级，且能使用本身的天赋技能。异变时间越长，身体和能力就越强大。异变超过半小时的，杀伤力和防御力基本都能达到十五级以上。”

“听起来不错，如果摩罗城距离我们比较近就好了，我们也能过去沾一波福利。”伏向军向往。

“现在摩罗城的怪物实力最差的也都达到了二十五级以上，平均在三十级，还有些更厉害的，我遇到也只能躲着走。”商非凡淡淡道。

伏向军：“……游戏开发组一定盯上你了，你现在就相当于一个挂逼。小心被查出你有两个系统的事。”

商非凡对满是妒忌的老伏笑了笑，“让他查。最好能查到我的IP地址。”

“什么意思？”

“我找不到他们，那就让他们来主动找我。”

商非凡分析过，他脑子中的那个游戏系统应该比笔记本系统更厉害一些。

他杀怪升级这件事是脑载系统布置出来的任务，也就是说，脑载系统一定知道他的快速升级会引来游戏开发组注意。

但脑载系统还是这样做了。

就说明脑载系统一定有这样做的理由。而且应该也想好了应对方法，比如保证游戏开发组无法删除他的游戏账号之类。

当然，这都是他的个人推测，实际情况会如何发展，他也不知道。

按理，脑袋中多了这么一个怎么看怎么诡异的系统，正常玩家都应该犹豫要不要再上游戏。

但商非凡显然不是正常人。

非正常人的商非凡遇到这么有趣的事怎么可能为了一点危险就退出？

更别说他现在还有一个绝对不能放弃这个游戏的情由。

话说回来，既然脑载系统敢让他这么升级，还敢让他暴露在游戏开发组面前，他又何必担心太多？

除非脑载系统想要借游戏开发组干掉他，但脑载系统本身就能删除他的游戏账号，根本没必要干这种脱裤子放屁的事。

“为什么你认为游戏开发商会主动来找你？他们不能直接删除你的账号吗？”伏向军疑问。

商非凡微微一笑：“如果他们删不掉呢？”

“怎么可能删不掉？你又不是病……毒。艹！你的脑载系统就相当于是这个游戏的超级病毒是吧？”

“你也可以这么理解。”商非凡现在就等着游戏商顺着IP地址摸到他的实际地址。

这么一个大型几近百分百真实的全息游戏，不说开发过程有多么艰难，光是耗费的金钱就无法想象。

将心比心，如果他是开发商，发现自己呕心沥血耗费无数资源制作出来想要从此称霸世界的终极游戏中-出现了这么一个挂逼，还怎么都删不掉，那肯定会找上门来看是什么情况。

毕竟，一个删除不掉的挂逼可不止是破坏游戏平衡，更有可能给这个游戏世界造成极大漏洞和破坏。

而只要游戏开发商还想靠这个游戏赚钱，他们就不可能眼睁睁看着这么一个巨大bug出现还无动于衷。

至于游戏开发商找上门后要怎么做，商非凡已经制定好了一个又一个详细计划。

伏向军看着商老大的神情，不掩担心：“你小心玩火。”

一个超巨国家组织都查不出丝毫痕迹的游戏开发商，会是普通人吗？

何况查这个游戏开发商的不止一个国家。

可以说现在全世界不少国家都已经注意到这个游戏，大家也都在查这个游戏开发商的根底。

可至今为止，还没任何组织和个人说揭开了这个游戏开发商的神秘面纱，就连面纱是什么样都没看到。

如今各方已经在猜测这个游戏开发商是否与外星人有关。

有国家和组织想要封杀这个游戏，想要呼吁国民们都不要去玩这个游戏，以防国民被洗脑甚至是直接被在脑中植入某些危险东西。

但更多国家和组织十分眼馋这个全息游戏涉及到的黑科技知识，打算先静观其变，看看这个游戏开发商到底想要做什么。

至于那些玩游戏的玩家，监视起来就是。

一旦发现不对，那就把这些玩家全都解决掉。

所以现在各国各组织都在查自己势力范围内的国民都有谁申请到了该游戏的账号，以及都有谁收到了游戏头盔。

“我们的人生不是一直在玩火。”商非凡似笑非笑。

伏向军：“……你听到游戏中声音这件事，真的不报上去吗？”

商非凡扭头看向他：“你要报上去？”

伏向军翻了个白眼：“我是怕你大脑已经被外星人不知不觉植入了控制芯片！”

商非凡摆摆手，套上游戏头盔：“好的，我赋予你发现我成为人奸后杀掉我的权力，只要你能做到。”

伏向军竖起中指，啐骂：“你就疯吧！”

时间回到现在。

商非凡和虎不帅两人再次结伴杀出安全屋，杀进街道中。

想杀怪，数量那是不愁的。

虫毒散播者拉出来的那条虫毒区域从城西北一直拉到城东南。

从上空往下看，就像是在一个方型棋盘上用烙铁烙出了一条斜宽条印，占据了棋盘五分之一的面积。

而这五分之一面积里最开始的那片区域正好是城中人口最多的贫民区，出事的时候又是城民晚上入睡的时候，最初被覆盖入这片区域的人逃出来的真不多。

虽然暂时没办法统计到底有多少人受害，但从两人大致看到的数量来估计，这座城里至少也有四五千名死后变异者。

两个人杀怪的速度已经不慢，但怎么也不可能在三天内就把四五千的怪物全部干掉。

实际上，他们两人总共才消灭了两百多尸变怪物。

商非凡还特地拉开个人面板看了看。

通过总贡献点数可以看出，他一个人一共杀了176个尸变者。

在贡献点突破两百点时，他的天赋技能点数有一次明显提升。

另外，每杀死一个怪，他就能通过吸收怪物尸体溃散的能量，让技能点增加0.001。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 67: Account Deletion and the Level 30 Update (Part 1)

Over the past three days, Shang Feifan had also logged off a few times during his rest periods, during which he ran into Lao Fu.

Lao Fu told him a piece of news: his player level had already caught the attention of the masses. Many people were crying out that he was hacking, and some even reported him on the game forums, claiming his leveling speed was abnormal.

Because of this, Shang Feifan specifically checked the player leaderboard.

Ever since his brain-implanted system had absorbed the laptop system, it had annexed some of the laptop’s functions.

This player leaderboard had been tossed into some obscure corner by the brain-implanted system; unless one went looking for it specifically, they would never notice it.

Only after checking the leaderboard did Shang Feifan discover that the current player levels were all hovering between Level 10 and Level 12. He was the only one standing head and shoulders above the rest, not only breaking through the milestone of Level 20, but charging all the way toward Level 30.

It was undeniably a bit too conspicuous.

"Is this just *a bit*?" Fu Xiangjun let out a strange howl. 

"What on earth have you been doing? How did you suddenly start leveling up so fast?"

Shang Feifan told Fu Xiangjun about the developments in Mola City.

"Must be nice. I knew you must have found a monster-grinding hotspot swarming with beasts." Fu Xiangjun’s face was green with envy. "Roughly what level are those monsters?"

"The ones that just mutated are around Level 7 or 8, making them relatively easy to farm. Those mutated for over five minutes have already reached Level 10 and can use their inherent innate skills. The longer the mutation time, the stronger their physical bodies and abilities. For those mutated for over half an hour, their lethality and defense basically reach Level 15 or higher."

"Sounds not bad. If Mola City were closer to us, we could head over and grab a slice of the pie too," Fu Xiangjun said with yearning.

"Right now, the weakest monsters in Mola City have already reached Level 25 and above, averaging around Level 30, with even more formidable ones that I have to give a wide berth whenever I run into them," Shang Feifan said calmly.

Fu Xiangjun: "……The game development team must have their eyes on you. Right now, you’re basically equivalent to a walking, talking cheat script. Be careful they don’t discover you have two systems."

Shang Feifan smiled at the envious Lao Fu. "Let them look. It would be even better if they could trace my IP address."

"What do you mean?"

"If I can't find them, I'll just let them come and find me."

Shang Feifan had analyzed this: the game system in his mind ought to be far superior to the laptop system.

The quest to kill monsters and level up was assigned by the brain-implanted system itself. In other words, the brain-implanted system definitely knew that his rapid leveling would attract the attention of the game developers.

Yet, the brain-implanted system had still done it anyway.

This meant the brain-implanted system certainly had its reasons for doing so. Furthermore, it must have already figured out counter-measures—such as ensuring that the game developers had no way to delete his game account.

Of course, this was just his personal speculation; how the actual situation would unfold, he had no way of knowing.

Logically speaking, with such a bizarre system mysteriously appearing in one's head, any normal player would hesitate before logging back into the game.

However, Shang Feifan was clearly no normal person.

How could an abnormal person like Shang Feifan encounter something so interesting and yet quit just because of a sliver of danger?

Not to mention, he currently had a compelling reason why he absolutely could not give up this game.

Besides, since the brain-implanted system dared to let him level up like this and expose him right in front of the game developers, why should he worry too much?

Unless the brain-implanted system wanted to use the game development team to wipe him out, but the brain-implanted system itself possessed the ability to delete his game account; there was simply no need to go through such a convoluted, redundant effort.

"Why do you think the game developers will take the initiative to come find you? Can't they just delete your account directly?" Fu Xiangjun asked, full of doubt.

Shang Feifan smiled faintly. "What if they *can't* delete it?"

"How could they not delete it? You aren't a vir—*Damn it!* Your brain-implanted system is basically the equivalent of a super-virus for this game, isn't it?"

"You could understand it that way." Shang Feifan was currently just waiting for the game developers to trace his IP address and track down his physical location.

For a large-scale holographic game boasting nearly one-hundred-percent realism, to say nothing of how arduous the development process was, the sheer amount of money consumed was unimaginable.

Putting himself in their shoes, if he were a developer and discovered that in the ultimate game he had poured his blood, sweat, tears, and countless resources into—the one with which he intended to conquer the world—a hacker had appeared who couldn't be deleted no matter what, he would definitely pay a personal visit to see what was going on.

After all, a hacker who couldn't be deleted didn't just disrupt game balance; they were entirely capable of causing massive loopholes and destruction to this game world.

And as long as the game developers still wanted to make money off this game, they couldn't possibly sit idly by and watch such a massive bug exist.

As for what to do after the game developers showed up at his doorstep, Shang Feifan had already formulated one detailed plan after another.

Fu Xiangjun looked at Old Shang's expression, his worry completely unmasked. "You're playing with fire, you know."

Could game developers capable of eluding the prying eyes of a super-state organization without leaving a single trace really be ordinary people?

What's more, it wasn't just one country investigating these game developers.

It could be said that quite a few nations across the globe had already taken notice of this game, and everyone was probing the background of these developers.

Yet, up to this point, no organization or individual had claimed to have lifted the mysterious veil shrouding the game developers—they hadn't even caught a glimpse of what that veil looked like.

By now, various factions were already speculating whether these game developers were connected to extraterrestrial beings.

Some nations and organizations wanted to ban this game, calling upon their citizens to steer clear of it in order to prevent them from being brainwashed or having dangerous foreign objects implanted directly into their brains.

However, even more countries and organizations were salivating over the black-tech knowledge involved in this holographic game. They intended to wait and see how things developed first, watching to figure out what these game developers were actually aiming to achieve.

As for the players actually playing the game, monitoring them would suffice.

The moment anything seemed amiss, all these players would simply be eliminated.

Therefore, various countries and organizations were currently investigating their own spheres of influence to see which of their citizens had applied for accounts to this game, and who had received the gaming helmets.

"Haven't our lives always been a game of fire?" Shang Feifan wore a half-smile.

Fu Xiangjun: "……That matter about you hearing voices in the game—are you really not going to report it up the chain?"

Shang Feifan turned to look at him. "Are *you* going to report it?"

Fu Xiangjun rolled his eyes. "I'm worried your brain has already been quietly implanted with a control chip by aliens!"

Shang Feifan waved a hand, pulling his gaming helmet back on. "Very well, I grant you the authority to kill me the moment you discover I've become a traitor to humanity—provided you can actually pull it off."

Fu Xiangjun shot him the middle finger and spat out a curse: "Go ahead and lose your mind, then!"

Bringing the time back to the present.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai once again teamed up, fighting their way out of the safehouse and charging straight into the streets.

If they wanted to slaughter monsters, there was certainly no shortage of numbers.

The toxic insect zone left in the wake of the insect-toxin spreader stretched all the way from the northwest of the city to the southeast.

Looking down from above, it resembled a slanted, wide band scorched onto a square chessboard with a branding iron, occupying fully one-fifth of the board's area.

And the initial sector within this one-fifth area happened to be the most densely populated slum in the city. When the disaster struck, it happened to be the time when the citizens had turned in for the night; truly, very few people managed to escape once they were enveloped by this zone.

Although there was temporarily no way to tally how many people had fallen victim, estimating from the rough count the two of them had seen, there were at least four to five thousand mutated corpses wandering this city.

The speed at which the two of them slaughtered monsters was hardly sluggish, but there was simply no way they could wipe out all four to five thousand monsters within three days.

In reality, the two of them had only eliminated a little over two hundred corpse-mutated monsters in total.

Shang Feifan had even deliberately pulled open his personal status panel to check.

Through the total contribution points, it was evident that he alone had slain 176 corpse-mutants.

Once his contribution points broke the two-hundred mark, his innate skill points experienced a noticeable boost.

Additionally, every time he killed a monster, he could absorb the energy dissipating from its corpse, increasing his skill points by 0.001.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第67章 账号删除和三十级更新 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
目前，他的个人数据是：

贡献点数：总计298点，结余83点。

玩家等级：29级

生命值：2900

能量值：2900

特殊能量值（怨气）：112566（不断上下浮动）

精神力值：55/100

智慧：8.2/10

敏捷值：29/100

力量值和血脉天赋（力大无穷）合并：49.8/100

血脉天赋（恶咒）：49.8/100

幸运值：0

商非凡挑眉。总贡献点数298点，这不是说他再杀两个怪，就能从玩家29级升到30级？

在他突破二十级时，游戏开发组还没有什么反应。

那么当他突破三十级后呢？

从目前玩家等级的升级速度来看，游戏开发组显然在有意控制，不想玩家在初期升级太快。

这表明，游戏商很可能在十九级升二十级，二十九级升三十级这样的大关卡都安排了重要的世界剧情。

说不定玩家的技能系统、职业系统等都会有极大变化。

这也是各种大型多人RPG游戏的惯常桥段。

可他却绕过了这些重大剧情，甚至是绕过了一些必要的大型任务，一路就要冲到三十级。

这游戏商还能忍？

游戏商确实不能忍。

以一己之力独立开发出这个伟大游戏的游戏策划大大都要气炸了。

刚开始，他没删除“你皇退休了”的玩家账号，是想查出来这个玩家在他的游戏系统中做了什么样的手脚。

但他查来查去，都没有查出bug。

怎么看，这个玩家的账号都很正常。

正常上游戏，正常下游戏，正常在游戏中活动……

呸！狗屁的正常！

他这个游戏策划、游戏系统最大的控制者竟然查不到这个玩家现在位于游戏世界的详细坐标。这正常吗？

他更没有查出来这个玩家在游戏世界里晃荡这么长时间，为什么连一个自动任务都没有弹出却依然能升级的原因。这正常吗？

系统任务并不需要都由他来发布，而是可以根据玩家身边情况，智能发布。

而只要被笔记本系统发布给玩家的任务，他这边都能看到详情。

可“你皇退休了”愣是将近三个月一个任务都没有做。

但他这边又显示对方的笔记本系统仍旧完好，并且就跟玩家待在一起。

可笔记本系统应该传递给他的玩家坐标点功能却像是消失了，无论他怎么召唤都召唤不出来！

更不要说他和笔记本系统都没有给该玩家发布任务，对方的玩家等级却能嗖嗖往上升，就像没有任何瓶颈一样。

就算你皇退休了的笔记本系统出了问题，发布了任务却没有反馈记录。

可是！他明明在十九级升二十级设置了关卡，只要没做相关转职任务，无论玩家做再多零碎任务都无法升级。

这是一个基础设定，实际上那时候游戏系统还会有一次更新，不更新玩家就无法升级。你皇退休了的笔记本系统就算出问题，也不可能自己更新吧？

所以对方到底是怎么绕过了他设置的关卡？

又是依靠什么在升级？

游戏策划查不出来，这让他好看的眉头皱成了川字型。

眼看“你皇退休了”已经升到二十九级，游戏策划当即下定决心：不能再放任了！

既然查不出病因，那就把病灶给彻底消除掉！

游戏策划瞄准“你皇退休了”这个游戏账号按下了删除键。

“你皇退休了”这个账号瞬间变成灰色。

游戏策划吐出一口气。问题总算暂时解决了。

同一时间，摩罗城。

商非凡刚杀了两个怪，就听到脑中叮咚一声响。

【注意！你即将突破玩家等级三十级，你的身体体质和技能将进行一次全面提升。提升期间，系统将进行再次更新。更新期间，你将无法下线、无法使用本系统，你本人动作也会变得僵硬。】

【特别注意！如果在更新期间死亡，你的体质提升将会失败，同时你的游戏身体有被捕获和销毁的危险。】

【更新时间预计一个小时。三十秒后开始，30、29……】

商非凡：卧槽！你都不事先提醒一下的吗？老子正在杀怪，你现在开始更新？

另外你给我说清楚，什么叫我的游戏身体有被捕获和销毁的危险？

谁要捕捉和销毁我的身体？

无奈，这个脑载系统就是这么不人性化，说更新就更新，丝毫不管玩家方便与否。

时间只剩下二十几秒，商非凡一铲子砍飞他正在引的怪，脚尖一点地面，跳到虎不帅背上。

“不帅，我的身体出了点问题，需要一个小时才能恢复。在这之前，我们先找个安全地方躲起来。”

虎不帅惊闻变故，脸色半点不变，只回应：“好。”
chunks.englishText:
Currently, his personal data was as follows:

Contribution Points: 298 total, 83 remaining.

Player Level: 29

Health Points (HP): 2900

Energy Points: 2900

Special Energy (Resentment): 112,566 (constantly fluctuating)

Mental Strength: 55/100

Intelligence: 8.2/10

Agility: 29/100

Strength and Bloodline Talent (Herculean Strength) Merged: 49.8/100

Bloodline Talent (Vile Curse): 49.8/100

Luck: 0

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. With a total of 298 contribution points, didn't that mean he only needed to kill two more monsters to level up from Level 29 to Level 30?

When he broke through Level 20, the game development team hadn't reacted.

But what about when he broke through Level 30?

Judging by the current leveling speed of players, the development team was clearly controlling the pace, not wanting players to level up too quickly in the early stages.

This indicated that the game developers had likely arranged major world events or story arcs at crucial milestones like Level 19 to 20, and Level 29 to 30.

Perhaps the players' skill systems, class systems, and so on would undergo massive changes.

This was a common trope in large-scale multiplayer RPGs.

Yet, he had bypassed these major plotlines, and even skipped some essential major quests, rushing all the way to Level 30.

Could the game developers tolerate this?

Indeed, they could not.

The great game designer, who had single-handedly developed this magnificent game, was about to explode with rage.

Initially, he hadn't deleted the player account "Your Emperor Has Retired" because he wanted to figure out what kind of tricks this player had pulled in his game system.

But no matter how much he searched, he couldn't find any bugs.

By all accounts, this player's account looked perfectly normal.

Logging in normally, logging out normally, active in the game normally...

Bah! Normal, my foot!

He, the game designer and ultimate controller of the game system, couldn't even find this player's exact coordinates in the game world. Was that normal?

Furthermore, he couldn't figure out why this player had been wandering around the game world for so long without a single automated quest popping up, yet was still able to level up. Was that normal?

System quests didn't all need to be manually published by him; they could be intelligently generated based on the player's surroundings.

And as long as a quest was issued to the player by the notebook system, he could see the details on his end.

Yet "Your Emperor Has Retired" had stubbornly gone nearly three months without doing a single quest.

But his panel showed that the other party's notebook system was still perfectly intact and remained with the player.

However, the coordinate transmission function that the notebook system was supposed to send back seemed to have vanished. No matter how he summoned it, nothing came up!

Not to mention, neither he nor the notebook system had issued any quests to this player, yet the player's level was soaring upward as if there were no bottlenecks whatsoever.

Even if "Your Emperor Has Retired's" notebook system had malfunctioned, issuing quests without recording feedback...

But! He had clearly set a bottleneck at Level 19 to 20. As long as the player didn't complete the class advancement quest, no amount of minor quests would allow them to level up.

This was a fundamental setting. In fact, the game system was supposed to undergo an update at that point; without the update, players couldn't level up. Even if "Your Emperor Has Retired's" notebook system had glitched, it couldn't possibly update itself, right?

So how on earth did the other party bypass the bottleneck he had set?

And what were they relying on to level up?

The game designer couldn't figure it out, causing his handsome brow to furrow deeply.

Seeing that "Your Emperor Has Retired" had already reached Level 29, the game designer made a prompt decision: he could not let this slide any longer!

Since he couldn't find the cause of the disease, he would completely eradicate the lesion!

The game designer targeted the account "Your Emperor Has Retired" and pressed the delete key.

The account "Your Emperor Has Retired" instantly turned gray.

The game designer let out a breath. The problem was finally resolved, at least for now.

At the same time, in Molo City.

Shang Feifan had just killed two monsters when he heard a chime in his mind.

【Attention! You are about to break through to Player Level 30. Your physical constitution and skills will undergo a comprehensive upgrade. During this upgrade, the system will perform another update. During the update, you will be unable to log out, unable to use this system, and your physical movements will become stiff.】

【Special Warning! If you die during the update, your physical upgrade will fail, and your game body will be at risk of being captured and destroyed.】

【Estimated update time: one hour. Beginning in thirty seconds. 30, 29...】

Shang Feifan: Holy shit! You didn't even give me a heads-up? I'm in the middle of killing monsters, and you're starting an update now?

And make yourself clear, what do you mean my game body is at risk of being captured and destroyed?

Who wants to capture and destroy my body?

Alas, this brain-loaded system was just that user-unfriendly. It updated whenever it pleased, with absolutely no regard for the player's convenience.

With only twenty-odd seconds left, Shang Feifan sent the monster he was pulling flying with a swing of his shovel. Tapping his toes against the ground, he leapt onto Hu Bushuai's back.

"Bushuai, something's wrong with my body. It will take an hour to recover. Before that, we need to find a safe place to hide."

Hearing this sudden turn of events, Hu Bushuai's expression didn't change in the slightest. He simply replied, "Alright."

chunks.chineseText:
第68章 升级完毕

商非凡在做完交代后，还做了一件事，他操纵怨气把自己和不帅都包裹了起来。

怨气可以遮掩他们的活人气息，走在怪物当中，只要他们不主动对怪物动手，那些怪物们就会对他们视而不见。

这也是他在杀怪不久后发现的怨气新使用方法。

但他不确定当他身体体质开始全面提升时，他的怨气护罩是否还可以持续下去。

三十秒时间转眼即逝。

商非凡都没有来得及把自己的身体固定在白虎背上。

他的身体果然变得僵直，连不帅的毛发都抓不住。

怨气护罩跟着消失。

他没有了任何自保和保护不帅的力量。

屋漏偏逢连夜雨，不帅的炼金装备貌似进入了冷却器。

之前不帅使用这个遮掩自己气息的炼金装备都是掐算着时间来的。

离开安全屋后，不帅就激活了身上的炼金装备，等跑到合适的杀怪地点，他就停止使用该炼金装备。

该炼金装备的使用时间为一个小时，每次使用都有一个小时的冷却时间。

但如果激活该装备后又停止使用，不管使用时长有没有一个小时，都会进入一个小时的冷却器。

本来这一个小时的冷却器是他们杀怪的时间。

可谁想到他的系统会突然升级。

之前十九级升二十级时，系统没有任何反应，商非凡以为二十九级升三十级也一样，这才没有做什么准备。

结果就被系统给坑了！

如果我老婆出什么事，我跟你没完！

商非凡在心里发狠。

忽然，商非凡感到身体内部就像是有无数虫蚁在啃咬他。

一开始不是特别疼，就是有点感觉，又疼又痒。

但没多一会儿，痛痒感就开始加剧。

他甚至感到自己的骨头内部都钻入了数不清的小虫子！

商非凡难受得身体肌肉微微颤抖。

可他一动不能动，只能僵硬地趴在虎不帅身上。

随着不帅奔跑跳跃，他的身体也跟着在虎背上滑来滑去，随时随地都会掉下去。

虎不帅边杀怪边往安全屋方向退，为此他还缩小了身形。

那些尸变怪物虽然没有清晰的神智，但它们只要看到闻到活的生物就会不管不顾地扑过去，拼命撕咬吞吃。

一旦陷入群怪包围，就算他能变身巨兽，也要担心蚁多咬死象的可能。

两人敢在摩罗城留下来杀怪，也是因为两人都有短暂让怪物们发现不了他们的自我保护方法。

他是靠一个炼金装备，商非凡似乎是靠本身特质。

之前有商非凡和他配合，两个人会分别引怪，限定怪物数量。当他身体变成巨兽，视野和灵活度受到一定阻碍时，商非凡会帮他留意，不让怪物爬到他身上。

巨大的身体是杀伤力巨大，但在城市巷道中反而会受到一定限制。

虎不帅只能变小身体。

追在他们屁股后面的怪物越来越多，街巷房屋中也不时有新的怪物蹿出来。

不帅奔跑的速度越来越快。

砰！

无法固定自己的商非凡从不帅身上滑落。

幸好这时的虎不帅身体不算巨大，否则从十米高处摔下来，就是商非凡现在拥有的是兽人身体，也得断胳膊断腿。

不帅一个急停。

转身就跑回商非凡身边。

一只怪物猛地扑向两人。

虎不帅身体陡然变大，一爪子抓碎那怪物的脑袋。

但他身后也被一只怪物攻击，为了保护身下的商非凡，不帅无法闪避，硬生生挨了一下。

血腥气似乎刺激了周围怪物，更多怪物向他们冲来。

眼看白虎就要陷入包围圈，白虎嘴巴一张，叼起商非凡，撒腿就跑。

商非凡看到白虎受伤，眼神变得极为暗沉。连身体中那万蚁钻心钻骨的痛苦都无法夺走他的注意力。

刺啦。

商非凡的衣服撕裂，人也再次从白虎嘴巴里掉到地上。

白虎低头。

商非凡从大白虎的眼睛里看到了“麻烦”两字。

这时候商非凡反倒希望不帅把他丢下，他好歹也是玩家，死了也还有复生的机会。

虽然系统说了他如果在这次升级期间死亡，游戏身体有被捕获和销毁的可能。

但也只是可能，不是绝对。

比起让不帅受伤甚至遇到更糟糕的事情，他宁可自己冒险。

白虎当然不可能丢下商非凡。

他既然答应要保护好这个人，就一定会遵守承诺。

他从没有叼过人，这次只是业务不熟练。

白虎再次叼起僵硬的商非凡，这次他没有再叼着商的衣服，而是直接用牙齿轻咬住他的躯体。

就这么一耽搁，怪物们再次形成包围圈。

白虎身体变到最大，十米高的肩高让他比周围建筑物还要高，大长腿一迈就冲出老远。

粗壮的长尾成了他现在最好的武器，灵活的长尾如鞭子一般把扑到他身上的怪物全都抽飞。

不过这么巨大的身体不适合在城市中奔跑，他只是利用巨大身形突破包围圈。

一冲出包围圈，他的身体就缩小到三米多高。

这个体型可以让他有力气叼着一个两米高的兽人还能跑得飞快，同时不用担心被狭窄的巷道限制住速度。

商非凡：那个该死的安全屋怎么还没有到！

这也是两人特意为之，既然是安全屋，那自然不能让怪物们发现。

为了避免从安全屋一出来就被怪物包饺子，两人每次从安全屋出来都会隐藏气息，直到跑到两三条街外才会开始引怪杀怪。

往常他们并不觉得两三条街道有多长，但现在……

白虎身上不断出现伤口

这都是沿途的怪物发现他们后扑过来造成。

有些怪物具有天赋技能，可以远程就对他们发出攻击。

白虎无法攻击，更无法停下脚步，因为一旦停下，他们就会陷入包围圈。

他只能拼命跑。

如果没有商非凡，白虎可以把身体变到很小，再利用速度优势，以最快速度逃回安全屋。

可他现在带着不能动弹更无法隐藏的商非凡，速度优势首先就没了。

商非凡眼眸的暗红越来越深。

一个有能力的人最讨厌的是什么？

那绝对是当自己关心的人陷入危难时，自己却只能无力地眼睁睁地看着。

不行！

不能再出现这样的情况。

如果每次系统升级，他就会跟着进入无力抵抗状态，那也太糟糕了。

更糟糕的是，他的身体显然受到脑载系统控制。

如果将来某一天，脑载系统想要对他不利，或者在某个关键时刻让他停机……

商非凡第一次生出想要摆脱脑载系统的想法，哪怕这只是一个游戏。

想要摆脱游戏程序控制的最好方法是什么？

那当然是成为程序的设计者和操控者。

商非凡的大脑中忽然再次出现了无数声音，那些声音刺激着他的大脑神经，让他想要疯狂喊叫疯狂厮杀。

忍住！

我必须忍住！

商非凡本能地控制住自己的思维，不让自己的精神陷入那种疯狂混乱状态。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 68: Upgrade Complete

After giving his instructions, Shang Feifan did one more thing: he manipulated his resentment to wrap both himself and Bushuai in it.

Resentment could mask their living aura. Walking among the monsters, as long as they didn't actively attack, the monsters would turn a blind eye to them.

This was a new way of using resentment that he had discovered not long after he started killing monsters.

But he wasn't sure if his resentment shield could be maintained once his physical constitution began its comprehensive upgrade.

Thirty seconds flew by in the blink of an eye.

Shang Feifan didn't even have time to secure his body onto the white tiger's back.

Sure enough, his body grew rigid, and he couldn't even grasp Bushuai's fur.

The resentment shield vanished along with it.

He was left without any power to protect himself or Bushuai.

To make matters worse, Bushuai's alchemical equipment seemed to have entered its cooldown period.

Previously, Bushuai had carefully timed his use of this alchemical equipment that masked his aura.

After leaving the safehouse, Bushuai would activate the alchemical equipment on his body. Once they reached a suitable monster-killing spot, he would stop using it.

The alchemical equipment could be used for an hour, and each use had a one-hour cooldown.

However, if the equipment was activated and then stopped, it would enter a one-hour cooldown regardless of whether it had been used for the full hour.

Originally, this one-hour cooldown was supposed to be their monster-killing time.

But who could have predicted that his system would suddenly update?

When he leveled up from 19 to 20, the system hadn't reacted at all. Shang Feifan had assumed it would be the same for Level 29 to 30, which was why he hadn't made any preparations.

As a result, he had been completely screwed over by the system!

If anything happens to my wife, I'm going to make you pay!

Shang Feifan swore fiercely in his heart.

Suddenly, Shang Feifan felt as if countless insects and ants were gnawing at the inside of his body.

At first, it wasn't particularly painful, just a slight sensation—both itchy and aching.

But before long, the painful itching began to intensify.

He even felt as if countless tiny bugs had burrowed into the very marrow of his bones!

Shang Feifan's muscles trembled slightly from the sheer discomfort.

Yet he couldn't move a muscle, forced to lie rigidly on Hu Bushuai's back.

As Bushuai ran and leapt, his body slid back and forth across the tiger's back, on the verge of falling off at any moment.

Hu Bushuai fought off monsters while retreating toward the safehouse, shrinking his body size for the task.

Although those mutated corpse monsters lacked clear intelligence, they would recklessly pounce on any living creature they saw or smelled, biting and devouring them frantically.

Once surrounded by a horde of monsters, even if he could transform into a giant beast, he still had to worry about the possibility of being overwhelmed by sheer numbers—like ants taking down an elephant.

The reason the two of them dared to stay in Molo City to kill monsters was because both possessed self-preservation methods that could temporarily hide them from the monsters.

He relied on an alchemical item, while Shang Feifan seemed to rely on his own unique traits.

Previously, with Shang Feifan cooperating with him, the two of them would pull monsters separately to limit their numbers. When his body transformed into a giant beast, restricting his field of vision and agility, Shang Feifan would watch his back and prevent monsters from crawling onto him.

A massive body possessed immense destructive power, but it was actually quite restricted in narrow city alleys.

Thus, Hu Bushuai could only shrink his body.

More and more monsters pursued them from behind, and new ones occasionally lunged out from the streets and buildings.

Bushuai ran faster and faster.

Thud!

Unable to secure himself, Shang Feifan slipped off Bushuai's back.

Fortunately, Hu Bushuai's body wasn't massive at this moment. Otherwise, falling from a height of ten meters would have broken Shang Feifan's arms and legs, even with his current beastman physique.

Bushuai came to a screeching halt.

He turned around and dashed back to Shang Feifan's side.

A monster lunged fiercely at the two of them.

Hu Bushuai's body suddenly expanded, and with a single swipe of his claw, he crushed the monster's head.

However, he was also attacked by a monster from behind. To protect Shang Feifan beneath him, Bushuai couldn't dodge and took the blow head-on.

The scent of blood seemed to stimulate the surrounding monsters, and even more of them rushed toward them.

Seeing that the white tiger was about to be surrounded, he opened his jaws, picked up Shang Feifan, and bolted.

Seeing the white tiger injured, Shang Feifan's eyes darkened intensely. Not even the agonizing pain of ten thousand ants boring into his heart and bones could distract him.

Riiip.

Shang Feifan's clothes tore, and he fell to the ground from the white tiger's mouth once more.

The white tiger looked down.

From the large white tiger's eyes, Shang Feifan read the word "trouble."

At this moment, Shang Feifan actually wished Bushuai would just leave him behind. He was a player, after all; even if he died, he still had a chance to respawn.

Although the system had warned that if he died during this upgrade, his game body might be captured and destroyed.

But that was only a possibility, not a certainty.

Compared to letting Bushuai get hurt or face something even worse, he would rather take the risk himself.

Of course, the white tiger would never abandon Shang Feifan.

Since he had promised to protect this person, he would absolutely keep his word.

He had never carried a person in his mouth before; this was just a lack of experience.

The white tiger picked up the rigid Shang Feifan once more. This time, instead of grabbing Shang's clothes, he gently clamped his teeth directly onto his body.

With this brief delay, the monsters formed a perimeter around them once again.

The white tiger expanded to his maximum size. With a shoulder height of ten meters, he towered over the surrounding buildings, covering a massive distance with a single stride of his long legs.

His thick, long tail became his best weapon, whipping around with agility to send any monsters leaping at him flying.

However, such a massive body was not suited for running through the city; he was merely using his giant form to break through the encirclement.

The moment he broke free, his body shrank back down to a height of just over three meters.

This size gave him enough strength to carry a two-meter-tall beastman while running at high speed, without worrying about being slowed down by narrow alleys.

Shang Feifan: Why the hell haven't we reached that damn safehouse yet!

This was also a deliberate choice on their part. Since it was a safehouse, they naturally couldn't let the monsters discover it.

To avoid being ambushed the moment they stepped out of the safehouse, they would hide their presence every time they left, only starting to pull and kill monsters once they were two or three streets away.

Usually, they didn't think two or three streets was a long distance, but now...

Wounds kept appearing on the white tiger's body.

These were caused by the monsters along the way pouncing on them after detecting their presence.

Some monsters possessed innate skills, allowing them to launch ranged attacks.

The white tiger couldn't fight back, let alone stop his pace, because the moment he stopped, they would be surrounded.

He could only run for his life.

If not for Shang Feifan, the white tiger could have shrunk his body to a very small size and used his speed advantage to flee back to the safehouse as quickly as possible.

But now, carrying Shang Feifan, who could neither move nor hide, his speed advantage was completely gone.

The dark red in Shang Feifan's eyes grew deeper and deeper.

What does a capable person hate the most?

It was undoubtedly having to watch helplessly as the person they cared about fell into danger.

No!

This cannot happen again.

If he was going to be rendered completely defenseless every time the system updated, that would be far too terrible.

Even worse, his body was clearly controlled by this brain-loaded system.

If one day in the future, the brain-loaded system wanted to harm him, or shut him down at a critical moment...

For the first time, Shang Feifan felt a desire to rid himself of this brain-loaded system, even if this was just a game.

What was the best way to escape the control of a game program?

Naturally, it was to become the designer and controller of the program itself.

Suddenly, countless voices echoed in Shang Feifan's mind once more. Those voices stimulated his brain nerves, making him want to scream and slaughter in a frenzy.

Endure it!

I must endure it!

Shang Feifan instinctively controlled his thoughts, refusing to let his mind fall into that state of mad chaos.

chunks.chineseText:
同一时间，他身体内部那万蚁钻心的痛苦也开始升级，他感到自己的筋骨肉皮血管神经等全都被撕裂重组。

如果不是他这时不能动弹也不能发声，他九成九已经嘶喊出声。

这种从身体到灵魂的痛苦根本就不是人能忍受！

该死的系统，这就是你所谓的全面提升？

系统没有回答他，也许是无法回答。

商非凡汗出如浆，随着汗液，他身体中的某些物质也跟着排出体外。

远处正在游荡的怪物们突然齐齐抬起头。

它们像是察觉到什么，整个怪物都亢奋起来。

它们发出嘶吼，一起转身向某个方向狂奔而去。

就连一些已经跑到城外的怪物也都被某种气息吸引，全都掉头往摩罗城内跑。

摩罗城外正在观察怪物、和正在试图捕杀怪物们的兽人们吃惊，不知道发生了什么事情。

拍卖行到了！

白虎一头冲入拍卖行大门。

在冲入拍卖行的同时，白虎变回人形，一把抱起商非凡冲向地下室方向。

后面一群怪物跟着他们冲入拍卖行。

冲下阶梯，冲入地下通道，看到那间敞开的地下仓库大门的同时，虎不帅扬手就把商非凡抛入仓库。随即转身、关门，一气呵成。

有两只速度快的怪物跟着冲进仓库。

咔嚓咔嚓，大门自动上锁。

其他怪物一头撞在大门上，都被关在了大门外。

虎不帅重新变身巨虎，与进入仓库的两只怪物厮杀。

五分钟后，两只怪物的尸体碎片四散，虎不帅喘着粗气趴到地上开始舔-舐自己身上的伤口。

这些伤口有些是被尸变怪物撕咬出来。

这种伤口中会含有一定虫毒，如果处理不好，就会导致感染。

但虎不帅早就发现他的身体对虫毒有一定抵抗性，只要虫毒浓度不是特别高，他就能依靠时间把身体中的虫毒分解出去。

不帅没有恢复人形，兽形可以让他的伤势恢复更快。

商非凡趴在地上的姿势不太好看，他是被抛进来的。

一只粗大的虎爪拨了拨他，把他翻成正面朝上。

“不帅……”他的嘴唇似乎在动。

白虎歪头看商非凡，似乎很好奇他为什么会变得如此僵硬。

过了一会儿，白虎在商非凡身边卧下，闭上眼睛，似乎睡着了。

这是兽人的本能，兽人在受伤又没有药物治疗的情况下，睡觉就是他们恢复自身的最大手段。

商非凡混乱的精神体硬是分出了一丝给不帅。

也就是这一丝关注，让他的精神体没有被不知从哪里冒出来的疯狂和混乱给全都拉扯进去。

商非凡异常后悔。

他们有食物也有药物，量还很多，但都在他这里。

不帅发现他有空间储物工具后，就把搜找来的药物都放在他这里。

原本他们想在地下仓库里也放一点备用，但地下仓库的大门在他们出去后必须保持打开状态，在里面放东西不安全，最后就什么都没有放。

商非凡后悔的是，如果这是现实世界，就算有被破坏的可能，他一定也会在各个安全点藏些必备品，这是他能比同期人活得都要长都要好的要素之一。

可就因为他把这里当游戏世界看，抱着游戏心态，就没有做到最好。

虎不帅是一段数据没错。

可他受伤是真实的，他流出的血液也是真实的。

在游戏世界，这些设定对于游戏人物来说就是真实！

换言之，如果不帅受到重伤，他一样会死亡，会彻底消失。

商非凡盯着白虎，就像是要把这只白虎收入自己的眼睛中。

一个小时的时间，你不在意的时候，很短。

但当你数着时间干熬，就会发现异常漫长。

商非凡一动不能动，不能说话、不能查看自己的系统面板，也不能下线，他还只能眼睁睁看着他家不帅带着一身伤趴在那里。

身体和灵魂传来的痛苦被他生生压制下去。

他在疯狂中保持着清醒，冷漠地看着这一切，等待系统更新结束。

叮咚。

【系统更新完毕。新增以下功能……】

【个人体质提升完毕，详细请查看个人数据面板……】

商非凡根本没去查看他的个人面板，他能重新操控自己的身体后，第一个动作就是摸出药物，翻身坐到白虎身边。

虎不帅睁开眼睛，他并没有真正睡着。

大门外不断传来怪物们的撞击声和各种破坏大门的声音，他能睡得着才怪。

他只是在尽可能地恢复体力，好在大门支撑不住时，能第一时间带着商非凡冲出去。

“你恢复了？那就好。我们得想办法从这里离开，外面很可能聚集了一大堆怪物。”不帅特别平静地说。

“我先给你上药。”商非凡的声音和神情都表示这事没得商量。

虎不帅当然不可能有药不用，“我自己来。顺便给我拿一套衣服。”

“你保持兽形是不是对你恢复更好？”商非凡开始给虎不帅查看伤势。

不得不说兽人的恢复力就是好，之前看着有些特别深的伤口，这都开始收口了，血液也不再渗出。

虎不帅身体挪动，想要躲开商非凡的手，被按住。

“别乱动。早点上完药，你也能早点好。然后我们才能想要怎么出去的事。”

虎不帅不动了。

商非凡加快上药速度，因为兽人的特殊体质，暂时不用考虑缝线。

“不要包扎。”虎不帅开口：“这会儿包扎好也没用，一会儿变身就会崩断。”

商非凡只能加大药量，给不帅的伤口全都糊上厚厚一层伤药。

虎不帅瞄见：“浪费。”

他们弄到的药物不少都是来自一些药行药店，他们没动库存，就是把店面里一些药物收集了起来。

想来店家在撤离时也在心中做好了准备，店面的那些药物都是被放弃的。

每家药店单留在铺面的药物都不多，有些还被人搜刮过。但他们两个人在药剂市场和商业市场走一圈下来，搜集到的药物也足够两人开一家大型药店。

“疼吗？”

“……你要我怎么回答你？”

商非凡手指在白虎厚实的皮毛中滑过。

“别乱摸！”虎不帅警告。

商非凡没有缩回手，反而揉了揉白虎的脑袋。

虎不帅瞪他。

商非凡突然低头亲了亲白虎的额头。

虎不帅眼睛瞪得溜圆。

不等白虎一脚踹开他，商非凡就主动拉开距离，走到门边查看那扇大门还能支撑多久。

虎不帅：“……给我衣服！”

商非凡转头笑，掏出一套衣服抛给他。

虎不帅刚要变回人形，看到商非凡仍旧盯着他看。

都是雄性，彼此当着对方面变身穿衣服也没什么。

但商非凡的目光太有侵略性。

偏偏偌大的仓库里没有任何隐蔽角落。

“能不能麻烦你转过头？”

“你要变身？你身上还有伤，要么等伤口长好以后……”

虎不帅尴尬了。原来商非凡转头看他不是想要占他便宜，而是担心他。

他想要变回人形，也是因为刚才商非凡突然亲他。
chunks.englishText:
At the same time, the agonizing pain of ten thousand ants boring into his heart escalated. He felt his muscles, bones, flesh, skin, blood vessels, and nerves being torn apart and reconstructed.

If he hadn't been unable to move or make a sound, he would have screamed out loud in ninety-nine percent of certainty.

This kind of pain, stretching from body to soul, was simply beyond human endurance!

Damn system, is this your so-called comprehensive upgrade?

The system did not answer him—perhaps it was unable to.

Shang Feifan sweated profusely. Along with the sweat, certain substances within his body were expelled.

In the distance, the wandering monsters suddenly raised their heads in unison.

It was as if they had sensed something; the monsters grew extremely excited.

They let out roars and turned to run wildly toward a certain direction.

Even some monsters that had already run outside the city were drawn by a certain scent, turning back to rush into Molo City.

Outside Molo City, the beastmen who were observing the monsters and trying to hunt them down were astonished, having no idea what was happening.

They reached the auction house!

The white tiger charged headfirst through the main doors of the auction house.

As he burst into the auction house, the white tiger shifted back into human form, scooped up Shang Feifan, and dashed toward the basement.

A horde of monsters followed them, swarming into the auction house.

Rushing down the stairs and into the underground passage, the moment he saw the open door of the underground warehouse, Hu Bushuai threw Shang Feifan inside. He then spun around and slammed the door shut in one fluid motion.

Two fast monsters managed to slip into the warehouse with them.

With a series of clicks, the door locked automatically.

The other monsters crashed headfirst into the door, shut out completely.

Hu Bushuai transformed back into a giant tiger and engaged the two monsters that had entered the warehouse.

Five minutes later, the shredded remains of the two monsters lay scattered. Panting heavily, Hu Bushuai collapsed onto the ground and began to lick his wounds.

Some of these wounds had been torn open by the bites of the mutated corpse monsters.

Such wounds contained a certain insect toxin. If not treated properly, it would lead to infection.

However, Hu Bushuai had long discovered that his body possessed a degree of resistance to the insect toxin. As long as the concentration wasn't exceptionally high, his body could break down and expel the toxin over time.

Bushuai did not revert to human form; his beast form allowed his injuries to heal faster.

Shang Feifan's posture on the ground was rather awkward, having been tossed inside.

A thick tiger paw nudged him, flipping him face-up.

"Bushuai..." His lips seemed to move.

The white tiger tilted his head at Shang Feifan, seemingly curious as to why he had become so rigid.

After a moment, the white tiger lay down beside Shang Feifan and closed his eyes, seemingly falling asleep.

This was a beastman's instinct. When injured and lacking medical treatment, sleep was their primary means of recovery.

Shang Feifan's chaotic mental state managed to spare a sliver of attention for Bushuai.

It was precisely this sliver of focus that kept his mind from being completely dragged down by the madness and chaos that had surged from out of nowhere.

Shang Feifan felt immense regret.

They had food and medicine, and in large quantities, but it was all stored with him.

After Bushuai discovered he had a spatial storage tool, he had placed all the medicine they scavenged with him.

Originally, they had planned to leave some supplies in the underground warehouse as a backup. However, the warehouse door had to remain open when they went out, making it unsafe to leave items inside, so they had ultimately left nothing.

What Shang Feifan regretted was that if this were the real world, even with the risk of destruction, he would have definitely hidden essential supplies at various safe points. This was one of the key reasons he had been able to live longer and better than his peers.

But because he viewed this place as a game world and held a gamer's mindset, he hadn't done his absolute best.

Hu Bushuai was indeed just a piece of data.

But his injuries were real, and the blood he spilled was real.

In the game world, these settings were reality for the game characters!

In other words, if Bushuai was gravely injured, he would still die and vanish completely.
