Shang Feifan stared at the white tiger, as if trying to imprint the beast into his very eyes.

An hour is very short when you aren't paying attention.

But when you are counting down the seconds in agony, you find it exceptionally long.

Shang Feifan couldn't move, couldn't speak, couldn't check his system panel, and couldn't log out. He could only watch helplessly as his Bushuai lay there covered in wounds.

He forcefully suppressed the pain radiating from his body and soul.

He maintained his sanity amidst the madness, coldly observing everything as he waited for the system update to finish.

Ding-dong.

【System update complete. The following functions have been added...】

【Personal constitution upgrade complete. Please check your personal data panel for details...】

Shang Feifan didn't bother checking his personal panel at all. The moment he regained control of his body, his first action was to pull out medicine and roll over to sit beside the white tiger.

Hu Bushuai opened his eyes; he hadn't actually been asleep.

With the constant sound of monsters slamming against the door and trying to break it down outside, it would be a miracle if he could sleep.

He was merely recovering his strength as much as possible so that if the door gave way, he could immediately carry Shang Feifan and break out.

"You've recovered? That's good. We need to find a way to leave this place. There's likely a massive horde of monsters gathered outside," Bushuai said with exceptional calmness.

"I'm applying medicine to your wounds first." Shang Feifan's voice and expression made it clear that this was non-negotiable.

Of course, Hu Bushuai wouldn't refuse medicine when it was available. "I'll do it myself. And get me a set of clothes while you're at it."

"Is staying in your beast form better for your recovery?" Shang Feifan began to inspect Hu Bushuai's injuries.

One had to admit that a beastman's recovery rate was incredible. Some of the wounds that had looked exceptionally deep were already beginning to close, and the bleeding had stopped.

Hu Bushuai shifted his body, trying to evade Shang Feifan's hands, but he was held down.

"Don't squirm. The sooner we apply the medicine, the sooner you'll heal. Only then can we figure out how to get out of here."

Hu Bushuai stopped moving.

Shang Feifan quickened his pace. Thanks to the beastman's unique constitution, there was no need to worry about stitches for now.

"Don't bandage it," Hu Bushuai said. "Bandaging is useless right now. It'll just snap when I transform later."

Shang Feifan could only increase the dosage, slathering a thick layer of medicinal paste over all of Bushuai's wounds.

Hu Bushuai caught sight of this and muttered, "Wasteful."

A lot of the medicine they had obtained came from various pharmacies and apothecary shops. They hadn't touched the backroom inventory, only gathering what was on display in the storefronts.

Presumably, the shopkeepers had prepared themselves when evacuating, and the medicines in the storefronts were abandoned.

The amount of medicine left in any single shop wasn't much, and some had already been looted. However, after the two of them made a round through the pharmaceutical and commercial districts, the medicine they gathered was enough to open a large pharmacy.

"Does it hurt?"

"...How do you expect me to answer that?"

Shang Feifan's fingers slid through the white tiger's thick fur.

"Don't touch me like that!" Hu Bushuai warned.

Instead of pulling his hand back, Shang Feifan rubbed the white tiger's head.

Hu Bushuai glared at him.

Shang Feifan suddenly leaned down and kissed the white tiger's forehead.

Hu Bushuai's eyes went wide and round.

Before the white tiger could kick him away, Shang Feifan actively pulled back and walked over to the door to check how much longer it could hold.

Hu Bushuai: "...Give me my clothes!"

Shang Feifan turned around with a smile, pulled out a set of clothes, and tossed them to him.

Hu Bushuai was about to shift back into human form when he noticed Shang Feifan was still staring at him.

They were both males, so there was nothing wrong with transforming and dressing in front of each other.

But Shang Feifan's gaze was far too predatory.

And unfortunately, there wasn't a single hidden corner in the massive warehouse.

"Could you please turn around?"

"You want to transform? You still have wounds on your body. Maybe wait until they heal a bit more..."

Hu Bushuai felt a wave of embarrassment. So Shang Feifan hadn't been staring to take advantage of him, but because he was worried.

His desire to shift back into human form was also because of Shang Feifan's sudden kiss just now.

chunks.chineseText:
他总觉得商非凡在面对他的兽形时特别喜欢动手动脚，比面对人形的他更加肆无忌惮一点。

“这扇门还算结实，应该还能支撑一段时间。”商非凡拍了拍大门，判断。

虎不帅为了缓解尴尬，也说：“希望外面的怪物们能在大门支撑不住前散开。”

商非凡忽然贴到大门上，像是在聆听什么。

但他不是聆听，而是他感知到大门外面的怪物不但没有减少，反而越来越多。

他感知到了大量的虫毒，还有只有怪物们死亡时才会溃散出来的特别能量。

怎么会吸引来这么多怪物？

这些尸变怪物没有神智，自然也没有指挥官，它们全都是独自行动，虽然会在发现猎物后一窝蜂地冲过来，但当猎物消失，它们也会逐渐散开。

商非凡还把怨气散发出去，笼罩住他和虎不帅，但外面的怪物们仍旧没有散去，不停地刮擦大门。

怨气护罩失效了？

还是有其他什么原因？

叮咚。

【注意！体质升级过程中，虫母心脏碎片能量外泄，吸引了大量感染虫毒后的尸变体。请尽量消灭这些尸变体，收集尸体溃散能量。每杀死五只三十级以下怪物，奖励一个贡献点。三十级以上，一只一点。如一次性消灭一百只以上，额外奖励游戏商城特价装备一套。】

所以这些怪物才没有离开？但商非凡关注的不是虫母心脏碎片力量外泄，他关注的是杀怪效益大幅度降低，原本杀一个就能赚一点，现在变成了杀五个才能赚一点。

至于特价装备？

都是特价了，还能是什么好货吗？

“力量还在外泄中吗？”商非凡轻声问。

虎不帅抬头看他。

商非凡这句问话不像是在问他。

系统没有回答。

商非凡只能从“体质升级过程中”这句话推测，他现在应该已经没有再外泄虫母的心脏碎片能量。

也就是说他如果重新用怨气包裹他和不帅，有很大可能还是会被怪物们忽略，方便他们从怪物群中脱离。

现在这些怪物们不是在围杀他们，而是被他一路泄露出来的虫母心脏能量给吸引。

不过外面聚集了那么多怪物，还有系统给的奖励，就这么离开似乎也有点可惜。特价装备也是装备嘛，如果能拿到为什么不拿？

“有点糟糕，我们好像陷入麻烦中了。”商非凡没有隐瞒，把他感知到的情况告诉了不帅。

不帅立起四肢，“你的咒术阵能献祭多少怪物？”

商非凡和他思维同步，他正在打量这个仓库，打算在里面绘制一个大型咒术阵。

但这里有个问题，就是当怪物们冲入仓库，一个接一个肯定会有时间差。

如果他不能及时发动咒术阵，就会让先冲入的怪物与他们面对面。

可如果他在怪物冲进来的一刹那就发动咒术阵，那也拦不住后面的怪物。

所以……

得弄个三段阵。
chunks.englishText:
He always felt that Shang Feifan was particularly fond of getting hands-on whenever he faced his beast form, acting far more uninhibited than when facing his human form.

"This door is reasonably sturdy; it should hold out for a while longer," Shang Feifan judged, giving the heavy gate a pat.

To ease the awkwardness, Hu Bushuai chimed in, "Let's hope the monsters outside disperse before the door gives out."

Shang Feifan suddenly pressed close against the heavy gate, as if listening intently for something.

However, he wasn't listening; rather, he could perceive that instead of decreasing, the monsters outside the gate were actually growing in number by the moment.

He sensed massive amounts of insect poison, alongside a peculiar energy that only dissipated when monsters perished.

Why would they attract so many monsters?

These mutated corpse monsters lacked sapience and, naturally, had no commander. They all acted independently; while they would swarm in a frenzy upon discovering prey, they would gradually scatter once the prey vanished.

Shang Feifan even projected his resentment energy outward, enveloping both himself and Hu Bushuai, yet the monsters outside still refused to disperse, continuing to scratch and scrape against the gate.

Had the resentment energy barrier failed?

Or was there some other reason?

*Ding-dong.*

[Notice! During the physique upgrade process, the energy of the Broodmother's heart fragment leaked outward, attracting a large number of corpse-mutants infected with insect poison. Please eliminate as many of these corpse-mutants as possible and collect the energy dissipated from their remains. For every five monsters below Level 30 killed, you will be rewarded with one contribution point. For Level 30 and above, one point per kill. If over one hundred are eliminated in a single sweep, an extra set of discounted Game Mall equipment will be rewarded.]

So this was why the monsters hadn't left? But what caught Shang Feifan's attention wasn't the leakage of the Broodmother's heart fragment power; it was the drastically reduced efficiency of monster-grinding. Killing one used to earn a point, but now it took five kills to get a single point.

As for the discounted equipment?

Since it was already on clearance, could it possibly be any good?

"Is the power still leaking?" Shang Feifan asked softly.

Hu Bushuai looked up at him.

Shang Feifan's phrasing didn't sound like he was asking him.

The system gave no reply.

From the phrase "during the physique upgrade process," Shang Feifan could only deduce that he should no longer be leaking the energy of the Broodmother's heart fragment.

In other words, if he were to re-wrap himself and Bushuai in resentment energy, there was a high probability the monsters would ignore them once more, making it convenient for them to slip away from the monster horde.

Right now, these monsters weren't actually hunting them down; rather, they had been lured by the Broodmother's heart energy he had leaked all along the way.

However, with so many monsters gathered outside, coupled with the system's rewards, leaving just like that seemed a bit of a waste. Discounted equipment was still equipment, after all; if he could get his hands on it, why not?

"This is a bit troublesome. It seems we've gotten ourselves into a mess," Shang Feifan didn't conceal it, sharing his perception with Bushuai.

Bushuai planted his four paws firmly on the ground. "How many monsters can your spell array sacrifice?"

Synchronized with his train of thought, Shang Feifan was already eyeing the warehouse, intending to set up a large-scale spell array inside.

There was a catch here, however: when the monsters charged into the warehouse, there would inevitably be a time lag as they poured in one after another.

If he failed to trigger the spell array in time, the monsters that rushed in first would come face-to-face with them.

Yet if he triggered the spell array the exact second the monsters broke through, it wouldn't stop the ones trailing behind.

Therefore...

He needed to set up a three-stage array.

chunks.chineseText:
第69章 突破限定值

地下仓库的炼金大门发出刺耳的嘎吱声。

噗呲！

门破了，一只尖锐利爪刺穿大门。

刺啦，嘎吱——！

刺耳的金属断裂声响起，大门愣是被暴力撕开一角。

怪物们的脑袋和爪子争相挤入这个破口。

商非凡抬头看去，这扇大门能支持到现在已经让他很满意。

“不帅！”

“收到。”

两个人并没有站在仓库最里面的角落，而是一边一个站在了大门两边的角落。

这对于整间仓库来说，是两个相对死角。

不帅身上用来掩饰气息的炼金装备冷却时间已过，这时正好激活。

商非凡则用怨气笼罩住自己。

轰隆！

大门被冲开。

怪物们一窝蜂地冲入仓库。

商非凡冷静地看着怪物们冲过第一、第二个咒术阵，等到一批怪物冲到第三个咒术阵上时。

“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯。请接受信徒奉献给您的祭品，诅咒这些进入仓库的尸变怪物们为争夺虫母力量自相残杀。”

最里面的咒术阵迅速发动。

凡是跑到这个咒术阵献祭位的怪物们瞬间变成黑灰。

随即！

冲入仓库的怪物们全都看向了位于仓库最里面的角落。

那里有一个白色的小骨碟，骨碟内有浅浅的一盏鲜血。

就是它！

就是那东西在吸引它们！

得到它！

一定要得到它！

尸变怪物们没有清晰神智，它们全都受到本能吸引，本能告诉它们，只要得到那骨碟里的鲜血，它们就能变得更强大，还能更……

更怎样，它们不知道。它们只知道无论如何都要得到那碟子里的鲜血！

尸变怪物们一般不会自相残杀，它们似乎知道彼此是同类。

可这种情况在这时候结束了。

一只身体强大却略显笨重，宛如大象长了虫翅、前肢和触角的巨大虫兽突然挥舞它的象鼻，卷起跑在它前面的一只尸变怪物，狠狠地砸向墙壁。

厉叫刺穿人耳。

混战，开始了。

仓库里很快就挤满了怪物。

所有怪物都杀红了眼睛。

商非凡和虎不帅不是不想借此机会离开仓库，但堵在仓库门口的怪物更多。

还有源源不绝的怪物从四面八方赶来。

他们谁也不敢保证挤在这些怪物群中真的不会被发现。

尤其是虎不帅，他身上能掩饰气息的炼金装备只能保证他不被普通尸变怪物发现，如果遇到级别特别高的怪物，比如邪神阴影者，那就不能保证了。

商非凡更担心自己身上的汗液沾染在虎不帅身上，让不帅变成了一个散发虫母能量气息的亮闪闪大灯泡。

如果他身上的炼金装备不能遮掩虫母能量怎么办？

事实上，当那些尸变怪物冲入仓库，就有感知比较敏锐的怪物被虎不帅吸引，下意识转头望向他。

这还是他用清水给不帅擦过皮毛后。

幸好仓库里有商非凡特意准备的一小盏鲜血，那鲜血散发的能量更加浓郁，转移了怪物们的注意力。

而且涌进来的怪物太多了，先进来的怪物只能被后面的怪物推挤着往里面冲。就是想要转道扑向虎不帅的怪物也只能被推向最里面。

商非凡很安全，他身上的怨气护罩完美笼罩了他的身体。

他可以用怨气也笼罩住不帅，但非常不幸的是，受伤并携带少许虫毒的不帅对于怨气极度不适，只要怨气笼罩住他，他的伤口就会变成黑色，他本人也感觉到虫毒浓度在提高。

无奈下，商非凡只能让不帅躲在另一边。

“至高伟大的……”

商非凡发动了第二个咒术阵，诅咒内容和第一个完全相同。

等到仓库再次被塞满，他发动了最后一个咒术阵，诅咒内容同样与第一个类似，只是稍微改了一下，变成“诅咒所有摩罗城的尸变怪物为争夺虫母能量自相残杀。”

那个小碟子的鲜血终于被一只怪物给抢到，它迫不及待地连同小碟子一起吞入腹中。

但争夺并没有到此结束。

其他怪物看到鲜血被夺，全都疯狂杀向那只抢到鲜血的怪物。

瞬间，那只抢到鲜血的幸运怪就变成了最倒霉的怪物，它被撕成了碎片。

其他怪物疯抢那怪物的尸体，吞噬。

当部分带有商非凡鲜血的怪物尸体被吞吃，那些尝到好处的怪物们还没有来得及消化这份好处，它们又成了其他怪物的攻击目标。

仓库里满是尸血，但没有尸体，连碎块都没有，全都被怪物们吞吃了。

这些尸变怪物死后的血液变成了黑色，但并没有完全凝固，它们一样在流动，并给这些怪物输送能量。

商非凡硬生生等了足足半个小时。

等到这个仓库里的怪物们已经消化了那一小碟鲜血的能量。

也就是说这些怪物身上的虫母能量已经消失，不再吸引其他怪物。

就在这时，商非凡对虎不帅打了个招呼，灵巧地冲入堵在门外的怪物群中。

他一边冲，一边撒出他事先准备好的鲜血。

这边甩一滴，那边甩一滴。

冲进仓库里的怪物齐齐转头，它们又感觉到了那股让它们渴望至极的能量。

这次这股能量不在仓库里，而是在外面。

也有怪物冲到虎不帅面前。

虎不帅也发现自己身上似乎有什么在吸引这些怪物。

但他还记得商非凡的提醒，没有冒然动手。喷火器就在他手边，他随时可以用爪子按下开关喷出火焰。

怪物们靠近他，但很快就被外面更多的鲜血能量给吸引，全都向仓库外冲去。

虎不帅松了口气。他现在正在拼命和虫毒抵抗，真的不想和这些怪物动手，更不想再受伤。

商非凡一边跑，一边甩自己的鲜血。

随着他的跑动，那些怪物也全都在跟着往拍卖行外面跑。

商非凡发现自己的动作变得灵活许多，还有速度也是。

他尝试着挥舞拳头击飞跑到他面前的一只怪物。

噗嗤！那怪物的脑袋直接就爆浆了。

商非凡：……好爽！

他的力气绝对提升了不止一倍。

商非凡兴奋起来，特别想继续一拳一只怪物。

但他压住了自己的杀怪心，继续按照原计划行事。

只是他的行动路线不再是只在路上跑，他开始一会儿跳上墙壁，沿着墙壁跑上一段。要么就跳上屋顶，在屋顶朝下方的怪物撒下他的血液。

脚尖轻点，跳跃，滑行。

手掌挂住墙角，翻身，在晒衣绳上飞快奔跑。

他甚至把怪物们当做了借力物，踩着它们跑得肆无忌惮。

他现在是掌握了轻功吗？

种种在现实世界无法做出来的动作，他做得挥洒自如。

这才是游戏嘛，爽！

拍卖行里的怪物全都跑了出来。

而这些跑出来的怪物，不少只身上都沾着商非凡的鲜血。

这些怪物又成了后面赶到的怪物们的目标。

商非凡越跑越远。

占到他血液的怪物也越来越多。

大约一百毫升的鲜血终于全部消耗完。

整座摩罗城都乱了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 69: Breaking Through the Limit

The alchemical iron gate of the underground warehouse emitted a harsh, screeching creak.

*Squelch!*

The door breached, a sharp claw piercing right through the metal.

*Rip, screech—!*

A jarring sound of tearing metal rang out as a corner of the door was violently ripped open.

Monsters scrambled, thrusting their heads and claws into the breach.

Shang Feifan looked up; the fact that this door had held out until now already left him quite satisfied.

"Bushuai!"

"Received."

The two of them hadn't stationed themselves in the deepest corner of the warehouse; instead, they stood on opposite sides, tucked into the blind spots flanking the heavy gate.

For the entire expanse of the warehouse, these were the two relative dead zones.

The cooldown period for the alchemical gear Hu Bushuai used to mask his aura had expired, and he activated it right on cue.

Shang Feifan, meanwhile, enveloped himself entirely in resentment energy.

*Boom!*

The gates were smashed wide open.

Monsters surged into the warehouse in a chaotic swarm.

Shang Feifan watched calmly as the monsters rushed past the first and second spell arrays, waiting until a wave of beasts surged onto the third spell array.

"O Supreme and Magnificent Existence, God of Curses, Konizeus. Please accept the tribute offered by your devotee, and curse these corpse-mutants entering the warehouse to slaughter each other for the Broodmother's power."

The innermost spell array activated instantly.

Every single monster that had run onto this spell array's sacrificial zone turned into black ash in a split second.

Immediately following that!

All the monsters that had breached the warehouse turned their gazes toward the corner at the very back.

There sat a small white bone saucer, containing a shallow pool of fresh blood.

It was right there!

That was the thing luring them!

Get it!

They had to get it!

The mutated corpse monsters possessed no clear sapience; they were driven entirely by instinct—an instinct telling them that as long as they acquired the fresh blood in that bone saucer, they would grow stronger and even...

Even how, they didn't know. They only knew they had to get their claws on that dish of fresh blood no matter what!

Mutated corpse monsters rarely slaughtered each other, seemingly recognizing one another as kin.

Yet that tacit understanding ended right then and there.

A massive insect-beast—possessing a powerful yet somewhat clumsy physique, resembling an elephant endowed with insect wings, front legs, and tentacles—suddenly swung its trunk, swept up a corpse-mutant running ahead of it, and slammed it ferociously against the wall.

A piercing screech tore through their eardrums.

The melee had begun.

The warehouse was soon packed to the brim with monsters.

Every single beast had its eyes stained crimson with bloodlust.

It wasn't that Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai didn't want to seize this opportunity to slip out of the warehouse, but the monsters blocking the exit were simply too dense.

Moreover, a continuous stream of monsters kept rushing in from all directions.

Neither of them dared guarantee they wouldn't be spotted if they squeezed through that horde of beasts.

Especially Hu Bushuai; the alchemical gear masking his aura could only ensure he remained undetected by ordinary corpse-mutants. If he ran into a particularly high-tier monster, such as a Shadow of the Evil God, there were no guarantees.

Shang Feifan was even more worried that sweat from his own body might rub off on Hu Bushuai, turning the tiger into a glowing neon beacon radiating the Broodmother's energy aura.

What if his alchemical equipment failed to mask the Broodmother's energy?

In fact, the moment those corpse-mutants charged into the warehouse, several beasts with sharper perception caught Hu Bushuai's scent and instinctively snapped their heads in his direction.

And this was *after* he had scrubbed the tiger's fur clean with pure water.

Fortunately, there was that small dish of fresh blood Shang Feifan had intentionally prepared in the warehouse; its energy radiated far more intensely, successfully hijacking the monsters' attention.

Besides, too many monsters had flooded in, forcing the ones that entered first to be shoved deeper inside by the tide pressing up from behind. Even the beasts trying to veer off and pounce on Hu Bushuai were inevitably pushed toward the back.

Shang Feifan was entirely safe; the resentment energy barrier wrapping around his body shrouded him to perfection.

He could have used the resentment energy to shield Bushuai as well, but very unluckily, Bushuai—who was already injured and carrying a trace of insect poison—reacted with extreme aversion to the resentment energy. The moment the dark fog draped over him, his wounds turned black, and he could vividly feel the concentration of insect poison rising within him.

Left with no choice, Shang Feifan could only have Bushuai hide on the opposite side.

"O Supreme and Magnificent..."

Shang Feifan triggered the second spell array, the incantation entirely identical to the first.

Once the warehouse was packed to capacity once more, he activated the final spell array. The incantation was similarly structured to the first, with a slight tweak: "Curse all corpse-mutants in Mola City to slaughter each other in the scramble for the Broodmother's energy."

The blood in the small saucer was finally snatched up by a monster, which impatiently swallowed it down whole, dish and all.

Yet the scramble was far from over.

Seeing the blood snatched away, the rest of the monsters went berserk, pouncing savagely upon the lucky beast that had claimed it.

In an instant, the fortunate monster went from the luckiest to the most tragic, ripped mercilessly to shreds.

Other monsters frantically scrambled over the corpse, tearing and devouring it.

As fractions of the monster carcasses tainted with Shang Feifan's blood were ingested, those beasts that tasted the sweet nectar hadn't even had time to digest the benefits before becoming targets for the next wave of attackers.

The warehouse was drenched in gore and blood, yet not a single whole corpse remained—not even fragments, as everything was devoured clean by the ravenous monsters.

The blood of these mutated corpse-mutants had turned black upon death, but it hadn't completely coagulated; it continued to flow, pumping energy back into the surviving beasts.

Shang Feifan waited it out stoically for a full half-hour.

Until the monsters inside the warehouse had fully digested the energy from that little dish of fresh blood.

Which meant the Broodmother's energy on these creatures had dissipated, ceasing to lure other monsters.

At that precise moment, Shang Feifan gave Hu Bushuai a hand signal and nimbly charged straight into the cluster of monsters blocking the exit.

As he ran, he scattered the fresh blood he had prepared beforehand.

A drop flicked here, a drop flicked there.

The monsters crammed inside the warehouse whipped their heads around in unison; they sensed that agonizingly intoxicating energy once more.

Only this time, the energy wasn't inside the warehouse—it was outside.

A few monsters approached Hu Bushuai as well.

Bushuai could sense that something on his body was drawing the monsters' attention.

Yet, he remembered Shang Feifan's warning and refrained from acting rashly. The flamethrower rested right beside his paw; he could hit the trigger and unleash a torrent of fire at a moment's notice.

The monsters drew close, but were quickly drawn away by the heavier concentration of blood energy outside, stampeding out of the warehouse en masse.

Hu Bushuai let out a breath of relief. He was currently fighting a desperate battle against the insect poison within him; he really didn't want to trade blows with these monsters, nor did he wish to sustain any more injuries.

Shang Feifan ran and flicked his blood simultaneously.

As he sprinted, the entire horde of monsters trailed after him, stampeding out of the auction house.

Shang Feifan noticed his movements had become vastly more agile, his speed skyrocketing.

He tested the waters by throwing a punch, launching it at a monster that had dashed right in front of him.

*Squelch!* The creature's head exploded like an overripe melon.

Shang Feifan: *...Damn, that feels good!*

His physical strength had definitely increased by more than fold.

Ignited with excitement, Shang Feifan felt a strong urge to keep up the one-punch-per-monster routine.

Yet he reined in his bloodlust, sticking strictly to his original plan.

Only this time, his route wasn't confined to running along the street level; he began leaping onto walls, sprinting along them for a stretch, or vaulting onto rooftops to scatter his blood down upon the monsters milling below.

Light toes tapping, vaulting, gliding.

Hooking a hand over a wall corner, flipping over, sprinting rapidly across a row of clotheslines.

He even used the monsters themselves as stepping stones, bouncing off them with total impunity.

Had he mastered some sort of *Qinggong* martial arts technique now?

He was executing movements with fluid ease that would be entirely impossible in the real world.

Now *this* was gaming—pure adrenaline!

Every single monster inside the auction house had poured outside.

And among those fleeing beasts, quite a few had Shang Feifan's fresh blood smeared across their hides.

These blood-marked monsters naturally became targets for the newly arriving reinforcement wave.

Shang Feifan ran further and further away.

More and more monsters were tainted with his blood.

The roughly one hundred milliliters of fresh blood was finally exhausted entirely.

The entirety of Mola City was thrown into utter chaos.

chunks.chineseText:
原本相安无事的怪物们全都在互相追逐、厮杀、吞噬。

商非凡飞速返回拍卖行。

看到从里面走出来的白虎。

为了让伤口更快愈合，白虎的身体保持在平时的正常状态。

白虎嘴里还叼着重新加满虫油的喷火器。

商非凡接过喷火器。

“我们换个地方。”

这个地下安全屋肯定不能待了。

之前看中它就因为它有一扇坚固的炼金大门，现在大门已经被破坏。地下仓库又没有第二个通道，一旦被堵住，就会变成瓮中捉鳖。

何况那仓库里现在满是怪物的黑血，全是虫毒，对身上有伤口的不帅太不利。

一人一虎避着那些尸变怪物在大街小巷里穿梭，奔向他们看好的第二个安全屋，钟塔。

这里是摩罗城的最高处，城卫军的警戒塔，一只巨大的炼金钟就悬挂在塔楼的最高处。

这只钟每次被敲响，都表示城中发生了大事。

警钟经过炼制，声音非常响亮，可以确保城中任何一个角落都能听到，就连-城外千米范围内也能隐约听到。

这里无法遮掩他们身上的气息，但现在城里的怪物压根顾不上他们。

两人就坐在钟楼里，靠在半人高的墙壁上休息。

刚才他们是没有和怪物们厮杀，但处在那种环境中，紧绷的神经就足够让他们疲累。

虎不帅还在和身体内的虫毒抵抗，因为商非凡尝试用怨气笼罩他，搞得原本被他压制的虫毒变得特别活跃。

但这事……虎不帅能责怪商非凡吗？

商非凡靠近不帅，“你怎样？很难受吗？”

虎不帅不太想说话，但他又不想商非凡自责，就勉强开口：“没事，等过一会儿就好。”

商非凡看白虎脸色……这比看人的脸色难多了，但他还是看出来不帅很不舒服。

他也不觉得不帅真的会过一会儿就好，他们在走来钟塔的路上，不帅就走得很慢，似乎怕奔跑会让伤势加重。

也许不是怕伤势加重，而是担心血流过快，会让虫毒更快发作？

怎么才能剔除不帅身体内的虫毒？

商非凡没有埋怨自己，脑子飞速思考如何解决问题。

叮咚。

【任务六十一完成。直接以及间接地一次性消灭了一百只以上尸变体，获得奖励游戏商城的特价装备一套。详细请打开游戏商城查看。贡献点数持续计算……】

【任务三完成。获得奖励贡献点5点。】

【任务九完成。获得奖励贡献点3点。】

商非凡都快忘了任务三和任务九的内容，就查看了下，发现就是帮助那名被杀死的虫人混血也就是真正的诺曼霍希尔找到杀死他的凶手，以及诅咒他自己的人。

他以为这两个任务早就结算了，没想到直到现在才给他结算。

那个杀死真诺曼霍希尔以及诅咒他的咒术师卢希恩尸体都已经化成灰。为什么直到现在才算是任务完成？

商非凡有点想不通，系统也无意跟他解释，他只能先放在一边。

接下来他就顺便查看了自己的个人面板。

贡献点数：总计334点，结余119点。

玩家等级：33级

生命值：3300

能量值：3300

特殊能量值（怨气）：112596（不断上下浮动）

精神力值：133/100

智慧：8.2/10

敏捷值：39/100

力量值和血脉天赋（力大无穷）合并：133/100

血脉天赋（恶咒）：133.9/100

幸运值：0

看完这串数值，商非凡也不禁挑了挑眉。

这还真是大幅度提升。

前面都还正常，敏捷值提升的也不少，但还在正常范围内。

可看看他的精神力值、力量值和血脉天赋，这三个项目的数值竟然超过了游戏设定的满值。

这是什么游戏bug，还是脑载系统给他的特殊加成？

“能解释一下吗？否则我觉得我们很难再合作下去。”商非凡低声说。

白虎的脑袋轻轻动了动。

商非凡说的是华夏语，他在和谁说话？

现在虎不帅越发确定商非凡身上有个随身老爷爷，还是个懂华夏语的。

商非凡以为系统会持续保持沉默，没想到对方竟然回答了。

【特别注释：原游戏系统对玩家身体限定了最高发展值，无法发挥玩家身体的真正实力。经过本系统努力，现已成功接管你的玩家身体，并顺利解除了你这具玩家身体的所有限定，让你的游戏身体可以按照正常程序正常发展。】

商非凡想到了之前升级的一个小时中他感受到的万虫钻心、身体乃至灵魂都被撕裂重组的痛苦感，难道那时就是系统在帮他突破这具游戏身体的限制？

【但请千万注意！一旦你这具身体死亡，你将在原游戏系统的出生池重新出生，那时你的身体也将会是一具崭新的身体，一切都将从头开始，甚至有被原游戏系统察觉，进而销毁你游戏身体的危险。】

“这意思是不是说，我以后不能再轻易死亡？”

系统没有回答，商非凡也不需要它回答，系统在刚才的解释中已经说得足够清楚。

“我现在是完全脱离原游戏系统的管制了吗？”商非凡又低声问。

虎不帅耳朵竖起：游戏系统？！

【是。】

“为什么？”这句问话里包含了很多问题。

这次系统没有再回答他。

哦，不，还是回答了。

【请尽量完成本系统发布的任务。当你完成主线任务后，你会获得一个实现愿望的机会。】

商非凡心中一动，脱口问道：“这个奖励能让我带出一个游戏人物到现实世界么？”

虎不帅强行忍住没有往商非凡那里看。他脑袋再次被商非凡搅成一团浆糊。

游戏？难道他所处的世界是一个游戏世界？

难道他没有穿越，只是在第一世死后，灵魂不巧进入了一个游戏程序中？

不不不，什么样的游戏会如此真实？

不管是法德尔大陆，还是现在的兽人大陆，他过的生活都如此真实。

周围和他相处的人也绝不像是程序编写出来的。

虎不帅强迫自己冷静下来，他不断告诉自己，他所处的世界不可能是一个游戏世界。

如果他不是待在游戏程序里，那商非凡为什么会说游戏系统，还说游戏人物什么的？

另一边，系统给出了回答，但系统的回答却让商非凡很是捉摸不透。

【一切皆有可能。只要不是不切实际的愿望。】

商非凡不爽：“你就不能给一个肯定回复？如果你能让我把不帅带回家，我做任务也会更有动力不是？”

听到全部的虎不帅：“……”

最后，系统答非所问，只给了他一个警告：【小心原游戏系统。】

商非凡：我就知道和病毒合作，肯定会成为游戏开发商的敌人。

他有很多问题想要询问脑载系统，比如脑载系统和笔记本系统是什么关系，和游戏开发商是否敌对，是不是想要借用他来破坏这个游戏世界的平衡等等。
chunks.englishText:
The monsters, which had previously coexisted peacefully, were now frantically chasing, slaughtering, and devouring one another.

Shang Feifan sped back to the auction house.

He saw the white tiger walking out from within.

To help its wounds heal faster, the white虎 kept its physique at its normal, everyday size.

Clenched in the white tiger's jaws was the flamethrower, freshly refilled with insect oil.

Shang Feifan took the flamethrower from him.

"Let's change locations."

This underground safe house was definitely no longer viable.

He had fancied it earlier purely because of its sturdy alchemical iron gate, but now the gate had been smashed to pieces. Furthermore, the underground warehouse had no secondary exit; once blocked off, they would be trapped like turtles in a jar.

Besides, the warehouse was currently swimming in the black blood of monsters—pure insect poison—which was disastrously detrimental to Bushuai, who still had open wounds.

Avoiding the mutated corpse-mutants, the man and the tiger threaded through the alleys, sprinting toward their second choice of safe house: the Bell Tower.

This was the highest point in Mola City, serving as the City Guard's watchtower. A massive alchemical bell hung suspended at the very apex of the tower.

Every time this bell was struck, it signaled that a major crisis had befell the city.

The warning bell had been specially crafted, producing an intensely resonant chime guaranteed to reach every corner of the city, and carrying faintly even within a kilometer outside the city walls.

Here, they couldn't mask their auras, but the monsters in the city were currently far too distracted to pay them any mind.

The two of them simply sat inside the bell tower, resting against the waist-high parapet wall.

They hadn't engaged in direct combat with the monsters just yet, but merely existing in that environment for so long strained their nerves enough to exhaust them completely.

Hu Bushuai was still locked in a struggle against the insect poison inside his body, especially since Shang Feifan's attempt to wrap him in resentment energy had thoroughly provoked the dormant toxins he had previously suppressed.

Yet... could Bushuai blame Shang Feifan for this?

Shang Feifan leaned closer to Bushuai. "How are you holding up? Is it agonizing?"

Bushuai wasn't in the mood to talk, but reluctant to let Shang Feifan worry, he forced out a response: "I'm fine. Give it a little while, it'll pass."

Shang Feifan looked at the white tiger's expression—reading a beast's face was far harder than reading a human's, but he could still tell that Bushuai was in agony.

He didn't really believe Bushuai would be fine in a little while; on their trek to the bell tower, Bushuai had walked sluggishly, as if afraid that running would aggravate his injuries.

Perhaps it wasn't the injuries he feared aggravating, but rather that a faster pulse would cause the insect poison to flare up more rapidly?

How on earth could they purge the insect poison from Bushuai's body?

Without wallowing in self-pity, Shang Feifan's brain raced, churning out solutions.

*Ding-dong.*

[Mission Sixty-One completed. Directly and indirectly eliminated over a hundred corpse-mutants in a single sweep. Reward obtained: A set of discounted Game Mall equipment. Please open the Game Mall to view details. Contribution points are being continuously calculated...]

[Mission Three completed. Reward obtained: 5 contribution points.]

[Mission Nine completed. Reward obtained: 3 contribution points.]

Shang Feifan had almost forgotten what Missions Three and Nine even entailed. A quick mental check revealed they were about helping the murdered insect-human hybrid—the real Norman Hosier—find his killer, as well as the person who had cursed him.

He had assumed those two missions were settled ages ago, never expecting them to officially clear only now.

The corpse of Lucian, the spellcaster who had murdered the real Norman Hosier and cursed him, had long since been reduced to ashes. Why was the mission only registered as complete now?

Shang Feifan couldn't quite wrap his head around it, and the system showed no inclination to explain, so he simply set the thought aside for the moment.

Next, he casually brought up his personal status panel.

Contribution Points: Total 334 points, Balance 119 points.

Player Level: Level 33

HP: 3300

Energy Value: 3300

Special Energy Value (Resentment): 112,596 (fluctuating up and down continuously)

Mental Strength: 133/100

Intellect: 8.2/10

Agility: 39/100

Strength Value merged with Bloodline Talent (Superhuman Strength): 133/100

Bloodline Talent (Malevolent Curse): 133.9/100

Luck: 0

Scanning this string of stats, even Shang Feifan couldn't help raising an eyebrow.

This was genuinely a massive leap.

The preceding stats were relatively normal, and while Agility had increased significantly, it still fell within normal parameters.

Yet look at his Mental Strength, Strength, and Bloodline Talents—the values for these three categories actually exceeded the maximum caps set by the game.

Was this some kind of game bug, or a special stat bonus granted by the neural-load system?

"Care to explain? Otherwise, I feel like it's going to be pretty hard for us to keep working together," Shang Feifan said in a low voice.

The white tiger's head twitched slightly.

Shang Feifan was speaking in Chinese—who was he talking to?

Hu Bushuai was now increasingly certain that Shang Feifan had some sort of portable old grandfather entity residing within him, and one who understood Chinese at that.

Expecting the system to maintain its silent streak, Shang Feifan was surprised when it actually answered.

[Special Note: The original game system imposed strict upper development limits on the player's physique, preventing them from unleashing their true combat prowess. Through the efforts of this system, your player vessel has now been successfully taken over, and all restrictions on this player body have been smoothly lifted, allowing your in-game physique to develop normally according to standard progression.]

Shang Feifan recalled the hour-long evolution process where he felt as though ten thousand insects were gnawing at his heart, his very body and soul torn apart and reassembled. Was that when the system was helping him smash through the limitations of this game vessel?

[However, please take utmost note! Once this body dies, you will respawn at the original game system's birth pool. At that time, your body will revert to a brand-new vessel, and everything will start over from scratch, with the added danger of being detected by the original game system and having your game body purged.]

"Does that mean I can't afford to die casually anymore from now on?"

The system gave no reply, nor did Shang Feifan need one; the explanation just now was more than clear enough.

"Am I now completely detached from the original game system's control?" Shang Feifan asked again in a low voice.

Hu Bushuai's ears pricked up: *Game system?!*

[Yes.]

"Why?" This single question packed a multitude of implications.

This time, the system stayed silent.

Ah, no—it answered after all.

[Please endeavor to complete the missions issued by this system. Once you complete the main questline, you will be granted an opportunity to make a wish come true.]

A thought stirred in Shang Feifan's chest, and he blurted out, "Can this reward let me bring an in-game character out into the real world?"

Hu Bushuai forcefully restrained himself from glancing over at Shang Feifan. His brain was once again being scrambled into mush by Shang Feifan's words.

A game? Could the world he inhabited actually be a game world?

Had he not transmigrated after all, but rather had his soul unfortunately stumble into a gaming program upon his death in his first life?

No, no—what kind of game could be this terrifyingly real?

Whether it was the Fader Continent or the current Beastman Continent, the life he lived felt profoundly genuine.

The people he interacted with around him bore no resemblance whatsoever to scripted programs.

Hu Bushuai forced himself to calm down, repeatedly telling himself that the world he lived in could not possibly be a game world.

If he wasn't trapped inside a gaming program, then why on earth was Shang Feifan babbling about game systems and game characters?

On the other end, the system delivered its response, though its wording left Shang Feifan thoroughly baffled.

[Everything is possible. So long as it is not an unrealistic wish.]

Shang Feifan was unimpressed. "Can't you give me a straight answer? If you let me bring Bushuai home, I'd have a lot more motivation to grind your missions, wouldn't I?"

Hu Bushuai, having heard every single word: "..."

Ultimately, dodging the question entirely, the system left him with only a single warning: [Beware of the original game system.]

Shang Feifan: *I knew it. Teaming up with a virus definitely makes you public enemy number one to the game developers.*

He had a mountain of questions he wanted to throw at the neural-load system—such as the relationship between the neural-load system and the laptop system, whether they were enemies with the game developers, and if they were trying to use him to upend the balance of this gaming world.

chunks.chineseText:
但他的直觉告诉他，就算他把这些问题问出来，脑载系统也不会回答他。

“以后不准再控制我的身体，更不能控制我的思维，除非我同意。否则我不知道自己还会不会上游戏。”商非凡平淡地威胁。

【可以。特注：你的思维无法控制，你的精神力足够强大，意志力更坚韧异常，这也是你被选择被培养的原因。】

商非凡没想到系统竟然解开了他目前的最大一个疑惑。

这个解释感觉就在说，他天生反骨，遇到这种事不会害怕，反而会主动跟着一起搞破坏。

但随后，他就轻轻叹了口气。

能突破原游戏系统限定的数值是很爽，但这就相当于不能再随便死亡。也不知道他这到底是算赚了，还是亏了。

商非凡打开游戏商城，特地瞄了眼天赋技能【不死之身】，他之前就馋这个技能，但因为要一千个贡献点，只能看着流口水。

但现在，这个天赋技能将成为他的绝对目标，接下来他要好好存贡献点，争取早日买到这个天赋技能。

不知道把这一座城的怪物全部杀完，能不能累积到一千贡献点？

对了，还有系统奖励的特价装备。

特价装备很好找，都在装备一栏，且都被排到最前列，一个个冒出金光，就生怕商非凡看不到一样。

商非凡没急着看特价装备，他在看药品。

他和不帅在摩罗城中收集到的药物都是普通药物，没有能抵抗虫毒的。

实际上兽人世界似乎就没有能真正消灭虫毒的药物出现。

药品太多，商非凡在搜索栏输入虫毒一词。

很快，搜索结果出来。

与虫毒有关的药物还不少。

商非凡挨个看注释。

找到了！

【虫毒消融药剂。可以消除活着的生物体内的虫毒，已经死亡后的感染体无法救治。注意：本药剂对于生物身体有一定伤害，体质偏弱者不适合使用。售价99点贡献点。】
chunks.englishText:
Yet his intuition told him that even if he voiced these questions, the neural-load system wouldn't grace him with an answer.

"From now on, you are forbidden from controlling my body, let alone my mind, unless I give consent. Otherwise, I can't guarantee whether I'll bother logging onto the game again," Shang Feifan issued a flat threat.

[Understood. Special Note: Your mind cannot be controlled; your mental strength is sufficiently formidable, and your willpower is exceptionally resilient—this is precisely why you were chosen and cultivated.]

Shang Feifan hadn't expected the system to unspool one of his biggest current riddles just like that.

That explanation essentially boiled down to: he was naturally rebellious by nature, someone who wouldn't panic when facing bizarre phenomena, but would instead actively join in to stir up trouble.

Yet a second later, he let out a soft sigh.

Breaking past the stat caps imposed by the original game system felt incredible, but it essentially meant he could no longer afford to die recklessly. He honestly couldn't tell whether he had come out ahead or taken a massive loss on this deal.

Shang Feifan opened the Game Mall, specifically glancing at the talent skill [Undying Body]. He had been drooling over this skill for ages, but was forced to just stare and swallow his envy because it cost a thousand contribution points.

Now, however, this talent skill would become his absolute objective; he needed to fiercely hoard contribution points so he could buy it at the earliest possible date.

Wondering if slaughtering every last monster in this city would net him a thousand contribution points?

Right, there was also the discounted equipment rewarded by the system.

The discounted items were easy to find, all listed under the equipment tab and shoved right to the very front, radiating golden glows as if terrified Shang Feifan wouldn't notice them.

Shang Feifan didn't rush to check out the discounted gear; instead, he opened the medicine category.

The potions he and Bushuai had scavenged across Mola City were all mundane medicines incapable of resisting insect poison.

In truth, the beastman world didn't seem to possess any remedies capable of truly eradicating insect poison.

With medicines cluttering the interface, Shang Feifan typed the keyword "insect poison" into the search bar.

A moment later, search results populated.

The pharmaceuticals related to insect poison were surprisingly numerous.

Shang Feifan browsed the descriptions one by one.

Found it!

[Insect Poison Dissolution Potion. Capable of purging insect poison from living biological entities; infected entities that have already died cannot be saved. Note: This potion inflicts a certain degree of damage to a living body; individuals with frail physiques are unsuited for its use. Price: 99 contribution points.]

chunks.chapterTitle: 第70章 都很迫不及待 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第70章 都很迫不及待

商非凡没有丝毫犹豫就点击购买了这瓶虫毒消融药剂。

他也想要药效更好的。

但他把所有与虫毒相关的药剂都看过，只有这一瓶对症，他想买更好的都没有。

商非凡就坐在白虎身边，拿到药剂，就示意不帅张口。

“什么东西？”

“可以消融虫毒的药剂。可能会让你有点痛苦。”

“你有治疗……消灭虫毒的药剂？”白虎支撑起四肢，改为蹲坐，两眼圆溜溜地瞪视着商非凡。

“你知不知道从虫毒出现开始，就没有任何一种有效方法可以消除虫毒。”虎不帅加重语气。

商非凡听不帅说过，也知道拿出这瓶药剂必然会让其怀疑，但比起不帅的身体，其他什么都不是。

“别问我这是从哪里来的。反正有效。”

虎不帅并不怀疑商非凡会害他，他只是想让他明白这瓶药剂的重要性。

“这种药剂能复制吗？”

“应该能吧。”

闻言，虎不帅精神一振，但有一点他必须问清楚：“你弄到这药剂是不是付出了很大代价？”

如果商非凡黑心一点，他一定会点头，让不帅歉疚、欠他人情，然后趁机攻克他的心。

但老商追人有他的准则，于是他就摇摇头，轻描淡写地说：“还好。”

虎不帅定定地看他。

他不想欠人情，不管对方是谁。

商非凡一看白虎表情就知道他在想什么。

“你不会想要拒绝吧？也别说什么让我留着以后用的话。你现在虫毒不解，就行动不便，也无法配合我消灭这座城市里的怪物，反而会成为我的拖累。我想你应该不是那种为了自己的自尊，故意拖后腿让别人去死的人吧？”

虎不帅：“……”

商非凡拧开瓶盖：“张口。”

白虎张开嘴巴。

这才乖嘛，商非凡把药剂倒入白虎口中。他最擅长搞定不帅这种死脑筋的人了。

虎不帅咽下药剂，闭眼等待药剂起作用。

商非凡也有点紧张，这药剂说明可是说了会伤身，他只能两相其害取其轻，先对付虫毒，然后再根据不帅的身体反应给他准备其他补身药剂。

叮咚。

老伏给他发来了信件。

商非凡分神查看，顺手打开。

老伏：你名字怎么变成灰色了？你还在游戏中吧，看到了回一声，必须！

商非凡回复前先低声询问系统：“我现在还能看到和使用原游戏系统的功能？如果有人联系我，我回复，会不会被原游戏系统察觉？”

这次脑载系统没有沉默，而是秒回：【已兼容原游戏系统全部功能，包括今后的更新内容。你的操作不会被原游戏系统查知。是否开通特定人物联系保密功能，开通需消耗一点贡献点。】

商非凡当然选择了开通，并选定特定人物为老伏。

【保密通讯开通成功。请把以下链接发给特定人选，让对方点击下载。】

商非凡看到那个链接，对脑载系统忽然有了新的认识。

伏向军那边收到商非凡回信。就见信中除了两句话，还有一个戴着眼罩的小骷髅头图标。附带一个只有他们彼此知道的用来确定对方身份的密码。

商非凡：点击骷髅头。不管发生什么，不要问不要惊讶。237*%￥@aeii899。

伏向军看到密码就放心了，没有多犹豫就点击了那个小骷髅头。

瞬间，他的通讯页面就变成了雪花，不到三秒又恢复正常。

伏向军翻看通讯页面，貌似一切正常，除了“你皇退休了”这个名字变成了一个戴眼罩的小骷髅头图标。

再看他之前发给你皇退休了的信件内容，也全都变成了乱码。

伏向军尝试点击小骷髅头，再次发信：你那边能看到玩家等级排行榜吗？你的名字在最上面，但大约一个小时前你的名字变成了灰色，当时我没注意，还是别人告诉我。现在大家都在热议你的事，你怎么会一口气升到了33级？还有，这个游戏只有下线和死亡，玩家名字才会变成灰色。所以你现在到底是什么状况？

商非凡回信：换了个老板，我现在在给病毒打工。不要向任何人透露你认识我的事。

老伏：你他妈别玩脱了！我和你的通讯安全吗？

商非凡：安全。线下详聊，回见。

伏向军头大无比，就玩一个游戏竟然玩出了碟中谍的惊心动魄感。虽然还是他主动上报这个游戏，觉得这个游戏不普通，就是商非凡也是被他引入这个游戏，但他当时是真的没有想到会发展成现在这样。

算了，他就是个兵，费那么多脑细胞干什么？就让他老大去搞事吧，他只要听命行事就好。

商非凡打开玩家等级排行榜瞅了眼。

他的玩家名字果然变成了灰色，排在了第一个。

商非凡没在意，却不知道玩家们看着他的玩家名闹腾成了什么样。

现在游戏论坛上“你皇退休了”这个名字出现率贼高，许多玩家都在询问有没有谁见过这个玩家。

结果竟然没有一个人认识。

越是没有人说见过你皇退休了，你皇这个人就越神秘，尤其他的玩家名还这么碉。

“举报挂逼！”

“你皇升级不正常！”

“你皇打破游戏平衡！狗策划出来说清楚，这个你皇是不是你们的人？”

“为什么到现在都没有人出面说明这个你皇是怎么回事？他为什么会升级这么快？别人辛辛苦苦三四个月才升到十二级。他呢？三天就从十二级升到了三十三级！我不服，狗策划再不出来解释，我就要闹了！”

谁也不知道，游戏策划这时也在盯着你皇这个名字，眼中满是震惊。

他明明彻底删除了这个游戏账号。

彻底删除是什么意思？

就是这个游戏账号和这个游戏人物就跟从来没有出现过一样，会从“游戏世界”彻底消失。

甚至就连他寄给那个玩家的游戏头盔也会跟着自毁。

可现在这个玩家账号就跟顽固的污迹一样，死死巴在玩家等级排行榜的顶端。他的名字是变成灰色没错，但他没有彻底消失啊！

这是怎么回事？

游戏策划再次寻找起这个账号，想要把问题根源找出来。

但无论他怎么查，游戏系统中都是查无此人。

他收到的反馈也告诉他，你皇的游戏头盔已经自毁。

所以为什么会删除不干净？

这家伙简直就像是潜伏最深的流氓软件，不管你怎么删除，它都会留下一点痕迹，只要你稍微不注意，它就会悄悄在你的程序中死灰复燃。

遇到这种流氓软件，除了重装系统，似乎就没办法彻底搞定它，特别让人抓狂。

游戏策划的心态还算稳，没有因为这么一点小事就陷入抓狂状态，但……真的很让人不爽啊。

游戏策划用尽了所有他能使用的方法，可你皇那个名字还是挂在排行榜上，动都没动一下。

游戏策划深吸一口气，平静自己冒火的心情，再次把你皇的申请资料翻找出来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 70: Everyone is Impatient (Part 1)

Shang Feifan did not hesitate for a single second before clicking to purchase this bottle of Insect Venom Dissolving Potion.

He had wanted one with even better efficacy.

However, he had looked through every single potion related to insect venom, and only this bottle matched the symptoms. Even if he wanted to buy a better one, there simply wasn't one.

Shang Feifan sat right beside the white tiger. Once he obtained the potion, he gestured for Bushuai to open his mouth.

"What is that?"

"A potion that can dissolve insect venom. It might cause you a bit of pain."

"You have a potion to treat... to eradicate insect venom?" The white tiger pushed himself up on his four limbs, shifting into a squatting posture, his round eyes staring wide at Shang Feifan.

"Do you have any idea that since insect venom first appeared, there has never been a single effective method to eliminate it?" Hu Bushuai emphasized, his tone heavy.

Shang Feifan had heard Bushuai mention this before, and he knew that bringing out this potion would inevitably arouse suspicion. But compared to Bushuai's body, nothing else mattered.

"Don't ask me where it came from. It works, that's all."

Hu Bushuai did not doubt that Shang Feifan would harm him; he just wanted him to understand the sheer importance of this potion.

"Can this potion be replicated?"

"It should be possible."

Hearing this, Hu Bushuai's spirits lifted, but there was one thing he had to ask clearly: "Did you pay a massive price to get this potion?"

If Shang Feifan were a bit more black-hearted, he would definitely nod, making Bushuai feel guilty and indebted, and then take the opportunity to conquer his heart.

But Old Shang had his own principles when pursuing someone. So he shook his head and said nonchalantly, "It was alright."

Hu Bushuai stared at him intently.

He did not want to owe favors, no matter who the other party was.

Shang Feifan knew exactly what the white tiger was thinking just by looking at his expression.

"You're not thinking of refusing, are you? And don't give me any of that 'save it for yourself to use later' nonsense. If your insect venom isn't cured, your movement will be impaired, and you won't be able to cooperate with me to eliminate the monsters in this city. Instead, you'll become a drag on me. I don't think you're the kind of person who would deliberately drag others down to their deaths just for your own pride, right?"

Hu Bushuai: "..."

Shang Feifan unscrewed the bottle cap: "Open up."

The white tiger opened his mouth.

*That's a good boy.* Shang Feifan poured the potion into the white tiger's mouth. He was best at handling stubborn, rigid-minded people like Bushuai.

Hu Bushuai swallowed the potion and closed his eyes, waiting for it to take effect.

Shang Feifan was also a bit nervous. The potion's description did say it would harm the body. He could only choose the lesser of two evils—deal with the insect venom first, and then prepare other nourishing potions based on Bushuai's physical reaction.

*Ding-dong.*

Old Fu sent him a message.

Shang Feifan distracted himself to check and casually opened it.

Old Fu: *Why has your name turned gray? You're still in the game, right? If you see this, reply. Must!*

Before replying, Shang Feifan asked the system in a low voice, "Can I still see and use the functions of the original game system? If someone contacts me and I reply, will it be detected by the original game system?"

This time, the brain-hosted system did not stay silent. It replied instantly: [All functions of the original game system have been integrated, including future update content. Your operations will not be detected by the original game system. Would you like to activate the confidential communication function for specific individuals? Activating this requires 1 contribution point.]

Of course, Shang Feifan chose to activate it and selected Old Fu as the specific individual.

[Confidential communication activated successfully. Please send the following link to the selected individual and have them click to download.]

Seeing that link, Shang Feifan suddenly had a new understanding of the brain-hosted system.

On Fu Xiangjun's side, he received Shang Feifan's reply. He saw that besides two sentences, there was also a small skull icon wearing an eyepatch. Attached was a password only the two of them knew to confirm each other's identity.

Shang Feifan: *Click the skull. No matter what happens, don't ask and don't be surprised. 237*%￥@aeii899.*

Seeing the password, Fu Xiangjun felt relieved. Without much hesitation, he clicked the little skull.

Instantly, his communication page turned into static, returning to normal in less than three seconds.

Fu Xiangjun flipped through the communication page. Everything seemed normal, except that the name "Your Emperor Has Retired" had turned into a small skull icon wearing an eyepatch.

Looking at the contents of the messages he had previously sent to "Your Emperor Has Retired," they had all turned into garbled code.

Fu Xiangjun tried clicking the little skull and sent another message: *Can you see the player level rankings on your end? Your name is at the very top, but about an hour ago, your name turned gray. I didn't notice at the time, someone else told me. Now everyone is heatedly discussing your situation. How did you jump to level 33 all at once? Also, in this game, a player's name only turns gray when they log off or die. So what exactly is your situation right now?*

Shang Feifan replied: *Changed bosses. I'm working for the virus now. Don't reveal to anyone that you know me.*

Old Fu: *Don't fucking play yourself! Is our communication secure?*

Shang Feifan: *Secure. We'll talk in detail offline. See ya.*

Fu Xiangjun's head throbbed. Just playing a game had somehow turned into a thrilling, suspenseful double-agent movie. Although he was the one who had actively reported this game, feeling it was unusual, and he was the one who had introduced Shang Feifan to it, he really hadn't expected things to develop to this point.

Whatever, he was just a soldier. Why waste so many brain cells? Let his boss do the scheming; he just had to follow orders.

Shang Feifan opened the player level rankings and took a look.

Sure enough, his player name had turned gray, sitting at the very top.

Shang Feifan didn't care, but he had no idea what a massive uproar the players were making over his name.

On the game forums, the name "Your Emperor Has Retired" was appearing at an incredibly high frequency. Many players were asking if anyone had ever seen this player.

As it turned out, not a single person knew him.

The more people said they hadn't seen "Your Emperor Has Retired," the more mysterious this person became, especially since his player name was so badass.

"Report the hacker!"

"Your Emperor's leveling speed is abnormal!"

"Your Emperor is breaking the game balance! Dog developers, come out and explain! Is this 'Your Emperor' one of your own?"

"Why has no one come forward to explain what's going on with this 'Your Emperor'? Why is he leveling up so fast? Others work hard for three or four months just to reach level 12. What about him? He went from level 12 to level 33 in three days! I'm not convinced! If the dog developers don't come out and explain, I'm going to make a scene!"

No one knew that the game planner was also staring at the name "Your Emperor Has Retired" at this moment, his eyes filled with shock.

He had clearly deleted this game account completely.

What did "completely deleted" mean?

It meant this game account and this game character should have completely vanished from the "game world," as if they had never existed.

Even the game helmet he had mailed to that player should have self-destructed along with it.

Yet now, this player account was like a stubborn stain, clinging tightly to the very top of the player level rankings. His name had turned gray, yes, but he had not completely disappeared!

What was going on?

The game planner searched for this account again, wanting to find the root of the problem.

But no matter how he checked, the game system showed "no such person."

The feedback he received also told him that Your Emperor's game helmet had indeed self-destructed.

So why wasn't it deleted cleanly?

This guy was like the deepest-lurking rogue software. No matter how you deleted it, it would leave a trace. The moment you let your guard down, it would quietly rise from the ashes in your program.

Encountering this kind of rogue software, there seemed to be no way to completely deal with it other than reinstalling the system, which was incredibly frustrating.

The game planner's mindset was still relatively stable; he wouldn't fall into a frenzy over such a small matter, but... it was truly irritating.

The game planner exhausted all the methods he could use, but Your Emperor's name still hung on the rankings, completely unmoved.

The game planner took a deep breath, calming his burning temper, and dug out Your Emperor's application materials once again.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第70章 都很迫不及待 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
他要看看这个人在现实中到底生活在哪里，长什么样，又有什么样的能力。

不过他现在暂时还无法伸手到“现实世界”那边，只是安排一个论坛和给玩家寄送头盔就已经是他对现实世界那边的最大影响。让他直接找上门，和玩家面对面，那就不可能。

但他可以安排那边的人，花钱让人去查探那个玩家底细，如果那个玩家真的有问题，那就花钱解决他！

如此一来，现实货币和游戏币的兑换通道必须加快开通，否则他也没那么多现实货币可以操作。

另外，他也要从游戏这边查找这个玩家。

虽然他无法查出对方在“游戏世界”中的确切坐标，但只看他还在升级，就表明你皇还在兽人大陆活动中。

而兽人大陆目前可以支持低等级玩家快速升级的地方……

游戏策划目光掠过兽人大陆的全景地图，那上面有几个圆形红点。

他一直在实时监测着这几个地方的状况变化。有的地方红点消失，有的地方红点在扩大，还有的地方红点在缩小。

消失表示问题已经被解决。

扩大表示感染者正在增多。

缩小则表示有人正在消灭感染者。

游戏策划点开正在缩小的红点，看到了地名。

摩罗城。

虽然不确定你皇这个玩家就在那里杀怪升级，但在没有其他线索的情况下，不妨先去那里看看。

游戏策划做好决定，闭上眼睛。

不一会儿，神殿出生池里走出一具赤-裸的兽人身体。

他没有走出神殿外，而是向没有人能走入的神殿后方走去。

那里有一个建造于大繁华纪，却已经被人遗忘的多向传送阵。

摩罗城这边，商非凡可不知道游戏策划要亲自来找他了。

但他心里早有准备。因为用膝盖想，游戏开发商也不可能放过他这个bug不处理。

不过他并不担心这点，兵来将挡水来土掩，总有解决的办法。再说脑载系统费这么大事让他脱离原游戏系统，应该也不会眼睁睁看他被游戏商给废掉。

他确信脑载系统一定会用任务的方式提醒他，狼来了。

所以在脑载系统提醒他之前，他理所当然把全部注意力都放在了他家不帅身上。

虎不帅在服下虫毒消融药剂后，一开始还很平静。

但不到五分钟，他的身体忽然剧烈颤抖起来。

“不帅？”商非凡单膝跪坐在虎不帅身边，担心。

虎不帅身体颤抖得越来越厉害，坐姿维持不住变成了趴卧。

商非凡在心里大骂脑载系统，这给的什么破药！

他立刻重新打开游戏商城，想要寻找能给不帅缓解疼痛的药物。

没想到他的右眼一阵滚烫，竟然在视界中浮现一行字。

【发现自然之神散落的力量，请问是否拾取？】

“什么意思？”商非凡厉声问。

【自然之神的力量正在脱离寄宿体，请问是否拾取？】

“我买的明明是虫毒消融药剂，为什么会让自然之神的力量脱离不帅身体？”商非凡有种被欺骗被耍弄的愤怒。

愤怒过头，他反而变得极致冷静。

【自然之神的力量一旦脱离寄宿体就会被邪神查知，请尽快拾取，送还给自然之神雕像。】

“不帅会怎样？”

【自然之神的力量已经脱离寄宿体百分之五十，请尽快拾取。】

【自然之神的力量已经脱离寄宿体百分之五十五，请尽快拾取。】

【自然之神的力量已经脱离寄宿体百分之六十，请尽快拾取。】

一条又一条文字出现，跟催命一样催促他。

虎不帅的身体也出现了巨大变化，他似乎无法再维持白虎状态，变成了人体。

不帅蜷缩在地上，胸口似乎有什么东西正在浮出。

商非凡伸手，想要止住不帅身体的剧烈痉挛。

不帅转眼又变成白虎。

就这样，在短短几分钟内，不帅身体在白虎和人体之间来回变幻。

每次转变，他胸口的浮起物就越来越明显，就好像马上就会冲出他的皮肤。

【自然之神的力量已经脱离寄宿体百分之九十……】

商非凡看清楚了，不帅胸口的皮肤硬是被顶出了一个耳朵的形状。

耳朵？！

不是心脏？

怪不得不帅的天赋能力会从普通超听力变成能听到尸体声音这么奇葩……

不管是耳朵还是心脏，商非凡都本能地觉得不能让它离开不帅身体。

我要怎么做才能让这个耳朵重新回到不帅身体中？

“取出去！”不帅突然睁开眼睛，挣扎着吐出几字。

商非凡：“你在说什么胡话！”

虎不帅痛苦地扣紧手指：“那不是我的力量，取出去！”

商非凡眉头狠狠皱起，他从来没有这么纠结过。

“我不知道取出自然之神的力量，你会怎样。”

虎不帅急速喘息，只不断重复：“取出去……不是我的，我不要！”

我不要不属于我的力量。

我不会挽留任何不想要留下的。

想走就走，我不稀罕！

商非凡不知道虎不帅的最大症结，但他看出了不帅的坚决。

不帅甚至弹出利爪，伸手抓向自己胸口。

商非凡一把抓住不帅的手，不让他伤害自己。

“我来！”

商非凡在动手前，平静地警告脑载系统：“我会照做。但如果不帅有个三长两短，除非你让我第一时间脑死亡，否则你会增加一个最难缠的敌人。”

脑载系统终于给出明确回应：【虎不帅的身体和自然之神的力量不兼容，与其强求不如放弃。】

“自然之神力量脱离他的身体后，他会死亡吗？”

【不会。】

“是否会重伤？生命力是否会衰减？”

【请善用游戏商城。】

艹！商非凡咬牙，右手猛地按住不帅胸膛，对准那浮出的耳朵形状，虚虚一抓。

右眼中的罗盘化成一道白光，附着在商非凡右手上。

白光延伸到不帅胸口，笼罩住那只浮出的耳朵，轻轻一提。

一只跟人类耳朵差不多大的石耳出现。

商非凡握住石耳。

随即他的身体就不由自主地转移到了雕像广场中。

MD！这是多么迫不及待。

商非凡担心外面的不帅，抬头看了看偌大雕像。

按照右眼视界中的说明，爬上雕像身体，把手中握着的石耳放到雕像缺失的耳朵部位。

原本只有人类耳朵大小的圆形石耳突然变大，重新回到了雕像脑袋上，严丝合缝的就像是从来没有失去过。

商非凡摸摸雕像。不知道是不是他的错觉，他竟然感觉到雕像像是多了一丝活气和灵动。

叮咚。

【恭喜你完成主线任务之一，寻回自然之神缺失的耳朵，成功获取一万点贡献点奖励。】

【你送回了自然之神散落的力量，得到自然之神的青睐。但受到你的血脉天赋‘恶咒’的影响，任何祝福buff的加成都对你无效。】
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 70: Everyone is Impatient (Part 2)

He wanted to see where this person lived in the real world, what he looked like, and what kind of abilities he possessed.

However, he could not reach his hand into the "real world" for the time being. Managing a forum and mailing helmets to players was already the limit of his influence on the real world. Having him directly knock on the door and meet a player face-to-face was impossible.

But he could arrange for people over there, spending money to have someone investigate that player's background. If that player really had a problem, he would spend money to solve him!

As such, the exchange channel between real currency and game currency had to be opened faster; otherwise, he wouldn't have that much real currency to operate with.

In addition, he also had to search for this player from the game's side.

Although he could not find the player's exact coordinates in the "game world," just looking at the fact that he was still leveling up indicated that Your Emperor was still active on the Beastman Continent.

And the places on the Beastman Continent that currently supported low-level players leveling up rapidly...

The game planner's gaze swept across the panoramic map of the Beastman Continent, which had several circular red dots on it.

He had been monitoring the changes in these locations in real-time. In some places, the red dots disappeared; in some, they were expanding; and in others, they were shrinking.

Disappearance meant the problem had been resolved.

Expansion meant the number of infected was increasing.

Shrinking meant someone was eliminating the infected.

The game planner clicked on the shrinking red dot and saw the place name.

Molo City.

Although he wasn't sure if the player Your Emperor was killing monsters and leveling up there, in the absence of other clues, it wouldn't hurt to go check it out first.

Having made his decision, the game planner closed his eyes.

A moment later, a naked beastman body walked out of the temple's spawning pool.

He did not walk out of the temple, but instead headed toward the back of the temple, where no one was allowed to enter.

There lay a multi-directional teleportation array built during the Era of Great Prosperity but long forgotten.

Over in Molo City, Shang Feifan had no idea that the game planner was coming to find him personally.

But he was already prepared. Because even thinking with his knees, the game developer couldn't possibly let him, a bug, go unresolved.

However, he wasn't worried about this. Soldiers to block, water to cover—there was always a way to solve it. Besides, the brain-hosted system had gone to so much trouble to detach him from the original game system, so it probably wouldn't stand by and watch him get ruined by the game developer.

He was certain that the brain-hosted system would use a quest to warn him when the wolf was coming.

So, before the brain-hosted system warned him, he naturally focused all his attention on his Bushuai.

After swallowing the Insect Venom Dissolving Potion, Hu Bushuai was quite calm at first.

But in less than five minutes, his body suddenly began to tremble violently.

"Bushuai?" Shang Feifan knelt on one knee beside Hu Bushuai, worried.

Hu Bushuai's body trembled harder and harder, unable to maintain his sitting posture, collapsing into a prone position.

Shang Feifan cursed the brain-hosted system in his heart. What kind of garbage medicine was this!

He immediately reopened the game mall, wanting to find a medicine that could alleviate Bushuai's pain.

Unexpectedly, a wave of heat surged in his right eye, and a line of text actually floated into his vision.

[Discovered scattered power of the God of Nature. Would you like to pick it up?]

"What do you mean?" Shang Feifan asked sharply.

[The power of the God of Nature is detaching from the host body. Would you like to pick it up?]

"I clearly bought an Insect Venom Dissolving Potion. Why would it cause the power of the God of Nature to detach from Bushuai's body?" Shang Feifan felt a surge of anger at being deceived and played.

But in his extreme anger, he became exceptionally calm instead.

[Once the power of the God of Nature detaches from the host body, it will be detected by the Evil God. Please pick it up as soon as possible and return it to the statue of the God of Nature.]

"What will happen to Bushuai?"

[The power of the God of Nature has detached from the host body by 50%. Please pick it up as soon as possible.]

[The power of the God of Nature has detached from the host body by 55%. Please pick it up as soon as possible.]

[The power of the God of Nature has detached from the host body by 60%. Please pick it up as soon as possible.]

Lines of text appeared one after another, urging him like a death knell.

Hu Bushuai's body also underwent a massive change. He seemed unable to maintain his white tiger form and turned back into a human.

Bushuai curled up on the ground, and something seemed to be emerging from his chest.

Shang Feifan reached out, wanting to stop the violent spasms of Bushuai's body.

In the blink of an eye, Bushuai turned back into a white tiger.

Just like that, within a few short minutes, Bushuai's body shifted back and forth between a white tiger and a human.

With each transformation, the protrusion on his chest became more and more obvious, as if it would burst through his skin at any moment.

[The power of the God of Nature has detached from the host body by 90%...]

Shang Feifan saw it clearly. The skin on Bushuai's chest was actually being pushed out into the shape of an ear.

An ear?!

Not a heart?

No wonder Bushuai's innate talent had transformed from ordinary super-hearing into the bizarre ability to hear the voices of corpses...

Whether it was an ear or a heart, Shang Feifan instinctively felt that he couldn't let it leave Bushuai's body.

*What do I need to do to make this ear return to Bushuai's body?*

"Take it out!" Bushuai suddenly opened his eyes, struggling to spit out a few words.

Shang Feifan: "What nonsense are you talking!"

Hu Bushuai clenched his fingers in agony: "That is not my power. Take it out!"

Shang Feifan's brow furrowed deeply. He had never been so conflicted.

"I don't know what will happen to you if I take out the power of the God of Nature."

Hu Bushuai panted rapidly, only repeating: "Take it out... It's not mine, I don't want it!"

*I don't want power that doesn't belong to me.*

*I won't hold onto anything that doesn't want to stay.*

*If it wants to go, let it go. I don't care for it!*

Shang Feifan didn't know Hu Bushuai's deepest psychological knot, but he could see Bushuai's determination.

Bushuai even extended his sharp claws, reaching out to claw at his own chest.

Shang Feifan grabbed Bushuai's hand, preventing him from harming himself.

"I'll do it!"

Before acting, Shang Feifan calmly warned the brain-hosted system: "I will do as you say. But if anything happens to Bushuai, unless you make me brain-dead immediately, you will gain the most troublesome enemy you've ever faced."

The brain-hosted system finally gave a clear response: [Hu Bushuai's body is incompatible with the power of the God of Nature. It is better to let go than to force it.]

"Will he die after the power of the God of Nature leaves his body?"

[No.]

"Will he be severely injured? Will his vitality decline?"

[Please make good use of the game mall.]

*Fuck!* Shang Feifan grit his teeth. His right hand slammed onto Bushuai's chest, aiming at the protruding ear shape, and made a grasping motion.

The compass in his right eye turned into a beam of white light, attaching to Shang Feifan's right hand.

The white light extended to Bushuai's chest, enveloping the protruding ear, and gently lifted.

A stone ear, about the size of a human ear, appeared.

Shang Feifan gripped the stone ear.

Immediately after, his body was involuntarily transferred to the Statue Plaza.

*Damn it! Talk about being impatient.*

Shang Feifan was worried about Bushuai outside. He looked up at the massive statue.

Following the instructions in his right eye's vision, he climbed up the statue's body and placed the stone ear he held in his hand onto the missing ear section of the statue.

The round stone ear, which was originally only the size of a human ear, suddenly expanded, returning to the statue's head and fitting seamlessly, as if it had never been lost.

Shang Feifan touched the statue. He wasn't sure if it was his imagination, but he actually felt as if the statue had gained a trace of life and spirit.

*Ding-dong.*

[Congratulations on completing one of the main quests: Retrieve the missing ear of the God of Nature. Successfully obtained a reward of 10,000 contribution points.]

[You have returned the scattered power of the God of Nature and gained the favor of the God of Nature. However, due to the influence of your bloodline talent 'Evil Curse', any blessing buff effects are ineffective on you.]

chunks.chapterTitle: 第70章 都很迫不及待 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
【因寄宿体虎不帅主动献出自然之神散落的力量，得到自然之神的青睐。自然类魔法感知加成百分之五十。寿命增加三百年，期间生命体会一直维持最佳状态。】

商非凡身体一顿。

他没有因为得到一万点贡献点兴高采烈，反而被系统最后一句话给吸引了注意力。

“自然类魔法？这么说不帅以后能使用魔法？”

脑载系统又变成了闭口葫芦。

但商非凡却笑了，他要把这个好消息告诉不帅。

这也算是因祸得福？

就算不帅因为吸收不到魔力的缘故，仍旧暂时无法使用魔法。但只寿命增加了一倍，还能在他长达六百年的人生中一直维持最佳状态，怎么看都不亏。

自然之神的力量是很好，但……就如不帅所说，不是自己的，与其强留还不如不要。

商非凡正要离开雕像广场，脚却被某物绊了一下。

商非凡下意识低头看。

看到了一具诡异的雕像。

这不是他之前从邪神信徒营地里收进来的邪神雕像吗？

这玩意怎么像是被狠狠鞭打过一样，身上都是一道又一道被抽过的痕迹？

【把它献祭给伟大的诅咒之神吧。请尽快！】

右眼视界怕商非凡看不见一样，给出偌大提醒。

商非凡：“……”

又是一个迫不及待的家伙。

行吧，给你给你。

商非凡连咒术阵都没绘制，直接手按邪神雕像，念咒：“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯。虔诚的信徒我将把这具邪神雕像献祭给您，请您诅咒……”

诅咒谁呢？

诅咒什么内容？

商非凡毫无准备，一时也想不起来要诅咒谁，脑子一抽，鬼使神差地冒出后文：“请您诅咒我乌鸦嘴威力大增。”

他说出这句时千真万确抱着百分百的玩笑心。

就因为刚刚他脑中突然想到老伏和不帅都说过他的嘴有点可怕，就顺口秃噜了这么一句。

反正是游戏嘛，随便说说也不会真的变成真，就算成真也顶多是在游戏中。

诅咒完自己，眼见邪神雕像一眨眼就变成灰烬，商非凡迅速离开了雕像广场。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 70: Everyone is Impatient (Part 3)

[Because the host body, Hu Bushuai, actively offered up the scattered power of the God of Nature, he has gained the favor of the God of Nature. Nature magic perception bonus increased by 50%. Lifespan increased by 300 years, during which his life form will always maintain its peak state.]

Shang Feifan's body froze.

He wasn't overjoyed by the 10,000 contribution points; instead, his attention was completely drawn to the system's last sentence.

"Nature magic? Does that mean Bushuai can use magic in the future?"

The brain-hosted system became a silent gourd again.

But Shang Feifan smiled. He wanted to tell Bushuai this good news.

Could this be considered a blessing in disguise?

Even if Bushuai still couldn't use magic for the time being because he couldn't absorb magic power, just having his lifespan doubled and being able to maintain his peak state throughout his 600-year-long life was a massive win no matter how one looked at it.

The power of the God of Nature was indeed good, but... just as Bushuai said, if it wasn't one's own, it was better to let it go than to force it to stay.

Shang Feifan was about to leave the Statue Plaza when his foot tripped on something.

Shang Feifan instinctively looked down.

He saw a bizarre statue.

Wasn't this the Evil God statue he had collected from the Evil God cultists' camp earlier?

Why did this thing look like it had been severely whipped, its body covered in lash marks?

[Sacrifice it to the great God of Curses. Please hurry!]

As if afraid Shang Feifan wouldn't see it, a massive prompt appeared in his right eye's vision.

Shang Feifan: "..."

Yet another impatient fellow.

Fine, fine, here you go.

Shang Feifan didn't even draw a magic circle. He placed his hand directly on the Evil God statue and chanted: "Supreme and great existence, God of Curses, Konizeus. I, your devout believer, shall sacrifice this Evil God statue to you. Please curse..."

Curse who?

Curse what?

Shang Feifan was completely unprepared. For a moment, he couldn't think of who to curse. His mind slipped, and by some bizarre twist of fate, the following words popped out: "...Please curse me so that my jinxing mouth's power increases dramatically."

When he said this, he was absolutely, one hundred percent joking.

It was just because he had suddenly remembered Old Fu and Bushuai saying his mouth was a bit terrifying, so he blurted it out on a whim.

It was just a game anyway. Saying it casually wouldn't make it real, and even if it did, it would only be in the game.

After finishing his curse, he watched the Evil God statue turn to ash in the blink of an eye. Shang Feifan then quickly left the Statue Plaza.

chunks.chineseText:
第71章 特价装备

白虎趴卧在地上，情况看起来要比商非凡想象的好得多。

他身上的伤口有些崩裂，但流出来的血液是红色的。

白虎舔-舐着自己的伤口，把药膏都舔掉了。

商非凡迅速拿出止血伤药，重新给不帅伤药。

他把不帅身上原本涂抹药膏的地方一一擦拭干净，擦拭好一处就重新上一次药。

“感觉如何？”商非凡摸摸白虎的大脑袋。

虎不帅抬起头，半句没问刚才商非凡去了哪里，只说：“很好，我感觉身体轻松了很多。”

虎不帅没骗商非凡，他是真的这么感觉。

自然之神力量离体时他很痛苦，就像是内脏被人生生拽出身体一样。

但等那份不属于他的力量离开，他却发现他对自己身体的掌控度更高，对整个身体的操纵更加丝滑。

就好像……他的灵魂现在才和这具身体真正融合一样。

这是一种很微妙的自我感知，只有自己才能体会到。

“虫毒呢？”

“没有了，确实已经消融掉。你看我的血液颜色已经恢复正常。”

商非凡用右眼观察不帅的能量，见其能量并没有降到危险线以下，还在缓慢恢复中，松了口气。

“你感觉……你的身体有什么变化吗？我是说你有没有感觉失去了什么、增加了什么？”

“失去……应该没有吧。我依然能听到尸体的声音。你认为我失去自然之神的力量，我的天赋能力也会消失？”

商非凡确实有这个担心。

白虎的嘴巴动了动，像是在笑：“自然之神的力量确实让我的天赋能力产生异变，但既然是天赋能力，它就存在于我这具身体的血脉中。一般来说，被激活的天赋能量不会再轻易消失。除非中毒，或身体根基被破坏严重。但自然之神的力量离开我的身体时并没有破坏我的身体。”

这似乎也证明自然之神并不是一个恶神？

“那就好。”商非凡笑：“告诉你一个好消息，你这次没有白吃苦，你获得了自然之神的青睐。”

商非凡简单告诉不帅原由。

如果不帅这个寄宿体不肯归还自然之神的力量，那么就算自然之神的力量想要离开也不会那么容易，还可能在过程中产生新的分裂和损耗。

商非凡想要取出自然之神的力量也会多费手脚，说不定会取不出来。

“所以自然之神给了我奖励，让我自然魔法感知力提升百分之五十？寿命提升一倍？”不帅神色怪异。

商非凡乐滋滋：“还能青春常驻，你会一直保持最佳状态到你生命结束的那一天。”

虎不帅有点不真实感。

他知道兽人最长寿命可以达到三百岁左右，翻倍不就能活六百年？

这可是魔导师才能达到的寿命！

让法德尔大陆的人知道，不知得有多羡慕。

实际上只是普通兽人的寿命长度就能让法德尔大陆的人类羡慕妒忌死。

“你试试看能不能施展魔法。”商非凡眼睛看人就像是带着某种特别的蛊惑魔力。

虎不帅注意到商非凡的眼眸颜色变成了暗红色，这个颜色似乎已经固定下来。

他试着回忆商非凡之前的眼眸颜色，好像是黑色？

商非凡眼眸之前是什么颜色跟我有什么关系？虎不帅失笑，摇摇头，不再多想。

不帅闭上眼睛，开始感知魔力，催动自己施展魔法。

过了一会儿，不帅睁开眼睛，摇头。

“不行吗？”

“不行，还是感知不到魔力，但是……”

“但是什么？”

虎不帅不太确定地说：“我似乎能感觉到周围的自然能量很活跃，能感觉到大地、植物和其他生物的存在。比如你的身后就有一株刚长出来不久的小草。”

商非凡转头，就发现他屁股后面，钟塔墙角的缝隙中冒出了一小株绿色。

那是被风吹进塔楼的草种，可能就在这几天才发芽冒头，躲过了被城卫兵发现拔掉的命运。

如果这座城市再空放一段时间，这样的野草会有更多冒出头。

“那你能操纵它吗？”

“不能。只是能感知到。”

虎不帅相信商非凡说的自然之神的青睐是真的，因为他以前对自然的感知力从没有这么敏锐过。

虽然仍旧不能使用魔法，但他还是很高兴。对于魔法师来说，感知力可是非常重要的施法因素。

“你能感知到自然能量，但没有办法吸收到魔力……”商非凡思索片刻，问：“你会不会能量转换的魔法？”

虎不帅摇头：“不会。我虽然会一点魔法知识，但我其实并没有系统的学习过，很多魔法知识我也只是一知半解，尤其是比较高深的魔法知识。”

实际上他绝大多数的魔法基础知识都来源于他后来教学的魔法学校，那里的图书馆，他是常客。

但那座魔法学校也只是一座很普通的魔法学校，里面最厉害的魔法师也只是高级。同样，她拥有的魔法知识也都比较基础，高深的不多。

他算是有魔法天赋，但机缘不是很好的人。

当他发现自己有魔法天赋想要去找个学校读书时，遇到了那个人。

也因为那个人会指点他一些魔法知识，他才和对方走到一起，然后慢慢深陷。

和那个人在一起的那几年，他也有认真学习魔法，但也不知道是天赋太差的缘故，还是理解力不佳，他总是不得其门而入，学了几年连个初级学徒都不如。

那个人发现了他的沮丧，就安慰他，说魔法天赋一般也没什么，说他已经比绝大多数没有魔法天赋的普通人要幸运得多，让他不要强求。

他也不是什么争强好胜的性子，在发现自己魔法天赋很可能极为一般后，也就接受了自己的普通，安于过普通人的日子。

后来那人离开他，他花了一点时间重新振作，然后为了生活，他又开始学习魔法并更多地使用魔法，这让他零碎地接触到一点魔法知识。

但他年龄太大了，魔法学校不愿收他，也没有哪个魔法师愿意收他为弟子。

这也是他与奥尔相遇，发现奥尔拥有非常优秀的魔法天赋，宁可掏空家底也要把他送入魔法学校的原因。

就是典型的家长错过了机会，不想要孩子也错过的想法。

那时候他和奥尔的感情很好，奥尔每次放长假回来会主动把他学到的魔法知识……偷偷告诉他。

但碍于学校的规定和魔法契约，奥尔能教给他的魔法知识也不多。

等到奥尔长大，他和奥尔分离，他飘泊了一段时间。

期间，他遇到了后来就职的魔法学校校长，那是他第二世人生最大的幸运。

对方很欣赏他，发现他靠自学达到了初级魔法师的程度，就邀请他进入他的魔法学校教刚入校的小孩子。

他在那座魔法学校教小孩子也相当于给自己打基础。

也不知道是不是心境放开，还是到了年龄理解力提升的缘故，他在那座魔法学校的提升很快，短短十五年就从初级魔法师升到了高级魔法师。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 71: Discounted Equipment (Part 1)

The white tiger lay on the ground, looking in far better shape than Shang Feifan had imagined.

A few of the wounds on his body had burst open, but the blood trickling out was now a healthy red.

The white tiger was busily licking his wounds, having licked off all the ointment previously applied.

Shang Feifan quickly pulled out a styptic salve to reapply medicine for Bushuai. 

He carefully wiped clean each spot where ointment had been smeared before, reapplying the fresh medicine location by location.

"How are you feeling?" Shang Feifan patted the white tiger's massive head.

Tiger Bushuai lifted his head. He didn't ask a single word about where Shang Feifan had just gone, only saying, "Very good. I feel like my body is much lighter."

Tiger Bushuai wasn't lying; he truly felt that way.

When the power of the God of Nature had left his body, the pain had been excruciating, as if his internal organs were being forcibly ripped out.

However, once that power that didn't belong to him was gone, he discovered he had a much higher degree of control over his own physical form. Maneuvering his body felt infinitely smoother.

It was almost as if... his soul was only now truly fusing with this body.

It was a subtle, internal self-awareness that only he could experience firsthand.

"What about the bug poison?"

"Gone. It really has dissolved completely. Look, my blood color has returned to normal."

Shang Feifan observed Bushuai's energy with his right eye. Seeing that the tiger's energy levels hadn't dropped below the danger line and were even slowly recovering, he let out a sigh of relief.

"Do you feel... any changes in your body? I mean, do you feel like you've lost anything or gained anything?"

"Lost anything...? Probably not. I can still hear the voices of the dead. Did you think that losing the power of the God of Nature would cause my innate talent to disappear as well?"

Shang Feifan had indeed worried about that.

The white tiger's mouth twitched, as if forming a smile. "The power of the God of Nature did cause a mutation in my innate talent, but since it is an innate ability, it resides within the bloodline of this body. Generally speaking, once an innate power is activated, it won't disappear so easily—unless one is poisoned or the bodily foundation is severely ruined. But when the God of Nature's power departed, it didn't harm my body in the slightest."

This also seemed to prove that the God of Nature wasn't a malevolent deity.

"That's good, then." Shang Feifan smiled. "I've got good news for you. You didn't suffer for nothing this time. You've earned the favor of the God of Nature."

Shang Feifan briefly explained the reason to Bushuai.

If Bushuai, as the host, had refused to yield the power of the God of Nature, even if that divine force wanted to leave, doing so wouldn't have been easy. The process would likely have caused new splinters and depletion of energy.

Shang Feifan would have had to go through far more trouble to extract it—or might not have been able to extract it at all.

"So the God of Nature rewarded me by boosting my natural magic perception by fifty percent? And doubling my lifespan?" Bushuai wore a strange expression.

Shang Feifan beamed merrily. "You also get eternal youth! You'll stay in peak condition until the day your life comes to an end."

Tiger Bushuai felt a sense of surreality.

He knew beastmen could live up to around three hundred years at most. Doubling that... wouldn't he live for six hundred years?

That was a lifespan only an Archmage could achieve!

If the people of the Fader Continent learned of this, who knew how envious they would be?

In fact, even the lifespan of an ordinary beastman was enough to make the humans of the Fader Continent green with envy.

"Try and see if you can cast magic." Shang Feifan looked at him with eyes that seemed to carry a strange, hypnotic charm.

Tiger Bushuai noticed that the color of Shang Feifan's eyes had turned a dark crimson, and this color seemed to have settled permanently.

He tried to recall the color of Shang Feifan's eyes before... Hadn't they been black?

*What does the color of Shang Feifan's eyes have to do with me?* Tiger Bushuai gave a self-deprecating chuckle, shook his head, and stopped dwelling on it.

Bushuai closed his eyes and began sensing magic power, trying to channel it to cast a spell.

After a moment, Bushuai opened his eyes and shook his head.

"It doesn't work?"

"No. I still can't sense magic power. However..."

"However what?"

Tiger Bushuai said, somewhat uncertainly, "I seem to feel that the surrounding natural energy is extremely active. I can sense the earth, the plants, and other living beings. For instance, right behind you, a small blade of grass has just sprouted."

Shang Feifan turned around and discovered a tiny shoot of green poking out from a crack at the corner of the clock tower wall right behind his buttocks.

It was a grass seed blown into the tower by the wind, which had probably germinated only in the past few days, narrowly escaping the fate of being pulled out by city guards.

If this city remained deserted for a while longer, even more wild grass like this would pop up.

"Can you control it?"

"No. I can only sense it."

Tiger Bushuai believed Shang Feifan's claim about the favor of the God of Nature, because his perception of nature had never been this sharp before.

Although he still couldn't use magic, he was still delighted. For a magician, perception was a crucial factor in spellcasting.

"You can sense natural energy, but you have no way to absorb mana..." Shang Feifan pondered for a moment, then asked, "Do you know any energy conversion magic?"

Tiger Bushuai shook his head. "No. Although I know a bit of magic theory, I've never studied it systematically. My knowledge of many magic topics is half-baked at best, especially when it comes to advanced magic."

In truth, the vast majority of his foundational magic knowledge had come from the magic academy where he later taught; he had been a regular in its library.

However, that academy was merely an ordinary one, where the most powerful mage was only at the senior level. Naturally, its magic collection was quite basic, with very little advanced material.

He possessed magical talent, but he was someone without great luck or opportunities.

Back when he first discovered his magic talent and wanted to find a school to study at, he had met *that person*.

It was precisely because that person offered to guide him in magic that he had walked alongside him, gradually falling deeper and deeper into the trap.

During the years he spent with that person, he had studied magic diligently. Yet whether it was due to poor talent or lack of comprehension, he could never find the doorway in. After years of study, he wasn't even equal to a novice apprentice.

When that person noticed his frustration, he comforted him, saying that having average magical talent was nothing to worry about. He told him he was already far luckier than the vast majority of ordinary people who lacked magic talent altogether, advising him not to push himself too hard.

He wasn't an overly competitive person by nature. Upon realizing that his magical talent was likely quite mediocre, he accepted his ordinary self and settled into living a normal life.

Later, when that person left him, he spent some time pulling himself back together. Then, to make a living, he began studying and using magic more, which allowed him to pick up bits and pieces of magical knowledge.

However, he was too old by then. Magic academies refused to enroll him, and no magician was willing to take him as an apprentice.

That was also why, when he met Or and discovered the boy possessed exceptional magical talent, he had been willing to empty his savings just to send Or to a magic academy.

It was the classic mindset of a guardian who had missed their own chance and didn't want their child to miss theirs.

Back then, he and Or had a wonderful relationship. Every time Or returned for a long vacation, he would proactively... secretly share the magic knowledge he had learned with him.

Yet due to school regulations and magical contracts, the knowledge Or could teach him was limited.

Once Or grew up, the two went their separate ways, and Bushuai drifted around for a time.

During that period, he met the principal of the magic academy where he was later employed—which turned out to be the greatest stroke of luck in his second life.

The principal greatly appreciated him. Upon discovering that he had reached the level of a junior mage through self-study, the principal invited him to join the academy to teach newly enrolled children.

Teaching young children at that magic academy was, in effect, a way for him to build his own foundations.

Perhaps because his mindset had broadened, or perhaps because his comprehension had improved with age, his progress at that academy was remarkably swift. In just fifteen short years, he rose from a junior mage to a senior mage.

chunks.chineseText:
这也是他对那座学校充满感情不惜牺牲自己的重要原因，那里不止是他任职的地方，更是成就他，给他建立信心，让他产生归属感的心灵家园。

虎不帅脑中想了很多，但他脸上什么都没有表达出来。

商非凡还在思考：“如果你不会能量转换的魔法，那么我还是按照原先的思路，给你炼制一个能量转换器。把兽人大陆的能量转换成魔力，这样你就能吸收魔力并使用魔法。”

虎不帅：“可我不知道能量转换器怎么做……”

“我来试试看。”如今商非凡也是学会了炼金和附魔两种知识体系的人，再加上他在地球那边学到的知识，三者结合起来，他就不信做不出一个能量转换器。

等等！他不是还有一个游戏商城吗？

之前他因为缺乏贡献点数，只能看着游戏商城里的诸般好货流口水，但现在他可是拥有一万贡献点的巨富！

商非凡迅速打开游戏商城，输入能量转换字样。

搜索结果出来。

排在第一位的就是：

【被玷污的法神手镯。传说中诅咒之神的战利品，祂看不上就扔了出来。该手镯可以吸收多种能量并进行互相转换和输出，详细使用方法如下……】

商非凡没想到游戏商城真的有现成的能量转换器，但在看到法神的前缀时，他心中就有不妙感，等拉到最后看清价格，他就在心中道了一声果然！

虽然诅咒之神看不上，但能冠以法神-的名头，这手镯能便宜吗？

整整五万贡献点。

这个价格让他再次清晰认识到他并不是巨富，只是一个穷鬼的现实。

商非凡默默关闭这条信息，看向其他搜索结果。

【魔法炼金高级篇。内含能量转换原理和炼制方法……。售价1000点。】

【附魔高级篇。内含能量转换和附着的最基础原理……。售价1000点。】

【魔法师知识大全。售价10000点。】

【通向魔导师的路。售价50000点。】

……

商非凡明白了，这个游戏系统虽然提供了大量商品，但它应该更希望玩家能通过自我学习来掌握游戏世界的各种知识。

只从价格上看，购买这些专业知识、掌握这些知识、再自己炼制这一条路是最适合穷鬼的。

虽然这些知识的价格也不低。

尤其这些知识的高级篇你可以买，但买来后，如果你不会初级中级的知识，高级篇的知识也无法学会。

所以要买，他就得买整一个职业体系的全部传承。

商非凡的学习能力不错，智商自认也还可以，但让他为了制作一个能量转换器就得从头学习至少两门专业知识，他也会头疼，并且想要放弃。

好在这毕竟是游戏，这些他从来没有接触过的稀奇古怪知识他也不必真的真刀实枪的一点点学习，只要他买下这些知识，这些知识就会自动进入他的大脑。

这就相当于他省略了大量繁复的学习过程，只要进行实践就行。

商非凡没有立刻购买这些魔法体系相关的知识，在花钱前，他得先做一个计划。

他想买的东西太多，可贡献点只有一万，他得按照轻重缓急排个序。

“我有一个问题，你可以回答，也可以不回答。”虎不帅突然开口。

商非凡看向他：“你问。”

虎不帅：“你说你给我的药剂是虫毒消融药剂，那它为什么会让自然之神的力量脱离我的身体？”

不帅不想怀疑商非凡，从结果来看，自然之神力量离开他也不是什么坏事。但这个问题是根刺，他也不知道为什么，就想知道答案。

商非凡忽然放松地在他面前盘膝坐下：“我很高兴你能问出这个问题。实际上，你就算不问，我也会跟你聊这件事。”

不帅露出疑惑神情。

商非凡看着不帅的眼睛：“我说我也不知道这瓶药剂会让自然之神的力量脱离你，你相信吗？”

虎不帅垂下眼眸。

商非凡偷偷伸手快速握住白虎的大爪子，捏捏：“你愿意听听我的分析吗？”

“……”虎不帅无可无不可，他想收回爪子，没能收回来。

商非凡握着爪爪不放：“我现在也不知道具体原因，但我猜测虫毒和自然之神的力量应该是互相排斥的。当你体内虫毒成分不多时，你体内的自然之神力量就可以压制这些虫毒并把虫毒排出体外。

但当虫毒超过一定浓度，你体内的自然之神力量就会无法压制这些虫毒，甚至因为这些虫毒而躁动不安，想要逃避。

我不是说自然之神的力量弱于虫毒，而是自然之神的力量不属于你，你也不知道该如何操纵这份力量，导致这份力量只能产生一些微弱的本能反应。你明白我的意思吗？”

虎不帅点头，表示自己听懂。

商非凡一本正经地捏着大爪子的肉垫，像是不知道自己在干什么一样，继续分析：

“虫毒消融药剂的主要成分和制作原理我也不知道。但我猜测它的主要成分很可能和神的力量有关。这股力量也许不是很强大，但它进入你的体内后，很可能唤醒了自然之神的力量。

加上我在你身边，自然之神感觉到自己的本位，自然想要回归，这才会强行脱离你的身体。”

虎不帅听到这里，差点脱口问出：难不成你的随身老爷爷就是自然之神？

好不容易才忍住。

商非凡对他眨眨眼：“没错，我有秘密，很大的秘密。如果你做我男朋友，我就全都告诉你。”

虎不帅爪子用力一蹬，把人蹬开，也顺利夺回了自己被非礼半天的爪爪。

商非凡被蹬，还笑。

他喜欢健康有活力的虎虎~

虎不帅闭眼休息，他想让自己尽快恢复过来。

一只手摸上他的皮毛。

虎不帅用尾巴抽那只手。

那只手被抽了也不肯挪开。

对方摸的只是他的背部，动作也很轻柔。

虎不帅赶了几次没有赶开，烦了，也就随他去了。

谁想那人得寸进尺，竟然靠到了他身上。

他的腹部是没有多少伤口，但你这么靠上来有问过我同意没有？

虎不帅想踹开他，但那人竟然无赖地躺在了他的怀里。

他们、他们什么时候这么亲密了？

给我走开！

不帅抬起爪子用力拍，滚蛋！别靠我身上。

那人打了个滚，让他随便拍，就是不离开。

虎不帅气得虎须都颤抖了。

商非凡忽然凭空拿出一套盔甲：“当当当！不帅，你看这是什么。”

虎不帅暗骂：我管你是什么！

但那套盔甲太闪耀，让他目光不由自主被吸引。

这是商非凡在游戏商城装备栏里发现的特价装备，他之前完成的任务的奖励。

就这么一套，超低特价，原价3999，现在只要一个贡献点！

商非凡原本对这种特价装备很是不屑一顾，认为系统就是在打发他。

但等他看了这套装备的说明后，他顿时不这么想了。

这明明就是系统通过他送给他家不帅的最佳礼物！
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 71: Discounted Equipment (Part 2)

This was also a major reason why he felt such deep affection for that school and had been willing to sacrifice himself for it. It was not merely his workplace; it was a spiritual sanctuary that had molded him, built his confidence, and given him a sense of belonging.

Many thoughts flashed through Tiger Bushuai's mind, but his face revealed none of them.

Shang Feifan was still lost in thought. "If you don't know energy conversion magic, then I'll stick to my original plan and forge an energy converter for you. It'll convert the energy of the Beastman Continent into mana, allowing you to absorb it and use magic."

Tiger Bushuai replied, "But I don't know how to make an energy converter..."

"Let me give it a try." Shang Feifan had now mastered both alchemy and enchantment knowledge systems. Combined with the knowledge he had acquired back on Earth, he refused to believe he couldn't craft a working energy converter.

Wait! Didn't he also have a Game Shop?

Previously, due to a lack of contribution points, he could only drool over the fine goods in the shop. But now, he was a tycoon with ten thousand contribution points!

Shang Feifan quickly opened the Game Shop and typed in "energy converter."

The search results popped up.

Ranked right at the top was:
