[Defiled Archmage's Bracelet: A legendary trophy belonging to the God of Curses, thrown out simply because He looked down on it. This bracelet can absorb multiple forms of energy and convert/output them interchangeably. Detailed usage instructions are as follows...]

Shang Feifan hadn't expected the Game Shop to actually carry a ready-made energy converter. However, the moment he saw the prefix "Archmage," a bad feeling rose in his chest. Sure enough, when he scrolled down to check the price, he sighed internally!

Even if the God of Curses held it in contempt, could an item bearing the title of "Archmage" be cheap?

A whopping fifty thousand contribution points.

This price brought him face-to-face once again with the harsh reality that he was no tycoon, but merely a penniless pauper.

Shang Feifan silently closed the item entry and looked at the other search results.

[Advanced Alchemy Guide: Contains energy conversion principles and crafting methods... Price: 1,000 points.]

[Advanced Enchantment Guide: Contains basic principles of energy conversion and attachment... Price: 1,000 points.]

[Encyclopedia of Magician Knowledge: Price: 10,000 points.]

[The Path to Archmage: Price: 50,000 points.]

...

Shang Feifan realized the pattern. Although the game system provided a vast array of goods, it clearly preferred players to master the knowledge of the game world through self-directed learning.

Judging purely by price, purchasing these professional skills, mastering them, and then forging the item oneself was the path best suited for broke players.

Even though the prices for these subjects were hardly cheap.

In particular, while you could buy the advanced guides, if you didn't already understand the basic and intermediate knowledge, you wouldn't be able to learn the advanced content anyway.

Therefore, if he wanted to buy, he would have to purchase the entire inheritance of a complete professional path.

Shang Feifan had good learning capabilities and considered himself reasonably intelligent. But having to study at least two professional subjects from scratch just to build an energy converter made his head ache, tempting him to give up the idea altogether.

Fortunately, this was a game after all. He didn't actually need to painstakingly master these strange and exotic subjects through real-world study bit by bit. As long as he bought the knowledge, it would automatically upload into his brain.

It was equivalent to skipping a massive, tedious learning process—he only needed to put it into practice.

Shang Feifan didn't buy the magic-related knowledge right away. Before spending his money, he needed to draft a proper plan.

There were too many things he wanted to buy, but he only had ten thousand contribution points. He had to prioritize them based on urgency and importance.

"I have a question. You can answer it, or you don't have to," Tiger Bushuai suddenly spoke up.

Shang Feifan looked over at him. "Ask away."

Tiger Bushuai asked, "You said the potion you gave me was a bug poison dissolving potion. Why did it cause the power of the God of Nature to leave my body?"

Bushuai didn't want to doubt Shang Feifan. Judging from the outcome, losing the God of Nature's power wasn't a bad thing. But this question remained a thorn in his mind; for reasons he couldn't explain, he simply wanted an answer.

Shang Feifan suddenly sat down cross-legged before him in a relaxed manner. "I'm really glad you asked this. In fact, even if you hadn't, I was planning to talk to you about it."

Bushuai wore a puzzled expression.

Shang Feifan looked into Bushuai's eyes. "If I say that I didn't know this potion would cause the God of Nature's power to leave you either, would you believe me?"

Tiger Bushuai lowered his eyes.

Shang Feifan stealthily reached out and quickly grabbed the white tiger's large paw, giving it a gentle squeeze. "Are you willing to hear my analysis?"

"..." Tiger Bushuai was noncommittal. He tried to pull his paw back, but couldn't.

Shang Feifan refused to let go of the paw. "I don't know the exact reason right now either, but my guess is that the bug poison and the power of the God of Nature are mutually repulsive. When the concentration of bug poison in your body was low, the God of Nature's power could suppress it and purge it from your body.

"However, once the bug poison exceeded a certain concentration, the natural god's power could no longer suppress it. It even became agitated and restless because of the poison, wanting to flee.

"I'm not saying the God of Nature's power is weaker than the bug poison. It's just that the power didn't belong to you, and you didn't know how to control it, leaving it able to produce only faint, instinctual reactions. Do you understand what I mean?"

Tiger Bushuai nodded, signaling that he understood.

Shang Feifan continued his analysis with absolute solemnity, squeezing the paw's soft pads as if completely unaware of what his hands were doing:

"I don't know the main ingredients or crafting principles of the bug poison dissolving potion either. But I suspect its primary component is likely related to divine power. That force might not be overwhelmingly strong, but upon entering your body, it likely awakened the God of Nature's power.

"Add to that the fact that I was right beside you—the God of Nature sensed its origin and naturally wanted to return, which was why it forcibly detached from your body."

Hearing this, Tiger Bushuai almost blurted out: *Don't tell me your grandmaster-in-the-ring is the God of Nature itself?*

He barely managed to hold his tongue.

Shang Feifan winked at him. "That's right, I have secrets—huge secrets. If you become my boyfriend, I'll tell you everything."

Tiger Bushuai kicked out hard with his paw, pushing the man away and successfully reclaiming the paw that had been molested for so long.

Even after being kicked, Shang Feifan just chuckled.

He really loved healthy, energetic big tigers~

Tiger Bushuai closed his eyes to rest, wanting to recover his strength as quickly as possible.

A hand reached over and stroked his fur.

Tiger Bushuai used his tail to swat the hand away.

Even after being swatted, the hand refused to back off.

The man was only stroking his back with very gentle movements.

Bushuai tried to shoo him away a few times to no avail. Annoyed, he decided to just let him be.

Who could have guessed the man would push his luck, leaning right up against his body?

His abdomen didn't have many wounds, sure, but leaning against him like this—did you even ask for my permission?

Tiger Bushuai wanted to kick him away, but the man shamelessly lay down right in his arms.

When... when had they become this intimate?

*Get off me!*

Bushuai raised a paw and slapped him firmly. *Beat it! Don't lean on me.*

The man simply rolled over, letting him slap away while refusing to leave.

Tiger Bushuai was so exasperated that his whiskers trembled.

Shang Feifan suddenly pulled out a set of armor out of thin air. "Ta-da! Bushuai, look at this!"

Tiger Bushuai cursed inwardly: *I don't care what it is!*

Yet the set of armor was so dazzling that his eyes were involuntarily drawn to it.

This was a discounted piece of equipment Shang Feifan had found in the Game Shop's equipment section—a reward from a quest he had previously completed.

There was only this one set, listed at a super low discount: originally 3,999 points, now yours for just 1 contribution point!

Shang Feifan had originally looked down on such bargain items, thinking the system was just throwing him a bone.

However, after reading the item description, his opinion changed instantly.

This was clearly the system using his hands to send his beloved Bushuai the absolute best present!

chunks.chineseText:
【残损的紫金铠甲。新兽人帝国第一位帝皇阿莫斯布莱顿送给长子的成年礼物。由当时的炼金大师柯浩林亲手炼制，人形和兽形两用，铠甲可随兽人身躯变化而变化，可供巨兽化兽人使用，又被称为变身铠甲。】

除了是变身铠甲，这套铠甲的坚固度也历史有名，同时还具有提升使用者力量和速度的附加能力。

虽然是残损版，坚固度只剩下57%，但对于现在的不帅来说就像是及时雨。

不帅巨兽化的身体缺点和优点一样明显，就是他的身体没有防护，白虎的皮毛也无法像鳞甲类兽人一样坚硬。

遇到少数怪物，他可以靠巨大的身体碾压对方。但怪物数量一多，他就会遇到蚁多咬死象的难题。

这样的不帅最缺的就是一套能覆盖身体重要部位的铠甲。

商非凡非常期待不帅穿上这套铠甲，在摩罗城大杀四方的模样。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 71: Discounted Equipment (Part 3)

[Damaged Purple-Gold Armor: A coming-of-age gift from Amos Brighton, the first emperor of the New Beastman Empire, to his eldest son. Hand-crafted by Ke Haolin, a master alchemist of that era, it functions in both human and beast forms. The armor expands and contracts according to the beastman's body, and can even be worn in giant beast form. It is also known as the Shapeshifting Armor.]

In addition to being a suit of shapeshifting armor, its durability was historically famous, and it possessed additional attributes that boosted the user's power and speed.

Although it was a damaged version with only 57% durability remaining, for the current Bushuai, it was a godsend.

The drawbacks of Bushuai's giant beast form were as obvious as its advantages: his body lacked protection, and the fur of a white tiger was nowhere near as tough as the scales of reptilian beastmen.

Against a small number of monsters, he could rely on his massive body to crush them. But if the monster numbers grew too large, he would face the dire problem of ants felling an elephant.

What a Bushuai like this needed most was a suit of armor capable of protecting the vital areas of his body.

Shang Feifan looked forward immensely to the sight of Bushuai donning this armor and sweeping through Molo City, slaughtering all before him.

chunks.chineseText:
第72章 他来了

一只巨大的白虎浑身披挂着一套紫金铠甲，在城市中心的钟塔下，在数十只怪物的围攻中不断厮杀。

铠甲覆盖了他的头部、脖颈、四肢、身躯，包括尾巴都有保护。

这套铠甲不止保护了巨虎，更给巨虎增加了冲击力和速度。

在不怕被围攻被偷袭的情况下，巨虎的杀伤力大幅度提高。

商非凡站在巨虎的背部，施展骑乘术，无论巨虎怎么腾挪跳跃都稳稳当当。

他手上的喷火器换了，换成了更好用、杀伤力更加巨大的远程爆炸箭。

他现在就是远程射手，除了用爆炸箭袭击怪物，他还时不时地掏出巴掌大的鹅卵石当做石弹，甩手攻击怪物。

他的准头极佳，力道又特别大，只要被他击中的怪物，不是爆脑就是穿胸。

力气大可真的好啊！

搭配他的准头，让他成为了完美炮台。

在重新杀怪前，商非凡自然不可能放过到手的一万贡献点，他尽可能地利用这些贡献点提升和武装自己实力。

血脉天赋技能【不死之身】，1000点。买！

这是他最眼馋的天赋，有钱了怎么可能不买？

就算买下来不能保证他马上就变成不死之躯，而是需要慢慢升级，但只冲着初级就能大大增加恢复力，让伤势愈合速度加快，并能保证最后一点血不失，让他生存的可能性大大提高，就十分值得。

就是这个天赋买下来激活后，与他设想的不同，在血脉天赋一栏中，显示出来的是：不死之身（融合）1/10

1/10可以理解为天赋技能的升级进度，但括号中的融合又是什么意思？

这让商非凡有点在意。他询问了系统，但系统没有给出任何解释。

商非凡只能暂时放下。

血脉天赋技能【瞳术】，500点。买！

瞳术不仅可以提升他的准头，更有诸多妙用，比如瞪谁谁怀孕……咳，这个初级还做不到，但让人恐惧、对敌人进行精神控制等都是瞳术的应用技。

瞳术和鉴定术结合，可以让他的眼睛变成探测器，只要不是实力比他超过太多的存在，他一眼看过去就能知道对方的具体数据值。

血脉天赋技能这么好用，商非凡当然想要多买几个。

他想购买杀伤力巨大的黑暗系的一系列技能，比如腐蚀、吞噬、吸取他人能量之类。

之所以要买黑暗系天赋技能，是因为他已经有一个恶咒的天赋在身，因为恶咒的缘故，所有祝福类和增益类天赋他都无法再拥有。

否则他一定先给自己买个治疗天赋。

可惜系统告诉他，他目前最多只能激活四个天赋。

血脉天赋技能栏满了，他就转向职业技能。

首先下手的就是【初级鉴定术】，100点。

之前的任务十，只要他能寻来迪莉娅夫人要求的东西，系统就会奖励他初级鉴定术。但那个任务因为他被诅咒死亡，到现在没能完成。

商非凡也不想等了，在贡献点富足且他十分需要鉴定术的情况下，就直接在游戏商城里购买了初级鉴定术。

学会初级鉴定术后，系统问他是否愿意花费500贡献点与瞳术融合，他看完两个技能结合后的说明，毫不犹豫就选择了同意。

职业技能栏一共有十个，如今不知不觉已经被占了九个。

商非凡看到职业技能栏里的【咒术师之咒术】和【诅咒祭司】这两个职业技能，心中一动，主动询问系统这两个技能和他的血脉天赋【恶咒】是否可以融合。

系统当即就回答他可以，就是需要1000贡献点。

花费的贡献点虽然有点多，但只要想到他可以节省出两个职业技能栏位，而且融合后的技能效果也会比原先的更好，商非凡当然不会多犹豫。

如此，他就有了三个职业技能栏位空余。

商非凡想购买的职业技能很多，但俗话说贪多嚼不烂，就算这些技能买下来不需要他学习，可仍旧需要他实际应用和巩固，如果不是特别需要，他并不打算一次性全部买满。

商非凡思考再三，选择了职业技能【猎人】。

这个职业看似普通，但猎人的技能包括攻击精准度提升、陷阱设置、驯兽、寻物、跟踪、剥皮、采集、鉴定、天气观测、地形观测、甚至还有窝棚搭建等附属技能，怎么看都是一个非常实用的职业。

且猎人的诸般技能可以和他原本的天赋和技能结合起来，能即时大幅度增加他的杀伤力和生存能力。

所以哪怕有看起来更炫的职业技能，他也没有选择。

最后，商非凡又购买了一个职业技能【阵法师】。

他买这个职业技能，就是冲着传送阵和空间阵法而来。

商非凡从融合技能上尝到好处，又询问系统他能不能把职业技能【兽人大陆初级炼金师】和【初级魔法炼金师】融合。

系统再次给与肯定答复，这次融合同样需要花费1000贡献点。

“那炼金师技能和附魔师技能可以融合吗？”商非凡期待地问。

【可以。融合后变成‘附魔炼金师’，融合点数1000点。】

这么贵？这次商非凡不想花这笔冤枉钱了。

他是想再节省出一两个职业栏位，但他仔细看了融合说明，【兽人大陆初级炼金师】技能和【法德尔大陆初级魔法炼金师】技能互相融合，相当于是把两种貌似知识体系不同、实际原理类似的炼金知识结合到一起，变成既可以在兽人大陆使用，也可以在法德尔大陆使用的通用炼金师技能。

这其中涉及到能量转换方面，正是他急需的知识。

让系统帮忙融合这两个职业技能要比他自己仔细分析两者不同和相同处，再嚼碎糅合的效率高得多。

但是把【炼金师】和【附魔师】两者再融合为【附魔炼金师】就没有必要，因为这就是学会了附魔的炼金师。

所以最终商非凡只选择把兽人大陆炼金师职业和法德尔大陆的魔法炼金师职业融合，变成一个新的通用【炼金师】职业。

这么一搞，职业技能栏就剩余了两个空位。

商非凡考虑到以后，想到说不定某个紧急情况就需要某个特殊的职业技能，就没有再选择新的职业，而是把两个职业技能栏当做备用。

至此为止，商非凡一共消费了4300个贡献点。

再看他的个人技能面板。

血脉天赋（栏位已满）：

1，力大无穷：133/100

2，恶咒：133.9/100

3，瞳术：初级

4，不死之身：（融合）1/10

职业技能（空余两个栏位）：

1，骑乘术：初级

2，铁匠：学徒

3，草药师：学徒

4，虫族研究者：学徒

5，炼金师：学徒

6，附魔师：学徒

7，猎人：学徒

8，阵法师：学徒

每个技能点开还有详细介绍，商非凡重点看了【虫族研究者】，这个职业技能是在他吸收了虫母九分之一的心脏碎片后出现，可以敏锐查知虫族、虫毒。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 72: He Is Here

A massive white tiger, clad head-to-toe in a set of purple-gold armor, was locked in a brutal slaughter beneath the clock tower at the center of the city, surrounded by dozens of monsters.

The armor covered its head, neck, limbs, torso, and even its tail was heavily protected.

Not only did this set of armor safeguard the giant tiger, but it also drastically increased its charging momentum and speed.

Without the fear of being swarmed or ambushed, the tiger’s lethality skyrocketed.

Shang Feifan stood atop the tiger's back, employing his Riding technique, remaining as steady as a mountain no matter how the giant beast leaped and bounded.

He had changed his flamethrower for something even easier to use and far more lethal: long-range explosive arrows.

Right now, he was acting as a ranged marksman. Aside from bombarding the monsters with explosive arrows, he would occasionally whip out pebble-sized cobblestones to hurl as stone-bullets.

His accuracy was phenomenal, and his physical strength was terrifyingly high. Any monster hit by him either had its skull blown apart or its chest pierced through.

Having immense strength was truly fantastic!

Coupled with his pinpoint accuracy, it turned him into the ultimate turret.

Before returning to the slaughter, Shang Feifan naturally wouldn’t let go of the ten thousand Contribution Points he had just acquired. He utilized every single one of those points to upgrade and arm himself to the teeth.

Bloodline Innate Skill: 【Undying Body】—1,000 points. Buy!

This was the talent he had been drooling over the most; how could he possibly not buy it now that he was flush with cash?

Even if buying it didn't instantly turn him into an immortal being, but instead required gradual leveling, just the primary rank alone would vastly boost his vitality, accelerate his wound-healing speed, and guarantee that his last sliver of health wouldn't drain away, greatly increasing his survival odds. It was well worth the price.

However, after buying and activating this talent, it differed from what he had imagined. Under the bloodline innate column, it displayed: Undying Body (Fused) 1/10.

1/10 could be understood as the upgrade progress of the innate skill, but what did "Fused" in the parentheses mean?

This caused Shang Feifan a pang of curiosity. He queried the system, but it provided no explanation whatsoever.

Shang Feifan could only temporarily set the matter aside.

Bloodline Innate Skill: 【Pupil Technique】—500 points. Buy!

Not only could the pupil technique enhance his accuracy, but it also possessed numerous miraculous uses—such as making whoever he glared at pregnant... Cough, the primary rank couldn't quite do that yet, but striking terror into foes and exerting mental control over enemies were all practical applications of pupil skills.

When combined with the Appraisal skill, his eyes could transform into a detector. As long as the target’s strength didn't vastly exceed his own, a single glance would reveal their precise numerical stats.

Bloodline innate skills were so incredibly useful that Shang Feifan naturally wanted to buy a few more.

He had wanted to purchase a series of devastating dark-series skills, such as corrosion, devouring, and draining other people's energy.

The reason he wanted dark-series innate skills was because he already possessed the "Malediction" trait. Due to this curse, all blessing-type and buff-type talents were permanently locked off from him.

Otherwise, he definitely would have bought himself a healing talent first.

Regrettably, the system informed him that he could activate a maximum of four talents at most.

With his bloodline innate skill slots full, he turned his attention to professional skills.

First on the chopping block was 【Primary Appraisal】—100 points.

Back in Quest Ten, as long as he managed to retrieve the item Lady Delia requested, the system would have rewarded him with Primary Appraisal. But because of his cursed death, that quest had remained unfinished to this day.

Shang Feifan didn't want to wait any longer. With abundant Contribution Points and a desperate need for the appraisal skill, he bought Primary Appraisal directly from the game store.

Upon learning Primary Appraisal, the system asked if he was willing to spend 500 Contribution Points to fuse it with his Pupil Technique. After reading the description of the combined skill, he agreed without a moment's hesitation.

There were a total of ten professional skill slots, and before he knew it, nine of them were now occupied.

Noticing the professional skills 【Sorcerer's Sorcery】 and 【Cursed Priest】 in his skill slots, a thought stirred in Shang Feifan, and he actively asked the system if these two skills could be fused with his bloodline innate skill, 【Malediction】.

The system immediately replied in the affirmative, though it would cost 1,000 Contribution Points.

Though the cost was somewhat steep, the moment he realized this would free up two professional skill slots, and that the fused skill would yield even better effects than the originals, Shang Feifan didn't hesitate for long.

Just like that, he now had three vacant professional skill slots.

There were many professional skills Shang Feifan wanted to buy, but as the saying goes, biting off more than you can chew. Even if buying these skills didn't require him to study them from scratch, they still demanded practical application and consolidation. Unless urgently needed, he had no intention of filling all his slots at once.

After much deliberation, Shang Feifan selected the professional skill: 【Hunter】。

Though this profession seemed ordinary, a hunter's skills included enhanced attack precision, trap setting, beast taming, item tracking, scouting, skinning, gathering, appraisal, weather observation, terrain observation, and even auxiliary skills like makeshift shelter construction. No matter how you looked at it, it was an immensely practical profession.

Furthermore, a hunter's various skills could be combined with his original talents and abilities, instantly multiplying his lethality and survivability by a wide margin.

Thus, even though there were flashier professional skills available, he passed them over.

Finally, Shang Feifan purchased another professional skill: 【Array Master】。

He bought this professional skill specifically for teleportation arrays and spatial formations.

Having tasted the benefits of skill fusion, Shang Feifan asked the system whether he could fuse the professional skills 【Orc Continent Primary Alchemist】 and 【Primary Magic Alchemist】.

The system gave another affirmative reply, though this fusion would likewise cost 1,000 Contribution Points.

"Can the Alchemist skill and Enchanter skill be fused then?" Shang Feifan asked expectantly.

【Affirmative. After fusion, it becomes 'Enchanting Alchemist'. Fusion cost: 1,000 points.】

So expensive? This time, Shang Feifan didn't want to waste his money on such a scam.

He did want to free up one or two more professional slots, but upon carefully reading the fusion description, merging the 【Orc Continent Primary Alchemist】 skill and the 【Fadel Continent Primary Magic Alchemist】 skill was essentially combining two seemingly different knowledge systems with similar underlying principles. It would transform them into a universal Alchemist skill usable in both the Orc Continent and the Fadel Continent.

This involved energy conversion, which was precisely the knowledge he urgently needed.

Having the system help fuse these two professional skills was far more efficient than him carefully analyzing their differences and similarities himself before digesting and synthesizing them.

However, there was no need to merge 【Alchemist】 and 【Enchanter】 into an 【Enchanting Alchemist】, because that would simply be an alchemist who had also learned enchanting.

Ultimately, Shang Feifan chose only to merge the Orc Continent Alchemist profession and the Fadel Continent Magic Alchemist profession into a new, universal 【Alchemist】 profession.

With this maneuver, two vacant slots remained in his professional skill panel.

Considering the future—in case some emergency situation required a specific, unique professional skill—Shang Feifan decided against choosing any new professions, choosing instead to keep the two professional skill slots in reserve as backups.

Up to this point, Shang Feifan had spent a total of 4,300 Contribution Points.

He checked his personal skill panel once more.

Bloodline Innate Skills (Slots Full):
1. Boundless Strength: 133/100
2. Malediction: 133.9/100
3. Pupil Technique: Primary
4. Undying Body: (Fused) 1/10

Professional Skills (Two Slots Vacant):
1. Riding: Primary
2. Blacksmith: Apprentice
3. Herbalist: Apprentice
4. Zerg Researcher: Apprentice
5. Alchemist: Apprentice
6. Enchanter: Apprentice
7. Hunter: Apprentice
8. Array Master: Apprentice

Clicking on each skill revealed detailed descriptions. Shang Feifan focused his attention on the 【Zerg Researcher】; this professional skill had manifested after he absorbed one-ninth of the Zerg Queen's heart fragments, granting him acute sensitivity to the Zerg and their toxins.

chunks.chineseText:
有了技能，当然还要有装备。

但好装备价格都很贵，比如像不帅穿在身上的变身铠甲，价格都在三千贡献点以上。

商非凡并不想变身为兽体，就只买了一套普通的人形护甲，只要99点。

另外买了一把加伤害加速度的弓箭和一千支爆炸箭，1299点。

买这么多，是因为多买箭可以打折。加上商非凡现在也没时间去满城搜索箭支或自己制作。

加速度的皮靴一双，99点。

即时百分百体力恢复药剂，十瓶，100点。

即时百分百精神力恢复药剂，十瓶，100点。

类似药剂，两人在药剂市场的药店里也找到一些，但都不是百分百且立刻恢复，摆到柜台里的绝大多数都是初级药剂，只有少量中级，高级根本没看到。

商非凡担心被怪物包围，不想陷入有药剂却来不及恢复的境地，宁可花贡献点跟游戏商城买了效果更好的药剂备用。

商非凡还给不帅买了一个口含式鼓风器，599点。

这个鼓风器这么贵，自然有它贵的道理。

它可以让兽人戴在脸上，用嘴巴咬住，或者固定在唇部位置，然后兽人只要对着鼓风器进口吹气，鼓风器出口就能吹出狂风。

这对于不喜欢用牙齿撕咬敌人的不帅来说非常适用。

这玩意在防备怪物近身时特别好用。

如果来不及处理扑过来的怪兽，就鼓嘴一吹，可以把怪物立刻吹飞。

商非凡还怕不保险，又给不帅买了一个隐身保命耳环，1999点。

这个耳环可以保障不帅在遇到极度危险时，可以主动或被动激活耳环的隐匿效果，不但可以隐身，更可以隐匿他的全部气息，包括身上的血腥味等，让敌人察觉不到他藏在哪里。

这样就可以给不帅争取出服药疗伤的时间以及逃跑的机会。

商非凡还想给不帅买几张传送卷轴和空间储物工具，却发现凡是与空间有关的物品全都昂贵的让他买不起。他也想给不帅买技能，但技能书只有他自己能使用。

虎不帅也不想商非凡再送东西给他，如果不是为了杀怪和为了不拖后腿，不管是铠甲还是耳环还是鼓风器等，他都不想要。

当然，装备和武器也不是越多越好。

商非凡也是结合两人的优势和弱点，花费了很多脑筋构思才决定买下这些东西。

至此，一万贡献点已经用去8595点，加上之前的任务结算，共结余1424点。

商非凡还特意查看了自己的玩家等级，还是三十三级。

这点并没有出乎商非凡预料。因为如果按照之前的贡献点与等级兑换比例，他现在的等级得冲破一千大关，这已经不是破坏游戏平衡，而是瞎搞。

系统果然对此给与了说明。

【特别说明：主线任务赚取到的贡献点数将全部用在血脉天赋技能‘不死之身（融合）’上。只有支线任务赚取到的贡献点数才会提升玩家等级。】

商非凡：这么说不死之身的融合度是一万贡献点才提升一级？

虽然玩家等级没有提升，但在系统再次升级后，他的杀伤力已经比三十级之前大大增加，更不要说他现在还给自己添置了一堆好用的装备。

一人一虎就这么全副武装地杀入了怪物群。

不说如砍瓜切菜，但效率着实比前三天要提高许多。

商非凡的玩家等级又开始往上蹿。

其他玩家看着玩家等级排行榜，都要被你皇给整没脾气了。

他们闹也闹了，举报也举报了，但那个你皇就跟钉子户一样就这么钉在榜首不下来，而且他还诡异地在变成灰色的状态下还在升级。

玩家们：“艹！不在线也能升级？这不是挂还是什么？要么就是bug！狗策划你出来，这么大的bug你没看见吗？”

此时，摩罗城外。

城外最大的营地，也是彘庞男爵所在处，这里在这两天赶来了很多大人物。

经过两天激烈商讨，在各方各怀心思的情况下，终于商讨出了一个“拯救摩罗城”计划。

各方派来的人手，加上看到招募的雇佣兵和冒险者，以及想要趁火打劫的人，决定和摩罗城城卫军一起，在今天中午十二点整共同杀入摩罗城。

经过虫毒研究者的分析判断，城中虫毒浓度已经降低到安全线，只要不被尸变怪物直接咬伤抓伤，进城的人就不用担心被虫毒感染。

现在距离夺回摩罗城的时间只剩下半小时不到。

城门口不远处已经聚集了大量兽人和辅助攀爬城墙的云梯。

为了防止怪物们从城里冲出来，他们不会打开城门，而是选择从城墙攀越进城。

彘庞男爵本不想这么早投入城卫军杀怪，他希望先让其他人进入摩罗城，把怪物消耗一批再说。

但眼看来的人越来越多，彘庞男爵十分担心他留在摩罗城中的全城库存，那是能供应全城十万城民吃上整整一年的粮食，还有大量武器和药物。

彘庞男爵知道那些来帮忙的人都抱着什么心思，他们不仅想要谋夺他的摩罗城，也想要摩罗城的药剂师和成品药物，如果能弄到粮草更好！

现在就有不少人在接触逃出来的药剂师，想要把他们带回自家地盘。

好在为了防止这种人才流失情况，虎国有专门针对领民的严苛移民要求。

如果某个领地的领民想要离开家乡前往其他领主地盘，首先要取得当地政府的许可——交出足够费用，拿到迁出许可令，才可以前往别的领地。

而接收该领民的其他领地政府则需要签发接收许可，同时要补偿原领地领主人才损失费。

如果没有迁出许可令和接收许可，长期离开家乡又没有正当证明的兽人就会变成流浪兽人。

像是不帅和莫约镇的人来摩罗城购买药物，都随身携带着莫约镇出具的外出证明，否则他们就算能进城也找不到住的地方。当地城民也会立刻向治安官汇报来了一群没有身份证明的外地人。

流浪兽人不容易找到固定工作，更无法得到普通兽人的信任，就算他们能找到工作，交纳的税金都是最高的。如果被人抓去做奴隶，也不会有人去救他。

逐渐的，流浪兽人就成了罪犯、废物、逃匿者、强盗土匪的代名词。

所以只要没有万不得已的原因，没有兽人愿意变成流浪兽人。

但现在情况很特殊，摩罗城被怪物占领，包括领主在内，所有城民都不得不出逃。

虎国同样有法规条例针对这种特殊情况，如果当地领主死亡或不能再保护自己的领民，那么只要想要离开的领民能找到愿意接收自己的领地，就可以无条件离开原领地。

彘庞男爵也就是没死，加上他还控制着城卫军，那些心怀叵测的帮助者才没敢肆无忌惮地直接就把摩罗城的人才和财富给掠走。四处逃散的城民们也才没有远离，而是得到消息后又重新围拢过来。
chunks.englishText:
Having skills was all well and good, but he naturally needed equipment as well.

However, high-grade equipment came at steep prices. For instance, the transformation armor worn by Bushuai cost over three thousand Contribution Points.

Shang Feifan had no desire to transform into a beast form, so he merely purchased a set of standard humanoid armor for just 99 points.

In addition, he bought a bow and arrow set that boosted both damage and speed, along with one thousand explosive arrows, totaling 1,299 points.

Purchasing in bulk granted a discount on the arrows, and moreover, Shang Feifan lacked the time to scavenge the city for arrows or craft them himself.

A pair of speed-enhancing leather boots cost 99 points.

Ten bottles of Instant 100% Stamina Recovery Potion cost 100 points.

Ten bottles of Instant 100% Spirit Recovery Potion cost 100 points.

The two of them had found similar potions in the shops at the potion market, but none offered instantaneous, full recovery. The vast majority displayed on the counters were low-tier potions, with only a handful of mid-tier ones, while high-tier potions were nowhere to be seen.

Fearing the prospect of being swarmed by monsters and unable to recover in time despite having potions, Shang Feifan preferred to spend Contribution Points in the game store to secure superior items for emergencies.

Shang Feifan also bought Bushuai a mouth-held air blower for 599 points.

A price tag that steep naturally came with good reason.

It could be worn on a beastman's face, clamped between the teeth or fixed at the lips. As long as the user blew into the intake, the output vent would blast out a gale-force wind.

This was extraordinarily practical for Bushuai, who detested using his teeth to tear into enemies.

It was especially handy for preventing monsters from getting too close.

If he couldn't react in time to a pouncing monster, a single puff of breath would instantly blow the beast away.

Still worried about safety, Shang Feifan bought Bushuai a life-saving invisibility earring for 1,999 points.

This earring ensured that in times of extreme peril, Bushuai could actively or passively trigger its concealment effect. Not only did it grant invisibility, but it also concealed his entire aura—including the scent of blood on his body—making it impossible for enemies to sense where he was hiding.

This would buy Bushuai precious time to take potions, heal his injuries, or find an opportunity to flee.

Shang Feifan had also wanted to buy a few teleportation scrolls and spatial storage tools for Bushuai, only to discover that anything related to spatial mechanics was astronomically expensive beyond his reach. He had also wanted to buy skill books for Bushuai, but those could only be used by himself.

Hu Bushuai didn't want Shang Feifan to shower him with more gifts either. Had it not been for the sake of slaying monsters and avoiding becoming dead weight, he wouldn't have accepted the armor, the earring, or the blower.

Of course, more gear and weapons didn't necessarily mean better.

Shang Feifan had spent a great deal of thought analyzing both their strengths and weaknesses before settling on these purchases.

By now, 8,595 of his 10,000 Contribution Points were gone. Combined with his previous task reward payouts, he was left with a total balance of 1,424 points.

Shang Feifan specifically checked his player level: it remained at Level 33.

This didn't surprise him. If the conversion rate of Contribution Points to levels had remained unchanged, his current level would have smashed past the 1,000 mark—which wouldn't just break the game's balance, but be downright absurd.

As expected, the system provided an explanation for this.

[Special Note: All Contribution Points earned from Main Quests will be directed toward the Bloodline Talent Skill 'Undying Body (Fusion)'. Only Contribution Points earned from Side Quests will raise the player's level.]

Shang Feifan thought: *So the fusion rate of Undying Body requires ten thousand Contribution Points just to increase by one level?*

Although his player level hadn't increased, after the system's latest upgrade, his lethal output was far greater than before Level 30—not to mention the array of useful gear he had just equipped.

Fully armed and geared to the teeth, the man and the tiger plunged straight into the horde of monsters.

While it couldn't quite be described as slicing through vegetables, their efficiency was undeniably far higher than over the past three days.

Shang Feifan's player level began surging upward once more.

Looking at the player level leaderboards, the other players were rendered utterly speechless by "Your Majesty."

They had thrown tantrums, they had filed reports, but "Your Majesty" remained rooted to the top spot like an unyielding squatter. What's more, he was bizarrely leveling up even while his status was greyed out!

Players raged: "Fuck! Leveling up while offline? If that isn't a hack, what is it?! Or it's a massive bug! Come out here, you dog devs! Are you blind to such a huge bug?!"

***

Meanwhile, outside Molo City.

In the largest encampment outside the city—where Baron Zhi Pang resided—numerous big figures had arrived over the past two days.

After two days of heated debate, with every faction harboring its own hidden agenda, they finally hammered out a plan: "Save Molo City."

The forces dispatched by various factions, along with hired mercenaries, adventurers, and opportunists seeking to profit from the chaos, resolved to join forces with the Molo City Guard and charge into the city together at precisely twelve noon today.

According to the analysis of insect poison researchers, the toxicity level inside the city had dropped below the safety threshold. As long as they weren't directly bitten or scratched by the mutated corpses, those entering the city wouldn't need to fear infection.

Less than half an hour remained before the launch of the operation to reclaim Molo City.

Not far from the city gates, a massive force of beastmen had assembled alongside scaling ladders meant for mounting the walls.

To prevent the monsters from bursting out of the city, they decided not to open the gates, choosing instead to scale the walls and breach the city from above.

Baron Zhi Pang had originally been reluctant to commit the City Guard so early; he preferred to let the others enter first to whittle down the monster forces.

However, seeing the growing influx of external forces, the Baron grew deeply anxious about the city's stockpiles left inside Molo City—provisions capable of feeding all one hundred thousand citizens for an entire year, along with vast quantities of weaponry and medical supplies.

Baron Zhi Pang knew full well what these so-called "helpers" were after. They sought not only to seize his city, but also to claim Molo City's apothecaries and refined medicines—and if they could plunder the grain supplies, all the better!

Even now, quite a few parties were contacting the escaped apothecaries, attempting to entice them back to their own territories.

Fortunately, to prevent such brain drain, the Tiger Kingdom had strict immigration regulations regarding territory citizens.

If a citizen wished to leave their domain for another lord's territory, they first had to obtain permission from the local authorities—paying a substantial fee to secure an Emigration Permit—before being allowed to travel elsewhere.

Meanwhile, the receiving territory's government had to issue an Acceptance Permit and pay compensation to the original lord for the talent loss.

Without both an Emigration Permit and an Acceptance Permit, any beastman who remained away from home long-term without valid documentation would become a Wandering Beastman.

For instance, when Bushuai and the people from Moyue Town came to Molo City to purchase medicine, they carried travel certificates issued by Moyue Town. Otherwise, even if they could enter the city, they wouldn't be able to secure lodging, and local citizens would instantly report the arrival of undocumented outsiders to the constables.

Wandering Beastmen struggled to find steady work and could never gain the trust of ordinary beastmen. Even if they managed to find employment, they were subjected to the highest tax rates. If captured and forced into slavery, no one would come to their rescue.

Over time, "Wandering Beastman" became synonymous with criminals, outcasts, fugitives, and bandits.

Thus, unless driven by absolute necessity, no beastman was willing to become a wanderer.

But the current situation was extraordinary. Molo City had been overrun by monsters, forcing all citizens—including the lord himself—to flee for their lives.

The Tiger Kingdom had statutory provisions for such dire circumstances: if the local lord died or could no longer protect his subjects, any citizen wishing to leave could depart unconditionally, provided they found a new territory willing to receive them.

It was only because Baron Zhi Pang was still alive and retained control of the City Guard that those scheming "helpers" had refrained from brazenly plundering Molo City's talent and wealth. Likewise, it was why the scattered citizens had not dispersed far, gathering back around upon hearing word of the siege.

chunks.chineseText:
但这也只是暂时，一旦城民们感觉到彘庞男爵无法再保护他们，更不能让他们吃饱肚子和安定生活，他们肯定会想要离开摩罗城。

如此一来，夺回摩罗城（的物资）就成了必须且极为紧迫的事。

彘庞男爵冒险派出城卫军不是为了杀怪，而是想让他们把城中重要物资都给运送出来。运送不出来，也要先占领，避免被其他宵小染指。

为此，彘庞男爵再次提高了杀怪悬赏，想要让雇佣兵和冒险者们能为了奖赏都去杀怪，让城卫军能分-身去做更重要的事情。

同一时间，摩罗城男爵府内，一个位于井下的隐秘地下空间忽然发出一阵亮光。

亮光消失，原地出现了一名身材修长、长相极为俊美的银发兽人。

银发兽人破开砖墙，从井口跳出。

这个传送阵建造于很早以前，就是彘庞男爵都不知道他的男爵府中还有这么一处隐秘所在。

摩罗城一直都有传送阵的传说，很多城民都坚信城主知道传送阵在哪里并会使用。

当初嗡城就跟商非凡说过传送阵的事，但他不知道彘庞男爵本人压根不知道传送阵在哪里。

彘庞男爵也找过传说中的传送阵，但从未找到过。

谁能想到自大繁华纪到现在已经失踪几百年，也几百年没有人使用过的传送阵会在今天出现了使用者。

银发俊美兽人跳到男爵府最高的屋顶向四处眺望。

想要找到那个你皇，就得先找到杀怪的人。

这座城这时看起来很安静，宛如一座死城。

银发兽人侧耳细听，听到城中心处似乎有一些动静。

十二点整到。

东城门口旗帜挥动，大量兽人爬上城墙，每个人都裹得严严实实地冲入城内。

这些兽人并没有乱莽，他们也没有形成一支大军，而是就这么各自分散开，变成大大小小不同的团队，如水滴进入湖泊一般，就这么奔向城中四面八方。

银发兽人刚想要前往城中心查看，却感知到了城东有了最新动静，似乎有大量兽人进入了城内？
chunks.englishText:
However, this was only temporary. Once the citizens of the city felt that Baron Zhipang could no longer protect them, nor could he provide them with full bellies and a stable life, they would inevitably desire to leave Mola City.

Consequently, recapturing Mola City—or rather, its stockpiled supplies—had become an absolute and most urgent priority.

Baron Zhipang’s decision to risk sending out the City Guards was not to slay monsters, but to have them haul out the vital resources hidden within the city. If they could not be transported away, they had to be secured first to prevent other petty scoundrels from getting their hands on them.

To this end, Baron Zhipang had once again raised the bounties for slaying monsters, hoping to entice mercenaries and adventurers into fighting the beasts for the sake of the rewards, thereby freeing up the City Guards to attend to more important matters.

At the same time, deep within the Baron’s Estate in Mola City, a flash of light suddenly erupted within a concealed subterranean space situated beneath a well.

As the light vanished, a slender and exquisitely handsome silver-haired beastman materialized in its place.

The silver-haired beastman shattered the brick wall and leaped up from the mouth of the well.

This teleportation array had been constructed long ago; even Baron Zhipang was unaware that such a clandestine location existed within his own estate.

Legends of a teleportation array had always circulated in Mola City, and many citizens firmly believed that the Lord of the City knew its whereabouts and how to use it.

Back then, Weng Cheng had indeed spoken to Shang Feifan about the teleportation array, but he was unaware that Baron Zhipang himself had no clue where it actually was.

Baron Zhipang had searched for the legendary teleportation array as well, but had never managed to find it.

Who could have imagined that a teleportation array—which had vanished since the Great Prosperous Era and had gone completely unused for hundreds of years—would finally see a user today?

The handsome silver-haired beastman leaped onto the highest rooftop of the Baron’s Estate and gazed out into the distance.

If he wanted to find His Imperial Majesty, he first had to find the ones slaying the monsters.

At this moment, the city appeared deathly quiet, resembling a ghost town.

The silver-haired beastman cocked his ear to listen, detecting some faint commotion echoing from the heart of the city.

Twelve o’clock sharp.

At the east city gate, banners fluttered as a massive horde of beastmen swarmed up the city walls, each one wrapped tightly as they charged into the city.

These beastmen did not charge blindly, nor did they form a single grand army. Instead, they dispersed individually, splitting into various teams of all sizes. Like droplets of water sinking into a lake, they surged toward every corner of the city.

Just as the silver-haired beastman was about to head toward the city center to investigate, he sensed a fresh disturbance at the eastern gate: it seemed a massive wave of beastmen had just entered the city?

chunks.chineseText:
第73章 震惊

彘庞男爵的人一入城就向男爵府方向奔行。

大家行动都很小心，所有人都警惕地看着街道两边的房屋、房顶、阴暗小巷，防止突然蹿出一个怪物来。

但行进半晌，他们发现了一件很奇怪的事。

“路德维希执事，您有没有发现城中的怪物似乎没有我们预料得那么多？”

被称为执事的中年人被保护在队伍当中，他看起来在强自镇定，实际上紧张得肌肉全都绷得死紧，听到领队跟他说话，惊得肩膀微微一颤。

“啊。是啊，我们走到现在，似乎还没有碰到几个怪物。真的有点古怪……”

按照他们在外面的推测，当时死于虫毒散播者手下的城民至少也有大几千。后来没有能及时逃出城的也不知道有多少个。

详细数据他们还没能统计出来，如今彘庞男爵还在派人寻回那些出逃的城民并统计人口。不过根据聚拢回来的城民数量判断，逃出的城民应该能达到七八成以上。

这点就不得不夸奖当时的城卫军敲钟及时，虽然导致城中大乱，也没有有规划的撤离，但好歹也让绝大多数城民在第一逃亡时间也就是尸变者转变成怪物的当晚逃出了城。

如果大家拖拖拉拉，在尸变者大量转变成怪物后还没能逃出城，那么被怪物所伤的城民也会大大增加。这些被伤害的城民极有可能感染虫毒，再异变成怪物，然后就是……人传人。

一旦怪物数量超过城民，那摩罗城就真的完了。

现在摩罗城里的怪物虽然多，但还在可控制范围内，这也是彘庞男爵敢于把军队和营地就建在城外不到十里的地方的重要原因。

也因为摩罗城中的怪物数量不算特别多，跑出城的怪物的数量也相对就比较少，城卫军和一些厉害的兽人遇到怪物也能勉强应付，不至于让新建成的几个营地再次溃散。

但就算如此，大家在进入城中时还是担心和紧张无比。

大几千的怪物数量已经不少，且它们不惧死残、不畏疼痛，更不需要粮草，每一个怪物存在的目的都是杀死活物把虫毒传播出去。

更不要说这些怪物只要抓伤咬伤兽人，就会导致兽人异变。

面对这样的怪物，普通兽人遇到它们就会先吓得两腿发颤，正常战斗力能发挥出一半就算不错。

可以说这次被派入城中的城卫军和执事们都是敢死军，进城前他们可都是写好遗书的，彘庞男爵也承诺如果他们牺牲，会加倍给他们家人补偿。

自然，如果他们能完成任务，赏赐也会非常丰厚。

谁想到！抱着必死的心，结果却发现情况比他们设想得要好得多。

要不是场合和情况不对，这支队伍的兽人们都想爬上屋顶好好找一找那些怪物们都躲到哪里去了。

“执事，您看，屋顶上的那个人是谁？”

领队惊讶地指向男爵府最高处。

路德维希执事下意识抬头看向领队所指之处，就看到一个非常耀目的兽人。

对方银发披肩，身形修长，身着修身长袍，只看侧脸就极为俊美。

对方似乎也发现了他们，目光略微扫过他们，就从屋顶上飞跃消失。

“糟糕！”路德维希执事脸色略变。

他开始担心男爵府留下的那些财富了。

他为什么会和第一批敢死队一起入城？

不就是接到了男爵的命令，让他进城查看男爵府状况，重点是让进入的城卫军把男爵府保护起来，以防进城杀怪的兽人们“顺便”光顾男爵府。

当时他们撤退时，可还有很多东西没有带走。他本人就掌握着两个重要仓库大门的钥匙。

“快！我们加快速度，得赶在其他人之前进入府邸。”路德维希执事顾不上害怕，连声催促。

领队毫无二话，他们接到的命令之一就是保护这名执事，听他的吩咐。命令之二则是把男爵府当做城卫军的一个据点……实际上就是保护男爵府。

等这支队伍以最快速度冲入男爵府，就发现整个男爵府空空荡荡。

不是形容词，是真的空空荡荡。

不止是库房空了，就连男爵、男爵夫人和男爵长子以及其他重要人物的房间也都空了，很多精美家具都失去踪影。

路德维希执事的脸色瞬间变得惨白。

当他带着一丝希望跑向那有炼金大门保护的两个仓库，就发现那两个仓库的大门都是虚掩着的。

坏了！

路德维希执事手掌颤抖，慢慢推开了虚掩的大门……

“……派人通知男爵大人。”

“要怎么说？”领队也十分苦恼。

“我们看到什么就说什么。”执事脸色苍白。

领队先没理解，随后就像是明白了什么：“那个银发兽人！府邸被搬空肯定和他有关。”

执事转身，离开被搬空的库房：“派人吧。”

男爵府虽然空了，但作为摩罗城的象征，还是要守护起来。而且只凭这么多房屋也能作为城卫军的据点之一。

这支城卫军就此留下，利用男爵府的围墙建造攻防塔和指挥中心。

感觉城中怪物不多的人不止这支队伍，其他队伍的兽人也有同样感受。

直到有人进入商业街，越靠近城中最大拍卖行，怪物就越多。

因为商业街上的怪物特别多，感觉整座城的怪物都集中到了这里，导致不少跑来商业街想要做些什么的雇佣兵和冒险者们都不得不先离开这片地。

除了想要趁火打劫的兽人，也有不少团队是接了任务进来，他们将负责查看各自雇主的家园、店铺、仓库的具体情况。

他们接到的大多数任务都是取出雇主没有来得及取出的重要物资，还有的就是保护雇主财产和家园完整，直到彘庞男爵从怪物手中夺回摩罗城。

有些人接到的任务地点恰好就在商业街，他们也是第一批赶到商业街的人。

虽然不明白城中怪物为什么会大量聚集在商业街，但比起探查究竟，当然还是保命第一。

“不对，这里的怪物虽然多，但也远不如我们之前推测的。”

“是啊，这里顶多聚集了一两千的怪物，其他怪物都在哪里？路上我们就没看到几个。”

“会不会集中在西北边的贫民区？”

“都变成怪物了，怎么还会待在原地不动？”

“会不会有人在我们之前就进来杀怪了？”

“有这个可能。但是……尸体呢？谁看到大量怪物尸体？”

几个雇佣兵面面相觑，事情真的太古怪。

“不管了！城中怪物少还不好吗？这么大一座城，还这么完整，我们又很可能是第一批进来的人，不是正好方便我们……嘿嘿！”

几个雇佣兵一起嘿嘿笑起来，立刻转向他们之前看好的一个贵族府邸。

类似的对话和场景不断出现。

绝大多数进入摩罗城的兽人都暂时远离了商业街，只有少数几个能力特别的兽人留下来负责在外围查探情况。

也有人进入市中心的钟塔附近，只看到三三两两零落的怪物。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 73: Shock (Part 1)

As soon as Baron Zhipang's men entered the city, they dashed toward the Baron's Manor.

Everyone moved with great caution. They vigilantly scanned the houses, rooftops, and dark alleys on both sides of the street, guarding against any monster that might suddenly spring out.

But after advancing for quite a while, they noticed a very strange phenomenon.

"Deacon Ludwig, have you noticed that the monsters in the city don't seem to be as numerous as we expected?"

The middle-aged man addressed as deacon was being protected in the middle of the squad. He appeared to be forcing himself to remain calm, but in truth, his muscles were tense with anxiety. Hearing the squad leader speak to him, his shoulders twitched slightly in surprise.

"Ah. Yes... We've walked all this way and barely encountered any monsters. It really is a bit strange..."

According to their earlier deductions outside the city, at least several thousand citizens had died at the hands of the insect poison spreaders back then. As for how many failed to escape the city in time, no one knew for sure.

They hadn't compiled detailed figures yet, as Baron Zhipang was currently sending people to locate the fleeing citizens and conduct a census. However, judging by the number of refugees gathered, over seventy to eighty percent of the population should have successfully fled.

In this regard, one had to praise the City Guards for ringing the alarm bell promptly. Although it triggered chaos in the city and lacked an organized evacuation, it at least allowed the vast majority of citizens to flee during the critical first window—the very night the infected corpses transformed into monsters.

If everyone had dithered and failed to flee before a massive number of corpses transformed into monsters, the number of injured citizens would have skyrocketed. Those wounded citizens would likely have contracted the insect poison, mutated into monsters, and caused a chain reaction of human-to-human transmission.

Once the number of monsters surpassed the citizens, Moruo City would truly be doomed.

Though there were still many monsters in Moruo City now, it was within a manageable scope. This was also a major reason why Baron Zhipang dared to establish his army and camp less than ten miles outside the city.

And because the number of monsters in Moruo City wasn't extraordinarily high, the number that escaped the city was relatively small. The City Guard and some powerful beastmen could barely handle encounters with them, preventing the newly established camps from collapsing again.

Even so, everyone felt immensely worried and tense upon entering the city.

A several-thousand-strong force of monsters was by no means small. Moreover, they feared neither death nor injury, felt no pain, and required no provisions. Every monster existed solely to kill living beings and spread the insect poison.

Not to mention that if these monsters so much as scratched or bit a beastman, it would cause them to mutate.

Facing such monsters, ordinary beastmen would have their knees trembling with fear upon sight; being able to exert even half their normal combat potential was already impressive.

It could be said that the City Guards and deacons dispatched into the city this time were essentially a suicide squad. Before entering, they had all written their final wills, and Baron Zhipang had promised to double their family's compensation should they fall in battle.

Naturally, if they completed their mission, the rewards would be exceedingly lavish.

Who could have guessed! Having prepared themselves to die, they found the situation far better than imagined.

Had the occasion and circumstances not been inappropriate, the beastmen of this squad would have loved to climb onto the roofs to search for where those monsters were hiding.

"Deacon, look! Who is that person on the roof?"

The squad leader pointed in astonishment toward the highest point of the Baron's Manor.

Deacon Ludwig instinctively looked up where the leader pointed and saw an extraordinarily striking beastman.

The individual had shoulder-length silver hair, a tall and slender physique, and wore a tailored robe. Just looking at his profile revealed a remarkably handsome face.

The figure seemed to notice them as well; his gaze swept lightly over them before he leaped off the roof and vanished.

"Oh no!" Deacon Ludwig's expression changed slightly.

He began to worry about the wealth left behind in the Baron's Manor.

Why had he entered the city with the first wave of the suicide squad?

Precisely because he had received the Baron's order to inspect the state of the Baron's Manor, with a focus on getting the entering City Guards to secure it, preventing the beastmen entering to slay monsters from "incidentally" paying the manor a visit.

When they retreated back then, they hadn't taken many things with them. He himself held the keys to the doors of two critical storehouses.

"Quick! Speed up! We must enter the manor before anyone else!" Disregarding his fear, Deacon Ludwig urged repeatedly.

The squad leader didn't hesitate. One of their orders was to protect this deacon and obey his commands. The second order was to use the Baron's Manor as a City Guard outpost... which effectively meant protecting the manor.

By the time the squad rushed into the Baron's Manor at top speed, they found the entire place completely bare and empty.

Not as a figure of speech, but literally empty.

Not only were the storehouses emptied, but even the rooms belonging to the Baron, the Baroness, the Baron's eldest son, and other important figures were swept clean, with much of the fine furniture missing without a trace.

Deacon Ludwig's face instantly drained of color.

When he ran toward the two storehouses protected by alchemy doors with a flicker of hope remaining, he found both doors left ajar.

Ruined!

Deacon Ludwig's hands trembled as he slowly pushed open the ajar doors...

"...Send someone to inform Lord Baron."

"What should we say?" The squad leader was also deeply troubled.

"Report exactly what we see," the deacon replied, pale-faced.

The squad leader was puzzled at first, but then seemed to realize something. "That silver-haired beastman! The manor being cleaned out definitely has to do with him."

The deacon turned around, leaving the emptied storehouse. "Send someone."

Although the Baron's Manor was empty, as the symbol of Moruo City, it still needed to be guarded. Moreover, with so many rooms, it could serve as one of the City Guard's bases.

This detachment of the City Guard remained behind, utilizing the manor's perimeter walls to construct defensive towers and a command post.

This squad wasn't the only team to feel there were few monsters in the city; beastmen in other squads shared the exact same sentiment.

Until someone entered the Commercial Street—the closer they got to the city's largest auction house, the denser the monsters became.

Because the concentration of monsters on the Commercial Street was unusually high, giving the impression that all the monsters in the city had gathered there, many mercenaries and adventurers who ran over wanting to make a move had no choice but to leave the area for now.

Besides the beastmen looking to profit from the chaos, many teams had accepted commissions to enter, tasked with checking the specific conditions of their employers' homes, shops, and warehouses.

Most of the tasks they accepted involved retrieving important supplies their employers hadn't had time to take, or protecting the integrity of their employers' property and homes until Baron Zhipang reclaimed Moruo City from the monsters.

The locations of some people's missions happened to be right on the Commercial Street, making them among the first to arrive there.

Although they didn't understand why the city's monsters were congregating in huge numbers on the Commercial Street, staying alive naturally took priority over investigating the reason.

"No, even though there are a lot of monsters here, it's still far less than what we calculated earlier."

"Yeah, at most one or two thousand monsters are gathered here. Where are the rest? We barely saw any on our way over."

"Could they be concentrated in the slummy district to the northwest?"

"They've turned into monsters—why would they just stay put in one spot?"

"Could someone have come in to kill the monsters before us?"

"It's possible. But... where are the corpses? Who saw piles of monster corpses?"

Several mercenaries looked at each other in confusion; the situation was truly far too strange.

"Who cares! Isn't it a good thing that there are fewer monsters in the city? In such a large, fully intact city, and with us likely being among the very first to enter, isn't it perfect for us to... hehe!"

Several mercenaries chuckled together and immediately turned toward a noble manor they had set their sights on earlier.

Similar conversations and scenes played out continuously across the city.

The vast majority of beastmen who entered Moruo City temporarily steered clear of the Commercial Street, leaving only a few uniquely skilled individuals to observe the situation from the perimeter.

Some also entered the area around the central clocktower, seeing only scattered groups of two or three monsters.

chunks.chineseText:
城卫军人数最多的一支队伍杀入市中心，除了少数人，很少有人知道摩罗城最重要的粮食仓库和军备仓库就盖在钟塔下方。

更没有几个人知道这两个最重要的地下仓库还有一条通往城外的秘密地下通道。

这条秘密地下通道非运送粮草和军备时不能开启，就是为了保密，也为了能给这座城的领主留下一张底牌。

彘庞男爵逃离摩罗城时情况还没有紧急到需要利用这条地下通道。

可能会有人奇怪为什么这样能在紧急情况下可以保命的地下通道不是建在男爵府内。

实际上，彘庞男爵少年时被父亲告知这条密道时也问过父亲同样的问题。

他的父亲告诉他：这条密道建在大繁华纪，曾经这里是一座繁华的城市，摩罗城就是在这座城市的地基上建造起来。地面上的建筑物在大战纪都毁得差不多，但奇迹的是有些地下建筑被完好地遗留下来。

他的父亲还告诉他：说他祖父原本想在这条密道的上面建造男爵府，但他的曾祖父却选择了现在男爵府的地址，选址原因因为曾祖父早早离世，已经没有人知道。但他们家的男爵府建在那个地址后就一直很顺，后来就没有再搬迁。之后他的祖父就在这条密道旁边开辟了地下仓库，又在仓库上面建造城卫军兵营和钟塔。

总之，第二支城卫军队伍赶来钟塔就是为了占领这处高地，同时保护这里的城市粮仓和军备库。

领队同时受命，如果发现情况不妙，就从地下通道把仓库里的粮草和军备全都偷偷运送出城。

除了这里的城市库存，城卫军还有一个地方要去，那就是位于药剂市场的中转仓库，那里有最大的药材和药剂存储中心。

在所有人都撤离摩罗城时，那个存储中心还有兽人留守。

那个存储中心同样位于地下，也是大繁华纪时期留下来的地下建筑，里面还用了不少现今人无法理解也无法掌握的科技手段。

好在屏除那些让现今兽人搞不懂的科技手段，那个地下空间还是有不少地方可以利用。

那里甚至还通上水和下水，空气流通也不成问题，能保证上万兽人躲在那里也能生活一段时间。

当然，那里现在没有那么多兽人，只有药商安排的看守人员。

而城中大药商背后都有贵族支持，最大的贵族就是彘庞男爵。换言之，这座城最大的药商也就是彘庞男爵。

同样，彘庞男爵也掌握着本城最大最多的药剂和药材库存。

商非凡和不帅在满城乱转时也发现了这个药剂地下仓储中心，但两人都没打这个仓储中心的主意，甚至都没有接近。

不是他们忌惮彘庞男爵和城中大药商们，而是觉得没必要。

摩罗城只是暂时遇到危难，并没有真正被摧毁，城外还有十万城民急着想要回家，灾难过后，他们也会是最需要粮食和药物的人。

如果他们把所有仓库全都搬空，最先倒霉的不是彘庞男爵和那些大商人，而是这十万城民。

当然他们也可以利用这些仓库里的库存，掌握摩罗城的命脉，谋夺民心，抢夺彘庞男爵的权力，但……问题是两人现在谁也不打算占据摩罗城当起义军首领。

如果只是把仓库里的东西抢夺下来再分发给十万城民，那就更没必要。

救灾、发放救灾物资等，这些也都需要精细的组织和策划。不是说把东西往那一堆，让人上来领取就可以，那只会造成更大混乱，让真正需要这些物资的人反而什么都得不到。

“彘庞男爵终于派人进城除怪了。”不帅已经变回人形，站在一处屋顶，眺望着远处动静。

以他的超绝听力，大量兽人进入摩罗城的瞬间，他就听到了动静。

两人不想引人注目，杀了身边那批怪后，就设法摆脱了那些怪物，远离了钟楼附近。

商非凡就站在他一边，“这是第四天。也是逃出城的城民能支撑的极限。当时很多人只顾着逃命，并没有带出多少食物和财产，就算野外能弄到一部分食物，也无法在短时间内供应这么多人。

找不到食物、又不愿远离家乡的人必然会返回摩罗城附近，并希望他们的领主给他们做主。彘庞男爵再不派人进来，他就要失去城民的信赖和当城主的威信。”

“好在散播在空气中的虫毒已经消散得差不多，都已经沉入大地中。”不帅轻轻叹气。

虫毒很难自然溶解，会沉入大地和水源中，虽然其毒性不会让兽人们只是吃土喝水也异变，却会破坏土壤和水质，让庄稼和药草等更难长出来。

“自然之神已经在恢复，兽人大陆还有希望。”商非凡随口说。

不帅却眼睛一亮：“是啊，我们还有希望！你能找到自然之神其他的散落力量吗？”

商非凡笑：“现在你愿意和我一起去寻找自然之神散落的力量了？”

不帅不看他：“反正我也没什么事要做。”

“我以为你组建了自己的势力。”商非凡直接说破自己的怀疑。

不帅侧头看他：“是什么让你这么猜测？”

商非凡在口袋里摸了摸，从雕像广场的一个小箱子里摸出一封信，递给不帅。

不帅接过这封血迹斑斑的信，打开。

【我和拉斐尔（血迹）先生有（血迹）殊关系……，他说他会把接头信物交给我……】

商非凡等不帅看完全部内容，笑问：“接头信物是什么？能给我看看吗？”

不帅沉默地收起信件，直接揣进了自己的口袋。

商非凡任他拿走这个重要的任务道具：“其实比起接头信物，我更好奇你和信主人到底有什么特殊关系？”

“没有任何特殊关系。”虎不帅淡淡说：“这封信关键的不是内容，是里面几个隐藏字。”

结果让你用来胡说八道！

商非凡像是完全忘记了自己是怎么编造他和不帅的暧昧成年人关系的，抱臂：“也就是说信件内容只是用来扰乱他人视线，实际上这封信本身就是你们的接头信物？”

虎不帅承认：“对。如果这封信被改动、被誊抄过，那几个隐藏字就会消失。”

“所以你们搞得这么秘密，到底是为了什么？”商非凡实在很好奇，他想知道不帅的一切。

之前他还能忍受不帅隐瞒他，但现在他恨不得扒光他所有秘密。

尤其是不帅之前“认识的人”，他恨不得挨个扒拉一遍。

虎不帅亮出一枚黑色带金边的骨牌。

商非凡不客气地拿过骨牌仔细看。

“艹！你也是特别调查官？”

虎不帅点头：“对，还是比较隐秘的那种，一般人不知道，一般的调查官也不会知道。我算是直属于虎王。”

“所以你和诺曼霍希尔约在莫约镇见面是为了调查案件？”商非凡有种“就这”的失望心情。

虎不帅再次点头：“他应该给我带来了某些秘密消息，我也有消息要通过他传递给调查局。只是……霍希尔调查官没想到自己的行踪会被察觉，被人跟踪，最后被人杀害。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 73: Shock (Part 2)

The largest squad of the City Guard fought their way into the city center. Aside from a handful of people, very few knew that Moruo City's most vital grain and military storehouses were built beneath the clocktower.

Even fewer knew that these two paramount underground storehouses possessed a secret subterranean passage leading outside the city.

This secret underground passage could not be opened except when transporting grain and military equipment, both to maintain secrecy and to preserve a trump card for the city's lord.

When Baron Zhipang fled Moruo City, the situation hadn't yet reached a crisis level that necessitated using this underground passage.

Some might wonder why a secret underground passage capable of saving lives during emergency situations wasn't built inside the Baron's Manor.

In fact, when Baron Zhipang was informed of this secret passage by his father in his youth, he had asked his father the exact same question.

His father told him: This secret passage was constructed during the Era of Great Prosperity. Back then, a thriving metropolis stood here, and Moruo City was built upon its foundations. Most of the surface structures were destroyed during the Era of Great War, but miraculously, some underground constructions survived intact.

His father also told him that his grandfather had originally intended to build the Baron's Manor directly above this secret passage. However, his great-grandfather chose the current site of the Baron's Manor instead. The reason for that choice remained unknown because his great-grandfather passed away early. Yet, after their family's manor was built on that site, everything had gone smoothly, so they never relocated. Afterward, his grandfather opened up the underground storehouses beside this secret passage and built the City Guard barracks and clocktower right above them.

In short, the second squad of City Guards rushed to the clocktower precisely to occupy this high ground while simultaneously protecting the city's granary and armory located here.

The squad leader was also instructed that if things took a turn for the worse, he should secretly transport all the grain, fodder, and armaments out of the city via the underground passage.

Beyond the municipal inventory here, the City Guard had another destination: the transfer warehouse in the potion market, home to the largest storage center for medicinal herbs and potions.

When everyone evacuated Moruo City, some beastmen stayed behind to guard that storage center.

That storage center was likewise underground, another remnant of the Era of Great Prosperity that utilized quite a few technological means incomprehensible and unmastered by people today.

Fortunately, setting aside the advanced technology that modern beastmen couldn't comprehend, there were still plenty of usable spaces within that underground complex.

It even had functional water supply and drainage systems, as well as proper ventilation, ensuring that even if over ten thousand beastmen hid down there, they could survive for a period of time.

Of course, there weren't that many beastmen down there right now, only guards assigned by the potion merchants.

And behind the city's prominent potion merchants were noble backers, the greatest of whom was Baron Zhipang. In other words, the biggest potion merchant in the city was none other than Baron Zhipang himself.

Naturally, Baron Zhipang also controlled the city's largest stock of potions and medicinal herbs.

As Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai wandered around the city, they too discovered this underground potion storage center, but neither laid eyes on it with intent to loot, nor did they even approach it.

It wasn't because they feared Baron Zhipang or the wealthy merchants, but rather because they felt it was unnecessary.

Moruo City was only experiencing a temporary crisis; it hadn't been truly destroyed. Outside the city, a hundred thousand citizens were anxiously waiting to return home, and after the disaster passed, they would be the ones in direst need of food and medicine.

If they cleaned out all the storehouses, the first to suffer wouldn't be Baron Zhipang or those wealthy merchants, but these hundred thousand citizens.

Of course, they could also utilize the contents of these storehouses to grasp Moruo City's lifeblood, win the hearts of the people, and seize Baron Zhipang's power... But the problem was that neither of them currently intended to occupy Moruo City and act as rebel leaders.

If it were merely to loot the storehouses and distribute the goods to the hundred thousand citizens, that was even less necessary.

Disaster relief and distributing relief supplies required meticulous organization and planning. It wasn't as simple as piling things up and letting people come claim them; that would only spark greater chaos and prevent those in actual need from getting anything.

"Baron Zhipang has finally sent people into the city to purge the monsters." Bu Shuai had reverted to his human form, standing on a roof while gazing into the distance.

With his extraordinary hearing, he had picked up the noise the moment a large force of beastmen entered Moruo City.

Unwilling to draw attention, the two had killed the nearby pack of monsters, shaken off the rest, and moved far away from the clocktower's vicinity.

Shang Feifan stood beside him. "This is the fourth day. It's also the limit of what the refugees outside can endure. Many fled in a hurry without bringing much food or property. Even if they can forage some food in the wilderness, it can't sustain so many people for long.

Those who can't find food and refuse to leave their homeland will inevitably return to the vicinity of Moruo City and hope their lord will take charge. If Baron Zhipang doesn't send people in soon, he will lose the trust of his citizens and his prestige as city lord."

"Fortunately, the insect poison dispersed in the air has mostly vanished, having settled into the earth," Bu Shuai sighed softly.

The insect poison was hard to naturally break down; it settled into the soil and water sources. Although its toxicity wouldn't cause beastmen to mutate simply from eating dirt or drinking water, it would ruin the soil and water quality, making crops and medicinal herbs much harder to grow.

"The God of Nature is already recovering. There is still hope for the Beastman Continent," Shang Feifan said casually.

Bu Shuai's eyes lit up. "Yeah, we still have hope! Can you locate the other scattered powers of the God of Nature?"

Shang Feifan chuckled. "Now you're willing to go search for the scattered powers of the God of Nature with me?"

Bu Shuai looked away. "I don't have anything else to do anyway."

"I thought you were building your own faction," Shang Feifan stated his suspicion outright.

Bu Shuai turned his head to look at him. "What made you guess that?"

Shang Feifan rummaged in his pocket and pulled out a letter from the small chest retrieved from the Statue Square, handing it to Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai took the blood-stained letter and opened it.

["I have a (bloodstain) special relationship with Mr. Raphael (bloodstain)... He said he would hand the rendezvous token to me..."]

Shang Feifan waited for Bu Shuai to finish reading, then smiled and asked, "What is the rendezvous token? Mind letting me see it?"

Bu Shuai silently tucked the letter away, stowing it straight into his own pocket.

Shang Feifan let him take the important quest item. "Actually, rather than the token, I'm more curious about what kind of 'special relationship' you had with the letter's writer?"

"There's no special relationship whatsoever," Hu Bushuai said calmly. "The key to this letter isn't its contents, but a few hidden characters embedded within it."

*Which you used to talk complete nonsense!*

Shang Feifan seemed to have entirely forgotten how he had previously fabricated an intimate, adult relationship between himself and Bu Shuai. Folding his arms, he remarked, "In other words, the written text was just a distraction to throw others off, and the letter itself was your rendezvous token?"

Hu Bushuai admitted, "Correct. If this letter were altered or transcribed, those hidden characters would disappear."

"So why were you guys being so secretive? What on earth was it all for?" Shang Feifan was genuinely curious; he wanted to know everything about Bu Shuai.

Previously, he could tolerate Bu Shuai keeping secrets from him, but now he wished he could uncover every single one of them.

Especially those "acquaintances" Bu Shuai knew before—he desperately wanted to investigate them one by one.

Hu Bushuai produced a black bone token with a gold border.

Shang Feifan unceremoniously grabbed the bone token to inspect it closely.

"Fuck! You're a Special Investigator too?"

Hu Bushuai nodded. "Yes, an undercover one. Ordinary people don't know about us, and even regular investigators aren't aware. I directly report to the Tiger King."

"So your meeting with Norman Hosier in Moyuo Town was to investigate a case?" Shang Feifan felt a sense of disappointment, like *that's all?*

Hu Bushuai nodded again. "He was supposed to bring me certain secret intel, and I had information to pass back to the Investigation Bureau through him. It's just... Investigator Hosier didn't expect his whereabouts to be tracked. He was followed and ultimately murdered."

chunks.chineseText:
“杀害诺曼霍希尔的人是咒术师卢希恩，但我们都知道卢希恩背后的人才是真正凶手。”

“我知道。”如果不是宰相艾萨克怀疑他想要染指他不该染指的东西，怀疑他和某些大臣以及贵族勾连，又怎么会让咒术师卢希恩直接杀死和他接头的诺曼霍希尔？

诺曼霍希尔可谓死得十分冤枉，他大概至死也不知道他只是因为一国宰相怀疑他想和王的私生子勾连，就宁可错杀一千的把他杀死了。

“我可以知道你和诺曼霍希尔接头调查的是什么案情吗？”

不帅沉默了一会儿，回答：“其实你已经知道了，就是邪神阴影者的事。王怀疑邪神阴影者不断出现在虎国是和某些心怀不轨的人有关。他想找出虎国中有没有人和邪神信徒勾连。

诺曼霍希尔来莫约镇找我，很可能是调查局那边查到了一些线索。另外……也是王不放心我一个人，特意派一个人手来给我帮忙。”

商非凡一听就懂：“帮忙？你确定不是监视？”

不帅不想回答这个问题，转而说：“我其实不太想管这些事情，尤其不想和虎国上层阶级接触。但邪神阴影者不止威胁到虎王的统治，它们更威胁和伤害到无辜的普通兽人们。所以我接受了特别调查官的职务，答应虎王在离开王城后会到处看看。但虎王也没有特别强求我一定要做到什么，他给我这个身份，更多还是为了保护我。”

“听起来你对虎王还有一点感情？他真是你亲生父亲？”商非凡顺势问。

不帅皱眉：“我们好像没这么熟。”

商非凡手掌搭住他的肩膀：“熟不熟的还是要看相处。你身后真的没有自己组建的秘密势力？”

虎不帅差点翻白眼：“没有！我知道你在想什么。我只是以前帮过某些人，和他们建立了一定联系，并不代表他们为我服务，更不代表他们是我的势力。”

商非凡：“你可以有。”

虎不帅硬邦邦：“没必要。我从来没有想过要当王，我连官都不想当。”

商非凡乐了：“原来你还拥有一颗自由的心。很好，以后你就跟着我浪迹天涯吧，让我们一起奔向自由美好的明天，我们一起过快乐的日子~”

虎不帅什么都不想说了。

两人略事休息就悄默默地摸向城外，打算离开摩罗城。

这时，路德维希执事和城卫军派出的传信兵也正奔跑在出城的路上，打算把城中情况传递给彘庞男爵。

他们要告诉彘庞男爵，如今摩罗城里的怪物不算多，完全可以派大军通过引怪的方式来进行分片包围和剿灭。

也就是说他们从怪物手中夺回摩罗城的希望非常大！

虎不帅听到了轻微的脚步声从附近房顶传来。

他拉住商非凡，两人躲到阴影里。

他们也不是怕见人，只是两人并不想让其他人知道他们是第一批进入摩罗城的人，自然能避就避。

商非凡翻广场库存，找到两块面巾，拿出来递给不帅一块。

不帅熟练地把布巾系到脸上。

商非凡同样。

哒。非常轻微的脚掌落地声。

有人从房顶上跳下来，正在向他们这个方向走近。

商非凡和虎不帅躲在角落阴影里一起看向那边。

西斜的阳光撒到对方身上，衬托得对方一头飘逸的银发就像是在发光，那俊美立体的五官更是让人一见难忘。

商非凡眼中流露出些许讶异：这不是那位给玩家们发放任务的重要NPC，天残谷主吗？他怎么会来到这里？

商非凡正诧异，忽然感觉到身边的不帅呼吸似乎有点不对劲。

商非凡下意识转头看向不帅。

就见不帅眼睛直直地盯着天残谷主，那神情就像是看到了死人复活、外星飞碟落地、天空裂开巨口……总之就是要有多震惊就有多震惊，同时混乱。

Chapter 73: Shock (Part 3)

"The one who killed Norman Hosier was Sorcerer Lucien, but we both know the mastermind behind Lucien is the true murderer."

"I know." If Prime Minister Isaac hadn't suspected that he wanted to lay hands on things he shouldn't, or suspected he was conspiring with certain ministers and nobles, why else would Isaac order Sorcerer Lucien to outright kill Norman Hosier, who was meeting him?

Norman Hosier truly died a tragic and wrongful death. Right up until his end, he likely never realized he was killed simply because the kingdom's Prime Minister suspected he might be colluding with the King's illegitimate son—preferring to kill a thousand innocents than let one culprit slip through.

"May I ask what case you and Norman Hosier were meeting up to investigate?"

Bu Shuai fell silent for a moment before answering, "Actually, you already know. It's regarding the Shadowers of the Evil God. His Majesty suspects that the frequent appearances of the Evil God's Shadowers in the Tiger Kingdom are tied to certain individuals with treacherous ambitions. He wanted to uncover whether anyone in the Tiger Kingdom is conspiring with the Evil God's cultists.

Norman Hosier came to Moyuo Town to find me likely because the Investigation Bureau uncovered some leads. Moreover... His Majesty was worried about me being alone, so he specifically dispatched an extra hand to assist me."

Shang Feifan understood instantly. "Assist? Are you sure it wasn't to monitor you?"

Bu Shuai didn't want to answer that question and redirected the topic instead. "I actually didn't want to get involved in these affairs, especially having contact with the Tiger Kingdom's upper class. However, the Shadowers of the Evil God don't just threaten the Tiger King's rule; they harm and endanger innocent ordinary beastmen. So I accepted the position of Special Investigator, promising the Tiger King that I would look around after leaving the Royal Capital. Still, the Tiger King didn't overly force me to achieve anything specific. Granting me this identity was mostly to protect me."

"Sounds like you still have some feelings for the Tiger King? Is he really your biological father?" Shang Feifan seized the opportunity to ask.

Bu Shuai frowned. "I don't think we're that close."

Shang Feifan rested a hand on his shoulder. "Close or not depends on how we spend time together. Do you really not have a secret faction of your own hidden behind your back?"

Hu Bushuai almost rolled his eyes. "No! I know what you're thinking. I only helped certain people in the past and established some connections with them. That doesn't mean they serve me, and it certainly doesn't make them my faction."

Shang Feifan said, "You could have one."

Hu Bushuai replied stiffly, "Unnecessary. I've never wanted to be a king, nor do I even want to be an official."

Shang Feifan was amused. "Turns out you possess a free spirit after all. Excellent! In the future, just roam the ends of the earth with me. Let us dash toward a free and glorious tomorrow, living joyous days together~"

Hu Bushuai was left completely speechless.

After taking a brief rest, the two quietly snuck toward the outside of the city, intending to depart Moruo City.

Meanwhile, Deacon Ludwig and the messenger dispatched by the City Guard were also sprinting along the road out of the city, aiming to report the internal situation to Baron Zhipang.

They wanted to inform Baron Zhipang that the monsters in Moruo City were currently few in number. They could definitely send in a large army to lure out, encircle, and wipe out the monsters district by district.

Which meant their hopes of reclaiming Moruo City from the monsters were immensely high!

Hu Bushuai heard faint footsteps coming from a nearby rooftop.

He pulled Shang Feifan aside, and both melted into the shadows.

It wasn't that they were afraid of meeting anyone; they simply didn't want others to know they were the first to enter Moruo City, so naturally, they avoided contact whenever possible.

Shang Feifan searched his plaza storage inventory, pulled out two face veils, and handed one to Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai skillfully tied the cloth mask over his face.

Shang Feifan did the same.

*Tap.* An extremely light sound of footsteps landing.

Someone leaped down from the roof and was walking in their direction.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai peered out from the corner shadows together toward that direction.

The slanting rays of the setting sun bathed the figure, accentuating his flowing silver hair as though it were glowing. His handsome, well-defined facial features were unforgettable at a single glance.

A hint of surprise flashed in Shang Feifan's eyes: *Isn't this the key NPC who issues quests to players—the Valley Master of Tiancan Valley? Why did he come here?*

While Shang Feifan was bewildered, he suddenly felt that Bu Shuai's breathing beside him seemed off.

Shang Feifan subconsciously turned his head to look at Bu Shuai.

He saw Bu Shuai staring dead-straight at the Tiancan Valley Master. His expression was as if he had witnessed a corpse coming back to life, an alien UFO landing, or the sky splitting open... In short, he was as shocked and bewildered as humanly possible.

第74章 逼问

虎不帅是真的没想到他还能看到那张脸。

洛伦米尔顿。

上辈子他的第一个交往者。

他以为他已经遗忘了和对方的绝大多数事情，但看到这张脸，他脑中立马就浮现出他们第一次见面时的场景。

那时他正在赶往某国魔法学校的路上，为了筹措盘缠和学费，他靠着第一世的记忆做了一些食物，拿到当地集市上零卖。

他当时抱着和商非凡差不多的想法，就是利用美食打出口碑，然后把配方卖给当地的食肆酒楼和富贵人家。

就是可惜他手艺一般般，也就卖个口味新奇。

第一天摆摊他就遇到了洛伦米尔顿。

对方品尝了他做出来的小食，微笑着夸奖，问他是哪里人，和他主动搭话。

洛伦的气质非常好，再搭配上他那张俊美至极的脸，恐怕任何人都难以拒绝他的主动搭讪。

虎不帅也不能。

是人基本都是颜狗，除非审美异常。

虎不帅面对那张堪称完美的脸，也很难冷下脸。

更何况对方说话特别有分寸，不会热情过度，也不会制作冷场尴尬，就让你如沐春风。

只聊了一会儿，他就感觉这人的脾性特别好。

不知不觉间，洛伦就在摊位边陪他站了一个多小时。

他察觉，顿觉不好意思，他也没有带椅子，自己都没地方坐。

洛伦看出他的歉意，表示坐不坐无所谓，然后看着他、笑着跟他说，认识他很愉快，跟他在一起根本感觉不到时间流逝，更感觉不到疲累。

那时他还没有察觉对方的勾搭之意，只以为两人投缘。

因为他是魂穿这个世界，又没有获得这具身体的原有记忆，加上他性格不算外向，光是度过初期适应期就很是手忙脚乱。

他那时就像是刚到了外国，不会当地语言，更不知当地民情风俗的外国人。周围还没有认识的人，全都是陌生人。

周围都是陌生人的好处是看不出来他和原来的他有什么不同，不会怀疑他。

可也因为周围都是陌生人，他也得不到任何帮助。

没钱，语言不通，对当地不了解，导致他的初期穿越生活过得磕磕绊绊。

好在他运气还不错？

初期并没有遇到什么初到外国因为人生地不熟被骗被欺负的惨事，相反周围的人虽然不算热情，但真没遇上什么坏人。

他找了一家杂货行打工，店主对他不错，知道他语言不通，就让他负责理货和管理仓库。

且并没有因为他年轻就压榨他让他搬重货当个苦力，反而还很照顾他，平时还让自家孩子和他练习对话、教他当地通用语，还为他提供一日两餐和住宿。

等到他在一次很偶然的机会中得知自己竟然有魔法天赋后，也是这位店主主动督促他去找一个魔法学校报名学习魔法，让他不要浪费自己的天赋。还为他打听了很多关于魔法学校的小道消息。

普通人和魔法师就是两个不同世界的人，普通人想要打听魔法师和魔法学校的消息非常困难，听到的很多都是道听途说。

杂货行店主却给他提供了几条很靠谱的消息，比如几所魔法学校的确切地址，以及报名测试地点。

最后，店主还给他送了盘缠。

他非常感激这位店主，后来有能力回报后自然好好报答了对方。

话题扯远，总之就因为初期的忙碌和不适应，他基本没什么深交的朋友，也不敢和人深交，就怕被人察觉他来历不明。

可洛伦米尔顿的主动，以及他那适度的体贴和温柔，让他不由自主想要和这人多聊一会儿、多待一会儿。

就是感觉很合得来。

他在第一世都没有遇到这么合得来的人。

洛伦第一天买走了不少他做的小食，第二天就为他带来了当地食肆的掌柜，把他的小食推荐给对方，还特特夸奖口味新奇这点。

所以哪怕他的小食做的口味一般，那家食肆掌柜还是购买了他的配方。

他自然要感谢洛伦，就请他吃饭。

一来二去，两人就这么熟悉起来。

洛伦知道他要去魔法学校，表示他也顺路，两人就同行了。

途中，他发现洛伦竟然也会魔法，很激动，觉得自己幸运极了，就起了请教之心。

洛伦一开始也非常认真地教他基础魔法知识，教他怎么感知魔力。

但他的魔法天赋可能真的太一般，学了很久都无法入门，搞得他对去魔法学校学习一事已经不抱希望。

尤其洛伦告诉他，魔法学校并不是什么人都收，入学的人不仅要具有魔法天赋，还得通过学校测试。

后来见他入门困难，洛伦就说不如跟他游历一段时间，在这期间，他会负责教导他魔法知识，直到他的水平能通过魔法学校测试的水准。

他也觉得这个提议不错，更感激洛伦为他着想。

两人游历了一段时间，洛伦对他非常好，还多次保护他，又对他明显透露出喜欢他、想要和他在一起的意思。

人心都是肉做的，时间久了，他就沦陷了。

两人确定关系后，就找了个地方定居。他也不再提去魔法学校学习的事，他那时已经认定自己魔法天赋一般，肯定无法通过魔法学校的测试。

想着与其浪费时间在不擅长的事情上，还不如过好现在的日子。

洛伦也跟他说，他现在很好，没必要和自己较劲，说和这样的他在一起觉得心很安定，就喜欢这样平平淡淡的他。

他那时也沉醉在这种平淡但安详的生活中。为此，他甚至没有去特意打听对方的身世底细，更没有去问对方每次出门都是去做什么，他怕打破这种平稳。

他并不是那种委曲求全的人，遇到不愉快，他也许不会说出来，也许会找找自己的原因，但如果无法忍受，他会直接走人。

但和洛伦在一起，他也不知道为什么，变得越来越不自信，也越来越小心翼翼。

他就像是守着唯一珍宝的穷人，不敢使用这个珍宝，不敢让别人知道这个珍宝，更怕这个珍宝离自己而去。

当洛伦提出和他分手，他心里其实已经有“终于来了”的心理准备。

只是理智上能接受，付出的感情却没有那么容易收回。

他那时的情况真的很像是一个和丈夫结婚多年、也和社会脱节多年的家庭主妇，除了自己的小家，对外面完全陌生，还没有自己的经济来源，没有知识储备，没有特殊能力……

洛伦离去时也没有给他留下什么财产。

他那时还想着是因为洛伦照顾他的自尊心，所以才没有给他留钱。同样也因为照顾他的自尊心，平时不会送昂贵的礼物给他，因为他会按照同等价值回礼。

可能有人会觉得这样的他特别蠢。

但也许就因为这点，直到现在他觉得自己和洛伦的心理地位都是相等的，他半点不欠这个人。

虎不帅收回目光。

极短的时间内，他已经把和洛伦相识和相爱的那些年的记忆又在脑中过了一遍。
