Chapter 74: Interrogation (Part 1)

Hu Bushuai truly never expected that he would ever see that face again.

Loren Milton.

His first partner from his past life.

He thought he had forgotten most of the things between them, but the moment he saw this face, the scene of their first meeting instantly flashed in his mind.

Back then, he was on his way to a magic school in a certain country. To raise travel expenses and tuition fees, he had used the memories of his first life to make some food and sell it at a local market.

At the time, his thoughts were similar to Shang Feifan's: to build a reputation using delicious food, and then sell the recipes to local taverns, restaurants, and wealthy families.

It was just a pity that his culinary skills were mediocre; he was only selling them for their novel taste.

On his very first day setting up his stall, he met Loren Milton.

The other man tasted the snacks he made, praised them with a smile, asked where he was from, and took the initiative to strike up a conversation.

Loren had an exceptionally refined temperament. Combined with his incredibly handsome face, it was likely hard for anyone to refuse his advances.

Hu Bushuai was no exception.

Humans were basically suckers for good looks, unless their aesthetic tastes were abnormal.

Facing that near-perfect face, it was hard for Hu Bushuai to maintain a cold expression.

Moreover, the other man spoke with perfect propriety, never overly enthusiastic, yet never letting the conversation stall or become awkward, making one feel as comfortable as a spring breeze.

After chatting for just a short while, he felt that this person had an exceptionally good temperament.

Before he knew it, Loren had stood by his stall, keeping him company for over an hour.

When he realized this, he immediately felt embarrassed. He hadn't brought any chairs, and he didn't even have a place to sit himself.

Loren saw his apologetic look and indicated that sitting didn't matter. He then looked at him, smiled, and said that meeting him was a pleasure, and that being with him made him lose all track of time, let alone feel tired.

At that time, he hadn't realized the other man was hitting on him; he simply thought they got along well.

Because his soul had transmigrated into this world, and he hadn't obtained the original memories of this body, coupled with his not-so-outgoing personality, just getting through the initial adjustment period had left him in a frantic rush.

Back then, he was like a foreigner who had just arrived in a foreign country, unable to speak the local language and ignorant of the local customs. There was not a single person he knew around him; everyone was a stranger.

The advantage of being surrounded by strangers was that they couldn't tell how he differed from the original owner of the body, so they wouldn't suspect him.

But because everyone around him was a stranger, he couldn't get any help either.

Having no money, not speaking the language, and knowing nothing about the local area made his early life after transmigrating quite bumpy.

Fortunately, his luck wasn't too bad?

In the beginning, he didn't encounter any tragic incidents of being scammed or bullied due to being unfamiliar with the place. On the contrary, although the people around him weren't overly warm, he didn't run into any bad people.

He found a job at a grocery store. The shopkeeper treated him well. Knowing he couldn't speak the language, the shopkeeper had him handle inventory and manage the warehouse.

Furthermore, the shopkeeper didn't exploit him just because he was young by making him carry heavy loads as cheap labor. Instead, he took good care of him, often letting his own children practice speaking with him to teach him the local common tongue, and even provided him with two meals a day and lodging.

When he learned by pure chance that he actually possessed magical talent, it was also this shopkeeper who took the initiative to urge him to find a magic school to enroll and learn magic, telling him not to waste his talent. The shopkeeper even gathered a lot of insider rumors about magic schools for him.

Ordinary people and mages belonged to two completely different worlds. It was extremely difficult for ordinary people to inquire about mages and magic schools; much of what they heard was mere hearsay.

Yet, the grocery store owner provided him with several highly reliable pieces of information, such as the exact addresses of several magic schools and the locations for enrollment testing.

In the end, the shopkeeper even gave him travel expenses.

He was deeply grateful to this shopkeeper, and naturally repaid him handsomely once he had the ability to do so later on.

To get back to the point, because of his initial busyness and lack of adaptation, he basically had no close friends, nor did he dare to form deep connections with anyone, fearing that others would discover his mysterious origins.

But Loren Milton's initiative, along with his moderate consideration and gentleness, made him involuntarily want to chat with this person a little longer and spend more time together.

It just felt like they clicked.

He hadn't met anyone he clicked with so well even in his first life.

On the first day, Loren bought quite a few of his snacks. On the second day, he brought over the manager of a local tavern, recommending his snacks to him and particularly praising their novel flavor.

So even though his snacks tasted mediocre, the tavern manager still purchased his recipe.

Naturally, he had to thank Loren, so he treated him to a meal.

One thing led to another, and the two of them became familiar with each other.

Knowing he was heading to a magic school, Loren said he was going the same way, so they traveled together.

Along the way, he discovered that Loren actually knew magic as well. He was thrilled, feeling incredibly lucky, and eagerly sought his guidance.

At first, Loren was also very earnest in teaching him basic magical knowledge and how to perceive mana.

But his magical talent might have been truly too mediocre. After learning for a long time, he still couldn't even cross the threshold, which made him lose hope in studying at a magic school.

Especially when Loren told him that magic schools didn't just accept anyone; those enrolling not only had to possess magical talent but also had to pass the school's entrance test.

Later, seeing his difficulty in getting started, Loren suggested that he might as well travel with him for a while. During this time, Loren would be responsible for teaching him magic until his level reached the standard required to pass the magic school's test.

He also thought this was a good proposal and felt even more grateful to Loren for being so considerate of him.

The two traveled together for a period. Loren treated him exceptionally well, protected him multiple times, and clearly expressed his affection and desire to be with him.

Hearts are not made of stone; over time, he fell for him.

After establishing their relationship, they found a place to settle down. He no longer brought up the matter of studying at a magic school. By then, he had already accepted that his magical talent was mediocre and that he would definitely fail the school's test.

He figured that rather than wasting time on something he wasn't good at, he might as well live a good life in the present.

Loren also told him that he was perfect as he was, that there was no need to push himself too hard, and that being with him like this made his heart feel at peace—he liked him just the way he was, plain and simple.

At that time, he was also intoxicated by this plain yet peaceful life. For this reason, he didn't even deliberately inquire about the other's background or ask what he did every time he went out, fearing he would shatter this stability.

He wasn't the type of person to compromise and swallow his pride. If he encountered something unpleasant, he might not say it out loud, and he might look for his own faults, but if it became unbearable, he would simply leave.

Yet, being with Loren, for some unknown reason, made him increasingly insecure and cautious.

He was like a poor man guarding his sole treasure, not daring to use it, not daring to let others know about it, and even more afraid that this treasure would leave him.

When Loren proposed to break up, he actually already had a mental preparation of "it's finally here."

It was just that while his intellect could accept it, the feelings he had invested were not so easily clawed back.

His situation back then was truly like a housewife who had been married to her husband for many years and had been out of touch with society for just as long. Aside from her own little home, the outside world was completely foreign. She had no source of income, no store of knowledge, no special skills...

Loren didn't leave him any property when he departed.

At the time, he even thought it was because Loren was being considerate of his self-esteem, which was why he didn't leave him money. Similarly, out of consideration for his self-esteem, Loren wouldn't usually give him expensive gifts, because he would try to return a gift of equal value.

Some might think he was incredibly foolish.

But perhaps because of this, even now, he felt that his psychological standing with Loren had always been equal. He didn't owe this man a single thing.

Hu Bushuai withdrew his gaze.

In a split second, he had already run through the memories of the years he met and loved Loren in his mind once more.

chunks.chineseText:
也因为这些记忆，和他对洛伦米尔顿的熟悉，让他十分确定那个银发兽人就是洛伦米尔顿！

虽然对方的头发颜色变了，从黑色变成银色。对方的人种也变了，从纯人类变成有长尖兽耳的兽人。

对方穿着做工精细的长袍，看不出他有没有尾巴。

仅从他的耳朵上看，也看不出他的兽人种族。

但不管他是什么品种的兽人，他都是洛伦米尔顿。

他甚至很确定对方仍旧拥有前世的记忆，因为对方的走路姿态、神情、某些小动作，都和前世一模一样。

如果一个人没有了记忆和习惯，从小婴儿开始成长，就算灵魂相同，也会长成不一样的人。

所以为什么洛伦米尔顿也会来到兽人世界？

为什么洛伦也能穿越？

为什么他的相貌没有任何改变？

为什么他们两人都来到了兽人世界？

难道是因为他们缘分没了？

虎不帅发出轻嗤的笑声。

商非凡一直在看不帅。

他们这时发出声音也没事，因为那个天残谷主已经走远。

“你认识他。”商非凡说的是肯定句。

虎不帅没有回应。

但这种没回应其实已经是一种回应。

如果不帅不认识天残谷主，他肯定会直接说不认识，也就是因为认识，且关系特殊，才会出现这种沉默现象。

商非凡心里不得劲，总觉得俊美的天残谷主看起来特别像挖他墙角的狗男人。

他家不帅看那个天残谷主的神情可不像是“只认识”那么简单。

“你之前是不是一直生活在王城？大半年前才去往莫约镇，然后就一直待在莫约镇？”商非凡换了问题。

虎不帅不知道商非凡为什么会这么问，他心里还在震荡中，就没怎么提防地回答：“嗯。”

商非凡大脑飞速转动：“我知道那个人，他是天残谷主，据说他从出生开始就没有离开过天残谷。所以你和他在理论上应该没有见过面，更不可能彼此认识。”

虎不帅惊讶：“他是天残谷主？他是天残？”

很好，不帅这句话又给他透露了不少信息。商非凡摆手：“他是不是天残不重要，重要的是，你和他是怎么认识的？”

虎不帅不喜欢商非凡这种咄咄逼人的口吻，皱眉：“我和他怎么认识的关你什么事？”

“我在追求你，当然关我的事。”商非凡逼近不帅，眼眸的暗红色更加明显。

虎不帅往后退，却发现后面就是墙角，他已经无路可退。

他只能伸手抵住对方胸膛，不让对方再靠近。

商非凡就那么恶狠狠地看着他。

虎不帅怒气涌上心头，喝：“往后退！逼得这么近，你是想打架吗？”

商非凡额头抵住不帅额头，不说话。

虎不帅手臂被大力推压得无法伸直。两人胸膛之间的距离已经只有十厘米不到。

“你不知道他是天残谷主，你在王城和莫约镇都没有见过他，所以……他是你在法德尔大陆的旧人？让我猜猜，他是不是你那几个情人之一？”商非凡说到后面，声音越来越暗哑。

虎不帅：“……”

这人的脑子太可怕了，他是怎么那么快得出这样的结论的？

“你不会到现在还惦记着他吧？”商非凡抵着不帅的脑门，轻哼：“不过那家伙长得确实人模狗样，也就比我差一点。谁还不是只颜狗，你会记住这么个家伙也不奇怪。但我敢保证，他活计肯定没我好。你要不要试试？”

虎不帅震惊到家。

他知道这人脸皮厚，但不知道他竟然能这么直接、这么无耻！

两秒，虎不帅的脸和脖颈全部爆红。

他气得脑袋都冒烟了。

“试你妈！你给我滚开！”极少说脏话的不帅都被激得喷出脏话。

“看来那家伙功夫不太行。你明显对他不太满意。”商非凡非常肯定地说。

“我去你……！”虎不帅用力踹商非凡小腿，想要把人踹开。

商非凡不动，贡献自己的小腿任他踹。

“亲爱的，你知道脱敏治疗吗？我觉得你现在就很需要。”

“滚！”

“他伤害过你吗？”

“滚开！”

“你被他伤害过。”又是肯定句。

“没有！我们是和平分手。”虎不帅脱口而出，说完他就后悔至极。

商非凡心里已经把天残谷主剁成渣渣，脸上却风平浪静，只把抵住不帅额头的脑门移开，低头看着他家不帅。

“既然是和平分手，那就聊聊你和他是怎么认识的，认识了多久，上了几次床，又是怎么分手的。”

“艹！我为什么要跟你聊这些？”虎不帅又震惊又尴尬又气恼，用力推商非凡。

商非凡仗着自己力气大，双腿犹如焊在地上的铁柱，纹丝-不动：“因为我想要知道你的所有事情，包括你曾经有过几个情人，以及你们是怎么相处的。你的一切，我都想知道。”

“你知道你这种人叫什么吗！”

“控制狂？”

虎不帅冷笑：“原来你还有自知之明。有毛病就赶紧去治，别在我这儿发疯！凭什么你想知道我的事，我就得告诉你？别说你喜欢我，这个理由只会让我恶心！”

这话很重，但商非凡脸色丝毫没变：“哦。我的喜欢让你恶心真抱歉。如果你想走相爱相杀的路，我也不反对。”

虎不帅……深吸气：“你，给我滚开！”

“好，我滚。我去剁了那个天残谷主，剁完去找你。”商非凡真的转身就走。

虎不帅瞪大眼睛，一秒后暴吼：“你给我站住！”

商非凡站住，转过身，眼神不爽：“你对那家伙还有感情？”

“屁！”虎不帅气得喷脏话。

此时他大脑一片混乱，他不是怜惜或对洛伦米尔顿还有感情，也不是担心商非凡打不过作为魔法师的洛伦。他只是还没搞清楚为什么洛伦米尔顿也会出现在兽人世界，而他潜意识觉得搞清楚这件事对他很重要。

商非凡挑挑眉。竟然能喷脏话，看来他不用担心他家不帅还对老情人有感觉了。

但狗男人还是要剁的。他可不会给敌人任何死灰复燃的可能性。

“你不觉得奇怪吗？你来到兽人大陆，你上辈子的狗男人也来到了兽人大陆。”

虎不帅已经无力去批评商非凡使用的不雅名词。

他努力平静自己的情绪，尽量平稳地说道：“我也在奇怪这件事。所以，”

“我会和你一起调查。把这件事查个清清楚楚明明白白。”

“不用。这是我的私事，我自己……”

“你就算不让我和你一起调查，我也会调查。到时候我们俩各查各的，如果让对方察觉，或是因为没有配合搞砸，你可不要怪我。”

“……你真就这么喜欢我？喜欢到想要插手这种一看就不正常就很危险的事情？”虎不帅不是感动，他是真迷惑。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 74: Interrogation (Part 2)

It was precisely because of these memories, and his familiarity with Loren Milton, that made him absolutely certain that the silver-haired beastman was Loren Milton!

Although the other's hair color had changed from black to silver, and his race had changed from a pure human to a beastman with long, pointed beast ears.

He wore a finely crafted robe, making it impossible to tell if he had a tail.

Judging solely by his ears, one couldn't discern his beastman tribe either.

But no matter what kind of beastman he was, he was Loren Milton.

He was even quite certain that the other still possessed his memories from his past life, because his gait, expressions, and certain small habits were exactly the same as before.

If a person grew up from infancy without their memories and habits, even if their soul was the same, they would grow into a different person.

So why did Loren Milton also come to the beastman world?

Why was Loren also able to transmigrate?

Why did his appearance not change at all?

Why did both of them end up in the beastman world?

Could it be because their ties weren't fully severed?

Hu Bushuai let out a soft, scoffing laugh.

Shang Feifan had been watching Bushuai the entire time.

It was fine for them to make noise now, as the Lord of Tiancan Valley had already walked far away.

"You know him," Shang Feifan said, his tone assertive.

Hu Bushuai did not respond.

But this lack of response was actually a response in itself.

If Bushuai didn't know the Lord of Tiancan Valley, he would have definitely said so directly. It was precisely because he knew him, and because their relationship was unusual, that this silence occurred.

Shang Feifan felt extremely uncomfortable, always feeling like the handsome Lord of Tiancan Valley looked very much like a scumbag trying to steal his partner.

The look his Bushuai gave that Lord of Tiancan Valley was definitely not as simple as "just knowing him."

"Weren't you living in the Royal Capital all along? You only went to Moyue Town about half a year ago, and then stayed there ever since?" Shang Feifan changed his question.

Hu Bushuai didn't know why Shang Feifan was asking this. His mind was still in turmoil, so he answered without much guard: "Yeah."

Shang Feifan's mind spun rapidly. "I know that man. He is the Lord of Tiancan Valley. It's said that he has never left Tiancan Valley since birth. So, theoretically, you two should never have met, let alone know each other."

Hu Bushuai was surprised. "He is the Lord of Tiancan Valley? He is a Tiancan?"

Excellent. This sentence from Bushuai revealed quite a bit of information to him again. Shang Feifan waved his hand. "Whether he is a Tiancan or not isn't important. What matters is, how do you two know each other?"

Hu Bushuai disliked Shang Feifan's aggressive tone and frowned. "How I know him is none of your business."

"I'm pursuing you, so of course it's my business." Shang Feifan pressed closer to Bushuai, the dark red in his eyes becoming even more pronounced.

Hu Bushuai backed up, only to find that behind him was a corner. He had nowhere left to retreat.

He could only stretch out his hand to press against the other's chest, keeping him from getting any closer.

Shang Feifan stared at him with a fierce intensity.

Anger welled up in Hu Bushuai's chest, and he barked, "Back off! Pressing so close, are you looking for a fight?"

Shang Feifan pressed his forehead against Bushuai's, remaining silent.

Hu Bushuai's arms were pressed so hard by the immense force that he couldn't straighten them. The distance between their chests was now less than ten centimeters.

"You didn't know he was the Lord of Tiancan Valley, and you've never met him in the Royal Capital or Moyue Town, so... he is an old acquaintance of yours from the Fardel Continent? Let me guess, is he one of those lovers of yours?" As Shang Feifan reached the end, his voice grew increasingly raspy.

Hu Bushuai: "..."

This guy's brain was terrifying. How did he reach such a conclusion so quickly?

"You're not still thinking about him even now, are you?" Shang Feifan pressed against Bushuai's forehead and snorted. "Though that guy indeed looks decent enough, he's still a bit worse than me. Who isn't a sucker for looks? It's not surprising you'd remember a fellow like him. But I can guarantee his skills in bed are definitely not as good as mine. Want to give me a try?"

Hu Bushuai was shocked to the core.

He knew this guy was thick-skinned, but he hadn't expected him to be so direct and shameless!

In two seconds, Hu Bushuai's face and neck completely flushed red.

He was so angry his head was practically smoking.

"Try your mother! Get the hell away from me!" Bushuai, who rarely swore, was provoked into spitting out curse words.

"Looks like that guy's skills weren't up to par. You're clearly not very satisfied with him," Shang Feifan said with absolute certainty.

"Go screw yourself...!" Hu Bushuai kicked Shang Feifan's shin hard, trying to kick him away.

Shang Feifan didn't budge, offering his shin for him to kick.

"Darling, do you know what desensitization therapy is? I think you really need it right now."

"Beat it!"

"Did he hurt you?"

"Get lost!"

"You were hurt by him." Another statement of certainty.

"No! We broke up amicably," Hu Bushuai blurted out, immediately regretting it the moment the words left his mouth.

In his heart, Shang Feifan had already minced the Lord of Tiancan Valley into pieces, but his face remained as calm as still water. He merely pulled his forehead away from Bushuai's and looked down at his Bushuai.

"Since it was an amicable breakup, let's talk about how you two met, how long you knew each other, how many times you slept together, and how you broke up."

"Fuck! Why should I talk to you about this?" Hu Bushuai was shocked, embarrassed, and infuriated all at once as he pushed Shang Feifan hard.

Relying on his immense strength, Shang Feifan's legs were like iron pillars welded to the ground, not budging an inch. "Because I want to know everything about you, including how many lovers you've had in the past and how you got along with them. Everything about you, I want to know."

"Do you know what people like you are called?!"

"Control freaks?"

Hu Bushuai sneered, "So you do have some self-awareness. If you're sick, go get treated, don't go crazy on me! Why should I tell you my business just because you want to know? Don't say it's because you like me—that excuse only disgusts me!"

These were harsh words, but Shang Feifan's expression didn't change in the slightest. "Oh. I'm really sorry my affection disgusts you. If you want to take the love-hate route, I don't mind either."

Hu Bushuai... took a deep breath. "You, get the hell away from me!"

"Fine, I'll beat it. I'm going to chop up that Lord of Tiancan Valley, and then I'll come find you once I'm done." Shang Feifan actually turned around to leave.

Hu Bushuai's eyes widened, and a second later, he roared, "Stop right there!"

Shang Feifan stopped, turned around, and looked displeased. "You still have feelings for that guy?"

"Bullshit!" Hu Bushuai spat out in anger.

At this moment, his mind was in utter chaos. It wasn't that he pitied Loren Milton or still had feelings for him, nor was he worried that Shang Feifan couldn't beat Loren, who was a mage. He just hadn't figured out why Loren Milton would also appear in the beastman world, and his subconscious felt that figuring this out was extremely important to him.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. Since he was swearing, it seemed he didn't need to worry about his Bushuai still having feelings for his old flame.

But the bastard still had to be chopped up. He wouldn't give the enemy any chance of rekindling old ashes.

"Don't you find it strange? You came to the Beastman Continent, and your bastard of an ex from your past life also came to the Beastman Continent."

Hu Bushuai was already too exhausted to criticize the crude terms Shang Feifan was using.

He tried his best to calm his emotions and said as steadily as possible, "I'm wondering about this too. So,"

"I will investigate it with you. We'll get to the bottom of this, clear and simple."

"No need. This is my private matter, I'll..."

"Even if you don't let me investigate with you, I'll still look into it. When the time comes, we'll both be investigating separately. If we alert him, or if things get messed up because we didn't cooperate, don't blame me."

"...Do you really like me that much? So much that you're willing to meddle in something that is clearly abnormal and highly dangerous?" Hu Bushuai wasn't touched; he was genuinely bewildered.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡忽然轻轻叹气，又走回来：“我也奇怪为什么会这么在意你。我第一眼看到你时就觉得你特别顺眼。但很多恋人不都是这么相恋的吗？就因为第一眼的眼缘，然后在日后相处中逐渐产生好感，直到彼此说破心意，然后在一起。”

虎不帅可以强硬面对硬起来的商非凡，但商非凡软化，他就也无法继续冷脸对他，他也知道他说的某些话十分伤人。

商非凡不能凭借自己的喜欢，就强迫他也喜欢他、接受他。

但他又凭什么仗着商非凡喜欢他，就对他恶言相向？

好吧，也许是因为商非凡说的话太流氓……

但虎不帅也不得不承认，他心里并不讨厌商非凡这个人，甚至觉得对方作为朋友很不错也很可靠。

如果商非凡对他不是那种喜欢，而是普通朋友和兄弟的喜欢就好了。

“不帅，我们先把那个狗男人的事调查清楚。其他，我们以后再说。”商非凡轻轻握住不帅的手腕。

不帅下意识甩开他的手，看到商非凡受伤又快速隐藏的神情，又尴尬起来。

商非凡：他好像知道要如何攻陷他家不帅了。他家不帅就是典型的吃软不吃硬，而且特别容易心软。

“我希望你不要伤心。”商非凡低声说。

虎不帅没听懂：“嗯？我会伤心什么？”

商非凡退后一步，给了不帅喘息的空间。

“我怀疑那个狗杂碎上辈子接近你就有某种目的。”说这句话时，商非凡忽然想到不帅那诡异的气运值。

97（-96）/100

这个-96是怎么产生的？

他家不帅原本明明应该是超级欧皇，为什么会变成气运值只有1点的非酋？

他的气运值是被谁盗取了吗？

“如果那个狗杂碎真的做了对不起你的事，就让他失去他那张脸。”

没了那张脸，我看他还怎么蛊惑我家不帅！

商非凡现在就特别理解那些被小三勾引了自己丈夫的原配的心情。只要想到他家不帅被那张脸吸引，他就恨不得……

商非凡神情一瞬间变得特别狰狞可怕，但在虎不帅看向他时，只一眨眼就恢复原状。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 74: Interrogation (Part 3)

Shang Feifan suddenly sighed softly and walked back over. "I also wonder why I care about you so much. The very first moment I saw you, I found you incredibly pleasing to the eye. But isn't that how many lovers fall in love? Just because of that initial spark, and then gradually developing feelings as they spend time together, until they finally lay their hearts bare and get together."

Hu Bushuai could be unyielding when facing a stubborn Shang Feifan, but once Shang Feifan softened, he couldn't bring himself to keep giving him a cold shoulder. He also knew that some of the things he had said were very hurtful.

Shang Feifan couldn't force him to like him back and accept him just on the basis of his own affection.

But by what right did he lash out at Shang Feifan with harsh words just because Shang Feifan liked him?

Well, maybe it was because Shang Feifan's words were too rogue-like...

But Hu Bushuai also had to admit that he didn't dislike Shang Feifan in his heart. He even felt that the other man was quite good and reliable as a friend.

If only Shang Feifan's feelings for him weren't that kind of romantic love, but rather the affection of ordinary friends or brothers.

"Bushuai, let's first investigate that bastard's situation thoroughly. We can talk about the rest later." Shang Feifan gently took hold of Bushuai's wrist.

Bushuai instinctively shook off his hand. Seeing the hurt expression that Shang Feifan quickly hid, he felt awkward again.

Shang Feifan: He seemed to know how to conquer his Bushuai now. His Bushuai was a classic case of being soft-hearted, yielding to gentle persuasion but rejecting force, and especially prone to softening up.

"I hope you won't be sad," Shang Feifan said in a low voice.

Hu Bushuai didn't understand. "Huh? What would I be sad about?"

Shang Feifan took a step back, giving Bushuai some breathing room.

"I suspect that bastard approached you in your past life with some sort of ulterior motive." As he said this, Shang Feifan suddenly thought of Bushuai's bizarre luck stat.

97 (-96) / 100

How did this -96 come about?

His Bushuai was clearly supposed to be a super lucky emperor, so why did he turn into an unlucky wretch with a luck stat of only 1 point?

Was his luck stolen by someone?

"If that bastard really did something to betray you, I'll make sure he loses that face of his."

Without that face, let's see how he can bewitch my Bushuai!

Shang Feifan could now deeply empathize with the feelings of a primary spouse whose husband had been seduced by a homewrecker. Just the thought of his Bushuai being attracted by that face made him itch to...

For a brief moment, Shang Feifan's expression became incredibly sinister and terrifying, but the instant Hu Bushuai looked at him, it returned to normal in the blink of an eye.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第75章 想要帅的怪物 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第75章 想要帅的怪物

天残谷主不知道他身后缀上了两个人。

那两个人为了不让他察觉，还特地高价购买了全隐匿型装备。

天残谷主正在根据提示寻找这座城里最厉害的怪物。

他也没想过一来摩罗城就能找到你皇。

果然，这座城里撒满了进来捕杀怪物的大胆兽人。

他一开始在这些兽人中寻找天残兽人，但找了一圈都没有看出哪个是天残。

这时候他就有点后悔没有给玩家增加一些更明显的设定。

但是谁能想到竟然有玩家能脱离游戏开发者的控制，成为“程序”中的幽灵。

原本任何玩家在他面前都是透明的，他只要看过去，一眼就能知道谁是玩家谁是NPC。

偏偏你皇成了例外！

既然从外表上无法分辨，那就只能通过其他方式寻找。

在天残谷主想来，你皇的游戏等级已经达到三十级以上，那么屠杀二十五级以下怪物的性价比就会变得很低。

当你皇发现原本只要杀几个怪物就可以升一级的情况变成杀几十个都不怎么涨经验值后，肯定会放弃那些看着就比较好对付的怪物，而去寻找比较难杀的高等级怪物。

目前，玩家还无法看到怪物的实力等级，这牵涉到兽人的血脉天赋技能和职业技能。

游戏设定是只有激活和学习了相关技能的玩家才能看到怪物和NPC的一些数据。

这样的设定必然会引来大部分玩家不满，但……游戏开发者也没办法，他是能做到让所有玩家都能看到这些数据，但这会大大加大他的负担，日常消耗的能量也更多。

好在这是一款以全息真实为噱头的游戏，只要用这样设定更贴近真实来说服玩家，玩家吵吵嚷嚷的也就接受了。

天残谷主看过你皇的资料，但当时他并没有把这么一个小小的玩家放在眼里，也就只查看了对方的任务日志，并没有留意对方的天赋技能和职业技能。

等到他发现这个玩家已经开始真正破坏游戏平衡，想要删除对方时，却发现查看不到对方在游戏中的资料了。

所以他并不确定你皇有没有能看到怪物和NPC某些数据的能力，但他决定假设对方有。

不小瞧自己的敌人从来都是他的优点之一。

之前他只是没有把你皇当做敌人，现在他也不认为你皇够格成为他的敌人，但对于钻入自己家中给自己捣乱的小虫子，他一样会认真对待。

在找不到你皇的明确坐标的情况下，那就找你皇的目标。

然后守株待兔。

天残谷主找到了商业街，也看到了大量聚集在这里的怪物。

他也感到奇怪，想要知道怪物聚集在这里的原因。

可惜他虽然是游戏策划和游戏的实际开发者，但这个世界是一个真实的世界，这里的怪物也都是真实的，并不是他能用程序控制的数据，他无法从后台找找数据就能看到怪物聚集在这里的原因。

他也试着感知这里有没有吸引怪物的特别能量或特别物品。

但什么也没感知到。

大概是他来迟了一步，吸引怪物的东西已经消失？

天残谷主不知道他猜对了，如果他再早来半个小时，说不定还能找到一只半只身上沾染了商非凡血液的怪物，进而从商非凡的血液中感知到一点点虫母的力量。

可现在所有沾染商非凡血液的怪物都被其他怪物撕碎和瓜分，连点残渣都没有留下来。

不小心落到地上墙壁上和屋顶上的血迹更是被怪物们舔-舐得干干净净，有些不在乎口感的怪物直接就把沾有血迹的泥土墙砖瓦片都吃进肚里。

现在这些怪物还没有全部散去，只不过是它们也不知道散去该干嘛，只是凭借本能游荡在虫母力量最初出现的地方，直到其他地方出现更吸引它们的东西。

天残谷主在这条商业街等待了一会儿，没看到多少兽人过来狩猎这里的怪物。

有些貌似雇佣兵和冒险者的兽人过来，发现这里怪物如此之多，几乎全都下意识跑远。

城卫军也派人来过这里查看，同样直接放弃。

不，他们不是放弃，他们发现这里聚集了大量怪物反而很高兴，这会方便他们搬出威力巨大的武器集中攻击这些怪物。

只是毁掉一条商业街就能夺回整座城，相信彘庞男爵会很愿意下达这样的命令。

至于这条商业街财产背后的主人，谁又敢和彘庞男爵掰腕子？

探查兵很快离去。

天残谷主也反应过来，这里已经不安全，如果他是这座城的领主，在发现这里的情况后也会重点攻击这条街。

新生纪后存活下来的兽人已经失去了大量大繁华纪时的科技传承，很多大威力武器已经不会使用，更不会制造。

同样，他们的血脉天赋激活率也降到最低，就算激活，那些天赋能力也表现一般。

这样的兽人原本应该很容易被解决，只要被其他智慧生物发现，九成九会沦为奴隶身，从此成为被其他智慧生物奴役的低等种族。

但兽人大陆的气运似乎还没有被榨干，曾经创造出神血辉煌和科技辉煌两种完全不同的璀璨文明的兽人们，在经历过大战纪和毒雾纪的蹂-躏后，竟然再次站了起来。

兽人们结合他们挖掘和寻找出来的残留知识，发明了独属于他们的炼金术。

这种炼金术炼制出来的器具可以帮助吸收兽人大陆上的游离能量，并增大使用者本人的天赋技能和职业技能效果。

比如原本一个只能用手指点火的兽人，在使用适合他的炼金装备后，他能变身喷火器，更进一步甚至能发射火炮和漫天火雨。

原本只能弄出一点点冰渣的兽人，在有了适用的炼金装备后，冰冻整座城都不算夸张。

当然，拥有这种超绝炼金装备的兽人不多，一般都是各国各族最强高手，他们使用这些威力超群的炼金装备的效果更可怕，是属于魔导师一般的存在，轻易不会动用。

可力量不够数量来凑。

摩罗城的领主显然掌握着不少城卫军，把这些城卫军按照天赋和职业技能分类，再给他们分发同类的炼金装备，让他们一起攻击敌人，就算这些兽人和装备的效果都很一般，加在一起的力量也十分可观。

就像只一颗火弹不算什么，但如果几千颗火弹同时发射呢？

天残谷主眼看在商业街找不到你皇，就决定换个地方，他可以通过指引找到这座城最厉害的怪物，也许你皇也正在寻找这座城里最厉害的怪物……

等等！

刚想到要去找那最厉害的怪物，那最厉害的怪物就自己找过来了。

天残谷主绕了个弯迅速跑向那最厉害的怪物，他要看看那怪物身后是不是追着一个你皇。

夏冰也不知道自己怎么了。

他就觉得自己神智很模糊，就像在做梦一般。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 75: The Monster That Wanted to Be Handsome (Part 1)

The Lord of Deformed Valley had no idea that two people were tailing him.

To avoid alerting him, those two had even gone out of their way to purchase high-priced, full-stealth equipment.

The Lord of Deformed Valley was currently using the system prompts to hunt down the most powerful monster in this city.

He hadn't expected to find You Huang the moment he arrived in Mo Luo City.

Sure enough, this city was crawling with bold beastmen who had sneaked in to hunt and kill monsters.

Initially, he had searched among these beastmen for a Deformed Beastman, but after looking around, none of them fit the bill.

At that moment, he felt a brief pang of regret for not giving the players some more obvious traits.

Who could have anticipated that a player would break free from the game developer's control and become a ghost within the "code"?

Normally, every player was completely transparent to him; a single glance would tell him instantly who was a player and who was an NPC.

Yet You Huang had turned out to be the sole exception!

Since they couldn't be distinguished by appearance, he had no choice but to search using other methods.

In the Lord of Deformed Valley's estimation, since You Huang’s in-game level had already surpassed Level 30, the cost-efficiency of slaughtering monsters below Level 25 would drop drastically.

When You Huang found that what used to be a quick level-up after killing just a few monsters now required slaying dozens with barely any EXP gain, he would definitely abandon those easy-to-handle monsters and go after high-level ones that were much harder to kill.

Currently, players were unable to see the strength levels of monsters due to ties with the beastmen's bloodline innate skills and professional skills.

The game design dictated that only players who had activated and learned the relevant skills could view certain stats of monsters and NPCs.

Such a design was bound to incur the dissatisfaction of most players, but... the game developer had no alternative. He *could* make it so that all players could see these stats, but it would drastically increase his burden and consume far more energy on a daily basis.

Fortunately, this was a game boasting holographic realism. By using that exact rationale—that such a setup brought the game closer to reality—to persuade the players, they grumbled a bit and accepted it.

The Lord of Deformed Valley had looked over You Huang’s profile, but at the time, he hadn't thought much of such an insignificant player, merely checking the target's quest log without paying attention to his innate and professional skills.

By the time he realized this player was genuinely disrupting game balance and wanted to delete him, he discovered he could no longer view the player's in-game data.

Therefore, he wasn't certain whether You Huang possessed the ability to view certain stats of monsters and NPCs, but he decided to assume the worst.

Never underestimating one's enemy had always been one of his virtues.

Previously, he simply hadn't regarded You Huang as an enemy, and even now, he didn't think You Huang was qualified to be his enemy. But towards a little bug that had wormed its way into his home to cause trouble, he would still treat it with seriousness.

Since he couldn't find You Huang’s exact coordinates, he would look for You Huang’s target instead.

And then wait for the hare by the stump.

The Lord of Deformed Valley found the commercial street and also saw the massive gathering of monsters there.

He couldn't help but feel puzzled, eager to know the reason behind the monsters gathering here.

Unfortunately, although he was the game planner and actual developer, this world was real, and the monsters here were equally real—not mere data he could control via program scripts. He couldn't just query the backend database to see why the monsters had gathered here.

He even tried to sense whether there was any special energy or special item here attracting the monsters.

Yet he sensed nothing at all.

Perhaps he had arrived a step too late, and the object attracting the monsters had already vanished?

The Lord of Deformed Valley did not know that his guess was spot on. Had he arrived even half an hour earlier, he might have managed to find a monster or two stained with Shang Feifan’s blood, and from that blood, sensed even a sliver of the Mother Worm’s power.

Yet now, all the monsters stained with Shang Feifan’s blood had been torn apart and carved up by other monsters, leaving not even a scrap behind.

The bloodstains that had accidentally splashed onto the ground, walls, and roofs were licked impeccably clean by the monsters; some monsters, unconcerned with taste or texture, had directly devoured the blood-stained soil, bricks, and roof tiles.

Now, these monsters had not completely dispersed; they simply didn't know what else to do, merely wandering on instinct around the spot where the Mother Worm’s power had first manifested, until something more alluring appeared elsewhere.

The Lord of Deformed Valley waited on this commercial street for a while, seeing very few beastmen coming to hunt the monsters here.

A few beastmen who looked like mercenaries and adventurers arrived, but upon seeing the sheer number of monsters, almost all of them instinctively fled far away.

The City Guard garrison had also sent men to investigate, and they similarly gave up on the spot.

No, they hadn't given up; upon discovering that a massive horde of monsters was gathered here, they were actually overjoyed. This would make it convenient for them to haul out high-powered weaponry to concentrate their attacks on these monsters.

If destroying a single commercial street could reclaim the entire city, Baron Xie Pang would surely be more than willing to issue such an order.

As for the owners of the property on this commercial street, who would dare lock horns with Baron Xie Pang?

The scout troops quickly departed.

The Lord of Deformed Valley snapped to his senses as well—this place was no longer safe. If he were the lord of this city, upon discovering the situation here, he would undoubtedly focus his primary assault on this street.

The beastmen who survived the New Era had lost a vast amount of the technological heritage from the Prosperous Era. Many high-powered weapons could no longer be used, let alone manufactured.

Similarly, their activation rate for bloodline innate talents had dropped to a minimum; even if activated, those innate abilities performed quite ordinarily.

Such beastmen should originally have been very easy to deal with. Once discovered by other intelligent beings, nine times out of ten they would be reduced to slavery, becoming a lower race enslaved by others from then on.

Yet the fortune of the Beastman Continent seemed far from exhausted. The beastmen, who had once forged two completely different brilliant civilizations—the Divine Blood brilliance and the Technological brilliance—had actually stood back up after being ravaged by the Great War Era and the Poison Fog Era.

Combining the residual knowledge they excavated and searched out, the beastmen invented their very own unique Alchemy.

Utensils refined through this alchemy could help absorb free-flowing energy on the Beastman Continent and amplify the effects of the user’s innate and professional skills.

For instance, a beastman who could originally only ignite a spark with his fingertips could, upon using suitable alchemical equipment, transform into a flamethrower, and further still, unleash artillery fire and torrential rains of fire.

A beastman who could previously only conjure a tiny bit of ice shards could freeze an entire city with appropriate alchemical gear—and that was hardly an exaggeration.

Of course, beastmen possessing such supreme alchemical equipment were few and far between; they were generally the strongest experts of various nations and races. The effects of using such peerless alchemical gear were terrifying, akin to Archmages, and were not easily deployed.

However, where strength lacked, numbers could compensate.

The Lord of Mo Luo City clearly commanded a considerable number of City Guards. By categorizing these guards according to their talents and professional skills, and then distributing matching alchemical equipment for them to assault enemies in unison, even if these beastmen and their equipment had mediocre base effects, the combined might was still quite formidable.

Just as a single fire bullet didn't amount to much, what if thousands of fire bullets were fired simultaneously?

Seeing that You Huang could not be found on the commercial street, the Lord of Deformed Valley decided to change locations. He could use the guidance system to find the city's most powerful monster—perhaps You Huang was also searching for the city's most powerful monster...

Wait!

Just as he thought about seeking out the most powerful monster, that very monster had come looking for him.

The Lord of Deformed Valley took a detour and rapidly sprinted toward the most powerful monster; he wanted to see if a You Huang was tailing behind it.

Xia Bing had no idea what was happening to himself either.

He only felt his consciousness grow extremely hazy, as though he were caught in a dream.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第75章 想要帅的怪物 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
他有时候能意识到自己在做梦，还想控制自己的梦境，但绝大多数时候他都会稀里糊涂的被梦境卷入，只偶尔间会冷不丁清醒过来，意识到自己在做梦，然后再试图控制梦境，再稀里糊涂地被卷入梦境……

如此不断循环往复。

随着做梦时间越来越多，夏冰意识到自己在做梦的时候也就越来越少。

他不喜欢这个梦境。

梦中他似乎变成了一个非常丑陋的怪物。

夏冰长得还不错，平时也很以自己的外貌为荣。因为自己的外貌，他找工作都比其他兽人更容易一些。

今年，他通过之前的老板介绍，找到了一份在商业街最大商行的伙计工作——暗地里的小消息说这个商行背后的主人就是本城城主呢！

他还算英俊的外貌就是他应聘上这份工作的最重要原因。同样，也是因为他的这张脸才会让原来的老板愿意为他费心。

这份工作高贵的人看不上，但对于他们这种贫民区里出来的兽人，却是一份提出来就会让人万分羡慕的绝好工作。

夏冰得到这份工作后，全家人都为他高兴，并期待他能在工作一两年后，就带着全家人都脱离这个不太-安全的第十一街，搬到比较安全也更干净的第九或者第十街也可以。

夏冰也愿意成为家里的骄傲和顶梁柱，家里人也并没有谁会给他拖后腿或只想吸他的血，这让他干劲满满。

到昨天为止，他在商业街最大商行已经工作了一个月，工作逐渐顺手，上司对他感观也很好，他瞅着对方似乎有提拔他和培养的意思。

这让他晚上睡下时带着极好的心情，做的梦都是美梦。

可转眼间，美梦就莫名其妙变成了噩梦。

夏冰很暴躁，他想从梦里醒来，他恼怒这个梦境为什么这么长，他担心自己睡过头上班迟到，怕给上司留下不好印象。

但逐渐的，随着他在梦中杀死和吞吃的怪物越多，他就越来越不记得自己在做梦。

他是什么时候开始吞噬那些怪物？

似乎是某几只怪物身上传来特别香喷喷的味道，就像是他妈妈偶尔会给他们做的煎肉饼，只闻着味就让他忍不住流口水。

等他实在忍不住，撕咬了其中一个，那食欲就变得一发不可收拾。

之后，他就开始追在那些怪物后面寻找闻起来像美味肉饼的。

越吃越想吃。

他的身体也开始进一步变化，变得越来越不像人，越来越难看。

他开始逐渐觉得他原本就应该是这个样子。

不！我不是这么丑陋的怪物！

夏冰的潜意识还在挣扎。

就在这时，他忽然闻到有更多新鲜美味的食物进来了。

他追着那些更加新鲜可口的食物追了一段时间，也不知道为什么，每次他想张口咬死那些食物时，他就会产生一点迟疑。

似乎有什么在约束他，这些新鲜食物不能吃。

追着追着，他烦躁了。

扭头就奔向另一个聚集了大量食物的餐厅。

那里有着他之前吞噬过的类似怪物，虽然它们闻起来不是那么新鲜可口，但也许吃它们可以打消他想要追逐新鲜食物的欲-望。

商非凡拉住虎不帅，他也看到了那个巨大的怪物。

那个怪物和其他怪物都不一样，它的身躯像是有数种不同怪物组成，特别臃肿庞大，但它身体最高处却长着一个人类的头颅。

那头脸竟然还很可爱讨喜。

圆圆的耳朵、圆圆的脸，以及天生往上翘的嘴角，一脸笑模样，让人看了就想揉揉他的脑袋。

可爱的脑袋却配着一副极致丑陋可怕的身躯，这反差感也是没谁了。

这也是商非凡第一次看到有怪物身上还保留着人的特征。

眼睛看向这怪物的同时，鉴定术同时使出。

商非凡的右眼视界里出现了一列数据。

姓名：夏冰

原种族：雪猫族

现状态：虫毒感染

虫毒感染程度：91%

血脉天赋：抗毒（血脉天赋被虫毒激活）

生命值：9（1000）

能量值：4999（5000）

商非凡讶异，这串数据和他之前看到的那些怪物的数据有两处最大不同。

首先，怪物没有生命值，只有能量值。

其次，怪物的虫毒感染程度都达到了百分百。

可这个拥有可爱头脸的怪物却拥有9点生命值，那是不是说它……他还活着，并没有完全死去？

而这9点生命值是不是跟他虫毒感染程度只有91%有关？

商非凡把他看到的数据告诉不帅。

虎不帅没问商非凡怎么能看到这些数据，就很正常地推测：“你说你看到了他因为虫毒被激活了血脉天赋？”

“对。”

虎不帅沉思片刻，“根据特别调查局之前调查到的情报来看，不少怪物在生前并不拥有特别能力，但在死后异变却变出了血脉技能。当时就有不少人怀疑虫毒具有激活血脉天赋的作用。”

“那有人为了激活血脉天赋故意感染虫毒吗？”商非凡觉得肯定有这种傻子。

虎不帅抿了抿嘴唇：“我不知道，明面上应该是没有吧。但肯定有人暗中试验。”

商非凡也没有纠缠这个话题，而是看向那个拥有可爱头脸的庞大怪物：“他虫毒感染度只有91%很可能就跟他激活的天赋能力是抗毒有关。”

“这个人还能救回来吗？”虎不帅带了一点期冀问。

商非凡笑：“不知道，但我们可以试试。”

“那虫毒消融药剂是不是很难得到？”

“别想这些。如果我不愿意，我会直接跟你说不。这不是你的愿望，是我自己也想试试。明白？”

虎不帅：“……”

好吧，商非凡这种态度确实大大减轻了他的心理负担。他不想因为自己给别人添麻烦，更不想提出让别人为难的要求。

但夏冰这种情况太特殊了，他忍不住想要试试看能不能拯救对方。

“如果虫毒消融药剂对他有效果。说不定其他拥有抗毒能力的兽人也有被救回的可能。”商非凡说。他是真的想要试试。

虎不帅惆怅：“以前似乎没有人发现过这点，也许有些感染虫毒的兽人明明还能救得回来。”

“这种事很难发现。就算有鉴定能力和瞳术的人，想要恰好看到一个具有抗毒能力且没有达到百分百感染程度的怪物的可能性也极低极低。”

虎不帅点头：“也是。”

商非凡指着夏冰：“如果我们再迟一天看到他，信不信那张脸已经没了。”

“洛伦……我是说那位天残谷主似乎也瞄上他了。他想干什么？”虎不帅被商非凡刺激过后，现在再看洛伦米尔顿已经很平静。

商非凡也在推测天残谷主前来摩罗城的原因。

他之前以为天残谷主是玩家营地里的固定NPC，绝不会轻易离开天残谷范围。

但在知道天残谷主很有可能就是他家不帅的前狗男人后，他就不再把这家伙当做单纯的NPC来看。

他把天残谷主的地位提升到了大Boss的高度。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 75: The Monster That Wanted to Be Handsome (Part 2)

At times, he could realize he was dreaming and even tried to control his own dreamscape, but the vast majority of the time he would be muddle-headedly swept into the dream. Only occasionally would he snap awake out of nowhere, realize he was dreaming, and then attempt to take control of the dreamscape before being muddle-headedly swept back in once more...

This cycle repeated continuously.

As the time spent dreaming increased, the moments when Xia Bing realized he was dreaming grew fewer and fewer.

He did not like this dream.

In the dream, he seemed to have turned into an extremely ugly monster.

Xia Bing was a fairly handsome man and usually took great pride in his appearance. Thanks to his looks, he had found it much easier to land a job than other beastmen.

This year, through the introduction of his former boss, he had secured a job as a clerk at the largest mercantile firm on the commercial street—with whispers going around that the true master behind this firm was none other than the Lord of the City!

His fairly dashing looks were the single most crucial reason he had passed the interview. Similarly, it was because of this face that his former boss had been willing to go out of his way for him.

This job was looked down upon by the noble and lofty, but to beastmen like them crawling out of the slums, it was an immensely enviable, top-tier job just to hear about.

Once Xia Bing secured the position, his entire family rejoiced for him, looking forward to the day when, after a year or two of work, he could bring his family away from this somewhat unsafe 11th Street and move to the safer and cleaner 9th or 10th Street.

Xia Bing was more than willing to become his family's pride and pillar of support, and none of his family members dragged him down or tried to live off his blood, which filled him with inexhaustible drive.

Up until yesterday, he had been working at the commercial street's largest mercantile firm for a full month. He was growing increasingly accustomed to the work, his superior held a very favorable view of him, and he could tell that the other party seemed to harbor intentions of promoting and grooming him.

This put him in a splendid mood as he fell asleep at night, and every dream he had was a sweet one.

Yet in the blink of an eye, the sweet dream inexplicably turned into a nightmare.

Xia Bing was irritable; he wanted to wake up from the dream, annoyed as to why it was dragging on for so long. He worried that he would oversleep and be late for work, fearing it would leave a bad impression on his supervisor.

Gradually, however, as he killed and devoured more and more monsters within the dream, he grew increasingly oblivious to the fact that he was dreaming.

When had he actually started devouring those monsters?

It seemed to have begun when a few particular monsters emitted an extraordinarily enticing aroma, much like the pan-fried meat patties his mother would occasionally make for them. Just the scent alone made his mouth water uncontrollably.

When he finally couldn't hold back and bit into one of them, that appetite spiraled completely out of control.

Afterward, he began trailing behind those monsters, hunting for the ones that smelled like delicious meat patties.

The more he ate, the more he craved.

His body also began to undergo further changes, becoming less and less human, and increasingly hideous.

He slowly began to feel that this was how he should have looked all along.

*No! I am not such an ugly monster!*

Xia Bing’s subconscious was still putting up a struggle.

At that moment, he suddenly smelled a wave of even fresher, more delicious food entering the area.

He chased after those fresher and more appetizing provisions for a period of time. For reasons unknown, every time he wanted to open his mouth to bite down on those provisions, a trace of hesitation would well up inside him.

It felt as though something was restraining him, telling him these fresh foods must not be eaten.

The chase grew frustrating.

He whipped his head around and bolted toward another restaurant where a large number of food items had gathered.

There were creatures there similar to the ones he had previously devoured. Although they didn't smell quite as fresh and appetizing, perhaps eating them would suppress his desire to chase after the fresh food.

Shang Feifan grabbed Hu Buwai, having also spotted that massive monster.

That monster was unlike any other; its body looked as though it were pieced together from several different beasts, exceptionally bloated and colossal. Yet atop the highest point of its torso grew a human head.

Oddly enough, that head and face were actually rather cute and pleasing.

Round ears, a round face, and lips naturally curved upward into a smiling expression—one couldn't help but want to reach out and rub its head.

Yet this cute head was attached to an utterly hideous and terrifying body; such a jarring contrast was truly one of a kind.

This was also the first time Shang Feifan had seen a monster retain human characteristics.

As his eyes locked onto the monster, Appraisal was cast simultaneously.

A line of data materialized within Shang Feifan’s right eye's field of vision.

Name: Xia Bing

Original Race: Snow Cat Clan

Current Status: Worm Poison Infection

Worm Poison Infection Rate: 91%

Bloodline Innate Talent: Anti-Poison (Bloodline talent activated by worm poison)

HP: 9 (1000)

Energy Level: 4999 (5000)

Shang Feifan was startled. This string of data had two major differences compared to the monster data he had viewed previously.

First, monsters had no HP; they only had energy levels.

Second, the worm poison infection rate of regular monsters had all reached a full hundred percent.

Yet this monster with the cute head possessed 9 points of HP. Did that mean... he was still alive and hadn't completely perished?

And could these 9 points of HP be related to the fact that his worm poison infection rate was only 91%?

Shang Feifan shared the data he was seeing with Buwai.

Hu Buwai didn't ask how Shang Feifan was able to see these stats, simply deducing matter-of-factly: "You're saying you saw that his bloodline talent was activated because of the worm poison?"

"Correct."

Hu Buwai fell into deep thought for a moment. "Based on the intelligence previously gathered by the Special Investigation Bureau, quite a few monsters didn't possess special abilities during their lifetime, but mutated to manifest bloodline skills after death. At the time, many people suspected that worm poison had the effect of activating bloodline talents."

"Did anyone intentionally get infected with worm poison just to activate their bloodline talents?" Shang Feifan figured idiots like that definitely existed.

Hu Buwai pressed his lips together. "I don't know. On the surface, probably not. But there are definitely people experimenting in secret."

Shang Feifan didn't dwell on the topic, turning his gaze instead to the colossal monster with the cute face: "His worm poison infection rate being only 91% is very likely related to the innate anti-poison ability he activated."

"Can this person still be saved?" Hu Buwai asked with a hint of hope.

Shang Feifan smiled. "I don't know, but we can try."

"Is the Worm Poison Dissolution Potion extremely difficult to obtain?"

"Don't overthink it. If I weren't willing, I would tell you straight out. This isn't just your wish; I want to give it a try myself. Understand?"

Hu Buwai: "..."

Alright, Shang Feifan’s attitude had indeed greatly lightened his psychological burden. He didn't want to add trouble for others, nor did he want to make requests that put people in awkward positions.

However, Xia Bing’s case was far too unique; he couldn't help but want to see if the other party could be saved.

"If the Worm Poison Dissolution Potion is effective on him, perhaps other beastmen with anti-poison capabilities have a chance of being rescued as well," Shang Feifan said. He genuinely wanted to give it a shot.

Hu Buwai looked melancholic. "No one seemed to have discovered this before. Perhaps some beastmen infected with worm poison could still have been saved."

"Things like this are terribly hard to discover. Even for someone with appraisal abilities and ocular techniques, the probability of happening to spot a monster with anti-poison capabilities whose infection hasn't reached one hundred percent is exceedingly, exceedingly low."

Hu Buwai nodded. "True."

Shang Feifan pointed at Xia Bing. "If we had come to see him even a day later, wanna bet that face would be gone?"

"Loren... I mean, that Lord of Deformed Valley also seems to have set his sights on him. What is he trying to do?" Having been stimulated by Shang Feifan, Hu Buwai was now very calm when looking at Loren Milton.

Shang Feifan was also speculating on the reason behind the Lord of Deformed Valley coming to Mo Luo City.

Previously, he had assumed the Lord of Deformed Valley was a fixed NPC in the player camp who would never easily leave the vicinity of Deformed Valley.

However, after learning that the Lord of Deformed Valley was very likely his Buwai's former scumbag ex-boyfriend, he stopped viewing this guy as a mere NPC.

He had elevated the status of the Lord of Deformed Valley to the level of a grand Boss.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第75章 想要帅的怪物 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
原本是法德尔大陆的纯人类，还是一名魔法师，却穿越到了兽人大陆，成为玩家营地表面上的首脑，一个拥有复杂身世，很可能会依仗玩家来成就自己霸业的天残兽人。

乍一看，这就是一个穿越类主角的雄起故事背景。

如果他不是不帅的前情人，如果没有不帅那诡异的气运值。

但在增加这两点后，商非凡怎么看那狗杂碎都觉得对方不像是命运主角，倒更像是隐藏在暗地里偷吸真主角气运、谋夺真主角命运的阴晦卑贱小人。

就是不知道游戏策划是长了什么脑洞，竟然搞出这么一个NPC出来，还摆出一副他才是故事主角、最后成就帝王霸业的大佬架势。

该不会这个游戏策划不是原来的游戏策划，他故意搞出这么一个天残谷主就是为了恶心原来的真游戏策划？

那会不会搞出脑载系统的就是原来的真游戏策划？

真游策找到他，就是想要让他破坏这个游戏，报复夺走他策划总监地位的仇人？

所以他才会一开始就被送到莫约镇外，就是为了让他能顺利和不帅见面？

换言之，不帅才是原游戏设定中的主角？

商非凡全往现实边推测，越想越觉得目前的游戏策划很不靠谱的样子。

如果他的推测是真，现在上位的游戏策划肯定不会希望原故事设定中的主角冒头，肯定是拼命打压，说不定还会干出修改数据，甚至是手动删除的事。

这么一想，商非凡的紧迫感立刻拉起来。

他真的真的得加快找到游戏开发商的服务器所在地，先一步把不帅的数据捞出来再说。

虎不帅可不知道商非凡这一会儿脑洞都开到哪里去了，更不会想到商非凡把这个世界、把他都当做了一段程序和数据。

他的注意力被夏冰吸引。

夏冰似乎发现了天残谷主。

天残谷主可能就没想着要怎么躲着夏冰，在他看来那就是一个普通怪物，也就是体型大了一点。

哦，还拥有一点生命力，没有完全变成怪物，等级也达到了五十级，但那又怎样呢？

这样的怪物，他随手就能杀了。

天残谷主压根就没分心在夏冰身上，他在仔细留意夏冰身后有没有兽人追过来。

夏冰看到天残谷主，顿时就被那张脸给吸引了。

他残留的那一点点属于人的神智在惊艳：哇，好好看！这兽人长得真好，超级羡慕！

而无法控制的本能则在疯狂叫嚣：吃了他！吃了他我可以变得更强，也能变得更英俊！

夏冰低头看自己丑陋的身躯，差点嗷的一声哭出来。

他怎么变得更丑更臃肿了？

咻！夏冰虎视眈眈垂涎万分地看向距离他不远的俊美兽人。

吃了他，吃了他那张脸，我就能重新变得好看起来！
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 75: The Monster That Wanted to Be Handsome (Part 3)

He was originally a pure human from Fadel Continent, as well as a mage, yet he had transmigrated to the Beastman Continent to become the apparent leader of the player camp—a Deformed Beastman with a complex background who would likely rely on players to achieve his own hegemony.

At a glance, this was the setup of a transmigration-genre protagonist's rise to power.

That was, assuming he wasn't Buwai's ex-lover, and assuming Buwai didn't possess that bizarre luck stat.

Yet after factoring in those two points, no matter how Shang Feifan looked at that scumbag, the guy didn't look like a protagonist of destiny at all. Instead, he seemed much more like a shady, base villain hiding in the shadows, secretly draining the true protagonist's luck and usurping their destiny.

He just wondered what kind of brain-damaged logic the game designer was running on to concoct such an NPC, even putting on the grand airs of an overlord who was the true protagonist of the story and destined to conquer the empire in the end.

Could it be that this game designer wasn't the original one, and that he deliberately churned out this Lord of Deformed Valley just to disgust the original, true game planner?

Then could the one who created the brain-embedded system be the original, true game planner?

And had the true game designer sought him out precisely because he wanted him to disrupt this game and exact revenge on the rival who had snatched away his position as planning director?

Was that why he was dropped right outside Moyue Town from the very beginning—so he could smoothly meet up with Buwai?

In other words, was Buwai actually the protagonist in the original game design?

Shang Feifan drifted further and further into reality-adjacent conjectures. The more he thought about it, the more he felt the current game planner was highly unreliable.

If his speculations were true, the newly ascended game planner definitely wouldn't want the protagonist of the original story to emerge; he would surely suppress him with all his might, and might even resort to modifying data or executing manual deletions.

With that thought, Shang Feifan's sense of urgency spiked instantly.

He really, really needed to speed up his search for the game developer's server location and fish Buwai's data out first.

Hu Buwai had no inkling of just how wild Shang Feifan’s mental gymnastics had become over this short span, nor would he ever guess that Shang Feifan regarded this world—and him—as mere programs and data.

His attention was completely captured by Xia Bing.

Xia Bing seemed to have spotted the Lord of Deformed Valley.

The Lord of Deformed Valley probably hadn't even bothered thinking about how to hide from Xia Bing; in his eyes, that was merely an ordinary monster—albeit one with a slightly larger build.

Oh, and it possessed a shred of life force, not having completely turned into a monster, and its level had reached fifty. But so what?

A monster like that was something he could kill with a flick of his wrist.

The Lord of Deformed Valley wasn't wasting any mental bandwidth on Xia Bing at all; he was paying close attention to whether any beastmen were tailing behind Xia Bing.

The moment Xia Bing laid eyes on the Lord of Deformed Valley, he was instantly captivated by that face.

The tiny fragment of human consciousness lingering within him gasped in stunned admiration: *Aww, so good-looking! This beastman looks amazing, I'm super jealous!*

Meanwhile, his uncontrollable instincts shrieked madly: *Eat him! Eat him and I can become stronger, and I can also become more handsome!*

Xia Bing looked down at his own ugly body, almost letting out a wail.

How had he become even uglier and more bloated?

*Whoosh!* Xia Bing cast a covetous, fiercely predatory gaze toward the handsome beastman not far away.

*Eat him, and with that face, I'll be able to look good again!*

第76章 谷主毁容

啪叽！

一大团灰黑色的虫丝黏住……没能黏住，天残谷主的反应非常快，虫丝刚喷过来，他就躲了过去。

天残谷主惊讶回头，他还在寻找兽人踪影，没想到会被偷袭。

转头就看到第二团虫丝冲着他喷射过来。

天残谷主气笑，他没想对这些怪物动手，没想到这怪物竟然如此不识好歹，竟然主动攻击他。

躲在一边观察的商非凡一看夏冰竟然主动攻击天残谷主，眼睛顿亮：机会！

他对不帅打了两个手势。

两人已经合作战斗了四天，默契度大大提升。

虎不帅一看手势就点头，当即和商非凡分成两个方向抄向天残谷主。

商非凡拿出长弓和爆炸箭。

长弓很帅，兼有机械弩省力和反作用力小的特点，同时还能多箭齐发，最多一次可以发射出十支爆炸箭。

商非凡不想让爆炸箭伤及夏冰，他计算角度，换了一个方向，从夏冰斜侧方瞄准天残谷主。

天残谷主被瞄准时，心头下意识生出警惕。

可还没等他找到躲在暗中的敌人，更多粘稠的虫丝向他喷射而来。

天残谷主迅速躲避。

咻！

轰！

一支爆炸箭落到天残谷主脚边，在他脚边炸开。

原本箭头瞄准的是他的下半身，但天残谷主躲避的速度飞快，这才以毫厘之差躲过箭头。

但爆炸箭炸开的余波还是波及到天残谷主的衣袍。

他的袍子脏了，被火焰燎出黑点，虽然没有破，但看着还是让他不舒坦。

天残谷主皱眉。

这件长袍的品质不算差，他给自己准备的外套都是炼金装备。

如果按照玩家的装备等级来算，他这件长袍已经达到九十级，普通武器别说击破长袍，就是弄脏都不太可能。

可现在……

这说明攻击他的武器等级绝对不低，至少不会低于他的长袍等级。

麻烦了！

他这具身体是他的分身之一，实力只在五十级左右。

不是他不想提升分身的实力，而是出生池有限制。

就算他拥有出生池的最大权限，也不能违反出生池本身的限定规则。

能搞出一出生就拥有五十级实力的兽人身体，已经耗费了他很多珍稀材料。

天残谷那具身体则不能动，那是游戏系统的锚点，更不能离开天残谷附近，同时也是这个兽人大陆给他的限制。

原本在他想来，五十级的实力也足够应对，何况他还穿了九十级的装备。

五十级对三十几级的玩家那还不是手到擒来？

可这该死的怪物竟然先一步盯上他。

而且这怪物的实力还达到了五十级！

怎么可能？

这些怪物才诞生多久？

难道这怪物在异变前就是高手？

可就算如此，他明明抑制了自己的信息素，这些怪物本应该无视他才对。

因为比起视觉，这些受虫毒感染的尸变怪物分辨周围活物的方式更多靠的是感知信息素。

信息素可以说是气味，但比平时嗅闻到的味道更加隐秘，它更像是一种促使行动发生的指令气味。

动物在感知到信息素时会攻击、发情等，就是受到这种指令气味的影响。

同样，尸变怪物感知到活人气息时，就会促使它们想要杀死和吃掉活人。它们也不会多思考为什么，只会直接行动。

还有，到底是谁在暗中偷袭他？

会是他要找的你皇吗？

天残谷主被攻击的瞬间想到很多，却完全没有影响到他的行动。

他想摆脱能喷吐虫丝的庞大怪物，化明为暗。

他怀疑你皇就在附近，很可能还认出了他。

能认出他，他不奇怪。只要你皇在玩家营地出现过，十有八九都见过他。

没有在玩家营地见过他，也一定在论坛里见过他的画像。

也就是游戏系统还没有开通拍照和录像功能，否则论坛里就不止有玩家给他画的画像。

天残谷主也想过要不要换一副容貌，但他觉得没必要。

他就不认为一只小虫子能伤害到他。

何况他来摩罗城总不能白来一趟，如果找不到你皇，或者处理你皇的过程太简单，那特意消耗能量开启传送阵的行为岂不是大大的浪费？

他希望这次出行的性价比能达到最高，所以他也做好了和当地权贵打交道的准备。

而他这张脸可以说天生自带好感度加成百分百，搭配他的气质，更是让他无往不利。

换掉岂不是不能让利益最大化？

眼看天残谷主一个飞跃就要脱离夏冰的攻击范围。

呼！

一阵狂风迎面吹来，把想要离开的天残谷主吹得差点闭眼掩面。

天残谷主操纵身体在狂风中飘荡，看起来还是很潇洒的。

咻咻咻！轰轰轰！

十支爆炸箭齐发，天残谷主脸色倏变。

这十支爆炸箭角度十分刁钻，几乎把他的躲避角度全都计算进去。

无论他往哪个方向躲，都会碰上至少一支爆炸箭。

天残谷主手腕一翻，手中出现一支精致的骨杖。

骨杖在天残谷主手中画了一个圆，一股看不见的能量波向四周弥漫。

能量波与爆炸箭相撞，发出剧烈的爆炸声。

这声剧烈的爆炸也引来了附近游荡怪物和斥候兽人的注意。

更多怪物向这边涌来。

天残谷主皱眉，想着要不要利用传送卷轴离开。

但储藏在骨杖中的魔力用一点少一点，他的传送卷轴需要不少魔力启动。

不行，不能就这么离开。

他连你皇那只小虫子都还没找到。

天残谷主举起骨杖，口中低念咒语。

虎不帅在看到那支长度约有一米左右的骨杖时，目光凝住。

他见过类似形状的东西，那是洛伦米尔顿的魔法杖，只不过当时那支魔法杖不是骨质。

他看到洛伦拿出魔法杖的机会不多，但他把魔法杖的外形记得很牢。

洛伦见他对杖头形状好奇，还曾告诉他那是他家族族徽的象征。

那是一只展翼的飞龙。

天残谷主现在手中拿着的骨杖杖头也是一只造型极为精美的展翼飞龙。

说来兽人大陆也有龙。

新兽人帝国的第一代帝皇阿莫斯布莱顿就是生有双翼的巨角龙族。

在古兽人帝国时期，龙族更是数量繁多。在远古时期，各龙族更只不过是众多兽人种族的一员。

只不过龙族好斗，自相残杀下，各龙族血脉越来越稀少，大战纪后更是少得可怜。

传说大战纪中，虫母带领的变异虫族先杀的就是战斗力强大的龙族。

龙族血脉也往往是战斗先锋，他们大多奋战在战斗第一线，这也导致含有龙族血脉的兽人死得最多。

大战纪过后，又经历了战毁纪和毒雾纪，龙族血脉进一步消失，现在的兽人大陆几乎听不到还有活的龙族兽人。

虎不帅忽然冷笑。

如果不是知道洛伦米尔顿的底细，第一次见到洛伦的人说不定会误以为他是龙族血脉后裔。

哦，也说不定。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 76: The Valley Master Disfigured (Part 1)

*Splat!*

A massive blob of grayish-black bug silk flew out to bind—or rather, failed to bind—its target. Valley Master Heavenly Maim possessed razor-fast reflexes; the moment the bug silk spat out, he dodged aside.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim turned his head in surprise. He had still been searching for traces of the beastman, never expecting to be ambushed.

As he turned, he saw a second cluster of silk shooting straight at him.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim let out a cold, exasperated laugh. He hadn't intended to act against these monsters, yet this beast was so ungrateful as to take the initiative and attack him.

Observing from the side, Shang Feifan’s eyes lit up the instant he saw Xia Bing attack Valley Master Heavenly Maim on his own initiative. *An opportunity!*

He flashed two hand signals to Tiger Bushuai.

Having fought alongside each other for four days, their tactical synergy had dramatically improved.

Tiger Bushuai nodded as soon as he saw the gestures, immediately splitting off in two directions with Shang Feifan to flank Valley Master Heavenly Maim.

Shang Feifan drew his longbow and loaded an explosive arrow.

The longbow was striking in appearance, possessing the mechanical crossbow's effortless draw and minimal recoil while capable of multi-shot salvos—up to ten explosive arrows at once.

Not wanting the explosion to splash onto Xia Bing, Shang Feifan calculated the angle and adjusted his position, aiming at Valley Master Heavenly Maim from Xia Bing’s diagonal flank.

The moment he was locked on, an instinctive alarm rang in Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s heart.

Yet before he could spot the enemy hidden in the shadows, even more viscous strands of bug silk sprayed toward him.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim dodged with lightning speed.

*Whew!*

*BOOM!*

An explosive arrow landed right at Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s feet, detonating beside him.

Originally, the arrow had been aimed at his lower body, but Valley Master Heavenly Maim moved so fast that he evaded the tip by a mere hair's breadth.

Even so, the shockwave of the detonation scorched Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s robes.

His robe was dirtied, singed black by the flames in several spots. Though unpurtured, it was an unsightly mess that displeased him greatly.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim frowned.

The quality of this robe was by no means low; the outerwear he prepared for himself were all alchemical gear.

If calculated according to player equipment tiers, this robe reached Level 90. Ordinary weapons could barely scratch it, let alone soil it.

And yet, now...

This meant the level of the weapon attacking him was definitely not low—at least not lower than the level of his robe.

Trouble!

This body was merely one of his avatars, with strength capped around Level 50.

It wasn't that he didn't want to raise his avatar's strength, but rather that the Spawning Pool imposed strict limitations.

Even with the highest authorization for the Spawning Pool, he couldn't violate the foundational laws of the pool itself.

Forging a beastman body that possessed Level 50 strength right upon spawning had already cost him vast quantities of rare materials.

As for his main body back in Heavenly Maim Valley, it couldn't move. That body served as the anchor for the game system, unable to leave the vicinity of Heavenly Maim Valley, and was also a restriction imposed on him by this Beastman Continent.

Originally, he had reasoned that Level 50 strength would be more than enough, especially since he wore Level 90 gear.

A Level 50 against Level 30-something players—wouldn't that be like taking candy from a baby?

Yet this damned monster had targeted him first.

And this monster’s strength had actually reached Level 50!

How was that possible?

How long had these monsters even existed?

Could this monster have been a high-level powerhouse before its mutation?

Even if that were true, he had clearly suppressed his own pheromones. These monsters should have ignored him completely.

Because rather than vision, these corpse-mutated beasts infected by the bug poison relied far more on sensing pheromones to distinguish living creatures around them.

Pheromones could be considered scents, but far more hidden than ordinary smells—more like directive scents that triggered specific actions.

When animals sensed pheromones, they would attack, mate, or react based on the influence of these directive scents.

Similarly, when corpse-mutated monsters sensed the aura of a living human, it impelled them to kill and devour the living. They wouldn't stop to think why; they would simply act.

Furthermore, who on earth was ambushing him from the shadows?

Could it be "Ni Huang," the one he was looking for?

A barrage of thoughts raced through Valley Master Heavenly Maim's mind the instant he was attacked, yet it didn't slow his movements in the slightest.

He wanted to throw off the massive monster spitting bug silk and shift from the light into the dark.

He suspected that Ni Huang was nearby and had very likely recognized him.

It wouldn't be surprising if Ni Huang recognized him. As long as Ni Huang had appeared in player camps, he would almost certainly have seen him.

Even if they hadn't seen him in player camps, they would have seen his portrait on the forums.

The only reason wasn't more widespread was that the game system hadn't unlocked photo and video recording features yet; otherwise, the forums would contain far more than just hand-drawn portraits made by players.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim had considered changing his appearance, but felt it unnecessary.

He simply didn't believe a mere little bug could harm him.

Besides, he couldn't make this trip to Molo City for nothing. If he failed to find Ni Huang, or if dealing with Ni Huang proved too simple, wouldn't expending energy to activate the teleportation array be a massive waste?

He wanted to maximize the cost-effectiveness of this journey, which meant he was also prepared to deal with the local nobility and upper crest.

And this face of his could be said to possess a natural hundred-percent favorability bonus. Combined with his demeanor, it made him invincible in diplomacy.

Wouldn't changing it prevent him from maximizing his profits?

Seeing Valley Master Heavenly Maim leap high into the air, about to break out of Xia Bing’s attack range—

*Whoosh!*

A violent gale blew straight into his face, forcing Valley Master Heavenly Maim, who was trying to leave, to nearly close his eyes and shield his face.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim manipulated his body to drift gracefully through the gale, maintaining a dashing appearance.

*Swish, swish, swish! BOOM, BOOM, BOOM!*

Ten explosive arrows fired simultaneously. Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s face abruptly changed.

The angles of these ten explosive arrows were extraordinarily tricky, calculating almost every single evasion path he could take.

No matter which direction he dodged, he would collide with at least one explosive arrow.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim flipped his wrist, and an exquisite bone staff appeared in his palm.

The bone staff traced a circle in his hand, and an invisible wave of energy radiated in all directions.

The energy wave collided with the explosive arrows, triggering a series of violent detonations.

The thunderous explosions instantly drew the attention of nearby wandering monsters and beastman scouts.

Even more monsters began swarming toward this location.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim frowned, weighing whether to use a teleportation scroll to leave.

However, the mana stored within the bone staff dwindled with every use, and his teleportation scroll required a considerable amount of mana to activate.

No, he couldn't leave just like this.

He hadn't even found that little bug, Ni Huang.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim raised his bone staff and softly chanted an incantation under his breath.

When Tiger Bushuai saw that bone staff—about a meter in length—his eyes locked onto it instantly.

He had seen something of a similar shape before: it was Loren Milton’s magic staff, except that one hadn't been made of bone.

He hadn't seen Loren take out his magic staff often, but he remembered its shape vividly.

When Loren saw his curiosity about the staff's pommel, he had once told him it represented his family’s crest.

It was a winged dragon.

The pommel of the bone staff in Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s hand right now was also an exquisitely crafted winged dragon.

Speaking of which, there were dragons on the Beastman Continent as well.

Amos Breton, the first emperor of the New Beastman Empire, was a giant horned dragon beastman with twin wings.

During the Ancient Beastman Empire era, dragons were even more numerous. In ancient times, the various dragon tribes were merely members of the vast beastman races.

However, dragons were combative by nature. Due to internecine slaughter, the bloodlines of the dragon tribes thinned over time, becoming exceedingly rare after the Era of Great War.

Legend had it that during the Era of Great War, the mutated insect swarms led by the Bug Mother first slaughtered the powerful dragon race.

The dragon bloodlines were often the battle vanguard, fighting on the front lines, which led to the highest death toll among beastmen containing dragon blood.

After the Era of Great War came the Era of War Ruins and the Era of Toxic Fog, further decimating the dragon bloodlines. Nowadays, living dragon beastmen were virtually unheard of on the Beastman Continent.

Tiger Bushuai suddenly let out a cold laugh.

If one didn't know Loren Milton’s true background, anyone meeting Loren for the first time might mistake him for a descendant of dragon blood.

Oh, perhaps it wasn't a mistake after all.

chunks.chineseText:
毕竟现在的洛伦米尔顿用的就是兽人身躯，谁能保证他这具身体里就没有蕴含龙族血脉？

以他对洛伦米尔顿的了解，对方如果想要换一具身体，也只会选择对他最有利的。

在兽人大陆还有比龙族血脉更强大的种族吗？

有，但那数量也是稀少到都是传说级别，比龙族还稀少的程度。

虎不帅看着天残谷主那张脸，心情极为复杂。

他当初以为他和洛伦米尔顿就是最普通的分手，两人在一起时间长了，感情消磨完了，不分手留着互相折磨吗？

好聚好散，他就是这么想的。

所以他从没有怨过更没有恨过对方，不管他心里有多难过。

其实比起后来他一手拉拔大的奥尔，他对洛伦的感情更纯粹。

对奥尔，他多少还是把对方当小孩子看。哪怕后来两人越过边界发展出情人关系，他还是会用包容的心态去看奥尔。

所以奥尔和他提出分手，说是喜欢上了别人。他难过伤心，但更多的是自己养大的崽子有老婆就忘记老父亲的被背叛感。

他和奥尔在一起时其实就做好了奥尔会喜欢上别人的心理准备。

这就像任何一个年纪大的情人和比自己年龄小很多的情人在一起时，都会做好的心理准备。

分手时很难过，但理智上早已接受。

他对奥尔就没有天长地久的指望，当然他会在心底期冀，但另一面又会冷静又冷漠地想，他迟早一天会离开我。

可是和洛伦在一起时，他真的认真考虑过一辈子。

为了对方，他甚至甘于洗手作羹汤，甘于过简单没有任何波澜的乡村生活。

他甚至还幻想要和对方领养一两个孩子，幻想两人一起慢慢老去的模样……

虎不帅用力咬住嘴唇，用劲太猛，咬出了血。

强烈的疼痛感让他快速冷静下来。

他以为他已经把两段感情全都遗忘，以为就算再见到两人，他也会平静微笑面对，说不定还能和对方点头打招呼，就跟路上看到前男友一样。

但他翻腾的心告诉他，他并没有真的遗忘。

他已经不爱，但受过的伤也不是那么容易抹平。

尤其在想到洛伦米尔顿和他的相识相爱很可能不是偶然……

不要想这么多！

冷静！

虎不帅在脑中命令自己。

他突然变成巨大白虎扑向天残谷主。

天残谷主刚刚施法杀死最先扑过来的一群怪物，逃出怪物包围圈，就见一只身高超过十米、身披陈旧铠甲的巨大白虎朝他扑了过来。

巨大的虎爪猛地抓向他的头脸。

天残谷主来不及再次施法，暗骂一声，飞速后跃。

砰！天残谷主的后背如被高速行驶的卡车撞到，整个人都被撞得飞向那庞大怪物。

天残谷主不知道身后是谁、是什么东西撞到了他，他只感到一股巨力和自己相撞，那力道大得他根本控制不住自己的身体，九十级的长袍也无法保护住他。

鲜血喷出口中的同时，天残谷主还在拼命扭动身躯想要改变方向。

噗噗噗！夏冰腹部一连喷出好几大坨虫丝。

天残谷主躲过了第一第二坨，到底没能躲过后面的，几坨极为粘稠的虫丝把他牢牢黏在原地，他的手和骨杖也被黏在了虫丝上。

趁他病要他命！

用巨力撞飞撞伤天残谷主的商非凡改弓为铲，挥铲就砍向天残谷主的脖颈。

杀死对方就查不出对方也穿越的原因？

那不重要！

这是游戏，商非凡不信杀死这个天残谷主就会让天残谷主彻底消失。

巨虎看到商非凡挥铲，他的身体猛然缩小，借着跃力跳到商非凡身后，防止他身后会有怪物偷袭他。

天残谷主看到了偷袭他的兽人。

一个蒙着脸的卑鄙家伙！

有种你给我露出脸来！

“你皇退休了？”天残谷主用极为肯定的语气喊出商非凡的玩家名。

商非凡没有理会，铲势不变。

天残谷主硬是扭头，让肩膀挨了一铲。

九十级的长袍起到了保护作用，但不是全部。

商非凡的力量已经超过百级，他这么尽全力的一铲，硬是让天残谷主发出一声闷哼，俊美的容颜疼到扭曲。

天残谷主听到了自己肩膀承受不住巨大铲力发出的破皮和碎骨声。

虽然有长袍保护和遮掩，但他的肩膀还是受到了重伤。

天残谷主用尽力气举起被虫丝黏住的骨杖，对准商非凡，他决定哪怕把骨杖里储存的魔力全部使用出来，也要干掉这只该死的胆敢伤害到他的虫子！

刷！

一只披着铠甲的白虎再次扑过来，咬住了他握着骨杖的手腕。

咔嚓一声，他的手腕直接被咬断。

白虎叼起即将落地的骨杖跳到一边。

“啊！”天残谷主突然发出惨叫。

惨叫不是因为他的手腕被白虎咬断。

而是一条滴着口水的长舌同时舔过他的脸！

口水落到地面发出腐蚀的声音。

天残谷主就是再能装，再能忍痛，被王水还要强腐蚀的口水舔到脸上，也受不了啊。

商非凡挑眉，他确实诅咒了天残谷主，但他真的没想到对方会以这种方式被毁容。

再看夏冰那裂开的可爱圆脸蛋，商非凡感觉自己在看新异形5。

Chapter 76: The Valley Master Disfigured (Part 2)

After all, the body Loren Milton was using right now was a beastman vessel. Who could guarantee that this body didn't harbor dragon bloodline traces?

Given his understanding of Loren Milton, if that man wanted to switch to a new body, he would only choose one that was most beneficial to him.

On the Beastman Continent, was there any race more powerful than the dragon bloodline?

There were, but their numbers were so scarce as to belong to legend—even rarer than dragons.

Tiger Bushuai looked at Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s face, his heart churning with complex emotions.

Back then, he had thought his breakup with Loren Milton was the most ordinary parting—that after being together for so long, their feelings had simply eroded away, so why stay together to torment each other?

Parting on good terms—that was what he had thought.

Hence, he had never resented or hated the man, no matter how deeply grieved he was in his heart.

In truth, compared to Aur, whom he had raised with his own hands later on, his feelings for Loren had been far more pure.

Toward Aur, he always viewed him more or less as a child. Even when the two later crossed the line and developed a romantic relationship, he still approached Aur with a tolerant, nurturing mindset.

So when Aur proposed breaking up, claiming he had fallen for someone else, he felt sad and heart-broken, but it was mostly the sense of betrayal of an old father whose raised pup forgot his dad once he got a wife.

When he was with Aur, he had already prepared himself mentally for the possibility that Aur would fall for someone else.

It was just like any older lover entering a relationship with someone much younger—a mental preparation everyone naturally made.

It hurt when they split, but his rational mind had accepted it long ago.

He had never expected a forever with Aur. Naturally, he harbored faint hopes deep down, but his cold, rational side would tell him: *He will leave me sooner or later.*

Yet when he was with Loren, he had genuinely, earnestly considered spending a lifetime together.

For Loren, he had even been willing to step away from his lifestyle, cook simple meals, and live a tranquil, mundane rural life.

He had even imagined adopting a child or two with him, picturing how they would slowly grow old together...

Tiger Bushuai bit his lower lip hard—so hard that it drew blood.

The sharp sting of pain brought him back to composure rapidly.

He thought he had completely forgotten both relationships, believing that even if he met them again, he could face them with a calm smile, perhaps even nodding in greeting like seeing an ex-boyfriend on the street.

Yet the churning within his heart told him he hadn't truly forgotten.

He no longer loved them, but the wounds he endured weren't so easily erased.

Especially when considering that his meeting and falling in love with Loren Milton might not have been a coincidence at all...

*Don't think about it so much!*

*Stay calm!*

Tiger Bushuai commanded himself in his mind.

Abruptly transforming into a colossal white tiger, he pounced toward Valley Master Heavenly Maim.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim had just cast a spell to slaughter the first wave of swarming monsters and escape their encirclement when he saw a massive white tiger—over ten meters tall and clad in worn armor—pouncing straight at him.

A massive tiger paw smashed violently toward his head and face.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim didn't have time to cast another spell. Cursing beneath his breath, he leaped backward at top speed.

*BANG!* 

Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s back felt as if it had been struck by a high-speed truck, sending his entire body flying straight toward that massive monster.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim didn't know who or what had struck him from behind. He only felt an immense force colliding with him, a power so vast that he couldn't control his own body at all, and his Level 90 robe failed to cushion the impact.

As blood sprayed from his mouth, Valley Master Heavenly Maim desperately twisted his body, attempting to shift his direction.

*Pfft, pfft, pfft!* 

Several massive wads of bug silk spat in rapid succession from Xia Bing’s abdomen.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim dodged the first and second wads, but ultimately couldn't dodge the ones that followed. Several clusters of extremely sticky bug silk pinned him firmly to the spot, trapping his hands and his bone staff against the adhesive web.

Strike while he's down!

Shang Feifan, who had used monstrous strength to slam into and injure Valley Master Heavenly Maim, switched his bow for a spade, swinging it viciously toward Valley Master Heavenly Maim’s neck.

Killing him would prevent them from investigating how he transmigrated?

That didn't matter!

This was a game; Shang Feifan didn't believe that killing this Valley Master Heavenly Maim would make him vanish permanently.

Seeing Shang Feifan swing the spade, the giant tiger’s body shrank rapidly. Using the momentum of his leap, he landed right behind Shang Feifan, guarding against any monster sneak attacks from behind.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim caught sight of the beastman ambushing him.

A masked, despicable coward!

If you have the guts, show your face!

"Ni Huang Retired?" Valley Master Heavenly Maim shouted out Shang Feifan’s player handle in an extremely definitive tone.

Shang Feifan ignored him completely, his spade’s trajectory unwavering.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim forced his neck aside, taking the full force of the spade onto his shoulder.

The Level 90 robe offered protection, but not entirely.

Shang Feifan’s raw physical power had already exceeded Level 100. Such a full-force strike made Valley Master Heavenly Maim let out a stifled groan, his handsome features contorting in agony.

Valley Master Heavenly Maim heard the sickening crunch of torn flesh and shattered bone beneath the massive impact on his shoulder.

Though protected and concealed by the robe, his shoulder had suffered a severe injury.

Summoning all his strength, Valley Master Heavenly Maim raised the bone staff stuck in the bug silk and aimed it at Shang Feifan. He decided that even if it meant expending all the magic power stored within the bone staff, he would obliterate this damned bug that dared to harm him!

*Swish!*

An armored white tiger pounced once more, biting directly onto his wrist holding the staff.

With a sharp *snap*, his wrist was bitten clean off.

The white tiger caught the falling bone staff in its jaws and leaped to the side.

"AHHH!" Valley Master Heavenly Maim suddenly shrieked in agony.

The scream wasn't because his wrist had been bitten off by the tiger.

It was because a long, slobbering tongue had simultaneously licked across his face!

Where the saliva splashed onto the ground, a loud hiss of chemical corrosion rang out.

No matter how composed Valley Master Heavenly Maim tried to act, no matter how high his pain tolerance, having saliva stronger than aqua regia lick across his face was unbearable.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. He had indeed cursed Valley Master Heavenly Maim, but he really hadn't expected the man to be disfigured in such a fashion.

Glancing at Xia Bing’s split, adorable round face, Shang Feifan felt as though he were watching a scene out of *Alien 5*.

第77章 诱饵

天残谷主身影陡然消失。

他这么做显然很聪明，失去目标的夏冰目光游荡，看到了白虎和商非凡。

两人也跟着迅速隐身，并飞快拉出距离。

商非凡在隐身之际，突然对着夏冰裂开的嘴巴抛出一个小瓶子。

夏冰来者不拒，也不管那小瓶子是什么，直接就嚼碎吞入腹中。

活物气息彻底消失，夏冰和其他怪物又变得毫无目标。

夏冰盯着那些四散游荡的怪物，原本还想找些味道比较好的，忽然他的身体抽搐了一下。

不帅隐身了，但商非凡还能感知到他在哪里。

他在跟踪天残谷主时给自己买了个隐身发箍，很小的束发环，就是装饰物，可以箍在毛发上，不管怎么活动都不会掉下来，也不会影响变身。

这个隐身发箍的效果没有他送给不帅的隐匿耳环那么优秀，不能隐匿全部气息，也不能掩盖住声音，优点就是只要一点点能量启动就能长时间使用。

但就算效果单一，价格也十分昂贵，需要500点。

不过具有隐身作用的装备没有一个便宜的。

商非凡会在一堆隐身装备中买这个隐身发箍，除了它本身的优点，更因为他看到这个隐身发箍的一个附加说明。

这个隐身发箍的炼制者和他送给不帅的隐身保命耳环的炼制者是同一个人。两者竟然可以联动使用。

也就是只要两人愿意，他们可以在隐身状态还能看到彼此，听到对方说话。只不过需要两人靠得很近才行。在一定距离内，他们还能感知到彼此的装备。

一看到这个说明，商非凡连犹豫都没有犹豫，就把这个隐身发箍买了下来。

商非凡跑到白虎身边，靠近一米之内，两人就能彼此看到。

商非凡低声说：“你觉得那家伙跑了吗？”

“他戴着一个手镯。”虎不帅放下叼着的骨杖，貌似答非所问。

但商非凡听懂了：“你是说他那支手镯有可能是空间手镯，他拿出了某种能隐身的道具？”

“也可能他本身就有隐身能力。”虎不帅小声说。

商非凡略略思考，“我觉得他应该是使用了道具。如果隐身对他来说很方便，我要是他，会在进入摩罗城后就选择隐身，这样他可以把自己完美地藏在暗处。现在才隐身，必然这种隐身需要某种代价，时间也不会很长。”

“他还在原地吗？”虎不帅利用精神力扫描，试图找出天残谷主。

商非凡按住他：“我感知到你的精神力了。说不定那家伙也能感知到。”

虎不帅不是不知道这点，只是有点心乱，一时没能想到。

“那人的实力似乎不是很强。”虎不帅忽然发现他也不知道洛伦米尔顿的真实实力，只知道对方会魔法，知识渊博，很可能来历不凡。

不帅有点晕，他和那人相识九年，同居八年，虽然有他自己刻意回避的问题，但当他发现他对自己情人的了解可能和路人差不多时，心中也忍不住生出了一股悲凉之感。

那时候他竟然觉得洛伦是为了不刺激他，不想他自卑，才会不说出自己的身份来历。并把这个当做对方的优点，觉得对方体贴又温柔。

如果两人只是露水情缘，那彼此这样处理没什么问题。

可他一开始可是以为两人要在一起过一辈子的！

面对一生认定的伴侣，一方什么都不问，另一方竟然也能什么都不说。

他那时候到底都在想些什么？

“他已经很强，只是我们先一步发现了他，算是有心算无心，加上夏冰和他实力等级差不多，更没想到我们的力量会超过他的预想，他才被我们联手打了个措手不及。但一旦他有所准备，胜负就难说。”

更重要的是他们身上还有远超玩家现有实力的装备和武器，这才是他们目前最大依仗。

商非凡很冷静。他再看天残谷主不顺眼，也不可能把他当做虫蚁，相反他在心里已经把天残谷主当做了这个游戏的幕后Boss之一。

Boss如果这么容易杀死，那还叫Boss吗？

就算这个杀死了，说不定副本中还会一遍又一遍冒出来恶心人。

“可惜。”

可惜这次没能留下那人，没能弄清楚对方穿越的秘密和原因。虎不帅把脚边骨杖轻轻推了推。

商非凡弯身捡起骨杖：“你好像很在意这个东西？”

他看到白虎是特意去咬天残谷主的手腕，等对方刚把骨杖脱手，就把骨杖抢了过来。

从不喜欢用嘴巴和牙齿攻击敌人的不帅竟然会用咬的……

商非凡心里小小不爽，他家不帅还没有咬过他呢，倒是让天残谷主抢先了。

白虎不知道老商心里都在想些什么乱七八糟的鬼东西，很认真地回答：“这是法杖。可以施展魔法的法杖。”

如果他之前还有点怀疑自己的猜测，可在听到天残谷主用法德尔的魔法专用语念出施展魔法的咒语，他最后一丝-不确定也被打消。

那节奏，那语感，不是洛伦米尔顿又是谁？

“哦？”看来这个游戏果然不止是异能和科技，魔法也就要加入进来。

也许以后会异能的兽人和会魔法的存在会成为两个阵营的敌人？

商非凡想到地球上的一些经典游戏，兽人和纯人类不向来是两个对立阵营吗？

“你看到法杖顶端那只展翼飞龙爪子下扣住的宝石了吗？”

“嗯。”

“那是魔晶。等级至少达到九级的魔晶！”

“九级魔晶很了不起？具体有什么作用？”

白虎神色严肃，“非常了不起。九级已经是法德尔大陆市面上能买到的最高等级魔晶。传说还有十级乃至以上的魔晶，但那都是传说，从来没有人真正看到过。当然也可能我混的层次太低，无法看到更高级的宝贝。

不过九级魔晶向来是魔导师的标配。而魔导师已经是法德尔大陆的最高力量层次。

至于魔晶的作用，很多。最常见的就是当做释放和储存魔力的媒介。”

商非凡恍然大悟：“怪不得他的能力有点怪，嘴里也在念念有词，原来他在借用这支法杖施展魔法。”

“是。他一开始明显在珍惜使用这支魔杖的魔力，一旦让他放开使用，就如你所说，胜负结果就难料了。而只要这支魔杖还在他手中，他就相当于拥有了一个超级……能量盒。”虎不帅差点说出蓄电池，及时改口。

“九级魔晶不是那么容易得到的东西，我相信他就算有多余的，也不会随身携带两枚。他现在隐身藏起来就是一个证明。”

商非凡沉思，“他既然能弄到九级魔晶，那会不会也能弄到九级以下的魔晶？”

虎不帅：“不排除这个可能。”

“看来我得加快弄出能量转换器。”以及提升自己的实力。商非凡自语。

在不知道天残谷主拥有多少魔晶的情况下，他们和天残谷主对上，就很可能对上一个可以随意施法的魔导师。

至少是魔导师。

商非凡理智地把天残谷主的实力等级放得很高。
