chunks.chineseText:
第87章 强大的心脏

商非凡再次进入游戏已经是一天后。

这是他第一次下线这么长时间。

“不帅呢？”商非凡把整个洞屋都找了一遍，没看到不帅。

夏冰正在门外带阿呆玩耍，闻言忙回答：“他去忙事情了。这会儿不是在治安所，就是在巡逻。”

商非凡揉揉阿呆的脑袋，“你跟夏冰在家里玩，我去找你不帅爸爸。”

阿呆点点头。

夏冰张口欲言。

商非凡像是知道他想说什么：“我打算在镇子上开一家炼金店，到时候你来看店。”

他才不会放着一个壮劳力不用，还白养着。

夏冰眼睛一亮，惊喜：“老大你会炼金？”

商非凡：“看你表现。”

这是什么意思？难道是？！夏冰不笨，但又有点不可置信。

他还想确认一下，回过神却发现商老大已经走远。

夏冰呆愣片刻，一把抄起地上的阿呆，抱着他的前肢用力摇晃，疯狂问：“老大说的是不是那个意思？他是不是说我只要表现好就会收我为学徒？他是不是想要教我炼金术？”

阿呆被晃得脑袋发晕，很想跟他商爸说别收这人为学徒了。

商非凡召唤来狰爷，跳上它的背，一路奔向镇治安所。

路上有巡逻队看到他，也没多少排斥之意，更没有人让他停下检查或询问。

治安所成了镇子的临时指挥中心。

镇长、治安官和民兵团长都在这里办事，镇祭司羊大婶支援。

不时有民兵在这里进进出出，大家看起来都很忙碌的样子。

商非凡还看到有人带着两箱药剂从治安所里出来，和等候的同伴骑上巨虫就匆忙离去。

狼四在治安所门口看到商非凡，直接把他领了进去。

镇长看到商非凡就不客气地说：“不帅参加了巡逻队，正在镇子外面巡逻。他说如果你来找我，就让我给你安排一点事情做。你擅长什么？”

这份不客气反而让商非凡自在：“我学了一点炼金术，另外还懂一点草药。不过在这之前，我需要先去莫约山谷一趟，我曾经答应迪莉娅夫人要为她寻找一颗百年不腐尸心脏、三只独角虫犀的角、和九十九只黑骨山活骨虫。”

虽然他现在已经不需要迪莉娅夫人为他解除诅咒，但一来那位夫人似乎在拿这个约定为难他，二来他也很好奇这个任务完成后系统会奖励他什么。

原定奖励是初级鉴定术，可现在他已经学会鉴定术，那么会让初级升到中级吗？

对此，商非凡很是期待。

“需要向导吗？”镇长可不敢让商非凡无视和自家夫人的约定。

商非凡摇头：“如果不帅有空的话。”

镇长笑：“不帅那支巡逻队现在应该就在莫约山谷谷口的流浪兽人营地那里，你去那里找他，就说我说的，让他给你当向导。”

“谢谢！”

商非凡达到目的，没有多耽搁，就骑着狰爷向镇子外跑去。

踏上镇外那条主干道时，商非凡远远看到荒原里那群林格莱特家族的迁徙队还在。

等来到混乱区，也是镇长口中的流浪兽人营地，商非凡发现这里似乎有了不小变化。

原本这里只有巨大的石头堆砌的围墙，围墙中间有一扇像是用骨头编织起来的骨头大门。但现在这堵围墙前面竟然又多了一堵由泥巴、石头和骨头混合而成的围墙。

围墙中间有门，大门敞开，并没有人看守。

商非凡驱使狰爷走入大门，里面竟然是一个新扩建出来的生活区。

特色还是混乱，乱搭乱建，毫无规划。

地面非常肮脏，有些地方还有大火焚烧过的痕迹。

往里走，商非凡看到了巡逻队。

巡逻队似乎正在忙着拆除一排地窝棚子，这支巡逻队的民兵人人都带着口罩一样的面巾。

“不帅！”商非凡一眼就看到了也在忙碌的虎不帅。

虎不帅转头，看到商，对他摇摇手。

商非凡从狰爷背上跳下来，很自然地走过去帮忙，还对巡逻队的民兵们打招呼。

带头的民兵队长他眼熟，似乎是他第一次来到莫约镇时治安官安德烈叫上的民兵之一。

“你不用动手。”虎不帅说着还掏出一个口罩递给商非凡，示意他戴上。

商非凡不想让不帅担心，依言戴上：“镇长让你做我的向导。”

两人几乎同时开口。

虎不帅：“给我点时间，我这边就快忙完了。”

民兵队长听到，直接喊：“不帅少爷，镇长既然另外有吩咐，你就先去忙镇长吩咐的事，这边都是杂事，多你一个不多，少你一个不少。”

其他民兵闻言一起笑起来。

不帅不在意地笑笑，也没坚持，拍拍手和身上的尘土，对商非凡道：“那我们走吧，趁着天色还早，我们先把不腐尸的心脏或者独角虫犀找到。”

民兵队长问要不要借他一只巨虫坐骑，不帅摇头，表示他和商非凡同骑就好。

从摩罗城到莫约镇那么长的路，他和商已经同乘惯了。

两人跳上狰爷的背，向莫约山谷奔去。

往里走就是原先的混乱区，那扇骨头大门敞开着，还歪到了一边。

里面建筑物大多被摧毁和焚烧过，到处都是一片寂寥，不见半个兽人踪影。

“这里的兽人都离开了？”商非凡站在不帅的身边问。

他试图让自己的语气正常，不想让自己把看到郎沐墓碑和骨灰的情绪带到这里。

不帅垂下眼眸：“病死很多。更多人死于自相残杀。有些人只是有生病征兆就被杀死烧死，更有些人没有病也被硬说成有病。混乱区内打成一团，镇长让我们封锁了混乱区大门，有跑出来的人就抓起来关到外面隔离区，直到里面平息下来。但里面跑出来的人不多。”

这种事谁听到都会骇然。

商非凡却面色冷静，“那种情况下，如果你姨父不这么做，倒霉的就是你们镇子。”

不帅自然知道这个道理，但亲身经历这种事的人谁能好过？

“何况你们镇长也没要求把逃出来的人都杀死。你自己也说了，混乱区的人是死于自相残杀。”

“我们原本可以进去阻止。”不帅艰难地道。

商非凡抬手就拍了他后脑勺一巴掌。

不帅：“……”

商非凡：“别说这种幼稚话。除了自我满足以外，没有任何意义。除非你们能确保进去也能保证自身和队友安全。还能保证自己和队友不会被抓、不会被里面的病患当做人质威胁镇子，但你们能吗？”

不帅哑巴了。

商非凡：“没有那金刚钻就不要揽瓷器活。否则只是害人害己。遇到自己无法解决的事，多听听老人的意见。他们也许保守，但他们能活到老也是有原因的。”

不帅：“……”

“外面隔离区在拆除？为什么不用火烧？”商非凡非常自如地转移到第二个话题。

Chapter 87: A Strong Heart

Shang Fanfan logged back into the game a full day later.

This was the first time he had logged off for so long.

"Where is Bushuai?" Shang Fanfan searched the entire cave dwelling from top to bottom without seeing him.

Xia Bing was outside the door playing with A-Dai, and upon hearing the question, he hurriedly replied, "He went out to take care of some business. At this hour, he's either at the security office or out on patrol."

Shang Fanfan rubbed A-Dai’s head. "You play here at home with Xia Bing; I'm going to find your Papa Bushuai."

A-Dai nodded.

Xia Bing opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something.

Shang Fanfan spoke as though he could read his mind: "I plan to open an alchemy shop in town, and you can tend the shop when the time comes."

He was hardly going to let a prime piece of labor go to waste while feeding him for free.

Xia Bing’s eyes lit up, and he asked in pleasant surprise, "Boss, you know alchemy?"

Shang Fanfan replied, "We'll see how you perform."

What was that supposed to mean? Could it be?! Xia Bing wasn't stupid, yet he found it a bit hard to believe.

He wanted to confirm further, but when he snapped back to his senses, he found that Boss Shang had already walked away.

Xia Bing stood frozen for a moment before scooping A-Dai off the ground, grabbing the little beast's front paws, shaking them vigorously, and demanding frantically, "Did what the Boss said mean what I think it means? Did he mean that as long as I perform well, he'll take me as an apprentice? Was he hinting that he wants to teach me alchemy?"

A-Dai was shaken until his head spun, desperately wishing he could tell his Papa Shang not to take this guy on as an apprentice.

Shang Fanfan summoned Master Zhen, leaped onto its back, and galloped all the way toward the town security office.

Along the way, patrol squads caught sight of him, yet showed no hint of hostility, nor did anyone stop him to check or question him.

The security office had now become the town's temporary command center.

The Mayor, the Sheriff, and the Militia Commander were all handling affairs here, with Auntie Sheep the town priestess providing support.

Militiamen constantly streamed in and out of the building, and everyone looked extremely busy.

Shang Fanfan even saw someone carrying two boxes of potions out of the security office, mounting a giant insect alongside waiting companions, and hurrying away.

Wolf Four spotted Shang Fanfan at the entrance of the security office and led him straight inside.

Upon seeing Shang Fanfan, the Mayor wasted no politeness. "Bushuai joined the patrol squad and is currently patrolling outside the town. He said if you came looking for me, I should arrange some work for you. What are you good at?"

This lack of formality actually made Shang Fanfan feel more at ease. "I've studied a bit of alchemy, and I also know a thing or two about herbs. Before that, however, I need to make a trip to Moyue Valley first. I once promised Madam Delia that I would find her an unrotting corpse heart that remains intact for a hundred years, three horns of a single-horned rhinoceros beetle, and ninety-nine live bone-worms from Black Bone Mountain."

Although he no longer needed Madam Delia to lift his curse, for one thing, that lady seemed to be using this promise to test him, and for another, he was quite curious about what kind of reward the system would grant him upon completing this quest.

The original promised reward was the Primary Appraisal Skill, but since he had already learned Appraisal, would it upgrade the skill from Primary to Intermediate?

At this, Shang Fanfan felt a surge of anticipation.

"Do you need a guide?" The Mayor wouldn't dare let Shang Fanfan brush off the agreement with his wife.

Shang Fanfan shook his head. "If Bushuai is free."

The Mayor chuckled. "Bushuai's patrol squad should be stationed right over at the wandering beastman camp at the mouth of Moyue Valley. Go find him there and tell him I sent you; have him act as your guide."

"Thank you!"

Having achieved his goal without further delay, Shang Fanfan rode Master Zhen and bolted out of town.

As he stepped onto the main thoroughfare outside the town, Shang Fanfan caught sight of the migrating caravan of the Lingelate family still camped out in the wasteland far in the distance.

Upon reaching the chaotic district—which the Mayor referred to as the wandering beastman camp—Shang Fanfan discovered that this place had undergone quite a few changes.

Originally, there had only been an enclosing wall built from massive stones, with a bone-woven gate right in the middle. But now, an additional wall made of a mixture of mud, stones, and bones had been erected right in front of the old one.

There was a gate in the middle of this new wall, and it stood wide open with no one guarding it.

Shang Fanfan urged Master Zhen through the entrance, only to find that the interior had been newly expanded into a residential zone.

The defining characteristic remained absolute chaos—shanties haphazardly thrown up with zero planning.

The ground was terribly filthy, and traces of heavy fire damage lingered in certain areas.

Walking deeper in, Shang Fanfan spotted the patrol squad.

The patrollers appeared busy tearing down a row of dugout shacks, and every militiaman in this unit wore a mask-like cloth covering over their face.

"Bushuai!" Shang Fanfan spotted Hu Bushuai working amidst the bustle at a single glance.

Hu Bushuai turned his head, saw Shang, and waved at him.

Shang Fanfan leaped down from Master Zhen's back, walked over quite naturally to lend a hand, and greeted the militia members.

He recognized the militia captain leading the group; it was one of the militiamen Sheriff Andre had called upon when Shang Fanfan first arrived at Moyue Town.

"You don't need to get your hands dirty," Hu Bushuai said, pulling out a cloth face mask to hand to Shang Fanfan, signaling him to put it on.

Not wanting to make Bushuai worry, Shang Fanfan put it on as instructed. "The Mayor sent you to be my guide."

The two of them spoke almost simultaneously.

Hu Bushuai said, "Give me a moment, I'm almost done here."

Hearing this, the militia captain shouted out directly, "Young Master Bushuai, since the Mayor has other orders for you, go take care of what the Mayor needs first. This is all just miscellaneous busywork; one more of you doesn't make a difference, and one less won't be missed."

The other militiamen chuckled in unison at this.

Bushuai smiled without minding, brushed the dust off his hands and body, and said to Shang Fanfan, "Let's go then. While the day is still early, let's find the unrotting corpse heart or the single-horned rhino beetle first."

The militia captain asked if they needed to borrow a giant insect mount, but Bushuai shook his head, indicating that he and Shang Fanfan would ride together.

After such a long journey from Moluo City to Moyue Town, he and Shang were already used to sharing a mount.

The two vaulted onto Master Zhen's back and galloped toward Moyue Valley.

Passing further inward brought them to the former chaotic zone; that bone gate stood wide open, canted drunkenly to one side.

Most of the buildings inside had been destroyed and burned down, leaving a desolate landscape everywhere, devoid of even a single beastman's shadow.

"Have all the beastmen here left?" Shang Fanfan stood beside Bushuai and asked.

He tried to keep his tone normal, unwilling to let his emotions regarding Lang Mu's gravestone and ashes bleed into this place.

Bushuai lowered his gaze. "Many died of illness. Even more died from mutual slaughter. Some were killed and burned just for showing signs of falling sick, while others who weren't sick at all were falsely accused of having the plague. The chaotic district fell into utter civil war; the Mayor had us seal the gates to the chaotic district, and anyone who managed to run out was rounded up and locked in the outer quarantine zone until things quieted down inside. But very few people managed to escape from within."

Anyone hearing of such events would find them horrifying.

Yet Shang Fanfan's expression remained calm. "Under those circumstances, if your uncle hadn't done that, your town would have been the one in bad luck."

Bushuai naturally understood this logic, but who could endure experiencing such a thing firsthand without it taking a toll?

"Besides, your Mayor didn't demand that everyone who escaped be killed. As you said yourself, the people inside the chaotic district died of mutual slaughter."

"We could have gone in to stop it," Bushuai said with difficulty.

Shang Fanfan raised his hand and slapped the back of his head.

Bushuai: "..."

Shang Fanfan: "Don't say such childish things. Apart from self-satisfaction, it has zero meaning—unless you can guarantee that going in would ensure the safety of both yourselves and your teammates, and guarantee that neither you nor your teammates would be captured or used as hostages by the sick patients inside to threaten the town. But can you?"

Bushuai was struck dumb.

Shang Fanfan: "Don't bite off more than you can chew if you don't have the diamond drill for it. Otherwise, you'll only end up harming others and yourself. When you encounter problems you can't resolve, listen more to the advice of the elders. They may be conservative, but there's a reason they've lived to old age."

Bushuai: "..."

"The outer quarantine zone is being torn down? Why aren't they burning it?" Shang Fanfan smoothly pivoted to a second topic.

chunks.chineseText:
不帅干咳：“因为还有些人躲在隔离区里不肯离去，其中还有带着幼崽的流浪兽人。我们现在只能手动拆除，等把里面藏着的兽人都赶出来，再放火焚烧整个隔离区和混乱区。镇长这次下定决心，要把混乱区彻底抹平。”

商非凡冷血地说：“你们放火，不想死的人自然会自己跑出来。”

虎不帅摇头：“我们试过，不行。有些兽人会故意把老兽人和孩子丢在帐篷里。”

“陷害？”

“嗯。有人想找镇子麻烦。”虎不帅把镇子目前的情况大致跟商非凡说了说。

这个新增加的隔离区除了收容混乱区逃出来的人，还有就是收留因为疫情跑来这边求救的附近其他地区的兽人。

绝大多数兽人在拿到药物或好转后就回去了自己的村落和聚集地，但也有少数人留下。

这些人有的是对原来的聚集地失望，有的是已经无处可去，但也有些浑水摸鱼的人，他们都想要加入镇子。

因为这些人成分太复杂，莫约镇几个管理者召集镇上德高望重的人一起商议后，觉得与其同意让少数人加入镇子，还不如一个都不要。

“制约镇子不能收留更多人口的要因还是因为粮食不够？”

“是。另外镇长他们也需要提防附近的大领主想要借此占领镇子农田。”

“附近领主是不是也看出来这场疫情来得很古怪？”

“能当领主的没几个傻子。他们甚至还猜测莫约镇是不是得罪了某个大人物，才会遭遇这种倒霉事。有些早就盯着莫约镇农田的领主就想趁此机会分一杯羹，也有些人是想讨好那个没有露面的未知大人物。”

不帅的表情有点讥讽。

商非凡很容易就能猜到，附近领主很可能打听到了不帅的身世，有人会对此避之不及，但也有人会觉得里面有利可图。

“你姨父和小姨怪罪过你吗？镇上的人因此说过你吗？”

虎不帅一愣，继而苦笑：“他们要是肯说我就好了。”

他小姨也从来只说原身母亲的死怪他，但从没有说要赶他离开镇子，更没有说过他给镇子带来灾祸的话。

商非凡按住他的肩膀：“我不否认莫约镇会遭遇此劫与你有一定关系，但最重要的原因还是怀璧其罪。”

“就这么一个镇子，却拥有能让四五千人吃饱的可耕种农田，包括附近村落也有一定的可耕种田地，就问附近哪个领主会不眼红？”

“否则背后的阴谋者为什么不搞其他手段，非要搞大型疫情，还把附近其他兽人聚集地也给牵连进来？”

“他们就是想要害人，想要消灭人口，想要得到这一大片土地！说句不好听话，你只是一个连带利益，甚至只是一个借口。”

不等不帅开口，商非凡又竖起手指：“最重要的是，受害者从来不是祸根。不要理会那些‘如果不是你，我们怎么会怎样怎样’的话，那只是弱者对恶人的无能表现和迁怒。”

“作恶者行凶者也巴不得受害者都这么想，让受害者彼此埋怨怨恨，他们的罪过就成了第二位，甚至变成事出有因。你不觉得这点很可笑吗？”

“有人因为美丽可爱，有人因为富裕，有人因为拥有特殊物品或特别的才能等等，导致家破人亡，甚而‘连累’整个国家。偏偏那些受害者不去找凶手麻烦，反而去围攻凶手的目标，甚至要把凶手的目标交给凶手，你觉得这种行为正确吗？”

虎不帅下意识想要摇头，忍住。

商非凡继续：“谁敢保证自己不是下一个被觊觎、被仇恨、被妒忌的存在？”

“难道有人要求大家交出他们想要的人或物，大家就必须交出吗？那这样人类跟羊圈里的羊还有什么区别？”

“不能保护自己人、只会推脱责任、只能对弱者狂怒的智慧物种存在又还有什么意义？”

“对此，你姨父和小姨以及整个镇子的兽人就做得很好，他们不仅仅是在保护你，他们更是在保护做人的原则。”

虎不帅举起手投降：“别再说了，你已经不止一次用这些毒鸡汤安慰我。”

“这不是毒鸡汤，这是真理。”商非凡跟对孩子一样……不，他对孩子可没这样的耐心和温柔。

摸摸不帅的短发：“看清真正的凶手，永远不要把不属于自己的罪过揽到自己头上，有那个力气不如去找真凶麻烦。”

不帅抬头：“你就是这么做的吗？”

商非凡毫不犹豫地回答：“是。”

他是卖刀的人，但他从来不认为用刀行凶的凶手的罪孽和他有关。

如果有人因为他的身份就要灭掉一个小镇，他只会想法查出对方身份，再反杀回去。或者干脆就武装小镇，让小镇把来犯者给直接灭了，再去抢夺来犯者的土地和财富来弥补自身损失和震慑他人。

如果小镇因此被灭，他也只会抱着强烈的仇恨心复仇，而不是强烈自责和愧疚。因为他清楚知道错的不是他，是行凶者！

虎不帅非常羡慕商能拥有如此强大的心脏。

他觉得绝大多数人遇到这种事都会自责愧疚，认为是自己连累了大家。

“你是做大事的人。”不帅感叹。

商非凡微微勾起唇角：“不，我就是个打手和棋子。”

“那执棋人拥有你这样的棋子一定很幸福。”

“哈！”商非凡大笑：“是的，他们很幸福。”

幸福到都不知道该把他放在哪里了。

所以他很自觉地从棋盘上下来，跳进了大海里。

他的工作已经结束，现在他将要开始自己真正的人生。

退役后他正好没什么人生目标，原本打算瞎混，但现在他找到了。

他给自己找到了一个锚。

如果他要给自己未来也设定一个任务目标，那大概就是和眼前人一起好好地活下去吧。

虎不帅轻轻吐气。

他得承认，商的鸡汤虽然老套，但对他真的很有用。

有时候人真的很需要他人支持，而且是不考虑任何道理道德，就不分青红皂白地站在自己这边这种。

“我找到郎沐的坟墓了。”

虎不帅心里咯噔一跳。

空气变得凝滞。

不帅嘴角慢慢拉平，神色也变得沉寂。

他让商非凡去调查十一年前遇到的那个人，心里已经做好准备要面对什么。

可他没想到对方速度那么快，这才过去多久？

商非凡轻轻握住不帅的手。

不帅想要挣脱，却被握得很紧。

过了一会儿，不帅不再挣扎，就任由商非凡那么握着他的手。

他在放空自己的所有情绪和想法。

商非凡没有看他，而是看着即将到达的前方谷口：“你那个同父异母的弟弟郎岸为什么要杀死你？”

不帅沉默。

作者有话说：

不帅和商非凡一样，也很需要心理按摩。

不过商非凡是疏导不要走歪走邪，不帅则需要从内耗中跳出。
chunks.englishText:
Hu Bushuai gave a dry cough. "Because there are still some people hiding in the quarantine zone who refuse to leave, including stray beastmen with their cubs. We can only dismantle the tents manually now. Once we've driven out all the beastmen hiding inside, we'll set fire to the entire quarantine zone and the chaotic zone. The mayor has made up his mind this time to completely raze the chaotic zone to the ground."

Shang Feifan said with cold blood, "If you set the fire, those who don't want to die will naturally run out on their own."

Hu Bushuai shook his head. "We tried, it didn't work. Some beastmen deliberately leave old beastmen and children behind in the tents."

"Framing you?"

"Mm. Someone wants to cause trouble for the town." Hu Bushuai briefly explained the town's current situation to Shang Feifan.

Aside from housing people who escaped from the chaotic zone, this newly added quarantine zone also took in beastmen from other nearby areas who had fled here seeking help due to the epidemic.

The vast majority of beastmen returned to their own villages and settlements after receiving medicine or recovering, but a small number stayed behind.

Some of these people were disappointed with their original settlements, some had nowhere else to go, but there were also opportunists trying to fish in troubled waters—all of them wanted to join the town.

Because the demographic composition of these people was too complicated, the several administrators of Moyue Town, after convening the town's respected elders for discussion, decided that rather than agreeing to let a small number of people join the town, it was better to accept none at all.

"Is the main factor preventing the town from taking in more population still a lack of food?"

"Yes. In addition, the mayor and the others also need to guard against nearby grand lords trying to use this as an excuse to seize the town's farmland."

"Are the nearby lords also realizing that this epidemic came about very strangely?"

"Few who can become lords are fools. They even speculated whether Moyue Town had offended some big shot to encounter such bad luck. Some lords who had long had their eyes on Moyue Town's farmland wanted to take this opportunity to grab a piece of the pie, while others wanted to ingratiate themselves with that unmasked, unknown big shot."

Bushuai's expression held a trace of mockery.

Shang Feifan could easily guess that the nearby lords had likely inquired about Bushuai's background. Some would avoid it like the plague, but others would see profit in it.

"Have your uncle and aunt ever blamed you? Have the people in the town ever spoken ill of you because of this?"

Hu Bushuai was stunned, followed by a bitter smile. "It would be good if they were willing to speak ill of me."

His aunt had only ever blamed the death of the original body's mother on him, but she had never said she wanted to drive him out of the town, nor had she ever said that he had brought disaster to the town.

Shang Feifan pressed his hand down on Hu Bushuai's shoulder. "I won't deny that Moyue Town meeting this calamity has a certain connection to you, but the most important reason is still the sin of harboring a treasure."

"Just a town like this, yet it possesses arable farmland capable of feeding four to five thousand people, including a certain amount of arable land in nearby villages—just ask, which nearby lord wouldn't be green with envy?"

"Otherwise, why would the mastermind behind the scenes resort to other methods, insisting instead on creating a large-scale epidemic and dragging other nearby beastman settlements into it as well?"

"They want to harm people, they want to eliminate the population, they want to obtain this vast expanse of land! To put it bluntly, you are merely collateral interest, or even just an excuse."

Before Bushuai could speak, Shang Feifan raised a finger. "Most importantly, the victim is never the root of the disaster. Pay no heed to those 'if it weren't for you, how could we have ended up like this and that' remarks; those are merely the impotent expressions of the weak taking out their anger on the wrong people."

"The perpetrators and wrongdoers are also dying for the victims to think this way, letting the victims resent and blame one another so that their crimes are relegated to second place, or even deemed justified. Don't you find this absurd?"

"Some people meet their doom because of beauty, cuteness, wealth, possessing special items or special talents, and so on, leading to the destruction of their families and even 'implicating' an entire nation. Yet instead of going after the culprit, those victims besiege the culprit's target, and even hand the culprit's target over to the culprit. Do you think this kind of behavior is right?"

Hu Bushuai subconsciously wanted to shake his head, but managed to stop himself.

Shang Feifan continued, "Who can guarantee that they won't be the next target of covetousness, hatred, and jealousy?"

"Must everyone hand over the person or object others demand just because someone asks for it? If so, what difference is there between humans and sheep in a pen?"

"What meaning is there in the existence of a sentient species that cannot protect its own people, only knows how to shirk responsibility, and can only rage furiously against the weak?"

"In this regard, your uncle, your aunt, and the beastmen of the entire town have done a wonderful job. They are not just protecting you; they are protecting the very principles of being human."

Hu Bushuai raised his hands in surrender. "Stop talking. You've used these toxic motivational chicken soup speeches to comfort me more than once."

"This isn't toxic chicken soup; it's the truth." Shang Feifan treated him like a child... No, he didn't have this kind of patience and tenderness for children.

He rubbed Bushuai's short hair. "Recognize the true culprit. Never take blame that doesn't belong to you and heap it onto your own head. Instead of wasting energy on that, you'd might as well go cause trouble for the real culprit."

Bushuai looked up. "Is that what you would do?"

Shang Feifan answered without hesitation, "Yes."

He was a man who sold blades, but he never considered the sins of the murderer who used the blade to commit violence as having anything to do with him.

If someone wanted to wipe out a small town because of his identity, he would only figure out the other party's identity and slaughter his way back in retaliation. Or he would simply arm the town, let the town directly annihilate the invaders, and then plunder the invaders' land and wealth to compensate for their own losses and deter others.

If the town were destroyed as a result, he would only harbor a burning desire for revenge, rather than deep self-blame and guilt. Because he clearly knew that he wasn't the one in the wrong—the murderer was!

Hu Bushuai deeply envied Shang for possessing such a powerful heart.

He felt that the vast majority of people, upon encountering such a thing, would blame and feel guilty, believing that they were the ones who had implicated everyone else.

"You're a man who does great things," Bushuai sighed.

Shang Feifan hooked the corners of his lips slightly. "No, I'm just a hired muscle and a chess piece."

"Then the chess player who owns a chess piece like you must be very fortunate."

"Ha!" Shang Feifan laughed loudly. "Yes, they are very fortunate."

So fortunate that they didn't even know where to place him anymore.

Therefore, he very consciously stepped down from the chessboard and plunged into the ocean.

His work was already finished, and now he was going to begin his own true life.

After retirement, he happened to have no goals in life; he originally intended to just drift along, but now he had found one.

He had found an anchor for himself.

If he were to set a mission goal for his future as well, it would probably just be to live well together with the person in front of him.

Hu Bushuai let out a gentle breath.

He had to admit that Shang's chicken soup, cliché as it was, was genuinely useful to him.

Sometimes a person really needs the support of others—and support that unconditionally and indiscriminately stands by your side, completely ignoring any logic or morality.

"I've found Lang Mu's grave."

Hu Bushuai's heart skipped a beat.

The air grew stagnant.

Bushuai's lips slowly flattened, and his expression turned desolate.

When he asked Shang Feifan to investigate the person he met eleven years ago, he had already prepared his heart for what he might face.

Yet he hadn't expected the other party to be this fast. How much time had even passed?

Shang Feifan gently clasped Bushuai's hand.

Bushuai tried to pull away, but was held tightly.

After a moment, Bushuai stopped struggling and simply let Shang Feifan hold his hand like that.

He was emptying out all of his emotions and thoughts.

Shang Feifan didn't look at him, staring instead at the upcoming mouth of the valley ahead. "Why did Lang Lang, that half-brother of yours, want to kill you?"

Bushuai fell silent.

Author's Notes:

Bushuai, much like Shang Feifan, also greatly needed psychological massage.

However, Shang Feifan needed guidance to keep from walking down crooked or evil paths, while Bushuai needed to snap out of his self-consumption.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第88章 第一世的故事 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第88章 第一世的故事

商非凡非常有耐心地等待着。

既然不帅让他去调查，就应该想到他会问这些问题。

不帅示意狰爷在谷口停下。

狰爷对不帅也很熟悉了，见背上的商非凡没有其他指令，就停下奔跑的长腿，直接往地上一趴。

不帅下意识舔了舔嘴唇。

商非凡瞄。嗯，不帅的嘴唇有点干燥，很需要滋润。

“我……郎沐的尸体是怎么处理的？”不帅轻声问。

商非凡似笑非笑：“怎么？你以为郎沐的骨灰被扔掉，还是以为没人管？”

不帅不看他：“郎沐曾经立有遗嘱，表明如果死亡就把骨灰撒入家乡江河中。不立碑、不做坟、不需要祭拜。”

“郎沐那时才多大，为什么那么年轻就要立遗嘱？”商非凡捏了捏不帅的手指。

不帅手指曲起：“因为……不想遗产便宜某些人？”

商非凡了然：“你的遗嘱有公正吗？还是有律师保管？”

“律师。”

“看来那个律师并没有很好地执行他的工作。你父亲给你在公墓里弄了一个坟，低价区，单个墓室只要八千八。”商非凡决定下线就去查查那个律师。

如果那个律师胆敢和郎沐父亲勾结在一起隐藏或修改遗嘱，好让郎沐父亲继承郎沐遗产，他就让他们吞掉多少就吐出多少，还要翻倍赔偿！

不帅被商非凡的语气逗笑，加上时间过去那么久，再是什么愤怒和伤心都已经平息得差不多。

这也让他接下来的语气自然很多，就像是在说其他人的事情。

“郎沐在遗嘱中说明，他的全部遗产将全部捐献给中学母校，用来给贫困学子当做助学金和给优秀学生当奖学金。”不帅简单说明自己的遗嘱内容。

“原因？”不帅轻笑一声：“其实也没什么太狗血的故事，但可能别人听起来会比较狗血。”

“郎沐父母在郎沐很小的时候就离婚了。郎沐在法律上跟随母亲，父亲需要支持抚养费直到郎沐成年。不过郎沐父亲郎云寿以自己生活困难为由，一直没有支付郎沐的抚养费。郎沐母亲懒得跟他扯掰，就当他不存在。”

不帅目光悠远，陷入回忆：“郎沐外公外婆很早就去世，留给女儿一套位于郊外的厂职工房，因为通勤不方便，郎沐母亲李女士就把那套不到七十平的老房子给卖了，在城区贷款买了一套大面积的套房。郎沐母亲李女士要付房贷，要养活自己和孩子，工作很辛苦。”

“无奈下，李女士就让儿子住校，从幼儿园开始一直上全托，包括小学、中学都如此，除了寒暑假，郎沐几乎都待在学校里。”

“只是郎沐大概没有什么亲人缘，在他十五岁时，他母亲突发脑溢血去世，警方找到郎沐法律上的父亲郎云寿。”

“那时候郎沐对这个自从两岁后就几乎从未见过面的父亲还是有一点好奇和期待的。郎云寿刚出现时，也表现得很是亲和，还表示自己再穷再苦，也会给郎沐交学费和生活费。”

商非凡插话：“郎沐母亲死后应该有留下存款吧？”

不帅点头，猜出商真正想要问的是什么，回复：“是，郎沐并没有要他父亲的钱，实际上他父亲也只是嘴巴上说说，压根就没打算负担长子的抚养费。

甚至……如你猜测，郎云寿成为郎沐的法定监护人后，就想顺便一起管理郎沐母亲留下的房产和存款。当然他嘴巴上说只是代为监管，说等郎沐成年后就会全部交给他。”

商非凡冷哼一声。

不帅：“郎沐当时很犹豫，他母亲很少说他父亲的事，他对父亲的印象就是母亲死后对方来学校见他时那悲痛怀念和心疼他的模样，为此他差点就在代理同意书上签字。

还是他学校老师说希望他能多考虑考虑，并为他找了律师，还请律师代为调查郎云寿这十几年有没有支付郎沐的抚养费。

比起十几年没有见过面的父亲，郎沐自然更相信一直很照顾他的学校老师，然后这一查，就发现郎云寿一直没有履行父亲的责任。而且他说生活困苦也只是借口，实际上他和李女士离婚后不久就再次结婚，次年就有了第二个孩子郎岸。

只是郎云寿性格似乎比较好吃懒做，还喜欢打麻将，工作一直都是断断续续，有了郎岸就靠开出租车养家糊口，但也不是很勤快，车也是租来的。总体来说郎云寿家的生活算不上好，也就是过得去的程度。”

商非凡嗤笑：“我敢打赌警方通知郎云寿让他负担起大儿子的养育时，他一定很愤怒。但在知道李女士死亡，还有房产和存款后，则一定疯狂高兴，以为自己有机会染指这笔财产。”

不帅面色平静：“郎沐那时候年龄小，没有什么见识。而且孩子对父母总是有期待，好在他选择相信学校老师，聘请了律师，最后弄了一份律师、郎云寿和学校的三方的李女士遗产代管契约，约定朗云寿只有在郎沐需要的时候，才能动用李女士账户里的钱，而且超过一定数额的费用必须有学校老师签字同意。”

不帅轻叹：“对学校和对学校老师来说，这是很麻烦的一件事，但他们还是同意了。”

商非凡也点头：“是个很负责也很有人情味的学校。”

不帅笑，也为有这样的母校而庆幸：“郎沐只是想要用他的方式报答学校和照顾他的老师以及宿管师傅。但他不好把自己的遗产直接赠送给老师和宿管师傅，那只会给他们带来麻烦。所以他就选择了捐献给整个学校。”

“你的律师是不是换掉了？”商非凡下意识问。

不帅点头，可惜道：“当时学校帮我找的那位律师年纪大了，等我再需要律师时，他早就退休。”

“我会跟进这件事情。”商非凡握紧不帅的手。

不帅抿了抿嘴唇。他也不想自己的遗产便宜不该便宜的人。

“后来郎云寿是不是把你当做了提款机？”商非凡又不客气地问。

不帅没有否认：“在郎沐成年后，他完全继承了母亲留给他的房产和存款。郎云寿就开始不断上门借钱，今天说身体不好需要做手术，明天说郎沐弟弟要上学交不起学费，后天说家里要买房，需要借钱交首付。”

商非凡只看不帅表情，就猜到李女士留下的那笔存款恐怕就没有多少花到郎沐身上。而且不帅的性格恐怕也很难拒绝一个名为父亲的人的“求助”。

不帅垂下眼眸，只道：“后来郎沐考上京城的大学，郎云寿又来借住，说房子空在那儿也是空着，与其租给别人不如租给他，说他们家正在筹钱贷款买房，现在只是借住过度一下。郎沐心里其实也知道让这一家住进来的后果是什么，就拒绝了。但是……”

商非凡挑眉：“对方不会在郎沐去上大学后，直接撬开门锁搬进去了吧？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 88: The Story of the First Lifetime (Part 1)

Shang Feifan waited with immense patience.

Since Bushuai had asked him to investigate, he should have anticipated that these questions would be asked.

Bushuai signaled for the Fierce Beast to stop at the mouth of the valley.

The Fierce Beast was already quite familiar with Bushuai. Seeing that the Shang Feifan on its back gave no further commands, it stopped its long, running strides and sprawled directly onto the ground.

Hu Bushuai subconsciously licked his lips. 

Shang Feifan glanced over. *Hmm, Bushuai's lips are a bit dry; they're in dire need of some moisture.*

"How... how was Lang Mu's corpse handled?" Bushuai asked softly.

Shang Feifan smiled with an ambiguous smirk. "What? Did you think Lang Mu's ashes were thrown away, or did you think no one cared?"

Bushuai didn't look at him. "Lang Mu once made a will stating that upon his death, his ashes were to be scattered into the rivers of his hometown. No stele, no grave, no worship required."

"How old was Lang Mu back then, why would he make a will at such a young age?" Shang Feifan squeezed Bushuai's fingers.

Bushuai curled his fingers inward. "Because... he didn't want his inheritance to benefit certain people?"

Shang Feifan understood instantly. "Was your will notarized? Or kept by a lawyer?"

"A lawyer."

"It seems that lawyer didn't do his job very well. Your father got you a grave in the cemetery—a low-tier district, a single crypt for only eight thousand eight hundred." Shang Feifan decided to check out that lawyer the moment he went offline.

If that lawyer dared to collude with Lang Mu's father to hide or alter the will so that Lang Mu's father could inherit Lang Mu's estate, he would make them spit out every last cent they swallowed and pay double in compensation!

Bushuai was amused by Shang Feifan's tone. Moreover, with so much time having passed, whatever anger and heartache he had felt had already subsided for the most part.

This also made his ensuing tone much more natural, as if he were recounting someone else's affairs.

"Lang Mu stated in his will that all of his inheritance would be entirely donated to his middle school alma mater, used as grants for impoverished students and scholarships for outstanding students," Bushuai briefly explained the contents of his will.

"The reason?" Bushuai gave a light chuckle. "Actually, there's no overly melodramatic story to it, but to others, it might sound a bit cliché."

"Lang Mu's parents divorced when Lang Mu was very young. Legally, Lang Mu stayed with his mother, and his father was required to provide child support until Lang Mu reached adulthood. However, Lang Mu's father, Lang Yunshou, never paid a cent of child support under the pretext of financial hardship. Lang Mu's mother couldn't be bothered to wrangle with him and simply treated him as if he didn't exist."

Bushuai's gaze grew distant as he fell into memory. "Lang Mu's maternal grandparents passed away very early, leaving his mother, Ms. Li, a factory dormitory apartment located in the suburbs. Because the commute was inconvenient, Ms. Li sold that old house of less than seventy square meters and used a bank loan to buy a large suite in the urban area. Ms. Li had to pay the mortgage, support herself, and raise her child; her work was grueling."

"Left with no choice, Ms. Li had her son board at school, starting from kindergarten and attending full-time boarding continuously through elementary and middle school. Except for winter and summer vacations, Lang Mu practically lived at school."

"Only, Lang Mu seemed to have a dearth of affinity for family. When he was fifteen, his mother suddenly died of a cerebral hemorrhage, and the police tracked down Lang Yunshou, Lang Mu's legal father."

"At that time, Lang Mu still held a bit of curiosity and anticipation toward this father whom he had almost never seen since he was two years old. When Lang Yunshou first appeared, he also acted very amiable, proclaiming that no matter how poor or bitter he was, he would pay for Lang Mu's tuition and living expenses."

Shang Feifan interjected, "Lang Mu's mother should have left behind some savings when she died, right?"

Bushuai nodded, guessing what Shang truly wanted to ask, and replied, "Yes, Lang Mu didn't ask for his father's money. In fact, his father was just all talk and had never intended to shoulder the eldest son's upbringing expenses at all.

Even... as you guessed, once Lang Yunshou became Lang Mu's legal guardian, he wanted to conveniently take over the management of the property and savings left by Lang Mu's mother as well. Of course, he claimed with his mouth that it was merely proxy supervision, saying he would hand it all over to Lang Mu once he became an adult."

Shang Feifan let out a cold snort.

Bushuai continued, "Lang Mu was young at the time and lacked worldly experience. Furthermore, children always hold expectations for their parents. Fortunately, he chose to believe his school teachers, hired a lawyer, and had the lawyer investigate whether Lang Yunshou had paid Lang Mu's child support over the past decade or so.

Compared to a father he hadn't seen in over ten years, Lang Mu naturally trusted the school teachers who had always taken care of him. And upon this investigation, they discovered that Lang Yunshou had never fulfilled a father's responsibilities. Moreover, his claim of living in dire poverty was merely an excuse; in reality, he had remarried shortly after divorcing Ms. Li, and the very next year, he had his second child, Lang Lang.

It was just that Lang Yunshou seemed rather lazy and fond of mahjong. His employment was intermittent; after having Lang Lang, he relied on driving a taxi to support the family, but he wasn't very diligent either, and even the car was rented. Overall, Lang Yunshou's household wasn't well off—just barely scraping by."

Shang Feifan sneered, "I bet when the police notified Lang Yunshou to make him shoulder the responsibility of raising his eldest son, he must have been furious. But upon learning that Ms. Li had died and left behind real estate and savings, he must have gone mad with joy, thinking he had a chance to get his claws on that fortune."

Bushuai's expression remained calm. "Lang Mu was young back then and had no worldly knowledge. Besides, children always hold expectations for their parents. Fortunately, he chose to trust his school teachers, hired a lawyer, and ultimately drafted a tripartite estate custody contract for Ms. Li's assets involving the lawyer, Lang Yunshou, and the school. It stipulated that Lang Yunshou could only tap into the money in Ms. Li's account when Lang Mu needed it, and any expenses exceeding a certain amount required the signature and consent of a school teacher."

Bushuai sighed softly. "For the school and the teachers, this was an extremely troublesome matter, but they agreed to it nonetheless."

Shang Feifan nodded as well. "It's a very responsible and humane school."

Bushuai smiled, feeling fortunate to have such an alma mater. "Lang Mu just wanted to repay the school, the teachers who cared for him, and the dormitory supervisors in his own way. But he couldn't directly gift his inheritance to the teachers and dormitory supervisors—that would only bring them trouble. So he chose to donate it to the entire school instead."

"Did you end up replacing that lawyer later?" Shang Feifan asked instinctively.

Bushuai nodded, expressing his regret. "The lawyer the school helped me find back then was already getting old. By the time I needed a lawyer again, he had long since retired."

"I'll follow up on this matter." Shang Feifan tightened his grip on Bushuai's hand.

Bushuai pressed his lips together. He didn't want his inheritance to benefit those who didn't deserve it either.

"Later on, did Lang Yunshou treat you like an ATM?" Shang Feifan asked unceremoniously.

Bushuai didn't deny it. "After Lang Mu came of age, he fully inherited the house and savings left by his mother. Lang Yunshou started showing up at his doorstep time and again to borrow money—one day claiming he was in poor health and needed surgery, the next day saying Lang Mu's younger brother needed tuition for school, and the day after that claiming the family wanted to buy a house and needed to borrow money for the down payment."

Just by looking at Bushuai's expression, Shang Feifan could guess that probably not much of the savings left by Ms. Li was ever spent on Lang Mu. Moreover, given Bushuai's personality, it was likely very difficult for him to refuse the 'pleas for help' from someone bearing the title of father.

Bushuai lowered his gaze, merely stating, "Later, when Lang Mu was admitted to a university in the capital, Lang Yunshou came over to ask to stay with him, saying that the house was empty anyway, and rather than renting it out to strangers, he might as well rent it to them. He claimed his family was currently scraping together funds to buy a house with a mortgage and just needed to borrow the place as a temporary stopgap. In his heart, Lang Mu actually knew what the consequences of letting this family move in would be, so he refused. But..."

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. "The other party wouldn't have gone and picked the door lock to move in directly after Lang Mu left for university, would they?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第88章 第一世的故事 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
不帅抬眼看他，苦笑：“你猜对了。郎沐当时把房子委托给中介，想要出租。等中介带人去看房，发现房子里已经有人居住，还是郎沐的父亲，就给郎沐打了电话询问。郎沐……报警了，但郎云寿闹着说这是他儿子的房子，他做父亲的凭什么不能住。说儿子就应该赡养父亲。警察没办法处理，就建议郎沐向法院起诉。”

“郎沐当时正在上学，他想拿奖学金，平时还在打工，根本没有时间和精力回去处理这件事。他当时也没钱找律师，就想着等大学毕业后再来处理这件事。”

商非凡：“……能理解，但是做错。”

不帅苦笑：“那是父亲啊。郎沐哪能想到那个男人那么无赖又无耻？而且他当时是真的没有精力和时间去和那一家折腾。生活毕竟不是小说，三两下就能把事情解决。”

商非凡站在郎沐当时的角度想了想，发现这件事确实不太好处理，尤其郎沐本人不在N城。不是说这件事告不赢，而是处理起来需要花费时间和大量精力。

郎云寿当时就是光脚的，郎沐却是穿鞋的。郎云寿有的是时间去闹腾，郎沐却正在人生的最关键期。

“后来呢？”

“后来郎沐一直读到硕士毕业，找到一份不错的工作。工作地点恰好就在N城，他就回到N城，并立刻向法院起诉，要求郎云寿一家归还他们非法侵占的房屋。”

商非凡冷笑：“占便宜占惯了，还住了好几年，恐怕郎云寿一家已经把那套房子当成自己的了。他们不会轻易归还的。”

不帅沉默点头：“郎沐要求郎云寿一家归还房产，郎云寿就闹着说自己身体不好、无法工作、孩子还小、妻子也身体不好，总之就是没钱租房，更没钱买房，只能让长子赡养。为此，他甚至真的不去工作，他妻子……也把超市理货的工作辞了。”

“果然不是一家人不进一家门。”商非凡气得胸口疼，要换了他，他有的是办法对付那一家子！也就是郎沐性格软，人又正派，只想着走法律途径。

不帅说第一世的事情也觉得有点累，哪怕事情对他来说已经过去很长时间，但他发现有些情绪并不是消失，只是被按压在了记忆深处。

“郎沐也知道这件事不能拖延下去，他在工作半年后就花钱找人来帮他解决这件事。对方建议他把那套房子卖了，虽然给的价格比市价要低三四成，但买房人不要求看房，也不要求郎沐把钥匙给他们，只要能办下房产证就行。

郎沐知道这个价格很吃亏，但对比给那一家死赖着白住，他宁可低价卖掉。”

商非凡称赞：“这也是一个办法。卖给社会人了？”

不帅给了他一个明知故问的眼神。

商非凡：“让我猜猜，因为你把房子卖掉，那一家子被赶出来。他们就去找你麻烦，然后争吵升级变成推搡，年轻性子急躁的郎岸就给了你一刀？不对，时间不对。郎沐死亡时已经三十七岁。但那时郎沐刚工作一年，顶多二十四五岁。这十多年间又发生了什么事情？”

不帅：“……就是一出又臭又长的所谓血亲狗血连续剧。”

商非凡嘴唇弯了弯，很想拥抱不帅，他这么想，也这么做了。

不过他放开得很快。

不帅看自己的手：能把他的手也放开吗？

商非凡假装不知道。

不帅加快语速：“郎沐刚开始工作时，清静了几年。可大约七八年后，那一家子竟然又找上门了。”

“可能是上梁不正下梁歪吧，郎云寿的小儿子郎岸……在上职业学校期间就套用信用卡，搞小额贷，一个套一个，最后利滚利债滚债，还不起了就找他父母闹。他父母帮他还了两次，郎岸每次都赌咒发誓说不会再借。”

“郎沐把房子卖掉，郎云寿一家被新房主赶出来，没了免费房子住，只能租房。考虑到郎岸结婚和郎云寿夫妻养老的问题，那对夫妻也打算存钱买房。

郎云寿和他妻子不得不出门工作。那时郎岸也从大专毕业，开始工作。

如果他们一家三口能好好地赚钱养家，生活肯定不是问题。但郎云寿好吃懒做惯了，加上年纪大了，重新开始工作后，三天两头喊腰疼，开个网约车依然三天打鱼两天晒网。他和他妻子赚的钱，扣掉租房费用，就只能勉强糊口。

偏偏郎岸明明没钱却花钱没数，又喜欢享受，没钱就又开始搞网贷。就这么一个套一个，贷了四年，再也周转不过来，连利息都还不起，就爆了。

郎云寿夫妻不想给小儿子还这笔钱，也不想小儿子信用和出行等都受到影响，更不想小儿子被法院强制还债，就让小儿子去找长子。”

商非凡气得冷笑：“他们一家应该非常眼红郎沐卖掉房子拿到的那些钱，只恨不得是自己的。”

“也许吧。郎岸找不到郎沐，郎云寿奇葩到去派出所报案，要求寻找自己长子下落。结果真给他们找到。”不帅空着的单手揉了揉额头，他现在还能想起那时的焦头烂额。

“他们一家跑到郎沐的公司和他新买不久的房子小区去闹，还威胁郎沐，说他不帮忙还钱，就到他公司和小区门口拉横幅，指责他吃香的喝辣的，却不管重病的老父亲和年幼的弟弟。主打一个他们过不下去，就让郎沐也过不下去的宗旨。”

不帅面无表情：“谣言止于智者，但这世上有多少人又是人云亦云？造谣一张嘴，避谣跑断腿，还不一定能把泼在身上的黑水洗干净。郎沐也不能因为这一家子总是卖房搬家以及换工作。”

“郎沐借钱了？”商非凡是用肯定语气在问。

不帅沉默片刻：“那一家摆明了死猪不怕开水烫，郎云寿还摆出一副你要报警就报，大不了老子就坐牢，等出来后你还是得赡养老子的无赖嘴脸。”

商非凡后悔，超级后悔。

如果那时他和郎沐能进一步认识，他肯定能帮郎沐解决这牛皮癣的一家，保证让他们再也不敢来找郎沐。

没认识郎沐前，他没办法帮他。但十一年前，他明明有机会挽救郎沐的人生和生命……

如果他那时能去找郎沐，那郎沐也不会才三十多岁就被人杀死，可恨！

不帅忽然笑，语气还有点调皮：“郎沐没有借钱。他报警了，并告诉那一家随便他们闹，他一分钱都不会给。至于赡养费，就等郎云寿打官司，法院怎么判，他就怎么给。”

商非凡握紧他的手。他爱死这样的不帅，只希望不帅真的已经走出来，而不是强装。

不帅语气轻松：“正好那时候郎沐需要出国工作一段时间，于是他把自己刚买不久的新房卖掉。这次的新小区物业管得比较严，郎云寿一家想要故技重施没能成功。郎沐的那套新房就给他以平价卖了出去。”

商非凡不爽：“郎沐还是吃亏了。不管第一套房还是第二套房，都没卖上价。”

“是啊。这就是……人生？不如意事常八-九。”不帅耸耸肩。
chunks.englishText:
Bu Shuai looked up at him with a bitter smile, "You guessed right. Back then, Lang Mu entrusted the house to an agency, hoping to rent it out. When the agent brought someone over for a viewing, they found out someone was already living inside—none other than Lang Mu's father. The agent called Lang Mu to ask what was going on. Lang Mu... called the police, but Lang Yunshou threw a tantrum, claiming this was his son's house and demanding to know why a father couldn't live in his own son's property. He argued that a son had a duty to support his father. The police couldn't do much and suggested Lang Mu file a lawsuit in court."

"Lang Mu was still a student at the time. He wanted to keep his scholarship and was working part-time to make ends meet; he simply didn't have the time or energy to go back and deal with this mess. He also couldn't afford a lawyer back then, so he figured he'd deal with it after graduating from college."

Shang Feifan: "...Understandable, but they took advantage of his situation."

Bu Shuai gave a bitter smile. "That was his father. How could Lang Mu have anticipated that man would be so shameless and unprincipled? Besides, he genuinely didn't have the energy or time to wrangle with that family at the time. Real life isn't a novel where everything gets solved in a snap."

Shang Feifan imagined himself in Lang Mu's shoes back then and realized it really wasn't an easy situation to handle, especially since Lang Mu wasn't even in City N. It wasn't that they couldn't win a lawsuit, but handling it would cost time and a massive amount of energy.

Lang Yunshou had nothing to lose as a barefoot man wearing no shoes, while Lang Mu was the one with shoes on. Lang Yunshou had all the time in the world to make a scene, whereas Lang Mu was at the most critical juncture of his life.

"And then?"

"Later on, Lang Mu studied all the way until he graduated with a master's degree and landed a pretty decent job. The workplace happened to be right in City N, so he returned and immediately filed a lawsuit in court, demanding that Lang Yunshou's family return the property they had illegally occupied."

Shang Feifan sneered, "Accustomed to taking advantage and living there for several years, Lang Yunshou's family probably considered that house their own by then. They wouldn't give it back easily."

Bu Shuai nodded silently. "When Lang Mu demanded they return the property, Lang Yunshou threw a fit, crying that he was in poor health, unable to work, that his child was still young, and his wife's health was failing too. In short, he claimed they had no money to rent a place, let alone buy one, and that their eldest son was obligated to support them. To back this up, he actually stopped working, and his wife... also quit her job as a supermarket stocker."

"Birds of a feather really do flock together." Shang Feifan felt a burning pain in his chest from anger. If it had been him, he would have had countless ways to deal with that family! It was just that Lang Mu had a soft personality and was a decent person who only wanted to walk the legal path.

Recounting the events of his first life also made Bu Shuai feel a bit tired. Even though a long time had passed for him, he realized some emotions hadn't vanished—they had simply been suppressed deep within his memories.

"Lang Mu knew this matter couldn't drag on. Half a year into his job, he paid someone to help him resolve it. The person suggested he sell the house. Although the offered price was thirty to forty percent lower than the market value, the buyer didn't require a viewing, nor did they ask Lang Mu to hand over the keys—as long as the property title could be transferred.

Lang Mu knew he was getting a raw deal with that price, but compared to letting that family stubbornly cling to it for free, he'd rather sell it cheap."

Shang Feifan praised, "That's one way to do it. Did he sell it to someone connected to the underworld?"

Bu Shuai gave him a look that said 'why ask when you already know.'

Shang Feifan: "Let me guess—because you sold the house, that family got kicked out. They came to cause trouble for you, the argument escalated into shoving, and the hot-tempered young Lang岸 [Lang An] stabbed you? No, the timeline doesn't match. Lang Mu was thirty-seven when he died. But back then, Lang Mu had only been working for a year, twenty-four or twenty-five at most. What happened during those ten-plus years?"

Bu Shuai: "...It was just a long, stinking, so-called blood-related melodramatic soap opera."

The corners of Shang Feifan's lips curved upward. He desperately wanted to hug Bu Shuai, and thinking it, he did just that.

However, he let go quite quickly.

Bu Shuai looked at his own hand: *Could you let go of his hand too?*

Shang Feifan pretended not to notice.

Bu Shuai picked up his pace. "When Lang Mu first started working, he had a few years of peace. But about seven or eight years later, that family actually tracked him down again."

"Apple doesn't fall far from the tree, I suppose. Lang Yunshou's younger son, Lang An... while attending a vocational school, maxed out credit cards and got into micro-loans, one cascading into another, until the interests rolled and debts piled up. When he couldn't repay them, he threw tantrums at his parents. His parents helped him pay it off twice, and each time Lang An swore up and down on his life that he would never borrow again."

"After Lang Mu sold the house, Lang Yunshou's family was kicked out by the new homeowner. With no free house to live in, they had no choice but to rent. Considering Lang An's upcoming marriage and Lang Yunshou and his wife's retirement needs, the couple also planned to save up to buy a home.

Lang Yunshou and his wife had no choice but to go out and work. By then, Lang An had also graduated from junior college and started working.

If the three of them could honestly earn money to support the household, life certainly wouldn't have been a problem. But Lang Yunshou was used to idleness, and combined with his advanced age, he started complaining of a sore back three days out of five after restarting work, treating driving for a ride-sharing service as a haphazard affair. After deducting rent, the money he and his wife earned was barely enough to keep them fed.

Yet Lang An had no money, spent recklessly, and loved luxury. When he ran out of cash, he started getting into online micro-loans again. One loan trapped inside another, and after four years of rolling them over, he could no longer keep up the cash flow. He couldn't even pay the interest, and everything blew up.

Lang Yunshou and his wife didn't want to pay off this debt for their younger son, nor did they want his credit and travel privileges to be restricted, let alone have him legally forced by the court to repay it. So, they pushed their younger son to go find his eldest brother."

Shang Feifan sneered with rage, "That family must have been green with envy over the money Lang Mu got from selling the house, wishing down to their bones that it was theirs."

"Perhaps. When Lang An couldn't find Lang Mu, Lang Yunshou went to such bizarre lengths as reporting it to the local police station, demanding they find the whereabouts of his eldest son. And they actually found him." Bu Shuai massaged his temples with his free hand; he could still recall the overwhelming headache of those days.

"That family ran over to Lang Mu's company and the residential complex where he had recently bought a home to cause a scene. They even threatened Lang Mu, saying that if he didn't help pay off the debts, they would hang banners at the entrance of his company and his neighborhood, accusing him of living the high life while ignoring his gravely ill aging father and young younger brother. Their core philosophy was: if they couldn't live a good life, they'd make sure Lang Mu couldn't either."

Bu Shuai expressionlessly stated, "Rumors stop at the wise, but how many people in this world just echo whatever others say? Spreading rumors takes just a word, but disproving them breaks your legs running around, and you still might not wash off the black muddy water splashed on you. Lang Mu couldn't just keep selling houses, moving, and changing jobs because of that family."

"Did Lang Mu borrow money?" Shang Feifan asked with a tone of certainty.

Bu Shuai paused for a moment. "That family made it clear they were like dead pigs unafraid of boiling water. Lang Yunshou even put on a rogue face: 'Go ahead and call the police if you want. The worst that happens is I go to jail, and when I come out, you'll still have to support your old man.'"

Shang Feifan regretted it—he regretted it to his very core.

If he and Lang Mu could have gotten to know each other further back then, he definitely could have helped Lang Mu solve that ringworm-like family, ensuring they would never dare look for Lang Mu again.

Before knowing Lang Mu, he had no way to help him. But eleven years ago, he clearly had the chance to save Lang Mu's life and destiny...

If he had gone to find Lang Mu back then, Lang Mu wouldn't have been murdered in his thirties. How hateful!

Bu Shuai suddenly smiled, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness. "Lang Mu didn't borrow any money. He called the police and told that family they could make as much fuss as they liked, but they wouldn't get a single cent from him. As for alimony, they could wait for Lang Yunshou to sue, and he would pay whatever the court judged."

Shang Feifan gripped his hand tighter. He loved this version of Bu Shuai to death and could only hope Bu Shuai had truly walked out of it rather than just putting on a brave face.

Bu Shuai's tone was relaxed. "Coincidentally, Lang Mu needed to work abroad for a period around that time, so he sold the new home he had just bought. The property management at this new neighborhood was much stricter, so Lang Yunshou's family failed to pull off their old tricks. That new home of Lang Mu's was sold off at fair market value."

Shang Feifan was displeased. "Lang Mu still got the short end of the stick. Neither the first house nor the second one sold for a good price."

"Yeah. That's... life, I suppose? Things not going your way happen eight or nine times out of ten." Bu Shuai shrugged.
"""

“走之前，为以防万一，郎沐就给自己立了遗嘱。”

“三年半后，郎沐回国，他跟N城的子公司申请，表示想去位于大西北的研发基地工作，报告打上去，母公司那边很快就同意了。他回N城只是办一下手续。”

不帅一口气说出故事结局：“他猜到那一家子大概率还会继续纠缠他，但他没想到对方疯狂到那种地步。

郎沐卖房出国，郎云寿一家再也找不到郎沐，去郎沐公司闹，门卫直接报警。

郎云寿夫妻找不到郎沐，又被郎岸闹腾得受不了，只能到处借钱，好不容易帮郎岸还了一笔债，但他们没想到郎岸欠的根本不止那一点。郎岸还跑去借了民间高利贷。

在郎沐出国的那三年多中，郎岸因为欠债太多，被追债人找上门，他想逃跑，被抓住，被狠狠打了一顿。郎岸被打得不敢再偷跑，他们一家也想通过法律手段来解决郎岸的欠债，比如申请停息还款。但民间高利贷可无法这么操作……

那一家子想不到办法，也不想通过辛苦工作来还债，更不想背负一辈子的重贷，一心想走捷径。他们的捷径就是郎沐，他们一直在找郎沐。

他们知道郎沐手上有钱，对他们来说，郎沐就是他们唯一的救命稻草，无论如何都要抓住。

郎岸和郎云寿千方百计打听到郎沐就要回国的消息，他们就轮流守在郎沐公司大门口等候。

那天，他们终于等到了。

郎沐来公司办手续，郎岸冲出来拦住车辆，郎云寿一把年纪跪在郎沐公司大门口前高举‘求儿子救救我’的牌子。”

“艹！”商非凡拳头都捏紧了。

不帅趁机挣脱自己被握住的手。

“郎沐只能下车，然后就被郎云寿和郎岸围住。他们先是哀求，见哀求不成就威胁，然后怒骂。

郎岸不停地吼，说你是我亲大哥，你那么有钱，借给我一点又怎样。还说如果不是郎沐不肯帮他还钱，不肯给他钱花，他也不至于欠下这么多。父子俩围着郎沐骂他绝情狠心不是人。

郎沐报警，郎岸上来抢他的手机，还踩碎了。

郎沐根本不想和这对父子说话，他对他们唯有的一点血缘亲情也早就给他们磨光消耗光。

大概是郎沐当时的反应太冷漠，他转身朝公司大门走，郎岸……就拔-出一把刀，从后面捅进郎沐的腰部。”

不帅说到这里，竟然还笑了一下：“可能郎岸也没想到那一刀就把郎沐给杀死了，他大概只是想要让郎沐知道他的厉害，知道他能做出可怕的事情，以此来胁迫郎沐给他钱。

但就是那么不巧，那一刀捅破了郎沐的脾脏。等救护车赶到时，郎沐已经不行。

郎岸当时还想逃跑，被公司警卫扑上去抓住。

后来的事情，我就不知道了。”

"""
“Before leaving, just in case, Lang Mu drew up a will.”

“Three and a half years later, Lang Mu returned to China. He applied to the N City subsidiary, expressing his wish to work at the R&D base located in the Great Northwest. Once the report was submitted, the parent company quickly approved it. He only returned to N City to process the paperwork.”

Bu Shuai delivered the end of the story in one breath: "He guessed that family would most likely continue to pester him, but he never expected them to go to such insane lengths.

When Lang Mu sold his house and went abroad, Lang Yunshou's family could no longer find him. They went to cause a scene at Lang Mu's company, and the security guards called the police directly.

Unable to find Lang Mu, and driven out of their minds by Lang An's relentless tantrums, Lang Yunshou and his wife had no choice but to borrow money from everywhere. They managed with great difficulty to pay off one batch of Lang An's debts, but they didn't expect that what Lang An owed was far more than just that little bit. Lang An had even gone out to borrow from underground loan sharks.

During the three-plus years Lang Mu was abroad, Lang An was hunted down by debt collectors due to his massive debts. He tried to run, was caught, and got beaten black and blue. The beating terrified Lang An so much he didn't dare run away again, and the family wanted to resolve Lang An's debts through legal means, such as applying for suspended interest and repayments. But underground loan sharks don't operate that way...

That family couldn't think of a solution, didn't want to pay off the debts through hard work, and refused to carry heavy debts for the rest of their lives. They were bent on taking a shortcut. Their shortcut was Lang Mu; they had been searching for him all along.

Knowing Lang Mu had money in his hands, to them, Lang Mu was their only straw to grasp, and they had to hold on no matter what.

By hook or by crook, Lang An and Lang Yunshou found out the news that Lang Mu was about to return to China, so they took turns waiting at the main gates of Lang Mu's company.

That day, they finally waited long enough.

Lang Mu came to the company to process his paperwork. Lang An rushed out to block the vehicle, and elderly Lang Yunshou knelt right in front of the company gates, holding high a sign that read, 'Begging my son to save me.'”

“F*ck!” Shang Feifan clenched his fists so hard they cracked.

Bu Shuai seized the opportunity to wrench his hand free from the grip.

“Lang Mu had no choice but to get out of the car, and was immediately surrounded by Lang Yunshou and Lang An. First they pleaded; when pleading failed, they threatened, and then they hurled curses.

Lang An shrieked endlessly, shouting, 'You're my own big brother, and you're so rich, what harm does it do to lend me some!' He also screamed that if Lang Mu hadn't refused to help him pay his debts and refused to give him money to spend, he wouldn't have ended up owing this much. The father and son surrounded Lang Mu, berating him for being heartless, ruthless, and inhuman.

Lang Mu called the police, but Lang An lunged forward to snatch his phone and smashed it underfoot.

Lang Mu didn't want to speak to this pair of father and son at all; the tiny shred of blood kinship he once had for them had long since been ground down and consumed to nothing.

Perhaps Lang Mu's reaction at the time was far too cold. As he turned and walked toward the company gates, Lang An... pulled out a knife and plunged it from behind into Lang Mu's waist.”

At this point, Bu Shuai even let out a small chuckle. “Lang An probably never expected that a single knife strike would actually kill Lang Mu. He likely just wanted to show Lang Mu he meant business, to prove he was capable of terrifying things, and use that to coerce Lang Mu into giving him money.

Yet, as fate would have it, that knife pierced Lang Mu's spleen. By the time the ambulance arrived, Lang Mu was already gone.

Lang An tried to flee on the spot, but the company guards lunged forward and pinned him down.

As for what happened afterward, I don't know anymore.”
"""

chunks.chineseText:
第89章 遗嘱案

后来的事情，商非凡找人调查，获得多方面描述，把整件事情拼凑得清清楚楚。

在这之前，他和不帅两人花了整整四天时间，把迪莉娅夫人要求的物品全都收集齐全。

当把那些任务物品交给迪莉娅夫人后，系统表示他任务完成，除了10点贡献点到账，又另外询问他是否提升其他相关技能。

因为这个任务原本要奖励初级鉴定术，但他已经购买并学习了该职业技能，可这个任务又没有达到让他升到中级的程度。

系统就给了他两个选择，一个是把初级骑乘术升级为初级骑士，一个是把初级草药师升级为初级炼药师。

商非凡眼馋初级炼药师的职业技能，但他在看完初级骑士的职业说明后，没多犹豫就选择了初级骑士。

虽然他有了狰爷作为坐骑，但初级骑士除了在骑乘任意坐骑方面有加成作用，另外还有攻防技能以及体质的大幅度加成。

商非凡本身就拥有力大无穷的血脉天赋，有了骑士职业的体质加成，他的攻击力度和防守力度都会增长到非人地步。

更让商非凡心水的是，骑士的职业技能中有一个【效忠】和【守护】技能。当选择骑士职业的兽人向某个人宣誓效忠或者决定誓死守护对方后，不但可以提升自身的体质和技能，还能把自己的生命力分享给守护对象。

如果守护对象受伤或被抓，骑士能立刻进入疯狂战斗模式，战斗力可根据本身实力翻双倍到数倍。

商非凡选择把初级骑乘术升级为初级骑士后，立刻就选定虎不帅为誓死守护对象。

为此，商非凡跟虎不帅要了一滴血。

虎不帅在商非凡没跟他说明要血液有什么用的情况下，就把自己的血液给了他。

商非凡心里一边觉得不帅这样轻信他人不行，一边又为不帅这么信任他而高兴异常。

至于虎不帅是怎么想的，只有他自己知道了。

他不是想要测试商非凡，而是希望另一只靴子赶紧落地——如果商对他有什么图谋，那就让那个图谋快点来吧。

绑定虎不帅为守护对象后，商非凡就在系统面板的初级骑士职业技能栏内看到了发光的虎不帅小人。

这个技能竟然还能随时观察守护对象的健康状态？

商非凡不禁为自己的选择大大点赞。

迪莉娅夫人也信守承诺，哪怕商非凡已经解除诅咒，她还是把她知道的解除虫族诅咒的方法告诉了他。

“供奉一只虫子？母虫最好？无论哪种虫子都可以？”商非凡很惊讶还有这种解除诅咒的方法。

迪莉娅夫人看着商非凡上交的任务物品，心里满意，说话都温和了不少：“这只有用虫族施展的诅咒才有效。而且一旦你供奉的虫子对你不满，在寿命自然结束前就要离开你，那么你一样会受到反噬。”

商非凡心想这种解除诅咒的方法也未免太过束缚，养不好就相当于缓刑。

不过对比随时都会死亡的诅咒，供奉一只虫子来延续生命，绝对会让绝大多数人满意这种解除诅咒的方法。

更不要说绝大多数普通虫子的寿命都不算长，好好养个一两年，把供奉的虫子养到自然寿终，就能真正解脱。

到此，任务八【见到迪莉娅夫人，设法得到诅咒的解除方法】和任务十二【深入探查莫约山谷】也跟着完成，共得到7点贡献点。

之前抵达莫约镇，任务十六【带阿呆到莫约镇】就已宣布完成，并奖励了2点贡献点。

虽然这些任务给予的贡献点很少，但蚊子腿再小也是肉，只要能完成，商非凡都想尽量完成。

系统目前为止一共发布了六十二个任务，以及一个主线任务和一个奇迹任务。除了主线任务和地图探索任务，任务列表中还有三个任务没能完成。

分别是任务二十三，【探索异度空间的未知区域，每探索十分之一地图，就奖励1点贡献点。】

商非凡现在虽然能自由进出雕像广场，但他一直没有再去探索这个异度空间。

他的本能告诉他，这个异度空间很危险，在他实力还不够强大前，最好不要随意探索。

他现在可不是一个人，他已经是拖家带口的人了，冒险前当然要为家人和伴侣多想想。

还有任务五十六，【查看邪神信徒在营地里干什么】。

他以为这个任务已经完成，没想到还是未完成状态，是不是说他进入邪神信徒营地没用，得给出系统一个明确答案？

商非凡试着回答：“那群邪神信徒在营地里祭拜邪神雕像？”

系统没反应。

“通过祭拜邪神雕像来控制虫毒散播者？”

【任务五十六完成，奖励3点贡献点。】

商非凡：……行吧，能完成就行。

最后一个未完成任务，任务五十九，【查出迫害那对祭品母子的凶手】。

当时不帅帮他分析过，他们推断出凶手有可能和黑森林城主有关。

但系统没有宣布完成，有可能是他们的推断错误，也有可能直接凶手不止黑森林城主？

这个任务可以再放一放，等以后和黑森林城主碰上再说。

想到不帅外婆的身份，商非凡有个强烈预感，他们一定会很快就和黑森林城主对上。

现在就只剩下两个支线任务和一个主线任务没有完成，他的贡献点数总计达到20486点，结余10977点，玩家等级又往上蹿了蹿，达到48级。

对于这个一直霸占玩家等级榜榜首位置的灰色玩家ID，其他玩家已经可以很淡定地看待，也都认定这个你皇不是狗策划本人的账号就是开发组工作人员的。

真游戏策划本人有苦说不出，这个账号他也很头疼好嘛，不但无法彻底删除，还找不到人。

不过比起你皇，游戏策划现在更在意另一个人。

他在寻找那个拿走他魔法杖且会瞬发魔法的兽人。

可恨对方当时遮住了头脸，让他无法看清对方全貌。

他甚至怀疑这个会使用魔法的藏头遮脸兽人会不会就是他要找的你皇。

虎不帅暂时不知道洛伦米尔顿正在下死力寻找他，他能猜到，但他和商非凡都认为对方不会那么快就找到他们头上。

商非凡还把洛伦米尔顿天残谷谷主的身份告诉了他，并怀疑对方和搞出游戏系统和玩家的幕后阴谋者有很大关系。

其实不用洛伦米尔顿来找他，不帅也会去找他。

只是他和商都冷静选择了先提高实力，以及搞清楚游戏系统背后的情况，再去找洛伦米尔顿的计划。

商非凡在“游戏”中收到现实世界的联系。

也许他现实世界的身体和游戏世界中的身体真的在融合中，他现在不但能在现实世界听到游戏世界的声音，在进入游戏世界后，他一样能听到现实世界的少许声音。

商非凡猜测应该是魏轲对郎沐被杀案和遗嘱案的调查有了新的进展，也没瞒着不帅，直接跟他说明情况，表明自己可能会离开几天。

"""
Chapter 89: The Will Case (Part 1)

As for what happened afterward, Shang Feifan had people investigate and gathered accounts from multiple sides, piecing the entire matter together crystal clear.

Prior to this, he and Bu Shuai had spent a full four days collecting all the items requested by Madame Delia.

When those quest items were handed over to Madame Delia, the system announced that his quest was completed. Aside from crediting 10 contribution points, it also additionally asked whether he wanted to upgrade any other related skills.

Because this quest was originally supposed to reward the Primary Appraisal skill, he had already purchased and learned that vocational skill, yet this quest's rewards hadn't reached the threshold to elevate him to Intermediate.

Thus, the system gave him two choices: one was to upgrade Primary Riding to Primary Knight, and the other was to upgrade Primary Herbalist to Primary Apothecary.

Shang Feifan coveted the vocational skills of a Primary Apothecary, but after reading the professional description of a Primary Knight, he didn't hesitate long before choosing Primary Knight.

Although he already possessed Lord Zhen as a mount, Primary Knight not only provided bonus effects for riding any mount, but it also granted attack and defense skills alongside a massive constitution boost.

Shang Feifan himself possessed a bloodline talent of boundless superhuman strength; combined with the constitution bonuses of the Knight class, his offensive and defensive output would soar to inhuman levels.

What made Shang Feifan even more enamored were the [Allegiance] and [Guard] skills within the Knight's vocational abilities. When an Orc who chose the Knight class swore allegiance to someone or decided to protect them unto death, not only could they boost their own constitution and skills, but they could also share their own vitality with the target of their protection.

If the protected target was injured or captured, the knight could instantly enter a berserk combat mode, multiplying their combat prowess anywhere from two-fold to several times over based on their original strength.

The moment Shang Feifan chose to upgrade Primary Riding to Primary Knight, he immediately designated Hu BuShuai as his death-sworn protection target.

To this end, Shang Feifan asked Hu BuShuai for a drop of blood.

Without asking what the blood was for, Hu BuShuai simply gave it to him.

In his heart, Shang Feifan simultaneously felt that BuShuai shouldn't be so gullible in trusting others so easily, while also feeling overwhelmingly joyous that BuShuai trusted him to such an extent.

As for what Hu BuShuai was thinking, only he himself knew.

He wasn't trying to test Shang Feifan; rather, he was hoping for the other shoe to drop—if Shang harbored any ulterior motives toward him, then let those motives come to light sooner.

After binding Hu BuShuai as his protection target, Shang Feifan saw a glowing chibi figure of Hu BuShuai appear within the Primary Knight vocational skill column on his system panel.

This skill actually allowed him to monitor the health status of the protection target at any time?

Shang Feifan couldn't help giving a massive thumbs-up to his own choice.

Madame Delia also kept her promise. Even though Shang Feifan had already lifted his curse, she still told him the method she knew for dispelling Zerg curses.

"Offer sacrifices to a bug? The Mother Queen is best? Any kind of bug will do?" Shang Feifan was astonished that there was such a method to lift curses.

Looking at the quest items Shang Feifan had handed over, Madame Delia felt satisfied, and her tone softened considerably: "This is only effective for curses cast using Zerg power. Moreover, if the bug you offer sacrifices to becomes dissatisfied with you and decides to leave before its natural lifespan ends, you will suffer a backlash all the same."

Shang Feifan thought to himself that this method of lifting a curse came with far too many restrictions; failing to raise it properly was equivalent to a stay of execution.

However, compared to a curse that meant death at any moment, offering sacrifices to a bug to prolong one's life would definitely satisfy the vast majority of people.

Not to mention, the lifespans of the overwhelming majority of ordinary bugs weren't very long. If you raised one properly for a year or two and let the sacrificed bug live out its natural lifespan, you would achieve true liberation.

At this point, Quest 8 [Meet Madame Delia, find a way to obtain the curse-dispelling method] and Quest 12 [Deeply probe Moyue Valley] were also completed, yielding a total of 7 contribution points.

Upon arriving at Moyue Town earlier, Quest 16 [Bring A-Dai to Moyue Town] had already been declared complete, rewarding 2 contribution points.

Although the contribution points granted by these quests were very few, even a mosquito's leg is meat. As long as they could be finished, Shang Feifan wanted to complete as many as possible.

So far, the system had issued a total of sixty-two quests, along with one main quest and one miracle quest. Aside from the main quest and map exploration quests, there were still three quests in the quest list that remained uncompleted.

They were Quest 23: [Explore unknown areas of the alternate dimension; for every tenth of the map explored, reward 1 contribution point.]

Although Shang Feifan could now freely enter and exit the Statue Plaza, he had never gone back to explore this alternate dimension.

His instincts told him that this alternate dimension was extremely dangerous, and until his strength was sufficiently formidable, it was best not to explore it casually.

He wasn't alone anymore; he now had a family to look after. Naturally, before taking risks, he had to think more of his family and partner.

There was also Quest 56: [Check what the evil god's cultists are doing in the camp.]

He had thought this quest was already completed, but to his surprise, it was still marked as incomplete. Did that mean just entering the cultists' camp wasn't enough, and he had to give the system a clear answer?

Shang Feifan tried answering: "That group of evil god cultists are worshipping the evil god's statue inside the camp?"

The system gave no response.

"Using the worship of the evil god's statue to control the spreaders of the insect poison?"

[Quest 56 completed, reward 3 contribution points.]

Shang Feifan: ......Fine, whatever. As long as it's completed.

The final uncompleted quest was Quest 59: [Find out the murderer who persecuted that pair of sacrificial mother and son.]

Bu Shuai had helped him analyze it back then, and they deduced that the killer might be related to the Black Forest City Lord.

However, since the system hadn't announced completion, either their deduction was wrong, or the direct culprit wasn't just the Black Forest City Lord alone?

This quest could be put on hold for now and dealt with when they crossed paths with the Black Forest City Lord later.

Thinking of Bu Shuai's maternal grandmother's identity, Shang Feifan had a strong premonition that they would inevitably clash with the Black Forest City Lord very soon.

Now, with only two side quests and one main quest left uncompleted, his total contribution points had reached 20,486, with a balance of 10,977. His player level had surged upward once more, reaching Level 48.

Regarding this gray player ID that constantly monopolized the top spot on the player leaderboards, other players could view it with great composure, having long since concluded that this 'Your Emperor' ID was either the wicked game planner's personal account or belonged to a development team staff member.

The real game planner had grievances he couldn't voice. He found this account a massive headache too—not only could he not completely delete it, but he also couldn't find the person behind it.

However, compared to 'Your Emperor', the game planner was currently paying much closer attention to someone else.

He was searching for that Orc who had taken away his magic staff and could cast instant magic.

It was hateful that the other party had covered their head and face at the time, preventing him from seeing their full appearance.

He even suspected whether this hidden-faced Orc who used magic could be the 'Your Emperor' he was searching for.

Hu BuShuai temporarily didn't know that Loren Milton was hunting him down with full force. He could guess it, but both he and Shang Feifan believed the other party wouldn't track them down to their doorstep so quickly.

Shang Feifan had also told him about Loren Milton's identity as the Valley Master of Heavenly Ravine, suspecting that he was heavily connected to the mastermind behind the game system and the players.

In truth, even without Loren Milton coming to look for him, Bu Shuai would eventually go look for him.

It was just that he and Shang had calmly chosen to first raise their strength and figure out the situation behind the game system before executing their plan to seek out Loren Milton.

Inside the 'game', Shang Feifan received contact from the real world.

Perhaps his physical body in the real world and his body in the game world were genuinely undergoing a fusion; he could now not only hear sounds from the game world while in the real world, but upon entering the game world, he could also catch faint sounds from reality.

Shang Feifan guessed that Wei Ke must have made new progress in the investigation of Lang Mu's murder case and will case. Without hiding it from Bu Shuai, he explained the situation directly, stating that he might have to leave for a few days.
"""

chunks.chineseText:
虎不帅叫住商非凡：“郎沐当初准备了两份遗嘱。”

“哦？”商非凡眼睛一亮：“立遗嘱时的见证人有几个？”

虎不帅：“郎沐是自书遗嘱，只有一个律师见证人。但他工作后多了一些社会阅历，在写遗嘱时就手写了两份，两份上都有他自己和律师的签名。”

“另一份遗嘱在哪里？”

“被他夹在工作夹里。工作夹在单位，就在他的办公桌上放着。但事情已经过去多年，我……郎沐也不能确定那个工作夹还能不能找到。”

不帅详细描述了那个工作夹的颜色和侧封提示文字。

商非凡推测：“郎沐死亡后，按理他的东西应该都会还给他家人。但我怀疑郎云寿他们很可能没有再去郎沐的公司，也不敢去。毕竟郎岸就是在郎沐公司门口杀的郎沐。另外，郎沐公司那边应该也没有郎云寿他们的联系方式。”

商非凡又问：“那个律师知道郎沐把另一份遗嘱放在哪里了吗？”

不帅摇头：“郎沐没跟他说。”

商非凡分析：“如果这个律师真的和郎云寿一家勾连，也许他会提醒郎云寿搜索郎沐的全部物品。但这里也有一个对郎沐利好的地方，那就是在他们眼里，郎沐已经死得干干净净，又没有其他亲人和亲近的朋友，就算另一份遗嘱还在，只要不出现就不会影响到他们。也就是说那名律师和郎云寿他们有可能不会认真搜索郎沐遗物。”

不帅直接道：“纸张类的东西应该都被烧了吧。”

商非凡乐观道：“我有预感，你放在公司里的东西很可能会成为漏网之鱼。”

不帅则不太乐观：“就算东西还在公司，公司也不会保留这么长时间。”

“先去找找。如果实在找不到，我们可以再手写一份。”商非凡毫不在意地说。

不帅没想到还有这种操作。

商非凡对他笑：“亲笔遗书，再怎么验证字迹都是本人写的。反而是另外一份遗嘱，如果真的偏向郎云寿一家，那肯定不是郎沐手写的。相信我，我一定能找出一堆漏洞。”

对他来说夺回郎沐遗产丝毫不是问题，报复郎云寿和郎岸一家才是关键！

不帅沉默片刻，“就算郎沐能再手写一份，要怎么把原件带出去？”

“这很简单，照着抄一份就可以。”模仿字迹而已，不敢说是他的专长，也是他掌握的技能之一，真练过那种。

不帅：“……你等我一会儿。”

十分钟后，不帅拿着一张纸递给商非凡。

商非凡看完，心中有数。

不过模仿郎沐笔迹再抄一份遗嘱是下策，能在郎沐公司找到他的遗物那最好。

“事情已经过去很久，如果很麻烦，那就不要……”

“我不是白帮你。我这个人从不做亏本买卖，如果做了，那让我亏本的人就得小心要时刻提防我。”商非凡上前一步，用力抱了抱不帅：“等着，我会连本带利地收取报酬。”

不帅还没想好要怎么回复，抱住他的人就软倒在他怀里。

不帅：这算啥？信不信我把你“尸体”随便扔路边！

商非凡在一家宾馆的客房沙发里睁开眼睛。

摘下游戏头盔，略微活动身体，他能明显感觉到这具身体变得越发轻盈有力，还有听力和视力也提升了不少。

如果游戏技能也能在地球使用那就有意思了。

商非凡只略微想了想，就把这个念头抛到一边。

他拿起电话，看到来电显示人，重新打回去。

魏轲接到电话就跟他说：“我正在去你宾馆的路上，我查到了一些东西。你说的那个律师，他压根就没有出现。我去你说的律师事务所找了，你绝对想不到，那个律师竟然和郎沐是同一天死亡！”

商非凡眉毛挑起，露出微微惊讶的神情：“这么巧？”

“可不是嘛！而且对方死得很突然，是车祸，他开的小车和渣土车直接撞到一起，整个人都被撞烂了。因为死得太突然，他手头的工作也没能立刻交接。郎家就是这样打了个时间差，等我到了再详细跟你说。”

约一刻钟后，魏轲赶到。

魏轲接过矿泉水瓶，拧开，一边喝，一边示意商非凡打开文件夹。

“先说律师这边。他是私人挂靠在一家律师事务所，平时工作地点都是在自己家中。除了每年固定给该事务所交纳一定挂靠费用，他接的任何一个案子都不需要通过那家事务所。

所以这位律师车祸后，他手上的案子就没能及时移交。一部分委托人联系不上他，找到他事务所，才知道他出车祸的消息，这部分委托人的案子就被那家律师事务所给接手了。但也有一部分委托人见联系不上那名律师，就没再继续联系。其中自然也包括郎沐这样的情况。”

魏轲一口气喝了半瓶水，抹抹嘴：“这样巧合的情况真的非常少见，只能说……”

“我家郎沐太倒霉？”商非凡接口。

魏轲干笑，但还是点头：“嫂子那运气还真是有点……”

他叫一个死去的男性为嫂子，是因为他发现商老大似乎很喜欢他这么称呼郎沐。

咳，做下属的自然要会看上司脸色嘛。虽然他现在已经不是商非凡的下属，但他们心里都承认商老大就是他们永远的老大！

有商非凡这样的老大可是很安心的，最起码如果你出什么事，其他兄弟难说，但商非凡一定会帮你，最重要的是他也有那个能力。

商非凡也没生气，示意魏轲接着说。

魏轲坐到床尾，握着矿泉水瓶陈述：“我去了那名律师家里，获得他家人同意，拿到了郎沐留下的遗嘱原件。他们家人还挺负责，没有动那名律师的文件，都好好放了起来。”

魏轲指了指文件夹，这可是他这几天的最大收获。

商非凡翻开文件夹，看到了不帅的笔迹。

这么多年过去，不帅的笔迹有了一点变化，但在细微处和整体风格上还是能看出来是同一个人写的。

秀气端正一笔一划的字体，都没有多少连体字。笔触看似圆润，又暗藏锋芒。

魏轲又继续说：“在郎沐死后大约一个月左右，郎岸被捕被判刑，郎云寿就跑到警察局说要拿回长子的所有遗产，说这是长子留给他的养老钱。”

魏轲看看商非凡的神色：“你一定不会想知道郎云寿在警察局是如何哭得一把眼泪一把鼻涕让人同情的样子，他把罪责都推到了小儿子郎岸身上，当然他也没说郎岸故意杀人，而是强调这是亲兄弟争执，是家事，是一时激动。总之，郎云寿完美扮演了一次失去两个儿子的可怜老父亲形象。”

“那郎沐的遗产真的都交给他了？”商非凡面无表情地问。

魏轲摊手：“在郎沐没有其他直系亲人和配偶，又没有遗嘱的情况下，他的遗产自然会转到他的亲生父亲那里。而且郎沐的遗产还非常清晰，没有房产和珠宝等，只有现金，一共五百六十三万。”

“这对郎云寿可谓是巨款了。”商非凡冷笑。
chunks.englishText:
Hu Bushuai stopped Shang Feifan. "Lang Mu originally prepared two wills."

"Oh?" Shang Feifan's eyes lit up. "How many witnesses were there when he drew up the will?"

Hu Bushuai replied, "Lang Mu wrote his will by hand, and there was only a single lawyer as a witness. But after he entered the workforce, he gained more worldly experience, so he handwrote two copies when drafting the will. Both bore his own signature and the lawyer's."

"Where is the other will?"

"He tucked it inside his work folder. The work folder is at his workplace, sitting right on his desk. But so many years have passed, I... Lang Mu can't be certain if that work folder can still be found."

Bushuai described the color of the work folder and the warning text on its side flap in detail.

Shang Feifan speculated, "After Lang Mu's death, logically speaking, all his belongings should have been returned to his family. But I suspect that Lang Yunshou and the others likely never went back to Lang Mu's company, nor would they dare to. After all, Lang An murdered Lang Mu right at the entrance of Lang Mu's company. Besides, Lang Mu's company probably didn't have Lang Yunshou's contact information either."

Shang Feifan asked again, "Did that lawyer know where Lang Mu put the other will?"

Bushuai shook his head. "Lang Mu didn't tell him."

Shang Feifan analyzed, "If this lawyer truly colluded with Lang Yunshou's family, perhaps he would have reminded Lang Yunshou to search through all of Lang Mu's possessions. But there's also a favorable point for Lang Mu here: in their eyes, Lang Mu died completely and thoroughly, and without any other relatives or close friends, even if the other will still exists, as long as it doesn't surface, it won't affect them. In other words, that lawyer and Lang Yunshou's gang likely wouldn't thoroughly search Lang Mu's leftover belongings."

Bushuai stated bluntly, "Paper items should have all been burned by now."

Shang Feifan said with optimism, "I have a hunch that the items you left at the company will very likely slip through the net."

Bushuai was less optimistic. "Even if the items are still at the company, a company wouldn't retain them for this long."

"Let's go look first. If we really can't find it, we can just handwrite another one," Shang Feifan said with utter nonchalance.

Bushuai hadn't expected such a maneuver.

Shang Feifan smiled at him. "A handwritten last will and testament—no matter how it's verified, the handwriting will always be proven to be his own. On the contrary, that other will, if it truly favored Lang Yunshou's family, definitely wasn't handwritten by Lang Mu. Trust me, I can surely pick out a mountain of loopholes."

To him, reclaiming Lang Mu's inheritance was not a problem in the least; exacting revenge on Lang Yunshou and Lang An's family was the key!

Bushuai fell silent for a moment. "Even if Lang Mu could handwrite another copy, how are we supposed to smuggle the original out?"

"That's simple. Just copy it word for word." Imitating handwriting wasn't necessarily his primary specialty, but it was certainly one of the skills he had mastered. He had genuinely practiced that kind of thing.

Bushuai: "......Wait for me for a moment."

Ten minutes later, Bushuai handed a piece of paper to Shang Feifan.

After reading through it, Shang Feifan knew what he was doing.

However, imitating Lang Mu's handwriting to recopy a will was a secondary option; finding his posthumous belongings at Lang Mu's company would be for the best.

"So much time has passed. If it's too much trouble, then forget..."

"I'm not helping you for free. I am a man who never does losing business; if I do, the person who made me take a loss had better be careful and stay on guard against me at all times." Shang Feifan stepped forward and gave Bushuai a firm hug. "Wait for it. I will collect my reward with interest."

Before Bushuai could figure out how to respond, the person holding him went limp and collapsed into his arms.

Bushuai: What on earth is this supposed to be? Believe it or not, I'll toss your "corpse" right by the side of the road!

Shang Feifan opened his eyes inside a guest room sofa at a hotel.

Taking off the gaming helmet and stretching his body slightly, he could distinctly feel that this physical vessel had grown increasingly light and powerful, while his hearing and vision had also improved quite a bit.

If gaming skills could be used on Earth as well, that would truly be interesting.

After just a fleeting thought, Shang Feifan cast the notion aside.

He picked up his phone, checked the caller ID, and returned the call.

The moment Wei Ke answered the phone, he blurted out, "I'm on my way to your hotel right now; I've dug up some things. That lawyer you mentioned didn't show up at all. I went to the law firm you specified, and you'll never believe this—that lawyer actually died on the exact same day as Lang Mu!"

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow, a flicker of genuine surprise crossing his face. "What a coincidence?"

"You bet! Moreover, the guy died very suddenly in a car accident. The car he was driving collided head-on with a dump truck, and his entire body was crushed to pieces. Because his death was so sudden, the work on his hands couldn't be handed over immediately. The Lang family took advantage of this exact time gap. I'll give you the details when I get there."

About a quarter of an hour later, Wei Ke arrived.

Wei Ke took a bottle of mineral water, unscrewed the cap, and while drinking, motioned for Shang Feifan to open the file folder.

"Let's talk about the lawyer first. He was privately affiliated with a law firm, and his usual workspace was at his own home. Aside from paying a fixed annual affiliation fee to that firm, none of the cases he took required going through the agency.

So after the lawyer's car accident, the cases in his hands couldn't be transferred in time. A portion of his clients couldn't get in touch with him and went to his firm, only to learn the news of his car accident; those clients' cases were then taken over by that law firm. But there were also clients who, upon failing to reach the lawyer, simply stopped trying to contact him. Naturally, Lang Mu's situation fell into this category."

Wei Ke chugged half the bottle of water in one breath, wiped his mouth, and said, "Such a coincidental situation is truly exceedingly rare. All I can say is..."

"My Lang Mu was just too unlucky?" Shang Feifan cut in.

Wei Ke dryly chuckled, but still nodded. "Sister-in-law's luck really is a bit..."

He addressed a deceased male as "Sister-in-law" because he discovered that Boss Shang seemed quite fond of him using this title for Lang Mu.

Ahem, as a subordinate, naturally one had to know how to read the boss's expression. Although he was no longer Shang Feifan's subordinate now, in their hearts they all acknowledged that Boss Shang would always remain their eternal boss!

Having a boss like Shang Feifan gave one great peace of mind. At the very least, if you ran into trouble, it was hard to say for the other brothers, but Shang Feifan would definitely help you—and most importantly, he had the capability to do so.

Shang Feifan didn't get angry either, gesturing for Wei Ke to continue.

Wei Ke sat down at the foot of the bed, clutching the mineral water bottle as he recounted, "I went to that lawyer's home, gained permission from his family, and obtained the original will left behind by Lang Mu. His family turned out to be quite responsible; they didn't touch the lawyer's documents and kept them properly stored."

Wei Ke pointed at the file folder. This was his biggest harvest over the past few days.

Shang Feifan opened the folder and saw Bushuai's handwriting.

So many years had passed, and Bushuai's handwriting had undergone slight changes, but in the subtle details and overall style, one could still tell it was written by the same person.

The handwriting was delicate, upright, stroke by stroke, with very few connected cursive characters. The brushstrokes appeared rounded, yet concealed an inner edge.

Wei Ke continued, "About a month after Lang Mu's death, Lang An was arrested and sentenced. Lang Yunshou ran straight to the police station, claiming he wanted to retrieve all of his eldest son's inheritance, stating this was the retirement money left to him by his eldest son."

Wei Ke glanced at Shang Feifan's expression. "You definitely wouldn't want to know how Lang Yunshou wept buckets of tears at the police station to evoke people's sympathy. He shifted all the blame onto his younger son, Lang An—though of course, he didn't say Lang An committed intentional murder, instead emphasizing that it was a dispute between biological brothers, a family matter, and a momentary burst of agitation. In short, Lang Yunshou played the role of a pitiful old father who had lost two sons to absolute perfection."

"So Lang Mu's inheritance was really all handed over to him?" Shang Feifan asked expressionlessly.

Wei Ke spread his hands. "In the absence of any other immediate family members or a spouse, and without a will, Lang Mu's inheritance naturally transferred over to his biological father. Moreover, Lang Mu's estate was very clear-cut—no real estate or jewelry, only cash, totaling 5.63 million."

"To Lang Yunshou, that could be considered an astronomical sum." Shang Feifan sneered.

chunks.chineseText:
“是啊。”魏轲搔了搔眉头：“听说郎云寿知道郎沐存了那么多钱后，就忍不住笑了出来，笑得特别惊喜，就跟中了大奖一样。他那时可是在哭长子的死。就因为那个笑容，让当时办事的老张印象特别深刻。我去找他了解情况，他就跟我说，那个做父亲的绝对有问题。”

魏轲也很佩服郎沐，三十来岁就赚了这么多，还是正经工作。

商非凡：“他不怎么花钱，也不喜欢买奢侈品。另外就是第一套房子是他母亲留给他的，他当时卖了两百多万，后来加上存款，买了一套价值五百多万的新房子，后来又因为郎云寿一家纠缠，平价卖掉。再之后又在工作工作几年，那时吃住都是公司的，工资就都存了下来。如此，他手头上才有这么多钱。”

魏轲也不奇怪商非凡这么了解郎沐的经济来源，两人是情侣嘛。

可只要一想到商老大回来只能抱着爱人的骨灰，魏轲又被虐到了。

他还看到了那个骨灰盒，就在商老大的床头放着。

“郎沐还有一份遗嘱，在他公司里，可能还要麻烦你跑一趟。”商非凡说。

魏轲表示没问题，他现在正式接手了郎沐的遗嘱案，是这个案件的主负责人。不过报案地点是N城郎沐户籍所在地的警局，案子仍旧属于N城，魏轲算是临时借调。

报案人就是商非凡。

商非凡报案的理由就是他是郎沐的好友，郎沐曾经跟他说过遗嘱的事，结果他这次回国却发现郎沐的遗嘱没有被正确执行。

民不举官不究，但一旦有人报案，那当然要立案调查。

“郎云寿一家现在情况如何？他们已经把郎沐的遗产花光了吗？”商非凡问。

魏轲苦笑：“距离郎沐被杀，已经过去整整十年。郎云寿拿到郎沐的遗产后，就立刻和郎岸母亲离婚，拿着钱跑到了Y城。我刚查到他在Y城的地址，他在那边买了一套新房，又再婚娶了一个，不过还没孩子。”

商非凡没有露出任何意外表情，郎云寿那种人什么事都能干得出来，拿到一笔巨款，又怎么舍得给别人花，何况郎岸和郎岸母亲对他来说都已经成为包袱，不丢才怪。

“郎岸母亲会这么轻易放过郎云寿？”

魏轲摇头：“具体情况我还没有查到。不过当时应该闹得很厉害，郎岸母亲应该是不想离婚，但郎云寿坚持离，郎岸母亲要分郎沐的遗产，郎云寿不同意，两人撕逼得很难看。后来郎云寿是怎么摆脱郎岸母亲，又是怎么让她同意离婚的，我还没查到。”

商非凡：“九成是给钱了。”

魏轲耸肩：“这个可能性很高。”

“郎岸呢？出狱了吗？”商非凡看到档案上郎岸并没有被判死刑。

魏轲干咳：“郎岸因为坚持自己不是故意杀人，而是激愤杀人。作为亲生父亲的郎云寿也极力主张代替长子郎沐原谅郎岸……”

咔嚓！

魏轲瞪大眼睛，他是不是看错了？

商老大竟然把沙发扶手给空手捏碎了？！

“呃，郎岸被判了十一年，可巧，这个月他就会被放出来。”魏轲坚持说完，但眼睛一直盯着商非凡的手和捏碎的沙发扶手。

商非凡站起身，脸上神色说不出是怒还是什么，就特别平静：“也好，就一起处理好了。”
