chunks.chapterTitle: 第90章 商非凡的安排 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第90章 商非凡的安排

N城第十一实验中学以诈骗罪名将郎云寿告上法庭。

这件事不但在本地新闻有报道，就连网上也出现相关热搜。

原本普通诈骗案并不会引起太多人注意，但当有人点开新闻链接，立刻就被里面狗血又劲爆的内容给吸引，成为自来水，到处转发。

不久，这条看似普通的新闻被换了一个题名，登上了数个搜索网站和社交网站的热搜榜前三。

【亲生父亲唆使次子杀害长子，只为吞没长子死后563万巨额捐款！】

吃瓜人点开新闻，以为又是个标题党，没想到新闻内容比标题还要劲爆。

无数人因为新闻内容差点气炸，只看留言就知道大家有多暴躁和愤怒。

无数人都在呼吁不能因为郎云寿是郎沐的血缘父亲就原谅他，反而因为对方是父亲的身份，更应该重判，这不但是诈骗，更是杀人抢劫！

郎云寿拿到长子遗产就和郎岸母亲离婚这点，更是让无数人诟病。认为这人无情无义卑鄙无耻到极点，利用别人的儿子也是他亲生子杀死长子，竟然就把孩子妈给踢了，半点好处都不肯分给对方。还转头就用染了两个儿子鲜血的钱又娶了更年轻漂亮的新妻子，就不是人！

甚至还有人从律师之死延伸到阴谋论上，认为这起车祸太巧合，怀疑律师的车祸也是人为，让警方仔细调查。

警方还真的仔细调查了。

魏轲就查了当年那个撞死律师的渣土车司机，不过他并没有从该司机的账户上查到有什么不妥，对方也没有饮酒，就是单纯的疲劳驾驶，开车途中打瞌睡，不小心就撞上了律师的车。

魏轲和商非凡也都不觉得郎云寿和郎岸几人有买凶杀人的能耐，不是他们瞧不起这对父子，他们是真没这个胆子，否则也不会被追债人追得那么狼狈。郎岸之所以杀死郎沐，也只是一时昏了头，加上窝里横的属性。真要他拿刀正面对人，你看他敢不敢。

商非凡和魏轲一起找到郎沐中学母校，找当时了解内情的校方人员说明情况。

二十二年过去，第十一中的老员工已经不多，很多人都已经退休。但现在的校长正好是当时的教导主任，他那时还很年轻，对郎沐这个几乎住在学校的优秀学生也还有记忆。

郎沐的班主任也还在学校工作，她已经退休，但因为她教学特别好，又被返聘回学校。只是不再带班，只上上课。

这位数学老师记忆特别好，当年她和宿管师傅是最照顾郎沐的人，对郎沐的家庭情况非常清楚，到现在都还记得郎沐在校期间的一些细小事情。

宿管师傅更早已经退休，但还活着，联系上对方后，对方非常爽朗地表示愿意出来作证，证明郎沐除了母亲以外并无家人关心，同时还能证明郎云寿从第一次露面开始就贪图郎沐母亲留下的遗产。

当年就是他看出来郎云寿不是个好东西，找郎沐班主任商量，才会有后来三方在郎沐成年前一起代理监管郎沐母亲留下遗产一事。

这几位一起来到校长办公室，听魏轲介绍郎沐情况，在知晓郎沐竟然被郎云寿那一家子纠缠那么多年，最后更被同父异母的亲兄弟杀害，都异常愤怒。

尤其当他们听到郎沐竟然在死前就留有遗嘱，要把所有遗产都捐献给中学母校，以此来资助贫困学子，可这笔遗产却被郎云寿无耻吞没后，更是怒上加怒。

“以诈骗罪名起诉郎云寿恐怕很难，只能起诉让他归还郎沐的遗产。但这么多年过去，加上他又是郎沐的亲生父亲，那些钱恐怕能要回来一半就算不错。”郎沐班主任何老师理智地说。

商非凡推了推戴在脸上的变色眼镜：“不难。我是郎沐的朋友，他跟我说过，说他在郎云寿和郎岸再次找到他并纠缠他非要借钱的时候，就曾清楚告诉郎云寿和郎岸，不要打他钱财主意，说就算是他死亡，他也不会给他们留一分钱，并明言自己已经立好遗嘱，他的遗产将全部捐献出去。”

“可郎沐已经去世，有其他人听到这段话吗？”宿管师傅一头白发，皱眉问。

商非凡点头：“有。当时郎云寿他们找上门，因为小区物业比较负责，就没有让他们进门。郎沐出来见他们，就在小区门口说了这段话，当时小区物业都有听到，还有一些看热闹的人也有听到。”

“那这些人还能找到吗？”校长看向穿着制服的魏轲。

魏轲：“我们已经在寻找，目前已经找到当时的物业工作人员。虽然时间已经过去十几年，但那时智能手机已经普及，有一名物业告诉我们，为了防止有人来小区闹事，也为了留证，除了监控录像以外，他们物业都有给闹事者拍视频留证的习惯。现在我们正在寻找当时的视频录像。”

商非凡垂眸。

这段视频录像他们已经找到，那名物业拍视频其实并不是像他嘴巴上说的为了留证那么好听，他其实有点偷窥癖，喜欢偷拍业主的一些不雅视频。有时也会拍一些闹事的视频。

一开始他们询问时，他并没有主动说明他有当时录像的事，还是他的同事随口提到他有拍视频的习惯，他们才知道此事。

魏轲以藏匿证据的名义吓他，商非凡则表示可以出钱购买这段视频，对方才吐露确实有当时的视频。

魏轲看到视频后很高兴，视频内容很清晰，包括郎沐和郎云寿郎岸的对话。

有了这段视频，加上当时听到对话的物业，他们不但可以夺回郎沐的遗产，还能以“诈骗”罪名起诉郎云寿。

这也算是意外之喜。

不过商非凡对要花那么长时间跟郎云寿打官司不感兴趣，这个诈骗罪名在那名律师没有拿着遗嘱出现的情况下，也很难成立。

他请第十一中学以这个名义起诉郎云寿，不是为了让郎云寿坐牢，而是为了让郎云寿恐惧、不安、每一天都活在要失去全部家产且摊上官司的惶恐中。

十一中学愿意出这个头，也不是为钱办事，他们就是纯为郎沐抱不平，不想要郎沐的遗产落在那种人手上。

用那位宿管老师傅的话来说，那就是钱能不能拿回来不重要，重要的是不能让郎云寿好过！

郎沐的遗产案就这么推动起来。

随着亲生父亲唆使次子杀死长子，只为吞没长子563万捐款的新闻飞速火爆，这个案件也进入了全民眼中，因为新闻中写的内容太恶劣、太气人，无数人都在关心这个案子。

就连郎沐生前工作的公司也有人主动站出来作证，证明他们当年亲眼目睹郎云寿和郎岸跑到公司闹事，只为跟郎沐要钱。更证明那对父子为了要到钱，根本不顾郎沐工作和前途，不顾郎沐在工作单位要怎么做人，是怎么让郎沐难堪就怎么做。

甚至郎云寿还拦着看起来像是领导的车子，以郎沐的名义跟公司领导借钱，就奇葩无耻到极点。

郎云寿这天刚从麻将档回来，就看到妻子正在往行李箱里放衣服。

“可郎沐已经去世，有其他人听到这段话吗？”宿管师傅一头白发，皱眉问。

商非凡点头：“有。当时郎云寿他们找上门，因为小区物业比较负责，就没有让他们进门。郎沐出来见他们，就在小区门口说了这段话，当时小区物业都有听到，还有一些看热闹的人也有听到。”

“那这些人还能找到吗？”校长看向穿着制服的魏轲。

魏轲：“我们已经在寻找，目前已经找到当时的物业工作人员。虽然时间已经过去十几年，但那时智能手机已经普及，有一名物业告诉我们，为了防止有人来小区闹事，也为了留证，除了监控录像以外，他们物业都有给闹事者拍视频留证的习惯。现在我们正在寻找当时的视频录像。”

商非凡垂眸。

这段视频录像他们已经找到，那名物业拍视频其实并不是像他嘴巴上说的为了留证那么好听，他其实有点偷窥癖，喜欢偷拍业主的一些不雅视频。有时也会拍一些闹事的视频。

一开始他们询问时，他并没有主动说明他有当时录像的事，还是他的同事随口提到他有拍视频的习惯，他们才知道此事。

魏轲以藏匿证据的名义吓他，商非凡则表示可以出钱购买这段视频，对方才吐露确实有当时的视频。

魏轲看到视频后很高兴，视频内容很清晰，包括郎沐和郎云寿郎岸的对话。

有了这段视频，加上当时听到对话的物业，他们不但可以夺回郎沐的遗产，还能以“诈骗”罪名起诉郎云寿。

这也算是意外之喜。

不过商非凡对要花那么长时间跟郎云寿打官司不感兴趣，这个诈骗罪名在那名律师没有拿着遗嘱出现的情况下，也很难成立。

他请第十一中学以这个名义起诉郎云寿，不是为了让郎云寿坐牢，而是为了让郎云寿恐惧、不安、每一天都活在要失去全部家产且摊上官司的惶恐中。

十一中学愿意出这个头，也不是为钱办事，他们就是纯为郎沐抱不平，不想要郎沐的遗产落在那种人手上。

用那位宿管老师傅的话来说，那就是钱能不能拿回来不重要，重要的是不能让郎云寿好过！

郎沐的遗产案就这么推动起来。

随着亲生父亲唆使次子杀死长子，只为吞没长子563万捐款的新闻飞速火爆，这个案件也进入了全民眼中，因为新闻中写的内容太恶劣、太气人，无数人都在关心这个案子。

就连郎沐生前工作的公司也有人主动站出来作证，证明他们当年亲眼目睹郎云寿和郎岸跑到公司闹事，只为跟郎沐要钱。更证明那对父子为了要到钱，根本不顾郎沐工作和前途，不顾郎沐在工作单位要怎么做人，是怎么让郎沐难堪就怎么让郎沐难堪。

甚至郎云寿还拦着看起来像是领导的车子，以郎沐的名义跟公司领导借钱，就奇葩无耻到极点。

郎云寿这天刚从麻将档回来，就看到妻子正在往行李箱里放衣服。
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第90章 商非凡的安排 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
“你这是要去哪儿？你不上班了吗？”郎云寿皱眉问。

郎云寿和第三任妻子包甜过得不冷不热，感情不算太好。

包甜比他年轻十多岁，也曾离过婚，和郎云寿结婚，一个是看郎云寿买了新房，一个是对方说自己没有儿女但有一定存款，能让她过上比较轻松的生活。

但实际和郎云寿结婚后，包甜才发现郎云寿好吃懒做，不喜欢工作，还喜欢成天待在麻将档。

如果郎云寿有很多存款，并愿意给她花钱也就罢了，但郎云寿把自己的存款看得极紧，除了每月给三千块生活费，竟然半分钱不肯多掏。

包甜早就后悔，但她已经离过一次婚，再离婚想要再找一个好的就更难。

偏偏包甜家里又是比较老派那种，认为女人就应该结婚嫁人，在她第一次离婚后就催着她再嫁，郎云寿也是他们介绍给她的，当时说得千般好，什么岁数大一些会疼人云云。

他么真结婚才知道全都是骗人！

她家里让她嫁给郎云寿，只因为当时只有郎云寿愿意出二十万的彩礼钱。

这二十万块，包甜一分钱都没有拿到。

别人家里嫁女儿，说是拿彩礼钱，但不管多少都会全部交给女儿，相当于就是转个手又还给小两口。

但他们家，无论是她第一次出嫁，还是第二次出嫁，彩礼钱都跟她没有丝毫关系，他们家连压箱底的钱都没给她一分。

包甜觉得自己的命很苦，嫁的第一个丈夫喜欢喝醉酒打人，打得她实在受不了，在被打得流产后，终于下定决心和对方离婚。

在第二次嫁人时，她对第二任丈夫还是有着不小期望的，愿意嫁个比自己大十五岁的男人，也是希望对方能真的会疼她。

结果……

好在郎云寿不打人，也不会跟她伸手要钱。包甜自己有工作，加上郎云寿每月给的三千块，家里也不用付房子贷款钱，不需要养老养小，她就觉得这样的日子也能过下去。

如果没有看到新闻。

包甜在连锁零食店上班，店里管得不严，比较闲的时候，大家会偷玩手机。

当时就有人把一条新闻链接传到他们店里员工的小群里，包甜空闲时点开看了，她刚看时只以为是别人家的热闹事，但等看到郎云寿的名字，整个人都像是被电打了一般。

一般新闻会遮掩当事人和相关者的名字，但这个新闻简直就像是怕别人不知道涉事人都有谁一样，把名字和来历全都交代得清清楚楚。

只名字稍微遮掩了一下，变成郎X寿，N城人士，搬迁到Y城，用长子的遗产购买了一套位于凤X小区的一套拆迁安置房。第一位妻子李女士，长子郎mu，第二位妻子安女士，次子郎an，第三位妻子包女士……

这样的遮掩，只要稍微熟悉郎云寿的，一眼就能看出来这指的是谁。

包甜只知道丈夫结过一次婚，只知道他前妻姓安，但并不知道他还有一位前妻，更不知道他有两个儿子！

这是骗婚！

郎云寿欺瞒了她很多事情。

包甜当时就给她父母打电话，问他们知不知道郎云寿在和她结婚前就结过两次婚还有两个儿子。

包甜父母支支吾吾，最后被女儿逼得受不了，就说了实话，说他们并没有打听得很清楚，郎云寿说什么他们也就信了。

包甜母亲还说：郎云寿看起来也不像是会骗人的人。

包甜气得在电话中就哭了出来，骂父母只要有钱收，压根就不管她的幸福。然后就把那条新闻链接转发给了父母。

包甜父母看完新闻内容，也怕了，他们不是怕女儿受牵连，而是担心郎云寿的钱来历不正，会被法院全部没收，导致她女儿什么都落不着。

包甜父母就立刻蛊惑女儿赶紧跟郎云寿离婚，争取在郎云寿没钱前先弄一笔分手费。然后又可惜那套房子是婚前买的，包甜无法分到好处。

包甜怼了句“那都是赃款买的！”，随即不想再跟父母说话，直接挂了电话。

下班回来后，包甜就开始收拾行李，她要立刻搬出去，立刻向法院起诉郎云寿骗婚。

赔偿什么的，她也不指望，她就希望能赶紧和这么一个吃自己亲生儿子血馒头的人分开。

包甜甚至在庆幸，庆幸郎云寿因为年岁大了，婚后一直没能让她有孩子，虽然郎云寿很想要一个。

郎云寿见包甜不回应，只埋头收拾行李，就上去拉扯她，问她到底怎么回事。

包甜冷着脸，把那条新闻链接发给他：“你自己看吧。”

郎云寿莫名其妙，麻将档的人都忙着打麻将，很少有人会玩手机，他自然不知道今天他上热搜的事。

等到郎云寿点开新闻，看到一半，脸色就变得苍白，随后充血，又变得铁青。

等看完，他的身体已经止不住地颤抖起来。

郎沐已经死了，为什么当年的事还会爆出来？

到底是谁在搞他？

他也听过郎沐对他放话说，说就算他死了也不会给他留一分钱，说他已经立了遗产全部捐献的遗嘱。

他当时以为郎沐说的是气话，没想到郎沐真的那么年轻就立了遗嘱。

郎云寿急得团团转，他觉得他需要找专家咨询。

于是，他也顾不上包甜那边，点开手机就开始在网上咨询网络律师。

一开始他说的遮遮掩掩，想要问他这种情况到底算不算诈骗和欺瞒。

网络律师回答得五花八门，大多都是让他留下电话号码好直接联系商谈，还有些则是在说到关键处就表示要收费才能继续咨询。

郎云寿刚开始还舍不得钱，但他问了不少网络律师，发现都说得模棱两可，只好花钱咨询。

包甜拎着一个大行李箱和几个包打开大门，最后回头看了眼她住了好几年的家。

丈夫郎云寿就坐在沙发上低头看着手机，不时还进行语音对话，声音焦急，脸色难看。

对方太过专注于咨询上，都没有注意到她的离开。

包甜扭头，关上大门。

她也不打算回父母家，她打算自己去租房，连续跳了两次坑，以后她也不想再结婚了，就打算一个人过一辈子。

不到两天，郎云寿所在的拆迁安置房小区就已经有不少人知道新闻中那个猪狗不如的郎云寿就住在他们小区。

郎云寿没工作，成天往麻将档跑，不止物业的人认识他，很多小区老人和闲散人都认识他。

郎云寿已经不敢出门，一出门他就会被人指指点点。

更糟糕的是，警察和法院的人接连上门。

他的银行账户也被冻结。

郎云寿这时才想起妻子包甜，但打电话发现已经打不通，对方把他拉黑了。

更更糟糕的是，包甜还把他告了，以骗婚的罪名。

郎云寿的生活一下变得一团糟，整个人被整得焦头烂额。

但他不知道，这还只是开始。

没过几天，他的第二任妻子包女士也把他告了，罪名是唆使次子郎岸杀害长子，就为了谋夺长子的遗产。
chunks.englishText:
"Where are you going? Aren't you going to work?" Lang Yunshou asked with a frown.

Lang Yunshou's relationship with his third wife, Bao Tian, had always been lukewarm and far from affectionate.

Bao Tian was more than a decade younger than him and had also been divorced once before. Her reasons for marrying Lang Yunshou were twofold: first, she saw that he had bought a new apartment; second, he claimed he had no children of his own but possessed a certain amount of savings, which would allow her to lead a relatively comfortable and stress-free life.

However, after actually marrying him, Bao Tian discovered that Lang Yunshou was gluttonous and lazy, hated working, and loved spending all day hanging around mahjong parlors.

It would have been one thing if Lang Yunshou had a massive fortune in savings and was willing to spend it on her, but he guarded his money with extreme tightness. Aside from a meager three thousand yuan a month for living expenses, he refused to part with a single extra cent.

Bao Tian had long since regretted her decision, but she had already been through one divorce; trying to find a decent partner after a second one would be even more difficult.

To make matters worse, Bao Tian's family held very old-fashioned views, believing that a woman's ultimate destiny was to marry and settle down. Ever since her first divorce, they had relentlessly pressured her into remarrying. Lang Yunshou had been introduced to her by them, painted in glowing terms—claiming that an older man would know how to pamper and cherish a wife.

*Damn it, only after actually marrying him did she realize it was all a lie!*

The only reason her family had urged her to marry Lang Yunshou was because he was the only suitor willing to shell out a bride price of two hundred thousand yuan at the time.

Not a single cent of that two hundred thousand yuan had ever reached Bao Tian's hands.

In other families, when a daughter married, even if they demanded a bride price, they would invariably hand the entire amount—regardless of how large it was—over to the daughter, effectively treating it as a transfer of funds right back to the newlywed couple.

But in her family, whether it was her first marriage or her second, the bride price had zero to do with her. Her family hadn't even given her a single penny of dowry money to line her own chest.

Bao Tian felt her life was bitterly tragic. Her first husband had been an alcoholic who liked to beat her, raining down blows until she simply couldn't take it anymore. After being beaten to the point of a miscarriage, she finally resolved to divorce him.

Entering her second marriage, she still held high hopes for her second husband. Agreeing to marry a man fifteen years her senior was born from the desire that he would genuinely care for her.

And the result...

Fortunately, Lang Yunshou didn't hit people, nor did she have to stretch out her hand to beg him for money. Bao Tian had her own job, and combined with the three thousand yuan Lang Yunshou doled out each month—with no mortgage to pay off, and no elderly parents or young children to support—she felt she could just barely scrape by and endure such a life.

That was, assuming she hadn't seen the news.

Bao Tian worked in a chain snack store. Management wasn't strict, and during quiet lulls, the staff would sneakily play on their phones.

Someone had forwarded a news link into the store's small employee chat group. Bao Tian clicked it open during a free moment. At first, she thought it was just some juicy gossip about strangers, but the moment she laid eyes on Lang Yunshou's name, her entire body felt as though it had been struck by lightning.

Ordinarily, news reports would mask the names of the principals and related parties, but this article seemed deliberately written as if terrified that people wouldn't know who was involved. It laid out names and backgrounds with crystal-clear precision.

The names were only slightly masked: Lang X-shou, a native of City N, who relocated to City Y and used his eldest son's inheritance to purchase a demolition-relocation apartment located in Feng X Residential Community. First wife, Ms. Li; eldest son, Lang Mu; second wife, Ms. An; second son, Lang An; third wife, Ms. Bao...

With disguises this thin, anyone even slightly familiar with Lang Yunshou could tell at a single glance who was being referred to.

Bao Tian had only ever known that her husband had been married once before and that his ex-wife's surname was An. She had no idea he had *another* ex-wife, let alone that he possessed *two* sons!

This was marriage fraud!

Lang Yunshou had deceived her about a multitude of things.

Bao Tian called her parents on the spot, demanding to know if they were aware that Lang Yunshou had been married twice before and had two sons prior to marrying her.

Her parents stammered evasively. Cornered and overwhelmed by their daughter's interrogation, they finally confessed the truth: they hadn't bothered to investigate thoroughly and had simply believed whatever Lang Yunshou told them.

Bao Tian's mother even defended him: "Lang Yunshou didn't look like the kind of man who would lie."

Bao Tian burst into tears right there on the phone, cursing her parents for caring only about collecting money while completely ignoring her happiness. With that, she forwarded the news link straight to them.

After reading through the article, Bao Tian's parents panicked as well. They weren't afraid that their daughter would be implicated; rather, they were terrified that Lang Yunshou's money had been obtained through illicit means and would be entirely confiscated by the court, leaving their daughter with nothing at all.

Her parents immediately brainwashed their daughter into divorcing Lang Yunshou posthaste, urging her to squeeze out a hefty breakup settlement before his funds were frozen. In the same breath, they lamented that the apartment had been purchased before the marriage, meaning Bao Tian had no legal claim to a share of the property.

"It was all bought with stolen blood-money!" Bao Tian snapped back, refusing to utter another word to her parents before slamming down the phone.

As soon as she got off work and returned home, Bao Tian began packing her luggage. She was going to move out immediately and file a lawsuit against Lang Yunshou for marriage fraud.

As for compensation, she wasn't counting on it; her sole desire was to rapidly sever ties with a man who feasted on the bloody, hard-earned bones of his own biological son.

Bao Tian even felt a sense of fortune—thankful that, due to Lang Yunshou's advanced age, she had never managed to conceive a child during their marriage, even though Lang Yunshou had desperately wanted one.

Seeing Bao Tian ignore him and bury herself in packing her bags, Lang Yunshou stepped forward to grab her, demanding to know what the hell was going on.

With an icy expression, Bao Tian shoved the news link in his face: "Read it yourself."

Bewildered, Lang Yunshou took the phone. The regulars at the mahjong parlor were all too busy playing to mess around on their phones, so he naturally remained completely oblivious to the fact that he was trending on the internet today.

The moment Lang Yunshou tapped open the article and read halfway through, his face drained of color. Then a rush of blood flooded his cheeks, turning them a livid, iron-gray.

By the time he finished reading, his entire body was trembling uncontrollably.

Lang Mu was already dead; why on earth was the past bubbling back up to the surface now?

Who the hell was trying to screw him over?

He recalled Lang Mu's parting words to him back then—that even if he died, he wouldn't leave him a single cent, and that he had already drawn up a will donating his entire inheritance.

At the time, he had assumed Lang Mu was just venting in a fit of anger. He never dreamed that Lang Mu would draft a legal will at such a young age.

Panicking and spinning in circles, Lang Yunshou decided he needed to consult an expert.

Putting Bao Tian completely out of his mind, he tapped open his phone and began searching for online lawyers.

At first, his inquiries were guarded and evasive as he tried to figure out whether his situation constituted fraud and deception.

The online lawyers gave a hodgepodge of answers, most of which demanded he leave his phone number for a direct consultation, while others hit a critical juncture and suddenly announced that further advice required a consultation fee.

Initially reluctant to part with his money, Lang Yunshou found that after querying a slew of web lawyers, every single one gave ambiguous, fence-straddling answers. Gritting his teeth, he finally caved and paid for professional advice.

Dragging a large suitcase and several bags, Bao Tian pulled open the front door. Pausing, she cast one final glance back at the home she had lived in for several years.

Her husband, Lang Yunshou, sat hunched over on the sofa, eyes glued to his phone screen as he traded voice messages at intervals. His voice was frantic, his face wretched.

So utterly consumed was he by his quest for legal advice that he didn't even notice her departure.

Bao Tian turned her head away and clicked the front door shut.

She had no intention of returning to her parents' house. She planned to rent a place of her own. Having stumbled into the same pit twice, she was entirely done with marriage; she intended to live out the rest of her days alone.

In less than two days, quite a few residents in Lang Yunshou's demolition-relocation housing estate learned that the scumbag described in the news—a man lower than a beast—lived right among them in their very neighborhood.

Since Lang Yunshou didn't have a job and spent his entire day haunting mahjong parlors, not only did the property management staff recognize him, but countless elderly residents and idlers knew his face well.

Lang Yunshou no longer dared to step foot outside; the moment he ventured outdoors, he became the target of pointed fingers and whispered condemnation.

What was even worse was that police officers and court officials came knocking at his door one after another.

His bank accounts were frozen as well.

It was only then that Lang Yunshou remembered his wife, Bao Tian, but when he tried to call, he discovered the line wouldn't go through—she had blocked him.

To make matters infinitely worse, Bao Tian had also slapped him with a lawsuit for marriage fraud.

Lang Yunshou's life was sent spiraling into absolute chaos, leaving him battered and utterly overwhelmed.

Little did he know, this was merely the beginning.

Scarcely a few days later, his second wife, Ms. Bao, filed a lawsuit against him as well, charging him with instigating their younger son, Lang An, to murder his elder brother in order to seize the eldest son's inheritance.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第90章 商非凡的安排 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
刚刚被放出来的郎岸也接受记者采访，流着眼泪告诉记者，说他并不想伤害他的兄长郎沐，都是因为他父亲逼迫他。还教唆他伪装成激-情杀人，他父亲还答应会帮他说话，不会让他被判死刑。

郎岸又哭着说，他原本不肯，但他父亲用和他母亲离婚来威胁他，他只好同意。

记者又采访安女士。

安女士也告诉记者，说他丈夫之前就设法谋夺过已去世前妻的遗产，而且和她结婚时也从没有提过他还有一个需要支付抚养费的长子。

记者从安女士那里证实，郎云寿从没有对长子郎沐支付过一分钱的抚养费，还试图吞掉第一个妻子李女士留给儿子郎沐的遗产，只是被郎沐校方和所请律师严厉监管，才没有占到多少便宜。

但安女士又证实说郎云寿在长子郎沐成年后，以各种借口跟郎沐借钱，把郎沐母亲留给他的那十来万遗产八成都骗到手，且从没有归还过一分钱。

记者从安女士那里了解了很多事，包括郎岸欠下网贷，无力偿还，郎云寿不想帮他还钱，就教唆郎岸去找郎沐，纠缠郎沐跟他借钱，不给钱就闹。

郎云寿从警方那里得知前妻和次子郎岸竟然污蔑他，往他身上泼黑水，说他教唆杀人有意谋夺财产，气得破口大骂，更怕得要死。

魏轲看到最新的案情进展，忍不住联系商非凡：“你是怎么让那对母子改口把罪过都推到郎云寿身上的？”

郎岸已经出狱，按理他并不需要再把罪名推到郎云寿身上以此来减刑，所以他为什么会反咬郎云寿一口？

商非凡淡淡道：“很简单。因为他们都是极度自私的人。郎云寿得到大笔钱财就甩掉姓安的女人，那女人怎么可能会舒坦？

我找人问了那女人，那女人并没有拿到一分钱，她会同意离婚，只因为郎云寿用郎岸威胁她，说如果她不同意离婚，他就不会帮郎岸辩护，不会代郎沐原谅郎岸，那么郎岸就很可能会被判死刑。

然后郎云寿又答应那女人，说只要郎岸出狱，他就把钱分一半给郎岸。”

魏轲无语：“那女人就相信了？”

“她不得不信。她恨郎云寿这个亲生父亲竟然用自己亲生儿子来威胁她这个母亲，但她又确实更在乎儿子，只能答应离婚。而且她也盼着儿子出狱后能拿到两百多万，她想着儿子拿到钱肯定不会不管她这个母亲。”

魏轲：“……那郎岸呢？他为什么也改口了？”

商非凡：“因为当年的民间高利贷又找到他了。十一年下来，他当年的欠债利滚利已经滚到他就算卖血卖肾脏，卖掉一辈子也还不起的程度。

我找到郎岸，跟他说，我可以帮他出国，让他在国外打工生活，让高利贷的人再也找不到他。

我这么一说，郎岸就同意把他亲爸郎云寿拉下水。何况他也异常痛恨郎云寿威胁他母亲、和他母亲离婚的事。

更何况郎云寿在郎岸坐牢期间，看都没有去看过他，在郎岸出狱后更没有去接他，电话号码也换了，这是明摆着不想要这个儿子。郎岸怎么可能不恨这个父亲？”

魏轲吃惊：“你真要帮郎岸出国？”

商非凡勾唇一笑：“当然是真的。为什么不帮？”

魏轲眼珠一转，明白了。

这个帮忙出国肯定不是通过正当途径。且真去了国外，郎岸人生地不熟，如果去的还是法治不太健全的地区，再有商非凡的特别“照顾”，啧！

魏轲：“你可是一个陌生人，你这么突然冒出来，他就这么相信了？”

商非凡笑了笑：“因为我跟他说做的工作很辛苦，如果我能成功介绍人过去，可以赚到不菲的中介费，所以我专门介绍刚出狱的人过去那边。郎岸被追债人追得焦头烂额，见有一个希望，就算有所怀疑也会当做救命稻草。”

魏轲咋舌。商老大搞得这一手，换了任何一个陷入类似境遇的，大概率都会上套。

商非凡用的手段很普通，但真的很有效。

“你全都安排好了？”魏轲问。

商非凡笑而不语。

他确实已经为郎云寿和郎岸父子俩都安排好了未来的人生。

郎云寿将会被以诈骗、教唆杀人罪、谋夺他人遗产罪、骗婚等四项罪名被起诉，只要其中有几项罪名能成立，郎云寿的后半生基本就完了。

他再找人在狱中“照顾照顾”郎云寿，想必郎云寿的狱中生活一定会过得非常丰富和愉快。

至于郎岸，那就更简单了。

他在国内不会乱来，但到了那些法制不健全的地方……不不不，他也不会乱来，他只会按照他和郎岸的约定，把他送去打工。

他觉得郎岸很适合在黑矿工作一辈子。赚到的钱就全以郎沐的名义捐献给国内贫困地区的失学儿童，也算是郎岸自己为自己还债。

至于郎岸母亲，在失去儿子这个唯一希望，又年老色衰没有固定工作也没有多少存款更没有固定房产的情况下，晚年生活肉眼可见凄苦，他也没必要再多做什么。

没过多久，郎云寿的案子判决就下来了。

除了诈骗罪，其他三项罪名全部成立，因为罪行恶劣，且在社会上造成极大影响，郎云寿被判十五年有期徒刑。

他当初得到的郎沐遗产被勒令全部归还。

他买下的拆迁安置房被法院安排拍卖，拍卖所得金额将和郎云寿被冻结的银行存款一起转给第十一中学。

肯定有不足部分，这些已经被折算成刑期。

郎岸也在商非凡安排下，隐瞒母亲，把亲生母亲丢给追债的人，一个人离开华夏，怀揣着出国淘金和永远逃离高利贷索债的梦想，来到了一片崭新又混乱的土地，开始了他的黑矿人生……

商非凡花了不少时间处理这些事情，导致他游戏上的断断续续，等到他把郎云寿和郎岸父子的未来全部处理好，再上游戏时，莫约镇已经进入了新的一年。

“嗨。”虎不帅看到醒来的商非凡就笑。

商非凡看着笑得神清气爽的不帅，也跟着笑了。

Lang An, who had just been released, also accepted an interview with reporters. Weeping tears of remorse, he told the press that he had never wanted to harm his elder brother Lang Mu; it was entirely because his father had forced him. His father had even coached him to disguise the murder as a crime of passion, promising to speak on his behalf so he wouldn't be sentenced to death.

Breaking down in tears once more, Lang An claimed that he had initially refused, but his father used the threat of divorcing his mother to back him into a corner, leaving him no choice but to comply.

Reporters then turned to interview Ms. An.

Ms. An likewise informed the press that her husband had previously schemed to plunder the inheritance of his deceased first wife, and during their marriage, he had never once mentioned that he had an elder son requiring child support.

From Ms. An, reporters verified that Lang Yunshou had never paid a single cent of child support for his eldest son, Lang Mu. Furthermore, he had attempted to swallow up the inheritance left to Lang Mu by his first wife, Ms. Li, and was only thwarted from grabbing the spoils due to the strict oversight of Lang Mu's school and retained lawyers.

However, Ms. An went on to confirm that once Lang Mu reached adulthood, Lang Yunshou used various pretexts to borrow money from him, defrauding him out of roughly eighty percent of the hundred-odd-thousand-yuan inheritance left by his mother, and never returning a single cent.

Reporters uncovered a wealth of details from Ms. An, including the fact that Lang An had accumulated massive online loans he was incapable of repaying. Unwilling to help him clear his debts, Lang Yunshou had instigated Lang An to hound Lang Mu, badgering him for loans and making a scene if he refused.

When Lang Yunshou learned from the police that his ex-wife and younger son, Lang An, were actually smearing his name, splashing dirty water over him by claiming he had instigated murder to deliberately seize property, he flew into a rage, cursing foully out of sheer fury and paralyzing terror.

Upon witnessing the latest developments in the case, Wei Ke couldn't help but contact Shang Feifan: "How on earth did you get that mother and son to recant their statements and pin the entire blame on Lang Yunshou?"

Since Lang An had already served his sentence and been released, logically speaking, he had no need to shift the blame back onto Lang Yunshou to commute his sentence. So why would he suddenly turn around and bite the hand that fed him?

Shang Feifan answered with icy indifference: "Simple. Because they are both profoundly, utterly selfish people. Lang Yunshou walked away with a massive fortune and dumped the An woman; how could she possibly swallow that injustice and live in peace?

I sent someone to sound out that woman, and it turned out she hadn't received a single cent. The only reason she agreed to a divorce back then was because Lang Yunshou used Lang An as a hostage, threatening that if she refused, he would refuse to hire a defense lawyer for Lang An and refuse to grant Lang Mu's forgiveness on Lang An's behalf—meaning Lang An would almost certainly face the death penalty.

Then Lang Yunshou made a promise to her: the moment Lang An was released from prison, he would split the money fifty-fifty with him."

Wei Ke was speechless: "And that woman actually believed him?"

"She had no choice *but* to believe him. She loathed Lang Yunshou for using his own biological son to threaten her as a mother, but since she cared far more about her son, she had no alternative but to consent to the divorce. Besides, she was banking on her son coming out of prison and securing over two million yuan, figuring that once her son got his hands on the cash, he wouldn't abandon his own mother."

Wei Ke: "...And what about Lang An? Why did he change his statement too?"

Shang Feifan: "Because the underground loan sharks from back in the day tracked him down again. Over the span of eleven years, compound interest had bloated his old debts to a point where even if he sold his blood and harvested his kidneys, he couldn't pay them off in a lifetime.

I tracked down Lang An and told him I could help him leave the country, set him up with work abroad, and make sure the loan sharks could never find him again.

The moment I dangled that bait, Lang An agreed to drag his biological father, Lang Yunshou, down into the mud with him. Besides, he harbored a deep, burning hatred for Lang Yunshou over the way he had threatened his mother and forced a divorce.

On top of all that, during the entire time Lang An was locked away in prison, Lang Yunshou never once went to visit him. When Lang An was released, his father didn't show up to pick him up either, and had even changed his phone number—a blatant display of abandonment, making it crystal clear he wanted nothing to do with this son. How could Lang An *not* hate such a father?"

Wei Ke asked in astonishment: "Are you really going to help Lang An leave the country?"

Shang Feifan curved his lips into a smile: "Of course it's real. Why wouldn't I?"

A light dawned in Wei Ke's eyes as comprehension struck him.

This "help getting abroad" certainly wasn't going to happen through legitimate channels. And once he actually arrived in a foreign land where he knew not a soul, especially if it was a region with a shaky legal system—with Shang Feifan providing some special, "personalized care"—heh!

Wei Ke probed: "You're a complete stranger to him. Why did he swallow your pitch so easily?"

Shang Feifan smiled faintly: "Because I told him the work overseas is grueling. If I successfully recruit people to go over there, I make a handsome agent's commission, which is why I specialize in introducing freshly released convicts to the overseas market. Pushed to his wits' end by debt collectors, Lang An grabbed onto that single thread of hope as a drowning man grasps a straw, letting go of whatever suspicions he might have had."

Wei Ke clicked his tongue in awe. Handled by Boss Shang, anyone trapped in a similar desperate plight would have swallowed the hook without a second thought.

The methods Shang Feifan employed were utterly ordinary, yet devastatingly effective.

"Have you arranged everything?" Wei Ke asked.

Shang Feifan smiled without answering.

He had indeed mapped out the future for both father and son, Lang Yunshou and Lang An.

Lang Yunshou was slated to face trial on four separate charges: fraud, incitement to murder, scheming to plunder another's inheritance, and marriage fraud. Provided just a few of those counts stuck, Lang Yunshou's remaining years were effectively finished.

By paying a few individuals to give Lang Yunshou some "special attention" behind bars, his prison life promised to be thoroughly vibrant and entertaining.

As for Lang An, that was even simpler.

He wouldn't dare cause trouble domestically, but once he was dropped into those lawless regions... no, no, he wouldn't cause trouble there either; he would simply fulfill his agreement with Shang Feifan and be sent off to honest labor.

Shang Feifan felt Lang An was an exceptional candidate to spend a lifetime toiling in a black-market mine. Every coin he earned would be donated in Lang Mu's name to underprivileged children in impoverished domestic regions—serving as a fitting way for Lang An to repay his debts with the sweat of his own brow.

As for Lang An's mother—having lost her only remaining hope, aged and withered, devoid of a steady job, sitting on negligible savings and owning no real estate—her twilight years promised a visible, agonizing desolation. There was simply no need for him to lift a finger against her.

Before long, the verdict on Lang Yunshou's case was handed down.

Aside from the fraud charge, the remaining three counts were fully sustained. Given the egregious nature of his crimes and the massive negative impact he had inflicted upon society, Lang Yunshou was sentenced to fifteen years in prison.

The inheritance of Lang Mu that he had illegally acquired was ordered to be returned in full.

The demolition-relocation apartment he had purchased was put up for auction by the court, with the proceeds—along with Lang Yunshou's frozen bank deposits—to be transferred in full to the Eleventh Middle School.

Naturally, there was still a shortfall, which had been duly converted into additional prison time.

Under Shang Feifan's orchestration, Lang An—keeping his actions hidden from his mother, effectively casting her aside to face the loan sharks alone—boarded a flight out of China. Clutching dreams of striking gold abroad and escaping the creditors forever, he stepped foot onto a brand-new, chaotic foreign soil, kicking off his career as a black-mine laborer...

Shang Feifan had devoted a considerable chunk of time to handling these affairs, resulting in his sporadic, stop-and-go presence in the game. By the time he completely settled the futures of the father-and-son duo Lang Yunshou and Lang An and finally logged back into the game, Moyue Town had already crossed into the New Year.

"Hey." Tiger the Handsome grinned the moment he saw Shang Feifan wake up.

Looking at Tiger the Handsome, whose smile radiated vitality and ease, Shang Feifan chuckled and smiled back.

chunks.chineseText:
第91章 有了第一次

不帅心里很舒畅，他以为他已经不在意第一世的事情，毕竟已经过去那么久。

但……现在他按着自己的心脏，却感觉到一股说不出来的轻松，就像是一层紧箍在灵魂上的枷锁被彻底打开，又像是紧紧裹在灵魂上的一层脏污终于被洗刷干净。

那不是商非凡语言的力量，冥冥中他似乎真的感知到了那一家人的下场。

也许那点血缘联系始终都没有消失，让他哪怕魂穿三世仍旧能有所感觉。

通过这种神奇的、无法用言语描述的灵魂感知，他也可以变相地确定商非凡没有在说谎，他真的帮他夺回了遗产，让他的遗嘱内容得以正确执行，也让那一家人得到了应有的惩罚。

商非凡在述说他如何解决遗嘱案和如何处理那一家人时特别轻描淡写，似乎他没怎么费力气就做到了。

但不帅又不是小朋友，他自己亲身经历过那一家人有多么难缠，也清楚世情想要解决那一家人又是多么麻烦，没有一定的手段、人脉和金钱，就不可能干净利落地解决他们，更不可能这么快。

“你想和我睡吗？”

“咳咳！”正在喝水的商非凡把水喝进了气管，呛了好一会儿。

不帅连忙拍他的背部。

商非凡摆手表示自己没事，止住咳嗽后，看向年轻的兽人。

不帅没有躲避他的目光，就那么坦然地回看他。

商非凡神情复杂又纠结：“你知道我这种人是很容易顺杆子上的，我可不是那种道德感强烈人品高尚的君子，就算你抱着回馈的心思，我也会顺势接受，然后占尽你的便宜。所以你刚才的问话是认真的吗？”

虎不帅沉默一秒，点头。

商非凡：“……你燎火，你就得负责，我不会让你有中途喊停的机会。”

虎不帅：“现在？”

商非凡抬头看看天色，腾地跳起来：“天色还早，我们是去找个山洞，还是去荒野？我带了全套露营设备。”

虎不帅不给自己退缩空间，也跟着站起：“去山洞吧，我知道有些山洞很久没有人用。”

商非凡一把拉住他，“带路！”

两人跟夏冰和阿呆打了个招呼，就真的顺着山道往风洞山另一头走去。

不帅选的山洞远离居住区，已经位于边沿，站在那边的山道往外看，能看到一条波光粼粼的河道把莫约山谷半包围起来。

初升的太阳红通通，渲染出一大片红霞。红霞与河水互相映照，自成天然美景。

“这里风景不错。”商非凡站在洞口看了一会儿，他还看到了一大片种植着密密麻麻作物的农田。

“之前这里也有不少人居住，但因为这里每到夏冬两季，风都太大，人们就逐渐往中段转移，这边的山洞就都空出来了。”

不帅试着推身边山洞的大门，大门发出吱嘎声，被推开一条缝隙。

不帅探头往里看看，“就这个吧。”

商非凡感到怪怪的，他有种不帅在献祭的献身感。

他和不帅相处时间也不算短了，对他也有了更多了解，他用膝盖想都能猜出不帅这时在想什么，无非是“你帮了我一个我无法做到的大忙，我不知道该怎么报答你，既然你对我有想法，那么我就顺你的意思，满足你。”

他甚至还能体悟到不帅在这个行为下的另一层含义：等你得到你想要的后，也许你对我就会有更清醒的认知，不会再被性冲动搅乱思绪，以为那就是爱恋。

说白了，就是不帅还是不认为他们能长久在一起，也不认为他是真的喜欢他，或者说他的喜欢还不足以达到能维持一辈子的程度。

不帅可能对他也有点意思，否则也做不出献身的事。

但不帅对自己太不自信，觉得让他满足，让他真实得到他，就不会再对他感兴趣，或者是兴趣大大降低。

换言之，不帅已经做好了事后两人就会渐行渐远的准备。

但商非凡会因此就选择放弃吗？

不！这对他来说就是机会。

他可不耐烦用水磨功夫慢慢地磨不帅。

作为一个健康得不能再健康的成年雄性，毫不讳言地说，他每天晚上都在想着怎么折腾不帅。

如今幻想成真的机会就在眼前，他会放过才怪！

爱嘛，当然是越做越有。

不趁着年轻时享受双人运动的快乐，难道要等到老来吃小药丸吗？

商非凡抢先推开门轴不太顺滑的大门，一把把不帅给推了进去。

不帅脸有点红，但他稳住了，看山洞里灰尘很厚，就掏出法杖施展了一个清洁术。

满是灰尘的山洞转眼就变得干干净净。

收集起来的灰尘球被不帅扔出山洞。

商非凡那边已经火急火燎地掏出铺盖，在地上铺了一层又一层，还用手压了压，看是不是足够软。

不帅关上山洞大门，不放心下，还施展了一个魔法，让其他人无法推开大门。

商非凡做好准备，一步步向不帅走来。

不帅清清嗓子，张嘴，却不知道说什么。

商非凡抓住他的手臂，声音已经变得沙哑：“给你最后一次机会，你现在还能打开门走出去。”

不帅站着没动。

商非凡靠近他，压低声音：“你最后一次逃离我的机会，没了。”

山洞外，天光变得越来越明亮，红霞上空出现刺眼的白光，红霞消失，天大亮。

整个莫约镇都变得热闹起来。

新的一年来到，去年疫病带来的恐慌和乱象已经变成记忆，人们开始重新迎接新的生活。

巡逻兵依然还在巡逻，但镇上又出现了老人和孩子，小幼崽们在镇子的大小路上跑来跑去戏耍玩闹，不时发出尖叫声和稚嫩的吼叫声，整个镇子都因此活了起来。

阿呆也被夏冰带着去和那些小幼崽玩。

现在的阿呆被养得极好，一身皮毛光润水滑，虽然看起来依然呆头呆脑，但足够可爱，莫约镇的小家伙很容易就接受了这个外来的小幼崽。

夏冰就蹲在路边和坐在家门口搓草绳缝衣服制皮的老兽人们瞎聊。

夏冰虽然顶着一张猫猫脸，但这张脸圆溜溜的超级可爱，他又能说会道，嘴还特别甜，来镇子没多久，就和镇子上的兽人们打成一片。

如果不是商非凡说要开一家炼金店，让他当伙计，他早就去其他镇民开的店铺工作，大家都很欢迎他。

不过这段时间他带孩子也有工钱拿，还不少，夏冰也就不是那么急着让商老大开店。

阿呆跟在其他小兽人后面蹦蹦跳跳，动作笨拙，可跑得慢的不止他一个，落后那几个很自然就混成一伙，互相说着一些孩子话，慢慢就熟悉了。

有个小兽人凑到阿呆身边，跟他咬耳朵，问他要不要玩躲猫猫。

阿呆点头答应。

小兽人很高兴，又叫了其他玩得好的小兽人，和其他稍大一些的小兽人脱离，带着阿呆等幼崽跑到另一边玩捉迷藏的游戏。

几个小家伙为了不让小伙伴找到他们，尽往犄角旮旯里藏。

Chapter 91: The First Time (Part 1)

Bu Shuai felt a profound sense of relief in his heart. He had thought he no longer cared about the matters of his first lifetime, considering how long ago they had passed.

Yet... as he pressed a hand against his chest right now, he felt an indescribable lightness, as if a tight shackle bound tightly around his soul had been completely broken open, or as if a layer of filth caked deeply upon his spirit had finally been washed away.

That was not the mere persuasive power of Shang Feifan's words; in some mystical realm, he seemed to have genuinely perceived the ultimate fate of that family.

Perhaps that trace of blood connection had never truly vanished, allowing him to still sense it even after crossing through three lifetimes of souls.

Through this miraculous, indescribable soul-perception, he could also indirectly confirm that Shang Feifan had not lied. He really had helped him reclaim his inheritance, ensuring that his will was executed properly and that the family received the punishment they deserved.

When Shang Feifan described how he had resolved the will dispute and dealt with that family, he made it sound exceptionally breezy and effortless, as if he had barely broken a sweat.

But Bu Shuai was no child. He had personally experienced how difficult and unyielding that family was, and he knew just how troublesome worldly affairs of that sort could be to untangle. Without a certain level of leverage, connections, and wealth, it was simply impossible to deal with them cleanly and decisively, let alone this quickly.

"Do you want to sleep with me?"

"Cough, cough!" Shang Feifan, who was in the middle of drinking water, swallowed it straight down his windpipe, choking violently for quite a while.

Bu Shuai hurriedly patted his back.

Shang Feifan waved a hand to signal he was fine. Once his coughing finally subsided, he looked up at the young beastman.

Bu Shuai did not dodge his gaze, returning it with absolute, calm candor.

Shang Feifan wore a complicated, conflicted expression. "You know, a person like me is all too ready to push his luck. I am no high-principled gentleman with a towering sense of morality. Even if your intention is merely to repay a favor, I will take it as an opening and squeeze every last advantage I can out of you. So, were you serious when you asked that question?"

Hu Bu Shuai was silent for a second, then nodded.

Shang Feifan: "...Since you've struck the match, you're going to have to bear the responsibility. I won't give you a single chance to call it off halfway."

Hu Bu Shuai: "Now?"

Shang Feifan looked up at the sky, leaped up with a start, and exclaimed, "The day is still young! Shall we find a cave, or head out to the wilderness? I brought a full set of camping gear."

Refusing to give himself any room to retreat, Hu Bu Shuai stood up as well. "Let's go to a cave. I know of some that haven't been used in a long time."

Shang Feifan grabbed him by the arm. "Lead the way!"

The two exchanged a brief greeting with Xia Bing and A'dai, then actually followed the mountain path toward the other side of Wind Cave Mountain.

The cave Bu Shuai chose was far from the residential area, located right on the outer periphery. Standing on the mountain path there and looking outward, one could see a sparkling river winding and half-enveloping the Moyue Valley.

The rising sun was a brilliant crimson, casting a vast expanse of rosy clouds across the sky. The colorful glow and the river waters reflected off one another, forming a naturally breathtaking scenery.

"The view here is not bad." Shang Feifan stood at the cave entrance for a while, and he also spotted a massive stretch of farmland dense with flourishing crops.

"Quite a few people used to live around here, but because the winds become much too fierce during both summer and winter, people gradually migrated toward the middle section, leaving all the caves on this side vacant."

Bu Shuai tried pushing the heavy wooden door of a nearby cave. It let out a creaky groan as it pushed open by a crack.

Peeking inside, Bu Shuai said, "Let's use this one."

Shang Feifan felt a strange sensation, as though Bu Shuai was embarking on some sort of sacrificial ritual of self-devotion.

He and Bu Shuai had not spent a short amount of time together, and he understood him quite well by now. He could guess what Bu Shuai was thinking without even needing his brain: it was nothing more than, *You helped me with a massive favor I could never have managed alone, and I don't know how to repay you. Since you have designs on me, I will defer to your wishes and satisfy you.*

He could even perceive another layer of meaning beneath Bu Shuai's actions: *Once you get what you want, perhaps you will have a clearer, more sober realization of who I am, and won't let sexual impulse scramble your thoughts into mistaking it for love.*

To put it bluntly, Bu Shuai still did not believe they could have a lasting future together, nor did he believe that Shang Feifan genuinely liked him—or at least, that his affection was deep enough to sustain a lifetime.

Bu Shuai probably held some degree of romantic interest in him as well; otherwise, he could never have brought himself to make such a sacrificial gesture.

Yet Bu Shuai lacked confidence in himself, believing that once he satisfied him and truly possessed him, Shang Feifan would lose interest, or at least see his enthusiasm plummet drastically.

In other words, Bu Shuai had already prepared himself for the two of them to naturally drift apart once the deed was done.

Would Shang Feifan simply choose to give up because of that?

No! To him, this was the golden opportunity of a lifetime.

He had no patience to slowly grind away at Bu Shuai through agonizingly drawn-out, water-dripping patience.

As an abundantly healthy adult male, to put it without any pretense, every single night he had been agonizingly dreaming of ways to turn Bu Shuai upside down.

Now that the chance to make his fantasies a reality was right in front of him, he'd have to be a fool to let it slip away!

As for love—of course it grows deeper the more you *do* it.

If you don't enjoy the bliss of intimate athletics while you're young, are you supposed to wait until your twilight years to pop little blue pills?

Shang Feifan rushed forward to shove open the poorly greased door hinges, and promptly pushed Bu Shuai right into the interior.

Bu Shuai's face flushed slightly, but he held his ground. Seeing that the cave was thick with dust, he drew his magic wand and cast a Cleansing Spell.

The dust-filled cavern instantly became spotless.

The gathered ball of dust was tossed out of the cave by Bu Shuai with a flick of his wrist.

Over on his side, Shang Feifan had already eagerly whipped out bedding, laying it down layer upon layer on the ground, pressing down on it with his hands to check if it was soft enough.

Bu Shuai closed the cave door, and feeling a bit uneasy, cast an additional magic seal so that outsiders wouldn't be able to push it open.

With everything prepared, Shang Feifan took step after step toward Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai cleared his throat, opened his mouth, but found himself completely at a loss for words.

Shang Feifan grabbed his arm, his voice already growing husky and hoarse. "I'll give you one last chance. You can still open that door and walk out right now."

Bu Shuai stood unmoving.

Shang Feifan leaned in close, lowering his voice. "Your last chance to run away from me... is gone."

Outside the cave, the daylight grew increasingly bright. A blinding white light pierced through the red clouds overhead, the rosy glow vanished, and full morning broke.

The entire Moyue Town bustled with life.

A new year had arrived, and the panic and chaos brought by the previous year's plague had faded into memory as the townsfolk began embracing a fresh life anew.

Patrol guards were still making their rounds, but the elderly and children had reappeared on the streets. Little cubs dashed back and forth across the lanes of the town to play and frolic, occasionally letting out shrill screams and childish roars that brought the entire settlement roaring back to life.

A'dai was also being led around by Xia Bing to play with those little cubs.

A'dai was currently being exceptionally well-cared for; his fur was glossy, smooth, and sleek. Though he still looked somewhat dim-witted, he was entirely endearing, and the little ones of Moyue Town easily accepted this foreign little cub.

Xia Bing squatted by the roadside, chatting idly with the elderly beastmen who were sitting at their doorsteps twisting straw ropes, sewing clothes, and tanning leather.

Though Xia Bing wore a cat-like face, it was wonderfully round and incredibly cute. Moreover, he was glib-tongued and honey-mouthed; not long after arriving in the town, he had already integrated seamlessly with the local beastmen.

If it hadn't been for Shang Feifan's plan to open an alchemy shop and hire him as a clerk, he would have long since taken a job at one of the other shops run by the townspeople, as everyone warmly welcomed him.

Still, he was earning a very generous wage just looking after the kids during this period, so Xia Bing wasn't in any pressing rush for Boss Shang to open his storefront.

A'dai hopped and skipped behind the other little beastmen with clumsy movements. However, he wasn't the only one lagging behind; the few stragglers naturally formed their own little group, babbling away in childish chatter until they slowly grew familiar with one another.

One little beastman scampered up to A'dai, whispering secretively in his ear to ask if he wanted to play hide-and-seek.

A'dai nodded in agreement.

The little beastman was thrilled, calling over several other close-knit playmates. They broke away from the slightly older group of kids and led A'dai and the other tots off to another corner to play a game of hide-and-seek.

To avoid being found by their playmates, the little ones scrambled to hide in every nook and cranny they could find.

阿呆在路边呆站了一会儿，也不知道看到了什么宝藏地点，颠颠地就往那里跑去。

夏冰偶尔抬头，看到小幼崽们还在玩耍，也就没怎么特意盯着阿呆。

镇长依然在治安所工作。

治安官安德烈正在跟他汇报：“林格莱特家族那些兽人还是不肯走。他们已经在这里住了一个半月，就靠在荒原和在莫约山打猎为生。虽说他们人数不多，对我们镇子的生计还造成不了太大影响，但他们赖在这里不走，引得其他流浪兽人也会留下来。”

狼四也跟着说：“是啊，我们好不容易才把混乱区给清理干净。可林格莱特家族这样做，要不了多久围着他们就要形成新的混乱区。而且这次他们还堵在荒原上。就因为他们，镇子上的猎人已经没办法在附近就猎到猎物，很多猎物都被惊得远离了这一片。”

镇长苦恼：“他们要见我夫人，我夫人也去见他们了。可他们就是不走，我能怎么办？”

安德烈和狼四互视，狼四轻轻点了点头。

安德烈心中有数了，开口：“如果迪莉娅夫人不介意，我建议我们可以用武力手段强行赶他们离开。之前的混乱区就是老镇长一时心软造成，已有前车之鉴，我们总不能再重蹈覆辙。”

镇长曲起手指敲敲额头：“我等会儿再去找他们谈谈，如果林格莱特家族的人真的给脸不要脸，那该怎么做就怎么做。”

安德烈脸上露出喜色，镇子上的人烦那群人很久了，要不是顾忌他们是迪莉娅夫人的亲戚，他们早就动手赶人。

“对了，今天你们有没有看到不帅？”镇长平时都能在治安所看到这个外甥，不帅做事细心认真，话不多说能力却强，不少队伍都抢着要他。

镇长有很多事也习惯交代给这个外甥去做，他现在手头正好有些事，需要不帅跑腿，但他早上到了治安所却没有看到不帅。

安德烈和狼四一起摇头。

“今天就没看到不帅少爷，可能有什么事耽搁了吧。”狼四说。

安德烈也说：“他的巡逻队工作已经结束，我暂时还没有给他安排新工作，可能他去办自己的事了。”

“要去找不帅少爷吗？”狼四问。

镇长想了想，“事情不急，不用特意寻找。等会儿你们看到不帅，就跟他说，他小姨有事找他。”

狼四和安德烈记下。

下午三点多，位于风洞山尽头的一个山洞内。

商非凡坐起身，盯着身边睡得沉沉的年轻兽人看了好一会儿。

不帅一脸疲累，一副被折腾惨的可怜模样。

商非凡忍不住附身亲了亲他，又亲了亲。

不帅不堪骚扰地抓起被子盖住头脸，整个人都躲进了被子中。

商非凡忍不住笑。轻轻摸了摸不帅露出的一点短发，轻轻掀开被子起身。

他饿了。

想必不帅醒来也会很饿，他得多做点好吃的，再做一点补身体的汤水。

商非凡也没有回去不帅住的那个山洞，他就在这个山洞门口找到了还没有被山风完全摧毁的厨房，利用里面的灶台，开始点火做饭。

灶台不太好用，还需要干草和干柴当燃料，但胜在做出来的饭菜味道有一股特别的柴禾香。

商非凡在雕像广场堆了很多乱七八糟的东西，反正地方大，他看到什么都会收集一些，就连干柴和干草他也堆了不少。

其他油盐酱醋等调料也一应俱全，各种食材更是储备丰富。

就连食用水他都准备了几大桶，完全不用他现跑到河道去打水。

所以有个空间就是方便啊。

说到空间，商非凡就想到上次系统奖励给他的空间储物工具全套炼制方法，因为这段时间太忙，他到现在都还没上手炼制，不过相应材料他已经开始收集。

有些材料不好弄到手的，他打算从游戏商城里购买。

他非常想要给不帅做一个空间储物工具，戒指最好！

如今这个想法更是膨胀到了极点。

他恨不得在不帅等会儿睡醒时，就手捧一个超大空间的戒指，一脸不经意地塞给他，说你拿着随便玩。

不帅是被一股诱人肺腑的香味给催醒的。

刚要坐起身，他就重新跌回厚软的铺盖上。

不帅满脸通红。

过了好一会儿，他才再一次慢慢坐起。

这次他能坐稳了，也重新感觉到自己的四肢和躯干。

他不好意思看自己身体都变成什么样，看到铺盖边堆放得整整齐齐的衣服，立刻拿起来穿戴。

他还记得他的衣服被撕扯得满地都是，现在这些衣服鞋袜看起来都好好的，应该是商非凡给他重新准备了一套。

还有他身上是不是被上了药，总觉得……

不帅不小心就想到一些画面，脸颊再次爆红，他用力拍了拍自己的脸，告诉自己要淡定。

不过商非凡这家伙是真的猛啊。

也不知道是不是兽人的缘故，其体力、精力、花样……简直颠覆他从前积累的所有认知。

不帅穿戴好站起，发现铺盖的上一层也被换过了。

怪不得他睡起来温暖又干燥，很舒服。

没看出来商非凡竟然这么会照顾人，他以为那人会很粗放。

而这种生活上的小细心和小体贴，也特别容易打动人。

虎不帅不想做对比，但是……

洛伦米尔顿算得上温柔体贴，但更多的是在嘴巴上。

奥尔，那就是小孩子性子，被他照顾得更多。

商非凡嘴巴最花，逗他最多，看起来最不正经，也不像是值得依靠的人。

但就是这个人反而做得更多，也最为他着想，虽然对方霸道的时候也特别霸道……

虎不帅用力摇头，想要把这些乱七八糟的想法都摇出去。

结果把自己摇晕了，捧着脑袋站在那里摇摇晃晃。

大门打开，商非凡走进来，看到不帅的姿势就笑起来。

“宝贝，你这是怎么了？头晕吗？”

不帅脸红，不好意思地放下手，严肃脸：“不要乱喊，我有名字。”

“好好好，你想我叫你什么都行。”商非凡好笑地捧住他的脸，用拇指帮他按压太阳穴，“有没有好一点？”

不帅被这宠溺的亲密搞得手足无措，往后退了一步，连连摆手：“没事没事，我很好。”

商非凡拉住他的手，不让他躲，“要不要洗漱？我给你准备。”

“不用，我回去我的洞屋。”

“那就等吃过饭再回去。我把饭菜都做好了。你等着。”

商非凡说完就拿出一张桌子，把他先前做好的几道菜都从雕像广场拿出来，摆上桌。又跑出去把放在灶台上炖着的补身汤给盛出来，端进洞屋。

不帅总觉得不洗漱就吃饭不好，但商非凡拉着他不让他走。

“就一次，没什么的。吃过再洗漱，一样。乖，坐下。”

商非凡拿出椅子，放到不帅身后。

虎不帅脸颊红得不像话，他越想要自然，越是尴尬。

“吃饭！”

“哦。”不帅坐下。

商非凡也不说话，给不帅准备好碗筷，给他盛好一碗汤，自己端着饭碗就大口吃起来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 91: The First Time (Part 2)

A'dai stood blankly by the roadside for a little while, then, as if spotting some treasure-trove location, scampered off with waddling steps.

Xia Bing occasionally looked up and saw that the little cubs were still playing, so he didn't keep a particularly close eye on A'dai.

The town mayor was still hard at work in the security office.

Chief Inspector Andre was reporting to him: "Those beastmen from the Lingreit family still refuse to leave. They've been staying here for a month and a half, surviving solely by scavenging in the wasteland and hunting on Moyue Mountain. Though their numbers aren't large and they don't cause an overwhelming impact on our town's livelihood, their stubborn squatting is setting a precedent that draws other wandering beastmen to linger as well."

Wolf Four chimed in as well: "Indeed. It took us immense effort to clear out the chaotic district. If the Lingreit family keeps this up, it won't be long before a new chaotic zone forms around them. Furthermore, this time they've blockaded the wasteland itself. Because of them, the town's hunters can no longer bag prey nearby; many game animals have been scared off and driven far away from this area."

The mayor sighed in frustration: "They demanded to see my wife, and my wife went to see them. But they simply refuse to budge. What can I do?"

Andre and Wolf Four exchanged glances, and Wolf Four nodded gently.

Understanding flashed in Andre's eyes, and he spoke up: "If Madam Delia doesn't mind, I suggest we use force to drive them out. The previous chaotic district was caused by the former mayor's momentary softness of heart—with that precedent before us, we certainly cannot afford to repeat the same mistake."

The mayor tapped his forehead with a curled finger. "I'll go talk to them again later. If those people from the Lingreit family really refuse to show basic courtesy, then we'll do whatever needs to be done."

Joy flickered across Andre's face. The townspeople had been thoroughly sick of that bunch for a long time; if not out of consideration that they were Madam Delia's relatives, they would have long since mobilized to chase them off.

"By the way, have either of you seen Bu Shuai today?" Normally, the mayor could always find his nephew at the security office. Bu Shuai was thorough and conscientious in his work, quiet in speech yet remarkably capable, and many teams fought over his services.

The mayor was accustomed to delegating various tasks to this nephew, and right now he happened to have some errands that required Bu Shuai's legwork. Yet upon arriving at the security office this morning, Bu Shuai was nowhere to be seen.

Andre and Wolf Four shook their heads in unison.

"I haven't laid eyes on Bu Shuai all day today. He might have been delayed by something," Wolf Four said.

Andre also added: "His patrol team duties have concluded, and I haven't assigned him any new tasks yet. Perhaps he went off to handle some personal business."

"Should we go look for Young Master Bu Shuai?" Wolf Four asked.

The mayor pondered for a moment. "It's nothing urgent; no need to go out of your way to search for him. If you happen to run into him later, just tell him his aunt is looking for him."

Wolf Four and Andre noted it down.

At a little past three in the afternoon, inside a cave located at the far end of Wind Cave Mountain.

Shang Feifan sat up, staring intently at the young beastman sleeping soundly beside him for quite a while.

Bu Shuai wore an expression of utter exhaustion, looking thoroughly pitied and thoroughly wrecked.

Unable to resist, Shang Feifan leaned down and kissed him—once, and then again.

Unable to tolerate the endless disturbance, Bu Shuai grabbed the quilt to cover his head and face, retreating entirely beneath the covers.

Shang Feifan couldn't help chuckling. He gently stroked a tuft of short hair poking out from Bu Shuai's cover, delicately lifted the blanket, and sat up.

He was hungry.

Presumably, Bu Shuai would also be starving when he woke up, so he needed to whip up something delicious and brew a nourishing soup to restore his vitality.

Shang Feifan didn't bother returning to the cave where Bu Shuai usually lived. Right outside the entrance of this very cave, he found a kitchen area that hadn't been completely destroyed by the mountain winds. Utilizing the stone stove there, he started a fire to cook.

The stove was somewhat finicky and required dry grass and firewood as fuel, but its greatest charm was that the food cooked on it carried a distinct, rustic aroma of burning wood.

Shang Feifan had stockpiled all sorts of miscellaneous junk in the Statue Plaza anyway; since space was vast, he tended to collect a bit of everything he laid eyes on, and he had stashed away plenty of firewood and dry grass.

Other basic seasonings like oil, salt, soy sauce, and vinegar were fully stocked as well, alongside an abundant reserve of various ingredients.

He had even prepared several large casks of drinking water, sparing him the trouble of running down to the river to haul water himself.

Ah, having a spatial storage item really was convenient.

Speaking of spatial storage, Shang Feifan thought of the complete set of spatial storage artifact crafting methods the system had rewarded him with last time. Because he had been so terribly busy lately, he hadn't gotten around to crafting any yet, though he had already begun gathering the corresponding materials.

As for the materials that were difficult to procure, he intended to purchase them directly from the game mall.

He desperately wanted to craft a spatial storage artifact for Bu Shuai—a ring would be best!

Right now, that urge had ballooned to its absolute peak.

He could hardly wait until Bu Shuai woke up later, so he could casually pull out a ring with ultra-large spatial capacity, slide it into his hand with an indifferent expression, and tell him to take it and play with it however he pleased.

Bu Shuai was jolted awake by an intoxicating, soul-stirring aroma.

The moment he tried to sit up, however, he collapsed right back down onto the thick, soft bedding.

Bu Shuai's face burned crimson.

It took him quite a while before he slowly managed to sit up once more.

This time, he managed to steady himself and regain sensation in his limbs and torso.

Too embarrassed to check the state of his own body, he spotted the neatly folded clothes piled by the edge of the bedding and immediately picked them up to put them on.

He vaguely remembered his clothes being torn to shreds and scattered all over the floor, but now these garments, shoes, and socks looked completely intact—Shang Feifan must have prepared a fresh set for him.

And had medicine been applied to his body as well? He felt a strange sort of...

Without meaning to, Bu Shuai's mind flashed back to certain vivid scenes, and his cheeks flared red hot once more. He slammed a hand against his face, telling himself to remain calm.

Still, that fellow Shang Feifan was truly a beast in the sheets.

Whether it was due to his beastman heritage or not, his stamina, energy, and sheer variety of tricks... completely subverted every cognitive notion Bu Shuai had ever accumulated.

Dressing and standing up, Bu Shuai discovered that the top layer of the bedding had also been replaced.

No wonder he had felt so warm, dry, and comfortable while sleeping.

He wouldn't have guessed that Shang Feifan could be so attentive when caring for others; he had assumed the man would be utterly rough and unrefined.

And such small, thoughtful acts of domestic consideration were devastatingly easy to touch a person's heart.

Hu Bu Shuai didn't want to make comparisons, but...

Loren Milton could be considered gentle and considerate, but most of it was just sweet talk.

Oarl had the temperament of a child, and required far more care from him than the other way around.

Shang Feifan had the slickest tongue, teased him the most, looked the least serious, and seemed the least reliable of all.

Yet it was this very man who took action the most, considered things most thoroughly for his sake, even if he could be exceptionally overbearing when he wanted to be...

Hu Bu Shuai shook his head hard, trying to rattle all these messy thoughts right out of his skull.

As a result, he ended up making himself dizzy, standing there swaying while clutching his head.

The door swung open, and Shang Feifan walked in. Seeing Bu Shuai's posture, he burst into laughter.

"Baby, what's wrong with you? Feeling dizzy?"

Blushing, Bu Shuai dropped his hand with an embarrassed expression and put on a stern face. "Don't call me random nicknames, I have a name."

"Alright, alright, alright. You can have me call you whatever you want." Amused, Shang Feifan cupped his face and massaged his temples with his thumbs. "Feeling any better?"

Completely flustered by this doting intimacy, Bu Shuai took a step back and waved his hands repeatedly. "No, no, I'm fine."

Shang Feifan grabbed his hand to stop him from dodging. "Need to wash up? I've got it ready for you."

"No need, I'll go back to my own cave dwelling."

"Then wait until we've eaten before you go back. I've finished cooking everything. Just wait."

With that, Shang Feifan pulled out a table, retrieved the dishes he had previously prepared from the Statue Plaza, and set them out. Then he ran outside, scooped up the nourishing soup simmering on the stove, and brought it into the cave room.

Bu Shuai felt it was improper to eat without washing up first, but Shang Feifan grabbed him and refused to let him leave.

"Just this once, it's no big deal. Eat first and wash up later, it's all the same. Be a good boy and sit down."

Shang Feifan produced a chair and placed it right behind Bu Shuai.

Hu Bu Shuai's cheeks were flushed an impossible shade of red; the harder he tried to act natural, the more awkward he felt.

"Let's eat!"

"Oh." Bu Shuai sat down.

Without speaking further, Shang Feifan handed Bu Shuai his bowl and chopsticks, ladled him a bowl of soup, filled his own rice bowl, and dug in with gusto.

chunks.chineseText:
不帅看他吃得香，人也逐渐放松，拿起了筷子。

两人就没说话，就闷头吃。

不帅知道商非凡手艺好，但今天的饭菜吃起来似乎味道更佳，尤其那汤，不知道是什么炖煮出来的，喝起来清淡，喝到肚里却暖洋洋的。

“之前我看到巡逻队的人，狼四叔也在，他问我有没有看到你，我说你有点事要办，傍晚回来。他让我转告你，等你回来后就去找迪莉娅夫人，似乎那位夫人有什么事要找你说。”商非凡见不帅不再那么别扭，这才开口说话。

不帅听到狼四叔问起他，立刻紧张起来，握着筷子的手指都僵直了。等到商非凡说他出去办事，才又放松下来。

“好，我等会就去。”

“我和你一起。”

不帅想拒绝，但商非凡根本不给他拒绝的机会，他一开口，他就给他夹菜盛汤，还问他身体有没有哪里不舒服。

不帅被搞得面红耳赤，他都不记得自己是什么时候吃好，又是什么时候回去洗漱，之后又是怎么被拉上狰爷的背脊，总之稀里糊涂地就被商非凡拉着一起去见迪莉娅夫人了。

Chapter 91: The First Time (Part 3)

Seeing how heartily Shang Feifan was eating, Bu Shuai gradually relaxed and picked up his own chopsticks.

Bu Shuai knew Shang Feifan was a talented cook, but today's meal tasted even better than usual. Especially the soup—he had no idea what ingredients had been boiled into it, but it tasted light yet left a warm, cozy sensation spreading through his belly as it went down.

"Earlier, when I saw the patrol team members, Uncle Wolf Four was among them. He asked if I'd seen you, and I told him you had some business to attend to and would return by evening. He asked me to pass along a message: as soon as you get back, go see Madam Delia. It seems that lady has something she wants to discuss with you." Seeing that Bu Shuai was no longer so uptight, Shang Feifan finally spoke.

Hearing that Uncle Wolf Four had asked about him, Bu Shuai immediately tensed up, his fingers gripping his chopsticks growing rigid. Only when Shang Feifan mentioned he had told them he was out on business did he relax again.

"Alright, I'll go see her shortly."

"I'm coming with you."

Bu Shuai wanted to refuse, but Shang Feifan gave him no room for refusal whatsoever. The moment Bu Shuai opened his mouth, he simply scooped food into his bowl and ladled him soup, while asking if his body felt any discomfort anywhere.

Bu Shuai was tormented into a state of glowing scarlet embarrassment. He couldn't even remember when he finished eating, when he went back to wash up, or how he ended up being hoisted onto the back of the zheng beast—in short, in a state of utter bewilderment, he found himself dragged off by Shang Feifan to see Madam Delia.

chunks.chineseText:
第92章 小姨你好

不帅始终感到身体有点异样，就算他悄悄给自己施展了恢复魔法，也总觉得哪哪都不对劲。

可能是做贼心虚吧？

面对迪莉娅夫人那犀利地似乎能看破一切的眼神，不帅在软椅上微微挪动臀部，想换个更自然更舒适的坐姿。

一只手伸到他腰后，自然撑住他的腰背。

不帅腰背猛地挺直，右手则偷偷按住那只伸到他腰后的手，示意赶紧挪开。

迪莉娅夫人眯眼看着对面坐着的两人，说到一半的讽刺话说不下去了。

这两年轻人怎么回事？

为什么看起来比之前更黏糊？

她那不喜欢亲近人的外甥竟然让那姓商的雄性兽人靠那么近？两人都快贴一起了！

同性坐这么近其实也没什么，很多好兄弟好朋友黏糊起来比情侣还要黏糊。

但氛围不对！

尤其是那个叫商非凡的家伙，他的眼睛几乎黏在她外甥身上，那手啊脚啊也总是想往她外甥身上蹭。

还有她外甥，既不排斥商非凡的靠近，可又对商非凡的动作极为敏感。

迪莉娅的目光在两人身上扫过来扫过去。

商非凡一脸坦然地任她打量，他的注意力就如迪莉娅所感，几乎都放在不帅身上。

他能感觉到不帅的不自然，以为他身体不舒服，就很后悔同意让不帅来见迪莉娅夫人，就应该让不帅好好休息到明天再说。

因为是第一次，他就很是收着力，没怎么下死劲折腾不帅，怕把对方吓跑。

不帅很能忍，不到痛苦难耐，几乎不会发出声音，嘴唇都要咬破，看得他心疼得要死，但心里同时又涌起非常可怕的摧毁欲-望，想要把不帅给欺负到变成破娃娃。

天知道他忍得多辛苦，不过后来他好像是有点刹不住，他好像听到不帅的求饶声……

打住！商非凡深呼吸，不能再继续深想。他可不想在不帅的亲人并且是长辈面前出丑。

商非凡调整了下坐姿。

迪莉娅夫人：“……”

日他姥姥的！她眼睛都要瞎了！

这两只要是没问题，她把自己的眼睛抠出来！

而且只看这两人的体型和性格，也知道谁是被欺负的一方。

就是不知道姓商的王八蛋有没有得手？

迪莉娅夫人不确定，但看外甥那故意挺直的腰背、还有那故作淡然的神色，越想越觉得两人已经发生什么，越想越生气。

“你和这小子睡了？”

轰！虎不帅的脸色爆红，他虽然控制住自己的神情没有变化，但那爆红的脸颊已经告诉迪莉娅答案。

迪莉娅夫人眼神特别阴暗地看向商非凡。

商非凡握住了不帅的手。

不帅想要挣脱，被死死握住。

商非凡神色平静又坦然地看向迪莉娅夫人：“您让我们过来，除了讽刺我们，和询问我们的隐私，还有什么事要吩咐吗？如果没事的话，我和不帅打算回去休息了。”

虎不帅咬牙，暗瞪商非凡：为什么要说得这么暧昧？还有，给我放开你的爪子！

商非凡不放。

迪莉娅夫人单手撑住额头，忽然发出不屑的冷笑：“别那么紧张，老娘什么没见过。不过就是和同性睡一觉，有什么大不了的。”

迪莉娅夫人抬起空着的手，手指点了点商非凡，厌恶道：“别用拥有所有物的姿态霸占我的外甥。”

迪莉娅又指向自己外甥：“睡了就睡了，别一副天塌下来的模样。这世上别的不多，雄性兽人大把抓，很多地方缺雌性，雄性都只能搭伙过日子。看在你是我外甥的份上，给你一个忠告，对这种雄性兽人，别太认真，玩玩就算，腻了就换。记住了？”

虎不帅：“……”

商非凡：“小姨，你能不能教一些好的？”

迪莉娅瞪眼：“你乱喊什么！谁允许你叫我小姨？”

商非凡耸耸肩：“这是尊称，谁让你是不帅的小姨。或者你更愿意我叫你镇长夫人？”

迪莉娅皱眉，对外甥说：“这种不太听话，我建议你赶紧换一个，免得被坑。”

虎不帅已经木了。

他活了三世都不如这两人脸皮厚。

随他们去吧，他就当没听到好了。

“这话我很想也对镇长说，俗话说家有贤妻万事不愁，但就小姨你这个性格，是真坑啊。”

“你这个虫日的杂种！老娘看到你第一眼就知道你不是什么好东西！赶紧给我滚出莫约镇！”

“你真以为你是女王，莫约镇就是你的地盘？你不是很小就离开家族了吗？到底是怎么养出来的一身公主病？”

“你的诅咒术是跟谁学的？你怎么可能在短时间内就掌握诅咒术？还有你到底是活人还是活死人？别把你身上的活死人病毒传给我外甥！”

“那不可能。我也不是活死人，我不信你看不出来。”

迪莉娅夫人和商非凡针锋相对，两人你来我往口头交锋了好几句。

但两人都不约而同避开提及不帅，只互相讽刺。

虎不帅想要捂住耳朵，这两人越说越恶毒，都开始互相攻击人身。

但攻击着攻击着，这两人竟然又开始聊起正事。

虎不帅：“……”

他真心觉得他的三世人生阅历还是太少了。

“你喊我们过来，是不是和外面那群林格莱特家族有关？”商非凡冷不丁问。

迪莉娅微微坐直身体：“对。他们一直不肯走，哪怕我去见他们，他们也依然找借口拖着不肯离开。一开始我以为他们只是死皮赖脸，但……”

“您感到有什么地方不对劲？”

迪莉娅轻哼，手指点了点椅子扶手：“他们一来，我就让狼守派人去林格莱特家族农庄打探，最近他们刚传回消息，林格莱特家族的农庄确实被其他人占领了，占领者是上一代家主的小女儿嫁过去的夫家。”

虎不帅听两人说起正事，也回过神细听。

商非凡摆出让迪莉娅夫人详细述说的架势。

迪莉娅看了眼外甥，继续：“但据我所知，那家人势力和林格莱特家族差不多，只是一个小贵族家的普通亲戚，仗着那个小贵族庇护守着自己家的一小片地盘。就算结合那个小贵族的势力，那家人想要拿下林格莱特家族的农庄也不容易。”

“因为盯着林格莱特家族农庄的人不止一个，可林格莱特靠嫁女儿维持了一张关系网，这张关系网上的人都想得到农庄，反而互相忌惮，形成了一个微妙的平衡。”

“如果那家人动手，就算是打破平衡，其他家必然也要跟着分一杯羹，绝不会让那家人独占好处。”

“可现在的情况却是那家人把林格莱特家族赶出农庄，他们稳妥地占了下来。”

“这只能说明一个可能。”

迪莉娅竖起一根手指：“那家人必然找上了更强大的靠山，或者说有权势地位更强大的大贵族出现，指使那家人出面占领农庄，而其他家都听到了风声，或干脆就收到了警告。”

商非凡听到这里插话：“那你们有跟其他家打听过消息吗？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 92: Hello, Auntie (Part 1)

Bu Shuai always felt a strange sensation lingering in his body. Even though he had quietly cast a recovery spell on himself, everything still felt somehow out of place.

Could it be the guilty conscience of a thief?

Facing Madame Delia’s sharp gaze, which seemed capable of seeing through everything, Bu Shuai shifted his hips slightly on the soft armchair, trying to find a more natural and comfortable posture.

A hand reached out behind his waist, naturally supporting his lower back and spine.

Bu Shuai’s back stiffened abruptly, and his right hand stealthily pressed down on the hand resting against his lower back, signaling it to move away immediately.

Madame Delia squinted at the two people sitting across from her, the sarcastic words halfway out of her mouth cutting off abruptly.

What on earth was going on with these two youngsters?

Why did they look even more clingy than before?

That nephew of hers, who usually disliked physical proximity with anyone, was actually letting that male beastman surnamed Shang lean in so close? The two of them were practically glued together!

There was nothing inherently wrong with people of the same sex sitting close; plenty of good brothers and close friends could be clingier than actual lovers.

But the atmosphere was all wrong!

Especially that fellow named Shang Feifan—his eyes were practically glued to her nephew, and his hands and feet kept trying to brush against her nephew as well.

And her nephew—while he didn't actively repel Shang Feifan's approach, he was acutely sensitive to every single movement Shang Feifan made.

Delia’s gaze swept back and forth across the two of them.

Shang Feifan accepted her scrutiny with a completely calm and unruffled expression. Just as Delia sensed, practically the entirety of his attention was focused on Bu Shuai.

He could sense Bu Shuai’s unnatural stiffness and assumed the other man was feeling physically unwell. He now deeply regretted agreeing to let Bu Shuai come and see Madame Delia; he should have just let Bu Shuai rest properly until tomorrow instead.

Because it was their first time, he had restrained his strength quite a bit, trying not to torture Bu Shuai too harshly for fear of startling the other man away.

Yet Bu Shuai had endured with incredible fortitude; unless the pain became truly unbearable, he hardly made a sound, almost biting through his lips in the process. The sight of it made Shang Feifan's heart ache fiercely, yet it simultaneously stirred a terrifying urge within him to bully Bu Shuai until he became like a broken doll.

Heaven knew how hard he had exercised self-restraint. Though later on, he seemed to have lost control a little bit, and he fancied he had heard Bu Shuai begging for mercy...

*Stop right there!* Shang Feifan took a deep breath, refusing to let his thoughts wander any further. He certainly didn't want to make a fool of himself in front of Bu Shuai’s blood relative, especially an elder.

Shang Feifan adjusted his sitting posture.

Madame Delia: "..."

*What in the world!* Her eyes were practically going blind!

If these two had nothing going on between them, she would gouge out her own eyes!

Furthermore, just looking at the physical builds and personalities of the two men, it was painfully obvious who the one being bullied was.

She just wondered if that bastard surnamed Shang had already succeeded?

Madame Delia wasn't entirely certain, but looking at her nephew's deliberately straightened back and his feigned nonchalance, the more she thought about it, the more convinced she became that something had already happened between them—and the angrier she felt.

"Did you sleep with this punk?"

*Boom!* Hu Bu Shuai’s face flushed a brilliant crimson. Although he managed to keep his expression from cracking, the violently blushing cheeks already gave the answer away to Delia.

Madame Delia shot a remarkably sinister look at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan reached out and grasped Bu Shuai’s hand.

Bu Shuai tried to pull away, but his hand was held fast.

With a calm and collected expression, Shang Feifan looked directly at Madame Delia. "Since you had us summoned here, apart from mocking us and prying into our private lives, is there anything else you need to instruct us on? If not, Bu Shuai and I plan to head back and rest."

Hu Bu Shuai gritted his teeth, glaring sideways at Shang Feifan: *Why did you have to phrase it in such an ambiguous way? And besides, let go of your claws!*

Shang Feifan refused to let go.

Madame Delia propped her forehead with one hand, suddenly letting out a disdainful, cold chuckle. "Don't be so nervous; there's nothing this old lady hasn't seen. Sleeping with someone of the same sex—what's the big deal?"

Madame Delia lifted her free hand, pointing a finger at Shang Feifan with a look of disgust. "Don't you dare use the posture of an owner trying to dominate my nephew."

Delia then pointed at her nephew. "You slept with him, so you slept with him; stop looking like the sky is falling. There's no shortage of things in this world, but male beastmen are a dime a dozen. In many places where females are scarce, males simply pair up to get by. For the sake of you being my nephew, I'll give you a piece of advice: don't take this kind of male beastman too seriously. Just play around with him, and dump him when you get tired of it. Understood?"

Hu Bu Shuai: "..."

Shang Feifan: "Auntie, can't you teach him something wholesome?"

Delia glared. "Who are you randomly addressing? Who gave you permission to call me Auntie?"

Shang Feifan shrugged. "It's a respectful form of address. Who asked you to be Bu Shuai's aunt? Or would you prefer I call you the Mayor's Wife?"

Delia frowned, turning to her nephew. "This one's a bit disobedient. I suggest you swap him out for a new one immediately, lest you get scammed."

Hu Bu Shuai had already gone numb.

His life experience across three lifetimes didn't even match the sheer thickness of these two people's facial skin.

Let them be; he'd just pretend he hadn't heard a thing.

"I'd love to say those exact words to the mayor as well. As the saying goes, 'with a virtuous wife at home, a man has nothing to worry about,' but with your personality, Auntie, you really are a hazard."

"You insect-spawned bastard! The moment I laid eyes on you, I knew you weren't anything good! Get the hell out of Moye Town right now!"

"Do you honestly think you're a queen and Moye Town is your personal kingdom? Didn't you leave your family at a very young age? Exactly how did you manage to cultivate such a severe case of princess syndrome?"

"Who on earth taught you curse arts? How could you possibly master curse arts in such a short period of time? And are you a living person or a living corpse? Don't you dare pass the living corpse virus from your body onto my nephew!"

"That's impossible. I'm not a living corpse either; I refuse to believe you couldn't tell."

Madame Delia and Shang Feifan went tit-for-tat, exchanging several rounds of sharp, verbal blows.

Yet, both of them tacitly avoided mentioning Bu Shuai, choosing instead to hurl insults solely at each other.

Hu Bu Shuai wanted to cover his ears; the things these two were saying were becoming increasingly vicious, and they had even started launching personal attacks.

Yet, amidst all the mutual attacks, the two of them abruptly pivoted back to serious business.

Hu Bu Shuai: "..."

He genuinely felt that his three lifetimes of worldly experience were still far too lacking.

"You called us over—does this have anything to do with that group of the Linglet family outside?" Shang Feifan asked out of the blue.

Delia sat up slightly straighter. "Yes. They refuse to leave. Even when I went out to see them, they still kept finding excuses to stall and refused to depart. At first, I thought they were just being utterly shameless, but..."

"You sensed something was amiss?"

Delia let out a soft hum, tapping her fingers against the armrest of her chair. "The moment they arrived, I had Lang Shou send people to investigate the Linglet family's estate. News just came back recently: the Linglet family's estate has indeed been seized by outsiders. The occupiers are the husband's family whom the previous family head's youngest daughter married into."

Hearing the two of them discuss serious business, Hu Bu Shuai pulled himself together and listened intently.

Shang Feifan struck a pose, signaling Madame Delia to elaborate with the full details.

Delia glanced at her nephew and continued, "But as far as I know, that family's influence is on par with the Linglets—just ordinary relatives of a minor noble family who rely on that minor noble's protection to guard their tiny patch of land. Even combined with that minor noble's faction, it wouldn't be easy for that family to take down the Linglet estate."

"Because there isn't just one party eyeing the Linglet family's estate. The Linglets maintained a web of connections through marrying off their daughters, and everyone within this network wanted to get their hands on the estate. Instead, they kept each other in check, forming a delicate balance."

"If that family made a move, it would shatter the balance. The other families would inevitably demand a cut of the spoils and would never allow that family to monopolize the benefits."

"Yet the current situation is that that family successfully drove the Linglets out of the estate and occupied it securely."

"This points to only one possibility."

Delia raised a single finger. "That family must have sought out a more powerful backer—or rather, a high-ranking noble with far greater power and status emerged, directing that family to step forward and seize the estate, while all the other families caught wind of it or received a direct warning."

Hearing this, Shang Feifan interjected, "Have you guys asked around with the other families for any information?"

chunks.chineseText:
迪莉娅哼：“我和不帅母亲早就和林格莱特家族不联系，他们家嫁出去的女儿和我们也没有关系，我们要跟谁打听？但狼守派出的人很能干，他收买了几家人的家仆，旁敲侧击出来一点消息。”

迪莉娅一顿：“在同一个月中，这几家都有大人物联络，有的是有人亲自过来，有的是只送来一封信。收到信件的那家家仆正好是当时的接信人，他说送信者不是普通邮差，而是一看就是贵族富豪家的护卫，对方专程送信过来，送到就走，连门都没进。他问过对方，对方说还有几封信要送。”

商非凡思索：“看来对方无意隐瞒。”

迪莉娅点头：“我觉得也是。”

商非凡想到一个可能，看向迪莉娅：“所以您觉得林格莱特家族跑来这里，不一定是走投无路，而是被遣派过来？”

“如果没有不帅，我还不会多想。但不帅在这里，他的身份……永远都是一个问题。”迪莉娅再次看向外甥。

虎不帅回以歉疚的眼神。

迪莉娅夫人翻了个白眼，只跟商非凡说：“原本我想跟不帅交代，但这小子有时候死脑筋，会把事情都往自己身上揽。既然你也来了，那你也听听吧，看这事要怎么处理最好。”

商非凡：“您说。不帅的事就是我的事。”

迪莉娅压根不信商非凡能帮到外甥，只是觉得这家伙满腹坏水，看问题角度也更广，说不定就有什么鬼主意或找出什么漏洞，就还是说道：“狼守还在让人打听那大人物到底是谁，但我已经对对方身份有所猜测。”

“黑森林城主？”商非凡脱口道。

迪莉娅挑眉：“为什么这么猜？”

商非凡给不帅身后塞了个靠枕，让他放松身体，不在意地说：“这很好猜。如果当初对你们父母动手的人真的和王后有关，那么在对方没有达成目的前，王后应该不会轻易放过你们。”

“不帅母亲安妮塔夫人跑到王城，成为虎王的情-妇，还生下不帅。如果王后不知道她的身份也就罢了，如果知道，为什么能容忍到现在？”

“哦，也许她并没有容忍，所以安妮塔夫人死了，不帅也差点死掉，现在更被迫离开王城。”

“现在的问题是，这么多年下来，王后到底有没有达成目的，或者该问她想要的到底是什么？”

迪莉娅接口：“假设现在夺下林格莱特家农庄的背后人就是王后相关者，他们已经拿到林格莱特家的农庄，所以他们要的并不是那片可耕种土地。”

“不会是农庄。”商非凡摇头，“只是一座农庄，不用王后出面，只要黑森林城主想要，林格莱特家族敢不给？”

“所以他们到底想要什么？”迪莉娅也不禁皱眉。

虎不帅忽然看向商非凡。

商非凡心脏一跳，想到一物。

王后或者说黑森林城主想要的东西会是自然之神的那只耳朵吗？

虎不帅脑中思绪飞转，下定决心，转向迪莉娅夫人：“小姨，您和我母亲离开林格莱特家族时，有带走什么东西吗？”

“嗯？什么意思？你在怀疑什么？”迪莉娅夫人眯眼。

虎不帅看向商非凡。

商非凡对他点头。迪莉娅虽然性格恶劣，但对外甥也是真心，可相信。

何况自然之神的耳朵已经回归自然之神雕像，就算有人想要从不帅身上夺取，也拿不到。

迪莉娅看到两人眼神，心中不爽，她和外甥不亲不错，但外甥更相信一个刚认识半年的人这点，让她这个当小姨的还是有点伤心。

“小姨，不知道我母亲有没有跟您说过，在六年前，我曾经差一点死掉。”

“嗯，听过这件事。据说还是你的好友害的是吧？”

不帅摇头：“六年前不是，一年前的才是。我遭到两次谋害，第一次在六年前，那次我差点死掉。第二次在一年前，我受伤但没有生命危险，但不久后我母亲就去世了。”

不帅神色黯然。

他的亲人缘真的非常浅薄，三世都是如此。

商非凡也是第一次听不帅提到过去的事情，听得很认真。

不帅继续说道：“六年前那次，我母亲为了救活我，付出了很大代价，她在我心脏里放入了一个……宝贝。”

迪莉娅夫人坐直身体，神色严肃：“什么宝贝？”

不帅：“一个耳朵。”

“耳朵？”迪莉娅夫人深深皱起眉头：“我不知道，安妮塔从来没有跟我说过。”

“那你们离开家族时有没有带走什么东西？或者你们小时候，你们父母有没有交给你们什么东西？”商非凡插话问。

迪莉娅夫人按住额头，似乎在回忆，过了好一会儿才说道：“安妮塔是姐姐，性格比我沉稳得多，从小爸爸妈妈都更相信她，我也依赖着安妮塔。如果他们有什么东西要交给我们保管，他们确实会选择安妮塔，而不是我。”

但什么都不告诉她，安妮塔也没跟她透露半点内容，这就有点过分了。

“我们走的时候，带走的东西不多，只有一些衣物，我父母遗留的一点钱财，和我母亲的一个……首饰盒。”迪莉娅夫人脸色变得不太好看：“如果真有什么宝贝，那东西一定装在首饰盒里。”

“实际上，我们离开家族后很缺钱花，就是典当了首饰盒里部分首饰，我们才能活下去。”

迪莉娅下意识摸了摸挂在脖颈上的一条项链，这就是那个首饰盒中的一件，安妮塔也有类似的一条，其他首饰都卖了，只有这两条项链给她们留下来当做纪念。

商非凡伸手：“我能看看您这条项链吗？”

“怎么？你怀疑这条项链有问题？”迪莉娅夫人手放在项链挂坠上。

商非凡：“只是看看。”

迪莉娅夫人讽刺：“我都看不出来，你又能看出什么？”

“术业有专攻，只是试试。再说看看又不会把项链看坏。”商非凡的手没有缩回去。

迪莉娅夫人沉默片刻，到底还是解下项链，丢给商非凡：“看吧，我倒要看看你能看出什么花！”

商非凡接住项链，放开感知。

不帅也凑过来看。

两人看了一会儿，互视，一起摇头。

这就是一条普通的宝石项链，他们没有感觉到任何特别能量。

商非凡把项链还给迪莉娅。

迪莉娅也不知道是不是嫌弃项链被他人摸过，放到一边就没再戴上。

“你刚才说你母亲在你心脏里放入一个耳朵？什么耳朵，竟然能救命？”

“……自然之神的力量。”

“什么？！”迪莉娅夫人被惊住。

虎不帅左右看看，看到窗台上摆放着一盆植物。

植物被维护得很好，不过因为天气缘故，只有树枝，没有叶子，更没有花。

虎不帅把那盆植物抱过来，单手握着放在一边的骨杖，口中轻念魔法口诀。

迪莉娅夫人就看到那盆被修剪的只剩下枝干、正处于休眠状态的植物慢慢长出了绿色的叶子，叶子中间又冒出了小巧的花苞。

花苞盛开，满盆蓝紫色的小花。
