Chapter 92: Hello, Auntie (Part 2)

Delia snorted. "Bu Shuai's mother and I cut ties with the Linglet family long ago, and the daughter they married off has nothing to do with us either. Who were we supposed to ask? But the people Lang Shou dispatched are quite capable; he bribed the domestic servants of several families and managed to fish out some information through roundabout inquiries."

Delia paused. "Within the exact same month, each of these families was contacted by high-ranking figures. Some had someone visit in person, while others merely sent a letter. The servant of the family that received the letter happened to be the one who took delivery at the time. He said the messenger wasn't an ordinary postal worker, but looked distinctly like a guard from a wealthy noble household. The person delivered the letter on a dedicated errand, turned around and left immediately without even stepping through the front door. When the servant questioned him, the other party replied that there were still several more letters to deliver."

Shang Feifan pondered this. "It seems the other party had no intention of keeping it hidden."

Delia nodded. "I think so too."

A possibility occurred to Shang Feifan, and he looked at Delia. "So you suspect that the Linglet family running here isn't necessarily because they've run out of options, but rather because they were dispatched here?"

"If it weren't for Bu Shuai, I wouldn't have thought much of it. But with Bu Shuai here, his identity... will always be a problem." Delia looked at her nephew once more.

Hu Bu Shuai returned an apologetic look.

Madame Delia rolled her eyes, addressing only Shang Feifan. "Originally, I intended to brief Bu Shuai, but this kid can be stubbornly rigid at times and tends to shoulder everything himself. Since you're here too, you might as well listen in and see how best to handle this matter."

Shang Feifan said, "Go ahead. Bu Shuai's affairs are my affairs."

Delia didn't believe for a second that Shang Feifan could actually help her nephew; she merely figured this fellow was brimming with malicious schemes and possessed a broader perspective on issues, so perhaps he might have some crooked ideas or spot some loopholes. Still, she continued, "Lang Shou is still having people investigate the true identity of that VIP, but I already have my suspicions."

"The Lord of the Black Forest?" Shang Feifan blurted out.

Delia raised an eyebrow. "Why make that guess?"

Shang Feifan stuffed a bolster behind Bu Shuai to let him relax his body, then said indifferently, "It's easy to guess. If the people who made a move against your parents back then are truly connected to the Queen, then until the other party achieves their goal, the Queen probably won't let you off easily."

"Bu Shuai's mother, Madame Anita, fled to the Royal City, became the Tiger King's mistress, and even gave birth to Bu Shuai. If the Queen was unaware of her identity, that would be one thing; but if she knew, why would she tolerate it until now?"

"Oh, perhaps she never tolerated it at all. Hence, Madame Anita died, Bu Shuai nearly died as well, and now he is even forced to leave the Royal City."

"The real question is, after all these years, has the Queen actually achieved her goal, or rather, what is it that she truly wants?"

Delia picked up the thread. "Assuming that the person behind the seizure of the Linglet family's estate is affiliated with the Queen, and they have already obtained the estate, then what they wanted was never that piece of arable land."

"It wouldn't be the farm," Shang Feifan shook his head. "If it were merely an estate, there'd be no need for the Queen to step in. If the Lord of the Black Forest wanted it, would the Linglet family dare refuse?"

"Then what on earth are they looking for?" Delia couldn't help frowning as well.

Hu Bu Shuai suddenly looked at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan's heart skipped a beat as an object crossed his mind.

Could the thing the Queen—or rather, the Lord of the Black Forest—was searching for be that ear of the God of Nature?

Storms of thoughts raged through Hu Bu Shuai's mind before he made up his decision and turned to Madame Delia. "Auntie, when you and my mother left the Linglet family, did you take anything with you?"

"Hm? What do you mean? What are you suspecting?" Madame Delia narrowed her eyes.

Hu Bu Shuai looked at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan nodded at him. Although Delia had a foul personality, she was genuinely affectionate toward her nephew and could be trusted.

Besides, the ear of the God of Nature had already returned to the statue of the God of Nature; even if someone wanted to snatch it from Bu Shuai, they wouldn't be able to get it.

Seeing the look exchanged between the two, Delia felt a wave of irritation. Her relationship with her nephew wasn't particularly close, but the fact that her nephew trusted someone he'd only known for half a year more than her still stung a little.

"Auntie, I'm not sure if my mother ever told you, but six years ago, I almost died."

"Mhm, I heard about that. Word has it that it was caused by a good friend of yours, right?"

Bu Shuai shook his head. "Not six years ago; that was a year ago. I've been targeted by murder plots twice. The first time was six years ago, and I nearly died then. The second time was a year ago—I was injured but my life wasn't in danger, yet shortly after that, my mother passed away."

Bu Shuai's expression turned desolate.

His affinity for family really was pitifully shallow; it had been like this across all three of his lifetimes.

This was also the first time Shang Feifan was hearing about Bu Shuai's past, and he listened with rapt attention.

Bu Shuai continued, "During that incident six years ago, to save my life, my mother paid a heavy price. She planted a... treasure inside my heart."

Madame Delia sat up straight, her expression turning solemn. "What treasure?"

Bu Shuai: "An ear."

"An ear?" Madame Delia furrowed her brow deeply. "I had no idea. Anita never mentioned a thing to me."

"Did you two bring anything with you when you left the family? Or when you were young, did your parents hand anything over to you?" Shang Feifan chimed in.

Madame Delia pressed her temples as if trying to recall. After a long moment, she said, "Anita was the older sister, and her temperament was much steadier than mine. Growing up, Mom and Dad trusted her more, and I relied heavily on Anita. If they had anything they wanted to entrust to our safekeeping, they certainly would have chosen Anita rather than me."

Yet, not telling her a single thing, and Anita keeping her completely in the dark—that was pushing it a bit too far.

"When we left, we didn't bring many things—just some clothing, a small amount of money left behind by my parents, and a... jewelry box belonging to my mother." Madame Delia's expression turned somewhat unsightly. "If there truly was any treasure, it must have been kept inside that jewelry box."

"In truth, we were desperately short on money after leaving the family. We survived solely by pawning off a portion of the jewelry from that box."

Delia subconsciously touched a necklace hanging around her neck. This was one of the pieces from that very jewelry box. Anita had a similar one, and all the other jewelry had been sold, leaving only these two necklaces behind as a memento for them.

Shang Feifan reached out a hand. "May I take a look at your necklace?"

"What? You suspect there's something wrong with this necklace?" Madame Delia placed her hand over the pendant.

Shang Feifan: "Just taking a look."

Madame Delia scoffed, "Even I can't tell, what on earth do you expect to see?"

"Every trade has its master; I'm just giving it a try. Besides, looking at it won't break the necklace." Shang Feifan didn't pull his hand back.

Madame Delia fell silent for a moment before finally unfastening the necklace and tossing it to Shang Feifan. "Have a look then! I'd love to see what miracles you can pull out of it!"

Shang Feifan caught the necklace and opened his perception.

Bu Shuai leaned in to look as well.

After studying it for a moment, the two exchanged glances and shook their heads in unison.

This was simply an ordinary gemstone necklace; they couldn't sense any special energy whatsoever.

Shang Feifan returned the necklace to Delia.

Whether out of disgust that the necklace had been touched by someone else or otherwise, Delia set it aside and didn't put it back on.

"You mentioned earlier that your mother put an ear inside your heart? What kind of ear could possibly save a life?"

"The power of... the God of Nature."

"What?!" Madame Delia was stunned.

Hu Bu Shuai glanced left and right, his eyes landing on a potted plant resting on the windowsill.

The plant was well-maintained, but due to the season, it only had bare branches with neither leaves nor flowers.

Hu Bu Shuai walked over, picked up the flowerpot, and holding his bone staff in one hand, softly chanted an incantation.

Madame Delia watched with her own eyes as the plant—which had been pruned down to mere stems and was currently in a dormant state—slowly sprouted green leaves, out of the center of which tiny flower buds emerged.

The buds burst open, filling the entire pot with petite, blue-purple blossoms.

chunks.chineseText:
这是迪莉娅的最爱，幽灵花。

迪莉娅夫人看着外甥送到她手边的花盆，看着那满盆盛开的花朵，哑巴了。

“你获得了自然之神的力量？”过了许久，迪莉娅夫人才再次开口说话。

虎不帅轻轻点头，“只获得一点。”

实际只是自然类魔法加成，但他不好解释他为什么会魔法，干脆借这个机会把他的魔法推到自然之神的力量上。

以后他要是再施展类似魔法，也有了依托。

眼看春天就要到了，不帅当然想在农田里试试自然魔法的威力。

“不帅把自然之神的力量还回去了，自然之神就给了他一点馈赠，让他自然亲和力大幅度增加，可以施展类似的让植物生长的天赋能力。”商非凡在一边描补。

“还回去？怎么还？”迪莉娅夫人声音有点迷茫，她的外甥竟然和自然之神接触过？！

“我们发现了一座自然之神的雕像，接到了自然之神的任务，祂让我们帮忙寻找祂散落的力量。”商非凡说。

“天啊！”迪莉娅夫人捂住额头，她不敢置信。

“你们竟然还接到了自然之神的任务？”

她知道这世上有神灵，但那不都是传说吗？

“也许那并不是真的自然之神，也许那只是一种自然能量的具现体，不管那是什么，我和不帅都觉得那东西对我们没有恶意。”商非凡说。

迪莉娅夫人站起来，她需要平复一下心情。

虎不帅也趁机抽出自己的手，正要理清思绪，一杯温热的饮料塞入他手心。

商非凡还又拿了个靠枕，想要塞给他。

不帅：“……够了。”

商非凡殷勤地轻轻揉揉他的腿：“累吗？有没有哪里不舒服？要不要躺下？”

“不用。你坐好，别管我。”不帅推他。

商非凡还是紧贴着不帅，又把桌上的小点心扯过来，端在手心里，示意不帅吃。

“我不饿。”

“那你喝点热的。”这里喝的热饮是一种动物奶加一些坚果粉调和而成，味道很浓厚，热量很高。

不帅被他烦得只能端起杯子喝了一口。

“味道怎么样？好喝吗？你要是喜欢，我回去调给你喝，我肯定调得比他们好喝。”老商自卖自夸。

不帅：“你尝尝不就知道好喝不好喝了。”

“哦，那我尝尝。”商非凡就着不帅手里端着的杯子，抬起不帅的手，喝了一口。

不帅：“……”

商非凡品了品：“味道一般，等我回去调给你喝。”

“我觉得还可以。”不帅下意识也跟着喝了一口。

迪莉娅夫人转头，就看到两只用着一个杯子喝核桃奶，你一口我一口，不禁手痒。

啪！

迪莉娅用力击掌。

等两只一起抬头看她。

迪莉娅没好气地说：“家里杯子多的是，明明给你们准备了两个杯子……算了！当我什么都没说。”

“我本来想让不帅继续埋伏到林格莱特家族附近，听听他们都在说些什么，多监听一段时间。但现在没这个必要了。”

迪莉娅摆摆手：“我把情况从头到尾重新整理一遍。”

“首先，我们可以确定的是，林格莱特家族的宝贝只有那一小片可以耕种的田地。虽然珍贵，但还不值得让大贵族谋夺。所以我父母一死一失踪，九成和家族无关。

其次，如果我父母手上有宝贝，那一定是我母亲从丹顿家族里带来的。但他们能把宝贝带出来，就表示当时没有人知道那是宝贝。

第三，如果我母亲知道她手上有王后或者当代丹顿侯爵想要的宝贝，为什么宁可家破人亡也不交出去？以我对我母亲的了解，她就是一个软弱娇贵的贵族小姐，根本没有抵抗的血性。如果王后和丹顿家族逼迫她，她不可能不交出去。所以……会不会她也不知道宝贝是什么？

然后是第四点，王后或者丹顿侯爵是怎么知道宝贝在我母亲手里？他们知道宝贝长什么样吗？

第五点，王后和丹顿侯爵为什么会放任我们姐妹这么长时间，还让安妮塔接近虎王？他们是否也不确定宝贝在不在我们手上，又觉得强要要不出来，就决定在一边偷偷观察和等待，看我们会不会自露马脚？

第六点，他们抢走林格莱特家族的农庄，逼迫他们来到莫约镇，又是为了什么？这是专门针对不帅的阴谋，还是依然与他们要找的宝贝有关？”

迪莉娅夫人一口气说完，转身面前两人。

“现在通过你们俩，我们可以假设王后和丹顿侯爵想要的宝贝就是自然之神的力量。只是他们没办法确定这宝贝到底在不在我们身上，所以他们一直在用各种手段试探。

包括但不限于杀死我父亲、让我母亲失踪，以及在六年前谋害你、逼死你母亲、又谋夺林格莱特家族土地逼迫他们来找我治疗他们所谓的血脉诅咒。

见我迟迟不出手，他们为了进一步确定，很可能还会做出什么事。而动手的人很可能就是林格莱特家族。”

迪莉娅夫人最后说：“我也交给你们一个任务，那就是给我抓住林格莱特家族的人，审问他们，问清楚他们到底藏了什么坏水。我绝不会允许他们破坏莫约镇安宁的生活！”

“不帅心软，抓人和审问的事就交给你了。我允许你对林格莱特家使用诅咒。”迪莉娅夫人一副我给你脸的傲然神情，下巴对着商非凡。

商非凡也不跟她计较。

不帅想说我和林格莱特家族的人不熟，不会心软，但那边商非凡已经接受任务。

因为脑载系统也给他布置了相同的任务，还另外加了一个，那就是拯救阿呆。

艹！阿呆被抓了？

商非凡拉着不帅就站了起来：“阿呆被人抓走，我们得去找他。”

Chapter 92: Hello, Auntie (Part 3)

This was Delia's absolute favorite—phantom flowers.

Madame Delia stared at the flowerpot her nephew had placed right beside her hands, gazing at the densely blooming blossoms, utterly speechless.

"You've obtained the power of the God of Nature?" After a long while, Madame Delia finally managed to speak again.

Hu Bu Shuai gave a slight nod. "Just a tiny fraction."

In truth, it was merely a nature-type magic bonus, but since it was hard to explain why he could cast magic, he simply seized the opportunity to attribute his magic to the power of the God of Nature.

From now on, whenever he cast similar spells, he would have a ready-made cover story.

With spring just around the corner, Bu Shuai naturally wanted to test the might of nature magic in the farmland.

"Bu Shuai returned the power of the God of Nature, so the God of Nature gave him a small token of gratitude—greatly increasing his natural affinity and allowing him to manifest a talent for stimulating plant growth," Shang Feifan chimed in to smooth things over.

"Returned it? How do you return something?" Madame Delia's voice was tinged with bewilderment. Her nephew had actually been in contact with the God of Nature?!

"We discovered a statue of the God of Nature and accepted a commission from the deity. It asked us to help find its scattered power," Shang Feifan said.

"Good heavens!" Madame Delia pressed a hand to her forehead, finding it utterly unbelievable.

"You actually accepted a commission from the God of Nature?"

She knew divine beings existed in this world, but weren't those all just legends?

"Perhaps that wasn't truly the God of Nature; perhaps it was merely a manifestation of natural energy. Regardless of what it was, both Bu Shuai and I felt that entity held no malice toward us," Shang Feifan said.

Madame Delia stood up; she needed a moment to calm her racing mind.

Taking advantage of the moment, Hu Bu Shuai pulled his hand free. Just as he was trying to sort out his thoughts, a warm cup of a beverage was pressed into his palm.

Shang Feifan even grabbed another bolster, trying to wedge it behind him.

Bu Shuai: "..." "That's enough."

Attentively, Shang Feifan gently rubbed his legs. "Are you tired? Is anything uncomfortable? Do you want to lie down?"

"No. Sit properly and leave me alone," Bu Shuai pushed him away.

Shang Feifan stubbornly stayed glued to Bu Shuai, pulling a small plate of pastries over from the table and holding it in his palm while gesturing for Bu Shuai to eat.

"I'm not hungry."

"Then drink something warm." The hot drink served here was concocted from animal milk blended with ground nuts; it was rich in flavor and very high in calories.

Annoyed by the fuss, Bu Shuai had no choice but to pick up the cup and take a sip.

"How does it taste? Is it good? If you like it, I'll brew it for you when we get back. I guarantee I can make it taste better than theirs." Old Shang wasted no opportunity to sing his own praises.

Bu Shuai retorted, "You'd know whether it tastes good or not if you tried it."

"Oh, then let me have a taste." Piggybacking on the cup Bu Shuai was holding, Shang Feifan lifted Bu Shuai's hand and took a sip.

Bu Shuai: "..."

Shang Feifan savored the taste. "Mediocre. Wait till we get back, I'll mix you a proper one."

"I think it's all right." Subconsciously, Bu Shuai took another sip as well.

Madame Delia turned her head and happened to catch sight of the two beasts sharing a single cup of walnut milk, taking turns drinking sip by sip. Her hands immediately started itching to throw something.

*Slap!*

Delia struck her palms together forcefully.

Until both of them raised their heads to look at her.

Delia snapped irritably, "There are plenty of cups in this house, and I clearly had two prepared for you... Forget it! Pretend I didn't say anything."

"Originally, I wanted to have Bu Shuai continue lingering near the Linglet family to eavesdrop on what they're saying and gather intelligence for a while longer. But there's no need for that now."

Delia waved a hand dismissively. "Let me reorganize the situation from start to finish."

"First, we can confirm that the only asset the Linglet family possesses of any real value is that small patch of arable land. Precious as it is, it's hardly worth a high noble scheming to seize it. Therefore, the death of my father and the disappearance of my mother are nine times out of ten unrelated to the family.

Second, if my parents did possess a treasure, it must have been brought by my mother from the Denton family. But the fact that they were able to spirit the treasure away implies that nobody knew it was a treasure at the time.

Third, if my mother knew she was holding a treasure coveted by the Queen or the contemporary Marquis of Denton, why would she rather watch her family fall apart and perish than hand it over? Knowing my mother as I do, she was nothing more than a frail, pampered noblewoman without a shred of defiant backbone. If the Queen and the Denton family pressured her, it's impossible she wouldn't have handed it over. So... could it be that she didn't even know what the treasure was?

Fourth, how did the Queen or the Marquis of Denton find out the treasure was in my mother's hands? Do they even know what the treasure looks like?

Fifth, why would the Queen and the Marquis of Denton leave our sisters alone for so long, and even allow Anita to get close to the Tiger King? Could it be that they aren't entirely certain whether the treasure is actually in our possession, yet felt they couldn't force it out of us, deciding instead to hide in the shadows, observing and waiting to see if we'd give ourselves away?

Sixth, what is their purpose in seizing the Linglet family's estate and driving them to Moye Town? Is this a conspiracy specifically targeted at Bu Shuai, or does it still relate to the treasure they're searching for?"

Madame Delia finished speaking in one breath, turning to face the two men.

"Now, through the two of you, we can hypothesize that the treasure the Queen and the Marquis of Denton are after is precisely the power of the God of Nature. It's just that they have no way of confirming whether this treasure is truly on us, which is why they've continuously tested us using various methods.

This includes, but is not limited to, murdering my father, causing my mother to go missing, plotting against you six years ago, driving your mother to her death, and seizing the Linglet family's land to force them into coming to me for a cure to their so-called bloodline curse.

Seeing that I haven't made a move yet, to further verify their suspicions, they will likely pull another stunt soon. And the ones carrying out the deed will most likely be the Linglet family."

Madame Delia delivered her final verdict: "I'm giving you two a mission as well: capture the people of the Linglet family for me, interrogate them, and find out what kind of malicious schemes they're plotting. I will never allow them to disrupt the peace of Moye Town!"

"Bu Shuai is soft-hearted, so the task of capturing and interrogating them falls to you. I grant you permission to use curses on the Linglets." Madame Delia assumed an air of haughty benevolence, her chin tilted up toward Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan didn't bother bickering with her either.

Bu Shuai wanted to say that he wasn't close with the Linglets and wouldn't be soft-hearted, but Shang Feifan had already accepted the mission on the spot.

Because his onboard system had assigned him the exact same quest, with an additional bonus objective: rescue Ah Dai.

*Damn it!* Ah Dai had been captured?

Grabbing Bu Shuai, Shang Feifan stood right up. "Ah Dai's been snatched away. We have to go find him."

chunks.chineseText:
第93章 阿呆被绑架

阿呆和小幼崽们玩捉迷藏玩得超开心。

他表面看起来呆呆的，又是新来的，小幼崽们就让他先当鬼抓人。

躲起来的小幼崽们以为阿呆花很长时间都不一定能找到他们，结果阿呆一找一个准，且速度特别快。

藏在自认为不可能被人找到地点的小幼崽们一个个叫叫囔囔，纷纷询问阿呆是怎么找到他们的。

阿呆歪着脑袋看着大家，不说话。

“你的天赋能力不会是找人吧？”最先拉他一起玩的小幼崽叹气道。阿呆第一个找到的就是他。

这只小幼崽叫伊凡，是治安官安德烈的小儿子。他还有一个姐姐，姐姐比他大四岁，有自己的圈子，很少带他一起玩耍。

伊凡的梦想就是成为像他爸爸一样的治安官，想要当头头，但他的领导能力实在一般，小幼崽们买他账的不多。加上他年龄还太小，听他话的小幼崽就更少啦。

伊凡看到阿呆，就想把阿呆发展为自己的小弟。

呆呆的，才听话嘛。

轮到伊凡当鬼了，在伊凡蒙着眼睛开始数数时，小幼崽们一哄而散。

阿呆左右看看，就藏在伊凡身后不远处的大门后。

坐在门口晒太阳的老兽人看着躲进他家大门后的阿呆笑了笑，也不阻止。

伊凡数完一百个数，睁开眼睛，扭头左右看，还抬起小鼻子嗅来嗅去。

捉迷藏对于小兽人们来说也是训练途径之一。

可以锻炼嗅觉、听力、观察力和分析能力等。

晒太阳的老兽人身上有着比较重的体味，完美遮掩了躲在门背后的阿呆。

伊凡没发现最近的阿呆，逐渐向远处跑去。

阿呆蹲坐在门背后等了好一会儿，突然探头朝外看。

老兽人慈爱地揉揉他的方脑袋，低声说：“伊凡跑远了。”

阿呆抬头看老兽人，突然说：“有不好的味道。”

老兽人愣了愣，还以为阿呆在说自己身上的体味，有点尴尬地拍拍阿呆的头，“小家伙鼻子倒是挺尖。我这身上是草药味，我关节疼，需要常年敷药。”

阿呆摇摇头，跑出老兽人家的大门，抬头向伊凡跑去的方向看。

“伊凡跑远了，朝不好味道的地方跑去。”阿呆愣愣地说。

老兽人听到阿呆重复他的话，敷衍地嗯了嗯。

阿呆突然撒腿就跑。

老兽人只抬头看了看，笑笑，也没放在心上。

守在不远处的夏冰也只是看看，没有跟上去。

镇子里有巡逻队，又有那么多老兽人看着，只要幼崽们不跑出镇子，就很安全。

“哈哈！找到你了！”伊凡找到了第一个小幼崽。

对方发出沮丧的叫声，只能乖乖走出来。

“阿呆？你怎么自己跑出来了？”伊凡回头就看到跑过来的阿呆。

阿呆只望着他。

伊凡心想，真是一个小呆瓜。

三个小幼崽聚集在一起，一起去寻找其他小幼崽。

伊凡招呼阿呆。

阿呆跟上，走了两步，又忽然扭头看向伊凡刚才找到第一个小幼崽的地方……的斜对面百多米处，那是一栋很大的房屋，有很大的后院，不好的味道就从那里传来。

等到小幼崽们全都被找到——不少人都是自己忍不住主动哇哇叫着跑了出来，新的鬼开始蒙眼数数。

如此玩了好几轮，地方也换了好几个。小兽人们特别能跑，他们不会只局限在一个地方，整个镇子都是他们玩耍的地盘。

阿呆总是跟着伊凡。

伊凡也不嫌弃阿呆，他已经把阿呆当小弟看，以为阿呆不懂得怎么躲藏，就很讲义气地带着他一起躲。

阿呆拦住伊凡，不让他跳入大屋子的后院。

伊凡莫名其妙：“你在干什么？”

阿呆：“这里不好。”

不好的味道就是从这栋大房子传出来的。

“什么不好？”伊凡没理睬自家小弟，自顾跳到院墙上。

阿呆抬头，喊他下来。

伊凡站在院墙上，反过来喊他上来。

“你到底在害怕什么？这里没人！一个大人都没有！”

阿呆：“不好的味道。”

伊凡装大人地说：“是酒味吗？我也不喜欢酒味，不过大人们都喜欢，等以后我们长大了，也会喜欢的。”

他挑的这个躲藏地点就是镇子唯一的酒坊，后院里堆着很多空酒桶，是最好的藏身地。

“我们不要玩了，去找大人吧。”阿呆有点害怕。

伊凡不高兴：“你怎么回事？为什么要去找大人？如果你不喜欢酒味，那你就找别的地方躲藏，不用跟着我。”

说完，伊凡就跳进院子里。

阿呆在院墙下面焦急地走来走去，他想回去找夏冰、找他商爸和不帅爸爸，但他的新朋友已经进去，他要是就这么跑了是不是不太好？

总觉得他如果离开，伊凡就会遇到不好的事情。

就跟他第一次见到他商爸，他直觉这个人会帮助他、会带他离开一样，就那么跳了出去。

他的直觉并不是每次都很准，也不会每次都起效用。

但他能闻到别人闻不到的味道。

商爸就跟他说，如果他闻到了别人都没有闻到的味道，一定要告诉他。

现在阿呆也不知道他是不是闻到了别人都没有闻到的味道。

他有点后悔，他应该在闻到不好的味道时就跟夏冰哥哥说。

阿呆蹲在院墙下面，小脑袋思考了几秒钟，决定：“有人吗！快来人呀！夏冰哥哥，爸爸快来啊！出事啦！”

小家伙扯开嗓子大喊。

伊凡在院子里听到了阿呆的喊叫声，一脸莫名其妙，心想那真是一个小呆瓜，没出事就乱喊，等会儿肯定会被大人教训！

在院子里转悠的伊凡完全没发现原本应该有几名工人的酒坊后院这时安静得出奇。

如果他再多走几步，就会发现后院和主屋相连的地下酒窖里有几名兽人人事不知地趴在地上。

但酒窖入口黑乎乎的，就是胆大如伊凡也不敢随便往里钻。

外面阿呆还在喊，伊凡担心大人真的被喊过来，只能跑回院墙边，打算跳出去让阿呆闭嘴。

“干！”有人在低骂。

“谁？”伊凡顿时扭头。

就在这时，伊凡闻到了一股特别浓烈的香味。

那香味太浓郁，浓得让他头晕。

伊凡跳起来，四条腿却软得无法发力，爪子搭在墙壁上滑了下来。

一只手捏住伊凡的后脖颈，把他拎起来，装入一个大袋子中。

墙外，阿呆也闻到了那股强烈的香味。

这就是那股不好的味道，变得更浓郁了。

阿呆脑中有什么在催促他，吓得他撒开四条小短腿就想跑。

“咦？竟然没有昏？”一只大手抓住阿呆。

阿呆腾空了，四只小短腿在空中无力地来回倒腾。

黑暗笼罩住他。

他想喊叫。但他发现自己叫不出任何声音。

“让你这只小崽子乱叫！”一只拳头隔着布袋重重击在阿呆的脑门上。

阿呆疼得昏了过去。

酒坊因为酒味浓郁的缘故，周围住户隔得都比较远。酒坊就位于镇子最外围，最靠近山脚的地方。
chunks.englishText:
>
Ah Dai was having a wonderful time playing hide-and-seek with the other beastman cubs.

Because he looked a bit dazed on the outside and was a newcomer, the cubs made him "it" first.

The hidden cubs thought it would take Ah Dai ages to find them, but to their surprise, he pinpointed them with unerring accuracy and incredible speed.

The cubs, who had hidden in spots they deemed absolutely impossible to find, cried out in protest one after another, clamoring to know how he had tracked them down.

Ah Dai just tilted his head, looking at them in silence.

"Is your innate talent tracking people?" sighed the cub who had first invited him to play. He had been the very first one Ah Dai found.

This cub was named Ivan, the youngest son of Sheriff Andre. He had an older sister who was four years his senior, but she had her own circle of friends and rarely played with him.

Ivan's dream was to become a sheriff just like his father and be a leader. However, his leadership skills were mediocre at best, and few of the cubs took him seriously. Since he was still so young, even fewer actually listened to him.

When Ivan saw Ah Dai, he immediately wanted to recruit him as his little lackey.

*He's so dim-witted, he'll definitely be obedient.*

When it was Ivan's turn to be "it," the cubs scattered in all directions as he covered his eyes and began to count.

Ah Dai looked left and right, then hid behind a gate not far behind Ivan.

An old beastman sitting by the doorway soaking up the sun smiled at Ah Dai as the boy slipped behind his gate, making no move to stop him.

Having counted to a hundred, Ivan opened his eyes, looked around, and twitched his little nose, sniffing the air.

For young beastmen, hide-and-seek was also a form of training.

It honed their sense of smell, hearing, observation, and analytical skills.

The sunbathing old beastman had a rather strong body odor, which perfectly masked Ah Dai's scent behind the gate.

Failing to notice Ah Dai right next to him, Ivan gradually ran off into the distance.

Ah Dai squatted behind the gate for a good while before suddenly poking his head out to look.

The old beastman affectionately patted his square head and murmured, "Ivan has run far away."

Ah Dai looked up at the old beastman and suddenly said, "There is a bad smell."

The old beastman froze, thinking Ah Dai was referring to his body odor. Feeling a bit embarrassed, he patted Ah Dai's head. "You have a sharp nose, little guy. But this is just the smell of herbal medicine. My joints ache, so I have to apply poultices year-round."

Ah Dai shook his head, ran out of the old beastman's gate, and looked toward the direction Ivan had run.

"Ivan ran far away. He ran toward the bad smell," Ah Dai said blankly.

Hearing Ah Dai repeat his words in his own way, the old beastman gave a dismissive grunt.

Suddenly, Ah Dai bolted.

The old beastman merely looked up, smiled, and paid it no mind.

Xia Bing, who was keeping watch nearby, also just watched and did not follow.

There were patrol teams in the town, and so many old beastmen keeping watch. As long as the cubs didn't run out of town, they were perfectly safe.

"Haha! Found you!" Ivan found the first cub.

The other cub let out a dejected groan and reluctantly stepped out.

"Ah Dai? Why did you run out on your own?" Ivan turned around and saw Ah Dai running over.

Ah Dai just stared at him.

*What a little dummy,* Ivan thought.

The three cubs gathered together and set off to find the others.

Ivan gestured for Ah Dai to follow.

Ah Dai followed. After a couple of steps, he suddenly turned his head to look diagonally across from where Ivan had found the first cub, about a hundred meters away. It was a large building with a spacious backyard. The bad smell was coming from there.

By the time all the cubs were found—many of whom couldn't help but squeal and run out on their own—a new "it" covered their eyes and began to count.

They played several rounds like this, changing locations multiple times. The young beastmen were incredibly energetic; they wouldn't confine themselves to one spot, treating the entire town as their playground.

Ah Dai always followed Ivan.

Ivan didn't mind Ah Dai's company either. He already viewed Ah Dai as his little lackey. Believing Ah Dai didn't know how to hide, he loyally dragged him along to hide together.

Ah Dai stopped Ivan, preventing him from jumping into the backyard of the large building.

Ivan was baffled. "What are you doing?"

Ah Dai: "This place is bad."

The bad smell was coming from this very building.

"What's bad?" Ignoring his little lackey, Ivan scrambled up onto the courtyard wall.

Ah Dai looked up and called for him to come down.

Standing on the wall, Ivan called back down to him.

"What on earth are you afraid of? There's no one here! Not a single adult!"

Ah Dai: "A bad smell."

Ivan said, putting on an adult-like air, "Is it the smell of alcohol? I don't like it either, but adults do. When we grow up, we'll like it too."

The hiding spot he had chosen was the town's only winery. The backyard was piled with empty wine casks, making it the perfect hiding place.

"Let's stop playing. Let's go find the adults," Ah Dai said, feeling a bit scared.

Ivan grew displeased. "What's wrong with you? Why go look for adults? If you don't like the smell of wine, go hide somewhere else. You don't have to follow me."

With that, Ivan leaped down into the courtyard.

Ah Dai paced anxiously beneath the wall. He wanted to go back to find Xia Bing, Papa Shang, and Papa Bushuai, but his new friend had already gone inside. Would it be bad if he just ran away?

He had a strong feeling that if he left, something terrible would happen to Ivan.

It was just like when he first saw Papa Shang; his intuition had told him this person would help him and take him away, so he had leaped out without hesitation.

His intuition wasn't always accurate, nor did it work every single time.

But he could smell things others couldn't.

Papa Shang had told him that if he ever smelled something no one else could, he must tell him.

Right now, Ah Dai didn't know if this was one of those scents that only he could perceive.

He regretted it a little. He should have told Brother Xia Bing the moment he smelled the bad scent.

Squatting beneath the wall, Ah Dai's little head pondered for a few seconds before he made up his mind. "Is anyone there? Help! Brother Xia Bing, Papa, come quickly! Something bad happened!"

The little guy yelled at the top of his lungs.

Inside the courtyard, Ivan heard Ah Dai's shouting. He found it utterly baffling, thinking that Ah Dai was indeed a little dummy. Screaming like that when nothing was wrong would surely get him scolded by the adults later!

Wandering around the courtyard, Ivan failed to notice that the winery's backyard, which should have had several workers bustling about, was eerily quiet.

If he took just a few more steps, he would see several beastmen lying unconscious on the floor of the underground wine cellar that connected the backyard to the main house.

But the entrance to the cellar was pitch black, and even someone as bold as Ivan didn't dare to venture inside blindly.

Outside, Ah Dai was still shouting. Fearing that the adults really would be summoned, Ivan had no choice but to run back to the wall, intending to jump out and make Ah Dai shut up.

"Damn it!" someone cursed in a low voice.

"Who's there?" Ivan whipped his head around.

Right at that moment, Ivan caught a whiff of an incredibly potent fragrance.

The scent was so overpowering that it made his head spin.

Ivan tried to leap, but his four legs went so weak he couldn't muster any strength. His claws scraped against the wall as he slid back down.

A hand pinched the back of Ivan's neck, lifting him up and stuffing him into a large sack.

Outside the wall, Ah Dai also smelled that intense fragrance.

This was the bad smell, now grown far more concentrated.

Something in Ah Dai's mind urged him to flee, and in his fright, he scrambled to run on his four short legs.

"Huh? He didn't pass out?" A large hand grabbed Ah Dai.

Ah Dai was lifted into the air, his four short legs flailing helplessly.

Darkness enveloped him.

He wanted to scream, but he found he couldn't make a sound.

"That's for screaming, you little brat!" A fist struck Ah Dai heavily on the forehead through the sack.

The pain knocked Ah Dai unconscious.

Because of the strong smell of alcohol, the neighboring houses were situated quite far from the winery. The winery itself was located on the outermost edge of the town, closest to the foot of the mountain.

chunks.chineseText:
阿呆叫声虽然响亮，但附近不少兽人家里都没有人，不是出去工作，就是出去上课。

有老兽人从屋里出来，神色疑惑地看向酒坊方向。刚才是不是有小幼崽在叫出事了？

远处，负责巡逻的小队有人竖起耳朵。

“你们有没有听到什么声音？”

“是小幼崽吗？我好像听到有小幼崽在叫。”

“声音是从哪里传来的？”

“好像是……酒坊那边？”

“过去看看，走！”

巡逻队加快速度向酒坊奔跑过去。

途中他们看到从家门走出来的两个老兽人。

彼此一对，发现都听到了小幼崽的叫声，担心下干脆一起跑向酒坊。

“不对劲！”带队的兽人一靠近酒坊就抬手命所有人停下。

酒坊太-安静了。

“小心戒备！”

巡逻小队的兽人们训练有素地分开，从不同方向跳入酒坊。

两名老兽人则返身就往镇子冲，他们得去通知镇子的人，酒坊出事了，说不定还有小幼崽也出事了。

很快，治安官安德烈和镇长就得到镇酒坊出事的消息，当即率人一起赶往酒坊，同时敲响警钟，让整个镇子都警戒起来。

所有老兽人都在喊小兽人，用最快速度把小幼崽们拎到身边聚集起来。

成年兽人全副武装，三分之一兽人守住农田，现在早就过了收获季节，他们只要保证没有人过来破坏农田就成。

剩下的兽人则全都负责守护镇子，他们守住了各个主要进出口，以及镇子最重要的粮仓和图书馆。

小幼崽们在老兽人们的带领下也集中到图书馆，这里还有已经到了入学年龄的小兽人们在上课。

镇子的防守设施也全部开启。

荒原里，林格莱特家族的人和少数聚集在附近的流浪兽人都发现了莫约镇的异常。

原本没有城墙、看似没有多少守卫力量的莫约镇竟然在镇子入口以及附近的山体中伸出了几十个炮口。

空中还有飞行兽人不时掠过。

这些兽人身上毫无疑问都带着炼金武器，只要需要，他们就能从空中攻击地面。

“发生了什么事？”

“不知道。是有人要攻击莫约镇吗？”

“我们要不要离远一点？”

“有没有看到进攻者？”

“找莫约镇的人问一问吧！”

林格莱特家族很多人都十分慌张，担心被牵连。

附近聚集的少数流浪兽人已经第一时间四散奔逃，只想赶紧离开是非地。

一处僻静地点，有人在说话。

“怎么回事？你怎么会被发现？”

“我也不知道！就两个小鬼突然闯入酒坊，其中一个小鬼还在外面大喊大叫，我根本来不及做下一步。”

“该死！我们的计划不会被发现吧？”

“难说。我怕被巡逻队发现，就先带着人回来了。”

“你带两个小鬼回来有什么用？”

“怎么没用？你知道这个小鬼是谁的儿子吗？”伊凡被单独拎出来晃了晃，“这可是莫约镇治安官安德烈的小儿子！必要时，他可以做我们的护身牌。”

“那另一个呢？”

“好像是新来的兽人带来的幼崽。但这小鬼有点诡异，就是他在外面大叫出事，还不肯进入酒馆。”

“哦？把他弄醒，问问他都知道什么！”

镇中，酒坊。

商非凡和虎不帅几乎和镇长他们同一时间赶到。

他们在途中就听到了镇子的警钟声，也看到了老弱兽人向镇子中心集中。

“出了什么事？”不帅看到镇长立刻问道。

镇长站在酒坊后院，看着被从地窖拖出来的几个兽人，声音沉重：“酒坊的工人都被迷昏了。”

“迷昏？没有伤亡？”商非凡插话。

镇长摇头：“没有。但是弄不醒他们，无论是打脸、泼水还是用药，都弄不醒他们。”

“羊大婶和药剂师正在赶来。”治安官安德烈说。

“酒坊主人呢？老伯特一家都在哪里？”不帅问。

镇长神色不妙：“没找到，包括他妻子和孩子都没有找到。”

商非凡和虎不帅互视。

“姨父，你有看到阿呆吗？”不帅问。

镇长一愣，摇头：“没有。你们去图书馆看过了吗？镇子的幼崽都集中在那里。”

“我去看看，你在这儿等消息。”商非凡转身就跳上狰爷的背。

狰爷飞速跑出去。

商非凡已经从系统那里得知阿呆被绑架的事，但他得做个样子，否则他要怎么跟其他人解释他如何知道阿呆被绑架的？

而且他去图书馆也不是白去，他想去那边问问情况，看阿呆是怎么被绑架的，首先要找的就是夏冰。

不帅留下，继续打听消息。

没一会儿，他就从巡逻队口中得知他们听到小幼崽叫声的事。

“我们赶过来时没找到小幼崽，只在酒窖里发现他们。”领队说。

不帅下意识就认为大叫出事的小幼崽就是阿呆。

他和阿呆也一起生活了不短时间，自然很清楚阿呆只是表面呆，实际这孩子敏感又聪慧。

“酒坊里的酒水检查过了吗？”不帅问。

安德烈：“正准备查，我们也刚到。我们都在等药剂师康成和祭司羊大婶。”

“房子里有没有打斗痕迹？”不帅又问。

“没有。”

“老伯特一家有留下什么线索吗？”

安德烈做出邀请的手势：“一起去看看？”

不帅没有拒绝。

安德烈也不是做样子，他是真心邀请不帅。

不帅的天赋能力在听力上，但他本人的观察力很强，又认真细致，安德烈和他合作过几次，自然知道他的能耐。

镇长留下主持大局。

祭司羊大婶和药剂师康成随后迅速赶到。

巡逻队帮忙随机打开几坛酒，让两人检查。

几只羊被牵过来，它们是备用。一旦羊大婶和康成查不出什么，就只能用活羊来尝那些酒水。

在不帅进入酒坊主屋查看时，商非凡那边也已经找到夏冰。

夏冰正焦急无比，他在和其他兽人一起清点幼崽，但清点来清点去，都少两个。

其中一个就是阿呆！

“老大！”夏冰看到商非凡过来，又怕又喜，眼泪都要出来了。

“阿呆不见了！对不起，我……”

商非凡抬手：“先别说对不起，先把情况详细说一遍。”

夏冰赶紧把他知道的都说了出来，他也没有推卸责任，说阿呆和一群小幼崽玩捉迷藏，他就没有跟着阿呆。

“警钟敲响后，小幼崽们都被带了过来，当时玩捉迷藏的小幼崽都在那里。”夏冰指向一群被单独隔开的小幼崽。

因为少掉的两只小幼崽就是和他们一起玩耍的，所以把他们单独列了出来，成年兽人好询问情况。

“少掉的另一个幼崽是谁？”商非凡问。

“是伊凡。安德烈治安官的小儿子。”夏冰回答。

商非凡挑眉：“安德烈还不知道吧？”

夏冰摇头，“这边正在清点人数，还没有人通知他。”

商非凡过去捉迷藏的小幼崽那边，正好有成年兽人在问那群小幼崽详细情况。
chunks.englishText:
>
Although Ah Dai's shouts were loud, many of the nearby beastman homes were empty, their occupants either out working or attending classes.

An old beastman stepped out of his house, looking toward the winery with a puzzled expression. *Did a cub just shout that something happened?*

In the distance, a member of the patrol team pricked up his ears.

"Did you guys hear something?"

"Was it a cub? I think I heard a cub shouting."

"Where did the sound come from?"

"It sounded like... the winery?"

"Let's go check it out. Move!"

The patrol team quickened their pace and dashed toward the winery.

On the way, they saw two old beastmen stepping out of their homes.

After comparing notes, they realized everyone had heard the cub's cries. Anxious, they all ran toward the winery together.

"Something's wrong!" The beastman leading the squad raised his hand to halt everyone as they neared the winery.

The winery was far too quiet.

"Stay on high alert!"

The well-trained beastmen of the patrol squad split up, leaping into the winery from different directions.

Meanwhile, the two old beastmen turned and rushed back to the town. They needed to notify the townspeople that something had happened at the winery, and that some cubs might be in danger.

Before long, Sheriff Andre and the Mayor received news of the incident at the town winery. They immediately led a group to the scene while sounding the alarm bell, putting the entire town on high alert.

All the old beastmen began calling for the young ones, gathering the cubs to their sides as quickly as possible.

The adult beastmen armed themselves fully. One-third of them went to guard the farmlands; though the harvest season had long passed, they still needed to ensure no one came to sabotage the fields.

The remaining beastmen were tasked with defending the town, securing all major entrances and exits, as well as the town's most vital granary and library.

Under the guidance of the old beastmen, the cubs were also gathered at the library, where school-aged young beastmen were currently attending classes.

The town's defensive installations were also fully activated.

Out in the wasteland, members of the Linglete family and a few wandering beastmen gathered nearby noticed the unusual activity in Moyue Town.

Moyue Town, which originally had no city walls and seemingly possessed little defensive force, had suddenly extended dozens of artillery barrels from the town entrance and the neighboring mountainsides.

Flying beastmen also swept through the air from time to time.

These beastmen were undoubtedly equipped with alchemical weapons, ready to launch aerial strikes on the ground at a moment's notice.

"What happened?"

"I don't know. Is someone attacking Moyue Town?"

"Should we keep our distance?"

"Have you seen any attackers?"

"Let's ask someone from Moyue Town!"

Many members of the Linglete family were in a panic, fearing they would be caught in the crossfire.

The few wandering beastmen gathered nearby scattered and fled immediately, wanting nothing more than to escape this trouble spot.

In a secluded spot, voices were speaking in hushed tones.

"What happened? How did you get spotted?"

"I don't know either! Two brats suddenly barged into the winery, and one of them started screaming bloody murder outside. I didn't even have time to take the next step."

"Damn it! Will our plan be exposed?"

"Hard to say. I was afraid the patrol would catch us, so I brought them back first."

"What's the use of bringing back two brats?"

"How is it useless? Do you know whose son this brat is?" Ivan was pulled out and shaken. "This is the youngest son of Andre, the Sheriff of Moyue Town! If necessary, he can be our shield."

"What about the other one?"

"He seems to be a cub brought by those newly arrived beastmen. But this kid is a bit bizarre. He was the one shouting outside, and he refused to enter the winery."

"Oh? Wake him up and ask him what he knows!"

Inside the town, at the winery.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai arrived at almost the exact same time as the Mayor and his group.

On their way, they had heard the town's alarm bell and seen the elderly and weak beastmen gathering toward the town center.

"What happened?" Bushuai asked immediately upon seeing the Mayor.

Standing in the winery's backyard, the Mayor looked at the several beastmen dragged out of the cellar, his voice heavy. "The winery workers have all been drugged unconscious."

"Drugged unconscious? No casualties?" Shang Feifan interjected.

The Mayor shook his head. "None. But we can't wake them up. Slapping their faces, splashing water, using medicine—nothing works."

"Auntie Yang and the apothecary are on their way," Sheriff Andre said.

"What about the winery owner? Where is Old Bert's family?" Bushuai asked.

The Mayor's expression was grim. "We haven't found them. His wife and children are missing too."

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai exchanged a look.

"Uncle, have you seen Ah Dai?" Bushuai asked.

The Mayor froze, then shook his head. "No. Have you checked the library? All the town's cubs are gathered there."

"I'll go take a look. Wait here for news." Shang Feifan turned and leaped onto Master Zheng's back.

Master Zheng bolted forward at lightning speed.

Shang Feifan had already learned of Ah Dai's kidnapping from the system, but he had to play along. Otherwise, how could he explain to the others how he knew Ah Dai had been abducted?

Besides, going to the library wasn't a pointless trip. He wanted to ask around and find out how Ah Dai had been kidnapped, and the first person he needed to find was Xia Bing.

Bushuai stayed behind to gather more information.

Before long, he learned from the patrol team that they had heard a cub's shouts.

"We didn't find any cubs when we rushed over. We only found them in the cellar," the squad leader said.

Bushuai instinctively assumed that the cub shouting about trouble was Ah Dai.

Having lived with Ah Dai for quite some time, he knew very well that the boy was only dim-witted on the surface; in reality, he was highly sensitive and clever.

"Has the wine in the winery been checked?" Bushuai asked.

Andre replied, "We're about to. We just arrived ourselves. We're waiting for the apothecary, Kang Cheng, and the priestess, Auntie Yang."

"Are there any signs of a struggle in the building?" Bushuai asked.

"None."

"Did Old Bert's family leave any clues?"

Andre made a welcoming gesture. "Shall we go take a look together?"

Bushuai did not refuse.

Andre wasn't just being polite; he genuinely wanted Bushuai's help.

Bushuai's innate talent lay in his hearing, but his personal observation skills were exceptionally sharp, and he was meticulous. Having worked with him a few times, Andre knew his capabilities well.

The Mayor stayed behind to oversee the overall situation.

Priestess Auntie Yang and apothecary Kang Cheng arrived shortly after.

The patrol team helped open a few random wine jars for them to inspect.

A few sheep were brought over as test subjects. If Auntie Yang and Kang Cheng couldn't find anything, they would have to feed the wine-soaked fodder to the live sheep.

While Bushuai went inside the winery's main building to investigate, Shang Feifan had already found Xia Bing.

Xia Bing was in a state of extreme anxiety. He was counting the cubs alongside other beastmen, but no matter how many times they counted, they were always short by two.

And one of them was Ah Dai!

"Boss!" Seeing Shang Feifan arrive, Xia Bing felt a mix of fear and relief, tears nearly welling in his eyes.

"Ah Dai is gone! I'm so sorry, I..."

Shang Feifan raised a hand. "Save the apologies for later. Tell me exactly what happened first."

Xia Bing quickly recounted everything he knew. He didn't shirk his responsibility, explaining that Ah Dai had been playing hide-and-seek with a group of cubs, so he hadn't followed him closely.

"After the alarm bell rang, all the cubs were brought here. The ones who were playing hide-and-seek are over there." Xia Bing pointed toward a group of cubs who had been set apart.

Because the two missing cubs had been playing with them, they had been separated so the adult beastmen could question them.

"Who is the other missing cub?" Shang Feifan asked.

"It's Ivan. Sheriff Andre's youngest son," Xia Bing answered.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. "Andre doesn't know yet, does he?"

Xia Bing shook his head. "They're still tallying the headcount here. No one has notified him yet."

Shang Feifan walked over to the cubs who had been playing hide-and-seek, where an adult beastman was currently questioning them for details.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡听了一会儿，总算从一堆乱七八糟的陈述中找出一两个重点。

“这么说阿呆一直和伊凡在一起？”

几个小幼崽齐齐点头。

“你们最后看到他们，是伊凡带着阿呆向酒坊的方向跑？”

这次只有一个小幼崽点头。

“阿呆有没有跟你们说什么？”

这次小幼崽们无法回答了。

人群中，一名老兽人忽然走了出来。

“你是阿呆的阿爸吧？我是卢西恩。”

商非凡听到这个熟悉的名字，不由看向这名老兽人：“您有什么事？”

同名的人很多，这位老兽人和那名咒术师卢希恩应该没有任何关系。

老兽人带着一点不确定说：“也许是我多心。但你们家阿呆之前跟我说了两句话，其中有一句让我特别在意，我当时以为他是在说我身上的味道，但那孩子摇头了。如果他没有失踪，我还不会多想，但现在……”

“他说了什么？”商非凡耐心问。

老兽人说：“他说他闻到了不好的味道。”

商非凡是知道他家阿呆有些奇异在身的，比如他成长缓慢，比如他能闻出活死人的味道。而玩家都拥有这种活死人的味道，但阿呆说他身上没有。

还有当初他们在强盗窝附近的河道边遇到诡异——恐惧之神的奴仆，不少兽人都死了，剩下所有活着的兽人都被带入异度空间，但阿呆却完好无损地待在了外面。

他问过阿呆他是怎么活下来的。

但阿呆自己都稀里糊涂，只说自己睡了一觉，睡醒就发现大家都不见了。

商非凡当时还猜测是不是恐惧之神的奴仆只会吞噬和带走能变身的兽人，把还不会变身的幼崽阿呆当做了普通野兽，这才忽视了他。

不好的味道？

这个说法太笼统，但能让阿呆特意说出来，应该是不同于一般的味道。

商非凡见在这边再也问不出新的消息，就带着夏冰跑回酒坊。

“你们最好能仔细检查这里的酒水。”商非凡一过来就说。

羊大婶已经检查了酒水，她还是一副邻家普通大婶的打扮，就连说话都没有神叨味：“抱歉，我什么都没看出来，但这酒水确实和之前的酒水有点不一样，也许里面掺入了一点黑暗的能量。我只能感知到这么多。”

镇长差点翻白眼。这说了跟没说有什么区别？

镇长又带着希望看向镇子里唯一的药剂师，其实是药剂师学徒康成。

康成也一脸尴尬，“这已经超过了我的知识范围。也许我们该用那几只活羊试试浸泡了酒水的草料。”

“既然查不出问题，以防万一，不如干脆把这些酒水都倒了。”一名兽人建议。

“等等，先别动那些酒水！”商非凡忽然走向一坛打开的酒水，探头嗅了嗅。
chunks.englishText:
>
Shang Feifan listened for a moment and finally managed to extract one or two key points from the jumble of chaotic accounts.

"So Ah Dai was with Ivan the entire time?"

The cubs nodded in unison.

"The last time you saw them, Ivan was leading Ah Dai toward the winery?"

This time, only one cub nodded.

"Did Ah Dai say anything to you?"

The cubs couldn't answer this.

Suddenly, an old beastman stepped out from the crowd.

"You're Ah Dai's father, right? I'm Lucian."

Hearing this familiar name, Shang Feifan couldn't help but look at the old beastman. "Is there something I can help you with?"

There were many people with the same name. This old beastman likely had no relation to the curse master, Luxian.

The old beastman said with a hint of uncertainty, "Perhaps I'm overthinking it. But your Ah Dai said a couple of things to me earlier, one of which caught my attention. At the time, I thought he was talking about my body odor, but the boy shook his head. If he hadn't gone missing, I wouldn't have given it a second thought, but now..."

"What did he say?" Shang Feifan asked patiently.

The old beastman replied, "He said he smelled a bad smell."

Shang Feifan knew that his Ah Dai possessed some extraordinary traits. For instance, he grew very slowly, and he could smell the scent of the living dead. Players all carried this scent of the living dead, though Ah Dai had told him that he didn't have it.

Furthermore, when they had encountered that anomaly—the Servant of the God of Fear—by the river near the bandits' lair, many beastmen had died, and all the remaining survivors had been dragged into an alternate dimension. Yet, Ah Dai had remained outside, completely unharmed.

He had asked Ah Dai how he survived.

But Ah Dai himself had been completely muddled, only saying that he had taken a nap and woke up to find everyone gone.

At the time, Shang Feifan had wondered if the Servant of the God of Fear only devoured and abducted beastmen capable of transformation, treating the untransformed cub Ah Dai as a common beast and thus overlooking him.

*A bad smell?*

The description was too vague, but for Ah Dai to mention it specifically, it had to be something out of the ordinary.

Seeing that he couldn't gather any more information here, Shang Feifan ran back to the winery with Xia Bing.

"You had better inspect the wine here very carefully," Shang Feifan said the moment he arrived.

Auntie Yang had already inspected the wine. She was still dressed like an ordinary neighborhood auntie, and even her speech lacked any mystical pretense. "I'm sorry, I couldn't find anything specific. However, this wine is indeed a bit different from before. Perhaps a trace of dark energy has been mixed into it. That is all I can perceive."

The Mayor nearly rolled his eyes. *How is that any different from saying nothing at all?*

The Mayor turned his hopeful gaze toward the town's only apothecary—who was actually just an apothecary apprentice—Kang Cheng.

Kang Cheng also looked embarrassed. "This is beyond the scope of my knowledge. Perhaps we should feed some fodder soaked in the wine to those live sheep to test it."

"Since we can't find the problem, just to be safe, why don't we just dump all this wine?" a beastman suggested.

"Wait, don't touch the wine yet!" Shang Feifan suddenly walked over to an open jar of wine, leaning in to sniff it.

chunks.chineseText:
第94章 救醒昏迷者

“虫毒。”

“什么？！”镇长等人大吃一惊。

商非凡转头：“你们都感觉不出来吗？这虫毒虽然不浓郁，但也算明显。”

镇长脸色大变，立刻下令：“把所有酒水都打开！”

全部酒坛都被搬到后院，一个接一个密封的酒坛被打开。

商非凡从中找出了七个含有虫毒的酒坛。

这下好了，有虫毒的酒水也不能随意倾倒，更别说找活物尝试。

动物异变的可能性要比兽人低，但接收过量虫毒一样会变异。异变动物的杀伤力会大大增加，而兽人一旦被异变动物咬中，就百分百有感染虫毒的危险。

“用火烧吧。”镇长无力挥手。

“等等。”商非凡开口：“这些酒水交给我，我能解决里面的虫毒。”

他已经感知过了，这些酒水里的虫毒他都能吸收。

“你怎么能感知到虫毒？”羊大婶忽然问道。

商非凡随口说：“我没说过吗，我的职业之一是虫族研究者。”

“就算是虫族研究者，也没办法解决虫毒吧？”羊大婶继续用疑惑的眼神看商非凡。

商非凡抬头，笑笑：“这就是我的天赋能力了。托上次有人诅咒我的福，诅咒者使用了虫族诅咒，当我解除诅咒后，我就觉醒了一个很特殊的血脉天赋。看到夏冰了吗，他曾经就中过虫毒，但被我救了回来，只是受到虫毒影响，他的脑袋暂时变不回来。”

夏冰在一边飞快点头。

他不知道商老大为什么要说破自己能解决虫毒的事，之前商老大还用这点威胁他，说如果世人知道他拥有对虫毒的抗毒能力，他的血液都会被人吸干。

只是能抵抗虫毒都能让世人疯狂，更何况是能彻底解决虫毒？

但他相信商老大敢说出来一定有他的道理。

羊大婶和镇长等在场人全都用吃惊和不信的目光看向商非凡。

从古至今，他们就从来没有听说有人能彻底解决虫毒。

这个人到底是在吹牛，还是在说真的？

如果是真的……

在场兽人的身体都微微颤抖起来。

他们在激动！

商非凡把这七坛酒水当着镇长等人的面，收入了雕像广场。

有空间却要藏着收着，太不方便，还不如大大方方地拿出来使用。

另，他其实并不能直接吸收虫毒，虽然他曾经吸收了虫母的九分之一心脏，让他对虫毒有了相当强的抵抗力。

这么说吧，虫毒在他身体里已经和他的身体其他能量形成某种平衡，如果吸收过多，依然会促使他身体向虫族方向变异，甚至不能保证自己的大脑不受影响。

但他能吸收感染虫毒导致变异的变异者死亡时的能量。

经过他自己研究，他发现不是不能直接吸收虫毒，而是需要加入能量一起，就像他不能干吃一斤辣椒粉，但如果把这一斤辣椒粉加入十瓶两千五百毫升的可乐中，不管这可乐味道有多么奇葩和刺激，还是能喝下去的。

最主要的是这样吸收的能量可以直接作用于他的各种能力上。

也就是辅助升级！

换言之，虫毒对他人来说是剧毒，但对他来说则是晋级的辅助法宝，当然不能就这么眼睁睁看着被烧掉。

镇长等人看到商非凡竟然有珍贵至极的空间储物工具，又是一通震惊和羡慕。

竟然是能瞬间收起七坛酒水的储物空间，那储物空间得多大？

商非凡的身份在他们眼中越发神秘。

镇长不由想了很多很多。

“对了，我有没有说我也是炼金师，最擅长的就是炼制空间储物工具，如果你们能提供材料，我就能给你们炼制，看在不帅的份上，只需要一点加工费。”

商非凡微笑。他还没有成功炼制过一件储物工具，不过牛可以先吹出去。如果这里真有人能拿出相应材料让他练手呢？

镇长等人被一连震惊数次，连话都说不出来。

“咳，我们先说这里的事。有人想要害我们镇子，这是肯定的了。”镇长干咳，打破寂静。

众人纷纷回神。

“是啊，太恶毒了，竟然想用从虫毒害我们。如果我们什么都不知道，让这些酒水流入镇中……天哪！我简直无法想象我们镇子会变成什么样！”

镇长用力点头：“是的，我们很幸运，我们及时发现了对方的阴谋。当然，我们还需要在整个镇子以及周边检查，以防还有其他针对我们的邪恶措施。”

巡逻小队队长满脸庆幸道：“感谢那个大叫的小幼崽吧，如果不是他，大家也不会那么快发现酒坊的变故。”

“是的是的。”镇长等人连连点头。

“你们谁看到那个小幼崽了？”镇长问巡逻队。

巡逻队苦笑：“我们真的没看到，我们来的时候，这里除了昏迷在酒窖内的几个人，就没有看到其他人。”

“我刚才去过图书馆，那边少了两个幼崽。”商非凡说。

“都少了谁？”镇长忙问。

商非凡：“我家阿呆，还有伊凡。”

刚刚从屋里走出来的安德烈听到，迅速冲过来：“你们说什么？伊凡怎么了？他是不是出事了？”

镇长忙拉住他：“安德烈你先别急。我们也正在查。”

安德烈表示自己不会做出过激的事情，摆脱镇长，询问商非凡：“伊凡到底怎么了？”

商非凡神色冷静异常：“我怀疑阿呆和伊凡很可能无意间看到了下毒者的举动，对方就把他们带走了。”

“什么？！”安德烈脸色瞬间变得苍白。

“为什么不是直接……杀死？”镇长尽量和缓地问。

商非凡：“下毒者能混入镇子却没有让镇民和巡逻队发现，说明他一定很熟悉巡逻队的巡逻线路和时间，也认识不少镇民，尤其镇长你和安德烈等人。”

“你是说下毒者认出伊凡是安德烈的儿子，才特意带走他，就为了后面威胁我们？”镇长直接说出来。

商非凡沉默。

安德烈脸色更加难看，突然转身就朝镇外走。

“站住！你去哪里？”镇长喝。

安德烈停住脚步，双拳紧握：“我去找林格莱特家族的人。最近来镇子的外人只有他们，也只有他们有人进入过镇子。”

“现在还不确定下毒者就是他们，而且如果他们不承认怎么办？”镇长其实也在怀疑林格莱特家族的人，但他必须比其他人更冷静。

“还能怎么办？只要迪莉娅夫人不在意，我们就……杀光他们！”安德烈手掌用力一挥，脸色狰狞。

“先等一下。”商非凡再次喊停。

众人一起看向他。

因为商非凡说他能解决虫毒，还从酒坛中找出含有虫毒的酒水，现在大家都很期待他有其他发现。

“就如镇长所说，是不是林格莱特家族还不确定，说不定有人就希望我们这么想。这几个昏迷的人是怎么回事？”商非凡一边说，一边已经走向昏迷者。

羊大婶回答：“他们似乎中了某种毒素，但应该不是虫毒。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 94: Awakening the Unconscious (Part 1)

"Insect venom."

"What?!" The town chief and the others were taken aback.

Shang Feifan turned his head. "Can't you all sense it? Though this insect venom isn't dense, it's distinct enough."

The town chief’s expression changed drastically, and he immediately gave the order: "Open all the jars of wine!"

All the wine jars were moved to the backyard, one sealed jar after another being unsealed.

From among them, Shang Feifan picked out seven jars that contained insect venom.

This presented a problem. Wine contaminated with insect venom couldn't be poured out casually, let alone used to test on living creatures.

The probability of animals mutating was lower than that of beastmen, but receiving an excessive amount of insect venom would still cause mutation. The lethality of a mutated animal would increase dramatically, and if a beastman were bitten by one, there was a hundred-percent risk of contracting the insect venom.

"Burn them with fire, then," the town chief said, waving his hand powerlessly.

"Wait," Shang Feifan spoke up. "Hand these jars of wine over to me. I can take care of the insect venom inside."

He had already sensed it; he could absorb all the insect venom present in these wines.

"How can you sense insect venom?" Auntie Yang suddenly asked.

Shang Feifan casually replied, "Didn't I mention it before? One of my professions is an Insect Race Researcher."

"Even if you're an Insect Race Researcher, there's no way to deal with insect venom, is there?" Auntie Yang continued to look at Shang Feifan with skeptical eyes.

Shang Feifan raised his head and smiled. "That is my innate talent. Thanks to the blessing of someone cursing me last time—the curse-caster used an Insect Race curse—once I lifted the curse, I awakened a very special bloodline talent. Have you seen Xia Bing? He was once infected with insect venom, but I saved him. It's just that due to the lingering effects of the venom, his head temporarily can't change back."

At the side, Xia Bing nodded rapidly.

He didn't know why Boss Shang wanted to expose his ability to handle insect venom. Previously, Boss Shang had even used this to threaten him, saying that if the world learned he possessed resistance to insect venom, his very blood would be sucked dry by people.

Merely being able to resist insect venom would drive the world crazy, let alone being able to completely neutralize it?

Yet, he believed that Boss Shang must have his reasons for daring to speak of it aloud.

Auntie Yang, the town chief, and everyone else present looked at Shang Feifan with expressions of shock and disbelief.

Since ancient times, they had never heard of anyone being able to completely resolve insect venom.

Was this person bragging, or telling the truth?

If it was true...

The bodies of the beastmen present trembled slightly.

They were stirred with excitement!

Right in front of the town chief and the others, Shang Feifan stored those seven jars of wine into the Statue Plaza.

Having spatial storage yet keeping it hidden was too inconvenient; it was better to simply take it out and use it openly.

Besides, the truth was that he couldn't directly absorb insect venom either, even though he had once absorbed one-ninth of the Insect Empress's heart, giving him a fairly strong resistance to it.

To put it simply, the insect venom in his body had already formed a certain balance with his body's other energies. If he absorbed too much, it would still drive his body to mutate toward the Insect Race, and he couldn't even guarantee that his brain wouldn't be affected.

However, he could absorb the energy released when mutants who had undergone mutation due to insect venom infection died.

Through his own research, he discovered that it wasn't that he couldn't absorb insect venom directly, but rather that it needed to be ingested alongside other energy. It was much like how he couldn't just eat a pound of chili powder dry, but if he mixed that pound of chili powder into ten bottles of two-thousand-five-hundred-milliliter cola, no matter how bizarre and stinging the cola tasted, he could still drink it down.

Most importantly, energy absorbed in this manner could directly empower his various abilities.

In other words, auxiliary leveling up!

To put it another way, insect venom was a deadly poison to others, but to him, it was an auxiliary treasure for leveling up. Of course, he couldn't just stand by and watch it get burned to ashes.

When the town chief and the others saw that Shang Feifan actually possessed an extremely precious spatial storage tool, they fell into another wave of shock and envy.

It was a spatial storage artifact capable of instantly stowing away seven jars of wine—just how massive must that storage space be?

In their eyes, Shang Feifan's identity grew increasingly mysterious.

The town chief couldn't help but let his thoughts wander far and wide.

"Oh right, did I mention that I'm also an alchemist, specializing in crafting spatial storage tools? If you can provide the materials, I can forge one for you. Considering our non-handsome bond, I'll only charge a small processing fee."

Shang Feifan smiled. He had never successfully crafted a spatial storage tool in his life, but there was no harm in bragging first. What if someone here actually produced the appropriate materials for him to practice on?

Stunned repeatedly several times in a row, the town chief and the others were left utterly speechless.

"Ahem, let's talk about the matter at hand. It's certain that someone is trying to harm our town," the town chief coughed dryly, breaking the silence.

Everyone snapped back to their senses.

"Indeed, how malicious! To actually try and harm us using insect venom. If we hadn't known any better and let this wine flow into the town... Good heavens! I simply cannot imagine what our town would have turned into!"

The town chief nodded heavily. "Yes, we are very fortunate that we discovered the enemy's plot in time. Of course, we still need to conduct searches throughout the town and its surroundings to guard against any other malicious measures targeting us."

The captain of the patrol squad said with a face full of lingering fear, "Thank that shouting little cub. If it weren't for him, everyone wouldn't have discovered the anomaly at the winery so quickly."

"Yes, yes, yes." The town chief and the others nodded repeatedly.

"Did any of you see that little cub?" the town chief asked the patrol squad.

The patrol squad laughed bitterly, "We really didn't see him. When we arrived, besides the few people unconscious in the wine cellar, we didn't see anyone else."

"I went to the library just now, and two little cubs are missing from there," Shang Feifan said.

"Who are missing?" the town chief asked hurriedly.

Shang Feifan replied, "My Ah Dai, and Ivan."

Hearing this, Andrei, who had just walked out of the house, rushed over quickly. "What did you say? What's wrong with Ivan? Did something happen to him?"

The town chief hurried to pull him back. "Andrei, don't panic yet. We are investigating right now."

Indicating that he wouldn't do anything rash, Andrei shook off the town chief and demanded of Shang Feifan, "What on earth happened to Ivan?"

Shang Feifan's expression was exceptionally calm. "I suspect that Ah Dai and Ivan likely accidentally witnessed the poisoner's actions, so the culprit took them away."

"What?!" Andrei's face instantly turned pale.

"Why didn't they just... kill them?" the town chief asked as gently as he could.

Shang Feifan: "The poisoner managed to sneak into the town without alerting the townspeople or the patrol squad, which means they must be very familiar with the patrol routes and timings, and they also know quite a few townspeople—especially you, Town Chief, and Andrei."

"You mean the poisoner recognized Ivan as Andrei's son and deliberately took him captive just to use him as leverage against us later?" the town chief blurted out.

Shang Feifan fell silent.

Andrei's expression grew even more unsightly. Abruptly turning around, he began to stride toward the town gates.

"Hold it right there! Where are you going?" the town chief barked.

Andrei stopped in his tracks, his fists clenched tightly. "I'm going to find the people of the Lingreit family. The only outsiders who have come to the town recently are them, and only they have people who have entered the town."

"We still haven't confirmed that the poisoner is from their family, and what will you do if they refuse to admit it?" The town chief was actually suspecting the Lingreit family as well, but he had to remain calmer than the others.

"What else can we do? As long as Lady Delia doesn't care, we'll... slaughter them all!" Andrei swept his arm downward forcefully, his face contorted in a ferocious snarl.

"Wait a moment," Shang Feifan called a halt once again.

Everyone turned to look at him.

Because Shang Feifan had claimed he could resolve insect venom and had successfully picked out the venom-tainted jars from the wine stock, everyone was now pinning high hopes on him having other discoveries.

"Just as the town chief said, it's not yet certain whether it's the Lingreit family. For all we know, someone might just be hoping that we'd jump to that conclusion. What's going on with these unconscious people?" As he spoke, Shang Feifan was already walking toward the unconscious victims.

Auntie Yang replied, "They seem to have been afflicted with some kind of poison, but it shouldn't be insect venom."

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡蹲下看了看，还划破其中一人的手指，放出一点血闻了闻：“确实不是虫毒。”

众人顿时松了口气。

镇长心中感到奇怪，商非凡带来的那个幼崽也失踪了，为什么商非凡看起来似乎不是那么紧张焦急？

商非凡看向药剂师康成，问：“你知道怎么解毒吗？”

康成尴尬：“我只是一个药剂师学徒，普通毒素我还有办法。但这种毒素我从未见过，也闻所未闻，我只能大略分辨出毒性，但如何解除……我连这是什么毒素都不知道，又要怎么给他们制作药剂？”

商非凡也有一个草药师学徒的职业头衔，也有相应技能，但这个毒，他同样不知道怎么解。

不过他比康成更占优势的一点就是他觉醒了瞳术天赋，和鉴定术结合后，他可以清楚看到这种毒素对昏迷兽人造成的影响。

“这种毒素不仅能造成人昏迷，它同时还在让中毒者器官不断衰竭，如果不能及时解毒，他们很可能会在昏迷中死亡。”

“这到底是什么毒？”镇长发怒：“难道我们这里来了一名毒师吗？”

商非凡摇头，同时开始翻找游戏商城里有没有相应的解毒-药。

“能操控虫毒，说不定和那些邪神阴影者有关系。”康成低声说。

羊大婶：“你是说邪神信徒？”

康成：“我听从摩罗城过来的兽人说，那边就出现了邪神信徒和虫毒散播者，摩罗城受到巨大损失……”

“不是操控虫毒，下毒者只是收集了虫毒，把它放入酒水中。”商非凡纠正。

“我去找伊凡，还有阿呆！”安德烈等不了了，打断其他人说话，对镇长说：“虽然不确定是林格莱特家族人做的，但我们总不能什么都不做，就这么干等着。”

镇长深吸一口气：“等会儿我和你一起去。先把他们控制起来也好。你去召集人手。”

安德烈立马跑走喊人。

商非凡没管安德烈，他的直觉告诉他安德烈就算带人去杀光林格莱特家族的人也不一定能找到两个小幼崽，他需要从其他方面入手，看能不能找到更多线索。

阿呆失踪没错，但他们现在手头上没有任何有效线索，光是锁定林格莱特家族的人还不够。

这太明显了，简直就像是有人让他们去找林格莱特家族的人一样。

再加上安德烈已经跑去召集人手准备去找林格莱特的麻烦，他自然没必要也去凑这个热闹。

因为不知道具体是什么毒素，商非凡只能从器官衰竭和深度昏迷这些词着手进行搜索。

最后他找出四种有可能有对应效果的药剂，经过对说明内容的精心对比，以及价格比较，最终选出两种。

一种是万能解毒-药剂，除了虫毒和活毒，什么毒都能解。就是很贵，一支就要88贡献点。

另一种药剂叫九红草解毒-药剂，这种解毒-药专门针对一种血脉天赋毒素，该血脉天赋毒素的效果就是散发出浓香，致使人昏迷和器官衰竭，会让人死得无声无息，就像是睡眠死一样。

药剂说明中还特别指出，在以前人们不知道这种血脉天赋毒素时，遇到被这种毒素迷昏的人，都以为他们得了怪病，或者就干脆认为是自然死亡。

直到使用这种毒素的兽人被抓到，人们才知道这种毒素竟然是一种血脉天赋。

之后治疗祭司和药剂师们用这名被抓住的兽人做实验，经过长久验证，终于找到一种九红草可以解除这种血脉毒素。

九红草在自然界不算特别珍稀，制作方法也不是很困难，只要知道配方，就是初级药剂师也能配制出来。

所以这支药剂在商城里的价格也不贵，只要10贡献点。

商非凡决定先买一支九红草解毒-药剂给昏迷的兽人试试，如果有效，他就不用购买更贵的万能解毒-药剂。

“我这里有一种药剂，我不知道对昏迷兽人是否有效，可以给他们试试。但我不保证效果。”

镇长立刻说：“你尽管试！出事我负责，另外你的药剂由镇子买下，你出个价。”

“一支药剂成本价三十银。”

“如果有效，我给你五十一支！”

商非凡就喜欢这种爽快人，立刻拿出药剂给康成：“直接喂昏迷者喝下就可以。”

康成小心接过药剂，找了身体最健壮的一个昏迷兽人，和羊大婶一起，掰开他的嘴巴，把药剂给灌了进去。

就在大家焦急等待昏迷兽人的反应时，虎不帅从屋里出来。

安德烈和他一起在主屋寻找线索，但安德烈什么都没找到，虎不帅有自己的特殊手段，就在屋里多待了一会儿。

一出来他就看到一名昏迷兽人眼皮抖动着，慢慢苏醒。

“有效！这药剂有效！”康成发出惊喜叫声。

商非凡又拿出四支药剂递给康成，还有四个昏迷兽人。

“你们谁知道拥有血脉天赋毒素的兽人？就是能散发出浓香，能致使人昏迷还能让人器官衰竭，但表面看，中毒的兽人就像是睡着一样的毒素。”商非凡大声问。

镇长一惊：“你确定是哪种毒素了吗？”

商非凡指向药剂：“这叫九红草解毒-药剂。”

不等镇长回应，康成那边已经先一步叫道：“我知道这种药剂！我也听过你说的那种血脉天赋毒素，对，九红草解毒-药剂就是专门解这种毒。只是中了那种毒素的兽人很难被看出来到底是中了什么毒，而九红草又不能随便乱使用，九红草本身就有毒，所以中那那种毒素的人往往会错过最佳解毒时间。”

康成握拳：“太好了！幸好商先生看出了昏迷者是中了血脉天赋毒素，身上还恰好有九红草解毒-药剂。”

虎不帅不由看向康成。

这位药剂师学徒在莫约镇一向不太显眼，因为镇上没有真正的药剂师，所以大家才会尊称他一声药剂师，但这位的制药能力……

先不说这位的能力如何，不知道是不是他的错觉，他怎么觉得康成说的话像是话中藏着话？

商非凡轻笑。康成的手段对他来说就跟小儿科一样，他连辩解都懒得辩解。

镇长也看向了康成，但目光中是不赞成。

在场只要有点脑子的人都听出了康成的言外之意。

有人警惕，有人皱眉，也有人不赞同。

“我在王城那边听过拥有这种血脉天赋的兽人。”虎不帅开口。

众人一起转头。

“你找到什么线索了吗？”商非凡迎向虎不帅。

不帅对他使了个眼色，在他身边站定。

镇长也询问不帅，有没有找到什么线索。

不帅微微点头，没有具体描述，只说：“我听到了亡者的哀嚎，老伯特家中一定在最近死了人。”

镇长皱眉：“我没听说过。”

作为祭司的羊大婶也说：“我也没听老伯特说他家最近有人死亡。”

“他的妻子和孩子最近有露面吗？”不帅问。

众人陷入回忆。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan squatted down to take a look, then even sliced open the finger of one of them, drawing a drop of blood to sniff. "Indeed, it is not insect venom."

The surrounding crowd instantly breathed a sigh of relief.

The town mayor felt a trace of doubt. The little cub brought by Shang Feifan had also gone missing, so why didn't Shang Feifan seem particularly tense or anxious?

Shang Feifan looked toward the apothecary Kang Cheng and asked, "Do you know how to cure this poison?"

Kang Cheng wore an awkward expression. "I am merely an apothecary's apprentice; I can handle ordinary toxins. But this kind of poison I have never seen nor heard of. I can only roughly distinguish its toxicity, but as for how to cure it... I don't even know what kind of poison this is, so how am I supposed to brew a remedy for them?"

Shang Feifan also held the professional title of herbalist apprentice and possessed the corresponding skills, yet he was equally clueless about how to lift this poison.

However, the advantage he held over Kang Cheng was that he had awakened a pupillary technique talent. Combined with his Appraisal skill, he could clearly perceive the toll this poison was taking on the unconscious beastmen.

"This toxin not only induces unconsciousness, but it also causes the victims' organs to constantly fail. If it is not detoxified in time, they will likely perish in their sleep."

"What kind of poison is this?" the town mayor fumed. "Could it be that a toxic master has infiltrated our territory?"

Shang Feifan shook his head while simultaneously browsing the gaming store interface to check for any corresponding antidotes.

"Being able to manipulate insect venom—perhaps this is connected to those Evil God's Shadow figures," Kang Cheng murmured under his breath.

Auntie Yang chimed in, "Are you speaking of the Evil God's cultists?"

Kang Cheng replied, "I heard from beastmen coming from Molo City that Evil God cultists and insect venom spreaders appeared over there, inflicting heavy losses on Molo City..."

"It is not a matter of manipulating insect venom. The poisoner merely gathered the venom and laced it into the wine and water," Shang Feifan corrected him.

"I'm going to find Ivan, and Ah Dai!" Andre could wait no longer. Cutting off the others, he said to the town mayor, "Even though we aren't certain this was done by the Ringlesteat family, we cannot simply do nothing and sit here waiting."

The town mayor took a deep breath. "I shall go with you shortly. It would be best to place them under control first. Go gather some men."

Andre immediately bolted off to summon people.

Shang Feifan paid Andre no mind. His intuition told him that even if Andre led a troop to slaughter the entire Ringlesteat family, he might not necessarily find the two little cubs. He needed to approach the matter from a different angle to see if he could unearth more clues.

It was true that Ah Dai had gone missing, but they currently lacked any effective leads; merely locking onto members of the Ringlesteat family was far from sufficient.

It was all too obvious—it felt precisely as though someone was intentionally guiding them to target the Ringlesteats.

Coupled with the fact that Andre had already rushed off to rally men and stir up trouble for the Ringlesteats, there was naturally no need for Shang Feifan to join in the commotion.

Since the exact nature of the toxin was unknown, Shang Feifan could only narrow down his search using keywords like "organ failure" and "deep coma."

Eventually, he fished out four kinds of potions that might have corresponding effects. After carefully comparing their item descriptions and pricing, he finally narrowed it down to two.

The first was a Universal Antidote Potion, capable of neutralizing any poison aside from insect venom and living toxins. The catch was its steep price—a single vial cost 88 contribution points.

The second potion was called the Nine-Red Herb Antidote Potion. This specialized antidote targeted a specific bloodline talent toxin. The effect of this bloodline toxin was to emit a rich fragrance that induced unconsciousness and organ failure, allowing victims to slip away silently without a sound, much like dying in their sleep.

The potion's description even specifically noted that back when people were still ignorant of this bloodline talent toxin, anyone who fell unconscious from it was thought to have contracted a strange illness or simply believed to have died of natural causes.

It wasn't until a beastman utilizing this poison was captured that people realized the venom was actually a bloodline talent.

Following that, healing priests and apothecaries used the captured beastman for experiments. After prolonged verification, they finally discovered that the Nine-Red Herb could neutralize this bloodline toxin.

In nature, the Nine-Red Herb was not exceptionally rare, nor was the brewing process overly difficult. As long as one knew the formula, even a junior apothecary could concoct it.

Thus, the price of this potion in the store was not high either—merely 10 contribution points.

Shang Feifan decided to first purchase a vial of the Nine-Red Herb Antidote Potion and test it on the unconscious beastmen. If it proved effective, he would be spared from buying the far more expensive universal antidote.

"I have a potion here. I am uncertain whether it will be effective on the unconscious beastmen, but we can try giving it to them. However, I cannot guarantee the results."

The town mayor immediately declared, "By all means, try it! I shall take responsibility if anything goes wrong. Furthermore, your potion will be purchased by the town—name your price."

"The production cost of a single vial is thirty silver coins."

"If it works, I'll pay you fifty silver coins a vial!"

Shang Feifan loved dealing with such straightforward people. He immediately produced the potion and handed it to Kang Cheng. "Just pour it directly down the unconscious patients' throats."

Kang Cheng cautiously took the potion, selected the most robust-looking unconscious beastman, and with the help of Auntie Yang, pried open the man's mouth to force the liquid down.

Just as everyone was anxiously awaiting the beastman's reaction, Tiger Hansu emerged from the house.

Andre had searched the main house for clues alongside him, but Andre had found nothing. Tiger Hansu, possessing his own special methods, had lingered inside the house a moment longer.

As soon as he stepped out, he saw the eyelids of one unconscious beastman twitching as he slowly blinked awake.

"It works! This potion works!" Kang Cheng cried out in pleasant surprise.

Shang Feifan produced four more vials of the potion and handed them to Kang Cheng for the remaining four unconscious beastmen.

"Does anyone here know of a beastman possessing a bloodline talent poison? Specifically, one that emits a rich fragrance, induces unconsciousness, and causes organ failure, yet on the surface makes the poisoned victim look as though they are merely fast asleep?" Shang Feifan asked in a loud voice.

The town mayor was startled. "Are you certain which poison this is?"

Shang Feifan pointed toward the potion. "This is called the Nine-Red Herb Antidote Potion."

Before the town mayor could respond, Kang Cheng chimed in ahead of him, "I know of this potion! I have also heard of the bloodline talent toxin you mentioned. Yes, the Nine-Red Herb Antidote Potion is specifically designed to cure that exact poison. It's just that beastmen afflicted by that toxin rarely show signs of what kind of poison they've taken, and the Nine-Red Herb cannot be used casually since it is toxic in its own right. As a result, those afflicted by that poison often miss the optimal window for a cure."

Kang Cheng clenched his fist. "Wonderful! Fortunately, Mr. Shang was able to discern that the unconscious victims were suffering from a bloodline talent toxin, and coincidentally happened to have the Nine-Red Herb Antidote Potion on hand."

Tiger Hansu could not help but glance at Kang Cheng.

This apothecary's apprentice had always kept a low profile in Moyue Town. Because there were no genuine apothecaries in the town, everyone respectfully addressed him as an apothecary, but this fellow's pill-crafting capabilities...

Putting aside his abilities for a moment, whether it was his imagination or not, why did it feel as though Kang Cheng's words carried a hidden meaning?

Shang Feifan chuckled lightly. Kang Cheng's little schemes were mere child's play to him; he couldn't even be bothered to offer a rebuttal.

The town mayor also looked at Kang Cheng, though his gaze carried disapproval.

Anyone with half a brain present could read between the lines of Kang Cheng's words.

Some grew vigilant, some frowned, and others felt a sense of disapproval.

"I have heard of beastmen possessing this kind of bloodline talent over in the Royal City," Tiger Hansu spoke up.

Everyone turned their heads in unison.

"Did you find any clues?" Shang Feifan turned to meet Tiger Hansu.

Hansu gave him a meaningful look and stepped over to stand beside him.

The town mayor likewise questioned Hansu, asking if he had uncovered any leads.

Hansu nodded slightly, omitting the specific details and merely stating, "I heard the wailing of the dead. Someone in Old Robert's household must have died recently."

The town mayor frowned. "I haven't heard about that."

Auntie Yang, acting in her capacity as a priest, also chimed in, "Nor have I heard Old Robert mention anyone in his family passing away recently."

"Have his wife and child been seen lately?" Hansu asked.

The crowd fell into recollection.

chunks.chineseText:
羊大婶摇头：“这段时间情况特殊，大家大多都待在家里，有人长时间没出门，也没有人奇怪。老伯特家的孩子都大了，也不用去图书馆上课，他妻子伊莎又是不太喜欢和别人来往的文静性格，我好像已经有五六天没看到伊莎和她的孩子们。”

“想要知道老伯特家的情况，问这几个酒坊工人就知道了。”商非凡指向已经苏醒的五名兽人。

他这么费心巴力地救醒这几个兽人，就是想要从他们嘴里问出一些线索。

致使这五名兽人昏迷的下毒者大概压根就没想过有人能救醒他们，所以他走时才没有彻底处理这几名兽人。

当然，也可能是因为小幼崽的叫声，导致他时间不够，最后只能来得及带走阿呆和伊凡，其他事就没能来得及收尾。

很快，被救醒的五名兽人在镇长询问下，把他们知道的事情都说了出来。

期间，商非凡把阿呆和伊凡失踪的事告诉了虎不帅。

虎不帅眉头紧皱。

“老伯特的儿子杰夫带回了一名美貌女兽人？”镇长眉头皱成疙瘩，这都是什么古老桥段！

“为什么我们都不知道这件事？”

那名身体最健壮的兽人干笑：“因为老伯特让我们不要说出去，而且那个女兽人看起来很柔弱，她的本体还是一只小兔子，还受伤了。我们也觉得没必要拿这件小事惊动镇子。”

镇长和其他人：……如果是在平时，这种事确实没必要通报给镇子知晓，而人都喜欢多一事不如少一事，老伯特家会隐瞒那个女兽人的事也不算多出格。

“那个女兽人和林格莱特家族有关吗？”镇长问。

五名兽人一起摇头，还是最健壮的兽人回答：“不是，杰夫说是在运送酒水去邻村的途中遇到了简妮。简妮是那个兔族女兽人的名字。”

“她有说她是什么来历吗？”

“这……”五名兽人再次摇头，“简妮胆子很小，被杰夫带回来后就待在屋里很少出来，她也不怎么和大家说话。杰夫说她是逃出来的，但具体是从哪里逃出来，杰夫没说。”

“老伯特和他的妻子伊莎，还有他的孩子杰夫和詹妮，这段时间都还好吗？”镇长又问。

这次五名兽人回答就不一致了，有人表示不清楚，有人露出迟疑表情。

“马顿，你说！”镇长指向神色迟疑的那名较为瘦小的兽人。

马顿看看左右，说道：“伊莎阿姨的身体似乎出了问题，就在那名兔族女兽人来了不久，可能是第二天还是第三天，伊莎阿姨就卧床不起。我问过伯特叔，伯特叔回答很含糊，只说伊莎阿姨累到了，需要休息。还有……”

“还有什么？你大胆说！”镇长耐着性子问。

马顿抿了抿嘴唇，拉开和最健壮的兽人之间的距离：“亚力克喜欢詹妮，但詹妮一直不想理会他。那个兔兽人简妮来了后，亚力克又看上了简妮，看她柔弱，还想占她便宜。”

“马顿！你胡说什么！”亚力克大吼，还想扑过来打马顿，被巡逻小队长一把按住。

“马顿你继续说。”镇长黑脸。

马顿似乎也憋了很久，终于找到机会一样，一股脑都倒了出来。

按照马顿所说，兔兽人简妮被杰夫带回来后，老伯特家中就变得不安生起来。

首先是伊莎阿姨病倒，一直卧床不起，除了老伯特，似乎其他人再也没有看到伊莎阿姨。

其次就是詹妮。詹妮不喜欢简妮，和杰夫争吵。詹妮想要离开家，却被老伯特拦住，还被老伯特关了起来。

然后亚力克想要占兔兽人简妮的便宜，但不知道简妮是怎么说的，亚力克又重新把目标放到了詹妮身上。似乎简妮说会帮亚力克把詹妮搞到手，简妮还说她会帮亚力克和老伯特说话，让老伯特同意亚力克娶詹妮。

之后亚力克就和兔兽人走得很近，还帮她做事。

马顿信誓旦旦地说老伯特家一定发生了不好的事情，他想进入主屋找老伯特说话，但每次都是亚力克拦着他，不让他进入主屋。

他试图和杰夫以及詹妮说话，也被亚力克阻拦。亚力克还故意挑衅说他是不是也看上了詹妮，想要和他抢。

马顿打不过亚力克，老伯特似乎也一心照料自己生病的妻子，这段时间几乎不怎么管酒坊的事，偏偏亚力克又摆出一副酒坊管事的架势，所有事情都要经过亚力克同意，老伯特对亚力克掌权貌似也没意见，马顿又不能没有这份工作，就只能忍耐。

亚力克不住大吼，说马顿污蔑胡扯。

镇长让巡逻队的人压住亚力克，把他带到一边审问。

“杰夫呢？你为什么没有怎么提到杰夫？”镇长盯着马顿的眼睛看。

马顿抿唇，垂下眼眸：“杰夫被那个兔兽人迷得神魂颠倒，那个兔兽人对他说什么就是什么，他跟没有自己意志一样，整个人都被迷傻了。”

商非凡看到马顿神情，搓了搓下巴。这个马顿大概率不是喜欢老伯特的女儿詹妮，而是喜欢儿子杰夫？

这大概也是马顿为什么受亚力克欺负还要待在酒坊的原因，因为不放心杰夫？

“杰夫有没有做什么事情？我是说他有没有什么异常行为？”镇长逼问。

马顿垂着头，似乎在回忆，又像是不想说。

商非凡上前一步：“如果没有我的药剂，你们已经死了。你们知道自己中毒了吗？”

马顿抬头，快速看了眼商非凡，点头：“昏迷前，我闻到了一股强烈的浓香。”

“在你闻到浓香之前呢，你看到了什么？”商非凡走到马顿面前。

马顿受到压迫，忍不住往后退了一步。

“马顿！”镇长神色严厉：“你知道什么就全说出来，现在不是隐瞒的时候。老伯特一家都失踪了，同时还有两个小幼崽也跟着不见，其中就有安德烈的孩子伊凡，还有你救命恩人的孩子！”

马顿双手不断松握，神色动摇，就在大家要不耐烦时，他松口了：“我看到杰夫拿着一个小瓶子，往酒坛里加某种粉末。我问他那是什么，杰夫跟我说是一种增加酒味风味的特别佐料。我觉得不对劲，逼问他那到底是什么佐料，杰夫说得驴头不对马嘴，我就说要去问伯特叔。

杰夫拉住我不让我去，我越发觉得不对劲，问他加的东西是不是那个兔兽人让他加的。杰夫不承认，还骂我多管闲事，和我吵了起来。我说要把兔兽人的事告诉治安官，杰夫就……对我动手，他想杀了我！”

马顿似乎伤心透了，身体颤抖：“亚力克他们听到声音也进入酒窖，亚力克只顾着看笑话，其他人帮忙拉开杰夫。我想说出杰夫往酒坛里下未知佐料的事，但还没开口就闻到了一股浓香味，然后我就什么都不知道了。”
chunks.englishText:
Auntie Yang shook her head. "The situation has been unusual lately; most people have been staying indoors. If someone hasn't ventured outside for a long time, nobody finds it strange. Old Robert's children are all grown up and don't need to go to the library for classes. Furthermore, his wife, Isa, has a quiet personality and doesn't care much for socializing. It seems I haven't seen Isa and her children for five or six days."

"If you want to know the situation at Old Robert's place, just ask these winery workers." Shang Feifan pointed toward the five Orcs who had already regained consciousness.

The very reason he had gone to such painstaking lengths to revive these Orcs was to extract clues from their mouths.

The poisoner who caused these five Orcs to lapse into a coma probably never imagined that anyone could revive them, which was why he hadn't completely exterminated these Orcs before leaving.

Of course, it could also be because the little cub's cries had cut his time short, leaving him with no choice except to snatch away Ah Dai and Yifan while failing to tie up the loose ends elsewhere.

Soon, under the mayor's questioning, the five revived Orcs spilled everything they knew.

During this period, Shang Feifan informed Hu Bushuai of the disappearance of Ah Dai and Yifan.

Hu Bushuai's brows furrowed deeply.

"Old Robert's son, Jeff, brought back a beautiful female Orc?" The mayor's brows knitted into a tight knot—what kind of antiquated cliché was this!

"Why didn't any of us know about this?"

The most robust-built Orc gave a dry laugh. "Because Old Robert told us not to spread the word. Besides, that female Orc looked very frail, her original form was just a little rabbit, and she was injured too. We didn't think it necessary to make a fuss and disturb the town over such a minor matter."

The mayor and the others: ......Under normal circumstances, such a matter indeed didn't warrant reporting to the town. Moreover, people naturally preferred to avoid extra trouble, so Old Robert's family concealing the rabbit female wasn't entirely out of line.

"Is that female Orc connected to the Lingleite family?" the mayor asked.

The five Orcs shook their heads in unison, and the sturdiest Orc answered once again, "No. Jeff said he ran into Jenny on the way to deliver wine to a neighboring village. Jenny is the rabbit-tribe female Orc's name."

"Did she say what her background was?"

"This..." The five Orcs shook their heads once more. "Jenny is extremely timid. Ever since Jeff brought her back, she has stayed inside the house and rarely comes out, nor does she talk much with anyone. Jeff said she escaped, but he didn't specify from where."

"How have Old Robert, his wife Isa, and his children Jeff and Jenny been doing lately?" the mayor asked again.

This time, the five Orcs gave inconsistent answers. Some expressed ignorance, while others wore hesitant expressions.

"Mardon, you speak!" The mayor pointed at the somewhat scrawny Orc with the hesitant look.

Mardon glanced left and right before saying, "Auntie Isa's health seems to have run into trouble. Not long after that rabbit-tribe female Orc arrived—maybe the second or third day—Auntie Isa became bedridden. I asked Uncle Robert about it, but his reply was very vague, only saying that Auntie Isa was exhausted and needed rest. Also..."

"Also what? Speak your mind!" the mayor urged with fading patience.

Mardon pursed his lips and distanced himself a bit from the sturdiest Orc. "Alex fancies Jenny, but Jenny has always ignored him. After that rabbit beastman Jenny arrived, Alex set his sights on Jenny instead. Seeing how delicate she is, he even tried to take advantage of her."

"Mardon! What are you spouting nonsense for?!" Alex roared, lunging forward to strike Mardon, only to be firmly pinned down by the leader of the patrol squad.

"Mardon, continue," the mayor said with a dark expression.

Mardon also seemed to have been holding this in for a long time; finding an opening at last, he poured it all out in one breath.

According to Mardon, ever since the rabbit beastman Jenny was brought back by Jeff, Old Robert's household had ceased to have any peace.

First, Auntie Isa fell ill and remained bedridden; aside from Old Robert, it seemed no one else had laid eyes on Auntie Isa since.

Second was Jenny. Jenny disliked Jenny (the rabbit) and argued with Jeff. Jenny wanted to leave home, but Old Robert blocked her path and even locked her up.

Then came Alex's attempt to take advantage of the rabbit beastman Jenny. However, nobody knew what Jenny had whispered to him, but Alex had promptly redirected his target back to Jenny (the daughter). It seemed Jenny claimed she would help Alex get Jenny into his hands, and she also promised to put in a good word for Alex with Old Robert so that the latter would agree to let Alex marry Jenny.

After that, Alex grew very close to the rabbit beastman and even started running errands for her.

Mardon swore up and down that something must have gone terribly wrong at Old Robert's house. He had tried to enter the main house to speak with Old Robert, but Alex had blocked him every single time, refusing to let him in.

Whenever he attempted to speak with Jeff and Jenny, Alex intercepted him there as well. Alex even deliberately provoked him, asking if he, too, had taken a fancy to Jenny and wanted to steal her away.

Mardon couldn't beat Alex in a fight, and Old Robert seemed entirely consumed with nursing his sick wife, paying almost no attention to winery affairs during this period. To top it all off, Alex put on the airs of a winery manager, demanding that all matters pass through his approval. Old Robert appeared indifferent to Alex seizing power, and since Mardon couldn't afford to lose his job, he had no choice but to endure.

Alex shrieked incessantly at the top of his lungs, claiming Mardon was slandering and talking nonsense.

The mayor ordered the patrol guards to pin Alex down and drag him aside for interrogation.

"What about Jeff? Why haven't you mentioned much about Jeff?" The mayor stared straight into Mardon's eyes.

Mardon pressed his lips together and lowered his gaze. "Jeff was completely bewitched by that rabbit beastman. Whatever she told him, he believed without question. It was like he had lost his own will; his whole being had been charmed into a stupor."

Watching Mardon's expression, Shang Feifan rubbed his chin. Was this Mardon unlikely to be infatuated with Old Robert's daughter Jenny, but rather with the son, Jeff?

This probably explained why Mardon tolerated Alex's bullying and stayed at the winery—out of worry for Jeff?

"Did Jeff do anything? I mean, did he exhibit any abnormal behavior?" the mayor pressed.

Mardon lowered his head, appearing to recall something, or perhaps reluctant to speak.

Shang Feifan stepped forward. "Without my potion, you'd all be dead right now. Do you even know you were poisoned?"

Mardon raised his head, cast a quick glance at Shang Feifan, and nodded. "Before losing consciousness, I smelled a strong, heavy fragrance."

"Before you smelled that heavy fragrance, what did you see?" Shang Feifan walked right up to Mardon.

Feeling the pressure, Mardon couldn't help taking a step back.
