This information was given by his most favored close attendant, so the accuracy is very high. This Valley Master prepared quite a grand procession for himself; he gave his personal guards a quest to escort him on a state visit to the Tiger Kingdom's royal capital. A total of four players accepted the quest, alongside four indigenous beastmen."

GarbledText: "Do you even need to promote my continent-level award-winning beef? It's already in short supply, okay?! What mode of travel is he using?"

OldSteedStout: "That's still just a continental award, not world-class. Connecting with the players around him will take a little time."

GarbledText: "I'll wait for your reply."

OldSteedStout: "Ok! Please prepare the following amount of beef: fifty silver coins to buy the Valley Master's recent movements and departure news, two gold coins for his whereabouts, one gold coin for the castle construction blueprints, and one gold coin for his itinerary schedule. That's a total of four gold and fifty silver coins—which translates to ninety catties of beef."

GarbledText: "I'll give you a hundred catties!"

OldSteedStout: "Thanks, boss! The boss is supreme! Feel free to contact me anytime; 7-star service guaranteed!"

When Bu Shuai woke up, Shang Feifan had also successfully obtained the most complete castle construction blueprints currently in players' hands, along with the latest itinerary schedule of the Sky-Remnant Valley Master.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第100章 情报贩子、旅途中 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
真的是行程表，上面从他什么时候出发、在哪里宿营、接触了什么人、下一站要去往哪里，全都罗列得清清楚楚。甚至就连谷主找到的两个隐蔽传送阵，都被标注出详细地点。

不得不说老伏找的那些情报贩子都是人才。

至于谷主身边那些喊着对谷主忠心的玩家侍卫……嗯，八十银是他们的忠心底线价。

倒不是说玩家不忠心，只是在所有玩家都以为兽人世界的NPC只是一段数据时，就算外表再俊美、性格再完美，也抵不过现实货币的冲击。

要是天残谷主知道他身边的侍卫只要八十银就能被收买……

商非凡忍不住笑起来。

不帅收起自己的睡袋，“你在笑什么？”

商非凡看向不帅。

不帅可能没察觉，他刚睡醒，无论是表情还是声音都有点软软的，让人看了就想……欺负他。

商非凡舔了舔嘴唇，声音有点暗哑：“我在笑某人不知道玩家的真实威力。他想利用玩家，最终很可能会被玩家玩死。”

“……祝福他？”不帅为这个某人点了根蜡烛。老商似乎还没意识到他嘴巴的威力。

啊，这个表情有点犯规啊。商非凡忽然一把抱住不帅，重重地收紧手臂，在不帅挣扎时又放开。

不帅心惊胆战，就在刚才，他感觉到了商非凡极为可怕的侵略性，他刚才都以为商非凡会……

“我弄到了几幅城堡建设图，其中有些图形和刻纹让我很在意，我想让你也看看。但我不知道该怎么弄出来。”商非凡点了点自己的大脑。

不帅：“呃，如果你脑中能浮现非常清晰的图纸，我有一个办法能看到你看到的。”

“什么办法？”

“有一个魔法叫通感术。利用精神力链接把两人的大脑短时间链接起来，在互相信任和不抵抗的情况下，可以让施法一方看到被施法一方脑中最清晰的画面。”

不帅顿了顿：“但这个魔法局限性很多，施展成功的可能性也比较低。”

“是信任度不够对吗？”商非凡也通过游戏商城获得了不少魔法基础知识，不帅一说魔法的名字，他就知道是什么魔法。

不帅点头。

商非凡信心十足：“我们试试。别人不行，但我们一定行。我信任你！你来施法。”

不帅：“……你确定？我也许会看到其他你不想我看到的内容。”

不帅表面神色不动，心里却很震撼。

他觉得商非凡就是不了解这个魔法，才会答应的这么干脆。

在法德尔大陆，尤其是魔法师之间，大家都知道这个魔法的威力，而人的思想是最不容易控制的，谁也不知道自己在和别人链接大脑时会想些什么，也不知道对方会看到什么。

基于这种担心，极少有魔法师会互相使用这个魔法，更少有人答应自己成为被施法的那一方。

只有在特殊情况下，比如说战败的俘虏和弱势的一方，为了取信强势的那一方，只能屈辱和被迫地答应展开自己的大脑。

别说对个人隐私非常注重的洛伦米尔顿，就是极为信任他的奥尔，恐怕都不会轻易答应他对他施展这个通感术。

不帅也不会随便对别人施展这个魔法。

刚才他就是随口一提，没想到商非凡竟然那么轻易地就答应了。

商非凡已经摆出了让不帅任意施为的架势。

不帅：“……好吧。如果你感到不适，可以随时喊停。”

这个法术中还有精神强行压制的一环，让被施法者就算想要反抗也难。

但不帅肯定不会这么对商非凡。

不帅默念咒语，随后靠近商非凡，额头与其额头相贴。

“放轻松，不要抗拒。”

半点不打算抗拒的商非凡：这个好！他喜欢这个姿势。

额头相贴不是必要，但可以保证魔力和精神力输出稳定，同时也能形成一个有形的稳定连接，如果一方想要结束，只要退开就可以，操作起来比较简单，对大脑的伤害性也最低。

商非凡也抬手抱住不帅的后脑勺，脑中思绪放空，先放不帅的精神力进来。

这是开门的过程。

不帅的精神力很礼貌地在外面等了等，等到商非凡给出明确的邀请信号，他的精神力才慢慢进入商非凡大脑。

一般人的大脑思绪会很紊乱，一秒钟内都能切换几十个混乱想法，想要锁定一个固定画面还要一直保持在这个画面上，对绝大多数人来说都是一个难题。

但商非凡的精神力非常坚韧，而且他还受过特别训练。可以确保自己的大脑在极端痛苦的情况下仍旧能只锁定某些特定内容，不管别人怎么拷问，都只会说出这些特定内容。

同样他也能在瞬间给出无数杂乱信息，就算有人能侵入他大脑，也很难从浩瀚且杂乱的信息中得到有效情报。

所以商非凡很轻易地把伏向军传给他的城堡建设图在脑中清晰重现，让不帅的精神力能清楚共感。

天残谷主那边为了方便玩家接取任务，就把城堡建设图弄成了电子图，上传到笔记本系统中，分发给领取了相关任务的玩家。

而且他大概是笃定玩家和兽人大陆的生灵不可能知道魔法，所以他没有对设计图做任何手脚，甚至没有多少隐瞒。

这也方便了伏向军，不用愁到哪里弄来扫描仪器把图纸扫描给商非凡。

现在玩家那边有一些专业人才正在设法把地球那边的工业链给复制到游戏中，他们想要把地球那边的照相机、扫描仪，甚至是电脑手机等都在游戏中复现。

实际上如果天残谷主愿意开放玩家账户，让某些研发公司和研究所人员进驻到游戏中，那些人一定会利用这个游戏百分百全息的特点，在这里复现地球科技并做各种新科技线的研发。

好在天残谷主还算头脑清醒，没敢这么大刀阔斧地干，他也怕自己控制不住。所以他虽然眼馋地球那边的科技知识，但也只是有选择地挑选了几个专业技能比较强的玩家进入游戏，让他们从零开始，一点点设计工业线。

一开始，商非凡大脑中呈现的画面还很正经。

不帅也“看”到了那些城堡设计图。

“这是兼容了魔法的炼金城堡。”不帅一口道出重点。

商非凡看到时也是这么想的，他让不帅看，只因为不帅比他经验更丰富，他现在就是纸面魔法师和纸面炼金师。

“你看，这些都是炼金中最常用的能量连接线。这些圆点都是能量节点，也是镶嵌魔晶的地方。”不帅指着图纸说。

商非凡也通过这个通感魔法看到不帅在对图纸进行比划。

他看不到具体的人，但能感觉到。

不帅甚至通过这些设计图和建设图直接勾勒出了实体城堡。

“我见过类似的城堡。这份设计图应该就是参考了这个城堡，几乎没有多少改动。”不帅说明他为什么能这么快就勾勒出实体城堡的原因。

商非凡看到不帅的身影出现在城堡中，眼睛就亮了。

真的太有意思了！
chunks.englishText:
It truly was an itinerary. From the exact time he departed, where he made camp, who he contacted, down to his next destination, everything was meticulously laid out. Even the two hidden teleportation arrays discovered by the Valley Master were marked with precise locations.

One had to admit that the intelligence brokers Lao Fu found were absolute talents.

As for those player guards beside the Valley Master who claimed undying loyalty to him... well, eighty silvers was the bottom line for their loyalty.

It wasn't that the players lacked loyalty; rather, when every single player assumed the NPCs of this Orc World were merely lines of data, no matter how handsome the appearance or how flawless the personality, it could never withstand the onslaught of real-world currency.

If the Valley Master of Tiancan knew that the guards beside him could be bought off for a mere eighty silvers...

Shang Feifan couldn't help but chuckle.

Bu Shuai put away his sleeping bag. "What are you laughing at?"

Shang Feifan looked at Bu Shuai.

Perhaps unaware of it himself, having just woken up, both his expression and his voice had a slight softness to them that made anyone who looked at him want to... bully him.

Shang Feifan licked his lips, his voice turning somewhat husky. "I'm laughing at someone who has no idea of the true terrifying power of players. If he tries to use the players, he will most likely end up being toyed to death by them."

"...Bless his soul, then?" Bu Shuai lit an imaginary candle for that nameless individual. Lao Shuai seemed yet to realize the terrifying lethality of his own mouth.

Ah, that expression was a bit foul-play. Suddenly, Shang Feifan pulled Bu Shuai into a tight embrace, tightening his arms fiercely before releasing him as Bu Shuai struggled.

Bu Shuai's heart pounded with unease. Just a moment ago, he had sensed an intensely terrifying aggressiveness from Shang Feifan, and for a split second, he thought Shang Feifan was going to—

"I managed to get my hands on a few castle construction blueprints. Some of the diagrams and carvings on them really catch my attention, and I want you to take a look too. But I don't know how to pull them out." Shang Feifan tapped his own temple.

Bu Shuai: "Uh, if you can conjure a very clear blueprint in your mind, I have a method to see what you're seeing."

"What method?"

"There's a spell called Sympathy (Tonganshu). By using a spiritual link to connect our minds for a short time, under the condition of mutual trust and zero resistance, the caster can view the clearest images within the target's mind."

Bu Shuai paused. "However, this spell has many limitations, and the probability of a successful casting is relatively low."

"Is it because of insufficient trust, right?" Shang Feifan had also acquired quite a bit of foundational magic knowledge through the game store; the moment Bu Shuai named the spell, he knew what it was.

Bu Shuai nodded.

Shang Feifan looked brimming with confidence. "Let's try it. It might not work for others, but it will definitely work for us. I trust you! You cast the spell."

Bu Shuai: "...Are you certain? I might end up seeing other things in there that you don't want me to see."

While Bu Shuai maintained an outwardly calm expression, internally he was deeply shocked.

He figured Shang Feifan simply didn't understand the terrifying nature of this spell, which was why he had agreed so readily.

In the Fader Continent, especially among mages, everyone knew the formidable power of this spell. Furthermore, human thoughts were the hardest things to control; no one knew what they might think when linking minds with another, nor what the other person might see.

Based on this apprehension, rare was the mage who would mutually cast this spell with another, and even rarer was the one who willingly agreed to be the target of the casting.

Only under exceptional circumstances—such as a defeated prisoner or the weaker party trying to gain the trust of the dominant party—would one be humiliated and forced to consent to laying bare their mind.

Let alone Loren Milton, who placed immense importance on personal privacy; even Ao'er, who trusted him deeply, probably wouldn't readily agree to let him cast this Sympathy spell on him.

Nor would Bu Shuai casually cast this spell on anyone else.

He had just thrown it out as a casual suggestion, never expecting Shang Feifan to agree so easily.

Shang Feifan had already assumed a posture inviting Bu Shuai to do as he pleased.

Bu Shuai: "...Fine. If you feel any discomfort, you can call a stop at any time."

This spell also contained a phase of forced mental suppression, making it difficult for the target to resist even if they wanted to.

Naturally, Bu Shuai would never do that to Shang Feifan.

Bu Shuai chanted the incantation silently, then leaned closer to Shang Feifan, pressing his forehead against his.

"Relax, don't resist."

Shang Feifan, who had zero intention of resisting: *This is great! I love this posture.*

Forehead-to-forehead contact wasn't strictly necessary, but it ensured a stable output of mana and spiritual energy while also establishing a tangible, stable connection. If either party wished to end it, they simply had to pull back; the operation was simple and caused the least amount of harm to the brain.

Shang Feifan also raised a hand to cup the back of Bu Shuai's head, letting his thoughts empty out first to allow Bu Shuai's spiritual energy to enter.

This was the process of opening the door.

Bu Shuai's spiritual energy waited politely on the outside for a moment, and only when Shang Feifan gave a clear signal of invitation did it slowly drift into Shang Feifan's mind.

An ordinary person's mind would be chaotic, shifting through dozens of messy thoughts every single second. Locking onto a fixed image and maintaining it consistently was a difficult challenge for the vast majority of people.

However, Shang Feifan's mental fortitude was exceptionally resilient, and he had undergone specialized training. He could ensure that even under extreme agony, his mind would only lock onto specific contents, reciting only those designated pieces of information no matter how he was interrogated.

At the same time, he could instantly generate countless fragments of chaotic data; even if someone managed to breach his mind, extracting valid intelligence from that vast and chaotic sea of information would be exceedingly difficult.

Therefore, Shang Feifan easily conjured the castle construction blueprints transmitted to him by Fu Xiangjun with absolute clarity in his mind, allowing Bu Shuai's spiritual energy to vividly co-experience them.

Over at the Tiancan Valley Master's side, to make it convenient for players to accept quests, the castle construction blueprints had been converted into digital files, uploaded to the laptop system, and distributed to players who had claimed the relevant quests.

Moreover, he was probably so dead certain that players and the living beings of the Orc Continent knew nothing of magic that he hadn't tampered with the design plans in the slightest, nor had he bothered to conceal much.

This also made things convenient for Fu Xiangjun, sparing him the headache of figuring out where to find a scanning device to scan the blueprints for Shang Feifan.

Right now, some specialized talents among the players were desperately trying to replicate Earth's industrial chain within the game, hoping to recreate cameras, scanners, and even computers and cell phones inside the virtual world.

In truth, if the Tiancan Valley Master were willing to open up player accounts and allow certain R&D companies and research institute personnel to station themselves inside the game, those people would undoubtedly leverage the 100% holographic nature of this game to reproduce Earth's technology and conduct research across various new technological lines.

Fortunately, the Tiancan Valley Master still possessed a clear head and didn't dare to act with such sweeping boldness, fearing he wouldn't be able to maintain control. Thus, while he coveted the technological knowledge from Earth, he merely handpicked a few players with relatively strong professional skills to enter the game, having them design the industrial chain from scratch, bit by bit.

At first, the imagery presenting itself in Shang Feifan's mind was quite proper and conventional.

Bu Shuai "saw" those castle design blueprints.

"This is an alchemical castle compatible with magic," Bu Shuai pointed out the crux of the matter in a single breath.

Shang Feifan had thought the same when he first saw it. He let Bu Shuai look at it simply because Bu Shuai was more experienced than him—at present, he was merely a paper mage and a paper alchemist.

"Look, these are the most commonly used energy connection lines in alchemy. These dots are energy nodes, and also where magic crystals are embedded," Bu Shuai said, pointing at the blueprint.

Through this Sympathy magic, Shang Feifan could also see Bu Shuai gesturing at the blueprints.

He couldn't see the physical person, but he could sense him.

Bu Shuai even used these design plans and construction blueprints to directly outline a physical castle.

"I've seen a similar castle before. This design must have been referenced from that one, with almost no alterations," Bu Shuai explained why he was able to outline the physical castle so quickly.

Seeing Bu Shuai's figure materialize inside the castle, Shang Feifan's eyes lit up.

This was simply too interesting!

chunks.chapterTitle: 第100章 情报贩子、旅途中 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
不帅在他的大脑中勾勒出一座城堡，还进入了这座城堡。

忽然，不帅身边有一道幻影出现，幻影慢慢的变得凝实。

不帅赞：“你的精神力很强大，你的精神力修炼法也很厉害，竟然这么快就能掌握通感术的使用诀窍。”

商非凡：我还能搞出更厉害的。你等下就能看到了。

两人在城堡中闲逛，一路不帅都在跟商非凡介绍这座炼金城堡的威力以及弱点。

“这座炼金城堡设计的初衷并不是为了增加炼金和附魔的威力，而是为了节省能量。这座城堡之所以出名到我也看过，就是因为它在法德尔大陆魔法界非常有名，它是由三位年轻炼金师共同设计，被称为世界上最节省魔力却能不减效果的城堡。”

“因为这座城堡，那三位炼金师很快就迈入大师行列，后来都成了法德尔有名的炼金宗师。他们这种设计也名扬整个法德尔大陆，模仿这种设计的人很多。因为三位炼金师非常大方地公开了图纸，导致这种城堡在各地都有出现。很多城堡设计，就算有所改变，基础也是它。”

“但这座城堡也有一个极大缺点，那就是为了节省魔晶，它放弃了单元结构式，而改为一体式，也就是只要摧毁了城堡的总控区域，就会导致整座城堡的魔法效果消失，甚至导致城堡的垮塌。”

“法德尔大陆最为流行的魔法城堡还是多单元多模块结构形成一个魔法网，这样虽然耗费的魔晶很多，但最大好处就是摧毁任何一处却不会影响到其他处。”

不帅的脚步在这座城堡的总控制中心停下。

商非凡怀疑这里也是天残谷主预定的居住中心，从设计图来看，这个总控中心像是一个密室，被卧室、卫浴室、衣帽间、起居室和书房给包裹在最中间。

“如果我想这座城堡的主人在城堡建造好后看不出这座城堡有什么毛病，但实际上只要一定力量就能摧垮这座城堡，应该怎么做？”

不帅：“……”

*

不帅仓惶而逃。

他作为施法者，却主动先推开了商非凡。

商非凡顺着力道放开不帅，睁开眼睛就冲着他笑。

笑屁笑！不帅跟被烫到一样，用力拍开商非凡伸过来的手，又威胁地举起骨杖。

商非凡不怕死地凑近他，亲了亲他的脸颊。

不帅小小叫了一声，整个人后仰，差点从狰爷背部掉下去。

商非凡连忙抱住他。

不帅脸爆红，用力推他。太丢脸了！

两人就在狰爷背上打打闹闹。

狰爷：这两只兽人在我背上干什么呢？

狰爷不爽，狰爷罢工了，往地上一趴，表示它要休息，今天就不继续跑了。

商非凡看看天色，是到该吃晚饭的时间了。

等吃过晚饭，相信他和不帅一定能渡过一个愉快的夜晚。

不帅的脸热得冒烟，哪怕商非凡已经远离他，跳下去准备今天的晚饭，他还是没有恢复过来。

那个混蛋！他怎么可以……在脑子里想那么多乱七八糟，又、又那么不可思议的事情！

他还敢想出来给他看，还想得那么具体！

现在的年轻人都这么疯狂的吗？！

不帅抱头，他现在不想看到某人。

“不帅，下来吃饭了。”

啊？时间过得这么快的吗？虎不帅恍恍惚惚地从狰爷背上跳下去。

吃过晚饭，商非凡就推着狰爷，让它走远一点休息，他不叫就别来找他们。

狰爷：“……”

商非凡偷偷给狰爷塞了一瓶它最爱的青草口味恢复药剂。

狰爷立马起身蹦出老远，三跳两蹦就不见了身影。

商非凡转回头，大踏步走向正在营地周围布置警戒线的不帅。
chunks.englishText:
Bu Shuai outlined a castle within his mind and even stepped inside it.

Suddenly, a phantom materialized beside Bu Shuai, its form slowly solidifying.

Bu Shuai praised, "Your spiritual energy is immense, and your mental cultivation technique is formidable. To grasp the secret of using Sympathy so quickly..."

Shang Feifan: *I can conjure up even more formidable tricks. You'll see in a moment.*

The two wandered idly through the castle, Bu Shuai explaining the firepower and weaknesses of this alchemical castle the entire way.

"The original design intent of this alchemical castle wasn't to amplify the power of alchemy and enchantments, but to conserve energy. The reason this castle is famous enough for me to have heard of it is because it's renowned throughout the Fader Continent's magical circles. It was jointly designed by three young alchemists and is hailed as the castle that saves the most mana in the world without diminishing its effects."

"Because of this castle, those three alchemists quickly stepped into the ranks of Masters and later became famous Alchemical Grandmasters of Fader. Their design spread far and wide across the entire Fader Continent, and many people copied it. Because the three alchemists generously made the blueprints public, castles of this type popped up everywhere. Many castle designs, even when altered, retain this as their foundation."

"However, this castle also has a fatal flaw: in order to save on magic crystals, it abandoned the modular unit structure in favor of an integrated design. This means as long as the master control area of the castle is destroyed, the magical effects of the entire castle will dissipate, and it could even lead to a collapse of the structure."

"The most popular magic castles in the Fader Continent still utilize a multi-unit, multi-module structure to form a magical net. While that consumes a massive number of magic crystals, the greatest advantage is that destroying any single location won't affect the rest."

Bu Shuai's footsteps halted at the master control center of the castle.

Shang Feifan suspected that this was also the residential hub designated by the Tiancan Valley Master. Judging from the blueprints, this master control center resembled a secret chamber, wrapped tightly at the very center by a bedroom, a washroom, a walk-in closet, a living room, and a study.

"If I wanted the owner of this castle to notice nothing amiss after it's built, yet have it collapse with just a specific application of force, how should I go about it?"

Bu Shuai: "..."

***

Bu Shuai fled in a panic.

As the caster, he had taken the initiative to push Shang Feifan away first.

Shang Feifan yielded to the momentum, released him, and opened his eyes to flash a grin.

*What are you grinning for?!* Feeling as though he'd been scalded, Bu Shuai forcefully swatted away Shang Feifan's outstretched hand and threateningly raised his bone staff.

Courting death, Shang Feifan leaned in close and kissed his cheek.

Bu Shuai let out a squeak, throwing his head back so hard he almost tumbled right off Zhen Ye's back.

Shang Feifan hurriedly caught him.

Bu Shuai's face flushed bright red, and he shoved him away hard. *So humiliating!*

The two began scuffling and playing around right on Zhen Ye's back.

Zhen Ye: *What are these two orcs doing on my back?*

Unhappy, Zhen Ye went on strike. It flopped down flat onto the ground, signaling that it needed to rest and wouldn't be continuing the run today.

Shang Feifan checked the sky; it was indeed time for dinner.

Once dinner was over, he was certain he and Bu Shuai would enjoy a most delightful evening.

Bu Shuai's face was so hot it felt like it was steaming. Even though Shang Feifan had already distanced himself and hopped down to prepare tonight's meal, he still hadn't recovered.

That bastard! How could he... think of so many messy, yet—yet such unimaginable things in his mind!

And he even dared to conjure them up for him to see, rendering them in such vivid detail!

Are young people these days all this crazy?!

Bu Shuai clutched his head; right now, he didn't want to laid eyes on a certain someone.

"Bu Shuai, come down and eat."

Ah? Did time pass by that quickly? Tiger Bu Shuai hopped down from Zhen Ye's back in a daze.

After dinner, Shang Feifan nudged Zhen Ye, signaling it to wander further away to rest and not to come looking for them unless called.

Zhen Ye: "..."

Shang Feifan stealthily slipped Zhen Ye a bottle of its favorite grass-flavored recovery potion.

Zhen Ye immediately scrambled up, leaped far away, and vanished from sight in three bounds.

Shang Feifan turned back around, striding purposefully toward Bu Shuai, who was currently setting up warning boundaries around the camp.

chunks.chineseText:
第101章 突下腐蚀雨

不帅都不知道自己是怎么到达黑森林城的。

这一路他过得简直就是……不能想！打住！

可人的思想如果能那么容易受到控制就好了。

不帅越是不想回忆这段路程，他脑中冒出来的画面就越多。

他总觉得狰爷在用行动鄙视他们两个，一到晚上就溜得不见虫影，第二天早上直到日头高升才会出现。

另外商非凡真的是很很很卑鄙！

每次他刚有生气的征兆，他就无耻地变成幼虎，在他面前毫无下限地撒娇卖萌，还任他抱起来揉搓。

不帅也不想每次都上当，但……商非凡变成的幼虎胖乎乎圆滚滚毛茸茸，还有着虎类幼崽特有的憨萌和小霸气。

每次商小虎昂着脑袋迈着不稳的步伐冲着他嗷嗷叫的时候，他有再多的火气都会泄光。

不帅把罩到口鼻处的围巾又往上扯了扯，心中暗做决定，如果商非凡继续对他胡来，他就、就把商小虎变成小秃虎！

“到了，已经能看到黑森林城的城墙。我们是就这么进去，还是换个身份，或用其他方法？”商非凡也围着用来挡风实际更是为了遮挡容貌的围巾，笑看不帅。

“啊？哦。”不帅拍打脸颊，大脑用力挤出一个思考正事的位置，正色道：“隐身进去。”

黑森林城非常热闹，比摩罗城还要热闹得多，体量也大许多。

只论占地面积和常住人口数量，黑森林城就是摩罗城的十倍之多。

黑森林城附近还有很多村镇，都附属于黑森林城。就像黑森林城附属于王城。

黑森林城距离王城只有五百里不到的路程，有水陆两条大型通道。黑水河面上每日来往船只络绎不绝，黑森林城最大的码头就修建在南城门口。

前往王城最近的城门是西城门，那里有虎国最宽阔也最安全的大道直通王城，这条道路也被称为急行军道，脚程快的兽人只要疾跑一天就能抵达王城。

两人从北面过来，要进的是北城门。

还没靠近城门，两人就看到路上有许多商队，还有看着像是附近村镇的兽人驱赶着驮兽和巨虫，驾驶着车辆进出黑森林城。

他们还在路边看到了不少小摊贩，主要卖一些吃食和土特产。

商非凡还看到了茶摊。

兽人也喝茶，也许很多兽人喜欢甜口的缘故，他们的茶水更像是坚果粉+茶叶粉+奶粉，熬制出的奶茶。

除了奶茶，兽人喝的最多饮料就是水果酒和麦酒，平日喝的都是清水。

“我去买两杯奶茶，要带一点吃的吗？”商非凡问。

他看到不帅在转头看路边小摊。

不帅一开始这样做只是在转移注意力，但是……

“不帅？”商非凡轻拍。

虎不帅看看路周边，又抬头看向远方，他甚至还仰头看向天空。

“怎么了？”商非凡警觉起来。

不帅脸上有一点疑惑：“我不知道，我感觉好像有哪里不对劲，就像是有什么事要发生了。”

商非凡并没有忽视不帅的直觉，自从不帅的自然魔法感知力加强后，他们在赶路途中有好几次遇到危险，不帅都比狰爷还要提前发现。

他无法用言语表述他是如何发现危险的。

就像是周围的花草树木，甚至是泥土和空气都在和他“说话”，向他传达着什么。

商非凡也静下心神感知。

路边兽人的吆喝声，行商的赶路声，还有行人的说话声，一切都那么正常和普通。

“虫鸣声变少了。”商非凡忽然道。

“跟我们有关吗？”不帅下意识问。

商非凡摇头：“我们的行踪虽然没有特意隐藏，但一路我们都有仔细观察，路上并没有人盯梢我们。我们也许只是很不巧，遇到了事情。”

不帅呢喃：“我现在已经不相信巧合和偶然这样的词语。”

商非凡嘴唇弯了弯：“既然赶上了，那就静观其变。我们是进城，还是留在城外？”

不帅无法判断，眼含期待地问：“你说呢？”

“进城。”

不入虎穴焉得虎子？

如果黑森林城真的要出事，还能方便他们趁乱行事。

不帅原本跳个不停的神经安稳下来，他不想明说。但他现在貌似越来越信赖商非凡，原本不喜欢和别人一起行动的他，竟然再次从同伴身上感到了安心感。

偏偏商非凡给他的感觉就像是也很依赖他、信任他。

不帅心里很清楚他为什么每次见到商小虎就会心软、就会忽略商非凡的某些过分行为，因为商小虎窝在他手心和怀里时，他能感到对方在全心依赖他。

更进一步，也是不帅最不想细想和比较的一点，那就是他和商的负距离运动，会让他更（被迫）投入，也更失去自我控制。

他和洛伦米尔顿在一起时，可能是出于羞涩和被动，他总是很克制。

和奥尔在一起时，更像是在利用那种方式在增加彼此的亲密度和感情。可能是年长的缘故，他总是放不开，更不会主动。

但和商非凡在一起，他感觉自己就像是暴风雨夜的海上小舟，彻底被狂风暴雨和巨大海浪给席卷！

不帅眼神有一丝迷茫。

他觉得这样的自己很不好，他害怕自己再次沉没，更害怕……

一只温暖干燥的大手握住他。

不帅低头，手指一点点弯曲。

“不管遇到什么，我们一起面对。”商非凡握紧不帅的手，淡淡说。

“……嗯。”

两人站在狰爷的背上，按照原来的速度逐渐靠近北城门。

“你说那位谷主也来了吗？”不帅轻声问。

商非凡抓起围巾往上提了提：“根据我得到的消息，对方应该会在这两天直接抵达王城，他似乎有本事找到连当地兽人都不知道的古老传送阵。虽然天残谷距离王城很远，但通过那几个传送阵，他和他的队伍大大缩短了行程。”

“也许我们应该先去王城。”

“不急。一个个来，王后能有力量，除了她老公和她自己的手头势力，黑森林城主绝对是她的一大臂助。就跟王后也是黑森林城主的依仗之一一样。我们先解决黑森林城主和这个家族的有生力量，再对付王后就更容易得多。”

“敏感的野兽和兽人也感觉到了。”不帅声音更轻。

商非凡转头四看，果然看到不少兽人脸上露出惊疑不安的神色，还有驮兽、巨虫以及作为猎物等的野兽，也发出了不安的叫声，还有的撒腿就想跑。

狰爷也发出急促的振翅声，细长的长腿不断敲击地面。

商非凡安抚狰爷，“你不想进城？”

哒哒哒。狰爷表示它也不知道，它只是感到有危险即将降临，它想要尽快离开原地。

“往城门跑，加速跑！看到那片小树林没有？从那里穿。”商非凡转头就对不帅说：“等狰爷一进入小树林，你就立刻施展隐身术，我们争取尽快冲入城门。”

“好！”不帅也顾不上会不会被路人注意到，在狰爷快速奔跑起来，即将冲入那片小树林时，不帅举起了骨杖。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 101: Sudden Corrosive Rain

Bu Shuai had no idea how he had even managed to reach Black Forest City.

His entire journey had been simply... unbearable to think about! Stop right there!

Yet, if human thoughts were so easily controlled, how wonderful that would be.

The harder Bu Shuai tried not to recall this leg of the journey, the more vivid images popped into his mind.

He always felt that Zhen Ye was using its actions to look down on the two of them. The moment night fell, it would slip away without a trace of its insectoid shadow, only reappearing the next morning after the sun was high in the sky.

Moreover, Shang Feifan was truly, truly, truly despicable!

Every single time Bu Shuai showed the slightest sign of getting angry, the shameless fellow would transform into a tiger cub, throwing away all dignity to act coquettishly and milkily cute right in front of him, even letting him pick it up and knead it.

Bu Shuai didn't want to fall for it every time either, but... the little tiger cub that Shang Feifan turned into was plump, round, and fluffy, possessing the clumsy cuteness and mini-dominance unique to feline cubs.

Every time Little Tiger Shang raised its head, walked with wobbly steps, and cried out *aowu* at him, all of Bu Shuai's anger would instantly evaporate.

Bu Shuai pulled the scarf covering his mouth and nose a bit higher, secretly resolving in his heart: if Shang Feifan dared to mess with him again, he would—he would turn Little Tiger Shang into a bald little tiger!

"We're here. The city walls of Black Forest City are already in sight. Do we just walk in like this, disguise ourselves, or use some other method?" Shang Feifan was also wrapped in a scarf meant to ward off the wind, though its true purpose was to conceal his features, as he smiled and looked at Bu Shuai.

"Ah? Oh." Bu Shuai slapped his cheeks, forcing his brain to carve out space for serious business, and said with a straight face, "Sneak in invisibly."

Black Forest City was exceptionally bustling, far livelier than Moluo City and vastly greater in scale.

Just in terms of land area and resident population, Black Forest City was ten times that of Moluo City.

Around Black Forest City were numerous villages and towns, all subordinate to it, much like how Black Forest City itself was subordinate to the Royal Capital.

Black Forest City was less than five hundred miles away from the Royal Capital, connected by two major waterways—land and water. Boats and ships bustled back and forth along the Black Water River every single day, and the largest dock of Black Forest City was built right at the South City Gate.

The closest city gate leading to the Royal Capital was the West City Gate. There, the widest and safest highway in the Tiger Kingdom led straight to the Royal Capital, a route known as the Forced March Road. Orcs with fast foot stamina could reach the Royal Capital in just a single day of sprinting.

Coming from the north, the gate they needed to enter was the North City Gate.

Before even approaching the gates, the two saw numerous merchant caravans on the road, alongside orcs who looked like residents from nearby villages driving pack beasts and giant insects, steering carts in and out of Black Forest City.

They also spotted quite a few small roadside vendors selling various foods and local specialties.

Shang Feifan even caught sight of a tea stall.

Orcs drank tea too; perhaps due to many of them favoring sweet flavors, their tea resembled a milk tea brewed from ground nuts, tea leaves, and powdered milk.

Aside from milk tea, the beverages orcs drank most frequently were fruit wine and ale, while plain water sufficed for everyday thirst.

"I'll go buy two cups of milk tea. Do you want any snacks?" Shang Feifan asked.

He noticed Bu Shuai turning his head to look at a roadside stall.

Bu Shuai had initially done this just to distract himself, but...

"Bu Shuai?" Shang Feifan gave him a gentle tap.

Tiger Bu Shuai looked around the roadside, then raised his gaze to the distance; he even tipped his head back to look up at the sky.

"What's wrong?" Shang Feifan immediately grew alert.

A trace of doubt flickered across Bu Shuai's face. "I don't know. I feel like something is off, as if something is about to happen."

Shang Feifan did not dismiss Bu Shuai's intuition. Ever since Bu Shuai's natural magic perception had heightened, they had encountered danger several times during their travels, and Bu Shuai had always sensed it ahead of Zhen Ye.

He couldn't put into words how Bu Shuai managed to detect danger.

It was as if the surrounding flowers, trees, soil, and even the air were "talking" to him, conveying some kind of message.

Shang Feifan also quieted his mind to perceive.

The hawking cries of roadside orcs, the trudging sounds of traveling merchants, and the chatter of pedestrians—everything seemed completely normal and ordinary.

"The sound of insect chirping has decreased," Shang Feifan suddenly remarked.

"Is it related to us?" Bu Shuai instinctively asked.

Shang Feifan shook his head. "Though we haven't deliberately concealed our tracks, we've kept a close watch all the way, and no one has been tailing us. We might just have the bad luck of running into trouble."

Bu Shuai murmured, "I've stopped believing in words like coincidence and accident."

The corners of Shang Feifan's lips curved upward. "Since we've run into it, we'll wait and see how things develop. Are we entering the city, or staying outside?"

Unable to make a judgment, Bu Shuai asked with expectant eyes, "What do you say?"

"Enter the city."

*If you don't enter the tiger's den, how can you catch tiger cubs?*

If Black Forest City was truly about to experience a crisis, it would make it easier for them to fish in troubled waters.

The nerves in Bu Shuai's head that had been twitching nonstop finally settled down. He didn't want to say it aloud, but he seemed to be growing increasingly reliant on Shang Feifan. Someone who usually disliked acting alongside others, he once again found a sense of safety from a companion.

Yet, the feeling Shang Feifan gave him was that he was equally dependent and trusting of him.

Bu Shuai knew very well why his heart softened every time he saw Little Tiger Shang, and why he would overlook some of Shang Feifan's outrageous behavior: because when Little Tiger Shang curled up in his palm and arms, he could feel that the other person trusted him with his entire being.

Taking it a step further—and this was the point Bu Shuai least wanted to dwell on or compare—was their skin-to-skin intimacy, which made him all the more (compulsorily) immersed and stripped him of self-control.

When he was with Loren Milton, perhaps out of shyness and passivity, he had always maintained restraint.

When he was with Ao'er, it felt more like utilizing that method to increase mutual intimacy and affection. Perhaps due to their age difference, he had always kept his guard up and never taken the initiative.

But when he was with Shang Feifan, he felt like a tiny boat on the sea during a violent storm, completely swept away by the raging tempests and massive waves!

A hint of confusion flashed in Bu Shuai's eyes.

He felt that being this way wasn't good for him. He feared sinking again, and even more, he feared...

A warm, dry, large hand grasped his.

Bu Shuai lowered his gaze, his fingers curling slightly bit by bit.

"No matter what we encounter, we'll face it together," Shang Feifan gripped Bu Shuai's hand tightly, speaking in a calm tone.

"...Mn."

The two stood upon Zhen Ye's back, gradually approaching the North City Gate at their original speed.

"Do you think that Valley Master has arrived too?" Bu Shuai asked softly.

Shang Feifan pulled his scarf up slightly. "According to the intel I received, that person should arrive directly at the Royal Capital within the next two days. He seems to have the ability to locate ancient teleportation arrays that even local orcs don't know about. Although Tiancan Valley is far from the Royal Capital, those teleportation arrays allowed him and his team to drastically shorten their journey."

"Perhaps we should head to the Royal Capital first."

"No rush. One step at a time. Aside from her husband and her own faction, the Black Forest City Lord is undoubtedly a major pillar of support for the Queen—just as the Queen is one of the City Lord's reliances. Once we eliminate the Black Forest City Lord and the living forces of that family, dealing with the Queen will become much easier."

"Sensitive beasts and orcs feel it too," Bu Shuai's voice grew even softer.

Shang Feifan looked around and sure enough, saw the expressions of many orcs turning suspicious and uneasy. Pack beasts, giant insects, and wild beasts kept as prey were also letting out anxious cries, with some desperately trying to bolt.

Zhen Ye also emitted rapid wing-flapping sounds, its slender long legs constantly tapping against the ground.

Shang Feifan soothed Zhen Ye, *You don't want to enter the city?*

*Tap tap tap.* Zhen Ye communicated that it had no idea either; it simply sensed that danger was imminent and wanted to flee the area as quickly as possible.

"Run toward the city gate, accelerate! See that small patch of woods? Cut right through it." Shang Feifan turned to Bu Shuai. "The moment Zhen Ye enters the woods, cast your invisibility spell immediately. Let's aim to rush through the city gate as fast as possible."

"Alright!" Bu Shuai discarded any concern about whether roadside onlookers might notice. As Zhen Ye surged into a fast sprint, about to plunge into that patch of woods, Bu Shuai raised his bone staff.

chunks.chineseText:
他和商非凡身上都有能隐身的炼金装备，但那些装备使用起来不如魔法这么方便和可控。

虽然会一定程度的消耗魔晶，但在路上商非凡送给了他一枚三级标准魔晶，还说以后也能继续弄到，让他在魔晶使用方面不用那么吝啬。

可就在这时，不帅身上的汗毛全都倒竖起来。

他看到……

周围一切都变得异常缓慢，就好像时间被被拉长了。

他听到商非凡似乎在张口喊他，但他喊出来的声音被拉长，让他听不出他在喊什么。

风带动空气，空气在流动。

他看到了空气的形状。

太阳在消失，乌云笼罩住天空。

危险！

不帅来不及多想，立刻从狰爷背上飞起来，冲着路上路边所有兽人大喊：“快跑——！”

时间恢复正常。

周围一切都迅速动了起来。

但极少有人逃离原地，很多人都看向浮在半空的不帅，脸上露出惊愕的神色。

不是惊愕这名兽人能飞，能飞的兽人很多，而是惊讶他没有翅膀也能飘浮在半空。

另外就是他喊出的话。

不帅看路上路边的兽人没有多少反应，再次大声喊道：“抬头看！有危险！快跑！离开这里！越远越好！”

天色越来越阴暗，浓厚的乌云像是要压下来。

有兽人望一眼天空，转身就向来路方向狂奔，甚至连自己的行李和摊位上的货物都顾不得。这是之前就感到有不对劲的兽人。

这些兽人大多都是雇佣兵、冒险者和经验丰富的老道商人。

经常在外讨生活的兽人总是会遇到很多稀奇古怪的事情，他们都知道比起逞英雄和嘲笑别人，听劝会得到更多活命机会。

看到有人跑，自然也有人盲从跟随。

路边摆摊的兽人看过天空又互望，浓厚的乌云带来奇异的心理压力，有些人想要说服自己这只是正常的气象变化，但很多人都开始收拾摊位上的货物，打算先离开再说。

可同样有人莫名其妙，还有人非要追着不帅问：“发生什么事情了？你说有危险？什么危险？”

“这就是晴转雨的正常气象，也许是暴雨。这在我们这儿很常见。”

“可现在是春天……”

“春天偶尔也有天气糟糕的时候！”

“前面就是城门，这已经是黑森林城范围，如果有危险是不是应该通知城卫？”

“那位兄弟！你是让我们远离这条路，还是远离黑森林城？”

“嗨，你是怎么浮在半空的？是你的天赋能力吗？还是特殊职业技能？你是干什么的？”

“你是什么人？为什么要在这里危言耸听！”

不帅根本无暇理会这些兽人，他感到自己头皮发麻，如果危险刚才在一百米外，现在已经到了三十米！

“来不及了，快跑！跑出这片地！不要管那些东西！”不帅再次大喊。

只有少数兽人心一狠，放下正在收拾的东西就往远处跑。

但更多人仍旧在犹豫，还有人满不在乎，更有人怀疑不帅，想把他弄下来。

二十米、十五米、十米……

“来了！”

不帅看到站在小树林边沿等他的狰爷和商非凡，不用选择，他已经尽到义务，当即就冲回商非凡身边，抬起骨杖，口中飞快地念出咒语。

“大地的精灵啊，请遵循古老魔法的契约力量，借予我力量，凡我精神力覆盖的范围，撑起魔力护罩！”

唰！

无形的保护罩刚刚笼罩住狰爷和它背脊上的两人。

簌簌，簌簌簌。

密集的雨点从天空降落。

有兽人抬头看天，还有人不在意地笑着说：“就是下雨而已。”

“这雨点……”

“啊——！”

“好烫！好疼！”

“救命！我的手！我的脸！”

“快躲雨！这雨会腐蚀……”

黑森林城外的一段路乱了，路上的兽人全都在找地方躲避。

很多人都在往附近的树林跑。

有车的往车里和车下钻。

有桌子的钻桌子底下。

还有人急切下只能举起衣服或毛皮来阻挡雨水。

但只要雨点落下，就有白烟冒起。

就算是金属，也被腐蚀出坑洼。

木头的抗腐蚀力更低。

更不要说毛皮和布匹。

到处都是惨叫声。

有人为了争抢能遮身的地方，把别人推出去。

有幸跑出乌云笼罩下的兽人全都转身看向身后。

他们看到整座黑森林城都被笼罩在乌云下。

密集的雨点不断落下。

就在他们面前，出现了一道明显的雨幕。

一边在下腐蚀雨，一边则是艳阳天。

一边是地狱，一边还是人间。

逃出来的兽人看着雨幕中的惨相，情不自禁咽口水，幸好他们听劝逃出来了！

有速度快的兽人冲出雨幕笼罩范围，跑到了艳阳下。

这些兽人全都倒地发出凄惨的叫声。

雨点没有继续浇灌在他们身上，但他们身上的雨水并没有就这么消失。

这些雨水还在腐蚀他们的身体。

“救命！救救我……”这些被腐蚀的兽人向那些逃出来的完好兽人伸手求救。

同一时间，整座黑森林城都响起了刺耳的惨叫声和怒吼声。

待在房子中的兽人还好，但这是白天，走在路上的兽人不知凡几。

还有在四个城门口排队等待进城以及出城的兽人队伍……

腐蚀雨降下，全都乱套了。

商非凡在不帅飞上天空的时候，也感知到极度危险来临。

他不知道这个危险是什么类型，也不知道该如何防御，他只能凭借本能，第一时间就打开了游戏商城，想要购买保护罩之类的物品。

这时他已经顾不上节省贡献点，这是他进入游戏世界后第一次感知到如此危险！

商非凡一边分神寻找效果最强最好的保护罩，一边准备抓回不帅。

他已经准备启动回城功能，如果危险真的无法抵御，他会立刻带不帅和狰爷回去莫约镇。

这边他刚买好一个兼有防护功能、被称为龟甲堡的小型营地屋，不帅回来了，并立即施展了保护罩魔法。

当然，他刚买好的龟甲堡也并不浪费，魔法只能坚持一段时间，尤其他们魔晶还非常不充足。

“先离开这里，进城，找房子！”趁着保护罩效果还在，不帅催促。

“不往外面跑？远处似乎没下雨。”商非凡快速问。

“进城！”不帅来不及解释更多。

商非凡相信不帅，不再多问，迅速和狰爷沟通。

狰爷听说它跑起来也不会被腐蚀雨伤害，再三确定后，这才飞快朝黑森林北城门狂奔而去。

城门口彻底乱了，原本排队的兽人都在疯狂往城内冲。

守在城门口的城卫们也忙着躲雨，他们也不可能在这时候关闭城门，更不可能阻拦住那些只想找地方躲雨的疯狂兽人。

这下好了，也不用特意隐身了，狰爷带着商非凡和虎不帅两人就这么冲进了黑森林城。

城中房屋不少紧闭门窗，不让其他兽人进入。

但也有善心的兽人打开自家大门，让路上的兽人进来躲雨。
chunks.englishText:
Both he and Shang Feifan possessed alchemical gear capable of granting invisibility, but such items were neither as convenient nor as controllable as magic.

Although it consumed a certain amount of magic crystal energy to operate, along the way Shang Feifan had gifted him a tier-3 standard magic crystal, telling him that more could be procured in the future and that he needn't be so stingy with their use.

Right at that moment, every hair on Bu Shuai’s body stood on end.

He saw...

Everything around him became abnormally sluggish, as if time itself had been stretched thin.

He heard Shang Feifan calling out to him, but the voice was drawn out so much that he couldn't make out the words.

The wind drove the air, and the air flowed.

He could actually see the shape of the air.

The sun vanished, and dark clouds blanketed the heavens.

Danger!

Without time to overthink, Bu Shuai leaped up from the back of the beast Zhenye, crying out at the top of his lungs to all the orcs along the road: "Run—!"

Time snapped back to normal.

Everything around them surged back into rapid motion.

Yet precious few fled the spot; many simply stared up at Bu Shuai hovering mid-air, astonishment written across their faces.

They weren't surprised that an orc could fly—plenty of flying orcs existed—but rather that he was levitating without wings.

Then there was what he had shouted.

Seeing that the orcs along the road showed little reaction, Bu Shuai shouted again at the top of his lungs: "Look up! There's danger! Run! Get away from here! As far as you can!"

The sky grew steadily darker, heavy storm clouds pressing down as if to crush the earth.

A few orcs glanced at the sky, whirled around, and bolted back the way they had come, abandoning even their luggage and the goods on their stalls. These were the orcs who had already sensed something amiss beforehand.

Most of these individuals were mercenaries, adventurers, and seasoned, weathered merchants.

Orcs who constantly scratched out a living in the wilds always encountered bizarre occurrences. They all knew that rather than trying to play the hero or mocking others, heeding warnings bought far more chances at survival.

Seeing some run, naturally others followed blindly.

The orcs tending roadside stalls looked from the sky to one another. The thick, brooding clouds carried a strange psychological pressure; some tried to talk themselves into believing it was merely a normal atmospheric shift, but many began packing up their wares, deciding to clear out first and ask questions later.

Yet others remained utterly clueless, while some insisted on chasing after Bu Shuai to demand: "What's happening? You said there's danger? What kind of danger?"

"This is just normal weather turning from clear to rain. Maybe a thunderstorm. Very common around here."

"But it's spring..."

"Spring has bad weather sometimes!"

"The city gate is right ahead, and this is already the sphere of Black Forest City. If there's danger, shouldn't we notify the city guards?"

"Hey, brother! Are you telling us to stay away from this road, or away from Black Forest City?"

"Oi, how are you floating up there? Is that a racial trait? Some special class skill? What do you even do?"

"Who the hell are you? Why are you out here mongering panic!"

Bu Shuai had no time to entertain these orcs. His scalp tingled fiercely; if the danger had been a hundred meters away a moment ago, it was now thirty meters!

"No time left, run! Get out of this zone! Forget about those things!" Bu Shuai shouted once more.

Only a handful of orcs hardened their hearts, abandoning what they were packing and sprinting into the distance.

Yet the majority still hesitated, some remained indifferent, and others grew suspicious of Bu Shuai, wanting to pull him down.

Twenty meters, fifteen meters, ten meters...

"It's here!"

Bu Shuai spotted Zhenye and Shang Feifan waiting by the edge of the small woods. There was no room for hesitation, and having fulfilled his duty, he immediately flew back to Shang Feifan’s side, raised his bone staff, and rapidly chanted an incantation.

"Spirits of the earth, heed the contract of ancient magic and lend me your might! Within the radius of my spiritual power, raise the barrier of mana!"

*Swish!*

An invisible protective dome instantly enveloped Zhenye and the two figures on its back.

*Pat-pat, pat-pat-pat.*

Dense raindrops cascaded from the heavens.

Some orcs looked up at the sky, chuckling carelessly, "It's just rain."

"These raindrops..."

"Aah—!"

"So hot! It burns!"

"Help! My hand! My face!"

"Seek shelter! This rain is corrosive—!"

The stretch of road outside Black Forest City plunged into chaos as every orc scrambled for cover.

Countless people fled toward the nearby woods.

Those with carts dived into or beneath them.

Those near tables crawled beneath them.

Others, in their desperation, could only hoist garments or furs overhead to block the downpour.

Yet the moment a raindrop struck, white smoke hissed into the air.

Even metal was pitted and gouged by corrosion.

Wood offered even lower resistance.

Furs and cloth fared infinitely worse.

Shrieks of agony echoed everywhere.

To seize shelter, some shoved others mercilessly out into the open.

The orcs lucky enough to clear the perimeter of the dark clouds all whirled around to look behind them.

They saw that the entire Black Forest City was now shrouded beneath a canopy of ominous black clouds.

Dense sheets of rain relentlessly plummeted.

Right before their eyes, a stark, distinct curtain of rain divided the world.

On one side poured a corrosive rain; on the other lay blazing sunlight.

One side was hell; the other remained the mortal realm.

The escaped orcs stared at the horrifying spectacle within the rain curtain and swallowed hard. Thank the heavens they had listened and fled!

Some swift-footed orcs burst through the edge of the rain veil, tumbling out into the brilliant sunshine.

Yet these orcs collapsed onto the ground, emitting wretched, agonizing screams.

The rain no longer fell upon them, but the liquid already coating their bodies had not vanished.

That water was still eating away at their flesh.

"Help! Save me..." These corroded orcs stretched out desperate hands toward the uninjured survivors who had fled before them.

At the same instant, piercing screams and angry roars erupted throughout the entirety of Black Forest City.

Those orcs sheltered indoors fared somewhat better, but it was daytime; countless others were walking the streets.

Not to mention the queues of orcs lined up at the four city gates waiting to enter and leave...

As the corrosive rain descended, total chaos ensued.

The moment Bu Shuai soared into the air, Shang Feifan had also sensed an extreme sense of danger descending.

Uncertain of the nature of this peril or how to defend against it, he relied on pure instinct, instantly opening the game store and searching for protective dome items.

Contribution points were the last thing on his mind; this was the first time since entering the game world that he had felt such overwhelming danger!

While multitasking to find the most powerful and effective shield, Shang Feifan prepared to snatch Bu Shuai back.

He was already prepared to trigger the return-to-city function; if the peril truly proved insurmountable, he would instantly take Bu Shuai and Zhenye back to Moyue Town.

Just as he purchased a small camp dwelling with defensive capabilities known as a "Turtle Shell Keep," Bu Shuai returned and immediately cast the protective barrier magic.

Of course, the Turtle Shell Keep he had just bought wouldn't go to waste either—magic could only hold out for a limited time, especially since their magic crystal reserves were severely lacking.

"Get out of here first, head into the city, find a building!" Bu Shuai urged while the barrier's effect still held.

"We aren't running outward? It looks like it's not raining in the distance." Shang Feifan asked quickly.

"Into the city!" Bu Shuai had no time to explain further.

Trusting Bu Shuai implicitly, Shang Feifan pressed no further and rapidly communicated with Zhenye.

Assured repeatedly by Bu Shuai that running through the storm wouldn't harm it under the barrier's protection, Zhenye bolted wildly toward the North Gate of Black Forest City.

The city gates were in utter disarray, with the previously orderly queue of orcs frantically stampeding inward.

The city guards stationed at the gates were equally preoccupied with dodging the rain; they were hardly in any position to seal the gates or block the frenzied throbs desperate to find shelter.

Well, stealth was entirely unnecessary now. Carrying Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai, Zhenye charged straight into Black Forest City.

Many buildings within the city had doors and windows tightly bolted, barring entry to outsiders.

Yet benevolent orcs could also be found flinging open their front doors, allowing the travelers on the streets to rush inside and escape the downpour.

chunks.chineseText:
更多兽人不管主人愿不愿意，强行破开门窗，冲进房子里。

狰爷身体庞大，它需要大房子或专门给巨虫坐骑修建的棚子。

但这时棚子都没什么用，木质棚子和屋顶都被腐蚀出一个个洞眼。

也就是石头和金属制造的房子坚持的时间还能久一点。

“那里！”商非凡看到一座像是政务大厅的高大房屋，立刻操纵狰爷往那边跑。

同样往那边跑的巨虫很多。

北区政务大厅大门敞开，无数兽人都在往里挤。

巨虫身体庞大，但它们有个最大好处，就是能沿着墙壁走，还能挂在屋顶上。

因为这个优点，现在还没有人拒绝巨虫也一起进入房屋躲雨。

只苦了那些普通兽类，它们是最先被放弃的一群。

兽人们现在根本顾不上它们。

狰爷带着两人冲入政务大厅。

商非凡拉着不帅从狰爷身上跃下，政务大厅里全是人。

狰爷跑到屋顶上挂着了。

“糟糕！农田，还有养殖的家禽牲口。这场雨一下，都得完蛋。”有政务大厅的工作人员焦急地叫。

“食物已经是其次，现在大家能不能活下来都是问题！”

“这见鬼的腐蚀雨是怎么冒出来的？”

“虫族诅咒！这一定是那些该死的虫族在诅咒我们！”

“我觉得更像是邪神的手段。”

“这腐蚀雨什么时候能停？它会不会一直下下去？”

“呸！别说倒霉话。也许再过一会儿就停了。”

“如果它不停呢？你们觉得我们的房顶还能坚持多久？”

商非凡把不帅揽到一边，靠着墙壁，在他耳边低声说：“为什么不往城外跑？”

不帅也低声回：“我的直觉告诉我，当雨水降下后，往外面跑，死得更快。当然，我的直觉不一定就可信。”

商非凡摸摸他的背，“相信你自己。”

“这事太古怪了。”不帅有点乱，不知道接下来该怎么办。

商非凡竟然还能笑得出来，“很有游戏感。跟着重要NPC走，必然会发生重大事件。”

不帅先没反应过来，后反应过来，轻轻踢了他一脚。

商非凡轻呼疼痛。

不帅摆正脸色，正要说话，就听到有人举起喇叭对着大厅中所有人喊：“所有人注意了！”

“区政务大厅的容量有限，但涌进来的人已经越来越多，如果腐蚀雨短时间内不能停歇，我们这里聚集这么多人一定会出事。我想大家应该都不想看到这点！”

“现在请大家听我指挥，我们将分流一部分人去其他房屋躲避，请放心，我们不会走没有遮挡的地方。”

“只要大家能听从指挥，不要互相推搡，更不要强行挤压抢位，所有人都会没事！”

突然，又一名兽人冲进来高声喊：“城主刚刚下令，地下城入口将被全部打开，所有没有地方躲避的兽人都可以进入地下城躲雨！”

之前说话的兽人精神一振：“我们这里就有地下城入口，我现在就去查看。大家请听从工作人员的指挥，我们将安全撤离到地下城中，直到这场该死的腐蚀雨停止！”

“城主万岁！”不少兽人庆幸高呼。

商非凡和不帅互看。

不帅微微点头。

这就表示一起进入地下城的意思。

商非凡握住他的手，低声说：“这位城主反应可真快，而且明智。”

不帅脸上打出一个问号，为什么他不觉得商非凡是在夸奖对方？

“你是在怀疑这场腐蚀雨和城主有关？”不帅声音小小的问。

他们周围兽人太多，很可能就有听力好的，就算环境噪杂，也有可能把他们的对话听了去。

商非凡：“这一代的丹顿侯爵是独-裁者吗？”

不帅摇头：“卧榻之下岂容他人鼾睡。黑森林城是王城的附属城，几座附属城虽然都有大贵族掌控，但附属城的官员和将领等关键职务，都是虎王亲自派遣的人手。另外为了进一步扼制城主们的权力，虎王还强行给他们安排了辅助的副城主。黑森林城的副城主有三位。啊，你是说……”

商非凡轻笑：“腐蚀雨才刚落下来不到十分钟，就算这位城主再勤政、再对手下掌控力度一流，等他召集三名副城主以及其他相关官员征询意见，再做决定，你觉得十分钟足够吗？”

“紧急情况也许不需要征集其他官员和副城主的意见？”

“下达命令要多长时间？这里可是北城门附近。而且别忘了现在黑森林城有多混乱，你能在这种情况下把从上到下的相关工作人员全都传令到位？”

商非凡眼中露出对那位城主的讽刺：“我用我的经验告诉你，任何地方，不管风险预案做得有多好，一旦遇到这种满城大乱的混乱且紧急情况，不说决定怎么做，光是把命令传达下去就得耗费大量时间，更不要说这里还没有手机和网络。”

“……那他为什么要这么做？这害的可是他自己的城民和自己的领地。”

“也许只有这样做，才有借口打开地下城，并把城中多数兽人转到地下城中？”

不帅皱眉：“地下城中有什么？”

“我们下去看就知道了。”商非凡调皮了一下：“我们来的时机可真巧不是吗？”

不帅抿了抿嘴唇。
chunks.englishText:
Regardless of whether their owners wished it or not, more and more beastmen forcefully battered open doors and windows, surging into the houses.

Zheng Ye was massive in size, requiring either a spacious domicile or a specialized shed built for giant insect mounts.

However, sheds were useless at a moment like this; both the wooden structures and their roofs were rapidly corroded into swiss cheese.

Only houses made of stone and metal could hold out a little longer.

"Over there!" Shang Feifan spotted a tall, towering building that resembled a municipal administrative hall, and immediately directed Zheng Ye to dash toward it.

Many other giant insects were stampeding in that exact direction as well.

The North District Administrative Hall had its main doors flung wide open, and countless beastmen were frantically squeezing inside.

Though giant insects possessed colossal frames, they had one tremendous advantage: they could scale walls and cling tightly to ceilings.

Thanks to this trait, no one was currently turning away giant insects seeking shelter alongside them.

Only the ordinary beasts were left to suffer, reduced to the very first group to be abandoned.

The beastmen simply could not afford to worry about them right now.

Zheng Ye carried the two men straight into the administrative hall.

Shang Feifan pulled Bu Shuai down from Zheng Ye’s back, the hall completely packed with people.

Zheng Ye scrambled up to cling to the high ceiling above.

"Oh no! The farmland, the livestock and poultry we're breeding—once this rain keeps pouring, everything is going to be ruined!" an administrative hall staff member cried out in panic.

"Food is secondary! Whether everyone can even survive right now is the real question!"

"Where in the world did this damned corrosive rain come from?"

"A beastman curse! This has got to be those damned bastards cursing us!"

"I think it looks more like the handiwork of an evil god."

"When is this corrosive rain going to stop? Is it just going to keep falling endlessly?"

"Bah! Don't jinx us with bad luck. Maybe it'll clear up in a little while."

"And if it doesn't stop? How much longer do you think our roof can hold out?"

Shang Feifan pulled Bu Shuai aside, leaning against the wall, and whispered in his ear, "Why aren't we running out of the city?"

Bu Shuai whispered back, "My intuition tells me that once the rain falls, running outside will only get us killed faster. Of course, my intuition isn't necessarily foolproof."

Shang Feifan rubbed his back. "Trust yourself."

"This whole thing is too bizarre." Bu Shuai's mind was in a whirl, unsure what to do next.

Surprisingly, Shang Feifan could still manage a chuckle. "It feels just like a video game. Following the important NPC is bound to trigger major events."

Bu Shuai didn't process it at first, but when it clicked, he gently kicked Shang Feifan's shin.

Shang Feifan let out a soft hiss of pain.

Bu Shuai straightened his expression, just about to speak, when he heard someone lift a loudspeaker and shout to everyone in the hall: "Attention, everyone!"

"The capacity of the district administrative hall is limited, but the number of people flooding in is growing by the second. If the corrosive rain cannot stop in a short time, gathering so many people here is bound to cause a disaster. I'm sure none of you want to see that happen!"

"Now, please listen to my instructions. We will divert a portion of the people to seek shelter in other buildings. Rest assured, we will not lead you through any unsheltered areas."

"As long as everyone follows orders, avoids shoving one another, and doesn't forcefully crowd or scramble for positions, everyone will be safe!"

Suddenly, another beastman rushed in and shouted at the top of his lungs: "The City Lord has just issued an order! All entrances to the Underground City will be fully opened, and any beastmen without shelter are free to enter the Underground City to escape the rain!"

The beastman who had been speaking earlier brightened up immensely: "There is an Underground City entrance right here in our building; I'm going to check it right now. Everyone, please follow the staff's instructions, and we will safely evacuate into the Underground City until this damned corrosive rain stops!"

"Long live the City Lord!" many beastmen cheered in relief.

Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai exchanged glances.

Bu Shuai gave a slight nod.

This signaled his agreement to enter the Underground City together.

Shang Feifan took hold of his hand and murmured, "This City Lord reacts remarkably fast—and wisely, at that."

A question mark practically materialized on Bu Shuai's face. Why did it feel like Shang Feifan wasn't actually praising the man?

"Are you suspecting that this corrosive rain is connected to the City Lord?" Bu Shuai asked in a hushed tone.

There were simply too many beastmen around them; even amidst the noisy environment, someone with sharp hearing might pick up on their conversation.

Shang Feifan asked, "Is the current Duke of Danton a dictator?"

Bu Shuai shook his head. "How could anyone tolerate another sleeping soundly by the side of their couch? While the Black Forest City is a vassal city under the Royal Capital, and its major strongholds are controlled by high-ranking nobles, the key positions—such as officials and generals in the vassal cities—are personally dispatched by the Tiger King himself. Furthermore, to deliberately curb the power of the City Lords, the Tiger King forcibly assigned them auxiliary Vice City Lords. There are three Vice City Lords in Black Forest City. Ah, you mean..."

Shang Feifan chuckled softly. "The corrosive rain has barely been falling for ten minutes. Even if this City Lord were the most diligent ruler on earth, possessing first-class control over his subordinates, do you think ten minutes is enough time for him to summon three Vice City Lords and other relevant officials to solicit their opinions before making a decision?"

"In an emergency, perhaps there's no need to solicit the opinions of other officials and Vice City Lords?"

"How long does it take to issue an order? This is near the North City Gate, mind you. And don't forget how chaotic Black Forest City is right now. Could you possibly transmit orders to every single relevant staff member from top to bottom under these conditions?"

There was a glint of sarcasm toward the City Lord in Shang Feifan's eyes. "I can tell you from experience that anywhere you go—no matter how well-prepared their risk contingency plans are—once a chaotic and emergency situation like a full-city panic breaks out, just getting the orders transmitted takes a massive amount of time, let alone the fact that there are no cell phones or internet here."

"...Then why would he do this? This harms his own citizens and his own territory."

"Perhaps only by doing this would he have an excuse to open the Underground City and herd the majority of the city's beastmen down there?"

Bu Shuai frowned. "What's inside the Underground City?"

"We'll find out once we go down," Shang Feifan said playfully. "Our timing really couldn't be more fortuitous, wouldn't you say?"

Bu Shuai pressed his lips into a thin line.

chunks.chineseText:
第102章 地下城

几名政务大厅工作人员去查看地下城入口是否开启。

之前通知所有人说城主会打开地下城入口的兽人已经离开，他还需要去其他地点通知其他人。

众兽人互看，大家对地下城现在的情况都不是很清楚。

如果这时政务大厅的房顶坚持不住，所有人会不管地下城安全与否，一股脑往里冲。

但现在这里的房顶看着还能抵御一段时间，人们自然会迟疑，尤其黑森林城关于地下城的传说很多，大多都是不好的。

“我听说地下城闹鬼，只有脑子有问题的人才会进入地下城。”

“我听说有人专门到地下城寻宝。”

“寻宝？早在地下城被发现时，整座地下城就被搬空了。传说我们丹顿侯爵的祖先之所以能发达起来，就是在地下城狠捞了一笔。”

“可我听说还有一些密室没有被发现，之前就有人拿着从一本古老日记中发现的藏宝地图，进入地下城寻宝。”

“那是骗人的好吗？什么样的密室能瞒过当时大祭司和王庭那些拥有特殊天赋的大佬的眼睛？”

“如果地下城真的还有宝贝，你觉得我们城主会就放在哪儿任由探险者去取？”

“那为什么城主不让我们进入地下城？要把地下城入口全部关闭？”

“还能为什么，当然是因为虫族诅咒！你知道地下城为什么会变成地下城吗？知道这么大一座城市是怎么变空的吗？”

“你知道？”

“我当然……不知道，但我知道城主不让我们进入地下城是为了我们好，我爷爷就说过地下城不能进入，说会遭到诅咒。”

“不是所有诅咒都和虫族有关。也不是所有不能进入的地方都遭到了虫族诅咒。”

“如果地下城真的有问题，那为什么城主现在又让我们进去避难？”

“两相其害取其轻？也可能地下城已经被清理干净，只是城主还没有想好地下城的用途，所以没有特别说明？”

“反正我是不想进入地下城。我们这个种族就不适合生活在地底下，谁愿意去谁就去，我宁愿在上面等腐蚀雨停止。”

商非凡和虎不帅靠在墙边，偷听周围人说话。

不帅借用他的非凡听力，听到了不少关于地下城的传说。

几名工作人员回来，脸上带着兴奋的神情，说地下城入口已经被开启，里面空气也是流通的，大家随时都可以进入。

有人愿意进入地下城，自然也有人不愿意。

工作人员们没有强求，愿意进入地下城的就跟他们走，不愿意的就继续留在大厅，或被引流到其他地方。

商非凡趁着人群混乱，把狰爷召唤到身前，摸出一个臂环，套到狰爷的长腿上。

狰爷趴在墙壁上，翘起长腿，似乎有点好奇套在它腿上的是什么玩意。

“我们要进入地下城。你这个身形可能进不去。万一我们失联，城中情况也不可控后，我可能没法再保护你。到时候你就不用管我们，先保护好自己，离开这座城市也可以。”

“这玩意在必要时可以帮你保命，遇到危险敲碎它，它会形成一个能维持三十分钟的保护罩，可移动。你争取在三十分钟内逃到安全地方。”

商非凡配合敲击和模仿振翅声，低声嘱咐狰爷。

狰爷听懂：这两人要单溜，不能带它，它可以自由活动。遇到危险，敲碎套在它腿上的玩意，逃命。

商非凡拍拍狰爷的长腿。

狰爷没有半点留恋地转身就跑了，它不打算待在这座大厅，人太多，虫也太多，它不喜欢。

不帅看商非凡盯着狰爷跑走的方向，以为他担心，就安慰他：“巨虫趋吉避凶的本能很强，它们能找到我们兽人都找不到的安全地点。而且别看它身体庞大，其实很多巨虫都能钻进我们钻不进去的地方。”

商非凡：“我不是担心它，我是好奇它会躲到什么地方。”

狰爷休憩和躲避的地方并不是都适合兽人，所以狰爷并不会主动带领商非凡他们和它一起走。除非商非凡要求它帮忙找一处大家都能当做安全营地的地方。

“其实我可以把狰爷体型变小。”不帅小声说。

商非凡：“能长时间维持吗？”

不帅摇头：“有时间限制。就跟变形魔法一样。”

“算了，狰爷也不一定愿意变小。”商非凡捏捏不帅的手指：“我倒是很想变小，让你装在口袋里带着走。”

不帅扭头就往政务大厅的工作人员走去。

商非凡笑，跟上不帅。

北区的地下城入口位于办公人员的宿舍楼下面，所有办公人员都知道这一点。

大家顺着走廊，跟在工作人员身后，一路来到宿舍的负一层入口。

“这下面就是地下城入口，请大家跟紧我。走下台阶后，大家会看到一扇打开的石门，经过石门，会看到一段地下石桥，石桥不算宽敞，大家千万不要推挤。”

工作人员就跟导游一样，举着喇叭大声介绍，说完就拿起墙上的油肚虫灯，领先走下台阶。

跟在后面的兽人们没怎么迟疑，一个接一个进入那个黑黝黝的楼梯口。

商非凡和虎不帅几乎同时顿住脚步。

这下面……

两人互看。

后面排着的兽人催促他们：“你们发什么呆，快下去啊。”

两人没有说话，沉默地一起走下楼梯。

楼梯不算高，只有十三阶。

下去就能看到一扇敞开的石门。

石门不算特别宽敞，只能让两个强壮兽人并肩进入。

石门后点了灯，能勉强看清一小段道路。

商非凡看到地面似乎刻有花纹，也许是石砖的纹路。

两人一前一后经过石门，看到了工作人员所说的石桥。

石桥上每隔一段路就挂着一个油肚虫灯，石桥还有护栏，路面也很平整，没有半点缺失的地方，状态保持得非常好。

商非凡特意挨近护栏，往护栏下面看。

下面黑洞洞的，以他的眼力都看不清下面有多深。但他可以确定石桥下面不是水流，他完全没有听到流水声。

因为石桥上面人推人不好停留，商非凡也无法多打量，只能顺着人-流往前走。

到了石桥这里，就是两两并肩前行。

商非凡理所当然地握住不帅的手。

不帅也没挣脱，随他去了。

这么多兽人，大人小孩少年都有，理应很吵闹，但古怪的是在经过那扇石门后，几乎所有兽人都变得安静，没有一个人大声说话。

大家似乎被地下城特殊的幽静环境给慑住了。

为此，工作人员的说话声变得异常清晰，尤其他的声音还经过喇叭放大。

“大家请注意，石桥大约有二三十米，经过石桥后，大家就能踏上地下城的坚实地面。这里有风，大家感觉到没有？所以不用担心通气问题，这里空气很清新，我想地下城对外的通气口肯定很多。”

该工作人员可能为了搞活气氛，特意说得很轻松，还发出了笑声，但很快他就收起笑声。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 102: The Underground City (Part 1)

A few administrative hall staff members went to check whether the entrance to the underground city had been opened.

The beastman who had previously notified everyone that the City Lord would open the underground city entrance had already left; he still needed to go to other locations to inform others.

The various beastmen looked at each other, as everyone was quite unclear about the current situation of the underground city.

If the roof of the administrative hall couldn't hold out at this moment, everyone would blindly rush inside regardless of whether the underground city was safe or not.

But right now, the roof here looked like it could still withstand the elements for a while, so people naturally hesitated. In particular, there were many legends about the underground city in the Black Forest City, most of which were bad.

"I heard the underground city is haunted. Only people with something wrong in their heads would go in there."

"I heard some people go specifically into the underground city to hunt for treasure."

"Treasure hunting? Ever since the underground city was discovered, the entire place was cleaned out. Legend has it that the reason our Marquis of Danton's ancestors were able to make a fortune was because they struck it big in the underground city."

"But I heard there are still some secret chambers that haven't been discovered yet. Someone previously went into the underground city to hunt for treasure holding a treasure map found in an ancient diary."

"That's a lie, alright? What kind of secret chamber could possibly elude the eyes of the High Priest and those big shots in the Royal Court with special talents back then?"

"If there were really still treasures in the underground city, do you think our City Lord would just leave them there for adventurers to take?"

"Then why won't the City Lord let us enter the underground city? Why close all the entrances to it?"

"Why else? Of course, because of the insect curse! Do you know why the underground city became an underground city? Do you know how such a massive city became empty?"

"You know?"

"I certainly... don't know, but I know the City Lord isn't letting us enter the underground city for our own good. My grandfather said the underground city must not be entered, saying it would bring a curse."

"Not every curse is related to the Zerg. And not every place you can't enter has been struck by a Zerg curse."

"If there's really a problem with the underground city, why is the City Lord telling us to go in for refuge now?"

"Choosing the lesser of two evils? Or maybe the underground city has already been cleared out, and the City Lord just hasn't figured out its use yet, which is why there's no special explanation?"

"Anyway, I don't want to enter the underground city. Our race simply isn't suited to living underground. Whoever wants to go can go; I'd rather wait up here for the corrosive rain to stop."

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai leaned against the wall, eavesdropping on the people around them.

Bushuai made use of his extraordinary hearing to catch quite a few legends about the underground city.

The few staff members returned with excited expressions on their faces, stating that the entrance to the underground city had been opened, the air inside was circulating, and everyone could enter at any time.

While some people were willing to enter the underground city, naturally, others were not.

The staff did not force anyone; those who were willing to enter the underground city followed them, while those who were unwilling chose to remain in the main hall or were directed to other locations.

Taking advantage of the chaotic crowd, Shang Feifan summoned the Beastly Mount to his side, pulled out an arm ring, and slipped it onto one of the beast's long legs.

The Beastly Mount lay flat against the wall, lifting its long leg as if somewhat curious about the contraption clamped onto it.

"We are going to enter the underground city. With your size, you probably won't be able to fit in. In case we lose contact, and the situation in the city becomes uncontrollable, I might not be able to protect you anymore. When that time comes, you don't need to worry about us—protect yourself first and leave this city if you have to."

"This thing can help save your life when necessary. If you encounter danger, smash it, and it will form a mobile protective shield that can last for thirty minutes. Try your best to escape to a safe place within those thirty minutes."

Shang Feifan accompanied his words by tapping and mimicking the sound of flapping wings, giving low instructions to the Beastly Mount.

The Beastly Mount understood: these two humans were going to slip away alone and couldn't bring it along, meaning it had the freedom to move about. If it encountered danger, it was to smash the thing on its leg and run for its life.

Shang Feifan patted the Beastly Mount's long leg.

Without the slightest bit of reluctance, the Beastly Mount turned and bolted. It had no intention of staying in this hall; there were too many people and too many bugs, and it didn't like it.

Seeing Shang Feifan staring in the direction the Beastly Mount had run off to, Bushuai assumed he was worried and comforted him: "Giant insects have a very strong instinct for seeking fortune and avoiding disaster; they can find safe locations that even we beastmen can't. Besides, don't look at its massive body—actually, many giant insects can squeeze into places we can't fit into."

Shang Feifan: "I'm not worried about it; I'm just curious about where it's going to hide."

Not all places where the Beastly Mount rested and hid were suitable for beastmen, so the Beastly Mount wouldn't proactively lead Shang Feifan and the others to travel with it—unless Shang Feifan asked it to help find a place they could all use as a safe camp.

"Actually, I can make the Beastly Mount smaller," Bushuai said softly.

Shang Feifan: "Can it maintain that for a long time?"

Bushuai shook his head: "There's a time limit. It's just like transformation magic."

"Forget it, the Beastly Mount might not even want to shrink," Shang Feifan pinched Bushuai's fingers. "I actually really want to shrink down and let you carry me around in your pocket."

Bushuai turned around and walked straight toward the administrative hall staff.

Shang Feifan smiled and followed after him.

The underground city entrance in the North District was located beneath the staff dormitory building, something all the office personnel knew.

Following the staff, everyone moved along the corridor, leading all the way to the basement-level entrance of the dormitory.

"Right down here is the entrance to the underground city. Please stay close to me. After walking down the steps, everyone will see an open stone door. Pass through the stone door, and you will see a section of underground stone bridge. The bridge isn't very spacious, so please make sure not to push or shove."

Like a tour guide, the staff member raised a loudspeaker and introduced the way loudly. Finished speaking, he picked up an oil-belly worm lamp from the wall and took the lead down the steps.

The beastmen following behind didn't hesitate much, entering that pitch-black stairwell one after another.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai came to a halt almost simultaneously.

Down here...

The two looked at each other.

The beastmen lined up behind them urged: "What are you two daydreaming for? Hurry up and go down."

Without speaking, the two silently walked down the stairs together.

The staircase wasn't very tall, consisting of only thirteen steps.

Upon descending, one could see an open stone door.

The stone door wasn't particularly wide, only allowing two sturdy beastmen to enter side by side.

Lights were lit behind the stone door, barely illuminating a short stretch of the path.

Shang Feifan noticed that the ground seemed to be carved with patterns, perhaps the texture of stone bricks.

Passing through the stone door one after the other, the two saw the stone bridge the staff member had mentioned.

An oil-belly worm lamp was hung along the stone bridge at regular intervals. The bridge also had guardrails, and the road surface was very flat without the slightest missing piece, maintained in exceptionally good condition.

Shang Feifan deliberately moved close to the guardrail and looked down beneath it.

It was pitch black below, and even with his eyesight, he couldn't make out how deep it was. Yet he could be certain there was no flowing water beneath the stone bridge, as he didn't hear the sound of flowing water at all.

Because people were pressing forward on the stone bridge and he couldn't linger, Shang Feifan couldn't look around much longer either, and could only move forward with the flow of people.

Once they reached the stone bridge, people walked two by two abreast.

As a matter of course, Shang Feifan took Bushuai's hand.

Bushuai didn't pull away either, letting him be.

With so many beastmen around—adults, children, and youths alike—it ought to have been noisy, but the strange thing was that after passing through that stone door, almost all the beastmen grew quiet, and not a single person spoke out loud.

Everyone seemed cowed by the special, tranquil environment of the underground city.

Because of this, the staff member's voice sounded exceptionally clear, especially since his voice was amplified by the loudspeaker.

"Please pay attention, everyone. The stone bridge is about twenty to thirty meters long. After crossing the stone bridge, you will step onto the solid ground of the underground city. There is a breeze here—can everyone feel it? So there's no need to worry about ventilation; the air here is very fresh. I imagine there must be many external ventilation vents for the underground city."

Perhaps to liven up the atmosphere, the staff member spoke very casually and even let out a laugh, but he quickly reined it in.

chunks.chineseText:
实话实说，如果只他一个人，他绝对不会进入这座地下城，哪怕现在周围都是人，他也感觉毛毛的。

通过石桥，就是一个像是广场的广阔平地。

这其实就是一间大型地下室。虽然面积大，但因为层高不高，给兽人们的感觉很压抑。

好在很快前面带路的工作人员又用喇叭大声介绍：“大家请注意！再往前面走，大家会看到一个很宽的往下的阶梯。这个阶梯往下我们还没有下去过，不过我想下面应该很安全。当然，我们会走在最前面，如果有什么事，我们会通知大家。”

很快，商非凡两人也看到了那道往下的阶梯。

就像是那种大型旅游区的阶梯，很宽，而且层数很多，分出了很多平台。

不帅一路计数，当他数到399阶，第十一个平台时，眼前豁然开朗。

他们看到了一座城市。

而他们现在就站在只有城楼门洞，没有城门的大门口广场上。

顺着门洞往里看，能影影绰绰看到规范的一排排建筑物，还能看到不少灯火。

是的，这座地下城竟然不是全黑，里面跟有人生活一样，路边亮着路灯，有些建筑物里也透出灯光。

刚刚还很安静的兽人们突然开始说话，一个个交头接耳，表达自己的感叹。

“我现在相信兽人世界真的有过非常辉煌的文明。”商非凡低声感叹。

他们走过的路面不是柏油马路，但也不是石砖和水泥铺出来的道路，他只能看出来这种道路不但平整，还非常结实，同时又具有一定弹性，非常适合绝大多数兽人的脚掌。

道路工程绝对是最能看出一个地方的文明程度的了。

而且从他们走下来的阶梯级数计算，这座地下城和地面之间的距离大约有七十多米。

更别说这座地下城的占地之大，虽然他们现在还没有看到这座地下城的全貌，但只从他们看到的这座庞大城楼洞门的规模来看，这座地下城都不会小于地面上的黑森林城。

建造一座庞大的地下城，可不止是挖出巨大地洞就可以，里面涉及到很多地质学、建筑学、环境学等各种复杂知识。

“也许这座城市原本是在地面上，因为战争或地质原因，才沉入地底。”不帅也小声说。

“不像是战争，你看城楼都如此完好。也不像是地面下沉，否则就不会有刚才的阶梯。”商非凡指出。

不帅：“你是说这座地下城原本就建立在地下？”

“对。”

“为什么？”

“也许是为了躲避战争，也许是种族特性，也许是人口过多？”商非凡猜测。

不帅忍不住道：“没想到兽人大陆也有人口过多的时候。”

现在的兽人数量虽然有一定恢复，但对比以前堪称少得可怜。

这也是各地领主都比较重视领民数量的缘故，所以不帅才会那么惊讶黑森林城主为何会对自己领地范围的那么多领民做不好的事情。

那得是多大的利益才能让黑森林城主如此“付出”？

前面的工作人员又在喊话：“诸位！地下城具体如何使用，我们还不太清楚。如果诸位愿意相信我们，可以先在这里等候，等我们找到上面管事的人，再看具体如何安排。”

进入的兽人也在喊：“我们要在这里待多长时间？我们喝什么、吃什么？在哪里睡觉？”

“这座地下城里的建筑物，我们可以随便进入吗？里面到底安不安全？”

“我建议大家先组织民兵队，不能这样乱散散的，总得有人管事。”

“呵！这是迫不及待就要掌权了吗？黑森林城还没真正乱起来呢！”

“这跟权力无关！难道大家就想这样乱下去，出事也不知道找谁？”

“我也觉得应该建立一个临时管理班子。衣食住行医疗守卫防止打斗抢劫偷窃，这些都需要人手管。那几个政务大厅的工作人员肯定不够。”

“诸位！请不要担心，城主既然打开地下城入口，他肯定会有所安排！请大家再等一等，不要焦急，更不要故意闹事，现在大家保持冷静是最重要的！我们已经派人去寻找……”

商非凡和虎不帅没管那些兽人们如何争吵，又是如何安顿，他们在混乱时使用隐身魔法，悄悄越过城楼门洞，进入了真正的地下城。

等远离了那些兽人，走入城池中的街巷，商非凡才低声问：“你刚才为什么会在入口处停住？你是否感知到什么？”

“你呢？”

“我……”

“嘘！”不帅忽然竖起手指，头微侧。

片刻，不帅做手势，指向两点方向。

商非凡点头，跟着放轻脚步。

两人仍旧是隐身状态，悄悄靠近说话声传来的地方。

前面的街道中迎面走来三个兽人。

三人边走边说话。

“北区的人速度好快，他们竟然已经进入地下城。”

“因为那边的入口最好找，很多人都知道，就在政务大厅宿舍楼下面。走吧，我们过去迎接他们，可不能让他们在地下城乱跑。”

“你们负责去引导。我去看那边的准备工作是否都已完成。”

商非凡做了个手势，不帅表示明白。

两人跟上了那个单独离开的兽人。

那个单独行动的兽人怎么也没想到有人隐身跟在他身后，他连半点警惕都没有，就这么直直地走向目的地。

目的地是一片住宅区，如同联排小别墅，一排排整齐排列，前后还都有小院子，只不过全都只有一层，只是层高很高。

那里灯火通明，已经有人在忙碌。

“都准备好了吗？躲雨的人就要过来了。”

“这么快？”

“我们这边已经差不多。保证三天的粮食和净水。但没有铺盖……”

“铺盖不需要，我们这是救急，只三天，怕冷的兽人可以变成兽形，再不行还可以挤一挤。另外，要确保每栋屋子至少住进三个以上的兽人。”

“知道了。”

那个单独过来的兽人像是头目，在这里巡视一圈后，又离开了。

等到那个兽人离开，有一个看起来不太健壮的兽人小声跟身边同伴说：“我觉得这次行动好奇怪。”

“哪里奇怪？”另一个在搬运干粮的兽人随口说。

“哪里都很奇怪。首先，为什么城主会提前知道我们黑森林城会遇到灾难？其次，城主既然能让我们提前准备，为什么不能提前告知城民，警告大家不要出门？最古怪的一点，什么时候那些大贵族会在乎平民的生死了，竟然还让我们……”

“够了！你可闭嘴吧。你想死我还不想死！”同伴瞪那个不太健壮的兽人。

那兽人在嘴唇处画了一个叉，表示不会再乱说。

可不到两秒，他又忍不住说道：“我应该警告我姐姐她一家，如果我能知道上面安排我运送净水到地下城是为了安排大家躲避灾难，我一定会让他们赶紧出城！”
chunks.englishText:
Truth be told, if he were alone, he would absolutely never enter this underground city. Even now, with people all around him, he still felt a bit creeped out.

Crossing the stone bridge led to a vast, flat clearing that resembled a plaza.

This was actually just a massive basement. Although it was vast, the low ceiling gave the beastmen a very oppressive, suffocating feeling.

Fortunately, the staff member leading the way soon announced loudly through a megaphone again, "Attention, everyone! If you keep going forward, you will see a very wide staircase leading down. We haven't gone down this staircase ourselves yet, but I believe it should be very safe down there. Of course, we will lead the way, and if anything happens, we will notify you."

Soon, Shang Feifan and his companion also saw the descending staircase.

It was like the stairs in a massive tourist resort—very wide, with many steps, divided by numerous landings.

Bushuai counted the steps along the way. When he reached the 399th step at the eleventh landing, the view before them suddenly opened up.

They saw a city.

And they were currently standing on a plaza before a grand entrance that had only a gatehouse archway but no actual city gates.

Looking through the archway, they could faintly make out orderly rows of buildings and quite a few flickering lights.

Indeed, this underground city was not completely dark. It looked as though people actually lived here; streetlamps lined the roads, and light spilled from some of the buildings.

The beastmen, who had been quiet just moments ago, suddenly began to chatter, whispering to one another and voicing their awe.

"I believe now that the beastman world truly once possessed an incredibly glorious civilization," Shang Feifan murmured in awe.

The road they walked on was not asphalt, nor was it paved with stone bricks or concrete. He could only tell that it was not only flat and extremely sturdy, but also possessed a certain elasticity, making it highly suitable for the paws of most beastmen.

Road engineering was definitely one of the clearest indicators of a society's level of civilization.

Furthermore, calculating from the number of steps they had descended, the distance between this underground city and the surface was roughly seventy-odd meters.

Not to mention the sheer size of this underground city. Although they had not yet seen its full layout, judging solely by the scale of the massive gatehouse archway before them, this underground city would not be any smaller than Black Forest City on the surface.

Building a massive underground city was not as simple as digging a giant hole; it involved complex knowledge of geology, architecture, environmental science, and more.

"Perhaps this city was originally on the surface and sank underground due to war or geological shifts," Bushuai whispered.

"It doesn't look like war; look at how intact the gatehouse is. It doesn't look like ground subsidence either, otherwise those stairs wouldn't be here," Shang Feifan pointed out.

Bushuai asked, "Are you saying this underground city was built underground from the very beginning?"

"Yes."

"Why?"

"Maybe to escape war, maybe due to racial traits, or maybe because of overpopulation?" Shang Feifan guessed.

Bushuai couldn't help but say, "I didn't expect the Beastman Continent to ever have a time of overpopulation."

Although the current population of beastmen had recovered somewhat, it was still pitifully small compared to the past.

This was also why lords everywhere placed great importance on the number of their subjects. That was why Bushuai had been so shocked that the Lord of Black Forest City would do such terrible things to so many of his own citizens.

Just how immense of a benefit would it take to make the Lord of Black Forest City make such a "sacrifice"?

The staff member ahead was shouting again, "Everyone! We are not yet clear on how this underground city is to be utilized. If you are willing to trust us, please wait here first. Once we find the person in charge above, we will see how things are to be arranged."

The beastmen who had entered also began to shout, "How long do we have to stay here? What will we eat and drink? Where will we sleep?"

"Can we enter the buildings in this underground city at will? Is it actually safe inside?"

"I suggest we organize a militia first. We can't just scatter in chaos; someone has to be in charge."

"Heh! Eager to seize power already? Black Forest City hasn't even truly fallen into chaos yet!"

"This has nothing to do with power! Do you all want to just remain in chaos like this, not knowing who to turn to if something happens?"

"I also think we should establish a temporary management committee. Food, clothing, shelter, transportation, medical care, security, preventing fights, robberies, and thefts—all of these require manpower to manage. Those few staff members from the administrative hall are definitely not enough."

"Everyone! Please do not worry. Since the City Lord opened the entrance to the underground city, he will surely have arrangements! Please wait a little longer, do not panic, and especially do not cause trouble on purpose. Staying calm is the most important thing right now! We have already sent people to look for..."

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai ignored how the beastmen bickered or settled down. Using invisibility magic amidst the chaos, they quietly slipped past the gatehouse archway and entered the true underground city.

Once they were far from the beastmen and walking through the streets and alleys of the city, Shang Feifan asked in a low voice, "Why did you stop at the entrance earlier? Did you sense something?"

"What about you?"

"I..."

"Shh!" Bushuai suddenly raised a finger, tilting his head slightly.

After a moment, Bushuai gestured, pointing in the two o'clock direction.

Shang Feifan nodded, softening his footsteps in turn.

Still invisible, the two of them quietly approached the source of the voices.

Three beastmen were walking toward them from the street ahead.

The three of them chatted as they walked.

"The people from the North District are so fast; they've actually entered the underground city already."

"Because the entrance on that side is the easiest to find. Many people know it's right under the administrative hall's dormitory building. Let's go, we need to head over and receive them. We can't let them run wild in the underground city."

"You guys handle the guiding. I'll go check if the preparations over there are complete."

Shang Feifan made a gesture, and Bushuai signaled his understanding.

The two of them followed the beastman who had departed alone.

The beastman acting alone never dreamed that someone was following him invisibly. Lacking even a shred of vigilance, he walked straight toward his destination.

The destination was a residential area that looked like a cluster of townhouses. They were arranged in neat rows, each with small front and back yards, though they were all only one story tall with very high ceilings.

The area was brightly lit, and people were already busy at work.

"Is everything ready? The people seeking shelter from the rain will be here soon."

"So fast?"

"We're almost done on our end. We've secured three days' worth of food and clean water. But there's no bedding..."

"Bedding isn't necessary. This is an emergency measure for only three days. Beastmen who are sensitive to the cold can shift into their beast forms, and if all else fails, they can huddle together. Also, make sure that each house has at least three or more beastmen staying in it."

"Understood."

The beastman who had come alone seemed to be a leader. After doing a round of inspection, he left.

Once that beastman had left, a rather frail-looking beastman whispered to his companion, "I think this operation is really strange."

"What's strange about it?" another beastman carrying dry rations replied casually.

"Everything is strange. First of all, why did the City Lord know in advance that our Black Forest City would encounter a disaster? Secondly, since the City Lord could have us prepare in advance, why couldn't he notify the citizens beforehand and warn everyone not to go out? And the strangest part of all—since when do those grand nobles care about the lives of commoners, to the point of having us..."

"Enough! Shut your mouth. You might want to die, but I don't!" The companion glared at the frail beastman.

The beastman drew an 'X' over his lips, indicating he wouldn't speak out of turn again.

But not even two seconds later, he couldn't help but say, "I should have warned my sister and her family. If I had known that the higher-ups had me transport clean water to the underground city just to arrange for everyone to take shelter from a disaster, I would have definitely told them to leave the city immediately!"

chunks.chineseText:
“小声点！”同伴呵斥，同时压低声音：“不止你一个人这么想。刚才知道城里突然下起腐蚀雨，大家都吓坏了，都很担心自家人，可我们现在一个都不能离开。你别忘了，这里除了我们，还有……”

“不用担心。上面说了，这次进入地下城的工作人员，不管职位高低，我们的家人都能得到妥善安排，他们会被集中安排到另一个区域。”一名兽人走过来，高声说。

“真的？”不算健壮的兽人惊喜。

“那些贫民区的贫民都能被安排进来，更何况我们？”

听到这话的工作人员都安心了，他们不安心也不行，这时候谁想离开工作岗位都不可能，有人盯着他们呢。

“但也请大家都记住一点，不要乱说话！不管那些城民询问任何事情，我们都只说是上面安排，是城主仁慈，其他一概不知。如果有谁说了不该说的话，那他家人的优待会被取消，还有他自己，也会和他的家人一起被撵出安全的地下城，上去品尝腐蚀雨的滋味。”

高声说话的兽人脸上在笑，声音却极为阴森。

这下所有工作人员都不说话了，大家变得更加“忙碌”。

虎不帅脸上疑惑神色变得更加明显。

商非凡眼含讽刺。

两人离开这块区域，往更深处走。

隐身时间到了，两人现出身形。

周围没有人，两人也就没有再隐身。

待周围再没有其他动静后，两人才低声说话。

“这简直就是秃子头上的虱子，明摆着有问题！”不帅气愤。

“但很有效。只要大家事先不知情，就一定会上当。”商非凡平静得多，他看过经历过的卑劣事情太多。有时上位者为了达到自己的目的，老百姓对他们来说就是一个数字。

不止是上位者，就算是普通人，有时候为了达成自己的目的，或为利益，或为报复，也会不顾其他普通人的生死，甚至因为不敢对真正的报复对象出手，而只能在其他无辜者身上发泄自己的怒气。

“只是为什么要特意照顾大家？这可不像是黑森林城主的行为习惯。”不帅想不通：“如果想要把大量城民坑入地下城，那为什么还要为他们准备住房，还有三天的食水？这可不是小数量。”

商非凡推测：“可能是需要三天才能达成目的？在这之前，不能让城民乱起来，更要保持状态良好？”

不帅皱紧眉头：“不管如何，我们得让大家离开地下城。地面上的房子应该还能支撑一段时间，而且我不相信腐蚀雨会一直下下去，除非丹顿侯爵不想再要这座城市。”

“如果你让大家上去，你信不信腐蚀雨会一直下下去。”

不帅腾地抬起头，看到商非凡冷静到还带着一丝笑意的双眼。

商非凡声音平淡：“我不知道最终会有多少城民进入这座地下城，但人数绝对不会少于全城十分之一人口，也许更多，这就要看丹顿侯爵是否打算把藏在各自家里的兽人也撤离到地下城。等他把地下城入口关闭的时候，就是地下城人口达到他所需数量的时候。”

“丹顿侯爵能‘牺牲’这么多城民，只为达到他某个目的。如果他的目的不能达成，你觉得他会怎么做？”

不帅喉头动了动，声音沙哑：“他会……报复？但也许他会等待下一个时机……”

“亲爱的，别天真了。千万不要对一个能随意牺牲自己子民的掌权者抱有期待，对他们来说，城民只是他们养在羊圈里的羊，想什么时候宰杀，全看他们的需要和心情。”

商非凡竟然掏出一枚干果捏开，倒出里面的果仁分给不帅。

“而且你也说了，那位侯爵大人不是报复就是等待下一个机会。你觉得下次我们还能这么巧地正好碰到他祸害自己的城民，然后让我们再拯救这座城的城民一次？”

商非凡摇摇手指：“他只会变得更狡猾，做事更隐密。至少不会留下这次这样明显的把柄和漏洞。也许这次他也不是不知道这个计划很粗糙，可那位侯爵大人不在意，因为能暴露他漏洞和成为把柄的证据，都会在事情过后彻底消失掉。”

商非凡捏开第二枚干果：“这就是上位者的傲慢。托他傲慢的福，我们才会刚来就查到这么多。”

不帅默默地捏起那枚被硬塞过来的果仁放入嘴里，“……难道我们就眼睁睁看着必然要发生的灾难发生？”

“怎么可能？”商非凡失笑：“我们现在也在地下城中。如果地下城里真的要发生什么更可怕的灾祸，我不觉得我们也能逃得过去。”

“你刚才在地下城入口感觉到了什么？”不帅忽然问。

他还对商非凡眨了眨眼睛。

商非凡就觉得这样的不帅特别可爱，对他笑了笑，表示明白。嘴中说：“跟上次在摩罗城外，在那个邪神信徒营地，感受到的能量一样。”

不帅：“……邪神的力量。”

不知道是不是自然之神的关系，不帅刚才在入口处感到极度不适，就好像这里的能量在排斥他，或者说他的本能在讨厌这个地下城中的某些东西。

“走吧，我们时间不多，不管那位城主大人要干什么，我们都得抢在他发动前找到代表邪神力量的东西。”商非凡转头四看，似乎在寻找方向：“我怀疑这里也有一座邪神雕像。”

上次那座邪神雕像可是给他带来不少好处。

如果是从这个意义层面上来说，他们接下来要做的事情也可以划为寻宝行列？

这样一想，商非凡顿时觉得自己的行动力biubiu上升。

不帅带着一点茫然，喃喃道：“你和我都能感知到邪神的力量，偏偏我们就在灾难发生的前一刻来到黑森林城。你说这代表着什么？”

“代表兽人大陆还不想毁灭？代表这片大陆或这个世界想要自救？”商非凡点点自己的脑袋：“也许这真的是一个游戏，背后有一只或几只大手在推动这个游戏，而我们看似玩家，其实真正玩游戏的玩家并不是我们。”

不帅很懂地接口：“我们只是真玩家操纵的小人？”

商非凡笑起来。

不帅也笑：“这么一说，我忽然就安心了。感觉这才是我人生的正确节奏。”

商非凡伸手用力一推，把人推到墙上，上去就亲。

不帅按住他的嘴巴，不让他亲。

商非凡就握着他的手胡乱亲。

不帅手臂放松，慢慢闭上了眼睛。

“咳，我不是想要打扰两位。只是……时间真的不多了，而我听到你们说话，你们似乎也是来找黑森林城主麻烦的？”

商非凡转头，但他并没有离开不帅，而是依然挨着他。

不帅睁开眼睛，也没有动，只是脸有点红。

商非凡声音慵懒，神情危险：“老兄，你终于肯出来了。”

阴影中走出一个人。

对方高举双手：“嗨，先说明，我不是黑森林城主那一边，相反，我和你们应该目的相同？”
chunks.englishText:
"Keep your voice down!" his companion hissed, lowering his voice further. "You're not the only one who thinks that way. When we found out earlier that corrosive rain had suddenly started falling in the city, everyone was terrified and worried sick about their families. But none of us can leave right now. Don't forget, besides us, there are also..."

"No need to worry. The higher-ups said that for the staff entering the underground city this time, regardless of rank, our families will be properly taken care of. They will be gathered and settled in another area," a beastman walked over and said loudly.

"Really?" The frail beastman was pleasantly surprised.

"Even the paupers from the slums can be brought in, let alone us."

Hearing this, the staff members all felt relieved. Not that they had a choice; at a time like this, it was impossible for anyone to leave their post, as they were being watched.
