"But please remember one thing: do not talk out of turn! No matter what those citizens ask, we are only to say that it was arranged by the higher-ups and that the City Lord is benevolent. We know nothing else. If anyone says something they shouldn't, their family's preferential treatment will be revoked, and they themselves, along with their families, will be kicked out of this safe underground city to taste the corrosive rain above."

The beastman speaking loudly had a smile on his face, but his voice was chillingly sinister.

At this, all the staff members fell silent, and everyone became even more "busy."

The look of doubt on Hu Bushuai's face grew even more pronounced.

Shang Feifan's eyes held a trace of sarcasm.

The two of them left this area and headed deeper inside.

The duration of their invisibility expired, and they revealed themselves.

Since there was no one around, they didn't turn invisible again.

Only when there was no other sound around did they speak in low voices.

"This is as plain as a louse on a bald head—there's obviously something wrong here!" Bushuai said angrily.

"But it's highly effective. As long as the people are kept in the dark beforehand, they will surely fall for it." Shang Feifan was much calmer; he had seen and experienced too many despicable things. Sometimes, to achieve their own goals, those in power treated ordinary people as mere numbers.

It wasn't just those in power. Even ordinary people, sometimes to achieve their own ends, whether for profit or revenge, would disregard the lives of other ordinary people. Some, too cowardly to strike at the actual targets of their vengeance, would vent their anger on innocent bystanders instead.

"But why go to the trouble of taking care of everyone? This doesn't seem like the Lord of Black Forest City's usual way of doing things." Bushuai couldn't wrap his head around it. "If he wanted to trap a large number of citizens in the underground city, why prepare housing and three days' worth of food and water for them? That's no small amount."

Shang Feifan speculated, "Perhaps it takes three days to achieve his goal? Before that, he can't let the citizens descend into chaos, and he needs to keep them in good condition?"

Bushuai frowned deeply. "Regardless, we have to get everyone out of this underground city. The houses on the surface should still hold up for a while, and I don't believe the corrosive rain will fall forever—unless Marquis Denton no longer wants this city."

"If you make everyone go back up, believe it or not, the corrosive rain will keep falling."

Bushuai snapped his head up, meeting Shang Feifan's calm eyes, which held a faint trace of a smile.

Shang Feifan's voice was flat. "I don't know how many citizens will ultimately enter this underground city, but the number definitely won't be less than a tenth of the city's population, perhaps even more. It depends on whether Marquis Denton plans to evacuate the beastmen hiding in their own homes into the underground city as well. The moment he closes the entrance to the underground city will be when the population down here reaches the number he requires."

"Marquis Denton is willing to 'sacrifice' so many citizens just to achieve some goal of his. If his goal isn't met, what do you think he will do?"

Bushuai's throat bobbed, his voice raspy. "He would... retaliate? But maybe he would wait for the next opportunity..."

"My dear, don't be naive. Never harbor expectations for a ruler who can sacrifice his own people at a whim. To them, the citizens are merely sheep kept in a pen, to be slaughtered whenever it suits their needs and mood."

Shang Feifan actually pulled out a dried nut, cracked it open, and poured out the kernel inside to share with Bushuai.

"And as you said, that Marquis will either retaliate or wait for the next opportunity. Do you think we'll be lucky enough to catch him harming his own citizens next time, allowing us to save the people of this city once again?"

Shang Feifan wagged his finger. "He will only become craftier and more secretive. At the very least, he won't leave behind such obvious leverage and loopholes. Perhaps he isn't unaware that this plan is crude, but the Marquis doesn't care, because any evidence that could expose his loopholes and become leverage will completely vanish once the deed is done."

Shang Feifan cracked open a second nut. "This is the arrogance of those in power. Thanks to his arrogance, we managed to uncover so much the moment we arrived."

Bushuai silently picked up the kernel that had been stuffed into his hand and popped it into his mouth. "...Are we just going to watch idly as an inevitable disaster unfolds?"

"How could we?" Shang Feifan chuckled. "We are currently inside the underground city as well. If some even more terrifying catastrophe is truly about to occur here, I don't think we would be able to escape it either."

"What did you feel at the entrance of the underground city earlier?" Bushuai asked suddenly.

He even blinked at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan found Bushuai incredibly adorable like this. He smiled back, signaling his understanding, and said, "It's the same energy I felt outside Molo City, in that camp of evil god cultists."

Bushuai: "...The power of an evil god."

Perhaps due to his connection with the God of Nature, Bushuai had felt extremely uncomfortable at the entrance earlier, as if the energy here was repelling him, or rather, his instincts loathed something within this underground city.

"Let's go. We don't have much time. No matter what that City Lord is planning, we must find the object representing the evil god's power before he initiates it." Shang Feifan looked around, seemingly searching for a direction. "I suspect there is an evil god statue here as well."

That evil god statue last time had brought him quite a few benefits.

If looked at from this perspective, could their next course of action be classified as a treasure hunt?

At this thought, Shang Feifan instantly felt his motivation shoot up.

Bushuai murmured with a hint of daze, "Both you and I can perceive the power of the evil god, and we just happened to arrive in Black Forest City right before the disaster struck. What do you think this represents?"

"It represents that the Beastman Continent doesn't want to be destroyed yet? That this continent or this world wants to save itself?" Shang Feifan tapped his own head. "Maybe this really is a game, with one or several giant hands behind the scenes driving it. We might seem like players, but the ones actually playing the game aren't us."

Bushuai chimed in understandingly, "We're just the avatars controlled by the real players?"

Shang Feifan laughed.

Bushuai laughed too. "Put that way, I suddenly feel at ease. It feels like this is the correct rhythm of my life."

Shang Feifan reached out and shoved him hard against the wall, leaning in to kiss him.

Bushuai pressed a hand against his mouth, stopping him.

Shang Feifan simply held his hand and kissed it playfully.

Bushuai's arm relaxed, and he slowly closed his eyes.

"Cough, I didn't mean to interrupt you two. It's just... time is really running out, and from what I heard, it seems you're also here to cause trouble for the Lord of Black Forest City?"

Shang Feifan turned his head, but he didn't pull away from Bushuai, remaining close against him.

Bushuai opened his eyes and didn't move either, though his face was slightly flushed.

Shang Feifan's voice was languid, his expression dangerous. "My friend, you're finally willing to show yourself."

A figure stepped out from the shadows.

The other party raised both hands high. "Hey, let me clarify first, I'm not on the side of the Lord of Black Forest City. On the contrary, we should have the same goal, right?"

chunks.chineseText: 随后，这人又好奇地问：“你们难道早就发现我了？还有你们刚才说的话用的是什么地方的语言，我竟然很多都没听懂。”
chunks.englishText: Then, the person asked curiously, "Did you guys discover me a long time ago? Also, what language were you speaking just now? I actually couldn't understand most of it."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第103章 勇者和恶魔的诞生 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第103章 勇者和恶魔的诞生

两人确实早就发现这个人。

应该说对方也同时发现了他们，并暗中跟上两人。

两人假装不知，但两人自然而然就兽人通用语夹杂着华夏语甚至是其他语言一起使用，这也是他们提醒对方的方式。

那人一直跟着他们，似乎想要看看他们想干什么。

商非凡很促狭，故意缠着不帅亲昵。

不帅更觉得这家伙是在借机给自己谋福利，咳！

不过这人耐心似乎没有想象中那么好，他们才开始“表演”，对方就忍不住跳出来了。

“在询问别人之前，你是不是应该先来个自我介绍？”商非凡慢腾腾地说。

那人放下举着的双手，有点嬉皮笑脸地说：“好吧，就让我们礼尚往来。我是鹰之翼，冒险者。”

不帅略微惊讶：“是你？”

鹰之翼有点沾沾自喜地说：“你听过我？看来我还蛮有名的。”

商非凡看向不帅。

不帅低声介绍：“鹰之翼，翼国出身，号称自由的独行冒险者，同时也是寻宝家，喜欢在世界各地寻找古早遗迹，从中探宝。他的能力很强大，近些年在各国大拍卖行出现的顶级宝贝中有三分之一都是他拿出来的，很多团队都在招募他，可惜他喜欢独行。”

“哇哦，你对我真了解。现在你们知道我是谁了，那你们是？”鹰之翼看看商非凡又看看虎不帅。

商非凡：“商皇。”

虎不帅：“拉斐尔郎沐。”

鹰之翼伸手点了点商非凡：“我没听过你的名字，但你……”

鹰之翼的手指转向虎不帅：“你的名字我有点熟悉，让我想想……”

“啊！我想起来了，你是不是一名宫廷侍卫？传言中虎王的私生子？王后的眼中钉肉中刺？前年底被迫离开王城的那个？”

不帅神情淡漠：“是我。你的情报收集得也很详细。”

“过奖。那是你对自己的名气太小看了，你在王城那些大贵族眼中可是一位大人物，想利用你的人不少，可惜你跑得太快。”鹰之翼还对不帅做了个夸奖的手势：“你很聪明，知道审时度势。”

商非凡侧头对不帅说：“他在说你是个胆小鬼。”

鹰之翼：“喂！”

不帅无所谓：“我胆子确实很小。”

“介绍也介绍过了，那就……走吧。”商非凡拉住不帅的手。

“好。”不帅跟着他迈步。

鹰之翼傻眼：“你们两个这就走了？你们就不多问问？比如我是来干什么的？喂！你们真走？”

两人越走越快，竟然不是做样子。

鹰之翼立刻跟上去，但跟着跟着，就发现两人不见了。

鹰之翼气得骂：“干！”

他这是碰上了两只狐狸。

不过拉斐尔郎沐竟然会在这个关头出现在黑森林城的地下城，事情似乎越来越有意思。

他也是偶尔发现黑森林城主似乎在密谋什么，正好他对这里的地下城比较感兴趣。

这座地下城他已经不是第一次来，那次他发现这座地下城看似空荡，但他的直觉告诉他，这里还隐藏着秘密，就打算做好万全准备再过来一趟。

于是在他收集到足够的情报以及带好所需装备后，他再次来到了黑森林城。

可在他偷溜入地下城进行查探时，他偶尔发现这座城的主人竟然进入了地下城，行动看起来还很隐秘。

他一时好奇就跟了上去，然后看到对方消失在一片区域中。

他最近一直在探查这片区域，然后他就发现出入这座地下城的人越来越多，那位城主貌似想要利用这座地下城做些什么。

鹰之翼感到了危险，可偏偏他好奇心旺盛，越是神秘的事情他越是想要知道究竟。

就在他探索到一些眉目时，他发现了两个行动奇怪的人。

说他们行动奇怪，不是他们行动鬼祟，而是他们太堂堂正正，就这么走在地下城的街巷中，就像是在……散步。

两个人的神情看着也像是在谈情说爱，就是两人说的内容……

因为两人的说话内容，鹰之翼跟上两人，想要看看他们的目的到底为何。

结果两人竟然在这么关键的关头，说着说着就一副要在阴暗街巷中进行深度交流的模样，他不得不……好吧，他只是看不顺眼！他讨厌一切在他面前炫耀爱情的伴侣！

这些人压根不知道他们不顾场合的亲密行为对单身鹰的伤害有多大！

言归正传，在知道两人的身份后，鹰之翼更好奇了。

拉斐尔郎沐到底是出于私人目的来破坏丹顿侯爵的计划，还是……想要捞一杯羹？抑或干脆就是合作者？

别看拉斐尔郎沐和丹顿侯爵立场相对，但当利益足够大时，合作也不是不可能。

可恨两人完全不给他了解的机会，竟然就这么跑了！

这对于好奇心旺盛的鹰之翼来说，简直就是最大折磨，憋死他了。

看起来消失的两人其实只是使用了隐身道具，而且他们并没有远离，绕了一圈就回到了鹰之翼身边。

鹰之翼骂他们的话，他们都听到了。

随后鹰之翼在原地站了一会儿，就跳起来变身成飞鹰，飞向地下城某处。

不帅直接施展魔法，拉着商非凡飞起来，也跟了上去。

鹰之翼完全没有想到有人能跟在飞行的他身后。

变身后的他羽毛漆黑，在阴暗的地下城中，他在上空飞行，几乎无人能够察觉。

商非凡怀疑鹰之翼身上也有空间储物工具，否则他的衣裤鞋袜不会收起来那么快，还看不到他身上有任何背包。

不利用任何工具就这么在空中飞行的感觉很奇妙，商非凡能感觉到风从他脸上刮过的肆意。

虎不帅则在惊讶商非凡的镇定和自如。

一般第一次飞行的人都会惊慌失措到手忙脚乱，更多人会紧张到四肢和身体僵硬，更别说在空中保持身体平衡和自如操控自己的肌肉。

如果有高空恐惧症的人，会更糟糕。

但商非凡就像是飞行了无数次一样，在他把他拉上天空时，商竟然很自然地放松肌肉，把自己交给他，但又没有完全失去自我控制。

如果跳过伞，并带别人一起跳过伞的人，就会清楚体会到带有经验的人和没有经验者的巨大区别。

而且直立飞行和跳伞还不一样，那种脚下虚无的感觉会让人不由自主得恐惧和紧张。

可商非凡身上完全看不出这一点。

他甚至还能转头对他笑，还能伸出一支手臂揽住他的腰。

要不是不帅一直在输出魔力并控制两人的飞行方向和速度，他都要怀疑实际带着他们飞行的人是商非凡了。

行吧，他已经不是第一次知道这家伙有多厉害了。

前方鹰之翼似乎在寻找什么，在整个地下城上空都飞了一圈。

两人跟着对方，也看到了地下城各个地方的动静。

诚如那名区政务大厅工作人员所说，地下城入口很多，刚刚他们看到大量城民被引入地下城。

这些城民都被有序引入固定区域。

这些固定区域都被点亮灯火，还准备了食水。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 103: The Birth of the Hero and the Demon (Part 1)

The two of them had indeed noticed this person long ago.

Or rather, the other party had spotted them at the same time and had been tailing them in secret.

Though they pretended not to know, the two men naturally conversed using a blend of the Orc Common Tongue mixed with Huaxia idioms and even other languages—this was their subtle way of alerting each other.

That person kept following them, seemingly wanting to see what they were up to.

Shang Feifan was feeling quite mischievous and deliberately pestered Bu Shuai with affectionate intimacy.

Bu Shuai felt even more strongly that this fellow was just seizing the opportunity to reap some personal benefits for himself. *Ahem!*

However, this person's patience didn't seem as good as they had imagined; the moment they started their "performance," the fellow couldn't help but jump out.

"Before questioning others, shouldn't you introduce yourself first?" Shang Feifan asked leisurely.

The man lowered his raised hands and said with a somewhat cheeky grin, "Alright, let's observe courtesy and exchange civility. I am Eagle's Wing, an adventurer."

Bu Shuai looked slightly surprised: "It's you?"

Eagle's Wing looked rather pleased with himself. "You've heard of me? It seems I'm quite famous after all."

Shang Feifan glanced at Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai introduced in a low voice, "Eagle's Wing, originally from the Wing Kingdom, known as a free and solitary adventurer, as well as a treasure hunter. He loves searching for ancient ruins across the world to unearth treasures. His abilities are formidable; a third of the top-tier treasures that have appeared in various countries' major auction houses in recent years were brought out by him. Many mercenary groups have tried to recruit him, but unfortunately, he prefers to travel alone."

"Whoa, you really know a lot about me. Now that you know who I am, what about you two?" Eagle's Wing looked back and forth between Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai.

Shang Feifan: "Shang Huang."

Hu Bushuai: "Raphael Langmu."

Eagle's Wing reached out and pointed at Shang Feifan: "I've never heard your name, but you..."

Eagle's Wing's finger shifted toward Hu Bushuai: "Your name sounds a bit familiar to me. Let me think..."

"Ah! I remember now. Aren't you a palace guard? Rumored to be the illegitimate son of the Tiger King? A thorn in the Queen's side? The one who was forced to flee the royal city the year before last?"

Bu Shuai's expression remained indifferent: "It is me. Your intelligence gathering is also quite detailed."

"Flattering, flattering. That's just because you underestimate your own fame. In the eyes of those high nobles in the royal city, you're quite a big figure. There are quite a few people who wanted to use you, but unfortunately, you ran too fast." Eagle's Wing even gave Bu Shuai a complimentary gesture. "You're very smart and know how to read the situation."

Shang Feifan turned his head to Bu Shuai and said, "He's saying you're a coward."

Eagle's Wing: "Hey!"

Bu Shuai was nonchalant: "My courage is indeed very small."

"Introductions are done, so... let's go." Shang Feifan grabbed Bu Shuai's hand.

"Alright." Bu Shuai followed his steps.

Eagle's Wing was dumbfounded: "You two are just leaving like this? Aren't you going to ask more questions? Like what I'm here to do? Hey! Are you really leaving?"

The two walked faster and faster, and they clearly weren't just putting on an act.

Eagle's Wing immediately gave chase, but the more he followed, the more he realized the two of them had vanished.

Eagle's Wing cursed in frustration: "Damn it!"

He had run into a pair of old foxes.

However, for Raphael Langmu to appear in the Black Forest City's underground labyrinth at a juncture like this—things seemed to be getting more and more interesting.

He had also stumbled upon the fact that the Lord of Black Forest City seemed to be plotting something, and as it happened, he was rather interested in the labyrinth here.

This wasn't his first time visiting this labyrinth. During his previous visit, he had found that the underground city seemed deceptively empty, but his intuition told him there were hidden secrets here, so he had planned to make full preparations before coming back.

Thus, after gathering sufficient intelligence and packing the necessary equipment, he had returned to Black Forest City.

Yet, while he was sneaking into the labyrinth to investigate, he accidentally discovered that the lord of the city himself had entered the labyrinth, and his movements looked extremely covert.

Out of sudden curiosity, he had followed him, only to watch the man vanish into a certain sector.

He had been scouting this sector continuously ever since, and then he noticed that more and more people were entering and exiting the labyrinth; that city lord apparently wanted to use this underground city to accomplish something.

Eagle's Wing sensed danger, but as luck would have it, his curiosity was insatiable. The more mysterious something was, the more he wanted to get to the bottom of it.

Just as he was making some headway in his exploration, he spotted two people acting strangely.

By strange, he didn't mean they were acting stealthily—rather, they were walking with far too much upright swagger down the streets of the labyrinth, as if they were... out for a stroll.

The expressions on their faces also looked as though they were sweethearts whispering sweet nothings; it was just that the content of their conversation...

Because of what they were saying, Eagle's Wing had trailed them, wanting to see what their true purpose was.

As a result, right at such a critical juncture, the two of them started talking as if they were about to have a deep, intimate exchange right there in a gloomy alleyway, forcing him to—well, fine! He just couldn't stand the sight of it! He hated all couples showing off their romance in front of him!

These people had no idea how much damage their uninhibited, intimate behavior in public places inflicted on a single hawk!

To get back to the point, upon learning their identities, Eagle's Wing became even more curious.

Was Raphael Langmu here to sabotage Baron Denton's plans for personal reasons, or... to fish for a share of the profits? Or could he simply be an accomplice?

Even though Raphael Langmu and Baron Denton stood on opposing sides, when the stakes were high enough, cooperation wasn't entirely out of the question.

Odious! The two of them hadn't given him the slightest chance to find out and had simply run off like this!

For someone cursed with insatiable curiosity like Eagle's Wing, this was sheer torture—it was driving him crazy.

The two people who appeared to have vanished had actually just used an invisibility item, and they hadn't gone far at all; after circling around, they came right back to Eagle's Wing's vicinity.

They heard every single word of Eagle's Wing's cursing.

After standing in place for a short while, Eagle's Wing suddenly leaped up, transformed into a giant flying hawk, and soared toward a certain section of the labyrinth.

Bu Shuai directly cast a spell, grabbed Shang Feifan, lifted off the ground, and gave chase.

Eagle's Wing never imagined anyone could tail him while he was in flight.

In his transformed state, his feathers were pitch-black. Flying high above in the dim labyrinth, almost no one could possibly notice him.

Shang Feifan suspected that Eagle's Wing also possessed spatial storage tools; otherwise, how could he have packed away his clothes, pants, shoes, and socks so quickly without any visible backpacks on him?

The sensation of flying through the air without any external contraptions was wondrous; Shang Feifan could feel the unrestrained wind sweeping across his face.

Meanwhile, Hu Bushuai was marveling at Shang Feifan's calmness and poise.

Normally, anyone experiencing flight for the first time would panic and flail about frantically. Most people would become so tense that their limbs and body would stiffen, let alone maintain physical balance and fluid muscle control in mid-air.

If someone suffered from acrophobia, it would be even worse.

Yet Shang Feifan acted as though he had flown countless times. The moment he was pulled into the air, Shang naturally relaxed his muscles, surrendering his weight completely to him while still retaining subtle self-control.

Anyone who had gone skydiving—and taken someone else along with them—would deeply understand the massive difference between an experienced person and a novice.

Furthermore, upright flight was different from skydiving; that sensation of emptiness beneath one's feet invariably triggered involuntary fear and tension.

Yet not a single trace of this could be seen on Shang Feifan.

He could even turn his head to smile at him and reach out an arm to wrap around his waist.

Had Bu Shuai not been continuously outputting mana and controlling their flight direction and speed, he would have suspected that Shang Feifan was the one actually piloting their flight all along.

Well, whatever. It wasn't the first time he had learned just how formidable this fellow was.

Up ahead, Eagle's Wing seemed to be searching for something, circling the entire upper airspace of the labyrinth.

Following closely behind, the two men also witnessed the hustle and bustle across various parts of the underground city.

Just as the district government office worker had said, there were numerous entrances to the labyrinth, and moments ago, they had watched massive numbers of citizens being guided down.

These townspeople were all being led in an orderly fashion into designated zones.

Every single one of these designated zones was illuminated with lamps and stocked with food and water.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第103章 勇者和恶魔的诞生 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
与之对比，其他没有做准备的地方就是一片漆黑。

也不是所有城民都听话跟着引导员走，有的兽人也会偏离引导员引领的道路，悄悄流入地下城其他漆黑的街巷中。

对于这些脱离队伍的兽人，那些引导员就像是没有看到一样，既没有苦口婆心地劝他们回来，也没有派人去追，一副随他们去的模样。

也许因为引导员这种随便大家行动的放任态度，反而安了兽人们的心。

绝大多数人都跟着引导员走，而没有胡乱闯入黑暗未知的地下城其他区域。

鹰之翼围绕整座地下城飞了两圈后，向某个方向飞去。

飞到那里他开始在上空盘旋，并降下高度。

虎不帅带着商非凡也停留在附近一处高楼楼顶上。

这里并不是地下城的中心区域，而是偏西南方。

就在距离这里的两条街外，有大量兽人聚集，他们都是被从上面带下来躲雨的兽人。

但那边灯火通明，这里却漆黑如深渊。

这里的天空没有星月，借不到光亮，黑暗就是真的黑暗。

商非凡指了指下方，做了个手势。

虎不帅点头。他也感觉到了。

之前，他并不能清晰感知到邪神的力量，哪怕他胸膛里装着自然之神雕像的一部分。

但当自然之神给了他馈赠后，他就能感知到邪神的力量了。

这让不帅忍不住想，藏有自然之神雕像的人并不算获得自然之神的认可，所以也没有办法得到祂真正的庇护。说不定还会引来自然之神的憎恨？

就算不是憎恨，也会是厌恶和排斥吧？

鹰之翼不断降低盘旋高度，但并没有莽撞地直接降落下去，他似乎有什么忌惮。

商非凡不知道其他人是否能感知到邪神力量，但想来鹰之翼作为有名的冒险和寻宝者，就算无法察觉到邪神力量，对危险的感知度也会很高。

最终鹰之翼还是没有降落下去，他飞到了附近一座高楼顶部，停留在那里，似乎在等待什么，又像是在观察。

商非凡对不帅打了个手势。

他们只是好奇鹰之翼发现了什么以及他待在地下城的目的，但并不是要一直跟着鹰之翼行动。

他们仍旧会按照他们的计划来。

如今他们已经确定了邪神力量的地点，自然不会就这么放过。

不管这里是否真有阴谋，也不管那阴谋是否和丹顿侯爵有关，他们就不可能眼睁睁等到地下城开始有变故的那一刻。

如果能提前解决，为什么不尽量提早？

如果他们也是那些对阴谋完全不知晓的城民之一，他们也会希望有人能在他们什么都不知道的情况下就把危险解除掉。

更何况他们这么做也是为了自己。

如果这真的是丹顿侯爵的阴谋，那么破坏这个阴谋，说不定就能重创丹顿侯爵，甚而降低他的威胁程度和武力值，至少让他无法继续提升实力。

哪怕这个阴谋和提升丹顿侯爵的实力无关，看他气得发疯也很有意思不是吗？

两人无声无息地进入了那片黑暗区域。

其他地方也黑，但这里似乎更加黑暗。

商非凡施展瞳术，眼睛微微发亮，让他可以清楚看见这里的一切。

不帅也有自己的手段，他对自己施展黑暗视物魔法，同样可以看清周围。

这里也有不少建筑物，从外形看很像是工坊区。

两人顺着邪神力量寻找过去。

当绕过一栋长方形的厂房房屋时，他们听到了有点熟悉的呢喃声。

在一片空地的中央，一群兽人聚集在一起，他们穿着让两人眼熟又辣眼的石布小短裙，趴伏在地上进行跪拜，一边跪拜，嘴中一边发出像是念咒一样的声音。

而在这群兽人跪拜的最中央，赫然就是一座看不出具体形状的雕像。

“……厄穆克拉索……”

那些邪神信徒不断呢喃着这个名字，一个个神情虔诚又疯狂。

这次没有一口煮着怪异汤水的大锅，反而是那些兽人一个接一个在地上爬行，爬到那雕像面前，用自己的指甲划开自己的手腕，把鲜血滴到雕像底部。

滴过血的兽人舔-舐自己的手腕，亲吻雕像，然后迅速没入黑暗中。

商非凡和虎不帅互看：这又是什么古里古怪的仪式？

等到那些邪神信徒全都滴完鲜血并隐入黑暗后。

不帅像是在自语一样地低声说道：“为什么有人会信仰这种一看就很诡异的神灵？还会自动做出这么可怕的仪式？”

商非凡听到不帅说话，就知道附近没什么人了，不帅的听力可以确保距离他们最近的生物都在哪里。

“因为需求。需求越高，需要付出的就越多，这是人们的普遍认知。当正位神灵，也就是被人视为正常神灵的存在不能响应人们的乞求时，人自然会寻求其他出路。”

“找邪神，找恶灵，找灵异精怪，虽然危险，但很多人都相信只要遵循一定规则，付出相应代价，他们就能获得他们想要的，从做生意的角度来看还是很划算的。”

商非凡又指了指自己的大脑：“而且人的精神和大脑是可以被控制的，尤其在集体行为中。洗脑、精神控制、恐惧植入、从众心理，都会让一些看起来很不可思议的事情变成根深蒂固的信仰，甚而变成固定群体中看起来很平常的事情。”

“而我们的生活方方面面都充斥着这种洗脑行为，甚而大家都知道自己在被洗脑，但因为‘社会需要’、‘反对就会倒霉’、‘接受会成为既得利益者’等思维，基本都会被动接受。”

虎不帅轻轻叹了口气：“也是。这些邪神信徒也许并不是不清楚他们在做什么，只是他们要么无法脱离，要么就是能从中获得利益，他们已经成为一种群体。”

商非凡笑：“我们觉得他们是邪神信徒，他们说不定还认为我们才是不可理喻的傻-逼。如果将来邪神真的上位，这些邪神信徒就是先驱者，鞋教会成为国教。然后只要他们稍微美化一下各种仪式，就可以让邪变成人们眼中的正。再重新谱写一部教义，定义为新约，就能彻底完美转身。”

“胜者为王，败者为寇。胜利者书写历史。”

“对。”

“……我不想让坏人成为胜利者。至少在我看来，他们就是坏人。”过了一会儿，不帅像是在对自己说道。

商非凡：“那就让他们不能成为胜利者。”

不帅有点不好意思，“我这样是不是很幼稚？”

商非凡握住他的手：“这不叫幼稚，这叫有自己的想法，如果你愿意，还可以叫做勇敢和睿智。”

不帅被逗笑：“听说勇者现在混得都很糟糕？”

商非凡眨眼：“也不算糟糕，就是勇者都变成恶魔的老婆了。”

不帅没忍住，笑弯了腰。

“所以为了得到你这个勇者，我也要做一个大恶魔，压过那些邪神，可不能让你被祂们抢走。”商非凡像是开玩笑，又像是很认真。
chunks.englishText:
By contrast, the other areas that hadn't been prepared were pitch black.

Not all citizens obediently followed their guides, of course; some orcs strayed from the guided paths, quietly drifting into other dark alleys of the labyrinth.

As for these orcs who broke away from the ranks, the guides acted as if they hadn't seen them at all. They neither earnestly tried to persuade them to return nor sent anyone in pursuit, maintaining a laissez-faire attitude.

Perhaps because of this casual, do-as-you-please attitude from the guides, it actually put the orcs' minds at ease.

The vast majority of people followed the guides and refrained from blindly blundering into the other dark, uncharted sectors of the labyrinth.

After circling the entire underground city twice, Eagle's Wing flew toward a specific direction.

Reaching that spot, he began to hover in the upper air and descended in altitude.

Hu Bushuai, carrying Shang Feifan, also came to a stop atop a nearby high-rise rooftop.

This was not the central district of the labyrinth, but rather towards the southwest.

Just two streets away from here, a massive crowd of orcs had gathered—they were the ones brought down from above to take shelter from the rain.

Yet while that area was brilliantly lit, this place was as dark as an abyss.

There were no stars or moon in the sky here, borrowing no light whatsoever; the darkness was absolute and true.

Shang Feifan pointed downward and made a hand gesture.

Hu Bushuai nodded. He had sensed it too.

Previously, he couldn't clearly perceive the power of the Evil God, even though part of the Goddess of Nature's statue rested inside his chest.

However, once the Goddess of Nature bestowed her gift upon him, he became capable of detecting the Evil God's presence.

This made Bu Shuai couldn't help but think: those who harbored the Goddess of Nature's statue hadn't truly earned her recognition, and thus had no way to receive her genuine blessing. Might they even incur the hatred of the Goddess of Nature?

Even if it wasn't hatred, it would surely be disgust and repulsion, wouldn't it?

Eagle's Wing continued to lower his hovering altitude, but he didn't recklessly plunge straight down; he seemed wary of something.

Shang Feifan didn't know whether others could perceive the Evil God's power, but figured that as a renowned adventurer and treasure hunter, even if Eagle's Wing couldn't pinpoint the Evil God's energy, his hazard perception must be exceedingly high.

In the end, Eagle's Wing refrained from descending. He flew to the rooftop of a nearby tall building and lingered there, seemingly waiting for something, or perhaps observing.

Shang Feifan gestured to Bu Shuai.

They were merely curious about what Eagle's Wing had discovered and his purpose in the labyrinth; they had no intention of trailing him indefinitely.

They would still proceed according to their own plan.

Now that they had pinpointed the location of the Evil God's power, naturally, they weren't going to let it go.

Regardless of whether a conspiracy truly lurked here, and regardless of whether that plot was tied to Baron Denton, they could not simply sit idly by until the upheaval within the labyrinth began.

If a crisis could be resolved ahead of time, why not nip it in the bud as early as possible?

If they were among those ordinary citizens completely oblivious to the conspiracy, they too would wish for someone to neutralize the peril while they remained in the dark.

Besides, they were doing this for their own sake as well.

If this genuinely proved to be Baron Denton's plot, dismantling it might deal a severe blow to him, reducing his threat level and martial prowess—at the very least, preventing him from continuing to elevate his strength.

Even if this conspiracy had nothing to do with boosting Baron Denton's power, watching him driven mad with fury would still be immensely entertaining, wouldn't it?

The two of them slipped silently into that zone of utter darkness.

While other areas were dark as well, this place seemed profoundly more so.

Shang Feifan activated his pupillary technique, his eyes glowing faintly to grant him crystal-clear vision of everything around him.

Bu Shuai possessed his own methods as well; casting dark-vision magic upon himself, he likewise pierced through the gloom to survey his surroundings.

Numerous structures stood here too; judging from their exterior architecture, they strongly resembled an industrial workshop district.

Following the trail of the Evil God's energy, the two men pressed forward.

As they skirted around a rectangular factory building, they heard a faintly familiar murmur.

In the center of an open clearing, a pack of orcs had gathered. Clad in stone-cloth mini skirts that looked both familiar and eye-searing to the duo, they prostrated themselves on the ground in worship, chanting incantations all the while.

Right in the dead center of these kowtowing orcs stood a statue of indefinite, amorphous shape.

"...Ermuclasuo..."

Those Evil God zealots chanted the name continuously, their expressions a mix of fanatical devotion and madness.

This time, there was no massive cauldron boiling bizarre broth; instead, the orcs crawled forward one after another toward the statue, dragged their own claws across their wrists, and let their fresh blood drip onto the base of the idol.

The orcs who had shed their blood then licked their wrists, kissed the statue, and rapidly vanished back into the dark.

Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai exchanged glances: What kind of bizarre, freaky ritual was this?

Once all the Evil God zealots had bled and dissolved into the shadows,

Bu Shuai spoke in a low murmur, as if talking to himself: "Why would anyone worship a deity that screams creepiness at first glance? And willingly perform such horrifying rituals?"

Hearing Bu Shuai speak, Shang Feifan knew there was no one else nearby; Bu Shuai's acute hearing could precisely pinpoint the locations of the nearest living creatures.

"Because of demand. The higher the demand, the greater the price one must pay—that's a universal human understanding. When orthodox deities—those regarded as legitimate gods—fail to answer people's prayers, mortals naturally seek other outlets."

"Turning to evil gods, vengeful spirits, and supernatural specters—though perilous—convinces many that as long as they follow certain rules and pay the corresponding price, they can obtain what they desire. From a business perspective, it's still considered a worthwhile trade."

Shang Feifan tapped his own temple: "Furthermore, human minds and psyches can be manipulated, especially within collective behaviors. Brainwashing, mind control, fear implantation, and herd mentality can turn seemingly absurd notions into deeply ingrained faiths—even transforming them into routine norms within a fixed group."

"And every facet of our lives is saturated with such brainwashing behavior. People even know they are being brainwashed, but due to thoughts like 'society requires it,' 'opposing it brings misfortune,' and 'accepting it makes one a vested beneficiary,' they passively submit by and large."

Hu Bushuai sighed softly: "True. Perhaps these Evil God cultists aren't oblivious to what they're doing; they are either trapped or reaping benefits from it, and they've simply congealed into a faction."

Shang Feifan chuckled: "We view them as Evil God zealots, but they probably think we're the irrational freaks. If the Evil God truly ascends to power in the future, these cultists will be the vanguard, and their church will become the state religion. Then, by merely putting a pretty gloss on their rituals, they can whitewash evil into righteousness in the public eye. Rewrite a doctrine, define it as a New Testament, and they can pull off a complete, immaculate rebranding."

"To the victor go the spoils, to the defeated go the shame. History is written by the victors."

"Right."

"…I don't want the bad guys to win. At least in my eyes, they are the bad guys." After a moment, Bu Shuai spoke as if to himself.

Shang Feifan: "Then we won't let them win."

Bu Shuai looked slightly self-conscious. "Am I being childish?"

Shang Feifan grasped his hand: "This isn't childishness; it's having convictions of your own. If you're willing, you can also call it bravery and wisdom."

Bu Shuai burst into a chuckle: "I heard heroes are having a terrible time these days?"

Shang Feifan blinked: "Not terrible at all. It's just that all the heroes ended up marrying demons."

Unable to help himself, Bu Shuai doubled over with laughter.

"So in order to win you, a hero, over, I have to become a supreme demon myself and crush those evil gods, lest they snatch you away." Shang Feifan said it half in jest, yet with utter seriousness.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第103章 勇者和恶魔的诞生 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
虎不帅只以为商非凡在开玩笑，抹了抹笑出来的泪花，“我们去挖掘那个邪神雕像的下方。我有预感，那邪神雕像的下方九成也埋了什么东西。”

邪神雕像没有人看守，大约是笃信这里不会有其他人过来。

或者是笃信邪神雕像自带的力量让普通人根本无法接近。

但谁能想到除了邪神信徒，还有“普通人”能不受邪神力量影响？

“好。”商非凡刚说完这个字，一个闪身就冲到邪神雕像面前，一把握住雕像，就把雕像送入了自然之神的雕像广场。

虎不帅同时变身，变成巨大白虎，两步就冲到地方，爪子一抓，就把那处地面刨开。

商非凡再用工兵铲挖两下，就碰到了东西。

同样是一口箱子，甚至连花纹都差不多。

商非凡没有多看，迅速把箱子也丢入雕像空间。

两人干完坏事就跑，一秒都没有多留。

这里的邪神信徒完全没发现他们祭拜的重要雕像不见了。

可在地下城某一处，有人发出了不可置信的怒吼。

九根黑色蜡烛，此时竟然熄灭了一根。

看守蜡烛的人吓懵了，立刻把事情上报。
chunks.englishText:
Hu Bushuai assumed Shang Feifan was merely joking. Wiping away a tear of laughter from his eye, he said, "Let's dig underneath that Evil God statue. I have a hunch that nine times out of ten, something is buried beneath it as well."

The Evil God statue was left unguarded, presumably resting on the absolute conviction that no one else would wander into this place.

Or perhaps out of firm faith that the inherent power radiating from the Evil God statue would make it utterly impossible for ordinary people to approach.

Yet who could have anticipated that, aside from the Evil God cultists, there would be "ordinary people" entirely immune to the Evil God's power?

"Alright." The moment Shang Feifan finished the word, he flashed forward directly in front of the Evil God statue, grasped it firmly, and hurled the idol straight into the Goddess of Nature's statue plaza space.

Simultaneously, Hu Bushuai transformed into a gigantic white tiger, lunged forward in two bounds, and with a sweep of his massive claws, ripped open the earth.

Shang Feifan struck twice more with his military folding shovel until it struck something solid.

It was yet another chest, bearing patterns remarkably similar to the last.

Without dwelling on it, Shang Feifan swiftly tossed this chest into the statue storage space as well.

Having finished their mischief, the two fled without lingering for even a single second.

The Evil God cultists stationed here remained entirely oblivious to the fact that their crucial object of worship had vanished.

Meanwhile, deep within a certain clandestine corner of the labyrinth, someone let out an incredulous roar of fury.

Among nine black candles, one had mysteriously extinguished.

Terrified out of his wits, the sentinel guarding the candles rushed to report the incident.

chunks.chineseText:
第104章 请上车

嗯？鹰之翼诧异。

他的感知是不是出现错误？

为什么他会觉得下方已经没有那么危险？

就在刚才，那让他毛骨悚然、让他却步不敢靠近的危险就像是突然消失了。

鹰之翼非常相信自己的直觉，这份直觉除了天生，也是他经历过无数危险积累下来的宝贵经验的总结。

是陷阱？

还是隐藏在暗中的阴谋者发现了他？

对方转移了地点，还是在诱惑他进去查看？

鹰之翼一时踟躇。

另一头，商非凡和虎不帅在弄到第一个邪神雕像后就跑得远远，跑到一座像是治安亭的尖顶小房子面前才停下。

不帅停下脚步：“危险解除了吗？”

“我感觉邪神力量在这里还是很多很浓郁。”商非凡实话实说。

就是因为感知到这座地下城到处都弥漫着邪神的力量，才让他无法准确寻宝，直到鹰之翼带他们来到刚才的西南工坊区域。

“邪神雕像会不会不止一个？”不帅猜测。

“如果进入地下城的城民都是用来献祭的，那么我也不觉得刚才那一个邪神雕像就能承受那么多。”

不是商非凡看不起刚才那个邪神雕像，而是真的没有感觉到它有那个排面。

甚至他觉得刚才拿到的雕像中蕴含的能量还不如摩罗城外被祭祀的那一个。

“我们要不要找鹰之翼合作？感觉他来地下城的时间比我们长得多，也许他已经查到一些眉目。”不帅建议。

商非凡：“对方的目的是寻宝。”

不帅无所谓：“那就让他寻宝，我们只要他……”

商非凡：“他不在乎这满城的生命。甚至巴不得黑森林城乱起来。”

不帅不解：“你是从哪里看出来的？”

商非凡笑了笑：“我接触过类似的人，他们看似不是坏人，但他们做的事情往往比坏人的破坏性更大。他们的特点就是自私，绝对的利己主义者。人基本都是利己主义者，但绝大多数人在没到绝境的时候，也愿意为别人考虑。但鹰之翼那种人不会，他们只会考虑自己的得失。

我的建议是，除非到了不得已的地步，或者你能付出让他们满意的代价，还能按压住他们对你或对你身上的东西不会心生贪婪，否则就不要和鹰之翼合作。

当然，我不是说这种人绝对不能处，相反我的朋友中就有这种人。但我绝对不会在这种涉及到他人生死的时候找那位朋友一起行动。”

不帅沉默片刻，点头：“听你的。”

商非凡却笑：“你不用听我的。毕竟我没有和鹰之翼真正接触过，也许他并不是我认为中那样的人。如果有机会，你可以试着接触看看，实际感受一下，如果我判断错误，你可以惩罚我。另外，那小子长得有点帅，我只是不想你和他太过接近。刚才他看我们俩的时候，眼睛一直盯着你。”

商非凡最后的大实话让不帅啼笑皆非。

“……你想要什么样的惩罚？”

“噢！”商非凡声音拖得长长，那眼神更是充满戏谑和……向往？

“我现在反倒希望我看错那个家伙了。好吧，我现在特别希望他是个好人。”

“请说正事。”不帅板脸。

“你知道你现在板着脸的模样特别让我想亲你吗？好的，我们说正事。外面的人还在持续进入，应该还有点时间。给我半小时，我去消化一下。也许等我出来，我就能精确定位下一个邪神雕像所在地点。”

商非凡示意不帅先找个地方休息。

不帅咬住嘴唇才能忍住笑意，摇头：“你去消化，我在周边转转。放心，一个高级魔法师只要不是自己作死，想出事都难。”

不帅提起骨杖，又指指身上的装备：“我还有这些，都是你精挑细选的。”

商非凡也不想把不帅当弱者看：“那好，半小时后，我们就在这里见。”

不帅刚点头，就看到商非凡在自己面前消失。

然后商非凡又冒出来：“那个鹰之翼看你的目光真的不对劲。”

不帅：“……你要是再冒出来，我就真的去见他。”

商非凡盯了盯人，再次原地消失。

不帅深深吸气。他之前还觉得商非凡很成熟，相处时间长了，才发现这家伙就跟小孩一样霸道又小心眼。

但不帅又忍不住笑了。

其实这样的商非凡还有点可爱？

而且和那家伙在一起后，他好像就对未来的生活充满了期待？

等等，他什么时候和那家伙在一起了？

商非凡刚进入雕像广场，他的右眼视界就跳出偌大提醒：

【把那具邪神雕像献祭给伟大的诅咒之神吧。请尽快！】

商非凡：“先不急，让我问问另一位大佬。系统，系统你在吗？”

“我发现了邪神雕像，你确定不给我发布一个任务？”

之前下腐蚀雨时，系统给他发布了一个新任务，让他查明腐蚀雨的形成原因，奖励5点贡献点。

在进入地下城时，系统再次发布任务，让他查明丹顿侯爵把遇难城民转入地下城的真正原因，奖励20点贡献点和一枚四级魔晶。

但发现那具邪神雕像并挖出埋在下面的箱子时，系统却毫无动静。

“还是说这具邪神雕像和丹顿侯爵把城民转入地下城的真正原因有关？”

“如果只是这样，那我就把这具雕像放在广场里，等我找到其他具雕像，然后再看怎么处理。也许很多具邪神雕像聚集在一起可以凝聚出更多的邪神力量，诅咒之神应该会更喜欢来一顿丰富的美餐？你觉得呢？”

系统仍旧沉默。

商非凡就不信系统能忍得住。只看他把邪神雕像才扔入雕像广场短短几分钟，那不可名状的雕像身上就布满了被火鞭抽打一样的痕迹，就知道这个异度空间有多讨厌这具邪神雕像。

商非凡无视右眼视界再次冒出的提醒，做出一副就要离开雕像广场的模样。

【任务六十八，发现邪神厄穆克拉索的雕像，请及时处理这具雕像，消灭其中蕴含的邪神力量。处理成功，奖励一枚空间石。】

商非凡握拳！

这才对嘛。

他也是事后才分析出来，雕像广场很讨厌邪神的力量，但同样也很忌惮。

上次他看到右眼提示，没多想就把那具邪神雕像献祭给诅咒之神，然后诅咒了自己乌鸦嘴威力大增。

可等到他救治夏冰时，系统发现夏冰体内的邪神力量，让他处理，可是允诺奖励他一百贡献点和全套的空间储物工具炼制方法！

夏冰体内那点邪神力量能比得上邪神雕像里蕴含的多吗？

另外，从系统的反应来看，无论是雕像广场还是诅咒之神，并不能一次性容纳或吸收太多邪神的力量，只能一点点来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 104: Please Get On Board (Part 1)

"Hm?" Eagle's Wing muttered in bewilderment.

Had his senses started playing tricks on him?

Why did he suddenly feel that the area below was no longer so dangerous?

Just moments ago, the dread that had made his hair stand on end and kept him from daring to approach had vanished as if it had never existed.

Eagle's Wing trusted his intuition implicitly. Beyond being an innate gift, this intuition was a distillation of precious experiences accumulated through countless brushes with death.

Was it a trap?

Or had some conspirator lurking in the shadows discovered him?

Had the enemy relocated, or were they trying to lure him in to take a closer look?

Eagle's Wing hesitated for a moment.

On the other side, Shang Feifan and Hu Bushuai had bolted far away the moment they secured the first Evil God statue. They only stopped in front of a small, spire-roofed building that looked like a security guard booth.

Bushuai halted in his tracks: "Has the danger lifted?"

"I still feel like the Evil God's power is heavy and dense around here," Shang Feifan said honestly.

It was precisely because he had sensed the Evil God's power permeating every corner of this dungeon that he had been unable to accurately locate any treasures—until Eagle's Wing led them to the southwestern workshop area just now.

"Could there be more than one Evil God statue?" Bushuai speculated.

"If the citizens entering the dungeon are all being used as sacrifices, then I don't think a single Evil God statue could possibly absorb that much."

It wasn't that Shang Feifan looked down on the statue they had just found, but he honestly hadn't sensed it possessing that kind of scale.

He even felt that the energy contained within the statue they had just acquired was inferior to the one sacrificed outside Moro City.

"Should we consider cooperating with Eagle's Wing? It feels like he's been in the dungeon much longer than we have; perhaps he's already uncovered some clues," Bushuai suggested.

Shang Feifan: "His goal is treasure hunting."

Bushuai was indifferent: "Then let him hunt for treasure. We only want him to—"

Shang Feifan: "He doesn't care about the lives filling this city. He might even be rooting for Black Forest City to plunge into chaos."

Bushuai was puzzled: "How can you tell?"

Shang Feifan smiled: "I've dealt with people like him before. They might look harmless on the surface, but the things they do are often far more destructive than actual villains. Their defining trait is selfishness—they are absolute egoists. While most people are naturally self-interested, the vast majority are still willing to consider others when not pushed to the brink of desperation. But people like Eagle's Wing? They only ever weigh their own gains and losses.

My advice is this: unless you have no other choice, or you can pay a price that satisfies them while managing to suppress any greed they might harbor toward you or what you carry, do not cooperate with Eagle's Wing.

Of course, I'm not saying people like this are completely unapproachable; on the contrary, I have friends just like that. But I would never seek out such a friend for joint operations when other people's lives are on the line."

Bushuai fell silent for a moment before nodding: "I'll listen to you."

Shang Feifan chuckled instead: "You don't have to just take my word for it. After all, I haven't truly interacted with Eagle's Wing myself—perhaps he isn't the kind of person I imagine. If you get the chance, you can try interacting with him and see for yourself. If my judgment is wrong, you can punish me. Besides, that kid is a bit too handsome; I just don't want you getting too close to him. When he looked at us earlier, his eyes were glued right onto you."

Shang Feifan's parting piece of absolute honesty left Bushuai alternating between laughter and tears.

"...What kind of punishment would you want?"

"Oh!" Shang Feifan drew out the syllable, his gaze brimming with playful banter and... yearning?

"Now I suddenly hope I misjudged that fellow. Well, right now I desperately wish he were a good person."

"Please talk about serious matters," Bushuai put on a straight face.

"You know, the way you pull a straight face right now makes me want to kiss you so badly? Fine, let's talk business. People are still continuously entering from the outside; we should still have some time. Give me half an hour to digest what I've gained. Perhaps when I come out, I'll be able to precisely pinpoint the location of the next Evil God statue."

Shang Feifan gestured for Bushuai to find a place to rest first.

Bushuai bit his lower lip to suppress a smile and shook his head: "You go digest your gains, and I'll walk around the vicinity. Rest assured, as long as a high-level mage isn't actively trying to court death, getting into trouble is rather difficult."

Bushuai lifted his bone staff and gestured to the equipment on his body: "I still have all these, and you hand-picked every single one of them."

Shang Feifan didn't want to treat Bushuai as a weakling either: "Alright, half an hour from now, we'll meet right here."

Just as Bushuai nodded, he watched Shang Feifan vanish right in front of him.

Then, Shang Feifan popped back into existence: "That Eagle's Wing really is looking at you with the wrong kind of gaze."

Bushuai: "...If you pop out one more time, I'm genuinely going to go see him."

Shang Feifan stared at him for a beat, then vanished from the spot once more.

Bushuai took a deep breath. He used to think Shang Feifan was quite mature, but after spending a long time together, he realized this guy was just as overbearing and petty as a child.

Yet, Bushuai couldn't help smiling.

Actually, was this side of Shang Feifan even a little bit cute?

And ever since he got together with that guy, it seemed like his heart had filled with anticipation for the future?

Wait a minute, since when did they get together?!

The moment Shang Feifan stepped into the statue plaza, a massive notification flashed across his right-eye's field of vision:

【Offer that Evil God statue as a sacrifice to the Great God of Curses. Do so immediately!】

Shang Feifan: "Hold your horses, let me consult the other big shot first. System, System, are you there?"

"I've discovered an Evil God statue. Are you sure you aren't going to issue me a quest?"

Back when the corrosive rain was falling, the System had issued him a new quest to investigate the cause of the rain, rewarding him with 5 contribution points.

Upon entering the dungeon, the System had issued another quest to investigate the true reason why Marquis Denton was transferring the victims of the city into the underground, offering a reward of 20 contribution points and a Tier 4 magic crystal.

Yet when he discovered that Evil God statue and dug out the box buried beneath it, the System had remained completely silent.

"Or could it be that this Evil God statue is connected to the real reason Marquis Denton transferred the citizens down here?"

"If that's all there is to it, I'll just leave this statue right here in the plaza. Once I find the rest of them, I'll figure out how to deal with them together. Perhaps gathering a bunch of Evil God statues can condense even more of the Evil God's power—wouldn't the God of Curses prefer a richer, more lavish feast then? What do you think?"

The System remained silent.

Shang Feifan refused to believe the System could hold back. Judging by how, mere minutes after he tossed the Evil God statue into the statue plaza, that indescribable statue became covered in lash marks resembling fire-whip strikes, it was clear just how much this different dimension despised that Evil God statue.

Ignoring the warning that popped up once more in his right-eye's field of vision, Shang Feifan made as if he were about to leave the statue plaza.

【Quest Sixty-Eight: Discover the statue of the Evil God Eumuklaso. Promptly dispose of this statue and eradicate the Evil God's power contained within. Upon successful processing, reward: one Space Stone.】

Shang Feifan clenched his fist!

Now that's more like it.

He had only figured it out through post-analysis: the statue plaza loathed the Evil God's power, but it was equally deeply wary of it.

Last time, when he saw the right-eye prompt, he didn't think much before sacrificing that Evil God statue to the God of Curses, which resulted in his curse-casting ability growing ridiculously powerful—turning him practically into a prophet of bad omens.

Yet when he went to treat Xia Bing, the System detected the Evil God's power inside her and told him to deal with it, promising a reward of one hundred contribution points and the complete crafting method for spatial storage tools!

Could that tiny wispy bit of Evil God power inside Xia Bing even compare to the vast amount contained within an Evil God statue?

Moreover, judging by the System's reaction, neither the statue plaza nor the God of Curses could accommodate or absorb too much of the Evil God's power all at once; they could only take it in bit by bit.

chunks.chineseText:
“系统，我知道你在骂我。没办法，我们的关系就像是打工人和老板的关系。你想我帮你做事，却又不想给我太多。而我则想着不干活也能拿好处。我们本身的立场就是相对的。在这种情况下，我们就需要各退一步，我可以为你干活，很用心地干活，但你也得拿出相应的报酬。”

【不要再随便吸收邪神的力量。】

商非凡挑眉，系统竟然单独给出一句警告，看来它是真的不希望他再摄入更多邪神力量。

“你是怕我受到邪神力量影响，从而倒向邪神那一边？还是担心邪神在我身上寄生？就像你一样？”

【任务六十九，黑森林城的地下城内布满了邪神的力量。彻底清除这座地下城内的邪神力量。完成后奖励相应数量的空间石。注：空间石可兑换魔晶，详细请查阅游戏商城。】

商非凡耸肩。系统聪明了，直接用任务来堵他的嘴。

还有，他发现系统似乎不太愿意给出贡献点奖励，宁可奖励他空间石和魔晶。

这是因为贡献点数和他的玩家等级绑定的缘故？

系统不想或无法让他升级太快，只能不给他贡献点数，导致连任务都不怎么发布？

算了，实力提升太快确实不太好，他需要先打好基础。如今他的技能栏一堆职业技能和天赋技能，他并没有真正地全部掌握。

比起给他贡献点，空间石和魔晶也挺好的。

有好处，商非凡做事就特别麻利。当即手按邪神雕像，念咒：“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯。虔诚的信徒我将把这具邪神雕像献祭给您，请您诅咒……我的右眼可以准确定位邪神的力量。”

他说出这句话时就有预感，诅咒之神会同意，或者说系统也同意了。比起让他吸收更多邪神力量，祂们更愿意直接赠送他更准确感知邪神力量的能力。

雕像迅速变成一滩黑灰。

商非凡特意用手按在黑灰上感知，果然半点邪神力量都感知不到了。再用右眼看，也没有看到任何提示。

而他没有直接诅咒丹顿侯爵阴谋失败，是因为他发现诅咒之神更喜欢具体的诅咒内容，而不是空泛的，或者连他这个施咒者自己都不确定的内容。

没有诅咒丹顿侯爵死亡，则是因为他本能地感知到这么点祭品还没办法直接咒死那个侯爵。

只是诅咒丹顿侯爵吃点苦，那也没多大意思，还不如来点更实在的。

商非凡目光落到了那口刚被挖出来的箱子上。

这次箱子里会装着什么？

尸体还是其他？

不帅正在地下城里查看他碰到的每条街道每个区域的石碑或是墙刻等任何文字以及图画记录。

这种“古早”时期的地下城只要保存完好，往往能在里面看到大量的文字记录。

有些城市遗迹甚至每一条街道都会有详细地图，指明你在哪里，并配上整个城市的缩略图。

不帅看到了一个车站，这个车站的完好程度让你会错以为随时随地都会有车辆过来停靠。

这个车站名叫安吉南街站。

有五辆交通车会停靠这个站点，看站点名，一条线从南到北，直穿整座地下城。还有三条线路则全都聚集在东南这一片。剩下一条线路则从南往东北方向走。

但这五条线路无一例外都会经过同一个站点，神殿站。

从方向看，这个神殿站很可能位于市中心。

不帅猛地转身。

一辆与地球那边十分类似的公交大巴车停在了车站前。

不帅睁大了眼睛。

这怎么可能？！

公交车内漆黑一片，不帅极尽眼力也只能看到模糊的影子。

车门无声无息地敞开，似乎在等待他上车。

这是什么闹鬼的镜头？

难道地下城就一定要配上幽魂鬼怪吗？

“你是不是看到了一辆车？”一道略微耳熟的声音在不远处响起。

不帅转头。

鹰之翼抬起手臂对他打招呼，并向他走了过来。

“怎么就你一个人？你的同伴呢？”

“你也看到了一辆车？什么样子的车？”不帅反问。

鹰之翼叹气：“我曾经看到一辆由巨翼鸟拉的车。那是我们翼国的特色，从很早以前就使用，现在也一样。据说只要看到这个车站的人，就有一定可能会看到自己臆想中的车辆，一般都是交通车。”

不帅暗中吐了口气，不是鬼车就好。他就说怎么会看到与地球那边类似的公交车。

“幻觉？”

“也许。这个车站在整个地下城都很有名。而且不是有缘人，还看不到它，我找了它很多次，才偶尔遇到。你运气不错。”鹰之翼的眼睛看人十分专注。

不帅笑笑：“你看到的车辆是停下并打开大门的吗？你有没有试着坐上去？”

“嗨，一直都是你在问我问题。”鹰之翼有点不满：“是的，我是个好奇心很重的人，我看到门敞开，就上去坐了。你猜结果怎样？”

“一屁股坐到地上？”

鹰之翼大笑：“当然不是。实际上我跟着巨翼之车飞了起来，它把我带到一个地方。最奇妙的是，当我第二次想要去那个地方时，却无论如何都找不到。我也试着再次来到这个车站，想要再次坐上巨翼之车，但都没有再见到过巨翼之车。所以我说你运气好，第一次来就碰到了。你是第一次来这座地下城吧？”

不帅默认。

鹰之翼又走近两步，笑着说：“不用紧张，我没有恶意。我一直都很想再去那个地方一次。根据我收集到的情报，只要看到车辆的人实际接触另一个人，那被他接触的人也能看到车辆。只要你同意带我过去，我可以跟你分享我的情报。

你应该很好奇黑森林城主在这里做了什么吧？我知道他每次来地下城必然都会去的一个地方，只要你愿意带我上这辆车，我可以告诉你那个地方在哪里，以及要怎么去。”

不帅貌似在考虑，不过他考虑的时间并不长：“先让我看到你的诚意。其他情报暂时不说，你先告诉我黑森林城主每次进入地下城必然会去的那个地方在哪里，以及怎么过去。我就送你上这辆车。”

不帅指了指仍旧停在他面前，似乎他不上去就不会走的公交车。

鹰之翼毫不犹豫地说：“成交！那位城主每次进入地下城，必然会去的地方位于城中心，自然之神的神殿。”

“自然之神的神殿？”

“对。但你想去那里并不是走过去就可以，那里被隐藏了。你得用一种特殊方法才能看到神殿，然后找到正确的道路，你才能进入神殿，还得躲开所有守卫以及鹰眼的扫视。”

“是什么特殊方法？”

“我已经按照你的要求回答了你的问题。我告诉你那位城主去了神殿，也告诉你要看到神殿才能进入神殿。现在轮到你履行诺言了。”

不帅点点头：“很公平。”

鹰之翼脸上带着嬉笑，握住不帅伸过来的手。

不帅避开他的目光。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 104: Please Get On Board (Part 2)

"System, I know you're cursing me out right now. But what can we do? Our relationship is just like that of an employee and a boss. You want me to do work for you, yet you're stingy with the rewards. Meanwhile, I want to reap benefits without doing any heavy lifting. Our fundamental stances are opposed from the start. Under these circumstances, we need to make mutual concessions. I can work for you—work very diligently, in fact—but you've got to cough up the matching compensation."

【Do not arbitrarily absorb the Evil God's power ever again.】

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. The System had actually issued a standalone warning; it seemed it genuinely didn't want him ingesting any more of the Evil God's power.

"Are you afraid I'll be corrupted by the Evil God's influence and defect to their side? Or are you worried an Evil God might parasitize me? Just like you?"

【Quest Sixty-Nine: The Black Forest City's underground dungeon is permeated with the Evil God's power. Thoroughly purge the Evil God's power from this dungeon. Upon completion, reward a corresponding quantity of Space Stones. Note: Space Stones can be exchanged for magic crystals; please check the Game Store for details.】

Shang Feifan shrugged. The System was getting smart, using quests directly to seal his lips.

Furthermore, he noticed that the System seemed somewhat reluctant to hand out contribution point rewards, preferring to pay him in Space Stones and magic crystals instead.

Was this because contribution points were bound to his player level?

Did the System not want—or was it unable—to let him level up too fast, forcing it to withhold contribution points, to the point where it barely even issued quests?

Never mind; growing in strength too rapidly indeed had its drawbacks. He needed to build a solid foundation first. Right now, his skill bar was packed with a bunch of occupational and innate skills that he hadn't truly mastered entirely.

Compared to getting contribution points, Space Stones and magic crystals were pretty good too.

With benefits on the line, Shang Feifan moved with exceptional briskness. He immediately pressed his hand against the Evil God statue and chanted: "Supreme and greatest existence, God of Curses Kenizeus. Your pious believer, I offer this Evil God statue as a sacrifice unto You. Please curse... my right eye so that it may accurately pinpoint the Evil God's power."

The moment he spoke those words, he had a premonition that the God of Curses would agree—or rather, that the System agreed as well. Compared to letting him absorb more of the Evil God's power, they would much rather directly grant him the ability to perceive the Evil God's power with greater precision.

The statue rapidly dissolved into a pool of black ash.

Shang Feifan deliberately pressed his hand into the black ash to test it; sure enough, not a shred of the Evil God's power could be sensed anymore. When he looked again with his right eye, no prompts appeared either.

As for why he hadn't directly cursed Marquis Denton's conspiracy to fail, it was because he instinctively sensed that this meager bit of sacrifice wasn't enough to directly curse a marquis to death.

Just cursing Marquis Denton to suffer petty miseries wasn't all that interesting either; he'd rather have something more tangible.

Shang Feifan's gaze landed on the chest that had just been dug out.

What would be inside this box?

Corpses, or something else?

Bushuai was walking through the dungeon, inspecting every single stele, wall carving, and any other textual or pictorial records across every street and area he encountered.

As long as such "ancient-era" dungeons were well-preserved, one could often find massive amounts of written records within them.

Some urban ruins even featured detailed maps on every street, indicating your current position alongside a thumbnail overview of the entire city.

Bushuai caught sight of a transit station. The station was preserved to such an intact degree that it made one falsely feel as though vehicles might pull up and park at any moment.

This station was named Anjin South Street Station.

Five transport vehicle routes stopped at this site. Judging by the station names, one line ran straight from south to north, piercing clear through the entire underground city. Another three lines all converged in the southeastern sector. The remaining line ran from the south toward the northeast direction.

Yet these five routes all unfailingly passed through the exact same station: the Temple Station.

Judging by the directional layout, this Temple Station was very likely located right in the city center.

Bushuai abruptly whipped around.

A city bus, remarkably similar to those on Earth, was parked right in front of the station.

Bushuai's eyes widened.

How could this be possible?!

The interior of the bus was pitch black; even with Bushuai straining his vision to the absolute limit, he could only make out vague, shadowy figures.

The bus doors swung open silently, as if waiting for him to board.

What kind of haunted scene was this?

Did every single dungeon have to come bundled with ghosts and specters?

"Did you happen to see a vehicle?" A slightly familiar voice rang out nearby.

Bushuai turned his head.

Eagle's Wing raised an arm to wave at him, then walked over.

"Why are you all by yourself? Where are your companions?"

"You saw a vehicle too? What kind of vehicle was it?" Bushuai countered with a question.

Eagle's Wing sighed: "I once saw a carriage pulled by giant-winged birds. That's a specialty of our Winged Kingdom, used since ancient times right down to the present day. Rumors say that anyone who spots this station has a certain probability of seeing whatever vehicle they subconsciously imagine—usually a transport vehicle."

Bushuai let out an internal breath of relief; at least it wasn't a ghost bus. That explained why he had seen something resembling an Earth-style transit bus.

"An illusion?"

"Perhaps. This station is quite famous throughout the entire underground city. Moreover, if you aren't fated, you can't even see it. I searched for it many times before stumbling upon it by chance. You've got good luck." Eagle's Wing's gaze was piercingly focused when looking at people.

Bushuai smiled faintly: "The vehicle you saw—was it parked with its doors open? Did you try getting on board?"

"Hey, you're the one asking me questions the whole time," Eagle's Wing grumbled playfully. "Yes, I'm a deeply curious person. When I saw the doors wide open, I got on and sat down. Guess what happened?"

"You sat flat on your bottom onto the floor?"

Eagle's Wing laughed heartily: "Of course not. In truth, I soared into the air following the giant-winged carriage, and it took me to a certain place. The most magical part was that when I wanted to go back to that place a second time, no matter what I tried, I couldn't find it. I even tried coming back to this station to catch the giant-winged carriage again, but I never laid eyes on it a second time. That's why I said you've got good luck, running into it on your very first visit. This is your first time in this dungeon, right?"

Bushuai tacitly agreed without confirming or denying.

Eagle's Wing took two steps closer and said with a smile, "Don't be nervous, I harbor no ill intent. I've always wanted to visit that place again. Based on the intelligence I've gathered, as long as the person who sees the vehicle makes physical contact with someone else, that touched person will be able to see the vehicle as well. As long as you agree to take me along, I can share my intelligence with you.

You must be quite curious about what the Black Forest City Lord has been doing down here, right? I know a place that the lord invariably visits every single time he enters the dungeon. As long as you're willing to take me onto this vehicle, I can tell you where that place is and how to get there."

Bushuai looked as though he were weighing the offer, but his deliberation didn't last long: "Show me your sincerity first. Skip the other intelligence for now—first tell me where the place is that the City Lord of Black Forest inevitably visits every time he enters the dungeon, and how to get there. Then, I'll send you onto this vehicle."

Bushuai pointed toward the bus, which was still parked right in front of him, looking as though it wouldn't leave unless he climbed aboard.

Eagle's Wing said without a moment's hesitation: "Deal! The place that lord invariably visits every time he enters the dungeon is located right in the city center—the Temple of the God of Nature."

"The Temple of the God of Nature?"

"Correct. But if you want to go there, you can't just walk over; that place has been concealed. You have to use a special method to perceive the temple, then find the correct path before you can enter it, all while evading every single guard and the sweeping gaze of the Hawk Eyes."

"What special method?"

"I have already answered your question in accordance with our agreement. I told you that lord went to the temple, and I told you that you must perceive the temple to enter it. Now it's your turn to fulfill your promise."

Bushuai nodded: "Fair enough."

A playful smirk lingered on Eagle's Wing's face as he grasped Bushuai's extended hand.

Bushuai averted his gaze.

chunks.chineseText:
鹰之翼微微勾唇，看向车站正前方：“哇哦，这可不像是虎国的交通车，这是远古时期的兽拉车？”

“不，它叫黄包车，人形与兽形都可以拉着跑。”不帅只是试着在脑中专注地想黄包车，那辆公交车就真的消失，转而出现的就是黄包车。

“好小，不过看起来能坐两个人。”鹰之翼侧头看不帅。

不帅挣脱被握住的手，顺势做了个请的姿势：“你可以先上车。”

鹰之翼拉了拉嘴角，“那我就不客气了，殿下。”

只要能看到车辆，他就能和不帅一样上车。

不帅脸上没有露出任何表情。

鹰之翼完全看不出这位虎王私生子对刚才的称呼是暗中喜欢还是排斥。

鹰之翼在位置上坐好，笑看还站在车下的不帅：“呃，有一个问题，谁来拉车？”

不帅退后一步，“这么神奇的车辆应该不需要有谁拉车，而且我相信你可以解决这个问题。重点是我想你应该并不想我和你一起去那个你特别想去的地方，所以你不用想着怎么甩开我了，你可以独自享有这次旅程。”

鹰之翼脸上露出诧异神色：“你要放弃？你知道你放弃的是什么机会吗？也许这辆车要去的终点站就是黑森林城主去的神殿。”

不帅摆摆手：“你忘了，我是个胆小鬼。比起探险，我更喜欢平平安安地过日子。”

鹰之翼心中讽刺：骗谁呢！喜欢平安日子的人会在这时候跑来黑森林城，还进入地下城乱转？

“关于地下城的情报，你也不想要了？”鹰之翼确实不想和别人分享那个地方。但他喜欢运气好的人，这位虎王私生子显然就运气不错。

如果拉斐尔郎沐的那个同伴也在，他绝对不会冒然提出邀请，那家伙看着威胁性就很大。就算拉斐尔运气再好，他也不想带两人一同去那个地方。

可惜拉斐尔郎沐落单后的警惕心太强，他一贯良好的亲和力在这人面前似乎没有多少用处。

不帅摇头：“我想要，但我不想冒险。”

鹰之翼深深地看不帅：“希望你不要后悔。错过这一次，你下次再想看到这辆车就不知道要等到什么时候。”

“慢走。”不帅继续后退，直到整个身体都退出车站外。

如他猜测，当他离开车站，黄包车瞬时从他眼中消失，连同坐在车上的鹰之翼一起。

不帅一点也不后悔，他和商非凡说好要在半小时后汇合，如果他坐上那辆车，鬼知道会被送到什么地方，更不知道什么时候才能再见到商非凡。

他也是看过恐怖片的，而恐怖片定律之一就是：凡是因为某些事错过约定的人，绝大部分永远都再也见不到相约的人。

不帅再次走进车站，他刚才看到站牌上还有广告，但没有注意看。

他很好奇那时候的广告都是什么内容。

不到一分钟，又一辆车停在不帅面前。

不帅看着眼前的消防车，沉默。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 104: Please Get On Board (Part 3)

Eagle's Wing curled the corner of his lip slightly, looking toward the front of the station: "Whoa, this doesn't look like a Tiger Kingdom transport vehicle. Is this an ancient beast-drawn carriage?"

"No, it's called a rickshaw; it can be pulled by either human or beast strength." Bushuai merely tried focusing his thoughts in his mind on a rickshaw, and the bus truly vanished, replaced instantly by a traditional rickshaw.

"So small, but it looks like it seats two people." Eagle's Wing tilted his head to look at Bushuai.

Bushuai pulled his hand free from the grip and smoothly made an inviting gesture: "You may get on first."

Eagle's Wing twitched the corner of his mouth. "Then I won't stand on ceremony, Your Highness."

As long as he could see the vehicle, he could board it just like Bushuai.

Not a single ripple of emotion showed on Bushuai's face.

Eagle's Wing couldn't tell at all whether this illegitimate son of the Tiger King secretly welcomed or repelled the title he had just used.

Eagle's Wing seated himself comfortably and smiled down at Bushuai, who was still standing beneath the carriage: "Ah, I have a question—who's going to pull the carriage?"

Bushuai took a step back: "A vehicle as magical as this shouldn't require anyone to pull it, and I'm sure you can handle that part. The point is, I imagine you don't want me tagging along to the place you're so desperate to visit anyway, so you don't need to rack your brain trying to shake me off. You can enjoy this journey all by yourself."

A look of astonishment surfaced on Eagle's Wing's face: "You're giving up? Do you have any idea what kind of opportunity you're throwing away? Perhaps the final stop of this vehicle's route is precisely the temple the Black Forest City Lord went to."

Bushuai waved a hand: "You forget, I'm a coward. Compared to exploration, I prefer living a safe and peaceful life."

Eagle's Wing scoffed inwardly: *Who the hell are you trying to kid! Would someone who likes a peaceful life run over to Black Forest City at a time like this, let alone wander around a dungeon?*

"You don't want the intelligence regarding the dungeon either?" Eagle's Wing genuinely didn't want to share that location with anyone else. But he liked people with good luck, and the Tiger King's illegitimate son clearly had plenty of it.

If Rafael Langmu's companion were also around, he would never have rashly extended an invitation; that fellow looked far too threatening. No matter how good Rafael's luck was, he had no desire to drag two people to that place together.

Pity that Rafael Langmu's vigilance spiked too drastically once he was left on his own; his usual top-tier charisma didn't seem to hold much sway over this guy.

Bushuai shook his head: "I want it, but I don't want to take the risk."

Eagle's Wing gave Bushuai a deep, penetrating look: "I hope you won't live to regret this. Miss this chance, and goodness knows when you'll ever get to see this vehicle again."

"Safe journey." Bushuai continued backing up until his entire body stepped clear out of the station.

Just as he predicted, the moment he left the platform, the rickshaw instantly vanished from his line of sight, along with Eagle's Wing sitting inside it.

Bushuai felt not a single shred of regret. He had an agreement with Shang Feifan to rendezvous in half an hour; if he had boarded that vehicle, goodness knew where he would have been dumped, let alone when he would see Shang Feifan again.

He had watched horror movies too, and one of the golden rules of horror was: anyone who missed an appointment because of some detour would, more often than not, never see the person they were supposed to meet ever again.

Bushuai walked back into the station. He had noticed advertisements on the station signs earlier, though he hadn't paid them much heed.

He was quite curious what kind of advertisements they ran back in those days.

Less than a minute later, another vehicle pulled up in front of Bushuai.

Bushuai stared at the fire engine parked right before him, falling silent.

chunks.chineseText:
第105章 抢雕像游戏

“消防车是你的梦中情车？”

“……没错。”

商非凡哈哈大笑。

不帅没好气地瞪他。

商非凡忍笑：“你小时候的梦想不会是想当消防员吧？”

“不是。我只是喜欢消防车。”不帅忍不住说：“你不觉得消防车很酷吗？”

“我觉得变形金刚更酷。”

“变形金刚中有消防车啊！”

商非凡看着两眼亮晶晶的不帅，感觉看到了他的另一面。

“这么喜欢？以后给你手敲一辆。”

“……真的？”

“等着！”

不帅在看到消防车后，就忍痛再次离开安吉南路站，前往和商非凡约定的地点。

走到一半就看到商非凡正向他走过来。

不帅没问他那具邪神雕像如何处理，而是直接说了车站和神秘车辆，以及见到鹰之翼的事。

“你和那家伙握手了？”商非凡抓过不帅的手翻来覆去地看。

不帅硬抢回自己的手，“他说要实际接触才能看到车。”

“亲爱的，你也太好骗，太没有警惕心。如果他骗你怎么办？如果他手上拿了凶器或涂抹了什么，或者对你有什么不好的目的，你把手伸出去就是在给他伤害你的机会。”商非凡认真说。

不帅叹息：“我做好了戒备。你忘了我是高级魔法师？”

“魔法师也不能随便把手伸出去让人牵！”

“我没让他牵手，我只是让他握住……打住！我们不要再争论这个问题了，你就是在无理取闹。”

“你要学会更好地保护自己。”

“好的，今晚你自己睡，还有以后你离我远一点。”

“我不算。”

“你凭什么不算？”

“凭我是你男朋友？”

“你什么时候成我男朋友了？我怎么不知道？”

“亲爱的，你吃干抹净就想不认账了吗？”

“别叫我亲爱的，我有名字。”

“……拔吊无情的男人，上过就跑的渣男。喔，快阻止我吧，我的嘴巴已经控制不住了。在我说出更恶毒的话之前，快封印我，用你独有的方式让我闭嘴。”商非凡像是怕不帅听不懂一样，点点自己的嘴唇。

“滚蛋！”

黑暗、幽静的地下城就看着这两人在没有半点人气的街道上肆无忌惮地……作妖。

两人说着毫无营养的话，却毫无自觉，还斗嘴斗得很认真。

斗着斗着，两人就来到了安吉南街站。

“鹰之翼说这个站点不容易找到？”商非凡看向车站，脑回路一秒回归正常。

不帅点头。

“但它就在这里。”

“是啊。鹰之翼还说那辆会载人前往神秘地点的车辆也是有缘人才能遇到，错过一次就别想上第二次，但……”

不帅看到了第三次。

就觉得这车特别迫不及待，前两次还让他等了等才现身，可这次他刚站到站台上，它就出现了。

商非凡很自然地握住他的手，也看到了那辆车。

“变形金刚版？”

“……就是忍不住想了一下。”

商非凡笑得上半身打颤，这具变形金刚版的消防车绝对经过了美化。

“你怎么看？是上车，还是怎么说？”商非凡问不帅。

不帅犹豫：“我也不知道为什么，但我不想现在跟着这辆车走。”

“那就相信你的直觉。我们先去解决这座地下城中的邪神力量。”商非凡毫不犹豫地说。

“可如果我们再找过来，这辆车不见了怎么办？而且根据鹰之翼的话语，我怀疑想要去往真正的自然之神神殿，可能真的要通过这辆车才能抵达。”

不帅有个明显缺点，那就是一旦队伍中-出现除他以外具有话语权的人，他就会自动后退，并变得优柔寡断。

商非凡很了解他这个缺点，冷静地问：“我们现在的首要目的是什么？”

不帅：“救出城民。”

商非凡：“救出城民的关键是什么？”

“毁掉地下城中针对城民的阴谋？”

“那阴谋又是什么？”

“唔，根据我们看到的邪神信徒和邪神雕像来看，也许是大型献祭？”

“所以我们现在最需要做的是什么？”

“破坏献祭，让献祭无法成功。”不帅紧接着就说道：“而献祭的关键就是要有邪神雕像，我们需要先找到那些邪神雕像。”

商非凡轻笑：“虽然我们不确定摧毁那些邪神雕像是否就能阻止丹顿侯爵的阴谋，但这是目前我们唯一掌握并能解决的麻烦。去神殿直接找丹顿侯爵虽然也是一个选择，但我更喜欢先拔除老虎的牙齿和爪子，再来对付它。”

不帅头脑变得清晰，“鹰之翼也去了那里，如果那里也有丹顿侯爵，让他们对上，说不定还能转移丹顿侯爵的注意力，让他暂时顾不上我们。”

“就是这样！”

“你现在能准确定位邪神雕像的所在地点吗？”

“只要靠近一百米范围内。”

“太好了！我们走。”

两人商量妥当，扭头就离开了车站。

车站：你们他么地耍我吗？来了三次，三次都不上车！

两人经过一处避难者营地，商非凡摸出一块石头，在上面刻写了一句话，丢到一名一看就是领头人的监督者面前。

咚。

监督者低头看，迟疑几秒，弯腰捡起那块多出来的石头。

石头很普通，随处可见，不普通的是它上面刻着的一句话：【有人在安吉南路站乘坐神秘车辆前往那里。】

监督者没看懂这句话是什么意思，但越是看不懂，他越不敢忽视，当即就跑去把这块石头交给了自己的上司。

石头一层层递交，直到传到能看懂这句话的人手上。

这人一看这句话，不敢怠慢，立刻就去找黑森林城主。

不帅看到商非凡丢出了那块石头，眼睛打出问号。

商非凡一脸善良地说：“我只是通知这里的主人，他家里进贼了。”

不帅：“……”

“那边！”商非凡忽然指向不远处的一片建筑，“我感觉到那里有浓郁的邪神力量。”

地下城中心，自然之神神殿。

黑森林城主，当代丹顿侯爵就在第一重大殿里办公。

这里也是整个地下城的指挥中心。

自然之神的神殿从内部装饰来看，远称不上豪华亮眼，甚至堪称朴实无华。

但它的建筑很有特色，规模也十分宏伟。

外部墙壁和立柱上布满动物、植物、人和山水的雕刻。可这些雕刻并不算精细，反而更像是毫无雕塑天赋更无技术的普通人随手凿出来的最粗糙拟态雕刻。

有些雕刻你甚至看不出那雕的到底是什么东西。

但这里就是自然之神的神殿，还是流传至今，最完好无损，也最古老的神殿之一。

根据丹顿侯爵祖辈在地下城找到的城市志中的说明，这座地下城就是围绕这座神殿而建，完全可以说因为有了这座神殿才有了这座地下城。

大繁华纪乃至以前的纪元，居住在这里以及附近的兽人都会在这座神殿进行神血天赋觉醒仪式。

Chapter 105: The Statue-Snatching Game (Part 1)

"A fire engine is your dream car?"

"……That's right."

Shang Feifan burst into laughter.

Bu Shuai glared at him, annoyed.

Shang Feifan tried to hold back his smile. "Surely your childhood dream wasn't to be a firefighter?"

"No. I just like fire engines." Bu Shuai couldn't help saying, "Don't you think fire engines are cool?"

"I think Transformers are cooler."

"There are fire engines *in* Transformers!"

Looking at Bu Shuai’s sparkling eyes, Shang Feifan felt as though he was seeing a completely different side of him.

"You like them that much? I'll hand-forge one for you in the future."

"……Really?"

"Just wait for it!"

After catching a glimpse of the fire engine, Bu Shuai forced himself to tear away from the Anji South Road Station once more and headed toward the rendezvous point he had agreed upon with Shang Feifan.

Halfway there, he saw Shang Feifan walking toward him.

Bu Shuai didn't ask how the Evil God statue had been dealt with; instead, he immediately brought up the station, the mysterious vehicle, and his encounter with Eagle Wing.

"You shook hands with that guy?" Shang Feifan grabbed Bu Shuai's hand, turning it over to inspect it from every angle.

Bu Shuai yanked his hand back forcefully. "He said he needed physical contact to see the car."

"My dear, you're far too gullible and completely lacking in vigilance. What if he was tricking you? What if he was holding a weapon, had smeared something toxic on his hand, or had malicious intentions toward you? Extending your hand like that was just giving him a chance to hurt you," Shang Feifan said seriously.

Bu Shuai sighed. "I was on guard. Did you forget I'm a Senior Mage?"

"Even a mage shouldn't just stick their hand out for anyone to hold!"

"I didn't let him hold it, I just let him shake it—stop right there! Let's not argue about this anymore, you're just being completely unreasonable."

"You need to learn to protect yourself better."

"Fine. Tonight you're sleeping alone, and from now on, stay away from me."

"I don't count."

"On what grounds do you not count?"

"On the grounds that I'm your boyfriend?"

"When did you become my boyfriend? How come I didn't know about it?"

"My dear, are you trying to wipe your mouth clean and deny everything after eating your fill?"

"Don't call me my dear, I have a name."

"……A ruthless man who pulls up his pants and walks away, a scumbag who pumps and dumps. Oh, someone stop me, I can't control my mouth anymore. Before I say something even more vicious, hurry up and seal me—shut me up using your unique method." As if afraid Bu Shuai wouldn't get the hint, Shang Feifan tapped his own lips.

"Get lost!"

The dark, gloomy underground city looked on as these two individuals acted outlandishly uninhibited on the utterly desolate street... courting trouble.

They exchanged mindless banter completely devoid of nutritional value, yet remained entirely oblivious to it, bickering with utmost earnestness.

Amidst their bickering, the two arrived at Anji South Street Station.

"Eagle Wing said this station isn't easy to find?" Shang Feifan looked toward the platform, his train of thought snapping back to normal in a second.

Bu Shuai nodded.

"Yet here it is."

"Yeah. Eagle Wing also said that the vehicle that carries people to mysterious locations can only be encountered by those fated to meet it, and if you miss it once, don't expect to board it a second time, but……"

Bu Shuai was seeing it for the third time.

He couldn't help feeling that this vehicle was particularly impatient; the first two times it had made him wait a while before appearing, but this time, the moment he stepped onto the platform, it showed up.

Shang Feifan naturally reached out to take his hand and spotted the vehicle as well.

"Transformers edition?"

"……I just couldn't help thinking about it."

Shang Feifan laughed so hard his upper body trembled. This Transformer-version fire engine had definitely been heavily beautified.

"What do you think? Do we get on, or what?" Shang Feifan asked Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai hesitated. "I don't know why, but I don't want to leave with this vehicle right now."

"Then trust your intuition. Let's go deal with the Evil God's power in this underground city first," Shang Feifan said without a moment's hesitation.

"But if we come back and this vehicle is gone, what then? And according to what Eagle Wing said, I suspect that wanting to reach the true Temple of the God of Nature might actually require taking this vehicle."

Bu Shuai had one glaring flaw: the moment someone else in the group possessed decision-making authority, he would automatically step back and become indecisive.

Shang Feifan knew this flaw of his inside out and calmly asked, "What is our primary objective right now?"

Bu Shuai: "Rescue the city residents."

Shang Feifan: "And what is the key to rescuing the city residents?"

"Destroying the conspiracy targeting the residents in the underground city?"

"And what is that conspiracy?"

"Well, judging by the Evil God cultists and Evil God statues we've seen, perhaps a large-scale sacrifice?"

"So what do we need to do most right now?"

" Disrupt the ritual so the sacrifice cannot succeed." Bu Shuai immediately replied, "And the key to the sacrifice is having Evil God statues. We need to find those Evil God statues first."

Shang Feifan gave a light chuckle. "Although we aren't sure whether destroying those Evil God statues will completely foil Marquis Danton's plot, it's the only trouble we currently have a handle on and can resolve. Going straight to the temple to find Marquis Danton is an option, but I prefer to pull out a tiger's teeth and claws before dealing with it."

Bu Shuai's mind cleared up. "Eagle Wing went over there too. If Marquis Danton is also there, letting them clash might just divert Marquis Danton's attention and keep him too busy to worry about us."

"Exactly!"

"Can you accurately locate the positions of the Evil God statues right now?"

"As long as I'm within a hundred-meter radius."

"Fantastic! Let's move."

Having reached a consensus, the two turned around and left the station.

The Station: *Are you guys fucking playing with me? You came three times, and not once did you get on the car!*

Passing by a refugee camp, Shang Feifan fished out a rock, carved a sentence into it, and tossed it right in front of a supervisor who clearly looked like the person in charge.

*Thud.*

The supervisor lowered his head, hesitated for a few seconds, and bent down to pick up the extra stone.

The stone was ordinary, the kind you could find anywhere. What wasn't ordinary was the sentence carved upon it: *[Someone took a mysterious vehicle from Anji South Road Station to go there.]*

The supervisor didn't understand what this sentence meant, but the less he understood it, the less he dared to ignore it. He immediately ran off to hand the stone over to his superior.

The stone was passed up level by level until it reached the hands of someone who could understand the message.

The moment this person saw the sentence, they didn't dare delay and immediately rushed to find the Lord of Black Forest City.

Seeing Shang Feifan toss that stone away, Bu Shuai's eyes formed question marks.

Shang Feifan said with an utterly innocent expression, "I'm just notifying the master of this house that there are thieves in his home."

Bu Shuai: "……"

"Over there!" Shang Feifan suddenly pointed toward a cluster of buildings not far away. "I sense a dense concentration of Evil God power coming from there."

***

At the center of the underground city, within the Temple of the God of Nature.

The Lord of Black Forest City, the contemporary Marquis Danton, was working in the first grand hall.

This was also the command center for the entire underground city.

Judging from its interior decoration, the Temple of the God of Nature was far from luxurious or eye-catching; in fact, it could even be described as unpretentious and plain.

However, its architecture was exceptionally distinctive and grand in scale.

The exterior walls and pillars were covered in carvings of animals, plants, humans, and landscapes. Yet these carvings were not delicate; rather, they looked more like the crudest mimetic carvings casually chiseled out by ordinary people devoid of sculpting talent and technique.

Some carvings were so crude you couldn't even tell what they were supposed to depict.

Yet this was the Temple of the God of Nature—one of the oldest, best-preserved temples handed down through the ages.

According to the city annals that Marquis Danton's ancestors had discovered in the underground city, this underground city had been built around this very temple. It was entirely fair to say that without this temple, this underground city would never have existed.

During the Great Prosperity Era and even earlier epochs, the Orcs living here and in the surrounding areas would perform their divine blood talent awakening ceremonies at this temple.

chunks.chineseText:
另外，这座神殿还承载着节日祭祀、战胜队祭祀、出征祭祀、给新生儿消灾祈福、学生学院毕业礼等重任。

城市志还记载，这座自然之神神殿有过许多不可思议的神迹，还有很多奇怪的用科学无法解释的现象发生。

相传，新兽人帝国第一代帝皇阿莫斯布莱顿也曾来祭拜过这座自然之神神殿。

如果这是真的，那么这座神殿的历史至少超过五千年。

因为大繁华纪之前就是新兽人帝国时期，新兽人帝国延续了三千年之久。

新兽人帝国如同旧兽人帝国一样被推翻，兽人大陆再次迎来联盟制，这就是大繁华纪。

大繁华纪则有两千多年历史。

在新兽人帝国时期，神血教霸占这座神殿很长一段时间，等到新兽人帝国和神血教一起被推翻，这座神殿才重新回到圣山祭司宫手中。

圣山祭司宫派出人手常驻这座神殿，直到大繁华纪结束，大战纪来临。

丹顿侯爵的祖辈是在毒雾纪发现了这座地下城，当时他们在到处寻找可以躲避毒雾、可以继续生存的地方，在一个非常偶然的机会下，他们打开了一个地下城入口，从而发现地下城。

更让他们惊喜的是，这座地下城竟然没有受到毒雾影响，里面的空气十分干净。

于是丹顿侯爵的祖辈和他率领的一帮兽人就占领了地下城，在这里居住下来。

期间，丹顿侯爵的祖辈一直在寻找这座地下城能不让毒雾侵袭进来的原因，更想知道这座地下城为什么在经历大战纪和战毁纪后，仍旧能保持的这么完好。

直到丹顿侯爵的祖辈发现居住在地下城竟然会大大减少寿命后。

这里的水土都没有问题，甚至有着能够种植的小片土壤，只要能解决光照问题。

这座城它不会让你生病，也不会让你衰弱，但它就是会减少你将近一半的寿命！

幸好毒雾纪过去了，丹顿侯爵的祖辈立刻就带着数量已经翻了好几倍的跟随者们从地下城搬迁了出来。

不算特殊种族，普通兽人的平均寿命可以达到三百岁，就算减少一半，也能活到一百多。

一百多年时间足够兽人们生下一轮又一轮幼崽。

只要食物充足，生活环境安定又健康，这些幼崽基本都能养活。

实际上就算没有地下城会减少兽人们寿命这个缺陷，丹顿侯爵的祖辈也打算带人搬出来。

因为他们的可耕种面积太少，他们产出的粮食已经跟不上增长的人口速度。

如果不想遏制人口增长，他们就必须找到更多能耕种的土地。

原本丹顿侯爵祖辈打算把地下城当做他们丹顿家的私人拥有领地，但古怪的是，当他们选择全员搬出地下城后，地下城中那块唯一能耕种的小片土地就变得再也长不出任何粮食。

没有了耕种土地，待在地下城又会减少寿命。

这座地下城顿时就成了鸡肋，在黑森林城建立后，这里就变成了仓储地。

但丹顿家的后代一直都没有放弃研究这座地下城，更没有放弃研究这座神秘又神奇的古老神殿。

第一个神秘处：神殿会隐藏自身，只有有缘人才能发现它。

第一个发现神殿的丹顿人是当代丹顿侯爵的曾祖父。

但找到固定途径，可以让丹顿家族人自由来往神殿的人则是当代丹顿侯爵的父亲。

可他们至今为止能打开的只是神殿第一重。

根据地下城城市志叙述，这座神殿一共有三重。

相传除了他们丹顿家掌握的那条线路，另外还有一个特殊方法可以抵达神殿。

就是在安吉南路站乘坐一辆只有特定人选才能看到的车辆。

甚至有传言，那辆车可以带着乘车人进入神殿第二重甚至是第三重。

但万分可惜又可恨的是，他们丹顿家这么多年寻找下来，竟然连安吉南路车站都没有找到！

明明他们掌握着整座地下城的地图。

丹顿侯爵敢说，这世上再也没有第二个人能比他更熟悉这座地下城。

可就算这样，他也没有找到安吉南路站，虽然他知道它就在那里！

不过没关系，他现在已经有了新的办法可以打开第二重和第三重神殿。

不不不，打开神殿不是关键，关键是……

“城主，这是下面刚刚送上来的东西。亚宁先生说，建议您看看。”侍卫得到允许上前，呈上物品。

亚宁，黑森林城主的智囊团第一智囊，也是他的心腹。

丹顿侯爵用手指夹起放在托盘上的石头。

能送到他面前的东西都被重重检查过，不用担心会有中毒或爆炸可能。

看到石头刻写的那句话，年过六十，但外表依旧年轻英俊的丹顿侯爵皱眉：“谁送来的？”

侍卫回答：“最先发现这块石头的是南区避难地监督队队长。他说是有人特意把这块石头丢到他脚下，但他想要寻找那个人，却没有找到。”

“避难的城民表现如何？有捣乱的人吗？”丹顿侯爵随手把石头扔到一边，问。

侍卫：“根据最新报上来的消息，只有极少数人不满分配的房屋、食物份量，还有极少数人没有进入避难营地，而是进入了地下城其他区域。各避难营地负责人按照传达下去的吩咐，没有管那些离开的人。”

“这么说，已经有一批兽人进入地下城。”

“是。”

丹顿侯爵沉默不语。

侍卫小心翼翼询问：“要派人处理他们吗？”

丹顿侯爵抬起一根手指，摇了摇：“不用特意处理，这座地下城会自己解决那些不听话的人。”

“上面的情况如何？”丹顿侯爵又问。

“腐蚀雨还在下，很多人的房屋已经无法坚守，这部分人在劝告下也开始转向地下城。”

“那些被腐蚀的人？”

“已经以集体救治的名义把他们集中起来，但也有少部分人更相信自己的家人和朋友。”

“只是少数的话，不用管他们。半小时后，我要看到那些被腐蚀的伤者集中到西六区。”

“是！”

侍卫退下，丹顿侯爵起身走到位于神殿后方的高大神像前。

这也许不能算是一座神像，因为它看起来就像是一棵大树，枯死的大树。

枯死的大树枝干上，零落地点着九支黑色蜡烛。

这九支蜡烛像是直接插-入树枝中，看不到根部。

如今九支蜡烛只有八支点燃，另一支像是融化一般，变成一坨黑色蜡液黏在树枝上。

一名全身黑色衣袍头发雪白的兽人跪坐在大树前，他的嘴中一直念念有词。

另一名身披华丽兽皮大氅的兽人则正在对那坨融化的蜡液做些什么，似乎试图想要让它重新凝结成型。

丹顿侯爵伸出手，轻轻抚摸粗糙不平的树身。

他的身体挺得笔直，目光锐利，全部输向后方的头发顺遂得不可思议。

长三角形的尖耳竖立在脑袋两侧，头发上夹着精致的发箍。一身剪裁合体的长袍让他的身体看起来修长优雅，但裸-露的半截手臂又能看到隆起的结实肌肉。
chunks.englishText:
Furthermore, this temple shouldered many heavy responsibilities, including festival sacrifices, victory sacrifices, expedition sacrifices, disaster-relief and blessing prayers for newborns, and graduation ceremonies for students of the academy.

The city annals also recorded that the Temple of the God of Nature had witnessed countless incredible divine miracles and many strange phenomena that science could not explain.

Legend had it that Amos Brighton, the first emperor of the New Orc Empire, had also come to worship at this Temple of the God of Nature.

If this was true, then the history of this temple spanned at least over five thousand years.

After all, the era preceding the Great Prosperity Era was the period of the New Orc Empire, and the New Orc Empire had endured for a full three thousand years.

Like the Old Orc Empire, the New Orc Empire was eventually overthrown, and the Orc Continent welcomed the alliance system once more—this was the Great Prosperity Era.

The Great Prosperity Era itself had a history of over two thousand years.

During the New Orc Empire era, the Divine Blood Cult had occupied this temple for a very long period. It was only when the New Orc Empire and the Divine Blood Cult were overthrown together that the temple finally returned to the hands of the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace.

The Sacred Mountain Priest Palace dispatched personnel to be permanently stationed in this temple until the end of the Great Prosperity Era and the arrival of the Great War Era.

Marquis Danton's ancestors had discovered this underground city during the Poison Fog Era. At that time, they were searching everywhere for a place to escape the poison fog and survive. Through sheer coincidence, they opened an underground city entrance and thus discovered the underground city.

To their even greater surprise, this underground city had completely escaped the effects of the poison fog, and the air inside was remarkably clean.

Consequently, Marquis Danton's ancestors and the group of orcs under his command occupied the underground city and settled down here.

During this period, Marquis Danton's ancestors continuously searched for the reason why this underground city could keep the poison fog out, and even more so, they wanted to know why this underground city remained so well-preserved after experiencing the Great War Era and the War-Ruined Era.

That was until Marquis Danton's ancestors discovered that living in the underground city drastically shortened one's lifespan.

There were no problems with the soil or water here; there was even a small patch of arable land, provided one could solve the lighting issue.

This city wouldn't make you sick, nor would it weaken you, but it would simply slash nearly half of your lifespan!

Fortunately, the Poison Fog Era passed, and Marquis Danton's ancestors immediately led their followers—whose numbers had multiplied several times over—out of the underground city and relocated.

Excluding special races, the average lifespan of ordinary orcs could reach three hundred years; even with half of it shaved off, they could still live to over a hundred.
