A hundred-odd years was enough time for the orcs to give birth to generation after generation of cubs.

As long as food was abundant and the living environment stable and healthy, these cubs could basically all be raised successfully.

In reality, even without the flaw of the underground city shortening orcs' lifespans, Marquis Danton's ancestors had planned to lead everyone out anyway.

Because their cultivable area was far too small, and the food they produced could no longer keep pace with the rate of population growth.

If they didn't want to curb population growth, they had to find more arable land.

Originally, Marquis Danton's ancestors intended to treat the underground city as the Danton family's private territory. But the odd thing was that the moment they chose to evacuate the entire underground city, that single patch of arable land within the city lost its ability to grow any crops whatsoever.

Without arable land, staying in the underground city would only shorten their lifespans.

This underground city instantly became a tasteless chicken rib—useful only for discarding, yet a pity to abandon. After Black Forest City was established, this place was converted into a storage depot.

However, the descendants of the Danton family had never given up studying this underground city, nor had they given up researching this mysterious and magical ancient temple.

Mystery Number One: The temple could conceal itself, and only those fated could discover it.

The first Danton to discover the temple was the great-grandfather of the current Marquis Danton.

However, the person who found a fixed route allowing members of the Danton family to travel freely to and from the temple was the current Marquis Danton's father.

Yet up to now, the only part they could open was the first layer of the temple.

According to the account in the underground city annals, this temple had a total of three layers.

Legend had it that besides the route mastered by their Danton family, there was another special method to reach the temple.

And that was boarding a vehicle at Anji South Road Station that only specific individuals could see.

There were even rumors that that vehicle could carry passengers into the second or even third layer of the temple.

Yet, most regrettably and hatefully, despite searching for so many years, their Danton family hadn't even been able to find the Anji South Road Station!

Clearly, they possessed the map of the entire underground city.

Marquis Danton dared say that no second person in this world was more familiar with this underground city than he was.

Yet even so, he hadn't been able to find Anji South Road Station, even though he knew it was right there!

It didn't matter, however; he now had a new method to open the second and third layers of the temple.

No, no, no—opening the temple wasn't the critical part; the crucial thing was……

"Lord City Lord, this is something just sent up from below. Mr. Yaning said he suggests you take a look." The guard obtained permission to step forward and presented the item.

Yaning, the top strategist of the Black Forest City Lord's think tank, and also his trusted confidant.

Marquis Danton picked up the stone resting on the tray with his fingers.

Everything sent before him underwent rigorous inspection; there was no need to worry about the possibility of poison or explosions.

Seeing the sentence carved into the stone, Marquis Danton, who was over sixty years old yet still looked young and handsome, frowned. "Who sent this?"

The guard replied, "The one who first discovered this stone was the captain of the South District refugee shelter's supervisory team. He said someone intentionally tossed this stone at his feet, but when he tried to look for that person, he couldn't find them."

"How are the refugee citizens behaving? Any troublemakers?" Marquis Danton casually tossed the stone aside and asked.

The guard answered, "According to the latest reports, only a tiny fraction of people are dissatisfied with the assigned housing and food rations, and an even smaller fraction didn't enter the refugee camps, instead heading into other areas of the underground city. In accordance with the instructions passed down, the managers of each refugee camp ignored those who left."

"In other words, a batch of orcs has already entered the underground city."

"Yes."

Marquis Danton fell silent.

The guard cautiously inquired, "Should we send people to deal with them?"

Marquis Danton raised a single finger and shook it. "No need to deal with them specially. This underground city will take care of those disobedient people on its own."

"What is the situation on the surface?" Marquis Danton asked again.

"The corrosive rain is still falling, and many people's houses can no longer hold out. Under persuasion, this group has also begun heading toward the underground city."

"Those who have been corroded?"

"They have been gathered together under the guise of collective treatment, but a small number of people still trust their own family and friends more."

"If it's only a minority, ignore them. In half an hour, I want to see those wounded by the corrosion gathered in District West-Six."

"Understood!"

The guard withdrew, and Marquis Danton stood up, walking over to the tall giant statue located at the back of the temple.

Perhaps this couldn't even be considered a divine statue, because it looked just like a tree—a dead, withered tree.

On the branches of the withered tree, nine black candles were sparsely dotted.

These nine candles seemed to be plugged directly into the tree branches, with no roots visible.

At present, only eight of the nine candles were lit; the remaining one looked as though it had melted, turning into a lump of black wax clinging to the branches.

An orc clad in entirely black robes with snowy white hair knelt before the great tree, muttering incantations ceaselessly under his breath.

Another orc draped in a luxurious beast-skin cloak was performing some action upon that melted blob of wax, seemingly attempting to make it solidify and reform.

Marquis Danton reached out and gently stroked the rough, uneven trunk of the tree.

His posture was ramrod straight, his gaze sharp, and his hair, swept entirely backward, was impeccably smooth.

Long, triangular pointed ears stood erect on both sides of his head, with an exquisite hairband clamped in his locks. A well-tailored robe made his physique appear slender and elegant, yet the exposed halves of his arms revealed bulging, solid muscles.

chunks.chineseText:
遥远的异度空间内：“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯。虔诚的信徒我将把这具邪神雕像献祭给您，请您诅咒……黑森林城主丹顿侯爵永垂不举。”

丹顿侯爵忽觉脖颈有点发凉，有种厄运缠身的糟糕感。

这让这位英俊的贵族微微皱起了眉头。

噗！

一支黑色蜡烛的火焰晃了晃，突然熄灭。

“不！”身披大氅的兽人怒吼：“是谁！是谁干的？！”

“怎么回事？”丹顿侯爵沉声质问。

跪在大树前的兽人惊恐地看向熄灭的蜡烛：“厄穆克拉索的力量被摧毁了……这不可能！”

丹顿侯爵反而看起来比较淡定：“是自然之神的力量在阻止吗？”

跪在大树前的兽人双手碰触大树树根，神情痛苦：“我不知道……神早已不再响应祂的信徒。”

丹顿侯爵转看向身披大氅的兽人。

大氅兽人神色愤怒又激烈：“这里已经没有自然之神的力量！就算有，也只能成为吾神的养料。”

“那么蜡烛连续熄灭两支是怎么回事？”丹顿侯爵问。

大氅兽人逼视丹顿侯爵：“这应该问城主你。整座地下城都在爵爷你的掌控之中，两支蜡烛连续熄灭一定有原因。”

丹顿侯爵似乎完全没把大氅兽人的态度放在心上，仍旧淡淡地说：“我已经派人去查。但这需要时间。而且当初是你拒绝让我派兵保护雕像，只让你的人守护，我的人还不知道能不能联系到你的人，希望他们都还活着吧。”

大氅兽人脸色变得难看。

丹顿侯爵又说：“现在我需要向你确定一件事，那就是如果缺少部分厄穆克拉索的力量，我们的计划是否还能进行下去？”

大氅兽人没有立刻回答，他低垂着头，似乎在思考，又像是在询问谁。

过了好一会儿，他才开口：“吾神的力量谁也无法消灭，如果真的有人想要摧毁吾神的力量，他只会空欢喜一场。”

“事实是现在已经熄灭了两支蜡烛。请回答我刚才的问题。”丹顿侯爵冷冷说。

大氅兽人抬起头，眼神诡异：“除非蜡烛全部熄灭，吾神的力量全部消融，否热城主你的计划就一定可以施行下去，只是吾神的力量越少，所需要的时间就越多。”

丹顿侯爵：“我不可能让腐蚀雨一直下下去。最多三天。”

“那就尽快找出破坏吾神力量的人！那是城主你的责任。”大氅兽人反唇相讥。

“我会先提供一部分祭品，增强厄穆克拉索的力量，我需要先看到效果。”丹顿侯爵眼睛紧紧盯着大氅兽人。

大氅兽人冷哼一声：“我答应城主你的事情自然会做到。只要你按照我们的约定，奉上足够的祭品，吾神会让你看到你想看到的。”

丹顿侯爵没有说话，只又轻轻抚摸了树身，转身走向神殿的前半部分。

那里已经被布置成一个综合起居室、会议厅和休息室的空间。

大氅兽人盯着丹顿侯爵的背影，强行压下心中的一丝-不安。

他一开始就不同意和这个人合作，他看不透这位侯爵。

但上面同意了，还把他派过来主持这件大事。

他需要功绩，哪怕不想和这位侯爵大人合作，为了能在教内更进一步，他也不得不来。

大氅兽人的目光又落到那个跪趴在大树树根下的白发兽人，眼中露出鄙夷神色。

一个因为得不到神灵响应，就背叛自己所信仰所服侍神灵的兽人，他根本就不配出现在这里！

转而，大氅兽人又开始心疼熄灭的两支蜡烛。

那可是用虔诚信徒之血浇灌出来的两尊神灵雕像，丢失一具都会让他们心疼死，更何况两具！

千万别让他知道是谁盗走了神像，又隐藏了厄穆克拉索的力量，否则他一定会用教中最残酷的刑罚把那个家伙献祭给至高伟大的厄穆克拉索。

遥远的异度空间：“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯。虔诚的信徒我将把这具邪神雕像献祭给您，请您诅咒……虎王每次和异性接触时都会浑身如针刺。”

感谢西游记给他的灵感！不知为何，比起王后，商非凡更不喜欢虎王。

“啊！”白发兽人再次发出惊叫。

第三根黑色蜡烛熄灭了。

大氅兽人眼睛瞪大到极点，这怎么可能？！

“城主！急报！”刚才传信侍卫再次出现。

丹顿侯爵在桌前抬起头：“说。”

侍卫：“我们的人与那些人碰头，根据他们所述，据说地下城中-出现了看不见的敌人，邪……厄穆克拉索的力量也无法阻止他们。”

丹顿侯爵：“详细描述他们的偷袭过程。”

“是。据说……”

商非凡向诅咒之神献祭了第三具邪神雕像后，从雕像广场回来。

一落地，商非凡就敏感地看向四周：“你有没有觉得好像有什么在看着我们？”

不帅神色微妙：“你也感觉到了？是不是感觉这座地下城像是活的一样？”

“之前还不明显，但现在……有你说的感觉了。”商非凡把不帅拉到身边，不让他远离自己。

不帅也在担心商非凡：“你已经处理了三尊邪神雕像，你没事吧？”

商非凡摇头，他只起到了传送带作用，真正处理邪神力量的是诅咒之神。

“我们去寻找第四具雕像。”

“从现在开始我们要小心了。那些邪神信徒似乎已经得到消息，全都守在雕像前，我们恐怕不能再像之前三次一样，轻易抢到雕像，更别说挖出雕像下的东西。”

除了第一次，第二次和第三次他们都是仗着隐身术，冲到雕像跟前，一个负责抓起雕像，一个负责用魔法直接把土壤里埋着的箱子挖出来，讲究的就是一个快。

等邪神信徒反应过来，却无法抓到隐身的他们。

但这只是仗着邪神信徒们还不知道他们用了什么手段，但刚才已经有邪神信徒喊破他们有隐身和加速能力。

如此，其他雕像面前的邪神信徒一定会有所准备。

“你会定身术吗？只要能把人都固定住的魔法就可以。”

“交给我。”

“速度还是要快，实在不行，我们就只抢雕像，回过头再处理地下掩埋的箱子。”

“也行。对了，你看过那三口箱子了吗？里面都是什么？”

“你绝对想不到。不是尸体，也不是内脏，更不是血液，而是各种看起来价值很高的物品。我看到了一个造型非常精美、上面还贴着宝石的罐子，一把也许有特殊作用的梳子，一条华丽的宝石项链。”

“听起来有点奇怪。邪神会需要这些吗？”

“也许跟仪式有关。”商非凡脑中一亮，他想好下一个诅咒内容是什么了。

他对邪神、邪神阴影者和邪神信徒以及邪神信徒们搞出来的仪式了解得太少，也许他可以补充一下这方面的知识。

半小时后。
chunks.englishText:
In a distant different-dimension space: "Supreme and magnificent existence, God of Curses Conizeus. I, your pious believer, shall sacrifice this evil god statue to you; please curse... Marquis Dalton, Lord of the Black Forest City, to suffer from eternal impotence."

Marquis Dalton suddenly felt a slight chill at the back of his neck, accompanied by an ominous sensation that disaster was clinging to him.

This caused the handsome noble to furrow his brow slightly.

Puff!

The flame of a black candle flickered and suddenly went out.

"No!" The orc draped in a heavy cloak roared, "Who is it?! Who did this?!"

"What's going on?" Marquis Dalton demanded in a deep voice.

The orc kneeling before the large tree stared in horror at the extinguished candle: "The power of Eumuklaso has been destroyed... This is impossible!"

Marquis Dalton, by contrast, appeared relatively calm: "Is it the power of the God of Nature intervening?"

The orc kneeling before the tree pressed his hands against its roots, his expression pained: "I don't know... The gods have long ceased to respond to their believers."

Marquis Dalton turned to look at the cloaked orc.

The cloaked orc's expression turned fierce and furious: "There is no longer any power of the God of Nature here! Even if there were, it would only serve as nourishment for my god."

"Then how do you explain two candles going out back-to-back?" Marquis Dalton asked.

The cloaked orc glared at Marquis Dalton: "That is something you should be asking yourself, Lord City Lord. The entire underground city is under your lordship's control; there must be a reason why two candles have gone out consecutively."

Marquis Dalton seemed entirely unbothered by the cloaked orc's attitude, saying indifferently, "I have already sent people to investigate. But that takes time. Besides, it was you who refused to let me dispatch troops to protect the statues, insisting that only your people guard them. I can't even be sure if my men can reach yours—let's just hope they're all still alive."

The cloaked orc's expression turned ugly.

Marquis Dalton continued, "Now I need you to confirm one thing: if a portion of Eumuklaso's power is missing, can our plan still proceed?"

The cloaked orc did not answer immediately. He lowered his head, appearing to ponder, or perhaps consulting someone.

After a long while, he finally spoke: "No one can annihilate the power of my god. If someone truly wishes to destroy it, they will only find it was all in vain."

"The fact is that two candles have already been extinguished. Please answer my question," Marquis Dalton said coldly.

The cloaked orc raised his head, a bizarre look in his eyes: "Unless all the candles are extinguished and my god's power is completely dissolved, your plan, Lord City Lord, will definitely be able to proceed. However, the less power my god retains, the more time it will require."

Marquis Dalton: "I cannot let the corrosive rain fall indefinitely. Three days at most."

"Then find the person destroying my god's power as soon as possible! That is your responsibility as City Lord," the cloaked orc retorted.

"I will provide a portion of the sacrificial offerings first to bolster Eumuklaso's power; I need to see results beforehand." Marquis Dalton fixed his gaze intently on the cloaked orc.

The cloaked orc snorted coldly: "What I promised the City Lord, I will naturally fulfill. As long as you provide enough sacrificial offerings according to our agreement, my god will let you see what you wish to see."

Marquis Dalton said nothing more. He merely stroked the tree trunk once more and turned to walk toward the front section of the temple.

That area had already been furnished into a comprehensive living space, meeting room, and lounge.

The cloaked orc stared at Marquis Dalton's retreating back, forcibly suppressing the trace of unease in his heart.

From the very beginning, he had disagreed with cooperating with this person; he simply could not see through this Marquis.

However, his superiors had agreed and even dispatched him here to preside over this monumental affair.

He needed achievements. Even though he had no desire to cooperate with this Lord Marquis, in order to advance further within the sect, he had no choice but to come.

The cloaked orc's gaze then fell upon the white-haired orc kneeling and prostrating himself at the roots of the massive tree, a look of disdain crossing his eyes.

An orc who betrayed the god he believed in and served simply because he received no divine response was utterly unworthy of appearing here!

Turning his thoughts, the cloaked orc began to feel a pang of anguish over the two extinguished candles.

Those were two divine statues nurtured and poured over with the blood of pious believers; losing even a single one would break their hearts, let alone two!

He prayed he never found out who had stolen the divine statues and suppressed Eumuklaso's power, or he would surely use the most brutal tortures of the sect to sacrifice that wretch to the supreme and magnificent Eumuklaso.

In the distant different-dimension space: "Supreme and magnificent existence, God of Curses Conizeus. I, your pious believer, shall sacrifice this evil god statue to you; please curse... the Tiger King to experience a sensation like pins and needles all over his body whenever he has contact with the opposite sex."

Thanks to Journey to the West for the inspiration! For some reason, Shang Feifan disliked the Tiger King even more than the Queen.

"Ah!" The white-haired orc shrieked again.

The third black candle had gone out.

The cloaked orc's eyes widened to their absolute limit—how could this be possible?!

"Lord City Lord! Urgent report!" The guard who had delivered messages earlier appeared once more.

Marquis Dalton raised his head from behind the desk: "Speak."

The guard: "Our men made contact with those troops. According to their account, it is rumored that an invisible enemy has appeared within the underground city, and even the evil... the power of Eumuklaso could not stop them."

Marquis Dalton: "Describe their ambush in detail."

"Yes. It is said..."

After sacrificing the third evil god statue to the God of Curses, Shang Feifan returned from the statue plaza.

The moment his feet touched the ground, Shang Feifan sensitively scanned his surroundings: "Do you feel like something is watching us?"

Bu Shu wore a subtle expression: "You feel it too? Does it feel like this underground city is somehow alive?"

"It wasn't obvious before, but now... I have the feeling you mentioned." Shang Feifan pulled Bu Shu close to his side, not letting him stray.

Bu Shu was equally worried about Shang Feifan: "You've already dealt with three evil god statues. Are you alright?"

Shang Feifan shook his head; he had merely acted as a conveyor belt. The one truly dealing with the evil god's power was the God of Curses.

"Let's go find the fourth statue."

"From now on, we must be careful. Those evil god cultists seem to have received word and are all guarding the statues. We probably won't be able to easily snatch the statues like the previous three times, let alone dig out what's buried beneath them."

Aside from the first time, for the second and third times they had relied on stealth to charge right up to the statues—one responsible for snatching the statue, the other using magic to directly excavate the chest buried in the soil. Speed was everything.

By the time the evil god cultists reacted, they couldn't catch their invisible targets.

However, that only worked because the evil god cultists didn't yet know what methods they were using. But just now, an evil god cultist had called out that they possessed stealth and speed-boosting abilities.

As such, the evil god cultists guarding the remaining statues would definitely be prepared.

"Do you know the Binding Spell? Any magic that can immobilize people will do."

"Leave it to me."

"We still need to be fast. If push comes to shove, we'll just snatch the statue and deal with the buried chest underground afterward."

"That works too. By the way, have you looked inside those three chests? What's in them?"

"You'd never guess. Not corpses, not internal organs, and not blood, but various seemingly high-value items. I saw a very exquisitely crafted jar with gems stuck to it, a comb that might have some special purpose, and a gorgeous gem necklace."

"Sounds a bit strange. Would evil gods need these?"

"Perhaps it's related to a ritual." A light bulb went off in Shang Feifan's mind; he had already thought of what his next curse would be.

He knew far too little about evil gods, evil god shadow-walkers, evil god cultists, and the rituals they concocted. Perhaps he could supplement his knowledge in this area.

Half an hour later.

chunks.chineseText:
某异度空间内：“至高伟大的存在，诅咒之神科尼泽厄斯。虔诚的信徒我将把这具邪神雕像献祭给您，请您诅咒……我遇到的每一个邪神信徒都恨不得把他们知道的邪神知识全都强行灌输给我。”

神殿中，丹顿侯爵再次被惊动。

因为黑色蜡烛刚刚又熄灭了一支。这已经是第四支！

大氅兽人再也端不住，目眦欲裂地喊：“无论如何都要找到捣鬼的人！必须把雕像找回来！必须！”

丹顿侯爵看着熄灭的四坨蜡液，只觉得那些黑色蜡液充满了不祥。但他还是迅速传令下去，在地下城加派人手寻找“看不见的敌人”。

趴伏在大树树根下的兽人身体不住颤抖，表情特别复杂，像是激动，又像是不可置信。
chunks.englishText:
In a certain different-dimension space: "Supreme and magnificent existence, God of Curses Conizeus. I, your pious believer, shall sacrifice this evil god statue to you; please curse... every single evil god cultist I encounter to feel an overwhelming urge to forcefully cram all the evil god knowledge they possess into my head."

Inside the temple, Marquis Dalton was disturbed once again.

Because yet another black candle had just gone out. This was already the fourth one!

The cloaked orc could no longer maintain his composure. With eyes splitting at the corners, he screamed, "Find the troublemaker no matter what! The statues must be retrieved! They must!"

Marquis Dalton looked at the four pools of melted wax, feeling that those black puddles were dripping with ominous intent. Yet, he still quickly issued orders to dispatch more manpower throughout the underground city to search for the "invisible enemy."

The orc prostrated at the roots of the massive tree trembled uncontrollably, his expression exceptionally complex—part excitement, part sheer disbelief.

chunks.chineseText:
第106章 抢先一步

九支蜡烛全灭！

丹顿侯爵不在。

在第七根蜡烛熄灭时，他就离开了神殿。

大氅兽人也顾不得询问丹顿侯爵去了哪里，他已经从暴怒转为强烈不安。

等到最后一支蜡烛熄灭，他整个人都傻住了。

相反，那名白发兽人从树根下爬了起来，他双手狂舞，围着枯死的大树跳着奇怪的舞蹈，嘴里还发出古怪的喊声。

大氅兽人瞪着那名白发兽人，像似要杀了他。

但最终他只是沉默地看着树上的九滩蜡液。

蜡烛熄灭了，但蜡液已经深入树干中。

厄穆克拉索永远都不可能被打倒！

大氅兽人举起手臂，右手指甲变长，划开自己的左手手腕，把鲜血均匀地浇灌在每一滩黑色蜡液上。

纵使失血过多导致他脸色苍白，他也没有停下。

直到他的身体肉眼可见变得干瘪。

一名健壮的兽人转眼间就变成了一具干尸。

大氅兽人没有死，他的眼珠还在转动，他甚至还舔了舔自己划破的手腕。

他的手腕已经滴不出鲜血，他却依然可以行动。

白发兽人用恐惧的目光看着他：“你……活死人。”

大氅兽人干瘪的容颜露出轻蔑的笑：“你根本不懂。这不是活死人，这是厄穆克拉索的赐福。得到厄穆克拉索赐福的信徒，哪怕在最极端的环境也能生存下去，我们不需要依赖自然！”

倏地，距离白发兽人最近的一根树枝，那一滩蜡液的位置飞速射出一条黑色长虫。

黑色长虫飞快钻入白发兽人的鼻孔。

白发兽人猛地捂住鼻子，想要把黑色长虫拽出来。

但没有用！

黑色长虫钻入了他的大脑。

白发兽人身体倒下。

大氅兽人低头看向倒地抽搐的兽人。

这个蠢货以为自己在丹顿侯爵面前很有面子，以为自己的地位比他这个外来者要高得多，却不知道当他也参与这个计划时，就已经被丹顿侯爵定义为祭品之一。

一名兽人大陆自然之神的祭司，却成为外来神灵厄穆克拉索的祭品，再也没有比这个更讽刺的事情。

“你的神灵已经消失了。古神的时代已经结束，新神才是兽人世界的未来！”

白发兽人眼球翻白，他的牙齿发出克克声，但他此时竟然还没有完全失去神智，他甚至还能挤出语音：“吾神……永存……”

所有人都以为自然之神陨落了，就连他这个祭司也是。

但就在今天，看到那寄生在枯树上的厄穆克拉索象征之烛一支接一支熄灭，他忽然又有了一点信心。

也许自然之神并没有消亡，祂只是隐藏起来，在积蓄力量。

自然被摧毁后，想要恢复总需要一定时间。

而他们这些沐浴着自然之恩的兽人们，理应做的是守护，是帮助自然抵御一切伤害自然的助手。

可他们实际做的却只是等待，只是强求，只一味的索求自然之神赐予和保佑。他们貌似也付出了，付出的却不对。

他们做错了……

可恨他直到生命的最后才想明白。

但好在想明白后，他的信念重新坚定起来，他的灵魂也变得坚不可摧。

我无法再保护吾神，但我最起码会让邪神无法利用我这具由自然造就的身体！

沙……

白发兽人的身体竟然一点点变成了沙粒。

见鬼！大氅兽人接连受到打击，他没想到一直被他瞧不起的自然之神祭司竟然能让自己的身体沙化！

明明阴影者已经钻入他的大脑，应该很快控制住他才对。

一条黑色长虫从沙粒中游弋出来。

它看起来变得衰弱许多，行动也变得缓慢。

大氅兽人慢慢跪到地上，他想把黑色长虫引回枯树中。

黑色长虫顺着他放下的手掌慢慢爬到他的手臂上。

大氅兽人吃力地站起，手臂上抬，正要把黑色长虫放到枯树上。

黑色长虫却一路钻向他的鼻孔。

大氅兽人动作迟缓，没能及时抓住黑色长虫。

“不——！”

大氅兽人眼中充满了恐惧和不甘，那也是他最后的意识。

时间倒回到两个小时前，地下城西区某处。

这里到处充满了痛苦的呻-吟和嘶嚎，还有哭声。

成年兽人能忍住不哭，孩童可忍不住。

一群装备精良的士兵守在这里。

这里集中了地面上被送下来的受伤者。

还有受伤者被源源不断送过来。

有人告诉他们，城主会想办法救治他们。

他们抱着希望来到这里，等待救助。

受伤者的家人朋友也想一起陪伴，但被引导者婉言劝回，表示救治区地方有限，容纳不了太多人，如果同意一个陪伴者进入就得同意无数个，只能全部禁止。

引导者又说治疗者和药剂师们也不喜欢噪杂的环境，伤者也需要一个更安静、更卫生的治疗环境。

最终受伤者的家人朋友被说服了。没被说服的要么带着伤者一起离开，要么就被以全城紧急戒严时制造骚乱的名义被抓了起来。

引导者信誓旦旦地保证，所有受伤者都会得到最好的照顾。

有人相信，也有人不相信。

不相信的人总觉得大贵族们不可能这么照顾平民，以前黑森林城也不是没有发生过灾难，但无论是受伤还是死亡，或者家产受到损伤，都是城民自负。

城中官员和城主别说帮助在灾难中受到巨大损伤的城民，他们甚至会借此趁机谋夺城民的土地、店铺、财产，甚至是人。

城民们人微权轻，遭到迫害也无处伸冤，最后绝大多数都会选择忍气吞声，不肯忍气吞声的人则九成被消失。

“城主有令，把第一批人送入一号治疗区。”一名士兵前来传令。

看守这里的千夫长点头，他早已做好准备。

他们这里是等候区，治疗区不在这里，还在更下一层。

原本负责保护黑森林城的士兵们已经超过一半转入地下城。

这些士兵都各有任务。

现在有几队士兵专门负责把那些伤者转送到指定地点。

伤者们很不安，询问士兵，被告知他们将被转到治疗区，又略略安心。

士兵们抬着担架，走下阶梯。

这是一座倒立的塔状建筑，地上只有一层，地下却有四层。

原本这里是黑森林城的粮食仓储区，现在却被拾掇出来当做治疗区。

把伤者送入地下一号治疗区的士兵在偌大的治疗区没有看到任何一名治疗者或是药剂师，心里奇怪，但做士兵的人习惯了听从命令，就算心中有疑惑，也不会马上问出来。

转眼，九百九十九名受伤兽人就被送入一号治疗区。

看守大门的士兵关上大门。

这九百九十九名伤者有老有少，有男有女。他们就那么被放在冰冷的地面上，周围甚至都没有多少亮光，只有墙壁上挂着几个刚才士兵们才放上去照明用的油肚虫灯。

“这是怎么回事？”有受伤较轻的人撑起身体：“不是说要治疗吗？治疗师呢？药剂师呢？为什么就把我们丢在这儿了？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 106: A Step Ahead

All nine candles completely extinguished!

Marquis Dalton was nowhere to be seen.

By the time the seventh candle went out, he had already left the temple.

The cloaked orc no longer cared to ask where Marquis Dalton had gone; his rage had transformed into a profound sense of intense unease.

When the final candle flickered out, he stood frozen, his mind blank.

Conversely, that white-haired orc climbed up from the tree roots, waving his hands wildly as he danced a bizarre dance around the withered, dead tree, uttering strange, eerie cries.

The cloaked orc stared at the white-haired orc as though he wanted to slaughter him.

Yet, in the end, he merely gazed in silence at the nine puddles of melted wax upon the tree.

The candles had gone out, but the wax had already penetrated deep into the trunk.

Eumuklaso could never be defeated!

The cloaked orc raised his arm, the nails of his right hand lengthening as he slashed open his left wrist, pouring his fresh blood evenly over every single puddle of black wax.

Even though excessive blood loss turned his face deathly pale, he did not stop.

Until his body visibly shriveled up to the naked eye.

A robust orc had transformed into a mummified corpse in the blink of an eye.

The cloaked orc was not dead; his eyeballs were still rolling, and he even licked his slashed wrist.

Though no fresh blood could drip from his wrist anymore, he was still able to move.

The white-haired orc looked at him with terror in his eyes: "You... living corpse."

A disdainful smile cracked across the cloaked orc's withered visage: "You understand nothing. This is not being a living corpse; this is the blessing of Eumuklaso. Believers blessed by Eumuklaso can survive even in the most extreme environments. We have no need to rely on nature!"

Swish—!

From the puddle of wax on a branch closest to the white-haired orc, a long black worm shot out at lightning speed.

The black worm swiftly burrowed into the white-haired orc's nostril.

The white-haired orc violently clutched his nose, trying to yank the black worm out.

But it was useless!

The black worm burrowed straight into his brain.

The white-haired orc's body collapsed.

The cloaked orc lowered his head to look at the convulsing, fallen orc.

This fool had thought he wielded great influence in front of Marquis Dalton, believing his status far surpassed that of an outsider like himself, completely unaware that the moment he partook in this plan, he had already been defined by Marquis Dalton as one of the sacrificial offerings.

A priest of the God of Nature of the Orc Continent, yet reduced to a sacrifice for the otherworldly god Eumuklaso—there could be no greater irony than this.

"Your god has already vanished. The era of the ancient gods has ended; new gods are the future of the orc world!"

The white-haired orc rolled his eyes back, his teeth clicking together, yet he had not entirely lost consciousness. He even managed to squeeze out a few words: "My god... shall endure eternally..."

Everyone believed the God of Nature had fallen, and so did he, a mere priest.

Yet today, watching the candles symbolizing Eumuklaso—parasitizing the withered tree—go out one by one, a glimmer of faith unexpectedly rekindled within him.

Perhaps the God of Nature had not perished; perhaps She had merely gone into hiding, accumulating strength.

After nature was devastated, recovery would inevitably take time.

And they, the orcs who had bathed in the grace of nature, ought to have been its guardians, assistants helping nature fend off all forms of harm.

Instead, what they had actually done was merely wait, make demands, and blindly plead for the God of Nature's bestowals and blessings. They thought they had given something in return, but what they gave was entirely wrong.

They had been wrong all along...

It was hateful that he only realized this at the very end of his life.

Fortunately, having understood this now, his convictions grew firm once more, and his soul became unbreakable.

I can no longer protect my god, but at the very least, I will not let the evil god make use of this body forged by nature!

Sands...

The white-haired orc's body actually began to turn into grains of sand, bit by bit.

What the hell?! The cloaked orc was struck by one blow after another; he never expected that the priest of the God of Nature, whom he had always looked down upon, could cause his own body to undergo sandification!

Clearly, the shadow-walker had already burrowed into his brain and should have taken control of him instantly.

A black worm wriggled its way out from amidst the sand grains.

It looked far weaker, its movements sluggish.

The cloaked orc slowly dropped to his knees, attempting to lure the black worm back into the withered tree.

Following his lowered palm, the black worm slowly crawled up his arm.

The cloaked orc struggled to stand up, raising his arm, intending to place the black worm back onto the tree.

Instead, the black worm drilled all the way toward his nostril.

With his sluggish reactions, the cloaked orc failed to grab the black worm in time.

"No—!"

Terror and unwillingness filled the cloaked orc's eyes—that was also his final shred of consciousness.

Time flowed back two hours, somewhere in the Western District of the underground city.

Here, the air was filled everywhere with painful groans, shrieks, and weeping.

Adult orcs could endure without crying, but children could not.

A group of heavily armed soldiers stood guard.

The wounded brought up from the surface were concentrated here.

More wounded individuals were being continuously brought in.

People told them that the City Lord would find a way to treat them.

Clinging to hope, they had come here, waiting for rescue.

The families and friends of the wounded wanted to stay by their sides, but were tactfully persuaded to return by the guides, who explained that space in the treatment zone was limited and could not accommodate so many people. If they allowed one companion to enter, they would have to allow countless others, so companions were strictly forbidden across the board.

Furthermore, the guides stated that healers and apothecaries disliked noisy environments, and the patients themselves required a quieter, more hygienic setting for their recovery.

Ultimately, the families and friends of the wounded were persuaded. Those who remained unconvinced either left with the injured or were arrested under the charge of creating a disturbance during a city-wide state of emergency.

The guides swore up and down that every single wounded person would receive the best care possible.

Some believed them; others did not.

The skeptics simply felt it impossible for high-ranking nobles to care so much about commoners. Disasters had occurred in Black Forest City before, but whether it was injury, death, or property damage, the citizens had always had to bear the consequences themselves.

Far from helping citizens who suffered massive losses in disasters, officials and the city lord would instead seize the opportunity to prey upon the citizens' lands, shops, properties, and even their very lives.

Lacking power and influence, the citizens had nowhere to voice their grievances when persecuted, and in the end, the vast majority chose to swallow their bitterness in silence. Of those who refused, nine out of ten simply vanished.

"Orders from the City Lord: send the first batch of people into Treatment Zone Number One," a soldier arrived to relay the command.

The centurion on guard nodded; he had already made preparations.

This was merely the waiting area; the treatment zone was not here, but another level down.

Over half of the soldiers originally responsible for guarding Black Forest City had already been transferred into the underground city.

Each of these soldiers had been assigned specific duties.

Right now, several squads of soldiers were exclusively tasked with transferring those wounded individuals to designated locations.

Feeling deeply uneasy, the wounded questioned the soldiers, only to be told they were being transferred to the treatment zone, which slightly eased their minds.

Bearing stretchers on their shoulders, the soldiers descended the stairwell.

This was an inverted tower-like structure—only one level above ground, but four levels underground.

Originally, this place had been Black Forest City's grain storage area, but it had now been cleared out and outfitted to serve as a treatment zone.

The soldiers who escorted the wounded into Underground Treatment Zone One saw not a single healer or apothecary in the cavernous treatment zone. Feeling it strange, they were accustomed to obeying orders; even with doubts in their hearts, they did not voice them immediately.

In the blink of an eye, nine hundred and ninety-nine injured orcs were ushered into Treatment Zone One.

The soldiers guarding the doors pulled them shut.

These nine hundred and ninety-nine wounded consisted of the old and the young, men and women. They were simply laid out upon the cold ground, with barely any illumination around them save for a few oil-bellyworm lamps that the soldiers had just hung upon the walls for lighting.

"What is the meaning of this?" A man with lighter injuries propped himself up. "Weren't we told we were going to be treated? Where are the healers? Where are the apothecaries? Why have we just been dumped in here?"

chunks.chineseText:
“是不是还在准备？要再等一等？”其他受伤兽人也惴惴不安地说。

“不对劲。这根本不像是要治疗我们，更像是……”

“别说！不会的，城主不可能做出这种事。”

“你们不觉得从腐蚀雨到城中那些传信士兵的行动，把人转到地下城，再把伤者集中起来的行为，都透着古怪吗？”

“我也觉得，处理速度太快了，就好像城主早就知道腐蚀雨会降临一样。”

“你们别乱说了！你们不想活，我还想活。”

“有人吗？这边有人昏迷了，救命！”

“不对，我不要留在这里，我要离开！”

有兽人挣扎着想要爬起来，离开这个看着就阴森恐怖的地下空间。

沙沙。

“什么东西？！你们有没有听到什么动静？”

“听到什么？别疑神疑鬼了。”

“嗷呜！那是什么？！”

“蛇？”

“不对，是虫子！”

“怎么会有这么多虫子？”

“快逃！这些虫子会吃人！”

凡是能爬起来的兽人都爬起来了，他们想要逃出这个地下治疗区。

但大门被锁上，不论他们怎么砸门，都无法把大门打开。

“救命！放我们出去！”

“救命啊！虫子吃人了！”

“城主在骗我们！我们受骗了！”

“放我们出去！”

“不，我不想死，救救我，爸爸，妈妈，救救我！”

受伤的兽人们怒吼着，求救着，哭喊着……

越来越多的虫子不知从哪里爬出来，它们几乎要淹没这些受伤兽人。

兽人们也不是没有反击，他们用手打、用爪子抓、用脚踩、用自己的天赋或职业技能对抗，但都没有用。

这些灰色的虫子就像是没有实体一样，怎么打都打不死。

“哇哦，我说怎么会忽然感知到大量虫毒。不对，这不是虫毒，这好像是……虫母的力量？”

曾经吸收融合了九分之一虫母心脏的商非凡从墙壁里冒出来。

他的一只手还牵着不帅。

不帅施展穿墙术带两人直接进入了这个入口处看守极为严格的地下塔楼。

看到这么多灰色虫子，不帅立刻举起骨杖，施展瞬发魔法，火球术。

兽人太多，他无法施展大型法术。

只能先烧死一部分虫子。

然后再看如何解救那些被虫子爬满身的兽人。

但火焰落在灰色虫子身上，那些虫子像是毫无反应。

不帅脸色微变：“虫族诅咒？这些虫子不是真正的虫子。”

“你没办法解决这些虫子？”商非凡侧头。

不帅连续施展几个对付虫子的魔法，全都失败。

“这种虫子似乎对魔法免疫。”不帅头疼。

“在法德尔大陆，如果碰到对魔法免疫的敌人要怎么解决？”商非凡问。

不帅沉默一秒：“用物理手段？但这些虫子似乎用物理手段也没用。”

商非凡突然手指两人脚下：“看到没有，这些虫子都在绕着我们走。”

不帅低头：“咦？”

商非凡看向已经快要积成雪堆的灰色虫子，眼中有强烈的渴望光芒：“我想也许我能解决它们。”

商非凡忽然刺破自己的指尖，挤出几滴鲜血。

鲜血中蕴含着浓郁的虫母力量。

原本已经把受伤兽人覆盖得严严实实并拼命往兽人身体里钻的灰色虫子们突然集体一个停顿，随后它们就像是收到某个强烈信号和号召一样，潮水一般从受伤兽人身上退下，疯狂涌向那几滴鲜血。

和摩罗城相似的情景发生了。

跑得最快的几只灰色虫子抢到了鲜血，吸食一净后，还没来得及消化及变化，它们就被其他虫子给扑上来分尸吞吃。

吃了第一批胜利者的第二批虫子又被第三批虫子给撕碎吃掉。

如此循环往复。

不到五分钟，商非凡和不帅身边就出现了一只比成年金毛犬还大的灰色大虫子。

这只虫子是最后的胜利者，它周围再也没有其他虫子和它抢食。

吞噬大量能量的它，也不管面前是否还有其他生物，就开始进行生命的进化和升级。

不帅连续对这只大虫子施展魔法，可仍旧没有任何效果。

他也用物理武器攻击这只虫子了，但就像打空气一样，连点打击手感都没有。

“不能让它进化！它在变得越来越强！”不帅的神经疯狂跳动。

“好的。”商非凡抬起左手。

他的左手手掌心裂开了一条口子，里面似乎有什么东西。

商非凡直接将自己的左手盖在了那只变异中的大虫子的头顶。

“咔嚓，咔嚓。”

几声宛如咀嚼脆骨的声音响起。

那只虫子篮球大的脑袋竟然被商非凡的左手裂口给吞了进去。

不不不，是左手裂口中有什么东西嚼碎了那虫子的脑袋，一点点却极为快速地把整只灰色虫子都给吃掉！

“唔。”商非凡按揉胃部，真的好撑啊。不仅是胃部撑，是全身都撑得慌。

不帅眼睛圆睁看着他，就像是在看新品种的哥斯拉。

商非凡亮出左手给不帅看：“别怕，就是我的虫族研究者职业在上次升级后自动出现一个新技能，虫族粉碎。”

不帅：只是粉碎吗？你明明都吃撑了！

商非凡一指那些受伤兽人：“这么多人，要怎么办？”

这看着有上千人数，如果全都放到雕像广场带出去，他怕自己的精神力吃不住。

脱离灰色虫子威胁的兽人们情况很糟糕，他们看起来都像是瘦了一大圈。

但好在还没有人死亡，虽然有不少人昏迷。

不帅没有听到亡者的哀嚎。

还有兽人仍旧被灰色虫子的幻象困扰，不断尖叫，直到旁边有人制止他。

不帅目光环视受伤兽人。

两人没有隐身，这些兽人全都看到了他们。

不过他们的脸依旧藏在围巾下面。

仍旧能保持清醒的受伤兽人有几个似乎想和他们说话。

不帅用老家话说：“我虽然不是专门的空间魔法师，但我勉强也可以撕开一个空间缝隙，把他们送到其他地方。只是距离无法太远，我也无法保证一定是安全地点。最重要的问题是，他们身上的伤势怎么办？我没办法一次性救治这么多。”

“你能治疗这种腐蚀伤？”商非凡问。

“腐蚀兽人身体的不是毒素，是黑暗能量。”不帅这次说的兽人大陆通用语。

好些兽人都看向他。

商非凡心中明了，这是不帅在告诉他，兽人大陆虽然没有魔力，但它的黑暗能量和法德尔大陆是同一性质。

不帅开始给那些惊魂未定的兽人施展驱逐黑暗能量的驱逐魔法。

如果有人把腐蚀雨当做普通腐蚀性毒素来看，进行普通清洗，再用抗腐蚀的药物治疗，不说会变得更糟糕，只能说毫无效用。

黑森林城这么大，城民中也有很多药剂师和治疗者，可为什么到现在都没有人表示能成功遏制那些腐蚀雨的腐蚀毒素、能救治那些被腐蚀的受伤兽人，就是因为他们没有找到真正的“病因”。
chunks.englishText:
"Are they still preparing? Do we need to wait a bit longer?" other injured beastmen asked anxiously, their voices laced with unease.

"Something's not right. This doesn't look like they're trying to treat us at all. It feels more like..."

"Shut up! No way, the City Lord could never do something like this."

"Don't you guys think everything is reeks of weirdness? From the corrosive rain to the actions of those messenger soldiers in the city, transferring people to the undercity, and then gathering all the wounded in one place?"

"I think so too. The processing speed was way too fast, as if the City Lord knew long in advance that the corrosive rain was coming."

"Stop spouting nonsense! If you don't want to live, I still do."

"Is anyone there? Someone's passed out over here, help!"

"No, I don't want to stay here, I want to leave!"

Some of the beastmen struggled to crawl up, desperate to flee this gloomy and terrifying subterranean space.

Rustle, rustle.

"What is that?! Did any of you hear a sound?"

"Hear what? Stop being so paranoid and spooked."

"Awooo! What was that?!"

"A snake?"

"No, it's bugs!"

"How can there be so many bugs?"

"Run! These bugs eat people!"

Every beastman who could stand or crawl got to their feet, desperately trying to escape this underground treatment area.

However, the main doors were locked tight. No matter how hard they beat and slammed against them, the heavy doors refused to budge.

"Help! Let us out!"

"Help! The bugs are eating people!"

"The City Lord is lying to us! We've been tricked!"

"Let us out!"

"No, I don't want to die! Save me! Daddy, Mommy, save me!"

The injured beastmen roared, cried for help, and wept hysterically...

More and more bugs crawled out from unknown crevices, threatening to completely engulf the injured beastmen.

The beastmen weren't without means of resistance. They struck out with their hands, scratched with their claws, stomped with their feet, and unleashed their innate talents or professional skills to fight back, but all of it was futile.

These gray bugs seemed entirely incorporeal, immune to any form of physical attack, refusing to die no matter how many times they were smashed.

"Well, well. I was wondering why I suddenly sensed a massive surge of insect venom. Wait, this isn't venom... Could this be... the Insect Mother's power?"

Shang Feifan, who had previously absorbed and integrated one-ninth of the Insect Mother's heart, materialized straight out of the wall.

He was still holding hands with Bu Shu.

Using his wall-clpassing ability, Bu Shu had led the two of them straight into this heavily guarded underground tower entrance.

Seeing the sea of gray bugs, Bu Shu immediately raised his bone staff and cast an instantaneous spell—Fireball.

There were simply too many beastmen, preventing him from unleashing large-scale area-of-effect spells.

He could only incinerate a portion of the bugs first.

Then he would figure out how to rescue the beastmen whose bodies were completely covered in crawling bugs.

Yet, when the flames landed on the gray bugs, they reacted as if nothing had touched them at all.

Bu Shu's expression shifted slightly. "An insectoid curse? These aren't real bugs."

"You can't deal with these bugs?" Shang Feifan glanced sideways at him.

Bu Shu consecutively cast several spells designed to counter insectoids, but every single one failed.

"These bugs seem to be completely immune to magic," Bu Shu said, a headache forming.

"In the Fader Continent, how do you deal with enemies that are immune to magic?" Shang Feifan asked.

Bu Shu fell silent for a second. "With physical methods? But these bugs don't seem to care about physical attacks either."

Shang Feifan suddenly pointed down at their feet. "Look at that. All these bugs are walking around us, giving us a wide berth."

Bu Shu looked down. "Eh?"

Shang Feifan gazed at the accumulating drifts of gray bugs, his eyes burning with intense desire. "I think... I might be able to handle them."

With a sudden motion, Shang Feifan pierced his own fingertip, squeezing out a few drops of fresh blood.

The blood was saturated with the rich, potent power of the Insect Mother.

The gray bugs, which had been covering the injured beastmen tightly and frantically burrowing into their flesh, suddenly froze in unison. The next instant, as if responding to a powerful signal and summons, they retreated from the injured beastmen like a receding tide and surged frantically toward those few drops of blood.

A scene strikingly similar to the one in Moluo City unfolded.

The fastest-running gray bugs snatched the fresh blood and drank it dry. Before they even had time to digest or transform, they were pounced upon by other bugs, dismembered, and devoured.

The second batch of bugs, having feasted on the first victors, were in turn torn apart and consumed by the third batch.

And so the cycle repeated.

In less than five minutes, right beside Shang Feifan and Bu Shu, a massive gray bug the size of an adult Golden Retriever materialized.

This bug was the ultimate victor; there were no other bugs left around it to compete for food.

Having swallowed an immense amount of energy, it began the process of life evolution and upgrading, paying no heed to whether there were other living creatures standing right in front of it.

Bu Shu unleashed consecutive magic spells upon the giant bug, yet they still had zero effect.

He also attacked the creature with physical weapons, but it felt like hitting empty air—there wasn't even the slightest impact feedback.

"We can't let it evolve! It's growing stronger by the second!" Bu Shu's nerves twitched frantically.

"Got it." Shang Feifan raised his left hand.

A slit split open across the center of his left palm, and something seemed to be lurking inside.

Shang Feifan directly pressed his left hand down onto the head of the mutating giant bug.

*Crunch, crunch.*

Several crisp sounds, akin to chewing on brittle bones, echoed through the space.

The giant bug's basketball-sized head was actually swallowed whole into the gaping slit of Shang Feifan's left hand!

No, no, no—something inside the palm's slit chewed up the bug's head, devouring the entire gray bug bit by bit with terrifying speed!

"Ugh." Shang Feifan massaged his stomach; he was completely stuffed. Not just his stomach, but his entire body felt bloated and overloaded to the brim.

Bu Shu stared at him with wide eyes, as if looking at a brand-new species of Godzilla.

Shang Feifan flashed his left hand to Bu Shu. "Don't panic. It's just that my Insect Researcher class automatically unlocked a new skill after my last upgrade—'Insectoid Annihilation'."

Bu Shu thought: *Just annihilation? You're literally stuffed to bursting!*

Shang Feifan gestured toward the injured beastmen. "There are so many people here. What do we do with them?"

There had to be over a thousand people here. If he transported them all out to the statue plaza at once, he feared his spiritual power wouldn't hold up.

The condition of the beastmen, now freed from the threat of the gray bugs, was abysmal. They all looked as though they had suddenly lost a tremendous amount of weight, emaciated and frail.

Fortunately, no one had died yet, though quite a few remained unconscious.

Bu Shu didn't hear the mournful wails of the dead.

Some beastmen were still trapped in the illusions cast by the gray bugs, screaming continuously until someone beside them slapped them back to reality.

Bu Shu swept his gaze across the injured beastmen.

The two of them hadn't used invisibility spells, so every single beastman had seen them clearly.

However, their faces remained hidden beneath scarves.

A few of the beastmen who had managed to stay lucid seemed eager to speak with them.

Speaking in their native tongue from home, Bu Shu muttered, "Though I'm not a specialized spatial mage, I can barely manage to rip open a spatial rift and send them somewhere else. But the distance won't be too far, and I can't guarantee the destination will be safe. The biggest problem is: what about the injuries on their bodies? I can't treat this many people all at once."

"Can you cure this kind of corrosive injury?" Shang Feifan asked.

"What's corroding the beastmen's bodies isn't poison; it's dark energy," Bu Shu replied this time in the common language of the Beastman Continent.

Many of the beastmen turned to look at him.

Shang Feifan understood instantly—Bu Shu was signaling to him that although the Beastman Continent lacked magic power, its dark energy shared the exact same nature as that of the Fader Continent.

Bu Shu began casting expulsion spells to purge the dark energy from the traumatized beastmen.

If anyone mistook the corrosive rain for ordinary toxic venom, applied standard washing, and treated it with anti-corrosion medicines, it wouldn't just fail to help—it would make things infinitely worse.

The Black Forest City was vast, and its citizens included numerous apothecaries and healers. Yet, why had no one stepped forward to claim they could successfully curb the corrosive toxins of the rain or heal the wounded beastmen? It was precisely because they had failed to pinpoint the true "root cause."

chunks.chineseText:
“我们可以自救。只要你能清除我们身上那些腐蚀毒素，剩下的就只是伤口，我们可以自己解决。”一名兽人吃力地扶着墙壁站起来说道。

“你是？”商非凡看向那名兽人。

“一名王城战士，我只是回来探亲。”那名体格原本很不错、现在却瘦得皮包骨的兽人说道。

又有一名兽人坐起身，他半身皮都没了，但这家伙还能说话：“我们虽然受伤了，但不代表我们就没有丁点战斗力。只要你们能帮我们打开那扇门，我们可以自己冲出去。”

“外面有很多士兵，你们冲出去也只是送死。”商非凡指出现实。

“至少我们能警告外面那些伤者，能和他们一起抗争，不管最后能逃出几个，总比这么一批批什么都不知道被带进这个见鬼的地方被虫子吃掉好！”

商非凡挑眉，这些兽人和他们在摩罗城遇到的不太一样，他们的性格似乎更彪悍。

不帅下定决心：“我的天赋能力可以让我把你们集体送出去，但只能送到附近某个地点。之后的情况，我们无法保证。”

几个清醒的兽人精神一振：“这样就足够了！”

商非凡拿出了几箱治疗内外伤的药剂，分发给那些已经被清除了黑暗能量的受伤兽人。

“暂时只有这么多，尽量分给每一个人。”商非凡把药剂的管理权交给了最先开口的兽人。

“谢谢！”那名兽人深深地看两人：“我不知道黑森林城出了什么事，这显然是一个大阴谋，而且必定与黑森林城主有关。我们只要能活着走出这里，就一定会把这个消息传给其他人知道。”

“先求活吧。”商非凡转头走向不帅。

不帅只能一次性对十个兽人施展驱逐魔法，他只希望能赶在外面的士兵进来查看情况前，能把这大几百兽人身上的黑暗能量都驱除干净。

“不帅，自然类魔法有驱逐黑暗能量的吗？”

不帅一愣，“还真有，不过效果很一般。驱逐黑暗能量和净化黑暗能量，最强大的是光明类魔法。”

“试试看吧。”商非凡建议。

不帅握紧骨杖，对准面前的一群兽人，低吟：“自然带来黑暗，自然带来光明，古老的神灵掌握着一切，当黑暗笼罩我们，光明也会降临。万物的精灵啊，请遵循自然的规则，把不应该出现的黑暗能量驱逐吧！”

商非凡微微侧身，挡住不帅的骨杖和半张脸，让那些兽人看不到不帅在念咒。

淡淡的柔光在黑暗的地下塔楼中亮起。

一开始这团光亮毫不起眼，它像纱一样，慢慢散开，扩大，直到笼罩住全部受伤兽人。

柔光变得越来越明显，它们融入兽人的身体，又慢慢飘出来。

当柔光飘出兽人身体时，所有人都能清晰看到那柔光中夹杂着一缕又一缕黑丝。

柔光落到地面，带着黑色能量一起，重新融入大地。

不帅惊呆。

这个自然类驱逐魔法威力这么强的吗？

感谢自然之神，祂的馈赠真的是……这哪里像是只加成百分之五十？

不帅只惊讶这个自然魔法的威力，却不知道上千兽人看他的目光跟看圣山大祭司差不多了。

商非凡抱臂：嗯，他家不帅要火了。

又过了大约五六分钟。

大约是隔了好一会儿没有听到地下塔楼内兽人的砸门声和惨叫声，外面看守的士兵终于打开了紧锁的炼金大门。

门内，一片空荡，什么都没有，干干净净。

地下城，城东。

这里已经是地下城的边沿区域。

这里没有建筑物，只有一大片光秃秃的土地。

在土地最中间，有一口深水井。

这样的深水井在地下城一共有七十二个，至今仍有一半以上能打出水，而且水质清澈甘甜。

但从地下城保留的完整供水系统来看，这座地下城以往并不靠深水井供水，而是另有供水渠道。

丹顿侯爵的曾祖父曾经派人查明，地下城的主供水源就是黑水河。

但不知为何，在他们发现地下城时，整个供水系统都被废弃，黑水河的水流再也流不进地下城。

好在还有很多深水井能用，当时的兽人们也害怕外面的水源有毒，就没有特意去疏通供水系统，一直使用着深水井的水。

其中-出水量最大也最平稳的一口井，就是丹顿侯爵面前的这一口。

传信侍卫小跑到丹顿侯爵面前，低声说：“那边说第一批已经消失，消失得非常干净。”

丹顿侯爵轻轻点头，走到深水井边，手撑着井沿，低头看向水井深处。

水井深处黝黑一团，什么都看不清楚。

但丹顿侯爵的眼眸发出幽绿色的光芒，他能清楚看到水井深处平静的水面。

他耐心地等待着。

一分钟，两分钟……

眼看十分钟过去，水井深处仍旧没有丝毫变化，丹顿侯爵直起身体。

他能接受失败。

他已经不是第一次失败。

这次失败，下次再尝试就是。

虽然付出的代价很大，但做任何伟大的事情，又有哪一件不需要付出沉重代价？

“咕嘟”。

就在丹顿侯爵转身之际，水井深处忽然响起咕嘟声。

丹顿侯爵站住脚步，深吸气，转身，再次俯身看向水井深处。

侍卫们担心他，想要让他退到安全距离。

丹顿侯爵抬起手，表示他没事，也不会后退。

他就那么看着水井深处。

“咕嘟，咕嘟。”

井水冒泡的声音越来越大。

“咕嘟咕嘟，咕嘟咕嘟。”

很快，井水反应激烈得就像是烧开了一样。

这跟他想象的反应有点不一样。丹顿侯爵眼中浮现疑惑之色，向后方招手。

立刻有仆人送上一只活鸡。

活鸡上拴着绳子。

丹顿侯爵指向水井。

仆人立刻把那只咕咕叫个不停的活鸡丢入水井中。

大约三分钟后，仆人拉起绳索。

活鸡被提上来。

但现在活鸡已经变成死鸡。

仆人抓了一把鸡毛，立刻扯下大把。

“温度很高，跟开水一样。”仆人小声说。

士兵上前，这次一名兽人主动被绑上绳索。

丹顿侯爵开口：“仔细看清楚，上来后告诉我你都看到了什么。”

“是！”那名兽人深吸气，自己爬到井沿上，对拽着绳索的士兵一点头，双手撑着井沿，双腿朝下，手一松，滑了下去。

噗通。

水井中传来重物落水的声音。

不久，绳索飞快抖动。

守在井口的两名士兵立刻用力拉拽绳索。

不一会儿，一个浑身湿淋淋、皮肤通红、身上冒烟的兽人被拉上来。

“你看到了什么？”丹顿侯爵不等这名兽人喘过气就问到。

兽人不敢怠慢，立刻回答：“我看到下面有红色的裂口，裂口里面流淌出来的是岩浆。”

丹顿侯爵自始至终都表现的极为冷静，但在听到这句话后，他情不自禁地闭上眼睛，握紧右手。

情况变得更糟糕了！

那些邪神信徒在说谎！

献祭生命也没有用。

厄穆克拉索并没有展现祂的神奇。
chunks.englishText:
"We can save ourselves. As long as you can clear the corrosive toxins from our bodies, the rest are just wounds. We can handle those ourselves," an injured beastman said, leaning heavily against the wall as he struggled to stand.

"Who are you?" Shang Feifan looked at him.

"A Royal City warrior. I just came back to visit family," replied the beastman, whose once-impressive physique was now reduced to skin and bones.

Another beastman propped himself up into a sitting position. Half the skin on his torso was completely gone, yet the fellow could still speak. "Even though we're injured, it doesn't mean we don't have an ounce of fight left in us. As long as you can help us open that door, we can charge out ourselves."

"There are plenty of soldiers outside. Charging out is just throwing your lives away," Shang Feifan pointed out the harsh reality.

"At least we can warn the other wounded people outside, and fight alongside them! No matter how many of us manage to escape in the end, it's still a thousand times better than being dragged into this hellish place in batches like cattle and eaten alive by bugs!"

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. These beastmen were somewhat different from the ones they had encountered in Moluo City; their personalities appeared much more fierce and indomitable.

Bu Shu made up his mind. "My innate ability allows me to transport all of you out collectively, but I can only send you to a nearby location. As for what happens after that, we can't guarantee anything."

The lucid beastmen felt a surge of renewed spirit. "That's more than enough!"

Shang Feifan produced several boxes of potions designed for treating internal and external injuries, distributing them to the wounded beastmen whose bodies had already been cleansed of dark energy.

"We only have this many for now. Try to divide them up so everyone gets a share." Shang Feifan handed the management of the potions over to the beastman who had spoken first.

"Thank you!" That beastman gave the two of them a profound, lingering look. "I don't know what happened in Black Forest City, but this is clearly a massive conspiracy, and it's bound to involve the City Lord. As long as we can walk out of here alive, we will make sure to spread this news to everyone."

"Focus on surviving first." Shang Feifan turned and walked back toward Bu Shu.

Bu Shu could only cast the expulsion spell on ten beastmen at a time. He desperately hoped he could purge the dark energy from all several hundred beastmen before the guards outside came in to investigate.

"Bu Shu, do nature-type spells have the ability to expel dark energy?"

Bu Shu was startled for a moment. "As a matter of fact, they do, but the effect is quite mediocre. When it comes to expelling and purifying dark energy, light-type magic is the absolute strongest."

"Let's give it a try," Shang Feifan suggested.

Bu Shu gripped his bone staff tightly, aimed it at the group of beastmen before him, and began to chant softly:

"Nature brings the dark, nature brings the light; ancient deities hold sway over all. When darkness enshrouds us, the light shall likewise descend. Oh spirits of all living things, heed the laws of nature and banish the dark energy that ought not to be here!"

Shang Feifan turned slightly, shielding Bu Shu's bone staff and half his face so the beastmen couldn't see him casting the incantation.

A faint, gentle radiance lit up within the dark subterranean tower.

At first, this ball of light was utterly inconspicuous. It drifted outward like a gossamer veil, gradually dispersing and expanding until it enveloped every single injured beastman.

The soft glow grew increasingly pronounced, blending into the beastmen's bodies before slowly drifting back out.

When the radiance drifted out from their bodies, everyone could clearly see wisps upon wisps of black silk trapped within the gentle light.

The soft light fell upon the ground, carrying the dark energy down with it to merge back into the earth once more.

Bu Shu was dumbfounded.

Was this nature-type expulsion spell really this powerful?

*Thank the Nature God, Her gift is truly... how on earth is this only a fifty percent bonus?*

While Bu Shu was marveling at the sheer potency of the nature magic, he remained oblivious to the fact that over a thousand beastmen were now looking at him as if he were the High Priest of the Sacred Mountain.

Shang Feifan crossed his arms: *Well, his Bu Shu was about to become famous.*

Another five or six minutes passed.

Perhaps having gone quite a while without hearing the beastmen's frantic door-banging and desperate screams from inside the subterranean tower, the guards stationed outside finally unlocked the heavy alchemical gates.

Inside the chamber, it was utterly empty. There was nothing left—it was completely spotless.

***

Undercity, Eastern District.

This was already the fringe area of the undercity.

There were no buildings here, only a vast expanse of barren, desolate land.

Right in the center of the land stood a deep water well.

There were seventy-two such deep wells scattered across the undercity, and to this day, more than half of them still yielded water—clean, crisp, and sweet.

However, judging by the intact water supply system preserved within the undercity, the place hadn't historically relied on deep wells for its primary water; there had been an alternative supply channel.

The great-grandfather of Marquis Danton had once dispatched men to investigate, discovering that the undercity's main water source was the Black Water River.

For reasons unknown, however, by the time they discovered the undercity, the entire water supply system had been abandoned, and the waters of the Black Water River could no longer flow into the city.

Fortunately, since numerous deep wells remained usable, and the beastmen of that era feared the external water sources might be poisoned, they hadn't bothered to dredge the old supply system, continuing to rely entirely on the deep wells.

Among them, the well with the largest and steadiest water output was the very one standing before Marquis Danton.

A messenger guard trotted up to Marquis Danton and whispered, "They reported that the first batch has vanished. Completely and utterly gone."

Marquis Danton nodded softly, walked over to the edge of the deep well, pressed his hands against the stone rim, and peered down into the abyss.

The depths of the well were pitch-black, rendering everything invisible.

However, a faint, ghostly green light flickered within Marquis Danton's eyes, allowing him to clearly discern the calm surface of the water deep below.

He waited patiently.

One minute, two minutes...

As ten full minutes ticked by without the slightest ripple or change in the depths of the well, Marquis Danton straightened his posture.

He could accept failure.

This wasn't his first time failing.

If it failed this time, he would simply try again next time.

Though the price paid was heavy, what great endeavor in this world was ever accomplished without heavy sacrifice?

*Glug.*

Just as Marquis Danton turned to leave, a sudden gurgling sound echoed from the depths of the well.

Marquis Danton halted his steps, drew a deep breath, spun around, and leaned over the well once more.

Concerned for his safety, the guards wanted him to retreat to a safe distance.

Marquis Danton raised a hand, signaling that he was fine and refused to step back.

He simply stared down into the murky depths.

*Glug, glug.*

The bubbling sound of the well water grew increasingly intense.

*Glug-glug, glug-glug.*

Before long, the water in the well reacted as violently as if it were boiling.

This reaction was somewhat different from what he had imagined. A look of confusion flickered in Marquis Danton's eyes as he gestured backward.

A servant immediately stepped forward, presenting a live chicken tied to a rope.

Marquis Danton pointed toward the well.

Without hesitation, the servant dropped the constantly clucking live chicken into the deep well.

Roughly three minutes later, the servant pulled on the rope.

The chicken was hauled back up.

Only now, the live chicken had become a dead chicken.

The servant grabbed a handful of feathers and easily plucked out a massive clump.

"The temperature is extremely high, just like boiling water," the servant muttered under his breath.

A soldier stepped forward. This time, an actual beastman volunteered to be bound by the rope.

Marquis Danton spoke up: "Watch carefully, and tell me everything you see once you come back up."

"Understood!" The beastman took a deep breath, climbed up onto the well rim, nodded at the soldier holding the rope, placed his hands on the edge, lowered his legs, let go, and slid down.

*Plop.*

A heavy splash echoed from deep within the well.

Shortly afterward, the rope began to jerk and vibrate violently.

The two soldiers stationed by the wellhead immediately hauled back on the rope with all their might.

Moments later, a soaked, skin-reddened beastman emitting wisps of steam was hoisted to the surface.

"What did you see?" Marquis Danton demanded, not even giving the beastman a chance to catch his breath.

Not daring to delay, the beastman blurted out, "I saw red rifts down there, and magma was flowing out from inside them!"

chunks.chineseText:
“爵爷？”一名穿着雅致、像是智者的兽人走到丹顿侯爵身边。

丹顿侯爵过了一会儿才开口：“你说我该继续下去吗？”

那名智者兽人没有点头也没有摇头，只平静地说：“如果不继续，结果……就在那里。”

丹顿侯爵明白了自己第一智囊的意思，“我并不怀疑厄穆克拉索的力量。毕竟我们已经看到祂施展了太多威能。但祂也许并不想帮助我们。”

智者兽人：“也许是有人捣乱，在破坏我们的计划。”

丹顿侯爵沉思，片刻后：“传我命令，尽全力寻找捣乱的兽人。先去查那个自然之神的祭司，看他之前都接触过什么人。”

智者兽人微微弯腰：“谨遵您的命令。”

就在这时，那名传信侍卫再次飞快跑过来，还没跑到跟前，就提高声音喊道：“城主，急讯！”
chunks.englishText:
"My Lord?" A sophisticated beastman dressed like a scholar walked up to Marquis Danton's side.

It took Marquis Danton a moment before he finally spoke. "Tell me, should I keep going?"

The scholarly beastman neither nodded nor shook his head, replying only with calm detachment, "If we stop here, the outcome... lies right there."

Marquis Danton understood the meaning behind his chief strategist's words. "I don't doubt the power of Eumuklaso. After all, we have already witnessed Him display too many mighty miracles. But perhaps He simply has no desire to help us."

The scholarly beastman mused, "Perhaps someone is interfering, actively sabotaging our plans."

Marquis Danton fell into deep contemplation. A moment later, he ordered, "Send out my command: spare no effort in hunting down the troublemaker. Start by investigating that priest of the Nature God; find out everyone he has been in contact with recently."

The strategist gave a slight bow. "Your will be done, My Lord."

At that very moment, the messenger guard came sprinting over at high speed. Before he even reached them, he raised his voice and shouted, "City Lord, urgent news!"

chunks.chineseText:
第107章 地下城变故

“地下城北边收容区刚刚传来消息，说他们遇到一群伤者，那些受伤者看到人就狂喊，说他们被城主您差点献祭给邪神，说这场腐蚀雨是城主您的阴谋！”

咔！丹顿侯爵抓碎了井沿一块石砖。

“传令下去！抓住那些兽人，无论用什么手段，我要知道他们是怎么从地下塔楼里逃出来，又是谁帮助了他们。”

“是。”立刻就有其他士兵去传令。

丹顿侯爵转身，看到传信侍卫没走，冷声问：“还有什么？”

传信侍卫暗中吞咽口水，鼓足勇气：“巴特将军刚刚紧急传信，黑水河……断流了。”

丹顿侯爵色变。

对于黑水河断流的事，丹顿侯爵无可奈何，他现在更把所有火气都集中在了捣乱者身上，认为就是他们破坏了他的计划。

丹顿侯爵不再盯着这边的深水井，只让负责看守的人随时注意水井变化，随时报给他知晓。

就在这片曾经是田地，如今只是光秃秃的干涸土地的外面，有一条土道。

土道上有一个看起来很破旧的车牌。

但丹顿侯爵却等候在这里，并朝地上扔了三枚很古旧的硬币。

一辆冒着黑烟的老车子吭哧吭哧出现在车站前。

车门嘎吱打开，只打开了一半。

丹顿侯爵却无所谓地亲自上前用力拉开车门，走上车。

他的两名贴身侍卫也迅速跟上。

车上座位还是很老旧的木椅，并且只有靠窗的一排。

车头部位并没有驾驶员，但在三人找位置坐好后，车辆却自动关闭车门，并发出启动的吭哧声。

车子慢慢滑行，逐渐加快，穿过地下城的大街小巷，一路不停地驰向神殿站。

当车辆到达神殿站后，丹顿侯爵起身，走到车头部位，直接打开挂在扶手上的木箱，从里面取出三枚古老硬币，下车。

他的两名侍卫跟着下车。

再转身，老车子已经消失。

神殿门口有重兵看守。

丹顿侯爵踏上台阶，旁边有人对他单膝跪下。

“看到了？”

“是。有一辆造型古怪的车辆经过第一重神殿，略作停留，但乘车人并没有下车，车辆消失。很可能去了第二重神殿。”

“没有赶上车？”

“跟以前一样，我们只能看到，却无法实际碰触到。”

丹顿侯爵点点头。从安吉南路站驶向神殿的车辆，必然会在第一重神殿门口略作停留，但他们只能看到，却无法碰到。

这让他们知道这辆车很可能会带着乘车人进入第二重乃至第三重神殿，却也只能眼睁睁看着。

商非凡想要让两虎相争的计划失败了。

鹰之翼压根就没有在第一重神殿下车，他知道丹顿侯爵在第一重神殿，自然不会傻到就这么撞上去。

看到丹顿侯爵前来，守门士兵无声地打开大门。

丹顿侯爵大步走进神殿大门，就看到一个身材干瘪宛如干尸的怪物站在他眼前。

对方身上披着让他眼熟的毛皮大氅。

“盖伦神甫？”

“是我。”盖伦神甫声音阴沉，他现在不用特意扮演，整体也是阴森诡异的。

“你怎么……”丹顿侯爵抬头看向神殿后方那株枯死的大树，他的目力足以让他看到那上面点燃的一点烛火，但现在他什么都没有看到。

“蜡烛全灭了？”丹顿侯爵神情平静。

盖伦神甫：“是。”

“你们的下一步计划是什么？”丹顿侯爵没有说任何批评的话，仍旧保持平静地询问。

盖伦神甫冷笑：“你还真是沉着。你已经在失败的边沿，竟然还能……”

“不是我在失败的边沿，是你们。”丹顿侯爵抚摸手上戴着的精美半指手套，“你们说厄穆克拉索的力量无人也无神可以阻挡，实际上你们已经失去九具拥有厄穆克拉索力量的雕像。我已经做到我承诺的，可你们失败了。”

盖伦神甫干瘪的眼皮无法跳动，但他的眼珠还在，还能射出凶狠的光芒：“我们不会失败，厄穆克拉索永远都不会失败！你们……根本不知道吾神的威能。等着吧，破坏者必将付出代价！”

“我不管厄穆克拉索如何教训破坏者，我只想知道这进行一半的闹剧是否还能进行下去。”

“闹剧？”盖伦神甫不禁也佩服这位城主的心狠手辣，一场腐蚀雨不知毁坏了多少财产，更不知杀死杀伤了多少城民，结果在这位城主嘴中竟然只是一场闹剧。

“你们按照约定献祭了吗？”盖伦神甫问。

丹顿侯爵一顿：“我们献祭了第一批九百九十九人，但刚有消息说，这些人有一部分出现在了地下城其他地方。”

盖伦神甫脱口而出：“这不可能！”

丹顿侯爵：“我也很奇怪。毕竟你说了只要把人关入那座地下塔楼，他们就无法再跑出来。”

盖伦神甫恨声：“肯定和夺取雕像的捣乱者有关系！你有查出那些捣乱者的来历吗？”

丹顿侯爵并不在乎对方那不客气的口吻，他压根就没把对方当做一个真正的人看待：“人都没有抓到，要怎么查出他们的来历。我很好奇，厄穆克拉索难道没有给你们任何指示？”

“吾神当然会给予我们指示！我现在正要去处理这件事。”盖伦神甫说着就朝大门走。

丹顿侯爵看向盖伦神甫的背影，他好像看到一团蛇形黑影附着在这名邪神信徒的后背，形成蛇咬尾的形状。

正要看个仔细，盖伦神甫忽然转头，干瘪僵硬的嘴角慢慢上扯，扯出一个怪异的微笑。

丹顿侯爵心跳加速，他再次感觉到了强烈的不祥。

离开这座地下城！

这一刻，他的大脑他的直觉都在跟他疯狂叫喊。

但丹顿侯爵只是沉默地看着盖伦神甫拉开神殿大门走了出去。

这名邪神信徒并不需要任何媒介就能自由来去神殿。虽然他也只能进出第一重神殿。

丹顿侯爵目光再次看向那株枯死的大树，低喃：“难道自然之神的力量还在保护这座地下城？”

突然，丹顿侯爵目光凝住。

那名从圣山祭司宫派来驻守神殿的祭司呢？

虽然这位祭司自从来到这里后就再也没有回去圣山祭司宫，甚至有传言说，这些被派出来驻守“古老遗迹”的祭司大多都是犯了错，被祭司宫流放出来的罪人，让他们看守没有人气的古老遗迹其实就是变相地让他们坐牢。

但那人到底也是祭司宫的一员。

就连虎王都不会轻易得罪圣山上的那群怪物，他就更不用说。没到必要，他并不想和那群怪物对上。

而且这名祭司是他好不容易策反过来，对方的能力多少也帮了他一些忙，否则那九支蜡烛也不会那么容易扎根在作为自然之神象征的枯树上。

最重要的是对方也认可他的计划，并答应如果事情泄露，会为他跟虎王以及圣山那边解释。

丹顿侯爵快步走到枯树前，目光搜索一圈后，落到树根边一堆沙粒前。

他伸手按住树身，低语：“是您吗？您没有真正消失，对吗？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 107: Upheaval in the Underground City

"Word just came from the northern containment zone of the Underground City that they encountered a group of wounded individuals. Those injured people are screaming wildly at everyone they see, claiming that the Lord City Lord was about to sacrifice them to an evil god, and that this corrosive rain is the City Lord's conspiracy!"

*Crack!* Marquess Danton crushed a stone brick on the wellhead.

"Pass down the order! Capture those beastmen! By any means necessary, I want to know how they escaped from the underground tower, and who helped them."

"Understood." Immediately, other soldiers hurried off to relay the command.

Marquess Danton turned around, and seeing that the messenger guard hadn't left yet, he asked coldly, "What else?"

The messenger guard swallowed hard in secret, mustered his courage, and said, "General Bart just sent an urgent dispatch... The Blackwater River has stopped flowing."

Marquess Danton’s expression changed drastically.

Regarding the stoppage of the Blackwater River, Marquess Danton was powerless to do anything about it. Right now, he had focused all his fury on the troublemakers, believing that they were the ones who had ruined his plans.

Marquess Danton stopped staring at the deep well here, only instructing the guards responsible to keep a close eye on any changes in the water well and report to him at a moment's notice.

Just outside this area, which was once farmland but was now merely barren, parched earth, lay a dirt road.

There was a rather dilapidated bus stop sign standing on the dirt road.

Yet Marquess Danton waited right here, tossing three very ancient coins onto the ground.

An old vehicle exhaling black smoke chugged noisily into view before the station.

The bus door creaked open, opening only halfway.

Indifferent to this, Marquess Danton personally stepped forward, forcefully pulled the door open, and got on board.

His two personal bodyguards quickly followed.

The seats inside the carriage were still old, worn-out wooden chairs, and they only lined the window side.

There was no driver at the front, but after the three of them found their seats and sat down, the vehicle automatically closed its doors and let out a chugging, starting groan.

The bus slid forward slowly, gradually picking up speed as it wove through the grand avenues and narrow alleys of the Underground City, hurtling towards the Temple Station without a single stop.

When the vehicle reached the Temple Station, Marquess Danton stood up, walked to the front, directly opened a wooden box hanging from the handrail, retrieved three ancient coins from inside, and got off.

His two bodyguards followed him down.

When he turned back around, the old vehicle had already vanished.

Heavy guards stood watch at the entrance of the temple.

Marquess Danton stepped onto the stone steps, and a guard at his side dropped to one knee before him.

"Did you see it?"

"Yes. A vehicle of bizarre design passed through the first temple gates, stopping briefly, but the passengers did not disembark before the vehicle vanished. It most likely went on to the second temple gates."

"Did we miss the ride?"

"Just like before, we could only see it, but we couldn't actually touch it."

Marquess Danton nodded. Any vehicle traveling from the South Anji Road Station toward the temple would inevitably pause briefly at the entrance of the first temple, yet they could only witness it without touching it.

This let them know that the vehicle would likely carry the passengers into the second or even the third temple gates, yet they could only watch helplessly.

Shang Feifan’s plan to make the two tigers fight each other had failed.

Wings of the Eagle hadn't gotten off at the first temple at all. Knowing that Marquess Danton was stationed at the first temple, he naturally wouldn't be foolish enough to crash right into him.

Seeing Marquess Danton approach, the gate-guarding soldiers silently pushed the great doors open.

Marquess Danton strode through the temple gates, only to see a withered monster, as shriveled as a mummified corpse, standing right before his eyes.

The creature draped a fur cloak over its shoulders—one that looked intimately familiar to him.

"Father Garen?"

"It is I." Father Garen’s voice was gloomy. He didn't even need to deliberately put on an act now; his entire aura was naturally grim and eerie.

"How is it that you..." Marquess Danton looked up toward the withered, dead giant tree at the back of the temple. His eyesight was keen enough to spot the tiny flicker of candle flame that used to burn upon it, but now, he saw nothing at all.

"The candles are all extinguished?" Marquess Danton’s expression remained calm.

Father Garen replied, "Indeed."

"What is your next step?" Marquess Danton offered no criticism, maintaining his composure as he inquired.

Father Garen sneered, "You certainly possess nerve. You are already standing on the precipice of failure, yet you still manage to—"

"I am not the one standing on the precipice of failure; you are." Marquess Danton stroked the exquisite fingerless gloves on his hands. "You claimed that the power of Eumuklaso could be opposed by neither mortal nor deity, yet in reality, you have already lost nine statues imbued with the power of Eumuklaso. I have fulfilled my promise, but you have failed."

Father Garen’s shriveled eyelids could not twitch, but his eyeballs remained, still able to shoot out a fierce glare. "We have not failed, and Eumuklaso will never fail! You... you understand nothing of our god's might. Just wait; the destroyers shall pay the price!"

"I care little for how Eumuklaso punishes the destroyers; I only wish to know whether this half-completed farce can still proceed."

"A farce?" Father Garen couldn't help but admire the City Lord's ruthlessness. A corrosive rain had destroyed countless properties and slaughtered or maimed countless citizens, yet in the mouth of this City Lord, it was dismissed as nothing more than a farce.

"Have you performed the sacrifices as agreed?" Father Garen asked.

Marquess Danton paused. "We sacrificed the first batch of nine hundred and ninety-nine people, but news has just arrived that a portion of these people have appeared elsewhere in the Underground City."

Father Garen blurted out, "Impossible!"

Marquess Danton said, "I find it quite strange as well. After all, you told me that once people were locked inside that underground tower, they could never escape."

Father Garen spat with venom, "It must be connected to the troublemakers who seized the statues! Have you uncovered the origins of those troublemakers?"

Marquess Danton didn't care about the other's impolite tone; he didn't view the creature as a real person to begin with. "We haven't even caught them, so how are we supposed to trace their origins? I am merely curious—did Eumuklaso truly give you no instructions whatsoever?"

"Naturally, our god has given us instructions! I am on my way to deal with this matter right now," Father Garen said as he walked toward the door.

Marquess Danton watched Father Garen’s retreating back. He fancied he could see a serpentine black shadow clinging to the back of this evil god cultist, forming the shape of a snake biting its own tail.

Just as he was about to look closer, Father Garen suddenly turned his head, his shriveled, stiff lips slowly pulling upward into a bizarre smile.

Marquess Danton’s heart skipped a beat; once again, he felt a powerful sense of ominous foreboding.

*Leave this Underground City!*

At that exact moment, his mind and his instincts were screaming wildly at him.

Yet Marquess Danton merely stood in silence, watching as Father Garen pulled open the temple doors and strode out.

This evil god cultist required no medium to freely enter and leave the temple—even if he could only access the first layer of the temple.

Marquess Danton’s gaze returned to the withered giant tree, and he murmured, "Could the power of the Nature God still be protecting this Underground City?"

Suddenly, Marquess Danton’s gaze froze.

What about the priest dispatched from the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace to guard the temple?

Ever since this priest had arrived, he had never once returned to the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace. There were even rumors that most priests sent out to guard these "ancient ruins" were sinners who had committed faults and been exiled from the palace, and letting them watch over deserted ancient ruins was essentially a disguised form of imprisonment.

Even so, that man was still a member of the Priest Palace.

Not even the Tiger King would easily offend those monsters on the Sacred Mountain, let alone himself. Unless strictly necessary, he had no desire to cross paths with that group of freaks.

Furthermore, this priest was someone he had managed to win over with great difficulty. The man's abilities had aided him to a certain extent; otherwise, those nine candles wouldn't have taken root so easily upon the dead tree that served as the symbol of the Nature God.

Most importantly, the man had approved of his plan, promising that if things were exposed, he would explain the situation to the Tiger King and the Sacred Mountain.

Marquess Danton strode swiftly up to the dead tree. After scanning the area, his gaze fell upon a pile of sand at the base of the trunk.

He reached out, pressed his hand against the tree bark, and whispered, "Is it you? You haven't truly vanished, have you?"

chunks.chineseText:
丹顿侯爵仰头，眼中露出极度讽刺的神情，拍拍树身：“就算你还存在，那又怎样？先抛弃我们的是你，那就不要怪我们也抛弃你。”

“不能庇护兽人的神灵就不配做兽人的神灵！”

丹顿侯爵毅然转身。

他原本并不想把事情做绝，但事情已经至此，他不想在付出那么多代价后却看不到任何效果。

丹顿侯爵一声令下，这里的士兵全都忙碌起来。

他们手持炼金武器，站在了枯树前。

他们知道这是自然之神的象征，但……他们的效忠对象是丹顿侯爵，就算侯爵命令他们焚毁神的雕像，他们也会去做。

何况这些古神早就成了传说，兽人士兵们对这些泥胎木雕毫无敬畏之心。

不一会儿，有人拖来三名挺着大肚子的女兽人。

这三名女兽人全都昏迷不醒。

丹顿侯爵站在士兵们的后方，颔首示意。

拖着三名怀孕女兽人的士兵们毫无表情地抽出长刀，一刀剖开三名孕妇的肚子。

孕妇惨叫醒来，剖出来的胎儿竟然发出了啼哭声。

但这些声音很快就戛然而止。

这是那名祭司告诉他的秘密——生与死共同的血能污染自然之神的象征。

充满怨恨的死亡之血流入枯树根部。

“放火！”

轰！大量炙热的火焰落在枯树身上。

原本任何手段都无法摧毁的枯树却在此刻发出了枯木被焚烧的噼啪声。

“城主！有急讯！”传信侍卫冲入神殿。

丹顿侯爵眉头一跳：“说。”

传信侍卫飞快说道：“被送入地下城的受伤兽人们突然联合起来冲杀看守他们的士兵，现在他们已经逃入地下城各处。有人还冲入了各处避难营地，号召那些躲避腐蚀雨的兽人们一起逃出地下城。”

丹顿侯爵深吸气：“为什么那些受伤兽人会突然有能力冲杀看守他们的士兵？”

传信侍卫：“不知道，据说他们突然就能抵抗腐蚀的痛苦，还有人手中还出现了药物。一开始看守士兵发现有人在分发药物，就去询问他们药物哪里来的，他们不肯说。士兵觉得不对，就想要制止他们，还想没收那些药物，就……惹恼了受伤的兽人们。然后有人趁机乱喊，还有之前逃出的受伤兽人现身说法，就彻底乱了起来。”

“蠢货！”丹顿侯爵低骂。

这显然是一场有预谋的叛乱！

如果那些士兵能聪明一点，不要阻止那些受伤兽人分发药物，甚至主动帮忙，说不定还能打消那些疑神疑鬼的兽人们的疑虑，不至于立刻就形成暴动。

“冲出去？离开地下城，他们也是死。”丹顿侯爵原本还想尽快停止腐蚀雨，只要计划顺利。

但现在……就让腐蚀雨继续下下去吧。

“关闭所有地下城入口，不要放跑任何一个人！”

他决不能让这些兽人跑到地面上。

现在黑森林城仍旧有不少人躲在自己家中，这些人都是未来黑森林城重塑的基础，他不想也失去这些人。

但如果事情发展彻底脱离他的掌控……

咔咔，枯树在烈火焚烧下碎裂了。

地下城中传来闷闷的轰鸣声，地面微微颤抖。

商非凡小心翼翼地弯腰，小心翼翼地把手掌按在地面上感知。

地震？

咔嚓。商非凡惊讶下，手掌不小心加了一点劲，结果那不知维持了多少年的坚硬路面竟然被他按开了一条裂缝。

呃，他不是有意的。只是吞吃了那只灰色大虫子后，他的力气就又提升了多倍，到现在他都还没有完全适应他的新力量。

不帅手持魔杖，施法困住那些追杀受伤兽人的士兵，扭头看向商非凡。

“发生了什么事？我听到了奇怪的声音。”

商非凡抬头：“你听到了什么？”

“我不知道，声音像是从地底深处传来，就像是什么东西断裂了，又像是什么东西碎开了。”

“总之就是不太妙的声音。我们得尽快离开地下城。”商非凡站起来。

“地下城中还有这么多兽人怎么办？”不帅口中说话，施法却没停。

一些简单魔法，他完全可以瞬发。

“相信他们。”商非凡一指带伤和士兵打斗的兽人们：“再说你看他们需要保姆吗？”

在知道自然魔法对驱逐黑暗能量也有奇效后，不帅就和商非凡溜到了受伤兽人等待治疗的等候区。

商非凡还特意留了几十个刚刚差点被灰色虫子吞吃的兽人。

等到不帅悄悄施展驱逐魔法，驱逐了那些受伤兽人身上的黑暗能量。商非凡就带着那几十个兽人溜入受伤的兽人中，给他们分发药物，让他们互相治疗，并说明情况。

一开始，那些受伤兽人还不相信，直到那些差点被献祭的兽人们现身说法。总有熟人彼此认识，或者有人记住了几个第一批被治疗的兽人样貌。

偏偏那些士兵也不知怎么想的，竟然跑出来制止受伤兽人互相分发药物。

这下可把受伤兽人们给气炸了。

说是治疗，结果就只是把他们运送到这个见鬼的地方，一个治疗者都不见出现，更没有人出来给他们分发药物，就连止疼止血都没有人帮忙。

这些受伤兽人们原本就在各种怀疑，现在好不容易有人出来帮助他们，不但让腐蚀毒素不再继续腐蚀他们的身体，更给他们分发治疗药物，可那些士兵不说帮忙，还跑出来阻止，更抢夺他们的药物，这能忍？

黑森林城的兽人们民性比较彪悍，平时虽然不会和贵族和管理者们对着干，但真的遇到事，就没几个怕的。

说打就打，半点不含糊！

他们还能条理地分队，给不同能力的兽人分派不同任务，老幼弱全都被保护起来，强壮者则负责战斗和开路。

商非凡还笑说：“我喜欢这帮家伙。”

他和不帅只有两个人，他们不可能把整座地下城的几万乃至更多兽人全都救出去，他们只能作为点火者，作为打开门锁的人。

真正能拯救自己的，永远都是自己。

如果真有神灵，神灵也会更愿意帮助那些愿意自救的人。

有了别人帮助，那就更需要自己也行动起来！

黑森林城的兽人们就做到了这一点。

“毕竟是王城的附属城市，原本这几座附属城市的基础人口就是从兵营和战士们的家属发展过来。为了保护王城，附属城市的城民都会经常接受各种来自王城的训练。”不帅说。

商非凡点头：“虎王这点做得很聪明。他让这些附属城市的城民知道谁才是他们真正的统治者。”

“是啊。”不帅轻叹，心想这会不会就是黑森林城主这么不珍惜自己城民的原因之一。

“我怀疑地下城入口会被那个傻叉城主关闭起来。”商非凡从来不会怀着乐观的心态去看那些疯狂者的下限，因为他们一旦疯起来压根就没有下限。

“那我们过去帮忙？”

“不用。”商非凡摇头：“就算入口真的被关闭，那么多兽人，杀也能杀出去。”
chunks.englishText:
Marquess Danton looked up, an expression of extreme mockery crossing his eyes as he patted the tree trunk. "Even if you still exist, so what? You were the first to abandon us, so do not blame us for abandoning you in turn."

"A deity that cannot protect the beastmen is unworthy of being the beastmen's god!"

Marquess Danton resolutely turned on his heel.

Originally, he hadn't wished to push matters to the absolute limit, but things had already reached this point; he refused to invest so much effort and endure so many sacrifices only to see zero results.

At Marquess Danton’s single command, the soldiers stationed here sprang into action.

Wielding alchemical weapons, they stepped before the withered tree.

They knew this was the symbol of the Nature God, but... their allegiance belonged to Marquess Danton. Even if the Marquess ordered them to burn down the statues of the gods, they would carry it out without hesitation.

Besides, these ancient deities had long since faded into myth; the beastman soldiers held zero reverence for these lumps of clay and carved wood.

Moments later, a few soldiers dragged over three heavily pregnant female beastmen.

All three of these female beastmen were completely unconscious.

Marquess Danton stood behind the soldiers and nodded in signal.

The soldiers dragging the three pregnant beastmen expressionlessly drew their sabers and slashed open the wombs of the three expectant mothers.

The pregnant women woke up screaming, and the fetuses pulled from their bodies actually let out shrill cries.

Yet those sounds were abruptly cut short.

This was the secret the priest had told him—the combined blood-energy of life and death could pollute the symbol of the Nature God.

Streams of resentful death-blood poured into the roots of the withered tree.

"Set the fire!"

*BOOM!* A volley of scorching flames rained down upon the dead tree.

The ancient tree, which previously could not be destroyed by any conventional means, now emitted the crackling sounds of dead wood burning under the blaze.

"City Lord! Urgent report!" A messenger guard rushed into the temple.

Marquess Danton’s brow twitched. "Speak."

The messenger guard blurted out at top speed, "The injured beastmen sent into the Underground City have suddenly united and launched an assault on the soldiers guarding them. Right now, they’ve broken into every corner of the Underground City. Some have even stormed the various refugee camps, rallying the beastmen hiding from the corrosive rain to escape the Underground City together!"

Marquess Danton took a deep breath. "Why would those injured beastmen suddenly have the strength to attack and overpower their guards?"

The messenger guard replied, "Unknown. Rumor has it that they suddenly became able to resist the agony of the corrosion, and some even produced medicine. At first, the guarding soldiers noticed someone distributing medicine and went to interrogate them about where it came from, but they refused to speak. Suspecting foul play, the soldiers tried to stop them and even attempted to confiscate the medicine... which infuriated the injured beastmen. Then someone seized the opportunity to stir up chaos, while other injured beastmen who had escaped earlier stepped forward to bear witness, and the situation completely unraveled into total pandemonium."

"Idiots!" Marquess Danton cursed under his breath.

This was clearly a premeditated rebellion!

If those soldiers had possessed a shred of sense and refrained from stopping the injured beastmen from distributing medicine—or even actively assisted them—they might have allayed the suspicions of those paranoid beastmen, preventing a riot from erupting on the spot.

"Break out? Even if they leave the Underground City, they'll still die." Originally, Marquess Danton had intended to halt the corrosive rain as soon as his plan proceeded smoothly.

But now... let the corrosive rain keep falling.

"Seal all entrances to the Underground City! Do not let a single person escape!"

He absolutely could not allow these beastmen to run amok on the surface.

At present, quite a few residents were still hiding in their homes within Black Forest City; these people formed the foundation for the city's future reconstruction, and he had no wish to lose them as well.

However, if things spiraled completely out of his control...

*Crack, snap!* The withered tree shattered amidst the raging inferno.

A muffled, rumbling echo reverberated through the Underground City, and the ground trembled slightly.

Shang Feifan stooped down cautiously, pressing his palm against the ground to feel the tremors.

An earthquake?

*Crack.* Caught off-guard, Shang Feifan accidentally exerted a bit too much force with his palm, and the hardened pavement—which had withstood countless years—actually fractured open under his touch.

Ah, he hadn't meant to. Ever since he had consumed that giant gray insect, his physical strength had multiplied severalfold, and he still hadn't fully adapted to his newfound power.

Bu Shuai clutched his magic staff, casting spells to entrap the soldiers hunting down the injured beastmen, before turning his head toward Shang Feifan.

"What happened? I heard a strange noise."

Shang Feifan looked up. "What did you hear?"

"I'm not sure. The sound seemed to come from deep underground, like something snapping, or something shattering."

"In short, it doesn't sound good. We need to get out of the Underground City as soon as possible." Shang Feifan stood up.

"What about all these beastmen still trapped in the Underground City?" Bu Shuai asked while his spellcasting never skipped a beat.

He could cast simple spells entirely instantaneously.

"Trust them." Shang Feifan gestured toward the beastmen fighting the soldiers with their injuries. "Besides, do you think they look like they need babysitters?"

After discovering that nature magic also had miraculous effects in dispelling dark energy, Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan had sneaked over to the waiting area where injured beastmen awaited treatment.

Shang Feifan had even deliberately left behind dozens of beastmen who had almost been devoured by the giant gray insect.

Once Bu Shuai quietly unleashed a purification spell, cleansing the dark energy from those injured beastmen, Shang Feifan led those dozens of individuals into the wider pool of wounded beastmen, distributing medicine, having them treat one another, and explaining the truth of the situation.

At first, those injured beastmen refused to believe it—until the beastmen who had nearly been sacrificed stepped forward to give firsthand accounts. In any community, acquaintances knew one another, or people recognized the faces of a few beastmen from the first batch of treated individuals.

Yet the guards, acting out of some unfathomable impulse, chose that exact moment to rush out and stop the wounded beastmen from exchanging medicines.

That completely infuriated the injured beastmen.

They had been told they were being brought for medical treatment, only to be hauled off to this godforsaken place where not a single healer was to be seen, let alone anyone handing out medicine. No one had even bothered to help them stop their bleeding or dull their pain.

These injured beastmen were already bristling with suspicions. Now, when people had finally come to their aid—halting the corrosive toxins from devouring their flesh and distributing real medicine—those guards hadn't helped, but had instead rushed out to stop them and snatch away their remedies. How could they endure that?

The beastmen of Black Forest City possessed rather fierce and unyielding dispositions. While they wouldn't normally pick fights with nobles and administrators, once pushed to the brink, very few among them knew fear.

When they wanted to fight, they fought—no hesitation whatsoever!

Moreover, they managed to organize themselves logically, assigning different tasks to beastmen with various abilities. The elderly, the young, and the weak were all placed under protection, while the strong took charge of combat and clearing the path.

Shang Feifan had chuckled, saying, "I like these fellows."

With only the two of them, it was impossible to rescue tens of thousands or more beastmen scattered across the entire Underground City. They could only act as firestarters, as the ones who unlatched the doors.

The only ones who could truly save people were themselves.

If gods truly existed, those deities would surely be more willing to lend a hand to those who sought to save themselves.

When others offered a helping hand, one had to act all the more resolutely!

And the beastmen of Black Forest City had accomplished precisely that.

"After all, this is a subordinate city of the Royal City. The foundational population of these subordinate cities originally evolved from military garrisons and the families of warriors. To safeguard the Royal City, the citizens of these subordinate towns are regularly put through various drills by the Royal City," Bu Shuai explained.
