Shang Feifan nodded. "The Tiger King played that rather smartly. He made sure the citizens of these subordinate cities knew who their true rulers were."

"Indeed," Bu Shuai sighed softly, wondering if this was precisely why the Lord of Black Forest City held such utter disregard for his own subjects.

"I suspect the entrances to the Underground City will be sealed by that moronic City Lord." Shang Feifan never viewed the lower limits of madmen through an optimistic lens, because once those lunatics lost their minds, they possessed no bottom line whatsoever.

"Then shall we go over and help?"

"No need." Shang Feifan shook his head. "Even if the entrances truly get sealed, with so many beastmen, they can carve their way out through sheer slaughter."

chunks.chineseText:
“杀出去后怎么办？外面还在下腐蚀雨。”不帅能驱逐受伤者身体中的黑暗能量，但他没办法让腐蚀雨停止。

“相信那些兽人们。这么大的城市肯定会有各种强者，他们为了自救也会想出办法逃出黑森林城。总比留在地下城等死要好。”

“也是！”不帅一挥骨杖，杀气腾腾：“那接下来我们就去寻找那位城主？想要制止这场灾难，就得先制止源头。”

不帅是真气那个城主，气对方完全不把人命但人命。他现在对黑森林城主已经不仅仅是私仇。

商非凡被杀气腾腾的不帅逗笑：“好，我们去神殿找那位城主。”

“你怎么确定丹顿侯爵就在神殿？”

“我不知道，但值得我们过去看一看。而且你真不好奇神殿里都有什么吗？”

不帅感受着脚底的轻微震动，怀疑：“丹顿侯爵真的会在地下城不稳的时候继续待在这里？”

“去看看就知道了。”商非凡仗着自己有回城功能，也不怕地震真的来临他和不帅逃不出去。

“接下来你绝对不能和我分开。”商非凡握住不帅的手，轻轻的。

之前他就没留意自己的力量，差点伤到不帅。

不帅笑笑：“如果真的分开，你也要相信我有自保能力。”

“别立flag！”

两人再次前往安吉南路站。

途中他们经过一处地下城入口，商非凡趁着守门士兵和其他兽人混战的时候，对着那紧闭的大门踹了一脚。

坚硬的大门，碎了。

一力破万法，进出口的开门机关现在对某人来说就是一个摆设。

这里也成了兽人们冲出地下城的第一个突破口。

从神殿消失的盖伦神甫身影出现在地下塔楼的第二层。

他摸了摸自己戴在拇指上的戒指，打开戒指上的装饰物。

装饰物下，是一个很小的凹陷，凹陷里面是指甲盖大的一小块黑色块状物。

一秒、两秒……

盖伦神甫等了又等，原本应该在他打开戒指盖后就会立刻出现在灰色虫子一只都没有出现。

这是怎么回事？！

盖伦神甫想到一个可能，又觉得不可能。

那些灰色虫子的威力，他再了解不过。不是他吹，就是圣山祭司宫的大祭司来了也无法对付那些没有实体的圣虫！

盖伦神甫又在原地等了片刻，仍旧没有等来哪怕一只圣虫。

吧嗒，他合上了戒指盖。

没有圣虫，他要怎么快速传播厄穆克拉索的威力？

盖伦神甫目光盯着地面，过了一会儿像是下定了某个决心一般，身影再次消失。

地下城中，原本分散的邪神信徒们聚集到了一起。

他们的任务就是祭拜和看守邪神雕像，但现在那些雕像全都被抢走，包括埋在雕像下的箱子也一样。

他们害怕受到惩罚，但又不得不等待他们的处罚结果。

“盖伦神甫！”一名邪神信徒发出惊喜和惊慌交织的喊声。

邪神信徒们一起看过去。

盖伦神甫悄无声息地站在角落。

邪神信徒全都对他跪拜下去。

邪神信徒中的头目匍匐在地上，诚惶诚恐地询问：“神甫大人，请问吾神有什么指示？”

“贡献你们力量的时候到了。”盖伦神甫开口，身影缥缈又诡异。

邪神信徒头目下意识抬头，恰好看到盖伦神甫整个人都化成一条黑色长蛇的过程。

这名头目最后看到的场景就是那条黑色长蛇游弋到他身边，冲着他张开了蛇口。

砰！

砰砰砰！

跪趴在地上的邪神信徒们一个接一个炸成了血雾。

那黑色长蛇张嘴狂吸。

血雾全都被它吸入口中。

黑色长蛇越来越长、越来越粗。

商非凡说要去神殿，却带着不帅到处绕路，一连踹碎了三个地下城进出口大门，这才和不帅来到安吉南路站。

这次他们等待的时间稍微长了一点。

大约等了三四分钟，那辆有缘车才姗姗来迟。

“布加迪末日战车GT01？”商非凡挑眉。他以为会再次看到消防车呢。

不帅学商非凡耸肩：“买不起，就幻想一下。”

这辆被称为坦克的幻彩超跑，按照某王室王子要求特别定做，全球只有一辆。

当它行驶在路上时，它就是全世界最靓的仔！

哪个男人能不爱这么酷炫的车？

两人并肩站在一起欣赏。

商非凡：“你想……”

不帅迅速打断他：“我不想！”

商非凡勾唇。

如飞翼的车门向上打开。这是早些年的设计了。

商非凡做了个请的手势。

不帅带着点小兴奋坐进驾驶座。

内饰和摆设都和他记忆中差不多。这辆车制造好后，他在车厂有幸看到过内外全貌。

商非凡就上了副驾驶位。

门翼合上，超跑发出轰鸣声，咻地飞驰了出去。

"What do we do after breaking out? It's still raining corrosive poison outside." Bu Shuai could purge the dark energy from the injured, but he had no way to make the corrosive rain stop.

"Trust those beastmen. A city this massive is bound to have all sorts of powerhouses. To save themselves, they'll figure out a way to escape Black Forest City. Anything is better than staying in the Underground City to wait for death."

"True!" Bu Shuai waved his bone staff, radiating a murderous aura. "Then shall we hunt down that City Lord next? To put an end to this disaster, we must first sever the source."

Bu Shuai was genuinely furious with that City Lord—furious that he treated human lives as utterly worthless. His grudge against the Lord of Black Forest City had long since transcended personal vengeance.

Shang Feifan was amused by Bu Shuai’s battle-ready stance. "Alright, let's head to the temple and find our dear City Lord."

"How can you be so sure Marquess Danton is still at the temple?"

"I don't know for certain, but it's worth checking out. Besides, aren't you even a little curious about what's hidden inside the temple?"

Feeling the faint tremors beneath his feet, Bu Shuai expressed doubt. "Will Marquess Danton really linger there while the Underground City is falling apart?"

"We'll know once we take a look." Relying on his recall function, Shang Feifan wasn't the least bit worried that he and Bu Shuai would fail to escape if a real earthquake struck.

"From here on out, you must not get separated from me." Shang Feifan gently took Bu Shuai’s hand.

Earlier, he hadn't controlled his strength well and had nearly hurt Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai smiled. "Even if we do get separated, you should trust in my ability to protect myself."

"Don't jinx it!"

The pair headed once more toward the South Anji Road Station.

Along the way, they passed by an Underground City exit. Taking advantage of the melee between the gate guards and the chaotic beastmen, Shang Feifan planted a kick squarely against the heavy, sealed doors.

The sturdy doors shattered.

Absolute strength breaks all spells; opening mechanisms at entry and exit points were nothing more than a decoration to someone like him now.

This spot instantly became the first breakthrough point for the beastmen storming out of the Underground City.

Father Garen, who had vanished from the temple, reappeared on the second level of the underground tower.

He stroked the ring on his thumb and popped open its decorative cover.

Beneath the ornament lay a tiny recess, and nestled inside was a small, thumbnail-sized piece of black matter.

One second, two seconds...

Father Garen waited and waited, but not a single gray insect—which should have materialized the instant he opened the ring's lid—appeared.

What was going on?!

Father Garen considered a possibility, only to dismiss it as absurd.

He knew the terrifying power of those gray insects better than anyone. He wasn't boasting; even if the High Priest of the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace came in person, he wouldn't be able to handle those intangible holy bugs!

Father Garen waited a moment longer in place, yet still failed to summon even a single holy insect.

*Click.* He snapped the ring's lid shut.

Without the holy insects, how was he supposed to rapidly spread the might of Eumuklaso?

Father Garen fixed his gaze on the floor. After a brief moment, as if having resolved himself to something, his figure vanished once more.

Down in the Underground City, the scattered evil god cultists had gathered together.

Their duty was to worship and guard the evil god's statues, but now all of those statues had been looted, along with the chests buried beneath them.

They feared the impending punishment, yet they had no choice but to await their fate.

"Father Garen!" A cultist cried out in a voice mingled with pleasant surprise and panic.

The other evil god cultists snapped their heads toward the sound.

Father Garen stood silently in the corner.

Every single cultist dropped to their knees before him.

The leader of the cultists prostrated himself on the ground, trembling as he asked, "Lord Father, what instructions does our god have for us?"

"The time has come for you to contribute your strength." Father Garen spoke, his figure ethereal and eerie.

The cult leader instinctively raised his head, catching just in time the exact moment Father Garen transformed entirely into a long, black serpent.

The final scene etched into the leader's eyes was that massive black serpent slithering to his side, gaping its jaws wide open before him.

*Bang!*

*Bang, bang, bang!*

The cultists kneeling on the ground exploded into mists of blood one after another.

The black serpent opened its maw and inhaled ravenously.

All the bloody mist was sucked straight into its gullet.

The black serpent grew longer and thicker by the second.

Though Shang Feifan had claimed they were heading to the temple, he kept leading Bu Shuai on detours, shattering three consecutive Underground City entry and exit gates before finally arriving at the South Anji Road Station.

This time, their wait was slightly longer.

After roughly three or four minutes, that miraculous vehicle finally arrived fashionably late.

"Bugatti Doomsday Chariot GT01?" Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. He had expected to see a fire truck again.

Bu Shuai mimicked Shang Feifan's shrug. "Can't afford to buy one, so I can only fantasize."

This colorful hypercar, dubbed a tank, had been custom-built to the specifications of a certain royal prince—the only one of its kind in the entire world.

When it cruised down the street, it was undeniably the most dazzling sight on earth!

Which man could resist such a breathtaking ride?

The two stood side by side, admiring it.

Shang Feifan asked, "Would you like to—"

Bu Shuai cut him off instantly. "I would not!"

Shang Feifan curled the corner of his lips.

The gull-wing doors swung upward in classic retro style.

Shang Feifan made a polite gesture of invitation.

With a hint of suppressed excitement, Bu Shuai slid into the driver's seat.

The interior and layout were almost identical to what he remembered. After this car was manufactured, he had been fortunate enough to tour the entire interior and exterior at the assembly plant.

Shang Feifan took the passenger seat.

The gull-wing doors clicked shut, the hypercar let out a thunderous roar, and it shot forward like a flying arrow.

第108章 意外收获

神殿中，一群士兵正在灰烬中翻找着什么。

丹顿侯爵就站在一边。

他的侍从正在劝他：“爵爷，整个地下城都在晃动，您待在这里太危险了，请您离开这里吧。有什么事您可以吩咐属下们去做。”

丹顿侯爵丝毫没有理会。

侍从愁眉苦脸。

丹顿侯爵命令士兵设法挖开那株枯死大树的根部。

枯树地面上部分被焚烧成灰烬后，它的根部也变得焦脆，只要士兵用铲子用力挖掘，就能挖断那些枯死虬结的树根。

几名士兵按照命令，一边破坏树根，一边用力往下挖。

一名士兵飞快跑进来：“报！车站有一辆奇怪的车停下。”

“停下？没有走？”丹顿侯爵惊讶转身。

士兵：“没有，是停下。”

丹顿侯爵立刻快步向外走去。

他不是要见乘车来这里的有缘人，而是想要看有没有机会坐上那辆车前往第二重乃至第三重神殿。

这么多年，他还是第一次碰到有人在第一重神殿停下。

之前也有人在第一重神殿车站停下，但在看到神殿门口有重兵把守后就会立刻驶离。

后来他曾撤销把守的士兵，隐在暗处，但之后不但少有人再遇到有缘车，遇到也不会在第一重神殿停下。

为此，他差点想要打开地下城，让冒险者寻宝者任意进出，然后看有没有更多人能碰到有缘车。

可他又不想真的有人乘坐有缘车前往第二重和第三重神殿，看到、得到他没有机会看到和得到的东西。

商非凡和不帅看到第一重神殿，也看到了神殿外那些士兵。

“他们看到我们了。”

“隐身？”

两人从车里出来，全都是隐身状态。

守卫士兵只看到那辆奇怪却酷炫的车辆展开了两翼，应该是打开了车门？

车内却没有人走出。

有士兵快速靠近车辆，也没看到车内有人。

丹顿侯爵从高高的台阶上飞速奔下，却只看到那辆古怪车辆消失的瞬间。

当乘车人离开车辆后，有缘车就会再次消失，直到乘车人再次出现在车站。

丹顿侯爵没办法直接坐上车，只能把希望放在那个有缘人身上。

但是……

“隐身术？”丹顿侯爵结合之前地下城中发生的一系列事情，脑中飞快得出判断。

“泼水！”丹顿侯爵立刻下令。

当他得知捣乱者有可能拥有隐身和瞬移之类的天赋能力后，他就做好了准备。

几个士兵快速奔出，他们手戴可以放大他们天赋能力的炼金装备，同时向四面八方喷洒水雾。

那水雾还带着明亮的橘黄色。

这可真是对付隐身术的好办法。商非凡和不帅两人都在心中称赞，不过他们两人也不是吃素的。

只两人的反应速度和转移速度，就让那些士兵喷洒出来的水雾追不上他们。

丹顿侯爵本人则在瞬间被一套全身盔甲包裹，同时他的身边出现了八名士兵，把他守护在最中间，向神殿内部转移而去。

丹顿侯爵不知道，有人就站在他身后不远处，看着他和士兵转移进神殿中。

商非凡和不帅都没有立刻攻击丹顿侯爵，他们不会小看丹顿侯爵身边那些士兵，更不会小看他身上那套盔甲，况且丹顿侯爵本人的能力也相当不错。

不帅想要施展定身术，但在他举起骨杖时，他的直觉告诉他，定身术未必会有效。那套盔甲让他感觉到了磅礴的能量。

商非凡更是不会莽撞，他在观察。

他们需要一击奏效，而不是给丹顿侯爵标记他们和逃匿的机会。

神殿大门口已经被水雾封锁，只要有人想要进入神殿，就势必会遇到水雾。

如果商非凡和不帅两人只会隐身术，他们确实会苦于想要进入神殿就得通过水雾这一点，但丹顿侯爵怎么也不会想到，这两人中有一个是魔法师，还是高级魔法师。

不帅感知到商非凡，摸索着握住他的手。站在神殿的墙壁边，施展穿墙术，带着商非凡直接进入了神殿内部。

一进入神殿，不帅就下意识抬头朝神殿顶部看去。

神殿拥有一个圆形拱顶，在拱顶最中央的位置有一个洞。

一般这种造型都是为了采光，可以让日光或月光可以照射到某个特定位置，形成特殊的光晕效果。

现在这个洞显然已经失去原本的功能，在这个洞的下方吊着一盏灯。

灯体是很古老的烛台，也不知是什么材料制成，整体蜿蜒曲折，有十二枚可以插蜡烛的烛插。

现在这些烛插上没有一支蜡烛，不知多少年前残留下来的蜡泪堆积在烛插根部。

神殿内点燃了很多油肚虫灯，照射得神殿几乎没有死角。

商非凡也听到了系统在给他发布新任务。

【主线任务四，寻找并归还自然之神的一支手臂。你已经发现它，请把它归还给自然之神。完成后奖励一万贡献点。】

自然之神的手臂，在哪儿？

商非凡只看到一群在灰烬中翻找什么的士兵。

这时，不帅忽然拍拍商非凡的胳膊，抓起他的手，指向上空。

商非凡抬头往上看，看到了那个造型独特，像是树枝一样的烛台吊灯。

等等，这东西不会就是主线任务让他寻找的自然之神的手臂吧？

右眼视界几乎是迫不及待地跳出讯息。

【发现自然之神的手臂！请立刻取回。】

好吧，还真的是。

没想到这次神殿之行，竟然这么轻易就得到了一个主线任务的线索，哦，不是线索，是抬手就可以完成的任务目标。

这真的是意外之喜了。

虽然他们来神殿多少也有寻找看这里有没有残留的自然之神的力量或自然系宝贝的意思，但真的没想到会这么轻松就有发现。

怪不得那有缘车三番五次停在不帅身边，大概是感知到不帅身上的“自然之神馈赠”？

商非凡看看那树枝型吊灯，又瞅瞅全身盔甲站在神殿中、神色戒备的丹顿侯爵，心想：这位侯爵兼城主大人知道这就吊在他们头顶上的吊灯就是自然之神的一支手臂吗？

想想看，这位侯爵和那位王后似乎一直在寻找自然之神的力量，若让他们知道他们苦苦寻找多年的自然之神的力量就在他们身边，甚至是伸手可及……

商非凡开始同情这位侯爵和那位王后了，真的。

不帅握住商非凡的手，要在他手心里写字。突然，他抬手捂住了耳朵。

凄厉的婴儿啼哭声陡然响起，且不止一个婴儿。

除了婴儿啼哭声，他还听到了女性的惨叫，同样不止一个。

属于亡者的哀嚎不断循环往复，在神殿的回音效果下更是响亮异常。

就在不帅忍不住要封闭自己的听力……他知道这没什么用，他是用精神力听到了亡者的哀嚎，而不是单纯的听力。

忽然，一道微风穿过拱顶顶部的圆洞，在风碰触到那吊挂烛台时，轻柔的歌声响起。

歌声朦胧，你听不出那是男声还是女声，你也听不出歌词，你甚至听不出曲调。

Chapter 108: Unexpected Harvest

Inside the temple, a group of soldiers were rummaging through the ashes.

Marquis Danton stood nearby.

His attendant was trying to persuade him, "My Lord, the entire dungeon is shaking. It is far too dangerous for you to stay here. Please leave. You can leave whatever needs to be done to your subordinates."

Marquis Danton paid him no heed whatsoever.

The attendant wore a look of deep worry.

Marquis Danton ordered the soldiers to find a way to dig out the roots of the withered, dead tree.

Once the above-ground portion of the dead tree had been burned to ashes, its roots had also become brittle. As long as the soldiers dug hard with their shovels, they could snap the gnarled, dead roots.

Following the orders, several soldiers hacked at the roots while digging downward with all their might.

A soldier rushed in swiftly: "Reporting! A strange vehicle has stopped at the station."

"Stopped? It didn't leave?" Marquis Danton turned around in surprise.

The soldier replied: "No, it stopped."

Marquis Danton immediately strode toward the exit.

He was not looking to meet the fated person who had arrived by vehicle; rather, he wanted to see if there was a chance to board that vehicle and travel to the second or even the third temple.

In all these years, this was the first time he had ever encountered someone stopping at the first temple.

Previously, people had stopped at the first temple's station, but upon seeing heavily armed guards at the temple gates, they would immediately drive away.

Later, he had withdrawn the guarding soldiers and hidden in the shadows, but after that, not only did people rarely encounter the fated vehicle, but even when they did, they never stopped at the first temple.

For this reason, he had almost wanted to open up the dungeon, letting adventurers and treasure hunters wander in and out freely to see if more people could encounter the fated vehicle.

Yet, he did not truly want anyone to ride the fated vehicle to the second and third temples, seeing and obtaining things he had no chance to see or acquire.

Shang Feifan and Bushuai had seen the first temple, and they had also seen the soldiers outside it.

"They saw us."

"Invisibility?"

The two stepped out of the vehicle, both remaining in a state of complete invisibility.

The guarding soldiers only saw that strange yet cool vehicle unfold its wings—presumably, the doors had opened?

Yet no one stepped out from inside.

A soldier quickly approached the vehicle, only to find no one inside.

Marquis Danton bolted down the high steps at top speed, only to catch a glimpse of the moment the bizarre vehicle vanished.

Once the passengers left the vehicle, the fated vehicle would disappear once more, until the passengers reappeared at the station.

Marquis Danton could not board the vehicle directly, so he had no choice but to pin his hopes on that fated person.

However...

"Invisibility arts?" Marquis Danton quickly synthesized the string of events that had occurred earlier in the dungeon and arrived at a swift judgment.

"Spray water!" Marquis Danton immediately issued the order.

Ever since he learned that the troublemakers might possess innate abilities like invisibility and teleportation, he had made preparations.

Several soldiers sprinted out, wearing alchemy equipment on their hands that could amplify their innate abilities, simultaneously spraying water mist in all directions.

The water mist even carried a bright, orange-yellow hue.

This truly was a brilliant countermeasure against invisibility. Both Shang Feifan and Bushuai praised it inwardly, but the two of them were no pushovers either.

Merely by relying on their reaction speed and repositioning agility, they kept the water mist sprayed by those soldiers from ever catching up to them.

As for Marquis Danton himself, he was instantly enveloped by a full set of armor, while eight soldiers materialized around him, guarding him tightly in the very center as they retreated toward the interior of the temple.

Little did Marquis Danton know, someone was standing not far behind him, watching him and his soldiers retreat into the temple.

Neither Shang Feifan nor Bushuai launched an immediate attack on Marquis Danton; they would not underestimate the soldiers surrounding him, nor would they underestimate the suit of armor he wore. Furthermore, Marquis Danton's own abilities were quite formidable.

Bushuai wanted to cast a Binding Spell, but the moment he raised his bone staff, his intuition told him the spell might not be effective. That suit of armor gave him a sense of boundless, overwhelming energy.

Shang Feifan was even less prone to recklessness; he was observing.

They needed a strike that would succeed on the first blow, rather than giving Marquis Danton a chance to mark them and escape.

The temple's grand entrance had been sealed off by the water mist; anyone wishing to enter the temple was bound to encounter it.

If Shang Feifan and Bushuai possessed only invisibility arts, they would indeed have been troubled by the need to pass through the water mist to enter the temple. But Marquis Danton could never have imagined that one of these two was a mage—and a senior mage at that.

Sensing Shang Feifan, Bushuai groped around and grasped his hand. Standing by the temple wall, he cast the Wall-Passing Spell, bringing Shang Feifan directly into the interior of the temple.

Upon entering the temple, Bushuai subconsciously raised his head to look toward the ceiling.

The temple featured a circular dome, with an opening right at the very center.

Designs of this sort were generally intended for lighting, allowing sunlight or moonlight to beam onto a specific spot to create a special halo effect.

Now, this opening had clearly lost its original function; hanging directly beneath the hole was a lamp.

The lamp body was an ancient candelabra made of an unknown material, winding and twisting as a whole, featuring twelve candle sockets.

Not a single candle sat in these sockets now; residual wax dripped down over countless years had piled up thickly at the base of the sockets.

Inside the temple, numerous oil-belly worm lamps had been lit, illuminating the place with virtually no dead angles.

Shang Feifan also heard the system issuing a new quest for him.

[Main Quest 4: Find and return one of the arms of the God of Nature. You have discovered it; please return it to the God of Nature. Reward upon completion: 10,000 contribution points.]

The arm of the God of Nature—where was it?

Shang Feifan only saw a group of soldiers rummaging through the ashes.

At that moment, Bushuai suddenly patted Shang Feifan's arm, grabbed his hand, and pointed upward.

Shang Feifan raised his gaze and saw that uniquely shaped, branch-like chandelier hanging above.

Wait, could this thing possibly be the arm of the God of Nature that the main quest wanted him to find?

His right-eye vision jumped out with a message almost impatiently.

[Arm of the God of Nature discovered! Please retrieve it immediately.]

Well, it really was.

He hadn't expected this trip to the temple to yield a clue to a main quest so easily—ah, not a clue, but a task objective that could be completed simply by reaching out a hand.

This truly was an unexpected windfall.

Although they had come to the temple partly to search for any lingering power of the God of Nature or nature-type treasures, they honestly hadn't expected to make a discovery so effortlessly.

No wonder that fated vehicle had stopped by Bushuai time and time again; could it be that it sensed the "Gift of the God of Nature" within Bushuai?

Shang Feifan looked at the branch-like chandelier, then glanced at Marquis Danton, who stood clad in full armor inside the temple with a guarded expression, thinking to himself: Did this Marquis and City Lord know that the chandelier hanging right above their heads was actually an arm of the God of Nature?

Just imagine, this Marquis and that Queen seemed to have been searching endlessly for the power of the God of Nature. If they knew that the power of the God of Nature they had sought so bitterly for years was right beside them, within arm's reach...

Shang Feifan was starting to feel a bit sympathetic toward the Marquis and the Queen, truly.

Bushuai gripped Shang Feifan's hand, intending to trace words in his palm. Suddenly, he raised his hands to cover his ears.

The shrill, piercing cries of an infant suddenly rang out, and there wasn't just one.

Alongside the infant cries, he heard the miserable screams of women, likewise more than one.

The wails of the dead echoed in an endless loop, sounding exceptionally loud and piercing due to the temple's acoustic resonance.

Just as Bushuai couldn't help but shut down his sense of hearing... he knew that would be useless; he was hearing the wails of the dead through his spiritual force, not through ordinary hearing.

Suddenly, a gentle breeze swept through the circular opening at the apex of the dome. When the wind brushed against the hanging candelabra, a soft song began to play.

The song was hazy; you couldn't tell whether it was a male or female voice, nor could you discern the lyrics, or even the tune.

chunks.chineseText:
不帅却沉入这歌声中，脑中响起的婴儿啼哭声和女兽人的惨叫声被掩盖住。

“哼……哼哼……”不帅半闭着眼睛，跟着那歌声哼唱起来。

商非凡吃惊地看向身边。

他看不到同样隐身的不帅，但他能感觉到此刻的不帅气息似乎特别平和，他哼唱的歌声更是说不出的轻柔好听。

婴儿啼哭声和女兽人的惨叫逐渐变小，不是被掩盖，而是它们停止了啼哭和惨叫。

正在灰烬中翻找的士兵们也抬头四处寻找。

他们同样听到了歌声。

但士兵们并没有立刻拿起武器，他们的神情从惊诧变成宁静，一个个摆出侧耳聆听的模样，有的士兵甚至闭上了眼睛。

丹顿侯爵也听到了歌声。

突然！丹顿侯爵抬手，对歌声传来的方向发动攻击。

商非凡反应极快，他一直在暗中注视丹顿侯爵，在他抬起手的一刹那，立刻抱住不帅转移方位。

咔嚓！一道雷电劈在不帅刚才站立的地方。

不帅的哼唱也因此被打断。

不帅睁开眼睛，他很确定他并不是被那奇怪的歌声给蛊惑了，而是他感觉到那歌声中的力量。

那是安魂曲，他本能地想到。

是来自自然安抚灵魂，让灵魂忘却痛苦，回归天地，化作本源能量的召唤。

他以前只能听见亡者痛苦的嘶嚎，却不知道该如何安抚它们。

现在他知道了。

自然之神一直都在，就像是自然一直都存在，只是没有人再去倾听祂的声音。

祂不会去刻意地庇护谁，因为生老病死原本就是自然的一部分，包括残酷的战争、残忍的天灾以及一切已知和未知的灾难。

祂也从不去寻求人们的信仰，也极少响应。

自然之神与其说是自然的神灵，不如说是兽人乃至其他生物对自然的迫切需求而形成的精神具现物。

当人们对神灵产生怀疑，那么由人类的精神信仰凝结而成的精神具现物自然也会破碎和消失。

人们以为自然之神陨落了，也越发难以重塑过去的精神具现物。

实际上，自然一直都在那里。

不帅不知道自己是获得了自然之神的青睐，才会听到自然赐予的安魂曲，还是他特殊的听力让他听到。

也许和这座神殿的构造也有关系。

也许在很早很早以前，人类就是通过这种方式来和自然“交流”，从而获得种种神奇的能力。

而最先能听到自然声音的人，就成了自然神殿的祭司。

他们把自然形成的声音，当成了神灵的声音。

不帅见丹顿侯爵已经发现他们，干脆在商非凡耳边用老家话低语：“上面那个吊灯有着自然之神力量的气息，我感觉它在召唤我，我想取下来。”

说完，两人手牵手，迅速转换位置。

商非凡也开口说：“那是自然之神的手臂，等会儿由你取下来，再给我。”

丹顿侯爵听不懂那两个声音在说什么，他只知道他们一说话就改变位置，让他几次攻击全都落空。

两个人！

“都给我清醒点！攻击！”丹顿侯爵对士兵们爆喝。

神殿中的士兵们当即跑到丹顿身边，围成一个圈，把丹顿侯爵圈在最中间，所有士兵面朝外，开始向神殿四面八方进行攻击。

火攻、水攻，还有暗箭。

都是最常见的攻击。

但当这些常见攻击形成密集攻击时，威力就很可怕了。

商非凡和不帅在这波密集攻击中直接飞起来。

不帅一把抓住树枝型吊灯，瞬发魔法对准扣在吊灯上的锁链。

锁链断裂，吊灯落入不帅手中。

这一连串动作非常快。

丹顿侯爵和士兵们都没有注意到他们头顶上的大吊灯消失了。

商非凡跟不帅低语。

不帅就按照商非凡教他的，一边递出吊灯，一边说：“请把这支手臂还给自然之神。”

商非凡这才接过吊灯，“等我。你小心躲好。”

商非凡连同吊灯一同进入雕像广场。

他也不知道吊灯哪头才是肩头，就把吊灯一头往雕像断裂的臂膀处一戳。

吊灯自动改变外形，变成一支粗壮的树枝。

树枝和雕像的肩膀长在一起，就像是原本就是这样。

不仅如此，那代表一支手臂的树枝还缓缓长出了绿叶。

【恭喜你完成主线任务之四，寻回自然之神缺失的手臂，成功获取一万点贡献点奖励。你的天赋技能‘不死之身’，融合度达到十分之三。】

【你送回了自然之神散落的力量，得到自然之神的青睐。但受到你的血脉天赋‘恶咒’的影响，任何祝福buff都对你无效。】

【因兽人虎不帅又一次主动献出自然之神散落的力量，再次得到自然之神的青睐。凡是受到他钟爱的地方，指定区域千亩范围内，自然植物生长速度增加两倍，抗虫毒危害能力增加两倍。】

商非凡看到对于不帅的嘉奖，满意。

系统很上道，也很懂他的心。

在他身怀恶咒天赋技能，无法受到自然之神任何嘉奖的情况下，把奖励转送给他的爱人，比奖励他本人还要让他高兴，这也让他更愿意为自然之神打工。

商非凡这次没忘立刻查看不帅的气运值。

如他所料，不帅的气运值变成了：97（-94）/100

他的气运值又增加了一点。

“亲爱的，恭喜你，以后你一定会成为这个世界最受欢迎的兽人。”

不帅不解，商非凡就凑到他耳边，小声把自然之神对他的奖励内容说了。

不帅嘴巴微微张大，这个奖励真的是太实用了，尤其对现在的兽人大陆来说。

“我们一定要在春耕开始前赶回去！”不帅握拳。

商非凡笑：“当然。”

随后他又听到不帅很小声地说：“谢谢。”

商非凡正想偷个吻。

“咔嚓！”

“爵爷！”

“城主！”

士兵和侍从们惊慌的喊声响起。

“神殿裂开了！”

轰隆！

神殿不止裂开，从顶部开始，大块大块的石头砸下来。

这下好了，丹顿侯爵也顾不得寻找那两个捣乱的隐身人，只能往神殿外面跑去。

不过神殿为什么会突然塌陷？

丹顿侯爵忽然抬头，刚刚他的眼角余光扫过整个神殿，也扫过顶部，那里是不是少了什么东西？

丹顿侯爵正要细看，一名侍卫突然扑上来抱住他，用力一滚。

轰！十几块巨石同时掉落，砸在刚才丹顿侯爵站立的地方。

“哎呀，没想到拿走自然之神的部分力量，竟然会导致神殿塌方，这真的是太糟糕了。”

一道声音在丹顿侯爵耳边响起，简直就像是故意说给他听的一样。

丹顿侯爵：自然之神的力量？自然之神的力量！

丹顿侯爵忍不住再次看向已经塌方的神殿顶部，他想起来缺少的是什么了。

是那支树枝状的吊灯！

谁能想到那个东西会是自然之神力量的一部分？！

进入神殿的人哪个不被祭台上的祭品吸引，然后就会把注意力全部放在那株象征自然之神的枯树上？
chunks.englishText:
Yet Bushuai was immersed in this song, and the infant cries and female orc screams ringing in his mind were covered up.

"Hmm... hmm-hmm..." Bushuai half-closed his eyes, humming along softly to the melody of the song.

Shang Feifan cast a startled look beside him.

He couldn't see the invisible Bushuai, but he could sense that Bushuai's aura at this moment was exceptionally serene, and the song he hummed was indescribably soft and pleasant to the ear.

The infant cries and the miserable screams of the female orcs gradually grew softer—not because they were being drowned out, but because they had stopped crying and screaming altogether.

The soldiers rummaging through the ashes also raised their heads and looked around.

They, too, had heard the song.

Yet the soldiers did not immediately pick up their weapons. Their expressions shifted from astonishment to tranquility; one by one, they turned their ears to listen, and some soldiers even closed their eyes.

Marquis Danton heard the song as well.

Suddenly! Marquis Danton raised his hand and launched an attack toward the direction whence the song came.

Shang Feifan reacted with lightning speed. He had been keeping a close eye on Marquis Danton from the shadows, and the moment the man raised his hand, Shang Feifan immediately grabbed Bushuai and shifted positions.

Crack! A bolt of lightning split the air, striking right where Bushuai had been standing a moment before.

Bushuai's humming was abruptly interrupted as a result.

Bushuai opened his eyes. He was quite certain that he hadn't been bewitched by that strange song, but rather, he could feel the power contained within it.

*That is a Requiem,* he thought instinctively.

It was a call originating from nature to comfort souls, allowing them to forget their pain, return to heaven and earth, and transform into primal energy.

In the past, he could only hear the agonizing shrieks of the dead, yet he had no idea how to soothe them.

Now, he knew.

The God of Nature had always been there, just as nature itself always existed; it was simply that no one bothered to listen to His voice anymore.

He would never deliberately protect anyone, because birth, old age, sickness, and death were inherently part of nature—including cruel wars, ruthless natural disasters, and all known and unknown calamities.

He never sought human worship, nor did He often respond.

Rather than calling Him a deity of nature, the God of Nature was more of a spiritual manifestation born from the urgent longing for nature harbored by orcs and other living creatures.

When people began to doubt the deities, the spiritual manifestation condensed from human faith would naturally shatter and vanish.

People thought the God of Nature had fallen, making it increasingly difficult to reshape past spiritual manifestations.

In reality, nature had always been right there.

Bushuai did not know whether he had gained the favor of the God of Nature to hear the requiem bestowed by nature, or if it was his own extraordinary hearing that allowed him to perceive it.

Perhaps it also had something to do with the architecture of this temple.

Perhaps, in the very distant past, humans communicated with nature through this exact method, thereby acquiring all sorts of miraculous abilities.

And those who were first able to hear the voice of nature became the priests of the Temple of Nature.

They mistook the naturally formed sounds of nature for the voices of the deities.

Seeing that Marquis Danton had already discovered them, Bushuai whispered directly into Shang Feifan's ear in their hometown dialect: "That chandelier above has the aura of the God of Nature's power. I feel like it's summoning me, and I want to take it down."

With that, the two joined hands and swiftly shifted their positions.

Shang Feifan also spoke: "That is the arm of the God of Nature. You take it down later and hand it to me."

Marquis Danton could not understand what those two voices were saying. He only knew that the moment they spoke, they shifted positions, causing his successive attacks to miss completely.

Two people!

"All of you, snap out of it! Attack!" Marquis Danton bellowed at the soldiers.

The soldiers inside the temple immediately ran to the Marquis's side, forming a tight circle with Marquis Danton right in the center. All the soldiers faced outward and began launching attacks in every direction of the temple.

Fire attacks, water attacks, and hidden arrows.

They were all the most common forms of attack.

Yet when these common attacks formed a dense barrage, their might became terrifyingly formidable.

Caught in this dense onslaught, Shang Feifan and Bushuai took to the air directly.

Bushuai grabbed the branch-like chandelier and instantly cast a spell targeted at the chain securing it.

The chain snapped, and the chandelier fell into Bushuai's grasp.

This sequence of actions happened in the blink of an eye.

Neither Marquis Danton nor the soldiers noticed that the massive chandelier hanging above their heads had vanished.

Shang Feifan whispered to Bushuai.

Following Shang Feifan's instructions, Bushuai handed over the chandelier while saying, "Please return this arm to the God of Nature."

Only then did Shang Feifan take the chandelier. "Wait for me. Hide yourself carefully."

Shang Feifan, along with the chandelier, entered the statue plaza.

Not knowing which end of the chandelier was the shoulder, he simply poked one end of the chandelier toward the broken arm of the statue.

The chandelier automatically altered its shape, transforming into a thick tree branch.

The branch and the statue's shoulder fused together, looking as though it had originally been that way all along.

Not only that, but the tree branch representing the arm slowly sprouted green leaves.

[Congratulations on completing Main Quest 4: Retrieve the missing arm of the God of Nature, successfully obtaining 10,000 contribution points as a reward. The integration degree of your innate skill 'Immortal Body' has reached three-tenths.]

[You have returned the scattered power of the God of Nature and gained the favor of the God of Nature. However, affected by your bloodline innate skill 'Cursed', all blessing buffs are ineffective against you.]

[Because the orc Hu Bushuai once again proactively offered the scattered power of the God of Nature, he has once again gained the favor of the God of Nature. In any region designated by him within a thousand mu, the growth rate of natural plants will increase twofold, and their resistance to pest and poison hazards will increase twofold.]

Shang Feifan felt thoroughly satisfied upon seeing the reward meant for Bushuai.

The system was sensible and understood his heart completely.

Given that he bore the cursed innate skill and could not receive any blessings from the God of Nature, transferring the reward to his beloved was even more delightful to him than receiving it himself. This made him all the more willing to work for the God of Nature.

This time, Shang Feifan didn't forget to immediately check Bushuai's fortune value.

Just as he expected, Bushuai's fortune value had changed to: 97 (-94) / 100.

His own fortune value had increased by one point once again.

"Darling, congratulations. You will surely become the most beloved orc in this world from now on."

Bushuai looked puzzled, so Shang Feifan leaned close to his ear and whispered the contents of the reward bestowed by the God of Nature.

Bushuai's mouth opened slightly. This reward was truly practical, especially for the current Orc Continent.

"We must hurry back before spring plowing starts!" Bushuai clenched his fist.

Shang Feifan smiled: "Of course."

Shortly after, he heard Bushuai say in a very soft voice, "Thank you."

Shang Feifan was just about to steal a kiss.

"Crack!"

"My Lord!"

"City Lord!"

The panicked shouts of the soldiers and attendants rang out.

"The temple is splitting open!"

Boom!

The temple didn't just split open; starting from the roof, massive chunks of stone came crashing down.

Well, that settled it. Marquis Danton no longer had the luxury of searching for those two troublemaking invisible figures and could only run toward the outside of the temple.

Yet why would the temple suddenly collapse?

Marquis Danton suddenly raised his head. Just moments ago, his peripheral vision had swept across the entire temple, including the ceiling—wasn't something missing from up there?

Just as Marquis Danton was about to look closer, a guard suddenly lunged forward, grabbed him, and rolled hard to the side.

Boom! Over a dozen giant boulders plummeted down simultaneously, smashing right into the spot where Marquis Danton had been standing a second ago.

"Oh my, I never expected that taking away a portion of the God of Nature's power would cause the temple to collapse. That is truly terrible."

A voice rang out right beside Marquis Danton's ear, sounding as if it were deliberately spoken for him to hear.

Marquis Danton: The power of the God of Nature? The power of the God of Nature!

Marquis Danton couldn't help but look back up at the collapsed roof of the temple. He remembered what was missing.

It was that branch-shaped chandelier!

Who could have guessed that such an object was a part of the power of the God of Nature?!

Which of those who entered the temple wasn't captivated by the offerings on the altar, thereby focusing all their attention on the withered tree symbolizing the God of Nature?

chunks.chineseText:
谁会去注意神殿里的一盏吊灯？

不，他不相信那盏吊灯就是自然之神力量的一部分。

可又要如何解释吊灯一消失，整个神殿就开始倒塌的事实？

也许是那株枯树被焚毁后的影响才刚刚蔓延开来……

“爵爷！小心！”

地面突然塌陷，丹顿侯爵连同他的士兵和侍从一起落入地下。

同一时间，炙热橘红的岩浆喷射而出。

“卧槽！”商非凡刚喊出口。

就听到不帅大喊：“危险！快走！”

两人几乎同时取消隐身效果。

不帅握着商非凡的手，施展飞行魔法，带着商非凡就向神殿外飞去。

地面不断塌陷，岩浆从地下喷涌而出。

神殿还在塌方，大块的石头砸入岩浆，溅起炙热的岩浆液。

大门倒塌。

神殿外的看守士兵大喊着“侯爵”和“城主”，见没有人回应，再看到神殿地面不断涌出岩浆，只能后退，最后全都拔腿狂跑。

“那个丹顿侯爵不会就这么死了吧？”不帅呢喃。

商非凡：“谁知道呢。就像是谁知道黑森林城竟然是建造在火山顶上。”

“可这里是平原，根本就没有火山。”

“火山也不全都是山，也有平原下面是满满的岩浆库，只是地层足够厚实，一般不会出事。可一旦压力达到一定程度，大地就会被强大的压力挤出裂缝，地底岩浆就会从这些裂缝中宣泄而出。”

两人飞到车站上空，岩浆还没有蔓延过来。

平原岩浆层的流动速度比火山爆发要慢，因为没有一个从高往下的加速度。

周围没有离开的路，看似路的地方走过去总是会绕回神殿前。

这里不是异度空间，更像是自然形成的天然迷宫，这里的一切都会影响进出者的五感，让他们无法找到正确进入和离开神殿的道路。

士兵们跟没头苍蝇一样到处乱跑，但他们全都找不到真正出去的路。

以前丹顿侯爵就派遣士兵在神殿周围仔细排查过，想要找出除了有缘车以外的道路，但至今为止没有一个人找到。

商非凡和不帅同样如此。

也许多花一点时间，凭借他们的个人能力，他们也许能找到道路出去，但现在他们最缺少的就是时间。

不帅尝试性地带着商非凡落到车站站台上。

这次有缘车出现得很快。

一辆真正的公交车，至少能塞下上百人。

车门打开。

不帅和商非凡上车。

有士兵看到车子，试探地冲了过来。

当他抓住车门，踏上台阶时，没有任何人阻止他。

这名士兵立刻回头，对同伴狂喊：“这里！快！”

其他在寻找生路的士兵慌乱下也全都冲了过来。

二十四名士兵全都冲上了公交车。

他们看到了商非凡和不帅，他们就坐在最后排。

但这些士兵什么都没有说，只全都或站或坐了下来。

有些事情不需要问，两人没有阻止他们上车，没有让车辆立刻离开，就已经说明了一切。

同样，商非凡和不帅也不需要这些士兵的感谢。

当最后一名士兵冲上车，不帅在心中想：离开。

车门缓缓关上。

啪！一只手夹在了车门和门框之间。

那只手硬是掰开车门，身体挤了上来。

丹顿侯爵铁黑色的盔甲变得赤红，他一步步走进车厢。

商非凡撇嘴：果然坏人都不那么容易死掉，何况还是个中级boss。

之前他们没有攻击这位侯爵也是对的，看看他的盔甲，竟然连岩浆都能扛得住！

不帅的骨杖指向丹顿侯爵。

“城主！”士兵们齐齐站起，有人想要上前搀扶他。

哗啦。

盔甲变成零碎落地。

露出里面全身湿透且皮肤赤红的丹顿侯爵。

丹顿侯爵抬手，制止士兵搀扶他，他不需要。

“离开这里！”

车门关闭，车子没动。

丹顿侯爵看向坐在最后排的两人，慢慢走过去。

士兵们全都紧张地看向三人。

“让这辆车离开第一重神殿。留下，我们所有人都得死在这儿。”

不帅动了动，被商非凡按住手。

两人不说话，只看着这位侯爵。

商非凡还在心里嘀咕：要不是已经知道这不是游戏，他一定会投诉游戏开发公司，为什么把反派一个个都设定得这么帅气俊美。

这个丹顿侯爵完全看不出年龄，他的外形和气质完全符合小女生对位高权重的贵族的幻想。

这是一个真什么都不用做，只一个眼神就能让无数男女为他疯狂的雄性。

“各位乘客，欢迎乘坐此趟地狱班车，想要乘坐本车离开地狱，请付清乘车费用。”戴着围巾的商非凡露出上半张脸，微笑。

“你们要什么？”丹顿侯爵平静地问。

“真相。还有让地下城的所有人离开，让地面上的腐蚀雨立刻停止。”不帅开口。

商非凡在心中叹了口气，他家不帅真的不适合谈判啊。

不过无所谓，爱人太完美，他不就很没用了？

不帅已经很厉害，这种小事就交给他吧。

CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第108章 意外收获 (Part 3)):
"""
谁会去注意神殿里的一盏吊灯？

不，他不相信那盏吊灯就是自然之神力量的一部分。

可又要如何解释吊灯一消失，整个神殿就开始倒塌的事实？

也许是那株枯树被焚毁后的影响才刚刚蔓延开来……

“爵爷！小心！”

地面突然塌陷，丹顿侯爵连同他的士兵和侍从一起落入地下。

同一时间，炙热橘红的岩浆喷射而出。

“卧槽！”商非凡刚喊出口。

就听到不帅大喊：“危险！快走！”

两人几乎同时取消隐身效果。

不帅握着商非凡的手，施展飞行魔法，带着商非凡就向神殿外飞去。

地面不断塌陷，岩浆从地下喷涌而出。

神殿还在塌方，大块的石头砸入岩浆，溅起炙热的岩浆液。

大门倒塌。

神殿外的看守士兵大喊着“侯爵”和“城主”，见没有人回应，再看到神殿地面不断涌出岩浆，只能后退，最后全都拔腿狂跑。

“那个丹顿侯爵不会就这么死了吧？”不帅呢喃。

商非凡：“谁知道呢。就像是谁知道黑森林城竟然是建造在火山顶上。”

“可这里是平原，根本就没有火山。”

“火山也不全都是山，也有平原下面是满满的岩浆库，只是地层足够厚实，一般不会出事。可一旦压力达到一定程度，大地就会被强大的压力挤出裂缝，地底岩浆就会从这些裂缝中宣泄而出。”

两人飞到车站上空，岩浆还没有蔓延过来。

平原岩浆层的流动速度比火山爆发要慢，因为没有一个从高往下的加速度。

周围没有离开的路，看似路的地方走过去总是会绕回神殿前。

这里不是异度空间，更像是自然形成的天然迷宫，这里的一切都会影响进出者的五感，让他们无法找到正确进入和离开神殿的道路。

士兵们跟没头苍蝇一样到处乱跑，但他们全都找不到真正出去的路。

以前丹顿侯爵就派遣士兵在神殿周围仔细排查过，想要找出除了有缘车以外的道路，但至今为止没有一个人找到。

商非凡和不帅同样如此。

也许多花一点时间，凭借他们的个人能力，他们也许能找到道路出去，但现在他们最缺少的就是时间。

不帅尝试性地带着商非凡落到车站站台上。

这次有缘车出现得很快。

一辆真正的公交车，至少能塞下上百人。

车门打开。

不帅和商非凡上车。

有士兵看到车子，试探地冲了过来。

当他抓住车门，踏上台阶时，没有任何人阻止他。

这名士兵立刻回头，对同伴狂喊：“这里！快！”

其他在寻找生路的士兵慌乱下也全都冲了过来。

二十四名士兵全都冲上了公交车。

他们看到了商非凡和不帅，他们就坐在最后排。

但这些士兵什么都没有说，只全都或站或坐了下来。

有些事情不需要问，两人没有阻止他们上车，没有让车辆立刻离开，就已经说明了一切。

同样，商非凡和不帅也不需要这些士兵的感谢。

当最后一名士兵冲上车，不帅在心中想：离开。

车门缓缓关上。

啪！一只手夹在了车门和门框之间。

那只手硬是掰开车门，身体挤了上来。

丹顿侯爵铁黑色的盔甲变得赤红，他一步步走进车厢。

商非凡撇嘴：果然坏人都不那么容易死掉，何况还是个中级boss。

之前他们没有攻击这位侯爵也是对的，看看他的盔甲，竟然连岩浆都能扛得住！

不帅的骨杖指向丹顿侯爵。

“城主！”士兵们齐齐站起，有人想要上前搀扶他。

哗啦。

盔甲变成零碎落地。

露出里面全身湿透且皮肤赤红的丹顿侯爵。

丹顿侯爵抬手，制止士兵搀扶他，他不需要。

“离开这里！”

车门关闭，车子没动。

丹顿侯爵看向坐在最后排的两人，慢慢走过去。

士兵们全都紧张地看向三人。

“让这辆车离开第一重神殿。留下，我们所有人都得死在这儿。”

不帅动了动，被商非凡按住手。

两人不说话，只看着这位侯爵。

商非凡还在心里嘀咕：要不是已经知道这不是游戏，他一定会投诉游戏开发公司，为什么把反派一个个都设定得这么帅气俊美。

这个丹顿侯爵完全看不出年龄，他的外形和气质完全符合小女生对位高权重的贵族的幻想。

这是一个真什么都不用做，只一个眼神就能让无数男女为他疯狂的雄性。

“各位乘客，欢迎乘坐此趟地狱班车，想要乘坐本车离开地狱，请付清乘车费用。”戴着围巾的商非凡露出上半张脸，微笑。

“你们要什么？”丹顿侯爵平静地问。

“真相。还有让地下城的所有人离开，让地面上的腐蚀雨立刻停止。”不帅开口。

商非凡在心中叹了口气，他家不帅真的不适合谈判啊。

不过无所谓，爱人太完美，他不就很没用了？

不帅已经很厉害，这种小事就交给他吧。
"""

chunks.chineseText:
第109章 小纸条

丹顿侯爵此时也在猜测两人的身份，尤其是商非凡。

商非凡这个人哪怕遮上半张脸，也能看出他有多不好惹。

没什么社会经验的新人，和老-江湖那遇到任何事情都游刃有余的自如气质，就如天壤之别。

后者演前者可以，但前者想要演好后者，就算演技再好的人也只能欺骗一时。

且商非凡的气质也不是属于常年混迹于社会底层的混混型，而更像是刀头舔血的佣兵头子或者是一方豪强。

丹顿侯爵宁可碰到一些难缠的大贵族，都不愿意碰到这种人，因为这种人太过难测。

对比这个只露出半张脸也能看出容颜有多优异的雄性兽人，开口就说出要求的另一个兽人看起来似乎要平凡得多也好说话得多，虽然他的态度很强硬。

丹顿侯爵眼睛扫过不帅的上半张脸，忽然觉得这半张脸看起来有点眼熟。

他绝对见过这人，是谁？

“我伙伴的话你也听到了，不和我们聊聊吗？”商非凡架起腿。

丹顿侯爵沉默。

“你是不是笃定如果我们不让车辆离开车站，我们也会被岩浆追上？”商非凡一句话就把丹顿侯爵的注意力全部吸引过去。

丹顿侯爵确实有恃无恐，他已经上车，就和车中人绑在了一起，他们走，他也会跟着离开。

他就不信这两个有缘人这时候还能把他扔下车。

“岩浆距离我们还有三十五米左右，按照现在的流速，大约二十秒左右就能流到这里。我不知道你和这些士兵有没有脱离危险的方法，但我和我的同伴就算不乘坐这辆车，我们也可以脱离这里。”

“我们不在乎这辆车把我们带去哪里，不去那神秘的未知地也无所谓，但你想去对吗？虽然我觉得你就算过去也不会有什么收获。”商非凡无意识地小小乌鸦嘴了一下。

“所以我们不妨等到最后一秒。”商非凡真不紧不慢。

丹顿侯爵知道这是心理博弈，赌的就是谁更能稳得住。

而最能稳住的就是拥有王炸底牌的人，现在对方向他亮出底气，表示他们能在最后一秒脱身。

然后就轮到他来猜测对方说的是不是真的，相不相信他们真有这样的底牌。

选择权看似在他手上，但在他明知自己的底牌没有任何胜面的情况下，他已经毫无选择。

二十四名士兵都没有说话，他们看似都在支持他们的侯爵大人，但谁知道他们心里到底在想什么？

丹顿侯爵这时孤立无援，他的最大依仗全身盔甲已经被岩浆摧毁，他本身天赋能力不弱，但他也不敢自信说一定能解决这两个让那么多邪神信徒都无可奈何的家伙。

他需要这二十四名士兵，更需要离开第一重神殿。

“你们想要知道真相？只怕我说出来，你们也不会相信。”

“你可以试试。我们还有约莫十秒左右。”商非凡淡淡说。

丹顿侯爵不想弱了气势，他讨厌别人坐着，他站着说话。

但这辆车的布局非常古怪，除了最后和最前面的座位，其他座位分左右两侧全都面向前方排列。

“好，你们想要知道真相，那我就给你们真相。”

丹顿侯爵突然一笑，那笑容中满含讽刺：“真相就是你们现在看到的，整个虎国有一半以上土地就在一个巨大的岩浆湖上方。如果不能加以控制，岩浆就会像今天一样爆发，把整个虎国都毁灭掉！”

“你不会是想告诉我，你和邪神信徒合作，就是想要借用邪神的力量来扼制岩浆爆发？”商非凡声音中充满不可思议。

丹顿侯爵冷笑：“这很难想象吗？当我们的正神全都放弃我们，没有一个响应我们，更没有一个肯拯救我们，我选择和能响应自己信徒的邪神合作，这很奇怪吗？”

岩浆就要淹没到车轮。

不帅心念一动，车辆移动起来。

这辆车就行驶在岩浆上，却像是没有受到任何影响。

看到车子动起来，士兵们全都松了口气。

丹顿侯爵表情没变，但他在后排靠近两人的位置找了个座位坐下。

商非凡：“你的出发点不奇怪，奇怪且让人无法接受的是你的作为。你想要拯救虎国，却要献祭一座城的城民？”

丹顿侯爵：“这是邪神信徒的要求，他们的神不会白干活。”

“你这样做，有没有问过虎王？有没有问过这满城城民？有没有问过你的士兵？”商非凡跟聊家常一样，脸上甚至还带着一丝笑。

“不需要。我是这座城的城主，是这个国家的一等侯爵，为了虎国，我可以做任何事情。”丹顿侯爵还有一句话没说——士兵不需要知道太多，他们只需要听令就可以。

“那你有没有想过跟虎国的全体民众发出警告，让他们搬迁，等岩浆爆发后再回来？”不帅忍不住插话。

丹顿侯爵嘴角浮起轻蔑的讽刺：“然后让他们恐慌不安，让他们四处逃亡，让虎国陷入动乱，让各地领主趁机叛乱，让其他国家的人趁火打劫，掠夺我们的人口甚至是土地？”

不帅皱眉：“那是没有规划后随便暴露消息的后果。但如果做好万全准备……”

“根本没有所谓的万全准备！”丹顿侯爵一口打断：“只一点，光是转移人口就是最大问题。你要明白，会爆发岩浆灾害的不是一座城，也不是一片区域，而是大半个虎国！”

“大半个虎国的国民全部转移，能转移到哪里？那些安全地方的领主和领民们愿意让不相干的人来他们的土地上抢夺他们本就不多的生存资源么？”

“还是说要掀起战争，去抢夺别的国家的土地和资源？”

“不管如何做，虎国都会因为这次岩浆灾难遇到极大危急，搞不好就会灭国。我就问你们，在这种情况下，你们是否愿意献出一座城的城民来获取整个虎国的安定？”

不帅和商非凡互视。

这位领主的口才真好，他们差点都要被说服了。

“你又怎么知道当你向邪神献祭一座城的城民，就能让整个虎国的国土都不会再爆发岩浆灾害？这个安定又能维持多久？”不帅问。

丹顿侯爵轻嗤：“我就知道你们会问这个问题。很简单，黑森林城乃至王城这么多年能蓬勃发展，没有碰到大的天灾，全是因为从我的曾祖父那一辈开始就在努力。”

“当年，第一代黑森林城民之所以会全体搬迁出地下城，不是因为地下城的土地产出已经供养不起那么多城民，也不是因为生活在地下城会让寿命缩短。而是因为我的曾祖父找到了地下城土地不再产出，以及生活在地下城会寿命减短的根由！”

“就因为地下城的下面是岩浆层，地下城的土壤全都被岩浆的火毒破坏，包括兽人们也在不知不觉间吸入大量火毒，导致寿命减短。”

不帅真心不解：“也就是说那么早你们就发现了危机，为什么还要在地下城上面建造黑森林城？”

“因为王城就在附近，我们需要拱卫王城。”丹顿侯爵回答。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 109: The Small Note

Marquis Danton was also trying to guess the identities of the two men, especially Shang Feifan.

Even with half of his face covered, one could tell just how formidable and untamable Shang Feifan was.

There was a world of difference between a newcomer with little worldly experience and an old-hand who moved through any situation with effortless ease. 

While an experienced veteran could pretend to be a novice, no matter how good an actor a true novice was, they could only fool people temporarily.

Furthermore, Shang Feifan's temperament did not belong to a street thug who had spent years at the bottom of society. Rather, he resembled a blade-licking mercenary leader or a supreme overlord of a region.

Marquis Danton would rather encounter some thorny, high-ranking nobles than ever cross paths with a man like this, because such individuals were entirely unpredictable.

Compared to this male beast-person whose exceptional beauty was visible even with half his face obscured, the other beast-person—who had stated his demands right off the bat—appeared far more ordinary and approachable, even if his attitude was exceptionally rigid.

Marquis Danton’s eyes swept across Bu Shuai’s upper face, and suddenly, he found those features looking rather familiar.

He had definitely seen this person before. Who was it?

"You heard my partner. Aren't you going to chat with us?" Shang Feifan crossed his legs.

Marquis Danton remained silent.

"Are you betting that if we don't let the vehicle leave the station, we will also be swallowed by the lava?" Shang Feifan’s single sentence instantly reeled all of Marquis Danton's attention back.

Marquis Danton was indeed acting with unconcerned impunity; he had already boarded the vehicle and was now bound to everyone inside it. If they left, he would leave with them.

He refused to believe these two destiny-fated fellows would throw him off the vehicle at a time like this.

"The lava is still about thirty-five meters away from us. At its current flow rate, it will reach here in roughly twenty seconds. I don't know if you and these soldiers have a way to escape danger, but my companion and I can leave this place even without taking this carriage."

"We don't care where this vehicle takes us, and it doesn't matter if we miss that mysterious unknown destination, but you want to go there, right? Though I have a feeling you won't gain anything even if you cross over." Shang Feifan subconsciously uttered a tiny, ill-omened jinx.

"So, we might as well wait until the very last second." Shang Feifan remained utterly unhurried.

Marquis Danton knew this was a psychological game of chicken, a gamble on who possessed the steadier nerves.

And the one who could remain the steadiest was the person holding the ultimate trump card. Now, the other party was showing him their hand, demonstrating that they could make their escape at the very last second.

Then it became his turn to guess whether what the other side said was true, and whether to believe they actually possessed such a trump card.

The power of choice seemed to be in his hands, but knowing full well that his own cards held zero chance of victory, he had already run out of choices.

The twenty-four soldiers remained silent. They appeared to be standing by their Lord Marquis, but who knew what they were truly thinking inside?

Marquis Danton found himself isolated and helpless at this moment. His greatest reliance—his full suit of armor—had been destroyed by the lava. His innate magical abilities were not weak, but he dared not claim absolute certainty that he could deal with these two fellows who had left so many evil god cultists completely helpless.

He needed these twenty-four soldiers, and even more so, he needed to leave the First Temple.

"You want to know the truth? I'm afraid that even if I tell you, you won't believe it."

"You can give it a try. We have roughly ten seconds left," Shang Feifan said indifferently.

Marquis Danton had no desire to lose his momentum. He hated the fact that they were sitting while he had to stand and talk.

However, the layout of this vehicle was bizarre in the extreme. Aside from the seats at the very back and the very front, all the other seats were arranged along the left and right sides, facing forward.

"Fine. Since you want to know the truth, I'll give you the truth."

Marquis Danton suddenly smiled, a smile brimming with mockery: "The truth is right before your eyes. More than half of the entire Tiger Kingdom's territory rests directly above a massive lava lake! If it cannot be kept under control, the lava will erupt just like it is doing today and completely destroy the entire Tiger Kingdom!"

"You wouldn't happen to be trying to tell me that your collaboration with the evil god cultists is meant to borrow the evil god's power to suppress a lava eruption?" Shang Feifan's voice was laden with incredulity.

Marquis Danton sneered: "Is that so hard to imagine? When all of our orthodox gods abandoned us, when not a single one responded to us, and not one was willing to save us, is it really that strange that I chose to cooperate with an evil god who actually responds to his followers?"

The lava was about to submerge the tires.

With a thought from Bu Shuai, the vehicle began to move.

Though driving right across the churning lava, the vehicle seemed completely unaffected by it.

Seeing the carriage move, all the soldiers let out a collective breath of relief.

Marquis Danton's expression remained unchanged, but he found a seat in the back row close to the two men and sat down.

Shang Feifan remarked: "Your starting point isn't strange. What is strange and utterly unacceptable is your actions. You want to save the Tiger Kingdom, yet you plan to sacrifice the citizens of an entire city?"

Marquis Danton replied: "That was the demand of the evil god's cultists. Their god does not work for free."

"When you did this, did you ever consult the Tiger King? Did you ask the citizens of this entire city? Did you ask your soldiers?" Shang Feifan spoke as if chatting about daily household matters, a faint smile even lingering on his face.

"There was no need. I am the lord of this city, a first-class marquis of this nation. For the sake of the Tiger Kingdom, I can do anything." Marquis Danton left one sentence unsaid—*soldiers don't need to know too much; they only need to follow orders.*

"Then have you ever thought about issuing a warning to all the citizens of the Tiger Kingdom, having them evacuate, and letting them return after the lava eruption subsides?" Bu Shuai couldn't help chiming in.

The corners of Marquis Danton's mouth curled into a contemptuous sneer: "And then cause them to panic and descend into unrest? Let the Tiger Kingdom plunge into chaos, allow local lords to seize the opportunity to rebel, and let opportunists from other countries pillage our population and even our territory?"

Bu Shuai frowned: "That is the consequence of carelessly leaking information without proper planning. But if complete preparations are made..."

"There is no such thing as complete preparations!" Marquis Danton cut him off sharply: "Take just one point: the mere relocation of the population is the biggest problem. You must understand that the disaster of a lava eruption is not limited to a single city, nor a single region; it threatens well over half of the Tiger Kingdom!"

"With the entire population of more than half the Tiger Kingdom relocating, where can they possibly be moved to? Are the lords and commoners of those safe lands willing to let unrelated outsiders trample onto their territories and plunder their already scarce survival resources?"

"Or should we spark a war to seize the land and resources of other countries?"

"No matter what course of action is taken, the Tiger Kingdom will face an extreme crisis because of this lava disaster, and it might very well perish as a nation. Let me ask you: under such circumstances, would you be willing to sacrifice the citizens of a single city to secure stability for the entire Tiger Kingdom?"

Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan exchanged glances.

This lord truly possessed a silver tongue; they had almost been persuaded.

"And how could you possibly know that sacrificing the citizens of one city to the evil god would prevent lava disasters from ever erupting across the rest of the Tiger Kingdom's territory? Just how long could this stability be maintained?" Bu Shuai asked.

Marquis Danton let out a light scoff: "I knew you would ask that question. It's very simple. The reason Black Forest City and even the Royal City have been able to flourish for so many years without encountering major natural disasters is entirely because my family has been working hard toward this since the generation of my great-grandfather."

"Back then, the reason the first generation of Black Forest City residents collectively migrated out of the underground city was not because the underground city's land could no longer sustain so many citizens, nor because living underground shortened one's lifespan. It was because my great-grandfather discovered the root cause of why the underground city's soil stopped yielding crops and why living underground shortened people's lifespans!"

"It was because right beneath the underground city lay a layer of magma, and all the soil of the underground city had been corrupted by the fire poison of the lava—including the beast-persons themselves, who unknowingly inhaled vast amounts of fire poison, leading to shortened lifespans."

Bu Shuai was genuinely baffled: "Meaning you discovered the crisis that early on—why on earth would you still build Black Forest City right on top of the underground city?"

"Because the Royal City was nearby, and we needed to guard and defend the Royal City," Marquis Danton replied.

chunks.chineseText:
“哈！”商非凡笑出声。

他故意对不帅说：“你相信这一家世世代代都如此忠心吗？就因为王城在附近，就跟历代虎王隐瞒他们的王城和附属城全都建立在一个庞大的岩浆湖上的秘密？”

不帅缓慢摇头。

商非凡提高声音：“事实告诉我们。如果有人能住在闹鬼的房子里还死活不搬，不是穷到没钱搬家，就是那栋房子里藏有无数金达盾！”

丹顿侯爵不再说话，似乎不屑于再回答两人的问题。

不帅捏紧拳头：“你们早就知道！你们有几百年的时间让历代虎王做准备，可你们却什么都没有说！哪怕是你，你和虎王关系那么好，你的妹妹还是虎王的王后，只要你告诉虎王，虎王完全可以提前几十年做准备……”

有士兵垂下眼眸，也有士兵悄悄握紧武器，更有士兵眼中流露出茫然和怀疑。

“那你们想过消息泄露的后果吗？”丹顿侯爵不屑：“跟你们这些平民真没什么好说的，你们什么都不懂，根本不明白管理一个国家、让一个国家延续下去有多难。”

商非凡的拳头痒了。

丹顿侯爵忽然问：“你是谁？我是不是见过你？”

不帅深吸气，对丹顿侯爵说：“不管你是为了什么，现在你的计划已经失败，岩浆已经爆发出来，你总能让地面上的腐蚀雨停止了吧？”

丹顿侯爵幽幽道：“我没有失败。只要岩浆能在地下城层面快速凝固，不再继续爆发下去，地面上的一切就都能保存下来。牺牲是必须的，我本来不想他们死得太痛苦，是你们破坏了对厄穆克拉索的献祭，是你们延长了那些城民的痛苦！”

艹！不帅气得要打人。

商非凡拉住他。

“这么说腐蚀雨也是召唤厄穆克拉索力量的一环？”商非凡问。

丹顿侯爵拒绝回答。

商非凡却了然地点点头：“那些邪神信徒一个劲跟我说，痛苦、悲伤、妒忌、愤怒、怨恨……这些都是唤醒和愉悦厄穆克拉索的要素。腐蚀雨虽然不会立刻杀死无数城民，却能令他们品尝到悲痛、愤怒和怨恨等各种负面情绪。这么多负面情绪，厄穆克拉索一定会很高兴，祂会因此把目光投注此地。”

“对了，我们曾经在摩罗城发现了一座邪神营地，他们也在祭拜一座邪神雕像，雕像下埋着一口箱子，还有摩罗城中-出现虫毒散播者的地方也埋着一口箱子。猜猜看，我们在箱子里发现了什么？”

车内士兵都竖起了耳朵，今天他们真的听到太多秘密，他们已经不求着能活着回去，死前能多听一些秘密也是好的。

不等任何人回答，商非凡就主动说道：“一对母子。一对被活生生剥皮而死，死前受尽无尽折磨饱含无尽怨气的亲生母子。”

商非凡的声音突然变得阴森：“丹顿侯爵，你的原配夫人和你的小儿子，他们还好吗？”

车上没有人说话，车内一时变得安静至极。

“……我一直在寻找他们。”丹顿侯爵声音变得低沉又充满悲痛，他还转过头问：“你们说的那一对母子，他们的尸体在哪里？”

商非凡歪头看不帅，认真说：“记住了，以后不管我们有多少儿女，我们都要从小告诉他们，让他们一定要睁大他们的钛合金狗眼，千万别看错人。这不小心嫁错了、娶错了，可不是伤心，而是伤命啊。”

不帅拍拍他的手背，不过脑地说：“我们会是他们最强大的后盾。我们不是某些懦弱的被权势压制到不敢为自己儿女说话，或被利益诱惑可以献祭自己儿女的……”

嗯？不帅回过神。

“对。谁敢伤害我们的儿女，我们作为父亲一定会去狠狠地教训那些虫日的混蛋！”商非凡迅速接口，还挥了挥拳头。

不帅：“……”你够了！

丹顿侯爵没有得到答案，不知道是懒得再扮演伤心的丈夫和父亲，还是另有谋算，他双拳紧握，背脊笔直地坐在简陋的塑料椅子上，不再说话。

商非凡也没指望只是跟这位侯爵聊聊天就能说动他停止他的阴谋。

他们只是想要知道丹顿侯爵为什么要这么做。

丹顿侯爵说了“真相”，但商非凡和不帅两人都不相信这是真正的原因。

这世上确实是有能为了一车人舍弃几个人的决定者，但只要有心的人都不可能做到毫无纠结毫无愧疚并理所当然地认为自己的选择是对的。

何况这并不是几个人，而是几万乃至几十万城民。

就算岩浆真的大爆发，如果有人能提前告知，让大家提前做好准备，就算加上各种有可能的动乱，最后的死亡数量说不定还没这么多。

丹顿侯爵提出来的问题确实会让上位者头疼，但就如不帅所说，如果丹顿侯爵的家族早在几百年前就知道岩浆的事，他们只要告诉虎王，那么历代虎王就有几百年的时间来准备这件事。

不说几百年，就是十年，也足够虎国去应对这样的灾难。

但丹顿家族硬生生隐瞒到现在，如今还搞出一副他们为了全虎国人不得不牺牲、不得不去做一个不被人理解的悲情英雄模样。

商非凡真心觉得好笑。

他之前觉得丹顿侯爵算得上是一个枭雄，现在只觉得对方就是个把别人都当傻子耍的小丑。

不过丹顿侯爵显然不会认为自己是个小丑，相反他可能真没把普通兽人放在眼里，甚至于除他之外，包括虎王在内的兽人在他眼里都是不能和他并列的劣等兽人。

可惜这个小丑掌握着至高的权力，他还掌握着数量过万的武装势力。

商非凡冷静地压住不帅，示意他不要动手。

他总觉得这个丹顿侯爵有点怪，但他暂时还没看出对方怪在哪里，但直觉告诉他，现在还不是动手揍人的时候。

公交车停住，车门嘎吱一声打开。

“寻宝罗盘还能用吗？能更改一下寻宝罗盘的功能吗？除了原先的寻宝功能，再增加一个在方圆千米之内发现自然之神的力量，就主动跳出来提示的功能。”商非凡用母语问系统。

不帅转头看他。

上次寻宝罗盘帮忙抓住不帅心脏中那只自然之神的耳朵，就隐身不见。也不知道是能量消耗太多，还是直接就不能用了。刚才发现自然之神的手臂也没主动跳出来。

【能用，可以。稍等两分钟，系统更新中。更新期间，系统暂时无法使用。】

商非凡就在车内坐了两分钟，期间掏出一张纸，写了一句话。

不帅好奇地凑过去看。

丹顿侯爵看到车门敞开，不等两人动作，就抢先下车。

那二十四名士兵有些人稍有迟疑，但也跟着下了车。

不帅看商非凡没动，就也没动。

商非凡身体能动，他只是以防万一才没下车，就坐在车里看着那位丹顿侯爵带着二十四名士兵踏上第二重神殿的台阶。

【更新完毕。】

商非凡见寻宝罗盘没有自己跳出来，就主动召唤。

一只金光闪闪的小号罗盘出息在他的视界中。
chunks.englishText:
"Ha!" Shang Feifan let out a laugh.

He deliberately said to Bu Shuai: "Do you believe that this family has been so loyal generation after generation? Just because the Royal City was nearby, they concealed the secret from generations of Tiger Kings that both the Royal City and its vassal cities were built on top of a massive lava lake?"

Bu Shuai slowly shook his head.

Shang Feifan raised his voice: "Facts tell us: if someone can live in a haunted house and stubbornly refuse to move out, either they are too poor to afford a move, or that house is hiding countless gold daldons!"

Marquis Danton fell silent once more, appearing to disdain answering their questions any further.

Bu Shuai clenched his fists: "You knew all along! You had hundreds of years to let successive Tiger Kings make preparations, yet you said nothing! Even you—your relationship with the Tiger King was so close, and your younger sister is even the Queen of the Tiger King. As long as you had told the Tiger King, he could have made preparations decades in advance..."

Some of the soldiers lowered their gazes, others quietly tightened their grips on their weapons, and a few even had expressions of confusion and doubt flickering in their eyes.

"And have you ever considered the consequences of information leaking?" Marquis Danton said dismissively: "There's really no point talking to commoners like you. You understand nothing and have no inkling of how difficult it is to govern a country and keep it enduring."

Shang Feifan's fists were beginning to itch.

Marquis Danton suddenly asked: "Who are you? Have I seen you before?"

Bu Shuai took a deep breath and said to Marquis Danton: "Whatever your reasons may be, your plan has now failed and the lava has erupted. At the very least, you can stop the corrosive rain on the surface, right?"

Marquis Danton said with an eerie calmness: "I have not failed. As long as the lava solidifies rapidly at the underground city level and stops erupting further, everything on the surface can be preserved. Sacrifice is necessary. I originally didn't want them to die too painfully; it was you two who ruined the sacrifice to Eumuklaso, and it was you who prolonged the suffering of those townspeople!"

*Damn it!* Bu Shuai was so angry he wanted to hit someone.

Shang Feifan grabbed his arm.

"So you're saying the corrosive rain is also part of summoning Eumuklaso's power?" Shang Feifan asked.

Marquis Danton refused to answer.

Shang Feifan, however, nodded knowingly: "Those evil god cultists kept telling me that pain, sorrow, jealousy, anger, hatred... these are all elements that awaken and please Eumuklaso. Although the corrosive rain won't instantly kill countless townspeople, it forces them to taste all kinds of negative emotions like grief, anger, and resentment. With so much negative emotion, Eumuklaso will certainly be very pleased, and He will cast His gaze upon this place because of it."

"Right, we once discovered an evil god camp in Moro City. They were also worshiping an evil god statue, with a chest buried beneath it, and a chest was also buried in the place where the insect-poison spreader appeared in Moro City. Guess what we found inside those chests?"

The soldiers inside the carriage all pricked up their ears. Today, they had truly heard too many secrets; they no longer cared about making it back alive—hearing a few more secrets before death was already a blessing.

Without waiting for anyone to answer, Shang Feifan took the initiative to speak: "A pair of mother and child. A biological mother and child who were skinned alive, suffering endless torture before death and filled with boundless grievance."

Shang Feifan's voice suddenly turned bone-chillingly eerie: "Marquis Danton, how are your lawful wife and your youngest son doing?"

No one in the carriage spoke; the interior fell into an absolute, pin-drop silence.

"...I have been searching for them all this time." Marquis Danton's voice grew deep and laden with grief, and he even turned his head to ask: "Where are the bodies of that mother and child you mentioned?"

Shang Feifan tilted his head to look at Bu Shuai, and said earnestly: "Remember this: no matter how many sons and daughters we have in the future, we must teach them from a young age to keep their titanium-alloy dog eyes wide open and never misjudge a person. Marrying or wedding the wrong person isn't just heartbreaking—it's life-threatening."

Bu Shuai patted the back of his hand, blurting out without thinking: "We will be their strongest backing. We aren't like some cowards who are so suppressed by power that they dare not speak up for their own children, or so tempted by profit that they would sacrifice their own offspring..."

*Huh?* Bu Shuai snapped back to his senses.

"Right. Whoever dares to hurt our children, as fathers, we will definitely go and fiercely teach those insect-fucking bastards a lesson!" Shang Feifan quickly chimed in, even throwing a punch in the air.

Bu Shuai: "..." *Enough is enough!*

Marquis Danton received no answer. Whether he was too lazy to continue playing the grieving husband and father or was plotting something else, he sat stiff-backed on the crude plastic chair with clenched fists and said no more.

Shang Feifan hadn't expected that a simple chat with this marquis would talk him out of his conspiracy.

They merely wanted to know why Marquis Danton was doing this.

Marquis Danton had stated the "truth," but neither Shang Feifan nor Bu Shuai believed that was the real reason.

Indeed, there were decision-makers in this world capable of abandoning a few people for the sake of a carriage full of passengers, but anyone with a conscience could never do so without internal struggle or guilt, let alone take it for granted that their choice was right.

Moreover, this wasn't just a few people—it was tens or even hundreds of thousands of townspeople.

Even if the lava eruption was real, if someone had given advance warning so everyone could prepare, even accounting for various possible disturbances, the final death toll might not have been nearly this high.

The problem Marquis Danton raised would indeed cause headaches for those in power, but just as Bu Shuai said, if Marquis Danton's family had known about the lava for hundreds of years, all they had to do was tell the Tiger King. Successive Tiger Kings would have had hundreds of years to prepare for this matter.

Forget hundreds of years; even a decade would have been more than enough for the Tiger Kingdom to handle such a disaster.

Yet the Danton family kept it strictly hidden until now, and now put on the airs of tragic heroes forced to make sacrifices for the whole Tiger Kingdom—heroes forced to play an unappreciated role.

Shang Feifan genuinely found it laughable.

Previously, he had considered Marquis Danton a formidable overlord of his time, but now he only saw him as a clown treating everyone else like fools.

However, Marquis Danton evidently did not view himself as a clown. On the contrary, he likely looked down on ordinary beast-persons entirely, viewing all beast-persons outside of himself—including the Tiger King—as inferior beings unworthy of standing on equal footing with him.

Pity that this clown wielded supreme authority, and command over an armed force numbering over ten thousand.

Shang Feifan calmly restrained Bu Shuai, signaling him not to make a move.

He always felt this Marquis Danton was a bit strange, though he couldn't yet put his finger on what was odd about him. Still, intuition told him it wasn't yet time to beat the man up.

The bus came to a halt, and its doors creaked open.

"Is the Treasure-Hunting Compass still usable? Can its function be modified? Aside from the original treasure-hunting feature, can you add a function where it automatically pops up a notification within a thousand-meter radius whenever the power of the God of Nature is detected?" Shang Feifan asked the system in his native tongue.

Bu Shuai turned to look at him.

The last time the Treasure-Hunting Compass had helped capture that ear of the God of Nature inside Bu Shuai's heart, it had vanished into stealth. He didn't know if it had consumed too much energy or was simply broken beyond use. Just now, when the arm of the God of Nature was discovered, it hadn't automatically popped up either.

[Usable, affirmative. Please wait two minutes, system updating. During the update, the system will be temporarily unavailable.]

Shang Feifan sat inside the vehicle for two minutes, during which time he pulled out a piece of paper and scribbled a sentence on it.

Bu Shuai leaned over curiously to look.

Seeing the vehicle doors swing wide open, Marquis Danton didn't wait for the two of them to move, but instead took the lead and stepped out of the carriage.

A few of the twenty-four soldiers hesitated slightly, but they followed him out as well.

Seeing that Shang Feifan hadn't moved, Bu Shuai remained seated too.

Shang Feifan was physically capable of moving; he simply hadn't stepped out as a precaution, choosing instead to sit inside the vehicle and watch Marquis Danton lead the twenty-four soldiers up the steps of the Second Temple.

[Update complete.]

Seeing that the Treasure-Hunting Compass hadn't popped up on its own, Shang Feifan took the initiative to summon it.

A tiny, glittering golden compass materialized within his field of vision.

chunks.chineseText:
看体积，似乎比他上次看到时小了一圈。

罗盘上的指针一阵乱转，慢慢指向西南方。

西南？商非凡看向车外，又一个貌似神殿的建筑似乎就在他们的正东面。

“我们看看这辆车还能带我们去哪里。”商非凡和不帅商量。

不帅：“你不担心……”

“这里没有自然之神遗留的任何力量。”也没有虫母的心脏，没有虫毒，总之没有对他们有用的东西。

不帅懂了，就算这里有其他珍宝，对他们也没什么大用，还不如去其他地方看看，正好也能甩开那个丹顿侯爵。

“我也感觉这里有点不稳。”不帅也说道。

丹顿侯爵踏上第二重神殿大门前，还回头朝他们这里望了望，似乎在奇怪他们怎么不下车。

“我们就这么放过他？”不帅不甘。

“当然不。我对他下了诅咒。”商非凡对不帅很善良地笑了一下。

“……什么时候？”

“就在刚才的神殿中，在神殿倒塌之前。我看到他被地陷吞没，还以为诅咒起效，没想到他竟然还能爬出来。”商非凡摊手：“看他这么厉害，我刚才在车上又忍不住诅咒了他一遍。”

“你诅咒他死亡？”

“不，我诅咒他想要得到什么就越是得不到什么，而且还要眼睁睁看着希望在自己面前一个个破裂。”

不帅对商非凡竖起大拇指。

商非凡想说他还诅咒了这位丹顿侯爵其他一些事情，但为了维持他在不帅心中的良好形象，他决定还是不说了。

车辆再次启动。

“稍等。”商非凡突然打开车窗，往外扔出一枚骨钉。

哚！骨钉连同一张纸被钉在车站牌上。

第二重神殿外。

丹顿侯爵非常惊讶那两人竟然没有下车，简直就像是特地把他送到第二重神殿来一样。

那两人会这么好心？

当看到车辆重新启动，丹顿侯爵明白了，那两个人肯定是想赶在他前头前往第三重神殿。

丹顿侯爵冷笑。

那些蠢货什么都不知道，神殿可不是想进就能进的。

就算是有缘人，没有钥匙，也无法打开神殿大门。

丹顿侯爵解开衣领，露出他当城主以后就一直佩戴的项链。

项链挂坠赫然是一把钥匙。

看，这就是这么多年来他虽然焦躁但也没有真的担心过第二重和第三种神殿已经被他人洗劫的原因。

他们家深耕地下城和第一重神殿这么多年，怎么可能是那些听到一些传说怪闻就跑来寻宝的小蟊贼能比的？

那两人不下车更好，免得他要一直提防那两个家伙。

丹顿侯爵拿下钥匙，把钥匙插-进大门的锁眼里，轻轻转动。

咔哒。

丹顿侯爵脑中忽然出现一双眼睛。

等等！他想起来了。

他想起车上那个貌不起眼的兽人是谁了。

那是拉斐尔郎沐！

传言中虎王的私生子。

他妹妹的眼中钉肉中刺。

同时也是林格莱特血脉和丹顿血脉创造出来的混血儿，二代。

虽然两族的血脉都被稀薄了，可如果拉斐尔郎沐真的是虎王的孩子，那就表示他的身体中也混入了虎王的血。

这简直就是最好的……容器。

可两次测试，似乎都证明拉斐尔郎沐并不是那个最佳选择。

所以当拉斐尔郎沐离开王城时几乎没有受到多少阻拦。

当然，他也不想这个让他妹妹不舒服的野种能开开心心地在外面生活。

可惜这个野种的运气似乎还不错，几次都逃脱了针对他的布置。

这都要让他怀疑对方身上是不是真的隐藏了他母亲留给他的东西。

而对方又那么恰巧地在这时候来到黑森林城，还找到了第一重神殿，更……

想到他听到的那段话。

拉斐尔郎沐真的在神殿中找到了自然之神的部分力量？

可他并没有看到任何异样发生，只有神殿塌陷。

如果一个人吸收了自然之神的力量，那个人身上必然会有异状发生。

可那两个人看起来都很正常，身上也没有让人生畏或情不自禁下拜的浩荡威严，更没有任何不健康的模样——神的力量又哪是那么好吸收的？

要么就是他们没有吸收，只是把自然之神的力量隐藏了起来？

但那两人身上连个背包都没有，能把东西藏到哪里？

那个树枝型吊灯体积可不小。

要么就是两人身上有空间储物工具？

可连真正的王子和公主都没有空间储物工具，拉斐尔郎沐又哪里能得到那样的宝贝？

还是说他身边那个雄性……

丹顿侯爵越想越多，越想越复杂，忍不住皱起眉头。

咔哒。门锁再次转动。

丹顿侯爵伸手一推，大门往内沉重又迟缓地打开了。

轰！

一股能烫死人的热浪冲上丹顿侯爵的面颊。

“退！快退！”

高温导致他梳理精美的头发都被烤焦了不少。

士兵们纷纷后退。

两个士兵还想帮助丹顿侯爵合上大门，但门内岩浆已经向门口这边流淌过来。

丹顿侯爵顾不上再关上大门，也顾不上查看神殿内部情况。

不用查看，他刚才已经看到了，第二重神殿内部也塌陷了，地面开裂，岩浆上涌，情况和第一重神殿一样糟糕！

丹顿侯爵和士兵们狂奔下台阶，冲向车站。

但那辆造型古怪却很能装的车子已经消失得无影无踪。

完了，丹顿侯爵变色。

二十四名士兵也跟着惊慌起来。

“城主！您看。”一名士兵惊喜地从车站的车牌上扯下一张纸。

丹顿侯爵一把夺过那张纸。

就见纸上写着一句话：【立刻停止地上的腐蚀雨，立刻释放地下城所有城民，车子会回来接你。否则你就等着泡岩浆澡吧。】

留言下方还画了一副歪斜又诡异的简笔画，就像是一张讥笑的脸。
chunks.englishText:
Judging by its size, it seemed to have shrunk by a circle compared to the last time he saw it.

The needle on the compass spun wildly for a moment before slowly pointing toward the southwest.

Southwest? Shang Feifan looked outside the carriage. Another structure resembling a temple seemed to be directly to their east.

"Let's see where else this carriage can take us," Shang Feifan discussed with Bushuai.

Bushuai asked, "Aren't you worried..."

"There is no residual power of the God of Nature left here." Neither was there the Mother Worm's heart, nor worm poison—in short, nothing useful to them.

Bushuai understood. Even if there were other rare treasures here, they wouldn't be of much use to them anyway. They might as well go check out other places, which would also conveniently allow them to shake off that Marquis Denton.

"I also feel that this place is a bit unstable," Bushuai added.

Before stepping onto the threshold of the second temple's gates, Marquis Denton even glanced back at them, seeming puzzled as to why they weren't getting out of the carriage.

"Are we just going to let him off like this?" Bushuai was unsatisfied.

"Of course not. I've placed a curse on him." Shang Feifan smiled benignly at Bushuai.

"—When?"

"Just back in the temple, right before it collapsed. When I saw him swallowed by the sinkhole, I thought the curse had taken effect, but I didn't expect him to be able to crawl back out." Shang Feifan spread his hands. "Seeing how tough he is, I couldn't help but curse him one more time while sitting in the carriage."

"You cursed him to die?"

"No, I cursed him that the more he desires something, the less he will be able to get it, and on top of that, he will have to watch every single one of his hopes shatter right before his eyes."

Bushuai gave Shang Feifan a thumbs-up.

Shang Feifan wanted to say that he had also cursed this Marquis Denton with a few other things, but to maintain his favorable image in Bushuai's heart, he decided against mentioning them.

The vehicle started up once more.

"Wait a moment." Shang Feifan suddenly opened the carriage window and tossed a bone nail outward.

*Clang!* The bone nail, along with a piece of paper, was pinned straight onto the station sign.

Outside the second temple.

Marquis Denton was extremely surprised that those two individuals hadn't gotten out of the carriage. It was almost as if they had deliberately escorted him straight to the second temple.

Would those two really be so kind?

When he saw the carriage start moving again, Marquis Denton understood—those two must have wanted to rush ahead of him to the third temple.

Marquis Denton sneered.

Those fools knew nothing; a temple wasn't a place you could enter just because you wanted to.

Even if one were fated, without the key, it was impossible to open the temple gates.

Marquis Denton loosened his collar, revealing the necklace he had worn ever since he became the City Lord.

The pendant of the necklace was strikingly a key.

Look, this was why, despite feeling anxious over all these years, he had never truly worried that the second and third temples had already been ransacked by others.

Having deeply cultivated their roots in the underground city and the first temple for so many years, how could they possibly compare to some petty thieves who came running to treasure-hunt upon hearing a few legendary tall tales?

It was even better that those two didn't get out of the carriage, saving him the trouble of having to constantly be on guard against them.

Marquis Denton took off the key, inserted it into the keyhole of the great gates, and gently turned it.

*Click.*

A pair of eyes suddenly flashed through Marquis Denton's mind.

Wait! He remembered.

He remembered who that unassuming Orc in the carriage was.

That was Raphael Langmu!

The reputed illegitimate son of the Tiger King.

A thorn in his sister's side and a thorn in her eye.

At the same time, he was a mixed-blood of the second generation, born from the intertwined lineages of the Ringlites and the Dentons.

Although both lineages had been diluted, if Raphael Langmu truly was the Tiger King's child, it meant that the blood of the Tiger King was also mixed into his body.

This was quite simply the ultimate... vessel.

Yet two rounds of tests seemed to prove that Raphael Langmu was not the optimal choice.

Therefore, when Raphael Langmu left the royal capital, he encountered almost no obstruction.

Naturally, he didn't want this bastard who made his sister uncomfortable to live happily outside either.

Unfortunately, this bastard seemed to have rather good luck, escaping the traps set against him on several occasions.

This almost made him wonder if something left behind by his mother was truly hidden within that fellow.

And yet, that fellow had so coincidently arrived at Black Forest City at this very time, found the first temple, and even...

Recalling the snippet of conversation he had overheard.

Had Raphael Langmu truly found a portion of the God of Nature's power inside the temple?

Yet he hadn't seen any anomalies occur; only the temple had collapsed.

If someone had absorbed the power of the God of Nature, abnormalities would inevitably manifest on that person.

Yet both of those two looked completely normal. There was no awe-inspiring, majestic might radiating from them that made others want to bow involuntarily, nor did they show any unhealthy appearance—after all, how could a god's power be so easily absorbed?

Either they hadn't absorbed it and had simply concealed the power of the God of Nature?

But neither of those two even carried a backpack; where could they have hidden such things?

That branch-shaped chandelier was certainly not small in volume.

Or perhaps the two of them possessed spatial storage tools?

Yet even true princes and princesses did not have spatial storage tools, so where could Raphael Langmu have obtained such a treasure?

Or could it be the male by his side...

The more Marquis Denton thought, the more complicated it became, and he couldn't help but frown.

*Click.* The door lock turned once more.

Marquis Denton reached out and gave a push; the heavy gates slowly swung inward.

*Boom!*

A scorching wave of heat capable of scalding flesh rushed straight onto Marquis Denton's face.

"Fall back! Fall back quickly!"

The intense heat singed away a considerable portion of his meticulously groomed hair.

The soldiers scrambled backward one after another.

Two soldiers even tried to help Marquis Denton pull the gates shut, but the magma inside was already surging toward the entrance.

Marquis Denton no longer cared about closing the gates, nor did he care to inspect the interior of the temple.

There was no need to inspect; he had already seen it just now—the interior of the second temple had also collapsed, the ground was cracking open, and magma was welling up, presenting a situation just as dire as the first temple!

Marquis Denton and the soldiers sprinted down the steps, charging toward the station.

However, that oddly shaped yet spacious vehicle had already vanished without a trace.

*It's over,* Marquis Denton's expression changed color.

The twenty-four soldiers panicked along with him.

"City Lord! Look at this." A soldier excitedly tore a piece of paper off the station sign.

Marquis Denton snatched the paper away in one go.

He saw a sentence written on it: [Immediately stop the corrosive rain on the surface, and immediately release all citizens in the underground city. The carriage will come back to pick you up. Otherwise, you can just wait to take a magma bath.]

At the bottom of the message was also drawn a crooked, bizarre stick figure, resembling a grinning face.

chunks.chineseText:
第110章 士兵

车辆停止，两人下车。

商非凡转头：“你说那家伙发现纸条了吗？”

不帅像是在感知什么，过了一会儿说道：“腐蚀雨没有停，黑暗能量仍旧在增加。”

他的自然感知力让他可以清楚感知到自然传递给他的信息，腐蚀雨夹杂着黑暗能量也渗入了地下城。

不帅只要感知黑暗能量多少就能知道地面上的腐蚀雨有没有停止。

“也许他还在第二座神殿里探险。”商非凡仰头看向第三座神殿。

三座神殿，建筑外型都差不多，乍一看就像是三胞胎。

“丹顿侯爵……我对他了解不多，但假如他能献祭自己的妻子和小儿子，还是用那么残忍的方式，那他绝不会对别人心生仁慈。他只会为了达到他的目的继续走下去，哪怕他知道那是死胡同。”不帅停住脚步。

商非凡了然地看向他：“那你觉得我们抓住他甚而杀死他，就能制止他吗？”

不帅缓缓摇头，“他……像是有恃无恐。”

商非凡：“我也是这么感觉。那家伙给我的感觉很奇怪，也许贵族都有点眼高于顶瞧不起普通人的臭毛病，但那个丹顿侯爵……他也许没有把自己提升到神的地位，但他绝对是在用俯视和不屑的眼神看待其他兽人，包括虎王。”

不帅也道：“他说起虎王就像是说起……晚辈？小辈？”

啪。商非凡打了个响指：“对，就是这样。一副我们大人所做的一切决定都是为小孩好，也是正确的，不需要小孩理解，也不需要小孩知晓的最讨厌长辈模式。”

“看来这位丹顿侯爵还有不少值得我们深挖的内容。”

“也许不需要深挖。有时候事实就放在那里，只是我们没有看到。”

商非凡抬手，对着台阶上的某人摇了摇手。

鹰之翼坐在台阶上，也对两人抬了抬手腕。

“进不去。”鹰之翼对走上来的两人说道。那神情要有多沮丧就有多沮丧。

“上次来，我用尽方法都无法进入这座神殿。这次，我做了不少准备，但你们也看到了，我现在仍旧在大门外。”

“你没有去试试第二座神殿？”商非凡笑。

鹰之翼抱怨：“我当然去试过。就是打不开第二座神殿，我才来到第三座。但除了浪费时间，我一无所获。这该死的门锁是炼金制品，只有专门的钥匙才能打开它！”

商非凡抬头打量那高大的门扉：“有没有想过换一条路，比如在墙壁上打洞？”

鹰之翼没好气地说：“你当我没想到吗？我什么方法都用尽了，自然也包括墙壁打洞、地下打洞、破坏墙顶等等一系列手段，但这两座神殿就跟用神力加固了一样，墙砖和地面全都坚硬得不可思议！”

商非凡看不帅，用眼神问他：你要不要试试？

不帅有点跃跃欲试。

他会不少开锁相关的魔法。

虽然不能确定能打开兽人建造的炼金神殿，但试试也没什么坏处。

商非凡看向寻宝罗盘。

刚才在第二座神殿，寻宝罗盘指向西南方，和神殿方向完全无关。

这里也同样。

但就在刚才，系统给他发布了一个任务，让他想法进入第三重神殿。

商非凡拉着鹰之翼询问他对地下城、对丹顿家族、对黑森林城的了解，又问他知不知道外面在下腐蚀雨，知不知道地下城爆发了岩浆流。

“岩浆流？！”鹰之翼跳起来，他的注意力完全被商非凡吸引住。

“是的，我们得快点离开地下城，这里是我们的最后一站，不管有没有收获，我们都会尽快离开。”商非凡挡住鹰之翼的视线。

不帅就站在神殿大门前，接连使用了几个开锁魔法。

但大门纹丝不动。

他还尝试使用穿墙术，但之前在第一重神殿还能使用的穿墙术在这里竟然失效了。

魔法免疫？还是必须要有人用正确办法打开门锁，才能彻底解除整座神殿的禁锢封锁？

商非凡侧头，看到不帅对他摇头。

“你们也打不开？”鹰之翼突然道。

不帅没有掩饰他想开门的举动，只是不想让鹰之翼知道他使用的是什么方法。

“你们有没有觉得气温在上升？”商非凡突然说。

不帅第一个回应：“有点，不，有很多。”

鹰之翼刚刚就无意识地卷起袖子，这会儿也不得不承认第三重神殿这里的温度升高了不少。

“我们打算离开。”商非凡说。

鹰之翼不相信：“你们就这么放弃了？等下次来，谁也不能保证你们还能等到那辆车。”

“那就表示我们和这里没有缘分。”商非凡搭住不帅的肩膀。

不帅也毫不留恋地说：“我们走了。你自便。不过第一重神殿已经倒塌，岩浆流从地底喷射而出，如果这三座神殿相距并不远，也许这里很快也会被岩浆包围。”

“你不用说了，我已经看到了第二重神殿。”鹰之翼站在台阶最上方，眼睛越过两人，看向了正西方。

商非凡和不帅两人也看过去。

发现他们真的看到了一座庞大的建筑。

“岩浆让阵法失灵了。”不帅低喃。

鹰之翼飞了起来，飞向前方的第二重神殿，在上空盘旋观察。

第二重神殿车站处，还活着的士兵简直是喜出望外，他们怎么也没想到，他们还能绝处逢生，竟然看到了第三重神殿，重点是他们看到了那两个能召唤来有缘车的兽人。

只不过二十四名士兵如今已经只剩下十六人。

他们叠罗汉一样地站在一起，岩浆已经流淌到他们周围，极高的温度让他们毛发蜷曲、身体都要被烤出油来。

这个车站似乎很特殊，在其他地方都被岩浆覆盖时，这里明明不比其他地方地势高，却能让岩浆不会那么快把这里淹没。

但淹没，也只是时间问题。

丹顿侯爵单独站立在车牌上，还是金鸡独立的姿势。

不帅手掌握拳放到唇边，轻咳。

商非凡可没客气，肆无忌惮地嗤笑了两声。

鹰之翼飞回来，落地：“那是丹顿侯爵？”

商非凡：“就是他。”

“他怎么会被困住？据我所知，他掌握着能自由进出第一重神殿的办法。”鹰之翼惊讶。

商非凡：“大约是他太想前往后面的神殿，宁可冒险乘坐别人的车辆，也没有用自己的方法及时撤离。当他达到第二座神殿后，就变成了他想离开，也无法离开了。”

丹顿侯爵遇到的就是这样的困境。

他在第二重神殿的车站扔出古硬币，但以往必定会到的车辆一直都没有出现。

看样子，那辆车确实只能送他到第一重神殿。

叠罗汉最上层的士兵用力对商非凡他们挥手，还大声喊：“我们在这里，救救我们！”

“岩浆往这边流过来了。两位，我先走一步！”鹰之翼对拯救虎国的侯爵和士兵显然不感兴趣，当即就疯狂召唤自己的有缘车。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 110: Soldiers

The vehicle stopped, and the two of them stepped out.

Shang Feifan turned his head. "Do you think that fellow found the note?"

Bushuai seemed to be sensing something. After a moment, he said, "The corrosive rain hasn't stopped, and the dark energy is still increasing."

His natural perception allowed him to clearly perceive the information conveyed to him by nature; the corrosive rain mixed with dark energy had also seeped into the underground city.

As long as Bushuai sensed the amount of dark energy, he would know whether the corrosive rain on the surface had stopped.

"Perhaps he's still exploring inside the second temple." Shang Feifan looked up toward the third temple.

Three temples, with exterior architectures that looked almost identical—at first glance, they resembled triplets.

"Marquis Denton... I don't know much about him, but if he could sacrifice his wife and young son, and in such a cruel manner, he will never feel mercy toward others. He will simply continue forward to achieve his goal, even if he knows it's a dead end." Bushuai paused his steps.

Shang Feifan looked at him knowingly. "Then do you think capturing him or even killing him would stop him?"

Bushuai slowly shook his head. "He... acts as if he has nothing to fear."

Shang Feifan said, "I feel the same way. That fellow gives me a very strange feeling. Perhaps nobles all have this obnoxious flaw of looking down their noses and despising ordinary people, but that Marquis Denton... maybe he hasn't elevated himself to the status of a god, but he definitely looks down upon other Orcs—including the Tiger King—with a gaze of utter condescension and disdain."

Bushuai also noted, "When he spoke of the Tiger King, it sounded as if he were speaking of... a junior? A younger generation?"

*Snap.* Shang Feifan clicked his fingers. "Right, exactly like that. The most annoying type of senior who acts like 'everything we adults decide is for the children's own good and is completely correct, no need for the children to understand, and no need for the children to know.'"

"It seems this Marquis Denton still has plenty of content worth us digging into."

"Perhaps we don't need to dig deep. Sometimes the facts are right there in front of us; it's just that we haven't seen them."

Shang Feifan raised a hand and waved at someone on the steps.

Eagle's Wing was sitting on the steps, and upon seeing them, he also raised his wrist to wave back.

"Can't get in," Eagle's Wing said to the two walking up, his expression as dejected as it could possibly be.

"The last time I came, I tried every possible method yet failed to enter this temple. This time, I made plenty of preparations, but as you can see, I'm still stuck outside the main gates."

"Didn't you go try the second temple?" Shang Feifan smiled.

Eagle's Wing complained, "Of course I went to try! It was precisely because I couldn't open the second temple that I came to the third. But apart from wasting time, I gained nothing. This damned door lock is an alchemical artifact; only a specialized key can open it!"

Shang Feifan looked up to appraise the towering double doors. "Ever thought of trying a different path, like punching a hole through the wall?"

Eagle's Wing retorted irritably, "Do you take me for a fool? I've exhausted every method—naturally including punching holes through walls, tunneling underground, destroying the roof, and a whole series of measures! But these two temples are reinforced as if by divine power; the wall bricks and the ground are all unfathomably hard!"

Shang Feifan glanced at Bushuai, asking with his eyes: Do you want to give it a try?

Bushuai felt a bit eager to try.

He knew quite a few lock-picking-related magic spells.

Although he couldn't guarantee he could open an alchemical temple built by Orcs, there was no harm in trying.

Shang Feifan looked at the Treasure-Hunting Compass.

Back at the second temple, the Treasure-Hunting Compass had pointed southwest, completely unrelated to the direction of the temple.

It was the same here.

However, just a moment ago, the system had issued a quest instructing him to find a way to enter the third temple.

Shang Feifan pulled Eagle's Wing aside to question him about his understanding of the underground city, the Denton family, and Black Forest City, further asking if he knew about the corrosive rain falling outside and the volcanic magma eruption within the underground city.

"Magma flow?!" Eagle's Wing leaped up, his attention completely hooked by Shang Feifan.

"Yes, we must leave the underground city quickly. This is our last stop; regardless of whether we gain anything, we will be leaving as soon as possible." Shang Feifan blocked Eagle's line of sight.

Bushuai stood directly in front of the temple gates and successively cast several lock-picking magic spells.

Yet the massive doors didn't budge an inch.

He also tried using the Wall-Passing technique, but the technique—which had still worked back at the first temple—actually failed here.

Magic immunity? Or must someone use the correct method to open the door lock in order to completely lift the restrictions and seals spanning the entire temple?

Shang Feifan turned his head and saw Bushuai shaking his head at him.

"You guys can't open it either?" Eagle's Wing suddenly spoke up.

Bushuai hadn't concealed his attempt to open the door, merely ensuring that Eagle's Wing didn't know what specific methods he was using.

"Don't you guys feel the temperature rising?" Shang Feifan suddenly remarked.

Bushuai was the first to respond. "A little—no, a lot."

Eagle's Wing had instinctively rolled up his sleeves just a moment ago, and at this point, he couldn't help but admit that the temperature around the third temple had indeed risen considerably.

"We plan to leave," Shang Feifan said.

Eagle's Wing didn't believe it. "You're just giving up like this? If you wait until next time, no one can guarantee you'll still be able to catch that carriage."

"Then that just means we lack affinity with this place." Shang Feifan patted Bushuai's shoulder.

Bushuai also said without a shred of lingering attachment, "We're leaving. Suit yourself. However, the first temple has already collapsed, and magma is erupting from the depths of the earth. If these three temples aren't far apart from each other, perhaps this place will soon be surrounded by magma as well."

"You don't need to tell me; I've already seen the second temple." Eagle's Wing stood at the very top of the steps, his gaze stretching past the two men to look toward the true west.

Shang Feifan and Bushuai also looked over.

Only to discover that they could indeed see a massive structure in the distance.

"The magma has caused the formation arrays to malfunction," Bushuai murmured under his breath.

Eagle's Wing took flight, soaring toward the second temple ahead, circling overhead to observe.
