"There's also another point," Shang Feifan brought up. "Earlier, you mentioned that the prophetic Saint-level Mage, Irene Monica, cried out that she had been deceived by a higher power before opening the spatial rift. So, I ask you, who is this higher power?"

"...An Evil God?" Bu Shuai said uncertainly.

Shang Feifan shifted his posture. "Let's assume that the entity which deceived and blinded Monica's precognition was an external Evil God from the Beastman Continent. Then why would these Evil Gods want to deceive Monica?"

"To get them to open the spatial barrier between the Fardell Continent and the Beastman Continent?"

"If the Evil Gods are so powerful, why couldn't they do it themselves instead of forcing the Fardell Continent's Saint-level Mages to do the dirty work?"

"Unable to pinpoint the location accurately? Is a world barrier easier to breach from the inside? Perhaps some sort of rule restriction, or maybe the Fardell Continent also has ancient gods? Those external Evil Gods didn't want to alert the dormant ancient gods sleeping on the Fardell Continent?"

"All of your hypotheses are possible. Let's put aside the Evil Gods tempting the Fardell Continent's mages into opening the spatial barrier for a moment. Do you think those Evil Gods might have captured those mages, experimented on them, or even devoured and brainwashed them into becoming their subordinates?"

Bu Shuai was startled. "You're saying those mages are likely acting as jackals for the tiger?"

"Two Saint-level Mages." Shang Feifan raised two fingers. "Both vanished without a sound. Either they're lying low, preparing to make a big move, or they've already embarked on their path to godhood, and we're simply unaware of it. Given that two Saint-level Mages were willing to launch a sneak attack and murder a prophetic Saint-level Mage just to achieve godhood, if an Evil God offered them hints and opportunities for godhood in exchange for cooperation, do you think they'd agree?"

"I don't know about Ludwig, but the Dark Saint-level Mage Dexter... he'd say yes nine times out of ten."

Bu Shuai wiped his sweat and murmured, "What should we do? Why does the Beastman Continent feel so utterly cursed? Ever since the Prosperous Era, it's been one disaster after another."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第112章 魔法师们在哪里 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
“但兽人被打倒了吗？亲爱的，对兽人更有信心一点吧。”商非凡安慰不帅：“往好处想，也许我们只是杞人忧天，说不定那些魔法师和法圣现在全都困于没有魔力无法施展的困境，搞不好没有魔力补充的他们已经老死了。”

不帅：“……”

商非凡又道：“而且我觉得冥冥中，兽人大陆已经在开始努力自救。虽然我现在还看不到全盘布局，但兽人大陆并没有坐以待毙。比如地球玩家的出现……”

“地球玩家能做什么？只要切断和地球那边的游戏终端的联系，地球玩家就完全无法影响到这个世界。”不帅忍不住悲观。

“而且玩家都有自己的想法，他们就是一群不可控的生物。何况这还是‘全息世界’。如果他们想要在这里做坏事，想要给这个世界带来更多纷乱……”

“那不是很好吗？”商非凡打断不帅，说道：“当敌人只有两方的时候，只会打得你死我活、有你无我。可当敌人变成三方乃至四方，你知道会发生什么事吗？”

不帅不解：“你是把玩家也当敌人看？”

“你可以把部分玩家当朋友看，但就如你所说，玩家是不可控的，与其把他们当友方，不如把他们也当做侵略者之一，还是特别爱捣乱、喜欢当搅屎棍的那种敌人。但也正因为有了玩家，兽人大陆的未来局势变化才会更有意思，也更充满不确定性。而这同时也是兽人们自救的机会！”

商非凡看不帅还是有些不懂，揉揉他的脑袋：“暂时不用想太多。我们一个问题一个问题的解决。先让我们专注解决那些想要害你和莫约镇的人，顺便看能不能解决虎国岩浆爆发的事。玩家和天残谷主，可以放到后面。”

不帅深吸气，“你说得对，让我们先专注于眼前问题。现在想太多也……”

轰隆！

巨大的爆炸声突然响起。

这座小楼都被震荡地晃动起来。

商非凡一把抱住不帅。

“岩浆爆发了？”不帅惊问。

“不像……”

轰隆！又是一声巨大的爆炸声。

不，不是爆炸声，是有谁撞碎了这座小楼。

光亮透入地下室。

一只巨大的脚爪猛地一脚踏向这座小楼的残渣。

噗嗤。

弗内德甚至没有来得及发出呼救声，就这么被踩踏成了肉酱。

他的头部射出一条暗影，蹿向远方。

不帅带着商非凡穿墙跑出了地下室。

商非凡离开前还可惜了一下他布置的咒术阵，错过一个诅咒的机会。

原本还想给诅咒之神换换口味，让祂尝尝外来魔法师的味道。

“巨兽！”不帅沉声。

这只巨兽比不帅变身的白虎还要巨大得多，身高足有十四五米，体长超过三十米。

而且这只巨兽看不出品种，它的脚爪不是肉垫，也不是蹄类，更像是具有厚厚角质层的恐龙脚掌，外加杀伤力巨大的弯钩爪尖。

巨兽似乎在寻找什么，它口中发出愤怒的吼叫声。

那叫声十分震耳。

周围的建筑物都被震得簌簌发抖。

城主府内跑出很多人，这些人大喊大叫，声音交织到一起，都分不清他们在喊什么。

如今城主府没有一个能称得上主人的人掌控大局，被留在府内的管家也不是第一管家，而是第三管事，他根本无法命令府里的侍卫和士兵，他只能冲着那些乱成一团的仆人大喊。

侍卫们发现巨兽时刚开始还很惊恐，不知是谁叫了一声，这些侍卫突然就镇定下来，并没有一人攻击巨兽，反而全部向城主府外撤离。

“这是……丹顿侯爵？”不帅听到了那名侍卫的喊声。对方认出了丹顿侯爵的巨兽之身。

而那名侍卫的声音，他也不陌生，正是带他来城主府的那名侍卫。

那名侍卫的那声大喊除了提醒其他侍卫和城主府仆人，让他们不至于在巨兽脚下凭白送死，也是在通知不帅两人。

现在那名侍卫也跟着其他人跑得不见人影。

偌大的城主府没一会儿就空了。

商非凡仰头看巨兽：“应该就是他了。没想到他竟然还能从神殿出来。”

不帅推测：“可能岩浆彻底破坏了阵法，让丹顿侯爵也看到第一座神殿，而他似乎有办法离开第一座神殿。”

“可惜。”商非凡虽然很希望岩浆就能解决这个一等侯爵，但他当时也猜到这名侯爵可能还有没有使用出的后手，不过他们急着去解决腐蚀雨和逃离岩浆，也就没多管这个侯爵。

如果他们那时候和丹顿侯爵打起来，不是说打不过对方，只是对方如果想要拉着他们一起死，在有岩浆威胁的情况下，他们也许不会死，但一定会受伤。

是，他可以带着不帅使用回城功能回去莫约镇，但想想他们一路来到黑森林城花的时间和精力，如果不是被逼到某种境地，谁想回到出发点再重跑一趟？

“我敢打赌他在寻找我们。”商非凡似笑非笑。

“如果我们离开，这一城人的结果就难说了。”不帅握紧了骨杖。

两人显出身影。

商非凡眼中闪过凌厉杀意：“那就打吧。彻底解决这家伙！你不要变身，避免暴露身份。”

说完，商非凡抓起手边倒塌的半边墙壁，转了两圈蓄力，就用力砸向巨兽。

巨兽也发现了他们，口中吐出雷电。

“霹咔！”

商非凡极限扭转身体，同时完成后跃，硬是躲开了那道雷电袭击。

不帅闪身，飞到巨兽上空，对其举起骨杖：“遇水结冰！全身僵化！自然之力侵蚀！”

感谢洛伦米尔顿，给他送来了魔晶和魔杖，让他不至于在这时候只能打辅助。

满地的雨水瞬间结冰，冰层逐渐上攀，冻住了巨兽的四肢。

巨兽愤怒挣扎，巨大的兽口张开，再次喷出闪电。

可很快他就感到身体变得僵硬、迟钝。

不帅在空中几乎瞬移一般，快速躲过闪电袭击。

商非凡迅速拿出一把弓箭，搭上三支爆炸箭，瞄准巨兽的心脏。

一条黑色巨蛇忽然蹿出来张口咬向浮在空中的不帅。

咻咻咻！三箭齐出，转射向那条黑色巨蛇的七寸处。

砰。黑色巨蛇在空中化作烟雾，爆炸箭落空。

不帅无视刚才偷袭他的黑色巨蛇，似乎笃定商非凡能保护好自己，他仍旧悬浮在半空，开始念咒，他要发大招解决巨兽丹顿侯爵。

“古老的神灵行于天空、行于大地，祂们的神力无所不在，我遵循古老魔法的契约力量，借用雷电之力，行雷霆之威，抽取那兽人身上的所有雷电元素吧！”

“大地的精灵啊，请遵循古老魔法的契约力量，以我的精神力为指引，把这些种子扎入他的血肉，哺育新的生命，偿还他的罪恶！”
chunks.englishText:
"But has the Beastman Continent been knocked down? Darling, have a little more faith in the beastmen," Shang Feifan comforted Bu Shuai. "Look on the bright side. Perhaps we're just borrowing trouble; for all we know, those mages and Saint-level Mages are currently trapped in a predicament where they lack magic power and can't cast a thing. With no magic replenishment, they might have already died of old age."

Bu Shuai: "..."

Shang Feifan continued, "Besides, I feel that in the dark, the Beastman Continent has already begun striving to save itself. Although I can't see the full picture yet, the Beastman Continent hasn't just sat back and waited for death. Take the appearance of the Earth players, for instance..."

"What can Earth players do? The moment you sever the connection with the game terminals on Earth, the Earth players become completely powerless to influence this world," Bu Shuai couldn't help but feel pessimistic.

"Furthermore, players all have minds of their own; they're a bunch of uncontrollable creatures. Not to mention this is a 'holographic world.' If they want to wreak havoc here, if they want to bring even more chaos to this world..."

"Isn't that wonderful?" Shang Feifan interrupted Bu Shuai, saying, "When there are only two opposing factions, they'll just fight tooth and nail until only one is left standing. But when the opposing forces turn into three or even four factions, do you know what happens?"

Bu Shuai was puzzled. "Are you treating the players as enemies too?"

"You can treat some players as friends, but as you said, players are uncontrollable. Rather than treating them as allies, it's better to treat them as another group of invaders—specifically, the kind of troublemakers who love stirring up trouble and acting like turd-stirrers. But precisely because of the players, the future shifts in the Beastman Continent's political landscape will become far more interesting and filled with uncertainty. And at the same time, this is an opportunity for the beastmen to save themselves!"

Seeing that Bu Shuai still didn't quite grasp it, Shang Feifan rubbed his head. "Don't overthink things for now. Let's solve our problems one by one. First, let's focus on dealing with those who want to harm you and Moyue Town, and incidentally see if we can resolve the magma eruption in the Tiger Kingdom. The players and the Heaven-Shattered Valley Master can wait for later."

Bu Shuai took a deep breath. "You're right, let's focus on the problem at hand. Thinking too much right now is just..."

*BOOM!*

A massive explosion suddenly rang out.

The small building shook violently from the shockwave.

Shang Feifan immediately pulled Bu Shuai into his arms.

"Did the magma erupt?" Bu Shuai asked in alarm.

"Doesn't look like it..."

*BOOM!* Another tremendous explosion echoed.

No, that wasn't an explosion. Something had just smashed right through this small building.

Stray light pierced into the basement.

A colossal claw ruthlessly stomped down upon the rubble of the small building.

*Splat.*

Frend didn't even have time to let out a cry for help before he was trampled into a bloody pulp.

A wisp of dark shadow shot out from his head, darting into the distance.

 dragging Shang Feifan, phased right through the basement wall to the outside.

Before leaving, Shang Feifan even felt a twinge of regret over the spell array he had meticulously set up, missing a prime opportunity for a curse.

He had originally wanted to give the God of Curses a change of palate, letting it taste the flavor of an external mage.

"A giant beast!" Bu Shuai said in a deep voice.

This giant beast was far more colossal than the white tiger form Bu Shuai could transform into; it stood a good fourteen to fifteen meters tall, with a body length exceeding thirty meters.

What's more, this giant beast's species was unrecognizable. Its feet lacked soft pads or hooves, looking more like dinosaur paws covered in thick keratinous scales, complete with lethal, hook-like talons.

The giant beast seemed to be searching for something, letting out an enraged roar from its maw.

The roar was deafening.

The surrounding buildings trembled violently from the vibrations.

A stream of people poured out of the City Lord's Mansion, shouting and screaming in a cacophony so loud that it was impossible to make out what they were saying.

Right now, the City Lord's Mansion lacked a master figure to take charge of the overall situation. The steward left behind wasn't the head steward, but the third steward; he was utterly incapable of commanding the mansion's guards and soldiers, reduced to screaming frantically at the panicked herd of servants.

When the guards first spotted the giant beast, they were terrified. But at someone's shout, the guards abruptly calmed down. Not a single one of them attacked the beast; instead, all of them retreated straight toward the outside of the City Lord's Mansion.

"Is this... Marquis Danton?" Bu Shuai overheard the shout of that guard. The other party had recognized the giant beast form of Marquis Danton.

Moreover, that guard's voice was not unfamiliar to him—it was precisely the guard who had escorted him to the City Lord's Mansion.

That shout from the guard served not only to alert the other guards and servants of the Mansion so they wouldn't die in vain beneath the giant beast's feet, but also to tip off Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan.

By now, that guard had vanished along with everyone else, running off into the distance.

In the blink of an eye, the sprawling City Lord's Mansion was completely deserted.

Shang Feifan looked up at the giant beast. "It should be him. I never expected him to actually make it out of the temple."

Bu Shuai deduced, "The magma probably completely destroyed the array, allowing Marquis Danton to catch sight of the first temple as well, and he seems to have found a way to leave it."

"Pity." Though Shang Feifan had fervently hoped the magma would take care of this first-class marquis, he had suspected at the time that the man might still have unspent trump cards. However, since they were in a rush to deal with the corrosive rain and escape the magma, they hadn't bothered to linger and deal with him.

Had they fought Marquis Danton back then, it wasn't a question of whether they could win; but if the marquis had been driven to drag them down with him under the threat of the magma, they might not have died, but they certainly would have been injured.

Sure, he could have activated the town-portal function with Bu Shuai and returned to Moyue Town, but considering the time and effort they'd spent trekking all the way to Black Forest City, who would willingly run the whole route back to the starting point unless driven to absolute desperation?

"I'll bet you anything he's looking for us." Shang Feifan wore a half-smile.

"If we leave, the fate of everyone in this city becomes hard to predict." Bu Shuai gripped his bone staff tighter.

The two of them revealed their figures.

A sharp, murderous intent flashed in Shang Feifan's eyes. "Then let's fight. Let's finish this bastard off completely! Don't transform—avoid exposing your identity."

With that, Shang Feifan grabbed a collapsed half-wall close at hand, spun it around to build momentum, and hurled it with all his might toward the giant beast.

The giant beast spotted them as well, spitting a bolt of lightning from its maw.

*Crack-zap!*

Shang Feifan twisted his body to the absolute limit while executing a backward leap, narrowly dodging the lightning strike.

Bu Shuai flashed forward, soaring into the air above the giant beast, and raised his bone staff at it: "Water to ice! Total petrification! Erosion of nature's might!"

He had Loren Milton to thank for delivering those magic crystals and the staff right to his doorstep, keeping him from being reduced to a mere support caster at a time like this.

The standing water across the ground instantly froze, the sheet of ice rapidly climbing upward to bind the giant beast's four limbs.

Struggling furiously, the giant beast snapped its massive jaws open and spat out another flash of lightning.

Yet soon, it felt its body grow stiff and sluggish.

In the air, Bu Shuai moved almost with the speed of a teleport, nimbly dodging the lightning assaults.

Shang Feifan swiftly drew a bow, nocking three explosive arrows as he aimed straight for the giant beast's heart.

Suddenly, a massive black serpent lunged out from the side, snapping viciously at Bu Shuai as he hovered in mid-air.

*Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!* All three arrows flew in unison, instantly redirecting toward the seven-inch vital spot of the black serpent.

*Bang.* The black serpent dissolved into mist mid-air, and the explosive arrows missed their mark.

Bu Shuai completely ignored the black serpent that had just ambushed him, as if utterly confident that Shang Feifan could protect him. He remained suspended in mid-air and began chanting his incantation—he was about to unleash a devastating ultimate spell to finish off the giant beast, Marquis Danton.

"Ancient deities who walk the skies and tread the earth, your divine might is omnipresent! I heed the contract power of ancient magic, borrowing the might of thunder and lightning to wield the wrath of the storm—strip away all lightning elements from that beast's body!"

"Spirits of the earth, heed the contract power of ancient magic! Guided by my spiritual will, drive these seeds deep into his flesh, nurture new life, and exact repayment for his sins!"

chunks.chineseText:
第113章 商巨巨

黑森林城城民不断外逃，尤其是住在城主府附近的大小官员和富豪们。

他们之前还能躲在自己坚固的府邸中，但随着那只巨兽出现，所有砖石建筑在它的巨大脚爪下就如同堆砌的沙堡，一踩就碎。

一些人没能及时逃出来，连同屋宇一起被踩成烂泥。

好在腐蚀雨已经停止，现在外面下的淅淅沥沥如雾一样的小雨淋到身上也不会有任何不良反应。

官员和富豪们也听到了那个声音，说这个雨淋了还有一定好处，但他们都不太相信，而且他们身上没有任何腐蚀伤，自然不会出来冒险。

现在他们不得不跑出来，当淋到雾雨的一刹那，顿时感到身体似乎被注入了一定能量。

可刚感受到没几秒，那雾雨就停止了。

原因无他，那个位于地下室的井台被踩碎，上面堆放的不纯粹魔晶本身就被抽取了不少魔力，被这重力一踩，也全都碎成了渣渣。

不帅施展的自然魔法没有魔力支撑，自然就停止了。

有身体长期处于亚健康状态和一些患有长期慢性疾病的官员和富豪以及他们的家人特别后悔，他们真的感受到了那雾雨的好处，但他们出来的太迟。

逃到四面八方的黑森林城民这时不论地位高低贫穷富贵，除了忙着远离黑森林城的，其他不愿离开家乡的兽人全都仰头看着位于城中心的战斗。

有人喊破巨兽的身份，说那就是他们的城主。

还有官员和富豪为丹顿侯爵洗地，硬说攻击巨兽的两名藏头遮脸的兽人才是引起黑森林城这场灾难的阴谋者，而他们的城主则在为保护黑森林城和城民战斗。

“呸！这群恶心的混蛋。他们在胡编乱造！”

“我知道这两个兽人中其中一个，他帮我们撞开了打不开的地下城出口。”

“我也知道这两人，就是他们救了我们。当时我们都被一群虫子给包围了，就是他们消灭了那些古怪的虫子，把我们救了出来，还救了其他受伤的人。好多人的药就是他们给的。”

“腐蚀雨应该也是他们解决的。”

从地下城逃出来的黑森林城城民们义愤填膺，恨不得把说瞎话的人拖出来暴打。

可能看出周围民众的愤怒和讽刺，喊着城主无辜的人不愿承认自己在恐惧这些平民，但他们闭上了嘴巴。

城民们看着城主府那边的战斗，很为两人担心。

“那巨兽那么巨大，还能喷射闪电。那两名英雄真的能解决得了他吗？”

“那巨兽还有一条黑色巨蛇伙伴。那黑色巨蛇我看着就心底发寒，那玩意也是巨兽吗？”

“我们要去帮忙吗？”

“呵。我想，但我不敢。”

这句话的意思大家都懂。

有人跟着叹息：“我现在就担心那两位英雄就算能打得过那两只巨兽，可之后怎么办？那可是丹顿侯爵！你们别忘了，他妹妹可是王后。”

“妈的，如果国王陛下不能为我们做主，我们就反了他！他大舅子可是要把我们一城人都献祭给邪神！”

“喂喂，话可不能乱说……”

“怕他个鸟！黑森林城最大的血骨军团团长还在城外驻扎，他们现在都没有动静，那就表示……”

“表示什么？兄弟你快说啊。”

“表示要么血骨军团团长被城主给拿下了，血骨军团已经被城主那个虫日的给控制住。要么就是血骨军团被调离，他们现在正在忙别的事。”

“兄弟们，大消息！血骨军团开拔过来了！他们正在准备入城，并在城外建立营地，收容受灾受伤的城民！”

“第二个大消息！驻守黑水河的水军将领巴特将军和血骨军团团长蒙川对上了！”

“黑水河断流了！所有想要乘船离开的人都走不了了！岩浆流的事应该是真的！”

“血骨军团是王城的直辖军，他们来了，是不是国王陛下已经知道这里的事？我们得救了对不对？”

随着血骨军团士兵抢过四大城门的看守权和城内管理权，黑森林城的混乱开始逐渐平息。不少受灾受伤城民都在身穿黑红色军服的士兵引领下前往西、北两个城门。

就在这两个城门外，之前腐蚀雨降临范围外一百米的地方，血骨军团建立了临时营地。

军团长蒙川派了副手向城民收集最新情报，他自己则带着精锐手下先一步奔向南城门港口，他想要控制住黑森林城的全部局势，就得先扼制住城主的最大臂助黑森林水军统领巴特。

蒙川赶到南城门的时候，巴特将军正带人要往城里冲。

之前巴特将军还在为黑水河断流头疼，他其实也没有全盘了解到城主的计划，只知道城主让他把控住码头和水军，在收到他命令时为他出战。

后来腐蚀雨突然降下，谁都无法踏入黑森林城百米范围内。

偏偏黑水河又突然断流，所有正在河面上航行的船只全都落入河底。

许多船只因为体型小，落入河底烂泥就被直接吞没。运气好一点的，现在也都被困在河底烂泥沙中。

更可怕的是黑水河中还生活着很多可怕的食肉水生物，这些食肉水生物来不及逃离，很多都发了疯，它们拼命攻击那些落底船只上的幸存者。

还有些能上岸的更是追着兽人跑。

巴特将军原本应该处理这些事，水军们本来就有保护河道和航行船只的责任。

但巴特将军听到了对城主大大不利的流言，更看到了那只巨兽。

正好腐蚀雨停止，巴特将军立刻就带领兵马想要冲入城中，帮助那只巨兽，并控制住黑森林城。

血骨军团也想要控制住黑森林城，这不就和巴特的水军对上了。

巴特和蒙川这两名将领一见面就冷嘲热讽，互相喷脏话。

两人早有宿怨，又各为其主，彼此看不顺眼已经很久。

两人谁都不让谁。

就在这时他们都看到了两个兽人飞上半空和巨兽战斗，中途又有一条黑色巨蛇加入的场景。

“那两个藏头遮脸的兽人是谁？”巴特将军质问。

蒙川团长翻了个白眼，“你问我我问谁？大概是看不顺眼丹顿侯爵把数十万城民献祭给邪神，想要教训他的过路人吧。”

“教训侯爵？他们也配！还有你不要乱说，爵爷身为黑森林城主，怎么会把自己的城民，还是满城城民献祭给邪神？这就是污蔑！”巴特将军声色俱厉。

“行，我们不扯这些。丹顿侯爵到底做了什么，有没有和邪神信徒合作，这事自有国王陛下论断。我们就先说岩浆流灾难的事，现在我的人已经进入城中救灾，并准备进入地下城查看岩浆喷发-情况。你身为水军将领，是不是也应该去处理黑水河断流的事？顺便看看河底有没有岩浆喷射口。”

“蒙川你眼睛瞎了吗？没看到侯爵大人正在被攻击？要想黑森林城稳定下来，没有侯爵大人怎么行？难道你想夺-权？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 113: Shang the Gigantic (Part 1)

The citizens of Black Forest City continuously fled outward, particularly the various officials and wealthy merchants who lived near the City Lord's Mansion.

Previously, they could hide within their sturdy manors, but with the appearance of that colossal beast, all masonry buildings crumbled like sandcastles beneath its massive paws, shattering at a single stomp.

Some failed to escape in time, reduced to pulp along with their homes.

Fortunately, the corrosive rain had ceased. The gentle, mist-like drizzle now falling outside produced no adverse reactions when it landed on the body.

The officials and wealthy elites had also heard the voice declaring that this rain possessed certain benefits, but they were deeply skeptical. Furthermore, having sustained no corrosive injuries themselves, they naturally had no intention of venturing out to take risks.

Now, however, they were forced to run out. The moment they stepped into the misty rain, they immediately felt as though a surge of energy had been injected into their bodies.

Yet, scarcely had they felt this for a few seconds when the mist rain stopped.

For no other reason than that the well platform located in the basement had been crushed. The impure magic crystals piled upon it had already been drained of much of their magical power, and under that sheer gravitational stomp, they had completely shattered into dust.

Without magical support, the natural magic cast by Bu Shu naturally ceased.

Officials, wealthy merchants, and their families whose bodies had long been in a sub-health state or plagued by chronic illnesses felt a profound sense of regret. They truly had experienced the benefits of the mist rain, but they had emerged far too late.

The citizens of Black Forest City, fleeing in all directions regardless of status or wealth, were now either frantically rushing away from Black Forest City or—in the case of the Beastmen unwilling to abandon their homeland—standing with their heads tilted back, watching the battle unfolding in the city center.

Someone cried out, identifying the giant beast as their very own City Lord.

Other officials and wealthy figures desperately spun narratives to whitewash Marquis Denton, stubbornly insisting that the two masked Beastmen attacking the giant beast were the conspirators who had plunged Black Forest City into this disaster, while their City Lord was merely fighting to protect Black Forest City and its people.

"Bah! A bunch of disgusting bastards. They're making things up!"

"I recognize one of those two Beastmen. He helped us smash open the dungeon exit that wouldn't budge."

"I know them too. Those two are the ones who saved us! Back then, we were surrounded by a swarm of bugs, and it was them who wiped out those bizarre insects, rescued us, and saved the other injured people. A lot of people got their medicine from them."

"The corrosive rain must have been dealt with by them too."

The citizens of Black Forest City who had escaped from the dungeons were filled with righteous indignation, itching to drag the liars out and beat them to a pulp.

Perhaps sensing the anger and mockery radiating from the surrounding populace, the people shouting about the City Lord's innocence were too proud to admit they were afraid of these commoners, but they snapped their mouths shut.

Watching the battle near the City Lord's Mansion, the citizens felt deeply concerned for the duo.

"That giant beast is so huge, and it can even shoot lightning. Can those two heroes really take it down?"

"That giant beast also has a black serpent partner. Just looking at that pitch-black snake sends a chill down my spine. Is that thing a giant beast too?"

"Should we go help?"

"Heh. I'd like to, but I don't have the guts."

Everyone understood the meaning behind those words.

Someone sighed in response, "My worry right now is: even if those two heroes manage to defeat those two giant beasts, what happens next? That's Marquis Denton! Don't forget, his sister is the Queen."

"Damn it, if His Majesty the King won't uphold justice for us, we'll rebel against him! His brother-in-law is trying to sacrifice an entire city of us to an evil god!"

"Hey, hey, you can't just talk nonsense like that..."

"Who gives a damn! The commander of Black Forest City's greatest Blood Bone Legion is still stationed outside the city. They haven't made a move yet, which means..."

"Means what? Brother, spit it out!"

"It either means the Blood Bone Legion Commander has been taken down by the City Lord, and the Blood Bone Legion has already been hijacked by that bug-fucking City Lord. Or the Blood Bone Legion was reassigned and they're busy with something else right now."

"Brothers, big news! The Blood Bone Legion has broken camp and is marching this way! They're preparing to enter the city and set up camp outside to take in the disaster-stricken and injured citizens!"

"Second piece of big news! General Batt, the naval commander guarding the Black Water River, has locked horns with Blood Bone Legion Commander Meng Chuan!"

"The Black Water River has run dry! Anyone trying to leave by boat is trapped! The magma flow thing must be true!"

"The Blood Bone Legion is the royal direct-rule army. Now that they're here, does it mean His Majesty the King already knows what happened here? We're saved, aren't we?"

As soldiers of the Blood Bone Legion seized control of the four city gates and internal municipal management, the chaos in Black Forest City began to gradually subside. Many disaster-stricken and injured citizens, guided by soldiers clad in black-and-red military uniforms, headed toward the western and northern gates.

Right outside these two gates, one hundred meters beyond the previous boundary of the corrosive rain, the Blood Bone Legion had established a temporary camp.

Legion Commander Meng Chuan had dispatched his second-in-command to gather the latest intelligence from the citizens, while he himself led an elite force straight toward the South Gate Port. To seize total control of the situation in Black Forest City, he first had to neutralize the City Lord's greatest military asset: Batt, the commander of the Black Forest Navy.

When Meng Chuan arrived at the South Gate, General Batt was leading his men in an aggressive push to charge into the city.

Earlier, General Batt had been tearing his hair out over the drying up of the Black Water River. In truth, he hadn't been fully clued into the City Lord's grand scheme; he only knew that the City Lord had ordered him to secure the docks and the navy, and to sortie upon receiving his command.

Then the corrosive rain had suddenly plummeted, making it impossible for anyone to approach within a hundred meters of Black Forest City.

To top it all off, the Black Water River had abruptly dried up, causing every vessel navigating the river to crash down onto the riverbed.

Due to their small size, many boats were instantly swallowed by the mire of the riverbed. Those slightly luckier were stranded in the mud and sand at the bottom of the river.

More terrifying still was that the Black Water River teemed with vicious carnivorous aquatic life. Unable to escape in time, many of these creatures had gone berserk, frantically attacking the survivors aboard the grounded vessels.

Others, capable of coming ashore, gave chase to the fleeing Beastmen.

Ordinarily, General Batt would have had to deal with these matters, as the navy bore the responsibility of protecting the waterways and navigating ships.

However, General Batt had caught wind of rumors deeply detrimental to the City Lord and, worse, had laid eyes upon that colossal beast.

Just as the corrosive rain ceased, General Batt immediately led his troops, eager to charge into the city, aid the giant beast, and seize control of Black Forest City.

The Blood Bone Legion also intended to control Black Forest City—which inevitably put them on a collision course with Batt's naval forces.

The moment generals Batt and Meng Chuan met, they began exchanging sarcastic jibes and hurling profusions of filth at one another.

The two had long harbored a grudge, served different masters, and had despised each other for ages.

Neither was willing to yield an inch.

Right at that moment, both witnessed the spectacle of two Beastmen flying into the midair battle against the giant beast, midway joined by a massive black serpent.

"Who are those two masked-and-robed Beastmen?" General Batt demanded.

Legion Commander Meng Chuan rolled his eyes. "You're asking me, but who am I supposed to ask? Probably some passersby who couldn't stand Marquis Denton sacrificing hundreds of thousands of citizens to an evil god and decided to teach him a lesson."

"Teach the Marquis a lesson? They aren't worthy! And don't spout nonsense! Lord Marquis is the City Lord of Black Forest City; how could he possibly sacrifice his own citizens—an entire city of them—to an evil god? That's pure slander!" General Batt barked, his voice stern and fierce.

"Fine, let's drop that for now. What Marquis Denton actually did, and whether he colluded with evil god cultists, His Majesty the King will judge in due time. Let's talk about the magma flow disaster first. My men have already entered the city for disaster relief and are preparing to descend into the dungeons to inspect the magma eruption. As a naval commander, shouldn't you be dealing with the drying up of the Black Water River? And by the way, check if there are any magma vents at the bottom of the river."

"Meng Chuan, are you blind? Didn't you see Lord Marquis being attacked? To stabilize Black Forest City, how can we function without Lord Marquis? What, are you trying to usurp power?"

chunks.chineseText:
“放屁！血骨军团身负王令，一旦黑森林城出现城主无法掌控的灾难，我血骨军团必须第一时间了解并控制住情况，以救灾救人为第一，同时肩负把情况传递给王城的要责。你这是要阻拦我行使国王陛下赋予血骨军团的权力？”

“我不是那个意思！你也说了只有当城主无法掌控灾难时……现在只要你让我救出城主，城主就能控制住灾情，也能让黑森林城立刻稳妥下来！”

“一个会献祭数十万城民，还搞出腐蚀雨的城主，你真的认为他能让城民稳定下来？还是你想造成民情激愤，逼城民叛乱？”

“你这是血口喷人！那只是城主仇家散布的谣言！侯爵大人就不是这样的人！”

两人的手下各自着急，这两位就顾着争吵，那边可是已经出大事啦！

“将军，那只巨兽好像要被打死了，那只黑色巨蛇好像已经死了，他变成了黑沙……”

两位将军顿时一起扭头。

商非凡刚刚把黑色巨蛇给解决了，就在他察觉对方的尾巴尖有一个让他十分心动的物品后。

那是一枚戒指，就被藏在黑色巨蛇尾巴尖的一枚鳞片下。

他一开始并没有发现那里有什么异样，直到他跳起来一脚踩住那尾巴尖。

黑色巨蛇似乎也没想到他的尾巴尖能被人踩住，十分惊讶地扭头看他，脑袋当即扭转过来就要咬他。

就在这刹那间，商非凡有了微妙的感觉，然后他毫不犹豫地拿出一把大刀，一刀斩下那尾巴尖。

黑色巨蛇感到剧烈疼痛的时候也感到不可思议！

他现在可是邪神阴影者，比原来的盖伦神甫不知强了多少倍。

他行走在阴影中，他就是阴影本身，理应没有任何人能捕捉到他的实体，更无法伤害到他。

就像那些圣虫。

可现在这个不知道从哪里冒出来的兽人，不但有一身巨力，竟然还能实质伤害到他？

这人到底是谁？！

黑色巨蛇想要抢回自己的尾巴尖。

但商非凡抢先一步抢到手。

为了躲避黑色巨兽的攻击，商非凡还激发了隐身道具的效果，让黑色巨蛇找不到他只能无能狂怒。

商非凡手指一点点摸索，那微妙的感觉再次传入他的大脑。

就在这里！

商非凡掀开鳞片。

他看到了一枚戒指。

重点不是戒指，是戒指里的东西。

商非凡手指用力，暴力捏碎戒面，露出戒面下的空间。

那是一枚指甲盖大的黑色块状物。

商非凡几乎是被魅惑般，手指捏起了那枚小小的黑色块状物。

看到这东西的刹那，他就知道这东西是什么。

虫母的心脏碎片！

【奇遇任务！你在偶然间得到了虫母九分之一的心脏碎片，请问是否选择吸收虫母九分之一心脏，让其助你已经觉醒的血脉天赋升级。能升多少级，能给哪个血脉天赋升级，未知。也有一定几率升级失败。】

商非凡当然选择吸收。

【恭喜你，奇遇任务完成，你受到虫母死亡时残留在心脏中的强烈怨力影响，致使你的血脉天赋‘恶咒’等级从169.5/100升级为200/100。即你的恶咒血脉天赋被打开到二级。】

【恭喜你，奇遇任务完成，你受到虫母天赋力量影响，你的血脉天赋‘力大无穷’从239.5/100升级到301/100。即你的力量血脉天赋被打开到三级。】

【恭喜，由于你再次吸收虫母心脏碎片，你的职业技能虫族研究者等级从敏锐感知提升为通感。你对虫族的感知能力将翻倍提升，对虫毒的抵抗和适应能力也将再次增强。另，受虫母力量影响，你对受虫毒影响导致的异变者具有天然的血脉压制能力。】

【注意！受到虫母心脏力量影响，你将即刻进入狂暴模式。持续时间最短两小时，最长未知。友情提醒，请尽量控制自己的精神状态，避免彻底陷入混乱。】

艹！商非凡还没来得及高兴自己各项能力再次得到提升，立刻感知到狂暴模式的降临。

他的身体在膨胀，他要炸开了！

“阿沐，闪开！”

虎不帅一愣，商非凡喊他什么？

比起思想，不帅的动作更快。

商非凡喊他闪开，他就火速往远处蹿离。

商非凡身体在一瞬间暴涨，他变成了巨人！

比丹顿侯爵变的巨兽还要高大两倍的巨人！

感谢他在游戏商城购买了变身两用的护身皮甲。

如今这皮甲虽然不能完全遮掩他的身体，但好在挡住了腰部以下的重点部位。

他的隐私保住了……

这是独属于他家不帅的权利，而他会誓死捍卫不帅的所有权！

隐身道具同时失效。

黑森林城民看到陡然出现的超大巨人，全都大惊失色：那是个啥？

只听说兽人能变身巨兽，就没听说有兽人能变成巨人的？

但巨人就在他们眼前。

等等，好像某些传说中也提到了巨人，那是什么传说来着？

那巨人一把抓住黑色巨蛇，简直就像传说中的大力神一样，双手分别扯住蛇头和蛇尾，用力一拉。

城民都听到了一声极为刺耳的惨叫。

那黑色巨蛇被一分为二。

这还不是结束。

那巨人手握两段巨蛇，也不知他做了什么，就见他握在手中的蛇头和蛇身不断扭曲，却也不断的萎缩和变得枯干。

几乎不到四五秒，那黑色巨蛇就变成黑色细沙，落到地面上。

然后那巨人的身体似乎又增大了一些？

盖伦神甫意识彻底泯灭前也不敢相信，他怎么可能会死掉。

他的身体已经异变成活死人，已经变成邪神阴影者，他怎么可能会死？

可他就是死了，死得干干净净，不但身体变成沙粒，就连他的灵魂也渣都没留下。

如今只剩下巨兽一个，现场变成了二打一。

不止巴特将军想要帮丹顿侯爵，有些和丹顿侯爵关系比较密切和想要巴结丹顿侯爵的人，也想要在此时过去为丹顿侯爵撑场子。

可是在看到巨人出现后，这些人的想法都变了。

这不是他们能插手的战斗，他们还是在一边老实看着吧，然后看有没有机会偷袭巨人，再救出丹顿侯爵。

丹顿侯爵化身的巨兽一看到巨人出现，当即色变，转身就想跑，他不想打了。

他曾经听过一个传说，那还是非常久远的传说。

这个传说现在知道的人已经不多，他还是有幸在圣山看到了一本古书，上面记载了一首古老歌谣，提到了巨人传说。

相传兽人并不是只有兽身才能巨大化，也有兽人能在人形状态下变身成巨人，这种兽人拥有非常特殊的血脉，那就是战神血脉！

虽然有各种历史记载证明，战神血脉早在第一届兽人联盟出现，也是旧神血皇族被推翻时就已经随着科技之父战书恒先生的死亡而消失。

但那首古老歌谣却提到战神血脉并不是靠生育来继承，他们代表了古神的意志。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 113: Shang the Gigantic (Part 2)

"Bullshit! The Blood Bone Legion bears the royal decree. The moment a disaster beyond the City Lord's control strikes Black Forest City, my Blood Bone Legion must immediately ascertain and take charge of the situation, prioritizing rescue and relief while bearing the crucial responsibility of relaying the situation back to the Royal City. Are you trying to obstruct me from exercising the authority bestowed upon the Blood Bone Legion by His Majesty the King?"

"That's not what I mean! You said it yourself, only when the disaster is beyond the City Lord's control... Right now, just let me rescue the City Lord, and he can get the disaster under control and stabilize Black Forest City immediately!"

"A City Lord who would sacrifice hundreds of thousands of citizens and conjure up corrosive rain—do you genuinely believe he can stabilize the citizenry? Or are you trying to provoke public outrage and force a citizen rebellion?"

"You're shifting the blame with malicious lies! Those are just rumors spread by the City Lord's enemies! Lord Marquis is simply not that kind of person!"

While their subordinates grew increasingly anxious, the two generals were utterly preoccupied with their bickering—meanwhile, a colossal crisis had just erupted over there!

"General, that giant beast looks like it's about to be beaten to death, and that black serpent seems to have died already... it turned into black sand..."

Both generals snapped their heads around simultaneously.

Shang Feifan had just finished off the massive black serpent, right after detecting an item at the tip of its tail that made his heart race with desire.

It was a ring, hidden beneath a scale at the very tip of the black serpent's tail.

Initially, he hadn't noticed anything amiss there, right until he leaped up and stomped squarely onto the tip of that tail.

The black serpent seemed utterly unprepared for its tail tip to be pinned down by someone. Stunned, it whipped its head around to bite him.

In that very fraction of a second, Shang Feifan experienced a subtle intuition; without the slightest hesitation, he drew a massive saber and cleaved straight through the tail tip.

As the black serpent felt the agonizing pain, it was filled with utter disbelief!

It was now an Evil God Shadow-Walker, immeasurably stronger than the original Priest Garen.

Walking within the shadows, it was the shadow itself; logically, no one should have been able to capture its physical form, let alone inflict damage upon it.

Just like those sacred bugs.

Yet right now, this random Beastman who had popped out of nowhere possessed monstrous physical strength and was actually capable of inflicting physical damage on it?

Who the hell was this guy?!

The black serpent tried to snatch back its severed tail tip.

But Shang Feifan beat it to the punch, snatching it into his hand.

To dodge the giant beast's subsequent onslaught, Shang Feifan even triggered the effect of an invisibility item, leaving the black serpent unable to find him and reduced to thrashing in impotent rage.

Shang Feifan's fingers probed bit by bit, and that subtle sensation flooded his brain once more.

Right here!

Shang Feifan pried open the scale.

He spotted a ring.

The focus wasn't the ring, but what was inside it.

Applying force with his fingertips, Shang Feifan violently crushed the ring's face, exposing the spatial pocket beneath it.

It was a black, blocky fragment the size of a fingernail.

As if completely charmed, Shang Feifan pinched the tiny black chunk between his fingers.

The instant he laid eyes on it, he knew what it was.

A fragment of the Insect Mother's heart!

[Adventure Quest! You have accidentally obtained one-ninth of the Insect Mother's heart fragment. Do you choose to absorb the Insect Mother's heart fragment to help upgrade your awakened bloodline talent? The number of levels gained and which bloodline talent will be upgraded remains unknown. There is also a certain chance of upgrade failure.]

Naturally, Shang Feifan chose to absorb it.

[Congratulations, Adventure Quest completed! Affected by the intense resentment lingering within the heart upon the Insect Mother's death, your bloodline talent 'Cursed Curse' has upgraded from 169.5/100 to 200/100. That is, your Cursed Curse bloodline talent has unlocked Tier 2.]

[Congratulations, Adventure Quest completed! Affected by the Insect Mother's innate power, your bloodline talent 'Boundless Strength' has upgraded from 239.5/100 to 301/100. That is, your Strength bloodline talent has unlocked Tier 3.]

[Congratulations, due to your repeated absorption of the Insect Mother's heart fragments, your professional skill 'Insect Researcher' has upgraded from 'Sharp Perception' to 'Telepathy'. Your sensory perception of the insect race will double, and your resistance and adaptability to insect venom will increase once again. Furthermore, influenced by the Insect Mother's power, you possess a natural bloodline suppression effect over mutants afflicted by insect venom.]

[Warning! Influenced by the power of the Insect Mother's heart, you will immediately enter Berserk Mode. Minimum duration: two hours; maximum duration: unknown. Friendly reminder: Please try your utmost to control your mental state and avoid descending into total chaos.]

Damn it! Before Shang Feifan could even revel in his skyrocketing abilities, he instantly felt the onset of Berserk Mode.

His body was swelling; he was going to explode!

"A-Shu, get back!"

Hu Bu Shu froze. What did Shang Feifan just call him?

Faster than thought, Bu Shu's instincts kicked in.

The moment Shang Feifan yelled at him to dodge, he bolted at top speed toward the distance.

In a fraction of a second, Shang Feifan's body ballooned exponentially—he transformed into a giant!

A giant twice as tall as the colossal beast transformed by Marquis Denton!

Thank goodness he had purchased a dual-purpose transformation protective leather armor from the game mall.

While this leather armor couldn't entirely cover his massive frame, it thankfully shielded the vital areas below his waist.

His modesty was preserved...

That was a privilege exclusively belonging to his family's Bu Shu, and he would defend Bu Shu's sole ownership of it with his dying breath!

Simultaneously, the invisibility item wore off.

When the citizens of Black Forest City saw the abruptly materialized super-giant, they were struck dumb with terror: What in the world is that?!

They had heard of Beastmen transforming into giant beasts, but they had never heard of a Beastman transforming into a literal giant!

Yet there the giant stood, right before their eyes.

Wait, didn't certain legends mention giants as well? What legend was that again?

The giant reached out and grabbed the black serpent, wielding it effortlessly like a legendary titan; gripping its head and tail in each hand, he pulled with all his might.

The citizens all heard an ear-piercing shriek.

The black serpent was ripped cleanly in two.

And that wasn't the end of it.

Wielding the two halves of the giant snake, the giant performed some unknown feat; the snake head and body in his grasp twisted continuously while rapidly withering and drying up.

In less than four or five seconds, the black serpent was reduced to fine black sand, scattering across the ground.

And then... did the giant's body grow even larger?

Before Priest Garen's consciousness was completely obliterated, he couldn't fathom how he could possibly die.

His body had already mutated into a living corpse; he had become an Evil God Shadow-Walker—how could he possibly die?

Yet die he did, thoroughly and utterly. Not only was his body reduced to grains of sand, but not even a scrap of his soul was left behind.

Now, with only the giant beast remaining, the battlefield had shifted to a two-on-one.

Not only did General Batt wish to aid Marquis Denton, but several individuals closely tied to Marquis Denton—or those eager to curry favor with him—also wanted to rush forward at that moment to back him up.

Yet the moment they witnessed the emergence of the giant, all their plans evaporated.

This was no longer a battle they could meddle in. They were better off staying put and watching honestly, waiting to see if an opportunity arose to launch a sneak attack on the giant and rescue Marquis Denton.

The moment the giant beast—transformed by Marquis Denton—laid eyes on the giant, its expression warped in terror. Turning tail, it tried to flee; it didn't want to fight anymore.

It had once heard a legend, a very ancient one indeed.

Very few people knew of this legend nowadays; he had merely been fortunate enough to browse an ancient tome on the Sacred Mountain, which recorded an archaic ballad mentioning the legend of the giants.

Legend had it that Beastmen weren't restricted to massive beast forms alone; certain Beastmen could transform into giants while retaining their humanoid state. Such Beastmen possessed an exceptionally unique bloodline—the God of War Bloodline!

Though various historical records proved that the God of War Bloodline had vanished long ago with the death of the Father of Technology, Mr. Zhan Shuheng, during the founding of the first Beastmen Alliance and the overthrow of the Old God Blood Emperor...

That archaic ballad hinted that the God of War Bloodline was not inherited through procreation; rather, they embodied the very will of the ancient gods.

chunks.chineseText:
歌谣还提到，战神血脉只会在兽人世界最危急的时候出现，而战神血脉一旦出现，这个世界必然要有极大变动。

丹顿侯爵无法判断那个巨人是否是战神血脉，但那条黑色巨蛇都死在巨人手中，他完全不想考验自己的身体坚固度是否超过那条用物理手段怎么都杀不死的黑色巨蛇。

那可是邪神阴影者！

丹顿侯爵自认自己的实力还无法超过邪神阴影者，这时候自然不会和杀死邪神阴影者的巨人硬钢。

巨兽一跑，巨人也追了上去。似乎不杀死他就不会罢休。

不帅偷偷施法拖慢巨兽的速度，巨兽身体庞大，只冻住他的四肢还不够，自然侵蚀也不能马上就拖垮他的身体。

巨兽跑得速度慢了一点，被巨人抓住了后腿，一把拎了起来。

巨兽用力猛踹。

可他的身体也受到了奇怪的术法影响。

他以前从来不知道拉斐尔郎沐竟然还会这种只有圣山祭司宫的祭司们才会的奇怪术法。

“放箭！”巴特将军急得对手下大吼。

弓箭兵们立刻挽开强工，对准半空的巨人。

蒙川看到巨人出现，瞳孔地震，在巴特将军喊着要放箭时也跟着厉喝：“你敢！那是战神血脉！”

一声战神血脉，让无数士兵震惊和震动。

就连巴特那边的弓箭兵都迟疑了。

战神血脉虽然早就消失，兽人大陆却一直都有关于战神血脉的传说。

当兽人们痛苦、悲伤和绝望时，战神血脉的传说甚至能给他们带来力量。

哪怕他们身边没有战神血脉，哪怕战神血脉已经消失，但只要传说还在，似乎希望就还在。

现在他们听到了什么？

那巨人竟然就是战神血脉？

活生生的战神血脉！

咻咻咻！几百只箭射出去。

有兽人士兵发出大叫，这叫声不是鼓舞士气，而是来不及挽回的痛叫。

他们当时箭在弦上，已经习惯听从命令的士兵们一听到巴特将军下令，身体就下意识动了。

等到他们听到“战神血脉”这个特殊词汇时，箭已经射了出去。

但也有士兵硬生生止住了动作。

不过这些远距离射出的箭对巨人似乎也没有多少影响，他直接抡起巨兽当做挡箭牌，把那些飞过来的箭全都打飞。

不仅如此，那巨人还拎着巨兽的后腿，抡起来就往地上、墙壁上、石砖房上反复砸摔。

巨兽被摔得完全没有反抗之力。

巨人本来就力道巨大，再加上他本身的力量天赋加成……

丹顿侯爵被砸晕前，不得不不顾形象地狂喊：“我是黑森林城主！我是虎国的一等侯爵！你不能这样对我！我要求贵族引渡权！把我送到王城，让陛下来审判我！”

想你妈的美事！还贵族引渡权？老子现在就要你死！巨人发出震耳欲聋的吼声，砸得更用力。

丹顿侯爵被砸晕了，他的四肢和身体都不知道断了多少根骨头，身体上全是血。

不帅惊得连揉眼睛都忘了。

老商有这么凶残的吗？

好吧，这家伙好像一直都很凶残，只不过在他面前表现不多而已。

但他怎么会变身巨人？

老商的身体真的很古怪，变兽身时就是一只路都走不稳专卖可爱的虎崽子，变人身时却是成年兽人的身体，可他巨大化时竟然能变身巨人。

难道是因为他是玩家才会这样？

还是说老商有什么隐藏血脉？

“老商，走了！”不帅高喊了一声。

再让商非凡这么砸下去，黑森林城就真的剩不下多少。

黑森林城民现在还感激他们，但再过一会儿，恐怕就要集体骂他们两人的祖宗。

商非凡虽然进入狂暴模式，但他的大脑始终保持着一丝清醒，而这丝清醒就连线着他家不帅大宝贝。

听到不帅叫他走人，商巨巨连想都没想，提着那半死的巨兽就迈开大步走出黑森林城。

轰隆，轰隆！

地面都在颤抖。

无人敢阻拦商非凡，城主府跑出来的人同样。

黑森林城人全都仰着头看着巨人提着那卖相特别凄惨的巨兽离开，当巨人的身形消失在远方森林中，黑森林城猛然爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼。

不帅听到了。他敢用膝盖打赌，这欢呼至少有一半是欢庆破坏者都离开了。

嗯，老商绝对也是破坏者之一。

所以说英雄不好当啊。

黑森林已经安静了很多年，但在今天糟了大殃。

一个巨人闯进森林深处，抓着一只巨兽就到处乱砸。

“不要破坏树木！”不帅大吼。

在兽人大陆，不到非必要的时候，就不允许损坏成型的树木，尤其是成片的大型森林。

很多兽人都认为只要森林和草原存在，那兽人大陆的自然就还有彻底恢复的一天。

更有大量兽人认为，当年离开兽人大陆的植物人族很可能就有那么几个躲在森林深处。

像黑森林就是虎国最有名也是占地面积最大的一片森林，在这里有个写进虎国法律的铁规定，那就是十年才能砍伐一次，一次不能超过三百棵树木。而且每年都要种下一批新树苗，不管是什么树木，只要能扩大森林范围，而不是缩小。

得到自然之神青睐的不帅在进入黑森林后就感觉到了舒适的气息，在这里，他有种回家的安心感。

没有人希望自己的家园被破坏，尤其破坏者还是自己的……伙伴。

巨人生气地提着巨兽往地面砸了两下。

丹顿侯爵也到了极限，身体缩小重新变回兽人状态。

这位侯爵的情况很糟糕，口鼻流血，四肢断骨戳出皮肤，原本顺遂的华丽金发也变得乱糟糟一团，胸口还陷下去一块。

就这样，巨人还不肯放过这个兽人，抬起大脚就想踩扁他。

“打住！你这是怎么了？”不帅再也忍不住，跑过来一把拖出丹顿侯爵。他还有些事要问这位，之前没机会，现在他不想浪费就在眼前的机会。

丹顿侯爵此时已经是进气多出气少，眼看就要玩完。

不帅正想着要不要给他补点血续命。

巨人生气了，一指弹开丹顿侯爵，用两根手指把小小的不帅捏起来。

不帅扒拉着巨人的手指，瞪他：“你到底怎么回事？我不问你是怎么变成巨人的，但你能不能不要发疯？怪不得地球那边关于巨人的传说都是说巨人生性粗暴暴躁，到处搞破坏，就是你这种人祸害了巨人的风评。还是说……你变成巨人就会狂暴？”

巨人忍耐地：“……你变成白虎，越大越好。”

不帅疑惑：“干嘛？你想和我打架？”

巨人舔了舔嘴唇，“不，我想和你干架。”
chunks.englishText:
The ballad also mentioned that the Bloodline of the God of War would only appear when the orc world faced its most critical moments, and whenever it manifested, the world was bound to undergo a drastic upheaval.

Marquis Denton could not judge whether that giant possessed the Bloodline of the God of War, but since that colossal black serpent had perished at the giant's hands, he had zero desire to test whether the sturdiness of his own body surpassed that of a creature that seemed utterly immune to physical destruction.

That was an apostle of the Evil God, the Shadow!

Marquis Denton knew his own strength could not possibly exceed that of the Shadow of the Evil God, so naturally, he had no intention of clashing head-on with the giant that had just slain it.

Seeing the giant beast flee, the giant gave chase as well, seemingly unwilling to stop until he had killed it.

Bu Shuai secretly cast spells to slow the giant beast down. Because the beast was enormous, simply freezing its limbs was not enough, and natural erosion wouldn't break down its body instantly either.

With its speed slightly reduced, the giant beast was caught by its hind legs and hoisted straight into the air by the giant.

The beast kicked and thrashed wildly.

However, its body was also afflicted by a strange incantation.

Never before had it known that Raphael Langmu actually possessed this kind of bizarre sorcery, something exclusive to the priests of the Holy Mountain's Temple.

"Fire!" General Butte roared anxiously at his subordinates.

The archers immediately drew their powerful bows taut, taking aim at the giant suspended in mid-air.

Upon seeing the giant appear, Meng Chuan's pupils dilated in shock. Hearing General Butte order a volley, he barked fiercely, "How dare you! That is the Bloodline of the God of War!"

Those three words—*Bloodline of the God of War*—shook and astounded countless soldiers.

Even the archers on Butte's side hesitated.

Though the Bloodline of the God of War had vanished long ago, legends concerning it had always endured across the Orc Continent.

Whenever orcs suffered, grieved, or despaired, the legend of the Bloodline of the God of War could actually instill them with strength.

Even if they had no such bloodline among them, even if it had seemingly faded into history, as long as the legend remained, hope seemed to endure.

And what had they just heard?

That giant was actually the Bloodline of the God of War?

A living, breathing Bloodline of the God of War!

*Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!* Hundreds of arrows were released.

An orc soldier let out a cry—not a battle cry to boost morale, but a cry of agonizing regret that came too late to recall.

Their arrows had already been nocked, and the soldiers, conditioned to obey commands unquestioningly, had reacted on pure muscle memory the moment General Butte issued the order.

By the time the special phrase "Bloodline of the God of War" registered in their minds, the arrows were already in flight.

Yet, there were also soldiers who managed to forcefully halt their actions.

However, these long-range arrows seemed to have little effect on the giant. He simply grabbed the colossal beast and swung it around like a shield, batting away every single incoming arrow.

Not only that, but the giant continued to haul the giant beast by its hind legs, repeatedly slamming and battering it against the ground, city walls, and stone-brick houses.

The giant beast was beaten completely into submission, stripped of any ability to resist.

Coupled with the giant's already terrifying baseline strength and the bonuses of his innate physical talent...

Before Marquis Denton was smashed into unconsciousness, he had to abandon all dignity and scream at the top of his lungs, "I am the Lord of Black Forest City! I am a First-Class Marquis of the Tiger Kingdom! You cannot treat me this way! I demand aristocratic extradition rights! Send me to the Royal City and let His Majesty judge me!"

审判你个大头鬼! What kind of sweet dream are you having? Aristocratic extradition rights my ass! I'm going to send you straight to hell right now! The giant let out a deafening roar, smashing him down with even greater force.

Marquis Denton was battered unconscious. Countless bones across his limbs and torso fractured, piercing through his skin, and he was covered entirely in blood.

Bu Shuai was so startled that he forgot to even rub his eyes.

Is Lao Shang really this savage?

Well, alright, this guy seemed to have always been pretty savage; it was just that he rarely displayed it in front of him.

But how on earth did he transform into a giant?

Lao Shang's body was truly bizarre. When he took his beast form, he was a wobbly, clumsy little tiger cub dedicated entirely to cuteness; when he took human form, he had the physique of an adult orc; yet when he scaled up, he could actually transform into a giant.

Could it be because he's a player that he can do this?

Or did Lao Shang possess some kind of hidden bloodline?

"Lao Shang, let's go!" Bu Shuai shouted loudly.

If Shang Feifan kept smashing things like this, there wouldn't be much left of Black Forest City.

The citizens of Black Forest City were grateful to them right now, but give it another minute, and they'd probably be collectively cursing both men's ancestors.

Although Shang Feifan had entered a berserk state, a sliver of sobriety always remained in his brain, and that sliver of sobriety was permanently linked to his precious Bu Shuai.

Hearing Bu Shuai tell him to bug off, Giant Shang didn't even hesitate. He hoisted the half-dead colossal beast and strode out of Black Forest City with massive strides.

*Rumble, rumble!*

The ground itself shook.

No one dared to stop Shang Feifan, not even the people who rushed out from the Lord's Manor.

The people of Black Forest City all tilted their heads back, watching the giant haul away the wretched-looking giant beast. The moment the giant's figure vanished into the distant forest, Black Forest City erupted into thunderous cheers.

Bu Shuai heard it. He would bet his kneecaps that at least half of those cheers were celebrating the departure of the destructive menaces.

Yeah, Lao Shang was definitely one of those menaces.

So they say, being a hero is truly not an easy job.

The Black Forest had enjoyed many years of peace, but today it suffered a massive disaster.

A giant barged deep into the forest, grabbing a colossal beast and smashing it around everywhere.

"Don't wreck the trees!" Bu Shuai roared.

In the Orc Continent, unless absolutely necessary, damaging mature trees was strictly prohibited, especially large swaths of contiguous forests.

Many orcs believed that as long as forests and grasslands existed, the nature of the Orc Continent still had a day of complete recovery.

A vast number of orcs even believed that among the Plant-kin who left the Orc Continent years ago, several likely remained hidden deep within the forests.

The Black Forest, for instance, was the most famous and largest forest in the Tiger Kingdom. Here, there was an ironclad rule written into the laws of the Tiger Kingdom: logging was only permitted once every decade, and no more than three hundred trees could be cut down at a time. Furthermore, a batch of new saplings had to be planted every single year—regardless of the species, as long as it expanded the forest's boundaries rather than shrinking them.

Bu Shuai, favored by the God of Nature, felt a soothing aura wash over him the moment he entered the Black Forest. Here, he felt the comforting warmth of returning home.

No one wanted to see their homeland destroyed, especially when the destroyer was their own... partner.

The giant irritably hoisted the giant beast and slammed it into the ground twice more.

Marquis Denton had also reached his limit, his body shrinking as he reverted to his orc form.

The marquis was in terrible shape. Blood flowed from his nose and mouth, broken bones protruded through the skin of his limbs, his once-sleek, luxurious blonde hair was a matted mess, and his chest had caved in significantly.

Even so, the giant was still unwilling to let this orc go, raising a massive foot as if to stamp him flat.

"Stop right there! What on earth are you doing?" Bu Shuai could no longer hold back, running over and dragging Marquis Denton out. He still had some questions to ask this fellow; he hadn't had the chance before, and now he refused to waste the opportunity right in front of him.

At this point, Marquis Denton was down to his last breath, looking every bit like he was about to kick the bucket.

Bu Shuai was debating whether to feed him a bit of healing energy to keep him alive.

The giant grew angry, flicking Marquis Denton away with a single finger, and pinched the tiny Bu Shuai up between two fingers instead.

Bu Shuai batted at the giant's finger, glaring at him. "What is wrong with you? I'm not even going to ask how you turned into a giant, but can you not go crazy? No wonder the legends about giants back on Earth always say they are crude, hot-tempered, and cause destruction everywhere—people like you are ruining the reputation of giants. Or is it... that turning into a giant makes you go berserk?"

The giant said with long-suffering restraint, "...Turn into a white tiger. The bigger, the better."

Bu Shuai was puzzled. "Why? You want to pick a fight with me?"

The giant licked his lips. "No, I want to wrestle with you."
