Chapter 117: The Old Man's Expectations (Part 2)

The overall design of the library felt very much like a museum. Aside from books, there were paintings, models, and... audio-visual dynamic projections and sounds.

"I don't know what the Holy Mountain Priest Palace is like nowadays, but from a very long time ago, the Priest Palace had strict regulations: it was strictly forbidden to interfere in the political affairs of various races, including racial and religious wars. The absolute highest duty of the Priest Palace was to protect the civilizational knowledge accumulated through generations and pass it down from era to era."

"Of course, the Priest Palace also undertook certain advisory roles, such as the ancient court priests, the later alliance priests, and the maintenance and sacrificial hosting work for various temples. Are the duties of the Priest Palace still the same today?" the old man asked.

Bu Shuai replied, "It should still be the same. As far as I know, various nations and independent major tribes all have royal court priests. As for the temples... it's unclear. Very few temples still survive today."

The old man nodded. "When people encounter disasters and hardships, they always pray to the gods for help. But to us—or rather, to the people's understanding of gods during our era—they are only responsible for the natural cycles of this world, establishing and maintaining the basic rules by which the world operates. The gods would never interfere in mortal affairs. The gods likely knew that once they meddled in mortal business, they would also be dragged into mortal conflicts, ultimately escalating into divine wars that would cause the entire world to suffer the consequences."

Shang Feifan praised, "The Ancient Gods of our Beastman Continent are all very sensible."

"Perhaps they learned it the hard way. There are quite a few stories about divine wars in ancient legends, and the Beastman Continent may have been destroyed more than once or twice." The old man turned his head. "We even speculate that the various large landmasses of the original Heavenly River Star originally had no spatial barriers between them at all. It is very likely that the Ancient Gods intentionally created these barriers, perhaps to reduce warfare, or perhaps to protect their own followers."

The two of them also felt this possibility was quite high, and furthermore, spatial barriers had effectively prevented the birth of new gods.

"If all the spatial barriers of Heavenly River Star were to open, what would happen?" Shang Feifan asked the old man for guidance.

The old man let out a low hum. "There are various possibilities. We suspect that the spatial energies of different continents might also have subtle differences. Once these energies circulate and mix with one another, they could very well generate new chemical reactions. Such changes might lead to a brand-new evolution of life across the entire world, but they could also cause mutations in life, or even biological extinction. Do you know a term in the beastman world called 'magic'?"

The two looked at each other and said in unison that they had heard of it.

The old man pointed at Bu Shuai. "The energy on your body is somewhat peculiar; it should be magic. For a detailed introduction regarding magic, you can check the Ancient History Hall; there are relevant records there."

Shang Feifan noticed that the old man seemed intentionally to steer the conversation away from the Holy Mountain Priest Palace, and he was just about to drag the topic back.

Bu Shuai had already fallen for it unconsciously, following the old man's words to ask, "Does that mean in the ancient eras of the Beastman Continent, beastmen could also use and absorb magic?"

The old man smiled. "Legends say so. In fact, regarding the bloodlines within beastmen, there used to be two distinct branches, known respectively as the Divine Bloodline and the Demonic Bloodline. The Divine Bloodline naturally possessed one or several miraculous abilities from birth. As for the Demonic Bloodline, it could absorb magic and utilize certain sorceries to cast spells. Such beastmen were also known as the Demonic Shaman Bloodline."

Shang Feifan wanted to interrupt the old man, but the old codger was too clever, hitting precisely the topics that tickled their curiosity.

As a magician, Bu Shuai could not possibly ignore these rumors.

The old man continued to disclose, "Our alchemy and certain ancient spells actually originated from the sorceries of the Demonic Bloodline."

"Unfortunately, a very, very long time ago, a great war broke out among the intelligent lifeforms on the Beastman Continent. The Demonic Bloodline was defeated and forced to leave the Beastman Continent. However, the legends concerning magic have been passed down ever since. It's just that later generations no longer knew how to use magic, nor did they know what magic truly was."

The old man led the two into the Ancient History Hall, gesturing toward a row of bookshelves. "That section contains the most comprehensive legends regarding magic in the entire continent."

The old man guided the two to pick up a book. "This biography records a very interesting event. This beastman was an adventurer who loved to travel everywhere. She wrote many biographies throughout her life, which serve as an important basis for later generations to study the history, culture, and geography of that era."

Bu Shuai took out the book and flipped it open. To his awkward realization, he couldn't read the ancient characters written on it.

Shang Feifan also tried to look at it, but the script was entirely composed of hand-drawn stick figures and symbols.

The old man probably guessed their predicament and smiled, saying, "We have translated editions here."

"Old sir, you might as well just tell us directly. We are rather pressed for time; we still need to go find our King and report to the Holy Mountain Priest Palace about this library and the fact that the entire continent will soon be swallowed by magma and volcanic ash," Shang Feifan said bluntly.

The old man sighed. "Young people today really have zero patience. And since you were able to arrive here at this time, it means you are the cream of the crop and important figures of this era. You should figure things out yourselves instead of kicking the difficulty over to others."

Shang Feifan expressionlessly replied, "Let's talk about that interesting event recorded in the biography you mentioned."

The old man smiled. "That's more like it. Gathering information extensively is also one of the ways to solve problems. That adventurer mentioned that during her adventures, she encountered a battered and bruised person who claimed to be a Saint-level Magician. He said he had ventured across spatial turbulence following ancient ballads recorded in his family's history, coming here to search for the primordial origin."

Bu Shuai was shocked and blurted out, "What era did that adventurer live in?"

"That was still during the rule of the Old God Blood Imperial Family, recorded in the two-thousandth year of the common calendar," the old man said knowingly. "I said that anyone who can arrive here at this time cannot be ordinary. You are an important medium bridging two spaces."

Shang Feifan frowned; the old man's words gave him the distinct feeling that this old codger was still withholding some crucial information from them.

Bu Shuai, meanwhile, was guessing whether that Saint-level Magician could be one of the two Magus Saints who had recently transmigrated. But the time span was far too huge, and the description of a Saint-level Magician by the adventurer sounded rather strange—what did "searching for the primordial origin" even mean?

The old man's next words unraveled some of Bu Shuai's doubts. He said, "According to the adventurer's records, she traveled alongside that Saint-level Magician for a very long time, and the two even had a child."

Bu Shuai wore a blank, stunned expression.

The old man had no idea what expression Bu Shuai was making and went on, "The adventurer learned from her partner that these people living in another space and on another continent were very likely the descendants of the Demonic Bloodline who had fled the Beastman Continent after their defeat long ago."

Shang Feifan was completely unsurprised; he had already suspected as much beforehand.

As for Bu Shuai, he firmly ruled out the possibility that the Saint-level Magician was either of the two Magus Saints who had recently transmigrated.

Yet this also indicated that a long time ago, Magus Saints from the Fadel Continent had indeed visited the Beastman Continent; they perhaps mastered some secret passage that bypassed the need to tear open spatial barriers.

"Do you know? The child born to that adventurer and her Saint-level Magician partner was historically recorded as the very first 'Heaven-Defier' [Tian Can]." The old man dropped yet another bombshell.

"And that Heaven-Defier, combining the knowledge taught by his parents, evolved the ancient heritage of sorcery into a brand-new alchemy. From then on, alchemy stepped onto the stage of history, becoming another great knowledge heritage of the beastman world."

"Before that Saint-level Magician died, he left behind a final remark: the entire world has had its path to birthing new gods cut off. If one wishes to break the restrictions of the Ancient Gods and forge a new path for new gods, they must shatter the Cage of Gods shrouding Heavenly River Star."

chunks.chineseText:
老人脸上露出神秘之色：“而就在这名圣级魔法师死后不久，圣山祭司宫在一座山洞里发现了你们刚才看到的壁画，我们不知道当时的圣山祭司宫掌握了多少信息，又推论出了怎样的结果，但一年后，当时的圣山大祭司以祭祀己身为代价，偷窥命运长河，留下了一个预言。”

两人一起看着老人。

老人也看着他们。

“这个预言内容我不会告诉你们。因为当你们听到预言的时候，你们就会受到预言内容影响。”

商非凡无语：“那您何必要说出这件事情？”

老人笑眯眯：“因为我就喜欢看别人抓心挠肺想要打我却又拿我无可奈何的样子。”

两人：“……”这是什么顽劣性格？

老人挥挥手：“不逗你们了。你们一气之下要是把我的大脑砸了，嗯，砸了也好，我早就该死了。我可不想一堆小鬼跑来找我问问题，还要问我灾难怎么解决。知道兽人为什么平均只能活三百年吗？就因为方便把难题交给下一代解决啊，哈哈哈。”

这个笑话简直不能更冷。两人对老人的感观也有了过山车一般的改变。

商非凡转头对不帅说：“先去找虎王，然后去圣山祭司宫。这事是整个兽人大陆的事，他们要开会也好、要协商也好，都应该由这些祭司和国王牵头，我们就是适逢其会的路人，负责传个消息就好。”

不帅神情慢慢放松，“你说的对。什么体量做什么样的事情。”

“你们这两个……不负责任只想甩包袱的小懒蛋！我跟你们说这么多，难道你们都没有领悟到重点吗？”老人跺脚。

不帅刚要说话，商非凡拉住他，不紧不慢地对老人说：“我们笨，领悟不了。您有话有任务就直说，只要报酬过得去，我们也会稍微勤快一点。”

老人：“……”哎呀，遇到两个小无赖了。

英雄呢？

那些被激个两句、夸奖两句，再弄点神秘色彩，画个大饼，就会嗷嗷叫着主动扛起救世大任的英雄都死哪儿去了？

商非凡：“现在不流行个人英雄主义，会坐牢还会赔钱，更会被骂成剩母剩父。”

老人痛心疾首：“你们现在怎么也这样！是不是社会发展到后来都会让人性变得越来越自私？”

“您真的想要在这里和我们讨论人性发展的问题吗？”商非凡冷冷地说。

老人长长叹息，嘀咕着什么我的签运一直很差，为什么抽中的人会是我之类的抱怨话。

“我又何必管这么多？早在一千一百年前，我就该死透了。我死后管他洪水滔天。”老人最后嘀咕一句，目光再次没有焦距地看向两人。

“你们以为谁都能激活我，让我出来和他们说话吗？”老人的神色变了，变得高冷又疏离。

有点圣山大祭司那味儿了。

“你，身上有着自然之神的眷顾，身体里还留有自然之神的神力。可你同时身怀魔力，灵魂却非这具身体的原装货。”

“而你，”老人又指向商非凡：“无数星辰从天空降落，星辰坠地之力造成兽人大陆灾难频发。整个兽人世界在地壳剧烈变动前就开始分崩离析。其中一枚偏离轨迹，成为诅咒之神的使徒。”

最后，老人厉声：“你们早就在预言中，这不是你们想逃避就能逃避了的。命运早已经纠缠住你们！”

“噗。”商非凡突然发出喷笑声。

不帅诧异地扭头看商非凡。

老人皱眉，神情不愉。

商非凡懒洋洋地说：“不愧是千年前的圣山大祭司，唬人就是有一手。什么预言、什么命运，您老明明无聊得要死，一察觉到我们出现就忙不迭地蹦跶出来，那时您老根本就不知道我们是什么人，又有什么能力。刚才您说的那些，都是您之后才感知出来的吧？”

老人脸色变化，忽然孩童一般地鼓起嘴巴，生气道：“你这个小鬼真不好骗！为什么你要跟来，就让你旁边那个单独进来就好。诅咒之神的使徒来凑什么热闹，你们就是一群搅屎棍，从古至今都是！”

“然后让我爱人被你忽悠得扛起救世大责？”

“他是你爱人？你们两个是一对？”老人表情古怪，脸上表情变来变去，嘴里还不住嘀咕：“自然之神的眷顾者竟然和诅咒之神的使徒凑到一起，这都是什么事！不过才过千年，那些古神竟然这么不讲究了吗？”

不帅脸有点红，他想否认，嘴巴张了张却什么声音也没有发出。

过了一会儿，老人忽然摆手：“算了。你们不想做，我也不想逼你们。自然有它自己的规律。而我相信你们也不可能眼睁睁看着兽人大陆上的无数生命就这么消逝。”

商非凡：这老头真坏，说是不逼他们，最后还要来那么一句。这老头应该摸清楚不帅的性格了，虽然不帅到现在就没说几句话。

不帅就是太好说话，直接问道：“您老到底想要让我们做什么？”

老人好一会儿没有回应，过了至少有一分钟才说：“打破空间屏障，找到通往魔血血脉后人居住的大陆的空间之路，在全大陆灾难来临前进行兽人大陆生命大迁徙。有很大可能性，那个新大陆可以帮助兽人进化，让兽人拥有新的未来。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 117: The Old Man's Expectations (Part 3)

A mysterious look appeared on the old man's face. "And shortly after this Saint-level Magician died, the Holy Mountain Priest Palace discovered the mural you saw earlier inside a cave. We do not know how much information the Holy Mountain Priest Palace grasped at the time, nor what conclusions they deduced from it, but a year later, the High Priest of the Holy Mountain at the time sacrificed his own body to peer into the River of Fate, leaving behind a prophecy."

The two looked at the old man together.

The old man looked back at them as well.

"I will not tell you the contents of this prophecy. Because the moment you hear the prophecy, you will be influenced by its contents."

Shang Feifan was speechless. "Then why on earth did you bring this matter up?"

The old man smiled beamingly. "Because I just love watching people's hearts itch and ache, wanting to beat me up yet being completely helpless against me."

The two: "..." What kind of mischievous personality is this?

The old man waved a hand. "I won't tease you anymore. If you smash my brain to pieces out of sudden anger—well, smashing it would be fine too, I should have died long ago anyway. I certainly don't want a bunch of little brats running over to ask me questions, expecting me to solve their disasters for them. Do you know why beastmen only live to an average age of three hundred? Precisely to make it convenient to dump difficult problems onto the next generation to solve, hahaha."

This joke could not possibly have gotten any colder. Their perception of the old man underwent a roller-coaster-like change.

Shang Feifan turned to Bu Shuai and said, "Let's go find the Tiger King first, then head to the Holy Mountain Priest Palace. This matter concerns the entire Beastman Continent; whether they want to hold meetings or negotiate, those priests and kings should take the lead. We are merely passersby who happened to run into it, responsible only for delivering a message."

Bu Shuai's expression gradually relaxed. "You're right. Let's handle matters proportional to our stature."

"You two... irresponsible little slackers who just want to dump your burdens! I've told you so much, did neither of you grasp the main point?" The old man stomped his foot.

Just as Bu Shuai was about to speak, Shang Feifan pulled him back and calmly said to the old man, "We're thick-headed and couldn't grasp it. If you have something to say or a mission to give, just spit it out directly. As long as the reward is decent, we can manage to be slightly industrious."

The old man: "..." *Ah, I've run into two little scoundrels.*

Where were the heroes?

Where on earth had all those heroes gone—the kind who would get riled up after hearing a couple of provocative words or praises, have a bit of mystery thrown their way, be fed a pie in the sky, and then howl at the top of their lungs to take up the heavy burden of saving the world on their own?

Shang Feifan: "Individual heroism isn't trendy anymore. You'll go to jail, lose money, and get cursed out as a bleeding-heart saint."

The old man beat his chest in grief. "Why are you two like this nowadays?! Does societal development inevitably make human nature increasingly selfish?"

"Are you seriously planning to stand here and debate the development of human nature with us?" Shang Feifan asked coldly.

The old man let out a long sigh, muttering complaints to himself about how his fortune sticks had always been terrible, wondering why the person drawn had to be him, and so on.

"Why should I care so much? As early as eleven hundred years ago, I should have been thoroughly dead. After I die, let the floods wash away the world." Muttering his final complaint, the old man's gaze once again looked at the two without focusing.

"Do you think anyone can just activate me and make me come out to talk to them?" The old man's demeanor changed, turning haughty and aloof.

He was finally giving off a bit of that Holy Mountain High Priest vibe.

"You—you carry the favor of the God of Nature, and divine power from the God of Nature still remains within your body. Yet you simultaneously harbor magic, and your soul is not the original factory model of this vessel."

"And you," the old man pointed at Shang Feifan, "countless stars fell from the sky, and the power of those falling stars caused frequent disasters on the Beastman Continent. The entire beastman world began to fall apart even before the violent crustal movements. One of those stars deviated from its trajectory and became the apostle of the God of Curses."

Finally, the old man said sternly, "You were already written into the prophecy long ago; this is not something you can escape just by wanting to. Fate has already entangled you both!"

"Pfft." Shang Feifan suddenly let out a snort of laughter.

Bu Shuai turned his head in surprise to look at Shang Feifan.

The old man frowned, his expression displeased.

Shang Feifan lazily drawled, "As expected of a Holy Mountain High Priest from a millennium ago; you certainly have a way of bluffing people. What prophecy, what fate—you were clearly bored to death, and the moment you sensed our presence, you hopped right out in a frantic rush. At that time, you had no idea who we were or what capabilities we possessed. Everything you just said was perceived *afterwards*, wasn't it?"

The old man's expression shifted. He puffed out his cheeks like a child and said angrily, "You little brat are really hard to fool! Why did you have to tag along? I should have let just the one beside you enter alone. What is an apostle of the God of Curses doing meddling in this? You lot are a bunch of troublemakers, from ancient times down to the present!"

"And let my lover get hoodwinked by you into shouldering the grand responsibility of saving the world?"

"He's your lover? The two of you are a pair?" The old man wore a bizarre expression, his face shifting through various emotions as he muttered incessantly, "A favored one of the God of Nature actually hooked up with an apostle of the God of Curses—what kind of mess is this?! Barely a millennium has passed, and those Ancient Gods have gotten this unprincipled?"

Bu Shuai's face flushed slightly. He wanted to deny it, but his mouth opened and closed without a single sound coming out.

After a moment, the old man suddenly waved a hand. "Fine whatever. Since you don't want to do it, I won't force you. Nature has its own laws. And I believe you two couldn't possibly stand by and watch countless lives on the Beastman Continent simply perish just like that."

Shang Feifan thought: *This old codger is truly wicked. He claims he won't force them, yet he still drops a line like that at the end. He must have figured out Bu Shuai's personality, even though Bu Shuai hasn't said more than a few words this whole time.*

Bu Shuai was simply too easy to talk to, and he asked directly, "What exactly do you want us to do?"

The old man didn't respond for quite a while. At least a full minute passed before he said, "Shatter the spatial barrier, find the spatial pathway leading to the continent inhabited by the descendants of the Demonic Bloodline, and carry out a massive migration of Beastman Continent life before the continent-wide disaster strikes. There is a high probability that this new continent can help beastmen evolve and grant them a new future."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第118章 隐藏的预言内容 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第118章 隐藏的预言内容

商非凡用力一拍掌：“这个好，我喜欢。您老早说要让我们带着海陆空兽人大军去侵略魔法师大陆，我早就答应了。干了，就这么定了！对了，您老说的那个空间通道在哪里？我看看有没有机会找虫族或邪神信徒先帮我们冲刺一波。”

不帅满脸黑线看他。

老人：“……”

他有点后悔了，他不会所托非人，找了个脑残战争狂吧？

他就说诅咒之神的使徒不会有好玩意！

“也许在你们率领全大陆迁徙之前，应该先想办法解决邪神信徒、虫族和虫毒感染的问题。否则把虫毒带到另一座大陆，只会让悲剧重复。”老人不得不谨慎地说。

商非凡笑：“这个简单。我们先偷偷地找到您老说的空间通道。我想您这么看重我爱人，就是因为他能成为打开通道的媒介？等确定通道安全后，我们就对各族开放迁徙名单，卖船票。”

不帅：“……”

商非凡认真计划：“先把精英、富豪、天才、健康的少年男女给悄悄送走一批，这样一旦兽人大陆出什么事，这批被送走的兽人就是火种。然后我们再安排军队，先把我们的落脚地给打下来，然后再慢慢扩大地盘。”

“当然这一切我们都要偷偷地来，避免被邪神信徒和虫族发现，这样我们就可以把他们和老弱病残都留在兽人大陆，让火山和地震来解决他们。你看，这样虫毒就能彻底解决了。”

商非凡接着说道：“实在不行，我们也可以通过空间通道只送走一批精英和幼崽，虽然这么点人数在魔法师大陆很可能混不下去，但作为珍奇物种稀有宠物以及纯苦力应该会有活下去的市场，说不定还能得到当地豪强贵族的重金扶持，比如兽人牧场、优种培育。”

“这其实也是我的入侵战略之一，就是让兽人们伪装成高智商高情感共鸣的宠物，让兽人们走进魔法师大陆的千家万户，直接从内部吃穷他们、干垮他们！”

老人脸色越来越黑。

不帅用力干咳：“老商，够了，别再说了。”

商非凡惋惜：“不用说了吗？我还有很多关于兽人大军侵略魔法师大陆的好主意，你们真的不想听一听？”

老人：“……不要曲解我的意思，我建议你们向别的大陆搞迁徙，不是说让你们去侵略别人，更不是让兽人们跑去做宠物！”

“呵！”商非凡似笑非笑：“您老听听您自个儿说的话，是不是很像笑话？那么多人迁徙进人家地盘，要么就是吞掉别人，要么就是被人吞掉，就两个结果。不是您不爱听，结果就会有所变化。”

不帅叹息，打圆场：“老先生，您要是还有什么事没告诉我们，不如一次性全说出来？免得让我们老是误会您的意思。”

老人轻哼：“这个迁徙到魔法师大陆的做法，只是我的个人建议。”

“来源于您老之前提到的那个预言？”商非凡挑眉。

老人没有正面回应，只说：“我承认这会涉及到入侵和战争，但对比于让无数兽人大陆生命在灾难中死亡，还不如冲出去找找生的机会。别人死，总比自己人死好。”

老人说最后一句话时神色非常平淡。

不帅吃惊。

商非凡却神色淡然，如果他是兽人高层还是老祖宗，他也会第一考虑兽人自己的利益，而不是别的种族别的智慧生物的。

“但，也有很大可能，你们会找到一座还没有被智慧生物占领的新大陆。”老人又透露了一点。

“也是预言中提到的？”商非凡问。

不帅则若有所思道：“预言的内容并没有说明我们具体会占领哪座大陆，但我们想要发现新大陆，想要有新的落脚地，必须先找到通道，还是必须和魔法师大陆相关的通道。对吗？”

老人欣慰地伸手，想是要拍抚不帅的脑袋，但手伸到半途就停住，面向商非凡：“你小子是不是又有什么话要说？”

他真实地感觉到了杀气！

商非凡脸上带笑眼神阴寒：“如果只是这样的预言内容，您老也不会藏着遮着。说吧，是不是打开通道需要不帅献祭自身？还是说在发现新大陆的过程中，我们俩至少得死一个？”

商非凡忽然停住，似乎想到了什么关键：“不，你一开始就没有指望两个人。所以预言中应该只提到了一个所谓的救世主，他是打开通道的媒介，更是兽人们发现新大陆的关键，但他的下场一定不会很好，说不定还会极惨。这才是你死活不愿意说出预言内容的原因！”

老人：……这个敏锐又会给人挖坑的小子哪里冒出来的？如果预言必然会成为真实，为什么现在会多这么一个家伙出来？

现场陷入了非常尴尬的寂静中。

不帅知道老人很可能在等他主动说些什么，比如说他不在乎这些，只要兽人大陆无数生命能有希望，他可以牺牲一切之类。

但每次他刚要开口，就看到商非凡用极为阴森可怖的眼神瞪他。一副只要他乱说话就会干死他的神情。

不帅明智地闭嘴。

商非凡发现非常奇妙的一点，那就是系统自从他们进入图书馆，给他随便布置了两个任务后，之后就一直没有反应。

按理老人在建议他们带领兽人大陆无数生命打通去往其他大陆的通道时，他就应该收到一条任务通知。

但没有。

商非凡心念转了几番，他很想跟系统聊聊，但看看面前的老人投影……他的怀疑心让他不会轻易相信一个陌生人，更何况这还只是一个投影，就暂时没开口跟系统联系。

“您老的建议我们会考虑。我们也要找其他人商议一番。有结果后一定会来告知您。”

商非凡带着不帅离开了图书馆，他没有应承老人任何要求。不过老人送给不帅一张骨质卡片，告诉他，以后凭借这张图书借阅卡，他可以随意来去图书馆。

不帅离去前还特意询问老人，岩浆会不会损毁这座图书馆。老人只让他们不用担心。

“我们可以带其他人前来吗？”不帅问。

“可以，但我不一定会出现。”老人目送两人走出图书馆大门。

大门一打开，一股超级热浪就扑面而来，差点让两人窒息。

好在两人都身体强悍，而且有缘车直接停在了图书馆门口，两人乘上有缘车离开神殿范围，回到地下城的安吉南路站。

商非凡和不帅从车上下来就按照地图所示去寻找宣泄口机关。

他们在车上就已经看过建造图。

一共有五个宣泄口开关，全都位于进出口位置。

两人分头打开自从建成后就从没有被人动用过的机关，千年时间，这些机关竟然还运转良好。

两人打开宣泄口机关就离开了地下城，并没有看到地下城中七十二口水井的水都开始翻腾。

已经在地底喷发的岩浆开始逐渐顺着七十二条斜沟流向七十二口水井，按照计划，岩浆最终会从七十二口深水井中喷发而出。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 118: The Hidden Contents of the Prophecy

Shang Feifan clapped his hands hard. "This is good, I like it. If you had told us earlier to lead a grand army of beasts across sea, land, and air to invade the Magicians' Continent, I would have agreed right away. Let's do it, it's settled! By the way, where is this spatial tunnel you mentioned? Let me see if there's a chance to have the Zerg or the Heretic God's cultists spearhead a wave for us first."

Bu Shuai stared at him with dark lines covering his forehead.

The old man: "..."

He was starting to regret his choice. Had he entrusted such a vital task to a brain-damaged war maniac? 

Just as the rumors said, nothing good ever came from the apostles of the God of Curses!

"Perhaps before leading the entire continent's migration, you should first figure out how to solve the problems of the Heretic God's cultists, the Zerg, and the insect toxin infection. Otherwise, dragging the insect toxin to another continent will only make the tragedy repeat itself," the old man said with forced caution.

Shang Feifan smiled. "That's simple. We'll secretly find the spatial tunnel you mentioned. I assume you value my lover so much precisely because he can serve as the medium to open the tunnel? Once we confirm the tunnel is safe, we'll open up the migration roster to all the tribes and sell boat tickets."

Bu Shuai: "..."

Shang Feifan planned earnestly: "First, we'll quietly evacuate a batch of elites, the wealthy, geniuses, and healthy young men and women. That way, if anything happens to the Beast Continent, these evacuated beasts will be the sparks of our survival. Then we'll arrange our forces to take down our landing spot first, and slowly expand our territory afterward."

"Of course, we must do all of this in secret to avoid being discovered by the Heretic God's cultists and the Zerg. That way, we can leave them behind in the Beast Continent along with the old, the weak, the sick, and the disabled, and let the volcanoes and earthquakes take care of them. Look, the insect toxin will be completely resolved just like that."

Shang Feifan continued, "If worst comes to worst, we can also use the spatial tunnel to send away just a batch of elites and infants. Even though such a small number of people will likely struggle to survive in the Magicians' Continent, there should be a market for them as exotic species, rare pets, and pure manual laborers. Who knows, we might even secure heavy financial backing from local tycoons and nobles, such as beast ranches or high-breed cultivation."

"This is actually one of my invasion strategies: disguising the beast-folk as high-intelligence, high-emotional-resonance pets, letting them enter thousands of households across the Magicians' Continent, and financially draining and collapsing them directly from the inside!"

The old man's face grew darker and darker.

Bu Shuai gave a heavy, dry cough. "Old Shang, enough. Stop talking."

Shang Feifan looked disappointed. "No need to talk? I still have plenty of good ideas about the beast army invading the Magicians' Continent. Do you guys really not want to hear them?"

The old man: "...Do not twist my meaning. I suggested that you migrate to another continent, not telling you to go invade others, and certainly not having the beast-folk run off to act as pets!"

"Ha!" Shang Feifan offered a half-smile that wasn't a smile. "Just listen to what you're saying, Senior—doesn't it sound like a joke? When so many people migrate into someone else's territory, there are only two outcomes: either you swallow them up, or you get swallowed by them. Those are the only two results. It won't change just because you don't like hearing it."

Bu Shuai sighed, trying to smooth things over. "Senior, if there's anything else you haven't told us, why not just spill it all at once? Save us from constantly misunderstanding your intentions."

The old man gave a light snort. "This approach of migrating to the Magicians' Continent is merely my personal suggestion."

"Derived from that prophecy you mentioned earlier?" Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow.

The old man didn't answer directly, only saying: "I admit this involves invasion and warfare, but compared to letting countless lives on the Beast Continent perish in disaster, it is far better to charge out and look for a chance at survival. Others dying is always better than our own people dying."

When the old man uttered those final words, his expression was completely detached.

Bu Shuai was startled.

Shang Feifan, however, remained calm. If he were in the upper echelons of the beast-folk or one of their ancient ancestors, he, too, would prioritize the interests of his own kind above all else, rather than those of other races or sentient beings.

"However, there is also a strong possibility that you will find a brand-new continent not yet occupied by sentient beings," the old man revealed a bit more.

"Also mentioned in the prophecy?" Shang Feifan asked.

Bu Shuai said thoughtfully, "The contents of the prophecy didn't specify which exact continent we will occupy, but if we want to discover a new continent and find a new foothold, we must first find the tunnel—a tunnel connected to the Magicians' Continent. Am I right?"

The old man reached out approvingly, as if wanting to pat Bu Shuai's head, but his hand stopped halfway. He turned to face Shang Feifan instead. "You brat, is there something else you want to say?"

He genuinely sensed killing intent!

Shang Feifan wore a smile, but his eyes were chillingly cold. "If it were merely that kind of prophecy, you wouldn't have kept it so heavily concealed. Tell me, does opening the tunnel require Bu Shuai to sacrifice himself? Or does discovering the new continent mean at least one of us two has to die?"

Shang Feifan suddenly paused, as if catching onto a crucial realization: "No, you never counted on two people from the start. So the prophecy should have only mentioned a single so-called Savior. He is the medium to open the tunnel and the key for the beast-folk to discover the new continent, but his end certainly won't be pretty—it might even be utterly tragic. That is why you stubbornly refused to reveal the contents of the prophecy!"

The old man: ...Where did this sharp, trap-digging brat spring from? If the prophecy is bound to come true, why did an extra variable like him have to pop up now?

An extremely awkward silence fell over the scene.

Bu Shuai knew the old man was likely waiting for him to actively say something, such as him not caring about these things, and that as long as the countless lives on the Beast Continent had hope, he was willing to sacrifice everything.

Yet every time he was about to open his mouth, he would catch Shang Feifan glaring at him with an extremely gloomy and terrifying gaze—a look that clearly conveyed: *Say another word and I'll beat you to death.*

Bu Shuai wisely kept his mouth shut.

Shang Feifan noticed a very peculiar thing: ever since they entered the library and the system casually assigned him two quests, it had remained completely silent.

Logically speaking, when the old man suggested that they lead the countless lives of the Beast Continent to punch through a passage to other continents, he should have received a quest notification.

Yet, nothing came.

Shang Feifan's thoughts spun through several possibilities. He desperately wanted to chat with the system, but looking at the projection of the old man before him... his cautious nature prevented him from easily trusting a stranger, especially when it was merely a projection. For now, he refrained from contacting the system.

"We will consider your suggestion. We also need to consult with others. Once we have a result, we will definitely come back to inform you."

Shang Feifan led Bu Shuai out of the library; he did not accept any of the old man's demands. However, the old man did gift Bu Shuai a bone card, telling him that with this library borrowing pass, he could come and go from the library as he pleased in the future.

Before leaving, Bu Shuai specifically asked the old man whether the magma would destroy the library. The old man simply told them not to worry.

"Can we bring others here?" Bu Shuai asked.

"You may, but I might not necessarily appear." The old man watched the two of them walk out the library gates.

The moment the doors swung open, a wave of super-heated air rushed toward them, almost suffocating the pair.

Fortunately, both of them possessed formidable physiques, and the Destiny Carriage was parked right outside the library entrance. They boarded the carriage and departed the temple grounds, returning to the Anji South Road station in the underground city.

Stepping off the carriage, Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai followed the map to locate the vent mechanisms.

They had already reviewed the construction blueprints while on the carriage.

There were five vent mechanisms in total, all located at the entry and exit points.

The two split up to activate the mechanisms, which had never been touched since their construction. After a thousand years, these mechanisms were still operating smoothly.

Once they triggered the vents, the two left the underground city, completely unaware that the water in all seventy-two wells throughout the underground city had begun to churn.

The magma that had already erupted underground began to flow along seventy-two inclined channels toward the seventy-two water wells. According to the plan, the magma would eventually erupt outward from these seventy-two deep water wells.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第118章 隐藏的预言内容 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
但因为地下城距离地面的夸张层高，那已经被宣泄了部分力量的岩浆就算从水井喷发而出，也只会重新落入地下城，而不会突破到地面。

除非这时候有强烈地震发生，导致上层地面开裂和塌陷。

在商非凡和不帅两人离开地下城不久，就有人再次打开一条地下城入口通道，进入地下城查看。

这些专业人士在经过紧张又仔细地探查后，发现黑森林城地下确实有岩浆爆发的危机，而且已经在爆发中。但让他们震惊又惊喜的是，似乎这些岩浆最终都会集中到地下城中，而不会祸及地面。

探测人员把这个好消息紧急送回王城。

而负责寻找丹顿侯爵的人都已经深入黑森林了，也没有找到丹顿侯爵身影。

商非凡和不帅走在黑森林城中，路上能看到几个脚步匆促的行人，但比起他们第一日进入黑森林城中看到的繁华景象相比，显得萧条凄凉许多。

尤其很多房屋被腐蚀雨破坏，看着就像是刚经历过战火一样。

城中士兵要比平民多，士兵来回巡逻，防止有人趁着灾难打砸抢。

也有彪悍的城民自己组建成民兵队，守护自家街道巷区，不让闲杂人进入。

更多城民还是待在城外血骨军团布置的救灾点，因为大家已经听说了岩浆要爆发的传言，都不敢轻易回城。

商非凡一路走一路查看他已经完成的任务，和还没有完成的。

首先，清除地下城邪神雕像的任务完成，他获得了一共九枚空间石。

加上之前任务获得的一枚，他现在手上已经有了十枚空间石，足够他开始尝试炼制空间储物工具。

查明腐蚀雨的来历，完成。获得5点贡献点。

想法进入第三重神殿，也就是图书馆，完成。获得10点。

另外还有悬挂许久的任务五十九，寻找迫害那对母子的真正凶手，竟然也显示完成了。获得10点。

这任务当时他以为锁定凶手为丹顿侯爵就是正解，但现在才完成，说明那对母子并不是丹顿侯爵所害，而是夺舍丹顿侯爵的老丹顿所害。

现在除了主线任务和地图探索任务，他还有四个任务没有完成。

分别是：

任务二十三，探索异度空间的未知区域。

任务六十七，查明丹顿侯爵把遇难城民转入地下城的真正原因。

任务七十一，设法解决黑水河大平原的岩浆大爆发灾难。

任务七十二，观看雕像广场的全部残留碑文，找到兽人大陆古神陨落的秘密。

商非凡比较在意的是任务六十七，他和不帅都以为丹顿侯爵把城民转入地下城是为了献祭给邪神，以此来阻止岩浆爆发。

但他提交了答案，发现这个任务还是未完成状态。

那么丹顿侯爵把数万城民转入地下城的真正原因是什么？总不能真是保护吧？

他把这个答案提交上去，同样没有通过。

看来想要完成这个任务，他还得找老侯爵的灵魂聊聊？

但他不知道要如何唤醒沉睡的灵魂。

商非凡只能把这个任务暂时放下，看以后会不会有机遇完成，或者请教不帅？

任务七十二最容易完成，但商非凡没有急着进入雕像广场，而是决定和系统先聊聊。

“系统，那老头的提议是不是很不靠谱？所以你才没有给我发布相关任务？”商非凡直接问。

不帅看他，没说话。

系统很高冷，拒绝回答问题。

商非凡要是那么容易打发就不是商非凡了。

“打开前往其他大陆通道的路走不通，或者代价极大。你们演算出了这点，也许是直接从命运长河中窥探到了未来，对吗？”

系统坚决保持沉默。

商非凡又道：“穿越到兽人大陆来的魔法师不止不帅一个。如果老头说的预言中真的需要一个具有两边大陆联系的人当做媒介，那么只要是从法德尔大陆魂穿过来的魔法师都吻合这个条件，对吗？”

系统还是没有回应。

但商非凡脸上却流露出肯定的笑容：“我说对了，所以你才没有反驳。那么我们再推理一下，你没有发布让我带领兽人迁徙的任务，也就说这个任务的性价比极低，至少对你、对整个‘游戏’的推进没有任何好处。”

“那么你推进的游戏的主旨是什么呢？从主线看，就是让自然之神恢复。”

“那么是不是让自然之神恢复，就能阻止兽人大陆的灭世灾难？毕竟，如果灾害频发，整个兽人大陆都乱成团，对于我寻找自然之神散落的力量也很不利。”

“再说我们看到的那幅壁画，根据壁画内容，似乎我们什么也不用做，只要等到兽人大陆灭世灾难爆发，让时间恢复大陆生态就好。到时候自然会恢复，按理自然之神也能恢复过来，甚至邪神都跑掉了。”

“可如果真是这样，也就没必要推动游戏，没必要给我发布主线任务，只要无为而治一心等待就好。”

“换言之，要么那幅预言壁画的预言内容不可信，要么就是……重新诞生的自然之神将是新神，古老的自然之神会随着兽人大陆的灭世之灾一起玩完。”

“你还要继续保持沉默吗？你应该知道，对我来说兽人世界怎样、自然之神怎样，都无所谓。我唯一在乎的就是不帅，你也知道我愿意去做任务的最终目的，就是想要把不帅带出这个游戏世界。”

在旁边听到一切的不帅就感到心里怪怪的。

商非凡最后道：“不要用不帅来拿捏我。想要我做得更多，你得告诉我更多信息。现代战士都知道，想要打赢一场战斗，掌握信息非常关键。基本上谁先掌握真实信息、谁掌握的信息更多，得到的胜率也就更大。蒙头做事不是我的风格，我想你选择我作为你的‘玩家’，看上的应该也不是我的听话和莽撞。”

他就没有这两个特质。

【完成任务七十二，你会得到一个惊喜，也会得到你想要的答案。】

商非凡挑眉。原本他还想把这个阅览碑文的任务放一放，现在倒是有必要尽早完成这个任务。

“你去做你的任务，我去南城门那边看看。”不帅道。

商非凡当即就想起了他们和那十六名士兵的约定：“我和你一起去。”

商非凡一路走一路发出召唤，他不知道狰爷躲藏在哪里，只能这么做。

后悔！他就该给狰爷也准备一个联络用的炼金装备，免得每次召唤都这么麻烦。

快走到南城门口时，狰爷终于听到召唤跑了出来，它跑出时嘴里还嚼着一只大虫子。

南城门口码头。

原本和商非凡两人约定要在这里见面的士兵们看到商、虎两人出现，全都异常高兴。

这十六名士兵中以那名传信侍卫为首，他们都换了服装、做了伪装，带着家人躲藏在码头附近。

原本传信侍卫想要带着家人单独离开，但他考虑再三，最终决定还是跟着大家一起抱团。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 118: The Hidden Contents of the Prophecy (Part 2)

However, due to the exaggerated vertical height between the underground city and the surface, even if that magma—having already lost a portion of its force—erupted from the wells, it would merely fall back down into the underground city rather than breaking through to the surface.

Unless a massive earthquake occurred at that exact moment, causing the upper ground level to crack and collapse.

Shortly after Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai left the underground city, someone once again opened an entrance tunnel and ventured inside to investigate.

After a tense and thorough inspection, these professionals discovered that there indeed was a crisis of magma eruption beneath Black Forest City, and it was already in progress. But to their shock and pleasant surprise, it seemed that all this magma would ultimately be concentrated within the underground city and would not harm the surface.

The detection team urgently rushed this good news back to the royal city.

Meanwhile, the people tasked with searching for Marquis Danton had penetrated deep into the Black Forest without finding a trace of him.

Walking through Black Forest City, Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai passed a few hurried pedestrians along the way, but compared to the bustling prosperity they had witnessed on their first day entering the city, it now appeared vastly more desolate and bleak.

In particular, many houses had been ravaged by the corrosive rain, making them look as though they had just weathered the fires of war.

Soldiers outnumbered civilians in the streets, patrolling back and forth to prevent anyone from looting amidst the disaster.

There were also fierce townspeople who had organized themselves into militia squads to guard their own streets and alleys, keeping idlers out.

The majority of the citizens remained stationed at the disaster relief camps set up outside the city by the Blood-Bone Legion, too terrified to easily return to town after hearing the rumors of the impending magma eruption.

As he walked, Shang Feifan checked his completed and uncompleted quests.

First, the quest to purge the Heretic God's statues in the underground city was complete, netting him a total of nine spatial stones.

Combined with the one obtained from a previous quest, he now had ten spatial stones in his possession—more than enough to begin attempting the refinement of spatial storage artifacts.

Investigate the origin of the corrosive rain: Completed. Reward: 5 contribution points.

Gain entry into the third tier of the temple, namely the library: Completed. Reward: 10 points.

In addition, Quest 59, which had been hanging for a long time—finding the true culprit who persecuted that mother and son—had unexpectedly shown as completed as well. Reward: 10 points.

At the time, he had assumed that pinning the blame on Marquis Danton was the correct answer. But completing it only now indicated that the mother and son weren't harmed by Marquis Danton, but rather by Old Danton, who had possessed Marquis Danton's body.

Now, aside from the main quest and map exploration quests, he had four quests left unfinished:

Quest 23: Explore the unknown regions of the alternate dimension.

Quest 67: Investigate the true reason why Marquis Danton transferred the afflicted townspeople into the underground city.

Quest 71: Find a way to resolve the massive magma eruption disaster in the Blackwater River Plain.

Quest 72: View all the remaining inscriptions in the Statue Plaza and uncover the secret behind the fall of the ancient gods of the Beast Continent.

What weighed heaviest on Shang Feifan's mind was Quest 67. Both he and Bu Shuai had assumed Marquis Danton moved the citizens underground to sacrifice them to the Heretic God in order to halt the magma eruption.

Yet when he submitted that answer, the quest still showed as incomplete.

So what was the true reason Marquis Danton moved tens of thousands of citizens underground? Surely it couldn't have been out of protection?

He submitted this new thought, but it was rejected as well.

It seemed that if he wanted to complete this quest, he would have to chat with the old Marquis's soul?

Yet he had no idea how to awaken a slumbering soul.

Shang Feifan could only temporarily set this quest aside, seeing if an opportunity would arise later, or perhaps he could consult Bu Shuai?

Quest 72 was the easiest to complete, but instead of rushing into the Statue Plaza, Shang Feifan decided to have a chat with the system first.

"System, isn't that old codger's proposal wildly unreliable? Is that why you didn't issue me any related quests?" Shang Feifan asked directly.

Bu Shuai glanced at him without speaking.

The system remained ice-cold, refusing to answer the question.

If Shang Feifan were someone who could be dismissed so easily, he wouldn't be Shang Feifan.

"The path to opening the passage to other continents is a dead end, or the cost is astronomical. You calculated this, perhaps directly peering into the future from the River of Destiny, am I right?"

The system maintained a stubborn silence.

Shang Feifan pressed on: "Bu Shuai isn't the only magician who transmigrated to the Beast Continent. If the prophecy told by the old man truly requires a medium with ties to both continents, then any magician who soul-transmigrated over from the Fader Continent fits the criteria, don't they?"

Still, the system gave no response.

A confident smile surfaced on Shang Feifan's face. "I guessed right, which is why you didn't refute it. Let's deduce further: you didn't issue me a quest to lead the beast-folk in migration, which means the cost-effectiveness of this quest is extremely low—at least for you, and for the progression of this entire 'game,' it yields no benefits whatsoever."

"Then what is the core theme of the game you're pushing? Judging by the main quest, it's to restore the God of Nature."

"Does restoring the God of Nature, then, prevent the apocalyptic disaster of the Beast Continent? After all, if disasters strike frequently and the entire Beast Continent falls into chaos, it wouldn't be very favorable for my search for the scattered power of the God of Nature."

"And speaking of the mural we saw, according to its contents, it seems we don't need to do anything at all. We just have to wait for the apocalyptic disaster of the Beast Continent to erupt, and let time restore the continent's ecology. By then, nature will naturally recover, the God of Nature should logically be able to restore herself, and even the Heretic God would have run off."

"Yet if that were truly the case, there would be no need to push this game forward, nor to assign me main quests. We could simply practice 'governance by non-action' and single-mindedly wait."

"In other words, either the prophecy on that mural is untrustworthy, or... the newly reborn God of Nature will be a brand-new deity, and the ancient God of Nature will perish along with the apocalyptic destruction of the Beast Continent."

"Are you going to keep silent? You should know that to me, what happens to the beast world or the God of Nature doesn't matter in the least. The only thing I care about is Bu Shuai, and you also know that the ultimate purpose for which I'm willing to do these quests is to take Bu Shuai out of this game world."

Hearing everything from the side, Bu Shuai felt a strange stirring in his heart.

Shang Feifan concluded, "Don't try to manipulate me using Bu Shuai. If you want me to do more, you have to give me more information. Any modern soldier knows that to win a battle, mastering information is crucial. Basically, whoever grasps the true information first, and possesses more of it, secures a higher win rate. Charging in blindly is not my style, and I'd wager you didn't choose me as your 'player' expecting obedience and recklessness."

He possessed neither of those traits.

[Complete Quest 72, and you will receive a surprise, as well as the answers you seek.]

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. Originally, he had intended to put the inscription-reading quest on hold, but now, it seemed necessary to complete it as soon as possible.

"You go do your quest; I'll head over to the South City Gate to take a look," Bu Shuai said.

Shang Feifan instantly recalled their agreement with the sixteen soldiers: "I'll go with you."

Walking along, Shang Feifan kept sending out a summon. He had no idea where Master Zheng was hiding, so this was his only option.

*Regret!* He really should have prepared a communicative alchemical gear for Master Zheng as well, saving him the trouble every time he needed to summon the beast.

As they neared the South City Gate, Master Zheng finally heard the call and came bounding out, still chewing on a large bug in its mouth.

The dock at the South City Gate.

The soldiers who had previously agreed to meet Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai here were overjoyed to see the two of them appear.

Led by the courier guard, these sixteen soldiers had all changed into civilian clothes, disguised themselves, and hidden near the docks with their families.

Initially, the courier guard had wanted to escape alone with his family, but after much deliberation, he ultimately decided it was safer to stick together with the group.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第118章 隐藏的预言内容 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
因为他和那几名士兵是看到和知道最多的人，他们知道这座城的灾难就是这两个人破解的，这让他们认定跟着商、虎两人有奔头，至少不会轻易丧命。

这会儿码头这边藏人很容易，很多难民都聚集在这里，想要通过船只离开。

可黑水河突然断流，就算现在河水重新出现，但把守码头的巴特将军以安全为由，没有让任何一艘船只下水。

不少难民不敢回黑森林城，就带着家人朋友集体向王城那边转移。

王城那边对这些一波波赶来的难民也很头疼，只能暂时把他们安置在城外。

商非凡和不帅两人一现身，那十六名士兵就找过来了。

如今城里对两人真身最清楚的就是这十六名士兵。

商非凡和不帅已经商量好，他们不会把这些士兵引往莫约镇。因为他们不清楚这些士兵是真心投靠，还是怀有他意。

不帅原本想让这些士兵去摩罗城，那边也是刚发生过灾难，正是管理较为混乱也缺人的时候，这时候这些士兵连同他们的家人会比较容易混入摩罗城，还能拿到转迁证。

但商非凡则跟十六名士兵说：“我建议你们暂时先留在黑森林城。我可以明言告诉你们，丹顿侯爵已经死了。而除了丹顿侯爵以外，没有任何人知道你们跟我们有联系。”

“你们也不用担心有人怀疑你们假传指令，因为那时候丹顿侯爵还没有从地下城出来，他出来后也没有去见任何人。所以没有人能证明你们说的是假话。相反，你们传达的那些指令对整座城城民都有好处。”

十六名士兵的神情逐渐稳定下来。

只传信侍卫说：“大家都知道我们是侯爵的近卫，当时跟他去神殿的人只剩下我们。如果上面追问丹顿侯爵曾经做了什么，一定会审问到我们头上。”

所以这些士兵担心的不仅仅是被人知道他们背叛了丹顿侯爵，更担心被王城那边抓住审问甚至是灭口。

商非凡沉思片刻：“也许王后会保你们。”

传信侍卫摇头，看看四周，压低声音说：“我这边得到一些秘密消息，我不敢保证真实，但……”

“你说。”

传信侍卫声音压得更低：“我得到消息，丹顿侯爵一家已经被王软禁，就连王后和三王子去探望他们，都被留在金溪庄园。”

商非凡打量传信侍卫。果然不能小看丹顿侯爵身边的亲信人。

这名传信侍卫在如此乱糟糟的情况下，都能打探到王城那边的最新消息，还是如此秘密的消息，可见其个人能力和手上掌握的信息渠道的厉害。

不过想到现在他在别人眼里还是丹顿侯爵的亲信，能打探到这些消息也算是正常。

商非凡正在想要怎么合理安排并能最大程度利用这些人的潜在能量。

不帅在旁边忽然开口：“你们对特别调查局的工作怎么看？”

传信侍卫神色一动。

其他士兵也都抬头看向不帅。

他们都是有能力的人，就算带着家人前往其他地方也能活下去，只是他们不愿被冠上叛徒或罪人的名义成为被追捕者，更不想自己和家人都变成没有身份的流浪兽人。

他们想要跟着两人，也是希望能让家人过上比较稳定的生活。

但那个能变身巨人的兽人似乎并不想带上他们，这让他们有点沮丧。

而虎不帅的话则让他们又看到了一点希望。

传信侍卫迅速道：“您的意思是？”

不帅坦然地说：“我是特别调查局的一级特别调查官，直属于国王陛下。按照规制，我手下可以有五名二级、十五名三级，以及若干实习调查员的名额。之前我一直都没有带人。如果你们有兴趣，可以先从实习调查员做起，以后……”

“我们愿意！”不帅还没说完，十六名士兵全都大声说道。

这对这些士兵们来说简直就是喜从天降。

他们以为他们跟上的是反权贵的造反头子一类的人，没想到人家竟然是官方人员，还直接隶属于虎王。

这在虎国简直不能更根正苗红，可以说他们只要进入特别调查局，成为虎不帅的正式手下，曾经跟随丹顿侯爵的事算个啥？

他们完全可以戴罪立功！

对，他们可以说出更多事情，帮助他们的头儿也就是虎不帅调查丹顿家族的更多隐秘，包括其他权贵的事，他们也知道不少。

他们对于虎不帅是有用的。

商非凡眉毛一挑，没有反对。不帅这神来一笔，他仔细琢磨一番，竟然觉得可行度很高。

特别调查局主要调查什么事？不就是调查邪神信徒和诡异事件吗？

而丹顿侯爵明显和邪神信徒关系密切，除了他自己，还有谁比这些丹顿侯爵身边的亲信士兵知道更多丹顿侯爵和邪神信徒之间的事？

而邪神信徒那边也不会知道这些丹顿侯爵的亲信士兵转投了不帅，这就让这些士兵在短时间内会成为寻找这些邪神信徒的最有效线索。

另外，不帅这次去往王城见虎王也有了借口，他是在调查邪神信徒的时候摸到了丹顿侯爵身上，而他带去的这些士兵会成为最好的佐证。

以不帅和虎王的“交情”，只要这些士兵发挥了他们应该发挥的作用，不帅以他们的功抵过，把这些士兵调入自己手下就是顺理成章的事。

相信虎王也不会反对让自己的私生子手下多一些原本属于丹顿侯爵的士兵，这对虎王来说就是两利。

至于说以后这些士兵会不会投靠王后和今后的丹顿侯爵，成为埋在不帅身边的一根刺？

这对不帅有影响吗？

不帅又不是真靠调查官的身份和薪水生活。那对他只是一个比较便利的身份而已。

不帅见商非凡也没有反对，这件事就这么定了下来。

眼看就要变成匪，结果还是回归官方。这些士兵喜出望外的同时也都安下心来，最美好的是他们不用再带着家人到处跑，家人仍旧可以回到原来的住处，继续原来的生活和工作。

只要他们跟着不帅前往王城，把该过的手续过一遍，他们就什么也不用担心了。

这些士兵的家人和亲朋同样，他们原本忐忑不安，结果转头就听说他们不用远离故土，一切都和以前一样，顿时纷纷长出了一口气。

不帅给了十六名士兵半天修整时间，约好下午五点准时出发，这次他们将从东城门直通王城的大道前往王城。

按照他们的脚程，他们在天明前应该可以赶到王城，天亮正好面见虎王。

琐碎事情安排妥当，两人找到一个隐秘位置，商非凡对不帅打了个招呼，就进入了雕像广场。
chunks.englishText:
Because he and those few soldiers were the ones who had seen and known the most—knowing that the disaster in this city had been resolved precisely by these two individuals—they were convinced that following Shang and Hu would give them a promising future, and at the very least, they wouldn't lose their lives easily.

At this moment, it was very easy to hide people around the docks, where many refugees had gathered in hopes of leaving by boat.

However, the Black Water River had suddenly stopped flowing. Even though the river water had reappeared by now, General Bart, who was guarding the docks, had used safety as an excuse to prevent any ships from launching.

Not daring to return to Black Forest City, quite a few refugees banded together with their families and friends to relocate toward the Royal City.

The authorities at the Royal City were also deeply troubled by these wave after wave of arriving refugees, and could only temporarily settle them outside the city walls.

As soon as Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai showed up, those sixteen soldiers sought them out.

Currently, the people in the city who knew the true identities of the two of them best were none other than these sixteen soldiers.

Shang Feifan and Bu Shuai had already discussed it: they would not lead these soldiers toward Moyue Town. Because they were unsure whether these soldiers were genuinely defecting or harbored alternative motives.

Bu Shuai had originally wanted to send these soldiers to Moluo City. That place had also just suffered a disaster and was currently in a state of chaotic management and a shortage of manpower. Under those conditions, these soldiers and their families would find it easier to blend into Moluo City and even obtain transfer permits.

However, Shang Feifan said to the sixteen soldiers, "I suggest you stay temporarily in Black Forest City. I can tell you plainly that Marquis Danton is already dead. Aside from Marquis Danton, no one else knows that you had any connection with us."

"You also don't need to worry about anyone suspecting you of fabricating orders, because at that time, Marquis Danton had not yet emerged from the underground city, and after he came out, he didn't see anyone. Therefore, no one can prove that what you said is false. On the contrary, the orders you conveyed were beneficial to the citizens of the entire city."

The expressions of the sixteen soldiers gradually steadied.

The liaison guard spoke up: "Everyone knows we are the Marquis's personal guards, and we were the only ones left who went with him to the shrine. If the higher-ups investigate what Marquis Danton once did, they will definitely interrogate us."

Therefore, what these soldiers worried about was not merely being found out for betraying Marquis Danton, but even more so being seized by the Royal City's forces for interrogation or outright silencing.

Shang Feifan pondered for a moment: "Perhaps the Queen will protect you."

The liaison guard shook his head, glanced around, and said in a lowered voice, "I received some secret information on my end. I can't guarantee its authenticity, but..."

"Speak," Shang Feifan said.

The liaison guard lowered his voice even further: "I received word that Marquis Danton's family has already been placed under house arrest by the King. Even the Queen and the Third Prince were detained at the Golden Creek Estate when they went to visit them."

Shang Feifan sized up the liaison guard. Sure enough, one could never underestimate the close confidants around Marquis Danton.

Amidst such chaotic circumstances, this liaison guard had managed to dig up the latest news from the Royal City—and such highly confidential news at that. It was a testament to his personal capability and the formidable strength of the intelligence channels at his disposal.

However, considering that in the eyes of others he was still Marquis Danton's confidant, it was somewhat normal for him to be able to uncover such intelligence.

Shang Feifan was currently wondering how to make reasonable arrangements to maximize the potential energy of these people.

Bu Shuai suddenly spoke up from the side: "What do you all think of the work of the Special Investigation Bureau?"

The liaison guard's expression flickered.

The other soldiers also raised their heads to look at Bu Shuai.

They were all capable individuals; even if they took their families to other places, they could still survive. It was just that they refused to be branded as traitors or criminals and hunted down, nor did they want themselves and their families to become undocumented stray beastmen.

They wanted to follow these two men precisely because they hoped to secure a relatively stable life for their families.

Yet the beastman who could transform into a giant seemed somewhat reluctant to take them along, which had left them a little disheartened.

Hu Bu Shuai's words, however, rekindled a glimmer of hope within them.

The liaison guard quickly asked, "What do you mean?"

Bu Shuai said candidly, "I am a Tier 1 Special Investigator of the Special Investigation Bureau, reporting directly to His Majesty the King. According to regulations, I am entitled to have five Tier 2, fifteen Tier 3, and a number of probation investigator positions under my command. Previously, I hadn't brought anyone on. If you are interested, you can start out as probation investigators, and in the future..."

"We are willing!" Before Bu Shuai could even finish, all sixteen soldiers cried out loudly.

To these soldiers, this was quite literally a windfall dropping from the heavens.

They had thought they were attaching themselves to some sort of anti-establishment rebel ringleaders, only to discover that the other party was actually official personnel, and directly subordinate to the Tiger King to boot.

In the Tiger Kingdom, this couldn't possibly be more orthodox and politically correct! Once they entered the Special Investigation Bureau and became Hu Bu Shuai's official subordinates, what did their past service under Marquis Danton even amount to?

They could completely redeem their crimes through meritorious service!

Yes, they could disclose even more matters to help their boss—namely Hu Bu Shuai—investigate further secrets concerning the Danton family. They also knew quite a bit about other powerful nobles.

They were useful to Hu Bu Shuai.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow and offered no objection. Pondering Bu Shuai's sudden stroke of brilliance carefully, he actually found the idea highly feasible.

What did the Special Investigation Bureau primarily investigate? Wasn't it cultists of evil gods and bizarre anomalies?

And Marquis Danton was obviously closely connected to the evil god cultists. Apart from the Marquis himself, who else could possibly know more about the dealings between Marquis Danton and the evil god cultists than these close confidants of his?

Furthermore, the evil god cultists wouldn't know that these confidants of Marquis Danton had defected to Bu Shuai. This would make these soldiers the most effective clue-trackers for hunting down those evil god cultists in a short period of time.

In addition, Bu Shuai now had an excuse for his upcoming trip to the Royal City to see the Tiger King: he had stumbled upon Marquis Danton while investigating evil god cultists, and the soldiers he brought along would serve as the best corroborating evidence.

Given the "friendship" between Bu Shuai and the Tiger King, as long as these soldiers played the role they ought to play, it would be a logical matter for Bu Shuai to commute their offenses and transfer them under his own command.

Believing that the Tiger King wouldn't object to his illegitimate son having a few more soldiers originally belonging to Marquis Danton among his subordinates, it was a win-win situation for the Tiger King.

As for whether these soldiers might eventually defect to the Queen and the future head of the Danton household, becoming a thorn planted beside Bu Shuai?

Did that have any impact on Bu Shuai?

Bu Shuai wasn't genuinely relying on an investigator's identity and salary to make a living. To him, that was merely a rather convenient cover.

Seeing that Shang Feifan had no objections, the matter was thus settled.

Having narrowly escaped becoming outlaws, only to end up back on the official side, the soldiers were both pleasantly surprised and deeply relieved. Best of all, they didn't need to drag their families around on the run; their families could return to their original dwellings and resume their former lives and work.

As long as they accompanied Bu Shuai to the Royal City and completed the necessary paperwork, they wouldn't have to worry about a thing.

The families, relatives, and friends of these soldiers, who had likewise been anxious and apprehensive, suddenly let out collective breaths of relief upon hearing that they wouldn't have to leave their homeland and that everything would remain just as it was before.

Bu Shuai gave the sixteen soldiers half a day to rest and regroup, arranging to set off promptly at five o'clock that afternoon. This time, they would take the main highway leading straight from the East City Gate to the Royal City.

At their marching pace, they should arrive at the Royal City before dawn, just in time to have an audience with the Tiger King at daybreak.

With the trivial matters properly arranged, the two found a secluded spot, and Shang Feifan gave Bu Shuai a brief nod before stepping into the Statue Plaza.

chunks.chineseText:
第119章 超级惊喜

队伍按时出发，狰爷四平八稳偶尔抽风地跑在最前面，后面跟着同样骑着巨虫的十六名士兵。

路途中，商非凡始终保持着安静，只无意识地抓过不帅的手捏来捏去，他两眼没有焦距地望着前方，似乎在思考什么很难缠的问题。

不帅侧头看他，终于忍不住问：“你那个任务完成了？”

说来也奇怪，以不帅和商非凡的关系，在雕像广场能进人的情况下，商非凡早就该邀请他进入雕像广场逛逛，但至今为止，不帅都没有踏入过雕像广场一步。

不帅脑中偶尔也闪过也许雕像广场对于商非凡意义重大，只有完全失去自我控制能力的存在才能被他放心放入其中。

实际上商非凡只是不想不帅受脑神经被摧残的罪。

他可是深深记得最初进入雕像广场时听到的无数声音，如果不是系统，他能被那些声音直接折磨成白痴。

不帅还是听力异能，进入雕像广场后接收到的杂音也许会远超过他，在没有系统帮忙的情况下，商非凡也不敢保证那座自然之神的雕像会因为一点青睐就保护不帅。

像是夏冰就是在昏迷状态下进入的雕像广场。

商非凡听到不帅提问，回过神：“嗯？嗯。”

不帅：“有什么不能说的吗？”

商非凡脸上再次露出困扰神情，过了一会儿才说道：“不关键的事情没有说的必要。但关键的事情却不能说、不能写、不能传。”

不帅下意识就想到了邪神：“事关邪神？”

商非凡轻轻点头：“我得到警告，只要离开广场，就不能把看到的相关内容传出去，不管我用任何方式，都可能被祂们察觉。而一旦被祂们察觉，我们接下来的行动和计划就会受到极大阻碍，甚至整个天河星都会跟着玩完。”

“整个星球玩完？这么严重。”不帅骇然。

商非凡的眼神似乎在跟不帅述说什么，不帅觉得自己有点看懂，但也不敢确定。

“这样，我提问，如果你能回答就回答，如果不能回答就摇头，如何？”不帅小心翼翼地问。

商非凡笑，揉了揉大宝贝的头发，“你问。”

“你有看到那位老先生提到的预言和壁画的相关记录吗？”

商非凡竖起大拇指，表示不帅这个问题问得好：“看到了，壁画很重要，在广场碑文中也有记录。但广场记载的壁画内容有微妙的不一样处。”

不帅深吸气，“能说哪里不一样吗？”

商非凡摇头。

不帅推测：只要事关邪神的内容就不能提及，也就是说壁画内容不一样的内容应该就涉及到邪神。而壁画最后，邪神受到整个兽人大陆岩浆爆发的影响，变得衰弱乃至不得不离开。看来是这段出了问题。

他之前就奇怪，以邪神的力量，就算祂们被古神逼迫的不得不陷入沉睡，但只是区区陆地地壳变动火山爆发就会导致祂们衰弱吗？祂们又不是和兽人大陆直接联系在一起。

如果有人特意把壁画中的这段内容修改掉，且能修改得让后人无从察觉，首先这人至少活跃在大繁华纪中期，且这人在大繁华纪时的身份地位都不会低。

那是不是说邪神其实在大繁华纪中期就已经出现？

另，若是只修改最后一段，似乎也没有多少意义，换言之，这幅壁画的内容很可能从岩浆爆发开始就有所变动，因为只有这段乃至后面的内容才是他们没有经历过的。

进一步细想，是不是黑水河平原岩浆爆发乃至整座兽人大陆地壳变动导致的火山爆发和地震频发……这些内容全不可信。

不，黑水河平原爆发岩浆灾难应该是真的，但后面波及整座兽人大陆的灾难就不一定是真实的了。

那邪神和祂们的信徒为什么要特意修改这段？

这种行为是不是和老人提及却不愿说出详细内容的预言联动起来？

也就是说邪神和邪神信徒希望兽人们大迁徙，希望兽人们找到通往法德尔大陆的空间通道去侵略法德尔大陆？

“是不是有谁想要坐收渔翁之利？”不帅斟酌词汇问。

商非凡露出赞扬笑容，但随即补充：“更恶劣。”

不帅：更恶劣是怎么一个恶劣法？难道邪神想要彻底掌控和改变兽人，就像掌控和改变了虫人族一样，把兽人全都改造成怪物，充当虫毒携带者和散播者，把法德尔大陆连同整个天河星都侵占和污染下来？

不帅越想越可怕，他甚至想到古神搞出各大陆之间的空间屏障是不是早就预见了这一点，这些空间屏障真实并不是为了阻拦自己人，而是为了防止和拖缓邪神污染整座天河星的脚步。

“祂们来到这里并不是虫母通过献祭和祈祷，而是有预谋的，对吗？”

“嘘。”商非凡在唇边竖起手指。

他第一次见到不帅就知道这人非常聪明，就是心太软，不喜欢把别人想得很坏。

不帅抿紧嘴唇，他看着商非凡的眼睛，鼓起勇气：“我能进去看看吗？”

他不是想要考验商非凡对他的感情，他真的是非常好奇那广场里的碑文都刻写了什么内容。

不帅提出这个请求后就后悔了，他变得忐忑不安，眼看商非凡露出微微头疼的模样，立刻弥补：“我就随便说说，你不用放在心上，我不去看了，你不用为难。”

商非凡好笑：“你以为我在为难什么？”

不等不帅说出什么，商非凡就说道：“我在头疼要怎么帮你屏蔽里面的杂音。那些杂音非常可怕，它们会主动钻进你的脑子里，就算你把耳膜戳破都没用，它们会占据你所有脑神经，就像无数锯子在同时拉锯你的脑神经。”

不帅血气上涌，脸颊变红，掩饰地说：“我的听力天赋刚觉醒的时候，很长一段时间就为耳朵和脑袋里充斥的无数声音痛苦。哪怕极小分贝的声音涌入我的耳朵也会放大无数倍。但后来我自然而然学会了自我调整和主动屏蔽不想听的声音。”

商非凡心疼地捏捏大宝贝的耳朵。

不帅脸色更红，耳朵也变得火烫。

商非凡看着大宝贝变得手足无措的模样，又心疼又好笑，直接拉过他的手：“等休息的时候我送你进去，你试试看，如果感觉不适，或者我感觉你情况不对，就会立刻把你放出来。”

不帅干咳：“不用勉强……”

“阿沐，我的一切都愿意与你分享。”商非凡轻轻说。

不帅呆滞住，目光不由自主地与商非凡对视。

一秒，两秒……

两人的气氛变得越来越微妙，脸与脸之间的距离不断缩短。

就在商非凡侧头，要把嘴唇贴上来的一瞬间。

吧唧！不帅的手掌盖住了商非凡的嘴唇。

“我们还在路上。”不帅绷着脸，一本正经地说。

商非凡先是低低笑，之后笑声越来越大。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 119: A Super Surprise

The procession set off on time, with Fierce General striding steadily at the very front—occasionally acting up and dashing about—followed by the sixteen soldiers, who were likewise riding giant bugs.

Along the journey, Shang Feifan maintained a steady silence, only unconsciously grabbing Bu Shuai's hand to knead and squeeze it. His gaze was unfocused as he stared straight ahead, appearing to ponder some intensely thorny problem.

Bu Shuai turned his head to look at him and finally couldn't help asking, "Did you finish that task?"

Oddly enough, given the relationship between Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan, back when the Statue Plaza was accessible to people, Shang Feifan should have invited him in to have a look long ago. Yet to this day, Bu Shuai had never set foot inside the Statue Plaza even once.

Occasionally, the thought flashed through Bu Shuai's mind that perhaps the Statue Plaza held immense significance for Shang Feifan, and only entities completely stripped of self-control were permitted by him to enter.

In reality, Shang Feifan simply didn't want Bu Shuai to suffer the torment of having his cranial nerves ravaged.

He deeply remembered the countless voices he had heard when he first entered the Statue Plaza; if not for the system, those voices could have directly tortured him into an idiot.

Bu Shuai possessed auditory superpower abilities as well; the cacophony he would receive upon entering the Statue Plaza might far exceed what Shang Feifan had experienced. Without the system's help, even Shang Feifan couldn't guarantee that the statue of the God of Nature would protect Bu Shuai simply out of a shred of favor.

Just like Xia Bing, who had entered the Statue Plaza while unconscious.

Hearing Bu Shuai's question, Shang Feifan snapped back to his senses. "Hmm? Yes."

Bu Shuai asked, "Is there anything you can't talk about?"

A troubled expression once again surfaced on Shang Feifan's face. After a moment, he replied, "Inconsequential matters aren't worth mentioning. But critical matters cannot be spoken, cannot be written, and cannot be transmitted."

Bu Shuai instinctively thought of the evil gods: "It concerns the evil gods?"

Shang Feifan nodded gently. "I received a warning: the moment I leave the plaza, I cannot transmit any related content I saw outward. No matter what method I use, I might be detected by Them. Once detected, our subsequent actions and plans will face immense obstruction, and the entire Tianhe Star might even go down with it."

"The whole planet goes down? It's that serious?" Bu Shuai was startled.

Shang Feifan's gaze seemed to be communicating something to Bu Shuai; the latter felt he understood a little, yet dared not be certain.

"How about this: I'll ask questions. If you can answer, you answer; if you can't, you just shake your head. How does that sound?" Bu Shuai asked cautiously.

Shang Feifan smiled and ruffled the hair of his precious darling. "Go ahead and ask."

"Did you see the relevant records of the prophecy and murals mentioned by that old gentleman?"

Shang Feifan gave a thumbs-up, indicating that Bu Shuai's question was well-pitched. "I saw them. The murals are very important, and they are also recorded in the plaza's stone inscriptions. However, the mural contents recorded in the plaza have subtle differences."

Bu Shuai took a deep breath. "Can you tell me where they differ?"

Shang Feifan shook his head.

Bu Shuai deduced: Anything concerning the evil gods could not be mentioned. That is to say, the differing parts of the mural must involve the evil gods. And at the end of the murals, the evil gods were affected by the magma eruptions across the entire Beastman Continent, growing weak and even being forced to leave. It seemed this section was where the problem lay.

He had found it strange previously: given the power of the evil gods, even if they were forced into slumber by the ancient gods, would they really be weakened by mere crustal movements and volcanic eruptions on a continent? They weren't directly tied to the Beastman Continent in that manner.

If someone deliberately altered this section of the murals in a way that left future generations utterly unable to detect the tampering, that person must have been active at least during the mid-Great Prosperity Era, and their status and position during that era could not have been low.

Does that mean the evil gods actually appeared as early as the mid-Great Prosperity Era?

Furthermore, modifying only the final section didn't seem to carry much significance. In other words, the contents of this mural likely began to shift starting from the magma eruptions, because only this section and what followed were events they had not personally experienced.

Thinking further, could it be that the magma eruption in the Black Water River Plain—and even the frequent volcanic eruptions and earthquakes caused by crustal movements across the entire Beastman Continent—were completely untrustworthy?

No, the magma eruption disaster in the Black Water River Plain should be true, but the subsequent disaster engulfing the entire Beastman Continent wasn't necessarily real.

Why would the evil gods and their cultists deliberately modify this section?

Could this behavior be linked to the prophecy mentioned by the old man, the details of which he was unwilling to divulge?

In other words, did the evil gods and their cultists want the beastmen to mass-migrate, hoping they would find the spatial passage leading to the Fadel Continent and invade it?

"Is someone trying to sit back and reap the spoils while others do the battle?" Bu Shuai asked, weighing his words.

Shang Feifan wore an approving smile, but immediately added, "It's even more vicious."

Bu Shuai: Just how vicious could "even more vicious" be? Could it be that the evil gods wanted to thoroughly control and transform the beastmen, just as they had controlled and transformed the insectoid race, turning all beastmen into monsters, serving as carriers and spreaders of insect venom, and invading and polluting the Fadel Continent along with the entire Tianhe Star?

The more Bu Shuai thought, the more terrified he became. He even wondered if the ancient gods creating spatial barriers between various continents had foreseen this long ago—that these spatial barriers weren't truly meant to block their own people, but rather to prevent and slow down the pace at which the evil gods polluted the entire Tianhe Star.

"They didn't arrive here through the Mother of Insects' sacrifices and prayers; it was premeditated, right?"

"Hush." Shang Feifan pressed a finger to his lips.

From the very first time he met Bu Shuai, he knew this person was exceedingly clever, save for being too soft-hearted and disliking to think the worst of others.

Bu Shuai pressed his lips tightly together. He looked into Shang Feifan's eyes and mustered his courage: "Can I go in and take a look?"

He wasn't trying to test Shang Feifan's feelings for him; he was genuinely and intensely curious about what was inscribed on the stone tablets in that plaza.

Bu Shuai regretted making the request almost as soon as it left his mouth. He grew anxious and nervous, and seeing Shang Feifan's slightly troubled expression, he quickly made amends: "I was just speaking off the cuff, you don't have to take it to heart. I won't go look, you don't need to be put in a difficult position."

Shang Feifan chuckled musically. "What do you think I'm finding difficult?"

Before Bu Shuai could say anything, Shang Feifan continued, "I'm agonizing over how to help you shield against the cacophony inside. Those noises are terrifying; they actively burrow into your brain. Even if you punctured your eardrums, it would be useless—they occupy all your neural pathways, like countless saws grinding against your brain nerves simultaneously."

Blood rushed to Bu Shuai's head, flushing his cheeks red. Covering his embarrassment, he said, "When my auditory talent first awakened, for a very long time I suffered terribly from the countless voices filling my ears and mind. Even the tiniest decibel of sound pouring into my ears would be amplified infinitely. But later on, I naturally learned to self-adjust and actively shield out the sounds I didn't want to hear."

With a heart full of tender affection, Shang Feifan pinched his precious darling's ear.

Bu Shuai's face flushed even deeper, and his ears grew piping hot.

Watching his precious darling's flustered and helpless demeanor, Shang Feifan felt both fond and amused. He directly pulled Bu Shuai's hand over: "When we rest, I'll send you in. Give it a try; if you feel any discomfort, or if I sense something is wrong with you, I'll pull you right back out."

Bu Shuai coughed dryly. "You don't have to force it..."

"Ah-Mu, I am willing to share everything of mine with you," Shang Feifan said softly.

Bu Shuai froze, his gaze involuntarily locking with Shang Feifan's.

One second, two seconds...

The atmosphere between the two grew increasingly subtle, the distance between their faces shrinking steadily.

Just as Shang Feifan turned his head, at the exact instant he was about to press his lips against Bu Shuai's—

*Slap!* Bu Shuai's palm covered Shang Feifan's lips.

"We're still on the road," Bu Shuai said with a rigid face and deadpan seriousness.

Shang Feifan first chuckled lowly, then his laughter grew louder and heartier.

“好了，不逗你了，我们来说正经事。”商非凡看向远方：“王后和三王子被放出来了。王后进入宫廷寻找虎王，想要派出人手寻找丹顿侯爵的下落，为此不惜和虎王提出交换条件。另外，我们另一个熟人，那位天残谷谷主也带着护卫进入了王城，如今正在王城四处活动，想要见到虎王。”

不帅先点头，随后反应过来，惊讶问：“你怎么知道这些？”

商非凡下午进入雕像广场查看碑文，一直到接近约定时间才出来，之后他和任何人都没有交流，除了他。

商非凡露出一个神秘笑容，指指自己的脑袋：“完成阅读任务后，我获得了一个惊喜。”

不帅很想问是什么惊喜，但商非凡摇头：“这个惊喜的内容不能说。你可以慢慢体会，时间久了，你就能猜出来。”

商非凡在系统告诉他获得了怎样的惊喜后，也是异常惊讶。

他没想到兽人世界在大繁华纪竟然已经搞出了比地球现代天眼系统还要发达的监控系统。

那是真天眼。

在大繁华纪，这些天眼遍布整个兽人海陆空领域，它们就像是地球的无线监控器，每时每刻都把它们看到、听到的内容反馈到总处理器中。

这个总处理器就会对所有汇总来的信息进行归纳、分析和剖解，找出不利于治安的犯罪活动，然后传达给相应部门。

这个部门在大繁华纪被称为警方的超快速反应警队，他们总是像能预知一样，可以抢在犯罪出现前，先一步解决犯罪可能的嫌疑人，或者提前救下受害人。

这让商非凡想到了地球某些科幻影视剧。

天眼系统想要实现不难，难就难在最后的信息汇总、归纳、分析、推理、剖析等。

兽人世界结合炼金术实现了这个梦幻系统。

但是这个天眼系统在大繁华中后期受到了来自联盟政府某些高层的各种打压，就跟地球人一样，兽人们同样担心自己的隐私被泄露、被成天监控，更担心最后兽人们会变相变成被机器给统治和管理。

最后这个天眼系统大半功能被封禁，变成不能主动提供情报分析功能，只能在相关人员进行查询时给出查询结果。

而且想要查询什么人、什么内容，还得得到相应级别的许可。不是说一个小警员想要去查询联盟要员的行踪，就能从天眼系统那里拿到。

到了大繁华纪后期，除了极少数人，绝大多数人都已经不知道天眼系统存在。

关于超快速反应警队的传说，也变成了该警队拥有预言天赋的警员，当这名警员去世后，这支超快速反应警队也跟着消失。

当然，监控设施仍旧存在。

兽人世界的监控器材除了固定在建筑物上的，更多的是自由飞来飞去的球状眼睛。

这种球状眼睛监控器可以三百六十度没有死角地监控自己视听范围内的所有内容，还能靠吸收光能来维持活动能量，属于真随便用不用充能那种，一经推出就非常受兽人们欢迎。

之后这种球状眼睛监控器还推出了隐形款，但很快就被民众抗拒，从市面消失。但实际上它们作为军用器材一直充斥在整个兽人大陆中。

除了普通的监控器材，兽人们还搞出了类似卫星的空间站。

大战纪时期，大量的监控器材被毁，但也有一部分被保留下来，尤其是太空中那些被遗忘的空间站。

说实话，商非凡真没想到他得到的惊喜会是这样一个惊喜，他竟然获得了向天眼系统查询一定信息的权限。

【系统，不会你就是天眼系统的进阶版本吧？还是说有哪位古神的部分能力甚至是意识进入了天眼系统中，才成为了现在的你？】

系统……拒绝回答，并再次进入更新状态。

"Alright, I won't tease you anymore. Let's talk business." Shang Feifan looked into the distance. "The Queen and the Third Prince have been released. The Queen entered the palace to seek out the Tiger King, wanting to dispatch manpower to search for Marquis Danton's whereabouts, and she didn't hesitate to propose a trade with the Tiger King to achieve it. In addition, another acquaintance of ours—that Valley Master of Heavenly Ravine—has also entered the Royal City with guards, and is currently moving about everywhere trying to see the Tiger King."

Bu Shuai nodded first, then reacted with astonishment as he asked, "How do you know all this?"

Shang Feifan had entered the Statue Plaza in the afternoon to examine the stone inscriptions, only emerging close to the appointed time. Afterward, he hadn't communicated with anyone else except him.

Shang Feifan flashed a mysterious smile and tapped his own head: "After completing the reading task, I received a surprise."

Bu Shuai desperately wanted to ask what kind of surprise it was, but Shang Feifan shook his head. "The contents of this surprise cannot be spoken of. You can slowly experience it for yourself; after some time, you'll be able to guess."

When the system informed him what kind of surprise he had obtained, even Shang Feifan had been exceptionally astonished.

He hadn't expected that during the mid-Great Prosperity Era, the beastman world had already concocted a surveillance system far more advanced than Earth's modern Sky-Eye system.

It was a true Sky Eye.

During the Great Prosperity Era, these Sky Eyes pervaded the entire beastman domain of sea, land, and air. Much like Earth's wireless surveillance cameras, they fed everything they saw and heard back into a central processor every single second.

This central processor would then categorize, analyze, and dissect all the aggregated information, pinpointing criminal activities unfavorable to public order, and dispatching the details to the corresponding departments.

In the Great Prosperity Era, this department was known as the police force's super-rapid response unit. They always seemed capable of clairvoyance, able to preemptively resolve potential suspects or rescue victims before crimes ever materialized.

This reminded Shang Feifan of certain science fiction films and television shows on Earth.

Implementing a Sky Eye system wasn't difficult; the hard part lay in the ultimate information aggregation, categorization, analysis, reasoning, and dissection.

The beastman world had realized this fantastical system by combining it with alchemy.

However, during the mid-to-late Great Prosperity Era, this Sky Eye system faced all sorts of suppression from certain high-ranking officials within the Alliance government. Much like humans on Earth, beastmen similarly worried about their privacy being leaked and being monitored around the clock, and even more so about beastmen ultimately turning into beings ruled and managed by machines.

In the end, the majority of this Sky Eye system's functions were sealed away, reducing it from a system that could proactively provide intelligence analysis to one that could only yield search results when relevant personnel made specific queries.

Moreover, querying about any specific person or content required authorization at the corresponding clearance level. It wasn't as if a low-ranking police officer could willy-nilly demand the whereabouts of Alliance VIPs from the Sky Eye system.

By the late Great Prosperity Era, apart from a tiny handful of people, the vast majority were entirely unaware that the Sky Eye system even existed.

Legends regarding the super-rapid response unit had also morphed into tales that the unit possessed prophetic talents; when the officers with those talents passed away, the super-rapid response unit vanished along with them.

Naturally, the surveillance hardware still existed.

Aside from monitoring equipment fixed onto buildings, a greater portion consisted of free-flying, spherical ocular drones.

This type of spherical eyeball monitor could keep tabs on everything within its audiovisual range through a full three-hundred-and-sixty degrees without any blind spots. Furthermore, it sustained its operational energy by absorbing solar power, belonging to the category of true "use it however you want without needing to recharge" devices. Upon its release, it became immensely popular among beastmen.

Later on, this spherical eyeball monitor even rolled out an invisible model, but the public quickly rejected it, and it vanished from the market. In reality, however, it continued to saturate the entire Beastman Continent as military-grade equipment.

Aside from standard monitoring equipment, the beastmen had also constructed space stations akin to satellites.

During the Great War Era, a massive quantity of monitoring equipment was destroyed, but a portion was also preserved—especially those forgotten space stations drifting in outer space.

To be honest, Shang Feifan truly hadn't expected the surprise granted to him to be of this magnitude: he had actually acquired the clearance to query a certain amount of information from the Sky Eye system.

*【System, don't tell me you're an advanced version of the Sky Eye system? Or did a portion of some ancient god's abilities, or even their consciousness, enter the Sky Eye system and thereby become the present you?】*

The system... refused to answer, and once again entered an updating state.

第120章 身世

王庭的一处花园中。

夜色已深，花园中挂起了制作精美的油肚虫灯。

这些虫灯摆放的位置非常巧妙，并没有把花园照得犹如白昼，而是显得如梦似幻。

仍旧处在壮年的虎王和容貌称不上美艳但也有着独特风情的王后面对面坐在凉亭内。

四周没有一个人，没有侍女，也没有侍卫。

春初，室外夜晚的气温与冬季无异，实在不是个谈话的好场所。

但两人不约而同没有选择在烧着壁炉的温暖室内，而是选择了能更让他们头脑冷静的寒冷室外。

“我们多久没有好好说话了。”

王后拥有一副非常适合唱歌的烟嗓，这让她说话的语调总是带着一种奇特魅力。混合她的端庄坐姿和打从骨子里溢出来的世家贵妇的高傲，让雄性生物面对她时总会有很多幻想。

这也是独属于王后的风情。

虎王看着眼前的王后，在心里叹息。当年他对王后也算是一见钟情，那么多贵族女儿，王后绝不是最美艳最好看的那一个，但当她开口的一刹那，在场所有雄性的目光几乎都投注到了她身上。

可激-情很快就会消退，爱情的保质期也过于短暂。

在老三出世之前，他们就开始彼此厌恶，原因各种各样，就是各种不满积累到一起，终于变成了反感。但他们无法分离，更无法对彼此置之不理，就这么互相折磨。之后两人感情还反复了几次，也有了后来的老三和两个女儿。

“你想说什么？”虎王淡淡问。

王后看着桌上她让侍女精心准备的茶点，提醒自己应该给自己的丈夫倒一杯香醇热烫的奶茶，但她最终还是坐着没动。

“我想说，你对我的羞辱是越来越不遮掩了。”王后原本想说的并不是这句话。

“羞辱？”虎王失笑，又像是冷笑：“我们到底谁在羞辱谁？当我命令软禁丹顿侯爵的情人和他的子女，不允许任何人接触时，你做了什么？”

“你身为一国之王后，身为我的妻子，却公然违反我的命令，不但自己跑去金溪庄园，还把老三也带了过去。哦，老三很大可能是自己也想去，他想为自己多争取一点来自丹顿家族的助力。”

虎王眼中满是嘲讽。

王后神色平静，并没有被指责后的暴跳如雷，更没有歇斯底里：“你是我的丈夫不错。但尤斯塔斯是我兄长，他的儿女也是我的亲人。在他们无法见到自己父母，又被国王软禁，正惊恐不安时，我去探望关照自己的亲人，有错吗？”

虎王低头看向桌上的茶杯，眼中流过失望，渐渐失望不见，只剩下冷漠：“同样的话我们已经讨论过很多次，你重视亲情没有问题，但虎国任何一个兽人都不能违反国家律法，尤其你还是一国王后。”

“如果王后都能带头无视国王的命令，能无视国家法律去庇护有罪之人，那么你要我如何管理这个国家？如何去震慑那些贵族？”

“所以你就迫不及待地拿丹顿家族开刀？”王后尖锐地道。

虎王气：“我拿他开刀？你怎么不问问你的好大哥都做了什么？他竟然使用邪法在整个黑森林城降下腐蚀雨，不但祸害了几十万城民，更污染了黑森林城的土地和水源。黑森林城附近刚刚种下的春种就在这场腐蚀雨中全部完蛋！更不要说他还把城民引入地下城，想要把几十万城民都献祭给邪神！”

“那只是传言！是那些低贱的贫民在污蔑贵族！他们总是这样，满口谎言，下贱卑劣，不是小偷就是骗子，要么就是伎子和无赖。这些人的话你也能听？”王后也怒怼。

虎王胸膛剧烈起伏：“下贱？低劣？你就是这么看待自己的国民的？我知道你骄傲，但你的骄傲已经让你走向偏执。你以前不是这样的，你以前明明也注重国民，你更不会这么辱骂自己的国民，你……这些年，你都在想些什么？你为什么会变成这样？”

王后冷笑：“我不是说所有国民都那么卑劣，我只是说那些传我兄长坏话的低贱兽人。”

“传你兄长不好的兽人就是低贱兽人？”虎王怒极而笑：“那我在你眼中是不是也是低贱者之一？”

王后眼神高傲，不愿低头。

虎王怒急攻心，脱口而出：“你以为你们丹顿家族有多高贵吗？当年第一代丹顿族长就是个人口贩子！是个贼！是个最卑劣最低贱的罪犯！他靠手上的几百奴隶才混到第一代国王身边……”

王后的神色变得铁青。

虎王也知道自己说得太过。

骂人不揭短，打人不打脸，可他们都犯了夫妻吵架的最大忌讳。

“我知道你的谋算。”王后突然道。

虎王也平静下来，冷眼看着妻子。

王后：“结束对丹顿家族的软禁和监视，让我安排人手去寻找尤斯塔斯，在我找到尤斯塔斯之前不能宣判对尤斯塔斯的任何罪名，更不能剥夺他的爵位和城主之位。作为交换，黑森林城水军将归王城军部统辖。”

虎王沉默良久：“巴特愿意？”

“我会和巴特将军说清楚，他会理解的。”王后似胸有成竹。

虎王深深地看王后，他知道丹顿家族养着一支私军，只是不知道这支私军被藏在什么地方。

实际上只要是有点能力的贵族，就没有不养私军的。

但丹顿侯爵手上的那支私军规模更大，并且这么多年下来，丹顿家族已经和其他贵族连成了一张网。

虎王早就想彻底掌控黑森林城，更想把丹顿家族从兽人大陆抹消掉，但牵一发动全身，他必须拥有面对众多贵族一起反弹的实力才能去动这个手。

为此，他等了多年，也布局了多年。

现在他终于等到了一个良好机会，而他的王后也急了。

“我还可以再加一条。今后我不会再对你那个私生子出手，前提是他不要妄想染指他不该妄想的东西。”王后忍耐地又退了一步。

虎王：“……好。”

王后腾地起身，似乎再也无法忍耐一样，头也不回地离开花园。

虎王等王后离开后，静静地坐了一会儿，抬手。

一名身材精壮的年轻侍卫悄然出现在虎王身边。

“去查查看拉斐尔现在在哪里，正在做什么。”

“是。”那名侍卫收到命令后并没有立刻离开。

虎王微皱眉：“怎么？”

侍卫低声说：“城里来了一个异常俊美的天残。他有着非常特别的能力，据说他和贝休恩伯爵有一定血脉关系。现在他已经是大王子的座上宾。”

虎王手指交错，“贝休恩现在还赖在王城？”

“是。”

“他那片地也确实该收回了，就是有点远……”虎王思考片刻：“这件事我已经交给大王子处理。多余的事不用做。”

“是。”侍卫低头，又等了片刻，这才离开。

花园再次变得寂静。

虎王侧身，看着那名侍卫离去的背景，轻轻叹了口气。
