一夜间，关金娱乐场和邪神信徒有关，当晚大火很可能是祭祀邪神仪式的一部分之事就传遍了王城。

另外，几乎王城所有权贵和大小官员都知道王城来了一个持有空间储物工具、年轻英俊、打扮随意，把钱不当钱花，视美色如粪土，却身怀绝技的贵族少爷。

这位贵族少爷穿着两只不一样的皮靴，说话刺人，喜欢追寻刺激……

这么多的特征，阿瑞斯商又就那么大摇大摆地回到双灯旅馆，这可比其他藏头遮脸的宾客好找多了。

次日。

双灯旅馆就迎来了好些个不好得罪的特别客人。

有治安局的人，有贵族家的管家，还有不大不小的官员。

甚至还有几个一看家世就很不错的贵族少爷小姐，这几个年轻兽人的神情和其他来找阿瑞斯商的人的神情明显不同，显得更兴奋一些。

治安局长手下的第一得力干将乌九命抢到了先机，先拿到了阿瑞斯商的房间号。

旅馆管事迫于压力，不敢不给。

其他人不敢明面上得罪治安总局，只能眼睁睁地看着乌九命带着人先上了四楼。

“咚咚。”

乌九命让手下敲响贵宾套房的门。

大门立刻被打开，里面站着一位着装干练、神情严肃的中年女兽人。

“请安静。我们少爷还在休息，他不喜欢休息时被人打扰。”女兽人严厉地说。

乌九命上前，对女兽人点头行礼：“日安，我是治安总局一级警督乌九命，有些事需要询问你的主人。你的主人是叫阿瑞斯商，对么？”

女兽人表情不变：“我不管你们是什么人，有什么事请等我们少爷起身后再来。”

说完，女兽人就要关门。

乌九命用手撑住门扉，忍耐道：“我们有重要的事情需要询问你家少爷，事关几十条人命和邪神信徒。能不能请他现在起来？”

中年女兽人面无表情：“警督先生，给你一个忠告。我们少爷有严重的起床气，如果睡不够就叫醒他，不管你们想问什么，都别想从他嘴里问出来。”

“哦，是吗？”乌九命冷笑一声，很想推开女兽人就这么闯进去。

但想到来时局长对他的交代，还有阿瑞斯商昨晚的行为……严格来说，人家还真没触犯虎国法律。

虽然参与人命相关的赌博属于犯法，但他们没有证据——关金娱乐场收钱的管事死掉了，他手上的赌金也全部消失。能证明阿瑞斯商参与那场竞技赌博的工作人员也要么死掉、要么跑掉。

说阿瑞斯商杀人？那杀的也是异变者，不但不应该罚，还应该奖励人家。

所以乌九命也无法用太强硬的态度，尤其在还不知道对方身世底细的情况下。

“请帮忙通传看看，谢谢。”乌九命硬是挤出一个笑容。

中年女兽人定定地看了乌九命一会儿，冷淡地说：“请稍等。”

女兽人转身走向卧室。

乌九命站在门口看不太清楚中年女兽人的动静，只能竖起耳朵听里面的声音。

但套房内非常安静。

两名雄性兽人像保镖一样站在卧室门口。

中年女兽人耽搁了一会儿才出现，她的神情有点古怪。

乌九命皱眉：“怎么？你家少爷不愿起来？”

“不。”女兽人顿了顿，说道：“少爷不在卧室，我也不知道他去了哪里。”

乌九命不信。

就在乌九命打算大声喊那位少爷的名字，把他吵到无法睡下去时。

一名治安员快速跑上来，“警督！那位少爷在楼下。”

乌九命腾地转头：你说啥？

治安员脸色怪异：“就是那位阿瑞斯商少爷，他正在旅馆一楼餐厅用早餐。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 125: Famous Overnight (Part 2)

Overnight, the rumors spread throughout the Royal City: the Guanjin Entertainment Arena was tied to worshippers of evil gods, and the raging fire that night was likely part of an evil god sacrificial ritual.

Furthermore, almost all the powerful elites, nobles, and officials of various ranks in the Royal City learned that a young, handsome, casually dressed aristocratic young master had arrived in town. He possessed a spatial storage artifact, treated money like dirt, viewed feminine beauty with utter disdain, yet possessed formidable and astonishing skills.

This aristocratic young master wore two mismatched leather boots, spoke with a tongue as sharp as thorns, and loved seeking out thrills...

With so many distinct traits—coupled with the fact that Ares Shang had swaggered right back into the Twin Lamps Inn—he was infinitely easier to track down than those other masked and tight-lipped guests.

The next morning.

The Twin Lamps Inn welcomed several rather formidable and untouchable special guests.

There were personnel from the Public Security Bureau, stewards from noble households, and mid-to-high-ranking officials.

There were even a few young noble scions and ladies whose family backgrounds were apparent at a glance. The expressions of these young beastmen were markedly different from the others who had come looking for Ares Shang, carrying a distinct air of excitement.

Wu Jiuming, the top ace subordinate under the Chief of Public Security, seized the initiative and managed to secure Ares Shang's room number first.

Pressured by the circumstances, the inn manager dared not refuse.

The others didn't dare openly offend the Public Security Bureau, so they could only watch helplessly as Wu Jiuming led his men up to the fourth floor.

"Knock, knock."

Wu Jiuming motioned for his subordinate to rap on the door of the VIP suite.

The heavy door swung open immediately, revealing a stern, crisply dressed middle-aged female beastman standing inside.

"Please keep your voices down. Our young master is still resting, and he dislikes being disturbed while he sleeps," the female beastman said severely.

Wu Jiuming stepped forward and nodded in greeting to the female beastman. "Good day. I am Wu Jiuming, First-Class Inspector of the Public Security Bureau. I have some matters to discuss with your master. Your master is named Ares Shang, correct?"

The female beastman's expression remained unchanged. "I don't care who you are. Whatever business you have, please come back after our young master wakes up."

With that, she made to close the door.

Wu Jiuming wedged his hand against the doorframe, enduring his frustration as he said, "We have important matters that require your master's testimony—it concerns dozens of human lives and worshippers of evil gods. Could you please wake him up now?"

The middle-aged female beastman wore a completely blank expression. "Inspector, let me give you a piece of advice. Our young master has a severe case of morning crankiness. If you wake him up before he gets enough sleep, don't even dream of getting a single word out of his mouth, no matter what you want to ask."

"Oh, is that so?" Wu Jiuming sneered, very much tempted to shove the female beastman aside and force his way in.

Yet, recalling the instructions his superior had given him before setting out, as well as Ares Shang's behavior the previous night... strictly speaking, the fellow hadn't actually broken the laws of the Tiger Kingdom.

Although participating in life-and-death gambling was illegal, they lacked the evidence—the Guanjin manager who had collected the money was dead, and all the stakes he held had vanished. The staff members who could prove Ares Shang's participation in that arena gamble were either dead or had fled.

Accuse Ares Shang of murder? The ones he killed were mutated monstrosities; far from being punished, he deserved a reward.

Therefore, Wu Jiuming couldn't afford to adopt an overly aggressive attitude, especially when he still had no idea of the other party's true background and lineage.

"Please be so kind as to announce us. Thank you," Wu Jiuming forced out a smile.

The middle-aged female beastman stared fixedly at Wu Jiuming for a moment before replying coldly, "Please wait a moment."

She turned and walked toward the bedroom.

Standing at the doorway, Wu Jiuming couldn't see the middle-aged female beastman's movements clearly and could only prick up his ears to catch any sounds from within.

However, the suite was dead silent.

Two male beastmen stood guard by the bedroom door like statues.

The middle-aged female beastman took a while before reappearing, her expression rather peculiar.

Wu Jiuming frowned. "What is it? Your young master refuses to get up?"

"No." The female beastman paused before saying, "The young master is not in the bedroom. I have no idea where he went."

Wu Jiuming didn't believe it.

Just as Wu Jiuming was about to shout the young master's name at the top of his lungs to hound him until he couldn't possibly sleep anymore—

A police officer came sprinting up the stairs, breathless. "Inspector! That young master is downstairs."

Wu Jiuming snapped his head around: *What did you say?*

The officer's expression was utterly bizarre. "It's that young master Ares Shang. He's having breakfast in the inn's first-floor restaurant."

chunks.chineseText:
第126章 我是炼金师

乌九命赶到一楼餐厅时，就看到有几个仆人打扮的兽人拥簇着一名手捂鼻子的高大兽人？

哟，这不是娱乐区有名的不倒翁副区长鲁埃林吗？

没想到这位竟然亲自跑来双灯旅馆，还被……揍了？

啧，这脸丢的。

乌九命笑眯眯地对鲁埃林行了个礼：“日安，鲁埃林副区长，你不在你的辖区办公，怎么跑到这儿来了？难不成现在42街拉业务都需要你亲自出马了？”

附近几个仆人和乌九命的手下一起低头。这话真是太难听了，42街就是王城最有名的红灯区，说堂堂副区长亲自跑来拉业务，不就是在骂他拉皮条？

鲁埃林看到乌九命不想说话，捂着鼻子，脚步匆匆离去。

乌九命偏头，立刻有人过来跟他低声说了情况。

原来鲁埃林的仆人第一个发现就在餐厅吃早餐的阿瑞斯商，立刻告知鲁埃林。

鲁埃林就带人去找阿瑞斯商了。

这位也不知受了谁的命令，还是为谁站台来了，跟阿瑞斯商说话很不客气，官架子摆得很足，一副我跟你说话是给你面子，你最好按照我所说的，给某人公开道歉，去某店亮个相好好消费一番，否则就凭你这个外地人想要在王城做什么都不可能。

然后……这位副区长就被揍了。

那位贵族少爷真的是连半个字都懒得说，拿起桌上的餐盘就拍在了鲁埃林脸上，最后附赠了一个“滚”字。

鲁埃林当然不可能吃了这么大亏就算，他好歹也是副区长，不要面子的吗？

但是阿瑞斯商当场拔-出了骨剑。

鲁埃林也不敢赌这位看着就任性妄为的少爷不会在公共场合动手杀人，就算事后能整治他，但他鲁埃林的命也没啦。

能被称为不倒翁，娱乐区换了那么多位区长副区长，他鲁埃林还能坐在这个位子上，当然不仅仅因为他身后有靠山，更因为他有眼色，知道什么时候该硬，什么时候该软。

“这里是王城，我不知道是什么给了你底气让你如此嚣张。但相信我，你一定会后悔今日举动！”鲁埃林捂着鼻子坚持放出狠话，这才离开。

刚走到餐厅门口，就撞到了乌九命。

乌九命早就看这家伙不顺眼，见到他吃瘪，怎么可能不嘲讽几句？

其他人看到鲁埃林的惨状，也不敢随便上去找阿瑞斯商搭话。

这会儿看到乌九命过来，就有人想要看乌九命的好戏，也有人想看看那个外地来的少爷面对治安总局的一级警督是不是也敢这么不给面子。

乌九命一眼就看到了坐在餐厅靠窗座位的阿瑞斯商。

他大步走过去，拉开阿瑞斯商对面的椅子，不请自坐。

阿瑞斯商眼皮都没有撩一下，一脸厌世神情地把餐盘里的烤肉块一口口吃完。

“很难吃？”乌九命好奇。

阿瑞斯商慢慢咀嚼，咽下最后一口肉，“嗯。”

“难吃为什么还要吃完？”乌九命更好奇。这种家中豪横的富家少爷不应该是一顿早餐几十个菜肴，遇到不爱吃的直接就扔吗？

阿瑞斯商喝了口清水，“家训，不准浪费食物。”

乌九命了然。同时也进一步推测出这名年轻少爷不是出身于某个有着很多古板规矩的古老贵族，就是出身于家教严厉的大家族，总之身份不会低。

至于为什么家教严厉的大家族会冒出一个穿着打扮都很随意，行为举止也有点肆意的纨绔少爷，这太好理解了。

任何家族都会出现一个或几个叛逆子，家教越严越容易激出叛逆心。

而这些叛逆子行事虽然出格，但又奇妙地会遵守一些在很多人看来不必要的规矩，可能不是他们刻意想要遵守，而是那种规矩已经深刻入骨子里，就比如阿瑞斯商始终挺直的背脊和他面前干净整洁的桌面。

一个人的坐姿很松垮，他的背脊必然不会挺直。

但阿瑞斯商硬是做到了坐姿随意，却风骨坚韧之感。

从桌上的餐盘数量来看，阿瑞斯商吃得很多。而餐厅供应的早餐应该有不少他不喜欢吃的、或者他觉得不好吃的食物，但桌上的餐盘内却没有多少不应该有的残渣。

有些贵族现在穷讲究，喜欢吃任何东西都会留一点，认为光盘是穷鬼才有的行为。

但那些从大繁华纪延续下来，又从大战纪一路走过来的家族，对于浪费食物有着不可容忍的坚定态度。

就连虎王也明言规定任何人都不能随便浪费食物，王庭里面从虎王到王后到王子公主的餐点都有固定的供应数量，吃饱绝对没问题，但绝不可以浪费。

可很多贵族和富豪仍旧我行我素，无视兽人大陆食物匮乏的现状，吃起东西来挑三拣四，什么都要最好的，对普通人需要花费大量钱财购买的自然食材毫不珍惜。

乌九命单从不浪费食物这一点就对阿瑞斯商产生了一点好感。

“咳，我是乌九命，王城治安局一级警督。”

“有事？”阿瑞斯商拿餐巾擦了擦嘴，一副吃饱喝足准备离开的模样。

“有点事想要请教。对了，你的仆人似乎没看到你离开套房？”乌九命还是一脸好奇的神情。

阿瑞斯商懒懒地说：“从阳台走，更近。”

乌九命：行吧，直接从四楼阳台跳下来，确实要比坐升降机快多了。

“昨晚十点到十二点，你是不是人在城东郊外的白石庄园？”乌九命翻开小本本，拿出笔准备记录。

阿瑞斯商：“我不知道什么白石庄园，我也不知道我昨晚在哪里，那个关金娱乐场把我引入了地下排水渠，来到一个小湖泊，进入一个观赛场地，看了一场超级无聊的球赛。最后还搞出了虫毒感染者，我无聊，就下去把那些异变者都杀了。有问题？”

阿瑞斯商眉毛一挑。

乌九命没有回答，只问：“那么昨晚你看到看台上一些宾客和一些工作人员身上突然起火的情况吗？”

“嗯，看到了，他们大喊大叫，生怕别人不知道他们又在搞什么无聊的把戏。”

“无聊把戏？”乌九命抬头：“你认为他们身上着火是把戏？”

“难道不是？我以为那是关金娱乐场搞出的又一个节目。”阿瑞斯商背靠椅背：“就算不是，那也跟我无关。我昨晚杀爽了，就回来睡了。”

乌九命看阿瑞斯商一身睡衣拖鞋的打扮，也是服了他，这位少爷真是半点不在乎别人怎么看他。

“这家旅馆早上的洗澡水不够热。”阿瑞斯商还抱怨了一句。

乌九命：“……能请问你来自哪里？来王城有什么事吗？”

阿瑞斯商听到这个问题，似乎来了一丝丝兴趣，身体前探，慵懒的眼神也亮了一点点：“你刚才说你是警督？那你对王城一定很了解咯。”

乌九命不想破坏两人之间还算良好的说话气氛，就谦虚地说：“一般吧。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 126: I Am an Alchemist (Part 1)

When Wu Jiuming hurried down to the first-floor restaurant, he caught sight of several beastmen dressed as servants surrounding a tall beastman who was holding his bleeding nose.

Well, if it isn't Ruelin, the infamous "Tumbler" Deputy District Chief of the Entertainment District!

Never in his wildest dreams would he have expected this fellow to personally run all the way to the Twin Lamps Inn, only to end up... beaten?

Tch, talk about losing face completely.

Wu Jiuming stepped forward, smiling all over his face as he bowed to Ruelin. "Good day, Deputy District Chief Ruelin. Why aren't you tending to official business in your own jurisdiction instead of running all the way over here? Could it be that District 42's business has gotten so slack that even you have to pitch in personally?"

The nearby servants and Wu Jiuming's subordinates all lowered their heads. That was a truly vicious jab—District 42 was the most notorious red-light district in the Royal City, and implying that a dignified Deputy District Chief had personally run over to "solicit business" was basically calling him a common pimp.

Upon seeing Wu Jiuming, Ruelin had no desire to exchange pleasantries. Clutching his nose, he stomped away with hurried, angry strides.

Wu Jiuming tilted his head, and someone immediately stepped over to brief him in a low voice.

As it turned out, Ruelin's servant had been the first to spot Ares Shang eating breakfast in the restaurant and had immediately reported it to Ruelin.

Ruelin had marched over with an entourage.

Driven by who-knows-what orders or acting on someone else's behalf, he had spoken to Ares Shang with extreme arrogance, putting on a heavy bureaucratic airs as if to say: *Me deigning to speak to you is doing you a massive favor. You'd better apologize publicly to a certain person according to my instructions and show your face at a certain shop to spend a hefty sum, otherwise, don't even dream of accomplishing anything as an outsider in the Royal City.*

And then... the Deputy District Chief got beaten up.

That aristocratic young master hadn't even bothered to waste half a syllable; he simply grabbed the dining plate from the table and smashed it straight into Ruelin's face, capping it off with a single, cold word: "Scram."

Naturally, Ruelin couldn't swallow such a monumental humiliation and let it go—he was a Deputy District Chief, after all; didn't he have his pride?

However, Ares Shang had drawn his bone sword right on the spot.

Ruelin didn't dare gamble on whether this wildly reckless young master would actually commit murder in broad daylight. Even if they managed to punish the perpetrator afterward, Ruelin's own life would be forfeit.

Able to earn the moniker of "Tumbler"—surviving the endless churn of district chiefs and deputies in the Entertainment District—Ruelin owed his longevity not merely to having powerful backers behind him, but even more to his acute situational awareness, knowing precisely when to stand firm and when to bow low.

"This is the Royal City! I don't know what gave you the guts to be so arrogant, but trust me, you will regret today's actions!" Ruelin pressed a hand to his bleeding nose, stubbornly tossing out a parting threat before storming off.

Just as he reached the restaurant entrance, he collided head-on with Wu Jiuming.

Wu Jiuming had long since found this fellow an eyesore; seeing him suffer such a crushing defeat, how could he possibly resist throwing out a few mocking remarks?

The other onlookers, having witnessed Ruelin's miserable state, didn't dare approach Ares Shang to strike up a conversation casually.

Now, seeing Wu Jiuming arrive, some wanted to watch a good show at Wu Jiuming's expense, while others were eager to see whether that foreign young master dared to treat a First-Class Inspector of the Public Security Bureau with the exact same utter lack of respect.

Wu Jiuming spotted Ares Shang sitting at a window table in the restaurant at a single glance.

He strode over, pulled out the chair opposite Ares Shang, and seated himself uninvited.

Ares Shang didn't even lift an eyelid, finishing the roasted meat chunks on his plate piece by piece with an expression of world-weary apathy.

"Tastes that bad?" Wu Jiuming asked, his curiosity piqued.

Ares Shang chewed slowly, swallowing the final morsel of meat. "Mm."

"If it tastes bad, why finish it?" Wu Jiuming became even more curious. Shouldn't a pampered young master from a wealthy, overbearing household be served dozens of different dishes for breakfast, tossing away anything he didn't fancy without a second thought?

Ares Shang took a sip of spring water. "Family precept: wasting food is forbidden."

Wu Jiuming understood. At the same time, this further reinforced his deduction: this young master either hailed from some ancient clan shackled by rigid, archaic traditions, or came from a strict, high-ranking aristocratic family. In either case, his social standing was bound to be extraordinarily high.

As for why a strictly raised scion of a prominent family would turn out to be a prodigal young master who dressed with casual abandon and acted with unbridled eccentricity, it was easily understood.

Every single great family produced one or two rebellious youths; the stricter the household discipline, the easier it was to provoke a rebellious streak.

And while these rebellious youths behaved in ways that flouted convention, they would bizarrely and rigidly adhere to certain rules that many considered utterly unnecessary. Perhaps it wasn't even a conscious choice on their part, but rather because those rules had already been branded deep into their very bones—just like Ares Shang's spine, which remained ramrod straight, and the impeccably neat and tidy table before him.

A person with a sloppy sitting posture could never keep their spine straight.

Yet Ares Shang effortlessly managed to project an aura of casual relaxation coupled with an unyielding inner backbone.

Judging by the number of empty plates on the table, Ares Shang had eaten a substantial amount. Moreover, the breakfast provided by the restaurant likely included many dishes he disliked or considered unpalatable, yet there were practically no scraps or leftovers left strewn across the plates that shouldn't have been there.

Some nouveau-riche nobles liked to put on pretentious airs, deliberately leaving a bit of food behind on every plate to signal that finishing everything was something only "paupers" did.

However, families that had endured from the Great Prosperous Era and survived the Great Age of Wars maintained an unyielding, zero-tolerance attitude toward wasting food.

Even the Tiger King had explicitly decreed that no one was allowed to waste food arbitrarily. Within the royal court, from the Tiger King and Queen down to the princes and princesses, food rations were strictly supplied in fixed quantities—there was always enough to eat one's fill, but wasting a single morsel was strictly forbidden.

Yet many nobles and wealthy tycoons still went their own way, ignoring the reality of food scarcity across the Beastman Continent, acting picky and choosing the absolute finest of everything while showing zero appreciation for natural ingredients that cost ordinary citizens a fortune to acquire.

Wu Jiuming developed a sliver of favorable impression toward Ares Shang based solely on this single point of not wasting food.

"Ahem, I am Wu Jiuming, First-Class Inspector of the Public Security Bureau."

"Something the matter?" Ares Shang wiped his mouth with a napkin, looking entirely like someone who had eaten his fill and was preparing to take his leave.

"I have a few matters I'd like to consult you on. By the way, your servants didn't seem to see you leave your suite?" Wu Jiuming kept up his inquisitive, curious expression.

Ares Shang replied lazily, "I took the balcony. It's shorter."

Wu Jiuming: *Fine, whatever.* Jumping straight down from a fourth-floor balcony was indeed much faster than taking the lift.

"Between ten and twelve o'clock last night, were you present at the White Stone Manor in the eastern suburbs?" Wu Jiuming flipped open his notebook and readied his pen to record the answer.

Ares Shang replied, "I don't know any White Stone Manor, nor do I know where I was last night. That Guanjin Entertainment Arena lured me into an underground drainage tunnel, brought me to a small lake, and led me into a spectator arena where I watched a hyper-boring ball game. In the end, they even conjured up some parasite-infected freaks. I was bored, so I went down and slaughtered all those mutated things. Any problem?"

Ares Shang raised an eyebrow.

Wu Jiuming didn't answer immediately, instead asking: "Then did you witness the sudden ignition of certain guests and staff members in the spectator stands last night?"

"Mm, saw it. They were screaming at the top of their lungs, terrified that the world wouldn't notice whatever boring little stunt they were trying to pull."

"A boring stunt?" Wu Jiuming looked up. "You think them catching fire was just a stunt?"

"Isn't it? I assumed it was just another show put on by the Guanjin Entertainment Arena." Ares Shang leaned back against his chair. "Even if it wasn't, it has nothing to do with me. I had my fill of killing last night, so I came back and went to sleep."

Seeing Ares Shang dressed in pajamas and slippers, Wu Jiuming had to hand it to him; this young master genuinely didn't give a damn what anyone thought of him.

"The bathwater in this inn isn't hot enough in the morning," Ares Shang added as a casual complaint.

Wu Jiuming: "...May I ask where you hail from? And what brings you to the Royal City?"

Hearing this question, Ares Shang seemed to finally muster a shred of interest. He leaned his upper body forward, his languid eyes brightening just a fraction. "You mentioned earlier that you're an inspector? Then you must know the Royal City quite well, right?"

Not wanting to ruin the relatively pleasant conversational atmosphere they had established, Wu Jiuming modestly replied, "So-so."

chunks.chineseText:
阿瑞斯商脸上露出一点点笑容：“那就好。我正好想要找一个对王城情况比较了解的地头蛇帮我做推荐。你知道王城哪里有专门给炼金师使用的房屋出售或出租吗？”

乌九命听到前半句时有点哭笑不得，听到后半句，不禁一愣：“炼金师？”

阿瑞斯商：“嗯，我打算在你们王城待一段时间。路上花得太多，得赚一点盘缠，才好继续浪。”

乌九命迟疑地又问一遍：“你是炼金师？”

阿瑞斯商一脸理所当然：“当然。我看起来不像吗？”

乌九命：那可太不像了！

阿瑞斯商摊手：“在我们这种古板大家族中，家中子弟掌握一两个技艺很重要，尤其当你想要一定自由的时候。否则只有两个下场。”

乌九命下意识问：“哪两个下场？”

“要么成为婚姻市场上的筹码。要么就是成为家族某些计划和阴谋诡计的道具人。”

阿瑞斯商指了指自己：“你看我像是那种乖乖听家族摆布的人吗？所以我只能努力让自己更有价值，这样无论我怎样闹腾，他们对我的容忍度都会比对家族其他人高。”

乌九命：“……你现在是高级炼金学徒？”

阿瑞斯商没有回答这个问题，而是自顾自说道：“你们这里喜欢空间储物工具吗？我打算半个月后拍卖一个，由我亲手炼制。”

啥？乌九命呆滞了，他现在已经完全忘了他是来干什么的。

“你是炼金师，你会炼制空间储物工具？”

“是啊。”

“半个月后你打算公开拍卖一个？”

“对。”

“……空间多大？底价多少？”

“暂时不知道，我还没炼制出来，得看具体的炼制情况。至于底价，嗯，为了打响名声，就从一个金达盾开始叫价，你觉得如何？”

乌九命：我不觉得如何，我就想问我现在开始巴结你，你能底价卖一个给我吗？

啪！阿瑞斯商打了个响指：“警督先生，所以你有好的房子推荐给我吗？”

“有！绝对有！”乌九命斩钉截铁地说。没有他也要现找出来。

这可是一个结识能炼制空间储物工具的炼金大师的绝好机会！错过就可能再也不会有了。

也许阿瑞斯商在说谎，也许他根本不会炼金。

但那又有什么关系。

他只是帮忙寻找一栋适合炼金师使用的房屋而已，基本上不需要他付出任何代价。

可如果阿瑞斯商真的是一名“出人意料”的炼金大师，他这不就和炼金大师交上朋友了吗？

反正阿瑞斯商和昨晚的自-焚案怎么看都不像有关联的样子，来问话更多是摸底和掌握更多情况。只阿瑞斯商可能是一名炼金师这一个消息，就足以让他应付上司。

乌九命带着一干手下兴冲冲离开了。

其他来“拜访”阿瑞斯商的人面面相觑，不知道具体发生了什么事。

原本还期待乌九命和阿瑞斯商针对针干上的人，这会儿又是失望又是好奇。

乌九命到底跟那个少爷聊了什么，为什么一开始那么正经，后面就变得很是激动？

有人想要上去结交阿瑞斯商，比如那几个像是来找小伙伴的贵族少爷小姐。

但大家一抬头。咦？人呢？刚刚还坐在窗户边的阿瑞斯商怎么不见了？

阿瑞斯商没骗乌九命，他确实打算炼制空间储物工具，不说他早就想给不帅炼制一只空间戒指，还有虎王那条腰带，他也得想法交换过来。

如果成功率高，到时匀出一只拿出来拍卖，正好能补充一下他的资金。

虽然昨晚小赚了一笔，但谁会嫌自己钱多呢？

乌九命看起来嘴巴比较紧，但他们当时说话声音并没有刻意压低，兽人耳力不错的很多，相信要不了多久，他是一个能炼制空间储物工具的炼金师的消息就会传扬出去。

阿瑞斯商迈着二五八万老子天下第一的步伐，提着骨杖晃晃悠悠地走入大厅，踏上升降机。

他等着大鱼咬钩。
chunks.englishText:
A slight smile played across Ares Shang’s face. "That's good. I happen to be looking for a local boss who knows the royal city inside and out to give me some recommendations. Do you know where in the royal city I can buy or rent a property specifically equipped for an alchemist?"

When Wu Jiuming heard the first half of the sentence, he felt a mix of amusement and exasperation; upon hearing the second half, he froze. "An alchemist?"

Ares Shang: "Mm, I plan to stay in your royal city for a while. I spent way too much on the road, so I need to earn some traveling funds before I can continue roaming about."

Wu Jiuming hesitated and asked again, "You're an alchemist?"

Ares Shang looked as though it were the most natural thing in the world. "Of course. Do I not look like one?"

Wu Jiuming: *You look nothing like one!*

Ares Shang spread his hands. "In a rigid, traditional big family like mine, it's very important for the younger generation to master a craft or two—especially when you want a certain degree of freedom. Otherwise, there are only two outcomes."

Wu Jiuming asked instinctively, "Which two outcomes?"

"Either becoming a bargaining chip in the marriage market, or becoming a pawn for the family's schemes and conspiracies."

Ares Shang pointed at himself. "Do I look like the kind of person who would obediently let my family push me around? That's why I have to work hard to make myself more valuable. No matter how much trouble I stir up, their tolerance for me will be higher than for anyone else in the family."

Wu Jiuming: "...Are you a Senior Alchemist Apprentice right now?"

Ares Shang didn't answer the question, continuing on his own, "Do you guys like spatial storage tools around here? I'm planning to auction one off in half a month, crafted by my own hands."

*What?* Wu Jiuming was dazed; by now, he had completely forgotten what he had come here for.

"You're an alchemist, and you can craft spatial storage tools?"

"Yeah."

"And you're planning to publicly auction one in half a month?"

"Right."

"...How large is the space inside? What's the starting bid?"

"I don't know yet. I haven't crafted it yet; it depends on how the actual process goes. As for the starting bid... well, to make a name for myself, I'll just start the bidding at one gold D盾. What do you think?"

Wu Jiuming: *I don't think anything of it. I just want to ask if I start sucking up to you right now, can you sell me one at the starting bid?*

*Snap!* Ares Shang snapped his fingers. "Inspector, so do you have any good properties to recommend to me?"

"I do! Absolutely!" Wu Jiuming said decisively. Even if he didn't have one, he would conjure one up right now.

This was an absolute golden opportunity to befriend an alchemist master capable of crafting spatial storage tools! If he missed it, he might never get another chance.

Perhaps Ares Shang was lying, and perhaps he couldn't alchemy at all.

So what if he was?

He was only helping to find a property suitable for an alchemist; it basically cost him nothing.

Yet if Ares Shang truly turned out to be an "unexpectedly formidable" alchemist master, wouldn't he have forged a friendship with an alchemist master?

Anyway, Ares Shang looked nothing like someone connected to last night's self-immolation case; coming to question him was more about sounding him out and gathering intelligence. The mere news that Ares Shang might be an alchemist was enough for him to fob off his superiors.

Wu Jiuming departed in high spirits, taking his subordinates with him.

The other people who had come to "visit" Ares Shang exchanged bewildered glances, having no idea what had actually transpired.

Those who had originally expected Wu Jiuming and Ares Shang to lock horns were left feeling a mix of disappointment and intense curiosity.

What on earth had Wu Jiuming talked about with that young master? Why had he started out so stern, only to become so wildly excited later on?

Some people wanted to go up and cozy up to Ares Shang—such as those young noble lords and ladies who looked like they were just seeking playmates.

Yet when everyone looked up—*Huh?* Where did he go? Why had Ares Shang, who had been sitting by the window just a moment ago, vanished?

Ares Shang hadn't lied to Wu Jiuming; he genuinely intended to craft spatial storage tools. Setting aside the fact that he had long wanted to make a spatial ring for Bushu, there was also the Tiger King's belt—he had to figure out a way to trade for that.

If the success rate was high, setting aside one to put up for auction would be just the thing to supplement his funds.

Though he had made a tidy little profit last night, who would ever complain about having too much money?

Wu Jiuming seemed to have a tight grip on his tongue, but they hadn't deliberately lowered their voices when speaking. Many beastmen had quite sharp hearing, and he believed it wouldn't be long before the news that he was an alchemist capable of crafting spatial storage tools spread far and wide.

Ares Shang strolled out with a swaggering gait that said *I am the number one supreme being under heaven*, carrying his bone staff as he sauntered into the grand hall and stepped onto the elevator.

He was waiting for a big fish to take the bait.

chunks.chineseText:
第127章 机缘这回事

不帅在黑森林城待了四天。

除了第一天陪着虎王处理政事，后面三天几乎都是在图书馆中度过。

老人还算给面子，在虎王和不帅一起进入图书馆后，跟他见了个面，还跟他聊了聊。

但不帅微妙地感觉到老人和虎王说话时的态度比较高傲，甚至有些冷淡。不像和他们聊天时那样平易近人、那么鲜活。

不过虎王却感觉良好，可能在他印象中祭司宫的大祭司就是这种特质，而且老祖宗嘛，有点架子不是很正常？

进入图书馆的人除了虎王和不帅，还有两名大臣和两名近卫。

这四人应该说是虎王最信任的人了。

两位大臣分别是宰相艾萨克海斯，这位不是第一天就陪着虎王过来，而是直到第二天才赶过来，还是秘密出行。

不帅和这位真实说来有不少恩怨，但两人见面都像什么事没有发生一样，不帅跟从前一样见礼，艾萨克也正常回应。

另一位是军事大臣大都督狮域，她也是虎国唯二的两位大公之一，还是女大公，位高权重，绝对的保王党，极得虎王信重。她同样是秘密出行。

不帅和这位完全不熟，实际上这位女大公性格高傲，除了虎王，谁都不被她放在眼里。传说这位杀人不眨眼，满身血腥气，她丈夫看她回家会吓到脚软。

两名近卫分别是雷米尔和角马。

角马和不帅关系好，看到不帅特别高兴，一直想找机会跟他说话，但不帅故意躲着他，不想让其他人知道角马和他过于亲近。

虎王带到黑森林城的人很多，但能被他带入图书馆的只有这四人。

进入图书馆，看到那一排排高达房顶的书架，以及书架上的无数书籍，还看到千多年前的大祭司，四个人全都震惊到说不出话。

雷米尔那天听到不帅和虎王的对话，还算有点心理准备，但在看到实景后，他还是忍不住震撼。

这还只是一个大厅，按照不帅所说，这样的大厅还有十数个。

规模如此庞大的图书馆，得存留多少宝贵的知识和历史秘辛？

虎王还能保持脸上表情，但他的瞳孔明显缩小。

雷米尔更是激动到双手都有一点点颤抖。

连有心理准备的虎王和雷米尔都如此，更不要说不知情的其他三人。

宰相艾萨克激动到捂住心脏，脸部通红，他不断呢喃：这是虎国大兴之兆，是祖宗们保佑，是兽人重新崛起的象征！

大都督狮域不爱看书，但她对这座图书馆保存下来的军事文化和武器图纸等非常感兴趣，简直迫不及待想要去看个究竟。

老人表示这里的图书，他们可以随意看，只不能带走。

虎王强忍兴奋和激动，和老人详谈岩浆灾害的事。

宰相和大都督也把注意力转移到这件事关所有虎国人的重大事情上。

不帅无意旁听，更不想参与——老商已经严重警告过他，不允许他深度参与此事，表示小人物有小人物的事情要做，既然他不想当王，就没必要掺和大人物的事。

如果虎王或其他人嫑脸地让他应承什么事，就采取拖字诀，总之他不在，就不能随便答应任何涉及到国家层面的事情。

不帅无奈，感觉老商像是在把他当容易上当受骗的小朋友看，但他也得承认，他不算笨，也能知道那些人都在谋算什么，但还是会被话术套住，或者是被一些事情打动，进而产生一些责任感。

不帅不知道自己能不能坚定地拒绝老人和虎王等人，干脆就远离他们，借口他想转转图书馆。

老人摆手，表示不帅随意。

虎王也不知道脑补了什么，干脆让自己的两个近卫也自由在图书馆闲逛，还笑说：“时间不多，能看到什么、学到什么，就看你们的机缘了。”

雷米尔当即就去寻找自己感兴趣的大厅和内容。

角马似乎没有什么目的，看似闲逛，却暗中跟上了不帅。

不帅在心里叹了口气，停下脚步，转身。

“有事吗？”

“有，很重要的事！”角马加重语气：“你为什么回到王城？你明明知道你回来会有多危险，你为什么要回来？是因为莫约镇发生了疫病吗？你是回来复仇的吗？”

“……我以为你希望我回来。”

角马用力抿紧嘴唇，“那不一样。我们知道莫约镇发生疫病后，头就跟我们说，你的情况很危险。”

“那你特地跟我说话是想警告我？”不帅的声音很温和。

角马左右看看。

不帅静静地等着。

角马看着他，神色有点古怪：“你变了一些。”

“哦？”

“我感觉你好像变得更自信……不是，是更洒脱了一些，对，就是洒脱。”角马右拳击左手，“这样很好，你以前给我的感觉，明明是我们中年龄最小的，却像是背着最沉重的包袱，就好像一个装了很多故事很多过去的老人。”

不帅摸了摸脸：“原来我在心中那么老气？”

角马点头：“嗯，比我爷爷还老气。”

两人相视而笑，气氛顿时变得轻松许多。

角马说话变得随意：“你想获得爵位吗？”

“你不如直接问我想不想获得王位。”不帅笑。

角马斜睨他：“那你想吗？”

“不想！”不帅毫不犹豫地说。

“但没有几个人会相信。尤其陛下还是跟以前一样那么宠爱和注重你。”角马叹息。

不帅无奈：“那你们觉得我的机会大吗？”

角马想了想，竟然说：“你也不是完全没有机会。”

不帅：“……但我真的不想。”

“我相信你。”角马很认真地说。

“谢谢。”不帅也很认真地回复。

角马忽然压低声音：“这次过后你就立刻离开王城，离得越远越好。”

不帅诧异地看他，想问他是否知道了什么消息，又忍住。

角马却主动说：“当灾难发生前，蛇鼠虫的反应总是比兽人更快，它们一旦察觉不对，就会一窝蜂地逃离灾难即将发生的地方。自从半年前开始，王城的蛇鼠虫就在……减少。”

“减少？”不帅眉头微皱，角马用的这个词很有意思：“为什么是减少，不是离开？”

角马：“因为没人知道那些减少的蛇鼠虫都去了哪里。”

不帅陷入沉思。

角马说的蛇鼠虫只是比喻，指的是王城那些干着见不得光事情的三教九流。

而角马的父亲正是城卫军统领，负责王城安定，除了民事和刑事案件以及行政工作以外，其他像是救火、巡逻、维持稳定、看守城门和担任重要部门警卫都是他的职责范围内。

比起各区治安局，城卫军对王城蛇鼠虫的动静更为留意，跟底层人士打交道更多，也掌握着更多信息。

“你父亲……认为这和我国最上层某些人的活动有关？甚至涉及到陛下安危？”不帅谨慎地问。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 127: The Matter of Destined Encounters

Bushu had stayed in Black Forest City for four days.

Aside from the first day spent accompanying the Tiger King in handling state affairs, the following three days were spent almost entirely within the library.

The old man was somewhat accommodating; after the Tiger King and Bushu entered the library together, he met with Bushu and even chatted with him for a bit.

Yet, Bushu had a subtle feeling that the old man’s attitude toward the Tiger King was rather haughty, even somewhat cold. It wasn't nearly as approachable or lively as when he conversed with them.

The Tiger King, however, felt quite at ease. Perhaps in his impression, the Grand Priest of the Priest Palace naturally possessed such traits, and after all, this was an ancient ancestor—wasn't a bit of airs completely normal?

Aside from the Tiger King and Bushu, the people who entered the library included two ministers and two imperial guards.

These four could be said to be the Tiger King's most trusted confidants.

The two ministers were Prime Minister Isaac Hayes—who hadn't accompanied the Tiger King on the first day, but had rushed over by the second day on a covert trip—and...

Truth be told, Bushu had quite a bit of old baggage with this man, but when the two met, they acted as if nothing had happened. Bushu offered greetings just as before, and Isaac responded normally.

The other was the Minister of Military Affairs, Grand Marshal Lion Realm. She was also one of only two Grand Dukes in the entire Tiger Kingdom, as well as a female Grand Duke. Holding immense power and prestige, she was an absolute loyalist to the throne, deeply trusted and valued by the Tiger King. She had also traveled in secret.

Bushu was completely unfamiliar with her. In reality, this female Grand Duke possessed a haughty personality; apart from the Tiger King, she didn't deign to look at anyone else. Legend had it that she killed without batting an eye, reeking of blood, and that her husband's legs would turn to jelly in fright when he saw her coming home.

The two imperial guards were Remire and Wildebeest.

Wildebeest had a good relationship with Bushu and was thrilled to see him, constantly trying to find opportunities to speak with him. However, Bushu deliberately avoided him, not wanting others to know that Wildebeest was overly close to him.

The Tiger King had brought many people to Black Forest City, but the only ones he brought into the library were these four.

Stepping into the library and gazing at those rows of bookshelves towering all the way up to the ceiling, along with the countless books upon them and the Grand Priest from over a thousand years ago, all four were so shocked they were rendered speechless.

Remire had heard the conversation between Bushu and the Tiger King that day and had some psychological preparation, but upon seeing the real thing, he still couldn't help but be struck with awe.

And this was merely the main hall; according to Bushu, there were over a dozen halls just like this one.

A library of such a massive scale—just how many precious pieces of knowledge and historical secrets must it preserve?

The Tiger King managed to maintain his facial expression, but his pupils noticeably constricted.

Remire, meanwhile, was so excited that both of his hands trembled slightly.

If even the mentally prepared Tiger King and Remire were shaken to this extent, needless to say, the other three remained utterly clueless.

Prime Minister Isaac was so excited that he clutched his chest, his face flushing crimson as he continuously muttered: This was the omen of the Tiger Kingdom's great prosperity, the blessing of their ancestors, and the symbol of the beastmen's resurgence!

Grand Marshal Lion Realm wasn't fond of reading, but she was deeply interested in the military culture, weapon blueprints, and other materials preserved in this library; she could hardly wait to inspect them firsthand.

The old man stated that they could freely read any of the books here, with the sole condition that none could be taken away.

Suppressing his excitement and agitation, the Tiger King discussed the magma disaster in detail with the old man.

The Prime Minister and the Grand Marshal also shifted their attention to this critical matter concerning all beastmen of the Tiger Kingdom.

Bushu had no intention of eavesdropping, nor did he wish to participate—Old Shang had issued a stern warning forbidding him from getting deeply involved, telling him that small fries had small fries' things to do. Since he didn't want to be king, there was no need to meddle in the affairs of the big shots.

If the Tiger King or anyone else brazenly coerced him into promising something, he was to employ the stalling tactic. In short, as long as he wasn't there, he wouldn't casually agree to anything involving state-level matters.

Bushu felt helpless, feeling as though Old Shang treated him like an easily gullible child. Yet, he had to admit he wasn't stupid; he could tell what those people were plotting, but he still risked being trapped by their rhetoric or moved by certain circumstances, thereby generating a sense of responsibility.

Unsure whether he could firmly refuse the old man, the Tiger King, and the others, Bushu simply distanced himself, excusing himself on the grounds that he wanted to look around the library.

The old man waved a hand, indicating that Bushu could do as he pleased.

Imagining things on his own, the Tiger King simply let his two imperial guards wander freely around the library as well, laughing as he said, "Time is short; what you see and what you learn depends entirely on your destined encounters."

Remire immediately set off to find halls and content that interested him.

Wildebeest didn't seem to have any particular destination. Seemingly wandering aimlessly, he quietly tailed behind Bushu.

Bushu sighed inwardly, came to a halt, and turned around.

"Something the matter?"

"Yes, something very important!" Wildebeest emphasized his tone. "Why did you return to the royal city? You clearly knew how dangerous it would be if you came back—why did you return? Is it because an epidemic broke out in Moye Town? Did you come back for revenge?"

"...I thought you'd want me to come back."

Wildebeest pressed his lips tightly together. "That's different. When we learned an epidemic broke out in Moye Town, the Boss told us your situation was extremely dangerous."

"So you specifically came to talk to me to warn me?" Bushu's voice was very gentle.

Wildebeest looked left and right.

Bushu quietly waited.

Looking at him, Wildebeest wore a somewhat strange expression. "You've changed a bit."

"Oh?"

"I feel like you've become more confident... No, more carefree. Yeah, carefree." Wildebeest punched his left palm with his right fist. "That's good. In the past, whenever I looked at you, you clearly were the youngest among us, yet you acted like you were carrying the heaviest burdens, just like an old man loaded down with countless stories and pasts."

Bushu touched his face. "Was I really that old-fashioned in your heart?"

Wildebeest nodded. "Mm, older than my grandfather."

The two of them exchanged a smile, and the atmosphere instantly relaxed considerably.

Wildebeest's tone grew casual. "Do you want to secure a title of nobility?"

"You might as well just ask if I want to seize the throne," Bushu laughed.

Wildebeest sidelong-glanced at him. "Well, do you?"

"Not at all!" Bushu said without the slightest hesitation.

"But very few people will believe that. Especially since His Majesty still favors and dotes on you just as much as before," Wildebeest sighed.

Bushu was helpless. "Then do you guys think my chances are high?"

Wildebeest thought for a moment, and to his surprise, said, "You aren't entirely without a chance."

Bushu: "...But I really don't want to."

"I believe you," Wildebeest said very earnestly.

"Thank you," Bushu replied just as earnestly.

Suddenly lowering his voice, Wildebeest said, "After this business is over, leave the royal city immediately and go as far away as possible."

Bushu looked at him in surprise, wanting to ask if he had caught wind of some news, but he held back.

Wildebeest, however, took the initiative to speak. "When a disaster is about to strike, snakes, rats, and insects always react faster than beastmen. Once they sense something is amiss, they flee en masse from the place where the disaster is about to happen. For the past half year, the snakes, rats, and insects of the royal city have been... diminishing."

"Diminishing?" Bushu frowned slightly. The word Wildebeest used was very interesting. "Why diminishing, and not leaving?"

Wildebeest: "Because no king or official knows where those missing snakes, rats, and insects went."

Bushu fell into deep thought.

The snakes, rats, and insects Wildebeest spoke of were merely a metaphor, referring to the dregs of society who engaged in shady business in the royal city.

And Wildebeest's father happened to be the Commander of the City Guards, responsible for the stability of the royal city. Aside from civil and criminal cases as well as administrative work, other duties such as firefighting, patrolling, maintaining stability, guarding the city gates, and serving as guards for important departments fell strictly within his purview.

Compared to the security bureaus of various districts, the City Guards paid closer attention to the movements of the royal city's underworld, dealt more with the people at the bottom, and held far more intelligence.

"Your father... believes this is related to the activities of certain high-ranking figures in our nation? Does it even involve His Majesty's safety?" Bushu asked cautiously.

chunks.chineseText:
角马没有明确回答，只说：“还有一些人事上的变动。这些变动看着都很不起眼，全都是一些职位很低的小官员。但是……我父亲说王城做事的就是这些底层官员。”

“陛下知道这些吗？”

角马沉默点头。

不帅略微放心，他对虎王还是有感情的，虽然这位对于原身来说是一个超级不负责任的渣爹。但不帅在担任虎王近卫期间，也确实实打实地感受到虎王对他的好，他无法忽视这点。

角马看向不帅：“头也想让我告诉你，这时候不是你出现在王城的最好时机，除非你有别的想法。他，还有我，还有其他关心的人，都希望你远离王城，越远越好，直到一切尘埃落定。”

不帅看着角马的眼睛，知道他肯定还有一些事情没有说，不是他不想说，应该是不能说。

“我知道了。我也没打算在王城待多久，这次只是恰逢其会。等这边事了，我就会尽快离开王城。”不帅的优点之一，听劝。也可以说他耳根子软，无法拒绝别人的好意。

角马吐气，笑了：“伊克斯很想你，这一年多，他没事就去找杜德家兄弟的麻烦，杜德家那对兄弟都要恨死他了。对了，伊克斯就要结婚了，你知道他的结婚对象是谁吗？你一定想不到。”

不帅对伊克斯找谁结婚不感兴趣，但不想驳角马的面子，就顺着他的语气问：“是谁？”

角马像是在忍笑：“是多丽丝王妃……的妹妹妮娜。”

不帅震惊：“你在开玩笑！”

伊克斯可是伯爵的小儿子，而且是极为得宠的小儿子，将来获得爵位的可能性比他兄长还高，而且他还身为虎王近卫，就算他将来得不到其父爵位，其前程也肉眼可见的光明。

多丽丝王妃很有名，但她再怎么也只是一朵交际花。而现今的虎国阶层认知，完全杜绝了平民嫁给贵族的可能，就是富豪子女都不容易进入权贵之门，更不要说特殊职业者。

多丽丝的妹妹，从身份上天然就绝了嫁给伊克斯的可能性。

伊克斯哪怕再爱惨了她、非她不可，他的伯爵父亲也绝对不会让多丽丝的妹妹成为儿子的妻子。那会让墨文家族成为整个上流社会的笑柄！

“你如果知道谁是妮娜和伊克斯的牵线人，就不会这么惊讶了。”角马挤挤眼睛。

“谁？”

“是我们的二王子殿下。他在个人宴会中邀请了妮娜梅尔文，期间还盛赞了妮娜的美貌和天赋，称她是王城近十年最优秀的女郎，任何人都会以娶她为荣。”

“二王子不知道妮娜梅尔文是多丽丝的妹妹？”

“这我就不知道了。但在二王子殿下邀请妮娜以及盛赞她之前，王城没有人知道她是谁。之后妮娜梅尔文就变得特别有名，然后她是多丽丝亲妹妹的事就被传了出来，有人说是妒忌她的人故意在抹黑她。但我父亲告诉我，妮娜梅尔文就是多丽丝的妹妹。”

不帅看角马，他总觉得角马并不是在单纯跟他扯八卦，但他想进一步细问时，角马却转移话题，问他图书馆的事，还随手抽出书架上的书籍，假模假样地看起来。

不帅：角马明明是他们中间最讨厌看书学习的。

“谢谢，我会远离这滩浑水。”最终不帅只是拍了拍角马的肩膀，就去了另一个大厅。

角马从书本中抬起头，看着不帅的背影，抿了抿嘴唇。

拉斐尔是个好人，如果不是他的身份，很多人都愿意成为他的朋友和好兄弟，但就因为他虎王私生子的身份，让绝大多数喜欢他、想要和他结交的人不得不把他当个隐形人看待。

兄弟，我帮不了你多少，只希望你能好好的，远离一切麻烦。

不帅心中有点愁闷，随手从身边书架上抽了一本书。

一看侧封，很好，是他认识的通用字。

不帅翻开书本，就见书籍第一页第一句话就写着“我们的世界是一个拥有魔力的世界……”

不帅沉默两秒，合上书页再看书名：《魔力消失的秘密》

在图书馆待了三天后，虎王宣布回归王城。

不帅不知道虎王和那位老祖宗具体谈了什么，但看虎王的神态似乎并不太紧张。

老人也没有全程陪同，只一开始出来亮了个相，和虎王聊完后就消失了。

直到他们走的时候。

虎王呼唤老人，想要跟老人再索要一张借阅卡。

老人出现，却说借阅卡只有一张。

不帅听到后，立刻就把自己手中那张借阅卡呈给虎王。

老人听到动静，无所谓地说：“谁手持那张借阅卡都能进来。”

虎王见不帅坚持，也没有推拒，收下了那张借阅卡。

宰相艾萨克看不帅的目光顿时和缓不少。

大都督狮域看不帅的神情却很微妙。

雷米尔目光低垂，角马把自己当隐形人。

等所有人都离开图书馆，老人发出嗤笑声。

借阅卡不认人，谁手持借阅卡都能打开图书馆大门没错，但有缘车可不是谁都能遇到。

当真以为这座深藏在地下千年之久的图书馆是谁都能发现、谁都能进来的吗？

机缘，它看似看不见摸不着，但又真真切切地存在啊。
chunks.englishText:
Wildebeest didn't answer directly, only saying, "There have also been some personnel changes. All of these changes look utterly inconspicuous, involving nothing more than low-ranking petty officials. However... my father says it's these low-level officials who actually run things in the royal city."

"Does His Majesty know about this?"

Wildebeest nodded silently.

Bushu felt slightly relieved. He still had genuine affection for the Tiger King, even though this man was a super irresponsible deadbeat dad to the original owner. Yet during his time serving as the Tiger King's imperial guard, Bushu had indeed genuinely felt the Tiger King's kindness toward him; he couldn't simply ignore that.

Wildebeest looked at Bushu. "The Boss also wanted me to tell you that this is not the best time for you to appear in the royal city, unless you have other plans. He, along with me and others who care about you, all hope you will stay far away from the royal city—as far as possible—until the dust settles."

Looking into Wildebeest's eyes, Bushu knew there must be some things he hadn't told him. It wasn't that he didn't want to, but rather that he couldn't.

"I understand. I didn't plan on staying in the royal city for long anyway; this time was just a coincidence. Once matters here are settled, I'll leave the royal city as soon as possible." One of Bushu's virtues was that he listened to advice. Or perhaps it could be said he was soft-hearted and unable to reject the goodwill of others.

Wildebeest exhaled and smiled. "Ikes misses you a lot. Over the past year or so, he's gone out of his way to make trouble for the Dodd brothers whenever he has nothing to do, and those two brothers probably hate his guts. Oh, right, Ikes is getting married. Do you know who his bride-to-be is? You'll never guess."

Bushu had zero interest in who Ikes was marrying, but not wanting to hurt Wildebeest's feelings, he went along with his tone and asked, "Who is it?"

Wildebeest looked as though he were fighting back laughter. "It's Princess Doris's... younger sister, Nina."

Bushu was shocked. "You've got to be kidding!"

Ikes was a count's youngest son, and a heavily favored one at that; the probability of him inheriting a title in the future was even higher than his brother's. Furthermore, he was an imperial guard of the Tiger King. Even if he failed to inherit his father's title, his future prospects were visibly radiant.

Consort Doris was quite famous, but no matter what, she was merely a socialite. The current class awareness in the Tiger Kingdom completely precluded the possibility of a commoner marrying into nobility; even the children of wealthy tycoons had a hard time crossing the threshold of the power elite, let alone those belonging to special professions.

By identity alone, Doris's younger sister was naturally barred from any possibility of marrying Ikes.

No matter how deeply Ikes loved her or how adamant he was about having no one else, his count father would absolutely never let Doris's sister become his son's wife. That would turn the Mervyn family into the laughingstock of the entire high society!

"If you knew who played matchmaker for Nina and Ikes, you wouldn't be so surprised," Wildebeest winked.

"Who?"

"His Highness the Second Prince. At a private banquet, he invited Nina Mervyn, and during the gathering, he lavished praise on Nina's beauty and talent, calling her the most outstanding young lady in the royal city over the past decade, and stating that anyone would consider marrying her an honor."

"The Second Prince didn't know Nina Mervyn was Doris's sister?"

"That I don't know. But before His Highness the Second Prince invited Nina and praised her, no one in the royal city knew who she was. Afterward, Nina Mervyn became exceptionally famous, and then the news that she was Doris's biological sister leaked out. Some people claimed it was malicious smearing by those jealous of her. But my father told me that Nina Mervyn really is Doris's sister."

Bushu looked at Wildebeest, sensing that he wasn't merely gossiping with him. When he tried to probe further, however, Wildebeest changed the subject, asking him about the library and casually pulling a book off the shelf, pretending to read it with a serious expression.

*Bushu:* Wildebeest was clearly the one who hated reading and studying the most among all of them.

"Thanks. I'll stay away from this muddy water." In the end, Bushu merely patted Wildebeest's shoulder and walked off to another hall.

Lifting his head from the book, Wildebeest watched Bushu's retreating figure and pressed his lips together.

Raphael was a good person. If not for his identity, many people would have been more than willing to be his friends and sworn brothers. Yet precisely because of his status as the Tiger King's illegitimate son, the vast majority of people who liked him and wanted to befriend him were forced to treat him as if he were invisible.

*Brother, I can't help you much. I just hope you can stay safe and steer clear of all trouble.*

A faint gloom lingered in Bushu's heart. He casually pulled a book from a nearby shelf.

Glancing at the spine, very well—it was written in the common script he recognized.

Bushu opened the book, and the very first sentence on the first page read: *"Our world is a world possessing magical power..."*

Bushu fell silent for two seconds, shut the cover, and checked the title once more: 《The Secret Behind the Disappearance of Magic》.

After spending three days in the library, the Tiger King announced his return to the royal city.

Bushu had no idea what specific conversation had taken place between the Tiger King and that ancient ancestor, but judging by the Tiger King's demeanor, he didn't seem particularly tense.

The old man hadn't accompanied them the entire time either, only appearing at the very beginning to make an appearance, and vanishing after finishing his conversation with the Tiger King.

Until the moment they left.

The Tiger King called out to the old man, wishing to request another reading pass from him.

The old man materialized, stating casually that there was only one reading pass.

Upon hearing this, Bushu immediately presented the reading pass he was holding to the Tiger King.

Hearing the commotion, the old man remarked indifferently, "Anyone holding that reading pass can enter."

Seeing that Bushu insisted, the Tiger King didn't decline and accepted the reading pass.

Prime Minister Isaac's gaze toward Bushu instantly softened quite a bit.

Grand Marshal Lion Realm's expression as she looked at Bushu, however, was rather subtle.

Remire kept his eyes lowered, while Wildebeest treated himself like an invisible man.

Once everyone had departed the library, the old man let out a cold chuckle.

The reading pass didn't recognize individuals; anyone holding it could indeed open the library doors—true enough. But a destined encounter wasn't something just anyone could stumble upon.

Did they genuinely think this library, buried underground for a thousand years, was a place just anyone could discover and enter?

Destined encounters—they might seem intangible and invisible, but they existed just as truly as anything else.

第128章 回到王城

不帅回到王城就去了特别调查局。

十六名士兵正在接受特别调查员的入职训练，他们的表现很好，首先体能全部过关，对于邪神信徒和虫毒感染者也没有恐惧心理，并有一定的侦查能力，协同性也很高。

训练官对这十六名新人的评价很高，认为要不了多久就能实际展开调查员工作。

不帅顺便收集了一下王城最新消息，结果听到满耳朵的“阿瑞斯商”这个名字。

传言这名叫做阿瑞斯商的年轻兽人是个气质独特英俊多金玩世不恭的大家族少爷，来到虎国只为游历，他行事放荡不羁，爱玩爱美色，却又对美色视若粪土。

另外他的外表看似华而不实，实际却特别能打。且做事特别随心所欲，翻脸就能杀人。

更有传言说这位少爷花钱大手大脚，不仅因为他出身国外某个大贵族世家，更因为他本身是一名炼金师，且是能炼制出空间储物工具那种顶级炼金师！

对于后者，相信的人不多，更多人以为这位纨绔少爷在吹嘘，就等着过几天看他的笑话。

因为这少纨绔少爷说过几天会在王城进行一场拍卖会，就拍卖他亲手炼制的空间储物工具。

因为这个传言，想要结交这位纨绔少爷的人更多，但又诡异地保持了一个平衡，很多人明知道他现在住在哪里，却也没有特意去骚扰。

绝大多数人都只是送去了一份问候帖或宴会小聚的邀请函，浅浅表示了一下他们的礼貌和重视。

大家都在等待，等待这名纨绔少爷是否真的能像他所说的，在十天半月后拿出空间储物工具进行拍卖。

不帅看着手里的资料有些迟疑。

他在想要不要上门去找这位阿瑞斯商。

毫无疑问，这个阿瑞斯商百分百就是商非凡。

不帅是真没想到，商非凡竟然能在他离开王城的短短四五天内就塑造出一个如此让人印象深刻的纨绔少爷身份，还能闯出偌大名声。

不愧是……嗯，职业者。

如此高调，老商莫非有什么计划？

不帅迟疑的就是商非凡没和他商量过要创造这个身份，他担心自己找上门去会给对方的身份扮演带来不必要的麻烦。

半夜，不帅睡得极为警觉。

他忽然感到屋内多了什么。

随后他的双脚部位鼓起一块，有什么东西钻进了他的被子里。

那东西毛茸茸暖呼呼，顺着他的脚背一路往上爬。

从他的双腿钻到他的腹部，又从腹部爬到胸口。

噗！被子被顶开，冒出一颗毛茸茸的小脑袋。

“昂~”商小虎贴着不帅的下巴就死命拱。

嗷嗷嗷，想死我了，快，快让我香香~

光是拱还不够，还张嘴咬来咬去，咬得不帅脖颈和下巴全是红印子。

“你够了。”不帅小声喝，伸手按住搞怪的小混球。

小老虎在他手心里打滚，贴着他的脖颈，张嘴咬住他的下巴，舔了两下，突然就不动了。

不帅听着耳边响起的小呼噜声：“……”

这是有多累？

不过累到这种程度还偷偷跑来找他。

不帅从自己的脸上抱起小老虎，放到自己臂弯里，侧过身，抱住小老虎，脸上带着无奈又宠溺的笑闭眼睡了。

早上，不帅被踩奶踩醒了。

没等不帅铁拳制裁，某只不老实的小老虎在他耳边留下一句话，就哧溜蹿没影。

不帅这次立下大功的事，该知道的人都知道了。

大王子特意派人来邀请不帅小聚，不帅婉拒。

没想到，转眼三王子竟然也送了请帖过来，这就很让不帅吃惊了。

可以说三位王子中看不帅最不顺眼的就是三王子，他也给不帅找过大大小小很多麻烦。

只不过不帅是个不惹事又能忍的性子，大多数情况都只当对方是只满屋乱窜的蟑螂，并不怎么把对方的挑衅放在眼里。

三王子也不敢做得太过，他的继承权只排在第三位，在他前面还有老大和老二，拉斐尔又在虎王跟前做事，他如果做得太过分，那距离王位就更遥远了。

不帅自然也婉拒了三王子的邀请，表示自己正在忙着调查邪神信徒的事，现在不适合和任何人见面聚会。

三王子看到不帅回信，就跑去找他的母后。

过去时就看到自己的两个妹妹也在。

在兽人世界，很多种族的雌雄武力差别都不算太大，为此雌性地位并不比雄性低，虎国王庭王子公主的继承权就是一样的，只按照出生时间往后顺延。甚至不少国家和部落，雌性兽人的继承权还排在雄性兽人前面。

所以虎王的两位公主对自己的三个哥哥并不巴结，也毫不忌惮他们，他们兄妹五个就是势均力敌的对手。

大公主武力相当强，她也是五兄妹中唯一一个能变身巨兽的存在，连王后对她都多一分亲昵和看重。

小公主为此很是吃味，和姐姐关系并不好。

但小公主同样不喜欢三王子，她总觉得三王子仗着是最小的王子，老是来抢夺虎王和王后的注意力，明明她才是最小最该受宠爱的那一个。

“之前我就怀疑父王把他从近卫营调去了特别调查局，你们还不信。现在你们都信了吧？父王就是喜欢那个贱人生的小杂种！”已经三十多岁的小公主嘟囔道。

三王子特别受不了小公主这副撒娇扮痴的模样，也不看看自己的年龄，还当自己才三岁呢？

三王子翻了个白眼，正好被小公主看到。

小公主当即就怼他：“你又闯出什么纰漏，想要让母后给你擦屁股？”

三王子讥讽：“你以为我是你，看到长得好的雄性兽人就走不动路。听说你跑去找王城新来的那个不知来历的纨绔少爷，却被人直接赶出门？幸亏你还知道隐藏身份，如果让人知道堂堂公主竟然因为一个雄性兽人看不上多丽丝，就兴冲冲跑去找他，还想把他招为入幕之宾，结果同样被人看不上，还不知道会被多少人嘲笑。”

小公主气得冲过来就打。

大公主面无表情地看着这一幕，转头对王后说：“就这两个东西，您还指望他们在王位竞争中有所表现？”

王后笑起来，温和地说：“别这么说你三哥和小妹。兄弟姐妹打打闹闹很正常。能不能竞争到王位不重要，重要的是在这个过程中，你们能有所成长。”

大公主看着打成一团的三王子和小公主，眼中满是不耐：“母后，说句您不爱听的话，有时候我更希望拉斐尔是我弟弟，而不是他们。拉斐尔性子好，办事能力也强，如果他能留在王城，会是我和大哥的好帮手，而不像某些人只会拖后腿。”

王后一听到拉斐尔这个名字就不舒服，“这不更说明他很会装，拉斐尔恐怕比他那个母亲还要狡猾。如果你真的信任他，将来连死都不知道怎么死的。”

大公主没回应，低头看自己的手指。

Chapter 128: Returning to the Royal City

The moment Bu Shuai returned to the Royal City, he headed straight for the Special Investigation Bureau.

Sixteen soldiers were currently undergoing the Special Investigation Bureau's recruit training. They were performing exceptionally well; first of all, their physical endurance all passed the standards, they showed no fear toward followers of evil gods or those infected by insect venom, possessed a decent level of investigative capability, and exhibited a high degree of coordination.

The training officer gave these sixteen newcomers high marks, believing it wouldn't be long before they could actually deploy as investigative officers.

Along the way, Bu Shuai gathered some of the latest news around the Royal City, only to find his ears filled with a single name: "Ares Shang."

Rumor had it that this young beastman named Ares Shang was an extraordinarily unique, handsome, wealthy, and devil-may-care young master from a great prestigious family who had only come to the Tiger Kingdom to travel. His demeanor was unrestrained and untamed; he loved play and appreciated beauty, yet treated treasures and peerless beauties like dirt.

Furthermore, despite his flashy and seemingly superficial exterior, he was actually exceptionally formidable in a fight. He acted entirely on whim, capable of turning on someone and executing them in a heartbeat.

Even wilder rumors claimed that this young master threw money around with reckless abandon, not just because he originated from some foreign superpower family, but because he himself was an alchemist—and a top-tier alchemist at that, capable of refining spatial storage tools!

As for the latter claim, not many people believed it. Most assumed this pampered young master was simply boasting, just waiting a few days to make a laughingstock out of him.

Because this pampered young master had announced that in a few days, he would hold an auction right here in the Royal City, auctioning off the spatial storage tools he had crafted with his own hands.

Because of this rumor, even more people wanted to befriend this arrogant young master, yet they maintained a bizarre equilibrium. Even though many knew precisely where he was currently staying, none of them deliberately went to harass him.

The vast majority merely dispatched a greeting card or an invitation to an intimate banquet, lightly expressing their politeness and high regard.

Everyone was waiting—waiting to see whether this arrogant young master could truly deliver on his words and produce spatial storage tools for auction in ten days to half a month.

Bu Shuai looked at the dossier in his hand with some hesitation.

He was wondering whether he should pay a visit to this Ares Shang.

Without a doubt, this Ares Shang was one hundred percent Shang Feifan.

Bu Shuai truly hadn't expected that within a mere four or five days of leaving the Royal City, Shang Feifan could carve out such an intensely impressive, pampered young master persona and drum up such a massive reputation.

He truly lived up to... well, being a professional gamer.

With such a high profile, could Lao Shang have some sort of grand plan up his sleeve?

What made Bu Shuai hesitate was that Shang Feifan had never discussed creating this persona with him. He was worried that showing up unannounced might bring unnecessary trouble to the other man's roleplaying disguise.

In the dead of night, Bu Shuai slept with extreme vigilance.

Suddenly, he sensed something extra in the room.

Then, a bulge formed near his feet as something burrowed under his quilt.

The creature was furry and warm, climbing all the way up along the instep of his foot.

It scrambled from his legs up to his abdomen, and then from his abdomen up to his chest.

*Puff!* The quilt was pushed aside, and a small, furry head poked out.

"Ang~" Little Tiger pressed against Bu Shuai’s chin, rubbing and shoving against it desperately.

*Ao-ao-ao, I missed you to death! Quick, let me get my sniffs in—*

Rubbing wasn't enough; it even opened its mouth to nip and nibble, leaving Bu Shuai’s neck and chin covered in reddish marks.

"That's enough out of you," Bu Shuai whispered softly, reaching out to pin down the mischievous little squirt.

The little tiger rolled around in his palm, pressed against his neck, bit his chin, licked it twice, and then suddenly froze.

Listening to the soft purring sound rumbling by his ear, Bu Shuai: "..."

Just how exhausted was this little guy?

Yet, tired to this extent, it still sneaked over to find him.

Bu Shuai scooped the little tiger up from his face, cradled it in the crook of his arm, turned onto his side, and held the little creature close. A helpless yet doting smile touched his lips as he closed his eyes and drifted back to sleep.

In the morning, Bu Shuai was woken up by a pair of paws kneading his chest like dough.

Before Bu Shuai could dole out an iron-fisted punishment, that unruly little tiger dropped a cryptic sentence right by his ear before *swooshing* away without a trace, vanishing in an instant.

Word of the massive merit Bu Shuai had just established naturally reached everyone who needed to know.

The First Prince specifically sent someone to invite Bu Shuai to an intimate gathering, but Bu Shuai politely declined.

To his surprise, in the blink of an eye, the Third Prince also sent over an invitation card. This left Bu Shuai quite astonished.

It could be said that among the three princes, the one who found Bu Shuai the most glaringly offensive was the Third Prince, who had previously caused him all manner of big and small troubles.

It was just that Bu Shuai had a temperament that avoided stirring up trouble while retaining high forbearance; in most cases, he simply treated the other party like a scurrying cockroach darting across the room, paying very little mind to their provocations.

Furthermore, the Third Prince didn't dare push things too far. His succession rights ranked only third, with the First and Second Princes ahead of him, and Raphael working directly by the Tiger King's side. If he crossed any lines, the throne would only drift further out of his grasp.

Naturally, Bu Shuai also declined the Third Prince’s invitation, stating that he was currently swamped with investigating matters regarding the evil god's cult and was in no position to meet or socialize with anyone.

Upon receiving Bu Shuai’s rejection letter, the Third Prince rushed off to find his mother, the Queen.

When he arrived, he saw his two younger sisters already there.

In the beastman world, the martial prowess between males and females of many races did not differ drastically. Consequently, the status of females was no lower than that of males; the succession rights for the princes and princesses of the Tiger Kingdom's royal court were completely equal, proceeding purely in order of birth time. In fact, in quite a few nations and tribes, female beastmen held higher succession priority than males.

Therefore, the Tiger King’s two princesses neither fawned upon their three older brothers nor held any awe of them. The five siblings were simply evenly matched rivals.

The First Princess possessed formidable martial might. She was also the only one among the five siblings capable of transforming into a gigantic beast, earning her an extra layer of affection and high regard even from the Queen.

The Young Princess felt deeply jealous on this account and did not get along well with her elder sister.

However, the Young Princess liked the Third Prince just as little. She always felt that the Third Prince leaned on his status as the youngest prince to constantly steal the Tiger King and Queen's attention—clearly, *she* was the youngest and the one who deserved to be spoiled the most!

"I already suspected back then that Royal Father had transferred him from the Imperial Guard to the Special Investigation Bureau, but you guys wouldn't believe me. Do you believe it now? Royal Father simply favors that cheap harlot's bastard spawn!" grumbled the princess, who was already past thirty years old.

The Third Prince found the Young Princess’s coquettish, spoiled act utterly unbearable. Had she forgotten her age? Did she still think she was three years old?

The Third Prince rolled his eyes, a gesture immediately caught by the Young Princess.

She snapped right back at him: "What kind of mess did you bumble into this time, running to Mother to wipe your backside?"

The Third Prince sneered, "You think I'm like you, losing all mobility the moment you lay eyes on a handsome male beastman? I heard you ran off to chase after that mysterious, arrogant young master newly arrived in the Royal City, only to be chased straight out his door? It's a fortunate thing you still knew how to hide your identity. If people found out that a dignified princess actually rushed over excitedly to proposition him because some male beastman dared look down on Doris, only to be rejected just as thoroughly, god only knows how many people would die laughing at you."

Furious, the Young Princess lunged forward to strike him.

The First Princess watched this scene with a completely expressionless face, then turned to the Queen and said, "With just these two pieces of trash, do you still expect them to make any waves in the succession race?"

The Queen chuckled and said gently, "Don't talk about your third brother and little sister like that. Bickering among siblings is completely normal. Whether they win the throne isn't what matters; the important thing is that through this process, the two of them can grow."

Watching the Third Prince and the Young Princess brawl into a tangled mess, the First Princess's eyes were filled with utter impatience and mockery: "Mother, if I may say something you won't like to hear—sometimes I wish Raphael were my younger brother instead of them. Raphael has a good temperament and formidable execution capabilities. If he could remain in the Royal City, he would be an exceptional assistant for me and Big Brother, rather than acting like certain people who only know how to drag us down."

The mere mention of Raphael's name twisted the Queen's expression in disgust. "Doesn't that just prove even more how adept he is at putting on a front? Raphael is likely even craftier than that mother of his. If you truly trust him, one day you'll die and won't even know how it happened."

The First Princess offered no response, lowering her gaze to study her own fingernails.

chunks.chineseText:
王后看向三王子和小公主，心中也是一阵气闷。不过她从来指望的就不是这两个，他们表现再差，也不会真的让她生气，但她希望这两人做到的事，他们一件都没做到，这才真正让她心烦意燥。

大公主看向还在互相指着对方大骂的三王子和小公主，眼中闪过一丝悲哀和嘲讽。

从小，母后就在他们心中深植“丹顿家族是他们靠山，是他们的血脉亲人”，“虎王是他们的父亲之前先是这个国家的王，母后和舅舅才最为他们着想”的认知。

搞得五兄妹对虎王都是敬畏有余亲近不足。

等到拉斐尔出现，他们母后又在他们耳边反复说“拉斐尔是你们的敌人”，“拉斐尔会害死你们”，“拉斐尔会夺取虎王的所有关注和喜爱”，“拉斐尔就是个会装会演的低贱私生子，他就不该出现”……

大王子和二王子那时都不再是小孩子，对于母后说的话，也就是随便听听，并没有怎么放入心里。

但三王子和小公主却十分听母后的话，也最是讨厌和痛恨拉斐尔。

至于她，她比三王子小一点，但她心性要比三王子和小公主都成熟得多，且因为她从小就展现了能变身巨兽的天赋，很小就跟随大都督狮域学习，受到王后的影响也少了很多。

这让她在面对拉斐尔郎沐时，评价可以更为客观。

大王子和她想法差不多，二王子则是对拉斐尔无视。

大公主真心觉得拉斐尔那样的性子不会是他们的敌人，但她的母后却一心要给自己的儿子女儿创造出一个强敌出来。

大公主有时会想，如果她是拉斐尔，性子再好，被这样三番五次的谋害和逼迫，不想反也会反了。

大公主想过拉拢拉斐尔，但有她母亲在，不管她表现得多善意，恐怕拉斐尔都不会相信她，就像拉斐尔对大王子的态度，所以大公主也就死了这份心。她会注意拉斐尔，但不会故意去为难他。

话说回来，大公主为三王子和小公主感到悲哀，不是因为他们不会自我判断，而是被自己的母亲当做工具。

母后一直都希望三王子和小公主能够动手直接杀了拉斐尔。

虽然这样做势必会惹怒虎王，但废掉一个三王子和一个小公主，对于他们的母亲来说完全不痛不痒。甚至他们的母亲还会想着她能力保他们的性命，顶多就是失去继承权而已。

大公主心里非常清楚他们母后最爱的孩子是谁。

他们的母后希望他们兄弟姐妹都能成为她最喜欢的那个孩子的垫脚石。

“够了！”王后头疼地喝止了三王子和小公主的对骂。

“你为什么会突然邀请拉斐尔郎沐？”王后皱眉质问三王子。

三王子有点激动，导致他语言有点混乱：“拉斐尔去过黑森林城，这次还带父王一起过去了。他很可能知道舅舅的下落，我找他就是想要探探他的口风。这次去黑森林城，父王宁可带着他，都没有带上我们兄妹任何一个。

他还找到了一座千年前的图书馆，据说那座图书馆收藏了兽人大陆数万年的文明传承，这事传出去，得是多大的功劳？整座兽人大陆都得为这件事疯狂！”

三王子更加激动了：“据说父王打算面向全兽人大陆筹备一个兽人万年传承文明分享大会，发现图书馆的事他都没有刻意隐瞒，显然是想借此召集全大陆的兽人领袖，和他们谈条件。我想负责操办这件事，但父王理都没理我，他是不是想要把这件事交给拉斐尔？”

CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第128章 回到王城 (Part 2)):
The Queen looked toward the Third Prince and the Young Princess, a wave of stifling frustration washing over her. Yet, she had never truly pinned her hopes on these two; no matter how poorly they performed, they wouldn't genuinely drive her to rage. What truly frayed her nerves and made her restless was that not a single task she hoped these two would accomplish had ever been completed.

The First Princess glanced at the Third Prince and the Young Princess, who were still pointing fingers and screaming insults at each other, a trace of sorrow and derision flashing through her eyes.

From a very young age, their mother had deeply ingrained a specific worldview into their minds: "The Denton family is your backing and your blood-related kin"; "Before the Tiger King is your father, he is first and foremost the King of this nation, and Mother and Uncle are the ones who truly have your best interests at heart."

This resulted in all five siblings harboring far more awe and dread toward the Tiger King than genuine closeness.

When Raphael finally appeared, their mother repeatedly drilled into their ears: "Raphael is your enemy"; "Raphael will kill you all"; "Raphael will usurp all of the Tiger King's attention and affection"; "Raphael is just a low-born illegitimate child who knows how to put on a show; he should never have existed..."

The First and Second Princes were no longer young children by that time, so they merely listened to their mother's words with a grain of salt without taking them deeply to heart.

However, the Third Prince and the Young Princess swallowed their mother's words wholesale, holding the deepest hatred and resentment toward Raphael.

As for her, she was slightly younger than the Third Prince, but her mental maturity far surpassed both the Third and Young Princes. Furthermore, because she had displayed the innate talent to transform into a gigantic beast from an early age, she began following the Grand Marshal Shi Yu for training very early on, which greatly insulated her from the Queen's influence.

This allowed her to maintain a far more objective evaluation when facing Raphael Langmu.

The First Prince shared a very similar perspective, while the Second Prince chose to treat Raphael with utter indifference.

The First Princess genuinely felt that someone of Raphael's temperament could never be their enemy, yet her mother was hell-bent on manufacturing a formidable adversary for her own sons and daughter.

Sometimes, the First Princess wondered: If she were Raphael, no matter how good her temper was, being targeted and cornered by such repeated schemes and plots would inevitably drive her to rebel, even if she hadn't wanted to before.

The First Princess had considered trying to win Raphael over, but with her mother around, no matter how much goodwill she displayed, Raphael would likely never trust her—just look at Raphael's attitude toward the First Prince. Realizing this, the First Princess had long since abandoned that notion. She would keep an eye on Raphael, but she would never deliberately make things difficult for him.

That being said, the pity the First Princess felt for the Third Prince and the Young Princess wasn't because they lacked independent judgment, but because they were treated as mere tools by their own mother.

Their mother had always wanted the Third Prince and the Young Princess to take direct action and assassinate Raphael.

Although doing so would inevitably provoke the Tiger King's wrath, discarding a third prince and a young princess was of zero consequence to their mother. Their mother likely even consoled herself with the thought that she could forcefully spare their lives, with the absolute worst penalty being the loss of their succession rights.

The First Princess knew with crystal clarity who their mother's favorite child truly was.

Their mother wished for all her sons and daughters to serve as stepping stones for her most cherished child.

"Enough!" the Queen barked with a headache, cutting off the verbal brawl between the Third Prince and the Young Princess.

"Why would you suddenly invite Raphael Langmu?" the Queen demanded, frowning at the Third Prince.

The Third Prince was rather agitated, causing his words to tumble out in a somewhat jumbled mess: "Raphael went to the Black Forest City, and this time he even took Royal Father along with him. He very likely knows the whereabouts of Uncle. I sought him out precisely to sound him out. During this trip to the Black Forest City, Royal Father preferred to take him rather than any of us siblings.

"He also discovered a library dating back a thousand years. Rumor has it that library houses tens of thousands of years of civilization and heritage from the Beastman Continent. Once word of this spreads, what kind of monumental merit will that be? The entire Beastman Continent will go crazy over this!"

The Third Prince grew even more agitated. "Word has it that Royal Father intends to prepare a 'Beastman Continent Ten-Thousand-Year Civilization Heritage Sharing Assembly' open to the entire Beastman Continent. He didn't even deliberately conceal the discovery of the library, which clearly shows he wants to use this to summon the leaders of the entire continent and negotiate terms with them. I wanted to take charge of organizing this event, but Royal Father didn't even give me the time of day. Is he planning to hand this matter over to Raphael instead?"

第129章 拍卖会预热

不帅躲在特别调查局不出来，别人也拿他没办法。

别人以为他只是找个借口回来，却不知道不帅是真的在查邪神信徒的相关资料。

特别调查局一直在追查邪神信徒和虫毒感染者的种种线索，包括和这些有关系的贵族以及相关富豪等。

邪神信徒和虫毒感染者听起来很可怕，但当他们可以带来巨大利益时，那也不是不能合作的。

尤其在正牌古神不再响应众生，邪神却能帮忙实现一定愿望的时候。

小老虎无声无息地出现在不帅脚边，扒着他的裤腿往上爬。

不帅单手把他抄起来，放到自己腿上。

小老虎也不闹他，看他翻阅文件做归纳。

这种调查工作听起来很酷炫，实际上特别繁琐，重复性还很高。

特别调查员把调查来的种种线索汇总到总局，等着必要时这些线索能派上用场。

而不帅现在做的就是对这些庞杂的线索进行归纳总结，找出相关联处，或者不对劲处，再单列出来。

然后再把列出来的线索再进行审核，看这些线索是否有关联。

如果某些线索触动某些相关记忆，可能还需要把更以前的调查资料找出来，寻找记忆中的那粒面包屑。

这工作就非常耗费时间，还需要特别的细心和耐心。

不帅驾轻就熟地做着这些工作，神色间不见半点烦躁，哪怕连续工作了四五天，他的头脑还很清晰。

俗话说，工作中的男人最帅。

小老虎看得口水都要流出来。

谁说王者就一定要霸气，要腹黑，要心机深沉？

在他看来，他家不帅就很适合当王。

不帅工作认真，责任心重，脑子也清醒，如果他当国王，这个国家老百姓的生活幸福指数一定很高。

性格软耳根软并不是缺点，重点是他身边都有谁辅佐。

实际上不管是什么性格的王者，不管这个王者拥有怎样的能力，其身边辅佐的人都很重要。

因为一个国家并不是有一个好国王就能撑起来玩得转。

好在物以类聚，如果一个国家能出现一个好的领导者，往往也会有优秀的人才集中到他身边。

商小虎脑中已经刷刷给不帅列了一堆大臣名单，虎国人没有特别适合的，他可以找玩家支援。

相信很多玩家都会对经营一个国家感兴趣。

当然啦，玩家不可控，不过只是过度的话，会是很不错的选择。

可惜不帅对当王真的没有半点兴趣，他可以当，也能当，但他当王以后恐怕不会有多快乐。

而商小虎希望不帅快乐。

所以他也只能眼馋地放过谋夺虎国甚至是一统兽人大陆这样刺激的权谋游戏，选择了寻宝探秘的自由人路线。

现在想想，当个自由人，到处搞事，也挺来劲？

至于让他来当王？

他可不喜欢被困在一个地方。

最重要的是他很了解自己，如果他成为王者，绝对不会搞忍耐那一套，他看不顺眼会下手，看别人背着他搞事会下手，看有人谋害国家和他的利益，他更会下狠手。

所以，他如果当王，一定会是最暴虐最血腥最残忍最独-裁也最专横霸道的那种王。故，为了无数普通人的心脏着想，他还是不要选择这么有激-情的工作比较好。

“别乱舔。”不帅拍他脑袋。

商小虎嗷一声，叼住不帅一根手指。

不帅拧不过他，就随他去了，就是只有一只手工作，有点不太方便。

小老虎看着看着，就趴在他腿上睡着了。

不帅抽出满是口水的手指，轻轻抚摸小老虎暖呼呼的小肚子。他们这段时间都很忙，可再忙，商非凡都会变成小老虎偷偷来见他，哪怕来了也只是窝在他身边睡觉。

不帅脑中偶尔会飘过第二世的某些片段。

奥尔也有过死黏着他的时期，比某只小老虎还要黏人。但他记得他和奥尔快要分手前的那两年，奥尔经常会用繁忙为借口，表示无法和他相聚，或者无法和他单独相处。

而他早就习惯了等待，所以也不觉得两人非要天天窝在一起。

现在想来，如果真心喜欢和在意的人，就算忙得飞起，恐怕都能挤出滴水的时间，就为和喜欢的人见一面。哪怕什么都不做，只是相视一笑，知道对方安好就好。

洛伦米尔顿就更不用说了，想走就走，也不会给他一个明确的归来日期。而他却认为只要等待下去就能有好结果，默默地以为自己的等待是一种值得的付出，真是要有多蠢就有多蠢。

不帅吐气，过去这些记忆想起来仍旧会让他心脏微微抽痛，这也是他不喜欢回忆过去的原因，毕竟谁也不喜欢不断面对自己的失败。

也许他将来和商非凡也会走到不再牵挂、不想见面、编借口说谎、乃至两看两相厌的地步。

所以珍惜现在，还是勒紧自己的感情控制自己绝不再投入？

奇怪，这样一想，些微的抽痛感竟完全消失了。

咔叽。小老虎在睡梦中还咬了他手指一口。很轻，但又轻微刺痛，让人无法忽视。

不止小老虎爱咬人，大的那个也有这毛病。

不帅脸红，拍拍脸不再胡思乱想，转而把注意力都投入到工作中。

他在庞大的资料海中已经抓住了一根线头，顺着线头往下拽，也许能找到丹顿公爵和邪神信徒合作的真正原因。

这几天王城各种消息纷飞，表面上看着和以前一样，实际要比以前热闹得多。

等到王庭传出明确消息，说虎王要召开一届“兽人大陆万年文明传承分享大会”，整个王城都为这个消息沸腾起来。

图书馆的事也泄露出去。

这件事是虎王有意泄露出去，因为他要邀请兽人大陆各国各部落领导者，还有圣山祭司宫的大祭司，总得让他们知道他为什么以及有什么底气能开这么一场大会。

一座千年前专门为后世准备、拥有兽人大陆数万年完整传承的图书馆！

无数人为这个消息疯狂。

更有无数人想要在这场势必会记载入兽人大陆重要历史的重大事件中分一杯羹。

哪怕只是负责操办这场大会。

不说操持大会最基础的衣食住行这些方面能抠出多少油水，这都属于小利。

更大头的是邀请名单！

邀请名单可以做手脚的地方太多了。

除了虎王点名必须要邀请的人员以外，大会主办人可以根据需要增减其他邀请人员，到时候邀请谁和不邀请谁不过是主办人一句话的事情。

光是为了能参加这场传承分享大会，就会有无数人捧着无数的金达盾主动去求大会主办人。

更何况这是一场面对整个兽人大陆的盛大大会，可以说新生纪以来，整个兽人大陆就没有搞过这么大规模且高规模的各族首领共聚大会。

如果能在这样一场大会中当上主办人，那得是多露脸的事情？

甚至可以说，虎王青睐谁来负责这场大会，谁就很有可能成为下一位虎王！
