Chapter 129: Auction Warm-Up

With Bu Shuai hiding out in the Special Investigation Bureau and refusing to step outside, there was nothing anyone else could do to reach him.

While outsiders assumed he was merely using that as an excuse to lay low, they had no idea that Bu Shuai was genuinely investigating the relevant intelligence concerning the evil god's cult.

The Special Investigation Bureau had consistently tracked various clues regarding evil god worshippers and insect-venom-infected individuals, including nobles and wealthy magnates linked to them.

Evil god worshippers and insect-venom-infected victims sounded terrifying, but when they could yield astronomical profits, cooperation was not entirely off the table.

Especially when the legitimate ancient gods no longer answered the living, yet evil gods could help fulfill certain desires.

The little tiger appeared silently by Bu Shuai's feet, clawing its way up his trouser leg.

Bu Shuai scooped it up with one hand and placed it on his lap.

The little tiger didn't kick up a fuss, simply watching as he flipped through documents and categorized data.

This sort of investigative work sounded cool and exciting, but in reality, it was exceptionally tedious and possessed a high degree of repetition.

Special investigators pooled all sorts of gathered clues into the headquarters bureau, awaiting the moment when these threads might prove useful.

And what Bu Shuai was currently doing was sorting and summarizing these tangled clues, identifying correlations or anomalies, and listing them out separately.

Then, he would audit these isolated clues once more to see if any genuine connections existed.

If certain clues triggered specific memories, he might even need to pull up older investigation archives, hunting for that single grain of breadcrumb buried deep within his memory.

This work was intensely time-consuming and demanded extraordinary meticulousness and patience.

Bu Shuai handled these tasks with practiced ease, not a shred of impatience showing on his features. Even after working continuously for four or five days, his mind remained remarkably clear.

As the saying goes, a man at work is at his most handsome.

The little tiger watched until drool was practically about to trickle out.

Who said a sovereign had to be domineering, scheming, and utterly unfathomable?

In his eyes, his Bu Shuai was exceptionally well-suited to be a king.

Bu Shuai was earnest in his work, possessed a high sense of responsibility, and had a clear head. If he became king, the happiness index of the common folk in this nation would undoubtedly be extremely high.

Having a soft personality or a yielding disposition wasn't a fatal flaw; the key factor was *who* assisted him by his side.

In truth, regardless of a ruler's personality or what abilities they possessed, the people assisting them were paramount.

Because a nation could never be propped up and run smoothly relying on a good king alone.

Fortunately, birds of a feather flock together; if a nation could produce a good leader, outstanding talent would naturally gravitate toward his side.

Shang Xiaohu was already busily drafting a list of ministers for Bu Shuai in his mind. Since Tiger Kingdom locals might not have ideal candidates, he could always source backup from the players.

He believed many players would be intensely interested in managing a country.

Of course, players were unpredictable, but as a transitional measure, they would make an exceptional choice.

It was a pity that Bu Shuai genuinely held zero interest in being king. He could do it, and he had the capability to do it, but he likely wouldn't find much happiness sitting on the throne.

And Shang Xiaohu wanted Bu Shuai to be happy.

Thus, he could only tearfully let go of the thrilling power-struggle game of conquering the Tiger Kingdom or even unifying the Beastman Continent, choosing instead the free-spirited path of treasure hunting and mystery exploration.

Come to think of it, being a free spirit running around stirring up trouble was also pretty exhilarating?

As for asking him to be king?

He certainly didn't enjoy being cooped up in one place.

Most importantly, he knew himself too well: if he became a ruler, he would absolutely never tolerate any nonsense. He would strike down anyone who displeased him, strike down anyone scheming behind his back, and strike down even harder anyone plotting against the nation and his interests.

Therefore, if he became king, he would undoubtedly be the most tyrannical, bloody, cruel, dictatorial, and overbearing sort of monarch. Thus, for the sake of countless ordinary citizens' hearts, he had better steer clear of such an emotionally charged profession.

"Stop licking randomly," Bu Shuai patted its head.

Shang Xiaohu let out an *ao*, clamping his jaws around one of Bu Shuai's fingers.

Unable to win against the little guy, Bu Shuai simply let him be, though having only one hand free made working a little inconvenient.

As he watched, the little tiger gradually drifted to sleep right on his lap.

Bu Shuai slid out his saliva-soaked finger and gently stroked the little tiger's warm, soft belly. Both of them had been extremely busy lately, but no matter how hectic things got, Shang Feifan would always transform into a little tiger and secretly come see him, even if it just meant curling up by his side to sleep.

Fragments of his second lifetime would occasionally drift through Bu Shuai's mind.

Auer had also gone through a phase of clinging to him desperately, even more clingy than this little tiger. Yet he remembered that in the two years leading up to their breakup, Auer frequently used busyness as an excuse to claim he couldn't meet up or spend time alone together.

And because he had long since grown accustomed to waiting, he never felt that the two of them needed to huddle together every single day.

Thinking back on it now, if someone is truly loved and cared for, even if one is swamped to the point of flying, they can still squeeze out a sliver of time just to see the person they adore. Even if they do nothing at all, just sharing a smile and knowing the other person is safe and well is enough.

As for Lauren Milton, there was even less need to mention him—he left whenever he pleased, never giving him a definite return date. Yet back then, he foolishly believed that as long as he kept waiting, a good outcome would follow, quietly convincing himself that his endurance was a worthwhile investment. Truly, nothing could be more foolish than that.

Bu Shuai let out a breath. Recalling those past memories still caused a slight, dull ache in his chest—which was precisely why he disliked dwelling on the past. After all, nobody enjoys repeatedly confronting their own failures.

Perhaps in the future, he and Shang Feifan would also reach a point of no longer caring, no longer wishing to see each other, fabricating excuses and lies, and ultimately looking at each other with mutual disgust.

So should he cherish the present, or tighten the reins on his emotions and vow never to invest his heart again?

Oddly enough, with that thought, the faint, throbbing ache vanished entirely.

*Crunch.* In its sleep, the little tiger took another bite of his finger. It was very light, yet carried a slight prickle that made it impossible to ignore.

It wasn't just the little tiger who loved biting people; the big one had this bad habit too.

Bu Shuai's face flushed. He patted his cheeks to banish the wandering thoughts and redirected all his focus back to his work.

Within the vast sea of data, he had already grabbed onto a single loose thread. Pulling downward along that thread might just uncover the true reason behind Duke Denton's collaboration with the evil god's cult.

Over the past few days, all sorts of rumors had been flying around the Royal City. On the surface, it looked just like any other day, but beneath the veneer, it was infinitely more bustling than before.

When definitive news finally trickled out from the royal court—announcing that the Tiger King was going to convene a "Beastman Continent Ten-Thousand-Year Civilization Heritage Sharing Assembly"—the entire Royal City erupted into a frenzy over the news.

The matter of the library leaked out as well.

This leak was intentionally orchestrated by the Tiger King, because if he wanted to invite leaders from various nations and tribes across the Beastman Continent, along with the High Priest of the Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace, he had to give them a reason and the confidence to justify holding such an assembly.

A library from a thousand years ago, specially prepared for future generations and holding the complete, tens-of-thousands-of-years-old heritage of the Beastman Continent!

Countless people went wild over this intelligence.

And countless more wanted to carve off a slice of the pie from this monumental event destined to be recorded in the pivotal history of the Beastman Continent.

Even if it was just taking charge of organizing this assembly.

Not to mention the oil and grease that could be skimmed from the most basic logistics like food, clothing, housing, and transportation—though those were just minor profits.

The real heavy prize lay in the invitation list!

There were far too many places where one could manipulate an invitation list.

Aside from the individuals the Tiger King explicitly named and ordered to be invited, the organizers of the assembly could add or remove other invitees based on their needs. When the time came, deciding who received an invitation and who didn't came down to a single word from the organizers.

Just for the sake of attending this heritage sharing assembly, countless people would willingly捧着 countless gold-bound shields to beg the assembly organizers.

Moreover, this was a grand assembly facing the entire Beastman Continent. It was no exaggeration to say that since the dawn of the New Era, the entire Beastman Continent had never hosted such a massive, high-caliber gathering bringing together the leaders of all races.

If one could secure the position of organizer for an assembly of this scale, what a face-saving, glorious feat that would be!

One could even say that whichever prince the Tiger King favored to oversee this event would likely become the next Tiger King!

chunks.chineseText:
五位王子公主以及他们各自的支持者，为了这场大会的主办人身份，已经快要狗脑子打出猪脑子。

当然，这些活动都是暗地里，还没有闹到明面上。

就是在这时候，在王城各种火都烧起来时，有人又在这堆熊熊燃烧的火焰上浇了一勺油。

阿瑞斯商出关了，他当众宣称：他已经做好一支储物手镯，打算在两天后就公开拍卖！

王城三家拍卖行的大掌柜把阿瑞斯商租住的府邸大门给堵住了，他们都想得到那支储物手镯的拍卖权。

中年女兽人出面，把三家大掌柜邀请入府邸，半个小时后就把人送了出来。

三位大掌柜都没有见到阿瑞斯商本人，但他们的表情并没有丝毫不满，还带着丝丝兴奋。

其他人从三名大掌柜的表情中就猜测出来，他们一定是见到了实物。

也就是说，那个纨绔少爷手上真的有一支空间储物手镯，甭管是不是他亲手炼制的，只要东西是真的就行！

空间手镯，那绝对是所有兽人都向往的宝贝。

越是大家族越是讲究面子，如果有哪个贵族家里能拿出一支空间储物工具，那绝对是极有面子的事。

而且从三名大掌柜隐隐透露出来的消息，那支空间手镯的内部空间还不小，至少超过五个立方米。

晚上，三名大掌柜分别带着自家许诺的种种条件来见阿瑞斯商。

这次，他们同样没有见到这位少爷，依旧是那名中年女兽人接待的他们。

女兽人拿走他们带来的契约，让他们在客厅稍等。

等到女兽人离开，屋内没有一个仆人时。

“你们有没有觉得那名女兽人有点脸熟？”奢梦拍卖行的大掌柜突然说。

另外两名大掌柜一起看向他，“你见过她？”

奢梦大掌柜仔细回忆，过了一会儿，啊地一声说道：“我想起来了！那女兽人曾经是杜德子爵家里的女管家，叫做玛利亚好像。”

“杜德家的女管家怎么会成为一个外来纨……炼金大师的女仆？”双贵拍卖行的大掌柜疑惑地说。

另一位无价拍卖行的大掌柜也一拍额头，他们都是王城消息最灵通的人：“你这么一说我就想起来了。杜德子爵家确实把自己家工作多年的女管家给辞退了，对外说那女管家身体不好无法再当管家。实际上……”

奢梦大掌柜单手遮住嘴：“实际上我们都知道杜德家那对兄弟俩是个什么德性。而那位玛利亚女管家性格较真，行事讲规矩又严厉，应该是被那对兄弟厌恶了。”

无价大掌柜左右看看，小声说：“我这里有个消息，据说那对兄弟做了不好的事情，被那女管家看见。女管家禀告给杜德子爵。杜德子爵不但没有管教那对兄弟，反而想要打杀那女管家。那女管家自己逃了出来，后来也不知找了谁的关系，从杜德子爵府脱离出来，对外则是说辞退。”

“因为那女管家是被辞退，又被说是身体不好，加上其他人碍着杜德子爵的面子，导致那女管家很长时间都找不到工作。很多人都以为她已经离开王城，没想到……”

“奇怪，那位阿瑞斯商少爷为什么不带自己的仆人？”

“也许是自己跑出来的，也许是不喜欢家里安排的仆人。这种事我们无需多问，只要他真的能拿出空间手镯，就值得我们捧着他。”

“也是。”

最终虎国最大的拍卖行，同样也是兽人大陆最负盛名的拍卖行奢梦拍卖行拿下了那支空间手镯的拍卖权。

虽然阿瑞斯商给出的准备时间很短，只有两天。

如果换在平时，这点时间连宣传都不够。

但阿瑞斯商本人的高调，相当于已经提前做足了宣传，不用奢梦拍卖行多加宣扬，就有很多人主动来跟他们索要拍卖邀请函。

奢梦拍卖行谁也不想得罪，更为了进一步扩大自己的影响力，干脆给王城乃至附近的大小贵族和富豪们都发了邀请函。

至于这些人会不会赶来，他们并不担心。

那可是空间手镯！

三位王子和两位公主也收到了邀请函，理所当然。

虎不帅看着手里的邀请函哭笑不得。他这封邀请函比较特殊，是一只小老虎用嘴巴叼着给他亲自送来的。

小老虎在他怀里撒泼打滚，死活要他也去拍卖会，说要让不帅看到他高光的时刻。

不帅被闹得只得同意，虽然他不太想在那么公众的场合露脸，那天可想而知，都有什么人会来。

两天时间转瞬而逝。
chunks.englishText:
The five princes and princesses, along with their respective supporters, had been fighting tooth and nail for the position of host for this grand assembly, nearly beating each other’s brains out.

Of course, these maneuvers were all carried out in the shadows and had not yet boiled over into the open.

It was precisely at this moment, while various fires were already blazing across the Royal City, that someone poured yet another ladle of oil onto the raging inferno.

Ares Shang emerged from seclusion and publicly proclaimed that he had crafted a spatial storage bracelet and intended to auction it openly in two days!

The head managers of the three major auction houses in the Royal City blocked the gates of the mansion rented by Ares Shang, all vying for the auction rights to that spatial storage bracelet.

The middle-aged female beastman stepped forward and invited the three head managers into the mansion, sending them back out just half an hour later.

None of the three head managers had actually laid eyes on Ares Shang himself, yet their expressions showed not the slightest trace of dissatisfaction; instead, they carried a faint trace of excitement.

From the expressions of the three head managers, onlookers guessed that they must have laid eyes on the physical item.

In other words, that wastrel young master genuinely possessed a spatial storage bracelet! Regardless of whether he had forged it with his own hands or not, as long as the item was real, that was all that mattered!

A spatial bracelet—that was unquestionably a coveted treasure that every beastman yearned for.

The more prestigious a clan, the more importance they attached to saving face. If any noble family could produce a spatial storage tool, it was an absolute matter of supreme prestige.

Moreover, according to the hints vaguely dropped by the three head managers, the inner space of that spatial bracelet was by no means small, exceeding at least five cubic meters.

That evening, the three head managers arrived to see Ares Shang, each bearing the various conditions and promises of their respective houses.

This time, they still did not get to meet the young master; it was once again that same middle-aged female beastman who received them.

The female beastman took away the contracts they brought and asked them to wait a moment in the parlor.

Once the female beastman had departed and there were no servants left in the room—

"Did any of you think that female beastman looked a bit familiar?" the head manager of the Dreamweaver Auction House suddenly asked.

The other two head managers turned to look at him in unison. "You've seen her before?"

The Dreamweaver head manager searched his memories carefully, and after a moment, he let out an "Ah!" and said, "I remember now! That female beastman used to be the head housekeeper of Viscount Dorde's estate. Her name seemed to be Maria."

"How could the head housekeeper of the Dorde family become a maid to an external wastr... an alchemy master?" the head manager of the Double-Noble Auction House asked, puzzled.

The other head manager, representing the Priceless Auction House, also slapped his forehead. They were the most well-informed individuals in the Royal City: "Now that you mention it, I remember. The Dorde Viscount's estate did indeed dismiss a head housekeeper who had served them for many years, giving the excuse that her health was poor and she could no longer serve as housekeeper. In reality..."

The Dreamweaver head manager covered his mouth with one hand: "In reality, we all know what kind of characters that pair of brothers from the Dorde family are. And that housekeeper Maria had a strict, uncompromising personality and adhered rigidly to the rules; she must have been deeply loathed by those two brothers."

The Priceless head manager looked left and right before whispering, "I have some inside information on this. It's rumored that those two brothers committed some unspeakable misdeeds and were witnessed by the housekeeper. The housekeeper reported it to Viscount Dorde. Not only did Viscount Dorde fail to discipline the brothers, but he even wanted to beat the housekeeper to death. The housekeeper managed to escape on her own, and later, using goodness knows whose connections, she severed ties with the Dorde Viscount's estate. Outwardly, however, it was announced as a standard dismissal."

"Because the housekeeper was officially 'dismissed' due to 'poor health,' combined with the fact that others had to give face to Viscount Dorde, it resulted in her being unable to find a job for a very long time. Many assumed she had already left the Royal City, but who would have thought..."

"Strange, why doesn't that young master Ares Shang bring his own servants?"

"Perhaps he ran away from home on his own, or perhaps he simply dislikes the servants arranged by his family. There's no need for us to pry into such matters. As long as he can genuinely produce a spatial bracelet, he is worth us flattering and pampering."

"True."

In the end, the Dreamweaver Auction House—the largest auction house in the Tiger Kingdom and also the most prestigious in the Beastman Continent—secured the auction rights for that spatial storage bracelet.

Although the preparation time given by Ares Shang was extremely short, spanning only two days.

Under normal circumstances, this amount of time wouldn't even be enough for publicity.

However, Ares Shang's own high-profile actions were equivalent to having done the publicity well in advance. Without any extra promotion from the Dreamweaver Auction House, many people proactively came to them demanding auction invitation letters.

The Dreamweaver Auction House wanted to offend no one, and to further expand their own influence, they simply issued invitations to nobles and wealthy figures of all sizes throughout the Royal City and its surrounding areas.

As for whether these people would actually rush over, they had no worries whatsoever.

That was a spatial bracelet!

The three princes and two princesses also received invitations, as a matter of course.

Hu Bushuai looked at the invitation in his hand, feeling a mix of laughter and tears. His invitation was rather special; it had been delivered to him personally by a tiger cub holding it in its mouth.

The tiger cub threw a tantrum and rolled around in his arms, stubbornly insisting that he must go to the auction, claiming he wanted Bushuai to witness his moment of peak glory.

Hounded relentlessly, Bushuai had no choice but to agree, even though he didn't much care to show his face in such a public setting—one could only imagine what kind of figures would be in attendance on that day.

Two days vanished in the blink of an eye.

第130章 拍卖会

奢梦拍卖行为这次拍卖会整出了最大的拍卖场所。

可以容纳两千人的拍卖大厅被挤得满满当当。

这里同样也承接开办音乐会和歌舞剧，王城权贵对这里都很熟悉。

奢梦拍卖行一般只有搞年终拍卖时才会使用这里，平时都是使用拍卖行的小拍卖厅。

别看两千人不多，但放在拍卖场，这么多人数已经是大场面，尤其来客都是高质量（愿意花钱）客户的情况下。

视听效果最好的半敞开式包间内坐的都是贵客中的贵客，平时能来一个都能让拍卖行老板嘴巴笑歪，但今天几乎请柬上邀请的大人物都来了。

三位王子两位公主，一个都不缺。

宰相艾萨克、大都督狮域、大公切斯特之类的大人物没有亲自到场，但家里的小辈必然有至少一个人前来。

很多人也把这场拍卖会当做一场能结交大人物的交际会，接到请柬的人与有荣焉，没有接到请柬的人想方设法蹭请柬也要过来。

不帅进入拍卖场时十分低调，他穿了连帽大氅，也没带任何侍从，就一个人单独进入大厅。

小老虎知道他的性子，给他送的请柬只是最普通的座位票，座位还在最后一排，最靠近内侧的位置。

这个位置的旁边还有一扇员工走的小门，方便不帅随时都可以偷溜。

不帅找到自己的位置坐下，先看周围通路布置，看到旁边的小门，嘴角微弯。某人果然懂他。

之后不帅就开始低头翻看起拍卖行临时制作的拍卖品小册子。

搞出规模这么大的拍卖会，奢梦拍卖行当然不可能只拍一件物品，那也太亏。他们可是允诺阿瑞斯商，无论空间手镯拍出什么价，他们都不会收取一个铜达铢的手续费。

这小册子其实也不是临时准备，里面的拍卖品都是准备在年中大拍时进行，现在不过是提前了三个月。

小册子中并没有空间手镯的介绍，但小册子的最前页加了一句话：今日有惊喜，敬请期待！

很快，整个拍卖大厅就坐满了人。

包间内的贵客几乎是踩着点进入包间。他们走的通道和普通客人不一样，大厅内的客人大多都看不到他们是从哪里进来。

但不帅那个位置，让他可以清楚看见二楼所有半敞开包间，而二楼包间的客人因为角度问题却看不到他。

当他看到洛伦米尔顿，不，现在应该是天残谷主，竟然和二王子坐在一起时，有点诧异，但也不是特别意外。

二王子和天残谷主都是容颜俊美的人，坐在一起侧头微笑时，十分赏心悦目。

他们身边的男女也都用或痴迷或羡慕的目光看着两人。

大厅内也有很多人眼睛直勾勾地看向两人。

两人似乎已经对这些恋慕和惊艳的目光司空见惯，只低语微笑，丝毫不受影响。

大厅内忽然响起一阵骚动。

一名只论面貌完全不亚于二王子和天残谷主的雄性兽人大踏步走入拍买大厅。

他的衣着打扮十分随意，带着说不出的肆意放荡，但他本人浑不在意，并一副天上地下老子才是最酷的崽的拽样。

阿瑞斯商来了！

他还是一个人来的，一个仆从都没有带。

在场几乎所有人的目光都转向这位最近在王城特别火的纨绔少爷。

阿瑞斯商的容貌不是二王子和天残谷主那样精致的俊美，而是一种充满野性和邪肆的酷帅，无需精雕细琢，自成独特魅力。

很多人只听过他的名头，原本以为传言过于夸大，但在看到他本人后，不少人眼睛就亮了。

又一个超级优质的雄性兽人！

而且他本人还是炼金师！会炼制空间手镯的那种！

在场不少人心中都蠢蠢欲动，有人已经要行动了。

就是对阿瑞斯商过于高调和邪肆的风格不太喜欢的老派权贵，这会儿也在心里琢磨家里有没有适合的儿女。

不说其他，单阿瑞斯商能炼制空间储物工具这点，如果他能成为自家人，那可不只是面子加成，而是会让整个家族都迈上一个大阶层啊！

何况阿瑞斯商本人容貌身材武力值和家世等都没得话说！

可惜阿瑞斯商这家伙完全不近人情，对于想要上来和他搭讪的人直接无视，而且他也没有进入包间或前排贵宾席，竟然随便找了个空位就坐下了。

那位置还在最后一排，搞得不少人只能扭头看他。

但阿瑞斯商抱臂而坐，老神在在。那架势！宛如他坐在哪儿，哪儿就是王座。

纨绔少爷气势十足，搞得周围人都不敢坐在他身边。

不帅把兜帽又往下拉了拉，他很想让旁边的人坐远一点，但他不敢有任何动作，就怕其他人也注意到他。

可恨啊，为什么他要坐在最边上的位置，现在他想挪动位置，也没座位给他挪。

这个欠揍的显眼包！

后面进来的人，眼看大厅再无其他空位，但也硬是和阿瑞斯商隔开了几个位置才敢坐下。

等到大王子带着几个朋友在包间落座后，拍卖会正式开始了。

大厅也逐渐安静下来，人们也不再扭头四看或是和人交际说话，都把目光投向了最前面。

主持人是一名兔族男孩，有着长长的耳朵，可爱的容颜。

但这个兔族男孩却是非常有名的拍卖会主持人，他的年龄也不像他的脸蛋看起来那么年轻，实际上他的实际岁数已经超过五十岁。

“诸位，我知道你们都不喜欢冗长的废话，所以让我们现在就开始进行第一件珍宝的拍卖！”

拍卖会现场响起掌声和笑声，还有吹口哨声。

这场拍卖会来的大人物多，不少都是年轻人，也不是所有贵族少爷小姐都循规蹈矩，相反他们的叛逆心都很重。

“为我们开场的第一件拍卖品，原本是年中拍卖会的压轴宝物，相信不少人都曾期待过它的出现。它就是由寻宝猎人鹰之翼从一处古遗迹中挖掘出来的大繁华纪珍品，一副能看到人体内部骨骼、肌肉和内脏，包括血液循环的透视眼镜！”

“想要知道人体的奥秘吗？想要知道自己不舒服的根源在哪里吗？想要成为治疗者和医生中的翘楚吗？来自大繁华纪，只要日常放在阳光下就能聚能的透视眼镜，使用没有任何副作用、没有任何限定次数和时间，只要能量足够，就能一直使用下去。”

“起拍价十个金达盾，每次加价不得少于十金，起拍开始！”

如此宝物，让原本只想集中资金拍买空间手镯的人也忍不住为之心动。

拍卖现场当即变得火爆。

拍卖行老板暗中兴奋握拳，他们选择把年中压轴放到今天的开场选对了！

如果开场宝物不够亮眼和刺激人，那么很可能会进入客人们都在期待空间手镯而不耐烦其他拍品的恶质状况。

可如果把空间手镯提前拿出，又可能出现客人们集中资金拼命拍空间手镯，以至于后面无力或因为没有得到想要的东西以至于不想再拍其他拍品，这种对拍卖行极端不利的场面。

Chapter 130: The Auction

The Dreamweaver Auction House had put together their largest venue yet for this auction.

The grand auction hall, capable of accommodating two thousand people, was packed to the brim.

This venue was also used to host concerts and operas, and the royal nobility of the city were all thoroughly familiar with it.

Ordinarily, the Dreamweaver Auction House only utilized this space for their year-end grand auctions, relying on their smaller auction halls for everyday events.

Two thousand people might not sound like much, but within the confines of an auction house, such a headcount constituted a massive spectacle—especially when the attendees were high-net-worth clients who were more than willing to spend lavishly.

The semi-open private booths, boasting the finest audio-visual acoustics, seated the absolute cream of the crop among the distinguished guests. On any regular day, the arrival of even one such person would cause the auction house owner’s mouth to split wide in a grin of delight, yet today, practically every major VIP invited on the guest list had arrived.

The three princes and two princesses were all present, without a single omission.

While heavyweights like Prime Minister Isaac, Grand Marshal Shiyu, and Grand Duke Chester did not attend in person, each of their households had sent at least one junior representative.

Many attendees treated this auction as a social gathering for rubbing shoulders with high society; those who received invitations felt deeply honored, while those who didn't went to great lengths to scrounge up invitations just to squeeze their way in.

When Bushuai entered the auction grounds, he kept an extremely low profile. He wore a hooded cloak, brought no attendants whatsoever, and stepped into the grand hall entirely alone.

Knowing his temperament, the tiger cub had sent him only the most ordinary seating ticket—one located in the very last row, right against the innermost side.

Right next to this seat was a small employee exit door, making it convenient for Bushuai to slip away at any moment he pleased.

Bushuai found his seat and sat down, first inspecting the surrounding passageways and layouts. Upon spotting the small door nearby, the corners of his mouth curved upward. Someone truly understood him.

Afterward, Bushuai lowered his head and began flipping through the temporary auction catalog compiled by the auction house.

Having organized an auction of this scale, the Dreamweaver Auction House naturally wouldn't auction off just a single item; that would be far too unprofitable. After all, they had promised Ares Shang that regardless of the final fetching price of the spatial bracelet, they would not charge a single copper Dadrach in commission fees.

In truth, this catalog wasn't cobbled together at the last minute; the items listed within had originally been prepared for the year-end grand auction, and this event merely brought them forward by three months.

The catalog contained no introduction for the spatial bracelet, but the opening page featured an added line: A surprise awaits today—stay tuned!

Before long, the entire auction hall was filled to capacity.

The distinguished guests in the private booths arrived almost right on the dot. The passage they used differed from the one for ordinary guests, preventing most patrons in the grand hall from seeing where they entered.

However, Bushuai’s seating position offered him a clear view of all the semi-open booths on the second floor, while the guests inside those booths were unable to see him due to the angle.

When he caught sight of Loren Milton—no, who should now be addressed as the Master of the Heavenly Scar Valley—sitting together with the Second Prince, he felt a brief flicker of astonishment, though it wasn't entirely unexpected.

Both the Second Prince and the Master of the Heavenly Scar Valley possessed exquisitely handsome features, and as they sat side by side, turning their heads to exchange smiles, they cut a breathtakingly pleasing picture.

The men and women surrounding them similarly gazed at the pair with expressions of infatuation or envy.

Inside the grand hall, many people cast unblinking, fixed gazes upon the two of them as well.

The pair seemed thoroughly accustomed to such admiring and bedazzling looks, merely speaking in low murmurs with soft smiles, completely unbothered.

Suddenly, a commotion rippled through the grand hall.

A male beastman, whose appearance was in no way inferior to the Second Prince and the Master of the Heavenly Scar Valley, strode with broad steps into the auction hall.

His attire was utterly casual, exuding an indescribable wild and lawless air. Yet he himself paid it no heed, wearing a swaggering expression that screamed he was the coolest baddest beastman under the heavens.

Ares Shang had arrived!

He too had come alone, without bringing a single servant.

Virtually everyone’s gaze in the hall shifted toward this wastrel young master who had recently taken the Royal City by storm.

Ares Shang’s looks lacked the delicate, refined prettiness of the Second Prince and the Master of the Heavenly Scar Valley; instead, they carried a cool, edgy handsomeness brimming with wildness and wicked charm. Requiring no meticulous sculpting, his appeal possessed a unique, self-contained magnetism.

Many had only heard his reputation and initially assumed the rumors were exaggerated, but upon laying eyes on him in person, more than a few gazes lit up.

Yet another top-tier, premium male beastman!

And on top of that, he was an alchemist himself! The kind who could forge spatial bracelets!

Hearts stirred restlessly among many present in the hall, and some were already poised to make a move.

Even the old-school nobility, who generally disliked Ares Shang’s excessively high-profile and unbridled style, were inwardly pondering whether they had any eligible sons or daughters at home.

Setting everything else aside, merely the fact that Ares Shang could forge spatial storage tools meant that if he were to become one of their own family, it wouldn't just be an addition to their prestige—it would elevate their entire clan by a massive tier!

Not to mention that Ares Shang himself was flawless in terms of looks, physique, combat prowess, and family background!

It was a pity that this fellow Ares Shang was completely devoid of warmth. He directly ignored anyone attempting to approach and strike up a conversation with him, nor did he enter a private booth or the front-row VIP seating; instead, he casually found an empty seat and sat right down.

That seat happened to be in the very last row, forcing numerous people to twist their necks just to look at him.

Yet Ares Shang sat with his arms crossed, completely unfazed and composed. That posture! It was as if wherever he sat became a throne.

The wastrel young master radiated such overwhelming presence that the people around him didn't even dare to sit next to him.

Bushuai pulled his hood down a bit further. He desperately wanted the person beside him to scoot a little farther away, but he didn't dare make any sudden movements, terrified of drawing anyone else's attention to himself.

Cursed fate—why did he have to choose a seat right on the absolute edge? Now, even if he wanted to shift his position, there wasn't a single empty seat left for him to move to.

What an infuriatingly conspicuous show-off!

The late arrivals, seeing that the hall had no other vacant seats left, stubbornly squeezed in by leaving a buffer of several empty chairs between themselves and Ares Shang before daring to sit down.

When the First Prince finally arrived and took his seat in a private booth alongside a few friends, the auction officially commenced.

The hall gradually grew quiet. People ceased turning their heads to look around or socializing and conversing with others, casting their gazes toward the front stage instead.

The host was a rabbit-folk boy blessed with long ears and an adorable countenance.

Yet this rabbit-folk boy was a tremendously renowned auction host. His age was far from what his youthful face suggested; in reality, his true age exceeded fifty years.

"My esteemed guests, I know none of you are fans of protracted small talk, so let us dive straight into the auction of our very first prized treasure!"

Applause, laughter, and a few whistles rang out across the auction venue.

With so many high-ranking figures present—many of them young—not every noble young master or lady followed rigid etiquette. On the contrary, their rebellious streaks ran quite deep.

"The opening auction item for our event was originally intended to be the grand finale piece of the year-end auction. I believe many of you have anticipated its appearance. It is a treasure from the Great Flourishing Era unearthly excavated from ancient ruins by the treasure hunter Wings of the Hawk: a pair of perspective glasses capable of peering through the human body to view bones, muscles, internal organs, and even blood circulation!"

"Do you wish to unravel the mysteries of the human anatomy? Do you wish to pinpoint the root cause of your bodily discomforts? Do you wish to become the pinnacle of healers and physicians? Hailing from the Great Flourishing Era, these perspective glasses merely need to be left basking in sunlight during the day to gather energy. They carry zero side effects, no limitations on usage count or duration—as long as there is sufficient energy, they can be used continuously!"

"Starting bid: ten gold daltons, with each increment no less than ten gold coins. Let the bidding begin!"

Such a miraculous treasure caused even those who had intended to hoard their funds exclusively for the spatial bracelet to find their hearts stirring uncontrollably.

The auction scene instantly turned fiery.

The auction house owner secretly clenched a fist in excitement. Choosing to feature the year-end grand finale piece as today's opening item had been the right call!

If the opening item lacked brilliance and failed to stimulate the crowd, it risked plunging the event into a terrible scenario where patrons grew impatient with everything else while impatiently fixating solely on the spatial bracelet.

Conversely, bringing out the spatial bracelet too early might cause guests to exhaust all their funds fighting over it tooth and nail, leaving them financially drained or disgruntled by failure, thereby losing the desire to bid on any subsequent items—a nightmare scenario utterly detrimental to the auction house.

chunks.chineseText:
好在他们选择对了，这也是他们拍卖主持人的坚持，对方果然很懂顾客心理。

第一件拍品被王城最有名的医师拍下。他本身也是一名贵族，虽然只是不入流的勋爵，但他身为伯爵的祖父还在世，加上他医术确实精湛，王城中的权贵也都愿意卖他一个面子，当价格推到三百二十金时，就没有人再继续举牌。

拍卖行老板已经满意了，这个价格基本在他的心理价位内。

拍卖主持人妙语如珠，介绍详尽却不烦人，在他热情声音推动下，拍卖会顺利进行到中段。

眼看客人们已经出现疲态，很多人的注意力已经不再放到拍品上，拍卖主持人看向某处，用眼神和拍卖行老板达成共识。

拍卖行老板点头。

啪啪啪，主持人突然用力击掌。

在场客人们的注意力被吸引。

拍卖主持人：“诸位，你们期待已久的惊喜来了！接下来我们要拍卖的是……”

主持人故意拖长语调。

有人忍不住，在下方大声喊出来：“空间手镯！快点拍空间手镯！”

大厅内一片喧哗，到最后竟然变成众人齐声高呼“空间手镯”。

氛围上来了，主持人哈的一声大笑：“好！我们接下来的拍品就是所有人都梦想拥有的空间储物工具！”

“第19号拍品，空间手镯，炼制者阿瑞斯商。让我们深感荣幸的是，这位炼金大师本人现在就在现场，相信不少人已经见到他。”

好多人扭头看向最后一排。

阿瑞斯商则在侧头看着什么，似乎在看旁边坐着的客人。

“天哪，不得不说，这位大师真的是出乎意料的年轻和英俊。不知道阿瑞斯商大师有没有婚配？感谢我吧，我帮在场不少客人问出了他们最想问出的问题。”

现场一阵笑声。

阿瑞斯商看向拍卖台。

主持人心中一凛，赶紧转移话题：“当然，我们的重点是大师炼制的空间手镯。现在，就让我们请出这件重宝！”

主持人做出手势。

四名强壮兽人形成四角包围的方阵，护卫着中间一名壮年兽人走出。

壮年兽人郑重其事地捧着一个透明盒子，在四名护卫保护下，走到拍卖台上。

透明盒子中间有一个精致的架子，架子上摆放着一只手镯。

手镯造型……就是很普通的圆形，内外都没有花纹，但外侧表面有一颗颗小粒的镶嵌物。

镶嵌物像是宝石，但没有宝石的亮彩，就那么朴实无华地镶嵌在手镯表面。

在场所有人目光都集中在了这只手镯上。
chunks.englishText:
Fortunately, their choice had been correct, a testament to the auction host's persistence; the man truly understood customer psychology.

The opening lot was successfully won by the Royal City’s most renowned physician. Though he himself was merely a low-ranking noble holding an unpretentious baron title, his grandfather—a count—was still alive, and coupled with his genuinely superb medical skills, the nobility of the Royal City were all willing to afford him a measure of face. Once the price was pushed to three hundred and twenty gold coins, no one else raised their bidding paddle.

The auction house owner was already well-satisfied; this price basically sat right within his psychological expectations.

The auction host spun words like pearls, delivering detailed yet unobtrusive introductions. Propelled by his enthusiastic voice, the auction proceeded smoothly into its middle stages.

Seeing that signs of fatigue were beginning to creep over the guests, with many no longer focusing their attention on the lots, the host glanced toward a specific spot and reached a mutual consensus with the auction house owner through a brief exchange of glances.

The auction house owner gave a slight nod.

*Clap, clap, clap!* The host suddenly struck his hands together forcefully.

The attention of the patrons in the hall was instantly recaptured.

The auction host announced, "My esteemed guests, the surprise you have all been longing for is here! Next up, we shall be auctioning..."

The host deliberately drew out his tone.

Unable to restrain himself, someone in the audience shouted loudly from below, "The spatial bracelet! Hurry up and auction the spatial bracelet!"

A clamor erupted across the hall, eventually culminating in the crowd chanting in unison, "Spatial bracelet! Spatial bracelet!"

With the atmosphere hyped to a peak, the host let out a hearty laugh. "Very well! Our next lot is precisely the spatial storage tool that everyone dreams of possessing!"

"Lot number nineteen: a spatial bracelet, forged by the alchemist Ares Shang. To our profound honor, the alchemy master himself is present right here in the venue today. I believe many of you have already caught sight of him."

Countless heads turned to look toward the very last row.

Ares Shang, meanwhile, was turning his head to look at something, seemingly observing a guest seated nearby.

"Goodness, I must say, this master is truly unexpectedly young and handsome. I wonder if Master Ares Shang is spoken for? Do thank me, everyone—I've just asked the question that many guests present here most wished to have answered."

A wave of laughter rippled through the venue.

Ares Shang turned his gaze toward the auction stage.

A chill ran through the host’s heart, and he hastily steered the conversation back on track. "Of course, our primary focus is the spatial bracelet crafted by the master. Now, let us present this supreme treasure!"

The host made an inviting gesture.

Four stalwart beastmen formed a defensive square, guarding a middle-aged beastman who walked out from the center.

The middle-aged beastman solemnly cradled a transparent box, walking up onto the auction stage under the protection of the four guards.

 resting within the center of the transparent box was an exquisite stand, and resting atop that stand was a single bracelet.

The bracelet's design... was simply a very ordinary circular loop, devoid of any decorative patterns either inside or out, save for a row of small embedded particles studding its outer surface.

The inlays resembled gemstones, yet lacked the radiant brilliance of precious gems, appearing instead unpretentiously embedded along the bracelet’s exterior.

The gazes of every single person present instantly locked onto that bracelet.

chunks.chineseText:
第131章 赚了一万金

“它的造型已经勿需过多言语描述，在场诸位都能看到它极简风格中透露出的高贵和优雅，它的配色极尽原色，尽显自然和古典之风。它的材质更是如此神秘，也许正是因为特殊的材质才会赋予它拥有芥子纳圣山般的神奇……”

拍卖主持人的声音极富感染力，原本造型普通的手镯在他的描述下仿佛变得高大上起来，不但充满了普通人无法理解的设计感，更多出了一层神秘光彩。

就连手镯上不知何故留下的几条不显眼纹路，也被主持人赋予了多重意义，仿佛没有那些纹路，这手镯的设计就不能达到登峰造极的程度。

不帅想到了那些他永远看不懂的抽象主义、后印象主义、超现实主义油画。

看不懂，不懂得欣赏，不妨碍它们价格昂贵。

一只手指戳戳他的手背，勾他的手指，想要和他握手。

不帅用力拍开。这是什么场合，你又扮演的这么一个角色，别挨我！

“就如诸位所见，它不奢华，它不高调，但这正恰恰符合了宝物自晦的特点。”

客人们的呼吸变重。

主持人声音陡然提高：“现在，让我们回归它最亮眼、最无法忽略的特质！没错，就是它的内在，它的容量！这只空间手镯拥有超过十个立方米，接近十二立方米的空间。”

“欢呼吧，为它如此惊人的容量！”

大厅中立即传出一片惊叹和小小喧哗声。

如今兽人世界被众人所知晓的空间储物工具，除了虎王身上那条传言中空间庞大的空间腰带，其他闻名世间的空储的容量绝大多数都是一到三个立方米。听说翼国国主有一只空间戒指，也只不过才十个立方左右的空间容量。

接近十二个立方的容量，足以让在场所有客人疯狂。

拍卖行老板和主持人甚至都在心中可惜，如果阿瑞斯商能采取他们的建议，把这次拍卖会放到“传承分享大会”那段时间再进行，那么来的客人份量更重、拍卖的价格自然也会更高。

主持人再次提高声音：“按照阿瑞斯大师的要求，这只空间手镯的起拍价只有一个金达盾！”

“是的，你们没有听错，如此宝物将从一金开始起拍，而且不设叫价金额要求，哪怕您报价一金一个铜达铢也可以。这就是顶级大师的任性！”

众人再次扭头看向那位任性的大师。

年轻的炼金大师似乎有点没精打采，又像是受了什么委屈，有点恹恹的。

他的身体歪斜着，似乎过于靠近他右边的位置。

可怜他右边位置上的那个倒霉蛋客人，为了避让他，都要缩到门边了。

“诸位，拥有传说级别空间手镯的机会来了。现在，起拍开始！”主持人的说话唤回了众人的注意力。

大厅中先是一片安静。

所有人都没有立刻报价，而是在等待别人先报出一个价格。

没有叫价要求，但谁都知道这只空间手镯不可能以一金一铜达铢的价格成交。

现在就看第一个叫价的人会把这只空间手镯的价格抬到什么程度。

三王子轻哼了一声，他很想用王子身份压迫在场所有人，就叫出一金一铜达铢的价格，只要其他人不敢跟他争抢，他就能用这么低的价格拍下这只空间手镯。

但他心里也清楚，这样做势必会得罪阿瑞斯商。

如果阿瑞斯商只是一个来历不明的外国贵族，他作为虎国王子完全可以不鸟对方。

但对方现在却宣称这只空间手镯是他自己炼制的。得罪一个贵族之子不算什么，但得罪一名能炼制空储的炼金大师，那就很不理智了。

与三王子有同样心理的不少，他们渴望用低价拍下这只空间手镯，但又理智的知道不可能。

眼看没有一个人报价，大王子发出爽朗笑声，在二楼最中间的包间开口：

“看来大家都不知道对如此宝物该报一个怎样的价格，那么就由我先来吧。当然，我报出的价格不是认为这只空间手镯只值这么多，而是……大家都知道我的零花钱并不太多。”

大厅中众人地位够的都笑起来。

大王子笑着举牌：“五百金。”

“五百金！”主持人大声重复：“空间手镯第一次报价，我们可敬的一号包厢客人拿出了他的零花钱五百金。”

“是我的储蓄。不是一次性的零花钱。”大王子又加注一句。

这下笑的声音变多了。

三王子撇嘴，他就不喜欢大王子走这个平易近人路线，堂堂王子却要去讨自己的子民欢心，还装穷，真他么丢份！

“五百金加一个铜达铢。”三王子举牌了。

他报这个价格就是故意恶心大王子，也有点恶心阿瑞斯商的意思。

三王子不喜欢比自己还高调、还肆意妄为的人。

大王子无语，他一直都觉得自家三弟的智商有点问题，正事一件干不了，给人拖后腿找麻烦的混蛋事是一件接一件干得特别欢畅。明明每一件事干得都奇蠢无比，他还觉得自己干得特别精彩。

如果这不是他亲弟弟，还有他们母后护着，他早就把这个脑残弟弟打发到偏远地区，让他和原始兽人互相毒害去了。

原始兽人当然不是真的原始兽人，而是一些从毒雾纪生存下来却不愿进入文明世界，继续搞奴隶制甚至吃兽人的野蛮人。他们也是邪神信徒的发源地。

“六百五十金。”不等主持人报出那个侮辱人的叫价，二王子就抬起了手指。

三王子更不爽。妈的，老大老二都不是东西，就喜欢在他面前彰显优越感！他每次看到这两人，尤其是老二，就特别想上去抽他两巴掌。

但可悲的是，他从小就打不过两个哥哥，哪一个都打不过。

就连他大妹都能随便揍他！

最小的妹妹仗着父母宠爱也可以随便顶撞他，完全不把他当兄长看。

就问他不变态谁变态？

大公主也很想要空间手镯，但她没有立刻报价，她要再等等。

小公主也不知出于什么心理，也没急着喊价。

主持人可不想冷场，连忙喊出：“二号包厢贵客出价六百五十金！这是最新叫价。对于一只空间手镯来说……啊，六百八十金！感谢六号包厢的客人，出价六百八十金！”

六号包厢，宰相家的人。

主持人只叫包间名也是一个很聪明的做法，他尽量模糊了客人们的身份地位，好让大家能放开来叫价，而不用顾忌太多，虽然看面子肯定会有的。

眼看三位王子都已经叫价，其他包间内的贵客和大厅众人也不再犹豫，从试探报价到全身心投入，去争抢去竞价。

这可是有近十二个立方容量的空间手镯！

现场再次变得火热起来，并且火热的气氛还在逐步上升。

“一千五百金！99号客人出价一千五百金，还有其他人要出价吗？”

主持人额头冒出汗水，竞价越来越激烈了。他有预感，一千五百金只是一个坎，接下来恐怕会有一次大跳跃。

主持人的预感成真了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 131: Earning Ten Thousand Gold Pieces (Part 1)

"Its design requires no excessive description; everyone present can see the nobility and elegance revealed within its minimalist style. Its color palette is entirely natural, exuding a rustic and classical charm. Even more mysterious is its material—perhaps it is precisely this unique substance that grants it the magical ability to contain a holy mountain within a mustard seed..."

The auction host's voice possessed a deeply infectious quality. Under his description, the ordinarily styled bracelet seemed to transform into something lofty and sophisticated, imbued not only with a sense of design beyond the comprehension of ordinary people, but also casting a layer of mystical splendor.

Even the few inconspicuous lines left on the bracelet for reasons unknown were endowed with multiple layers of significance by the host, as if without those markings, the bracelet's design could never have reached the pinnacle of perfection.

Bu Shuai thought of those abstract, post-impressionist, and surrealist oil paintings that he could never understand.

Unable to understand them, unable to appreciate them—none of this prevented them from being exorbitantly expensive.

A finger poked the back of his hand, hooking his fingers as if trying to hold his hand.

Bu Shuai slapped it away with force. What kind of occasion is this, and what kind of persona are you playing right now? Don't touch me!

"As you can all see, it is not luxurious, nor is it flamboyant. Yet this precisely matches the characteristic of a supreme treasure concealing its own brilliance."

The patrons' breathing grew heavier.

The host's voice suddenly rose: "Now, let us return to its most dazzling and undeniable trait! That's right—its inner core, its capacity! This spatial bracelet possesses a volume exceeding ten cubic meters, approaching nearly twelve cubic meters."

"Rejoice at such an astonishing capacity!"

A wave of gasps and a low murmur immediately rippled through the grand hall.

Among the spatial storage tools currently known to the Beastman World—aside from the Tiger King's waist belt, which was rumored to possess a massive internal space—the capacities of other renowned spatial storage devices were overwhelmingly between one and three cubic meters. It was said that the ruler of the Winged Kingdom possessed a spatial ring, yet its capacity was only around ten cubic meters.

A capacity close to twelve cubic meters was enough to drive every single guest present mad.

The auction house owner and the host even felt a pang of regret in their hearts. If the Ares Commerce could have followed their suggestion and held this auction during the "Heritage Sharing Conference," then the guests in attendance would have held even greater weight, and the auction price naturally would have been even higher.

The host raised his voice once more: "In accordance with Master Ares's request, the starting bid for this spatial bracelet is merely one golden daric!"

"Yes, you heard that correctly. Such a supreme treasure will start at a mere one gold piece, and there are no minimum bid increments required. Even if you offer one gold and one copper daric, you may do so. Such is the caprice of a top-tier master!"

Everyone turned their heads once again to look at that capricious master.

The young alchemy master seemed somewhat listless, looking as though he had suffered some grievance, appearing rather spiritless and drooping.

His body leaned crookedly, appearing to lean a bit too close to the seat on his right.

Pity the poor, unlucky guest occupying the seat to his right, who had been squeezed all the way against the doorway just to avoid him.

"Ladies and gentlemen, the opportunity to acquire a legendary-tier spatial bracelet has arrived. Now, let the bidding begin!" The host's words recalled everyone's attention.

Silence hung over the great hall for a moment.

No one rushed to bid immediately; everyone was waiting for someone else to throw out the opening price.

There were no minimum bidding requirements, but everyone knew this spatial bracelet could never possibly sell for a single gold and one copper daric.

Now it all depended on how high the very first bidder would push the price of the spatial bracelet.

The Third Prince let out a soft snort. He desperately wanted to use his royal status to suppress everyone present and bid a single gold and one copper daric. As long as the others dared not contend with him, he could acquire this spatial bracelet at such a low price.

Yet, deep down, he also knew that doing so would inevitably offend Ares Commerce.

If Ares Commerce were merely some foreign noble of unknown origin, as the Tiger Kingdom's prince, he could completely ignore them.

However, the other party now claimed this spatial bracelet was crafted by his own hand. Offending the son of a noble was nothing, but offending an alchemy master capable of forging spatial storage devices would be extremely unwise.

Many harbored the same mentality as the Third Prince—they yearned to snap up this spatial bracelet at a low price, yet rational thought told them it was impossible.

Seeing that not a single person was placing a bid, the First Prince let out a hearty laugh, speaking from the central private box on the second floor:

"It seems no one knows what sort of price to offer for such a treasure, so allow me to start. Of course, the price I am calling out does not mean I believe this spatial bracelet is only worth this much, but rather... as everyone knows, my allowance isn't terribly large."

Those of sufficient status in the great hall chuckled.

The First Prince smiled and raised his bidding plaque: "Five hundred gold pieces."

"Five hundred gold pieces!" The host loudly repeated: "The first bid for the spatial bracelet! Our esteemed guest in Private Box Number One has produced his allowance of five hundred gold pieces."

"It's my savings. Not a one-time allowance," the First Prince added by way of clarification.

At this, the sound of laughter grew louder.

The Third Prince curled his lips in disgust. He simply detested the way the First Prince walked this approachable path; a dignified prince trying to win over his own subjects while pretending to be poor—how utterly disgraceful!

"Five hundred gold pieces and one copper daric," the Third Prince raised his plaque.

He called out this price precisely to nauseate the First Prince, and it also carried a hint of intent to vex Ares Commerce.

The Third Prince disliked anyone who was more flamboyant and self-willed than himself.

The First Prince was left speechless. He had always felt that his third younger brother's intelligence was somewhat defective. He couldn't accomplish a single proper task, yet when it came to being a nuisance, dragging people down, and causing trouble, he strung together one joyful blunder after another. Clearly every single thing he did was profoundly idiotic, yet he felt his actions were utterly brilliant.

If this weren't his own flesh-and-blood brother, protected by their Queen Mother, he would have long since banished this brainless younger brother off to some remote frontier region to let him and the primitive beastmen mutually poison each other's minds.

The primitive beastmen were, of course, not true primitive beastmen, but rather barbarians who had survived the Poison Fog Era yet refused to enter civilized society, continuing to practice slavery and even consuming beastmen. They were also the cradle of cultists worshiping evil gods.

"Six hundred and fifty gold pieces." Before the host could announce that insulting bid, the Second Prince raised his finger.

The Third Prince grew even more displeased. Damn it, the eldest and the second were neither of them anything good, always fond of flaunting their superiority in front of him! Every time he laid eyes on those two—especially the second one—he felt an overwhelming urge to walk up and slap them twice across the face.

Yet, pathetically, since childhood he had never been able to beat either of his older brothers—not a single one of them.

Even his eldest sister could casually beat him to a pulp!

His youngest sister, relying on their parents' pampering, could also talk back to him at will, completely failing to treat him like an older brother.

I ask you, if he wasn't psychologically warped, who would be?

The Eldest Princess also greatly desired the spatial bracelet, but she did not bid immediately; she wanted to wait a little longer.

The Youngest Princess, driven by whatever inner thoughts she harbored, was likewise in no rush to shout out a bid.

The host had no desire for dead air, and hurriedly cried out: "The esteemed guest in Private Box Number Two bids six hundred and fifty gold pieces! That is the latest bid. For a spatial bracelet... ah, six hundred and eighty gold pieces! My thanks to the guest in Private Box Number Six, bidding six hundred and eighty gold pieces!"

Private Box Number Six—belonging to the Prime Minister's household.

For the host to address them solely by their box number was also a clever tactic. He deliberately blurred the guests' identities and statuses, allowing everyone to bid freely without excessive restraint—though concerns for face naturally still existed.

Seeing that all three princes had already placed bids, the esteemed guests in the other private boxes and the crowd in the grand hall no longer hesitated, shifting from tentative bidding to wholehearted devotion as they competed and vied for the prize.

This was a spatial bracelet with a capacity of nearly twelve cubic meters!

The scene once again grew heated, and the fiery atmosphere continued to steadily escalate.

"One thousand five hundred gold pieces! Guest Number 99 bids one thousand five hundred gold pieces. Are there any other offers?"

Beads of sweat dotted the host's forehead; the bidding was becoming increasingly fierce. He had a premonition that one thousand five hundred gold pieces was merely a stepping stone, and the next leap forward would likely be a massive one.

The host's premonition came true.

chunks.chineseText:
二楼包厢客人有人举牌。

“三千金！二号包厢客人出价三千金！”主持人的声音极为激动。

很多人都扭头看向二号包厢，就连三王子都特意探出头来，想要对他二哥放两句嘲讽。三千金他也能拿得出来，但绝对会让他肉疼很久。

但二号包厢内对众人微笑示意的却是另一个人，一个容颜俊美到任何人看到他都会失神的雄性兽人。

见是那名俊美的天残出价三千金，很多人都在心中惊讶无比。

他们以为这个突然被二王子当做座上宾的天残，靠的是他的容颜……

没想到这个天残竟然这么有钱。

普通小贵族家里都不一定能拿出五百金的积蓄，三千金绝对是大数字。

有钱还有颜，就是可惜是个天残，但天残能如此富有，还能成为二王子的座上宾，似乎也是一个值得结交的对象？

不帅……什么都没想，因为旁边有人一直骚扰他！

“三千一百金！”大公主举牌了。

主持人深吸气：“四号包厢的贵客出价三千一百金。请问是否还有别的人出价，如果没有……”

大公主极少出来购物，参加拍卖会就更少了。提起大公主，所有人想到的都是她的武力值和她能变身巨兽的天赋。

比起三位王子，虎国权贵们更愿意给大公主面子。不是因为她的继承可能性仅次于大王子，而是她的老师是虎国唯二的大公之一，同时也是军事最高长官的大都督狮域。

他们给大公主面子，变相的就是给大都督狮域面子。

拍卖行也给大都督送了请柬，七号包厢就是给狮域准备的。但狮域大公没来，只派了一名近卫代表自己，而那名近卫是她丈夫弟弟的孩子，也就是她的侄子。

狮域大公没有自己的孩子，能让侄子代替她前来，已经算是给面子的行为。给拍卖行，也是给她丈夫面子。

而狮域大公的这个侄子也很懂事，就把自己当做一尊泥菩萨，只管看戏，绝不叫价任何一个拍卖品。

主持人非常了解王城权贵们的心理，所以他连说话的语气都偏向大公主，想要把叫价停在三千一百金这个数字。

虽然这个报价对于空间手镯低了点，但……成交价再高，他们拍卖行也收不到一个铜达铢的手续费。那又何必得罪大公主呢？

“三千一百金一次，三千一百金第二次，三千一百金第三……”

“三千五百金！”五号包厢举牌。

大公主抿唇，她就知道她这个妹妹会针对她。

“四千金。”大厅内，一名脸上裹着围巾的雄性兽人举牌。

主持人再次深吸气：“61号客人叫价四千金！”

不帅目光转过去，他觉得这个声音有点熟。像是那位寻宝猎人鹰之翼？

隔壁的纨绔少爷又盯着他看，然后顺着他的目光望过去，又转回来。

不帅握紧拳头：别再看了！你不知道现场有多少人在留意你的动静吗？

“五千金！”又有人叫出新的报价。

“六千！”

“八千！”

“九千五！”

眼看报价就要接近一万金大关，不管是拍卖行的人，还是客人都变得更为亢奋。

不帅想揍人。他看到某人的高光时刻了，但他绝不想也跟着高光！

等等，这家伙的脸怎么凑过来了？

他想干什么？！

“九千五一次……一万金！七号包厢贵客出价一万金！”主持人的声音都变得尖锐。

不帅趁着众人被主持人激昂声音吸引的一刹那，一巴掌把那张凑过来的脸推开。

所有人都知道七号包厢客人是谁。

那是虎国另一位大公切斯特的长子，也是唯一的儿子。

和其他兽人不同，切斯特大公特别想要儿子，且他结婚迟，直到两百岁才娶妻，对孩子更有迫切需求。

他和第一任妻子一共生了三个女儿。眼看妻子迟迟没有再怀上身孕，切斯特大公表现得很焦急。

也许是这份焦急给了大公夫人莫大压力，不久，这位大公夫人就病倒了，拖了一年就再也拖不下去。

妻子病逝不到半年，切斯特大公就火速娶了妻子的亲妹妹，在五年内又生了两个女儿。

没多久，他的第二任妻子也病逝了。对外的说法是两姐妹都患有同样的家族疾病，他妻子的家族也默认了。

然后切斯特大公娶了第三位妻子。

他的第三位妻子头一胎也给他生了个女儿，这个女儿非常不幸地没能养活。两年后，年轻的第三任大公夫人终于再次怀孕，这次她幸运地生下了一个雄性兽人。

切斯特大公对这个儿子真正是待之如珠如宝，要什么给什么，把这个儿子养得骄纵无比。

不过这位大公之子据说身体不太好，很少跑出来找事。

但这位不出来则已，一旦露面，那就得所有人都要围着他转。敢让他不爽的，结果都不太好。

就是王子公主，他都不怎么放在眼里。而三位王子和两位公主也不怎么愿意招惹这个切斯特大公的命根子。

不帅对这位不算熟悉，但也见过。

这位公爵之子长得不难看，就是脸色过于苍白，眼皮还发青，头发细软偏黄，兽耳也耷拉着，身体偏瘦弱，看着就不太像健康人。

而兽人世界，病娇一向没有市场。

如果不是有一个大公父亲，这位病歪歪的公爵之子绝对骄纵不起来。

主持人一看是这位出价，心里就想：应该没人再叫价了。

果然，一万金这个报价一出，再加上报价人的身份，整个大厅都变得安静下来。

“一万金一次，一万金两次，一万金三次！”

当！主持人重重敲下锤子，表示这次拍卖成交。

“恭喜七号包厢的贵客，您获得了举世少有的珍宝，一只内容量接近十二立方的空间手镯！”
chunks.englishText:
CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第131章 赚了一万金 (Part 2)):
A guest in a second-floor private box raised a bidding plaque.

"Three thousand gold pieces! The guest in Private Box Number Two bids three thousand gold pieces!" The host's voice was exceedingly excited.

Many people turned their heads to look toward Private Box Number Two. Even the Third Prince deliberately poked his head out, wanting to toss a few taunts at his second brother. Three thousand gold pieces was a sum he could pull together, but it would undoubtedly cause him a deep, agonizing ache in his wallet.

However, the person smiling and signaling to the crowd from within Private Box Number Two was someone else entirely—a male beastman whose looks were so strikingly handsome that anyone who laid eyes on him would momentarily lose their wits.

Seeing that it was this handsome, disabled outcast who had bid three thousand gold pieces, countless people felt utterly astonished in their hearts.

They had assumed that this outcast, who had suddenly been elevated to an honored guest by the Second Prince, relied entirely on his looks...

Never had they imagined that this disabled outcast was actually so wealthy.

Ordinary lesser noble families might not even be able to scrape together five hundred gold pieces in savings, making three thousand gold pieces an absolute astronomical figure.

Wealthy and handsome, it was only a pity he was a disabled outcast. Yet for an outcast to be this unimaginably wealthy and become an honored guest of the Second Prince—he seemed to be a person worth cultivating ties with, no?

Bu Shuai... thought of absolutely nothing, because someone beside him kept harassing him!

"Three thousand one hundred gold pieces!" The Eldest Princess raised her plaque.

The host drew a sharp breath: "The esteemed guest of Private Box Number Four bids three thousand one hundred gold pieces. Might there be anyone else bidding? If not..."

The Eldest Princess rarely went shopping, and attended auctions even less frequently. Whenever the Eldest Princess was mentioned, everyone immediately thought of her combat prowess and her innate talent to transform into a colossal beast.

Compared to the three princes, the high nobility of the Tiger Kingdom were far more willing to give face to the Eldest Princess. This was not because her likelihood of succession was second only to the First Prince, but because her mentor was none other than the Grand Duke Shi Yu, one of the only two Grand Dukes in the Tiger Kingdom, who concurrently served as the Supreme Military Commander and Grand Governor.

Granting face to the Eldest Princess was, by extension, granting face to Grand Duke Shi Yu.

The auction house had also dispatched an invitation to Grand Duke Shi Yu, and Private Box Number Seven had been prepared specifically for her. However, Grand Duke Shi Yu had not come; she merely dispatched a member of her personal guard to represent her, and that guard happened to be the child of her husband's younger brother—her own nephew.

Grand Duke Shi Yu had no children of her own, so sending a nephew to attend in her stead was already considered a gesture of giving face—both to the auction house and to her husband.

Moreover, Grand Duke Shi Yu's nephew was quite sensible. He treated himself like a clay bodhisattva carved of stone, solely watching the show while steadfastly refusing to place a bid on a single auction item.

The host possessed a deep understanding of the psychology held by the royal capital's elite, which was why even his tone of voice leaned favorably toward the Eldest Princess, hoping to halt the bidding right there at the figure of three thousand one hundred gold pieces.

Although this bid was slightly on the low side for a spatial bracelet, but... no matter how high the final transaction price climbed, their auction house wouldn't receive a single copper daric more in commission fees. Why bother offending the Eldest Princess over that?

"Three thousand one hundred gold pieces, going once! Three thousand one hundred gold pieces, going twice! Three thousand one hundred gold..."

"Three thousand five hundred gold pieces!" Private Box Number Five raised its plaque.

The Eldest Princess pressed her lips into a thin line; she had known her younger sister would target her.

"Four thousand gold pieces." Inside the grand hall, a male beastman wrapped in a scarf raised his plaque.

The host drew another sharp breath: "Guest Number 61 bids four thousand gold pieces!"

Bu Shuai shifted his gaze over. He found that voice rather familiar. Could it be that treasure hunter, Eagle's Wing?

The profligate young master next to him stared at him once more, then followed his line of sight across the room before turning his gaze back.

Bu Shuai clenched his fists: Stop looking! Don't you realize how many people at this venue are paying attention to your every move?

"Five thousand gold pieces!" Someone else called out a new bid.

"Six thousand!"

"Eight thousand!"

"Nine thousand five hundred!"

Seeing that the bidding was about to breach the milestone mark of ten thousand gold pieces, both the staff of the auction house and the patrons grew increasingly fervent.

Bu Shuai wanted to beat someone up. He had just witnessed someone else's moment in the spotlight, but he had zero desire to share that limelight!

Wait, why is this guy's face leaning closer?

What on earth is he trying to do?!

"Nine thousand five hundred, going once... Ten thousand gold pieces! The esteemed guest in Private Box Number Seven bids ten thousand gold pieces!" The host's voice turned piercingly sharp.

Taking advantage of the moment when everyone was captivated by the host's impassioned cry, Bu Shuai shoved that leaning face away with a single sweep of his hand.

Everyone present knew precisely who the guest in Private Box Number Seven was.

That was the eldest son—and the sole son—of Chester, the other Grand Duke of the Tiger Kingdom.

Unlike other beastmen, Grand Duke Chester harbored an extraordinary obsession with having a son. Furthermore, he married late, taking a wife only when he reached two hundred years of age, which only intensified his desperate yearning for an offspring.

He and his first wife produced a total of three daughters. Seeing that his wife failed to conceive again for a prolonged period, Grand Duke Chester displayed immense anxiety.

Perhaps this anxiety placed immense pressure upon the Grand Duchess, for not long after, she fell gravely ill, lingering for a year before finally succumbing.

Less than half a year after his wife's passing, Grand Duke Chester precipitously married his late wife's younger sister, fathering two more daughters within five years.

Before long, his second wife also passed away. The official explanation circulated to the outside world was that both sisters suffered from the same hereditary illness, a narrative tacitly accepted by his late wife's clan.

Following that, Grand Duke Chester married a third wife.

On her very first pregnancy, his third wife also bore him a daughter, though tragically, this child did not survive. Two years later, the young third Grand Duchess finally conceived once more, and this time, she was blessed with a male beastman.

Grand Duke Chester truly cherished this son like a precious pearl in the palm of his hand, granting him whatever he desired and spoiling this boy to a lawless degree.

However, this young duke's son was rumored to be in frail health and rarely ventured out to stir up trouble.

Yet when this young lord did emerge, once he showed his face, everyone had better revolve around him. Those who dared to displease him invariably met with unpleasant consequences.

Even princes and princesses were individuals he scarcely paid any mind to. As for the three princes and two princesses, none of them particularly wished to provoke this precious lifeblood of Grand Duke Chester.

Bu Shuai was not particularly familiar with him, but he had seen him before.

This duke's son was not unattractive, save for an excessively pale complexion, bluish eyelids, fine, soft, yellowish hair, and drooping beast ears. His physique leaned toward the frail and slender side, giving him the appearance of anything but a healthy individual.

In the Beastman World, sickly pampered youths had never found much of a market.

If not for his Grand Duke father, this sickly young lord would never have possessed the capital to act so domineeringly.

As soon as the host saw who had placed the bid, a thought arose in his mind: surely no one else would dare bid against him.

Sure enough, the moment the bid of ten thousand gold pieces was spoken, coupled with the identity of the bidder, the entire grand hall plunged into absolute silence.

"Ten thousand gold pieces, going once! Ten thousand gold pieces, going twice! Ten thousand gold pieces, going thrice!"

*Clang!* The host brought his gavel down heavily, signaling that the auction had concluded.

"Congratulations to the esteemed guest in Private Box Number Seven! You have acquired a rare treasure matched by none in this world—a spatial bracelet with an internal capacity approaching nearly twelve cubic meters!"

chunks.chineseText:
第132章 高调的追求

空间手镯当即被护送至七号包厢。

同时一万金也送到了阿瑞斯商面前。

这是一张骨卡，整个面值就是一万金，可以在王城国家银行进行现金兑换。

说来也有意思，虎国的国家银行并没有遍布整个虎国，只有王城有。其他诸如黑森林城和摩罗城之类的大城镇也只有地方钱庄。

地方钱庄都认国家银行开出来的钱卡，国家银行却不认地方钱庄的储蓄票。

为此想要地方钱庄给出国家银行认可的钱卡，客户得付出一定兑换手续费。

阿瑞斯商接过钱卡，转手就往右边座位的兽人手上塞，“给你当零花钱。”

不帅瞪大眼睛：他就知道这家伙会搞事！

亲自来送钱卡的拍卖行大掌柜愕然，下意识看向戴着兜帽的虎不帅。

这是谁？

竟然让阿瑞斯商拿一万金给他当零花钱！

感觉到四面八方投射来的目光，不帅来不及多想对方用意，下意识打开阿瑞斯商的手掌，腾地起身，转身就往旁边的员工用门快步走去。

“喂，你叫什么名字？别走，你是不喜欢金达盾吗？那空间戒指你喜欢吗？等等！”阿瑞斯商起身，立即就要追上去。

附近的客人和拍卖行的员工们：“……”

大掌柜尴尬地喊住阿瑞斯商：“大师，有几位贵客想要和您见面，谈谈关于定制空储的事。”

“没空。”阿瑞斯商不耐烦，挥骨杖示意大掌柜让开。

“价钱好说！”大掌柜迅速接上一句，并捧出了几张制作或精美奢华或庄重古派的请柬。

“滚开！”阿瑞斯商看都没看，用骨杖拨开大掌柜，跟在那个兜帽兽人屁股后面就追了出去。

现场看到这一幕的所有人：“……”

拍卖会还在继续，但二楼的贵客们全都走光了。

空间手镯有了主人，这些贵客就不打算再待下去。原本他们还托拍卖行给阿瑞斯商送了请柬，希望借用拍卖行的会客室进行一次会面，主要就是想要当面跟阿瑞斯商定制空储，至少也能结交一番。

没想到阿瑞斯商那么不给面子，竟然追着一个兽人就跑出去了，那迫不及待和屁颠颠的模样跟看到什么绝世美人一样。

真绝世美人的天残谷主和同样俊美无匹的二王子：“……”

不用说，那名戴着兜帽的兽人引起了在场绝大多数人的好奇。

很多人都开始打听那名兜帽兽人的来历。

大家的心都已经不在拍卖会上。

随着二楼贵客离去，大厅中某些客人也逐渐退场。

勉强又拍了两个拍品，其中一个还流拍了，拍卖主持人当机立断地宣布本次拍卖会到此结束。

这次拍卖会对于奢梦拍卖行来说算圆满也算有遗憾，但话题性却是足够了，也方便奢梦拍卖行趁此热度再度酝酿。

所有人都对即将到来的全兽人大陆传承分享大会充满期待，每个人都想趁着这个大会能狠狠吃上一波红利。

奢梦拍卖行能联系到阿瑞斯商，让对方把空间手镯放到他们拍卖行拍卖，这对于在大会期间宣扬他们的名气非常有利。

不说别的，就说当阿瑞斯商这个空间储物炼制大师的名头传遍整个兽人大陆时，他们奢梦拍卖行必然也会在这些传言中占住一个位置。

如果其他国家的领袖和权贵富豪想要在虎国王城拍买或拍卖什么宝贝，第一个考虑的必然会是奢梦拍卖行。而这就是奢梦拍卖行想要的效果。

但现在王城话题性最大的并不是奢梦拍卖行和它拍出的空间手镯，他们变成了故事背景的一部分，现在王城人最好奇提起最多的就是那个被阿瑞斯商追出拍卖行的兜帽兽人。

那可是让阿瑞斯商当场就要送出一万金达盾的人！

阿瑞斯商甚至亲口问出他要不要空间戒指！

可那个人却跑了。

谁不喜欢一夜暴富？

谁不想要飞上枝头变凤凰？

这种平民兽人遇见权贵子弟，被一见钟情疯狂追求的事最让兽人们喜闻乐见，无论雄性雌性都喜欢。

王城酒馆、旅店、街头巷尾，到处都有人在聊这件事，无数人都在羡慕那个兜帽兽人，梦想自己当时如果能坐在阿瑞斯商身边，说不定也会被对方看上。

很多人都跑去询问奢梦拍卖行，威逼利诱各种手段使尽，想要知道奢梦拍卖行把那张请柬给了谁。

但奢梦拍卖行也很苦恼，他们是会给身份贵重者以及以往的大客户以及王城新贵等人派送邀请函，但也有一部分邀请函他们送给了合作商。

合作商会根据他们的需要送人。

大厅中那些位置靠后的普通席位就是给这些人的，这些人大多数是某些小家族小官员的子女或本人，过来开开眼界或试图结交某些人。

拍卖会特意安排的职业抬价人和气氛组也会安排在那里。

这些普通席位设置有编号，但邀请函上没有啊，来的普通客人可以在后面几排随便坐。

这要他们怎么锁定那名兜帽客人的身份？

好在王城人也没有抓心挠肺太久，那名兜帽客人的身份很快就暴露出来。

因为阿瑞斯商的行为真的太高调了，看上谁完全不加遮掩。

他天天往特别调查局总局跑，每次去都要求见一个人，那就是他们的一级特别调查官拉斐尔郎沐。

每次去他都会带上礼物。

第一天是五箱金达盾，一箱两千。

阿瑞斯商兑现了自己的诺言，他真的把一万金兑换出来，送来给拉斐尔郎沐当零花钱。

拉斐尔郎沐当然不可能要。

阿瑞斯商竟然就把这一万金往特调局里一扔，人就走了。

总局长手一挥：“都给我抬去给拉斐尔郎沐！”

第二天，阿瑞斯商又来了。

这次他手捧一枚空间戒指，在特调局大门口喊：“阿沐，你见见我啊，上次我炼制空间储物工具，多做了几个，这枚空间戒指的空间最大，送给你玩啊。”

在附近偷看偷听的人：“……”呜呜呜！羡慕死我了！小手绢都要咬穿了。

那些去过拍卖会没有拍到空间手镯的贵客们：妈的！你多做了几个你倒是拿出来卖啊！送什么送！不知道舔狗舔狗舔到最后一无所有吗！

拉斐尔郎沐依旧不肯露面。

总局长看到丢在自己桌子上的空间戒指，不知用了多大的毅力才压制住那份想要私吞的贪婪心，心痛地一挥手，喊人……不，还是他自己送吧！

他怕特调局其他员工没有他这么强的意志力。

第三天，阿瑞斯商手推一整车的粮食，后面还跟了满满两大车。宣称支援特调局。

第四天，阿瑞斯商骑着一只巨虫，耀武扬威从自己的空储里抛出一头巨大的野兽，表示这些肉都是给拉斐尔郎沐加餐用的。

第五天……

拉斐尔郎沐死活不肯见阿瑞斯商，阿瑞斯商也不知得了谁的指点，不再乱送东西，而是胡搅蛮缠说自己有邪神信徒的线索。

特调局的人只好接待他，但阿瑞斯商只想要拉斐尔郎沐负责自己的案子。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 132: High-Profile Pursuit

The spatial bracelet was immediately escorted to Box Seven.

At the same time, the ten thousand gold coins were delivered to Ares Shang.

This was a bone card with a face value of exactly ten thousand gold coins, redeemable for cash at the Royal National Bank.

Come to think of it, the Tiger Kingdom's National Bank did not have branches all over the Tiger Kingdom; it was only located in the Royal Capital. Other major towns like Black Forest City and Moro City only had local pawnshops and private banks.

While local banks accepted money cards issued by the National Bank, the National Bank did not honor savings notes from local banks.

Because of this, if a customer wanted a local bank to issue a money card recognized by the National Bank, they had to pay a certain exchange fee.

Ares Shang took the money card and immediately shoved it into the hands of the beastman sitting to his right, saying, "Here, take this as your pocket money."

Bu Shuai's eyes widened: He just *knew* this guy was going to stir up trouble!

The chief auctioneer, who had personally delivered the money card, was dumbfounded and instinctively looked toward the hooded Hu Bushuai.

Who was this?

To actually have Ares Shang hand him ten thousand gold coins as casual pocket money!

Feeling the gazes converging from all directions, Bu Shuai didn't have time to dwell on the other man's intentions. He instinctively slapped away Ares Shang's hand, sprang up from his seat, spun around, and briskly walked toward the nearby staff exit.

"Hey, what's your name? Don't leave! Do you not like Gold Darics? What about a spatial ring, do you like those? Wait!" Ares Shang stood up and immediately made to chase after him.

Nearby guests and auction house staff: "……"

The chief auctioneer awkwardly called out to stop Ares Shang: "Master, several distinguished guests wish to meet with you to discuss customizing spatial storage items."

"No time." Ares Shang said impatiently, waving his bone staff to signal the chief auctioneer to move aside.

"The price is negotiable!" the chief auctioneer quickly followed up, holding out several invitations crafted with exquisite luxury or solemn antique styles.

"Get lost!" Ares Shang didn't even glance at them, brushed the chief auctioneer aside with his bone staff, and bolted out in hot pursuit right behind that hooded beastman.

Everyone present who witnessed this scene: "……"

The auction was still ongoing, but the distinguished guests on the second floor had all cleared out.

Now that the spatial bracelet had an owner, these wealthy patrons had no intention of staying any longer. Originally, they had even entrusted the auction house to send invitations to Ares Shang, hoping to use the auction house's reception room for a meeting primarily to commission custom spatial storage directly from Ares Shang, or at the very least, to forge some connections.

Who would have thought Ares Shang would be so utterly devoid of giving face, sprinting out after a beastman instead? The eager, tail-wagging look on his face was as if he had laid eyes upon some peerless beauty.

The truly peerless beauty—the Valley Master of Heavenly Remnant—along with the equally peerless and handsome Second Prince: "……"

Needless to say, that hooded beastman had instantly piqued the curiosity of the vast majority of people present.

Many people began inquiring about the origins of that hooded beastman.

No one's heart was in the auction anymore.

Following the departure of the second-floor VIPs, certain guests in the main hall also gradually filtered out.

After barely managing to auction off two more lots—one of which even failed to receive a single bid—the auctioneer decisively announced that the current auction was hereby concluded.

For the Luxury Dream Auction House, this auction could be considered both a success and a disappointment, but it had generated more than enough buzz, making it convenient for Luxury Dream to capitalize on the momentum and brew further hype.

Everyone was full of anticipation for the upcoming All-Beastman Continent Heritage Sharing Convention, and everyone wanted to capitalize heavily on the dividends of this grand event.

Being able to contact Ares Shang and have him place his spatial bracelet in their auction was immensely beneficial for promoting their reputation during the convention.

To put it mildly, once the reputation of Ares Shang as a grandmaster of spatial storage refining spread across the entire Beastman Continent, the Luxury Dream Auction House would inevitably secure a prominent spot amidst those rumors.

If leaders, dignitaries, and wealthy tycoons from other countries wanted to buy or sell any treasures in the Tiger Kingdom's Royal Capital, their very first consideration would undoubtedly be the Luxury Dream Auction House. And that was precisely the effect Luxury Dream wanted.

However, the hottest topic in the Royal Capital right now wasn't Luxury Dream Auction House or the spatial bracelet it had auctioned off; they had merely become part of the background story. What the people of the Royal Capital were most curious about and talking about the most right now was that hooded beastman who had been chased out of the auction by Ares Shang.

That was a person whom Ares Shang had offered ten thousand Gold Darics to on the spot!

Ares Shang had even asked him in person if he wanted a spatial ring!

Yet that person had simply fled.

Who doesn't love getting rich overnight?

Who doesn't want to soar up the branches to become a phoenix?

This kind of commoner beastman running into a young scion of nobility, sparking love at first sight and a frantic pursuit, was the kind of romance beastmen loved to see most—favorites of both males and females alike.

In the taverns, inns, and alleys of the Royal Capital, everyone was talking about this matter. Countless people were filled with envy toward that hooded beastman, dreaming that if they had been sitting beside Ares Shang back then, they might have caught his eye as well.

Many people rushed to inquire with the Luxury Dream Auction House, pulling strings and using various coercive and enticing methods just to find out to whom the auction house had given that invitation.

Yet the Luxury Dream Auction House was equally distressed. While they did send invitations to people of high status, past major clients, and newly rising nobles in the royal capital, a portion of the invitations had also been distributed to their business partners.

The partners would distribute them to people according to their own needs.

The ordinary seats located toward the back of the main hall were designated for these people. Most of these individuals were the children or personal associates of minor families and low-ranking officials, who came just to broaden their horizons or attempt to network with someone.

The professional price-botherers and atmosphere-boosters specially arranged by the auction house were also seated there.

These ordinary seats were numbered, but the invitation letters themselves weren't. The ordinary guests who came could sit casually in the back few rows.

How on earth were they supposed to lock down the identity of that hooded guest?

Fortunately, the people of the Royal Capital didn't have to stay on tenterhooks for too long; the identity of that hooded guest was soon exposed.

Because Ares Shang's behavior was simply too high-profile—he made no effort whatsoever to conceal whom he had taken a fancy to.

Every single day, he would run over to the Special Investigation Bureau Headquarters, demanding to see one specific person every time he went: their Level-One Special Investigator, Rafael Langmu.

Every time he went, he would bring gifts.

On the first day, it was five chests of Gold Darics, with two thousand per chest.

Ares Shang made good on his promise; he really did exchange those ten thousand gold coins and brought them to Rafael Langmu as pocket money.

Naturally, there was no way Rafael Langmu would accept them.

Ares Shang simply dumped those ten thousand gold coins right inside the Special Investigation Bureau and walked away.

The Chief of the Bureau waved a hand: "Carry all of it over to Rafael Langmu!"

On the second day, Ares Shang came again.

This time, he was holding a spatial ring in the palm of his hand, shouting at the entrance of the Investigation Bureau: "A-Mu, won't you see me? Last time I refined spatial storage tools, I made a few extra. This spatial ring has the largest space, I'm giving it to you to play with."

Onlookers and eavesdroppers nearby: "……" Wuwuwu! I'm dying of envy! I'm about to chew through my little handkerchief!

Those wealthy VIPs who had gone to the auction and failed to secure a spatial bracelet: Damn it! If you made a few extra, why didn't you put them up for sale instead! Giving them away like this! Don't you know that a simp always ends up with nothing in the end!

Rafael Langmu still stubbornly refused to show his face.

When the Chief of the Bureau looked at the spatial ring tossed onto his desk, he had to summon an unknown amount of sheer willpower to suppress the greedy urge to embezzle it. With a heart-wrenching wave of his hand, he called someone over—no, better yet, he'd deliver it himself!

He was afraid the other employees of the Investigation Bureau didn't have willpower as strong as his.

On the third day, Ares Shang pushed an entire cartload of grain, followed by two full carts behind it, announcing it as aid to the Special Investigation Bureau.

On the fourth day, Ares Shang rode a giant insect, swaggeringly tossing a massive beast carcass out of his own spatial storage, proclaiming that all this meat was for Rafael Langmu to supplement his meals.

On the fifth day……

Rafael Langmu stubbornly refused to see Ares Shang no matter what. Guided by who-knows-who, Ares Shang stopped sending random items and instead began pestering them under the pretense that he had leads on Evil God cultists.

The people at the Investigation Bureau had no choice but to receive him, but Ares Shang insisted that only Rafael Langmu take charge of his case.

chunks.chineseText:
拉斐尔郎沐借口工作繁忙就是不见阿瑞斯商。

阿瑞斯商就开始搞事了。对，前面送东西对他来说就不算搞事。

他也不知道从哪里弄来的线索，竟然连续挑了几个邪神信徒的盘据地。

那些盘据地有的在红灯区，有的在贫民区，有的竟然和王城官员有关联。

如果只是胡闹也就罢了，顶多王城治安官虎着脸去找阿瑞斯商，给他定个扰乱治安之类的罪名。

但阿瑞斯商找出的那几个据点竟然真的都和邪神信徒有关，不但有物证，更有人证。

人证就是那些个看着就不像是正常人的邪神信徒。

阿瑞斯商还从这几个地方搜索出虫毒，并在那个涉事官员位于城外的农庄中抓住了关金娱乐场老板本人以及几个关金娱乐的高层。

好嘛，阿瑞斯商抓着这些人证招摇过市，一路亲自押送到特别调查局大门口。

特调局能怎么办？

当然只能接待阿瑞斯商和收押他送来的这些嫌疑犯了。

拉斐尔郎沐在总局长的强烈要求下，也不得不出来和阿瑞斯商打交道。

因为总局长说了：这个阿瑞斯商就不是个低调的性子，他为了达成目的绝对会折腾得整个王城都不安宁。

虽然阿瑞斯商帮忙找出几个邪神信徒的据点对王城对虎国都是好事，可是在传承大会即将召开的节骨点，所有人都希望求稳，而不是看到王城烟火四起，天天都在玩纨绔贵公子踹门放火抓邪神信徒的把戏。

最可怕的是，阿瑞斯商的性格、外表、家世和个人才能让他在王城快速聚集了一帮粉丝。

这些粉丝的身份最差都是某个官员或某个富商的子女，这些权贵家的年轻兽人全都怀着一颗叛逆的心，但他们要么自己做不到阿瑞斯商的程度，要么不敢，日常都被憋坏了，在看到阿瑞斯商这样的人物出现后，自然而然就被吸引。

如果阿瑞斯商只是做一些纨绔常做的混账事，那也吸引不了这么多身份不凡的粉丝。

明明他做事高调又肆意妄为，可他做的事却又让民众忍不住叫好。

无论是在郊外庄园斩杀虫毒感染者，还是搞出空间手镯，之后又去单挑邪神信徒据点，等等诸般事宜都让兽人们大为敬佩。

于是不少权贵子弟被吸引，并自然而然开始模仿偶像做事，看到阿瑞斯商去找邪神信徒麻烦，这些权贵子弟竟然也兴冲冲地搞起秘密结社，利用他们的家世和家族人脉，开始到处查找邪神信徒的相关线索，经过初步分析总结后，再屁颠颠地送去给阿瑞斯商。

王城很多心中有鬼的人都头疼了。

那些纨绔子弟平时不干正事，单论个人力量也不算什么，但他们会合在一起，把力量聚拢起来以后，那就非常可怕了！

也许这些权贵子弟有不少都是草包，但并不是人人都是草包，只要有一两个有才能的人，把他们组织起来，再帮助他们分析和理清线索，再加上草包身边也是有些可用人手的，这么一汇总，那还得了？

何况他们还把汇总的情报送到了阿瑞斯商处。

如果说生在长在王城的权贵子弟在办某些事查某些人时还有所顾忌，但阿瑞斯商这个外来的纨绔少爷压根不讲江湖规矩，也不信奉过江龙不压地头蛇那一套，只要他拿到线索，他就敢上门去找，才不管你背后有什么靠山。

阿瑞斯商如果是个弱渣打不过别人也就算了，但这家伙是真强啊，打到现在就没输过！

头疼的人当然要找自己的靠山哭诉。

靠山们被烦得头疼，当然要去找相关者的家中长辈。

就这么一层推一层，层层压力就堆积到特调局总局长头上了。

总局长也没办法，只能把拉斐尔郎沐拉出来挡剑。

总之，你招惹来的，你解决！
chunks.englishText:
Rafael Langmu used the excuse of a heavy workload to persistently avoid seeing Ares Shang.

So Ares Shang started stirring up trouble. Yes, delivering gifts earlier didn't even count as making trouble in his book.

Who knows where he dug up his leads, but he successively raided several strongholds of Evil God cultists.

Some of those dens were located in the red-light district, some in the slums, and some were even connected to officials in the Royal Capital.

If it were just mere mischief, that would be one thing. At worst, the Royal Capital's chief of security would pull a long face and go find Ares Shang to slap him with a charge like disturbing the peace.

However, the hideouts rooted out by Ares Shang actually turned out to be genuinely tied to Evil God cultists—not only were there physical evidence, but there were human witnesses as well.

Those human witnesses were precisely those Evil God cultists who looked anything but normal.

Ares Shang even dug up insect poison from these locations and apprehended the owner of the Guan Jin Entertainment Club himself, along with several high-ranking executives of Guan Jin Entertainment, right out of the implicated official's suburban manor.

Well, what a sight! Ares Shang paraded these witnesses through the streets in broad daylight, personally escorting them all the way to the front gates of the Special Investigation Bureau.

What could the Investigation Bureau do?

Naturally, they could only receive Ares Shang and take these suspects into custody.

At the strong urging of the Bureau Chief, Rafael Langmu had no choice but to come out and deal with Ares Shang.

Because the Bureau Chief had said: This Ares Shang is simply not a low-profile character. To achieve his goal, he will undoubtedly flip the entire Royal Capital upside down until there's no peace left.

Although Ares Shang helping to root out several Evil God cultist dens was a good thing for both the Royal Capital and the Tiger Kingdom, at this critical juncture right before the Heritage Convention, everyone wanted stability—not seeing the Royal Capital go up in flames of chaos every single day, playing out the trope of an arrogant, wealthy young scion kicking down doors, setting fires, and arresting Evil God cultists.

What was most terrifying was that Ares Shang's personality, appearance, family background, and personal talents allowed him to rapidly amass a following of fans within the Royal Capital.

At the very least, these fans were children of officials or wealthy merchants. These young beastmen from influential families all harbored rebellious streaks in their hearts, but either they lacked the capability to act like Ares Shang, or they didn't have the guts, and they were cooped up in their daily lives. The moment they saw a figure like Ares Shang appear, they were naturally and irresistibly drawn to him.

If Ares Shang merely engaged in the kind of jerkish antics typical of pampered rich kids, he wouldn't have been able to attract so many extraordinary fans.

Clearly, his actions were high-profile and flagrantly lawless, yet the things he actually did left the common folk unable to help themselves from cheering in applause.

Whether it was slaying insect-poison-infected individuals in a suburban manor, creating spatial bracelets, or subsequently going solo to raid Evil God cultist dens, all these feats filled the beastmen with immense admiration.

Thus, quite a few young scions of nobility were drawn in, naturally beginning to imitate their idol's actions. Seeing Ares Shang go looking for trouble with Evil God cultists, these young aristocrats actually excitedly banded together to form secret societies, utilizing their family backgrounds and familial connections to hunt down clues related to Evil God cultists everywhere. After preliminary analysis and summarization, they would eagerly deliver the intel straight to Ares Shang.

Many people with guilty consciences in the Royal Capital were developing splitting headaches.

Those pampered young masters usually didn't do any honest work, and in terms of individual strength, they weren't much to write home about. But when they gathered together and pooled their collective strength, that became terrifying indeed!

Perhaps quite a few of these young nobles were good-for-nothings, but not *everyone* was useless. As long as there were one or two capable individuals among them to organize the rest, help them analyze and sort out clues, coupled with the usable manpower already at the disposal of these pampered youths, once everything was compiled like that—how could it *not* be explosive?

To top it all off, they even delivered the compiled intelligence straight to Ares Shang.

If born-and-raised aristocratic youths of the Royal Capital still had certain misgivings when handling certain matters or investigating certain people, Ares Shang—this foreign, rebellious young master—didn't play by the Jianghu rules at all, nor did he subscribe to the notion that a foreign dragon shouldn't try to crush a local snake. The moment he got a lead, he dared to show up on their doorstep, completely disregarding whatever backing you had behind your back.

If Ares Shang were a total weakling who couldn't beat anyone, that would be one thing; but this guy was genuinely overpowered, and up until now, he had never lost a single fight!

Naturally, the people with headaches had to go cry to their backers.
