Yet Remir found it difficult to speak his mind at this moment, as he did not wish the Tiger King to see through his eagerness.

The Tiger King pondered for a moment. "The Heritage Sharing Assembly is about to commence, and the security of the assembly is of the utmost importance. This time, security will be jointly undertaken by the City Guard and the Royal Guards. You shall temporarily follow the Commander of the Royal Guards, Baron Clement, and first handle the security work for this assembly. I will have him pile a bit more responsibility on your shoulders, so you must perform diligently."

Initially, Remir had no desire for this temporary job, but upon second thought, this assignment would allow him to make a prominent impression before the leaders and VIPs of the entire Beastman Continent. Suddenly, the position felt exceptionally alluring.

Remir agreed, stating that he would defer entirely to the Tiger King's arrangements.

The Tiger King nodded with apparent satisfaction and dismissed Remir to rest.

The guard on rotation entered as Remir departed.

That guard happened to be a gnu.

The Tiger King instructed the gnu to summon the Commander of the Royal Guards, Baron Clement.

There was no one else left in the study, save for the Tiger King alone.

He had even shooed away the servants.

With guards stationed outside the study as well, there was no need to worry about the Tiger King's safety.

A sigh escaped the Tiger King within the quiet study.

Truth be told, he had wanted to hear Remir say that he wished to stay by his side to continue observing and learning.

Remir was still far too green!

He had mentioned that Raphael and Remir were the same age, and that Raphael could already stand on his own, but he had never said that Remir could do the same.

Moreover, Raphael had been forced to leave the Royal City at the time; as Raphael grew older and his personal abilities became increasingly apparent, the Queen's tolerance toward him had grown progressively thinner.

He had had no choice but to send Raphael away.

Yet Remir's background was so secure that the Queen had paid no heed to him as a lowly guard, nor had anyone else.

He could have entirely remained by his side to study properly for a period, plotting other paths only when the time was ripe.

However, Remir had been far too eager, and his intentions were so nakedly exposed that even the Tiger King felt the boy truly did not know how to conceal himself.

Very well, perhaps Remir was more inclined to seek trials under the Grand Marshal, Shiyun, and develop his future in the military.

Yet Shiyun was a haughty man who held everyone else in disdain; whether Remir could thrive under him was hard to say. Especially since the Eldest Princess was also by Shiyun's side.

The City Guard was different. While it belonged to the military department, it remained independent from it. The City Guard could be said to be the final line of defense for the Royal City, as well as the army most trusted by the Tiger King.

Coincidentally, Elder Count Langzhen was the former commander of the City Guard. As Langzhen's grandson, Remir entering the City Guard—if not entirely a matter of course—would certainly afford him a great deal of preferential care.

Indeed, Remir had made a choice highly advantageous to himself.

However! The Tiger King had never once entertained the thought of handing the City Guard over to an illegitimate son.

Even if he favored this child ever so much, it was utterly impossible.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第137章 老伯爵生气了 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第137章 老伯爵生气了

不帅刚从王宫出来就看到一辆标有家徽的兽车停在王宫门口。

没有什么大排场，就一辆车，一个仆从。

但只要认识那家徽的人，谁也不敢小瞧这辆兽车的乘坐者。

这里当然不是王宫正门口，而是专门给官员和宫廷工作人员进出的专用通道。

驾车的兽人打开车门。

车厢里跳出一名头发花白却脊背挺直的老兽人。

兽人的青壮期很长，一旦出现老态就表示已经进入末年，很多兽人一出现老态就会自觉辞职、退位，从一线岗位退下来。

不帅见过这位老兽人。前城卫军统领，前代虎王和当代虎王都器重和信任的郎侦老伯爵。

因为老伯爵的姓名，不帅对这位老伯爵就多了一丝关注。

郎侦老伯爵也看到了不帅。

不帅右拳放到胸口，点头施礼。

郎侦老伯爵目光从他脸上瞟过，也轻轻点头回了一礼。

虽然没有说话，但对于这些年越活越孤僻的老伯爵来说，已经算是好态度。

通常老伯爵见到王子公主都没一个好脸色。

王子公主们也拿这个孤僻老头没办法，他对自己唯一的亲外孙都不亲近，你还指望他对其他人能有好脸色吗？

想拿他外孙威胁他？逼迫他向你低头？那你除非准备和这个老保王党撕破脸。

最后王子公主们只好自我安慰这就是一个快死的老头子，不用跟他多计较。

就在两人即将错身而过的一刹那，郎侦老伯爵忽然说道：“你和阿瑞斯商那个外来纨绔是怎么回事？”

不帅：“……”怎么现在谁见着他都要问上这么一句？就连孤僻的老伯爵都被传染了？

“他不是纨绔，他只是……活得真实。”不帅不知道自己为什么要跟老伯爵说上这么一句。

可能是不太想老伯爵这样称得上品性高尚、一生都没什么污点的人，也对阿瑞斯商产生误解吧。

“真实？”老伯爵停住脚步，竟然转头看向虎不帅。

不帅也只好站住脚步，他尊重这位老伯爵，也同情他失去唯一的女儿，又和自己唯一的外孙不亲近。

听说老伯爵夫人在听到女儿女婿牺牲的当场，身体就垮掉了，这大概也是老伯爵衰老得快的原因之一。

“你和他的关系？”老伯爵人老成精，当即就从不帅的话语中品出了一点味。

不帅干咳：“我们算是朋友。”

“你为什么回来王城？”老伯爵忽然转换话题。

不帅有点跟不上老伯爵跳跃的思维，但也不好不回答，就说：“我正在查邪神信徒的线索，偶尔查到黑森林城，有些事就需要回王城禀报清楚。”

“是查邪神信徒，还是查丹顿侯爵？”老头有点咄咄逼人。

不帅只回了一个礼貌的微笑。

“是你找到了那座图书馆？”

“算是吧。”

“是就是，什么叫算是？是你的功劳就是你的，谁也抢不走！”老伯爵忽然就生气了。

“呃，功劳不功劳的，我无所谓。等查清楚黑森林城邪神信徒的事，我就会离开王城。”

“匆匆回来，又急着离去，谁又在迫害你不成？还是你想要和那个炼金师纨绔玩双宿双飞浪迹天涯的把戏？”老头的语调充满嘲讽。

不帅只觉得这老头子的心情就跟小孩子一样，说变就变，想变就变。

“也许？”不帅顽皮之心忽起。

“你收了他的戒指？”老伯爵目光落到不帅手指上，似乎真生气了，怒瞪不帅一眼，并附赠一声重重的“哼”，又重重踩着脚步离开。

他今天回去就找城卫军去把那个阿瑞斯商关进大牢里！

罪名就是扰乱王城治安！

炼金师怎么了？炼金师就能随便勾搭他们虎国杰出青年才俊了？！

不帅一脸懵。他是不是哪里得罪这位老伯爵了？

送老伯爵过来的驾车兽人却冲着不帅露出很是慈祥的笑容。他们家老爵爷多少年没和年轻兽人说过话了，真是难得看到他关心某个年轻兽人还为他生气的样子。

就连雷米尔少爷都没能让老爵爷这么生气过呢。

回去后，他可要把这件事告诉老夫人，让老夫人也高兴高兴。

商非凡连打了好几个喷嚏，抱臂看着罗列在他眼前的一连串任务。

系统这是有多担心他爱美人不爱玩游戏啊，而且瞅瞅，全都跟主线任务有关。

系统这是也不掩饰了，以前还顶着游戏系统的壳子给他发一些玩家常有的支线任务。

可现在！

任务七十三，想法接近虎王，探查对方的腰带是否为自然之神失落的力量之一。完成后奖励20点贡献点，以及空间石一枚。

任务七十四，想法接近天残谷主本体，探查对方身上是否有自然之神失落的力量之一。完成后奖励20点贡献点，以及空间石一枚。

任务七十五，想法参加兽人大陆文明分享大会，探查前来参加大会的各族兽人身上是否有自身之神失落的力量。每确认一名，奖励10点贡献点，以及空间石一枚。

任务七十六，随着千年前的图书馆暴露，邪神阴影正在王城弥漫，查出邪神信徒位于王城的最大巢穴，摧毁其中的邪神雕像，奖励20点贡献点，以及空间石一枚。

商非凡可以确定了，系统不缺空间石。

好在这些任务都没有时间限制，商非凡决定还是按照自己的原计划，先做他的个人私事。

系统大概看这样还打动不了商非凡，立马改换思路，再次发布了一个任务。

任务七十七，王后正在寻找失踪的丹顿侯爵，并怀疑自然之神失落的力量被拉斐尔郎沐获得，她正阴谋计算拉斐尔郎沐，希望从他身上夺回自然之神的力量。同时王后也在密谋得到虎王身上的空间腰带。请打破王后的阴谋，保护好拉斐尔郎沐和虎王的空间腰带，完成后奖励“拉斐尔郎沐的身世之秘”。

商非凡：“……来，系统，我们就任务七十七的奖励，展开说说？”

系统拒绝聊天。

商非凡立刻跟天眼系统查询，但天眼系统在此时也装傻。没装死，只装傻，天眼系统还是回应了，虽然只给出了一条信息。

【安妮塔夫人】

“我当然知道找到安妮塔夫人肯定能知道拉斐尔郎沐的身世，但安妮塔夫人在一年半前就已经去世，我就算找到她的坟墓……等等，安妮塔夫人是不是还活着？”

商非凡从椅子上蹦了起来。

在炼金室内走了两圈，停住脚步。

“安妮塔这样为了报复仇人，宁可给仇人丈夫生孩子的疯狂又聪明的女人真的死了吗？”

“她能把不帅的灵魂从法德尔大陆召唤过来，就表明她对灵魂学有一定认知，也说明她掌握着其他兽人没有掌握的特殊能力。这样的女人会因为一场疾病就撒手人寰？”

就算她是为了保护自己的孩子……也不对劲，这种为了子女不惜奉献一切的行为真不符合安妮塔夫人这个人设。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 137: The Old Count is Angry

Bu Shuai had just stepped out of the royal palace when he saw a beast-drawn carriage bearing a family crest parked at the palace gates.

There was no grand fanfare—just a single carriage and a single servant.

Yet anyone who recognized that crest would never dare look down upon the occupant of this beast-drawn carriage.

Naturally, this was not the main entrance of the royal palace, but a dedicated passage specifically for officials and palace staff.

The beastman driving the carriage opened the door.

An old beastman with white hair yet a straight back hopped out of the carriage box.

The prime of a beastman's life was quite long; once signs of old age appeared, it meant they had entered their twilight years. Many beastmen would consciously resign and step down from frontline positions the moment old age set in.

Bu Shuai had met this old beastman before: Elder Count Langzhen, the former commander of the City Guard, a figure deeply valued and trusted by both the previous and current Tiger Kings.

Because of the old count's name, Bu Shuai had paid a sliver of extra attention to him.

Elder Count Langzhen also caught sight of Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai placed his right fist over his chest and nodded in salute.

The old count's gaze swept across his face, and he, too, gave a slight nod in return.

Though no words were exchanged, for an old count who had grown increasingly reclusive with each passing year, this already constituted a favorable attitude.

Normally, the old count wouldn't even deign to give princes and princesses a pleasant look.

And those princes and princesses could do nothing about this reclusive old eccentric; if he wasn't even close to his own biological grandson, could one possibly expect him to grant anyone else a warm expression?

Thinking of using his grandson to threaten him? To force him to bow his head? Unless you were prepared for a complete falling out with this staunch Royalist diehard, you wouldn't dare.

In the end, the princes and princesses could only comfort themselves with the thought that he was just a dying old codger not worth bickering with.

Just as the two were about to brush past each other, Elder Count Langzhen suddenly spoke up, "What is going on between you and that arrogant prodigal from the Ares firm?"

Bu Shuai: "..." Why did everyone he met feel the need to ask him this lately? Had even this reclusive old count caught the contagion?

"He isn't a prodigal. He's simply... living authentically." Bu Shuai had no idea why he felt compelled to say such a thing to the old count.

Perhaps it was because he was reluctant for someone like the old count—whose reputation was noble and whose life was free of major blemishes—to harbor misunderstandings about Ares Shang.

"Authentically?" The old count stopped in his tracks, turning his head to look at Hu Bu Shuai in surprise.

Bu Shuai had no choice but to halt as well. He respected the old count and sympathized with him for losing his only daughter, only to remain estranged from his sole grandson.

He had heard that upon hearing the news of her daughter and son-in-law's sacrifice, the old countess's health had completely collapsed—which was likely one of the reasons the old count had aged so rapidly.

"Your relationship with him?" The old count, wise with age, immediately caught a hint of something in Bu Shuai's words.

Bu Shuai gave a dry cough. "We could be considered friends."

"Why have you returned to the Royal City?" The old count abruptly shifted the topic.

Bu Shuai struggled slightly to keep up with the old count's jumping train of thought, but it wouldn't do to leave it unanswered, so he said, "I've been investigating leads on the cultists of the Evil God. While tracing a lead to Black Forest City, certain matters required me to return to the Royal City to report clearly."

"Are you investigating the Evil God's cultists, or are you investigating Marquis Danton?" The old man's tone carried a hint of aggression.

Bu Shuai merely offered a polite smile in response.

"Were you the one who found that library?"

"You could say that."

"Either you did or you didn't, what is this 'you could say that'? If the credit is yours, it is yours, and no one can take it away from you!" The old count suddenly flared up in anger.

"Uh, as for credit, it doesn't matter much to me. Once the matter of the Evil God's cultists in Black Forest City is sorted out, I'll be leaving the Royal City."

"You rush back, only to anxiously hurry away—is someone persecuting you once again? Or are you planning to pull some stunt of flying away together to roam the ends of the earth with that alchemist prodigal?" The old man's tone dripped with sarcasm.

Bu Shuai could only feel that this old man's temperament was like a child's—changing on a whim, whenever he pleased.

"Perhaps?" A sudden streak of mischief flared within Bu Shuai.

"Did you accept his ring?" The old count's gaze dropped to Bu Shuai's finger. Looking genuinely incensed, he glared fiercely at Bu Shuai, punctuated by a heavy "Hmph!" before stomping away with heavy footsteps.

The moment he got back today, he was going to have the City Guard drag that Ares Shang into the dungeon!

The charge would be disturbing the public peace of the Royal City!

So what if he was an alchemist? Since when could an alchemist casually flirt with the brilliant young talents of their Tiger Kingdom?!

Bu Shuai wore a blank expression. Had he offended the old count somehow?

Meanwhile, the beastman driver who had brought the old count cast a deeply affectionate smile toward Bu Shuai. How many years had it been since their old master had deigned to speak with a young beastman? It was truly a rare sight to see him care about a young beastman to the point of getting angry over him.

Even Lord Remir had never managed to provoke such anger out of the old master.

Once he returned, he must share this news with the old mistress so she could rejoice as well.

Shang Feifan sneezed several times in succession, crossing his arms as he stared at the long list of quests lined up before him.

Just how worried was the system that he would prefer beauty over playing the game? And look at them—every single one was tied to the main storyline.

The system wasn't even bothering to hide it anymore. Previously, it still wore the skin of a gaming system, tossing him standard side quests players typically received.

But now!

Quest Seventy-Three: Find a way to approach the Tiger King and investigate whether his belt is one of the lost powers of the God of Nature. Upon completion, reward: 20 contribution points and a spatial stone.

Quest Seventy-Four: Find a way to approach the true form of the Valley Master of Heaven's Scar and investigate whether he carries one of the lost powers of the God of Nature. Upon completion, reward: 20 contribution points and a spatial stone.

Quest Seventy-Five: Find a way to attend the Beastman Continent Civilization Sharing Assembly and investigate whether the beastmen of various races attending the assembly possess any of the lost powers of the God of Nature. For each confirmed individual, reward: 10 contribution points and a spatial stone.

Quest Seventy-Six: With the exposure of the millennium-old library, the shadow of the Evil God is permeating the Royal City. Uncover the Evil God cult's largest nest within the Royal City and destroy the Evil God statue within. Reward: 20 contribution points and a spatial stone.

Shang Feifan could confirm one thing: the system was certainly not lacking in spatial stones.

Fortunately, none of these quests came with a time limit. Shang Feifan decided to stick to his original plan and handle his personal private matters first.

Realizing that this failed to move Shang Feifan, the system abruptly changed tactics and issued yet another quest.

Quest Seventy-Seven: The Queen is searching for the missing Marquis Danton and suspects that the lost power of the God of Nature was obtained by Raphael Langmu. She is plotting against Raphael Langmu, hoping to wrest the power of the God of Nature from him. Simultaneously, the Queen is conspiring to acquire the spatial belt worn by the Tiger King. Please disrupt the Queen's conspiracy, protect Raphael Langmu and the Tiger King's spatial belt. Upon completion, reward: "The Secret of Raphael Langmu's Birth."

Shang Feifan: "...Come out, System. Let's have a detailed chat about the reward for Quest Seventy-Seven."

The system refused to converse.

Shang Feifan immediately queried the Heavenly Eye system, but the Heavenly Eye system played dumb at this moment. It didn't play dead—it merely feigned ignorance. Still, the Heavenly Eye system did respond, albeit by providing a single piece of information.

[Madam Anita]

"Of course I know that finding Madam Anita would certainly reveal Raphael Langmu's origins, but Madam Anita passed away a year and a half ago. Even if I were to find her grave... Wait, is Madam Anita still alive?"

Shang Feifan sprang up from his chair.

He paced back and forth twice inside the alchemy chamber before halting his steps.

"Could a woman as crazily clever as Anita—who would rather bear a child with her enemy's husband just to exact vengeance—really be dead?"

"She was able to summon Bu Shuai's soul across from the Fadel Continent, which proves she possesses a certain understanding of soul arts, as well as mastery over special abilities unknown to other beastmen. Would a woman like that simply surrender her life to an ordinary illness?"

Even if she did it to protect her child... No, that didn't add up either. Such an act of sacrificing everything for one's offspring completely clashed with Madam Anita's established character persona.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第137章 老伯爵生气了 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
之前不帅和他小姨迪莉娅夫人聊起过去的事情，提到安妮塔夫人是受到胁迫，为了保护儿子才不得不放弃自己的生命时，他就觉得有点古怪。

如果安妮塔夫人是真的爱上了虎王，视不帅为爱情结晶，她也许会非常非常爱这个孩子，会为这个孩子筹谋很多。

但如果安妮塔夫人能力很强，她为了保护孩子，只会尽可能地活着，因为她活着才能真正保护好她的孩子。

商非凡直觉安妮塔夫人并没有爱上虎王，她为虎王生下拉斐尔郎沐，更多的还是为了膈应王后，也为了给自己留一条后路，甚而扰乱虎国王位继承。

对，商非凡就是这么认为：拉斐尔郎沐这个孩子只是安妮塔夫人给自己准备的工具人。

但凡一个母亲真心爱自己的孩子，怎么忍心让自己的孩子背负上私生子的名头？

就算不小心生下来，也会千方百计地隐藏，不让孩子知道自己的身世，更不会让他背上骂名，从小生活在别人的辱骂和鄙视下。

商非凡不知道原身是什么样的性格，不帅也奇怪地极少提到原身。

但按照常理设想，原身在那样的环境下长大，要么就极度自卑，自卑到自尊过头，性格也会变得极为敏感，变成一个不讨喜的孩子。要么就过度小心翼翼，每天谨小慎微地活着。也有可能长成怨天尤人自私自利小鸡肚肠爱攀比的性格。

如果原身是这三种性格中的一种，安妮塔夫人如果真的爱这个孩子，她会放心就这么死去？

哦，原身已经不是原身了。六年半前，原身死了，安妮塔夫人把不帅招了过来。

而不帅的性格和能力完全可以承担起没有母亲照顾的生活。

但这样也就更奇怪。

安妮塔夫人明知道不帅不是她的亲生骨肉，明知道不帅可以脱离王城还能把自己照顾得很好，为什么还要为这个儿子自我寻求死亡？

把这些线索全部在脑中过了一遍，商非凡几乎可以肯定地说：安妮塔夫人九成九没有死，她只是死遁了。

这可真是一个聪明的女人！

她的这场死亡，即向王后示弱，表示自己有弱点且不是她的对手，让王后彻底把这个恨之入骨的敌人抛到脑后。

同时还赚足了虎王对她的同情和怜爱。

谁都知道活人永远无法和死人相比。

安妮塔夫人继续活着，可能会从朱砂痣变成蚊子血，但她死了，她就在虎王心田里永远扎根了。

王后活着一天，都会被虎王拿来和安妮塔不断比较。

如果王后还做了某些让虎王不快的事情，那可好，能更快地消磨虎王对王后的感情，并更加怀念曾经的情人。

更进一步，安妮塔夫人安排的死遁把拉斐尔郎沐彻底推到了幕前，让所有人的注意力都集中到了他身上。

而安妮塔则可以藏在幕后做些事情，也不会被人注意到。

就算注意到，可能查着查着就查到拉斐尔郎沐的头上。

工具人效果出现。

商非凡眼中闪过厉光。

他不管安妮塔夫人要怎么报复王后和丹顿侯爵一家，包括她的子女在内。

只要安妮塔做的事不会影响到拉斐尔郎沐。

看在对方是原身生母的份上，他可以更退一步，只要安妮塔做的事不会伤害到拉斐尔郎沐，哪怕安妮塔把虎国搅得人仰马翻，他也只会当没看到。

但是！

任务七十七的奖励却是“拉斐尔郎沐的身世之秘”。

这几乎已经告诉他，不帅的身世有问题。

不帅很可能不是安妮塔的亲生骨肉，甚至有可能不是虎王的血脉。

如果这事被暴露出来，虎王会否因此暴怒，进而把怒火都宣泄到不帅头上？

毕竟没有哪个男人能忍受自己的情人给自己戴绿帽子，还得给绿帽对象的孩子当爹。

安妮塔进行的复仇计划中有没有自曝不帅身世这一条？

再狗血一点，搞不好不帅其实是王后的孩子，而安妮塔生的孩子则交换给了王后？

不过从三个王子两个公主的年龄来看，这个可能性低到几乎没可能。

那么不帅到底拥有什么样的身世才能让安妮塔利用？

这个身世更让安妮塔不惜招外来的灵魂上原身的身，也要保证原身活下去。

商非凡提起骨杖就冲出了炼金室。

有些事可以等，有些事绝对不能等。

他不想被动地等待别人出招，更无法忍受有人在利用不帅的身世做文章。

他要尽快找到安妮塔，从她那里询问出不帅的真正身世。顺便搞清楚她死遁后在做什么。

不帅不是原身，他不会在得知自己不是虎王血脉或有其他身世后感到伤心，但什么都不知道的他们，显然会处于一个非常被动的状态。

这是掌控欲强盛的商非凡绝对无法忍受的。

只有掌握不帅的真正身世之秘，他才能安然继续其他事情。

系统默默给自己点了个赞，下次它会给胡萝卜再换个姿势。
chunks.englishText:
Earlier, when Bu Shuai had chatted with his maternal aunt, Madam Delia, about past events and mentioned that Madam Anita had been coerced, forced to give up her life to protect her son, he had felt something was amiss.

If Madam Anita had genuinely fallen in love with the Tiger King and viewed Bu Shuai as the crystallization of their love, she might have loved the child deeply, plotting and scheming extensively for his future.

Yet if Madam Anita possessed formidable abilities, to protect her child, she would have fought to stay alive by any means possible, because only by staying alive could she truly keep her child safe.

Shang Feifan had a strong intuition that Madam Anita had never loved the Tiger King. Bearing Raphael Langmu for the Tiger King was done far more to stick a thorn in the Queen's side, to carve out a fallback option for herself, and to disrupt the succession of the Tiger Kingdom's throne.

Yes, that was precisely how Shang Feifan saw it: the child Raphael Langmu was merely a tool pre-arranged by Madam Anita for her own ends.

Any mother who genuinely loved her child would never bear to let him shoulder the stigma of being an illegitimate son!

Even if he were accidentally born, she would have gone to extreme lengths to conceal it, preventing the child from ever learning his true lineage, let alone suffering public condemnation and living his whole life beneath the insults and contempt of others.

Shang Feifan did not know what the original owner's personality had been like, and strangely enough, Bu Shuai rarely ever mentioned the original owner.

Yet logically speaking, growing up in that kind of environment, the original owner would either become intensely insecure—insecure to the point of excessive pride, with a hyper-sensitive disposition that rendered him an unlikable child—or he would grow up overly cautious, walking on eggshells every single day. It was also possible he could develop a resentful, selfish, petty, and endlessly competitive personality.

If the original owner was one of these three archetypes, and Madam Anita truly loved the child, would she have felt at ease simply dying like that?

Oh right, the original owner was no longer the original owner. Six and a half years ago, the original owner died, and Madam Anita summoned Bu Shuai over.

Bu Shuai's personality and capabilities were completely sufficient to handle a life without maternal care.

Yet that made it all the more bizarre.

Knowing full well that Bu Shuai was not her biological flesh and blood, and knowing full well that Bu Shuai could leave the Royal City and take perfectly good care of himself, why would she still actively seek her own death for this son?

Reviewing all these clues in his mind, Shang Feifan could state with ninety-nine percent certainty: Madam Anita was not dead at all; she had merely faked her death to escape.

What a brilliant woman!

By staging this death, she demonstrated weakness to the Queen, signaling that she possessed a fatal flaw and was no match for her, causing the Queen to completely cast this enemy she hated to the bone out of her mind.

Simultaneously, she wrung out the Tiger King's deepest sympathy and affection.

Everyone knew that the living could never truly compete with the dead.

Had Madam Anita continued to live, she might have eventually faded from a cherished cinnabar mole on the wall to a mere speck of mosquito blood; but by dying, she planted herself permanently in the fertile soil of the Tiger King's heart.

As long as the Queen lived, the Tiger King would constantly compare her to Anita.

If the Queen happened to commit any missteps that displeased the Tiger King—well then, all the better! It would only faster erode the Tiger King's feelings for the Queen while heightening his nostalgia for his former lover.

Pushing it further, the faked death arranged by Madam Anita pushed Raphael Langmu completely into the spotlight, drawing everyone's attention entirely onto him.

Meanwhile, Anita could hide behind the scenes to pull strings without drawing anyone's notice.

Even if she were noticed, investigations would likely lead right back to Raphael Langmu.

The tool's utility was maximized.

A sharp glint flashed through Shang Feifan's eyes.

He didn't care how Madam Anita intended to exact her revenge on the Queen and Marquis Danton's family, including her own children.

As long as Anita's actions did not impact Raphael Langmu.

For the sake of her being the original owner's birth mother, he could take a step back: as long as Anita's actions didn't harm Raphael Langmu, even if she turned the Tiger Kingdom completely upside down, he would simply pretend not to see it.

However!

The reward for Quest Seventy-Seven was "The Secret of Raphael Langmu's Birth."

This was practically telling him outright that Bu Shuai's identity had a problem.

It was highly likely that Bu Shuai was not Madam Anita's biological child, and perhaps not even the Tiger King's flesh and blood.

If this matter were exposed, would the Tiger King fly into a rage and vent all his fury upon Bu Shuai?

After all, no man could stomach the thought of his lover cuckolding him and then forcing him to play doting father to another man's spawn.

Was there a clause in Madam Anita's revenge plan involving the voluntary exposure of Bu Shuai's true identity?

To take it down an even more melodramatic path—could Bu Shuai actually be the Queen's child, and Anita's own child had been swapped with the Queen's?

Yet judging by the ages of the three princes and two princesses, the probability of that was practically near zero.

Then what kind of background did Bu Shuai truly possess that made Madam Anita willing to summon a foreign soul into the original owner's body, all to ensure the original owner survived?

Shang Feifan grabbed his bone staff and bolted out of the alchemy chamber.

Some matters could wait, but others absolutely could not.

He refused to passively wait for others to make their move, nor could he tolerate anyone using Bu Shuai's background as a chess piece.

He needed to find Anita as quickly as possible and extract Bu Shuai's true origins from her own mouth. By the way, he would also figure out what she was up to after faking her death.

Bu Shuai was not the original owner; he wouldn't feel heartbroken upon discovering he wasn't the Tiger King's flesh and blood or that he had a different background. However, remaining entirely in the dark would undoubtedly place them in a severely passive position.

This was something the control-obsessed Shang Feifan could never tolerate.

Only by mastering the secret of Bu Shuai's true birth could he calmly proceed with everything else.

The system silently gave itself a thumbs-up. Next time, it would dangle the carrot from a different angle.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第138章 安妮塔夫人的坟墓 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第138章 安妮塔夫人的坟墓

商非凡跑出门的时候正在询问天眼系统：“安妮塔下落。”

天眼系统：【安妮塔最近一次记录，新生纪214年10月18日，尸体被葬入王城公墓。】

商非凡掐指一算，现在是新生纪216年4月，也就是天眼系统最后一次观察到安妮塔已经是一年半前。

天眼系统不可能在这方面说谎，换言之，安妮塔如果没死，铁定换了身份，包括面容。

如果安妮塔这一年半以来一直没有暴露以前的容颜，也没有和任何人提到过自己的身份，天眼系统确实无法察觉到她的踪迹。

由于战争等诸多原因，大繁华纪时期留下来的地面监控系统基本已经被毁得差不多，只靠太空中的监控卫星以及少数地面上残留的“眼睛和耳朵”，天眼系统现在的全面监控能力已经远不如大繁华纪时期。

但就算如此，天眼系统的监控和分析能力也不可小觑。

“安妮塔在王城公墓的坟墓地址。”

右眼视界中，游戏小地图中自动出现了一个红点标记。

途中，商非凡找专门的羽檄快递给不帅传了消息，让他尽快前来王城公墓山一趟。

有小地图指引，商非凡骑着狰爷快速来到了位于王城郊外一座山上的王城公墓。

这座山就叫公墓山，原本只是郊外一座荒山，因为第一代虎王把这里规划为王城公墓，就有了公墓山之名。

虎王很想把安妮塔葬入王室墓地，但他不能。

他只能在王城公墓给安妮塔建造了一座称得上豪华的墓室。

这座墓室位于半山腰，和其他坟墓都有一小段距离，周围种植着一些低矮的长青灌木。

商非凡顶着阿瑞斯商的装扮出城，自然有不少人注意到他的动静。

有人好奇阿瑞斯商要做什么，就跟了出来。

平日就在盯梢他的人也跟在他屁股后面。

阿瑞斯商也没有特意隐藏自己的踪迹，众所周知他正追求拉斐尔郎沐，进而对其母亲好奇，或想进一步赢得拉斐尔好感，来墓地祭拜一番也是正常发展不是？

阿瑞斯商就这么骑着狰爷大摇大摆地一路来到安妮塔夫人的墓地。

狰爷的外表也做了一些修饰，身上涂了一些草本颜料，又挂上了一些贵族子弟喜欢的花里胡哨的佩饰和炼金装备。

只要没有特别留意过狰爷外表的人，乍一看狰爷绝对无法联想到原本的狰爷身上。

狰爷还挺臭美，以前不知道，等阿瑞斯商给它装扮起来，发现它不但不排斥，还会自己选择颜色和挂饰，且不喜欢清雅只喜欢闪亮亮的豪奢款，才知道狰爷并不是一个粗糙的老爷们，而是一个爱土豪风的精致boy。

果然当年狰爷会看上商非凡，不是没有原因的，这本质也是一个爱炫的！

商非凡一直以为巨虫也会延续虫类的特质，不会让自己的颜色太醒目，以免被天敌鸟类发现。

但巨虫显然已经和普通虫类的天性和审美都不一样了，它们的基因早已异变。

狰爷压根就不怕鸟类，除非是那种身体特别巨大的。

商非凡翻身从狰爷身上下来，拍拍它，让它自由活动。

墓室大门紧闭，门是雕花式栅栏，没有锁，只从里面用插销闩上。

商非凡手伸进栅栏缝隙里，拉动插销，推开栅栏门。

进去后，又随手把门插上。

墓室里面空间不算大，只有二十平左右。

中间是一座有基座的站立雕像。

这是安妮塔的原身雕刻。

从雕像上看，安妮塔确实是一个大美人，风姿绰约，容颜清丽。

雕像前摆放着还没有枯萎的鲜花，整个墓室打扫得很干净。

这显然是一座有人经常照顾打理的墓室。

商非凡围绕雕像走了一圈，提着的骨杖在地面敲敲打打。

他在听地面是实心还是空心。

如果是空心，就表示有机关可以下去。

如果是实心，就表示下面已经被填埋封死。

咚！

商非凡的骨杖敲到一处地方，听到下面传来空洞的声音。

咚，咚。

商非凡提起骨杖又敲了两下，并逐渐向周围扩大试探范围。

最终，商非凡重新站在了雕像面前。

他敲出来的空心点正好围绕雕像一圈。

换言之，这座雕像的正下方就是空洞。

商非凡一点点打量这座雕像，并伸手来回触摸。

他在用炼金师的手段来查看这座雕像有没有暗藏机关。

哐当。

栅栏门处传来响动。

“你来这里干什么？”门口传来不帅惊讶的声音。

不帅收到消息就用最快速度赶了过来。

他赶到墓地的时候，就看到安妮塔夫人的墓室前有人徘徊，还在朝里探看。

看到不帅过来，这几个跟踪阿瑞斯商的人立刻散开。

商非凡对他招手示意：“你来看。”

不帅不解，走过去。

商非凡手掌也不知做了什么，紧接着就对雕像基座用力一推。

雕像基座竟然发出了咔咔声，往后退了一步。

不帅：“……”

商非凡又推着基座转动两圈。

雕像再次往后退。

露出了下方一个黑洞。

黑洞不大，毕竟那个基座也不算大，但足够一个强壮的兽人爬进爬出。

商非凡胆子特别大，直接探头朝黑洞里面看。

“你看。”商非凡指着黑洞，再次招呼不帅。

不帅探过头去。

黑洞下面有一条木头做的直梯。

一年半的时间还不算长，木梯仍旧完好无损。

“要不要下去看看。”商非凡兴致勃勃。

不帅直接问：“你查到了什么？”

商非凡打了个手势。

不帅：“他们知道我听力卓绝，附近跟踪的人都散开了。”

虽然但是，商非凡也还是说道：“这里不是说话的地方，等晚上我去找你再跟你详说。”

商非凡这次没有招呼不帅，直接抓着木梯滑了下去。

不帅犹豫片刻，也跟了下去。

黑暗的地下墓室亮起灯火。

底下的墓室也不大，比上面的墓室还要小一圈，不过墓室高度约有三米高，不算逼仄，中间摆放着一台石棺。

商非凡仔细观察石棺，同样用炼金师手法查探这座石棺。

最后判断，这就是一座普通石棺。

商非凡上手就去推动石棺棺盖。

沉重的棺盖被推开。

全程，不帅都只是在旁边看着，没有阻止商非凡。

他相信商非凡没有特殊理由，不会跑来“辱”他名义上母亲的坟墓。

石棺里躺着一具女尸。

尸体保存得很好，并没有多少腐烂痕迹，也没有虫蚁乱爬，衣着整洁，只有一些干瘪。

不帅看了看，对商非凡说：“这就是安妮塔夫人。”

商非凡却突然伸手探向女士的脸部。

不帅张口，又止住。

商非凡的手指灵活地在女尸脸部来回滑动，轻搓了几下。

随后，商非凡就掏出一瓶药剂，对着尸体脸部外沿一圈滴了几滴药水。

略等几秒，商非凡再上手轻搓尸体脸部外沿部分。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 138: Madam Anita's Grave (Part 1)

As Shang Feifan ran out of the door, he was questioning the Eye of Heaven System: "Where is Anita's current location?"

Eye of Heaven System: [Anita's most recent record: October 18, 214 of the New Era, her body was interred in the Royal City Cemetery.]

Shang Feifan did a quick mental calculation. It was currently April of the 216th New Era, meaning the Eye of Heaven System had last observed Anita a year and a half ago.

It was impossible for the Eye of Heaven System to lie about this. In other words, if Anita wasn't dead, she had definitely changed her identity, including her facial features.

If Anita had not exposed her previous appearance or mentioned her identity to anyone over the past year and a half, the Eye of Heaven System truly wouldn't be able to trace her whereabouts.

Due to various factors such as warfare, the ground-based surveillance systems left over from the Grand Prosperous Era had been mostly destroyed. Relying solely on surveillance satellites in space and the few remaining "eyes and ears" on the ground, the current comprehensive monitoring capability of the Eye of Heaven System was far inferior to that of the Grand Prosperous Era.

Even so, the monitoring and analytical capabilities of the Eye of Heaven System were not to be underestimated.

"Give me the address of Madam Anita's grave in the Royal City Cemetery."

In his right-eye's field of vision, a red dot automatically appeared on the mini-game map.

Along the way, Shang Feifan used a specialized feathered messenger pigeon to send a message to Bu Shuai, asking him to come to the Royal City Cemetery Mountain as soon as possible.

Guided by the mini-map, Shang Feifan rode the Fiend-Beast quickly to the Royal City Cemetery located on a mountain in the suburbs of the royal city.

The mountain was simply called Cemetery Mountain. Originally, it was just a barren hill in the outskirts, but after the first-generation Beast King designated it as the Royal City Cemetery, it acquired the name Cemetery Mountain.

The Beast King had desperately wanted to bury Anita in the royal cemetery, but he could not.

He could only construct a tomb for Anita in the Royal City Cemetery that could truly be described as luxurious.

This tomb was located halfway up the mountain, a short distance away from all the other graves, with some low evergreen shrubs planted around it.

Shang Feifan had left the city disguised as Ares Shang, so naturally, quite a few people noticed his movements.

Curious about what Ares Shang was up to, some followed him out.

Those who normally kept tabs on him also trailed right behind his ass.

Ares Shang made no special effort to conceal his tracks. As everyone knew, he was currently pursuing Raphael Lang Mu, so being curious about Raphael's mother—or wanting to further win Raphael's favor by paying respects at the grave—was a natural progression of events, wasn't it?

Thus, riding the Fiend-Beast, Shang Feifan swaggered all the way to Madam Anita's grave.

The Fiend-Beast's appearance had also been slightly modified; its body was daubed with herbal pigments and hung with garish trinkets and alchemical equipment favored by young nobles.

As long as one hadn't paid special attention to the Fiend-Beast's appearance beforehand, at first glance, one would never connect it to the original Fiend-Beast.

The Fiend-Beast turned out to be quite vain. Shang Feifan hadn't known this before, but once he started dressing it up, he found that not only did it not reject the decorations, but it would actually pick its own colors and pendants. Moreover, it didn't like understated elegance; it only liked flashy, extravagant styles. That was when he realized the Fiend-Beast wasn't some rough-and-tumble old man at all, but rather an exquisite boy who loved the *tuhao* (flashy rich) aesthetic.

Sure enough, there was a reason the Fiend-Beast had taken a fancy to Shang Feifan back then—at its core, it was also a show-off!

Shang Feifan had always assumed that giant insects would retain the traits of ordinary bugs, avoiding overly eye-catching colors to prevent detection by predatory birds.

However, giant insects clearly no longer shared the instincts and aesthetics of ordinary insects; their genes had long since mutated.

The Fiend-Beast was utterly unafraid of birds, unless they were of the exceptionally massive variety.

Shang Feifan flipped down from the Fiend-Beast, patted it, and let it roam freely.

The tomb's door was tightly shut. It was a carved iron-grate door without a lock, secured from the inside only by a sliding bolt.

Shang Feifan reached his hand through the gaps in the iron grate, slid back the bolt, and pushed open the barred door.

After entering, he casually bolted the door shut from the inside.

The space inside the tomb wasn't very large, only about twenty square meters.

In the middle stood a standing statue upon a pedestal.

This was sculpted in Anita's likeness.

Judging from the statue, Anita was indeed a great beauty with an air of grace and delicate features.

Uwwithered flowers were placed before the statue, and the entire tomb chamber was kept impeccably clean.

Clearly, this was a tomb that someone frequently tended and cared for.

Shang Feifan circled the statue, tapping against the ground with the bone staff he was carrying.

He was listening to whether the ground was solid or hollow.

If it were hollow, it meant there was a mechanism leading downward.

If it were solid, it meant the space beneath had been completely filled and sealed off.

*Thud!*

Shang Feifan's bone staff struck a certain spot and heard a hollow sound echo from beneath.

*Thud, thud.*

Shang Feifan raised the bone staff to strike twice more, gradually expanding his probing range outward.

In the end, Shang Feifan returned to stand before the statue.

The hollow spots he had tapped formed a circle precisely around the statue.

In other words, directly beneath this statue was a hollow void.

Shang Feifan scrutinized the statue piece by piece, reaching out to touch it back and forth.

He was using an alchemist's methods to check whether the statue concealed any hidden mechanisms.

*Clang.*

A sound came from the barred door.

"What are you doing here?" Bu Shuai's surprised voice rang out from the entrance.

Upon receiving the message, Bu Shuai had rushed over at top speed.

When he arrived at the cemetery, he had seen people loitering in front of Madam Anita's tomb, peering inside.

Seeing Bu Shuai approach, those who had been tailing Ares Shang promptly scattered.

Shang Feifan beckoned to him, signaling, "Come take a look."

Perplexed, Bu Shuai walked over.

Shang Feifan performed some unknown motion with his palm, and then shoved hard against the statue's pedestal.

The pedestal actually emitted a grinding *creak* and slid backward by a step.

Bu Shuai: "..."

Shang Feifan then pushed the pedestal and rotated it twice.

The statue retreated backward once more.

A dark hole was revealed beneath it.

The dark hole wasn't very large, considering the pedestal itself wasn't huge, but it was wide enough for a sturdy Orc to crawl in and out.

Shang Feifan was exceptionally bold; he stuck his head directly into the dark hole to look.

"Take a look." Shang Feifan pointed into the dark hole and called out to Bu Shuai again.

Bu Shuai leaned his head over.

Inside the dark hole was a straight wooden ladder.

A year and a half wasn't all that long; the wooden ladder remained completely intact.

"Should we go down and take a look?" Shang Feifan asked, full of zest.

Bu Shuai asked straight to the point: "What did you find out?"

Shang Feifan made a hand gesture.

Bu Shuai: "They know my hearing is exceptional; the people tracking us nearby have all dispersed."

Even so, Shang Feifan still said, "This isn't a place to talk. I'll come find you tonight and tell you the details."

Without waiting for Bu Shuai, Shang Feifan grabbed the wooden ladder and slid right down.

After a moment of hesitation, Bu Shuai followed him down as well.

Lamplight illuminated the dark underground tomb.

The tomb down below was also small—a circle smaller than the one above—though the ceiling height was roughly three meters, so it didn't feel cramped. A stone coffin sat right in the middle.

Shang Feifan carefully observed the stone coffin, using an alchemist's methods to inspect it as well.

In the end, he concluded that this was simply an ordinary stone coffin.

Shang Feifan reached out and pushed against the coffin lid.

The heavy lid was shoved aside.

Throughout the entire process, Bu Shuai merely watched from the side without stopping Shang Feifan.

He believed that without a special reason, Shang Feifan would not come here to "desecrate" the grave of his nominal mother.

Lying inside the stone coffin was a female corpse.

The body was very well preserved, showing very few signs of decay. There were no crawling insects or ants, her attire was neat, and she was only somewhat withered and shrunken.

Bu Shuai looked at it and said to Shang Feifan, "This is Madam Anita."

However, Shang Feifan suddenly reached his hand toward the woman's face.

Bu Shuai opened his mouth, then halted.

Shang Feifan's fingers deftly glided back and forth across the female corpse's face, rubbing lightly for a few moments.

Following that, Shang Feifan pulled out a vial of potion, dripping a few drops along the outer perimeter of the corpse's facial skin.

After waiting a mere few seconds, Shang Feifan reached out again to gently rub the outer edges of the corpse's face.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第138章 安妮塔夫人的坟墓 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
轻轻的，商非凡揭开了一层脸皮。

不帅嘴巴微微张开：哦！传说中的人皮面具！

商非凡似乎知道他在想什么一样，抬头笑了一下：“不是人皮面具那么夸张，就是一层膜，根据手感，主材料九成是植物胶，如果平时用在脸上，不太容易紧密黏合，时间一长，很容易会被人看出来。但用胶水贴合在死人脸皮上，再上一层精细的妆，就不太容易察觉。”

通常也不会有人跑来摸死人的脸。

而虎王和王后等人肯定是几次确定过安妮塔夫人真正的“尸体”，既然确定安妮塔真的死了，他们自然不会再来确认安妮塔埋在墓地里的尸体。

商非凡并没有把那层面皮全部揭开，在确定女尸并不是安妮塔夫人后，他又把揭开的面皮贴了回去。

“我认识她。”不帅忽然说。

“你是说尸体？”商非凡直起身。

不帅点头，神情平静，只眼睛里有着无法遮掩的哀伤：“她是安妮塔夫人身边的侍女，在我出事前，她就死了，死于中毒。她吃了我的晚餐。那天晚上角马突然跑来找我，说有人和他约架，他需要帮手，我就跟他出去了。凯茜已经做好了我的晚餐，为了不浪费，她就把这份晚餐给吃了。”

商非凡也点点头，“这大约就是某些人对安妮塔夫人的警告之一。”

不帅抿唇。

“看来安妮塔夫人那时就应该有所谋划，她把这具尸体保存得很好。”

“烧了吧，我们把骨灰拿出来，单独给她找个地方埋了。免得后面持续有人来打扰她的安眠。”不帅说。

商非凡没反对。

烧了这具尸体，反而会让后面那些摸到地底墓室的人摸不着头脑。

不帅拿出骨杖，对着尸体施展了火系魔法。

尸体很快就烧成灰烬。

商非凡帮助不帅把骨灰取出来，用个小坛子装了。

两人重新合上石棺，顺着木梯爬上来。

商非凡顺手把木梯也给抽走。

当年安妮塔夫人离开墓地时，为了不引人注目，很可能只能把木梯留在墓室里。

商非凡再次推动机关，把雕像回归原位。

墓室看起来又跟之前一模一样。

做戏做到家，商非凡又拿出一束鲜花和几盘供品放到雕像前，做出他只是来祭拜的假象。

不帅站在雕像前，默立。

“不管您有什么谋划，我最后帮您一把。”

不帅低语，蹲下-身，单手按住雕像基座下方，口中默念咒语。

地底泥土翻涌，很快就把下方墓室填充得严严实实。

这下就算有人能发现雕像的机关，也无法再打开下面的墓室。

除非有人愿意下死力气去挖，才有可能挖出那具石棺。

不过那动静就大了。

而虎王怎么可能容忍有人动他心头朱砂痣的坟墓？

不帅和阿瑞斯商一前一后，大大方方走出安妮塔夫人的墓室。

远处跟踪的人等到两人离开，才敢靠近墓室。

有人大着胆子进去溜达了一圈，见没有什么异样，又火速退出。

然后不到下午，王城中就有了新的流言。

阿瑞斯商为了拿下拉斐尔郎沐，都去墓地祭拜安妮塔夫人啦。

母亲都见过了，下一步是不是就要见父亲了？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 138: Madam Anita's Grave (Part 2)

With a gentle motion, Shang Feifan peeled away a layer of facial skin.

Bu Shuai's mouth parted slightly: *Oh! The legendary human-skin mask!*

As if knowing what he was thinking, Shang Feifan looked up and smiled. "It's not as exaggerated as a human-skin mask; it's just a thin membrane. Based on the texture, the main material is ninety percent plant-based adhesive. If worn on a living face normally, it wouldn't adhere very tightly, and after a while, it would easily be detected by others. But when glued onto a dead person's facial skin and topped with a layer of fine makeup, it's not so easily noticed."

Normally, nobody would go around touching a dead person's face anyway.

And the Beast King, the Queen, and others had undoubtedly confirmed Madam Anita's true "corpse" several times. Since they were certain Anita was truly dead, naturally they would never come back to re-verify the body buried in the cemetery.

Shang Feifan didn't peel that layer of skin all the way off. Upon confirming that the female corpse was not Madam Anita, he pressed the peeled-back skin right back into place.

"I know her," Bu Shuai suddenly said.

"You mean the corpse?" Shang Feifan straightened up.

Bu Shuai nodded, his expression calm, though his eyes held an unmasked sorrow: "She was a maid by Madam Anita's side. Before the incident happened to me, she died—she died of poisoning. She ate my dinner. That night, the Wildebeest suddenly came to find me, saying someone had challenged him to a fight and he needed help, so I went out with him. Cassie had already prepared my dinner, and so as not to waste it, she ate that portion."

Shang Feifan also nodded. "This was probably one of those 'warnings' directed at Madam Anita by certain individuals."

Bu Shuai pressed his lips into a thin line.

"It seems Madam Anita must have been plotting something even back then; she preserved this corpse very well."

"Burn it. We'll take her ashes out and find a separate place to bury her, so that people won't keep coming to disturb her rest in the future," Bu Shuai said.

Shang Feifan didn't object.

Incinerating this corpse would actually leave anyone who later managed to track their way down to the underground tomb completely baffled.

Bu Shuai produced his bone staff and cast fire-magic upon the corpse.

The body was quickly reduced to ashes.

Shang Feifan helped Bu Shuai retrieve the ashes and pack them into a small urn.

The two of them closed the stone coffin back up and climbed up the wooden ladder.

Shang Feifan casually pulled the wooden ladder up with them.

Back when Madam Anita left the cemetery, to avoid drawing attention, she likely had no choice but to leave the wooden ladder inside the tomb.

Shang Feifan triggered the mechanism once more, returning the statue to its original position.

The tomb chamber looked identical to how it had appeared before.

To make the act convincing, Shang Feifan produced another bunch of fresh flowers and a few plates of offerings, placing them before the statue to fabricate the illusion that he had simply come to pay respects.

Bu Shuai stood silently before the statue.

*Regardless of what plots you may have harbored, I will help you one last time.*

Bu Shuai muttered under his breath, crouched down, pressed one hand against the base of the statue's pedestal, and chanted an incantation under his breath.

The underground soil churned, rapidly packing the tomb below until it was filled completely solid.

Now, even if someone managed to discover the statue's mechanism, they would no longer be able to open the tomb beneath.

Unless someone was willing to expend desperate, back-breaking effort to dig, it would be impossible to unearth that stone coffin.

However, the commotion caused by that would be far too massive.

And how could the Beast King ever tolerate anyone disturbing the grave of the cinnabar mole upon his heart?

Bu Shuai and Ares Shang walked out of Madam Anita's tomb one after the other, acting open and unbothered.

The people tailing them from afar waited until the two left before daring to approach the tomb.

One of them bravely poked around inside for a round, and seeing nothing out of the ordinary, bolted back out in a hurry.

And so, by afternoon, a new rumor was circulating within the royal city:

Ares Shang had even gone to the cemetery to pay respects to Madam Anita just to win over Raphael Lang Mu!

He'd already met the mother; was meeting the father the next step?

chunks.chineseText:
第139章 隐身人

“其实我早就有所猜测。”不帅在下山的途中，用夏国语小声说道。

商非凡没吭声，就走在他身边，像是在做一个称职的陪伴者。

“她给我的感觉很强大，也很坚韧，就是那种为达目的，什么都能做出来的人。她真的不像是会为了孩子……为了我，放弃生命的人。”

不帅想说安妮塔不是一个慈祥温柔的母亲，但想到自己并不是她的孩子，觉得自己并没有资格说这个话。

“你对小时候有记忆吗？”商非凡也同样切换了母语，小小声问。

不帅思考片刻，“有些记忆片段，就藏在大脑里，偶尔我的脑中会掠过这些片段。晚上做梦的时候，梦到的更多。只是我有时候分不清那到底是梦境，还是真实发生过的事情。”

“那你觉得你小时候是个什么样的人？和那位关系如何？”商非凡又问。

不帅回答得比较迟疑：“我不知道。我接收到的记忆大多来自于少年时期，差不多是十岁以后。那时候拉斐尔已经知道自己是私生子。不过他在知道自己是虎王的孩子后，一度很骄傲，很想见到虎王，还跟其他人吹嘘自己是王子。”

商非凡轻叹：“小孩子的特性。”

“是啊。然后他就被嘲笑和羞辱了。后来他在嘲笑声中明白了私生子的含义，之后小拉斐尔的性格就有了一些变化。他变得沉默寡言，变得自卑。原本他虽然算不上活泼的孩子，但也绝谈不上自卑胆小，除了有点惧怕自己的母亲。安妮塔对他来说算是严母。”

“那位没有开导他？”

“我不知道，我没有相关记忆。也许被伤害的记忆总是最深刻的，我大脑记得的几乎都是被人辱骂嘲笑吐口水以及被围殴的片段。还有好朋友跟小拉斐尔绝交，只因为其家长不想自家孩子和不名誉的私生子玩耍。”

商非凡心里很不是滋味，哪怕知道小时候的拉斐尔不是现在的郎沐，但他还是为小小的原身难受。

“安妮塔应该是发现了这种情况，就拘着小拉斐尔，让他不要随便出门。小拉斐尔自己也不想出门，小小年纪就宅在家里，但他心里应该是渴望朋友的。”

不帅轻声说：“六年半前，丰收祭当天，那一天整个王城都非常热闹，会有各种祭祀活动，一直会闹到深夜。十四岁的拉斐尔收到昔日好友相约。”

“对方表示自己长大了，知道当年做错了，说拉斐尔的身世不应该成为阻碍两人友情发展的阻碍，想要和拉斐尔在丰收祭这一天重新恢复友谊。当时非常缺乏伙伴，也非常渴望友谊的拉斐尔就瞒着安妮塔，从家里偷跑了出去。”

不帅按住心脏，他来到这具身体后，有一段时间，心脏总是会莫名抽痛。

那时他以为是伤口的缘故，后来他才知道那是小拉斐尔最后的感情残留。

小拉斐尔没有留下他最后被人杀死的记忆，可能那段记忆对他来说太残忍或太可怕，以至于直接从自己的大脑里抹消掉。

“当年约小拉斐尔出门的人，现在怎样？”商非凡问。

不帅扭头看他：“你想干嘛？”

“不干嘛。就了解一下。”

“四年半前，我把对方约出来决斗。对方比我大一岁，大概觉得不可能会输给我，就来了。然后我斩断了他一支手臂。”

“太轻了。”商非凡不满地嘟哝。

不帅理智地说：“约小拉斐尔出门的是他，但最后杀死小拉斐尔的人并不是他，他只是一个引小拉斐尔出门的引子。”

商非凡心想：这就是他和不帅最大的不同之处，不帅会适可而止，而他不会。他睚眦必报，不让自己爽快了，绝不会收手。

“当年没有详细调查那少年？”

“安妮塔按下了这件事。有人上门询问，包括虎王询问，她都让我不要提太多，只说我自己调皮偷跑出去玩耍，莫名其妙被捅了一刀，连凶手的脸都没看清楚。而我当时确实什么都不知道，相关记忆，我也是后来才接收到一点。”

商非凡有种安妮塔夫人也许知道什么的错觉。

他看向不帅的眼睛，发现不帅可能也有同样想法。

“那当年到底是谁杀了小拉斐尔？”

“不知道。”不帅不等商非凡询问，就把他知道的情况全部说出：“我没有那时的记忆，梦中可能梦到过一些，加上我打听来的消息，大致拼凑出一幅画面。小拉斐尔到了约定的地方，没有见到朋友。他被卷入祭祀人群中，等暗中保护他的人发现不对劲，赶过去，他已经胸口中刀倒在地上。等送回家时，他已经伤重无救。”

“凶手一直没有找到？”商非凡问。

不帅摇头：“没有。”

商非凡忽然仰头看天，“我这边还有点事，具体情况等我晚上去找你和你详说。等会儿我会纠缠你，你拒绝我，单独离开就好。”

不帅：“……”

虽然不知道商非凡从哪里得知安妮塔夫人没死的消息，但这件事显然牵扯到他，他都能感觉出商非凡身上的煞气。

“你，小心。”不帅轻轻说。

明明很普通的话，说着却有些不好意思。

商非凡……阿瑞斯商冲他一笑，忍不住上前，用力抱住他。

不帅顺势踹开他，转身就跑。

阿瑞斯商在后面追了几步，停下，看着不帅的背影发出怪笑，吹着口哨跳上跑过来的巨虫坐骑，也离开了王城公墓山。

刚刚他询问天眼系统，安妮塔夫人下葬后两三天内，有没有人单独从墓室里出来。

天眼系统给了他回应：【有。外表男性，穿着像是苦力，戴着一顶破毡帽，在安妮塔下葬的第二天晚上单独从墓室里走出来。而之前，并没有这样一个人走入墓室。】

“看来你很早就盯上了不帅？因为你发觉不帅很可能是外来灵魂？还是你一直在追踪自然之神遗失的力量，所以一直在监视拥有石耳的安妮塔？”

天眼系统沉默。

“你作为天眼系统应该能从兽人的五官特征来判断那人是谁吧？”商非凡明智地换了一个问题。

天眼系统：【高明的化妆术可以掩饰五官特征。】

“那你能透视骨骼吗？”

【不能。】

“行吧，看样子你把那个苦力也盯丢了，对么？”

天眼系统再次沉默，不过这次应该不是不想回答，而是大约不太愿意承认自己盯丢人的事实？

商非凡笑：“那么你总能告诉我，那个苦力离开王城公墓后的最后一个落脚点在哪里吧？就是你盯丢前的落脚点。”

天眼系统这次火速给出了答复：【金溪庄园。】

阿瑞斯商只觉得这个名字十分熟悉，一回忆：艹！这不是丹顿侯爵一家现在正被软禁的地方吗？

阿瑞斯商正要让狰爷带他前往金溪庄园，但转念一想，他如果就这么大咧咧地过去好像不太好，太高调了，也没什么适合的借口。

嗯，该是隐身道具发挥作用的时候了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 139: The Invisible Man (Part 1)

"Actually, I'd had my suspicions for a long time," Bu Shuai said in a low voice using Xia Kingdom's tongue as they walked down the mountain.

Shang Feifan didn't utter a sound, walking right beside him like a dutiful companion.

"The feeling she gave me was immensely powerful and tenacious—the sort of person who would stop at nothing to achieve her goals. She really didn't seem like the kind of person who would give up her life for a child... for me."

Bu Shuai wanted to say that Anita wasn't a kind and gentle mother, but then he remembered he wasn't actually her biological child, feeling he had no qualification to make such a remark.

"Do you have memories of your early childhood?" Shang Feifan also switched to their mother tongue, asking in a soft voice.

Bu Shuai pondered for a moment. "There are some memory fragments hidden away in the deepest recesses of my brain; occasionally, these fragments flash across my mind. When I dream at night, I see even more. It's just that sometimes I can't tell whether those are dreams or things that actually happened."

"Then what kind of person do you think you were when you were little? And how was your relationship with *her*?" Shang Feifan asked again.

Bu Shuai answered rather hesitantly: "I don't know. Most of the memories I receive come from my adolescent years, roughly after I turned ten. By then, Raphael already knew he was an illegitimate child. However, once he found out he was the Beast King's child, he was proud of it for a time—he desperately wanted to see the Beast King and even bragged to others that he was a prince."

Shang Feifan sighed softly: "Typical characteristics of a young child."

"Indeed. And then he was mocked and humiliated. Later, amidst the ridicule, he finally understood the meaning of 'illegitimate child,' and young Raphael's personality underwent some changes. He became taciturn and introverted. Originally, while he couldn't be called a particularly lively child, he was certainly never introverted or cowardly—aside from being somewhat terrified of his mother. To him, Anita could be considered a stern mother."

"Didn't she counsel him?"

"I don't know; I don't have relevant memories. Perhaps the memories of being hurt are always the deepest; almost everything my brain remembers consists of fragments of being cursed, mocked, spat upon, and beaten in groups. There was also his best friend breaking ties with young Raphael, simply because that friend's parents didn't want their child playing with a disreputable bastard."

Shang Feifan felt a sour ache in his heart. Even knowing that the young Raphael wasn't the current Lang Mu, he still felt distressed for the little original soul.

"Anita must have noticed this situation, so she kept a tight leash on young Raphael, forbidding him from going out casually. Young Raphael himself didn't want to go out either, turning into a shut-in at such a tender age, but deep down, he must have longed for friends."

Bu Shuai said softly, "Six and a half years ago, on the day of the Harvest Festival, the entire royal city was extremely bustling with all sorts of sacrificial activities that would rage on until late into the night. Fourteen-year-old Raphael received an invitation to meet from an old friend."

"The other party expressed that he had grown up and realized he was wrong back then, saying that Raphael's birth status shouldn't become an obstacle to the development of their friendship, and wanting to restore their friendship on the day of the Harvest Festival. At the time, Raphael—who was severely lacking in companions and desperately yearned for friendship—snuck out of the house behind Anita's back."

Bu Shuai pressed a hand against his heart. After arriving in this body, for a period of time, his chest would always experience inexplicable twinges of pain.

Back then, he had thought it was due to his wounds; only later did he realize those were the lingering emotions left behind by young Raphael.

Young Raphael hadn't retained the memory of being murdered at the very end—perhaps that memory was too cruel or terrifying for him, causing it to be wiped clean from his brain entirely.

"What has the person who invited young Raphael out back then become now?" Shang Feifan asked.

Bu Shuai turned his head to look at him: "What do you want to do?"

"Nothing much. Just inquiring."

"Four and a half years ago, I called him out for a duel. He was a year older than me and probably figured he couldn't possibly lose to me, so he showed up. Then, I severed one of his arms."

"Too light," Shang Feifan muttered with dissatisfaction.

Bu Shuai said reasonably: "He was the one who lured young Raphael out, but the person who ultimately killed young Raphael wasn't him; he was merely the bait that coaxed young Raphael out of the house."

Shang Feifan thought to himself: *This is the biggest difference between him and me. Bu Shuai knows when to stop, whereas I never do. I hold grudges and seek immediate payback; until I've made myself thoroughly satisfied, I will never let up.*

"Wasn't that youth investigated in detail back then?"

"Anita suppressed the matter. When people came to inquire—including the Beast King himself—she told me not to say too much, only claiming that I had been mischievous, snuck out to play on my own whim, and was inexplicably stabbed without even catching a glimpse of the assassin's face. And since I genuinely knew nothing at the time, I only received those related memories much later."

Shang Feifan had a lingering illusion that Madam Anita might actually have known something.

He looked into Bu Shuai's eyes and found that Bu Shuai probably harbored the exact same thought.

"Then who on earth killed young Raphael back then?"

"I don't know." Without waiting for Shang Feifan to ask, Bu Shuai spilled everything he knew: "I don't have memories of that time. I might have dreamt of some pieces, and combined with information I gathered around, I roughly pieced together a scene. Little Raphael arrived at the designated spot and didn't see his friend. He got swept up in the sacrificial crowd, and by the time the guards secretly protecting him noticed something was amiss and rushed over, he had already collapsed with a knife wound to his chest. By the time they carried him home, his injuries were too severe to save."

"The murderer has never been found?" Shang Feifan asked.

Bu Shuai shook his head: "Never."

Shang Feifan suddenly raised his head to look at the sky. "I still have some business on my end; I'll come find you tonight to fill you in on the specifics. Later on, I'm going to pester you—you just need to reject me and leave by yourself."

Bu Shuai: "..."

Although he didn't know where Shang Feifan had learned that Madam Anita was still alive, this matter clearly involved him, and he could palpably sense the fierce killing intent radiating off Shang Feifan.

"You... be careful," Bu Shuai said softly.

It was a very ordinary phrase, yet speaking it made him feel somewhat embarrassed.

Shang Feifan... Ares Shang flashed him a grin, couldn't help stepping forward, and pulled him into a tight embrace.

Bu Shuai smoothly kicked him away and turned to run.

Ares Shang chased after him for a few steps, halted, let out a bizarre cackle at Bu Shuai's retreating figure, whistled, leaped onto his summoned giant insect mount, and similarly departed from the Royal City Cemetery Mountain.

Just moments ago, when he questioned the Eye of Heaven System, he had asked whether anyone had walked out of the tomb alone within two or three days after Madam Anita's burial.

The Eye of Heaven System had given him a reply: [Yes. A male in appearance, dressed like a laborer, wearing a tattered felt hat, walked out of the tomb alone on the second night after Anita's burial. Prior to that, no such individual had entered the tomb.]

"It looks like you've had your eyes on Bu Shuai for a very long time? Because you realized Bu Shuai was most likely an otherworldly soul? Or have you been tracking the lost power of the God of Nature all along, which is why you've been monitoring Anita, who possessed the Earth's Ear?"

The Eye of Heaven System fell silent.

"As the Eye of Heaven System, you should be able to deduce who that person was based on an Orc's facial features, right?" Shang Feifan sensibly changed his question.

Eye of Heaven System: [Advanced makeup techniques can disguise facial features.]

"Can you perform X-ray skeletal scans then?"

[Cannot.]

"Fine, looks like you lost track of that laborer too, right?"

The Eye of Heaven System fell silent once more. This time, however, it probably wasn't because it didn't want to answer, but rather because it was rather reluctant to admit the fact that it had lost track of someone?

Shang Feifan laughed: "Then surely you can at least tell me where that laborer's last stopping point was after leaving the Royal City Cemetery? The exact location before you lost track of him."

This time, the Eye of Heaven System provided a swift reply: [Golden Stream Manor.]

Ares Shang found this name extremely familiar. Upon recalling: *Damn it! Isn't this the place where Marquis Danton's family is currently being kept under house arrest?!*

Ares Shang was about to have the Fiend-Beast carry him toward Golden Stream Manor, but on second thought, it seemed rather inappropriate to just swagger over like that—far too high-profile, and without any suitable pretext.

Ah, it was time for his invisibility items to shine.

chunks.chineseText:
疑似安妮塔的苦力最后去的地方，和丹顿侯爵一家软禁的地方，竟然是同一个地方。这样的巧合地点，当然值得好好查一查。

王宫内。

王后正在听手下跟她汇报“阿瑞斯商特地去墓地祭拜安妮塔夫人”的消息。

听完，王后放下正端着的精致骨杯，只觉得今天的心情全都被破坏了。

那个女人，连死了都让她不舒服。

什么时候那对母子才会彻底消失？

王后心里很清楚安妮塔是在报复。

她一开始对安妮塔姐妹俩确实有那么一点点愧疚之心，但是在安妮塔勾搭上虎王后，这点愧疚就完全消失了。

石耳本来就是丹顿家族所有，他们想要收回来有问题吗？

不管是安妮塔的母亲琼，还是安妮塔本人，他们都是丹顿血脉，原本就应该为家族服务。

可琼咬死她拿到石耳不久，石耳就失踪了。用她丈夫的命和两个女儿的未来也没逼出来。

安妮塔找到王城时，一开始她并不知道对方身份，直到对方主动暴露。

想到安妮塔主动找上她，对她耀武扬威地说出自己的真实身份，还威胁她……

王后现在想起这一段，都恨不得把安妮塔当场剁成肉泥！

要不是丹顿侯爵坚持，她也不可能答应安妮塔的条件。

结果呢？

这个小贱人跟她那个柔弱却爱说谎的妈一样，嘴里就没有一句真话！

她死了，却违反诺言并没有交出石耳！

现在她还要眼睁睁地看着小贱人生的野种在她眼睛上蹦跶。

为什么那个野种就是不死？

为什么他的运气会这么好？

明明长得很一般，竟然会被阿瑞斯商那样的年轻炼金师给看上！

“丹顿侯爵还没有找到吗？”王后有点焦躁地质问。

下属低头，“没有。”

“继续找！他肯定会留下线……”王后忽然一顿，“你亲自去一趟金溪庄园，跟尤金妮亚说，让她想办法来见我。”

“是。”

尤金妮亚就是丹顿侯爵的现任情-妇，目前和丹顿侯爵的子女一起被软禁在金溪庄园。

因为之前虎王的警告，王后不好再堂而皇之地和尤金妮亚见面，只能让对方设法来见她。

虽然他们都被软禁了，但王后相信尤金妮亚那个女人一定有办法摆脱看守他们的人来秘密见她，还不会让人察觉。

当晚，尤金妮亚果然就来了。

她穿着一身宫廷侍女的装束，容貌说不上艳丽，脸部棱角分明，带着女生男相的味儿，但很耐看。

“侯爵还没有联系你？”王后把所有侍从全都赶出去，只留下尤金妮亚一人，这才问道。

尤金妮亚在面对王后时，态度不亢不卑：“没有。”

“他有没有跟你说遇到这样的事情，有没有什么紧急预案？或者特别的联络方式？”王后端坐在椅子中。

尤金妮亚点头，又摇头：“我试过所有联络方法，都无法联络到侯爵大人。”

王后心里咯噔一下，“这么说……不！他不可能出事！”

尤金妮亚却冷静地说：“距离侯爵大人失踪，时间已经过去近一个月，我们必须考虑最糟糕的可能性。”

王后猛地捏紧椅子扶手，又慢慢放松。

“也许他只是进入了休息状态，也许……”王后低喃。

“对了，那个巨人！”王后打起精神，脸上露出怒容：“当时就是一个巨人和侯爵打斗，侯爵之后才会失踪。找到那个巨人就能找到侯爵。”

尤金妮亚：“那边已经在找，他们也很重视这个巨人。”

王后也在利用她和丹顿家族的力量找寻那个巨人的线索。

当时黑森林城确实有很多人目睹到巨人和丹顿侯爵的战斗，可因为两人战斗波及范围太大，根本没有人敢靠近他们。

最后巨人带着丹顿侯爵进入黑森林后失踪。

王后已经派出大量人手去黑森林中搜索，可至今还没有发现任何有效线索。

尤金妮亚忽然道：“只要侯爵大人不出现，黑森林城的掌控权就无法回到丹顿家族手中。虎王也会趁机收回原本属于丹顿家族的领地和权力。陛下，我们必须尽快让大少爷继承爵位，让丹顿血脉拿回本应属于丹顿家族的一切。”

王后按住额头，她让尤金妮亚来找她，是希望尤金妮亚那边能有她没有的线索，结果尤金妮亚却跟她建议推她的侄子继承爵位。

如果不是知道尤金妮亚是丹顿侯爵的死忠，只忠心于丹顿侯爵一人，王后都要怀疑尤金妮亚是不是和她的大侄子达成了什么协议，还是有了什么首尾。

尤金妮亚重点点出：“陛下！地下城。”

王后抬起头：“我知道地下城对于丹顿家族的重要性，但那座图书馆的出现，虎王必定不会让地下城再落入其他人手中。”

“那我们也可以争取共享权。毕竟从第一代丹顿侯爵开始，黑森林城地面上地面下的一切都属于丹顿家族。”

王后摇头：“你想的太简单了。如果是其他人发现那座图书馆，丹顿家族还有插一脚的可能性。但发现那座图书馆并掌握进出门卡的人却是……拉斐尔郎沐。”

一提到这个名字，王后的心脏就忍不住刺痛。

再一想到就是这个被她当做臭虫一样的该死私生子，竟然立下如此大功。

为什么就是拉斐尔郎沐？

为什么不能是别人？

“这也证明了我们之前的推测。自然之神的一部分力量必然就在拉斐尔郎沐身上。因为有自然之神的力量影响在，他才可能发现神殿，并能顺利抵达第三重神殿，打开了那座图书馆。同样也因为他身上的自然之神的力量，让他拥有了别人没有的运势。”尤金妮亚缓缓说道。

“可我曾经让人翻遍他身边所有东西，并没有发现那只石耳。”王后也在怀疑，但又拿不出证据。

尤金妮亚：“如果他已经吸收了自然之神的力量呢？”

“你说什么？！”王后脸色陡然变得狰狞。

“拉斐尔郎沐自从暴露身份，他身边就从没有安宁过。你我都知道他遭受过什么，但他一直都活得好好的。那时候我就在怀疑，是不是那只石耳的力量在保护他。”

尤金妮亚侃侃而谈：“当然，虎王陛下盯得紧，也是他能活到现在的原因之一。但六年半前，拉斐尔郎沐遭受到的伤害绝对是必死伤害，别说只是一个十三四岁的小孩子，就是虎王，在那样的伤势下也不可能挺得过去。”

“可他在躺了半年后，竟然痊愈了，还越活越健康。”

“你是说……”王后脸上流露出强烈恨意和懊悔。

尤金妮亚：“有没有可能拉斐尔郎沐就是在那时候吸收了那只石耳中自然之神的力量？他的个人能力也是从那时候开始提升了很多，还被陛下收到身边当近卫。”

王后冷笑：“虎王把那个野种收到身边当近卫，不是欣赏他的能力，是怕他再受到类似伤害，那是我们的陛下对他私生子的保护。”
chunks.englishText:
The place where the suspected laborers of Anita ended up and the location where Marquis Denton’s family was placed under house arrest turned out to be one and the same. Such a coincidence in location was certainly worth investigating thoroughly.

Inside the Royal Palace.

The Queen was listening to her subordinate report the news that "the Ares merchant went to the cemetery to pay his respects to Madam Anita."

Upon hearing this, the Queen put down the delicate bone china cup she was holding, feeling that her entire mood for the day had been completely ruined.

That woman—even in death—still managed to make her uncomfortable.

When would that pair of mother and son completely disappear?

The Queen knew very well in her heart that Anita was exacting revenge.

She had indeed felt a tiny, fleeting pang of guilt toward the two Anita sisters at the very beginning, but that guilt vanished entirely the moment Anita seduced the Tiger King.

The Stone Ear belonged to the Denton family in the first place; was there anything wrong with them wanting to take it back?

Whether it was Anita’s mother, Joan, or Anita herself, they both carried Denton blood and were naturally meant to serve the family.

Yet Joan had stubbornly insisted that the Stone Ear went missing shortly after she obtained it. Even using her husband’s life and the future of her two daughters failed to force it out of her.

When Anita arrived at the Royal City, the Queen initially did not know her identity until the other party took the initiative to expose it.

Thinking back to how Anita had brazenly sought her out, flaunted her true identity, and even threatened her...

Even now, recalling that episode made the Queen wish she could hack Anita into minced meat on the spot!

If not for the insistence of Marquis Denton, she would never have agreed to Anita’s terms.

And the result?

This little bitch, just like her frail yet mendacious mother, didn’t have a single truthful word in her mouth!

She died, yet she violated her promise and failed to hand over the Stone Ear!

And now, she had to watch with her own eyes as the bastard spawn born of that little bitch pranced around right before her.

Why wouldn't that bastard just die?

Why was his luck so infuriatingly good?

Despite having utterly ordinary looks, he had actually caught the eye of a young alchemist like the Ares merchant!

"Has Marquis Denton still not been found?" the Queen demanded with a hint of agitation.

Her subordinate lowered his head. "No."

"Keep looking! He must have left some clu—" The Queen suddenly paused. "You, go to Golden Creek Manor in person and tell Eugenia to find a way to see me."

"Yes."

Eugenia was the current mistress of Marquis Denton, currently under house arrest at Golden Creek Manor along with the Marquis’s children.

Because of the Tiger King’s previous warning, it was no longer convenient for the Queen to meet Eugenia openly; she could only have the woman figure out a way to see her.

Even though they were under house arrest, the Queen believed that a woman like Eugenia would definitely find a way to slip past their guards to meet her in secret without alerting anyone.

That night, Eugenia indeed arrived.

She was dressed in the attire of a palace maid. Her features were not exceptionally dazzling, but her face was sharply chiseled, carrying a masculine elegance that grew more striking the longer one looked.

"Has the Marquis still not contacted you?" The Queen dismissed all her attendants, leaving only Eugenia behind, before asking the question.

Facing the Queen, Eugenia’s demeanor was neither servile nor overbearing. "No."

"Did he mention any emergency protocols or special methods of contact in the event of such a situation?" The Queen sat regally in her chair.

Eugenia nodded, then shook her head. "I have tried every single method of contact, but it is impossible to reach Lord Marquis."

The Queen’s heart skipped a beat. "You mean to say... No! Nothing could have happened to him!"

Eugenia, however, said calmly, "Nearly a month has passed since Lord Marquis disappeared. We must consider the worst-case scenario."

The Queen gripped the armrests of her chair fiercely, then slowly relaxed her hands.

"Perhaps he has simply entered a state of seclusion; perhaps..." the Queen murmured.

"Ah, that giant!" The Queen rallied herself, a look of fury crossing her face. "At the time, it was a giant fighting with the Marquis, and the Marquis went missing afterward. Find that giant, and we will find the Marquis."

Eugenia replied, "Our people are already searching that side as well. They place great importance on this giant, too."

The Queen, too, was utilizing her own and the Denton family’s resources to hunt for clues about the giant.

Back then, many people in Black Forest City had indeed witnessed the battle between the giant and Marquis Denton. However, because the shockwaves of their combat spanned too vast an area, no one dared to approach them.

In the end, the giant had taken Marquis Denton into the Black Forest and vanished.

The Queen had already dispatched a massive number of hands to search the depths of the Black Forest, but to this day, no effective clues had turned up.

Suddenly, Eugenia said, "As long as Lord Marquis does not reappear, control of Black Forest City cannot return to the hands of the Denton family. The Tiger King will also take advantage of this opportunity to reclaim the territories and authority that rightfully belong to the Denton family. Your Majesty, we must as soon as possible have the eldest young master inherit the title, allowing the Denton bloodline to take back everything that rightfully belongs to them."

The Queen pressed her fingertips to her temples. She had summoned Eugenia in the hope that the woman might possess clues she herself lacked, yet Eugenia was instead advising her to push her nephew to inherit the title.

If she didn't know that Eugenia was a die-hard loyalist devoted solely to Marquis Denton, the Queen would have suspected whether Eugenia had struck some kind of deal or entanglement with her eldest nephew.

Eugenia emphasized pointedly, "Your Majesty! The underground city."

The Queen raised her head. "I am aware of the underground city's importance to the Denton family, but with the appearance of that library, the Tiger King will undoubtedly refuse to let the underground city fall into anyone else's hands."

"Then we can also strive for shared rights. After all, ever since the first generation of Marquis Denton, everything above and below ground in Black Forest City has belonged to the Denton family."

The Queen shook her head. "You are thinking too simply. If anyone else had discovered that library, the Denton family would still have a chance to wedge a foot in. But the one who discovered the library and holds the entrance and exit cards is..."

"...Raphael Langmu."

At the mere mention of this name, a sharp pang pierced the Queen's heart.

And the thought that this damned bastard, whom she regarded as nothing more than a lowly bug, had achieved such a monumental merit...

Why did it have to be Raphael Langmu?

Why couldn't it have been someone else?

"This also proves our previous hypothesis. A portion of the God of Nature's power must reside within Raphael Langmu. It is precisely because of the influence of the God of Nature's power that he was able to discover the shrine, successfully reach the third tier of the shrine, and unlock that library. It is also thanks to the power of the God of Nature within him that he possesses a fortune no one else enjoys," Eugenia said slowly.

"Yet I once had people tear apart every single belonging around him, and that Stone Ear was never found." The Queen harbored suspicions too, but lacked any evidence.

Eugenia countered, "What if he has already absorbed the power of the God of Nature inside that Stone Ear?"

"What did you say?!" The Queen’s expression abruptly twisted into something ferocious.

"Ever since Raphael Langmu’s identity was exposed, he has never known a moment of peace. You and I both know what he has endured, yet he has continued to live on quite well. At the time, I began to wonder if the power of that Stone Ear was protecting him."

Eugenia spoke fluently and logically, "Of course, His Majesty the Tiger King keeping a close watch is also one of the reasons he has survived until now. But six and a half years ago, the injuries Raphael Langmu suffered were absolute fatal wounds. To say nothing of a mere thirteen or fourteen-year-old child, even the Tiger King would find it impossible to pull through injuries of that magnitude."

"Yet, after lying in bed for half a year, he miraculously recovered, and has only grown healthier by the day."

"Are you saying..." A wave of intense hatred and profound regret surfaced on the Queen’s face.

Eugenia concluded, "Is it possible that Raphael Langmu absorbed the God of Nature's power from that Stone Ear back then? His personal capabilities also skyrocketed starting from that period, which was why His Majesty took him in as a personal guard."

The Queen sneered. "The Tiger King taking that bastard in as a guard isn't out of appreciation for his abilities—it's to prevent him from suffering similar harm again. That is simply our sovereign protecting his illegitimate son."

chunks.chineseText:
尤金妮亚无视王后对虎王的复杂感情，只淡淡陈述：“好在那边知道如何提取自然之神力量的方法。神的力量可不是那么好吸收的。只要我们抓住拉斐尔，把他送到那边，就能把他身体里自然之神的力量重新提取出来。”

王后沉默片刻：“现在不好动他。那个阿瑞斯商太高调，引得现在整个王城的人都在注意那个野种。而且他发现图书馆还献出进出门卡的事，也传到了几个老家伙的耳朵中，他们因此对那野种的印象也改观和提升不少。”

“如果那野种现在出事，哪怕只是失踪，也会引起整个王城震动，虎王必定会大力寻找他，更会……找到我头上。他现在巴不得找个理由把我废掉，如果让他抓住把柄……”王后脸上露出强烈的恨和怨。

尤金妮亚见王后一副陷入个人情绪当中的势头，心脏一跳，连忙转换话题：“陛下，关于那个炼金师阿瑞斯商，您这边知道多少？”

王后回过神，一次深呼吸就恢复了平静：“我正在查。现在只知道他来到王城时身边没有一个仆人，他现在的三个仆人都是从雇工市场临时雇佣而来。”

“能收买那三个仆人吗？”

“很多人都在这么做。”王后冷笑，“那三个仆人也是见钱就收，但他们传出的消息却不多。阿瑞斯商更喜欢单独行动，并不喜欢带上仆人。”

“阿瑞斯商能炼制储物工具，那边对他也很感兴趣。很想知道他的材料清单和炼制方法。”尤金妮亚说。

王后脸色变冷：“让那边先别想这些有的没的，他们想要利用我，也得先做到我要求的事情。如今，不但那个野种活得好好的，就连莫约镇那边也平安无事，现在更让那野种在王城大出风头。他们是怎么办事的？”

尤金妮亚：“那边传来消息，说拉斐尔身边有人相助。”

“有人相助？谁？”

“是个很神秘的家伙，带着一个小鬼，同样来历不明。但根据那边收集到的些许情报，据说拉斐尔和那人很亲密，吃住都在一起。”

王后眉毛一挑，讽刺：“看不出来那野种还能这么受欢迎。那个神秘人现在在哪里？”

“不知道，没有查出来。那名雄性兽人把孩子留在了莫约镇，本人则消失了，没人能查到他的踪迹。就跟拉斐尔突然出现在王城一样。”

王后心中一动：“那个人会不会也在王城？只是隐藏在暗处帮拉斐尔办事？”

尤金妮亚：“很可能。”

王后忽然又道：“你说那个神秘人会不会就是那个巨人？”

不等尤金妮亚回答，王后就自己摇头道：“应该不会。如果那个小野种有这么一个帮手，他回到王城就不可能这么安分。”

王后又满是讥讽地说：“那个小野种在拥有那么大的功劳后，还有这么一个巨人帮他，那虎王的位子，他还真的不是不能想。”

尤金妮亚在仔细思考后，也觉得拉斐尔身边的神秘人就是巨人的可能性不大。

因为如果换了她是拉斐尔，有了这么一个能打败丹顿侯爵的巨人帮手，那一定会在王城闹个天翻地覆，至少也要把丹顿家族连根拔起。

王后不知道想到什么，忽然笑起来：“你说如果让那个神秘人知道阿瑞斯商和那个野种发生了亲密关系，那个神秘人会怎么做？”

尤金妮亚有点看不上王后这个想法，但也不得不承认，这种阴私手段往往会有奇效。

拉斐尔是有功于虎国乃至整个兽人大陆不错，但如果是他自己惹出来的风流债，导致他被自己的情人或追求者误伤或杀死，那再怎么也不可能怪到别人头上不是？

王后没有跟尤金妮亚透露太多，尤金妮亚有她的事要做，至于她的谋算自然有其他人会帮她完成。

尤金妮亚再次叮嘱王后，让她找个合适时机尽快把下一代丹顿给推到黑森林城城主之位上，最起码也要继承丹顿家族的爵位和领地。

王后有点心烦，挥挥手表示知道，让尤金妮亚安排那边的人继续寻找丹顿侯爵，同时留意那个巨人的消息，就让尤金妮亚离开了。

尤金妮亚走出王后起居室，忽然扭头往后看了一眼。

刚刚有一瞬间，她总觉得那间起居室里还有第三个人。

尤金妮亚从王宫出来后就上了一辆兽车，进入王城一条热闹的商业街后，下车，进入一家酒馆。

过了一会儿，身穿侍女服侍的尤金妮亚消失，一名身穿皮甲、肩背弓箭的年轻猎人从酒馆出来。

年轻猎人像是喝醉了，身体摇晃，三绕两绕走进一条小巷子。

这条小巷子是有名的赌鬼巷。

去不起大型赌场的赌鬼们就喜欢往这里钻。

门上画着特有标记的房子，敲开门，里面就是一个小赌场，一群赌鬼在里面厮混。

年轻猎人用力敲打一扇门。

刷！大门上端特意留出的观察孔被打开，里面有人向外观察。

大约是在打量年轻猎人。

不知道年轻猎人是这里的常客，还是他看起来就像是来赌钱的，观察孔合上，大门被拉开一条缝，只容年轻猎人侧身进去。

打手关上门的时候，感觉有点风从自己身边吹过，还感觉有什么擦过自己手臂。

但他前后左右看看，只看到刚才的年轻猎人挤进人堆，没一会儿就没了人影。

打手也没多在意，只当是错觉。
chunks.englishText:
Ignoring the Queen’s complicated emotions toward the Tiger King, Eugenia simply stated, "Fortunately, *they* know how to extract the power of the God of Nature. A god's power is not so easily absorbed. As long as we capture Raphael and send him over there, the power of the God of Nature within his body can be extracted once again."

The Queen was silent for a moment. "It’s not wise to make a move against him right now. That Ares Shang is too high-profile; he’s drawn the attention of the entire royal city to that little bastard. Furthermore, the news that he donated entrance passes after discovering the library has reached the ears of those old fogies. Because of this, their impression of that little bastard has changed and improved quite a bit."

"If anything happens to that little bastard now—even if it's just a disappearance—it will cause a tremor throughout the entire royal city. The Tiger King will definitely pull out all the stops to search for him, and worse... it will lead right back to me. He's currently just itching to find a reason to strip me of my position. If he gets a hold of any handle against me..." Intense hatred and resentment surfaced on the Queen's face.

Seeing that the Queen was on the verge of sinking back into her personal emotions, Eugenia’s heart skipped a beat, and she quickly changed the subject. "Your Majesty, how much do you know about that alchemist, Ares Shang?"

The Queen snapped out of it, recovering her composure with a single deep breath. "I am currently investigating. All we know so far is that he arrived in the royal city without a single servant. His three current servants were temporarily hired from the labor market."

"Can those three servants be bought off?"

"Many people are trying to do just that," the Queen sneered. "Those three servants are the type to take money the moment they see it, but they haven't leaked much information. Ares Shang prefers to act alone and doesn't like dragging servants around."

"Ares Shang is capable of refining storage artifacts, and *they* are very interested in him. They are quite eager to know his ingredient list and refining methods," Eugenia said.

The Queen’s expression turned cold. "Tell them to put aside these idle fancies for now. If they want to use me, they must first accomplish what I demand of them. Not only is that little bastard still living quite comfortably, but even Moye Town remains safe and sound, and now that wretched boy is even making a huge splash in the royal city. How are they handling things?"

Eugenia replied, "Word came from that side that someone is assisting Raphael."

"Assisting him? Who?"

"It’s a very mysterious fellow accompanied by a brat, equally of unknown origin. But according to the scraps of intelligence they've gathered, Raphael is supposedly very intimate with this person, eating and living together."

The Queen raised an eyebrow, speaking with sarcasm. "I wouldn't have thought that little bastard could be so popular. Where is this mysterious person right now?"

"Unknown. We haven't been able to find out. That male beastman left the child in Moye Town while he himself vanished into thin air. No one can trace his whereabouts, just like how Raphael suddenly appeared in the royal city."

A thought stirred in the Queen's mind. "Could that person also be in the royal city? Just hiding in the shadows and doing Raphael's bidding?"

"Very likely," Eugenia said.

Suddenly, the Queen brought up another angle: "Do you think that mysterious person could be that giant?"

Before Eugenia could answer, the Queen shook her head herself. "Probably not. If that little bastard had such a helper, he wouldn't have been so well-behaved upon returning to the royal city."

The Queen continued with full of mockery, "With that little bastard achieving such a massive merit, coupled with having a giant to help him... as for the Tiger King's throne, it really isn't impossible for him to harbor ambitions for it."

After careful consideration, Eugenia also felt it unlikely that the mysterious figure by Raphael's side was the giant.

Because if she were in Raphael's place—having a helper capable of defeating Marquis Denton—she definitely would have turned the royal city upside down, or at the very least, uprooted the entire Denton family.

The Queen seemed to think of something, and suddenly chuckled. "What do you think would happen if that mysterious person found out that Ares Shang and that little bastard had engaged in an intimate relationship?"

Though Eugenia held a rather low opinion of this petty scheme of the Queen's, she had to admit that such underhanded, sordid tactics often yielded miraculous results.

It was true that Raphael had rendered great service to the Tiger Kingdom and even the entire Beastman Continent, but if he were accidentally injured or killed by his own lover or pursuer due to a romantic debt of his own making, then no matter what, the blame could never be pinned on anyone else, could it?

The Queen did not reveal too much more to Eugenia. Eugenia had her own tasks to attend to, and as for the Queen's plotting, naturally, there were others who would help her carry it out.

Eugenia once again reminded the Queen to find a suitable opportunity as soon as possible to push the next generation of the Dentons into the position of Lord of Black Forest City, or at the very least, have him inherit the Denton family's title and fiefdom.

Annoyed, the Queen waved her hand to show she understood. She instructed Eugenia to have her people continue searching for Marquis Denton while keeping an eye out for news of the giant, and then dismissed her.

Stepping out of the Queen's bedchamber, Eugenia suddenly paused and glanced back.

For a split second just then, she had a lingering intuition that there might have been a third person in that bedchamber.

After leaving the royal palace, Eugenia boarded a beast-drawn carriage. Once they entered a bustling commercial street in the royal city, she stepped down and walked into a tavern.

A short while later, Eugenia vanished, replaced by a young hunter clad in leather armor with a bow and arrows slung across her back, who emerged from the tavern.

The young hunter staggered as if drunk, swaying unsteadily as she weaved through several turns and stepped into a narrow alleyway.

This particular alley was a notorious den for gamblers.

Gamblers who couldn't afford the large-scale gambling dens loved to frequent this place.

Knocking on a door bearing a distinct mark, one would find a small gambling den hidden inside, teeming with a crowd of degenerate gamblers.

The young hunter pounded heavily on one of the doors.

*Swish!* The peephole specially reserved at the top of the heavy door was flung open, and someone peered out from within.

They were likely sizing up the young hunter.

Whether recognizing the young hunter as a regular or simply judging that she looked like she was here to gamble, the peephole slammed shut, and the heavy door was pulled open just a crack—just enough for the young hunter to slide through sideways.

As the bouncer pulled the door shut, he felt a faint gust of wind brush past him, accompanied by the sensation of something grazing his arm.

Yet when he looked left, right, front, and back, he saw only the aforementioned young hunter squeezing into the crowd, vanishing from sight a moment later.

The bouncer didn't pay it much mind, simply chalking it up to an illusion.

chunks.chineseText:
第140章 干坏事啦

“轰隆！”

“轰隆！轰隆！”

接二连三的巨大爆炸声在夜晚的王城中响起。

一座建筑彻底倒塌，附近居住的兽人发出惊叫，纷纷从家里和店里跑出来。

城卫军和治安员听到声响，也是迅速往声音传来的方向狂奔。

赌鬼巷顿时大乱，爆炸就发生在这条巷子的巷尾。

一个又一个小赌场打开大门，几百个赌鬼大喊大叫一窝蜂地往外逃。

混乱中，某个隐身人跑出赌鬼巷，又跑过红灯区，在经过商业街时，看到一家商行门口停放了几辆拉货兽车。

领头的拉车兽体型巨大，一边吃草一边噗噗往下拉粑粑。

隐身人经过那辆兽车，走两步，停住，又退了回来。

月上高空，位于王城中心的古王宫跨越千年时间，巍然耸立在凡尘之中。

赌鬼巷那边的爆炸声并没有传到这里。

王宫中的一切都还是那么有条不紊。

王后在侍女的服侍下卸下佩饰，清洁身体，换上睡衣，掀被上床。

“啊！”

一声急促的惊叫打破了王后寝室的安宁。

王后怒不可遏，身体气到发抖。

她捂住口鼻，往后退了两步：“查！给我查清楚！查出是谁干的！”

王后怒转身，摔门走出独属于王后的宫殿。

今晚她是无论如何都不能住在这里了！

侍女们好奇与惊恐交织，看向王后的床铺。

就见整洁的大床上，在掀开的纯丝面羽绒被下，堆着好大一坨粪便。

粪便一看就不是兽人的粪便，太大坨了，而且不是特别臭，还带着一点点青草味，一看就是素食类生物，还是很大只的生物拉下的便便。

宫廷侍卫得到消息，飞快赶来，当看到床上那一大坨便便时，也不知该摆出什么表情。

这真的是伤害性不大，侮辱性极强。

尤其这还是一国王后的床铺！

虎王不久后也听到了这个荒诞的消息。

“……好好查，看看是谁干的。”虎王心中并不同情王后，他甚至有点想笑。

但是对方在王宫里做出这种事，却是打了整个王宫和他这个虎王的脸。

就算这是个恶作剧，也得把人找出来狠狠教训一通才是。

不帅在特调局的办公室等到深夜。

如今他几乎是扎根在这儿。

考虑到想他死的人不少，他住到哪儿都有可能给附近带来连带伤害，不帅干脆就没有租房。

幸好他的级别足够高，能够拥有单独的办公室，办公室还附带一间小小的休息室。

没有合拢的窗户被推开一条缝，窗帘微微抖动。

一只小虎崽子扑上不帅膝头。

不帅捞起小老虎，顺手关上窗户，窗帘落下。

周围很安静。

只要仔细查过不帅的人都知道不帅有着超凡的听力，到了晚上夜深人静的时候，极少会有人留在附近盯梢他，就算盯梢也会离得远远的。

特调局里当然还有其他工作人员在，这些人中说不定就有被收买的。

好在不帅和小老虎也有特殊的应对方法，他们说出的语言就算有人听到也不会听得懂，除非对方是玩家。

但玩家现在想要混入特调局，基本不可能。

“你是洗澡了？还是刚从河里上来？”不帅感觉到小老虎的毛发上还有点水汽。

“昂~”当然是洗澡，洗得香喷喷！

不帅闻闻，确实很香。

“你吃晚饭了吗？”不帅又摸摸小老虎的肚子，鼓鼓的，应该是吃过了。

小老虎舔舔他的手，眯眼享受不帅爱的揉肚肚~

不帅在心中叹息：怪不得很多人喜欢养猫养狗，这撸起来真的太上瘾，会让人不知不觉就沉醉进去。

如果不是知道这小老虎内在是个成年兽人，不帅真的很想把脸埋在他暖呼呼的小肚子上狠狠吸上几口。

“昂~”

“好了，别撒娇了。说吧，今天到底是怎么回事？你怎么知道安妮塔夫人没有死？”不帅两手掐着小老虎的上肢，提起来，让他坐在办公桌上。

小老虎不喜欢冰凉坚硬的木桌子，从桌子上又扑进不帅怀里。

不帅拿他没办法，这家伙就是仗着萌物的身体横行无忌。

“嗷~！”小老虎咬住不帅的手指，留下几个小牙印。

不帅捏他耳朵，捏他的爪垫，捏他的尾巴……

小老虎伸爪子打他，嗷嗷！

不帅抬起手掌和他对拍。

明明想说正事，却忍不住和小老虎玩了起来。

你拍一，我拍一……停！

不帅一把捏住和他对拍拍得特别欢的小老虎的爪子，“别把我蒙在鼓里，更别用为我好的借口，你知道我不喜欢这样。”

小老虎停止胡闹，挂在不帅的臂弯里，开口：“宝贝，我可不会干这种蠢事。”

“……你知道你用幼崽的声音说着这样的话有多可笑吗？”不帅要紧紧控制住嘴巴肌肉，才能让自己不笑场。

小老虎给了他一个幽怨的眼神，他也想变回成年兽人身体，但这不是知道你喜欢吸小老虎吗？

我都付出这么大的牺牲了，你还嘲笑我。

不帅忍笑，手指撩撩小老虎的下巴，“好吧，我的错。你想怎么叫就怎么叫好了。”

反正虎崽一样的身体，幼崽一样的声音，不管说什么，尴尬的都不会是他。

小老虎抬起爪子超凶地拍下去。

不帅接住他的爪子，顺势推倒，揉他的小肚肚。

小老虎仰躺着，四肢摊开，一副老子随便你蹂-躏的模样。

不帅喜欢死这样的小老虎了。

商非凡真的是很懂得怎么拿捏他。

不帅忍不住用手指戳他的小肚子。

戳一下，叫一声。

“昂~”

“嗷~”

“喵嗷~！”

“你喵了。”

“……没！”

“你喵了，我听到了。”

“你听错了。你有没有想过，你可能不是虎王的孩子？”

这个转移很成功，不帅立刻放弃“拷问”，脑子回归正途：“你是听到什么消息了吗？”

“来自系统。它说如果我能完成某个任务，就会用你的身世之秘奖励我。”

不帅：“看来我的……原身的身世真的有问题了。”

“就是这样。”小老虎一骨碌爬起来，主动跳到桌子上蹲坐，摆出威严不可侵犯的姿势。

不帅手指撩过他的胡须。

小老虎胡须抖了抖。他家不帅有时也很顽皮的！

“我本人对身世如何并不在意。”不帅诚实地说，任谁有了三世经历，且拥有成年人思维，都不会太在意第三世的父母是谁。

“但我的身体来自原身，虽然穿到原身身上并不是我自愿，但我通过他的身体以及安妮塔的召唤，获得了第三次生命也是事实。我想原身如果还活着，应该会很想要知道自己的亲生父母是谁，以及他为什么会成为拉斐尔郎沐。”不帅道。

小老虎明白不帅的意思，这就是要和他一起把这件事查个清楚的意思。

他就知道不帅也许不会在意，但他会为原身在意。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 140: Up to No Good

"Boom!"

"Boom! Boom!"

One after another, massive explosions echoed through the night-shrouded Royal Capital. 

A building collapsed entirely, and the Beastmen residing nearby let out alarmed shrieks, scrambling out of their homes and shops in a panic. 

Hearing the commotion, the city guards and magistrates promptly sprinted toward the source of the noise. 

Gamblers' Alley instantly descended into utter chaos; the explosions had occurred right at the tail end of the alleyway. 

One small underground casino after another flung open its doors as hundreds of gamblers roared and shrieked, pouring out in a chaotic swarm. 

Amidst the pandemonium, a certain invisible figure slipped out of Gamblers' Alley, dashed past the Red-Light District, and while passing through the Commercial Street, noticed several cargo-hauling beast-drawn carriages parked outside a merchant firm. 

The lead draft beast was massive in size, lazily chewing on fodder while plopping fresh turds onto the ground. 

The invisible figure hurried past the carriage, took two steps, stopped, and then backed up.

High in the sky hung the moon. Located at the very heart of the Royal Capital, the ancient Royal Palace stood towering over the mortal realm, spanning a history of a thousand years. 

The sounds of the explosions over in Gamblers' Alley did not reach this far. 

Everything within the palace remained as methodical and orderly as ever. 

Under the attendance of her maidservants, the Queen removed her jewelry, cleansed her body, changed into her nightgown, lifted the covers, and got into bed. 

"Ah!"

A sharp, panicked shriek shattered the peace of the Queen's bedchamber. 

Wrath consumed the Queen, her body trembling with fury.
