Chapter 143: Prelude to Mischief (Part 1)

For the next period of time, the entire Royal City seemed to have entered a phase of steady calm.

The Tiger King devoted the majority of his energy to organizing the Heritage Sharing Convention, while the remaining small fraction was directed toward the reconstruction of the Black Forest City and the arrangement of various military and political positions within it.

During a court council meeting, an official proposed to the Tiger King whether they should begin considering letting Marquis Dalton’s children inherit the Dalton family peerage and all its assets.

The Tiger King immediately declared that all matters related to the inheritance of titles in the Tiger Kingdom would be postponed until after the Sharing Convention.

During this period, if local government decrees were hindered or management was inadequate due to the temporary lack of an heir to the peerage, temporary officials would be dispatched by the Royal City to exercise interim administrative jurisdiction over the noble territory.

As soon as this administrative measure was announced, it immediately provoked opposition from quite a number of nobles.

Many nobles worried that this was a signal of the Tiger King beginning to centralize power and suppress the feudal lords.

Marquis Dalton’s relatives by marriage were the first to jump out in opposition, stating that according to the laws established at the founding of the Tiger Kingdom and passed down to this day, the ownership of land by the original landowners at the founding is recognized, and landowners are permitted to freely trade the land and resources they possess. It is recognized that nobles hold jurisdiction over their territories and subjects, and nobles are permitted to designate their own family heirs. Unless there are no longer any direct heirs within the family, noble inheritance rights should be protected by the laws of the Tiger Kingdom, rather than having the Tiger King send people to take over noble territories—not even temporarily.

The Tiger King’s faction naturally stepped forward to refute this, saying that doing so was for the better protection of the nobles' inheritance rights, preventing the interests of the heirs who truly ought to inherit the peerage and territory from being harmed in a hasty manner.

Someone even argued eloquently: Right now, the Heritage Sharing Convention is the most important matter in the Tiger Kingdom. Whether this convention can be successfully convened and smoothly carried out concerns the future of the Tiger Kingdom; no other matter can possibly compare to this convention.

Furthermore, selecting the future heir of the Dalton family is likewise an event of immense importance to the Tiger Kingdom. Such a major event naturally cannot be handled hastily; it must be decided only after careful selection and discussion.

Those who supported the Dalton family stamped their feet in anger, retorting: There is nothing to discuss about this matter; one simply needs to decide the next head of the Dalton family in accordance with the order of succession.

The King's supporters stirred the pot by arguing: When Marquis Dalton’s eldest son, Wilton, died, the second right of succession should belong to the eldest daughter, Lucia, who was two years older than the second son, Alpert, rather than to Alpert.

Hearing this, the supporters of the Dalton family immediately fired back: Then let Lucia succeed!

Then someone else jumped out to say: Lucia is already engaged; she ought not to inherit the Dalton family.

In the end, the various factions argued themselves into a tangle over exactly who should inherit the Dalton family.

After arguing to the point of exhaustion, both sides reached a compromise, temporarily coming to the following decisions regarding the inheritance of the Dalton family's peerage and those of other nobles in the near future:

First, candidates for the peerage heirs must be decided within one month after the conclusion of the Heritage Sharing Convention, with no delays permitted.

Second, during this period, noble families may designate a direct bloodline member as an interim family head to exercise jurisdiction over various matters concerning the territories and subjects within the family, including land and resource transactions. However, the latter would require review by the Tiger Kingdom’s Land General Bureau and Resource General Bureau and the Tiger King’s consent before any transactions could truly be concluded.

Anyone with discerning eyes could see that this second condition was precisely intended to prevent nobles from adopting a "broken pot, broken away" attitude or transferring assets and privately buying and selling land and resources.

The Tiger King had already curbed this loophole to the utmost of his ability; he only lamented that the laws established at the founding of the nation were extremely favorable to the nobility, and even now, attempting to modify these laws would be met with joint resistance from the vested-interest nobles.

He could only carry out some difficult administrative remedial measures without pushing all the nobles into total opposition against him.

Meanwhile, the Queen was holding a meeting with her think tank and trusted confidants.

The core focus of this meeting was how to rapidly transfer the Dalton family's land and property.

"We only have roughly half a year. Six months from now, His Majesty the King will inevitably determine the heir to the Dalton family in accordance with today's agreement and bestow the peerage. But I can tell you all with absolute certainty, this peerage will certainly not be high. His Majesty will definitely use the previous disaster at Black Forest City as an excuse to appease public sentiment, claiming the need to mete out punishment to the Dalton family as grounds to lower the peerage rank."

A think-tank strategist stated aloud the very thing everyone least wanted to hear.

The Queen was silent for a moment before nodding: "Indeed. He will indeed do that."

The strategist continued: "Once the peerage is lowered—for instance, down to a viscount or even a baron—certain nobles or officials will inevitably step forward to say that the amount of land owned by the Dalton family exceeds the maximum land area permitted for that peerage rank. His Majesty will inevitably use this as a pretext to confiscate a massive amount of the Dalton family's land and resources."

"Even if Her Majesty the Queen opposes it at that time, His Majesty the King will simply switch to another method—such as dividing the Dalton family's land and property equally among every single direct heir. Then, picking them off one by one, given a little time, he can still successfully confiscate and nationalize the Dalton family's land and property."

Hearing this, everyone inside the meeting room began to whisper among themselves in low voices.

Someone hesitated and said: "The other nobles won't agree to this, will they? Once they all consent to His Majesty the King doing this, it's equivalent to opening a dangerous floodgate."

That strategist spoke again: "They have to agree. Because His Majesty has fully justified grounds; after all, Black Forest City was the first to suffer an incident, with tens of thousands of citizens affected, and the Marquis even concealed a major event like a magma eruption. If a noble commits such a grave fault and His Majesty does not take the slightest disciplinary measure, that would truly cause the masses of nobles to panic."

Everyone fell silent.

What this strategist had said was phrased with polished restraint, yet they all knew deep down that the crime committed by Marquis Dalton was a capital offense—summoning corrosive rain that destroyed Black Forest City and subsequently sacrificing hundreds of thousands of urban residents. If it were any ordinary noble, the Tiger King would have executed him and his entire family long ago, confiscating all their property and land wholesale. Where would there be any talk of an heir inheriting the territory?

It was precisely because of the Queen's relationship with the Dalton family, coupled with the Tiger King's wariness of the combined might of the Queen and the Dalton family, that he was forced to handle the matter lightly despite its severity.

"Therefore, within these six months, we must transfer everything of the Dalton family's land, property, and whatever else can be transferred. These assets are the foundation of the Dalton family; transferring them now will allow us to preserve our strength. Once His Majesty the King finds an opportunity and begins stripping away the Dalton family's land, resources, and property, the Daltons will inevitably grow weaker and weaker until they are finally crushed by His Majesty," the strategist emphasized, raising his tone.

Everyone subconsciously looked toward the Queen seated at the head of the table.

The Queen was calm and serene for a moment before speaking: "These are all temporary measures. As long as we hold out until the next Tiger King ascends the throne, everything will return to normal. Until then, let us preserve our strength as much as possible."

With the tone set, the people in the meeting room began discussing how to transfer the Dalton family's property without suffering excessive losses.

On this day, Bu Shu suddenly received an order commanding him to go to the Royal Palace immediately.

The messenger was Wildebeest.

"His Majesty wants you to come see him right away," Wildebeest said, his expression grave.

Bu Shu immediately stood up: "Do you know what it's about?"

Wildebeest’s expression was cold and stern, but he whispered out of the corner of his mouth: "His Majesty doesn't look too happy. It seems something happened over at the Dungeon."

Bu Shu instantly guessed what might have prompted the Tiger King to summon him.

If it really was that matter, he felt quite helpless as well.

Upon arriving at the Royal Palace and meeting the Tiger King,

The Tiger King first inquired about his work, then asked him in a joking tone how he and Ares Shang were getting along, and finally said casually:

"You said that going to the shrine—that is, the library—requires a special method, and you need to wait for the shuttle vehicle at the Anji South Road station in the dungeon. But the people I dispatched have been guarding there day and night, ensuring someone is standing on the platform waiting at all times. Yet up until now, a full month has passed, and those people haven't even caught a glimpse of a single vehicle."

Bu Shu: He knew it was probably this matter.

chunks.chineseText:
“你也说了丹顿侯爵是在另一个站台，用抛出古硬币的方式召唤接引车。但很不幸，那个站台已经被岩浆淹没，现在变成了一大片岩石层。我派遣的人在那里同样尝试等待了一个月，但同样没有等来接引车。”

虎王看向不帅，语气还算温和：“实际上那座地下城绝大多数地方都被喷涌出井口的岩浆淹没，如今已经从地下城变成了一个巨大的、充满窟窿的岩石洞穴。我们等待岩浆层冷却，再打通前往安吉南路站的通道就费了很大工夫。奇妙的是，那个站台却完好无损，它就单独矗立在一个较大空洞里。”

“这是多么神奇的事情。”虎王扬手感叹。

“我需要你再跑一趟黑森林城。”虎王正色道：“这次我会派遣一支百人队伍跟你一起过去。他们会带上足够的饮食和住宿用具，如果他们有机会进入图书馆，他们的任务就是把里面的图书给抄写下来，能抄多少就抄多少。”

之前三天，虎王和他带过去的两大臣两侍卫，都抄写了一点他们感兴趣的知识。

这还是亏得虎王带着空间腰带，里面有一些备用的纸笔。

但只五个人抄写的那点东西太少了，而且他们当时以为还能随时再过来，就没有劳累自己太多。

如果不是担心图书馆那边的管理员老祖宗会反感他们带去太多人，进而取消他们进入图书馆的资格，虎王恨不得派出一千人去抄写。

当然，如果能把里面的书籍和图像资料带出来就好了，可惜不可能。他也不敢冒得罪那位老祖宗的危险硬抢。

只看那图书馆在岩浆中还能完好无损，更只能通过特别的接引车才能见到它，就知道那座图书馆蕴含的黑科技含量以及神秘学，已经超出了新生纪兽人们能理解并掌握的范畴。

虎王很确定，硬抢只会让他们失去一切。

不帅……以为自己交出借阅卡就已经甩脱了一个麻烦，没想到这个麻烦是回旋镖属性，又打回他身上了。

“好。但我也不确定到时会不会有车来接我。”不帅说。

虎王温和地道：“三天，你只要在那个车站待三天。”

不帅只能同意。

阿瑞斯商听不帅说要离开王城，去黑森林城地下再待三天，竟然没闹。

但是！

“也就是最少五天，我都看不到你了，也不能和你一起睡觉觉了。”阿瑞斯商盯着不帅的眼睛。

不帅：“……好好说话。”

阿瑞斯商凑近他：“五天！而在这之前我们已经素了整整三十六天。”

不帅：“……”

阿瑞斯商图穷匕见：“你知道适当的爱爱是治病的良药吗？它不但可以调节人的内分泌，稳定人的精神状态，促使人类心情愉悦，更能大大减少出轨可能，以及缓解精神疾病。”

不帅：“……”

阿瑞斯商看着包裹在合身制服下的不帅，眼里充满兽性的侵略光芒，往前逼近一步。

次日一大早，不帅就出发了。他要在城外和虎王准备的一百人秘密集合，一同前往黑森林城。

阿瑞斯商翻身抱住不帅的枕头，脸埋进去。

他家不帅真的是太棒了！

各种意义上。

早上他真的很不想放走不帅，但……好男人不能阻挡自己伴侣的事业，更不能让伴侣不高兴。

何况不帅这几天离开王城也是好事。

他也可以放开手脚做某些事。

阿瑞斯商一大早从特调局的院墙跳出来，毫无遮掩，就那么坦坦荡荡地提着骨杖一路走回自己租下的府邸。

不用说，王城的流言又将增加新料。

狰爷跟着不帅跑了。

阿瑞斯商就只能靠自己两条腿走路。

刚走到大门口，他那位负责的女管家就迎出来说道：“昨天到现在为止，您一共有九份请柬需要处理，另外还有六个人上门请求购买储物工具，他们全都留下了名帖并表示价钱好说。”

阿瑞斯商嗯了声，顺手接过女管家递给他的请柬，打开一封，看完，扔掉，再打开下一封。

最后他只留下两封，一封是一名王城大商人给他发来的邀请函，邀请他参加一个内部举行的材料鉴赏会。

另外一封……

女管家捡起阿瑞斯商扔下的请柬，眼睛扫过阿瑞斯商拿在手里的两张请柬，低声询问：“您是打算参加杜德子爵两位公子举办的宴会吗？”

阿瑞斯商转头：“哦，我差点忘了，你之前就曾服务于杜德家族，能说说你对他们的了解吗？”

女管家玛利亚抿了抿嘴唇，似乎不怎么想说过去雇主的坏话，只说：“我的建议是如果请柬是杜德子爵发出，您可以过去看看，拓展一下您的社交面。但如果请柬来自杜德子爵的两位公子的话，还请谨慎出行。”

阿瑞斯商嗤笑出声，扬了扬手中请柬：“如果是杜德子爵请我，我反而没兴趣去。年轻人当然要和年轻人混才有意思，你说是不是？”

女管家没有回应，但也没有再出言阻止。

虽然她和这位她目前还不清楚来历的新主人才相处一个多月，但已经足够让她了解到这位不会做毫无意义的事情，更不会随便让自己陷入险境。

他嚣张狂妄，他肆意妄行，也只是因为他有支撑自己行为的底气。

不像杜德两兄弟和其他一些贵族子弟，他们也嚣张狂妄，但他们的嚣张和狂妄只会在面对弱者时才会出现，那只是他们彰显身份的面具。在真正的大人物面前，他们乖得比驯养的狗还乖。

阿瑞斯商嗤笑出声，扬了扬手中请柬：“如果是杜德子爵请我，我反而没兴趣去。年轻人当然要和年轻人混才有意思，你说是不是？”

女管家没有回应，但也没有再出言阻止。

虽然她和这位她目前还不清楚来历的新主人才相处一个多月，但已经足够让她了解到这位不会做毫无意义的事情，更不会随便让自己陷入险境。

他嚣张狂妄，他肆意妄行，也只是因为他有支撑自己行为的底气。

不像杜德两兄弟和其他一些贵族子弟，他们也嚣张狂妄，但他们的嚣张和狂妄只会在面对弱者时才会出现，那只是他们彰显身份的面具。在真正的大人物面前，他们乖得比驯养的狗还乖。
"""
CHINESE SOURCE TEXT TRANSLATION:
"You also said that Marquis Dalton was at another platform, summoning the shuttle by tossing out an ancient coin. But unfortunately, that platform has already been submerged by magma, turning into a vast expanse of rock strata. The people I dispatched tried waiting there for a month as well, but similarly failed to wait for a shuttle."

The Tiger King looked at Bu Shu, his tone still quite mild: "In reality, the vast majority of that dungeon was flooded by magma gushing from the wellhead, and it has now transformed from a dungeon into a massive, cavernous rock cave riddled with holes. It took us a great deal of effort to wait for the magma layer to cool down and then clear a passage leading to the Anji South Road station. Strangely enough, however, that platform remained completely intact, standing alone within a relatively large hollow."

"What a truly miraculous thing." The Tiger King raised a hand in exclamation.

"I need you to make another trip to Black Forest City," the Tiger King said with a serious expression. "This time, I will dispatch a hundred-man team to go with you. They will carry sufficient food, drink, and lodging supplies. If they have the opportunity to enter the library, their task is to copy down the books inside—as many as they can copy."

During the previous three days, the Tiger King and the two ministers and two guards he brought with him had only copied a small amount of knowledge that interested them.

This was thanks to the fact that the Tiger King was carrying a spatial belt, which contained some spare paper and writing brushes.

However, the amount copied by just five people was far too little, and at the time, they had assumed they could return at any moment, so they hadn't overworked themselves.

If he hadn't been worried that the librarian ancestor over at the library would resent them bringing too many people and consequently revoke their eligibility to enter the library, the Tiger King would have loved to dispatch a thousand people to do the copying.

Of course, it would be best if they could bring the books and image materials out directly, but unfortunately, that was impossible. Nor did he dare to risk offending that ancestor by attempting a forcible seizure.

Just seeing that the library could remain completely undamaged amidst the magma, and could only be accessed via a special shuttle, was enough to show that the level of black technology and mysticism contained within that library far exceeded what the New Epoch beasts could understand and master.

The Tiger King was certain that a forcible seizure would only cause them to lose everything.

Bu Shu... who had thought that by handing over his library card he had shaken off a piece of trouble, never expected this trouble to possess boomerang properties, striking right back at him.

"Alright. But I'm also not certain whether a vehicle will come to pick me up at that time," Bu Shu said.

The Tiger King said gently: "Three days. You only need to stay at that station for three days."

Bu Shu had no choice but to agree.

When Ares Shang heard that Bu Shu was leaving the Royal City to stay underground in Black Forest City for another three days, he surprisingly didn't kick up a fuss.

However!

"That means for at least five days, I won't be able to see you, nor can I sleep with you," Ares Shang said, staring straight into Bu Shu's eyes.

Bu Shu: "...Speak properly."

Ares Shang leaned in closer to him: "Five days! And before this, we've been abstaining for a full thirty-six days."

Bu Shu: "..."

Ares Shang finally bared his true intentions: "Did you know that proper intimacy is a miraculous cure for ailments? Not only can it regulate a person's endocrine system, stabilize their mental state, and induce happiness, but it can also greatly reduce the probability of cheating and alleviate mental illness."

Bu Shu: "..."

Looking at Bu Shu, who was enveloped in a well-fitted uniform, Ares Shang’s eyes flickered with a bestial, predatory glint as he pressed forward another step.

Early the next morning, Bu Shu set off. He was to rendezvous in secret outside the city with the hundred-man team prepared by the Tiger King, and journey together to Black Forest City.

Ares Shang turned over, embraced Bu Shu's pillow, and buried his face into it.

His Bu Shu was truly fantastic!

In every sense of the word.

He really didn't want to let Bu Shu go this morning, but... a good man must not stand in the way of his partner's career, nor should he make his partner unhappy.

Besides, Bu Shu leaving the Royal City for a few days was also a good thing.

It allowed him to let go and do certain things.

Early in the morning, Ares Shang vaulted over the courtyard wall of the Special Investigation Bureau. Without any concealment, he swaggered openly, carrying his bone staff all the way back to the mansion he had rented.

Needless to say, the rumors in the Royal City were about to gain some fresh material.

Master Zhen had run off with Bu Shu.

Ares Shang was reduced to relying on his own two legs to walk.

As soon as he reached the front entrance, his female head housekeeper hurried out to greet him and said: "From yesterday until now, you have a total of nine invitations to process, and additionally, six people have come by to request the purchase of storage tools. They all left their calling cards and indicated that price is no object."

Ares Shang let out an "hn," casually taking the invitations handed to him by the housekeeper. He opened one, finished reading it, tossed it aside, and opened the next one.

In the end, he kept only two. One was an invitation sent to him by a major merchant in the Royal City, inviting him to attend an internally held rare materials appreciation event.

As for the other one...

The housekeeper picked up the invitation Ares Shang had discarded, swept her eyes over the two invitations he was holding in his hand, and asked in a low voice: "Are you planning to attend the banquet hosted by the two young masters of Viscount Dude?"

Ares Shang turned his head: "Oh, I almost forgot. You previously served the Dude family. Can you tell me what you know about them?"

The housekeeper, Maria, pursed her lips, seeming reluctant to speak ill of her former employer. She only said: "My suggestion is that if the invitation was issued by Viscount Dude, you can go take a look to broaden your social circle. But if the invitation comes from Viscount Dude's two sons, please exercise caution when attending."

Ares Shang let out a scoff, lifting the invitation in his hand: "If Viscount Dude invited me, I'd have no interest in going instead. Young people naturally hang out with young people to be interesting, don't you think?"

The housekeeper did not reply, but she didn't offer any further dissuasion either.

Although she had only spent a little over a month with this new master whose background she still didn't quite understand, it was already enough for her to realize that this man would never do anything meaningless, nor would he casually allow himself to walk into a death trap.

He was arrogant and overbearing; he acted with unbridled lawlessness—all because he possessed the backing and confidence to support his behavior.

Unlike the two Dude brothers and other young scions of the nobility, who were also arrogant and overbearing, their arrogance and overbearingness only ever surfaced when facing the weak; it was merely a mask to flaunt their status. In front of truly big shots, they were more obediently well-behaved than domesticated dogs.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第144章 参加宴会的目的
chunks.chineseText:
第144章 参加宴会的目的

阿瑞斯商几乎是踩着点来到杜德子爵府邸门口。
　　门口负责迎客的仆人眼睛非常尖，一眼就认出刚从车下来的年轻兽人是谁，立刻让人对内传信。
　　杜德两兄弟听到传信，兴奋得差点跳起来。
　　他们没想到阿瑞斯商这么给他们兄弟俩面子。
　　当即两人就一起狂奔出去，刚奔到花园就看到被仆人领进来的阿瑞斯商。
　　两兄弟立刻放缓脚步，整理衣裳，脸上堆满笑容迎向这位贵客。
　　这段时间，阿瑞斯商可以说是王城最炙手可热的大人物，王城内想要邀约他的人不计其数，但阿瑞斯商真正接下邀请的极少。
　　阿瑞斯商的到来让杜德两兄弟感觉十分有面子，心情都飞扬起来。
　　可惜阿瑞斯商性格就如传言中一样高傲，面对两兄弟的热情跟没看见一样，连半个字都懒得回应，就这么提着骨杖往办理宴会的大厅走。
　　两兄弟对视，心里不快，但他们遮掩了这份不快，一左一右伴在阿瑞斯商身边，走进宴客大厅。
　　大厅中满是被邀约而来的男男女女。
　　他们中有贵族子弟，有官员子弟，有富商子弟，也有交际花，和一些看着就像是佣兵和探险者的彪悍兽人。
　　当杜德兄弟俩陪伴阿瑞斯商走入大厅时，几乎大半以上的客人注意到这一幕，并转头看向他们。
　　阿瑞斯商目光扫过一众神情各异的客人，大步走向他的目标。
　　“你就是寻宝猎人鹰之翼？”
　　鹰之翼礼貌地笑笑，“是我。你就是大名鼎鼎的新晋炼金大师阿瑞斯商了？”
　　阿瑞斯商面无表情，手一晃，亮出一小枚指甲盖大的黑色带星点的晶石：“我在找寻这种矿石，定金五十金，如果你能帮我找到这种矿石的产地，在我确定后，会根据矿藏大小，再支付你五百到一千金达盾。时间不限。”
　　鹰之翼在听到报酬数额后就十分心动。光是定金就五十金，更不要说找到矿藏后最少也能收入五百金。而他跑几个所谓古迹，花费大量精力和时间，甚至冒着生命危险，也不一定能挖掘出价值很高的宝物，有时连成本都收不回来。
　　更何况阿瑞斯商这个寻矿石任务还不限时间，相当于他只要答应下来，马上就可以收获五十金，还不用偿还。
　　当然，以他的信用程度，他不可能干出只拿定金不干活的事情。
　　事实上，鹰之翼自信如果不是他的信誉良好加能力非凡，阿瑞斯商也不会找上他，并如此大方。
　　大厅中的其他人都注意到了这一幕。
　　紧跟在阿瑞斯商身后的杜德两兄弟自然也看到和听到了全部经过，他们俩这时才明白，阿瑞斯商会前来他们举办的宴会，可能就是得知寻宝猎人鹰之翼也会来。
　　“咳，日安，阿瑞斯大师，我是暗鸦佣兵团的团长暗鸦。不知道您有没有听过我们佣兵团的名字，我们团其实也很擅长寻物，且去过很多地方。如果您愿意把那枚晶石给我们看看，说不定我们能提供一些线索。”一名身材极其强壮的兽人强行挤到阿瑞斯商面前，露出笑脸。
　　鹰之翼闻言，斜睨名叫暗鸦的强壮兽人。他么的，这么快就来抢生意？还有没有一点同是翼人族的兄弟情了？
　　“可以。”阿瑞斯商转手就把手中晶石递给暗鸦。
　　暗鸦接过晶石仔细观看，脸上露出一点像是回忆的神情。
　　“这个寻找晶石的任务不知道我们能不能接？”暗鸦笑着询问，把晶石递还给阿瑞斯商。
　　阿瑞斯商没接：“可以。这枚晶石你先拿着。我希望任务完成速度越快越好，越快奖励越高。”
　　暗鸦一口答应，当仁不让地把晶石塞进怀里。
　　鹰之翼：泥马！
　　阿瑞斯商又转看向鹰之翼：“你的意思？”
　　鹰之翼毫不犹豫地说：“我接。不过我也需要一枚晶石做样子。”
　　他打算拿着晶石去找些老朋友问问，这种晶石有什么作用。
　　阿瑞斯商点头同意，不是很在意地又拿出一枚更小一点的晶石递给鹰之翼。
　　克伟杜德在一边忍不住问道：“阿瑞斯大师，这晶石有什么作用吗？”
　　闻言，鹰之翼和暗鸦一起用怪异的眼神看向克伟杜德。
　　韦莱杜德感觉到不妙，立刻暗中拉扯弟弟的衣服。
　　阿瑞斯商轻哼一声：“你不配知道。”
　　说完，竟然就这么离开了宴会大厅，离开了杜德子爵府邸。
　　大厅中人先是沉默地看着这一幕，之后议论声小小掀起，直到变大。
　　克伟杜德脸色爆红，又变得惨白，整个人气得身体发抖。
　　之前他有多么觉得阿瑞斯商给他们兄弟面子，现在就有多恨阿瑞斯商不给他面子。
　　韦莱杜德忙打圆场：“阿瑞斯商大师有急事需要去办理，他这次过来就是委托我们帮他联系好手寻宝。宴会继续。”
　　韦莱杜德做了个手势，宴会厅里音乐重新响起。
　　被邀请来的客人也很有眼色地继续交际起来。
　　韦莱杜德把弟弟拖出宴会厅，警告他：“注意你的脸色！”
　　克伟杜德气得骂：“你听到那个混蛋说什么了吗？他说我不配！”
　　韦莱杜德也很生气，但他只能安抚他弟：“那家伙就是那样，我们又不是第一天知道。他不客气的人也不止我们。况且你当时那个问题也太冒失了，这些大师都敝帚自珍的很，他们怎么可能把材料的作用轻易泄露出去，防的就是有人提高材料价格，或者用材料卡着他们。”
　　克伟杜德委屈：“我当时就没多想，只是想要和那个混蛋多搭搭话。”
　　“行了，那可是能炼制空间储物的大师，你别一口一个混蛋的叫他，让别人听到，你是想彻底和那样的大师交恶吗？”
　　“有什么了不起，我没了空间储物工具还过不下去不成？”克伟杜德嘴巴上这么说，但他也知道这只是他强行挽尊而已。
　　“对了，你觉得那晶石会不会就是他炼制空储的关键材料？”
　　“有可能。我们去找鹰之翼和暗鸦，看能不能从他们那里弄到一点晶石碎片。”
　　与杜德兄弟有同样想法的人不少，他们一来对那晶石好奇，二来也是想看看有没有机会找到晶石从而结交上阿瑞斯商。
　　次日，阿瑞斯商又去参加了一个大商人举办的珍稀材料鉴赏会，在那里消费了不少，同时放出消息，表示自己想要购买更多且大量的材料，貌似想要批量炼制某些物品。
　　于是王城所有人都知道阿瑞斯商正在收集材料，阿瑞斯商还没到家，就有人为他送来了材料市场的春季材料展销大会邀请函。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 144: The Purpose of Attending the Banquet

Ares Shang arrived at the entrance of Viscount Dude’s mansion almost right on the dot.
The servants in charge of welcoming guests at the entrance had extremely sharp eyes; the moment they recognized which young beastman had just stepped down from the carriage, they immediately had someone send word inside.
Upon hearing the message, the two Dude brothers were so excited they nearly jumped for joy.
They hadn't expected Ares Shang to show their duo such immense face.
Without a moment's delay, the two of them sprinted out together, only to see Ares Shang being led in by a servant just as they reached the garden.
The two brothers instantly slowed their pace, tidied up their clothes, and greeted this distinguished guest with smiles plastered all over their faces.
During this period, Ares Shang could be said to be the most sought-after and hottest big shot in the Royal City. Countless people within the city desired to invite him, yet Ares Shang had accepted very few invitations in earnest.
Ares Shang’s arrival made the two Dude brothers feel immensely honored, their moods soaring sky-high.
Unfortunately, Ares Shang’s temperament was just as arrogant as the rumors claimed. Facing the enthusiastic welcome of the two brothers, he acted as if he hadn't seen them at all, not even bothering to reply with half a word, and simply walked straight toward the grand banquet hall, carrying his bone staff.
The two brothers exchanged glances, displeasure welling up in their hearts. However, they concealed this displeasure, flanking Ares Shang on the left and right as they walked into the banquet reception hall.
The hall was packed with men and women who had been invited.
Among them were young nobles, young officials, scions of wealthy merchants, socialites, and some fierce-looking beastmen who looked very much like mercenaries and adventurers.
When the Dude brothers accompanied Ares Shang into the hall, well over half of the guests noticed the scene and turned to look at them.
Ares Shang’s gaze swept across the guests with their various expressions, and he strode directly toward his target.
"You must be the treasure hunter Hawk’s Wing?"
Hawk’s Wing smiled politely, "It is I. And you must be the renowned newly-risen alchemy master, Ares Shang?"
Ares Shang wore a blank expression as his hand flickered, revealing a small, fingernail-sized black crystal dotted with stars: "I am searching for this kind of ore. Fifty gold coins as a deposit. If you can help me find the place of origin for this ore, once I verify it, I will pay you an additional five hundred to one thousand gold darics depending on the size of the mineral deposit. There is no time limit."
Upon hearing the sum of the reward, Hawk’s Wing felt deeply tempted. The deposit alone was fifty gold coins, not to mention the minimum of five hundred gold coins he would earn after locating the deposit. When he ran around various so-called ancient ruins, expending massive amounts of energy and time while risking his life, he didn't necessarily unearth treasures of very high value, and sometimes he couldn't even recoup his costs.
What's more, Ares Shang’s quest to find this ore had no time limit, which meant that as long as he accepted it, he would immediately net fifty gold coins without needing to pay it back.
Of course, given his level of credibility, he could never do something like taking the deposit and refusing to work.
In fact, Hawk’s Wing was confident that if it weren't for his stellar reputation combined with extraordinary abilities, Ares Shang wouldn't have sought him out and been so generous.
Everyone else in the hall had noticed this scene.
The two Dude brothers, who were closely following behind Ares Shang, naturally saw and heard the entire process. It was only at this moment that they realized Ares Shang had come to their banquet probably because he learned that the treasure hunter Hawk’s Wing would be attending as well.
"Ahem, good day, Master Ares. I am Raven, the leader of the Dark Crow Mercenary Corps. I wonder if you've ever heard of our mercenary corps' name? Our corps is actually quite adept at tracking down items and has been to many places. If you are willing to let us take a look at that piece of crystal, perhaps we can provide some clues." A heavily built beastman forcibly squeezed his way in front of Ares Shang, wearing a smile.
Hearing this, Hawk’s Wing cast a sideways glance at the burly beastman named Raven. *Damn it, trying to steal business so fast? Is there even a shred of brotherly camaraderie left as fellow Winged beasts?*
"Sure." Ares Shang turned his hand and handed the crystal directly to Raven.
Raven took the crystal, examining it carefully while a look resembling recollection crossed his face.
"I wonder if we can take on this quest to find the crystal?" Raven asked with a smile, handing the crystal back to Ares Shang.
Ares Shang didn't take it back: "You may. Keep this crystal for now. I hope the quest completion speed is as fast as possible; the faster it's done, the higher the reward."
Raven agreed instantly, stuffing the crystal into his bosom without a shred of modesty.
Hawk’s Wing: *What the hell!*
Ares Shang turned his gaze back to Hawk’s Wing: "And your answer?"
Hawk’s Wing said without hesitation: "I'll take it. But I also need a piece of crystal as a sample."
He intended to take the crystal to ask some old friends what its properties and uses might be.
Ares Shang nodded in agreement, pulling out an even smaller crystal unconcernedly and handing it to Hawk’s Wing.
Ke Wei Dude couldn't help asking from the side, "Master Ares, what purpose does this crystal serve?"
Hearing this, Hawk’s Wing and Raven both shot strange looks toward Ke Wei Dude.
Wei Lai Dude sensed trouble and immediately grabbed his younger brother's clothes in secret.
Ares Shang let out a cold snort: "You aren't worthy to know."
Having said that, he simply turned and walked out of the banquet hall, leaving Viscount Dude's mansion entirely.
The people in the hall first watched this scene in silence, after which murmurs arose in small whispers before swelling into loud discussions.
Ke Wei Dude’s face flushed beet red before turning deadly pale, his entire body trembling with rage.
Just how much he had previously felt that Ares Shang was giving their duo face, that was exactly how much he now hated Ares Shang for not giving him any face.
Wei Lai Dude hurriedly smoothed things over: "Master Ares Shang has urgent matters to attend to; his purpose in coming here this time was simply to commission us to contact skilled treasure hunters for him. The banquet continues."
Wei Lai Dude made a hand gesture, and the music in the banquet hall struck up once again.
The invited guests also knew how to read the room and resumed their socializing.
Wei Lai Dude dragged his younger brother out of the banquet hall and warned him: "Watch your expression!"
Ke Wei Dude cursed furiously in anger: "Did you hear what that bastard said? He said I wasn't worthy!"
Wei Lai Dude was furious as well, but he could only pacify his younger brother: "That guy is just like that; it's not the first day we've known it. We aren't the only ones he treats without courtesy. Besides, the question you asked at that time was far too rash. These masters all hold their knowledge and secrets close to their chests; how could they possibly leak the uses of materials so easily? What they guard against is precisely people driving up material prices or using materials to hold them hostage."
Ke Wei Dude felt aggrieved: "I didn't think much of it at the time, I just wanted to make a bit more small talk with that bastard."
"Alright, that is a master capable of refining spatial storage tools. Stop calling him a bastard left and right. If someone else hears you, are you trying to completely make an enemy of such a master?"
"What's so great about him? Is my life going to grind to a halt just because I don't have a spatial storage tool?" Although Ke Wei Dude said this, he knew deep down that this was just him forcefully trying to save face.
"By the way, do you think that crystal could be the key material he uses to refine spatial storage?"
"It's possible. Let's go find Hawk’s Wing and Raven and see if we can get some crystal shards from them."
There were quite a few people who harbored the same thought as the Dude brothers. For one, they were curious about the crystal; secondly, they also wanted to see if there was a chance to track down the crystal and thereby build a connection with Ares Shang.
The next day, Ares Shang went to attend a rare material appreciation event hosted by a major merchant, spending quite a sum there while simultaneously spreading the word that he wished to purchase even more materials in large quantities, seemingly intending to batch-refine certain items.
Thus, everyone in the Royal City learned that Ares Shang was collecting materials. Even before Ares Shang arrived back home, someone had already sent him an invitation to the Spring Material Exhibition and Sales Convention hosted by the material market.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第145章 阿瑞斯商的报复 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第145章 阿瑞斯商的报复

这种邀请函更像是一种资格证明，没有邀请函的人可以进入展销大会的外围，但无法进入内围，不管你是什么身份，哪怕是国王都需要邀请函才能进入。

一个材料市场敢有这样的底气，自然是因为其背后有着极为庞大的势力撑腰。

材料市场属于虎国，但春季材料展销大会的主办者却是整个兽人大陆都极为有名的大商会，鬼火商会。

阿瑞斯商原本对鬼火商会不了解，询问了天眼系统后，顿时对该商会冒出了一点兴趣。

据传这家商会始建于旧神血皇朝时期。那时对商人的税收很重，很多小商人为了逃避重税，会在晚上偷偷聚集到河岸边，点燃一种特制的蓝光灯，搞黑市交易。一旦被发现，就会立刻划船逃跑。

因为那些蓝光灯远看很像鬼火，久而久之，这种黑市交易也被称为鬼火市场。

之后有人发现主办这种鬼火市场有极大利益可图，就搞了个商会专门经营这事，且为了让人明白他们商会是干什么的，对内都叫鬼火商会。

这也是鬼火商会最早的由来。

现在的鬼火商会是否源自最初的鬼火商会，谁也说不清楚。反正这种事也没有人去跟鬼火商会的头脑们争论。

总之，现在的鬼火商会在大战纪期间支持了一支民兵队伍，脱离当时已经分崩离析的联盟政府，占领了南边一块地盘，取名复兴小联盟。

等到毒雾纪结束，新生纪来临，那个复兴小联盟已经成了兽人大陆的南方霸主，占地面积是虎国的十倍之多。无论经济、人文、科技，还是武力，都比虎国乃至兽人大陆其他国家和大部落都强得多。

同样，暗中援助甚至是掌控复兴小联盟的鬼火商会也成了整个兽人大陆实力最强、规模也最大的商会。

鬼火商会特别喜欢搞各种会展，他们从中间抽成。

而如今的兽人大陆受到交通、通讯方面的阻碍，想要在一个地点就收集齐全兽人大陆的大部分特产，基本就是不可能的事。

但就在数十年前，这个不可能在鬼火商会的牵线搭桥和大力支援下，变成了可能。

这也是鬼火商影响力如此之大的重要原因——你想要远方国家和地区的特产，又没有那个财力精力和能力把想要的东西弄到自己面前，就只能依靠鬼火商会。同样，你想把自己的东西送出去，也得依靠鬼火商会。

同时，阿瑞斯商也从天眼系统那里了解到鬼火商会之所以会突然在虎国举办春季材料展销大会，就是旨在黑森林城下面的图书馆。

只不过他们无法进入图书馆，只能暂时留在虎国王城，先参加传承分享大会，然后看有没有机会撕下一大块肥肉。

虎国对鬼火商会也十分提防，但鬼火商会举办春季展销大会的理由也非常正当，就是不想浪费这次传承分享大会，全大陆首领和权贵都会前来虎国王城的良好机会。

而对于前来虎国的各国各地区人来说，如果有了这场材料展销会，就算他们拿不到传承，也不算白跑一趟，大不了就当一次远途跑商。这样一些原本不想来的首脑和权贵，说不定也会考虑前来。

同样，这样的材料展销大会在虎国王城召开，对虎国自然也有不小好处。到时必须会吸引兽人大陆各地的炼金大师、药剂大师等前来虎国王城，以及全大陆大大小小的商行。

虎王和手下商量后，“欢欣”地接受了这个提议，并为这个展销会能及时召开，开了很多绿灯。

这么一来，传承分享大会还没开始，材料展销会带来的热度就已经让虎国王城先热闹起来，城门每天都有大量商队进出，王城的客流量一下暴增许多。

王城的酒馆、旅馆、饭店、租赁民宅和销金窟等笑得合不拢嘴，一个个赚得盆满钵满，这还只是开始。

虎国的上层权贵们则是痛并快乐着，一边享受这两场大会给虎国带来的种种红利，一边在王城警备和防守方面增加了大量人手。

阿瑞斯商了解到这个背景后，单纯为了接触更多材料，也会前往这个展销会，当即就让仆人回复他会过去。

同一时间，二王子和天残谷主等人也拿到了阿瑞斯商之前在商人处购买的材料的清单，他们甚至弄到了那黑色带星点的晶石的画像。

因为阿瑞斯商给出的晶石碎片太小，无论是鹰之翼还是暗鸦佣兵团都不愿意再分样品出来，就是二王子出马都没用。

二王子的人设也不是为难人的人设，见索要不成也没有继续强求。

何况无论是鹰之翼还是暗鸦佣兵团都不是弱者，他们也都不是虎国的人，压根不惧虎国的权贵。

“你见过这种材料吗？”天残谷主询问二王子。

二王子仔细看画像，最后缓缓摇头：“没见过。你呢？”

天残谷主也摇头：“这不像是我们熟知的空储材料。”

“这么说，我们基本可以排除阿瑞斯商也是魔法师的可能？”

“先别急，我打算找个机会见见他。你不是要办宴会吗？给他发请柬了吗？”

二王子苦笑，“原本茜娜要举办宴会，我想着带你顺便过去一趟，但现在茜娜被母后禁足，老三也被父王关了起来，我这时候再举办宴会就不太适合。”

“那就只能去那个春季材料展销会，看有没有机会碰到他了。”

“展销会会开办很长时间，但开幕当天，阿瑞斯商应该会过去捧场。据我所知，鬼火商会那边第一时间就给阿瑞斯商发了邀请函。”

展销会还需要几天才会开幕。

阿瑞斯商这几天也没闲着，还特别忙。

他把杜德兄弟给揍了，揍得两人脑袋开花，胳膊腿全部粉碎性骨折，属于就算接好了骨头，也会变成残废那种重伤。

一开始人们听到消息还很惊讶，昨天杜德两兄弟才邀请了阿瑞斯商，对方还给面子的去参加了宴会，怎么隔天就把人给揍了？还揍得这么狠？

然后知道内-幕消息的人就说啦。

“克伟杜德那个傻叉在宴会中直接询问阿瑞斯大师那晶石的作用，大师很生气，就说他不配知道。克伟杜德那小心眼的不就恨上阿瑞斯大师了嘛。”

“然后第二天，阿瑞斯大师偶然撞到克伟杜德欺辱小姑娘，把人当街往车子里拖，路上人看到没人敢管，阿瑞斯大师就是个眼睛里揉不进沙子的，当场把克伟杜德揍了，把小姑娘救了，听说克伟杜德的脸都被扇肿了。”

“听说当时阿瑞斯大师还嘲笑克伟杜德那个很短小，只能欺负小女孩，嘿！克伟杜德那小子都要气疯了。”

“哇，打人不打脸，阿瑞斯大师这是半点不客气啊。”

“打得好！那些贵族子弟就没几个好东西，尤其杜德兄弟俩，不知干出多少缺德事。城里的治安官根本不敢治他们，其他人又都睁只眼闭只眼。如果不是遇到阿瑞斯大师，那小姑娘被欺负了也没人为她出头。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 145: The Retribution of the Ares Merchant (Part 1)

This type of invitation letter was more akin to a qualification certificate. Those without an invitation could enter the outer perimeter of the exhibition, but stepping into the inner ring was impossible. Regardless of one's status—even if one were a king—an invitation was required for entry.

For a mere materials market to possess such confidence, it naturally had an immensely powerful backing.

While the materials market belonged to the Tiger Kingdom, the organizer of the Spring Materials Exhibition was the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce, an extremely renowned mercantile syndicate across the entire Orc Continent.

The Ares Merchant had initially known nothing about the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce. However, after consulting the Heavenly Eye System, a spark of interest immediately ignited within him.

Legend had it that this chamber of commerce was founded during the era of the Ancient Gods' Blood Dynasty. Back then, merchant taxes were exorbitant. To evade heavy taxation, many small-scale traders would secretly gather along riverbanks at night, igniting a special type of blue-glow lamp to conduct black-market transactions. The moment they were discovered, they would immediately leap into their boats and flee.

Because those blue-glow lamps looked much like ghost fires from afar, these black-market transactions gradually came to be known as the Ghost Fire Market.

Later on, some individuals realized that organizing such a ghost-fire market yielded immense profits, so they established a dedicated chamber of commerce to manage the enterprise. To make it clear to everyone what their organization did, they internally referred to it as the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce.

This was the earliest origin of the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce.

Whether the present-day Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce actually originated from that initial syndicate remained anyone's guess. In any case, no one bothered to argue about such matters with the top brass of the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce.

In short, during the Great Epoch, the modern Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce supported a militia force, broke away from the then-disintegrating Allied Government, occupied a stretch of territory in the south, and named it the Rebirth Lesser Alliance.

By the time the Poison Fog Era ended and the New Era arrived, that Rebirth Lesser Alliance had already become the southern hegemon of the Orc Continent, boasting a landmass ten times that of the Tiger Kingdom. Whether in terms of economy, culture, technology, or military might, it far surpassed the Tiger Kingdom and all other nations and major tribes across the Orc Continent.

Similarly, the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce—which had covertly aided and even controlled the Rebirth Lesser Alliance—had grown into the most powerful and largest mercantile syndicate on the entire Orc Continent.

The Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce was particularly fond of hosting various exhibitions and trade fairs, taking a cut of the profits from the middle.

Given that the current Orc Continent was hindered by logistical and communication barriers, gathering most of the continent's specialty goods in a single location was practically an impossible feat.

Yet decades ago, under the matchmaking and vigorous support of the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce, this impossibility became a reality.

This was a major reason why the influence of the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce was so formidable: if you desired specialty goods from distant nations and regions, yet lacked the financial resources, energy, and capability to bring what you wanted before yourself, you had no choice but to rely on the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce. Likewise, if you wished to ship your own goods outward, you still had to depend on them.

At the same time, the Ares Merchant learned from the Heavenly Eye System that the primary reason the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce had suddenly chosen to host the Spring Materials Exhibition within the Tiger Kingdom was precisely to target the library beneath Black Forest City.

It was just that since they were unable to enter the library, they could only temporarily remain in the Tiger Capital, first attending the Heritage Sharing Conference and then waiting to see if there would be an opportunity to rip off a massive piece of fat meat.

The Tiger Kingdom was also deeply wary of the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce. However, the excuse given by the Chamber for hosting the Spring Exhibition was entirely legitimate: they simply did not want to waste the golden opportunity presented by the gathering of chieftains and dignitaries from across the continent in the Tiger Capital for the Heritage Sharing Conference.

Furthermore, for people from various nations and regions coming to the Tiger Kingdom, having this materials exhibition meant that even if they failed to secure any heritage, their trip would not have been in vain—at the very least, they could treat it as a long-distance mercantile expedition. Chieftains and dignitaries who might have otherwise been reluctant to come would now be inclined to consider the journey.

Likewise, holding such a materials exhibition within the Tiger Capital naturally brought no small benefits to the Tiger Kingdom itself. By then, it would undoubtedly attract grand alchemy masters, grand potion masters, and mercantile firms of all sizes from every corner of the Orc Continent to the Tiger Capital.

After consulting with his subordinates, the Tiger King "joyfully" accepted the proposal and flashed numerous green lights to ensure the exhibition could be held on time.

As a result, even before the Heritage Sharing Conference had officially begun, the buzz generated by the materials exhibition had already made the Tiger Capital lively in advance. Massive caravans entered and exited the city gates daily, and the visitor traffic in the capital surged dramatically overnight.

Taverns, inns, restaurants, rental properties, and pleasure quarters across the capital grinned from ear to ear, filling their coffers to the brim—and this was merely the beginning.

As for the upper-crust dignitaries of the Tiger Kingdom, they were in a state of painful bliss: while enjoying the various dividends brought to the kingdom by the two grand events, they heavily reinforced the capital with massive amounts of security and defense personnel.

Upon understanding this background, the Ares Merchant decided that, purely for the sake of accessing more materials, he would also attend the exhibition, immediately instructing his servant to reply that he would be there.

At the same time, the Second Prince, the Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley, and others had also obtained the inventory of materials the Ares Merchant had previously purchased from the merchant, even managing to secure a portrait of the black crystal dotted with stars.

Because the crystal fragments provided by the Ares Merchant were far too small, neither the Wings of Hawk nor the Dark Crow Mercenary Corps was willing to part with any more samples—a refusal that proved futile even when the Second Prince stepped in person.

The Second Prince's persona was not one of a man who deliberately made things difficult for others. Seeing that extortion was unsuccessful, he did not continue to press the matter.

Besides, neither the Wings of Hawk nor the Dark Crow Mercenary Corps were weaklings, nor were they citizens of the Tiger Kingdom; they held zero fear for the dignitaries of the Tiger Kingdom.

"Have you ever seen this kind of material?" the Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley asked the Second Prince.

The Second Prince studied the portrait carefully before slowly shaking his head. "Never seen it. What about you?"

The Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley also shook his head. "This doesn't look like any storage-spatial material we are familiar with."

"Does this mean we can basically rule out the possibility that the Ares Merchant is also a mage?"

"Don't be so hasty just yet. I intend to find an opportunity to meet him. Weren't you planning to host a banquet? Did you send him an invitation?"

The Second Prince gave a bitter smile. "Originally, Xina was going to host a banquet, and I was planning to bring you along for the ride. But right now, Xina has been grounded by the Queen, and the Third Prince has been locked up by Father King. It wouldn't be appropriate for me to host a banquet at a time like this."

"Then we can only head to that Spring Materials Exhibition and see if we run into a chance to bump into him."

"The exhibition will run for quite a long time, but on opening day, the Ares Merchant will undoubtedly show up to lend his support. As far as I know, the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce sent an invitation to the Ares Merchant at the very first moment."

The exhibition was still a few days away from opening.

Over the past few days, however, the Ares Merchant was anything but idle; in fact, he was exceptionally busy.

He had beaten the Dodd brothers, smashing their heads until blood bloomed and fracturing every bone in their arms and legs. It was the sort of severe trauma where even if the bones were reset, they would remain crippled for life.

When people first heard the news, they were utterly astonished. Just yesterday, the two Dodd brothers had invited the Ares Merchant over, and the man had even graciously attended the banquet; how was it that just a day later, he had beaten them up? And so brutally at that?

Then, those privy to the inside gossip began to speak.

"That absolute moron Clevis Dodd directly asked Grandmaster Ares about the function of that crystal during the banquet. The Grandmaster was furious and told him he wasn't worthy of knowing. Being the petty-minded bastard he is, Clevis Dodd naturally harbored a grudge against Grandmaster Ares."

"Then, the next day, Grandmaster Ares happened to run into Clevis Dodd bullying a young girl, dragging her into a carriage right out in the open street. Passersby saw it but no one dared to intervene. Grandmaster Ares, being a man who couldn't tolerate a single grain of sand in his eyes, beat Clevis Dodd right on the spot and rescued the girl. I heard Clevis Dodd's face was beaten until it swelled up like a pig's head."

"I heard Grandmaster Ares even mocked Clevis Dodd for being tiny and short, only capable of bullying little girls. Heh! That brat Clevis Dodd was practically driven insane with rage."

"Whoa, hitting someone without sparing their face—Grandmaster Ares didn't hold back in the slightest."

"Served him right! There are hardly any decent folks among those aristocratic scions, especially the Dodd brothers, who have no idea how many malicious deeds they've committed. The city guards didn't dare discipline them, and everyone else just turned a blind eye. If it weren't for Grandmaster Ares stepping in, that poor girl would have been bullied with no one standing up for her."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第145章 阿瑞斯商的报复 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
“是啊。本来这件事就是克伟杜德那小子不对，如果他能忍下这口气，这事也就算了。但他两次被阿瑞斯大师鄙视，又被打脸还嘲笑那里短小，就问哪个雄性能忍受得了这个？他心里气不过，竟然回去叫了一帮人就去找阿瑞斯大师报复。他哥听到消息就带人追了上去。”

“然后呢？他哥不是去阻止他弟的吗，怎么一起被揍了？”

“嗐！这不是克伟杜德那小子跑得太快，阿瑞斯大师又不是个能忍的性子，当场就动了手。等到韦莱杜德带人赶到，克伟杜德已经被揍得不成人形。你说自己弟弟被打成这样，韦莱杜德能不说几句场面话吗？”

“然后阿瑞斯大师直接就让他别废话，想打就打。还说以后见了他们兄弟一次就打他们一次。当时饭馆里那么多人看着，韦莱杜德如果就这么退了，他以后也别想在王城权贵里混了。他就说要单对单挑战阿瑞斯大师。”

“有种。”说话的人明是夸奖，脸上却充满讥笑。

“他没种也不行，那种情况他总不能和他弟弟一样搞群殴，如果单挑打不过还能有点脸面留下，如果群殴还被暴揍，那可真的就是……啧！”

“最后阿瑞斯大师就满足了他单挑的要求，骨剑都没拔，就用骨杖把人揍翻了。韦莱杜德连伤势都和他弟差不多，忒惨！”

“这就是意气之争的下场啊。”

分享八卦的人突然压低声音，鬼唧唧地说：“其实还有说法说阿瑞斯大师就是故意的。”

“嗯？怎么说？”

“你们都知道吧，阿瑞斯大师正在追求那个拉斐尔郎沐。嘿，就前年，拉斐尔郎沐差点被杜德两兄弟害死，就在城外的里尔山，当时一群权贵子弟约了在那里进行打猎比赛，那群权贵子弟中有不少都是陛下-身边的侍卫，拉斐尔郎沐也被喊去了，据说是去给好友助威。谁想到……”

“那天到底发生了什么事？”有人好奇，忍不住追问。

“具体我也不太清楚。”说话的人语气含糊：“听说好像是林子里出现了不应该出现的猛兽，把众人冲散了，拉斐尔郎沐为了救助受伤的侍卫伙伴，对上那只猛兽，但被人从后面用暗箭偷袭，不但身负重伤，还差点死于猛兽口中。”

“背后放箭的人就是杜德两兄弟。但他们争辩说他们当时是为了射杀那只猛兽，没看到拉斐尔郎沐。为这事，墨文伯爵家的少爷伊克斯也和杜德两兄弟闹翻，之后也是见到两兄弟一次就打一次。因为当时拉斐尔郎沐救助的就是伊克斯少爷。”

“所以阿瑞斯大师是在为拉斐尔郎沐出头？”

“这不是明摆着嘛。当然了，也可能是杜德两兄弟太讨厌，惹得阿瑞斯大师就是看他们不顺眼。”

头一天，阿瑞斯商暴揍杜德两兄弟很可能也是为拉斐尔郎沐出气的说法还只是传言，但当第二天，阿瑞斯商又跟赶趟一样，把王城大商人獭金的独臂儿子给变成无臂，还把为儿子出头的獭金也给打到脑浆子差点流出来，这事就被定性了。

阿瑞斯商就是在报复，就是在为拉斐尔郎沐出头。

杜德两兄弟的父亲杜德子爵和獭金这名大商人当然不可能就这么咽下这口气，他们到处找人，要惩戒阿瑞斯商。

但治安官表示，克伟杜德当时是带着很多人去群殴阿瑞斯商，阿瑞斯商只是出于自保进行了适当反击。而韦莱杜德则是自己挑战阿瑞斯商，按照虎国的不成文规矩，法律管不到正式挑战的双方。

至于獭金的儿子会被阿瑞斯商削断双臂，则是因为他在赌场输得太多，不愿意付钱还想耍赖，阿瑞斯商就说只要他付出一条胳膊的代价，就可以不用付钱。獭金的儿子想逃，就被阿瑞斯商自取了。

治安官去问过阿瑞斯商，阿瑞斯商明确表示，只要獭金的父亲愿意付清其子欠他的赌债，他就帮对方把胳膊接回去，不敢说跟原来一样，但肯定能用。

可獭金不但不肯付出这笔赌债，还纠结了一帮人去找阿瑞斯商麻烦。阿瑞斯商同样出于自保，不得不还击。

对于治安局给出的答复，杜德子爵和獭金都要气疯。

以往都是他们这么胡搅蛮缠，治安局这边也都是这么偏着他们，那时他们也不觉得哪里不对，还会嘲笑和他们作对的倒霉鬼。

可现在轮到自己变成吃亏一方，他们就觉得这些治安官简直就是一群眼瞎又偏心的混蛋！并笃定他们肯定是收了阿瑞斯商的贿赂。

治安局靠不上，杜德子爵和獭金又去找别人给他们出头。

找到城卫军，城卫军敷衍地说这是治安局的管辖范畴，和他们城卫军无关。

杜德子爵就控诉说阿瑞斯商的行为已经影响到王城的整体安稳，这样的不安定因素就应该抓捕关押，也给其他来王城的外来者看看，虎国王城不是外来者可以胡作非为的地方。

城卫军现任统领角合被迫出来接待这位子爵，听完这位子爵的控诉，一脸“你有病就去治，别来我这里撒泼”的神情说：“这样，你去找陛下，如果他同意抓捕这位炼金大师，我就下令。”

杜德子爵气得暴喘，扭头就走。

杜德子爵和獭金找来找去，就找到了王后那里。

但他们刚求到王后那边，就看到阿瑞斯商被王后身边的亲信侍女恭恭敬敬亲自送出王宫的一幕。

"Indeed. To begin with, that affair was entirely Clevis Dodd's fault. If he could have swallowed that insult, the matter would have ended there. But to be despised by Grandmaster Ares twice, slapped across the face, and mocked for being short down there—tell me, which male could ever endure such humiliation? Consumed by fury, he actually went back, rallied a gang of thugs, and went looking for Grandmaster Ares to retaliate. When his older brother heard the news, he led men in hot pursuit."

"And then? Wasn't his older brother going to stop his younger sibling? How did they both end up getting thrashed?"

"Bah! It's just that Clevis Dodd ran way too fast, and Grandmaster Ares isn't the type to swallow his anger, so he struck on the spot. By the time Verley Dodd arrived with his men, Clevis Dodd had already been beaten beyond recognition. Tell me, seeing his own younger brother beaten into such a state, could Verley Dodd possibly refrain from spouting a few face-saving threats?"

"And then Grandmaster Ares bluntly told him to cut the crap and fight if he wanted to. He even warned them that from then on, every time he laid eyes on the pair of them, he would beat them once. With so many people watching in the restaurant back then, if Verley Dodd had simply backed down right there, he could forget about ever mixing with the capital's nobility again. So, he demanded a single-combat duel against Grandmaster Ares."

"Having some spine, at least." The speaker sounded like he was praising him, yet his face was filled with mockery.

"He had no choice even if he lacked spine. In that situation, he certainly couldn't gang up for a group beatdown like his younger brother. If he lost a fair duel, he could still salvage a sliver of face; but if he led a mob and still got thoroughly stomped, then he truly would be... tsk!"

"In the end, Grandmaster Ares satisfied his request for a duel. Without even drawing his bone sword, he knocked the man flat on his back using merely a bone staff. Verley Dodd's injuries ended up just as miserable as his brother's—utterly tragic!"

"That's the price of a pointless squabble driven by sheer pride."

The gossip-monger suddenly lowered his voice, speaking with a furtive smirk: "Actually, there's another rumor saying that Grandmaster Ares did it entirely on purpose."

"Oh? How so?"

"You all know about it, right? Grandmaster Ares has been courting that Rafael Langmu. Heh, just the year before last, Rafael Langmu was almost killed by those two Dodd brothers out in the Lile Mountains outside the city. A bunch of aristocratic scions had organized a hunting competition there, and quite a few of those scions were guards by His Majesty's side. Rafael Langmu was invited along as well, supposedly to cheer on a good friend. Who could have expected..."

"What on earth happened that day?" someone asked curiously, unable to hold back.

"The specifics aren't entirely clear to me," the speaker said vaguely. "Word has it that an abnormal ferocious beast suddenly appeared in the woods and scattered the crowd. To rescue a wounded guard companion, Rafael Langmu confronted that beast, only to be ambushed from behind with a concealed poisoned arrow. Not only was he grievously wounded, but he also nearly died in the jaws of the beast."

"The one who loosed the arrow from behind was none other than the Dodd brothers. But they argued that they were merely trying to shoot the beast and hadn't seen Rafael Langmu. Because of this incident, Ickes, the young master of Count Moven's household, also fell out completely with the Dodd brothers, and ever since, he beats the two brothers every single time he sees them. After all, the person Rafael Langmu had saved back then was none of other than Young Master Ickes."

"So Grandmaster Ares was standing up for Rafael Langmu?"

"Isn't that as plain as day? Of course, it's also possible that the Dodd brothers are simply so utterly detestable that Grandmaster Ares couldn't stand the sight of them from the get-go."

On the first day, the theory that the Ares Merchant's brutal thrashing of the Dodd brothers was done to vent grievances for Rafael Langmu was merely a rumor. But on the following day, as if checking items off a checklist, the Ares Merchant chopped off the arms of the one-armed son of Ottergold, a wealthy capital merchant, and then beat Ottergold himself—who had stepped forward to seek justice for his son—to the verge of brain matter leaking out, the nature of the matter became definitively established.

The Ares Merchant was retaliating; he was standing up for Rafael Langmu.

Naturally, Viscount Dodd, the father of the two brothers, and the wealthy merchant Ottergold could not possibly swallow this insult. They scoured everywhere for people to enlist, determined to punish the Ares Merchant.

However, the chief constable stated that Clevis Dodd had led a large mob to gang up and assault the Ares Merchant in the first place, and the Ares Merchant had merely executed a proper counterattack in self-defense. As for Verley Dodd, he had proactively challenged the Ares Merchant to a duel; according to the unwritten rules of the Tiger Kingdom, the law had no jurisdiction over parties engaged in a formal challenge.

As for why Ottergold's son had his arms severed by the Ares Merchant, it was because he had lost an exorbitant sum at the gambling den and refused to pay his debts while attempting to renege. The Ares Merchant had declared that as long as he paid the price of a single arm, his debts would be written off. When Ottergold's son tried to flee, the Ares Merchant simply collected it himself.

When the chief constable went to question the Ares Merchant, the latter explicitly stated that as long as Ottergold's father was willing to clear his son's gambling debts, he would gladly help reattach the young man's arms. He couldn't guarantee they would be as good as new, but they would certainly remain functional.

Yet Ottergold not only refused to pay off this gambling debt, but he also gathered a gang of thugs to hunt down the Ares Merchant for trouble. Once again acting in self-defense, the Ares Merchant had no choice but to strike back.

Faced with the response given by the constabulary, both Viscount Dodd and Ottergold were driven to the brink of insanity.

In the past, it was always they who twisted the law through bullying, and the constabulary had always favored them in return. Back then, they never found anything wrong with it, even mocking the unlucky bastards who dared to cross them.

Yet now that the tables were turned and they were the ones suffering the losses, they felt these constables were nothing more than a bunch of blind, partial bastards—firmly convinced they must have accepted bribes from the Ares Merchant.

With the constabulary proving useless, Viscount Dodd and Ottergold sought out other authorities to champion their cause.

Turning to the City Guard, they were met with a perfunctory dismissal: maintaining order fell under the jurisdiction of the constabulary, and had nothing to do with the City Guard.

Viscount Dodd angrily accused the Ares Merchant's actions of severely undermining the overall stability of the royal capital, arguing that such a destabilizing element ought to be arrested and imprisoned to serve as a warning to other foreign visitors that the Tiger Capital was not a place where outsiders could run amok.

Jiehe, the current commander of the City Guard, was forced to step out and receive the viscount. Listening to the accusations with an expression that clearly read, *"If you're sick, go see a physician instead of throwing a tantrum here,"* Jiehe replied flatly: "Tell you what, go petition His Majesty. If he gives the order to arrest this grandmaster alchemist, I will dispatch my men."

Viscount Dodd gasped for breath in sheer fury, whirled around, and stormed off.

Searching high and low, Viscount Dodd and Ottergold ultimately took their grievances to the Queen.

Yet the moment they threw themselves at the Queen's mercy, they witnessed a sight that made their blood run cold: the Ares Merchant being respectfully and personally escorted out of the royal palace by the Queen's trusted personal maid.

chunks.chineseText:
第146章 五公主之死

阿瑞斯商看到两人，唇边勾起一丝冷笑。他才上了一点小菜，这就受不了了吗？

真正的报复哪里是打一顿就了事这么简单。

杜德两兄弟敢那么嚣张，獭金的儿子敢那么欺骗拉斐尔郎沐，还不就是仗着他们身为贵族和大商人的父亲？

如果杜德没有了贵族身份，獭金没有了庞大资产，他们两家还能继续上蹿下跳吗？这两家的子弟又还敢继续陷害不帅、到处说他坏话泼他污水吗？

他不是不帅，他从来不会对敌人仁慈，更不会给敌人爬起来反击的机会。

而这两个还只是小怪，后面还有一串小中大boss等着他解决呢。

杜德子爵很想知道阿瑞斯商来见王后是为了什么事，但王后身边的人嘴巴都很严，半个字都没有告诉杜德子爵，杜德子爵塞再多好处都没用。

獭金则开始后悔，他背后的最大靠山确实是王后没错，但他忘了，阿瑞斯商本人的身份也不低，仅他能炼制空储这点，别说王后，国王都得供着他。

现在獭金只能指望王后能看在他是她钱袋子之一，且一向听她话的份上，能给他撑撑腰，至少能缓和他和阿瑞斯商之间的关系，别让他这么下不来台。

可王后现在正忙着处理丹顿家族的财产，根本没空管这些狗屁倒灶的小事，就给了两人一句话：忍。一切事情等传承分享大会后再说。

杜德子爵和獭金无奈，能给他们撑腰的王后都要他们忍，他们还能怎么办？

两人从王宫回去家里，不约而同都下达了类似命令，那就是从现在开始到传承分享大会结束前，家族中任何人都不能在王城惹事，所有人都要低调做人。

如果阿瑞斯商再找上门来，就直接叫治安官，不要主动跟他发生任何冲突。

这个命令下得很憋屈，杜德两兄弟和獭家大少爷知道后，憋屈得差点吐血。

但他们此时还不知道，他们和他们家族的痛苦大戏才刚刚拉开帷幕。

阿瑞斯商给自己的女管家玛利亚下达了一个任务。

女管家听完任务内容，沉默良久，对阿瑞斯商屈膝行礼。

她什么都没说，但无论是她自己还是阿瑞斯商都知道，她一定会尽心尽力做好这个任务。

阿瑞斯商目送女管家离开，又找到另外两名雄性仆人。

“人才市场主管跟我推荐你们时，说你们是虎国最优秀的舞台剧演员，你们可以扮演各种身份，可以应对各种情况。之前让你们扮演仆人只是让你们牛刀小试，现在就让我看看你们真正的实力吧。”

两名雄性兽人精神一振，满眼期待地看向阿瑞斯商。

他们并不是什么最优秀的舞台剧演员，只是在这行混口饭吃，否则也不至于要他们亲叔叔帮他们介绍工作。但他们的优点在于胆子特别大，还善于学习，他们自信，如果有金钱包装开道，并有一个完美的剧本，他们什么都能演，也能演好。

阿瑞斯商看着这两名也许未来会成为大明星的雄性兽人，拿出一本皮质笔记本，为了让两人能有更好地发挥，他甚至写了一个简单的剧本。

这个剧本内容如果让地球高中水平以上的人看了，都会知道他要让两兄弟演绎的是什么样一个故事。

数日后，有一名象国商人带着一支小型商队来到虎国王城，在一家酒馆内喝酒。没多一会儿，一个外表老实可靠的中年兽人就接近了这名商人，并对他的戒指表示出极大兴趣。

象国商人亮出自己的戒指，指着戒面上镶嵌的黑色带星点宝石说：“你说这种宝石？这不是什么宝石，就是很普通的石头，我……等等，你是不是想要知道这种石头产自哪里？你想要它？”

象国商人很警觉，及时收口，并反过来询问中年兽人。

中年兽人眼看瞒不过象国商人，就坦言：“是的，我的朋友想要这种石头，如果你能告诉我产地，我可以支付你一定报酬。”

“……那如果我能把这种石头运送过来呢？”象国商人眼中流露出贪婪，是人都想赚得更多。

中年兽人左右看看，神神秘秘地说：“我们另外找地方说。”

象国商人却警觉地大声说：“不，我们就在这里说！你不告诉我，我也可以去材料市场询问本地商人，我想终会有人告诉我这些夜空星石的价值。”

当晚，这名象国商人连同他的商队队员全都从他们的下榻旅馆神秘失踪。

多少人都在寻找这名象国商人，却寻找无果。

有人立即跟其他象国人打听这名象国商人的来历。

但这种小商人太多了，他显然是第一次来虎国王城，这里的象国人并没有人认识他。

也有人立刻启程前往象国，想要碰碰运气，看能不能找到这种夜空星石的产地。

又过了半个月，有一支队伍带着两口箱子秘密进入虎国王城……

时间拉回到现在，也是不帅离开王城的第五天。

五公主被人发现死在王宫一处隐蔽的小花园内。

这个小花园几乎是废弃状态，王宫的主人们根本不会来这种犄角旮旯。

更何况五公主明明被禁足在王后的宫殿一角，从王后的宫殿走到这里需要经过多重宫殿，路上更会碰到大量侍卫和侍女。

可没有一人发现五公主从禁足之地溜到这里。

发现五公主的是宫廷祭司的侍者。

这个几乎被人忽略的小花园被这名侍者利用起来，在这里栽种了一些草药。这名侍者本身就是一名药剂师学徒。

虎王和王后都匆匆赶来了现场。

侍卫统领克莱门特已经提前一步到达，并初步检查过现场，也询问过那名侍者发现五公主尸体的详细经过。

看到五公主尸体，虎王震怒，王后悲痛。

在场所有人都噤若寒蝉，只有统领克莱门特的陈述声不急不缓，回荡在花园内。

“……综上所述，也是初步推断，五公主殿下是在没有提防的情况下，被人从正面划破脖子。五公主当时十分惊慌，她想大喊，但她喉咙受伤让她喊不出来，她想用手捂住伤口，阻止血液流出，她还想逃走，她已经转过身，但凶手十分残忍，追上去，在她后背心又插了一刀。”

克莱门特声音微微一顿：“根据伤口来看，不一定是刀，更有可能是兽人的爪子。爪尖长度超过十五厘米，微弯曲，爪尖和爪子边沿都异常锋利。”

“可以看出兽人的种类吗？”虎王尽量冷静地问。

克莱门特点头：“根据爪子的特点，基本可以锁定兽人种类，大多数都是猛兽。比如虎、熊、狮、角蜥，也有可能是水獭、树懒、角雕等。”

王后怒：“这跟不知道凶手种类有什么区别？”

克莱门特不亢不卑地回复：“确实很难锁定凶手。因为凶手也可以手持别的兽人或猛兽脱落的利爪谋害五公主。”

“封锁这件事，五公主遇害一事先进行秘密调查，先从内部查起。”虎王下令。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 146: The Death of the Fifth Princess (Part 1)

Catching sight of the two men, a cold sneer curled the corners of the Ares Merchant's lips. He had merely served up a tiny appetizer, and already they couldn't take it?

True retribution was never as simple as just giving someone a beating and calling it a day.

How was it that the two Dodd brothers dared to act so arrogantly, and Ottergold's son dared to deceive Rafael Langmu? Wasn't it entirely because they leaned on their fathers, who were nobles and wealthy merchants?

If the Dodds lost their aristocratic status and Ottergold lost his immense wealth, could these two households still prance about? Would the scions of these families still dare to frame Bu Shu, spread vicious rumors about him, and throw dirt on his name everywhere?

He was not some soft-hearted pushover; he never showed mercy to his enemies, nor would he ever give an adversary the chance to crawl back up and retaliate.

Besides, those two were mere small fry; there was still a whole string of minor, medium, and major bosses waiting in line for him to deal with.

Viscount Dodd was burning to know why the Ares Merchant had sought an audience with the Queen, but the people around Her Majesty possessed lips sealed like tombs. Not a single half-word leaked to the viscount, no matter how many bribes he tried to stuff.

As for Ottergold, he was beginning to feel deep regret. While it was true that his ultimate pillar of support was the Queen, he had forgotten that the Ares Merchant's own status was far from low. Based solely on his ability to craft storage-spatial items, let alone the Queen, even the King had to treat him with utmost reverence.

Right now, Ottergold could only pin his hopes on the Queen remembering that he was one of her personal money-bags and had always obeyed her commands, trusting that she would back him up—or at least smooth over the relations between him and the Ares Merchant so he wouldn't lose face so thoroughly.

However, the Queen was currently preoccupied with handling the assets of the Denton family and simply had no time to spare for such trivial, messy squabbles. She gave the two men a single directive: Endure. Everything else would wait until after the Heritage Sharing Conference concluded.

Viscount Dodd and Ottergold were left helpless. If even the Queen, their ultimate backer, demanded that they swallow their anger, what else could they possibly do?

Returning home from the royal palace, the two men independently issued nearly identical orders: from this moment until the conclusion of the Heritage Sharing Conference, no member of their households was permitted to stir up trouble in the royal capital. Everyone was to keep a low profile.

Should the Ares Merchant show up at their doorsteps again, they were to summon the city constables directly and avoid initiating any direct conflicts with him.

This order was issued with bitter humiliation. Upon learning of it, the two Dodd brothers and the eldest young master of the Otter family were so mortified they nearly coughed up blood.

Yet, at this moment, they still had no inkling that the tragedy and torment awaiting them and their respective families had only just begun.

The Ares Merchant assigned a specific task to his female housekeeper, Maria.

After listening to the instructions in full, the housekeeper remained silent for a long moment before curtsying to the Ares Merchant.

She said nothing, but both she and the Ares Merchant knew that she would undoubtedly execute the task to the absolute best of her ability.

Watching the housekeeper depart, the Ares Merchant turned his attention to his two remaining male servants.

"When the talent market director recommended you two to me, he claimed you were the finest stage actors in the Tiger Kingdom, capable of portraying any identity and handling any situation. Previously, letting you play simple servants was merely testing your skills with a small knife; now, let me witness your true prowess."

The two male orcs felt a surge of adrenaline, locking their eyes onto the Ares Merchant with brimming anticipation.

They weren't actually any grand stage actors; they were merely scraping by in the profession, otherwise they wouldn't have needed their paternal uncle to help secure them jobs. Their greatest strengths, however, lay in their exceptional boldness and adaptability. They were confident that with financial backing to pave the way and a flawless script, they could act out anything—and play it brilliantly.

Studying these two male orcs who might one day blossom into major stars, the Ares Merchant produced a leather-bound notebook. To ensure the pair could deliver a stellar performance, he had even penned a straightforward script.

Anyone from Earth with a high school education or above reading the contents of this plot outline would instantly recognize the exact kind of story he was setting the two brothers up to enact.

Several days later, an Elephant Kingdom merchant arrived in the Tiger Capital with a small trade caravan, drinking inside a tavern. Before long, a middle-aged orc with an honest and dependable appearance approached the merchant and displayed an intense interest in his ring.

The Elephant Kingdom merchant flashed his ring, pointing at the black star-speckled gemstone embedded on the bezel. "You're asking about this kind of gemstone? This isn't any precious gem; it's just a very ordinary stone. I—wait, are you trying to find out where this stone is mined? Do you want it?"

The Elephant Kingdom merchant was extremely vigilant, biting back his words just in time and turning the interrogation back onto the middle-aged orc.

Seeing that he could no longer fool the merchant, the middle-aged orc spoke frankly, "Yes, a friend of mine is looking for this kind of stone. If you can tell me the origin, I can pay you a certain reward."

"...And what if I manage to ship these stones over myself?" Greed flickered in the merchant's eyes; after all, anyone would jump at the chance to earn more.

The middle-aged orc glanced left and right before whispering mysteriously, "Let's find somewhere else to talk."

Instead, the Elephant Kingdom merchant raised his voice deliberately and retorted, "No, we'll talk right here! Even if you don't tell me, I can just go inquire among the local merchants in the material market; I'm sure someone will eventually tell me the value of these Night-Sky Star Stones."

That very night, the Elephant Kingdom merchant along with all the members of his trade caravan mysteriously vanished from the inn where they were staying.

Countless people searched for this Elephant Kingdom merchant, but to no avail.

Some immediately began asking other people from the Elephant Kingdom about the background of the missing merchant.

However, petty traders of his sort were simply too numerous; it was evidently his first time visiting the Tiger Capital, and none of the local Elephant Kingdom residents recognized him.

Others immediately packed their bags and departed for the Elephant Kingdom, hoping to try their luck and track down the source of these Night-Sky Star Stones.

Another half-month passed, and a convoy carrying two heavy crates secretly entered the royal capital...

Bringing the timeline back to the present moment—which was also the fifth day since Bu Shu had left the royal capital.

The Fifth Princess was discovered dead in a secluded, hidden little garden deep within the royal palace.

This small garden was practically in a state of abandonment; the masters of the royal palace would never set foot in such a forgotten nook.

Moreover, the Fifth Princess had supposedly been grounded in a corner of the Queen's palace. To walk from the Queen's quarters to this spot required passing through multiple halls and courtyards, along the way encountering numerous guards and maids.

Yet not a single soul had noticed the Fifth Princess sneaking away from her confinement to this place.

The one who stumbled upon the body was an attendant of the court priest.

This nearly forgotten garden had been utilized by the attendant to cultivate a few medicinal herbs, as the attendant himself was an apprentice apothecary.

Both the Tiger King and the Queen hurried to the scene in haste.

Commander of the Guards Clement had arrived a step ahead, having already conducted a preliminary inspection of the site and interrogated the attendant regarding the detailed sequence of events surrounding his discovery of the Fifth Princess's corpse.

Upon gazing at the Fifth Princess's remains, the Tiger King flew into a rage, while the Queen was consumed by grief.

Everyone present held their breath in absolute terror, save for Commander Clement, whose calm, steady recitation echoed through the garden.

"...To summarize, based on preliminary deductions, Her Highness the Princess was slashed across the throat from the front while completely off guard. The Fifth Princess was extremely panicked at the time; she wanted to scream, but her injured windpipe prevented her from making a sound. She tried to cover the wound with her hands to stem the bleeding, and she even attempted to flee, having already turned around. However, the perpetrator was exceptionally cruel, chasing her down and driving a second blade straight into her back."

Clement paused slightly. "Judging by the wound, it wasn't necessarily a blade; it is far more likely to have been an orc's claws. The claw tips exceed fifteen centimeters in length, slightly curved, and both the tips and the edges of the claws are abnormally sharp."

"Can you identify the species of the orc?" the Tiger King asked, trying to remain as composed as possible.

Clement nodded. "Based on the characteristics of the claws, we can essentially narrow down the category of orc: the vast majority are ferocious beasts. For instance, tigers, bears, lions, horned lizards, or potentially otters, sloths, and harpy eagles."

The Queen angrily snapped, "How is that any different from not knowing the killer's species at all?"

Clement replied neither servilely nor arrogantly, "It is indeed difficult to pinpoint the exact culprit. Because the murderer could just as easily be wielding the detached sharp claws of another orc or fierce beast to commit the murder."

"Seal off this matter. Conduct a covert investigation into the Fifth Princess's murder first, starting from within the palace," the Tiger King commanded.

chunks.chineseText:
他不想在传承大会即将召开的最重要时间段，闹出公主被杀死在王宫这样骇人听闻的丑闻。

王后也没有反驳虎王的命令，她也不想五公主被害一事闹大，尤其五公主还是从她的宫殿偷溜出来。

但五公主遇害的消息没能被彻底封锁住，虎王和王后想要彻查凶手，就不可能把消息隐瞒得住。

没过三个小时，商非凡就在坊间听到了传闻。

这样快的流言速度，要说暗中没有人推动，商非凡都不相信。

“五公主死了？”商非凡并不是很惊讶，他在王宫溜达时就有强烈预感，三王子和五公主会死一个。

至于预感来源，跟他收集到的各种琐碎信息有关，他的大脑比他的思维更快地分析出了结果，就以预感的方式告诉了他，这对于他已经不是第一次。

实际上，他有很多次都得益于这种预感，让他能逃脱或提前规避某些危险。

此时他的思维还没有重点提炼出“谁想杀了王子或公主”这一条线索，他看到听到感觉到了，但他没有特别注意到。

“是谁杀了五公主？你看到了吗？”商非凡懒得在那一家子身上花费时间和精力，直接询问天眼系统。

天眼系统能告知他的，绝不会隐瞒，直接报出凶手名字：【一名侍女，内蒂舒密尔，王后身边的亲信侍女。】

商非凡挑眉：“王后身边的亲信侍女杀了五公主？为什么？五公主发现了这个内蒂舒密尔的某个秘密？还是内蒂舒密尔接到谁的命令当了杀手？”

天眼系统：【无法判断。距离过于遥远，无法收音。且她们在说话时有意遮掩了自己的嘴唇，无法从她们的唇形判断出她们具体说了什么。】

商非凡好奇：“什么秘密竟然能让一名侍女狠心杀了一名公主？这个秘密暴露的后果一定比她杀死公主的后果要大得多也糟糕得多。难道这个侍女是安妮塔安排在王后身边的人？”

天眼系统沉默。

商非凡也不介意天眼系统在关键时掉链子，这就是一个残缺版天眼系统，能帮上忙就不错了，不能要求太多。而且天眼系统明显受到他的脑载系统控制，或者这两者根本就是一个系统，当然不可能把所有秘密都告诉他。

否则那家伙怎么驱使他干活？

虽然答应不帅不再使用隐身道具进入王宫，但商非凡有点心痒痒，想要知道这个侍女内蒂舒密尔到底隐藏了什么秘密，竟然为此连公主都宰掉了。

他不是有多高看安妮塔，而是通过安妮塔这些年的布局来看，她显然是个极有耐心且特别能忍的女兽人。五公主并不算什么重要人物，说句不好听的话，她死不死都不会影响到虎王和王后，反而会激起他们的愤怒。

如果那侍女真的是安妮塔的人，她完全没有必要安排这么重要、隐藏这么深的一个细作去杀掉一个无关紧要的公主。

所以那侍女如果真是安妮塔的人，杀死五公主的事，也只会是她自作主张。

但商非凡直觉认为该侍女和安妮塔关系不大。
chunks.englishText:
He had no wish to stir up a scandalous and shocking incident, such as a princess being murdered right inside the royal palace, during the most critical period right before the upcoming Heritage Assembly.

The Queen did not refute the Tiger King's order either; she was equally unwilling to blow the murder of the Fifth Princess out of proportion, especially since the Fifth Princess had sneaked out of her palace in the first place.

However, news of the Fifth Princess meeting her demise could not be completely sealed off. If the Tiger King and the Queen wanted to thoroughly investigate the murderer, it was impossible to keep the news under wraps.

In less than three hours, Shang Feifan heard the rumors floating around the streets.

With such rapid spread of the gossip, Shang Feifan would never believe that there was no one secretly pushing things along behind the scenes.

"The Fifth Princess is dead?" Shang Feifan was not particularly surprised. When he had been strolling through the royal palace earlier, he had a strong premonition that either the Third Prince or the Fifth Princess would die.

As for the source of this premonition, it was related to the various fragments of miscellaneous information he had gathered. His brain had analyzed the results much faster than his conscious thought, presenting it to him in the form of a premonition—and this was far from the first time it had happened to him.

In fact, he had benefited from this kind of premonition on numerous occasions, allowing him to escape or preemptively avoid certain dangers.

At the time, his thoughts had not yet explicitly distilled the clue of "who wants to kill the prince or princess." He had seen, heard, and felt it, but he hadn't paid special attention to it.

"Who killed the Fifth Princess? Did you see it?" Shang Feifan couldn't be bothered to waste time and energy on that family and directly questioned the Heavenly Eye System.

Whatever the Heavenly Eye System could tell him, it would never conceal. It directly reported the murderer's name: [A maid-in-waiting, Netty Schmidt, a trusted confidante by the Queen's side.]

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow: "A trusted maid by the Queen's side killed the Fifth Princess? Why? Did the Fifth Princess discover some secret belonging to Netty Schmidt? Or did Netty Schmidt take orders from someone to act as an assassin?"

Heavenly Eye System: [Unable to determine. The distance is too far, and audio recording is impossible. Furthermore, they deliberately shielded their lips while speaking, making it impossible to determine what they said specifically from their lip shapes.]

Shang Feifan was curious: "What kind of secret could possibly make a maid ruthlessly murder a princess? The consequences of this secret being exposed must be far greater and more terrible than the consequences of her killing a princess. Could this maid be someone Anita planted by the Queen's side?"

The Heavenly Eye System fell silent.

Shang Feifan didn't mind the Heavenly Eye System dropping the ball at a crucial moment; this was merely an incomplete version of the Heavenly Eye System, and it was already helpful enough—he couldn't ask for too much. Moreover, the Heavenly Eye System was clearly controlled by his onboard brain system, or perhaps the two were simply the same system. Naturally, it was impossible for it to tell him all its secrets.

Otherwise, how could that fellow drive him to work?

Although he had promised Bu Shuai not to use stealth items to enter the royal palace anymore, Shang Feifan's curiosity was somewhat tickled. He wanted to know what kind of secret this maid, Netty Schmidt, was hiding that compelled her to slaughter even a princess over it.

He didn't hold Anita in exceptionally high regard, but judging by Anita's maneuvers over the years, she was clearly a female beastman with immense patience and endurance. The Fifth Princess was hardly an important figure; to put it bluntly, whether she lived or died would not affect the Tiger King and Queen in the slightest—on the contrary, it would only ignite their fury.

If that maid was truly Anita's person, there was absolutely no necessity for her to arrange such an important, deeply hidden mole to assassinate an inconsequential princess.

Therefore, if that maid genuinely belonged to Anita, the act of killing the Fifth Princess could only be her own arbitrary decision.

Yet, Shang Feifan's intuition told him that the maid didn't have much of a connection to Anita.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第147章 五公主的死因 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第147章 五公主的死因

王家四位继承人全都来了。

就连被关起来的三王子也被临时放出来。

四个人看到最小妹妹的尸体，神情都不太好看。

大王子眼圈当时就红了，他一步步走到小妹身边，单膝跪下，伸手轻轻抚摸她的头发和脸。

大王子想起了五妹的小时候。

他是老大，比老二年长五岁，比小五年长十九岁，见过每个弟弟妹妹的幼崽时期，看着他们一点点长大。

尤其是五妹，她出生的时候，他已经是青年。

他还记得自己有多么喜欢这个妹妹，成天把她抱在怀里，都舍不得撒手。

后来这个妹妹一天天长大，不知道什么时候就跟他越行越远，也不再和他亲近，有时候他都觉得自己妹妹像是变了一个人。

小时候那么可爱的小家伙，长大后怎么就变得那么任性自私心眼狭小，恨不得整个世界都围着她转，稍微有点不如意就撒泼胡闹，甚至为此伤人杀人。

但不管五公主的性格如何，这都是他妹妹，亲妹妹！

大王子脑子中现在都是这个小妹妹小时候天真无邪的模样，就连她后来一些让他无法忍受的举动也在她死后变得无足轻重。

大王子用力擦拭流出的眼泪。

虎王轻轻拍抚大儿子的肩膀。

大王子用手遮住眼睛，却根本挡不住涌出的泪水。

二王子抬手擦过眼睛，眼睛也是红通通的。

三王子怔愣地看着五公主的尸体，似乎还无法相信一国公主就这么死了。

大公主表现得最冷静，她只是沉默地看着妹妹的尸体。

过了很长一段时间，大公主第一个开口：“有凶手的线索了吗？”

虎王摇头。

王后脱力地坐在宽大的椅子上，她在观察她的几个孩子。

她不是怀疑自己的孩子是杀死亲手足的凶手，她只是想要看看这几个孩子在知道自己妹妹死亡后都会有什么样的表现。

每个人的表现都很符合他们的各自性格。

内蒂舒密尔就站在王后身边，手里拿着救急的药剂。她的眼神很哀伤，不时用担心的眼神看向王后。

虎王也带了一个人，侍卫角马。

他没有带雷米尔，因为他觉得这个场合不适合雷米尔出现。他也不想看到雷米尔可能会有的任何表情。

“我们合力查，大家一条心，一定可以查出凶手。”大公主慢慢说道。

虎王也拍了拍大公主的肩膀。

二王子开口，声音微微沙哑：“凶手留下的痕迹非常少，加上没有一个人注意到茜娜和其他人进入那个园子，说明凶手对王宫内部一定非常熟悉。而且茜娜会在那里见凶手，并对凶手没有丝毫提防，说明凶手一定是茜娜认识的人，茜娜说不定还很信任对方。”

三王子立刻像是被惊醒一样，大声说：“对！一定是熟人！先查小五身边的侍卫，她那些侍卫有可能为了争风吃醋杀了她。”

室内一静，三王子还没有察觉，继续嚷嚷：“我早就跟小五说过，她收的那些雄性兽人不是好控制的，他们要么图财、要么图前途，要么就是贪图小五这个公主身份可以给他们带来的其他好处，为此他们可以忍受小五的不讲理和任性，还有狠毒和花心，可一旦小五不能满足他们的要求，他们一定会反噬……”

“够了！”虎王一声爆喝，吓得三王子立刻闭嘴。

“你就是这么看你妹妹的？”虎王冷眼看三王子。

三王子低头不说话，心里则在腹诽：这可不是我怎么看，是你小女儿她就是这么一个人。

王后深吸气，后面的内蒂立刻拿出一小瓶嗅闻式药剂递给她。

“老三的话不好听，但也有一定道理。”大公主说话还是那么冷静。

虎王单手按到自己的要带上，沉声：“小五身边的人都已经被看押起来，如今侍卫统领克莱门特正在审问他们。”

不知道是不是自己的错觉，虎王总觉得有谁像是在盯着他这条腰带。

虎王眼睛扫过整个房间，没有发现半点异样。

大王子也想为找到杀害小妹的凶手出一份力，但他现在脑子很乱，一看到小妹紧闭的双眼、苍白的脸颊，就难受得不行。

“还有当时看管五妹的人。”二王子再次开口，他看向王后：“五妹是什么时候从禁足之地出来，当时又是谁在看守她，这些都需要查清楚。五妹能从禁足之地出来，肯定有人帮助了她。而这个人必然是母后身边的人。”

虎王也早想这么说，他更想借此机会把王后身边的人全部控制起来，但这样做，势必会和王后撕破脸皮，所以他忍到了现在。

眼看王后死活不主动说要调查她身边的人，显然这件事她打算自己私下进行，没想到很少说话的二王子竟在此时开口，还说出了虎王最想说出来的话。

虎王也想拍拍二儿子的肩膀，但最终他没有伸手。

王后沉默片刻：“内蒂，你和克莱门特统领配合，这件事，给我查到底。”

内蒂立刻躬身应是。

哀悼过后，虎王把大王子、二王子和大公主都叫走了。

三王子左右看看，他是继续回去软禁的地方，还是可以自由行动了？

王后也在内蒂的陪伴下离开。

三王子留在了最后，他下意识抬头看向五妹的尸体，突然打了个寒颤，转身就跑。

这间临时的停灵室变得极为安静，只有两名侍卫站在门口守卫。

商非凡从屋顶大梁上跳下来，仔细查看五公主的伤势，顺便感知到对方身上残留的怨气。

如此强烈的怨气，恐怕就算没有天眼系统告诉他凶手是谁，他凭借怨气指引，都能找到杀死五公主的凶手。

可惜他对灵魂学不擅长，否则现在可以看看五公主的怨灵在不在，然后看能不能问出一些关键信息。

不过没关系，有这么强烈的怨气在，他完全可以换个方式审问凶手。

晚上，王宫变得安静。

在所有侍候的人都离开后，卧室里只剩下内蒂一个侍女。

王后忽然用不自信的语调说：“我是不是做错了？”

内蒂等了一会儿，才小声说道：“不，您已经做到一位母亲和王后能做到的一切。”

王后苦笑，眼底发青，她还在壮年期，她的容颜也没有衰老，但她感觉自己的精气神似乎大不如以往。

老五不是她最爱的孩子，但那也是她的亲骨肉啊！

在有了不止一个孩子后，她不止一次地想过要让谁来继承这个国家。

她选出了最有可能的三个，放弃了另外两个。

老三和小五都是她选择的放弃对象。

因为确定他们不会继承王位，她对他们的教育就不怎么上心，甚至会故意放纵他们的“天性”。

她不希望她的孩子们为了王位挣得你死我活，想着其中几个蠢一点也好，至少未来的国王能容忍一个愚蠢的兄弟姐妹，但他一定无法接受一个聪明又有野心的手足。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 147: The Cause of the Fifth Princess's Death

All four royal heirs had arrived.

Even the Third Prince, who had been locked up, was temporarily released.

Seeing the corpse of their youngest sister, none of the four wore pleasant expressions.

The First Prince's eyes instantly turned red. He walked step by step to the side of his youngest sister, knelt on one knee, and gently stroked her hair and face with his hand.

The First Prince recalled the Fifth Sister's childhood.

He was the eldest, five years older than the second, and nineteen years older than the youngest. He had witnessed every younger sibling's cubhood and watched them grow up bit by bit.

Especially the Fifth Sister; by the time she was born, he was already a young man.

He still remembered how much he adored this little sister, holding her in his arms all day long and refusing to let go.

Later on, as this sister grew day by day, she drifted further and further away from him at some point, no longer close to him. Sometimes, he even felt as though his sister had turned into a completely different person.

How could such an adorable little tot from their childhood grow up to become so willful, selfish, and narrow-minded, wishing the whole world would revolve around her, throwing tantrums and making a scene over the slightest dissatisfaction, and even hurting or killing people because of it?

Yet regardless of the Fifth Princess's personality, she was still his sister—his own flesh and blood!

Right now, the First Prince's mind was filled only with the innocent and naive image of this little sister from her childhood, and even those actions of hers later on that he had found intolerable became insignificant following her death.

The First Prince wiped hard at the tears flowing from his eyes.

The Tiger King gently patted and stroked his eldest son's shoulder.

The First Prince covered his eyes with his hand, yet he utterly failed to stem the gushing tears.

The Second Prince raised a hand to wipe across his eyes; his eyes were equally red-rimmed.

The Third Prince stared blankly at the Fifth Princess's corpse, seemingly still unable to believe that a princess of the realm had died just like that.

The Eldest Princess appeared the calmest; she merely looked silently at her sister's body.

After a long while, the Eldest Princess was the first to speak: "Are there any clues to the murderer?"

The Tiger King shook his head.

The Queen sat drained of strength in a large, wide chair, observing her children.

She didn't suspect her own children of being the murderers of their own sibling; she simply wanted to see what kind of reactions these children would display upon learning of their sister's death.

Each person's reaction completely matched their respective personality.

Netty Schmidt stood beside the Queen, holding a bottle of emergency potion. Her expression was deeply sorrowful, and from time to time, she cast worried glances toward the Queen.

The Tiger King had also brought someone: the guard Wildebeest.
