He had not brought Remir because he felt this occasion was inappropriate for Remir's presence. Nor did he wish to see whatever expression Remir might wear.

"We will investigate together. With everyone of one mind, we will surely find the murderer," the Eldest Princess said slowly.

The Tiger King also patted the Eldest Princess's shoulder.

The Second Prince spoke up, his voice slightly hoarse: "The traces left behind by the murderer are extremely minimal. Coupled with the fact that not a single person noticed Xina and the others entering that courtyard, it shows that the murderer is certainly extremely familiar with the interior of the royal palace. Moreover, for Xina to meet the murderer there and harbor not the slightest vigilance toward them, it proves that the murderer must be someone Xina knew—and Xina might even have trusted the other party deeply."

As if jolted awake, the Third Prince immediately blurted out loudly, "Right! It must be an acquaintance! Let's investigate Xiao Wu's personal guards first; those male beastmen of hers might have killed her out of jealousy and rivalry."

The room fell dead silent. Without even realizing it, the Third Prince continued to rant, "I told Xiao Wu long ago that the male beastmen she takes in aren't easy to control. They're either after money, chasing a future, or coveting the other benefits that Xiao Wu's status as a princess can bring them. For that, they can endure Xiao Wu's unreasonableness, wilfulness, viciousness, and promiscuity. But the moment Xiao Wu fails to satisfy their demands, they will definitely bite back..."

"Enough!" The Tiger King let out a booming roar, startling the Third Prince into snapping his mouth shut instantly.

"Is that how you view your sister?" The Tiger King cast a cold glance at the Third Prince.

The Third Prince lowered his head in silence, inwardly scoffing: This isn't how I view her; your youngest daughter is simply that kind of person.

The Queen took a deep breath, and Netty immediately handed over a small bottle of inhalant potion from behind.

"Third Brother's words sound harsh, but they do make some sense," the Eldest Princess spoke with her habitual calmness.

The Tiger King pressed a single hand to his belt, saying in a deep voice, "Everyone around Xiao Wu has already been placed under arrest, and Guards Commander Clement is currently interrogating them."

Whether it was his own illusion or not, the Tiger King always felt as though someone was staring fixedly at his belt.

The Tiger King swept his gaze across the entire room, finding not the slightest trace of abnormality.

The First Prince also wanted to contribute to finding the murderer of his youngest sister, but his mind was in utter chaos right now; the moment he saw his little sister's tightly closed eyes and pale cheeks, he felt an unbearable ache.

"And we must check those guarding Fifth Sister at the time." The Second Prince spoke up once more. He looked toward the Queen: "When did Fifth Sister leave the grounds of confinement, and who was guarding her at the time? Both need to be thoroughly investigated. For Fifth Sister to have been able to leave the restricted area, someone must have helped her. And that person is bound to be someone close to Mother Queen."

The Tiger King had long wanted to say this; he even wished to seize this opportunity to place everyone around the Queen under his control. Yet doing so would inevitably mean tearing down all pretenses with the Queen, which was why he had endured until now.

Seeing that the Queen stubbornly refused to voluntarily suggest investigating the people around her—clearly intending to handle this matter privately in secret—he had never expected that the rarely speaking Second Prince would speak up at this exact moment, voicing the very words the Tiger King most wanted to utter.

The Tiger King wanted to pat his second son's shoulder as well, but ultimately, he held back his hand.

The Queen remained silent for a moment: "Netty, you will coordinate with Commander Clement. Investigate this matter to the very end for me."

Netty immediately bowed and complied.

After the mourning, the Tiger King summoned the First Prince, Second Prince, and Eldest Princess away.

The Third Prince looked around to the left and right: should he continue back to his place of confinement, or was he now free to move about?

The Queen also departed, accompanied by Netty.

The Third Prince remained until the very last. Subconsciously raising his head to look at his youngest sister's corpse, he suddenly shivered and bolted away.

The temporary mourning hall grew exceptionally quiet, with only two guards standing watch at the entrance.

Shang Feifan dropped down from the roof beams, carefully examining the Fifth Princess's injuries while simultaneously sensing the lingering resentment left behind on her body.

With such intense resentment, even without the Heavenly Eye System telling him who the culprit was, he could likely track down the murderer of the Fifth Princess simply by following the guidance of the grudge.

Pity that he was unskilled in the study of souls; otherwise, he could check right now to see if the Fifth Princess's vengeful spirit was present, and then see if he could extract some crucial information.

Still, it didn't matter. With such intense resentment lingering here, he could completely change his approach to interrogating the murderer.

That night, the royal palace grew quiet.

Once all the attending servants had departed, only the maid Netty remained in the bedchamber.

The Queen suddenly spoke in an uncertain tone: "Did I do something wrong?"

Netty waited for a moment before speaking in a low voice: "No, you have already done everything a mother and a queen can possibly do."

The Queen gave a bitter smile, dark shadows under her eyes. Although she was still in her prime and her beauty had not faded, she felt her vitality and spirit were far inferior to days gone by.

Lao Wu was not her favorite child, but she was still her own flesh and blood!

After having more than one child, she had thought more than once about who should inherit this country.

She had selected the three most likely candidates and abandoned the other two.

Both Lao San (the Third Prince) and Xiao Wu (the Fifth Princess) were the targets she chose to abandon.

Because she was certain they would not inherit the throne, she hadn't put much effort into their education, even deliberately indulging their "nature."

She did not wish for her children to fight tooth and nail for the throne, thinking it would be good if a couple of them were a bit foolish. At the very least, a future king could tolerate a foolish brother or sister, but he would certainly never accept a clever and ambitious sibling.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第147章 五公主的死因 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
她其实也没有选择大公主，但大公主入了狮域的眼缘，加上大公主自己尚武，宁可放弃宫廷教育，也要跟着狮域在兵营里混，她想着有个能掌握一定军权的公主也不错，只要野心不太大，将来也可以辅佐自己的兄弟。

为此，她还屡次有意无意地打压大公主，不让她冒头。

剩下两个儿子，一个是生来就拥有第一继承权的长子，还有一个则是聪慧英俊会体贴她的二王子。

二王子看起来是个学者的性子，对权力似乎也不是很在乎，但王后知道这个儿子很聪明，也很有能力，小小年纪就知道藏拙。

她看着对方随着年龄增长，暗中铺设的人际网也越发广大。

还有二王子的敛财能力，这一点绝对远超其他四个兄妹。

王后敢打赌，就是虎王也不知道他的二儿子拥有的财力已经不亚于一个传统大贵族。王城最大佣兵团，以及几家大型商行背后都有二王子的身影。

王后原本也不知道这些，她是在一个偶然的机会，才知道二王子年纪不大竟然就在暗地里经营了那么大的生意。

之后她就一直很关注这个儿子，并暗中给了他不少帮助。

她承认，她更愿意帮助次子，也是因为长子更偏向其父亲虎王，立场也更站在虎王那边。而次子则比长子贴心得多，也更愿意与丹顿家族友好相处。

她也明白，今天二王子主动提及要查她身边的人，不是让她难堪，而是为了缓和她和虎王之间的关系。

她不好主动提查自己的人，那会让她没有面子。虎王也不好主动提，那会让两个人的关系更僵硬。

大王子当时光顾着沉浸在痛苦中，完全想不到这些。

而大公主足够冷静，但她明显没有插手查案的意思，显然不想搅进这滩浑水中。

大王子过于感情用事，在关键时候很可能背负不起重任。大公主理智却只想利己。三王子就不用提了。对比下来，王后越发确信，她的选择没有错。

是的，我没有做错！

小五会被害，都是害她的人太恶毒！也是小五倒霉。

“你一定要好好配合克莱门特统领，把帮助小五离开宫殿的人务必给我找出来！”

“是。”内蒂垂下头，见王后闭上眼睛，立刻放下床帘，恭敬退下。

内蒂的休息室距离王后的起居室不远，那是一间很小的隔间，里面狭窄得只能放一张单人床和一个小柜子。

内蒂坐在单人床上，像是在发呆。

过了一会儿，她从衣襟下扯出一条项链，握住项链挂坠，那神情就像是握住了某种依靠。

半个小时后，内蒂也梳洗睡下。

内蒂睡得有点不安稳，她开始不断做梦。

她隐隐察觉自己在做梦，想要从梦境中挣脱出来。

可梦中追杀她的女兽人太可怕！

她知道那个女兽人是谁。

那是五公主。

死亡后的五公主变得更可怕，那张脸狰狞得简直让人望之就会做噩梦！

“滚开！”

“你死了！我知道你已经死了，你吓不住我！”

“我能杀你一次，就能杀你第二次！”

内蒂变身，扑向五公主。

五公主也变身了，更可怕的是她的身体开始变异，变得无比庞大。

内蒂却发现自己的动作变得缓慢无比。跑不动，也抬不起爪子，她想张口撕咬，却连嘴巴的咬合都变得无力。

也因此，她更加确定自己在做梦。

醒过来！内蒂的意识拼命挣扎，她努力想要抬起自己的手指。

她知道只要她能抬起自己的手指，她就一定能清醒过来。

啊，她的手指动了。

内蒂的大脑立刻恢复清醒。

她醒了，她从噩梦中挣脱了。

内蒂差点喜极而泣。

“内蒂。”

内蒂抬头，惊喜：“你怎么来了？”

对方温柔地看着她：“你在害怕，我感觉到了。”

内蒂咬住嘴唇。

雄性兽人握住她的手：“别害怕。我知道你都是为了我。”

内蒂呢喃：“她知道了，她看到你和我在一起，她威胁我放她出去，她竟然还无耻地肖想你。她逼迫我，让我约你出来，她想和你见面，她想勾引你……那个不要脸的贱人！”

“是公主又怎么了？是公主就能肖想别人的雄性？她都有那么多俊美侍从了，为什么她不能放过你，为什么要从我身边夺走你……”

“我不能让她这么做，我也不想你痛苦。她是公主，就算你再得陛下信重，你也无法抗拒她，你一定会被迫成为她的面首，你会成为近卫中的笑话，你外公知道了也会对你更有意见……”

内蒂抬起头，握住雄性的手，迫切且焦急地说：“你不会怪我的对吗？我不是有意要杀她，是她说话太难听了，我恳求她，求她不要去找你，求她不要把我们的关系说出去，但她不但不肯，她还嘲笑我，她还嘲笑你，说你只是一个小小的侍卫，只要她勾勾手指，你就会像狗一样……”

内蒂恨得咬牙：“那个贱人！她该死！我不能让她毁了你。”

雄性兽人温柔地把她抱入怀中，温柔地亲吻她。

内蒂哭泣着，紧紧抓住雄性兽人的衣襟，反复呢喃：“……我爱你……雷米尔，我爱你，我会为你做任何事情，不要把我当凶手看……”

内蒂哭醒了。

醒来才发现自己做了一个梦中梦。

内蒂捂脸，把自己缩成一团。

一股怨气被强行拽出内蒂的身体。

商非凡也迅速离开了王宫。

怨气只会让内蒂见到在梦中追杀她的五公主，他原本想利用五公主诱使内蒂说出她杀害对方的原因。

没想到内蒂自己搞了个梦中梦。

原本内蒂挣脱怨气侵袭，商非凡还有点小小惊讶，称赞这名侍女坚韧的精神。

结果内蒂因为强烈不安和强烈的倾诉欲望，“逃”向了她认为最安全的港湾，也就是她情人的怀抱。

之后她对她情人说的那些话，都是她想告诉她情人的，但她又不能真正地告诉对方。

只是内蒂不知道，在商非凡操纵怨气对她进行有意引导下，那些话她不仅仅在梦中说出，而是真的说出了口，有点像是催眠。

成功得到答案的商非凡却有些郁闷。

费这么大劲，且让他在王宫浪费了大半个下午和大半个晚上的时间，结果这就是一桩称不上情杀案的争风吃醋案件。

他甚至想，三王子那家伙搞不好有做侦探的资质。虽然他搞错了对象，不是公主身边的侍卫吃醋杀人，而是公主想要抢夺他人情人，被情敌给杀了。

商非凡没有回去自己租来的府邸，他跑去了特调局。

不帅不在的日子，他都睡在不帅那张单人床上。

“阿沐，你回来了！”

商非凡超级惊喜，一下就扑倒正在换衣服的不帅。

不帅仰面躺在床上，伸手按住某人：“今晚不变成小老虎了？”

“你不在，变什么变。”商非凡抱住人，黏黏糊糊。

“变成小老虎，我的床太窄了。”不帅轻敲他的脑袋。
chunks.englishText:
In truth, she hadn't chosen the Eldest Princess either, but the Eldest Princess had caught the eye of the Lion Territory. Coupled with the Eldest Princess's own martial inclinations—preferring to forsake court education to mix with the Lion Territory in the military camps—she figured having a princess who could command a certain degree of military power wasn't a bad idea, provided her ambitions weren't too grand; she could still assist her brothers in the future.

To this end, she had even repeatedly suppressed the Eldest Princess intentionally or unintentionally, preventing her from coming to the fore.

As for the remaining two sons, one was the eldest born with the right of primogeniture, and the other was the clever, handsome Second Prince who knew how to cater to her feelings.

The Second Prince appeared to have a scholar's temperament and seemed largely indifferent to power, yet the Queen knew this son was exceptionally clever and capable, knowing how to hide his talents and bide his time from a very young age.

As he grew older, she watched as the network of interpersonal relationships he laid out in secret expanded ever more vastly.

There was also the Second Prince's talent for accumulating wealth, which absolutely far surpassed his other four siblings.

The Queen would bet anything that even the Tiger King was unaware that his second son's financial resources were already no less than those of a traditional grand noble. The largest mercenary group in the royal city and several major commercial firms all had the Second Prince's shadow behind them.

The Queen hadn't known any of this originally; it was only by a stroke of chance that she discovered her second son, despite his young age, was actually operating such a massive enterprise in secret.

From then on, she kept a close eye on this son and covertly provided him with no small amount of assistance.

She admitted that she was more willing to help her second son also because the eldest leaned closer to his father, the Tiger King, standing more firmly on the Tiger King's side. In contrast, the second son was far more considerate than the eldest and much more willing to maintain friendly relations with the Denton family.

She also understood that today, when the Second Prince proactively brought up investigating the people around her, it wasn't to put her on the spot, but rather to ease the tension between her and the Tiger King.

It would be awkward for her to proactively suggest investigating her own people, as it would cause her to lose face. Nor would it be easy for the Tiger King to suggest it himself, as that would only make their relationship even more rigid.

At the time, the First Prince had been too consumed by grief to think of any of this.

Meanwhile, the Eldest Princess was calm enough, but she clearly had no intention of meddling in the investigation, obviously unwilling to wade into this muddy pool.

The First Prince was overly emotional and likely incapable of bearing heavy responsibilities at critical moments. The Eldest Princess was rational, but her sole concern was self-preservation. As for the Third Prince, there was no need to even mention him. Comparing them all, the Queen grew increasingly convinced that her choice had been correct.

Yes, I did nothing wrong!

Xiao Wu met her doom simply because the person who harmed her was too vicious! It was also Xiao Wu's own bad luck.

"You must properly cooperate with Commander Clement and make sure to find the person who helped Xiao Wu leave the palace!"

"Understood." Netty lowered her head. Seeing the Queen close her eyes, she immediately lowered the bed curtains and respectfully withdrew.

Netty's resting quarters were not far from the Queen's living chambers; it was a tiny compartment, so narrow that it could barely fit a single bed and a small cabinet.

Netty sat on the single bed, looking as though she were in a daze.

After a while, she pulled a necklace out from under the collar of her garments, clutching the pendant tightly as if gripping some kind of psychological support.

Half an hour later, Netty washed up and went to sleep.

Netty's sleep was somewhat restless, and she began to experience continuous dreams.

Vaguely sensing that she was dreaming, she tried desperately to break free from the dreamscape.

Yet the female beastman hunting her down in the dream was terrifying!

She knew who that female beastman was.

It was the Fifth Princess.

Having died, the Fifth Princess had become even more horrifying, her face twisted and ferocious to the point that one would have nightmares just looking at it!

"Get away!"

"You're dead! I know you're already dead, you can't scare me!"

"I could kill you once, and I can kill you a second time!"

Netty transformed and lunged at the Fifth Princess.

The Fifth Princess transformed as well, and what made it even more terrifying was that her body began to mutate, growing incomparably massive.

Yet Netty found that her own movements had become sluggish to the extreme. She couldn't run, nor could she raise her claws. When she wanted to open her mouth to tear and bite, even her jaw's biting strength turned powerless.

Because of this, she grew all the more certain that she was dreaming.

Wake up! Netty's consciousness struggled frantically, trying hard to wiggle her fingers.

She knew that as long as she could move her fingers, she would definitely wake up.

Ah, her finger moved.

Netty's mind instantly regained clarity.

She woke up; she had broken free from the nightmare.

Netty almost wept with joy.

"Netty."

Netty looked up, pleasantly surprised: "Why are you here?"

The other party looked at her tenderly: "You're scared, I could feel it."

Netty bit her lip.

The male beastman took her hand: "Don't be afraid. I know you did it all for me."

Netty murmured: "She found out. She saw you with me, and she threatened me to let her out. She even shamelessly coveted you. She forced me, making me lure you out—she wanted to meet you, she wanted to seduce you... that shameless bitch!"

"So what if she's a princess? Does being a princess mean she can covet someone else's male? She already had so many handsome attendants, why couldn't she just let you go? Why did she have to snatch you away from my side..."

"I couldn't let her do that, and I didn't want you to suffer. She's a princess. No matter how much His Majesty favors and trusts you, you wouldn't be able to resist her. You would be forced to become her kept plaything, you'd become a laughingstock among the guards, and if your maternal grandfather found out, he'd have an even worse opinion of you..."

Netty raised her head, grasping the male beastman's hand eagerly and anxiously: "You don't blame me, do you? I didn't mean to kill her. It's just that her words were too vicious. I begged her, pleaded with her not to come looking for you, begged her not to let our relationship slip out. But not only did she refuse, she even mocked me. She mocked you too, saying you were nothing more than a lowly guard, and that as long as she crooking her finger, you would come running like a dog..."

Consumed by hatred, Netty muttered, "That bitch! She deserves to die! I couldn't let her ruin you."

The male beastman pulled her gently into his embrace, placing tender kisses upon her.

Weeping, Netty clutched tightly at the male beastman's collar, repeatedly murmuring: "...I love you... Remir, I love you, I'd do anything for you, don't look at me like I'm a murderer..."

Netty cried herself awake.

Waking up, she realized she had experienced a dream within a dream.

Netty covered her face, curling herself into a ball.

A wisp of resentment was forcibly pulled out from Netty's body.

Shang Feifan promptly left the royal palace as well.

The resentment would only cause Netty to see the Fifth Princess hunting her down in her dreams; originally, he had intended to use the Fifth Princess to entice Netty into revealing her reasons for killing her.

He hadn't expected Netty to conjure up a dream within a dream all on her own.

At first, when Netty broke free from the encroachment of the resentment, Shang Feifan had felt a tiny sliver of surprise, mentally praising the maid's resilient spirit.

As it turned out, driven by intense anxiety and a strong desire to unburden herself, Netty had "fled" toward the safe haven she deemed most secure: the embrace of her lover.

Afterward, all those things she said to her lover were things she wished to tell him, yet could never truly voice in reality.

Only, Netty had no idea that under Shang Feifan's deliberate guidance wielding the resentment, those words were not merely spoken in a dream—she had genuinely muttered them aloud, somewhat akin to hypnosis.

Having successfully obtained the answer, Shang Feifan felt somewhat depressed.

Going through so much trouble, making him waste most of a sunny afternoon and deep into the night within the royal palace, and it all boiled down to a petty case of jealousy and rivalry that couldn't even be called a genuine crime of passion.

He even found himself thinking that the Third Prince might actually have the aptitude to be a detective. Though the fellow had gotten the target wrong—it wasn't a guard of the princess killing out of jealousy, but rather the princess attempting to snatch someone else's lover, only to be slain by a rival in romance.

Shang Feifan did not return to his rented mansion; instead, he bolted straight to the Special Investigation Bureau.

On the days when Bu Shuai was away, he always slept on Bu Shuai's single bed.

"A-Mu, you're back!"

Shang Feifan was overwhelmingly surprised, instantly pouncing and knocking over Bu Shuai, who was in the middle of changing his clothes.

Lying flat on his back on the bed, Bu Shuai reached out to press down on the fellow: "Not turning into a little tiger tonight?"

"You're not here, what's the point of changing." Shang Feifan wrapped his arms around him, clinging to him affectionately.

"If you turn into a little tiger, my bed is too narrow." Bu Shuai lightly tapped him on the head.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第147章 五公主的死因 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡不愿意：“上次不也没变，你睡我身上就好。”

不帅一脚把人踹开：“你要么睡地上，要么变成小老虎，二选一。”

商非凡二话不说，伸手一扯衣服，衣裤落地，一只小老虎从衣服里蹿出来，一个高跃跳进不帅怀里。

不帅抱住小老虎，感受到这份沉甸甸的份量，不帅的心也顿时安稳下来。

“这么晚才回来，跑哪儿浪去了？”捏捏小老虎的耳朵。

“我去看戏了。你知道么，五公主死了。你知道她是被谁杀死的吗？是王后身边的心腹侍女，一个叫内蒂舒密尔的女兽人。你知道那个侍女为什么要杀五公主吗？因为五公主看上了她的情人。”

不帅被这串自问自答逗笑了，但他很快就收起笑容：“五公主死了？”

他不喜欢五公主，但……原身和五公主可是有血缘关系的亲姐弟。

因为这点，就算五公主和三王子经常找他的麻烦，他也是能忍让就忍让。

现在听到五公主年纪轻轻就死了，不帅说不上难过，但也无法感到高兴。

商非凡把他查到的线索和从内蒂那里听到的内容进行拼凑，推测：“我想事情大致应该是这样的……侍女内蒂有一个叫雷米尔的侍卫情人，五公主看上了这个雷米尔。我在虎王身边见过这个雷米尔，长得确实还可以，外在条件算是不错。”

商非凡脑中闪过什么，但没有抓住。

“雷米尔？”不帅惊讶。

“如果我没听错的话。”小老虎拍爪子：“总之，五公主发现虎王侍卫雷米尔和王后侍女内蒂有亲密关系，而考虑到王后和虎王的关系，如果让王后知道心腹侍女内蒂和虎王身边的侍卫好上，可以想见内蒂会有什么下场，就算不死，也会被王后厌弃。”

“内蒂因此受到五公主威胁，不得不把她从禁足地放出来。五公主也不知道是无聊，还是纯心恶心人，被放出来的第一个要求就是想要见一见雷米尔，还非要内蒂去约自家情人。”

“内蒂就把地点选在了一个非常僻静的小花园中。但她并没有让自己的情人过去见五公主，而是自己去了。”

“内蒂恳求五公主放过他们，恳求五公主不要对王后告密，但五公主拒绝，还嘲笑了内蒂。”

“最后内蒂一怒之下，就把五公主给杀了。”

不帅不可置信：“就这样？”

小老虎摊开爪爪：“真的就这样。除非内蒂的精神力量强大到比我还强，还能在被催眠状态快速编造出一个逻辑通顺的故事。”

不帅缓缓吐气。

这位五公主死得可真是……都不能说冤，只能说是她自己硬作的。

好端端地非要去抢别人的情人。

以不帅对这位公主的了解，他甚至觉得五公主可能并没有多喜欢雷米尔，她可能更多地是出于自己被禁足的愤怒和不爽，让她想要折腾别人。

而王后身边的亲信侍女，负责传达命令的内蒂就成了她最想报复的对象。

不帅猜测五公主不知道从哪里得知内蒂和雷米尔的地下恋情，就以此作为威胁，更把抢夺内蒂情人这件事当做了一个能让内蒂痛苦、却能让她快乐的游戏兼惩罚手段。

五公主大概至死都不会想到，她会因为一个“小小”恶作剧把自己给作死了。

当然，这些都是他和商非凡的推理和猜测，事实到底如何，还得看王宫那边的追查结果。

“内蒂会被查出来吗？”

“那个侍卫统领克莱门特是个厉害家伙。”商非凡难得赞扬别人，但他这句称赞却说的真心实意。他有次经过克莱门特身边，差点被对方逮住。

克莱门特应该已经发现有人隐身进入了王宫，但他不动声色，连虎王都没有告知，就一直自己在做布防。

不帅嘴角微翘，“他确实很厉害。”

小老虎不高兴，小老虎妒忌了，翻身咬不帅。

不帅按住虎嘴，犹豫片刻：“我想提醒一下雷米尔。”

他和雷米尔关系普通，可好歹也在同一个侍卫营待过。

内蒂如果真的杀死了五公主，那她肯定无法逃脱罪责，但整件事也确实就是五公主自己作出来的，如果把事情告诉雷米尔，说不定雷米尔能有办法跟虎王求情，免了内蒂的死刑。

“你同情他？”小老虎歪头问。

不帅：“让别人来看这场情杀案，雷米尔就是那个因。如果他真的爱内蒂，内蒂被处死，他会一生都活在内疚和痛苦中吧。”

小老虎发出嗤笑：“算了吧，那个雷米尔可不是什么情圣，我在那个多丽丝王妃那里看到过他两次，两人可是真上了床的。”

不帅拉被蒙头：“……当我什么都没说。”

小老虎被不帅萌坏了，钻进被子里和不帅闹做一团。

“你是不是更同情那个侍女内蒂？”小老虎咬他耳朵。

不帅翻身按住他：“睡觉！”
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan was unwilling: "It didn't change last time either. You can just sleep on top of me."

Bu Shuai gave him a kick: "Either you sleep on the floor, or you turn into a little tiger. Take your pick."

Without a second word, Shang Feifan reached out and tore off his clothes. His garments fell to the ground, and a little tiger scrambled out from within, leaping high into Bu Shuai's arms.

Bu Shuai caught the little tiger, feeling its heavy, solid weight, and his heart instantly settled.

"You took so long to come back. Where have you been gallivanting?" He pinched the little tiger's ears.

"I went to watch a show. Do you know? The Fifth Princess is dead. Do you know who killed her? It was a close confidante and maid of the Queen's, a female beastman named Netty Schmill. Do you know why that maid killed the Fifth Princess? Because the Fifth Princess set her sights on the maid's lover."

Bu Shuai was amused by this sequence of self-asked and self-answered questions, but he quickly wiped the smile from his face: "The Fifth Princess is dead?"

He didn't like the Fifth Princess, but... the original owner and the Fifth Princess were blood-related biological siblings.

Because of this, even though the Fifth Princess and the Third Prince often gave him a hard time, he exercised forbearance whenever he could.

Now, hearing that the Fifth Princess had died at such a young age, Bu Shuai couldn't exactly say he felt sad, but he couldn't feel happy either.

Shang Feifan pieced together the clues he had investigated and what he had heard from Netty, speculating: "I think things probably went like this... The maid Netty had a guard lover named Remil, and the Fifth Princess took a fancy to this Remil. I've seen this Remil beside the Tiger King; he really does look all right, and his external conditions are considered quite good."

Something flashed through Shang Feifan's mind, but he failed to catch it.

"Remil?" Bu Shuai was startled.

"If I heard correctly." The little tiger patted its paws. "Anyway, the Fifth Princess discovered the intimate relationship between the Tiger King's guard Remil and the Queen's maid Netty. Considering the relationship between the Queen and the Tiger King, if the Queen found out that her trusted maid Netty had hooked up with a guard by the Tiger King's side, one could easily imagine Netty's fate. Even if she didn't die, she would be cast aside and loathed by the Queen."

"Netty was thus threatened by the Fifth Princess and had no choice but to release her from her confinement. Whether out of boredom or sheer malice to disgust people, the Fifth Princess's very first demand upon being released was to see Remil, and she insisted that Netty go set up a meeting with her own lover."

"Netty chose a very secluded little garden as the location. But instead of letting her lover go meet the Fifth Princess, she went herself."

"Netty pleaded with the Fifth Princess to let them go, begging her not to snitch to the Queen, but the Fifth Princess refused and even mocked Netty."

"In the end, driven by anger, Netty killed the Fifth Princess."

Bu Shuai said in disbelief: "Just like that?"

The little tiger spread its paws. "Really, just like that. Unless Netty's mental power is stronger than mine and she could rapidly fabricate a logically sound story while in a hypnotic state."

Bu Shuai let out a slow breath.

This Fifth Princess died in a way that was... well, you couldn't even call it a grievance; it was purely her own courting of death.

For no good reason, she just *had* to go snatch someone else's lover.

Based on Bu Shuai's understanding of this princess, he even suspected that the Fifth Princess might not have liked Remil all that much. It was more likely out of anger and displeasure at being grounded, which made her want to torment others.

And Netty, the close confidante and maid of the Queen responsible for conveying orders, became the prime target for her revenge.

Bu Shuai guessed that the Fifth Princess had somehow caught wind of the illicit underground romance between Netty and Remil, using it as leverage and treating the seizure of Netty's lover as a dual game and punishment that would cause Netty agony while bringing herself joy.

The Fifth Princess probably never imagined until the day she died that she would dig her own grave over a "petty" little prank.

Of course, these were all deductions and guesses made by him and Shang Feifan. As for what the actual facts were, they would still have to wait for the investigation results from the royal palace.

"Will Netty be exposed?"

"That guard captain, Clement, is a formidable guy." Shang Feifan rarely praised others, but this compliment was spoken with genuine sincerity. He had once passed close to Clement and had almost been caught by the man.

Clement should have already discovered that someone had sneaked into the royal palace invisibly, yet he kept his composure, not even informing the Tiger King, and had quietly been making defensive deployments all on his own.

The corners of Bu Shuai's mouth curved up. "He really is formidable."

The little tiger was unhappy; the little tiger was jealous, and it rolled over to bite Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai held down the tiger's snout, hesitating for a moment: "I want to give Remil a warning."

His relationship with Remil was ordinary, but at least they had served in the same guard battalion.

If Netty truly killed the Fifth Princess, she naturally wouldn't be able to escape punishment, but the whole affair was indeed brought upon the Fifth Princess by her own hand. If they told Remil, perhaps Remil could find a way to plead with the Tiger King to spare Netty from the death penalty.

"Do you pity him?" The little tiger tilted its head and asked.

Bu Shuai: "If anyone else were to look at this crime of passion, Remil is the root cause. If he truly loves Netty, and Netty is executed, he will live in guilt and agony for the rest of his life."

The little tiger let out a snort of derision: "Forget it, that Remil is no romantic saint. I've seen him twice with that Concubine Doris, and the two of them have definitely slept together."

Bu Shuai pulled the quilt over his head: "...Consider what I said unsaid."

The little tiger was completely charmed by Bu Shuai's cuteness, burrowing under the covers and tumbling into a playful mess with him.

"Do you pity that maid Netty even more?" The little tiger bit his ear.

Bu Shuai rolled over and pinned him down: "Go to sleep!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第148章 商非凡的疑惑 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第148章 商非凡的疑惑

克莱门特查到了当天侍候五公主的侍女。

正要找这名侍女问话，却发现她失踪了。

认识该侍女的人都说这两天没有看到她，以为她到了轮休日，出宫休息去了。

克莱门特一查该侍女的轮休日，发现确实是这两日，就让人出宫去这名侍女家里寻找。

但侍卫们赶到这名侍女家里，却听闻其家人说并没有看到她回来。

瞬间，所有疑点都集中到该侍女身上。

有人怀疑她畏罪潜逃。

但就在克莱门特查询这名侍女的人物关系图以及让人审问她的家人，看她家人有没有说谎时，负责守卫西侧门的侍卫们有了新的发现。

西侧门是专供王宫工作人员和仆佣等进出的门，利用率很高。

克莱门特接到消息，立刻赶到王宫西侧门，随后就发现他们正在找寻的那名侍女已经死在馊水桶里。

这个馊水桶即将被运送出王宫，但这两天因为五公主出事，王宫在防守方面加大了力度，对进出王宫的一切人和物，都会进行最严厉的检查。

平常王宫侍卫对于馊水桶的检查，就是打开看一眼，再用专用的尖锐长矛捅一捅。

哦，他们还会确定馊水桶的深度，这点还是不帅在几年前提醒克莱门特，克莱门特让侍卫们特地加上了这一层检查手段。

就在今天，有侍卫检查馊水桶时，发现长矛潮湿的高度和桶深对不上，如果是平时，侍卫们可能就含糊过去，不会仔细检查。

但今天，他们当即就让运送馊水桶的兽人卸下所有馊水桶，把馊水桶里的残渣倒进空桶里，对馊水桶挨个进行检查。

最后在他们最先发现不对的馊水桶下层发现了一个隔层，打开隔开，就看到里面蜷缩着一个瘦小的兽人。

而这名瘦小兽人就是克莱门特正在找的侍女。

为了把这名侍女塞进馊水桶下面的隔层，她的四肢和腰椎都被折断。

经过检查，确定这些断裂伤都是在死后造成，该侍女的真正死因是筋骨骨折。

另外药剂师还查出她体内有迷-药残留，且这种迷-药和迷昏看守五公主的宫廷嬷嬷与侍女的迷-药相同。

克莱门特根据手头掌握的线索，对虎王和王后进行了第一次汇报。

被塞在馊水桶里的侍女叫兔铃，她也是疑似放出五公主的主要嫌疑人。

根据其他人对她的印象，兔铃胆子很小，做事认真，和其他侍女关系都处得还可以。

而她之所以和其他侍女关系处得好，就因为其他侍女往往会把自己不喜欢不想做的事推给她。

兔铃性子软不善拒绝，一般都会接下。

而监管和照顾五公主显然是一个苦差事，大家都不喜欢接手这份工作，排班时经常就让兔铃负责贴身照顾五公主。

五公主因为心中有怨，有气没处发，就把火气都发在了兔铃身上。

兔铃经常被五公主责骂乃至责打。

在五公主被放出的那一天，负责在宫殿外看守她的宫廷嬷嬷和两名侍女都昏睡了过去。

等她们醒来，就发现公主已经不在宫殿中。

她们害怕责罚，先暗中寻找了公主一段时间，直到怎么都找不到，她们才把公主跑出宫殿的事报上去。

“所以你怀疑侍女兔铃受到五公主威胁，给其他人下药，帮助五公主逃脱。之后又因为对五公主心怀怨恨，故意把她骗到那处偏僻花园，进而对她下了杀手？”虎王问。

克莱门特的回答很谨慎：“从目前的证据来看，似乎是如此。但是……”

“说。”

“有两个最明显疑点。”克莱门特竖起手指：“第一，如果兔铃就是凶手，那么杀她的人会是谁？又为什么要杀她？”

王后皱眉：“这明摆着是灭口。也许兔铃敢于对五公主下手，是因为受到他人教唆？甚或对方才是真正凶手，只是利用了兔铃，事后又怕兔铃把他供出来，才杀了兔铃？”

要不是拉斐尔郎沐这几天刚好不在王城，王后绝对第一个怀疑杀死五公主的背后教唆犯就是他。

王后始终认为拉斐尔的宽容和退让都是他的伪装，她认定拉斐尔对王位有奢望，且希望所有王子公主都死光。

就算拉斐尔这几天不在王城，她也忍不住想拉斐尔的不在场证明过于巧合，说不定他就是趁着自己离开王城之际，安排人杀了五公主，就是为了让人不怀疑到他身上。

不过王后并没有把她的怀疑说出口，就像她认定拉斐尔不是好东西一样，她也一直认为虎王偏心这个私生子。

不说她提出这个疑点，势必会再度惹虎王不快。她更担心虎王为了保护他这个私生子，会暗中帮助他把所有痕迹扫干净。

所以王后憋住了没说，就等克莱门特是否能查出更多线索。

王后也很信任克莱门特的能力，虽然这位子爵是虎王的铁板心腹。

克莱门特点头：“兔铃有帮手是肯定的事。或者说兔铃其实只是谋害公主案件中一环。这也是我要说的第二个疑点，兔铃不但胆子很小，她的手指也无法异变成那么长且锋利的爪刃，如果说她身上带了武器，为什么武器没有和她一起。既然要处理兔铃的尸体，把凶器一起放在她身上，不是更容易让我们认为兔铃是凶手？”

虎王听明白了：“你认为杀死五公主的凶器不是外物，而是就长在凶手身上。所以ta才没办法取下来栽赃给兔铃。而这也是ta直接杀了兔铃灭口，而不是让兔铃活着栽赃兔铃，让兔铃百口莫辩的原因？”

克莱门特再次点头：“凶手的时间很紧急，五公主的尸体被发现后，整个王宫都进入了紧急戒备状态，ta做不了太多事情，也无法做出完美的栽赃计划，只能选择灭口，让我们无法把线索查到真正凶手身上。这点也可以看出，凶手杀死五公主是突发事件，并不是有预谋的事情。”

虎王挑眉：“你认为这是一件好事。”

克莱门特承认：“是。激-情杀人比预谋杀人要更容易留下线索，包括ta把兔铃灭口，都表示ta慌张了，想要紧急擦除所有痕迹，却不知道这样做，会留下更多痕迹。”

虎王感觉克莱门特似乎胸有成竹，就像是已经知道了真正凶手是谁。

克莱门特又道：“另外，兔铃的本体到底只是一只普通兔子，她的优点在于跑得快、身体轻巧、弹性也不错，可能踢腿的力道也很强。但我不觉得她会是虎兽人的五公主的对手，她更无法对五公主做到一击必杀，就算五公主对她不提防。”

克莱门特觉得他透露的线索已经足够多。

“激-情杀人……这点先放一边。认识王后身边的侍女兔铃，能自由进出王宫并对王宫地形熟悉无比，又能在短时间内改造馊水桶把兔铃尸体塞入馊水桶中还不让别人发现，同时具有杀死五公主的实力，还是五公主认识的人，又有那样的爪子……”

“王后身边符合这些特征的人不多，也就那么几个，而其中嫌疑最大的就是……”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 148: Shang Feifan's Doubts (Part 1)

Clement had tracked down the maid who had attended to the Fifth Princess that day.

Just as he was about to call her in for questioning, he discovered she had gone missing.

Those who knew the maid said they hadn't seen her for the past two days, assuming she was on her days off and had left the palace to rest.

Upon checking the maid's scheduled days off, Clement found that it indeed fell on these past two days, so he sent guards out of the palace to search her home.

However, when the guards rushed to the maid's home, they were told by her family members that they hadn't seen her return at all.

In an instant, all suspicions converged on the maid.

Some suspected she had fled in fear of her crime.

However, just as Clement was checking the maid's interpersonal relationship chart and having her family interrogated to see if they were lying, the guards guarding the west side gate made a new discovery.

The west side gate was exclusively for palace staff and servants to enter and exit, and it had a very high utilization rate.

Upon receiving the news, Clement rushed to the west side gate of the royal palace, only to discover that the maid they were searching for was already dead inside a slop barrel.

This slop barrel was about to be transported out of the palace, but over the past two days, due to the incident with the Fifth Princess, the palace had stepped up its defense efforts, carrying out the strictest inspections on all people and objects entering and exiting.

Usually, the palace guards' inspection of slop barrels consisted of a glance inside, followed by a poke with a dedicated sharp spear.

Oh, they would also verify the depth of the slop barrel—a checkpoint method that Bu Shuai had reminded Clement of a few years ago, prompting Clement to instruct the guards to specifically add this layer of inspection.

Today, while inspecting a slop barrel, a guard noticed that the wet height of the spear did not match the depth of the barrel. Under normal circumstances, the guards might have brushed it off and skipped a detailed check.

Today, however, they immediately ordered the beastman transporting the slop barrels to unload every single one, dump the residue from the barrels into empty containers, and inspect the slop barrels one by one.

Finally, at the bottom layer of the slop barrel where they had first sensed something amiss, they discovered a false bottom. Prying it open, they found a small, thin beastman curled up inside.

And this petite beastman was none other than the maid Clement had been searching for.

To cram this maid into the false bottom beneath the slop barrel, her limbs and lumbar spine had all been snapped.

Upon examination, it was confirmed that these fracture injuries were inflicted post-mortem, and the maid's true cause of death was bone trauma.

Additionally, the apothecary discovered residues of a stupefying drug in her body—the exact same drug used to knock out the court mamasan and maids guarding the Fifth Princess.

Based on the clues at hand, Clement made his first report to the Tiger King and the Queen.

The maid stuffed into the slop barrel was named Tu Ling, and she was also the primary suspect suspected of releasing the Fifth Princess.

According to others' impressions of her, Tu Ling was very timid, conscientious in her work, and got along relatively well with the other maids.

The reason she got along well with the other maids was precisely because the others often pushed tasks they disliked or didn't want to do onto her.

Tu Ling had a soft personality, was poor at refusing, and generally accepted these chores.

And monitoring and caring for the Fifth Princess was clearly a miserable assignment; no one liked taking on the job, so when scheduling shifts, Tu Ling was frequently assigned to personally tend to the Fifth Princess.

Harboring grievances and having nowhere to vent her anger, the Fifth Princess had taken all her frustrations out on Tu Ling.

Tu Ling was frequently scolded and even beaten by the Fifth Princess.

On the day the Fifth Princess was released, the court mamasan and two maids stationed outside the palace hall to keep watch had all fallen into a deep sleep.

When they woke up, they discovered the princess was no longer in the hall.

Fearing punishment, they had first searched for the princess in secret for a while until, finding her nowhere, they finally reported that the princess had run out of the palace.

"So you suspect that the maid Tu Ling was threatened by the Fifth Princess, drugged the others, and helped the princess escape? And then, harboring resentment toward the Fifth Princess, she deliberately lured her to that secluded garden and subsequently murdered her?" the Tiger King asked.

Clement's reply was extremely cautious: "Judging from the current evidence, it would seem so. But..."

"Speak."

"There are two most obvious suspicions." Clement held up his fingers: "First, if Tu Ling was indeed the killer, then who was the person that killed her? And why kill her?"

The Queen frowned: "This is obviously a silencing. Could it be that Tu Ling dared to move against the Fifth Princess because she was instigated by someone else? Or perhaps the other party was the true culprit all along, merely using Tu Ling, and afterward feared Tu Ling would betray them, which is why they killed her?"

If Raphael Langmu hadn't been away from the royal city these past few days, the Queen would have absolute certainty in suspecting him as the mastermind behind the Fifth Princess's murder.

The Queen had always believed that Raphael's tolerance and concessions were mere facades; she was convinced that Raphael harbored ambitions for the throne and wished for all princes and princesses to perish.

Even though Raphael wasn't in the royal city these days, she couldn't help but think his alibi was far too coincidental. Perhaps he had taken advantage of her absence from the capital to arrange for someone to kill the Fifth Princess, specifically to avoid any suspicion falling on him.

However, the Queen didn't voice her suspicions aloud. Just as she was convinced Raphael was no good, she had always believed the Tiger King favored this illegitimate son.

Not to mention that bringing up this suspicion would inevitably displease the Tiger King once more; she was even more worried that the Tiger King, in order to protect his illegitimate son, would secretly help him sweep away all traces of evidence.

Therefore, the Queen choked it back and kept quiet, waiting to see if Clement could unearth more clues.

She also trusted Clement's ability, even though this viscount was a die-hard confidant of the Tiger King.

Clement nodded: "It is certain that Tu Ling had an accomplice. Or rather, Tu Ling was merely a single link in the plot to murder the princess. This leads to the second suspicion I wanted to mention: not only was Tu Ling extremely timid, but her fingers were also incapable of mutating into claws that long and sharp. If she had carried a weapon with her, why wasn't the weapon found with her? Since they had to dispose of Tu Ling's corpse, wouldn't leaving the murder weapon on her make it much easier for us to conclude that Tu Ling was the killer?"

The Tiger King understood: "You believe the murder weapon used to kill the Fifth Princess was not an external object, but something that grew directly on the killer's body? And that's why they couldn't take it off to frame Tu Ling? And that's also why they chose to directly silence Tu Ling by killing her, rather than leaving her alive to frame her and rendering her unable to clear her name?"

Clement nodded once more: "The killer was pressed for time. Once the Fifth Princess's body was discovered, the entire palace went into a state of emergency lockdown; they couldn't do too much, nor could they concoct a flawless framing plot. They had no choice but to resort to silencing her, preventing us from tracing the clues back to the true culprit. This also shows that the killer's act of murdering the Fifth Princess was a sudden, spontaneous event, not a premeditated one."

The Tiger King raised an eyebrow: "You consider this a good thing."

Clement acknowledged it: "Yes. A crime of passion is much easier to leave clues behind than a premeditated crime, including the fact that they silenced Tu Ling—it all shows that the killer panicked and wanted to hurriedly erase all traces, completely unaware that doing so would leave behind even more evidence."

The Tiger King felt that Clement seemed utterly confident, as if he already knew who the true culprit was.

Clement continued: "Furthermore, Tu Ling's true form is ultimately just an ordinary rabbit. Her strengths lie in running fast, being light on her feet, and having good elasticity; perhaps her kicking force is also quite strong. But I do not believe she would be a match for a tiger-beastman Fifth Princess, nor could she deliver a fatal blow to the Fifth Princess in a single strike, even if the Fifth Princess had her guard down."

Clement felt he had already revealed enough clues.

"A crime of passion... Let's put that aside for a moment. Someone who knows the Queen's maid Tu Ling, can freely enter and exit the royal palace while being thoroughly familiar with its layout, can modify a slop barrel and stuff Tu Ling's corpse into it within a short time without anyone noticing, possesses the strength to kill the Fifth Princess, is someone the Fifth Princess recognizes, and has claws like that..."

"There aren't many people around the Queen who fit these traits—just a select few. And among them, the one with the greatest suspicion is..."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第148章 商非凡的疑惑 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
克莱门特转看向王后……身后的侍女。

“内蒂舒密尔，你是自己交代，还是让我们先看看你的爪子？抑或我们先去厨房找你的叔叔，审问他，他有没有为你准备一个放了隔板的馊水桶？”

王后大惊失色，转头就看向身后的心腹侍女。

“不可能！”王后脱口而出。

内蒂也飞快扑到王后身边跪下，口喊冤枉。

王后不相信她那么信任的内蒂会是杀害她女儿的人，也不认为她有这个胆子。

“你说的那些凶手特征，有可能是内蒂，但也有可能是别人。而且你为什么认定凶手就一定是我身边的人？”王后不是要袒护自己的侍女，而是她真的不认为凶手会是内蒂。

虎王冷冷看向跪在地上的内蒂，冷静地问克莱门特：“除此之外，你还有什么证据能证明凶手就是内蒂舒密尔吗？”

克莱门特淡定道：“有。”

“我为什么会锁定凶手一定是王后身边的人，为什么不怀疑其他人？”

首先克莱门特看到案发现场的第一直觉就告诉他，杀死五公主的人九成是一名雌性，且对方身高没有超过五公主，这点从五公主伤口的角度就能看出。

比五公主身高更高的人，爪刃划出的角度应该是从上往下，相反则是从下往上。

不是绝对，但还有其他迹象也可以表明杀死五公主的凶手是雌性。

现场没有留下脚印，但有香气。

虽然是室外，香气挥散的速度很快，但好在公主尸体被发现的还算早，距离她死亡也就过了半天不到。

残留香气不多，但克莱门特还是闻到了。

克莱门特的嗅觉很好，排除侍卫和他自己身上的味道，他可以闻出来现场最浓郁的香气有三种，一种是五公主身上的熏香味，一种则是不算廉价的花香香水味道，第三种则是那名炼药师学徒身上的草药味。

兽人用熏香和香水很常见，大多数都是为了遮掩他们身上较为浓郁的体味。

当然，也不是所有兽人体味都重，但在王宫生活和工作的兽人几乎九成以上都会使用芳香剂。

而其中能用得起自然花香香水的人并不多。

实际上，他只在少数几个人身上闻到过这种味道。

而这少数几个人特指两个人。

“王宫中的女兽人很多。但即使用这种香水，又符合我列出的所有疑凶特征的人，就只有一个，也就是王后身边的大侍女内蒂舒密尔。”克莱门特总结。

“你不是说还有一个人吗？”王后找到一个漏洞。

克莱门特张嘴，似乎要说出另一个人的人名。

就在这时，内蒂突然抬起头，大声且焦急地喊：“是我干的！是我杀了五公主，跟别人没有任何关系，都是我一个人干的！”

根据内蒂接下来的交代，案情逐渐清晰。

五公主不愿被禁足，一天到晚就想着怎么逃出去，她发现兔铃性格软弱胆子小，就威胁她，让她帮她出逃。还告诉她要如何做，比如在哪里弄到迷-药，怎么给看守她的人下药等等。

兔铃就因为胆子小，反而不敢承担偷偷放出公主的大罪，就找到侍女们的头头，也就是内蒂，向内蒂求教该怎么办。

内蒂就去找五公主说话，劝她不要这么做。

但五公主不但没听劝，反而被激怒，宣称内蒂如果不帮她，她就跟王后告状，说内蒂偷窃王后的首饰。

内蒂当然没有偷窃王后的首饰，自然不会接受五公主的威胁。

但五公主说她已经联系了她的手下，把王后的首饰放到了内蒂家里，而这个地方只有她知道。

内蒂不相信，五公主就说了内蒂卧室和家里的布置。

内蒂不得不相信，只能帮助五公主逃脱，她帮兔铃弄来了迷-药，指示兔铃给看守公主的人下药。

之后，兔铃也喝下茶水让自己昏迷过去，公主逃出软禁地点。

但公主根本不是想逃离王宫，她逃出王后宫殿只是想要私会情人。

五公主命令内蒂帮助她避开所有宫人，进入那处僻静花园。

在五公主等待秘密情人前来见她的期间，内蒂就以她已完成承诺为由，希望五公主能说出那件栽赃她的首饰放在她家什么地方。

但五公主却洋洋得意地说这是她控制她的把柄，以后她还要内蒂为她做更多事，让内蒂死心，不要指望能找出那件首饰。

内蒂苦苦恳求，但五公主就是不肯说。

“我、卑下当时就是太绝望了，想到要一直被五公主控制，以后说不得还要背叛王后陛下，再被怒火一冲，就就脑子一昏，等到卑下清醒过来时，五公主已经……”内蒂掩面哭泣。

至于会杀死兔铃，则是只有兔铃知道帮助公主逃脱的人还有一个内蒂。

五公主被害一案，到此似乎已经水落石出。

内蒂被带下去，等待她的必然不会是什么好结局。

王后脸色铁青地离开，她的心情糟糕透了。

虎王叫住了克莱门特，书房内只剩下他们两人。

“你是不是还有什么没说？”虎王很了解自己的侍卫统领。

克莱门特也没有否认，淡淡道：“内蒂在说谎。”

“哦？她不是杀死五公主的凶手？”虎王头疼，他刚为这个案子能快速了结而高兴。

“不，杀人的就是她。但她杀死五公主的真正原因一定不是五公主要栽赃她和控制她一生。”

“怎么说？”

克莱门特理智分析：“如果五公主威胁她要栽赃她，内蒂完全可以告诉王后。王后知道五公主的性子，知道这种事五公主完全做得出来。就算能在内蒂家里搜出王后的首饰，就问五公主为什么能知道详细地点？为什么知道却不告诉王后？又是谁告诉五公主，内蒂偷了王后的首饰？”

“漏洞太多了。能在王后身边做大侍女的人会那么轻易被恐吓住吗？”

“还有，内蒂说五公主逃出软禁宫殿，却没有离开王宫，而是跑去僻静花园，只为了见情人。这点也很不符合五公主的性子，以五公主的……娇蛮和受宠，她就算在禁足，也可以堂而皇之地把自己的面首叫进来陪她，而不是她纡尊降贵地跑去私会。除非对方身份比较特别，不方便在王后宫殿相见。”

“所以，综上所述，内蒂杀死五公主的真正原因绝不是她交代的那样。”

虎王深深皱起眉头：“会是有人教唆或迫使内蒂杀死五公主吗？”

“不，证据表明，那就是一场冲动下的激-情杀人。”克莱门特给与否定。

虎王沉默片刻：“你去审问那个侍女，务必要问清楚她杀死五公主的真正原因。”

“是。”克莱门特右拳放于胸口行礼。

虎王看克莱门特没有立刻离开，挑眉看他：“还有什么？”

克莱门特一顿：“其实我已经有点眉目。陛下您有没有奇怪内蒂为什么会突然就招供了？而且几乎是迫不及待一样，恨不得把所有嫌疑都揽到自己身上。”

虎王不笨，“……她在保护另一个你说的使用花香香水的人？”
chunks.englishText:
Clement turned his gaze toward the Queen... and the maid standing behind her.

"Netty Schmill, will you confess on your own, or shall we inspect your claws first? Or should we head straight to the kitchen to interrogate your uncle and see if he prepared a slop barrel with a false partition for you?"

The Queen turned pale with shock and whipped her head around to look at her trusted confidante behind her.

"Impossible!" the Queen blurted out.

Netty also scrambled forward rapidly, dropping to her knees before the Queen while crying out that she had been wronged.

The Queen refused to believe that Netty, whom she trusted so deeply, could be the person who murdered her daughter, nor did she believe the maid had the guts to do it.

"The traits of the killer you described might apply to Netty, but they could just as easily apply to someone else. And why are you so certain the killer *must* be someone from my side?" The Queen wasn't trying to shield her maid; she genuinely didn't believe the killer could be Netty.

The Tiger King gazed coldly down at the kneeling Netty and calmly asked Clement: "Aside from this, what other evidence do you have to prove that the killer is indeed Netty Schmill?"

Clement replied calmly: "I do."

"Why did I lock onto the killer as someone from the Queen's side? Why didn't I suspect others?"

First, his gut instinct upon seeing the crime scene told him that nine times out of ten, the person who killed the Fifth Princess was a female, and her height did not exceed the princess's. This could be deduced from the angle of the wounds on the Fifth Princess.

For someone taller than the princess, the angle of the claw slash should be from top to bottom; conversely, it would be from bottom to top.

It wasn't absolute, but there were other signs indicating that the murderer of the Fifth Princess was a female.

No footprints were left at the scene, but there was a fragrance.

Although it was outdoors and the fragrance dissipated quickly, fortunately, the princess's body was discovered fairly early—less than half a day had passed since her death.

There wasn't much residual scent left, but Clement had still caught it.

Clement possessed an exceptional sense of smell. Excluding his own scent and those of the guards, he could detect three of the most intense fragrances at the scene: one was the scented fumigation unique to the Fifth Princess; the second was a floral perfume of non-cheap quality; and the third was the herbal scent belonging to that apothecary apprentice.

It was common for beastmen to use scented fumigation and perfumes, mostly to mask their own potent body odors.

Of course, not all beastmen had heavy body odors, but easily ninety percent or more of those living and working in the royal palace used aromatic agents.

Among them, however, very few could afford natural floral perfume.

In reality, he had only ever smelled this particular scent on a select few individuals.

And those few specifically referred to two people.

"There are many female beastmen in the royal palace. But among those who use this perfume and fit all the suspect criteria I listed, there is only one—and that is the Queen's head maid, Netty Schmill," Clement concluded.

"Didn't you say there was another person?" The Queen seized upon a loophole.

Clement opened his mouth, seeming about to utter the name of that other person.

Right at that moment, Netty suddenly raised her head, crying out loudly and anxiously: "I did it! I killed the Fifth Princess! It has nothing to do with anyone else, I did it all by myself!"

Based on Netty's subsequent confession, the case gradually became clear.

Unwilling to remain grounded, the Fifth Princess spent day and night plotting how to escape. Finding Tu Ling to be timid and weak-willed, she threatened the maid, forcing her to assist in her escape. She even instructed her on how to go about it—such as where to acquire the sleeping drug and how to drug those keeping watch.

Out of sheer cowardice, Tu Ling hadn't dared to shoulder the heavy crime of secretly releasing the princess on her own, so she sought out the head of the maids, Netty, to ask for advice on what to do.

Netty had gone to speak with the Fifth Princess, urging her not to do such things.

Instead of listening, the Fifth Princess was enraged, declaring that if Netty refused to help, she would report to the Queen that Netty had stolen the Queen's jewelry.

Of course Netty had never stolen the Queen's jewelry, so she naturally wouldn't submit to the Fifth Princess's threats.

However, the Fifth Princess claimed she had already contacted her subordinates and planted the Queen's jewelry inside Netty's home, in a hiding spot only she knew of.

Netty didn't believe it, whereupon the Fifth Princess rattled off the exact layout of Netty's bedroom and home.

Left with no choice, Netty had to believe her and ended up aiding the Fifth Princess's escape. She procured the sleeping drug for Tu Ling and instructed her to drug the guards watching the princess.

Afterward, Tu Ling even drank some of the tea to knock herself out, allowing the princess to slip away from her place of confinement.

Yet the princess had no intention of fleeing the royal palace; escaping her mother's palace was merely a pretext to meet her secret lover.

The Fifth Princess ordered Netty to help her evade all palace attendants and enter that secluded garden.

While the princess waited for her secret lover to arrive, Netty, operating under the belief that she had fulfilled her end of the bargain, hoped the Fifth Princess would reveal where the framed jewelry was hidden in her house.

Instead, the Fifth Princess gloated, saying that this was her leverage to control her, and that she would demand even more from Netty in the future, telling her to abandon all hope of ever finding out where the jewelry was.

Netty begged bitterly, but the Fifth Princess stubbornly refused to say.

"I... your humble servant was simply too desperate at the time. Thinking about being controlled by the Fifth Princess forever, and likely having to betray Her Majesty the Queen in the future... swept away by a wave of boiling rage, my mind went blank. By the time I regained my senses, the Fifth Princess was already..." Netty covered her face and wept.

As for why she killed Tu Ling—it was because Tu Ling was the only other person who knew Netty had helped the princess escape.

With this, the case of the Fifth Princess's murder seemed to have come to a complete resolution.

Netty was dragged away, and what awaited her was certainly not going to be a happy ending.

The Queen left with an ashen face; her mood was foul to the extreme.

The Tiger King called out to Clement, leaving only the two of them inside the study.

"Is there something you haven't told me?" The Tiger King knew his guard captain very well.

Clement didn't deny it either, saying flatly: "Netty is lying."

"Oh? She isn't the killer who murdered the Fifth Princess?" The Tiger King felt a headache coming on; he had just been rejoicing that the case was wrapped up so quickly.

"No, she is indeed the one who committed the murder. But the real reason she killed the Fifth Princess is definitely not what she confessed—that the princess was trying to frame and control her for life."

"How so?"

Clement analyzed it rationally: "If the Fifth Princess threatened her with a frame-up, Netty could have completely told the Queen. The Queen knows the Fifth Princess's temperament; she knows the princess is fully capable of pulling off such a stunt. Even if the Queen's jewelry were found in Netty's home, one could simply ask the Fifth Princess how she knew the exact location? Why knew it without telling the Queen? And who told the Fifth Princess that Netty had stolen the Queen's jewelry in the first place?"

"There are far too many loopholes. Would someone capable of becoming the head maid by the Queen's side be frightened into submission so easily?"

"Furthermore, Netty claimed that after escaping her confinement, the Fifth Princess didn't leave the royal palace but instead ran off to a secluded garden just to meet a lover. This behavior starkly contradicts the Fifth Princess's character. Given her... pampered and spoiled nature, even while grounded, she could easily summon her retainers right into her quarters to keep her company, rather than lowering herself to sneak around for a private rendezvous. Unless the other party's identity was exceptionally special and inconvenient to meet within the Queen's palace."

"Therefore, summarizing all of the above, the true reason Netty killed the Fifth Princess is by no means what she confessed."

The Tiger King furrowed his brow deeply: "Could someone have instigated or forced Netty into killing the Fifth Princess?"

"No, the evidence indicates that it was a crime of passion born of a sudden impulse," Clement dismissed the notion.

The Tiger King fell silent for a moment: "Go interrogate that maid; you must get to the bottom of her true motive for killing the Fifth Princess."

"Yes." Clement placed his right fist over his chest in a salute.

Seeing that Clement didn't leave immediately, the Tiger King raised an eyebrow at him: "Anything else?"

Clement paused: "Actually, I already have a rough idea. Your Majesty, haven't you found it strange why Netty confessed so abruptly? Moreover, she was practically impatient, eager to take every single bit of suspicion upon herself."

The Tiger King wasn't stupid: "...She's protecting the other person you mentioned—the one who uses floral perfume?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第148章 商非凡的疑惑 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
克莱门特点头：“是否使用不知道，但对方身上确实偶尔会带有那种香味。如果不是他自己使用这种女兽人常用香水，那就是和使用这种香水的女兽人有过非常亲密且长时间的接触。”

“你说的到底是谁？”克莱门特有点拖拉的陈述方式让虎王心感不妙。

克莱门特看向虎王。

虎王一愣，随即脸色下沉：“我身边的人？且是我重视和信任的人？是王子还是公主？”

商非凡在跟踪雷米尔。

不帅回到王城没两天就又忙碌起来，虎王不知为何给他派了一堆工作，让他负责和鬼火商会的人对接，调查这次参加春季材料展销会的所有货商，看他们中间有没有邪神信徒或者和邪神信徒有关。

总之就是防止邪神信徒在展销会中搞事。

查找邪神信徒的踪迹，这本来就是特调局的工作内容之一，不帅也不好推拒。

虽然他很想离开王城——自从解决了丹顿侯爵，丹顿一家也被软禁，王后似乎也不再找他和莫约镇那边的麻烦，不帅就觉得到了离开的时候。

但自从他把图书馆借阅卡上交，又暴露出他是有缘车的有缘人，虎王好像就有点不想放他离开王城的意思。

偏偏那个天残谷主也跑到了王城，而商非凡也似在谋划着什么，不帅就打算先看看天残谷主想做什么，这可是一个魔法师，还控制着大量地球玩家，谁知道他会做出什么事情。

至于商非凡那边……他相信他，相信他不管再怎么谋划，也不会伤害到他、伤害到这个世界。

不帅也不讨厌特调局的工作，他甚至有点喜欢这份工作。否则也不会在离开王城后，还在注意邪神信徒的活动。

但让他感到有点尴尬的是，他这次的工作将和城卫军一起合作，而城卫军那边派来“助他一臂之力”的则是他曾经的同僚雷米尔。

和城卫军合作没什么，但和雷米尔成天同进同出？

饶了他吧！

他和雷米尔不至于气场互相排斥，但也绝对称不上相合。

他对雷米尔没什么反感的地方，但架不住每次雷米尔见到他，都会用一种也许他自己都不知道的奇诡眼神看他。

无奈，城卫军那边表示，人选是虎王亲自指定的，他们也没办法调换。

不帅只得和这个昔日同僚开始了尬里尬气的合作。

商非凡原本没怎么留意这个虎王近身侍卫雷米尔，但虎王突然把这家伙派到不帅身边，对方还一副他才是主导两人调查工作的领导者架势，让他看这个雷米尔就特别不爽。

知己知彼百战不贻。

商非凡当即就对雷米尔展开了细致又周密的调查。

隐身跟踪、收买乞丐混混、询问天眼系统……只要能用得着的手段，商非凡都用在了雷米尔身上。

而这么细致的一调查，商非凡就发现了一件曾经让他忽略过去，现在怎么看怎么有意思的事情。

雷米尔和旖梦楼妈妈桑伊娃互相认识。

他和旖梦楼的台柱子多丽丝王妃也有着远超一般男女友谊的负距离关系。

后者属于风流事，商非凡不是雷米尔的爹妈，自然管不着。

但雷米尔和妈妈桑伊娃认识这件事，就很让商非凡在意了。

伊娃皮下可是安妮塔夫人，他家不帅名义上的母亲。

好在雷米尔和伊娃的关系不是那种关系，否则商非凡……大概率会把雷米尔的第五条腿打断。

让商非凡感到有意思的不是雷米尔认识伊娃并且和对方关系良好这点，而是……

商非凡低头欣赏手中画像。

这可是王城一位出名画师的作品，这幅画绘于十年前，画中人是当时王城最有名的美人。

安妮塔夫人！

当年安妮塔“被”暴露出她是虎王情人的身份后，王城无数人都对她的外貌和身世好奇。

虽然虎王把安妮塔保护得很好，但安妮塔又不是大门不出二门不迈的羞涩小姑娘，相反她在结识虎王前参加了不少贵族富豪的宴会，成为虎王的情人后，也曾在不少重要场合露面。

这位画师就画了安妮塔不少画像，其中最有名的就是这幅春倦图。

画中安妮塔夫人侧坐在花架下，头微微靠在立柱上，眼睛微闭，侧脸角度也是最能呈现她清丽容颜之美的四十五度角。

月光撒下，美人如画。

商非凡用阿瑞斯商的身份，豪撒五十金买下了这幅画。

这还亏得画师还在世，否则这幅画的价格会更高。

商非凡的手指掠过画中人的眉骨，以及位于眉梢的一点小痣。

小痣藏在眉毛下，不仔细看几乎看不出来。

而让他感到有意思的一点就在这里！

雷米尔的眉梢也有这么一点小痣，同样藏在眉毛下。

一个是雄性，一个是雌性，虽然他们眉毛的走向几乎一致，但不进行仔细对比，加上雌性会修眉，完全看不出两者有相像之处。

雷米尔的整体容貌并不像安妮塔夫人。

但如果把两人的画像放到一起仔细对比，就会发现两人的眉骨以及唇形几乎一模一样。

安妮塔夫人的嘴唇有唇珠，雷米尔也有。

但安妮塔会涂抹唇彩，会让嘴唇看起来饱满又光亮，充满诱人色泽。

经过修饰的眉毛和涂抹唇彩的嘴唇，完全遮掩了两人的相像之处。

这也是他明明看过安妮塔夫人的“尸体”，却没有注意到雷米尔和她的容貌有相似之处的原因。

直到他开始调查雷米尔，并仔细观察对方的长相、身材、举止习惯等。

他终于抓到了那一点点让他差点没抓住的感觉。

比起安妮塔夫人，雷米尔的长相更像虎王。

但这点并没有引起任何人怀疑，因为雷米尔也算是王族血脉，甚至还没有出五服。

他和他外公郎侦也有一点像，但很多人都说他更像他母亲郎飞。

据说郎飞是很英气的长相，和虎王站在一起就像是亲兄妹。

商非凡看看左边的雷米尔画像，再瞅瞅右边的安妮塔夫人画像，突然弹身跳起。

他坐不住了，他要去找郎飞和她丈夫泽沐尔卡内的画像。

看看雷米尔和他母亲郎飞以及和他父亲泽沐尔有多少相似之处。

他的直觉在跟他吼叫——雷米尔和安妮塔夫人一定有血缘关系！

但按照雷米尔的身世，雷米尔和安妮塔夫人应该一点关系也没有才对。

商非凡是个怀疑派，想要让他打消怀疑，就得让他看到更多证据。

为此，商非凡甚至放弃今天要利用阿瑞斯商身份勾搭天残谷主的计划，打算跑一趟郎侦老伯爵的府邸。

之前看到伊娃和雷米尔来往密切，他还以为伊娃也就是安妮塔夫人想要利用这个虎王近卫收集消息或做其他事情。

但现在他开始怀疑两人的真正关系。

还有雷米尔名义上的亲生父母的名字，郎飞和泽沐尔……郎沐？

没有怀疑雷米尔身世以前，他以为虎王是出于对已经牺牲的前侍卫统领夫妇的感激，是出于纪念意义，才巧合地给不帅取了这么一个吻合了他原本名字的名字。
chunks.englishText:
>
Clement nodded. "Whether he uses it himself is unknown, but he does occasionally carry that scent. If he doesn't use this female beastman perfume himself, then he must have had very close and prolonged contact with a female beastman who does."

"Who on earth are you talking about?" Clement's somewhat dragging way of speaking gave the Tiger King an uneasy feeling.

Clement looked at the Tiger King.

The Tiger King was stunned, and then his face darkened. "Someone close to me? And someone I value and trust? A prince or a princess?"

***

Shang Feifan was tracking Lemuel.

Not two days after Bu Shuai returned to the royal city, he became busy once more. For some reason, the Tiger King had assigned him a mountain of work, making him responsible for coordinating with the people of the Will-o'-the-Wisp Chamber of Commerce to investigate all the merchants participating in the spring materials exhibition, checking to see if there were any evil god cultists among them or anyone connected to them.

In short, it was to prevent evil god cultists from causing trouble at the exhibition.

Tracking down the traces of evil god cultists was originally part of the Special Investigation Bureau's duties, so Bu Shuai could not easily refuse.

Although he really wanted to leave the royal city—ever since Marquis Denton was dealt with and the Denton family was placed under house arrest, and the Queen seemed to have stopped causing trouble for him and Moyue Town, Bu Shuai felt it was time to leave.

But ever since he handed in his library card and revealed that he was the fated person of the Fated Car, the Tiger King seemed somewhat unwilling to let him leave the royal city.

Coincidentally, the Valley Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley had also run to the royal city, and Shang Feifan also seemed to be plotting something. Bu Shuai decided to first see what the Valley Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley wanted to do. This was a mage who also controlled a large number of Earth players; who knew what kind of trouble he might stir up.

As for Shang Feifan... he trusted him. He believed that no matter what Shang Feifan was plotting, he would never hurt him or this world.

Bu Shuai did not dislike the Special Investigation Bureau's work; he even liked it a bit. Otherwise, he would not have kept paying attention to the activities of the evil god cultists even after leaving the royal city.

But what made him feel a bit awkward was that his work this time would be in cooperation with the City Guard, and the person the City Guard sent to "lend him a hand" was his former colleague, Lemuel.

Cooperating with the City Guard was fine, but going in and out with Lemuel all day long?

Spare him!

He and Lemuel did not exactly have clashing auras, but they certainly were not compatible either.

He had no real dislike for Lemuel, but every time Lemuel saw him, he would look at him with a bizarre look that perhaps Lemuel himself was not even aware of.

Helplessly, the City Guard stated that the choice of personnel was personally designated by the Tiger King, and they had no way to change it.

Bu Shuai could only begin this awkward cooperation with his former colleague.

Shang Feifan had not paid much attention to Lemuel, the Tiger King's close guard, at first. But the Tiger King suddenly sending this guy to Bu Shuai's side, and the guy acting as if he were the leader guiding their investigation, made him particularly annoyed with Lemuel.

*Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated in a hundred battles.*

Shang Feifan immediately launched a detailed and thorough investigation into Lemuel.

Invisibility tracking, bribing beggars and thugs, querying the Sky Eye system... whatever means could be used, Shang Feifan used them on Lemuel.

And with such a detailed investigation, Shang Feifan discovered something he had previously overlooked, but which now looked incredibly interesting.

Lemuel and Eva, the madam of the Yimeng Brothel, knew each other.

He also had a "negative-distance" relationship with Princess Doris, the star of the Yimeng Brothel, which far exceeded normal male-female friendship.

The latter was just a romantic affair; Shang Feifan was not Lemuel's parent, so he naturally could not care less.

But the fact that Lemuel and Madam Eva knew each other made Shang Feifan very concerned.

Under Eva's skin was Lady Anita, his Bu Shuai's nominal mother.

Fortunately, the relationship between Lemuel and Eva was not *that* kind of relationship, otherwise Shang Feifan... would highly likely break Lemuel's fifth leg.

What Shang Feifan found interesting was not just that Lemuel knew Eva and had a good relationship with her, but...

Shang Feifan looked down to admire the portrait in his hand.

This was the work of a famous artist in the royal city, painted ten years ago. The person in the painting was the most famous beauty in the royal city at that time.

Lady Anita!

Back then, after Anita was "exposed" as the Tiger King's mistress, countless people in the royal city were curious about her appearance and background.

Although the Tiger King protected Anita very well, she was not a shy young girl who never stepped out of her boudoir. On the contrary, before meeting the Tiger King, she attended many banquets of nobles and wealthy men, and after becoming the Tiger King's mistress, she also appeared on many important occasions.

This artist had painted many portraits of Anita, the most famous of which was this *Spring Weariness Portrait*.

In the painting, Lady Anita sat sideways under a flower trellis, her head resting slightly against a pillar, her eyes half-closed. Her profile was at a forty-five-degree angle, which best showcased the beauty of her delicate face.

The moonlight fell, making the beauty look like a painting.

Using his identity as the merchant Ares, Shang Feifan spent a whopping fifty gold coins to buy this painting.

This was only because the artist was still alive; otherwise, the price of this painting would have been even higher.

Shang Feifan's finger brushed over the brow bone of the person in the painting, as well as a tiny mole located at the tip of her eyebrow.

The tiny mole was hidden under the eyebrow, almost invisible unless one looked closely.

And this was where he found it interesting!

Lemuel also had such a tiny mole at the tip of his eyebrow, also hidden under his eyebrow.

One was male, one was female. Although the shape of their eyebrows was almost identical, without a careful comparison, and given that females would pluck and shape their eyebrows, it was completely impossible to see any resemblance between the two.

Lemuel's overall appearance did not look like Lady Anita.

But if one placed their portraits side by side and compared them carefully, one would find that their brow bones and lip shapes were almost identical.

Lady Anita's lips had a lip bead, and Lemuel had one too.

But Anita would apply lip gloss, making her lips look full, shiny, and alluring.

The groomed eyebrows and the lip gloss completely concealed the resemblance between the two.

This was also why, even though he had seen Lady Anita's "corpse," he had not noticed any similarity between Lemuel and her.

Until he started investigating Lemuel and carefully observed his appearance, build, behavior, and habits.

He finally caught that tiny trace of a feeling that he had almost missed.

Compared to Lady Anita, Lemuel's appearance looked more like the Tiger King.

But this did not arouse anyone's suspicion, because Lemuel was also considered to have royal blood, not even five generations removed.

He also looked a bit like his maternal grandfather, Lang Zhen. But many people said he looked more like his mother, Lang Fei.

It was said that Lang Fei had a very heroic and spirited appearance, and standing next to the Tiger King, they looked like biological brother and sister.

Shang Feifan looked at Lemuel's portrait on the left, then glanced at Lady Anita's portrait on the right, and suddenly sprang up.

He could not sit still anymore. He wanted to find the portraits of Lang Fei and her husband, Zemur Kane.

He wanted to see how much resemblance Lemuel had to his mother Lang Fei and his father Zemur.

His intuition was screaming at him—Lemuel and Lady Anita definitely had a blood relation!

But according to Lemuel's background, Lemuel and Lady Anita should not have any relationship at all.

Shang Feifan was a skeptic. To dispel his doubts, he had to see more evidence.

For this reason, Shang Feifan even abandoned his plan to use his Ares identity to hook up with the Valley Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley today, intending to make a trip to the estate of the old Earl Lang Zhen.

Seeing Eva and Lemuel in close contact before, he had thought Eva—who was actually Lady Anita—just wanted to use this close guard of the Tiger King to gather information or do other things.

But now, he began to suspect their true relationship.

And the names of Lemuel's nominal biological parents, Lang Fei and Zemur... Lang Mu?

Before doubting Lemuel's heritage, he had thought the Tiger King named Bu Shuai "Lang Mu" out of gratitude to the deceased former guard commander couple, as a commemorative gesture, which coincidentally matched Bu Shuai's original name.
