chunks.chapterTitle: 第149章 拉斐尔的身世 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第149章 拉斐尔的身世

下午，外面阳光明媚。

老伯爵府安静得就像是坟墓，偌大的伯爵府看着已经有些衰败，仆人很少。

老伯爵陪着老妻坐在几乎没有什么植物的花园里晒太阳，跟她低声絮叨着什么。

商非凡站在不远处看向两位老人。

重点看老伯爵夫人的五官。

老伯爵和虎王有血缘关系，多少有点相像处，如果没有属于个人的显著外貌特征，很难断定不帅和他的关系。

但老伯爵夫人就不一样了，不帅和雷米尔，谁是她的直系后代，谁才可能和她有相似之处。

看到老伯爵夫人的第一眼，商非凡就感到了亲切。

这位老夫人有着地球东方人的五官特征，对比西方人，五官就显得不是那么突出，更像是混血儿。就像是不帅。

不帅的五官在兽人中也不算突出，但放到地球东方人种中，又属于五官相当立体的那一挂，有浓郁的少数民族混血儿的感觉。就像是老伯爵夫人。

商非凡觉得不帅超级帅，哪儿哪儿都好看。

但兽人们更喜欢立体感更强更突出的容貌，认为那种相貌才算好看。

商非凡见过虎王，也见过安妮塔夫人的画像，一直很好奇两名五官如此立体的兽人是怎么生出五官类似东方人种的拉斐尔。

他之前猜测不帅可能是隔代遗传，比如虎王或安妮塔夫人的先辈中有五官不是那么立体的人。

毕竟拉斐尔的五官和虎王有相似之处，他的头发颜色和安妮塔夫人则是一模一样，都是灿烂的白金色。

老伯爵夫人的头发不知是年龄缘故，还是原本就是这个色泽，也是白色。

如果让老伯爵夫人、安妮塔、不帅三人坐在一起，商非凡相信绝大多数人都会认为老伯爵夫人和不帅才是一家人，虽然两人的五官看起来并没有相似之处，但他们更像是同一个种族。

而雷米尔和老伯爵夫人则没有任何相似之处，他的头发是金黄色，据说虎身也是一只毛皮金黄的大老虎。他的五官也非常挺-立，属于典型的雄性兽人脸型。

商非凡忍不住想老伯爵不喜欢雷米尔这个外孙，会不会就因为在他身上看不到多少老妻的血脉特征？

不过这个想法在商非凡看到郎飞的画像后就打消了。

郎飞的五官十分立体，和虎王真的很像是亲兄妹。当然，她和老伯爵也长得很像，一看就是亲生的。老伯爵夫人的外在基因似乎并没有怎么影响到郎飞。

这幅画像就挂在大厅里。

那是一幅全家福，老伯爵夫妻俩坐着，一名身穿皮甲英武气十足的高个女兽人站在两人身后。

那时老伯爵夫妻看着一点都不老，他们还处在壮年期，看起来只是比女儿成熟，更像是女儿的兄嫂，而不是父母。

郎飞那时候看起来也特别年轻，也许才二三十岁。

商非凡看到画像上的郎飞的第一眼，人就站在原地不动了。

是的，郎飞的五官很立体，她和不帅的相貌乍一看就是两个人，但如果异常熟悉两人的人，就会发现他们五官有着浓浓的母子感。

就像是西方人的妈妈生了一个东方血统的孩子。

商非凡的大脑在跟他疯狂喊叫：郎飞绝对和不帅有血缘关系，而且还是直系血缘关系！

同时他还注意到郎飞的手指。

郎飞的手指很长，她的左右手无名指长度要超过一般人，几乎和中指一样长。

这是一个非常显著的遗传特征。绘者很好地捕捉到了这个特征。

不帅的手同样如此。

很少人会去留意别人的手，更少有把两个貌似完全没有关系的人的手放到一起比较。更何况其中一人还已经去世多年。

如果商非凡没有对雷米尔的身世产生怀疑，如果不是系统先一步提醒他不帅的身世有问题，他绝不会闲得没事跑来观看郎飞的画像，更不会看得这么仔细。

画像中郎侦伯爵夫妇的手部特征看起来不是很清晰，但能勉强看出老伯爵的手指也很长，只不过手指长度分明，老伯爵夫人的手指也属于正常手型。

商非凡耐心地看向其他画像。

大厅和走廊里挂了不少幅画像，有些一看就是郎侦伯爵家的祖先。

商非凡一幅画一幅画地看下去，最终他停留在一幅身穿王者服饰、头戴王冠的雄性兽人画像前。

对方手持权杖，坐在一张宽大的兽皮椅子上，腰间系着让商非凡眼熟的宽腰带，气势威严。

如果他没有猜错，这位应该就是老伯爵和当代虎王共同的祖先，也就是前前前任虎王。

从这位虎王的服饰和座椅的材料以及周围布置可以看出来，当时虎国应该刚建国不久，这位与其说是一个国王，不如说更像是一个大部落头领。

那时应该还是毒雾纪？

据说因为受到毒雾影响，这位前前前任虎王只在位五十多年就去世了。

之后的前前任虎王把虎国带入新生纪，但也没有享受到新生纪多少福利，同样因为身体积累的毒素过多，两百岁不到的年纪就遗憾离世。

前任虎王在位时间最长，统治虎国将近一百五十年，直到新生纪162年，才由当代虎王继位。

闲话不多说，看到这位虎王的画像，商非凡简直气笑。

怪不得从来没有人怀疑拉斐尔郎沐不是虎王的种，只看这位前前前任虎王的画像，不知道的人还以为他是拉斐尔亲爹。

他家不帅的相貌竟然和这位前前前任虎王有六七成左右的相似度。

如果把不帅的五官拉得更立体一点，再把头发染成金黄色，那相似度几乎能达到八成五！

而且这位前前前任虎王的双手无名指和中指也是几乎一样长。

他现在可以百分百确定，不帅绝对是虎国王室直系血脉。只不过他亲生父母不是当代虎王和安妮塔，而是郎侦老伯爵的女儿、前侍卫统领的郎飞和她的丈夫泽沐尔卡内！

虽然他还没有看到泽沐尔卡内的画像，但只看老伯爵夫人那偏向东方人种的五官特征，以及郎飞的手指，这都是显著遗传基因，拉斐尔是郎家孩子的可能性几乎铁板钉钉。

商非凡会被气笑，完全是因为虎王和安妮塔的“换子大戏”。

他推测当拉斐尔出生时，虎王可能还没有想到要利用自己的侍卫统领也是远房堂妹之子。

但随着小小的拉斐尔一点点长开，显示出他和前前前任虎王相似的容貌后，虎王的脑子可能就被触动了。

也许虎王和安妮塔那时候就已经有了找一个挡箭牌保护他们亲生子的想法。

于是……还能有比拉斐尔郎沐更好的替换对象吗？

父母全都死了，出生时没有一个至亲亲人在身边，只有虎王最清楚这个小婴儿的模样，接生者和当时知道拉斐尔样貌特征的随从仆人随手就能处理掉。

偏偏这个小婴儿一看就是王室血脉，他还是个少见的白化虎，这让他的头发颜色和安妮塔一模一样。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 149: Raphael's True Heritage

In the afternoon, the sun outside was bright and beautiful.

The old Earl's estate was as quiet as a grave. The massive estate looked somewhat dilapidated, with very few servants.

The old Earl sat with his elderly wife in the garden, which had almost no plants, basking in the sun and whispering something to her in a low voice.

Shang Feifan stood not far away, looking at the two elderly people.

He focused on the old Countess's facial features.

The old Earl shared blood with the Tiger King, so they looked somewhat alike. Without distinct personal features, it would be hard to determine Bu Shuai's relationship to him.

But the old Countess was different. Between Bu Shuai and Lemuel, whoever was her direct descendant would be the one likely to share a resemblance with her.

At first glance of the old Countess, Shang Feifan felt a sense of familiarity.

This old lady had the facial features of an Easterner from Earth. Compared to Westerners, her features were not as prominent, looking more like a mixed-race person. Just like Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai's features were not prominent among the beastmen, but in terms of Earth's Eastern races, his features were quite defined and three-dimensional, giving off a strong vibe of a mixed-race minority. Just like the old Countess.

Shang Feifan thought Bu Shuai was super handsome, good-looking in every way.

But beastmen preferred more defined, prominent features, considering that kind of appearance to be truly handsome.

Shang Feifan had met the Tiger King and seen Lady Anita's portrait, and he had always been curious how two beastmen with such defined features could give birth to Raphael, whose features resembled an Easterner.

He had previously guessed that Bu Shuai might have inherited it through atavism, perhaps because some ancestor of the Tiger King or Lady Anita had less defined features.

After all, Raphael's features had some resemblance to the Tiger King's, while his hair color was exactly the same as Lady Anita's—a brilliant platinum blonde.

The old Countess's hair was also white, though whether due to age or its original color was unknown.

If the old Countess, Anita, and Bu Shuai were to sit together, Shang Feifan believed most people would think the old Countess and Bu Shuai were family. Although their features did not look identical, they looked like they belonged to the same race.

Meanwhile, Lemuel had no resemblance to the old Countess at all. His hair was golden-yellow, and it was said his tiger form was also a large tiger with golden fur. His features were also very sharp and defined, a typical male beastman face.

Shang Feifan could not help but wonder: could the old Earl's dislike for his grandson Lemuel be because he could not see much of his late wife's bloodline traits in him?

However, this thought was dismissed after Shang Feifan saw Lang Fei's portrait.

Lang Fei's features were very defined, looking very much like the Tiger King's biological sister. Of course, she also looked very much like the old Earl, clearly his biological daughter. The old Countess's external genes did not seem to have affected Lang Fei much.

This portrait hung in the main hall.

It was a family portrait. The old Earl and his wife were seated, while a tall female beastman wearing leather armor and looking very heroic stood behind them.

At that time, the old Earl and his wife did not look old at all. They were in their prime, looking only slightly more mature than their daughter, more like her older brother and sister-in-law than her parents.

Lang Fei also looked exceptionally young then, perhaps only in her twenties or thirties.

The moment Shang Feifan saw Lang Fei in the portrait, he froze in place.

Yes, Lang Fei's features were very defined, and at first glance, she and Bu Shuai looked like two completely different people. But anyone extremely familiar with both of them would find a strong mother-son vibe in their features.

It was like a Western mother giving birth to a child of Eastern descent.

Shang Feifan's brain screamed wildly at him: Lang Fei definitely has a blood relation to Bu Shuai, and a direct one at that!

At the same time, he also noticed Lang Fei's fingers.

Lang Fei's fingers were very long. The ring fingers of both her hands were longer than average, almost as long as her middle fingers.

This was a very prominent hereditary trait. The painter had captured this trait perfectly.

Bu Shuai's hands were exactly the same.

Few people would pay attention to other people's hands, and even fewer would compare the hands of two people who seemed completely unrelated. Especially when one of them had been dead for many years.

If Shang Feifan had not doubted Lemuel's heritage, and if the system had not warned him beforehand that there was something wrong with Bu Shuai's background, he would never have idly come to look at Lang Fei's portrait, let alone examine it so closely.

In the portrait, the hand features of Earl Lang Zhen and his wife were not very clear, but one could barely make out that the old Earl's fingers were also very long, though the lengths were clearly distinct. The old Countess's fingers were of a normal hand shape.

Shang Feifan patiently looked at the other portraits.

Many portraits hung in the hall and corridors, some of which were clearly ancestors of Earl Lang Zhen's family.

Shang Feifan looked at them one by one, finally stopping in front of a portrait of a male beastman wearing royal attire and a crown.

The man held a scepter, sitting on a wide beast-skin chair, with a wide belt that looked familiar to Shang Feifan tied around his waist, exuding a majestic aura.

If he was not mistaken, this should be the common ancestor of the old Earl and the contemporary Tiger King—the Tiger King from three generations ago.

From this Tiger King's attire, the materials of his chair, and the surrounding decor, it could be seen that the Tiger Kingdom was probably newly founded at that time. Rather than a king, he looked more like a grand tribal chief.

Was that during the Poison Mist Era?

It was said that due to the influence of the poison mist, this Tiger King from three generations ago only reigned for fifty-odd years before passing away.

The subsequent Tiger King from two generations ago brought the Tiger Kingdom into the New Life Era, but he did not enjoy many of its benefits either. Also due to the excessive accumulation of toxins in his body, he regrettably passed away before reaching the age of two hundred.

The previous Tiger King reigned the longest, ruling the Tiger Kingdom for nearly a hundred and fifty years, until the year 162 of the New Life Era, when the contemporary Tiger King succeeded him.

To make a long story short, seeing this Tiger King's portrait, Shang Feifan was practically amused to the point of laughter.

No wonder no one had ever suspected that Raphael Lang Mu was not the Tiger King's offspring. Just looking at this Tiger King's portrait, anyone who did not know better would think he was Raphael's biological father.

His Bu Shuai's appearance actually shared about sixty to seventy percent similarity with this Tiger King from three generations ago.

If Bu Shuai's features were made slightly more defined and his hair dyed golden-yellow, the similarity could almost reach eighty-five percent!

Furthermore, this Tiger King's ring fingers and middle fingers were also almost the same length.

He could now be one hundred percent certain that Bu Shuai was absolutely of the direct royal bloodline of the Tiger Kingdom. It was just that his biological parents were not the contemporary Tiger King and Anita, but Lang Fei—the daughter of the old Earl Lang Zhen and the former guard commander—and her husband, Zemur Kane!

Although he had not seen Zemur Kane's portrait yet, just looking at the old Countess's Eastern-leaning features and Lang Fei's fingers, which were both prominent genetic traits, the possibility of Raphael being the Lang family's child was practically set in stone.

Shang Feifan was amused to the point of laughter entirely because of the Tiger King and Anita's "child-swapping drama."

He deduced that when Raphael was born, the Tiger King might not have thought of using the child of his guard commander, who was also his distant cousin.

But as little Raphael grew up bit by bit, showing a resemblance to the Tiger King from three generations ago, the Tiger King's mind must have been triggered.

Perhaps the Tiger King and Anita already had the idea of finding a shield to protect their biological child back then.

And so... could there be a better replacement than Raphael Lang Mu?

His parents were both dead, and he had no close relatives by his side at birth. Only the Tiger King knew exactly what this baby looked like. The midwives and the servants who knew Raphael's appearance at the time could easily be dealt with.

And coincidentally, this baby clearly had royal blood, and he was also a rare albino tiger, which made his hair color exactly the same as Anita's.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第149章 拉斐尔的身世 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
加上出生时间也那么吻合，也许相差一两个月，但谁都知道小婴儿一天一个样，就连毛发颜色都会随着时间而改变，只要把孩子藏上一段时间，几个月的差别很容易就含糊过去。

且安妮塔为了保护自己的孩子，在生下雷米尔时肯定没有几个人知道。

这给他们调换孩子也起到更大便利。

更不要说虎王和安妮塔肯定都不想委屈自己的亲生子，找一个同样是王室血脉且是伯爵的孙子来替换，最起码可以保证他们的孩子在替换后也会拥有优质的生活和良好教育。

更美好的是这个孩子的父母还都死了，可以确保没有人会来分薄乃至抢夺他们这对真父母在孩子心目中的地位和感情。

虽然有点对不起被替换的拉斐尔，但对比别人的孩子，当然还是亲生子更重要。

说不定虎王和安妮塔还会觉得这种替换对拉斐尔并不算糟糕，毕竟他可以挂一个虎王之子的名头，作为一个没有王子头衔的王子被人羡慕。还能在“母亲”身边长大，并有着“父亲”的关照和呵护。

而他们可怜的亲生子雷米尔则只有一个不怎么爱他的外公，和一个想要爱他却有心无力的病弱外婆。

否则虎王怎么敢这么理直气壮地让不帅给他做那么事情，为他亲儿子挡那么多灾难！

而这也是安妮塔为什么不惜使用石耳和秘术也要挽回拉斐尔性命的最重要原因！

不仅仅因为她需要拉斐尔继续做她亲生子的挡箭牌，更因为她无法承受将来拉斐尔身世暴露后，郎侦老伯爵以及拉斐尔父母昔日好友们的暴怒乃至疯狂报复。

虎王也承担不起！

所以安妮塔无论如何都需要拉斐尔活着，哪怕身体里换了一个灵魂。

安妮塔也不怕不帅说出换魂真相，只要他还想在这个世界平平安安活下去的话。

真他么的好算计！

艹！

商非凡越想越气，为了不让自己做出不理智的事情，他逼迫自己转移注意力。

“系统，你该给我换一个任务奖励了。我已经知道不帅的身世之秘。”

系统似乎也不想在此时触商非凡的霉头，竟然真的给任务七十七换了奖励，换成“郎沐的幸运值之秘”。

商非凡再次气笑，这个破系统真的是越来越懂得怎么拿捏他。

越生气，商非凡的脑子就越冷静。

关于拉斐尔的真正身世，他肯定会一五一十全都告诉不帅。

但他敢打赌，不帅也许会生气，但九成不会想着报复相关人士，顶多让拉斐尔和雷米尔的身世各自归位，远离王室纷争，然后代替原身好好照顾老伯爵夫妻。

商非凡可以理解不帅的立场，因为不帅欠原身一份情，同样也欠安妮塔一份情，甚至是欠安妮塔更多。

原本商非凡也觉得他欠安妮塔一份情，因为是安妮塔把自爆身死的郎沐的灵魂给召唤到原身身上，让郎沐有了第三世，也让他和郎沐有了再续前缘的可能。

可现在知道拉斐尔的真正身世后，商非凡的想法就完全改变了。

安妮塔并不是为了挽救和延续自己孩子的生命，才召唤来郎沐的灵魂。说白了，她只是出于利用的目的，招来一个灵魂继续给她亲儿子做挡箭牌。

如果说郎沐有欠她的地方，也在郎沐遇到一次又一次羞辱、为难、针对，乃至谋杀后，就还清了。

那可是将近六年时间的挡箭牌！

哪怕是现在，郎沐也依旧在承担着王后和王子公主的仇恨和众多人的鄙视。

前年郎沐再次被算计，重伤到差点死掉，可以说如果不是他身体里藏有石耳，自然之神的神力起到了一点作用，可能郎沐就会再次死亡，也不可能等到商非凡前来。

在商非凡看来，他家不帅就是个心软的大傻子，为了偿还这所谓的“恩情”，不断支付远超市场价的报酬。要换了他，他绝对会彻底利用虎王私生子的名头和身份，要么争权夺利把整个王城都搅得鸡犬不宁，要么就弄一大堆好处远远离开王城，早自找地方逍遥去了。

如今，拉斐尔和雷米尔都已经成年，可虎王和安妮塔还在继续隐瞒两人的身世，而且看样子雷米尔很可能早已知道自己的身世，只拉斐尔郎沐还被瞒在鼓里。

这两人摆明了想要让拉斐尔继续当他们亲生孩子的替命木偶，还要让拉斐尔背负一切不利和骂名。

商非凡自己不是什么好人，所以他非常了解坏人的想法。

他猜测虎王和安妮塔可能打着直等到老伯爵夫妻去世，等到虎王能掌握更多权力，或者安妮塔把虎王的其他孩子全都搞-死后，才可能会公开两人身世，让两人各自归位的想法。

到那时只要随便说一声仆人或王后使坏暗中替换了孩子——他们不需要别人相信，只要有个过得去的理由就成。就能让这场换子风波在最短时间内消弭。

搞不好，他们说不定还会让拉斐尔继续背上骂名。

只要说替换孩子的仆人是他母亲郎飞的贴身仆人，担心没了父母照顾的小少爷将来过得不好，毕竟无论是叔伯那边还是外公外婆那边都隔了一层。

于是该仆人在偶然知道虎王的情人给他生了一个孩子后，就偷偷调换了两个孩子，想要让没有了父母的小少爷变成虎王的儿子，哪怕是个私生子，那也毕竟是虎王血脉。

而那个调换孩子的仆人出于忠心，也为了彻底掩埋这个秘密，就自杀身亡了。

但安妮塔这个做母亲的察觉不对，一直在暗中寻找自己的孩子，因为怀疑是王后动的手脚，就假死藏匿，仍旧在暗中继续寻找亲子，之后无意间碰到雷米尔，母子天性让安妮塔认出了自己的亲子……

随后一身清白又无辜，还成为了虎王唯一血脉的雷米尔自然而然会成为所有人同情的对象，继而成为新的王子，乃至下一代虎王。

而他的离奇身世也将成为他传奇故事中精彩的开篇。

至于拉斐尔郎沐，如果“运气”好，也许能获得一个爵位，过上“平静安详”的生活。如果运气不好，说不定一场小小感冒或一个意外，就能让他“遗憾”离世。

商非凡觉得后者的可能性更大，他从来不介意把坏人想得更坏一点。

“谁？！”

刚刚端着盘子走进大厅，看着已经像是老中年的管家突然爆喝。

偌大的大厅异常安静，只有微风吹过窗帘，掀起淡淡波澜。

管家警觉地环视一圈，放下盘子，动作异常矫健地奔向最大的画像前。

他天天打扫和巡视这栋府邸，对这栋府邸的任何一丝微小变化都会注意到。

现在就在那幅伯爵府全家福面前，被人摆放了两张画像。

管家拿起画像，眼中闪过不解。

画像中的两个人他都认识，作为贵族管家，认得王城中大小贵族和重要官员是基本功。

可为什么有人要把虎王的情人和他私生子的画像放到他们府邸来？

还特意放到了伯爵府全家福画像面前。
chunks.englishText:
Coupled with the fact that their birth times matched so closely—perhaps differing by a month or two, but everyone knew a newborn changed drastically by the day, and even hair color could shift over time—as long as the child was kept hidden for a while, a gap of several months could easily be glossed over.

Furthermore, to protect her own child, Anita certainly ensured that very few people knew when she gave birth to Remiel.

This provided them with even greater convenience for switching the babies.

Not to mention that both the Tiger King and Anita surely did not want to wrong their own flesh and blood. By finding a baby who was equally of royal lineage and the grandson of an Earl to use as a replacement, they could at least guarantee that their child would enjoy a high-quality life and a fine education after the swap.

Even better, this child's parents were both dead, ensuring that no one would ever come to divide—let alone usurp—the status and affection they, as the true parents, held in the child's heart.

Though it was a bit unfair to the replaced Raphael, compared to someone else's child, one's own flesh and blood naturally mattered more.

Perhaps the Tiger King and Anita even felt that this swap wasn't too bad for Raphael. After all, he would carry the title of the Tiger King's son, being envied as a prince without the official title. He would also grow up by his "mother's" side, with his "father's" care and protection.

As for their poor biological son, Remiel, he had only a grandfather who didn't care much for him, and a sickly grandmother who wanted to love him but lacked the strength to do so.

Otherwise, how dared the Tiger King be so righteous in making Bushu do so many things for him, and having him shield his biological son from so many disasters!

And this was the most important reason why Anita went as far as using the Stone Ear fungus and secret arts to salvage Raphael's life!

It wasn't just because she needed Raphael to continue acting as a shield for her biological son, but also because she could not bear the fury—and even the frantic revenge—that Old Earl Langzhen and the former close friends of Raphael's parents would unleash if Raphael's true lineage were ever exposed.

Nor could the Tiger King bear it!

Therefore, no matter what, Anita needed Raphael to stay alive, even if a different soul had replaced the one inside his body.

Nor was Anita afraid that Bushu would spill the truth about the soul-swap, provided he still wished to live a peaceful life in this world.

What a motherfucking brilliant scheme!

Damn it!

The more Shang Feifan thought about it, the angrier he grew. To prevent himself from doing anything irrational, he forced himself to shift his focus.

"System, you should change my quest reward. I've already figured out the secret of Bushu's background."

Seemingly reluctant to provoke Shang Feifan's wrath at this moment, the system actually changed the reward for Quest 77 to "The Secret of Lang Mu's Luck Value."

Shang Feifan was once again so angry he laughed. This crappy system was getting better and better at knowing how to manipulate him.

The angrier he got, the calmer Shang Feifan's mind became.

As for Raphael's true lineage, he would certainly tell Bushu everything, down to the last detail.

Yet he would bet that while Bushu might be angry, there was a ninety percent chance he wouldn't think of taking revenge on the parties involved. At most, he would return Raphael and Remiel to their rightful lineages, distance himself from the royal struggles, and then take the original owner's place in properly caring for the old Earl couple.

Shang Feifan could understand Bushu's stance because Bushu owed the original owner a debt, just as he owed Anita a debt—perhaps even owing Anita far more.

Originally, Shang Feifan had also felt that he owed Anita a favor, since it was Anita who had summoned the soul of Lang Mu—who had perished in a self-detonation—and placed it into the original owner's body, giving Lang Mu a third life and making it possible for him and Lang Mu to continue their romance.

Yet now, knowing Raphael's true background, Shang Feifan's perspective completely changed.

Anita had not summoned Lang Mu's soul to save and prolong the life of her own child. To put it bluntly, she had done it purely for the sake of utility, summoning a soul simply to continue acting as a shield for her biological son.

If Lang Mu had ever owed her anything, it had long since been repaid after enduring humiliation, trouble, targeting, and even assassination attempts time and time again.

That was nearly six years of acting as a human shield!

Even now, Lang Mu was still bearing the hatred of the Queen, the princes, and princesses, as well as the contempt of many others.

The year before last, Lang Mu was plotted against once more, wounded so severely he nearly died. To put it mildly, if he hadn't hidden the Stone Ear fungus within his body, allowing the divine power of the God of Nature to play a minor role, Lang Mu might have perished then and there, never living to wait for Shang Feifan's arrival.

In Shang Feifan's eyes, his dear Bushu was just a soft-hearted, great fool who continuously paid out rewards far exceeding market value just to repay this so-called "graces." If it had been him, he would have thoroughly exploited the title and identity of the Tiger King's illegitimate son—either stirring up a storm that turned the entire royal city upside down through a ruthless power struggle, or grabbing a massive haul of benefits and fleeing far away from the royal city to live a carefree life somewhere else.

Now, both Raphael and Remiel had reached adulthood, yet the Tiger King and Anita were still concealing their true identities. Moreover, it looked as though Remiel had likely known his true background for a long time, leaving only Raphael—Lang Mu—kept completely in the dark.

It was glaringly obvious that these two intended for Raphael to continue acting as the substitute scapegoat for their biological child, while forcing Raphael to bear all the defamation and grievances.

Shang Feifan was no saint himself, so he understood the minds of villains all too well.

He guessed that the Tiger King and Anita were probably waiting until the old Earl couple passed away, until the Tiger King could seize greater power, or until Anita managed to kill-off all the Tiger King's other children, before finally making their identities public and letting the two young men return to their rightful places.

By then, they would simply spin a tale about a servant or the Queen acting maliciously to switch the children in secret—they wouldn't even need people to believe it, as long as there was a passable excuse. That would be enough to quell this child-swapping scandal in the shortest time possible.

For all he knew, they might even make Raphael continue shouldering the infamy.

They could simply claim that the servant who switched the babies was the personal attendant of his mother, Lang Fei, who had worried that the young master—now left without parents to care for him—would have a hard time in the future, especially since both the paternal uncles and maternal grandparents were a generation removed.

Thus, upon accidentally discovering that the Tiger King's mistress had borne him a child, the servant had secretly swapped the two infants, wishing to turn the little master who had lost his parents into the Tiger King's son—even if he was just an illegitimate child, he would at least carry the Tiger King's bloodline.

And that servant, out of loyalty and to bury the secret completely, had committed suicide.

As for Anita, the mother who had sensed something was amiss, she had spent all this time searching for her child in secret. Suspecting that the Queen was behind it all, she had faked her death and gone into hiding, continuing her search for her biological child in the shadows. Later, by chance, she encountered Remiel, and maternal instinct allowed Anita to recognize her own flesh and blood...

Following that, Remiel—spotless, innocent, and now the sole remaining bloodline of the Tiger King—would naturally become the object of everyone's sympathy, subsequently rising to become the new prince and even the next Tiger King.

As for Raphael Lang Mu, if he had good "luck," he might perhaps be granted a title of nobility and live a "peaceful and serene" life. If his luck were bad, a minor cold or a sudden "accident" would be enough to make him pass away with "regret."

Shang Feifan felt the latter possibility was far greater; he never minded assuming the worst of villains.

"Who?!"

The butler, who had just stepped into the hall carrying a tray, suddenly let out a fierce roar as he looked at what appeared to be a middle-aged man.

The cavernous hall was abnormally quiet, save for a gentle breeze rustling the curtains and stirring faint ripples.

The butler scanned his surroundings vigilantly, set down the tray, and sprinted with extraordinary agility toward the largest portrait.

He cleaned and patrolled this mansion every single day, and would notice even the most minuscule change in any corner of the estate.

Right there, directly in front of the Earl's family portrait, someone had placed two new paintings.

The butler picked up the portraits, a look of puzzlement flashing in his eyes.

He recognized both individuals in the pictures. As a noble butler, recognizing the various nobles and important officials throughout the royal city was a basic skill.

Yet why would anyone place portraits of the Tiger King's mistress and his illegitimate son inside their estate?

And deliberately right in front of the Earl's family portrait, no less.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第149章 拉斐尔的身世 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
管家不敢怠慢，把画像丝毫不差地放回原地，转头就去找郎侦老伯爷禀告。

别看老伯爷年纪大了，现在也不想管事，但老伯爷可是当过一百多年城卫军统领的人，他的智慧和能力至今无人敢小瞧。

郎侦老伯爵听到管家的禀告，立即起身。

老伯爵夫人也跟着站起，不等丈夫让她留下，就先说道：“难得家里发生一些特殊的事情，我躺着也无聊，不如和你一起去看看。”

老伯爵只好同意。

三人一同进入府邸大厅，走到全家福画像处。

老夫妻俩不约而同，都先把目光投到了那幅最小的半身画像上。

那是拉斐尔郎沐，这些年在王城里闹得纷纷扬扬的可怜人。

是的，老伯爵夫妻俩一直很同情这个孩子。他们也看不上私生子，但这个孩子出奇的低调，不但不会主动惹事，性子也是个平和讲理的，如果不是知道他的身世，不会有人想到他会是私生子出身。

老伯爵曾经见到过这孩子很多次，第一次见到这孩子，他就很喜欢。

也许人和人之间真的有眼缘这么一说，他看拉斐尔可比看自家亲外孙要顺眼得多。

只是拉斐尔的身世，让他这个已经不想再沾惹王室纷乱的老人并不想和他产生过多交集，每次见面只是一掠而过，说话字数最多的那一次还是上次两人在王宫门口见面。

老伯爵夫人喜欢拉斐尔，则是因为拉斐尔有着和她类似的平淡五官，这让她一度以为拉斐尔和她是同一种族，一种短毛猫，后来知道拉斐尔是一只白虎，她还可惜了一阵子。

老伯爵又把目光放到一旁的画像上，他认出来那是拉斐尔的母亲、虎王的情人，前年年末去世的安妮塔夫人。

“为什么要把这对母子的单人画像放到我们家？谁干的？”老伯爵夫人奇怪地问。

老伯爵仔细打量画像半晌，像是发现了什么，突然抬头看向全家福画像。

因为这幅画像比较大，他还退了两步，好看清全貌。

他首先看的就是自己女儿的手指。

然后他又看向拉斐尔那幅半身像。

这幅半身像上，拉斐尔正在办公，他的一只手按着文件，一只手握笔在书写什么。

“你看他的手指。”老伯爵的声音有点小小的颤抖。

老伯爵夫人下意识顺着老伴的意思看过去，看到了拉斐尔的双手。

管家在一边忽然倒吸一口冷气，呢喃：“不会吧？”

如果没有人特意把拉斐尔的画像放到他们家的画像前，老伯爵和管家就算看到拉斐尔的手指特征也不会多想，因为王族血脉总有一两个人会出现这样的特征。

但是看看不帅那稍显平淡的五官，再看他那特征明显的手指……

老伯爵腾地抬起头，抓起拉斐尔的画像，不断和自己女儿的画像对比。

“你们有没有觉得小飞和这孩子……很像？”老伯爵轻声问。

老伯爵夫人按住心脏，声音也有些微颤抖：“难道不是因为我们家小飞和虎王长得很像，拉斐尔是虎王的孩子，自然和小飞也有点像。”

“可他和你一样，五官和脸型看起来都没有那么挺-立。你们再看虎王和安妮塔……”老伯爵呼吸变得急促。

他忽然抬手，啪地把拉斐尔的画像放到全家福中间：“看看，你们都看看，如果这个孩子一开始就在这里，他是不是比雷米尔更像是我们家的种？”

老伯爵夫人捂住嘴，她的眼中充满慌乱和不可置信。

“我真蠢！我看到那孩子那么多次，明明有那么多明显特征，明明我那么喜欢那孩子，可我竟然没有怀疑过，我竟然从没有一次怀疑过！”老伯爵下意识呢喃。

管家在一边扶住老伯爵夫人，担心地看向老伯爵，出言：“您要冷静。这事……还需要更多证据。何况虎王和您本来就有血缘关系，两家后代有相像之处实在太正常了，只要是正常人，都不会多想。”

老伯爵深吸气：“我很冷静。我就从没有这么冷静过！”

他就说他第一眼看到雷米尔时就有种淡淡的排斥感。当时他还以为自己是因为女儿去世，才会不想见到这个外孙。

但后来看着外孙一天天长大，他仍旧很难对这个孩子产生亲近感。

这个孩子也不亲近他，在刚满十六岁就搬到他父母原来的房子居住，他也没觉得太难过。

他满足了这个孩子的一切物质要求，并为他找到最好的家庭教师，还为他觉醒天赋血脉付出大半家产，他自觉并不欠这个孩子什么。

只是无法给予这孩子想要的爷孙感情。

现在老伯爵很庆幸自己并没有对这个外孙付出太多感情，否则他真的不知道他能否接受知道“真相”后的打击。

可他的老妻……

老伯爵小心放下拉斐尔的画像，从管家手中接过老妻。

“别哭，我们需要查明真相。如果拉斐尔真的是小飞的孩子，想想他这二十一年都过得是什么日子！还有当年他怎么会变成安妮塔和虎王的私生子？我们……决不能在此时倒下，我们必须更坚强，这事绝不简单，一旦查明，这就是一个王室巨大丑闻，而我们真正的孙子需要我们，我们也将是他唯一的后盾。”

老伯爵在老妻耳边低声说。

神奇的，他病弱的老妻慢慢挺直了腰身，整个人的精神气看着也不一样了。

“你说的对。我们得先查明真相，我们必须知道真相！首先搞清楚，雷米尔和拉斐尔到底谁才是小飞的孩子。”老伯爵夫人紧紧握住了丈夫的手。

管家也在一边深吸气，这件事真的太突然，太大，导致他的心脏到现在还在飞快跳动。

只不过两幅画像，没想到竟然惹出了伯爵府继承人的身世之谜！
chunks.englishText:
The butler dared not be negligent. He placed the portraits back exactly where they were, without the slightest deviation, and hurried off to report to Old Earl Langzhen.

Do not underestimate the old Earl simply because of his advanced age and his current retirement from administrative duties; he had once served as the commander of the City Guard for over a hundred years, and to this day, no one dared look down upon his wisdom and capability.

Upon hearing the butler's report, Old Earl Langzhen immediately stood up.

The old Countess rose alongside him, speaking before her husband could tell her to stay behind: "It's rare for something unusual to happen at home, and I'm bored lying down anyway. I might as well go have a look with you."

The old Earl had no choice but to agree.

The three of them entered the mansion's grand hall together and walked up to the family portrait.

Without prior consultation, the elderly couple both cast their gazes first toward the smaller half-length portrait.

That was Raphael Lang Mu, the pitiful figure who had caused such a massive uproar in the royal city over the past few years.

Yes, the Earl and his wife had always felt deep sympathy for this child. They looked down upon illegitimate children themselves, but this young man was unusually low-key. Not only did he avoid actively stirring up trouble, but his temperament was also peaceful and reasonable; if not for knowing his background, no one would ever have guessed he was born an illegitimate son.

The old Earl had crossed paths with the boy many times, and upon first meeting him, he had taken an immediate liking to him.

Perhaps there really was such a thing as a natural affinity between people; he found Raphael far more pleasing to the eye than his own biological grandson.

Only, Raphael's background made the old man—who no longer wished to meddle in royal entanglements—unwilling to cross paths with him too deeply. Each time they met, they merely brushed past one another, and the longest conversation they had ever shared was that previous encounter at the royal palace gates.

As for the old Countess, she liked Raphael because he possessed facial features somewhat similar to her own understated ones, which had once led her to believe Raphael belonged to the same race as her—a short-haired cat. When she later learned Raphael was actually a white tiger, she had felt regret for quite a while.

The old Earl then shifted his gaze to the portrait beside it, recognizing it as Raphael's mother, the Tiger King's mistress, Lady Anita, who had passed away at the end of the year before last.

"Why would anyone place portraits of this mother and son in our home? Who did this?" the old Countess asked, bewildered.

The old Earl studied the portraits closely for a long time. As if discovering something, he suddenly raised his head to stare at the main family portrait.

Because this portrait was quite large, he even took two steps back to take in the entire picture.

His eyes went first to his daughter's fingers.

Then, he looked back at Raphael's half-length portrait.

In this portrait, Raphael was working at his desk, one hand pressing down on a stack of documents while the other held a pen, writing something.

"Look at his fingers," the old Earl's voice trembled slightly.

Unconsciously, the old Countess followed her husband's cue, looking toward Raphael's hands.

Standing nearby, the butler suddenly gasped sharply and muttered, "No way?"

If someone hadn't deliberately placed Raphael's portrait before their family painting, the old Earl and the butler would never have thought twice upon seeing the distinctive features of Raphael's fingers, as royal bloodlines often produced one or two individuals with such traits.

Yet, when one looked at Bushu's somewhat plain facial features, and then looked at those distinctly shaped fingers...

The old Earl jerked his head up, snatched up Raphael's portrait, and continuously compared it against the portrait of his own daughter.

"Don't you all think Little Fei and this child... look alike?" the old Earl asked softly.

The old Countess pressed a hand to her chest, her voice trembling slightly as well: "Isn't that just because our Little Fei looks a lot like the Tiger King, and since Raphael is the Tiger King's child, it's only natural he resembles Little Fei a little?"

"But like you, his facial features and face shape aren't all that sharp and prominent. Look at the Tiger King and Anita instead..." The old Earl's breathing grew ragged.

Abruptly, he raised his hand and slapped Raphael's portrait right into the center of the family painting: "Look! All of you, take a good look! If this child had been right here from the very beginning, wouldn't he look much more like our family's flesh and blood than Remiel?"

The old Countess covered her mouth, her eyes filled with panic and disbelief.

"I am such a fool! I've seen that child so many times, when there were so many obvious traits, when I liked that child so much... yet I never once suspected it. I never suspected it even once!" the old Earl muttered involuntarily.

The butler hurried over to support the old Countess, casting a worried look at the old Earl as he spoke up: "You must remain calm. This matter... requires more evidence. Besides, the Tiger King already shares a blood relation with you; it is entirely normal for descendants of both families to share similarities. Any ordinary person wouldn't read into it."

The old Earl took a deep breath. "I am very calm. I have never been this calm in my life!"

He had always felt a faint sense of repulsion the very first time he laid eyes on Remiel. Back then, he had assumed it was simply because his daughter had passed away, leaving him reluctant to look upon this maternal grandson.

Yet later on, as he watched his grandson grow day by day, he still found it difficult to cultivate any sense of closeness toward the boy.

Nor was the boy close to him; the moment he turned sixteen, Remiel had moved out to live in his parents' original house, and he hadn't felt particularly heartbroken over it either.

He had satisfied every material request the boy made, found him the finest private tutors, and expended the greater part of his family fortune to help him awaken his innate bloodline talent. He felt he owed the child nothing.

He simply could not give the boy the grandfather-grandson affection he desired.

Right now, the old Earl felt immensely grateful that he hadn't invested too much emotional attachment in this grandson; otherwise, he truly wouldn't know if he could withstand the blow of learning the "truth."

As for his aging wife...

The old Earl gently set down Raphael's portrait and took his wife from the butler's arms.

"Don't cry. We need to unearth the truth. If Raphael really is Little Fei's child, just think about what kind of life he has endured over these past twenty-one years! And how did he end up becoming Anita and the Tiger King's illegitimate child back then? We... must not collapse at a time like this. We have to be stronger. This matter is by no means simple. Once it is brought to light, it will be a colossal royal scandal, and our true grandson will need us—we will be his only backing."

The old Earl murmured softly in his wife's ear.

Miraculously, his sickly wife slowly straightened her back, and her entire spirit seemed to transform.

"You're right. We must investigate the truth first; we have to know the truth! Above all, we must figure out whether Remiel or Raphael is truly Little Fei's child." The old Countess gripped her husband's hand tightly.

The butler also drew a sharp breath beside them. This matter had come so suddenly and on such a massive scale that his heart was still pounding wildly against his ribs.

Who would have thought that a mere two portraits would drag up the hidden secrets behind the heir of the Earl's estate!

chunks.chapterTitle: 第150章 嚣张的阿瑞斯商 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第150章 嚣张的阿瑞斯商

晚上，不帅一身疲累地回到特调局的小休息室。

工作不累，但和雷米尔相处心累。

那家伙看起来也不像是要和他作对，但也没有好好合作的意思，而且总是想要主导调查行动。

不帅承认对方有一定才能，但对方才二十一岁，他的某些手段和应对在他看来真的太嫩，就跟刚出学校的愣头青差不多。

而且不帅是稳健派，讲究的是循序渐进，尽量做到不打草惊蛇地查明情况。

但雷米尔却喜欢单刀直入，只要有疑点就咬着不放，甚至会不管三七二十一，先把嫌疑者抓起来。

这么做其实在某些时候也没什么，甚至很有效。

问题是没有证据就随便抓人，自然会惹得这些商人愤恨和抱怨，其中还有象国、犀国和翼国等地来的非虎国商人。

如果雷米尔能摆平这些抱怨，那也是他的本事，可他根本没办法摆平。还说他只负责查找可疑者，不负责安抚这些商人的情绪。

不是不帅多心，但雷米尔这种查案手法让他感觉对方就像是在故意找事。

那些商人不平，就闹到了鬼火商会那边，让鬼火商会为他们出头解决这些麻烦。

鬼火商会就直接找到虎国的商务大臣，那位商务大臣则跟虎王告状，虎王又把事情交给特调局局长和城卫军统领处理。

结果就是今天大半天时间，不帅都不得不在各个部门之间来回解释，听各路人马跟他抱怨、讽刺和谩骂。

且因为雷米尔只是一个普通侍卫，而他顶着虎王私生子的名头，谁都以为抓人的事是他主导的。

但不帅不习惯把这些工作上的不愉快和别人述说，包括商非凡，所以他全都闷在了心里。

反倒是商非凡，看到他就跟他说了他的怀疑。

“……以上，就是我查到的全部内容。”

商非凡没有变成小老虎，而是就坐在床边上，跟不帅说了他这两天对雷米尔的身世调查结果。

不帅刚洗完澡出来，在商非凡说到一半的时候，他擦头发的手就停住了。

“你看起来似乎不是很惊讶？”商非凡神情有点好奇。

不帅抓着布巾在唯一一张椅子上坐下，“我一直以为安妮塔夫人对我不亲近，偶尔还会用奇怪的目光看我，是因为她知道我不是她的亲生孩子。”

“而你刚才告诉我的事，证明我的直觉正确，只不过不仅仅是我的灵魂不是安妮塔夫人的孩子，就连这具身体也不是。而她从一开始就知道。”

“你的想法？”商非凡直截了当地问。

不帅沉默片刻，过了一会儿才说道：“你说虎王和安妮塔为了他们以及雷米尔的名声，就算公开原身和雷米尔的身世，也不会说实话，而是会把污水泼到郎飞的仆人头上？”

商非凡：“这是必然。否则你认为两个能把别人孩子和自己孩子调换，就为了让别人孩子做挡箭牌的‘聪明人’，会给别人主动送上攻击他们的借口吗？”

不帅再次沉默。以他对虎王和安妮塔夫人的了解，那两人真的会做出这种事。他们能为他们的孩子搞出一个挡箭牌，自然也会为他们的孩子归位后的名声考虑。

除非他们从没有考虑过再让两个孩子换回来。

但安妮塔付出那么多、又暗中布置多年，她的所求会只是给儿子一个安稳未来吗？

一旦两个孩子的身世曝光，哪怕不为了亲生子的名誉，只为了保护自己……不说安妮塔，单虎王也会想办法让当年的换子行为看起来非他之过。

因为虎王用自己心腹近臣的孩子充作自己的私生子没什么，只要这近臣能同意。但是让牺牲的英雄之子冒充自己的私生子，让这个孩子顶着骂名长大，且明知自己的王后和某些人在不断谋害这个孩子，他也没有说出这个孩子的真正身世。

这事一旦曝光，虎王别说名声了，不被赶下位就算好的。

“这些都是我们的推测。”不帅开口。

商非凡了然一笑：“所以我问你，你想怎么做？”

不帅很自然地把自己放到一边，只考虑原身，这让他很容易就得出结论：“很简单，该是怎样就是怎样。原身已死，但他不能连身后名都被污蔑。”

“你知道，一旦让原身和雷米尔的身世曝光，我们就得准备好对付虎王和安妮塔的‘对应说辞’。”商非凡提醒不帅：“他们不可能等到两人身世曝光才来想应对说辞，以那两人的智商，他们绝对会在替换孩子的那一刻开始就已经做好了将来两个孩子身世曝光的准备。”

不帅皱眉，这确实是一个麻烦。曝光拉斐尔和雷米尔的身世不难，难的是怎么样让虎王和安妮塔不颠倒黑白。

就在不帅思考要如何破解这个难题时。

“这两天，郎侦老伯爵应该会接触你。”商非凡忽然道。

不帅抬头：“你跟老伯爵说了？”

商非凡摇头：“我只是把你和安妮塔的画像放到了他们家的全家福画像下。如果那位老伯爷的能力真的像传言中那样，他不可能一点都不怀疑，而他只要产生怀疑，就一定会来找你这个当事人。”

不帅对老伯爵不太了解，但也听过他一些传言，下意识说：“也许他会请宫廷祭司帮忙查验我和他的血缘关系。”

商非凡挑眉：“宫廷祭司还有这个能力？”

不帅失笑：“我没跟你说过吗？宫廷祭司的主要职责之一就是在王子公主出生后，确认他们血脉无误，避免王室血脉被混淆。”

商非凡：“拉斐尔没有被检测过？”

不帅摇头：“他……我只是私生子，只要我没有被虎王正式承认，列入继承人行列，宫廷祭司就不需要查验我的血脉。”

商非凡握拳：“很好，我们至少多了一条可以确认你和雷米尔血脉的路子。”

不帅却说：“宫廷祭司一般不会轻易出手。但……传言老伯爵和宫廷祭司关系很好，也许他会暗中请宫廷祭司帮忙。”

商非凡敏锐地查知：“这个传言是不是没有太多人知道？”

不帅尴尬点头：“我也是在虎王身边当侍卫时，偶尔撞见他和宫廷祭司说话才发现的。两人态度看起来像是普通认识，但他们之间的说话气氛和彼此对视的眼神，就是那种好友才会有的默契。当然我也可能看错了。”

“相信自己的观察力，还有你三世的人生经验。”商非凡走过来抢过布巾按到不帅头发上，用力揉搓几把。

不帅仰头，身体放松。他可以用魔法烘干全身，如果他现在是兽身，他一定会这么做。但只是短发，他就不想浪费魔晶了。

商非凡一边给他擦头发，一边给他按摩头皮，适度的力道和准确的穴位疏通，让不帅身体涌上一股股放松的酥麻感。

“趴床上去，我给你好好按按。然后你也跟我好好说说你在黑森林城六天，以及你和雷米尔这几天的合作情况，别想隐瞒我，你绝对是积累了满满一大桶的情绪垃圾。”商非凡拍拍不帅。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 150: The Arrogant Ares Merchant (Part 1)

That evening, Bu Shuai returned to the Special Investigation Bureau’s small lounge feeling utterly exhausted.

The work itself wasn't tiring, but dealing with Remiel was mentally draining.

That fellow didn't seem actively hostile toward him, but he had no intention of cooperating properly either, and always tried to hijack the lead in investigative operations.

Bu Shuai admitted that the other party possessed a certain degree of talent, but at only twenty-one years old, some of his methods and reactions seemed entirely green in Bu Shuai's eyes—much like a hotheaded rookie fresh out of school.

Furthermore, Bu Shuai was a man of the cautious faction, advocating for gradual progress and investigating the situation thoroughly without startling the enemy.

Remiel, however, loved to charge straight in. Whenever he found a suspicious point, he would bite down and refuse to let go, sometimes ignoring all common sense to arrest suspects on the spot.

Such an approach was fine in certain situations and could even be remarkably effective.

The problem was that arresting people arbitrarily without evidence naturally aroused resentment and complaints among the merchants, including non-Tiger Clan merchants who hailed from Elephant Country, Rhinoceros Country, and Winged Country.

If Remiel could smooth over these complaints, that would be his own capability, but he couldn't handle them at all. He even claimed that he was only responsible for hunting down suspicious characters, not for soothing the merchants' emotions.

It wasn't that Bu Shuai was being overly paranoid, but Remiel's investigation style gave him the distinct impression that the fellow was deliberately stirring up trouble.

Unable to stomach their grievances, those merchants ran straight to the Ignis Chamber of Commerce, demanding that the chamber step up and resolve their troubles.

The Ignis Chamber of Commerce went directly to the Tiger Kingdom’s Minister of Commerce, who in turn complained to the Tiger King, and the Tiger King then tossed the mess to the Director of the Special Investigation Bureau and the Commander of the City Guards to sort out.

As a result, for the greater part of today, Bu Shuai had been forced to run back and forth among various departments offering explanations, listening to all sorts of people complain, mock, and curse at him.

Moreover, because Remiel was merely an ordinary guard while Bu Shuai bore the title of the Tiger King’s illegitimate son, everyone assumed that the arrests had been spearheaded by him.

However, Bu Shuai was not accustomed to venting these workplace grievances to others—not even to Shang Feifan—so he kept all of it pent up inside.

Ironically, as soon as he saw Bu Shuai, Shang Feifan came forward and shared his own findings.

"...The above is everything I managed to investigate."

Shang Feifan hadn't transformed into his little tiger form; instead, he sat right on the edge of the bed and recounted to Bu Shuai the results of his two-day investigation into Remiel's true lineage.

Bu Shuai had just emerged from a shower, and midway through Shang Feifan's report, his hand holding the towel froze.

"You don't seem particularly surprised?" Shang Feifan asked with a hint of curiosity in his expression.

Bu Shuai clutched the cloth and sat down on the only chair in the room. "I always thought Madam Anita treated me with distance and occasionally looked at me with strange eyes because she knew I wasn't her biological child."

"And what you just told me proves my intuition was correct—except it wasn't just my soul that didn't belong to Madam Anita; even this body didn't. And she knew it from the very beginning."

"Your thoughts?" Shang Feifan asked bluntly.

Bu Shuai fell silent for a moment before replying, "Are you saying that for the sake of their own reputations and Remiel's, even if the true identities of the original owner and Remiel are exposed, the Tiger King and Anita won't tell the truth, but will instead splash dirty water onto Lang Fei's servants?"

Shang Feifan replied, "That's inevitable. Otherwise, do you think two 'clever people' who would swap someone else's child with their own just to use another's child as a scapegoat would willingly hand others an excuse to attack them?"

Bu Shuai fell silent once more. Based on his understanding of the Tiger King and Madam Anita, those two were entirely capable of doing such a thing. Since they could conjure up a scapegoat for their own child, they would naturally take the child's post-reunion reputation into account as well.

Unless they had never considered letting the two children swap back in the first place.

Yet, given how much effort Anita had invested and how many years she had secretly plotted, would her ultimate desire really be just to give her son a peaceful future?

Once the identities of the two children were exposed—forget about Anita's reputation for a moment—the Tiger King alone would find a way to make the child-swapping incident of yesteryear look like no fault of his own.

Because there was nothing wrong with the Tiger King using the child of his trusted close retainer as his own illegitimate son, provided the retainer agreed. But using the child of a fallen hero to impersonate one's own illegitimate son, letting that child grow up bearing endless curses while knowing full well that his Queen and certain others were continually plotting against the child, yet failing to reveal his true lineage...

Once this matter came to light, never mind his reputation, the Tiger King would be lucky not to be driven off his throne.

"All of this is just our speculation," Bu Shuai pointed out.

Shang Feifan smiled knowingly. "That's why I'm asking you, what do you want to do?"

Bu Shuai naturally put himself aside and considered only the original owner, which made it easy for him to reach a conclusion: "It's simple. Things should be what they are. The original owner is already dead, but his posthumous reputation cannot be slandered."

"You know, once the identities of the original owner and Remiel are exposed, we must be prepared with a counter-narrative to deal with the Tiger King and Anita," Shang Feifan reminded him. "They won't wait until the identities are exposed to think of a response. Given those two brains, the moment they switched the children, they absolute made preparations for the day the truth would come out."

Bu Shuai frowned. This truly was a troublesome matter. Exposing the identities of Raphael and Remiel wasn't difficult; the hard part was preventing the Tiger King and Anita from twisting black into white.

Just as Bu Shuai was pondering how to crack this difficult puzzle:

"In the next couple of days, Senior Grand Duke Lang Zhen should be reaching out to you," Shang Feifan said suddenly.

Bu Shuai looked up. "You spoke with the Old Grand Duke?"

Shang Feifan shook his head. "I merely slipped the portrait of you and Anita beneath their family portrait. If that old grand master's abilities are truly as formidable as the rumors say, it's impossible for him not to harbor suspicions. And once he has doubts, he will definitely come looking for you, the person directly involved."

Bu Shuai didn't know much about the Old Grand Duke, but he had heard some rumors about him and instinctively said, "Perhaps he will ask the Palace Priest to help verify the bloodline between us."

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. "The Palace Priest has this kind of ability?"

Bu Shuai chuckled helplessly. "Didn't I mention this to you? One of the primary duties of the Palace Priest is to confirm the unimpeachable bloodline of princes and princesses upon their birth, preventing any confusion of the royal lineage."

Shang Feifan asked, "Raphael was never tested?"

Bu Shuai shook his head. "He... I was merely an illegitimate son. As long as I wasn't formally recognized by the Tiger King and entered into the succession line, the Palace Priest had no need to verify my blood."

Shang Feifan clenched his fist. "Splendid. We have at least one more path to confirm the bloodline relationship between you and Remiel."

Yet Bu Shuai noted, "The Palace Priest generally doesn't step in lightly. However... rumor has it that the Old Grand Duke enjoys a very close relationship with the Palace Priest. Perhaps he will secretly ask the Palace Priest for assistance."

Shang Feifan acutely perceived, "Does this rumor remain largely unknown to others?"

Bu Shuai nodded awkwardly. "I only discovered it by chance when I was serving as a guard beside the Tiger King and happened to catch him speaking with the Palace Priest. Their attitude seemed like ordinary acquaintances, but the conversational atmosphere between them and the way they looked at each other carried that tacit understanding exclusive to close friends. Of course, I might have misread it."

"Trust your powers of observation, and your three lifetimes of life experience." Shang Feifan walked over, snatched the towel from Bu Shuai's hands, and pressed it against his hair, rubbing vigorously.

Bu Shuai tilted his head back, his body relaxing. He could have used magic to dry himself entirely—if he were in beast form right now, he certainly would have done so. But for short hair, he simply didn't want to waste magic crystals.

While drying his hair, Shang Feifan massaged his scalp. The moderate pressure and accurate acupoint stimulation caused waves of relaxed, tingling warmth to wash over Bu Shuai's body.

"Lie down on the bed, and I'll give you a proper massage. Then you're going to tell me all about your six days in Black Forest City, as well as your cooperative work with Remiel these past few days. Don't think about hiding anything from me; you've definitely accumulated a whole bucket full of emotional garbage." Shang Feifan patted Bu Shuai.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第150章 嚣张的阿瑞斯商 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
不帅无意识地笑起来，“你想当垃圾桶吗？”

“嗯，我还可以是你的垃圾站。对你来说那些都是负面能量，对我来说，说不定里面就有价值极高的情报。你知道很多心理医疗师也兼任间谍吗？哦，说错，是很多间谍会考取心理医师执照。”

不帅被逗笑，之后就为商非凡一手精湛的按摩技术给征服了。

不帅甚至忍不住想：这家伙对人体这么了解，杀人一定也很利落。

不对，他的身体和人类并不完全相同，他是兽人！

所以这家伙在进入兽人世界大半年时间就已经掌握并了解了兽人的身体构造？

商非凡听不帅陈述他这段时间的工作内容。

不帅还是没有用抱怨的语气，他就像是在跟同事交代自己的工作内容，尽量不含感情地进行完整述说。

但商非凡还是从不帅的平铺直叙中听出了他心底的疲累。

别看黑森林城之行不帅的任务只是当个引路人，但只是他的身份就让和他一起过去的那些人在他面前上演了一场场舞台剧。

有人想要巴结他，对他说着让彼此都尴尬的吹捧之词。

有人怀着各种目的想要结交他，对他表示好感、拉拢他。

也有人明目张胆地讽刺他，说他现在成了能否进出图书馆的关键先生（车夫），肯定很自得，觉得自己很了不起云云。

更有人不掩好奇，想要打听出他召唤车辆的秘密。

最让不帅好笑的是，还有人别出心裁地警告他不要上阿瑞斯商的当，说他亲耳听到阿瑞斯商和某位大人物在一起说笑打赌，赌他一定能拿下拉斐尔，再抛弃他，让拉斐尔出个大丑。

商非凡听到这里，特别询问那个胡说八道污蔑他的人是谁。

不帅笑得身体发颤，在商非凡的挠痒痒大法下跟他吐露了相关人名。

不帅又告诉商非凡，图书馆把所有他带过去的人都接纳了，老人还出来转悠了一阵子，他似乎想要找人说话。

那百多名兽人看到老人出现都非常激动，人人都想和老人搭上话，但老人态度很高傲，一副不怎么搭理人的样子。如果他和谁说上一两句，那个人会非常自豪，更会受到其他人的羡慕妒忌。

老人也没有反对让人抄写图书馆的书籍，相反他很欣赏这种举措。

“他跟你说话了吗？”

“嗯，我在看历代关于魔力传说的资料，我发现了一个秘密，那就是在旧神血皇朝期间，不止一个魔法师进入兽人大陆，但在旧兽人联盟时期，这种现象就几乎消失了。那位老人突然出现在我面前，他说如果我是预言中的那个人，就一定能找到消失的空间通道。哦，他还让我离诅咒之神的使徒远一点，说你会让我运气变得糟糕。”

“屁！”商非凡很想说自从他跟不帅在一起后，不帅的幸运值就在上升，虽然没有上涨多少，但那也是上升！

不帅低声说：“但我知道，你才是我的幸运星。”

商非凡嘴唇翘起，没错，他就是他家不帅的幸运星和幸福星！

“那个老头人老糊涂了，以后你离他远一点。”

不帅吃吃笑。

“我发现那些抄写者都在集中抄写旧兽人联盟时期的科技理论基础和发明创造。只有少数人在抄写炼金术和血脉天赋方面的知识。”

“这是很聪明的做法，旧兽人联盟时期的科技发展基本是从零开始，而大繁华纪的科技却是高中生以上才可能理解和掌握的知识，更掺杂了炼金术。经历毁灭后重建的虎国兽人目前就是小学三年级生的水平，与其去扒拉和研究繁华纪的黑科技，还不如踏踏实实从头打基础。”

不帅想说他似乎在几本传记和野史小说中找到了那条被老人说是消失的空间通道的相关信息，但他又不觉得他的运气真的能这么好，只不过随便翻了几本书就能找到通往其他大陆的空间通道，就没有跟商非凡特别提起这件事。

等不帅说完他和雷米尔这几天的合作，鼻息已经变得平稳。

商非凡看着不知不觉就已睡着的不帅，低头亲了亲他发青的眼底，给他调整了下睡姿，帮他拉上被子。

当晚，阿瑞斯商在销金窟旖梦楼找到正在和多丽丝王妃放松的雷米尔，抄着骨杖就把对方狠揍了一顿。

雷米尔的身手也不错，但阿瑞斯商的气力大得惊人，你打他十下，都不如他抽你一下的伤害度高。

而且阿瑞斯商不仅力大无穷，他敏捷性也超凡。

动作快，力气大，准头高，反应迅捷，就问这样的敌人你头不头疼？

多丽丝王妃在一边大喊，旖梦楼打手涌过来想要拉架，他们原本想要对阿瑞斯商动手，但在看到阿瑞斯商的脸后就迟疑了。

这位可是王城炙手可热的大红人，靠的还不是他的身份地位，而是他的个人能力。

要问现在王城最不能得罪的人，除了王室那几位，顺着数下来，阿瑞斯商绝对能排进前三。

阿瑞斯商对上原本来揍人、看到他才改成拉架的打手们也没客气，谁敢挨边就揍谁，揍得一群打手东倒西歪，都不敢爬起来。

好多客人在不远处围观，他们不敢靠近，但也没有逃跑。

还有不少幸灾乐祸的家伙在外围叫好，就差没当场下赌注。

好在阿瑞斯商并不打算打死打残雷米尔，把雷米尔打得爬不起来后，就提着骨杖大摇大摆地离开。

从头到尾，阿瑞斯商就没有和雷米尔说过一句话，连一个字都没有。

奇怪的是雷米尔也没有质问阿瑞斯商为什么对他动手。

多丽丝看到阿瑞斯商离开，急忙奔过来扶起口鼻流血的雷米尔。

“阿瑞斯商好过分！他好端端地为什么打你？”多丽丝急问。

雷米尔抓过多丽丝给他擦鼻血的手帕，用力一抹口鼻，声音极为阴沉地说：“拉斐尔。”

十分钟后，雷米尔坐进了旖梦楼的特别套房中。

老板娘伊娃一边给他上伤药，一边不赞成地说：“阿瑞斯商就是个肆无忌惮的疯子，这种人喜欢谁就会对谁好到极点，也不会管对方是否能接受。你看曾经和拉斐尔有仇怨的杜德家两兄弟，还有大商人獭金的儿子，被整得多惨？杜德子爵和獭金都跑去找他们的靠山王后了，但王后有对阿瑞斯商做什么吗？”

“没有。现在反而是杜德一家和獭金一家都开始约束自家子弟，开始在王城低调做人。”

伊娃看雷米尔表情不好，摇头：“拉斐尔本来可以是你的助力，他那个人性子平和，只要没有踩到他的底线，他能忍让的就会忍让。但他能忍让你，不代表阿瑞斯商那个疯子能容忍别人欺负他的情人。”

“所以拉斐尔就是个跟自己情人告状自己受到欺负的柔弱雄性？”雷米尔嘴角勾起讥讽的笑，结果扯到伤口，疼得捂住嘴角。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 150: The Arrogant Ares Merchant (Part 2)

Bu Shuai chuckled unconsciously. "Do you want to be a garbage can?"

"Well, I can also be your garbage disposal station. To you, those are all negative energies, but to me, who knows? Among them might lie intelligence of extremely high value. You know that many psychological therapists also moonlight as spies? Oh, correction, many spies obtain psychological physician licenses."

Bu Shuai was amused, and soon completely conquered by Shang Feifan's exquisite massage techniques.

He couldn't help thinking: *With such a deep understanding of the human body, this guy must be exceptionally clean when it comes to killing people.*

*No, wait, his body isn't entirely identical to a human's; he's an Orc!*

*So this fellow managed to master and understand the physiological structure of Orcs within just over half a year of entering the Orc world?*

Shang Feifan listened as Bu Shuai recounted the contents of his work during this period.

Bu Shuai still avoided using a complaining tone; he spoke as if he were briefing a colleague on work assignments, recounting the events as completely and emotionlessly as possible.

Yet Shang Feifan still detected the underlying fatigue hidden beneath Bu Shuai's flat narration.

Though Bu Shuai's mission on the Black Forest City trip was merely to act as a guide, his very identity had prompted the people traveling with him to stage one performance after another right before his eyes.

Some sought to curry favor, uttering awkward flattery designed to make both parties uncomfortable.

Others harbored various agendas, attempting to befriend him, express goodwill, and pull him into their circles.

There were also those who blatantly mocked him, sneering that he must be immensely smug and full of himself now that he had become the crucial gentleman (coachman) who controlled entry and exit to the library.

Still others, their curiosity uncontained, tried to pry into the secret of how he summoned vehicles.

What amused Bu Shuai the most was that someone had even gone out of their way to warn him not to fall for Ares Merchant's tricks, claiming they had heard with their own ears that Ares Merchant and a certain bigwig were laughing and betting together, wagering that Ares Merchant would surely hook Raphael and then dump him, making Raphael look utterly foolish.

Hearing this, Shang Feifan specifically inquired who that talking-nonsense slanderer was.

Bu Shuai laughed until his body trembled, and under Shang Feifan's tickling torture, he finally revealed the person's name.

Bu Shuai went on to tell Shang Feifan that the library had accepted all the people he brought over, and the old man had even strolled out for a spell, seeming as though he wanted to find someone to talk to.

The hundred-odd Orcs were utterly ecstatic upon seeing the old man appear, and everyone wanted to strike up a conversation with him. However, the old man maintained an extremely arrogant attitude, barely deigning to pay attention to anyone. If he deigned to exchange a word or two with someone, that person would swell with immense pride, drawing the envy and jealousy of all the others.

Nor did the old man object to people copying the books in the library; on the contrary, he highly appreciated this initiative.

"Did he speak to you?"

"Mm. I was reading materials on magical legends through the ages, and I discovered a secret: during the Old God Blood Dynasty era, more than one magician entered the Orc Continent, but during the Old Orc Alliance era, this phenomenon practically vanished. That old man suddenly appeared before me and said that if I were the person in the prophecy, I would definitely be able to find the vanished spatial passage. Oh, he also told me to stay far away from the Apostle of the God of Curses, saying you would bring me bad luck."

"Bullshit!" Shang Feifan desperately wanted to say that ever since he started hanging out with Bu Shuai, Bu Shuai's luck stat had been steadily climbing—though not by much, it was still an increase!

Bu Shuai said softly, "But I know you are my lucky star."

Shang Feifan's lips curled upward. Indeed, he was his Bu Shuai's lucky star and happiness star!

"That old codger is losing his mind. Stay away from him in the future."

Bu Shuai giggled.

"I noticed that all the copyists are concentrating on transcribing the scientific theoretical foundations and inventions of the Old Orc Alliance era. Only a handful are copying knowledge regarding alchemy and bloodline talents."

"That's a very smart approach. The scientific development of the Old Orc Alliance era basically started from scratch, whereas the technology of the High Prosperity Era is knowledge that only high schoolers or above can understand and master, and it's even intermingled with alchemy. The Tiger Kingdom's Orcs, rebuilding after destruction, currently possess the comprehension level of third-grade elementary school students. Instead of digging up and researching the black tech of the Prosperity Era, it's far better to honestly build a solid foundation from the ground up."

Bu Shuai wanted to mention that he seemed to have found information related to the spatial passage the old man claimed had vanished within a few biographies and unofficial historical novels. However, he didn't feel his luck was truly so good that he could stumble upon a spatial passage leading to other realms just by flipping through a few random books, so he didn't bring it up specifically to Shang Feifan.

By the time Bu Shuai finished recounting his cooperation with Remiel over the past few days, his breathing had grown steady and even.

Shang Feifan looked down at Bu Shuai, who had drifted off to sleep without realizing it. He gently kissed the dark circles under Bu Shuai's eyes, adjusted his sleeping posture, and pulled the quilt over him.

That very night, Ares Merchant tracked down Remiel, who was relaxing with Concubine Doris at the Yimeng Pavilion in the Pleasure Quarter, and thoroughly thrashed him with a bone staff.

Remiel's combat skills were quite decent, but Ares Merchant's physical strength was astonishingly high. Ten blows landed on Ares Merchant didn't match the damage inflicted by a single swipe from him.

Moreover, Ares Merchant was not only possessed of boundless strength, but his agility was also extraordinary.

Fast movements, immense strength, high accuracy, and lightning-fast reflexes—one could only imagine how headache-inducing such an enemy was.

Concubine Doris shrieked from the side, and the thugs of Yimeng Pavilion swarmed over to break up the fight. They had originally intended to make a move against Ares Merchant, but upon catching sight of his face, they hesitated.

This fellow was currently a wildly popular, blazing red-hot figure in the royal city, relying not on his status or position, but on his sheer personal capability.

If one asked who must not be offended in the royal city right now, aside from those figures in the royal family, counting downwards, Ares Merchant would definitely rank in the top three.

Ares Merchant showed no courtesy to the thugs who had originally come to beat someone up and only switched to breaking up the fight when they saw who it was. Anyone who dared come close was thrashed, beaten until the group of thugs sprawled haphazardly across the floor, too terrified to crawl back up.

Many guests watched from a distance, too afraid to approach yet unwilling to flee.

There were also quite a few gloating fellows cheering from the outer perimeter, lacking only the initiation of a field wager.

Fortunately, Ares Merchant had no intention of beating Remiel to death or crippling him. After pounding Remiel until he couldn't get back up, he sauntered off loftily, dragging his bone staff behind him.

From beginning to end, Ares Merchant hadn't spoken a single word to Remiel—not even a single syllable.

Strangely enough, Remiel didn't demand to know why Ares Merchant had attacked him either.

Seeing Ares Merchant depart, Doris hurried over to help up Remiel, whose nose and mouth were bleeding.

"Ares Merchant is too outrageous! Why did he beat you up out of the blue?" Doris asked anxiously.

Remiel snatched the handkerchief Doris offered to wipe his bloody nose, wiped his mouth and nose forcefully, and said in an extremely gloomy voice, "Raphael."

Ten minutes later, Remiel was seated inside a special suite at the Yimeng Pavilion.

While applying medicinal ointment to his injuries, the proprietress Eva disapproved as she spoke: "Ares Merchant is simply an unbridled madman. A fellow like that treats whoever he likes to the absolute extreme, without caring whether the other party can accept it. Look at the two Dudde brothers who used to have bad blood with Raphael, and the son of the wealthy merchant Ottergold—how miserably were they fixed? Lord Dudde and Ottergold both ran crying to their backer, the Queen, but did the Queen do anything to Ares Merchant?"

"No. Instead, both the Dudde family and the Ottergold family have started reining in their own juniors, keeping a very low profile in the royal city."

Seeing Remiel's ugly expression, Eva shook her head. "Raphael could have been your asset; he has a peaceful temperament, and as long as his bottom line isn't stepped on, he will endure whatever he can. But just because he can tolerate you doesn't mean that madman Ares Merchant will tolerate anyone bullying his lover."

"So Raphael is just a weak male who runs to his lover to complain that he's been bullied?" The corners of Remiel's mouth twitched into a sarcastic smirk, which immediately pulled at his wounds, making him wince and clutch his jaw in pain.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第150章 嚣张的阿瑞斯商 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
伊娃抓住他的手，挪开，重新上药，嘴里则不客气地骂：“你哪里看出来拉斐尔是个柔弱雄性？用你的妒忌吗？拉斐尔看起来不惹事，但这种老实人一旦发怒才是最可怕的。我跟你说过很多次，不要小瞧拉斐尔郎沐，也不要随意招惹他，你都忘了吗？”

雷米尔不说话。

伊娃叹气，放柔声音：“拉斐尔有没有和阿瑞斯商告状我不知道。但我知道以阿瑞斯商的能力，在这王城里，只要是他想知道的事，他就一定会知道。拉斐尔不说，也有一堆想要巴结阿瑞斯商的人，把拉斐尔的事情一一告诉他。”

“就凭他能做空间储物工具？”雷米尔明显不服。

伊娃眼中闪过一丝厉光，但她还是维持着温柔的语调说：“是的，就凭他能别人所不能。你有多么想要虎王的空间腰带，那么别人也会多么想要一个随身空间。”

雷米尔躲闪地说：“我没有……”

“你不用隐瞒我，你是我……最重要的宝贝，我知道你想要什么，我也会尽一切努力帮你达成愿望。不过在这之前，你得忍耐、得学会隐藏，更要好好学习虎王的做事方法。他那个人，当了这么多年国王，不算特别成功，但也绝对不算失败。”

“原本我希望你在他身边多留几年，多看多听，也能了解他最亲信的人都是谁。但既然你想出来历练，虎王也把你安排到了城卫军，那么你在城卫军锻炼自己也是不错的。”

伊娃语调更温柔，只眼中没有多少温度，但雷米尔没敢看她的眼睛，没看到。

“另外，你和王后身边侍女的首尾我已经帮你处理干净，以后别做这么……配不上你身份的事情。”

雷米尔猛地抬头：“是你！”

但随后他就疑惑道：“可克莱门特统领查出来就是内蒂动的手，怎么会……”和你有关？

伊娃微笑，对面前英俊的年轻雄性说：“那是你不知道爱情和妒忌的力量有多么强大。”

那个女人就是个被爱情迷了心魂的蠢货，被人在耳边刺激几句，就以为五公主真的要夺走雷米尔，因为害怕失去情人，也担心情人被伤害，就那么为爱情献身了。

就像是为了在恶龙口下拯救王子的平民女孩。

看到王后那惊恐和伤心的模样，真的让她心情特别愉快。

还有虎王……死了一个女儿也许不会让他真正伤心，但如果不止一个呢？

她真的很想看看在虎王心中一个柔弱无用只能依靠雄性、且让她死就只能去死的女兽人，却在最终掀翻他的国家时的表情。

“别想着去报复回来。”伊娃最后也没忘警告雷米尔：“如果你不能和拉斐尔好好合作，那就分开办事。别再给那个疯子找你麻烦的借口。”

雷米尔抿唇，也不知道是接受了这个警告，还是心中另有想法。

次日，阿瑞斯商揍了郎侦老伯爵的外孙、前虎王侍卫、现城卫军中尉雷米尔一事，就在王城传扬开了。

同样阿瑞斯商暴揍雷米尔的原因也被人们周知。

毕竟杜德家两兄弟和大商人獭金儿子的遭遇才刚过去没几天。

行吧，就因为这，过去曾经得罪、欺辱过拉斐尔的人，现在都变得心惶惶，就生怕阿瑞斯商那个欲求不满的疯子找上门来。

也因此有更多有志男女雄心勃勃满怀期望想要把阿瑞斯商的注意力从拉斐尔那里抢夺过来。要是能把这样的阿瑞斯商变成自己的情人，那得是多有面子的事啊！

不帅盯着满床打滚的小老虎：“……别想卖萌过关。你到底怎么想的？雷米尔会是被打一顿就老实的人吗？他只会更加仇视我、找我麻烦。”

小老虎停止打滚，趴在枕头上，抬起头：“我只是做了符合人设的事。如果阿瑞斯商知道你被欺负，却没有任何反应，那才叫奇怪。”

不帅：“……你其实就是想揍人。”

小老虎：“昂~”

不帅：“……谢谢。”

小老虎顿时一个飞扑扑进他怀里。

不帅就揣着这只小老虎去上班了。阿瑞斯商放狠话了，不让他陪，就得让小老虎陪着，否则他就……照着他弄到手的名单挨个打人去！

虎王也知道了雷米尔被揍一事，询问只是皮肉伤，就只是点点手指表示知道，其他任何多余表示都没有。

他更在意亲生子没错，但他在作为父亲之前更是一位国王。

他身边的人都知道他有多看重这次的传承分享大会，为此，这场由鬼火商会主持的、用来吸引和留住他国商人以及更多客人的春季材料展销大会，他也同样重视无比。

更不要说这种展销大会在虎国王城召开，可以为王城带来多少商业上的创收和税金收入。

这两笔钱哪一笔都不是小钱！

虎王不说要捧着这些商人，但也绝不希望他们心怀怨恨，更不想他们联合起来对付虎国。

拉斐尔的做法没问题，他调查归调查，但他足够尊重那些商人，也懂得该严厉时就严厉，该缓和时就缓和。

而且拉斐尔明显安排了两拨人，明线的一拨就是他，暗线的一拨则是特调局的其他调查员。拉斐尔在明面上吸引那些商人的注意力，其他调查员就能躲在暗中根据他们的反应展开探查。

可雷米尔不说配合拉斐尔的调查，还惹得那些商人抱怨不休。

虎王不在乎前者，但很在乎虎国在别国商人口中的口碑。他不希望其他国家的人提起虎国就是“一群野蛮人”的印象。

以前的虎王有野心，但野心并不算大，他想着能在传位前从大小贵族手中收回一半国土和税收权力就算成功。

但他（的手下）发现了图书馆，他见到了千年前的圣山祭司宫大祭司，他还是唯一掌握进出图书馆途径（引路人）的国王。

没有任何一个国王会放过这么好的机会。

就算他原本不是一个特别有野心的人，也会产生一些“我和虎国能否获得更多”的想法。

如果能成就一个伟大名声，如果能超越他的祖先，如果能让他这个国王在兽人的新历史记录中留下浓墨重彩的一笔，如果能让虎国变得更强大，他会不惜代价也要达成！

所以他认为办事没有达到他要求、还给他增添了一点麻烦的雷米尔需要一点小小的惩罚。

他出手会让雷米尔怨恨和伤心，由阿瑞斯商出手就正好。

反正那就是个做事肆无忌惮只图自己爽快的贵族纨绔，别说暴揍雷米尔，就是有王子招惹了他，信不信他也会照揍不误？

虎王当然不想王城里有人这么嚣张，但他暂时还不打算处理这个年轻的炼金大师，至少在传承分享大会召开之前，以及有人挖出对方炼制储物工具的秘密前，他不会对这个“大师”动手。

虎王起身，简单活动身体，看着外面阳光灿烂，让他心情很好。

虽然有些糟糕的事情发生，但大致的一切都还在他的掌握中，并按照他的预想在发展，这就很好。

容颜清丽的侍女捧着茶点姿态婀娜的走进来。
chunks.englishText:
Eva grabbed his hand, pulled it away, and reapplied the medicine while bluntly scolding, "Where on earth did you see that Raphael is a weak male? Through the lens of your jealousy? Raphael may look like he doesn't like trouble, but an honest person like that is the most terrifying when they finally lose their temper. I’ve told you many times not to underestimate Raphael Langmu, nor to provoke him casually. Have you forgotten all of it?"

Remiel remained silent.

Eva sighed, her voice softening. "Whether Raphael complained to Ares Shang, I don't know. But I know that with Ares Shang’s capability, in this royal city, as long as it's something he wants to know, he will inevitably find out. Even if Raphael doesn't say a word, there are plenty of people eager to curry favor with Ares Shang who would tell him everything about Raphael piece by piece."

"Just because he can make spatial storage tools?" Remiel was obviously unconvinced.

A flash of fierce light crossed Eva's eyes, but she maintained her gentle tone. "Yes, just because he can do what others cannot. How badly you desired the Tiger King's spatial belt is how badly others desire a portable spatial storage."

Remiel evaded her gaze. "I didn't..."

"You don't need to hide it from me. You are my... most precious treasure. I know what you want, and I will do everything in my power to help you achieve your wish. But before that, you must endure, learn to hide, and properly study the Tiger King's way of doing things. That man, having served as king for so many years, may not be exceptionally successful, but he is certainly not a failure either."

"Originally, I hoped you would stay by his side a few more years, to watch and listen more so you could understand who his most trusted confidants are. But since you wanted to go out and temper yourself, and the Tiger King also arranged for you to join the City Guard, training yourself in the City Guard is not a bad option either."

Eva’s tone grew even softer, though there was little warmth in her eyes. However, Remiel didn't dare look into her eyes, so he didn't see it.

"Also, the loose ends between you and the Queen’s chief handmaiden have already been cleaned up by me. Don't ever do anything so... unworthy of your status again."

Remiel jerked his head up. "It was you!"

Then, confusion filled his voice. "But Commander Clement investigated and found out it was Netty who did it. How could it..." Have anything to do with you?

Eva smiled, looking at the handsome young male before her. "That's because you don't know how powerful love and jealousy can be."

That woman was simply a fool intoxicated by love, easily incited by a few whispered words in her ear into thinking the Fifth Princess was truly going to rob her of Remiel. Fearing the loss of her lover and worrying that he might be harmed, she sacrificed herself for love.

Just like a commoner girl trying to save a prince from the jaws of a vicious dragon.

Seeing the Queen's terrified and heartbroken expression truly put her in a remarkably pleasant mood.

And the Tiger King... the death of a single daughter might not truly grieve him, but what if there were more than one?

She genuinely wanted to see the expression on the Tiger King's face when a female beastkin—one he deemed weak, useless, and entirely dependent on males, a tool who died the moment he ordered it—ultimately overthrew his nation.

"Don't even think about seeking revenge." In the end, Eva did not forget to warn Remiel. "If you cannot cooperate properly with Raphael, then handle things separately. Don't give that madman any more excuses to make trouble for you."

Remiel pressed his lips together, unsure whether he had accepted the warning or was harboring other thoughts of his own.

The next day, the news that Ares Shang had beaten up Count Langzhen's maternal grandson, former Tiger King guard, and current City Guard lieutenant Remiel spread like wildfire through the royal city.

Equally well-known to the public was the reason *why* Ares Shang had given Remiel such a brutal beating.

After all, only a few days had passed since the miserable encounters of the two Dude brothers and the wealthy merchant Tan Jin’s son.

Very well, because of this, anyone in the past who had ever offended or bullied Raphael now walked on eggshells, terrified that the insatiable madman Ares Shang would show up at their doorstep.

Consequently, even more ambitious males and females grew full of ambition and hope, eagerly plotting to steal Ares Shang's attention away from Raphael. To turn such an Ares Shang into one's own lover—what an immensely prestigious thing that would be!

Bu Shu stared at the little tiger rolling all over the bed. "...Don't think you can play cute to get away with this. What on earth are you thinking? Is Remiel the type of person to behave just because he got a beating? He's only going to resent me more and make more trouble for me."

The little tiger stopped rolling, lay flat on the pillow, and raised its head. "I just acted in accordance with my persona. If Ares Shang found out you were bullied and didn't react at all, *that* would be the strange part."

Bu Shu: "...You actually just wanted to beat someone up."

Little Tiger: "Ang~"

Bu Shu: "...Thank you."

With that, the little tiger launched itself into his arms in a flying leap.

Carrying this little tiger, Bu Shu went off to work. Ares Shang had laid down a harsh ultimatum: if Bu Shu wouldn't let him accompany him, the little tiger had to come along, or else he would... go down the list of names he had managed to dig up and beat them all up one by one!

The Tiger King also learned of Remiel being beaten. Upon inquiring and discovering it was merely superficial flesh wounds, he simply tapped his finger to indicate he was aware of it, making no other redundant gestures.

He cared about his biological children, true, but before being a father, he was a king.

Those around him knew how much he valued this upcoming Heritage Sharing Conference. For this very reason, he also attached supreme importance to this spring material exhibition and sales convention hosted by the Ghost Fire Chamber of Commerce, which was designed to attract and retain merchants from other kingdoms and even more visitors.

Not to mention how much commercial revenue and tax income such an exhibition and sales convention could bring to the royal city if held within its walls.

Neither of these two sums of money was a small amount!

The Tiger King had no intention of treating these merchants with overly pampered deference, but he certainly did not want them harboring resentment, nor did he want them uniting to target the Tiger Kingdom.

Raphael's approach was flawless. Investigation was investigation, but he showed enough respect to those merchants and understood when to be stern and when to soften.

Furthermore, Raphael had clearly arranged two sets of people: the overt line consisting of himself, and the covert line consisting of other investigators from the Special Investigation Bureau. With Raphael drawing the merchants' attention in broad daylight, the other investigators could lurk in the shadows and launch secret probes based on their reactions.

Yet Remiel not only failed to cooperate with Raphael's investigation, but also provoked endless complaints from the merchants.

The Tiger King didn't care about the former, but he cared deeply about the Tiger Kingdom's reputation in the mouths of merchants from other countries. He did not want people from other nations to associate the Tiger Kingdom with the impression of being "a bunch of savages."

The Tiger King of the past had ambition, but not an exceptionally grand one. He had thought that successfully reclaiming half of the national territory and tax authority from the major nobles before passing on the throne would constitute success.

However, he (and his subordinates) had discovered the library; he had met the High Priest of the Holy Mountain Priest Palace from a millennium ago, and he was the sole king who mastered the method of entering and exiting the library (the Guide).

No king in his right mind would ever let go of such a golden opportunity.

Even if he hadn't originally been a particularly ambitious person, he would still inevitably develop thoughts like, *"Can I and the Tiger Kingdom obtain even more?"*

If he could achieve great renown, if he could surpass his ancestors, if he could leave a heavily inked stroke in the new historical records of the beastkin as a king, if he could make the Tiger Kingdom even stronger—he would achieve it at any cost!

Therefore, he believed Remiel—who had failed to meet his standards of handling affairs and had instead added minor troubles to his plate—deserved a small punishment.

If he acted personally, it would cause Remiel resentment and heartbreak; having Ares Shang do it instead was simply perfect.

Besides, that fellow was an unbridled, arrogant noble playboy who only cared about his own gratification. Not to mention beating up Remiel, if a prince had provoked him, would anyone doubt that he would beat the prince up just the same?

Of course the Tiger King didn't want someone in the royal city acting so flagrantly arrogant, but he had no intention of dealing with this young alchemy master just yet—at least not before the Heritage Sharing Conference was held, and before someone excavated the secret of how the other party crafted spatial storage tools.

The Tiger King stood up, stretched his body briefly, and looked at the brilliant sunshine outside, which put him in a very good mood.

Although some troublesome events had occurred, the general trajectory of everything remained within his control and was developing according to his expectations, which was splendid.

A handmaiden with delicate, exquisite features walked in gracefully, holding tea and pastries.

虽然小老虎很想天天黏在他家不帅宝贝身上，但他也有他的事情要做。

4月最后一天，就在阿瑞斯商再一次和王后手下负责处理丹顿家族部分财产的管事见面时，身在材料市场仓库区，挨个检查仓库存储情况的不帅被一名搬货的兽人撞了一下。

chunks.chapterTitle: 第151章 见面与新的疑问 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第151章 见面与新的疑问

夜晚，位于城东区商业街边缘的一家小酒馆。

酒馆背面就是城卫军东营区所在，很多城卫军在下班后会直接通过后门进入酒馆，这里几乎也成了城卫军放松的驻扎地之一。

不帅戴着一顶遮掩兽耳的带檐软帽，单肩背着一个兽皮包，走进这家他从没有来过的酒馆。

酒馆内很嘈杂，一群糙汉子糙妹子在一起喝酒吹牛打屁，上了年纪的招待不耐烦地送上酒水食物，偶尔还要制止几个闹腾过头的家伙。

酒馆最中间还有一个擂台，里面正有两个兽人赤膊着上身在打斗，周围一群挥舞着赌票看热闹叫好叫骂的人。

不帅避开醉醺醺的酒鬼们，走到吧台，对正在忙碌的酒保喊了一声。

头发花白、身材却异常壮硕的半老酒保走过来，简单打量不帅：“第一次来？想喝什么？第一杯我请客。”

“谢谢，您是店主？”

“嗯哼。”

不帅掏出一张巴掌大的硬纸片推到酒保面前。

硬纸片上印着酒馆的名字和一个冒着火焰的酒桶，背面还有一个看起来有点特殊的标记。

这家酒馆就叫烈焰酒馆。

酒保垂眸看了一眼纸片，示意不帅收起纸片，冲着厨房里面大吼一声：“老丁！有人来买烈焰酒，带他去地窖拿货。”

厨房里探出一颗长角的羊脑袋。

酒保打开隔板，让不帅进厨房。

吧台有客人注意到这一幕，但也没有多少人在意，这家酒馆最有名的就是烈焰酒，经常有人慕名来买。

但只有酒馆自己人才知道，买烈焰酒很正常，但让老丁带路就不正常了。

不帅跟在羊脑袋的老丁身后从厨房的角落踩着阶梯进入地窖。

酒馆地下的地窖丝毫不逼仄，层高足有四米，里面堆满了酒桶酒坛，绕过这些酒桶酒坛，里面竟然还有几个隔间。

从隔间透出的灯光来看，里面都有人。

“这里可是我们的贵客包间。”老丁伸手。

不帅一愣，随即反应过来，把硬纸片递给老丁。

老丁接过，瞄了一眼上面的标记，直接揣进口袋，然后径直走向左侧尽头的房间，不轻不重地敲了敲门：“老丁，客人到了。”

包间门打开，老丁侧身。

不帅走进包间。

门从外面被带上。

不帅取下软帽，看向正面对面坐在石桌边的两位客人。

都是他认识的人。

郎侦老伯爵和他曾经的上司侍卫统领克莱门特。

看到郎侦老伯爵，不帅不惊讶。

但他没想到克莱门特竟然也来了。

克莱门特笑，对不帅招手：“别发呆了，过来坐。”

不帅背在胸前的包裹内部有东西蠕动，一只小老虎脑袋从袋口钻出。

郎侦老伯爵眯眼：“这是你收-养的那个幼崽？”

不帅：“……他闹着来，我就带他来了，你们不用管他。”

小老虎：“昂~！”

郎侦老伯爵瞅瞅这只虎崽子，很想伸手把他从不帅的怀里拎出来。

不帅在桌子外侧这边坐下，顺手把单肩背包取下，抱住。

小老虎扒拉袋口，想要从背包里出来，被不帅按住。

小老虎张嘴咬不帅的虎口，但他的小乳牙显然没使劲。

“你自己都还是孩子，养什么小崽子。”郎侦老伯爵的眼里有不赞成，但也有一丝纵容的笑意。

不帅尴尬，他没想到自己这么大了还能被人当孩子。

也许在家人长辈眼中，后辈不管年龄长到多大，都还是个孩子吧。

“不知两位约我过来是为了？”不帅装糊涂，主要也是他搞不明白克莱门特统领为什么也在场。

克莱门特看向老伯爵。

老伯爵把面前的酒杯推开，两手交握：“克莱门特曾经和我的女儿郎飞共事，他差点就娶了小飞。但小飞只把他当哥们看，最后她为了躲避克莱门特的追求，就选择了卡内家的泽沐尔。”

克莱门特神情正常，甚至还笑了笑。

不帅下意识问：“虎王不知道这件事？”

克莱门特回答：“他并不关心下属这种感情上的事，加上我的表达比较内敛，且当时我只是侍卫营中一名普通小队长。郎飞也是个非常果断的人，她发现我对她有意思，而她对我没意思后，就火速和她感觉来电的泽沐尔发展成情侣关系。侍卫营中就没有几个人知道我喜欢过郎飞。”

克莱门特还夸赞：“郎飞本可以吊着我，但她没有。她说我就是她哥，如果她和我暧昧，感觉就像乱-伦。”

小老虎咧嘴。

“但小飞答应克莱门特，说将来她生了第一个孩子，不管雄雌，都会许给他做伴侣。”老伯爵说。

啥？！小老虎震惊地抬起头。

不帅也有点傻眼。

克莱门特轻笑：“有那么惊讶么，我们兽人好歹也能活两三百岁，年龄相差百来岁的夫妻也很常见。小飞结婚很早，如果她愿意早早生孩子，那孩子和我的年龄相差也不会太大。”

“再说，她只是这么允诺，不代表将来她的孩子一定会喜欢我，我也不一定会喜欢上她的孩子，所以这只是一个朋友间的玩笑式承诺。”

不帅吐了一口气。

小老虎也放松地重新把脑袋搭在不帅的手上，但他的眼睛仍旧紧紧盯着克莱门特。他要看透这个男人，马上！

克莱门特指着小老虎对老伯爵说：“看，护食的来了。”

老伯爵大笑。

不帅干咳：“两位特意跟我提这事的意思是？”

这次是克莱门特先开口：“因为这个约定，在郎飞怀孕后，我把家族传下来的一个宝物借给她使用。”

老伯爵接口：“当时我和小飞母亲以及泽沐尔那孩子也在场，因为这个宝物的作用有点特殊，使用起来也需要一定技术，所以克莱门特和小飞没有隐瞒我们。”

克莱门特：“这个宝物没有名字，但因为它的外表看起来有点像心脏，我家祖先就习惯叫它心之果。”

“心之果？一种果物？”不帅好奇。

小老虎一听这个名字，脑中就冒出一个奇妙的预感。

克莱门特点头，但随后又摇头：“我们也不知道它到底是什么，但不管是它的外表还是捏上去的手感都很像是果物，可我们家人已经持有它很多很多年，它一直都没有腐坏，看起来还是那么新鲜。”

“难道这么长时间，你们家人就没有人想要吃掉它吗？”不帅问。

“当然。但是这东西并不是谁都能吃。实际上我家祖先在得到这枚心之果后，第一时间就把它吞吃了。之所以是吞吃，只因为这看起来像水果的心之果完全咬不动。”

克莱门特摊手：“然后我那位祖先在吃掉果子的第二天，就发现胸口结出了一枚果子。也就是那枚心之果，它自己又跑出来了。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 151: Meeting and New Doubts

At night, in a small tavern situated on the edge of the East District commercial street.

Directly behind the tavern was the East Camp area of the City Guard. Many City Guards would head straight through the back door into the tavern after getting off work, turning this place into practically one of the garrison's relaxation hubs.

Bu Shu wore a brimmed soft cap that concealed his beastkin ears, a hide bag slung over one shoulder, as he walked into this tavern he had never visited before.

The tavern was noisy. A group of rough-hewn male and female toughs sat together drinking, boasting, and shooting the breeze, while an elderly, impatient waiter bustled about serving drinks and food, occasionally having to stop a few individuals who were getting too rowdy.

Right in the middle of the tavern was a fighting ring, inside of which two shirtless beastkins were brawling while surrounded by a crowd waving betting slips, cheering, and jeering.

Avoiding the drunken revellers, Bu Shu walked up to the bar and called out to the busy bartender.

The white-haired, exceptionally robust middle-aged bartender walked over and gave Bu Shu a brief, appraising look. "First time here? What would you like to drink? Your first cup is on the house."

"Thanks. Are you the owner?"

"Mmhmm."

Bu Shu took out a palm-sized piece of hard paper and pushed it across the counter toward the bartender.

Imprinted on the hard paper was the tavern's name along with a flaming beer keg, and on the back was a rather peculiar-looking mark.

The tavern was called the Blazing Tavern.

The bartender lowered his gaze to glance at the slip, motioned for Bu Shu to put it away, and roared toward the kitchen, "Old Ding! Someone's here to buy Blazing Wine. Take him to the cellar to fetch the goods."

A horned sheep’s head poked out from the kitchen.

The bartender lifted the counter flap and let Bu Shu enter the kitchen.

Some customers at the bar noticed the scene, but few paid it any mind. The tavern's most famous item was its Blazing Wine, and people frequently came to buy it by reputation.

However, only the tavern's own insiders knew that while buying Blazing Wine was normal, having Old Ding personally lead the way was anything but normal.

Following behind the horned Old Ding, Bu Shu descended the stairs from a corner of the kitchen down into the cellar.

The underground cellar was not cramped at all; the ceiling clearance was a full four meters high, and it was piled high with wine barrels and jars. Weaving around these barrels and jars, one could even see several partitioned rooms further inside.

Judging from the light spilling out from the gaps in the partitions, there were people inside them.

"This here is our VIP private room area." Old Ding gestured outward.

Bu Shu froze, then reacted quickly and handed the hard paper over to Old Ding.

Old Ding took it, glanced at the mark on the back, tucked it straight into his pocket, and walked directly toward the room at the far left end. He gave the door a moderate rap. "Old Ding. The guest has arrived."

The private room door opened, and Old Ding stepped aside.

Bu Shu stepped into the private room.

The door clicked shut behind him.

Bu Shu removed his soft cap and looked at the two guests sitting face-to-face by a stone table.

Both were people he knew.

Old Count Langzhen and his former superior, Guard Commander Clement.

Seeing Old Count Langzhen did not surprise Bu Shu.

What he hadn't expected, however, was that Commander Clement was here as well.

Clement smiled and waved at Bu Shu. "Stop daydreaming, come sit."

Inside the pouch slung across Bu Shu's chest, something squirmed, and a little tiger's head poked out from the opening.

Old Count Langzhen narrowed his eyes. "Is this the cub you adopted?"

Bu Shu: "...He made a fuss to come, so I brought him along. You guys can ignore him."

Little Tiger: "Ang~!"

Old Count Langzhen eyed the tiger cub, clearly itching to reach out and yank him straight out of Bu Shu's embrace.

Bu Shu sat down on the outer side of the table, casually took off his single-strap shoulder bag, and held it in his arms.

The little tiger clawed at the bag's opening, trying to emerge, but Bu Shu pressed him back down.

The little tiger opened his mouth and bit down on the webbing between Bu Shu's thumb and forefinger, though his little milk teeth clearly weren't exerting any real force.

"You're still a child yourself, what are you doing raising a little cub?" There was disapproval in Old Count Langzhen's eyes, but also a trace of indulgent amusement.

Bu Shu felt awkward; he hadn't expected that even at his age, he could still be viewed as a child.

Perhaps in the eyes of family and elders, no matter how old the younger generation grew, they would always remain children.

"I wonder why the two of you asked me to come here?" Bu Shu played dumb, largely because he couldn't figure out why Commander Clement was in attendance.

Clement looked toward the old count.

The old count pushed his wine cup aside and clasped his hands together. "Clement used to work with my daughter, Langfei, and he almost married Xiao Fei. But Xiao Fei only ever saw him as a buddy, and in the end, to escape Clement's pursuit, she chose Zemuer of the Kanai family."

Clement's expression remained completely normal, and he even chuckled.

Bu Shu instinctively asked, "The Tiger King didn't know about this?"

Clement replied, "He doesn't care about such romantic matters among his subordinates. Besides, my expression of affection was relatively restrained, and at the time I was just an ordinary squad leader in the Guard Camp. Langfei was also a very decisive person; the moment she realized I had feelings for her and she didn't reciprocate, she swiftly developed a romantic relationship with Zemuer, whom she felt a spark with. Very few people in the Guard Camp even knew I had ever liked Langfei."

Clement added in praise, "Langfei could have strung me along, but she didn't. She said I was like her brother, and if she engaged in ambiguity with me, it would feel like incest."

The little tiger grinned.

"However, Xiao Fei promised Clement that her firstborn child in the future, male or female, would be betrothed to him as a partner," the old count said.

*What?!* The little tiger lifted his head in shock.
