Chapter 159: Memory Regression (Part 2)

Filled with swirling doubts, Anita got up and paced around the room, yet she found nothing out of the ordinary.

*It was just a dream,* Anita consoled herself.

It was probably because the news of her secret meeting with Remil had leaked out, making her worry that Remil’s true lineage would be exposed too quickly. That anxiety must have subconsciously drawn her thoughts to Raphael, and consequently to that long-ago scene.

What you think about by day, you dream about by night. That must have been why she had such a dream.

Yet, why was her heart feeling so unnerved?

Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan walked out of the Golden Creek Manor in complete silence, neither of them speaking a word all the way back, as if both were lost in deep thought.

Shang Feifan exercised patience and refrained from questioning him.

It wasn't until the two returned to Bu Shuai’s small lounge at the Special Investigation Bureau that Shang Feifan finally spoke.

"What did you experience during the empathy link?" Shang Feifan asked impatiently.

The magic Bu Shuai had cast allowed him to share the dreamscape with the caster—in essence, browsing through specific memory fragments together.

Having seemingly finally digested that chunk of memories, Bu Shuai recounted everything he had seen and heard in complete detail.

After listening, Shang Feifan concluded: "So there was no summoning magic at all? And Anita didn't put the Stone Ear into the original host's body to save his life; rather, the Stone Ear automatically embedded itself into the original host's heart?"

Bu Shuai nodded. "That's exactly how it happened."

Shang Feifan looked astonished. "Doesn't that mean... you transmigrated here entirely under your own power?"

What Bu Shuai had been pondering the most was precisely this point. "Yeah, it seems I really did transmigrate on my own. Probably right during that brief window when Anita dug out the original host's heart, and the heart flew right back into his chest?"

Sensing something amiss, Shang Feifan tapped his forehead in thought. "Anita used the Oblivion Draught on the original host. Does this kind of oblivion potion wipe away basic life common sense as well? Does it turn the drugged victim into something like an infant?"

Bu Shuai said uncertainly, "It shouldn't affect instinctual behaviors, right? Erasing memories from the brain doesn't mean wiping out bodily muscle memory entirely."

Shang Feifan analyzed it layer by layer: "Let's assume this oblivion potion left the original host's mind blank—not in the sense of turning him into an idiot, as he would still retain basic living capabilities, but simply wiping away familiar people, things, events, and learned knowledge. That explains why Anita gave you such a bizarre look when she saw you wake up.

Even though you didn't know the common knowledge of the Beastman Continent, your behavior was nothing like that of someone with total amnesia. You were simply a stranger to this world."

Bu Shuai nodded. "When I first woke up and realized I had been transported to a different place, I wanted to fake amnesia. But no matter how well I acted, it was still different from true amnesia. Especially since I wasn't a little child; my words and actions made it hard to truly pull off the persona of a youth. Madam Anita must have spotted my anomalies."

Shang Feifan continued: "Anita realized the original host likely had a different soul inhabiting him. She might have panicked, felt terrified, and worried at first, but when she saw that you harbored no malice and possessed a calm, easygoing personality, her heart gradually settled. She even started trying to control you, making you work for her."

Bu Shuai nodded again. "Around the time I first arrived, Madam Anita indeed kept her distance from me, only observing me from the shadows. She only started approaching me later on, teaching me the common knowledge of this world."

"Did she tell you with her own mouth that she used a secret technique to summon your soul?" Shang Feifan asked.

"No, she said she cast a secret technique to recall Raphael's soul," Bu Shuai replied.

Shang Feifan thought for a moment. "That must correspond to the explanation she gave the servant about performing a secret technique. She needed to give an account to the Tiger King, who rushed over to check on you, regarding why she cast a secret technique on you. The excuse was likely that she noticed you hadn't woken up because your soul had flown away, and she needed to summon your soul back."

Bu Shuai smiled slightly. "Such things sound bizarre, but they're actually quite common back on Earth. Many old folks still believe a child's soul can be frightened out of them, requiring someone to take the child's worn clothes and run outside calling their name to summon the soul back. There are many similar soul-calling methods. I suppose such things are common in this beastman world as well."

Shang Feifan immediately connected the dots. "So this so-called soul-summoning secret technique wasn't some scandalous taboo; it's likely something many beastmen know. That's why Anita dared to speak so openly about casting a soul-recalling secret technique to the Tiger King."

Bu Shuai hummed in agreement. "It should be just like that."

One mystery had been unraveled, and they now knew the true reason behind Bu Shuai’s arrival in this world. Yet, Shang Feifan still felt something was off.

"Though a person dies once their heart is removed, the time between the original host's heart leaving his body and returning to it was extremely short. According to what you described, it was probably around a minute. In such a short span of time, would the original host's soul really have vanished? Is it possible..."

"What possibility?" Bu Shuai looked up.

Shang Feifan made a bold hypothesis: "Is it possible that you were Raphael to begin with?"

"Huh?" Bu Shuai was shocked. "How could that be?"

"Why couldn't it? Compared to you reincarnating across three lifetimes with complete memories intact, I think it's far more likely that in this life, your memories of your past two lives were sealed, and you were born purely as an infant. You weren't supposed to recover your memories, but through a twist of fate, you integrated the Heart Fruit, and then someone stabbed you in the chest. The Heart Fruit merged with your heart, saving your life while likely triggering other effects as well.

Didn't Clement say your injuries had already healed, yet you simply delayed waking up? Perhaps the time you spent unable to wake up was precisely the period when your past two lives' memories began to awaken under the influence of the Heart Fruit, merging with your current memories.

If Anita hadn't done anything extra to you, you probably would have woken up after resting for a few days, recalling the complete memories of all three lifetimes.

However, in order to reclaim the Stone Ear—and likely coveting your heart as well—Anita made a move on you. That interrupted your memory fusion process. To make matters worse, Anita used the Oblivion Draught on you. Thus, when you woke up after your heart returned to your chest, you became someone who had lost Raphael's memories."

The more Shang Feifan spoke, the more he felt this possibility was extremely high. "So you didn't transmigrate the moment your heart was put back; you were Raphael from the start! It's just that Anita's meddling caused you to lose your memories as Raphael!

This also explains why you could inherit partial memories of Raphael—because you *are* Raphael. Even if your memories were erased, having crossed through three lifetimes, your spiritual power is far stronger than an ordinary person's. The oblivion potion only erased the memories stored in your hippocampus; it couldn't erase the memories deeply embedded in your soul."

Bu Shuai was almost persuaded by Shang Feifan's reasoning and opened his mouth to say something.

Shang Feifan’s eyes lit up. "Actually, if we want to know whether our guess is accurate, we just need to compare the timeline of the Fadel Continent with that of the Beastman Continent. If the time you blew yourself up coincided precisely with the period when Raphael was being conceived, you're most likely a womb-transmigrator."

However, Shang Feifan quickly grew troubled. "But how are we supposed to compare the timelines of the Fadel Continent and the Beastman Continent? Are we supposed to leave this question unanswered until we find a passage leading to Fadel?"

Bu Shuai smiled. "It doesn't need to be that troublesome. I have a much more efficient and accurate method of verification."

"What method?"

"If I really am a womb-transmigrator, if my soul genuinely holds the original host's memories and my soul is undamaged, then I only need to cast a soul memory regression magic on myself. There's a very high probability it will allow me to recall my forgotten memories."

Shang Feifan was excited. "There's magic that convenient? Hurry up and cast it on yourself then. I have a strong feeling you really are the original Raphael!"

Unlike Shang Feifan, however, Bu Shuai didn't look happy. In truth... he didn't particularly want to be the original host.

Because that would mean he would have to shoulder all of the original host's grievances, hatreds, and complex entanglements, making his relationship with the Tiger King and Anita infinitely more complicated.

Human emotions weren't a Twister game where you could spin your limbs however you liked.

chunks.chineseText:
他不是想要逃避责任，他只是……

作为一个原本只抱着纯打工心态的打工仔，突然被告知他不是替身演员，甚至连演员都不是，而是原本就是本尊，他的生活也不是舞台剧，而是原生本身，就问这谁能马上就适应过来？

“阿沐？”商非凡看出了不帅的迟疑。

不帅被这声呼唤叫得下定了决心。

有些事躲着也没用，与其拖延，还不如尽快面对。

不帅还算慎重地对商非凡委托：“帮我护法。这个魔法施展后，期间不能受到任何打扰，否则……严重的话有可能会损伤灵魂，甚至造成记忆缺失。”

商非凡也立刻认真起来：“你放心，我会守着你，不会让任何人事物打搅到你。”

商非凡很绝，直接在不帅周围布置了一个诅咒阵。谁敢在不帅施法期间硬闯进来惊扰到不帅，谁就会被诅咒之神收走灵魂。

除了诅咒阵，商非凡还释放出大量怨气，把整个小休息室包裹起来。

如此一来，谁想接近小休息室都会先被怨气攻击。

不帅见商非凡准备周全，他也就不浪费自己的魔力，专心对自己施展起针对灵魂的记忆回溯魔法。

过去的记忆如流水一般从不帅脑中流淌而过。

在魔法的效用加成下，过去被遗忘的记忆全都重新浮现。

第一世，他作为郎沐，哇哇诞生，他第一次听到声音，他第一次睁开眼睛……

第二世，他莫名其妙魂穿到一名刚刚死亡的少年身上，磕磕绊绊地在法德尔大陆开始新的人生……

第三世……

不帅在心中叹了口气，他竟然真的就是原身。

而且他应该是在拉斐尔郎沐的大脑发育期间就已经有了比较清醒的意识，但他的整体意识一直在沉睡中，只模糊地接收到外界一些信息。

等到拉斐尔出生，他并没有唤醒过去两世的记忆，就如商非凡所说，他其实是作为一个崭新的存在，从头开始经历新的人生。

这时候的他，并不是郎沐，而就是拉斐尔。

不过他的灵魂多少还是影响到拉斐尔，让拉斐尔从小就是个乖巧性子，听话不闹腾，也很少发小脾气，属于非常好带的那种乖孩子。

同时也因为他两世灵魂力量的影响，小小的拉斐尔在知道自己是虎王的私生子后，虽然偷偷高兴，但并没有飘起来，更没有觉得自己自此就高人一等什么的。他只是忍不住把这个秘密告诉了自己的好朋友。

只是好朋友出卖了他，把这个秘密告诉了其他人。

之后这个好友还成为了嘲笑他、讽刺他、甚至是背叛和迫害他的人。

如果不是他原本的灵魂力量，可能小拉斐尔就被四面八方狂涌而来的各种异样目光和大量负面议论给摧垮了。

可小拉斐尔还是变得自闭了许多，他不再往外面跑，也不再结交新的朋友，他把自己关在家里，美其名曰学习，实际上就是封闭了自己，不想和外界接触。

安妮塔似乎也乐得他如此。

可能因为他原本的乖巧性子，照顾他的人包括安妮塔在内，都没有发现他的内心和性格变化，没有人去开导小拉斐尔，就任由他这么自己委屈着自己。

不帅看着这样的小拉斐尔，忍不住心疼。

他看到小拉斐尔躲在被窝里偷偷哭泣。

看到小拉斐尔躲在窗户后面看着外面玩耍的孩童满心羡慕和向往，却又充满害怕和畏缩。

看到小拉斐尔盼着能见到虎王，希望虎王这个父亲能像其他幼崽的父亲一样抱着他，疼爱他，带他出门玩，带他买好吃的。

小拉斐尔奇怪地对安妮塔并没有特别的期待，他对安妮塔更多的是敬畏，而不是孺慕。

也许他的灵魂力影响了小拉斐尔，让他天生敏感，小拉斐尔本能地知道谁真的爱他，谁又只是做做样子。

在小拉斐尔心中，偶尔才会出现一次的虎王要比安妮塔更喜欢他，也更关心他得多。

最后，他看到小拉斐尔收到过去好友的信件，花了很长时间才再次鼓起勇气决定面对这份已经损毁的友情，打开窗户，偷偷跳了出去。

就在小拉斐尔赶到约定地点，等待獭德出现时，丰收祭花车出现，大量奇装异服的人群跟在花车后面，人们载歌载舞，所过之处满城欢腾。

小拉斐尔的注意力被花车和游-行队伍吸引。

一名身穿黑色长袍的人接近他，一刀插-入他的胸口，还转了一圈。

小拉斐尔被剧痛袭击，人疼到喊不出任何声音。

那名杀手突然转头，撩起兜帽，画着油彩的扭曲的脸对准了小拉斐尔的眼睛，最可怖的是，那杀手的眼睛竟然腐烂了。

邪神信徒！

不帅看到刺杀者的第一眼，脑中就下意识地冒出了这个想法。

小拉斐尔惊恐到极点，手指抓着插-入心脏的匕首，缓缓倒下。

一只手接住小拉斐尔，捂着他的嘴把他裹挟到路边，让他靠坐在路边，就像是玩累了坐在街角休息的模样。

这一切都发生得很快，整个过程可能都不到三五秒。

……随着记忆回溯，属于小拉斐尔的记忆一点点融入他的记忆。

逐渐的，那种第三者旁观他人人生的感觉越来越浅淡，替而代之的是他开始想拉斐尔所想、思拉斐尔所思，连着自己的心脏和灵魂都在为小拉斐尔的记忆而痛苦和难受。

他的三世好像都过得不怎么愉快呢。

此时的不帅整个人都被浓郁的阴霾笼罩。

记忆回溯魔法结束了，不帅静静地坐在那里，久久没有说话。

一只强韧的手臂突然把他拉入怀中，紧紧抱住了他。

这个拥抱非常紧，几乎让他窒息。

但不帅却感到快要把他拉入深渊的浓重抑郁正一点点远离他而去。

有人在帮他驱逐那些负面能量。

有人正在用自己火热的胸膛和浓郁的爱，唤回他。

拥抱慢慢放松，一只大手轻轻拍抚他的后背。

他甚至听到有人在耳边哼唱着一首民谣。

The Hanging Tree。

不帅慢慢闭上眼睛，像个孩子一样缩在商非凡的怀抱里。

他的三世人生很操-蛋，但他遇到了这个人，只希望……这不是一场梦，更不是一场新的痛苦开端。
chunks.englishText:
He wasn't trying to shirk responsibility; he was simply...

As an ordinary wage slave who had originally held a purely "clock-in, clock-out" mentality, suddenly being told that he wasn't a stunt double—not even an actor at all, but the actual original person himself, and that his life wasn't a stage play but raw reality—well, let's ask anyone: who could adapt to that right away?

"Ah-Mu?" Shang Feifan noticed Bu Shuai's hesitation.

Bu Shuai made up his mind at this call.

Some things were useless to hide from. Rather than dragging it out, it was better to face it as soon as possible.

Bu Shuai gave Shang Feifan a rather cautious commission: "Help me guard the perimeter. Once this magic is cast, I cannot be disturbed by anything during the process. Otherwise... in a severe case, it could damage my soul or even cause memory loss."

Shang Feifan immediately turned serious as well: "Rest assured, I'll watch over you. I won't let a single person or thing disturb you."

Shang Feifan was ruthless. He directly set up a cursing array around Bu Shuai. Anyone who dared to forcibly break in and disturb Bu Shuai during his spellcasting would have their soul reaped by the God of Curses.

Aside from the cursing array, Shang Feifan also released a massive amount of resentment, wrapping up the entire small lounge.

That way, anyone wanting to approach the lounge would first be attacked by the resentment.

Seeing that Shang Feifan had made thorough preparations, Bu Shuai stopped wasting his own magic power and concentrated on casting the memory-retrieval magic targeting his soul.

Past memories flowed through Bu Shuai's mind like running water.

Under the additive effect of the magic, all the forgotten memories of the past resurfaced.

In his first life, as Lang Mu, he wailed as he was born. He heard sound for the first time, he opened his eyes for the first time...

In his second life, his soul inexplicably transmigrated into a young man who had just died, stumbling his way to start a new life on the Fader Continent...

In his third life...

Bu Shuai sighed inwardly. He really was the original body after all.

Moreover, he should have gained a relatively lucid consciousness during the embryonic development of Raphael Lang Mu, but his overall consciousness had remained in a dormant state, only vaguely receiving some external information.

By the time Raphael was born, he hadn't awakened the memories of his past two lives. Just as Shang Feifan had said, he had actually started experiencing a brand-new life from scratch as a completely fresh existence.

At that time, he wasn't Lang Mu; he was simply Raphael.

However, his soul had still influenced Raphael to some extent, making Raphael a well-behaved child from a young age—obedient, non-disruptive, and rarely throwing tantrums. He belonged to the category of very easy-to-raise "good kids."

At the same time, influenced by his soul power from two lifetimes, little Raphael, upon learning that he was the Tiger King's illegitimate son, felt a secret joy but didn't let it go to his head, nor did he feel superior to others in any way. He simply couldn't help sharing this secret with his good friend.

Yet that good friend betrayed him, spilling the secret to others.

Later on, that same friend became the person who mocked him, satirized him, and even betrayed and persecuted him.

If not for his original soul power, little Raphael might have been crushed by the all-encompassing, surging torrents of strange looks and massive negative gossip.

Even so, little Raphael became a lot more reclusive. He stopped running outside, stopped making new friends, and locked himself at home. Under the polite guise of studying, he effectively sealed himself off, unwilling to have any contact with the outside world.

Anita seemed quite content with him being this way.

Perhaps due to his naturally well-behaved temperament, the people caring for him, including Anita, failed to notice the changes in his inner world and personality. No one tried to guide or counsel little Raphael, leaving him to suffer alone in silence.

Looking at little Raphael like this, Bu Shuai couldn't help feeling a pang of heartache.

He saw little Raphael hiding under the covers, crying in secret.

He saw little Raphael hiding behind a window, looking at the children playing outside with a heart full of yearning and longing, yet filled with fear and cowardice.

He saw little Raphael hoping to see the Tiger King, wishing that his father would hold him, pamper him, take him out to play, and buy him delicious treats just like the fathers of other cubs.

Strangely enough, little Raphael didn't hold any particular expectations for Anita. Toward Anita, he felt more awe and reverence rather than filial attachment and yearning.

Perhaps his soul power had influenced little Raphael, making him innately sensitive. Little Raphael instinctively knew who truly loved him and who was merely putting on a show.

In little Raphael's heart, the Tiger King—who only showed up on rare occasions—was much more fond of him and cared for him far more than Anita did.

Finally, he saw little Raphael receive a letter from his former friend. It took him a long time to muster up the courage once more to face this damaged friendship; he opened the window and quietly jumped out.

Just as little Raphael rushed to the agreed meeting place and waited for the appearance of the otter-kin, the Harvest Festival float appeared. A massive crowd in bizarre costumes followed behind the float, singing and dancing, the entire city erupting in jubilation wherever it passed.

Little Raphael's attention was caught by the float and the parade.

A figure in a long black robe approached him, drove a dagger straight into his chest, and twisted it.

A brutal pain struck little Raphael, hurting him so intensely he couldn't utter a single sound.

The assassin suddenly turned his head, pulling back his hood to reveal a distorted, oil-painted face inches from little Raphael's eyes. Most horrifyingly, the assassin's eyes were actually rotting away.

A cultist of the Evil God!

The very moment Bu Shuai laid eyes on the assassin, this thought instinctively popped into his mind.

Terrified to the extreme, little Raphael clutched the dagger buried in his heart and slowly collapsed.

A hand caught little Raphael, covered his mouth, and dragged him to the roadside, propping him up against the curb so he looked like a child resting on a street corner after getting tired of playing.

All of this happened very quickly, the entire process likely taking less than three to five seconds.

...As the memories regressed, the memories belonging to little Raphael gradually merged into his own.

Little by little, the detached feeling of a third party observing someone else's life grew fainter, replaced by him beginning to think Raphael's thoughts and ponder Raphael's reflections. Even his own heart and soul began to ache and suffer agonizingly over little Raphael's memories.

His three lifetimes really hadn't been very pleasant, had they?

At this moment, Bu Shuai was entirely enveloped in a thick, gloomy haze.

The memory-retrieval magic ended. Bu Shuai sat quietly there, remaining silent for a long, long time.

A strong pair of arms suddenly pulled him into an embrace, holding him tightly.

The embrace was intensely tight, almost suffocating him.

Yet Bu Shuai felt the heavy depression that had threatened to drag him into the abyss slowly receding bit by bit.

Someone was helping him purge those negative energies.

Someone was using a blazing chest and profound love to call him back.

The embrace slowly loosened, and a large hand gently patted and stroked his back.

He even heard someone softly humming a ballad by his ear:

*The Hanging Tree.*

Bu Shuai slowly closed his eyes, curling up like a child in Shang Feifan's arms.

His three lifetimes of existence had been utterly screwed up, but he had met this person. He only hoped... this wasn't a dream, and certainly not the beginning of a new torment.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第160章 八卦报第五期 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第160章 八卦报第五期

不帅站在伯爵府外深吸一口气。

原本他看郎家的两位老人只是把他们当做责任，可现在知道自己就是原身，两位老人也是他真正的血脉至亲，不帅反而有点情怯。

商非凡在他背后轻轻一推。

不帅转头看他一眼。

商非凡轻声说：“去吧，晚上我来接你。”

不帅点头，“晚上见。”

商非凡半点都不想和不帅分离，但不帅第一次正式回伯爵府探望两位老人，他这个外人跟着也不太好。

私心里，商非凡只希望不帅眼里心里都只有他。但昨天不帅的模样让他心疼坏了，他希望能多一些人，尤其是亲人，让不帅体会到亲情，让不帅体会到他被更多人爱着。

他见过老伯爵夫妇，原本那两位对还冠着虎王私生子名头的拉斐尔都怀有好感，如今知道拉斐尔才是他们的亲孙子，还不知道要怎么爱拉斐尔才好。

正好老伯爵昨晚又派人来催不帅过府和他们两老相聚，他就大力推了一把。

商非凡忽然贴近不帅耳边，小声说：“今晚回去你可要好好补偿我，昨晚我看你哭得可怜才放过你，下次你就别想有这样的好事了。”

不帅脸颊猛地爆红，想到昨晚的癫狂和崩溃，整个人顿时热得都快冒烟。

幸亏他是魔法师，可以对自己施展恢复魔法，否则今天他能否爬得起来都是一个问题。

商非凡看到不帅的神情，脑中浮想联翩，但也不敢多想，他怕自己起反应，就再次轻轻推了推不帅。

不帅的情怯被另一种强烈情绪替代，两种强烈情绪对冲下，反而让他迅速冷静下来。

不帅斜睨商非凡一眼，略微整理衣着，再无犹豫，大步向伯爵府大门走去。

伯爵府大门不等不帅靠近就唰地敞开。

看大门的仆人在看到拉斐尔郎沐刚出现时就飞快跑进去通知老伯爵夫妇。

管家听说拉斐尔少爷来了，当即就奔去大门口亲自拉开大门，要迎接少爷进府。

整个伯爵府喜气洋洋。

下仆们并不知道拉斐尔郎沐和伯爵府的真正关系，但伯爵府两位老主人和管家都高兴颠了，下仆自然也感受到这种期待与开心的气氛，在看到拉斐尔时，也跟着热情得不得了。

“拉斐尔来了？”老夫人听到亲外孙来了，兴奋地直接就从屋里往外奔。

“等等我！”老伯爵在后面都追不上。

管家把拉斐尔迎入大门，立刻让仆人紧锁大门，任何人来都不让进，除非得到老伯爷同意。

管家还叮嘱仆人，如果有人过来询问拉斐尔少爷是来干什么的，就说拉斐尔少爷有点事情想要请教老伯爷，具体什么事情，下人们也不知道。

不帅刚走入大门没几步，就看到飞奔而来的两位老人。

两老脸上激动的神情，期盼的目光，让不帅微微紧张。

“孩子，你受苦了！”老夫人第一个冲过来，一把抱住了不帅。

这时的老夫人哪还有半点病弱无力的样子。

“没有，还好。老夫人日安。”不帅声音微微沙哑，局促得不知道该说些什么。

“哎，你……”老夫人哽咽着没能说出第二句话，眼泪就流了出来。

亲手抱到这孩子，老夫人更加肯定，这才是她的亲孙孙，那种血脉相连的感觉是那么奇妙，这是她在雷米尔身上从没有体会过的。

雷米尔小时候也是一个可爱孩子。

老夫人不想对两个孩子进行对比，但她不得不承认，有血缘关系和没有血缘关系就是不一样。

听说远古兽人可以轻易分辨出自己的崽儿，压根不怕血脉混淆的问题。

但随着兽人文明不断发展，属于兽人的某些本能也不断萎缩乃至消失，就跟他们的血脉天赋一样，这不得不说是一件很可惜的事情。

老伯爵看着老妻和拉斐尔抱成一团。

老妻哭得眼泪汪汪，话都说不出来。拉斐尔也是眼睛通红，抬手轻轻反抱住老夫人。

老伯爵不想哭，但他忍不住鼻头发酸。

他可怜的小孙孙哦，这么多年遭了多少罪！

偏偏他不是完全不知情，只要一想到他曾经亲眼看到、听到拉斐尔遭遇到的那些事情，老伯爵就心脏纠疼得厉害。

他后悔极了。

如果他当年能稍微伸手帮帮拉斐尔，如果他能早点知道……

一想到这里，老伯爵心中的痛苦悔恨就被疯狂涌来的恨意给淹没。

他恨！

他从来没有这么恨过某些人！

虎王，安妮塔，你们想要保护你们的亲生孩子是你们的事，为什么要把我可怜的小孙孙给牵扯进来，让他做了这么多年的替身，还不肯好好对待他！

还有王后！

那个毒心肝又愚蠢的女人。

背叛你的人是你的丈夫，有种你去对付虎王去，为什么要对一个小孩子下手？

再不济，你也能把安妮塔干掉。

欺负一个小孩子，还不是因为拿小孩的父母没办法，只能在小孩身上撒气摆威风！

追根究底，如果没有王后贪心想要石耳导致安妮塔家破人亡，也不至于遭到安妮塔的报复。

如果不是王后不敢跟虎王真的杠上，也不至于连个虎王情-妇都不敢下手。

老伯爵原本还有点同情王后。他对老妻一心一意，自然看不上那些对待自己妻子三心二意的雄性，看到王后对付虎王私生子，虽然觉得那孩子可怜，但也觉得王后的做法情有可原。

可在知道所有事情的实情后，他对王后的同情全都没了，更快恨死她。

虎王、安妮塔、王后，这三个，他一个都不想放过！

“有什么话，我们进屋里说。在这里哭成一团像什么样子。”老伯爵自以为很有家主风范地说道，却不知他的声音有多么软。

管家站在不远处看着张开手臂抱住孙孙和老妻的老伯爷，笑出眼泪。

商非凡抬头看天，不帅就是原身这件事，让他的计划也有稍许变动。

帮他人报仇，和帮自己人报仇，那投入度也不一样啊。

他没有看到不帅作为小拉斐尔时的记忆，不帅不肯把这份记忆共感给他看。

但只从昨晚不帅那小自闭的模样就能看出，他作为小拉斐尔的童年和少年时期绝对称不上愉快。

商非凡只稍微了解到不帅的第一世遭遇，就恨到恨不得把郎沐的父亲和那个弟弟全都剁成肉酱。

没想到不帅的第二世和第三世遭遇也不遑第一世。

他家不帅这是得罪了哪路神仙吗？

还是他曾经做过什么惨绝人寰灭绝天地的大恶事，要让他几世轮回都受这么大罪。

商非凡再次想到不帅那诡异的气运值。

他之前一直以为不帅的气运值是在第二世被那个叫做洛伦米尔顿的魔法师给夺取，但现在他的想法有了一点改变。

他怀疑不帅的气运值很可能在第一世之前就出了问题。

如果真是这样，第一世之前的不帅又是谁？

商非凡脑中自然而然想到了自然之神。

“不帅和自然之神是什么关系？”商非凡低声问系统。

系统沉默。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 160: The Gossip Gazette, Issue 5

Bu Shuai stood outside the Earl's Mansion and took a deep breath.

Originally, when he looked at the two elderly members of the Lang family, he only treated them as a matter of responsibility. But now, knowing that he was the original person himself, and that the two elders were his true blood-related kin, Bu Shuai felt a sudden wave of timid stage fright.

Shang Feifan gave him a gentle nudge from behind.

Bu Shuai turned his head to glance at him.

Shang Feifan said softly, "Go on. I'll come pick you up tonight."

Bu Shuai nodded. "See you tonight."

Shang Feifan didn't want to part with Bu Shuai for even a second, but this was Bu Shuai's first formal return to the Earl's Mansion to visit the two elders, and it wouldn't be appropriate for him, an outsider, to tag along.

Secretly, Shang Feifan only wished Bu Shuai's eyes and heart held room for him alone. But the state Bu Shuai was in yesterday broke his heart, and he hoped that having more people—especially family—would let Bu Shuai experience familial warmth and feel that he was loved by many more.

He had met the old Count and his wife before. Originally, the two of them had felt a fondness for Raphael, who still bore the title of the Tiger King's illegitimate son. Now that they knew Raphael was their actual biological grandson, there was no telling how much affection they would shower upon him.

Coincidentally, the old Count had sent people once again last night to urge Bu Shuai to cross over to the manor and reunite with the two elders, so he had given him a strong push.

Shang Feifan suddenly leaned close to Bu Shuai's ear and whispered, "Tonight when you get back, you'd better properly make it up to me. Seeing how pitiful you looked crying last night made me let you off, but don't expect to have such good luck next time."

Bu Shuai's cheeks instantly flushed crimson. Recalling the madness and breakdown of the previous night, his entire body suddenly grew so hot it felt like it was about to smoke.

Fortunately, he was a mage and could cast recovery magic on himself; otherwise, whether he could even crawl out of bed today would have been a serious question.

Seeing Bu Shuai's expression, Shang Feifan's imagination ran wild, but he didn't dare let his thoughts wander too far for fear of a physical reaction, so he gave Bu Shuai another gentle nudge.

Bu Shuai's timid stage fright was replaced by another intense emotion. The clash of these two strong emotions quickly caused him to calm down.

Bu Shuai shot Shang Feifan a sidelong glance, slightly straightened his clothes, and without any further hesitation, strode toward the main gates of the Earl's Mansion.

Before Bu Shuai even approached, the gates of the Earl's Mansion swung wide open with a swish.

The gatekeeper had spotted Raphael Lang Mu appearing and immediately sprinted inside to notify the old Count and his wife.

Hearing that Young Master Raphael had arrived, the butler rushed straight to the front gates to open them personally, welcoming the young master into the mansion.

The entire Earl's Mansion was filled with a festive, joyous atmosphere.

The servants didn't know the true relationship between Raphael Lang Mu and the Earl's Mansion, but since the two elderly masters and the butler were so happy they were practically jumping for joy, the servants naturally caught that wave of expectant and cheerful mood. Upon seeing Raphael, they became immensely enthusiastic as well.

"Raphael is here?" Hearing that her true maternal grandson had arrived, the old Madam leaped up from her room and hurried outside in excitement.

"Wait for me!" The old Count couldn't even catch up from behind.

The butler welcomed Raphael through the front gates and immediately had the servants securely lock the main entrance, barring anyone from entering unless granted permission by the old Count.

The butler also instructed the servants that if anyone came inquiring about what Young Master Raphael was here for, they were to say that Young Master Raphael had some matters he wished to consult the old Count about, and as for the specific matters, the servants had no idea.

Just a few steps after walking through the gates, Bu Shuai saw the two elders rushing toward him.

The excited expressions on the faces of the old couple and their expectant gazes made Bu Shuai slightly nervous.

"Child, you've suffered!" The old Madam was the first to rush over, pulling Bu Shuai into a tight embrace.

At this moment, there was not a shred of frailty or weakness left about the old Madam.

"No, it's alright. Good day, Madam." Bu Shuai's voice was slightly raspy, feeling too awkward and flustered to know what to say.

"Ah, you..." The old Madam choked up, unable to utter a second word before tears began to stream down her face.

Holding this child in her own arms, the old Madam became even more certain that this was her real grandson. That feeling of being connected by blood was so miraculous—something she had never experienced with Remil.

Remil had also been a cute child when he was little.

The old Madam didn't want to compare the two children, but she had to admit that having blood ties and not having them were simply different.

She had heard that ancient Orcs could easily distinguish their own young, having zero worries about confused bloodlines.

However, as Orc civilization continued to develop, certain instincts belonging to Orcs had steadily atrophied and even vanished, much like their bloodline talents. One had to say, this was truly a regrettable matter.

The old Count watched his old wife and Raphael hugging into a ball.

His old wife was crying with tearful eyes, unable to speak. Raphael's eyes were also red-rimmed as he slowly raised his arms to hug the old Madam back.

The old Count didn't want to cry, but he couldn't help the stinging sensation in the bridge of his nose.

His poor little grandson! How much suffering had he endured all these years!

And yet he wasn't completely oblivious; the mere thought that he had once witnessed and heard about the things Raphael had suffered made the old Count's heart ache fiercely.

He regretted it to the extreme.

If only he had been able to reach out and help Raphael back then, if only he had known sooner...

At this thought, the pain and regret in the old Count's heart were instantly swallowed by a crazed surge of hatred.

He hated them!

He had never hated certain people this much before!

Tiger King, Anita—it was your own business if you wanted to protect your biological children, so why drag my poor little grandson into it, making him act as a substitute for all these years while still refusing to treat him well?

And the Queen!

That venomous-hearted and foolish woman.

The one who betrayed you was your husband; if you have the guts, go deal with the Tiger King. Why take it out on a little child?

At worst, you could have just wiped out Anita.

Bullying a little child—isn't it just because you couldn't do anything about the child's parents, so you could only vent your anger and put on airs on the child?

Tracing the root cause, if the Queen hadn't been greedy for the stone fungus and caused Anita's family to be ruined, Anita wouldn't have sought revenge.

If the Queen hadn't been too afraid to truly lock horns with the Tiger King, she wouldn't have lacked the courage to even lay a finger on a mistress of the Tiger King.

Originally, the old Count had felt a shred of sympathy for the Queen. Being devoted to his old wife, he naturally looked down upon males who were noncommittal toward their own wives. Seeing the Queen target the Tiger King's illegitimate son, though he felt the child was pitiful, he had also considered the Queen's actions somewhat understandable.

Yet now, knowing the truth of everything, his sympathy for the Queen was completely gone, quickly turning into a burning hatred that wished her dead.

The Tiger King, Anita, the Queen—he didn't want to let a single one of these three off!

"Whatever we have to say, let's talk inside the house. What kind of sight is this, crying in a huddle out here?" The old Count said, fancying himself quite the head of the household, unaware of just how soft his voice actually sounded.

Standing not far away, the butler watched the old Count—who had opened his arms to hug his grandson and his old wife—and laughed until tears came to his eyes.

Shang Feifan looked up at the sky. The fact that Bu Shuai was the original person caused a slight shift in his plans as well.

Helping others get revenge versus helping one's own people get revenge—the level of personal investment was entirely different.

He hadn't seen Bu Shuai's memories as little Raphael; Bu Shuai refused to share that memory empathy with him.

Yet just from Bu Shuai's mildly reclusive state last night, he could tell that his childhood and youth as little Raphael could by no means be called pleasant.

Shang Feifan had only learned a little about Bu Shuai's experiences in his first life, and it had filled him with a hatred so deep he wished he could hack Lang Mu's father and that younger brother into minced meat.

He hadn't expected Bu Shuai's experiences in his second and third lives to be any better than the first.

Just which deity had his Bu Shuai offended?

Or had he committed some earth-shattering, heaven-destroying heinous crime in the past, forcing him to suffer such immense torment across successive reincarnations?

Shang Feifan once again thought of Bu Shuai's bizarre fortune value.

He had previously assumed Bu Shuai's fortune value was stolen in his second life by a mage named Loren Milton, but now his thoughts had shifted slightly.

He suspected that something had likely gone wrong with Bu Shuai's fortune value even before his first life.

If that was truly the case, who exactly was Bu Shuai before his first life?

Naturally, the God of Nature popped into Shang Feifan's mind.

"What is the relationship between Bu Shuai and the God of Nature?" Shang Feifan asked the system in a low voice.

The system remained silent.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡了然：“我想知道不帅和自然之神的关系，要做什么任务？你直接发布就好。”

【请先完成已经发布的任务。】

“这是在玩抽丝剥茧的游戏吗？行吧，我知道了。”

商非凡激活右眼中的寻宝罗盘。

一个小小的金色罗盘出现在他的视界中。

“寻找自然之神失落的力量。”

寻宝罗盘中立刻跳出数个光点。

商非凡把寻宝罗盘中的光点位置和游戏地图功能结合，很容易就能看到这些光点分别散布在哪些位置。

不到半个小时，阿瑞斯商大摇大摆地来到一家高层人士俱乐部，拿着请柬。

他是来参加二王子召开的神秘学同好研究会。

这个研究会的会长就是二王子本人，据说这个研究会不轻易收入新会员，如有新会员目标，这个新会员必须得到一半以上老会员认可，才有可能收到研究会的邀请函。

阿瑞斯商凭借他能炼制空间道具这点，让这个研究会主动给他发了邀请函。

二王子早就想要接触阿瑞斯商，但他走的路子和其他王子公主不同，不好直接去找阿瑞斯商，就绕了个弯子。

阿瑞斯商接到入会邀请函后，回信表示会前来看看。

回信语气很拽，似乎完全没把二王子放在眼里，但这就是阿瑞斯商。想让他因为某人身份就变得谦虚有礼，那就是不可能的。

俱乐部内部布置得异常奢华舒适，里面侍候的仆人安静克制，整个俱乐部都听不到半点喧哗声。

一些看着就身份不一样的贵客要么坐在某处静静地看书，要么就坐着和三俩朋友喝茶聊天，说话声音都压得很低。

侍者引领阿瑞斯商，把他送到俱乐部地下一层。

这一层楼似乎都是神秘学同好研究会的地盘。

因为是神秘学，所以非要在地下吗？阿瑞斯商腹诽。

到了门口，侍者一句话不说，只轻轻敲了敲门，对阿瑞斯商做了个请的手势。

阿瑞斯商为这种作态翻了个白眼，提着骨杖，昂首走入敞开的大门。

门内有侍者上前，似乎要为阿瑞斯商宽衣。

阿瑞斯商直接用骨杖抵住那名侍者，让他距离自己远一点。

侍者弯身退下。

“阿瑞斯大师，日安，终于见到您了。”二王子亲自迎上前来，给足了阿瑞斯商面子。

阿瑞斯商右手握拳轻敲左边胸口，点头：“日安，二王子殿下。”

“快请进。大家基本都来了，就等你了。”二王子十分热情，招呼阿瑞斯商入座，并给他介绍研究会中的同好。

研究会中的人看着倒不全是权贵出身，有些人一看就是那种埋头做研究的学者，还有人看起来神经兮兮不修边幅，更有人全身都笼罩在黑袍中透出一股神秘气质。

在二王子的介绍下，这些人也纷纷过来跟阿瑞斯商打招呼。

当然，也不是所有人都会主动和阿瑞斯商说话，有人的表现就很冷漠。

阿瑞斯商对这些人有什么态度压根无所谓，他一眼就看到正在和人说话的天残谷主，眼睛放肆地盯着对方不放。

二王子看阿瑞斯商的注意力被天残谷主吸引，嘴角微微勾起一丝弧度，也不介意对方的走神。

天残谷主的俊美容颜确实很吸引人。他这个二王子的颜值也很高，但比起这位天残谷主还是差上几分。

况且这位阿瑞斯大师貌似男女通吃，听说这位对拉斐尔郎沐紧追不休，因为他的锲而不舍，已经让他成功走入拉斐尔的办公室。

虽然不知道阿瑞斯商有没有得手，但也不妨碍人家对第二个雄性感兴趣。

二王子介绍到天残谷主，先卖了一个关子：“阿瑞斯大师，您知道亡灵谷、活尸城吗？”

阿瑞斯商：“好像听过。”

二王子微笑，指着天残谷主说：“这位就是来自传说中的神秘活尸城。”

天残谷主顺势接话，笑着伸出手：“洛伦米尔顿，这一代的天残谷谷主。天残谷就是传说中的活尸城，外界把那里传扬的十分神秘，实际上毒雾纪之后，那里就是一个普通山谷，只有一群被人遗弃的天残生活在那里。”

呵，竟然还敢用这个名字，这是笃定兽人大陆没人认识你是吧？阿瑞斯商在心中冷笑。

阿瑞斯商火速伸出手，一把握住天残谷主的手，用力晃了晃：“我知道你是谁。你就是贝休恩伯爵遗弃的那个天残儿子吧？听说长得特别好，惹得王城不少贵女心动，表示就算是天残，也愿意一亲芳泽。还有不少雄性兽人跟你表白了？”

天残谷主：“……”

周围的兽人：“……”

天残谷主想要抽回自己的手。

阿瑞斯商紧握不放，还一脸邪肆地上下打量天残谷主，“我看你长得也一般啊，怎么那么多人说你长得好看？”

天残谷主心里骂着麻麦痹，表面还得维持着得体的礼仪：“确实是大家谬赞了，鄙人长相也就一般。”

放手。天残谷主用力抽手。

阿瑞斯商仍旧紧握不放，他甚至握得更紧：“身体残缺、长相一般，其实都没什么，只要人品没问题，那就是一个好兽人。你觉得你是一个好兽人吗？”

“阿瑞斯大师是不是对我有什么意见？”天残谷主终于把自己的手抽了出来。

阿瑞斯商脑中响起系统提醒声。

【任务七十四完成，你成功近距离接触了天残谷谷主，并成功接触了一定时间。经过系统检测确认，此人为天残谷谷主本体，他随身携带了自然之神失落的力量之一。特此奖励贡献点20点，以及空间石一枚。】

阿瑞斯商感觉到手中-出现的石头，顺手放进自己炼制的空间戒指中。

天残谷主似乎感觉到了些微空间波动，但他正想要仔细感知，就发现那一点点空间波动消失了。

【任务七十八，自身之神雕像上遗失的一块大脑，已经被天残谷谷主融合，系统无法直接收回。请你想办法分离天残谷主身上的自然之神遗失力量，让系统能顺利回收。任务成功完成后将奖励贡献点100点，空间石五枚。】

阿瑞斯商不禁感到可惜，他忍着恶心和天残谷主握手那么长时间，结果系统竟无法直接回收对方身上的自然之神力量。

“不，我对你没有意见，我就是看你长得有点奇怪，不像我们兽人。虽然你说自己是天残，但你身上没有我们兽人的味道。”

阿瑞斯商很认真地问：“你真的是天残兽人吗？真的不是其他什么奇怪的东西混到我们兽人大陆来了？”

天残谷主心里惊骇，脸上神情不变：“我想阿瑞斯大师可能对我有什么误解，我确实是一名兽人，货真价实。”

“是吗？我总觉得你不是。你敢让我检查一下吗？”

人群中突然有人发出喷笑声。

好多人都看过去。

喷笑的人捂住嘴，不好意思地连连摆手，解释：“别误会，我就是笑阿瑞斯大师真的很会。”

这话一出，在场众人纷纷露出恍然大悟的表情，就连二王子看向阿瑞斯商的眼神都充满玩味。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan said with sudden understanding, "I want to know the connection between Not-Handsome and the God of Nature. What quest do I need to take? Just issue it directly."

[Please complete the already issued quests first.]

"Is this some kind of game where I have to peel the cocoon to find the silk? Fine, whatever."

Shang Feifan activated the Treasure-Seeking Compass in his right eye.

A tiny golden compass materialized within his field of vision.

"Search for the lost power of the God of Nature."

Several dots of light immediately popped up on the Treasure-Seeking Compass.

Combining the locations of the light dots on the compass with the game map function, Shang Feifan could easily see where each of these points was scattered.

In less than half an hour, Ares Shang swaggered up to a high-class VIP club, holding an invitation letter.

He was here to attend an Occult Amateur Research Society meeting convened by the Second Prince.

The president of this research society was the Second Prince himself. It was said that this society did not easily accept new members; any prospective new member had to be approved by more than half of the veteran members before receiving an invitation.

Relying on his ability to craft spatial artifacts, Ares Shang had prompted the society to actively send him an invitation.

The Second Prince had long wanted to make contact with Ares Shang, but because he walked a different path from the other princes and princesses, it was inconvenient for him to approach Shang directly, so he had taken a roundabout route.

After receiving the invitation, Ares Shang had replied that he would drop by to take a look.

The tone of his reply was extremely arrogant, appearing to completely disregard the Second Prince—but that was just how Ares Shang was. To expect him to become modest and polite just because of someone's status was sheer impossibility.

The interior of the club was exceptionally luxurious and comfortable. The servants attending within were quiet and restrained, and not a trace of commotion could be heard throughout the entire establishment.

Distinguished guests whose status was visibly extraordinary were either sitting quietly somewhere reading books, or chatting with two or three friends over tea, keeping their voices lowered to a whisper.

An attendant led Ares Shang, escorting him down to the basement level of the club.

This entire floor seemed to be the territory of the Occult Amateur Research Society.

*Because it's about the occult, does it strictly have to be underground?* Ares Shang inwardly scoffed.

Upon reaching the door, the attendant didn't say a word. He merely knocked gently and made a welcoming gesture toward Ares Shang.

Rolling his eyes at this pretentious display, Ares Shang hoisted his bone staff and strode haughtily through the open doors.

Inside the doorway, an attendant stepped forward, seemingly intending to help Ares Shang take off his outer garment.

Ares Shang directly pressed his bone staff against the attendant, signaling him to keep his distance.

The attendant bowed and stepped back.

"Master Ares, good day. I'm finally meeting you." The Second Prince stepped forward to welcome him personally, giving Ares Shang plenty of face.

Ares Shang tapped his left chest with his clenched right hand and nodded. "Good day, Your Royal Highness the Second Prince."

"Please, come right in. Everyone has pretty much arrived, just waiting for you." The Second Prince was extremely enthusiastic, ushering Ares Shang to a seat and introducing him to the like-minded members of the society.

Looking around, the people in the research society weren't all of aristocratic birth; some looked like dedicated scholars buried in their research, others looked eccentric and disheveled, and still others were shrouded from head to toe in black robes, exuding an aura of mystery.

Under the Second Prince's introductions, these people also came over one after another to greet Ares Shang.

Of course, not everyone took the initiative to speak with him; some showed a distinctly cold attitude.

Ares Shang couldn't care less about what these people thought of him. At a single glance, he spotted the Master of the Heavenly Flaw Valley conversing with someone, his eyes staring impudently at the other party without moving away.

Seeing Ares Shang's attention captured by the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master, the Second Prince's lips curved into a slight arc, entirely unmindful of the man's distraction.

The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master's handsome and refined appearance was indeed captivating. The Second Prince himself was quite good-looking, but compared to this Heavenly Flaw Valley Master, he still fell a bit short.

Besides, this Master Ares seemed to swing both ways; rumor had it that he had been relentlessly pursuing Raphael Langmu, and thanks to his persistent efforts, he had successfully breached Raphael's office.

Though it was unknown whether Ares Shang had actually succeeded, it didn't stop him from showing interest in a second male.

Introducing the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master, the Second Prince decided to build a little suspense first: "Master Ares, do you happen to know about the Necromancy Valley and the Corpse City?"

Ares Shang: "Sounds like I've heard of it."

The Second Prince smiled, pointing at the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master as he said, "This person here is from the legendary, mysterious Corpse City."

Taking his cue, the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master smiled and extended a hand. "Loren Milton, the current Master of the Heavenly Flaw Valley. The Heavenly Flaw Valley is the legendary Corpse City. The outside world paints it as terribly mysterious, but in reality, ever since the Poison Fog Era, it has just been an ordinary valley where a group of abandoned the-flawed live."

*Heh, you even dare to use this name? You're really betting that nobody on the Beastmen Continent recognizes you, aren't you?* Ares Shang sneered inwardly.

Swiftly extending his hand, Ares Shang grabbed the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master's hand and shook it vigorously. "I know who you are. You're that flawed son abandoned by Count Bethune, right? I heard you're exceptionally good-looking, driving quite a few noble ladies in the royal city wild with infatuation—so much so that they proclaimed themselves willing to taste your favors even if you're flawed. Didn't quite a few male beastmen confess their love to you, too?"

Heavenly Flaw Valley Master: "..."

Surrounding beastmen: "..."

The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master tried to yank his hand back.

Ares Shang kept a tight grip, staring up and down at the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master with an evil, provocative look. "I don't think you look all that special. How come so many people say you're good-looking?"

The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master cursed inwardly with a mouthful of profanities, but on the surface, he had to maintain proper etiquette: "Indeed, everyone flatters me too much. This humble one's appearance is quite ordinary."

*Let go.* The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master pulled hard.

Ares Shang still refused to let go, tightening his grip even further. "Physical defects and average looks don't really matter. As long as a person's character is fine, they're a good beastman. Do you think you're a good beastman?"

"Does Master Ares have some kind of issue with me?" The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master finally wrenched his hand free.

A system notification chimed in Ares Shang's mind.

[Quest Seventy-Four completed. You have successfully made close contact with the Master of the Heavenly Flaw Valley and maintained contact for a set duration. Verified by system detection, this individual is the true body of the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master, and he carries one of the lost powers of the God of Nature upon his person. You are hereby rewarded with 20 Contribution Points and one Spatial Stone.]

Feeling the stone materialize in his palm, Ares Shang casually slipped it into his self-crafted spatial ring.

The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master seemed to sense a slight spatial fluctuation, but just as he wanted to examine it closely, that tiny ripple vanished entirely.

[Quest Seventy-Eight: A piece of the brain missing from the statue of the God of Nature has been fused with by the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master; the system cannot retrieve it directly. Please find a way to separate the lost power of the God of Nature from the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master so the system can successfully reclaim it. Upon successful completion of the quest, you will be rewarded with 100 Contribution Points and five Spatial Stones.]

Ares Shang couldn't help feeling a pang of regret. He had endured his disgust to shake hands with the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master for so long, only for the system to be unable to directly reclaim the God of Nature's power from him.

"No, I don't have an issue with you. I just think you look a bit strange—nothing like us beastmen. Even though you claim to be flawed, you don't have the scent of a beastman."

Ares Shang asked earnestly, "Are you really a flawed beastman? Are you sure you aren't some other strange thing that sneaked into our Beastmen Continent?"

A shock ran through the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master's heart, but his expression remained unchanged. "I believe Master Ares might have some misunderstanding about me. I am indeed a beastman, through and through."

"Is that so? I always feel like you aren't. Do you dare let me check?"

Someone in the crowd suddenly let out a snort of laughter.

Many people looked over.

The person who snorted covered his mouth, waved his hands apologetically over and over, and explained, "Don't misunderstand, I was just laughing at how skilled Master Ares is at this."

As soon as those words fell, everyone present wore expressions of sudden realization, and even the Second Prince looked at Ares Shang with a playful glint in his eyes.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第160章 八卦报第五期 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
天残谷主不确定：这家伙是真的在调戏他，想要借检查占他便宜，还是真的看出了什么？

阿瑞斯商转头瞪喷笑者：“别瞎说！我是个专情的好兽人，我对拉斐尔郎沐一心一意，眼里再没有别人。我是真的怀疑这位谷主不像是兽人，你们看他像吗？”

又有好几个人笑起来，现在更多人认为阿瑞斯商是在口头调戏天残谷主。

如果天残谷主地位稍微低一点，没有那么受二王子关注，可能在场就要有不少人跟着开口调戏天残谷主让他给阿瑞斯商检查一番了。

天残谷主脸色拉了下来。跟这种肆意的纨绔浑人相处，就不能跟他讲贵族礼仪那一套！

二王子出来打圆场：“诸位，今天我们要讨论的话题是神灵是如何出现的。不如大家先落座，我们各自抒发己见，最后再进行现场神秘物品交流。诸位看如何？”

在场众人都愿意给二王子面子，一听二王子这么说，纷纷应是，都分别找位置坐下。

阿瑞斯商在二王子的盛情邀请下，坐到了他身边。

就在阿瑞斯商一脸无聊地听一群人激烈讨论兽人大陆的古神都是怎么形成时，王城的人正在激烈地讨论另一件事。

王城八卦报真的要变成日报，今天他们又出新刊了。

第五期的头条内容，不如前几期那么震惊整个王城乃至虎国民众。

但对于某些人来说，这个消息简直比八卦报暴露的前几期头条还要让人震撼。

王宫内，王后直接冲去议事大殿。

今天是十天一次的大朝议，除了极个别人请假，王城里有头有脸且在职的大臣和贵族全都参加了这次议事。

虎王正在询问几名大臣关于春季材料展销大会的事进行得如何。

商务大臣正在汇报。

王后就是在这时候冲入了议事大殿。

侍卫们想要阻拦，但又不敢真的抓住王后不放，更不敢伤害她，只能围着她一起进入了大殿。

坐在上首的虎王第一个看到冲入大殿的王后，随后其他大臣和权贵也看到了，大家全都转头看向大殿入口处。

王后进来前神情激动，在看到这么多人后，稍微冷静了一点，但也没冷静多少。

她如果冷静，就不会在这时候冲过来。

虎国没有后宫不能干政之类的律法，但王后没有收到邀请，一般也不会出现在大朝议中。

大臣们看到明显来者不善的王后，纷纷交换眼色。

虎王皱眉：“有什么事吗？”

王后往前走。

大臣和权贵们如摩西分海般让开道路。

王后终于走到虎王面前。

虎王心里不快至极，但仍旧按捺着性子，再次问道：“王后过来是有什么重要事情吗？”

虎王在“重要”一词上加了重音。

王后冷冷盯着虎王，忽然发出一声冰冷嗤笑，甩手就扔出一张报纸：“你自己看！”

侍从们哪敢让虎王弯腰捡起地上的报纸，连忙冲过来捡起报纸，抖干净了再呈给虎王。

虎王忍怒，接过报纸，迅速阅读。

当他看到新闻中一句话时，虎王眼睛猛然睁大，整个人似乎受到了巨大打击，或者说是震惊。

下面的大臣和权贵们全都好奇得抓心挠肺。

那八卦报上又说了什么，怎么惹得全国地位最高的两位全都一副震怒震惊的模样？

尤其王后，那神情就像是在控诉虎王对不起她。

虎王看完八卦报上的头条内容，深深吸气平息自己的情绪。

等到情绪略微平定，虎王站起身，“今天-朝议到此结束，有什么事情直接来报。”

虎王转身就走，竟是没有理会站在一边的王后。

王后双手握拳，长长的指甲陷入掌心，冷哼一声，也转身离开。

这两位陛下一离开，议事大殿里立刻轰地炸开，好多人按照自己的小圈子围成一团，互相询问知不知道发生了什么事。

“八卦报呢？谁有八卦报？”

“王宫里应该有订阅吧？”

“呃，我订了，我去找我的侍从，他应该已经给我带来了。”

“对对对，去找份八卦报来看，应该就知道发生什么事了。”

终于，有人拿到了最新出炉的八卦报。

打开报纸，就见一排刺目的黑色大字映入眼帘。

【国王情-妇安妮塔夫人假死遁逃，伪装多重身份扰乱王城！

据本报记者冒死探查得知，曾经的王城第一美人安妮塔夫人在两年前病死家中，虎王和其子伤心不已，但近期却有人发现旖梦楼老板伊娃极有可能就是那位给虎王生下一个儿子的安妮塔夫人！

安妮塔夫人竟然还活着？

虎王是否知情？

他的儿子是否知情？

丹顿侯爵的失踪是否和安妮塔夫人有关？

五公主之死是否也是安妮塔夫人的手笔？

安妮塔夫人在青春之际，宁愿冒着得罪王后的危险也要成为国王陛下的情-妇，这真的是出于对国王的爱吗？

她为国王生育一个儿子，也真的出于爱吗？

如果你被人害得父母双亡，自己不得不带着年幼的妹妹到处逃亡，过着颠沛流离的生活，你真的能不恨不怨不想报复吗？

当伊娃与虎王近卫雷米尔密谋的事暴露，伊娃立即消失无踪。

可安妮塔夫人只有这一重身份吗？

如果你是安妮塔夫人，你觉得伪装成哪种身份最有利于她的活动？

现，王城八卦报诚邀全城人士参与“寻找安妮塔夫人”的大型公共活动，如提供可靠消息者，将根据消息内容获得十银到五金的奖励！

如此有趣的活动，机不可失失不再来，大家快来一起参加啊。】
chunks.englishText:
The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master was uncertain: Was this guy genuinely flirting with him and trying to take advantage under the guise of an examination, or had he truly noticed something?

Ares Shang turned his head and glared at the one who had snorted. "Stop talking nonsense! I am a devoted and good beastman. I am single-mindedly devoted to Raphael Langmu, and there's no room for anyone else in my eyes. I genuinely suspect this Valley Master doesn't look like a beastman. Do you guys think he does?"

A few more people chuckled. By now, even more people were convinced that Ares Shang was merely flirting verbally with the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master.

If the Heavenly Flaw Valley Master's status were slightly lower and he weren't so favored by the Second Prince, quite a few people present might have joined in on the teasing, urging him to let Master Ares give him an examination.

The Heavenly Flaw Valley Master's expression darkened. Dealing with this kind of unbridled, arrogant scoundrel meant you couldn't use standard aristocratic etiquette!

The Second Prince stepped in to smooth things over. "Everyone, today's topic of discussion is how deities came into being. Shall we take our seats first, express our respective views, and then conduct an on-site exchange of mystical items? What do you all think?"

Everyone present was willing to give face to the Second Prince. Hearing him say this, they chimed in with agreement and went to find their seats.

At the Second Prince's warm invitation, Ares Shang sat right beside him.

While Ares Shang listened with a bored expression to a group of people passionately debating how the ancient gods of the Beastmen Continent had formed, the royal city was passionately debating an entirely different matter.

The Royal City Gossip Gazette was truly transforming into a daily paper, and they had released a fresh edition today.

The headline content of this fifth issue wasn't quite as earth-shattering to the entire royal city and the tiger-folk populace as the previous issues.

Yet for certain individuals, this news was even more shocking than the front-page bombshells of the earlier issues.

Inside the royal palace, the Queen stormed straight into the Council Grand Hall.

Today was the grand decennial court assembly. Aside from a tiny handful of people who had asked for leave, all the high-ranking, active ministers and nobles in the royal city were attending this session.

The Tiger King was currently asking several ministers about how preparations for the Spring Material Exhibition and Sales Convention were progressing.

The Minister of Commerce was right in the middle of a report.

It was precisely at this moment that the Queen charged into the Council Grand Hall.

The guards wanted to stop her, but they didn't dare to truly grab the Queen or harm her in any way, so they could only surround her as she forced her way into the hall.

Sitting at the head of the chamber, the Tiger King was the first to spot the Queen charging in, followed shortly by the other ministers and nobles, all of whom turned their heads toward the entrance of the hall.

Before entering, the Queen's expression had been fierce; upon seeing so many people, she calmed down slightly, though not by much.

Had she truly been calm, she wouldn't have burst in at a time like this.

The Tiger Kingdom had no laws forbidding the inner palace from interfering in politics, but without an invitation, the Queen generally never appeared at the grand court assembly.

Seeing the Queen—who clearly came with ill intent—the ministers exchanged glances.

The Tiger King frowned. "Is there something the matter?"

The Queen walked forward.

The ministers and nobles parted paths like Moses parting the Red Sea.

Finally, the Queen arrived before the Tiger King.

The Tiger King felt extremely displeased, but he suppressed his temper and asked again, "Does the Queen have some important matter to attend to?"

The Tiger King placed heavy emphasis on the word "important."

Staring coldly at the Tiger King, the Queen suddenly let out an icy scoff, flicked her wrist, and threw down a newspaper. "See for yourself!"

How could the attendants dare let the Tiger King stoop to pick up a newspaper from the floor? They rushed forward to retrieve it, shook off the dust, and respectfully presented it to the Tiger King.

Suppressing his anger, the Tiger King took the paper and read rapidly.

When his eyes hit a certain sentence in the news report, the Tiger King's eyes widened sharply. His entire person seemed to have suffered a massive blow—or rather, a profound shock.

Down below, the ministers and nobles were dying of curiosity, itching in their hearts.

What on earth did that gossip paper say this time to make the two highest-ranking figures in the entire country look so outraged and shocked?

Especially the Queen; her expression looked as though she were accusing the Tiger King of betraying her.

Having finished reading the front-page story in the Gossip Gazette, the Tiger King took a deep breath to steady his emotions.

Once his composure was slightly restored, the Tiger King stood up. "Today's court assembly ends here. If there are any matters, report them directly."

With that, the Tiger King turned and walked away, completely ignoring the Queen standing off to the side.

Clenching her hands into fists so hard that her long nails dug into her palms, the Queen let out a cold snort and turned to leave as well.

The moment these two sovereigns departed, the Council Grand Hall instantly exploded into an uproar. Many people clustered together in their small circles, frantically asking one another if they knew what had happened.

"Where's the gossip paper? Who has a gossip paper?"

"The palace should have a subscription, right?"

"Uh, I ordered one. Let me go find my attendant; he should have brought it to me by now."

"Right, right, go find a copy of the Gossip Gazette to read, and we'll probably know what's going on."

Finally, someone managed to secure a freshly minted copy of the Gossip Gazette.

Opening the paper, a row of striking black characters leaped into view:

[The King's Mistress, Lady Anita, Faked Her Death and Fled, Disguising Herself with Multiple Identities to Disrupt the Royal City!

According to our reporters' perilous investigations, the former First Beauty of the Royal City, Lady Anita, reportedly died of illness at home two years ago, leaving the Tiger King and her son heartbroken. Yet recently, someone discovered that the proprietor of the Dreamy Pavilion, Eva, is extremely likely to be none other than Lady Anita, the woman who bore a son for the Tiger King!

Is Lady Anita still alive?

Did the Tiger King know?

Did her son know?

Is the disappearance of Marquess Denton related to Lady Anita?

Was the death of the Fifth Princess also Lady Anita's doing?

Back in her youth, Lady Anita was willing to risk offending the Queen to become His Majesty's mistress—was this truly out of love for the King?

Was giving birth to a son for the King also truly out of love?

If you were someone whose parents were murdered, leaving you forced to flee everywhere with a little sister, living a life of displacement, could you truly harbor no hatred, no resentment, no desire for revenge?

When Eva's conspiracy with the Tiger King's close guard, Remir, was exposed, Eva vanished instantly.

Yet does Lady Anita possess only this single identity?

If you were Lady Anita, which identity would you think most beneficial for your activities?

The Royal City Gossip Gazette now cordially invites all citizens of the city to participate in a large-scale public event: "Find Lady Anita." Anyone who provides reliable information will be rewarded with anywhere from ten silver coins to five gold coins based on the value of the intel!

Such an interesting event—don't miss out, for it won't come again. Come join us and participate!]

chunks.chineseText:
第161章 就膈应你

王宫中气氛非常压抑。

王后一个人坐在宫殿里生闷气。

知道安妮塔很可能没死，最生气也最慌乱的人就是她。

看到新闻的一刹那，王后脑中就冒出：一定是虎王帮助安妮塔假死。

王后越想越觉得这个可能性非常高。

她一直看不起安妮塔，认为安妮塔只是一个被分出去的旁支的后裔，一个连父母都没了的可怜虫。就算安妮塔撬了她的墙角，她也不认为安妮塔对她有什么巨大威胁，只觉得对方就是一只恶心的水蛭。

所以安妮塔假死遁逃，她自然不认为是安妮塔的本事，只以为是虎王的安排。

她甚至怀疑虎王这两年一直在和假死的安妮塔偷偷往来。

如果没有虎王的安排，安妮塔怎么可能变成伊娃？

旖梦楼可不是这两年才建成，而是几十年前就出现了，只是前期经营规模很小，就是个很普通的高级妓-院，直到这一二十年才逐渐成为王城知名的销金窟之一。

也许虎王早就在暗中做了安排，否则安妮塔怎么可能混到她的眼皮子底下还不被她知晓？

王后不想承认自己被安妮塔给耍得团团转，她宁可接受自己不如虎王的事实。

安妮塔没死，不但和虎王身边的人密谋要对付她，还很可能害死了五公主，王后气炸了！

她就知道那个雷米尔不是什么好东西！

虎王还护着他，说五公主的死和他无关。

王后怒上心头，不管不顾就跑去找虎王了。

到了议事大殿，她能抑制住没有当场吼虎王，已经算是给了虎王面子。

可虎王却没有给她半分面子。

想到自己被单独丢在大殿，想到那些大臣和权贵全都在偷偷地看她，心里还不知道怎么想她，王后越想越委屈，越想越难过。

她一定要杀了安妮塔！

还有那个贱种拉斐尔郎沐！

王后叫来心腹下属：“那件事安排得怎么样了？”

下属低头回复：“那边说这段时间王城对于他们的搜查非常严密，他们很难混进来。”

王后毫不犹豫地说：“就用我的名义，安排他们伪装成商人进来。”

“这……”下属迟疑：“如果事情暴露，联系到您身上？”

“无事。”王后豁出去了。她和虎王已经撕破脸皮，虎王这么护着安妮塔那个贱人，说不定哪天就能为那个贱人把她这个王后给解决了。

她已经退无可退，既然如此，还不如好好利用她现在的名头和权势，彻底解决她的敌人！

下属看王后已经下定决心，只能点头：“属下立刻安排。”

“告诉那边，这次无论如何都要拿下那个野种的小命！我不希望再出现七年前同样的事情，要死就让他死得彻彻底底！不惜代价！”

“是。”

“还有，给我去查安妮塔躲在哪里，我要那个贱人死！把多丽丝给我抓起来拷问，说不定她知道什么。”王后恨得面部扭曲。

“是。”下属有点心疼。多丽丝可是他们好不容易培养出来的高级人才，长得美貌天生魅惑，不但能赚钱，更能从那些馋她美色的雄性兽人身上弄来各种情报。可王后现在说废就废，唉。

王后挥手让下属离开。一个高级妓-女而已，有什么好心疼的。死掉这一个，她还可以让人培养无数个。

王后又让心腹侍女去找二王子。

有些事，她不想再等下去了。

虎王那边正在和克莱门特说话。

克莱门特把他调查到的情报都告诉了虎王：“时间太短，卑下只查到这么多。”

“这么说伊娃真的有可能是安妮塔？”虎王到现在还觉得有点不可置信。

在他眼中，安妮塔一直都是一个清丽柔婉的可心美人，虽然她心里恨着王后，也是因为想要报复王后才会跟他，但他能感觉出来，安妮塔是真心喜欢他的，否则也不会为他生育一个孩子。

安妮塔还经常吃王后的醋，但她不说，只每次看到他都会紧紧依靠着他，大大满足了他的雄性自得之心。

他一直认为他掌控着安妮塔，一直认为安妮塔是依靠他才能在王后的威胁下活下来，也一直认为安妮塔没有他就什么都做不成。

可现在八卦报上透露出的一点消息却显示出安妮塔似乎早在勾引他之前就开始在王城布局。

她在当他情-妇期间，看起来似乎一直都是弱势一方，对王后的咄咄逼人也是不断后退。

虎王忍不住同情安妮塔，认为她和王后相比就是一个彻底的弱者，更觉得自己委屈了安妮塔，让她吃了很多苦头。

可现在仔细想想，安妮塔在王后那看似咄咄逼人的威胁下损失了什么？

除了有人背地里嘲笑安妮塔只是一个情-妇，但谁敢当面嘲讽她？

相反，因为她是国王唯一的情-妇，还给国王生了孩子，这王城谁敢不给她面子？

要说安妮塔受到的最大委屈，可能就是拉斐尔被欺负、被暗杀？

可拉斐尔压根就不是安妮塔的亲生骨肉啊！

虎王抱头。

他竟然直到今天才反应过来。

安妮塔表现得那么委屈和可怜，但实际上真实受罪的人和安妮塔根本毫无关系。

他心中愤恨王后威胁逼迫安妮塔有病不能治，只能慢慢等死。

但实际上安妮塔正好借此机会摆脱国王情-妇这个身份，隐入暗中继续兴风作浪。

虎王甚至想到安妮塔死后给拉斐尔留下遗言，让他务必等到二十岁成年后才能离开王城，这不就是在利用拉斐尔这块挡箭牌继续为她吸引王后的注意力，给她更多布局时间吗？

说不定安妮塔连假死的时间都算计好了，因为雷米尔……长大了。

想到八卦报上说雷米尔和伊娃有密切接触，还密谋对付王后，虎王按住太阳穴。

他以为雷米尔是个老实的，就算有点小野心，也不会真的去奢想他不该奢想的，但有安妮塔的撺掇在，雷米尔真的能忍住不去想某些事吗？

还有五公主的死亡，看起来好像是五公主自己作死，但这其中真的没有安妮塔的推波助澜吗？

如果安妮塔开始对王子公主下手，那么她会就此停止吗？

“留意八卦报那边，看那边能不能找出安妮塔的踪迹。如果找到……”虎王看向克莱门特。

克莱门特贼精，就是不主动接口。

虎王无奈，只能明说：“如果她不反抗，就带她来秘密见我。如果她反抗得厉害，那就该怎么样就怎么样吧。”

克莱门特接令。

就在克莱门特刚要走出书房之际，虎王再次叫住克莱门特：“盯住雷米尔，也许他会去找她。还有，如果对安妮塔动手，不要让雷米尔知道。”

克莱门特面无表情，心想陛下知不知道他这样的说法会让人怀疑雷米尔的身世。但他就像是什么都没听出来一样，只接令：“是。”

金溪庄园内，女管家看着最新一期的八卦报，要不断深呼吸才能平息自己的情绪。

这个该死的八卦报！

他们到底哪里来的渠道，怎么会挖出那么多秘密？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 161: Just Here to Disgust You

The atmosphere within the royal palace was suffocatingly oppressive.

The Queen sat alone in her palace, stewing in her anger.

Knowing that Anita was likely still alive made her the angrier and more panicked person of all.

The very instant she saw the news, a thought popped into the Queen's mind: It must have been the Tiger King who helped Anita fake her death.

The more the Queen thought about it, the more she believed this possibility was extremely high.

She had always looked down on Anita, viewing her merely as the descendant of a splintered branch, a pitiful wretch who had lost both parents. Even when Anita had poached her man, the Queen hadn't considered Anita a major threat; she had simply viewed the woman as a disgusting leech.

Therefore, when Anita faked her death and fled, she naturally didn't credit it to Anita's own cleverness, assuming instead that it was all arranged by the Tiger King.

She even suspected that the Tiger King had been secretly communicating with the supposedly dead Anita for the past two years.

Without the Tiger King's arrangements, how could Anita possibly have morphed into Eva?

The Dreamy Pavilion hadn't been built in just the last two years; it had appeared decades ago, though its early scale of operations was very small—just an ordinary high-end brothel—only gradually growing over the past decade or two to become one of the royal city's renowned dens of pleasure.

Perhaps the Tiger King had made arrangements in the shadows long ago; otherwise, how could Anita have operated right under her nose without her knowledge?

The Queen refused to admit that she had been played for a fool by Anita; she would rather accept the reality that she was inferior to the Tiger King.

Anita was not only alive, conspiring with people around the Tiger King to deal with her, but likely also responsible for the death of the Fifth Princess. The Queen was boiling with rage!

She just knew that Remir fellow was no good!

Yet the Tiger King still protected him, claiming the Fifth Princess's death had nothing to do with him.

Blinded by fury, the Queen threw caution to the wind and rushed off to find the Tiger King.

Arriving at the Council Grand Hall, managing to restrain herself from yelling at the Tiger King on the spot was already giving him immense face.

Yet the Tiger King hadn't given her an ounce of face in return.

Thinking of how she had been left alone in the hall, thinking of how those ministers and nobles had all been secretly watching her—wondering what kind of thoughts they harbored in their minds—the Queen felt increasingly aggrieved and miserable.

She had to kill Anita!

And that bastard Raphael Langmu, too!

The Queen summoned a trusted subordinate. "How are the arrangements for that matter coming along?"

The subordinate lowered his head and replied, "The people over there say that the royal city's searches for them have been extremely tight lately, making it very difficult to sneak in."

Without a moment's hesitation, the Queen commanded, "Use my name. Arrange for them to disguise themselves as merchants and enter."

"This..." The subordinate hesitated. "If things are exposed and traced back to you?"

"It doesn't matter." The Queen had burned her bridges. She and the Tiger King had already torn off their masks; with the Tiger King protecting that bitch Anita so fiercely, who was to say he wouldn't get rid of her as Queen for that bitch's sake one day?

She had nowhere left to retreat. Since that was the case, she might as well make good use of her current name and power to utterly eliminate her enemies!

Seeing that the Queen had made up her mind, the subordinate could only nod. "Your subordinate will arrange it immediately."

"Tell them that no matter what, they must take that bastard's life this time! I don't want a repeat of what happened seven years ago—if he dies, make sure he dies thoroughly! Spare no expense!"

"Understood."

"Also, go investigate where Anita is hiding. I want that bitch dead! Arrest Doris and interrogate her; she might know something." The Queen's face twisted with hatred.

"Yes." The subordinate felt a pang of pity. Doris was a high-tier talent they had cultivated with immense difficulty; naturally alluring and beautiful, she could not only make money but also extract all sorts of intelligence from the male beastmen captivated by her charms. Yet now the Queen was discarding her just like that—sigh.

The Queen waved her hand, dismissing the subordinate. A mere high-end prostitute—what was there to feel sorry for? With one dead, she could have people cultivate countless more.

The Queen then sent her trusted maid to summon the Second Prince.

Some matters, she refused to wait for any longer.

Over on the Tiger King's side, he was currently conferring with Clement.

Clement was reporting all the intelligence he had gathered to the Tiger King. "The time was too short; your humble subordinate managed to uncover only this much."

"So you're saying Eva really might be Anita?" To this moment, the Tiger King still found it somewhat unbelievable.

In his eyes, Anita had always been a pure, gentle, and pleasing beauty. Although she held hatred for the Queen in her heart and had come to him partly out of a desire for revenge, he could sense that Anita genuinely liked him; otherwise, she wouldn't have borne him a child.

Anita also frequently grew jealous of the Queen, though she kept it to herself, merely clinging tightly to him whenever she saw him, greatly satisfying his male vanity.

He had always believed he controlled Anita, always believed Anita relied on him to survive under the Queen's threats, and always believed Anita could accomplish nothing without him.

Yet the tidbits revealed in the Gossip Gazette indicated that Anita seemed to have begun laying out her plans in the royal city even before she seduced him.

During her time as his mistress, she had always appeared to be the vulnerable party, constantly retreating in the face of the Queen's aggressive onslaughts.

The Tiger King couldn't help feeling a wave of sympathy for Anita, thinking that compared to the Queen, she was a complete underdog, and feeling all the more that he had wronged her and made her suffer greatly.

Yet thinking about it carefully now, what had Anita actually lost amidst the Queen's seemingly aggressive threats?

Aside from people secretly mocking Anita for merely being a mistress, who had ever dared to mock her to her face?

On the contrary, because she was the King's sole mistress and had borne the King a child, who in the royal city dared not show her respect?

If one had to name the greatest grievance Anita suffered, it was probably Raphael being bullied and targeted for assassination?

Yet Raphael wasn't even Anita's biological flesh and blood!

The Tiger King clutched his head.

He hadn't realized the truth until today.

Anita had acted so aggrieved and pitiful, but in reality, the ones truly suffering had nothing to do with Anita at all.

He had previously resented the Queen for threatening and cornering Anita when she was supposedly terminally ill, forcing her to slowly await her death.

In reality, Anita had simply used that exact opportunity to shed the identity of the King's mistress, slip into the shadows, and continue stirring up trouble.

The Tiger King even recalled that when Anita "died," she had left behind last words for Raphael, instructing him strictly not to leave the royal city until he turned twenty. Wasn't she simply using Raphael as a shield to continue drawing the Queen's fire and buy herself more time to lay her plans?

For all he knew, Anita had even calculated the timing of her fake death because Remir... had grown up.

Thinking of the Gossip Gazette's report that Remir and Eva had been in close contact and conspiring against the Queen, the Tiger King pressed his temples.

He had thought Remir was an honest sort; even if the boy harbored a little ambition, he wouldn't genuinely dare to covet things he shouldn't. But with Anita egging him on, could Remir really resist harboring certain thoughts?

And then there was the death of the Fifth Princess. It looked like the Fifth Princess had brought about her own demise, but was there truly no catalyst from Anita behind the scenes?

If Anita had started targeting the princes and princesses, would she stop here?

"Keep an eye on the Gossip Gazette and see if they can track down Anita's whereabouts. If you find her..." The Tiger King looked toward Clement.

Clement was craftier than a fox and steadfastly refused to take the bait.

Left with no choice, the Tiger King had to spell it out: "If she doesn't resist, bring her to see me in secret. If she puts up fierce resistance... then handle it as circumstances dictate."

Clement acknowledged the order.

Just as Clement was about to step out of the study, the Tiger King called him back once more: "Keep an eye on Remir. He might go looking for her. Also, if action is taken against Anita, do not let Remir know."

With a blank expression, Clement thought to himself whether His Majesty realized that phrasing would only cast further doubt on Remir's true parentage. Yet, acting as though he had heard nothing at all, he simply accepted the command: "Yes."

Inside the Golden Stream Manor, the head housekeeper stared at the latest issue of the Gossip Gazette, forced to take deep breaths to calm her churning emotions.

*That damned gossip paper!*

*Just where do they get their channels, digging up so many secrets?!*

chunks.chineseText:
之前看他们对付王后，她还看得挺爽。

但火苗现在烧到她身上，那滋味就不一样了。

尤其这该死的八卦报不但曝光她假死的事，还搞出“全王城人一起来找她”的活动。

她这是哪里得罪了这家报社吗？

她现在去送钱给这家报社，对方能中止活动，或者转而和她合作吗？

女管家一边想着找报社有无谈判的可能，一边觉得这家报社搞出的活动恶心无比。

她对自己的隐藏能力很有自信，但凡事不怕一万就怕万一，她也不敢保证百分百没有露出马脚，更不敢保证真没有一个人怀疑她。

只要有一个人怀疑她，并为奖励金心动，说不定就会去报社打小报告。

反正说错了也没惩罚。

搞不好庄园内有下人看她不顺眼，故意跑去报社乱说也有可能。

一想到她今后无论见什么人、去哪里、做任何事，都需要小心翼翼，女管家心里就烦躁得要命。

这报社的寻人活动，真的是伤害性不大，恶心人的能力一流！

该不会幕后报道这件事的人的真正目的就是给她添堵来的吧？

正在俱乐部和二王子等人交易储物道具的阿瑞斯商：没错，就是这样。直接杀了你，太便宜了你。我家不帅受的罪，也总得让你尝尝其中滋味。而这还只是开始！

“咚咚。”

女管家被敲门声吓了一跳，下意识厉喝：“谁！什么事？”

“斯纳德管家，是亚尔佩特少爷闹着要看八卦报……”

“给他。”女管家说完就后悔了。谁知道丹顿家族的人看到八卦报又会闹出什么事来。

不过转念一想，丹顿家族的人现在都在她的看管之下，就算他们想要传递消息出去，也要看她允不允许。

王城八卦报社人头涌动，屋外也不断有人往里面挤，不断有人高喊：“我有安妮塔夫人的消息，让我进去！”

人虽多，但报社里的员工倒是忙而不乱，每个人职责清晰，负责引导的、做记录的、维持秩序的，安排得井井有条。

报社员工明明可以引导大家排队，却故意没有这么做。

太有秩序了，有些握有真实消息的人反而不敢出面。

另外，就这样混乱着，等报社再进行报道时，谁也搞不清他们的消息是从哪里来的。

“这是您的记录号码，我给您写手臂上……换到小腿上？没问题。”做标记的员工从善如流，改变位置写下号码：“好了。如果我们核实您的消息属实，会在后期的报纸上公开您的记录号码，到时请直接凭号码来报社领取奖励金。”

“能不能洗澡？当然能洗。放心，这种颜料短时间内就算用力擦洗都不会消退。”

“总编！这边有位大婶说她有值得让我们报道的大事告诉我们。”

“让球球接待她。所有愿意提供有价值新闻的人，都请到里面的会议室。来买广告位的，请广告组组长接待！”

“总编，这区的治安局来人，让我们派人维持门口的秩序，说人太多太乱。”

“那就再雇佣几个钟点工。”总编丁勾提高声音：“熊猫？熊猫在吗？下一期报纸排版了没有？没有，我这边要再临时添加一个广告。”

王城八卦报业务大兴，死而复生的总编丁勾给自己加了一副假胡须就又出来工作了。他还让升职副总编的皮蛋负责在玩家中继续招人。

原本丁勾和皮蛋以及其他死在王城的玩家死后重生只能重生在天残谷的转生池中。

但玩家中有位血脉天赋很特殊的玩家“熊猫是我老婆”，他的天赋是隔空召唤。只要给他被召唤者的一样贴身物品，他就能把被召唤者召唤到身边。

伏向军接了商非凡交给他的任务后，第一个去找的就是这位。

有这位玩家在，至少可以保证长距离任务，玩家就算死亡也不会掉队。

皮皮虾会不断掉队，不是因为熊猫不愿召唤他，而是皮皮虾不愿被召唤，他就是个独行侠，喜欢自己一个人行动，不喜欢跟着大部队一起走。

这次如果不是为了空间道具，皮皮虾也不会跟着伏向军的队伍跑。

总之，有了熊猫的召唤大法，过了三天死亡期惩罚的丁勾和皮蛋立刻就被召唤回王城，继续为八卦事业发光发热。

在报社工作的人也没白干，笔记本系统通过任务触发机制，只要遇到合适的任务就会发布，其中不少都是和兴建报社有关。

也就是说这些玩家办八卦报，不但能满足他们的搞事欲-望，同时还能得到任务奖励，简直一举多得。

很多刚来王城的玩家，一时找不到任务，就来八卦报这边找机会，基本上每个人都能领到报酬不错的任务。

作为笔记本系统的幕后控制者，天残谷主也看到八卦报这边的偌大声势和延伸而出的大量任务。

但他并没有强行禁止。

一来，游戏系统有自己的运行规则，就算他是系统掌控者，也无法强行更改和破坏系统的基础运行规则。

实际上，他不是系统开发者，更像是一个系统维护员和后台操控员，他可以在不违背系统基础规则的基础上小幅度地增加系统某些功能，可以发布任务、修改任务内容、删除玩家账号、对玩家做出奖励和惩罚等，但他无法对系统本身进行修改。

二来，八卦报这个东西虽然是一把双刃剑，但不能否认的是，利用好了也是一个巨大臂助。

三来，天残谷主的最终目的是利用玩家掌控整个兽人大陆，从而达成他成神的目的。为此，玩家们怎么折腾虎国王室乃至折腾整个兽人大陆的兽人，对于天残谷主都没有任何影响，他巴不得虎国更乱。

不过这会儿天残谷主没有去想八卦报的事，他在想那个阿瑞斯商。

那个年轻的炼金大师太古怪了，说是对他感兴趣吧，言语和神情却又对他充满讽刺和不善。

如果说他想借此吸引他的注意力，那他不得不说，对方做得很成功。

但天残谷主也并没有自恋到真的认为阿瑞斯商喜欢上他，实际上那家伙在参加神秘学同好研究会时几次嚷嚷他只喜欢拉斐尔郎沐一个，简直生怕别人不知道他有多迷恋拉斐尔。

天残谷主之所以这么在意阿瑞斯商，是因为他发现这家伙的实力有点深不可测，而且不知道是不是他的错觉，他总觉得对方身上似乎也透出一点魔法师的味道。

当时阿瑞斯商握住他的手，他几次抽都没有抽出来。

在别人看来两人的动作很平常。除了阿瑞斯商的表现很失礼。

只有天残谷主自己心里清楚，他当时花了多大的劲，期间他还悄悄施展了类似针刺的小魔法，可对方似乎毫无所觉。最后他抽出手掌也不是因为他施展了某个小法术或者力气超过阿瑞斯商，而是阿瑞斯商主动松手。

最可怕的是，在对方握住他手的那不算长的时间内，他有种被人从头到脚从内到外都探索了一遍的恐怖感，他还无法阻止。
chunks.englishText:
At first, watching others deal with the Queen had been quite satisfying.

However, once the flames licked right up to her own feet, the taste was entirely different.

Especially since this damned tabloid not only exposed her fake death, but also launched an event where "the entire Royal City turns out to search for her."

Just how had she offended this publishing house?

If she went right now and bribed them with a massive sum of money, would they call off the event or even switch to cooperating with her?

As the head housekeeper pondered the possibility of negotiating with the tabloid, she found their stunt utterly sickening.

She was extremely confident in her stealth abilities, but one feared not the ten thousand, but the one-in-a-million chance. She couldn't guarantee she hadn't left behind a single flaw, nor could she be certain that absolutely no one suspected her.

The moment even a single person suspected her and grew tempted by the reward money, they might well run off to the tabloid to snitch.

After all, there was no penalty for making a wrong guess.

For all she knew, some servant in the manor who harbored a grudge might deliberately run to the tabloid and spout nonsense just to spite her.

The mere thought that from now on she would have to tread carefully no matter who she met, where she went, or what she did made the head housekeeper's blood boil with irritation.

This tabloid’s search event truly had negligible direct harm, but its ability to disgust people was top-tier!

Could the mastermind behind this report have had the sole purpose of giving her a migraine?

Inside the club, as he traded storage items with the Second Prince and the others, Ares Shang thought: *Spot on, exactly that. Killing you outright would be letting you off way too easily. You must taste even a fraction of the suffering my unhandsome lover endured. And this is just the beginning!*

"Knock, knock."

The head housekeeper was startled by the rap on the door, subconsciously snapping in a harsh voice, "Who is it! What do you want?"

"Housekeeper Snade, Young Master Alpert is throwing a tantrum and demanding to see the tabloid..."

"Give it to him." The head housekeeper regretted her words the moment they left her mouth. Who knew what kind of trouble the people of the Denton family would stir up once they laid eyes on the gossip paper?

On second thought, however, the members of the Denton family were currently under her strict surveillance. Even if they wanted to pass any information outside, it would depend entirely on whether she permitted it.

Outside, the Royal City Tabloid office was a seething mass of humanity. People continually shoved and elbowed their way toward the entrance, shouting at the top of their lungs, "I have news about Madam Anita, let me in!"

Despite the overwhelming crowd, the tabloid staff remained remarkably busy yet unruffled. Everyone had clearly defined duties; some were responsible for guiding the crowd, others for taking notes, and others for maintaining order, organizing everything in an orderly fashion.

Yet, despite being fully capable of making everyone line up, the staff deliberately chose not to do so.

If it were too orderly, those holding genuine intelligence might not dare to come forward.

Moreover, amidst such chaos, when the tabloid published its subsequent reports, no one would ever be able to trace where their intelligence had actually originated.

"Here is your tracking number, let me write it on your arm... Switch it to your calf? No problem." The staff member assigned to marking individuals went with the flow, changing locations and writing down the number. "Alright. If we verify that your information is authentic, we will publish your tracking number in a later edition of the paper. At that time, simply bring this number directly to the tabloid to claim your reward."

"Can you take a bath? Of course you can. Rest assured, this kind of pigment won't fade away even if you scrub it vigorously in the short term."

"Editor-in-Chief! There's an auntie over here claiming she has a major scoop worth our reporting."

"Have Qiuqiu receive her. Anyone willing to provide valuable news, please head to the conference room inside. Those here to purchase ad space, report to the advertising team leader!"

"Editor-in-Chief, the local security precinct sent someone over, telling us to dispatch people to maintain order at the entrance because there are simply too many chaotic people."

"Then hire a few more part-time workers." Editor-in-Chief Ding Gou raised his voice. "Panda? Is Panda around? Has the layout for the next issue been finalized? If not, I need to temporarily squeeze in another advertisement."

The Royal City Tabloid business was booming. Ding Gou, having resurrected from the dead, slapped on a pair of fake whiskers and went right back to work. He even had Pidan, now promoted to deputy editor-in-chief, continue recruiting new hands among the players.

Originally, when Ding Gou, Pidan, and the other players who had perished in the Royal City respawned, they could only revive at the Reincarnation Pool in the Heaven-Abandoned Valley.

However, there was a player among them with a very special bloodline talent named "Panda is My Wife," whose unique ability was long-range summoning. As long as he was given a personal item belonging to the target, he could summon that person directly to his side.

When Fu Xiangjun accepted the task assigned to him by Shang Feifan, this player was the very first person he sought out.

With this player around, they could at least ensure that during long-distance missions, players wouldn't fall behind even if they died.

The reason Pi Pixia kept falling back wasn't because Panda was unwilling to summon him; rather, Pi Pixia refused to be summoned. He was a pure lone wolf who preferred acting on his own and detested following a massive horde.

If not for the spatial artifact this time around, Pi Pixia never would have tagged along with Fu Xiangjun’s team.

In short, thanks to Panda’s summoning magic, Ding Gou and Pidan—having weathered the three-day death penalty—were instantly summoned back to the Royal City to continue shining brightly for the cause of gossip.

Those working at the tabloid weren't toiling in vain either; the notebook system featured a quest-trigger mechanism. Whenever suitable circumstances arose, it would issue quests, many of which were directly tied to expanding and establishing the tabloid.

In other words, by running this tabloid, these players not only satisfied their cravings for stirring up trouble, but also reaped system quest rewards, achieving multiple goals at once.

Many players who had just arrived in the Royal City and temporarily couldn't find any quests would flock to the tabloid to look for opportunities, and practically everyone could walk away with a well-paying task.

As the master behind the scenes controlling the notebook system, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley was well aware of the tabloid's massive momentum and the flood of quests branching out from it.

Yet, he made no move to forcibly ban it.

For one, the game system operated under its own intrinsic rules. Even as the system administrator, he could not arbitrarily alter or break the foundational rules of its operation.

In truth, he was less of a system developer and more of a system maintenance worker and backend operator. He could make minor tweaks to certain system functions without violating core rules—such as issuing quests, modifying quest content, deleting player accounts, and granting rewards or penalties—but he could not alter the core system itself.

Secondly, while a gossip tabloid was a double-edged sword, it was undeniable that if utilized properly, it could also serve as a tremendous asset.

Thirdly, the ultimate goal of the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley was to use the players to seize control of the entire Orc Continent, thereby achieving his ambition of ascending to godhood. To that end, no matter how much the players tossed the Tiger Kingdom's royal family or the orcs of the entire continent into turmoil, it had zero impact on him; in fact, he secretly wished the Tiger Kingdom would plunge into even greater chaos.

Right now, however, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley wasn't thinking about the tabloid. His mind was occupied with that fellow, Ares Shang.

That young alchemy master was utterly bizarre. While he claimed to be interested in him, his words and expressions were riddled with sarcasm and ill intent.

If the man was trying to use this method to attract his attention, he had to admit that the fellow had succeeded brilliantly.

Yet, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley wasn't narcissistic enough to truly believe that Ares Shang had fallen for him. In fact, during the Occultism Enthusiasts' Club gatherings, that guy had repeatedly blustered that he only had eyes for Raphael Langmu, practically terrified that the world wouldn't know how obsessed he was with Raphael.

The real reason the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley paid so much attention to Ares Shang was because he discovered that this guy’s strength was somewhat unfathomable. Furthermore, whether it was his imagination or not, he always felt as though the fellow faintly exuded a trace of a mages aura.

Back then, when Ares Shang had grabbed his hand, he tried to pull away several times without success.

To outside observers, their interaction looked entirely normal—aside from Ares Shang's highly discourteous behavior.

Only the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley knew in his heart just how much strength he had exerted at that moment. During the encounter, he had even quietly cast a minor needle-prick spell, yet the other party seemed completely oblivious. In the end, he managed to withdraw his palm not because he had unleashed some spell or because his physical strength surpassed Ares Shang's, but simply because Ares Shang had chosen to release his grip.

What was most terrifying was that during that brief span when the man was holding his hand, he had experienced the horrifying sensation of being scanned from head to toe, from the inside out, completely helpless to stop it.

chunks.chineseText:
因为这些都只是他的感觉，他其实并没有察觉对方施展什么探测手段，这让他想要阻止也不知道该怎么阻止。

还有阿瑞斯商说的那些话，别人听起来像调戏，但他和二王子都听出了更深层次的意思。

这个阿瑞斯商绝对不是一个普通兽人！

对方会也是穿越而来的魔法师吗？

研究会后，二王子也问了他同样的问题。

天残谷主的回答是：他也看不出来。

二王子表示他也无法确定。

两人在研究会上跟阿瑞斯商分别购买了一支储物手镯。

空间只有三个立方，售价五千金。
