两人买下储物手镯除了自用，就是想要看看这手镯的炼制方法走的是否是魔法炼金的路子。

但两人研究半天也没看出来。

天残谷主看到王城多了许多玩家，差不多已经有五六十人。

这些人都是从天残谷那边赶过来的，刚路上消耗的时间就接近两个月。

可以说这批能在最近赶到王城的玩家，除了实力在玩家中排行靠前，更是玩家中的卷王。

五六十人的人数还是太少了。

天残谷主考虑要不要在虎国王城附近也搞一个出生池。

来之前，天残谷主完全没有考虑这一点。

玩家出生池对他太重要，一旦出生池的秘密被发现，他的成神大计就会受到阻挠乃至破坏。

出生池可以分裂。

只是哪里都没有天残谷那座神庙安全。

出生池放在那里，哪怕他离开也不怕出生池被人发现和破坏。

可一旦把出生池挪到其他地方，出生池就无法做到那么隐秘了。

天残谷主想来想去，决定还是不设出生池，而是利用这里的传送阵。

是的，王城也有传送阵，还不止一个。

虎国第一代虎王会选择把这片土地当做王城来建设，当然不是随便选的。

在大繁华纪时期，这里就是十八城之一，虎城。

大繁华纪也就是新兽人联盟时期，各族兽人不再各自立国，而是以种族或部落为名。而这些种族和部落中人员最密集的地方就被称作某某城。

这么大的兽人大陆当然不止十八座大城，只是这十八城最出名。

出名，自然来往的人也多。

为此，这十八座大城内外被布置了很多传送阵。

虽然经过大战纪、战毁纪、毒雾纪，这些传送阵毁了不少，但也有几个幸存下来。

天残谷主来到王城后，一半时间就在寻找这些传送阵。

实际上，他就是通过摩罗城内的一个传送阵来到了王城。

这个传送阵的位置就藏在彘庞男爵在王城购买的府邸中。

因为彘庞一家都知道这个传送阵的位置，天残谷主也不好立刻把这一家都杀绝灭口，只能暂时放弃拿下这个传送阵的想法。

最近，天残谷主找到了第二座传送阵。

第二座传送阵位于王城郊外的山林里，那座山原本隶属于一名伯爵，他们家的庄园就在那里。

但这位伯爵也不知哪里得罪了虎王，不但被削爵，连名下所有土地都被虎王收回，连带那座山一起。

也不知道是巧合还是其他，二王子说他喜欢研究神秘学，但有些研究在王城内不方便施展，只能挪到郊外。就跟虎王讨要了那座山的使用权。

虎王见二王子要的只是两百年的使用权，就同意了。

天残谷主原本还想等一等再跟二王子提交易这座山使用权的事，但阿瑞斯商一出，他心里不安，想要多一点保护和能使用的人手，当即决定加快进度。

当天晚上，天残谷主就跟二王子提出购买这座山使用权的请求。

二王子看似和天残谷主相处密切，暗中也在警惕对方。

天残谷主对这点心知肚明，他们虽然都是来自法德尔大陆，但也不代表能互相信任。

但两人最终目的一致，在最后争夺前，他们合作得到的利益显然更大，二王子考虑一番，也就同意了天残谷主的购买请求。

主要是天残谷主拿出来的交易物品让他实在无法拒绝。

那是魔晶！

他渴望无比、寻求了几十年都没找到的魔晶！

他是魔法师，更是魔法师中的翘楚，中级魔导师。

但再厉害的魔法师，没有魔力使用也枉然。

现在有了天残谷主交易给他的魔晶，就算数量不多，他也能做很多事了。

天残谷主拿下这座山，当夜就开始布置。

他要把这座传送阵和天残谷那边的传送阵连起来。

他对空间阵法掌握不多，但只是略微修改短距离传送阵的目的地还是能做到的。

连好传送阵，天残谷主就在天残谷发布任务，招募玩家利用传送阵前来王城。

有了这座传送阵，今后王城的玩家再死亡，就能从天残谷那边复活后直接乘坐传送阵过来。

虽然消耗大了一点，但传送阵使用的能量不是魔晶，而是使用的地力，崽卖爷田不心疼，兽人大陆只是他成神的踏脚石，土地变得再贫瘠也和他无关，且越是糟糕的环境越能帮助他在未来聚集信仰，天残谷主也就无所谓这点消耗了。
chunks.englishText:
Because these were merely his sensations—he had never actually detected any probing methods being cast—he didn't even know how he was supposed to stop it if he wanted to.

And then there were those remarks made by Ares Shang. To others, they sounded like flirtatious banter, but both he and the Second Prince had perceived a much deeper underlying meaning.

This Ares Shang was definitely no ordinary orc!

Could that fellow also be a transmigrated mage?

Following the club gathering, the Second Prince had posed that exact question to him.

The Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley's answer was: He couldn't tell either.

The Second Prince stated that he was equally unable to determine it.

At the gathering, the two of them had each purchased a spatial storage bracelet from Ares Shang.

The internal space was a mere three cubic meters, yet the price tag was five thousand gold coins.

Aside from personal use, their primary motive in buying these bracelets was to inspect whether the crafting method followed the path of magical alchemy.

Yet, after studying them for a long time, neither of them could figure it out.

Noticing that the Royal City now boasted a large influx of players—numbering around fifty or sixty—the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley grew thoughtful.

These individuals had all hurried over from Heaven-Abandoned Valley, and the travel time alone on the road had taken nearly two months.

It was safe to say that this batch of players who managed to reach the Royal City in such a short window were not only among the top tier in strength, but were also the ultimate grinders of the player community.

Fifty or sixty people was still far too few.

The Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley began weighing whether he should set up another spawn pool near the Tiger Kingdom's Royal City.

Before coming here, he hadn't considered this option at all.

The player spawn pool was far too crucial to him; once its secret was exposed, his grand scheme to ascend to godhood would face severe obstruction and even destruction.

The spawn pool was capable of division.

The problem was that no place was as secure as that shrine in Heaven-Abandoned Valley.

With the spawn pool left there, he had no fear of it being discovered or destroyed even when he was away.

However, the moment he relocated a spawn pool elsewhere, it would be impossible to maintain that level of absolute secrecy.

After mulling it over from every angle, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley decided against building a new spawn pool. Instead, he would utilize the local teleportation arrays.

Indeed, the Royal City possessed teleportation arrays, and more than one at that.

When the first generation Tiger King of the Tiger Kingdom chose this land to build his royal capital, it was naturally no random selection.

During the High Prosperity Era, this place had been one of the eighteen major cities known as Tiger City.

The High Prosperity Era, also referred to as the New Orc Alliance Period, was a time when various orc tribes no longer established independent nations, but instead organized themselves by race or tribe. The most densely populated settlements of these races and tribes were designated as cities.

Naturally, an Orc Continent this vast featured far more than just eighteen major cities; it was simply that these eighteen were the most renowned.

Being renowned, they naturally attracted a high volume of travelers.

To accommodate this, numerous teleportation arrays had been laid out both inside and out across these eighteen major cities.

Although a great many of these arrays had been destroyed through the Great War Era, the War-Ravaged Era, and the Poison Fog Era, a few had managed to survive.

Ever since arriving in the Royal City, half of the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley's time had been spent hunting down these teleportation arrays.

In fact, it was through a teleportation array located inside Molo City that he had managed to reach the Royal City in the first place.

That particular array was concealed within an estate purchased in the Royal City by Baron Zhipang.

Because the entire Zhipang family knew the location of this array, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley couldn't simply slaughter them all to silence them, forcing him to temporarily abandon the idea of seizing it.

Recently, however, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley had located a second teleportation array.

This second array was situated within a mountain forest on the outskirts of the Royal City. The mountain had originally belonged to an earl, whose family estate was established right there.

Yet, for reasons unknown, that earl had somehow offended the Tiger King; not only was he stripped of his title, but all the lands under his name—including that mountain—were confiscated by the Tiger King.

Whether by coincidence or design, the Second Prince had remarked that he enjoyed studying occultism, but certain experiments were inconvenient to conduct within the Royal City proper and needed to be moved to the outskirts. He had thus requested the use of that mountain from the Tiger King.

Seeing that the Second Prince only sought a two-hundred-year lease on the land, the Tiger King readily agreed.

Initially, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley had planned to wait a while longer before negotiating with the Second Prince for the use of the mountain. But the emergence of Ares Shang had left a lingering sense of unease in his heart, fueling his desire for stronger protection and a larger pool of usable manpower. He promptly decided to accelerate his timeline.

That very night, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley approached the Second Prince with a formal request to acquire the usage rights of the mountain.

Though the Second Prince appeared to be on intimate terms with the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley, he was secretly keeping his guard up against him.

The Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley was well aware of this; just because they both hailed from the Fadel Continent didn't mean they could blindly trust each other.

However, since their ultimate goals aligned, cooperating would yield far greater benefits before the final contention. After pondering the matter for a moment, the Second Prince agreed to the acquisition request.

Primarily, the trade item produced by the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley was something he simply could not refuse.

It was magic crystals!

Magic crystals—the objects of his desperate yearning, which he had sought for decades without finding!

He was a mages, and an elite among mages at that: an Intermediate Magus.

Yet, no matter how formidable a mage might be, lacking magic power to utilize rendered one utterly powerless.

Now, with the magic crystals traded to him by the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley—even if the quantity was modest—he could accomplish a great many things.

Securing the mountain that very night, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley immediately set to work laying out arrays.

He wanted to link this teleportation array directly with the one in Heaven-Abandoned Valley.

While his mastery of spatial arrays was limited, making slight modifications to the destination of a short-range teleportation array was well within his capabilities.

Once the arrays were linked, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley issued a quest back in Heaven-Abandoned Valley, recruiting players to use the teleportation array to travel directly to the Royal City.

With this array in place, any players who died in the Royal City from then on could resurrect in Heaven-Abandoned Valley and immediately take the teleportation array straight back.

Although the energy consumption was slightly higher, the power source for the array wasn't magic crystals, but rather the ambient earth energy of the land. He had no qualms about squandering resources that didn't belong to him. The Orc Continent was merely a stepping stone for his ascent to godhood; it mattered not to him if the land grew barren. In fact, a harsher, more desolate environment would only better aid him in gathering faith in the future.

chunks.chineseText:
第162章 獭金家覆灭

八卦报第六期的新闻头条总算不再和王室有关联，而是第一期一条新闻的后续。

【空间储物工具的重要炼制原料，夜空星石！

继本报记者潜伏调查得知，围绕夜空星石，多方势力被搅入夜空星石的争夺战。王城大商人獭金更为此得罪了丹顿家族商队……】

这条新闻讲述了象国商人因为夜空星石失踪的始末，最后查明这名象国商人在被人劫持后又被人所救，象国商人逃出虎国王城。

出于感激，也是为了报答恩人，象国商人带着救命恩人獭金一起去挖掘夜空星石。

原来，这夜空星石矿并不在象国商人的家乡，象国商人其实也留了一手，这夜空星石只是他在赶路途中偶尔发现的一种晶石，他觉得好看才制成了戒指，并不知道其珍贵性。

谁想当象国商人找到夜空星石矿时，却有人跳出来嘲笑并告知象国商人，说他的救命恩人獭金玩了一场计中计，就是为了欺骗象国商人主动说出夜空星石的产地。

象国商人痛恨獭金的欺骗，与獭金和他带的人当场打起来。

戳破獭金计谋的第三方人士原本想要等到两方打到两败俱伤，他们好坐享渔翁之利，没想到第四方也出现了。

第四方人士竟和丹顿家族有关，更是王后的人马，他们知道了星空夜石的事，发现其中利益极大，就也跟着插了一脚。偷偷跟在象国商人身后，一路跟到夜空星石矿这里。

四方人马为了夜空星石矿大打出手。

象国商人败退逃跑，夜空星石矿最终落到王后派来的人手中。

象国商人逃走后越想越愤怒，激愤之下携带违禁炼金物品偷偷溜回夜空星石矿，把整个夜空星石矿连同占领矿坑的人一同炸毁。

而这名象国商人也在爆炸中身亡。

大爆炸后，獭金的人、王后的人，和其他不明人士都在拼命挖掘夜空星石矿，却失望的发现这些夜空星石只有表面那一层，而且只有一个坑洞中有。

之后有人推断这夜空星石并不是兽人大陆原本的矿物，很可能来自天外，原本是一颗陨石，砸到山中，落地的陨石碎裂，变成了一个小小的夜空星石矿坑。

夜空星石矿消失，众人想要发大财的梦也就此消失，现在夜空星石只剩下最初挖出的一小箱。

这一小箱夜空星石辗转多人之手，终于被运回王城，很可能会出现在春季材料展销大会中。

因为夜空星石掀起的波澜还在持续。

獭金原本也算是王后的人，可丹顿侯爵一家被软禁后，丹顿商队的实力也跟着大大降低，虽然有王后撑腰，但也不敢再像以前那么嚣张。

獭金在发现夜空星石后，认为这是他们家发展的机会。知道丹顿商队插足后，也不想放过这个大好机会。

而獭金不想放弃夜空星石的另一个重要原因就是，这夜空星石是制作空间道具的重要原材料，而王城现在最出名的空储炼金大师就是阿瑞斯商。

阿瑞斯商为了给拉斐尔出气，把獭金的儿子獭德剩下的一支胳膊也给斩断，獭金父子对其简直恨之入骨。

如今有机会掌控空储原材料，能掐住阿瑞斯商的脖子，獭金自然不想放弃这个机会。

可丹顿商队同样不想放弃夜空星石，最后他们依仗王后的名头，硬是抢下了夜空星石矿坑的挖掘权，挖出了一小箱。

最后夜空星石矿坑被毁，那仅仅一小箱的夜空星石也就显得越发珍贵。

可就在丹顿商队秘密带着这一小箱夜空星石前往王城的途中，有人截杀了他们，抢走了那一小箱星空夜石。

还活着的丹顿商队成员偶尔拽下那几个蒙面强盗中一人的面巾，发现对方长得很像是他见过的獭金家的一个打手。

丹顿商队找上獭金家，獭金矢口否认，表示他们绝没有抢夺那一小箱星空夜石。

丹顿商队管事不信，逼迫獭金必须交出凶手和星空夜石。

獭金坚持声称他们是被诬陷的。

丹顿商队则认定獭金狡猾。

丹顿商队步步紧逼，獭金也不想后退，双方闹得很难看。

偏偏王后这段时间因为八卦报上曝光的一些事情，也很是焦头烂额，根本没心情去管手下这些狗屁倒灶的事情，丹顿商队的人来哭诉，她自然偏心丹顿家族这边，派人把獭金狠狠斥责了一顿，并责令他必须交出凶手和星空夜石。

獭金气到吐血，他是真的没有抢夺星空夜石，可王后那边却不信。

眼看獭金死活不肯交出凶手和星空夜石，正在火头上的王后暴怒，认为獭金现在看她落在下风就不再把她这位王后放在眼中，当即就让人打压獭金家族的商行，并给獭金家族找各种麻烦。

老话说民不与官斗，獭金能成为大商人，也是靠的王后这座靠山。

现在这座靠山不让他靠，还想压制他、压毁他，獭金顿时就不知如何是好。

眼看獭家家财在短短几天内就缩水大半，很多獭家直系子弟和关系密切者也突然就被翻出各种不法行为，要么被抓、要么被人追着打，就连没了两条胳膊的獭德也被治安局抓了去，理由是有人密告他曾强-暴女仆并致使对方流产。

偌大的獭金家族顿时呈现风雨飘摇之势，眼看就要完蛋。

獭金到处找人求救，找来找去就找到了二王子头上。

二王子听说獭金找上门，思考片刻，拒绝了见面。

他很清楚獭金是为何事，而他并不想为了这么一个就要完蛋的商人得罪正心情不好的王后。

一个商人而已，当年仗着儿子和拉斐尔的关系主动投靠王后，成为王后谋害拉斐尔的马前卒。

这种靠打压和谋害一个孩子来讨得上峰喜欢，从而获得发展的黑心商人，二王子私心里很是瞧不上这种人。更别说拉斐尔和獭金儿子獭德还曾是好友关系。

二王子正在思考要不要接受王后的“建议”。

他对王位确实有一点兴趣，如果他不能找到看得见的成神之路，那么先成为一个掌握庞大权势的国王，也不是什么坏事。

那位天残谷主也提议要和他合作，表示他手上有一些得用人手，可以为他开疆拓土，掌握更多权势。

当然那位天残谷主也不是白帮他，他想建立一个教派，为自己竖立神像，需要二王子给与官方支持。

因为兽人大陆曾经有过一个神血教，新神血皇朝的第一代帝皇就是靠这个教派坐上皇位，这件事导致之后的兽人政权包括新神血皇朝在内，对于各种教派的打压都不遗余力。

近五六百年的混乱时期，兽人大陆也冒出不少乱七八糟的教派，很多都不是什么好玩意。新生纪元后，兽人大陆各地只要能稳当下来的地方都在消灭这些教派。

现在，除了一个邪神信徒搞出的真神降临会，兽人大陆基本没有什么知名的教派。

天残谷主想要建立新教派，还想快速形成规模，没有官方支持，基本就没可能。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 162: The Fall of the Ottergold Family

The front-page headline of the sixth issue of the Royal City Tabloid finally ceased its association with the royal family, serving instead as a follow-up to a news story from the very first issue.

【Crucial Crafting Material for Spatial Storage Tools: Night Sky Starstones!

Following our reporters' undercover investigations, multiple factions have been dragged into the tug-of-war surrounding the Night Sky Starstones. Ottergold, a prominent merchant in the Royal City, even offended the Denton family caravan over this...】

This report detailed the whole saga of the Elephant Kingdom merchant who had gone missing over the Night Sky Starstones. Investigations ultimately revealed that after being waylaid and kidnapped, the Elephant Kingdom merchant had been rescued by someone, allowing him to flee the Tiger Kingdom's Royal City.

Out of gratitude and to repay his savior, the Elephant Kingdom merchant took his savior, Ottergold, along with him to unearth the Night Sky Starstones.

As it turned out, the Night Sky Starstone mine wasn't located in the Elephant Kingdom merchant's homeland; the merchant had actually kept a card up his sleeve. The Night Sky Starstones were merely a type of crystal he had occasionally stumbled upon during his travels. Finding them aesthetically pleasing, he had fashioned them into rings, completely oblivious to their true value.

Who could have anticipated that when the Elephant Kingdom merchant finally located the Night Sky Starstone mine, a third party would jump out to mock and inform him that his savior Ottergold had played a double-cross scheme precisely to trick the merchant into willingly revealing the origin of the starstones?

 Filled with bitter hatred for Ottergold's deception, the Elephant Kingdom merchant immediately clashed with Ottergold and the men he had brought along.

The third party, who had exposed Ottergold's plot, originally intended to wait until both sides battered each other to mutual destruction so they could reap the fisherman's profit, only for a fourth party to emerge.

This fourth party turned out to be connected to the Denton family and operated under the Queen's faction. Having caught wind of the Night Sky Starstones and realizing the immense profits involved, they muscled their way into the fray, secretly trailing behind the Elephant Kingdom merchant all the way to the Night Sky Starstone deposit.

Four distinct factions engaged in a brutal free-for-all over the mine.

The Elephant Kingdom merchant was defeated and forced to flee, leaving the Night Sky Starstone mine to ultimately fall into the hands of the Queen's agents.

Fleeing the scene, the Elephant Kingdom merchant grew increasingly enraged. Driven by fury, he smuggled prohibited alchemical contraband back into the Night Sky Starstone deposit and detonated the entire mine, burying the pit and everyone occupying it in a massive explosion.

The merchant himself also perished in the blast.

Following the cataclysmic explosion, Ottergold’s men, the Queen's faction, and various unidentified parties frantically excavated the site, only to discover to their profound disappointment that the Night Sky Starstones existed only as a superficial surface layer, confined entirely to that single isolated pit.

Subsequent deductions by experts suggested that the Night Sky Starstones were not native minerals of the Orc Continent at all; they likely originated from the heavens. A meteorite had slammed into the mountain, shattering upon impact to form a diminutive Night Sky Starstone pocket.

With the deposit destroyed, everyone's dreams of striking it rich vanished along with it. The only Night Sky Starstones left in existence were the ones from that initial box that had been dug out.

That single small chest of starstones had passed through numerous hands before finally being transported back to the Royal City, and it would likely make an appearance at the upcoming Spring Material Exhibition and Fair.

Yet, the ripples stirred up by the Night Sky Starstones continued to spread.

Ottergold had previously been considered part of the Queen’s faction. However, ever since Marquis Denton's family was placed under house arrest, the strength of the Denton caravan had plummeted drastically. Though still backed by the Queen, they no longer dared to act as brazenly as before.

Upon discovering the Night Sky Starstones, Ottergold viewed them as a golden opportunity for his family's expansion. Learning that the Denton caravan was meddling, he had no intention of letting such a prime opportunity slip through his fingers.

Another crucial reason Ottergold refused to give up the starstones was that they served as a vital raw material for crafting spatial artifacts, while the most renowned master of spatial alchemy in the Royal City was currently Ares Shang.

To vent his anger on behalf of Raphael, Ares Shang had sliced off Ottergold’s son, Otterde’s, remaining arm. Father and son held a bone-deep, venomous hatred toward him.

Now presented with an opportunity to monopolize the raw materials of spatial storage and essentially put a chokehold on Ares Shang, Ottergold naturally refused to abandon the pursuit.

Yet, the Denton caravan was equally unwilling to surrender the starstones. Relying on the prestige of the Queen, they forcibly snatched the excavation rights to the mine, unearthing that single small chest of stones.

In the end, with the mine destroyed, that sole chest of Night Sky Starstones appeared all the more precious.

However, just as the Denton caravan was secretly transporting this chest back to the Royal City, a group of assailants intercepted them, slaughtering the guards and absconding with the box of starstones.

A surviving member of the Denton caravan had managed to yank the veil off one of the masked bandits during the skirmish, discovering that the man bore a striking resemblance to a muscleman under the employ of the Ottergold family.

The Denton caravan immediately confronted the Ottergold family, but Ottergold flatly denied the accusation, insisting they had absolute nothing to do with the robbery of the starstones.

The Denton manager refused to believe him, demanding that Ottergold hand over the culprits and the starstones.

Ottergold maintained adamantly that they were being framed.

The Denton caravan, on the other hand, was convinced of Ottergold's cunning.

With the Denton caravan pressing harder by the step and Ottergold refusing to yield an inch, the conflict turned exceptionally ugly.

To make matters worse, the Queen had been bogged down and plagued by various scandals exposed in the tabloid during this period; she had zero leisure to manage the messy domestic squabbles of her subordinates. When the people from the Denton caravan came weeping to her with their grievances, her bias naturally tilted toward the Dentons. She dispatched agents to severely reprimand Ottergold and issued a strict ultimatum demanding he surrender the culprits and the starstones immediately.

Ottergold was so furious he coughed up blood. He truly hadn't stolen the starstones, yet the Queen's side refused to believe him.

Seeing that Ottergold stubbornly refused to hand over anyone or anything, a furious Queen—already burning with wrath—concluded that Ottergold no longer held her, the Queen, in any regard now that she had fallen from grace. She immediately ordered sanctions against the Ottergold family's commercial firms, manufacturing all sorts of trouble for them.

As the old saying went, commoners do not fight officials. Ottergold had risen to become a major merchant largely thanks to the backing of the Queen.

Now that this backing refused to support him and instead sought to suppress and crush him, Ottergold found himself utterly at a loss.

Within mere days, the vast wealth of the Ottergold family shrank by more than half. Various illicit activities involving direct descendants and close associates of the Ottergold clan were suddenly dug up and exposed; they were either dragged off to prison or hunted down in the streets. Even Otterde, who had already lost both arms, was hauled away by the security precinct under the pretense of a confidential tip alleging he had once raped a maid and caused her to miscarry.

The colossal Ottergold family instantly began to teeter in the storm, looking as though its destruction was imminent.

Desperate, Ottergold scurried everywhere seeking help, eventually finding his way to the doorstep of the Second Prince.

When word reached the Second Prince that Ottergold was seeking an audience, he pondered for a moment and flatly refused the meeting.

He was crystal clear on what Ottergold had come for, and he had no desire to offend a thoroughly disgruntled Queen over a merchant on the verge of ruin.

A mere merchant! Back then, relying on his son's relationship with Raphael, he had eagerly thrown in his lot with the Queen, serving as her vanguard in framing and harming Raphael.

Such a black-hearted merchant, one who curried favor with superiors by suppressing and destroying a child, was held in profound contempt by the Second Prince on a personal level. Not to mention, Raphael and Ottergold's son Otterde had once been close friends.

At that moment, the Second Prince was contemplating whether he should accept the Queen's "proposal."

He did indeed harbor a shred of ambition for the throne. If he found himself unable to locate a tangible path to ascend to godhood, first seizing supreme power as a monarch was hardly a bad fallback option.

That Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley had also proposed a partnership, offering to deploy some capable subordinates under his command to help him conquer territory and amass greater authority.

Naturally, the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley wasn't offering charity; he wished to establish a religious sect, erect statues in his own honor, and required official backing from the Second Prince to do so.

Because the Orc Continent had once housed the Divine Blood Cult—and the founding emperor of the New Divine Blood Empire had ridden that very cult to the throne—subsequent orcine regimes, including the New Divine Blood Empire itself, spared no effort in ruthlessly suppressing all manner of religious sects.

During the chaotic era spanning the past five or six centuries, countless messy cults had sprouted across the continent, the vast majority of which were absolute garbage. Following the dawn of the New Era, wherever stability took root across the Orc Continent, these cults were systematically eradicated.

Presently, aside from the True God Descent Cult operated by the cultists of an evil deity, there were virtually no notable religious sects left on the Orc Continent.

If the Master of Heaven-Abandoned Valley wanted to establish a new sect and rapidly scale it up, it was practically impossible without official sanction.

chunks.chineseText:
二王子作为曾经的魔导师，对于走信仰之路成神的方法有点看不上眼。

如果一个神灵靠民众信仰才能成神，那么当民众对其失去信仰时，这个神灵也可能就此陨落。

看看兽人大陆的古神，祂们不就是这么消失的吗？

他可不想步上这些古神的后路。

况且靠兽人信仰成神，很可能会被绑缚在兽人大陆上，那样跟被拘禁一样的神当了又有什么意思？

二王子想要成神，他希望是能靠自己的力量突破凡人的极限，获得可以自由翱翔宇宙的力量，他不想被任何东西限制住。

当然，如果他实在找不到靠自身力量成神的路，那么走信仰成神之路也不失一个良好选择。

至少成神后，他的寿命可以无限延长，能做的事情也更多。

如果不喜欢被信仰之力绑缚，他也可以在成神之后再想办法。

二王子思考良久，决定接受王后的建议。

接受信仰不一定非要给自己建立一个教派，成为一个让民众愿意追随的强大王者，同样可以收集信仰。

二王子府外，獭金听说二王子拒绝了他的求见，大失所望下失魂落魄地离去。

他们獭家要完蛋了。

他们獭家怎么就突然落到这个地步了。

一切似乎都是从夜空星石开始，如果他们家管事没有遇到受伤逃出的象国商人，如果他们不知道夜空星石就是空间道具的重要炼制原料，如果他们没有想着要通过原料来掐住阿瑞斯商的脖子，想要从他们家的大仇人阿瑞斯商身上赚钱，他们家也不会……

等等！

为什么他们会认定阿瑞斯商非夜空星石不可？

为什么他们会认定只要掌握了夜空星石就能掐住阿瑞斯商？

更为什么他们家管事能那么巧地遇见那名象国商人？

还有为什么不是别人来和他们争抢夜空星石，偏偏是丹顿家族的商队？

最后打劫丹顿商队抢走那一小箱夜空星石的人又是谁？

獭金越想，冷汗冒得就越多。

他们獭家是不是早就踏入了别人布置好的圈套？

所谓的夜空星石就是一个针对他们獭家的巨大阴谋？

獭金越想越觉得这个可能性非常高，但现在想明白有什么用？一切都迟了！

就算他现在求见王后，把他分析出的内容告诉王后，王后恐怕也不会相信他。

阿瑞斯商！

这个圈套肯定和阿瑞斯商有关！

他还在报复他们獭家，他根本没有因为斩断了獭德一根手臂就满足，也许他最开始要的就是毁灭整个獭家。

“哈！哈哈哈！”

突然，獭金狂笑起来。

阿瑞斯商的报复心如此之重，他能把只是谋害过拉斐尔的相关者都整成这样，那他又岂会放过其他谋害拉斐尔的主谋？

“我等着你们！等着你们和我一起落入地狱！”獭金狰狞嘶喊。

路边的人看着状若疯狂的獭金，要么避着他走，要么就盯着他看。

獭金一路怪笑，跌跌撞撞地往回走。

獭金刚到家，就看到了来逮捕他的治安官。

“獭金，你儿子供出你为了抢占市场、谋取更大利益，曾多次设局谋害其他商人，并为了获得一个炼金配方，害死了一对孤苦无依的祖孙。现在，跟我们走一趟吧！”

大商人獭金被抓，獭金家族彻底完蛋的事，自然也上了王城八卦报头条。

就在整个王城都因为八卦报曝光的各种大瓜每天都热热闹闹时，春季材料展销大会终于在万众瞩目下开幕了。
chunks.englishText:
As a former Grand Magus, the Second Prince held a rather dismissive view of ascending to godhood through the path of faith.

If a deity relied solely on the faith of mortals to achieve divinity, then the moment those mortals lost their faith, that deity would inevitably fall from grace.

Look at the ancient gods of the Beastman Continent; wasn't that precisely how they had vanished?

He had no intention of following in the footsteps of those obsolete entities.

Furthermore, attaining divinity through the faith of beastmen would likely bind him to the Beastman Continent. What was the point of becoming a god if one was merely a prisoner?

If the Second Prince wished to become a god, he hoped to shatter the limits of mortality through his own strength, acquiring the power to soar freely across the cosmos without being restricted by anything.

Of course, if he truly could not find a path to godhood through his own power, then taking the path of faith would not be a bad alternative.

At the very least, upon achieving divinity, his lifespan would be infinitely extended, and far more options would open up to him.

If he disliked being bound by the power of faith, he could always figure out a solution after ascending.

After pondering for a long time, the Second Prince decided to accept the Queen's suggestion.

Accepting faith did not necessarily mean establishing a cult for oneself; becoming a powerful monarch whom the common people were willing to follow was equally effective for gathering faith.

Outside the Second Prince's residence, Otter Gold heard that the Second Prince had refused his audience, and he departed in utter despair, his soul seemingly stripped from his body.

The Otter family was finished.

How had his Otter family suddenly fallen to this state?

It all seemed to have started with the Night Sky Starstone. If their estate manager hadn't happened to cross paths with the fleeing and wounded Elephant Kingdom merchant; if they hadn't learned that the Night Sky Starstone was a vital refining raw material for spatial artifacts; if they hadn't intended to use this material to choke the Ares Merchant and squeeze profits out of their bitter enemy, their family wouldn't have...

Wait!

Why had they been so certain that the Ares Merchant desperately needed the Night Sky Starstone?

Why had they been convinced that controlling the Night Sky Starstone would allow them to hold the Ares Merchant by the throat?

And even more puzzling, why had their estate manager happened to cross paths with that Elephant Kingdom merchant by such a sheer coincidence?

Why wasn't it anyone else competing with them for the Night Sky Starstone, but rather the Danton family's caravan?

And lastly, who on earth were the bandits who had ambushed the Danton caravan and stolen that small box of Night Sky Starstones?

The more Otter Gold thought about it, the more cold sweat poured down his back.

Had his Otter family stepped into a well-laid trap from the very beginning?

Was the so-called Night Sky Starstone nothing more than a colossal conspiracy targeting their family?

The more Otter Gold pondered, the higher the probability seemed, but what good was figuring it out now? It was far too late!

Even if he begged to see the Queen right now and laid out all his deductions, she probably wouldn't believe a word of it.

The Ares Merchant!

This trap must be connected to the Ares Merchant!

He was still retaliating against the Otter family. He had never been satisfied with merely severing one of Otter De's arms; perhaps what he had wanted from the very beginning was the complete destruction of the entire Otter clan.

"Ha! Hahaha!"

Suddenly, Otter Gold burst into wild, maniacal laughter.

The Ares Merchant's desire for revenge ran so deep. If he could reduce everyone even remotely connected to the conspiracy against Raphael to such a state, how could he possibly spare the other masterminds?

"I'll be waiting for you! Waiting for you all to tumble into hell right along with me!" Otter Gold shrieked with a savage, distorted expression.

Passersby on the street stared at the raving, madman-like Otter Gold, either giving him a wide berth or gazing at him with fixed curiosity.

Otter Gold chuckled bizarrely the entire way, stumbling as he staggered back home.

The moment Otter Gold arrived at his estate, he was greeted by the sight of magistrates waiting to arrest him.

"Otter Gold! Your son has confessed that in order to monopolize the market and secure greater profits, you repeatedly plotted against other merchants, and even murdered an isolated, helpless pair of grandparents to acquire an alchemy recipe. Now, come with us!"

The arrest of the wealthy merchant Otter Gold and the complete ruin of the Otter family naturally made the front page of the Royal City's gossip newspaper.

Just as the entire Royal City was buzzing with daily excitement over the various juicy scandals exposed by the gossip columns, the Spring Material Exhibition finally commenced amidst the eager anticipation of the masses.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第163章 材料展销会开幕 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第163章 材料展销会开幕

新生纪216年6月16日。

春季材料展销大会在王城的材料市场召开。

王城原本是圆形城墙，但经过多次扩建后就变成了不规则的圆形，比如这个材料市场就从王城边沿突出来一大块。

材料市场里面很热闹，这里不仅有炼金所需的材料，还有药剂师需要的药材，以及建筑行业需要的建材。

三者混杂，导致这块市场占地很大，但又乱中有序，整个市场被划分成五块。分别是炼金材料区、药材区、建材区、仓储区和综合展区。

今天开始举办的展销大会就被放在综合展区。

展区门口，客人络绎不绝。

展销大会分成内外两个展销区，外区随便人进出，不需要邀请函。但内区就必须要有邀请函，如果实在拿不出邀请函又想进入，就要在外区消费至少一百金达盾以上。

相当于一张邀请函就要一百金，这样一笔巨款能把绝大多数兽人拒之门外。

展销会大门口忽然冒出一阵骚动。

“看，阿瑞斯大师来了！”

“谁？谁是阿瑞斯大师？”

“就是他，气势最碉的那个。啊，他竟然带拉斐尔郎沐一起来了！”

“拉斐尔郎沐？那个拉斐尔？传说中虎王私生子那个？”

“对，就是他。”

“阿瑞斯商这是把拉斐尔郎沐追到手了吗？”

“你看他那个殷勤样，应该还没有？”

“啧，这种纨绔少爷胆子真不小，竟然敢沾惹拉斐尔郎沐。”

“一般的纨绔自然没有这个胆子，但这可是阿瑞斯大师！”

“又有车到了！那是……郎侦老伯爵？”

“没想到这位老伯爵竟然也来了，还带了老伯爵夫人一起，真是稀罕事。”

“是啊，这位老伯爵已经很久没有在公众场合露面。听说老伯爵夫人身体不是很好。我看她今天似乎还挺精神的样子？”

“也许就是因为老伯爵夫人的身体好转了一些，老伯爵才会带夫人出来散心？”

“哎呀！老伯爵和阿瑞斯商以及拉斐尔郎沐他们撞上了！”

阿瑞斯商对老伯爵夫妇竟然很礼貌，还退让了一步，让他们先行。

拉斐尔也对老伯爵夫妇恭敬行礼。

老伯爵夫妇对两人点头回礼。

老伯爵夫人路过拉斐尔身边时，突然抓住他的手，满脸和蔼地对他说了什么。

拉斐尔貌似有点窘。

阿瑞斯商凑过去说话。

老伯爵夫人似乎被逗乐了，掩嘴笑起来。

老伯爵用力干咳，看阿瑞斯商的目光特别犀利，跟刀子一样在他身上扫来扫去，看到拉斐尔时，目光倒是和缓不少，不过表情也不像是很高兴的样子。

“芸芸，走了。”老伯爵挽住老妻的胳膊。

老伯爵夫人被老伴这么叫习惯了，也没觉得不好意思什么的，笑眯眯地和老伯爵一起走入展销会场，她还回头对拉斐尔摇了摇手。

拉斐尔也冲着老夫人笑了笑，很温柔很软的笑容。

阿瑞斯商跟个痴汉似地盯着拉斐尔看，看他笑，也跟着露出开心笑容。

但转过头，阿瑞斯商又变成碉炸天的酷拽纨绔样。

“我们也进去吧。”阿瑞斯商伸手对拉斐尔做了个请的手势。

不帅神情淡定，无视周围人或明或暗打量他的目光，与阿瑞斯商并肩走入展销会场。

门外，很多人露出讶然神情。

“没想到郎侦老伯爵夫妇和那个拉斐尔郎沐不但认识，看起来似乎处得还很不错？”

“说来也奇怪，郎侦老伯爵夫妇竟然没有带外孙雷米尔一起过来？”

“可能是有事吧，有人看到雷米尔离开了王城，似乎是有王令在身。”

“不知道今天王室成员会不会来，如果他们看到拉斐尔郎沐……”

“好了，这种事就不要说了。”

“有什么不能说的？我看到挂着八卦报记者牌子的兽人刚刚进入会场了，不知道他们今天能逮到什么大瓜。”

“大王子肯定会来，他好像会在内部展销会开幕式露脸。”

“内部展销会开幕式几点开始？”

“快了，来的大人物越来越多了。”

刚进入展销会大门，阿瑞斯商就感觉到周围有更多打量的目光落在他们身上。

比起拉斐尔是尽量忽视打探他们的目光，阿瑞斯商是真不把别人的偷窥和打量放在眼里，旁若无人地走入展销大厅后，一双眼睛就开始扫视大厅里的一个个展位。

“我们分头行动？”不帅提议。

阿瑞斯商扭头看他，那神情……绝了。

不帅无奈：“你想一起那就一起吧。但答应我，别仗着披了这层皮就乱搞事。”

“我像是那种会故意找事的人吗？”阿瑞斯商委屈巴巴。

不帅平静地看他：你这是对自己有多不了解？

阿瑞斯商正色脸：“好吧，我答应你，只要别人不找我麻烦，我就绝不会主动出击。”

不帅轻轻点头。

阿瑞斯商这才又转头去打量那些展示出来的材料。

在黑森林深处发现一个魔晶矿后，不帅和他就在想兽人大陆其他地方是否也有魔晶矿石存在。只可惜为了防备其他魔法师，他们不能大张旗鼓地寻找魔晶矿石。

其实商非凡本人并不怎么需要魔晶，他已经琢磨出了用怨气来替代魔力的方法。

怨气在这个世界几乎无穷无尽，只要他愿意，他可以随意施展魔法。

不过学习魔法也需要时间。

他刚刚才开始进行魔法奠基，魔法种子还在培育中，并不急着跨入魔法师行列。

就算将来他开始学习魔法，他也会重点学习黑暗类魔法，到时候把黑暗类魔法和他的怨气以及咒术结合起来，不知道威力会有多大？

他很是期待。

不帅也在寻找材料。

魔晶不用愁以后，他就可以把以前很多属于魔法师的本领捡起来。

魔法师也分很多系别，能精通所有类别魔法的魔法师只有极少数，大多数魔法师都是专精一系，再辅修炼药、炼器、附魔、魔法阵之类的专业。

不帅原本并无偏科，他属于学得很杂的那类魔法师，就是什么都会一点，但真说精通又说不上。

想要某系魔法达到精通，至少也得达到魔导师级别才行。

什么都会一点的不帅因为得到自然之神的奖励，在施展自然类别魔法时无论效果还是威力都更强，精神力和魔力的消耗则更低。

不帅自然而然就想在自然类魔法上多下一点工夫。

他原还想着早早结束王城这边的事，在春耕前赶回莫约镇，对莫约镇的农田施展自然类魔法，提升莫约镇的粮食产出，乃至改善莫约镇的水土。

谁想到王城这边发生了一连串的事情，如今连他的身世都来了个大翻转，在没有彻底解决这些事情之前，他也无法离开王城。

但不帅也不想把时间和精力都消耗在解决身世的问题上，他打算有时间就制作一些魔力土壤存着。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 163: The Opening of the Material Exhibition (Part 1)

June 16th, New Era Year 216.

The Spring Material Exhibition was held in the Royal City's Material Market.

The Royal City originally had circular walls, but after numerous expansions, it had transformed into an irregular circle. For instance, the Material Market protruded outwards in a massive chunk from the edge of the city.

The interior of the Material Market was bustling with activity. It not only housed materials required for alchemy, but also medicinal herbs needed by pharmacists and construction materials demanded by the building industry.

With these three categories intermingling, the market covered a vast expanse, yet it remained orderly amidst the chaos, divided into five distinct zones: the Alchemical Materials Zone, the Herb Zone, the Building Materials Zone, the Storage Zone, and the Comprehensive Exhibition Zone.

The exhibition commencing today was hosted within the Comprehensive Exhibition Zone.

At the entrance of the exhibition area, streams of guests arrived in an endless flow.

The exhibition was split into inner and outer zones. The outer zone permitted free entry and exit without requiring an invitation. However, the inner zone strictly mandated an invitation letter; for those utterly unable to produce one yet desperately wishing to enter, a minimum consumption of over one hundred gold dalduns within the outer zone was required.

Equivalent to a hundred gold coins per ticket, such an astronomical sum was enough to bar the vast majority of beastmen from entering.

A sudden commotion erupted at the grand entrance of the exhibition.

"Look, Master Ares has arrived!"

"Who? Who is Master Ares?"

"Right there, the one with the most overbearing aura. Ah, he actually brought Raphael Langmu along with him!"

"Raphael Langmu? That Raphael? The legendary illegitimate son of the Beast King?"

"Correct, that's him."

"Did this Ares Merchant actually manage to win over Raphael Langmu?"

"Judging by how ingratiating he's acting, probably not yet?"

"Tch, this kind of spoiled young master has some serious nerve, daring to trifle with Raphael Langmu."

"An ordinary wastrel naturally wouldn't have such guts, but this is Master Ares!"

"Another carriage has arrived! That is... Old Count Langzhen?"

"I never expected this old count to show up, and he even brought the Countess with him. What a rare sight."

"Indeed, it's been quite a long time since the old count last appeared in public. I heard the Countess hasn't been in good health. Look at her—doesn't she seem quite spirited today?"

"Perhaps it's precisely because the Countess's health has improved that the old count brought her out for a breath of fresh air?"

"Oh my! The old count's party has collided with the Ares Merchant and Raphael Langmu!"

Surprisingly, the Ares Merchant maintained polite etiquette toward the elderly couple, even taking a step back to let them pass first.

Raphael also offered a respectful bow to the old count and his wife.

The elderly couple nodded in return.

As the Countess passed by Raphael, she suddenly grasped his hand and spoke to him with a benevolent expression.

Raphael looked somewhat embarrassed.

The Ares Merchant leaned in to say something.

The Countess seemed thoroughly amused, covering her mouth as she giggled.

The old count gave a heavy, dry cough, fixing a razor-sharp gaze upon the Ares Merchant—his eyes sweeping over him like a pair of daggers. When his gaze shifted to Raphael, it softened considerably, though his expression still didn't look overly pleased.

"Yunyun, let's go," the old count said, hooking his arm around his aging wife's.

Accustomed to being addressed by that pet name by her husband, the Countess felt no embarrassment whatsoever. She smiled warmly as she walked into the exhibition hall with the old count, even turning back to wave at Raphael.

Raphael smiled back at the old lady—a remarkably gentle and soft smile.

The Ares Merchant stared at Raphael like a lovesick stalker, his own face breaking into a joyful grin the moment he saw the youth smile.

Yet, the instant he turned his head back, the Ares Merchant reverted to his arrogant, swaggering, over-the-top rich-boy persona.

"Let's head inside as well," the Ares Merchant said, extending a hand to gesture for Raphael to enter.

Bu Shuai maintained an indifferent expression, ignoring the overt and covert gazes sizing him up from all directions, and walked shoulder-to-shoulder with the Ares Merchant into the exhibition hall.

Outside the gates, many onlookers wore expressions of sheer astonishment.

"Who would've thought that Old Count Langzhen and his wife not only knew that Raphael Langmu, but actually seemed to be on quite good terms with him?"

"Speaking of which, it's rather strange that Old Count Langzhen and his wife didn't bring their grandson, Remil, along with them."

"Perhaps they were occupied with matters; someone saw Remil leaving the Royal City, seemingly carrying out a royal decree."

"I wonder if members of the royal family will show up today. If they happen to spot Raphael Langmu..."

"Alright, let's not talk about such things."

"What's forbidden about talking of it? I just saw a beastman wearing a gossip newspaper reporter's badge slip into the venue. Who knows what juicy gossip they might unearth today."

"The First Prince will definitely come; it seems he's scheduled to make an appearance at the inner exhibition's opening ceremony."

"What time does the inner exhibition's opening ceremony start?"

"Soon. More and more big shots are arriving."

The moment they stepped through the exhibition doors, the Ares Merchant sensed even more probing gazes locking onto them.

While Raphael tried his best to ignore the prying eyes, the Ares Merchant genuinely didn't give a damn about anyone's peeping and sizing up. Strutting into the exhibition hall as if no one else was around, his eyes immediately began scanning the various booths lining the hall.

"Shall we split up?" Bu Shuai suggested.

The Ares Merchant turned to look at him, and that expression... was priceless.

Bu Shuai sighed helplessly: "If you insist on sticking together, then let's stay together. But promise me, don't go stirring up trouble just because you're wearing this disguise."

"Do I look like the kind of person who deliberately seeks out trouble?" the Ares Merchant asked, looking deeply aggrieved.

Bu Shuai stared at him calmly: *Just how utterly lacking in self-awareness are you?*

The Ares Merchant put on a serious face: "Fine, I promise you. As long as others don't look for trouble with me, I will never strike first."

Bu Shuai nodded slightly.

Only then did the Ares Merchant turn his attention back to inspecting the displayed materials.

Ever since discovering a magic crystal mine deep within the Black Forest, he and Bu Shuai had been wondering whether magic crystal deposits existed elsewhere in the Beastman Continent. Unfortunately, to guard against other magicians, they couldn't search for magic crystal ores with great fanfare.

In truth, Shang Feifan himself didn't have much personal need for magic crystals; he had already figured out a method to use resentment energy as a substitute for magic power.

Resentment was practically infinite in this world; as long as he wished, he could cast magic at will.

However, studying magic also required time.

He had only just begun his foundational magic training, and his magic seed was still cultivating; he was in no rush to officially step into the ranks of magicians.

Even if he began learning magic in the future, he would focus primarily on dark-type magic, blending it with his resentment and curse arts. He wondered just how terrifying the resulting might would be.

He was eagerly anticipating it.

Bu Shuai was also searching for materials.

With magic crystals secured for the future, he could finally pick up many of the skills that rightfully belonged to a magician.

Magicians were divided into numerous schools. Very few could master every branch of magic; the vast majority specialized in a single branch while dabbling in auxiliary professions such as alchemy, artifact refining, enchantment, or magical arrays.

Bu Shuai hadn't originally leaned heavily toward any single subject; he belonged to that eclectic category of magicians who knew a little bit of everything, though he couldn't claim true mastery in any particular one.

To achieve mastery in a specific school of magic, one had to reach at least the Grand Magus level.

Because Bu Shuai had received a reward from the God of Nature, the effectiveness and power of the nature-type magic he cast were vastly amplified, while his consumption of mental energy and magic power was significantly reduced.

Naturally, Bu Shuai felt inclined to invest more effort into nature-type magic.

Initially, he had intended to wrap up matters in the Royal City early and rush back to Moyue Town before the spring plowing, casting nature-type magic over Moyue Town's farmland to boost crop yields and even improve the local soil and water quality.

Who could have anticipated the cascade of events that unfolded in the Royal City, culminating in the shocking upheaval surrounding his own lineage? Until these matters were completely resolved, he couldn't simply walk away from the Royal City.

Yet Bu Shuai had no desire to exhaust all his time and energy solely on untangling his family background. He planned to craft batches of magical soil whenever he had spare time and store them away.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第163章 材料展销会开幕 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
魔力土壤可以按照颗粒制作，效用很多，可以用来肥沃田地，也可以用来布置魔法阵、改变地形、填堵水患，甚至是用来躲避和攻击敌人。

当然，不同效用的魔力土壤制作方法也不尽相同，原材料更不一样。

不帅想要制作的魔力土壤不仅想要有肥沃土壤的作用，还想要具有消融虫毒乃至把虫毒能量转化为土壤养分的作用。

目标有点高，但可以一步步来嘛，可以先来一个魔力土壤1.0版。

之前商非凡在帮助夏冰解决虫毒感染时，误打误撞发现了真正消除虫毒的方法。

当时有诸多巧合。

这些巧合让商非凡和他都知道，想要真正消融虫毒，得用上系统提供的虫毒消融药剂+虫母的力量+夏冰的血+自然之生命力。

前三者，不帅无法提供，他只能在即将制作的魔力土壤中大大增加自然之生命力的浓度，提升魔力土壤对虫毒的抗性。

现在不帅就在寻找能制作魔力土壤的材料。

商非凡除了寻找魔晶，也在寻找一些炼金材料。

他的炼金术可是融合了兽人炼金与魔法炼金的新炼金术，由系统帮他融会贯通，把相关知识直接灌输进他的大脑，加上他原本的动手底子，他已经利用新炼金术做出了不少东西。

这也是他敢把空间道具卖给二王子和天残谷主的原因，对方就算能看出他的制作手法，也无法摸清他的底细。而且系统出品融合的新炼金术，他真不觉得那两人能一眼看破。

八卦报社使用的印刷机、排版机、油墨调和机，就都是出自他手。

油墨调和机是他近期才炼制出来的，送过去后，报社就不用再向油墨厂购买印刷用油墨，他们可以自己购买油墨原材料，利用那台油墨调和机自己制作需要的油墨。

这也是八卦报价格能压到十铜一份的重要原因。

他还打算改良兽人大陆使用的造纸机器。

现在兽人大陆使用的造纸术有三种。

第一种就是传统的用草本植物来当原材料，额外添加一些化学材料。

第二种则是使用皮毛、羽毛、柔软的虫翅之类物品来制作。

第三种则是近些年的创新，利用骨骼、虫蜕、甚至是矿石来制作纸张。

这三种造纸术都有专业的炼金机器辅助造纸，尤其是第三种。

商非凡想要改良的就是第三种，看能不能把各种废料融合起来制作成纸张，他想把纸张价格压到更低。

展厅里的商人很多都是外地人，但他们有不少人都听过阿瑞斯商的大名，甚至买过他的画像。

当看到阿瑞斯商和拉斐尔停在自家展位前时，该展位的商人总是很开心。

但到问价环节，这些商人就不高兴了。

这个阿瑞斯商不是说财大气粗，完全不把钱当钱吗，为什么他砍价砍得这么狠？

虽说他们看到客人是阿瑞斯商，就把价格报得稍微高了那么一点。

不帅忽然抬头，他感觉到有谁在看他，目光可比其他人尖锐多了。

但当他抬起头寻找时，那目光却不见了。

“怎么？”阿瑞斯商始终分了三分心神给不帅，当即低声问他。

不帅摇头：“没什么，我就是感觉到……啊，三王子来了。”

阿瑞斯商顺着不帅的目光看过去，就看到被一群人簇拥的三王子正往他们这边走来。

三王子的动静不小，一群人围着他，还有人正在跟他介绍什么。

三王子也算是大人物，对外展区的货物都不怎么看得上，他这是正往内展区走。

实际上，有身份的人基本不会停留在外展区，他们的目的地一开始就是内展区。

不帅想要离开，阿瑞斯商却抓住他的手。

为什么要避让？

不帅用眼睛说：你答应我不搞事？

阿瑞斯商理直气壮：我哪里搞事了？我明明就是在正大光明的看货。凭什么三王子走过来，我们就得躲开？

只想低调做人的不帅叹息，现在他们想躲也来不及了，三王子看到他们了。

作者有话说：

商非凡：今天情人节~

不帅：……
chunks.englishText:
Magical soil could be manufactured in particulate form and served a multitude of functions. It could be used to fertilize fields, construct magical arrays, alter terrain, dam floodwaters, or even evade and attack enemies.

Naturally, the production methods for magical soil with different functions varied considerably, and the raw materials differed even more.

The magical soil Bu Shuai intended to create was meant not only to act as a potent fertilizer, but also to possess the ability to dissolve insect toxins and even convert the energy of those toxins into soil nutrients.

The goal was somewhat lofty, but one could advance step by step; starting with a Version 1.0 of magical soil was entirely feasible.

Previously, when Shang Feifan was helping Xia Bing deal with her insect-toxin infection, he had stumbled upon the true method for eradicating insect poison through sheer coincidence.

Numerous fortuitous circumstances had aligned at the time.

Those coincidences made both him and Shang Feifan realize that to genuinely dissolve insect toxins, one had to utilize the insect-toxin dissolution potion provided by the system, combined with the power of the Insect Mother, Xia Bing's blood, and the vitality of nature.

The first three elements were beyond Bu Shuai's ability to provide, so he could only vastly increase the concentration of natural vitality in the magical soil he was about to manufacture, thereby boosting the soil's resistance against insect poisons.

Right now, Bu Shuai was scouring the exhibition for materials capable of producing magical soil.

Aside from magic crystals, Shang Feifan was also hunting for various alchemical ingredients.

His alchemy was a novel discipline that fused beastman alchemy with magical alchemy. Integrated seamlessly by the system, the relevant knowledge had been directly instilled into his mind. Coupled with his existing hands-on foundation, he had already crafted a considerable number of items using this new alchemical method.

This was precisely why he dared to sell spatial artifacts to the Second Prince and the Master of Heavenly Cripple Valley; even if those individuals could discern his manufacturing techniques, they could never unravel his true background. Moreover, given that the new alchemy was a fusion product of the system, he truly didn't believe those two could see through it at a glance.

The printing machines, typesetting machines, and ink mixers used by the gossip newspaper office were all crafted by his own hands.

The ink mixer was something he had refined only recently. Once delivered, the newspaper office no longer needed to purchase printing ink from external factories; instead, they could buy raw ink materials and manufacture whatever ink they required using that machine.

This was also a crucial reason why the gossip newspaper's price could be driven down to a mere ten coppers per copy.

He also intended to upgrade the papermaking machinery currently utilized across the Beastman Continent.

Presently, there were three primary papermaking techniques in use within the continent.

The first was the traditional method, employing herbaceous plants as raw materials with minor chemical additives.

The second utilized furs, feathers, soft insect wings, and similar items for production.

The third was a recent innovation from recent years, using bones, discarded insect molts, and even minerals to manufacture paper.

All three papermaking methods relied on specialized alchemical machinery to assist production, particularly the third.

What Shang Feifan wanted to improve was the third method, exploring whether various types of waste materials could be blended together to produce paper, thereby driving paper prices down even further.

Many of the merchants in the exhibition hall were from out of town, yet quite a few had heard of the legendary Ares Merchant and had even purchased his portraits.

Whenever they saw the Ares Merchant and Raphael linger before their booths, the merchants were invariably overjoyed.

However, when it came time to negotiate prices, those same merchants weren't happy at all.

Wasn't this Ares Merchant supposed to be filthy rich and completely careless with money? Why was he haggling so ruthlessly?

Granted, seeing that their customer was the Ares Merchant, they *had* marked their prices up just a tiny bit...

Suddenly, Bu Shuai raised his head. He sensed someone watching him, a gaze far sharper than anyone else's.

Yet when he lifted his gaze to scan the area, that penetrating look had vanished.

"What is it?" The Ares Merchant always kept a fraction of his attention focused on Bu Shuai, and instantly lowered his voice to ask.

Bu Shuai shook his head: "It's nothing. I just felt... Ah, the Third Prince is here."

Following Bu Shuai's line of sight, the Ares Merchant looked over and spotted the Third Prince making his way toward them, flanked by an entourage of attendants.

The Third Prince commanded quite a presence; surrounded by a crowd, someone was actively introducing various exhibits to him.

As a prominent figure, the Third Prince showed little interest in the goods displayed in the outer exhibition zone—his destination all along was the inner zone.

In truth, individuals of status rarely lingered in the outer exhibition zone; their sights were set firmly on the inner zone from the very beginning.

Bu Shuai wanted to move away, but the Ares Merchant grabbed his hand.

*Why should we dodge?*

Bu Shuai communicated with his eyes: *Didn't you promise me not to cause trouble?*

The Ares Merchant looked thoroughly justified: *How am I causing trouble? I am merely observing the goods in broad daylight. Why should we scamper off just because the Third Prince is walking over?*

Desiring nothing more than to live a low-profile life, Bu Shuai let out a sigh. It was too late to evade anyway—the Third Prince had already spotted them.

Author's Note:

Shang Feifan: Today is Valentine's Day~

Bu Shuai: ......

chunks.chineseText:
第164章 诅咒之火

三王子看到拉斐尔，表情就变了。

像是怒上心头，又像是要过来打拉斐尔。

但不知何故，三王子貌似硬生生忍住了来找拉斐尔麻烦的欲-望，眼睛扫过他，冷哼一声，对阿瑞斯商挤出一点笑容，点点头，就带着一帮拥趸向内展区走去。

不帅巴不得三王子赶紧离开才好，谁想，三王子一群人走过他们身边时。

有人忽然在他耳边低声说：“你母亲干的好事终归会报应到你头上，你和你那个贱人母亲等着王后陛下的报复吧！”

啪！

棍影扫过。

某人发出惨叫，整个人都被打飞了出去。

轰隆！噼里啪啦。

被打出去的兽人摔到了附近的摊子上。

摊主惊呼。

人群骚动。

三王子猛地停住脚步，皱眉：搞什么？

不帅无奈转头看阿瑞斯商。

阿瑞斯商提着骨杖晃了晃：“他骂你。还威胁你。”

不帅心想这种辱骂和威胁算得了什么，这种已经算程度很轻的了。而且他们骂的是安妮塔，又不是郎飞。

三王子质问发生了什么事。

展销区的人纷纷立足望向这边。

不远处，老伯爵夫妇发现这边的变故，老伯爵立刻就要过来给孙子撑腰。

老夫人抬手按住他，让他稍安勿躁。

那个被抽飞的兽人爬起来，还没来得及开口告状。

就见阿瑞斯商提起骨杖指向他，很随意地说：“这家伙在挑拨离间，他希望安妮塔夫人出手杀了你。”

被抽飞的兽人脸色大变，忙喊道：“我没有！”

阿瑞斯商露出讥讽的笑：“哦，你没有，我无聊抽着你玩。所以呢？我是在故意挑衅虎国的三王子殿下？想要在大庭广众给自己树个大敌？”

三王子脸色变得极为难看，他瞪向那名被抽飞的兽人，对手下侍卫使了个眼色。

侍卫们迅速上前控制住那名兽人。

那兽人惊慌，不住喊自己没有挑拨离间，更没有让安妮塔夫人出手杀害三王子。

三王子让侍卫把那人拖走。

“等等。”阿瑞斯商忽然叫停，“让那家伙赔偿人家摊主的损失。把人摊子砸了，想就这么离开吗？”

三王子和其他人：到底谁砸了人家的摊子？

但三王子也不想在这点小事上和阿瑞斯商争辩，直接让侍卫搜出那名兽人的钱袋，也不管里面有多少，就扔给那摊主。

摊主打开钱袋一看，顿时喜笑颜开。

那兽人被打又破财，肉疼又心疼，想到后面还要面对王宫的拷问，眼睛一翻就昏了过去。

侍卫拖死狗一样把那名兽人拖出展销区。

三王子心中特别不快，转头对阿瑞斯商说：“打狗还得看主人面，阿瑞斯大师，你说呢？”

阿瑞斯商点点头：“是啊，问题是这只狗的主人真的是三殿下你吗？”

三王子脸皮跳动，最终什么都没有说，竟然忍了下去，挥手就带人快步离开。

阿瑞斯商轻哼：“看来是被叮嘱过了。”

否则以三王子的性子，怎么可能不发作？

不帅：“死了一个五公主，对于王子公主的影响还是很大的。”

阿瑞斯商突然捏了捏不帅的耳朵。

不帅不解地看他。

阿瑞斯商笑：“想捏就捏了。”

不帅注意到附近人的目光，脸色发红，轻声说：“别闹。我没有说你刚才不该出手。”

阿瑞斯商毫不留情地指出：“但是你想忍过去。”

不帅想说多一事不如少一事。

阿瑞斯商又戳了戳他的脸颊：“有些事情不是你想躲就能躲过去。你得更换一下心态，你现在可是觉醒了多种血脉天赋的超强兽人，你完全没有必要去忍让一些不该忍让的事情，你得让人知道你的不好惹。这样，以后碍眼的虫子才会越少出现在你面前。”

不帅：“……多种血脉天赋？”

阿瑞斯商：“难道你要告诉别人你是魔法师？其实我觉得让别人知道你是魔法师也没什么，只是会稍微麻烦一点。”

不帅：“还是觉醒了多种血脉天赋吧。”

不帅决定后面就暂时只公开使用自然类魔法，让别人以为他觉醒了操纵植物的血脉天赋。

阿瑞斯商满意地点点头。这才对嘛，扮猪吃老虎不适合不帅这个身份，不帅现在就应该让别人知道他的厉害。

不远处的老伯爵夫妇看惹事的阿瑞斯商也算平稳地解决了这件事，老伯爵嘴里嘀咕几句，到底没过来。

老夫人拍了拍老伴的手臂。阿瑞斯商虽然缺点一大堆，怎么看都不是良人，但他只要肯一心一意地维护拉斐尔，那他就比别人胜出百倍千倍。

小插曲过后，两人跟没事人一样继续寻找适合的材料。

不帅经过一个卖各种杂物的摊子，停下脚步。弯腰伸手拿起摊子上摆放的一块软泥，轻轻捏了捏。

他的自然感知力告诉他：这块软泥中蕴含多种适合农作物生长的物质，非常适合用来当做炼制魔力土壤的载体。

“这块软泥怎么卖？”不帅询问摊主。

摊主嘿一声：“这可不是什么软泥。这是神血泥！”

不帅惊讶：“神血泥？”

他以为他学到的材料知识已经足够多，没想到会突然冒出一种神血泥。

摊主当即就吹嘘起来：“这神血泥出自百族战场，当时无数神血战士在那里战斗，滴落下来的血液和掉落的皮肉骨，以及他们的尸体，就化作了这神血泥。可惜那里无数怨魂聚集，加上当时打得太厉害，什么放毒、爆炸、毁天灭地的手段都在那里使用出来，导致那战场的环境都为之改变，里面瘴气弥漫、危险重重。”

摊主一抹嘴：“所以虽然这神血泥宝贵无比，但想要获得它却极不容易。我要不是机缘巧合得到这么一块，都不会特意跑来虎国这边参加展销会。客人你也是眼光毒辣，一眼就看中它。这样吧，看在你有眼光的份上，这神血泥，你给五百金，就让你拿走。”

不帅无语。五百金，真的好便宜哦。

“就这么一块泥巴，你后面的箱子里装的都是。这就是你自家田地里的泥土吧？不，也许都不是你自家田地里的，大概是你从哪家能种植的农田里偷偷挖出来的种植土。”旁边忽然响起冰冷的嘲讽声。

摊主双眼一瞪：“客人，你不懂就别乱说，这明明就是神血泥！胡扯什么种植土。”

阿瑞斯商已经对那块软泥施展过鉴定术，鉴定结果明明白白地摆在他视界中。

“要我把这块种植土的来源地说出来吗？说不定这土壤的主人就在这展销厅中。”阿瑞斯商一脸找茬的神情。

摊主脸色微变，伸手就撵人：“去去去，懒得跟你们这种不识货的人废话。不想买就离开。”

阿瑞斯商打量摊主，心里差不多有数，转头就叫巡逻兵：“喂，那边的兵哥，麻烦过来一下，这边好像有人窃取他人土壤来贩卖。”

“喂！你他……别喊别喊！我和二位有缘，这神血泥我便宜卖给你们了。”摊主跳起来小声阻止。

Chapter 164: The Fire of Curse (Part 1)

The Third Prince’s expression changed the moment he laid eyes on Aris.

It was a mix of surging rage and the urge to march right over and pummel Aris into the dirt.

Yet, for some unknown reason, the Third Prince seemed to forcibly suppress his desire to pick a fight with Aris. His gaze swept coldly past him, a forced, tight-lipped smile squeezed out as he nodded at Ares Shang. With a cold huff, he led his entourage of flatterers and sycophants deeper into the exhibition hall.

Bubu Shuai was hoping the Third Prince would hurry up and leave. But who could have predicted that as the Third Prince’s group brushed past them, someone would suddenly lean in close and mutter in his ear:

"Whatever dirty deeds your mother committed will eventually come back to haunt you. You and that whore of a mother are just waiting for Her Majesty the Queen's vengeance!"

*Crack!*

A blur of a staff swept through the air.

A miserable shriek rang out as the man was sent flying through the air.

*Boom! Crash, shatter!*

The sent-flying beastman crashed heavily into a nearby stall.

The stall owner shrieked in alarm.

The crowd erupted into an uproar.

The Third Prince stopped dead in his tracks, his brow furrowing deeply: *What in the world is going on now?*

Bubu Shuai turned helplessly to look at Ares Shang.

Ares Shang twirled his bone staff casually and gave it a light shake. "He was hurling insults at you. And making threats."

Bubu Shuai thought to himself: *What kind of insults and threats are those? That barely even scratches the surface compared to what I usually hear.* Besides, the ones they were cursing were Anita, not Lang Fei.

The Third Prince demanded to know what had just happened.

Patrons and merchants in the exhibition area stopped in their tracks, craning their necks to look over.

Not far away, the elderly Count and Countess noticed the commotion. The Count immediately moved to step forward and back up his grandson.

The elderly Countess reached out and pressed a hand on his arm, motioning for him to remain calm and wait.

The beastman who had been sent flying scrambled back to his feet, before he even had a chance to open his mouth and play the victim, Ares Shang pointed his bone staff directly at him and said with utter nonchalance, "This fellow was sowing discord, trying to instigate Lady Anita into coming here and assassinating you."

The face of the beastman who had just been smacked away drained of all color, and he hurriedly shouted, "I did no such thing!"

Ares Shang let out a mocking laugh. "Oh, you didn't? So I just randomly felt bored and smacked you around for fun. Is that it? Am I intentionally provoking His Highness the Third Prince of the Tiger Kingdom here? Am I trying to make a powerful enemy for myself in broad daylight?"

The Third Prince’s expression turned utterly hideous. He glared fiercely at the beaten beastman and shot a sharp glance at his personal guards.

The guards instantly stepped forward, pinning the beastman down and subduing him.

Panic seized the beastman, and he shrieked frantically that he had never sown discord, nor had he ever incited Lady Anita to assassinate the Third Prince.

The Third Prince ordered his guards to drag the man away.

"Hold on." Ares Shang suddenly called out a halt. "Make that fellow compensate the stall owner for his losses. You smashed up someone's stall, and you think you can just walk away like nothing happened?"

The Third Prince and everyone else thought: *Just who on earth was the one who smashed the stall?!*

However, the Third Prince had no desire to bicker with Ares Shang over such a trivial matter. He curtly ordered his guards to search the beastman’s money pouch and, without bothering to count how much was inside, tossed the entire thing at the stall owner.

The stall owner flipped open the pouch, and his face instantly bloomed into a wide, delighted grin.

Having taken a beating *and* lost his money, the beastman felt a searing ache in both his flesh and his wallet. The horrifying thought of the interrogation awaiting him back at the palace made his eyes roll back, and he promptly fainted dead away.

The guards dragged the beastman out of the exhibition area like a dead dog.

Unpleasantness churned heavily in the Third Prince's chest. He turned to Ares Shang and said stiffly, "To beat a dog, one must still look at the master's face. Master Aris, what do you have to say to that?"

Ares Shang nodded. "True enough. The only question is, is Your Highness really the master of this particular dog?"

The muscles on the Third Prince’s face twitched violently. In the end, he swallowed the bitter pill, said nothing more, and instead waved his hand to lead his people away in a brisk march.

Ares Shang let out a soft huff. "Looks like someone gave him strict orders beforehand."

Otherwise, knowing the Third Prince’s volatile temper, how could he possibly have swallowed that insult without exploding?

Bubu Shuai remarked, "The death of the Fifth Princess must still be casting a heavy shadow over the minds of the princes and princesses."

Ares Shang suddenly reached out and pinched Bubu Shuai’s ear.

Bubu Shuai looked at him in bewilderment.

Ares Shang smiled. "I wanted to pinch it, so I did."

Noticing the curious gazes of the people nearby, Bubu Shuai felt a blush creep up his cheeks and muttered softly, "Stop messing around. I'm not saying you shouldn't have made a move just now."

Ares Shang pointed out mercilessly, "But you wanted to just grit your teeth and swallow the insult."

Bubu Shuai wanted to argue that it was better to avoid trouble than to invite it.

Ares Shang gave his cheek a light poke. "There are some things in life you simply cannot dodge, no matter how hard you try. You need to adjust your mindset. Right now, you are an ultra-powerful beastman who has awakened multiple bloodline talents. There is absolutely no need for you to tolerate things you shouldn't have to bear. You need to let people know that you are not someone to be trifled with. Only then will fewer annoying pests crawl out to pester you in the future."

Bubu Shuai blinked. "......Multiple bloodline talents?"

Ares Shang asked, "Or would you prefer to announce to the world that you're a human mage? Actually, I suppose letting people know you're a mage wouldn't be the end of the world, just slightly troublesome."

Bubu Shuai decided, "Let's stick with having awakened multiple bloodline talents."

Bubu Shuai resolved that moving forward, he would temporarily only display nature-type magic in public, letting everyone assume he had awakened a bloodline talent that manipulated plant life.

Ares Shang nodded in satisfaction. *That's more like it.* Playing the pig to eat the tiger simply didn't suit Bubu Shuai's current standing; right now, Bubu Shuai needed to make his formidable prowess known to all.

Not far away, the elderly Count and Countess watched the troublemaking Ares Shang resolve the situation smoothly enough. The old Count muttered a few complaints under his breath, but ultimately decided not to come over.

The old Countess patted her husband’s arm. Though Ares Shang possessed a mountain of flaws and by no means looked like a reliable husband, as long as he was willing to wholeheartedly protect and cherish Bubu Shuai, he was a thousand times, ten thousand times better than anyone else.

After the minor interlude, the two of them acted as though nothing had happened and continued browsing for suitable materials.

As Bubu Shuai passed a stall selling various odds and ends, he stopped in his tracks. He bent down, reached out to pick up a lump of soft clay displayed on the stall, and gently squeezed it.

His natural perception told him that this lump of soft clay contained multiple substances favorable to crop growth, making it an exceptionally ideal carrier for refining magical soil.

"How much for this lump of soft clay?" Bubu Shuai asked the stall owner.

The stall owner chuckled knowingly. "This isn't just any ordinary soft clay. This is God-Blood Mud!"

Bubu Shuai stared in surprise. "God-Blood Mud?"

He had thought his acquired knowledge of crafting materials was already vast enough, but he had never expected to stumble upon something called God-Blood Mud out of nowhere.

The stall owner immediately launched into a grand boast: "This God-Blood Mud originates from the Myriad Clans Battlefield! Back then, countless God-Blood Warriors fought and bled there. The blood that dripped, the flesh and bones that fell, and even their very corpses transformed into this God-Blood Mud. Unfortunately, countless vengeful spirits gather in that place, and coupled with the ferocious combat back then—where lethal poisons, earth-shattering explosions, and world-destroying techniques were deployed—the environment of the entire battlefield was permanently altered. Miasma fills the air, and danger lurks at every turn."

The stall owner wiped his mouth and continued: "So, while this God-Blood Mud is infinitely precious, getting your hands on it is no easy feat. If I hadn't stumbled upon a piece by sheer coincidence, I wouldn't have bothered coming all the way to the Tiger Kingdom to participate in this exhibition. My friend, you certainly have a sharp eye to spot it right away. Tell you what, seeing as you appreciate its value, take this God-Blood Mud for five hundred gold coins."

Bubu Shuai was utterly speechless. *Five hundred gold coins... wow, how terribly 'cheap'.*

"Just a lump of mud like this, and you've got a whole box of it sitting right behind you. This is just dirt from your own backyard, isn't it? No, perhaps not even your backyard—you probably dug it up stealthily from someone else's arable farmland," a cold, mocking voice suddenly rang out nearby.

The stall owner’s eyes bulged. "Customer, if you don't know what you're talking about, keep your mouth shut! This is clearly God-Blood Mud! What are you blabbering about calling it farmland dirt?"

Ares Shang had already cast an Appraisal Spell on that lump of soft clay, and the appraisal results were displayed crystal-clear in his field of vision.

"Shall I spell out the exact origin of this farming soil for you? For all we know, the true owner of this dirt is sitting right here in this exhibition hall," Ares Shang said, his expression radiating pure intention to pick a fight.

The stall owner’s face shifted slightly, and he immediately waved his hands to shoo them away. "Go on, go on! I can't be bothered to argue with ignoramuses who don't know a treasure when they see one. If you're not buying, clear off."

Ares Shang sized up the stall owner, a mental calculation forming in his mind. He turned around and called out to a passing patrol guard: "Hey, buddy in uniform over there, do me a favor and come over here. It looks like someone is stealing other people's soil to peddle here."

"Hey! You bastard... Don't call them! Don't call them! It seems fate has brought the two of you and me together after all. I'll sell you this God-Blood Mud at a discount!" The stall owner jumped up in a panic, whispering in a frantic rush to stop him.

chunks.chineseText:
阿瑞斯商转过头：“多少钱，我是问那一箱子。”

摊主嘴角抽搐，五官扭曲，憋了好一会儿才憋出一个价格：“一金。”

“一箱种植土卖个一金倒也不贵，不过你这个……”

“五十银！这是最低价，大不了我不要这箱泥土，你也别想低价买到！”摊主发狠。

阿瑞斯商挥了挥骨杖：“行吧，五十银就五十银。阿沐，收起来吧。”

不帅沉默无语地把那一箱子泥土收入储物戒指。

看到拉斐尔使用储物戒指，附近的人都露出羡慕妒忌的眼神。

这可是储物戒指啊！

就问谁不想要？

阿瑞斯商不让不帅付钱，扔下五十银就拉着不帅去另外的摊子看货。

“这些金属怎么卖？”阿瑞斯商看中了某外国商人带来的矿石。

那商人看起来像个老实人，说话也特别中肯，说他这些矿石都是经过提纯的金属，杂质含量低到只有百分之五以下，不是矿原石，价格自然要高出不少。

阿瑞斯商一听他的报价，就挑眉说：“你是不是当我是人傻钱多没眼力的傻叉？就你这些杂质含量达到百分之三四十的金属块，你也敢报这样的价？来，你自己挑，你要是能从你摆出来的货物中挑出一块杂质含量低到百分之二十的，我就把你摊子上的货全都按照你的报价买下来。否则，你就等着诈骗罪被没收全部货物吧！”

阿瑞斯商抬头喊巡逻的展区工作人员：“你们这里应该有检测矿物杂质含量的仪器对吧？如果没有，我可以提供。”

工作人员一看是阿瑞斯商，头大的同时忙点头：“有的有的，而且我们展区提供第一次检测免费的服务。您是想要检测这个摊子上的矿石吗？”

摊主：“……”

最终阿瑞斯商以比正常批发价还稍低的价格买下了那摊主带来的全部矿石。

没过多时，整个展销大厅的商人都知道了一件事：千万别把阿瑞斯商当冤大头。惹恼了他，他会帮你把你的材料重新鉴定一番，鉴定后的新价格绝对会比你定的原价低一半以上。

很多来逛材料市场的客人都很羡慕阿瑞斯商的眼力，展销区龙蛇混杂，有好东西，自然也有各种假货和品质低劣的货物，想要分辨出来很是不易。

像阿瑞斯商这样拥有一双毒辣的眼睛，鉴定能力还很高，不说能淘到好货，至少不会吃亏上当。

展销区突然响起偌大响声，有人在使用扩音器对着全展销区宣布：“内部展销区开幕式即将开始，请持有邀请函的客人尽快前往内部展销区。”

不帅看向阿瑞斯商，“要去内部展销区看看吗？”

“去是要去，不过等开幕式过后再说。”阿瑞斯商毫不犹豫地说。

不帅也是这个意思，开幕式不过是听权贵轮番讲话，另外可能还有一些节目，对某些人来说能参加开幕式就是荣誉，但对他们来说就很无聊和没必要。

阿瑞斯商的目光忽然停留在附近一个摊子上。

那个摊子的规模很小，只占了三分之一个展位。

这个展位本来就不大，还分成了三个摊子，就给人很拥挤的感觉。

像这种情况在外展区不少，很多来摆摊的人并不是商人，他们只是有一些货物想要借展销会的机会销售，但又没有资格申请到展位。

于是很多拥有展位的小商人会把自己的展位租借，就造成一个展位会有多个摊主的情况。

展销区对这种情况心知肚明，不过为了丰富展销品，他们也就睁一只眼闭一只眼了。

几个玩家或蹲或坐，眼睛亮闪闪地打量着人头攒动的展销会。

他们是最近才来到王城的玩家。

路上假扮佣兵小队加入一个商队，护送了他们将近一个月时间。

这一个月因为他们积极做任务，就是各种给商队中人帮忙，无论有没有报酬都乐颠颠的。

商队对他们印象极好，听说他们要售卖在途中弄来的各种杂货，就热情邀请他们一起参加展销会，免费把展位借给了他们一部分。

这几个玩家头脑也很好，当即就联络了其他玩家，问他们有没有货物出售，他们可以帮忙代销，只要十分之一的代销费，或者玩家自己带货来卖也可以。

众多玩家们一听可以到展销会摆摊，顿时大感兴趣，纷纷表示想要加入。

阿瑞斯商并不是发现玩家才会留意这个摊子，而是感觉到这个摊子上有什么东西似乎正在呼唤他。

等到阿瑞斯商带着拉斐尔走过来，他就发现这几个兽人的异样了。

不说他们中有好几个明显的天残，就看那神情、那姿态，也和普通兽人不一样。

阿瑞斯商用鉴定术一看，就看出了他们的玩家身份。

不帅并不知道这些兽人都是玩家，他见阿瑞斯商对这个摊子上的货物感兴趣，就也蹲下来翻看。

玩家们拿出来的货物很杂，几乎什么都有。

阿瑞斯商看中的似乎是一块布巾上摆放着的首饰。

不帅看到这布巾上的首饰竟然做得都很精美，样式也和虎国流行的首饰样式有所不同。

“你这条项链怎么卖？”阿瑞斯商询问坐在布巾后面的玩家。

迷你薯饼刚才就注意到这个问价的兽人拉着另一个雄性兽人的手，直到另外一个蹲下才放开，眼中不由闪过兴奋的光。

两个帅哥！且不管看脸看体型还是看气势都是攻受分明。

“便宜卖！你看着随便给！”

阿瑞斯商：很好，不愧是玩家，就是随性。

阿瑞斯商拿起那条项链，他看中的不是项链的样式，而是项链的挂坠。

这枚挂坠是一根手指粗的柱型体，通体半透明，柱身有红色的火焰纹路缠绕，看起来十分漂亮。

不过应该不是什么宝石。

阿瑞斯商一触摸到项链挂坠，顿时肯定：就是它。就是这东西在呼唤他。

不，也许不应该说呼唤，而是这东西在吸引着他。

阿瑞斯商对柱体使用鉴定术。

他的右眼突然一阵发烫，猛地跳出一段话，几乎是在催促他一样，不断闪烁光芒。

【发现诅咒之火！】

诅咒之火？

这是什么东西？

不过和诅咒有关，那就怪不得会吸引他了。

迷你薯饼看到帅哥兽人拿起那条火焰柱体项链，露出一丝迟疑神色。

“客人，你要不要换一个？这个是我放错了。”迷你薯饼咬牙，想要收回那条项链。

她是真没注意到这条项链是什么时候混入了她摆出的首饰中。

“怎么？这条项链不卖？”阿瑞斯商问。

迷你薯饼思考两秒，还是决定说实话：“客人，我也不瞒你，这项链有点古怪，可能会影响佩戴者的运气，会让佩戴者倒霉。”

她原本很喜欢这条项链，做好就自己戴上了，结果就碰到了好些个诡异事情。

后来有觉醒了占卜血脉的玩家告诉她，说这条项链附带诅咒之力，她就吓得拿了下来。

原本她想着把这条项链交易给玩家营地的官方杂货铺，又舍不得。

Chapter 164: The Fire of Curse (Part 2)

Ares Shang turned his head back. "How much for the whole box? I asked about the box, not just this piece."

The stall owner’s mouth twitched, his features contorting into a mask of agony. He struggled internally for a long while before finally squeezing out a price: "One gold coin."

"Buying a whole box of farming soil for one gold coin isn't too expensive, but this stuff of yours..."

"Fifty silver coins! That's my rock-bottom price! If you don't want it, I'd rather throw this box of dirt away than let you snatch it for a song!" the stall owner snapped, driven to desperation.

Ares Shang flicked his bone staff. "Fine, fifty silver coins it is then. A-Mu, put it away."

Bubu Shuai silently stowed the entire box of dirt away into his storage ring.

The moment they saw Raphael use a storage ring, the onlookers nearby flashed looks of envy and jealousy.

That was a storage ring!

Who wouldn't want one?

Refusing to let Bubu Shuai pay, Ares Shang tossed fifty silver coins onto the stall and pulled Bubu Shuai away to browse other booths.

"How much for these metals?" Ares Shang had taken a liking to some raw ores brought by a foreign merchant.

The merchant looked like an honest man and spoke with a ring of sincerity, explaining that his ores were all refined metals with an impurity content dropping below five percent. Since they weren't raw unrefined ores, the price was naturally much higher.

The moment Ares Shang heard his quote, an eyebrow shot up. "Do you take me for some gullible idiot with more money than sense? You dare quote me this kind of price for metal blocks with an impurity content reaching thirty or forty percent? Come on, pick one yourself. If you can pull a single piece of metal out of your entire display whose impurity content is genuinely below twenty percent, I'll buy out every single item on your stall at your quoted price. If not, you can wait to be charged with fraud and have all your goods confiscated!"

Ares Shang raised his voice to call out to a passing exhibition hall staff member: "You guys have equipment capable of testing mineral impurity levels here, right? If not, I can provide one."

The staff member recognized Ares Shang instantly. While a headache bloomed behind his temples, he nodded hastily. "Yes, we do! Furthermore, our exhibition area offers the first test free of charge. Are you looking to test the ores at this particular stall?"

The stall owner: "..."

In the end, Ares Shang purchased the entire batch of ores brought by the merchant at a price slightly lower than normal wholesale rates.

Before long, every single merchant in the entire exhibition hall learned a golden rule: Never treat Ares Shang as a fat sheep to be fleeced. If you pissed him off, he would personally help re-appraise your materials, and the new appraised price would guaranteed be at least half lower than your original asking price.

Many patrons visiting the material market envied Ares Shang’s sharp eye. The exhibition area was a chaotic mix of dragons and snakes—while genuine treasures existed, there were also all kinds of counterfeits and substandard goods. Discerning the real from the fake was no easy feat.

Someone like Ares Shang, possessing a pair of venomous eyes and formidable appraisal skills, might not always strike it rich with legendary finds, but at least he would never be duped or cheated.

Suddenly, a loud, booming voice echoed through the exhibition area as someone used a loudspeaker to announce to the entire hall: "The opening ceremony of the inner exhibition area is about to begin. Guests holding invitation cards, please proceed to the inner exhibition area as soon as possible."

Bubu Shuai looked over at Ares Shang. "Shall we go take a look at the inner exhibition area?"

"We're going, of course, but let's wait until after the opening ceremony," Ares Shang said without hesitation.

Bubu Shuai shared the exact same sentiment. Opening ceremonies were nothing more than listening to dignitaries take turns giving long-winded speeches, occasionally accompanied by a few lackluster performances. For certain people, attending the opening ceremony was a matter of supreme honor, but to them, it was utterly tedious and entirely unnecessary.

Ares Shang’s gaze suddenly locked onto a nearby stall.

The scale of that stall was exceedingly small, occupying only a third of a standard booth space.

The booth itself wasn't large to begin with, and having been carved up into three separate stalls, it gave off a deeply cramped and cluttered feeling.

Such sights were common in the outer exhibition area. Many people who set up stalls were not professional merchants; they simply had some goods they wanted to sell by hitching a ride on the exhibition's coattails, yet lacked the qualifications to formally apply for a booth.

Consequently, many minor merchants who *did* own booths would sublet portions of their space, resulting in situations where a single booth housed multiple vendors.

The exhibition organizers were well aware of this practice, but to enrich the variety of exhibited goods, they simply turned a blind eye.

A few players, some squatting and others sitting, were scanning the bustling, head-to-head crowds with bright, shining eyes.

They were players who had arrived in the Royal City only recently.

Along the way, they had disguised themselves as a mercenary squad to join a caravan, escorting them for nearly a full month.

Throughout that month, because they actively took on quests—assisting everyone in the caravan with boundless enthusiasm, regardless of whether there was payment involved or not—they had left an exceptionally favorable impression on the caravan members.

Hearing that the players wanted to sell various odds and ends they had collected along the road, the caravan had warmly invited them to join the exhibition, freely lending them a portion of their booth space.

These few players were quite sharp-witted. They immediately contacted other players, asking if they had any goods to sell and offering to act as consignment agents for a mere ten percent commission, or allowing other players to bring their own goods to sell directly.

Upon hearing that they could set up stalls at the exhibition, the broader player base had grown immensely interested, eagerly expressing their desire to join in.

Ares Shang hadn't noticed this stall because he sensed players; rather, he felt that something within this booth seemed to be calling out to him.

By the time Ares Shang walked over with Raphael, he immediately spotted the anomalies in these beastmen.

Setting aside the fact that several of them clearly possessed physical disabilities, just their demeanor and posture alone set them apart from ordinary beastmen.

A single glance using his Appraisal Spell was all it took for Ares Shang to instantly identify their player status.

Bubu Shuai had no idea these beastmen were players. Seeing that Ares Shang was interested in the goods on this stall, he squatted down as well to browse.

The goods brought out by the players were an absolute hodgepodge, featuring virtually everything under the sun.

The item that caught Ares Shang’s eye appeared to be a collection of jewelry resting on a piece of cloth.

Bubu Shuai noticed that the jewelry displayed on the cloth was crafted with surprising exquisiteness, sporting styles distinct from the mainstream jewelry popular in the Tiger Kingdom.

"How much for this necklace?" Ares Shang asked the player sitting behind the cloth.

Mini Potato Cake had already noticed earlier that this handsome beastman was holding hands with another male beastman, only letting go when the other squatted down. Excitement had involuntarily flashed in her eyes.

*Two dashing hunks!* Regardless of whether one judged by their faces, body types, or aura, the dynamic of top and bottom was crystal-clear.

"Selling it cheap! Just name whatever price you think is fair!"

Ares Shang thought: *Very good. True to form for players, utterly casual.*

Ares Shang picked up the necklace. What caught his eye wasn't the style of the chain, but the pendant.

The pendant was a pillar-like object about the thickness of a finger, semi-transparent throughout, with red flame-like patterns winding around the body of the pillar, looking exceptionally striking.

However, it was likely not any sort of precious gemstone.

The moment Ares Shang’s fingers brushed against the necklace pendant, a wave of absolute certainty washed over him: *It’s this. This is the thing calling out to me.*

No, perhaps it wasn't accurate to call it a call; rather, this object was exerting a profound attraction over him.

Ares Shang cast an Appraisal Spell on the pillar-like object.

A sudden wave of burning heat surged into his right eye, and a line of text violently popped out, flashing with intense brilliance as if urging him forward:

【Fire of Curse discovered!】

The Fire of Curse?

What on earth was this?

Still, given that it was related to curses, it was no wonder it had managed to attract him.

Mini Potato Cake watched the handsome beastman pick up the flame-pillar necklace, a look of fleeting hesitation crossing his face.

"Customer, would you like to swap for a different one? I must have put this one out by mistake," Mini Potato Cake gritted her teeth, reaching out in an attempt to take the necklace back.

She genuinely hadn't noticed when this particular necklace had managed to slip into the assortment of jewelry she had laid out.

"What? This necklace isn't for sale?" Ares Shang asked.

Mini Potato Cake pondered for two seconds before deciding honesty was the best policy: "Customer, I won't keep it from you. This necklace is a bit strange; it might affect the wearer's luck and bring them bad fortune."

She had originally loved this necklace and wore it herself right after crafting it, only to run into a string of bizarre misfortunes shortly after.

Later on, a player who had awakened an divination bloodline told her that the necklace carried a lingering force of a curse, scaring her into taking it off immediately.

She had originally planned to trade the necklace to the official grocery store in the player camp, but she couldn't bear to part with it.

奇怪，她明明把这条项链收到了箱子底，怎么会被她放到了摊子上？

迷你薯饼想到这条项链的诡异，不由打了个哆嗦。

“哦？听起来很有意思。我买了。十金够不够？”

“够了！”迷你薯饼就没想到她制作的首饰能卖这样的高价，不由狂点头。

旁边的玩家一听迷你薯饼一条项链竟然卖出十金，疯狂羡慕。

“但是……”良知让她踌躇。

阿瑞斯商拿出十金递给迷你薯饼，当即就把那条项链收起：“不管这项链是否会影响我的运气，都是我的选择，与你无关。”

迷你薯饼见对方坚持，只能说：“那好吧，希望你不会后悔。我这边货物一旦售出，概不退换哈。”

那肯定不会。老商打算等会儿就找个地方把诅咒之火吸收融合掉。

不帅看这里摆出的首饰制作精美，样式不一，忍不住也买了两个，打算送给老伯爵夫人。

迷你薯饼摆脱了有诡异力量的项链，心里开心，给不帅的报价都不高。

等两人离开，玩家们一拥而上。

“我感觉你卖亏了。你知道刚才买你项链的是什么人吗？”一个脖子上挂着八卦记者报牌子的兽人凑近几人，神秘兮兮地说。

刚到王城不久的迷你薯饼一脸迷糊：“他是谁？”

“他就是能炼制空间储物工具的炼金大师阿瑞斯商！你别看人家年轻，他的眼力绝对不会差。”

“你是说他捡漏了？在我们的摊子上？”

“很有可能。十金对于别人很多，但对于阿瑞斯商就是毛毛雨，他肯出十金，就表示那项链绝对有超过十金的价值。”

迷你薯饼倒是很洒脱：“就算那项链价值超过十金，我无法驾驭也没用啊。那玩意和我不合！”

“也是。特殊装备虽然好，但也要看适不适用。”

“哎，你还待在这里呢？不进入内展区看看吗？听说内展区里全都是大人物！”

挂着记者证的兽人撇嘴：“那也要我能混进去。那边入口管得太严，没有邀请函就不能进去。我刚才想冒充某个权贵的随从，结果被识破。算了，我等皮蛋副主编过来，他能隐身，等会儿就靠他了。”

远处，不帅换了语言，边走边问：“那项链是不是有什么特殊的地方？”

阿瑞斯商低声回答：“嗯，那挂坠里面的东西对我的能力有用。”

“哦？那不错。”不帅一顿：“那几个兽人？”

“是不是跟其他人有点不一样？”阿瑞斯商低笑：“那几个都是玩家。”

不帅睁大眼睛：“玩家？”

这不就是说那几个人都是他的地星老乡！

“现在王城玩家多么？”不帅压低声音。

“我知道的应该有几十个。”

不帅脑中灵光一闪，“王城八卦报是不是和玩家有关。”

阿瑞斯商竖起拇指。

不帅恍然大悟。他就说哪来的兽人有那么大的胆子，不但敢揭露虎国权贵的丑闻，还敢屡次三番地刺激虎国王室。

是玩家就不奇怪了。

只要能不断复生，玩家什么不敢做？

很快，不帅就皱起眉头：“有玩家做帮手，天残谷主恐怕会变得很难对付。”

“先不急着对付他。我们先提高自己的实力。那家伙目前的实力应该比我们强，如果没有任何准备就和他对上，吃亏的很可能是我们。”老商头脑冷静。

他是很想非常想极度想要把那个曾经和不帅有过一段还渣了不帅的洛伦米尔顿给干掉，但经过上次接触，他就发现对方实力深不可测。

如果不是对方不想暴露，对方根本没必要“费了很大的劲”才抽出手。

不帅点头。他死前是大魔法师，但不代表他永远都是大魔法师，实际上他距离魔导师也就只差临门一脚。

穿到兽人大陆这些年……前面十四年不算，这七年，他一直在学习魔法，只是无法使用出来。

七年时间，虽然不至于让他立刻跃入魔导师的层次，但也让他对魔法的理解更深刻。

如今有着充足魔晶，他想他也许可以试试冲击一下魔导师境界。

两人在外展区找了一圈，并没有看到类似魔晶的存在，更没有找到蕴含魔力的物品。

“去内展区看看吧，听说那里才有真正的好东西。开幕式应该也早就结束了。”阿瑞斯商提议。

“好啊，那就过去看看。”不帅不想见到王室成员和其他权贵，不是害怕，而是嫌麻烦。

何况他现在身份改变，压根就不是虎王的私生子，这下就连最后一丝心理上的尴尬也消失无踪。

Chapter 164: The Fire of Curse (Part 3)

Strange—she clearly remembered stowing this necklace away at the very bottom of her storage box. How on earth had it ended up displayed on her stall?

The thought of the necklace's eerie nature sent a shiver down Mini Potato Cake's spine.

"Oh? Sounds fascinating. I'll buy it. Is ten gold coins enough?"

"Enough!" Mini Potato Cake had never imagined that the jewelry she crafted could command such a high price, and she nodded frantically.

Hearing that Mini Potato Cake had sold a single necklace for ten gold coins, the surrounding players were consumed with raging envy.

"However..." Her conscience made her hesitate.

Ares Shang produced ten gold coins, handed them to Mini Potato Cake, and promptly stowed the necklace away. "Regardless of whether this necklace affects my luck or not, it is my choice, and it has nothing to do with you."

Seeing the buyer remain so resolute, Mini Potato Cake could only shrug. "Very well then. I hope you won't live to regret it. Once my goods are sold, no returns or exchanges are accepted, alright?"

That certainly wouldn't happen. Lao Shang planned to find a secluded spot shortly to absorb and fuse the Fire of Curse.

Seeing that the jewelry displayed here was exquisitely crafted and uniquely styled, Bubu Shuai couldn't resist buying two pieces as well, intending to gift them to the elderly Countess.

Having unloaded the necklace plagued by eerie energies, Mini Potato Cake felt a weight lift from her chest and beamed happily, offering Bubu Shuai a very modest price for his purchases.

Once the two of them walked away, the surrounding players swarmed over.

"I think you sold that too cheap. Do you have any idea who just bought your necklace?" A beastman wearing a press badge labeled *Royal City Gossip Gazette* sidled up to them with a mysterious air.

Mini Potato Cake, who had only recently arrived in the Royal City, blinked in confusion. "Who is he?"

"He's the legendary Alchemy Master Aris, the one capable of refining spatial storage tools! Don't let his youthful appearance fool you—his eye for treasure is razor-sharp."

"You mean he picked up a supreme bargain right off our stall?"

"Highly likely. Ten gold coins is a fortune to most, but to Aris, it's pocket change. The fact that he was willing to fork over ten gold coins means that necklace is definitely worth far more than that."

Mini Potato Cake remained remarkably carefree. "Even if that necklace is worth more than ten gold coins, it's useless if I can't control it. That creepy thing and I just don't mix!"

"True. Special equipment is great, but only if it's compatible."

"Hey, why are you still hanging around here? Aren't you going to check out the inner exhibition area? I heard it's packed with big shots in there!"
