Little did he expect that he would be brought straight into the Grand Council Hall, coming face-to-face with over ninety percent of the Tiger Kingdom’s upper echelons.

Then, the Tiger King directly exposed his identity, ordering him to remove his disguise in front of everyone.

The Tiger King would have liked to spare some face for this son, but the Queen was glaring fiercely from the sidelines. If the Tiger King showed any favoritism toward Remiel, the Queen would surely find a way to make it even more humiliating for him.

The Tiger King hoped Remiel could understand his difficult position.

Yet the look Remiel gave him was filled with shock, blame, and anger.

He clearly believed that his own royal father was denying him any face.

It was undeniably humiliating for Remiel to have his disguise stripped away, but in the beginning, he genuinely hadn't thought there was anything wrong with using a disguise to stay within the royal palace, nor did he consider it a severe crime.

It was merely a small trick. He was the Tiger King's biological son; what was wrong with defying his father's orders out of a desire to stay by his side?

Surely his royal father wouldn't beat him or kill him over such a minor matter?

Unfortunately, the way things unfolded turned out completely different from Remiel's expectations...

"Other matters can wait. First, undergo a bloodline relation test with Count Langzhen," the Tiger King said, his face cold, making it impossible for anyone to guess what he was really thinking.

The old Earl and his wife did not mind shedding a few more drops of blood.

After all, the elderly couple still harbored genuine affection for Remiel.

The old lady even spoke up: "Don't be afraid; it's merely a verification. As long as you are willing, no matter the outcome, you will always be a child of our family."

Remiel stared fixedly at the two elderly people. That day, under the old Earl’s nearly explicit words, he had fled in panic, and he hadn't seen the couple since.

Neither had he been able to find his mother, Anita. Though he had left a message, he received no reply whatsoever.

He was twenty-one years old and considered himself no longer a child, yet when faced with a situation like this, he still felt somewhat at a loss for what to do.

Fortunately, Anita had instructed him long ago on how to handle such a contingency.

Remiel took a deep breath, forced a reluctant smile at the two elders, pricked his finger, and dripped a few drops of blood onto the small disc at the center of the shamanic artifact.

Anita had told him that he need not worry about this sort of bloodline test; no matter how it was tested, he would always be a descendant of the Lang family.

That day, the old Earl had brought it up so abruptly that it had caught him completely off guard. Afterward, he had been filled with endless regret.

Perhaps the old man hadn't been a hundred percent certain back then; if he had simply bluffed his way through, it might have amounted to nothing. Yet his reaction at the time... anyone who saw it would have grown suspicious.

The court shaman suddenly smiled at him.

The smile was gentle, yet it carried the unsettling air of someone who knew everything.

Remiel's heart raced. He felt as though the hundreds of gazes fixed upon him from behind were like swords and sabers, pricking his skin with a stinging pain.

Just like Raphael's blood from earlier, the drops of blood Remiel let fall rapidly split into two streams, flowing toward the blood samples left behind by the old Earl and his wife respectively.

"24.4% and 25.1%. Judging by the numerical values, the probability of Remiel being the grandchild of the Earl Lang couple is also extremely high."

The shaman slowly announced the result.

The crowd was astonished: What was going on here? Why did Remiel also share a direct blood relation with the Lang family?

"However," the shaman suddenly pointed to the shamanic artifact used for bloodline testing, "the color of the Countess's blood dish displays as blue. This indicates that she has no kinship whatsoever with Remiel—not even their beastman species match. The ancestors of the Countess’s lineage completely refuse to acknowledge Remiel as their descendant."

An uproar instantly erupted once more within the grand hall.

Remiel felt his heart thumping wildly, beating at a frantic pace.

Hadn't Anita said that no one would be able to uncover the truth?

The shaman turned toward the Tiger King: "Your Majesty, when a bloodline testing shamanic artifact yields this kind of result, there are generally only two possibilities. One is that Remiel is the descendant of a child born between the old Earl and another female beastman."

The old Earl blurted out on the spot, "Impossible! In this lifetime, I have only ever had my wife!"

The old lady patted the old Earl’s hand, signaling her trust in him.

The old Earl's chest heaved with indignation.

Raphael also gently stroked the old man's back, soothing him.

The Tiger King said with a headache, "Old Lang, let the shaman finish."

The old Earl fell silent, still fuming with anger.

The shaman continued, "Another possibility is that someone used a special mystic technique to alter Remiel's blood, merely to pass a superficial bloodline test. But such an alteration comes with a severe sequela: it makes it exceptionally difficult to awaken bloodline innate abilities. Even if one pays a massive price to barely awaken them, their power remains extremely feeble."

Remiel's expression shifted dramatically. He was indeed one who had only managed to awaken his bloodline innate ability at the age of sixteen, and the awakening process had been unimaginably arduous. Even after awakening, his powers were terribly weak.

The shaman paused for a moment before continuing: "This shamanic artifact can not only test bloodline relations but also summon the spirits of ancestors. No form of cheating can ever deceive the ancestral spirits, for they do not identify bloodline descendants merely through blood. If you all do not believe it, you may test any other person on the spot."

Shang Feifan thought to himself: *As expected of a world where black tech and the occult coexist. You thought that shamanic artifact was just testing genetic similarity, but in reality, it summoned your ancestors to watch the show.*

In Shang Feifan's understanding, the so-called ancestral spirits were likely a form of spiritual power—akin to an aggregate of family or racial faith.

As for why the ancestral spirits could tell that Remiel shared no blood relation with the old Countess, it was likely because the ancestral spirits could also perceive Remiel's bodily genetics beyond just his blood.

Living beastmen could not see what genes looked like with the naked eye, but in the eyes of a spiritual aggregate, everyone's genes were probably as conspicuous as house numbers.

The Queen's mocking voice once again echoed through the grand hall: "Heh, what meticulous planning. Just how terrified were they that Count Lang and his wife would figure out Remiel wasn't their true grandson, that they didn't even hesitate to resort to such shady methods?"

"Could this little bastard have had his blood swapped the moment he was born? Whose blood was used? Raphael's?"

"Raphael truly had it miserable, but this little bastard isn't much better off either. After all, he almost failed to awaken his bloodline innate ability entirely."

"Tsk tsk, I used to think Anita loved this son dearly, but now it seems she's nothing much. Perhaps in her eyes, everyone is merely a tool for revenge. Your Majesty, what do you think?"

The Tiger King did not wish to speak, refusing even to respond.

The Queen then looked Remiel up and down with a gaze usually reserved for cockroaches, her eyes brimming with malice: "I heard back then that the old Earl of Lang expended the greater part of his family fortune just to secure a divine blood talent-激发 ceremony so his grandson could awaken his innate abilities. It's a pity that the old Earl spent so much wealth and effort only to make wedding clothes for someone else. He poured his heart and soul into raising the child of his enemy, unaware that his true grandson was right under his nose, suffering endlessly. Remiel, don't you plan to ask your mother to repay this debt?"

"I suppose you needn't worry about your mother being unable to pay this sum. After all, after faking her death, she ended up running a brothel. Still possessing her lingering charm, she should have no shortage of wealthy patrons and must have earned quite a pretty penny."

Remiel's face flushed crimson, anger surging rapidly within him, mingling with shame and vexation. He finally experienced the exact plight Raphael had once endured, and this was only the first time.

While this Queen used to maintain a shred of decorum in the past, having now completely broken ties with the Tiger King, she truly held back no longer in her words.

chunks.chineseText:
王后不等雷米尔回嘴，又看向虎王，像是才想起来一样：“哦，如果你母亲实在付不出来，你父王应该也愿意帮你支付这笔欠债。好歹也是自己的种，怎么能干出让大臣之子当自己骨肉挡箭牌，还要那野种侵吞霸占大臣家里财产的丑事。”

整个大殿好安静，没有一个人说话。

不管地位多高的人，全都眼观鼻鼻观心。

就连三王子都老实了，噤若寒蝉。

商非凡都要开始欣赏王后，果然恶人就是要让恶人来治。

虎王终于开口：“事情还没有查清，还请王后注意口德，不要做那亲者痛仇者快的事情。”

王后发出嗤笑，“那就继续查！今天这么多人在这里，大家都是见证者，我们就查个清清楚楚明明白白，务必把拉斐尔和雷米尔的身世搞清楚。”

虎王只想这件事快点结束，主动道：“祭司，请验证我和雷米尔的血缘关系。”

祭司微微点头，十分给虎王面子，主动走上台阶。

“等等！”王后喊停：“如果雷米尔的血液被做过手脚，这么验证，又怎么能验证出结果？”

祭司淡淡道：“所以这次我们不取血，而是取毛发和皮屑进行验证。”

还是同样的巫器，只是这次放入圆盘的不是血液，而是虎王和雷米尔身上的毛发。

祭司同样没有接触这个巫器，只是默念咒语。

巫器自动发出光芒，雷米尔的毛发断成两节，有一半直接跑到了虎王放置毛发的圆盘里。

看起来很儿戏，但在场每一个人都看得特别仔细认真。

祭司宣布结果：“通过毛发，检测雷米尔和陛下的血缘关系相似度的数值为50%，证明两人乃是亲父子关系。同时祖先之灵也认可了雷米尔乃是王室血脉，且是陛下的直系亲属。”

不用祭司多说，只看虎王血盘那红得发亮的颜色就知道他和雷米尔的血缘关系有多近。

虎王放心的同时，也在心里叹息。

终于还是被揭破了。

虽然早就想到会有这么一日，但他设想的让雷米尔认祖归宗的场景可不是这样的场景。

王后则是露出了笑容，那笑容看着比往日要张扬得多，配上她的烟嗓，竟形成了一种十分独特的魅力。

可在场能并敢欣赏王后之美的人不多，很多人看到她的笑容只觉得心脏颤抖。

“二十一年啊。你和安妮塔的亲生骨肉竟然都长这么大了。”

任谁都能听出王后的声音里淬了毒。

虎王：王后绝对不能留了。不管几个儿女怎么想他，他都必须除掉这个大患！

王后单手撑住下颚，忽然看向郎侦老伯爵：“郎伯爵，你的外孙被人调换这么多年，你就没有什么想说的吗？”

老伯爵知道王后是什么意思，这是想要利用他来对付虎王，不说能把虎王拉下王位，只要能打虎王的脸、动摇他的威望，王后就也达到目的。

但老伯爵这会儿和王后立场一致，都不打算就这么放过虎王。

老伯爵当即上前一步，先行礼，再站直身体开口：“陛下，据老臣所知，当年老臣女儿和女婿全部战死后，他们带去的随从和仆人也全都要么战死，要么在几个月内接连病死或意外死亡。老臣的外孙一出生就被交到您手上。”

“当然，您日理万机，也没办法时时刻刻盯着老臣外孙。照顾老臣外孙的都是一群仆人，而谁也不知道里面是否混了一两个心怀不轨之人。”

虎王：“……是啊，关于两个孩子被调换一事，虽然时间过去良久，但只要想查还是能查出蛛丝马迹，你放心，本王一定会把这件事尽快查明，搞清楚这个换子事件背后到底是谁在搞鬼。”

“感谢陛下。”老伯爵再次行礼。

直起腰，继续说：“为了给陛下减少一点调查负担，老臣就说说自己的一些推测。”

虎王想要糊弄过去，或者找个私下的机会再和这老头好好说道说道，正要拒绝。

老伯爵已经抢先说道：“想来应该可以排除老臣女儿和女婿身边的仆从，因为他们没有理由、也没有必要去做这种事情。老臣地位不高，但好歹也是王室血脉，还有个伯爵的头衔，家里钱财不丰但也能勉强养活几个孙儿。不至于要把自己的亲孙子送去当别人的私生子。”

虎王脸黑。

不等虎王说话，老伯爵又抢着说：“最重要的是，他们没有那个能力！首先，老臣外孙被养在陛下-身边，以陛下对那孩子的重视，想来老臣女儿女婿的奴仆随从就算想要接近那孩子，也需要获得陛下允许。”

虎王张口。

老伯爵又抢先两秒：“其次，他们更不可能接近安妮塔夫人，并从安妮塔夫人那里偷到孩子，进而还能神不知鬼不觉地从陛下-身边调换两个孩子。我记得当年陛下可是派了人到安妮塔夫人身边保护她以及侍候她。”

老伯爵又道：“还有第三点，陛下您曾说过老臣女儿的孩子就跟您的孩子一样，说那孩子刚出生的时候，您一直贴身带着。所以那孩子长什么样、身上有什么特征，您和您身边的那些宫人应该是最清楚的。如果有人调换孩子，陛下和照顾孩子的仆人也不至于看不出来。”

虎王很不想说，但又不得不说：“……老伯爵分析得不错。能调换两个孩子的人必然很得本王和安妮塔的信任，并且能同时接触到两个孩子。”

艹！这跟直接说孩子就是他和安妮塔调换的又有什么区别？

虎王想到一点，又忙补充：“也许拉斐尔刚送到我身边时就已经被调换。”

老伯爵：呵！

“如果是这种情况，那雷米尔的出生时间应该比拉斐尔更早一些，且调换孩子的人早有预谋，提前一步就把孩子送到了战场，并一直在等待我女儿在战场上生育出孩子。”

听到这段话的权贵和大臣们，不少人都替虎王感到尴尬。

把一个刚出生的婴儿带到战场上，就为了等待另一个孕妇在战场上生下孩子再进行调换。不说其中变数之多，这得是什么人才能花这么大精力和代价，就为了调换两个孩子，图什么？

如果真的是对虎国王权有所图谋或者是想从虎国内部开始摧垮的人，又何必大费周章地在一个私生子身上做文章，有这个能力还不如直接对王子公主下手。

“其实想要查明这件事也很简单，只要让祭司帮忙验证一下拉斐尔和雷米尔的骨龄。”老伯爵图穷匕见。

虎王：“……”这老头子绝对是有备而来！几乎把他能找到的借口都堵死了。

宫廷祭司看向虎王：“好让陛下得知，想要准确查出两人各自详细骨龄有点难，而且每个人的骨龄并不能完全和他的真实年龄贴合，根据测试者的身体状况，骨龄有可能比实际年龄老化，也有可能更年轻化。但陛下如有需要，愿意为陛下效劳。”

虎王：“……”平时怎么不见你这么积极？
chunks.englishText:
Without waiting for Remiel to retort, the Queen looked back toward the Tiger King as if just remembering something: "Oh, if your mother truly cannot pay it off, your royal father should be willing to help you settle this debt. After all, he's his own flesh and blood; how could he stoop to the ugly deed of letting a minister's son act as a shield for his own kin, while allowing that wild brat to swallow up and usurp the Lang family's estate?"

The entire grand hall fell deathly silent. Not a single person uttered a word.

Regardless of how high their status might be, everyone kept their eyes fixed on their noses and their hearts calm.

Even the Third Prince behaved himself, trembling in terror like a cicada in late autumn.

Shang Feifan was almost starting to admire the Queen. Truly, wicked people had to be dealt with by even more wicked people.

The Tiger King finally spoke up: "The matter has yet to be fully investigated. I ask the Queen to mind her tongue and refrain from doing things that grieve loved ones and gladden foes."

The Queen let out a sneer. "Then let the investigation continue! With so many people present today as witnesses, we shall investigate this thoroughly and clearly, and make sure to get to the bottom of Raphael and Remiel's true parentage."

Wishing only for this ordeal to end quickly, the Tiger King took the initiative: "Shaman, please verify the blood relation between Remiel and myself."

The shaman nodded slightly, giving the Tiger King ample face by stepping up onto the dais himself.

"Wait!" the Queen shouted to halt him. "If Remiel's blood has been tampered with, how can this kind of verification yield any true results?"

The shaman calmly replied, "Therefore, this time we will not draw blood, but instead use hair and skin dander for verification."

It was the same shamanic artifact, except this time, what was placed onto the disc was not blood, but strands of hair from both the Tiger King and Remiel.

The shaman similarly refrained from touching the artifact, merely chanting an incantation silently.

The shamanic artifact automatically emitted a beam of light. Remiel's hair snapped into two sections, and half of it drifted directly into the disc holding the Tiger King's hair.

Though it looked somewhat like a child's game, every single person present watched with the utmost focus and seriousness.

The shaman announced the result: "Through the hair samples, the degree of bloodline similarity between Remiel and His Majesty is detected to be 50%, proving that the two are indeed biological father and son. At the same time, the ancestral spirits have also recognized Remiel as possessing royal blood and being His Majesty's direct relative."

Without the shaman needing to elaborate further, one only had to look at the brilliantly glowing red color of the Tiger King's blood dish to know just how close his blood ties with Remiel were.

While relieved, the Tiger King sighed inwardly as well.

The truth had been exposed after all.

Though he had long anticipated that such a day would come, the scenario he had envisioned for Remiel to acknowledge his ancestry and return to the clan was certainly not like this.

As for the Queen, a smile blossomed on her face—a smile that looked far more unrestrained than usual. Coupled with her husky voice, it formed a uniquely captivating allure.

Yet very few people present dared or were able to appreciate the Queen's beauty; upon seeing her smile, many felt their hearts tremble with dread.

"Twenty-one years. The biological flesh and blood shared between you and Anita has actually grown this old."

Anyone could hear the poison steeped in the Queen's voice.

*The Queen must not be allowed to live,* the Tiger King thought. *No matter what my sons and daughters think of me, I must eliminate this major threat!*

Resting her chin on one hand, the Queen suddenly looked toward Old Earl Langzhen: "Count Lang, your grandson has been swapped away for so many years. Do you have nothing to say about this?"

The old Earl knew what the Queen was getting at. She wanted to use him to strike against the Tiger King; even if it wasn't enough to pull the Tiger King from his throne, as long as she could slap him in the face and undermine his prestige, the Queen would have achieved her goal.

Yet the old Earl's stance happened to align with the Queen's at this moment—neither of them intended to let the Tiger King off so easily.

The old Earl immediately stepped forward, first offering a bow before straightening his posture to speak: "Your Majesty, as far as this old subject knows, back then when my daughter and son-in-law died in battle, all the retainers and servants accompanying them either perished in battle or fell ill and died in succession within a few months, or suffered accidental deaths. My grandson was handed over to you the moment he was born."

"Of course, with your myriad responsibilities, you naturally couldn't keep an eye on my grandson every single moment. The ones caring for my grandson were a group of servants, and no one could know whether one or two ill-intentioned individuals had mixed among them."

The Tiger King: "......Indeed. Regarding the swapping of the two children, although a long time has passed, as long as we wish to investigate, we can still unearth clues. Rest assured, We will certainly investigate this matter as swiftly as possible and figure out who is pulling the strings behind this child-swapping incident."

"Thank you, Your Majesty." The old Earl bowed once more.

Straightening his back, he continued: "To reduce Your Majesty's investigative burden, this old subject will venture to share a few of my own deductions."

Intending to brush the matter aside or find a private opportunity to reason things out properly with the old man, the Tiger King opened his mouth to refuse.

However, the old Earl preempted him: "I imagine we can rule out the servants from my daughter and son-in-law's household, for they had neither the motive nor the necessity to commit such an act. While my status is not exceptionally high, I am nonetheless of royal blood and hold the title of an Earl. Though my family's wealth is modest, it is more than enough to comfortably raise a few grandchildren. I would hardly need to send my own biological grandson away to become someone else's illegitimate child."

The Tiger King's face darkened.

Before the Tiger King could speak, the old Earl cut in again: "Most importantly, they simply lacked the capability! First of all, my grandson was raised by Your Majesty's side. Given Your Majesty's high regard for that child, even if the servants and retainers of my daughter and son-in-law had wanted to approach the child, they would have needed Your Majesty's permission."

The Tiger King parted his lips.

The old Earl preempted him by a full two seconds: "Secondly, it was even less possible for them to approach Madam Anita, steal the child from her, and then swap the two children right under Your Majesty's nose without anyone noticing. I recall that back then, Your Majesty dispatched a contingent to Madam Anita's side precisely to protect and serve her."

The old Earl went on: "And there is a third point. Your Majesty once stated that my daughter's child was just like your own, and that from the moment the child was born, you kept him constantly by your side. Therefore, what that child looked like and what physical traits he possessed should be crystal clear to you and the palace attendants around you. If someone truly swapped the children, Your Majesty and the servants tending to the child could not possibly have failed to notice."

Though he desperately wished not to speak, the Tiger King was forced to concede: "...The old Earl's analysis is sound. Whoever could swap the two children must have enjoyed deep trust from both Myself and Anita, while simultaneously having access to both children."

*Damn it!* How was this any different from outright saying that he and Anita had swapped the children themselves?

A thought suddenly occurred to the Tiger King, and he hastily supplemented: "Perhaps Raphael had already been swapped right before he was sent to my side."

The old Earl: *Heh!*

"If that were the case, then Remiel's birth time should have predated Raphael's, and whoever swapped the children must have planned it long in advance, dispatching a child to the battlefield ahead of time and simply waiting for my daughter to give birth on the battlefield so they could make the swap."

Hearing these words, quite a few of the nobles and ministers present felt an acute sense of awkwardness on behalf of the Tiger King.

To drag a newborn infant onto a battlefield simply to wait for another pregnant woman to give birth on that same battlefield just so they could make a swap—setting aside the sheer number of variables involved, what kind of person would expend such immense effort and cost merely to swap two infants? What could they possibly hope to gain?

If someone truly harbored malicious designs against the Tiger Kingdom's throne or wished to dismantle the Tiger Kingdom from within, why go to such elaborate lengths to make a fuss over an illegitimate child? With that kind of capability, they would be far better off directly targeting the princes and princesses.

"Actually, wanting to clarify this matter is quite simple. We only need to ask the shaman to help verify the bone ages of both Raphael and Remiel," the old Earl finally revealed his true intent.

The Tiger King: "..." *This old fogey came completely prepared! He's blocked off almost every excuse I could possibly use.*

The court shaman looked toward the Tiger King: "If it pleases Your Majesty, accurately determining the detailed bone ages of the two individuals is somewhat difficult. Furthermore, an individual's bone age does not always align perfectly with their true age; depending on the tester's physical condition, bone age can appear older or younger than their actual age. However, should Your Majesty require it, this subject is entirely at your service."

The Tiger King: "..." *Why are you never this proactive on ordinary days?*

chunks.chineseText:
王后发出诡异笑声，不容虎王找借口，直接说：“那就请祭司大人帮忙检测一下吧，既然都已经检测这么多了，也不差这一步。陛下，你说呢？”

虎王……面无表情地下达命令：“那就麻烦祭司了。”

祭司拿出了一个新的炼金物品。

商非凡瞄过去，惊讶。这玩意看着好现代化，甚至还有点黑科技的味道。

祭司拿着那笔一样的炼金物品对着拉斐尔和雷米尔分别扫了一扫，就给出了答案。

“陛下，检测结果出来了。雷米尔的骨龄为22岁到23岁之间，拉斐尔的骨龄……约为16岁到17岁左右。”

众人惊讶。

这个检测结果完全出乎众人意料，就连王后听到这个结果都愣了愣。

好多人都看向拉斐尔。

不帅自己也有点懵。他确实是21岁，而且应该比雷米尔大两三个月左右。

雷米尔的骨龄检测结果还算正常，他怎么会比实际年龄小那么多？

老伯爵也傻眼了，测骨龄只是为了恶心虎王，但他也没想到会测出这么一个结果。

祭司清清嗓子，倒是非常淡定地说：“这种检测结果并不奇怪，这只能说明雷米尔骨骼老化程度要比他的真实年龄要快一些。而这很可能与他刚出生时就被施展了不良术法有很大关系。毕竟不是每个人的血液都能随便换给其他人，不适合的话，对被施术者伤害很大。”

雷米尔脸色也黑了。他一直以为自己是父母心中的宝，结果发现他似乎刚出生就被自己的亲生父母毁得差不多？

祭司又解释拉斐尔的情况：“至于拉斐尔，他身体中有一种很特别的能量，这股能量在一点点蕴养并改善他的身体素质，如果仔细检测的话，我想不止他的骨骼，他的皮肤、内脏、筋膜等应该都变得更加年轻化，或者说是让他的身体状况始终处于一种最佳状态。”

不帅和商非凡同时想到了系统奖励——自然之神的青睐。

当时那个奖励就说不帅的寿命会翻一倍，且在寿命结束之前，他的身体状态都会保持在最佳。

十六七岁的身体状态不能说是最强，但这个年龄段的恢复力无疑是最好的，且潜力无穷。

老伯爵夫人听祭司直接说出拉斐尔的身体状况，有点不高兴，也有点为孙子担心。

拉斐尔看出来，轻轻握住老夫人的手，对她笑笑，小声说：“没事。”

他被暴露出来的事情已经有不少，现在再多一个也不算什么。

等到他多系天赋的秘密被暴露出来，那才会真的惊掉别人的眼睛珠子。

“你是吃了什么吗？”有人忍不住问。

谁不想长生不老？

长生不可能，不老总能追求一下吧？

甚至比起长生，青春永驻才是人们最梦寐以求的。

不帅没有回答。

问的人也没指望拉斐尔回答。

虎王是在场所有人中唯一一个觉得这个检测结果太好的人。

这个检测结果给他留住了最后一点面子。

虎王几乎是迫不及待地说：“既然骨龄检测结果无法确认雷米尔和拉斐尔谁先出生，那么我们也可以初步推断，当年阴谋者很可能先偷了雷米尔，再跟拉斐尔进行交换。桑倚林听令，这个换子案件就由你负责调查，务必要查清楚背后的阴谋者是谁。”

桑倚林，治安局最高长官，他没想到虎王竟然会把这么一个超级棘手的案子交给他来调查。

这个案子还用调查吗？

在场只要脑子清楚的人谁看不出来，这个换子案件的作案人就是虎王和安妮塔。

但虎王为了面子，自然不可能承认这件事。也不可能把情人安妮塔推出去当替罪羊，至少现在不能。

“是，陛下。卑下一定尽力而为！”桑倚林一边揣摩着虎王的意思，一边苦哈哈地接下这个任务。

好多人都给他投去同情的目光。

“嗯。”虎王一挥手，面色一正，宣布：“事情到此已经水落石出。既然祭司已经验证出结果，在场诸位也没有异议，那么从现在开始，拉斐尔和雷米尔就各归各位。”

虎王目光扫到雷米尔，心里就是一阵厌烦和不爽。

这小子等会儿再处置，先解决郎家这边再说。

老伯爵不甘，还想继续质问虎王。

不帅拉住他，对他轻轻摇了摇头。

他身后背后灵一样的某人也和他同样意见，都认为这个程度差不多了。

他们不是这场大戏的主角，安妮塔、雷米尔、王后、国王以及那些王子公主们才是。

如果老伯爵继续质问下去，虎王下不来台极有可能会干出掀桌子的事。

到时候老伯爵一家和不帅都会成为虎王的首要敌对目标。

搞不好，虎王、安妮塔、雷米尔，甚至是王后以及那些王子公主都能先联手来对付他们。

而在虎王的武力值还是虎国第一的情况下，在场的权贵和大臣们也不可能真的站到郎家这边一起对抗虎王。

那不符合那些权贵们的利益准则。

虽然老伯爵夫妇和不帅都对虎国已经没有多少留恋，但也没必要变成虎国公敌，最后落得只能逃离虎国的下场。

所以见好就收，让虎王对他们保持一个微妙的立场就好。

冷静下来的老伯爵很快也想通这些道理，明白今天只能到此为止。

实际上，按照阿瑞斯商当初的谋划，他们现在能得到这个结果已经算胜利。

至少他们堵上了虎王把换子黑水泼到郎家头上的所有可能。

现在郎家和拉斐尔不管在谁眼里都是真正的受害者，不管别人怎么骂都不可能骂到拉斐尔和郎家头上，拉斐尔本人也总算从王室那个泥坑中彻底拔了出来。

接下来他们就可以站在一边，尽情地观看狗咬狗的大戏。

虎王见郎侦老伯爵没有了进一步找他麻烦的意思，也暗暗松了口气。

但随后他就因为自己被老伯爵闹得下不来台而感到羞恼和愤怒。

就让这老头再活一段时间，等熬过传承分享大会，再设法弄死他。

虎王有了决断，把注意力又重新放回拉斐尔身上，叹息：“你在我身边多年，我虽想护住你，但对你仍旧有许多照顾不周之处，让你受了这么多年的委屈。你说，我要怎么补偿你才好？”

老伯爵不屑，他倒要听听虎王能给拉斐尔什么补偿。

周围的人也竖起了耳朵。

王后撇嘴，但也没有阻止。她和郎家以及拉斐尔结了仇没错，但她儿子没有，她可以不在乎郎家，但也没必要继续和郎家敌对。

雷米尔咬住嘴唇，他竟然羡慕起了拉斐尔郎沐。

他忍不住想，如果郎家真正的孩子是他，那么今天拉斐尔得到的一切是不是就是他的了？
chunks.englishText:
The Queen let out an eerie laugh. Giving the Tiger King no room to make excuses, she chimed in directly, "Then I must ask the High Priest to help test it. Since so many have already been checked, one more won't hurt. Your Majesty, what do you say?"

The Tiger King... ordered with a completely expressionless face, "Then I must trouble the Priest."

The Priest produced a brand-new piece of alchemical apparatus.

Shang Feifan glanced over and blinked in surprise. This contraption looked remarkably modern, even carrying a hint of black tech.

The Priest held the pen-like alchemical tool and scanned Raphael and Remiel respectively, before delivering his verdict.

"Your Majesty, the test results are out. Remiel's bone age is between 22 and 23 years old. Raphael's bone age... is approximately 16 to 17 years old."

The crowd gasped.

This test result completely exceeded everyone's expectations. Even the Queen was stunned when she heard it.

Many people cast their gazes toward Raphael.

Bu Shuai himself was somewhat baffled. He was indeed 21 years old, and should have been older than Remiel by about two or three months.

Remiel's bone-age test result was considered relatively normal, so why was he so much younger than his actual age?

The old Count was also dumbfounded. Testing bone age was merely meant to disgust the Tiger King, but he had never expected it to yield such an outcome.

The Priest cleared his throat, maintaining a remarkably calm demeanor as he explained, "This kind of test result is not actually strange. It merely indicates that the degree of skeletal aging in Remiel is somewhat faster than his true age. This is very likely related to having inauspicious sorcery cast upon him shortly after birth. After all, not everyone's blood can be casually swapped with another person's; if it's incompatible, the damage to the person receiving the spell is immense."

Remiel's complexion turned dark as well. He had always believed he was the apple of his parents' eyes, only to discover that he had apparently been nearly ruined by his biological parents right after birth?

The Priest then explained Raphael's situation: "As for Raphael, there is a very special energy residing within his body. This energy is nourishing and improving his physical constitution bit by bit. If tested carefully, I believe not only his bones, but his skin, internal organs, fascia, and other tissues have all grown younger—or rather, this energy keeps his physical condition permanently at its peak."

Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan simultaneously thought of the system reward—*The Favor of the Nature God*.

At the time, that reward stated that Bu Shuai's lifespan would be doubled, and his physical condition would remain at its absolute peak until the moment his life ended.

A physical state of sixteen or seventeen years old might not be the strongest, but the recovery rate at this age group was unquestionably the highest, brimming with infinite potential.

The Old Countess felt slightly displeased upon hearing the Priest expose Raphael's physical condition, and she grew a bit worried for her grandson.

Sensing this, Raphael gently grasped the old lady's hand, smiled at her, and whispered softly, "It's fine."

Too many things about him had already been exposed by now, so adding one more made little difference.

Once the secret of his multi-element talent was eventually brought to light, that would truly cause people's eyeballs to pop out in shock.

"Did you eat something?" someone couldn't help asking.

Who wouldn't want to attain eternal youth?

Immortality might be out of the question, but could one at least pursue eternal youthfulness?

In fact, compared to living forever, staying forever young was what people desired most in their dreams.

Bu Shuai did not answer.

Nor did the person who asked expect Raphael to reply.

The Tiger King was the only one present who thought this test result was simply fantastic.

This test outcome preserved the last shred of his dignity.

Almost impatiently, the Tiger King declared, "Since the bone-age test results cannot confirm whether Remiel or Raphael was born first, we can make a preliminary deduction that the conspirator back then likely stole Remiel first, and then swapped him with Raphael. Sang Yilin, hear my decree! This baby-swapping case shall be assigned to your jurisdiction for investigation. You must thoroughly uncover who the mastermind behind the scenes is."

Sang Yilin, the highest commander of the Security Bureau, never expected the Tiger King to hand over such an ultra-thorny case for him to investigate.

Was this case even worth investigating?

Anyone present with a clear brain could see that the perpetrators of this baby-swapping crime were none other than the Tiger King and Anita.

Yet, for the sake of his pride, the Tiger King naturally could not admit to this matter. Nor could he push his lover Anita out to take the fall—at least, not right now.

"Yes, Your Majesty! This subordinate will do his utmost!" Sang Yilin accepted the mission with a bitter expression while desperately trying to decipher the Tiger King's true intent.

Many people cast sympathetic glances his way.

"Hm." The Tiger King waved his hand, his expression turning stern as he announced, "The matter has now come to light. Since the Priest has verified the results and none present have any objections, from this moment on, Raphael and Remiel shall each return to their respective places."

The Tiger King's gaze swept over Remiel, instantly filling his heart with intense irritation and disgust.

This brat could be dealt with later; he needed to settle matters with the Lang family first.

Unreconciled, the old Count wanted to continue interrogating the Tiger King.

Bu Shuai pulled him back, shaking his head gently at him.

Someone standing right behind him like a lingering spirit shared the exact same view, both believing that this level of progress was quite enough.

They were not the protagonists of this grand drama; Anita, Remiel, the Queen, the King, and those princes and princesses were.

If the old Count were to press on with his questioning, the Tiger King might very well flip the table out of sheer inability to save face.

By then, the old Count's family and Bu Shuai would become the Tiger King's primary targets of hostility.

If things went south, the Tiger King, Anita, Remiel, and even the Queen and those princes and princesses might unite first just to deal with them.

And given that the Tiger King's combat prowess remained the highest in the Tiger Kingdom, the nobles and ministers present would never truly stand on the Lang family's side to oppose him.

That did not align with the self-interest guidelines of those nobles.

Although both the old Count's couple and Bu Shuai no longer held much lingering affection for the Tiger Kingdom, there was no need to become public enemies of the entire nation and end up forced to flee in exile.

Therefore, it was best to quit while they were ahead and let the Tiger King maintain a delicate, neutral stance toward them.

Calming down, the old Count quickly figured out these logic points and realized that today's proceedings had to end here.

In truth, according to Ares Shang's original scheme, achieving this outcome already counted as a victory.

At the very least, they had blocked off every possibility of the Tiger King splashing the dirty water of the baby-swapping scandal onto the Lang family.

Now, regardless of whose eyes they were viewed through, both the Lang family and Raphael were genuine victims. No matter how others cursed, the insults could never land on Raphael or the Lang family, and Raphael himself had finally pulled himself completely out of the muddy pit of the royal family.

Next, they could stand by the sidelines and enjoy the magnificent spectacle of dogs biting dogs.

Seeing that Old Count Lang no longer intended to cause further trouble for him, the Tiger King secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Yet, immediately afterward, he felt a surge of shame and fury at being driven into such a corner by the old Count.

He would let this old man live a little longer; once the Heritage Sharing Convention was over, he would find a way to kill him.

Having made up his mind, the Tiger King refocused his attention on Raphael and sighed. "You have stayed by my side for many years. Though I wished to protect you, there were still many aspects where I fell short in caring for you, causing you to suffer grievances for so many years. Tell me, how should I compensate you?"

The old Count sneered internally. He was eager to hear just what kind of compensation the Tiger King could possibly offer Raphael.

Those around them also pricked up their ears.

The Queen curled her lip, but did not stop him. It was true that she and the Lang family—along with Raphael—had forged a feud, but her son had not. She could care less about the Lang family, but there was no need to continue harboring hostility toward them either.

Remiel bit his lower lip, a sudden sense of envy welling up within him toward Raphael Langmu.

He couldn't help thinking: if he were the true child of the Lang family, would everything Raphael was receiving today belong to him instead?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第175章 补偿、抓捕、安妮塔的下落 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第175章 补偿、抓捕、安妮塔的下落

虎王是真心想要给拉斐尔补偿，不是他觉得对不起拉斐尔，而是想要笼络住这个唯一能抵达那座地下图书馆的人。

一想到拉斐尔将脱离他的掌控，甚至还会对他产生怨恨之心，虎王心里就再次生出一股强烈的暴躁感。

为什么那么重要的一座图书馆的进入权会落到拉斐尔手上？

为什么他堂堂虎王就没有这个机缘？

到底有没有办法真正获得那座图书馆的全部掌控权？

虎王想了想，“郎老已经公开说过，在他过世后，他的爵位就不用再传下去。既然如此，那本王就赐你新的爵位，郎老是一等伯爵，你不好超过他，就赐你为一等子爵吧。以后爵位如何，且看你的个人努力。”

老伯爵嘴角耷拉下来，表情就差没明晃晃地说出：就这？这就是你的补偿？

虎王很明智地接着说：“作为新晋子爵，本该赐你一片封地，但你也清楚，自你外祖父主动把封地全部交还给王庭开始，再有新封爵士都只有爵位和俸禄，而没有封地。”

虎王还适时给了老伯爵一个称赞的眼神。

老伯爵面无表情：所以你就是用我孙子给你私生子当挡箭牌来报答我对你集权的支持和忠心？

虎王对不帅温和一笑：“不过你情况特殊，这样吧，本王将把一片土地以租赁的形式交给你，你可以获得那片土地整整一百年的免费租赁时间，且十年之内都不用交税。一百年后，只要你还活着，你都将拥有那片土地的优先租赁权，且税额减半。”

这也是虎王的一个尝试，他希望通过这种方式兵不血刃地从各地大小贵族手中把土地全部收归国有。

而今天公开说出，也算是给那些贵族们提个醒。

在场权贵暗中交换眼色交换得飞快，如果眼神能化成光线，议事大殿内早就变成烟花祭现场。

有人希望两位大公和宰相等高位者说些什么，但那几个人始终不动如山，也不知道心里都有什么打算。

真说起来，这几位拥有的领地面积在众权贵中能排到前十。如果虎王真的要把土地全部收归国有，这几个人不可能完全没有反应。

比起官员和贵族们，王子和公主们心里则是充满羡慕。

他们虽然贵为王子公主，但他们也没有一个人拥有封地。虽然拉斐尔得到的土地只是租赁，名义上并不属于他。但一百年时间也不短了。

雷米尔更是羡慕得恨不得以身相代。

老伯爵很不客气地直接问：“那片土地在哪里？”

他这时候也没必要扮演一个忍气吞声的忠臣，也没人会相信。

实际上老伯爵就算明言挑战虎王，众人都不会奇怪。

老伯爵不想挑战虎王吗？

他非常想！

但无论拉斐尔、阿瑞斯商还是克莱门特，都不赞成他这么做。

不说老伯爵非常有可能不是虎王的对手，打完了不但不能出气，还极有可能会搞得自己重伤甚至丧命。

就算老伯爵能打得过虎王，那也必将是两败俱伤的惨胜局。

到时候郎家不但报不了仇，还变成了其他人手中对付虎王的先锋刀，怎么算这笔账都不划算。

虎王也没介意老伯爵的说话口吻，让人拿来地图，指着地图上一小片空白说：“就是这里，黑水荒原领区从金麦城往北的这一片，都是拉斐尔的租赁之地。”

虎王还特特加了一句：“不包含金麦城。里面的松山家族我还没处理干净，就不让拉斐尔烦心这家的事了。”

老伯爵鄙视：还不是金麦城也是大城，油水也多，你压根就舍不得给出来。

再看金麦城往北那一片都是什么地，全都是荒原！

不说各个大小村镇几乎全都各自独立，还有不少强盗土匪也窝在那一片。

这哪里是把土地免费租赁给拉斐尔？

明明就是想要让拉斐尔帮他打白工，等拉斐尔把那块土地全部收拢下来再梳理好，能创造出价值后，再过来收税还要收土地租赁费。

拉斐尔一死，更是可以顺理成章把那片土地全部收回。

这算计真他么绝了！

老伯爵气得要死，他对这个狗屁补偿一点都不满意。

但不帅看到那片土地的位置后，却心中一动。

那片土地正好包含了莫约镇。

这大概也是虎王的算计之一，他明知道他和莫约镇的关系有所变化，却仍旧把那片土地租赁给他，不是想要借他之手来解决莫约镇，就是想要莫约镇成为他领地中的一根刺，让莫约镇监视他。

但不帅哪会在乎这些？

虎王的赔偿对他毫无意义，有没有都一样。给他这么多土地，还不如直接给他一笔金达盾。

不过虎王真的把这片土地免费租赁给他百年，他可以把这片土地送给莫约镇镇长。再不行，他也可以转租出去换一笔现钱。

不帅正在思考要怎么处理那片土地，忽然感觉到有人在他后背写字。

商非凡：不要白不要。

“这不太好吧。”老伯爵声音阴沉地说：“陛下不是早就想要把权贵们手上的封地全部收回来吗？就算是租赁也不太适合。不如陛下直接把那片土地一百年可以产生的总价值折算成金达盾，直接补偿给拉斐尔好了。”

虎王：“……”

他不想只给钱不给土地吗？

可他现在没钱啊！

他装钱的空间腰带被人偷换走，他现在就算想要拿出大量钱财堵上拉斐尔和老伯爵的嘴都做不到。

现在，虎王也切身体会到了被“偷换”宝贝的痛楚。

为此，虎王只能挤出笑容说：“钱财虽好，到底不如土地稳妥。这样吧，十年内免税改成二十年内。有二十年时间，相信以拉斐尔的能力，一定可以把那片土地经营起来。”

老伯爵似乎非常看不上这片土地，提了个特别为难虎王的要求：“二十年不够，至少五十年。另外在拉斐尔租赁那片土地期间，他将拥有那片土地的全部管辖权，以及辖地所有官员的任命权，另外他可以自由招募民兵。”

没直接说让拉斐尔自建军队，已经是老伯爵送给虎王的遮羞布。

虎王宁可少收点税，也不可能真的让那么一大片土地完全脱离自己掌控。

“免税五十年太长，顶多三十年。拉斐尔作为那片土地的租借者，可以自由开垦田地、开采矿石以及做各种生意，但官员任命以及军队，必须由王城这边派遣和驻扎。”

老伯爵寸步不让：“那这还算什么补偿？敢情陛下你就是想要找个免费奴隶给你经营那片土地？别说什么百年免费租赁和三十年的免税，在场之人谁不清楚想要经营好一片土地，基本上赚来的都要投进去。尤其是初期，根本就是往里面砸钱砸人，还不一定能砸出效果！”

“这片土地情况如何，知道的人都知道。如果是一片好土地，你会舍得给拉斐尔？或者陛下你干脆把金麦城赔偿给拉斐尔，老臣还能看出你一点诚意！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 175: Compensation, Arrest, and Anita's Whereabouts

The Tiger King was genuinely eager to compensate Raphael—not because he felt any remorse toward him, but because he wanted to win over the only person capable of accessing that underground library.

The mere thought that Raphael was about to slip out of his control, and might even harbor resentment toward him, stirred another wave of intense irritability within the Tiger King's heart.

Why had the right to enter such a crucial library fallen into Raphael's hands?

Why did he, the grand Tiger King, lack this fortuitous encounter?

Was there truly no way to gain complete control over that library once and for all?

After pondering for a moment, the Tiger King said, "Old Lang has already publicly stated that upon his passing, his peerage will not be passed down. Since that is the case, this king shall bestow upon you a new title. Old Lang is a First-Class Count; it would not be fitting for you to surpass him, so I shall grant you the title of a First-Class Viscount. As for your future peerage, it will depend entirely on your personal efforts."

The old Count's mouth drooped into an expression that practically screamed: *Just this? Is this your compensation?*

Wisely bypassing that reaction, the Tiger King continued smoothly, "As a newly minted Viscount, you ought to be granted a fief. But as you well know, ever since your maternal grandfather voluntarily returned all his fiefs to the royal court, any newly ennobled knights receive only titles and stipends, but no fiefs."

The Tiger King even tossed an approving look toward the old Count at the appropriate moment.

The old Count remained expressionless: *So you're repaying my support for your centralization and my loyalty by using my grandson as a human shield for your illegitimate son?*

The Tiger King smiled warmly at Bu Shuai. "However, your situation is special. How about this: I shall grant you a tract of land in the form of a lease. You will receive an entire hundred years of free lease rights over that land, and you won't have to pay a single copper of tax for the first ten years. After a hundred years, as long as you are still alive, you will retain the right of first refusal for leasing that land, and the tax rate will be halved."

This was also an experimental move by the Tiger King; he hoped to use this method to quietly reclaim land from all the large and small nobles across various regions and bring it entirely under state ownership.

Announcing it publicly today could also be considered a warning to those nobles.

The dignitaries present exchanged quick glances; if gazes could be converted into light, the grand assembly hall would have long since turned into a firework festival site.

Some hoped that the two Grand Dukes, the Prime Minister, and other high-ranking figures would say something, but those few individuals remained as motionless as mountains, their inner thoughts entirely unreadable.

Truth be told, the territories owned by these few individuals ranked within the top ten among all the nobles. If the Tiger King truly intended to nationalize all land, it was impossible for them to remain completely indifferent.

Compared to the officials and nobles, the princes and princesses were filled with burning envy.

Though they held noble royal titles, not a single one of them possessed a fief. Even though the land Raphael obtained was merely leased and did not legally belong to him, a hundred years was by no means a short time.

Remiel was even more consumed with envy, wishing desperately that he could trade places with him.

Without a shred of politeness, the old Count asked bluntly, "Where is that land?"

There was no need for him to play the part of a swallowing-his-breath loyal subject at this point, nor would anyone believe it anyway.

In reality, if the old Count openly challenged the Tiger King right now, no one would find it strange.

Didn't the old Count want to challenge the Tiger King?

He wanted to immensely!

Yet whether it was Raphael, Ares Shang, or Clement, none of them supported him in doing so.

Leaving aside the high probability that the old Count was no match for the Tiger King—meaning a fight would not only fail to vent his spleen but could very well leave him heavily injured or dead—even if the old Count could defeat the Tiger King, it would undoubtedly be a tragic, mutually destructive pyrrhic victory.

By then, not only would the Lang family fail to exact revenge, but they would also become the vanguard weapon in someone else's hands to deal with the Tiger King. No matter how one calculated it, that ledger didn't add up.

The Tiger King didn't mind the old Count's tone either. He had someone bring over a map, pointed to a small blank area, and said, "Right here. The northern region of the Blackwater Wasteland territory, starting north of Golden Wheat City—all of this shall be Raphael's leased land."

The Tiger King specifically added, "Excluding Golden Wheat City. I haven't finished dealing with the Pine Mountain family there yet, so I won't let Raphael be troubled by their affairs."

The old Count sneered with contempt: *As if it's not because Golden Wheat City is a major city with deep pockets that you simply can't bear to give it up.*

And what kind of land was located north of Golden Wheat City? It was nothing but barren wasteland!

Not to mention that various large and small villages were practically independent, there were also plenty of bandits and outlaws entrenched in that area.

Was this supposed to be leasing land to Raphael for free?

It was clearly an attempt to make Raphael work for him as free labor. Once Raphael pacified that entire tract of land, sorted it out, and made it productive, the King would swoop in to collect taxes and land rental fees.

And the moment Raphael died, he could smoothly and logically take the entire territory back.

What a vicious calculation!

Furious enough to die, the old Count was utterly dissatisfied with this crappy compensation.

However, upon seeing the location of that land, a thought stirred within Bu Shuai's heart.

That plot of land happened to encompass Moyue Town.

This was probably part of the Tiger King's scheme as well. Knowing full well that the nature of his relationship with Moyue Town had shifted, the King still leased that land to him—either hoping to use his hands to resolve the Moyue Town issue, or intending to let Moyue Town remain a thorn in his side to keep him under surveillance.

Yet, how could Bu Shuai possibly care about such things?

The Tiger King's compensation held zero meaning for him; it made no difference whether he had it or not. Giving him this much land was far less useful than simply handing him a lump sum of gold shields.

Still, if the Tiger King was genuinely willing to lease this land to him for free for a century, he could gift the territory to the Mayor of Moyue Town. Failing that, he could sublease it out in exchange for a pile of hard cash.

As Bu Shuai pondered how to handle that plot of land, he suddenly felt someone tracing characters onto his back.

*Don't refuse what's given for free,* wrote Shang Feifan.

"This doesn't seem quite right," the old Count said in a gloomy voice. "Hasn't Your Majesty long wanted to take back all the fiefs in the hands of the nobles? Even a lease doesn't seem quite appropriate. Why doesn't Your Majesty simply calculate the total value that land can generate over a hundred years, convert it into gold shields, and compensate Raphael directly instead?"

The Tiger King: "……"

Did he *want* to give money instead of land?

The problem was that he had no money right now!

The spatial belt containing all his wealth had been stolen and swapped away; even if he wanted to fork over a massive amount of wealth to shut Raphael and the old Count up, he simply couldn't do it.

At long last, the Tiger King personally experienced the agonizing pain of having one's treasures "swapped away."

Forcing a smile, the Tiger King could only squeeze out, "Though wealth is fine, it ultimately lacks the stability of land. How about this: let's change the ten-year tax exemption to twenty years. With twenty years' time, I believe that with Raphael's capability, he will surely be able to develop that land."

Seeming utterly unimpressed by the land, the old Count posed a demand that deliberately made things extremely difficult for the Tiger King: "Twenty years is not enough; at least fifty years. Furthermore, during the period of Raphael's lease, he shall hold complete jurisdictional authority over that land, as well as the power to appoint all officials within his domain. In addition, he shall be permitted to freely recruit militia."

Not directly demanding that Raphael build his own private army was already the old Count's way of preserving the Tiger King's shred of dignity.

The Tiger King would rather collect slightly less tax than allow such a massive territory to slip entirely out of his control.

"A fifty-year tax exemption is too long—thirty years at most. As the lessee of that land, Raphael is free to reclaim farmland, mine ores, and engage in all sorts of businesses, but the appointment of officials and the garrisoning of troops must be dispatched and stationed by the Royal City."

Yielding not an inch, the old Count retorted, "Then how can this even be considered compensation? It sounds to me like Your Majesty is just looking for a free slave to develop that territory for you! Spare me the talk of a hundred-year free lease and a thirty-year tax exemption. Everyone present knows that wanting to develop a piece of land means pouring everything you earn right back into it. Especially in the initial stages, you're literally dumping money and manpower into a bottomless pit with no guarantee of results!

"Everyone knows what the situation in that territory is like. If it were actually good land, would you be willing to give it to Raphael? Or why doesn't Your Majesty simply compensate Raphael with Golden Wheat City? Then this old subject might at least see a shred of sincerity from you!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第175章 补偿、抓捕、安妮塔的下落 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
刚刚还很羡慕的王子公主以及雷米尔：仔细一想，好像真是这样。这片土地也许是有不少油水，但在榨出油水前，这投入恐怕就不是一笔小数目。光是清理这片土地上的强盗土匪和大大小小各自独立的村镇势力，就是一大-麻烦。

如果拉斐尔身后有庞大的家族势力帮忙还好，但郎家的情况……就剩下两个老人，领地也都献给虎王，家中奴仆和兵勇全都遣散，钱财恐怕也不算太多，真的是想要给拉斐尔支持都给不出来。

雷米尔心里也平顺了。他就说嘛，他父王怎么会对一个外人送出那么多好处。

虎王不想跟气得脸红脖子粗的老伯爵争吵，他看向拉斐尔。

拉斐尔压根不在乎什么赔偿，也不想老伯爵为这种事气坏身体，就张口想要劝阻老伯爵。

一只看不见的手捂住他的嘴。

商非凡：这时候小辈别插嘴，就让长辈帮你讨公道。便宜能多讨一点就是一点。别以为这么做没格调，利益之争就没有脸面一说。

拉斐尔好不容易才控制住自己的表情：能不能不要这么大胆！你真以为别人看不见你？

背后灵老实了。

拉斐尔也错过了劝阻老伯爵的时机。

虎王见拉斐尔原本都要说什么了，似乎又被什么转移了注意力，不禁心中满不是滋味。

原本拉斐尔可是很在意、很重视他的，可现在……

王后想要开口，但在开口之前她看到二王子对她不动声色地摇了摇头。

王后忍下。她不是想要帮助拉斐尔和郎家获得好处，她只是单纯想要和虎王作对，想要戳虎王的心肺，让他难受。

虎王这时候非常希望有人能站出来反驳老伯爵。

但他忘了，在场所有权贵都是分封制的既得利益者，帮助虎王反驳老伯爵就相当于是在支持虎王集权和把土地收归国有的行为。

虎王很快也想通了这点，他在心里破口大骂的同时，眼睛扫过几个和他利益捆绑在一起的官员和贵族。

这几人无奈，只能站出来反驳老伯爵，让他见好就收，不要太贪心。

老伯爵卷起袖子就开始破口大骂，他不跟这些人讲道理，就问他们本人如果被人调换，被人当做挡箭牌这么多年，被人成天谩骂羞辱，还不时遭到折磨和暗杀，他们是否也会这么大度地“见好就收”！

那几人就说这种换子一事陛下也是不知道的，错全部在那个阴谋者身上，陛下愿意为此事补偿拉斐尔已经足够仁慈和大度。

老伯爵被激怒了，直接就要挑战这几个跳出来的家伙。

虎王一看老伯爵一副杀不了他就要杀了那几个官员出气的势头，他当然不可能让老伯爵杀了那几人，只能再次跳入战局，和老伯爵继续扯掰给拉斐尔的补偿内容。

就这么互相扯皮了一刻钟……时间不长，但虎王已经有点精疲力尽之感。

以往都是权贵和官员们在下面为各种利益之争争吵，他坐在上面看戏，只要最后做出决断即可。

可现在他需要亲身下场和老伯爵“谈判”，还没有人能帮他，他才发现这种唇枪舌剑的交锋有多耗费心力。他真的是宁可跑到战场上和敌人打一天一夜，都不愿这么和老伯爵吵上一刻钟。

虎王再退一步，同意租赁给拉斐尔的土地不但百年内免除一切租金，且免税五十年。另，在租赁期间不帅拥有这片土地的全部管辖权和开发权，拥有一半的辖地官员任命权。还可以设置民兵团队，但包括后勤在内的所有人员数量不能超过一万。军队则由王城派遣驻扎。

老伯爵丝毫无法容忍虎王插手拉斐尔领地，自然不愿接受这样的条件。

就在这时，一直都是作壁上观的狮域大都督开口了：“郎老，陛下不是说了吗，换子事件的背后主谋者还没有抓到，等到抓到那个主谋，再让那个主谋好好赔偿拉斐尔和郎家这二十一年来的痛苦和损失。现在，您不妨先接受陛下对拉斐尔的个人补偿。”

虎王：……你这他么的是在帮我，还是在给我挖坑？

老伯爵心念一转，又看到老妻和外孙都在对他隐隐点头，脸上便做出一副勉强神情：“既然大都督都这么说了，那就先这样吧。陛下，还请正式下旨！”

虎王：你这时倒是干脆了？

虎王想说王印不在他身上，但老伯爵立刻就堵住了这个漏洞：“陛下可盖上虎爪印。”

虎王嘴角抽搐，但也不想为了这点小事继续在这件事上消耗，就很干脆地答应了。

当着在场所有人面，虎王正式赐封拉斐尔郎沐为一等子爵，并把其封为黑水荒原领区的大区长。

书记官现场写好正式的封爵令、委任状、土地租赁契约，呈交给虎王。

虎王确认无误，手掌变为虎爪，当堂盖上虎爪印。

拉斐尔上前，接过了这三样补偿。

虎王和拉斐尔说了两句场面话。

拉斐尔从头到尾保持了沉默。

而他这样的反应，没有任何人感到奇怪，也没有任何人觉得不对。

毕竟大家印象中的拉斐尔就是这样一个低调少言的人。

甚至很多人都觉得拉斐尔完全没有他们想象中那份愤怒和冤屈，他真的是太平静了。

狮域大都督轻轻叹了口气。可惜了，这么好的一个人才，却与虎国离心了。

特调局总局长奥古斯特侯爵心情更为复杂，但他这时也冒出了和狮域类似的认知：特调局恐怕留不住拉斐尔了。

拉斐尔的补偿事宜到此才真正告一段落。

虎王刚要张口说今天的廷议就到此为止，要让所有人离开。

切斯特大公表示他有话要说：“陛下，雷米尔中尉虽然是您的亲生骨肉，但他并没有被记入王室成员名单。您看今天是否需要明确他的身份？”

虎王惊讶又不解。

他从来不知道切斯特大公和雷米尔关系这么好，竟然在这时候站出来要为他争取正式的王室成员身份。

不过切斯特这么做，真的是为雷米尔着想？

王后勃然大怒。

二王子忽然对王后打了个手势。

王后讶异，忍住。

雷米尔心中又惊又喜，他也不知道切斯特大公为什么要帮他，但他也知道这是一个机会，就看虎王怎么回复。

在雷米尔想来，虎王这么在乎他，肯定会顺水推舟地接受切斯特大公的建议，把他记入王位继承人之列。

不帅拉着老伯爵夫妇火速退回人群中，一路退到他们原本该站的位置。

他们这是在让出场地，让真正的大戏出场。

虎王从没有想过要给雷米尔一个正式的王子身份，他可以公开承认对方是他的骨血，可以给他封爵、给他大堆好处，但不会把他放入王位继承人序列。

他对王后不满，但也不想让情人的孩子来扰乱王权继承。

就如他再怎么喜欢安妮塔，也不会娶安妮塔为王后。

公和私，虎王分得清清楚楚。

“不用。雷米尔被证明是我的骨肉，这就可以了。他不会是王子，也不会拥有王位继承权。”
chunks.englishText:
The prince, princess, and Remir, who had just been feeling quite envious, thought about it carefully and realized it was indeed the case. This patch of land might have some untapped potential, but before any profits could be squeezed out of it, the initial investment would be no small sum. Merely clearing out the bandits, outlaws, and the various independent village and town factions scattered across the territory was already a massive headache.

If Raphael had a powerful family backing him, it might have been manageable, but the Lang family's current situation... was left with just two old folks, their ancestral lands surrendered to the Tiger King, and all household servants and guards dismissed. Their remaining wealth probably wasn't much either; even if they wanted to provide Raphael with support, they simply didn't have the means.

Remir’s heart finally settled as well. He had known it all along—how could his Imperial Father possibly shower so many benefits upon an outsider for no reason?

Unwilling to argue with the red-faced, vein-bulging old Count, the Tiger King turned his gaze to Raphael.

Raphael didn't care about the compensation in the slightest, nor did he want the old Count to damage his health over such a matter, so he opened his mouth to dissuade him.

An invisible hand clamped over his mouth.

Shang Feifan: *Don't interrupt as a junior right now. Just let your elders fight for justice on your behalf. Grab every bit of advantage you can get. Don't think there's no dignity in this; when it comes to a struggle of interests, there's no such thing as saving face.*

With great difficulty, Raphael managed to control his facial expression: *Can you not be so bold?! Do you really think others can't see you?*

The backing spirit behaved himself.

Raphael had also missed the window to stop the old Count.

Seeing that Raphael had been about to say something before appearing to be distracted by something else again, the Tiger King couldn't help but feel a swirl of mixed emotions inside.

Originally, Raphael used to care about him a great deal, holding him in high regard, but now...

The Queen wanted to speak up, but before she could, she saw the Second Prince give her an imperceptible shake of his head.

The Queen held her tongue. It wasn't that she wanted to help Raphael and the Lang family gain benefits; she simply wanted to oppose the Tiger King, to pierce his heart and make him miserable.

At that moment, the Tiger King desperately wished someone would step forward to refute the old Count.

Yet he forgot that every noble and official present was a vested beneficiary of the feudal system. Helping the Tiger King refute the old Count was tantamount to supporting the Tiger King's centralization of power and his efforts to reclaim lands for the crown.

The Tiger King quickly realized this as well. While cursing fiercely in his heart, his eyes swept over several officials and nobles whose interests were tightly bound with his own.

Helpless, those individuals had no choice but to step out and counter the old Count, urging him to quit while he was ahead and not be too greedy.

Rolling up his sleeves, the old Count launched into a furious tirade. He didn't bother reasoning with these people; he demanded to know whether, if *they* had been swapped at birth, used as pawns for all those years, subjected to daily insults and humiliation, and periodically tormented and targeted for assassination, *they* would still be so magnanimous as to "quit while they were ahead"!

Those few officials argued that His Majesty had been entirely unaware of the baby-swapping incident, that the blame lay solely with the mastermind, and that His Majesty's willingness to compensate Raphael for this matter was already more than benevolent and magnanimous.

Enraged, the old Count directly threatened to challenge these jumping-out-of-the-woodwork fellows to a duel on the spot.

Seeing that the old Count had adopted an attitude of "if I can't kill him, I'll at least kill these officials to vent my anger," the Tiger King—knowing he could never allow the old Count to slaughter those men—had no choice but to leap back into the fray and continue haggling with the old Count over the specifics of Raphael's compensation.

Back and forth they barged for a full quarter of an hour... It wasn't a long time, but the Tiger King already felt somewhat exhausted.

In the past, it was always the nobles and officials arguing below over various clashes of interest while he sat above watching the show, stepping in only at the end to make a ruling.

Yet now, he had to personally descend into the arena to "negotiate" with the old Count, with no one to help him. Only now did he realize how mentally draining such a war of words could be. He would honestly prefer charging onto the battlefield to fight enemies for a day and a night than bickering with the old Count like this for even fifteen minutes.

The Tiger King took another step back, agreeing that the land leased to Raphael would not only be exempt from all rent for a century, but also tax-free for fifty years. Furthermore, during the lease term, Raphael would possess full jurisdiction and development rights over the land, along with a fifty percent share in appointing local officials. He was also permitted to establish a militia, though the total headcount, including logistics, could not exceed ten thousand. The regular garrison troops would be dispatched by the Royal City.

The old Count could not tolerate the Tiger King meddling in Raphael's territory in the slightest, and naturally refused to accept such terms.

At that moment, the Grand Commander of the Lion Domain, who had remained a detached spectator all along, spoke up: "Old Lang, didn't His Majesty say that the mastermind behind the baby-swapping incident has yet to be caught? Once that culprit is apprehended, we can make them pay dearly for the twenty-one years of suffering and losses inflicted upon Raphael and the Lang family. For now, you might as well accept His Majesty's personal compensation to Raphael."

The Tiger King: *...Are you fucking helping me here, or are you digging a pit for me to fall into?*

A thought flashed through the old Count's mind. Seeing his wife and grandson both subtly nodding at him, he put on a reluctant expression: "Since the Grand Commander has put it this way, let it be so for now. Your Majesty, please issue the official decree!"

The Tiger King: *You're being awfully decisive right now, aren't you?*

The Tiger King wanted to say the Royal Seal wasn't on his person, but the old Count immediately blocked that loophole: "His Majesty can stamp it with his tiger claw print."

The Tiger King's mouth twitched, but unwilling to drag this out any longer over such minor details, he flatly agreed.

Right before everyone present, the Tiger King formally conferred upon Raphael Lang Mu the title of First-Class Viscount, appointing him as the Chief Administrator of the Blackwater Wasteland territory.

The clerk hastily penned the official decree of nobility, letter of appointment, and land lease contract on the spot, presenting them to the Tiger King.

Verifying that everything was correct, the Tiger King transformed his hand into a tiger claw and stamped it on the spot before the court.

Raphael stepped forward and accepted the three items of compensation.

The Tiger King exchanged a few conventional pleasantries with Raphael.

Raphael remained silent from start to finish.

Yet no one found his reaction strange, nor did anyone feel anything was amiss.

After all, the Raphael in everyone's impression had always been such a low-key, taciturn person.

In fact, many felt that Raphael completely lacked the anger and grievances they had expected; he was truly, unnervingly calm.

The Grand Commander of the Lion Domain sighed softly. What a pity—such an exceptional talent, yet he had grown estranged from the Tiger Kingdom.

Marquis August, Director-General of the Special Investigation Bureau, felt an even more complex emotion, but a realization similar to the Lion Domain's surfaced in his mind: the Special Investigation Bureau probably couldn't hold onto Raphael for much longer.

Only now did the matter of Raphael's compensation truly come to a close.

Just as the Tiger King was about to announce that today's court session was adjourned and dismiss everyone, Grand Duke Chester expressed that he had something to say: "Your Majesty, although Lieutenant Remir is your own flesh and blood, he has not been entered into the royal family registry. Do you think we need to clarify his status today?"

The Tiger King was both surprised and baffled.

He never knew Grand Duke Chester and Remir were close enough for the former to step forward at this moment and fight to secure an official royal family status for him.

However, was Chester really doing this out of consideration for Remir?

The Queen flew into a rage.

The Second Prince suddenly gestured subtly to the Queen.

The Queen reined herself in, enduring the impulse.

Remir felt a mixture of shock and joy. He didn't know why Grand Duke Chester was helping him, but he also knew this was an opportunity—it all depended on how the Tiger King responded.

In Remir's mind, the Tiger King cared about him so deeply that he would surely go with the flow, accept Grand Duke Chester's suggestion, and enter him into the line of succession.

Not Shu pulled the old Count and his wife back into the crowd in a flash, retreating all the way to their original posts.

They were clearing the stage for the real drama to take center stage.

The Tiger King had never intended to grant Remir the formal status of a prince. He could publicly acknowledge the youth as his blood, bestow titles upon him, and shower him with numerous favors, but he would never place him in the line of succession to the throne.

While he was dissatisfied with the Queen, he had no desire to let a lover's child disrupt the succession of royal power.

Just as no matter how much he loved Anita, he would never take her as his Queen.

Public and private, the Tiger King drew the line with absolute clarity.

"No need. Remir has been proven to be my flesh and blood, and that is enough. He will not be a prince, nor will he possess the right of succession to the throne."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第175章 补偿、抓捕、安妮塔的下落 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
虎王说得很平淡，也非常理所当然。

他知道这样说势必会伤害到雷米尔，但那又怎样？

他早就跟雷米尔透露过他的意思，他可以给他父爱，但不会给他王位。

如果雷米尔没有认知到这一点，还抱着不切实际的期望，那么就让他在今天清楚明白地彻底斩断！

虎王对雷米尔有很深的父子之情没错，但一想到雷米尔违反他的命令，不但偷偷留在王城，还敢伪装王宫侍卫留在王宫，他就特别恼怒。

原本他以为这个儿子也就是有些小小野心，但本质还是比较单纯的。没想到对方不但瞒着他和假死的安妮塔勾连，还违抗他的命令阳奉阴违，更把手伸到了他的宫廷侍卫中。

而这三点都踩到了虎王的底线，尤其是最后一个。

他正式的王子公主，一个个年岁也都不小，但也没有哪一个敢把手伸到他身边来。

反而是一个私生子，竟然大胆至此！

到底是谁给他的底气？

雷米尔到底年轻，他没能控制住自己的表情。

在他听到虎王公开宣布他不会是王子，也不会拥有王位继承权后，他感觉自己像是被人当场抽了几个大耳刮子。

丢脸！

失望！

不可置信！

还有心脏都要裂开的极致疼痛。

雷米尔不敢相信一向表现得十分疼爱他的父王竟然会当众给他没脸。

这已经不是在断绝他的期望，这简直就是在断绝他的未来！

他以后还要怎么做人？

一想到以后他认识的不认识的人都会嘲笑他、对他指指点点，雷米尔就想逃得越远越好。

听，他们已经开始嘲笑他了。

看，他们都在用讽刺的目光看他。

雷米尔身体颤抖，一言不发，竟然转身就往大殿外走。

虎王震怒：这小子竟然还敢给他甩脸色？

“不愧是我们虎王最宠爱最珍视的心肝生的宝贝疙瘩，虽然只是一个上不了台面的私生子，可这架势简直比王子还要王子。我还是第一次见到有人违抗王令还冒充他人待在王宫，被抓后竟然什么事都没有。”

说话的人不用说，自然是王后。

虎王：“……抓住雷米尔！”

几名侍卫迅速拦住雷米尔，不让他离开。

雷米尔脑袋发热，不管不顾地吼：“我要离开，你们谁敢拦我！”

虎王眼中闪过失望，只觉得雷米尔还是缺少人生历练，不过遇到这么一点小挫折就受不了。又觉得雷米尔心性不行，心想如果让雷米尔一开始就处在拉斐尔的境况中，还不知道这小子会变成什么样。

虎王虽然对这个儿子失望，但还是想保下这个儿子，就只是说：“把他拿下。”

侍卫们都认识雷米尔，面对这位，他们也是复杂得很。

只要想到他们因为拉斐尔和雷米尔的不同身份，曾经是怎么排挤和嘲讽拉斐尔，如何在背后说拉斐尔的小话，又是如何照顾和捧着雷米尔，他们就觉得……人生怎么可以如此艰难？

雷米尔听到虎王要抓他，伤心透顶，真的和抓捕他的侍卫打了起来。

三王子撇嘴：“瞧瞧，这才是真被宠爱的儿子才会有的反应。”

二王子竟然搭话了，微笑着说：“他大概以为他做的事情并不算什么，一定可以得到父王谅解。”

大王子想说什么又忍住。

他见过雷米尔很多次，那时他只是想着父王真的很喜欢和信任这个年轻侍卫，不但经常带在身边，连一些十分重要且秘密的场合，也不会让他离开。

为此，他身为王子，对雷米尔也很客气，还送过他一些比较珍贵的东西。

如果雷米尔只是虎王身边一个信任的宠臣，他这样做无可厚非。

可现在知道这个年轻侍卫才是父王和安妮塔夫人的真骨血，大王子真的有种吃了苍蝇的恶心和憋屈感。

大王子忍不住看向拉斐尔，特别想要知道拉斐尔心里都是怎么想的，怎么就能表现得如此平静？

甚至大王子还有个直觉，郎老伯爵今天没有冒死挑战虎王、王后和逼迫虎王交出安妮塔，闹个鱼死网破，很大可能就是和拉斐尔的态度有关。

拉斐尔感觉到大王子的目光，如往常一样对他点了点头。

大王子：“……”他其实更希望拉斐尔是他弟弟，真心的。

大公主忽然靠近大王子，压低声音说：“情况不太对。”

大王子不解：难道不是今天一开始就什么都不对吗？

大公主神色严肃：“郎老和拉斐尔都已经退了，他们显然不想把事情闹大。”

大王子感叹：“他们心里还是有虎国的。”

大公主差点给兄长一个白眼：“他们不是心里还有虎国，而是打算坐山观虎斗。他们希望父王、母后、还有安妮塔能打起来。”

大王子担忧：“母后一个人应该不是父王和安妮塔的对手吧？我们是不是去劝劝母后，让她不要再跟父王闹了，这时最重要的应该是抓出藏在背后的安妮塔夫人。这个女人有点可怕啊。”

大公主：“……行吧，你好歹抓住了重点。但他们不会听我们的，母后更不会。”

大王子张口。

大公主一挥手：“别打岔！我想说的不是安妮塔的威胁性，而是今天来的人不少来者不善，他们原本很可能想要借郎侦老伯爵的手动摇父王的王位，可现在郎老伯爵退了，他们恐怕还有后手。”

大王子终于警觉：“你是说今天来的权贵中有人想要把父王从王位上拉下来？”

大公主紧盯着大王子的眼睛：“你跟我说实话，是不是你？”

大王子瞠目结舌：“你在说什么？什么是不是我？等等，你认为那些想要把父王拉下来的权贵是我的人？”

大公主自言自语：“我看你也不像有那个脑子。”

大王子：“……”这就是他妹妹！为什么拉斐尔不是他妹妹？

大公主目光从大王子身上转移向二王子、三王子，最后停留在二王子身上。

大公主：如果傻-逼老三能隐藏如此之深、扮演如此之真，别说虎国之王，就是帝位也不是不能想一想。

排除掉大王子和三王子，那么剩下的人选就只有一个。

二王子注意到大公主看他的目光，冲着她微微一笑。

大公主：咬人的狗不叫，果然如此。

大公主伸手拍拍大王子的背，“你去跟二哥投诚吧，也许还能弄片封地当个小领主。”

二王子自己有能力，母后还最喜欢他，他的上位可能真说起来并不比大哥小。

如果论起心机，他们大哥真不如直接洗洗睡。

大王子：“……”

就在几位王子公主嘀嘀咕咕时，雷米尔已经被侍卫们顺利拿下。

虎王看侍卫们控制住雷米尔，就对在场众人表示他累了，今天所有事情到此为止，说雷米尔的罪行他会按律处置。同时又点了治安总局负责人的名字，让他派人把王城八卦报给封了，拘捕报社重要成员，挖出他们背后的资助者。
chunks.englishText:
The Tiger King's tone was flat and matter-of-fact.

He knew saying this would inevitably hurt Remir, but so what?

He had long since revealed his intentions to Remir: he could grant him paternal love, but not the throne.

If Remir hadn't grasped this and still harbored unrealistic expectations, then today he would make it crystal clear and cut those illusions away completely!

It was true that the Tiger King held deep paternal affection for Remir, but the moment he thought of how Remir had defied his orders—not only secretly staying in the Royal City and disguising himself as a palace guard to remain within the palace walls, but also getting caught—he grew exceptionally furious.

Originally, he had thought this son merely harbored petty ambitions while remaining relatively simple-natured at heart. Never did he expect that the boy not only colluded behind his back with the feigned-death Anita, but also disobeyed his orders with a two-faced attitude, even reaching his hands into the ranks of his personal royal guards.

All three of these offenses stepped directly upon the Tiger King's bottom line, especially the last one.

None of his official princes and princesses, despite their advancing years, had ever dared to stretch their hands into his personal retinue.

Yet an illegitimate son had grown this brazen!

Just who gave him the audacity?

Remir was young after all; he failed to control his facial expression.

Upon hearing the Tiger King publicly declare that he would neither be a prince nor hold any right of succession to the throne, he felt as though he had been struck across the face with heavy slaps right there in public.

Humiliation!

Disappointment!

Disbelief!

And an agonizing, heart-splitting pain.

Remir couldn't believe that the Imperial Father, who had always shown him such deep affection, would humiliate him so publicly.

This wasn't just shattering his expectations; this was outright severing his future!

How was he supposed to face people from now on?

The mere thought of everyone he knew—and didn't know—mocking him and pointing fingers at him made Remir want to flee as far away as possible.

Listen, they had already started ridiculing him.

Look, they were all casting sarcastic glances his way.

Trembling all over, Remir uttered not a single word as he abruptly turned on his heel and strode toward the exit of the grand hall.

The Tiger King was incensed: *This brat actually dares to give me attitude?*

"As expected of the precious darling born to our Tiger King's most cherished and adored sweetheart. Though merely an unspeakably lowly bastard, this swagger is even more princely than a true prince. This is my first time seeing someone defy a royal decree and impersonate another to stay within the royal palace, only to get caught and face zero consequences."

The speaker, needless to say, was the Queen.

The Tiger King: "...Seize Remir!"

Several guards swiftly intercepted Remir, blocking his path.

With his head burning hot and completely losing his reason, Remir roared, "I'm leaving! Which of you dares to stop me?!"

A flash of disappointment crossed the Tiger King's eyes. He felt that Remir still lacked worldly experience, cracking under the slightest setback. He also deemed Remir's temperament lacking, thinking that if the boy had been placed in Raphael's shoes from the start, god only knows what kind of twisted creature he would have turned into.

Disappointed as he was in this son, the Tiger King still wanted to protect him, so he merely commanded, "Take him down."

The guards all recognized Remir, and facing him, their feelings were exceptionally conflicted.

The mere thought of how they had once ostracized and mocked Raphael due to the disparity in their statuses, how they whispered behind his back while pampering and flattering Remir, made them feel... how could life be so bitterly ironic?

Hearing that the Tiger King intended to arrest him, Remir's heart shattered completely, and he actually started fighting the guards who moved to capture him.

The Third Prince curled his lip. "Look at that—now *that* is the reaction you only get from a truly pampered son."

Surprisingly, the Second Prince chimed in with a smile, "He probably thought what he did was no big deal and that he was bound to win Imperial Father's understanding."

The First Prince opened his mouth to speak, but swallowed his words back down.

He had met Remir many times in the past. Back then, he had simply assumed that Imperial Father genuinely liked and trusted this young guard, frequently keeping him by his side and refusing to dismiss him even during highly sensitive and secret occasions.

Because of this, as a prince, he had always treated Remir very politely and even gifted him quite a few precious items.

If Remir had merely been a trusted favorite minister by the Tiger King's side, treating him this way would have been entirely justified.

But now, knowing that this young guard was actually the true flesh and blood of Imperial Father and Lady Anita, the First Prince genuinely felt a nauseating, suffocating sense of disgust, as if he had swallowed a fly.

He couldn't help glancing over at Raphael, burning with curiosity to know what on earth was going on inside Raphael's mind to allow him to remain so unfathomably calm.

The First Prince even had a hunch: the reason Old Count Lang hadn't risked his life today to challenge the Tiger King and Queen, nor forced the Tiger King to hand over Anita in a desperate, mutual-destruction showdown, very likely had something to do with Raphael's attitude.

Sensing the First Prince's gaze, Raphael nodded to him as usual.

The First Prince: "..." Honestly, he almost wished Raphael was his younger brother instead. Truly.

The Grand Princess suddenly leaned closer to the First Prince and lowered her voice: "Something's not right."

The First Prince was baffled: Wasn't literally *everything* not right from the moment court started today?

With a grave expression, the Grand Princess muttered, "Old Lang and Raphael have both withdrawn. They clearly don't want to blow this matter out of proportion."

The First Prince sighed. "They still have the Tiger Kingdom in their hearts."

The Grand Princess nearly rolled her eyes at her older brother: "It's not that they have the Tiger Kingdom in their hearts; it's that they intend to sit on the mountain and watch the tigers fight. They're hoping Imperial Father, Mother, and Anita tear each other to shreds."

The First Prince worried aloud, "Mother alone probably isn't a match for Imperial Father and Anita, right? Shouldn't we go advise Mother to stop making a scene with Imperial Father? Right now, the most important thing should be flushing out the hidden Lady Anita. That woman is terrifying."

The Grand Princess: "...Fine. At least you managed to grab onto the main point. But they won't listen to us, and Mother even less so."

The First Prince opened his mouth.

With a wave of her hand, the Grand Princess cut him off: "Don't interrupt! I'm not talking about Anita's threat. I mean that quite a few of the people who came today harbor malicious intentions. They likely intended to use Old Detective Lang to shake Imperial Father's grip on the throne. But now that Old Lang has backed down, they probably still have a backup plan."

The First Prince finally grew alarmed: "Are you saying someone among the nobles who came today wants to pull Imperial Father off the throne?"

Staring intently into the First Prince's eyes, the Grand Princess asked, "Tell me the truth—is it you?"

The First Prince stared, dumbfounded: "What are you talking about? What do you mean *is it you*? Wait, do you think those nobles trying to unseat Imperial Father are *my* people?"

The Grand Princess muttered to herself, "Looking at you, you don't seem to have the brains for it."

The First Prince: "..." This was his sister! Why wasn't Raphael his sister?

The Grand Princess shifted her gaze away from the First Prince, passing over the Second and Third Princes before finally lingering on the Second Prince.

*If idiot number three could hide this deep and act this convincingly,* the Grand Princess thought, *forget the throne of the Tiger Kingdom—even the Imperial Throne wouldn't be entirely out of reach.*

Excluding the First and Third Princes, only one candidate remained.

Noticing the Grand Princess's gaze upon him, the Second Prince offered her a faint smile.

*A barking dog doesn't bite, and sure enough, it's always the quiet ones.*

Reaching out, the Grand Princess patted the First Prince's back. "Go pledge your loyalty to Second Brother. Maybe you can still snag a fiefdom and become a minor lord."

Second Prince had the capability, and Mother favored him most; his chances of claiming the throne were truly no lower than Big Brother's.

When it came to scheming, their eldest brother really ought to just wash his face and go to sleep.

The First Prince: "..."

While the princes and princesses were whispering amongst themselves, Remir had already been successfully subdued by the guards.

Seeing that the guards had him under control, the Tiger King announced to the gathered crowd that he was exhausted and that all business for today was concluded, adding that Remir's crimes would be dealt with in accordance with the law. At the same time, he singled out the head of the Public Security Bureau, ordering him to deploy men to shut down the Royal City's gossip newspaper, arrest its key members, and dig out their financial backers.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第175章 补偿、抓捕、安妮塔的下落 (Part 4)
chunks.chineseText:
虎王急着要去找空间腰带，到现在去抓安妮丽娜的侍卫们都没有回音，他表面稳定，心里都快急疯。

如果抓不到安妮丽娜，那他就只能把王后给扣押起来。

“王后，我有事跟你说，去我的寝宫。”

虎王这会儿已经认定安妮丽娜就是王后派来的，而空间腰带也已经落入王后手中。

王后没动，脸上还带着深深的讽刺和冷笑：“陛下，先别急着走。大家似乎还有事情要请教你。”

虎王皱眉，环视众人：“什么事？”

宰相艾萨克海斯站了起来，“陛下，就在臣出发前来王宫之前，臣收到了一封来自八卦报的密信，上面说他们已经收集到与安妮塔夫人相关的大量线索，经过他们认真推理分析以及求证，他们已经锁定了安妮塔夫人的另一个伪装身份以及落脚地。”

宰相的话简直就像是冷水浇进油锅里，原本已经安静下来的议事大殿再次沸腾起来。

被扣住的雷米尔都在伤心绝望中抬起头。

虎王：……这个八卦报怎么就这么能！为什么他的手下就没有这么厉害的情报收集队伍？且早不送晚不送，偏偏在今天送，还特意送到宰相手中。要说这八卦报不是故意的，他都不相信。

就在这时，切斯特干咳一声，也举手说：“这样的信件我也收到了一封。”

奥古斯特侯爵：“我也有。”

治安局总局长跟着尴尬地说：“其实我也收到了。”

随后，大殿内响起好些人的附和，表示他们也收到了相关信件。

虎王：“……是谁？在哪里？”

王后忽然发出微微沙哑的笑声，“陛下，你可以问我，我也知道。”
chunks.englishText:
Anxious to locate the spatial belt—as the guards sent to capture Annalina had yet to return, leaving him composed on the outside while frantic on the inside—the Tiger King needed to act fast.

"Queen, I have something to discuss with you. Come to my bedchamber."

By this point, the Tiger King had concluded that Annalina was an agent sent by the Queen, and that the spatial belt had already fallen into the Queen's hands.

The Queen didn't move. A deep, satirical sneer still hung on her face: "Your Majesty, don't rush off just yet. It seems everyone else has a few questions they'd like to ask you."

Frowning, the Tiger King swept his gaze across the assembly: "What questions?"

Prime Minister Isaac Hayes stood up. "Your Majesty, just before I set out for the royal palace, I received a confidential letter from the gossip paper. It stated that they have compiled a massive volume of leads related to Lady Anita. Through rigorous deduction, analysis, and verification, they have locked down Lady Anita's alternate disguise and her current hiding place."

The Prime Minister's words were like cold water splashing into a pan of boiling oil; the grand council hall, which had finally quieted down, erupted once more.

Even the restrained Remir raised his head in sorrow and despair.

The Tiger King: *...Just how hyper-competent is this gossip paper?! Why doesn't his own intelligence network possess such terrifying efficiency? And why didn't they send it earlier or later, but precisely today—delivering it straight into the Prime Minister's hands, no less? If anyone claimed this gossip paper wasn't doing it on purpose, he wouldn't believe a single word.*

At that moment, Chester let out a dry cough and raised his hand as well. "I received a letter of that nature too."

Marquis August chimed in: "I have one as well."

The Chief of Public Security followed up awkwardly, "Actually... I received one too."

Shortly after, echoing voices rang out across the hall as several others confirmed that they, too, had received related letters.

The Tiger King: "...Who is it? Where are they?"

A low, husky laugh escaped the Queen's throat. "Your Majesty, you might as well ask me. I know as well."

chunks.chineseText:
第176章 你不配当王

不帅很想问某个背后灵：是不是你？

商非凡悄悄握住不帅的手：有他在，安妮塔这个始作俑者还想要置身事外坐等他们家和王室斗得两败俱伤，她再出来捡便宜，做什么春秋大梦？

他没直接把王后送到安妮塔面前，让两人先对撕几场，就已经算厚道。

虎王没理会王后，只是询问宰相艾萨克，“安妮塔现在在哪里？”

宰相艾萨克就跟公事公办地公事汇报一样：“按照密信上所说，安妮塔夫人现在正在金溪庄园，她伪装成为了那里的女管家戴芬斯纳德。”

虎王瞳孔收缩。

大殿中突然响起王后充满愤恨的声音：“萨雷斯法雷尔，你故意的对不对！你明知道丹顿家族和那贱人有仇，你就故意把那贱人安排到金溪庄园。”

“我没有！”虎王下意识否认。

王后压根不信：“你不用再伪装了！你连拿前侍卫统领郎飞孩子来给自己私生子做挡箭牌的事都做得出来，你还有什么做不出来？我说你为什么非要把丹顿家族的人囚禁在金溪庄园，原来安妮塔就在那里！你是故意的，你就是想要把丹顿家族的人送给安妮塔磋磨，让你的小情人出气！”

而这点才是引爆王后，气得王后不顾诅咒也要变身去找虎王算账的最重要原因。

虎王怒：“本王根本不知道安妮塔假死，又怎么可能把安妮塔安排到金溪庄园做女管家？我把丹顿家族的人软禁在金溪庄园，也是为他们好。难道你要你家族的人全都跟丹顿侯爵一样消失无踪吗？”

王后尖声：“你会有这么好心？”

“你爱信不信！”虎王也不想再给王后留脸什么的，这对虎国第一夫妻是彻底撕破脸了，在群臣面前也不再伪装。

虎王环视众人：“你们应该有不少人派人去金溪庄园查看或监视，我就问你们，你们谁抓到了安妮塔？”

虎王不用问王后，因为只看王后的神情和表现就知道她肯定没有抓到安妮塔。

宰相艾萨克摇头：“臣确实派人去了金溪庄园，但不是抓捕，只是想要确认消息是否属实。之后臣收到王宫出事的消息就立刻赶来王宫，金溪庄园那边还没有得到任何回信。”

虎王又看向其他人：“你们派去的人都没有看到安妮塔？”

收到密信的人全都摇头，纷纷表示他们也都还没有收到回音。

金溪庄园在王城郊外，来回至少需要两兽时。

在场众人都是看到密信不久就得知王后大战虎王以及郎侦老伯爵带着全家去找虎王的事，就火速赶来王宫平息事态（看戏），自然不知道赶去金溪庄园的人都发现了什么。

王后这边同样，她收到密信就也秘密派出人手，现在这些出去的人都还没有回转。

哦，就算有人回来，恐怕这会儿也会被拦在王宫之外。

为了寻找和抓捕安妮丽娜，现在整个王宫都被封锁，不准进也不准出。

虎王看向特调局总局长奥古斯特。

奥古斯特对他轻点头，表示如果他们能先一步发现安妮塔夫人，一定会把人带到虎王面前。

虎王现在只想比王后更快一步抓到安妮塔。

但他偏偏是最后一个得知安妮塔躲在金溪庄园的人。

金溪庄园的女管家，那可是他十分信任的一个手下。

如果不是出于信任，他也不会把丹顿家族血脉都软禁在那里。

谁能想到他那么信任的一个手下，竟然被安妮塔给顶替了。

虎王看向被侍卫扣住的雷米尔。

雷米尔伪装成他人的本领是不是就是跟安妮塔学的？

真是有其母必有其子啊！

“你知道吗？”虎王原本想避开人眼单独询问雷米尔，但这会儿他忍不住了。

雷米尔一愣，但很快反应过来，他很不想回答虎王的问题，他觉得虎王背叛了他，哪有父亲这样对待自己的亲生儿子？

但在看到虎王那双眼眸的一刹那，雷米尔心脏一颤，嘴巴快过思考：“我不知道！我从没有去过金溪庄园！我更不知道她伪装成那里的女管家。”

虎王：“但你知道你母亲还活着，也知道她就是旖梦楼的老板娘伊娃，但你从没有告诉过我。”

雷米尔心中忽然生出一股浓浓的恐惧，他感觉到虎王生气了，这种生气还不是一般的生气。他曾经在虎王身边担任近身侍卫多年，自然不止一次见过虎王真正生气时是什么模样，也知道虎王真生气后会有什么结果。

“我、我也是偶尔发现的。她让我不要说，说如果我没了母亲，您会更怜惜我更照顾我一些。”雷米尔呢喃，下意识就说了真心话：“她说她假死不是为了骗你，是为了躲避王后那个毒妇。说如果她不死，王后就不会放过我。”

“不会放过你？明明是不会放过拉斐尔吧？”三王子不爽吐槽。

雷米尔现在根本听不得拉斐尔的名字，一听三王子提到拉斐尔，竟跟红了眼的公牛一样，大喊大叫起来：“你们以为拉斐尔是什么好东西！她跟我说过，说拉斐尔有秘密，说他才是最可怕的人，表面上在做侍卫，其实不声不响的就进入了特调局，不声不响地就开始调查她，她就是害怕被拉斐尔查出真相，才会假死！”

“嚯——！”这可真是一个出人意料的新瓜。

在场众人几乎全都唰地看向拉斐尔，就连宫廷祭司都看了过去。

不帅淡定地垂眸看地，就像是不知道雷米尔在说他的秘密，也不知道众人都在看他一样。

老伯爵生气，身体移动，挡住拉斐尔。一双老眼用力瞪回去，嘴中更是骂出声：“看什么看！这种为了报仇什么都能做得出来的毒妇说的话，你们也信？”

商非凡也好奇了，特别想问不帅：你真的调查过安妮塔？

不帅感觉到有只手在他背后画圈圈，就知道某人在想什么。

“当年我加入特调局，是因为我在为陛下办事的过程中偶尔发现邪神信徒的踪迹，遵循陛下的命令，和特调局有了些许来往。之后也是陛下询问我想不想调入特调局。而我本人也觉得做特别调查官比做侍卫更有意思，这才转入特调局。这点，陛下一清二楚。”

不帅不紧不慢地开口说明。

虎王在上面也印证了这一点：“没错，确实是本王先询问拉斐尔是否愿意转入特调局。原因是因为奥古斯特觉得拉斐尔耐心又细致，是个不错的调查官苗子，主动和我开口要人。”

奥古斯特侯爵也承认了这一点。

不帅又道：“我当年加入特调局也算是秘密调动，表面上我还是王宫侍卫，除了陛下和奥古斯特局长，其他人都不知道这事，我也没有跟任何人说过，没想到安妮塔夫人竟然知道了这点，也是很厉害了。”

虎王脸色变黑。他想起来了，他和奥古斯特谈及拉斐尔调动一事时，雷米尔就在他身边。

所以这些年雷米尔到底泄露了多少秘密给安妮塔？

雷米尔看到虎王脸色更加难看，心中也越发慌乱。他是不是又做错了？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 176: You Are Unworthy to Be King (Part 1)

Bu Shuai desperately wanted to ask the spirit dwelling behind him: *Was this your doing?*

Shang Feifan quietly gripped Bu Shuai's hand. *With him around, Anita—the root cause of all this chaos—actually thought she could stand aloof, waiting for the royal family and the Denton family to tear each other to pieces so she could swoop in and reap the spoils? What kind of pipe dream is she smoking?*

The fact that he hadn't directly delivered the Queen to Anita so they could claw each other's eyes out first was already him being generous.

The Tiger King ignored the Queen entirely and turned to Prime Minister Isaac instead, demanding, "Where is Anita right now?"

Prime Minister Isaac reported in a detached, strictly business-like tone, "According to the secret intelligence, Madam Anita is currently at the Golden Brook Manor. She has disguised herself as the head housekeeper there, a woman named Davin Snade."

The Tiger King's pupils constricted.

Suddenly, the Queen's shrill, hate-filled voice echoed through the grand hall: "Saris Farrell, you did this on purpose, didn't you! You knew full well that the Denton family and that cheap bitch are mortal enemies, yet you deliberately arranged for her to stay at Golden Brook Manor!"

"I did no such thing!" the Tiger King instinctively denied.

The Queen refused to believe a single word: "Don't bother pretending anymore! You even went so far as to use the former guard commander Lang Fei's child as a human shield for your illegitimate son—is there anything you wouldn't do? And I wondered why you insisted on placing the members of the Denton family under house arrest at Golden Brook Manor. So Anita was there all along! You did it on purpose! You wanted to hand the Dentons over to Anita so she could torture them and let your little mistress vent her anger!"

This was precisely the straw that had broken the camel's back, infuriating the Queen to the point where she was willing to risk the curse just to transform and settle scores with the Tiger King.

The Tiger King roared in fury, "I had no idea Anita faked her death, so how could I possibly have arranged for her to act as a housekeeper at Golden Brook Manor? I placed the Dentons under house arrest there for their own protection. Or would you rather have everyone in your family vanish without a trace, just like the Marquis of Denton?"

The Queen shrieked, "And I'm supposed to believe you have that kind of a good heart?"

"Believe what you want!" The Tiger King had no desire to save face for the Queen anymore. The number one imperial couple of the Tiger Kingdom had completely torn off their masks, casting away all pretense in front of the assembled ministers.

The Tiger King swept his gaze across the crowd. "Many of you must have sent people to investigate or monitor Golden Brook Manor. Let me ask you: did any of you manage to capture Anita?"

The Tiger King didn't even need to ask the Queen. One look at her expression and demeanor told him she certainly hadn't caught Anita.

Prime Minister Isaac shook his head. "This official did dispatch men to Golden Brook Manor, but not to make an arrest—merely to verify whether the intelligence was true. Shortly after, upon receiving word that an incident had occurred at the royal palace, I rushed here immediately. No report has returned from Golden Brook Manor yet."

The Tiger King looked at the others. "Did none of the people you sent see Anita?"

Those who had received the secret intelligence all shook their heads, confirming they too were still awaiting reports.
