Golden Brook Manor lay on the outskirts of the royal capital; a round trip took at least two beast-hours.

Everyone present had rushed over to the palace to quell the situation (and watch the show) mere moments after receiving the secret intelligence—learning of the epic clash between the Queen and the Tiger King, as well as Old Count Lang Zhen dragging his entire family to confront the monarch. Naturally, none of them knew what their subordinates had discovered at the manor.

It was the same for the Queen's faction; she had secretly dispatched operatives upon receiving the intelligence, but none of them had returned yet.

Well, even if anyone managed to return, they would likely be blocked outside the palace gates at this point.

To hunt down and capture Anailina, the entire palace had been placed under strict lockdown. No one was allowed in or out.

The Tiger King glanced at August, the Director of the Special Investigation Bureau.

August gave him a slight nod, implying that if his bureau managed to locate Madam Anita first, they would surely bring her straight to the King.

Right now, the Tiger King's sole desire was to capture Anita faster than the Queen could.

Yet, he had turned out to be the absolute last person to know she was hiding at Golden Brook Manor.

The head housekeeper of Golden Brook Manor—that was a subordinate he trusted implicitly.

Had it not been for that deep trust, he never would have stashed the surviving bloodline of the Denton family there.

Who could have imagined that a subordinate he trusted so thoroughly had been replaced by Anita herself?

The Tiger King's gaze shifted to Remir, who was currently pinned down by royal guards.

Had Remir learned his knack for impersonating others from Anita?

Like mother, like son indeed!

"Did you know?" The Tiger King had initially intended to question Remir in private, away prying eyes, but at this moment, he could no longer hold back.

Remir started in surprise, but quickly recovered. He desperately wanted to refuse to answer the Tiger King's question. He felt betrayed; what kind of father treated his own flesh and blood like this?

Yet, the instant he caught sight of the Tiger King's chilling gaze, Remir's heart skipped a beat, and his mouth moved faster than his brain: "I didn't know! I've never been to Golden Brook Manor! And I certainly didn't know she was disguised as the housekeeper there!"

The Tiger King pressed on, "But you knew your mother was still alive, and you knew she was Eva, the proprietorship of the Dream Pavilion. Yet you never told me."

A deep-seated terror welled up inside Remir. He could sense that the Tiger King was furious—and this was no ordinary anger. Having served as a close bodyguard by the Tiger King's side for years, he had witnessed the monarch's true wrath on more than one occasion, and he knew all too well the consequences that followed.

"I—I only found out by accident. She told me not to say anything, saying that if I lost my mother, you would pity me more and take better care of me," Remir stammered, blurting out the bitter truth out of pure instinct. "She said she faked her death not to deceive you, but to hide from that poisonous shrew of a Queen. She said that if she didn't 'die,' the Queen would never let me live."

"Never let you live? Clearly, she meant she wouldn't let Raphael live!" The Third Prince chimed in with an annoyed snort.

Remir couldn't stand the mere sound of Raphael's name anymore. The moment the Third Prince mentioned it, he snapped like a bull seeing red, screaming at the top of his lungs, "You all think Raphael is some kind of good guy! She told me herself that Raphael has secrets! She said he's the most terrifying one of all—pretending to be a humble guard on the surface, but quietly infiltrating the Special Investigation Bureau behind our backs and investigating her without a single sound! She faked her death precisely because she was terrified of Raphael uncovering the truth!"

*Whoa—!* Now this was a truly unexpected plot twist.

Almost everyone in the hall snapped their heads toward Raphael, even the High Temple Priest.

Bu Shuai calmly lowered his gaze to the floor, acting entirely oblivious to the fact that Remir was airing his secrets or that everyone was staring at him.

Fuming with rage, the old count shifted his stance to physically block Raphael from view. Glaring fiercely back at the crowd, he barked, "What are you all staring at? You actually believe the words of a venomous bitch who would do anything for revenge?"

Shang Feifan grew curious as well, itching to ask Bu Shuai: *Did you actually investigate Anita back then?*

Sensing a pair of hands tracing invisible circles across his back, Bu Shuai knew exactly what that man was thinking.

"When I first joined the Special Investigation Bureau, it was because I accidentally stumbled upon the traces of cultists while carrying out a mission for His Majesty. Following the King's orders, I had some minor interactions with the Bureau. Afterward, His Majesty asked if I wished to transfer there. Personally, I felt that being a special investigator sounded much more interesting than being a palace guard, so I made the transfer. His Majesty is well aware of this."

Bu Shuai explained unhurriedly.

Up on the throne, the Tiger King corroborated his words. "That's correct. It was indeed I who first asked Raphael if he was willing to transfer to the Special Investigation Bureau. August felt that Raphael was patient, meticulous, and showed great potential as an investigator, so he personally requested him from me."

Marquis August also nodded in confirmation.

Bu Shuai continued, "My entry into the Bureau back then was treated as a secret transfer. On paper, I remained a royal guard. Aside from His Majesty and Director August, no one else knew about it, and I never mentioned it to a soul. I must say, it's quite impressive that Madam Anita somehow found out."

The Tiger King's expression darkened. He suddenly remembered: when he and August had discussed Raphael's transfer, Remir had been right by his side.

So just how many secrets had Remir leaked to Anita over the years?

Seeing the Tiger King's face grow even uglier, Remir panicked further. *Did I do something wrong again?*

chunks.chineseText:
不帅没有看雷米尔，只述说了事实：“在我刚进入特调局大约两个多月的时候，我偶尔发现安妮塔夫人和某个地痞无赖的头子有接触，担心她受到威胁，才稍微调查了一下，然后发现了那个地痞一些罪证，就把他送入了治安局大牢。当时我以为我为自己的母亲解除了一个威胁，没想到会让她以为我在调查她。”

众人：原来如此！

王后更是发出嘲讽的笑声：“这可真是歪打正着。拉斐尔以为母亲被地痞无赖纠缠，想要帮自己母亲一把，哪想到那个母亲根本就是在和自己人接触！”

雷米尔看着拉斐尔那平静无波的神情，只觉得对方就像是在无声地讽刺自己。

为什么？

为什么他会落到现在的地步？

他和拉斐尔的身世没有曝光之前，明明一切都是好好的。

安妮塔跟他保证过，说会选择一个最好时机让人知道他才是虎王的真正骨肉，而且完全不用担心会对他的名声有损。

同样，在此之前虎王也如一个真正的父亲一样关心和疼爱他。

可现在一切都变了！

这不应该是他的人生，这不应该！

雷米尔眼底充血，神情扭曲，突然看向王后，声音嘶哑地喊：“王后，你不是一直都想知道那个石耳在哪里吗？其实它一直就在你面前，它就藏在拉斐尔郎沐的身体里！安妮塔亲口告诉我，她把石耳亲手放入了拉斐尔的胸膛，这才让拉斐尔从致命伤害中活过来！”

王后挺直身体，眼神火热。这是真的吗？石耳就在拉斐尔的身体里？

商非凡：剁了吧。

雷米尔又冲着不帅大喊：“安妮塔救过你，她救过你的命！你欠她，你永远都欠她一条命！”

雷米尔还冲着在场所有人，疯狂喊：“你们也都听到了，祭司大人可是亲口说出拉斐尔郎沐身体里有一股很特别的能量在改善他的身体体质。你们知道这股能量是什么吗？你们想知道为什么王后和丹顿家族那么想要得到那只石耳吗？”

老伯爵脸色大变，当即就想要阻止雷米尔。

但不帅拉住了他，对他轻声说：“没关系，让他说。”

雷米尔那边已经喊出来：“因为那只石耳是自然之神力量的一部分！拉斐尔郎沐体内的神秘能量就是自然之神的力量！得到它，你们都能青春永驻长生不老！甚至可以成神！”

轰！

整个大殿都炸开了……并没有。

相反，整座大殿都陷入了异样的沉寂。

落到不帅身上的目光更多了。

二王子也露出感兴趣的眼神。神的力量啊，不知道是真是假。而想要验证这一点，最好的方法就是弄到那个石耳。

就连虎王都在用一种异样的眼神看着不帅。

商非凡拍拍不帅，表示有他在，什么都不用担心。大不了，他放大招带他和老俩口一起杀出去！

不帅嘴角弯了弯。他可不想老商真的在这里放大招。

不帅轻轻推开挡在他前面、想要保护他的老伯爵，向前一步，声音不高不低：“我想，我有必要声明三件事。”

虎王下意识说：“你说。”

不帅：“第一件事，我不欠安妮塔夫人，任何方面。”

“不是因为她先把我和雷米尔调换，所以她对我的所有施恩都被扯平。而是她并没有主动把石耳交给我，更没有用石耳救我的命，相反她还亲手挖出了我的心脏。甚至为了让我忘记这段记忆，对我下了遗忘药剂，让我忘掉了十四岁前的所有事情，直到最近我才机缘巧合把这段失去的记忆找回来。”

老伯爵夫妇惊骇至极，一把抓住外孙的胳膊：“这么重要的事，为什么你没有告诉我们？”

不帅对老伯爵露出一个歉意的笑容：“都过去了，也不是什么值当说的大事。”

“这还不是大事？快说清楚，到底怎么回事？”老伯爵怒。

不帅小声跟两位老人说：“回去以后跟你们详说。”

老夫人拉住丈夫，示意他看场合说话。

老伯爵这才忍住。但他心中真的恨透了安妮塔，比恨王后更多。

不帅再次面对众人：“我知道你们很好奇我被挖出心脏怎么还能活下来。这也是我要说的第二件事，我能活到现在，因为我觉醒了一个很特别的血脉天赋。至于是什么天赋，你们可以尽情猜测。祭司察觉到的那股能量，也和这个天赋有关。”

宫廷祭司对不帅露出歉意的神情。

不帅也搞不清楚这人是不是故意的，只维持了一个表面礼仪。

商非凡已经盯上了祭司，如果不是担心这位发现他，他早就把对方盯出两个窟窿。

在场众人虽然好奇到抓心挠肺，但他们也知道血脉天赋这种事，对于兽人来说就是隐私，愿意说可以说，但不愿意说也是人家的自由。

雷米尔疯狂喊：“你说谎！你根本没有觉醒什么特别天赋，明明就是石耳救了你的命，还让你获得了更多青春！”

老伯爵夫妇，尤其是老夫人对雷米尔流露出不可置信的眼神。

从两人身世曝光以来，拉斐尔没有说雷米尔一个字的不是，更没有怨怼谁。

可雷米尔呢？

不说感念他们老夫妻把他养大的恩情，也不说欺骗他们这么久的愧疚，竟然还在自己要完蛋时拼命想要拖拉斐尔一起下水。

他们家到底哪里对不起这一家三口？！

“雷米尔？”老夫人难受得不得了。

雷米尔像是没有听到她的声音，眼中也完全没有老伯爵夫妇。

老伯爵搂住老妻：“不用喊他。妒忌之火已经把他的理智烧没了，这就是个小蠢蛋！根本就没搞清楚他真正该恨该怨的人是谁！”

老夫人深深吸气。

雷米尔被她和丈夫亲手养到这么大，尤其前面十六年更是一直养在他们跟前。这么长时间，就算养只虫子都养出感情了。

就算曝出雷米尔不是她的亲外孙，她也没有说马上就抽出感情，那就不可能。

将心比心，老夫人以为自己在雷米尔心中也还是有点地位的，没想到……他们好像连对老保姆都不如。

如果雷米尔心里有他们，又怎么会这么对拉斐尔？

不帅轻声安抚老俩口，看都没看雷米尔。

“第三件事，诸位有没有想过，安妮塔夫人作为一个当年被王后和丹顿家族逼迫得家破人亡只能带妹逃亡的柔弱女孩，为什么她能顺利走到虎王面前，为什么能在短短二十三年间就在王城布局如此之深？而且还是在虎王和王后的眼皮子底下。”

其实在场不少人早就开始在想这个问题。

不帅看向王后：“我想王后你也许碍于虎王，不好对安妮塔下杀手，但你一定在时刻紧盯着安妮塔，想要找出她的把柄，更想要找到那只石耳，可你什么异常都没有发现。”

王后抓紧扶手。拉斐尔说得没错，她确实让人盯梢安妮塔，想要找到她的任何黑点，好在虎王面前抹黑她，或者能找到一个合适的理由杀了她。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 176: You Are Unworthy to Be King (Part 2)

Without looking at Remir, Bu Shuai simply stated the facts: "Roughly two months after I first entered the Special Investigation Bureau, I happened to notice Madam Anita interacting with a leader of local ruffians. Fearing she might be in danger, I investigated the matter slightly, uncovered some criminal evidence against that scoundrel, and threw him into the security bureau's dungeon. At the time, I thought I was eliminating a threat for my mother, never dreaming that it would make her think I was investigating her."

The crowd murmured: *So that was what happened!*

The Queen let out a mocking laugh. "Well, that is what you call a blind cat running into a dead mouse. Raphael thought his mother was being harassed by local thugs and wanted to help her out, only to find out his 'mother' was actually meeting with her own cronies!"

Watching Raphael's unruffled expression, Remir felt as though the other man was silently mocking him.

*Why?*

*Why had he fallen to this state?*

Before his and Raphael's true identities were exposed, everything had been going so wonderfully.

Anita had promised him that she would choose the absolute best moment to let everyone know he was the Tiger King's true flesh and blood, and assured him it wouldn't harm his reputation in the least.

Likewise, before all this, the Tiger King had cared for and doted on him like a real father.

Yet now, everything had changed!

This wasn't supposed to be his life—it shouldn't be!

With bloodshot eyes and a distorted expression, Remir suddenly turned to the Queen, his voice hoarse as he screamed, "Queen! Haven't you always wanted to know where the Stone Ear is? It's right here in front of you! It's hidden inside Raphael Lang Mu's body! Anita told me herself—she personally placed the Stone Ear into Raphael's chest, and that's how Raphael survived a fatal wound!"

The Queen straightened her back, her eyes burning with fiery intensity. *Is this true? The Stone Ear is inside Raphael's body?*

Shang Feifan: *Chop him up.*

Remir shrieked at Bu Shuai next: "Anita saved your life! She saved you! You owe her—you owe her your life, forever!"

Then, turning to everyone present, Remir went completely mad: "You all heard it! The High Priest himself said that there is a very special energy within Raphael Lang Mu's body, constantly improving his physical constitution. Do you know what that energy is? Do you want to know why the Queen and the Denton family are so desperate to get their hands on that Stone Ear?!"

The old count's expression shifted drastically; he immediately moved to stop Remir.

However, Bu Shuai held him back, saying softly, "It's fine. Let him speak."

Remir was already screaming at the top of his lungs: "Because that Stone Ear is a fragment of the Nature God's power! The mysterious energy inside Raphael Lang Mu is the power of the Nature God! Get your hands on it, and you can achieve eternal youth and immortality! You can even ascend to godhood!"

*Boom!*

The entire grand hall erupted into absolute chaos... well, not quite.

On the contrary, the entire hall fell into a bizarre, heavy silence.

More and more gazes locked onto Bu Shuai.

Even the Second Prince wore a look of intense interest. The power of a god—he wondered if it was true. And the best way to verify it would be to seize that Stone Ear.

Even the Tiger King stared at Bu Shuai with a strange, unfathomable gaze.

Shang Feifan gently patted Bu Shuai, silently signaling that with him here, there was nothing to fear. Worst-case scenario, he would unleash his ultimate power and blast a path out for Bu Shuai and the old couple!

The corners of Bu Shuai's lips curved upward. He certainly didn't want Old Shang unleashing his trump cards here.

Gently pushing aside the old count who was trying to shield him from the front, Bu Shuai stepped forward. His voice carried a steady, even tone: "I believe I need to clarify three things."

The Tiger King instinctively prompted, "Speak."

Bu Shuai began: "First, I do not owe Madam Anita anything—not in any sense of the word."

"It's not just because she switched me and Remir at birth, which means any supposed grace she showed me has already been canceled out. The truth is, she never handed the Stone Ear to me voluntarily, nor did she use it to save my life. On the contrary, she carved my heart out with her own hands. Furthermore, to make me forget those memories, she fed me a forced-forgetting potion, wiping away everything prior to my fourteenth year. It was only recently, by sheer coincidence, that I managed to recover those lost memories."

Horrified beyond measure, the old count and his wife grabbed their grandson's arms. "Such a vital matter—why didn't you tell us?"

Bu Shuai offered the old count an apologetic smile. "It's all in the past. It wasn't worth making a fuss over."

"You call this not worth making a fuss over?! Explain yourself right now, what on earth happened?!" the old count roared.

Bu Shuai whispered to the two elders, "I'll explain everything in detail when we get back."

The old countess pulled her husband back, signaling him to mind the occasion.

The old count managed to swallow his fury, but inside, he hated Anita with a passion that burned far hotter than his hatred for the Queen.

Bu Shuai turned his attention back to the crowd. "I know you are all dying of curiosity as to how I survived having my heart cut out. That brings me to the second thing: I am able to stand here today because I awakened a unique bloodline talent. As for what kind of talent it is, you are free to guess. The mysterious energy sensed by the High Priest is also related to this talent."

The High Temple Priest gave Bu Shuai an apologetic look.

Whether the man had done that on purpose or not was unclear to Bu Shuai, who simply maintained a veneer of polite etiquette.

Shang Feifan had already locked his sights onto the Priest; if he weren't worried about alerting the fellow, he would have burned two holes right through him with his stare.

Although everyone present was burning with maddening curiosity, they also knew that bloodline talents were deeply personal matters for beastmen. One could speak of them if willing, but keeping them secret was entirely one's own freedom.

Remir shrieked frantically, "You're lying! You didn't awaken any special talent at all! It was clearly the Stone Ear that saved your life and granted you eternal youth!"

The old count and his wife—especially the old countess—looked at Remir with utter disbelief.

Ever since their true identities had been exposed, Raphael hadn't said a single disparaging word about Remir, nor had he harbored any resentment toward him.

And yet, what about Remir?

Instead of showing gratitude for the old couple raising him, or expressing any guilt for deceiving them for so long, he was desperately trying to drag Raphael down with him the moment his own ship started to sink.

How on earth had their family wronged this mother-and-son trio?!

"Remir?" The old countess felt physically sick with grief.

Remir acted as though he hadn't heard her voice, his eyes devoid of any recognition for the old couple who had raised him.

The old count pulled his wife into his arms. "Don't bother calling him. The fires of jealousy have burned away his sanity. He's just a little fool! He hasn't the foggiest notion of who he should truly hate and resent!"

The old countess took a deep breath.

She and her husband had raised Remir with their own hands, especially pouring their hearts into his first sixteen years. After such a long time, one would grow attached even to raising an insect.

Even after it was revealed that Remir wasn't her biological grandson, she hadn't been able to instantly sever her affection—that was simply impossible.

Putting herself in his shoes, the old countess had thought she still held some place in Remir's heart. But alas... they apparently meant less to him than an old family nanny.

If Remir had held any shred of genuine care for them, how could he possibly treat Raphael this way?

Bu Shuai softly comforted the two elders, not even sparing Remir a glance.

"Thirdly, have any of you ever wondered: Madam Anita was once a frail young girl whose family was destroyed by the Queen and the Denton family, leaving her with no choice but to flee with her younger sister. Why was she able to walk straight up to the Tiger King, and how did she manage to weave such a deep web of influence within the royal capital in just twenty-three years? And all of this right under the noses of both the Tiger King and the Queen."

In truth, quite a few people present had begun pondering this exact question.

Bu Shuai turned his gaze to the Queen. "I imagine, Your Majesty, that while you may have been restrained by the Tiger King and unable to murder Anita outright, you must have kept a constant, unblinking watch on her—waiting to unearth her dirt, and most importantly, hoping to find that Stone Ear. Yet, you never found a single anomaly."

The Queen gripped her armrests tightly. Raphael was right; she had indeed assigned spies to monitor Anita, hoping to dig up any scandal to blacken her name before the Tiger King, or to find a justifiable excuse to execute her.

chunks.chineseText:
但安妮塔太小心，生活看起来也特别简单。以至于她什么把柄和机会都没有找到。

王后阴声说：“你想说什么？”

不帅貌似答非所问：“我是一名特别调查官，主要调查的就是邪神信徒的活动。这几个月调查下来，我发现一件很有意思的事情，那就是王后、丹顿侯爵，以及旖梦楼的老板娘伊娃都和邪神信徒有密切往来。”

轰隆！

这才是真正的大炸-弹。

比起谋夺那不知道是真是假的自然之神的力量，邪神信徒才是最让兽人们忌惮的。

虎王当场就拉开了和王后的距离，他太了解邪神和邪神信徒的可怕，在知道王后竟然和邪神信徒有来往后，他哪里还敢继续和这个女人坐在一起？

大殿中，不少人也露出了戒备神色，更有不少人站了起来。

王后非常愤怒。

对曝光她秘密的拉斐尔，更是对邪神信徒！

对，王后此时的愤怒更多的是冲着邪神信徒而去。

如果拉斐尔说的是真的，那就说明邪神信徒一边和她和丹顿家族合作，一边还和安妮塔那个贱人勾连在一起！

邪神信徒这是想干什么？

两边下注？

还是故意借她和安妮塔的仇敌关系，好把邪神的力量渗入到虎国上层？

王后想到这里，脸色瞬间变得惨白。

“你这是污蔑！”王后还算反应及时，立刻斥责。

不帅神情平静，无所谓地说：“你说污蔑就是污蔑吧。我说出这件事，只是想要告诉在场所有人，虎国现在已经被邪神信徒给渗透成了一个大漏勺。”

“噗！”三王子看到周围人的神色，立刻板起脸，做严肃状。

“在这种情况下，你们还要执意召开传承分享大会吗？就不怕邪神信徒借此机会把兽人大陆的高层一网打尽？”不帅口中说的是“你们”，但眼睛看的只有虎王。

虎王握紧双拳。

这个传承分享大会，他无论如何都是要召开的。这关系到虎国以后在兽人大陆的地位，还有他这个虎王……的未来。

“拉斐尔，你是不是忘了？这场传承分享大会除了分享传承，还有一件重要事情要所有人出力才能解决。如果我只是单纯呼吁大家一起来解决全大陆岩浆爆发的事，没有几个人会相信，只有以分享传承为名，才能把大陆上的各族各国首领召集到一起。”虎王缓缓说道。

在场至少大半的人都是第一次听说“全大陆岩浆爆发”这件事，当场瞪大了眼睛。

不帅：“那么就请好好解决渗透入虎国的邪神信徒吧。”

商非凡抱臂。这个发展有点不妙，他可不想他家不帅被卷入虎国和邪神信徒的斗争中。

不过他们也没有想到雷米尔竟然知道石耳的事，还当众曝了出来。

虎王忽然笑道：“拉斐尔你在特调局就是负责调查邪神信徒的，既然如此，不如就由你继续负责此事。”

商非凡：艹！他就知道。

不帅毫不犹豫地说：“可以。不过我需要特别权限，避免有些人仗着身份拒绝我的调查。”

虎王警惕：“你想要多大的权限？”

“让这个虎王八倒霉吧。我就不该把他留到最后。”某人嘀嘀咕咕。

不帅：我听到你的声音了，你想暴露吗？祭司看过来了！

不帅正要回复虎王。

王后突然厉声喝：“不行！”

怎么能让拉斐尔继续调查邪神信徒？

拉斐尔本来就和她有仇，现在还知道她和邪神信徒有来往，那还不往死里调查？

她身为一国王后，绝对不能和邪神信徒扯上关系，丹顿家族也不行！

王后反应飞快，堂而皇之地说：“拉斐尔和我、和丹顿家族，包括和王室都有仇恨，他刚才还没有任何证据地污蔑我和丹顿侯爵，所以拉斐尔不适合负责这件事。而且拉斐尔不是已经被任命为黑水荒原领区的大区长了吗？他就应该早点离开王城才是。”

商非凡想给王后鼓掌，就冲着王后这段话，哪怕她是为了保护自己，他也愿意让王后再舒坦几天。

虎王心里暗骂王后就是个只会拖他后腿的蠢货。

“两位陛下，今天扯出来的事情比较多，更涉及到邪神信徒和整个兽人大陆的安危，但事情总要一件件做。不如我们就先找到安妮塔夫人，先搞清楚换子一事的始末，以及安妮塔夫人背后是否有人支持。如果有，其目的为何？总而言之，先找到安妮塔夫人吧。”

说话的人是宰相艾萨克，也是铁杆的保王党。

但他保的并不是虎王，而是虎国正统。

对于虎王找了个情-妇，还生了个私生子，差点乱了王室血脉一事，他本就有一肚子的意见。

万万没想到，虎王竟然还搞出了换子的大丑事。

这对重视王室名誉更高过自己名誉的他来说，简直就是不能容忍之极。

如果不是想要求稳，更有传承分享大会以及全大陆灾难的事吊在前面，以及顾忌虎王的武力，他真的很想联合其他权贵，推举大王子立刻继位。

“对。”切斯特大公也附和，并更狠：“如今我虎国丑闻已经闹到全大陆兽人面前，想要不彻底成为笑柄，那就把笑柄源头解决掉。安妮塔夫人必须要找到并控制住，搞清楚她假死到底想干什么，以及是否真的和邪神信徒有牵扯。那家八卦报社也得立刻查封，里面的人该抓就抓，该杀就杀。另外，”

切斯特大公眼睛扫过虎王腰部：“在我们刚过来之际，陛下是不是失去了某件特别重要的物品？希望那物品真是您说的王印，而不是那条代表虎国王权象征的空间腰带。”

虎王变色：切斯特大公说这话是什么意思？

王后适时跳出来：“萨雷斯法雷尔，你就别隐瞒了。你不说，我帮你说。”

王后面向众人：“你们没有猜错，虎王就是丢失了那条重要至极的空间腰带！”

虎王怒指王后：“凯斯琳！你这个……！”

“陛下，空间腰带异常重要，希望您不要隐瞒。”宰相也开口了。

王后更是进一步逼迫：“堂堂虎王，不但搞出换子丑闻，还让自己的情-妇祸乱虎国王室甚至是整个虎国，如今还弄丢了虎国开国传承至今的至宝空间腰带，就问这样的人又怎么配继续坐在王位上？萨雷斯法雷尔，不如你干脆自请下位，把你的王位让给你的儿女吧！”

一声震耳的虎吼！

虎王再次变身，猛地一跃，张口就咬向王后。

满场人色变，虎王这是真的想要杀死王后。

“快救王后/母后！”大殿中响起一片喊声。

某人：“打打打！一起上！”

王后在千钧一发之际变身往旁边一跳，幸亏虎王没有变身巨兽——大殿不够巨兽腾挪。

王后变身也算及时，但就算如此，她的一条腿也被虎王咬断，就连皮带肉地撕扯下来那种。

虎王咬断王后的腿还不甘心，又去咬她的脑袋。

王后痛苦大叫。

大王子二王子大公主全都冲了过来。
chunks.englishText:
Yet Anita was exceedingly cautious, and her daily life appeared remarkably simple, leaving him with no dirt or opportunities to exploit.

The Queen said in a chilling voice, "What are you trying to say?"

Bushuai replied, seemingly answering off the mark, "I am a Special Investigator, primarily tasked with investigating the activities of the evil god's cultists. After months of investigation, I’ve discovered a very interesting fact: the Queen, Marquis Denton, and Eva, the proprietress of the Yimeng Pavilion, all maintain close ties with the evil god's cultists."

*Boom!*

This was a genuine blockbuster.

Compared to scheming for the power of the God of Nature—which was of dubious authenticity—the cultists of the evil god were the most terrifying entities to the orcs.

The Tiger King immediately put some distance between himself and the Queen. He knew far too well how horrifying the evil god and his cultists were. Upon learning that the Queen was actually in league with them, how could he dare to continue sitting beside this woman?

In the grand hall, many people also wore guarded expressions, and quite a few stood up.

The Queen was utterly furious.

Furious at Raphael for exposing her secret, but even more furious at the evil god's cultists!

Yes, the majority of the Queen's anger at this moment was directed at the cultists.

If what Raphael said was true, it meant that while the evil god's cultists were cooperating with her and the Denton family, they were simultaneously colluding with that bitch Anita!

What were the evil god's cultists trying to do?

Hedge their bets on both sides?

Or were they intentionally exploiting her bitter feud with Anita to infiltrate the upper echelons of the Tiger Kingdom with the evil god's power?

At this thought, the Queen's face turned instantly pale.

"You're slandering me!" Reacting with commendable swiftness, the Queen immediately rebuked him.

Bushuai’s expression remained calm as he said indifferently, "Call it slander if you wish. Bringing this up is simply to inform everyone present that the Tiger Kingdom has already been infiltrated by the evil god's cultists to the point of leaking like a massive sieve."

"Pfft!" Seeing the expressions of those around him, the Third Prince immediately straightened his face and assumed a solemn look.

"Under such circumstances, do you still stubbornly insist on holding the Heritage Sharing Assembly? Aren't you afraid the evil god's cultists will take this opportunity to wipe out the top leadership of the Orc Continent in one fell swoop?" Bushuai used the word "you," but his eyes were fixed solely on the Tiger King.

The Tiger King clenched his fists tightly.

No matter what, this Heritage Sharing Assembly had to be held. It concerned the Tiger Kingdom's future status on the Orc Continent, as well as the future of—his own position as Tiger King.

"Raphael, have you forgotten? Aside from sharing the heritage, there is another crucial matter that requires everyone's collective effort to resolve. If I were to simply appeal to everyone to come together and tackle the continent-wide magma eruption, hardly anyone would believe it. Only under the banner of sharing our heritage can the leaders of all races and nations across the continent be gathered in one place," the Tiger King slowly said.

At least a large majority of those present were hearing about the "continent-wide magma eruption" for the first time, and their eyes widened on the spot.

Bushuai replied, "Then please properly resolve the evil god's cultists who have infiltrated the Tiger Kingdom first."

Shang Feifan folded his arms. This development was looking a bit ominous; he certainly didn't want his Bushuai dragged into the struggle between the Tiger Kingdom and the evil god's cultists.

However, they hadn't expected that Remiel actually knew about the stone ears and had exposed it publicly.

The Tiger King suddenly laughed. "Raphael, since your job in the Special Investigation Bureau is to investigate evil god cultists, why don't you continue taking charge of this matter?"

Shang Feifan: *Damn it!* He knew it.

Bushuai said without hesitation, "Very well. However, I require special authority to prevent certain individuals from pulling rank and refusing my investigation."

The Tiger King grew vigilant. "How much authority do you want?"

"Let that bastard Tiger King meet his doom already. I shouldn't have left him for last," someone muttered.

*Bushuai:* I heard your voice. Do you want to expose yourself? The High Priest is looking over here!

Bushuai was just about to reply to the Tiger King.

The Queen suddenly barked sharply, "No way!"

How could they let Raphael continue investigating the evil god's cultists?

Raphael already had a blood feud with her, and now that he knew she was mixed up with the cultists, wouldn't he investigate her to the death?

As the Queen of a nation, she absolutely could not be linked to the evil god's cultists, and neither could the Denton family!

Reacting with lightning speed, the Queen grandly declared, "Raphael holds a grudge against me, the Denton family, and even the royal family. Just now, he slanderously accused me and Marquis Denton without a shred of evidence, making him entirely unsuited to be in charge of this matter. Besides, hasn't Raphael already been appointed as the Grand District Chief of the Blackwater Wasteland? He should be leaving the Royal City sooner rather than later."

Shang Feifan wanted to applaud the Queen. For the sake of this speech alone—even if she was merely trying to save her own skin—he was willing to let the Queen live in comfort for a few more days.

Inwardly, the Tiger King cursed the Queen as a stupid cow who only knew how to drag him down.

"Your Majesties, too many matters have been dragged into the light today, and they involve the evil god's cultists and the safety of the entire Orc Continent. Still, things must be tackled one by one. Why don't we first locate Madam Anita, figure out the ins and outs of the child-swapping incident, and find out whether anyone is backing her from the shadows? If so, what is their ultimate goal? In short, let's find Madam Anita first."

The speaker was Prime Minister Isaac, a staunch royalist.

However, his loyalty was not to the Tiger King, but to the orthodoxy of the Tiger Kingdom.

He had already harbored a bellyful of grievances regarding the Tiger King taking a mistress, siring an illegitimate child, and nearly throwing the royal bloodline into chaos.

Never in his wildest dreams did he expect the Tiger King to pull off such a scandalous child-swapping stunt.

To a man who valued the reputation of the royal family far above his own, this was simply beyond intolerable.

If not for his desire to maintain stability, the impending Heritage Sharing Assembly, the continent-wide disaster hanging over their heads, and his wariness of the Tiger King's martial prowess, he would have loved to unite other powerful nobles and push the First Prince to ascend the throne immediately.

"Agreed," Grand Duke Chester chimed in, stepping up the pressure even further. "Now that the scandal of our Tiger Kingdom has been put on full display for all the orcs of the continent, if we wish to avoid becoming a complete laughingstock, we must resolve the source of the joke. Madam Anita must be found and placed under control. We need to find out what she hoped to achieve by faking her death, and whether she truly has ties to the evil god's cultists. That gossip newspaper must be sealed up immediately, and everyone inside should be arrested or executed. Furthermore—"

Grand Duke Chester's eyes swept across the Tiger King's waist. "Just as we arrived, did Your Majesty happen to lose a particularly important item? I do hope that item was indeed the Royal Seal you claimed, and not that spatial belt which symbolizes the sovereign power of the Tiger Kingdom."

The Tiger King's expression changed drastically. *What does Grand Duke Chester mean by saying that?*

The Queen seized the opportune moment to jump in. "Sares Falier, stop trying to cover it up. If you won't say it, I'll say it for you."

Turning to the crowd, the Queen announced, "You guessed correctly! The Tiger King has indeed lost that supremely important spatial belt!"

The Tiger King pointed an enraged finger at the Queen. "Kathleen! You...!"

"Your Majesty, the spatial belt is of extraordinary importance. I implore you not to conceal it," the Prime Minister also spoke up.

The Queen pressed her advantage further. "As the dignity of the Tiger King, you not only stirred up a child-swapping scandal and allowed your mistress to ravage the Tiger royal family and the entire kingdom, but you've also gone and lost the supreme treasure passed down since the founding of our realm—the spatial belt! I ask you, how could someone like this possibly be fit to continue sitting on the throne? Sares Falier, why don't you simply abdicate and hand the throne over to your children!"

A deafening tiger roar!

The Tiger King transformed once more, leaping forward ferociously with his jaws bared to bite the Queen.

Everyone present turned pale. The Tiger King genuinely intended to kill the Queen.

"Quickly, save the Queen / Mother!" Cries erupted throughout the grand hall.

Someone cheered: "Hit her! Hit her! All together now!"

At the very last second, the Queen shifted into her beast form and leaped to the side. Fortunately, the Tiger King hadn't transformed into his colossal beast form—the grand hall simply wasn't spacious enough for a giant beast to maneuver.

Though the Queen's transformation was timely, her leg was still bitten off by the Tiger King, ripped away skin, flesh, and all.

Unsatisfied with tearing off her leg, the Tiger King lunged for her head.

The Queen shrieked in agony.

The First Prince, Second Prince, and Eldest Princess all rushed forward.

chunks.chineseText:
三王子慢了一步，不忘转头冲着大都督等人喊：“大都督，救命啊！宰相大人，祭司大人，切斯特大公，你们都快上啊！”

被叫到名字的人：泥马！

侍卫们都冲了过来，想要分开虎王和王后。

但虎王凶悍异常，像是完全失去了理智，就一个劲追着断腿的王后撕咬。

王后身上很快就被撕扯出大片伤口。

大王子第一个扑到王后身上，惨叫：“父王！快停下来！”

大公主拦到了虎王跟前，被虎王一爪拍飞。

宰相艾萨克、特调局总局长奥古斯特、治安局总局长……纷纷变身，跑来阻止陷入暴怒状态的虎王。

虎王也不知是气疯了，还是想要借此机会用武力震慑众人，竟然暴吼一声，在大殿中就变身成了巨兽。

好嘛，整个大殿都乱了起来。

商非凡按住不帅，笑：这才像话嘛。都是兽人，干嘛要那么文明，不爽就应该直接开战。

“吼——！”

狮域大都督也变身了，变成了不比虎王小多少的巨狮。

“萨雷斯！你给我冷静点！”狮域暴吼。

虎王冲着大都督发出挑战的吼叫声。

狮域：艹，给你脸不要脸，那就打吧！

两只巨兽的战斗让其他兽人毫无插足的机会，还得注意自己不被那两位不小心踩死。

轰隆，好好的一座大殿就在两只巨兽的对战中垮塌了。

所有人都跑出了大殿。
chunks.englishText:
The Third Prince was a step slower, though he didn't forget to turn and shout at the Grand Governor and the others, "Grand Governor, save us! Lord Prime Minister, Lord High Priest, Grand Duke Chester, hurry up and do something!"

The people whose names were called: *My goodness!*

Guards rushed forward, attempting to separate the Tiger King and the Queen.

Yet the Tiger King was fiercely savage, looking as though he had completely lost his mind as he relentlessly pursued and mauled the one-legged Queen.

Gash after gash was quickly torn into the Queen's body.

The First Prince was the first to throw himself over the Queen, crying out in despair, "Father! Stop this at once!"

The Eldest Princess intercepted the Tiger King, only to be batted away by a single swipe of his paw.

Prime Minister Isaac, Special Investigation Bureau Chief August, Public Security Bureau Chief... one after another transformed, rushing forward to stop the Tiger King, who had plunged into a state of blind fury.

Whether out of absolute madness or a desire to use brute force to cow the onlookers, the Tiger King let out a furious roar and transformed into a colossal beast right there inside the grand hall.

Well then, the entire grand hall plunged into utter chaos.

Shang Feifan pinned Bushuai down with a chuckle. *Now this is more like it. They're all orcs anyway; why bother acting so civilized? If you're pissed off, you should just start a war directly.*

"Roar—!"

The Grand Governor of the Lion Territory also transformed, turning into a giant lion not much smaller than the Tiger King.

"Sares! Get a hold of yourself!" the Lion Territory Governor roared thunderously.

The Tiger King let out a challenging roar back at the Grand Governor.

The Lion Territory Governor: *Damn it, if you won't take a hint, let's fight!*

The battle between the two giant beasts left the other orcs with no opportunity to intervene whatsoever, forcing them to be constantly on guard lest they be accidentally trampled to death by the pair.

*Boom!* The stately grand hall collapsed amid the clash of the two colossal beasts.

Everyone fled out of the grand hall in a scramble.

chunks.chineseText:
第177章 杀死太多了

不帅在战斗刚打起来的时候，就护着老伯爵夫妇远离了战场。

老伯爵老当益壮，跑的时候还抱住老妻，但还没有等他发力，就感觉一股轻柔的力量缠绕住他和老妻，然后轻轻一拖，就把他们全都拖到了大殿外面的广场上，还是犄角旮旯，不会有人注意到的地方。

老伯爵惊讶地看向老夫人。

老夫人也感觉到了。

两人又一起转头看向拉斐尔。

不帅对他们笑笑，小声说：“小把戏。”

老伯爵眼睛一亮：“是你说的那个很特别的天赋？”

不帅点头。

老伯爵夫妇都高兴了。

雷米尔也跟着跑了出来，情况太乱，扣住他的侍卫有点顾不上他，被他趁机挣脱。

侍卫们看在他是虎王亲儿子份上，到底还是手软了不止三分。

雷米尔跑出大殿，看看左右，见大家要么在关注两只巨兽的战斗，要么在救治王后，竟没有人注意到他，当即慢慢向后退，退到墙根下，一溜烟跑了。

不帅和老伯爵夫妇都看到了，但他们都没有吱声。

不帅是压根就没有把雷米尔当对手乃至仇敌看，在他看来这也就是个被父母操控的儿工具。

雷米尔虽然暴露了他不少秘密，但当一个人的实力足够强大时，又怎么会在乎一只蚂蚁对他的挑衅？

老伯爵夫妇就更不用说了，他们对雷米尔的感情太复杂，想着对方也不可能再来找他们，干脆也就随他去。

老伯爵还特意看了眼拉斐尔，见拉斐尔也愿意放雷米尔一马，不由吐了口气。

他在想拉斐尔恐怕也是不想他们两老伤心。

虎王和狮域打得越发激烈，有些收不住手的架势。

狮域体型不比虎王小，却有点落在下风。

不得不说，虎王能坐稳王位，他的武力值真不是盖的。

“姥姥，姥爷，我们走吧。”不帅不想再看下去。

老伯爵：“王宫不是封锁了吗？现在能出去？”

不帅转头看向进出门，那里果然有侍卫守着，也有官员想要离去，但都被挡了回来。

不帅听到身边有人小声咕咕。

商非凡：“诅咒你脚底打滑！”

虎王脚下一滑，原本要击中狮域的攻击落空，反而挨了狮域一爪子。

不帅：“……”

商非凡：“诅咒你牙髓炎发作！”

虎王跳起来张嘴欲咬狮域，牙齿都已经碰到了狮域的脖颈。就在这时，一股尖锐且剧烈的疼痛突然从牙根袭来。

疼得虎王一个哆嗦，牙齿硬是没能咬下去。

狮域反过来摆脱虎王。

“诅咒你踩到坑里。”

虎王凶狠回击，一脚踏入他刚才自己踩碎的石板坑中，脚踝立即传来一股刺痛。

狮域张嘴，咔嚓一口咬断了虎王小半截尾巴

商非凡玩得兴起。进阶了恶咒三级后，这个天赋能力终于可以成为真正的战力。

虽然消耗怨气有点多，但这个世界什么都不多，怨气真的是随便吸收。

就比如他现在，一边使用怨气施展诅咒术，一边就能吸收现场那浓厚的怨气。

虎王气炸，口中发出厉吼，随后就猛地喷出熊熊火焰。

商非凡睁大眼睛，不愧是虎王，不但能巨兽化，还拥有控火天赋。

狮域灵活躲开，竟然也以冰箭反击。

轰隆！宫墙被撞出一个大洞。

轰隆！又一座宫殿崩溃。

两只巨兽打斗的范围越来越大，被波及的王宫建筑也越来越多。

很好，王宫这下想封锁也封锁不住，想要逃跑的人全都趁机跑了出去。

宫外的人也清楚看到两只巨兽在王宫是如何战斗的。

不帅他们现在已经可以离开王宫。

不帅跟两位老人低语。

两老其实还不想离开，他们想要看到王后和虎王窝里斗，想要看他们为伤害拉斐尔、伤害郎家而付出代价。

商非凡瞅瞅自己的怨气值，应该还够花销一阵子。

“诅咒你咳嗽咳个不停！”

“咳！”虎王刚喷出一口火焰，还想再接再励，忽然感到嗓子眼发痒，止不住地想要咳嗽。而这一咳，他就停不下来了。

好机会！狮域趁此机会脱离战场，并冲着虎王一挥爪子。

厚厚的冰层冻住了虎王的四肢。

虎王原本可以用火焰轻易融合这层厚冰，但他咳得停不下来。

咔嚓！虽然如此，虎王还是凭借他的力量挣脱了厚冰束缚。

“陛下，你冷静下来了吗？”狮域冷声爆喝。

其他大臣权贵也都围成一圈，神情不满地看着虎王。

虎王确实冷静下来了，他的实力确实比狮域高，如果他拼命，狮域九成九会陨在这里。但他有和狮域拼命的理由吗？

更不要说，如果他和狮域拼命，最后他也一定不会完好无损，而王后和某些心怀叵测的家伙就在旁边，他这时可不敢让自己受重伤。

“咳！”虎王重重地清了清嗓子，嗓子总算舒服了一些。

刚才的打斗过程好像有点古怪，简直就像是神灵在帮着狮域一样。

难道是有人在暗中帮助狮域对付他？

虎王警惕起来，他不怕面对面地打斗，但他怕有人躲在暗中对他抽冷子。

王后见狮域都没能打伤虎王，失望之余也十分心惊。

这样的虎王要怎么打败他？

又怎么能让他心甘情愿地让出王位？

王后心里不断谋算，她和虎王已经彻底撕破脸，接下来不是他死就是她亡。

王后还不想死，她还想扶持自己看中的那个孩子上位，还想看到丹顿家族重回巅峰，想要找到失踪的丹顿侯爵，想要亲眼看到虎王死，想要亲手折磨死安妮塔那个贱人……

她要做的事情还很多，她绝对不要死在虎王手上。

王后的目光对上二王子。

刚才情况太混乱，她看到大儿子扑到她身上，看到大女儿挡住虎王的功绩，但她没有看到老二和老三。

二王子在王后身边单膝跪下，轻声说：“母后，很抱歉，我刚才一心想用自己的天赋能力拖住父王，没能第一时间……”

王后立刻心软：“我知道了。”

王后把身边的人全都喝开，包括现在才跑过来的三王子。

大王子和大公主已经走到虎王身边，像是防备，又像是保护。

王后压低声音对二王子说：“今天过后，你父王一定不会放过我。听好，接下来，你这样做……”

商非凡感到可惜，这就停战了？他才开始练习他的天赋能力。

不帅伸手往后，一只手立刻塞入他手里。

不帅忍不住捏了捏。

对方反过来握住他。

不帅低声：“祭司已经往这边看了好几眼。”

商非凡：“让他看。”

老伯爵：“拉斐尔，你在说什么？”

老爷子人老成精，没问外孙在和谁说话。

不帅做了个口型。

老伯爵挑眉。他就说阿瑞斯商那么粘着他家拉斐尔，怎么遇到这样的大事反而隐身了。

原来是真的隐身，就隐在拉斐尔身后。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 177: Too Many to Kill (Part 1)

The moment the battle broke out, Bushuai had shielded the elderly Earl and his wife, escorting them far away from the battlefield.

The old Earl was full of vigor; as they ran, he even scooped up his old wife. But before he could exert himself, he felt a gentle force wrap around them both, pulling them with a soft tug all the way to the plaza outside the grand hall—right into a quiet corner where no one would pay them any mind.

The old Earl looked in astonishment at the old夫人 (old madam).

The old madam had felt it too.

The two of them turned their heads together to look at Raphael.

Bushuai smiled at them and whispered, "A little trick."

The old Earl's eyes lit up. "Is that the very special talent you mentioned?"

Bushuai nodded.

Both the old Earl and his wife were overjoyed.

Remiel had also fled outside. The situation was too chaotic, and the guards holding him had grown somewhat distracted, allowing him to break free during the commotion.

Out of consideration that he was the Tiger King's biological son, the guards ultimately showed him more than a triple measure of leniency.

Slipping out of the grand hall, Remiel glanced left and right. Seeing that everyone was either fixated on the battle between the two giant beasts or tending to the wounded Queen, paying him no mind whatsoever, he quietly retreated to the base of a wall and bolted away in a flash of smoke.

Bushuai and the elderly couple all saw it, but none of them uttered a sound.

Bushuai didn't view Remiel as an opponent or an enemy in the slightest; in his eyes, the fellow was merely a tool manipulated by his parents.

Although Remiel had exposed quite a few of his secrets, when a person's strength was sufficient, who would care about the provocations of an ant?

As for the elderly Earl and his wife, their feelings toward Remiel were far too complicated. Figuring that he would never dare seek them out again, they simply let him be.

The old Earl cast a special glance at Raphael, and seeing that Raphael was also willing to let Remiel off the hook, he couldn't help letting out a breath of relief.

He figured Raphael probably didn't want the two old folks to be heartbroken.

The battle between the Tiger King and the Lion Territory Governor grew increasingly fierce, showing signs of spinning out of control.

Though the Lion Territory Governor was no smaller than the Tiger King, he was starting to fall slightly behind.

One had to admit, the Tiger King's ability to firmly hold onto his throne meant his martial prowess was truly no joke.

"Grandma, Grandpa, let's go," Bushuai said, unwilling to watch any longer.

The old Earl asked, "Wasn't the royal palace locked down? Can we just leave now?"

Bushuai turned his gaze toward the gates. Sure enough, guards were still stationed there, and while some officials wished to depart, they were all being turned away.

Bushuai heard someone murmuring softly beside him.

Shang Feifan: *"I curse the soles of your feet to slip!"*

The Tiger King's foot suddenly slipped. The attack meant to strike the Lion Territory Governor missed completely, and instead, he took a swipe from the lion's paw.

Bushuai: "..."

Shang Feifan: *"I curse you to get pulpitis!"*

The Tiger King leaped up, jaws agape to bite the Lion Territory Governor, his teeth practically brushing the lion's neck. Right then, a sharp, violent pain suddenly flared from his tooth roots.

The pain made the Tiger King shudder so violently that he couldn't bring his teeth down.

Seizing the opening, the Lion Territory Governor shook him off.

*"I curse you to step into a pit."*

The Tiger King counterattacked viciously, stepping straight into the stone-slab pit he had smashed open himself just moments earlier, and a sharp pain instantly shot through his ankle.

The Lion Territory Governor opened his jaws and *snap!* bit off a good chunk of the Tiger King's tail.

Shang Feifan was having a blast. Having advanced to Level Three Malevolent Curse, this innate ability could finally function as a true combat power.

Though it consumed a fair bit of grievance energy, this world was short of nothing, and grievance energy could be absorbed entirely at will.

Take him right now, for instance: while using grievance energy to cast curses, he was simultaneously absorbing the dense ambient grievance energy lingering over the scene.

Furious to the point of explosion, the Tiger King let out a piercing roar before unleashing a torrent of blazing flames.

Shang Feifan's eyes widened. As expected of the Tiger King—not only could he transform into a colossal beast, but he also possessed fire-control abilities.

The Lion Territory Governor nimbly dodged out of the way, countering with a barrage of ice arrows.

*Boom!* A palace wall was blasted through, leaving a massive hole.

*Boom!* Another palace collapsed.

The scale of the two giant beasts' battle expanded, and more and more palace structures were caught in the crossfire.

Splendid. At this rate, there was no sealing the royal palace anymore, and anyone wishing to flee took the opportunity to bolt out.

People outside the palace could clearly see how the two giant beasts were tearing up the royal grounds.

Bushuai and his group were now entirely free to leave the palace.

Bushuai murmured softly to the two elders.

In truth, the old couple didn't want to leave just yet. They wanted to see the Queen and the Tiger King tear each other apart in dog-eat-dog fashion; they wanted to see them pay the price for harming Raphael and the Lang family.

Shang Feifan checked his grievance energy reserve; it should still be enough to splurge on for a while longer.

*"I curse you to cough incessantly!"*

*"Cough!"* The Tiger King had just spat out a breath of fire, intending to press his advantage, when he suddenly felt an itch in his throat and an uncontrollable urge to cough. And once he started coughing, he simply couldn't stop.

*A prime opportunity!* Seizing the moment, the Lion Territory Governor broke away from the fight and lashed out with a paw.

A thick layer of ice froze the Tiger King's four limbs solid.

Ordinarily, the Tiger King could have easily melted this thick ice with his flames, but he was coughing too relentlessly to stop.

*Crack!* Even so, relying on sheer brute force, the Tiger King broke free from the ice shackles.

"Your Majesty, have you cooled your head yet?" the Lion Territory Governor demanded in an icy, booming voice.

The other ministers and nobles also formed a circle around them, gazing at the Tiger King with dissatisfaction.

Indeed, the Tiger King had calmed down. His strength truly surpassed that of the Lion Territory Governor; if he fought to the death, nine times out of ten, the Lion Territory Governor would perish here. But did he have any reason to throw his life away against him?

Moreover, if he fought the Lion Territory Governor to the death, he certainly wouldn't emerge unscathed, and with the Queen and other harboring-ulterior-motives lurkers standing right nearby, he didn't dare allow himself to sustain severe injuries now.

*"Cough!"* The Tiger King cleared his throat heavily, finally feeling a bit of relief in his windpipe.

The whole fight just now had felt rather bizarre—it was almost as if some deity was actively helping the Lion Territory Governor.

Could someone be hiding in the shadows, stabbing him in the back?

The Tiger King grew vigilant; he wasn't afraid of a face-to-face brawl, but he feared cowards lurking in the dark throwing cold blades.

Seeing that even the Lion Territory Governor had failed to injure the Tiger King, the Queen felt a mix of disappointment and profound shock.

How on earth was she supposed to defeat a Tiger King like this?

How could she coerce him into willingly relinquishing the throne?

Calculations spun endlessly in the Queen's mind. She and the Tiger King had completely broken ties; from here on out, it was either he died or she perished.

She didn't want to die yet. She still wanted to hoist her chosen child onto the throne, she wanted to see the Denton family return to its peak, she wanted to find the missing Marquis Denton, she wanted to witness the Tiger King's death with her own eyes, and she wanted to personally torture that bitch Anita to death...

There were still too many things she had to do; she absolutely refused to die at the Tiger King's hands.

The Queen's gaze locked onto the Second Prince.

The situation had been too chaotic earlier; she had seen her eldest son throw himself over her and her eldest daughter shield her from the Tiger King's attack, but she hadn't laid eyes on the second and third princes.

The Second Prince dropped to one knee beside the Queen, speaking softly, "Mother, I am truly sorry. I was fully focused on trying to stall Father with my innate abilities earlier, and failed to come to your side at the very first moment..."

The Queen’s heart immediately softened. "I know."

She waved away everyone in her vicinity, including the Third Prince, who was only just running over now.

The First Prince and Eldest Princess had already walked over to the Tiger King's side, adopting a posture that was half-defensive, half-protective.

Lowering her voice, the Queen told the Second Prince, "After today, your father will never let me go. Listen carefully: next, you are going to do this..."

Shang Feifan felt a pang of regret. *They're stopping the fight just like that? I was only just getting warmed up with practicing my innate ability.*

Bushuai reached behind him, and a hand immediately slipped into his palm.

Bushuai couldn't help giving it a squeeze.

The other party squeezed back in return.

Bushuai murmured low, "The High Priest has glanced over here several times already."

Shang Feifan: "Let him look."

The old Earl spoke up: "Raphael, who are you talking to?"

Having lived long enough to become wise, the old gentleman didn't ask who his grandson was talking to.

Bushuai formed a silent shape with his lips.

The old Earl raised an eyebrow. That explained it; he had been wondering why Ares Shang was usually so clingy toward his Raphael, only to mysteriously vanish when such a major crisis struck.

Turns out he really had turned invisible, hiding right behind Raphael.

chunks.chineseText:
老夫人暗笑，心情好了一些。她也听到了阿瑞斯商的嘀咕声，虽然听不懂他在说什么。但老夫人认定拉斐尔今天能保持这么平静的心情，没有被愤怒、怨恨、委屈等负面情绪淹没，九成就是因为阿瑞斯商陪在他身边。

狮域等人和虎王似乎做了些商议，宰相和切斯特大公等人开始清场。

虎王没有反对，他巴不得今天这些进入王宫的人全部都消失才好。

现在说封锁王宫已经毫无意义，宫墙和宫殿都塌了好几座，侍卫们为了躲避两巨兽的打斗，更是无暇顾及寻找安妮丽娜。

克莱门特回来了。

这位抓来雷米尔后，就去忙活抓捕安妮丽娜的事。

克莱门特对虎王微微摇头。

虎王虽然心里已经做好准备——安妮丽娜敢动手，肯定已经找好接应。但见克莱门特出马都没能找到人，还是感到十分焦躁和烦闷。

任谁几世积累的家财消失大半，都会急疯了好吗。

虎王还能耐着性子在这里和虎国权贵扯皮，已经是少有的能稳得住的国王。

宫廷祭司抬脚向不帅一家走来。

不帅轻轻一拉老伯爵夫妇。

老伯爵夫妇立刻反过来拉住不帅，直接走人。

虎王的目光扫了眼拉斐尔和老伯爵夫妇，并没有阻止他们离开。

宫廷祭司看到不帅头也不回地离开，停住脚步。

他也看出来了，这一家对他暴露出不帅身体中有股特别能量的事十分不满。原本和他关系不错的郎侦老伯爵都不想和他说话了。

宫廷祭司无奈地叹了口气。

他现在还不能走。

狮域他们都要求他留下来，见证接下来的商讨结果。

虎王又扫向王后，目光异常冰冷。

他怀疑他的空间腰带以及偷换走腰带的安妮丽娜就是被这个毒妇给藏了起来。

虎王把克莱门特叫过来，给了他两个任务。

第一个任务是寻找逃跑的雷米尔，把他抓回来交给他，特别注明要活的。

第二个任务就是搜索王后寝宫，务必要找到空间腰带的线索。

两个任务，后者为重。

不帅一家离开王宫后，就火速回到伯爵府。

商非凡还有点事要办，没跟着他们一起。

不帅猜出商非凡应该是要去八卦报社报信。

虎王现在是恨透了曝光了他最大丑闻的八卦报，而其他恐惧八卦报力量的虎国权贵也都希望马上封掉这家报社。

毕竟这家报社连虎王的丑闻都敢报道，他们还有谁的秘密不敢告诉民众的？

商非凡赶到报社的时候，就看到报社里面忙碌得热火朝天，他们竟然在排版印刷新一期报纸。

商非凡化身报社老板龙岳，拿过底稿阅读。

看完，商非凡不禁再次感叹：玩家中果然人才辈出！而且是真的敢啊。

他隐身在王宫看大戏时就猜测玩家中会不会也有人溜进来了。

没想到还真的有人溜进来。

“看来不用我警告你们了。你们应该很清楚虎王马上就会派人来抓捕你们，这次你们做什么都用，虎王铁了心要封掉八卦报。”

总编丁勾一脸义愤和悲伤，眼中却满是兴奋：“为了报道新闻的自由，我们都已经做好了为新闻事业牺牲的准备。”

龙岳：“……倒也不必如此，只要由明转暗。”

“不！”丁勾激动地喊：“我们八卦报就算消失也要轰轰烈烈地消失！”

丁勾转身，大吼：“兄弟们，让我们守好这最后一班！无论如何都要把这最新一期的报纸给印刷出来！”

“好哒~”

“没问题！”

“虎王要来抓我们了吗？哇，好刺激，好鸡冻，我们是不是变成了反派。等下我们反抗，会不会有几千几万的兽兵来抓我们？”

“那我们是不是可以拥立新的虎王？”

“苍天已死，黄天当立！废掉旧王迎新王！”

“打完这一场，我们应该能升好几级吧？”

“新的任务出现啦！好像是俺们谷主亲自下达的任务，我先看看~”

龙岳：天残谷主也忍不住想要加入进来了吗？

龙岳忽然发现这里已经没他这个老板的事了，报社员工在用全部热情印刷新一期报纸，压根没把有人就要来抓他们的事放在心上，甚至十分期待。

龙岳：“如果有什么问题，需要机器和材料的话，你们知道如何联系上我。”

丁勾摆摆手，态度特别敷衍。

如果龙岳真的是这群人的老板，大概能气死。

不过他知道这些人都只是把他当做一个普通的游戏NPC看待，长得又一般，当然不会在乎他。

而这也正是龙岳这个身份需要达到的效果。

忙碌的报社员工甚至没注意到他们的老板什么时候离开，倒是有几个跑出门查看，一个个摩拳擦掌就等着抓捕他们的人过来。

“都做好准备！这次，我们要玩一把大的！”丁勾激动得声音都劈叉了。

“摇人啊！赶紧摇更多的人过来！”

王宫那边的热闹刚结束，八卦报社这边的热闹又升起。

治安局带来大量人员前来抓捕报社成员并关停报社。

双方都没有什么好话，一方要抓人，一方不让抓人，更不让对方进入报社内部。

不到两分钟，双方就打了起来。

围观的人特别多，很多人没有看到王宫的大戏，这会儿都跑来看八卦报的生死之战。

好多人都在为八卦报社呐喊助威，还有人跟着报社的员工高喊“我们有知道真相的权力”，附近听到的人好奇之下自然而然聚拢过来。

结果就是看热闹的越来越多，天空地面屋顶到处都是兽人，还有巨虫！

治安官向城卫军求救，要求城卫军把看热闹的民众全部驱离。

城卫军特别想翻白眼：这么多人怎么驱离？靠武力吗？你这是想要把事情闹到多大？

但城卫军也不好真的什么都不管，他们组成了人链，阻挡看热闹的兽人进入八卦报社附近五十米内。

治安局的人和八卦报的人就在这块空地上厮杀。

治安局的人还希望城卫军也帮他们抓人。

但城卫军现场负责的大队长说：“我们没有接到相关任务，不能妄动。”

意思很明显，双方职责清晰，你们闹出来的事你们自己收拾，别想把我们也拉下水。

领头的治安官特别想骂人。合作单位就是这么合作的吗？还有没有一点合作单位的兄弟情了？

城卫军大队长坚定的：一码归一码，这事我们不沾，有什么话你找我们统领谈。

治安局的人无奈，他们也不想来啊，但是王令难违！

等打起来，治安局才骇然发现这群报社员工竟然非常能打。

不但每个人都拥有特别的血脉天赋，更可怕的是他们每个人都悍不畏死！

而任何与别人战斗过的人都知道，实力强不算真的强，不怕死敢玩命还有实力的那才叫真正的强大。

跑来抓人的治安官们只能不断摇人前来帮忙。
chunks.englishText:
The Old Madam smiled faintly to herself, her mood lifting slightly. She had also heard Ares Shang’s low muttering, even if she didn’t quite catch what he was saying. Yet, she was convinced that the reason Raphael had remained so calm today—unswallowed by negative emotions like rage, resentment, or grievance—was largely due to Ares Shang staying by his side.

The Lion Territory group and the Tiger King seemed to have held a brief consultation, and the Prime Minister, Grand Duke Chester, and others began clearing the area.

The Tiger King offered no objection; he would have been more than glad if everyone who had entered the palace today simply vanished into thin air.

At this point, sealing off the palace was entirely meaningless. Several palace walls and halls had already collapsed, and the guards, desperate to avoid the clash between the two behemoths, had no spare attention to hunt for Annelina.

Clement had returned.

After capturing Remiel, he had immediately gone to busy himself with hunting down Annelina.

Clement gave the Tiger King a slight shake of his head.

Although the Tiger King had already steeled himself—knowing that if Annelina dared to make a move, she must have prepared an escape route—seeing that even Clement had failed to find her still left him feeling intensely anxious and vexed.

Anyone watching the accumulated wealth of generations vanish into thin air would be driven frantic with worry.

That the Tiger King could still maintain his composure here and parry words with the Tiger Kingdom’s nobles made him a remarkably steady monarch indeed.

The court priest stepped forward and walked toward Bushuai’s family.

Bushuai gently pulled the Old Count and his wife.

The elderly couple instantly grabbed Bushuai in return, and they turned to leave right then and there.

The Tiger King’s gaze swept over Raphael and the Old Count’s family, but he made no move to stop them from leaving.

Seeing Bushuai leave without even looking back, the court priest halted his steps.

He could tell that this family was deeply displeased by his exposure of the special energy hidden within Bushuai’s body. Even Old Count Langzhen, who had previously been on good terms with him, no longer wished to speak to him.

The court priest let out a helpless sigh.

He could not leave just yet.

The Lion Territory faction and the others all demanded that he stay to witness the outcome of the upcoming deliberations.

The Tiger King’s gaze shifted once more toward the Queen, exceptionally chilling in its intensity.

He suspected that this vicious woman was the one hiding his spatial belt, as well as the culprit behind the switch.

The Tiger King summoned Clement and assigned him two tasks.

The first task was to track down the escaped Remiel, capture him, and bring him back alive—he specifically emphasized that he wanted him alive.

The second task was to search the Queen’s bedchamber and uncover any clues regarding the missing spatial belt.

Between the two tasks, the latter took precedence.

After leaving the palace, Bushuai’s family made all haste back to the Count’s Estate.

Shang Feifan still had matters to attend to and did not accompany them.

Bushuai guessed that Shang Feifan must be heading to the gossip newspaper office to break the news.

The Tiger King currently harbored a deep hatred for the tabloid that had exposed his greatest scandal, while the other Tiger Kingdom nobles—frightened by the paper’s influence—were equally eager to have the publication shut down immediately.

After all, if this newspaper dared to report on the Tiger King’s own scandals, whose secrets wouldn’t they dare broadcast to the common folk?

When Shang Feifan rushed to the newspaper office, he found the place bustling with frantic activity; they were actually typesetting and printing a new issue of the paper.

Assuming his disguise as the newspaper owner, Long Yue, Shang Feifan picked up a draft and began to read.

Having finished it, Shang Feifan could not help but marvel once again: players truly were a talented lot! And they were utterly fearless.

When he was cloaked in invisibility watching the grand spectacle at the palace, he had wondered if any players might have slipped inside.

He hadn’t expected that someone actually had.

"It seems I don’t need to warn you. You should be well aware that the Tiger King will soon dispatch men to arrest you. This time, no matter what you do, the Tiger King is dead set on shutting down the Gossip Daily."

Editor-in-Chief Ding Gou wore an expression of righteous sorrow, yet his eyes burned with excitement: "For the freedom of the press, we are fully prepared to sacrifice ourselves for the cause of journalism!"

Long Yue: "…… There’s really no need for that. You just need to take your operations underground."

"No!" Ding Gou shouted passionately. "Even if our Gossip Daily must vanish, we will vanish in a blaze of glory!"

Ding Gou spun around and bellowed, "Lads, let's hold this final line! No matter what, we must print out this latest issue!"

"Gotcha~"

"No problem!"

"Is the Tiger King coming to arrest us? Wow, how thrilling, how exciting! Are we the villains now? If we resist later, will there be thousands upon thousands of beast soldiers coming after us?"

"Does that mean we can enthrone a new Tiger King?"

"The Azure Heaven is dead; the Yellow Heaven shall stand! Down with the old king, hail the new!"

"After this fight, we should be able to level up quite a bit, right?"

"A new quest has appeared! It seems to be a quest issued personally by our Valley Master. Let me check it out first~"

Long Yue: *Is the Sky Remnant Valley Master itching to get in on the action too?*

Long Yue suddenly realized that there was no role left for him, the owner, here. The newspaper employees were pouring all their enthusiasm into printing the new issue, completely unconcerned that people were coming to arrest them—in fact, they were thoroughly looking forward to it.

"If you run into any issues and need machinery or materials, you know how to contact me."

Ding Gou waved a hand dismissively, his attitude exceedingly perfunctory.

If Long Yue had truly been the owner of this unruly bunch, he probably would have died of anger.

However, he knew these people simply viewed him as a standard gaming NPC—and a rather average-looking one at that—so naturally, they wouldn't care about him.

And that was precisely the effect the identity of Long Yue was supposed to achieve.

The busy newspaper staff didn't even notice when their boss departed. A few of them ran out the door to keep watch instead, rolling up their sleeves and eagerly awaiting the arrival of their arresters.

"Get ready, everyone! This time, we're going to play big!" Ding Gou’s voice cracked with excitement.

"Call in reinforcements! Hurry up and summon more people over!"

The commotion at the royal palace had barely subsided when a new uproar erupted right outside the Gossip Daily office.

The Public Security Bureau brought a massive force to arrest the newspaper staff and shut down the publication.

Neither side minced words. One side wanted to make arrests, while the other refused to be taken—and flatly barred them from stepping foot inside the building.

Within two minutes, a brawl broke out.

The onlookers numbered in the masses. Many had missed the grand spectacle at the palace and rushed over to watch the life-and-death struggle of the Gossip Daily instead.

Countless people began cheering and shouting slogans for the newspaper. Some even joined the staff in roaring, "We have the right to know the truth!" Hearing the commotion, curious passersby in the vicinity naturally gathered around as well.

As a result, the crowd of onlookers grew larger and larger. Beastmen filled the sky, the ground, and the rooftops—there were even giant insects!

The chief inspector appealed to the City Guards for backup, demanding that they disperse the spectating citizens entirely.

The City Guards wanted to roll their eyes: *How are we supposed to disperse a crowd this massive? By force? Just how big of a mess do you want to make?*

Yet the City Guards couldn't just stand by and do nothing. They formed human chains to block the spectating beastmen from getting within fifty meters of the Gossip Daily office.

Thus, the men of the Public Security Bureau and the employees of the Gossip Daily fought fiercely in the open space between them.

The Public Security officers still hoped the City Guards would help them make arrests.

However, the commander of the City Guards on site stated flatly, "We have received no such orders. We cannot act rashly."

The implication was crystal clear: both sides had distinct duties; you clean up the mess you started, don't try to drag us down with you.

The lead inspector was practically choking on his own rage. *Is this how allied units cooperate? Is there even an ounce of fraternal camaraderie left between us?*

The City Guards commander remained resolute: *Business is business. We are staying out of this. If you have anything to say, take it up with our Commander-in-Chief.*

The men of the Public Security Bureau felt utterly helpless. They hadn't wanted to come here either, but royal orders could not be disobeyed!

Once fighting broke out, the Public Security officers were horrified to discover that these newspaper employees were freakishly strong in combat.

Not only did every single one of them possess unique bloodline talents, but even more terrifyingly, not a single one of them feared death!

Anyone who had ever fought others knew that raw strength wasn't true power—those who didn't fear death, dared to risk their lives, and had the strength to back it up were the truly terrifying ones.

With no other choice, the inspectors who had come to make arrests could only continuously call in reinforcements to help.

chunks.chineseText:
可那八卦报的成员不知道为什么，也是越打越多。明明地上都躺着不少尸体，可还是有人从报社里往外冲，外面也会有人大喊着为了新闻自由冲过来和他们打斗的兽人。

天残谷主就站在附近，八卦报社这边一打起来，他那边就知道了。

他还知道为什么八卦报社成员怎么都杀不完抓不完的原因，因为他的传送阵已经设置好，这几天已经有大量玩家跑来王城。

天残谷主对此情况喜闻乐见，他原本就想利用玩家搞乱虎国乃至整个兽人大陆。

现在玩家自己和虎国最高层对上，都不用他找什么说辞，玩家这会儿都要打疯了。

不过只是和治安局成员打也没什么意思。

天残谷主低头，再次编辑并发布了几个任务。

【虎王持身不正，联手情-妇做下换子丑闻，并为此不惜要动手杀死原配王后。如此国王……】

【传闻虎王遗失的腰带乃是一条空间腰带，里面装满了虎国几代积累的大半财富，如果谁能得到这条腰带……】

【有人想要虎王死，正在招募死士刺杀虎王……】

“哗啦！”

天空中突然降落大量报纸。

还有人用大喇叭高喊：“号外号外！王后变身巨兽，欲咬死虎王！虎王变身巨兽反击！”

“看报看报！王室特大丑闻！虎王与情-妇安妮塔联手调换他人骨肉已经实锤！”

“重大消息快来看啊！堂堂虎王竟然遗失了虎国象征的空间腰带！”

“虎王再次陷入粉红陷阱，被一名美艳宫女调换了身上的空间腰带！虎国权贵纷纷指责虎王！认为他不配继续当虎国的王！”

“虎王翻脸无情，命令抓捕私生子雷米尔，只因为他……”

“安妮塔藏身金溪庄园，只为杀光丹顿家族血脉……”

“虎国最高夫妇虎王和王后反目成仇，当着众臣和儿女之面，一心想要杀死对方……”

“虎王愤怒王城八卦报揭露真相让王室丢脸，竟然命令大臣关停报社还要抓捕报社成员……”

看热闹的人不敢置信，这些内容是他们能听到的吗？

但报纸落下来，几乎每个人都伸手去抓去捡。

平时好歹也要卖十个铜达铢呢，如今可是免费就能得到，抓到一张，哪怕不看内容，只当引火纸也好啊。

实际上，王城中只要认字的人这会儿绝大多数都在看报。

八卦报的员工不止在报社附近狂撒报纸，他们还把报纸送到了王城各个热闹区域，见人就发报纸，口中喊着骇人的题头，还跟你说报纸免费。

谁能忍住不去拿一份报纸看看？

一开始还是有人在发，之后派发报纸的人就被热情的王城民众给包围起来。这些热情的吃瓜群众看报社员工一个人派报纸太辛苦，就主动帮他分发。

“虎王的空间腰带遗失了？真的假的？”

只要是稍微有点见识的人都被这条新闻给锁住目光。

更别说那些来自虎国之外的客人。

听说虎王竟然遗失了被称为虎国象征、藏有虎国几代财富的空间腰带，好多人都蠢蠢欲动。

如果他们中有谁能在虎王之前找到这条空间腰带，那不是要发爆？

八卦报社那边，治安局的人已经不敢再继续打下去。

这哪里是抓捕，这根本就是杀人！

虽然上面明确跟他们说明，遇到强烈抵抗，可以按照袭击治安官和妨碍治安的罪名格杀勿论，但是他们是不是杀得太多了？

治安官们都麻了。

他们什么时候竟然杀死了这么多兽人？

地上真的躺了好多兽人，全都是血！

周围看热闹的人也不再为报社呐喊助威，好多人就那么沉默地看着抓捕现场。

还有小幼崽被大人捂住眼睛。

“虎王暴虐！为掩饰自己的丑闻不惜派出治安官大肆杀人，明明应该保护民众的治安官却成了杀死无辜兽人的凶手！这样的虎王不配当王！”

“这样的虎王不配当王！”

一声又一声，原本还杂乱低微的声音，逐渐变得越来越整齐、越来越嘹亮。

“暴虐的虎王不配当王！”

“为暴虐虎王杀害无辜兽人的治安官不配当治安官！他们应该住手！”

“住手！住手！”

“暴虐不仁的虎王下台！”

“下台！下台！”

这里面呼喊的人有多少是玩家，多少是真正的王城民众，就没有多少人知道了。

最后王城民众只知道八卦报社附近全是震耳欲聋的呼喊虎王下台的声音。

八卦报社死伤无数的重大新闻在没有报纸宣传的情况下，在当天就传遍了全王城。

“你是没看到，那场景是真的惨啊！”

“死了好多人，地上全都是尸体。那些虫日的治安官到后面全都吓退了，他们恐怕都没有意识到他们怎么会就杀了那么多人！”

“至少死了几十个人，听说那边地上全都是血，一脚踩下去都能踩出血溜子。”

“几十人？何止，听说死的人有上百！当时好多人在支援八卦报，好多人实力不强也冲出去了。”

“……你们听说没有，八卦报社那边死了几百人，那些治安官自己都杀怕了。”

“……你们听到没有，王城里到处都是哭声，就是因为一群想要推翻虎王暴-政的民众被虎王命令全都杀了，那人数少说也有上千人！”

“你们是没看到啊，八卦报社那边简直就是血流成河尸堆如山！好多人义愤填膺，为了争取真相知情权，和虎王派来的治安官们拼死战斗。死了好多好多人……”

天残谷主看到这个局面，一边觉得玩家真好用，一边和二王子联系。

他已经按照约定在帮他登上虎国王位，那么二王子答应他的事情是否也应该兑现？

他要求不高，只想进入那个千年前就留存下来的地下图书馆内看一看。
chunks.englishText:
Yet, for reasons unknown, the number of Gossip Daily members seemed to multiply the harder they fought. Even though a fair number of corpses lay scattered across the ground, more people kept charging out from the office, while others outside rushed into the fray, shouting slogans about freedom of the press as they fought the beastmen.

The Sky Remnant Valley Master was standing nearby; the moment the fighting broke out at the Gossip Daily, he had been notified.

He also knew the reason why the newspaper staff seemed impossible to kill or arrest: his teleportation array had already been set up, and over the past few days, a massive influx of players had flooded into the Royal City.

The Sky Remnant Valley Master was more than happy to see this situation play out. His original intention had been to use the players to throw the Tiger Kingdom—and indeed, the entire Beast Continent—into chaos.

Now that the players had locked horns with the highest authorities of the Tiger Kingdom of their own accord, he didn’t even need to manufacture a pretext; the players were fighting with fanatical zeal.

Still, just fighting the Public Security officers wasn't all that interesting.

The Sky Remnant Valley Master lowered his head, edited a few more quests, and published them.

[The Tiger King lacks moral integrity, conspiring with his mistress to pull off a child-swapping scandal, and stopping at nothing to murder his lawful Queen. Such a monarch...]

[Rumor has it that the belt lost by the Tiger King is a spatial belt filled with the accumulated wealth of generations of the Tiger Kingdom. If anyone manages to acquire this belt...]

[Someone wants the Tiger King dead and is currently recruiting suicide assassins to assassinate him...]

*Whoosh!*

A flurry of newspapers suddenly rained down from the sky.

Some people even used loudspeakers to shout at the top of their lungs: "Extra! Extra! The Queen transforms into a giant beast in an attempt to bite the Tiger King to death! The Tiger King transforms into a giant beast to fight back!"

"Read all about it! A monstrous royal scandal! The rumor that the Tiger King and his mistress Anita conspired to swap another’s flesh and blood has been confirmed!"

"Major news, come take a look! The mighty Tiger King has actually lost the spatial belt that symbolizes the Tiger Kingdom!"

"The Tiger King falls into a honey trap once again, having his spatial belt swapped right off his waist by a stunning palace maid! Tiger Kingdom nobles condemn the Tiger King in unison, deeming him unworthy to continue ruling as the King of the Tiger Kingdom!"

"The Tiger King turns ruthlessly heartless, ordering the arrest of his illegitimate son Remiel simply because he..."

"Anita is hiding in the Golden Brook Manor, intent on wiping out the bloodline of the Danton family..."

"The highest-ranking couple of the Tiger Kingdom, the Tiger King and the Queen, have turned against each other. Right in front of their officials and children, they are bent on murdering one another..."

"Enraged that the Royal City's Gossip Daily exposed the truth and brought shame upon the royal family, the Tiger King actually ordered his ministers to shut down the newspaper office and arrest its staff..."

The onlookers could hardly believe their eyes. Were these contents things they were actually allowed to hear?

Yet, as the newspapers fluttered down, almost everyone reached out to grab and pick them up.

Normally, a paper would cost at least ten copper dāzhū, but now they were completely free! Even if they didn't read the content, snagging a copy to use as kindling paper wasn't a bad idea.

In truth, the vast majority of literate people in the Royal City were reading the paper at that very moment.

The Gossip Daily employees weren't just scattering newspapers wildly around their office; they had also dispatched papers to every bustling district in the Royal City, handing them out to anyone they saw while shouting shocking headlines and proclaiming that the papers were entirely free.

Who could resist the temptation to grab a copy and take a look?

At first, it was only the staff handing them out, but soon enough, the distributors were surrounded by enthusiastic citizens of the Royal City. Seeing how hard the newspaper employees were working to hand out the papers, these enthusiastic gossip-lovers proactively stepped in to help distribute them.

"The Tiger King's spatial belt is lost? Is that for real?"

Anyone with even a modicum of insight had their attention instantly hooked by this single piece of news.

Let alone those foreign visitors hailing from beyond the borders of the Tiger Kingdom.

Hearing that the Tiger King had actually lost the spatial belt—a sacred symbol of the Tiger Kingdom said to hold generations of national wealth—many individuals felt their hearts begin to stir.

If any one of them could track down this spatial belt before the Tiger King did, wouldn't they strike it rich beyond their wildest dreams?

Over at the Gossip Daily office, the men of the Public Security Bureau no longer dared to keep fighting.

This wasn't an arrest anymore; this was outright slaughter!

Although their superiors had explicitly instructed them that severe resistance could be met with lethal force under charges of assaulting inspectors and disrupting public order, weren't they killing far too many people?

The inspectors were utterly numb.

Since when had they slaughtered so many beastmen?

There were genuinely countless beastmen lying on the ground, and everything was drenched in blood!

The onlookers surrounding the scene no longer cheered or rooted for the newspaper; many simply stared in heavy, chilling silence at the site of the arrests.

Some parents even covered the eyes of their young cubs.

"The Tiger King is a tyrant! To cover up his own scandals, he hesitates not to dispatch inspectors to commit mass slaughter! The inspectors who ought to protect the populace have instead become executioners murdering innocent beastmen! Such a Tiger King is unworthy of being king!"

"Such a Tiger King is unworthy of being king!"

One voice after another—initially chaotic and quiet—gradually grew more uniform and resounding.

"The tyrannical Tiger King is unworthy of being king!"

"The inspectors who kill innocent beastmen for the tyrannical Tiger King are unworthy of being inspectors! They should stop right now!"

"Stop! Stop!"

"Down with the tyrannical and unmerciful Tiger King!"

"Step down! Step down!"

Just how many of the voices chanting these slogans belonged to players, and how many belonged to true citizens of the Royal City, was anyone's guess.

In the end, all the citizens of the Royal City knew was that the vicinity of the Gossip Daily office was filled with deafening cries demanding the Tiger King step down.

Without even needing newspaper propagation, the major news of the massive casualties at the Gossip Daily office spread across the entire Royal City that very day.

"You didn't see it, but that scene was truly tragic!"

"So many people died, the ground was covered in corpses. Those worm-ridden inspectors were scared shitless by the end of it; they probably didn't even realize how they managed to kill so many people!"

"At least a few dozen people died. I heard the ground over there was swimming in blood—you'd step ankle-deep into pools of gore!"

"Dozens? Far from it, I heard the death toll is in the hundreds! Back then, tons of people were backing the Gossip Daily, and many who weren't even all that strong rushed out to fight."

"…Have you heard? Hundreds died at the Gossip Daily office, and even the inspectors scared themselves to death with their own killing."

"…Have you heard? Crying can be heard everywhere in the Royal City. It's because a group of citizens who wanted to overthrow the Tiger King's tyranny were all ordered killed by him—the number is at least a thousand!"

"You guys didn't see it, but the place outside the Gossip Daily office was literally rivers of blood and mountains of corpses! Out of righteous indignation and for the right to know the truth, countless people fought to the death against the inspectors sent by the Tiger King. So, so many people died..."

Witnessing this state of affairs, the Sky Remnant Valley Master simultaneously felt that players were truly convenient tools while contacting the Second Prince.

He had already upheld his end of the bargain by helping him ascend the Tiger King's throne, so shouldn't the Second Prince also fulfill the promises he made?

His demands weren't high; he simply wanted to enter that underground library left behind a thousand years ago and take a look.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第178章 大王子的赔礼道歉 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第178章 大王子的赔礼道歉

郎伯爵府内。

“你说天残谷主也在给玩家发布任务，想要推翻虎王？还让人去刺杀虎王，以及寻找那条空间腰带？他想干什么？”不帅眉头紧皱。

商非凡拿着一条热毛巾擦脸，他刚把脸上的伪装去掉：“还能干什么，进一步扰乱虎国，他才好浑水摸鱼。”

“你认为他想走建立教派成神的路？”不帅顺手给倒了一杯热奶茶。

商非凡接过来，喝了一口，只觉得心都暖了。

“不是想，而是原本就是这个计划，否则他不会选择天残谷主这个身份。大贵族之后，天生异貌，血脉天赋惊人，再悲天悯人收留大量天残，先为天残立命，再收拢奴隶、被权贵欺压的平民、逃难的灾民，然后就是传播教义，竖立神像，再搞些神迹出来，进而收集信仰之力。这就是一条包装成熟的成神之路……的捷径。”

不帅脑中灵光一闪：“神迹？那家伙是不是打算利用魔法？”

商非凡打了个响指：“现成的东西，为什么不利用？如果让那家伙找到魔晶，或者找到替代魔力的能量，他完全可以把魔力包装成新神之力。还能搞出只有皈依他的神教，信仰他，才能被赐予新神力之种学到魔法，并地位越高学到的魔法威力就越大，这一条龙的利益链。”

“而他的发展地盘在虎国境内，一个教派想要在虎国快速崛起，还不被针对，只有得到上层乃至官方的支持。或者就干脆把整个虎国搞乱，让上层根本无力去管束和打压新教派。”

不帅反应非常快：“天残谷主和二王子联合了？”

商非凡想到他从天眼系统那里打听来的消息，点头：“天残谷主从二王子手中买下了城外一座荒山的使用权，并在那山里的别府建造了传送阵。”

不帅：“怪不得王城一下来了那么多玩家，还源源不断。等等，你知道传送阵的确切地点？那不是说，只要去毁了那个传送阵，新的玩家就无法再继续进入王城？”

商非凡笑：“不止。天残谷主之所以在王城郊外建造传送阵，好像和出生点不能随意移动和建造有关。”

不帅眼睛一亮：“这么说，只要毁掉传送阵，玩家就算复活也无法立刻赶来王城？”

商非凡笑：“就是如此。”

不帅松了口气，必要时他们对付一个天残谷主没问题，但如果还要面对无数前赴后继的玩家，那他……恐怕就只能做一个游戏中的反派大boss了。

更要紧的是，他好歹也是这里土生土长的人……恢复记忆后，不得不说他对这个世界的认同感也加强了不少，虽然这里有人对他不好，但也有很多人对他很好。

他并不希望虎国生乱。否则单以他的能力，他都能把虎王给暗杀了。

总之，虎王可以换，但虎国不能乱！

两人又聊了几句玩家和八卦报社的情况。

商非凡说回正事：“二王子背地里对王位肯定也有所筹谋，但他肯定比不上大王子多年培养出来的势力。但有了天残谷主也是玩家的支援，那就不一样了。二王子相当于拥有了一群人数众多还打不死的兽人大军。”

“但虎王也不是吃素的，二王子就算有玩家支援，想要谋夺王权也需要徐徐图之。但现在虎王名声受损、威望下降，加上王后恨透了虎王，其他权贵对虎王也有不满，这就让二王子看到了一个最好的发力机会。”

不帅明白了：“所以二王子希望王城这会儿越乱越好，而天残谷主必然和二王子做了某种交易，比如他放出玩家帮助二王子，二王子在成为新虎王后，就会让他的教派合法化？”

商非凡：“八-九不离十。现在的玩家也许还没有实力杀死虎王，但如果让他们找到机会围攻虎王，采取放风筝的方法，就把虎王困在一个地方慢慢磨，一批玩家被打死再换一批玩家，七十二小时就可以轮流一次。虎王就是再厉害也会被活生生磨死。”

“如果在这之前再弄一些刺杀、下毒、捣乱，让虎王睡都睡不安生，虎王必然会变得焦头烂额。到时候如果有虎王信任的人建议他离开王宫，去往其他地方暂避，说不定虎王真的会同意。”

不帅接口：“但虎王不会想到他去避难的地方才是真正要他命的地方”

商非凡：“对！”

“你们俩在说什么呢？阿瑞斯商你小子是什么时候进来……你是谁？”老伯爵刚跨进小厅就变了颜色。

不过他并没有摆出攻击架势，也没有露出敌意，只看他大孙子和对方站得那么近、神态还那么放松且带着一丝亲昵，就知道对方不会是敌人。

商非凡转过头，右拳放到胸口，行礼：“姥爷好！”

老伯爵：“谁是你姥爷？别乱喊！阿瑞斯商？”

商非凡笑，神态一变，变得特别碉：“就是我。”

老伯爵无语地上下打量商非凡：“这才是你真正的模样？”

商非凡点头。

“那你的名字？”

“商皇。”

不帅干咳：“姥爷，你叫他商就行。”

商非凡眨眨眼：“叫我阿瑞斯也可以，我护照上就这个名字。”

老伯爵没听懂护照什么意思，不过不妨碍他理解：“行吧，我就叫你阿瑞斯。”

老伯爵又看向外孙：“这么说，你们早就认识？”

不帅不好意思地点头。

老伯爵轻哼：“那这小子那么大张旗鼓地追求你？”

商非凡抢着说：“是我真的在追求不帅。而且我总要有个理由出现在不帅身边。”

“为什么要特意弄出阿瑞斯商这么一个身份？”老伯爵不明。

商非凡：“一来这个身份可以高调做事，也不会连累到不帅。二来多一重身份也能多一重掩护。第三嘛，如果让别人知道我和不帅一开始就认识，某些人恐怕会怀疑不帅，进而会进一步想要调查他甚至谋害他。”

老伯爵明了，赞赏地说：“很好。你虽然年轻，但也思虑周到。”

商非凡坦然接受赞扬。

“姥姥怎么样了？”不帅转移话题。

老伯爵叹息：“我让她先休息了。她身体虽然好了很多，但今天喜怒交加，再看到雷米尔那个样子，她心里很不好受。”

三人一回来，不帅就看出老夫人有点强撑，就赶紧和老伯爵一起送老夫人回房休息。

老夫人拉着他说了一会儿话，支撑不住就睡着了。

老伯爵心疼老妻，就坐在床边陪伴了一会儿。

不帅就退出来，浏览伯爵府里挂的画像。

管家特别殷勤，跟前跟后给他介绍。

不帅不好意思这么劳烦管家，就找了个借口让管家去忙自己的事。

管家虽然离开，但也时刻注意着不帅这边的需求。

商非凡用的热水，还有喝的热奶茶，都是管家听到动静主动送来的。

“雷米尔……随他去吧。”不帅只希望这个人能不要再惹事，最好从此不冒头。

他其实有点可怜这个人。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 178: The Eldest Prince's Apology and Reparations

Inside the Count Lang Estate.

"You're saying the Sky Remnant Valley Master is also issuing quests to the players, trying to overthrow the Tiger King? He's even getting people to assassinate the Tiger King and hunt for that spatial belt? What on earth is he plotting?" Bushuai furrowed his brow deeply.

Shang Feifan was wiping his face with a hot towel, having just removed the disguise from his skin. "What else could he be plotting? Throwing the Tiger Kingdom into even greater turmoil so he can fish in troubled waters."

"Do you think he wants to walk the path of founding a sect and becoming a god?" Bushuai casually poured him a cup of hot milk tea.

Shang Feifan took it and took a sip, feeling a warmth spread straight to his heart.

"It's not that he wants to—that was his plan from the very start. Otherwise, he wouldn't have chosen the identity of the Sky Remnant Valley Master. The descendant of a grand aristocrat, born with abnormal features, possessing astonishing bloodline talents, yet filled with universal compassion to take in a multitude of the maimed and handicapped. First, establish a righteous cause for the outcasts, then gather slaves, commoners oppressed by the aristocracy, and displaced refugees. Following that, spread doctrines, erect divine statues, and pull off a few divine miracles to harvest the power of faith. This is a maturely packaged shortcut to godhood."

A flash of inspiration struck Bushuai’s mind: "Miracles? Is that guy planning to use magic?"

Shang Feifan snapped his fingers. "Why not make use of something that's already readily available? If that fellow manages to find magic crystals or a substitute energy source for magic, he can completely package magic as the power of a new god. He can even establish an exclusive benefit chain where only those who convert to his church and worship him are bestowed with the seed of this new divine power to learn magic—and the higher their status, the more powerful the magic they can learn."

"And his territorial base is within the borders of the Tiger Kingdom. For a sect to rise rapidly within the Tiger Kingdom without being targeted, it can only happen if it gains the support of the upper echelons, or even the official government. Alternatively, he can simply plunge the entire Tiger Kingdom into chaos, leaving the higher-ups utterly powerless to rein in or suppress the new sect."

Bushuai reacted with lightning speed: "The Sky Remnant Valley Master has joined forces with the Second Prince?"

Recalling the intelligence he had gathered from the Heavenly Eye system, Shang Feifan nodded. "The Sky Remnant Valley Master bought the usage rights of a barren mountain outside the city from the Second Prince, and built a teleportation array in a detached manor within that mountain."

Bushuai said, "No wonder so many players suddenly arrived in the Royal City, and continue to pour in endlessly. Wait, do you know the exact location of that teleportation array? Doesn't that mean as long as someone goes and destroys that array, new players won't be able to enter the Royal City anymore?"

Shang Feifan smiled. "More than that. The reason the Sky Remnant Valley Master built the teleportation array in the outskirts of the Royal City seems to be tied to the restriction that spawn points cannot be casually moved or constructed."

Bushuai’s eyes lit up. "In other words, as long as the teleportation array is destroyed, even if players respawn, they won't be able to rush back to the Royal City immediately?"

Shang Feifan smiled. "Precisely."

Bushuai let out a breath of relief. Dealing with a Sky Remnant Valley Master was well within their capabilities if necessary, but if he also had to face endless waves of inexhaustible players, he... well, he might just have to resign himself to playing the role of a final boss villain in a video game.

More importantly, he was, after all, a native born and raised here... After regaining his memories, he had to admit that his sense of belonging to this world had grown significantly. Although some people here had treated him poorly, there were also many who had treated him exceptionally well.

He did not wish to see the Tiger Kingdom descend into chaos. Otherwise, using his abilities alone, he could have quietly assassinated the Tiger King.

In short, the Tiger King could be replaced, but the Tiger Kingdom must not plunge into chaos!

The two chatted for a few more moments about the players and the Gossip Daily.

Returning to business, Shang Feifan said, "The Second Prince is definitely plotting behind the scenes for the throne, but he certainly can't compare to the faction the Eldest Prince has spent years cultivating. However, with the support of the Sky Remnant Valley Master and the players, it's a whole different story. The Second Prince essentially commands a massive army of beastmen who are numerous and unkillable."

"Yet the Tiger King is no pushover either. Even with player support, if the Second Prince wants to seize royal power, he has to bide his time. But right now, the Tiger King’s reputation is in ruins, his prestige has plummeted, coupled with the Queen's utter hatred for him and the dissatisfaction of other nobles, the Second Prince sees this as the absolute best window of opportunity to make his move."

Bushuai understood. "So the Second Prince wants the Royal City as chaotic as possible right now. And the Sky Remnant Valley Master must have struck some sort of deal with him—for instance, he deploys players to help the Second Prince, and once the Second Prince becomes the new Tiger King, he will legalize his sect?"

Shang Feifan replied, "Eight or nine out of ten. Today's players might not have the strength to kill the Tiger King yet, but if they find an opportunity to besiege him, adopting a kite-flying tactic to trap the Tiger King in one place and slowly wear him down—with one batch of players dying only to be replaced by another, cycling every seventy-two hours—no matter how powerful the Tiger King is, he will eventually be ground down to death."

"If they mix in some assassinations, poisonings, and sabotage beforehand to ensure the Tiger King can't even sleep in peace, he's bound to become frantic and overwhelmed. By then, if someone the Tiger King trusts suggests he leave the royal palace to take refuge elsewhere, he might actually agree."

Bushuai chimed in, "Except the Tiger King won't expect that the place he goes to seek refuge is the very place meant to take his life."

Shang Feifan: "Exactly!"

"What are you two whispering about? Ares Shang, when did you brat walk in... Who are you?" The Old Count’s expression changed the moment he stepped into the small parlor.

However, he did not strike a hostile posture or show any animosity. Just seeing how closely his eldest grandson stood to this fellow, with such a relaxed and faintly affectionate demeanor, told him this person could not possibly be an enemy.

Shang Feifan turned around, placed his right fist over his chest, and bowed. "Good day, Grandpa!"

Old Count: "Who’s your grandpa? Don't go spouting nonsense! Ares Shang?"

Shang Feifan smiled, his demeanor shifting into something distinctly roguish. "It's me."

The Old Count speechlessly looked Shang Feifan up and down. "This is your true appearance?"

Shang Feifan nodded.

"And your name?"

"Shang Huang."

Bushuai gave a dry cough. "Grandpa, you can just call him Shang."

Shang Feifan blinked. "Or you can call me Ares, that's the name on my passport."

The Old Count didn't quite catch the meaning of 'passport,' but that didn't stop him from grasping the gist. "Fine then, I'll just call you Ares."

The Old Count looked back at his grandson. "So you two knew each other long ago?"

Bushuai nodded, looking slightly embarrassed.

The Old Count let out a soft huff. "Then what was with this brat openly and boldly pursuing you?"

Shang Feifan cut in, "I really am pursuing Bushuai. Besides, I always needed a reason to appear by his side."

"Why go out of your way to invent an identity like Ares Shang?" The Old Count was puzzled.

Shang Feifan explained, "Firstly, this identity allows me to act high-profile without implicating Bushuai. Secondly, having an extra identity provides an extra layer of cover.
