And thirdly, if others knew that Bushuai and I had known each other from the very beginning, certain individuals might grow suspicious of him, leading them to investigate him further or even plot against him."

Understanding dawned on the Old Count, and he praised approvingly, "Very good. Though young, you are thorough and thoughtful."

Shang Feifan accepted the praise with poise.

"How is Grandma holding up?" Bushuai changed the subject.

The Old Count sighed. "I had her lie down to rest first. Though her health has improved a lot, today brought a roller-coaster of emotions, and seeing Remiel in that state has left her feeling deeply distressed."

As soon as the trio had returned, Bushuai had noticed the Old Madam was forcing herself to stay strong, so he and the Old Count had hurried her back to her room to rest.

The Old Madam had pulled him close to chat for a while before falling asleep from sheer exhaustion.

Out of deep affection and concern for his wife, the Old Count had remained by the bedside to keep her company for a bit.

Bushuai had then stepped out to browse the portraits hanging in the count's estate.

The butler had been exceptionally attentive, trailing behind him to introduce each one.

Feeling rather bad about troubling the butler so much, Bushuai found an excuse to send him off to attend to his own duties.

Even though the butler left, he constantly kept an eye on Bushuai’s needs.

The hot water and hot milk tea Shang Feifan used had been promptly delivered by the butler the moment he heard the sounds of activity.

"Remiel... let him be." Bushuai only hoped this person wouldn't cause any more trouble and, ideally, never show his face again.

Truth be told, he felt a shred of pity for the man.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第178章 大王子的赔礼道歉 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
看起来被保护，实际上一样被当做工具人，还没有被教好，如今还被曝出真实身世。

对方对他的妒忌和仇恨在他看来就是身份立场陡然转换后的巨大落差造成。

加上雷米尔把虎王当父亲看，而虎王则是在当雷米尔父亲之前先把自己放在了国王的身份位置上。

雷米尔想要当个可以跟父亲肆意任性的儿子，但虎王却希望雷米尔这个儿子既能和他撒娇卖乖，同时还要像最忠心的臣子一样毕恭毕敬，并绝对不可违反他的命令。

看看雷米尔今天被抓时的神情，不帅是真同情他。

更不要说王后恨安妮塔入骨，绝不可能放过雷米尔。

但王后那情况，显然也坚持不了多久。只要熬到王后离世，雷米尔也不用再担心以后会有人追杀他。

天下这么大，哪里不能去？

“我等会儿让人去……你父母的宅子看看，也许他躲回家里了。”

老伯爵说这话时心里很清楚雷米尔这时候不可能躲回那座宅子，别人要找他，肯定也会先去那个宅子找他。

不帅和商非凡都听出了老伯爵的意思。

老伯爵应该很困扰，那栋宅子是否应该收回来。

道理上，那栋宅子肯定要收回来。

但……世上很多事并不是只看道理如何，雷米尔对他们狠得下心，他们对雷米尔却无法狠心一刀两断，还要人净身出户。

不帅就只是点了点头。他对父母的宅子并没有念想。

老伯爵：“宅子无所谓，但你父母留在那里的一些东西，还是得让雷米尔还回来。郎飞和泽沐尔不是他亲生父母，他也没见过他们，那些东西对他也毫无意义。”

商非凡抢在不帅前面说：“那等会儿我们就去那边看看，如果能碰到雷米尔，正好把这件事做个了断。”

“对了，阿瑞斯怎么叫你不帅？”老伯爵皱眉。这个名字真难听，阿瑞斯这是在嫌弃拉斐尔长得不够好看吗？

一想到阿瑞斯商有可能嫌弃他外孙的长相，老伯爵看商非凡的眼神就特别不善。

商非凡委屈大了：“我也觉得阿沐很帅超级帅，但这不是他第一次告诉我名字就是不帅，后来我就叫习惯了。”

老伯爵看向不帅。

不帅只好解释：“我对外的正式名字是拉斐尔郎沐，但在我是虎王私生子的身世被公开前，也就是十岁以前，我都叫虎不帅。”

老伯爵愤怒：“这是虎王还是安妮塔给你取的名字？他们怎么可以这么恶毒！”

不帅：“就是小名，贱名好养活……而我五官确实平常。”

“呸！”老伯爵特别生气：“那两个混蛋！把你换了去，还不肯好好对待你。我是怎么对待他们儿子的？他们竟然连个好名字都不愿意给你！”

老伯爵气得身体发抖。

不帅并不在意自己的名字，就哄老爷子：“那我以后就叫郎沐，不叫虎不帅，也不叫拉斐尔。”

老伯爵气立刻顺了，特别大声地说：“对！以后你就叫郎沐！是我郎家血脉！”

商非凡心里一动，忽然问：“姥爷，雷米尔的名字是您给取的吗？”

老伯爵一愣，“不是，是陛下……”

话没说完，老伯爵又把自己给气到。

当年虎王亲自给他外孙赐名，他还觉得虎王爱屋及乌，觉得这是一个荣耀，哪怕他们老夫妻俩为外孙想了很多名字，最后还是放弃了为外孙取名的权力。他女儿和女婿当年可是说了让他们老俩口给第一个孙孙取名。

不说其他，按照郎家传统，他们家儿孙要取名字也是走表意的象形字，而不是用表音文字。

商非凡又问：“那郎沐这个名字，您熟悉吗？”

老伯爵回忆，过了一会儿才说道：“我一开始听到郎沐这个名字还真觉得有点熟悉，现在想来这个名字好像也在我和孩子姥姥列出的名单上。我们当时想了很多个名字，其中用郎飞和泽沐尔的名字也做了各种排列组合。但列得太多，除了最喜欢的一两个，其他反而记得不是很清楚。”

老伯爵看向两人：“你们怀疑虎王就是看到了我们给外孙取的名字，才给拉斐尔添加了郎沐这个发音？”

商非凡点头：“因为这种从两个名字中各取一个单独发音的取名行为不像是表音文字使用者的习惯。虎王说郎沐这个名字是为了感念前侍卫统领夫妻的牺牲，才给自己的孩子取了这么一个中间名。但按照表音文字的取名习惯，不更应叫拉斐尔·郎·泽沐尔吗？”

老伯爵恍然大悟：“对！就是这样。我当年怎么没想到呢？”

老伯爵再次懊悔。

商非凡宽慰老人：“这就是有心算无心。你们有一个孙子在身边，相貌和郎飞统领也有相似之处，又怎么会怀疑别的小孩会是自己的亲孙子。就算听到名字发音，也不会多想。而虎王的解释也算说得过去。”

老伯爵还是生气，并想着幸亏老妻现在不在，否则听到这些还不得气昏过去！

商非凡又说：“所以不帅这个名字可能真的只是一个小名，虎王他们不是不重视阿沐的名字，反而就是因为重视，才不敢随便叫。”

“拉斐尔郎沐这个名字，虎王可能早就取好，他那时心里应该还是觉得对不起郎家的，这才从二位给孙子取的名字中找了个不太起眼的加给阿沐。但他做贼心虚，不敢把这个名字公开。”

“十年过后，虎王应该是觉得换子一事不再可能会被挖出来，加上阿沐身世暴露，堂堂虎王的儿子，纵然是私生子，也不能弄个很随意的名字，这才把拉斐尔郎沐这个名字正式给了阿沐。”

老伯爵包括郎沐本人，都觉得这个可能性很高。

商非凡勾住郎沐的手：“当然，这只是我的个人猜测。情况到底如何，以后有机会可以问问虎王或安妮塔。”

老伯爵也不想再纠缠此事，反正他外孙以后就叫郎沐。

“现在王城里很乱，我刚刚听管家说八卦报社那边好像死了不少人，真是作孽！人家只是实话实说罢了。”老伯爵气呼呼。

“你们说我们家是不是应该帮一把八卦报社？我打算等会儿就去治安局要人，把那些被抓的报社员工全都要回来。”老伯爵虽然是在问两个晚辈，但他的态度明显已经决定好。

郎沐和商非凡互看。

商非凡摇头，对老人说：“不用去。八卦报内部已经解决了这个问题，他们把被抓走的人都抢了回来。另外，剩下的报社成员也全都由明转暗。治安局这次杀了不少人，引得民怨沸腾，暂时也不敢再开大。”

“能联系上那家报社吗？他们现在是不是很缺钱缺药剂？”老伯爵还是觉得他们家应该做些什么。

商非凡原本想要拒绝，但转念一想：“好，我去找找看，他们现在应该很需要来自民众的关心和支持。”

让老爷子去给玩家送个温暖，给玩家留个好印象也是好的。
chunks.englishText:
He appeared to be protected, but in reality, he was treated just as a tool; he hadn't been raised properly, and now his true parentage had been exposed.

In Bu Shuai's eyes, the other's jealousy and hatred stemmed from the massive psychological drop caused by the sudden shift in identity and stance.

Furthermore, Remil regarded the Tiger King as a father, whereas the Tiger King had placed himself in the position of a monarch long before treating Remil as a son.

Remil wanted to be a son who could act willfully and recklessly with his father, but the Tiger King expected Remil—as a son—to not only play coy and fawn over him, but also to bow and scrape like the most loyal of subjects, strictly forbidden from ever defying his commands.

Looking at the expression on Remil's face when he was captured today, Bu Shuai truly pitied him.

Not to mention that the Queen hated Anita to the bone and would never let Remil off.

Yet, given the Queen's condition, she clearly wouldn't last much longer. As long as he hung on until the Queen passed away, Remil wouldn't have to worry about anyone hunting him down in the future.

The world was so vast; where could he not go?

"I'll have someone go... and take a look at your parents' residence later. Perhaps he is hiding back home."

When the old Earl said this, he knew very well in his heart that Remil was unlikely to hide in that mansion right now; anyone looking for him would undoubtedly check that place first.

Both Bu Shuai and Shang Feifan caught the old Earl's implication.

The old Earl was likely troubled over whether that mansion should be reclaimed.

Logically speaking, that residence definitely had to be taken back.

However... many things in this world are not judged by logic alone. While Remil could harden his heart against them, they found it impossible to make a clean break with Remil and force him to leave with nothing.

Bu Shuai merely nodded. He had no lingering attachment to his parents' house.

The old Earl continued: "The house doesn't matter, but some things your parents left behind there still need to be returned by Remil. Lang Fei and Zemuer weren't his biological parents, nor had he ever met them; those items are utterly meaningless to him."

Shang Feifan spoke up before Bu Shuai could: "Then we'll head over there to take a look later. If we happen to run into Remil, we can settle this matter once and for all."

"By the way, why does Ares call you Bu Shuai?" The old Earl frowned. That name was truly hideous; was Ares showing disdain for Raphael's lack of good looks?

The mere thought that Shang Feifan might be dissatisfied with his grandson's appearance made the old Earl's gaze toward Shang Feifan exceptionally unkind.

Shang Feifan felt immensely aggrieved: "I also think A-Mu is handsome, super handsome! But this was the first name he told me when we met, and after a while, I just got used to calling him that."

The old Earl looked at Bu Shuai.

Bu Shuai had no choice but to explain: "My official external name is Raphael Lang Mu, but before my identity as the Tiger King's illegitimate son was made public—that is, before I turned ten—everyone called me Hu Bu Shuai."

The old Earl flew into a rage: "Did the Tiger King or Anita give you that name? How could they be so malicious!"

Bu Shuai replied: "It was just a childhood nickname; cheap names are easier to raise... And my facial features are indeed quite ordinary."

"Pui!" The old Earl was furious. "Those two bastards! They traded you away yet refused to treat you properly. Look at how I treated their son? And they couldn't even bother to give you a decent name!"

The old Earl trembled with anger.

Bu Shuai didn't care about his own name at all, so he coaxed the old man: "Then I'll be called Lang Mu from now on, not Hu Bu Shuai, and not Raphael."

The old Earl's anger immediately subsided, and he said in a booming voice, "Right! From now on, your name is Lang Mu! You are of the Lang family bloodline!"

A thought stirred in Shang Feifan's heart, and he suddenly asked, "Grandpa, was Remil's name given by you?"

The old Earl was startled. "No, it was His Majesty..."

Before he could finish, the old Earl managed to anger himself all over again.

Back then, the Tiger King had personally bestowed a name upon his grandson, and at the time, he had felt that the Tiger King was extending his affection to the house for his sake, considering it an honor. Even though he and his old wife had brainstormed many names for their grandson, they ultimately relinquished the right to name him. His daughter and son-in-law had told the old couple back then to name their very first grandchild.

Besides, according to the Lang family's tradition, when naming their children and grandchildren, they used ideographic pictographs rather than phonetic writing.

Shang Feifan asked again, "Then the name Lang Mu, are you familiar with it?"

The old Earl reminisced, speaking only after a moment: "When I first heard the name Lang Mu, I really felt it sounded a bit familiar. Now that I think about it, this name seemed to be on the list compiled by me and the child's grandmother. We thought of many names back then, and even made various permutations and combinations using Lang Fei and Zemuer's names. But we listed too many, and apart from the one or two we liked best, we didn't remember the others very clearly."

The old Earl looked at the two of them. "Are you suspecting that the Tiger King saw the name we chose for our grandson and thus gave Raphael the phonetic sound of Lang Mu?"

Shang Feifan nodded. "Because this kind of naming practice—taking a single sound from two separate names—doesn't match the habits of phonetic script users. The Tiger King claimed he gave his child this middle name in memory of the sacrifice made by the former chief guard couple. But following the naming conventions of phonetic writing, shouldn't it be Raphael-Lang-Zemuer?"

The old Earl had a sudden flash of insight. "Right! Exactly. Why didn't I think of that back then?"

The old Earl was filled with regret once more.

Shang Feifan comforted the old man: "This is a case of intentional planning against the unprepared. You had one grandson by your side, and his features resembled those of Commander Lang Fei; how could you possibly suspect that another child was your own biological grandson? Even upon hearing the phonetic sound of the name, you wouldn't think much of it. Moreover, the Tiger King's explanation sounded plausible enough."

The old Earl was still furious, thinking to himself that it was a fortunate thing his old wife wasn't here right now; otherwise, hearing all this would have frightened her to the point of fainting!

Shang Feifan added, "Therefore, the name Bu Shuai might truly have been just a childhood nickname. It wasn't that the Tiger King and the others didn't care about A-Mu's name; on the contrary, it was precisely because they cared that they didn't dare use it casually."

"The Tiger King probably settled on the name Raphael Lang Mu long ago. At that time, he must have still felt a sense of guilt toward the Lang family, which is why he picked a rather inconspicuous part from the names you and your wife had chosen for your grandson and tacked it onto A-Mu. But because he had a guilty conscience, he didn't dare make the name public."

"Ten years later, the Tiger King must have felt that the child-swapping incident could no longer be unearthed. Coupled with A-Mu's exposed heritage—as a dignified Tiger King's son, even if illegitimate, he couldn't bear a casual name—he finally officially bestowed the name Raphael Lang Mu upon A-Mu."

Both the old Earl and Lang Mu himself felt this possibility was extremely high.

Shang Feifan hooked his finger around Lang Mu's. "Of course, this is just my personal conjecture. As for what the actual situation was, we can always ask the Tiger King or Anita if the opportunity arises."

The old Earl didn't wish to dwell on the matter any further; in any case, his grandson would be called Lang Mu from now on.

"The royal city is in complete chaos right now. I just heard the steward say that quite a few people seem to have died over at the gossip newspaper office. What a sin! They were merely speaking the truth." The old Earl was indignant.

"What do you say, should our family lend a hand to the gossip newspaper? I plan to go down to the Public Security Bureau later and demand the release of all those arrested newspaper employees." Although the old Earl was asking his two juniors, his tone made it clear he had already made up his mind.

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan exchanged glances.

Shang Feifan shook his head and said to the old man, "There's no need to go. The gossip newspaper office has already resolved this issue internally; they staged a raid and snatched back everyone who was arrested. Furthermore, the remaining staff members have all gone underground. The Public Security Bureau killed quite a few people this time, causing public outrage to boil over, so they won't dare press the issue openly for the time being."

"Can we get in touch with that newspaper office? Are they severely lacking in money and potions right now?" The old Earl still felt that their family ought to do something.

Shang Feifan had originally wanted to refuse, but upon second thought, he said, "Alright, I'll go look for them. They must be in great need of concern and support from the citizens right now."

It would also be a good thing to let the old master send some warmth to the players and leave them with a favorable impression.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第178章 大王子的赔礼道歉 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
“尽快，早一点找到他们，也能多救几个人。”老伯爵还是挺担心那些报社员工生死的，甚至说出：“如果他们没有地方躲避，就把他们带来我这里。我看谁敢上门找麻烦！”

老伯爵牙齿咬得咯吱响，他就不信虎王能好意思跑到他家里来抓人杀人。

郎沐没赞成也没反对，他的着重点不在玩家身上，而是：“王城乱起来，那些邪神信徒就更好作乱。我想在走之前，把王城里的邪神信徒都找出来。”

“那是特调局的工作、虎王的职责，你难道还想继续在特调局工作吗？”老伯爵生气。

郎沐劝慰老人：“覆巢之下无完卵。况且如果王城真的出事，您和姥姥真的能视而不见？只怕到时候你们比谁都伤心难受。”

老伯爵沉默了。

他和老妻在王城待了大半辈子，在这里出生、在这里长大，他们又怎么可能真的看到王城遭劫而无动于衷？

就算他们要走，也希望他们走的时候王城和虎国都是好好的。

“你一个人又能做到多少。”老伯爵小声叨叨。

郎沐笑起来：“能做多少是多少，我也没想要大包大揽，坚持到下一个虎王上位，我们就离开王城。”

老伯爵夫妇在今天跑去找虎王算账时就已经做好离开王城的准备。

不管是虎王继续坐在王位上，还是换虎王的儿女来当王，他们一家留在王城就是一个大写的尴尬。

他们家不尴尬，但挨不住虎王和王室成员看到他们会感到尴尬。

“行吧，正好我们家还有一些家产要处理。”老伯爵随即就询问两人将来打算去哪里。

“去黑河荒原那边经营也可以，天高国王远，你们俩可以在那里慢慢发展你们的势力，将来就是把整个黑河荒原都拿下来也不是不可能。放心，不要担心前期建设经费的事，你姥爷我虽然把土地都送给了虎王，但家底子还在。不说多，给你凑个百八十万还是能凑出来的。”

老伯爵说话的架势明显就是不打算再归还黑河荒原。

租赁？租个屁的赁！

以前他傻，把家里的封地全都送给虎王，想要支持他集权。

现在……管他去死！

土地给了他外孙，那就是他外孙的了。别说百年后的租赁费他们不会给，就是五十年后的税金，他们家也不会掏一铜！

郎沐想要婉拒，但老爷子根本不给他开口的机会。

“如果你们不想在虎国发展，也可以去别的国家。到时候你就把黑河平原再转租给其他人，拿着钱去南方联盟。你姥爷我在那里买了一个农庄。那农庄原本想送给雷米尔，但那孩子不稀罕。阿沐啊，你不介意姥爷把别人不要的东西塞给你吧？”

郎沐哪可能介意，老爷子这是故意不给他婉拒的任何借口。

老伯爵拍拍孙子的手臂：“到时候姥爷和姥姥跟你一起过啊。不过你要是嫌弃我们老而无用又烦人，我们也不会去碍你的眼睛。”

“姥爷！您在说什么呢？我巴不得和你们住在一起。”郎沐哭笑不得。

“那好，那我们一家三口就住在一起。再加一个也不是不行。”老伯爵笑眯眯。

商非凡插话：“那是一定要加的。”

郎沐囧。

“哦，你们还年轻，不想待在家里种田也没关系，姥爷帮你们看着家，你们什么时候想回来就回来，姥爷和姥姥给你们守着家。”

老伯爵找回亲外孙，整个人都变得精神气勃勃，完全没有了之前那种等死的浓厚暮年感。

郎沐直觉他姥爷和姥姥只要养得好，说不定能再活一百年！

“姥爷……”郎沐感动。

在这个世界，就是商非凡都没能给他一个家的感觉。

可面前的老人却说要帮他们守着家，让他们随时都有一个可以回去的地方。

郎沐的心忽然就有了一点着落。

就好像是浮萍终于飘到了岸上，找到了属于自己的土壤，有了要扎根的迹象。

前面两世，他也有过家，但自始至终那都是他一个人居住的房子。

总感觉与家还是有点差别。

大约有家人等待的房子才是家吧，还得是真心待你的家人。

郎沐抱住了老人，真心实意地说：“你们二老去哪里，我就跟去哪里。你们二老在的地方，就是我的家。”

老伯爵眼圈发红，欣慰地笑，反手不断拍抚外孙的肩背：“好，好。”

商非凡妒忌坏了。

但他能怎么办呢？

那可是阿沐的姥爷姥姥啊，真有至亲血缘关系的！

想想阿沐的前两世，亲人缘都极为浅薄。第二世是没有亲人，第一世的亲人有还不如没有。这第三世好不容易有了亲人，还分离了二十一年。

现在祖孙相逢，如果两老对阿沐感情平平，阿沐也绝不会强求，更不会特意亲近，尽到孝道即可。但二老在不知道阿沐是他们孙子的情况下都很喜欢阿沐，现在知道阿沐的身世那就更不用说了。

就是商非凡作为旁观者也不得不承认，老伯爵夫妇是真的疼爱和极度在乎这个外孙。

换言之，两位老人绝对是郎沐最想要的那种家人。

算了，他家大宝贝缺爱，能有更多人疼爱阿沐也是好事。

商非凡转头，看向通道。

管家站在那里抹眼泪，他也看了听了好一会儿，不忍心出言打搅。

还是郎沐察觉到管家前来，不好意思地轻轻松开老伯爵。

老伯爵现在看外孙是哪儿哪儿都好，不过该理会的事情还是要理会的。

“阿武，怎么了？”

武管家清清嗓子：“大王子殿下来了。”

三人一起看向武管家。

老伯爵惊讶：“大王子怎么来了？克莱门特也来了吗？”

武管家摇头：“没有克莱门特大人，只有大王子，而且他只带了四名侍卫，且是轻装出行。”

老伯爵对虎王和王后意见特别大，但对大王子的感观还可以，想了想，就让管家带王子去客厅。

“你和我一起去，看看大王子突然跑来是想干什么。”老伯爵跟外孙说。

郎沐答应，并猜测：“他应该没有恶意。”

他甚至猜到了大王子跑来伯爵府的用意。

商非凡掏出化妆工具开始变装。

老伯爵和郎沐没有等他，商非凡摆摆手，让他们先去。

看着郎沐的背影，商非凡忽然想起一件事，他好像还没有把拿到空间腰带的事告诉不帅？

大王子前来的用意果然和郎沐猜测的一样。

他就是来赔礼道歉的。

“还好你们都还在家。我就怕赶不及，我担心你们会马上离开王城，想着如果我今天不赶来，以后还不知道有没有机会。”大王子一见到郎沐和老伯爵就说道。

老伯爵脸色有点黑，但还是给了大王子一点面子，让管家给大王子上茶和茶点。

“不知大王子殿下特特赶来一趟，是有什么事？”

大王子就说了一大通对于换子事件的感想和歉意。
chunks.englishText:
"As soon as possible. Finding them earlier means saving a few more lives." The old Earl was quite concerned about the life and death of those newspaper employees, even going so far as to declare: "If they have nowhere to hide, bring them here to my estate. Let's see who dares come knocking looking for trouble!"

The old Earl gnashed his teeth, refusing to believe the Tiger King would have the nerve to march into his home to make arrests and kill people.

Lang Mu neither agreed nor objected. His focus didn't lie with the players, but rather on: "With the royal city in turmoil, those evil god cultists will find it even easier to stir up trouble. Before I leave, I want to root out all the evil god cultists hidden in the royal city."

"That's the Special Investigation Bureau's job, the Tiger King's duty! Do you seriously still want to keep working at the Special Investigation Bureau?" The old Earl grew angry.

Lang Mu placated the old man: "When the nest is overturned, no egg remains intact. Besides, if a disaster truly strikes the royal city, could you and Grandma really turn a blind eye? I fear you'd end up more heartbroken and distressed than anyone else."

The old Earl fell silent.

He and his old wife had spent the better part of their lives in the royal city; they were born here and grew up here. How could they possibly watch the royal city fall to ruin and remain indifferent?

Even if they were going to leave, they hoped that when the time came, both the royal city and the Tiger Kingdom would still be in good shape.

"How much can you possibly accomplish on your own?" The old Earl muttered under his breath.

Lang Mu laughed. "I'll do as much as I can. I have no intention of shouldering the whole world; once the next Tiger King ascends the throne, we'll leave the royal city."

The old Earl and his wife had already prepared themselves to leave the royal city when they went to settle accounts with the Tiger King earlier today.

Regardless of whether the Tiger King remained on the throne or if his sons and daughters took over as monarch, their family staying in the royal city would be awkward to the extreme.

Even if their own family didn't feel awkward, they couldn't stop the Tiger King and the royal family members from feeling uncomfortable at the sight of them.

"Fine. As it happens, our family still has some estate properties to settle." The old Earl immediately asked where the two of them planned to go in the future.

"Running operations over in the Black River Wasteland is an option. The heavens are high and the king is far away; the two of you can slowly build up your forces there. In the future, taking over the entire Black River Wasteland isn't impossible. Rest assured, don't worry about the initial development funding. Although your grandpa gave all his land to the Tiger King, the family foundation is still intact. To put it modestly, scrounging up a million or eight hundred thousand to give you a start is well within my power."

The old Earl's tone and posture made it abundantly clear that he had no intention of ever returning the Black River Wasteland.

Rent? Rent my ass!

He had been a fool in the past, handing over all his family's fiefs to the Tiger King in a bid to support his centralization of power.

Now... to hell with him!

The land was given to his grandson, so it belonged to his grandson. Forget about refusing to pay the lease fees a hundred years from now; even fifty years from now, their family wouldn't shell out a single copper coin!

Lang Mu wanted to politely decline, but the old man didn't give him the slightest opening to speak.

"If you don't want to develop in the Tiger Kingdom, you can go to other countries. By then, you can just sublease the Black River Plain to someone else and take the money down to the Southern Alliance. Your grandpa bought a farm down there. That farm was originally meant for Remil, but that child didn't think much of it. A-Mu, you won't mind your grandpa stuffing someone else's rejected scraps into your hands, will you?"

How could Lang Mu possibly mind? The old man was deliberately cutting off any excuse for a polite refusal.

The old Earl patted his grandson's arm. "Grandpa and Grandma will go live with you then. But if you find us old, useless, and annoying, we won't stay around to be an eyesore."

"Grandpa! What are you talking about? I'd be begging to live with you." Lang Mu was torn between tears and laughter.

"Good, then our family of three will live together. Adding one more isn't out of the question either." The old Earl smiled brightly.

Shang Feifan interjected: "Adding one is absolute."

Lang Mu felt a twinge of awkwardness.

"Oh, you two are still young; it doesn't matter if you don't want to stay home and farm. Grandpa will watch the house for you. Whenever you want to come back, just come back—Grandpa and Grandma will hold down the fort for you."

Having recovered his biological grandson, the old Earl looked radiant with energy, completely shedding that heavy, lingering sense of twilight-years despair he'd had earlier.

Lang Mu had a gut feeling that as long as his grandpa and grandma were well-nurtured, they might just live another hundred years!

"Grandpa..." Lang Mu was deeply moved.

In this world, even Shang Feifan hadn't been able to give him the true feeling of a home.

Yet the old man before him was saying he would help them guard their home, ensuring they always had a place to return to.

Lang Mu's heart finally felt like it had anchored somewhere.

It was as if a piece of duckweed had finally drifted ashore, found soil of its own, and begun to take root.

In his previous two lives, he had also had houses, but from beginning to end, they were just places where he lived alone.

There was always a sense that it fell short of being a true home.

Perhaps a house with family waiting for you could truly be called a home—provided they were family who treated you with sincerity.

Lang Mu hugged the old man and said sincerely, "Wherever you two go, I'll follow. Wherever the two of you are, that is my home."

The old Earl's eyes reddened with a gratified smile, and he reached out to pat and stroke his grandson's shoulders repeatedly. "Good, good."

Shang Feifan was green with jealousy.

Yet what could he do?

That was A-Mu's grandfather, tied by genuine blood relations!

Thinking back on A-Mu's first two lives, his affinity for family had been exceptionally thin. In his second life, he had no family; in his first life, having family was worse than having none at all. In this third life, having finally found family, they had been separated for twenty-one years.

Now that grandfather and grandson were reunited, if the old couple had felt only lukewarm affection for A-Mu, A-Mu would never have forced it or sought special closeness, simply fulfilling his filial duty and nothing more. But the two elders had liked A-Mu immensely even before knowing he was their grandson; knowing his true lineage now made their fondness go without saying.

Even as an onlooker, Shang Feifan had to admit that the old Earl and his wife truly cherished and deeply cared for this grandson.

In other words, the two elders were unequivocally the kind of family Lang Mu desired most.

Fine. His big darling lacked love; having more people shower A-Mu with affection was a good thing after all.

Shang Feifan turned his head to look down the hallway.

The steward was standing there wiping away his tears, having watched and listened for quite a while, unable to bear interrupting.

It was only when Lang Mu sensed the steward's presence that he sheepishly and gently loosened his grip on the old Earl.

Right now, the old Earl thought his grandson could do no wrong, but business that needed tending still had to be addressed.

"A-Wu, what is it?"

Steward Wu cleared his throat. "His Highness the Eldest Prince has arrived."

The three of them looked at Steward Wu in unison.

The old Earl was startled. "Why is the Eldest Prince here? Did Clement come too?"

Steward Wu shook his head. "Lord Clement is not here. Only the Eldest Prince, and he brought merely four guards, traveling light."

The old Earl held deep grievances against the Tiger King and the Queen, but his impression of the Eldest Prince was passable. After pondering for a moment, he instructed the steward to show the Prince into the drawing room.

"Come with me and see what the Eldest Prince is up to by showing up all of a sudden," the old Earl said to his grandson.

Lang Mu agreed, guessing aloud: "He shouldn't harbor any malicious intent."

He even managed to guess the Eldest Prince's purpose in running over to the Earl's estate.

Shang Feifan whipped out his makeup tools and began changing his appearance.

The old Earl and Lang Mu didn't wait for him; Shang Feifan waved his hand, telling them to go ahead.

Watching Lang Mu's retreating figure, Shang Feifan suddenly remembered something—had he even told Bu Shuai about obtaining the spatial belt yet?

The Eldest Prince's purpose for coming turned out to be exactly as Lang Mu had guessed.

He was here to apologize.

"It's a good thing you're both still at home. I was afraid I wouldn't make it in time, worried that you might leave the royal city immediately. I thought if I didn't rush over today, I might never have the chance again." The Eldest Prince blurted out the moment he set eyes on Lang Mu and the old Earl.

The old Earl's expression was somewhat dark, but he still gave the Eldest Prince a modicum of face, having the steward serve tea and pastries.

"I wonder what brings Your Highness the Eldest Prince rushing over on a special trip?"

The Eldest Prince launched into a long speech expressing his reflections and apologies over the child-swapping incident.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第178章 大王子的赔礼道歉 (Part 4)
chunks.chineseText:
“……虽然父王给了你和郎家补偿，但我知道那远远不够。这是我个人的一点收藏，没有其他意思，就是希望你能收下，很抱歉以前我和弟弟妹妹们待你那么苛刻，我也不求原谅，只是……你就当我想让自己心里好过一些。”

大王子姿态放得很低，重要的是他不是装出来的。

郎沐摇头：“殿下，你对我从没有苛刻过，不需要对我说抱歉。”

“那你就当我这个做兄长的替弟妹道歉吧。我知道老三和……茜娜给你找了很多麻烦，他们那时那么大了，还欺负你一个小孩子，真的很不像话。可惜我没能次次阻止他们。”

“殿下，真的不用。你不是应该来道歉的人。”

“拉斐尔，我……”

“郎沐，收下吧。”老伯爵开口了：“既然大王子殿下诚心来道歉，就像他自己说的，你就当为了让他心里能好过一些。”

大王子立刻满脸期盼地看向郎沐。

郎沐无奈，只能收下大王子殷勤推过来的一个小盒子。

大王子的目的就是道歉和送东西，见郎沐收下，他就像是完成了一件大事，起身感叹：“拉斐尔，如果你真是我弟弟就好了，我是说同父同母的那种。”

老伯爵破功，特别想把大王子给扫地出门。

郎沐：“……殿下谬赞。”

大王子走了，就像是卸下了一个重负。

来这一趟，除了道歉，他还想看看拉斐尔和郎家对他有什么看法。

他心里其实很希望拉斐尔能留下来，如果拉斐尔愿意留下来辅佐他，他真的会很很很高兴。

现在他虽然没有看出对方有留下来的意思，但是他也能感觉出来拉斐尔并不恨他，这就已经……很好了。

郎沐肩膀旁边冒出一颗脑袋：“看看那位大王子给你送了什么好东西，值得他巴巴地跑这一趟。”

大王子没送其他东西，就单送了这么一个小盒子。

老伯爵也很好奇。

郎沐倒不在乎盒子里有什么，看大家都很好奇，就很随意地把盒盖打开了。
chunks.englishText:
"Although Royal Father has provided compensation to you and the Lang family, I know it is far from enough. This is a small collection of my own, and it carries no other meaning; I simply hope you can accept it. I am truly sorry for how harshly my younger siblings and I treated you in the past. I don't ask for your forgiveness; I just... think of it as something to help me ease my own conscience."

The Eldest Prince lowered his posture immensely, and crucially, it didn't look faked.

Lang Mu shook his head. "Your Highness, you have never treated me harshly. You don't need to apologize to me."

"Then consider it me, as an elder brother, apologizing on behalf of my younger siblings. I know third-brother and... Xina caused you a great deal of trouble. They were already so old back then yet bullied a child like you—it was truly disgraceful. It's just a pity I couldn't stop them every single time."

"Your Highness, really, there's no need. You aren't the one who should be apologizing."

"Raphael, I..."

"Lang Mu, accept it." The old Earl spoke up: "Since His Highness the Eldest Prince has come sincerely to apologize, just as he said himself, consider it a way to help him feel a bit better at ease."

The Eldest Prince immediately looked at Lang Mu with a face full of eager anticipation.

Helpless, Lang Mu had no choice but to accept the small box the Eldest Prince pushed toward him.

The Eldest Prince's sole objective was to apologize and deliver the gift. Seeing Lang Mu accept it, he acted as though he had completed a momentous task, standing up with a sigh: "Raphael, if only you really were my brother—I mean, of the same mother and father."

The old Earl broke character, harboring a powerful urge to sweep the Eldest Prince out the door with a broom.

Lang Mu: "...Your Highness flatters me."

The Eldest Prince left, looking as though a heavy burden had been lifted from his shoulders.

Aside from apologizing, his trip was also meant to gauge what Raphael and the Lang family thought of him.

In his heart, he genuinely hoped Raphael would stay. If Raphael were willing to stay and assist him, he would be truly, truly, truly happy.

Although he hadn't detected any intention on the other's part to stay just yet, he could at least sense that Raphael didn't hold a grudge against him, and that alone was... already very good.

A head popped out next to Lang Mu's shoulder: "Let's see what good things that Eldest Prince sent you, enough to make him run all the way over here in such a rush."

The Eldest Prince hadn't sent anything else; he had delivered solely this small box.

The old Earl was also quite curious.

Lang Mu didn't care what was inside, but seeing that everyone was so curious, he very casually flipped open the lid of the box.

chunks.chineseText:
第179章 收获的一天

盒子里面垫了一块白色的绒布，白色的绒布上是一枚巴掌大的黑色石头。

石头形状并不规则，通体漆黑，又略带通透感，宛如墨翡。

如果只是这样，还不算稀奇。

这块石头稀奇就稀奇在黑色的石身上遍布金色纹路，配上那略略的通透感，华贵又神秘，哪怕再不识货的人也能看出这是一枚价值连-城的宝石。

“这是洒金墨翡？不，这已经不是洒金，应该称为金纹墨翡。”

老伯爵年纪大，见到的好东西海了去，不过他也承认这块金纹墨翡极为珍贵，至少他见过不止一次洒金墨翡，但形成图画一般的金纹墨翡还是第一次见。

商非凡的反应就很平淡。也就是一块好看点的石头而已。

不过这石头是不是有点特别？

商非凡发现郎沐打开盒子后，眼睛就盯在这块金纹墨翡上，表情似乎极为惊讶。

“有什么不对吗？”老伯爵也注意到孙子的讶异神情。

郎沐深吸气，他没有伸手去拿起金纹墨翡把玩，而是抽出了魔法骨杖。

老伯爵看到郎沐凭空抽出一条骨杖，一愣，随后想到阿瑞斯商的空间道具大师身份。就是他身为姥爷，也有点羡慕外孙的这个待遇。

不过阿沐这时候把骨杖抽出来是想干嘛？

郎沐也顾不得老伯爵在身边……他相信老伯爵，他原本就打算找个适合的时机告诉对方自己会用魔法的事情，还想请教对方对魔力的了解，同时也是为了让老伯爵警觉天残谷主和二王子一类的人。

计划赶不上变化，今天正好遇到这块金纹墨翡，还是大王子送来的，也许这就是天意？

郎沐用骨杖指着金纹墨翡，口中轻声念出咒语：

“古老的神灵行于天空、行于大地，祂们的神力无所不在，我遵循古老魔法的契约力量，借知识之神的伟力打开眼前的知识之门。”

咒语刚落，金纹墨翡忽然爆发出灿烂的金色光芒，转瞬间，石头就变成了一本厚厚的魔法书。

老伯爵张大嘴巴，下意识揉了揉眼睛。

他没看错吧，刚刚盒子里的石头竟然变成了一本书，还浮在了半空？

郎沐伸手取过那本飘浮在半空的厚厚魔法书，翻开，他只看了一页，就又把魔法书给合上。

魔法书刚合上，又变回了金纹墨翡。

商非凡眼睛特别亮，不用问，这肯定是好东西！

“这是什么？”老伯爵几乎是迫不及待地询问外孙。

但不等郎沐回答，老伯爵又摇手说：“不方便说就不用说，不要为难。”

郎沐笑了笑，“不为难，也没什么不能说的。不过姥爷听了，千万不要传出去。”

“那当然！”老伯爵示意郎沐稍等，“我们去书房说。”

三人当即转换地点。

书房门一关，老伯爵可以确保就算耳力再好的兽人都无法听见他们在书房的说话声，包括听力天赋者。

郎沐再次亮出那枚金纹墨翡，他也没再施展魔法，只是解说：“这是魔法奥秘石，也叫法圣传承石。”

“魔法？”老伯爵脸色有点异样，但他没有追问，只是示意郎沐继续说下去。

郎沐从善如流：“法圣是仅次于法神的魔法师，相当于魔法师中的最顶层。有些法圣会在感觉到自己即将离世，或单纯只是想要留下自己的传承时，就会制作这种魔法奥秘石。

这种奥秘石非常稀少，制作起来也非常困难。得到它就相当于得到了一名法圣的全部传承，也相当于是得到了一条直通法圣之路的通天大道。”

郎沐是真没想到他竟然能在兽人大陆看到一枚魔法奥秘石。

这玩意在法德尔大陆属于任何一名魔法师都梦寐以求却求而不得的超珍稀异宝。

就算同是法圣，也会想要得到奥秘石，好研究其他法圣的成圣之路，给自己增添知识、开拓眼界，说不定还能琢磨出一点成神的法子。

但奥秘石只有法圣能制作，而法圣在制作了奥秘石后又怎么可能轻易让别人知道？

再加上整个法德尔大陆一共才多少个法圣？

故此，奥秘石从来都是传说之物。

但奥秘石的模样不是秘密。

郎沐在来到这个世界之前已经达到大魔法师的境界，他想往前进已经很难，他需要更高深的魔法知识和来自更高境界的魔法师的指导，可魔导师和法圣级别的魔法师又怎么会轻易收弟子进行教学？

更别说他当时年龄已经很大。

而只靠自学和闭门造车就想要突破，郎沐自认自己没有那么强大的天赋，自然就对奥秘石这样的法圣传承特别感兴趣，早早就了解过其外形和特征等。

但他从没有奢望过自己运气真那么好，会得到一枚传说中的奥秘石。

谁想到身死魔法鼎盛的法德尔大陆，重生于没有魔力的兽人大陆，他却意外地得到了一枚奥秘石。

要不是奥秘石就在自己面前，他刚才也用魔法验证过，他还以为自己在做梦呢。

“那两名法圣的遗落物？”商非凡在一边问。

郎沐点头：“我看到了魔法书上的署名，是路德维希法圣。”

商非凡：“这么说，路德维希很有可能陨落了？”

郎沐也不确定：“也许魔法书中会有相关说明，不过我在打开魔法书时感觉到一丝危险……”

“危险？”商非凡立刻警觉起来。

郎沐：“我也不知道。可能路德维希法圣在这枚奥秘石上做了什么手脚，只要有人打开，就会让他知晓。或者是其他。总之，想要翻阅这本魔法书，恐怕我还得做些准备。”

商非凡立刻道：“警觉一些也好。到时候让我陪你一起。”

郎沐点头。

老伯爵终于找到机会插话：“你们两人在说什么？路德维希是谁？这个法圣是哪里来的？阿沐你……是不是会魔法？你刚才施展的是不是就是魔法？”

“姥爷，您不用紧张。”

“我没有紧张，我就是好奇。”老伯爵真的是好奇死了，难道他的外孙有他不知道的奇遇？

“那我们坐下说。”

三人在书房落座。

商非凡自然而然地坐在了郎沐身边。

老伯爵坐在两人对面。

老伯爵瞪了眼商非凡，又满眼期待地看向外孙。

郎沐整理了下思绪：“姥爷，您听过魔力或魔法吗？”

老伯爵一顿：“我曾经听过一个传说。传说在很久很久以前，久到兽人的旧神血帝国建立以前，那时候应该算是远古，兽人大陆的兽人几乎都能觉醒神血天赋，同时都能变身巨兽。但也有一部分兽人觉醒的不是神血，而是魔血，这种兽人又被称为魔巫血脉，他们使用的就是魔力。”

郎沐和商非凡互看。老伯爵说的这个传说，图书馆老人也提到过，且更详细。

“这个传说是谁告诉您的？”商非凡貌似很好奇地询问。

老伯爵坦然说：“是宫廷祭司蚪海潮。我和他关系不错，他跟我说过一些只有圣山祭司宫才知道的古老传说。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 179: A Day of Harvest (Part 1)

The box was lined with a piece of white velvet, and resting upon the velvet was a palm-sized black stone.

The stone was irregular in shape, pitch-black throughout, yet possessed a faint, translucent quality, resembling deep-water black jade.

If it were merely this, it would not have been particularly rare.

What made this stone extraordinary was that the black surface was crisscrossed with intricate golden veins. Combined with its subtle translucency, it looked both luxurious and mysterious. Even someone utterly ignorant of treasures could tell at a glance that this was a priceless gemstone.

"Is this flecked gold black jade? No, this goes far beyond mere flecks—it should be called golden-veined black jade."

The old Earl was advanced in years and had seen countless treasures in his lifetime, yet even he had to admit that this golden-veined black jade was exceptionally precious. He had encountered flecked gold black jade more than once, but this was his first time seeing one where the golden veins formed patterns as intricate as a painting.

Shang Feifan’s reaction, however, was quite mundane. To him, it was merely a somewhat prettier rock than usual.

Still, was there something special about this stone?

Shang Feifan noticed that the moment Lang Mu opened the box, his gaze locked onto the golden-veined black jade, his expression one of profound astonishment.

"Is something wrong?" The old Earl also caught his grandson's startled look.

Lang Mu drew a deep breath. Instead of reaching out to pick up and examine the golden-veined black jade, he drew forth his magical bone staff.

Upon seeing Lang Mu conjure a bone staff out of thin air, the old Earl was stunned for a moment before remembering Ares Shang's identity as a master of spatial artifacts. Even as his maternal grandfather, he couldn't help feeling a trace of envy regarding his grandson's perks.

However, why was A-Mu drawing his bone staff at a time like this?

Lang Mu had no leisure to worry about the old Earl being right beside him... He trusted the old Earl; he had originally intended to find a suitable moment to tell the man that he could use magic, and hoped to seek his guidance regarding magical power. At the same time, he wanted to alert the old Earl to dangerous figures like the Valley Master of Heavenly Mutilation and the Second Prince.

Man's plans could never keep up with sudden changes. Running into this piece of golden-veined black jade today—and having it sent by the First Prince at that—perhaps this was divine will?

Lang Mu pointed his bone staff at the golden-veined black jade and softly chanted an incantation:

*"Ancient deities walk the skies, walk the earth; their divine might is omnipresent. I follow the contract power of ancient magic, and by the mighty will of the God of Knowledge, I open the Door of Knowledge before me."*

The moment the incantation ended, the golden-veined black jade suddenly erupted with a brilliant golden radiance. In the blink of an eye, the stone transformed into a thick magic tome.

The old Earl’s jaw dropped, and he rubbed his eyes reflexively.

Surely his eyes weren't playing tricks on him? The stone in the box just now had actually turned into a book, and it was floating in mid-air?

Lang Mu reached out and took the thick magic tome floating in the air. He flipped it open, read a single page, and then snapped the book shut.

The moment the magic tome closed, it reverted back into the golden-veined black jade.

Shang Feifan’s eyes shone with a brilliant light. Without needing to ask, this was undoubtedly a supreme treasure!

"What is this?" The old Earl asked his grandson, practically bursting with impatience.

Yet before Lang Mu could reply, the old Earl waved his hand and said, "If it's inconvenient to say, you don't have to explain. Don't put yourself on the spot."

Lang Mu chuckled. "It's no trouble at all, and there's nothing that can't be said. However, once Grandfather hears this, you must never let it spread outside."

"Of course!" The old Earl motioned for Lang Mu to wait a moment. "Let's go to the study to talk."

The three of them immediately changed locations.

With the study door firmly shut, the old Earl could rest assured that even Beastmen with the sharpest hearing could not eavesdrop on their conversation inside, not even those with innate auditory talents.

Lang Mu once more produced the piece of golden-veined black jade. Without casting any magic this time, he simply explained: "This is a Magic Mystery Stone, also known as a Saint-Mage's Inheritance Stone."

"Magic?" The old Earl’s expression turned somewhat peculiar, but he didn't press the matter, merely gesturing for Lang Mu to continue.

Lang Mu gracefully obliged: "A Saint-Mage is a spellcaster second only to a God-Mage, standing at the absolute pinnacle of magic. When some Saint-Mages sense that their end is near, or simply wish to leave behind their legacy, they forge these Magic Mystery Stones.

Such mystery stones are exceedingly rare and immensely difficult to make. Obtaining one is equivalent to acquiring the complete heritage of a Saint-Mage, and is tantamount to obtaining a direct, unhindered highway leading straight to the realm of a Saint-Mage."

Lang Mu truly had never expected that he would witness a Magic Mystery Stone here on the Beastman Continent.

In the Fadel Continent, this item was an ultra-rare, exotic treasure that any spellcaster would dream of day and night yet could never hope to obtain.

Even among Saint-Mages themselves, one would desperately desire a mystery stone to study the path to sainthood walked by another, thereby broadening their knowledge, expanding their horizons, and perhaps even catching a glimpse of a method to attain godhood.

Yet only Saint-Mages could forge mystery stones, and once a Saint-Mage had crafted one, how could they possibly let others know easily?

Coupled with the total number of Saint-Mages across the entire Fadel Continent...

Hence, mystery stones had always been the stuff of legend.

However, the appearance of a mystery stone was no secret.

Before coming to this world, Lang Mu had already reached the realm of a Great Mage. Advancing further had become exceptionally difficult; he required deeper magical knowledge and guidance from spellcasters of a higher realm. But how could Archmages and Saint-Mages easily accept disciples for instruction?

Not to mention that he was already quite old at the time.

Knowing that he could never hope to break through relying solely on self-study and working behind closed doors—and knowing he lacked such monstrous talent—Lang Mu had naturally taken a keen interest in Saint-Mage inheritances like the mystery stone, familiarizing himself with their appearance and characteristics long in advance.

Yet he had never dared to dream that his luck would be so good as to actually acquire a legendary mystery stone.

Who would have thought that after dying in the magic-flourishing Fadel Continent and being reborn in the magic-barren Beastman Continent, he would unexpectedly stumble upon a mystery stone.

If not for the mystery stone resting right before him, and the fact that he had just verified it using magic, he would have thought he was dreaming.

"The left-behind relic of a Saint-Mage?" Shang Feifan asked from the side.

Lang Mu nodded. "I saw the signature on the magic book: Saint-Mage Ludwig."

Shang Feifan: "Does that mean Ludwig has most likely perished?"

Lang Mu wasn't certain either. "Perhaps the magic book contains related notes, but when I opened it, I sensed a trace of danger..."

"Danger?" Shang Feifan instantly became alert.

Lang Mu: "I'm not sure. Perhaps Saint-Mage Ludwig left some kind of trigger on this mystery stone so that anyone who opens it will make their presence known, or perhaps something else. In any case, if I want to peruse this magic book, I'm afraid I'll need to make some preparations first."

Shang Feifan immediately said, "It's best to be cautious. Let me accompany you when the time comes."

Lang Mu nodded.

The old Earl finally found an opening to interject: "What are the two of you talking about? Who is Ludwig? Where did this Saint-Mage come from? A-Mu, do you... do you know how to use magic? Was what you just cast actually magic?"

"Grandfather, you don't need to be nervous."

"I'm not nervous, I'm just curious." The old Earl was burning with curiosity—could his grandson possess some miraculous fortune unknown to him?

"Then let's sit down and talk."

The three of them took their seats in the study.

Shang Feifan naturally sat beside Lang Mu.

The old Earl sat opposite them.

The old Earl glared at Shang Feifan before looking expectantly at his grandson.

Lang Mu gathered his thoughts. "Grandfather, have you ever heard of magical power or magic?"

The old Earl paused. "I once heard a legend. It is said that long, long ago—so long ago that it was before the establishment of the Beastmen's ancient Divine Blood Empire, an era that should be considered primeval—nearly all Beastmen of the Beastman Continent could awaken divine blood talents and transform into giant beasts. However, there were also those who awakened not divine blood, but demonic blood. These Beastmen were known as the Demon Shaman bloodline, and what they wielded was magical power."

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan exchanged glances. The legend the old Earl spoke of was also mentioned by the old man in the library, and in even greater detail.

"Who told you this legend?" Shang Feifan asked, feigning intense curiosity.

The old Earl answered candidly, "It was the Court Priest, Dou Haichao. We have a good relationship, and he once told me some ancient legends known only to the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace."

chunks.chineseText:
“他还跟我说，在远古时期，神血兽人可以吸收神力来让自己变得更为强大，魔血兽人吸收的则是魔力。可惜随着时间过去，尤其随着众神陨落，神力已经消失，而魔力也不见踪影。”老伯爵补充。

“他还说，神力和魔力是一对双生兄弟，就像光明与黑暗、生与死，两者缺一不可。当一方消失，另一方也会消失。而想要神力重现，也必须唤醒魔力。”

老伯爵苦笑：“我当时完全不理解他在说什么。只以为他又习惯地神神叨叨。祭司嘛，总是会说一些很诡异又让人听不懂的话。何况他那时还喝醉了。”

商非凡若有所思地说：“看来圣山祭司宫那帮人知道的要比普通兽人多得多。”

郎沐：“他们应该还保留着比较完整的传承。”

老伯爵表示他对魔力和魔法只了解这么多，随后又问郎沐是不是觉醒了魔血血脉。

不等郎沐回答，商非凡抢着问道：“兽人对魔血血脉怎么看待？您在和那位宫廷祭司聊天时，他提到魔血血脉是恐惧、鄙视、排斥，还是其他？”

老伯爵立刻明白商非凡在担心什么，笑着摇摇手：“魔血和神血只是一个说法，现在兽人们觉醒天赋的都不多，能变身巨兽的也没几个。你看我虎国，最高层那批兽人，也只有虎王和狮域大都督能变身巨兽。”

老伯爵还说：“王后当年要不是能变身巨兽，虎王图和她结婚有更大可能生育出能变身巨兽的孩子，虎王当年恐怕也不会迎娶她。

幸而虎王的谋算也不算失败，王后生育了五个孩子，大公主是唯一可以变身巨兽的。

五比一的比列，也不算低了。听说不少大部落和王国，新一代出生的王室血脉能变身巨兽的一个都没有。”

老伯爵最后说：“所以神血血脉的说法早已经没落。如果有谁能帮助他人觉醒天赋能力，或让他们掌握特别的能力，换成魔血血脉又算什么？兽人最终渴求的还是力量！”

商非凡扯了个题外话：“既然大公主能变身巨兽，虎王为什么不让她当第一继承人？而是重点培养大王子？”

老伯爵：“虎国王室的继承权先看出生次序，其次看能力。因为兽人有三百年寿命，生育期从成年开始一直能维持到两百岁左右，很多兽人夫妻一生会有很多孩子，这些孩子的年龄也会相差很大。

这也是贵族尤其是国王结婚很迟的原因。

大王子身体健康，觉醒的天赋能力也很不错，他又比大公主年长将近十多岁。等大公主表现出能变身巨兽的征兆，大王子早已经成年，且已经被当做第一继承人培养多年。”

商非凡明白了。

老伯爵又看向外孙。

郎沐已经想好说辞：“我不知道我是不是魔血血脉，不过我确实机缘巧合下学会了魔法。但我当时以为那本魔法书上写的内容只是胡编乱造，因为我无法感知到魔力。

直到我遇到天残谷主，发现他施展的能力并不是天赋能力，而是很像那本书上描写的魔法，我和老商就想法从他手上夺过了这支骨杖。”

郎沐重新展示骨杖，让老伯爵看杖头上镶嵌的魔晶：“这块魔晶就是魔力来源。在这枚魔晶里的魔力消耗完之前，我都可以凭借这支魔杖施展魔法。”

老伯爵稀奇极了，接过骨杖把玩了好一会儿，又把那魔晶的样子记下。

“这么说我们兽人大陆的魔血血脉一直都没有消失？”

“也许。我们偶尔发现了一个魔晶矿，里面的魔晶储备不算丰富，也不算纯粹，但等级不低。”商非凡有意地透露更多。

老伯爵不是普通老人，如果他不能承担事情，商非凡和郎沐都不会跟他说这么多。

但老伯爵不但有丰富的人生经验，还有能力，郎沐如果一味隐瞒他是魔法师以及他们要寻找自然之神遗失力量的事，也没多大意义。更不要说他们还希望老伯爵能警惕兽人大陆已经出现的魔法师。

“没想到那个天残谷主也是魔血血脉。”老伯爵感叹。

商非凡：“也许从来就没有神血和魔血的分别。所谓神血血脉，不过是天生的异能者。而魔血则是适合学习魔法的人。

我怀疑神血血脉也能学习魔法，只不过远古时期的兽人太过强大，所以他们不屑于去学习魔法。

能张嘴就喷火、跺脚就地震，为什么还要费心费力地去凝结魔法种子，去学习魔法咒语和魔法阵？

这就跟科技与神血能力的竞争一样。自然觉醒神血天赋的人越来越少，普通兽人为了能打得过神血兽人，就只能依靠武器。

远古时期，魔血兽人大概就是打不过神血兽人，才另辟蹊径，发展巫术也就是魔法。”

老伯爵乐了：“你这个猜测很有意思，不过不无可能。”

商非凡耸肩：“事实上，魔血兽人最后也确实败给了神血兽人。神血兽人的能力相当于都是瞬发，且身体强大，还能变身巨兽。而魔血兽人施展魔法得念咒语、得先画魔法阵，临阵战斗力就差了一截，身体体质上可能也差许多，比如不能变身巨兽。最后魔血兽人不得不败走其他大陆。”

商非凡又叹息说：“可靠天赋吃饭和靠知识吃饭还是不一样的。天赋这东西，这一代出现了，下一代不一定还会出现。

就像是种地，第一批农作物收获总是会很好，可随着农作物吸收太多养料导致土地贫瘠，以后的作物收获就会一年比一年差。

但掌握知识就不同了。他们可以在耕作前先培育良种，再改良土质，对土地施肥除草除虫等等，还能搞轮换耕作，确保同一块土地上的作物每年都能丰收。

所以兽人大陆上的神血兽人越来越少，但魔法大陆上的魔法师却日益鼎盛，至少没有那么快衰落。”

老伯爵迟疑：“你是说兽人的未来其实不是看神血血脉，而是应该大力发展魔血……魔巫的知识？”

商非凡：“历史已经告诉我们答案。首先是兽人炼金术的出现，其次就是科技的出现。这两次大变革都是知识在推动。”

郎沐插话：“如果神血兽人能总结出神血能力是如何出现、如何激发、如何传承、如何更好地利用神力，也许还不会那么快消失。”

“神血天赋激发仪式。”老伯爵喃喃说。

老伯爵的神色忽然激动起来：“也许虫人族已经掌握了神血天赋觉醒的方法。这也许就是虫人族和邪神合作的真正原因！”

商非凡忽然有所感应。但这个感应闪得飞快，还没等他细细体会就消失不见。

老伯爵腾地站起，在书房里走来走去。他感觉自己像是知道了一个大秘密。

但很快，老伯爵就冷静下来。知道这个秘密又怎样呢？

神血天赋激发仪式早已经在兽人大陆出现，他帮助雷米尔觉醒天赋就是使用了该仪式。

但雷米尔最后觉醒出的神血天赋很一般，威力更是小儿嬉戏一般。
chunks.englishText:
CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第179章 收获的一天 (Part 2)):
"He also told me that in primeval times, divine blood Beastmen could absorb divine might to grow stronger, while demonic blood Beastmen absorbed magical power. Unfortunately, as time passed—especially with the fall of the gods—divine might vanished, and magical power also disappeared without a trace," the old Earl added.

"He also said that divine might and magical power were like twin brothers, akin to light and darkness, life and death; the two were inseparable. When one vanished, the other would vanish as well. And if divine might were to reappear, magical power would likewise have to be awakened."

The old Earl gave a bitter smile. "At the time, I had no idea what he was talking about. I just assumed he was being his usual eccentric, mystic self. Priests, after all, always spoke in eerie, incomprehensible riddles—especially since he was drunk at the time."

Shang Feifan said thoughtfully, "It seems those folks at the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace know far more than ordinary Beastmen."

Lang Mu: "They likely still preserve a relatively complete heritage."

The old Earl stated that his knowledge of magical power and magic went no further than that, before asking Lang Mu if he had awakened the demonic bloodline.

Before Lang Mu could answer, Shang Feifan jumped in with a question: "How do Beastmen view the demonic bloodline? When you were chatting with that Court Priest, did he mention whether the demonic bloodline is viewed with fear, contempt, rejection, or something else?"

The old Earl instantly understood what Shang Feifan was worrying about. He smiled and waved his hand. "Demonic blood and divine blood are just terms. Nowadays, very few Beastmen awaken talents, and even fewer can transform into giant beasts. Look at my Tiger Kingdom; among the topmost echelon of Beastmen, only the Tiger King and the Lion Territory Grand Governor can transform into giant beasts."

The old Earl continued, "Back then, if the Queen hadn't been able to transform into a giant beast, and if marrying her gave the Tiger King a higher probability of siring children capable of transforming into giant beasts, the Tiger King probably wouldn't have married her in the first place.

Fortunately, the Tiger King's calculations weren't a total failure; the Queen bore five children, and the First Princess is the only one who can transform into a giant beast.

A ratio of one in five isn't considered low. I've heard that in many large tribes and kingdoms, not a single child born to the new generation of royal blood can transform into a giant beast."

The old Earl concluded, "Therefore, the concept of the divine bloodline has long since declined. If someone can help others awaken innate abilities or allow them to master special skills, what does it matter if it's called a demonic bloodline? What Beastmen ultimately crave is power!"

Shang Feifan changed the subject slightly: "Since the First Princess can transform into a giant beast, why didn't the Tiger King make her the primary heir instead of focusing on grooming the First Prince?"

The old Earl: "The succession rights of the Tiger Kingdom royal family look first at birth order, and secondly at ability. Because Beastmen have a lifespan of three hundred years, and their reproductive prime lasts from adulthood all the way until they are around two hundred years old, many Beastman couples have many children throughout their lives, and the age gaps between these children can be quite large.

This is also why nobles—especially kings—marry very late.

The First Prince is in good health, his awakened innate abilities are quite impressive, and he is nearly ten years older than the First Princess. By the time the First Princess showed signs of being able to transform into a giant beast, the First Prince was already an adult and had been groomed as the primary heir for many years."

Shang Feifan understood.

The old Earl looked back at his grandson.

Lang Mu had already prepared his explanation: "I don't know whether I possess the demonic bloodline, but by some twist of fate, I did indeed learn magic. However, back then I assumed the contents of that magic book were pure fabrication because I couldn't perceive any magical power.

It wasn't until I encountered the Valley Master of Heavenly Mutilation and discovered that the abilities he displayed were not innate powers, but closely resembled the magic described in that book, that Old Shang and I figured out a way to seize this bone staff from him."

Lang Mu re-displayed the bone staff, showing the old Earl the magic crystal embedded in the staff head: "This magic crystal is the source of the magical power. Until the magic power within this crystal is exhausted, I can cast magic with the help of this staff."

The old Earl found it utterly fascinating. He took the bone staff, played with it for quite a while, and carefully memorized the appearance of the magic crystal.

"Does this mean the demonic bloodline of our Beastman Continent has never vanished?"

"Perhaps. We occasionally discovered a magic crystal mine; the reserves inside aren't particularly abundant, nor are they entirely pure, but the grade isn't low." Shang Feifan intentionally revealed a bit more.

The old Earl was no ordinary old man; if he couldn't handle heavy matters, neither Shang Feifan nor Lang Mu would have told him so much.

Yet not only did the old Earl possess a wealth of life experience and capability, but if Lang Mu kept blindly concealing the fact that he was a spellcaster and that they were searching for the lost power of the God of Nature, it wouldn't make much sense. Not to mention, they also hoped the old Earl would remain vigilant against the spellcasters who had already appeared on the Beastman Continent.

"To think that Valley Master of Heavenly Mutilation also possesses the demonic bloodline," the old Earl sighed.

Shang Feifan: "Perhaps there has never been any division between divine blood and demonic blood. The so-called divine bloodline is merely innate esper-like ability. Meanwhile, demonic blood is simply suited for learning magic.

I suspect that divine bloodline holders can also learn magic, but the Beastmen of primeval times were simply too powerful, so they disdained to learn it.

When you can spit fire just by opening your mouth and cause earthquakes by stamping your foot, why bother going through the painstaking effort to condense magic seeds, learn magical incantations, and set up magic arrays?

This is just like the competition between technology and divine blood abilities. As fewer and fewer people naturally awakened divine blood talents, ordinary Beastmen had no choice but to rely on weapons to defeat divine blood Beastmen.

In primeval times, demonic blood Beastmen probably couldn't beat the divine blood Beastmen, so they took a different path, developing witchcraft—which is to say, magic."

The old Earl chuckled. "That's a very interesting hypothesis, but it's not entirely impossible."

Shang Feifan shrugged. "In fact, demonic blood Beastmen did indeed lose to divine blood Beastmen in the end. The abilities of divine blood Beastmen are practically instantaneous, their physical bodies are powerful, and they can transform into giant beasts. On the other hand, demonic blood Beastmen had to chant incantations and draw magic arrays to cast magic, leaving their combat effectiveness a cut below in the heat of battle. Their physical constitutions were likely much inferior as well, lacking the ability to transform into giant beasts. In the end, demonic blood Beastmen had no choice but to flee to other continents."

Shang Feifan sighed once more. "Relying on innate talent versus relying on knowledge are still two different things. Talent is something that appears in this generation, but might not necessarily appear in the next.

It's just like farming: the harvest of the first batch of crops is always excellent, but as the crops absorb too much nourishment and leave the soil barren, subsequent harvests grow worse year by year.

Mastering knowledge, however, is different. Before cultivating the land, they can breed fine seeds, improve soil quality, fertilize, weed, and exterminate pests. They can also practice crop rotation to ensure that the crops on the same piece of land yield a bountiful harvest every year.

That is why divine blood Beastmen on the Beastman Continent are dwindling, while spellcasters on the magical continent are flourishing by the day—at least, they aren't declining so rapidly."

The old Earl hesitated. "Are you saying that the future of the Beastmen doesn't lie in the divine bloodline, but that we should vigorously develop the knowledge of the demonic blood... the Demon Shamans?"

Shang Feifan: "History has already given us the answer. First was the emergence of Beastman alchemy, and second was the emergence of technology. Both of these great revolutions were driven by knowledge."

Lang Mu interjected, "If divine blood Beastmen could summarize how divine blood abilities manifest, how they are stimulated, how they are inherited, and how to better utilize divine might, perhaps they wouldn't vanish so quickly."

"The Divine Blood Talent Activation Ritual," the old Earl murmured.

The old Earl’s expression suddenly grew agitated. "Perhaps the insectoid race has already mastered the method for awakening divine blood talents. This might be the true reason why the insectoid race is cooperating with the evil god!"

Shang Feifan suddenly felt a spark of intuition. But the sensation flashed past so swiftly that it vanished before he could grasp it in detail.

The old Earl sprang to his feet, pacing back and forth across the study. He felt as though he had just stumbled upon a massive secret.

Yet very quickly, the old Earl calmed down. So what if he knew this secret?

The Divine Blood Talent Activation Ritual had already appeared on the Beastman Continent; he had used that very ritual to help Remir awaken his talent.

Yet the divine blood talent Remir ultimately awakened was utterly mediocre, its power little more than a child's plaything.

chunks.chineseText:
“所以关键是消失的神力？因为天地间已经没有足够的神力，所以神血兽人才会越来越少，威力也越来越低？”老伯爵神色怅然，同样，想通了这点又怎样？

历史中那么多厉害人物，肯定早就有许多人想到了这一点，但他们都无力改变神力始终在消退的现实。

老伯爵转身看向两个年轻兽人：“你们都学会了魔法？”

两人一起-点头。

老伯爵：“也好。以后我会帮你们留意这种蕴含魔力的魔晶。你们既然能发现一处，肯定还会有更多。”

郎沐看了眼商非凡。

商非凡点头。

郎沐这才对老伯爵说：“关键既不是神力也不是魔力，而是能量转换。魔法大陆那边的魔法师早就开始研究能量转换的问题，确保就算某个地方没有魔力，他们也可以把其他能量转换为魔力。”

老伯爵挥手：“这个什么能量转换就靠你们这些年轻人去研究了。”

随即老伯爵看外孙就像是在看某种新品种兽人：“真是没想到啊。我以为我外孙就是个被人欺负了二十年的小可怜，谁想你竟然很可能是左右兽人大陆未来发展的关键人物。我就说嘛，普通兽人怎么可能发现并进入那座千年前的图书馆。真想让那些瞧不起你的人都知道你是多么厉害。”

郎沐汗颜，连连摆手：“姥爷，您可别这么说，兽人大陆未来发展和我可没什么关系，我只能做一些力所能及的事情。我更不想成为风云人物。”

老伯爵笑：“我也不想你去扛起太多责任。你只要好好的、快乐地活着就好。”

商非凡趁机提到二王子可能也是魔法师的事，让老伯爵小心提防。

老伯爵当即就要去找克莱门特谈谈。

二王子一向表现得与世无争，表面上也没怎么发展自己的势力，可如果他是魔法师，还和同样是魔法师的天残谷主走得很近，一旦他想要竞争王位，那大王子继位一事就很难说了。

“还有王后也会帮助二王子。”商非凡警告。

“我做点东西送给大王子防身。”郎沐的心里原本就偏向大王子继位，现在得到大王子送来的这一份大礼，他就算还人情也得帮大王子啊。

商非凡轻哼。行吧，他也不想欠那个大王子的。

一家人略事休息，老伯爵就要带两人去郎飞和泽沐尔生前住的宅子，他还叫上了老妻一起。

这么重要的事情，如果不喊上老妻，他怕老妻知道后会几天不跟他说话。

在老伯爵去找老夫人时，商非凡叫住郎沐。

“两件事。第一，虎王的那条空间腰带在我手上。第二，我想到了天地复苏的关键，就是打开神之笼。”

郎沐：“……”

郎沐深吸气，“你先让我缓缓。”

商非凡不给他缓和的时间，直接把他拉进了雕像空间。

进入空间的一刹那，商非凡就把寻宝罗盘给封了。

这东西一进来就爆发金光，催他赶紧把空间腰带上交。

空间腰带还在，未知存在并没有动它。

商非凡拿起空间腰带，掏出一个小瓶子。

瓶子里装着一点点暗红色的鲜血。

商非凡把瓶子里的鲜血倒在空间腰带某处，再用自己强大的精神力强行突破。

“砰”，很微小的声音，更像是精神感知。

空间腰带的空间被打开了。

“这是谁的鲜血？”郎沐闻到了血腥气，他心中已经有猜测。

商非凡乐颠颠地说：“虎王的血。之前趁他和王后打架的时候弄到了一点。”

他猜对了，这条空间腰带的控制锁有两重，除了精神印记，还有生物锁。

“让我们看看这里面都装了些什么吧。”

商非凡把自己的精神力延伸进去。

不愧是神的腰带，这里面的空间相当大，一眼都看不尽。

而里面堆放的东西……

商非凡这样见过世面的人也忍不住激动：“我们发财了！”

“里面都有什么？”郎沐也忍不住好奇。

商非凡握住郎沐的手，示意他不要抵抗，带着郎沐的精神力一起进入腰带中的空间。

郎沐头一眼看到的就是宛如一座山一般的粮食堆。

粮食山不止一座，种类也很多，从麦子到豆子应有尽有。

这么多粮食，足够上万人敞开肚皮吃上十年。

除了粮食，还有大量的兽皮、骨头、兽肉。

兽肉竟然看起来都还很新鲜。

商非凡眼红：“竟然可以保鲜。这个雕像广场就没有这样的功能。我炼制的空间道具更没有，顶多就是延缓一些保质时间。要么我们还是不还了吧。”

郎沐：“我相信你一定能炼制出可以保鲜的空间道具。”

商非凡立刻就转换出笑颜：“也是。”

可能是经历过饥荒的缘故，这条空间腰带里存放了大量食物和清水，还有药物。

除了食物，剩下的就是大量的金银珠宝。

这些金银珠宝全都装在箱子里，一箱箱分门别类地堆放。

光是盛放金达盾的箱子就有上千箱。而一箱就是一万金。

银达鲁和铜达铢反而数量不多，不过也有上百箱。

另外还有一些一看就是珍奇的宝物。

其中还有一箱子装的都是地图。

宝物数量不少，商非凡也没时间一一鉴定。

郎沐还看到了王印和一些印有王室标记的特殊物品，其中还包括国王权杖。

郎沐还是第一次看到国王权杖，这东西除非是国王登基这样的重大国事，否则极少会拿出来。

看到国王权杖上那硕大的魔晶，郎沐沉默了。

商非凡也发现了国王权杖的秘密，不由哈哈大笑：“这可真是有心栽花花不开，无心插柳柳成荫。今天绝对是个好日子！”

“这不是魔法杖，就是一根做工精良的权杖上镶嵌了一枚高阶魔晶。我可以把这枚魔晶取下来，给你做一支魔杖。”郎沐说。

商非凡摇头：“我不需要魔晶，我可以把怨气当做魔气使用。这魔晶还是你留着用吧。”

郎沐想要拒绝，商非凡就堵住他：“我不是跟你客气，而是真用不着，魔晶对我来说就是锦上添花的东西，但对你则是必需品。”

郎沐心想怎么可能只是锦上添花。

商非凡凑过去，亲了亲大宝贝的嘴角，“我们是什么关系？需要这样推来推去的吗？”

郎沐脸红，赶紧切换话题：“这里的东西你打算怎么处理？”

商非凡：“你看呢？”

郎沐迟疑。

商非凡揽住他：“想说什么就说。我们凡事都可以商量着来。你不说出你的意见，我就只能揣测。这样虽然也很有意思，但我更希望你说出来。你想想，如果你遇到这种情况，是不是也希望我把我的想法都告诉你？”

郎沐睨商非凡：“我只是在想这么多粮食和鲜肉，我们根本吃不完。又没有一个好的保鲜方法，我可以用魔法延长这些粮食和鲜肉的保质期，但消耗魔力不说，延长时间也不会太长。这里的粮食和兽肉太多了。”

“卖掉？”商非凡问。
chunks.englishText:
"So the key is the vanishing divine power? Because there is no longer enough divine power between heaven and earth, the divine-blooded beastmen are becoming scarcer and their powers weaker?" The old count's expression turned desolate. Yet, what good was it even if they had figured this out?

Throughout history, countless brilliant figures had undoubtedly realized this long ago, yet all of them had proved utterly powerless against the reality of a perpetually receding divine power.

The old count turned to look at the two young beastmen. "You've both learned magic?"

Both nodded in unison.

The old count continued, "Very well. In the future, I will help you keep an eye out for magic crystals containing such magical energy. Since the two of you managed to find one location, there are bound to be more."

Lang Mu glanced at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan nodded.

Only then did Lang Mu say to the old count, "The key is neither divine power nor magical energy, but energy conversion. Mages on the Magic Continent began researching energy conversion a long time ago to ensure that even if a place lacks magic, they can convert other forms of energy into it."

The old count waved a hand dismissively. "You young people can go research whatever this energy conversion is."

With that, the old count looked at his grandson as if examining some brand-new breed of beastman. "I truly never would have imagined. I thought my grandson was just a poor little wretch who had been bullied for twenty years, but who would have guessed that you might very well be the key figure swaying the future development of the Beastman Continent? I always said it: how could an ordinary beastman possibly discover and enter that library from a millennium ago? I only wish those who looked down on you could see just how extraordinary you truly are."

Lang Mu felt thoroughly sheepish, waving his hands repeatedly. "Grandpa, please don't say that. The future development of the Beastman Continent has nothing to do with me; I can only do what lies within my power. I certainly have no desire to become a figure of public renown."

The old count laughed. "I don't expect you to shoulder too much responsibility, either. As long as you live well and happily, that's enough."

Taking the opportunity, Shang Feifan mentioned the possibility that the Second Prince might also be a mage, warning the old count to be on his guard.

The old count instantly declared he would go talk to Clement.

The Second Prince had always projected an attitude of indifference toward worldly struggles, seemingly doing little to cultivate his own faction on the surface. But if he were a mage—and moreover, closely associated with the Master of the Heavenly Remnant Valley, who was also a mage—the question of who would succeed to the throne should the Second Prince decide to make a play for it became highly uncertain.

"The Queen will also assist the Second Prince," Shang Feifan warned.

"I'll craft something to give to the Eldest Prince for self-defense." Lang Mu's heart had naturally inclined toward the Eldest Prince succeeding to the throne to begin with. Now that he had received such a lavish gift from him, he had to help the Eldest Prince simply to repay the favor.

Shang Feifan let out a soft huff. Fine, then. He had no desire to owe that Eldest Prince anything, either.

After the family rested briefly, the old count prepared to take the two of them to the residence where Lang Feiyue and Zemu'er had lived before their deaths, and he even called for his wife to accompany them.

Given a matter of such importance, failing to bring his wife along would mean enduring days of the silent treatment once she found out.

While the old count went to fetch the old madam, Shang Feifan called out to Lang Mu.

"Two things. First, the Tiger King's spatial belt is in my hands. Second, I've figured out the key to the revival of heaven and earth—it is to open the Cage of the Gods."

Lang Mu: "..."

Lang Mu took a deep breath. "Give me a moment to process this."

Giving him no time to recover, Shang Feifan pulled him directly into the statue space.

The moment they entered the space, Shang Feifan sealed the Treasure-Hunting Compass.

The moment that thing came in, it had erupted with golden light, urging him to hand over the spatial belt immediately.

The spatial belt was still intact; the unknown entity had not touched it.

Shang Feifan picked up the spatial belt and produced a small vial.

Inside the vial was a tiny droplet of dark red blood.

Shang Feifan poured the blood from the vial onto a specific spot on the spatial belt, then forced a breakthrough with his formidable spiritual power.

*Bang*—a very faint sound, more akin to a ripple in spiritual perception.

The internal space of the spatial belt was unlocked.

"Whose blood is this?" Lang Mu caught the scent of fresh blood, a suspicion already taking root in his mind.

Shang Feifan said cheerfully, "The Tiger King's blood. I managed to skim a little off him earlier while he was fighting the Queen."

His guess had been correct. The control lock on this spatial belt had two layers: apart from the spiritual imprint, there was also a biological lock.

"Let's see what's stashed inside."

Shang Feifan extended his spiritual awareness inward.

As expected of a deity's belt, the space within was remarkably vast, stretching beyond the limits of sight.

And the items piled inside...

Even someone as worldly as Shang Feifan could not suppress a surge of excitement: "We're rich!"

"What's in there?" Lang Mu could not help his curiosity.

Shang Feifan grasped Lang Mu's hand, signaling him not to resist, and brought Lang Mu's spiritual consciousness along into the belt's interior space.

The very first thing Lang Mu saw was a mountain-like pile of grain.

There was more than one mountain of grain, and the varieties were plentiful, ranging from wheat to beans.

With this much grain, tens of thousands of people could eat their fill for a decade.

Aside from grain, there were massive quantities of beast skins, bones, and meat.

Miraculously, the beast meat still looked remarkably fresh.

Shang Feifan turned green with envy. "It actually preserves things. The statue plaza doesn't have a function like this. The spatial artifacts I forge certainly don't either—at best, they just delay the expiration time. Maybe we shouldn't return it after all."

Lang Mu said, "I believe you'll definitely be able to forge spatial artifacts that can preserve things."

Shang Feifan instantly broke into a smile. "True."

Perhaps having experienced famine, the Tiger King had stored massive amounts of food, clean water, and medicine inside this spatial belt.

Beyond the provisions, the rest consisted of vast quantities of gold and silver jewelry.

All of these gold and silver treasures were packed into chests, stacked neatly by category.

The chests containing Golden Dars alone numbered over a thousand. And a single chest held ten thousand gold coins.

Silver Dars and Copper Dars were fewer in number, yet still accounted for over a hundred chests.

Additionally, there were several items that were clearly rare treasures at a glance.

One entire chest was filled exclusively with maps.

With treasures in such abundance, Shang Feifan had no time to appraise them one by one.

Lang Mu also spotted the Royal Seal and various special items bearing royal insignia, including the King's Scepter.

This was Lang Mu's first time seeing the King's Scepter; such items were rarely brought out unless for monumental affairs of state like a king's coronation.

Seeing the massive magic crystal embedded in the King's Scepter, Lang Mu fell silent.

Shang Feifan also discovered the secret of the King's Scepter and burst into laughter. "Well, isn't that something? *'Willful blossoms fail to thrive, straying willows form a shade.'* Today is undoubtedly a lucky day!"

"This isn't a magic wand; it's simply a finely crafted scepter inlaid with a high-tier magic crystal. I can extract this magic crystal and forge a wand for you," Lang Mu said.

Shang Feifan shook his head. "I don't need a magic crystal; I can use resentment in place of demonic energy. You should keep this magic crystal for your own use."

Lang Mu wanted to refuse, but Shang Feifan cut him off. "I'm not being polite with you; I genuinely have no use for it. A magic crystal is merely icing on the cake for me, but it's a necessity for you."

Lang Mu thought to himself how it could possibly be considered "mere icing on the cake."

Shang Feifan leaned over and pecked the corner of his great treasure's mouth. "What kind of relationship do we have? Do we need to push things back and forth like this?"

Lang Mu blushed and hurriedly changed the subject. "How do you plan to deal with everything in here?"

Shang Feifan asked, "What do you think?"

Lang Mu hesitated.

Shang Feifan pulled him close. "Say whatever's on your mind. We can discuss anything together. If you don't voice your opinion, I can only guess. While that has its own charm, I'd much rather you speak your mind. Just think: if you were in this situation, wouldn't you also want me to tell you all my thoughts?"

Lang Mu glanced sideways at Shang Feifan. "I was just thinking that we simply can't finish this much grain and fresh meat. And without a proper preservation method... I can use magic to extend the shelf life of these provisions and meat, but aside from consuming magical energy, the extension won't be all that long. There's just too much grain and beast meat in here."

"Sell it?" Shang Feifan asked.

chunks.chineseText:
郎沐摇头：“我刚才也想过要不要卖掉，但量太大，这时候出手必然会引起虎王注意。你觉得送给莫约镇如何？”

商非凡：“我还以为你说要送给大王子。”

郎沐哭笑不得：“这些粮食送给大王子，他也不方便出手。毕竟他现在还不是国王。这么多粮食和鲜肉送给他，只会给他招祸。”

“当然，你想卖也行，大不了我们去其他国家出手。”郎沐又说。

商非凡不在意地说：“太麻烦了，我们也不差这点钱，就送给莫约镇吧。”

郎沐试探地问：“还有王印、国王权杖、王冠、礼服等衣裤鞋袜、历代国王王后画像之类的王室用品，以及一些纪念物品，这些不如都送还给大王子？”

商非凡索性大方道：“除了你说的那些，金银珠宝也分他一半。做国王嘛，总不能手上没有一点钱。还有那些瓶瓶罐罐以及药剂也都给他。”

他能炼制空间道具，来钱又快又多，真没必要贪图虎国王室财产。

不过他辛苦这么一趟，也不可能什么都不要。

那些奇珍异物，他就留下了。

还有那一箱子地图，他让郎沐用魔法复制了一份，原件自己留着。能被虎王珍而重之地放在空间腰带里，这些地图也许不止是地图那么简单。

不过这个可以等他空闲以后再来研究。

商非凡又让郎沐挑选一些自己喜欢的。

郎沐物质欲很淡，只让花圃吸收了部分骨材和矿物质，又取了权杖上那枚九级魔晶，其他就没有什么想要的了。

商非凡把东西分作四堆，一堆拿出来放到自己的空间戒指里，这是他留给自己的辛苦费。

粮食和鲜肉以及兽皮这类物品就统一装到几个大的空间手镯中。

再把要交给大王子的东西放到他炼制出来的一个空间腰带里。这条腰带外表和虎王的空间腰带外形很像，只不过内里空间没有原版那么广大，但也有三千立方。是商非凡迄今为止炼制出来的容量最大的空间道具。

剩下一半的金银珠宝，商非凡就全部塞给了郎沐，让他花着玩。

分赃完毕，商非凡把空间腰带交给郎沐。

然后一本正经地开始表演。

“啊，看我发现了什么？这不是自然之神雕像遗失的那条腰带吗？”

“这位英俊帅气的调查官先生，请问你能把这条腰带送给我吗？我愿意为此奉献我的身体和灵魂给你。”

郎沐听不下去了，迅速把腰带塞回给商非凡：“拿走，给你！不用你奉献。”

“不，这条腰带属于你，它是那么珍贵，我怎么可以无功受禄？来吧，不要怜惜我，请尽情地享用我！”

大概系统也听不下去了，在商非凡的手指刚触碰到空间腰带时，就把腰带咻地收走，都不用商非凡再把腰带给送到雕像跟前。

同时给出了奖励信息。

【恭喜你完成主线任务之九，寻回自然之神缺失的腰带，成功获取一万点贡献点奖励。你的天赋技能‘不死之身’，融合度达到十分之四。】

【你送回了自然之神散落的力量，得到自然之神的青睐。但受到你的血脉天赋‘恶咒’的影响，任何祝福buff都对你无效。】

【因兽人虎不帅又一次主动献出自然之神散落的力量，再次得到自然之神的青睐。与其神魂绑定的‘破碎的法神花圃’获得自然的原初之力，今后栽种作物可获得五倍加速以及成熟后保持最好状态的增益buff。其他益处，请自行探索。】
chunks.englishText:
Lang Mu shook his head. "I did consider whether we should sell it just now, but the volume is too massive; unloading it at a time like this would inevitably draw the Tiger King's attention. How about giving it to Moyue Town?"

Shang Feifan remarked, "I thought you were going to say we should give it to the Eldest Prince."

Lang Mu didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "Even if we gave this grain to the Eldest Prince, it wouldn't be convenient for him to dispose of it. After all, he isn't the king yet. Gifting him this much grain and fresh meat would only court disaster for him."

"Of course, if you want to sell it, we can always go unload it in another country," Lang Mu added.

Shang Feifan said indifferently, "Too much trouble, and we aren't hurting for money. Let's just donate it to Moyue Town."

Lang Mu probed tentatively, "What about the Royal Seal, the King's Scepter, the crown, ceremonial robes, clothing, shoes, socks, portraits of past kings and queens, and other royal items, along with certain commemorative pieces? Wouldn't it be better to return all of those to the Eldest Prince?"

Shang Feifan generously conceded, "Aside from what you mentioned, let's split the gold and silver jewelry with him as well. After all, a king can't run a country without a bit of cash on hand. Give him those jars, bottles, and potions, too."

Since he could forge spatial artifacts and make money both quickly and abundantly, he had no reason to covet the Tiger King's royal estate.

However, having made such an arduous trip, it was impossible for him to leave empty-handed.

He decided to keep the rare and exotic curiosities.

As for that chest of maps, he had Lang Mu duplicate a set using magic while keeping the originals for himself. Kept so preciously by the Tiger King inside his spatial belt, those maps were likely more than they appeared.

Still, he could study those when he had leisure time.

Shang Feifan then urged Lang Mu to pick out a few items he personally liked.

Lang Mu had very subdued material desires; he only had the garden absorb a portion of the bone materials and minerals, and plucked the ninth-tier magic crystal from the scepter. Apart from that, there was nothing else he wanted.

Shang Feifan divided the loot into four piles. One pile was taken out and placed into his own spatial ring—this was his hard-earned commission.

The grain, fresh meat, beast skins, and similar goods were uniformly packed into several large spatial bracelets.

The items meant for the Eldest Prince were placed inside a spatial belt he had just forged. The exterior of this belt closely resembled the Tiger King's original, though the internal space wasn't quite as vast as the original version, still boasting a capacity of three thousand cubic meters. It was the spatial artifact with the largest capacity Shang Feifan had forged to date.

As for the remaining half of the gold and silver treasure, Shang Feifan shoved all of it onto Lang Mu, telling him to spend it as he pleased.

With the division of spoils complete, Shang Feifan handed the spatial belt back to Lang Mu.

Then, he put on a solemn, deadpan act.

"Ah, what do I see? Isn't this the very belt lost by the statue of the God of Nature?"

"My handsome and dashing Investigator sir, might I trouble you to gift this belt to me? I am willing to offer my body and soul to you in return."

Unable to bear it any longer, Lang Mu swiftly shoved the belt back into Shang Feifan's hands. "Take it, it's yours! No need for you to offer anything."

"No, this belt belongs to you. It is so precious, how could I accept a reward for nothing? Come now, don't spare me—please indulge in me to your heart's content!"

Perhaps the system couldn't stand it either; the moment Shang Feifan's fingers brushed against the spatial belt, it swooped in and whisked the belt away, saving Shang Feifan the trouble of walking it back to the statue himself.

At the same time, reward notifications rang out:

[Congratulations on completing Main Quest Nine: Recovering the missing belt of the God of Nature, successfully obtaining a reward of ten thousand contribution points. Your innate skill, 'Undying Body,' has reached forty percent integration.]

[You have returned the scattered power of the God of Nature, earning the favor of the God of Nature. However, affected by your bloodline trait, 'Malediction,' all blessing buffs are rendered ineffective on you.]

[Because the beastman Tiger Handsome once again took the initiative to offer up the scattered power of the God of Nature, he has once again won the favor of the God of Nature. The 'Shattered Flower Garden of the Law God,' bound to his soul, has acquired the primal power of nature. Hereafter, cultivating crops within will yield a five-fold acceleration as well as a buff that preserves them in their prime condition upon maturity. Other benefits remain for you to explore.]

chunks.chineseText:
第180章 长夜漫漫

郎沐看到有光点从那尊自然之神的雕像飞出，直接没入他的身体。

他当时还想躲，但光点近身的一刹那，他没有感受到任何恶意，再加上商非凡及时告诉他这是自然之神的赠予。

光点刚没入身体，郎沐就感觉到花圃的变化。

之前花圃虽然恢复了一点生机，但总感觉还差点什么，可现在再看花圃，就有种生机勃勃之感，哪怕他还没有栽种任何作物。

变化最大的就是花圃中间的那口水井。

井内出现白雾，白雾凝聚在水井内并没有蔓延出来。

但郎沐就是觉得井水产生了偌大变化，而这些白雾对整个花圃来说都有莫大好处。

他甚至舀出水井的水喝了一口。

味道清凉甘甜，喝下去后感觉身体都清爽不少。

郎沐又舀了一勺，让商非凡也喝。

商非凡喝了，立即竖起大拇指：“这井水绝了！”

“是吧。”郎沐开心异常。

“唔，你有没有闻到什么味？”商非凡忽然嗅了嗅鼻子。

郎沐被提醒，超常的嗅觉发挥作用，也闻到了那股淡淡的臭味。

而臭味的源头……

两人互看，再一起低头闻闻自己。

郎沐二话不说，拿出法杖就给自己施展了清洁术，也给商非凡来了一下。

清洁术效果非常好，两人身上分泌出来的脏污和异味转瞬消失。

“没想到这井水还有洗精伐髓的效果。”商非凡惊叹。

郎沐摇头：“没有洗精伐髓那么夸张，也就是帮助排排身体毒素和废料。”

“那也很好了。”商非凡觉得这次自然之神的奖励很够意思。这井水水质改变还只是附带效果，花圃其他变化，他们还没有实验。

两人又去看了自然之神的雕像。

雕像的腰间多了一条软藤条编织的腰带，藤条上还镶嵌着一朵朵颜色各异的鲜花。

“你有没有觉得这尊雕像……”

“有了活气？”

两人盯着雕像看了好一会儿。

“对了，你之前说你想到了天地复苏的关键，就是打开神之笼？那个在兽人大陆娶妻生子的法圣曾提到的神之笼？”郎沐问。

商非凡：“对。说到神之笼，就不得不提到兽人大陆众神陨落的秘密。这个等晚上我再跟你详细说，姥爷和姥姥过来了。”

两人当即离开雕像广场，出来果然就看到老伯爵夫妇已经准备好。

郎沐一看天色，已经黑透。

“姥姥，姥爷，去取纪念物这事也不急，不如明天吧。”

今天两位老人忙了一天，情绪本身就很激动，晚上看到女儿女婿的遗物只怕还要伤心一番。他真的很担心两位老人身体吃不住。

郎沐花圃中的井水刚好升级，他就想着先给两位老人饮用，调养一下二老的身体，等明天再过去那边也不迟。

老伯爵看看老妻，想了想：“也好。”

老夫人欲言又止。

郎沐走到她身边，轻声说：“姥姥，您是不是在担心雷米尔？”

老夫人苦笑，“我还以为虎王会对这个儿子有多好，结果还不是提防着雷米尔染指王位，甚至根本就不打算承认他是王室成员。雷米尔那孩子也是傻，真的以为他是虎王的心肝宝贝，还做着一步登天的美梦。”

老伯爵冷哼：“他会这样想，还不是有人不停地给他灌输这个想法？否则在明知道他只是一个私生子且虎王已经有五个婚生子的情况下，他还敢肖想王位？”

商非凡插话：“雷米尔此时不在郎宅。”

他刚刚问过天眼系统。

郎飞虽是雌性，但她职位和爵位都比丈夫泽沐尔卡内高，夫妻俩共同居住的宅子就被人习惯称为郎宅。郎飞还在世时也被称为统领府。

郎沐也察觉出二老选择在这时候还要去郎宅，除了想要取回女儿女婿的东西，多少还是有点想要庇护雷米尔的意思。

如果雷米尔真躲在郎宅，而克莱门特等人前去那里找他，他们二老出面，克莱门特怎么也会给他们一点面子。

但管家到现在为止都没有来禀告克莱门特去了郎宅，也不知道克莱门特是给他们两老面子，还是掌握了其他线索。

老夫人没有问商非凡怎么知道雷米尔此刻不在郎宅，只神色怅然地叹了口气：“那就明天再过去吧。”

她其实是想要和雷米尔当面说清楚，还想要质问他，他们家哪里对不起他，自己不好就想要拉斐尔也遭殃。

问清楚后，自然该断就断，断个一干二净。

管家适时冒出，说晚餐已经准备好。

老伯爵一拍脑门，懊恼道：“看我！这么长时间了，都忘记你们还没用饭。阿武，快，赶紧上餐。”

一家四口吃过晚饭，老俩口带着郎沐去看房间。

他们给郎沐准备的房间在二楼，占了左边一半。右边一半则是郎飞曾经的地盘。

天色不早，两老也没有带郎沐去参观郎飞的房间，就催着郎沐早点休息。

“客房在楼下。阿瑞斯阁下，时间不早，你也该下楼休息了。”老伯爵半点不委婉地说。

商非凡：“……阿沐这里很宽敞，住两个人足够。”

老伯爵用杀必死目光瞪视商非凡。

商非凡迅速把郎沐拉出来当挡箭牌。

郎沐站在商非凡前面，看到老伯爵不可置信的目光，忍笑忍得好辛苦。

“姥姥，姥爷，我送二位下楼。正好我有点东西想要孝敬二老。”

郎沐不等二老拒绝，就一手一个挽着两位老人下楼。

商非凡停住脚步，歪头，有人想跑。

他感觉到自己的诅咒对象正在远离他。

按照距离来算，对方这时很可能已经离开王城。

商非凡轻笑，取出诅咒之线，轻轻一弹：“哪里来的就回去哪里吧。”

本来他还想留着王后折磨虎王，可王后很理智地选择了“留青山”。

而王后那种心眼狭小又滥杀无辜的人，在和阿沐和老伯爵夫妇已经结仇的情况下，怎么可能和他们相安无事？

更何况丹顿侯爵还是死在他和郎沐手上。

哦，对方支持的王位继承人还是二王子。

与其留着这么一个不定时炸-弹，那还不如趁早解决了好。

商非凡一个人待着无聊，就开始和天眼系统“聊天”。

郎沐给两位老人一人饮下一杯井水，见二老排毒后身体无恙，就上来了。

他已经嘱咐过管家，给二老准备沐浴。

他可以用清洁术，但二老还是更想洗个澡。

“你这是想要坑谁吗？”郎沐站住，商非凡此时的表情看着就像是在打坏主意。

商非凡露出有点痞的笑容，伸手邀请：“要出去转转吗？”

郎沐似乎猜出什么，“今天可真是漫长的一天。”

商非凡接口：“今晚对某些人来说会更漫长。”

两人手牵手悄悄从伯爵府里跑了出去。

王宫中，王后得到消息，她派去抓捕安妮塔的人没能抓到安妮塔，还跟丢了对方。

王后对此很生气，命令手下无论如何都要找到安妮塔。
