Chapter 180: The Long Night

Lang Mu watched as rays of light drifted out from the statue of the God of Nature, sinking directly into his body.

He had initially wanted to dodge, but the moment the points of light drew close, he sensed no malice whatsoever. Besides, Shang Feifan had promptly reassured him that this was a bestowal from the God of Nature.

The instant the light particles merged into his body, Lang Mu felt a transformation within the garden.

Previously, although the garden had recovered a shred of vitality, it always felt like something was missing; but looking at the garden now, it exuded a vibrant, thriving aura, even though he had yet to plant a single crop.

The most dramatic change occurred at the well situated in the center of the garden.

A white mist began to swirl within the well, contained entirely within the stone basin without spilling outward.

Yet Lang Mu instinctively knew that the well water had undergone a profound transformation, and that this white mist held immense benefits for the entire garden.

He even scooped up a mouthful of water from the well and drank it.

The taste was crisp and sweet, and after swallowing it, his body felt remarkably refreshed.

Lang Mu scooped up another ladle and had Shang Feifan drink it as well.

After taking a sip, Shang Feifan immediately gave it a thumbs-up. "This well water is phenomenal!"

"Right?" Lang Mu was exceptionally pleased.

"Hmm, do you smell something?" Shang Feifan suddenly twitched his nose.

Prompted by the remark, Lang Mu brought his heightened sense of smell into play and caught a faint, foul odor as well.

And the source of that stench...

The two exchanged glances, then lowered their heads to sniff at themselves in unison.

Without a second word, Lang Mu drew his magic wand and cast a Cleansing Spell on himself, quickly following up with one for Shang Feifan.

The effect of the Cleansing Spell was exceptional; the grime and strange odors secreted from their bodies vanished in an instant.

"I never expected this well water to have the effect of cleansing the marrow and transforming the bones," Shang Feifan marveled.

Lang Mu shook his head. "Not quite as exaggerated as cleansing the marrow—it's more like helping purge the body's toxins and waste."

"That's still pretty great." Shang Feifan felt that this reward from the God of Nature was quite substantial. The change in water quality was merely a supplementary bonus; they had yet to test the garden's other transformations.

The two went over to inspect the statue of the God of Nature once more.

Around the statue's waist now hung a belt woven from soft rattan vines, adorned with clusters of brightly colored fresh blossoms.

"Do you feel like this statue..."

"Has grown a bit of life?"

The two stared intently at the statue for quite a while.

"Right, you mentioned earlier that you figured out the key to the revival of heaven and earth—that it's opening the Cage of the Gods? The very Cage of the Gods mentioned by that Saint of Law who took a wife and had children on the Beastman Continent?" Lang Mu asked.

"Correct," Shang Feifan replied. "Speaking of the Cage of the Gods, we inevitably have to talk about the secret behind the fall of the gods on the Beastman Continent. I'll explain all the details to you tonight; Grandpa and Grandma are coming over."

The two immediately stepped away from the statue plaza. Sure enough, upon emerging, they saw that the old count and his wife were already prepared.

Lang Mu looked up at the sky; it had turned pitch black.

"Grandma, Grandpa, retrieving those mementos isn't all that urgent. How about we go tomorrow instead?"

Both elderly folks had been busy all day, and their emotions had already been running high; witnessing the lingering belongings of their deceased daughter and son-in-law tonight would likely only stir up another wave of grief. He was genuinely worried that their health wouldn't hold up under the strain.

Furthermore, the well water in Lang Mu's garden had just been upgraded; he figured he should have the two elders drink some first to nourish their constitutions, and waiting until tomorrow wouldn't hurt.

The old count looked at his wife and pondered for a moment. "Fair enough."

The old madam looked as though she had something more to say.

Lang Mu walked to her side and spoke softly, "Grandma, are you worried about Remir?"

The old madam gave a bitter smile. "I used to think the Tiger King cared deeply for that son of his, but in the end, wasn't it just about guarding against Remir making a grab for the throne, not even intending to acknowledge him as a member of the royal family? That boy Remir is a fool too; he genuinely believed he was the Tiger King's apple of his eye, still indulging in daydreams of soaring to the heavens in a single bound."

The old count let out a cold huff. "If he thinks that way, isn't it because someone kept constantly feeding him those notions? Otherwise, how could he dare covet the throne knowing full well he was only a bastard son, and that the Tiger King already had five legitimate sons?"

Shang Feifan chimed in, "Remir isn't at the Lang residence right now."

He had just checked with the Heavenly Eye system.

Although Lang Feiyue was a female, her rank and peerage were higher than her husband's, Zemu'er Kane, so the residence where the couple lived together had customarily come to be called the Lang residence. While Lang Feiyue was still alive, it had also been known as the Commander's Mansion.

Lang Mu also realized that by choosing to visit the Lang residence at this hour, aside from wanting to retrieve their daughter and son-in-law's belongings, the old couple undoubtedly harbored some intention of sheltering Remir.

If Remir were truly hiding at the Lang residence, and Clement and his party went looking for him there, with the two elders stepping forward in person, Clement would have to show them at least a shred of respect.

Yet the butler hadn't come to report Clement heading to the Lang residence yet; it was unclear whether Clement was giving the two elders face or had simply gotten wind of other clues.

The old madam didn't ask how Shang Feifan knew Remir wasn't at the Lang residence at that moment; she merely let out a desolate sigh. "Then let's head over tomorrow."

In truth, she wanted a face-to-face confrontation with Remir to demand an explanation—to ask where their family had ever wronged him, that he could drag Raphael down with him just because he was unhappy.

Once things were cleared up, they would make a clean break—severing ties completely once and for all.

The butler appeared right on cue to announce that dinner was ready.

The old count slapped his forehead in remorse. "Look at me! With all this time passing, I completely forgot you two hadn't eaten yet. A-Wu, quickly, serve dinner!"

After the family of four finished their evening meal, the elderly couple led Lang Mu to his room.

The quarters prepared for Lang Mu were on the second floor, occupying the entire left wing. The right wing had once been Lang Feiyue's domain.

With the hour growing late, the two elders didn't drag Lang Mu off to tour Lang Feiyue's former rooms, urging him instead to get an early night's rest.

"The guest rooms are downstairs. Lord Ares, it's getting late, you should head down to rest as well," the old count said, completely devoid of tact.

Shang Feifan: "..." *A-Mu's quarters are plenty spacious; two people can fit just fine.*

The old count fixed Shang Feifan with a look that could kill.

Shang Feifan promptly pulled Lang Mu out as a human shield.

Standing in front of Shang Feifan, Lang Mu caught sight of the old count's incredulous expression and had to bite his cheek to keep from laughing out loud.

"Grandma, Grandpa, I'll walk the two of you downstairs. Actually, there's something I've prepared to honor you both."

Without giving the old couple a chance to refuse, Lang Mu looped an arm around each of them and escorted them down the stairs.

Shang Feifan paused in his tracks, tilting his head. *Somebody's trying to run.*

He could sense that his cursed target was pulling away from him.

Judging by the distance, the person had likely already departed the royal city.

Shang Feifan smiled faintly, retrieving a thread of curse-energy and giving it a gentle flick. *"Go back right where you came from."*

Originally, he had intended to keep the Queen alive to torment the Tiger King, but the Queen had sensibly chosen the adage, *'As long as the green hills remain, there's no lack of firewood.'*

Yet someone of the Queen's petty and murderous disposition—having already forged blood feuds with A-Mu and the old count's family—how could she possibly live alongside them in peace?

Not to mention that Marquis Danton had died at his and Lang Mu's hands.

Oh, and the royal heir she supported happened to be the Second Prince.

Rather than leaving such a ticking time bomb around, it was better to deal with her early on.

Finding himself bored alone, Shang Feifan began to "chat" with the Heavenly Eye system.

Having just had the two elders drink a cup of well water each and seeing that their bodies had successfully purged toxins without complications, Lang Mu came back upstairs.

He had already instructed the butler to prepare baths for the elderly couple.

He could use cleansing spells, but the two elders naturally preferred a proper soak.

"Are you plotting to frame someone?" Lang Mu stopped in his tracks, noting the mischievous expression currently plastered across Shang Feifan's face.

Shang Feifan broke into a roguish grin, extending a hand in invitation. "Care to go out for a stroll?"

Guessing what was on his mind, Lang Mu murmured, "Today has truly been a long day."

Shang Feifan chimed in, "Tonight's going to be even longer for certain people."

Hand in hand, the two of them slipped quietly out of the count's estate.

Back within the royal palace, the Queen received word that her operatives dispatched to capture Anita had not only failed to secure their target, but had lost track of her entirely.

Enraged by the news, the Queen ordered her subordinates to hunt Anita down by any means necessary.

chunks.chineseText:
但现在找到安妮塔还是其次，王后还有更重要的事要做。

因为虎王认定就是她拿走了空间腰带，不但喝令她必须交出安妮丽娜和空间腰带，还要废除她的王后之位。

王后趁虎王被狮域和宰相等人包围的机会，带着心腹手下迅速逃离王宫。

她要带着她的手下和丹顿家族的人逃回族地，在那里和虎王分庭抗礼。

这也是她送给次子最后一个礼物，只有她看中的次子上位，她才会让丹顿家族的人重新效忠虎国王室。

可当王后赶到金溪庄园，她就得到了一个巨大噩耗。

就在伪装女管家的安妮塔逃离金溪庄园不久，被软禁在这里的丹顿家族成员全都出现了被万虫噬身般的痛苦和症状，庄园内的侍卫找了治疗师和药剂师过来，但这些人面对这种“疾病”全都束手无策。

最后丹顿家族成员从身体最弱者开始，一个个痛苦死去。

死后，他们的身体还爬出了很多小虫子。

庄园仆人和侍卫害怕这些人会变异，立刻用火焚烧尸体和那些跑出来的虫子。

等王后赶到金溪庄园时，恰好最后一个丹顿血脉咽下最后一口气。

王后疯了！

她怒斥庄园侍卫，质问他们为什么没有把这么重要的消息传回王宫。

侍卫就很冤枉，说他们早早就把消息传回王宫，还传递了不止一遍。一开始可能王宫比较忙乱，虎王没能收到传信，直到快傍晚，虎王才传来一个口信，说不用管。

王后愤怒到想要把虎王连同这庄园的所有侍卫杀光！

还是她的心腹属下再三劝慰她，让她赶紧离开王城。

王后也担心被虎王追上及抓回王宫，只能带着属下先逃。

虎王这时还没有废除王后头衔，王后想要离开王城并不难。

刚奔出城门不远，王后忽然感到脸上肌肤有点痛痒。

这熟悉的感觉让王后骇然变色。

确认王后率众离开王城后，城卫军第一时间就派人去报给虎王。

虎王早已经知道王后逃离王宫，但奇异的是，他竟然没有立刻去追。

他的身边站着一名将领，这是虎王心腹中的心腹。

“不急，等她亲自带路，亲自带我们找到丹顿家族隐藏的那支军队。”虎王阴沉沉地说道。

虎王一挥手：“跟上去，别让她察觉。”

将领无声行礼，迅速消失。

虎王一个人单独坐在书房里，心情糟糕透顶。

他今天竟然被几个大臣联手逼迫，不得不和他们定下一个约定。

他被迫答应，务必在传承大会召开之前找回代表王室象征以及装有王室大半财富的空间腰带，同时消灭王城中藏着的邪神信徒，另外还要想法恢复王室被破坏的声誉。

如果做不到这三点，这些大臣将连同虎国王室宗亲和权贵一起，重新甄选新的国王。

虎王很清楚，这些大臣只是在借故发难。

他们不满他想要集权尤其是想要收回贵族所有领地的做法已久，以前忌惮他的武力值，也怕把他逼急了，惹得他和权贵们鱼死网破。

但现在他失去了王后这个臂助……丹顿家族虽然很讨厌，暗中和他争权夺利，但也不得不承认，他们作为王子公主的舅家，同样也是他的臂助之一。

又因为换子事件搞得声望暴跌，更惹得不少臣子不满。

更重要的是他失去了相当于退路的空间腰带。

有空间腰带里的那些物资和财物，他就算被逼得失去王位、失去王城，他也能想法子东山再起。

没有了这笔庞大的物资，他和其他大贵族又有什么区别？

如果三者只有一者犯了，他也能挺得住。

可现在一犯就是三者一起犯，那些早就不满他的大臣又怎么可能放过这个好机会。

虎王双拳慢慢捏紧，脸色狰狞，眼中满是盛怒之火。

他会如此愤怒，并不仅仅是连续遭到背叛以及自尊受损。

他愤怒的是，那些大臣敢这么逼迫他，就是已经抱着无论如何都要把他拉下台的准备。

谁会让一个对自己心怀怨恨的王继续坐在王位上？

那些大臣又不是蠢，给自己凭白找一把凶刃悬在自己头顶。

他堂堂虎王，竟然被逼到这种地步！

虎王闭上眼睛，告诉自己，越是如此他越不能乱。

王宫以外。

大公主离开王宫后，就去拜访狮域大都督，一直待到晚上还没出来。

大公主想要跟大都督要建议。

大都督就直接问她：“你想当女王吗？”

大公主沉默良久：“如果我说我想，您会支持我吗？”

结果大都督断然道：“不会。”

大公主不解：“为什么？难道您认为我比不上我那几个兄弟？不说个人能力和治国才能，我自认都不输给他们，更不要说我还能变身巨兽，他们却都不能。”

大都督神色冷漠：“因为你只有权欲之心，没有半点爱民之心。”

大公主：“……”要不是打不过您，我真的会翻脸哦。

大都督端起茶杯，摆出送客的架势。

大公主无视，表示自己要留下吃饭，今晚就住在这里了。

大都督起身：“随你。”

二王子和天残谷主见面，商量进一步的计划。

三王子躲在自己的府邸里决定这段时间哪里都不去，就算听到王后带人离开王城的消息，都假装不知道。

大王子从郎府回来后也在为王后离开王城一事烦心，他想去劝阻王后不要走，但他又知道王后留下九成九会死。

这可是他亲妈！

想来想去，大王子也只能装作不知道王后离开王城。

另一头，安妮塔怎么都没有想到，她的身份会暴露得那么彻底。

如果说有人通过雷米尔的行踪找到伊娃这个假身份，那金溪庄园女管家这个身份又是怎么暴露的？

而且为什么有人会特意监视雷米尔？

难道是五公主被杀一案，最终还是牵扯到雷米尔身上，导致王后派人跟踪调查雷米尔？

安妮塔正准备等风声过去一些就去找雷米尔问个清楚。

可就那么突兀的，那家王城八卦报竟然就那么简单地曝光了她的另一重身份。

这个八卦报到底是什么来历？

为什么这么厉害？

宰相等人派来的人手还只是打探和盯梢，大概是想要等确认她的身份后再下手。

可王后派来的人手才不会管这是不是假消息，直接就闯入庄园，说奉王后懿旨，要带她进宫一趟。

她只好找了个借口，说她只尊王令。

结果王后的人一听她不肯跟他们走，当即就翻脸说她是叛国之人，必须当场束手就擒，否则就地格杀勿论。

安妮塔能怎么办？

当然只能跑路。

要不是她做了一点准备，王后派来的人真的有可能把她杀死当场。

安妮塔仓惶逃出金溪庄园，好不容易才摆脱身后跟踪者。

无奈下，她只能去找她的合作者。

安妮塔其实并不想和这些人有更深纠葛，非必要，她也不会借用这些人的力量。
chunks.englishText:
Finding Anita was secondary for now; the Queen had far more important matters to attend to.

Because the Tiger King was convinced that she had taken the spatial belt, he had not only ordered her to hand over Angelina and the spatial belt but also threatened to strip her of her title as Queen.

Taking advantage of the moment when the Tiger King was surrounded by the Lion Territory's forces and the Prime Minister, the Queen fled the palace swiftly with her trusted confidants.

She intended to retreat with her subordinates and the Denton family back to their ancestral lands, where she could hold her ground against the Tiger King on equal terms.

This was also the final gift she was preparing for her favored second son. Only when the son of her choice ascended to the throne would she allow the Denton family to pledge their allegiance to the Tiger Kingdom's royal family once more.

Yet, the moment the Queen arrived at Golden Stream Manor, she was struck by a devastating piece of news.

Shortly after Anita, disguised as a female steward, fled Golden Stream Manor, the Denton family members placed under house arrest there were all suddenly seized by agonizing symptoms resembling their bodies being devoured by ten thousand insects. The manor's guards had summoned healers and apothecaries, but these professionals were utterly helpless against this strange "illness."

In the end, the Denton family members perished in agonizing pain, starting from those with the weakest physiques.

After death, countless tiny insects crawled out from their corpses.

Terrified that the bodies might mutate, the manor servants and guards immediately burned the corpses along with the swarming bugs.

By the time the Queen arrived at Golden Stream Manor, she arrived just in time to witness the very last Denton bloodline draw their final breath.

The Queen snapped!

She lashed out furiously at the manor guards, demanding to know why such critical news had not been sent back to the palace.

The guards felt deeply aggrieved, explaining that they had dispatched messages back to the palace early on, and more than once. At first, the royal palace might have been too chaotic for the Tiger King to receive the reports, but by early evening, a message finally came back from the Tiger King stating that the matter could be ignored.

The Queen was so enraged that she wanted to slaughter the Tiger King and every single guard in the manor!

It was only through the repeated, desperate pleas of her loyal subordinates that she was persuaded to leave the royal city immediately.

The Queen was also worried about the Tiger King pursuing her and dragging her back to the palace, leaving her with no choice but to flee with her men first.

The Tiger King had not yet officially stripped the Queen of her title, making it relatively easy for her to leave the royal city.

Yet, no sooner had she sprinted past the city gates than the Queen suddenly felt a stinging itch upon the skin of her face.

This familiar sensation caused the color to drain from the Queen's face in sheer horror.

As soon as confirmation reached the City Garrison that the Queen had led her forces out of the royal city, they immediately sent word to the Tiger King.

The Tiger King had already known of the Queen's escape, but strangely enough, he made no immediate move to pursue her.

Standing beside him was a general—one of the Tiger King's most trusted confidants.

"No rush. Let her lead the way herself, straight to the hidden army of the Denton family," the Tiger King said with a dark, sinister expression.

The Tiger King gave a wave of his hand. "Follow her, and make sure she doesn't notice."

The general bowed in silence and vanished in an instant.

Left alone in his study, the Tiger King felt his mood plummet to the absolute abyss.

Today, he had actually been cornered by a coalition of high-ranking ministers, forcing him to strike an agreement with them.

He had been coerced into promising that before the upcoming Succession Grand Ceremony, he would recover the spatial belt—which symbolized royal authority and contained the majority of the royal family's wealth—while simultaneously eradicating the evil god cultists hiding within the royal city, and devising a way to restore the ruined reputation of the royal family.

Should he fail to achieve these three objectives, these ministers, alongside the royal clan and high nobility of the Tiger Kingdom, would join forces to select a new king.

The Tiger King was well aware that these ministers were merely manufacturing a pretext to strike.

They had long been dissatisfied with his attempts to centralize power, particularly his moves to reclaim all noble territories. Previously, they had exercised restraint out of fear of his martial might and dread that pushing him too far would result in mutual destruction.

But now, he had lost the Queen as a pillar of support... As irritating as the Denton family was, secretly competing with him for power, he had to admit that as the maternal family of the princes and princesses, they were one of his key pillars of support.

Furthermore, his reputation had plummeted due to the Prince-Swapping incident, drawing the discontent of numerous officials.

Most importantly, he had lost the spatial belt, which served as his ultimate fallback.

With the resources and wealth stored within that spatial belt, even if he were forced to lose his throne and the royal city, he could still plot a comeback.

Without this massive reserve of supplies, how was he any different from the other great nobles?

If only one of these three crises had occurred, he could have weathered the storm.

Yet now, all three had struck at once. How could those ministers, who had long harbored resentment toward him, possibly let go of such a golden opportunity?

The Tiger King slowly clenched his fists tight, his expression contorted and savage, his eyes burning with raging fury.

His anger stemmed from far more than successive betrayals and bruised pride.

What truly enraged him was that these ministers dared to pressure him to this extent precisely because they had already resolved to drag him down from his throne by any means necessary.

Who would ever allow a monarch harboring deep resentment against them to remain seated upon the throne?

Those ministers were hardly fools; they would never voluntarily dangle a sharpened blade of vengeance directly above their own heads.

He, the majestic Tiger King, had actually been driven to such a wretched state!

The Tiger King closed his eyes, telling himself that the more desperate the situation, the more he must keep his composure.

Outside the palace.

Upon leaving the palace, the Grand Princess went straight to visit the Grand Commander of the Lion Territory, remaining there well into the night without emerging.

The Grand Princess sought counsel from the Grand Commander.

The Grand Commander asked her directly, "Do you wish to become Queen?"

The Grand Princess remained silent for a long moment before answering, "If I said I do, would you support me?"

The Grand Commander's reply was absolute and cold, "No."

The Grand Princess was baffled, "Why? Do you truly believe I am inferior to my brothers? Leaving aside personal capability and statecraft, I refuse to yield to them in any aspect, not to mention the fact that I can transform into a colossal beast while none of them can."

The Grand Commander's expression remained icy. "Because you possess only the lust for power, and not a shred of love for the common people."

The Grand Princess: "..." If I weren't certain I couldn't beat you, I would seriously flip out right now.

The Grand Commander picked up his teacup, striking a posture that clearly signaled for her to leave.

Ignoring the gesture, the Grand Princess declared that she intended to stay for dinner and would lodge right here tonight.

The Grand Commander stood up. "As you wish."

The Second Prince met with the Master of the Sky-Severing Valley to discuss further plans.

The Third Prince holed up inside his estate, resolving to go nowhere for the foreseeable future. Even upon hearing the news that the Queen had fled the royal city with her subordinates, he feigned complete ignorance.

The Eldest Prince, returning from the Lang estate, was likewise consumed by anxiety over the Queen's flight. He wanted to go and persuade the Queen not to leave, yet he knew all too well that if she stayed, her chances of survival were negligible.

Yet this was his own mother!

After turning it over and over in his mind, the Eldest Prince had no choice but to pretend he knew nothing of the Queen's departure.

On the other side, Anita would never have imagined that her identity could be exposed so thoroughly.

If someone had managed to track down her false identity as Eva through Remir's movements, how on earth had her identity as the female steward of Golden Stream Manor been exposed?

Moreover, why would anyone go out of their way to keep Remir under surveillance?

Could the murder case of the Fifth Princess have ultimately looped back to Remir, causing the Queen to dispatch people to track and investigate him?

Anita had been preparing to wait for the fuss to die down before seeking out Remir to demand an explanation.

Yet, with abrupt suddenness, that royal tabloid paper had simply exposed her alternate identity just like that.

What on earth was the background of this gossip rag?

Why were they so formidable?

The operatives dispatched by the Prime Minister and his faction were still merely gathering intelligence and staking out the place, presumably waiting to confirm her identity before making a move.

However, the agents sent by the Queen gave no thought to whether the reports were false; they broke straight into the manor, declaring that they were acting on the Queen's direct decree to escort her into the palace.

She had no choice but to fabricate an excuse, stating that she obeyed only royal commands.

As a result, the moment the Queen's men heard her refuse to accompany them, they immediately flipped the script, declaring her a traitor to the state who must be captured on the spot, or else executed without mercy.

What else could Anita do?

Naturally, she had to run for her life.

Had she not made a few preliminary preparations, the Queen's men might genuinely have struck her down on the spot.

Fleeing Golden Stream Manor in panic, Anita only barely managed to shake off the pursuers trailing behind her.

Left with no other choice, she had no option but to seek out her collaborators.

Truth be told, Anita had never wished to become deeply entangled with these people, and unless absolutely necessary, she had no desire to borrow their power.

但现在她多年布局，莫名其妙就被人掀开了一个大窟窿，搞得她措手不及不说，还不知道敌人是谁。

不是安妮塔瞧不起王后，如果不是她谋划巨大，取王后命只是目标之一，王后早就被她弄死。

她留着王后，除了忌惮虎王，更因为丹顿侯爵。

因为她和那些人合作，所以她知道丹顿侯爵和那些人也有很深的合作关系，而丹顿侯爵本身实力也超强。

同时她也从合作方那里得知了一个大秘密，知道丹顿侯爵在近期打算搞一场大的。

一旦丹顿侯爵成功，虎王和他必然会势不两立，就算不彻底成为敌人，也会撕破脸。

如果她再从中挑拨一二，比如让虎王知道丹顿侯爵和王后想要谋害他，扶持一个儿女上位，从而控制虎国，甚至是给虎国换一个王室。

那么虎王必然会厌弃王后，也会和丹顿侯爵彻底站到对立面。

虎王一旦和丹顿侯爵斗起来，输的那一方必死无疑，赢的那一方就算不死，也逃不过重伤。而她会帮助虎王，那么就可以保证死的那一方一定是丹顿侯爵。

之后她再一步步蚕食王室血脉，先把具有末位继承权的王子公主搞-死几个，留下继承可能性最高的两个，再挑拨离间使用各种手段，让这两人对上。

等到最强最有希望的继承人两败俱亡，虎王又伤重难治的话，那么他的选择就只剩下一个。

一旦雷米尔继位成新的虎王，她就可以变相地掌控整个虎国。

如果雷米尔听话也就罢了，如果不听话……

看，她做了非常周全的计划。

她不敢说这计划百分百会成功，但八成以上的可能性还是有的。

可事情真正发展起来却偏离了她的计划。

首先，丹顿侯爵确实在黑森林城搞出祭祀全部城民的大戏，结果却是虎头蛇尾，最后连丹顿侯爵都失踪了。

其次，黑森林城突然冒出一个疑似战神血脉的巨人。

第三，黑森林城地下城神殿曝光，还曝出了一座千年前的图书馆。

但好在虎王早就对黑森林城和丹顿家族的家产虎视眈眈，一看丹顿侯爵失踪，立刻就把丹顿家族血脉全部控制起来，同时也对上了王后。

虎王和王后因为丹顿家族对上，对于安妮塔来说简直就是喜闻乐见。

丹顿家族的人被软禁在金溪庄园，基本跟落到她手里没什么区别。

听说王后想要推举丹顿侯爵的长子继承爵位和家产，她立刻出手把那好赌的纨绔给解决了。没有任何一个人怀疑到她头上。

总体来说，行动初期虽然和她的设想有所偏离，但还是能达到她的目的。

撇除那个巨人在外，虎王想要举办传承分享大会，对她来说也没什么坏处。

爬得越高才能摔得越痛！

不管虎王在这次分享大会中能得到多少红利，按照她的计划，也只会是为他人做嫁衣。

她的计划也确实顺利展开。

她采取迂回的办法，弄死了五公主。

就在她准备对三王子下手时，事情就开始变得越来越不对劲起来。

一家八卦报横空出世。

一开始这家报纸报道的内容看起来很偏向她，让她没有及时警觉，只觉得这家报社消息灵通。

当时她还猜测这家八卦报背后的主人会不会就是虎王。

但随着八卦报改成日报，报道的内容就越来越对她不利。

她找人去调查过这家报纸，想要查到是谁在给他们提供她的消息，但她只查到这家八卦报核心成员都非常古怪，他们就像是突然出现在王城，没有来历也没有身份骨牌。

有几个人拿出了身份骨牌，但仔细调查后就会知道那只是他们不知道从哪里弄来的他人身份骨牌。

等到雷米尔和拉斐尔的身世曝光，安妮塔这才确定八卦报背后的主人绝不是虎王，更不会是王后。

她开始怀疑郎侦老伯爵是否查知了什么，故意搞出这家报社来报复他们。

但还没等到她对老伯爵夫妇动手，她的最后一重伪装身份也曝光了。

安妮塔躲到了合作方的秘密藏身地点，在这里她看到了今天下午才出的八卦报号外。

看到老伯爵夫妇带着拉斐尔去找虎王算账，看到一堆权贵官员跑去关心（看热闹），看到虎王和王后彻底翻脸，还看到虎王竟然丢失了象征王权和藏有王室大量财产的空间腰带，以及雷米尔拘捕逃离王宫……

安妮塔心中产生诡异快-感的同时，也在细细思量，想要通过这些最新事件找出翻本的可能。

她的假死和伪装身份确实都暴露了，但她自认还没有输。

她手上还有一个虎王亲生血脉雷米尔，只要她按照原计划把虎王和那些王子公主全部弄死，再利用合作方的力量，也不是不能强夺虎国王位。

当然，那时候肯定会有很多大贵族反对，甚至借此机会独立。

但无所谓，她要的就是虎国王室完蛋，如果最后她能接手虎国最好，不能的话，虎国分崩离析也不是不能接受。

安妮塔按照最新情况，重新制定了新的行动计划，她也没有多耽搁，立刻伪装成一名老妇，去找雷米尔。

别人不知道雷米尔会躲在什么地方，她可清清楚楚。
chunks.englishText:
Yet now, her layout of many years had been inexplicably ripped wide open by a massive breach. Not only was she caught completely off guard, but she still had no idea who her enemy was.

It wasn't that Anita looked down on the Queen; had her own grand scheme not involved much larger objectives where taking the Queen's life was merely one stepping stone among many, the Queen would have been dead by her hands long ago.

She had kept the Queen alive not only out of wariness toward the Tiger King, but more importantly, because of Marquis Denton.

Through her partnership with those entities, she knew that Marquis Denton maintained a deeply entrenched cooperative relationship with them as well, and the Marquis himself possessed terrifying strength.

At the same time, she had learned a monumental secret from her collaborators: Marquis Denton intended to initiate a massive upheaval in the near future.

Once Marquis Denton succeeded, he and the Tiger King would become utterly irreconcilable. Even if they didn't become outright enemies, they would inevitably tear off any remaining pretenses of civility.

If she were to add fuel to the fire with a few calculated maneuvers—for instance, letting the Tiger King discover that Marquis Denton and the Queen intended to assassinate him, enthrone one of their children to seize control of the Tiger Kingdom, or even completely replace the Tiger Kingdom's royal bloodline—

Then the Tiger King would inevitably loathe the Queen and find himself standing in direct, uncompromising opposition to Marquis Denton.

Once the Tiger King and Marquis Denton locked horns, the losing party was guaranteed to die, while the victorious side, even if they survived, could not escape grievous injuries. And since she would be aiding the Tiger King, she could ensure that the side destined to fall was unquestionably Marquis Denton.

Following that, she would systematically devour the royal bloodline step by step. First, she would eliminate a few princes and princesses holding the lowest positions in the line of succession, leaving only the two with the highest probability of inheriting the throne. Then, through sow-discord tactics and various schemes, she would pit those final two against one another.

Once the strongest and most promising heirs destroyed each other, and with the Tiger King suffering from debilitating, incurable injuries, his options would be whittled down to a single choice.

Once Remir ascended the throne as the new Tiger King, she would effectively control the entire Tiger Kingdom from behind the scenes.

And if Remir proved obedient, well and good; if he dared to disobey...

Look at that—her plans had been meticulously thorough.

She wouldn't dare claim that this plan had a hundred percent chance of success, but an eighty percent probability was well within reach.

Yet, reality had deviated wildly from her blueprints as events actually unfolded.

First, Marquis Denton had indeed orchestrated a grand spectacle in Black Forest City involving the sacrificial ritual of the entire populace, only for it to fizzle out into an anticlimax, culminating in the disappearance of Marquis Denton himself.

Second, a giant suspected of possessing the War God bloodline had suddenly emerged out of nowhere in Black Forest City.

Third, the subterranean temple beneath Black Forest City had been exposed, along with a thousand-year-old library.

Fortunately, the Tiger King had long cast a covetous gaze upon the assets of Black Forest City and the Denton family. The moment he discovered Marquis Denton was missing, he immediately clamped down on all Denton bloodlines while simultaneously coming to blows with the Queen.

The fact that the Tiger King and the Queen had turned on each other because of the Denton family was, to Anita, a sight for sore eyes.

With the Denton family members placed under house arrest at Golden Stream Manor, they were essentially as good as fallen into her own grasp.

Hearing that the Queen intended to elevate Marquis Denton's eldest son to inherit the title and estate, she immediately made her move and eliminated that gambling prodigal son without leaving a shred of suspicion pointing toward her.

Overall, though the early stages of the operation had deviated somewhat from her expectations, it was still achieving her ultimate goals.

Setting the giant aside, the Tiger King's insistence on holding the Inheritance Sharing Assembly held no disadvantages for her whatsoever.

The higher one climbed, the harder one fell!

Regardless of how many dividends the Tiger King reaped from this sharing assembly, according to her design, it would ultimately amount to wedding garments made for someone else.

And her plans had indeed rolled out smoothly.

Employing indirect methods, she had successfully snuffed out the Fifth Princess.

It was just as she was preparing to make her move against the Third Prince that things began to spiral out of control.

A gossip tabloid materialized out of thin air.

At the very start, the content published by this paper appeared heavily biased in her favor, preventing her from raising her guard in time; she had merely assumed the news agency was exceptionally well-connected.

Back then, she had even speculated whether the mastermind behind this gossip rag could be the Tiger King himself.

However, as the tabloid transitioned into a daily publication, the content grew increasingly detrimental to her interests.

She had dispatched operatives to investigate the paper and unearth who was feeding them intelligence concerning her, but she only discovered that the core members of this gossip sheet were thoroughly bizarre. They seemed to have materialized in the royal city out of thin air, bearing neither background nor identity tokens.

A few individuals produced identity tokens, but rigorous investigation revealed those tokens merely belonged to others, acquired from unknown sources.

It wasn't until the true parentage of Remir and Raphael was exposed that Anita finally became certain the mastermind behind the tabloid was definitely not the Tiger King, let alone the Queen.

She began to suspect that old Count Lang had uncovered something and deliberately orchestrated this newspaper to exact revenge upon them.

Yet before she could take action against the old Count and his wife, her final layer of disguised identity was blown wide open as well.

Anita had fled into a secret safehouse provided by her collaborators, and it was here that she laid eyes on the tabloid's special edition published just this afternoon.

She watched as the old Count and his wife marched Raphael to settle accounts with the Tiger King; she saw flocks of nobles and officials rush over to express their "concern" (rubbernecking); she witnessed the Tiger King and the Queen completely burning their bridges; she even learned that the Tiger King had managed to lose the spatial belt symbolizing royal authority alongside the massive royal fortune contained within it, while Remir was resisting arrest and fleeing the royal palace...

While a twisted sense of sadistic gratification welled up within Anita's heart, she was simultaneously pondering deeply, seeking a path to turn the tables through these latest developments.

Her fake death and disguised identities had indeed been exposed, but she refused to concede defeat just yet.

She still held a genuine blood-descendant of the Tiger King in her hands—Remir. As long as she followed her original blueprint to eliminate the Tiger King and all those princes and princesses, and leveraged the power of her collaborators, staging a forceful coup to seize the Tiger Kingdom's throne was by no means impossible.

Naturally, numerous grand nobles would undoubtedly object at that point, perhaps even seizing the opportunity to declare independence.

But it mattered not; her ultimate goal was the collapse of the Tiger Kingdom's royal family. If she could successfully take the helm of the Tiger Country in the end, excellent; if not, watching the Tiger Kingdom shatter into fragments was an outcome she could readily accept.

Adapting her strategy to the latest developments, Anita rapidly formulated a new operational plan. Wasting no time, she immediately disguised herself as an elderly woman and set out to find Remir.

While others might remain clueless as to where Remir was hiding, she knew his whereabouts with absolute clarity.

chunks.chineseText:
第181章 母与子，窃听

墨文伯爵府。

伊克斯墨文抿了一口金色的酒液，轻声说：“你知道么，王后已经秘密离开王城。”

雷米尔神情焦躁，双眼赤红：“那个毒妇是否离开王城和我有什么关系？你到底想说什么？”

伊克斯似笑非笑：“怎么会和你没有关系？原本国王陛下和王后陛下互斗，不可能拿出全部精力去搜捕你和你的亲生母亲。但现在王后陛下离开王城，我们的国王陛下可不就能腾出手来，把精力全部放在抓捕你和安妮塔夫人上？”

雷米尔神色凶厉，“所以？”

伊克斯不为所动：“所以我建议你最好能立刻离开王城，这对你、对安妮塔夫人都是最好的选择。”

雷米尔死死盯住伊克斯：“你不会是想杀了我，找……虎王邀功吧？”

伊克斯把酒杯放到窗台上，轻笑：“你怎么会这么想？”

雷米尔浑身肌肉紧绷，“你以为我来你这里会不做任何准备？如果我出事，相信我，你们墨文伯爵府也绝没有好果子吃。”

伊克斯这次是真笑起来了：“雷米尔殿下，你这是在威胁我墨文伯爵府吗？”

雷米尔听到伊克斯叫他殿下，自尊心就跟被烙铁烙了一样：“呵，看看你现在的嘴脸，你似乎忘了以前是怎么巴结讨好我的。怎么，看我现在落魄了，觉得在我身上榨不出油水了，你就把你的真实嘴脸暴露出来了？”

伊克斯挑眉，表情似乎有点惊讶：“你竟然以为我以前巴结讨好过你？你是不是想太多了？”

伊克斯还摸摸下巴说：“要说讨好，我好像也只讨好过拉斐尔。一开始我只是对他好奇，看他小小年纪被那么多人说闲话，还被三王子和五公主欺凌，竟然能表现得宠辱不惊，更能适当反击。这样的表现就连成年人都做不到。我当时还想着这个少年城府真深啊，但和他实际接触后，我才发现……”

伊克斯看向雷米尔，“他不是城府深，他只是把自己抽离了出来。他就像是一个旁观者一样，冷静地看待一切，理智地处理一切。这是一种非常出色、出色到可怕的天赋。

你是不是不明白我为什么说这是一种可怕的天赋？因为人都有情绪问题。你看，你现在就受到了情绪的极大影响，整个人都被愤怒、妒忌、自卑这样的强烈负面情绪给淹没。

这样的你，如果平时的智慧和做事能力能达到5分，现在恐怕连1分都没有。

你在国王陛下-身边待了那么长时间，你看我们的陛下有几次被激烈情绪影响到？如果有，表演的成分又有几分？

一个成功的王者，首先就是要学会控制自己的情绪，而不是被情绪控制。

雷米尔，只论这点，你就比拉斐尔差上很多。当然，不止是你，其他五位王子和公主殿下也同样比不上拉斐尔。”

雷米尔的指甲深深陷入掌心。

伊克斯忽然按住自己的心脏，神态夸张地：“可我只要想到拉斐尔这种‘天赋’是怎么练成的，我就为他心痛不已。我认识他时，他才多大？一个才十五岁的少年，竟然就把心境修炼到古井不波的地步。除了他本身的性格外，他又经历了多少？”

“雷米尔，你真的应该感谢你那缺了大德的父母，为你找了这么一块挡箭牌。如果换了你，你觉得你会变成什么样子？如果你想象不出来的话，不妨参照卡拉家族那个被认回来的私生子，或者是帕灯家族的那对私生子姐弟。”

雷米尔眼皮跳了两下。

伊克斯提的这几个私生子都是从小被人欺凌被人羞辱长大的。

卡拉家族的那个长成了一个对权贵自卑到极点、对普通人却残忍狠毒至极的杀人犯。如果他敢于报复他生父一家，敢于报复那些欺凌羞辱他的人，别人说不得都会赞他一声有心气。但他根本不敢面对那些欺辱他的人，反而把自己的痛苦和愤怒都发泄到无关的无辜者身上。

而帕灯家族的那对私生子姐弟，他们为了反踩，一个劲想要往上爬，什么事都敢做，一点脸皮都不要，完全没下限。他们为自己得到的得意洋洋，却不知别人都只把他们当笑话看。

他们可怜吗？

他们很可怜，同样可悲到极点。

雷米尔只要一想到自己也会长成那种样子就不寒而栗。

“不管婚生子还是私生子，生长环境真的非常重要。拉斐尔在那样的环境下还能长成堂堂正正并心怀柔软和正义的人，这简直就是奇迹！”

伊克斯最后叹息：“我越了解拉斐尔，就越是可惜他怎么不是虎王的真正血脉。如果是他，就算没有安妮塔夫人，我们墨文伯爵府也是愿意一力支持他登上王位的。”

雷米尔两手紧握成拳，整张脸被羞辱到通红。

是的，他认定伊克斯是在羞辱他。

伊克斯看着这样的雷米尔，摇摇头：“你竟然以为我在巴结讨好你，就凭你私生子的身份吗？你看我巴结讨好过哪一位王子和公主殿下吗？你是不是不太了解什么是真正的世家贵族？”

伊克斯忽然笑起来：“哦，你是不是以为我墨文家族只是一个伯爵，所以觉得我们很一般？”

雷米尔只觉得伊克斯的笑容就是讥笑。

他想转身就走。

“如果我们很一般，你以为你母亲会巴巴找上我们家，和我们家合作，还特意把你的身世透露给我们知道吗？”

伊克斯的声音就如魔鬼一般从身后传来：“安妮塔夫人会把你的身世告诉我们，就是为了表现诚意，更是把你当做了质子。必要时，我们家可以选择杀了你、废了你，从而破坏安妮塔夫人的谋划。”

雷米尔身体颤抖，他想大喊这不可能。

伊克斯简直就像是担心雷米尔还不够崩溃一样，用轻柔的语言说出最刺激人心的话：“当然，安妮塔夫人会把你的身世暴露给我们知道，我想也只是因为你并不是她计划中最重要的一环，更不是她心目中最重要的存在。对她来说，你就是一个好用的工具而已。必要时，完全可以舍弃。”

雷米尔如果不是紧紧咬住自己的舌尖，他就要哭出来了。

不管如何，他都只才二十一岁。

这几天，对他来说，就跟翻天覆地一样。

雷米尔转身，这里他实在待不下去了。

伊克斯微笑地看向已经走到门边的雷米尔：“你猜，安妮塔夫人现在对你会有什么安排？”

雷米尔手已经放到了门把手上。他咬紧了舌尖，什么都不想说，他怕自己说出来的任何一个字眼都会成为伊克斯嘲笑他、攻击他的把柄。

他在心里狂喊：赶紧走，离开这里！

但他又很想听听伊克斯接下来会说什么。

就像是一种变态的自虐。

他需要用更痛的痛苦来掩盖现在的痛苦。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 181: Mother and Son, Eavesdropping

The Count of Mervyn’s estate.

Icks Mervyn took a small sip of the golden liquor and said softly, "Did you know? The Queen has secretly fled the royal city."

Remir wore a frantic expression, his eyes burning red. "Whether that vicious woman has left the royal city or not, what does it have to do with me? What on earth are you trying to say?"

Icks wore a smile that didn't quite reach his eyes. "How can it not concern you? Originally, His Majesty the King and Her Majesty the Queen were locked in a mutual struggle, leaving neither with the full capacity to hunt down you and your biological mother. But now that the Queen has abandoned the royal city, won't our King be able to free up his hands and focus all his energy on capturing you and Madam Anita?"

Remir’s expression turned fierce. "And so?"

Unmoved, Icks replied, "Therefore, I suggest you leave the royal city immediately. That is the best choice for both you and Madam Anita."

Remir stared fixedly at Icks. "You aren't planning to kill me and use my head to... curry favor with the Tiger King, are you?"

Icks set his wine glass down on the windowsill and chuckled lightly, "Whatever gave you that idea?"

Remir’s muscles tensed all over. "Do you think I came here without making any preparations? If anything happens to me, trust me, your Mervyn estate won't come to a good end either."

This time, Icks genuinely laughed out loud. "Your Highness Remir, are you threatening my Mervyn estate?"

Hearing Icks address him as 'Highness', Remir felt his self-esteem sting as if branded by a hot iron. "Heh, look at your current attitude. It seems you've forgotten how you used to fawn over me and kiss up to me. What, seeing me fallen on hard times and realizing you can't squeeze any more oil out of me, you've dropped the act and exposed your true colors?"

Icks raised an eyebrow, looking somewhat surprised. "You actually thought I used to fawn over you and kiss up to you? Aren't you overthinking things a bit?"

Icks even rubbed his chin, musing, "If we're talking about fawning, the only person I ever recall trying to butter up was Raphael. At first, I was simply curious about him—how a mere child could face such malicious gossip, as well as bullying from the Third Prince and Fifth Princess, yet maintain such unshakeable composure while executing measured counterattacks. That kind of poise is something even adults fail to achieve. Back then, I thought to myself: this youth is truly deep in calculation. But after actually interacting with him, I realized..."

Icks looked at Remir. "He wasn't deep in calculation; he had simply detached himself entirely. He viewed everything like a bystander, looking upon all matters with a cool head and handling them with absolute rationality. That is an extraordinary talent—a terrifyingly brilliant talent.

Do you not understand why I call this a terrifying talent? Because human beings are slaves to their emotions. Look at you—you are currently being utterly consumed by intense negative emotions like anger, jealousy, and inferiority, completely overwhelmed by them.

A person like you, whose usual wit and capability might rate a 5 out of 10, probably doesn't even retain a score of 1 right now.

You spent so much time by His Majesty's side—how many times have you ever seen our sovereign swayed by violent emotions? And if he was, how much of it was mere performance?

A successful monarch must first learn to master their emotions, rather than be mastered by them.

Remir, on this point alone, you fall far short of Raphael. Of course, it isn't just you; the other five princes and princesses likewise pale in comparison to Raphael."

Remir's fingernails dug deep into his palms.

Suddenly pressing a hand to his chest, Icks adopted an exaggerated expression of theatrical anguish. "Yet every time I think about how Raphael forged such 'talent,' my heart aches for him. How old was he when I first met him? A mere fifteen-year-old youth, yet he had cultivated his state of mind to be as tranquil as an ancient well. Aside from his innate temperament, just how much suffering must he have endured?

Remir, you truly ought to thank those profoundly wicked parents of yours for finding you such a magnificent scapegoat. If you had been in his shoes, what do you suppose you would have grown into? If you can't picture it, you might as well look at that recognized illegitimate child of the Kara family, or that pair of illegitimate siblings from the Paden family."

Remir’s eyelids twitched twice.

The illegitimate children Icks mentioned had all grown up facing daily bullying and humiliation since childhood.

The illegitimate son of the Kara family had morphed into a murderer who was utterly servile and degraded before the nobility, yet displayed savage, venomous cruelty toward ordinary people. If he had dared to retaliate against his biological father's family, against those who had bullied and humiliated him, people might have at least praised him for having a backbone. Instead, he lacked the courage to face his actual abusers, choosing instead to vent all his agony and fury upon innocent strangers.

As for the illegitimate siblings of the Paden family, in their desperate drive to climb upward and step over others, they would stop at nothing, doing whatever it took without an ounce of shame or moral bottom line. They reveled in their petty gains, completely oblivious to the fact that everyone else viewed them as mere jests.

Were they pitiful?

They were pitiful indeed, and pathetic to the absolute extreme.

The mere thought of growing into that kind of creature sent a cold shiver down Remir's spine.

"Whether born in wedlock or out of it, one's upbringing environment truly matters immensely. For Raphael to grow into an upright man with a heart full of gentleness and justice under such circumstances—that is nothing short of a miracle!"

Icks sighed at last. "The more I understand Raphael, the more I regret that he isn't truly the Tiger King's blood. If he were, even without Madam Anita, our Mervyn estate would be more than willing to throw our full weight behind him to help him ascend the throne."

Remir clenched both hands into tight fists, his entire face flushing crimson with humiliation.

Yes, he was convinced that Icks was deliberately humiliating him.

Watching Remir like this, Icks shook his head. "You actually thought I was fawning over you? Just because you're an illegitimate prince? Have I ever gone out of my way to kiss up to any of the other princes or princesses? Do you really understand so little about what a true ancient aristocratic family is?"

Icks suddenly smiled. "Oh, do you suppose that because my Mervyn family holds merely the title of Count, we are nothing special?"

Remir felt as though Icks's smile was nothing short of a mocking sneer.

He wanted to turn and storm out.

"If we were truly so ordinary, do you think your mother would have come scurrying to our doorstep, seeking a partnership and deliberately leaking your true heritage to us?"

Icks's voice trailed after him like a demon whispering from the shadows. "Madam Anita revealed your identity to us precisely to demonstrate her sincerity, while simultaneously treating you as a political hostage. Should the need arise, our family has the option of executing you or crippling you to shatter Madam Anita's grand plots."

Remir's body trembled; he wanted to scream that it was impossible.

As if fearing that Remir wasn't already on the verge of a psychological collapse, Icks delivered the most emotionally piercing blows in a gentle tone: "Of course, the only reason Madam Anita exposed your identity to us, I imagine, is because you were never the most crucial cog in her grand design, let alone the most cherished existence in her heart. To her, you are nothing more than a convenient tool—one that can be discarded whenever necessary."

Had Remir not been biting down fiercely on the tip of his tongue, he might have burst into tears right then and there.

No matter what, he was only twenty-one years old.

These past few days had felt like the sky itself was turning upside down.

Remir turned around; he could no longer bear to stay in this place a single second longer.

Icks smiled as he watched Remir, who had already reached the door handle. "Tell me, what kind of arrangements do you suppose Madam Anita has in store for you now?"

Remir's hand rested upon the doorknob. Biting down hard on his tongue, he refused to utter a single word, terrified that any syllable escaping his lips would serve as ammunition for Icks to mock and attack him further.

He screamed frantically in his mind: *Get out of here, run away!*

Yet, a perverse part of him desperately wanted to hear what Icks would say next.

It was akin to a form of perverted self-flagellation.

He needed an even deeper, sharper agony to numb the pain tearing through him in the present.

chunks.chineseText:
伊克斯满足了雷米尔，就像是戏弄：“如果安妮塔夫人真的爱你这个儿子，她现在最想要做的就是把你远远送离王城，甚至是送出虎国。以安妮塔夫人这些年搜刮和累积的财富，她也有足够的金钱供你在其他任何地方生活得很好。”

雷米尔背对伊克斯，他的心在动摇，受到这么多的连番打击，他原本某个根深蒂固的想法也在动摇：也许离开王城对他来说才是最好的。

伊克斯：“如果安妮塔夫人很在意你这个儿子，她会直接去找虎王，让虎王认可你为王室血脉，用尽手段让虎王把你放入继承人之列。虽然你以后会成为其他王子和公主的眼中钉，但只要你自己不拉胯，安妮塔夫人又能笼络住虎王，你的未来也不是没有希望。”

雷米尔身体紧绷到微微颤抖。

伊克斯嘴角勾起：“如果安妮塔夫人只是把你当做她复仇和争权夺利的工具，她应该会来我家找你。并和我家商讨接下来的行动计划。她会安抚你，让你继续留在我家，发挥你作为质子的功用。必要时，她还会让你去找郎侦老伯爵夫妇，让你跟他们哭诉哀求道歉，争取让郎家和拉斐尔不再针对你和她。

当时机成熟，比如所有王子公主全都死光，包括我们的国王陛下在内。安妮塔夫人九成会让你站出来宣布要为父报仇，然后再让我家以支持最后一个虎王血脉为借口，要么推你上位，要么就是另起炉灶，彻底搅乱虎国。

但以安妮塔夫人的性格，她绝不会容许你能成长到可以压制她的那一天，所以……你应该会在辉煌刹那后就成为安妮塔夫人的垫脚石吧。母后监国，进而成为女王，那也是一条曾经有人走成功过的路。”

伊克斯看着雷米尔的背影：“雷米尔，你会选择哪一个未来？”

雷米尔的身体不再颤抖，他转过身，呸的一口吐出含有血沫的口水：“那么你们墨文家族呢？你说我母亲连我都会利用到底，最后更会踩着我上位，那么你们墨文家族就不担心走上和我同样的道路？”

雷米尔露出讥笑：“所以你们和我母亲一样，都只是想要利用对方，只是看最后谁手段更高明。而我不管是对于我母亲来说，还是对你们墨文家族来说，都是一个好用的工具。”

伊克斯竟然点头承认：“没错，我们和你母亲就是互相利用的关系。那你知道我今天跟你说得这么清楚的原因吗？”

雷米尔脸色阴沉，“你们想让我背叛我母亲？想让我在最后反过来捅她一刀？”

伊克斯笑而不语。

雷米尔嗤：“你们当我是真的蠢货吗！你说我亲生母亲都能为了登上王位反手杀了我，又要我怎么相信你们墨文家族会在最后支持我登上王位，还能乖乖当我的臣子？只怕你们在利用我对付我母亲后，就会彻底解决我。”

伊克斯赞扬：“你不笨嘛，竟然能想到这么多。”

雷米尔被气得脸色涨红。

伊克斯脸色一正：“我今天不妨给你吃个定心丸。我就明明白白告诉你，我们墨文家族会全力支持你登上王位，包括成为你的最大臂助，在你不对我们动手的情况下，我们也绝不会对你出手。”

雷米尔冷笑：“你们的条件？”

伊克斯：“很简单，你需要以国王的身份同意虎国成立真神教，奉厄穆克拉索为真神，奉真神教为国教，命令全国子民都必须信仰厄穆克拉索。除厄穆克拉索以外的神灵，皆为邪神。”

雷米尔脸色大变，声音都尖锐了：“你让我认可邪神教派？！”

伊克斯笑，笑意却没有达到眼中：“胡说什么邪神教派，我们明明是真神教。邪神什么，都是对我们真神的污蔑。同样的要求，你母亲安妮塔夫人可是同意了的。”

雷米尔身体再次颤抖起来，他再看伊克斯，忽然发现这人怎么看怎么邪诡。

“你们墨文家族……你们竟然……”

“嘘。”伊克斯竖起手指。

“你听到了这个秘密，如果不与我们签订灵魂契约，就再也无法活着离开这个房间了哦。”

雷米尔恐惧到极点。

他很快就想明白伊克斯为什么要多此一举的和他另外签订灵魂契约，因为他们觉得他要比安妮塔更好控制得多。

“我、我需要考虑，给我一点时间考虑。”

“可以。你就待在这间房里好好考虑，什么时候想明白了，对外喊一声就是。”伊克斯拿起放在窗台上的酒杯，施施然地拧开门把手走出了这间宽敞的会客室。

雷米尔迅速冲到窗户前，用力推窗，却发现整扇窗户跟封死了一样。

半晌，雷米尔颓然地坐倒在椅子上。

安妮塔扮作老妇人进入墨文伯爵府时，夜色已深。

这次是墨文伯爵亲自接待了安妮塔，伊克斯在一边作陪。

安妮塔和墨文伯爵商谈了很久，双方需要根据现在的情况重新商定计划。

“拉斐尔这颗棋已经废掉。不过他和郎侦老伯爵一起离开王城，对我们也是一件好事。本身拉斐尔就在调查上有一定天赋，他还喜欢紧盯着邪神信徒，真的给我们带来了很大-麻烦。而郎侦作为前城卫军统领，在城卫军和侍卫营中都有着非凡影响力，如果他帮着拉斐尔，让城卫军和侍卫营深度自查，对我们的伤害必然会很大。”

“而且郎侦原本是保王党，他留在王城，对虎王的助力也不小，至少他绝不会允许有人伤害虎王和王室。那老头别看老了，不说影响力，只他本身也超级能打，否则他也无法当上城卫军统领，还当了那么多年。但现在那老头大概是最巴不得王室出丑的人，更希望虎王下台。”

“还有拉斐尔一走，那个炼金大师阿瑞斯商极有可能也会跟着离开。这个人留在王城，同样会对王城产生不小影响。尤其在我们还没有调查清楚他的背后实力前。”

“……虎王已经派人去跟踪王后，应该是想找到丹顿家族藏起来的那支军队。就且先让他们狗咬狗，互相消磨实力。”

“……二王子终于展现野心，他接手了王后留下的所有人脉和财产，想来要不了多久，他和大王子就会形成势均力敌的局势。而虎王应该对这种局势喜闻乐见。同样，这也是我们期待的发展。”

“先不要动三王子和大公主，他们继承权靠后，与其先对他们动手引起另外两个继承人的注意，不如先把实力最强的解决掉。”

“……传承分享大会并没有停办，虎王显然是想借此打个翻身仗，重新把王权集中到自己手中。这部分，我们可以按照原计划做准备。”

墨文伯爵父子和安妮塔的谈话房间是特制的，隔音效果极佳，里面就算敲锣打鼓，外面也不会听见。

但这种程度的隔音显然挡不住某个超级听力天赋者。

而在房间里密谈的三人打死也不会想到拉斐尔郎沐会在这时候跑到墨文伯爵府来偷听。

郎沐听到一半，转头看向商非凡，眼神怪异。

商非凡：“怎么这么看我？”
chunks.englishText:
Irex satisfied Remiel, as if toying with him: "If Lady Anita truly loves you as her son, the very first thing she’d want to do right now is send you far away from the Royal City, or even out of the Tiger Kingdom entirely. With the wealth Lady Anita has looted and accumulated over all these years, she has more than enough money to provide for you to live comfortably anywhere else."

Remiel turned his back to Irex. His heart was wavering. Struck by one heavy blow after another, a certain deeply ingrained notion of his was beginning to shake: perhaps leaving the Royal City truly was the best thing for him.

Irex continued: "If Lady Anita deeply cared about you as her son, she would go directly to the Tiger King, compel him to acknowledge you as royal blood, and use every means at her disposal to have the Tiger King place you among the heirs. Though you would become a thorn in the side of the other princes and princesses from then on, as long as you didn't squander your potential and Lady Anita could keep the Tiger King reined in, your future wouldn't be without hope."

Remiel’s body stiffened into a slight tremor.

The corners of Irex's lips curved upward: "If Lady Anita merely regards you as a tool for her revenge and her struggle for power and profit, she should come to my estate to find you, and discuss the next phase of action with my family. She will placate you, making you continue to stay at my home to fulfill your function as a hostage. When necessary, she’ll even have you go to Old Count Langzhen and his wife, making you weep, plead, and apologize to them in an effort to get the Lang family and Raphael to stop targeting you and her.

"When the time is ripe—for instance, once all the princes and princesses have perished, including His Majesty our King—Lady Anita will, nine times out of ten, make you step forward to announce your intent to avenge your father. Then, she will use my family’s support for the last remaining Tiger King bloodline as a pretext to either push you onto the throne or start anew, completely throwing the Tiger Kingdom into chaos.

"Yet given Lady Anita’s temperament, she will never allow you to grow to a day where you might suppress her. Therefore... after a fleeting moment of glory, you will likely become nothing more than stepping stones for Lady Anita. The Queen Mother ruling as regent, and eventually ascending as Queen—that, too, is a path someone has walked successfully before."

Irex gazed at Remiel’s back: "Remiel, which future will you choose?"

Remiel’s body stopped trembling. He turned around, spat a mouthful of blood-flecked saliva, and snarled: "And what about your Mervyn family, then? You say my mother would use me to the bitter end and finally step over me to take the throne. Doesn't your Mervyn family worry about walking down that exact same path with her?"

Remiel wore a derisive sneer: "So you are just like my mother—you both only want to use each other, merely gambling on whose methods are more ruthless in the end. As for me, whether it's to my mother or to your Mervyn family, I am nothing more than a convenient tool."

Irex actually nodded in admission: "That's right. Your relationship with us and your mother is one of mutual utilization. Do you know why I'm telling you all of this so clearly today?"

Remiel’s expression turned gloomy: "You want me to betray my mother? You want me to turn around and stab her in the back at the very end?"

Irex smiled without a word.

Remiel scoffed: "Do you take me for an utter fool! You said my own birth mother could turn around and kill me just to ascend the throne. How do you expect me to believe that your Mervyn family will support me in claiming the throne in the end, or obediently act as my subjects? I'm afraid that the moment you use me to deal with my mother, you'll completely dispose of me."

Irex praised: "You aren't stupid after all, to be able to think of this much."

Remiel was so furious his face turned beet red.

Irex straightened his expression: "I might as well give you some peace of mind today. Let me spell it out for you clearly: our Mervyn family will lend our full support to your ascension to the throne, acting as your greatest pillar of strength. Provided that you do not make a move against us, we will never lift a finger against you either."

Remiel sneered: "Your conditions?"

Irex replied: "Very simple. As king, you will need to consent to the establishment of the True God Cult within the Tiger Kingdom, worshiping Eumuklaso as the True God, establishing the True God Cult as the state religion, and commanding all citizens across the nation to worship Eumuklaso. Any deities other than Eumuklaso shall be branded as evil gods."

Remiel’s expression changed drastically, his voice turning shrill: "You want me to endorse a heretic cult?!"

Irex smiled, though the mirth did not reach his eyes: "What nonsense about a heretic cult? We are clearly the True God Cult. Calling anything an 'evil god' is sheer slander against our True God. Your mother, Lady Anita, has already agreed to this very same demand."

Remiel’s body trembled once more. As he looked at Irex anew, he suddenly found this person utterly bizarre and sinister.

"Your Mervyn family... to think you actually..."

"Shh," Irex pressed a finger to his lips.

"Since you’ve heard this secret, if you refuse to sign a soul contract with us, you won't be leaving this room alive."

Remiel was gripped by extreme terror.

He quickly figured out why Irex had gone through the redundant trouble of making him sign a separate soul contract: it was because they felt he was far easier to control than Anita.

"I—I need to think about it. Give me some time to consider."

"Very well. Stay right here in this room and think it through thoroughly. Whenever you've made up your mind, just give a shout outside." Irex picked up the wine glass left on the windowsill, unlatched the door handle leisurely, and walked out of the spacious parlor.

Remiel rushed over to the window immediately and shoved it hard, only to find the entire window frame sealed as tight as iron.

After a long while, Remiel slumped back into the chair in defeat.

***

When Anita entered the Count of Mervyn’s estate disguised as an old woman, the night had already deepened.

This time, Count Mervyn himself received Anita, with Irex accompanying them on the side.

Anita and Count Mervyn conferred for a long time, both sides needing to renegotiate their plans based on the current situation.

"That pawn Raphael is already useless. However, his departure from the Royal City alongside Old Count Langzhen is also a stroke of luck for us. Raphael possesses a certain talent for investigation, and he loved keeping a close eye on the evil god’s cultists, truly causing us massive trouble. And as the former commander of the City Guard, Langzhen holds extraordinary influence within both the City Guard and the Imperial Guard. If he helped Raphael subject the Guard and the guardsmen to a deep internal purge, the damage to us would undoubtedly be severe."

"Furthermore, Langzhen was originally a royalist. His remaining in the Royal City provides a formidable boost to the Tiger King—at the very least, he would never allow anyone to harm the Tiger King or the royal family. Don't let his age fool you; aside from his influence, the old man himself is monstrously strong, or he never could have served as the Commander of the City Guard for so many years. But right now, that old man is probably the one most eager to see the royal family make a fool of themselves, and even more desperate to see the Tiger King step down."

"Then there's the fact that with Raphael gone, that grandmaster alchemist Ares Shang will most likely leave as well. If this man stays in the Royal City, he will likewise exert a considerable impact—especially since we have yet to thoroughly investigate the powers backing him."

"...The Tiger King has already dispatched men to tail the Queen, presumably hoping to find that army the Danton family has hidden away. Let them play dog eat dog and wear each other's strength down first."

"...The Second Prince has finally bided his time to show his ambition; he has taken over all the connections and assets left behind by the Queen. It shouldn't be long before he and the First Prince reach a stalemate. The Tiger King ought to be quite pleased to see such a deadlock. Likewise, this is a development we look forward to."

"For now, do not touch the Third Prince and the Eldest Princess. Their claim to the succession comes later; rather than moving against them first and drawing the attention of the other two contenders, we should eliminate the strongest faction first."

"...The Heritage Sharing Convention has not been suspended. The Tiger King clearly intends to use this to stage a comeback and reconcentrate royal power in his own hands. For this part, we can make preparations according to our original plan."

The room where Count Mervyn, his son, and Anita held their discussions was specially constructed, possessing exceptional soundproofing. Even if someone beat gongs and drums inside, not a single sound would leak outside.

However, this level of soundproofing was evidently no match for someone blessed with super-hearing.

And the three people holding a clandestine meeting inside would never in their wildest dreams imagine that Raphael and Lang Mu had sneaked over to the Mervyn estate to eavesdrop at a time like this.

Hearing halfway through, Lang Mu turned his head to look at Shang Feifan with a bizarre expression.

Shang Feifan: "Why are you looking at me like that?"

chunks.chineseText:
郎沐忍不住：“你怎么知道墨文伯爵有问题？”

他认识伊克斯，也见过墨文伯爵。伊克斯就像是个自来熟，以他朋友自居，在他离开王城后，对方还和角马一起跑到莫约镇找他。

但他总觉得自己看不透伊克斯这个人，从不敢跟他深交。

但他不管怎么想，也没有想到伊克斯和他的父亲墨文伯爵竟然会和邪神信徒有关。不仅如此，他们似乎在邪神信徒中貌似还是高层。

那可是伯爵啊！信仰邪神是图什么？

他还听说过墨文家族的族谱年代久远，似乎是从新神血帝国时期就传延下来的世家。

商非凡反问：“不是你告诉我的吗？”

郎沐哑然。

他想起来了，之前他根据收集到的大量情报线索进行细致分析，从无数线索中找到一些似是而非的东西。其中有两条线都牵扯到了墨文伯爵府，但这两条线索细查下去后却都断了。

郎沐看来看去，也没有看出墨文伯爵府有什么问题。但他心里又觉得就这么放过也不得劲。

不久他又得知伊克斯墨文竟然和交际花多丽丝的妹妹妮娜梅尔文正式订婚，更是觉得哪里都不对。那可是老牌世家的墨文伯爵府！

后来商非凡问他调查邪神信徒调查得怎么样时，他就把几条不太确定的线索也交给商非凡，其中就包括墨文伯爵，让他帮忙查查看。他知道商非凡有些特别的能力（有系统）能查出一些别人查不出的事情。

“所以你查出了墨文伯爵府真有问题？”郎沐问。

商非凡摇头：“不，我只是查到雷米尔躲进了墨文伯爵府。这个墨文伯爵和他的家人做事十分谨慎，在外面几乎没有留下任何痕迹。”

郎沐：“……”

郎沐把他听到的内容大致告诉商非凡，迟疑片刻：“你觉得我们有必要警告虎王吗？”

商非凡对此的态度是：“你决定就好。虽然我更希望他们自相残杀，但你肯定不愿意他们的互斗影响到其他虎国人。”

郎沐实话实说：“虎王再差也比邪神信徒强，何况他治理国家并不算差，只是私德有点问题。让邪神信徒成为国家决策者，那才是最可怕的事情。”

商非凡叹息：“怎么你们兽人大陆动不动就有人想要搞教派，就因为曾经有个神血教成功过吗？”

郎沐给了商非凡一个白眼，搞得好像地星没有鞋教一样。

商非凡感叹。他家阿沐是越来越活泛了，不再那么古井不波万事不惊，就像是还俗的僧人。

随即，商非凡就被自己的想法逗乐，忍不住抬手摸了摸郎沐的头。

郎沐莫名其妙，搓我头发干什么？

密室内。

安妮塔和墨文伯爵的商谈已经到了末尾。

这是一次极为秘密的会谈。

墨文伯爵对他们家的防守力量极为自信，安妮塔也认定没有人能跟踪她。

故，这三人没有一个人意识到他们秘密商谈的内容已经被人从头到尾都听了去。

“你要见见雷米尔吗？”墨文伯爵眼神温柔，看安妮塔装扮的老妇就如在看深恋的情人。

“当然。”安妮塔面色如常地起身。

“好好安抚他。那孩子被吓坏了。”墨文伯爵示意儿子伊克斯带路。

这两人一动，商非凡和郎沐也跟了上去。

但商非凡看到墨文伯爵并没有从密室出来，心念一动，跟郎沐耳语一句，在密室门将关未关之际，悄悄溜了进去。

郎沐单独一人跟上安妮塔和伊克斯。

安妮塔看到了雷米尔。

雷米尔神情憔悴，看到安妮塔扮演的老妇，并没有认出这就是他母亲。

直到安妮塔用自己的声音喊出雷米尔的名字。

雷米尔眼中迸发出惊喜，连喊声都带了一点泪音：“母亲！”

伊克斯微微一笑：“你们母子慢慢聊。”

说完，伊克斯带上房门离去。

走时，伊克斯目光快速在房间内环视一遍，好像有哪里有点古怪，但他又没看出来。

想了想，觉得自己应该只是多心。

郎沐就站在这个会客室的角落里，沉默地看着那对真母子。

伊克斯刚走，雷米尔就迫不及待地跟安妮塔告状，说伊克斯威胁他。

但这孩子总算没有傻到家，没有问安妮塔是否真如伊克斯所说，打算在利用他获得虎国王位后，就废掉他，换自己上位。

更没有质问安妮塔，把他的身世暴露给墨文伯爵知道，是否是真的拿他当质子看。

雷米尔只是说了伊克斯想要和他签订灵魂契约，让他捧真神教成为虎国国教一事。

“母亲，你知道墨文家族和真神教有来往吗？”

安妮塔沉默片刻，“我们需要力量，前期只能和这些人虚与委蛇。”

“但……把邪神信徒引入虎国高层真的好吗？那些人明显所图甚大！”雷米尔可不是白在虎王身边待那么久，最起码的政治素养和警惕心，他还是有的。

安妮塔笑了笑，温和地说：“一把刀再锋利，它也只是一把刀。但是用它来杀人，还是用它来切菜，则全看使用者。你明白我说的意思吗？”

雷米尔：他明白是明白。问题是他为什么觉得这个比喻听起来似乎很有道理，实际就是在忽悠他？

安妮塔又道：“你还小，现在你还握不住这把刀，才会如此担忧。等到你成长到可以握住这把刀，甚至可以肆意摧毁它时，你就知道刀永远都只是一把工具而已。”

雷米尔眼看安妮塔似乎铁了心要跟墨文他们合作，也不再劝阻。

他母亲看起来清丽文雅，实际控制欲极强，且一旦下定决心要做的事，就是九只巨虫都拉不回来！

而他真正想跟安妮塔谈的是……

“母亲，我后面该怎么办？”

安妮塔声音更加柔和，她拉起儿子的手，轻轻拍了拍：“不用担心，我跟墨文伯爵说好了，你先住在他们家，他们会保护好你。等到时机恰当时，我再让你去见你父王。他现在也就是心情不好才会生你的气。等过一阵子，他肯定会想念你，并后悔这么对你。”

雷米尔看着安妮塔温柔且充满关心的眼神，心情一阵激荡。

忍不住，他就说了出来：“母亲，我、我不想当王了，我不喜欢王城，我想离开，我想去其他地方重新开始。”

安妮塔的眼神陡然变了，变得犀利又尖锐。

雷米尔心脏收缩，他忽然感到了恐惧。

安妮塔迅速调整自己的神情，眼神也重新变得温柔，语气就跟哄小孩一样：“我知道你这几天受到了不小打击，你会这么想无可厚非。人总是会逃避困难，向往安逸。但是，你甘心吗？雷米尔，你明明比那些所谓的正牌王子公主都更加优秀。你真的愿意让他们中的一个成为下一代虎王？”

安妮塔的语气变得哀伤，捧住儿子的脸：“你真的想要王后那个毒妇生的孩子成为新的虎王吗？夺走本该属于你的一切。更让那毒妇耀武扬威，永远骑在你母亲的头上？”

CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第181章 母与子，窃听 (Part 3)):
"""
Lang Mu couldn't help asking: "How did you know the Count of Mervyn had issues?"

He knew Irex and had also met Count Mervyn. Irex acted like a social butterfly who took it upon himself to be his friend; after Lang Mu left the Royal City, that guy had even chased after him all the way to Moyue Town alongside the wildebeest.

Yet he always felt he couldn't quite see through Irex, and never dared to deepen their association.

No matter how he thought about it, though, he never expected that Irex and his father, Count Mervyn, would actually be connected to the evil god cultists. Not only that, they seemed to hold high-ranking positions within the cult.

That was a count we're talking about! What on earth were they plotting by worshiping evil gods?

He had also heard that the Mervyn family tree stretched far back into history, appearing to be an aristocratic house handed down all the way from the Divine Blood Empire era.

Shang Feifan asked in return: "Didn't you tell me?"

Lang Mu was struck dumb.

He remembered now. Earlier, after conducting a meticulous analysis based on a vast amount of intelligence and clues he had gathered, he had managed to fish out some ambiguous leads from countless threads. Two of those threads had pointed directly to the Count of Mervyn’s estate, but both had hit dead ends when investigated further.

Try as he might, Lang Mu couldn't spot anything amiss with the Mervyn residence. Yet a nagging feeling in his gut told him that letting it go just like that didn't sit right.

Not long after, he learned that Irex Mervyn had officially gotten engaged to Nina Mervyn, the younger sister of the socialite Doris, which made him feel even more that something was deeply wrong everywhere. That was the venerable aristocratic house of Count Mervyn!

Later, when Shang Feifan asked him how his investigation into the evil god cultists was going, Lang Mu had handed over several uncertain leads to Shang Feifan as well, including Count Mervyn, asking him to help look into it. He knew Shang Feifan possessed certain special abilities (a system) that allowed him to uncover things others couldn't.

"So you found out that the Mervyn estate really does have problems?" Lang Mu asked.

Shang Feifan shook his head: "No, I only discovered that Remiel had taken refuge inside the Mervyn estate. This Count Mervyn and his family act with extreme caution, leaving virtually no trace of themselves outside."

Lang Mu: "..."

Lang Mu roughly recounted what he had overheard to Shang Feifan, hesitating for a moment: "Do you think we need to warn the Tiger King?"

Shang Feifan's attitude toward this was: "You decide. While I'd rather prefer they tear each other to shreds, you certainly wouldn't want their infighting to harm other people of the Tiger Kingdom."

Lang Mu spoke frankly: "No matter how bad the Tiger King is, he's still better than evil god cultists. Besides, his governance of the country isn't terrible; he just has some flaws in his personal conduct. Letting evil god cultists become national decision-makers—that is the most terrifying thing imaginable."

Shang Feifan sighed: "Why is it that whenever someone in your Beastmen Continent wants to start a cult, they always do? Is it just because there once was a Divine Blood Cult that succeeded?"

Lang Mu rolled his eyes at Shang Feifan, making it sound as if Planet Earth didn't have any cults of its own.

Shang Feifan sighed inwardly. His Ah Mu was becoming much more lively and expressive; he was no longer as detached and tranquil as stagnant water, like a monk returning to secular life.

Immediately afterward, Shang Feifan was amused by his own thoughts and couldn't help raising a hand to lightly stroke the top of Lang Mu’s head.

Lang Mu was baffled: What are you doing messing up my hair?

***

Inside the secret chamber.

Anita and Count Mervyn’s discussion had reached its closing stages.

This had been an extremely clandestine meeting.

Count Mervyn possessed absolute confidence in his family's defensive strength, and Anita was equally certain that no one could have tracked her.

Consequently, not a single one of these three people realized that the contents of their secret deliberations had been listened to from start to finish.

"Would you like to see Remiel?" Count Mervyn's gaze was tender; looking at the old woman disguised by Anita felt like gazing upon a deeply beloved lover.

"Of course." Anita rose to her feet with an expression as calm as ever.

"Comfort him well. That child has been terribly frightened." Count Mervyn motioned for his son Irex to lead the way.

As the two of them moved, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu followed right behind.

However, seeing that Count Mervyn did not emerge from the secret chamber, an idea struck Shang Feifan. He whispered a quick word to Lang Mu and slipped quietly inside just as the secret door was half-closing.

Lang Mu alone followed after Anita and Irex.

Anita caught sight of Remiel.

Remiel’s expression was haggard; upon seeing the old woman disguised as Anita, he failed to recognize that this was actually his mother.

It wasn't until Anita called out Remiel's name in her natural voice that he realized the truth.

Joy burst forth in Remiel’s eyes, and his cry even carried a trace of tearful sound: "Mother!"

Irex smiled faintly: "You mother and son take your time chatting."

With that, Irex pulled the door shut and departed.

As he left, Irex’s gaze swept rapidly across the parlor, feeling as though something was slightly odd, yet he couldn't quite put his finger on it.

After a moment of thought, he decided he must simply be overthinking things.

Lang Mu stood quietly in the corner of the parlor, watching the true mother and son in silence.

The moment Irex left, Remiel impatiently began to vent to Anita, blurting out that Irex had threatened him.

Yet the boy wasn't entirely devoid of sense; he didn't ask Anita whether it was true, as Irex had claimed, that she intended to discard him and replace him with herself after using him to gain the Tiger King's throne.

Nor did he question Anita about whether exposing his true parentage to Count Mervyn meant she genuinely viewed him merely as a hostage.

Remiel merely spoke of how Irex wanted to make him sign a soul contract and force him to elevate the True God Cult as the state religion of the Tiger Kingdom.

"Mother, did you know that the Mervyn family has dealings with the True God Cult?"

Anita fell silent for a moment: "We need power, and in the early stages, we can only dance with these people."

"But... is it really wise to introduce evil god cultists into the upper echelons of the Tiger Kingdom? Those people are clearly plotting something massive!" Remiel hadn't spent all that time by the Tiger King's side for nothing; he still possessed the bare minimum of political literacy and vigilance.

Anita smiled and spoke gently: "No matter how sharp a blade is, it remains nothing more than a tool. Whether it is used to kill people or to chop vegetables depends entirely on the wielder. Do you understand what I mean?"

Remiel: He understood the principle, certainly. The problem was, why did this analogy sound like it made sense in theory, while in reality it felt like she was just trying to hoodwink him?

Anita continued: "You are still young, and you cannot yet wield this blade yourself, which is why you are so anxious. Once you grow strong enough to wield this blade—and even destroy it at will—you will realize that a blade is forever just a tool."

Seeing that Anita seemed dead set on cooperating with the Mervyns, Remiel stopped trying to dissuade her.

His mother looked refined and gentle, but her desire for control was terrifyingly strong. Once she made up her mind to do something, not even nine giant insects could drag her back!

What he truly wanted to discuss with Anita, however, was...

"Mother, what should I do next?"

Anita’s voice grew even softer. She took her son’s hand and gently patted it: "Don't worry, I've already discussed it with Count Mervyn. You will stay at their estate for now, and they will protect you well. When the proper opportunity arises, I'll arrange for you to see your royal father. He's only angry with you right now because he's in a foul mood. After a while, he's bound to miss you and regret treating you this way."

Remiel looked into Anita’s gentle, caring gaze, and a wave of turbulent emotion washed over him.

Unable to hold it in any longer, he blurted out: "Mother, I—I don't want to be king anymore. I don't like the Royal City. I want to leave; I want to go somewhere else and start over."

Anita’s gaze shifted abruptly, turning sharp and piercing.

Remiel’s heart constricted, and a sudden terror gripped him.

Anita swiftly adjusted her expression, her gaze turning gentle once more as her tone took on the soothing cadence of coaxing a child: "I know you've suffered quite a blow these past few days, and it's only natural that you'd feel this way. People always want to flee from hardship and yearn for ease. But are you willing to let it go, Remiel? You are clearly far more outstanding than those so-called legitimate princes and princesses. Are you truly willing to let one of them become the next Tiger King?"

Anita’s tone grew sorrowful as she cupped her son’s face: "Do you really want the child borne by that viper of a Queen to become the new Tiger King? To snatch away everything that should rightfully belong to you? And to let that vicious woman swagger about, forever riding roughshod over your mother?"

chunks.chineseText:
雷米尔的手指微微痉挛，他听到自己的嘴巴在说：“母亲，我错了，我不会再让你失望。”

“好孩子。”安妮塔抱住雷米尔，轻轻拍抚他的背。

过了一会儿，安妮塔放开雷米尔，温柔地：“你放心，你是我唯一的孩子，我会为你准备好一切，给你铺好路，必定会让你登上那最高的位子。至于墨文伯爵他们的要求，你不妨先答应。”

“……可他们要求灵魂契约。”雷米尔木讷地说。

安妮塔微笑：“只要你不违反誓约内容，又何必担心契约是灵魂契约还是王印契约。而且灵魂这东西虚无缥缈，说不定就是他们想来吓唬人的。”

雷米尔想问：那为什么不是你跟他们签灵魂契约，非要让我签？

但雷米尔实际说出口的是：“那我再想想。”

安妮塔拍拍儿子的胳膊：“那你就好好想想，这事不急。有我在，墨文伯爵他们也不敢逼迫你。好了，我还有些紧急的事情要去办，你就在这里好好待着，不要乱跑。”

“好的，母亲。”雷米尔硬生生扯出一个微笑，目送安妮塔离去。

安妮塔一走，雷米尔就抱头窝进了椅子中。

伊克斯没有说错，他在安妮塔眼中果然只是一个实现她复仇愿望和野心的工具。

雷米尔后悔了。

当他姥姥……郎老夫人跟他提议，说要送他离开虎国，让他去南方的复兴联盟生活时，他为什么要拒绝？

那时老夫人明明已经知道他不是她的外孙，可她仍旧愿意为他着想，甚至愿意送他一座能种植的农庄。

可他的亲生母亲呢？

却一脸温柔地亲手把他送入深渊，还要踩上一脚，不让他爬上来。

雷米尔身体颤抖，轻轻抽泣起来。

CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第181章 母与子，窃听 (Part 4)):
"""
Remiel’s fingers twitched slightly, and he heard his own voice saying, "Mother, I was wrong. I won't let you down again."

"Good boy." Anita embraced Remiel, gently patting his back.

After a moment, Anita released Remiel and said softly: "Rest assured, you are my only child. I will arrange everything for you and pave the road so that you are guaranteed to ascend that highest seat. As for Count Mervyn and his people's demands, you might as well agree to them for now."

"...But they require a soul contract," Remiel said dully.

Anita smiled: "As long as you don't violate the terms of the oath, what does it matter whether the contract is a soul contract or a royal seal contract? Besides, things like souls are illusory—perhaps they're just making that up to scare people."

Remiel wanted to ask: Then why didn't you sign a soul contract with them instead? Why did it have to be me?

Yet what Remiel actually said out loud was: "Then I'll think about it some more."

Anita patted her son's arm: "Go ahead and think it over carefully; there's no rush. With me here, Count Mervyn and the others wouldn't dare to force you. Well, I have some urgent business to attend to. You stay right here and behave yourself; don't run around."

"All right, Mother." Remiel forced out a smile, watching her leave.

The moment Anita left, Remiel buried his face in his hands and curled up in the chair.

Irex hadn't lied. In Anita's eyes, he really was nothing more than a tool to fulfill her desire for revenge and ambition.

Remiel regretted it.

When his grandmother—Old Lady Lang—had offered to send him away from the Tiger Kingdom and let him live in the Revival Alliance in the south, why had he refused?

At that time, the old lady already knew he wasn't her grandson, yet she was still willing to look out for him, even offering to give him a farm where he could grow crops.

And his birth mother?

She had gently and personally shoved him into the abyss, only to step on him to ensure he couldn't climb back out.

Remiel’s body trembled as he began to weep softly.

第182章 捣乱

商非凡一进入密室就忍不住感叹：这里的怨气可真他么浓厚，都快形成实质的乌云。

在进入墨文伯爵府前，商非凡站在这座伯爵府外就感知到这里有大量的怨气。

但他没想到，还有更多的怨气竟然被拘束在这里。

商非凡一边大肆吸收这些怨气，一边观察这间密室。

明明没有从密室出来的墨文伯爵此刻竟然不在密室中，就像是消失了一般。

商非凡对此没有感到半点惊讶。

他仔细打量这座密室，利用原本学到的建筑知识、侦查技术加经验，再辅以猎人技能，很快就找到了疑似机关的布置。

果然！

谁没事会留在连扇窗户都没有的全封闭型密室中？

密室又不是书房，更不是休息间，墨文伯爵单独留在密室九成有秘密的事要干。

出于职业直觉，商非凡就决定暂时和郎沐分头行动。

他和郎沐都不算是弱者，保命手段更是比一般人多得多。那天观看了虎王和大都督狮域的打斗后，两人都对自己的实力有了一个具体估量——与虎王单打独斗应该还是没问题的。

商非凡走到他判断为门扉的墙壁边，开始集中精神力施展穿墙魔法。

发现机关却不用的原因？

那当然是不想让人察觉。

这不是他第一次施展该魔法，不过还是有些生疏。

怨气值消耗有点大，大概是强行把怨气转化为魔力的原因？

好在这座伯爵府别的不多，怨气管够！

商非凡顺利穿过厚厚的墙壁，进入一条通道。

通道的墙壁上爬满了黑色的甲壳虫。

这些虫子可比警卫虫的杀伤力大多了。

城门口负责检查行李货物的警卫虫只是负责检查，杀伤力并不强。

但这些黑色甲壳虫，只看它们尖锐的前肢和锋利的虫翅，就知道它们的攻击力有多强。

这府邸他们进来后就发现是典型的明松暗紧，虫子特别多。

这些虫子全都藏在暗处，就算仔细搜寻都不能轻易搜寻到。

可郎沐身怀自然之神的青睐，自然类魔法感知力极高，他可以通过和自然环境沟通，知晓很多肉眼看不到的秘密。

商非凡同样有他的手段，他的职业技能就是“虫族研究者”。

尤其在他第二次吸收虫母心脏碎片后，该职业技能已经从敏锐升级为通感。换言之，他可以像虫母一样，感知到绝大多数种类的虫子。

也许还没有办法和虫族交流，以及让他命令这些虫子做事情，但感知它们的存在就是洒洒水啦。

同时受虫母力量影响，他对受虫毒影响导致的异变者和全部虫族包括虫人族都具有天然的血脉压制能力。

于是商非凡还没踏进墨文府邸就已经提前感知到这座伯爵府中有大量虫子隐藏，更有受到虫族影响产生的异变者。

再加上安妮塔走入这座伯爵府。

两人当时就有了一个大胆猜测。

一般兽人府邸，不管身份高低，家里有这么多虫子的可不多。

虽然兽人族对各种虫子的利用很多，但喜欢养虫子和使用虫子的兽人仍旧是少数。

甚至很多高位兽人就不喜欢家里有除了巨虫坐骑以外的虫子。

这就跟地星人类也许会在家里养一只看家狗，但极少有人在家里养上几十几百只狗一样。而畜牧业者也会把自己养的牲口和自己家分开，不是实在没地方住，压根不会搞人畜合住。

而两人至今为止见到最喜欢养虫子，还一养就一大堆的，就是邪神信徒。

为了不惊动墨文伯爵府中的人，两人都没有去沟通或震慑那些虫子，而是用隐身术进入了伯爵府。

商非凡还利用虫族研究者的技能模拟了虫子的磁场。

郎沐则让自己的气息融入自然环境，任何一只虫子碰到他都不会把他当敌人看。

墨文伯爵府也有破除隐身术的炼金器物。

不过商非凡用隐身道具逛王宫已经逛出心得体会，他现在已经摸清楚破除隐身术的炼金器物的原理。

有了准备，墨文伯爵府的炼金监测器对他们自然毫无效用。

作为主要戒备和攻击手段的虫子更是把他们当自己虫，发现了只会打招呼叫兄弟，绝不会通知这府邸的主人有敌人钻进来，更不会扑上去就咬。

现在这些黑甲虫的表现同样如此。

商非凡脚步未停，就这么大大咧咧地从密密麻麻的虫墙中穿梭而过。

而那些黑甲虫动都没动，跟装饰物一样。

通道不到二十米，一扇骨门出现。

骨头发黑，黑中还带着一点红，看着特别瘆人。

加上这里的灯光十分阴暗，胆子小点的人进入这里不是掉头就跑，就是吓到脚软走不动路。

骨门忽然打开，长相英俊身材修长的墨文伯爵从门内走出。

他的神情看不出是喜是悲。

商非凡注意到这位伯爵手上很慎重地捧着一个小盒子。

趁着骨门没有关闭，商非凡侧身闪入门内。

墨文伯爵忽然顿住脚步，转头。

骨门正在缓缓关闭。

墨文伯爵又装回头打量墙壁两边密密麻麻的黑甲虫，见黑甲虫安安静静，不由哂笑。

这些黑甲虫可比炼金监测器好用得多，不管拥有怎样厉害的隐身天赋，进入这里都会被黑甲虫察觉。

墨文伯爵捧着小盒子，快步走出密室。

作为有毛类兽人，他同样不太喜欢被那么多虫子包围着。

伯爵府侧楼的会客室中。

雷米尔感觉到有谁在看着他。

他也是个要面子要强的人，一察觉到房间内有人，立刻擦干净眼泪，抬头。

他以为是伊克斯特意跑来嘲笑他和逼迫他签下那个灵魂契约，没想到却看到了一个根本不应该在这里出现的人。

“拉斐尔？”雷米尔呆滞，眼睛和鼻头都还有点红。

郎沐点头：“是我。”

雷米尔震惊到有点发傻：“你怎么来了？”

郎沐：“跟踪安妮塔夫人。”

“哦。”雷米尔从自己的情绪中拔-出，脑子也重新活动起来，当即焦急道：“你疯了！竟然就这么冒出来，我都不知道这房间里有没有东西在监视我。要是被他们发现……”

郎沐打断雷米尔：“有两只虫子在监视你。它们现在已经睡着。”

他一进入这间会客室，这里的尘土、空气、房间里摆放的花草就告诉他，有两只监视虫在监视雷米尔。

两只监视虫，一只就趴在花盆的土壤里，小小的，几乎与土壤混为一体。另一只则停在房顶天花板上。

监视虫一般都是成对出现，一旦发现被监视者有异常，其中一只就能飞出去传递信息。

郎沐施展了魔法中的高端隐身术进来，该隐身术不但能达到光学隐身效果，同时还能隔绝气味，并让他的周身温度与所处环境相同。

两只监视虫和安妮塔都没有发现他。

直到安妮塔离开，他打算跟雷米尔谈谈，才施展睡眠魔法催眠了两只监视虫。

“你能让监视虫无声无息地睡着？”雷米尔不可置信。

郎沐没有回答这个问题。
