Chapter 182: Causing Trouble

The moment Shang Feifan stepped into the secret chamber, he couldn't help muttering in his heart: The resentment here is truly fucking thick; it’s almost forming solid, pitch-black clouds.

Before even entering Count Moven’s estate, Shang Feifan had sensed a massive amount of resentment lingering outside the mansion's walls.

Yet, he hadn't expected that even more resentment was actually being constrained and pent-up right here.

As Shang Feifan frantically absorbed these wisps of resentment, he began to survey the secret chamber.

Count Moven, who clearly hadn't left the chamber, was nowhere to be seen at the moment—as if he had simply vanished into thin air.

Shang Feifan felt not the slightest bit of surprise at this.

He carefully inspected the secret chamber. Drawing upon his learned architectural knowledge, reconnaissance techniques, and past experience, supplemented by his hunter skills, he quickly pinpointed what appeared to be a concealed mechanism.

Sure enough!

Who in their right mind would hole up in a completely sealed secret chamber without even a single window?

A secret chamber was neither a study nor a resting quarters; for Count Moven to seclude himself here alone meant there was a ninety-nine percent chance he was up to something covert.

Driven by his professional intuition, Shang Feifan decided to temporarily split up with Lang Mu.

Neither he nor Lang Mu could be considered weak, and their means of preserving their lives far exceeded those of ordinary people. Having witnessed the fierce battle between the Tiger King and the Governor of the Lion Domain the other day, both of them had formed a concrete estimate of their own strength—going toe-to-toe with the Tiger King in a one-on-one fight should pose no problem at all.

Shang Feifan walked over to the wall he had deduced to be a hidden door and began to concentrate his mental energy to cast Wall-Crossing Magic.

As for why he had discovered a mechanism yet chose not to use it?

Naturally, it was to avoid alerting anyone.

This wasn't his first time casting this spell, though he was still somewhat rusty.

The consumption of resentment points was a bit high. Was it perhaps because he was forcibly converting resentment into magic power?

Fortunately, if there was one thing this count's estate wasn't short on, it was an abundant supply of resentment!

Shang Feifan smoothly passed through the thick walls and entered a corridor.

The walls of the tunnel were crawling with black beetles.

These bugs possessed far greater lethality than the security insects.

The guard bugs stationed at the city gates to inspect luggage and cargo were only meant for checking, and their offensive power wasn't high.

However, just by looking at the sharp anterior limbs and razor-sharp wing-casings of these black beetles, one could tell just how formidable their offensive capabilities were.

Upon entering this estate, they had already discovered that the security here was styled 'loose on the outside, tight on the inside,' with a remarkably high density of insects.

All of these bugs were hidden in the shadows, impossible to spot easily even with a thorough search.

Yet Lang Mu was blessed by the God of Nature, granting him exceptionally high perceptual powers regarding nature-type magic. By communicating with the natural environment, he could perceive countless secrets invisible to the naked eye.

Shang Feifan possessed his own methods as well; his professional skill was none other than "Insect Tribe Researcher."

Especially after absorbing the Insect Mother's heart fragment a second time, this professional skill had upgraded from acute perception to empathy. In other words, he could perceive the vast majority of insect species just like an Insect Mother.

While he might not yet have the ability to communicate with the insect race or command these bugs to do his bidding, sensing their presence was an absolute breeze.

Simultaneously influenced by the Insect Mother's power, he possessed an innate bloodline suppression capability over all variants affected by insect toxins, the entire insect race, and even the insect-human race.

Thus, even before setting foot in Moven's estate, Shang Feifan had already sensed in advance that a massive number of bugs were concealed within this count's mansion, alongside mutants spawned under the influence of the insect race.

Coupled with the fact that Anita had walked right into this estate, the two of them had arrived at a bold hypothesis early on.

In a typical beastman estate, regardless of social standing, very few would keep such a massive quantity of bugs around.

Although the beastman race made extensive use of various insects, beastmen who genuinely enjoyed raising and utilizing bugs remained a small minority.

In fact, many high-ranking beastmen loathed having any insects in their homes, save for giant insect mounts.

This was akin to how humans on Earth might keep a watch-dog at home, but rarely would anyone keep dozens or hundreds of dogs. Furthermore, livestock farmers would keep their raised beasts separated from their living quarters; unless they literally had nowhere else to live, they would never resort to living under the same roof as livestock.

Yet, the ones they had seen thus far who loved breeding bugs—and did so by the hordes—were precisely the Cultists of the Evil God.

To avoid startling the occupants of Count Moven's estate, neither of them attempted to communicate with or intimidate those bugs; instead, they used invisibility arts to infiltrate the mansion.

Shang Feifan even utilized his Insect Tribe Researcher skills to simulate the magnetic field of the insects.

As for Lang Mu, he allowed his aura to blend seamlessly into the natural environment, ensuring that any bug that happened to brush past him would never mistake him for an enemy.

Count Moven's estate certainly possessed alchemical artifacts capable of piercing through invisibility spells.

However, Shang Feifan had already gained plenty of experience strolling through royal palaces using stealth items; he had long since figured out the underlying principles of those invisibility-dispelling alchemical gadgets.

With ample preparation, the alchemical monitors in Count Moven's estate were naturally completely useless against them.

As the primary defensive and offensive measures, the insects mistook them for one of their own. Upon discovering them, they would only exchange greetings like brothers, never dreaming of notifying the estate's master that intruders had sneaked in, let alone lunging forward to bite.

Right now, the behavior of these black beetles was precisely the same.

Without breaking his stride, Shang Feifan swaggered right through the dense wall of bugs.

And those black beetles didn't even twitch, looking just like inanimate decorations.

After walking less than twenty meters down the corridor, a skeletal door appeared.

The bones were pitch-black, tinged with a hint of crimson, looking exceptionally eerie.

Coupled with the deeply dim lighting in this area, anyone with a slightly timid disposition would either turn tail and run or have their legs turn to jelly from fright, unable to take another step.

Suddenly, the bone door swung open, and a handsome, slender Count Moven stepped out from within.

His expression betrayed neither joy nor sorrow.

Shang Feifan noticed that the count was carefully cradling a small box in his hands.

Taking advantage of the fact that the bone door had yet to close, Shang Feifan sidestepped and slipped inside.

Count Moven suddenly halted his steps and turned his head.

The bone door was slowly closing.

Count Moven turned back around to survey the densely packed black beetles lining both sides of the wall. Seeing that the insects remained utterly still and quiet, a mocking smirk curled his lips.

These black beetles were far more useful than alchemical monitors; no matter how formidable an intruder's stealth talent might be, entering this place would inevitably be detected by the black beetles.

Clutching the small box, Count Moven strode out of the secret chamber.

As a furry beastman, he likewise wasn't particularly fond of being surrounded by so many bugs.

Meanwhile, in the reception parlor on the side wing of the count's mansion:

Remir felt as though someone was watching him.

He was someone who cared deeply about his pride and dignity. The moment he sensed someone else in the room, he quickly wiped away his tears and raised his head.

He assumed Ikes had deliberately run over to mock him and force him into signing that soul contract, but to his shock, he saw a person who had no business appearing here at all.

"Raphael?" Remir asked dumbly, his eyes and the tip of his nose still faintly red.

Lang Mu nodded: "It's me."

Remir was so shocked his mind went blank: "How did you get here?"

Lang Mu: "Tracking Madam Anita."

"Oh." Remir snapped out of his emotional spiral, his brain kicking back into gear as he immediately blurted out in panic, "Are you out of your mind?! To just show up like this—I don't even know if there's anything monitoring this room. If they discover you..."

Lang Mu cut Remir off: "There are two surveillance bugs watching you. They're asleep right now."

The moment he stepped into this reception parlor, the dust, the air, and the potted plants placed around the room had all signaled to him that two surveillance bugs were keeping tabs on Remir.

Two surveillance bugs—one was clinging to the soil of the flowerpot, tiny and almost blending in completely with the dirt, while the other was perched on the ceiling overhead.

Surveillance bugs generally appeared in pairs. Once they detected an anomaly in the target, one of them would fly off to relay the message.

Lang Mu had used a high-end concealment magic to enter. This invisibility spell not only achieved optical stealth effects but simultaneously insulated his scent and matched his body temperature to the surrounding environment.

Neither the two surveillance bugs nor Anita had noticed him at all.

It wasn't until Anita departed and he intended to have a word with Remir that he cast a sleep spell to hypnotize the two surveillance bugs.

"You can make surveillance bugs fall asleep without making a single sound?" Remir asked, finding it hard to believe.

Lang Mu didn't answer the question.

chunks.chineseText:
雷米尔：他似乎小瞧了这位。不，包括虎王在内，可能王城那些认识拉斐尔的人都小瞧了拉斐尔。这人绝不止一个听力天赋！

怪不得他母亲会假死脱身，可能就是因为害怕自己的行动被拉斐尔察觉？

雷米尔突然有点想笑。

他母亲和虎王选择用拉斐尔当他的挡箭牌时，大概也没想到这位能暗中成长到他们全都无法掌控的地步。

雷米尔甚至想到他母亲拥有石耳那么多年，可最后石耳却投入拉斐尔身体中，这是不是说明就连神灵都站在拉斐尔那边？

雷米尔灰暗了。咬了咬嘴唇：“……你是打算抓我和我母亲回去，还是打算杀了我们？”

郎沐答非所问：“我听你和安妮塔夫人的交谈，你似乎被困在了墨文伯爵府？”

雷米尔下意识怼：“关你什么事！”

郎沐也不介意雷米尔的语气，只是笑笑：“确实不关我的事。看在两老的面子上，我本来想问问你，想不想离开王城，他们到现在都很担心你。看来是我多事了。”

雷米尔嘴巴下意识张开，不到一秒，他的脸再次涨得通红。

眼看郎沐转身，一副要离开的模样。雷米尔也顾不得询问郎沐是怎么进入墨文伯爵府、又是怎么溜入这间会客室还没让安妮塔发现，他急得跳了起来。

“拉斐尔！”雷米尔用气音叫。

郎沐停住脚步，侧身看向雷米尔，神情像是在问有什么事吗。

雷米尔知道这也许是他逃出深渊的最后一个也是唯一一个机会，如果他就这么放过，他绝对会后悔一辈子。

“你没有骗我？”

“骗你什么？”

雷米尔握紧双拳，眼中满是忐忑：“你不会故意骗我说能带我离开，然后在我满怀希望时又把我交给伊克斯吧？我记得你和伊克斯墨文的关系很好。”

郎沐无语：“我就算把你交出去，也只会把你交给克莱门特。”

“那你会把我交给克莱门特吗？”雷米尔追问。

郎沐：“这就要问你了。你是想从此离开王城，远离你那对父母的是是非非，还是想要回到虎王身边，继续当一个私生子。”

雷米尔迟疑了一秒，但一想到虎王不承认他是王室血脉、还要抓捕他的凉薄态度，雷米尔咬牙：“我想离开王城。我可以向你发誓，我不会再对任何人透露我是虎王血脉的事，更不会再掺和到虎国王位继承权纷争中。我只想离王城、离虎国越远越好！”

郎沐淡淡道：“你不用向我发誓。这是你的人生，你如何选择是你的自由。我愿意送你离开王城，也只是全了两老对你的心意，我不希望他们再担心你。同样，这也是我最后一次帮助你。”

雷米尔双手握紧又放松，几次后，还是忍不住问道：“为什么？我以为你恨我，我还当着那么多人的面，说石耳在你身上，你为什么还愿意帮我？”

郎沐奇怪：“原因我刚才已经说了。”

雷米尔不信：“你就一点不反感我？不想毁了我？不想报复我？”

郎沐：“你想听实话？”

雷米尔重重点头，他当然想要听实话，哪怕他知道拉斐尔接下来说的话极有可能会非常刺耳。

郎沐想了想，“其实真没多少原因。想帮你，一个是你年龄不大，以往也没什么劣迹，还不算无可救药。另外一个重要原因，则是不想我姥姥姥爷惦记你一辈子，如果你死了或者出事，他们嘴巴不说，心里也会很伤心。”

雷米尔声音微微颤抖：“你不生气吗？”

如果有个人在那么多人面前说自己的坏话，暴露自己的秘密，只为了借刀杀人，他一定会恨不得把对方碎尸万段才好。

他不相信拉斐尔能如此大度。

郎沐看雷米尔还是一副想要“深挖”的模样，有点好笑：“好吧，其实是我不想安妮塔和墨文家族，包括他们身后的邪神信徒利用你搞事。虽然你不算太重要，没有你，他们一样能把虎国搞得一团糟。但有了你，他们显然会更顺利。”

“那你可以杀了我，一了百了。”雷米尔喃喃。

郎沐笑起来，眼中带了一点点商非凡式的小小邪气：“那样多没意思。就是要让你活着逃离，才能更打你母亲安妮塔的脸，也能让他们尝尝求而不得，无法走捷径的滋味。”

郎沐偏头：“难道你不想看看那些拿你当工具的阴谋者失去你这个工具后气急败坏的样子吗？还不是被人杀死，而是你自己跑掉，在他们认定你根本无法逃走的情况下。”

“……”雷米尔脸上的怨愤和灰暗消失了一点点，他的眼睛也多出了一点神采。

“你要怎么带我出去？”雷米尔理智回来不少，他告诉郎沐：“墨文伯爵府外松内紧，他们还和邪神信徒有关系，府邸里面还不知道有多少可怕的东西。我想除了监视虫，外面肯定也有人守着我。”

郎沐很平常地说：“我们能进来，自然就能出去，再多带你一个也不是问题。”

雷米尔抓住关键词：“我们？还有谁来了？”

郎沐笑而不语，拿出骨杖，准备施展魔法。

忽然。

“对不起。”雷米尔低声说，声音非常非常小。

两个小时以前，他绝说不出这样的话。

可现在他就这么说出来了。

郎沐轻轻挑眉，随即笑了笑。

他对雷米尔没有任何多余感情，帮他真就只是不想两老为雷米尔担心一辈子，以及不想安妮塔和邪神信徒得意。

他也不图雷米尔的感激和道歉，雷米尔怎么想他，他真的不是特别在意。

就如他跟雷米尔说的，他只会帮他这一次，以后雷米尔如何做、会过什么样的日子，都是他自己的选择。

“我当时就是气疯了，我……妒忌你，妒忌到恨不得你跟我一样失去一切。”一旦有了第一句，后面的话也就更容易吐露出来。

“你不知道，当我知道自己真正身世的那一天，我就不想看到你，不，不是不想，是不敢。每次见到你，看到别人因为你的私生子身份嘲笑你，我就会代入到自己身上，我就会特别害怕，害怕我们的身份会对调。我那段时间几乎天天做噩梦，梦到我的身世暴露……”

“我表现得越骄傲，我心里就越清楚我有多自卑。尤其在面对你的时候。有时候我真的希望他们没有跟我说出我的真正身世，这样我至少能坦然面对你，也能坦然面对姥爷和姥姥。”

“有好几次，我都想跟姥姥说，但他们不让，而我也害怕身世暴露的后果，我害怕看到姥姥姥爷厌弃我仇恨我的模样。我就是个胆小鬼……”

“当我们俩的身世被八卦报曝光，我又恐惧，又有种身上枷锁被卸掉的轻松感。”
chunks.englishText:
Remir thought: *It seems he has underestimated this fellow. No, including the Tiger King, perhaps everyone in the royal city who knows Raphael has underestimated him. This guy definitely possesses more than just a hearing talent!*

No wonder his mother had staged a fake death to make her escape—was it perhaps out of fear that her actions would be detected by Raphael?

Suddenly, Remir felt a strange urge to laugh.

When his mother and the Tiger King chose to use Raphael as his scapegoat, they probably never imagined that this person could grow in the shadows to a degree where none of them could control him.

Remir even recalled how his mother had possessed the Stone Ear for so many years, yet in the end, the Stone Ear had embedded itself into Raphael's body. Did this imply that even the gods were standing on Raphael's side?

Remir sank into gloom. He bit his lower lip: "...Are you planning to drag me and my mother back, or are you planning to kill us?"

Not answering the question directly, Lang Mu countered: "From what I heard in your conversation with Madam Anita, you seem to have been trapped in Count Moven's estate?"

Remir instinctively snapped back: "None of your business!"

Lang Mu didn't mind Remir's tone; he merely smiled: "Indeed, it's none of my business. For the sake of the two elders, I originally wanted to ask if you'd like to leave the royal city—they've been worried sick about you to this day. It seems I was just meddling."

Remir's mouth fell open reflexively. Less than a second later, his face flushed red once more.

Seeing that Lang Mu had turned around and made a motion to leave, Remir threw all caution to the wind. He didn't bother asking how Lang Mu had infiltrated Count Moven's estate or slipped into this reception parlor without Anita noticing; he leaped up in desperation.

"Raphael!" Remir called out in a breathy whisper.

Lang Mu halted his steps, turning his body sideways to look at Remir with an expression that seemed to ask if something was the matter.

Remir knew this might be his first, last, and only chance to escape the abyss. If he let it slip away like this, he would undoubtedly regret it for the rest of his life.

"You aren't lying to me?"

"Lying to you about what?"

Clenching his fists tightly, Remir's eyes were filled with anxious trepidation: "You won't deliberately trick me into thinking you can take me away, only to hand me over to Ikes the moment I'm filled with hope? I remember your relationship with Ikes Moven is quite good."

Lang Mu was speechless: "Even if I were to hand you over, I'd only hand you over to Clement."

"Then will you hand me over to Clement?" Remir pressed on.

Lang Mu replied: "That depends on you. Do you want to leave the royal city for good, far away from the rights and wrongs of that pair of parents, or do you want to return to the Tiger King's side and continue playing the role of an illegitimate son?"

Remir hesitated for a second, but the moment he recalled the Tiger King's heartless attitude—refusing to acknowledge him as royal blood and even hunting him down—he gritted his teeth: "I want to leave the royal city. I can swear to you that I will never reveal to anyone that I possess the Tiger King's bloodline, nor will I ever meddle in the power struggles for the Tiger Kingdom's throne again. I just want to get as far away from the royal city and the Tiger Kingdom as possible!"

Lang Mu said indifferently: "You don't need to swear to me. This is your life, and how you choose to live it is your freedom. I am only willing to send you out of the royal city to fulfill the heartfelt wishes of the two elders; I don't want them worrying about you anymore. Likewise, this is the last time I will ever help you."

Remir clenched and unclenched his hands several times before finally blurting out, "Why? I thought you hated me. I even blurted out in front of so many people that the Stone Ear was on you—why are you still willing to help me?"

Lang Mu found it odd: "I already stated the reason just now."

Remir didn't believe it: "Do you not feel any aversion toward me at all? You don't want to ruin me? You don't want revenge?"

Lang Mu: "Do you want to hear the truth?"

Remir nodded heavily. Of course he wanted to hear the truth, even if he knew what Raphael was about to say might be brutally ear-piercing.

Lang Mu pondered for a moment. "To be honest, there really aren't many grand reasons. Wanting to help you comes down to this: first, you're young, you haven't committed any egregious misdeeds in the past, and you aren't completely beyond saving. Another major reason is that I don't want my maternal grandparents fretting over you for the rest of their lives. If you were to die or run into trouble, even if they didn't say it out loud, they would grieve in their hearts."

Remir's voice trembled slightly: "Aren't you angry?"

If someone had spoken ill of him in front of such a crowd and exposed his secrets simply to use others as a knife, he would surely wish to hack that person into ten thousand pieces.

He simply couldn't believe Raphael could be this magnanimous.

Seeing that Remir still wore a look determined to "dig deeper," Lang Mu chuckled good-naturedically: "Fine, the truth is I simply don't want Anita, the Moven family, and the Evil God cultists behind them to use you to stir up trouble. While you aren't all that crucial—without you, they could still turn the Tiger Kingdom upside down—having you around clearly makes things go smoother for them."

"Then you can just kill me and be done with it," Remir muttered.

Lang Mu burst into laughter, a hint of playful, Shang Feifan-esque mischief dancing in his eyes: "How boring would that be? Only by letting you escape alive can we truly slap your mother Anita across the face, and let them experience the agony of yearning for something they cannot have, unable to take any shortcuts."

Lang Mu tilted his head: "Don't you want to see those conspirators who treat you like a tool lose their minds with fury once they lose their tool? And not because someone killed you, but because you ran away on your own, precisely when they were 100% certain you could never escape."

"..." The resentment and gloom on Remir's face faded just a fraction, a spark of vitality returning to his eyes.

"How are you going to get me out of here?" Remir regained much of his composure, reminding Lang Mu: "Count Moven's estate is loose on the outside and tight on the inside. They're tied to the Evil God cultists, and who knows how many terrifying things are hidden inside this mansion. Aside from the surveillance bugs, I'm sure there are people guarding the perimeter."

Lang Mu said casually: "If we could get in, we can naturally get out. Dragging you along as extra baggage won't be a problem."

Remir caught the key word: "We? Who else came?"

Lang Mu smiled without answering, pulled out his bone staff, and prepared to cast a spell.

Suddenly.

"I'm sorry," Remir whispered, his voice extremely, extremely quiet.

Two hours ago, he would never have been able to utter such words.

Yet right now, he had actually spoken them.

Lang Mu raised a brow slightly, then let out a soft chuckle.

He held no extra emotional attachment toward Remir; helping him truly stemmed from simply not wanting the two elders to worry about him for a lifetime, and refusing to let Anita and the Evil God cultists have their way.

He wasn't angling for Remir's gratitude or apology, and what Remir thought of him wasn't something he cared deeply about.

Just as he had told Remir, he would only help him this once. Whatever Remir chose to do or what kind of life he led in the future was entirely his own choice.

"I was just out of my mind with anger back then. I... envied you, envied you to the point where I wished you could lose everything just like me." Once the first sentence crossed his lips, everything that followed came tumbling out much easier.

"You have no idea—the day I learned my true lineage, I didn't want to see you. No, not that I didn't want to; I didn't *dare*. Every time I saw you, watching others mock you for your illegitimate status, I would project it onto myself, and I would grow terribly frightened—terrified that our identities would be swapped. During that time, I had nightmares almost every day, dreaming that my background was exposed..."

"The more prideful I acted on the outside, the clearer I knew how deep my inferiority complex went. Especially when facing you. Sometimes, I truly wished they had never told me my true heritage. That way, at least I could face you with a clear conscience, and face grandpa and grandma with ease."

"There were several times I wanted to tell grandma, but they wouldn't let me, and I was terrified of the consequences if my background came to light. I was terrified of seeing the look of disgust and hatred in my grandparents' eyes. I'm just a coward..."

"When our backgrounds were exposed by the gossip tabloids, I felt terror, but at the same time, I felt a strange sense of relief, as if the shackles on my body had finally been unbuckled."

chunks.chineseText:
“但我没有想到父……虎王会那样对我，我以为我是他最宠爱的小儿子，是他的心头肉掌心宝，就算身世暴露，他也会承认我、心疼我，并为我撑腰。不管我做错什么，他也会给我擦屁股。可实际上，我只是不想离开王城而已，就被他视为背叛。而且他也在歧视我的私生子身份……”

“既然连做父亲的都看不起自己的私生子，认为不配有继承权，那他们为什么还要把我生下来？”

“还有我母亲安妮塔，我以为她是全世界最爱我的人，以为她的所作所为都是在为我着想。而实际上，我在她眼中和旖梦楼里那些女孩没有任何区别……”

雷米尔低着头，眼泪吧嗒吧嗒往下掉。

这将是他唯一一次坦白，以前他没有跟任何人说过这些话，以后也不会。

一只手落在他头顶上，轻轻拍了拍

雷米尔原本可以察觉，也能闪过，但此时的他没有做出任何躲避动作。

他甚至想：如果拉斐尔想要杀了他，那就杀吧。

“我不是在求你原谅，做错就是做错，我不至于连承认错误的勇气都没有。我、我宁可是你杀了我，也不想被他们利用和控制。”雷米尔抬起头，梗着脖子，用力忍住眼泪。

他还是不想在拉斐尔面前失去最后的尊严。

明明拉斐尔只比他大两三个月，为什么他面对拉斐尔时就像小孩面对大人？

他觉得自己很成熟了，甚至觉得自己已经成熟到可以治理好一个国家、当一个伟大的王。而实际上……会这么想的他就很幼稚！

郎沐：这孩子好像是成长了一点，果然挫折更容易让幼稚鬼成长吗？

“我对杀你没兴趣，你要是真的觉得自己做错了，就跟姥爷姥姥好好道歉，他们才是你最应该说对不起的人。”

雷米尔：“我知道，我只是……”

郎沐不想再哄孩子，飞速念完魔法口诀，骨杖一点：“睡吧，等你醒来，你就会脱离困境，到时你再考虑自己的未来也不迟。”

雷米尔慢慢闭上眼睛，眼角还挂着泪珠。

郎沐接住睡着的雷米尔，把他放到椅子上。随即握住骨杖对他施展了一个缩小魔法。

雷米尔转眼就变成了拇指男孩。

郎沐抄起雷米尔，随手塞进口袋里。

郎沐穿墙离开这间具有囚室性质的会客室。

在他走后大约十五分钟，那两只监视虫才醒过来。

当监视虫发现监视对象消失后，立刻飞出一只去传信。

但那时墨文伯爵府已经顾不上逃跑的雷米尔。

因为府里有更严重的事情发生了。

“轰隆！”

半座墨文伯爵府被炸上了天。

巨大的爆炸声惊动了小半个王城的人。
chunks.englishText:
"But I never imagined fa... the Tiger King would treat me like that. I thought I was his most cherished youngest son, the apple of his eye, the palm of his hand. Even if my background was exposed, I thought he would acknowledge me, dote on me, and back me up. No matter what mistakes I made, I thought he would clean up my mess. But in reality, just because I didn't want to leave the royal city, he viewed it as betrayal. What's more, he looks down on my illegitimate birth just as much..."

"If even a father looks down upon his own illegitimate child and thinks he's unworthy of the right of succession, then why on earth did they give birth to me in the first place?"

"And my mother Anita—I thought she was the person who loved me most in the entire world, believing everything she did was for my own good. But in reality, in her eyes, I'm no different from those girls in the Dreamy Pavilion..."

Remir lowered his head, tears dripping down tap, tap, tap.

This would be his one and only confession. He had never spoken these words to anyone before, and he never would again.

A hand descended onto the crown of his head, giving it a gentle pat.

Remir could have sensed it and dodged away, but at this moment, he didn't make a single evasive move.

He even thought: *If Raphael wants to kill me, then let him.*

"I'm not begging for your forgiveness. A mistake is a mistake; I at least have the courage to admit when I'm wrong. I—I'd rather you killed me than be used and controlled by them." Remir raised his head, stiffening his neck as he fought back his tears with all his might.

He still didn't want to lose his final shred of dignity in front of Raphael.

Raphael was only two or three months older than him—why did he feel like a child standing before an adult whenever he faced Raphael?

He had always considered himself mature, even believing he was mature enough to govern a nation and become a great king. But in truth... anyone who thought like that was utterly childish!

Lang Mu thought: *This kid seems to have grown up just a tiny bit. Sure enough, setbacks are better at maturing a naive brat.*

"I have no interest in killing you. If you genuinely feel you were in the wrong, go make a proper apology to grandpa and grandma. They are the ones you owe an apology to the most."

Remir: "I know, I just..."

Not in the mood to coddle children any longer, Lang Mu rapidly recited an incantation and tapped with his bone staff: "Sleep. When you wake up, you'll be out of this predicament, and you can consider your future then."

Remir slowly closed his eyes, tear droplets still hanging from the corners of his lashes.

Lang Mu caught the sleeping Remir and set him down onto a chair. Immediately after, he gripped his bone staff and cast a Shrinking Spell on him.

In the blink of an eye, Remir shrank down to the size of Tom Thumb.

Picking up Remir, Lang Mu casually shoved him into his pocket.

Lang Mu walked straight through the wall, leaving behind the prison-like reception parlor.

About fifteen minutes after his departure, the two surveillance bugs finally woke up.

When the surveillance insects discovered that their target had vanished into thin air, one of them immediately flew off to report the news.

However, by that time, Count Moven's estate no longer had the bandwidth to care about the escaped Remir.

Because something far more severe had just occurred within the mansion.

*BOOM!*

Half of Count Moven's estate was blown straight into the sky.

The massive blast shook a good portion of the royal city awake.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第183章 墨文伯爵府完 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第183章 墨文伯爵府完

“阿沐！”商非凡溜到约定好的汇合地点。

郎沐正抬头看着被炸上天的碎片和火光，看到商非凡现出身影，不由吃惊询问：“你做了什么？”

商非凡很得意地笑了笑，“没什么，就是炸了一个地下祭坛，顺便搬空了墨文伯爵府的藏宝库。”

郎沐嘴巴微张。

商非凡觉得可爱，凑上去亲了亲。

郎沐迅速闭紧嘴巴。

商非凡轻轻咬了一口。

郎沐脸红，干咳：“那什么，说正事。”

商非凡不满地说：“说完了。”

郎沐按住商非凡凑过来的脸：“不是……那个地下祭坛是怎么回事？这么短的时间，你又是怎么发现了墨文伯爵府的藏宝库？”

“等回去跟你细说。这个给你。”商非凡拿出一枚空间手镯塞给郎沐。

郎沐神色复杂地接过手镯，不用问他都知道这里面塞了什么。

商非凡：“鸡蛋不能都放在一个篮子里。你拿一半，我拿一半。不管我们中谁的储物空间出事，都还有另一方兜底。”

郎沐听商非凡这么说，自然不好拒绝，只能收下。

商非凡很高兴，一家人嘛，那么客气作甚？他的不就是他家阿沐的？

不过阿沐现在还是对他有些客气，更不会做他的主。这点慢慢来吧，等到哪天他家阿沐能理所当然地给他管账，把两人的财产都握在手里，他们就能真正成为一家人。

商非凡自问也不是一个非常信任别人的人，他想如果他没有遇到郎沐，而是随便找个还算顺眼的人结婚，可能最多就是上交个表面的工资卡，但绝不会把自己的全部财产交给对方打理，更别说告诉对方自己所有秘密。

很奇怪，他和郎沐真正认识的时间也不长，但他就是相信他，觉得这就是一个会跟自己过一辈子并绝不会背叛自己的人。

哪怕将来他们因为某些原因分手，他家阿沐也绝不会伤害他，反倒有可能伤害自己。

商非凡想到郎沐的前两世，心里忍不住一阵刺痛，下意识伸手抱住男人。

这次，他绝不会再错过这个人，更不会放过，绝不会！

郎沐愣，这家伙好端端地怎么突然抱住他？还抱得这么紧。

商非凡对他家大宝贝的身体线条太了解了，贴近后马上就察觉出不对。

“你口袋里是什么？”商非凡手伸进郎沐口袋，掏出一个小玩意。

等看清手上捏着的是什么时，顿时嫌弃地想要扔掉。

郎沐一把接过：“先回姥爷那边，让雷米尔和他们见一面，然后我们就送雷米尔离开王城。”

商非凡不爽：“管那家伙干嘛？”

郎沐：“就算是为了我姥爷和姥姥？”

商非凡这才不说话，牵起郎沐的手，双双把家还。

郎侦老伯爵也听到了爆炸声，这会儿正在安排管家去探听事情详细。

“多事之夏啊。”老伯爵叹息。

老夫人走出来，边走边穿外套。

老伯爵看到老妻，立刻把人搂入怀里：“你怎么起来了？”

“那么大的爆炸声，还有震动，我就是聋子也能感觉到。”老夫人仰头看天，“烧得很厉害。不知道是哪家？”

老伯爵：“看方向不是墨文伯爵府就是大都督府，不过大都督府应该更远一些。”

老夫人转头：“阿沐和阿瑞斯呢？他们出去了？”

老伯爵也不清楚，只知道他醒来就没看到那两小崽子。

两老正唠叨两个小的，两个小的就手牵手地回来了。

老伯爵只觉得没眼看！

老夫人则微微笑。她就希望能多一点人来宠爱她的小阿沐。

“那爆炸和你们有关？炸的谁家？”老伯爵冲着两人就问。

“墨文伯爵府。”商非凡堂而皇之地点头，他就是想到两老会问他，这才跟郎沐说等回来详说。

老伯爵呵一声，没有半点责怪，只问：“你们发现了什么？”

老夫人拍拍老伴的手臂：“我们进去说，在外面站着说像什么样。”

一家四口转移到客厅中。

武管家的妻子送来茶点。

郎沐和她道谢。

武厨娘笑眯眯又带着点慈爱地摸了摸郎沐的头。

郎沐有点不好意思，他都这么大人了。

武厨娘对两老点点头，又看了看郎沐，一脸笑容地离开客厅。

老夫人低声跟两小说：“她是阿武的妻子阿厨，天生不能发出声音，但她也只是嘴巴不能说，心里可明亮，她和阿武成婚后就在家里做厨娘，管着家里进口的所有东西。她也是照顾你母亲长大的人，还给你母亲喂过好几个月的奶。你母亲可能吃了！”

郎沐明白了，这就是心腹中的心腹，武管家夫妻就是两老最信任的人。

老夫人没说武厨娘对雷米尔不太亲近，一开始看雷米尔还小，就很照顾疼爱，但没几年就远离了雷米尔身边。

老夫人当时也没想太多，只以为是虎王派来照顾雷米尔的女家庭教师有点排斥其他人接近雷米尔。久而久之，原本照顾雷米尔的郎家人都和雷米尔疏远了。

但武厨娘显然很喜欢郎沐，明明她还是第一次见到阿沐，竟然就伸手摸他脑袋。

老夫人也为此在心中啧啧称奇。猜想心如明镜的阿厨可能也有所感觉吧。

老伯爵跟外孙补充：“你母亲去世后，我和你姥姥就不怎么想再管事情，把家里的房屋、铺子、商队商行、田地、仆人，全都做了安排。

如今整个府里，加上护卫就只有二十人不到。都是当年跟着我和你姥姥的老人，他们也都早已把府里当做家，在这里生儿育女。

以后我们一家离开，必然也是要带上他们的。我已经问过他们，他们都要跟着我们一起走。”

郎沐奇怪：“可我好像没有在家里看到年轻兽人？”

老夫人听到郎沐用了家这个字眼，笑得眼睛弯弯：“这座伯爵府就跟我们一样都老了。当年雷米尔被送来时，还热闹过一阵子，等到他年满十六岁闹着要搬出去住后，这里就又变得死水一潭，不适合年轻人留下来。我就做主，正好你姥爷还有些关系，就把那些年轻人都安排走了。”

郎沐了然：“那我们走的时候，那些年轻人也会跟着我们离开吗？”

老伯爵摇头：“看情况，应该不是全部，但也有一部分会跟着我们一起走。反正我们不勉强，想留就留下来，想走就一起走。”

“好了，家里的事以后慢慢说。你们先说说墨文伯爵府是怎么回事？”

郎沐看向商非凡。

商非凡就先开口，两人互相补充，把他们在墨文伯爵府的发现以及做的事情都说了一遍。

“……那骨门后面就是邪神祭坛，祭坛下面埋葬了上千具尸骨。看尸体的腐烂程度，这种活人祭祀应该已经进行了很长时间。祭坛上的邪神雕像也是我至今为止发现的能量最庞大的一具。”

商非凡没具体说他怎么处理邪神雕像，只让两老放心，说他已经把邪神雕像处理得干干净净，绝不会有后遗症留下。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 183: The Fall of Count Moven (Part 1)

"Ah-Mu!" Shang Feifan slipped into the agreed rendezvous point.

Lang Mu was looking up at the debris and fire being blasted into the sky. Seeing Shang Feifan materialize out of the shadows, he couldn't help asking in surprise, "What did you do?"

Shang Feifan smiled smugly. "Nothing much. Just blew up an underground altar and emptied out Count Moven's treasury by the way."

Lang Mu's mouth parted slightly.

Finding this adorable, Shang Feifan leaned in and gave him a kiss.

Lang Mu quickly shut his lips tight.

Shang Feifan playfully bit down on his lower lip.

Lang Mu flushed and gave a dry cough. "Ahem, let's talk about serious business."

Shang Feifan said with dissatisfaction, "We're done talking."

Lang Mu pressed against Shang Feifan's approaching face. "No... what's with that underground altar? And in such a short amount of time, how on earth did you find Count Moven's treasury?"

"I'll tell you all the details when we get back. Here, take this." Shang Feifan produced a spatial bracelet and shoved it into Lang Mu's hand.

Lang Mu's expression grew complicated as he took the bracelet; without asking, he already knew what was packed inside.

Shang Feifan said, "You shouldn't put all your eggs in one basket. You take half, and I take half. No matter whose storage space gets compromised, the other person will still have enough to fall back on."

Hearing Shang Feifan put it this way, it was naturally hard for Lang Mu to refuse, so he could only accept it.

Shang Feifan was thrilled. They were a family, after all; why be so polite? Wasn't what belonged to him also his Ah-Mu's?

However, Ah-Mu was still somewhat reserved around him for now, and certainly wouldn't take charge of his affairs yet. They would take this step by step. When the day came that his Ah-Mu could naturally take over managing their finances and hold all their assets in his hands, they would truly become a family.

Shang Feifan didn't consider himself someone who trusted others easily. He figured that if he hadn't met Lang Mu and had instead just married someone who was moderately pleasant to look at, the most he would do would be to hand over a superficial salary card, but he would never entrust his entire fortune to the other person to manage, let alone share all his deepest secrets.

Strangely enough, the time he had genuinely known Lang Mu wasn't very long, but he simply trusted him. He felt this was a person who would walk through life with him until the end and would never betray him.

Even if they were to break up for some reason in the future, his Ah-Mu would never hurt him, and would more likely end up hurting himself instead.

Thinking of Lang Mu's past two lives, a sharp pain stabbed at Shang Feifan's heart, and he subconsciously reached out to pull the man into his embrace.

This time, he would never miss out on this person again, nor would he let him go—absolutely not!

Lang Mu was stunned. Why on earth did this guy suddenly hug him? And so tightly, too.

Shang Feifan was intimately familiar with his big baby's physical contours, and the moment they pressed close, he immediately sensed something amiss.

"What's in your pocket?" Shang Feifan slid his hand into Lang Mu's pocket and fished out a small gadget.

When he saw clearly what he was pinching between his fingers, he immediately wanted to throw it away with a look of disgust.

Lang Mu snatched it back. "Let's head back to Grandfather's place first, let Remiel meet them, and then we'll send Remiel away from the Royal City."

Shang Feifan muttered unhappily, "Why bother with that guy?"

Lang Mu asked, "Even if it's for my grandfather and grandmother?"

Only then did Shang Feifan quiet down. He took Lang Mu's hand, and the two of them headed home together.

Old Count Langzhen had also heard the explosion and was currently instructing the butler to investigate the details.

"A turbulent summer," the old count sighed.

The old marchioness walked out, putting on her coat as she moved.

Seeing his wife, the old count immediately pulled her into his arms. "Why did you get up?"

"With an explosion and tremor like that, I'd notice even if I were deaf." The old marchioness looked up at the sky. "It's burning fiercely. I wonder whose place it is?"

The old count mused, "Judging by the direction, it's either Count Moven's estate or the Grand Governor's Manor, though the Grand Governor's Manor should be a bit further away."

The old marchioness turned her head. "Where are Ah-Mu and Ares? Did they go out?"

The old count wasn't sure either; he only knew he hadn't seen the two little rascals since he woke up.

Just as the two elders were grumbling about the youngsters, the two youngsters came back hand-in-hand.

The old count simply couldn't bear to watch!

The old marchioness, however, smiled faintly. She just hoped that more people would dote on her little Ah-Mu.

"Was that explosion related to you two? Whose place did you blow up?" The old count demanded bluntly.

"Count Moven's estate," Shang Feifan answered brazenly. He had figured the two elders would ask, which was why he told Lang Mu they would discuss the details upon their return.

The old count let out a "Hmph," showing not an ounce of blame, and only asked, "What did you discover?"

The old marchioness patted her companion's arm. "Let's go inside to talk. Standing out here like this looks ridiculous."

The family of four relocated to the living room.

Steward Wu's wife brought in tea and pastries.

Lang Mu thanked her.

Chef Wu beamed with a touch of maternal affection as she gently patted Lang Mu on the head.

Lang Mu felt a little self-conscious; he was quite a grown man now.

Chef Wu nodded to the two elders, glanced at Lang Mu again, and left the living room with a beaming smile.

The old marchioness lowered her voice and told the two youngsters, "She is Ah-Wu's wife, Ah-Chef. She was born mute, but while she can't speak with her mouth, her heart is as clear as a mirror. After she and Ah-Wu got married, she became the estate's cook and manages everything imported into the household. She's also the one who raised your mother and even breastfed her for several months. Your mother could really eat!"

Lang Mu understood. This was a confidante among confidantes; the Steward Wu couple were the people the two elders trusted most.

The old marchioness didn't mention that Chef Wu wasn't particularly close to Remiel. When Remiel was young, Chef Wu had been very caring and affectionate toward him, but within a few years, she had distanced herself from him.

At the time, the old marchioness hadn't thought much of it, simply assuming that the female governess sent by the Tiger King to look after Remiel was somewhat averse to others getting close to him. As time went on, the members of the Lang family who had originally looked after Remiel gradually grew distant from Remiel.

Yet Chef Wu clearly liked Lang Mu. Even though it was her very first time seeing Ah-Mu, she had actually reached out to pat his head.

The old marchioness inwardly marveled at this, guessing that Ah-Chef, with her crystal-clear heart, must have sensed something as well.

The old count added for his grandson, "After your mother passed away, your grandmother and I didn't feel like managing affairs anymore, so we made arrangements for all the houses, shops, merchant caravans, fields, and servants in the estate.

Today, including the guards, there are fewer than twenty people left in the entire manor. They are all the old retainers who followed your grandmother and me back then, and they have long since regarded this estate as their home, growing up and having children here.

When our family leaves in the future, we will certainly take them with us. I've already asked them, and they all want to come along."

Lang Mu wondered, "But it seems I haven't seen any young beastmen around the house?"

Hearing Lang Mu use the word "home," the old marchioness smiled, her eyes curving into crescents. "This earldom has grown old, just like us. Back when Remiel was sent here, it was lively for a while, but once he turned sixteen and insisted on moving out to live on his own, the place became stagnant again—no place for young people to stay. So I made the executive decision, taking advantage of your grandfather's remaining connections, to arrange for all those young people to be transferred elsewhere."

Lang Mu understood. "Then when we leave, will those young people follow us too?"

The old count shook his head. "It depends on the situation. Probably not all of them, but a portion will come with us. In any case, we won't force anyone. Those who want to stay can stay, and those who want to leave will go together."

"Alright, we can talk about family matters slowly later. Tell us what's going on with Count Moven's estate first."

Lang Mu looked at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan spoke up first, and the two of them supplemented each other, recounting their discoveries and actions at Count Moven's estate.

"...Behind that bone gate is an evil god altar, with over a thousand corpses buried beneath it. Judging by the degree of decomposition, this kind of human sacrifice must have been going on for a very long time. The evil god statue on the altar also possesses the most massive concentration of energy I've encountered so far."

Shang Feifan didn't specify how he handled the evil god statue, simply assuring the two elders that he had dealt with it completely, leaving no lingering aftereffects.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第183章 墨文伯爵府完 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
因为那具雕像富含的邪神能量，他的恶咒等级竟然直接升了一级，可见某诅咒大神有多满意这份祭品。

老板吃肉他喝汤，他把那祭坛内浓郁至极的怨气全都给吸收了。

等到他把怨气吸收完，冥冥中就好像有什么在指引他。

一面墙壁裂开，露出了墨文家族藏在祭坛后面的家族藏宝库。

藏宝库放在邪神祭坛的后面，那真的是再安全不过。就算虎王前来，也没办法顺利通过邪神祭坛，从而拿到墨文伯爵府的家族宝藏。

但打死墨文家族也没有想到，有人竟然能不受邪神力量影响，更能直接接触邪神雕像，还能把含有一丝邪神力量的邪神雕像给献祭掉，更能在浓厚的怨气中也没有失去理智发疯。

要知道以前进入这个地下祭坛的人，如果没有邪神力量的保护，可是进一个疯一个，无一例外。

“另外那个地下祭坛里还有几个受到虫毒影响变异的怪物，它们被拴在炼金锁链上，看起来像是守护祭坛的守卫，实际上应该是在接受邪神力量的浸淫。”

商非凡神色微微凝重：“我怀疑那些邪神阴影者就是这么被制造出来的。”

老伯爵夫妻骇然：“墨文伯爵竟然在王城制造邪神阴影者？！他想毁掉整座王城吗？”

商非凡摊手：“那就不知道了。可能邪神阴影者对于他们来说就是国家级的毁灭武器，制造出来，不管是用于毁灭，还是用于威慑，都很好用。”

老伯爵不可置信：“真没想到……墨文家的野心竟然这么大，不是，他们怎么会和邪神信徒勾结？明明墨文家族的地位已经很高。”

商非凡：“有时候地位并不代表一切，何况墨文也只是伯爵，不是国王。且只是成为王者又算什么？一国之王寿命最多也就三百年，一个人的力量也无法抗衡上千人。

可如果效忠邪神，邪神答应赐他们长寿，并给予他们超凡的力量，比如更厉害的血脉天赋，比如兽身巨大化。甚而告诉他们，兽人大陆即将毁灭，只有信仰邪神才能得到救赎。试问有多少人会不动心？”

老伯爵沉默。

老夫人叹息。

郎沐忽然说：“也许老丹顿就是这么被邪神信徒蛊惑的。”

“老丹顿又是怎么回事？”不等郎沐回答，老伯爵就摆手道：“算了，这个也不急，等以后你们再慢慢跟我们说。继续说墨文伯爵府。”

老伯爵一顿：“我就不问阿瑞斯是怎么抵抗邪神力量侵袭的，我就问阿瑞斯你在那地下祭坛里又发现了什么？”

只看商非凡的表情，老伯爵就知道他的话没说完。

商非凡果然接着说道：“除了那几个疑似要被转化为邪神阴影者的虫毒变异者。我还在那祭坛上发现了一只虫子。”

“那虫子是一只母虫，我发现它的时候，它刚下过虫卵，正在啃吃活人来补充体力。”

老俩口和郎沐一起露出震惊神色。

老伯爵更是被刺激地站起来：“虫母？！”

“不是虫母，只是一只母虫。”商非凡纠正，他很确定这一点。

他甚至猜到了墨文伯爵之前捧着的小盒子里装的是什么，应该就是虫卵，还是比较珍稀宝贵的虫卵。

“这个墨文真的是疯了！不但跟邪神信徒有勾结，竟然还勾结上了虫族！”老伯爵气坏了，团团转了两圈：“不行，我得把这事告诉虎王。这事他必须管！”

郎沐连忙拉住老爷子。

商非凡嘿嘿笑：“姥爷，这事不用您操心。这么大的事，自然会有人告诉虎王。”

老伯爵看到商非凡那笃定的神情，心情也逐渐平静下来，重新坐回椅子中。

“总之，不管是邪神祭坛、正在转变中的邪神阴影者，还是母虫，现在都已经消失，我保证它们再也不可能跳出来为祸王城。如果有跳出来的，那绝不是墨文伯爵府所有。”

商非凡说到最后还开了一个小玩笑。

可惜两老都不太捧场，没笑出来，还有点忧心忡忡。

如果不是两小今天跟他们说了在墨文伯爵府的发现，他们都不知道虎国高层竟然已经被邪神信徒侵染得这么深。

“不过那片土地还是被污染了，为了不让邪神信徒继续利用，我就做了点手脚，炸一炸，也算消毒。”

商非凡说着对郎沐眨眨眼。

郎沐：这家伙肯定有所隐瞒。

商非凡确实隐瞒了一点点，他原本并没有想搞出一场大爆炸，这太高调，不符合他们今晚偷偷摸摸的行为。

他就只是利用那里的上千具尸骨做祭品，搞了一场大型诅咒。

诅咒凡是参与迫害这些受害人的直接凶手与间接凶手全都受到以牙还牙以眼还眼的诅咒。

可能是凝聚了上千怨魂的力量太过庞大，他的诅咒阵刚一发动就发生了巨大爆炸，以那座邪神祭坛为中心，把半个墨文伯爵府给炸上了天。

“从墨文伯爵府出来时，我好像看到了墨文伯爵，他……死得有点惨。相信我，他绝不是被炸死，更像是被人凌虐至死。”

商非凡摊手，一副“我什么都不知道、墨文伯爵之死和我毫无干系”的无辜样子。

两老：“……”我信你的鬼！

商非凡又像一个神棍一样幽幽说：“墨文伯爵的死应该只是一个开始，明天也许我们会在王城中听到更多人的死讯。”

“哈！”老伯爵忽然大笑：“很好，就让虎王那个混蛋焦头烂额去吧！”

老夫人摇头，自从知道虎王干了什么事后，老头子就看虎王极度不顺眼，恨不得虎王一天被人打三顿才好，没事还要诅咒虎王两句。

商非凡说完，轮到郎沐。

郎沐简单，就说他们发现了扮作老妇的安妮塔夫人，跟踪安妮塔到了墨文伯爵府，然后他和商非凡分头跟踪，随后他发现雷米尔被墨文家软禁。

“……他们想逼迫雷米尔签订灵魂契约，答应奉真神教为国教，立邪神厄穆克拉索为真神。雷米尔不愿意，安妮塔夫人竟然亲自劝说雷米尔同意。”

“什么？！”老夫人震惊，更愤怒：“安妮塔在做什么？雷米尔可是她的亲生骨肉！她不帮雷米尔也就算了，竟然还逼迫雷米尔签订那样的契约，还是灵魂契约？她想干什么，让雷米尔去当邪神走狗吗？”

老伯爵冷哼：“何止。安妮塔根本就是想要把整个虎国都献祭给邪神！”

“这个女人已经疯了，她已经不是为了复仇，她根本就是……”老夫人都不知道要怎么形容。

“自私。”商非凡冷漠地吐出。

“从我的调查来看，安妮塔应该在很小的时候就得到了石耳，她甚至知道要把石耳藏在自己身体中。她母亲琼夫人才是真冤枉，琼夫人应该是真不记得自己的嫁妆中有石耳。”

商非凡略略停顿：“当王后的人去询问林格莱特家族时，不可能不问一问琼夫人的两个女儿。王后连自己的堂妹和堂妹夫都一起抓了，还会在乎多抓两个小女孩吗？”

郎沐：“你是说？”
chunks.englishText:
Because the statue was brimming with evil god energy, his malignant curse tier had actually leveled up directly, which showed just how satisfied a certain cursed deity was with this offering.

The boss ate the meat while he drank the soup; he absorbed every last shred of the immensely rich resentment within that altar.

Once he finished absorbing the resentment, it felt as though some unseen force was guiding him.

A section of the wall cracked open, revealing the Moven family treasury hidden behind the altar.

With the treasury tucked away behind an evil god altar, it couldn't possibly have been safer. Even if the Tiger King himself were to show up, he wouldn't be able to safely bypass the evil god altar to claim Count Moven's family fortune.

Yet, in their wildest dreams, the Moven family never imagined that someone could be immune to the evil god's influence, directly touch the evil god statue, sacrifice a statue containing traces of evil god power, and do it all without losing their mind or going crazy amid the thick waves of resentment.

One had to know that anyone who had entered this underground altar in the past—barring protection from evil god power—would go mad one by one, without exception.

"In addition, there were several mutated monsters tainted by insect venom down in that underground altar. They were tethered by alchemical chains; they looked like temple guards, but in reality, they were likely being steeped in the power of the evil god."

Shang Feifan's expression grew slightly solemn. "I suspect that's how those Evil God Shadows are manufactured."

The old count and his wife were horrified. "Count Moven is actually manufacturing Evil God Shadows in the Royal City?! Does he want to destroy the entire Royal City?"

Shang Feifan spread his hands. "Well, who knows? Perhaps to them, Evil God Shadows are weapons of mass destruction on a national scale. Once produced, they're terribly useful whether used for annihilation or deterrence."

The old count found it hard to believe. "I never would have thought... The Moven family's ambitions run this deep. No, wait, how on earth did they hook up with evil god cultists? Clearly, Count Moven's status was already high enough."

Shang Feifan replied, "Sometimes status doesn't mean everything. Besides, Moven was only a count, not the king. And what does merely becoming a monarch amount to anyway? A king's lifespan is capped at three hundred years at most, and a single person's strength cannot contend against a thousand.

Yet if one pledges allegiance to an evil god, the evil god promises them longevity and grants them extraordinary power—such as more formidable bloodline traits, or the ability to enlarge their beast forms. They are even told that the Beastman Continent is facing destruction and that only by believing in the evil god can they find salvation. Ask yourself, how many people wouldn't be tempted?"

The old count fell silent.

The old marchioness sighed.

Lang Mu suddenly spoke up, "Perhaps old Denton was seduced by the evil god cultists in the exact same way."

"What's this about old Denton?" Without waiting for Lang Mu to answer, the old count waved a hand. "Forget it, there's no rush for that. You can slowly tell us about it later. Let's get back to Count Moven's estate."

The old count paused. "I won't ask how Ares resisted the intrusion of the evil god's power; I only want to know what else you found down in that underground altar, Ares."

Just by looking at Shang Feifan's expression, the old count knew he hadn't finished his story.

True to form, Shang Feifan continued, "Aside from those insect-venom mutants who appeared to be undergoing conversion into Evil God Shadows, I also found an insect on that altar."

"That insect was a mother bug. When I found it, it had just laid a batch of eggs and was feeding on living humans to replenish its stamina."

The elderly couple and Lang Mu all wore expressions of shock.

The old count was so stimulated he bolted to his feet. "An insect mother?!"

"Not the Mother of Insects, just a regular mother bug," Shang Feifan corrected, and he was quite certain of this.

He even guessed what was inside the small box Count Moven had been clutching earlier: it must have been insect eggs, and rather rare, precious ones at that.

"This Moven bastard has truly lost his mind! Not only is he colluding with evil god cultists, he's actually hooked up with the Zerg!" The old count was furious, pacing around twice in a circle. "No, I have to tell the Tiger King about this. He has to handle it!"

Lang Mu quickly pulled the old man back.

Shang Feifan chuckled. "Grandfather, you don't need to worry yourself over this. With a matter this big, naturally someone else will inform the Tiger King."

Seeing Shang Feifan's resolute expression, the old count gradually calmed down and settled back into his chair.

"In short, whether it's the evil god altar, the transitioning Evil God Shadows, or the mother bug, they've all vanished now. I guarantee they'll never pop up to plague the Royal City again. If any do pop up, it certainly won't have anything to do with Count Moven's estate."

Shang Feifan even cracked a little joke at the end.

Unfortunately, neither of the elders appreciated the humor; they didn't laugh and instead looked rather worried.

If these two youngsters hadn't shared their discoveries at Count Moven's estate today, they would have had no idea that the upper echelons of the Tiger Kingdom had already been corrupted by evil god cultists to such a profound degree.

"However, that piece of land was still contaminated. To prevent evil god cultists from continuing to exploit it, I pulled a few tricks—blew it up. Consider it disinfection."

As he spoke, Shang Feifan winked at Lang Mu.

Lang Mu thought: This guy is definitely keeping something from them.

Shang Feifan was indeed hiding a tiny detail. He hadn't originally intended to pull off a massive explosion; that was far too high-profile and didn't fit their stealthy operations for tonight.

He had simply utilized the over a thousand corpses there as sacrifices to trigger a large-scale curse.

He cursed all direct and indirect perpetrators who had taken part in persecuting those victims, visiting upon them a curse of an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.

Perhaps the gathered power of over a thousand resentful souls was simply too immense: the moment his curse formation activated, a colossal explosion erupted, using the evil god altar as its epicenter and blowing half of Count Moven's estate straight into the sky.

"When we came out of Count Moven's estate, I seemed to catch a glimpse of Count Moven. He... died rather miserably. Trust me, he definitely wasn't blown to death; it looked much more like he had been tortured to death by someone."

Shang Feifan spread his hands with an innocent air that screamed, *I know nothing, and Count Moven's death has nothing to do with me.*

The two elders: "..." We believe your ghost stories!

Like a charlatan mystic, Shang Feifan continued in an ethereal voice, "Count Moven's death should only be the beginning. Tomorrow, we might hear the news of even more deaths echoing through the Royal City."

"Ha!" The old count suddenly burst into laughter. "Splendid! Let that bastard of a Tiger King sweat blood over this!"

The old marchioness shook her head. Ever since she learned what the Tiger King had been up to, the old man had looked upon him with extreme disdain, wishing the Tiger King would get beaten three times a day and taking every free moment to curse him twice.

With Shang Feifan finished, it was Lang Mu's turn.

Lang Mu's account was simple: they discovered Madame Anita disguised as an old woman, trailed her to Count Moven's estate, split up to track her, and subsequently found Remiel placed under house arrest by the Moven family.

"...They wanted to force Remiel into signing a soul pact, agreeing to establish the True God Cult as the state religion and worshiping the evil god Emu-Craso as the True God. When Remiel refused, Madame Anita actually tried to personally persuade him to agree."

"What?!" The old marchioness was shocked, and then enraged. "What is Anita doing? Remiel is her own flesh and blood! If she wouldn't help Remiel, fine, but she's actually forcing him to sign a contract like that—a soul pact, no less? What is she trying to accomplish, turning Remiel into a running dog for an evil god?"

The old count let out a cold snort. "More than that. Anita is dead set on sacrificing the entire Tiger Kingdom to the evil god!"

"This woman has lost her mind. She isn't doing this for revenge anymore; she's simply..." The old marchioness couldn't even find the words to describe it.

"Selfish," Shang Feifan spat out coldly.

"From my investigation, Anita must have obtained the stone ear when she was very young, and she even knew to conceal it inside her body. Her mother, Lady Qiong, was truly wronged; Lady Qiong likely had genuinely forgotten that the stone ear was among her dowry items."

Shang Feifan paused slightly. "When people sent by the Queen went to inquire at the Lingleight family, it's impossible they didn't question Lady Qiong's two daughters. Since the Queen even arrested her own cousin and cousin-in-law together, would she care about grabbing two extra little girls?"

Lang Mu asked, "You mean...?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第183章 墨文伯爵府完 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡：“我在说安妮塔那时极有可能知道王后是为了什么抓走她的父母，但她为了保下石耳，假装什么都不知道。而大人通常都不会把小孩放在眼里，虽然安妮塔那时已经十六岁，但这个年龄也就是一个少女。

王后的人以为稍微吓吓两个没见过世面的富家小姐，就能让她们什么都说出来。可有些人，哪怕年龄小也能把大人耍得团团转。

这也能解释为什么安妮塔能在林格莱特家族要求她们嫁人时能及时带着妹妹从家里逃出去，还能带走一定财物。

因为她知道王后为什么要迫害她们一家，也知道王后为了找到石耳的蛛丝马迹，一定会派人盯着她们姐妹，至少短时间内不会放过她们。”

郎沐：逻辑通顺。

老伯爵也认可这份推理，不过他还有一个问题：“安妮塔又是怎么知道石耳的重要？”

商非凡：“按照王后所说，琼夫人小时候就表现得对石耳很有兴趣，小小年纪就跟其父亲闹着想要获得石耳。这也是琼夫人的父亲为什么会把石耳当做陪嫁物品送给女儿的原因。

再看琼夫人的父亲也是同样受到石耳吸引，才会在上一代丹顿侯爵让子女到宝库中挑选宝物时，选择了毫不起眼的石耳。”

老伯爵恍然：“就是说安妮塔祖父这一支都遗传了某种特质，能感知到石耳隐藏的力量，从而被石耳吸引？”

商非凡：“应该是。类如自然亲和。”

“但石耳最终还是选择了阿沐。”老伯爵看向外孙，有很多骄傲，也有些许担忧：“这是不是说明阿沐的自然亲和力比安妮塔祖父那一支更强得多？”

“也许自然之神更喜欢阿沐吧。”商非凡笑眯眯地握住郎沐的手。

郎沐：“……”

老伯爵得意：“也是。克莱门特家的心之果也是，主动钻入我们阿沐的身体里。对了，这个心之果会不会也是自然之神力量的一部分？”

“很有可能。”商非凡说出这句话时忽然想到一个问题。

之前只要发现自然之神雕像的缺失部分，系统都会追着他收回那些缺失部分。

可如果心之果也是雕像缺失的一部分，为什么系统会毫无反应？包括寻宝罗盘也没有特别反应。

郎沐也恰在此时看向商非凡，显然他也想到了这一点。

商非凡记下这个问题，打算等会儿呼唤系统问问看。

“安妮塔这么痛恨王后和丹顿家族，甚至恨上虎王和其他无关者，连自己的亲儿子都不在乎。你们说会不会是因为她也在仇恨自己？”老夫人缓缓开口。

“因为就算全世界人都不知道，但她知道，她明明有机会挽救她父母的生命，可她为了留下石耳，假装什么都不知道，就这么等来了自己母亲的死讯和父亲的失踪讯息。”

老夫人叹息：“虽然以王后的狠毒，就算得到石耳也不一定放过琼夫人一家。但作为儿女，就算明知不可为也总是要尝试一番。但安妮塔连尝试都没有尝试。”

“愧疚导致的心理失衡？”郎沐呢喃。

老夫人颔首。

一家四口陷入短暂沉默。

老伯爵冷笑着打破沉寂：“安妮塔当时怎么想怎么做的，以及她现在的想法又是怎样的，已经不重要。重要的是她成年后做出来的事情。她报仇归她报仇，可她不该拿我家的孩子当她的复仇工具，更不该和邪神信徒走到一起，不把其他人的人命当人命。”

“她必须为她做出的事情付出代价！”

眼看老伯爵又被气到的样子，郎沐轻咳，主动提到：“我想姥爷和姥姥一定很想问我们，雷米尔现在怎么样？”

老夫人苦笑。没错，刚才听郎沐提到雷米尔，她就想问那孩子是否已经被迫签订了那个灵魂契约。

郎沐安慰地说：“姥姥，别担心。我已经把雷米尔带出来了。他被安妮塔打击得不轻，已经不想再在王城跟他们搅合，我答应会送他离开王城。您和姥爷想要见见他吗？”

老伯爵脱口说出：“不想。”

老夫人却没有立刻回答。

郎沐看出姥姥的犹豫，起身：“雷米尔就在外面，我喊他进来。你们和他好好聊聊，也许这就是最后一面。有心结，还是解开的好。”

老伯爵气哼哼，但也没说真不见。

郎沐拉起商非凡，走出客厅。

郎沐从口袋里掏出拇指男孩，口中念出魔法口诀，往地上一扔。

拇指男孩刚落地就变回正常大小。

郎沐又解开雷米尔身上的催眠魔法。

雷米尔睁开眼睛，一跃而起：“这是哪……”

雷米尔失声，他认出来了，这里他太熟悉。

“姥爷和姥姥在里面等你。你进去吧，有什么话就赶紧说。说完，我就送你离开。”郎沐抬手示意。

雷米尔张了张嘴巴，最终转身向屋内走去。

两人就站在外面等待。

郎沐也不怕雷米尔临时反水伤害到两老，他虽然没有进去，但屋内有什么动静，他全都听得清清楚楚。

两老也不是弱者，尤其是老伯爵。以雷米尔的能力想要对两老一击必杀就不可能。

“心之果……”两人异口同声。

“你等等。”商非凡开始呼唤系统。

“系统，我就问你，阿沐体内的心之果是不是也是自然之神缺失力量的一部分？”

系统隔了一会儿才回答：【是。】

商非凡：“那为什么你没有催着我收回？”

系统反问：【你会愿意吗？】

商非凡：“……也就是说一旦收回心之果，郎沐就会失去生命？”

系统：【是。】

商非凡：“那你应该知道我听了这话后会有什么反应吧？”

系统：【如果你推迟主线任务，故意不去做主线任务，系统会另外寻找适合的玩家去做主线任务。一旦让其他玩家发现郎沐身体里的心之果，他们可不会手下留情。】

商非凡：“你这是在威胁我？”

系统：【请注意看主线任务的任务内容。】

商非凡迅速翻出主线任务查看。

【……任务完成后，你将得到一个特别奖励——系统将会实现你一个愿望。】

好的，他找到重点了。

“这个愿望可以让郎沐失去心之果也能活下去？”

系统却神神秘秘地：【不要小看自然之神的青睐。兽人身体本来就拥有自愈能力。】

商非凡被气笑：“你们他妈就是在套路我！”

系统给了一点保证：【尽快完成主线任务，获得更多自然之神的青睐，只有当取出心之果也不会影响郎沐生命时，才会要求你回收心之果。】

商非凡怒意稍平，嘀咕：“这还差不多。”

郎沐用眼神询问他。

商非凡舒了口气：“没事了。我们只要找回更多的自然之神缺失力量，你得到更多自然之神的青睐，你的身体自愈能力会大幅度提高，直到你的心脏重新长出来。然后那时候我们再交出心之果。”

郎沐也松了口气。

如果是以前，死也就死了。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan: "I'd wager that back then, Anita most likely knew why the Queen had her parents abducted, but she chose to play dumb to keep the petrified ear. Adults generally don't take children seriously; although Anita was sixteen at the time, that's barely past being a young girl.

The Queen's lackeys probably thought that intimidating two sheltered young ladies from a wealthy family would be enough to make them spill everything. But some people, no matter how young, can run adults in circles.

This also explains why Anita was able to pack up her younger sister and flee their home in a timely manner when the Lingeret family tried to force them into marriage, managing to take a decent amount of wealth with her as well.

Because she knew why the Queen was persecuting her family, and she also knew that in order to find any trace of the petrified ear, the Queen would definitely have people keep tabs on the sisters—meaning she wouldn't let them off the hook, at least not in the short term."

Lang Mu: "The logic holds up."

The old Count also approved of this deduction, but he still had one question: "How did Anita even know the petrified ear was important?"

Shang Feifan: "According to what the Queen said, Madam Qiong showed a great deal of interest in the petrified ear when she was a child. At a very young age, she made a fuss with her father, demanding to have it. That's why Madam Qiong's father gave her the petrified ear as part of her dowry.

And looking at Madam Qiong's father, he must have been similarly drawn to the petrified ear, which is why he chose that utterly unremarkable stone when the previous Marquis of Denton allowed his children to pick treasures from the royal vault."

The old Count had a sudden realization: "You mean Anita's grandfather's branch inherited some kind of trait that allowed them to perceive the hidden power of the petrified ear, drawing them to it?"

Shang Feifan: "It should be. Something like a natural affinity."

"Yet in the end, the petrified ear chose Ah Mu." The old Count looked at his grandson with immense pride, but also a hint of worry: "Does this mean Ah Mu's natural affinity is much stronger than that of Anita's grandfather's line?"

"Perhaps the God of Nature simply prefers Ah Mu." Shang Feifan smiled warmly as he took Lang Mu's hand.

Lang Mu: "..."

The old Count looked smug: "True enough. Just like the Clement family's Heart Fruit, which actively burrowed into our Ah Mu's body. By the way, could this Heart Fruit also be a part of the God of Nature's power?"

"Quite possibly." The moment Shang Feifan said this, a thought suddenly crossed his mind.

Previously, whenever a missing fragment of the God of Nature's statue was discovered, the system would hound him to retrieve it.

If the Heart Fruit was also a missing piece of the statue, why was the system acting completely unresponsive? Even the Treasure-Seeking Compass had shown no special reaction.

At that exact moment, Lang Mu looked over at Shang Feifan, clearly having thought of the same thing.

Shang Feifan filed the question away in his mind, intending to call upon the system and ask in a moment.

"Anita harbors such deep hatred for the Queen and the Denton family, and even resents the Tiger King and other unrelated parties, not caring about her own biological son. Do you suppose it's because she's also hating herself?" The old Countess spoke up slowly.

"Because even if the whole world didn't know, she knew. She clearly had a chance to save her parents' lives, but in order to keep the petrified ear, she feigned ignorance and thus waited for the news of her mother's death and her father's disappearance."

The old Countess sighed: "Given the Queen's ruthlessness, even if she had obtained the petrified ear, she might not have spared Madam Qiong's family. But as a son or daughter, even knowing it's impossible, one must always try. Yet Anita didn't even try."

"A psychological imbalance caused by guilt?" Lang Mu murmured.

The old Countess nodded.

The family of four fell into a brief silence.

The old Count broke the stillness with a cold laugh: "How Anita thought and acted back then, and what her thoughts are now, no longer matters. What matters is what she did after coming of age. Her revenge is her own business, but she had no right to use my family's children as her tools for vengeance, nor should she have walked side by side with the followers of evil gods, treating human lives as dirt."

"She must pay the price for what she has done!"

Seeing that the old Count was getting worked up again, Lang Mu gave a light cough and proactively brought up: "I'm sure Grandpa and Grandma must be dying to ask how Remiel is doing right now."

The old Countess gave a bitter smile. Indeed, just hearing Lang Mu mention Remiel a moment ago, she had been wanting to ask if the boy had already been forced to sign that soul contract.

Lang Mu comforted her, saying: "Grandma, don't worry. I've brought Remiel out. He's been hit hard by Anita's betrayal and no longer wants to be entangled with them in the royal city. I promised to help him leave the royal city. Would you and Grandpa like to see him?"

The old Count blurted out: "No."

The old Countess, however, did not answer immediately.

Sensing his grandmother's hesitation, Lang Mu stood up: "Remiel is right outside; I'll call him in. You two can have a proper chat with him. Perhaps this will be the last time. If there's an emotional knot, it's best to untie it."

The old Count huffed angrily, but he didn't explicitly forbid it.

Lang Mu pulled Shang Feifan up and walked out of the living room.

Lang Mu took Tom Thumb out of his pocket, chanted a magic incantation, and tossed him onto the ground.

The moment Tom Thumb landed, he reverted to his normal size.

Lang Mu then lifted the hypnotic magic on Remiel.

Remiel blinked open his eyes and sprang to his feet: "Where is this..."

Remiel gasped aloud; he recognized this place—he was far too familiar with it.

"Grandpa and Grandma are waiting for you inside. Go on in, and say whatever you need to say. Once you're done, I'll send you away." Lang Mu raised a hand in a gesture of direction.

Remiel opened his mouth, but ultimately turned and walked toward the house.

The two of them stood outside to wait.

Lang Mu wasn't worried that Remiel might suddenly turn hostile and harm the two elders. Although he wasn't going inside, every single movement within the house was crystal clear to his ears.

Moreover, the two elders were no weaklings, especially the old Count. With Remiel's current abilities, a fatal sneak attack on them was an absolute impossibility.

"The Heart Fruit..." The two of them spoke in unison.

"Hold on a second." Shang Feifan began calling out to the system.

"System, let me ask you straight—is the Heart Fruit inside Ah Mu's body also a part of the God of Nature's missing power?"

It took a moment for the system to reply: [Yes.]

Shang Feifan: "Then why haven't you been pushing me to reclaim it?"

The system countered with a question: [Would you be willing?]

Shang Feifan: "...Meaning that once the Heart Fruit is reclaimed, Lang Mu will lose his life?"

System: [Yes.]

Shang Feifan: "Then you must know how I'll react once I hear that?"

System: [If you delay the main quest and intentionally refuse to complete it, the system will find another suitable player to take over the main quest. Once other players discover the Heart Fruit inside Lang Mu's body, they will not show mercy.]

Shang Feifan: "Are you threatening me?"

System: [Please review the description of the main quest.]

Shang Feifan quickly pulled up the main quest to check.

[...Upon completion of the quest, you will receive a special reward—the system will grant you one wish.]

Alright, he found the key point.

"Can this wish allow Lang Mu to survive even without the Heart Fruit?"

The system, however, remained enigmatic: [Do not underestimate the favor of the God of Nature. Orcs inherently possess the power of self-healing.]

Shang Feifan was so angry he laughed: "You bastards are just playing me for a fool!"

The system offered a guarantee: [Complete the main quest as soon as possible to gain more favor from the God of Nature. Only when extracting the Heart Fruit will no longer affect Lang Mu's life will you be required to retrieve it.]

Shang Feifan's anger subsided slightly, and he muttered: "That's more like it."

Lang Mu looked at him with questioning eyes.

Shang Feifan let out a breath: "It's fine. We just need to recover more of the God of Nature's missing power so you can gain greater favor from Him. Your body's self-healing capabilities will increase drastically until your heart grows back entirely. Only then will we hand over the Heart Fruit."

Lang Mu also let out a sigh of relief.

If it were the past, dying would just be dying.

chunks.chineseText:
第184章 赠品

商非凡和郎沐把雷米尔送到了王城外，就返身回去王城。

雷米尔转头最后看了眼王城，深吸一口气，转过身，再无半点留恋地大步向远方走去。

从此，他将真正地走上自己的人生道路。

他不知道未来如何，但此刻他的心灵无比轻松，整个身体都变得轻快起来。

两位老人没说原谅他，但他能看出来两位老人始终担心着他。

老伯爵把他痛骂了一顿。

他很高兴，因为如果老伯爵对他失望透顶的话，恐怕连一个字都不会和他多说。

而且老伯爵更多地是在骂那两个人，说是那两个混蛋把好好一个孩子教坏了，就像家里的老人骂儿女把孙子教坏一样，总之错都是大人的。

老夫人看出他的难受、自卑和懊悔，竟然还愿意伸手把他揽入怀中，就像对小时候的他一样，轻轻拍抚他。

雷米尔当时心情无法用言语描述，他跪在地上趴在老人的膝头哭个不停，不住地说对不起。

知道他要远离虎国，老夫人还担心他盘缠不够，非要塞钱给他。

雷米尔哪好意思要，直说自己这几年存了不少钱。

因为这句话，老夫人就把郎沐他们叫进来，让两人送他去取钱和其他需要的物资，然后再把他安全送离王城。

郎沐竟然同意了。

他就在郎沐和阿瑞斯商的陪伴下，回到他的住所也就是原郎飞的统领府。

他只取了属于他自己的个人财产，原本属于郎家的东西他都没有动。

走时，他把那座府邸的钥匙也交还给郎沐。

这些都比他原先的设想好得多。

他原本以为自己要仓惶逃离王城，不得不像个流浪野人一样在荒野中挣扎求生。

而现在虽然他仍旧需要一个人去远方闯荡，可他至少带上了对于普通兽人来说足够富足过上一生的财产，他本身实力也不算太差。

只要他小心一点，路上找个靠谱一点的商队加入，想来应该可以顺利前往其他国家。

商非凡在回城的路上跟郎沐闲聊：“那小子单单把你拉到一边，塞了什么给你？还扭扭捏捏的。”

郎沐失笑，摊开手心：“就是这个。”

商非凡好奇，抓过来仔细看：“钥匙？郎宅的钥匙？”

郎沐摇头：“不是，他说是他从安妮塔那里摸来的，他也不知道这是什么，但安妮塔似乎很重视。丢了后还找了好一阵子。”

商非凡：“……他没还给安妮塔？”

郎沐：“他说他本来想还回去的，但怕安妮塔骂他，就没敢立刻还。时间久了就忘了，这次回去拿他的存款和私人物品，看到这东西才想起来。”

商非凡：“……熊孩子。”

郎沐笑：“你的鉴定术不错，东西就放在你那儿，你琢磨琢磨，看有什么用。”

“好。”商非凡也没客气，收起那像钥匙一样的金属条，打算等有时间的时候再好好看看。

刚才第一眼看过去，他已经使用了鉴定术，但鉴定结果为空，提示他需要提升鉴定术等级。

“那小子竟然还拥有空间手镯。”商非凡嘀咕。

这段时间，他断断续续卖了不少空间道具出去，但他记得买主中并没有雷米尔这个人。

郎沐笑：“雷米尔怎么也是虎王的儿子。安妮塔想要利用他，也不会亏待他。如果他想要一个空间道具，还是能弄到的。”

“便宜那小子了。”商非凡还是看雷米尔不顺眼，只凭雷米尔当时在王宫喊出的那些话，就足够上他的敌人名单。

郎沐顺毛：“就当给姥爷姥姥面子，你看他们嘴上骂的凶，心里还是很惦记雷米尔的，好歹也养了那么多年。而且雷米尔……也真的不算坏，否则在他知道自己身世后，他完全可以暗害了姥爷姥姥，彻底霸占郎家的一切。或者干脆演戏，用感情哄骗两老，利用姥爷的地位和关系，让郎家为他争夺更多权势地位而摇旗呐喊。

就因为雷米尔是个还算有底线有良知的人，他才会在知道自己的身世后，闹着搬出伯爵府，并逐渐和两老疏远。说到底就是心里愧疚。

同样，雷米尔也就是个还没长大的毛头小子，他在王宫会喊出那些话只不过是……”

郎沐给了商非凡一个“你懂”的眼神。

商非凡撇嘴，他不懂！

“也就是你心软，还能为他找这么多理由。”

“我以前当老师的嘛。各种各样的小孩子见多了。有时候小孩做坏事都不知道自己在做坏事，要么是受到环境影响，要么就是被朋友撺掇。等他们大了，就会后悔自己曾经的所作所为。真正天生坏种的人不算多。”

“二十一岁还叫小孩子？”

“人一百岁也会后悔九十九岁做过的某件事。年龄不代表心理和行为上的成熟度。”

“我看是缺少社会毒打。”

“所以雷米尔才在一夜间长大了不少。”郎沐感叹：“我宁愿从没有接受过社会毒打，宁愿永远天真蠢萌，那表示有人把你保护得好好的。”

商非凡摸下巴：“你这么一说，我都不好把阿呆早早丢出去接受社会考验。”

郎沐想踹他：“阿呆才几岁？”

两人说说笑笑，还去围观了一下墨文伯爵府那边的热闹。

城卫军、治安局，包括虎王都把克莱门特派过来了。

毕竟出事的可是一位伯爵，还是一位地位和实力都不低且有实权在手的伯爵。

更不要说墨文伯爵还在这场爆炸中暴毙。

克莱门特想不到其他词语来形容墨文伯爵的死亡，他看到尸体的一瞬间，脑中闪过的就是“暴毙”这个词。

墨文伯爵死相真的太惨。

偏又看不出与爆炸有半点关系。

要不是克莱门特知道这位伯爵今天白天也在王宫露过脸，他都要以为这位伯爵被人囚禁多日，受过凭多折磨，直到承受不住死亡。

除了墨文伯爵死相凄惨，他的儿子伊克斯墨文情况也好不到哪里去。

虽然伊克斯没有死，但也就剩下一口气，整个人就像是被绑在铜柱上炮烙过一样，一张英俊的脸也变成了厉鬼。

克莱门特想要询问伊克斯，墨文伯爵府发生了什么事，但伊克斯的舌头也烂得差不多，半个字都说不出来。

克莱门特看到伊克斯的眼睛。

伊克斯的眼神非常古怪，就像是要告诉他某个重大秘密，又像是在恐惧以及期待着什么。

克莱门特和城卫军以及治安局的负责人又去找墨文伯爵府其他能担事的人。

他们找到了墨文伯爵夫人，但这位夫人死得更惨，皮肤都没了，就像是被人活活扒皮抽筋还被人放到滚油里熬过。

紧接着，他们去找墨文伯爵府的管家。

这名管家看起来像是被炸碎的砖块砸死，但身上同样有奇怪伤痕。

克莱门特等人找了一圈，越找越觉得这个伯爵府古怪无比。

他们竟然没有找到多少活人，就好像整座伯爵府都受到了某种邪法诅咒，很多人要么死相凄惨，要么就是重病或重伤到只剩下一口气。
