chunks.chineseText:
除此之外，他们遇到了大量虫子。

这些虫子疯狂往伯爵府外涌出。

搞得城卫军和治安局带来的人手不得不先解决这些虫子。

“墨文伯爵府怎么有这么多虫子？”

“这些虫子的种类看起来是不是有点不对？不像是我们常用的虫子。”

“墨文伯爵一家是不是被人诅咒了？”

“什么时候有了这么厉害的诅咒师，竟然一咒就能咒死这么多人？我不是听说诅咒的代价很大吗？”

“你们还记得王后的样子吗？有人说王后就是被人诅咒。”

“嘘，这事莫谈。”

能诅咒王后的人，那得是什么人？

“报告统领，找到一处地牢！”汇报的侍卫神色怪异，欲言又止。

克莱门特：“怎么？那处地牢有异样？”

汇报者：“统领，您去看就知道了。”

克莱门特当即带人前往那处地牢。

城卫军和治安局的负责人听到消息，也带人赶了过去。

几个兽人暗搓搓地躲在墨文伯爵府附近。

“你们都拍到了吗？”

“拍到了，绝对一手资料！放出来保证惊爆眼球！”

“可惜那么多尸骨全都炸没了。”

“能拍到你就偷着乐吧。”

“也不知道给我们传递消息的大佬是谁。”

“烈狐啊。就是那个死要钱的情报贩子帮派。那里面有大佬，似乎总能比别人更快一步得知最新最秘密的消息。我一得到消息，这不就把你们都召唤过来了吗。”

“你们说烈狐帮里面的神秘大佬会不会就是玩家排行榜那个bug？”

“你皇？”

“很有可能不是吗？”

“我反而觉得不会是他。大家不都说你皇那个ID就是游戏开发组员用来测试游戏用的，要么就是狗策划本人的号。否则哪有人的ID一天到晚都是灰色的，还能不断升级？”

“也是。对了，那些NPC大佬好像全都去了同一个地方，我们要不要过去看看？”

“过去！被拍死了也就七十二小时。”

几个兽人再次暗搓搓地溜入墨文伯爵府。

他们本事不小，整座伯爵府都被城卫军的人包围住，他们还能找到缝隙溜进去。

商非凡和郎沐就站在不远处看热闹，他们还看到了武管家。

武管家正在和几个一看就同样是大人物家管事的人说话，大家对着被炸毁的墨文伯爵府指指点点，小声交流着各自掌握的小道消息。

围观的人特别多，要不是此时正是深夜，可能来的人会更多。

天空都飞了不少兽人，在墨文伯爵府上空不住盘旋。

城卫军里自然也有会飞的，飞上去驱赶这些看热闹的家伙。

商非凡低声询问天眼系统。

他让天眼系统盯住了安妮塔。

“阿沐，走，带你去抓安妮塔。”

郎沐：“不再继续留着她钓鱼？”

“该钓的鱼已经差不多都钓出来。安妮塔的作用已经没多少，我们和她的恩怨也该做个了结。”商非凡特别冷漠地说。

“而且安妮塔现在的情况很不妙，如果我们再不过去，我怕某些人可能会反过来处理掉她。”

两人立即离开墨文伯爵府。

王宫。

克莱门特赶回来汇报。

虎王撑着额头。

今天真的是太漫长的一天。

白天发生的种种事情就已经让他焦头烂额，没想到晚上也不安生。

“禀告陛下，出事的是墨文伯爵府。”克莱门特干脆利落地说出答案。

虎王在心中哼了一声，可惜出事的不是大都督府。

今天狮域和他打得旗鼓相当，让他很没面子。

不过虎王也不是真的希望大都督出事，大都督虽然对他不客气，但同样也是保王党，而且一心为虎国，是虎国真正的中流砥柱。

对虎王来说，伯爵死上几个都无所谓，但大都督是真的不能出事。

“详细说说，这家不是一向低调安稳的吗？怎么一闹就闹出这么大的事情？”

克莱门特就把他看到的内容一五一十全都告知虎王。

“不知道爆炸原因？墨文伯爵和他夫人全都死了，他们的儿子伊克斯墨文也只剩下一口气？”虎王简直怀疑自己的耳朵。

这简直就是被灭了满门。

死的还是大贵族，这在虎国绝对是头等大事。

“我记得墨文伯爵还有一个嫁出去的女儿吧？”

“对。墨文小姐嫁给了切斯特大公的一个孙子，两人在切斯特大公的领地迪安要塞生活。就算墨文小姐听到消息，再赶过来也要一个月的时间。”

“伊克斯是不是还有一个未婚妻？”

“是。他的未婚妻叫妮娜梅尔文，是旖梦楼交际花多丽丝的妹妹。”

“是她啊。”虎王的神色变得冷淡。

他知道王后抓了多丽丝拷问，到现在人都没放出来。

妮娜梅尔文则自多丽丝被抓后就消失不见，众人都以为这女人是被伊克斯藏了起来。

但克莱门特告诉虎王，他并没有在墨文伯爵府发现妮娜梅尔文，反而在墨文府的地牢中发现了……

“王室成员？”虎王再次怀疑自己的耳朵。

克莱门特点头，神色平淡：“是陛下您的四叔迈尔斯伯爵，据说出门游历的那位。我们发现他时，他的情况很不好，似乎被多次取血。”

“取血？”虎王勃然大怒：“墨文家族是想干什么？！”

克莱门特：“迈尔斯伯爵也不清楚。他说他偶尔发现墨文家族似乎在大量购买黑市里的奴隶，他看中的一个绝色女奴被墨文伯爵府买走，他去找墨文伯爵讨要，又问墨文伯爵买那么多奴隶干什么。

墨文伯爵说是用来开垦田地，嘴上答应会把那女奴交给迈尔斯伯爵，转头就把迈尔斯伯爵骗出来，随后就把他关押在地牢中，且三天两头来取他的血。”

虎王气：“那个蠢货！”

克莱门特给了虎王一点消化怒火的时间，这才继续汇报：“另外，我们在墨文伯爵府的地牢深处发现了一间更秘密的牢房，里面关着的是……安妮丽娜。”

虎王腾地站起，脸色都变了：“你说什么？安妮丽娜那个贱人被关在墨文伯爵府的地牢里？”

克莱门特点头肯定。

“怎么会？安妮丽娜不是王后的人吗？我以为她在王后手里。如果安妮丽娜不是王后的人，王后为什么不说？”虎王想不通。

克莱门特猜测：“也许王后也在等着安妮丽娜把腰带送给她，但今天发生了太多事，王后已经顾不得找到安妮丽娜。也许在王后派人去寻找安妮丽娜时走露了风声，让墨文伯爵先一步抓到了安妮丽娜。”

“那本王的腰带还在她手上没有？”虎王焦急。

克莱门特：“她说她已经把腰带交给墨文伯爵，但墨文伯爵验看后却把她关了起来，还拷问她真的空间腰带在哪里。”

虎王眉头狠狠皱起，他好不容易得到安妮丽娜的消息，还以为马上就能找回他的空间腰带，没想到事情又复杂化了。

“等等。交给？难道安妮丽娜就是墨文伯爵的人？”虎王变色。
chunks.englishText:
Aside from that, they encountered a massive swarm of bugs.

These bugs were frantically pouring out from within the Earl of Bowen’s estate.

This forced the personnel brought by the City Guard and Public Security Bureau to deal with the insects first.

"Why are there so many bugs in Earl Bowen’s estate?"

"Do these species look a bit off? They don't look like the kind we usually see."

"Could the Earl of Bowen's family have been cursed?"

"Since when has there been such a powerful curse-master who could curse so many people to death in a single stroke? Didn't I hear that casting curses comes with a heavy price?"

"Do you all still remember what the Queen looked like? Some people say the Queen was cursed by someone."

"Hush, don't talk about this."

Just what kind of person could manage to curse the Queen?

"Reporting to the Commander, we've found a dungeon!" The reporting guard looked strange, hesitating as if he had more to say.

Clement: "What? Is there something unusual about that dungeon?"

The reporter: "Commander, you'll know once you go and see for yourself."

Clement immediately led his men toward the dungeon.

Upon hearing the news, the heads of the City Guard and the Public Security Bureau also hurried over with their men.

Several beastmen were lurking stealthily near the Earl of Bowen’s estate.

"Did you guys capture it all on video?"

"Got it, absolute first-hand material! Releasing this is guaranteed to blow people's minds!"

"It's a pity all those bones were blown to smithereens."

"You should just count your blessings that you managed to film anything at all."

"I wonder who the big shot was that passed the information along to us."

"The Fiery Foxes. That's that extortionist intelligence broker gang. There's some big shot in there who always seems to get the latest, most secretive intel a step faster than everyone else. As soon as I got the word, didn't I summon all of you over?"

"Do you think the mysterious big shot inside the Fiery Fox gang could be that bug on the player leaderboard?"

"You Emperor?"

"Isn't that highly likely?"

"I actually think it probably isn't him. Didn't everyone say that You Emperor's ID is used by the game development team to test the game, or it's the dog planner's personal account? Otherwise, how could someone's ID be gray all day long while they keep leveling up?"

"True. By the way, those NPC big shots all seem to have headed to the same place. Should we go over and take a look?"

"Go! Even if we get blasted to death, it's only a seventy-two-hour respawn."

The few beastmen once again sneaked stealthily into the Earl of Bowen's estate.

They had no small amount of skill; even though the entire estate was surrounded by the City Guard, they still managed to find a gap and slip inside.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were standing not far away watching the commotion, and they even spotted Steward Wu.

Steward Wu was talking to several people who clearly looked like stewards from other major noble households. Everyone was gesturing and pointing at the blown-up estate, quietly exchanging whatever inside information they had managed to gather.

The number of onlookers was huge; if it weren't the dead of night, there probably would have been even more people coming.

A good number of beastmen were flying in the sky, continuously circling above the Earl of Bowen's estate.

Naturally, there were flying units among the City Guard as well, soaring up to chase away these rubberneckers.

Shang Feifan whispered to the Heavenly Eye System.

He instructed the Heavenly Eye System to keep its gaze locked on Anita.

"Mu, let's go. Time to take you to catch Anita."

Lang Mu: "We're not going to leave her as bait a bit longer?"

"The fish that needed to be hooked have pretty much all been caught. Anita doesn't serve much purpose anymore, and it's about time we settled our score with her," Shang Feifan said with utter indifference.

"Besides, Anita's current situation is looking very bad. If we don't go over now, I'm afraid certain people might turn around and dispose of her themselves."

The two of them immediately left the Earl of Bowen's estate.

The Royal Palace.

Clement hurried back to make his report.

The Tiger King pressed a hand against his forehead.

Today was truly far too long a day.

The various events that had transpired during the day had already left him at his wit's end, and he hadn't expected the night to bring any peace either.

"Reporting to Your Majesty, the incident happened at the Earl of Bowen's estate," Clement stated cleanly and concisely.

The Tiger King let out a hum of displeasure in his heart; what a pity the incident hadn't occurred at the Grand Governor's Manor.

The Lion Territory had fought him to a standstill today, causing him to lose quite a bit of face.

However, the Tiger King didn't truly wish for the Grand Governor to come to harm. Although the Grand Governor showed him no special courtesy, he was likewise a loyalist to the throne, devoted heart and soul to the Tiger Kingdom, and served as a genuine pillar of strength for the nation.

To the Tiger King, a few dead counts didn't matter in the least, but the Grand Governor was someone who absolutely could not fall.

"Give me the details. Hasn't this family always maintained a low profile and kept to themselves? How did they manage to stir up such a massive disaster?"

Clement laid out everything he had witnessed to the Tiger King, point by point.

"You don't know the cause of the explosion? Earl Bowen and his wife are both dead, and their son, Ikes Bowen, is hanging on by a single breath?" The Tiger King almost doubted his own ears.

This was practically the complete annihilation of a family line.

And it was a high-ranking noble family that had perished; this was an absolute top-tier crisis in the Tiger Kingdom.

"I recall that Earl Bowen also has a married daughter, doesn't he?"

"Yes. Miss Bowen is married to a grandson of Grand Duke Chester, and the two live in Dean Fortress within Grand Duke Chester's territory. Even if Miss Bowen hears the news and rushes over, it will take her a full month."

"Does Ikes have a fiancée?"

"He does. His fiancée is Nina Melvyn, the younger sister of Doris, the courtesan from the Dreamy Pavilion."

The Tiger King's expression turned cold. "It's her."

He knew the Queen had seized Doris for interrogation and hadn't released her to this day.

As for Nina Melvyn, she had vanished ever since Doris was captured, and everyone assumed the woman had been hidden away by Ikes.

Yet Clement informed the Tiger King that he had not found Nina Melvyn at the Earl of Bowen's estate; instead, down in the estate's dungeon, he had discovered...

"A member of the royal family?" The Tiger King doubted his ears once again.

Clement nodded, his expression calm: "It is Your Majesty's fourth uncle, Earl Myles, the one who was rumored to have gone out on a distant journey. When we found him, his condition was very poor; it appears blood had been drawn from him repeatedly."

"Blood drawn?" The Tiger King flew into a rage: "What on earth is the Bowen family trying to pull?!"

Clement: "Earl Myles is unclear on that as well. He said he occasionally discovered that the Bowen family seemed to be purchasing a massive number of slaves from the black market. A stunningly beautiful female slave caught his eye and was bought by the Earl of Bowen's estate. When he went to Earl Bowen to demand her, he also asked why the Earl was buying so many slaves.

Earl Bowen claimed they were for reclaiming farmland, verbally promised to hand the female slave over to Earl Myles, and then turned around to lure Earl Myles out under false pretenses, locking him away in the dungeon where he had his blood drawn every three days or so."

The Tiger King fumed: "That idiot!"

Clement gave the Tiger King a moment to digest his anger before continuing his report: "Additionally, deep within the dungeon of the Earl of Bowen's estate, we found an even more covert cell. Imprisoned inside is... Anielina."

The Tiger King jerked to his feet, his complexion changing utterly: "What did you say? That bitch Anielina is locked up in the dungeon of the Earl of Bowen's estate?"

Clement nodded in confirmation.

"How could that be? Wasn't Anielina one of the Queen's people? I thought she was in the Queen's hands. If Anielina wasn't the Queen's person, why didn't the Queen say anything?" The Tiger King couldn't fathom it.

Clement speculated: "Perhaps the Queen was also waiting for Anielina to bring the belt to her, but too many things happened today, and the Queen no longer had the bandwidth to hunt for Anielina. Perhaps wind leaked out when the Queen sent people to look for her, allowing Earl Bowen to seize Anielina a step ahead."

"Is my belt still in her possession or not?" The Tiger King asked anxiously.

Clement: "She claims she already handed the belt over to Earl Bowen, but after inspecting it, Earl Bowen locked her up and interrogated her about where the real spatial belt was."

The Tiger King's brow furrowed deeply. He had finally gotten news of Anielina and thought he would immediately recover his spatial belt, only for things to become complicated all over again.

"Wait. Handed it over? Could it be that Anielina is actually one of Earl Bowen's people?" The Tiger King's expression shifted.

chunks.chineseText:
克莱门特表情不变：“安妮丽娜是这么说的。说她明面上隶属于王后手下，实际上却是墨文伯爵府培养的细作。她还主动招供说墨文伯爵府培养了不少绝色女兽人，专门用来勾引诱惑一些大人物，从他们手中骗取情报或财物。”

“比如您的四叔迈尔斯伯爵发现的那名绝色女奴，就是诱惑他上钩的诱饵。”还有您。

虎王：“……”

色字头上一把刀，虎王这次是真的深切体会到这句话的含义。

他们王室两代人竟然都栽在女兽人身上。

而且这两个女兽人还都是墨文伯爵府培养出来的。

这个墨文伯爵府到底想干什么？

虎王特别特别生气，更想手撕墨文伯爵。

哦，墨文伯爵现在已经嗝了。

“你去亲自审问安妮丽娜，务必要问出腰带下落。”虎王作为失主，自然非常确定安妮丽娜确实换走了他的空间腰带。

克莱门特点头，领命而去。

虎王焦躁地在书房里走来走去。

好像自雷米尔和拉斐尔的身世暴露后，他身边的所有事情都似失去了控制，变得一团糟。

天残谷主特别郁闷。

为什么他好像总是迟了一步？

他来王城，除了想要结交权贵，更有一个目的是想得到虎王的那条空间腰带。

可是二王子却告诉他，那条空间腰带竟然被人替换掉了，如今已经不知去向。

另外玩家那边也让他有点小头疼。

他给玩家发布了好几个任务，希望他们能搅乱王城。

但玩家们似乎并不是人人都对他的任务感兴趣，他们还领取了其他任务，忙的不亦乐乎。

偏偏那些任务属于游戏系统在触发机制下，根据环境和情景自动发布的任务，就是他也无法在第一时间删除。

那么些玩家都已经领了任务在做，如果他临时删除这些任务，肯定会引起玩家不满。

天残谷主还想让玩家帮着寻找空间腰带，奖励就是一个容量为十立方的空间背包。

同样容量的空间道具在阿瑞斯商手上买的话，可是要一万金！

不过玩家能否完成这个任务，也是个未知数。

天残谷主手中的空间道具也不多，他放在杂货铺里的空间背包就是一个噱头加胡萝卜，等到真有玩家凑齐一百金买下这个背包，下次再出现的空间道具就不是这个价了。

总之，空间背包等高档装备就是他用来回收货币的渠道之一。

他给玩家们发钱，再用各种装备把这些发出去的钱收回来，勉强也能达到游戏的货币平衡。

天残谷主开始翻看玩家们正在王城执行的任务，他想从中寻找一些线索。

玩家自己搞出来的八卦报那边似乎总是能得到一些新奇或秘密的消息，也不知道他们哪里来的消息来源。

看到一连串新的任务内容，天残谷主沉默了。

这个墨文伯爵府爆炸又是怎么回事？

还有玩家们竟然发现了盗走虎王空间腰带的安妮丽娜。

最新的触发任务就是查明安妮丽娜为什么会被关在墨文伯爵府的地牢里。

天残谷主揉揉额头，决定去找二王子谈谈。

这么一个小小的虎国王城，怎么会这么复杂？

天残谷主转念一想：复杂好啊，不复杂怎么创造混乱？

他恨不得虎国王城马上就乱起来才好，虎国人过得越凄惨、境况越糟糕，宗教才可能更快速发展并扎根。

结果一看到二王子，二王子张口就对他说：“这里还有第三个魔法师！”

“我感觉到了魔力残留以及魔法波动。”

天残谷主立刻问：“在哪里？”

二王子：“就在墨文伯爵府。”

“你也去了那边？”

“墨文伯爵府附近都是贵族，我也住在不远处，出了这么大的事，怎么可能不过去查看？”

“这么说墨文伯爵府出事和魔法师有关？”天残谷主沉吟，会是谁？

二王子心中有好几个猜想：“当时大家全都分散，谁也不知道其他人落到了什么地方。但我怀疑虎国这边有个出口，导致不止你我，还有更多魔法师落到虎国地界。要么就是虎国这边的空间壁比较薄。”

天残谷主也在怀疑这点，因为他身边几个重要NPC就是魔法师，只是现在无法使用魔法，只能当个铁匠、医师之类。

“你说那个魔法师是谁？还有他为什么能使用魔力？”

“应该和你一样，连带身体和身上的储物道具一起穿越过来，而不是像我一样只能保留灵魂。”二王子苦笑。

天残谷主脸色更加凝重：“能够身穿过来，那最少也是高级魔导师，也许就是法圣本人。”

二王子没说话，他可不想对上一个法圣，尤其对方还有魔晶和魔杖在手。

“如果真是一位法圣，他为什么会对上墨文伯爵府？墨文伯爵府有什么秘密吗？”

“和邪神信徒合作算吗？”二王子到底知道得更多一点。

治安局那边在墨文伯爵府发现了几个奇怪的人，那些人虽然没死，但也只剩下一口气，其中有个人还能说话，嘴里一直在呢喃着邪神厄穆克拉索的名字。

更古怪的是，那个不断呢喃邪神名字的人竟然无火自燃，转眼就烧成了一滩黑灰。

其他几个快要死的家伙看见，竟然跟疯了一样，一起大喊着厄穆克拉索，有人喊不出声音还在喊，有人只能发出气音也要喊，然后这几个人接连都死了，虽然没有化成黑灰，但死状也非常诡异。

他们身体上有很多伤，就像是被凌虐过一样，他们脸上却露出诡异笑容，一双眼睛更睁得大大的，就好像在期待着什么。

天残谷主皱起好看的眉头：“邪神信徒？”

他们对邪神也十分忌惮，能不跟邪神接触就不想接触。

尤其那位预言法圣曾在临死前喊出被欺骗的话。

加上他们这些魔法师虽然很想踏上成神之路，但理智尚存，如果能成为正统神灵最好，邪神之路将是他们最后的选择。

何况谁也不敢保证，如果他们和邪神合作，会不会变成邪神的傀儡。

二王子推测：“邪神信徒可能想要走到台前来了。他们一直都是被打压的、见不得人的存在，他们的神灵也一直被视为邪神。可现在兽人大陆的古神消失，此消彼长下，邪神想要上位也属正常。”

天残谷主笑笑：“邪神正神还不是靠人一张嘴。很多教派在成立之初不也被正统打做邪祟？但只要后期发展得好，邪神也能被塑造为正神甚至是唯一神。相反原本的正神则都会被打成邪祟。”

二王子：“你不会也想要和邪神信徒合作吧？”

天残谷主摇头：“那些邪神信徒很可能看上了虎国这块地盘，任何教派发展总需要一个扎根地。如果让他们在虎国扎下根，他们绝不会允许另一个宗教出现在虎国国土上。”

而他也不可能随便转移出生池，换言之，他也把虎国视为了基本盘，自然不可能拱手让给邪神信徒。

但这也不代表他就必须和邪神信徒对上。
chunks.englishText:
Clement's expression remained unchanged: "That is what Anielina claimed. She said that while she outwardly belonged to the Queen's faction, she was actually a secret agent cultivated by the Earl of Bowen's estate. She also voluntarily confessed that the Earl of Bowen's estate has cultivated numerous stunning female beastmen specifically designed to seduce and lure high-ranking figures, swindling intelligence or wealth from their hands."

"For instance, the stunning female slave discovered by your fourth uncle, Earl Myles, was the bait used to hook him." And you as well.

The Tiger King: "..."

Beauty is a blade hanging over the head; the Tiger King now truly and deeply understood the meaning of those words.

Two generations of their royal family had actually both fallen to female beastmen.

And both of those female beastmen had been cultivated by the Earl of Bowen's estate.

Just what on earth was the Earl of Bowen's estate trying to achieve?

The Tiger King was overwhelmingly furious, wishing nothing more than to tear the Earl of Bowen apart with his bare hands.

Oh, right, Earl of Bowen had already kicked the bucket.

"Go and interrogate Anielina personally. You must extract the whereabouts of the belt." As the owner who had lost the item, the Tiger King was naturally dead certain that Anielina had indeed swapped away his spatial belt.

Clement nodded and left to carry out the order.

The Tiger King paced back and forth restlessly inside the study.

It seemed that ever since the true identities of Remiel and Raphael had been exposed, everything around him had slipped out of control and devolved into an absolute mess.

The Valley Master of Residual Heaven was exceptionally gloomy.

Why did it feel like he was always a step too late?

Aside from wanting to cultivate ties with the nobility upon coming to the Royal City, one of his primary objectives was to acquire that spatial belt belonging to the Tiger King.

Yet the Second Prince had informed him that the spatial belt had actually been swapped out by someone else and its current whereabouts were unknown.

Moreover, the players were giving him a bit of a headache as well.

He had issued several quests to the players, hoping they would stir up chaos in the Royal City.

Yet it seemed not every player was interested in his quests; they had picked up various other tasks and were running around busy as bees.

To make matters worse, those quests belonged to the game system's automated trigger mechanism, which dispatched missions based on the surrounding environment and scenarios; even he couldn't delete them on the fly.

With so many players having already accepted and undertaken those quests, forcibly deleting them now would undoubtedly provoke player discontent.

The Valley Master of Residual Heaven had intended to enlist the players' help in searching for the spatial belt, offering a ten-cubic-meter spatial backpack as a reward.

Buying a spatial item of the exact same capacity from the Aress merchant would cost a full ten thousand gold!

However, whether the players could actually complete this quest remained a total unknown.

The Valley Master didn't have many spatial items on hand to begin with; the spatial backpack he placed in the sundry shop was simply a gimmick combined with a dangling carrot. Once a player actually gathered a hundred gold to buy that backpack, any spatial items appearing after that would definitely not be sold at such a price.

In short, high-end gear like spatial backpacks served as one of his channels for recycling currency.

He doled out money to the players, and then used various pieces of equipment to claw that distributed money back in, barely managing to maintain the game's monetary equilibrium.

The Valley Master of Residual Heaven began flipping through the quests the players were currently executing in the Royal City, hoping to dig up some clues.

The gossip tabloid put together by the players themselves always seemed to unearth novel or secretive intel; heaven only knows where they got their news sources from.

Upon seeing the consecutive string of new quest contents, the Valley Master fell silent.

What on earth was going on with this explosion at the Earl of Bowen's estate?

And the players had actually managed to discover Anielina, the culprit who stole the Tiger King's spatial belt.

The latest triggered quest was to investigate why Anielina had been locked up in the dungeon of the Earl of Bowen's estate.

The Valley Master rubbed his temples and decided to go talk things over with the Second Prince.

How could such a tiny Tiger Kingdom Royal City possibly be this complicated?

A second thought crossed the Valley Master's mind: complexity is a good thing; how else could one manufacture chaos?

He desperately wished the Tiger Kingdom Royal City would immediately plunge into total turmoil. The more miserable the people of the Tiger Kingdom were and the worse off their circumstances, the faster his religion could develop and sink its roots deep.

As a result, the moment he laid eyes on the Second Prince, the prince blurted out: "There's a third magician here!"

"I sensed residual magic power and magical fluctuations."

The Valley Master immediately demanded: "Where?"

The Second Prince: "Right at the Earl of Bowen's estate."

"You went over there too?"

"The area around the Earl of Bowen's estate is filled with nobles, and I happen to live not far away. With such a massive incident breaking out, how could I not go over and check it out?"

"So you're saying the incident at the Earl of Bowen's estate is related to a magician?" The Valley Master mused deeply. Who could it be?

The Second Prince harbored several suspicions in his heart: "At the time, everyone scattered; no one knew where anyone else had landed. But I suspect there is an exit point here in the Tiger Kingdom, causing not just you and me, but even more magicians to tumble into the Tiger Kingdom's territory. Alternatively, the spatial barrier on this side of the Tiger Kingdom is simply much thinner."

The Valley Master was harboring the same suspicion, because several key NPCs around him were magicians as well, only they currently lacked the ability to use magic and could only serve as blacksmiths, physicians, and the like.

"Who do you suppose that magician is? And why is he able to use magic power?"

"He must be just like you, having traversed over with his physical body and storage items intact, rather than retaining only his soul like me," the Second Prince said with a bitter smile.

The Valley Master's expression turned even more solemn: "To be able to cross over with one's physical body, one must be at least a Senior Magus, perhaps even a Saint of Magic himself."

The Second Prince remained silent. He had zero desire to cross paths with a Saint of Magic, especially since the other party possessed magic crystals and a magic staff in hand.

"If it truly is a Saint of Magic, why would he target the Earl of Bowen's estate? Does the Earl of Bowen's estate hold some kind of secret?"

"Does cooperating with followers of the Evil God count?" The Second Prince ultimately knew a bit more.

The Public Security Bureau had discovered several strange individuals at the Earl of Bowen's estate. Though those people weren't dead yet, they were hanging on by a single thread. One of them could still speak, continuously murmuring the name of the Evil God, Emuclaso, in his mouth.

Even weirder was that the individual constantly murmuring the Evil God's name had spontaneously combusted, burning down into a pool of black ash in the blink of an eye.

When the few remaining individuals on the verge of death saw this, they had gone completely mad, shouting "Emuclaso" in unison. Those who couldn't force out a voice kept shouting anyway, while those who could only produce a breathy wheeze forced it out all the same, after which these individuals died one after another. Though they hadn't turned into black ash, their manner of death was bizarre in the extreme.

Their bodies bore numerous wounds, as if they had been brutally tortured, yet strange smiles hung upon their faces, their eyes blown wide open as though eagerly anticipating something.

The Valley Master knitted his handsome brows: "Followers of the Evil God?"

They held deep wariness toward the Evil Gods and preferred to avoid any contact with them whatsoever.

Especially since that prophetic Saint of Magic had screamed out about being deceived right before his death.

Furthermore, while these magicians yearned immensely to tread the path to divinity, they still possessed their sanity. Becoming an orthodox deity was ideal, whereas the path of the Evil God would always be their absolute last resort.

Besides, no one could guarantee whether cooperating with an Evil God would turn them into the Evil God's puppets.

The Second Prince hypothesized: "Followers of the Evil God probably want to step out into the open. They have always been suppressed, hiding in the dark and seeing no light of day, and their deity has always been viewed as an evil god. But now, with the ancient gods of the Beastman Continent vanishing, under these shifting tides, it's only natural for the Evil God to want to claim the throne."

The Valley Master chuckled: "Whether a deity is righteous or evil ultimately depends on one's own spin. Weren't many religious sects branded as heterodox evils by the orthodoxy during their inception? But as long as they develop well in later stages, an Evil God can be shaped into a righteous deity or even the sole true god. Conversely, original righteous gods can all be beaten down into heterodox evils."

The Second Prince: "You surely aren't thinking of cooperating with followers of the Evil God as well?"

The Valley Master shook his head: "Those Evil God followers likely have their eyes set on the territory of the Tiger Kingdom; the development of any religious sect always requires a foothold. If they are allowed to sink their roots into the Tiger Kingdom, they will never permit another religion to exist on Tiger Kingdom soil."

And he had no intention of randomly shifting his spawn point either. In other words, he also viewed the Tiger Kingdom as his foundational base and naturally couldn't hand it over on a silver platter to the Evil God's followers.

However, this didn't mean he had to lock horns with the Evil God's followers head-on, either.

chunks.chineseText:
很多事情都可以谈判，只要利益交换得当。

“这个魔法师貌似和邪神信徒对上了，我们先暂时不管他，且让他和邪神信徒狗咬狗。”天残谷主说。

二王子也道：“现在找回空间腰带最至关重要，如果我能找回空间腰带，就算不能立即坐上王位，也能给虎王和其他权贵留下极好印象。”

天残谷主：“我已经让人在找。那个安妮丽娜是怎么回事？我能见到她吗？”

二王子：“我会想办法让你见到她。”

他们魔法师有的是手段让人说出真话。二王子也就是暂时不想暴露实力，还有就是想要节省魔晶。

天残谷主忽然又道：“对了，我听说那个拉斐尔郎沐似乎得到了王后一直想要寻找的石耳？”

二王子笑：“是有这回事，还是雷米尔喊破。不过我看拉斐尔似乎没当回事，也不知道石耳是不是真的在他身上。”

天残谷主神秘一笑：“见见就知道了。”

得不到空间腰带，得到石耳也是好的。只要让他的这具真身实际接触到拉斐尔，他就能分辨出对方是不是真的身怀自然之神的神力。
chunks.englishText:
Many matters could be negotiated, provided the exchange of interests was properly managed.

"Since this magician appears to have locked horns with the Evil God's followers, let's leave him alone for now and let him and the Evil God's followers tear at each other like dogs," the Valley Master said.

The Second Prince also added: "Recovering the spatial belt is of paramount importance right now. If I can retrieve it, even if I cannot immediately ascend to the throne, I can still leave an exceptionally stellar impression on the Tiger King and other high-ranking nobles."

The Valley Master: "I've already sent people to search for it. What's the deal with that Anielina? Can I see her?"

The Second Prince: "I'll find a way for you to see her."

Magicians had plenty of methods at their disposal to compel people to speak the truth. The Second Prince simply didn't want to expose his strength prematurely, and he also wished to conserve his magic crystals.

The Valley Master suddenly spoke up again: "Right, I heard that Raphael Lang Mu seems to have acquired the Stone Ear fungus that the Queen has been searching for all this time?"

The Second Prince smiled: "That is indeed the case, and it was even blurted out by Remiel. However, from what I observed, Raphael didn't seem to take it to heart, and it's unclear whether the Stone Ear fungus is truly in his possession."

The Valley Master smiled mysteriously: "We'll know once we see him."

Failing to acquire the spatial belt, securing the Stone Ear fungus would also suffice. As long as his true physical body made actual contact with Raphael, he would be able to discern whether the other party genuinely carried the divine power of the God of Nature.

chunks.chineseText:
第185章 安妮塔夫人死

安妮塔服下一种药剂见没用，又服下另一种疗伤药剂。

但身体上的伤口仍旧没有消失，甚至在进一步变得严重。

妮娜梅尔文焦急地看着安妮塔，想要帮助她，却束手无策。

安妮塔疼痛难忍，再次拿出一瓶药剂服下。

这瓶药剂是用来抵抗诅咒的。

是的，她已经猜到她身上的变化九成九来自诅咒。

也只有咒术才会这么神鬼莫测防不胜防。

服下的抗诅咒药剂似乎起了一点效果，她身上的伤口没有消失，可也没有继续加重。

“夫人，我去找贾斯特大人吧。”妮娜梅尔文建议。

安妮塔坐起身，“不要去。”

贾斯特也是一名咒术师，但并不是她的人，而是一名自由佣兵。

只要你给的钱足够多，贾斯特就能为你办事。同样，你也不要指望他有什么忠心。

安妮塔不信任贾斯特。

现在外面不知道多少人在寻找她，要说贾斯特没有对赏金动心就不可能，也就是他不知道她现在躲在哪里，否则早就出卖她。

妮娜梅尔文见安妮塔拒绝，担心：“可是您身上这是诅咒吧？如果不找咒术师，要怎么解决？”

安妮塔反问：“你就这么信任贾斯特？”

妮娜目光闪动。

安妮塔警惕，心想妮娜也不能相信了，这小妮子一看就是春心萌动的样子。

她还以为妮娜喜欢上伊克斯墨文，没想到她还对贾斯特也动了情。

不过贾斯特外表确实很招女人喜欢，又带着点冷漠和神秘的气质，会吸引到妮娜也不奇怪。

“这样，那你去找贾斯特过来吧，找他时先不要跟他说我的事情，就说我请他过来一趟。”安妮塔说。

妮娜露出笑容：“好，我这就去找他。夫人，您等着，贾斯特一定有办法救您。”

安妮塔目送妮娜欢欢喜喜地离开，立刻起身，快速捡了几样东西装进空间手镯里，又给自己套上一件斗篷，转头就从后门走了。

“啧，看到我炼制的空间道具戴在这些人的手上，真的很不爽啊。”

“谁？！”安妮塔猛地转身。

“这边。”小巷子的墙壁顶端有人对安妮塔摇手。

安妮塔抬头，看到两个人影。

两人从屋顶上跳下来，正好落到安妮塔面前。

安妮塔裹紧斗篷，她感觉那瓶扛诅咒药剂好像开始失效，她身体上的伤口又开始剧烈疼痛起来。

小巷子里的光线不太好，但足够安妮塔认出对面两人。

其中一人对她来说可真的是再熟悉不过。

拉斐尔，还有那个阿瑞斯商。

安妮塔没说话，她不确定这两人是否真的认出她，还是偶尔碰到。

商非凡上下打量安妮塔，怪笑：“你这是也中了以牙还牙的诅咒？没想到啊，你竟然也搞出拿活人献祭还凌虐无辜者的事。没有直接死亡，大概是帮凶一级？”

安妮塔眼眸收缩：“这位阁下，我不知道你在说什么。”

商非凡呵呵：“安妮塔，这时候你还伪装有什么意思？”

安妮塔沉默两秒：“诅咒和你们有关？”

商非凡：“你这是要去哪里？人说狡兔三窟，我看夫人你恐怕至少有三十窟。”

安妮塔见阿瑞斯商不肯正面回答，就看向郎沐，声音也变回原声：“好久不见。”

郎沐对安妮塔点点头，就跟招呼一个普通认识的人：“好久不见。”

安妮塔索性拨下兜帽，露出真容：“能告诉我，你们是怎么找到我的吗？”

郎沐笑了笑：“八卦报那边给出的消息。”

安妮塔：“……”

商非凡也不管安妮塔信不信，一脸让人想打他的表情说：“那谁，你有两个选择。第一个选择，乖乖跟我们去王宫，让我们顺利领到赏金。第二个选择，你看你身上有什么好东西可以拿出来贿赂我们，如果价值比虎王给出的赏金更高，我们也不是不可以考虑睁一只眼闭一只眼，放你过去。”

安妮塔不看阿瑞斯商，只盯着郎沐：“你恨我？”

郎沐想笑。

阿瑞斯商嗤笑一声，代答：“你算什么东西，也配我家阿沐恨你？”

安妮塔一手悄悄摸向口袋，一边对郎沐说：“我不知道你到底是谁，但我知道你绝不是拉斐尔。如果你们把我送去给虎王，我一定会跟虎王说出这件事，而虎王必然会告诉郎侦老伯爵。”

阿瑞斯商歪头：“你这是在威胁我家阿沐？”

安妮塔心中震惊阿瑞斯商对她爆出来的秘密毫无反应，脸上却保持着镇定，仍旧盯着郎沐：“你身上有石耳，你猜如果我把这件事告诉……”

“不用你告诉，你儿子雷米尔已经在王宫当众说出来。”阿瑞斯商抱臂：“来，继续，看你还有多少能威胁阿沐的小秘密。”

安妮塔有点生气也有郁闷，这么重要的事，雷米尔为什么没有跟她说？

“那你就不担心吗？”安妮塔紧紧盯着郎沐的眼睛：“石耳就是自然之神力量的一部分，知道这个秘密的人并不少。据我所知，邪神信徒那边有办法把已经融入人体内的自然之神力量给提取出来。”

郎沐终于开口：“哦。”

安妮塔不明。哦？你的反应就这？

知道你淡定，但你是不是也太淡定了一些？

商非凡懒得看安妮塔继续表演，转头就对郎沐说：“不玩了，把她打残了送给虎王吧。要么直接切了她给你报仇。”

郎沐刚知道自己就是原身拉斐尔时，确实很难受。

但看到安妮塔的嘴脸，他对报仇忽然就变得意兴阑珊。

“她身上的诅咒是不是好不了？”郎沐问商非凡。

商非凡异常自信地说：“好不了。除非诅咒之神出手为她解除诅咒。”

“果然是你们！没想到你竟然还是一名咒术师。”安妮塔失声。

两人都没理睬安妮塔。

郎沐：“把她送给虎王处置吧。我想，这样她可能会更痛苦一点，可惜王后不在，否则把她送给王后是最好的。”

安妮塔不可置信：“拉斐尔，你怎么能说出这种话？你根本就不是这样的人。”

郎沐双眼毫无感情地看向安妮塔：“我有时候真的觉得很奇怪，你们这些人在对付其他人时总是什么事都能干得出来，但如果有人这样对你们，你们就会大惊小怪，似乎其他人就应该躺平任你们欺凌宰割一样。”

安妮塔手一扬，转身就跑。

“全身麻痹！”

安妮塔脚一软，整个人倒向地面。

安妮塔撒出的药剂在一阵轻风下，全都聚集到一起，并全都落到了安妮塔的脸上。

安妮塔陡然发出惨叫。

她的脸瞬间冒出一个又一个血泡。

“嘶。”商非凡看得咧嘴：“这药剂可真歹毒。”

安妮塔身体倏然下沉，整个身体都沉入了地面。

郎沐抽出骨杖，指向地面：“出来！”

安妮塔的身体直接就从土壤里飞了出来。

安妮塔眼中充满不可置信。拉斐尔这是什么手段？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 185: The Death of Madam Anita (Part 1)

Madam Anita swallowed one potion, but seeing it had no effect, she quickly downed another healing potion.

Yet the wounds on her body still refused to vanish; if anything, they were worsening further.

Nina Melvin watched Anita anxiously, eager to help, but utterly at her loss for what to do.

Tormented by the agonizing pain, Anita retrieved yet another vial and drank it down.

This particular potion was meant to resist curses.

Indeed, she had already guessed that nine out of ten changes happening to her body stemmed from a curse.

Only curse arts could be so unfathomable, bizarre, and impossible to guard against.

The anti-curse potion she had just consumed seemed to take a sliver of effect. While her wounds did not disappear, at least they stopped spreading further.

"Madam, should I go find Lord Justin?" Nina Melvin suggested.

Anita sat up straight. "Don't go."

Justin was also a curse master, but he was not her man; rather, he operated as a free mercenary.

As long as you paid him enough, Justin would work for you. By the same token, you could never expect an ounce of loyalty from him.

Anita did not trust Justin.

Right now, who knew how many people were out searching for her? It was practically impossible that Justin hadn't been tempted by the bounty. The only reason he hadn't betrayed her yet was that he didn't know where she was hiding; otherwise, he would have sold her out long ago.

Seeing Anita refuse, Nina worried, "But isn't this a curse on you? If we don't find a curse master, how are we going to fix it?"

Anita retorted, "Do you trust Justin that much?"

Nina’s eyes flickered.

Anita grew vigilant, thinking to herself that Nina could no longer be trusted either. At a single glance, this little lass looked utterly lovestruck.

She had previously thought Nina fancied Ickes Mervyn, but she hadn't expected her to harbor feelings for Justin as well.

Still, Justin’s exterior truly appealed to women, carrying an aura of cold detachment and mystery. It wasn't strange that he had attracted Nina.

"How about this, then? Go fetch Justin over," Anita instructed. "When you find him, don't mention anything about me at first—just say I've invited him over for a visit."

A smile bloomed on Nina's face. "Alright, I'll go find him right now. Madam, just wait; Justin will definitely have a way to save you."

Watching Nina leave in joyful high spirits, Anita immediately got to her feet, swiftly grabbed a few items to stuff into her spatial bracelet, threw on a hooded cloak, and turned to flee through the back door.

"Tsk, seeing the spatial artifacts I refined being worn on the hands of such people really pouts me off."

"Who?!" Anita spun around abruptly.

"Over here." Someone at the top of the alleyway's wall waved at Anita.

Anita raised her head and spotted two figures.

The pair leaped down from the roof, landing right in front of Anita.

Anita wrapped her cloak tighter around herself. She felt as though the anti-curse potion was beginning to wear off, and the wounds on her body flared up with intense pain once more.

The lighting in the narrow alley was poor, but it was bright enough for Anita to recognize the two figures opposite her.

One of them was truly a familiar face to her.

Raphael, along with that Ares merchant.

Anita remained silent. She couldn't be sure whether these two had genuinely recognized her or if they had simply run into her by chance.

Shang Feifan looked Anita up and down with a weird smile. "Did you also catch an 'eye for an eye' curse? I never expected you to pull off things like sacrificing living humans and torturing the innocent. Since you didn't drop dead on the spot, are you perhaps an accomplice-tier culprit?"

Anita’s pupils constricted. "My lord, I have no idea what you're talking about."

Shang Feifan chuckled. "Anita, what's the point of keeping up the disguise at this stage?"

Anita fell silent for two seconds. "The curse... has something to do with you?"

Shang Feifan asked, "Where are you heading off to? People say a crafty rabbit has three burrows, but I reckon you, Madam, probably have at least thirty."

Seeing that the Ares merchant refused to give a straight answer, Anita shifted her gaze to Lang Mu, her voice reverting to its original tone. "Long time no see."

Lang Mu nodded at Anita, greeting her as casually as one would greet an ordinary acquaintance: "Long time no see."

Anita simply pulled back her hood, revealing her true visage. "Can you tell me how you found me?"

Lang Mu smiled faintly. "The gossip rags provided the information."

Anita: "……"

Disregarding whether Anita believed him or not, Shang Feifan wore an expression practically begging to be punched as he said, "Well, you've got two choices. Option one: come quietly with us to the royal palace so we can safely collect the bounty. Option two: see if you have any good treasures on you to bribe us with. If their value exceeds the bounty offered by the Tiger King, we might consider turning a blind eye and letting you pass."

Ignoring the Ares merchant entirely, Anita stared straight at Lang Mu. "Do you hate me?"

Lang Mu almost laughed.

Shang Feifan let out a scoff, answering in his stead, "What kind of thing are you? Are you even worthy of our Ah Mu hating you?"

One of Anita's hands stealthily felt for her pocket while she said to Lang Mu, "I don't know who you really are, but I know for a fact you are no Raphael. If you hand me over to the Tiger King, I will definitely tell him about this matter, and the Tiger King will undoubtedly report it to Old Count Lang."

Shang Feifan tilted his head. "Are you trying to threaten our Ah Mu?"

Shock rippled through Anita’s heart at how unfazed the Ares merchant was by the secret she had just dropped, yet she maintained her composure on the surface, keeping her eyes locked on Lang Mu. "You have the Stone Ear on you. Guess what would happen if I were to tell—"

"No need for you to blab; your son Remier already spilled it publicly in the royal palace." Shang Feifan crossed his arms. "Go on, continue. Let's see how many more little secrets you have left to threaten Ah Mu with."

Anita felt a mix of annoyance and frustration. Why hadn't Remier mentioned such an important matter to her?

"Then aren't you worried at all?" Anita stared intently into Lang Mu’s eyes. "The Stone Ear is a fragment of the Nature God's power, and quite a few people know this secret. As far as I know, the Evil God's cultists possess methods to extract the Nature God's power once it has fused into a human body."

Lang Mu finally spoke. "Oh."

Anita was baffled. *'Oh?' Is that your entire reaction?*

*I knew you were calm, but aren't you a bit too calm?*

Too lazy to watch Anita put on any further performances, Shang Feifan turned to Lang Mu. "Let's stop playing around. Shall we cripple her and hand her over to the Tiger King? Or we could just chop her up right now to avenge you."

When Lang Mu had first discovered that he was the original Raphael, it had indeed been an agonizing realization.

Yet, upon witnessing Anita's hypocritical face, his enthusiasm for revenge suddenly withered away into complete indifference.

"Is the curse on her incurable?" Lang Mu asked Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan replied with extraordinary confidence, "Incurable. Unless the God of Curses personally steps in to lift it."

"It really was you lot! I never expected you to be a curse master as well," Anita blurted out in shock.

Neither of them paid her any mind.

Lang Mu said, "Hand her over to the Tiger King to deal with. I suppose that way, she might suffer even more. What a pity the Queen isn't here; otherwise, handing her over to her would have been the best option."

Anita looked at him in disbelief. "Raphael, how can you say such things? You are fundamentally not that kind of person."

Lang Mu gazed at Anita with utterly devoid, emotionless eyes. "Sometimes I find it genuinely bizarre. You people are capable of doing literally anything when targeting others, but the moment someone treats you the exact same way, you throw a massive fit of outrage, as if everyone else is just supposed to lie flat and let you bully and slaughter them at will."

With a flick of her hand, Anita turned and bolted.

"Full-body paralysis!"

Anita’s legs went limp, and her entire body collapsed toward the ground.

Under a sudden gust of wind, the potion Anita had scattered gathered together and rained squarely down upon her face.

Anita let out a shrill, piercing scream.

Instantly, bubble after bloody bubble erupted across her face.

"Hiss." Shang Feifan winced, pulling a face. "That potion is truly vicious."

Anita’s body abruptly sank, her entire frame submerging straight into the ground.

Lang Mu drew his bone staff and pointed it at the earth. "Get out!"

Anita’s body was yanked straight back up out of the soil.

Her eyes were filled with utter disbelief. *What kind of method is this, Raphael?*

chunks.chapterTitle: 第185章 安妮塔夫人死 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
她的血脉天赋就是土行者，只要她双脚落在地面，她就比别人多了更多逃跑和攻敌的机会。

她几次遇到危险，包括今天在金溪庄园，她都是靠这份血脉天赋脱险。

一般她只要钻入土地里，想要再抓住她就非常困难。

哪怕她刚才身体麻痹，不能自由操控身体，但她的精神力还在，就能操控身体沉入土地中，只是没有四肢自由时穿行得那么快。

可就在她想要往远处穿行逃跑时，她忽然感觉到一股力量像一张网一样网住她，并把她生生从土壤里拉拽了出来。

安妮塔被拖出地面，感觉身体的麻痹感有所消失，立刻掏出一支炼金武器，甩手就射向郎沐。

咔嚓！

那炼金匕首飞到半途就变成冰坨子从半空落到地面。

咚！一只拳头砸中了安妮塔的太阳穴，把她整个人都打飞了出去。

商非凡看到砸到墙上又软软滑下来的安妮塔，毫无歉意地道歉：“不好意思，手重了一点。”

安妮塔已经昏迷，压根就没有听见商非凡的道歉。

郎沐低头看趴在地面上昏迷不醒的安妮塔，眼神微微怪异：“就这么解决了？”

商非凡：“还能有多复杂？别看她布局这么多年，貌似做了很多事，但如果她是一拳就能打倒虎王和王后的强者，她也不需要搞这些有的没的。”

郎沐一想也是。费尽心机有时就等于实力不足，别人耍拳头，她就只能耍心眼子。

这种耍心眼的人就跟某些不修体还无法瞬发魔法的魔法师一样，最怕就是让人近身。

法德尔大陆的魔法师听说就是吃了不少身体娇弱的苦头，后来的魔法师都很注重炼体，有些还对自己的身体直接施展黑魔法，用另类的手法给自己炼制一具强大体魄。

而魔导师为什么厉害？

除了他们能施展大型魔法，更因为他们能大量瞬发厉害的魔法。

郎沐现在虽然没有达到魔导师境界，但也就一线之差，掌握的小型瞬发魔法不少。

而且他还从大王子那里得到了魔法奥秘石，只要他融合了那枚奥秘石，开始接受里面的法圣传承，相信要不了多久他就能踏入魔导师境界。

商非凡把安妮塔提起来，随手扔进雕像广场。

两人并没有立刻去找虎王，而是向安妮塔刚才出来的宅邸走去。

两人在这座宅邸里搜索了一圈，找到了一些财物和秘密书信。

商非凡没客气，把东西全都塞进自己兜里。

妮娜梅尔文带着贾斯特回来得还挺快。

商非凡见两人身上没有受到诅咒的痕迹，也不像是对邪神信徒有多少了解的样子，就没管两人，拉着郎沐离开。

妮娜在屋里跑来跑去地寻找，最后沮丧地对贾斯特说：“夫人不在，没有打斗痕迹和破门痕迹，她应该是自己走了。她还把府里值钱的东西都拿走了。”

贾斯特目光在屋内环视一圈，心中暗暗可惜不能拿安妮塔领赏，不过……

贾斯特微笑着牵起妮娜的手：“墨文伯爵府一家已经废了，安妮塔夫人也跑了，我想安妮塔夫人恐怕也不会再回来找你。你也不需要再听她的话去笼络那个伊克斯墨文，心不甘情不愿地做安妮塔夫人和墨文家族之间的桥梁。妮娜，你自由了，我看虎国王城就要乱了，你不如跟我早早离开。”

妮娜原本还有些犹豫，但想到她的姐姐多丽丝被王后抓走那么长时间，安妮塔夫人说救她结果什么都没做，如果不是她拿着姐姐的贴身物品去找贾斯特，请贾斯特帮忙寻找她姐姐，她都不知道她姐姐已经惨死于拷问中。

妮娜再想到安妮塔的不告而别，终于下定决心，对贾斯特露出羞涩的笑：“好。我跟你走。”

贾斯特暗中露出得意笑容。这些春心萌动的女孩，真的太好骗。

咕咚！

贾斯特突然两眼皮一翻，脑袋破了一个大窟窿倒在地上，转眼就没了气息。

妮娜吓了一大跳，差点尖叫出声。

调转回来的商非凡无奈地对郎沐说：“现在你放心了？”

郎沐只是笑：“不是你说的那咒术师身上有大量怨气纠缠吗。”

而他则听到了亡灵的惨叫和咒骂声。

商非凡原本不想多管闲事，但郎沐走了几步非要拉他回来。

等郎沐听清那些亡灵都在咒骂什么后，就要对贾斯特出手。

商非凡抢先一步动手，一砖头就把贾斯特干翻，特别干脆利索。

这次两人是真走了。

妮娜梅尔文在原地呆愣愣地站了好一会儿，终于反应过来，迅速回屋里收拾自己的东西，跑了。

她没动贾斯特身上的财物，那可是咒术师，她怕对方的东西拿了不祥。

天快蒙蒙亮时，这座宅邸里又有了一点动静。

有人摸了进来。

玩家皮皮虾贼眉鼠眼地左看右瞄，确定这偌大府邸竟然空无一人，立刻露出喜色。

希望这家里有宝箱让他开出来啊。

哎呀！什么东西？

皮皮虾差点被某物绊倒，低头一看，吓了一大跳。

卧槽！尸体！

任务？！

任务没跳出来，皮皮虾有点扫兴，但等他开始习惯性摸尸后，他的嘴笑歪了。

就在刚刚，系统跳出来提醒，说他发现了咒术师传承，问他是否要学习成为咒术师。

这可真是喜从天降，大大的奇遇！

皮皮虾几乎是迫不及待地跑去世界频道炫耀去了。

皮皮虾的奇遇放到一边。

王宫中，虎王在天快亮时睡了一会儿。

可能一个半兽时都不到。

门外突然传来侍卫的敲门声和禀报声：“陛下！卑下有重要事情禀告，有人把安妮塔夫人给送来了。”

虎王啪地睁开眼睛，迅速翻身坐起。

阿瑞斯商大大咧咧地站在虎王寝宫外的院子里，他就这么提着安妮塔夫人闯到了这里。

一群侍卫围着他。

虎王快步走出来。

阿瑞斯商不等虎王开口，就说：“赏金呢？赶紧结账，我还得回去抱我家亲爱的睡觉。忙了一晚上，困死我了。”

虎王：“……阿瑞斯商？”

阿瑞斯商翻白眼：“不是我还有谁，虎王陛下，你要的安妮塔夫人给你送来了，你答应的赏金呢？”

虎王在发出悬赏时万没想到这么快就有人找到安妮塔，还把人一路送进了王宫。

更没想到这人竟然是炼金大师阿瑞斯商。

所以阿瑞斯商是真的喜欢拉斐尔吧，才会这么拼命。

虎王觉得他要重新评估这位炼金大师的实力。

别人都找不到的安妮塔，竟然被一个外来的纨绔给找到了，就问这个纨绔有多厉害？

“稍等，你是在哪里找到的安妮塔？还有，安妮塔怎么会变成这样？”

虎王视力不错，看到了安妮塔那张满是血泡的脸。

阿瑞斯商不耐烦地：“我怎么知道？我就在墨文伯爵府附近看到的她，发现她时她就这样了。阿沐给我看过她的画像，她虽然变成了这个死样子，但也不妨碍我把她认出来。行了，虎王陛下你也确认她就是安妮塔了，能不能赶紧交易？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 185: The Death of Madam Anita (Part 2)

Her bloodline talent was Earth Walker; as long as her feet touched the ground, she gained far more opportunities for escape and counterattack than anyone else.

Several times she had encountered danger—including today at the Golden Brook Estate—she had relied entirely on this bloodline talent to slip away safely.

Normally, the moment she burrowed into the earth, capturing her became an extraordinary challenge.

Even though her body was paralyzed just now and she couldn't freely control her limbs, her spiritual power remained intact, allowing her to compel her body to sink into the soil, albeit without the swift mobility of free limbs.

Yet just as she attempted to tunnel away into the distance, she suddenly felt a force grip her like a fisherman's net, dragging her ruthlessly back out from the soil.

Pulled out of the ground, Anita felt the numbness in her body recede slightly. She instantly whipped out an alchemical weapon and hurled it straight at Lang Mu.

*Crack!*

Mid-flight, the alchemical dagger turned into a lump of ice and plummeted to the ground.

*Thud!* A fist smashed squarely into Anita's temple, sending her flying away.

Watching Anita crash into the wall and slide down limply, Shang Feifan apologized with zero remorse, "My bad, put a bit too much strength into that."

Having already passed out, Anita heard none of Shang Feifan's apology.

Lang Mu lowered his gaze to look at the unconscious Anita sprawled across the ground, a trace of strange amusement in his eyes. "Just like that? It's over?"

Shang Feifan shrugged. "How complicated did you expect it to be? Don't let her years of plotting and all those seemingly grand schemes fool you; if she were the kind of powerhouse who could knock out the Tiger King and the Queen with a single punch, she wouldn't need to resort to all these underhanded tricks."

Lang Mu thought about it and had to agree. Desperate scheming was often just another word for insufficient strength. When others threw punches, all she could do was play mind games.

People who relied on mind games—much like certain mages who neglected physical conditioning and couldn't cast spells instantly—were most terrified of opponents closing in on them.

Mages on the Fader Continent reportedly suffered greatly from their frail physical bodies in the past, leading subsequent generations of mages to place heavy emphasis on physical tempering. Some even went so far as to cast dark magic directly upon their own bodies, forging robust physiques through alternative methods.

And why were Grand Mages so formidable?

Aside from their ability to cast large-scale spells, it was precisely because they could instantaneously cast a massive volume of powerful magic.

While Lang Mu hadn't yet reached the realm of a Grand Mage, he was only a hair's breadth away, and he had mastered quite a few minor instant-cast spells.

Moreover, he had obtained the Magic Mystery Stone from the First Prince. Once he integrated that mystery stone and began receiving the Saint of Magic's legacy within it, he believed it wouldn't be long before he stepped into the Grand Mage realm.

Shang Feifan picked Anita up and casually tossed her into the plaza of the statues.

The two didn't immediately go looking for the Tiger King; instead, they walked back toward the mansion Anita had just emerged from.

They searched the estate thoroughly, unearthing some wealth and a stash of confidential letters.

Shang Feifan didn't stand on ceremony, stuffing everything straight into his own pockets.

Nina Melvin and Justin returned remarkably quickly.

Noticing that neither of them showed any traces of being cursed, nor did they look like they knew much about the Evil God's cultists, Shang Feifan ignored the pair and dragged Lang Mu away.

Nina ran frantically around the house in search of Anita before finally telling Justin with a dejected expression, "Madam isn't here. There are no signs of a struggle or a broken door—she must have left on her own. And she took all the valuables from the manor with her."

Justin’s gaze swept across the room as a quiet wave of regret washed over him. It was a pity he wouldn't be able to cash in on Anita's bounty, but...

With a warm smile, Justin reached out to take Nina's hand. "The Mervyn Count's household is finished, and Madam Anita has fled. I doubt she'll ever come back looking for you. You won't have to follow her orders to cozy up to that Ickes Mervyn anymore, acting as an unwilling bridge between Madam Anita and the Mervyn family. Nina, you're free. I reckon the Tiger King's capital is about to descend into chaos; you'd be better off leaving early with me."

Though Nina had initially hesitated, the thought of her sister Doris being dragged away by the Queen for so long—and how Madam Anita had promised to save her yet done absolutely nothing—flooded her mind. If she hadn't taken her sister's personal token to find Justin and beg for his help, she wouldn't even have known her sister had died a miserable death under torture.

Coupled with Anita's unannounced departure, Nina finally hardened her resolve. She cast a shy, blushing smile at Justin. "Alright. I'll go with you."

A smug grin crept inwardly across Justin's face. These lovestruck girls were truly too easy to trick.

*Thud!*

Suddenly, Justin's eyes rolled back. A gaping hole was blown through the back of his head as he crashed face-first onto the floor, his life extinguished in a flash.

Startled out of her wits, Nina nearly let out a shriek.

Stepping back into the room, Shang Feifan said helplessly to Lang Mu, "Are you satisfied now?"

Lang Mu merely chuckled. "Weren't you the one who said that curse master had heavy grievances entangling him?"

As for him, he had heard the wretched wails and curses of the wraiths.

Shang Feifan originally hadn't wanted to meddle, but after walking a few paces, Lang Mu had insisted on dragging him back.

Once Lang Mu clearly understood what those wraiths were cursing about, he decided to deal with Justin on the spot.

Shang Feifan had beaten him to the punch, felling Justin with a single brick in a remarkably crisp and decisive move.

This time, the two of them truly departed.

Nina Melvin stood frozen in place for a long while before she finally snapped back to her senses, rushed back inside to pack her own belongings, and bolted.

She didn't dare touch the valuables on Justin's corpse—he was a curse master, after all, and she feared taking a dead mage's possessions would bring bad luck.

As dawn approached, a hint of movement stirred within the mansion once more.

Someone had sneaked in.

The player Pipi Shrimp darted left and right with shifty eyes. Seeing that the sprawling estate was completely devoid of people, delight instantly bloomed on his face.

*Let's hope there's a loot chest here waiting for me to open.*

*Whoa! What is this?*

Pipi Shrimp almost tripped over something, and when he looked down, he got the fright of his life.

*Holy shit! A corpse!*

*A quest?!*

No quest notification popped up, which left Pipi Shrimp slightly disappointed. But the moment he instinctively started looting the body, his mouth split into a wide grin.

Right then, the system pinged with a notification: he had discovered a Curse Master legacy and was asked whether he wished to learn it and become a Curse Master.

This was truly a blessing dropping out of the blue—a massive hidden encounter!

Pipi Shrimp practically sprinted to the World Channel in eager anticipation to flex.

Leaving Pipi Shrimp's serendipitous encounter aside...

Inside the royal palace, the Tiger King had managed to snatch a brief nap as dawn broke.

It had barely lasted half a half-beast hour.

Suddenly, a guard's knocking and urgent report echoed from outside the bedchamber: "Your Majesty! Your humble servant has an urgent report. Someone has brought Madam Anita here!"

The Tiger King's eyes snapped open as he swiftly flipped himself upright.

Ares Shang stood casually in the courtyard outside the Tiger King's bedchamber, dragging Madam Anita along by her collar as he brazenly barged in.

A ring of guards surrounded him.

The Tiger King strode out briskly.

Before the Tiger King could utter a word, Ares Shang demanded, "Where's the bounty? Hurry up and settle the bill; I still need to go back and hold my darling while I sleep. I've been busy all night, I'm exhausted."

The Tiger King: "……Ares Shang?"

Ares Shang rolled his eyes. "Who else could it be? Tiger King, Your Majesty, I've brought you the Madam Anita you wanted. Where's the bounty you promised?"

When the Tiger King issued the bounty, he never expected anyone to track Anita down so quickly, let alone drag her all the way into the royal palace.

Even less did he expect the bounty hunter to be the Grand Alchemist, Ares Shang.

*So Ares Shang must really, truly love Raphael to go to such desperate lengths.*

The Tiger King felt he needed to reevaluate this grand alchemist's capabilities.

Nobody else could find Anita, yet an outsider playboy managed to dig her out. Just how formidable was this playboy?

"Hold on a moment. Where did you find Anita? And how did Anita end up looking like this?"

Blessed with good eyesight, the Tiger King had already spotted Anita's face, which was covered entirely in bloody blisters.

Ares Shang answered impatiently, "How would I know? I spotted her near the Mervyn Count's estate, and she was already like this when I found her. Ah Mu showed me her portrait, so even though she looks like a bloody ghost right now, it didn't stop me from recognizing her. Alright, Tiger King, Your Majesty, you've confirmed it's her. Can we wrap up this transaction now?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第185章 安妮塔夫人死 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
虎王沉默一秒，挥手让人去取赏金。

侍者抱着一个箱子进来。

虎王让侍者把箱子放到阿瑞斯商面前。

阿瑞斯商打开箱子看了看，确定金额无误，满意地点点头，挥手就把箱子收入空间戒指，丢下安妮塔就走。

虎王：“……”

这纨绔是不是就没把他这个虎王放在眼里？

虎王就算看阿瑞斯商不顺眼，现在也暂时拿他没办法。

他把全部注意力都放到了安妮塔身上。

当安妮塔幽幽醒转时，就看到了对面坐着的虎王。

她浑身湿透，清晨的冷风吹得她身体发颤。

有人对她泼了冷水。

克莱门特就站在她两步远的斜侧方。

还有一群侍卫远远围着。

安妮塔咬紧牙关，慢慢坐起身。

她的身体太疼了，该死的诅咒！

安妮塔同时感觉到自己身上应该被人仔细摸索过，她身上所有额外的零部件都消失了。

现在除了一件遮身的斗篷，她身上就再没有其他外物。

再看到自己手腕上、脚腕上专门用来防止血脉天赋的炼金镣铐，安妮塔缓缓抬起头。

“有必要做到这种程度吗？”

虎王冷眼看着面前的女兽人，过了好一会儿才说道：“你的野心也让我吃惊。”

“野心？”安妮塔不用抬手摸自己的脸，都知道自己的脸现在有多可怕。

她也没指望用这张脸能引出虎王怜爱或过往的情谊，实际上她很清楚，如果落到拉斐尔和郎家人手中，她还有活路，但落到虎王手中，虽然没有落到王后手中那么惨，但也是别想活命的。

因为她太清楚虎王最在意的是什么。

而她已经严重踩踏了虎王的底线。

“你怎么不说你贪花好色吃着碗里还要看锅里，好大喜功心比天高却昏庸无能呢。哦，你还愚蠢到把第一个愿意奉献自己领地、一心一意支持你集权大业的贵族的亲外孙给当成自己私生子的挡箭牌，我真的就没有见过比你更昏庸的国王。”

虎王羞恼交加，暴怒：“明明是你……”

安妮塔冷笑：“是我提议，但我只是说担心雷米尔长大后会因为私生子身份被人羞辱欺凌，我可没有建议用牺牲的郎飞统领的儿子来换。”

周围一圈侍卫恨不得捂上自己的耳朵。这种话是他们能听的吗？事后他们不会被灭口吧？

克莱门特不动如山，就像什么都没听见一样。

虎王胸口几次激烈起伏，可能他也想明白了，和安妮塔吵架毫无意义，他试图往正事上扯：“只靠你一人，你根本无法在王城布局这么多，告诉本王，你的其他合作者是谁？”

安妮塔：“你的大儿子。”

虎王：“放屁！”

安妮塔：“那就是你家老二，或者你也可以认为是你的大女儿。老三那只猪猡就算了，那就是个真废物。”

虎王再次被安妮塔气得胸口疼。

安妮塔还嘲笑：“你的王后呢？枉费你还是一国之王，只因老婆娘家势大，你就像个龟孙一样，不得不忍受王后的嚣张霸道，甚至连自己的儿子都保护不了，更别说保护自己的情人。幸好我是为了报复你们一家才当你的情人，否则谁当你的情人谁倒霉！就你这样的孬种还跟人学玩偷吃，呸！”

周围的侍卫：我们不存在不存在……，陛下已经忘掉我们忘掉我们……

虎王气着气着忽然就平静了，他看安妮塔的眼神就像在看一个死物。

“既然你什么都不愿意说，那么就这样吧。早在一年多两年前，你就已经死了。已经死掉的人又何必再跳出来扰乱世间。”

虎王站起身，居高临下地看着安妮塔：“放心，这次我会亲眼看着你死透，不会再给你任何假死逃亡的可能。”

安妮塔还没有看到王后死透，还没有看到虎王倒台、虎国完蛋，她怎么甘心就这么死去？

“你不能杀我。你杀我，你也会死！”

虎王阴森森：“你以为我会怕你的威胁？”

安妮塔声音更加阴森：“这不是威胁！这是事实。不信你大可以试试，不过你试试的代价就是你的命！”

虎王只当安妮塔为了活命在胡扯，眼中露出讥讽至极的冷笑。

“你以为杀了我就能万事大吉？”安妮塔突然疯狂大笑：“萨雷斯法雷尔，你看错的人何止一个我！”

“你看得最错的不是我，是拉斐尔郎沐！你以为这段时间一连串的事情都是谁查出来谁曝光出来的？你以为那家八卦报真的神通到那种地步？错！大错特错！”

“萨雷斯，我等着，等着看你的王位你的国家都被拉斐尔郎沐给夺去！还有你那些儿子女儿，必然也会一个个都死在拉斐尔手中！”

“当年我会假死，可不单单是为了躲避王后那个毒妇的骚扰，我更怕的是拉斐尔！你应该仔细看看他的眼睛，他就像是什么都知道一样。他知道，但他不说。”

“你再看看他十五岁以后，那些欺负过他的人有谁有个好下场？你还记得你那个愚蠢的三儿子被人揍了好几顿却找不到凶手吗？还有你那个又毒又坏跟她母亲一样的小女儿，她不是被人剃光过头发，还被人大冬天扔到冰窟窿里，结果同样找不到凶手？”

安妮特咯咯笑，笑得声音特别难听，没有半点当年清丽佳人的柔婉悦耳。

“你以为那些事情都是谁干的？就是你认为特别老实的拉斐尔啊！哈哈哈……”

“对了，把我送过来的人是谁？你是不是以为是别的人？别蠢了，发现我、抓到我，把我送到你这里来的同样也是拉斐尔！”

安妮塔笑得越发癫狂：“我不是败在你手中，更不是败在丹顿家那个毒妇手中，我就是败给了拉斐尔！他才是真正的不动则已，一动就要我们所有人的命！”

“你不奇怪丹顿侯爵怎么会突然消失得无影无踪吗？还有拉斐尔那日为什么就那么恰巧地出现在黑森林城，他还那么幸运地发现了千年前的图书馆，且只有他一个人有进去的办法。”

“就是因为拉斐尔才是最强大的那个人。就是他杀死了丹顿侯爵！也是他阻止了丹顿侯爵献祭整座黑森林城。”

“你等着吧！拉斐尔的复仇才刚刚开始！他没有放过我，也绝不会放过你和丹顿家的那个毒妇！对了，那毒妇是不是已经倒霉了，听说她被诅咒了？咯咯咯，你看我也被诅咒了，你也逃不过，你也会被诅咒，你只是被放到了最后一个。”

躲在一边偷偷旁观的郎沐转头，无辜地看向商非凡：看看，你做的事都算到我头上了，我都快成幕后大boss了。

商非凡被郎沐的小表情逗乐，捏了捏他的脸：宝贝，我做的不就是你做的，一家人不用分得那么清。

虎王的表情随着安妮塔的话变来变去，也不知他心里都在想些什么。

知道一点实情的克莱门特：别说虎王，就是他也差点相信了安妮塔的说辞。

“我当年在发现不对时就该早早杀了他，不应该抱着观察的心思，也不应该……”
chunks.englishText:
The Tiger King was silent for a second before waving his hand to order the bounty to be brought out.

A waiter walked in holding a box.

At the Tiger King’s gesture, the waiter placed the box before Aresi Shang.

Aresi Shang opened the box, inspected it, and confirmed that the amount was correct. He nodded in satisfaction, swept the box into his spatial ring with a wave of his hand, and left Anita behind without another glance as he walked away.

The Tiger King: “……”

Did this arrogant playboy simply not take him, the Tiger King, seriously at all?

Even though the Tiger King despised Aresi Shang, there was nothing he could do to him for the time being.

He shifted his entire focus onto Anita.

When Anita slowly regained consciousness, she saw the Tiger King sitting across from her.

Her entire body was soaked, and the cold morning breeze made her shiver violently.

Someone had doused her with cold water.

Clement was standing diagonally to her side, just two steps away.

Further off, a group of guards formed a wide perimeter.

Anita clenched her teeth and slowly pushed herself up into a sitting position.

Her body ached terribly—damn that curse!

At the same time, Anita sensed that she had been thoroughly searched; every extra component and gadget on her person was gone.

Now, apart from a cloak covering her body, there was not a single external item left on her.

Seeing the alchemical shackles specifically designed to suppress bloodline talents locked around her wrists and ankles, Anita slowly raised her head.

“Was it really necessary to go this far?”

The Tiger King gazed coldly at the female beastman before him for a long moment before speaking. “Your ambition has also caught me off guard.”

“Ambition?” Anita didn’t need to raise a hand to touch her face to know how terrifying it looked right now.

Nor did she harbor any illusions that this face could evoke the Tiger King’s pity or past affection. In truth, she was well aware that if she fell into the hands of Raphael and the Lang family, she might still find a way to live. But falling into the Tiger King’s hands—though perhaps not as miserably as falling into the Queen’s—meant she could kiss her life goodbye.

Because she knew all too well what the Tiger King cared about most.

And she had severely trampled upon his bottom line.

“Why don’t you mention how lustful and greedy you are, eating from your own bowl while eyeing what’s in the pot; how fond of grand achievements you are, aiming higher than the heavens yet being utterly incompetent and mediocre? Oh, and how foolish you were to use the maternal grandson of the first noble who willingly offered up his territory and wholeheartedly supported your grand enterprise of centralization as a smokescreen for your illegitimate son. I have truly never laid eyes on a more incompetent king than you.”

Arage and humiliation mingled in the Tiger King’s chest, driving him to fury. “Clearly, it was you—”

Anita sneered. “I made the proposal, but I only said I was worried Remil might be humiliated and bullied for his illegitimate status as he grew up. I certainly didn’t suggest replacing him with the son of the sacrificing Commander Lang Fei.”

The circle of guards nearby wished they could cover their ears. Were these things they were allowed to hear? Wouldn't they be silenced after the fact?

Clement stood as steady as a mountain, as if he hadn't heard a single word.

The Tiger King’s chest rose and fell violently a few times. Perhaps he, too, realized that arguing with Anita was utterly meaningless, so he tried to steer the conversation back to serious matters. “Solely by your own strength, you could never have laid out such an extensive scheme in the royal city. Tell me, who are your other collaborators?”

Anita: “Your eldest son.”

The Tiger King: “Bullshit!”

Anita: “Then it’s your second son, or you could consider it your eldest daughter. Let’s skip the third one, that swine; he’s a total waste of space.”

The Tiger King felt his chest ache from anger once again.

Anita laughed derisively. “What about your Queen? To think you call yourself a king of a nation; just because your wife’s maternal family holds immense power, you cower like a turtle, forced to endure the Queen’s arrogance and tyranny. You can't even protect your own sons, let alone your lover. Fortunately, I only became your lover to exact revenge on your entire family; otherwise, whoever becomes your lover is cursed! A spineless coward like you dares to play around behind your partner’s back—spit!”

Guards in the vicinity: *We don't exist, we don't exist... His Majesty has already forgotten us, forgotten us...*

As the Tiger King fumed, he suddenly grew calm. The way he looked at Anita was as if he were gazing at a dead object.

“Since you are unwilling to say anything, then so be it. A year or two ago, you were already dead. Why should someone who is already dead pop back out to disrupt the world?”

The Tiger King stood up, looking down at Anita from on high. “Rest assured, this time I will watch you die thoroughly with my own eyes. I won’t give you any more chances of fake deaths and escapes.”

Anita had yet to see the Queen die a miserable death; she had yet to see the Tiger King fall and the Tiger Kingdom collapse—how could she possibly be willing to die like this?

“You can’t kill me. If you kill me, you’ll die too!”

The Tiger King said with a sinister dark tone, “You think I’ll be scared by your threats?”

Anita’s voice turned even more bone-chilling. “This isn’t a threat! This is the truth. If you don’t believe me, you are welcome to try, but the price of your experiment will be your own life!”

The Tiger King simply assumed Anita was talking nonsense to save her skin, a derisive sneer of utmost mockery surfacing in his eyes.

“You think killing me will solve everything?” Anita suddenly burst into manic laughter. “Sareis Farrel, you’ve misjudged far more than just me!”

“The person you misjudged the most isn’t me—it’s Raphael Lang Mu! Who do you think investigated and exposed all those recent strings of events? Do you really think that tabloid newspaper is supernatural to that extent? Wrong! Dead wrong!”

“Sareis, I’ll wait and watch as Raphael Lang Mu strips away your throne and your country! And those sons and daughters of yours? They will inevitably die at Raphael’s hands one by one!”

“When I faked my death back then, it wasn’t merely to escape the harassment of that poisonous hag of a Queen; I was even more terrified of Raphael! You should take a careful look at his eyes—he looks as though he knows everything. He knows, but he simply doesn't say.”

“Just look at him after he turned fifteen. Did any of those people who bullied him ever come to a good end? Do you remember how your foolish third son was beaten up several times, yet you could never find the culprit? And what about that vicious, wicked little daughter of yours who’s just like her mother? Wasn't she once shaved bald and thrown into an icy crevice in the dead of winter, yet the culprit remained unfound?”

Anita cackled, her voice sounding exceptionally grating, devoid of the soft, melodious grace of the gentle beauty she once was.

“Who do you think carried out all those deeds? It was that Raphael whom you thought was so terribly honest! Hahaha……”

“Right, who do you think delivered me here? Did you assume it was someone else? Don’t be a fool. The one who discovered me, captured me, and sent me to you is none other than Raphael!”

Anita laughed with mounting delirium. “I didn't fall into your hands, nor did I fall into the hands of that poisonous hag of the Danton family—I fell to Raphael! He is the truly terrifying kind of person who remains still as a statue, but the moment he moves, he takes all our lives!”

“Aren't you wondering why Marquis Danton suddenly vanished without a trace? And why did Raphael happen to appear in Black Forest City so coincidentally on that day, being so fortunate as to discover a library from a thousand years ago, with only him possessing the method to enter?”

“It is because Raphael is the most powerful person of all. He killed Marquis Danton! And he was the one who stopped Marquis Danton from sacrificing the entire Black Forest City.”

“Just wait and see! Raphael’s revenge has only just begun! He didn't let me go, and he will never let you or that poisonous hag of the Danton family off the hook! Oh, right, hasn't that wicked woman already met with misfortune? I heard she was cursed? Hehehe, look, I’ve been cursed too, and you won’t escape it either—you will be cursed as well. You’re simply placed at the very end.”

Lang Mu, who had been hiding to watch the spectacle, turned his head and looked innocently at Shang Feifan. *Look, all the things you did are being pinned on me. I’m practically turning into the mastermind behind the scenes.*

Shang Feifan was amused by Lang Mu’s little expression and pinched his cheek. *Baby, what I do is what you do; as family, we don't need to draw such a clear line.*

The Tiger King’s expression shifted constantly as he listened to Anita’s words, though there was no telling what thoughts were swirling in his heart.

Clement, who knew a sliver of the truth, thought: *Forget the Tiger King; even he had almost bought into Anita’s rhetoric.*

“Back then, when I first noticed something was amiss, I should have killed him early on instead of harboring thoughts of observation, and I shouldn't have...”

chunks.chapterTitle: 第185章 安妮塔夫人死 (Part 4)
chunks.chineseText:
“石耳选择了他，自然之神选择了他……不是我，神没有选择我，为什么不肯选择我？为什么？明明石耳先选择了我……”

“他是谁？他不是拉斐尔。他是什么怪物？他和自然之神是什么关系？他怎么会那些诡异的能力？”

“杀了他！雷米尔你给我杀了他！萨雷斯你给我杀了他！他不是我儿子，他是怪物！是怪物！”

安妮塔精神似乎出了问题。

虎王听安妮塔一个劲给拉斐尔拉仇恨，心里莫名就厌烦得不得了。

“呼！”

一口烈火喷出去，落到了安妮塔的身上。

“你竟然真的对我动手，萨雷斯你会后悔的，你一定会后悔的，你是不是忘了曾经跟我发过什么誓言？”

安妮塔发出惨叫以及大笑，她高喊着：“萨雷斯法雷尔，我死了你也别想好过！”

虎王深深皱起眉头，用力想也没想起自己曾经发过什么誓言。

所有人都沉默地看着安妮塔夫人烧成一团火焰。

等到火焰熄灭，安妮塔变成一具焦尸。

就这样，虎王还抽刀亲自砍掉安妮塔的头颅，并让人把她挫骨扬灰。

克莱门特沉默地按照吩咐做事。

曾经的王城第一美人，搅风搅雨差点就把虎国王室给搅翻掉的安妮塔夫人就这么落下了帷幕。

郎沐主动握住了商非凡的手，小声说：“走吧。”

商非凡知道郎沐心里不好过，但他什么也没说，这时候任何安慰的话都毫无意义。

两人回到郎侦伯爵府，就蒙头睡了一大觉。

回去途中，商非凡还给老伏发了一点特别消息过去。

相信今天新出炉的八卦报一定会很火热。

是的，八卦报没有倒闭，只是由明转暗了。
chunks.englishText:
“The Stone Ear chose him, the God of Nature chose him... not me. The God didn't choose me, why refuse to choose me? Why? Clearly, the Stone Ear chose me first...”

“Who is he? He is not Raphael. What kind of monster is he? What is his relationship with the God of Nature? How does he know those bizarre abilities?”

“Kill him! Remil, kill him for me! Sareis, kill him for me! He is not my son, he is a monster! A monster!”

Anita’s mental state seemed to have fractured entirely.

Listening to Anita relentlessly stoke hatred against Raphael, the Tiger King felt an inexplicable, overwhelming wave of irritation.

“Whoosh!”

A mouthful of blazing fire spewed out, landing directly upon Anita.

“You’re actually going to attack me, Sareis? You will regret this, you will definitely regret it! Have you forgotten the oath you once swore to me?”

Amidst her miserable screams and wild laughter, Anita shouted at the top of her lungs, “Sareis Farrel, if I die, you won't have an easy time either!”

The Tiger King furrowed his brow deeply, trying hard as he might to recall what oath he had ever sworn.

Everyone stood in silence as they watched Madam Anita burn into a roaring mass of flames.

When the fire finally died down, Anita had been reduced to a charred corpse.

Even so, the Tiger King drew his blade and personally severed Anita’s head, ordering her remains to be ground to dust and scattered to the winds.

Clement carried out the instructions in silence.

Madam Anita—once the foremost beauty of the royal city, the femme fatale who had stirred up winds and rains and nearly turned the Tiger Kingdom’s royal family upside down—thus reached the final curtain of her life.

Lang Mu actively took Shang Feifan’s hand and whispered, “Let’s go.”

Shang Feifan knew that Lang Mu was feeling heavy-hearted, but he said nothing; any comforting words at this moment would be utterly meaningless.

Upon returning to the Count Lang Manor, the two of them crawled under the covers and slept soundly for a massive stretch of time.

On the way back, Shang Feifan had also dispatched a special piece of news to Old Fu.

He believed that today’s freshly minted tabloid would undoubtedly be a massive hit.

Yes, the tabloid hadn’t gone out of business; it had merely transitioned from the open to the shadows.

chunks.chineseText:
第186章 收尾

郎沐早上起来，双腿一软，赶紧单手撑墙才免于跪到地上。

郎沐脸颊爆红，气得磨牙。

牲口！太牲口了！

缓了好一会儿，他才缓过来。

“阿沐，你怎么了？哪里不舒服吗？”商非凡推门进来，看到郎沐依墙站着，连忙伸手去扶他。

郎沐拍开他的手，给了他一个凶狠的眼神。

商非凡眼里满是笑，再次伸手扶住郎沐。

“我睡了多久？”郎沐一说话，才发现自己声音异常沙哑。

“没多久。刚天亮。”商非凡特别手顺地从空间里拿出一杯水，想要喂给郎沐。

“我自己喝。”郎沐接过水杯，咕咚咕咚一口气全部灌了下去。

商非凡笑着看郎沐。他也没说错，他家阿沐确实没睡多久，昨天他们先是好好睡了一觉，醒来后他就缠着阿沐胡闹了许久，连晚饭都没吃。

郎沐把空杯子递给商非凡，表示要去洗漱。

就算有清洁术，他还是习惯了传统的洗漱。

商非凡很想跟进去，被郎沐拍了出来。

早上到餐厅吃饭时，老伯爵看商非凡的眼神特别不满。

老夫人倒是笑眯眯的，还亲手给郎沐盛了一碗汤，让他多喝一点，说补身体。

郎沐两耳红通通，低头喝汤吃早餐不说话。

可能都是食肉兽人的缘故，伯爵府一大早的早餐就全都是肉，麦饼和汤水之类反而成了辅食。

商非凡脸皮厚，早餐全程愉快得不得了，他饭量还大，吃得特别多。

老伯爵怼他：“就你这胃口，家里没有千亩田，都不敢说能养活你。”

商非凡把郎沐不爱吃的肥肉塞进口中：“没事，阿沐能喂饱我。”

郎沐：“……”

商非凡从他碟子里叉走肥肉的动作太自然，他也没觉得有什么不对。直到看到老伯爵的眼神，他才感到不好意思。

至于商非凡说的话，也没说错啊，他确实有能力喂饱商非凡，而且他喜欢这种能养活自己伴侣、被伴侣依靠的踏实感。

老伯爵气呼呼，阿瑞斯商这家伙比当年娶他女儿的泽沐尔卡内要讨厌多了！

泽沐尔卡内虽然是猛兽，但性格内向，做事说话都是不紧不慢，不喜欢惹事，倒是和阿沐很像。

老伯爵想到去世多年的女儿女婿，心里一阵伤痛，再看狡猾阴狠多面派的阿瑞斯，突又觉得阿瑞斯这样也很好，至少不用担心他吃闷亏。

但他心里又怕老实的郎沐玩不过这一看就特别腹黑的阿瑞斯商。

阿瑞斯愚笨，他愁。

阿瑞斯太聪明，他也愁。

换其他人？

不说郎沐喜欢不喜欢，就说换的人真的能比阿瑞斯更好吗？

可如果郎沐不找伴侣，一直单着，他也会愁。

老伯爵在心里叹息，真的是养儿三百岁，长忧两百九。

老夫人伸手拍了拍老伴，她觉得老头子就是在瞎愁，只看阿瑞斯目前为止所做的一切事情，就知道他有多在意他们的阿沐。

说句夸张点的话，阿瑞斯可是为了郎沐一人，单挑了一国之王。

自家人了解自家事，他们郎家已经势微，就算老头子还有些关系，也无法真的与虎王和王后对抗。

更别说还有一个布局谋算多年的安妮塔躲在后面。

可自从阿瑞斯亮相王城后，先是曾经欺负阿沐的人全都倒了大霉，一个个不说家破人亡，也是家道衰落，原本的高层落入底层，那日子难过得比死还痛苦。

然后就是王后、虎王、安妮塔夫人……

老夫人回过神都感到心惊。

感觉阿瑞斯好像也没做什么，可堂堂一国之主和一国之后就是被整弄到几乎废掉的地步，安妮塔更是连命都没了。

老夫人甚至想，恐怕只要阿瑞斯愿意，他甚至能在短短几个月内彻底颠覆虎国政权。

这个阿瑞斯绝对不是普通出身，老夫人暗想。

“爵爷，这是今天最新的八卦报。”武管家进来，把一份报纸呈给老伯爵。

郎沐对武管家点头打招呼：“早安，武叔。”

商非凡也对武管家道早。

“早安，小少爷。早安，阿瑞斯少爷。”武管家心里满满的欢喜，看着餐厅里轻松用餐说说笑笑的四人，只觉得这才像个家。

老伯爵打开折叠起来的八卦报，从头开始看。

郎沐微惊讶：“现在还能买到八卦报？”

武管家回答：“八卦报社原址被查封了，但报纸还在发行，昨天就有，满大街都是小幼崽在喊着卖八卦报，很多酒馆饭店杂货铺也有的卖。治安局的人想管也管不过来。”

武管家又小声说：“主要是治安局也不敢多管。前天封禁八卦报，死了太多人，当时就已经引起民愤，如果治安局再抢夺商铺和小幼崽手里的报纸，那整个王城都得爆掉。”

郎沐看向商非凡。

商非凡吃饱了，拿起餐巾擦擦嘴：“昨天最热闹的新闻大概就是虎王和众权贵的约定，以及墨文伯爵府为祭祀邪神虐杀上千无辜民众这两条。”

武管家用力点头：没错，就是这两条。

正好一早一晚两条号外。

这两条号外让整个王城都沸腾了。

早上的号外新闻告诉众人，虎王允诺众大臣，一定会在传承大会召开之前找回代表王室象征以及装有王室大半财富的空间腰带，同时消灭王城中藏着的邪神信徒，另外还要想法恢复王室被破坏的声誉。

如果做不到这三点，这些大臣将连同虎国王室宗亲和权贵一起，重新甄选新的国王。

空间腰带长什么样，知道的人并不多。

但不妨碍民众议论，议论到后来，新闻内容就变了样，变成只要有人能找到空间腰带就能成为虎国的新国王。

这下好了，现在王城众人走在路上都会下意识去看别人的腰带，搞得王城人出门都不敢系造型太华贵的腰带，就生怕被人当做王之腰带给抢了。

晚上的号外新闻附带了三张照片。

一张是邪神祭坛，一张是邪神祭坛下露出的上千具尸骨。

拍照者就是商非凡本人。

他在商城购买了一个来自大繁华纪的照相机，类似拍立得。

另外一张照片是八卦报某玩家拍的，拍的是墨文伯爵府被炸得稀烂的模样。

八卦报把这场爆炸和曾经发生在赌博街的一场爆炸联合起来，认为墨文伯爵府在祭祀邪神的过程中不知道做了什么惹怒了邪神，或者是祭祀过程哪里出错，导致祭坛爆炸。

也让墨文伯爵府信仰邪神并虐杀无辜者祭祀邪神的事暴露了出来。

“这八卦报消息怎么这么灵通？他们竟然连虎王抓住安妮塔的事也知道，还知道虎王当场处死了安妮塔。”老伯爵看着今天的新报纸惊讶道。

提供消息的商非凡微微笑。

“安妮塔被抓住了？还被杀死了？”老夫人惊讶万分，让老伯爵念给她听。

郎沐指了指商非凡。

老夫人脸上露出恍然大悟的神情。原来是阿瑞斯干的，那就不奇怪了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 186: Wrapping Up

When Lang Mu woke up in the morning, his legs turned to jelly, and he had to hurriedly brace one hand against the wall to keep from collapsing to the floor.

Lang Mu’s cheeks flushed a blazing red, and he gnashed his teeth in fury.

An absolute beast! Too much of a beast!

It took him quite a while to recover.

“A-Mu, what’s wrong? Are you feeling unwell anywhere?” Shang Feifan pushed the door open and, seeing Lang Mu leaning against the wall, quickly reached out to support him.

Lang Mu swatted his hand away and shot him a fierce glare.

Shang Feifan’s eyes were filled with amusement as he reached out to steady Lang Mu once again.

“How long did I sleep?” Lang Mu asked, only to find his voice unusually hoarse.

“Not long. Just broke dawn.” With practiced smoothness, Shang Feifan produced a cup of water from his spatial storage, intending to feed it to Lang Mu.

“I can drink it myself.” Lang Mu took the cup and chugged the contents down in one go.

Shang Feifan looked at Lang Mu with a smile. He wasn't wrong, strictly speaking—his A-Mu hadn't slept for very long. Yesterday, after they had a proper rest and woke up, he had pestered A-Mu into fooling around with him for ages, to the point that they even skipped dinner.

Lang Mu handed the empty cup back to Shang Feifan, indicating that he needed to wash up.

Even though purification spells existed, he remained accustomed to traditional washing and grooming.

Shang Feifan very much wanted to follow him inside, only to be shoved out by Lang Mu.

When they arrived at the dining room for breakfast in the morning, the old Count cast a look of intense dissatisfaction at Shang Feifan.

The old Madam, however, was all smiles. She personally ladled a bowl of soup for Lang Mu, telling him to drink more to nourish his body.

With his ears burning red, Lang Mu kept his head down, sipping his soup and eating breakfast in silence.

Perhaps due to being carnivorous beastmen, the Count Manor’s breakfast was entirely meat-heavy, with barley cakes and soup serving merely as side dishes.

Shang Feifan was thick-skinned; the entire breakfast was brimful of cheer for him, and possessing a large appetite, he ate a tremendous amount.

The old Count snorted at him: “With an appetite like yours, if a family didn’t own a thousand acres of farmland, they wouldn't dare claim they could afford to feed you.”

Shang Feifan popped a piece of fatty meat that Lang Mu disliked straight into his mouth: “It’s fine, A-Mu can keep me full.”

Lang Mu: “……”

Shang Feifan’s action of forking the fatty meat from his plate was far too natural, and he hadn’t felt anything was amiss until he caught the old Count’s gaze, which finally made him feel embarrassed.

As for what Shang Feifan had said, it wasn't wrong either. He indeed had the ability to feed Shang Feifan, and he rather liked this grounded feeling of being able to support his partner and be relied upon by him.

The old Count fumed inwardly. This fellow Aresi Shang was even more annoying than Zemuer Canei, who had married his daughter back then!

Although Zemuer Canei was a fierce beast, he had an introverted personality, did things and spoke at a leisurely pace, and disliked stirring up trouble—which actually made him quite similar to A-Mu.

Remembering his daughter and son-in-law who had passed away many years ago, a wave of sorrow gripped the old Count's heart. But looking back at the cunning, ruthless, multi-faceted Aresi, he suddenly felt that being like Aresi wasn't bad either—at least there was no need to worry about him suffering in silence.

Yet in his heart, he also feared that the honest Lang Mu wouldn't be able to outplay this seemingly black-bellied Aresi Shang.

If Aresi were foolish, he would worry.

If Aresi was too clever, he would worry just as much.

What about someone else?

Setting aside whether Lang Mu liked them or not, could a replacement truly be better than Aresi?

Yet if Lang Mu didn't find a partner and remained single forever, he would worry about that too.

The old Count sighed inwardly; truly, raising a child for three hundred years leaves you with two hundred and ninety years of worry.

The old Madam reached out and patted her old companion’s hand. She felt the old man was just worrying blindly; judging by everything Aresi had done thus far, anyone could tell how deeply he cared for their A-Mu.

To exaggerate slightly, Aresi had taken on an entire kingdom’s monarch single-handedly, all for Lang Mu’s sake.

Family knows family best; their Lang family was already in decline. Even if the old man still had some connections, he couldn't truly go toe-to-toe with the Tiger King and the Queen.

Not to mention that Madam Anita, who had plotted and schemed for years, was lurking in the background.

Yet ever since Aresi made his appearance in the royal city, first, everyone who used to bully A-Mu suffered terrible misfortune. Leaving aside those whose families were ruined, the rest saw their households decline, with former elites dropping to the very bottom, leading lives so miserable death seemed preferable.

And then came the Queen, the Tiger King, Madam Anita...

When the old Madam looked back on it, she felt a chill in her heart.

It felt as though Aresi hadn't really done much, yet the dignified ruler of a nation and his queen had been pushed to the brink of utter ruin, while Anita had even lost her life.

The old Madam even mused that, perhaps as long as Aresi wished it, he could completely uproot the Tiger Kingdom’s political regime in a matter of mere months.

This Aresi definitely did not come from an ordinary background, the old Madam thought to herself.

“My Lord, here is the latest edition of today’s tabloid.” Steward Wu walked in and presented a newspaper to the old Count.

Lang Mu nodded in greeting to Steward Wu: “Good morning, Uncle Wu.”

Shang Feifan also wished Steward Wu a good morning.

“Good morning, Young Master. Good morning, Young Master Aresi.” Steward Wu’s heart was filled with joy. Looking at the four people dining, chatting, and laughing relaxedly in the dining room, he felt that this finally looked like a proper home.

The old Count unfolded the tabloid and began reading from the beginning.

Lang Mu asked in mild surprise: “You can still buy the tabloid nowadays?”

Steward Wu replied: “The original address of the tabloid office was sealed off, but the newspaper is still in circulation. It was already out yesterday, with little cubs shouting to sell tabloids all over the streets. Many taverns, restaurants, and grocery stores are also selling them. Public Security Bureau officers can’t manage it even if they wanted to.”

Steward Wu added in a low voice: “Mainly because the Public Security Bureau doesn't dare manage it too closely. When they banned the tabloid the day before yesterday, too many people died, which already caused public indignation. If the Public Security Bureau were to go around snatching newspapers from shops and little cubs, the entire royal city would explode.”

Lang Mu looked toward Shang Feifan.

Having eaten his fill, Shang Feifan picked up a napkin to wipe his mouth: “Yesterday’s most sensational news was probably the Tiger King’s pact with the various dignitaries, along with the story about the Mervyn Count Manor slaughtering thousands of innocent citizens as sacrifices to an evil god.”

Steward Wu nodded vigorously: *That’s right, precisely those two items.*

A morning extra and an evening extra, perfectly timed.

These two extra editions had set the entire royal city boiling.

The morning extra news informed everyone that the Tiger King had promised the ministers that he would definitely retrieve the spatial belt—which symbolized the royal authority and contained the majority of the royal family’s wealth—before the upcoming Inheritance Assembly, while simultaneously eradicating the evil god cultists hidden within the royal city, and finding a way to restore the royal family’s damaged reputation.

Few people knew what the spatial belt actually looked like.

That, however, did not stop the citizens from discussing it. The discussions eventually morphed until the news rumor became: whoever could find the spatial belt would become the new king of the Tiger Kingdom.

Well, that changed things. Now, people walking on the streets of the royal city would subconsciously eye other people’s waistlines, making folks too afraid to wear overly extravagant belts when going out, terrified of being mugged under the suspicion of wearing the royal belt.

The evening extra news came attached with three photographs.

One showed the evil god’s altar, and another showed the thousands of skeletons exposed beneath it.

The photographer was none other than Shang Feifan himself.

He had purchased a camera from the Great Prosperous Era through the mall, similar to a Polaroid.

The other photo was taken by a reader of the tabloid, depicting the Mervyn Count Manor blown to absolute smithereens.

The tabloid linked this explosion with the one that had previously occurred on Gambling Street, theorizing that the Mervyn Count Manor must have angered the evil god through some unknown action during their sacrificial ritual, or that something went wrong with the ritual itself, causing the altar to detonate.

This also exposed the Mervyn Count Manor’s faith in the evil god and their slaughter of innocents as sacrifices.

“How does this tabloid get such well-informed news? They even knew about the Tiger King capturing Anita, and that he executed her on the spot,” the old Count said in astonishment as he looked at today’s new paper.

Shang Feifan, the provider of the intelligence, smiled faintly.

“Anita was captured? And killed?” The old Madam was utterly astonished and asked the old Count to read it out to her.

Lang Mu gestured toward Shang Feifan.

A look of sudden realization dawned on the old Madam’s face. So Aresi was the one who did it; that explained everything.

chunks.chineseText:
老伯爵瞪了眼商非凡。就你能干，为什么不把安妮塔抓来他们家，他可是有不少话想跟那心理扭曲的女兽人说道说道。

商非凡指了指郎沐。

快刀斩乱麻也好，免得那女人说什么话让阿沐再心烦。老伯爵轻哼一声，放过了商非凡。

“这份报纸的消息不止一个。还有墨文伯爵府的后续报道，说墨文伯爵夫妇和他们的儿子伊克斯墨文都遭到了怨魂诅咒，墨文伯爵夫妇当场被咒死，死相极为凄惨。而他们的死相也和他们曾经亲自做过的恶事有关。咦？报上说伊克斯墨文失踪了？”

老伯爵坐直身体，仔细往下阅读，看到最后不禁皱起眉头。

老夫人看向老伴：“伊克斯墨文不是被治安局的人看管着的吗？他怎么会失踪？”

武管家可是去看了热闹，亲眼看到伊克斯墨文被治安局的人带走。

因为事情有可能涉及到邪神信徒，特调局的人也来了，还想带走伊克斯墨文，但被治安局的人拒绝。

城卫军和克莱门特就没插手墨文伯爵府的调查，毕竟这事明面看确实属于治安局的管辖范围。

而虎王那边命令克莱门特全力寻找空间腰带，次要寻找安妮塔，第三寻找雷米尔。克莱门特自然也不想给自己多揽事情，他就是去墨文伯爵府看看，然后把看到的内容告诉虎王。之后治安局调查到什么，就由治安局那边禀报。

商非凡对郎沐摇头，表示他也不知道伊克斯墨文失踪一事。

他昨天一天加整个晚上几乎一直待在郎沐身边，就没出去搞事。

老伯爵又发出惊讶声：“怨魂诅咒？八卦报说王城多处出现死相凄惨的人，而且几乎都是在一夜之间发生，有些人没死，但浑身都是怪异伤口，这些人找了药剂师和治疗者，但据说怎么都治不好他们的伤。八卦报呼吁治安局和特调局调查这些死伤者，怀疑他们是否和墨文伯爵府也就是和邪神信徒有关。”

郎家这边对今天的新闻惊奇不已，其他地方也同样。

虎王也看到了今天的八卦报。

这让他又是郁闷，又是无奈，还有一点点对下属无能的愤怒。

他的手底下也有搞情报的人，为什么他们的消息还不如一家报社灵通？

虎王真的特别想要收编八卦报为己用。

可惜……现在八卦报大概最恨的人就是他了。

偏偏他暂时还拿八卦报没办法。

不说这家报社由明转暗，想要寻找他们的新巢穴比较困难。

就说找到了，还能怎样？再大杀特杀一番吗？

如果八卦报在胡说八道，故意污蔑，故意挑起对立，那他还有理由去查封这家报纸、继续抓捕里面的人员。

可人家是真的在实实在在的报道，虽然语言夸张了一点，但基本没有扭曲事实，说的都是真话。

民众也不都是傻子，你说人家瞎写，他们就会真的相信。

他的名声以及威望在这段时间已经降到最低点，再降下去，他恐怕也不用寻找空间腰带，还不如直接把王位让给儿女，还能保住虎国的安稳。

最可笑的是，他堂堂虎王竟然也需要从这八卦报上才能知道王城里最新发生的事情。

就比如伊克斯墨文失踪一事，治安局就没有报上来！

还有王城出现大量被咒死咒伤的人，他也不知道。

“来人！传本王命令，令治安局和特调局联手调查王城中的奇异死者和伤者，务必查明他们是否和邪神信徒有关，包括他们的家人和亲友。如发现异常，不论身份，即刻抓捕！如有违抗者，可就地格杀。”

“是。”侍卫立刻跑去传令。

邪神信徒的危害太大，连老牌贵族墨文伯爵府都被邪神信徒笼络了过去，还有安妮塔好像也在和邪神信徒合作。虎王只觉得这些邪神信徒对虎国图谋日久，恐怕想要颠覆虎国。

为此，他宁可错杀也不愿放过。

虎王脑中甚至冒出一个念头，想要不要把八卦报社的成员也打成邪神信徒。

但他刚冒出这个念头，就自己否决了。

在找回空间腰带、召开传承大会之前，他不想再节外生枝。等到一切稳定下来后，他再来慢慢处理这家八卦报也不迟。

虎王故意忽视了头条新闻。

他看到八卦报曝光他处死安妮塔的事，心里确实很愤怒，更震惊八卦报社的消息渠道。

看完这条新闻他就想命令克莱门特严查当时在现场的所有侍卫。

但他到底忍耐了下来，只让克莱门特暗查是否有侍卫对他不满，或者是和其他权贵勾连。
