他不想让人知道他最依重的近身侍卫营竟然也出现了叛徒，更不想让那些侍卫知道他在怀疑他们。

但虎王还是很痛苦。

他就感到自己特别憋屈。

曾经的他，虽然不能做到完全集权，但也算政令通畅，权贵们都需要看他脸色过日子，民众们就更不用说了，不说崇拜，至少也会尊敬他，极少说他坏话。

可这几个月，尤其这几天！

他感觉自己就像被人掐住了脖子。

明明丹顿家族已经废了大半，王后也跑了，他还把最大的隐患安妮塔给杀了。

他明明应该感到轻松才对，为什么他还是有种喘不过气的窒息感？

呃！虎王抬手捂住脖子。

这不是感觉，他是真的窒息了！

虎王脸色涨红迅速变成发紫。

附近的几个近身侍卫和侍者发现了虎王异常，惊得大喊：“陛下！”

几个侍卫一起冲了过去。

虎王病倒了。

不但呼吸不畅，更浑身火烫。

如果不是他本身就具有释放火焰的天赋能力，可能此刻他已经被高温烧成浆糊。

宫廷药剂师、治疗师，最后连宫廷祭司都来看了，都对虎王的病情束手无策。

他们只能勉强让虎王好过一点，让他不至于死于邪法。

邪法一说是宫廷祭司蚪海潮跟虎王说的，在他使用种种奇怪的炼金道具再三验证后。

他的原话是：“陛下，您身上有共命法则的痕迹。与您建立共命契约的人现在很可能已经死了，而您也被共命契约法则影响，如果不是您身上佩戴着极为珍贵的护命法宝，可能在那个人死时，您也会跟着死亡。”

宫廷祭司示意虎王看他佩戴在胸口的项链。

只见这条晶石项链中的晶石内部竟然出现无数裂纹，似乎稍微碰一下就会变得粉碎。

虎王抬手握住这条晶石项链。

这是他父亲也是前代虎王临死前送给他的礼物，跟空间腰带一样重要。

前虎王告诉他，这条项链可以替一条命，让他无论如何、不论什么时候和场合都不能摘下来。

他佩戴这条项链至今也没有碰到危及生命的危险，让他不禁有点怀疑这项链是否真的有替命功效。

现在他终于碰到了让这条项链发挥作用的极致危险，可这条项链也就是保证他暂时不死而已。

他仍旧呼吸不畅，只觉脖子被人勒住，又像是吸不到新鲜空气。

他浑身火烫，就如有烈火在内部炙烤着他。
chunks.englishText:
The Old Count glared at Shang Feifan. Of all the capable ones, why didn't he just drag Anita back to their house? There were quite a few things he'd been dying to say to that warped, twisted female beast-person.

Shang Feifan pointed toward Lang Mu.

A quick end was probably for the best, anyway; it would spare the woman from saying anything that might upset A-Mu further. The Old Count let out a soft huff and let Shang Feifan off the hook.

"There's more than one piece of news in this paper. There's also a follow-up report on the Marquis of Moven's estate. It says the Marquis and his wife, along with their son, Ikes Moven, all fell victim to a vengeful soul curse. The Marquis and his wife were cursed to death on the spot, and their corpses looked utterly wretched—a state of death that apparently tied directly back to the evil deeds they had personally committed in the past. Huh? The paper says Ikes Moven is missing?"

The Old Count straightened up, reading on more carefully, his brows furrowing deeply by the end.

The Old Lady looked over at her husband. "Isn't Ikes Moven being kept under watch by the Public Security Bureau? How could he have gone missing?"

Butler Wu had actually gone to watch the commotion and had seen with his own eyes Ikes Moven being hauled away by the Public Security Bureau.

Because the matter potentially involved Cultists of the Evil God, the Special Investigation Bureau had also turned up and tried to take Ikes Moven into custody, but the Public Security Bureau had flatly refused.

The City Garrison and Clement hadn't interfered with the investigation into the Marquis of Moven's estate; on the surface, after all, the matter clearly fell under the jurisdiction of the Public Security Bureau.

Moreover, the Tiger King had ordered Clement to focus entirely on finding the spatial belt, with secondary priority given to finding Anita, and tertiary priority to Remiel. Naturally, Clement didn't want to pile any extra trouble onto his own plate. He had simply gone to the Marquis of Moven's estate to take a look, then reported what he saw to the Tiger King. Whatever the Public Security Bureau investigated afterward would be reported by them.

Shang Feifan shook his head at Lang Mu, indicating he knew nothing about Ikes Moven's disappearance either.

He had stayed by Lang Mu's side for almost the entire day and night yesterday and hadn't gone out stirring up trouble at all.

The Old Count let out another sound of astonishment. "A vengeful soul curse? The gossip rag says multiple people across the Royal City have turned up dead in horrific states, and almost all of it happened overnight. Some didn't die, but their entire bodies are covered in bizarre wounds. These people have sought out apothecaries and healers, but reportedly, no one can cure their injuries. The gossip rag is calling on the Public Security Bureau and the Special Investigation Bureau to investigate these casualties, suspecting whether they might be connected to the Marquis of Moven's estate—in other words, to the Cultists of the Evil God."

While the Lang family was filled with astonishment at today's news, the rest of the city was reacting in much the same way.

The Tiger King had also laid eyes on today's gossip rag.

It left him feeling depressed, utterly helpless, and harboring a tiny spark of wrath toward the incompetence of his subordinates.

He had intelligence operatives under his command; why on earth was their information nowhere near as well-informed as a mere newspaper office?

The Tiger King genuinely, desperately wanted to co-opt the gossip rag for his own use.

Pity... right now, the person the gossip rag probably hated most in the entire world was him.

Yet, for the time being, there was nothing he could do to the publication.

Leaving aside the fact that the newspaper office had shifted from the open into the shadows, making it rather difficult to track down their new hideout,

even if he did manage to find it, what then? Slaughter them all over again in a massive rampage?

If the gossip rag were purely spouting nonsense, deliberately slandering him, and intentionally stirring up societal division, he would at least have grounds to seal down the paper and continue arresting its personnel.

The problem was that these people were actually reporting hard facts. Granted, their phrasing was a little exaggerated, but they fundamentally hadn't twisted the truth—everything they printed was real.

The common folk weren't all fools; you couldn't just shout that someone was writing lies and expect them to blindly believe it.

His reputation and prestige had already plummeted to rock-bottom over this past period. If they dropped any further, he probably wouldn't even need to bother searching for the spatial belt; he might as well just hand the throne directly to his children, which at least stood a chance of preserving stability in the Tiger Kingdom.

The most laughable part of it all was that he, the mighty Tiger King, actually had to rely on this very gossip rag to find out what was newly happening inside his own Royal City!

Take Ikes Moven's disappearance, for instance—the Public Security Bureau hadn't reported a single word of it up to him!

And he had been completely oblivious to the massive wave of people being cursed to death or injury across the Royal City either.

"Someone come! Convey My decree: order the Public Security Bureau and the Special Investigation Bureau to join forces and investigate the bizarre deaths and injuries within the Royal City. They must ascertain whether these incidents are linked to the Cultists of the Evil God, and extend the check to include their families and close associates. Should any abnormalities be discovered, apprehend them immediately, regardless of status! Any who dare to resist may be executed on the spot."

"Understood." A guard immediately sprinted off to transmit the order.

The threat posed by the Cultists of the Evil God was far too great; even an old-line noble house like the Marquis of Moven's estate had been subverted and roped in by them, and Anita seemed to be collaborating with them as well. The Tiger King could only conclude that these cultists had been plotting against the Tiger Kingdom for a long time, and their ultimate goal was likely to overthrow the nation.

With stakes like these, he would rather kill the innocent by mistake than let a single guilty party slip through.

A stray thought even flashed through the Tiger King's mind: should he brand the members of the gossip rag office as Cultists of the Evil God as well?

But the moment the thought surfaced, he dismissed it himself.

Before recovering the spatial belt and holding the Grand Inheritance Assembly, he did not want to branch out into any more side troubles. Once everything had stabilized, it wouldn't be too late to slowly deal with this wretched newspaper.

The Tiger King deliberately glossed over the headline news.

When he saw the gossip rag expose the fact that he had executed Anita, a surge of genuine fury ignited in his chest, compounded by shock at the gossip rag's intelligence channels.

The moment he finished reading that piece of news, he had wanted to order Clement to strictly interrogate every single guard who had been present at the scene.

In the end, though, he managed to restrain himself, restricting his orders to having Clement secretly investigate whether any guards harbored resentment toward him or were colluding with other high-ranking nobles.

He did not want outsiders to learn that a traitor had actually surfaced within his most trusted elite personal guard battalion, nor did he want those guards to realize he was suspecting them.

Yet the Tiger King was in absolute agony.

He felt an overwhelming sense of suffocating grievance.

In the past, even if he couldn't achieve total centralization of power, his royal decrees had at least flowed smoothly. The high nobles had all needed to gauge his expression to survive, and as for the common populace—forget about adoring him, they had at least respected him, rarely ever speaking ill of him.

Yet these past few months, especially these last few days!

He felt as though someone had a chokehold clamped tightly around his throat.

Clearly, the Danton family had been mostly dismantled, the Queen had fled, and he had even slain his greatest hidden hazard, Anita.

He ought to have felt a sense of relief; why, then, did he still have this suffocating sensation, as though he couldn't draw a breath?

*Urk!* The Tiger King raised a hand to clutch his own throat.

This wasn't just a feeling—he was genuinely suffocating!

The Tiger King's complexion flushed a deep crimson, rapidly turning into a bruised, terrifying purple.

Several nearby personal guards and attendants noticed the Tiger King's distress and cried out in absolute terror, "Your Majesty!"

A handful of guards rushed forward all at once.

The Tiger King had collapsed.

Not only was his breathing obstructed, but his entire body was burning with a raging, fiery heat.

Had he not possessed an innate talent and ability related to the release of flame, he likely would have already been baked into a boiling paste by the searing temperature.

The royal apothecaries, the healers, and ultimately even the Grand Royal Priest were summoned to examine him, yet every single one of them was utterly powerless against the Tiger King's condition.

The best they could manage was to slightly ease the Tiger King's suffering just enough to keep him from dying instantly of dark sorcery.

The mention of "dark sorcery" had come from Dou Haichao, the Grand Royal Priest, after he used a battery of strange alchemical instruments to verify the situation over and over again.

His exact words were: "Your Majesty, there are traces of the Law of Shared Destiny upon your person. The individual who forged the mutual destiny pact with you is very likely dead at this moment, and you have been affected by the laws of that pact. Were it not for the immensely precious life-saving magical treasure you wear upon your person, you would likely have died alongside that person the moment they drew their last breath."

The Grand Royal Priest motioned for the Tiger King to look at the necklace resting upon his chest.

Lo and behold, countless spiderweb cracks had formed within the crystal core of the crystal necklace, looking as though the slightest touch would cause it to shatter into fine powder.

The Tiger King raised a hand to grip the crystal necklace.

This was a gift given to him by his father, the late Tiger King, on his deathbed—an artifact just as crucial as the spatial belt.

The former Tiger King had told him that this necklace could substitute for his life once, instructing him never to take it off under any circumstances, no matter when or where.

He had worn this necklace up to the present day without ever running into a life-threatening crisis, which had occasionally made him wonder if the necklace truly possessed the power to substitute for a life.

Now, he had finally encountered the ultimate peril that forced this necklace into action, but the necklace was merely keeping him from dying on the spot.

His breathing remained obstructed; it felt as though someone had a stranglehold around his neck, or as though he were trapped somewhere utterly devoid of fresh air.

His entire body burned like fire, as if blazing flames were roasting him from the inside out.

chunks.chineseText:
“共命契约？不可能。我没有和任何人建立这样的契约。”虎王断然否认。

祭司：“您再想想，您可以先从您身上的症状想一想，您表现出来的症状很可能是对方死时的遭遇。您想到死者是谁，也许就能想起您是否和对方建立过共命契约。”

虎王一听这话，脑中立刻想到了安妮塔。

安妮塔被他用火焰焚烧，安妮塔还被他砍下了头颅。

后者不说，前者就能造成窒息和火燎这两种症状。

难道真的是安妮塔？！

虎王惊疑不定，他继而想到了安妮塔临死时喊出来的那些话。

他以为安妮塔只是不甘心被他处死，想要他也不好过，才会喊出那些“她死了他也活不了”的话。

可只不过一天，安妮塔说的话就在他身上应验了。

难道他真的和安妮塔结过共命契约？

虎王用力地想，他从来没有这么认真地回想一件事。

想了很久，他终于隐约想起来，在他认识安妮塔大约大半年后，也是在安妮塔怀上雷米尔的那一阵子，他和安妮塔好到蜜里调油，那时他几乎每晚都要去看安妮塔。

有一天，在他与安妮塔你侬我侬时，安妮塔说愿意为他献出生命，说不求同年同月同日死，只求能在他身边有个依偎的位置，他一时心情激荡，加上那时候箭在弦上，脑子一热好像就许诺会和安妮塔同生共死。

但是那在他看来就是情热时说的甜言蜜语，根本当不了真。

他也没有发誓，他就是随口一说。

祭司：“看来您是想起来了。”

虎王脱口道：“我没有发誓，我只是随口说了会和她同生共死，那就是一句……”

“对方是安妮塔夫人？”

“是。”

祭司垂下眼眸：“有心算无心，安妮塔夫人早与邪神信徒勾连，她很可能用了什么邪法，只要您说出同生共死一类的话，就算契约成立。”

“这个恶毒阴险的女人！”虎王气到吐血。

安妮塔竟然那么早就算计他，可能安妮塔自己都不太相信这个邪法能成功，否则安妮塔被他处死前肯定会用这个契约来威胁他，而不是只是喊几句空话。

安妮塔死时可能也没想到这个共命契约真的成立了。

可惜安妮塔不知道，如果她死后有知，恐怕也得跟他一样活活再气死一遍。

多好的威胁手段啊，就这么浪费了。

虎王想笑，疯狂大笑。

噗！虎王喷出一口血，人转眼昏死过去。

宫廷祭司和治疗师一起为虎王医治，确认虎王是受到极大刺激，情绪激荡下导致内火上升，身体压不住高温炙烤导致脏腑受伤。

虎王没死，但等他再次醒来，他已经没有了正常办事的能力。

祭司非常遗憾地告诉虎王：“除非安妮塔活过来，否则您只能被活活拖死。这是共命法则在起作用，您的替命项链相当于在帮您作弊，但作弊就是作弊，法则的力量异常强大，就是神灵也不能抗衡，您以后可能就只能保命了，算是处在死亡与未死之间。”

虎王迷茫。

事情怎么就变成这样了？

他昨天还能手刃千敌，怎么今天他就变成了只能躺在床上、还是需要躺上一辈子的病歪歪？

祭司叹息：“这应该是邪神信徒的阴谋。他们可能也没有告诉安妮塔夫人太多，但这显然是他们下的一步棋，如果安妮塔夫人阴谋得逞，让雷米尔坐上王位，对邪神信徒来说最好。如果不能，安妮塔夫人被抓被杀，不管是被王后还是被您，或者死在其他人手中，您也会跟着出事，而虎国将会陷入换位的震荡中。怎么做，邪神信徒都不亏。”

虎王：“……”

虎王闭上眼睛，过了好一会儿，才声音嘶哑地说道：“请大都督狮域、宰相艾萨克、城卫军统领角合，还有侍卫统领克莱门特过来一趟。请祭司你也在场旁听。”

祭司点头：“好。”

同一时间，商非凡带着郎沐出门晃荡，三晃两晃，晃丢所有跟踪者，进入了克莱门特的府邸。

“请帮我把这条腰带交给大王子。”郎沐拿出一条华丽的腰带递给克莱门特。

饶是克莱门特对郎沐十分欣赏并认定他能力卓绝，还是愣了好几秒：“腰带怎么会到你手中？”

郎沐摆手：“这不是原版腰带。这是阿瑞斯专门为大王子炼制，算是感谢他送给我的礼物。不过这也是一条空间腰带就是。”

克莱门特心情复杂地接过腰带，“那我就代大王子殿下谢过二位。”

如果真的找不到原版腰带，用这条也能搪塞过去，大概。

好歹也是块遮羞布。反正都是空间腰带，外形也相似。

而大王子拥有这条腰带，对于他继承王位自然有极大好处。

“我能跟陛下说明这条腰带的来历吗？”克莱门特问。

商非凡懂，克莱门特这句问话也是在为大王子解除后顾之忧，免得有人怀疑他和腰带盗窃者有关。

郎沐点头：“可以。”

他们做得越是大方，虎王也就越不会怀疑他们。不过就算怀疑原版腰带在他们手上，那又怎样？

大不了就和虎王打一架嘛。

就在这时，王宫里有人来传话，让克莱门特立刻进宫一趟，不得耽误。

商非凡和郎沐见克莱门特有事，也没再和他多聊，转眼就不见人影。

克莱门特对这两人的神出鬼没也是无可奈何，思考片刻，带着那条空间腰带，立刻奔去王宫。

商非凡和郎沐摸到了二王子名下的俱乐部，也就是那家神秘学同好研究会所在地。

两人把一些东西放到俱乐部的密室里，又留下一些痕迹，这才从研究会离开。

“虎王已经知道安妮丽娜被关在墨文伯爵府的地牢里，这样做会让他怀疑吧？”

“就虎王那个性子，他一定会想，这到底是真的有人栽赃二王子，还是二王子故意想要让他以为有人栽赃他，从而好方便二王子将来有借口拿出腰带。”

郎沐哭笑不得：“你还真是号准了王者多疑这个通病。”

商非凡表示这就是基操，不值得夸奖。

没多久，正在一家酒馆和一帮纨绔胡混的三王子看到了一个疑似安妮丽娜的身影，兴奋得当即就率人追了上去。

安妮丽娜=空间腰带！

三王子怎么可能不兴奋？

就算他在兄弟姐妹中得到王位的机会最低，但如果能找到腰带交给父王，不说父王会不会对他刮目相看，以后他一定也能在兄弟姐妹中昂起脑袋走路。

三王子带着一帮子走狗和打手，就这么一路跟到了一家高端俱乐部的门口，并亲眼看到那疑似安妮丽娜的人跑进了俱乐部。
chunks.englishText:
“A Symbiotic Fate Pact? Impossible. I have never established such a pact with anyone,” the Tiger King flatly denied.

The high priest replied, “Your Majesty, please think carefully. You can start by considering the symptoms you are currently experiencing; the manifestations you show are likely the exact suffering the other person endured at the moment of death. If you can think of who the deceased was, perhaps you will remember whether you ever forged a Symbiotic Fate Pact with them.”

Upon hearing this, the Tiger King instantly thought of Anita.

Anita had been burned by his flames; Anita’s head had also been severed by his blade.

Setting the latter aside, the former alone could easily cause both the symptoms of suffocation and scorching heat.

Could it really be Anita?!

A wave of dread and suspicion washed over the Tiger King. Following that, he recalled the final words Anita had shouted as she faced her death.

He had simply assumed that Anita was merely unwilling to accept her execution and wanted to make things difficult for him as well, which was why she had screamed that “if she died, he wouldn’t live either.”

Yet barely a day had passed before Anita’s words came true upon his own body.

Could it be that he truly had formed a Symbiotic Fate Pact with Anita?

The Tiger King racked his brain, forcing himself to recall a memory with a degree of seriousness he had never mustered before.

After pondering for a long time, he finally managed to vaguely remember that it was roughly half a year after he had first met Anita, around the time she had conceived Remil. Back then, they were as sweet and inseparable as honey and oil, and he would go to see Anita almost every single night.

One day, amidst their passionate whispering of sweet nothings, Anita had proclaimed that she was willing to sacrifice her life for him. She said she didn’t ask to die on the same month, day, or year, but only prayed for a place to lean upon by his side. Swept up in the heat of the moment—and with the arrow already taut on the bowstring—his head had grown hot, and it seemed he had indeed promised to live and die together with Anita.

To him, however, that was merely sweet-talking pillow talk uttered in the throes of passion, something entirely impossible to take seriously.

He hadn't sworn any oaths; it was just something he had blurted out casually.

The high priest remarked, “It seems Your Majesty has remembered.”

The Tiger King blurted out, “I didn’t swear an oath! I just casually said I’d live and die with her, that was just a—”

“Was the other party Lady Anita?”

“Yes.”

The high priest lowered his gaze. “A deliberate plot against the unsuspecting. Lady Anita had long since colluded with the Evil God's cultists; she likely employed some sort of dark sorcery. As long as you uttered phrases about living and dying together, the pact was considered established.”

“That vicious, scheming woman!” The Tiger King was so furious he spat a mouthful of blood.

Never had he imagined that Anita would scheme against him from so long ago. It was likely that even Anita herself hadn't been entirely certain the dark sorcery would succeed; otherwise, before he had her executed, she surely would have used this pact to threaten him rather than merely shouting empty threats.

When Anita died, she probably hadn't expected that this Symbiotic Fate Pact would actually take effect.

Pity that Anita was oblivious to it; if she knew this in the netherworld, she would likely be infuriated to the point of dying of anger all over again, just like him.

What an extraordinary threat to hold over someone, yet it had been completely wasted like that.

The Tiger King wanted to laugh—he laughed with mad hysteria.

*Puff!* The Tiger King coughed up another mouthful of blood and collapsed, passing out cold in an instant.

The court priests and healers rushed to treat the Tiger King, ultimately confirming that he had suffered a massive psychological shock. The violent emotional turmoil had caused his inner fire to surge, and because his body could no longer suppress the searing heat, his internal organs had sustained severe damage.

The Tiger King did not die, but when he regained consciousness once more, he had completely lost the capacity to function as a normal man.

With profound regret, the high priest informed the Tiger King, “Unless Anita comes back to life, Your Majesty can only be dragged down to your death by inches. This is the operation of the Laws of Symbiosis. Your Life-Substitution Necklace is currently equivalent to helping you cheat, but cheating is still cheating. The power of the Law is exceptionally formidable; even deities cannot contend with it. From now on, you will likely only be able to preserve your life, existing somewhere between the living and the dead.”

The Tiger King was dazed and bewildered.

How on earth had things turned out like this?

Only yesterday, he was capable of slaying a thousand enemies with his own hands; how had he transformed into a bedridden invalid today—and one who would be confined to a bed for the rest of his life?

The high priest sighed. “This must be a conspiracy by the Evil God's cultists. They probably didn't reveal too much to Lady Anita either, but this is evidently a move they laid out in advance. If Lady Anita’s conspiracy had succeeded and allowed Remil to ascend the throne, that would have been the best outcome for the cultists. If it failed and Lady Anita was captured and slain—whether by the Queen, by Your Majesty, or by the hands of someone else—you would still be implicated, throwing the Tiger Kingdom into a violent upheaval of succession. No matter how it played out, the Evil God's cultists would never lose.”

The Tiger King: “……”

The Tiger King closed his eyes. After quite a long while, he spoke in a hoarse, raspy voice, “Have Grand Commander Lion Realm, Prime Minister Isaac, City Guard Commander Jiao He, and Guard Commander Clement come here at once. And High Priest, I must ask you to stay and observe the proceedings.”

The high priest nodded. “Very well.”

At the same time, Shang Feifan took Lang Mu out for a stroll. After making a few twists and turns, they easily shook off all their trackers and entered Clement’s manor.

“Please help me deliver this belt to the First Prince.” Lang Mu produced an ornate belt and handed it to Clement.

Even though Clement held a deep appreciation for Lang Mu and recognized his exceptional abilities, he still froze for several long seconds. “How did this belt end up in your hands?”

Lang Mu waved a hand dismissively. “This isn't the original belt. It’s one Ares specially forged for the First Prince, as a token of gratitude for the gift he gave me. Though, it is a spatial belt nonetheless.”

With a conflicted expression, Clement accepted the belt. “Then on behalf of His Highness the First Prince, I thank the two of you.”

If the original belt truly could not be found, passing this one off as the original would probably suffice—somehow.

At the very least, it provided a shred of plausible deniability. Since it was a spatial belt anyway, the appearance was remarkably similar.

Moreover, for the First Prince to possess such a belt would naturally bring immense advantages to his bid for the throne.

“May I explain the origins of this belt to His Majesty?” Clement asked.

Shang Feifan understood. Clement’s question was also intended to clear the First Prince of any lingering worries, lest anyone suspect him of having a hand in the theft of the original belt.

Lang Mu nodded. “You may.”

The more magnanimous and open they acted, the less the Tiger King would suspect them. But even if the Tiger King did suspect that the original belt was in their possession, so what?

At worst, they would just have a go and fight the Tiger King.

Just then, a messenger from the royal palace arrived, ordering Clement to enter the palace immediately without a moment's delay.

Noticing that Clement was occupied, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu did not linger to chat further. In the blink of an eye, they had vanished without a trace.

Clement could only sigh in helpless resignation at the enigmatic, ghost-like arrivals and departures of these two. After a moment of contemplation, he clutched the spatial belt and hurried straight toward the royal palace.

Meanwhile, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu slipped into a club belonging to the Second Prince—none other than the headquarters of that esoteric occult research society.

The two deposited several items inside the club's secret chamber and deliberately left behind a trail of clues before departing the research society.

“The Tiger King already knows that Annelina is locked up in the dungeon of Count Moven’s estate. Won't doing this make him suspicious?”

“Given the Tiger King’s temperament, he will definitely start thinking: Is this truly someone framing the Second Prince, or did the Second Prince deliberately want to make him *think* someone was framing him, just so the Second Prince would have a convenient excuse to produce the belt in the future?”

Lang Mu laughed in spite of himself. “You really have the paranoia common to monarchs completely pegged down.”

Shang Feifan remarked that this was merely basic operation and not worth praising.

Before long, the Third Prince—who had been carousing and running amok with a pack of hedonistic nobles at a tavern—caught sight of a figure who looked suspiciously like Annelina. Seized with instant excitement, he immediately led his men in hot pursuit.

Annelina meant the spatial belt!

How could the Third Prince *not* be excited?

Even if his chances of seizing the throne were the slimmest among all his siblings, if he could find the belt and present it to his Royal Father, not to mention whether his father would look at him in a new light, he would certainly be able to walk with his head held high among his brothers and sisters from then on.

Leading his entourage of sycophants and thugs, the Third Prince trailed the target all the way to the entrance of an exclusive, high-end club, and watched with his own eyes as the person resembling Annelina darted inside.

chunks.chineseText:
第187章 选择继承人

商非凡原本要带郎沐去破坏某个玩家传送阵，但就在他和天眼系统沟通时，得到一个消息。

“我们去王宫。”

“王宫又怎么了？”郎沐是真的不想再去王宫，他现在就想快点解决邪神信徒，好早点离开王城这个是非地。

商非凡扯了扯他：“虎王病倒了。他还喊了宰相和大都督等大臣进宫。刚才克莱门特不是被虎王派人来叫走了吗，就是这事。”

“虎王病倒？怎么会？”郎沐奇怪，虎王的身体向来康健，好端端的怎么说病倒就病倒？还病到不得不喊几个重要大臣的程度？

“可能和安妮塔或和邪神信徒有关。我们去看看。”

这么重要的事情，商非凡肯定要掌握第一手消息。

如果他家阿沐有当王的野心，这对他们来说绝对是一个极好机会。

可惜阿沐半点不想当王，还希望虎国的王位继承权能平稳过度，就是不想要虎国出事。

可现在虎王突然病倒，大王子的根脚还没有稳固，二王子又和天残谷主搅合到一起，邪神信徒也在暗中露出獠牙，怎么看对于虎国来说都是一个不祥征兆。

“希望不是邪神信徒搞出来的事。”郎沐神色沉重，他对虎王的感情比较纠结，原本想着就此不见也算了结。可这会儿听到他病得都要喊大臣来床边了，他又忍不住担心起来。

商非凡握紧他的手，他其实也不太想让郎沐见到虎王。

他家阿沐最大的毛病就是心软。只要有人对他有过一分好，他都能记一辈子。

虎王坑了他，可也照顾过他，对他好过。那份照顾和欣赏更是让雷米尔都妒忌的地步。

商非凡也能看出来，虎王对郎沐不说有十分真心，但三四分还是有的。

尤其有个安妮塔做比较。

安妮塔还是郎沐名义上的母亲，更和郎沐一起生活了那么多年，可阿沐却没有从她身上感到半点母爱。

如果安妮塔能稍微对阿沐好一点，他都别想要了安妮塔的命。

实际上，阿沐也没有要安妮塔的命，反而是安妮塔又是毒-药又是污蔑，一心想要害死阿沐。

阿沐把安妮塔送去给虎王，如果虎王看在往日情分上留安妮塔活命，想来阿沐也不会有任何意见。

算了，去看看。然后真正做个了结，也免得将来阿沐还惦记着这些不值得惦记的人。

大都督等人站在虎王寝宫里，神色都很沉重。

不管他们心里有什么想法，看到虎王从那么生龙活虎的一个人突然变成连喘气都不利索的病人躺在床上，以后也可能站不起来，他们心里还是很不是滋味。

尤其虎王还是虎国最强大的武力，是虎国的支柱。

一旦虎王病弱的消息传出去，那影响会极为可怕。

尤其在春季材料展销大会已经召开，王城中到处都是其他国家的人。更不要说虎王还到处送邀请函邀请其他国家和部落的人来参加传承分享大会。

这时候虎王倒下，真的是再也没有什么事能比这个更糟糕。

某些权贵想要虎王下台，不过是受不了虎王想要集权，想要换一个更好控制也更温和的国王上位。

但他们并没有想要虎王死，不但不想要虎王死，他们还希望虎王能好好地活着，继续威慑其他国家和大部落的兽人。

虽然他们知道虎王活着，必然会影响下一个新虎王的政策和想法。

这就是一种很矛盾的想法，说白了就是这个也想要那个也想要。

又想要现任虎王的武力给他们撑起一片天，又想要新任虎王能给他们权力和自由。

祭司有座位，单独坐在一边，他就是一个旁观者和见证者，不会给出任何意见。

虎王叫来的这几位都是真正的保王党，也是他最为信任的几个人。

哪怕就在几天前，这几个人除了克莱门特和祭司，都背刺过他。但好歹他们不是真的想要他下台，而只是想要逼迫他早点找回空间腰带和挽回王室名声。

何况虎王现在的情况也容不得他隐瞒和拖延下去。

“都不用沉默，说说你们的意见。现在必须选出下一个继任者，你们觉得几名王子和公主，谁更适合成为新的国王？”

虎王喘息着：“我说话很吃力，别逼我一次又一次重复。”

大都督看到虎王连喘息都吃力的模样，不忍地转过头。

看着往昔强大的人就这么倒下，越是把他当对手的人越是难受。

“我提议大王子。”宰相艾萨克第一个开口。

城卫军统领角合点头：“大王子可。名正言顺，能力也不错。”

克莱门特没吭声，大家的目光就落到大都督身上。

大都督身为虎国最高军事长官，她的意见无疑非常重要。

几个人心里都想着大都督也许会选择大公主，毕竟大公主几乎就算是她弟子。

大都督狮域却问虎王：“你中意谁？”

几人心想，虎王肯定选择大王子啊。

没想到虎王却犹豫了一下，断断续续地说：“老三不行，他被他母亲养废了，就是个纨绔，脑子也不清醒，容易被身边人撺掇。”

几位虎国最位高权重的大人全都点头，三王子算是被他们首先放弃的继任者。

虎王：“玛瓦虽是女孩子，能力并不弱，尤其她还有野心。可她的最大缺点就是过于冷漠，且没有容人之心。她适合开疆扩土，但不适合成为一国之主，除非有……拥有强大行政管理能力的人愿意辅佐她，还能影响她。”

虎王话看似说完，但在场的谁不是政治上的人精，一听虎王的话就明白，虎王并不想让大公主继位，他怕大公主穷兵黩武，更怕大公主在外征战，实际却被人架空，最后沦落为一个国家战斗武器。

同时虎王还担心大公主一旦继位就会对几个兄弟下手，包括对她有一定威胁性的王室成员也不会放过，而像雷米尔这样的私生子必然是第一个死的。

虎王想要抓回雷米尔，也就是想要教训他，并没有想要处死他或流放他。

他不承认雷米尔的王室成员身份是一回事，但雷米尔是他亲生儿子这点永远不会改变，哪怕他母亲是安妮塔。

他同样痛恨王后，可他还不是要把王位传给王后生的孩子？

虎王看向大都督，他也以为大都督会支持大公主上位。

谁想大都督神色平静，直接问：“大王子和二王子，您属意哪一位？”

虎王沉默了好一会儿。

他原本以为老二无意王位，以后就想在学术界发展，虽然他沉迷的是神秘学，感觉有点不着调。

但那天二王子在王宫的表现，让他意识到老二也许并不是对王位没有意图，只是很会蹈光隐晦，说不定正在暗中积蓄力量。

虎王认为二王子的选择很正确，与其早早发力让人注意到他，让大王子把他当敌人，让自己正当年的父王也戒备他，还不如暗中发展，争取他这个父王的好感，等到他这个父王年老体衰时，再一举发力。

Chapter 187: Choosing a Successor (Part 1)

Shang Feifan had originally planned to take Lang Mu to sabotage a certain player teleportation array, but just as he was communicating with the Sky Eye system, he received a piece of news.

"We're heading to the royal palace."

"What's wrong with the royal palace again?" Lang Mu genuinely did not want to step foot into the palace anymore. Right now, he just wanted to quickly deal with the Evil God's followers so he could leave this right-and-wrong vortex of the Royal City as soon as possible.

Shang Feifan tugged at his sleeve. "The Tiger King has fallen ill. He's also summoned the Prime Minister, the Grand Marshal, and other high-ranking ministers to the palace. Wasn't Clement just sent for by one of the Tiger King's men a moment ago? That's what this is about."

"The Tiger King has fallen ill? How is that possible?" Lang Mu was perplexed. The Tiger King's constitution had always been robust. How could someone who was perfectly fine suddenly fall ill out of nowhere? And to the extent that he had to summon several key ministers to his side?

"It's probably related to Anita or the Evil God's followers. Let's go take a look."

With a matter this important, Shang Feifan naturally wanted to secure first-hand intelligence.

If his beloved Mu had any ambitions of claiming the throne, this would undoubtedly be an exceptional opportunity for them.

Unfortunately, Mu had zero desire to become king. He only hoped that the succession to the Tiger Kingdom's throne would transition smoothly, simply wishing to prevent any disaster from befalling the kingdom.

Yet now, the Tiger King had suddenly fallen ill, the First Prince's foundation was not yet secure, the Second Prince had gotten tangled up with the Master of the Heavenly Remnant Valley, and the Evil God's followers were secretly baring their fangs. No matter how one looked at it, this was an ominous omen for the Tiger Kingdom.

"I hope this isn't something stirred up by the Evil God's followers." Lang Mu's expression grew heavy. His feelings toward the Tiger King were rather conflicted; he had originally thought that never seeing each other again would bring closure to the matter. But now, upon hearing that the king was sick enough to summon ministers to his bedside, he couldn't help but worry.

Shang Feifan gripped his hand tightly. To be honest, he didn't really want Lang Mu to see the Tiger King either.

The biggest flaw in his Mu was his soft heart. As long as someone had shown him even a fraction of kindness, he would remember it for a lifetime.

The Tiger King had schemed against him, but he had also looked after him and treated him well. That care and appreciation had even reached a level that made Remiel jealous.

Shang Feifan could also tell that while the Tiger King's feelings for Lang Mu weren't entirely sincere, there was at least a thirty or forty percent genuine sentiment there.

Especially when compared to Anita.

Anita was Lang Mu's nominal mother and had lived with Lang Mu for so many years, yet Mu had never felt even a shred of maternal love from her.

If Anita had been just a tiny bit nicer to Mu, he wouldn't have bothered taking her life.

In reality, Mu hadn't even taken Anita's life; instead, Anita had resorted to poisons and slander, single-mindedly trying to murder Mu.

Mu had handed Anita over to the Tiger King. If the Tiger King chose to spare Anita's life for the sake of past sentiment, Mu likely wouldn't have any objections.

Forget it. Let's go take a look. Then they could truly bring this to a final close, sparing Mu from continuing to dwell on people who weren't worth remembering.

The Grand Marshal and the others stood inside the Tiger King's bedchamber, all of their expressions grave.

Regardless of what thoughts they harbored inwardly, seeing the Tiger King—someone who had always been so full of life and vigor—suddenly reduced to a patient struggling even to draw a breath, lying on the bed and perhaps never able to stand again, left a very bitter taste in their mouths.

Especially since the Tiger King was the Tiger Kingdom's greatest military might and its ultimate pillar of support.

Once the news of the Tiger King's frailty leaked out, the repercussions would be terrifyingly severe.

This was especially true given that the Spring Material Exhibition and Sales Convention was already underway, with people from other nations swarming everywhere in the Royal City. Not to mention that the Tiger King had been sending out invitations far and wide, inviting people from other countries and tribes to attend the Heritage Sharing Convention.

For the Tiger King to collapse at a time like this—truly, no event could possibly be worse than this.

Certain nobles and high-ranking officials wanted the Tiger King to step down simply because they couldn't stand his drive for centralized power and wanted to replace him with a more compliant and moderate monarch.

However, they did not want the Tiger King to die. Not only did they not want him dead, but they desperately hoped he would live on in good health to continue serving as a deterrent against other nations and the beastmen of the great tribes.

Even though they knew that as long as the Tiger King lived, it would inevitably constrain the policies and visions of the next Tiger King.

This was a deeply contradictory mindset; to put it bluntly, they wanted to have their cake and eat it too.

They wanted the current Tiger King's martial might to hold up the sky for them, yet they also wanted the new Tiger King to grant them power and freedom.

The High Priest had his own seat, sitting alone off to one side. He was merely an onlooker and a witness, offering no opinions whatsoever.

The individuals summoned by the Tiger King were all true loyalists of the throne, as well as the ones he trusted the most.

Even though just a few days prior—with the exception of Clement and the High Priest—all of these people had backstabbed him, at the very least, they hadn't genuinely wanted him to step down; they had only sought to pressure him into retrieving his spatial belt and restoring the royal family's reputation sooner.

Moreover, the Tiger King's current condition no longer permitted him to conceal things or drag his feet.

"There's no need for silence; voice your opinions. We must choose the next successor right now. In your view, which of the princes and princesses is best suited to become the new king?"

The Tiger King wheezed, "Speaking takes a heavy toll on me; don't force me to repeat myself over and over."

Upon seeing the Tiger King struggle just to draw a breath, the Grand Marshal turned her head away, unable to bear the sight.

Seeing someone who was once all-powerful brought down like this—the more one regarded him as a rival, the more agonizing it felt.

"I nominate the First Prince." Prime Minister Isaac was the first to speak.

City Guard Commander Jiao He nodded. "The First Prince is acceptable. He has legitimacy, and his competence is quite good."

Clement remained silent, and everyone's gaze shifted to the Grand Marshal.

As the highest military commander of the Tiger Kingdom, her opinion was undoubtedly of paramount importance.

Everyone secretly wondered if the Grand Marshal might choose the Eldest Princess, seeing as the Eldest Princess was practically her disciple.

Instead, the Grand Marshal, Shi Yu, asked the Tiger King, "Whom do you favor?"

The others thought to themselves that the Tiger King would surely choose the First Prince.

To their surprise, the Tiger King hesitated for a moment, then said intermittently, "The Third Prince won't do. He's been ruined by his mother; he's nothing more than an arrogant prodigal, muddle-headed and easily manipulated by those around him."

All of the most powerful and high-ranking officials of the Tiger Kingdom nodded in unison. The Third Prince was immediately written off as their primary candidate to discard.

The Tiger King continued, "Though Mawa is a woman, her competence is not weak, and above all, she has ambition. However, her greatest flaw is that she is overly apathetic and lacks tolerance for others. She is suited for expanding territories, but not for becoming the ruler of a nation—unless there is... someone with formidable administrative and managerial skills willing to assist her and capable of influencing her."

Although the Tiger King's words seemed finished, who among those present wasn't a political veteran? The moment they heard this, they understood that the Tiger King did not want the Eldest Princess to ascend the throne. He feared she would indulge in relentless militarism, and even more, he feared that while she was out campaigning on battlefields, she would actually be hollowed out and reduced to nothing more than a national weapon of war.

At the same time, the Tiger King worried that once the Eldest Princess claimed the throne, she would strike down her brothers, sparing none of the royal family members who posed a threat to her. Illegitimate sons like Remiel would undoubtedly be the first to die.

The Tiger King had wanted to capture Remiel simply to discipline him; he had never intended to execute or exile him.

Refusing to acknowledge Remiel's status as a member of the royal family was one thing, but the fact that Remiel was his biological son would never change, even if his mother was Anita.

He hated the Queen just as intensely, yet wasn't he still about to pass the throne to the child born of the Queen?

The Tiger King looked toward the Grand Marshal, assuming she would support the Eldest Princess's ascension.

To everyone's surprise, the Grand Marshal's expression remained calm as she asked directly, "Between the First Prince and the Second Prince, which one do you favor?"

The Tiger King fell silent for a long while.

He had originally thought the Second Prince had no interest in the throne and intended to pursue an academic career in the future—even though his obsession with mysticism felt a bit eccentric.

However, the Second Prince's performance in the royal palace that day made him realize that the Second Prince might not actually be devoid of ambitions for the throne; rather, he was exceptionally skilled at biding his time and keeping a low profile, perhaps secretly accumulating strength all along.

The Tiger King believed the Second Prince's choice was correct. Rather than making a move early on, drawing everyone's attention, treating the First Prince as an enemy, and arousing the vigilance of his own reigning father, it was far wiser to develop in secret, vie for the favor of his royal father, and then strike with overwhelming force once his father grew old and frail.

chunks.chineseText:
就因为二王子隐隐透露出这样的意图和能力，这时候虎王在选择继承人时就犹豫了。

他是虎国的国王，不可能只凭自己的喜好选择继承人，这也是他为什么不承认雷米尔王室成员身份的原因。他希望王室稳定，不希望自己的继承人为了王位打成一团，互相谋害，更不希望虎国分裂。

虎王这个位子不止是荣耀和权力，更代表了责任。

他得综合考虑，为虎国选出最好最适合的继承人。

如果二王子有能力，他却没有选择，那么一个有野心有能力的王子十有八-九就会成为虎国的隐患。

虎王又想到大公主，这也是个不安份的主儿。

头疼！

“老二，你们怎么看？”虎王问众人。

宰相艾萨克和城卫军统领互看，他们对二王子并不算了解，那位二王子似乎一直游离在权力圈之外，平时也极少结交大臣和权贵子女。

大都督却说：“他实力很强。玛瓦如果不变身巨兽，就不是他的对手。”

众人惊。

大公主的实力，他们都知道，可以说是几位王子公主中最强的。大王子真和大公主打起来，恐怕只有被虐的份。

结果大都督却说二王子的实力并不亚于大公主？

大都督狮域接着说道：“据我所知，王后在离开王城之际，把自己手上的人脉和留在王城的财产都交给了二王子。”

这是一个大爆料，震惊在场所有人。

狮域没说她是从哪里得来这个消息，但她的神情告诉众人，她没有信口开河。

虎王相信狮域所说。

狮域是军部最高长官，王后肯定也有笼络军队中的将领。

而被王后笼络的将领真的被王后笼络了吗？

只看狮域能知道别人都不知道的秘密，就能知道答案。

所以大公主死活要缠着狮域成为她的弟子，真的没有选错人。只是这位大都督心眼明亮，看得太通透，并有着自己绝对的原则，让大公主的盘算落空。

虎王一口气呛进气管，猛烈咳嗽。

没有侍者在现场，克莱门特就充当了侍者，轻拍虎王背部，给他倒水顺喉。

宰相艾萨克忽然说：“如果让二王子继位，那么王后那边的丹顿家族势力是否也会彻底归顺？”

艾萨克继续说：“大王子有容人之心，不知道二王子如何？如果大王子继位，二王子会怎么做？他会辅佐自己的兄长，还是会……分裂虎国？”

城卫军统领角合皱眉：“你这话不就相当于在问，如果让二王子继位，大王子是否愿意辅佐自己的弟弟？如果大王子愿意，那最好的选择不就成了二王子？”

“那这岂不成了蛮不讲理的可以得到所有，而老实的只能吃亏？”角合不爽。

宰相艾萨克没有生气，只说：“我只是在陈述事实。你别忘了，我是最支持正统的人，大王子在我眼中就是正统中的正统。但二王子的威胁，我们也不能忽视。”

角合不客气地：“你的意思是想要让大王子安然继位，就得先解决二王子？”

宰相艾萨克没有回答。

角合冷笑：“那大公主是不是也要解决？最后为了避免三王子渔翁得利，那是不是也得解决三王子？”

宰相什么话都没说，只看虎王。

虎王胸口剧烈起伏，喘了好一会儿才说出话：“你们这是想要把本王的儿女都给杀死？”

大都督开口：“如果大王子继位，玛瓦不会有意见，但是新王必须允诺玛瓦可以在将来继承我的位子。在这之前，我会把她派到边境守卫。如果陛下没有意见的话。”

这相当于是大都督的承诺，确保王权交替的稳当，也是大都督对大公主的保护。

虎王平静了一会儿，颔首：“可。”

大都督又道：“如果陛下考虑二王子，那就也请考虑大公主。”

在大都督看来，二王子也不是多怜惜民众的仁慈国王，而且他看不透二王子。让二王子上位，那还不如让大公主当女王。

虎王不想回复，看向其他人：“你们的意见？”

“不如我们投票吧，看是选择大王子还是二王子。等选出继承人选，我们再看如何安抚另一位落选之人。”宰相艾萨克提议。

克莱门特自始至终没有说话，只是在最后投票时，选择了……虎王。

克莱门特忠心耿耿地说：“陛下选择谁，我就选择谁。”

其他人也没有觉得这有什么不对，克莱门特是侍卫统领，也是虎王最信任的人，他会如此做太正常了。

城卫军统领角合毫不犹豫投了大王子一票，大都督也是。

宰相艾萨克原本也是大王子的铁杆支持者，但他更想要虎国稳定，反而犹豫了好一会儿。

“要么我们可以出题考验两位王子，最后谁胜出就选择谁为第一继承人？”

角合翻白眼：“让投票的人是你，大家都投了，你又说要弄个考验。宰相大人，不如干脆选你当新国王如何？”

宰相艾萨克没有半点被激怒的痕迹，沉稳地说：“我只是不想两位王子为了王位闹到兄弟相残的地步。我们的投票很重要，但让两位王子心服口服地承认另一人比自己强，不更能解决问题？”

角合冷笑：“大王子心里有兄弟姐妹，他如果输给自己弟弟，也许会心甘情愿辅佐二王子。但二王子输了，我可不觉得他会真的心甘情愿辅佐大王子。只看他不显山不露水的藏到现在，还让王后倒向他，就知道这位绝不是个甘心人下的主儿。”

宰相：“你的意思是想彻底废掉二王子，让他再也没有和大王子竞争的能力？”

“当断不断反受其乱。刚才的投票结果明明是大王子获得最高票数，那么我们就应该推举大王子为下一位国王。二王子那边，他如果选择臣服，愿意辅佐自家兄长最好，如果不愿意，如果敢闹事，那就该雷霆镇压他！”角合态度强硬。

大都督忽然问：“陛下为什么没有让切斯特大公过来？”

几人其实在过来时就想问这个问题，但都忍住没问。

祭司也在此时看向国王，他也很好奇这个问题的答案。

虎王神色阴晴不定：“他家和墨文伯爵走得很近。”

宰相迟疑：“陛下是在怀疑切斯特大公也和邪神信徒有往来？”

虎王沉默不语。

“我记得十二年前，切斯特大公重病，当时他的年龄已经超过两百六十岁，一夕间，他就从壮年模样变成老年。”克莱门特说道。

其他人惊讶，他们从没有听说过这件事。

虎王总不能说是他的情报部门查出来的吧，就示意克莱门特。

克莱门特跳过他们是怎么发现的这个秘密，接着说道：“但半个月后，切斯特大公再次出现在人前，却又恢复了壮年模样。”

宰相艾萨克脱口道：“这不可能！”

克莱门特：“当时，我出于好奇也调查过原因。但最后得到的答案是切斯特大公运气好，买到了一支非常特别的药剂，不但治愈了他的重病，还让他身体机能恢复到壮年。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 187: Choosing a Successor (Part 2)

It was precisely because the Second Prince had subtly revealed such intent and capability that the Tiger King now hesitated when choosing a successor.

As the King of the Tiger Kingdom, he could not simply pick a successor based on personal preference. This was also why he had refused to acknowledge Remiel's royal status in the first place—he wanted stability within the royal family and did not want his heirs tearing each other apart over the throne through mutual murder, nor did he want the Tiger Kingdom to split apart.

The Tiger King's seat represented far more than glory and power; it embodied profound responsibility.

He had to weigh all factors comprehensively to select the best and most suitable successor for the Tiger Kingdom.

If the Second Prince possessed such competence yet was passed over, an ambitious and capable prince would, nine times out of ten, become a hidden hazard to the Tiger Kingdom.

The Tiger King's thoughts drifted back to the Eldest Princess—another restless element.

A massive headache!

"What are your thoughts on the Second Prince?" the Tiger King asked the gathered crowd.

Prime Minister Isaac and the City Guard Commander exchanged glances. They were hardly familiar with the Second Prince; that prince seemed to have hovered perpetually outside the inner circles of power, rarely interacting with ministers or the children of nobility.

However, the Grand Marshal stated, "His combat strength is formidable. If Mawa does not transform into her beast form, she is no match for him."

The crowd gasped in shock.

Everyone knew the Eldest Princess's power; she could be said to be the strongest among all the princes and princesses. If the First Prince were to actually fight her, he would likely do nothing more than get utterly thrashed.

Yet the Grand Marshal was declaring that the Second Prince's strength was in no way inferior to the Eldest Princess's?

Grand Marshal Shi Yu continued, "To my knowledge, when the Queen left the Royal City, she handed all the connections she had cultivated and the assets she left behind in the Royal City directly over to the Second Prince."

This was a colossal bombshell that stunned everyone present.

Shi Yu did not reveal where she had obtained this intelligence, but her demeanor assured them she was not speaking idly.

The Tiger King believed Shi Yu's words.

Shi Yu was the supreme commander of the military, and the Queen would undoubtedly have attempted to win over generals within the armed forces.

Were the generals supposedly won over by the Queen actually in her pocket?

One only needed to look at Shi Yu's possession of secrets unknown to anyone else to know the answer.

Thus, the Eldest Princess's relentless persistence in forcing Shi Yu to take her on as a disciple was truly not a mistaken choice. It was simply that the Grand Marshal possessed a discerning eye, saw through things far too clearly, and held absolute principles of her own, which ultimately dashed the Eldest Princess's calculations.

A breath of air caught in the Tiger King's windpipe, sending him into a violent fit of coughing.

With no attendants present, Clement stepped in to fill the role, gently patting the Tiger King's back and pouring him water to soothe his throat.

Prime Minister Isaac suddenly spoke up, "If the Second Prince ascends the throne, will the Danton family faction aligned with the Queen also pledge complete allegiance?"

Isaac pressed on, "The First Prince possesses a tolerant heart, but I wonder about the Second Prince? If the First Prince ascends, how will the Second Prince react? Will he assist his elder brother, or will he... split the Tiger Kingdom apart?"

City Guard Commander Jiao He frowned. "Aren't you essentially asking whether the First Prince would be willing to assist his younger brother if the Second Prince takes the throne? If the First Prince is willing, wouldn't the best choice naturally become the Second Prince?"

"Doesn't that mean the unreasonable one gets everything while the honest one gets screwed over?" Jiao He grumbled, deeply displeased.

Prime Minister Isaac did not get angry. He merely replied, "I am merely stating facts. Don't forget, I am the staunchest supporter of orthodoxy; in my eyes, the First Prince is orthodoxy personified. But we cannot simply ignore the threat posed by the Second Prince."

Jiao He said bluntly, "Are you implying that if we want the First Prince to ascend the throne in peace, we must first get rid of the Second Prince?"

Prime Minister Isaac offered no reply.

Jiao He sneered, "Then does that mean the Eldest Princess must be eliminated as well? And finally, to prevent the Third Prince from reaping the spoils while two others fight, do we have to get rid of the Third Prince too?"

The Prime Minister said nothing, fixing his gaze solely on the Tiger King.

The Tiger King's chest heaved violently. After wheezing for a long moment, he finally squeezed out the words: "Are you people trying to slaughter all of my children?"

The Grand Marshal spoke up. "If the First Prince ascends the throne, Mawa will raise no objections, on the condition that the new king promises Mawa can inherit my position in the future. Until then, I will dispatch her to guard the borders. Provided Your Majesty has no objections."

This amounted to a guarantee from the Grand Marshal, ensuring a smooth transition of royal power while also serving as her protection of the Eldest Princess.

After calming down for a moment, the Tiger King nodded. "Acceptable."

The Grand Marshal added, "If Your Majesty considers the Second Prince, then please consider the Eldest Princess as well."

In the Grand Marshal's view, the Second Prince was hardly a benevolent ruler with tender mercy for the common folk, and she couldn't see through him. If the Second Prince were allowed to take power, it would be far better to let the Eldest Princess become Queen.

Unwilling to reply, the Tiger King looked toward the others. "Your opinions?"

"Why don't we take a vote to see whether we choose the First Prince or the Second Prince? Once a successor is chosen, we can figure out how to placate the losing candidate," Prime Minister Isaac proposed.

Clement had remained silent from beginning to end, but when the final vote came, he chose... the Tiger King.

Clement declared with unwavering loyalty, "Whomever Your Majesty chooses, I choose."

The others found nothing wrong with this; Clement was the commander of the guards and the Tiger King's most trusted confidant, so his stance was completely natural.

City Guard Commander Jiao He cast his vote for the First Prince without the slightest hesitation, as did the Grand Marshal.

Prime Minister Isaac had originally been a staunch supporter of the First Prince as well, but his desire for the stability of the Tiger Kingdom caused him to hesitate for quite a while.

"Or perhaps we could devise trials to test the two princes, and whoever triumphs is chosen as the primary heir?"

Jiao He rolled his eyes. "You were the one who suggested voting. Now that everyone has voted, you're talking about setting up trials. Prime Minister, why don't we just elect you as the new king instead?"

Prime Minister Isaac showed no trace of irritation, saying calmly, "I simply wish to prevent the two princes from descending into fratricidal slaughter over the throne. Our vote is important, but wouldn't making the two princes wholeheartedly admit that the other is superior resolve the issue much more effectively?"

Jiao He sneered, "The First Prince cares for his siblings. If he loses to his younger brother, he might willingly assist the Second Prince. But if the Second Prince loses, I don't believe for a second that he would genuinely and willingly assist the First Prince. Just looking at how he hid his capabilities until now and even made the Queen capitulate tells us he is definitely not someone who will willingly stay under someone else's thumb."

The Prime Minister countered, "Are you implying that we should completely cripple the Second Prince so he never has the ability to compete with the First Prince again?"

"He who hesitates is lost. The voting results clearly showed that the First Prince received the highest number of votes, so we should enthrone the First Prince as the next king. As for the Second Prince, if he chooses to submit and is willing to assist his elder brother, that's for the best. If he's unwilling and dares to stir up trouble, we must crush him with thunderous force!" Jiao He's attitude was resolute and unyielding.

Suddenly, the Grand Marshal asked, "Why hasn't Your Majesty summoned Grand Duke Chester over?"

In truth, the others had wanted to ask this question the moment they arrived, but had held their tongues.

The High Priest also looked toward the King at that moment, equally curious about the answer.

The Tiger King's expression flickered uncertainly. "His household has grown very close to Count Mowen."

The Prime Minister hesitated. "Is Your Majesty suspecting that Grand Duke Chester is also colluding with the Evil God's followers?"

The Tiger King remained silent.

"I recall that twelve years ago, Grand Duke Chester fell gravely ill. At the time, he was already over two hundred and sixty years old, and overnight, his appearance transformed from that of a man in his prime into an old man," Clement stated.

The others were startled; they had never heard of this incident before.

Since the Tiger King couldn't very well admit that his intelligence network had uncovered it, he gave Clement a subtle signal.

Clement skipped over how they had discovered the secret and continued, "However, half a month later, Grand Duke Chester reappeared in public, having reverted once more to the appearance of his prime."

Prime Minister Isaac blurted out, "That's impossible!"

Clement said, "At the time, out of curiosity, I investigated the cause. But the answer I ultimately received was that Grand Duke Chester was fortunate enough to purchase a very special potion that not only cured his severe illness but also restored his bodily functions to his prime years."

chunks.chineseText:
“我把此事禀告给陛下，陛下和我都很羡慕，但谁也没有多想。一年后，墨文伯爵的小女儿嫁给了切斯特大公最喜欢的孙辈。”

克莱门特顿了顿：“当时看来很普通的事情，可在现在看来……”

宰相深吸气：“你认为切斯特大公当年能痊愈，还能从衰老状态恢复到壮年状态是因为信仰了邪神，得到了邪神的力量？”

克莱门特淡淡说：“除此之外，您还听说过有谁能在进入衰老期后还能返老还青？”

宰相苦笑：“确实。没想到邪神那么厉害，连这样的事情都能做到。”

角合冷不丁问：“你很羡慕？”

宰相坦然说：“我已经两百出头，谁也不知道我的衰老期会什么时候来到，也许会等到三百岁的那一天，但也有可能明天就降临。如果说我对返老还青不心动，那就是骗人。”

“我觉得邪神就算能做到这点，也不可能轻易做到，另外承受者也不可能不付出巨大代价。否则邪神早就替代正神征服了整个兽人大陆。”克莱门特理智地说。

宰相点头：“也是。”

城卫军统领角合：“八卦报上不是说墨文伯爵府设置了邪神祭坛，还在祭坛周围的土地里埋藏了上千具尸骨，还都是被凌虐至死，这才导致怨魂诅咒在墨文伯爵府蔓延的吗？也许这就是代价。说不定去切斯特大公府上挖一挖，也能挖出不少尸骨。”

虎王没说话。他心想，如果这时候有人站到他面前，对他说能让他恢复健康，摆脱那个共命邪法，只要他信仰邪神，他九成也会动心。

对了，邪神信徒为什么不来找他？

这是多么好的诱惑他、威胁他的机会。

难道是邪神也没有办法改变共命契约的效果吗？

虎王心更冷了。

“克莱门特，你去问问切斯特大公，问他更属意谁继承王位。”虎王慢腾腾地说。

克莱门特当即就领命而去。

大都督、宰相和城卫军统领三位则转入旁边的会客室继续讨论。

他们三人也清楚，今天王位继承人不定下来，他们肯定走不掉。

虎王则待在寝宫里休息，只和几名大臣讨论了这么点时间，他就累得不得了。

祭司环视寝宫角落，微微一笑，跟虎王暂时告退，同时打了个手势。

隐身藏在角落的商非凡戳戳郎沐的手心：那家伙好像发现我们了，要跟过去吗？

郎沐沉默，他从虎王身上感觉到了法则的力量。

对于魔法师来说，法则魔法大概是最高端的魔法，没有之一。

甚至在魔法师界有一个共通的传言，那就是掌握了法则之力就能成神。

换言之，他救不了虎王。

郎沐点头。

商非凡就和他一起走出寝宫。

寝宫外面，祭司昂首看着天空，像是在思考事情，又像是在发呆。

周围的侍者和侍卫也没有人敢打搅他。

商非凡走到祭司身边，轻咳。

祭司放平视线，迈开脚步。

当两人跟着祭司走入专为祭司修建的宫殿时，祭司蚪海潮才开口说话：“我没有发现你们，我只是预感到今天会见到你们。”

商非凡和郎沐：“……”

两人干脆现出身影。

祭司赞：“你们的隐身能力真厉害，我半点没有察觉。”

商非凡：“你会预言术？”

祭司看向郎沐：“你应该知道我，我既是宫廷祭司，也是宫廷预言师。”

郎沐惊讶：“原来是您。”

商非凡看向郎沐：“你没有见过宫廷预言师？”

郎沐摇头：“预言师是王宫中最神秘的存在，除了虎王，就是王后都不知道他是谁。”

商非凡一想也是。战斗先杀治疗，预言师有时候比治疗师还bug，如果他指挥战斗也会先杀预言师。

如此，虎王怎么保护预言师也不为过。

商非凡又看向祭司：“你特意让我们跟过来，难不成你看到了与我们有关的预示？”

祭司笑笑，没有承认也没有否认：“很可惜，我没有看到虎王病倒的这一幕。虎王为此对我很有怨言。可预言就是这样，并不是我想看到什么就能看到什么。虎王让我看他的未来，而我看到的却是……”

约一个兽时后，克莱门特刚回到王宫，就看到三王子带着几口大箱子，耀武扬威地跟侍卫嚷嚷说要见到虎王，说他有重要消息以及重要物品呈现给虎王。

侍卫们早就得了吩咐，没有虎王的允许，任哪个王子公主前来都不能让他们进入王宫。

三王子进不去，就在门口闹腾。

三王子看到克莱门特，眼睛一亮，立刻缠上来。

“真的是很重要的事情，也是很重要的东西。”三王子在重要上加重了语气。

“相信我，父王看到我带去这些东西，他一定会很高兴！”

克莱门特无奈，只得耐着性子问：“到底是什么消息和什么东西？如果三殿下不介意，不如跟我说说，我再转告陛下。然后再看陛下是否愿意召见您。”

三王子也不敢得罪克莱门特，这可是他父王真正的心腹重臣。

“好吧，也就是你……”三王子嘀嘀咕咕，凑到克莱门特耳边：“我发现了安妮丽娜，跟踪她……”

克莱门特挑眉：安妮丽娜？你确定？

但等听到后面，克莱门特的脸色有了小小变化。

这确实是一件很重要的事情，尤其今天虎王还召见重臣正在讨论王位继承人的事。

“殿下，请您稍等。我这就把您带来的东西呈去给陛下。”克莱门特脸色变得严肃。

三王子兴奋：“好好好，本王子就在这里等，你可要快一点！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 187: Choosing a Successor (Part 3)

"I reported this matter to His Majesty. Both he and I felt quite envious, but neither of us suspected anything further. A year later, Count Mowen's youngest daughter married Grand Duke Chester's favorite grandson."

Clement paused. "What seemed like an ordinary occurrence back then, when viewed from the perspective of today..."

The Prime Minister drew a sharp breath. "You believe that Grand Duke Chester's recovery back then, and his ability to revert from a state of senility back to his prime, was because he pledged allegiance to the Evil God and obtained the Evil God's power?"

Clement said flatly, "Aside from that, have you ever heard of anyone who could reverse aging and return to youth after entering their senescent years?"

The Prime Minister gave a bitter laugh. "Indeed. I never imagined the Evil God could be so terrifyingly capable, accomplishing a feat like that."

Jiao He asked out of the blue, "Are you envious?"

The Prime Minister answered honestly, "I am already over two hundred years old. No one knows when my senescent period will arrive; perhaps I'll reach the age of three hundred, but it could just as easily descend upon me tomorrow. To say I am not tempted by the prospect of reversing aging would be a lie."

"Even if the Evil God is capable of such a feat, it surely cannot be easily achieved, and the recipient must pay an exorbitant price. Otherwise, the Evil God would have long since supplanted the True Gods and conquered the entire Beastman Continent," Clement analyzed rationally.

The Prime Minister nodded. "True."

City Guard Commander Jiao He chimed in, "Didn't the tabloid newspapers say that Count Mowen's estate set up an Evil God altar, burying thousands of corpses in the soil around the altar—all of whom were tortured to death—which caused a curse of vengeful spirits to spread throughout Count Mowen's manor? Perhaps that was the price. For all we know, if we dug up Grand Duke Chester's estate, we might unearth quite a few corpses ourselves."

The Tiger King said nothing. In his heart, he thought: If someone were to stand before him right now and tell him they could restore his health and rid him of that shared-fate evil technique, provided he worshipped the Evil God, there was a ninety percent chance he would be tempted.

Right, why hadn't the Evil God's followers come looking for him?

What a prime opportunity this was to tempt and threaten him.

Could it be that even the Evil God had no way to alter the effects of the shared-fate pact?

The Tiger King's heart grew even colder.

"Clement, go question Grand Duke Chester and ask him whom he favors to inherit the throne," the Tiger King commanded slowly.

Clement immediately accepted the order and departed.

Meanwhile, the Grand Marshal, the Prime Minister, and the City Guard Commander withdrew into the adjoining parlor to continue their discussion.

The three of them knew well that until today's choice of royal successor was settled, they would not be allowed to leave.

As for the Tiger King, he remained resting in his bedchamber. After discussing matters for just that short period with a few ministers, he was utterly exhausted.

The High Priest glanced around the corners of the bedchamber, smiled faintly, and temporarily took his leave of the Tiger King while making a subtle hand gesture.

Shang Feifan, who was concealed by invisibility in the corner, nudged Lang Mu's palm: *That fellow seems to have noticed us. Should we follow him?*

Lang Mu fell silent. He could sense the power of laws emanating from the Tiger King.

To a magician, law magic was arguably the highest echelon of magic—there was none higher.

There was even a widespread rumor in the magical world that mastering the power of laws allowed one to become a god.

In other words, he could not save the Tiger King.

Lang Mu nodded.

Shang Feifan walked out of the bedchamber alongside him.

Outside the bedchamber, the High Priest stood with his head held high, gazing up at the sky as if pondering something or lost in a trance.

None of the surrounding attendants or guards dared to disturb him.

Shang Feifan walked up beside the High Priest and gave a light cough.

The High Priest leveled his gaze and set off walking.

When the two of them followed the High Priest into a palace specially constructed for the High Priest, Dou Haihao finally spoke: "I didn't notice you. I merely had a premonition that I would see you today."

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu exchanged glances: "..."

The two simply dropped their invisibility and revealed their forms.

The High Priest praised, "Your stealth abilities are truly formidable; I didn't sense you in the slightest."

Shang Feifan asked, "You possess prophecy arts?"

The High Priest looked at Lang Mu. "You should know of me. I am both the court high priest and the court prophet."

Lang Mu was surprised. "So it was you."

Shang Feifan looked at Lang Mu. "You've never met the court prophet?"

Lang Mu shook his head. "The prophet is the most mysterious existence in the royal palace. Aside from the Tiger King, not even the Queen knows who he is."

Upon reflection, Shang Feifan supposed that made sense. In battle, you take out the healer first; a prophet could sometimes be even more bugged than a healer. If he were commanding a battle, he would target the prophet first too.

Given that, no matter how the Tiger King protected the prophet, it wouldn't be excessive.

Shang Feifan looked back at the High Priest. "You specifically had us follow you—could it be that you foresaw a prophecy related to us?"

The High Priest smiled, neither confirming nor denying it. "Regrettably, I did not foresee this scene of the Tiger King falling ill. The Tiger King harbors deep resentment toward me because of this. But prophecies are like that; it's not a matter of seeing whatever I wish to see. The Tiger King commanded me to look into his future, but what I laid eyes upon instead was..."

About one beast-hour later, just as Clement returned to the royal palace, he saw the Third Prince accompanied by several large chests, swaggering and arguing loudly with the guards that he needed to see the Tiger King, claiming he had crucial news and an essential item to present to the monarch.

The guards had long since received strict instructions: without the Tiger King's permission, not a single prince or princess was allowed entry into the inner palace.

Unable to get inside, the Third Prince was making a scene at the entrance.

When the Third Prince caught sight of Clement, his eyes lit up and he immediately pounced on him.

"It really is a matter of utmost importance, and a truly crucial item!" The Third Prince emphasized the word 'crucial'.

"Trust me, when Royal Father sees what I've brought, he will definitely be overjoyed!"

Helpless, Clement had no choice but to patiently ask, "What on earth is this news and this item? If Third Highness doesn't mind, why don't you tell me first, and I will relay it to His Majesty. Then we can see whether His Majesty is willing to grant you an audience."

The Third Prince didn't dare offend Clement either; this was his father's genuine confidant and heavy-hitter.

"Fine, seeing as it's you..." The Third Prince muttered under his breath, leaning close to Clement's ear. "I discovered Anielina and tracked her..."

Clement raised an eyebrow. *Anielina? Are you certain?*

However, upon hearing what followed, Clement's expression underwent a subtle shift.

This truly was a matter of great significance, especially since the Tiger King was holding a council with his top ministers today to discuss the succession of the throne.

"Your Highness, please wait a moment. I shall present the items you brought to His Majesty immediately," Clement said, his expression turning solemn.

The Third Prince beamed with excitement. "Good, good, good! This Prince will wait right here, make it quick!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第188章 又想让我家阿沐当血包是吧 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第188章 又想让我家阿沐当血包是吧

克莱门特一进寝宫就看到虎王那隐含殷切期盼的眼神。

不由心下一叹。

“陛下，切斯特大公说那药剂只有一支。”

虎王眼中的光芒消散，整个人都变得死气沉沉。

克莱门特果然很懂他，知道他只是找个借口让他去询问切斯特大公有没有“奇迹”推荐。

而切斯特大公的回答就差没有明摆着告诉虎王：他没有办法，他身后的人也没有办法。

如果切斯特大公身后真的有邪神信徒操纵，他让克莱门特过去找切斯特大公就是在释放一个信号。

对方没有接受这个信号，这不就说明他的问题就连邪神也没有办法解决？

也许有，但代价太大，邪神信徒知道他绝不会答应。

至少他无法做出献祭满城子民就为了恢复健康。

他想跟邪神信徒搭上线，也是想要协商，看能不能支付其他代价来换取健康。

可邪神信徒连谈都不愿和他谈。

为什么？

“陛下，”克莱门特忽然说：“属下听到一个传言，传言邪神信徒似乎想要把他们信奉的真神教捧为虎国的国教，也是唯一教派，让全虎国的人都来信仰厄穆克拉索。”

“不可能！他们在做梦。”虎王断然道。

克莱门特垂眸。

虎王看向这名他最信任的下属，明白了什么，慢慢坐起身，吃力地说：“有人联系你了？”

克莱门特点头：“卑下从切斯特大公府邸出来后，有人让一个小幼崽传信给我。”

虎王沉默了很久，宛如用尽全身力气：“让狮域他们都过来，我要跟他们说一件事。”

邪神信徒终归是联系他了，但他们提出的条件，他就不可能答应。

虎王闭上眼睛。

他想要活下去，他想要健康。

但他更不能把整个虎国双手奉给邪神，这是他为王的最后底线！

何况做一个被邪神操控的国王，即便得到健康又有什么意义？

哪怕邪神信徒是想要跟他要一块封地，搞国中国，他说不定都会犹豫。

“陛下，另有一件事。”克莱门特神色不变地说道：“三王子跟踪疑似安妮丽娜的女子进入一家俱乐部，在一个名为神秘学同好研究会的密室里发现了大量王室珍藏，以及王印。”

虎王没有见三王子。

他只是让克莱门特接手了三王子送来的王印和王室珍藏。

看过这些东西，虎王非常确定这些都是他空间腰带里的东西，只要是与王室有密切关系的物品都在这里了。

虎王果然想了很多，最后他认为不管二王子是不是被栽赃陷害，都需要来跟他说明情况，那个神秘学同好会也没必要再存在下去。

不可否认的是，这件事让虎王原本有点摇摆不定的想法变得坚定起来，他的选择也彻底偏向了大王子。

虎王当即下令让治安局总局长亲自带队，查封那家俱乐部，并对二王子名下的神秘学同好研究会进行详细搜查，包括“请”那些同好会成员去治安总局喝茶谈心。

同时命令二王子进宫来见他。

三王子最后只等到了“做得很好”这句表扬，连虎王的面都没见到。

三王子竟然也没闹腾，因为他听到虎王传令让二王子进宫，脑补虎王看到那些东西后有多么愤怒，这才顾不得赏赐他，只想要把老二拎去审问。

三王子想到一向端着且看不起他的二哥会被父王训得灰头土脸，说不定连王位继承权都丢失，就开心得能接连彻夜狂欢好多天。

三王子还不肯离开，他要亲眼看到他二哥狼狈的模样。

虎王在见到二王子前，再次召见就待在隔壁的大都督几人。

祭司也得到传令，过去见证。

在这之前。

“两位考虑得如何？”祭司盘坐在椅子上，笑容温和。

做阿瑞斯商装扮的商非凡和郎沐坐在祭司对面。

“你说的大乱将至，是指整个兽人大陆，还是单指虎国？”商非凡单手搭在郎沐肩膀上，满不在意地问。

祭司：“我能看到的不多，看到的只有虎国。我是以虎王为锚点来窥视未来。”

“虎王那时还活着吗？”郎沐问。

祭司：“我看到了他最后看到的场景。”

郎沐懂了。

商老大冷笑：“你知道我最烦你们这类人哪一点吗？就是说起预言就遮遮掩掩，还死活不肯说重点。如果你只是给我们‘大乱将至’的预言，那抱歉，我们很忙。虎国怎样，也和我们无关。阿沐，走了。”

商非凡说着就站起身。

祭司依然坐得稳稳：“魔血血脉出现。或者我该说魔法师？”

郎沐拉住了商非凡。

商非凡冷眼盯祭司。

祭司也有点承受不了这人犀利如刀的目光，没和他对视，只不紧不慢地继续说：

“我看到的场景不多，只能从那些场景分析推测，魔血者应该是和邪神信徒联手了，他们先是联手打败虎国王室，杀死虎王、大都督和王宫祭司等人，又活祭了包括大王子和大公主等人在内的所有王室成员。”

郎沐和商非凡一起看向祭司。

祭司面色没有丝毫改变，说话的语速也没有停顿：“我最后看到的场景，邪神阴影者带领虫毒变异者出现，与成千上万的天残兽人战斗，魔血者在背后操控那些天残兽人。”

“我没看到结局，只看到满目疮痍。虎国王城彻底消失……”

会客室陷入沉寂，只有些微熏香烟雾在鼻尖缭绕。

商非凡的嗤笑打破沉寂：“你跟我们说这些有什么用？我家阿沐就是个被当做挡箭牌的倒霉鬼，好不容易才搞清楚自己的身世，认回自己的亲人。而我也只是一个就会做点空间道具的小小炼金师。你觉得我们两个能在这场大乱中起到什么作用？”

祭司哂笑：“阿瑞斯商阁下也不必如此菲薄自身。原本我也没有想过要把希望放在二位身上。只是在看到那样的未来后，我自然会忍不住想要看到破局之策。于是，我献祭了百年寿命，只求能窥探到一丝希望。”

郎沐看祭司的眼神变了。

商非凡：狡猾的家伙，这根本就是抓住我家阿沐心软的弱点。

祭司轻叹：“总算吾神没有完全抛弃我等，祂让我看到了沉沦的世界中唯一的绿色，有人在那片土地上正常劳作生活，而守护那片土地的人正是……”

祭司看向郎沐。

商非凡眼神变冷，再无丝毫温度。

“圣山祭司宫信奉的是什么神？”商非凡冷不丁问。

祭司：“古神，最古老最原始的神灵，也是这个世界本身，也可以说是规则和知识本身。”

商非凡挑眉。

郎沐倒是没有感到意外。魔法师同样把天地规则制定者当做最高神灵。

商非凡没兴趣跟祭司讨论神灵。对他来说，神灵也好、老板也好，都是同一种存在。只不过后者比较容易反抗，甚可反制。前者则难以反抗，甚至连影子都摸不到。

真说起来，他现在也是在给某个也许是某几个神灵打工。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 188: Trying to Use My A-Mu as a Blood Bag Again, Are We? (Part 1)

The moment Clement stepped into the bedchamber, he caught sight of the Tiger King’s gaze, which was laced with a faint, eager anticipation.

He couldn't help but inwardly sigh.

"Your Majesty, Grand Duke Chester said there is only one dose of that potion."

The light in the Tiger King's eyes instantly extinguished, his entire person sinking into a lifeless gloom.

Clement understood him all too well. He knew the King had merely been using him as an excuse to sound out Grand Duke Chester and see if he had any "miraculous" remedies to recommend.

And Grand Duke Chester’s response might as well have been a blatant declaration to the Tiger King: he had no solution, and neither did the figures behind him.

If Grand Duke Chester truly had ties to the cultists of the Evil God, the King sending Clement to probe him was essentially casting out a signal.

Since the other party had chosen not to accept that signal, didn't that prove even the Evil God was powerless to resolve his condition?

Perhaps a solution existed, but the price was far too steep, and the cultists knew he would never agree to it.

At the very least, he could never bring himself to sacrifice every single citizen in the capital just to recover his health.

When he sought to establish contact with the Evil God's cultists, his goal had been to negotiate—to see if he could pay some other price in exchange for his vitality.

Yet the cultists were unwilling to even entertain talks with him.

Why?

"Your Majesty," Clement suddenly said, "this subordinate heard a rumor. It is said that the Evil God's cultists seem intent on elevating the true god they worship into the state religion of the Tiger Kingdom—the sole and exclusive faith, compelling all people across the land to worship Emuclaso."

"Impossible! They are dreaming," the Tiger King stated flatly.

Clement lowered his gaze.

The Tiger King looked at this most trusted subordinate of his, slowly comprehending the implications. He propped himself up into a sitting position and said with labored breath, "Someone has contacted you?"

Clement nodded. "After I stepped out of Grand Duke Chester’s estate, someone had a little cub pass a message to me."

The Tiger King remained silent for a long time, as if expending every ounce of his remaining strength. "Have the Lion Domain and the others all come over. There is something I must tell them."

The cultists had contacted him after all, but the conditions they demanded were utterly unacceptable.

The Tiger King closed his eyes.

He wanted to live. He wanted his health back.

Yet, even more so, he could never hand the entire Tiger Kingdom over to the Evil God on a silver platter. That was his absolute bottom line as a king!

Besides, what meaning was there in regaining one's health only to become a puppet king manipulated by an Evil God?

Even if the cultists had merely demanded a piece of territory to carve out an independent state within a state, he might have at least hesitated.

"Your Majesty, there is another matter," Clement said, his expression unchanged. "The Third Prince tailed a woman suspected of being Anelina into a club, and discovered a vast cache of royal heirlooms as well as the Royal Seal within a secret room belonging to an organization called the Occult Amateur Research Society."

The Tiger King refused to grant an audience to the Third Prince.

He simply instructed Clement to take custody of the Royal Seal and the royal treasures brought back by the Third Prince.

Upon inspecting the items, the Tiger King was utterly certain these were the contents of his own spatial belt. Anything closely tied to the royal family was present here.

Indeed, a thousand thoughts churned through the Tiger King's mind. In the end, he concluded that regardless of whether the Second Prince had been framed or not, the youth needed to be summoned to explain the situation, and that Occult Amateur Research Society had no reason to continue existing.

Undeniably, this incident solidified the Tiger King's previously wavering thoughts, steering his choice decisively toward the First Prince.

The Tiger King immediately issued an order for the Chief of the Public Security Bureau to personally lead a team to seal off the club, conduct a thorough search of the Occult Amateur Research Society under the Second Prince's name, and "invite" its members to the Security Bureau for a friendly chat over tea.

Simultaneously, he commanded the Second Prince to enter the palace for an audience.

In the end, the Third Prince received nothing more than a perfunctory praise of "Well done," without even getting to lay eyes on the Tiger King.

Yet, astonishingly, the Third Prince threw no tantrums. Having heard the King order the Second Prince's summons, his mind conjured up vivid fantasies of how furious his father must be upon seeing those stolen goods, leaving the monarch with no time for rewards as he dragged the second-eldest in for interrogation.

Just the thought of his always aloof and condescending second brother being chewed out in humiliation by their father—perhaps even stripped of his right to inherit the throne—filled the Third Prince with such elation that he felt ready to party through the night for days on end.

Refusing to leave just yet, he intended to witness his second brother's wretched state with his own eyes.

Before meeting the Second Prince, the Tiger King summoned the Grand Commander and the others waiting in the adjacent room once more.

The Priest was also summoned to witness the proceedings.

Just prior to this.

"How have the two of you considered my proposition?" The Priest sat cross-legged on a chair, wearing a gentle smile.

Shang Feifan, disguised in Ares Commercial attire, and Lang Mu sat opposite him.

"This massive upheaval you speak of—does it refer to the entire Beastman Continent, or merely the Tiger Kingdom?" Shang Feifan rested one hand casually on Lang Mu’s shoulder, asking with unfeigned indifference.

The Priest replied, "I can see very little; the visions are confined solely to the Tiger Kingdom. I used the Tiger King as an anchor to peer into the future."

"Was the Tiger King still alive by then?" Lang Mu asked.

The Priest answered, "I witnessed the final scene he laid eyes upon."

Lang Mu understood.

Boss Shang let out a cold laugh. "You know what I despise most about people like you? You speak in cryptic riddles whenever prophecy is involved, stubbornly refusing to cut to the point. If your only contribution is a prophecy of 'impending chaos,' then I'm afraid we are quite busy. What happens to the Tiger Kingdom is of no concern to us. A-Mu, let's go."

With that, Shang Feifan stood up.

The Priest remained firmly seated. "The Demonic Bloodline has emerged. Or perhaps I should say... a Magus?"

Lang Mu caught Shang Feifan by the arm, holding him back.

Shang Feifan cast a chilling glare at the Priest.

Unable to withstand the razor-sharp intensity of the man's gaze, the Priest averted his eyes, continuing unhurriedly:

"The scenes I witnessed were sparse. I can only deduce and speculate based on those fragments that the Demonic Bloodline-holder has seemingly joined forces with the Evil God's cultists. First, they collaborated to defeat the Tiger Kingdom's royal family, slaying the Tiger King, the Grand Commander, and the palace priests, before offering up all the surviving royals—including the First Prince and First Princess—in a mass blood sacrifice."

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan both turned their gazes to the Priest.

The Priest's expression remained completely unchanged, his pacing and tone unwavering:

"In the final scene I beheld, the Shadow of the Evil God led mutated insect-fiends forth, engaging in battle against tens of thousands of mutilated beastmen, while the Demonic Bloodline-holder manipulated those mutilated beastmen from the shadows."

"I did not see the conclusion. I saw only devastation. The royal capital of the Tiger Kingdom vanished entirely..."

Silence descended upon the reception room, broken only by the thin wisps of aromatic incense curling through the air.

Shang Feifan's scoff shattered the quiet. "What good does telling us all this do? My A-Mu here is merely an unlucky scapegoat who was used as a convenient shield, and it took him ages just to figure out his true heritage and reunite with his kin. As for me, I am nothing more than a humble alchemist who crafts a few spatial trinkets. What role do you possibly expect the two of us to play in this grand chaos?"

The Priest gave a self-deprecating chuckle. "Lord Ares Commercial, there is no need to be so overly modest. Originally, I never intended to place my hopes upon the two of you. However, after witnessing such a future, I naturally found myself yearning to discover a way to break the deadlock. And so, I sacrificed a century of my lifespan, praying merely to catch a glimpse of a single thread of hope."

Lang Mu’s gaze toward the Priest shifted.

Shang Feifan thought to himself: *A crafty old fox. He’s deliberately exploiting A-Mu’s soft heart as a weakness.*

The Priest sighed softly. "Fortunately, my God has not entirely forsaken us. He showed me the sole patch of green within a sunken world—people laboring and living normally upon that very land, and the one guarding that domain was none other than..."

The Priest's eyes drifted to Lang Mu.

Shang Feifan’s expression turned frosty, devoid of the slightest remaining warmth.

"Which deity does the Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace serve?" Shang Feifan asked abruptly.

The Priest answered, "The Ancient Gods—the most primordial and ancient deities, the embodiment of the world itself, or one might say, the physical manifestation of cosmic rules and knowledge."

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow.

Lang Mu, on the other hand, felt no surprise. To a magus, the arbiters of the world's laws were likewise regarded as the supreme deities.

Shang Feifan had no interest in debating theology with a priest. To him, gods and bosses were cut from the exact same cloth. The only difference was that bosses were far easier to oppose or even subvert, whereas gods remained elusive figures whose shadows could never even be touched.

Truth be told, he was currently working odd jobs for some god—or perhaps several of them—himself.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第188章 又想让我家阿沐当血包是吧 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
“我一直很奇怪，你们圣山祭司宫地位如此超然，更肩负整个兽人世界的知识传承，按理那些邪神阴影者、邪神信徒、虫族虫母之类，第一个要灭的不就该是你们吗？”

“还有，为什么你们会不知道图书馆的存在？不，说错，你们知道图书馆。但你们为什么会不知道那些图书馆都在哪里？为什么不把那些图书馆找出来，造福现在的兽人？”

商非凡的表情充满挑衅。

蚪海潮平静地回答：“祭司也是人，是人就会出错。图书馆是另外一道保障，与圣山祭司宫就是两条平行线，我们彼此知道对方存在，但又各行其是。这是为了保证一旦哪一方出现问题，另一方还能继续。”

商非凡嗯了声，认可了这个说法。

蚪海潮紧接着说：“圣山祭司宫有一定自保之力，但也只是自保。我们从不干涉政事，更没有武装力量。就是想要庇护更多人，也无能为力。”

“也因为你们不偏不倚，一直作为旁观者和见证者存在？”商非凡像是在嘲讽。

蚪海潮神情正常，坦然承认：“是。就是恨透了兽人的虫母对祭司宫也没有太多恶感，本身祭司宫成员里就有虫人族。”

商非凡：“那你们怎么看邪神？”

蚪海潮：“我们的世界和古神是包容的，如能共存，我们也会接受。但事实证明祂们和我们不能共存。实际上，这些年来，圣山祭司宫一直在受到邪神信徒的攻击。可以说，就是因为有圣山祭司宫牵扯了邪神信徒大部分力量和注意力，其他地方的邪神信徒才只是小打小闹。”

商非凡的神色好看了一些。

不管如何，他还是很钦佩和尊敬这些在背后默默做事默默奉献的人。

郎沐同样。如果不是商非凡在旁边用手臂压着他，他已经主动问出“需要他做什么”了。

“言归正传，你到底想要我们……想要阿沐做什么？”商非凡直接挑明。

蚪海潮恳切地说：“带走孩子。”

这样的要求完全出乎两人意料之外。

蚪海潮似乎并不指望他们能阻止即将到来的大乱，而只是希望他们能帮忙留住一些火种。

商非凡侧头，当他看到阿沐的神情，他就知道……蚪海潮成功了。

这他妈就是一个阳谋！

这个狡猾的祭司前面说的那么多全都是铺垫，包括他提出的最后要求也是。

他想要的根本不是带走多少个孩子那么简单。

他就是想要阿沐主动跳进来，主动做得更多。

商非凡敢打赌，这个祭司看到的未来场景肯定不止他说的那些，他很可能看到了阿沐在施展魔法。

所以他才会特意提到魔血者和魔法师这样的词汇，来吸引他们和留住他们。

蚪海潮没能继续和商非凡两人聊下去，虎王派来的传令者到了。

三人就一起再次前往虎王寝宫。

郎沐不好开口说话，一路只能偷瞄商非凡。

商非凡逮住他的偷瞄。

看到阿沐露出讨好和期盼的神情，商非凡不由心疼。

那个图书馆老头也好，这个祭司也好，全都吃准了阿沐的心软！

如果他没来这个世界，如果他没有遇到阿沐，那阿沐现在岂不是要担起一堆乱七八糟的责任，做着一大堆吃力不讨好的事情？最后九成九会献出生命，说不定还会成为无名奉献者，甚而成为他人踏脚石。

搞不好那个天残谷主的成神路就系在阿沐身上。

商非凡下意识查看郎沐现在的气运值，97（-93）/100，相当于4点。

也就是每找到一个自然之神雕像的缺失部分，郎沐的气运值就能增加一点？

可这样算来，就算把雕像缺失部分全部找齐，也无法让郎沐的气运值恢复到97点。

所以一定还有其他什么方法可以提升阿沐的气运值，比如彻底干掉某个人。

他总觉得这么多狗屁倒灶的事情找到阿沐头上，让他们老是无法按照预计的计划到处浪着玩，就跟阿沐的气运值被降低这么多有关。

商非凡心里想着事情。

祭司蚪海潮希望他们能留下来解决即将来临的大乱，阿沐在知道王城和虎国有这样的危机后也不可能就这样和他一走了之，如果能做到这点，阿沐也不是阿沐。

就算是郎侦老伯爵夫妇，在听到这样的预言内容后，恐怕也不太可能会就这么离开王城。

善良的人总是这样，老是会自动背负起不属于他们的更多责任。

所以好人总是死得很快。

商非凡勾起的冷笑中含着丝丝毒液。

握住他的那只手晃了晃，手的主人抬眼看他，用眼神问：生气了？

商非凡眼神改变，冰冷阴毒变得温柔又包容：没，我怎么可能会生你的气。我只是在想，希望那些千方百计想要留下我们的人不会后悔而已。

郎沐没看懂商非凡的眼神，就……感到了胆颤心惊，总觉得事情的发展也许会脱离某些人的预想。

走在前面的祭司蚪海潮忽然感到一阵寒意从心脏深处蔓延到全身。

虎王见到众人，没有立刻说他的决定，也没有询问狮域几人最后的选择，而是先一步说道：

“传本王命令，自本王这一代开始，无论是谁继承虎国王位，都不得建立任何教派，更不能奉任何教派为国教，虎国不承认除圣山祭司宫以外的任何宗教组织。凡是任何进行活人活物祭祀、对民众宣传具有威胁恐吓类教义、用虚无物品向民众变相索要大量财产的教派，俱是邪-教，人人得以诛之！此王令为最高王令，凡有违反者，便不配为王，任何人皆可推翻其。”

虎王这段话说得断断续续，但他的态度异常坚决。

他还要求克莱门特等会儿就把这段话给刻成碑文，竖立在王宫正门口，确保每个经过王宫正门的人都能看到。

狮域和角合对虎王突然下的这个最高王令没有任何意见。

宰相艾萨克略有迟疑，但最终也没有说什么。

二王子在接到王令的时候，也得到了他的神秘学同好会连同那家高端俱乐部一起被查封的消息。

三王子做的事情并不隐秘，只不过二王子那时候正在接手王后留给他的人员和财产，负责报信的人没能及时找到二王子。

等二王子知道三王子干了什么好事，三王子已经把东西运往王宫。

生气归生气，但比起三王子干的事，二王子更在意的是，虎王为何秘密传令让大都督、宰相和城卫军统领一起进宫？

他虽然还不知道虎王病倒，但隐约也有了一些猜测。

“殿下，只怕……”忠心属下满脸担忧，总觉得自家王子这次去王宫就是羊入虎口。

虽然他家王子也是一只虎。

“没事。我问心无愧，如果父王对我有什么误会，说清楚就好。”二王子一脸轻松，握起他刚做好没多久的法杖，就要前往王宫。

“殿下，要么我们还是离开吧。王后陛下就在丹顿家族的领地等您，那里还有一支军队……”

Chapter 188: Trying to Use My A-Mu as a Blood Bag Again, Are We? (Part 2)

"I've always found it curious. Your Sacred Mountain Priest Palace holds such a transcendent status and shoulders the heritage of knowledge for the entire beastman world. Logically speaking, wouldn't entities like the Evil God's shadows, cultists, and Zerg Broodmothers target you guys for annihilation first?"

"Furthermore, why would you claim ignorance of the libraries' existence? No, let me rephrase—you *do* know about the libraries. But why on earth do you not know where they are located? Why not unearth those libraries and use them to benefit the beastmen of the present era?"

Shang Feifan’s tone was laced with provocation.

Dou Haichao calmly replied, "Priests are human too, and humans make mistakes. The libraries are a secondary safeguard, running parallel to the Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace. We are aware of each other's existence, yet we operate independently. This is to ensure that should one party suffer a catastrophe, the other can endure."

Shang Feifan grunted, acknowledging the rationale.

Dou Haichao continued seamlessly, "The Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace possesses a certain capacity for self-preservation, but that is all. We never interfere in political affairs, nor do we command armed forces. Even if we wished to shelter more people, we are powerless to do so."

"Is that also why you remain neutral, functioning perpetually as mere bystanders and witnesses?" Shang Feifan's tone bordered on mockery.

Maintaining his calm, Dou Haichao freely admitted, "Yes. Even the Broodmother, who harbors a deep loathing for beastmen, holds no great animosity toward the Priest Palace. After all, there are members of the insectoid race among our ranks."

Shang Feifan asked, "Then what is your stance on the Evil Gods?"

Dou Haichao answered, "Our world and the Ancient Gods are inclusive. If peaceful coexistence is possible, we would accept it. However, reality has proven that they cannot coexist with us. In truth, over the years, the Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace has been under constant assault by the Evil God's cultists. One could say that precisely because the Priest Palace draws the brunt of the cultists' power and attention, the cultists operating elsewhere have been limited to petty disturbances."

Shang Feifan's expression softened slightly.

Regardless of anything else, he still harbored deep respect and admiration for individuals who quietly labored and sacrificed behind the scenes.

Lang Mu felt the same. Had Shang Feifan not been pressing down on his arm, he would have already blurted out, "What do you need me to do?"

"Let's get back to the point. What do you actually want from us—from A-Mu?" Shang Feifan cut straight to the chase.

Dou Haichao said earnestly, "Take the children away."

Such a request completely caught both of them off guard.

Dou Haichao did not seem to rely on them to prevent the impending chaos; rather, his sole wish was for them to help preserve a few sparks of hope.

Shang Feifan glanced sideways. The moment he caught A-Mu's expression, he knew—Dou Haichao had won.

This fucking thing was an open conspiracy!

Everything this crafty priest had said previously was nothing more than laying the groundwork, including this final demand.

What he wanted wasn't simply as straightforward as taking away a batch of children.

He wanted A-Mu to step into the trap willingly and take on an even heavier burden.

Shang Feifan would bet his life that the future scenes the priest had witnessed extended far beyond what he had shared; he had almost certainly foreseen A-Mu unleashing magic.
