That was why he had deliberately dropped buzzwords like "Demonic Bloodline-holder" and "Magus" to hook them and keep them tethered here.

Dou Haichao was cut off from continuing his conversation with Shang Feifan and Lang Mu as the messengers sent by the Tiger King arrived.

The trio once again made their way toward the Tiger King's bedchamber.

Unable to speak freely along the way, Lang Mu could only steal furtive glances at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan caught him in the act.

Seeing A-Mu's apologetic and pleading look, Shang Feifan felt a pang of heartache.

Whether it was that old librarian or this priest, they had all accurately zeroed in on A-Mu's soft-hearted nature!

Had he never transmigrated to this world, had he never crossed paths with A-Mu, would A-Mu right now be lumbered with a mountain of chaotic responsibilities, slogging through thankless, bone-crushing tasks? Ninety-nine percent of it would have ended with him sacrificing his life, perhaps fading away as an unsung martyr or serving as someone else's stepping stone.

For all he knew, the path to godhood for that Master of Mutilated Valley might very well be tied directly to A-Mu.

Subconsciously, Shang Feifan checked Lang Mu’s current Luck Value: 97 (-93) / 100, effectively resting at 4 points.

Did that mean every time a missing piece of a Nature God statue was recovered, Lang Mu's Luck Value increased by a single point?

Even so, by that math, gathering every single missing piece of the statues wouldn't be enough to restore Lang Mu's Luck Value back to 97.

Therefore, there had to be some other method to raise A-Mu's luck—such as completely eradicating a certain individual.

He couldn't shake the feeling that all these bullshit troubles constantly plaguing A-Mu—preventing them from roaming free and playing around according to plan—were directly linked to his luck being suppressed to such a degree.

Shang Feifan's mind raced with thoughts.

Priest Dou Haichao wanted them to stay and resolve the impending chaos, and upon learning of the crisis facing the capital and the Tiger Kingdom, A-Mu could never simply turn tail and walk away with him. If he could do that, A-Mu wouldn't be A-Mu.

Even if the elderly Count Lang and his wife were to hear of this prophecy, they likely wouldn't just pack up and flee the royal capital either.

Kind-hearted souls were always like this, instinctively shouldering burdens that did not belong to them.

And that was why good people always died young.

Shang Feifan's sardonic smirk carried a trace of venom.

The hand holding his shook slightly. The owner of the hand raised his eyes to look at him, asking wordlessly with his gaze: *Are you angry?*

Shang Feifan's expression shifted, the icy malice melting into tenderness and indulgence: *No, how could I ever be angry at you. I was just thinking—I only hope those who went out of their way to trap us here won't live to regret it.*

Lang Mu couldn't decipher Shang Feifan's look; he merely felt a sudden chill run through him, an uneasy premonition that events might veer wildly off script from what certain people had anticipated.

Walking ahead of them, Priest Dou Haichao suddenly felt a shiver creep outward from the depths of his heart, spreading across his entire body.

Upon seeing the group, the Tiger King did not immediately announce his decision, nor did he ask the Lion Domain faction about their final choice. Instead, he spoke first:

"Hear my decree: Starting from my generation, regardless of who inherits the throne of the Tiger Kingdom, no one shall establish any religious sects, let alone elevate any sect to the status of state religion. The Tiger Kingdom recognizes no religious organizations other than the Sacred Mountain's Priest Palace. Any sect that practices living sacrifices of men or beasts, propagates threatening or terror-inducing doctrines to the populace, or extorts massive amounts of wealth from citizens under the guise of illusory items shall be deemed an *evil cult*, and every citizen has the right to slay them! This royal decree is the supreme decree of the realm. Whosoever violates it is unworthy of being king, and any person shall have the right to overthrow them."

The Tiger King's delivery was halting and intermittent, yet his stance was unyielding.

He further demanded that Clement carve these very words onto a stone tablet immediately and erect it directly before the main gates of the royal palace, ensuring every passerby would see it.

Lion Domain and Jiao He raised no objections to this sudden supreme decree issued by the Tiger King.

Prime Minister Isaac hesitated briefly, but ultimately remained silent.

Upon receiving the royal decree, the Second Prince simultaneously received news that his Occult Amateur Research Society and the high-end club had both been sealed off.

The Third Prince’s actions hadn't been terribly discreet; it was simply that the Second Prince had been occupied with taking over the personnel and assets left behind by the late Queen, causing the messenger to fail in locating him promptly.

By the time the Second Prince learned what the Third Prince had pulled, the latter had already shipped the items off to the palace.

Annoying as it was, rather than dwelling on the Third Prince's antics, the Second Prince was far more preoccupied with a deeper question: Why had the Tiger King secretly summoned the Grand Commander, the Prime Minister, and the Commander of the City Guards into the palace together?

Though unaware of the Tiger King's failing health, he harbored vague suspicions.

"Your Highness, I fear..." His loyal subordinate's face was etched with anxiety, plagued by a gut feeling that this palace visit was akin to walking into a tiger's den.

Even if his prince happened to be a tiger himself.

"It's fine. My conscience is clear. If His Majesty harbors any misunderstandings, we can simply clear them up." Wearing an easygoing smile, the Second Prince picked up the magic staff he had finished crafting not long ago and prepared to set off for the palace.

"Your Highness, perhaps we should just leave. Her Majesty the Queen is waiting for you in the Denton family's territory, and there is an army stationed there..."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第188章 又想让我家阿沐当血包是吧 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
二王子摇头，轻笑：“还没到那种程度，你们不用担心。就算父王真的对我有意见，我想出来还是不难的。”

二王子脸上轻松，心中则在想到底是谁在陷害他，又有谁有这个能力陷害他？

他第一个想到的就是大王子。

但他总觉得大王子不是这样阴险的人，而且不是他小看大王子，他真不觉得大王子能瞒过所有人眼睛神不知鬼不觉地弄到空间腰带。

如果大王子拿到空间腰带，他也没必要把里面的东西取出来一部分就为了栽赃陷害他。

以大王子的性子，他最大可能是把腰带直接交给虎王，要么就是一直隐藏，直到他成为新王后再拿出来。

这陷害还十分不走心，弄了一个像是安妮丽娜的人进入那家俱乐部，还让三王子逮个正着。

安妮丽娜被关在墨文伯爵府地牢的事已经流传出来。

任谁来看，这就是妥妥的陷害和闹剧，有脑子的人都不会当真。

而且这个陷害弄不好还会让陷害者深陷泥坑。

二王子怎么想，都不觉得大王子会这么多此一举。

那就是大公主？

如果虎王没有指定继承人，他觉得大公主来挑战他的可能性更高，就单纯地用武力定输赢，谁赢了谁上位。

至于说三王子特意陷害他……那就是个被利用的蠢货，还自以为干了什么大事，说不定现在正沾沾自喜，等着看他倒霉。

二王子想来想去都没有想到，有人把那些东西放到他那里，不是为了栽赃陷害，只是想找一个合适的地方把那些属于王室的用品拿出来还给虎王，顺便给他添点堵而已。

在二王子到达王宫前，虎王已经做出了最后选择。

他也已经下达完第二道王令——即传位给大王子，这道王令不会马上公开。

如果现在就传位给大王子，民众和他国人肯定会议论和怀疑他这个虎王是不是出了什么大事。

他得先稳住虎国和其他国家。

虎王和大都督几人沟通后，决定先以锻炼为由，让大王子代替他处理政事，而他则隐于幕后。

这段时间顺便也观察二王子和大公主，提防他们搞出事来。

等到传承大会召开前夕，再正式公布让大王子继位的消息。

各国各部落领袖也可顺便观礼。

虎王到时候找个理由不露面，比如正在突破之类。

这样他依然可以作为武力威慑存在，可以最大程度削弱新王继位有可能造成的动荡。

二王子进宫时，大都督等人刚好离开。

二王子收到一张纸条，打开看完，毁掉纸条，脑中各种念头飞转。

三王子等到了二王子，但还没等他近身嘲笑，就忽然感觉自己全身剧痛。

三王子惨叫着倒下，身体不断抽搐，眼口鼻耳都流出了红黑色的血液。

王宫侍卫和三王子的侍者见到这一幕，差点吓傻。

有人惊慌大喊：“诅咒！这是怨魂诅咒！”

正要离开王宫的商非凡瞄过去：屁的诅咒。

郎沐看到：哦，魔法啊。

这个魔法不会要人命，只会让人痛入骨髓。显然二王子还不打算杀了三王子。

不是二王子不想杀掉三王子，而是就在王宫门口，直接杀人也不好，给个教训也算给自己出了口气。

“二王子手里拿的是法杖，只看他没怎么念咒就施展出惩戒魔法，说明他的魔法等级不低，应该和我差不多。”郎沐头疼，为什么想要离开王宫就这么难呢，简直一波又一波。

商非凡被郎沐神情逗笑，直接拉着郎沐转身：“走吧，去看看。”

看在虎王立的那块石碑的份上，商非凡和郎沐都不希望虎王再出什么问题，更不想要让刚刚定下的王位继承人选再有什么波折。

只是郎沐没有看到商非凡转过身时，眼神中的阴狠与决绝。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 188: Trying to Use My A-Mu as a Blood Bag Again, Are We? (Part 3)

The Second Prince shook his head and gave a light chuckle. "It hasn't come to that yet, so there's no need to worry. Even if my royal father truly holds a prejudice against me, leaving the palace won't be difficult."

While his expression remained relaxed, his mind raced: *Who on earth is trying to frame me, and who possesses the capability to pull it off?*

His first suspect was the First Prince.

Yet, he felt the First Prince lacked such an insidious nature. Furthermore, not to underestimate his eldest brother, but he simply didn't believe the First Prince could bypass everyone's notice and purloin the spatial belt without a sound.

If the First Prince had indeed obtained the spatial belt, there would be no reason to empty out a portion of its contents solely to frame him.

Given the First Prince's temperament, his most likely course of action would have been to hand the belt directly to the Tiger King, or conceal it entirely until he ascended the throne as the new monarch.

Moreover, the framing was remarkably sloppy—manufacturing a woman resembling Anelina to enter that club and making sure the Third Prince caught her red-handed.

The fact that Anelina had been locked away in Lord Mervyn's estate dungeon was already public knowledge.

To anyone with eyes, this was a blatant frame-up and a farce; anyone with half a brain would refuse to take it seriously.

Worse still, this clumsy setup threatened to plunge the perpetrator deep into the mire.

No matter how the Second Prince analyzed it, he couldn't fathom the First Prince going to such superfluous lengths.

Could it be the First Princess?

If the Tiger King had left the succession open, he would deem it far more likely for the First Princess to challenge him—settling matters purely through raw martial might to determine who took the crown.

As for the Third Prince deliberately framing him... that was merely a pawn being used as a fool, convinced he had achieved some monumental feat while likely sitting back right now, drooling in anticipation of his downfall.

Try as he might, the Second Prince never imagined that whoever had planted those items in his possession had done so without any intent to frame him at all. They had simply sought a convenient spot to unearth those royal artifacts and return them to the Tiger King, while incidentally stirring up some trouble for him.

Before the Second Prince arrived at the palace, the Tiger King had already made his final choice.

He had also issued his second decree—bestowing the crown upon the First Prince. However, this decree would not be made public immediately.

Announcing the succession right now would inevitably spark speculation and panic among the populace and neighboring nations regarding whether some fatal calamity had struck the Tiger King.

He needed to stabilize both the Tiger Kingdom and foreign powers first.

Following consultations with the Grand Commander and the others, the Tiger King decided to use the pretext of "stewardship training" to let the First Prince handle state affairs in his stead, while he himself retreated behind the scenes.

During this interval, they would also keep a close eye on the Second Prince and First Princess to prevent them from staging any upheavals.

When the eve of the Succession Ceremony arrived, the news of the First Prince's ascension would be officially proclaimed.

Leaders of various nations and tribes could then attend as witnesses.

By that time, the Tiger King could simply find an excuse to remain absent—such as being in the middle of a breakthrough.

This way, he could continue serving as a deterrent through sheer might, minimizing the potential turmoil caused by the new king's succession.

As the Second Prince entered the palace, the Grand Commander and his companions were just departing.

The Second Prince received a slip of paper. He unfolded it, read the contents, destroyed the scrap, and let a flurry of thoughts spin through his mind.

The Third Prince had been waiting to intercept the Second Prince, but before he could even close the distance to hurl mockery, a sudden, excruciating agony wracked his entire body.

With a miserable shriek, the Third Prince crashed to the ground, his body twitching uncontrollably as dark-red blood poured from his eyes, nose, mouth, and ears.

The palace guards and the Third Prince's attendants were frightened out of their wits by the sight.

Someone shrieked in panic, "A curse! This is a wraith's curse!"

Shang Feifan, who was just about to leave, glanced over: *Curse my ass.*

Lang Mu observed the scene: *Oh, magic.*

This spell wouldn't take a life; it simply inflicted pain that pierced straight to the marrow. Clearly, the Second Prince had no intention of killing the Third Prince just yet.

It wasn't that the Second Prince didn't *want* to kill him, but rather that standing right at the gates of the royal palace, committing murder outright was unseemly. Giving him a taste of torment counted as venting some of his frustration.

"The Second Prince is holding a magic staff. The fact that he cast a punitive spell with hardly any chanting implies his magical rank is quite high—probably on par with mine," Lang Mu muttered, a headache forming. Why was leaving the royal palace turning out to be such an arduous ordeal, wave after wave of trouble blocking their path?

Amused by Lang Mu's expression, Shang Feifan grabbed his hand and turned him around. "Let's go. Let's see what's happening."

For the sake of that stone tablet the Tiger King had erected, neither Shang Feifan nor Lang Mu wished to see the monarch suffer any further mishaps, nor did they want any turbulence to derail the newly minted succession.

Only, Lang Mu missed the cold, ruthless flash of finality that crossed Shang Feifan's eyes as he turned his back.

chunks.chineseText:
第189章 诅咒的力量

“怨气诅咒！咒你永远无法成为王者。”

谁也没有看到一团浓重的怨气咻地钻入二王子身体。

二王子打了个冷颤，冷到他的脑子都清醒不少。

随即他就怀疑自己是不是被人暗算了。

但他暗中检查了数回，也没有发现身体哪里异样，只能带着疑惑继续往前走。

二王子发现领路人不是领他去往书房，而是领他去往虎王寝宫时，心中就产生了波澜。

等到他在寝宫见到半躺在床上，喘气非常吃力，遮掩都遮掩不住的虎王时，二王子脑中已经闪过数个念头。

只不过虎王并不是毫无防备，克莱门特就站在他的床边。寝宫四角都有侍卫守护，还有负责侍候的侍者。

为了确认这不是陷阱。二王子口中默念魔法口诀，眼睛泛起一点点淡淡的光芒，快速扫过虎王全身。

没错了，虎王确实病倒，还病得很重。他似乎看到了法则的痕迹？

虎王也在观察他的二儿子。

他感觉他已经很久没有好好看过他的儿女。

寝宫的采光很好，床的位置也很巧妙，让虎王可以看清楚每个进入寝宫人的模样。

二王子是他几个儿女中长得最好的，气质也非常特别。

虎王正在回忆二王子小时候，可不知道为什么，也许是儿女太多、时间过去太久的缘故，他竟然无法想起老二小时候的模样。

他记得大王子，那是他第一个孩子，他自然十分关注。小小年纪就老成持重，跟个小大人一样。

他也记得三王子，那小子从小就闹腾得很，一个不如意就满地打滚。

两个公主他也记得清楚，大公主很小就展示出强大的战斗力，年纪不大就能觉醒为巨兽，让他十分欢喜。小公主则娇俏可爱，是他和王后的掌心宝，明明小时候那么可爱，长大后却变得特别娇纵跋扈。

只有二王子，印象特别浅，只记得身体很差。

似乎他脑中关于二王子的第一个清晰印象就是他站在书房里向他行礼，表示自己想要去翼国游学。

那时老二多大，十六还是十八？

他记得自己答应了老二的请求。

等他再一次见到老二，已经是三四年后。

那之后老二好像就是现在这个样子，安静不惹事，游离在权力之外，只对神秘学感兴趣。

他有时候会感觉到老二似乎有点瞧不上他几个兄弟姐妹。

“我记得你小时候似乎经常生病。”虎王缓缓说道。

二王子微愣，没想到虎王的开场白竟然是这个。

有点摸不着头脑，但二王子还是耐心回复：“是，儿子小时候身体不好，让父王和母后担忧了。”

虎王忽然问：“你病了多久？什么时候痊愈的？”

二王子摸不清虎王的想法，只能斟酌着回答：“听母后说，儿子出生身体就不好，她以为儿子会养不活。但儿子生命力也算顽强，吃药吃到十岁出头，大约十四五岁时身体开始恢复。期间，儿子一直住在别宫。”

虎王点头，心想怪不得他对老二印象单薄，想来是因为他身体不好，而王后也有其他更小的孩子要照顾，只能把老二送到别宫修养。

这也是兽人贵族或大家族的一贯做法，对于天残和身体不好的孩子，会首先放弃培养。

这大约也是兽人的原始兽性使然。

远古时期，兽人如果生出身体残缺或不太健康的孩子，在有其他健康孩子的情况下，甚至会把不健康和残缺的孩子咬死，后来发展为丢弃。

“你恨我吗？”

“父王，您说笑了。”二王子似乎异常吃惊，哭笑不得地说：“儿子怎么可能恨您。”

“那就好。”虎王单手撑着靠枕，想要再坐起来一点，但就这么一个小小动作，竟然让他气喘不止。

侍者忙过来帮忙。

二王子担心：“父王，您这是怎么了？是身体不适吗？”

虎王摆手，让侍者退开。

“伊迪艾德里安，如果我让你兄长加百列穆勒成为新的虎王，你可愿意辅佐他？”

二王子听到自己说：“当然愿意。”

虎王看着自己的次子：“既然如此，那你可愿意从今日起就留在王宫为你父王侍疾，直到传承分享大会结束。”

二王子沉默片刻：“父王，您可以直接跟我说，您不相信我，想要软禁我。”

虎王像是笑了下，慢慢说：“我不是不相信你，我是不相信你的手下。听说王后给你留了一些人手。你是个好孩子，但人是禁不起撺掇的，我只是不希望你被那些人带上歧路。”

二王子看向克莱门特，发现克莱门特的手已经按在武器手柄上。

二王子叹息一声，从空间手镯里抽出了他的法杖。

虎王看到二王子的动作，没有丝毫震怒和惊讶，只是平静地说：“看来你学了一些很特殊的本事。”

进入寝宫者，未经允许不得带入任何炼金物品、武器，包括空间储物道具等。

二王子进寝宫前，肯定经过搜检，但他却还是把空间手镯带进来了。

二王子：“我也没办法。您在心中似乎已经给我定了罪名，认定我会成为加百列穆勒继位的阻碍。您现在只是软禁我，但我们都看到了丹顿血脉被软禁的下场。还有我的母亲，现在也不得不逃向丹顿领地。”

杀了他！杀了虎王！把他和克莱门特都控制起来，你能做到。只要控制他们，让虎王传位给你，你马上就是虎王。

不，当王有什么意思，我觉得我不太可能成为一个王者，我明明是个魔法师。

二王子脑中有两个声音在打架。

“那如果我没有想要软禁你，当我宣布你大哥成为新一代虎王时，你会乖乖听话吗？”虎王似乎真的很好奇这点。

二王子哂笑：“我记得我们虎国的教育向来是弱肉强食、最强的人才配拥有最好的。您认为加百列穆勒会是最强的那个吗？”

对，把大王子也给干掉，还有大公主。他们都不是你的对手！

算了，都是兄弟姐妹，干掉什么干掉。我就是一个魔法师啊。

虎王：“那你认为你才是最强的那个？你有多少信心能比你大哥更优秀、更适合作为国王？”

二王子笑了笑，把另一道声音完全踢出大脑：“父王，您不会以为我要伤害您吧？”

二王子摇头：“不，我不会对您动手。实际上，我对当国王并没有多大兴趣。”

对，这才是他的真实想法，他就是为魔法师而生，当什么国王？

打算出手阻止二王子的克莱门特，以及就站在寝宫一角的郎沐和商非凡也生出了一丝好奇心。

这位二王子到底想要做什么？

虎王也在笑：“那你对什么感兴趣？”

“成神。”二王子淡淡说出他的最终目的。

“是不是很可笑？”二王子怅然，“可这真的是我唯一也是最想要的。这几乎已经成了我的执念。”

二王子看向虎王：“父王，您能告诉我，要怎么样才能成神吗？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 189: The Power of the Curse

"A grievance curse! I curse you to never become a monarch."

No one saw a thick cluster of resentful aura dart into the Second Prince's body in a flash.

The Second Prince shivered, the chill so piercing that it cleared his mind significantly.

Immediately, he suspected that someone had plotted against him in secret.

Yet, after secretly checking himself several times without finding any bodily abnormalities, he could only press forward with lingering doubts.

When the Second Prince discovered that his guide was leading him not to the study, but toward the Tiger King's bedchamber, ripples of emotion stirred within his heart.

By the time he entered the bedchamber and saw the Tiger King half-lying on the bed, breathing with extreme difficulty and failing utterly to mask his condition, several thoughts flashed through the Second Prince's mind.

However, the Tiger King was not completely unguarded; Clement stood right beside his bed. Guards were stationed at all four corners of the bedchamber, alongside attending servants.

To confirm this was not a trap, the Second Prince silently recited a spell incantation, a faint glow flickering in his eyes as he swept them quickly across the Tiger King's entire body.

Indeed, there was no mistake. The Tiger King had fallen ill, and gravely so. Had he just caught a glimpse of the traces of the Laws?

The Tiger King was also observing his second son.

He felt as though he hadn't properly looked at his children in a very long time.

The bedchamber was well-lit, and the bed was positioned so ingeniously that the Tiger King could clearly see the appearance of everyone who entered.

The Second Prince was the best-looking among all his children, possessing a deeply unique temperament.

The Tiger King tried to recall the Second Prince's childhood, but for some reason—perhaps due to having too many children and the passage of so much time—he actually found himself unable to recall what the Second Prince looked like when he was young.

He remembered the First Prince; that was his firstborn, so naturally, he paid close attention. From a tender age, the boy had been mature and steady, acting just like a little adult.

He also remembered the Third Prince; that little rascal had been full of mischief since he was a child, rolling on the ground in tantrums whenever things didn't go his way.

He remembered both princesses clearly as well. The First Princess had displayed formidable combat prowess from a very young age, awakening as a giant beast while still quite young, which had greatly pleased him. The Little Princess, delicate and adorable, was the precious apple of his and the Queen's eye—clearly so lovely in her youth, yet turning exceptionally spoiled and domineering as she grew older.

Only the Second Prince left a remarkably faint impression; he only remembered that his health had been poor.

It seemed the first clear impression in his mind regarding the Second Prince was of him standing in the study, paying his respects and expressing his desire to go on a study tour to the Winged Country.

How old had the Second son been back then? Sixteen or eighteen?

He remembered granting the Second son's request.

By the time he saw the Second son again, it was three or four years later.

After that, the Second son seemed to have remained just like this ever since—quiet, causing no trouble, hovering on the periphery of power, and interested solely in mysticism.

At times, he had the feeling that the Second son looked down slightly on his brothers and sisters.

"I remember you seemed to fall ill quite often when you were young," the Tiger King slowly said.

The Second Prince was slightly startled, not expecting the Tiger King's opening remark to be this.

Though slightly baffled, the Second Prince still replied patiently, "Yes, Son's health was poor in his youth, causing Father and Mother to worry."

The Tiger King suddenly asked, "How long were you sick? When did you fully recover?"

Unsure of what the Tiger King was thinking, the Second Prince could only choose his words carefully. "According to Mother, Son's health was poor right from birth, and she thought Son wouldn't survive. But Son's vitality was somewhat tenacious; I took medicine until my early teens, and my health began to recover around fourteen or fifteen. During that time, Son always lived in the annex palace."

The Tiger King nodded, thinking to himself that no wonder his impression of the Second son was so thin. It must have been because of his poor health, and with the Queen having other younger children to care for, she could only send the Second son to the annex palace to recuperate.

This was also the usual practice among orc nobility and great families: for children born with physical flaws or poor health, rearing them was abandoned first.

This was likely driven by the primitive bestial nature of the orcs.

In ancient times, if orcs gave birth to physically incomplete or unhealthy children, provided they had other healthy offspring, they would even bite the unhealthy and flawed children to death, a practice that later evolved into abandonment.

"Do you hate me?"

"Father, you jest." The Second Prince seemed exceptionally surprised, saying with a wry laugh, "How could Son possibly hate you?"

"That's good." The Tiger King propped himself up on a pillow with one hand, wanting to sit up a bit more, but this tiny movement alone left him panting heavily.

A servant hurriedly stepped forward to help.

The Second Prince asked with concern, "Father, what is wrong? Are you feeling unwell?"

The Tiger King waved a hand, signaling the servant to step back.

"Edi Adrian, if I were to have your elder brother, Gabriel Muller, become the new Tiger King, would you be willing to assist him?"

The Second Prince heard himself say, "Of course."

The Tiger King looked at his second son. "In that case, would you be willing to stay in the royal palace starting today to tend to your father's illness, right up until the Heritage Sharing Assembly concludes?"

The Second Prince fell silent for a moment. "Father, you can just tell me directly—you don't trust me and want to place me under house arrest."

The Tiger King seemed to smile slightly, slowly saying, "It's not that I don't trust you; it's that I don't trust your subordinates. I've heard the Queen left you some personnel. You're a good child, but people cannot withstand incitement; I simply don't wish for you to be led astray by those people."

The Second Prince looked at Clement and noticed that Clement's hand was already resting on the hilt of his weapon.

The Second Prince sighed and drew his magic staff from his spatial bracelet.

Seeing the Second Prince's action, the Tiger King showed neither rage nor surprise, saying only calmly, "It seems you have learned some rather special skills."

Anyone entering the bedchamber was strictly forbidden from bringing in any alchemical items, weapons, or spatial storage items without permission.

Before entering the bedchamber, the Second Prince must have undergone a search, yet he had still managed to smuggle his spatial bracelet inside.

The Second Prince: "I had no choice. In your heart, you seem to have already convicted me, determining that I would become an obstacle to Gabriel Muller's ascension. You're only placing me under house arrest now, but we've all seen the fate of the Danton bloodline when they were placed under house arrest. And my mother—she now has no choice but to flee toward the Danton territory."

*Kill him! Kill the Tiger King! Control both him and Clement, you can do it. As long as you control them and make the Tiger King pass the throne to you, you will be the Tiger King immediately.*

*No, what's the point of being a king? I don't think I'm likely to become a monarch anyway; I am clearly a magician.*

Two voices were fighting inside the Second Prince's head.

"Then, if I had no intention of placing you under house arrest, would you obediently obey when I announce your eldest brother as the new generation of Tiger King?" The Tiger King seemed genuinely curious about this point.

The Second Prince sneered, "I recall that our Tiger Kingdom's education has always been about the law of the jungle—only the strongest deserve to possess the best. Do you believe Gabriel Muller will be the strongest one?"

*That's right, take out the eldest prince as well, and the eldest princess too. None of them are your match!*

*Forget it, they're all brothers and sisters; take what out? I'm just a magician.*

The Tiger King: "Then do you think you are the strongest one? How much confidence do you have that you are superior to your eldest brother and more suited to be king?"

The Second Prince smiled and completely kicked the other voice out of his mind. "Father, you surely don't think I would harm you, do you?"

The Second Prince shook his head. "No, I will not raise a hand against you. In truth, I don't have much interest in being king."

*Right, this is his true thought; he was born for magic. Why be a king?*

Clement, who had been about to step forward to stop the Second Prince, as well as Lang Mu and Shang Feifan standing in the corner of the bedchamber, couldn't help but feel a flicker of curiosity.

What on earth was this Second Prince trying to do?

The Tiger King was also smiling. "Then what are you interested in?"

"Becoming a god," the Second Prince stated calmly, revealing his ultimate goal.

"Isn't it ridiculous?" The Second Prince said with a wistful sigh, "Yet this is truly my only and greatest desire. It has practically become my obsession."

The Second Prince looked at the Tiger King. "Father, can you tell me how one becomes a god?"
---

chunks.chineseText:
虎王觉得他这个二儿子有点病，“如果我知道，我还会躺在这里吗？”

“也是。”二王子点头，“我听别人跟我说，统治一个国家，集民众信仰，以信仰之力转为魔力，也有可能送我上神位。”

虎王皱眉：“你要在虎国境内搞宗教？”

二王子摇头：“不是宗教。一名伟大的国王一样能得到民众大量信仰。但我观察了很久，发现想要在兽人大陆成为神灵，哪怕就是成为整个兽人大陆的帝皇也无法做到。因为古神的存在，祂们已经把往上走的路给封死。还有传说中的神之笼封禁了整个世界，魔力不能流通，仅剩下的能量根本无法支撑法圣冲破桎梏变成法神。”

虎王：完了，这个儿子确实病得不轻。

二王子手握法杖，对克莱门特笑了笑：“别担心，我真的没打算动手。如果我想动手，你现在已经躺下。”

克莱门特没说话。

二王子又看向虎王：“我就实话对您说了吧，我不想被任何人软禁，虽然您也做不到，但我还是喜欢说清楚。我会离开虎国，带着我的人一起。您也不用担心母后那边，我会过去接手那批人手，包括丹顿家族的那支军队。”

虎王冷静地：“你想去哪里？”

二王子：“找个大点的岛屿占领下来。毕竟听说兽人大陆即将发生岩浆大爆发的地质灾害，我也不认为我的个人力量能抵抗祸及整个大陆的天灾。”

虎王：“……”

商非凡和郎沐对看。

郎沐想笑。没想到这个二王子竟然是这样的二王子。

商非凡：为什么诅咒会产生这么奇怪的效果？算了，这也算达成目的了。也许这家伙原本心里就摇摆不定，诅咒影响了他，让他的想法彻底倒向另一边。

二王子又亮了下法杖：“我想走，你们阻止不了我。”

随即，他用法杖一指虎王……床边不远处的石桌。

石桌无声无息变成粉末。

二王子倔强地表示：他不是无法当王，而是他不想当王，武力还是要展示一下的。

嚓！寝宫内响起整齐划一的拔兵器声。

虎王抬手，示意侍卫们不用紧张。

克莱门特始终紧紧盯着二王子。

二王子法杖对着几名侍卫轻轻一点：“土牢囚笼！”

几名侍卫瞬间被包裹进一个大土球中。

虎王没有半点惊恐之色，还露出了若有所思的神情：“你这是……魔血天赋？你觉醒了魔血？”

二王子又用魔法恢复了石桌，同时解开那几个侍卫的束缚。

有侍者发出倒吸冷气的声音。

二王子提着魔杖对虎王行了个魔法师礼：“算是吧。您也可以称我为魔法师。”

“你真的打算离开？”虎王再次询问。

“是。”二王子认真回复。

他还笑着说：“我已经从另外一个有野心的魔法师身上想明白，他走的路不是我想走的路，但他也给了我一点启发。我想我应该从能量的最本质入手。

好在这么些年的神秘学我也没有白白研究，虽然不能施展魔法，但单论理论上的知识我已经远超以前的我。

我的老师曾经教导过我，他说三流的魔法师只会使用魔法，二流的魔法师会创造新的魔法，一流的魔法师会研究魔法的本质，而能踏上法圣之路的魔法师则在思考一切的源头，也就是能量本身。”

二王子坦然笑道：“这就是我选择的成神之路，研究能量的本质，研究能量从哪里来，是不是万物都能产生能量，而任何能量是否都能万宗归一乃至互相转换。

我想，当我能掌握能量本质是什么的那一天，我就能自然而然踏入神灵的境界了吧。

也许我永远都无法做到，不过没关系，至少我认为我已经踏上了成神的正确道路。”

二王子再次对虎王行礼：“别了，我的父王。以后不知道是否还有见面的机会，不要派人来阻拦我，也请收回剿灭丹顿家族那支军队的人手。我说会带他们离开就一定会带他们离开。如果他们不肯，我会为您解决他们。这就算是偿还您和虎国养育我多年的恩情吧。”

“我永远遵循魔法师的平等交换原则。”二王子最后说了这么一句，转身，大步走出寝宫。

虎王：“……”

“哦，对了。”二王子突又转身：“小心那位天残谷主，他也是魔法师，还是比我强得多的魔法师，他手下还有一支不明数量的天残大军。对比邪神信徒，这支力量同样不可小觑。”

二王子顿了顿：“不要跟他说是我跟你们透露的，我还不想招惹他。这次是真走了，再回！”

看着二王子消失在寝宫门口的身影，克莱门特也不禁沉思：也许他从没有真正的认识这位二王子。

商非凡忍不住对郎沐吐槽：“能量的本质是什么我不知道，但这个二王子的本质一定是中二！”

否则他的诅咒绝不是这种效果！

两人还以为要过来拯救虎王，商非凡都已经做好了杀死二王子的准备，结果……二王子竟然选择跑路。

商非凡特别郁闷：他都还没有带着郎沐跑路，这个二王子竟然先一步脚底抹油了。

狡猾，太狡猾了。

这些魔法师果然没几个傻的。

想想也是，辛辛苦苦地跟自己的兄弟姐妹争夺王位，周围还有一圈妖魔鬼怪围着自己，将相王侯贵族大臣也都各有心思，还得想着怎么解决岩浆大爆发的问题，同时还要让虎国子民能尊敬他到信仰的程度。

二王子就算想要琢磨魔法都没有多少时间吧？

而魔法师大多都很宅，很多魔法师都偏向于研究者。

对于一名研究者来说，让他去做一堆杂事，不给他研究的时间，还不如杀了他。

二王子的野心也许都点在了成神上，当个能完全自主还事少的魔法师领主，不比当事多还烦的虎国国王更香？

尤其二王子的能力足以让其他大势力都对他无可奈何，在有魔晶的情况下。

“是个聪明人。”郎沐也感叹。

二王子确实是个聪明人，他和天残谷主结交的时间越长，就越发忌惮这个人。

一开始他还以为这是个需要依赖他权势的人。

但不久后，他就发现自己错了。

天残谷主的目的一样是成神，而他显然已经为此筹谋多年，甚至已经踏上了他认为是正确的道路，且有了一定眉目。

在这种情况下，作为二王子的他和其合作，也许初期还能占到一点便宜，比如获得魔晶和得到对方的武力支援。

但时间一久，便宜和支援就会变成勒住他脖颈的绳索。

魔法师得拥有足够的魔力才能施展魔法，一旦天残谷主断掉他的魔晶提供，他别说和天残谷主对敌，恐怕只能躺平任由天残谷主予取予求。

同样，曾经支援他的武力，也会在未来成为掠夺他一切的大军。

二王子经过重重思量——就在他刚才进宫和见到虎王的那一段时间，最终决定远离天残谷主，也远离虎国。
chunks.englishText:
The Tiger King felt that his second son was somewhat out of his mind. "If I knew, would I still be lying here?"

"True enough." The Second Prince nodded. "I heard others say that ruling a country, gathering the faith of the masses, and converting that power of faith into magic power might also send me up to a divine throne."

The Tiger King frowned. "You want to start a religion within the borders of the Tiger Kingdom?"

The Second Prince shook his head. "Not a religion. A great king can likewise gain a massive amount of faith from the people. But I have observed for a long time and discovered that wanting to become a deity on the Orc Continent—even becoming the emperor of the entire Orc Continent—is impossible. Because of the existence of the ancient gods, they have sealed off the path upward. Furthermore, the legendary Cage of Gods seals the entire world, preventing magic power from circulating; the meager energy that remains is simply insufficient to support a Saint Magister in breaking through their shackles to become a God Magus."

The Tiger King: *It's over, this son is indeed severely deranged.*

Wielding his staff, the Second Prince smiled at Clement. "Don't worry, I truly have no intention of making a move. If I wanted to strike, you would already be lying down."

Clement remained silent.

The Second Prince looked back at the Tiger King. "I'll be honest with you: I don't want to be placed under house arrest by anyone. Although you wouldn't be able to pull it off anyway, I still prefer to make things clear. I will leave the Tiger Kingdom, taking my people with me. You needn't worry about Mother's side either; I will go over and take charge of that group of people, including the Danton family's army."

The Tiger King asked calmly, "Where do you want to go?"

The Second Prince: "Find a larger island and occupy it. After all, I've heard that a geological disaster of massive magma eruptions is about to strike the Orc Continent, and I don't believe my personal strength can resist a natural disaster that plagues the entire continent."

The Tiger King: "..."

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu exchanged glances.

Lang Mu wanted to laugh. He hadn't expected this Second Prince to turn out to be such a character.

Shang Feifan: *Why would a curse produce such a bizarre effect? Whatever, this still achieves the goal. Perhaps this fellow was already wavering in his heart, and the curse influenced him, making his thoughts lean entirely toward the opposite side.*

The Second Prince flashed his staff again. "If I want to leave, you cannot stop me."

With that, he pointed his staff at the Tiger King... or rather, the stone table not far from the bedside.

The stone table silently turned into powder.

The Second Prince stubbornly expressed: it wasn't that he couldn't be king, but that he didn't want to be king; some force still had to be displayed.

*Clack!* A neat, uniform sound of weapons being drawn rang out inside the bedchamber.

The Tiger King raised a hand, signaling the guards not to be nervous.

Clement kept his eyes locked tightly on the Second Prince.

The Second Prince lightly tapped his staff toward several guards. "Earth Prison Cage!"

The guards were instantly enveloped inside a massive ball of earth.

The Tiger King showed not a shred of panic, instead wearing a pensive expression. "This is... magic blood talent? You've awakened magic blood?"

The Second Prince restored the stone table with magic once more, simultaneously releasing the restraints on those guards.

A servant let out a sharp gasp of air.

Carrying his magic wand, the Second Prince gave the Tiger King a magician's bow. "You could say that. You may also call me a magician."

"You truly intend to leave?" the Tiger King asked again.

"Yes," the Second Prince replied earnestly.

He even smiled and said, "I have figured things out from another ambitious magician: the path he walks is not the path I wish to take, but he has also given me a bit of inspiration. I think I should start from the most fundamental essence of energy.

Fortunately, my years of mysticism have not been in vain; although I cannot cast grand spells, purely in terms of theoretical knowledge, I have far surpassed my former self.

My teacher once taught me that a third-rate magician only uses magic, a second-rate magician creates new magic, a first-rate magician studies the essence of magic, and a magician capable of stepping onto the path of a Saint Magister ponders the origin of everything—that is, energy itself."

The Second Prince smiled frankly. "This is the path to godhood I have chosen: studying the essence of energy, researching where energy comes from, whether all things can generate energy, and whether any form of energy can return to a single source or even transform into one another.

I imagine that the day I grasp what the essence of energy is, I will naturally step into the realm of divinity.

Perhaps I will never succeed, but it doesn't matter. At least I believe I have set foot on the correct path to godhood."

The Second Prince bowed to the Tiger King once more. "Farewell, my Father. I know not if we shall ever have the chance to meet again hereafter. Send no one to block my path, and please recall the forces tasked with wiping out the Danton family. Since I said I would take them away, I will certainly take them away. If they are unwilling, I will deal with them for you. Let this be considered repayment for the grace of you and the Tiger Kingdom raising me for all these years."

"I shall forever abide by the magician's principle of equivalent exchange," the Second Prince uttered those final words, turned around, and strode out of the bedchamber.

The Tiger King: "..."

"Oh, right," the Second Prince suddenly turned back. "Beware of that Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley; he is also a magician—a far more powerful one than I—and he commands an unknown number of Heaven-Defying troops under his banner. Compared to the heretical god's followers, this force is likewise not to be underestimated."

The Second Prince paused. "Do not tell him that I am the one who leaked this to you; I've no wish to provoke him just yet. I'm truly leaving this time. Farewell!"

Watching the Second Prince's figure vanish at the doorway of the bedchamber, Clement couldn't help falling into deep thought: perhaps he had never truly understood this Second Prince.

Shang Feifan couldn't help but complain to Lang Mu: "I don't know what the essence of energy is, but the essence of this Second Prince is definitely *chuunibyou*!"

Otherwise, his curse would never have produced such an effect!

The two of them had thought they were coming to rescue the Tiger King, and Shang Feifan had even prepared himself to kill the Second Prince, but as it turned out... the Second Prince chose to slip away instead.

Shang Feifan felt exceptionally depressed: he hadn't even gotten to whisk Lang Mu away yet, and this Second Prince had greased his palms and fled first.

Cunning, far too cunning.

These magicians truly had very few fools among them.

Come to think of it, struggling bitterly with one's brothers and sisters for the throne, with a circle of monsters and demons lurking around, ministers and nobles each harboring their own agendas, while also having to figure out how to resolve the magma eruption crisis and make the subjects of the Tiger Kingdom respect him to the point of worship—

Even if the Second Prince wanted to ponder magic, how much time would he realistically have?

And magicians were mostly homebodies; many of them leaned toward being researchers.

For a researcher, making him handle a bunch of trivial chores without giving him time to research was practically worse than killing him.

The Second Prince's ambition was likely entirely invested in becoming a god. Becoming a completely autonomous magician lord with few troubles—wasn't that far more fragrant than being the Tiger Kingdom's king, weighed down by endless troubles and annoyances?

Especially since the Second Prince's ability was enough to render other major powers helpless against him, provided he had magic crystals.

"A smart man," Lang Mu also lamented.

The Second Prince was indeed a smart man. The longer he associated with the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley, the more wary he became of this person.

At first, he had thought this was someone who needed to rely on his power.

But shortly after, he realized he was wrong.

The Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley's goal was similarly to become a god, and he was clearly plotting for this for many years, having even stepped onto what he believed to be the correct path with some headway made.

Under such circumstances, as the Second Prince cooperating with him might yield some small advantages in the early stages, such as acquiring magic crystals and receiving the other party's military support.

But as time went on, those advantages and support would turn into a noose tightening around his neck.

A magician needed sufficient magic power to cast spells; the moment the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley cut off his supply of magic crystals, let alone fighting the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley, he would probably have to lie flat and let the other party do whatever they pleased with him.

Likewise, the military force that had once supported him would in the future become a grand army plundering everything he owned.

After thorough consideration—right during that brief period when he entered the palace and saw the Tiger King—the Second Prince ultimately decided to distance himself from the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley, and from the Tiger Kingdom as well.
---

chunks.chineseText:
虎国眼看就要陷入风雨飘摇中，不论是天残谷主还是邪神信徒，都有拿下虎国的意思。

二王子不想在这里面当个棋子，更不想成为炮灰。

正好他已经和天残谷主交易了几枚中高阶魔晶，只要省着点用，他还是能撑起一片领地的。

另外就是，在这次春季材料展销大会中，他和天残谷主都发现了其他魔法师的痕迹。

二王子想要抽时间去寻找这些魔法师，看能不能通过他们找到更多魔晶，或者回去的路。

是的，二王子想要回去法德尔大陆了。

一片没有魔力的大陆，对于魔法师来说，真的太窒息。

在这里，他们如果疏忽大意甚至能被一只兽人幼崽轻易杀死。

而二王子穿到兽人大陆之前，可是一名初级魔导师，在法德尔大陆不说是横着走的存在，也没有多少人敢招惹。

二王子满心怅然，走出王宫经过三王子身边时，随手解了他身上的惩戒魔法。

这个蠢货竟然到现在还不肯离开王宫，竟然让治疗师和药剂师就在王宫门口为他治疗。

当然，三王子也没真的待在王宫门口，他被抬进了门内一处宫殿。

二王子摇摇头，忽然觉得一身轻松。原来摆脱（放弃）王位是这么轻松的吗？

商非凡比较多疑，还特地又跟踪了二王子一段时间，并让天眼系统盯住他，一旦发现他有什么异常行为就告诉他。

当天，二王子回去后就秘密找到大王子，把自己一些无法快速脱手的固定资产和货物全都半价交易给了大王子。

大王子吃惊不已，但他并没有怀疑自家兄弟不怀好心，他完全相信了二王子的说法——要去新领地发展，为此不得不紧急筹措资金。

结果资金筹集到一半，克莱门特就带着虎王的家底来了。

虎王空间腰带被盗，但不代表王室的财产全都消失。

有虎王的资助，大王子顺利买下二王子的全部不动产和大量货物。而父子俩都心知肚明，这里面有大半都是王后的私人财产。

二王子想要用金钱和矿物换取一定的粮食和食物。

大王子想到拉斐尔郎沐赠送给他的空间腰带里附带的大量粮草和肉类，和克莱门特商议良久，还是拒绝了二王子的交易请求。

大王子倒是很想帮助兄弟，但克莱门特严肃警告他：王城乃至整个虎国后面有可能会不好过，郎沐送给他的那些粮食和肉就是救命用的，别说交易出去，就是虎王也不能让知道。

大王子一听这话，深以为然。二王子有那么多钱和物资，还能去丹顿领地再搜刮一番，饿着谁都饿不着他。但虎国子民就不一样了，一旦出点风险，食物首先就是最大问题。

次日，虎王下令，命二王子前往丹顿领地收拾那边的丹顿家族残余力量。

二王子就这么带着一大堆人手和他自己的私人财产，浩浩荡荡地离开了王城。

众人看他去的方向，确实是丹顿领地没错。

有不少人认为虎王这样的命令根本就是放虎归山。

只有极少人才知道二王子这是准备跑路，再也不会回来了。

天残谷主皱眉看着二王子离去的方向，想到二王子昨晚找他谈的话。

二王子说现在虎国上层有点乱，大家都跟乌鸡眼似地盯着几个王子公主，尤其是他和大王子。

正好王后给他留了一点后手，他打算去收回来，就找了个理由说服了虎王。也借此暂时离开王城这个权力漩涡，算是以退为进。

天残谷主觉得二王子的打算也没有错，毕竟大王子才是最具有继承资格的那一个，二王子虽然也有一定胜算，但身处王城确实不好施展，还不如在外面先囤积自己的力量，然后再找人里应外合反杀回来。

就是二王子走得太匆忙，总有点逃出王城的仓惶感，也不知道是不是他的错觉。

天残谷主转过身，他也该进行他的下一步计划了。

不远处，商非凡盯着天残谷主，跟上。
chunks.englishText:
The Tiger Kingdom was poised to plunge into a tempest, with both the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley and the heretical god's followers harboring intentions of taking over.

The Second Prince had no desire to be a chess piece in this chaos, let alone cannon fodder.

It just so happened that he had already traded a few mid-to-high-tier magic crystals with the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley; as long as he used them sparingly, he could still carve out a territory of his own.

Furthermore, during this spring material exhibition and trade fair, both he and the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley had discovered traces of other magicians.

The Second Prince wanted to take the time to seek out these magicians and see if he could use them to find more magic crystals or discover the way back home.

Yes, the Second Prince wanted to return to the Fadel Continent.

For a magician, a continent devoid of magic power was truly too suffocating.

Here, if they grew careless, they could even be easily killed by an orc cub.

Before crossing over to the Orc Continent, the Second Prince had been a junior Archmage—someone who couldn't exactly walk sideways without care in the Fadel Continent, but certainly not someone many dared to provoke.

Filled with a heart full of wistfulness, as the Second Prince walked out of the royal palace and passed by the Third Prince, he casually lifted the disciplinary magic placed on him.

This fool actually still refused to leave the royal palace, even having healers and apothecaries treat him right at the palace gates.

Of course, the Third Prince wasn't actually staying right at the palace gates; he had been carried into a palace hall just inside the entrance.

The Second Prince shook his head, suddenly feeling a great sense of relief. So casting off (abandoning) the throne felt this liberating?

Shang Feifan was rather suspicious and deliberately trailed the Second Prince for a period of time, having the Sky-Eye system lock onto him and report any anomalous behavior.

That very day, upon returning, the Second Prince secretly sought out the First Prince and traded all his fixed assets and goods—which could not be liquidated quickly—to the First Prince at half price.

The First Prince was utterly shocked, but he did not suspect his own brother of harboring ill intentions; he completely bought the Second Prince's explanation: he was going to develop a new territory and thus had to urgently raise funds.

Halfway through raising the funds, however, Clement arrived bearing the Tiger King's private fortune.

The Tiger King's spatial belt had been stolen, but that did not mean all the royal family's wealth had vanished.

With the Tiger King's backing, the First Prince smoothly bought out all of the Second Prince's immovable property and massive inventory of goods. Both father and son were well aware in their hearts that a good half of these assets were the Queen's private property.

The Second Prince wanted to exchange gold and minerals for a certain amount of grain and food supplies.

Remembering the vast quantities of rations and meat attached to the spatial belt gifted to him by Raphael Lang Mu, the First Prince deliberated with Clement for a long time before ultimately rejecting the Second Prince's trade request.

The First Prince desperately wanted to help his brother, but Clement gave him a stern warning: the royal city and even the entire Tiger Kingdom might face hard times ahead. The food and meat Lang Mu gave him were meant for saving lives; forget trading them away, even the Tiger King couldn't be allowed to know about them.

Upon hearing this, the First Prince deeply agreed. The Second Prince had so much money and supplies, and he could even go raid the Danton territory to plunder more—he would starve before anyone else did. But the subjects of the Tiger Kingdom were different; once a crisis broke out, food would instantly become the biggest problem.

The next day, the Tiger King issued an order commanding the Second Prince to head to the Danton territory and clear out the remaining forces of the Danton family there.

Thus, the Second Prince swept out of the royal city in a grand procession, taking a massive retinue and his personal fortune along with him.

Watching the direction he took, it was indeed the Danton territory, without a doubt.

Quite a few people believed that such an order from the Tiger King was simply letting a tiger back into the mountains.

Only a tiny handful of people knew that the Second Prince was actually preparing to run for his life and would never return.

Frowning, the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley watched the direction in which the Second Prince departed, recalling the conversation the Second Prince had initiated with him the previous night.

The Second Prince had claimed that the upper echelons of the Tiger Kingdom were currently in a bit of chaos, with everyone staring at the various princes and princesses like red-eyed fighting cocks, particularly eyeing him and the First Prince.

Just as it happened, the Queen had left him some contingency forces, and he intended to retrieve them, so he had used an excuse to persuade the Tiger King. By doing so, he could temporarily leave the whirlpool of power in the royal city—considered a strategic retreat of advancing by retreating.

The Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley felt the Second Prince's plan wasn't wrong. After all, the First Prince was the one most qualified for succession; although the Second Prince also held a certain chance of winning, being stuck in the royal city made it difficult to maneuver. It would be better to build up his own strength out in the provinces first, then find someone to coordinate from the inside and outside to stage a counter-kill.

It was just that the Second Prince had left in such a rush, carrying a faint aura of panicked flight from the royal city. Perhaps that was just his imagination, though.

The Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley turned around; it was time for him to proceed with his next plan.

Not far away, Shang Feifan locked his gaze onto the Master of the Heaven-Defying Valley and followed.
---

chunks.chapterTitle: 第190章 莫约镇的反应 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第190章 莫约镇的反应

八卦报社现在彻底是变成小报了，没有固定报社地址的那种。

偏偏这个被说为上不了台面的小报，就连王室都每日购买，其他贵族和官员同样。

八卦报社的销量不但没有影响，反而随着王城来往的人越来越多，他们的发行量也日益增大。

有些商队会大量购买他们的报纸，带到其他地方销售。

而虎国民众和其他国家的人也因此知道了虎国高层发生的诸多秘密。

莫约镇。

镇长狼守刚从农场回来，就询问家里人：“有王城过来的商队吗？他们有没有带新的八卦报过来？”

科林管家立刻拿出几张报纸：“在这里，他们一来，我就找他们把最新的几张都买了下来。”

“快，让我看看。”镇长几乎是用抢的从管家手中抢过报纸。

镇长甚至都没顾得上坐下，就那么站着浏览报纸内容。

管家帮助镇长把外套脱下来，拿出去拍灰、挂起。

轻微的脚步声传来。

科林躬身：“夫人，日安。”

迪莉娅夫人提着一个花篮，问：“有新报纸送来了？”

科林：“是。”

迪莉娅抬眼就看到丈夫正拿着几张报纸阅读。

“上面说了什么？”迪莉娅夫人懒得自己接过报纸看，轻轻扯了扯丈夫，慵懒地坐入长椅。

管家妻子玛琳接过迪莉娅夫人手中的花篮，把花篮里的花草插-入花瓶，给这座宅子增添一点颜色。

镇长顺着迪莉娅夫人的力道，在妻子身边坐下。

“已经是一个月以前的消息。”镇长看了报纸的日期。

“报纸传过来的速度太慢了。”迪莉娅夫人小声抱怨。

镇长也觉得太慢，但这不是没办法嘛。商队从王都过来这边就要近一个月，如果路上有事耽搁，拖的时间会更长。

“报纸上有没有提到那两个家伙？”迪莉娅夫人抬了抬下巴。

镇长安抚地拍拍妻子：“稍等，我还没看完。”

迪莉娅夫人冷哼：“那两个家伙倒好，跑到王城那么长时间也不知道传个消息回来。可怜阿呆天天望眼欲穿，等着他两个爸爸来接他。”

“人家也不是真的没管。前段时间不是还让人送了东西回来吗？”镇长分神给商非凡和郎沐说好话。

迪莉娅夫人似乎更生气：“那两个没数的！竟然把空间手镯那么宝贵的东西就那么托别人带回来，也幸亏那商队的人还算讲诚信，把东西原原本本送到了。如果让商队的人发现他们送的东西竟然是空间道具，你看那商队的人会不会私吞掉！就算商队可靠，他们也不怕商队出事，东西送不回来！”

镇长对这事也很有微词。那两人也太大胆，当他收到他们从王城送来的东西时，还以为就是普通礼物，直到看到郎沐用密语写的信件，才知道送来的都是什么，差点没让他眼珠子瞪掉出来。

尤其他还在郎沐指名送给他的空间手镯里发现了大量粮食和肉类，还有大量皮毛。

迪莉娅夫人抬手示意在一边侍候的玛琳：“去把阿呆和夏冰接过来，跟他们说有新报纸送到了。晚饭多准备点。”

“是。”玛琳笑着退下，让儿子去帮忙送信。

对于小阿呆，镇长一家很照顾。

镇长原本想让阿呆搬过来和他们一起住，但阿呆不愿意。

夏冰也说自己可以照顾好阿呆，不肯搬来寄人篱下。

镇长想着年轻人可能喜欢自由，而且他夫人的嘴巴太坏，就是关心的话说出来都十分刺耳，想了想也就没有坚持。

不过镇长还是经常叫阿呆和夏冰过来家里吃饭，又让自己的儿女带着阿呆玩。

他两个儿女年龄不大，倒是和阿呆玩得还挺好。

主要阿呆不烦人，每天大部分时间都在镇图书馆泡着，听羊大婶给他们上课，没事就自己看书学习，还特别喜欢听老人讲古。

镇里的老兽人都很喜欢安静又充满好奇心的阿呆。

不过阿呆最好的朋友是当初和他一起被绑架走的伊凡，还有镇酒馆老板的儿子小安东。

这三人加上镇长的两个孩子，形成了一个固定小团队。

迪莉娅夫人就说阿呆特别聪明，看看他交的朋友：小安东是镇子里的包打听，和谁人缘都很好。伊凡是治安官安德烈的小儿子。飞影和狼杀则是镇长的两个孩子。

有这四个小朋友在，其他幼崽就算再看阿呆不顺眼，也不敢欺负他啊。

夏冰现在已经是镇上的炼金师学徒，他看着商非凡走时给他留下的炼金师手册自学，又给镇长的铁匠打下手，倒也琢磨出一点东西来。

现在复杂的东西不会做，但简单的物品还是能修修弄弄的。

对于这个未来的炼金师，镇民自然不会排斥，对夏冰接受得很快。

夏冰对阿呆也是真的好，不但把阿呆照顾得干干净净，喂的饱饱的，还能保证小阿呆每天兜里都有零食。

前两者对于镇民来说是平常，但后者就不容易啦。

镇上很多小幼崽都很羡慕阿呆那装满零食的大口袋呢。

更不要说商非凡和郎沐那两个没数的，竟然给那么小的阿呆也准备了一个空间手镯。

不过阿呆是真聪明，他有了空间手镯也不亮出来，更从不在幼崽面前炫耀，他依旧每天带着他装零食的大口袋，假装自己没有空间手镯一样。

原本镇长还担心阿呆有了这么一个宝贝会不会被人盯上打劫，看阿呆这么有数，多少放了点心。

空间手镯，夏冰也有份。夏冰也不怎么当着他人面使用，和阿呆一样都很会藏。

商非凡让人一共带来六个空间手镯，其中有四个指定了人选，另外两个只说让镇长随意。

镇长思考良久，还和妻子商量了好半天，最终决定把多余的两个空间手镯，一个给了治安官安德烈，一个给了镇祭司羊大婶。并说明这不是私用，而是公用，一旦他们转交工作，那么空间手镯也得跟着转交。

就算这样，两人拿到传说中的空间道具，也都快高兴傻了。

安德烈笑得合不拢嘴，听说是商非凡和郎沐让人特意带给他们的，嘴上不说，心中感激非凡。而商非凡他们不在眼前，自然这份感激就多数用在了照顾阿呆和夏冰身上。

羊大婶也是喜气洋洋，有了空间道具，她再也不用担心如果有人攻打镇子或出什么其他灾难，图书馆的书籍不好及时转移和保存。

反应到阿呆身上，就是羊大婶对教导阿呆学识上心得不得了。

迪莉娅夫人斜靠在丈夫身上，摩挲着戴在左手腕上的手镯，两眼放空，也不知在想些什么。

镇长终于把几张报纸全部看完，又问妻子要不要看。

迪莉娅夫人嫌弃报纸不干净，不愿意碰：“你告诉我就好。”

镇长就展开报纸，把一些重要消息念给妻子听：“最新消息，嗯，一个月前的消息了，大王子现在已经正式接手处理国务，虎王不知为何隐于幕后，像是要培养大王子快点接手王位一样。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 190: The Reaction in Moyue Town

The Gossip Tabloid had now completely devolved into a low-brow rag—the kind without a fixed office address.

Yet, despite being dismissed as unpresentable, this very tabloid was purchased daily by the royal family, along with various nobles and officials.

Far from being hurt by the controversy, the Gossip Tabloid’s sales soared. As more and more travelers passed through the royal capital, its circulation grew by the day.

Some merchant caravans would buy the papers in bulk to resell in other regions.

Through this, the common folk of the Tiger Kingdom and people in neighboring nations learned of the many hidden secrets bubbling among the upper echelons of the kingdom.

Moyue Town.

Mayor Wolf Guard had just returned from the farm when he immediately asked his family, "Are there any caravans from the royal capital? Did they bring the latest gossip tabloids?"

Butler Colin hurriedly produced a stack of newspapers. "Right here, sir. As soon as they arrived, I tracked them down and bought all the newest issues."

"Quick, let me see!" The mayor practically snatched the newspapers from the butler's hands.

Without even bothering to take a seat, the mayor stood right there and began browsing through the pages.

The butler stepped forward to help take off the mayor's coat, which he took outside to dust off before hanging it up.

Soft footsteps echoed from the hallway.

Colin bowed. "Good day, Madam."

Madam Delia was carrying a basket of flowers. She asked, "Were the new newspapers delivered?"

"Yes, Madam," Colin replied.

Delia raised her gaze to see her husband standing and reading a bundle of papers.

"What does it say this time?" Too lazy to take the papers and read them herself, Madam Delia gave her husband a gentle tug and languidly settled into a long chair.

Marlene, the butler’s wife, took the flower basket from Madam Delia’s hands and carefully arranged the blossoms and foliage into a vase, adding a touch of vibrant life to the estate.

Yielding to the gentle pull, the mayor sat down beside his wife.

"These are already from a month ago," the mayor noted, checking the date on the newspaper.

"The newspapers take far too long to arrive," Madam Delia muttered in soft complaint.

The mayor agreed that it was terribly slow, but there was simply no helping it. A caravan took nearly a month just to travel from the royal capital to this remote town, and if they were delayed on the road, it took even longer.

"Is there any mention of those two rascals in the paper?" Madam Delia raised her chin.

The mayor patted his wife's hand soothingly. "Hold on, I haven't finished reading yet."

Madam Delia let out a cold snort. "Those two ungrateful wretches! They ran off to the royal capital for all this time without even sending a single message back. Poor Ah Dai is waiting with bated breath every single day, hoping his two daddies will come to pick him up."

"It's not like they completely forgot about him. Didn't they just send a batch of items back not long ago?" The mayor divided his attention to put in a good word for Shang Feifan and Lang Mu.

This seemed to anger Madam Delia even further. "Those two thoughtless idiots! To entrust a treasure as precious as a spatial bracelet to a passing caravan just like that! We are only lucky the caravan people happened to be honest and delivered everything intact. If those merchants had realized they were carrying spatial artifacts, just imagine if they had tried to pocket them! Even if the caravan was reliable, weren't they worried something might go wrong and the items wouldn't reach us?"

The mayor harbored his own grievances about the matter. Those two men had been far too reckless. When he received the package sent from the royal capital, he had assumed it was just ordinary gifts, right up until he read Lang Mu's letter written in cipher and discovered what was actually inside—it had nearly made his eyes pop out of his head.

Especially since he had found a massive store of grain, meat, and furs inside the spatial bracelet that Lang Mu had explicitly designated for him.

Madam Delia raised a hand to signal Marlene, who was waiting nearby. "Go fetch Ah Dai and Xia Bing. Tell them the new newspapers have arrived. And have the kitchen prepare a bit more for dinner."

"Yes, Madam." Marlene smiled and retreated, sending her son to help deliver the message.

The mayor's family looked after little Ah Dai with immense care.

Initially, the mayor had wanted Ah Dai to move in and live with them, but the boy refused.

Xia Bing also insisted that he could take care of Ah Dai himself, unwilling to move in and live under someone else's roof.

Figuring that youngsters preferred their freedom—plus the fact that his wife had a rather sharp tongue, making even her expressions of concern sound biting—the mayor didn't press the matter further.

However, the mayor frequently invited Ah Dai and Xia Bing over for dinner, and even had his own children take Ah Dai out to play.

Though his son and daughter were quite young, they got along wonderfully with Ah Dai.

Partly it was because Ah Dai wasn't annoying; he spent most of his days immersed in the town library, listening to Auntie Sheep's lessons, reading and studying on his own when he had free time, and showing a particular fondness for listening to the old folk tell ancient tales.

The elderly beastmen in town all adored the quiet yet endlessly curious Ah Dai.

Still, Ah Dai's best friends remained Ivan, who had been kidnapped alongside him, and little Anton, the son of the town tavern owner.

These three boys, together with the mayor's two children, formed an inseparable little clique.

Madam Delia often remarked on how exceptionally clever Ah Dai was, judging purely by the company he kept: little Anton was the town's ultimate gossip hub, well-liked by everyone; Ivan was the younger son of Magistrate Andre; and Shadow-Fly and Wolf-Slayer were the mayor's two children.

With these four little ones looking out for him, no matter how unpleasantly some of the other cubs might view Ah Dai, not a single one dared to bully him.

Xia Bing was now officially an alchemy apprentice in the town. He taught himself using the alchemy manual Shang Feifan had left behind when he departed, while also helping out as a blacksmith's assistant in town, slowly picking up the trade.

He couldn't craft anything complicated yet, but he was getting quite handy at repairing simple items.

Naturally, the townspeople harbored no prejudice against this future alchemist; they had accepted Xia Bing into their community with open arms.

Xia Bing was genuinely wonderful to Ah Dai. Not only did he keep the boy impeccably clean and well-fed, but he also made sure little Ah Dai always had a pocketful of snacks every single day.

While the first two were standard parenting expectations for the villagers, the latter was no easy feat.

Plenty of the younger beastmen in town gazed upon Ah Dai's bulging, snack-filled pockets with intense envy.

Let alone the fact that those two reckless fools, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu, had actually prepared a spatial bracelet for someone as young as Ah Dai.

Yet Ah Dai was remarkably clever; upon receiving the spatial bracelet, he neither flashed it around nor showed it off to the other children. He continued to carry his bulky snack-pocket everywhere, acting as if he owned no spatial artifact at all.

At first, the mayor had worried that Ah Dai might attract the wrong kind of attention and get robbed if people knew he held such a treasure. Seeing how sensible the boy was, the mayor felt considerably more at ease.

Xia Bing also had a spatial bracelet of his own. Much like Ah Dai, he rarely used it in front of others and was exceedingly good at keeping it hidden.

Shang Feifan had sent back a total of six spatial bracelets. Four had been designated for specific individuals, while the other two were left entirely at the mayor's discretion.

After deep thought and lengthy discussions with his wife, the mayor ultimately decided to distribute the two extra spatial bracelets: one went to Magistrate Andre, and the other to Auntie Sheep, the town priestess. He explicitly noted that these were not for personal use, but public assets—if either of them ever transferred their duties, the spatial bracelets must be handed over as well.

Even so, the two veterans had nearly gone crazy with joy upon receiving the legendary spatial items.

Andre grinned from ear to ear; hearing that the items were specially sent by Shang Feifan and Lang Mu, though he said little aloud, his heart overflowed with gratitude toward Feifan. Since Shang Feifan and the others weren't around, that gratitude naturally manifested as even greater care and protection for Ah Dai and Xia Bing.

Auntie Sheep was equally radiant. With a spatial artifact in her possession, she no longer had to worry about how difficult it would be to safely transfer and preserve the library's books should anyone attack the town or another disaster strike.

For Ah Dai, this translated into Auntie Sheep pouring an extraordinary amount of care and insight into teaching him knowledge.

Leaning sideways against her husband, Madam Delia stroked the bracelet on her left wrist, her gaze drifting into the distance as if lost in thought.

The mayor finally finished reading through the newspapers and asked his wife if she wanted to take a look.

Finding the newspaper dirty and refusing to touch it, Madam Delia waved a hand in disgust. "Just tell me what it says."

Unfolding the paper, the mayor began reading the important highlights to his wife. "The latest news—well, news from a month ago: the First Prince has now officially taken over the administration of state affairs. For reasons unknown, the Tiger King has retreated behind the scenes, almost as if grooming the First Prince to swiftly inherit the throne."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第190章 莫约镇的反应 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
迪莉娅夫人撇嘴，但她对于大王子接手王位也没多少意见。

至少大王子没有欺负过拉斐尔郎沐，据说还比较照顾。

“二王子带着他的人手去了丹顿领地。报社的人偷偷跟着过去查看，说是亲眼看到这位二王子带着一支军队和大量物资，浩浩荡荡地离开了丹顿领，从距离丹顿领最近的海湾乘船出海了。那架势像是不会再回来。”

迪莉娅夫人不信：“有那么快？丹顿领虽然靠近王城，但想要收拾军队和物资，再到整装和准备大量船只，怎么可能那么快？”

镇长再次看向报纸：“报上说了，那个跟过去的记者偷看到二王子似乎施展了某种神秘术法，报上称之为魔法。二王子施展魔法给整个队伍加快了速度，还施展魔法收服了丹顿领的军队领导者，之后又施展魔法让小型船只也能在海上乘风破浪。”

“不过二王子去的地方距离陆地并不远，也就是一日海程，那边有几座连起来的大岛屿，原本就和丹顿家族有点关系。现在应该是被二王子彻底占下来了。”

迪莉娅夫人听到这里，忍不住问：“王后那个毒妇呢？她还活着？”

镇长抖了抖报纸：“我正要跟你说，这还是一期的头版头条。王后薨了。报上说是王后受不了诅咒的折磨，自杀了。但记者也透露出，说王后原本对二王子充满期待，希望二王子带领丹顿家族的军队打回王城，夺取王位。

谁想二王子竟无意王位，只想带着丹顿家族的军队远离虎国占个小地盘当个不管事的快乐小领主。

如果二王子能力一般，王后可能都没有那么不甘愿。但二王子亮相丹顿领时，为了收服丹顿家族剩下的人和那支军队，展示了非凡的力量。

据说王后当时看到二王子展现出来的力量，高兴得大笑。但之后就知道了二王子的真实想法，然后第二天人就没了。大概是失去了希望，也可能是想用自己的死亡来惩罚二王子。”

迪莉娅夫人嘴角勾起浓浓的嘲讽：“惩罚？我要是二王子，只会高兴得饮酒庆祝。那毒妇终于死了！”

镇长握住妻子的手。

迪莉娅夫人：“我没事。当我知道她被诅咒的那一天，知道她不得不逃出王城的那一天，我就知道她完了。”

迪莉娅夫人露出笑容，没一会儿像是想到什么，又收起笑容。

镇长拍拍妻子：“别想了，都过去了。上一辈的恩怨到此也算彻底了结。”

迪莉娅夫人没吭声，过了一会儿才说：“你说拉斐尔还会回来吗？”

镇长失笑，毫不怀疑地说：“当然会回来。我们这里就是他的另一个家！”

镇长又故意对妻子说：“难不成你知道拉斐尔不是你亲外甥，就不认他了？”

“怎么会？”迪莉娅夫人轻哼：“我又不是看他是安妮塔的孩子的份上才接受他。”

相反，就因为拉斐尔背着安妮塔和虎王私生子的名头，才让迪莉娅夫人百般看他不顺眼。直到慢慢了解拉斐尔的为人，逐渐认可了拉斐尔本人，她才真正接受这个外甥。

“现在不是我认不认的问题，恐怕人家已经看不上我们。”

“不会的。如果拉斐尔想要疏远我们，他就不会寄送这么珍贵的宝贝回来，也不可能依旧把阿呆和夏冰放在镇子上。他们完全可以让人来接走阿呆和夏冰，更没必要给我们送空间手镯和大量物资。”

迪莉娅夫人也知道这个理，她就是还有点别扭。

“报上还说什么了？有没有提到虎王？那渣子怎么会突然隐于幕后？”

镇长再次拿起报纸翻看：“我没有看到相关消息，要么就是特意隐瞒了，要么就是八卦报还没打探到。”

迪莉娅夫人冷声：“王后死了，安妮塔也死了，虎王还留着干嘛，不如一起下去陪那两个女人。”

镇长理智地说：“虎王现在还不能死，他好歹也是虎国最强的武力威慑。何况他还想举办传承分享大会，如果他这时候出事，不说传承分享大会能不能举办，只怕虎国就要不稳。”

迪莉娅夫人可没有什么爱国爱民之心，直接说：“虎国散了最好。那些权贵就没几个好的！”

“真散了，最痛苦最遭殃的还是普通虎国人。到时候战火四起，我们镇子也逃不了。”

“那就好好准备。”迪莉娅夫人坐直身体：“虎王不是赔偿了拉斐尔封地吗，我们莫约镇不就在他的封地里？他为什么还不带着郎家老两口离开王城回来？难道是怕我们不认可他这个新领主？”

镇长也不确定：“他们可能是还有点事要办吧。报上说那个能炼制空间道具的炼金大师阿瑞斯商为了我们拉斐尔，暴揍那个特别俊美的天残谷主。因为那个天残谷主竟然故意勾引拉斐尔……”

迪莉娅夫人嘴角抽搐，这八卦报真的是什么都报道，连这种风月事都报道得特别欢庆，也怪不得发行量那么大还被视为难登大雅之堂的小报。

“你说那个阿瑞斯商会不会就是商皇？”迪莉娅夫人忽然问。

镇长：“之前我还不敢确定。但……”

迪莉娅夫人点头。能那么大手笔地一口气送回六个空间道具，还不怕丢失的，也只有炼制者本人了。

否则就空间道具的超高昂价格，拉斐尔就是继承了郎家全部家产，也不可能买下这么多，而且他们的空间手镯的容量都不小，她和镇长的手镯空间都有三百立方左右，就是额外的两个也有一百五十立方的容量。

这样庞大的容量，迪莉娅都不敢想如果拿到拍卖会上拍卖能拍出多夸张的价格来。

“结果如何？”迪莉娅夫人追问：“那个什么天残谷主被阿瑞斯商打死了吗？”

镇长找到那条报道：“嗯，这个天残谷主也不是弱者，还非常强。很多人原本以为那个天残谷主就是个花瓶，等到阿瑞斯商对天残谷主出手，大家才发现那也是个战斗力不亚于虎王的存在。啧，看这报上说的……”

“两人在郊外一座山里打得天昏地暗，把那座山头都给炸塌了大半，导致地下水涌出，直接在原地形成了一个天然湖泊。

最诡异的是，天残谷主施展的能力貌似不是神血天赋，更像是传说中的魔血巫术，报上说这就是魔法。还说天残谷主施展的魔法和二王子施展的魔法同出一脉，两人都是什么魔法师。

但那个阿瑞斯商的战斗力也超强，他的血脉天赋应该是力气大，报上还说他的箭法特别精准，使用的弓和箭都是非常厉害的炼金武器，身法快速迅捷，怀疑他应该是学习了猎人的职业技能。

有意思的是，报上说天残谷主施展的魔法往往还没有发出去就莫名其妙消失了，要么就是准头不行，威力还忽高忽低。

一开始阿瑞斯商用远程武器对付天残谷主，之后就摸到天残谷主身边，逼他近身打斗。

阿瑞斯商放弃弓箭，改用一把金属锤，速度超快力气又大，把天残谷主锤得满地乱窜。
chunks.englishText:
Madam Delia curled her lip, though she held no strong objections to the First Prince ascending the throne.

At the very least, the First Prince had never bullied Raphael or Lang Mu, and rumor had it he had actually treated them with some care.

"The Second Prince took his forces and headed to the Denton Fief. Tabloid reporters sneaked along to investigate, claiming they saw with their own eyes this Second Prince leaving the Denton Fief in a grand procession with an army and massive supplies. They boarded ships and set sail from the bay closest to the Denton Fief, acting as though they would never return."

Madam Delia scoffed in disbelief. "Could it really be that fast? Even though the Denton Fief is close to the royal capital, gathering an army and supplies, reorganizing them, and preparing a vast fleet of ships—how could all that happen so quickly?"

The mayor checked the paper once more. "The report says that the reporter who tailed them witnessed the Second Prince casting some kind of mysterious art, which the paper calls 'magic.' The Second Prince used magic to accelerate the entire army's march, used magic to subdue the military leaders of the Denton Fief, and then used magic to allow even small boats to brave the wind and waves at sea."

"However, the place the Second Prince went isn't terribly far from the mainland—about a day's journey by sea. There's a cluster of large islands there that historically had ties with the Denton family. He's likely completely taken them over by now."

Hearing this, Madam Delia couldn't help but ask, "What about that venomous bitch of a Queen? Is she still alive?"

The mayor flicked the newspaper. "I was just about to get to that—it's the front-page headline of this issue. The Queen has passed away. The paper says she couldn't bear the torment of the curse and committed suicide. But reporters also revealed that the Queen had originally pinned high hopes on the Second Prince, expecting him to lead the Denton family's army back to the royal capital to seize the throne.

Who could have guessed that the Second Prince had zero interest in the throne? All he wanted was to take the Denton family's army far away from the Tiger Kingdom, claim a small territory, and live out his days as a carefree, hands-off little lord.

If the Second Prince had been mediocre, the Queen might not have felt so resentful. But when the Second Prince made his appearance in the Denton Fief, he displayed extraordinary power in order to subjugate the remaining members of the Denton family and that army.

Rumor has it that when the Queen saw the power the Second Prince displayed, she laughed for joy. But upon learning his true intentions the very next day, she simply ceased to exist. Perhaps she lost all hope, or perhaps she wanted to use her own death as a final punishment for the Second Prince."

The corners of Madam Delia's mouth curled into a deep, mocking sneer. "Punishment? If I were the Second Prince, I'd pop open the wine and celebrate. That poisonous hag is finally dead!"

The mayor reached out and squeezed his wife's hand.

"I'm fine," Madam Delia murmured. "From the day I learned she was cursed, the day she was forced to flee the royal capital, I knew she was finished."

A smile touched Madam Delia's face, though a moment later, as if recalling something, she let it fade.

The mayor patted her shoulder. "Don't dwell on it; it's all in the past. The grudges of the older generation are completely settled now."

Madam Delia remained silent. After a short pause, she asked, "Do you think Raphael will ever come back?"

The mayor chuckled, showing not a sliver of doubt as he replied, "Of course he will. This place is his other home!"

He playfully teased his wife, "Don't tell me that now you know Raphael isn't your biological nephew, you're going to cast him aside?"

"As if!" Madam Delia gave a soft huff. "I never accepted him just because he was Anita's child."

On the contrary, precisely because Raphael carried the stigma of being the illegitimate son of Anita and the Tiger King, Madam Delia had initially found everything about him grating. It was only after slowly coming to understand Raphael's character and gradually recognizing his true self that she truly accepted him as her nephew.

"The issue isn't whether I accept him or not; I worry that *they* might look down on us now."

"Not at all. If Raphael wanted to distance himself from us, he wouldn't have sent back such precious treasures, nor would he have left Ah Dai and Xia Bing here in the town. They could easily have had someone come and fetch Ah Dai and Xia Bing, and they certainly wouldn't have bothered sending us spatial bracelets and massive amounts of supplies."

Madam Delia knew the logic was sound; she was simply feeling a bit awkward.

"What else does the paper say? Is there any mention of the Tiger King? Why would that scum suddenly retreat behind the scenes?"

The mayor picked up the paper again to flip through the pages. "I haven't seen any relevant news. Either it's being deliberately concealed, or the Gossip Tabloid hasn't managed to sniff it out yet."

Madam Delia's voice turned icy. "The Queen is dead, Anita is dead—what is the Tiger King still hanging around for? He might as well go down and keep those two women company."

With pragmatic reason, the mayor said, "The Tiger King cannot afford to die just yet. He is still the Tiger Kingdom's strongest military deterrent. Besides, he's planning to host the Heritage Sharing Convention; if anything happens to him right now, never mind whether the convention can even take place, the entire Tiger Kingdom would likely plunge into chaos."

Madam Delia possessed zero sense of patriotism or civic duty, retorting bluntly, "It would be for the best if the Tiger Kingdom fell apart. Not a single one of those nobles is any good!"

"If it truly shatters, the ones who will suffer the most are ordinary Tiger Kingdom citizens. When the flames of war erupt everywhere, our town won't be able to escape either."

"Then we'll just prepare properly." Madam Delia straightened up. "Didn't the Tiger King compensate Raphael with a fief? Isn't our Moyue Town located right inside his territory? Why hasn't he brought the elderly Lang couple out of the royal capital and come back yet? Could it be he's afraid we won't acknowledge him as our new lord?"

The mayor wasn't entirely sure. "They probably still have some matters to attend to. The paper mentioned that Ares Shang, the grand alchemist capable of refining spatial artifacts, gave a vicious beating to the exceptionally handsome Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley—all on Raphael's behalf. Because that Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley actually had the audacity to intentionally seduce Raphael..."

Madam Delia's mouth twitched. This Gossip Tabloid really printed absolutely anything, even reporting on such romantic entanglements with absolute glee. No wonder its circulation was so massive, even if it was dismissed as a vulgar little rag.

"Do you think that Ares Shang could be Emperor Shang?" Madam Delia suddenly asked.

The mayor replied, "I wasn't entirely certain before, but..."

Madam Delia nodded. To display such staggering wealth by handing over six spatial items in one breath without fearing their loss—only the creator himself could pull that off.

Otherwise, given the astronomical price of spatial artifacts, even if Raphael had inherited the entire Lang family fortune, he wouldn't have been able to afford this many. Furthermore, the capacity of their spatial bracelets wasn't small at all; both her and the mayor's bracelets held around three hundred cubic meters, while the two extra ones possessed a capacity of one hundred and fifty cubic meters each.

With such immense storage space, Delia didn't even dare to imagine what kind of absurd prices they would fetch if put up at an auction house.

"How did it end?" Madam Delia pressed urgently. "Was that so-called Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley beaten to death by Ares Shang?"

The mayor found the relevant article. "Well, this Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley was no weakling; he was actually formidable. Many people originally thought he was just a pretty vase, but once Ares Shang made his move against him, everyone realized his combat power was on par with the Tiger King himself. Tsk, look at what the paper says..."

"The two of them fought a heaven-shattering, earth-flipping battle in a mountain on the outskirts, blasting apart more than half the peak and causing the groundwater to gush out, forming a natural lake right on the spot."

"The eeriest part is that the abilities displayed by the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley didn't seem like divine blood talents; they looked far more like the legendary demonic blood witchcraft, which the paper refers to as 'magic.' The paper also stated that the magic cast by the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley came from the exact same lineage as the Second Prince's magic—both of them are what they call 'mages.'"

"However, Ares Shang's combat power was monstrously high. His bloodline talent appears to be super strength; the paper also noted his marksmanship is terrifyingly accurate, using a bow and arrows made of immensely powerful alchemic weapons, combined with lightning-fast footwork. They suspect he must have studied hunter class skills."

"Interestingly, the paper noted that whenever the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley tried to cast a spell, it would inexplicably vanish before it could even be launched, or else his accuracy would falter, with his power fluctuating wildly."

"At first, Ares Shang dealt with the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley using ranged weapons, but then he closed the distance, forcing the Master into close-quarters combat."

"Ares Shang discarded his bow and arrows in favor of a metal hammer. His speed was terrifying and his strength monstrous, smashing the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley so hard he was sent scrambling all over the ground."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第190章 莫约镇的反应 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
天残谷主最后被逼得不得不叫来帮手，有很多天残突然冒出来一起围攻阿瑞斯商。

然后……”

镇长皱眉。

迪莉娅夫人急：“然后怎么了？”

镇长神色怪异：“恐惧之神的奴仆出现了。”

“什么？！”迪莉娅夫人色变，下意识问：“不是邪神阴影者？他们会不会把两者弄错了？”

镇长摇头：“不是邪神阴影者，报上写的很明白，就在越来越多的天残出现围攻阿瑞斯商、天残谷主对阿瑞斯商施展一种禁术魔法时，恐惧之神的奴仆突然出现，把现场所有活人全都带走了。”

“阿瑞斯商呢？他有没有出事？”迪莉娅夫人焦急。

不管她怎么看商皇，商皇都是自己人，胳膊肘当然要往里拐。而且商皇和拉斐尔的关系明摆在那里，一旦商皇出事，迪莉娅夫人无法想内敛的拉斐尔会变得怎样。

镇长倒是神色轻松：“没事。这条报道是最新版八卦报的头条，用了一整页报道。报道最后说第二天阿瑞斯商就又大摇大摆地出现，而且一出来就提着王城最有名店铺的烤肉去郎家找拉斐尔去了。”

“那天残谷主和那些天残呢？”

“报上没说，应该是没出现。”

迪莉娅夫人庆幸之余，想得也比较深：“你说阿瑞斯商是躲过了恐惧之神的奴仆，还是被恐惧之神的奴仆抓走后又逃了回来？”

镇长迟疑：“应该是躲过了吧。从没有听说有人被恐惧之神的奴仆抓走还能逃出来的。”

迪莉娅夫人忽然生气：“为什么八卦报不能在我们这边也弄一个办事处？每次都要等一个月左右才能看到新报纸。这都一个月过去了，也不知道那两个到底怎样。还有恐惧之神的奴仆怎么会突然跑到王城附近？它不是一向在天残谷附近的荒原上游荡？”

这个问题不止迪莉娅夫人和镇长想要知道，王城的人更想要知道。

自从八卦报报道出恐惧之神的奴仆出现在王城附近，还带走了大量活人，王城的兽人们就有点惶惶不可终日。

很多人都听过恐惧之神奴仆的传说，尤其是商队的人。

有很多人都想从阿瑞斯商口中探知他到底是怎么从恐惧之神奴仆的手中逃脱的，可惜阿瑞斯商跑了，连带拉斐尔郎沐和郎家人一起。

就在半个月前，这一家子就离开了王城，还都是轻装上阵，就一人骑着一只巨虫，就离开了。

大王子还特意过来给他们送行。

八卦报的人还拍了现场的送别照片，登在了次日的头版头条上。

逮不到阿瑞斯商，就有很多人去骚扰八卦报，想要知道他们是怎么知道恐惧之神奴仆出现，又是怎么在拍了现场照片后，还能逃脱。

八卦报被骚扰得受不了，就放出风声说这些情报都是由神秘人秘密提供，包括现场照片也是。至于他们派去现场的记者，现在也是失踪状态，都被恐惧之神奴仆抓走啦。

比起王城兽人们的摸不着头脑和担忧，玩家们简直超级兴奋。

死掉的玩家纷纷在论坛现身。

“天哪地哪！我看到了新的副本！超级诡异，超级可怕！”

“这个游戏有副本了？那不是说可以开荒拿装备和职业技能书了？”

“别做梦了，还开荒呢。那个副本超恐惧，进去就死，连动都动不了。”

“奇怪，那个副本地图竟然没有在游戏系统里出现，只用红点表示那是未知之地。”

“同样死脱离回来。让我喝口水缓缓，再跟你们说我的见闻。”

“所有人都被串在了一根绳索上，就跟拴畜生一样，所有人的脖颈和手都被拴在同一根绳子上。所有人都木楞地往前走，旁边有长相特别丑的怪物监督，还会用鞭子抽人！”

“我看到了一座古城，但刚进去，我还没看清里面有什么，就死了。死得特别莫名其妙。”

“你们进入古城的时候是不是听到了特别噪杂的声音，那声音特别刺耳，我大概是七窍流血而死。”

“对对对！我也听到了，我甚至忘了我听到了。现在回忆起来，好可怕！”

“大消息！我们那位超级俊美超级有范的谷主也被抓去了副本，就问他能活着出来吗？”

“谁看到我们谷主大大了？”

“他跟我们串在一条命运的绳索上吗？”

“快问问玩家营地的人，问他们有没有看到谷主。”

“喜讯！谷主回来了！谷主就在营地，不过他家常开的大门关上了，侍者说他身体不舒服，需要休息一段时间。然后发布了让玩家探索强盗谷荒原寻找恐惧之神奴仆的大型任务。”
chunks.englishText:
"In the end, the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley was pushed into a corner and forced to call for backup. A swarm of crippled individuals suddenly emerged and surrounded Ares Shang in a joint assault."

"And then..."

The mayor furrowed his brows.

Madam Delia grew anxious. "And then what?!"

The mayor wore a strange expression. "A servant of the God of Fear appeared."

"What?!" Madam Delia's expression shifted drastically as she asked instinctively, "Not the Evil God's Shadow-Walkers? Could the paper have gotten the two confused?"

The mayor shook his head. "Not the Evil God's Shadow-Walkers. The report states it very clearly: just as more and more crippled individuals appeared to swarm Ares Shang, and the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley unleashed a forbidden magic spell against him, a servant of the God of Fear suddenly manifested and dragged away every single living person at the scene."

"What about Ares Shang?! Is he alright?" Madam Delia asked anxiously.

Regardless of how she viewed Emperor Shang, he was one of their own—naturally, her loyalties lay with her family. Furthermore, Emperor Shang's relationship with Raphael was blatantly obvious; if anything happened to Emperor Shang, Madam Delia couldn't even begin to imagine what state the reserved Raphael would fall into.

The mayor, however, remained relaxed. "He's fine. This article was the front-page headline of the latest gossip tabloid, taking up a full page. The report concluded by stating that the very next day, Ares Shang swaggered back into public view. As soon as he appeared, he carried roasted meat from the most famous shop in the royal capital straight to the Lang residence to find Raphael."

"What about the Master of Heaven-Crippled Valley and those crippled freaks?"

"The paper didn't say. They probably didn't show up again."

While feeling a wave of relief, Madam Delia's thoughts ran a bit deeper. "Do you think Ares Shang managed to evade the servant of the God of Fear, or was he dragged away by it and managed to escape?"

The mayor hesitated. "He must have evaded it, I suppose. I've never heard of anyone being dragged away by a servant of the God of Fear and actually escaping alive."

Suddenly, irritation flared in Madam Delia. "Why can't the Gossip Tabloid set up an office over here too? Every single time, we have to wait a whole month just to see a new issue. A whole month has already passed—who knows how those two are doing right now? And why did a servant of the God of Fear suddenly run all the way to the outskirts of the royal capital? Doesn't it usually wander the wastes near Heaven-Crippled Valley?"

This was a question not only Madam Delia and the mayor wanted answered; the people of the royal capital desired it even more.

Ever since the Gossip Tabloid reported that a servant of the God of Fear had appeared near the royal capital and abducted a massive group of living people, the beastmen of the capital had been living in a state of nervous panic.

Many had heard the legends surrounding the servants of the God of Fear, caravan members most of all.

Countless people desperately wanted to pry the secret from Ares Shang's lips—to find out just how he had managed to slip away from the clutches of the God of Fear's servant. Unfortunately, Ares Shang had already vanished, taking Raphael, Lang Mu, and the rest of the Lang family with him.

Just half a month prior, this entire family had packed up and left the royal capital traveling light, each riding atop a giant insect as they departed.

The First Prince had even made a special trip to send them off.

The Gossip Tabloid's staff had even snapped photographs of the farewell scene and printed them on the front page of the next day's edition.

Unable to catch Ares Shang, crowds of people swarmed the Gossip Tabloid's offices, demanding to know how they had learned of the servant's arrival in advance, and how they managed to escape and take photos of the scene.

Pushed to their absolute limit by the harassment, the tabloid finally leaked word that all these intelligence reports—including the onsite photographs—had been secretly provided by a mysterious informant. As for the reporters they had dispatched to the scene, they remained missing, presumably dragged off by the servant of the God of Fear.

In stark contrast to the bewildered and anxious beastmen of the royal capital, the players were utterly ecstatic.

The players who had died promptly resurfaced on the forums.

"Oh lord in heaven! I saw a brand-new dungeon! Super eerie, super terrifying!"

"This game has dungeons now? Doesn't that mean we can go raiding for gear and class skill books?"

"Keep dreaming about raiding. That dungeon is pure terror; you die the second you step inside, before you can even move."

"Strange, that dungeon map didn't even appear in the game system interface—it's just marked with a red dot as an Unknown Land."

"I died and respawned back too. Let me grab a drink to steady my nerves before I tell you guys what I witnessed."

"Everyone was strung together on a single rope like a bunch of livestock—all our necks and hands were tethered to the exact same cord. We were forced to march forward in a daze while hideous monsters stood guard on the flanks, whipping anyone who lagged behind!"

"I caught a glimpse of an ancient city, but before I could even step inside or see what was in there, I died. Died for reasons I couldn't even figure out."

"Did you guys hear an intensely chaotic noise when you entered the city? It was ear-piercingly shrill—I think my seven orifices started bleeding before I died."

"Yes, yes, yes! I heard it too! I had even blocked it out of my memory until just now. Thinking about it now is terrifying!"

"Major news! That super gorgeous, super stylish Valley Master of ours got dragged into the dungeon too. Wonder if he'll make it out alive?"

"Has anyone seen Lord Valley Master?"

"Is he tied to the same rope of fate as us?"

"Quick, ask the people at the player camp if they've spotted the Valley Master."

"Great news! The Valley Master is back! He's right there in the camp, but the front gates he usually leaves open are bolted shut. His attendant says he's feeling unwell and needs to rest for a while. Then he went and released a massive quest for players to explore the Bandit Valley Wastes and hunt for the servant of the God of Fear!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第191章 郎沐的幸运值之谜 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第191章 郎沐的幸运值之谜

所有人都以为拉斐尔郎沐和阿瑞斯商与郎家人一起前往了黑水荒原领。

却不知这两人在离开王城没多久就转道去了黑森林城，进入了那座地下图书馆。

商非凡打算在这座图书馆内补充知识，提升自己的鉴定术，另外就是沉淀一下。

这段时间，数个任务接连完成，他的玩家等级再次提升，各项天赋和职业技能也跟着提升，他需要安下心来消化这些技能。

郎沐则是需要契约那枚魔法奥秘石，接受和消化其中的魔法传承。

两人都需要一个安静的不被打扰的地方好好进修，黑森林城的地下图书馆自然而然就成了他们的最好选择。

而且商非凡和郎沐都没有打算马上就离开王城，他们还有一些扫尾工作没有做完。

两人假装离开王城，可以让诸如邪神信徒之类的阴谋者放心冒头搞事，他们正好也可以借此看看还有多少人和邪神信徒有勾连。

商非凡还有一个任务和传承分享大会有关，想着与其再回来，还不如就待在附近，反正时间也不远了。

在炸掉墨文伯爵府内的邪神祭坛后，任务七十六宣布完成，获得20点贡献点和一枚空间石的奖励。

这也说明墨文伯爵府就是邪神信徒位于王城的最大巢穴，这个地方被捣毁，连同墨文伯爵一家完蛋，不说给了邪神信徒严重打击，至少也让他们伤筋动骨。

邪神信徒简直恨死了……他们不知道恨谁，捣毁墨文伯爵府的人根本没有露面，八卦报也没有对此进行报道。

邪神信徒特别生气，你八卦报连王室那么隐秘的秘密都能挖掘出来，怎么会不知道捣毁墨文伯爵府的人是谁？

邪神信徒因此还跑去找八卦报麻烦，不过别人不知道他们是邪神信徒罢了。

八卦报的玩家们被人找上门，有些人还莫名失踪。

失踪的玩家下游戏就在论坛上摇人，高喊自己被绑架了，让兄弟姐妹们救他，还说有人拷问他们，非要逼问出捣毁墨文伯爵府的人是谁。

更有玩家表示有人在暗搓搓地勾搭他们，对他们宣传真神教教义，希望他们能加入真神教。

玩家们兴致勃勃，捞人的捞人，宰人的宰人，捣乱的捣乱，还有想要加入真神教内部，想要过把教皇瘾的野心玩家。

玩家们这时对邪神信徒还不了解，并不知道真神教就是邪神信徒搞出来的教派，等他们加入其中，顿时觉得这个教派好邪祟好好玩啊，顿时召朋唤友，喊大家一起来真神教发展。

这群玩家的口号就是：我们是反派，杀一人是凶手，杀千人是枭雄，我们要杀妻杀子杀光所有亲人证道，更要以杀戮成神！在我们脚下恐怖吧颤抖吧，赶紧奉我们为神！

还有打入真神教的玩家觉得真神教的教义太low，他们想要打入高层，夺取最高的教宗之位，改善教义，改变发展方针，还想给厄穆克拉索塑造一个新形象。

这些想法不同的玩家在进入真神教后，迅速分裂了真神教……

后话暂且不说。

商非凡本来就不爽天残谷主，要对他动手，正好系统也发布了与其相关的新任务。
