【任务八十，天残谷主对郎沐有不轨之心，想要勾搭诱骗其，夺取郎沐身上的自然之神力量。请破坏天残谷主的谋算，保护郎沐身上的心之果。成功奖励100点贡献点，血脉天赋力大无穷无条件提升一级。】

商非凡看清任务内容，差点气炸。

天残谷主并不知道心之果，他只以为石耳在郎沐身上。

他知道石耳九成就是自然之神的力量之一，就想把石耳从郎沐身上夺取过来。

直接夺取不太可取，天残谷主对自己的容貌和气质非常有自信，他觉得自己单论外貌，完全不弱于阿瑞斯商。论个人能力的话，更不会比只会炼制空间道具的阿瑞斯商差。

只是他需要一个向拉斐尔郎沐展示的机会。

可惜天残谷主刚要靠近郎沐，还没有来得及发挥自己的魅力，就被阿瑞斯商拦截，先是遭到一通冷嘲热讽，接着阿瑞斯商就对他出手了。

天残谷主不想在王城内暴露太多，就选择了战略性退让。

阿瑞斯商也不想对郎府和无辜者造成损伤，就没有追击，只是放话说绝不会放过他。

天残谷主没当真。

谁想那阿瑞斯商隔日就追到了他在王城郊外的别庄。

阿瑞斯商表现异常疯狂，完全不讲理，一心想要打死他。

天残谷主与他越打越心惊，他没想到这个年轻的炼金大师的战斗力竟然如此强，远攻近攻都强得不像是普通血脉天赋者。

最可恨的是，在打斗途中，那阿瑞斯商竟然炸毁了他的传送阵！

传送阵可不是说布置就能布置出来的。

尤其这个兽人大陆的传送阵的设置方法和原理都与法德尔大陆的有所区别。

法德尔大陆的传送阵借用的能量是魔力，使用的能源是魔晶。

可兽人大陆的传送阵借用的是自然能量，在他研究后确定为地力。

实际上，他觉得兽人大陆的传送阵使用的应该是另外一种能量，只不过那种能量不再运转，才改为借用地力来启动。

那种能量属于兽人大陆的科技知识结晶，他根本搞不懂。

他能给传送阵重新定位，就已经是他魔法阵知识学得不错。

可在成品上只是改换一个传送位置，和要从头制作一个成品出来，那需要的知识点根本不是一个当量级别。

换言之，天残谷主根本无法在短期内再弄一个传送阵出来。

这让他如何不愤怒？

他在王城的布局很需要人手，他只有一个人，就算他再厉害，他现在也不是神，无法和整个真神教对抗。就是和虎国这个势力，他也不敢说能以一人之力镇压。

偏偏就在他最需要人手的时候，阿瑞斯商把他的传送阵给炸了，那么多玩家再也不能快速从天残谷赶来。

更让天残谷主心惊和不可置信的是，阿瑞斯商竟然召唤来了恐惧之神的奴仆。

是的，别人都以为恐惧之神的奴仆是随机出现。

但天残谷主十分笃定恐惧之神的奴仆九成九就是阿瑞斯商召唤来的。

原本他和玩家一起已经要把阿瑞斯商解决掉。

毕竟阿瑞斯商再怎么厉害，他也就一个人。

可就在阿瑞斯商身负重伤，眼看就要支撑不住时，恐惧之神奴仆就出现了。

天残谷主猝不及防下，狠狠吃了一个大亏。

不但他召唤到王城的玩家七八成都死在恐惧之神奴仆的手中，他自己这具真身也差点栽了。

玩家还能用死亡来脱离那个诡异空间，但他用的可是真身！

为了脱离那个诡异空间，他不得不召唤了一具分-身，使用禁术替命魔法，这才让自己脱离出来。

而每失去一具分-身，对他的本体来说都是一种莫大伤害。

天残谷主不得不暂时闭门养伤。

还有一下子损失那么多玩家身体，也让他肉疼不已。

这些可都是珍贵资源！
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 191: The Mystery of Lang Mu's Luck Value (Part 1)

Everyone thought that Raphael Lang Mu and Ares Shang had traveled together with the Lang family to the Blackwater Wasteland fief.

Little did they know that shortly after leaving the Royal City, the two of them had diverted their path toward the Black Forest City, entering its underground library.

Shang Feifan intended to supplement his knowledge within this library, elevate his Appraisal skill, and take some time to consolidate his foundations.

Over this recent period, several quests had been completed in succession, raising his player level once more along with his various innate talents and professional skills. He needed to settle his mind and digest these abilities.

As for Lang Mu, he needed to bind the Magic Mystery Stone and receive and digest the magical inheritance contained within it.

Both of them required a quiet, undisturbed place for serious self-improvement, making the underground library of Black Forest City a natural and optimal choice.

Furthermore, neither Shang Feifan nor Lang Mu intended to leave the Royal City permanently just yet; they still had some loose ends to tie up.

Their feigned departure from the Royal City would allow conspirators, such as the Evil God's followers, to feel secure enough to rear their heads and stir up trouble. They could conveniently use this ruse to see how many people remained linked to the Evil God's cult.

Shang Feifan also had a quest related to the Inheritance Sharing Convention. Figuring that he would only have to return later anyway, he might as well stay nearby—besides, the date wasn't far off.

Upon blowing up the Evil God's altar within the Count of Bowen’s estate, Quest Seventy was declared complete, rewarding him with 20 contribution points and a spatial stone.

This also demonstrated that the Count of Bowen’s estate was the Evil God followers' largest stronghold in the Royal City. With this place eradicated and the entire Bowen family ruined, even if it couldn't be said to have dealt a fatal blow to the Evil God's cult, it had at least broken their bones and severely damaged their vitality.

The Evil God's followers hated them to the core... yet they didn't even know whom to hate. The person who destroyed the Count of Bowen’s estate hadn't shown their face at all, and the Gossip Gazette hadn't reported on it either.

The Evil God's followers were furious. *You guys at the Gossip Gazette manage to dig up even the most deeply guarded secrets of the Royal Family; how could you possibly not know who destroyed the Count of Bowen’s estate?!*

Because of this, the Evil God's followers actually went to cause trouble for the Gossip Gazette—unaware, of course, that those targets were merely players.

When the players from the Gossip Gazette were confronted, some even went missing inexplicably.

The missing players, upon logging off, immediately rallied people on the forum, shouting that they had been kidnapped and begging their brothers and sisters to rescue them. They also claimed that someone had interrogated them, desperately trying to force out the identity of the person who destroyed the Count of Bowen’s estate.

Even more players reported that shadowy figures were trying to hook up with them, preaching the doctrines of the True God Church in the hopes of recruiting them.

The players were thrilled: some went to fish their peers out, some went to slaughter the cultists, some went to stir up chaos, while ambitious players even wanted to infiltrate the inner ranks of the True God Church so they could experience the thrill of being a Pope.

At this point, the players still knew nothing about the Evil God's followers and had no idea that the True God Church was a front set up by them. The moment they joined, however, they felt that this cult was wicked yet extremely entertaining. They immediately called upon their friends to come develop the True God Church together.

The slogan of this group of players was: *“We are villains! Killing one man makes you a murderer; killing a thousand makes you an overlord! We shall kill our wives, kill our children, and slaughter all our kin to attain the Dao, and ascend to godhood through massacre! Tremble and cower beneath our feet, and quickly revere us as gods!”*

There were also players who had infiltrated the True God Church only to find its doctrines too low-brow. They plotted to climb into the higher echelons, seize the supreme position of High Pontiff, reform the doctrines, change the development policy, and even sculpt a brand-new public image for Emuklaso.

These players with wildly differing agendas quickly fractured the True God Church from the inside out the moment they entered...

But we shall leave their future antics aside for now.

Shang Feifan had always despised the Valley Master of Tiancan, and as he prepared to make a move against him, the system conveniently issued a new related quest.

[Quest Eighty: The Valley Master of Tiancan harbors improper intentions toward Lang Mu, wishing to woo and seduce him in order to seize the power of the God of Nature residing within Lang Mu. Please disrupt the Valley Master of Tiancan's scheming and protect the Heart Fruit within Lang Mu. Success reward: 100 contribution points, unconditional advancement of the bloodline talent 'Boundless Strength' by one rank.]

When Shang Feifan read the quest details, he was so angry he almost exploded.

The Valley Master of Tiancan had no idea about the Heart Fruit; he only thought the Stone Ear was on Lang Mu.

Knowing with ninety percent certainty that the Stone Ear was one of the manifestations of the God of Nature's power, he sought to wrest it away from Lang Mu.

Direct plunder wasn't ideal, and the Valley Master of Tiancan was supremely confident in his appearance and demeanor. He felt that in terms of raw looks alone, he was completely not inferior to Ares Shang. As for personal ability, he certainly wouldn't be any worse than Ares Shang, who could only refine spatial apparatuses.

He simply needed an opportunity to display his charms to Raphael Lang Mu.

Unfortunately, just as the Valley Master of Tiancan tried to approach Lang Mu without even getting a chance to flex his charm, he was intercepted by Ares Shang, who first subjected him to a torrent of cold mockery and sarcasm before immediately launching an attack.

The Valley Master of Tiancan did not wish to expose too much of himself within the Royal City, so he chose a strategic retreat.

Ares Shang had no desire to cause damage to the Lang Estate and innocent bystanders either, so he didn't pursue, merely dropping a declaration that he would never let him off.

The Valley Master of Tiancan hadn't taken it seriously.

Who could have expected that the very next day, Ares Shang would track him all the way to his suburban villa outside the Royal City?

Ares Shang's performance was exceptionally frenzied and utterly unreasonable, single-mindedly intent on beating him to death.

As their battle wore on, the Valley Master of Tiancan grew increasingly alarmed. He hadn't anticipated that this young alchemy grandmaster possessed such terrifying combat prowess; both his ranged and close-quarters combat were so formidable that he didn't resemble a standard bloodline talent user at all.

What was most infuriating was that in the middle of the fight, that damn Ares Shang actually blew up his teleportation array!

A teleportation array wasn't something you could just set up on a whim.

Especially since the setup methods and principles of teleportation arrays on this Orc Continent differed from those on the Fadel Continent.

The teleportation arrays on the Fadel Continent borrowed magic power and utilized magic crystals as energy sources.

Yet the teleportation arrays on the Orc Continent borrowed natural energy, which he determined after research to be terrestrial force (*dili*).

In truth, he suspected that the teleportation arrays on the Orc Continent utilized an entirely different kind of energy, but because that energy was no longer circulating, they had been altered to borrow terrestrial force for activation.

That kind of energy belonged to the technological crystallization of the Orc Continent's knowledge, which he couldn't comprehend at all.

The fact that he was able to recalibrate the coordinates of the teleportation array was already a testament to his profound knowledge of magical arrays.

However, merely altering the destination coordinates of a finished product versus manufacturing a finished product entirely from scratch required a completely different, unquantifiable magnitude of knowledge.

In other words, the Valley Master of Tiancan was utterly incapable of setting up another teleportation array in the short term.

How could this not enrage him?

His layout within the Royal City desperately required manpower. He was all by himself; no matter how formidable he was, he wasn't a god yet, and he couldn't stand against the entire True God Church single-handedly. Even against a faction like the Tiger Kingdom, he wouldn't dare claim he could suppress them with his sole strength.

Yet right when he needed manpower the most, Ares Shang blew up his teleportation array, cutting off all those players from rapidly rushing over from Tiancan Valley.

What left the Valley Master of Tiancan even more alarmed and incredulous was that Ares Shang had actually summoned the minions of the God of Terror.

Indeed, while everyone else assumed that the minions of the God of Terror appeared at random, the Valley Master of Tiancan was ninety-nine percent certain that Ares Shang was the one who had summoned them.

Originally, he and the players had been on the verge of finishing off Ares Shang.

After all, no matter how powerful Ares Shang was, he was only one person.

Yet just as Ares Shang was heavily wounded and seemed on the verge of collapse, the minions of the God of Terror had appeared.

Caught completely off guard, the Valley Master of Tiancan suffered a devastating blow.

Not only did seventy to eighty percent of the players he had summoned into the Royal City perish at the hands of the God of Terror's minions, but his own true physical body had nearly perished there as well.

Players could simply use death to escape that bizarre spatial dimension, but he was using his true physical body!

To escape that eerie space, he had no choice but to summon an avatar and use a forbidden substitution technique, narrowly managing to break free.

Yet losing an avatar each time dealt immense, excruciating damage to his main body.

The Valley Master of Tiancan had no choice but to temporarily close his doors to recuperate from his injuries.

Furthermore, losing the physical forms of so many players all at once also caused his heart to bleed with anguish.

These were all precious resources!

chunks.chapterTitle: 第191章 郎沐的幸运值之谜 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
以前玩家死亡，他都会让玩家尽量把尸体回收，可落到异度空间里的玩家尸体要怎么回收？

不过这次诡异空间之行，也让他有了一些新发现，多少弥补了他一点肉疼感。

他发现兽人大陆的古神也许并没有完全陨落，祂们仍旧有一些东西残留在这个世界。

而那个诡异的异度空间很可能就是那些古神最后的藏身之地。

那里极度危险，可如果能探明那里，收获必然也会极为巨大。

天残谷主自信的想，这次他会遇险，不过是他毫无准备，如果让他有所准备，他绝不会这么狼狈。

可惜他不知道该如何再度进入那个异度空间。

这也是他让玩家大肆寻找恐惧之神奴仆踪迹的原因。

天残谷主起身，走到窗户边往外看。

也不知道是不是那个异度空间的力量，他总感觉自己的伤势恢复得有点慢，似乎体内有一股力量在阻碍他身体快速恢复，更像是在吸收他的生命力。

天残谷主皱起好看的眉头，他需要想个法子查明他体内的那股力量到底是什么，能否驱除。

黑森林城地下图书馆内，商非凡正在感知他给某人种下的诅咒之火。

诅咒之火是他在玩家手中偶尔买到，当时他就觉得这东西对他有大用。

等吸收融合了诅咒之火后，他发现这东西对于他来说真的能称得上如虎添翼。

他还仔细研究了诅咒之火的用途。

诅咒之火除了可以当做实际火焰使用……没错，这玩意可以让他炼金，只不过需要控制好不要让炼制出来的器具带有诅咒之力。

当然，如果就要炼制一些带有诅咒之力的炼金法器，那诅咒之火简直就是最佳辅佐火焰。

除此之外，诅咒之火还能外放当做攻击手段，不但能对敌人造成实质性的烧伤，烧伤还会附着诅咒之力。

商非凡还研究出诅咒之火的阴人之法，那就是把诅咒之火分离出来，从敌人的伤口中潜入进去，就埋伏在敌人体内，依靠敌人的生命力来壮大自身，还能日夜不断地折磨敌人，却让敌人无法察觉根源在哪里。

商非凡就在和天残谷主的打斗中，趁其不备，在给对方制造伤口的同时，把诅咒之火分离了一丝出来，送入天残谷主体内。

不过为了送出这一丝诅咒之火，商非凡也被天残谷主的魔法正面击中，差点就玩完。

商非凡实心实意地承认，单论实力，天残谷主这具身体确实超过他不少，远非摩罗城那个出现的天残谷主可比。

他也就是仗着恶咒之力，不断地诅咒天残谷主，打断对方施法，或让对方施法准头偏离，这才拖延了很长时间。

等到他“不小心”炸了传送阵，天残谷主竟然愤怒到不要脸地召唤来一大群玩家群殴他，商非凡也只能使出大招。

他原本也只是想要试试，看看是不是臭果真的能把恐惧之神奴仆吸引过来。

没想到效果竟然那么好！

他还做了第二手第三手准备，当时系统的回城功能已经被他召唤出来，只要一个不对，他就能迅速返回莫约镇。

好在他运气不错，天残谷主的力量也没办法与恐惧之神奴仆相抗衡，连同那一大群玩家一起，都被恐惧之神奴仆带进了异度空间。

他有从那些巨齿兽人手上逃脱的经验，发现自己被绳索窜上时就故技重施挣脱了出来。

就是可惜天残谷主当时距离自己稍微有点远，他想悄悄跑过去彻底杀死天残谷主时，却被那些巨齿兽人发现。

不得不说，天残谷主的运气很不错。

就算他隐身也没用，那些巨齿兽人似乎能看到隐身的他。

那些巨齿兽人似乎认出了他，冲着他发出了难听的吼叫。

原本看守队伍的巨齿兽人全都向他狂奔而来。

商非凡无奈下，只能放弃这最好的杀死天残谷主的机会，转头就跑。

系统地图自动打开，他的右眼视界中-出现了一条绿色的线路。

商非凡下意识就跟着那条绿色线路跑，跑着跑着就跑到了雕像广场。

在他看到雕像广场的同时，身后那些巨齿兽人也全都消失不见。

就好像那座诡异的古城池和这座雕像广场城市属于不同大佬管辖，且立下了彼此互不侵犯的规则，过了某条看不见的边境线，追捕者就只能望对面兴叹。

从雕像广场出来，系统就宣布他完成了任务八十，获得了奖励。

他的血脉天赋【力大无穷】从三级升到四级。

另外，他的【恶咒】因为使用频繁，熟练度达到，也从四级自然升入五级。

技能升级是大好事，随着大量知识涌入脑海，商非凡就跟郎沐商量，是否找个地方好好沉淀一番。

郎沐正好也有此意，两人就假装离开王城，半路拐到了黑森林城。

【恭喜！任务七十七完成。王后刚刚死于丹顿领别庄。你已经顺利打破王后所有阴谋，保护了拉斐尔郎沐，保住并得到了虎王的空间腰带，特此奖励“郎沐的幸运值之秘”。】

正在翻书的商非凡唰地坐直身体。

郎沐就坐在距离他不远的空地，正在闭目冥想。

商非凡有点激动，他可太想知道郎沐的幸运值为何会那么诡异。

终于！

系统也没故意拖延，宣布任务完成的瞬间，就把“郎沐的幸运值之秘”的详细内容全部化作文字传输给他。

【洛伦·米尔顿·索特伯恩斯，原籍法德尔大陆，索特国王室成员，法圣突破到法神失败，使用禁术强夺了其亲重孙的身体。他有十九个孙子孙女，都是他为自己准备的灵魂容器。其中其重孙曼宁·米尔顿的身体与他最为契合。

洛伦米尔顿为了成神，研究各种秘术和禁术。他偶尔发现掠夺他人气运，很可能有助于他的成神之路。

经过苦心研究，洛伦米尔顿发现气运并不是可以随意掠夺，他需要选择合适的人，还需要对方心甘情愿地转移气运给他。

经过漫长时间寻找，洛伦米尔顿还为此修习了占卜之术，终于让他找到了一个拥有绝高气运值的人。

这人就是魂穿法德尔大陆的郎沐。

洛伦米尔顿为夺取郎沐的气运，特意接近其，施展全部魅力勾引其，编织爱情陷阱让郎沐为他情根深种。

之后洛伦米尔顿诱骗郎沐和他结下共运契约，并在第一次和郎沐结合时，诱骗其说出“愿意把自己的好运全部给他，只求他一生顺遂”的承诺，后就使用禁术掠夺其气运转移到自己身上，同时断开共运契约。】

看到这里，商非凡气得身体发抖。

如果洛伦米尔顿现在就在他眼前，他能扑上去把对方活活撕碎！

但系统的说明并没有到此结束。

【洛伦米尔顿的气运掠夺术是完全掠夺，按照他的设想，郎沐之后就会遭遇不幸死亡，但古怪的是郎沐的气运值在被他掠夺后竟然还能保有1点，且无论他怎么掠夺，都无法夺过来。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 191: The Mystery of Lang Mu's Luck Value (Part 2)

In the past, whenever players died, he would instruct them to retrieve their corpses whenever possible. But how was one supposed to retrieve player corpses that had fallen into an otherworldly dimension?

Nevertheless, this trip into the bizarre spatial dimension had also yielded some new discoveries, which somewhat compensated for his bleeding heart.

He discovered that the ancient gods of the Orc Continent perhaps had not entirely perished; remnants of their existence still lingered in this world.

And that eerie otherworldly dimension was very likely the final hiding place of those ancient gods.

It was fraught with extreme danger, but if one could thoroughly explore and investigate that place, the rewards would undoubtedly be astronomical.

The Valley Master of Tiancan thought with supreme confidence that he had only run into danger this time because he was utterly unprepared. If he were properly prepared, he would never be caught in such a sorry state.

Unfortunately, he didn't know how to re-enter that otherworldly dimension.

This was precisely why he had been ordering the players to frantically search for the traces of the God of Terror's minions.

The Valley Master of Tiancan stood up and walked over to the window, gazing outside.

Whether it was due to the lingering power of that otherworldly dimension or something else, he always felt that his injuries were healing somewhat slowly. It seemed as though there was a strange force within his body obstructing his rapid recovery, or rather, greedily devouring his vitality.

The Valley Master of Tiancan furrowed his handsome brows; he needed to devise a method to investigate exactly what that force within his body was and whether it could be purged.

Deep within the underground library of Black Forest City, Shang Feifan was currently perceiving the flame of the curse he had planted inside a certain someone.

The Curse Flame was something he had occasionally purchased from a player. At the time, he instinctively felt that this item would be of immense use to him.

After absorbing and fusing with the Curse Flame, he found that it truly deserved to be called a mighty reinforcement for his abilities.

He had even thoroughly studied the various applications of the Curse Flame.

Aside from being usable as actual fire—yes, this thing could be used for alchemy, provided one controlled it properly so that the refined artifacts didn't carry the power of curses.

Of course, if one specifically wanted to forge alchemical magical instruments imbued with cursed powers, the Curse Flame was quite literally the optimal auxiliary fire.

Beyond that, the Curse Flame could also be projected externally as a means of attack. Not only would it inflict substantial physical burn injuries upon the enemy, but the burns would also carry lingering cursed corruption.

Shang Feifan had even researched a malicious, backstabbing method utilizing the Curse Flame: severing a tiny sliver of the Curse Flame, having it infiltrate the enemy's wounds, and laying low within their body. It would feed upon the enemy's life force to grow itself, relentlessly torturing the target day and night while leaving them utterly clueless as to where the source originated.

During his battle with the Valley Master of Tiancan, taking advantage of the other's lack of preparedness while inflicting a wound, Shang Feifan had quietly detached a wisp of the Curse Flame and slipped it right into the Valley Master of Tiancan's body.

However, to successfully deliver that wisp of Curse Flame, Shang Feifan had also been struck square-on by the Valley Master of Tiancan's magic, almost kicking the bucket himself.

Shang Feifan sincerely and honestly admitted that, purely in terms of raw strength, the Valley Master of Tiancan's current body indeed surpassed him by a wide margin, far outclassing the Valley Master of Tiancan who had appeared in Moluo City.

He had simply relied on the power of malicious curses, ceaselessly cursing the Valley Master of Tiancan to disrupt his spellcasting or throw off his spell accuracy, thereby dragging out the battle for a long time.

By the time he “accidentally” blew up the teleportation array, driving the Valley Master of Tiancan into such a rage that he shamelessly summoned a massive horde of players to gang up on him, Shang Feifan had no choice but to unleash his ultimate move.

Originally, he had only wanted to test it out—to see if the stinky fruit could really attract the minions of the God of Terror.

He never expected the effect to be so magnificent!

He had also prepared a secondary and tertiary contingency plan; his system's recall function had already been queued up, ready to whisk him back to Moyue Town at the slightest sign of trouble.

Fortunately, his luck was decent, and the Valley Master of Tiancan's power was no match for the minions of the God of Terror. Along with that massive swarm of players, he had been dragged straight into the otherworldly dimension by the minions of the God of Terror.

Having had prior experience escaping from those toothed orcs, the moment he felt himself being snared by the ropes, he used the exact same trick to break free.

It was only a pity that the Valley Master of Tiancan was slightly too far away at the time. Just as he tried to sneak over to thoroughly finish off the Valley Master of Tiancan, he was spotted by those toothed orcs.

He had to admit, the Valley Master of Tiancan possessed truly remarkable luck.

Even invisibility was useless against them; those toothed orcs seemed capable of seeing right through his stealth.

Those toothed orcs seemed to recognize him, letting out ear-piercing, ugly roars in his direction.

Every single toothed orc guarding the formation charged toward him in a mad frenzy.

Left with no other choice, Shang Feifan had to abandon this prime opportunity to slay the Valley Master of Tiancan, turning tail and running.

The system map automatically opened up, and a green path materialized within his right-eye vision.

Instinctively, Shang Feifan followed that green path, running until he eventually burst into the Statue Plaza.

The moment his eyes locked onto the Statue Plaza, the pursuing toothed orcs behind him vanished entirely.

It was as if that bizarre ancient city and the city of the Statue Plaza belonged to the jurisdiction of two different supreme overlords, having established a mutual non-aggression pact. Once someone crossed a certain invisible border line, the pursuers could only stare across it and sigh in frustration.

Emerging from the Statue Plaza, the system announced that he had completed Quest Eighty and granted him his reward.

His bloodline talent, [Boundless Strength], advanced from Level 3 to Level 4.

Additionally, due to its frequent usage, his [Malicious Curse] skill reached the necessary proficiency threshold, naturally advancing from Level 4 to Level 5.

Skill upgrades were a phenomenal event. As a massive influx of knowledge flooded into his mind, Shang Feifan discussed with Lang Mu whether they should find a secluded place to properly consolidate and digest these gains.

Lang Mu happened to harbor the exact same thought, so the two of them feigned their departure from the Royal City and detoured halfway to Black Forest City.

[Congratulations! Quest Seventy-Seven is complete. The Queen has just perished at the Danton fief villa. You have successfully shattered all of the Queen's schemes, protected Raphael Lang Mu, and successfully defended and secured the Tiger King's spatial belt. As a special reward, you have been granted 'The Mystery of Lang Mu's Luck Value'.]

Shang Feifan, who was in the midst of turning pages, bolted upright in a stiff posture.

Lang Mu was sitting in an open area not far from him, eyes closed in deep meditation.

Shang Feifan felt a surge of excitement; he had been yearning to find out why Lang Mu's luck value was so utterly bizarre!

Finally!

The system didn't deliberately drag things out either. The instant it announced the quest's completion, it transformed all the detailed contents of "The Mystery of Lang Mu's Luck Value" into text and transmitted it directly into his mind.

[Loren Milton Sortborns, originally native to the Fadel Continent, a member of the Sort Royal Family, failed his breakthrough from Saint Mage to God Mage and utilized a forbidden art to forcefully seize the body of his own direct great-grandson. He had nineteen grandchildren and great-grandchildren, all of whom he had prepared as soul vessels for himself. Among them, the body of his great-grandson, Manning Milton, possessed the highest compatibility with him.

In order to ascend to godhood, Loren Milton researched various esoteric arts and forbidden techniques. He occasionally discovered that plundering the fortune of others would likely aid his path toward godhood.

Through painstaking research, Loren Milton found that fortune could not be plundered indiscriminately; he needed to select suitable individuals, and the targets had to willingly transfer their fortune to him.

After a long search, Loren Milton even practiced the art of divination for this very purpose, finally leading him to discover a person possessed of an extraordinarily high luck value.

This person was Lang Mu, who had transmigrated across souls to the Fadel Continent.

To seize Lang Mu's fortune, Loren Milton deliberately approached him, exerted all his charm to seduce him, and wove a romantic trap that caused Lang Mu to fall deeply and hopelessly in love with him.

Subsequently, Loren Milton tricked Lang Mu into entering a shared-fortune pact with him. During their very first union, he coaxed Lang Mu into uttering the pledge: 'I am willing to give all my good luck to you, praying only for your lifelong smooth and peaceful journey.' Following this, he executed a forbidden art to plunder Lang Mu's fortune, transferring it entirely onto himself while severing the shared-fortune pact.]

Reading up to this point, Shang Feifan trembled with rage.

If Loren Milton were standing right in front of him at this very second, he would pounce forward and tear the bastard limb from limb!

However, the system's explanation did not end there.

[Loren Milton's Fortune Plundering Art was a total plunder. According to his design, Lang Mu should have subsequently met with misfortune and died. Yet, bizarrely, Lang Mu's luck value still retained a value of 1 even after being plundered, and no matter how Loren Milton attempted to siphon it, he could never wrest it away.]

chunks.chapterTitle: 第191章 郎沐的幸运值之谜 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
洛伦米尔顿花了近八年时间想要搞清楚这个问题，更想要把那最后的1点气运值从郎沐身上掠夺过来，但全都失败。

洛伦米尔顿最终决定杀死郎沐，他的直觉告诉他，留着郎沐必定会影响他的成神之路。

洛伦米尔顿为了防止术法反噬，他试图创造出意外来让郎沐身死。

意外果然发生，郎沐居住的房屋失火，郎沐差点就死在这场大火中。

但最终郎沐还是从火场里走了出来。

可附近居民包括洛伦米尔顿都以为郎沐死在了那场大火中，因为那是魔法火焰，燃烧过后，任何物体都不会留下痕迹，包括尸体。

可普通人看不出这点，只认为这场大火过于猛烈，才把一栋房子连同里面的人烧得干干净净，只剩下灰烬。】

商非凡的脸色变得铁青。

系统的说明还再继续。

【那么郎沐的气运值也是幸运值为何会如此诡异？

直到郎沐在法德尔大陆为救护魔法学校的师生选择自爆，后魂穿到兽人大陆，被系统注意到。经过系统的大量分析和推算，终于揭开了这个秘密。

郎沐的灵魂中含有自然之神的神格碎片。

神格碎片会为他带来莫大幸运，也会为他带来不幸。

从天河星兽人大陆脱离而出的一小片神格碎片融入了地球一个初生婴儿的灵魂中。

神格碎片沉寂着、隐藏着，寻找着返回天河星的机会。

小小的婴儿一点点长大。

普通人类的命运无法承载神格的力量，哪怕那只是一小片。

郎沐长大后，亲缘浅薄，更死于亲人之手。就与神格有莫大关系。

悄悄说：身怀其他世界神灵神格的郎沐被本世界意识给排斥了。

郎沐死后，那一小片神格带着郎沐的灵魂返回天河星。

注意！郎沐的气运值受到神格影响，但神格并不能决定郎沐的气运值。相反，如果没有神格，郎沐的气运值会接近满点，他是个天生幸运的气运之子。

而这也是神格会落到郎沐身上的重要原因。

自然之神的那一小片神格虽然没有给郎沐带来多大好处，反而拖累了第一世的郎沐。但也正因为有这片神格，让洛伦米尔顿无法完全夺取郎沐的气运。

想要彻底恢复郎沐的气运值，第一，必须反向使用气运掠夺术，迫使洛伦米尔顿把郎沐的气运值还回来。第二，剔除那一小片神格。

注意！如果不能先夺回郎沐的气运值，你将始终无法杀死洛伦米尔顿。就算杀死，也无法让郎沐的气运值恢复。

特别注意！如果你想带着郎沐前往其他世界生活，除非你们已经成神，否则请千万剔除本世界神灵的神格。否则被其他世界的意识排斥，不要怪系统没有事先说明。】
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 191: The Mystery of Lang Mu's Luck Value (Part 3)

Loren Milton spent nearly eight years trying to figure out this anomaly, even more desperate to wrench that final 1 point of luck value from Lang Mu, but all his attempts ended in failure.

In the end, Loren Milton decided to kill Lang Mu. His intuition told him that keeping Lang Mu alive would inevitably hinder his path to godhood.

To prevent karmic backlash from spell retaliation, Loren Milton attempted to manufacture an 'accident' that would cause Lang Mu to perish.

The accident indeed occurred: the residence where Lang Mu lived caught fire, and Lang Mu nearly died within the blaze.

Yet in the end, Lang Mu managed to walk out from the inferno alive.

However, the nearby residents, including Loren Milton, all believed that Lang Mu had perished in that raging fire. After all, it was magical fire; once it burned through, not a single trace of any object would remain, corpses included.

Ordinary people lacked the discernment to realize otherwise, assuming simply that the fire had been overly ferocious, incinerating an entire building and the people inside down to nothing, leaving behind only ashes.]

Shang Feifan's complexion turned iron-blue.

The system's explanation continued relentlessly.

[Then why was Lang Mu's fortune and luck value so bizarre?

It wasn't until Lang Mu chose to detonate himself on the Fadel Continent to save the teachers and students of the magic academy, subsequently soul-transmigrating to the Orc Continent and catching the system's attention, that this secret was finally unraveled through massive systemic analysis and calculation.

Lang Mu's soul contains a fragment of the God of Nature's divine persona.

This fragment of divine persona would bring him immense fortune, yet simultaneously plague him with misfortune.

A tiny fragment of divine persona that had broken free from the Heavenly River Star's Orc Continent had merged into the soul of a newborn infant on Earth.

The fragment of divine persona lay dormant and hidden, searching for an opportunity to return to Heavenly River Star.

The little infant grew up bit by bit.

The fate of an ordinary human could not bear the power of a divine persona, even if it were merely a tiny fragment.

After Lang Mu grew up, his ties of kinship were exceptionally shallow, and he ultimately died at the hands of kin—a tragedy intimately tied to the divine persona.

*Whispered aside: Lang Mu, harboring the divine persona of a deity from another world, was rejected by the consciousness of this world.*

Following Lang Mu's death, that tiny fragment of divine persona carried Lang Mu's soul back to Heavenly River Star.

Note! Lang Mu's luck value is influenced by the divine persona, but the divine persona does not dictate Lang Mu's luck value. On the contrary, without the divine persona, Lang Mu's luck value would approach the absolute maximum; he is a Child of Fortune blessed with innate luck.

And this was precisely the crucial reason why the divine persona landed upon Lang Mu in the first place.

Although that tiny fragment of the God of Nature's divine persona did not bestow much benefit upon Lang Mu, instead dragging down his first lifetime, it was precisely the presence of this divine persona that prevented Loren Milton from completely stripping away Lang Mu's fortune.

To fully restore Lang Mu's luck value, two conditions must be met: First, one must reverse-use the Fortune Plundering Art, compelling Loren Milton to return Lang Mu's fortune. Second, the tiny fragment of the divine persona must be excised.

Attention! If you fail to reclaim Lang Mu's fortune first, you will forever be incapable of killing Loren Milton. Even if you manage to kill him, you will not be able to restore Lang Mu's luck value.

Special Notice! If you intend to take Lang Mu to live in other worlds, unless you have both already ascended to godhood, you must absolutely excise the divine persona belonging to this world's deity. Otherwise, if you are rejected by the consciousness of other worlds, do not blame the system for failing to warn you in advance.]

chunks.chineseText:
第192章 神格碎片

郎沐刚睁开眼睛，就看到商非凡正托着腮帮坐在他对面盯着他看。

“你看……”

话没说完，对面那人就移动位置，把他揽入怀中，还轻轻摩挲他的头发，像是对小幼崽一样。

郎沐满心问号。

商非凡揉揉郎沐的头发，亲亲他的额头、鼻尖和嘴角。

温暖，充满活气，血色也好。

看他把阿沐养得多好啊。商非凡内心有点骄傲。

郎沐虽然不知道这家伙在做什么，但他也没问，就放松力道靠在这人身上。

两人什么也没干，就这么互相依偎着坐了好一会儿。

“系统跟我说了你的一个小秘密。”商非凡开口。

“哦？我还有什么秘密是你不知道的？”郎沐失笑。

“关于你的气运值，也是你的幸运值。”原本这句话在郎沐面前说出来会变成无意义的发音，但今天他顺利说了出来。

也许是“游戏”进程已经到了可以向郎沐揭秘的时候？

或许也和郎沐交出了三份自然之神的力量有关？

自然之神已经不用担心郎沐知道自己身上有神格碎片，进而收拢这些神力成神。

“哦？”郎沐挑眉，“我的幸运值怎么了？”

“你原本的气运值有97点，满点为100点。”

“听起来好像很高。”

“非常高。”毕竟他的幸运值可是0点。

但他好像也没有特别不幸，相反他觉得自己运气还不错。

这也是很古怪的一点。

不，仔细回想，他的运气确实不好也不坏，有劳就有得，但不会不劳而获。而每次发现什么额外的好东西，或者遇到什么额外的好事，似乎都是郎沐在他身边的时候。

另外，他好像和怨气、诅咒之类的东西特别合，很容易发现与这些负面能量相关的事物。

“幸运值和气运值，也许不是同一种数值。也许玩家的幸运值压根就不精确。”商非凡自言自语。

商非凡拉开自己的数据面板，想要寻找自己的气运值，果然没有看到，只看到幸运值。

“系统，我没有气运值吗？”商非凡直接问。

系统过了一会儿才回答：【你之气运值无法看见。非本世界生命，其气运值都无法看见。】

“所以玩家才都是幸运值。这个幸运值是根据玩家的身体数据、个人能力以及性格为人等，推导出来的数值，对吗？”

【差不多如此。】

商非凡明白了。这个幸运值就跟地星人常看的星座属相的运势一样，说白了就是统计学加概率学的结果。换言之，不太准确。

“气运值则跟人的命运有关，不单单指幸运和不幸，气运值高的人也有可能会遇到很多危险和挫折，只是这些危险和挫折有可能让他得到更多收获、迈向更高层次，对不对？”

【对。】

郎沐在一边听商非凡和系统交流，虽然没有听到系统的回应，但从商非凡的话语中，他也听明白了不少。

商非凡看向郎沐：“我们再说你的气运值。”

“嗯，你说我原本有97点，那么是不是我现在没有那么高的气运值？”郎沐像是在说别人的事情一样，神情淡定。

商非凡点头：“我遇到你时，你的气运值是97（-96），后来每次归还自然之神的一部分力量，你的气运值就会上升一点。现在是97（-93）。”

郎沐在看人上也许不是很擅长，但他脑子很聪明，一听商非凡的话，他就把他三世遇到的事情全都结合起来，瞬间得出结论。

“你认为有人掠夺了我的气运值？是洛伦米尔顿，在我和他第一次发生亲密关系的时候？”

商非凡观察郎沐神色，发现他不喜不怒，忍不住皱眉：“你不要这样。”

郎沐茫然：“我怎样了？”

商非凡握住他的手：“就是谈到自己的事情就像是在说别人。你已经习惯压抑自己的感情，习惯把自己的感情抽离出来，尤其在自己的事情上。这不好。我知道你这样做是为了防止自己受伤。但是时间久了，你就会逐渐……”

“失去人性？”郎沐歪头笑。

商非凡没好气：“是体会不到更多快乐，也无法再对某件事某个人全心投入。”

郎沐忍笑：“你是在抱怨我无法对你全心投入吗？”

商非凡耍无赖：“我有抱怨吗？我肯定没有。我爱你十二分，你回我八分，我就很高兴。”

郎沐：“……”就这还说没有抱怨？

郎沐忍不住捏了捏老商的厚脸皮。

让他说出爱这个字眼真的太难，但是他可以亲亲这家伙。

郎沐探头。

……

要不是这里是图书馆，里面还有个图书管理员，商非凡可能真的会上演全套大保健。

两人分开时，郎沐脸红得不得了。

黏黏糊糊好一会儿，两人才又开始说正经事。

商非凡把系统展示给他的信息，全都告诉了郎沐。

郎沐听完，脸上露出一点奇怪神色。

“怎么，有不对的地方？”商非凡一下就捕捉到郎沐的异样。

郎沐迟疑，“为什么你的那个系统对我过去的人生那么了解？甚至连第一世都知道得那么清楚？”

商非凡也想过这点：“对你三世人生都非常了解的存在只有你体内的神格碎片。我怀疑系统本身可能也拥有一片神格碎片，甚至是很大的一片。而你体内的神格碎片和系统拥有的那一片，应该属于同一位神。两片神格碎片相遇，进行了某种我们不知道的交流方式，所以系统才能得知你前两世的事情。”

“系统，我说的对么？”

系统没有回应。

商非凡也料到系统不会解答这个问题，这家伙就跟挤牙膏一样，总是要等事情进程达到某一程度，它才会透露出更多。

郎沐也觉得商非凡的猜测很接近真相。

“那么系统说的那些事情都正确吗？”商非凡确认。

郎沐沉默片刻：“你是不是在现实中调查过我？”

商非凡坦然承认：“你的骨灰，我带到我那里了。”

你竟然连我骨灰都挖出来了？郎沐有点被惊到，但转而又觉得商非凡做出这种事半点不奇怪。

“我发现我的记忆似乎出了一点问题。”郎沐揉了揉额头。

“我跟你说过我被郎岸刺了一刀后，就没有了意识，也不知道后来发生了什么事。但我在法德尔大陆醒来时，只记得自己是中暑昏倒后穿越过来。我一直这么认为，直到我在这里见到洛伦米尔顿。”

“我开始做噩梦。之后我就发现自己的记忆似乎有了一点冲突，不止是在洛伦米尔顿的事情上，还有就是我第一世的死因。”

商非凡推测：“你见到洛伦米尔顿后，记忆受到了刺激，一些被蒙蔽和修改的记忆开始恢复，所以你脑中才出现记忆冲突？”

郎沐也觉得是这样：“但是，洛伦米尔顿修改我的记忆，我可以理解。可为什么我第一世的死因记忆也被修改过？又是被谁？”

商非凡冷笑：“还有谁？当然是你身体中那片神格碎片。”

Chapter 192: Fragments of a Godhead (Part 1)

The moment Lang Mu opened his eyes, he saw Shang Feifan sitting opposite him, cupping his chin and staring straight at him.

"You..."

Before he could finish, the man shifted his position, pulling Lang Mu into his embrace. He gently stroked Lang Mu's hair, treating him as tenderly as if he were a little fledgling.

Lang Mu was filled with a maze of question marks.

Shang Feifan ruffled Lang Mu's hair, planting soft kisses on his forehead, the tip of his nose, and the corner of his lips.

Warmth, full of vitality, and a healthy rosy complexion.

Look at how well he had raised Ah Mu. A trace of quiet pride welled up inside Shang Feifan.

Though Lang Mu had no idea what this fellow was up to, he didn't press him, simply relaxing his body and leaning into the man's warmth.

The two of them did nothing else, just lingering together in each other's embrace for a long while.

"The system told me a little secret about you," Shang Feifan said.

"Oh? What other secrets of mine are left that you don't know?" Lang Mu let out a soft, amused laugh.

"It's about your Luck Value, which is also your Fortune Value." Originally, speaking of this in front of Lang Mu would have resulted in meaningless gibberish, but today, he was able to articulate it smoothly.

Perhaps the "game" progress had finally reached a point where it could reveal this secret to Lang Mu?

Or perhaps it was related to Lang Mu handing over the three portions of the God of Nature's power?

The God of Nature no longer needed to worry about Lang Mu discovering the fragments of the Godhead within him and subsequently gathering those divine powers to ascend as a god.

"Oh?" Lang Mu raised an eyebrow. "What about my Fortune Value?"

"Your original Fortune Value was 97 points, out of a maximum of 100."

"That sounds exceptionally high."

"It's extraordinarily high." After all, his own Fortune Value was a dismal 0.

Yet he didn't seem particularly unfortunate; on the contrary, he felt his luck had always been fairly decent.

This was also a rather peculiar point.

No, upon careful reflection, his luck was truly neither good nor bad—you reap what you sow through labor, but there were never any unearned windfalls. Yet every time he discovered some extra-special treasure or encountered some unexpected stroke of good fortune, it seemed to happen whenever Lang Mu was by his side.

In addition, he seemed to have a strange affinity for lingering grievances, curses, and the like, making it exceptionally easy for him to spot things related to these negative energies.

"Fortune Value and Luck Value might not be the same metric. Perhaps a player's Luck Value isn't accurate at all," Shang Feifan muttered to himself.

Shang Feifan pulled open his own data panel, wanting to check his own Fortune Value. Sure enough, he didn't find it; only his Luck Value was displayed.

"System, do I not have a Fortune Value?" Shang Feifan asked directly.

After a short pause, the system replied: [Your Fortune Value cannot be viewed. For beings not of this world, their Fortune Value is unobservable.]

"So that's why players only have a Luck Value. This Luck Value is a calculated figure derived from a player's physical stats, personal abilities, personality, and conduct, am I right?"

[Pretty much so.]

Shang Feifan understood. This Luck Value was just like the horoscopes and zodiac fortunes that Earthlings frequently looked at—in plain terms, it was the result of statistics combined with probability. In other words, it wasn't very accurate.

"As for the Fortune Value, it is tied to a person's destiny, and it doesn't simply refer to luck and misfortune. A person with a high Fortune Value might encounter numerous perils and setbacks, but these very dangers and setbacks could allow them to reap greater rewards and ascend to a higher plane, right?"

[Correct.]

Lang Mu listened from the side as Shang Feifan communicated with the system. Although he couldn't hear the system's responses, he managed to grasp quite a bit from Shang Feifan's end of the conversation.

Shang Feifan looked at Lang Mu. "Let's talk more about your Fortune Value."

"Mm, you said I originally had 97 points. Does that mean my Fortune Value isn't that high anymore?" Lang Mu's expression remained as calm as if he were discussing someone else's affairs.

Shang Feifan nodded. "When I first met you, your Fortune Value was 97 (-96). Every time we returned a portion of the God of Nature's power afterward, your Fortune Value would increase by a bit. Right now, it's 97 (-93)."

Lang Mu might not be exceptionally skilled at reading people, but his mind was sharp. The moment he heard Shang Feifan's words, he linked together everything he had experienced across his three lifetimes, instantly arriving at a conclusion.

"You think someone plundered my Fortune Value? Was it Loren Milton, around the time we first became intimate?"

Observing Lang Mu's expression and finding him neither angry nor joyful, Shang Feifan couldn't help frowning. "Don't be like this."

Lang Mu looked bewildered. "How am I being?"

Shang Feifan took his hand. "It's just... whenever you talk about your own matters, it sounds like you're talking about a stranger. You've grown accustomed to suppressing your emotions, accustomed to detaching yourself from your feelings, especially when it comes to your own affairs. This isn't good. I know you do this to protect yourself from getting hurt. But as time goes on, you will gradually—"

"Lose my humanity?" Lang Mu tilted his head with a smile.

Shang Feifan scoffed impatiently. "You won't be able to experience deeper joy, nor will you be able to invest your whole heart into a certain matter or a certain person ever again."

Lang Mu chuckled, holding back his laughter. "Are you complaining that I can't invest my whole heart into you?"

Shang Feifan acted shamelessly. "Am I complaining? Certainly not. If I love you twelve parts, and you return eight parts to me, I'm already thrilled."

Lang Mu: "..." And he still had the nerve to say he wasn't complaining?

Lang Mu couldn't resist pinching Shang Feifan's thick-skinned face.

Making him utter the word "love" was truly too difficult, but he could certainly kiss this fellow.

Lang Mu leaned forward.

...

If this weren't a library, and if there weren't a librarian sitting inside, Shang Feifan might have actually gone ahead and treated him to the full VIP treatment.

When the two finally separated, Lang Mu's face was flushed a brilliant red.

After lingering in a sweet, clingy haze for a good while, they finally returned to discussing serious business.

Shang Feifan relayed all the information the system had displayed to him over to Lang Mu.

Upon hearing it all, a strange expression flickered across Lang Mu's face.

"What, is something off?" Shang Feifan immediately caught Lang Mu's odd reaction.

Lang Mu hesitated. "Why does that system of yours know my past life so thoroughly? Even my first lifetime is known so clearly?"

Shang Feifan had also pondered this point. "The only existence that knows all three of your lifetimes so intimately is the fragment of the Godhead residing within your body. I suspect that the system itself might also possess a fragment of a Godhead—perhaps even a very large one. Furthermore, the fragment within you and the one the system possesses probably belong to the very same deity. When two godhead fragments meet, they carry out a form of communication unknown to us, which is how the system managed to find out about your first two lives."

"System, am I right?"

The system gave no response.

Shang Feifan had anticipated that the system wouldn't answer this question. This fellow was always like squeezing toothpaste; it would only reveal more once the plot progress reached a certain threshold.

Lang Mu also felt that Shang Feifan's conjecture was very close to the truth.

"Then are the things the system mentioned accurate?" Shang Feifan sought confirmation.

Lang Mu fell silent for a moment. "Have you been investigating me in reality?"

Shang Feifan admitted it frankly. "I brought your ashes back to my place."

You even dug up my ashes? Lang Mu was somewhat startled, but upon reflection, he realized that it was entirely in character for Shang Feifan to pull off such a stunt.

"I've discovered that my memories seem to have run into a bit of a problem," Lang Mu rubbed his temples.

"I told you that after Lang An stabbed me, I lost consciousness and had no idea what happened afterward. But when I woke up on the Fadel Continent, I only remembered that I had fainted from heatstroke and transmigrated over. I've always believed that, right up until I saw Loren Milton here.

"I started having nightmares. After that, I realized there seemed to be some conflicts in my memories—not just regarding Loren Milton, but also concerning the cause of my death in my first lifetime."

Shang Feifan speculated: "After seeing Loren Milton, your memories were stimulated, and some tampered-with and rewritten memories began to recover, which is why memory conflicts appeared in your mind?"

Lang Mu believed it was likely the case as well. "However, I can understand Loren Milton tampering with my memories. But why was the memory of my death in my first lifetime also altered? Who did it?"

Shang Feifan sneered. "Who else? Naturally, it was that fragment of the Godhead inside your body."

郎沐还是想不通：“那它为什么要修改我的记忆？”

商非凡想到自己的调查结果，他脑中忽然冒出一个大胆猜测：“我怀疑郎岸刺中你后，你并没有立刻死亡，你被送上了救护车，也许原本你很可能能被救回来。”

“你是说？”

“神格碎片在地星受到排斥，它在那里无法成神，也无法脱离你。它迫切地想要回到天河星。可你不死，它就不能离开地星。于是……”

两人互视。

郎沐苦笑：“于是本不该死的我，就这么被死亡了？神格碎片可能做了什么，也许是延误我的治疗时机，也许是移动我身体里的刀。”

商非凡接口：“神格碎片动手，导致你当时很可能已经感觉到神格碎片的存在。神格碎片为了不让你察觉这一点，就影响乃至修改了你的记忆，让你在法德尔大陆醒来时只以为自己是中暑死亡。”

郎沐：“但郎岸刺杀我的过程，我记得很清楚。”

商非凡：“可你不记得后来发生了什么事。这表示你被刺中后的记忆已经被修改和隐藏。”

郎沐皱眉：“那为什么非要让我以为我是中暑死亡，为什么不干脆让我以为我就是被郎岸刺杀而死？”

“中暑……”商非凡呢喃：“我想我明白神格碎片是怎么动手的了。它可能并不能真正影响到你太多，更别说做一些物理上的事情。但你当时被刺伤，身体极度衰弱，对身体的掌控力变弱，神格碎片就利用自己的能量升高了你的体温，让你产生热射病。你最后的记忆就是中暑症状，因为太痛苦，你就以为自己是中暑昏迷。神格碎片没有过多的修改你的记忆，它只是加深了你最后的死亡记忆，让你以为自己是中暑死亡。”

商非凡声音陡然变厉：“系统，你在包庇那枚神格碎片！”

系统立刻回复：【你看到的就是系统了解到的真实。】

“那就是阿沐体内的神格碎片欺骗了阿沐？”

系统还没回答，郎沐突然按住额头。

商非凡紧张，一把抱住他：“阿沐，你怎么了？”

郎沐过了好一会儿才说话：“是那枚神格碎片，它在喊冤。它表示它确实想要回到天河星，但它并没有动手害死我，杀死我的人就是郎岸，我当时被刺中脾脏，又被郎云寿晃动身体，导致伤口扩大，没等到医院，在救护车上我就死了。在我死亡的一刹那，神格碎片用它的能量带着我的灵魂穿越，穿越过程让我的灵魂产生了中暑症状，于是我就以为……”

商非凡无语。这也太扯了！

郎沐也在笑，笑得特别无奈，扯归扯，但它真的就是真相啊。

想想也是，世上哪有那么多阴谋。

“这枚神格碎片还说，因为它在我体内，其实我已经产生了一定异变，已经不是普通人，否则我的灵魂根本无法承受穿越空间乱流的能量灼烧。另外，”

商非凡：“还有什么？”

郎沐神情古怪：“它说，也因为我的异变，才让洛伦米尔顿无法完全掠夺我的气运，甚至我的气运还对洛伦米尔顿造成了一定影响，就是让他的运气变得很好，总能发现机缘和宝物，但同样会造成他命运多舛，磨难多多。”

商非凡：“……”

郎沐又道：“还有那场大火，确实是洛伦米尔顿想要烧死我。我本来无法从火灾中逃出来，我当时甚至是想死在大火中的，但神格碎片当时对我产生了影响，让我处在一种非常怪异的状态，就像是本能控制了我的身体。然后我依靠本能的求生欲，找到了万分之一的生机，这才从火场中走出来。”

“还有和我说话的邻居，其实是一些死去的亡灵，它们对我议论纷纷。我当时处在一种非常微妙的状态中，这才听到了它们的声音，甚至看到它们。”

“我怎么就忘了，我住的房子明明就远离村落，就算村人看到我的房子失火，想要赶过来也需要时间。”

郎沐又呢喃：“怪不得我在得到石耳后觉醒了能听到亡者声音的血脉天赋，原来我早就有了这种能力。”

郎沐迟钝地想，也许他在法德尔大陆遇到的一些人、听到的一些密语，可能都不属于真正的活人，而他半点没有察觉。

回忆中，他有时在荒郊野外找不到路、找不到吃的，却总是会碰上一些路过的好心人，那些好心人会给他指路、会告诉他哪里有能吃的食物。

他当时只以为自己运气好，现在想来，也许那些好心人压根就不是活人？

郎沐捂脸。他的第二世活得真的太糊涂。

商非凡吐气，没有阴谋就好。他就怕系统和神格碎片联手，一起坑他家阿沐。

“你想要留下那枚神格碎片吗？”商非凡问郎沐。

郎沐毫不犹豫地摇头：“不属于我的东西，让它哪里来的就回哪里去吧。神格碎片要怎么取出来？”

商非凡转头就去询问系统。

系统：【请先完成主线任务。】

商非凡告诉郎沐：“可能自然之神需要恢复一定的神力后才能取回自己的神格碎片。”

郎沐忽然说：“你有没有觉得，自然之神不急着收回神格碎片，也可能跟邪神有关？也许自然之神收回神格碎片，就会让邪神察觉到祂的所在？”

商非凡也觉得这个可能性很高，否则系统不会说出要等主线完成后再收回神格碎片。

“总感觉自然之神似乎并不是很在意神格碎片，也许神格可以重新凝结？旧的要不要都无所谓？”商非凡胡乱猜测。

郎沐忽然发笑：“我感觉到我体内那枚神格碎片似乎有点郁闷？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 192: Fragments of a Godhead (Part 2)

Lang Mu still couldn't wrap his head around it. "Then why did it tamper with my memories?"

Recalling the results of his investigation, a bold conjecture suddenly popped into Shang Feifan's mind: "I suspect that after Lang An stabbed you, you didn't die immediately. You were put into an ambulance, and originally, you likely could have been saved."

"You mean—?"

"The fragment of the Godhead faced rejection on Earth; it couldn't achieve godhood there, nor could it break away from you. It was desperately eager to return to Tianhe Star. But as long as you didn't die, it couldn't leave Earth. And so..."

The two of them exchanged glances.

Lang Mu gave a bitter laugh. "And so, I—someone who shouldn't have died—was thus 'processed' into dying? The godhead fragment might have done something, perhaps delaying my treatment, or perhaps shifting the blade inside my body."

Shang Feifan took over: "The godhead fragment made a move, causing you to very likely sense its presence at the time. To prevent you from noticing this, the fragment influenced and even altered your memories, making you think you had simply died of heatstroke when you woke up on the Fadel Continent."

Lang Mu: "But I remember the process of Lang An assassinating me very clearly."

Shang Feifan: "Yet you don't remember what happened afterward. This indicates that your memories immediately after being stabbed had already been altered and concealed."

Lang Mu frowned. "Then why did it have to make me think I died of heatstroke? Why didn't it just make me think I was killed by Lang An's assassination?"

"Heatstroke..." Shang Feifan murmured. "I think I understand how the godhead fragment pulled it off. It probably couldn't truly influence you too much, let alone perform physical actions. But you were severely wounded at the time, your body was extremely weak, and your control over your physical form had diminished. The godhead fragment used its own energy to raise your body temperature, inducing heat exhaustion. Your final memory was of heatstroke symptoms, and because it was so agonizing, you assumed you had passed out from heatstroke. The godhead fragment didn't overly modify your memories; it simply deepened your final moments of death, making you believe you died of heatstroke."

Shang Feifan's voice suddenly turned stern: "System, you're covering for that godhead fragment!"

The system replied immediately: [What you see is the truth as understood by the system.]

"So it was the godhead fragment inside Ah Mu's body that deceived Ah Mu?"

Before the system could answer, Lang Mu suddenly pressed a hand to his temples.

Panicking, Shang Feifan pulled him into a tight embrace. "Ah Mu, what's wrong?"

It took a good while before Lang Mu spoke. "It's that godhead fragment... it's crying foul. It says that while it *did* want to return to Tianhe Star by carrying my soul across, it never harmed me or killed me. The one who killed me was Lang An; I was stabbed in the spleen, and then Lang Yunshou shook my body, causing the wound to widen. Before we could reach the hospital, I died in the ambulance. At the exact moment of my death, the godhead fragment used its energy to carry my soul across the rift, and the transit process caused my soul to experience heatstroke symptoms, which made me think—"

Shang Feifan was speechless. That was absurd to the extreme!

Lang Mu was also laughing, a laugh of pure helplessness. As farfetched as it sounded, it really was the truth.

Come to think of it, there weren't that many grand conspiracies in this world.

"This godhead fragment also says that because it was inside my body, I actually underwent a certain mutation and am no longer an ordinary human. Otherwise, my soul simply wouldn't have been able to withstand the energy scorching of crossing spatial turbulence. Also—"

Shang Feifan: "Also what?"

Lang Mu wore a peculiar expression. "It says that it was precisely because of my mutation that Loren Milton was unable to completely plunder my Fortune Value. In fact, my fortune even exerted a certain influence on Loren Milton, making his luck exceptionally good and enabling him to constantly discover opportunities and treasures, though it likewise brought him a life fraught with trials and numerous tribulations."

Shang Feifan: "..."

Lang Mu continued: "And as for that fire, Loren Milton indeed wanted to burn me to death. I originally wouldn't have been able to escape the blaze—at the time, I even wanted to die in the fire. But the godhead fragment exerted an influence on me back then, plunging me into a very bizarre state, as if instinct had taken over my body. Relying on my instinctive will to survive, I found a one-in-a-ten-thousand chance of life and walked out of the burning inferno."

"As for the neighbor who spoke to me, they were actually departed wandering souls, and they were gossiping about me. I was in a very subtle state at the time, which is why I heard their voices and even saw them."

"How could I have forgotten? The house I lived in was clearly far away from the village; even if the villagers saw my house on fire and wanted to rush over, it would have taken time."

Lang Mu murmured again: "No wonder when I obtained the stone fungus, I awakened the bloodline talent to hear the voices of the dead. It turns out I already possessed this ability long ago."

Lang Mu thought dully that perhaps some of the people he had met and the secret whispers he had heard on the Fadel Continent weren't true living beings at all, yet he hadn't suspected a thing.

In his memories, whenever he lost his way in the desolate wilderness or couldn't find food, he would always bump into kind-hearted passersby who would point him in the right direction or tell him where edible food could be found.

At the time, he had simply thought his luck was good. Now that he thought about it, perhaps those kind-hearted people weren't living humans at all?

Lang Mu covered his face. He had truly lived his second lifetime in a daze.

Shang Feifan let out a long breath. It was a relief that there was no conspiracy. What he feared most was the system and the godhead fragment teaming up to trick his Ah Mu.

"Do you want to keep that godhead fragment?" Shang Feifan asked Lang Mu.

Lang Mu shook his head without the slightest hesitation. "Things that don't belong to me should go back where they came from. How do we extract the godhead fragment?"

Shang Feifan immediately turned to question the system.

System: [Please complete the main questline first.]

Shang Feifan told Lang Mu: "It's possible the God of Nature needs to recover a certain amount of divine power before reclaiming its godhead fragment."

Lang Mu suddenly said, "Don't you think the God of Nature not being in a hurry to take back the godhead fragment might also be related to the Evil God? Perhaps reclaiming it would alert the Evil God to its whereabouts?"

Shang Feifan also felt this possibility was very high; otherwise, the system wouldn't have stated that they had to wait until the main quest was completed before taking back the fragment.

"I have a vague feeling that the God of Nature doesn't really care much about the fragment. Perhaps a godhead can be re-condensed? Whether the old one is kept or not doesn't really matter?" Shang Feifan guessed wildly.

Lang Mu suddenly chuckled. "I have a feeling that the godhead fragment inside me is feeling a bit depressed?"

第193章 婚了

商非凡对于取出郎沐体内的神格并不是很执着，如果神格碎片对郎沐有好处，那就留着。

虽然这样也许无法带郎沐回地球，但他早就做好以后就留在兽人世界和郎沐生活的准备。之前他以为郎沐是数据，害怕郎沐消失，才一心一意想要把郎沐带出去。

现在知道这个世界是真实的世界，郎沐也是活生生的人，而他这具玩家身体并不受洛伦米尔顿的控制，那留在这里和郎沐生活也是很美好的事。

当然，前提是得解决邪神、神灵、虫族、天灾等等带来的麻烦。

他可不想和郎沐留在这里当苦力（救世主）。

如果真留在这个世界，他想把自己在地星的身体给弄过来。而这也不是什么做不到的难事，他的现实身体融合程度已经达到4级。

等到他把主线任务全部做完，他的现实身体应该就能和他的玩家身体彻底融合。

不过有可能的话，他还是想要带郎沐回去地星看看。

他想把自己的农场，还有其他隐藏财产亮给郎沐看，顺便带郎沐周游整个世界，这也算是一种雄性的本能炫耀心？

他还想把郎沐介绍给自己的战友们，免得那些家伙老以为他精神出了问题，以为他死了爱人，就找了个模样比较像的纸片人来喜欢。

“你在想什么？”郎沐看商非凡一脸荡漾的神情。

商非凡收回奔走的思绪，“我想带你周游地星，想让你看看我的农场。”

郎沐也跟着笑：“我对你的农场也挺好奇的。”

“我想请你吃烤牛肉，卤牛肉，红烧牛肉，爆炒牛柳。贼好吃！”

“看来你对自己培育的牛很有自信？”

“那是！”

商非凡忍不住把自己的农场跟郎沐好好介绍了一遍，吹嘘自己培育出来的牛马羊有多好多好，又说自己新种了一种麦子。

商非凡真的很想把自己另一边的生活分享给郎沐，不止是分享，更想要郎沐也参与。

郎沐听得也十分向往。

商非凡揽着郎沐：“这些，我都可以搬来和你一起做。我在地星那边可以做这些，在这里也可以和你做这些。你看，我有野心没错，但我同样能做好一个农夫。和我在一起，你能过上自己最想要的生活。你想要什么样的生活，我们就过什么样的日子，我很能干的，不会的也可以学。”

郎沐捏着他的手指：“你这是在勾引我？”

商非凡：“是啊。”

两人说说笑笑，又聊到神格碎片，商非凡就觉得郎沐体内的那枚神格碎片很没有用。

“身为神格碎片，竟然还能让别人夺取宿主的气运，你说你顶着个神格碎片的名头有什么用？”

听到商非凡的逼叨叨，郎沐就觉得心口有点发热。

“呃，它说它带着我的灵魂从地星穿越到天河星就已经耗费了绝大部分的能量，之后只能陷入沉睡。但就算这样，它还是保住了我的气运根本。后来它稍微恢复一点能量后，我再次身死，它不得不耗费能量再次带我穿越。等到了兽人大陆，也因为有它，才能让心之果和石耳主动投奔。它还说我第一世出生时身体不好，是它的到来提升了我的身体素质，否则我小时候会过得病歪歪。”

郎沐忍笑，把神格碎片的抱怨说了出来。

商非凡挑眉：“就问它，如果没有它，你第一世会死得那么早吗？同样，如果它带着你第一次魂穿，如果没有搞错着落点，落到了法德尔大陆，你会遇到洛伦米尔顿进而被人欺骗乃至掠夺气运吗？”

郎沐过了一会儿小声说：“你把它怼自闭了。”

商非凡冷笑：“没用的东西！”

郎沐干咳：“它说等它恢复力量，它可以帮我夺回被夺走的气运值。不过需要先在对方身上建立一个联系，好形成通道。如果能恢复共运契约最好。”

商非凡变色，断然道：“不行。不能和洛伦米尔顿那个人渣恢复共运契约，就算是为了夺回你的气运也不行。我不是吃醋，而是你的气运才恢复一点，而那个人渣的能力……谁也不知道他是否会借此继续掠夺你的气运，或者利用你做什么。”

郎沐看商非凡此地无银三百两，再次忍笑，不过有件事还是需要说出来的：“神格碎片说我和洛伦米尔顿之间的共运契约并没有断干净。”

“没有断干净？怎么会没有断干净？第二世的你都死了一遍。”商非凡那脸色跟要杀人似得。

郎沐也不是很了解，询问神格碎片后才回复：“神格碎片说洛伦米尔顿只切断了他的气运流向我，但并没有切断我的气运流向他。可能和他始终没有把我身上的气运全部夺取过去有关。”

商非凡差点气炸：“这是灵魂契约？”

郎沐尴尬，点头：“是。”

商非凡忍着怒意，“要怎么彻底断开？不止是断开，我要这个共运契约半点痕迹都不能留下！”

郎沐沉默片刻，回答：“神格碎片说想要彻底抹消这个共运契约，必须彻底杀死洛伦米尔顿。但因为共运契约的存在，我不死，洛伦米尔顿也很难死得干净。”

郎沐一顿：“所以必须先夺回我被夺取的气运，再反掠夺洛伦米尔顿的，然后彻底切断共运契约的通道，再杀死洛伦米尔顿。”

商非凡深吸气：“说起来简单，但操作起来时间太长，而且很容易出现各种变故。问问它，还有没有其他更简单的方法，比如我和你重新结一个共运契约。”

郎沐脸上表情几乎消失，这次他沉默得更久。

他不想再和别人结契，任何灵魂类的契约都不愿意。

他不希望再被人束缚，同样也不希望靠灵魂契约去束缚别人。

商非凡沉沉地盯着郎沐，他怎么可能不知道郎沐在想什么。

“阿沐，不要隐瞒我。你不告诉我，我也可以问系统。”

郎沐避开商非凡的目光，淡淡说道：“神格碎片说只要我和你结下更高等的灵魂契约，就可以利用魔法世界的最基础法则之力，公平法则，来彻底毁掉我和洛伦米尔顿之间的共运契约。”

商非凡心中一动：“对，魔法师讲究等价交换原则，但洛伦米尔顿和你之间的共运契约，却只是他单方面掠夺你的气运，这已经违反了契约的最根本原则。但他仍旧能成功，一定是用什么东西压制了契约反噬。”

郎沐摇头：“他只是钻了空子，我曾自愿说出把自己的运气都给他。”

“是，你说了。但如果对方是欺诈，那结果将完全不同。”商非凡脑子转得飞快。

“所以我需要和你缔结更高法则的契约。这就像民间契约很多都不公平，但很多人都忍了，因为诉讼过程繁琐、聘请律师价格昂贵，耗费时间也长，而最后的审判结果也很难说就一定会利于自己。

但如果真的诉讼，严格按照法律条文来审核民间契约的内容，尤其抓住契约内容是否公平这一条，那么吃亏者胜诉的可能就非常大。不说赔偿，至少可以从法律层面强行解除契约。”
