Chapter 198: Straightforward (Part 1)

Insect King Josiedoyle had already noticed this person the moment Ares Shang stepped into the grand hall.

The man's bearing was utterly brazen; not even the most arrogant playboy in the Eastern Tribes carried himself with such swagger.

Coincidentally, Ares Shang's gaze landed squarely upon him.

As the king of the Insectoid Tribe, Josiedoyle naturally possessed his own pride, yet meeting Ares Shang's look, he still offered a subtle nod.

To his surprise, the young male beastman walked straight toward him.

If there was one thing hardest to manage at such large-scale conferences, aside from security, it was undoubtedly the seating arrangements.

Deciding who sat at the front, who sat at the back, or even who sat in the center versus the flanks was enough to provoke dissatisfaction from certain individuals.

The First Prince bore full responsibility for all matters concerning this conference, and he had wrung his brains dry over the seating chart, coming close to losing all his hair from stress. Later, upon receiving a hint from Clement, he simply abandoned assigning seats altogether, letting the attendees choose wherever they pleased—sit wherever you like.

Unlike past events, the seating layout within the grand hall was circular, stripped of any primary or secondary distinctions. Using the central podium as the focal point, the seats radiated outward in successive rings.

Regarding the Tiger Kingdom's seating arrangement, a few high-ranking heavyweights who valued status and prestige murmured discontentedly, but the majority of leaders felt the setup was remarkably refreshing. If they ever hosted events in the future, they could certainly adopt a similar approach.

The arriving leaders simply sat wherever caught their fancy, without even needing to separate from their own retinues.

At similar gatherings in the past, standard protocol dictated that top leaders and their partners sat at the front, while the accompanying officials and guards were relegated to the rear or barred from entering the venue entirely.

Today’s venue, however, adopted a system where the holders of the invitation letters could freely choose who to bring inside—as long as the total head count did not exceed six, they could bring whomever they wished.

Some leaders with close ties even chose to sit clustered together, making it exceptionally convenient to gather information, chat, and shoot the breeze.

Of course, certain high-status dignitaries who prided themselves on their rank or preferred not to mingle with others still chose to sit in the front row, while their entourages filtered into the seats directly behind them without daring to usurp the front-row spots.

Josiedoyle, for his part, had chosen the fifth row—a position neither too far forward nor too far back.

The six individuals he brought with him surrounded him in a tight semicircle.

Ares Shang walked right up to Josiedoyle, offered a faint smile, and proactively saluted, "Good day, Your Majesty the Insect King. I am Ares Shang, a freelance alchemist."

Normally, anyone attempting to approach Josiedoyle would have been intercepted by his fiercely loyal bodyguards.

However, Josiedoyle had signaled beforehand, instructing his guards not to block this young male beastman; he wanted to see what this youngster was after.

"Good day." Josiedoyle responded casually, his gaze sweeping over Lang Mu, whose unremarkable features were styled to look like a standard, loyal bodyguard.

Lang Mu remained silent, perfectly enacting the template of a devoted retainer.

Josiedoyle turned over Ares Shang's identity in his mind, having no recollection of ever hearing this name. Yet anyone capable of entering this venue today was either a leader of various races or a master-class figure across various industries; mediocrities simply could not gain entry.

Furthermore, Ares Shang's personal demeanor and aura did not resemble someone who had snuck in illicitly.

As the king of the Insectoid race, Josiedoyle considered himself quite confident in his ability to discern talent.

Ares Shang gave neither side a chance for an awkward silence, quickly continuing, "I prefer not to beat around the bush, so I'll get straight to the point: I rather fancy the gem pendant hanging from Your Majesty's waist. I wonder if Your Majesty would be willing to part with it? In exchange, I am more than willing to offer a treasure of equivalent value."

Josiedoyle let out a dry laugh; it was his first time encountering someone so brazen, especially when the person knew full well they were addressing an Insect King.

Normally, anyone stepping before him—let alone discussing a direct transaction—would tremble in sheer terror just trying to report a matter.

Josiedoyle couldn't help wondering if he was suddenly projecting an exceptionally easygoing aura today.

"You've got quite the nerve."

"Thank you, many people say so." Ares Shang accepted the remark with unperturbed calm.

Josiedoyle: *I wasn't complimenting you.*

The guard behind him shifted slightly, but Josiedoyle raised a hand marginally, halting the subordinate.

A few people nearby glanced over or quietly pricked up their ears, clearly paying attention to their conversation.

Especially the Tiger Kingdom dignitaries who recognized Ares Shang; they couldn't help clicking their tongues in private awe at the sheer audacity of this master alchemist, who actually dared to proposition the King of the Insectoids directly.

The notoriety of the Insectoid Tribe was widespread and deeply rooted.

Ever since the Insect Queen led mutant insectoid swarms to invade the Dou Qi Continent, the lives of the Insectoid race had grown rather difficult, with many of them facing ostracization or even being treated with suspicion as spies.

It wasn't until the Insectoids officially joined the battles against the mutant insectoids—suffering heavy casualties in the process—that the other races gradually began to shift their perception of them.

Even so, the rift between the Insectoid race and other races remained. Over eight hundred years of history had failed to completely erode this divide; instead, bizarre occurrences—such as insectoid curses and the prohibition against burying dead insectoids in the soil—only served to worsen relations between the Insectoids and the rest of the world.

Some beastmen even clamored for the complete expulsion of the Insectoids from the Dou Qi Continent.

If the Insectoid race had been easy to bully or possessed weak dispositions, they would likely have abandoned the Dou Qi Continent long ago.

Yet not only did they refuse to leave, but they also seized a massive swath of territory in the Eastern region, establishing themselves as one of the two largest tribes in the East.

Their main rival in the East, locked in a fierce, balanced struggle with the Insectoid Tribe, was the Eastern Tribe.

As the name suggested, the Eastern Tribe harbored immense ambitions. Successive leaders of the Eastern Tribe had always sought to unify the entire East, but the presence of a powerful rival like the Insectoid Tribe perpetually thwarted their ambitions of true unification.

Furthermore, the Insectoid territory directly bordered the Hundred Clans Battlefield. Rumor had it that every insectoid coming of age was thrown into the Hundred Clans Battlefield to undergo brutal trials; those who failed to survive were deemed unworthy of being called true members of the insectoid race.

Consequently, the Insectoids were fiercely combative. Anyone daring to provoke them had better prepare themselves to be viciously bitten back.

An Insectoid Tribe possessing such strength could be counted among the premier superpowers across the entire Dou Qi Continent, and their primary impression on outsiders was that they were not to be trifled with.

Their leader, Insect King Josiedoyle, was practically demonized in rumors, reputed to be a terrifying existence in the East capable of stopping crying children at night.

Many had assumed Josiedoyle would not personally attend this Heritage Sharing Conference, making his actual arrival a surprise.

It was precisely because word spread that Josiedoyle would personally travel to the Tiger Kingdom's capital that the Grand Chieftain of the Eastern Tribe abruptly altered his plans, deciding to make the trip in person as well.

When the leaders of several other major factions learned that the two heavyweights from the Eastern region were both attending personally, they all discarded their original intentions of sending deputies or heirs, opting instead to attend themselves.

All in all, Josiedoyle sat right there, and though many recognized him, hardly anyone dared to approach him for a greeting.

As for those qualified to address him, they either hadn't arrived yet or hadn't had the chance to make their way over.

Josiedoyle unlatched the gemstone pendant from his waist, casually swinging it back and forth. "Is this what you've set your sights on?"

Ares Shang: "It is."

Josiedoyle's expression cooled. "You have quite an eye."

Ares Shang stated proudly, "My eye for things has always been exceptional."

"Do you know what special significance this gemstone holds for me?" The tone was tantamount to a flat refusal.

Yet Ares Shang acted as though he hadn't caught the implication at all. "A spatial bracelet, with a capacity reaching thirty cubic meters."

Josiedoyle's pupils contracted slightly.

This offer was by no means low; in fact, it far exceeded the value of the gemstone pendant he carried.

"You possess a spatial bracelet? And you're willing to trade it just for this gem pendant?" Josiedoyle felt a trace of incredulity.

Could this Ares Shang be trying to curry favor with him, resorting to such a clumsy method of offering gifts?

Ares Shang smiled faintly. "I consider myself a minor alchemist who is rather proficient in the refinement of spatial storage artifacts."

chunks.chineseText:
意思就是别多想，在你们这些人眼中看来珍贵无比的空储对我来说也就是换一个心头好的交换物而已。

乔西道尔眸色不明，他心中偏向于达成这项交易，但又有点摸不清这个阿瑞斯商的底细。

“这枚宝石对本王很重要。”乔西道尔再次表明。

阿瑞斯商：“可以请教它对陛下的重要之处在哪里吗？”

乔西道尔冷下脸：“你胆子很大，也很无礼。”

这就表示本王生气了，你可以滚蛋了。

阿瑞斯商却一脸无畏地说：“陛下觉得我无礼，无非是觉得我是个小人物，不配站在您面前和您谈条件。”

乔西道尔冷笑：“哦，看来你也很清楚这点。”

阿瑞斯商特别拽地轻轻一笑：“既然交易不成，那我们就换一种方式吧。我挑战您，我赢，您把那枚宝石腰坠赠予我。我输，我把三十立方容量的空间手镯赠予您。您看如何？”

不如何！乔西道尔还没有反应，他身边的人就被这个年轻雄兽的大胆给惊住，更感到愤怒。

这是什么人，竟然敢挑战他们的王！

乔西道尔现在特别想一巴掌拍死眼前的年轻雄兽。

他欣赏大胆勇敢的年轻人，但勇敢不代表鲁莽和没数。

他甚至猜测这名年轻雄兽是不是他的敌人派来故意在这种场合下他面子，或单纯就是为了看他笑话。

也许还有其他阴谋……

乔西道尔越想越深。

阿瑞斯商转头无奈地对他的贴身护卫说：“这位陛下现在肯定想到什么阴谋诡计上了。我真的就只是想要交易那枚宝石挂坠而已。”

声音很大，附近的人都听到了，自然也包括虫王陛下。

“陛下日安。”一道清冷的声音插-入进来。

“这位炼金大师在我们虎国王城相当有名，他就是这样狂妄的人，仗着自己有一手出神入化的炼金术，对我们这些王室成员从来不放在眼中，对我父王也没有多少尊重，倒也不是有意对陛下无礼。”

这话说得槽多无口，让听到的人都搞不清楚这位虎国王女是在为阿瑞斯商解围，还是想故意借此机会狠踩他一脚。

大公主玛瓦扫向阿瑞斯商和他身边带着的护卫，嘴角翘起不明笑意，又说：“这位大师除了对一个人舔狗，那是谁都看不上。”

“拉斐尔没跟你一起回来？”大公主问。

阿瑞斯商撇嘴：“不劳你关心。你们家的人离我家阿沐越远越好。”

大公主眼色流转：“你身边这个护卫看起来很陌生。不过你的口味似乎就没变过，就喜欢这种……”

阿瑞斯商冷下脸：“不会说话就别说话，没人当你是哑巴。”

大公主脸色不好看，这家伙是真不客气，也是真的没把虎国王室放在眼中。

“别忘了你今天是拿着谁发给你的邀请函过来。”大公主隐隐警告。

阿瑞斯商从鼻子里发出嗤笑，特别吊炸天地说：“拽什么拽？你们今天能发出邀请函又是靠的谁？要不是我家阿沐对当王没兴趣，你们以为今天能轮得到你们来召开这个传承分享大会。”

大公主一听这话，脸色就拉了下来。

阿瑞斯商得理不饶人：“也就是我家阿沐好说话，半个铜达铢都没要，免费把那座千年前图书馆里的无数传承都转让给你们。要是换了我，谁想进去先付十万金进门费！想抄录带走？一字十金，一图千金。”

周围的人：嚯！大瓜！

乔西道尔原本不愉的神色也变得兴致勃勃，他自然不会认为堂堂虎国王女，还是那位狮域大都督的弟子会和阿瑞斯商合谋来捧阿瑞斯商。

也就是说，这个阿瑞斯商是真的本色演出，也是真的有本事，否则也不可能不给虎国王女半点面子，还能说出这样狂妄的话。

乔西道尔对身后一人做了手势，让人去打听那个拉斐尔阿沐是谁，还有这个阿瑞斯商又是什么来历。

我就不该来给你解围，就应该让你被虫人族当场打死。大公主在心里狠骂。

阿瑞斯商不屑：你是来帮我解围的吗？你根本就是想借此机会骂我还想我感谢你。哦，顺便也是不想大会还没开始就多生事端。

“玛瓦！”狮域大都督来了。

大公主都要忍不住变身挥爪，听到大都督的喝声才将将忍住。

她以前知道这个阿瑞斯商不好惹，但她真的不知道这家伙这么让人……受不了！

所以这人会选择拉斐尔不是没有原因的，大概也就只有拉斐尔那样平和善忍的性子，才能吃得消这个混蛋吧。

大公主心里记住这个人了，决定等今天大会结束，她就找这个家伙掂量掂量，看看他本人的实力是不是也跟他嘴皮子一样厉害。

阿瑞斯商收到大公主“你给我等着”的挑战眼神，丝毫没有放在眼里。

要不是这个大公主没有对阿沐做过什么，他早就把她诅咒得满头包。

看看三王子现在多倒霉，喝水呛水，吃饭噎嗓，出门就跌跤，进门就下跪，睡觉睡一半不是遇鬼就是床塌。

这也就是他不想弄死三王子才小惩大诫，否则……王后的下场看一看。

狮域大都督和虫王乔西道尔说了两句话，就带着大公主离开。

虫王的目光重新落到阿瑞斯商身上，突然说：“你身上的气息……你是虫人混血？”

阿瑞斯商通常会把自己身上的气息收敛得很好。

但就在刚才他有意无意地释放了一些，看起来就像是他受到大公主挑衅，情绪一时控制不住才导致气息泄露。

阿瑞斯商淡淡说：“我是不是虫人很重要吗？”

虫王眸色变得深沉，如果他刚才没有感知错误，他似乎感知到一点虫母的力量？

任何虫人族，包括虫族在内，对于虫母都具有天生的畏惧和亲昵心，也能本能感知到属于虫母的能量。

不！

这根本不可能。

虫母已经离开兽人大陆，更不可能在兽人大陆留下她的血脉和力量。

除非……

虫王想到了一个可能。

这个可能也算是虫人族留下来的传说。

传说虫母在率领变异虫族和兽人大陆各族大战时，曾受到重创。

她的心脏被人炸伤，一半心脏被炸成碎片，四散飞溅。

如果换了普通虫人，心脏被炸没了一半，人肯定也会死翘翘，但虫母不但没死，还能在如此重伤下保护手下撤离。

而虫母那被炸飞出去的一半心脏碎片则成了所有虫人族和虫族都想得到的重宝。

当时据说有幸运儿得到了一小块碎片，但也不知道是不是其身体无法承受那么磅礴的力量，竟然在等级飞升后全身自爆了开来。

之后这些心脏碎片就毫无下落。

虽然这么多年来时不时会听到一些传言，说有谁疑似得到了虫母心脏碎片的东西，可一不能消化吸收，二不能融合，就算勉强融合的也会被炸成碎片。

往往虫人族按照消息寻找过去时，发现不是假消息，就是东西又已经不见踪影。
chunks.englishText:
"What I mean is, don't overthink it. In the eyes of people like you, a priceless spatial storage device is nothing more than a bargaining chip for me to acquire something that pleases my heart."

Ares Shang's eyes flickered with an unreadable expression. In his heart, he leaned toward concluding this transaction, yet he couldn't quite figure out the true background of this Ares Shang.

"This gemstone is very important to Us," Josiedol stated once more.

Ares Shang asked, "May I ask where its importance to Your Majesty lies?"

Josiedol's face turned cold: "You are very bold, and extremely impolite."

*That means We are angry, and you can scram.*

Yet, Ares Shang replied with a fearless expression, "If Your Majesty finds me impolite, it's simply because you view me as a nobody, unworthy of standing before you and negotiating terms."

Josiedol sneered, "Oh, it seems you are well aware of that fact."

Ares Shang let out a light, devil-may-care chuckle. "Since the trade cannot be made, let's change our approach. I challenge you. If I win, you gift me that gemstone waist pendant. If I lose, I gift you a thirty-cubic-meter spatial bracelet. How does that sound?"

Not at all! Before Josiedol could react, those beside him were stunned by the young male beast's audacity, followed swiftly by intense anger.

What kind of person was this, daring to challenge their King!

Right now, Josiedol desperately wanted to slap the young male beast before him into a pulp.

He appreciated bold and courageous youths, but bravery did not equate to recklessness and a lack of boundaries.

He even suspected whether this young male beast was sent by his enemies to deliberately make him lose face on such an occasion, or simply to make a fool of him.

Perhaps there were other conspiracies at play...

The deeper Josiedol thought, the more suspicious he became.

Ares Shang turned his head and said helplessly to his personal guard, "His Majesty here is undoubtedly cooking up all sorts of dark conspiracies right now. I honestly just want to trade for that gemstone pendant."

His voice was loud enough for everyone nearby to hear, naturally including His Majesty the Insect King.

"Good day, Your Majesty." A cold, crisp voice cut into the conversation.

"This alchemy master is quite famous in our Tiger Kingdom. He is just this arrogant, relying on his unfathomable alchemy skills to never hold us royal family members in his eyes, nor showing much respect for my royal father. It's not as if he deliberately means to be rude to Your Majesty."

There were so many flaws in those words that anyone listening would be hard-pressed to tell whether the Tiger Kingdom's Eldest Princess was bailing Ares Shang out or intentionally using the opportunity to trample him hard.

The Eldest Princess Mawa swept her gaze toward Ares Shang and the guard he had brought along, the corners of her lips curling into an ambiguous smile as she added, "Aside from acting like a bootlicking dog toward one specific person, this master looks down on everyone else."

"Didn't Raphael come back with you?" the Eldest Princess asked.

Ares Shang curled his lip. "Don't trouble yourself with concern. The further people from your household stay away from my A-Mu, the better."

The Eldest Princess's gaze shifted. "This guard by your side looks rather unfamiliar. However, your tastes seem never to have changed—you just love this type..."

Ares Shang's face went cold. "If you don't know how to speak, then don't speak. No one is treating you as a mute."

The Eldest Princess's expression turned ugly. This fellow was truly unbridled, genuinely not holding the Tiger Kingdom's royal family in any regard.

"Don't forget whose invitation letter you used to get in here today," the Eldest Princess warned veiledly.

Ares Shang let out a snort from his nose, radiating supreme swagger as he said, "What are you acting so high and mighty for? Whose backing allowed you to issue those invitation letters in the first place? If my A-Mu hadn't lacked any interest in becoming King, do you think it would've been your turn to host this heritage-sharing convention today?"

Upon hearing this, the Eldest Princess's face instantly darkened.

Ares Shang pressed his advantage mercilessly. "It's only because my A-Mu is soft-hearted that he didn't demand even half a Tonda pearl, transferring the countless heritages from that millennium-old library to you completely free of charge. If it were up to me, anyone who wanted to enter would first pay a ten-thousand-gold entry fee! Want to transcribe and take it away? Ten gold per character, a thousand gold per diagram!"

The surrounding crowd: *Whoa! A massive piece of juicy gossip!*

Josiedol’s originally displeased expression turned intrigued. Naturally, he wouldn't believe that the dignified Eldest Princess of the Tiger Kingdom—who was also a disciple of the Lion Domain's Grand Governor—would collude with Ares Shang just to prop him up.

In other words, this Ares Shang was truly acting as his authentic self, and he genuinely possessed real skills; otherwise, he could never afford to show the Tiger Kingdom's Eldest Princess zero respect while uttering such arrogant words.

Josiedol gestured to a subordinate behind him, ordering them to find out who this "Raphael A-Mu" was, as well as what background this Ares Shang hailed from.

*I shouldn't have come to bail you out; I should have let you be beaten to death on the spot by the Insect-folk,* the Eldest Princess cursed fiercely in her heart.

Ares Shang felt nothing but disdain: *Are you here to bail me out? You simply wanted to use this opportunity to badmouth me while expecting me to thank you. Oh, and incidentally, you also didn't want any trouble stirred up before the convention even started.*

"Mawa!" The Grand Governor of the Lion Domain had arrived.

The Eldest Princess almost couldn't help transforming and unsheathing her claws, managing to restrain herself only upon hearing the Grand Governor's stern shout.

She had known before that this Ares Shang was not someone to be trifled with, but she truly had no idea that this fellow was so utterly... infuriating!

So there was a reason why this guy chose Raphael; probably only someone with Raphael's peaceful and extraordinarily tolerant temperament could endure such a bastard!

The Eldest Princess locked this person deep in her memory, deciding that once today's convention concluded, she would find this fellow and test his mettle, seeing if his personal strength was just as formidable as his sharp tongue.

Ares Shang received the Eldest Princess's "you just wait" challenging glare and didn't care in the least.

If this Eldest Princess hadn't ultimately refrained from doing anything truly harmful to A-Mu, he would have already cursed her until her entire head was covered in boils.

Look at how miserably the Third Prince was currently suffering: choking on water when drinking, choking on his throat when eating, falling the moment he stepped out the door, kneeling the moment he stepped inside, and whenever he slept half the night, he would either encounter ghosts or have his bed collapse.

That was only because he didn't want to kill the Third Prince and merely gave him a minor punishment; otherwise... just look at the Empress's end.

The Grand Governor of the Lion Domain exchanged a few words with Insect King Josiedol before leading the Eldest Princess away.

The Insect King's gaze fell back onto Ares Shang as he suddenly remarked, "The aura on you... are you a half-blood insect-person?"

Ares Shang usually kept his aura meticulously concealed.

Yet just moments ago, he had intentionally or unintentionally released a trace of it—appearing as though he had been provoked by the Eldest Princess and lost emotional control for a moment, causing his aura to leak.

Ares Shang said calmly, "Does it matter whether I am an insect-person or not?"

The Insect King's eyes deepened. If his senses hadn't failed him just now, it seemed he had perceived a trace of the Queen Mother's power?

Any insect-folk, including the Zerg race, harbored an innate fear and affection for the Queen Mother, and could instinctively perceive energy belonging to her.

No!

That was simply impossible.

The Queen Mother had already left the Beastman Continent, and it was even more impossible for her to have left behind her bloodline and power within the Beastman Continent.

Unless...

The Insect King thought of a possibility.

A possibility that could be considered an enduring legend among the insect-folk.

Legend had it that when the Queen Mother led the mutated Zerg and the various races of the Beastman Continent in a great war, she had suffered devastating injuries.

Her heart had been blasted by an attack, shattering half of it into countless flying fragments.

For an ordinary insect-person, having half their heart blown away would undoubtedly mean instant death, but not only did the Queen Mother survive, she even managed to protect her subordinates' retreat under such severe injuries.

And those fragments of the Queen Mother's blasted heart became supreme treasures coveted by every single member of the insect-folk and Zerg race.

It was said that at the time, some lucky individual managed to obtain a small fragment, but whether it was because their body couldn't withstand such a majestic surge of power, they actually suffered a total bodily explosion once their tier soared.

Afterwards, those heart fragments vanished completely without a trace.

Although rumors would surface from time to time over the years claiming that someone had supposedly acquired a piece of the Queen Mother's heart, they could neither digest nor absorb it; and even those who forced a fusion were blasted into pieces.

Whenever the insect-folk tracked down these rumors, they invariably found them to be either false leads or discovered that the object had vanished once again.

chunks.chineseText:
传说如果有人能真正融合或吸收虫母的心脏碎片，那其本身也一定会携带虫母的部分力量，从而让虫族和虫人族产生臣服感。

乔西道尔好歹也是虫王，他倒是没有因为那一点点泄露的气息就产生臣服感，但他也确实感知到了像是虫母的力量。

虫王定定看了阿瑞斯商好一会儿。

阿瑞斯商神色淡定，任由他看。

进入会场的人越来越多。

虫王和阿瑞斯商这边引来不少人注目。

虫王心中思量几许，压低声音对阿瑞斯商说：“我可以把这枚宝石腰坠交易给你，不过空间手镯必须要达到一百立方以上的容量。另外，我还需要你三滴精血。”

虫母心脏不易融合，一旦融合更不可能取出。

虫王非常清楚虫母心脏能量的特殊性，他知道如果阿瑞斯商真的融合了虫母心脏，那么除非他自愿，他就是把阿瑞斯商抓起来榨干他全身血液也不可能得到一丝虫母力量。

搞不好还会引阿瑞斯商自爆。

再说，他也不敢保证自己真的能擒下这个阿瑞斯商。

之前他觉得这就是个狂妄且没数的年轻人，但刚才他跟狮域大都督交谈中得知，就连那位大都督都觉得这个阿瑞斯商的实力深不可测。

否则就凭他会炼制空间道具、身后还没有靠山这一点，他岂能安安稳稳在虎国王城待到现在？

实际上，自从阿瑞斯商在拍卖会拍出空间道具，打他主意的人就络绎不绝，有人来明的，有人来暗的。

但不管明的暗的，最后全都无功而返。

要不然阿瑞斯商掀翻了一个子爵和一个大商人的家族，竟无人敢找他算账。

那两个家族总也有些姻亲吧？

王后感到被打脸，总是会出手吧？

可这些全都无声无息地消失，阿瑞斯商始终活蹦乱跳，最后还大摇大摆地和郎家人一起离开，如今又大摇大摆地回来。

阿瑞斯商似乎感到有点无趣，撇撇嘴，慵懒地说：“陛下你这要求太高，我觉得我可能无法接受。既然您这么喜欢那枚宝石，那您就自己留着吧。”

说完，阿瑞斯商竟然转身就走。

虫王陛下：“……”这什么人哪！

懂不懂什么叫谈判？

我漫天要价，你不能坐地还价？

竟然一言不合就走人，有你这么做交易的吗？

虫王手痒，再次想要一巴掌拍死那个离开的嚣张纨绔。

自他接手王位后，他还是第一次遇到这么不给他面子的人。

有和虫王熟识的大佬过来和虫王说话。

“那个年轻人是哪家的？看起来比东部落那个第一继承人还拽。”

“不知道是哪里来的。据他自己说，就是一个自由炼金师。”

“自由炼金师敢不把你这位虫王放在眼里？”

“你这位南方第二大佬要是对他好奇，可以自己去试试。”

“哈！算了，我看东部落那位第一继承人似乎对那位自由炼金师很感兴趣，我就不过去凑热闹了。对了，那小子找你什么事？”

虫王不答反问：“你们盟主怎么没来？”

“他原本想要亲自过来，不过在出发时遇到一点事……”南方联盟的次盟主大概不想谈及此事，转换话题：“你知道虎国为什么能得到这么多传承吗？”

“因为他们发掘了一座千年前的图书馆，那图书馆还就在虎国所属的黑森林城地底下。”虫王也不禁感叹虎国的运气。

南方联盟次盟主神色微妙：“那你知道那座图书馆就是虎王也不能随意进入，只能由一个特定人选带领吗？”

“哦？这个特定人选是谁？”

“你刚才也听到他的名字了。”

“拉斐尔阿沐？”

“不，他叫拉斐尔郎沐，也是那名炼金大师阿瑞斯商的爱人。”
chunks.englishText:
Legend stated that if anyone could truly fuse with or absorb a fragment of the Queen Mother's heart, they would inevitably carry a portion of her power within them, thereby commanding absolute submission from the Zerg and insect-folk.

Josiedol was an Insect King, after all. He didn't fall into a state of absolute submission from that tiny leak of aura, but he had indeed sensed something akin to the Queen Mother's power.

The Insect King stared fixedly at Ares Shang for a long moment.

Ares Shang maintained a calm and composed expression, letting him look.

More and more people were entering the venue.

The Insect King and Ares Shang's standoff drew the gaze of quite a few onlookers.

After weighing his thoughts, the Insect King lowered his voice and said to Ares Shang, "I can trade that gemstone waist pendant to you, but the spatial bracelet must have a capacity of over one hundred cubic meters. In addition, I also need three drops of your vital blood."

The Queen Mother's heart was not easily fused with, and once fused, it was even more impossible to extract.

The Insect King was well aware of the special nature of the Queen Mother's heart energy; he knew that if Ares Shang had truly fused with it, then short of his voluntary consent, even if he captured Ares Shang and squeezed him dry of every drop of blood, he would never extract even a shred of the Queen Mother's power.

Worse still, it might even trigger Ares Shang to detonate himself.

Besides, he couldn't guarantee that he could actually capture this Ares Shang.

Previously, he had thought this was just an arrogant and reckless young upstart, but from his earlier conversation with the Lion Domain's Grand Governor, he learned that even that Grand Governor deemed Ares Shang's strength to be unfathomable.

Otherwise, just based on his ability to forge spatial artifacts and his lack of any powerful backing, how could he possibly have lived in peace and security within the Tiger Kingdom's capital until now?

In truth, ever since Ares Shang auctioned off his spatial artifacts, people eyeing him had been endless—some coming openly, some in the shadows.

Yet regardless of whether their methods were overt or covert, they had all returned empty-handed.

Otherwise, how could Ares Shang have overturned the families of a viscount and a major merchant without a single soul daring to call him to account?

Those two families surely had some marital alliances, right?

The Queen would have felt slighted and stepped in, wouldn't she?

Yet all of them vanished quietly into thin air, while Ares Shang remained as lively as ever, eventually strutting away with the Lang family, only to strut right back in today.

Ares Shang seemed to find this somewhat tedious. He curled his lip and said lazily, "Your Majesty, your demands are simply too high; I'm afraid I cannot accept them. Since you like that gemstone so much, you might as well keep it for yourself."

With that, Ares Shang actually turned around and walked away.

His Majesty the Insect King: "..." What kind of person is this?!

Does he even understand what negotiation is?

I throw out an exorbitant demand, and you aren't even going to counter-offer?

He just walks away over a disagreement—is that any way to conduct a trade?

The Insect King's palms itched, and once again, he felt a powerful urge to slap the departing, arrogant prodigal son to death.

Ever since he inherited the throne, this was the first time he had ever encountered someone who showed him such utter disregard.

A heavyweight figure familiar with the Insect King walked over to strike up a conversation.

"Whose family does that young man belong to? He looks even more unbridled than the First Heir of the Eastern Tribe."

"No idea where he crawled out from. According to his own words, he's just a free alchemist."

"A free alchemist dares to look down upon you, the Insect King?"

"If you, the Southern Alliance's second-in-command, are so curious about him, you can go try him out yourself."

"Ha! Forget it. I see that First Heir of the Eastern Tribe seems quite interested in that free alchemist, so I won't go over and crowd the scene. By the way, what did that brat want with you?"

Instead of answering, the Insect King asked, "Why didn't your Alliance Master come?"

"He originally wanted to come in person, but he ran into a minor issue right as he was setting out..." The Southern Alliance's vice-master presumably didn't wish to dwell on the matter and changed the subject. "Do you know why the Tiger Kingdom managed to obtain so much heritage?"

"Because they excavated a millennium-old library, and that library happens to be right underneath the Black Forest City belonging to the Tiger Kingdom." The Insect King couldn't help marveling at the Tiger Kingdom's sheer luck.

The Southern Alliance's vice-master wore a subtle expression. "Then do you know that even the Tiger King cannot enter that library at will, and can only do so when led by a specific designated individual?"

"Oh? And who might this specific designated individual be?"

"You just heard his name a moment ago."

"Raphael A-Mu?"

"No, his name is Raphael Lang Mu, and he is also the lover of that alchemy master, Ares Shang."

chunks.chineseText:
第199章 大会议事

大王子代表虎王出现的时候，会议厅里产生微微骚动，有人发出嗤笑，也有人直接发出阴阳怪气的哼声，但看在传承的面子上，暂时还没有人做出让大王子下不来台的事情。

大王子环视整个大殿，就见原本排列整齐的座位如今变成了自由集会一般，来宾们全都东一簇西一簇，移动椅子按照自己喜好坐在一起。

不过这种情况也能看出来哪些势力彼此间交好，哪些势力是对头。

交好的势力大多坐得比较靠近，或者是坐在同一片区域。如果关系不好的，哪怕势力的地理位置再接近，这会儿座位也会相隔几重，恨不得见不到对方的人才好。

兽人们不习惯搞多余花俏，在简单又正式的开场白后，大会便迅速进入议题。

来宾们也都还算安静地听大王子在台上说话。

大王子心里很紧张，在刚走入大殿，走到中间讲台位置，面对四面八方那么多势力大佬或严厉或不屑或考校的神色，他的腿不禁有点发软。

如果不是他练习过许多次开场白，他都不敢保证自己说话声音不会颤抖和结巴。

好在，他还算体面地撑了下来。

说着说着，他的语音变得越来越稳定，头脑也跟着变得清醒。

“我知道诸位前来是想立刻看到传承，不过在这之前还有一件重要的事情需要在座所有人群策群力地决定。这件事诸位应该也已经心里有数，对，就是关于我兽人大陆即将遭受全大陆性质地理自然-灾害的事。”

大王子挺起胸膛，让自己的神色尽量严肃，环视众人。

“这件事在我们发现的图书馆中有预言壁画提示，同时真实的灾难，岩浆爆发也在黑森林城发生，只是当时有人处理及时，没有让岩浆流出地面造成更多伤害。不过黑森林城原本的地下古城也因此被岩浆淹没，如果有人不信，可以过去参观。”

“关于灾难和预言这块，有请圣山祭司宫的祭司帮忙补充，请！”

大殿一角站起一人，对方并没有走到中心讲台，而是站在原地直接说道：“我是圣山祭司宫特别派遣祭司梁润明。我不为任何事情做证明，只是说出圣山祭司宫知道的事实。”

“首先，经过祭司宫确认，虎国人拉斐尔郎沐发现千年前图书馆一事为真。该座图书馆不同于普通城市图书馆，它是我们的前辈专门针对灭绝型灾难而准备的兽人文明传承图书馆，里面包含着兽人出现之初至千年前的全部历史记载和所有文明传承。”

“图书馆里的文明传承包含神血血脉、魔血血脉的说明。神血天赋方面包含至今为止出现过的所有血脉天赋技能的说明、使用和培养方法，各套完整的神血天赋觉醒仪式，巨兽的觉醒仪式、培养和提升方法，全套职业技能开发、培养和使用知识。”

“炼金术方面包含从古至今各个派流的全套炼金术知识。阵法方面包含传送阵、空间阵在内的相关所有阵法知识。能量利用方面包含能量的感知、利用和转换。”

“另外还有伟大的科技之父战书桓先生开创，后人发现发明创造以及补充的全部科技知识。科技知识包含武器、生活器具、交通工具、交流工具、警备工具、医疗器械……”

在梁润明说到神血天赋觉醒仪式这一组词汇时，大殿中众人呼吸就陡然变重，有些人的面色甚至变得潮红，更有人挺直背脊，眼睛死死盯住梁祭司。

等到后面梁祭司表述得越多，大殿中众人的目光也越发明亮。

大王子在最中间高高的讲台上看得很清楚，不少兽人眼中都流露出明显的渴望和贪婪之色，就算能控制自己情绪的各势力大佬也都露出势在必得之色。

不过想到自己当初知道那座图书馆里都有哪些传承时，他的定力也没好到哪里去，大王子也能理解此时在座各位的心理。

“以上传承知识，虎国在发现后并没有打算私藏，而是决定广而告之，让全天下共同分享这份属于所有兽人的厚重传承。虎国这份为天下兽人着想的……”

梁润明一连给虎国送了很多顶高帽，把虎国的大义之心夸得天上有地下无。

而在座众兽人也不得不承认虎王确实够大度够大义。将心比心，换了他们自己，如果发现这样的宝贵传承，他们可真不一定能舍得透露出去，更别说和别人分享。

就算要分享，那也是自己先享用了最好的，利用传承把自己的势力发展起来，然后再以传承为诱饵，开始逐渐吞并和统一整个兽人大陆。

当然，虎王这样做，也是因为在传承的蜜糖下还隐藏着全大陆性质的自然-灾害，这个至关重要的问题需要所有人共同解决，在他一个人无力解决这个问题的情况下，他只能用传承来吸引各势力。

更不要说如果他不愿意，郎沐和商非凡肯定也不愿意把传承交给他。

不过这种事就不需要特别说明，也算是郎沐帮助虎王和虎国增加威望。

虎王本该在这时出现承受这份至高无上的荣誉，提升他的威望，从而一跃成为整个兽人大陆最有名、最令人敬仰的一代王者，但可惜……

商非凡对这种发展则十分满意。

郎沐对虎王感情复杂，宁愿自己吃亏也不愿弄死虎王。

商非凡就不一样了，他从一开始就不太看得上虎王，觉得这家伙做什么都无法做好，看似想要各处都照顾到，行事有着各种思量，实际上就是能力不足还心性不坚的典型失败者。

想要集权、想要把权力和土地从贵族手中收回来，这是一个正常王者都想要做的事情。

可虎王一边想要集权，一边又忌惮贵族手里的权力和武力，磨磨蹭蹭犹犹豫豫五十多年都没能把土地收回多少。用的方法也大多都是小道，想要靠联姻、交换利益等方式来让权贵主动让利。

国事上如此不给力，私德上也没能守得住。

私德守不住，如果能坚持红旗不倒政策，对外面的彩旗只是随便玩玩，那也不会闹出多大的事情。

可是一边想要王后的家族势力，一边又贪心情人的小意温柔。一边想要确保正统血脉，一边又想让私生子也能过得堂堂正正。一边笼络重要大臣，一边又自毁长城。

搞到最后众叛亲离，还被自己的情人差点害死，只能说活该。

反正，商非凡是非常不想要虎王来享受他家郎沐给其挣来的荣光，如今虎王身体弱到根本不能出现在人前，而大王子的威望和能力又不足以让他承担那份荣耀，对商非凡来说就是正正好。

梁祭司洋洋洒洒说了很多，全都是关于传承有多么丰富的描述，说得大殿中众兽人心潮彭拜，如果不是给祭司宫面子，恨不得马上就逼迫虎国赶快把这些传承都拿出来分了。

梁润明看大家情绪都被调动得差不多，这才语调一转，提到了预言和灾害。

Chapter 199: Grand Assembly Discussions

When the Eldest Princess appeared on behalf of the Tiger King, a slight commotion rippled through the conference hall. Some people let out mocking chuckles, while others emitted direct, sarcastic hums. However, out of regard for the upcoming heritage, no one went so far as to make things awkward enough to cause the Eldest Princess to lose face completely.

Scanning the grand hall, the Eldest Princess saw that the neatly arranged rows of seats had been rearranged into something resembling a free-form gathering. The guests were clustered in various small groups, having moved their chairs to sit together according to their personal preferences.

Yet this very arrangement made it glaringly obvious which factions were on friendly terms and which were sworn enemies.

Allied factions mostly sat close together or occupied the same zone. As for those with hostile relations—no matter how geographically close their territories might be—their seats were separated by multiple gaps, as if they wished nothing more than to never lay eyes on each other.

Beastmen were unaccustomed to superfluous flair. Following a simple yet formal opening speech, the assembly quickly transitioned to its agenda.

The guests listened with a reasonable degree of quiet as the Eldest Princess spoke from the stage.

Internally, the Eldest Princess was extremely nervous. The moment he had walked into the grand hall and strode to the central podium, facing the severe, disdainful, and scrutinizing gazes of powerful figures from all directions, his legs had practically turned to jelly.

Had he not practiced his opening remarks countless times, he wouldn't have dared to guarantee that his voice wouldn't tremble and stutter.

Fortunately, he managed to carry himself through with a semblance of dignity.

As he spoke on, his voice grew increasingly steady, and his mind cleared up in tandem.

"I know that everyone here has come hoping to witness the heritage immediately. However, before that, there is one critical matter that requires the collective wisdom and concerted effort of everyone present to decide. You should all have a fair idea of what this matter is by now. Yes, it concerns the continent-wide geographical and natural disaster that is about to befall our Beastman Continent."

The Eldest Princess puffed out his chest, striving to make his expression as solemn as possible as he swept his gaze across the crowd.

"Hints of this disaster were foretold in mural prophecies within the library we discovered, and the physical reality of it—a magma eruption—actually occurred in Black Forest City. Fortunately, timely intervention prevented the magma from breaching the surface and causing greater devastation. However, the ancient underground city beneath Black Forest City was consequently submerged by magma. If anyone doubts this, you are welcome to go inspect it yourselves."

"Regarding the disaster and the prophecies, we have invited a priest from the Sacred Mountain's Temple of Priests to provide supplementary explanations. Please!"

A figure stood up in a corner of the grand hall. Instead of walking up to the central podium, he remained where he was and spoke directly: "I am Liang Runming, a specially dispatched priest from the Sacred Mountain's Temple of Priests. I am not here to vouch for anyone; I am merely stating the facts known to the Temple of Priests."

"First, the Temple of Priests has verified that the discovery of a millennium-old library by the Tiger Kingdom's Raphael Lang Mu is entirely true. Unlike ordinary municipal libraries, this library was specifically prepared by our predecessors in anticipation of an extinction-level disaster. It is an assemblage library of beastman civilization heritage, containing complete historical records and all cultural legacies from the dawn of the beastmen up until a thousand years ago."

"The civilization heritage within the library includes detailed explanations of the Divine Blood and Demonic Blood lineages. Regarding Divine Blood talents, it encompasses explanations, usage methods, and cultivation techniques for every single bloodline talent skill that has ever manifested in history, complete sets of Divine Blood talent awakening rituals, beast awakening rituals along with their cultivation and enhancement methods, and comprehensive knowledge for developing, nurturing, and utilizing all occupational skills."

"In terms of alchemy, it contains the complete body of alchemical knowledge spanning all schools from antiquity to the present. In terms of array formations, it encompasses all knowledge related to array formations, including teleportation arrays and spatial arrays. In terms of energy utilization, it covers the perception, utilization, and conversion of energy."

"Furthermore, it holds all technological knowledge pioneered by the great Father of Technology, Zhan Shuhuan, along with subsequent inventions, creations, and expansions by later generations. This technological knowledge includes weaponry, household appliances, means of transportation, communication devices, security tools, and medical instruments..."

When Liang Runming uttered the phrase "Divine Blood talent awakening rituals," the breathing of everyone in the grand hall abruptly turned ragged. Some people's complexions even flushed scarlet, while others straightened their spines, locking their eyes relentlessly onto Priest Liang.

As Priest Liang detailed more and more thereafter, the gazes of the people in the grand hall grew increasingly blazing.

Standing high upon the central podium, the Eldest Princess could see it all too clearly. Countless beastmen revealed expressions of undisguised yearning and greed in their eyes, and even the powerful figures from various factions who managed to control their emotions wore looks of absolute determination to secure these treasures.

Yet, recalling his own lack of composure when he first learned what heritages were housed in that library, the Eldest Princess could well understand the psychological state of everyone present.

"Upon discovering these heritage knowledge bases, the Tiger Kingdom had no intention of keeping them secret. Instead, we have chosen to broadcast them far and wide, allowing the entire world to jointly share this profound heritage belonging to all beastmen. The Tiger Kingdom's magnanimity for the sake of beastmen everywhere..."

Priest Liang heaped one glorious title after another onto the Tiger Kingdom, praising its noble-mindedness as towering to the heavens and plunging deep into the earth.

And the beastmen present could not deny that the Tiger King was indeed magnanimous and righteous. Putting themselves in his shoes, if they were the ones to discover such precious heritage, they truly couldn't guarantee they would be willing to leak it, let alone share it with others.

Even if they did share it, they would undoubtedly help themselves to the best parts first, using the heritage to develop their own faction before employing it as bait to gradually annex and unify the entire Beastman Continent.

Of course, the Tiger King acted this way partly because hidden beneath the honeyed sweetness of the heritage was a continent-wide natural disaster—a paramount crisis that required everyone to resolve collectively. Since he alone lacked the power to handle it, he had no choice but to use the heritage as bait to entice the various factions.

Not to mention that even if he had been unwilling, Lang Mu and Shang Feifan certainly wouldn't have agreed to hand the heritage over to him.

However, there was no need to spell out such details explicitly; this also served as a way for Lang Mu to bolster the prestige of the Tiger King and the Tiger Kingdom.

Normally, the Tiger King should have appeared at this moment to reap this supreme glory, elevate his renown, and leap to become the most illustrious and revered monarch of an era across the entire Beastman Continent. But alas...

Shang Feifan was thoroughly satisfied with how things had turned out.

Lang Mu held complicated feelings toward the Tiger King and preferred to suffer losses himself rather than see the Tiger King dead.

Shang Feifan was different. From the very beginning, he hadn't thought much of the Tiger King, viewing him as a typical failure who wanted to cater to everyone on all fronts, acting with all sorts of calculations while essentially lacking both true capability and steadfastness of character.

Wanting to centralize power and reclaim authority and land from the nobility was something any normal monarch would desire.

Yet while the Tiger King wanted to centralize power, he simultaneously feared the nobility's military might and authority. Hesitating and dilly-dallying for over fifty years, he had failed to reclaim any meaningful amount of land. Most of the methods he employed were petty tricks, attempting to coax the privileged nobles into voluntarily yielding profits through marriages of convenience and interest exchanges.

He was just as incompetent in state affairs as he was bankrupt in personal morality.

If he lacked moral integrity in private, but could at least maintain a strict facade while treating flings outside as mere casual playthings, it wouldn't have blown up into anything major.

Yet he simultaneously wanted the backing of the Queen's family faction while coveting the sweet, tender obedience of his lover. He wanted to secure his orthodox bloodline while desiring his illegitimate children to live in the light. He wanted to rope in crucial ministers while repeatedly acting as his own worst enemy.

In the end, he alienated everyone and was almost murdered by his own lover—he had only himself to blame.

Anyway, Shang Feifan had zero desire to let the Tiger King enjoy the glory won for him by his family's Lang Mu. Right now, the Tiger King's health was too frail to show his face in public, while the Eldest Princess lacked the prestige and capability to shoulder that honor—which, to Shang Feifan, was absolute perfection.

Priest Liang rattled on at great length, painting a vivid picture of how bountiful the heritage truly was. His words sent waves of turbulent excitement through the hearts of the beastmen in the hall; if not out of respect for the Temple of Priests, they would have loved to immediately coerce the Tiger Kingdom into coughing up the heritage for division right then and there.

Seeing that everyone's emotions had been sufficiently whipped up, Liang Runming finally shifted his tone, bringing up the prophecy and the disaster.
