chunks.chineseText:
“其次，就是关于灾难一事。经过祭司宫确认，黑森林城地下确实发生了岩浆爆发的灾害。另外在图书馆中发现的灾难预言壁画，祭司宫也有同样的壁画传承下来。甚至还有与灾难相关的预言。”

梁祭司眼睛准确找到阿瑞斯商和他的护卫。

如果不是知道拉斐尔郎沐和阿瑞斯商的关系，如果不是前天他才在城门外遇见自称商非凡的雄性兽人和拉斐尔郎沐，他可能也会和其他人一样以为这次大会只有阿瑞斯商来了，而拉斐尔郎沐没有来吧。

阿瑞斯商神色懒散，目光如刀。

他身边的护卫倒是神色自然，神态也较为放松。

梁祭司没敢多看。他有种强烈错觉，那阿瑞斯商似乎很想要砍了他。

“咳！关于壁画内容，因为事关重大，大祭司让我带来了其中一部分壁画的临摹绘画。”

两祭司身后有两个兽人站起，走到讲台最中间，两名兽人各持画轴一侧，缓缓向两边展开。

兽人大多目力不错，哪怕隔得比较远，也能看清楚临摹画中内容。

更何况这临摹的图画被特意放得很大。

那是岩浆爆发、地震频出后整个兽人大陆的凄凉景象。

从右往左，第一幅图是大山崩塌、地面开裂，众多兽人在震颤如波浪的地面上疯狂逃跑，大量野兽虫蚁鸟雀跟着跑出飞出山区和森林的场景。

第二幅图是随着地面裂开，大量岩浆从地底涌出甚至喷射而出，把整个世界都变成了红通通一片。无数生命在岩浆中倒下，化为灰烬。

第三幅图是有翅一族背负着幼崽在天空盘旋，宛似发出哀鸣之声，他们在到处寻找落脚之处，但大地一片火光和浓烟，就连天空中都到处是黑灰，没有任何能让他们落脚的地方。有累极的翼人从空中跌落，直直摔入岩浆和火光之中。

第四幅图是江河湖水温度变高，大量鱼尸浮在水面，还有很多兽人的尸体。就连海洋，近海之处的海水颜色也不对，沙滩和岸边堆积了大量尸体。

第五幅图是黑红色的气体在整个兽人大陆蔓延，覆盖了整座兽人大陆和周边岛屿。毒气下，勉强存活下来的兽人扼住自己的脖子痛苦倒下。幼崽对毒气更是没有丝毫抵抗力，全都死去。

临摹的绘画到此为止。

梁祭司也没让收起这临摹图画，让虎国侍卫帮忙把图画高悬在大殿中，确保每个人抬头都能看见。

“诸位，从壁画内容来看，这场灾难将是全大陆性质，谁也逃不掉。”

“那黑红色气体是什么？我以为毒雾纪已经过去。”有人忍不住大声询问。

梁润明一顿：“我们也不知道这种黑红色气体是什么气体，只能推测应该是岩浆和地震导致深藏在地底的毒素蔓延上来，可能随着热量升空，污染了整个兽人大陆的空气。这毒气里有可能包含毒雾纪里的毒素，也可能包含浸透兽人大陆的虫毒，甚至也许有邪神的手笔，谁也不知道。”

“但我们可以从壁画看出这黑红色气体对兽人的伤害有多大，几乎没有人能逃脱。我们也不知道这黑红色毒气会存在多久。”

梁润明总结：“地震是第一波灾难，岩浆爆发是第二波，大火是第三波，火山灰和地热是第四波，毒气是第五波。在这样一波又一波遍及整个兽人大陆的灾难下，就不知我们兽人最后能存活几人？”

全场沉默。

各势力大佬来开会前自然都打听到一些消息，他们也知道灾难即将发生的事极有可能是事实，但耳听为虚，他们总觉得虎国有可能夸大其词，总觉得自己的地盘会是幸运的那一方，而巴不得敌对势力倒霉的被灾害牵连。

但今天他们看到壁画临摹，才知道这灾难有多可怕，遍布范围又有多广。

如果壁画真的是对灾难的预言，那么就如梁祭司所说，整个兽人大陆所有兽人都无法逃脱这场大难！

“梁祭司，刚才您还提到了相关预言。请问预言的内容是什么？”开口询问的是东部落大首领。

刚才的临摹画中，他看到了一座崩塌的大山，从大山和周围景色的特征来看，他怀疑那就是他们部落的标志大山雷山，东部落的王庭也就在那座雷山脚下。

梁润明抬起头：“时间。预言提到了灾难发生的确切时间，以及有可能的解决方法。”

众人精神一振。

东部落大首领更是急声问道：“什么时候？又有什么解决方法？”

阿瑞斯商阴阴地盯着梁润明。

梁润明叹息一声：“七月连珠。当天空的七月并成一线，只能看到一个月亮时，灾难就会爆发。”

阿瑞斯商：看来灾难和月亮潮汐也有一定关系。

“那是什么时候？哪年哪月哪日？”翼国国主也出声询问。

翼国人能飞，看起来他们逃避灾难的自救能力最高，但翼国国主也无法忽略临摹画中无数有翅族在天空找不到落脚地的凄惨景象。

翼人能飞没错，但总要有个休息的落脚地。如果连个休息和补充食水的地方都没有，他们又能在空中飞翔多久？

兽人大陆可不是一座小岛，那是曾经能容得下百亿人口生活还有富余的超广大大陆。

绝大多数兽人穷其一生也无法走遍整个兽人大陆，那还是在大繁华纪交通方便的情况下。

梁润明回复：“根据祭司宫对天象的观测和总结，七月连珠的那一天很有可能就在三年后的十月下旬。”

全大殿哗然。

竟然只有三年时间！

“解决方法呢？”好些人一起问出来。

梁润明声音低沉，说得极为简单：“迁往其他陆地。”

众兽人倒吸一口冷气。

这就是预言给出的解决方法？

就算他们这时开始向大陆以外的岛屿迁徙，三年时间也不够啊！

更不要说整个大陆这么多种族，就问大陆外的大岛屿能有多少个？

大家会不会为了抢夺资源丰富的大岛屿而打起来？

还有出海的大型船只，很多内陆人根本就没有制造大型船只的经验，他们要怎么办？购买吗？那价格会不会暴涨？又要等多久才能拿到船只？

这么一想，简直问题重重。

“陆地？”虫王乔西道尔十分敏锐。

当即询问梁润明：“刚才梁祭司提到了陆地，不是岛屿？”

这下众人的注意力都被吸引，全场先是充满议论声，慢慢的声音变小到消失，整个大殿转眼间变得寂静无声，所有人都在等待梁润明回答。

梁润明深吸一口气，考虑良久，想到大祭司的吩咐，还是说道：“是，预言中提到的是陆地，不是岛屿。”

全场再次发出议论声。

南方联盟次盟主站起来：“大家请安静一下，下面我要问的问题很关键。”

大殿中再次安静下来。

南联盟次盟主面向梁润明：“请问梁祭司，预言中提到的陆地在哪里？”

梁润明感觉一道极为犀利的目光似乎要穿透自己的身体，他想要看那道目光的主人是谁，环视一圈，看到了脸色阴沉的阿瑞斯商。
chunks.englishText:
"Secondly, regarding the disaster itself. The Priest Palace has confirmed that a magma eruption disaster did indeed occur beneath Black Forest City. Furthermore, the disaster prophecy murals discovered in the library match the traditions preserved by the Priest Palace. We even have prophecies directly related to this calamity."

Priest Liang’s eyes accurately found Ares Shang and his bodyguard.

If he hadn't known about the relationship between Raphael Langmu and Ares Shang, and if he hadn't happened to run into Raphael Langmu and a male beast-man calling himself Shang Fanfan outside the city gates the day before yesterday, he might have been like everyone else, assuming that only Ares Shang had come to this grand assembly while Raphael Langmu was absent.

Ares Shang wore an indolent expression, though his gaze was like a blade.

His bodyguard, on the other hand, looked entirely natural and relatively relaxed.

Priest Liang didn’t dare to look too much. He had a strong, illusory feeling that Ares Shang looked like he really wanted to hack him to pieces.

"Ahem! Because the contents of the mural are of paramount importance, the High Priest has had me bring copies of a portion of them."

Two beast-men stood up behind Priest Liang and walked to the very center of the podium. Each held one end of a scroll, slowly unfurling it to both sides.

Most beast-men possessed excellent eyesight, and even those sitting further back could clearly make out the contents of the copied paintings.

Not to mention, these copies had been deliberately enlarged.

It depicted the desolate scenery of the entire Beast-man Continent following a volcanic eruption and frequent earthquakes.

From right to left, the first painting showed mountains collapsing and the earth splitting open. Countless beast-men fled wildly across ground that rippled like waves, while vast numbers of beasts, insects, ants, and birds bolted and flew out of the mountain ranges and forests.

The second painting showed massive amounts of magma gushing and even shooting out from beneath the earth as the ground split, turning the entire world into a sea of red. Innumerable lives fell within the magma, reduced to ashes.

The third painting showed the winged race carrying their young as they circled the sky, their cries seeming to echo with mournful grief. They searched everywhere for a place to land, but the earth was a sea of fire and thick smoke, and the sky itself was choked with black ash, leaving nowhere for them to touch down. Exhausted winged humanoids tumbled from the sky, plunging straight into the magma and raging flames.

The fourth painting showed the waters of rivers and lakes rising in temperature, with countless dead fish floating on the surface alongside the corpses of many beast-men. Even in the ocean, the water near the coast was discolored, and beaches and shores were piled high with corpses.

The fifth painting showed blackish-red gas spreading across the entire Beast-man Continent, covering the mainland and its surrounding islands. Beneath the toxic gas, the beast-men who had barely survived clutched their own throats and collapsed in agony. The young possessed not the slightest resistance to the poison and perished entirely.

The copied paintings ended here.

Priest Liang didn't have the copies put away; instead, he had the guards of the Tiger Kingdom hang them high within the grand hall, ensuring that everyone could see them simply by raising their heads.

"Everyone, judging from the contents of the murals, this disaster will be continental in scale. No one can escape."

"What is that blackish-red gas? I thought the Toxic Mist Era had already passed." Someone couldn't help asking aloud.

Liang Runming paused. "We do not know what kind of gas this blackish-red vapor is. We can only surmise that it is likely caused by magma and earthquakes driving toxins deeply buried beneath the earth up to the surface. Rising with the heat, it may have polluted the air of the entire Beast-man Continent. This poisonous gas might contain toxins from the Toxic Mist Era, or insect poisons that have saturated the Beast-man Continent, or perhaps even the handiwork of an Evil God—no one can say for sure."

"Yet we can see from the murals how devastating this blackish-red gas is to beast-men; almost no one can escape it. Nor do we know how long this blackish-red poisonous gas will linger."

Liang Runming summarized, "Earthquakes are the first wave of disaster, magma eruptions the second, raging fires the third, volcanic ash and geothermal heat the fourth, and poisonous gas the fifth. With wave after wave of such disasters sweeping across the entire Beast-man Continent, I wonder how many of us beast-men will ultimately survive?"

The entire hall fell silent.

Before coming to the assembly, the leaders of various factions had naturally caught wind of some news, and they knew that the impending disaster was very likely true. But hearing was one thing; they always felt that the Tiger Kingdom might be exaggerating, that their own territories would be the lucky ones, and half-hoping that their rival factions would suffer and become entangled in the catastrophe.

Yet today, seeing the copied murals, they finally understood just how terrifying this disaster was, and how vast its scope.

If the murals truly were a prophecy of calamity, then as Priest Liang said, every single beast-man across the entire Beast-man Continent would be unable to escape this cataclysm!

"Priest Liang, you just mentioned related prophecies. May I ask what the contents of the prophecy are?" The one speaking was the Grand Chieftain of the Eastern Tribe.

In the copies just shown, he had seen a collapsing mountain. From the characteristics of the mountain and its surrounding scenery, he suspected it was Lei Mountain, the landmark mountain of his tribe. The Royal Court of the Eastern Tribe happened to lie at the foot of that very Lei Mountain.

Liang Runming raised his head. "Time. The prophecy mentions the exact time the disaster will occur, as well as a possible solution."

The spirits of everyone present lifted.

The Grand Chieftain of the Eastern Tribe even asked anxiously, "When? And what is the solution?"

Ares Shang stared sinisterly at Liang Runming.

Liang Runming sighed. "The Seven Moons Alignment. When the seven moons in the sky merge into a single line and only a single moon can be seen, the disaster will erupt."

Ares Shang: *It seems the disaster is also related to lunar tides to a certain extent.*

"When is that? Which year, which month, which day?" The ruler of the Winged Kingdom also spoke up.

Winged humanoids could fly, making their self-preservation capabilities in escaping disaster seemingly the highest. Yet the ruler of the Winged Kingdom could not ignore the tragic imagery in the copied paintings of countless winged beings unable to find a place to land in the sky.

Winged humanoids could fly, true, but they always needed a resting place to land. If they didn't even have a place to rest and replenish their food and water, how long could they keep flying in the sky?

The Beast-man Continent was no tiny island; it was a super-vast continent that had once easily sustained a population of tens of billions with plenty to spare.

The vast majority of beast-men could not traverse the entire Beast-man Continent in their lifetimes, and that was during the convenient transportation of the Great Prosperity Era.

Liang Runming replied, "Based on the Priest Palace's observations and summary of celestial phenomena, the day of the Seven Moons Alignment is very likely to be in late October three years from now."

An uproar broke out across the grand hall.

There was only a three-year window!

"What about the solution?" Several people asked simultaneously.

Liang Runming’s voice was low, exceedingly brief: "Migrate to other lands."

The assembled beast-men gasped sharply.

This was the solution provided by the prophecy?

Even if they started migrating to islands outside the mainland right now, three years would not be enough!

Not to mention the countless races across the entire continent—just how many large islands could there possibly be outside the mainland?

Would everyone end up fighting over islands rich in resources?

And what about large ocean-going vessels? Many inland people had no experience building large ships at all. What should they do? Purchase them? Would prices skyrocket? How long would it take to actually get a ship?

Thinking along these lines, it was a mountain of problems.

"Lands?" King Xizhiduo of the Insect Race was exceptionally sharp.

He immediately questioned Liang Runming, "Priest Liang just mentioned *lands*, not islands?"

At this, everyone's attention was instantly captured. The noisy chatter in the hall gradually quieted until it vanished entirely, the entire hall plunging into utter silence in the blink of an eye as everyone awaited Liang Runming's answer.

Liang Runming took a deep breath. After thinking for a long while and remembering the High Priest's instructions, he said, "Yes, the prophecy mentions land, not islands."

Another wave of commotion rippled through the hall.

The Vice-Alliance Master of the Southern Alliance stood up. "Everyone, please quiet down. The question I am about to ask is crucial."

The hall fell silent once more.

The Southern Alliance Vice-Alliance Master faced Liang Runming. "May I ask, Priest Liang, where is the land mentioned in the prophecy?"

Liang Runming felt an intensely sharp gaze piercing through his body. Wanting to see who the owner of that gaze was, he swept his eyes around and landed upon the gloomy face of Ares Shang.

chunks.chineseText:
梁润明心脏一颤：“不知道。预言中没有提及。”

北方联盟盟主皱眉：“不可能。如果这样，预言还有何意义？”

“就是。难道预言就是告诉我们三年后的十月底我们要大难临头了吗？”众兽人跟着嚷嚷。

梁润明舔了舔嘴唇：“我还没说完。预言中虽然没有提及那大陆的详细地点，但是给出了一个提示，表明有人可以找到那处陆地所在。”

一只手握住了阿瑞斯商的手，手的主人压根不怕其他人看到，也不怕其他人猜测他的身份。

阿瑞斯商因为愤怒绷紧的肌肉略略放松下来，与那只手十指交握，就这么握着不放了。

北联盟盟主理智地说：“就算有人能找到一片大型陆地，能容纳我们所有人都迁徙过去。可是那么大的陆地必然在远海吧？就问我们这么多人，虽然远不比大繁华纪时的人口，但也有一千多万人。就问这么多人要怎么全都转移到那位于远海的大陆？”

“南方联盟听说很擅长制造船只，但他们能在三年内制造出足够一千两百多万人使用的大型船只吗？”犀国国主意有所指。

“北方联盟也有海港，他们同样也有大型船厂。如果两边一起全力开工……”

“你们是不是忘了东部落也叫东海部落？他们拥有广大的海岸线，造船能力想必也不在话下。”

“不够！远远不够。”

“其他各势力也可以先自己准备船只，大的小的都行，实在不行，到时候抱着木盆飘在海上也是一条出路。”

“呸！你当海洋是你家门口的小池塘？还一个木盆就能飘到目的地？你当海洋中就没有凶兽吗？我跟你说，海洋中的凶兽更多，多到就是我们一千多万人都不一定够喂饱那些凶兽的！”

“除了凶兽。还有海洋上可怕的暴风雨和大风，我们的大船都不一定能扛得住风浪，更何况小型船只。”

“海洋里还有海人族，那些家伙我知道，也是种族和势力繁多，有好说话的，也有特别凶悍嗜杀的。如果我们遇到海人族攻击我们怎么办？”

“不如我们把那些传承都复制一份，各自拿一份回去，然后找找传承中有没有什么好办法。”

“对对对，我也觉得应该先把传承给分了。”

大殿中众兽人七嘴八舌，提出各种困难和问题，还有人一个劲要先分传承。

别说梁润明祭司，就是各势力大佬也都听得一个头两个大。

大王子站在中间讲台上，感到有一点微妙的尴尬，他好像就是一个主持大会的司仪，并没有掌控整个大会的权威和实力，那些来参加大会的各势力大佬们没给他难堪，但也没把他放到同等地位。

如果父王没有倒下就好了。大王子暗想。这时他才和其他虎国人深深体会到有个超强者撑腰的好处和重要性。

眼看众兽人都在把话题往赶紧分了传承这件事上扯，梁润明给大王子做了好几个眼色，让他把会议主题给重新拉回到解决全大陆灾难上。

大王子很想虎吼一声，如果这时候虎王在，想必一声虎啸就会让所有人安静下来都看向他。

“诸位，我们现在的重点是如何解决三年后就会到来的全大陆灾难，关于传承分享我们后面再……”

没有人听大王子说话，所有兽人都在各自议论。

“安静！”一道响彻整个大殿的暴吼响起。

众人一静，这声暴吼充满了威压，实力低的兽人根本吼不出来。

再一看暴吼者，哦，是北方联盟那位大佬啊，那就没问题了。

这位可是全大陆实力能排到前三的超强存在。

北方联盟盟主冷着脸说：“我的问题还没有问完。敢问梁祭司，你说有人能找到让所有人迁徙的陆地，那么预言中可有提到这个人是谁？”

众人恍然，对哦，这也是一个关键问题。

快快快，快说说救世主是谁？

今天过后我们就能让全大陆都知道这个兽人的名字。

梁润明掌心潮湿，他很想大声说出拉斐尔郎沐的名字，但他知道，如果他敢就这么爆出拉斐尔的名字，不说阿瑞斯商是不是真的会杀了他，祭司宫和那两人之间必将再无转圜余地。

“预言中没有提到那人的名字，只说那人能找到通往其他大陆的通道。”梁润明思索再三，还是把预言最关键的内容说了出来。

这是祭司宫对他的要求，而兽人大陆的兽人们也需要一份希望支撑他们，梁润明不得不说。

“通道？什么通道？”在座的大佬就没有一个反应慢的。

梁润明：“祭司宫也不知道，预言中也没有详细提及，但根据祭司宫历代祭司推演，猜测应该是一个类似传送阵的特殊通道。”

众人大哗，这次议论声更高。

有人提高嗓音询问：“这么说只要发现那条特殊通道，我们就不需要制造船只，也不需要远渡重洋？”

梁润明：“是。”

这一声是一出，整个大殿都炸开了锅。
chunks.englishText:
Liang Runming’s heart skipped a beat. "I do not know. The prophecy does not mention it."

The Northern Alliance Master frowned. "Impossible. If that is the case, what is the point of the prophecy?"

"Exactly. Is the prophecy just here to tell us that we're doomed at the end of October three years from now?" Cried out several beast-men in tow.

Liang Runming licked his lips. "I haven't finished. Although the prophecy does not mention the detailed location of that continent, it does provide a hint, indicating that someone can find the whereabouts of that land."

A hand grasped Ares Shang's hand. The owner of the hand had no fear of others seeing, nor of others guessing his identity.

The muscles in Ares Shang’s body, tensed with anger, relaxed slightly. He interlaced his fingers with that hand, holding it firmly and refusing to let go.

The Northern Alliance Master said rationally, "Even if someone can find a large piece of land capable of accommodating all of us to migrate there, such a massive continent must surely lie in the distant ocean, right? Just look at all of us. Although far fewer than the population during the Great Prosperity Era, there are still over ten million people. How are all these people supposed to be transferred to a continent located in the distant ocean?"

"I've heard the Southern Alliance is very skilled at ship-building, but can they build enough large ships for over 12.1 million people within three years?" The ruler of the Rhinoceros Kingdom dropped pointed insinuations.

"The Northern Alliance also has harbors, and they possess major shipyards as well. If both sides go all-out at full production..."

"Did you forget that the Eastern Tribe is also called the East Sea Tribe? They possess vast coastlines, so their ship-building capacity must be second to none."

"Not enough! Far from it."

"The other factions can also prepare their own ships first, big or small. If push comes to shove, drifting on the ocean clinging to a wooden basin is a way out too!"

"Pui! Do you think the ocean is a little pond in your backyard? You expect to drift to your destination in a wooden basin? Do you think there are no fierce beasts in the ocean? Let me tell you, there are even more fierce beasts in the ocean—so many that even if there were over ten million of us, we might not even be enough to fill their stomachs!"

"Aside from fierce beasts, there are the terrifying storms and gales on the ocean. Our large ships might not even withstand the wind and waves, let on small vessels."

"There are also the Sea Clans in the ocean. I know those fellows; their races and factions are numerous. Some are easy to talk to, but others are exceptionally fierce and bloodthirsty. What if we encounter attacks from the Sea Clans?"

"Why don't we copy all those inheritances, each take a portion back, and then look through them to see if there are any good methods?"

"Right, right. I also think we should divide the inheritance first."

Inside the hall, the beast-men talked over one another, bringing up all sorts of difficulties and problems, while others stubbornly insisted on dividing the inheritance first.

Never mind Priest Liang; even the leaders of the various factions felt their heads throbbing with a splitting headache.

The First Prince stood on the central podium, feeling a trace of subtle awkwardness. He felt rather like a master of ceremonies hosting the assembly, lacking the authority and power to control the entire gathering. The major faction leaders attending the assembly weren't giving him a hard time, but they certainly weren't placing him on an equal footing either.

*If Father King hadn't fallen, how wonderful it would be,* the First Prince thought darkly. Only now did he and the rest of the Tiger Kingdom deeply realize the benefit and importance of having a supreme powerhouse backing them up.

Seeing that the beast-men were steering the topic back to quickly dividing the inheritance, Liang Runming exchanged several glances with the First Prince, prompting him to pull the meeting's theme back to resolving the continental disaster.

The First Prince desperately wanted to let out a tiger roar. If the Tiger King were here right now, a single tiger roar would surely have made everyone quiet down and look to him.

"Everyone, our current focus is how to resolve the continental disaster that will arrive in three years. As for sharing the inheritance, we can discuss that later..."

No one was listening to the First Prince; all the beast-men were chatting amongst themselves.

"Silence!" A thunderous roar that resonated through the entire hall exploded out.

The crowd quieted. This roar was filled with immense pressure; low-level beast-men simply couldn't roar like that.

Looking at the source of the roar—ah, it was that big shot from the Northern Alliance. Then there was no problem.

This person was a supreme powerhouse whose strength ranked in the top three of the entire continent.

The Northern Alliance Master said with a cold face, "My question hasn't been answered yet. May I ask Priest Liang, since you said someone can find the land that allows everyone to migrate, does the prophecy mention who this person is?"

The crowd came to a sudden realization. *Ah, right. That's also a crucial question.*

*Quick, quick, quick, tell us who the savior is!*

*After today, we'll make the whole continent know this beast-man's name.*

Liang Runming’s palms were slick with sweat. He desperately wanted to shout out Raphael Langmu’s name, but he knew that if he dared to blurt out Raphael’s name like that—leaving aside whether Ares Shang would really kill him—there would be no turning back between the Priest Palace and those two.

"The prophecy does not mention that person's name, only that the person can find the passage leading to other lands." After much deliberation, Liang Runming still revealed the most crucial part of the prophecy.

This was the demand placed upon him by the Priest Palace, and the beast-men of the Beast-man Continent also needed a shred of hope to sustain them; Liang Runming had no choice but to speak.

"A passage? What passage?" Not a single big shot present was slow-witted.

Liang Runming answered, "The Priest Palace does not know either, and the prophecy does not mention it in detail. But based on the deductions and summaries of past generations of Priest Palace priests, we suspect it is a special passage similar to a teleportation array."

An uproar erupted among the crowd, the clamor of discussion growing even louder.

Someone raised their voice to ask, "Does that mean as long as we discover that special passage, we won't need to build ships or cross the vast ocean?"

Liang Runming answered, "Yes."

As soon as these words fell, the entire grand hall exploded into chaos.

chunks.chineseText:
第200章 牛掰坏了

不用船只，首先就能节省许多准备时间。

更不要说不用渡海，这面对的危险一下就能少几倍甚至更多。

对于兽人，包括虫人族和飞行族，都没人想要长期生活在海面上。兽人们在陆地上、天空上是霸主，但进了海洋只有被海族和海里生物欺负的份。

兽人们几乎不用选择，如果有那么一条特殊通道，哪怕再难走、再难找到，他们也想找找看。

那么能找到这条特殊通道的人就很关键了。

接下来整座大殿的兽人们都在议论要如何找到这个关键人物，几位大佬更是直接走到梁祭司身边询问他是否有寻人线索。

阿瑞斯商拍拍身边护卫，起身，大步走到中间讲台。

大王子看到阿瑞斯商上来，一愣：这位想干嘛？

阿瑞斯商对大王子态度勉强还行：“殿下，麻烦让个位置，我有话说。”

“你和那护卫是什么关系？”大王子压低声音。

他看到阿瑞斯商和那护卫牵手了，如果不是他还在台上负责主持大会，他都想下去找阿瑞斯商算账——你竟然敢背着拉斐尔乱来？

阿瑞斯商听出大王子的质问和愤怒，无语一秒：“你看看他的眼睛。”

大王子下意识抬头看向那留在原地的护卫的眼睛。

那护卫忽然对他笑了一下，笑容充满鼓励和赞扬，眼神是熟悉的温和。

熟悉？

“他是拉……”

“知道就好。除了他，我还能和谁这么亲密？快点让开。”阿瑞斯商不耐烦催促。

大王子一瞬间怒火全部消退，竟然真的让开，直接退出讲台，坐到了虎国权贵那一圈中。

大公主凑过来：“你怎么下来了？那家伙想干什么？”

大王子摇头。

大公主斜睨他：“你跟那家伙关系不错？”

“还行吧。”大王子想到自己拿到的空间腰带和大量物资，心里骄傲地想，我们何止关系不错。

大公主眉头紧皱：“这么重要的场合，父王为什么还是不肯出现？”

“父王不是说了么，他在闭关冲级的紧要关头。”大王子低声说。

大公主不信。她总觉得哪里出了问题，虽然大都督看起来还很淡定，但宰相和城卫军统领身上似乎带着几分挥之不去的紧张和愁闷。

讲台上，阿瑞斯商掏出一块木头，啪啪啪连续拍打三下，一声比一声炸耳。

在阿瑞斯商走上讲台时，就有不少人注意到。

梁润明虽然在和几位大佬说话，但眼角余光一直在注意着阿瑞斯商两人，看到他走上讲台，顿时看了过去。

几位大佬也跟着他的目光移动。

三声惊堂木后，大殿中所有兽人的目光都被吸引到了讲台那里。

整个大殿也微妙地安静下来。

阿瑞斯商神情睥睨傲视众人，似乎对这种大场合早就司空见惯，被这么多大佬盯着，就跟被普通人看一样，没有半点多余反应。

哦，除了有点被迫上台讲话的不耐烦。

“不知道我的人可以去找虎国的人打听。废话不多说，我有三个消息告诉你们。”

与会众人微微有些喧哗，很多人都看不惯阿瑞斯商那吊炸天的说话态度。不认识他的人都在跟别人打听这人是谁。

阿瑞斯商也不管台下人议论，径直说道：“第一个消息，你们听到的预言、看到的预言壁画，被邪神厄穆克拉索给修改过。至于哪部分被修改过，邪神又为什么这么做，你们自己想。”

喧哗声陡然变大。

几位大佬同时喝：“安静！”

整个大殿所有人立刻闭嘴。

北方联盟盟主直接问梁润明：“梁祭司，这位说的可是真的？”

梁润明头疼无比，踟躇片刻，还是回道：“现在这事还在确认中，但关于灾难的部分经过我们祭司宫多方多年验证，可以确保是真的会发生。”

翼国国主进一步问：“那请问是哪一部分内容有可能被修改？”

梁润明吐字艰辛：“还未确定，但应该和特殊通道以及领路人有关。”

“如果预言和壁画内容真的被邪神动过手脚，那是不是说预言中的生路也有可能变成我们所有人的死路？”南方联盟次盟主声音沉重。

“这……”梁润明额头滑下冷汗，他无法给出肯定回复，在阿瑞斯商目光逼迫下，他也不敢把拉斐尔郎沐牵扯出来。

他甚至看到阿瑞斯商用口型威胁他：要是你敢乱说，我就敢说出祭司宫已经被邪神渗透乃至被蛊惑的事。

梁润明：……我可太难了。

阿瑞斯商发出古怪的讽刺笑声：“说不得邪神就巴不得我们去寻找那个关键人物，让那人找到特殊通道。当然，也有可能那个关键人物就是邪神附体的邪神信徒，等我们所有人跟着他进入那条所谓的特殊通道时，砰！”

阿瑞斯商做了个爆炸飞天的手势。

众人：“……”

阿瑞斯商扬了扬手，像是扔掉手中炸-弹：“再说第二个消息，邪神信徒在今天至少准备了四个邪神阴影者，分为四个方向包围了虎国王宫。他们差不多也该发动。”

卧槽！大殿众人好多人都惊得站了起来。

但那些顶层大佬们反而很淡定，似乎早有心理准备。

阿瑞斯商也知道这些人不可能毫无准备地前来。

虎国王室也早提前跟这些人打过招呼。

没有人在此时痛斥虎国为什么没有搞好安保工作。全大陆兽人都了解邪神信徒有多么难搞，又是多么无孔不入，邪神阴影者更是不用说，根本防不胜防。

北方联盟的盟主还有闲心问：“第三个消息是什么？”

阿瑞斯商：“第三个消息，为什么你们只想着逃离灾难即将发生的大陆，而不是想法解决灾难？”

众人一愣。这样的大型灾难也能解决？开什么大陆玩笑？

阿瑞斯商冷笑：“我就这么跟你们说吧，大陆上的生命对于邪神来说可有可无，吃了可以有一点能量，不吃也无所谓，甚至吃太多会导致消化不良。对于邪神来说，最重要的是这颗星球，祂需要的是来自星球本身的资源和能量。其次，是生命产生的精神能量，所以祂需要邪神信徒信仰祂。”

“证据。”虫王皱眉。

阿瑞斯商：“证据那么明显，你们没有看到吗？否则邪神为什么要策反虫母，要帮助虫母把整个虫人族异变成只知道吞吃和杀戮的怪物虫？还要让虫族和信徒到处散播虫毒？”

“就因为祂需要这个世界乱起来，需要进一步削弱我们古神的力量。”

阿瑞斯商紧接着道：“虫毒侵入我们的空气、水源和土地，对我们这些生活在兽人大陆上的人来说就是莫大灾难。但虫毒对于邪神来说，就跟食物中加入的调料一样，祂在试图让兽人大陆变得更为可口也更容易下口。”

“同样，兽人大陆环境改变对我们的古神也有影响。我们的古神才是和这个世界、这块大陆，以及大陆上的无数生命息息相关。祂们看似不存在，也不和我们接触，实际上祂们融入我们生活的方方面面。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 200: Utterly Badass

Without needing ships, a great deal of preparation time could be saved right off the bat.

Not to mention avoiding sea crossings, which would instantly slash the dangers faced by severalfold or even more.

Among beast-men, including insect-men and the winged races, not a single soul wanted to live on the open ocean for long periods. Beast-men were overlords on land and in the sky, but once they entered the ocean, they were left entirely at the mercy of the Sea Clans and marine creatures.

The beast-men barely needed to choose; if such a special passage truly existed, no matter how hard it was to traverse or find, they would want to track it down.

Thus, the person capable of finding this special passage became the crucial pivot.

Next, the beast-men across the entire hall discussed how to unearth this key figure, with several big shots even walking directly up to Priest Liang to ask if he had any clues for the search.

Ares Shang patted his bodyguard beside him, stood up, and strode toward the central podium.

Seeing Ares Shang step up, the First Prince froze: *What is this fellow trying to do?*

Ares Shang’s attitude toward the First Prince was barely passable. "Your Highness, do me a favor and give up your spot. I have something to say."

"What is your relationship with that bodyguard?" The First Prince lowered his voice.

He had seen Ares Shang and that bodyguard holding hands. If he weren't still on stage presiding over the assembly, he would have wanted to step down and settle accounts with Ares Shang—*How dare you fool around behind Raphael's back?*

Detecting the First Prince's interrogation and anger, Ares Shang was speechless for a second. "Take a look at his eyes."

The First Prince subconsciously looked up toward the eyes of the bodyguard left standing in place.

The bodyguard suddenly smiled at him, a smile brimming with encouragement and praise, the gaze carrying a familiar warmth.

*Familiar?*

"He is Ra—"

"Knowing is enough. Apart from him, who else could I be this close with? Hurry up and move aside." Ares Shang urged impatiently.

In an instant, all of the First Prince's anger vanished. He actually stepped aside, retreating directly from the podium to sit among the circle of Tiger Kingdom nobles.

The Eldest Princess hurried over. "Why did you come down? What does that fellow want?"

The First Prince shook his head.

The Eldest Princess eyed him sideways. "You're on good terms with that guy?"

"Pretty much." Thinking of the spatial belt and massive supplies he had received, the First Prince thought proudly, *Good terms? We're way more than that.*

The Eldest Princess furrowed her brow tightly. "On such an important occasion, why is Father King still refusing to show himself?"

"Didn't Father King say so? He's at a critical juncture of closed-door cultivation to breakthrough," the First Prince said in a low voice.

The Eldest Princess didn't believe it. She always felt something was off. Although the Grand Governor still looked very composed, the Prime Minister and the Commander of the City Guards seemed to wear a lingering trace of tension and gloom.

On the podium, Ares Shang pulled out a wooden gavel and gave it three consecutive sharp raps, each strike more explosive than the last.

When Ares Shang had walked onto the podium, quite a few people had already noticed.

Although Priest Liang was talking with several big shots, the corner of his eye had constantly kept tabs on Ares Shang and his companion. Seeing him walk onto the podium, he immediately looked over.

The big shots also followed his gaze.

After three claps of the gavel, the attention of every beast-man in the hall was drawn toward the podium.

The entire hall also grew subtly quiet.

Ares Shang’s expression was haughty and disdainful as he looked down upon the crowd, seemingly long accustomed to such grand occasions. Being stared at by so many big shots was no different to him than being watched by ordinary people; he showed not a single ripple of extra reaction.

Well, aside from a bit of impatience at being forced up on stage to speak.

"Those who don't know me can ask around among the Tiger Kingdom folks. Without further nonsense, I have three pieces of news to tell you."

A slight commotion rippled through the assembled crowd, as many found Ares Shang’s overbearing speech style unpalatable. Those who didn't recognize him began asking others who he was.

Ignoring the murmurings of the crowd below, Ares Shang went straight to the point: "First piece of news: the prophecy you heard and the prophetic murals you saw have been altered by the Evil God Emuclaso. As to which parts were altered, and why the Evil God did so, figure it out yourselves."

The din of commotion suddenly swelled.

Several big shots shouted in unison: "Silence!"

Everyone in the entire hall immediately clamped their mouths shut.

The Northern Alliance Master asked Liang Runming directly: "Priest Liang, is what this person said true?"

Giving off a splitting headache, Priest Liang hesitated for a moment before replying, "This matter is still being verified, but the parts concerning the disaster have been verified by our Priest Palace through various means over many years. We can guarantee that it will indeed happen."

The ruler of the Winged Kingdom asked further: "Then may I ask which portion of the content might have been altered?"

Liang Runming squeezed out each word with difficulty: "Not yet determined, but it should be related to the special passage and the guide."

"If the prophecy and mural contents really have been tampered with by the Evil God, does that mean the path of survival in the prophecy might also turn into a path of death for all of us?" The Southern Alliance Vice-Alliance Master’s voice was heavy.

"This..." Cold sweat slid down Liang Runming's forehead. He could not give an affirmative reply, and under Ares Shang’s piercing gaze, he didn't dare drag Raphael Langmu into this.

He even saw Ares Shang threatening him with mouth movements: *If you dare talk nonsense, I'll dare expose the fact that the Priest Palace has already been infiltrated and even bewitched by the Evil God.*

Liang Runming: *...My life is so hard.*

Ares Shang let out a bizarre, mocking chuckle: "For all we know, the Evil God is just dying for us to go search for that key figure, to have that person find the special passage. Of course, it's also possible that this key figure is an Evil God believer possessed by the Evil God, and when all of us follow him into that so-called special passage—*boom!*"

Ares Shang made a gesture of an explosion flying sky-high.

Everyone: "..."

Ares Shang flicked his hand, as if tossing away a bomb: "Now for the second piece of news: the Evil God believers have prepared at least four Evil God Shadows today, surrounding the Tiger King's Palace from four directions. They should be about ready to launch."

*Holy crap!* A great many people in the hall leaped to their feet in shock.

Yet those top-tier big shots remained utterly composed, seeming to have been mentally prepared long ago.

Ares Shang knew these people couldn't possibly have arrived completely unprepared.

The Tiger Kingdom's royal family had also given these people a heads-up beforehand.

No one at this moment condemned the Tiger Kingdom for failing to secure good security. Beast-men across the entire continent understood just how tricky Evil God believers were and how omnipresent they could be; let alone Evil God Shadows, which were fundamentally impossible to guard against.

The Northern Alliance Master even had the leisure to ask: "What is the third piece of news?"

Ares Shang: "The third piece of news: why are you all only thinking about fleeing the continent where the disaster is about to occur, instead of thinking of ways to resolve the disaster?"

The crowd froze. *An upscale disaster like this can even be solved? Are you making a continental joke?*

Ares Shang sneered: "Let me put it to you this way: life on the continent is dispensable to the Evil God. Eating it yields a tiny bit of energy; not eating it doesn't matter, and eating too much might even cause indigestion. To the Evil God, what matters most is this planet itself—He needs the resources and energy originating from the planet proper. Secondly, it's the spiritual energy generated by life, which is why He needs Evil God believers to worship Him."

"Proof." The Insect King frowned.

Ares Shang: "The evidence is so obvious, didn't you see it? Otherwise, why would the Evil God instigate the Insect Mother, helping her mutate the entire insect-human race into monstrous bugs that only know how to devour and slaughter? Why else would He have the insect race and His believers scatter insect poison everywhere?"

"Simply because He needs this world to descend into chaos, needing to further weaken the power of our ancient gods."

Ares Shang continued seamlessly: "Insect poison invading our air, water sources, and land is a monumental disaster for those of us living on the Beast-man Continent. But to the Evil God, insect poison is just like seasoning added to food; He is trying to make the Beast-man Continent tastier and easier to devour."

"Likewise, changes to the environment of the Beast-man Continent affect our ancient gods as well. Our ancient gods are the ones truly bound to this world, this continent, and the countless lives upon it. They seem non-existent and do not contact us, yet in reality, they are integrated into every facet of our lives."

chunks.chineseText:
“我们完全可以把古神看做自然本身。所以对古神无需信仰，只需要有敬畏之心就好。”

“自然不会顺应我们，但我们可以去了解自然，让自然为我们所用。同样我们也需要回馈自然，那就是对自然尽量保护，而不是破坏。有问题也应该想办法治理，而不是只顾着逃离和抛弃。”

郎沐在台下听到商非凡的发言，心想地星的自然保护者就应该请老商当代言人。

阿瑞斯商目光凉凉地扫向梁祭司：“邪神被我们的古神困住，祂想脱困，想要彻底打败我们的古神，就需要更多能量。那么更多能量哪里来？”

虫王：“你是说？”

阿瑞斯商：“自然是去其他大陆掠夺。我们兽人有古神保护，其他大陆就不一定。你们想想，虫母找到的那块大陆，明明虫人族可以在那里休养生息，成为那片大陆的霸主。他们完全没必要再跑回来跟我们打架，就算因为过往恩怨怀有仇恨，也不至于让虫母把整个虫人族都变成没有多少自我意识的战争工具。”

“就问你们仇恨自己的敌人，会恨到把自己一大家子全都变成没有神智的怪物，只为了和敌人同归于尽吗？那得是什么样的深仇大恨？”

虫王心脏狠狠一颤：“难道虫母找到的那块大陆已经……”

“没错。”阿瑞斯商点头：“如果我推测不错，当年邪神被我们的古神困住时，祂一定会想方设法脱困，而脱困需要力量，祂为什么不找别人就找到虫母头上？只不过是因为祂发现了虫人大陆。”

“我甚至怀疑邪神就是吸收了虫人大陆的能量，才有了反过来压制我们古神的力量。导致我们的古神彻底不再响应我们，关于祂们陨落的传言才会传得到处都是。”

阿瑞斯商说的这些话可不是乱说，也不是他的推测，而是他看完了雕像广场那些石碑，了解到当年古神陨落的秘密。

这也是他已经完成的任务七十二的内容——观看雕像广场的全部残留碑文，找到兽人大陆古神陨落的秘密。

这个任务完成后的奖励就是天眼系统的查询权限。

按照那些石碑上的记载，古神在远古时候最为活跃，祂们和生活在这片大陆上的生命有很多接触，有惩罚，也有帮扶。

可能那时候的古神也刚有完整意识，祂们对生命好奇，想要接触。就像是AI刚有了灵魂。

所谓神血血脉，就是传说中和神灵结合的生命生下的后代。

也有说法是兽人大陆上的生命接受了神灵的点化，被激发出身体中的特殊力量。

在兽人大繁华纪时，兽人的科学研究者们已经对基因有了一定了解，他们推测超远古时期，最开始的那些神血觉醒者全都是被打开基因锁的人。

而这些人的基因被遗传给后代，就有了神血血脉。

魔血血脉则是被打开了另一种基因锁，类似精神力开发。

这些人大多数都很聪明，想得很多，他们从自然规律中总结出各种规则，最终以精神力结合天地间的能量，来达到想要的效果。

但因为一开始魔血血脉不了解天地能量本质是什么，所以他们就以各种精灵为名，什么大地精灵、冰雪精灵、万物精灵，之后又发展成各种神灵。

而他们念出咒语的过程，其实就是他们的精神力在接触天地能量并操纵的过程。能被他们吸收入体内，并被他们使用的天地能量，就被他们统称为魔力。

阿瑞斯商觉得魔法也好、科技也好、异能也好，都是殊途同归，全都是操纵某种能量，通过咒语、手势、机械、电路等等，产生自己想要的效果。

唯一的区别就是有无精神力。

不，应该说是精神力的使用多寡。

商非凡修炼精神力至今，认为任何物体和生命都拥有精神力。只不过有人的精神力可以强大到能外放，有人的精神力低到无法察觉。

但实际上只要承认有灵魂存在，精神力就是存在的。

说得极端一点，人产生某个想法，进而操纵自己的身体去做某个动作，这个过程也是在使用精神力。只不过精神力操纵的是自己的身体。

列成公式就是：

精神力+魔力=魔法。

精神力+天赋能量=异能。

人类的想法（精神力）+生命能量=人体动能。

怎么看，精神力都是最基础，也是最重要的存在。

商非凡把自己从石碑内容上推理出来的结论告诉郎沐：“邪神极有可能也是能量生物，就跟这个世界的古神一样。古神是自然规则产生意识后的天然神灵，而邪神有可能也是类似存在，但更贪婪，祂想要更多，想要变得更为强大，就像是……病毒，外来的病毒。”

商非凡从石碑记载上了解到，等到兽人们能自我发展，古神就丢开了手，也可能是对兽人们失去了兴趣。这就是最初的旧神血皇朝时期，也许是更早以前。

兽人世界就只留下了古神传说。

等到邪神入侵，古神和邪神打成一团，但那时候古神应该还没有真的陨落，只是为了困住邪神，进入了相持状态。

那时候的兽人们对此一无所知，仍旧在发展着自己的文明。时间大约是新神血皇朝向新兽人联盟过度的时期。

直到邪神为了寻找脱困的方法，逃出一丝能量找到报仇心切的虫母，也发现了虫人大陆。

邪神帮助（蛊惑）虫母的同时，也在侵吞虫人大陆的能量。

在得到虫人大陆的能量后，邪神的力量占到上风，相持局面被打破，古神们被邪神打败。

偏偏那时候虫母率领变异虫族侵略兽人大陆，到处散播虫毒，让古神想要从兽人大陆汲取力量也跟吞入毒物一样。

古神们付出了莫大代价，是自我牺牲那种方式，再次困住邪神。

但古神们也因此失去了大量力量，甚至有的被打碎完整意识。

这就是古神陨落的真相。

同样也是邪神千方百计想溜出兽人大陆要再找到一个大陆的重要原因。

因为邪神只有吞噬更多能量，祂才能真正打破兽人大陆古神们给祂设置的樊笼，真正地把残余古神的力量全部吞噬，进而一点点蚕食整个天河星。

“你怎么知道这些？你到底是谁？来自哪里？”东部落大首领忍不住质问。

这些问题也是在场所有兽人都想知道的。

阿瑞斯商一昂脑袋：“我？我是曾经进过神灵残留力量形成的异度空间的人，我在那里看到了古神由盛而衰以及邪神入侵乃至被困的全部过程。”

全场哗然。

有人忍不住好奇：“你说的异度空间要怎么进入？你又怎么能证明你说的是实话？”

阿瑞斯商不屑地一笑：“我为什么要证明给你们看？你们愿意相信就相信，不愿意相信就拉倒。至于那异度空间要怎么进入？”
chunks.englishText:
"We can entirely view the Ancient Gods as nature itself. Therefore, there is no need to worship the Ancient Gods; we only need to maintain a heart of reverence."

"Nature will not accommodate us, but we can strive to understand nature and make it serve us. Likewise, we also need to give back to nature. That means protecting it as much as possible rather than destroying it. When problems arise, we should figure out ways to manage and fix them, rather than simply escaping and abandoning them."

Listening to Shang Feifan’s speech from the audience, Lang Mu thought that Old Shang ought to be hired as a spokesperson for Earth's environmental protection organizations.

Ares Shang swept a cool, detached gaze toward High Priest Liang: "The Evil God was trapped by our Ancient Gods. If He wants to break free and completely defeat our Ancient Gods, He requires a vast amount of energy. So, where does that extra energy come from?"

The Insect King asked, "You mean...?"

Ares Shang replied, "Naturally, by plundering other continents. Our Beastmen are protected by the Ancient Gods, but other continents might not be so fortunate. Think about it: the continent discovered by the Insect Mother—the Insect-folk could easily have rested, recuperated, and become the undisputed overlords of that realm. There was simply no need for them to run all the way back here to pick a fight with us. Even if they harbored hatred due to past grievances, it wouldn't drive the Insect Mother to turn her entire race into mindless weapons of war."

"Let me ask you this: if you hated your enemies, would you hate them to the extent of turning your entire family into mindless monsters just to perish together with them? What kind of bone-deep, irreconcilable hatred would that require?"

The Insect King’s heart violently skipped a beat: "Could it be that the continent the Insect Mother found has already...?"

"Precisely." Ares Shang nodded. "If my deductions are correct, when the Evil God was trapped by our Ancient Gods back then, He must have tried every possible means to break free, and escaping required power. Why didn't He look for anyone else, yet managed to find the Insect Mother? It was simply because He discovered the Insect-folk Continent."

"I even suspect that the Evil God absorbed the energy of the Insect-folk Continent, which gave Him the strength to suppress our Ancient Gods in return. That caused our Ancient Gods to completely stop responding to us, leading to the widespread rumors of their demise."

What Ares Shang was saying wasn't random nonsense or mere speculation; rather, he had read the stone tablets in the plaza of statues and uncovered the secret behind the fall of the Ancient Gods back then.

This was also the content of the completed Mission Seventy-Two—observing all the remaining inscriptions in the statue plaza and discovering the secret behind the fall of the Beastman Continent's Ancient Gods.

The reward for completing this mission was query access to the Heavenly Eye System.

According to the records on those stone tablets, the Ancient Gods were most active in primordial times, having numerous interactions with the lifeforms living on this continent—both punishments and assistance.

Perhaps back then, the Ancient Gods had just developed complete consciousness; they were curious about life and eager to interact, much like an AI that had just acquired a soul.

The so-called God Bloodline referred to the legendary offspring born from unions between lifeforms and deities.

Another theory was that the lifeforms on the Beastman Continent received enlightenment from the deities, which stimulated the special powers dormant within their bodies.

During the Great Prosperity Era of the Beastmen, their scientific researchers had already gained a certain understanding of genetics. They hypothesized that in the ultra-ancient era, the very first God Bloodline awakeners were all individuals whose genetic locks had been unlocked.

When these individuals passed their genes down to their descendants, the God Bloodline was formed.

The Demonic Bloodline, on the other hand, was the result of unlocking a different kind of genetic lock, similar to the development of spiritual force.

Most of these people were highly intelligent and contemplative; they summarized various rules from the laws of nature and ultimately combined spiritual force with the energy between heaven and earth to achieve their desired effects.

However, because the Demonic Bloodline did not initially understand the true nature of worldly energy, they attributed it to various spirits—such as Earth Spirits, Snow Spirits, and Spirits of All Things—which later evolved into various deities.

The process of them chanting incantations was actually the process by which their spiritual force came into contact with and manipulated the energy of heaven and earth. The worldly energy that they could absorb into their bodies and utilize was collectively referred to by them as magic.

Ares Shang felt that magic, technology, and superpowers all led to the same destination by different paths. They were all methods of manipulating a certain type of energy to produce a desired effect through incantations, gestures, machinery, electrical circuits, and so on.

The only difference was the presence or absence of spiritual force.

No, it should be said that the difference lay in the amount of spiritual force utilized.

Having cultivated spiritual force up to the present day, Shang Feifan believed that all objects and lifeforms possessed spiritual force. It was simply that some people's spiritual force was powerful enough to be projected externally, while others' spiritual force was so low it was imperceptible.

In reality, as long as one acknowledged the existence of the soul, spiritual force existed.

To take it to an extreme, the process of a person generating a thought and subsequently commanding their body to perform a specific action was also an application of spiritual force—only that the spiritual force was manipulating one's own body.

Expressed as a formula:

Spiritual Force + Magic Energy = Magic.
Spiritual Force + Innate Energy = Superpowers.
Human Thought (Spiritual Force) + Life Energy = Human Kinetic Energy.

No matter how one looked at it, spiritual force was the most foundational and vital existence.

Shang Feifan shared the conclusions he had deduced from the contents of the stone tablets with Lang Mu: "It is highly probable that the Evil God is also an energy-based lifeform, just like the Ancient Gods of this world. The Ancient Gods were natural deities born from consciousness arising within natural rules, and the Evil God may be a similar entity, but far greedier. He wanted more, wanting to become even stronger—much like a… virus, an external virus."

From the records on the stone tablets, Shang Feifan learned that once the beastmen became capable of self-development, the Ancient Gods cast them aside, or perhaps simply lost interest in them. This was the period of the early Old God Blood Dynasty, or perhaps even earlier.

Only the legends of the Ancient Gods remained in the beastman world.

When the Evil God invaded, the Ancient Gods and the Evil God fought fiercely, but at that time, the Ancient Gods had probably not truly fallen; they had merely entered a state of stalemate in order to trap the Evil God.

The beastmen of that era remained completely oblivious to this, continuing to develop their civilization. The timeline roughly coincided with the transition period from the New God Blood Dynasty to the New Beastman Alliance.

It wasn't until the Evil God, searching for a way to break free, managed to leak a wisp of energy that He found the vengeful Insect Mother, thereby discovering the Insect-folk Continent.

While aiding (and bewitching) the Insect Mother, the Evil God was simultaneously devouring the energy of the Insect-folk Continent.

Upon obtaining the energy of the Insect-folk Continent, the Evil God's power gained the upper hand. The stalemate was broken, and the Ancient Gods were defeated by the Evil God.

To make matters worse, at that time the Insect Mother led mutated insect swarms to invade the Beastman Continent, scattering insect toxins everywhere. This caused any attempt by the Ancient Gods to draw power from the Beastman Continent to be akin to swallowing poison.

The Ancient Gods paid a tremendous price—the self-sacrificial kind—to trap the Evil God once again.

However, the Ancient Gods lost a massive amount of power as a result, and some even had their complete consciousness shattered.

This was the truth behind the fall of the Ancient Gods.

It was also the crucial reason why the Evil God was pulling out all the stops to slip out of the Beastman Continent and find another continent.

Because only by devouring more energy could the Evil God truly shatter the cage set for Him by the Ancient Gods of the Beastman Continent, completely devour the power of the remaining Ancient Gods, and subsequently nibble away at the entire Tianhe Star step by step.

"How do you know all this? Just who are you, and where do you come from?" The Great Chieftain of the East Tribe couldn't help demanding.

These questions were also what every beastman present wanted to know.

Ares Shang lifted his chin proudly. "Me? I am someone who once entered the alternate dimension formed by the residual power of deities. I witnessed the entire process of the Ancient Gods rising and falling, as well as the Evil God's invasion and ultimate imprisonment."

An uproar erupted across the entire venue.

Someone couldn't help asking out of curiosity, "How does one enter this alternate dimension you speak of? And how can you prove that you're telling the truth?"

Ares Shang smiled with utter disdain. "Why should I prove it to you? Believe it if you're willing, or forget it if you aren't. As for how to enter that alternate dimension...?"

chunks.chineseText:
阿瑞斯商不屑的笑容转变为诡异的笑：“简单啊，只要你们引来恐惧之神的奴仆或者类似它的存在，它们自然会带你进入异度空间。不过那里能量古怪、空间诡异莫名，进去的人基本就别想活着出来，如果你们没有我的好运气，还是别乱来比较好。当然，如果有人就想进去，那随便进。”

众人：“……”你他么这说了跟没说有什么区别？

还有那个恐惧之神的奴仆是谁？

不是虎国人或者经常来虎国行商的外国人并不清楚这位的名号。

大殿中有人突然惊呼：“我想起来了！这家伙和那个俊美的天残谷主在王城外干架，结果就引来了恐惧之神的奴仆！”

虫王单纯好奇，问阿瑞斯商：“你是不是有办法引来恐惧之神的奴仆？”

阿瑞斯商摆手：“巧合而已。”

是吗？你猜我们信不信？

梁润明简直想给阿瑞斯商竖起大拇指：你牛！你他么简直牛掰坏了！就这么三言两语就把所有人的注意力都从关键人身上转移开。

而且被阿瑞斯商这么一说，不管大家信不信，等以后就算有人爆出拉斐尔郎沐就是找到特殊通道的关键人物，恐怕大家也会在脑中多想一想：这到底是阴谋，还是针对阿瑞斯商的个人报复。

梁润明现在只想赶紧传讯大祭司，告诉他，兽人大陆出现了一个可怕的妖孽。

这个妖孽不仅知道得多，还特别狡猾和狠辣。

拉斐尔郎沐被这么一个妖孽叼进窝里，别人想要把拉斐尔郎沐给扒拉出来，就得先对上这个妖孽。

“好了。”阿瑞斯商又一拍惊堂木：“我要说的消息已经说完，接下来大家最好做好和邪神阴影者战斗的准备。等打完了，再来谈如何解决我们兽人大陆的地质灾难。”

话音刚落，刺耳又紧急的响铃声便响遍整个王宫和虎国王城。

邪神阴影者出现了！
chunks.englishText:
Ares Shang’s disdainful smile shifted into a chillingly eerie grin. "Simple. Just lure over a servant of the God of Terror, or some similar entity, and they'll naturally drag you right into that alternate dimension. But the energy and spatial laws in there are bizarre beyond imagination; once you go in, you can pretty much kiss your chances of coming out alive goodbye. Unless you possess my kind of stellar luck, I'd strongly advise against playing with fire. Of course, if someone's dead set on taking a suicide stroll, be my guest."

Everyone: "……" *What the hell is the difference between what you just said and saying nothing at all?!*

And just who in the world is this "servant of the God of Terror"?

Anyone who wasn't a citizen of the Tiger Kingdom or a foreign merchant frequenting its lands had no earthly idea who this personage was.

Suddenly, a voice rang out in the grand hall in shock: "I remember now! This bastard got into a brawl with that gorgeous Valley Master of Heavenly Remnants right outside the royal capital, and that exact fight summoned a servant of the God of Terror!"

The Bug King, purely out of curiosity, asked Ares Shang, "Do you actually have a way to summon a servant of the God of Terror?"

Ares Shang waved a hand dismissively. "Pure coincidence."

*Is that so? Do you want to guess whether we believe you or not?*

Liang Runming practically wanted to stick his thumbs up at Ares Shang: *You're a beast! You're ridiculously, mind-bogglingly awesome!* Just like that, in a mere three sentences, he had successfully steered everyone's attention entirely away from the key individual.

Moreover, after being spun by Ares Shang like this, regardless of whether people believed it or not, even if someone exposed Raphael Langmu as the crucial figure who found the special passageway later on, people would likely hesitate and overthink it: *Is this an elaborate conspiracy, or just a personal vendetta against Ares Shang?*

Right now, Liang Runming only wanted to shoot a message straight to the High Priest, telling him that a terrifying, monstrous freak had appeared on the Beastmen Continent.

This freak didn't just know an immense amount; he was exceptionally cunning, ruthless, and vicious.

Now that Raphael Langmu had been dragged into such a freak's den, anyone hoping to fish Raphael Langmu out would first have to contend with this monster.

"Alright," Ares Shang clapped his gavel once more. "The news I wanted to share has been delivered. Next, you'd all better prepare yourselves to do battle with the Evil God's Shadow. Once that's settled, we can come back and talk about how to resolve the Beastmen Continent's geological cataclysm."

The moment his voice faded, a piercing, urgent alarm bell began to toll wildly throughout the entire royal palace and the Tiger Kingdom's capital.

The Evil God's Shadow had appeared!

chunks.chineseText:
第201章 震惊我全家

往日只要出现一个邪神阴影者就是大灾难。

比如在摩罗城出现了一个虫毒散播者，就导致整个摩罗城的人不得不逃出城，更有数千人在逃跑前就死于虫毒感染，因此造成的财产损失更是不计其数。

王城毕竟是王城，对于各种灾难和突发事情的应对还算比较周全。

建国以来，王城也出现过邪神阴影者，且不止一次。

在第一次对王城造成极大危害后，当时的虎王和虎国高层就绞尽脑汁想要怎么对付这邪神阴影者，至少也要减少其带来的伤害。

之后在当时的宫廷祭司帮忙出谋划策下，虎国王城终于搞出了一套还算有效的邪神阴影者应对方法。

这个方法简单说就是把邪神阴影者困在一个地方，不让它祸害到太多面积。

只糟糕的是，困住邪神阴影者的同时，也会困住那个地方的兽人。

但邪神阴影者一旦出现，它所过之处，几乎很少有人能活下来。所以民众对于把兽人和邪神阴影者困在一起的事接受良好，甚至巴不得虎国上层能把邪神阴影者待过的地方的兽人，无论死活全都消灭得干干净净。

因为这些人不管死活，都会异变，都会给周围还活着的兽人带来极大危害。

不管如何，两百多年下来，虎国王城的民众在听到代表邪神阴影者出现的紧急报警音后，真正会带着全家老少和财产立刻逃出王城的人极少。

绝大多数人会按照城卫军指令，立刻调转回家，准备好撤离准备。

此时，整座王城路上的行人以飞快的速度在减少，酒馆、店铺里的人也转瞬间都跑得不见人影。

原本繁华又热闹的庞大城市竟然在不到一刻钟时间就变得寂静无声。

能回家的人都回家了，他们在家里收拾好最紧要的财产以及身份证明，把家人都聚集到身边，竖起耳朵听着外面的警示钟声或者是城卫军的通知。

外地来客则大多数待在旅馆，也有一部分人匆忙向城外撤离。

除了极少部分人会惊慌失措，不知如何是好，然后在附近人或城卫军的帮助下，安排到最近的藏身地点。绝大多数人，包括外地人对这种情况都不陌生。

不止虎国王城会出现邪神阴影者，整个兽人大陆各个地方都有可能出现。

有些地方就如虎国王城一样有不错的应对机制，有些地方就算没有，但经验也会告诉他们要如何应对这种情况。

虎国王城全都安静下来，路上除了不断巡逻的城卫军，就再看不到多少闲人。

城卫军统领担忧地抬头看向王宫方向。

现在王宫周围两个街区的范围已经全被戒严并撤空。

而能这么快撤空民众，只因为撤离工作在传承分享大会召开前就秘密开始。

也不知道虎国高层从哪里得来的消息，提前知晓邪神信徒会袭击王宫。

原本城卫军和治安局还担心邪神信徒会搞些声东击西、调虎离山的行动，在王城多处搞出事端。

但他们把担心告诉上层后，上层却只让他们按照命令行事。

城卫军统领太过担心，就去找克莱门特打听，随后从克莱门特那里得到秘密消息，说是邪神信徒在虎国的信众被不断剿灭和打压，单虎国这边已经没有多少人手可以动用。再加上真神教内部似乎闹出了一些事，最后那些邪神信徒商议出的结果就是集中力量对付大会举办地点。

城卫军统领不知道克莱门特是从哪里得来这么秘密的消息，就像是在真神教内部安插了密探一样。

城卫军统领又去找了大都督打探，得到了类似回应。

他忍不住就询问了大都督消息来源。

他还记得当时狮域大都督的神情很是微妙，最后只给了他一个名词“八卦报”。

城卫军统领角合嘴角肌肉跳了跳，一个小报的信息来源，真的靠谱吗？

狮域大都督又加了一个人名，“拉斐尔郎沐”。

城卫军统领听到这个名字，虽然不知道拉斐尔是怎么弄到这么秘密的情报，但他顿时就觉得这些情报靠谱了不少。

“所以拉斐尔并没有和郎老伯爷前往领地，而是出去查探邪神信徒的线索去了吗？”

大都督：“他并没有辞去特调局的工作。”

回忆结束，角合统领看着王宫方向，轻轻吐出一口气。

他的任务不是保护王宫，那里有其他人执行他们的职责，他只要保护好这座城市里的其他民众就好。

角合统领掉头就去检查王城的地下通道。

特殊时期，王城路面和地下的通道出入口会全部打开，就是为了确保一旦有什么大难，可以让民众迅速逃出王城。

实际上地下通道这时已经在秘密转移一部分人，这些人都是在学校上学的幼崽。

王城每座学校都有通往地下通道的入口。

幼崽们都是最先转移的目标，跟随幼崽一起走的都是最优秀的老师和学者，还有保护者。

他们会通过地下通道转移到城外各处村镇，在那里等待消息。

如果王城没事或危险过去，他们就能立刻返回。

如果危险持续，但还没有危及到周围，他们就会暂时待在附近村镇。

如果王城沦陷，那么他们就会跟着村镇的人一起逃向更远的地方。

有个混入学校当厨师的玩家，就接到了保护幼崽撤离的任务。

这个玩家还不知道王城发生了大事，他就是正在学厨的手艺人，进入游戏也是为了锻炼自己的厨艺实操能力。

接到这个任务，他还有点莫名其妙，但看报酬不错，就顺手接了下来。

因为这个任务被算作精英任务，需要至少五个玩家组成小队共同完成，这个游戏名为“踏上厨神之路”的玩家就上世界频道吼了一声，把自己的任务分享了出去。

无巧不巧，就在该玩家刚刚把任务分享出去，就有一个玩家跳出来喊：“卧槽！这是要分阵营了吗？我在我神教接到一个任务，是去抓捕异端逆神者后代。看地点好像就是上面那个兄台标出来的坐标啊。”

这声喊一出，世界频道顿时热闹了。

“你神教不会就是那个真神教吧？邪神教派真有人加入？”

“什么邪神！那都是普罗大众对我神的误解，是兽人大陆高层和祭司宫对我神的污蔑！”

“污蔑不污蔑我不知道，但这个真神教真的很奇奇怪怪，它的很多仪式都很血腥诡异不可理喻。”

“但这样不是更好玩？而且游戏嘛，肯定有反派。人家也许是为了震慑教众才会故意搞得这么诡异，说不定邪神厄穆克拉索真的被世人误解。神嘛，肯定懒得解释。”

“等等！我去查了那个任务坐标地点，那是学校啊。是王城第一初级学校，里面全都是十二岁以下的幼崽！”

“卧槽！这么说上面那个仁兄说的抓捕异端逆神者后代，就是去抓捕人家幼崽？”

“报名保护幼崽撤离的任务！保护可可爱爱的幼崽人人有责！”

“我也报名。我现在就在坐标点附近，马上就到！”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 201: Shocking My Entire Family

In the past, the mere emergence of a single Evil God's Shadow spelled an absolute catastrophe.

For instance, when a Vermin Toxin Spreader appeared in Molo City, it forced the entire populace to flee for their lives. Thousands had already perished from worm-toxin infections before they could even escape, resulting in countless and uncountable property losses.

Still, the royal capital was the royal capital; its emergency response protocols for various disasters and sudden crises were relatively comprehensive.

Since the founding of the nation, Evil God's Shadows had appeared in the capital before—and more than once.

After the first such entity wreaked catastrophic devastation upon the capital, the Tiger King of that era and the senior echelons of the Tiger Kingdom racked their brains trying to figure out how to deal with these abominations, or at least how to minimize the casualties they inflicted.

Later, with the strategic planning and counsel of the court priests of the time, the Tiger Kingdom's capital finally devised a somewhat effective containment method against the Evil God's Shadows.

Put simply, this method involved trapping the Evil God's Shadow within a designated zone, preventing it from ravaging too vast an area.

The only catch—and a terrible one at that—was that while trapping the Evil God's Shadow, it also trapped any beastmen unfortunate enough to be caught in that zone.

However, once an Evil God's Shadow manifested, virtually no one in its path survived. Thus, the citizenry accepted the practice of sealing beastmen and the Evil God's Shadow together quite readily; they practically prayed for the higher-ups to thoroughly annihilate everything in areas touched by the Shadow, beastmen included, dead or alive.

Because regardless of whether these people died or survived, they would undergo grotesque mutations, posing an extreme threat to all surrounding living beastmen.

Regardless, over the past two hundred-plus years, whenever the citizens of the capital heard the emergency alarm signifying the arrival of an Evil God's Shadow, very few actually packed up their entire families and all their worldly possessions to flee the city outright.

The vast majority would follow the City Guard's instructions, immediately turn back home, and ready themselves for evacuation.

At that moment, pedestrians on the streets of the entire capital dwindled at a blistering pace, and people inside taverns and shops vanished in the blink of an eye.

The previously bustling, lively, and massive city plunged into absolute silence in less than a quarter of an hour.

Those who could return home did so, packing up their most critical assets and identification papers, gathering their families close, and straining their ears to listen for the warning bells outside or instructions from the City Guard.

Out-of-town visitors mostly stayed put in their inns, though a small fraction hurriedly evacuated toward the city gates.

Aside from a tiny minority who panicked and lost their minds, not knowing what to do—who would then be guided to the nearest safehouse by bystanders or the City Guard—the overwhelming majority, including outsiders, were no strangers to this scenario.

Evil God's Shadows didn't just appear in the Tiger Kingdom's capital; they could manifest anywhere across the entire Beastmen Continent.

Some regions possessed robust response mechanisms just like the capital; others might not, but experience would always teach them how to handle such crises.

The Tiger Kingdom's capital fell completely silent, with no idlers to be seen on the streets save for constantly patrolling squads of the City Guard.

The Commander of the City Guard looked up toward the royal palace with a furrowed, worried brow.

Right now, a two-block radius surrounding the royal palace had been placed under complete martial law and thoroughly evacuated.

The reason this evacuation of civilians had been executed so swiftly was simply because the operation had begun in secret well before the Heritage Sharing Conference even commenced.

Heaven knows where the Tiger Kingdom's higher-ups had acquired their intelligence, but they had known in advance that cultists of the Evil God would launch an assault on the royal palace.

Initially, the City Guard and the Public Security Bureau had worried that the cultists might pull off feints and distractions, creating chaos in multiple locations across the capital to draw their forces away.

Yet when they voiced these concerns to their superiors, the higher-ups simply ordered them to follow instructions blindly.

Consumed by anxiety, the City Guard Commander had sought out Clement for answers, subsequently receiving a classified piece of intelligence: the Evil God’s cultists within the Tiger Kingdom had been continually hunted down and suppressed, leaving them with barely any manpower to spare in this territory alone. Coupled with some internal strife erupting within the True God Church, the cultists had ultimately resolved to concentrate all their remaining strength on striking the venue where the conference was being held.

The Commander had no idea where Clement had managed to dig up such top-secret intelligence—it was as if he had planted secret agents right inside the True God Church itself.

Seeking further verification, the Commander had even approached the Grand Marshal, only to receive a remarkably similar response.

Unable to resist, he had pressed the Grand Marshal on the source of the information.

He still remembered the subtle, ambiguous expression the Lion Territory's Grand Marshal wore at the time, finally tossing him just a single name: "The Gossip Gazette."

The corners of City Guard Commander Jiao He’s mouth had twitched involuntarily. Could the source of information from a tabloid rag possibly be reliable?

The Grand Marshal had then casually added a person's name: "Raphael Langmu."

Upon hearing that name, even though the Commander had no clue how Raphael had managed to unearth such classified intelligence, he instantly felt that the intel had become a whole lot more credible.

"So Raphael didn't accompany old Baron Lang to the fiefdom, but went out to investigate leads on the Evil God's cultists instead?"

The Grand Marshal had replied: "He never resigned from his post at the Special Investigation Bureau."

With his memories fading, Commander Jiao He looked toward the royal palace and let out a soft breath.

His mission wasn't to protect the royal palace—others had their own assigned duties for that; his sole responsibility was to safeguard the rest of the civilians within this city.

Turning on his heel, Commander Jiao He headed off to inspect the capital's underground transit network.

During extraordinary times, all surface and underground exit-and-entry portals of the capital would be thrown wide open specifically to ensure that, in the event of a catastrophic disaster, the populace could rapidly evacuate the city.

In fact, the underground tunnels were already being utilized at that very moment to quietly evacuate a specific group of people: the cubs attending school.

Every school in the capital possessed an entrance leading directly to the underground network.

The cubs were the absolute top priority for evacuation, accompanied by the finest teachers, scholars, and armed protectors.

They would be transported via the underground tunnels to various villages and towns outside the city, where they would wait for further news.

If the capital remained unscathed or the danger passed, they could immediately return.

If the danger persisted but hadn't yet threatened the surrounding areas, they would temporarily remain stationed in those nearby villages and towns.

And if the capital fell, they would join the villagers in fleeing even further away.

One of the players who had infiltrated the school as a chef happened to receive a mission to protect the evacuating cubs.

Clueless about the massive crisis unfolding in the capital, this player was merely a crafting enthusiast learning the culinary arts; he had entered the game purely to hone his practical cooking skills.

Upon receiving the mission, he had been somewhat baffled, but seeing that the rewards were quite generous, he casually accepted it.

Because this assignment was classified as an elite-tier quest requiring a party of at least five players to complete together, the player—whose in-game handle was "Embarking on the Path of the God of Cooking"—shouted out in the World Channel and shared his quest details.

As fate would have it, no sooner had the player shared the quest than another player jumped into the chat, yelling: "Holy shit! Are we choosing factions now? I just accepted a quest in my God's Cult to hunt down the descendants of heretical god-defiers. Looking at the location, it seems to match the exact coordinates marked by the bro above!"

The moment that shout echoed out, the World Channel instantly erupted into a frenzy.

"Is your God's Cult by any chance that True God Church? Does the Evil God Cult actually have people joining it?"

"What Evil God?! That's just the general public's misunderstanding of my god, and malicious slander by the Beastmen Continent's higher-ups and the priest palace!"

"Whether it's slander or not, I don't know, but this True God Church is genuinely bizarre. A lot of their rituals are bloody, creepy, and completely incomprehensible."

"Isn't that even more fun, though? Besides, any game's bound to have villains. Maybe they purposefully make things look so eerie just to intimidate their followers; who knows, maybe the Evil God Ymucklaso really *is* misunderstood by the world. Gods are bound to be too lazy to explain themselves anyway."

"Wait! I just looked up those quest coordinates—that's a school! The Capital's First Primary School, which is packed entirely with cubs under twelve years old!"

"Holy crap! Does that mean the dude above who took the quest to hunt down heretical descendants is actually going after kid cubs?!"

"I'm signing up for the cub-protection evacuation quest! Protecting cute little cubs is everyone's civic duty!"

"Count me in too! I'm right near those coordinates; I'll be there in a second!"
"""

chunks.chineseText:
“兄弟们，操刀子准备！真神教的王八蛋出现了，我们不保护幼崽，我们就去干死那些王八蛋！”

“我怀疑真神教既然发布了这样的任务，他们肯定不止瞄上了一所学校的幼崽。兄弟姐妹们，有没有人跟我一起去其他学校看看的？我感觉那附近肯定有任务接。”

“我已经赶到王城第三中级学校，我也接到了任务，是保护地下通道进出口。”

“来了来了，大军马上就到。”

“该死的阿瑞斯商，他为什么要把传送阵给炸掉！现在我们想过去掺一脚都赶不及。”

“哈哈哈，要你们早不来王城。”

“早来王城也没用，那天谷主摇人去对付情敌，谁想那个人模狗样的阿瑞斯商竟然召唤来了恐惧之神的奴仆，把大家一波全带走了！现在那波人全都死回了出生池，传送阵又被炸毁，想要回来王城只能等谷主修好传送阵。”

“谷主好像也回到玩家营地了。那个传送阵短期内看样子是修不好了。”

“这个破游戏最不好的地方就是跑路太多，还有死亡惩罚时间太长！”

“呃，悄悄说，其实王城不止一个传送阵，真神教这边就有一个，虽然要先从天残谷出生池赶到真神教的秘密驻点，但真神教的秘密驻地距离玩家营地并不远，骑上巨虫，跑个半天就到了。”

“桀桀桀，你们这些傻叉，现在知道加入我真神教有多大的好处了吧？”

“妒忌使我质壁分离。为了传送阵，我也要加入真神教。”

“可以先加入使用传送阵，等到了王城再退教。”

“真神教加入好像就不能退了。”

“我就退，它能拿我怎么样？追杀我？来啊~”

“噢噢噢！在王城的大家快看啊。王宫那边的那片天竟然全变黑了。这可是大白天！”

“桀桀桀，我神教的异端审判员出现了，你们这些不信者、渎神者、异端逆神者，就等着接受审判员的审判和制裁吧！”

“杀了真神教信徒，从我做起！”

“操刀子一起上！”

“就来！”

于是城卫军刚发现邪神信徒有动静，且目标瞄准了城中学校时，就发现在他们大部队赶到学校之前，已经有一群热心市民配合附近的城卫军和那些邪神信徒战做一团。

王宫这边则完全成为了隔离区。

邪神阴影者一出现就开始散播虫毒。

但王宫内的侍卫侍从和来参加大会的人竟然没有一个倒下。

这是怎么回事？

大王子强作镇定，他走上讲台让众人安静，表示：“我们已经撑起防护罩，但邪神阴影者一共有四个，这个防护罩恐怕抵御不了多久。为了保护更多人，我这里有一个请求。”

大王子的请求就是希望在场的大佬能出去对付邪神阴影者，而报酬就是传承让他们先挑、先拓印，除了事先已经说好的会免费赠送一份完整传承，可以再另外免费赠送一份。

与会众人也都知道想要拿到传承，不可能什么代价都不付。

原本那座图书馆的传承是供给全兽人的，按理虎国应该无条件开放给所有人。

但这种事大家也就是嘴巴上叨叨两句，就问任何一人，如果你发现了这么宝贵且巨量的传承，你会免费拿出来吗？

你个人愿意，那你的家族乃至国家是否愿意？

虎王身为一国之王，他愿意公开传承一事已经算十分有大义之心，否则他完全可以什么都不说，就自家闷头发展。

虎王把传承拿出来交易也无可厚非，更不要说他还明言可以免费赠送一份完整传承。

虎国都这么大方了，大家也不好意思连点辛苦钱都不给人家。

原本他们已经做好了低价提供物资、粮食、装备，或放宽和虎国的经济贸易往来，包括提供武力租借等条件。

在虎国附近的国家甚至做好了虎国提出联盟制，他们要如何应对以及是否答应虎王当上第一任联盟主的准备。

而现在，虎国大王子竟然表示他们如果帮忙抵御邪神信徒侵袭，竟然还可以额外赠送一份完整传承，这个报酬不可谓不让人动心。

实际上，邪神阴影者的出现也在与会众人的预料之中。

就算虎国人不提，他们也会和邪神阴影者对上。

不过应该是在耗尽虎国的防守力量，让虎国不得不求助他们的时候。

谁都想借此机会多要一点好处。

白干活那就是不可能的。

哦，他们出手也是在救自己？

那他们可以逃啊。

敢来参加大会的人可都做了不少准备，光是逃离的方法就准备了不下三套。

传承没能拿到？

虎国被灭？

那又怎样呢？

图书馆就在那里，也许虎国灭亡，他们还能去打打那座图书馆的主意。

“四个邪神阴影者，看来真神教也是下了血本，想要在今天多宰杀一些兽人的高层力量。大家不妨猜猜看，如果大家分头逃离，能逃出去多少个人？”

一道戏谑的声音响彻会议大殿。

众人望去，说话人正是刚刚从讲台上走下来回到原位的阿瑞斯商。

“虎国灭亡，各势力高层也跟着死上几个，再加上三年后就会爆发的全大陆灾难，啧啧，我看兽人大陆是真的要完。”

阿瑞斯商拉着身边护卫一起起身，“战斗指挥是门大学问，我自认不擅长，不过当个敢死先锋应该没什么问题。北熊盟主听说非常擅长战斗指挥，你能接过今天的指挥权吗？”

北方联盟盟主心念数转，坦然道：“如果大家都同意，震没问题。”

北熊震就是北联盟盟主的全名。

大王子提出请求，见无人应声，正头疼，见阿瑞斯商竟然上来就直接把北联盟盟主推上指挥者的位置，最奇妙的是，北熊盟主竟然还同意了，顿时大喜。

狮域大都督也主动站起来：“愿做先锋。”

虫王看向阿瑞斯商，想到对方透露出来的那一点气息……站起：“邪神阴影者是所有兽人的大敌。算本王一个。”

南联盟次盟主对身边护卫轻轻点头，那护卫也站了起来：“我，南戎，代表南方联盟参加此战！”

没有人对南方联盟只派出一名护卫表示反对，因为在场不少人都听过南戎的大名，这可是南方联盟公认的第一高手。

其他势力的大佬还在观望和思考。

“不够！”阿瑞斯商断然说，语气特别不客气：“其他人也别做缩头乌龟。如果你们这时候躲着，只想享受成果和安全，那么等会儿讨论如何解决大陆灾难的问题上，那些没有出力的势力必须多出资源和人手，至少得是别人的五倍！”

大王子心惊。阿瑞斯商这是多不怕别人恨他？这家伙不为自己想想，也得为拉斐尔想想啊！

果然当场就有人皱起眉头，很不爽阿瑞斯商说话，似乎就要反驳。

北熊盟主恰好开口，特别淡然地说：“不出也可以，我们可以自取。”

虫王大笑：“自取很好。”

大都督狮域：“我们虎国付出这么大代价，可不是为了当别人的踏脚石。”
chunks.englishText:
"Brothers, unsheathe your blades and get ready! The bastards of the True God Sect have shown up. If we're not protecting the cubs, we're going to chop those bastards to pieces!"

"Since the True God Sect issued a quest like this, I bet they haven't just targeted one school's cubs. Brothers and sisters, anyone want to come with me to check out other schools? I have a feeling there are quests waiting to be accepted over there."

"I've already rushed to the Third Middle School of the Royal City. I've accepted the quest too—it's guarding the entrance and exit of the underground passage."

"Coming, coming! Our army is arriving right away."

"Damn Ares Merchant, why did he have to blow up the teleportation array?! Now we want to rush over and get in on the action, but it's too late."

"Hahaha, that's what you get for not coming to the Royal City early."

"Coming to the Royal City early wouldn't have done any good either. The Valley Master went looking for people to deal with a love rival the other day, and who would have thought that high-and-mighty Ares Merchant would summon the servants of the God of Terror, wiping out everyone in one wave! Now that whole batch of people has died back to the respawn pool, and the teleportation array has been blown up. If we want to return to the Royal City, we can only wait for the Valley Master to fix the teleportation array."

"The Valley Master seems to have returned to the players' camp as well. It looks like that teleportation array won't be fixed anytime soon."

"The worst part about this crappy game is that you have to run too much, and the death penalty respawn timer is way too long!"

"Uh, whispering quietly... actually, there's more than one teleportation array in the Royal City. There's one right here at the True God Sect. Although you first have to rush from the Tiancan Valley respawn pool to the True God Sect's secret stronghold, the True God Sect's secret stronghold isn't far from the players' camp. Just hop on a giant bug and ride for half a day, and you'll be there."

"Heh heh heh, you idiots, do you finally realize how huge the benefits are of joining my True God Sect?"

"Jealousy is tearing me apart at the cellular level. For the sake of the teleportation array, I'm joining the True God Sect too."

"You can just join to use the teleportation array first, and then quit the sect once you reach the Royal City."

"It seems you can't quit once you join the True God Sect."

"I'm quitting anyway. What are they going to do to me? Hunt me down? Bring it on~!"

"Oh oh oh! Everyone in the Royal City, look! The sky over the royal palace has turned completely pitch black. And this is in broad daylight!"

"Heh heh heh, the Inquisition Inquisitors of my Divine Cult have appeared! You unbelievers, blasphemers, and heretical defiers of the gods, just wait to receive the Inquisitors' judgment and sanctions!"

"Killing True God Sect believers starts with me!"

"Draw your blades and charge together!"

"Let's go!"

Thus, just as the City Guard discovered that the evil god cultists were making a move and targeting the schools in the city, they found that before their main force could even reach the schools, a group of enthusiastic citizens had already teamed up with the nearby City Guards to battle the evil god cultists into a chaotic melee.

As for the royal palace area, it had completely become a quarantined zone.

The moment the Evil God Shadow Walkers appeared, they began spreading insect poison.

Yet not a single guard, servant, or attendee participating in the assembly inside the royal palace fell.

What was going on here?

The First Prince forced a calm expression, walked up to the podium to quiet the crowd, and stated: "We have already raised a protective barrier, but there are a total of four Evil God Shadow Walkers. I'm afraid this barrier won't be able to hold out for long. To protect more people, I have a request."

The First Prince's request was for the bigwigs present to step outside and deal with the Evil God Shadow Walkers. The reward was that they would be allowed to pick and copy the heritage texts first. In addition to the previously promised free complete heritage text, they could choose another complete heritage text for free.

Everyone attending the assembly also knew that wanting to acquire the heritage without paying any price was impossible.

Originally, the heritage in that library was meant to be shared by all orcs, so logically, the Tiger Kingdom should have opened it unconditionally to everyone.

But people usually just grumbled about such things with empty words. Just ask anyone: if you discovered such a precious and massive store of heritage, would you give it away for free?

Even if you personally were willing, would your family—or even your nation—be willing?

As the king of a nation, the Tiger King's willingness to make the heritage public was already considered a grand and righteous act; otherwise, he could have kept quiet and developed his own strength in secret.

It was entirely reasonable for the Tiger King to use the heritage for trade, not to mention that he had explicitly stated he would gift a complete heritage copy for free.

Since the Tiger Kingdom was being this generous, everyone else felt a bit embarrassed not to offer some compensation for their trouble.

Originally, they had prepared to provide low-priced supplies, food, and equipment, or to loosen economic and trade ties with the Tiger Kingdom, including terms for military rentals.

The nations near the Tiger Kingdom had even prepared for how to respond if the Tiger Kingdom proposed an alliance system, and whether they would agree to the Tiger King becoming the first Alliance Leader.

And now, the First Prince of the Tiger Kingdom actually announced that if they helped fend off the invasion of the evil god cultists, they would receive an *additional* free complete heritage text. This reward was too tempting to resist.

In truth, the appearance of the Evil God Shadow Walkers was already within the expectations of everyone attending.

Even if the Tiger Kingdom hadn't brought it up, they would have eventually clashed with the Evil God Shadow Walkers.

However, that should have happened only after the Tiger Kingdom's defensive strength was completely exhausted, forcing the Tiger Kingdom to beg them for help.

Everyone wanted to use this opportunity to squeeze out a few more benefits.

Working for free was simply out of the question.

Oh, stepping up meant they were saving themselves too?

Well, they could run.

Anyone daring enough to attend the assembly had made plenty of preparations; they had prepared no less than three sets of escape routes alone.

Couldn't get the heritage?

The Tiger Kingdom destroyed?

So what?

The library was right there. Perhaps even if the Tiger Kingdom fell, they could still go and plot against that library.

"Four Evil God Shadow Walkers—it seems the True God Sect has really broken the bank to slaughter a few more high-ranking orc powerhouses today. Care to guess how many people would actually escape if we all fled in different directions?"

A teasing voice rang through the grand meeting hall.

The crowd looked over, and the speaker was none other than the Ares Merchant, who had just stepped down from the podium and returned to his original seat.

"The Tiger Kingdom falls, the upper echelons of various factions die off one after another, plus the continent-wide disaster that will erupt in three years... Tsk tsk, looks like the Orc Continent is truly finished."

The Ares Merchant pulled his guard up and stood up together. "Combat command is a profound science. I admit I'm not good at it, but acting as a suicide vanguard shouldn't be a problem. I heard the Northern Bear Alliance Leader is exceptionally skilled at combat command; can you take over today's command rights?"

The Northern Bear Alliance Leader turned the thought over in his mind several times before saying candidly, "If everyone agrees, Zhen has no problem with it."

Northern Bear Zhen was the full name of the Northern Alliance Leader.

The First Prince had made his request, and seeing no one respond, he was breaking out in a headache. When he saw the Ares Merchant march right up and directly push the Northern Alliance Leader into the commander's seat—and most miraculously, the Northern Bear Alliance Leader actually agreed—he was instantly overjoyed.

The Lion Territory Grand Governor also took the initiative to stand up: "I am willing to act as vanguard."

The Insect King looked at the Ares Merchant, recalling that faint trace of aura the other party had revealed... and stood up: "The Evil God Shadow Walkers are the mortal enemies of all orcs. Count this king in."

The Southern Alliance Vice-Leader nodded gently to the guard beside him, and that guard also stood up: "I, Nan Rong, represent the Southern Alliance in this battle!"

No one raised an objection to the Southern Alliance sending only a single guard, because many present had heard of Nan Rong's great reputation. This was recognized as the undisputed number one expert of the Southern Alliance.

The bigwigs of other factions were still watching and thinking.

"Not enough!" the Ares Merchant said decisively, his tone exceptionally unpolite. "The rest of you shouldn't act like shrinking turtles either. If you hide right now, wanting only to enjoy the fruits and safety, then when we discuss how to resolve the continental disaster later, those factions that didn't put in any effort must contribute extra resources and manpower—at least five times what everyone else gives!"

The First Prince's heart skipped a beat. Just how fearless was the Ares Merchant when it came to making enemies? Even if this guy didn't care about himself, he should at least think of Raphael!

Sure enough, right on the spot, someone furrowed their brows, highly displeased with the Ares Merchant's words, and looked as though they were about to retort.

The Northern Bear Alliance Leader happened to speak up then, his tone exceptionally nonchalant: "If you don't contribute, that's fine too. We can just take what we need ourselves."

The Insect King laughed heartily: "Taking it ourselves sounds wonderful."

Grand Governor of Lion Territory: "Our Tiger Kingdom paid such a heavy price not to be stepping stones for others."

chunks.chineseText:
南联盟次盟主也跟着表明态度：“不想出力，那就出别的，只想占便宜那就不是生意之道。”

东海部落大首领缓缓站起：“众位说得不错，我东海部落亦支持此点。”

翼国国主在心中叹息，跟着站起：“打吧打吧，尽快安排。老熊你可得看仔细点，别瞎指挥。”

“滚球！不信我的指挥，你可以自己上。”北熊盟主笑骂。

能在大陆上数得上的大佬都站了出来，其他势力的决策者也不好继续躲在后面，只能同意派出人手交给北熊盟主指挥。

大都督对大王子点头。

大王子立刻密语克莱门特。

克莱门特迅速离去。

不到十秒，所有有战斗力的兽人都转移出大殿。

出外的人只要抬头就能看到变黑的天空，和隐约的邪神阴影者的身影。

王宫的天宫像是在颤抖，看不见的护罩暂时挡住了邪神阴影者的攻击。

众人全都跃上了王宫屋顶。

北熊盟主正在观察，对于四名邪神阴影者都有什么能力，他现在还一无所知，总不能就这么把人派出去。

他得做一些针对性分析，再把相应人手派去对付相应的邪神阴影者。

阿瑞斯商走到北熊盟主身边。

北熊盟主抬手，示意身边护卫不用阻拦。

“四个阴影者，我知道其中两个的一些信息。一名是虫毒散播者，没有实体，会化作雾气，不惧水火，它的能力就是散播虫毒让中毒者昏迷乃至死亡。”

北熊盟主没有问阿瑞斯商怎么知道这样的秘密情报，这时候容不得他浪费时间：“虫毒散播者，这玩意可不好对付。以往我们都是熬到邪神阴影者自动离开，再出手处理被虫毒感染的人。”

阿瑞斯商：“我也不知道该怎么消灭邪神阴影者，但是我知道让它快速离去的方法。”

“哦？请说。”

“想要召唤和操纵虫毒散播者需要邪神雕像。邪神信徒通过雕像来操纵虫毒散播者。而给虫毒散播者提供能量的是被放入两口黑巫术箱子里、被残忍虐待至死的尸体，这两具尸体彼此之间应该拥有密切关系，也许是至亲，也许是情侣，通过这两口箱子施展的黑巫术，我们称之为子母怨咒。”

“你是说想要让虫毒散播者消失，最好的方法是找到操纵它的邪神信徒和雕像，以及那两口黑巫术箱子？”

“对。”

“要怎么找到？”

“这件事可以交给我们，我们有一定经验。但在我们找到并摧毁这些东西之前，希望你们能抵住。”

北熊盟主沉思片刻，他不会认为阿瑞斯商这样骄傲的人会在此时找理由避战。

“好！”北熊盟主没有思考多久，当即同意。

“这是第一个，还有一个邪神阴影者，你知道多少？”

阿瑞斯商回答：“还有一个叫变异虫操纵者。看到防护罩东北角上那密密麻麻的黑点了吗？那都是这家伙操纵的变异虫。对方拥有自我意识，可操控大量变异虫为它战斗。我怀疑它原本是虫人，得到邪神力量被改造，建议让虫王对付它。这玩意拥有实体，只要突破它操控的变异虫，应该能杀死它。”

北熊盟主精神一振。对敌就讲究要了解敌人，只要能了解到敌人的部分信息，他也不至于两眼一抹黑。

“另外两个，你真的一点都不了解了吗？哪怕不确实的信息也行。”北熊盟主带着一点点期盼问。

阿瑞斯商没好气道：“你以为真神教的保密措施真的那么差？我能得到两个阴影者的信息就已经花了大价钱好吧。”

那些玩家可都是不见兔子不撒鹰的主，报酬给少了，他们就懒得接相关任务。

不过玩家到底打入真神教的时间还短，没能打听出真神教攻打虎国王宫的全部计划，但能弄到两个阴影者的信息也很了不起了。

关于邪神阴影者，那可是真神教的绝密，非上层不可知。

北熊盟主哈哈一笑，拍拍阿瑞斯商的肩膀，语气一转：“防护罩已经打开，你要怎么离开王宫？”

“虎国高层自然有让人秘密出去的办法，你们不也要出去对付阴影者。”阿瑞斯商不再多话，和护卫转身离开。

走之前，阿瑞斯商又从怀里掏出一个小袋子，抛给北熊盟主。

“这是虫毒祛除药剂，一瓶可治疗一人。一共五瓶，你看着分配。不是白给的，一瓶一百金，用不完就还我。”

北熊盟主猛地瞪大眼睛。卧槽，震惊我全家！刚刚这狂徒在说什么？

但阿瑞斯商大概已经料到他抛出这个小袋子的后果，说完就拉着他的护卫跑没影了。

北熊盟主一把抓住身边侍卫的衣襟，不可置信地问：“你听到那小子刚才说什么了吗？”

侍卫：说实话，他也在怀疑自己的耳朵。
chunks.englishText:
The Southern Alliance Vice-Leader also stated his stance: "If you don't want to exert effort, then contribute something else. Wanting only to reap the benefits is no way to do business."

The Great Chieftain of the East Sea Tribe slowly stood up: "Everyone speaks well. My East Sea Tribe also supports this point."

The ruler of the Winged Kingdom sighed inwardly and stood up as well: "Fight, then, fight. Make the arrangements quickly. Old Bear, you better keep your eyes open; don't go issuing blind commands."

"Piss off! If you don't trust my command, you can step up yourself," the Northern Bear Alliance Leader cursed with a smile.

Since all the heavyweight bigwigs of the continent had stood up, the policy-makers of other factions could no longer afford to hide in the back and were forced to agree to dispatch personnel under the command of the Northern Bear Alliance Leader.

The Grand Governor nodded to the First Prince.

The First Prince immediately sent a secret mental message to Clement.

Clement departed swiftly.

In less than ten seconds, all orcs with combat capabilities were transferred out of the grand hall.

Anyone who stepped outside only needed to raise their head to see the blackened sky and the faint, looming figures of the Evil God Shadow Walkers.

The palace's celestial buildings seemed to tremble as an invisible protective barrier temporarily blocked the attacks of the Evil God Shadow Walkers.

Everyone leaped onto the roof of the royal palace.

The Northern Bear Alliance Leader was observing. He currently knew nothing about the abilities of the four Evil God Shadow Walkers, and he certainly couldn't just send people out blindly like that.

He had to perform some targeted analysis before dispatching the appropriate personnel to deal with the corresponding Evil God Shadow Walkers.

The Ares Merchant walked up to the Northern Bear Alliance Leader.

The Northern Bear Alliance Leader raised a hand, signaling his guards not to block the way.

"Four Shadow Walkers. I have some information on two of them. One is the Insect Poison Spreader. It has no physical form, can transform into mist, and fears neither water nor fire. Its ability is to spread insect poison, causing those infected to fall unconscious or even die."

The Northern Bear Alliance Leader didn't ask how the Ares Merchant obtained such secret intelligence; this was no time for him to waste time: "The Insect Poison Spreader—that thing is not easy to deal with. In the past, we always had to wait until the Evil God Shadow Walkers left on their own before stepping in to treat the people infected with the insect poison."

The Ares Merchant: "I don't know how to exterminate an Evil God Shadow Walker either, but I know how to make it leave quickly."

"Oh? Please speak."

"Summoning and manipulating the Insect Poison Spreader requires an evil god statue. Evil god cultists use the statue to manipulate the Insect Poison Spreader. Meanwhile, what provides energy to the Insect Poison Spreader are corpses placed inside two black witchcraft boxes, having been cruelly tortured to death. These two corpses should have a close relationship with each other—perhaps immediate family, or lovers. The black witchcraft cast through these two boxes is what we call the Mother-Child Grievance Curse."

"You're saying that if we want the Insect Poison Spreader to disappear, the best method is to find the evil god cultist manipulating it, the statue, and those two black witchcraft boxes?"

"Correct."

"How do we find them?"

"You can leave this matter to us; we have some experience. But before we find and destroy these things, we hope you can hold the line."
