Having observed up to this point, they still couldn't figure out what madness the Grand Duke's son was up to.

However, Shang Feifan noticed that those captured people either had red names floating above them or carried thick, heavy vengeful auras.

In short, ever since they arrived, every single person killed by Imanchest was deserving of death.

As for the people who ambushed Imanchest, every single one of them had red names.

Shang Feifan had originally thought Imanchest was entangled with the Heretic God's cultists—perhaps even a cultist himself, and quite possibly a high-ranking member of the True God Church.

Yet based on what they were currently seeing, the truth seemed to be the exact opposite of their guess?

Who knew what was going through Imanchest's mind; upon discovering that someone was helping him block the assailant, he completely ignored the people attacking him and focused solely on slaughtering the captured individuals.

Shang Feifan was particularly amused to find that several of the ambushers were actually players.

Players truly were a chaotic faction; they gravitated toward whatever was most lively, completely disregarding notions of justice and kindness, caring only about quest rewards and how fun a mission was.

This had nothing to do with the players' actual personalities; rather, it was because players all assumed this was a game world and all life mere data.

Of course, there were also players who were wicked individuals back in the Earth Star dimension. Upon entering the game, they unleashed their true natures even more. Even though many suspected whether this might be a real world, they showed no mercy; instead, they found even greater stimulation in the fact that the lives they abused or killed were genuinely real.

Seeing Shang Feifan handling those ambushers with ease, Lang Mu went to support Imanchest.

Unlike Shang Feifan, whose strikes were heavy, Lang Mu simply stood in mid-air, casting magic while remaining invisible, sweeping the attackers and assassins targeting Imanchest off to the side, binding them or knocking them unconscious.

Imanchest had no idea who was helping him, only seeing that the plants throughout the courtyard suddenly seemed to possess extraordinarily vigorous vitality, their stems, vines, branches, and leaves all capable of entangling and harming people.

Countless grassroots surged from the ground to bind the beastmen's hands and feet.

As for the rose bushes growing along the perimeter walls, their thorny vines wrapped around anyone they touched, making the victims shriek in agonizing pain.

The previously stunted, withered flower trees grew luxuriantly, bursting into countless blossoms. The delicate fragrance turned heavy and intense; smelling too much of it induced dizziness and even... unconsciousness.

Thud. Thud.

More and more people collapsed.

When the floral fragrance became so concentrated that even Imanchest found it hard to bear, everyone still standing dropped to the ground.

Yet Imanchest stubbornly finished killing all the remaining captured people, using an alchemical weapon to set fire to their corpses.

A gust of wind blew by, carrying the intense floral fragrance out of the Grand Duke's estate.

The vines moved like serpents, automatically gathering the living people on the ground and piling them in the corner of the wall so they wouldn't be caught in the cremation flames.

Only after executing his final target did Imanchest look across the massive courtyard.

"I don't know who you are, but... believe me, you didn't do anything wrong."

Dropping this baffling remark, Imanchest turned and walked toward the house, not even sparing a glance at his own mother lying unconscious in the corner of the wall.

"You aren't planning to commit self-immolation, are you?" A figure abruptly blocked Imanchest's path.

Imanchest stared steadily at the newcomer, then suddenly smiled: "Master Ares Shang."

Ares Shang twirled the bone staff in his hand: "Precisely yours truly."

Imanchest glanced around: "Where is your Raphael?"

The corners of Ares Shang's mouth curled upward. He was starting to like this person named Iman; what a smooth talker.

"Good day, Lord Iman." Lang Mu materialized out of thin air, standing right beside Ares Shang.

Iman nodded to Lang Mu: "Good day."

Before the two could ask anything, Iman took the initiative to speak: "Do you both have a belly full of questions? Although I don't know why you ended up here, and arrived at such a coincidental moment, but... it's fortunate that it's you. I don't have much time; you ask, I answer, and I'll tell you as much as I can."

Iman added with profound meaning: "If it were anyone else, I wouldn't say a single word. The higher-ups of this nation have completely rotted away; I can no longer tell who is good and who is evil."

Lang Mu had no idea what Iman meant by "not having much time," but wasting no moments, he immediately asked the question he most wanted answered: "Why take action against your own family?"

Iman curled his lip: "I didn't want to either, but if they don't die, even more of our Tiger Country people will. Hmm, this matter involves a lot of things. Let me think about how to explain it."

A few seconds later, Iman began: "Grand Duke Chester once fell gravely ill, and coupled with his advanced age, he nearly died. That was roughly thirty years ago. His butler introduced him to a divine physician, and that divine physician was Anita."

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan wore calm expressions, but exchanged glances. They hadn't expected Anita to have hooked up with the big shots of the Tiger Country's royal capital so long ago.

"In truth, Anita gained the opportunity to approach the Tiger King precisely through a banquet hosted by my father," Iman revealed another small secret.

"Anita administered a potion to my father, allowing him to escape death. But Anita also told my father that escaping death was only temporary; if he wanted a longer, healthier youth like a young person's, he could only obtain it through a god's bestowal. And this god, as you can probably guess, was the Heretic God Emuclaso."

Derision surfaced in Iman's eyes: "The Grand Duke desperately wanted to live on with eternal youth, but he was also deeply wary of the Heretic God. He wanted to strike a balance between the two—utilizing the Heretic God's power without letting the Heretic God manipulate him too much. Thus, he sought counsel from someone else. That person was said to be the most formidable sorcerer of the current era, capable of wielding bizarre arts that had long been lost yet possessed terrifying might."

"That sorcerer actually came up with a method for the Grand Duke, called the Soul-Transfer Technique. It could transfer the Grand Duke's soul into a younger beastman's body."

The two men looked at Iman with knowing gazes.

Iman shrugged: "It seems you've already guessed. That's right; I was the vessel specifically cultivated by the Grand Duke to transfer his soul. That sorcerer told the Grand Duke that the Soul-Transfer Technique does not work on just any body. The optimal choice is a direct bloodline; the closer the physical condition, innate talent, and soul magnetic field are to one's own, the better. If the vessel is even willing of their own accord to surrender their body, the success rate of the soul transfer is even higher."

chunks.chineseText:
“大公已经习惯了雄性兽人的身体，自然不想要转变成雌性。这也是他如此渴求雄性之子的原因。”

“而且按照那名咒术师所说，培养一具适合自己灵魂的身体，也需要一些前期准备。所以他放弃了前面三个女儿，期盼着第四个孩子。”

“可也许是业务不熟练，也许是第一位大公夫人的身体承受不住，在她怀上被做了手脚的第四个孩子时，那个孩子在她腹中异变，连带她这个母亲也一起害死。”

“大公就娶了这位夫人的亲妹妹，理由是他认为姐妹身体天赋都差不多，做生不如做熟。可惜的是，第二位夫人虽然成功连续生下两个孩子，但两个孩子都是雌性，且天赋不算特别优越。”

“大公就用了比较狠的新配方，结果第二位夫人出现了和第一位夫人同样的问题，身体因为承受不住变异胎儿，在生孩子时被活生生疼死。”

听到这里，郎沐皱眉：“孩子生下来了？”

伊曼点头：“对，还是一个雄子。可惜的是，那雄子天生异样，且刚出生就凶残无比，张口就要撕咬自己母亲的尸体。大公恐惧这个异变之子，就把他杀了，和第二位夫人一起焚烧尸体再秘密安葬。”

商非凡插话：“第一位大公夫人的尸体和她腹中胎儿也被焚烧了吗？”

伊曼再次点头。

商非凡自语：“看来这胎儿的异变应该是虫人方向。”

伊曼冷笑没否认，接着说道：“大公觉得前两个妻子资质不佳，就精挑细选了现在的妻子。”

伊曼顿了顿：“我母亲并不是出身大贵族，就是一个小富商女儿。原本她根本不够资格嫁给大公，但因为大公对外说已经死了两个妻子，现在已不求妻族身份，只求一个能伴随自己到老的健康妻子。其他人就都相信了这个理由。”

“而我母亲的家族自然非常高兴能攀上大公，我母亲自己也是个……聪明人，她认为大公比她大了两百多岁，按照兽人最多活三百岁的寿命来计算，只要她嫁过去生下一儿半女，要不了多久她就会成为大公府身份最高的人，大公府的一切都会是她的。所以她也欣然嫁了，全然不知她就是一个培育转魂容器的工具，更不可能活得过大公。”

伊曼终于看向昏倒在一边的母亲，可他并没有任何多余动作，就跟看一个陌生人一样。

“她的身体条件和天赋确实很优秀，所以她能在生下两个孩子后还能活到现在。”

商非凡看到伊曼神色，推测：“她是不是知道了？”

伊曼轻嗯：“在我姐姐被生下来后，那个女人看清楚那个孩子的模样，就知道了。可笑的是，我姐姐除了性别，其他都符合我那位父亲的要求，但我母亲却觉得我姐姐丑陋无比，更诡异又可怕。她趁着我父亲短暂离开的时候，亲手闷死了我姐姐、她的亲生女儿。因为她觉得这个孩子会影响她坐稳大公夫人这个位子。”

郎沐深吸气。

商非凡神色平常。

“大公为此愤怒无比，他虽然不想转魂到雌性身上，但多一个备胎总是好的。可这个备胎却被他自作聪明的小妻子给杀死。”伊曼脸上再次露出讥讽神色。

“但因为有了一次成功，且他刚娶了第三个妻子，也不好再娶一个夫人，而大公希望自己的灵魂容器生下来就具有大公府光明正大的第一继承权，他也不好暗中找人给他生孩子。”

伊曼突然露出古怪笑容：“当然，这也跟大公的年龄有关，他已经两百多岁，而兽人过了两百岁想要生孩子就非常困难。他能和三任妻子连续生出好几个孩子，已经算兽人中比较厉害的，另外就是他使用了秘法。为此，他就算想要在外面广撒网，也比较困难，因为身体条件不太允许。”

伊曼悠悠说：“那可是大公，他一点都不想在外面留下他不行的传言。”

郎沐：“咳。”

伊曼笑了笑，完全没有揭露自己父亲不行的愧疚：“我就是他最后一个收获。再之后，他就算再怎么想要一个容器，也创造不出来了，他已经彻底无法再播种。”

所以哪怕他的身体条件不太符合大公的期盼，哪怕他一出生就病歪歪，他的大公父亲还是在他身上倾注了所有心血和关爱，把他如珠似宝地养大。

伊曼语调一转：“到此为止，似乎我父亲的谋划已经成功大半，接下来他只要等到时机合适的那一天，把自己的灵魂转移到我这个儿子身上就行，他就能最少再活两三百年，然后再培养新容器，子子孙孙无穷尽。但邪神的船岂是想上就上、想下就下？”

郎沐：“那个咒术师是不是就是真神会高层？”

伊曼笑：“你看，这是多么明显的事实。可我父亲，他却没有看出来。”

商非凡：“他已经入笼。且犯蠢的聪明人有个通病，通常只愿意看到自己想看的，而去故意忽略一切警告。”

伊曼把玩着手中能放火的炼金武器，漫不经心地说出能震惊世人的绝大秘密：“也许吧。他以为自己培养的是转移自己灵魂的容器，却不知别人也在借他的手培养让邪神意识和力量降临的神之容器。”

郎沐一惊。

商非凡心想原来如此。怪不得系统会给他发布那样的任务内容。

“你想焚烧自己，是不是因为不想当神降的容器？”郎沐问。

伊曼点头，冷笑：“想让我当容器，做梦！”

他就是他，这具身体也是他自己的，别人想抢，也看他愿不愿意给。

“你是怎么知道自己是神降的容器？”郎沐接着问。

伊曼竖起手指：“这就跟你之前问的第一个问题联系起来了。我父亲并不满意我这个病殃殃的容器，他自己不能生，就把主意打到了他的女儿们身上。他想让他的女儿们帮他生出一个合格的容器。”

“于是他又去请教那个咒术师，和对方深度合作，拿到了新的配方。他甚至亲手安排了女儿们的婚事，为容器的培育者精挑细选。可他不知道，他挑选出来的女婿都是真神教那边给他准备的人。包括四姐现在的恋人，也是真神教信徒。”

伊曼讽笑：“这也是我几个姐姐婚后也能居住在大公府的原因。别人只当是大公给女儿的补偿，却不知这是大公不想容器跑掉。”

商非凡闻言感叹：“真神教还没有占领整个兽人大陆，真的是神灵保佑。”

伊曼接口：“可不是。”

郎沐干咳：“也因为真神教在虎国这边下了血本吧。”

商非凡耸肩，他家阿沐说什么就是什么吧，反正他是不会当着郎沐的面说虎国人比较蠢直这点的。

郎沐叹息，问伊曼：“所以你杀死你那些亲人，只因为他们也是邪神的容器？”

“没错。而且这些蠢货还被他们身边的人忽悠得心甘情愿，并把成为邪神容器一事当做了莫大荣誉。”伊曼冷笑。

“因为他们的父亲和身边仆人护卫成天给他们灌输？”商非凡问。
chunks.englishText:
"The Grand Duke was already accustomed to the body of a male beastman, so naturally he had no desire to transform into a female. This was why he was so desperate for a male heir."

"Furthermore, according to that sorcerer, cultivating a body suitable for one's own soul required some preparatory work. Therefore, he abandoned his first three daughters and pinned his hopes on a fourth child."

"Perhaps due to unfamiliarity with the process, or perhaps because the first Grand Duke's wife's body could not withstand it, when she conceived the tampered fourth child, that infant mutated within her womb, dragging her, the mother, down to her death as well."

"The Grand Duke then married that wife's own younger sister, reasoning that since sisters shared similar physical talents, dealing with the familiar was better than the unfamiliar. Regrettably, although the second wife successfully birthed two children in a row, both were females, and their talents weren't particularly outstanding."

"The Grand Duke then employed a harsher, newer formula. As a result, the second wife suffered the exact same problem as the first; her body could not endure the mutated fetus, and she was burned alive by excruciating pain while giving birth."

Hearing this, Lang Mu frowned: "Was the child born?"

Iman nodded: "Yes, it was still a male child. Unfortunately, that male child was born with abnormalities, and right at birth he was savagely fierce, opening his mouth to tear into his mother's corpse. Terrified of this mutated child, the Grand Duke killed him, cremated his body alongside the second wife's, and buried them in secret."

Shang Feifan interjected: "Were the corpse of the first Grand Duke's wife and the fetus in her womb cremated as well?"

Iman nodded once more.

Shang Feifan muttered to himself: "It seems the mutation of this fetus was leaning toward the direction of the Insect-men."

Iman sneered without denying it, continuing: "Feeling that his first two wives lacked sufficient aptitude, the Grand Duke carefully handpicked his current wife."

Iman paused: "My mother didn't come from a grand aristocratic family; she was simply the daughter of a minor wealthy merchant. Originally, she wasn't qualified to marry the Grand Duke at all. However, because the Grand Duke publicly claimed that two wives had already died and he no longer sought a wife of prominent lineage, desiring only a healthy companion to grow old with him, everyone else believed this excuse."

"And her family was naturally overjoyed to climb up to the Grand Duke. My mother herself was... a clever person; she believed the Grand Duke was over two hundred years older than her, and calculating based on the maximum lifespan of three hundred years for a beastman, as long as she married over and bore a child or two, it wouldn't be long before she became the person of highest status in the Grand Duke's estate, and everything here would belong to her. Thus, she happily accepted the marriage, entirely unaware that she was merely a tool for cultivating a soul-transfer vessel, and stood no chance of outliving the Grand Duke."

Iman finally glanced at the mother lying unconscious off to the side, yet he made no extra movements, looking at her as if she were a complete stranger.

"Her physical condition and talents were indeed exceptional, which is why she managed to survive until now after giving birth to two children."

Seeing Iman's expression, Shang Feifan guessed: "Did she find out?"

Iman let out a soft 'en': "After my sister was born, that woman saw the child's appearance and figured it out. Ironically, aside from her gender, everything else about my sister met my father's requirements, yet my mother thought my sister was utterly hideous, bizarre, and terrifying. Taking advantage of a brief moment when my father was away, she smothered my sister—her own flesh and blood—with her own hands, because she felt that child would jeopardize her position as the Grand Duke's wife."

Lang Mu took a deep breath.

Shang Feifan's expression remained ordinary.

"The Grand Duke was furious about this. Although he didn't want to transfer his soul into a female, having an extra spare tire was always good. Yet this spare tire had been killed by his own clever-by-half young wife," a derisive look surfaced on Iman's face once more.

"However, having had one success, and having just married his third wife, it wasn't appropriate to take another bride immediately. Moreover, the Grand Duke hoped his soul vessel would be born with the legitimate, righteous primary inheritance right of the Grand Duke's estate, so it wasn't convenient for him to secretly find someone else to bear him a child."

Iman suddenly broke into a quirky smile: "Of course, this also had to do with the Grand Duke's age. He was already over two hundred years old, and for a beastman to want children past two hundred is extremely difficult. The fact that he managed to continuously father several children with three wives already made him relatively formidable among beastmen, not to mention he had used secret techniques. Because of this, even if he wanted to cast a wide net outside, it was quite difficult, as his physical condition didn't quite permit it."

Iman said leisurely: "He was the Grand Duke, after all; he didn't want rumors spreading outside that he couldn't perform."

Lang Mu: "Ahem."

Iman chuckled, completely devoid of any guilt about exposing his father's impotence: "I was his final harvest. After me, no matter how desperately he wanted a vessel, he could no longer create one; he had completely lost the ability to sow seeds."

Therefore, even though his physical condition didn't quite meet the Grand Duke's expectations, and even though he was sickly from birth, his Grand Duke father still poured all his painstaking effort and care into him, raising him like a precious pearl.

Iman's tone shifted: "Up to this point, it seemed my father's scheming had largely succeeded. Next, all he had to do was wait for a suitable day to transfer his soul into me, his son, allowing him to live for at least another two to three hundred years, and then cultivate a new vessel—descendants ad infinitum. But is boarding the Heretic God's ship something you can just step on and off at will?"

Lang Mu: "Is that sorcerer a high-ranking member of the True God Church?"

Iman smiled: "Look, how obvious a fact is that? Yet my father, he failed to see it."

Shang Feifan: "He has already stepped into the cage. Moreover, clever people who act foolishly share a common malady: they usually only wish to see what they want to see, while deliberately ignoring all warnings."

Toying with the fire-emitting alchemical weapon in his hand, Iman casually uttered an earth-shattering secret: "Perhaps. He thought he was cultivating a vessel to transfer his own soul, unaware that others were also borrowing his hands to cultivate a divine vessel for the descent of the Heretic God's consciousness and power."

Lang Mu was startled.

Shang Feifan thought to himself, *So that's how it was.* No wonder the system had issued that kind of quest to him.

"You wanted to commit self-immolation—was it because you didn't want to be the vessel for the divine descent?" Lang Mu asked.

Iman nodded, sneering: "Want me to be a vessel? In their dreams!"

He was himself, and this body belonged to him. If others wanted to snatch it, they'd have to see whether he was willing to give it.

"How did you find out you were a vessel for the divine descent?" Lang Mu continued.

Iman raised a finger: "This ties back to the first question you asked earlier. My father wasn't satisfied with me as a sickly vessel, and since he couldn't reproduce anymore, he turned his sights onto his daughters. He wanted his daughters to help him birth a qualified vessel."

"So he consulted that sorcerer again, cooperated deeply with him, and obtained a new formula. He even personally arranged his daughters' marriages, meticulously handpicking the cultivators of the vessels. Yet he didn't know that the sons-in-law he selected were all people prepared for him by the True God Church. Even my fourth sister's current lover is a cultist of the True God Church."

Iman scoffed derisively: "This is also why my sisters were able to reside in the Grand Duke's estate even after marriage. Outsiders simply thought it was compensation from the Grand Duke to his daughters, unaware that this was the Grand Duke's way of ensuring his vessels wouldn't run away."

Hearing this, Shang Feifan sighed: "It is truly divine protection that the True God Church hasn't yet conquered the entire Beastman Continent."

Iman chimed in: "You can say that again."

Lang Mu gave a dry cough: "It's probably also because the True God Church invested a heavy price here in Tiger Country."

Shang Feifan shrugged; whatever his Ah Mu said went. Besides, he certainly wouldn't say to Lang Mu's face that the people of Tiger Country were somewhat foolish and straightforward.

Lang Mu sighed and asked Iman: "So you killed those close relatives of yours just because they were also vessels for the Heretic God?"

"Precisely. And these idiots were even willingly hoodwinked by the people around them, treating becoming a Heretic God's vessel as the highest honor." Iman sneered.

"Because their father and the servants and bodyguards around them kept brainwashing them day in and day out?" Shang Feifan asked.

伊曼：“就是如此。他们已经废了，被彻底洗脑，再也不可能清醒过来，留着就是祸害。”

商非凡一指躺在地上的切斯特家三个女婿……如今还只剩下两个：“为什么不杀他们？”

伊曼不屑：“这不是他们躲得太好吗，我杀了他们的孩子，他们都不敢出来，直到我几个姐姐跳出来，他们才不得不露面。”

他刚才只是没有来得及去杀这几个真神教底层。

“那些才是重点。”伊曼指向已经被他杀死的外甥外甥女和他们的仆人护卫：“他们是请邪神降临的关键，他们想要献祭整座王城的兽人。”

伊曼又指了指自己：“我也是他们的备胎之一。而且我还是最适合的一个，别看我身体弱，实际上我的天赋比谁都强。至于我为什么会知道这么多？”

伊曼表情怪异：“就因为我那些外甥和外甥女太蠢，他们竟然跑到我面前，向我炫耀他们神降容器的身份，说自己才是真正的圣子圣女，让我不要为自己的大公第一继承人身份得意。”

商非凡和郎沐：“……”

伊曼：“他们故意把我的外甥和外甥女养得蠢笨不会自己思考，却也正因为如此，让他们干出蠢事。也算一报还一报？”

商非凡举手：“那几个在你之前出生的，他们也是容器？”

伊曼：“当然。我父亲在我出生前还没有培育第三代容器的计划，但真神教有。我那几个姐姐为了获得父亲宠爱，对于父亲介绍的对象哪敢拒绝，何况真神教选出来的人，起码外表和家世都能过得去。”

郎沐紧跟着问：“你是什么时候知道这一切的？”

伊曼慢悠悠说：“很早。在他们向我炫耀时，我故意装作自己早已知道神降容器的事，还在那几个小蠢货面前摆出傲然之态，看不起他们，嘲笑他们。这让他们有什么事都会跑来向我炫耀，我再假装自己早已知道。”

“前段时间，我察觉我父亲行动和神情有异，就去找那几个小蠢货聊了聊，顺便挑拨了一圈，他们就在我面前暴露出真神教的神降和献祭计划。”

伊曼看起来像是在嘲讽，眼中却流露出淡淡的悲伤。

看着自己的血脉亲人被人忽悠得心甘情愿献出自己的生命，把自己的身体交出去当容器，还以此为荣，那还不如在他们还是自己时，让他们死去。

这就是伊曼动手的根由。

伊曼最后看向自己的母亲。

她没有被别人忽悠傻，她只是被自己期待的利益给迷惑了神智。明知自己的丈夫对她怀着的孩子有图谋，明知她的怀孕不正常，仍旧想要生下一个继承人，还非要生下一个雄子，就因为她以为自己丈夫想要一个雄子，她想要邀宠。

她无视府中一切不正常，忍耐自己丈夫对自己的轻蔑和冷漠，忽视自己儿子对自己不亲近的事实，就生活在“再熬几年，熬到丈夫死亡，她就能获得一切”的美梦中。

到时她可以把府中那些前夫人生的孩子全都赶出去，可以以母亲的名义让儿子听自己的话，可以以大公夫人的身份傲视王城中绝大多数的贵妇人。

伊曼就因为了解这个女人在想什么、期待什么，才无法对她生出感情。

而且不知道是不是因为秘法的缘故，他有时会觉得自己就是那个被亲生母亲闷死的孩子，他有着他姐姐那短暂一生的记忆。

更没有任何人知道，他一出生就有了健全的神智和记忆。周围人说的话、做的事，他都记得，也都听得懂。

而大人又怎么会防备一个刚出生不久的小婴儿？

他知道的可要比那些大人以为的多多了。

他甚至听到过大管家和邪神信徒的交流，那些仆人和护卫大半都是这位大管家安排进来的。

他的父亲切斯特大公前两百年也许能称得上一声英明雄武，但两百岁过后的他，随着年岁越来越增长，他就变成了过去的自己最讨厌的那种人。

更可笑的是，他并不知道自己信任的大管家和某些心腹也跟他这个主子一样，为了寿命、青春、亲人、情人、利益和权力等，也都投向了真神教。

他还以为自己是钓鱼翁，却不知自己早已在局中。
chunks.englishText:
Iman: "Just like that. They were already ruined, thoroughly brainwashed, and completely incapable of ever waking up. Keeping them around would only spell disaster."

Shang Feifan pointed at the three sons-in-law of the Chester family lying on the ground—though only two remained now: "Why didn't you kill them?"

Iman spoke with disdain: "Isn't it because they hid too well? When I killed their children, none of them dared to show their faces; it wasn't until my sisters jumped out that they were forced to reveal themselves."

He simply hadn't had time to deal with those low-level members of the True God Church just yet.

"Those ones are the main point," Iman pointed toward the nephews, nieces, servants, and bodyguards he had already slain: "They are the key to summoning the Heretic God's descent. They intended to sacrifice all the beastmen of the entire royal capital."

Iman pointed to himself next: "I am also one of their spare vessels. Furthermore, I am the most suitable one. Don't let my frail body fool you; in truth, my talent surpasses anyone else's. As for why I know so much?"

Iman's expression turned bizarre: "It's simply because those nephews and nieces of mine were too foolish. They actually ran right up to me, flaunted their identities as divine descent vessels, claimed they were the true Holy Sons and Holy Virgins, and told me not to be so smug about being the Grand Duke's primary heir."

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu: "..."

Iman: "They deliberately raised my nephews and nieces to be so foolish and incapable of independent thought, yet precisely because of that, those brutes committed such stupid deeds. I suppose that's what you call retribution?"

Shang Feifan raised a hand: "Were those ones born before you vessels as well?"

Iman: "Of course. My father didn't have plans to cultivate a third-generation vessel before I was born, but the True God Church did. In order to win our father's favor, how could my sisters possibly refuse the targets introduced by him? Not to mention that the people selected by the True God Church at least passed muster in appearance and family background."

Lang Mu quickly followed up: "When did you find out about all this?"

Iman said leisurely: "Very early on. When they flaunted it to me, I deliberately pretended that I had already known about the divine descent vessels, putting on an arrogant posture in front of those little fools, looking down on them and mocking them. That made them run to me to show off whenever anything happened, and I would just fake that I had known it all along."

"A while ago, I noticed my father's actions and expressions were abnormal, so I went to chat with those little fools and incidentally stirred up some trouble. That was how they exposed the True God Church's divine descent and sacrificial plans right in front of me."

Iman looked as though he were mocking them, yet a faint sorrow leaked from his eyes.

Watching his own blood-related family members get hoodwinked into willingly offering up their own lives, surrendering their bodies to act as vessels, and taking pride in it—rather than letting that happen, it was better to put them out of their misery while they were still themselves.

This was the root cause of why Iman took action.

Finally, Iman looked toward his mother.

She hadn't been driven stupid by others; her mind had simply been clouded by the benefits she anticipated. Knowing full well that her husband harbored ulterior motives toward the child she carried, knowing full well her pregnancy was unnatural, she still insisted on giving birth to an heir—and stubbornly demanded a male child at that—simply because she believed her husband desired a male heir, and she wanted to curry favor.

She ignored all the abnormalities within the estate, endured her husband's contempt and indifference toward her, and disregarded the fact that her own son was not close to her, living entirely inside a sweet daydream of "just holding out a few more years until my husband dies, and I'll get everything."

When that time came, she could drive out all the children born to the former wives, command her son to obey her using the name of a mother, and look down upon the vast majority of noblewomen in the royal capital with the status of the Grand Duke's wife.

It was precisely because Iman understood what this woman was thinking and what she anticipated that he could not generate any affection for her.

Moreover, whether due to the secret technique or something else, he sometimes felt as though he himself was that child smothered to death by his biological mother, carrying the memories of his sister's brief life.

And no one whatsoever knew that he had possessed complete sanity and memories right from birth. Everything the people around him said and did, he remembered and understood.

How could adults possibly be on guard against a newborn infant?

What he knew far surpassed what those adults imagined.

He had even overheard the communications between the head butler and the heretic cultists; the majority of those servants and bodyguards had been arranged by this head butler.

His father, Grand Duke Chester, might have been called brilliant and mighty for his first two hundred years, but past the age of two hundred, as the years grew ever heavier, he had transformed into the very kind of person he used to loathe most.

What was even more laughable was that he remained oblivious to the fact that the head butler and certain trusted aides whom he trusted implicitly were just like their master—surrendering themselves to the True God Church in pursuit of longevity, youth, family, lovers, profit, and power.

He thought himself an angler casting a line, completely unaware that he had long since been trapped within the board.

chunks.chineseText:
第205章 邪神的圣物

伊曼看看天，“对了，你们记得等会儿把我四姐和五姐也杀了吧。她们身上也被动过手脚，虽然资质低了不少，但也有可能变成容器。”

商非凡看着伊曼云淡风轻、什么都不在乎的模样，摇摇头。

哀莫大于心死，伊曼也是这句话的另一个代表了。

想着，他就下意识握住郎沐的手。

“还有，我们家那个大管家，还有我两个姐夫，也一并杀了吧。我两个姐夫应该只是真神教底层加外部人员，知道的不多，他们的家族早就该衰败下去，在真神教帮助下才再次站了起来，还能娶到大公府的女公子。那个大管家，你们要是感兴趣的话，倒是可以审一审。”

伊曼想了想，觉得自己交代得差不多，就继续迈步朝屋里走。

他已经给自己选好了死亡的地方，就是他的书房，那里也是他最喜欢的房间，里面摆放了所有他最喜欢的物品。

他要带着这些一起离开。

“伊曼阁下，等等。”郎沐叫住他。

伊曼回头，“有什么事吗？如果是劝我，那就不必要了，我早就做好准备，而且我不想后面两百多年一直活在自己内壳随时随地都可能换个人的惶恐中。”

郎沐忽然说：“真神教为了今天，布局了这么久，这么大、这么秘密的事情，怎么会就这么被暴露？”

伊曼原本要走，又停住脚步，眉头微微皱起：“我以为我已经解释过这点。”

嗯？商非凡心中一动，脑中似乎有什么东西冒出来，一边想一边说：“伊曼阁下聪慧，他很早就察觉到蛛丝马迹，我猜他应该一直在暗中调查，等抓住一两个线头后自然就能一点点抽丝剥茧了解真相。如果换了一个人，恐怕早就被洗脑成功，或什么都不知道的活到身体被夺的那一天。”

伊曼点头：就是这样。

商非凡微微一笑。讲真，他还挺欣赏这个看似身体不佳的公子哥，会忍，会装，头脑清楚，意志坚定，且果断无比。

这样的人，就这么死了是有点可惜。

商非凡一边想着有什么方法能就挽救这位大公之子，一边总有种还有什么重要情报被他们忽略的感觉。

就听郎沐声音略微沉重地说：“两位，我们是不是忘了一件事？”

商非凡随口问：“什么事？”

郎沐：“你还记得吗，克莱门特跟我们说过，切斯特大公还有一个外孙在外地，且他的妻子还是墨文伯爵的女儿。”

商非凡一愣，他终于明白他忽略的重要情报是什么了，就是这个！

伊曼挑眉，他也差点忘了这个外甥。

他还记得这个由二姐生下来的外甥以赛亚最受大公喜欢，但某一天忽然就让他娶了墨文伯爵家的小姐，并把他打发去了迪安要寨。

那么早就能去领地当家做主，这在任何贵族看来都是一件好事，但去哪里也要看地方。

迪安要寨就是那种特别贫瘠贫苦的边境，那里还有王庭军队驻扎，一般的贵族子弟都不喜欢被分到类似那样的领地当小领主。

所以当他这个外甥带着新娶的妻子被派去那边暂代领主之职时，以赛亚的同辈几乎没有谁羡慕妒忌，反而猜测以赛亚是不是被大公厌弃了。

时间过去了两三年，对方也没有回来，他就把这人遗忘到了脑后。

伊曼在回忆这个外甥的信息，那边商非凡和郎沐也在聊这个人。

“墨文伯爵府毁灭，他那个女儿原本应该回来奔丧，但一直没回来对不对？”商非凡问。

郎沐：“应该是。王城一直没有人看到她。我留在特调局的人也说没有看到她和她丈夫回来过。”

商非凡回忆克莱门特跟他们说的相关信息：“他们所在的地方叫什么来着？”

郎沐：“迪安要塞。切斯特大公的领地之一。”

商非凡立刻问：“那个迪安要塞位于哪里？”

郎沐叹息：“虎国边境除去海岸线，与四个国家相接，分别是犀国、翼国、象国，以及蝠国。迪安要寨就是我们虎国与蝠国之间最后一道防线。”

商非凡皱眉：“那么重要的地方，虎王怎么会同意让一个公爵的外孙带着夫人过去镇守？”

郎沐摇头：“他们不负责镇守。迪安要寨以及附近很大一片都属于切斯特大公的领地，切斯特那个外孙过去是暂代领主之责，相当于只负责管理当地民生。但真正的镇守是军队，那边的驻扎军队属于大都督和虎王直辖。实际上所有边境都有军队驻扎，也都只听命于虎王和大都督。”

商非凡明白了，边境事关重大，不像其他地方，贵族们不但有权管理自己领地的民生，连民兵也是他们自己安排。但边境则是文武分开管辖，王庭直接派军队驻扎。

“边境要寨……这种地方可真是微妙。我们得查明这个派遣到底是切斯特大公自身的意思，还是真神教那边的要求。如果是后者，那边九成九会出大事。”商非凡根据自己的经验判断。

郎沐对虎国有感情，自然不想虎国出事，闻言就有些焦急，只是强行忍住。

毕竟迪安要寨位于他们太远，他们就算用最快速度赶过去，也不一定能来得及阻止邪神信徒们的阴谋。

伊曼插话：“你们是不是怀疑以赛亚是次重要的备胎？就算我把这里的容器都毁了，但只要以赛亚还活着，邪神就能找他当容器？”

郎沐神色有点苦恼：“不止。我怀疑邪神信徒们给邪神准备的神降容器不止你们家这几个。”

他想到了雷米尔。

安妮塔真的那么心甘情愿给虎王生下一个孩子？

就算这个孩子出生就是工具。

但从伊曼告诉他们的事情可以得知，安妮塔早在三十年前就已经和邪神信徒合作，并把切斯特大公也拉下水。

真神教那边能告诉切斯特大公如何培养转魂容器，安妮塔会不知道吗？

商非凡和郎沐心意相通，“雷米尔？”

郎沐沉沉点头。

商非凡无所谓：“这种事不能想太多。真神教如果真的要培养神降容器，九成会遍地撒网，最后选择最优秀的进行重点捕捞。伊曼这里不成，还有那个以赛亚，如果以赛亚也不成，还有雷米尔。如果这些人都不成，说不定在其他国家还有类似存在。我们根本管不过来。”

商非凡又看向伊曼：“你看，类似你这样的存在很多，你就算把自己弄死了，邪神也可以选择其他容器，还不如……”

“不如怎样？”伊曼原本坚定的想要灭掉自己的心微微动摇。

商非凡没有立刻回应，而是看向郎沐：“你有没有什么好办法能帮助伊曼稳固他的灵魂，并在他的精神海中布置一个陷阱，一旦有谁入侵他的精神海就会被陷阱击伤，让对方无法夺舍。”

商非凡自己也有办法，比如用诅咒之法，让夺取伊曼身体的存在受到惩罚或无法成功。

但因为这件事牵涉到邪神，以邪神的力量，他如果想要这个诅咒成功，恐怕得付出相当大的代价。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 205: Holy Relic of the Evil God (Part 1)

Yiman glanced up at the sky. "Right, remember to kill my fourth and fifth sisters later as well. Their bodies have been tampered with too. Although their aptitudes are much lower, it's still possible for them to be turned into vessels."

Shang Feifan shook his head as he watched Yiman's calm and indifferent demeanor, looking as if he cared about nothing in the world.

Grief beyond despair was the death of the heart—Yiman was another perfect embodiment of this saying.

With that thought, Shang Feifan unconsciously took hold of Lang Mu's hand.

"Also, that chief steward of ours, plus my two brothers-in-law—kill them too while you're at it. My two brothers-in-law are probably just low-level outer members of the True God Cult who don't know much. Their families should have collapsed long ago, but they managed to stand back up with the Cult's help and even marry daughters of a Grand Duke's estate. As for that chief steward, if you're interested, you could interrogate him."

Yiman thought for a moment, felt he had explained enough, and continued stepping toward the house.

He had already chosen the place of his death: his study. It was also his favorite room, containing all his favorite possessions.

He wanted to take them all with him as he departed.

"Lord Yiman, wait," Lang Mu called out to him.

Yiman turned around. "Is there something else? If it's to persuade me, there's no need. I've long been prepared, and I don't want to live the next two hundred-plus years in constant terror that someone might swap out my inner shell at any time or place."

Lang Mu suddenly asked, "The True God Cult laid out their plan for so long for today. How could such a massive, top-secret affair be exposed so easily?"

Yiman had been about to leave, but he stopped in his tracks, his brow furrowing slightly. "I thought I had already explained this."

*Hmm?* A thought stirred in Shang Feifan's mind. Something seemed to pop up in his brain, and he spoke as he pieced it together: "Lord Yiman is brilliant. He noticed subtle clues very early on. My guess is that he's been investigating in secret all along, and once he caught a thread or two, he naturally unraveled the truth step by step. If it were anyone else, they probably would have been successfully brainwashed long ago or lived in complete ignorance until the day their body was stolen."

Yiman nodded: *Exactly so.*

Shang Feifan smiled faintly. Honestly, he quite admired this young master who appeared to be in poor health. He knew how to endure, how to put on a facade, possessed a clear mind, a firm will, and utmost decisiveness.

It was a bit of a pity for a person like this to just die.

As Shang Feifan pondered whether there was any way to save this son of the Grand Duke, he kept feeling that there was some vital piece of intelligence they had overlooked.

Then he heard Lang Mu's voice sound slightly heavy: "You two, did we forget something?"

Shang Feifan asked casually, "What is it?"

Lang Mu: "Do you remember? Clement told us that Grand Duke Chester has a grandson living elsewhere, and his wife happens to be the daughter of Earl Mowen."

Shang Feifan froze. He finally realized what crucial intelligence he had overlooked—it was this!

Yiman raised an eyebrow; he had almost forgotten about this nephew as well.

He still remembered that this nephew, Isaiah—born to his second elder sister—had been the Grand Duke's favorite. But one day, the Grand Duke suddenly had him marry the young lady of Earl Mowen's house and dispatched him to Dian Fortress.

Being able to head off to a fiefdom to take charge at such a young age would be considered a good thing by any noble, but it depended on the location.

Dian Fortress was an exceptionally barren and miserable border territory where the Royal Court's army was stationed. Average noble youths hated being assigned to places like that to serve as minor lords.

So when his nephew led his newly wedded wife to take up the post of acting lord over there, almost none of Isaiah's peers felt envy or jealousy. Instead, they speculated whether Isaiah had fallen out of favor with the Grand Duke.

Two or three years had passed without the man returning, so Yiman had put him out of his mind.

While Yiman recalled the information about this nephew, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were also discussing him.

"Earl Mowen's estate was destroyed. That daughter of his should have returned for the funeral, but she never did, right?" Shang Feifan asked.

Lang Mu: "That should be the case. No one in the Royal Capital ever saw her. The people I left at the Special Investigation Bureau also said they never saw her or her husband return."

Shang Feifan recalled the relevant information Clement had shared with them: "What was the name of the place they were at again?"

Lang Mu: "Dian Fortress. One of Grand Duke Chester's fiefs."

Shang Feifan immediately asked, "Where is Dian Fortress located?"

Lang Mu sighed. "Excluding the coastline, the Tiger Kingdom borders four countries: the Rhino Kingdom, the Wing Kingdom, the Elephant Kingdom, and the Bat Kingdom. Dian Fortress is our Tiger Kingdom's final line of defense against the Bat Kingdom."

Shang Feifan frowned. "At such an important location, how could the Tiger King agree to let a Duke's grandson take his wife there to guard it?"

Lang Mu shook his head. "They aren't responsible for guarding it. Dian Fortress and a vast surrounding area belong to Grand Duke Chester's domain. That grandson went over to temporarily assume the responsibilities of a lord, which means he's only in charge of managing local civil affairs. The actual defense lies with the army. The garrison stationed there falls under the direct jurisdiction of the Great Commander and the Tiger King. In fact, all borderlands have military garrisons stationed, and they only take orders from the Tiger King and the Great Commander."

Shang Feifan understood. Border affairs were of grave significance; unlike other regions where nobles had the authority to manage not only civil affairs but also organize their own militias, borderlands operated under separate civil and military jurisdictions, with the Royal Court directly stationing armies.

"A border fortress... a place like that is truly delicate. We have to ascertain whether this deployment was Grand Duke Chester's own intention or a requirement from the True God Cult. If it's the latter, something major is ninety-nine percent guaranteed to happen over there," Shang Feifan judged based on his experience.

Lang Mu felt deep affection for the Tiger Kingdom and naturally didn't want anything bad to happen to it. Hearing this, he felt somewhat anxious, though he forcibly restrained himself.

After all, Dian Fortress was too far away. Even if they rushed over at maximum speed, they might not make it in time to stop the evil god cultists' plot.

Yiman interjected, "Are you suspecting that Isaiah is a secondary spare vessel? Even if I destroy all the vessels here, as long as Isaiah is alive, the evil god can still use him as a vessel?"

Lang Mu looked somewhat troubled. "It's more than that. I suspect the evil god cultists have prepared more than just a few divine descent vessels from your family."

He thought of Remiel.

Was Anita truly that willing to bear a child for the Tiger King?

Even if that child was born to be a tool.

From what Yiman had told them, Anita had already cooperated with the cultists thirty years ago and dragged Grand Duke Chester into the mire as well.

If the True God Cult could teach Grand Duke Chester how to nurture soul-transfer vessels, would Anita be out of the loop?

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu shared an unspoken understanding: "Remiel?"

Lang Mu nodded gravely.

Shang Feifan said nonchalantly, "We can't overthink these things. If the True God Cult really wants to prepare divine descent vessels, they'll ninety percent cast a wide net across the realm and eventually choose the most outstanding ones for focused harvesting. If it fails with Yiman here, there's still that Isaiah. If Isaiah fails, there's Remiel. If none of them work out, there might even be similar existences in other countries. We simply can't manage it all."

Shang Feifan turned back to Yiman. "Look, there are plenty of existences like you. Even if you kill yourself, the evil god can just pick another vessel. It'd be better to..."

"Better to do what?" Yiman's previously resolute determination to destroy himself wavered slightly.

Shang Feifan didn't answer immediately. Instead, he looked at Lang Mu: "Do you have any good method to help Yiman stabilize his soul and set a trap within his mental sea? That way, if anyone invades his mental sea, they'll be injured by the trap, preventing them from taking over his body."

Shang Feifan had methods of his own—for instance, using curses to make whoever tried to seize Yiman's body suffer retribution or fail outright.

However, because this involved an evil god, given the evil god's power, if he wanted such a curse to succeed, he would likely have to pay a considerable price.

chunks.chineseText:
这个代价也许怨气都不足够，得用生命，且是大量生命来献祭。就像邪神信徒想要献祭整座王城来让降神成功一样。

而最简单阻止神降的方法就是直接献祭伊曼的生命。

可那样一来，对拯救伊曼的生命也毫无意义。

郎沐刚刚就在思考这个问题，过了一会儿才回答：“我可以试试。但对方是邪神……”

商非凡：“邪神不可能把自己的意识和力量全部降临到一具普通的兽人身体上，任何兽人身体都不可能承受得住，可能就是一丝意识和一丝力量。”

他诅咒邪神神降不成功，是在和邪神抵抗。

但如果只是单纯在伊曼的精神海做手脚，那就只是对抗邪神那降下来的一丝意识和些许力量。

郎沐眼睛一亮：“你说得对。”

伊曼那边的眼神也逐渐有了活气：“如果你们真的想在我身上试试，可以随便试。不过你们要保证一旦你们的方法不成功，就一定要在邪神意识降到我身上时，让我身体毁灭。”

有了伊曼这句话，郎沐就更能放开手尝试。

“在这之前，我还要练练手。给我一点时间就好。”郎沐想要把丹顿侯爵的灵魂取出来，他正好有一些事要询问对方。

丹顿侯爵九成九也是用了魂转之法，他用的后代身体就是他的灵魂容器。

伊曼对魂转之法的详细并不了解，郎沐想要从丹顿侯爵那里了解魂转之法的详细，他总觉得这个魂转之法不像是邪神的手法，倒更像是魔法师们搞出来的黑魔法。

还有那个咒术师，他觉得对方很像是那位从法德尔大陆硬穿过来的黑暗法圣德克斯特。

“我可以给你时间，但邪神信徒定下来献祭全城的时间还有半个小时不到。”伊曼说。

商非凡问：“他们要怎么献祭全城？”

伊曼回答：“依靠邪神的力量。根据我打探到的消息，那些邪神信徒手上应该有一个储存了邪神些许力量的圣物，他们会在约定时间，释放这股邪神力量，利用这股邪神力量来召唤邪神，同时杀死全王城的所有生灵。而邪神降临时就能享用到这满城的生命力。”

商非凡又问：“他们是不是会把这个圣物送到他们选定的神降容器手中？”

伊曼点头：“对。我就是知道了这件事，才会提前动手，杀死所有有可能变成容器的人。”

商非凡和郎沐对看。

很好，现在的重点变成了如何找到那个储存了邪神些许力量的圣物。

商非凡先看系统地图和寻宝罗盘，都没有任何提示。

看来这个任务的难点就在这里。

商非凡询问伊曼是否知晓那东西的下落。

伊曼残念摇头：“我不知道，我只知道他们会在约定时间把东西送到我手中。也许你可以拷问一下大管家，外面的东西想要送进大公府、送到我这个大公之子手上，除了大公本人，就只有他能做到。”

商非凡二话不说，过去就拎起了昏迷的大公府大管家。

郎沐：“正好给我多一个练手的。”

时间紧急，郎沐放弃了温柔、伤害性较低的灵魂探测（拷问）法，而是以达成目的为首要目标。

三世灵魂累加的精神力，让郎沐的精神力极为磅礴和坚韧，他很轻易就冲破大管家的精神海防守。

实际上，兽人大陆的兽人们就没有几个会保护自己的精神海，也许大繁华纪时有过精神力修炼的法门，但大战纪过后，这些传承就都失传了。

至少如今的兽人大陆还知道修炼精神力并知道如何保护自己精神海的兽人就极少。

也许圣山祭司宫的人还会，但不知为何，他们并没有把相关传承传出来。

这也是郎沐和商非凡怀疑祭司宫被邪神侵染的原因之一。

祭司宫原本就肩负保存知识和技术传承，在传承断绝时，把传承重新传播出去的任务，可祭司宫却没怎么履行这个职责，只是对各方势力派遣出祭司。

但那些被派遣来的祭司看似在帮助各势力，更像是在监视。以前驻守的祭司还有给幼崽上课的任务，现在也几乎看不到这么做的祭司。

郎沐就盯着一个问题问：储存了邪神力量的圣物在哪里？

大管家对这个问题反应较低。

郎沐就又换了一个问题：那些人让你交给伊曼的东西在哪里？

这次大管家有反应了，他的灵魂直接给出了答案。

郎沐又问了几个相关问题，直到确定大管家已经把知道的都交代出来。

郎沐放下口鼻流血、精神海被摧毁大半的大管家，询问伊曼：“你可认识一个叫费斯汀的人？”

伊曼眼皮眨了下：“我外祖家管家的儿子好像就叫这个名字。我不太记得了，我就见过他两三次，都是他给我母亲送东西过来，我偶尔见到的。”

郎沐：“你们府的大管家并不知道圣物，他只知道他的联络者交代他，说费斯汀会给你送一个礼物，让他务必要帮助费斯汀把那礼物交到你手中，还敲定了时间。”

伊曼：“哦，那可能就是了。”

郎沐头疼：“但他说，费斯汀已经来过，他正准备带他去见你，可就碰到你大杀特杀，然后那个费斯汀就跑掉了。”

伊曼一脸这事与他无关的表情说：“那就去我外祖家找他呗。他肯定是跑回去了。”

“你外祖家在哪里？”郎沐紧急问。

伊曼：“带上我，我给你们带路，还能让你们直接进入我外祖家。”

商非凡和郎沐自然不会反对，当即带上伊曼就离开了大公府。

伊曼走前，还把大管家和二姐夫三姐夫都给刀了。

但他没有对四姐和五姐下手。他想，如果拉斐尔郎沐能帮助他抵抗邪神意识降临，也许也能帮到他这两个姐姐。

大公府满地尸体和昏迷的人。

过了好一会儿，有人缓缓醒来，一睁眼就看到满地血腥，吓得浑身一颤。

醒来的人越来越多，有人连忙去唤醒认识的人。也有人撒腿就跑。

治安官们清点人数，见己方人员都没有一个死去，受伤也不算太重，顿时松了口气。

治安官们想离开这个是非地，但醒来的大公夫人和大公小姐们拖着他们不让他们走。

二小姐三小姐看到自己的丈夫被杀死，哭得死去活来。

大小姐去找大公夫人麻烦，治安官只能去保护大公夫人。

伊曼的护卫和仆人们醒来，见自家主子不见了，特别焦急，到处寻找。

大管家也死了，整个大公府乱哄哄一团。

终于有人想起来要给大公送信。

治安官提醒说王宫附近都被戒严，在分享大会结束前任何人都不得靠近。

但大公府的人根本不听他们的，几个小姐和公爵夫人都分别派出了奴仆跑去王宫。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 205: Holy Relic of the Evil God (Part 2)

That price might not be satisfied even by resentment power; it would require sacrificing life—and a massive amount of life at that. Just like how the evil god cultists wanted to sacrifice the entire Royal Capital to ensure a successful divine descent.

And the simplest way to prevent the divine descent was to directly sacrifice Yiman's life.

Yet doing so would render saving Yiman's life completely meaningless.

Lang Mu had been contemplating this exact issue just now. After a moment, he replied, "I can try. But the opponent is an evil god..."

Shang Feifan: "An evil god cannot possibly descend its entire consciousness and power into an ordinary beastman's body. No beastman body could withstand that. It would likely be just a wisp of consciousness and a sliver of power."

If Shang Feifan were cursing the evil god's descent to fail, he would be resisting the evil god directly.

However, if it was merely tampering with Yiman's mental sea, it would only be countering that single wisp of consciousness and fraction of power descended by the evil god.

Lang Mu's eyes lit up. "You're right."

The light of life gradually returned to Yiman's eyes as well. "If you really want to try it on me, feel free to try whatever you like. But you must guarantee that if your method fails, you will destroy my body the moment the evil god's consciousness descends upon me."

With Yiman's promise, Lang Mu could feel much freer to experiment.

"Before that, I still need to practice my skills. Just give me a little time." Lang Mu wanted to extract Marquis Danton's soul; he happened to have a few questions to ask the man.

There was a ninety-nine percent chance Marquis Danton had also used the soul-transfer method, using his descendant's body as his soul container.

Yiman was not familiar with the details of the soul-transfer technique. Lang Mu wanted to learn the particulars from Marquis Danton; he always felt this soul-transfer method didn't seem like an evil god's handiwork, but rather resembled black magic created by mages.

There was also that curse master—he felt that person strongly resembled Dexter, the Dark Archmage who had forced his way over from the Fadel Continent.

"I can give you time, but there's less than half an hour left until the time set by the evil god cultists to sacrifice the whole city," Yiman said.

Shang Feifan asked, "How are they planning to sacrifice the whole city?"

Yiman replied, "By relying on the evil god's power. According to the news I gathered, those cultists should have a holy relic containing a portion of the evil god's power. At the appointed time, they will release this power to summon the evil god while simultaneously killing every living soul in the entire Royal Capital. When the evil god descends, it will be able to feast upon this city full of vitality."

Shang Feifan asked again, "Will they deliver this holy relic into the hands of their chosen divine descent vessel?"

Yiman nodded. "Yes. It was precisely because I found out about this that I took action in advance, killing everyone who had the potential to become a vessel."

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu exchanged a look.

Very well, the priority had now shifted to finding that holy relic containing a portion of the evil god's power.

Shang Feifan checked the system map and the treasure-hunting compass first, but neither provided any prompts.

It seemed the difficulty of this quest lay right here.

Shang Feifan asked Yiman if he knew the whereabouts of that item.

Yiman shook his head with regret. "I don't know. I only know they will deliver it to my hands at the appointed time. Perhaps you can interrogate the chief steward. For items outside to be delivered into the Grand Duke's estate and into the hands of a Duke's son like me, besides the Grand Duke himself, he's the only one capable of doing so."

Without another word, Shang Feifan went over and hauled up the unconscious chief steward of the Grand Duke's estate.

Lang Mu: "Just in time—another subject for me to practice on."

Time was tight, so Lang Mu gave up on gentle, low-damage soul probing (interrogation) methods and made achieving his goal the top priority.

The mental power accumulated over three lifetimes rendered Lang Mu's spirit extraordinarily majestic and resilient. He easily broke through the chief steward's mental sea defenses.

In truth, almost no beastmen on the Beastman Continent knew how to protect their own mental seas. Perhaps there had been cultivation methods for mental power during the Era of Great Prosperity, but after the Great War Era, those heritages had all been lost.

At least nowadays, extremely few beastmen on the Beastman Continent still knew how to cultivate mental power and defend their mental sea.

Perhaps the people of the Sacred Mountain Priest Palace still knew how, but for some reason, they hadn't passed down the relevant heritage.

This was also one of the reasons why Lang Mu and Shang Feifan suspected the Priest Palace had been corrupted by the evil god.

The Priest Palace originally bore the duty of preserving knowledge and heritage, and disseminating it once again whenever heritages were severed. Yet the Priest Palace had barely fulfilled this responsibility, merely dispatching priests to various factions.

However, those dispatched priests, while appearing to assist the various factions, seemed more like monitors. Stationed priests in the past also had the duty of teaching young cubs, but nowadays, priests doing so were almost nowhere to be seen.

Lang Mu focused on a single question: *Where is the holy relic containing the evil god's power?*

The chief steward had a weak response to this question.

Lang Mu changed the question: *Where is the item those people asked you to hand over to Yiman?*

This time, the chief steward reacted, his soul giving the answer directly.

Lang Mu asked several related questions until he was sure the chief steward had divulged everything he knew.

Lang Mu set down the chief steward—whose nose and mouth were bleeding, his mental sea mostly destroyed—and asked Yiman, "Do you know a person named Festin?"

Yiman's eyelids flickered. "The son of the steward at my maternal grandfather's house seems to be named that. I don't remember clearly. I've only seen him two or three times when he brought things over to my mother, which I caught glimpses of occasionally."

Lang Mu: "Your estate's chief steward doesn't know about the holy relic. He only knows that his contact instructed him that Festin would bring you a gift, and urged him to ensure Festin handed that gift to you, even fixing a specific time."

Yiman: "Oh, then that's probably it."

Lang Mu felt a headache coming on. "But he said Festin already came. He was preparing to take him to see you when you went on your killing spree, so Festin fled."

Yiman wore an expression indicating this had nothing to do with him and said, "Then go look for him at my maternal grandfather's house. He definitely ran back there."

"Where is your maternal grandfather's house?" Lang Mu asked urgently.

Yiman: "Take me along. I'll lead the way, and I can get you straight into my maternal grandfather's estate."

Naturally, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had no objections. They immediately brought Yiman along and left the Grand Duke's estate.

Before leaving, Yiman also finished off the chief steward and his second and third brothers-in-law with his blade.

However, he didn't lay a hand on his fourth and fifth sisters. He thought that if Raphael Lang Mu could help him resist the descent of the evil god's consciousness, perhaps he could help his two sisters as well.

The Grand Duke's estate was strewn with corpses and unconscious people.

After a long while, someone slowly woke up. Upon opening their eyes and seeing the bloodbath all over the ground, they trembled violently in terror.

More and more people woke up; some hurried to awaken acquaintances, while others bolted for their lives.

The peace officers took headcount and felt relieved to see that none of their own personnel had died, nor were their injuries too severe.

The peace officers wanted to leave this scene of trouble, but the awakened Duchess and the Grand Duke's daughters dragged them back, refusing to let them leave.

The second and third daughters cried their eyes out upon seeing their husbands killed.

The eldest daughter went to cause trouble for the Duchess, leaving the peace officers with no choice but to protect the Duchess.

Yiman's guards and servants woke up, and seeing their master missing, grew extremely anxious and searched everywhere.

With the chief steward dead as well, the entire Grand Duke's estate was plunged into total chaos.

Finally, someone remembered to send word to the Grand Duke.

The peace officers reminded them that the area surrounding the Royal Palace was under martial law, and no one was allowed near before the Sharing Conference concluded.

However, the people of the Grand Duke's estate paid no heed. Several daughters and the Duchess dispatched servants to rush toward the Royal Palace separately.

chunks.chineseText:
第206章 王城的宁静

为了节省时间，郎沐直接使用加速魔法。

伊曼惊诧，但以为是某种炼金物品的特效，就什么都没问。

有伊曼在，三人闯入伊曼外祖家里简直如入无人之境，没有任何人敢真正拦阻他们。

费斯汀就躲在他父亲的小院子里，他完全没想到伊曼切斯特竟然会特意从公爵府跑来他家来找他这个小小的富商管家之子，且来得如此之快。

他手里的东西都还没有脱手出去。

当他赶到公爵府，想要把那件被人嘱托的东西交给伊曼少爷，却得知伊曼少爷正在府邸里大开杀戒，连他的外甥和外甥女都杀了，其他仆人护卫也杀了不少。

费斯汀胆颤心惊，就害怕自己出现在伊曼少爷面前，哪里惹到他不快，连他也一块杀了。

恐惧心下，他就趁着公爵府大管家带人去阻止伊曼少爷的时候，偷偷溜走了。

他回来后就传信给那边，说明情况。

可消息刚刚让信使传递出去，他还没有得到那边回复，伊曼少爷竟然就找过来了。

他父亲可是一边跑一边大喊让他出来，说伊曼少爷来找他了。

费斯汀非常害怕，也不知道伊曼少爷特意来找他是什么事，总不能伊曼少爷把公爵府的人杀光，没杀够，又跑来杀他外祖家的人吧？

还是伊曼少爷从公爵府大管家那里知道了他要送某件宝贝给他，好奇下才寻找过来？

费斯汀根本没有多少时间胡思乱想，他刚听到他父亲的“提醒”，还没来得及想好要如何面对伊曼少爷，伊曼少爷就带着两个人出现在他面前。

“东西呢？”伊曼上来就问。

费斯汀慌忙下，连忙把那个华贵的礼盒拿出来，双手奉上：“在这里。这是达索商行主人达索勋爵送给您的礼物，委托小人转交。”

伊曼伸手，商非凡拦住他，自己接过了盒子，并迅速放入雕像广场。

这种通过地位比较高或和主人关系比较亲密的仆人来送上礼物的事，在权贵层很常见。

像是达索商行这样拐着弯子找公爵之子外祖家的管家之子帮忙给公爵之子送礼的情况，也不是第一次。

“费斯汀？”郎沐轻声呼唤。

费斯汀一愣，“是小人。”

郎沐盯着他的眼睛，温和地问：“这个礼盒是谁让你送给伊曼阁下的？”

费斯汀愣愣地回答：“是达索勋爵。他儿子找到小的，给了小的十金，说只要小的把礼物送到伊曼少爷手中，就会再给我二十金。”

一共三十金的贿赂，这对于一个富商家的仆人来说，就是一笔无法拒绝的巨款。

“你对达索勋爵有什么了解，你和他们一家是怎么认识的？”郎沐继续问。

费斯汀特别老实地回答了郎沐的问题，无非是对方特意接近他，一开始给他钱向他打听伊曼少爷的喜好，后来又邀请他出入一些他作为仆人根本无法出入的场所消费，等他上钩后，就开始委托他办一些事情。

因为费斯汀顶着公爵夫人家里管家之子的名头，他在某些时候和某些场合还真的很好用，别人多少都会给公爵夫人和公爵之子几分面子。

郎沐来回问了几个问题，就对商非凡和伊曼说：“他应该和邪神信徒无关，就是个被拖下水的贪心糊涂蛋。”

伊曼眼神微闪。这是某种精神类控制的血脉天赋吧？

可拉斐尔的血脉天赋不是说与听力相关吗？

伊曼还不知道之前他看到的那些植物抓人、迷昏人的特殊情况，也全都与郎沐有关。如果知道了，还不知道有多么惊讶。

郎沐现在也不怎么在乎让人知道他是魔法师的事，不过他多少还是有一些遮掩，但也只能骗骗兽人大陆土著们的眼睛，如果真遇到魔法师，他做的事，那些魔法师一看就知道他是同行。

郎沐又看向费斯汀：“你会遗忘今天的所有事情，怎么想都想不起来。当你听到有人是邪神信徒和真神教信徒时，你会恐惧，不敢接近相关者。”

费斯汀神情怔愣，下意识地跟着重复。

郎沐伸手轻轻往费斯汀脑门一拍。

费斯汀闭眼，啪叽昏倒。

郎沐转头就对商非凡说：“我们去找那个达索勋爵。”

伊曼现在对寻找圣物源头的事也有了一点兴趣，他想知道躲在后面、安排这一切的人到底是谁：“我跟你们一起去。不管那达索勋爵是不是邪神信徒，相信我，我的身份一定可以让你们直接见到他，而不需要通过等待和打斗。”

他更想看看那圣物是什么。

但阿瑞斯商拒绝了他的要求，说那东西不适合在这里打开。

伊曼也担心他把礼盒一打开，那邪神的意识和力量就会钻入他的身体。

“你把礼盒放空间手镯里了？空间手镯能阻挡邪神意识和邪神力量吗？如果时间一到，它自己跑出来怎么办？”伊曼连续问。

阿瑞斯商：“普通空间确实无法阻挡邪神意识和力量。但我什么时候说把那礼盒放入空间储物工具里了？”

“呃，那你放哪儿了？”伊曼下意识问。

阿瑞斯商给了他一个“你觉得我会说吗”的眼神。

伊曼摸摸鼻子。好吧，不管阿瑞斯商把那礼盒放到哪里，那种能阻挡邪神意识和力量的存储工具或地方，肯定不凡，九成是阿瑞斯商的压箱底秘密，哪会轻易告诉别人。

转眼间，商非凡三人就离开伊曼外祖家，前往达索勋爵府邸。

等伊曼外祖听到消息赶来，只看到抱着儿子忧心不已的管家。

等他们好不容易弄醒费斯汀，结果发现费斯汀竟然失去了这一天的所有记忆，他根本不记得伊曼少爷刚才带人来找他的事，更不记得自己曾去过公爵府，当然也不知道自己为什么去。

伊曼外祖母当即就要派管家去公爵府打听。

伊曼外祖却制止了妻子的行为，并要求全家上下都当不知道今天伊曼少爷来过，严令所有人都不准把相关事情说出去，更不准私下议论。

另一头，伊曼仗着自己的身份，带着商非凡和郎沐两人就直闯达索勋爵府。

门房听说是大公之子亲自来了，正要去向上面禀告，就被伊曼推开。

达索勋爵府的仆人在后面追着伊曼三人，管家之类的人一边跑着询问伊曼少爷前来是为何事，一边让人快速传消息给达索勋爵。

伊曼到底是第一次来达索勋爵府，也不知道达索勋爵到底住在哪一片。他只能喝令管家带路。

管家一心为主，表面唯唯诺诺地带路，其实是带着绕路，暗中则让人通知主人。

郎沐看出这点，直接用上了精神控制类魔法。

管家神情一变，停止绕路，直接带着三人去往达索勋爵住的主楼。

达索勋爵这边刚听到仆人跟他说公爵之子伊曼切斯特少爷找来一事，就看到了对方身影。

半个小时已经只剩下十分钟不到。

王城到底还是太大，就算使用了加速魔法，只赶路就耗费了大量时间。

“阿沐。”商非凡示意郎沐直接用魔法。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 206: Tranquility in the Royal Capital

To save time, Lang Mu directly cast an acceleration magic.

Imman was astonished, but assuming it was some sort of special effect from an alchemical item, he didn't ask any further.

With Imman present, the three of them broke into Imman's maternal grandfather's estate as if walking through an uninhabited realm. Not a single person dared to truly stop them.

Festin was hiding in his father's small courtyard. He never expected that Imman Chester would actually run all the way from the Duke's Mansion to find him—the son of a humble steward to a wealthy merchant—let alone arrive with such lightning speed.

He hadn't even managed to dispose of the item in his hands yet.

When he had rushed to the Duke's Mansion earlier, intending to deliver that entrusted item to Young Master Imman, he learned instead that Young Master Imman was on a bloody rampage within the estate. He had killed even his own nephew and niece, along with quite a few other servants and guards.

Trembling with fear, Festin was terrified that if he appeared before Young Master Imman and somehow displeased him, he would be slaughtered right along with the rest.

Driven by panic, while the Duke's Mansion's head steward was leading men to try and stop Young Master Imman, Festin had slipped away stealthily.

Upon returning, he immediately sent a message to the other side to explain the situation.

Yet, just as the messenger set off with the news, before he had even received a reply, Young Master Imman had tracked him down.

His father had come running all the way, shouting at the top of his lungs for him to come out because Young Master Imman had come looking for him.

Festin was petrified, having no idea why Young Master Imman would make a special trip to find him. Surely it couldn't be that Imman hadn't killed enough people at the Duke's Mansion and had run over to slaughter his maternal grandfather's family as well?

Or perhaps Young Master Imman had learned from the head steward that he was supposed to deliver some treasure to him, and had tracked him down out of curiosity?

Festin didn't have much time for wild imaginations. Just as he heard his father's "warning" and before he could even figure out how to face Young Master Imman, the young master appeared before him accompanied by two people.

"Where is the item?" Imman demanded straight to the point.

Flustered, Festin hurriedly pulled out an ornate gift box and offered it with both hands: "Right here. This is a gift sent by Lord Dassou, master of the Dassou Trading Firm, who entrusted this humble servant to deliver it."

Imman reached out, but Shang Feifan intercepted him, taking the box himself and swiftly storing it away into the Statue Square.

In the upper echelons of the nobility, it was common practice to have servants of higher status or closer ties deliver gifts.

It wasn't the first time an indirect approach like this had occurred—where the Dassou Trading Firm went through the steward's son of the Grand Duchess's maternal family just to send a gift to the Duke's son.

"Festin?" Lang Mu called out softly.

Festin started, dazed. "This—this humble servant is here."

Lang Mu stared straight into his eyes and asked gently, "Who instructed you to deliver this gift box to Lord Imman?"

Festin answered in a daze, "It was Lord Dassou. His son found me and gave me ten gold coins, saying that as long as I delivered the gift into Young Master Imman's hands, he would give me another twenty gold coins."

A total bribe of thirty gold coins was an irresistible fortune for a servant of a wealthy merchant family.

"What do you know about Lord Dassou? How did you and their family come to know each other?" Lang Mu continued to ask.

Festin answered Lang Mu's questions with absolute honesty. It turned out the other party had deliberately approached him, initially paying him to inquire about Young Master Imman's preferences, later inviting him to spend money at establishments a mere servant could never normally enter. Once he took the bait, they began entrusting him with various tasks.

Because Festin bore the title of the Duke's wife's family's steward's son, he proved genuinely useful on certain occasions and in specific places, as people would invariably show some degree of respect to the Grand Duchess and the Duke's son.

After asking a few back-and-forth questions, Lang Mu said to Shang Feifan and Imman, "He shouldn't have any connection to the evil god's cultists. He's just a greedy, muddled fool who got dragged into this."

Imman's eyes flickered slightly. Was this some kind of bloodline talent for mental control?

Didn't Raphael say his bloodline talent was related to hearing?

Imman was still unaware that the earlier bizarre incidents—where plants seized and knocked people out—were also all the work of Lang Mu. If he had known, there's no telling how shocked he would be.

Lang Mu didn't care much anymore about letting people know he was a magician, though he still maintained a degree of concealment. Even so, it could only fool the natives of the Orc Continent; if he ever encountered a real magician, what he did would instantly reveal him as a peer.

Lang Mu looked back at Festin. "You will forget everything that happened today, and no matter how hard you try, you won't be able to recall it. Whenever you hear about evil god cultists or True God Church believers, you will feel fear and dare not approach anyone associated with them."

Festin's expression went blank, and he unconsciously repeated the words.

Lang Mu reached out and gently tapped Festin on the forehead.

Festin closed his eyes and collapsed to the ground with a thud.

Lang Mu turned to Shang Feifan. "Let's go find that Lord Dassou."

Imman now held a bit of interest in tracking down the source of the sacred artifact; he wanted to know who was hiding behind the scenes orchestrating all of this. "I'll go with you. Regardless of whether Lord Dassou is an evil god cultist or not, trust me, my identity will ensure you can meet him directly without having to wait or fight your way through."

He was even more eager to see what that sacred artifact actually was.

However, Ares Shang rejected his request, stating that the item was not suited to be opened here.

Imman was also worried that the moment he opened the gift box, the evil god's consciousness and power would burrow straight into his body.

"You put the gift box into your spatial bracelet? Can a spatial bracelet block an evil god's consciousness and power? What if the time runs out and it breaks out on its own?" Imman fired off a series of questions.

Ares Shang: "Ordinary spatial storage indeed cannot block an evil god's consciousness and power. But when did I say I put that gift box into a spatial storage tool?"

"Uh, then where did you put it?" Imman asked instinctively.

Ares Shang gave him a look that clearly conveyed: *Do you think I'd tell you?*

Imman rubbed his nose. Fine. Regardless of where Ares Shang had stowed that gift box, any storage tool or location capable of blocking an evil god's consciousness and power was bound to be extraordinary—ninety-nine percent likely to be Ares Shang's ultimate trump card. There was no way he would easily reveal it to others.

In the blink of an eye, the three of them left Imman's maternal grandfather's estate and headed toward Lord Dassou's mansion.

By the time Imman's maternal grandfather received the news and rushed over, all he found was a steward holding his son in deep distress.

When they finally managed to wake Festin up, they discovered to their shock that Festin had lost all memories of the entire day. He had no recollection of Young Master Imman bringing people to find him just moments ago, let alone ever visiting the Duke's Mansion—and certainly no idea why he would have gone there in the first place.

Imman's maternal grandmother immediately wanted to dispatch the steward to the Duke's Mansion to make inquiries.

However, Imman's grandfather stopped his wife's actions and ordered everyone in the household to pretend they knew nothing about Young Master Imman's visit today. He strictly forbade anyone from speaking of related matters, and even more so from whispering about it behind closed doors.

On the other side, relying entirely on his status, Imman led Shang Feifan and Lang Mu in directly storming Lord Dassou's mansion.

The gatekeeper, hearing that the Grand Duke's own son had arrived in person, was just about to run inside to report when Imman shoved him aside.

The servants of Lord Dassou's estate chased after the three of them, with stewards and managers running alongside, frantically asking why Young Master Imman had come while simultaneously ordering someone to rush a message to Lord Dassou.

This was, after all, Imman's first time visiting Lord Dassou's estate, and he had no idea which section Lord Dassou lived in. He could only bark orders for the steward to lead the way.

Loyal to his master, the steward feigned obedience on the surface while actually leading them on a detour, secretly signaling someone to alert his master.

Sensing this, Lang Mu directly employed mental control magic.

The steward's expression shifted; he immediately abandoned the detour and led the three directly toward the main residential building where Lord Dassou resided.

Lord Dassou had just heard a servant report that Young Master Imman Chester had come looking for him when he caught sight of the figures approaching.

Less than ten minutes remained of the half-hour time limit.

The royal capital was simply too vast; even with acceleration magic, traveling across it had consumed a massive amount of time.

"A-Mu," Shang Feifan signaled for Lang Mu to use magic directly.

chunks.chineseText:
这个达索勋爵同样满身怨气缠身，只不过系统没有把他标为红名。

郎沐掏出了骨杖，他能感觉出来这个达索勋爵的精神力比较强。

达索勋爵的精神力是强，那也要看和什么人比。

郎沐对他施展精神类控制魔法，几乎毫无难度，这位的精神海同样没有任何保护，轻易就被郎沐侵入。

郎沐没有破坏他的精神海，只是让他回答问题。

但几个问题下来，三人发现这个达索勋爵竟然也不知道礼盒里是什么，问就是他儿子准备的，说一定会得到公爵之子的喜欢。

至于送礼物的原因，则是达索商行想要拿下粮食贩卖许可证。

粮食贩卖在虎国乃至在整个兽人大陆都是大事，很多国家和势力都不允许民间私下买卖大量粮食和肉类，除非是得到许可的粮商。

“父亲？听说伊曼阁下亲自来了？”

三人一起转头，就看到一名身材削瘦的雄性兽人从外面走了进来。

商非凡眼睛一亮：红名！怨气！九成九邪神信徒没跑。

之后也没多废话，商非凡和郎沐一起动手，直接就抓住并控制住这位达索勋爵的儿子。

达索勋爵看到阿瑞斯商和他的护卫竟然攻击他儿子，大惊又大怒，忙询问这是怎么回事。

伊曼嫌他哔哔得烦人，直接道：“你儿子是邪神信徒，你知道吗？”

闻言，达索勋爵一屁股坐到椅子上，脸色变来变去。

伊曼看他神色就知道，达索勋爵可能多少也有点数。

在郎沐的真言魔法审问下，约翰达索交代了他在真神教的身份。

这竟然是一条……大虾。

约翰达索是真神教在虎国王城的高级教徒。

达索勋爵听到儿子承认自己是邪神信徒，当即脸色灰败，满脸都是完了的神情。

虎国对于邪神信徒可是零容忍，只要发现，那就一定会铲除，不管你是什么身份都无法逃脱。

虽然他们家可以说不知情，但高层是绝不可能让一个邪神教派的高级教徒的家族掌握大量财富和权力的。

他们家别说保住现有的家产，全家能不被抓进牢里就得谢天谢地。

但问到礼盒来历，约翰达索也不清楚，他只知道礼盒是主教交给他的。

商非凡揉揉眉头，嘀咕：“这个真神教简直就跟洋葱一样，剥了一层还有一层。”

郎沐倒是耐心十足：“如果他们没有这么谨慎，早就被我们抓光，也轮不到他们来搞什么献祭全城让邪神降临的大阴谋。”

伊曼提醒他们：“半个小时要到了。”

郎沐安慰他：“只要没有邪神意识和力量降临，你就不用担心被夺取身体。而且我怀疑你这边既是目标，也是一个幌子。如果你这边不成，还有你的外甥以赛亚，只可惜我们来不及赶到迪安要寨。”

伊曼：“……”

商非凡也说：“放心，那家伙跑不出来。”

如果邪神的一丝意识和些微力量放到自然之神的地盘还能跑出来，那商非凡也不必再为系统做任务——兽人大陆的古神这么没用，他这个小小凡人能干啥？还不如带着他家阿沐直接投奔邪神算球。

三人还想继续剥洋葱，可线索到了约翰达索这里就断了。

因为约翰达索也不知道主教的真实身份，他每次见主教，对方都穿着黑袍，头脸隐藏在兜帽里，他也不敢盯着主教大人看。

至于聚会地点，也都是信使给他送信，并没有固定的聚会地点。

而信使就是王城普通的快递人员，这些信使们可不知道他们送的信件是什么内容、委托人又是谁，只要委托人付足酬劳，他们就会负责跑腿。

商非凡对郎沐说：“询问他印象中那名主教的特征，以及他们之前都在哪里见面。”

郎沐点头，他也正要这样询问。

他们特调局很多事情都是靠这么一点点蛛丝马迹，一点点拼凑出来。

半个小时的时限到达。

商非凡和郎沐全都下意识抬起头看向天空。

天空依然碧蓝如故，今天有个好天气。

没有黑暗降临，没有大风呼啸，也没有诡异的雾气弥漫，大地也一片平静。

伊曼双手紧握成拳，他脸上看起来满不在乎，但人又怎么可能真的能轻松面对死亡？

一秒、两秒……

整整两分钟过去，王城依旧一片安宁。

达索勋爵不知道发生了什么事，只觉得这份安静让他难受到极点。

看着委顿在地上、神情茫然的儿子，达索勋爵心里又恨又气。

但他心里同样清楚他这个勋爵位置是怎么来的，他们家又是怎么突然暴富起来的。

就因为他这个儿子……

达索勋爵也不是没有想过他儿子的运气怎么那么好，就能弄到那么多价格低廉的优质货物，虽然那些货物杂了一点、来历不明了一点，但只要能让他们家赚大钱，这些都是小事。

他也怀疑过儿子是怎么认识了那么多人脉，有些还是他们家以前绝对高攀不上的。

靠着这些人脉和近乎无本的货物资金累积，他儿子很快就给他钻营出一个勋爵的名头。

勋爵，就是一个用钱就能买来的最低等爵位，也可以说是爵的预备役。

甚至很多贵族都不承认有这么一个爵位。

但不管怎么说，这个名头对于普通兽人来说还是很好使的，尤其是在行商的时候。

现在达索勋爵终于知道了他儿子这么能干的原因。

就因为他儿子背后有一整个真神教在支持！

“王城又度过了一天呢。”商非凡开玩笑。

郎沐轻轻吐气：“是啊，又平安度过一天。”

伊曼则感叹道：“我们什么时候能把真神教彻底拔除，这群家伙对我们兽人世界的毒害太大了，有他们在，兽人们都别想过安生日子。”

“邪神信徒是个麻烦，但源头还是在邪神身上。”商非凡抽出一点精神力偷瞄雕像广场。

那个礼盒安静地待在自然之神雕像脚下。

“那邪神什么时候能真正消失？我们要怎么帮助我们的神灵打败祂？”伊曼似乎真的很想给神灵们帮忙。

商非凡随口说：“抢在邪神恢复之前，把我们的古神的力量找到并还回去。”

也许还不止。

但商非凡现在也不知道那些神灵（系统）暗中都有什么打算，只能走一步看一步。

郎沐嘴唇微动，说的却不是兽人大陆的语言：“根据特调局收集到的情报看，以前邪神信徒只是会打打杀杀，暗中搞事。可最近几十年似乎变得越来越诡异和狡猾，而且变得越来越有组织，就好像有了大脑和各种术法的知识储备。你猜，会不会是不少魔法师加入了真神教？”

商非凡对他眨眨眼：“很有可能。”

伊曼见两人用自己听不懂的语言说话，撇嘴。

最后商非凡和郎沐带走了约翰达索。

作为高级信徒，约翰达索知道真神教在王城的不少安排，至少他知道好几个高级信徒的名字。

当然，真神教的信徒见面时，除非特殊情况，否则都是藏头遮脸，不会暴露自己的真实身份。
chunks.englishText:
This Lord Dassou was similarly wreathed in grievances, except the system had not marked him with a red name.

Lang Mu drew his bone staff, sensing that this Lord Dassou's mental power was relatively strong.

Strong as Lord Dassou's mental power might be, it all depended on who he was being compared to.

Lang Mu cast mental control magic on him with virtually zero difficulty. This man's sea of consciousness was similarly devoid of any protection, easily breached by Lang Mu.

Lang Mu didn't damage his sea of consciousness; he simply compelled him to answer questions.

Yet, after a few questions, the three discovered that this Lord Dassou actually had no idea what was inside the gift box either. Whenever asked, he claimed it was prepared by his son, who insisted it would surely win the favor of the Duke's son.

As for the reason behind the gift, it was because the Dassou Trading Firm wanted to secure a grain-selling license.

Grain trading was a major affair in the Tiger Kingdom and across the entire Orc Continent. Many nations and powers prohibited private entities from buying and selling large quantities of grain and meat privately, unless they were licensed grain merchants.

"Father? I heard Lord Imman has arrived in person?"

The three turned simultaneously to see a lean male beastman walking in from outside.

Shang Feifan's eyes lit up: A red name! Grievances! There was a ninety-nine percent chance he was an evil god cultist.

Without wasting any more words, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu moved in unison, instantly seizing and subduing Lord Dassou's son.

Seeing Ares Shang and his guard attack his son, Lord Dassou was shocked and infuriated, hastily demanding an explanation for what was going on.

Annoyed by his incessant yapping, Imman bluntly stated, "Your son is an evil god cultist. Did you know?"

At those words, Lord Dassou collapsed into a chair, his face shifting through a kaleidoscope of colors.

From his expression, Imman could tell that Lord Dassou probably had some inkling of the truth.

Under the interrogation of Lang Mu's Truth-Speaking magic, John Dassou confessed his status within the True God Church.

And what a catch this turned out to be—a big shrimp indeed.

John Dassou was a high-ranking member of the True God Church in the Tiger Kingdom's capital.

Hearing his son confess to being an evil god cultist, Lord Dassou's face instantly turned ashen, plastered with the despair of utter ruin.

The Tiger Kingdom maintained a zero-tolerance policy toward evil god cultists. Once discovered, they were invariably eradicated, regardless of what status one held.

Though their family could claim ignorance, the higher-ups would never allow the family of a high-ranking evil god cultist to hold massive wealth and power.

Forget holding onto their existing family fortune; they would have to thank the heavens just to avoid being dragged into the dungeons.

However, when questioned about the origin of the gift box, John Dassou was clueless as well. He only knew that the gift box had been handed to him by the Bishop.

Shang Feifan rubbed his brow and muttered, "This True God Church is practically an onion; you peel back one layer only to find another underneath."

Lang Mu, by contrast, showed endless patience: "If they weren't this cautious, they would have been hunted down by us long ago, and they wouldn't have had the chance to pull off some grand conspiracy to sacrifice the entire city and let the evil god descend."

Imman reminded them: "Half an hour is almost up."

Lang Mu reassured him, "As long as the evil god's consciousness and power fail to descend, you don't have to worry about your body being usurped. Besides, I suspect your end was both a target and a decoy. If things didn't work out on your end, there was still your nephew Isaiah—it's just a pity we didn't have time to rush to Dean Fortress."

Imman: "..."

Shang Feifan also chimed in, "Don't worry, that bastard isn't getting out."

If a sliver of an evil god's consciousness and meager power could escape even after being dropped into the domain of the God of Nature, then Shang Feifan wouldn't even need to do tasks for the system anymore—if the ancient gods of the Orc Continent were that useless, what could a mere mortal like him possibly accomplish? He might as well just take his A-Mu and defect straight to the evil god.

The three of them wanted to keep peeling the onion, but the trail ended right here with John Dassou.

Because even John Dassou did not know the Bishop's true identity. Every time he met the Bishop, the other party wore a black robe with their face hidden beneath a hood, and he never dared to stare directly at the Lord Bishop.

As for their meeting locations, couriers would simply deliver messages to him, and there was no fixed rendezvous point.

These couriers were ordinary delivery personnel in the royal capital. They had no idea what contents the letters held or who the client was; as long as the client paid a sufficient reward, they would handle the legwork.

Shang Feifan said to Lang Mu, "Ask him for the characteristics of that Bishop in his memory, and where they used to meet."

Lang Mu nodded; he was just about to ask the exact same thing.

Many of the Special Investigation Bureau's cases were pieced together bit by bit from just such meager clues.

The half-hour time limit arrived.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu both subconsciously raised their heads to look at the sky.

The sky remained as azure as ever, promising fine weather today.

There was no descent of darkness, no howling winds, no eerie rolling mists, and the earth remained completely calm.

Imman clenched his hands into tight fists. He looked completely carefree on the outside, but how could anyone truly face death with ease?

One second, two seconds...

A full two minutes passed, and the royal capital remained entirely at peace.

Lord Dassou had no idea what was happening, only feeling that this suffocating silence was agonizing to the extreme.

Looking at his son, who had collapsed limply onto the ground with a dazed expression, Lord Dassou felt a surge of bitter hatred and rage.

Yet, he was equally clear in his heart about how he had obtained his lordship, and how their family had suddenly skyrocketed to immense wealth.

It was all because of this son of his...

Lord Dassou hadn't failed to wonder why his son was so remarkably lucky, able to acquire such a vast quantity of high-quality goods at such low prices—even if those goods were a bit miscellaneous and of dubious origin. As long as it brought their family massive profits, those were trivial matters.

He had also suspected how his son had managed to network with so many people, some of whom were figures their family could never have previously hoped to reach.

Relying on these connections and capital accumulation from virtually zero-cost goods, his son had quickly greased the wheels and bought him the title of baron.

A baron was the lowest-tier peerage that could be bought with money, essentially a preparatory rank of nobility.

Many true nobles didn't even acknowledge such a title.

Regardless, the title still carried considerable weight for ordinary beastmen, especially when conducting trade.

Now, Lord Dassou finally understood the secret behind his son's astounding competence.

It was because his son had an entire True God Church backing him from behind!

"The royal capital has survived another day," Shang Feifan joked.

Lang Mu let out a soft breath. "Yeah, another day passed in safety."

Imman sighed emotionally, "When can we completely eradicate the True God Church? These bastards are poisoning our beastman world far too severely. With them around, beastmen will never know a day of peace."

"Evil god cultists are a nuisance, but the root of the problem still lies with the evil god itself." Shang Feifan channeled a trace of mental power to steal a glance into the Statue Square.

That gift box sat quietly at the feet of the God of Nature's statue.

"When will that evil god truly vanish? How can we help our deities defeat it?" Imman genuinely seemed eager to lend a hand to the gods.

Shang Feifan casually replied, "Before the evil god recovers, find our ancient gods' power and return it to them."

Perhaps even more than that.

However, Shang Feifan had no idea what the deities (the system) were plotting behind the scenes right now; he could only take things one step at a time.

Lang Mu's lips moved slightly, but the language he spoke was not from the Orc Continent: "According to the intelligence gathered by the Special Investigation Bureau, evil god cultists used to only engage in mindless violence and stir up trouble behind the scenes. But in recent decades, they've grown increasingly bizarre and cunning, and far more organized—as if they've gained a brain and a repository of tactical knowledge. Guess what? Do you think quite a few magicians might have joined the True God Church?"

Shang Feifan blinked at him. "Highly likely."

Seeing the two of them conversing in a language he couldn't understand, Imman curled his lips in disdain.

In the end, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu took John Dassou away with them.

As a high-ranking believer, John Dassou knew quite a few of the True God Church's arrangements within the royal capital—at least, he knew the names of several other high-ranking cultists.

Naturally, unless under special circumstances, True God Church members always kept their faces and heads covered when meeting to avoid exposing their true identities.

但约翰达索的天赋能力就是眼力，虽然没有达到透视眼的地步，但他的观察力非常强，可以注意到别人注意不到的细微之处。

就凭这个天赋，他找出了好几个高级信徒在王城的真实身份，只是他从来不说。

郎沐三人去找那几个高级信徒，途中经过特调局，郎沐就把约翰达索交给了特调局内他的人手。

查找邪神信徒，原本就是特调局的责任。

而达索一家自然也会有特调局派人去调查、搜索，等罪证收集完毕后，再上交给大法官审问和判决。
