Yet John Dassou's innate talent happened to be keen eyesight. While it hadn't reached the level of X-ray vision, his observation skills were extraordinarily acute, allowing him to notice subtle details that others routinely missed.

 Relying on this talent, he had figured out the true identities of several high-ranking cultists in the royal capital, though he had never spoken of them.

As the trio went in search of those high-ranking cultists, they passed by the Special Investigation Bureau along the way, and Lang Mu handed John Dassou over to his subordinates stationed there.

Tracking down evil god cultists was, after all, the responsibility of the Special Investigation Bureau.

As for the Dassou family, the Bureau would naturally dispatch personnel to investigate and search their premises. Once the evidence of their crimes was fully gathered, the case would be handed over to the Grand Magistrate for trial and sentencing.

chunks.chineseText:
第207章 伊曼的来历

为了防止那些真神教的高级信徒得到消息逃跑，商非凡和郎沐两人从达索勋爵的府邸出来，就去找约翰达索交代出来的那几个真神教的高级信徒。

找到一个，就让郎沐审问，迫使对方供出更多邪神信徒。

如此抽丝剥茧、顺藤摸瓜下，真神教花了几十年时间在虎国王城埋下的棋子和势力，几乎被两人连根拔起。就算还有几个漏网之鱼，相信短期内也无法再形成规模。

期间，郎沐还找来了特调局的人，把一些不太重要的底层邪神信徒交给他们抓捕。

两人带着伊曼跑了一整天，只可惜两人最想抓到的主教一直没有明确信息。

约翰达索只说出这名主教大人的身高、体型、性别、说话腔调、走路姿势等大致印象，另外一个就是对方有一个习惯，说话的时候总喜欢嗯几声，另外提到对方似乎很喜欢穿灰绿鞋面的靴子。

这样的描述，不见到人肯定是无法辨认出来的。

在天完全黑透时，郎沐带着商非凡和伊曼回到了郎府。

郎侦老伯爵他们已经全都离开，府里一个人都没留。

郎沐对伯爵府和郎飞留下的那栋宅子都施展了魔法，不但可以防尘防潮防虫防腐蚀，更能保护房屋不被他人侵入。

伊曼惊讶地看向被郎沐打开的侧门。

刚刚他也就在这里，可他竟然没有注意到这里有一座偌大宅邸。

“这是什么炼金术？隐藏还是忽略？”伊曼好奇地问。

郎沐神秘一笑，推开侧门，邀请人进入。

伊曼看向阿瑞斯商：“你是不是不止擅长炼制空间类物品？”

“当然。不过别人发现不了这座宅邸可不是我的功劳。”商非凡骄傲地想：阿沐本事大着呢，他也就是低调惯了，不喜欢炫耀。

伊曼看看商非凡，又看看郎沐，只觉得这两人神秘无比。

郎沐等两人走进宅邸，轻念咒语，郎府侧门关闭。

伊曼看到自动关闭的大门，倒没有多惊讶，有些炼金大门也能有同样效果。

郎沐把两人带到花房。

花房里的植物都已经被带走，现在就是一个空房间。

伊曼忽然紧张起来。

郎沐看出他的紧张，笑：“别怕，就算不成功，我应该也不会把你弄成白痴，顶多让你头疼几天。”

伊曼深吸气，他不怕死，但想到有人要在自己的精神海里动手脚，莫名就紧张起来，并十分抗拒。

商非凡就靠在一边，负责护法。

郎沐：“如果你不愿意……”

伊曼强行忽略本能的抗拒，断然道：“我愿意。你开始吧！”

反正都是等死，还不如让郎沐试试。

当然他也有怀疑拉斐尔会不会在他的精神海里做手脚，让自己变成他的傀儡，可……如果没有拉斐尔和阿瑞斯商，他早在大半天前就自绝。

虽然他宁可死亡，也不愿被人控制。

但……他决定相信拉斐尔。

主要也是拉斐尔以前的为人让人相信，至少他表现出来的不像是那种会把别人当傀儡的坏蛋。

再说拉斐尔控制他又能让他做什么？

杀死切斯特大公？

那简直太好了！

刺杀王室成员？乃至刺杀虎王？

emmm……他父亲是切斯特大公，他可是知道很多人都不知道的王室秘密。比如虎王现在重病，比如大王子和拉斐尔的关系贼好。

除此之外，伊曼也想不到拉斐尔还能利用他做什么。

既然他的顾忌和担忧都不成立，那他为什么不试试？

说不定就成了呢？

人活着，总要抱些希望不是？

郎沐从空间戒指里拿出一张床，让伊曼躺上去。

伊曼咬牙躺上去，他的本能一直在抗拒。

郎沐双手轻轻笼罩住伊曼头颅两侧，轻声说：“放轻松，不要抵抗，你抵抗越强，越容易受到伤害。如果抵抗过强，为了不伤害你，我会放弃。”

伊曼再度深呼吸，强行压下自己本能的抗拒心，尽量放松：“你来吧，我受得住。”

商非凡在一边抽了抽嘴角。这话暧昧的，搞得他家阿沐好像要对他怎样似的。

伊曼闭上眼睛，郎沐轻念咒语。

伊曼本人没有抵抗的念头，就在郎沐的咒语声中慢慢沉睡过去，身体也跟着放松下来。

郎沐做好了精神防御，这才把自己的精神力丝一点点探入伊曼的精神海……

片刻后，郎沐脸上露出微微怪异的神情。

商非凡挑眉，因为不想打扰到郎沐，就忍住没询问。

大约过了半刻钟，郎沐额头都微微冒出了一些汗珠，这才结束了为伊曼精神海建造防御网和陷阱的过程。

商非凡看到郎沐松开双手，过去接住他，小小抱怨：“怎么搞得这么累？”

郎沐靠在他怀里，低笑：“没事。只是我没想到……”

“没想到什么？这家伙的精神海里有什么古怪？”商非凡问。

郎沐舔了舔嘴唇：“当年那群魔法师穿越过来时，肯定有一个空间裂缝就在虎国上方。怪不得真神教会把重点放在虎国，如果那群魔法师真的有不少去了真神教，他们肯定会想要先占领自己首先来到的地方。说不得他们还想要守住那条空间裂缝，想着以后还能回去法德尔大陆。”

商非凡瞬间明了：“这个伊曼也是魂穿者？”

郎沐颔首：“如果我没看错，他还是胎穿。切斯特大公的这个孩子早就胎死腹中，如果不是伊曼的灵魂穿越到胎儿身上，切斯特大公只会再次得到一个死胎。”

商非凡啧啧称奇：“怪不得伊曼生下来会是个病秧子，已经死掉的胎儿还能活过来就已经是奇迹。”

郎沐轻叹：“伊曼也付出了不小代价，他失去了魔法师的力量，也几乎失去了作为魔法师的全部记忆，相当于他是真的轮回重生。只是他的精神海深处还牢记了魔法师的基础法则，比如等价交换、保护自己的精神海等等。所以他才会那么抗拒被人侵入精神海。”

商非凡猜测：“那他的精神力是不是很强大？”

郎沐赞：“非常强大。强大到他很可能刚出生就有完整意识。”

商非凡了然：“我就说这么年轻的兽人怎么就有那么深的城府。竟然从小就知道套别人的话，还能搞清楚切斯特大公和邪神信徒来往，以及自己身为容器的秘密。毕竟谁会提防一个不懂事的小幼崽呢？”

商非凡忽然亲了亲郎沐的嘴角，还轻轻咬了咬。

郎沐脸上打出问号。

商非凡：“给你润润。”

郎沐：“……”

伊曼醒来，就看到不远处有一张小桌子，小桌子边摆放了两张椅子，那两个人正态度亲密地坐在那儿吃饭喝汤。

“你醒了，感觉如何？”郎沐抬头笑问。

伊曼从床上坐起，缓缓说道：“感觉脑子很清醒，我好像想起了一些事情，但又不是很清晰。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 207: Iman's Origin (Part 1)

To prevent the high-ranking cultists of the True God Cult from catching wind of the news and fleeing, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu left Lord Dasso’s estate and immediately went after the high-ranking cultists named in John Dasso's confession.

As soon as they caught one, Lang Mu interrogated them, forcing them to turn over even more evil god cultists.

Unraveling the thread layer by layer, the pair virtually uprooted the pawns and forces the True God Cult had spent decades planting in the Royal Capital of the Tiger Kingdom. Even if a few fish slipped through the net, they would be unable to form any substantial threat in the short term.

During this time, Lang Mu also contacted the Special Investigation Bureau, handing over less significant low-level cultists for them to arrest.

The two dragged Iman along for an entire day, but unfortunately, they obtained no clear intelligence regarding the bishop they wanted to capture most.

John Dasso could only provide a general impression—the bishop’s height, build, gender, tone of voice, and manner of walking. Beyond that, the man had two distinct habits: he constantly hummed or grunted "mm" while speaking, and he seemed particularly fond of wearing boots with grey-green vamps.

With a description like that, it was impossible to identify the man without seeing him in person.

By the time night had fallen completely, Lang Mu brought Shang Feifan and Iman back to the Lang Manor.

Old Earl Lang Zhen and the others had all departed, leaving no one behind in the residence.

Lang Mu had cast spells on both the Earl’s estate and the house left behind by Lang Fei. These spells not only prevented dust, moisture, pests, and corrosion, but also protected the structures from intruders.

Iman looked in surprise at the side door opened by Lang Mu.

He had been standing right here just a moment ago, yet he hadn't noticed that a massive mansion stood on this spot.

"What kind of alchemy is this? Concealment or cognitive erasure?" Iman asked curiously.

Lang Mu offered a mysterious smile, pushed open the side door, and invited him inside.

Iman turned to Ares Shang. "Are you skilled in more than just crafting spatial items?"

"Of course," Shang Feifan thought with pride. *It wasn't my doing that kept people from noticing this mansion, though. Ah-Mu is immensely capable—he's just used to keeping a low profile and dislikes showing off.*

Iman looked at Shang Feifan, then back at Lang Mu, feeling that the pair were profoundly enigmatic.

Once both of them stepped inside, Lang Mu softly chanted an incantation, and the side door of the Lang Manor swung shut.

Seeing the gate close automatically, Iman wasn't particularly shocked; certain alchemy doors possessed similar functions.

Lang Mu led the two to the conservatory.

The plants inside had all been moved away, leaving it an empty room.

Iman suddenly grew nervous.

Noticing his tension, Lang Mu smiled. "Don't be afraid. Even if it fails, I shouldn't turn you into an idiot. At most, you'll have a headache for a few days."

Iman took a deep breath. He wasn't afraid of dying, but the thought of someone meddling inside his spirit sea made him inexplicably anxious and deeply resistant.

Shang Feifan leaned against the wall nearby, acting as their guardian.

Lang Mu said, "If you're unwilling..."

Forcibly suppressing his instinctual resistance, Iman cut him off resolutely, "I am willing. Begin!"

Since he was waiting for death anyway, he might as well let Lang Mu try.

Of course, he had also suspected whether Raphael would tamper with his spirit sea to turn him into a puppet, but... without Raphael and Ares Shang, he would have ended his own life over half a day ago.

Although he would rather die than be controlled, he chose to trust Raphael.

This was mainly because Raphael's past conduct inspired trust; at least, he didn't project the air of a villain who treated others like puppets.

Besides, even if Raphael controlled him, what could he make him do?

Kill Grand Duke Chester?

That would be fantastic!

Assassinate members of the royal family? Or even assassinate the Tiger King?

*Emmm...* His father was Grand Duke Chester, so he knew many royal secrets that others were blind to. For instance, the Tiger King was gravely ill, and the First Prince was on exceedingly good terms with Raphael.

Apart from that, Iman couldn't imagine what else Raphael could use him for.

Since his misgivings and worries held no water, why shouldn't he give it a shot?

What if it actually worked?

A living person always needed to hold onto some hope, didn't they?

Lang Mu retrieved a bed from his spatial ring and gestured for Iman to lie down.

Gritting his teeth, Iman laid down, his instincts still fighting against it.

Lang Mu gently hovered his hands over both sides of Iman's head and whispered, "Relax. Do not resist. The stronger your resistance, the easier it is for you to get hurt. If your resistance is too strong, I will give up to avoid harming you."

Iman took another deep breath, forcefully stifling his instinctual aversion, and relaxed as much as he could. "Go ahead. I can take it."

Standing to the side, Shang Feifan's lips twitched slightly. *Those words sounded so ambiguous, as if my Ah-Mu was about to do something inappropriate to him.*

Iman closed his eyes. Lang Mu began to chant a soft incantation.

With no active thought of resistance from Iman, he gradually drifted off to sleep amid Lang Mu's chanting, his body relaxing completely.

Lang Mu constructed his mental defenses first before extending threads of his spiritual force, little by little, into Iman's spirit sea...

A moment later, a slightly strange expression appeared on Lang Mu's face.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. Not wanting to disturb Lang Mu, he held back his questions.

After about a quarter-hour, beads of sweat glistened on Lang Mu's forehead before he finally concluded the process of erecting a defense network and traps within Iman's spirit sea.

Seeing Lang Mu release his hands, Shang Feifan stepped forward to support him, complaining quietly, "Why did you exhaust yourself so much?"

Leaning against his chest, Lang Mu chuckled softly. "I'm fine. It's just that I didn't expect..."

"Didn't expect what? Is there something strange inside this guy's spirit sea?" Shang Feifan asked.

Lang Mu licked his lips. "Back when that group of mages transmigrated over, there must have been a spatial rift directly above the Tiger Kingdom. No wonder the True God Cult focused their efforts on the Tiger Kingdom. If a good number of those mages truly joined the True God Cult, they would definitely want to occupy the territory where they first arrived. They might even want to guard that spatial rift, hoping to return to the Fadel Continent in the future."

Shang Feifan instantly understood. "This Iman is also a soul-transmigrator?"

Lang Mu nodded. "If I'm not mistaken, he was a fetus transmigrator. Grand Duke Chester's child was already dead in the womb. If Iman's soul hadn't transmigrated into the fetus, Grand Duke Chester would have only gotten another stillborn."

Shang Feifan marvelled, "No wonder Iman was born sickly. Bringing a dead fetus back to life is already a miracle in itself."

Lang Mu sighed softly. "Iman paid a heavy price as well. He lost his power as a mage and nearly all his memories of being one. It's equivalent to a true reincarnation. However, deep within his spirit sea, the fundamental laws of a mage—such as equivalent exchange and protecting one's spirit sea—were firmly ingrained. That is why he was so resistant to having his spirit sea invaded."

Shang Feifan mused, "Then is his spiritual force very powerful?"

Lang Mu praised, "Extremely powerful. So powerful that he likely possessed complete consciousness the moment he was born."

Shang Feifan gained a sudden epiphany. "No wonder such a young Beastman possesses such deep scheming minds. He actually knew how to probe others for information since he was a child, and even uncovered Grand Duke Chester's dealings with the evil god cultists and his own secret as a container. After all, who would guard against a clueless little cub?"

Shang Feifan suddenly kissed the corner of Lang Mu's lips, giving it a gentle nip.

A question mark practically popped up on Lang Mu's face.

Shang Feifan said, "Moistening your lips for you."

Lang Mu: "..."

When Iman woke up, he saw a small table nearby with two chairs beside it, where the two were sitting close together, eating food and drinking soup.

"You're awake. How do you feel?" Lang Mu looked up and asked with a smile.

Iman sat up from the bed and spoke slowly, "My mind feels very clear. I seem to remember some things, but they aren't very distinct."

chunks.chineseText:
郎沐放下筷子：“不用在意，那只是你的深层潜意识，你也可以认为那是你上一世的记忆。不用去特意想，它们会在你的梦境里出现，直到你能分得清自己到底是谁。”

伊曼下意识说：“让一切顺其自然？”

郎沐：“对。相信你自己，不要急。”

伊曼虽然还没有恢复作为魔法师的记忆，但他隐隐又有一种知道郎沐在说什么的微妙感觉。

“成功了吗？”伊曼转而问起自己最关心的事。

郎沐点头：“还算顺利。你本身的精神力就很强大，这点很好。我帮你建立了双重精神防御网，也布置了双重陷阱。一旦有谁的灵魂或精神力闯入你的精神海，就会被你的精神力重创。如果对方强行闯到第二层，你的精神力会反过来吞噬对方的精神力。”

伊曼欣喜又感到神奇：“我自己要怎么做？”

郎沐：“当有人的精神力闯入你的精神海，你就本能地知道该怎么做。”

郎沐还想说，你原本就是很厉害的魔法师，你虽然失去了记忆，但一些基础魔法和精神类魔法已经成为你的本能，当有人攻击你，你自然就知道该如何反击。

但想到伊曼情况特殊，还是由他自己想起来比较好。郎沐就没有多说。

他给伊曼建立的防御网和陷阱，相当于是帮助伊曼建造了两层城墙和坑陷，但要如何打退甚至是杀死敌人，则要靠伊曼自己的士兵（精神力）。

原本郎沐设想的是，伊曼精神力不强的话，他会留一部分自己的精神力帮助伊曼对敌，等以后再收回自己的这部分精神力。

但伊曼本身精神力就很强大，那他就没必要这么做了。强行留下自己的精神力，反而会被伊曼的精神力排斥。

伊曼看着郎沐，神色异样。

过了一会儿，他才说道：“你和我想的有点不一样。”

郎沐好笑：“哪里不一样？”

“比我想的厉害得多。”伊曼转而想到拉斐尔郎沐的身世，忍不住说：“你真能忍。”

如果换了他有拉斐尔这样的本事，他才不会忍到身世暴露的那一天，他绝对会把敢于得罪他、欺负他的人都揍成猪头。

郎沐失笑，幽幽说：“这不是缺乏魔晶吗。”

“魔晶？那是什么？”伊曼下意识觉得这东西对自己很重要。

“是魔法师需要的能量源泉。”郎沐还很贴心地解释：“魔法师就是传说中的魔血血脉，他们施展的魔法就是古老巫术。”

伊曼吃惊：“你是魔血血脉？”

郎沐笑笑，没有回答是，也没有回答不是。

伊曼非常感兴趣，紧追着问：“觉醒魔血血脉需要什么条件？你看我有魔血血脉吗？”

郎沐心想：你压根不需要觉醒，你只要恢复记忆就能成为魔法师。

嘴上则说：“魔血血脉需要魔力提供能源。在非常遥远的远古时期，兽人大陆还有魔力存在，但随着时间流逝，魔力逐渐从兽人大陆消失。我怀疑可能就因为魔力越来越少，才导致魔血血脉不得不离开兽人大陆。”

商非凡搭话：“可能和神之笼有关。神之笼出现后，各大陆之间的能量流通被隔断，兽人大陆仅存的魔力如果没有源头持续生产，里面的魔力自然会越用越少。”

郎沐露出若有所思的神情：“以前就有法圣说魔力和魔晶源有关。”

商非凡自然询问：“魔晶源是什么？”

郎沐思考片刻：“应该是天河星的某种特殊物质，这种特殊物质可以吸收周边的能量，比如暗物质、暗能量，经过某些我们还不知道的化学作用，最终凝结成魔晶。”

商非凡懂了：“就像是宇宙尘埃吸附附近的尘埃，逐渐凝结成石块，再慢慢凝聚成一个星球。”

郎沐点头：“过程类似。魔晶源继续吸附更多能量凝结成新的魔晶，如此就慢慢形成了魔晶矿。而魔晶矿散发出的辐射能，改变了当地环境，就在空气中形成魔力。而魔力浓郁后又能像魔晶源一样把其他能量转化为魔力，当魔力浓郁到某种程度，又能形成魔晶源。如此产生循环。”

两人说这段话没有避着伊曼，伊曼听到这里不禁问：“我们兽人大陆没有魔晶源吗？还有神之笼是什么？”

商非凡回答了伊曼的问题：“如果兽人大陆有魔晶源，当年魔血血脉就不会败给神血血脉，从而离开兽人大陆去寻找其他新大陆。”

“至于神之笼，简单说就是古神对天河星的一种保护手段。根据我们在图书馆看到的一些远古记载和传说，推测天河星能量太丰富，从而孕育了很多神灵，且这些神灵隶属于各个不同大陆，使用的能量也不同。

当这些神灵想要展开神灵之战，也许已经展开之时，有一个非常厉害，也许是天河星的星球意识，就搞出了一个神之笼，把整个天河星所有大陆都分割开，让那些神灵不能前往其他大陆。”

商非凡又补充：“虎王他让人抄录回来的书籍中就有不少关于神之笼的传说。我记得他说过这些不涉及传承的普识书籍会放到王城图书馆中供所有人阅读，现在应该已经放进去，你可以去看看。”

伊曼耸肩：“如果我能活下来，我会去看看的。”

“事情办完，你也该回去了。王宫那边的邪神阴影者已经消失，你父亲应该已经归家，我想他应该正在派人满城寻找你。”商非凡收起碗筷说道，显然不打算请伊曼吃饭。

伊曼眨眼：“我报酬还没付。”

商非凡就喜欢这种懂事的，“你可以回去后再付。我相信你这位大公之子应该不会赖掉我们的报酬。”

郎沐在桌下轻轻踢了老商一脚，他就没想过要报酬。

商非凡觉得冤枉，“他自己提的。”

伊曼似笑非笑：“对，是我自己提的。你们想要土地还是想要金达盾？”

商非凡才不会客气，表示都行。

伊曼索性说：“你们愿意接收雇佣吗？我父亲的战斗力还是很厉害的，否则他也不会成为一国大公。论起战斗力，他大概可以在虎国排到前三。”

商非凡：“你这是怕打不过你父亲？”

伊曼坦然：“我怕他在侵入我精神海之前，先把我打到昏迷。”

郎沐：“除非对方的精神力远超过你，直接用精神力打晕你。否则你就算身体昏迷过去，精神上也还是会保持清醒。退一万步说，你意识跟着昏迷，可一旦有人侵入你的精神海，你的意识也会立刻被刺激醒。我建的精神力防御网就有这样的作用。”

伊曼放心了一些，从单人床上跳下来：“我记得我家有一块领地就在你刚得到的那块领地附近。如果你们愿意帮我对付我父亲，加上之前的帮助，我可以把那块领地送给你们。只要我能继承切斯特家族的一切。”

不等两人考虑，伊曼又追加说明：“那块领地沿海，你们获得那片土地就可以让你们的领地直通海域。”

商非凡和郎沐都动心了。

Chapter 207: Iman's Origin (Part 2)

Lang Mu put down his chopsticks. "Don't dwell on it. That's merely your deep subconscious—you can also regard it as memories from your past life. There's no need to force yourself to recall them. They will surface in your dreams until you can distinguish who you truly are."

Iman said subconsciously, "Let nature take its course?"

Lang Mu replied, "Exactly. Trust yourself, and don't rush."

Although Iman had yet to recover his memories as a mage, he felt a subtle, vague sensation that he knew what Lang Mu was talking about.

"Did it succeed?" Iman pivoted to the matter he cared about most.

Lang Mu nodded. "It went smoothly enough. Your own spiritual force is inherently formidable, which was a huge advantage. I helped you construct a dual spiritual defense network and laid down a dual layer of traps. If anyone's soul or spiritual force invades your spirit sea, they will be severely damaged by your own spiritual force. If they forcibly push into the second layer, your spiritual force will turn around and devour theirs."

Delighted and amazed, Iman asked, "What do I need to do on my end?"

Lang Mu answered, "When someone's spiritual force invades your spirit sea, you will instinctively know what to do."

Lang Mu had originally wanted to say: *You were originally a powerful mage. Although you lost your memories, basic magic and mental spells have become part of your instincts. When someone attacks you, you will naturally know how to fight back.*

However, considering Iman's unique situation, it was better for him to remember on his own, so Lang Mu refrained from saying more.

The defense network and traps he built for Iman were equivalent to constructing two layers of city walls and moat traps. But how to beat back or even slay the enemy would ultimately depend on Iman's own soldiers (his spiritual force).

Initially, Lang Mu had envisioned that if Iman's spiritual force was weak, he would leave a portion of his own spiritual force behind to help Iman fight off enemies, which he would reclaim later.

However, since Iman's spiritual force was exceptionally strong on its own, there was no need for that. Forcibly leaving his own spiritual force behind would instead cause Iman's spiritual force to reject it.

Iman looked at Lang Mu with a strange expression.

After a long moment, he finally said, "You're a bit different from what I imagined."

Lang Mu found it amusing. "Different in what way?"

"Far more formidable than I thought." Turning his thoughts to Raphael Lang Mu's background, Iman couldn't help but add, "You really know how to endure."

If he possessed Raphael's capabilities, he would never have endured until his heritage was exposed. He would have thrashed anyone who dared to offend or bully him into a bloody pulp.

Lang Mu let out a wry chuckle and said softly, "Wasn't that due to a lack of magic crystals?"

"Magic crystals? What are those?" Iman instinctively felt that this item was vitally important to him.

"They are the energy source required by mages." Lang Mu thoughtfully explained, "Mages possess the legendary Magic Bloodline, and the magic they cast is ancient sorcery."

Iman was shocked. "You have the Magic Bloodline?"

Lang Mu smiled, neither confirming nor denying it.

Deeply intrigued, Iman pressed on, "What conditions are required to awaken the Magic Bloodline? Do you think I have it?"

Lang Mu thought to himself: *You don't need to awaken it at all. As long as you recover your memories, you can become a mage.*

Aloud, he said, "The Magic Bloodline requires mana as an energy source. In the extremely distant ancient era, mana existed on the Beastman Continent. But as time passed, mana gradually dissipated from this land. I suspect that the diminishing mana was precisely what forced those with the Magic Bloodline to leave the Beastman Continent."

Shang Feifan interjected, "It might be related to the Cage of the Gods. After the Cage of the Gods appeared, energy flow between the continents was severed. Without a continuous source to produce it, the remaining mana on the Beastman Continent naturally dwindled as it was consumed."

Lang Mu showed a thoughtful expression. "In the past, Arcane Masters said that mana was linked to Magic Crystal Sources."

Shang Feifan asked naturally, "What is a Magic Crystal Source?"

Lang Mu pondered for a moment. "It should be a special substance unique to Planet Tianhe. This special substance can absorb surrounding energy, such as dark matter and dark energy. Through certain chemical reactions we don't yet understand, it eventually condenses into magic crystals."

Shang Feifan grasped it immediately. "Just like cosmic dust attracting nearby dust, gradually condensing into rock, and slowly coalescing into a planet."

Lang Mu nodded. "A similar process. The Magic Crystal Source continues to absorb more energy to condense into new magic crystals, gradually forming a magic crystal mine. The radiation energy emitted by the mine alters the local environment, creating mana in the air. Once mana becomes dense enough, it can convert other energies into mana just like a Magic Crystal Source. And when mana reaches a certain concentration, it can form a new Magic Crystal Source. Thus, a cycle is created."

The two did not hide their conversation from Iman. Hearing this, Iman couldn't help asking, "Does our Beastman Continent have no Magic Crystal Sources? And what is this Cage of the Gods?"

Shang Feifan answered Iman's questions: "If the Beastman Continent had Magic Crystal Sources, those with the Magic Bloodline wouldn't have lost to those with the Divine Bloodline, forcing them to leave the Beastman Continent in search of new lands.

As for the Cage of the Gods, simply put, it was a protective measure enacted by ancient gods for Planet Tianhe. Based on ancient records and legends we found in the library, it is speculated that Planet Tianhe was so rich in energy that it birthed many deities. These deities belonged to different continents and utilized different energies.

When these deities sought to wage a War of Gods—or perhaps when one had already begun—an immensely powerful entity, possibly the planetary consciousness of Planet Tianhe itself, created the Cage of the Gods. It partitioned all the continents of Planet Tianhe so those deities could no longer travel to other lands."

Shang Feifan added, "The Tiger King had his men transcribe many books containing legends about the Cage of the Gods. I recall him saying that these general knowledge books without secret inheritances would be placed in the Royal Capital Library for everyone to read. They should be available by now; you can go take a look."

Iman shrugged. "If I survive this, I will go check them out."

"Now that business is done, you should head back. The shadow of the evil god at the palace has vanished, so your father has likely returned home. I imagine he's sending people across the city to look for you," Shang Feifan said as he cleared the bowls and chopsticks, clearly having no intention of inviting Iman to dinner.

Iman blinked. "I haven't paid my reward yet."

Shang Feifan liked people who were sensible. "You can pay us after you get back. I trust that as the son of a Grand Duke, you won't renege on our payment."

Under the table, Lang Mu lightly kicked Old Shang. He had never intended to demand a reward.

Shang Feifan felt wronged. *He brought it up himself.*

Iman smiled half-heartedly. "Yes, I brought it up myself. Do you want land, or do you want Gold Dashields?"

Shang Feifan wasn't one to stand on ceremony and indicated that either was fine.

Iman simply said, "Are you willing to accept a commission? My father's combat power is formidable; otherwise, he wouldn't have become a Grand Duke of the realm. In terms of sheer battle prowess, he probably ranks among the top three in the Tiger Kingdom."

Shang Feifan said, "Are you afraid you can't beat your father?"

Iman admitted frankly, "I'm afraid he'll beat me into a coma before he invades my spirit sea."

Lang Mu stated, "Unless the opponent's spiritual force far surpasses yours and knocks you unconscious directly with mental power, your spirit will remain awake even if your physical body falls unconscious. Even in the worst-case scenario where your consciousness falls asleep, the moment someone invades your spirit sea, your consciousness will be instantly jolted awake. The spiritual defense network I constructed serves that exact purpose."

Reassured, Iman jumped down from the single bed. "I recall my family owns a territory located right near the land you just acquired. If you are willing to help me deal with my father, combined with your previous assistance, I can gift that territory to you—provided I inherit everything from the Chester family."

Before the two could consider it, Iman added further details: "That territory lies along the coast. Obtaining that land will give your territory direct access to the sea."

Both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were moved by the offer.

黑水荒原领区虽然好，但它属于内陆，唯一一条大河就是黑水河，可黑水河每个段落都有另外的领主，想要利用黑水河进行水运，不是不可以，但会受到很多挟制。

如果黑水荒原能一路通到海边，除了交通会更加便利，更能给他们以及依赖那片土地生活的人们带来一条新退路。

除交通和海运的利好之外，领地包括海域还有更多好处。制盐、渔业、与海货相关的各种副食品、港口通商、税收……好处简直数不胜数。

“成交！”商非凡和郎沐互视，一口答应。

郎沐哪怕不为自己着想，也会为莫约镇民和他的镇长姨父多想一想。

“为了保证你动手的合法性，我们在与你回去切斯特公爵府之前，最好先去一趟王宫。”商非凡提醒。

伊曼想到大王子和拉斐尔交好的事，“你们要去找大王子说明我的事情？”

商非凡没有否认：“想说多少，全看你自己。我们要的是你动手后，王庭也不会找你麻烦，并承认你的继承权。另外，你还得和王庭那边想好一个统一的借口，就是你为什么会杀死你那么多亲人。”

伊曼仔细想了想，同意。

“我继位后，可能无法再做公爵，很可能是降等袭爵，就是不知道要降几等。而属于切斯特家族的财产，应该都能保留下来。就算保不住，我也会把承诺的那片领地转让给你们。我想以你们和大王子的关系，那片领地只要我转让给你们，那就是你们的了。”

郎沐忽然说：“如果你保不住太多领地，我建议你可以把一些你觉得麻烦的领地送归国有，比如迪安要寨这样的地方，这样大王子保你也有理由。”

伊曼眼睛一亮：“你说的没错。收不回来的领地还不如不要。一些靠近边境线，或者和其他大贵族接壤的贫瘠领地或具有军事作用的领地，我完全可以送给大王子。到时候就算无法再继续做公爵，做个侯爵应该没多大问题。还能博得大王子信赖。”

商非凡对伊曼竖起大拇指：“想得通透。我相信你以后一定会在虎国混得很好。”

郎沐心说：以后伊曼如果能恢复魔法师的记忆，并弄到魔晶，说不定还会成为虎国核武器一样的存在。

在法德尔大陆，很多国家都会拥有自己的魔导师。而魔导师就相当于核武器，非轻易不会动用。

伊曼又和两人商量了一个统一借口，来和大王子以及民众解释他为什么会杀死那么多亲人和仆从。

商量妥当，三人就不再耽搁，直接去了王宫。

这次商非凡没有大摇大摆地进去，而是让郎沐对伊曼施展了隐身术，偷偷溜入王宫。

他们进入王宫后，也没有先去找大王子，而是先去找克莱门特了解情况。

克莱门特看到伊曼切斯特，心中惊讶，却没有多问。

阿瑞斯商说明来意，克莱门特按照规矩，让他们稍等，先去见了大王子询问意见，这才带领他们去见大王子。

这一套都是做给伊曼看的，也给大王子一个心理准备。

大王子对送上门的公爵之子非常欢迎，尤其对方还想把自己的父亲从公爵位子上拉下来，咳。

大王子承认他不太喜欢切斯特大公。哪个掌权者会喜欢一个不把自己放在眼里的臣子？

尤其他父王都在怀疑切斯特大公是否和邪神信徒有勾结。

伊曼切斯特就显得有眼力多了，对他十分尊敬，更摆出了以他马首是瞻的模样。

最重要的是，伊曼切斯特是拉斐尔和阿瑞斯商带来的。

大王子认定拉斐尔就不可能坑他。

在伊曼和大王子秘密商谈时，克莱门特也在和商非凡两人说事情。

克莱门特告诉两人，说北熊盟主等人都在寻找他们，原因就是阿瑞斯商拿出来的虫毒祛除药剂太好用。

商非凡早就猜到会有这种反应，他却不打算那么快就去见那些势力大佬。

送上门的不值钱，先吊吊他们的胃口再说。

“还有虫王也在找你，说要找你单独聊聊。”克莱门特意有所指地说。

商非凡微笑。看，这不就有大鱼上钩了。

Chapter 207: Iman's Origin (Part 3)

Although the Blackwater Wasteland territory was excellent, it was landlocked. Its only major river was the Blackwater River, but every stretch of it was controlled by different lords. Utilizing the river for water transport was possible, but it came with heavy restrictions.

If the Blackwater Wasteland could reach all the way to the coast, beyond making transportation infinitely more convenient, it would offer a new line of retreat for them and the people relying on that land for survival.

Apart from the benefits to transport and maritime shipping, holding coastal territory and ocean waters yielded countless advantages: salt production, fisheries, various processed sea products, port trade, tax revenue... the benefits were practically endless.

"Deal!" Shang Feifan and Lang Mu exchanged a glance and agreed in unison.

Even if Lang Mu didn't consider himself, he had to think for the townsfolk of Moyue Town and his uncle-in-law, the town mayor.

"To ensure the legitimacy of your actions, we had better visit the royal palace before heading back with you to the Chester Ducal Manor," Shang Feifan reminded him.

Iman recalled the close relationship between the First Prince and Raphael. "You want to explain my situation to the First Prince?"

Shang Feifan didn't deny it. "How much you reveal is entirely up to you. What we want is for the Royal Court not to trouble you after you make your move, and to officially recognize your right of succession. Additionally, you need to work out a unified excuse with the Royal Court regarding why you killed so many of your own relatives."

Iman pondered carefully and agreed.

"After I succeed the title, I might not be able to remain a Grand Duke. It's highly likely my title will be demoted by a few ranks upon inheritance. However, the property belonging to the Chester family should largely remain intact. Even if it can't all be preserved, I will still transfer that promised territory to you. Given your relationship with the First Prince, as long as I transfer that land to you, it will be yours."

Lang Mu suddenly said, "If you can't hold onto too much territory, I suggest you surrender troublesome lands to the state—places like Fortress Di'an, for instance. That way, the First Prince will have a valid reason to protect you."

Iman's eyes lit up. "You're right. Lands that can't be held onto are better surrendered. Impoverished border territories, lands bordering other grand nobles, or military strongholds—I can give all of those to the First Prince. When the time comes, even if I can no longer remain a Grand Duke, retaining the title of Marquis shouldn't be much of a problem. It will also earn me the First Prince's trust."

Shang Feifan gave Iman a thumbs-up. "Clear thinking. I believe you'll do very well in the Tiger Kingdom in the future."

Lang Mu thought to himself: *In the future, if Iman recovers his memories as a mage and acquires magic crystals, he might even become a deterrent equivalent to a strategic weapon in the Tiger Kingdom.*

On the Fadel Continent, many nations possessed their own Archmages. An Archmage was akin to a strategic weapon—one not easily deployed without grave reason.

Iman then brainstormed a unified excuse with the two of them to explain to the First Prince and the public why he had slain so many of his relatives and servants.

With their plan settled, the trio wasted no time and headed straight for the royal palace.

This time, Shang Feifan didn't strut inside openly. Instead, he had Lang Mu cast an invisibility spell on Iman, allowing them to sneak into the palace undetected.

Upon entering the royal palace, they didn't seek out the First Prince right away. Instead, they went to Clement first to get a sense of the situation.

Clement was surprised to see Iman Chester, but he refrained from asking unnecessary questions.

Ares Shang explained their purpose. Following protocol, Clement asked them to wait while he went to consult the First Prince. Only after receiving permission did he lead them to the audience chamber.

This formality was performed for Iman's benefit and to give the First Prince time to prepare mentally.

The First Prince warmly welcomed the Grand Duke's son who had delivered himself to his doorstep—especially since the youth wished to pull his own father down from the ducal seat. *Ahem.*

The First Prince admitted he didn't particularly care for Grand Duke Chester. What ruler would favor a subject who held no respect for him?

Particularly when his royal father already suspected Grand Duke Chester of conspiring with evil god cultists.

Iman Chester appeared far more perceptive, treating him with utmost deference and adopting an attitude of taking his lead entirely from the First Prince.

Most importantly, Iman Chester was brought here by Raphael and Ares Shang.

The First Prince was convinced that Raphael would never set a trap for him.

While Iman and the First Prince conferred in secret, Clement was also conversing with Shang Feifan and Lang Mu.

Clement informed the pair that the Alliance Leader of the Northern Bear and other faction leaders were searching high and low for them. The reason was simply that the insect toxin detoxifying potion Ares Shang had produced was extraordinarily effective.

Shang Feifan had long anticipated such a reaction, yet he had no intention of meeting those faction heavyweights so soon.

Unsolicited favors were held in low regard; it was better to whet their appetites first.

"Also, the Insect King is looking for you as well, saying he wants to speak with you in private," Clement said, his tone laden with subtle implication.

Shang Feifan smiled. *Look at that—a big fish has taken the bait.*

第208章 原来他是

郎沐跟克莱门特大致说了这天他们在王城里干的事，让这位王身边的重臣加近臣能心中有数。

“那个主教是王城人？”克莱门特也很在意这个主教。

郎沐摇头：“现在还不确定。约翰达索说他说话是王城本地口音，不是那种特意学过本地方言的外地人。但也有可能对方很早就来到王城，特意学习了很久的本地语调和俚语。另外就是对方气质很好，应该是当惯了上位者。对了，据说对方很喜欢穿灰绿色靴子。”

“灰绿色靴子？”克莱门特微微一怔。

商非凡：“怎么？有印象？”

克莱门特还真的有印象，先问：“知不知道对方的身高和体型？”

郎沐按照约翰达索的描述，对着商非凡比划：“跟阿商差不多高，但没有他身材这么精干。约翰达索推测对方年龄很可能在一百岁以上，有非常丰富的社会经验。”

克莱门特听到这个描述，再和脑中印象中那人一对比：“我不知道是不是那人，但可以去详细查一查。”

“别卖关子了。是谁？”商非凡直接问。

克莱门特叹息：“是三王子府的大管家。他全名叫库尔特劳伦斯，跟随母姓。”

商非凡玩味地说：“听起来这位管家的身世似乎有点可说的内容？”

克莱门特无奈：“也算不上什么特殊，就是各国王室和贵族间常有的事。库尔特是一位王室成员的后代，但他母亲是别人送给对方的女奴。按照王室规矩，这样的孩子大多都会被送到外地，让他们自由成长，他们甚至不会知道自己的身世。”

“但也有少数几个会因为天赋、能力、容貌等原因，被父母留在身边。但他们的身份通常不会被承认，只是会被重点培养。”

“库尔特这个人，我对他年轻时了解不多，只知道他曾作为王宫侍从培养，也在王宫工作过很长一段时间。后来因为表现比较优异，被王后做主赐给三王子当管家。据说他在三王子面前也十分有脸面，三王子对这个管家也十分倚重，府邸中所有杂事几乎都交给这个管家处理。”

“库尔特喜欢穿灰绿色靴子则跟王室颜色有关，我虎国王室的徽章底色就是灰绿色。库尔特在借用这种方式，暗搓搓地表明自己也是王室血脉的身份。”

克莱门特顿了顿：“我记得陛下还曾夸奖过库尔特，说他把三王子府安排和管理得井井有条，没有让三王子府变得乌烟瘴气。还能帮三王子经营一些买卖，维持三王子的豪奢生活。”

商非凡懂了：“管家中的精英人物，具有不错的行政管理能力。”

克莱门特：“对。贵族家里的管家可不好做，越是大贵族对于管家的能力要求越高。库尔特作为管家还是挺有名的，很多贵族都觉得库尔特跟着三王子可惜了，还有人透露过要是库尔特被三王子辞退或不想在三王子那里做事，他们会很欢迎。”

郎沐插话：“库尔特的父亲是王室直系成员？”

“不是。”克莱门特摇头：“他父亲只是王室的旁支，与郎老伯爵和王室的血缘关系类似。只是郎老伯爵跟随母姓，才和王室关系远了。”

“也就是他父亲只是王城的边缘人物，并没有什么实权在手？”商非凡问。

克莱门特点头：“对方能力一般，靠着王室血脉混到一个子爵的名头，但也只有名头，没有封地更没有实权，年轻时还在王宫做些杂事，年老后就靠子爵的那点补贴生活。对方如今年岁比郎老伯爵还大一些，身体也不怎么样。”

郎沐询问了那位老子爵的居住地址后，表示：“我会把他们都查一查。等会儿伊曼出来，麻烦你跟他说一声，就说我和阿商去查线索，让他有什么事先联系你。另外，大王子那边有什么疑问，也等我们回来再说。”

克莱门特压根就没劝阻，只说：“你们小心。”

郎沐正要和商非凡离开，想了想，停下脚步，转身，从空间戒指中摸出一块半透明的晶石交给克莱门特。

“这个，你等会儿给伊曼，让他随身携带。如果他问这晶石是什么，有什么作用。你就说他带着就知道了，总之对他没有害处。”

克莱门特接过晶石，答应一定会转交给伊曼。

于是，等伊曼和大王子商谈完毕出来时，就没看到商非凡两人。

克莱门特把两人的交代告诉伊曼。

“有什么需要我帮忙的吗？”克莱门特看到大王子侍从出来时打出的手势，问伊曼。

伊曼也没客气：“大殿下说，请您安排几名身手比较强的侍卫随同我一起回大公府，直到我的事情办完。”

克莱门特立刻安排人手，他给伊曼安排了四名好手，让他们务必保护好伊曼。

伊曼看护身符到手，就要离开王宫。

克莱门特叫住伊曼，掏出晶石，递给他：“这是拉斐尔让我一定要转交给你的东西，他让你随身携带，说对你有用。”

伊曼好奇地接过那枚晶石，刚把晶石拿到手中，心中就升起一股奇妙的感觉。

克莱门特注意观察伊曼表情，猜测他对这个晶石并不是一无所知。

伊曼从恍惚中醒来，低头看手中晶石，眼中有奇异的光彩闪过。刚刚，他脑中似乎浮现了一些奇妙的知识。

伊曼有些兴奋，他紧握住晶石，甚至忘记和克莱门特告辞，就这么匆匆离开王宫。

四名侍卫收到统领指示，迅速跟上。

等走出王宫，被冷风一吹，伊曼发热的脑子冷却了几分。

伊曼把晶石收入空间手镯，对四名侍卫歉意地笑笑，这才叫车回去大公府。

商非凡和郎沐的速度很快，他们不希望给那名主教得到消息逃离的机会。

更不想对方拿三王子和其府邸中的人来威胁王城。

三王子府的守卫比起王宫可就差远了，连防隐身的炼金工具都只是基础款。

商非凡和郎沐不说进三王子府如进无人之境，但也差不了多少。

至少他们一路走入三王子府的中心位置，都没有人发现他们。

三王子今天没有得到允许，进入传承分享大会会场，这让他很不高兴。

但他也不敢闹，因为他发现他的父王似乎不再容忍他们这些子女的胡闹。

大半个月前他不过率众打了一个外地来的小贵族，就被他父王斥责，不但命他赔礼道歉赔偿对方一切损失，更把他拘禁在家中，且在没有得到明确王令前，不准他踏出三王子府一步。

三王子想闹，但他的心腹仆人和管家都劝他先忍过这段时间。

三王子也不是真的没头脑，他能感觉出来自己已经被边缘化，也许要不了多久，他就只能被封一个顶多是伯爵的名誉头衔，然后就跟以前的王室血脉一样，被圈养在王城中。

等过个两三代，他这一支就会彻底化成平民。

三王子并不想落到那样凄惨的地步。在他看来只能得一个爵位的名誉头衔，靠一点王室补贴金生活，那就是凄惨。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 208: So It Turns Out He Was... (Part 1)

Lang Mu gave Clement a general rundown of what they had done in the royal city that day, ensuring that this high-ranking and deeply trusted minister by the monarch's side was kept in the loop.

"That bishop is a native of the royal city?" Clement was also extremely concerned about this bishop.

Lang Mu shook his head. "Not certain yet. John Darsuo said he spoke with a local royal city accent, not like an out-of-towner who had deliberately studied the local dialect. However, it's also possible that the individual arrived in the royal city a long time ago and spent a long time mastering the local intonations and slang. Moreover, the person carries an air of great refinement; they must be accustomed to being in a position of authority. Oh, right, it is said that this person is very fond of wearing grey-green boots."

"Grey-green boots?" Clement paused slightly.

Shang Feifan asked, "What? Does that ring a bell?"

Clement actually did have a mental impression. He asked first, "Do you know the person's height and build?"

Following John Darsuo's description, Lang Mu gestured in comparison to Shang Feifan. "About the same height as Ah-Shang, but not quite as lean and athletic. John Darsuo deduces that the person's age is very likely over a hundred, possessing extremely rich worldly experience."

Hearing this description and comparing it with the image in his mind, Clement muttered, "I don't know if it's him, but we can look into it in detail."

"Stop playing riddles. Who is it?" Shang Feifan asked bluntly.

Clement sighed. "It's the Third Prince's head steward. His full name is Kurt Lawrence, and he follows his mother's surname."

Shang Feifan said with a playful tone, "Sounds like this steward's background has some interesting stories to tell?"

Clement said with a helpless shrug, "It's nothing particularly special—just the usual sort of affair among royal families and nobles of various nations. Kurt is the descendant of a royal family member, but his mother was a female slave given to that person as a gift. According to royal rules, children born like this are mostly sent away to the outer provinces to grow up freely; they might not even know their own lineage."

"However, a small handful are kept by their parents due to talent, ability, or appearance. But their status is usually not officially acknowledged; instead, they are groomed as key retainers."

"As for Kurt, I didn't know much about him in his youth, only that he was once trained as a palace attendant and worked in the royal palace for a very long time. Later, because of his exceptional performance, the Queen herself decreed that he be bestowed upon the Third Prince as a steward. It is said he holds a great deal of face in front of the Third Prince, who relies heavily on him, leaving almost all the miscellaneous affairs of the estate in this steward's hands."

"Kurt's penchant for grey-green boots is related to the royal colors; the background tincture of our Tiger Kingdom's crest is precisely grey-green. Kurt is using this subtle method to hint at his own royal bloodline."

Clement paused for a moment. "I remember His Majesty once praised Kurt, saying that he managed and organized the Third Prince's estate in immaculate order, preventing it from descending into utter chaos. He was even able to help the Third Prince manage certain business ventures to sustain the Third Prince's extravagant lifestyle."

Shang Feifan understood. "An elite among stewards, possessing sound administrative management capabilities."

"Precisely," Clement nodded. "A noble family's steward is not an easy role to fill; the higher the aristocracy, the stricter the demands on a steward's competence. Kurt has quite a reputation as a steward, and many nobles feel it's a pity he's tied to the Third Prince. Some have even let it slip that if the Third Prince ever dismisses Kurt or if Kurt no longer wishes to work there, they would welcome him with open arms."

Lang Mu interjected, "Kurt's father is a direct member of the royal family?"

"No," Clement shook his head. "His father is merely a collateral branch of the royalty, with a blood relation to the royal family similar to that of Old Count Lang. It's just that Old Count Lang followed his mother's surname, which distanced his ties to the royal lineage."

"In other words, his father was merely a peripheral figure in the royal city holding no real power?" Shang Feifan asked.

Clement nodded. "His abilities were mediocre. He managed to scrape together the title of a viscount relying on his royal blood, but it was just a title—no fiefdom, and certainly no real authority. In his youth, he did odd jobs in the royal palace; in his old age, he subsists entirely on the meager stipend of a viscount. He's even older than Old Count Lang now, and his health is poor."

After inquiring about the old viscount's place of residence, Lang Mu stated, "We'll go check all of them out. Later when Iman comes out, please let him know that Ah-Shang and I have gone to trace some clues, and tell him to contact you if anything comes up. Furthermore, if the First Prince has any questions, they can wait until we return."

Clement didn't attempt to dissuade them in the slightest, merely saying, "Be careful."

Just as Lang Mu was about to leave with Shang Feifan, he paused, turned around, and fished out a translucent crystal from his spatial ring, handing it to Clement.

"Give this to Iman later, and tell him to keep it on his person. If he asks what this crystal is and what its purpose is, just tell him he'll know once he carries it—in short, it will do him no harm."

Clement accepted the crystal and promised to pass it on to Iman.

Thus, when Iman finished his discussion with the First Prince and emerged, the two of them were already gone.

Clement relayed the message left by the pair to Iman.

"Is there anything you need my help with?" Clement asked Iman upon seeing the hand signal flashed by the First Prince's attendant as he stepped out.

Iman didn't stand on ceremony. "His Highness the Grand Prince said to please arrange a few formidable guards to accompany me back to the Grand Duke's Estate until my matters are concluded."

Clement immediately made arrangements, assigning four skilled operatives to Iman with strict instructions to ensure his safety.

With the protective talisman in hand, Iman prepared to leave the royal palace.

Clement called out to him, taking out the crystal and handing it to it. "This is what Raphael insisted I hand over to you. He told you to keep it on your person, saying it will be of use to you."

Curiously, Iman took the crystal. The moment the crystal touched his hand, a wondrous sensation blossomed in his heart.

Noticing Iman's expression, Clement guessed that he wasn't entirely in the dark about this crystal.

Recovering from his daze, Iman looked down at the crystal in his hand, a strange luster flashing through his eyes. Just then, some marvelous knowledge seemed to have surfaced in his mind.

A surge of excitement gripped Iman. Clenching the crystal tightly, he hurried out of the royal palace, completely forgetting to bid Clement farewell.

Acting on their commander's orders, the four guards quickly fell in step behind him.

Once outside the palace, a blast of cold air cooled the feverish heat in Iman's brain.

Stowing the crystal away into his spatial bracelet, Iman offered an apologetic smile to the four guards before flagging down a carriage back to the Grand Duke's Estate.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu moved with immense speed. They did not want to afford that bishop any opportunity to receive word and escape.

Even less did they want the man to use the Third Prince and the inhabitants of his estate as hostages against the royal city.

The guards of the Third Prince's estate were vastly inferior to those of the royal palace; even their anti-stealth alchemical devices were merely baseline models.

While Shang Feifan and Lang Mu couldn't quite claim that breaking into the Third Prince's estate was like walking through an empty courtyard, it wasn't far off.

At the very least, they walked all the way into the central sanctum of the Third Prince's residence without a single soul noticing them.

Having been denied permission to enter the venue of the Heritage Sharing Conference today, the Third Prince was in a thoroughly foul mood.

Yet he dared not cause a scene, for he had discovered that his royal father no longer seemed willing to tolerate the reckless antics of his children.

A little over half a month ago, merely because he led a mob to beat up a minor foreign noble, his father had severely reprimanded him. Not only was he ordered to apologize and pay full compensation for all losses, but he was also placed under house arrest, forbidden from stepping a single foot outside the Third Prince's estate until an explicit royal decree permitted it.

The Third Prince wanted to throw a tantrum, but his confidants, servants, and stewards all advised him to grit his teeth and endure through this period.

He wasn't entirely brainless either; he could sense that he had already been marginalized. Before long, perhaps he would merely be bestowed an honorary title at most equivalent to a count, and then, much like past royal bloodlines, he would be kept in captivity within the royal city.

After another two or three generations, his branch would be completely reduced to commoners.

The Third Prince had no desire to fall into such a pathetic plight. In his eyes, holding nothing more than an honorary peerage and subsisting on a sliver of royal stipend was the definition of tragedy.

chunks.chineseText:
别看他们这些王子公主现在没有任何封衔和爵位，但王子的名头绝对比一个小伯爵的名头好用得多！

三王子很想要挣扎一下，想要跟父王表示自己也是有能力的，他也想在传承分享大会露脸，想要得到一定权力。

是的，他现在已经不指望成为王位第一继承人，他就想多掌握一点权力和财富，最起码能得到一片领地，而不是像养猪狗一样被圈养在王城中。

实在不行，就是像拉斐尔那样得到一块可以免租金免税收的租借地也可以啊。

三王子真心羡慕拉斐尔。

以前拉斐尔过得有多糟糕，现在他的日子就有多潇洒。

黑水荒原领区的大区长，不是领主胜似领主。更何况那一片土地可不小，资源也不算少，只要拉斐尔想，他就可以在那里搞出一个国中国，过得堪比小国国王。

可惜他父王看不上他，他越是闹腾，他父王就越是烦他，完全不给他表现机会，甚至把他当小孩一样直接给他禁足，还派了原本圈禁丹顿家族的侍卫们来看守他。

三王子一想到自己有可能落到丹顿家族那些人一样的下场，就忍不住……借酒浇愁。

这段时间，三王子在自家府邸里每天都醉生梦死地大吃大喝，和府中美人胡天胡地。

他没有娶妻，但府中美人并不少。有其他人巴结他送来的，有他自己看中通过各种手段弄来的，也有看中他身份自己贴上来的……

管家库尔特十分理解他的心情，就只是让人注意他的身体，也没怎么劝阻他。

商非凡和郎沐看到三王子光着上半身蒙着眼睛和十来个漂亮女仆男仆玩耍，默默离开。

管家库尔特则这个时间还在书房中兢兢业业地忙着工作。

商非凡小声对郎沐说：“三王子知道他的管家在用他的书房、用他的印章吗？”

郎沐：“看库尔特如此坦然的姿态，应该不是第一次。”

商非凡嗤笑：“三王子放权还放得真彻底。”

郎沐：“对于某些臣子来说，这种上司要比什么都管的上司好得多。”

商非凡赞成：“库尔特眼光不错，没有选错人。”

郎沐则在心里叹息。他觉得真神教内部肯定有能人在为这个教派出谋划策。

因为兽人大陆绝大多数国家和势力都不允许乱七八糟的教派出现，一旦发现就会强力打压，根本不会给某些教派在民间扎根的机会。

这些教派大多都坚持不了多久。

就是背后有邪神支撑的真神教也发展缓慢，而且他们的现有规模基本是靠大战纪及之后的混乱时期发展起来，那时候的兽人谁也顾不上谁。等到兽人大陆开始进入新纪元，他们就再没有多少发展土壤，吸收新人也变得很难。

就连真神教明面上的地盘都被祭司宫连同其他兽人势力派遣的大军给打垮和抹消。

迫使真神教不得不再次由明转暗。

可不知什么时候开始，真神教就变聪明了。

他们不再东一榔头西一棒，而是盯住虎国，想要拿下这个国家当基盘。

他们也不再只是威胁和恐吓他人加入他们真神教，而是利用更多的寿命、青春、天赋觉醒等让兽人无法拒绝的好处来诱惑兽人。

他们甚至不再只是从底层发展，而是把触角伸入一个国家的上层。

更聪明到从权贵身边的心腹身上下手。

他们不止是收买这些人，而是从小培养这些人，给他们洗脑，让他们对真神教忠心不二。

他们耐着性子，花费几十年乃至上百年时间，一点点蚕食虎国。

如果没有人察觉，也许要不了多久，整个虎国都会落到真神教手中。

想想看，如果雷米尔或安妮塔真的上位，那真神教一定会成为虎国国教。

就算安妮塔的计划失败，但真神教对于虎国的安排显然不止安妮塔这一重。

郎沐甚至想，也许三王子就是真神教准备的另一个傀儡王。
chunks.englishText:
Don't look at how these princes and princesses currently lacked any official fiefs or titles; the name of a prince was still vastly more useful than the title of a minor count!

The Third Prince desperately wanted to struggle, to demonstrate to his royal father that he too possessed capability. He wanted to show his face at the Heritage Sharing Conference and acquire a measure of real power.

Yes, he no longer harbored hopes of becoming the primary heir to the throne; he merely wanted to grasp a bit more power and wealth—at the very least, to secure a patch of territory for himself, rather than being penned up in the royal city like a pig or a dog.

If worse came to worst, obtaining a rental territory exempt from rent and taxes, just like Raphael, would do as well.

The Third Prince genuinely envied Raphael.

Look at how miserable Raphael's life used to be, and look at how dashing and unrestrained he was now.

As the Grand District Chief of the Black Water Wasteland, he was a lord in all but name. Furthermore, that territory was far from small, and its resources were considerable. If Raphael so desired, he could carve out a country within a country right there, living a life comparable to the sovereign of a small nation.

It was a pity his royal father held him in contempt. The more he threw tantrums, the more his father despised him, refusing to give him a single opening to prove himself. Instead, his father treated him like a child, slapped him with house arrest, and even dispatched the guards who had originally sequestered the Danton family to stand watch over him.

The mere thought that he might end up with the same fate as those members of the Danton family drove the Third Prince to... drown his sorrows in alcohol.

During this period, the Third Prince spent every day in his estate living a decadent life of hedonism, gorging himself on food and wine, and dallying wildly with the beauties of his household.

He had never taken a wife, but the beauties within his estate were by no means few. Some had been sent by others trying to curry favor, some he had fancied and acquired through various means, and others had thrown themselves at him, drawn by his status...

Steward Kurt fully understood his state of mind; he simply instructed others to keep an eye on the prince's health and offered little dissuasion otherwise.

Witnessing the Third Prince stripped to the waist, blindfolded, and frolicking with a dozen or so pretty maids and valets, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu silently averted their eyes.

As for the steward Kurt, he was still industriously hard at work in his study at this ungodly hour.

Shang Feifan whispered to Lang Mu, "Does the Third Prince know his steward is using his study and his seal?"

Lang Mu replied, "Judging by Kurt's utter composure, this shouldn't be the first time."

Shang Feifan let out a cold chuckle. "The Third Prince certainly delegates power thoroughly."

Lang Mu observed, "To certain subordinates, this kind of superior is far better than one who meddles in everything."

Shang Feifan agreed. "Kurt has a good eye; he didn't pick the wrong master."

Inside, however, Lang Mu was sighing. He felt that there must be capable masterminds within the True God Sect devising strategies for this cult.

After all, the vast majority of nations and powers on the Beastman Continent did not tolerate chaotic, unbridled cults. The moment they were discovered, they were met with brutal crackdowns, giving them zero opportunity to take root among the common folk.

Most of these cults failed to endure for long.

Even the True God Sect, backed by an evil deity, had grown at a snail's pace, with their current scale built essentially on the chaos of the Great Era and its aftermath—a time when no beastman had the luxury to care about anyone else. Once the Beastman Continent began entering a new epoch, they lost all fertile soil for growth, and absorbing fresh recruits became exceedingly difficult.

Even the True God Sect's overt territories had been smashed to pieces and obliterated by grand armies dispatched by the Priest Palace alongside other beastman factions.

This forced the True God Sect to retreat once again from the light into the shadows.

Yet, starting at some unknown point, the True God Sect had grown clever.

They no longer struck out blindly in all directions; instead, they locked their sights on the Tiger Kingdom, intent on capturing this nation as their base of operations.

They no longer relied solely on threats and intimidation to coerce others into joining the True God Sect; instead, they tempted beastmen with irresistible benefits—extended lifespans, restored youth, awakened talents, and more.

They no longer restricted their growth to the lowest strata of society, stretching their tentacles all the way into the upper echelons of a nation.

Cleverer still, they struck from the trusted confidants around the powerful and wealthy.

Rather than merely buying these individuals off, they cultivated them from a young age, brainwashing them until their loyalty to the True God Sect was absolute.

With infinite patience, investing decades or even a century, they began gnawing away at the Tiger Kingdom piece by piece.

If no one caught on, it wouldn't be long before the entire Tiger Kingdom fell into the hands of the True God Sect.

Just imagine: if Remiel or Anita truly ascended to power, the True God Sect would undoubtedly become the state religion of the Tiger Kingdom.

Even if Anita's plot failed, the True God Sect's arrangements for the Tiger Kingdom clearly extended far beyond a single chess piece like Anita.

Lang Mu even entertained the thought that perhaps the Third Prince was yet another puppet monarch prepared by the True God Sect.

第209章 第二把

商非凡眼瞳特别亮，在他的视界中，他能看到很多其他人看不到的东西。

最明显的就是怨气。

另外，他还能看到一些很特别的光芒，也许不是光芒，而是物品特有的磁场。

通过分辨这些磁场的不同，他就能分辨出这些物品的制作年代和具体功效等。相信，等以后他累积的经验越多，辨识率和辨识正确率也就会越高。

瞳术的作用不止这些。

他感觉自己的记忆力似乎都变好了许多，就好像患了超忆症，只要眼睛看到过的东西，就能自动转变为图像储存在大脑中。

商非凡的目光停留在书桌上的笔筒上，又落到地面。

再看向管家库尔特挂在腰间的一个小包，那模样就是常见的放零碎物品的小袋子。

可商非凡盯着看了好一会儿。

他们现在还没有确定这名管家库尔特就是约翰达索口中的主教。

郎沐抽出骨杖，对准书房内正在办公的库尔特，快速念出一串咒语。

突然！库尔特身上爆发出一阵光芒。

商非凡和郎沐甚至听到了清晰的咔嚓一声，就像是什么东西碎掉。

库尔特反应极快，他手摸向桌面笔筒，用力一旋再一压，座椅立刻下降。

商非凡几乎同时动作，撞破窗户就冲了进去，也不管是否会惊动他人。

郎沐的魔法也不慢。大量的藤蔓卡住了机关，让通往地下的通道只打开一半。

库尔特感觉到座椅下降到一半就被卡住，立刻拍碎座椅就往下跳。

一根藤蔓捆住他的身体。

库尔特身体忽然变得极软极滑，哪怕跟着他体型变化紧缩的藤蔓也捆不住他。

库尔特很顺利地就从藤蔓中滑了出来。

就在库尔特要滑到地道里的一瞬间，一只手从上方抓住了他。

“草！”商非凡骂，他也不知道自己抓住了什么，就特别滑溜，竟然从他手里滑了出去。

那手感让商非凡忍不住把手在裤子上擦了好几遍。

摊开手，他手中还多了一个小袋子，正是库尔特系在腰带上的那个。他没有抓住库尔特，但扯下了这个袋子。

商非凡捏了捏小袋子中的物品，感觉硬硬的，随手把小袋子放入空间戒指中。

“咒你此路不通。”商非凡跟个超级反派一样，狞笑一声，提拳就用力击向地面。

轰隆！地面和下方砖石崩塌，生生堵上了地道。

库尔特还想从缝隙里溜出去，但上面那个兽人又是两拳捶下，不但房屋震动，连地面都跟着震荡起来。

稀里哗啦，扑簌簌。

这下好了，准备多年的地道就这么被堵塞得严严实实，越往里走越没有缝隙。

库尔特也只是能让身体变柔软变滑溜，并不能让身体变成纸片人或缩小，但他这时还能冷静地想，来者就算挡住他的去路，可想要在这一片废墟里找到他也不容易。

库尔特也不再一心找缝隙溜出去，而是找了个隐秘角落，打算把自己藏起来。他不能变小，但他能把自己卷起来，藏入正常人根本进入不了的狭小空间。

房间里，商非凡桀桀怪笑。

库尔特这次出逃反倒让系统确认了对方邪神信徒的身份，直接就把对方标红，还在小地图上标示出来。

别人也许在下方废墟里寻找库尔特要花费不少工夫，但对于拿着坐标的商非凡来说……

商非凡走到一处，指着那里的地面对郎沐说：“那家伙就在下面，深度大约一米二左右。你看是你使用魔法，还是我直接击穿地面把他掏出来？”

郎沐似乎正在思考什么，闻言回神：“我来吧。你帮我应付外面那些赶来的人，我们速战速决。”

“好。”商非凡一口答应。

郎沐用骨杖指着拿出地面，口中轻念咒语。

地面土壤自动翻动，把下面藏着的库尔特直接送到地面。

库尔特发现不对，想要找缝隙逃跑，却发现自己的四周八方土壤都变得坚硬无比，竟然无论他怎么刨挖都挖不动。

郎沐看到卷成瑞士卷的库尔特，也觉得开了眼界，这兽人世界果然是什么奇葩天赋都有。

视界变得明亮，库尔特看到陌生的脸孔，似乎很惊讶，又似乎松了口气，当即从卷曲状态恢复直立。

还说：“你们是谁？我听说邪神阴影者今天攻击了王宫，刚你们对我动手，我还以为是邪神信徒打进来了。对了，我们三殿下还好吗？我需要马上去看看他。”

郎沐：“……”

商非凡站在门口扭头，乐：是个人才。

一群人手持武器围过来，对商非凡大声喝问：“你们是谁？这里发生了什么事？库尔特管家呢？”

商非凡掏出一块黑色骨牌，扬了扬：“特调局办事，闲者回避。”

特调局的名头很好用，就算是三王子府的仆从护卫也不敢不把商非凡当回事。

有仆从不敢决断，跑去找能管事的人。

还有人则朝着墙被撞塌的书房大声喊库尔特管家。

“原来你们是特调局的人。就是不知两位阁下前来何事？”库尔特发现头顶上方封锁消失，指了指外面：“如果方便的话，能否让在下出去说明一下情况，另外再把事情禀告给三王子殿下知晓。”

商非凡鼓掌叫好：“演，继续演，不要停。”

郎沐见库尔特一副自己真就不知道发生什么事，还一脸无奈地看着商非凡的模样，也不由佩服。

冷不丁问：“你们真神教内有人会魔法吗？”

库尔特一愣：“什么？”

内心：这个人怎么知道魔法这个词？

郎沐：“换个说法，你们真神教内部是不是有不少魔血血脉？”

库尔特苦笑：“这位特调官阁下，我不知道您在说什么。魔血血脉不是传说中的血脉吗，而且您对我是不是有什么误会？我可不是邪神信徒。”

“是吗。”商非凡在不远处坏笑说：“那你跟着我复述，厄穆克拉索就是个脑子进水的傻-逼，厄穆克拉索就是个钻到别人家里偷窃的上不了台面的卑鄙小偷，厄穆克拉索就是个屎都不如的衰货，厄穆克拉索一定会被我们的古神打败，厄穆克拉索就是给我们兽人洗脚都不配。”

商非凡的声音特别大，确保屋内外所有人都能听得清清楚楚。

库尔特脸色丕变：“这位阁下，这种玩笑不好开的。邪神是什么存在，我一个小小的普通兽人哪敢说祂坏话。”

商非凡似笑非笑：“哪怕你不这样复述，我们就会把你当做邪神信徒抓捕起来？”

门外的人都在朝里看。

赶来的护卫队长听到两人对话，缓住脚步。

库尔特脸色铁青：“你们这是在逼我去死。而且你们有什么证据能证明我是邪神信徒？”

商非凡笑：“我们查出来你是资深邪神信徒，当上主教那种。至于证据，你别急，等回去自然会拿给你看。所以，现在能跟我们走了吗？”

库尔特听到商非凡说出“主教”这个词，就知道这两人是绝对不可能放过他的了。
