商非凡眼睛不离青皮鸡蛋，馋得口水泛滥，他真的很想很想吃掉这枚蛋。

“为什么我们一定要相信系统和自然之神说的话？”

“嗯？！”郎沐惊住。

“为什么自然之神要特意提醒你不要直接碰触它？到底是因为它危险？还是因为祂不想我们掌握能相当于神灵的力量？”

郎沐用力抓住商非凡的手臂，把他往后面拖：“阿商！商非凡！你给我清醒一点！你是不是被邪神力量给迷惑了？”

商非凡眼睛直勾勾，不停地吞咽口水。

“老商？商非凡！”

“我没疯。我的意识也很清醒。好吧，也许我是受到了一点诱惑。”商非凡转头对郎沐笑，“放心，我没事。”

郎沐松了口气，又把人往后拉了拉：“我们离远一点。你赶紧把那东西献祭了吧。”

商非凡笑着说：“好。宝贝，相信我。”

郎沐心下感到一丝怪异，看到商非凡抬起了手。

随即眼前一黑。

郎沐对商非凡毫无提防，更想不到商非凡会对他出手。

当他失去意识时，脸上还残留着不可置信的神情。

商非凡抱住郎沐，如抱着这世上最珍贵的珍宝，小心翼翼地把人送出雕像广场，送到他原来的卧室中，把人放到床上，确保人躺得舒舒服服，又低头亲了亲他的眉心和嘴角。

商非凡轻轻抚摸郎沐的脸颊，身影一闪，从原地消失。

雕像广场内，一切还都跟刚才一样。

不，还是有一点变化的。

构成咒术阵的藤蔓长出了锐利的尖刺，且都竖了起来。

似乎在拒绝有人进入阵中。

商非凡离开郎沐，那气质瞬间就变了。之前他还是只想和爱人过安逸退休生活的退役武器商，现在他似又走进了尔虞我诈的黑暗战火地带，那已深入骨髓的黑暗再次从他身上弥漫而出。

商非凡打量着咒术阵、礼盒里的青皮鸡蛋，以及自然之神雕像，没有任何感情地笑了笑。

“我刚才知道了一个很有意思的消息。你们想知道吗？”

雕像广场一片宁静。

商非凡无所谓，自言自语说：“我看遍了整个广场的碑文，以为对这个世界、对兽人大陆古神陨落的秘密已经掌握得七七八八。但谁又知道正是那缺少的二三成才是重中之重？”

雕像广场仍旧一片安静。

商非凡亮出刚才融合的钥匙，晃了晃：“你们不想知道邪神跟我说了什么吗？”

“祂说，祂会来到这个世界，不是因为虫母的召唤，而是因为你们，我们兽人大陆的神灵们，是你们召唤了祂。也是你们强行攻击神之笼，令神之笼产生缝隙，这才让祂能发现这个世界并进入。”

“而你们之所以这么做，也只是贪图祂的力量。你们想要吞噬这个外来的神灵，想要获得更强大的能量来突破这个世界，想要前往更高等更高维度的宇宙。”

“但是，你们没想到的是，外来的神灵很强大，而你们这些神灵却偏偏在此时产生了内讧。最后你们还把兽人大陆的生灵一起拖入你们的战局，而外来生灵则拉拢了虫母。”

商非凡陡然提高嗓音：“你们还要隐瞒下去吗，你们根本不是兽人大陆的古神，你们就是一帮本土生灵！跟那些法圣级别的魔法师一样，只是你们达到了相当于法神的境界。你们是最古老的兽人，也是最初的所谓神血血脉。”

整个雕像广场空间安静得像死去一般。

商非凡冷笑：“你们是不是想问为什么我这么轻易就相信了这把钥匙传递给我的信息？原因很简单，因为你们暴露的破绽真的太多了。”

“哦，你们是不是也在想，为什么我敢在这时候跟你们摊牌？有什么依仗？”

商非凡嘴角含笑，眼神冷漠。

“因为我仔细想了想，与其和你们合作，还不如和邪神合作。祂能给我的更多。”商非凡手一翻，手中再次出现一个礼盒。

这个礼盒和咒术阵中的礼盒外表一模一样。

商非凡眉眼皆是邪肆：“厄穆克拉索可是亲口跟我说，祂可以让我拥有与你们抗衡的力量。系统，你刚刚是不是一直想要控制我的身体却发现控制不了？你们是不是在惊讶我在什么时候和厄穆克拉索有了联系？”

终于，系统有了反应。

【神格碎片！】

这个感叹号几乎表达了系统的愤怒。

商非凡只笑，没承认也没否认。

【邪神不可信。不要做愚蠢的选择。】

“系统，你应该知道我这种人最讨厌什么。”

【你想要什么？】

商非凡微笑：“对嘛。这才是正确的打开方式。”

系统沉默。

商非凡毫不在意，他知道对方一定在听。

“首先，我对掺和你们神灵之间的战斗毫无兴趣。其次，我也不介意继续当你们的雇佣兵，不过具体报酬，我们得重新谈。第三，你们就算杀了我也没用，我可以在天残谷主的玩家重生池中再次复活，只不过身体条件不会像现在这么好，但厄穆克拉索说了，祂会给我重新塑造一具更好的身体。”

商非凡停顿两秒，“第四，也是最重要的一点，你们别想用郎沐来要挟我。他是我最后的底线，如果你们动他，我会毫不犹豫地投向厄穆克拉索那边。”

【厄穆克拉索在欺骗你，祂不会让你的力量超越祂。】

商非凡冷笑：“我为什么要超越厄穆克拉索？我只要拥有与你们抗衡的力量，不需要打得过你们，只要能在未来必然来到的灾难中自保，能把郎沐带回我的世界，那就可以。”

【这个世界对你来说就真的毫无意义吗？】

“你们找一个外星人来解救你们的危机本来就很危险。虽然你们千方百计把郎沐送到我身边，让我有了牵挂。因为郎沐，我会在意这个世界。但你们始终弄错一点，我是一个自私的人。我爱郎沐，但如果他的爱会拖我入死境，我也许不会杀了他脱困，但我一定会打晕他直接把人带走，不管他愿不愿意。”

商非凡的表情让任何一个看到的存在都知道他说的是真实。

而以系统对商非凡的了解，也知道他说的是实话，且有能力做到。

当初系统在无数人选中挑选了商非凡，一半原因就是因为商非凡个人能力卓绝，同时心性该狠就狠、做事果决。

所以商非凡说他会投向邪神，那也真的不止是威胁，而是他真的会这么做。

“当然，你们也可以换一个人，重新开始培养。”商非凡坦然说：“不想谈的话，你们现在可以想办法弄死我了。”

【你故意的。你故意和郎沐结成同生共死婚契，你知道有郎沐在，你就不可能真正死亡。就算能同时杀死你和郎沐，你也可以借玩家重生池重新复活，而只要你不死，郎沐就不会真正死亡。郎沐不真正死亡，你就不会死得彻底。你给自己套了一层又一层护身符。】

【可是你为什么不继续等下去？为什么不等到你的实力更高的时候？你还可以和厄穆克拉索暗中合作。】
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan's eyes remained glued to the cyan-skinned egg, his mouth watering with overwhelming temptation. He wanted—oh, how he desperately wanted—to devour this egg right then and there.

"Why must we blindly believe what the System and the God of Nature tell us?"

"Huh?!" Lang Mu froze in shock.

"Why did the God of Nature deliberately warn you not to touch it directly? Is it truly because it's dangerous? Or is it because He doesn't want us to grasp power that rivals the gods?"

Lang Mu grabbed Shang Feifan's arm hard, dragging him backward. "Ah-Shang! Shang Feifan! Get a grip on yourself! Have you been bewitched by the Evil God's power?!"

Shang Feifan’s eyes remained hollow and fixed, his throat bobbing as he swallowed repeatedly.

"Old Shang? Shang Feifan!"

"I haven't gone mad. My mind is perfectly clear. Well, perhaps I've been tempted just a little." Shang Feifan turned his head and smiled at Lang Mu. "Rest assured, I'm fine."

Lang Mu let out a breath of relief, pulling him back a little further. "Let's stay away from it. Hurry up and sacrifice that thing."

Shang Feifan smiled. "Alright. My love, trust me."

A faint sense of oddness washed over Lang Mu. Then, he saw Shang Feifan raise his hand.

Instantly, his vision went black.

Lang Mu had harbored zero suspicion toward Shang Feifan; he never in his wildest dreams imagined that Shang Feifan would strike at him.

When he lost consciousness, a look of utter disbelief still lingered on his face.

Shang Feifan caught Lang Mu, holding him as gently as if he were the most precious treasure in the world. He carefully carried him out of the Statue Plaza, back to his original bedroom, and laid him down on the bed. Ensuring that he was lying comfortably, he lowered his head to press a kiss to Lang Mu's brow and the corner of his lips.

Gently stroking Lang Mu's cheek, Shang Feifan's figure flickered and vanished from the spot.

Inside the Statue Plaza, everything remained just as it had been a moment ago.

No, there was one slight change.

The vines forming the spell array had grown sharp thorns, all of which stood rigidly on end.

It was as if they were barring anyone from entering the array.

The moment Shang Feifan left Lang Mu's side, his entire aura underwent a drastic transformation. Previously, he might have passed for a retired arms dealer simply yearning to live out an easy-going, retired life with his lover. Now, however, it was as though he had stepped back into a treacherous, dark warzone. The darkness that had long since seeped into his very bones billowed out from him once more.

Shang Feifan eyed the spell array, the cyan-skinned egg inside the gift box, and the statue of the God of Nature, letting out a laugh devoid of any warmth.

"I just learned some very interesting news. Would you all care to hear it?"

The Statue Plaza remained dead silent.

Shang Feifan didn't mind. He muttered to himself, "I read through every single inscription across this entire plaza, thinking I had a pretty firm grasp on this world and the secrets behind the fallen ancient gods of the Orc Continent. But who would have guessed that the two or three tenths missing from those texts were the most crucial parts of all?"

The Statue Plaza remained as quiet as ever.

Shang Feifan flashed the fused key he had just obtained, giving it a light shake. "Don't you want to know what the Evil God told me?"

"He said that He came to this world not because of the Mother Worm's summons, but because of *you*—you gods of the Orc Continent. It was you who summoned Him. It was also you who relentlessly attacked the Cage of Gods, fracturing it and allowing Him to discover this world and force His way in."

"And the only reason you did so was out of greed for His power. You wanted to devour this foreign deity, to obtain greater energy to break through the shackles of this world, and to journey toward a higher, more multidimensional universe."

"Yet, you never anticipated that the foreign deity would be so immensely powerful, while you gods happened to suffer internal strife at that very moment. In the end, you even dragged the living beings of the Orc Continent into your battlefield, whereas the foreign entity won the Mother Worm over to its side."

Shang Feifan raised his voice abruptly. "Are you still going to keep up the charade? You are no ancient gods of the Orc Continent at all—you are merely a pack of native entities! Much like those Saint-tier mages, you simply reached a realm equivalent to the Divine Tier. You are the oldest orcs, the very progenitors of the so-called 'divine bloodline'."

The space throughout the entire Statue Plaza fell as still as the grave.

Shang Feifan sneered. "Are you wondering why I believed the information transmitted to me by this key so easily? The reason is simple: you've exposed far too many flaws."

"Oh, and are you also wondering why I dare to show my cards to you at a time like this? What do I have to rely on?"

The corners of Shang Feifan's mouth curled into a smile, his gaze cold and indifferent.

"Because I've given it careful thought. Rather than cooperating with you lot, I'd much prefer to cooperate with the Evil God. He can offer me far more." With a flip of his hand, another gift box materialized in his grip.

Its exterior was an exact carbon copy of the gift box sitting within the spell array.

Wicked amusement danced in Shang Feifan's eyes. "Ermuklaso told me himself, you know: he can grant me the power to contend with you. System, have you been trying to control my body this whole time, only to find you couldn't? Are you wondering just when I established a connection with Ermuklaso?"

At last, the System reacted.

[Divine Spark Fragment!]

That exclamation mark practically conveyed the System's towering fury.

Shang Feifan merely chuckled, neither confirming nor denying it.

[The Evil God cannot be trusted. Do not make a foolish choice.]

"System, you should know what someone like me detests the most."

[What do you want?]

Shang Feifan smiled. "There we go. That's the correct way to open negotiations."

The System fell silent.

Shang Feifan didn't mind in the least; he knew for a fact that the other party was listening.

"Firstly, I have zero interest in getting mixed up in the war between you gods. Secondly, I don't mind continuing to act as your mercenary, but we need to renegotiate my pay. Thirdly, even if you kill me, it's useless. I can resurrect yet again in the Lord of Tiancan Valley's player resurrection pool—even if my physical condition won't be quite as optimal as it is now. But Ermuklaso has promised to forge a brand new, even better body for me."

Shang Feifan paused for two seconds. "Fourth, and most importantly, don't even think about using Lang Mu to blackmail me. He is my absolute bottom line. If you touch him, I will defect to Ermuklaso's side without a moment's hesitation."

[Ermuklaso is deceiving you. He will never allow your power to surpass his.]

Shang Feifan sneered. "Why would I need to surpass Ermuklaso? I only need the power to hold my own against you lot. I don't need to defeat you; I only need enough strength to survive the catastrophe that will inevitably come, and to bring Lang Mu back to my world. That is enough."

[Does this world truly hold no meaning for you whatsoever?]

"Bringing in an alien to resolve your crisis was a perilous gamble to begin with. Though you pulled out all the stops to send Lang Mu to my side and forge a tether between us—making me care about this world precisely because of him—you've made one fundamental miscalculation all along: I am a selfish man. I love Lang Mu, but if his love were to drag me into a death trap, I might not kill him to escape, but I would certainly knock him out and drag him away with me, regardless of whether he's willing or not."

Shang Feifan's expression made it abundantly clear to any observing entity that every word he spoke was the absolute truth.

And given the System's deep understanding of Shang Feifan, it knew he spoke the truth and possessed the capability to carry it out.

When the System had originally scoured countless candidates to select Shang Feifan, half the reason was his peerless personal capability combined with a ruthlessness when required and absolute decisiveness in his actions.

Therefore, when Shang Feifan claimed he would defect to the Evil God, it wasn't just an empty threat—he genuinely would do it.

"Of course, you are also free to pick someone else and start cultivating them from scratch," Shang Feifan said candidly. "If you don't wish to negotiate, you can start trying to figure out how to wipe me out right now."

[You did this on purpose. You deliberately forged a shared life-and-death matrimonial contract with Lang Mu. You knew that with Lang Mu around, you could never truly die. Even if you and Lang Mu were killed simultaneously, you could still use the player resurrection pool to revive. And as long as you aren't dead, Lang Mu won't truly die either. As long as Lang Mu isn't truly dead, you won't perish completely. You've wrapped yourself in one layer of life-insurance talismans after another.]

[Yet why didn't you continue waiting? Why not wait until your strength was higher? You could have covertly cooperated with Ermuklaso all the while.]

chunks.chineseText:
系统似乎真的很困惑。

商非凡叹息：“因为这枚鸡蛋看起来真的太可口了，我不想把它献祭掉，我想独吞它，更想安全地获得这份力量。贪婪是原罪，我也逃不过这点原始欲-望。还有……”

【还有什么？】系统不想被一个玩家牵着鼻子走，但这个玩家已经把它套住。

虽然它付出一定代价还是能把这个家伙解决掉，可……它能确保以后找到的玩家还这么好用吗？能确保以后找到的玩家就不会背叛它吗？能确保真的能把这家伙彻底解决掉吗？

如果商非凡不死，不用问，他一定会疯狂报复。

被这么一个家伙当做报复目标……它是给自己找麻烦还是给自己找麻烦？

而且这家伙好歹还有个本地牵挂。

商非凡不是人，但郎沐是啊！

最让系统郁闷的是，祂们推算过很多次，也多次窥探过命运长河，商非凡和郎沐都是关键。

如果可以，它也想找本地土著，可这不是找不到嘛。而且它已经试过好几次，找到的人选都失败了。

如果不是如此，大战纪后也不会又冒出毒雾纪……

总之，这个人选又岂是随便选选就能选出来的？

商非凡慢悠悠地回答：“还有当初我从商城购买到的‘碎裂的玻璃球’，我研究了很久，终于搞明白那压根就不是什么极端邪恶的诅咒大巫的眼睛，而就是诅咒之神的神格碎片。感谢阿沐体内的那枚神格碎片，也感谢你们赐予的瞳术和鉴定术，让我得以确定。”

最后：“当我和我右眼中的诅咒之神神格碎片沟通后，它表示，它不想再增加另外一枚神格碎片的力量，它说它可以帮我成为新的诅咒之神，只要我获得足够多的能量。”

系统：艹！
chunks.englishText:
The System genuinely seemed baffled.

Shang Feifan let out a sigh. "Because this egg looks utterly delectable, and I have no desire to sacrifice it. I want to swallow it all for myself, and more importantly, I want to safely acquire this power. Greed is an original sin, and I am no exception to such primal desires. Also..."

[Also what?] The System loathed being led by the nose by a mere player, yet this particular player had it completely wrapped around his finger.

While it could still eliminate this fellow if it paid a certain price, but... could it guarantee that any future players it found would be just as useful? Could it guarantee that future players wouldn't betray it? Could it guarantee it could thoroughly and permanently wipe this guy out?

If Shang Feifan didn't die, it went without saying that he would unleash a frenzy of retaliation.

To be targeted for revenge by a lunatic like this... was it looking for trouble, or was it *really* looking for trouble?

Besides, this fellow at least had a local tether.

Shang Feifan wasn't human, but Lang Mu was!

What depressed the System the most was that it had run countless calculations and peered into the River of Fate many times, only to find that both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were pivotal keys.

If it were possible, it would have preferred to find local natives, but it simply couldn't find any suitable candidates. Moreover, it had tried several times, and every candidate it found had ended in failure.

If not for that, the Poison Fog Era wouldn't have emerged in the wake of the Great Epoch...

In short, how could a candidate of this caliber be found simply by picking at random?

Shang Feifan answered leisurely, "Also, regarding the 'Shattered Glass Sphere' I purchased from the System Mall back then—after studying it for a long time, I finally figured out that it was never some exquisitely evil curse master's eye at all. It is a Divine Spark Fragment belonging to the God of Curses. My thanks to the Divine Spark Fragment residing within Ah-Mu's body, and thanks to the pupil techniques and appraisal skills you bestowed upon me, which allowed me to confirm it."

Finally, he added, "When I communicated with the God of Curses' Divine Spark Fragment inside my right eye, it indicated that it had no intention of letting another Divine Spark Fragment grow stronger. It said it could help me become the new God of Curses, provided I acquire enough energy."

System: Fuck!

chunks.chineseText:
第211章 谈判

系统原本以为是藏在郎沐身上那枚自然之神的神格碎片在拖后腿，没想到商非凡身上竟然也藏了一枚，还是某个最不着调的神灵的神格碎片。

偏偏那神格碎片还是从它的系统商城里卖出去的……

它明明检查过所有商品！

只能说那枚诅咒之神的神格碎片躲得太深，否则就是再小的碎片也不可能逃过它的检查。

换言之：对方就是故意为之。

怪不得商非凡会那么顺利就踏上咒术师之路，还在吸收虫母心脏碎片时只吸收虫母能量为己用，而不会被虫母意识影响。

虽然这也有商非凡本人意志坚定、精神力过人的原因，但也不能排除有某个混蛋神灵在暗搓搓地带路。

明明原本它的计划是让商非凡成为自然之神的眷顾者，觉醒植物系的血脉天赋，主修药剂和种植，辅修炼金。

可它只能引导，并不能强行指派。

结果就被诅咒之神给钻了空子，偏生商非凡本人的气质和天赋也适合当个咒术师，就这么让他觉醒了诅咒方面的血脉天赋，后面更“机缘巧合”下一步步升级为恶咒，彻底把自然之神的力量给阻挡在外。

奸诈！真的是太奸诈了。

不愧是众神都厌恶的大混子诅咒之神。

而诅咒之神会这样做的原因也很简单，祂需要能量。

还有什么比让“命运之子”成为自己信徒更好的掠夺能量的方法吗？

其他信徒很可能会迷失在黑暗能量中，到时候别说献祭大量能量给诅咒之神，恐怕自己都自身难保。

但商非凡不一样啊，他精神力异常坚韧，意志更是极为顽强，本身就是行走在黑暗中还能坚持自我的人，简直就是作为诅咒之神眷顾者的不二之选。

而且命运之子成为自己的信徒，对那名神灵来说自然也好处多多。

不过那位大概也没想到祂分出去的神格碎片竟然也拥有了些许自己的独立意识，前面多次献祭都忍了，只偷偷藏在商非凡身体内吃点残羹剩饭。可现在一遇到大餐，就忍不住跳出来和主神格开始争夺能量。

是的，那枚青皮鸡蛋绝对算得上大餐。

没见自然之神都显灵就为了不让那股能量逃脱，也不让其他存在有夺走那股能量的可能。

真是一个蠢货！

系统不是在骂商非凡，而是在骂那枚神格碎片。

系统也就是当着商非凡的面不好说，否则它一定会警告那枚诅咒之神的神格碎片：朋友，你现在跳出来太早了，在这么弱小的时候跳出来，你以为就凭你那三言两语就能诱惑你的宿主为你所用？错，大错特错。你眼中的工具人宿主可是能反吞你的存在。不信就等着瞧吧。

系统甚至毫不怀疑商非凡早就和厄穆克拉索联系上，并且已讨价还价很久。

在它看来，商非凡绝对有这个能力，而且能做得不动声色，不但没让郎沐察觉，更没让它这个系统察觉。

实际上……

商非凡确实收到了厄穆克拉索的联系。

但不是早就，而是就在他刚刚进入雕像广场前。

在他把两枚钥匙重叠，看到它们融合为一体后，脑中就突然多出一段话。

他跟郎沐说他不知道那钥匙有什么用，他说谎了。

在握住融合后钥匙的时候，他就隐隐感觉到这是个联络器。

等到脑中-出现邪神的声音，他就肯定了这一点。

甚至他还知道，这种钥匙只发给真神教的重要人物，就是用来和真神教高层联系的单向联络器。持有钥匙的人无法主动联系真神教高层，但可以通过钥匙接受指令。

而融合后的钥匙，相当于能量增强，接受波段也更多更广，甚至能接收到特殊波段，也就是来自邪神的声音。

两把钥匙融合原本还不够，但这不是商非凡本身精神力就非常强大嘛，原本接收不到或接收到也会模糊不清的波段也变得清晰。

甚至让邪神注意到他，特意给他补充了一段“缺失的真实历史”。

但商非凡并不觉得那真是邪神在跟他说话，而更像是某种定好的电脑程序，发现符合条件的对象，就按照特定条件发送特定内容。

更奇妙的是，那段广播并没有蛊惑他投靠邪神，只是向他叙述事实。

商非凡原本就有不少疑问，这段补充的历史真相倒是让他解开了不少疑惑。

当然，那时他并不确定这段突然出现的信息内容是否为真，他会说出来就是为了看看系统的反应。

而系统也不知是太耿直，还是觉得这种事隐瞒不过去，相当于默认。

等商非凡确认脑中-出现的“历史真相”竟然是真的真相后，他就决定利用邪神来试探更多。

因为他有一点说的是真真真心话。

他是真的馋那个青皮鸡蛋啊。

他真的一点都不想献祭给诅咒之神或者其他什么神灵，他就想自己吞下去消化掉！

他的本能告诉他，吸收那枚青皮鸡蛋很危险，但只要度过危险，那好处也会极大。

富贵险中求。

商非凡从不缺乏冒险精神，他当然想要搏一搏。

比起被某些存在控制当个打手，他当然更想成为一名合作者，哪怕地位还是不平等，至少也不能让对方完全掌控他的生死。如果实在打不过，他也希望能有力量重伤对方。

至于那个钻进他右眼的破碎玻璃球，他也没说谎，那玩意确实就是诅咒之神的神格碎片。

他也确实是在和郎沐体内那枚自然之神的神格碎片接触后，才察觉到右眼中玻璃球的真面目。

神灵的能量是那么特殊，只要感受过一次，就不可能错认。

不过那枚神格碎片并没有和他沟通，也没有诱惑他另立门户，反倒是他自从察觉自己体内有一枚神格碎片后，就一直想要吸收那枚碎片。

就是可惜他暂时还不知道如何吸收右眼中的神格碎片。

也不知道是不是那把融合钥匙感知到他的强烈愿望，竟然再次发送了一段信息给他，表示他只要能吞掉那枚青皮鸡蛋里的能量，他就能知道如何反过来吞噬他体内的神格碎片。

甚至还告诉他，只要他实际接触钥匙，钥匙就能帮他抵抗其他神灵的力量，比如让他身体不被系统控制。

能察觉他心思，还察觉到系统存在的钥匙很恐怖。

但……商非凡也真的很心动。

那个该死的邪神可真的太懂人心了。

不是蛊惑，胜似蛊惑。

商非凡擦了擦口水，耐心地等待系统回应。

系统倒是很想晾着商非凡，可谁让它这次只发展了这一个玩家。

不说时间已经不允许它再去找更多人，只说以前的经历，有时候真的不是人数多就能把事情办成。

甚至事情没办成，还给它搞出了更大-麻烦。

至少眼前这位退役武器商只不过进入“游戏”短短一年不到就已经明确找到自然之神雕像五个缺失部分。

甚还提前发现黑森林城的大灾难，提前消融。

最重要的是，它不想把这个人推到邪神那边。

【你想要什么？】
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 211: Negotiation

The System had originally assumed that the drag on its plans was the Divine Spark Fragment of the God of Nature hidden within Lang Mu. It never expected that Shang Feifan was hiding one as well—and a fragment of one of the most unhinged deities at that.

What's more, that very Divine Spark Fragment had been sold right out of its own System Mall!

And it had clearly inspected every single item on shelves!

The only explanation was that the God of Curses' Divine Spark Fragment had concealed itself far too deeply; otherwise, no matter how minute the fragment, it couldn't have escaped its inspection.

In other words: the other party had done it intentionally.

No wonder Shang Feifan had embarked upon the path of a Cursing Master so smoothly, and when absorbing the Mother Worm's heart fragment, he had only absorbed the Mother Worm's energy for his own use without being influenced by the Mother Worm's consciousness.

While this was partly due to Shang Feifan's own indomitable willpower and extraordinary mental strength, one could not rule out the possibility that some bastard deity had been secretly leading the way in the shadows.

Originally, its plan had been for Shang Feifan to become favored by the God of Nature, awakening a plant-based bloodline talent, focusing primarily on potion-making and cultivation, supplemented by alchemy.

Yet it could only guide him; it had no power to forcefully assign his path.

As a result, the God of Curses had seized the opening. And as it happened, Shang Feifan's personal temperament and talents made him a natural fit for a Cursing Master. Thus, he was led to awaken a curse-based bloodline talent step-by-step, later "coincidentally" upgrading it into maledictions, thoroughly blocking the God of Nature's power outside.

Crafty! Truly, utterly crafty!

He was worthy of being the God of Curses—that giant scoundrel loathed by all the pantheon.

The reason the God of Curses would do such a thing was also simple: He needed energy.

And what better way to plunder energy than by making the "Child of Destiny" his own believer?

Ordinary believers were highly likely to lose themselves within the dark energies; by the time that happened, let alone sacrificing massive amounts of energy to the God of Curses, they would struggle just to keep themselves alive.

But Shang Feifan was different. His mental resilience was abnormally formidable, and his willpower was exceptionally tenacious. He was precisely the kind of person who could walk in the dark while holding fast to his true self, making him the absolute premier choice as a favored one of the God of Curses.

Furthermore, having the Child of Destiny become his own follower naturally brought immense benefits to that deity.

However, that deity probably hadn't expected that the Divine Spark Fragment He had split off would develop a sliver of independent consciousness of its own. It had endured multiple previous sacrifices, hiding quietly within Shang Feifan's body to scavenge meager leftovers. But the moment it encountered a grand feast, it couldn't help but leap out to contend with the primary divine spark for energy.

Yes, that cyan-skinned egg could definitely be considered a grand feast.

Didn't they see how even the God of Nature had manifested a divine projection solely to prevent that energy from escaping and to deny any other entity the possibility of seizing it?

What an absolute fool!

The System wasn't cursing Shang Feifan; it was cursing that Divine Spark Fragment.

If the System weren't constrained by Shang Feifan's presence, it would have loved to issue a warning to the God of Curses' Divine Spark Fragment: *Friend, you've jumped out far too early. Jumping out while you're still this weak—do you really think a few sweet words of yours can seduce your host into becoming your pawn? Wrong, dead wrong. The tool-host in your eyes is fully capable of swallowing you right back. If you don't believe it, just wait and see.*

The System didn't even doubt that Shang Feifan had already established contact with Ermuklaso and had been bargaining with him for a long time.

In its view, Shang Feifan unquestionably possessed this capability, and he could pull it off with absolute subtlety—keeping it concealed not only from Lang Mu, but even from it, the System.

In reality...

Shang Feifan *had* indeed received contact from Ermuklaso.

Not long ago, however, but just before he stepped into the Statue Plaza.

The moment he overlapped the two keys and watched them fuse into one, a string of text had suddenly flooded into his mind.

When he told Lang Mu that he didn't know what the key was for, he had lied.

The instant he grasped the fused key, he had vaguely sensed that it was a communication device.

When the Evil God's voice echoed in his mind, that suspicion had turned into certainty.

He even knew that keys of this sort were issued exclusively to vital figures within the True God Cult, serving as one-way communication devices to liaise with the cult's higher-ups. The key holder could not actively initiate contact with the cult's upper echelons, but they could receive commands through the key.

As for the fused key, it was equivalent to an amplified signal strength, capable of receiving more and broader frequency bands, and even tuning into special frequencies—namely, the voice originating from the Evil God.

Merging the two keys originally wouldn't have been quite enough, but wasn't Shang Feifan's own mental power exceptionally formidable? Frequency bands that normally couldn't be received, or would come through muffled and unclear, suddenly became crystal clear.

It even caught the Evil God's attention, prompting Him to deliberately supplement him with a chunk of "missing true history."

Yet, Shang Feifan didn't truly believe the Evil God was speaking to him directly; it felt much more like some pre-set computer program. Once it detected a subject meeting the criteria, it transmitted specific content based on preset conditions.

Even more wondrously, that broadcast didn't attempt to bewitch him into defecting to the Evil God; it merely narrated the facts to him.

Shang Feifan had harbored quite a few doubts to begin with, and this supplementary historical truth helped resolve a great many of his puzzles.

Of course, he hadn't been certain at the time whether this abruptly appearing information was true or false; speaking of it aloud was simply a way to test the System's reaction.

Whether the System was simply too upright or felt such matters were impossible to conceal, it had practically given tacit confirmation.

Once Shang Feifan confirmed that the "historical truth" appearing in his mind was indeed genuine, he decided to utilize the Evil God to probe for more.

Because one of the things he had said was dead, honest-to-god truth.

He genuinely craved that cyan-skinned egg!

He didn't want to sacrifice it to the God of Curses or any other deity in the slightest; he wanted to swallow it whole and digest it himself!

His instincts told him that absorbing that cyan-skinned egg was fraught with peril, but as long as he survived the danger, the benefits would likewise be astronomical.

Fortune favors the bold.

Shang Feifan had never lacked a spirit of adventure; naturally, he wanted to roll the dice and take a gamble.

Compared to being controlled by certain entities to serve as a mere thug, he naturally preferred to become a partner. Even if the power dynamic remained unequal, he at least refused to let the other party hold absolute dominion over his life and death. If he truly couldn't defeat them, he hoped to at least wield enough power to inflict grievous wounds in return.

As for that shattered glass sphere burrowed into his right eye, he hadn't lied about that either—that thing genuinely was a Divine Spark Fragment of the God of Curses.

And it was indeed only after coming into contact with the God of Nature's Divine Spark Fragment inside Lang Mu's body that he had discerned the true identity of the glass orb in his right eye.

A deity's energy was simply too unique; once one had experienced it firsthand, it was impossible to mistake it.

However, that Divine Spark Fragment had not communicated with him, nor had it tempted him to set up a rival faction. On the contrary, ever since he realized there was a Divine Spark Fragment inside his body, he had constantly wanted to absorb it.

It was only a pity that he didn't yet know how to absorb the Divine Spark Fragment residing within his right eye.

Whether it was coincidence or not, the moment the fused key sensed his intense desire, it had transmitted another piece of information to him, stating that as long as he could devour the energy inside that cyan-skinned egg, he would learn how to turn the tables and devour the Divine Spark Fragment within his own body.

It even told him that as long as he physically contacted the key, the key could help him resist the power of other deities—for instance, preventing his body from being controlled by the System.

A key capable of perceiving his innermost thoughts and detecting the existence of the System was terrifying.

But... Shang Feifan was genuinely tempted.

That damned Evil God truly understood human nature inside and out.

It wasn't persuasion, yet it surpassed persuasion.

Shang Feifan wiped away his drool, patiently awaiting the System's response.

The System desperately wanted to leave Shang Feifan hanging, but who told it that he was the only player it had managed to develop this time around?

Setting aside the fact that time no longer permitted it to go out and recruit more people, past experiences proved that simply throwing more numbers at a problem didn't guarantee success.

In fact, failing to resolve the issue often just conjured up even bigger troubles for it.

At the very least, this retired arms dealer before it had entered the "game" for barely a year before definitively locating five missing segments of the God of Nature's statue.

He had even discovered the catastrophic disaster in Black Forest City ahead of time, neutralizing it early.

Most importantly, it had no desire to push this individual into the Evil God's camp.

[What do you want?]

chunks.chineseText:
“我刚才已经说了。”商非凡拖了一张椅子坐下，一副要长谈的架势。

对面，自然之神的雕像静静地凝视着他。

【你是说你可以继续受雇佣做任务，但需要重新谈报酬？】

“没错。”

【每次任务都有奖励，且奖励已经十分丰厚。】

“丰厚？你觉得我把找到自然之神雕像缺失部分交给邪神，我会得到什么奖励？让我想想，我记得谁好像跟我说过，真神教那边有提炼神灵力量的方法？你说我交出一个缺失部件，以此换取如何提取神灵力量并吸收的方法，真神教那边会同意吗？”

不等系统回答，商非凡就自言自语说：“我想那位邪神一定会同意。说不定祂还会告诉我如何吸收神格和利用神格。比如……”

商非凡不怀好意地笑了笑：“你说我以后再施展咒术，不再念那位诅咒之神-的名字，而是念我自己的名字，会有什么结果出现？那枚神格碎片会因此慢慢和我融合吗？”

【神格不是那么好融合的，你不要做傻事，那是在断你自己的成神之路。】

“可我压根就没打算成神。我只要在活着的时候可以日天日地就好。”

系统：【……】

系统现在特别明白商非凡为什么要特意弄昏郎沐，还把人送出雕像广场了。

就是为了方便他现在脱缰撒欢！

【那你想要什么样的报酬才会满足？】

商非凡感觉到系统的怒意，但他才不在乎，他和人进行某些“商业”谈判时，那些“合做伙伴”别说吵架拍桌，掏枪都不知道多少回。

可只要生意谈成，那还不是一脸假笑地互相拥抱说好兄弟下次继续合作。

反正他也不打算做系统或某些神灵的小甜心。他就是一把刀，想要用好他，但也得小心他伤手。

“简单，等价交换。”

商非凡悠悠说：“先别急，等价交换并不代表你会吃亏。你给我搞了主线任务，也就是你最在意的还是回收自然之神散落的力量。对于这点，我可以确保和之前一样，只要发现并找到自然之神散落的力量就会给你送回来。只要你付出相应报酬就可。当然，不能亏了我家阿沐。我想自然之神也应该很想要培养他。”

【除此之外？】

商非凡把骨杖横放到膝头：“除此之外，虫母的力量、邪神的力量、以及诅咒之神需要的献祭，包括其他黑暗系能量，都属于我。”

【那不可能。如果不经过特殊净化，你的身体根本无法承受，你会被那些黑暗能量污染。】

“需要净化也许是真的，但你们净化过后的能量也不属于我。”

系统沉默了很久，也许是在计算利弊得失，也许是在和谁商量，过了很久才回复。

【如果你再发现虫母的心脏碎片或其他属于以及适合虫母的能量，只要你能吸收，都属于你。不需要上交此类任务物品。但也不会再有额外奖励。】

“为什么不能有额外奖励？我做任务，不是在帮你们解决麻烦吗？这就跟雇主指派雇佣军去攻打自己的敌人，只要能杀死敌人，雇佣军就算是完成任务，也应该得到任务报酬。但在任务途中，雇佣军从敌方那里搜刮到的财物自然属于雇佣军自己所有。”

【……到时会根据实际情况发布任务以及拟定任务报酬，你可以选择做任务还是不做任务。】

“说到这个，就必须先说好一点。那就是以后任何任务，不管我做不做，做了是否失败，都不能有任何惩罚。”

【可以。】

“我需要诅咒术、瞳术以及我所有职业技能的全部修炼法，并且不能用玩家等级来故意限制我。你们肯定也希望我能刷刷地做任务，每个任务都完成得漂漂亮亮，对吧？那就好好培养我，别扼制我的成长。”

系统想说你脸皮真厚。

商非凡诚心诚意说：“你们和我处好关系，就算我将来能成长到和你们一样的程度，看在老交情和我家阿沐的份上，我也会站在你们这边。就算要吞噬神灵的力量，不还有一个邪神吗？而且你们想要做什么事，只要阿沐同意，我也不是不能帮助你们。多个朋友多条路，蝼蚁也有蝼蚁的用法，你觉得呢？”

系统：就问你有把自己当蝼蚁看吗？

【不能直接给予，必须按照系统规则。】系统顿了顿，退后一步：【以后会相应减少贡献点，增加实物奖励。】

商非凡想了想，同意。

“这个青皮鸡蛋归我，包括以后发现的邪神能量，比如雕像内能量，都归我所有。”

商非凡又紧跟着说：“我知道危险，我知道你也不想我被邪神力量污染，那么就请告诉我净化邪神力量的方法，或者告诉我如何吞噬对方力量也不会受到影响。”

系统：贪婪的混蛋！你这全都是踩在底线上蹦跶。

商非凡见系统不肯回应，索性把自己剩下的要求也说出：“我对吞噬其他神灵的神格碎片没有兴趣，但我体内的，我必须解决掉。告诉我如何融合神格碎片。”

【无法告知，违反规则。】

“规则？诅咒之神是怕再出现一个诅咒之神，抢了祂的神位吗？你告诉祂，大可不必惧怕。我保证不会在兽人大陆成为诅咒之神。”后面一句话，商非凡说得很随意。

几乎话音刚落，商非凡和系统都感知到什么。

系统感知到的不算清晰，可也让它明白商非凡的话相当于和诅咒之神立下了某种契约，这里的世界规则也接受了。

而且它为什么要为诅咒之神那根搅屎棍考虑？

对方在劫走商非凡做祂的眷顾者时，有考虑它吗？

既然如此……

系统再三计算和分析后，又去绕了一圈。

这才回来回复：【邪神厄穆克拉索吞噬了黑暗之神。】

商非凡眨眼。系统说的是他想的那个意思吗？

【如果你不想自己被邪神力量污染，那么最好的办法就是请一名神灵的力量保护你。黑暗之神消失，但祂留下了一枚很大的神格碎片，且这枚碎片里面不含有任何意识。】

【如果你愿意向诅咒之神献祭这枚邪神之卵，祂可以诅咒你获得吞噬及融合神格碎片的办法。】

随即，商非凡听到久违的叮咚一声，打开系统任务栏一看，任务八十三的奖励变了，原本从三个特价装备任选一件变成了奖励固定装备。

那装备还有名字，叫【黑暗之神的赐福】。

很好，系统就差没明明白白地告诉他：别去打诅咒之神神格的主意了，给你一枚黑暗之神的神格碎片，对方本尊还消失了，去吸收这枚神格碎片的力量，努力成为黑暗之神吧。

“我右眼中的诅咒之神神格碎片？”

【特殊情况，可以更换同类其他商品。】

“要等价值的。不是我当初购买的价格，是这枚神格碎片的价格。”

系统：╰_ ╯得寸进尺的混蛋！

【给你更换成特殊物品‘黑暗之火火种’。】
chunks.englishText:
"I've already stated my terms," Shang Feifan said, pulling over a chair and sitting down with the posture of someone settling in for a long talk.

Opposite him, the statue of the Goddess of Nature gazed down in silence.

[Are you saying you can continue taking on employment and doing tasks, but we need to renegotiate the compensation?]

"Exactly."

[Every task comes with a reward, and the rewards are already exceptionally generous.]

"Generous? What kind of reward do you think I'd get if I handed the missing pieces of the Goddess of Nature's statue over to the Evil God? Let me think... didn't someone mention to me that the True God Cult has a method for extracting divine power? Tell me, if I hand over a missing component in exchange for how to extract and absorb divine power, do you think the True God Cult would agree?"

Without waiting for the system to reply, Shang Feifan muttered to himself, "I'm sure that Evil God would agree. Who knows, maybe He'd even tell me how to absorb and utilize a Divine Godhead. For instance..."

Shang Feifan smiled maliciously. "What do you think would happen if I cast incantations in the future, but instead of chanting the name of the God of Curses, I chanted my own name? Would that Godhead fragment slowly fuse with me then?"

[A Godhead isn't something so easily fused with. Don't do anything foolish; you'll be cutting off your own path to becoming a god.]

"I never had any intention of becoming a god in the first place. I'm quite content as long as I can stir up trouble and live as I please while I'm alive."

System: [...]

The system now fully understood why Shang Feifan had deliberately knocked Lang Mu unconscious and sent him out of the statue plaza.

He had done it purely for the freedom to run wild off the leash!

[Then what kind of compensation will satisfy you?]

Shang Feifan sensed the system's anger, but he couldn't care less. Back when he negotiated certain "business" deals with people, those "partners" didn't just argue and bang fists on tables—who knew how many times they'd drawn guns on him.

Yet once the deal was struck, they'd still hug each other with fake smiles and talk about being good brothers who'd cooperate again next time.

Besides, he had no intention of becoming a sweet little pet for the system or some deity. He was a blade; if they wanted to wield him well, they had to be careful not to cut their own hands.

"Simple: an equivalent exchange."

Shang Feifan drawled leisurely, "Don't be in a rush—equivalent exchange doesn't mean you'll get the short end of the stick. You've given me the main storyline quests, which means what you care about most is still recovering the scattered power of the Goddess of Nature. On that point, I can guarantee it'll be just like before: whenever I discover and find the scattered power of the Goddess of Nature, I'll send it back to you. You just need to pay the corresponding reward. Of course, you can't shortchange my Mu. I imagine the Goddess of Nature should be quite eager to nurture him, too."

[Anything else?]

Shang Feifan laid his bone staff horizontally across his knees. "Aside from that, the Mother Worm's power, the Evil God's power, the sacrifices required by the God of Curses, and any other dark-attribute energies all belong to me."

[That's impossible. Without special purification, your body simply won't be able to bear it; you will be corrupted by those dark energies.]

"That I might need purification could be true, but the energy you guys purify still doesn't belong to me."

The system fell silent for a long time—perhaps calculating the gains and losses, perhaps consulting with someone else. It replied only after a long pause.

[If you discover any more Mother Worm heart fragments or other energy belonging to and suitable for the Mother Worm, as long as you can absorb them, they belong to you. You won't need to turn in those types of quest items. But there won't be any additional rewards, either.]

"Why can't there be extra rewards? When I do quests, aren't I helping you solve problems? This is just like an employer sending mercenaries to attack their enemy. As long as they kill the enemy, the mercenaries have completed their mission and deserve their pay. But during the mission, whatever loot the mercenaries scavenge from the enemy naturally belongs to the mercenaries themselves."

[...Quests and task rewards will be issued according to actual circumstances at the time, and you can choose whether or not to take them.]

"Speaking of which, we need to make one thing clear beforehand: from now on, no matter what the quest is, whether I do it or whether I fail, there must be no penalties whatsoever."

[Agreed.]

"I need the complete cultivation methods for curses, eye techniques, and all my job skills, and you cannot deliberately restrict me using player levels. You guys surely want me to breeze through quests and complete every single one of them brilliantly, right? Then groom me properly instead of stunting my growth."

The system wanted to say that he had the sheer audacity to ask.

Shang Feifan said sincerely, "If you guys get on my good side, even if I grow to the same level as you in the future, for the sake of our old friendship and my Mu, I'll still stand on your side. Even if I have to devour a deity's power, isn't there still an Evil God left? Furthermore, whatever you want to do, as long as Mu agrees, it's not like I can't help you. More friends mean more paths; even an ant has its uses as an ant. Don't you think?"

System: *Let me ask you, do you actually view yourself as an ant at all?*

[We cannot grant them directly; we must follow the system's rules.] The system paused, then took a step back: [In the future, Contribution Points will be appropriately reduced, and physical rewards will be increased.]

Shang Feifan thought about it and agreed.

"This cyan-skinned egg is mine, and any Evil God energy discovered in the future—such as the energy inside the statues—will also belong to me."

Shang Feifan quickly added, "I know it's dangerous, and I know you don't want me to be corrupted by the Evil God's power. So please tell me the method to purify Evil God power, or tell me how to devour the other party's power without being affected."

System: *Greedy bastard! You're dancing right on the edge of the line with every single demand.*

Seeing that the system refused to respond, Shang Feifan simply laid out his remaining demands: "I have no interest in devouring the Godhead fragments of other deities, but the one inside my body—I have to deal with it. Tell me how to fuse with Godhead fragments."

[Unable to disclose. It violates the rules.]

"Rules? Is the God of Curses afraid that another God of Curses will appear and steal His divine throne? Tell Him He needn't worry at all. I guarantee I won't become the God of Curses on the Beastmen Continent." Shang Feifan said the latter half quite casually.

Almost the moment his voice fell, both Shang Feifan and the system sensed something.

What the system sensed wasn't entirely clear, but it was enough to make it realize that Shang Feifan's words were equivalent to forming a kind of pact with the God of Curses, and the rules of this world had accepted it.

Besides, why should it care about that troublemaking stirrer, the God of Curses?

When that entity snatched Shang Feifan away to become His favored one, did He consider the system?

Since that was the case...

After recalculating and analyzing repeatedly, the system took a detour.

Only then did it return to reply: [The Evil God Emmuklaso has devoured the God of Darkness.]

Shang Feifan blinked. Was the system meaning what he thought it meant?

[If you don't want to be corrupted by the Evil God's power, the best method is to have the power of a deity protect you. The God of Darkness has vanished, but He left behind a very large Godhead fragment, and this fragment contains no consciousness whatsoever.]

[If you are willing to sacrifice this Evil God's egg to the God of Curses, He can curse you with the method to devour and fuse with Godhead fragments.]

Immediately after, Shang Feifan heard a long-awaited chime. Opening his system quest log, he saw that the reward for Quest 83 had changed: the original choice of any one discounted piece of equipment out of three had now been replaced by a fixed equipment reward.

The equipment even had a name: [Blessing of the God of Darkness].

Splendid. The system might as well have spelled it out for him clearly: *Stop eyeing the God of Curses' Godhead; I'm handing you a Godhead fragment of the God of Darkness whose original owner has already vanished. Go absorb the power of that Godhead fragment and strive to become the God of Darkness yourself.*

"And the God of Curses' Godhead fragment in my right eye?"

[Special circumstances; it can be exchanged for another item of the same category.]

"It has to be of equal value. Not the price I bought it for back then, but the actual value of this Godhead fragment."

System: ╰_ ╯ *An inch-gaining, pushy bastard!*

[We will exchange it for the special item 'Flame of Darkness (Seed)' (Darkness Fire Seed).]

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡眼睛一亮。如果能得到黑暗之神的神格碎片，还是没有意识那种，又能得到黑暗之火火种，那么他右眼中的诅咒之神神格碎片要不要就无所谓，留下反而是障碍。

当然，这不代表他放弃咒术。毕竟咒术也源自于黑暗能量。

【就算你融合了黑暗之神的神格碎片，也不代表你能肆无忌惮地吸收邪神力量。】

“我知道。感谢提醒，我会小心操作。”

商非凡起身，一挥骨杖，扛到肩头，吊气满满地说：“签份合作协议吧。把我们刚才提到的事都写上去，包括以后我们具体的合作方式一起。”

能和系统合作，那当然还是和系统合作的好。

邪神虽然诱人，但……重新和新上司磨合太麻烦，他还是更习惯和原来的老板相处。

尤其他也得考虑一下郎沐的感受。

如果没有郎沐，换成以前的他，他是真的不在意和谁合作、为谁打工。这个世界最后会变成什么样，和他有什么关系？

他就是个进游戏休闲的玩家而已。

系统：【必须把你手中那个礼盒中的邪神之物也一起献祭。】

商非凡诡异一笑，手一翻，亮出那个礼盒，抛了抛：“哦，你说这个啊，这就是个装了一枚钥匙的空盒子。我去伊曼切斯特外祖家找那个管家儿子时，看到类似的礼盒，就拿了一个。拿出来时我还想可能瞒不过你，没想到……”

商非凡笑眯眯地打开礼盒，露出里面融合后的钥匙。

“提前说好，这个钥匙就不献祭了，我留着还有用。”

系统：这个混蛋到底是什么时候搞出了这么一个礼盒？

哦，知道了，这家伙有空间戒指，他可以利用自己的精神力在空间戒指中操作这一切，而不让它察觉丝毫。

如果盒子中放的是其他东西，它还能分辨出来，可那枚钥匙也不知道是不是才使用过的缘故，满满的都是属于厄穆克拉索能量的味道！

【别和祂联系，曾经有比你更聪明更有能力的人，他们都以为自己能玩得过那个邪神，结果都在不知不觉间滑入深渊，成为了邪神的粮食。】

商非凡眸色深深，勾起唇角：“当然。为了确保安全，我会把这把钥匙放到这里。”

他已经发现并确定，这个雕像广场可以隔绝邪神感知和联系。这也是他特意进入雕像广场才和系统谈判的原因。

系统：……所以你还是不肯放弃和厄穆克拉索联系是吧？
chunks.englishText:
CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第211章 谈判 (Part 3)):
Shang Feifan's eyes lit up. If he could acquire a Godhead fragment of the God of Darkness—especially one without consciousness—along with the Seed of the Flame of Darkness, then it didn't really matter whether he kept the God of Curses' Godhead fragment in his right eye; leaving it there would only be an obstacle.

Of course, this didn't mean he was giving up on curses. After all, curses also originated from dark energy.

[Even if you fuse with the God of Darkness's Godhead fragment, it doesn't mean you can absorb Evil God power recklessly.]

"I know. Thanks for the reminder; I'll operate with care."

Shang Feifan stood up, swung his bone staff up onto his shoulder, and said with high spirits, "Let's sign a cooperation agreement. Write down everything we just talked about, including our specific cooperation methods from here on out."

If he was going to cooperate with someone, cooperating with the system was naturally the better choice.

The Evil God was tempting, but... breaking in a new boss was too much of a hassle. He was still more accustomed to dealing with his original employer.

Especially since he also had to consider Lang Mu's feelings.

Without Lang Mu—if it were the old him—he truly wouldn't care who he cooperated with or whose errand boy he was. What did it matter to him what the world eventually turned into?

He was just a gamer dropping in for some casual entertainment.

System: [You must also sacrifice the Evil God's artifact currently inside that gift box in your possession.]

Shang Feifan gave an eerie smile. With a flip of his hand, he produced the gift box and tossed it up and down. "Oh, you mean this? It's just an empty box containing a key. When I went to find that butler's son at Imanchest's maternal family estate, I saw a similar gift box and took one. When I took it out, I figured I might not be able to pull the wool over your eyes, but who would've thought..."

Shang Feifan smilingly opened the gift box, revealing the fused key resting inside.

"Let's make this clear in advance: this key won't be sacrificed. I'm keeping it; it'll still be useful."

System: *Just when on earth did this bastard manage to rig up such a gift box?*

Oh right, he had a spatial ring. He could use his spiritual power to manipulate all of this right inside his spatial ring without letting the system notice the slightest trace.

If the box had contained anything else, it might have been able to tell, but that key—perhaps due to having been used just recently—was reeking heavily of Emmuklaso's energy!

[Do not contact Him. There have been people smarter and more capable than you who all thought they could outplay that Evil God, only to unknowingly slide into the abyss and become food for the Evil God.]

Shang Feifan's gaze deepened as the corners of his lips curved upward. "Naturally. To ensure safety, I'll store this key right here."

He had already discovered and confirmed that this statue plaza could block out the Evil God's perception and connection. That was why he had specifically entered the statue plaza to negotiate with the system.

System: *...So you're still refusing to give up on contacting Emmuklaso, aren't you?*

chunks.chapterTitle: 第212章 夫夫同心的合演 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第212章 夫夫同心的合演

商非凡从雕像广场出来，就看到郎沐正侧坐在窗台上，左腿曲起，右腿落在地面，侧脸看着窗外七枚月亮。

屋里没有点灯，只有月光洒在郎沐身上，勾勒出一层淡淡的光晕。

商非凡在他对面坐下，眼睛几乎黏在对面年轻雄性兽人的脸上。

他家阿沐真的好好看，从骨到皮都贼好看！

郎沐转头看商非凡，抓起骨杖戳戳他的胸口。

商非凡笑。

“笑屁笑。”郎沐面无表情。

商非凡笑容更大。难得他家阿沐也会说脏话。

“老实交代，背着我干了什么？”骨杖又戳了戳雄兽的胸膛。

商非凡脑袋一歪，一只圆滚滚的小老虎就从衣服里钻出来，一头扎进他家男人怀里。

郎沐托着这只毛茸茸，捏捏他肉墩墩的小屁股，随即就用迅雷不及掩耳之势一把夹住了毛蛋蛋。

小老虎嗷地一声惨叫。

郎沐松手，弹了弹毛蛋蛋。

小老虎夹着腿，凄凄惨惨地喵嗷喵嗷叫。

郎沐忽然盯着小老虎的臀部，手掌蠢蠢欲动。

崽儿不乖怎么办？

当然是打啊。

嗷！小老虎吓得扒拉着四肢就往外逃。

被郎沐死死按住。

“嗷嗷嗷！家暴要不得，家暴会上瘾。你明明也答应了，不能这样事后算账。我的肚肚给你揉，我的脚垫给你捏，实在不行毛蛋蛋也可以盘，只求不要打屁屁~”小老虎含泪，他男人的尊严啊！

就是吧，这只小老虎嘴里哭着喊着，四肢扒拉着，可半点力气都没用上，那嗷嗷的叫声似乎还带着一点点期盼？

郎沐挑眉，拍拍某只虎的屁屁，反过来抱住小老虎，揉揉他柔软的小肚肚，慢悠悠地说：“我答应你什么了？”

“答应配合我。”小老虎可理直气壮。

“我什么时候答应配合你？嗯？”捏捏爪爪。

小老虎小声嘀咕：“我就没用劲，就做个样子，你就昏过去了，还配合地露出那样震惊的表情。”

郎沐轻哼：“白痴，想打昏我都不知道用劲，你也不怕被看出来。”

“我知道你会配合嘛。”小老虎四脚朝天，被揉得哼哼唧唧。

郎沐气，为了配合这个混蛋，他还不得不对自己使用速眠魔法，好让自己的昏迷看起来更像是真的。

等到商非凡把他放到床上，再进入雕像广场不久，他就醒来。

“你到底在搞什么鬼？什么事情不能给我看到、不能被我知道？而且……你现在这样，就不怕被系统知道你和我在联合演戏？”郎沐原本还想帮这家伙隐瞒，故意做出冷漠生气的模样，结果倒好，这家伙直接自曝。

小老虎在郎沐怀里打了个滚，“不怕，我已经跟系统重新签了协议，就算它知道我们之前在演戏也迟了，而且签协议前，它也知道我在诈它。”

郎沐猛然抬头。

一颗光球突然浮现在半空。

小老虎也抬头看过去。

“这个光球是不是在生气？”郎沐迟疑。光球逐渐发出红光。

小老虎跳起来扑向光球。

光球倏地一闪，稳稳躲过小老虎的一扑。

小老虎冷哼一声，迈着傲娇的步伐昂首走回窗台边，四肢蹬地往窗台上跳。

郎沐接住小老虎，眼看光球，好奇：“这是系统？”

小老虎懒洋洋：“八成就是它。不用管它，它爱飘出来就让它飘出来好了。”

郎沐神情微妙。他总觉得这个光球特地冒出来就是想要看热闹？

“那行，我们不管这个光球。回到刚才的话题，有什么不能让我听到和看到？老实交代，敢有一个字谎言，你自己知道后果。”郎沐的手从毛茸茸的小肚肚往下滑。

小老虎摊开的两条后腿立刻夹紧扭成麻花。

郎沐忍笑。

小老虎生气：“真是一点都不为自己的幸福着想。”

郎沐捏住圆圆的虎耳朵，眼神危险：“你说什么？我没太听清楚。”

小老虎耿直地飞快说道：“我说我太爱你了，无论你对我怎样，我都甘之如饴。亲爱的，我们说正事！”

小老虎毫不隐瞒，把他和系统的谈判过程以及内容全都交代了一遍，确保没有任何遗漏。

郎沐听完，就知道商非凡为什么要“打昏”他，且不让他留在雕像广场。

果然，小老虎斜睨那飘在半空的光球，表情和姿势都特别欠揍地说：“阿沐，你永远记住，我不会隐瞒你任何事情，更不可能违背你的意愿一意孤行，如果有什么事我们谈不拢，我也只会和你慢慢协商，求同存异。之前让你配合我演戏，不过就是想要让系统和某些神灵知道，必要时我也会对你动手，而且不会因为你而影响我的决定。”

小老虎裂开嘴唇，露出尖锐的虎牙，像是在嘲笑：“祂们相信了。显然祂们轻视了我们之间的信任度，也轻视了我们之间的感情。”

光球这次没有发出红光，它发出了蓝光。

郎沐都能猜测系统此时的心情有多郁卒。如果系统有情绪的话。

小老虎看系统不爽，他就爽。这破系统刚才跟他签协议，跟他扣字眼，非要又跟他讨价还价一番，还摆出地主家也没余粮的无赖架势，嘴上说着等价交换，实际就只想占他这个打工人的便宜。

郎沐：“这么说来，你还是放弃了那枚邪神之卵？”

小老虎无奈：“没办法，祂们太无赖了。如果我不献祭那枚邪神之卵，我就得不到黑暗之神的神格碎片，也无法交换到黑暗之火火种，以及神格碎片的融合之法。”

光球飘了一圈，似乎有异议，又忍住。

郎沐没管那个光球，而是担心地问：“你已经吸收了那枚神格？”

“没，我只是把右眼中的诅咒之神神格碎片换成了黑暗之火火种。等我消化了这枚黑暗之火，才能吸收那枚黑暗之神的神格碎片。到时还需要你帮我稳住意识。”

“好！”郎沐虽然担忧，但并不反对商非凡冒险。

这个世界并不是一个平和的世界，比地星那边还要讲究弱肉强食，如果他们不够强大，那么不管他们是什么心性、有什么抱负，都没用。

商非凡确实可以求稳，按照系统颁布的任务一点点做下去。

但现在商非凡已经接触到邪神，而系统那边并不能跑出来正面和邪神抵抗。

也就是说商非凡以后会很危险，搞不好就会死亡。

虽然系统为此揩了天残谷主的油，让商非凡和那边也有了联系，确保商一旦死亡，可以从玩家出生池中重生。

但没人可以确保万一，如果邪神真的那么好对付，现在就不会有残缺的神像和需要玩家做任务的系统。

郎沐很清楚，有些危险必须得冒。

说得难听点，与其等死，还不如搏一搏。

郎沐想，换成自己，他恐怕也会这么做。

只不过他的精神力和意志力都没有商非凡那么坚韧，所以他不会采取吞噬和吸收神格碎片这种方法来让自己快速变强。

他有自己的路走。

而商非凡现在显然也摸出了自己的道路方向，并开始实行。
