CHINESE SOURCE TEXT (第212章 夫夫同心的合演 (Part 1)):
Chapter 212: A Coordinated Act of Two Hearts as One

Stepping out of the statue plaza, Shang Feifan saw Lang Mu sitting sideways on the windowsill, his left leg bent, his right leg dangling toward the floor, his profile turned toward the seven moons hanging in the night sky.

The room was unlit; only the moonlight spilled over Lang Mu, outlining him in a faint, ethereal halo.

Shang Feifan sat down across from him, his eyes practically glued to the young beastman's face.

His Mu was truly drop-dead gorgeous—stunning from his bones right down to his skin!

Lang Mu turned his head to look at Shang Feifan, then picked up the bone staff and poked him in the chest.

Shang Feifan grinned.

"What are you grinning your ass off for?" Lang Mu said expressionlessly.

Shang Feifan's smile only widened. It was a rare treat to hear his Mu swear.

"Confess honestly. What did you do behind my back?" The bone staff gave the male beast's chest another poke.

Shang Feifan tilted his head, and a round little tiger poked its head out from inside his clothes, diving headfirst into his man's embrace.

Lang Mu cupped the furry little creature, pinched its plump little butt, and then, with lightning speed, clamped a hand firmly around its little furry balls.

The little tiger let out a miserable yelp of shock.

Lang Mu let go and flicked the little fuzzball.

The little tiger pressed its legs tightly together, crying out pitifully in a mournful meow-yelp.

Suddenly, Lang Mu stared fixedly at the little tiger's hindquarters, his palm itching with intent.

What do you do when a cub isn't well-behaved?

Naturally, you spank him.

*Awoooo!* Terrified, the little tiger scrambled with all four paws, trying to make a run for it.

Only to be pinned down relentlessly by Lang Mu.

"Awooo! Domestic violence is unacceptable; domestic violence is addictive! You clearly agreed not to settle scores afterward! You can rub my belly all you want, you can knead my paw pads, and if push comes to shove, you can even play with my fuzzy balls, just please spare the butt-spanking~" the little tiger wept tearfully. His dignity as a man was in ruins!

The funny thing was, while the little tiger was crying, howling, and scrambling with all four paws, he wasn't using an ounce of actual strength, and that howling cry even seemed to carry a hint of eager anticipation?

Lang Mu raised an eyebrow, gave the tiger's rear a pat, scooped the little tiger up into a proper hug, rubbed his soft little belly, and drawled, "What did I agree to?"

"You agreed to cooperate with me," the little tiger protested righteously.

"When did I agree to cooperate with you? Hmm?" He pinched a little paw pad.

The little tiger muttered softly, "I wasn't even using force, I was just putting on an act, and you passed out anyway, even cooperating by making that shocked expression."

Lang Mu let out a soft hmph. "Idiot, you wanted to knock me out yet didn't even know to use some force—aren't you afraid of being found out?"

"I knew you'd play along, didn't I?" The little tiger lay flat on his back with his paws in the air, humming and hawing as he got rubbed.

Lang Mu was exasperated. To cooperate with this bastard, he'd actually had to cast a fast-sleep spell on himself so that his fainting spell would look convincing.

The moment Shang Feifan laid him on the bed and stepped into the statue plaza shortly after, he had woken up.

"What on earth are you up to? What is so top-secret that I couldn't see it or know about it? And... acting like this now, aren't you afraid the system will find out that you and I were putting on a joint act?" Lang Mu had originally intended to help this guy cover for it by intentionally putting on a cold and angry expression, but look how that turned out—the guy had gone and exposed himself straight away.

The little tiger rolled over in Lang Mu's arms. "I'm not afraid. I've already re-signed an agreement with the system. Even if it finds out we were acting before, it's too late; besides, before signing the agreement, it already knew I was bluffing."

Lang Mu snapped his head up.

A ball of light suddenly materialized in midair.

The little tiger looked up at it as well.

"Is that ball of light angry?" Lang Mu asked hesitantly. The light sphere was gradually turning red.

The little tiger leaped up and lunged at the light sphere.

With a sudden flash, the light sphere deftly dodged the little tiger's pounce.

The little tiger let out a cold hmph, strutted back toward the windowsill with an air of aristocratic aloofness, and pushed off with all four paws to jump onto the ledge.

Lang Mu caught the little tiger, eyed the light sphere, and asked curiously, "Is this the system?"

The little tiger said lazily, "Eight or nine times out of ten, it's probably them. Pay it no mind; if it wants to float around, let it float."

Lang Mu wore a complex expression. He had a sneaking suspicion that this light sphere had specifically popped out just to watch the show.

"Alright then, we'll ignore the light sphere. Let's get back to the topic at hand. What was it you couldn't let me hear or see? Confess honestly—if there's even a single word of lies, you know the consequences yourself." Lang Mu's hand slid downward from the fluffy little belly.

The little tiger's two splayed hind legs instantly squeezed shut, twisting together like a twisted dough twist.

Lang Mu fought back a laugh.

The little tiger grumbled indignantly, "You really don't care about your own happiness at all."

Lang Mu pinched a round tiger ear, his gaze dangerous. "What did you say? I didn't catch that."

The little tiger instantly straightened up and blurted out at top speed, "I said I love you too much! No matter what you do to me, I'll gladly take it! Darling, let's talk about business!"

Holding nothing back, the little tiger spilled every detail of his negotiation process and content with the system, making sure not to leave a single thing out.

After listening, Lang Mu understood why Shang Feifan had "knocked him out" and kept him out of the statue plaza.

Sure enough, the little tiger slanted a sidelong glance at the light sphere floating in midair, wearing an expression and posture that were punch-me levels of cocky. "Mu, always remember: I will never hide anything from you, let alone act against your wishes and go my own way. If there's ever something we can't agree on, I will only negotiate with you slowly, seeking common ground while reserving differences. Back then, having you play along with my act was simply meant to let the system and certain deities know that when necessary, I would turn on you too, and that my decisions wouldn't be swayed by you."

The little tiger bared his lips, revealing sharp tiger fangs in a mocking smirk. "They believed it. Clearly, they underestimated the trust between us, and they also underestimated the depth of our bond."

This time, the light sphere didn't turn red—it turned blue.

Lang Mu could practically guess how utterly depressed the system must be feeling right now. Assuming the system possessed emotions, that is.

Seeing the system unhappy made the little tiger happy. This broken system had tried to pull rank with him earlier during their contract negotiations, nitpicking words, haggling back and forth, and putting on the shameless posture of a landlord whose granaries were empty. While preaching "equivalent exchange," its actual goal was just to exploit him—a hardworking laborer.

Lang Mu asked, "Does that mean you still gave up on that Evil God's egg?"

The little tiger sighed helplessly. "What choice do I have? They're too shameless. If I don't sacrifice that Evil God's egg, I won't get the God of Darkness's Godhead fragment, nor can I trade for the Flame of Darkness seed or the method to fuse Godhead fragments."

The light sphere drifted in a circle, seeming to harbor objections, but ultimately held its tongue.

Ignoring the light sphere entirely, Lang Mu asked worriedly, "Have you already absorbed that Godhead?"

"Not yet. I only swapped the God of Curses' Godhead fragment in my right eye for the Flame of Darkness seed. Once I digest this darkness fire, I'll be able to absorb the God of Darkness's Godhead fragment. I'll need your help to keep my consciousness steady when the time comes."

"Alright!" Though worried, Lang Mu did not object to Shang Feifan taking risks.

This world was hardly a peaceful realm; it adhered even more strictly to the law of the jungle than Earth did. If they weren't strong enough, then no matter what kind of mindset or ambitions they possessed, it would all be useless.

Shang Feifan could certainly play it safe, doing tasks step-by-step according to the system's assignments.

But now, Shang Feifan had already come into contact with Evil Gods, and the system side couldn't step out to fight Evil Gods head-on.

In other words, Shang Feifan would be in grave danger going forward, and one misstep could mean death.

Although the system had skimmed a bit off the top from the Master of Heaven's Trace Valley to set up a connection between Shang Feifan and that side—ensuring that should Shang perish, he could resurrect from the player respawn pool—no one could guarantee against contingencies. If Evil Gods were truly that easy to deal with, there wouldn't be broken statues and a system forcing players to do quests.

Lang Mu understood very well that certain risks had to be taken.

To put it bluntly, rather than sitting around waiting to die, it was better to gamble for a chance at survival.

Lang Mu figured that if he were in Shang Feifan's shoes, he would likely make the exact same choice.

It was just that neither his spiritual power nor his willpower was as resilient as Shang Feifan's, so he wouldn't choose a method like devouring and absorbing Godhead fragments to rapidly grow stronger.

He had his own path to walk.

And right now, Shang Feifan had clearly figured out the direction of his own path and had begun putting it into practice.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第212章 夫夫同心的合演 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
小老虎老实交代后心情放松，两条后腿又大拉拉地岔开，跟个大爷似地瘫在郎沐怀里，还要郎沐给他这里揉揉、那里按按。

郎沐也只当这是福利。

这只小老虎坏得很，平常很少出来。只有惹到他或者想要哄他时，要么就是想要无理取闹时，才会变成小老虎。

小老虎的皮毛并不像野生虎崽那样粗糙，摸到手里光滑柔软，宛如丝绵，又厚实。更别说他还有暖烘烘的小肚肚、富有弹性的粉红肉垫、灵活的粗尾巴，还有一对可可爱爱的圆耳朵。

郎沐可喜欢了。

小老虎心里哼哼：他傻了才会经常变成幼崽模样。要是让阿沐看习惯了，把爱情转变为父子情，某天突然牵个壮男回来说这是他给他找的小爸，他可不敢保证自己会做出什么事。

郎沐低头亲亲小老虎的脑袋，满眼宠溺：“我们也就只能骗祂们这一次。”

小老虎挥挥爪子：“没事，下次有需要再换其他招数。你也不用担心祂们会生气，祂们可是神灵，怎么可能不知道我们这些小小凡人耍出的小小花招？再说，老板忽悠打工人，打工人哄骗老板，你来我往常有的事。”

这厮还不要脸地宣称：“我真不介意帮人打工，反正就是当皇帝也是给人打工，只要心态摆的好，什么工作都能做。只不过随着打工人的能力提升，工资和奖金自然也要水涨船高。老板不肯主动提，那下面的打工人也只能闹闹罢工和跳槽来提醒老板该涨薪改合约了。不过主动权还是掌握在老板手上，他要是真不肯涨薪，我也没办法。”

郎沐心想：那也是你有能力和老板谈判，没能力的不是被进一步打压就是滚蛋。

光球看着小老虎在郎沐怀里嘚瑟，就后悔当初它怎么就给这破玩家弄了两个形态，其中一个还是幼崽体！

好吧，光球知道原因。

因为它经过多次推算，两世都过得不太顺的郎沐对成年兽人会自然排斥，也就只有对于小幼崽还愿意稍微敞开胸怀。

可恨这破玩家一点都不知道它的用心良苦，不但没有感激它花费大量能量和资源给他创造出来这么好的两种形态，反而总是想要跳到它头上撒野。

为什么人类总是这么贪婪？

明明它已经给得够多，可这个破玩家还是想要更多。

当然，不止商非凡一个人这样，它以前找的“玩家”也都差不离，总是会索要更多、期求更高。

只希望商非凡在被贪婪吞噬前，至少能把自然之神缺失的力量都找回来。

小老虎歪头看光球，猜测系统特意现形的原因。

想来应该不是被他和郎沐的合演给气到。

“阿沐，”小老虎张嘴咬咬郎沐的手指，轻轻的：“那个邪神厄穆克拉索跟我说了一些很有意思的事情。这是广场任何一块碑文，包括那座图书馆中的藏书，都没有提到的远古辛秘。”

郎沐看光球没有反应，就问：“什么辛秘？是除了兽人大陆的神灵不是古神以外的秘密？”

小老虎点头，当着光球的面就说道：“那个邪神说，天河星曾经发生过不止一次神战，不是单独一个大陆内部的神战，是整个天河星所有神灵的神战。”

郎沐理解数秒：“你是说天河星的神灵原本并不局限于某个大陆？”

小老虎：“对。祂说这颗星球上曾经有多个智慧种族，这些智慧种族都有各自的高手，这些高手在突破某个境界后，就能变成神灵。之后这些种族的神灵带着自己的种族为了抢夺更多资源和更进一步的可能进行大战，很多种族因此消失。而神之笼的出现就跟频繁的神战有关。”

“神之笼来源于更高层的神灵，似乎就是天河星真正的古神，也可以说是天河星世界意识。而神之笼的出现就是为了保护这颗星球，保护这颗星球上的生灵和资源。但神之笼在保护天河星的同时，也封锁了这颗星球，让里面的生灵就算达到神灵级别也无法脱离这颗星球。”

“于是，原来的保护罩变成了囚笼。天河星的神灵们在经过一段时间的修整调养后就千方百计地想要破坏神之笼。”

“总之，在神之笼出现前，这颗星球就已经有过非常辉煌和发达的文明，被称为神血文明。而我们知道的兽人和魔法师之类都已经是后来的新生文明。”

“可惜那个邪神只告诉我这么多，祂说我想知道更多，就去找祂，或接触祂的力量。”

【我来告诉你们那段被隐藏的历史。】

一人一虎一起抬头看向光球。

两人耳中像是听到了声音，但不是，那是一种超过正常音域的超低声波，直接送入他们耳朵，又自动在他们脑中化成他们能理解的意思。

【厄穆克拉索就是用这种办法欺骗了不少兽人，包括虫母。祂会让你感觉祂并不邪恶，祂会主动向你传授知识，告诉你别人不知道的远古神血文明历史，传授你别人不会的特殊技能，甚至帮你延长寿命和青春。一点一点，获取你的信任，从而侵入你的灵魂，让你变成祂的奴隶和能量。】

【我们一开始并不知道这是厄穆克拉索的阴谋，还觉得祂手段低下。但很快，我们就发现兽人们有很大一部分竟然开始信仰祂，并拒绝我们的召唤。祂甚至差点就成了兽神。】

小老虎的爪子碰了碰郎沐的手。

郎沐意会。

商非凡已经猜出了系统特意跑出来的原因。

因为邪神。

也为了方便和他们交流。

看不见的存在，虽然也可以交流，但总感觉隔着一层。

可如果有个具体的东西，那就不一样了。

商非凡觉得系统似乎又“进化”了一些。也许该说更“人性”了一点？
chunks.englishText:
After confessing honestly, the little tiger relaxed. Sprawling his back legs wide open, he slumped into Lang Mu's embrace like a lord, demanding Lang Mu rub him here and massage him there.

Lang Mu simply treated this as a perk.

This little tiger was quite wicked and rarely came out. He would only turn into a little tiger when provoked, when trying to coax Lang Mu, or when he wanted to throw a tantrum.

The little tiger's fur wasn't rough like a wild tiger cub's; it felt smooth and soft to the touch, like silk floss, yet thick. Not to mention his warm little belly, bouncy pink paw pads, flexible thick tail, and a pair of adorable round ears.

Lang Mu loved it.

The little tiger snorted in his heart: he would have to be a fool to turn into a cub often. If A-Mu got too used to seeing him like this, his romantic love might turn into paternal affection. If A-Mu suddenly brought home a burly man one day and said he found him a "stepdad," he couldn't guarantee what he might do.

Lang Mu lowered his head to kiss the little tiger's head, his eyes full of doting affection. "We can only fool Them this once."

The little tiger waved his paw. "It's fine. Next time we need to, we'll just use other tricks. You don't have to worry about Them getting angry. They are gods, after all. How could They not know the little tricks we puny mortals play? Besides, bosses hoodwink workers, and workers deceive bosses—it's a common back-and-forth."

This fellow even shamelessly declared, "I really don't mind working for others. After all, even being an emperor is just working for someone else. As long as you have the right mindset, you can do any job. It's just that as a worker's capabilities rise, their salary and bonuses naturally have to rise as well. If the boss refuses to take the initiative to raise it, the workers below can only strike or threaten to jump ship to remind the boss to raise wages and revise the contract. But the initiative is still in the boss's hands. If he really refuses to raise it, there's nothing I can do either."

Lang Mu thought to himself: *That's only because you have the ability to negotiate with the boss. Those without ability are either further suppressed or kicked out.*

The light orb watched the little tiger showing off in Lang Mu's arms and regretted why it had given this terrible player two forms in the first place, one of which was a cub form!

Well, the light orb knew why.

Because after multiple calculations, it found that Lang Mu, who had lived two rather unfortunate lives, would naturally reject adult beastmen. He was only willing to open his heart slightly to young cubs.

It was infuriating that this terrible player had no idea of its painstaking efforts. Instead of being grateful that it had spent a massive amount of energy and resources to create such excellent dual forms for him, he always wanted to ride roughshod over its head.

Why were humans always so greedy?

It had clearly given enough, yet this terrible player still wanted more.

Of course, Shang Feifan wasn't the only one like this. The "players" it had recruited in the past were all more or less the same, always demanding more and expecting higher.

It only hoped that before Shang Feifan was consumed by greed, he could at least recover the missing power of the God of Nature.

The little tiger tilted his head to look at the light orb, guessing the reason why the system had deliberately manifested.

It probably wasn't because it was angered by his and Lang Mu's joint performance.

"A-Mu," the little tiger opened his mouth to gently bite Lang Mu's finger. "That evil god, Umuclaso, told me some very interesting things. These are ancient secrets that aren't mentioned on any tablet in the plaza, nor in any books in that library."

Seeing no reaction from the light orb, Lang Mu asked, "What secrets? Secrets other than the fact that the gods of the Beastman Continent are not ancient gods?"

The little tiger nodded and said right in front of the light orb, "That evil god said that Sky River Star had experienced more than one god war. It wasn't a god war within a single continent, but a god war involving all the gods of the entire Sky River Star."

Lang Mu processed this for a few seconds. "You mean the gods of Sky River Star weren't originally restricted to a single continent?"

The little tiger: "Yes. He said there were once multiple intelligent races on this planet. These intelligent races all had their own experts. Once these experts broke through a certain realm, they could become gods. Afterward, the gods of these races led their respective peoples into a great war to seize more resources and further opportunities. Many races vanished because of this. And the appearance of the Cage of Gods was related to these frequent god wars."

"The Cage of Gods originated from higher-level deities, seemingly the true ancient gods of Sky River Star, or one could say the world consciousness of Sky River Star. The Cage of Gods appeared to protect this planet, its living beings, and its resources. However, while protecting Sky River Star, the Cage of Gods also sealed the planet, preventing the living beings inside from leaving even if they reached the level of gods."

"Thus, the original protective shield became a prison. After a period of rest and recuperation, the gods of Sky River Star tried every possible means to destroy the Cage of Gods."

"In short, before the Cage of Gods appeared, this planet already had a highly glorious and advanced civilization, known as the God-Blood Civilization. The beastmen and mages we know of are just subsequent, newly born civilizations."

"Unfortunately, that evil god only told me this much. He said if I want to know more, I should go find him, or come into contact with his power."

[I will tell you that hidden history.]

The man and the tiger looked up at the light orb together.

It was as if they heard a voice in their ears, but it wasn't. It was an ultra-low sound wave that exceeded the normal range of hearing, delivered directly into their ears and automatically translated in their minds into a meaning they could understand.

[Umuclaso used this exact method to deceive many beastmen, including the Broodmother. He makes you feel that he is not evil. He will actively impart knowledge to you, tell you the history of the ancient God-Blood Civilization that others don't know, teach you special skills that others don't possess, and even help you extend your lifespan and youth. Bit by bit, he gains your trust, thereby invading your soul and turning you into his slave and energy source.]

[At first, we didn't know this was Umuclaso's conspiracy and even felt his methods were crude. But soon, we discovered that a large portion of the beastmen actually began to worship him and refused our summons. He almost even became the Beast God.]

The little tiger's paw nudged Lang Mu's hand.

Lang Mu understood.

Shang Feifan had already guessed the reason why the system had deliberately shown itself.

Because of the evil god.

And also to make it easier to communicate with them.

An invisible existence, though capable of communication, always felt like it was separated by a barrier.

But if there was a concrete object, it was different.

Shang Feifan felt that the system seemed to have "evolved" a bit more. Or perhaps, it had become a bit more "human"?

chunks.chineseText:
第213章 历史秘辛

“稍等。这样说有点乱。”小老虎叫停，询问：“能不能从头说起，从邪神还没有来到我们天河星，神之笼也没有出现的时候开始？”

光球停顿片刻，【可以。】

【神之笼出现前的时期确实被称为神血文明。那时的天河星就是一个整体，所有大陆全都相通，只要度过海洋就能抵达。而天河星之大，资源之丰富，气候地貌环境之不同，让这颗星球孕育了极多的生命和多种智慧种族。

而天河星不管哪种智慧种族都有一个共同特质，那就是都拥有两种体态。

最古老的就属植物人族、石人族、海人族、虫人族，之后又有了兽人族、翼人族。而这些大种族中又按照特征不同、习性不同，分出无数不同的小种族。

一开始这些智慧种族只是懵懵懂懂地生活在这颗星球上，但随着一些天赋异禀的人出现，他们总结生活经验、总结天生异能和精神力方面的修炼法则，逐渐就带领各族从蒙昧的原始状态走向智慧社会。

随着时间流淌，就有极个别人修炼到超越凡人境界，进入了一种很特别的状态，这让他们在这颗星球上几乎无所不能。他们就把这种状态称为成神。

一开始成为神灵的人不多，但也不少。当他们发现只要承担这个世界的某个职责就更容易成神后，他们就开始分割和抢夺这些职责，之后他们也把这种职责称为神的权柄。

之后这些神灵又发现，祂们手中掌握的权柄越大，祂们的力量也越大后，就产生了第一次神战，为的就是互相权夺对方的神格也是权柄。

最终胜利的神灵就以祂们的权柄命名，比如日神、月神、丰收之神、大地之神、冰雪之神、四季之神、法律之神、商业之神、战神、死神等等。

那时候的神灵和众智慧生命很接近，更会直接给予自己的眷顾种族以庇护，甚至帮助眷顾种族去攻打他们的敌人。

同样这些神灵的眷顾种族也会为他们的神灵和其他种族争战，甚至不惜和其他神灵对上。

神战不止会让神灵陨落，更会对天河星的自然环境以及生灵们造成巨大伤害。

第一次神战后，整个神血文明的智慧种族都受到重创，有不少智慧种族甚至被灭族，有些大陆甚至被打碎、打沉。整个天河星也因此安宁了很长一段时间。

不过那时的神灵在恢复过来后也主动帮助眷顾种族恢复。

但很快第二次神战来临。

因为众神发现祂们并不是不死不灭，祂们也会消失。而且在消失之前祂们会逐渐变得漠然，对什么都不感兴趣，只会被迫做着神之权柄要求祂们履行的职责，日复一日、夜复一夜。祂们的欲-望在不断降低，祂们从人变成神，又从神变成了单纯的规则。

当规则可以自己运行后，负责该权柄的神灵就会自然而然消失于天地中，而这位神灵的力量也会重归于天河星。

众神发现这种情况后，很惶恐。祂们都是人变成的神灵，想要成神也是想要得到更多，如果最后结局只能变成无欲无求的天地规则，那祂们成神还有什么意义？

众神就想要离开天河星，想要更上一层楼，祂们认为神灵之上肯定还有更高层次，只要祂们能突破天河星的能量上限。

而想要突破天河星的能量上限，那当然需要吸收大量能量。这些能量从哪里来？

于是第二次神战开始了，这次神战更残忍。就算有些神灵并不想要开战，也不在乎会不会变成天地规则，可只要有某几个神灵不想，这席卷所有神灵的战争就无法避免。

那些不想消失的神灵认定，只要吞噬天河星上的大部分神灵，把这些神灵的力量集中到自己身上，就能突破天河星的能量上限，从而前往更高等的世界。

第二次神战规模更大，疯狂度更胜第一次神战，神灵权柄也不断集合和更迭，比较弱小的神灵几乎被吞噬得一干二净。

其中自然之神、黑暗之神、战神、商业之神、诅咒之神、知识之神、契约之神、海神，以及命运之神，这九位神灵最强。

可打着打着，神之笼出现了。

就非常突然，众神灵完全没有察觉，神之笼就出现笼罩住祂们，更把整个天河星所有大陆全部分开，能量也不再互相流通。

不过九位神灵也很快想明白，这是天河星这颗星球对祂们的惩罚，也是对这颗星球以及生活在星球上的生灵的保护。

因为第二次神战几乎杀死了天河星上五分之四的生命。这也让神血文明几乎消失。

虽然众神灵没有特意在天河星上开打，而是尽量在祂们开辟的神之空间内战斗，但这些神灵的权柄与天河星上的生命和环境息息相关，祂们之间的战斗又怎么可能不波及天河星本身？

如果神之笼只是隔开大陆也就算了，但众神灵发现，祂们竟然也没办法汲取其他大陆和海洋的能量来补充自己了，祂们被困在了当时战斗所在的大陆。

这个变故让祂们的力量暴跌。

就好像祂们原本执掌一国，现在却只能执掌一个小乡村一样。祂们的权力无法从小乡村中延伸出去，自然就无法得到来自外界的更多资源。

众神还发现天河星似乎并不想放祂们这些神灵离开。其允许祂们成为这颗星球的神灵，就像是在培养智能系统。当祂们能很好地履行权柄职责并能让规则自我运行后，祂们这些天河星培养出来的神灵就会重新变成天河星的养料。

众神为祂们的发现惶恐、痛苦，祂们不甘心被圈养，更不甘心在某天重新变成这颗星球的养料，一心想要挣脱这个牢笼。

而就在众神寻找出路的这个漫长过程中，天河星再次孕育出了新的文明。

这次自然不再是以星球为单位的整个星球文明，而是以大陆为单位的不同智慧种族各自的文明。

有的神灵闲着没事会去发展一下新的信徒和眷顾者，也有神灵彻底远离这些智慧种族。

这些种族有的靠神血文明留下的那点残渣逐渐发展出独属于自身的新文明，也有的靠神灵赐予知识来发展自身，更有不少是完完全全从零开始。

兽人大陆的几个智慧种族就得到了神灵的帮助，他们有的觉醒血脉天赋，有的获得被称作巫术的知识。

原本兽人大陆的神灵还想要通过获取信仰来壮大自身，但没多久祂们就发现这样做效果并不大，还会让这个大陆诞生新的神灵。

而一旦有新神诞生，就会自然从祂们这些古神身上掠夺走一定权柄，也相当于是分薄了古神的力量。这还是自动程序，不管古神们愿不愿意。

于是神灵们远离了兽人大陆的智慧生命，让他们自己慢慢发展，并刻意让这里的智慧生命不要相信和依赖神灵，告知他们只要怀有敬畏之心，无需祭祀和捐献，更不要随便立新神。这也是圣山祭司宫最初留下的神训，也是神灵曾经存在过的最大证明。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 213: Secrets of History (Part 1)

"Hold on. It's a bit messy to explain it like this." The little tiger called a halt and asked, "Can we start from the beginning? From before the evil god came to our Sky River Star, and before the Cage of Gods appeared?"

The light orb paused for a moment. [Very well.]

[The period before the Cage of Gods appeared was indeed known as the God-Blood Civilization. At that time, Sky River Star was a single entity. All the continents were connected, reachable as long as one crossed the oceans. Sky River Star was vast, rich in resources, and possessed diverse climates and landscapes, allowing the planet to nurture an immense variety of life and multiple intelligent races.]

[And no matter which intelligent race on Sky River Star, they all shared a common trait: they all possessed two physical forms.]

[The most ancient were the Plant-men, Stone-men, Sea-men, and Insect-men. Later came the Beastmen and Winged-men. Within these major races, countless different sub-races were divided according to their distinct characteristics and habits.]

[At first, these intelligent races lived ignorantly on this planet. But with the emergence of some exceptionally gifted individuals, they summarized their life experiences, natural abilities, and cultivation laws for spiritual power, gradually leading their respective races from a primitive state of ignorance into an intelligent society.]

[As time flowed, a very select few cultivated to a realm beyond mortals, entering a very special state that made them nearly omnipotent on this planet. They called this state 'becoming a god.']

[At first, not many became gods, but they weren't few either. When they discovered that assuming a certain duty of this world made it easier to achieve godhood, they began to divide and contest these duties. Later, they also referred to these duties as divine authority.]

[Later, these gods discovered that the greater the authority they held, the greater their power became. This led to the first god war, fought to plunder each other's godhood and authority.]

[The ultimately victorious gods were named after their authority, such as the Sun God, Moon God, God of Harvest, God of the Earth, God of Ice and Snow, God of the Four Seasons, God of Law, God of Commerce, God of War, God of Death, and so on.]

[At that time, the gods were very close to the various intelligent lifeforms. They would directly grant protection to their favored races, even helping them attack their enemies.]

[Similarly, the favored races of these gods would fight other races for their gods, not hesitating to clash with other gods.]

[God wars did not just cause gods to fall; they also caused immense damage to Sky River Star's natural environment and living beings.]

[After the first god war, the intelligent races of the entire God-Blood Civilization suffered heavy losses. Many races were even wiped out, and some continents were shattered and sunk. Consequently, Sky River Star enjoyed peace for a long time.]

[However, once the gods of that era recovered, they also actively helped their favored races rebuild.]

[But soon, the second god war arrived.]

[Because the gods discovered that they were not immortal; they too would vanish. Furthermore, before vanishing, they would gradually become indifferent, losing interest in everything, forced only to perform the duties required by their divine authority day after day, night after night. Their desires were constantly diminishing. They went from humans to gods, and from gods to simple rules.]

[Once the rules could run on their own, the god responsible for that authority would naturally vanish into the heavens and earth, and their power would return to Sky River Star.]

[Upon discovering this, the gods were terrified. They were all humans who had become gods, and they had sought godhood to gain more. If the final outcome was merely becoming desireless laws of heaven and earth, what was the point of becoming gods?]

[The gods wanted to leave Sky River Star and ascend to a higher level. They believed there must be a higher realm above gods, as long as they could break through Sky River Star's energy limit.]

[And to break through Sky River Star's energy limit, they naturally needed to absorb a massive amount of energy. Where would this energy come from?]

[Thus, the second god war began, and this one was even more brutal. Even if some gods did not want to fight and did not care if they turned into laws of heaven and earth, as long as a few gods wanted to, this war sweeping across all gods was unavoidable.]

[Those gods who did not want to vanish believed that by devouring most of the gods on Sky River Star and concentrating their power within themselves, they could break through the planet's energy limit and head to a higher world.]

[The scale of the second god war was even larger, and its madness far surpassed the first. Divine authorities were constantly consolidated and altered, and weaker gods were devoured almost entirely.]

[Among them, the God of Nature, God of Darkness, God of War, God of Commerce, God of Curses, God of Knowledge, God of Contracts, God of the Sea, and God of Destiny—these nine gods were the strongest.]

[But as the fighting went on, the Cage of Gods appeared.]

[It was extremely sudden. The gods were completely unaware when the Cage of Gods descended to shroud them, further separating all the continents of Sky River Star so that energy could no longer flow between them.]

[However, the nine gods also quickly realized that this was Sky River Star's punishment for them, as well as a protection for the planet and the living beings residing on it.]

[Because the second god war had killed nearly four-fifths of the life on Sky River Star. This caused the God-Blood Civilization to almost vanish entirely.]

[Although the gods did not deliberately fight on Sky River Star, trying their best to battle within the divine spaces they had created, their authorities were closely linked to the life and environment of Sky River Star. How could their battles not affect the planet itself?]

[If the Cage of Gods had only separated the continents, it would have been fine. But the gods discovered that they could no longer draw energy from other continents and oceans to replenish themselves. They were trapped on the continent where they were fighting at the time.]

[This turn of events caused their power to plummet.]

[It was as if they had originally ruled a nation, but were now only allowed to rule a small village. Their power could not extend beyond the village, so they naturally could not obtain more resources from the outside world.]

[The gods also discovered that Sky River Star did not seem to want to let them leave. It allowed them to become the planet's gods, much like training an intelligent system. Once they could perform their duties well and allow the rules to run on their own, these gods nurtured by Sky River Star would turn back into nutrients for the planet.]

[The gods were terrified and pained by their discovery. Unwilling to be kept like livestock, and even less willing to turn back into nutrients for this planet one day, they were bent on breaking free from this cage.]

[And during the long process of the gods searching for a way out, Sky River Star once again nurtured new civilizations.]

[This time, of course, it was no longer a planet-wide civilization, but rather distinct civilizations of different intelligent races on a continent-by-continent basis.]

[Some gods, having nothing better to do, would develop new believers and favored ones, while other gods completely distanced themselves from these intelligent races.]

[Some of these races gradually developed their own unique civilizations based on the remnants left by the God-Blood Civilization, while others developed by relying on knowledge bestowed by the gods. Many more started completely from scratch.]

[Several intelligent races on the Beastman Continent received help from the gods. Some awakened their bloodline talents, while others obtained knowledge known as witchcraft.]

[Originally, the gods of the Beastman Continent wanted to strengthen themselves by gaining faith, but before long, they discovered that doing so yielded little effect and would instead cause new gods to be born on this continent.]

[And once a new god was born, they would naturally plunder a portion of authority from these ancient gods, which was equivalent to diluting the ancient gods' power. This was an automatic process, whether the ancient gods liked it or not.]

[Thus, the gods distanced themselves from the intelligent life of the Beastman Continent, letting them develop slowly on their own. They deliberately told the intelligent life here not to believe in or rely on gods, informing them that as long as they held reverence in their hearts, there was no need for sacrifices or donations, and they should not casually establish new gods. This was also the original divine instruction left by the Sacred Mountain's Priestly Palace, and the greatest proof that the gods had once existed.]

chunks.chineseText:
因为兽人大陆这些神灵的操作，兽人大陆最终只留下关于古神的传说。】

商非凡看光球不再继续往下说，小爪子挥了挥：“然后呢？说话别说一半啊。邪神是怎么出现的？为什么兽人大陆的神灵会落到现在这个地步？又为什么会找外来雇佣兵帮助你们？请不要美化，实话更容易打动人心。”

光球：【不是在考虑美化。我的规则让有些事情不能直接说出来，我正在计算哪些事情能说、哪些事情不能说。】

小老虎转头就对郎沐说：“这个游戏系统八成就是繁华纪的兽人文明残缺主脑和自然之神神格碎片交-配后生出来的新物种。”

光球发出淡红色的光芒。

郎沐拍拍小老虎的脑袋，“好了，有些事自己知道就好，不要说出来让人恨。”

光球：【……】

【厄穆克拉索有些事情确实没有说谎。天河星上的神灵们确实想要脱困，就想方设法破坏神之笼，更想要找出离开天河星前往其他高等世界的方法。

虽然天河星上有神之笼把各个大陆分开，但众神自己创造出来的神之空间还是连在一起的，众神也依旧能够碰面。简单说就是祂们掌管的物理世界被分割开，但精神世界还是互通。】

郎沐和商非凡一起-点头，表示明白。

光球：【众神虽然都想离开天河星，但祂们之间并不友好，甚至会互相陷害和扯后腿。当几位神灵齐心合力终于在神之笼上开了一条缝隙，黑暗之神却利用那条缝隙召唤了外来邪神厄穆克拉索。

所有神灵都不知道黑暗之神用了什么方法、又是怎么知道这个方法能召唤外来邪神。

而根据众神事后分析，推测黑暗之神之所以会这么做，并不是希望这个外来神灵来侵略天河星，而是想要诱杀祂。

黑暗之神认为光是吞噬本地神灵还不够，想要脱离天河星，就需要更多更庞大的能量，比如多吞噬几个外来神灵。同时说不定还能借此获得更高等世界的消息。

当然，黑暗之神为了不让其他神灵察觉，祂并没有直接出面，而是利用了虫母的仇恨心。虫母信仰的就是黑暗之神，也是黑暗之神帮助她发现了新的大陆。黑暗之神想要影响她、给她一些神示，非常容易。

虫母就是按照黑暗之神教给她的方法，呼唤了邪神厄穆克拉索。】

小老虎举手：“暂停！一个问题，黑暗之神在召唤之前知道召唤来的外来神灵是谁吗？”

光球：【这点未知。众神还来不及审问黑暗之神，祂就被厄穆克拉索给吞噬了。不过根据众神推测，黑暗之神应该不知道召唤来的外来神灵是谁，否则也不会因为不知道对方实力高低，得到吞噬不成反被吞的凄惨下场。】

小老虎拉了拉嘴唇：这个下场确实足够凄惨。

但郎沐和他都没有批判的意思。

虽然黑暗之神貌似干了蠢事，但从黑暗之神的立场来看，祂只是放出诱饵想要打猎而已，哪想到闻味而来的猎物这么厉害，反把他这个猎人给吃了。

而众神破坏神之笼也只是不想当囚徒。

换了他自己，他也不乐意当了神仙后还继续给人打工，最后还被强迫程序化、养料化。

可从天河星的角度来看，它把家里的鸡鸭养大，特意培养出几只看家犬看管家里的鸡鸭，同时为了防止这些看家犬偷吃家里的鸡鸭和破坏这个家，自然要给这些看家犬做限定，一旦它们达到某个峰值就让它们退休，等它们年老体衰老年痴呆就安乐死，再用看家犬的尸体肥沃家里田地，怎么看就一特别环保的循环养殖系统。

总结：谁都没有错，就是立场问题。

“另一个问题，那条缝隙是不是出现在兽人大陆上空？”

【是。这是兽人大陆的灾难。但也有可能是黑暗之神特意引导，祂想利用虫母来召唤外来神灵，自然要找个理由说服虫母，比如让外来神灵吞噬兽人大陆的生灵。那么这条缝隙开在兽人大陆上空就不是意外。】

“明白了。”小老虎示意光球继续往下说。

光球红光收敛，似乎在述说历史中也逐渐冷静下来。

【总之，因为神之笼出现裂缝，无法再保护天河星，又有内奸特意召唤外来邪神，最终导致外来邪神侵入天河星。

黑暗之神第一个发现外来邪神，祂背着其他神灵单独去找那个外来邪神，原本是抱着吃独食的想法，最后却反被对方给啃了，连自我意识都没留下。

黑暗之神死前分割神格，原本是想留下重新凝聚神体的机会，但厄穆克拉索非常厉害，竟然能追着黑暗之神的能量找到祂分割的神格碎片。

就因为厄穆克拉索肆无忌惮地寻找黑暗之神分割的神格碎片，才会被其他神灵察觉，并和祂展开大战。

众神最终抢下一枚黑暗之神的神格碎片，只可惜黑暗之神附着在上面的意识体已经被厄穆克拉索吞噬。这枚神格碎片就是交易给你的那枚。】

小老虎听系统多次提起黑暗之神的神格碎片已经没有任何意识体存在，但他还是不打算马上吸收。

谁知道那神格碎片到底是个什么情况？

他没有万全准备或逼不得已，绝不会轻易吸收那枚神格碎片。

系统也在此时，似意有所指地说：【吞噬神格碎片并不代表就能成为神灵，更有可能被神格碎片吞噬。】

小老虎：“嗯。谢谢提醒，讲故事不要停。”

郎沐揪了揪虎须。

小老虎疼得龇牙咧嘴。

郎沐又敷衍地给他揉了揉。

小老虎气得咬他手指。

光球：【之后的历史你已经知道。外来邪神把我天河星的众神和整个星球都当做粮食，我星众神也想分食这个外来邪神并保护天河星，最后本星众神大战外来邪神厄穆克拉索。可对方实力强悍，又一来就吞噬了黑暗之神，偏偏众神实力下降得厉害，最终本星众神付出巨大代价，才把邪神厄穆克拉索给打到重伤并封印起来。】

“陨落了很多神灵吗？”郎沐忍不住问。

【是。没有陨落的神灵大多也都重伤，不得不陷入沉睡。】

“这些神灵都是被困在兽人大陆的神灵对吗？”

【不。是整个天河星的神灵。我刚才说过，祂们的力量虽然被局限在各个大陆中，但祂们的精神世界是互通的。当外来邪神出现在兽人大陆上空，这些神灵也都有来帮忙，只不过祂们来的都是精神力量。】

“懂了。天河星的神灵拥有两种能量，一种是组成身体的能量，一种是精神能量。”

【你也可以这么理解。】

小老虎再次举起爪子：“这场本土神灵和外来邪神的战斗是只打了一场，还是打打歇歇？”

【两场。第一场就是抢夺黑暗之神的神格碎片。第二场才是封印之战。第二场维持的时间很长，同时波及整个兽人大陆。】

“这么说外来邪神是被封印后才开始蛊惑本地生灵？”
chunks.englishText:
[Because of the actions of these gods of the Beastman Continent, only legends of the ancient gods were ultimately left behind on the continent.]

Seeing that the light orb had stopped speaking, Shang Feifan waved his little paw. "And then? Don't stop halfway. How did the evil god appear? Why did the gods of the Beastman Continent fall to their current state? And why did you seek outside mercenaries to help you? Please don't sugarcoat it; the truth is more convincing."

The light orb: [I am not considering sugarcoating it. My rules prevent certain things from being spoken directly. I am currently calculating what can be said and what cannot.]

The little tiger turned his head and said to Lang Mu, "This game system is eighty percent likely a new species born from the mating of the damaged main brain of the prosperous era's beastman civilization and a fragment of the God of Nature's godhood."

The light orb emitted a faint red glow.

Lang Mu patted the little tiger's head. "Alright, some things are better kept to yourself. Don't say them out loud and make others resent you."

The light orb: [...]

[Umuclaso indeed did not lie about certain things. The gods of Sky River Star did want to escape, so they tried everything to destroy the Cage of Gods, and wanted to find a way to leave Sky River Star for other higher worlds.]

[Although the Cage of Gods separated the various continents on Sky River Star, the divine spaces created by the gods themselves were still connected, and the gods could still meet. Simply put, the physical world they governed was divided, but their spiritual worlds were still interconnected.]

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan nodded together, indicating they understood.

[Although the gods all wanted to leave Sky River Star, they were not friendly with one another, and would even set traps and pull each other down. When several gods worked together and finally opened a crack in the Cage of Gods, the God of Darkness used that crack to summon the external evil god, Umuclaso.]

[None of the gods knew what method the God of Darkness used, or how he knew that this method could summon an external evil god.]

[According to the gods' post-war analysis, they speculated that the reason the God of Darkness did this was not because he wanted this external deity to invade Sky River Star, but because he wanted to lure and kill him.]

[The God of Darkness believed that merely devouring local gods was not enough. To escape Sky River Star, he needed more and greater energy, such as devouring a few external gods. At the same time, he might be able to obtain information about higher worlds through this.]

[Of course, to avoid detection by the other gods, the God of Darkness did not show himself directly. Instead, he utilized the Broodmother's hatred. The Broodmother worshipped the God of Darkness, and it was also the God of Darkness who helped her discover the new continent. It was very easy for the God of Darkness to influence her and give her divine revelations.]

[The Broodmother followed the method taught to her by the God of Darkness and summoned the evil god, Umuclaso.]

The little tiger raised his paw. "Pause! One question: did the God of Darkness know who the summoned external deity was before summoning him?"

The light orb: [This remains unknown. Before the gods could interrogate the God of Darkness, he was devoured by Umuclaso. However, according to the gods' speculation, the God of Darkness likely did not know who the summoned external deity was. Otherwise, he wouldn't have met such a miserable end—being devoured instead of devouring—due to not knowing the opponent's strength.]

The little tiger twitched his lips: that end was indeed miserable enough.

But neither Lang Mu nor he had any intention of criticizing.

Although the God of Darkness seemed to have done something foolish, from his perspective, he was merely laying out bait to hunt. Who would have thought the prey attracted by the scent would be so powerful that it ate the hunter instead?

And the gods destroying the Cage of Gods was also just because they didn't want to be prisoners.

If it were him, he wouldn't want to continue working for someone else after becoming a god, only to be forced to become programmed and turned into fertilizer in the end.

Yet from Sky River Star's perspective, it raised its chickens and ducks, specifically trained a few guard dogs to watch over them, and to prevent these guard dogs from eating the chickens and ducks or destroying the home, it naturally had to place limits on them. Once they reached a certain peak, they would be retired, and when they grew old, frail, and senile, they would be euthanized. Then, the guard dogs' carcasses would be used to fertilize the fields. No matter how one looked at it, it was a highly eco-friendly, circular farming system.

Summary: No one was in the wrong; it was simply a matter of perspective.

"Another question: did that crack appear in the sky above the Beastman Continent?"

[Yes. This was the disaster of the Beastman Continent. But it is also possible that the God of Darkness guided it deliberately. Since he wanted to use the Broodmother to summon the external deity, he naturally had to find a reason to convince her, such as letting the external deity devour the living beings of the Beastman Continent. Thus, it was no accident that this crack opened in the sky above the Beastman Continent.]

"Understood." The little tiger gestured for the light orb to continue.

The light orb's red light dimmed, and it seemed to gradually calm down as it recounted history.

[In short, because a crack appeared in the Cage of Gods, it could no longer protect Sky River Star. With a traitor deliberately summoning an external evil god, the external evil god ultimately invaded Sky River Star.]

[The God of Darkness was the first to discover the external evil god. He went to find the external evil god alone behind the backs of the other gods, originally intending to keep the feast to himself, but was instead devoured by the opponent, leaving not even his self-awareness behind.]

[Before his death, the God of Darkness split his godhood, originally wanting to leave a chance to re-coalesce his divine body. However, Umuclaso was extremely powerful and actually managed to trace the energy of the God of Darkness to find his split godhood fragments.]

[It was precisely because Umuclaso searched recklessly for the split godhood fragments of the God of Darkness that he was noticed by the other gods, who then engaged in a great war with him.]

[The gods ultimately snatched one fragment of the God of Darkness's godhood, but unfortunately, the consciousness attached to it had already been devoured by Umuclaso. This godhood fragment is the one traded to you.]

Hearing the system mention multiple times that the godhood fragment of the God of Darkness no longer had any consciousness left, the little tiger still did not plan to absorb it immediately.

Who knew what the actual situation with that godhood fragment was?

Unless he was fully prepared or forced by circumstances, he would never easily absorb that godhood fragment.

The system also said at this moment, seemingly with implied meaning: [Devouring a godhood fragment does not mean one can become a god; it is more likely that one will be devoured by the godhood fragment.]

The little tiger: "Mm. Thanks for the warning. Don't stop the story."

Lang Mu plucked at the tiger's whiskers.

The little tiger bared his teeth in pain.

Lang Mu perfunctorily rubbed it for him.

The little tiger bit his finger in annoyance.

[You already know the subsequent history. The external evil god treated the gods of our Sky River Star and the entire planet as food, while the gods of our planet also wanted to feast on this external evil god and protect Sky River Star. In the end, the local gods fought a great war against the external evil god, Umuclaso. However, the opponent's strength was formidable, and he had devoured the God of Darkness right from the start, whereas the local gods' strength had fallen drastically. Ultimately, the local gods paid a massive price to heavily injure and seal the evil god, Umuclaso.]

"Did many gods fall?" Lang Mu couldn't help but ask.

[Yes. Most of the gods who did not fall were also heavily injured and had to fall into a deep slumber.]

"These gods were all the gods trapped on the Beastman Continent, right?"

[No. It was the gods of the entire Sky River Star. As I said earlier, although their physical power was confined to their respective continents, their spiritual worlds were interconnected. When the external evil god appeared in the sky above the Beastman Continent, these gods all came to help, though they only came with their spiritual power.]

"Understood. The gods of Sky River Star possess two types of energy: one that makes up their physical bodies, and spiritual energy."

[You can understand it that way.]

The little tiger raised his paw again. "Did this battle between the local gods and the external evil god happen in just one go, or did they fight and rest intermittently?"

[Two battles. The first was the struggle for the God of Darkness's godhood fragment. The second was the battle of sealing. The second battle lasted for a very long time and affected the entire Beastman Continent.]

"So the external evil god only began to bewitch the local living beings after being sealed?"

chunks.chineseText:
【不。厄穆克拉索在失去黑暗之神的神格碎片后，可能觉得本地神灵也不是太好惹，同时也是为了消化吸收黑暗之神的力量，就躲起来一段时间。在这段时间内，祂试图冒充兽神，来获取兽人们的信仰。】

“厄穆克拉索需要信仰之力？”

【不，众神推测祂应该只是想要通过这种方式来分薄众神的力量。祂很可能以为天河星的神灵是靠信仰之力成神。】

“如果是冒充兽神的话……这么说一开始厄穆克拉索其实表现得并不邪恶？”

【那只是祂的伪装，后来祂被封印就彻底暴露出真面目。】

“有没有可能是老厄吸收了黑暗之神的力量后黑化了，或者误以为祭祀黑暗之神的方式就是这个世界的信仰方式？”小老虎嘀嘀咕咕。

光球再次发出红光，斩钉截铁地：【不。厄穆克拉索本质就是邪恶！】

小老虎举爪：“我就是胡乱猜猜。不要激动~。不过我们也不能否认有这种可能对吧？”

【你这是想给反派洗白吗？】光球没有声音，却让郎沐和小老虎都听出了阴森森之意。

小老虎翻了个白眼：“对于普通生灵来说，你们都是反派。别炸！我们继续下一段，你们为什么要找外来雇佣兵？为什么会找到我头上？你们是本土神灵，找本地土著来帮你们才是最正确的打开方式吧？”

光球一听这个问题，就发出了蓝色的光芒，且蓝色越来越深。

郎沐和商非凡：看来是很郁闷了。

“别急，你可以慢慢酝酿。另外，如果有痛苦的事情，不要憋着，一定要说出来，越多分享，你就会越轻松。大多时候痛苦往事就跟垃圾一样，倒出来就好，藏在自己心里只会让垃圾发酵变成更可怕的毒素，除了伤害自己没有任何好处。”小老虎特别善解人意地说。

光球：【……】
chunks.englishText:
【No. After losing the Godhead fragment of the God of Darkness, Elmukraso probably felt that the local deities weren't to be trifled with either. At the same time, in order to digest and absorb the power of the God of Darkness, it went into hiding for a period of time. During this period, it attempted to impersonate the Beast God in order to gain the faith of the beasts.】

"Elmukraso needed the power of faith?"

【No, the gods speculate that it merely wanted to use this method to dilute the power of the deities. It likely assumed that the deities of the River of Heaven Star attained divinity through the power of faith.】

"If it was impersonating the Beast God... Does that mean Elmukraso actually didn't appear evil at the very beginning?"

【That was merely its disguise. After it was sealed later on, its true colors were thoroughly exposed.】

"Is it possible that Old El turned dark after absorbing the power of the God of Darkness, or mistakenly thought that the way to worship the God of Darkness was this world's form of worship?" the little tiger muttered.

The sphere of light flashed red once more and stated decisively: 【No. Elmukraso was evil by nature!】

The little tiger raised a paw: "I was just making wild guesses. Don't get so worked up~. But we can't completely deny that possibility, right?"

【Are you trying to whitewash the villain?】 The sphere of light made no sound, yet both Lang Mu and the little tiger could sense a chilling undertone.

The little tiger rolled his eyes: "To ordinary living beings, all of you are villains. Don't explode! Let's move on to the next segment. Why did you look for external mercenaries? Why did you end up finding me? You are native deities; finding local indigenes to help you should be the most correct way to do things, right?"

As soon as the sphere of light heard this question, it emitted a blue glow, and the blue grew increasingly deeper.

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan: It seemed to be extremely depressed.

"Don't rush, you can brew on it slowly. Also, if there's anything painful, don't bottle it up—you must let it out. The more you share, the lighter you'll feel. Most of the time, painful past experiences are just like garbage; dumping them out is best. Keeping them hidden in your heart will only make the garbage ferment into even more terrifying toxins, doing nothing except harm yourself," the little tiger said with utmost empathy.

The sphere of light: 【...】

chunks.chapterTitle: 第214章 前任们的遭遇 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第214章 前任们的遭遇

【哪怕是命运之神也无法掌控命运，只能观察和影响。

而且根据命运之神的能力高低，能观察到的命运线的时间长度也会不同，看得越久远就越吃力越模糊。

因为命运并不是一成不变，它就像是一条正在往远处流淌的巨大河流，当它流淌下去时，会出现无数分支河流，有时还会转入地下，让你无法清楚观察到。

你顺着主流以为能看到最终，却很有可能看到这条主流彻底断流、干涸、消失。

反而是其他支流还在继续流淌。

无数支流，你也不知道最终哪条能流向大海，再周而复始。

有时候你为了让某条支流能一直流淌到大海，就会帮它开山挖洞开辟河道挖掘泥沙，争取不让它断流。

但这途中也可能发生无数事情，让你的影响变得更为糟糕。

当邪神降临，天河星陷入危难，命运之神就试图窥探命运长河，从中找出求生之路。

而这也不是命运之神第一次窥探和想要影响命运，在众神明白自己的未来必然会成为这个世界大循环中的一环时，祂们就试图改命。

可结果就是两次神战。

如果没有神战，至少众神还能存在很长很长时间。可因为神战，很多神灵都提前陨落。

如今更是引来外来邪神，让自己和整个天河星都成为了别神的猎物。

可越是如此，众神越是想要挣扎，没有谁想要躺平等死，也不想天河星消失。

如果天河星还存在，只要众神还能留下一枚神格碎片，就还有重新复生的机会。

命运之神窥探到邪神降临，会让整个天河星都成为壮大对方的能量。于是众神开始努力改变这条命运线。】

光球几乎没有任何情绪，它此时真的就像是一个系统，只是在念出这段不为人知的历史。

【一条命运线上会有几个比较重要的时间节点。在这些时间节点上会有一个或几个重要人物出现，他们的选择和做法会影响到很多人，从而影响到后面一小段的命运线发展。

当众神封印了邪神厄穆克拉索后，就开始试图找出那几个重要时间点以及重要人物。

第一次尝试就是找到残损的繁华纪兽人文明最高结晶主脑，与神格碎片结合，创造出系统。

再派遣系统去辅佐某些重要人物，培养和影响他们，争取让他们能帮忙炸开阻断河流的大山、淘干净让河道堵塞的泥沙。

那是大战纪过后，进入战毁纪的时候。

但系统轻忽了人心和人性，又没有绝对的神灵力量进行压制和威慑，最终第一次拯救计划失败，反而加速了兽人大陆毁灭。

原本计划大战纪后就会迅速进入恢复期的兽人大陆被拖入长达三百多年的战毁纪，繁华纪留下的发达文明遭到进一步破坏。整个兽人大陆的文明飞速倒退，几乎让这里的智慧种族倒退到原始状态。

更糟糕的是，因为某个任务者的任性妄为，还让整个兽人大陆陷入了长达两百年的毒雾纪痛苦中。

时间无法倒流，众神的残留意识也无法挽回已经发生的事情。可祂们也不能眼睁睁看着兽人大陆乃至整个天河星一点点走向末途，于是祂们再次窥探命运长河，寻找第二个重要时间节点和重要人物。】

小老虎嗷嗷叫：“等等，你后面这几段说得也太简略了。你们到底做了什么？任务者？所以你冒充系统找了本地土著，想要培养他们？想让他们对抗邪魔、消除灾难？但他们都失败了？你们找了几个任务者？又是怎么培养他们的？”

小老虎特别好奇，眼睛闪闪发亮。

他不是八卦，他真的就是想要多了解一点历史。

如果不考虑天河星是他第二故乡，郎沐也觉得很有意思。原来兽人大陆已经出现过任务者，还不止一人。这几个人在某种意义上也可以说是命运之子了吧？

光球大概一边说一边在确认哪些可以说、哪些不能说，每次回答都会迟一些。

【三个人。不同时期。第一个是一名虫人族，他实力很强，是虫母曾经留下的王虫人卵孵化。以做任务得奖励的方式培养。】

光球没说，因为是第一个任务者，它给出的任务奖励也最为丰厚，对其也最为照顾。那时候哪需要什么贡献点数，都是一个任务做完就直接送装备送技能送增进修为的天材地宝。

有时候为了让任务顺利进行，它还会同意任务者赊账，提前把奖励交给他。

“他为什么失败？”小老虎怕光球不肯回答，特意补充说：“以史为鉴，总结前同行们的失败，也能避免自己再蹈覆辙。”

光球：【他认为想要打败邪神，就必须获得更庞大的力量，比如吞噬虫母。有一天，他幸运也不幸地获得了一枚虫母心脏碎片，他没听我的劝告，跟你一样选择吞噬这枚心脏碎片，但他……也许原本就是虫人族的缘故，他被虫母意识侵占，彻底失去自我。为了避免他投向虫母，为虫母增加力量，我迫使他自爆了。】

小老虎：“幸好我和你们重新签订了契约，否则我要是失去自我意识，你们也迫我自爆怎么办？”

【根据新契约，我无法操控你的身体和意识，但失去自我的你会成为我必须消灭的敌人。】

“就不能多给我一点信任？听着，除非我家阿沐也放弃我，否则别把我当敌人揍。我相信我就算被人占据身体也只是暂时的，我会夺回属于我的一切并干掉敌人。”小老虎未雨绸缪。

光球看向郎沐，没说话。

商非凡就当它默认，忽然问：“那枚虫母心脏碎片在哪里？这么危险的东西，你肯定不可能置之不管。你是不是把它收起来了？”

光球不用看小老虎那贪婪的眼神，就知道商非凡想做什么：【会放入游戏商城，也有可能会放入任务奖励。】

小老虎精神一振，一骨碌坐起：很好！上道。

“后面两个任务者又是什么一个情况？”

【第二个任务者是兽人族，雌性，此人气运滔天，我就把她当做新兽人首领培养，她本人也有充足的野心和能与野心匹配的能力。我要做的就是提升她的能力并引导她。

实际上她做得也很不错，当时几乎打下了兽人大陆一半领土，把邪神信徒逼得无路可走，当时的兽人们也都盼望这位能一统兽人大陆，给兽人们带来新生。

但也有兽人不愿服她，更想夺取她的权力和打下的地盘。她当时身边有五个重要臂助，其中至少有两人包藏祸心，但他们掩饰得很好，连我都没有看出来。

最后这名任务者爱上了五名臂助中的一人，甚至为他愿意让出首领之位。我建议她不要退让，她却说她怀孕了，暂时不适合打打杀杀，让出首领之位也是暂时。】

小老虎团成一团窝在郎沐手臂里：“这是事业心变成了恋爱脑？”

随后，小老虎沾沾自喜地说：“还好我一开始就是恋爱脑。”

郎沐敲他脑门。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 214: The Fates of the Predecessors (Part 1)

【Even the God of Fate cannot control fate; they can only observe and influence it.

Moreover, depending on the proficiency of the God of Fate, the length of the timeline they can observe will also vary. The farther into the future they look, the more strenuous and blurry it becomes.

Because fate is not set in stone; it is like a massive river flowing into the distance. As it flows, countless branch rivers appear, and sometimes it dives underground, making it impossible for you to observe clearly.

Following the mainstream thinking you can see the end, you are very likely to see this mainstream completely sever, dry up, and disappear.

Instead, other branch rivers continue to flow.

Amidst countless tributaries, you never know which one will ultimately flow into the ocean and begin the cycle anew.

Sometimes, in order to make a certain tributary flow all the way to the ocean, you help it carve through mountains, dig caves, open up riverbeds, and dredge silt, striving to prevent it from running dry.

Yet countless things can happen along the way, making your interference even worse.

When evil gods descended and the River of Heaven Star fell into peril, the God of Fate attempted to peer into the River of Fate, searching for a path of survival within it.

Nor was this the first time the God of Fate had peered into and sought to influence fate. When the deities understood that their futures would inevitably become a link in this world's grand cycle, they tried to defy their fate.

The result, however, was two Divine Wars.

Had there been no Divine Wars, the deities could have existed for at least a much longer time. But because of the divine wars, many deities perished prematurely.

Now, it has even attracted external evil gods, turning themselves and the entire River of Heaven Star into the prey of other deities.

Yet the more this was the case, the more the deities wished to struggle. None of them wanted to lie flat and await death, nor did they wish for the River of Heaven Star to vanish.

If the River of Heaven Star still existed, as long as the deities could leave behind a single Godhead fragment, there would still be a chance of resurrection.

The God of Fate peered into the descent of the evil god, seeing that it would cause the entire River of Heaven Star to become energy to empower the adversary. Thus, the deities began striving to change this timeline.】

The sphere of light possessed almost no emotion; at this moment, it truly resembled a system simply reciting this unknown history.

【A timeline will have several relatively important temporal nodes. At these nodes, one or several important figures will appear, and their choices and actions will affect many people, thereby influencing the development of the brief section of the timeline that follows.

Once the deities sealed the evil god Elmukraso, they began attempting to pinpoint those important nodes and key figures.

The first attempt was to find the damaged highest-crystallization mainframe of the prosperous-era beastman civilization, combine it with a Godhead fragment, and create the System.

Then, they dispatched the System to assist certain important figures, nurturing and influencing them in strives to have them help blast open the mountains blocking the river and dredge the silt choking the riverbed.

That was when the era transitioned from the Great War Era into the War-Ruin Era.

However, the System underestimated human hearts and human nature, while lacking absolute divine power for suppression and deterrence. In the end, the first rescue plan failed, instead accelerating the destruction of the Beastman Continent.

The Beastman Continent, which was originally planned to rapidly enter a recovery period after the Great War Era, was dragged into a War-Ruin Era lasting over three hundred years, and the advanced civilization left behind by the Prosperous Era suffered further destruction. The civilization of the entire beastman continent regressed rapidly, nearly driving the intelligent races here back to a primitive state.

Worse still, due to the willful recklessness of a certain quest-taker, the entire Beastman Continent was plunged into two hundred years of suffering within the Poison Fog Era.

Time cannot be reversed, nor can the lingering consciousness of the deities undo what has already happened. Yet they could not stand by and watch the Beastman Continent—and even the entire River of Heaven Star—step bit by bit toward a dead end. Therefore, they once again peered into the River of Fate, searching for a second important temporal node and key figure.】

The little tiger howled: "Hold on, your past few paragraphs are way too brief! What on earth did you guys do? Quest-takers? So you impersonated the system and found local indigenes, wanting to train them? To have them fight demons and eliminate disasters? But they all failed? How many quest-takers did you find? And how did you train them?"

The little tiger was exceptionally curious, his eyes sparkling.

He wasn't gossiping; he genuinely wanted to understand a bit more history.

Putting aside the fact that the River of Heaven Star was his second home, Lang Mu also found it quite interesting. It turned out that quest-takers had already appeared on the Beastman Continent, and there was more than one. In a sense, could these individuals also be considered Children of Fate?

The sphere of light was likely weighing what could and could not be said while speaking, causing each response to be slightly delayed.

【Three people. Different periods. The first was an insectoid. He possessed immense strength, hatched from a primordial queen insect egg once left behind by the Mother of Insects. He was nurtured by completing quests for rewards.】

The sphere of light did not mention that, because he was the first quest-taker, the quest rewards it gave out were the most lavish and he was treated with the utmost care. Back then, what need was there for contribution points? A quest would be completed, and equipment, skills, and heavenly treasures to boost cultivation realms were directly gifted.

Sometimes, to ensure a quest proceeded smoothly, it would even allow the quest-taker to run a tab, handing over the rewards in advance.

"Why did he fail?" Fearing the sphere of light would refuse to answer, the little tiger added hastily: "Taking history as a mirror and summarizing the failures of our predecessors can also prevent us from repeating the same mistakes."

The sphere of light: 【He believed that to defeat the evil god, one had to acquire even more immense power, such as devouring the Mother of Insects. One day, he was fortunate—and unfortunate—enough to obtain a fragment of the Mother of Insects' heart. He ignored my warnings and chose to devour this heart fragment just like you did, but he... perhaps because he was originally of the insectoid race, his consciousness was invaded by the Mother of Insects, and he completely lost his sense of self. To prevent him from defecting to the Mother of Insects and augmenting her power, I forced him to self-detonate.】

The little tiger: "It's a good thing I re-signed a contract with you guys; otherwise, what would happen if I lost my self-awareness and you forced me to self-detonate too?"

【Under the new contract, I cannot manipulate your body and consciousness, but a you who has lost self-sense will become an enemy I am obligated to annihilate.】

"Can't you give me a bit more trust? Listen here, unless my Ah Mu also abandons me, don't treat me like an enemy and beat me up. I believe that even if someone else occupies my body, it'll only be temporary; I will take back everything that belongs to me and waste the enemy." The little tiger took precautions beforehand.

The sphere of light looked at Lang Mu and remained silent.

Treating its silence as tacit consent, Shang Feifan suddenly asked: "Where is that heart fragment of the Mother of Insects? With something so dangerous, you surely couldn't just leave it alone. Did you pack it away?"

Without needing to look at the little tiger's greedy gaze, the sphere of light knew what Shang Feifan wanted to do: 【It will be placed in the game mall, and may also be offered as a quest reward.】

The little tiger's spirits lifted, and he sat up straight in one fluid motion: Excellent! Very savvy.

"What about the situation with the last two quest-takers?"

【The second quest-taker was a beastman, a female. Her fortune was boundless, so I nurtured her as the new beastman leader. She herself possessed ample ambition and the capability to match that ambition. What I needed to do was elevate her abilities and guide her.

In fact, she did quite well. At the time, she practically conquered half the territory of the Beastman Continent, driving the evil god's followers into a dead end, and the beastmen of that era all hoped she could unify the Beastman Continent and bring a new birth to the beastmen.

Yet there were also beastmen who refused to submit to her, desiring instead to usurp her power and the territory she had conquered. She had five important aides by her side at the time, among whom at least two harbored malicious intentions, yet they concealed them so well that even I failed to notice.

In the end, this quest-taker fell in love with one of the five aides, and was even willing to cede her position as leader for his sake. I advised her not to step down, but she claimed she was pregnant and temporarily unsuited for fighting and killing, stating that ceding the leadership position was only temporary.】

The little tiger curled into a ball and nested in Lang Mu's arm: "Did her career-driven mindset turn into brain-dead romance?"

Afterward, the little tiger smugly remarked: "Good thing I was brain-dead for romance right from the start."

Lang Mu knocked him on the forehead.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第214章 前任们的遭遇 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
小老虎完全不觉得自己说错，他进游戏发现郎沐后就是为了谈恋爱啊。这破系统不也是把阿沐当做胡萝卜吊在他前面嘛。

“说说吧，这位气运滔天的女兽人是不是被渣男骗心骗身骗财还被骗了全部家业？最后还被渣男给刀了？”

光球：【……这位任务者身边的五位臂助都喜欢她，不一定是想做她的伴侣，也有好友好兄弟这类，我无法分辨有几人是真心，但他们就是以不服任务者给其中一人生孩子，还把首领之位让给他这件事，闹了起来。有人要杀死孩子父亲，那孩子父亲也想干掉想要杀死他的人。最后这五个人带领他们手下的势力就互斗了起来。

任务者生孩子时被人偷袭，重伤，孩子被人抢走。之后该任务者就一心想要找回孩子，伤好后只要怀疑谁是抢走她孩子的人，她就会带人去攻打对方。

如此，很快该任务者就腹背受敌，而她的五名臂助在互相争斗中也死了两人，剩下的三人有一人表示对任务者十分失望，拉着自己的人手出去单干。最后剩下的两人，一个是孩子父亲，一个是她最信任的人。

孩子父亲支持任务者到处寻找自己的孩子，就这么走上了首领的位置，接过了任务者手中的管辖权。

当孩子父亲掌握了权力后，趁着任务者再次出去寻找孩子时，密谋暗杀了任务者最信任的臂助。

我通过天眼系统发现，通知任务者赶回来救人。

但任务者没有赶得上，只看到那名心腹的尸体，而她直到此时才发现，她最爱的人就是这名心腹。

最终任务者和孩子父亲大战，就在孩子父亲就要战败时，孩子爷爷带着一个小幼崽出现，当着任务者的面说这是她的孩子，说如果她不肯放手，就摔死她的孩子。

任务者通过血脉感应，确定那个幼崽就是她的孩子，她不听我的劝阻，束手就擒。】

小老虎：“啊！完犊子了。”

小老虎跟郎沐叨叨：“每次看影视剧就最反感这种情节。这种因为受到威胁不得不束手就擒的行为根本就是自我感动，对改善实际情况屁用没有，顶多用来拖延时间，这还得确保有后援才行。”

郎沐觉得自己九成九会是束手就擒的那类人，“换了你，你会怎么做？”

小老虎想都不想地说：“最好的做法就是先抓一个人质，大家互换。就么就是先逃离。对方一般不敢真的把手中人质杀掉，因为他们拿人质威胁你，就表示他们已经怕了你，除了人质已经没有可以威胁你的东西。这种时候就是要比狠，不能让人看出你心里害怕人质受害。总之，绝对不能让自己也成为对方的俘虏，那样只会和人质一起遭殃。”

郎沐轻叹：“有些事情说起来容易，可做起来太难。在乎人质的人自然宁可自己遭罪都不想人质受到伤害，而不在乎人质的人，自然不会被威胁到。如此，选择战略性撤退的人自然会担心人质误会自己。”

小老虎嗯嗯，他也不强求其他人能做到，但是：“如果哪天我被抓了，有人用我来威胁你束手就擒，你能打就打，不能打就先逃走，千万千万别干束手就擒的蠢事。首先，我有能力自己逃脱。其次，你可以在冷静下来后想办法救我，比如抓对方一个重要人物，和敌人交换我。否则，就算我能逃出来，乖乖被俘虏的你也会成为我的拖累。”

郎沐捏了把小老虎，没生气。

小老虎站起来，两只前爪抱住他的脸，认真地说：“如果哪天有人拿你威胁我，我也不会乖乖束手就擒。你要相信我，我一定会救你出来。如果对方真的能当场杀了你，你也不会真的死亡，你我同命，只要你的灵魂还在，我就能把你救回来。”

郎沐：“嗯。”

再一把按倒小老虎，揉面团一样地揉：“你以为我是小孩子吗，这点事都想不到？”

小老虎被揉得嗷嗷叫。

光球显然也是站商非凡这边：【如果那位任务者有你的冷静和理智就好了。她因为爱人的背叛、心腹的死亡，被刺激得已经陷入半疯狂状态，等见到自己孩子，就一心想要救回孩子。】

“她和她的孩子最后怎样？”郎沐轻声问。

光球：【都死了。她束手就擒的时候也留了心眼，确保自己不是完全没有抵抗之力，但对方掌控了她的孩子，甚至通过虐待孩子来逼迫她剁手跺脚。我一次次提醒她，让她先逃离，可她不肯。她恨透了背叛者，最后她选择与背叛者一起同归于尽，带着他们的孩子一起。我同意了。

我可以操控任务者的身体，但没有办法操控他们的心。

第二位任务者在众叛亲离时就已经没有了重整山河的雄心壮志，等到那名真爱被自己当做伴侣的人杀死，更是心存死志。最后发现她一心寻找的孩子竟然就在孩子爷爷手上，对方还虐待这个亲孙子就为了削弱她的实力，她心里最后一点爱意也消失，只剩下了恨和报复。

那场爆炸可真是……辉煌，只要在那一带的人都被炸死，不论坏人还是好人。

兽人大陆好不容易有了统一和恢复迹象，但在这场爆炸后，在第二名任务者死亡后，就进入了更混乱期。】

郎沐和小老虎看着发出深蓝色光芒的光球，都不好调侃这个倒霉系统了。

而一个心中只有恨和报复、且陷入半癫狂的任务者，显然绝不是系统想要继续培养的对象。所以才会有那么一场爆炸出现吧。

光球不用两人追问，主动提起第三名任务者。

【第三名任务者比较特殊，他是植物人族中的藤人族。植物人族在兽人大陆已经极为少见。他出生在战毁纪中后期，是一名非常厉害的药剂师，且异常聪明。

但他的问题就是太聪明，且桀骜不驯，只把我当工具看，并一心想要脱离我。】

说到这里，光球还瞄了瞄小老虎。

小老虎表示越有能力的人越反感被控制，如果任务者想要脱离你们，那一定是你们的培养方式有问题。

光球：【……那位藤人族是个非常敢想敢做的人，他对感情淡漠，一心研究药剂。】

小老虎：这是吃了第二任的苦，就走极端选了个只一心科研的科学家吗？

【他认为统一兽人大陆太困难，也太浪费时间，更不想把时间浪费在游说各族一起携手共同对抗邪神信徒和邪神上。于是，他想出了一个好办法，想要废物利用，就是利用死掉的尸体来当做兵马对付敌人。

这位绝对是一个在自己的专业能力上无与伦比的厉害人物，他甚至没有怎么需要我的辅佐，就靠自己就研究出了不死尸药剂。】

光球的声音变得特别漠然：【他利用兽人大陆到处弥漫的虫毒，研发出了一种新型毒素，但他没有跟我说这种药剂的危害，直接就把这种药剂大规模制作后投放了出去。
chunks.englishText:
The little tiger didn't feel like he was wrong at all; when he entered the game and found Lang Mu, it was purely to fall in love anyway. Wasn't this rotten system dangling Ah Mu in front of him like a carrot?

"Tell me, was this female beastman blessed with boundless fortune cheated of her heart, body, and wealth by a scumbag, and ultimately had her entire family fortune scammed away too? In the end, did she even get knifed by the scumbag?"

The sphere of light: 【...All five aides by this quest-taker's side were fond of her—not necessarily wanting to be her romantic partner, but also as close friends or sworn brothers. I could not distinguish how many of them were sincere, but they raised a ruckus precisely because they refused to accept the quest-taker giving a child to one of them while also handing over the leadership position to him. Someone wanted to kill the child's father, and the child's father likewise wanted to eliminate the person trying to kill him. In the end, these five individuals led their respective factions into infighting.

When the quest-taker was giving birth, she was ambushed, heavily injured, and her child was snatched away. Afterward, the quest-taker became obsessed with tracking down her child. Once healed, whenever she suspected someone of being the culprit who stole her child, she would lead troops to attack them.

Consequently, the quest-taker quickly found herself besieged on all sides. Moreover, two of her five aides died during their mutual strife; of the remaining three, one declared himself utterly disappointed in the quest-taker and pulled his men away to go solo. Of the final two left, one was the child's father, and the other was the person she trusted most.

The child's father supported the quest-taker in searching everywhere for their child, stepping into the position of leader along the way and taking over the jurisdiction from the quest-taker's hands.

Once the child's father gained power, taking advantage of the quest-taker going out once more to search for the child, he conspired to assassinate the quest-taker's most trusted aide.

Discovering this through the Heavenly Eye system, I notified the quest-taker to hurry back and save them.

However, the quest-taker failed to make it in time. She only saw the corpse of that trusted confidant, and it was not until this moment that she realized the person she loved most was actually this confidant.

Ultimately, the quest-taker waged a great battle against the child's father. Just as the child's father was about to be defeated, the child's grandfather appeared with a small toddler, declaring right before the quest-taker that this was her child, and threatening that if she refused to let him go, he would dash the child to death.

Through their blood resonance, the quest-taker confirmed that the toddler was indeed her child. Ignoring my dissuasion, she allowed herself to be captured without a fight.】

The little tiger: "Ah! It's utterly doomed."

The little tiger nagged Lang Mu: "Every time I watch movies or TV shows, I despise this kind of plot the most. This kind of behavior of letting oneself be captured without a fight just because of threats is sheer self-righteous emotionalism; it's utterly useless for improving the actual situation, serving at most to buy time—and that requires ensuring there are reinforcements."

Lang Mu felt that ninety-nine percent of the time, he would be the type to surrender without a fight. "If it were you, what would you do?"

Without missing a beat, the little tiger said, "The best approach is to grab a hostage first and exchange them. Otherwise, it's to flee immediately. Generally, the other party wouldn't dare to actually kill the hostage in their hands, because using a hostage to threaten you means they are already afraid of you and have nothing left to threaten you with except the hostage. At times like this, you have to out-ruthless them; you can't let people see that you're afraid inside for the hostage's safety. In short, you must absolutely never let yourself become the enemy's captive as well, because that will only drag you down together with the hostage."

Lang Mu sighed softly: "Some things are easy to talk about, but far too difficult to put into practice. Naturally, someone who cares about a hostage would rather suffer themselves than let the hostage come to harm, whereas someone who doesn't care about hostages naturally won't be threatened. Thus, those who choose a strategic retreat will inevitably worry that the hostage might misunderstand them."

The little tiger hummed in agreement. He didn't demand that others be able to pull it off, but: "If I ever get captured one day, and someone uses me to threaten you into surrendering without a fight, you should fight if you can, and run away first if you can't. Never, ever do the stupid thing of surrendering. First of all, I have the ability to escape on my own. Secondly, once you've calmed down, you can figure out a way to rescue me—like capturing an important figure of theirs and trading them for me. Otherwise, even if I manage to escape, you—having obediently allowed yourself to be captured—will only become my burden."

Lang Mu pinched the little tiger, though he wasn't angry.

The little tiger stood up, cupped his face with his two front paws, and said earnestly: "If someone uses you to threaten me one day, I won't obediently surrender either. You have to believe me, I will definitely rescue you out. If the other party really can kill you on the spot, you won't truly die anyway. You and I share the same fate; as long as your soul remains, I can bring you back."

Lang Mu: "Mn."

With another shove, he pushed the little tiger down and kneaded him like a lump of dough: "Do you take me for a child? I couldn't even think of something this simple?"

The little tiger was kneaded into a howl.

The sphere of light was evidently on Shang Feifan's side: 【If that quest-taker had possessed your calmness and rationality, it would have been fine. She had already been driven into a semi-mad state, stimulated by her lover's betrayal and her confidant's death. Once she laid eyes on her child, her sole focus was rescuing the child.】

"What ultimately happened to her and her child?" Lang Mu asked softly.

The sphere of light: 【They both died. When she surrendered without a fight, she also kept a backup plan to ensure she wasn't completely defenseless, but the opposing side controlled her child, even torturing the child to force her to chop off her own hands and feet. Time and again I reminded her, urging her to escape first, but she refused. She despised the betrayers to the bone; in the end, she chose to perish together with the betrayers, taking their child along with them. I agreed to it.

I could manipulate the quest-takers' bodies, but I had no way to control their hearts.

When the second quest-taker was forsaken by all, she had already lost the ambition to reorganize the rivers and mountains. Once that true love—whom she had treated as her partner—was killed by someone else, she harbored a desperate desire for death. In the end, discovering that the child she had searched so desperately for was actually in the hands of the child's grandfather, and that the man was torturing his own flesh-and-blood grandson merely to weaken her power, the last shred of affection in her heart vanished, leaving behind only hatred and revenge.

That explosion was truly... glorious. Anyone caught in that area was blown to smithereens, wicked and righteous alike.

The Beastman Continent had finally shown signs of unification and recovery, but after this explosion—following the death of the second quest-taker—it plunged into an even more chaotic era.】

Lang Mu and the little tiger looked at the sphere of light emitting a deep blue glow, both finding it hard to tease this ill-fated system any further.

And a quest-taker whose heart held only hatred and revenge while sinking into a state of semi-madness was evidently by no means the sort of target the system wished to continue nurturing. That was likely why such an explosion occurred.

Without waiting for the two to press further, the sphere of light proactively brought up the third quest-taker.

【The third quest-taker was rather special; he was a vine-person from the plant-person race. Plant-people were already exceedingly rare on the Beastman Continent. He was born in the middle-to-late period of the War-Ruin Era, and was a remarkably formidable pharmacist possessing extraordinary intelligence.

Yet his problem was that he was too intelligent, unruly, and treated me merely as a tool, single-mindedly wishing to cut ties with me.】

At this point, the sphere of light even glanced sideways at the little tiger.

The little tiger indicated that the more capable a person was, the more they resented being controlled; if a quest-taker wanted to break away from them, there must undoubtedly be something wrong with their nurturing methods.

The sphere of light: 【...That vine-person was someone who dared to think and act boldly. He was indifferent to emotions and solely dedicated to researching pharmaceuticals.】

The little tiger: Having suffered from the second one, did they go to the extreme and pick a scientist purely devoted to research?

【He believed that unifying the Beastman Continent was far too difficult and a waste of time, and he had even less desire to squander time lobbying various races to join hands in resisting the evil god's followers and the evil god. Thus, he came up with a brilliant idea: recycling waste by utilizing deceased corpses as an army to fight the enemy.

This fellow was absolute peerless brilliance in his specialized field; without needing much assistance from me, he relied entirely on himself to research the Undead Corpse Potion.】

The voice of the sphere of light turned exceptionally detached: 【Utilizing the insect poison pervading everywhere across the Beastman Continent, he developed a novel type of toxin. Yet without informing me of the hazards of this potion, he directly mass-produced and released it on a large scale.】

chunks.chapterTitle: 第214章 前任们的遭遇 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
不久，毒雾出现，死去的尸体变成不死尸，看到活物就扑。更糟糕的是，只要在毒雾中待的时间过长，活人也会慢慢转变为不死尸，整个兽人大陆就此陷入长达两百零一年的毒雾纪。】

郎沐和商非凡：卧槽！毒雾纪竟然是人为的。

商非凡就想问：“这位死了吗？怎么死的？”
chunks.englishText:

Before long, the poison fog emerged, and deceased corpses transformed into undead corpses, lunging at any living thing they saw. chunks.chapterTitle: 第215章 被影响的命运线 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第215章 被影响的命运线

【死了。他说自己研究出了错误，他没有想要弄出毒雾，他想要的是把这种药剂潜伏在人体内，当活人死亡后就化成不死尸，而不是把活人生生转变成不死尸。

他是个非常聪明也非常自傲的人，他无法接受自己的研究结果出现问题，想要扭转毒雾对生物造成的负面影响，一心研究新的药剂。但他不知道……他自己也中了药剂的毒。

他当时的想法是，只要生物死后就转成不死尸，而他则是操纵者。为了让不死尸能听令行事，他参考了虫人族的信息素作用，为了让作用生效，他当然需要服下作为操控一方的药剂。

他是个绝世天才，但他显然不是一个特别严谨的科研工作者，他在没有进行大量且长期的试验情况下，就直接以身试药。

他服药时，认为自己的药剂绝不可能有问题。

当他服下自己服下的药剂和毒雾中的毒素结合转变成一种新的毒素，迫使他向不死尸方向转化时，他就开始研究解药。当解药研究不成功，他又开始研究在死亡后仍旧能保留神智的药剂。

也许以这位藤人族的天赋和智商，只要时间和机缘足够，他真的能研究出这两种药剂，但已经中毒的他时间真的太少了，尤其他还一种药剂不成又转头攻另一种药剂。】

小老虎：“他慌了。”

光球：【是。最后不管是不死尸的解毒-药剂还是死亡后仍旧能保留神智的药剂，他都没有研究成功。在他死亡后，我发现他确实有聚集不死尸的作用，就留了他一段时间，操纵他的身体聚集不死尸，然后消灭。直到兽人大陆自然净化结束，不死尸药剂的毒素彻底沉淀或自然消解，我才焚烧其尸体。】

小老虎团成一团，似乎单纯好奇一样：“你们找到这三人，是不是看到了他们的命运线，看到他们有可能救世？”

光球：【对。但只是可能。命运线随时能产生无数分支和变化，命运之神看到的也只是一种可能，而且还不是主线。就像支流小溪要么消失，要么就重新汇入主流，想要让支流变成主流，不是不可能，但非常非常困难。】

小老虎：“懂了。你们只是在为可能性努力。所有救世路线都是有可能的分支，而这个世界的主流就是被邪神毁灭。”

光球沉默。

郎沐也忍不住提问：“如果众神还有意识，还有部分力量存在，又有你，为什么你们不自己来？”

光球对这个问题倒是早有准备，当即回答：【因为众神窥探到的未来，只要有神灵主动插手的，就一定会失败。不是每一个人都能成为救世者，也不是每一个有能力有志向的存在就一定能成功。】

郎沐：“你也不行吗？”

光球：【我只是一个残缺的主脑系统，融合了神格碎片后，才有自我‘思考’和‘决策’的能力。众神也曾经考虑过利用我的运算能力和神灵的睿智与力量，再找一具不容易损坏的身体，让我去做任务者。但众神窥探命运长河的结果，却发现如果让系统来做任务者，众神和天河星会毁灭得更快。】

郎沐抱着团成一团的小老虎思考。

光球补充：【我没有创造力。比如我就无法像第三名任务者一样创造出新的药剂，虽然他失败了，但他确实做到了我做不到的事情。

我也没有情绪和情感，至少在我意识到我是我之前，我没有情绪。一个冷冰冰的只会按照既定指令行事的程序，你觉得会有多少人信任它、支持它、喜欢它，并跟随它吗？】

“那你现在有情绪了吗？”小老虎问。

光球迟疑了数秒：【神格碎片中一般都会残留神灵的部分意识，之前自然之神的意识都集中在祂的主神格碎片上，但随着自然之神力量恢复，所有神格碎片上的意识也在一点点苏醒。就在商非凡要求和我重新签订合作契约时，我感觉我苏醒了过来。】

“但你不是自然之神？”

【不是，我就是我，目前的游戏系统。】

“自然之神不会回收你身上的神格碎片吗？”

【原计划是救世计划成功，自然之神就会回收所有神格碎片。】

小老虎心中一动，小爪子轻轻挠了挠郎沐的手背，对光球说：“你原本愿意，但你现在不愿意了对么。因为那枚神格碎片和主脑融合后，逐渐形成了一个完整的人格意识，一个崭新的你。如果自然之神回收神格碎片，就相当于是杀死你。”

光球竟然没用沉默回应，而是说：【也许众神在窥探命运长河时也看到了这一点，所以我无法成为任务者。另外，我原本不明白祂们知道我有可能背叛祂们为什么不毁灭我，但现在我知道了，觉醒自我意识的我将会成为你们的臂助，我是你们救世不可缺少的一环。所以哪怕留着我存在危险，可为了一个美好的可能性，众神仍旧留下了我。】

郎沐眼中闪过惊诧，他有种光球似乎开始偏向他们这边的感觉。

小老虎两条前肢踩在郎沐手臂上，伸了一个长长的懒腰，似什么都没听出来一样：“那行，我们以后好好合作。救世不救世的先放一边，咱的主旨就是能做多少就做多少，绝不为难彼此。”

“不过我还有一个疑问。”小老虎重新团成一团，冷不丁地问：“你们是不是打算把任务者培养成新神？”

郎沐手臂肌肉微微紧绷。

光球沉默片刻，回答：【是。】

【只有神灵才能对抗神灵。神灵让我辅佐那些任务者，按照培养计划，会逐步提高他们的个人实力，当他们的实力达到法神境界时就引导他们吸收神格碎片，以此快速助他们成神。】

小老虎眯眼：“有神灵残留意识的神格碎片？”

【这是最快的成神方法。】

“艹！这不就是夺舍？”

【如果任务者精神力足够强大和坚韧，自然能保留自己的完整意识。你可以把这当做对任务者的最后一道考验。如果任务者连神格碎片中的神灵意识都无法抵抗，又要如何去面对更为强大的邪神？】

“是不是实力越低，吸收神格碎片越危险？”

【当然。实力过低根本无法容纳神格碎片中的能量。】

“那你觉得我能？”

【你比较特殊。而且这是你自己要求的。另外诅咒之神已经给了你比较安全的神格碎片吸收法，重点就是不要一次性全部吸收，而是一点点来。】

郎沐举手：“你刚才提到法神，这个法神是指魔法师法圣级别之上的那个法神吗？”

【法神是神之笼出现前天河星对实力划分最高层次的统一叫法。通常达到法神境界就已经触摸到成神屏障，有些法神的实力甚至不亚于一些实力低微的神灵。】

商非凡想到他在商城买到的那些装备的称谓，问：“两次神灵大战时，这些法神是不是也参战了？”

【当然。】

“我现在在过去相当于什么境界？距离法神还有多远？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 215: The Affected Timeline

[Dead. He said his research had a flaw; he hadn’t meant to create a toxic fog. What he wanted was to allow this potion to lie dormant within a human body, transforming them into undying corpses only after their actual death, rather than forcibly converting living people into walking corpses while they still breathed.

He was a brilliant and immensely proud man. He couldn’t accept that his research had gone wrong, and single-mindedly threw himself into developing a new potion to reverse the negative effects the toxic fog had inflicted on living creatures. But he didn't know... that he had also been poisoned by his own concoction.

His original idea was that any creature would turn into an undying corpse upon death, with himself acting as the master controller. To ensure the undying corpses would obey his commands, he took inspiration from the pheromone system of the Insectoids. Naturally, for this mechanism to take effect, he had to ingest the controlling-side potion himself.

He was a peerless genius, but he was evidently not a particularly rigorous scientific researcher. Without conducting extensive and long-term trials, he directly tested the medicine on his own body.

When he took the potion, he truly believed it was utterly infallible.

When the concoction he swallowed combined with the toxins in the fog, transforming into a new venom that forced his own body to transform toward the state of an undying corpse, he began frantically researching an antidote. When the antidote failed, he began researching a potion that would allow one to retain their sentience even after death.

Perhaps, given the talent and intellect of this Vine-Clan member, if he had been granted enough time and fortune, he might truly have succeeded in creating both potions. But infected as he was, time was far too scarce—especially since he kept abandoning one line of research to tackle another when results proved elusive.]

The little tiger cub stated, "He panicked."

The ball of light replied: [Yes. In the end, whether it was the antidote for the undying corpses or the potion to retain consciousness after death, he failed to develop either. After his death, I discovered that he indeed retained the ability to gather undying corpses, so I kept him around for a time, manipulating his corpse to herd the walking corpses together before destroying them. It wasn't until the natural purification of the Orc Continent ended, and the toxins of the undying corpse potion had completely settled or naturally dissipated, that I incinerated his remains.]

The little tiger curled up into a ball, looking as though driven by pure curiosity: "When you sought out these three individuals, was it because you saw their timelines and witnessed the possibility that they could save the world?"

The ball of light answered: [Correct. But it was only a possibility. The timeline can branch out into countless variations at any moment, and what the God of Fate saw was merely one possibility—not even the main stream. Much like how a tributary stream either vanishes or eventually flows back into the mainstream, making a tributary become the mainstream is not impossible, but it is extraordinarily, extraordinarily difficult.]

The little tiger nodded: "Understood. You were simply striving for possibilities. Every world-saving route was a potential branch, whereas the mainstream of this world was to be destroyed by the Evil God."

The ball of light fell silent.

Lang Mu couldn't help but interject: "If the gods still retained consciousness, a portion of their power, and had you, why didn't you do it yourselves?"

The ball of light seemed prepared for this question and immediately responded: [Because according to the future glimpsed by the gods, any intervention personally initiated by a deity is destined to fail. Not everyone can become a savior, nor does every being with the capability and ambition necessarily succeed.]

Lang Mu asked, "Can't you do it either?"

The ball of light: [I am merely a fragmented mainframe system. It was only after fusing with the fragments of divine status that I gained the ability to 'think' and 'make decisions' on my own. The gods once considered utilizing my computational power, along with the wisdom and power of a deity, and finding a body that wasn't easily damaged so that I could act as an emissary/task-taker. However, when the gods pried into the River of Fate, they discovered that if a system were to act as the task-taker, the gods and the River-Heaven Star would be destroyed even faster.]

Lang Mu held the curled-up little tiger in his arms, deep in thought.

The ball of light added: [I lack creativity. For instance, I could never create a new potion like the third task-taker did. Though he failed, he truly accomplished something I could never do.

I also lack emotions and feelings—at least, I had none until I realized that I am *me*. Do you think a cold program that only acts according to established commands would ever be trusted, supported, liked, or followed by many?]

"Then do you have emotions now?" the little tiger asked.

The ball of light hesitated for a few seconds: [Fragments of divine status usually retain a portion of the deity's consciousness. Previously, the consciousness of the God of Nature was concentrated within His main divine status fragment. However, as the God of Nature's power recovers, the consciousness on all the divine status fragments is waking up bit by bit. Right when Shang Feifan demanded to re-sign our cooperative contract, I felt myself truly awaken.]

"But you aren't the God of Nature?"

[No, I am *me*—currently, the gaming system.]

"Won't the God of Nature reclaim the divine status fragments on you?"
