[The original plan was that once the world-saving project succeeded, the God of Nature would take back all the divine status fragments.]

A stir arose in the little tiger's heart. Its small paw gently scratched the back of Lang Mu's hand as it said to the ball of light: "You were originally willing, but you aren't willing anymore, right? Because once that divine status fragment fused with the mainframe, it gradually formed a complete personality and consciousness—a brand-new you. If the God of Nature reclaims the divine status fragment, it would be tantamount to killing you."

Surprisingly, the ball of light did not respond with silence this time. Instead, it said: [Perhaps the gods saw this as well when they peered into the River of Fate, which is why I could never become a task-taker. Furthermore, I originally didn't understand why they didn't destroy me when they knew I might betray them, but now I understand. Having awakened my own self-awareness, I will become your arm and shield; I am an indispensable link in your quest to save the world. Therefore, even though keeping me poses a risk, for the sake of a beautiful possibility, the gods still allowed me to remain.]

A flash of astonishment crossed Lang Mu's eyes; he had the distinct feeling that the ball of light was beginning to lean toward their side.

The little tiger placed its two front paws on Lang Mu's arm, stretched out in a long, lazy yawn, and spoke as if it had heard nothing out of the ordinary: "Well then, let's cooperate nicely from now on. Saving the world or whatever can take a backseat for a moment; our core motto is to do as much as we can, and never make things difficult for each other."

"Though, I still have one question." The little tiger curled back into a ball and asked out of nowhere: "Are you people planning to cultivate the task-takers into new gods?"

Lang Mu's arm muscles tightened slightly.

The ball of light paused for a moment before answering: [Yes.]

[Only a deity can combat a deity. The gods instructed me to assist those task-takers. According to the cultivation plan, their personal strength will be progressively elevated. Once their strength reaches the realm of a Mage God, I am to guide them in absorbing the divine status fragments, thereby rapidly assisting them in ascending to godhood.]

The little tiger narrowed its eyes: "Divine status fragments that still retain the residual consciousness of deities?"

[This is the fastest method to achieve godhood.]

"Damn it! Isn't this just soul possession (duo she)?"

[If a task-taker's mental power is sufficiently strong and resilient, they can naturally preserve their complete consciousness. You can view this as the final test for the task-taker. If a task-taker cannot even resist the divine consciousness within the divine status fragment, how can they hope to face the far more formidable Evil God?]

"Does that mean the lower the strength, the more dangerous it is to absorb a divine status fragment?"

[Of course. Excessively low strength makes it utterly impossible to contain the energy within a divine status fragment.]

"Then do you think *I* can do it?"

[You are rather special. Besides, this was something you requested yourself. Furthermore, the God of Curses has already provided you with a relatively safe method of absorbing divine status fragments—the key is not to absorb them all at once, but rather bit by bit.]

Lang Mu raised a hand: "You mentioned the 'Mage God' just now. Is this Mage God the realm of power that exists above the Great Mage level?"

[Mage God was the unified designation for the highest tier of power division on the River-Heaven Star before the Cage of Gods appeared. Generally, those who reach the realm of a Mage God have already touched the barrier of godhood, and the strength of some Mage Gods is no less than that of certain low-power deities.]

Thinking of the titles of the equipment he had purchased in the system shop, Shang Feifan asked, "During the two great divine wars, did these Mage Gods participate?"

[Naturally.]

"Roughly what realm am I at in the past context? How far am I from a Mage God?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第215章 被影响的命运线 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
【每个智慧种族都有自己的实力等级称谓，之后有强者统一了全大陆的境界，分为九个等级。按照你的主天赋技能等级，你现在是五级。九级就是法神境界，突破九级就意味有成神的可能。但很多法神都死在突破的过程中。】

“雷劫？”

【……天河星没有雷劫，法神突破失败的原因多种多样，那时的强者戏称此为渡神劫。】

“那也差不多。”

光球还特意说明：【天残谷主那边的玩家系统，玩家达到满级也只有五级。换算一下，大约是二十级为一级。】

郎沐换算了下：“那我现在相当于七级初？”

【对。】

小老虎挑眉，没想到他竟然比阿沐低两个等级。看来他得更努力一下下了。虽说软饭吃起来喷香，但自己也得准备几道大菜不是。

“还有一件事。第三个任务者，就是那个藤人族，他最后的研究资料在哪里？不死尸和毒雾的解药还有人在研究吗？”

【有。自然之神在研究。原本这份药剂师传承应该通过任务奖励的方式传给你，但你显然对炼金和诅咒更有兴趣。】光球提到这点就觉得可惜。

【另外，在那名藤人族死亡前，他曾在三个地点留下自己的部分传承。安妮塔得到的一份药剂师传承就来自于这位任务者。】

商非凡和郎沐惊讶，两人都没想到这时还能听到安妮塔的名字。

“安妮塔……”郎沐神色复杂：“她如果没有把全部心力用在报复上，说不定她也能成为一名优秀的任务者。”

光球竟然没否认，并道：【在命运长河的这段时间线中，安妮塔也是一个关键人物，她原本应该成为命运之子的辅佐者。但命运线被打乱，一切都变了。】

郎沐感觉光球像是在看自己，就用眼神回了个问号。

光球飞到郎沐面前，蹭了蹭他的脸颊。

郎沐吃惊，手下意识去碰触光球。

但他的手指却穿过光球。

光球并没有实体。

光球停在了郎沐曲起的膝盖上。

小老虎眯眼看光球，想扑。

光球无视小老虎，只专注地看郎沐。它喜欢郎沐，有时候它会很可惜郎沐为什么不是那个命运之子。

说错，郎沐也算是命运之子。

【三个任务者全都失败。众神再次窥探命运长河，这次窥探，祂们付出了不小的代价。甚至让命运之神彻底陷入沉睡。】

“哦？这次的窥探与我和郎沐有关？”

光球承认：【在天河星几条主未来发展可能线中，其中一条，得到自然之神神格碎片，从地星魂穿而来的郎沐就是命运之子。】

商非凡毫不意外，只看郎沐的气运值就知道他一定不会是普通角色。

郎沐失笑：“我是命运之子？”

光球严肃：【是的，你就是。】

【你会发现自然之神雕像碎片，就是天残谷主得到的那几个碎片。并发现兽人大陆繁华纪的最高科学结晶，也就是已经融合神格碎片后的主脑我。最后结合两者，搞出游戏系统和出生池。同时还会发现收藏了全套兽人文明传承的地下图书馆。

之后你会从地星召唤来大量玩家，激活玩家的血脉天赋，利用传承培养他们，从而帮助天河星抵抗邪神、对付天灾，最终让天河星脱离困境，迎来崭新的光明未来。

这几乎是众神窥探到的最清晰、结局最美好、可能性也最高的一条线。】

小老虎坐起，尾巴卷住郎沐的手臂：“但事实上并不是如此。”

光球也很气，发出了微微红光：【因为这条命运线被人窥探并影响了。郎沐并没有如几位神灵所愿魂穿到兽人大陆，反而穿到了魔法师所在的法德尔大陆，更被洛伦米尔顿掠夺了几乎全部气运。

洛伦米尔顿因此成为天河星伪命运之子，他会成功随同其他魔法师穿过神之笼的空间屏障，落到兽人大陆，得到郎沐应该得到的机缘。

且洛伦米尔顿因为对郎沐暗中使用真言术和梦境记忆魔法，知道了地星存在。

虽然洛伦米尔顿并不能前往地星，可他也因此拿到了郎沐另一个机缘——郎沐从地星魂穿而来，留下了一条隐约的空间通道。

这条空间通道原本是命运给真命运之子准备的便利，方便他从地星那边招兵买马来帮助天河星。

玩家不死且喜欢做任务的特性，会让他们无惧邪神和其他任何存在，也会成为命运之子的最大臂助。

而且以郎沐的性子，他不会白白利用玩家，他会通过游戏给玩家在地星的实际身体也带来一定好处，这会让玩家更加黏这个游戏、更愿意为这个游戏付出。

他更会不惜余力地提升玩家实力，并引导和控制好玩家不让他们做非法无良的事情。

只可惜这个便利却被伪命运之子洛伦米尔顿利用，他先利用梦境法术联系上几个地球人，从中找出能利用的存在，再对其深度催眠，让其为自己所用。

再利用那条隐秘的空间通道，以及一个半神级的单向传送阵，制作游戏头盔发给地星那边。

可洛伦米尔顿自私又卑鄙，他就不可能好好培养玩家，更不可能把玩家能力提升到和他差不多的程度，更更不可能给玩家的实际身体带来好处。

他只是想把玩家当做他争权夺利并走向成神之路的工具。

最后没有被好好引导的玩家反而会被邪神吸引，成为邪神吞噬这个世界的最有利武器。

甚至邪神也因此顺藤摸瓜找到了前往地星的空间通道，等祂吞噬并消化了天河星后，祂就会去往地星。】

郎沐脸色苍白。

小老虎拍拍他，“不关你的事。”

随即问光球：“郎沐的命运线被谁窥探？洛伦米尔顿？”

光球：【就是他。他原本已经达到法圣境界，只差一点就能突破到法神，但他的生命已经走到末尾，他已经没有时间也没有实力去成为法神。于是他就以最后的生命力加上大量活祭品为代价，施展黑暗魔法，想要知道自己成为法神的可能性在哪。】

小老虎：“然后他就窥探到了郎沐？”

【是。郎沐是命运之子，他别说成为法神，就是成为真正的神灵也不是梦。洛伦米尔顿那次施法就是想要知道如何能成为法神，他求的是一个可能性。然后他就在几个可能性中选择了最高的一个，就是掠夺郎沐的气运。】

小老虎恨极了，但他脸上完全没有表现出来。

光球也特别生气，它多想自己辅佐的任务者是郎沐啊。

如果是郎沐，它一定会和郎沐相处得极为愉快。

可就因为被人插了一脚，导致天河星的命运之子差点陨落，也导致它不得不和商非凡合作，郁！

【就因为这次的命运窥探十分复杂，支流又产生支流，命运之神为了窥探到真正有可能救世的命运线才会力竭沉睡。】

商非凡：“祂看到了我？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 215: The Affected Timeline (Part 2)

[Every intelligent race has its own titles for strength tiers, but later, powerhouses unified the realms of the entire continent, dividing them into nine levels. Based on your primary talent skill level, you are currently at level five. Level nine is the realm of the Mage God, and breaking through level nine signifies the possibility of ascending to godhood. However, many Mage Gods perished during the breakthrough process.]

"Divine tribulation?"

[...The River-Heaven Star has no divine tribulations. The reasons for failure in breaking through to the Mage God realm are varied; the powerhouses of that era jokingly referred to it as undergoing a divine tribulation.]

"Same difference, then."

The ball of light specifically clarified: [As for the player system on the side of the Heaven-Remnant Valley Master, even when players reach max level, they are only at level five. Converted equivalently, roughly twenty levels of theirs equal one of yours.]

Lang Mu did a quick mental conversion: "Then I am currently equivalent to early level seven?"

[Correct.]

The little tiger raised an eyebrow. He hadn't expected to be two levels lower than Ah Mu. It seemed he would have to work a bit harder. Even though living off a partner's accomplishments felt wonderfully satisfying, he needed to prepare a few substantial dishes of his own, didn't he?

"There is one more matter. The third task-taker—that Vine-Clan member—where is his final research data? Is anyone still researching the antidote for the undying corpses and the toxic fog?"

[Yes. The God of Nature is researching it. Originally, this apothecary heritage was supposed to be transmitted to you as a task reward, but you clearly show more interest in alchemy and curses.] The ball of light felt a sense of pity whenever it brought this up.

[Furthermore, prior to the death of that Vine-Clan member, he left behind portions of his heritage in three separate locations. The apothecary heritage that Anita acquired came from this very task-taker.]

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were both surprised; neither of them expected to hear Anita's name at this juncture.

"Anita..." Lang Mu's expression grew complex. "If she hadn't poured her entire heart and soul into revenge, she might have become an exceptional task-taker as well."

Surprisingly, the ball of light did not deny this, stating instead: [In this timeline of the River-Heaven Star, Anita was also a crucial figure. She was originally supposed to become the assistant to the Child of Fate. But the timeline was disrupted, and everything changed.]

Lang Mu felt as though the ball of light was looking right at him, so he responded with a questioning look in his eyes.

The ball of light flew up to Lang Mu and rubbed against his cheek.

Lang Mu was startled, his hand instinctively moving to touch the orb.

However, his fingers passed right through the light.

The ball of light had no physical form.

It finally came to rest on Lang Mu's bent knee.

The little tiger narrowed its eyes at the ball of light, itching to pounce.

The ball of light ignored the little tiger, focusing solely on Lang Mu. It liked Lang Mu; at times, it deeply regretted why Lang Mu wasn't that Child of Fate.

Correction—Lang Mu *was* considered a Child of Fate, after all.

[All three task-takers failed. The gods peered into the River-Heaven Star's River of Fate once more. For this observation, they paid a not-insignificant price, even causing the God of Fate to plunge into a complete slumber.]

"Oh? Was this observation related to me and Lang Mu?"

The ball of light admitted: [Among the several primary probable lines of future development for the River-Heaven Star, in one of them, Lang Mu—who obtained the God of Nature's divine status fragment and transmigrated across souls from Earth—was the Child of Fate.]

Shang Feifan was entirely unsurprised; just by looking at Lang Mu's fortune value, he knew the man could never be an ordinary character.

Lang Mu laughed in spite of himself: "I am the Child of Fate?"

The ball of light stated solemnly: [Yes, you are.]

[You would have discovered a fragment of the God of Nature's statue—specifically those fragments acquired by the Heaven-Remnant Valley Master. You would have also discovered the highest scientific crystallization of the Orc Continent's prosperous era, which is myself—the mainframe that has already fused with the divine status fragments. Finally, by combining the two, you would have created the gaming system and the birth pool. At the same time, you would have uncovered the underground library housing the complete collection of orc civilization heritage.

Following that, you would have summoned a massive number of players from Earth, activated their bloodline talents, nurtured them using the heritage, and thereby helped the River-Heaven Star resist the Evil God and deal with natural disasters, ultimately allowing the River-Heaven Star to break free from its plight and usher in a brilliant, luminous new future.

This was virtually the clearest, happiest-ending, and highest-probability timeline the gods ever glimpsed.]

The little tiger sat up, its tail wrapping securely around Lang Mu's arm: "But in reality, that's not how it turned out."

The ball of light was also furious, emitting a faint red glow: [Because this timeline was pried into and interfered with by someone else. Lang Mu did not soul-transmigrate to the Orc Continent as the deities wished; instead, he transmigrated to the Fader Continent where mages reside, and moreover, Lawrence Milton plundered nearly all of his fortune.

Consequently, Lawrence Milton became a false Child of Fate of the River-Heaven Star. He would successfully pass through the spatial barrier of the Cage of Gods alongside other mages, land on the Orc Continent, and seize the opportunities that rightfully belonged to Lang Mu.

Furthermore, because Lawrence Milton covertly used True Speech and dream memory magic on Lang Mu, he learned of Earth's existence.

Although Lawrence Milton could not travel to Earth himself, he thereby acquired Lang Mu's other opportunity—the faint spatial passage left behind when Lang Mu soul-transmigrated from Earth.

This spatial passage was originally a convenience prepared by fate for the true Child of Fate, making it easy for him to recruit troops and buy horses from Earth to help the River-Heaven Star.

The characteristics of players—that they do not truly die and love completing quests—would make them fearless in the face of the Evil God and any other existence, and they would become the greatest arm and shield for the Child of Fate.

Moreover, given Lang Mu's temperament, he wouldn't simply exploit the players for nothing; through the game, he would also provide tangible benefits to the players' actual bodies back on Earth. This would make the players even more attached to the game and more willing to dedicate themselves to it.

He would spare no effort to raise the players' strength, while guiding and controlling them properly to prevent them from engaging in illegal or unscrupulous deeds.

It is simply a pity that this convenience was exploited by the false Child of Fate, Lawrence Milton. He first used dream magic to contact a few Earthlings, picked out exploitable individuals from among them, and subjected them to deep hypnosis so they would serve his ends.

Then, utilizing that covert spatial passage along with a demigod-tier one-way teleportation array, he manufactured game helmets and sent them to Earth.

Yet Lawrence Milton was selfish and despicable; he could never properly nurture players, let alone raise their abilities to a level close to his own, and *certainly* could not provide benefits to the players' physical bodies.

He merely intended to treat players as tools for seizing power and treading the path to godhood.

In the end, players who were not properly guided would instead be drawn to the Evil God, becoming the most advantageous weapon for the Evil God to devour this world.

Even the Evil God would thus follow the vine to find the spatial passage leading to Earth; once it devoured and digested the River-Heaven Star, it would head straight for Earth.]

Lang Mu's face turned pale.

The little tiger patted him gently, saying, "It has nothing to do with you."

It then asked the ball of light: "Who pried into Lang Mu's timeline? Lawrence Milton?"

The ball of light: [It was him. He had originally reached the Great Mage realm, needing only a sliver more to break through to the Mage God, but his lifespan had reached its end. He no longer had the time nor the strength to become a Mage God. Therefore, at the cost of his remaining vitality and a massive number of living sacrifices, he cast dark magic, wishing to know where the possibility of his becoming a Mage God lay.]

The little tiger asked: "And then he glimpsed Lang Mu?"

[Yes. Lang Mu is the Child of Fate; for him, let alone becoming a Mage God, becoming a true deity is not a pipe dream. Lawrence Milton's casting that time was intended to figure out how to become a Mage God; he was pleading for a possibility. He then chose the highest among several possibilities—which was to plunder Lang Mu's fortune.]

The little tiger felt extreme hatred, though not a trace of it showed on his face.

The ball of light was similarly furious. How it wished the task-taker it assisted had been Lang Mu!

If it were Lang Mu, it would surely have gotten along exceptionally well with him.

Yet because someone had shoved their foot into the mix, the Child of Fate of the River-Heaven Star had almost perished, and it had been forced into a partnership with Shang Feifan. Utterly frustrating!

[Because this prying into fate was extremely complex, with tributaries spawning further tributaries, the God of Fate exerted themselves to the point of exhaustion and fell into a slumber simply to glimpse a timeline that truly held the possibility of saving the world.]

Shang Feifan asked: "Did He see me?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第215章 被影响的命运线 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
【是。】光球又看向郎沐：【被人掠夺了气运的你，之后的命运非常坎坷，如果没有遇到商非凡，你的气运就基本不可能恢复。而不能恢复气运的你就会成为那个伪预言的牺牲者，如前两世一样不得善终，甚至牺牲都不会被人感念，死后都没有什么好名声留下。同样，天河星也会跟着完蛋。】

郎沐神色平静，只脸色微微苍白。

小老虎深吸气，钻进衣服里就变回成年雄性兽人模样，转过身就坐到郎沐身后，把人搂入怀中。

郎沐紧绷的肌肉一点点放松。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 215: The Affected Timeline (Part 3)

[Yes.] The ball of light looked toward Lang Mu again: [Your subsequent fate, after having your fortune plundered, was exceptionally rugged. Had you not crossed paths with Shang Feifan, it would have been fundamentally impossible for your fortune to recover. And without recovered fortune, you would have become the sacrificial lamb to that false prophecy, meeting a grim end just like in your first two lives. Not even your sacrifice would have been remembered with gratitude, and you would have left behind no good reputation after death. Similarly, the River-Heaven Star would have gone down to ruin along with you.]

Lang Mu's expression remained calm, save for a slight pallor on his face.

The little tiger took a deep breath, burrowed back into the clothing to transform back into his adult male orc form, turned around to sit right behind Lang Mu, and pulled him tightly into his embrace.

Lang Mu's tense muscles relaxed bit by bit.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第216章 另一条命运线 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第216章 另一条命运线

“在郎沐成为命运之子的那条命运线里，我出现了吗？”商非凡耐不住问。

光球似乎不太想回答这个问题，但还是回答了：【你会出现，而且会成为郎沐的最大臂助。】

“也是情人对吗？”

光球拒绝回答这个问题。

商非凡抱着他的大宝贝满意地笑了。

郎沐拍拍他的腿，这时他已经平复许多，问光球：“你说在我原先的命运线中，安妮塔会成为我的臂助之一？难道那条命运线里，她没有为复仇而疯狂？也没有和虎王搞出换子的缺德事？我能作为郎飞的孩子出生长大？”

光球可以不回答这么多题外的问题，但它愿意为郎沐解谜，还说得很详细。主要也因为这条命运线已经被改变，说出来也不会有任何影响。

【因为你是直接魂穿到兽人大陆，还是在胎儿时期，你的气运也连带影响了你的亲人，而且你在胎儿时期就能感知外界甚至能感知到危险。

郎飞因为你在她肚子里闹腾，疼得无法为虎王冲锋，避开了必死的重伤局面。

你的父亲也因为担心即将生产的妻子，神志不安而受伤，被虎王斥责并赶到后方陪伴妻子，同样避开了为保护妻子而战死的必死局。

代之虎王重伤，但虎王发威，也打退了敌人。

同一时间，你在战场出生。】

郎沐激动又痛苦，如果他的命运没有被改变，他的父母就都不会死，两位老人不会失去女儿和女婿，他也可以在郎飞和泽沐尔身边好好长大。

商非凡拥住他，在他耳边小声说：“我们会去讨回这一切。”

郎沐失神：“那也迟了，人都已经没了。”

“那也要报仇！”商非凡固执地说：“越是如此，越不能放过那个祸害这一切的杂碎！”

郎沐咬紧嘴唇。

光球看出郎沐的难过，但它还没有学会如何劝慰人，只能继续述说：【安妮塔仍旧勾搭上虎王，意图报复王后。她也同样生育了雷米尔。但这次虎王没有找到合适人选，就没有搞出换子的事情。

但当时王后已经怀疑安妮塔怀孕有了孩子，就想要找出这个私生子除掉。虎王愁如何才能更好地保护这个私生子，又不会进一步得罪王后。

你的父母是虎王的侍卫，他们感念虎王当时在战场上竭力保护他们，让他们安全生下孩子的事，就主动向虎王提议，他们可以再养一个孩子。正好雷米尔也就只比你小两个月。

虎王大喜。郎飞本身就是他的心腹，且也是王室血脉，这简直就是他孩子最好的养父母。当即他就把雷米尔秘密送给郎飞抚养。

正好那时郎飞他们刚从战场上下来，只有少数人知道他们生了孩子，但也不清楚他们到底生了几个孩子。郎飞和泽沐尔就对外宣称他们生了一对双胞胎。】

郎沐：“……”

这种发展意外也不意外，只能说雷米尔就是和他有一场兄弟缘分。

光球继续：【你拥有成年人的灵魂和记忆，自然不会和正常幼崽一样，你从小就是个非常好带的孩子，还会主动照顾弟弟，甚至反过来照顾自己的父母和姥爷姥姥，家里人都非常喜欢你。雷米尔也非常黏你这个哥哥。

虎王依旧以感念郎飞和泽沐尔功绩的名义，派了侍女和家庭教师来教导雷米尔，但孩子有两个，他不能只教导雷米尔一个，名义上就是教导你们两个。

你不是真小孩，而大人不会把小孩当回事，为此你很快就发现那个侍女有问题。

你发现她不但拼命笼络雷米尔，还会向雷米尔灌输一些不适合的想法，比如对王后的批评，对王子公主的轻蔑，以及对安妮塔的赞扬。甚而那侍女还会说郎家的坏话，故意挑拨雷米尔和你的兄弟感情，想要分离雷米尔和郎家的情分。

你就把侍女的问题暗中告诉了你的四位长辈，并让雷米尔不要听那个侍女的话，说那个侍女很坏。

雷米尔那时非常信任、崇拜和喜欢你这个兄长，对其他人都不如对你亲近，那侍女再笼络他，也远不如你这个哥哥来得亲。自然你说什么就是什么，还因为那名侍女说你的坏话，而对她异常排斥。

当那个侍女再说郎家和你的坏话时，雷米尔大怒，不但拿东西打砸那个侍女，还哭着跑去找郎老伯爵告状。

之后那个侍女就被光明正大地退回。

老伯爵还对虎王哭诉是不是不相信他们能养好雷米尔，说如果不相信，那就把雷米尔接回去，他们家不敢养了。

虎王不好意思下也没有再派遣侍女侍者过来照顾雷米尔，还因此对安妮塔很生气，并严厉处罚了那名侍女。

而家庭教师们也收到虎王警告，同时被郎飞他们盯紧，每次上课都有郎家仆人在旁边盯着，美其名曰是帮着照顾还小不懂事的两位小少爷。家庭教师也就都不敢乱来，只老老实实地上课。

加上你又特别注意雷米尔有没有被养歪，一旦发现问题就会把雷米尔给掰回来。雷米尔就长成了和郎家人一样正直又勇猛的好少年。

你又在无意间利用神灵力量修复了雷米尔的身体，让他血脉天赋能自然激发，还激发出了很不错的天赋。苦于天赋迟迟不能激发而有点小自卑的雷米尔就更崇拜和喜欢你，只要你说的话他都听。】

商非凡偷偷撇嘴，在心中哼哼唧唧。总觉得这条命运线上的雷米尔一定会给这条命运线上的他找很多麻烦，成为他追求郎沐的最大阻扰呢。

郎沐心下则越发难受。如果他的命运没有被改变，这一切是多么棒。

光球：【就算安妮塔找上雷米尔，跟他说明了他的真正身世，雷米尔也没有被安妮塔影响多少。而当雷米尔愁苦自己竟然不是郎家的亲生孩子时，你就发现了他的问题，和他悉心交谈。

雷米尔对你依恋至深，加上心中惶恐不安，你一问，他就哭着把他是虎王和安妮塔私生子的秘密全都告诉了你。

你就好好开导了他，跟他说私生子的身份不重要，只要他愿意，他永远都是郎家的真正孩子，也是他的亲弟弟。

雷米尔几乎不用选择，他只想做你的弟弟和郎家的孩子。

但安妮塔经常找他，还暗中教导和引导他一些事情。雷米尔就把这些都跟你说了，你就让他先敷衍着，还跟郎家的长辈们商量。

郎家人养雷米尔也养出感情，把他当自家孩子一样看待，也很重视这件事。问清楚雷米尔不想当王子只想当郎家孩子后，他们就教雷米尔如何和安妮塔以及虎王相处，就是有好事就接着，让他干坏事就不理。

雷米尔逐渐也在这种秘密身份中玩出了乐趣，之后和安妮塔相处中发现安妮塔和邪神信徒有来往，他就赶紧告诉你和郎家长辈。

郎家人因此有了防备，原本想让雷米尔和安妮塔彻底断开，但雷米尔却主动说要当卧底，潜伏在安妮塔身边，搞清楚她想做什么，还有邪神信徒们想要做什么。为此，着实破坏了不少邪神信徒的密谋。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 216: Another Line of Fate (Part 1)

"In the line of fate where Lang Mu became the Child of Destiny, did I appear?" Shang Feifan couldn't help asking.

The orb of light seemed somewhat reluctant to answer this question, but it ultimately replied: [You would appear, and you would become Lang Mu's greatest helper.]

"And his lover as well, right?"

The orb of light refused to answer that question.

Shang Feifan smiled with satisfaction, holding his precious darling tightly.

Lang Mu patted his leg. Having calmed down considerably by now, he asked the orb of light, "You said that in my original line of fate, Anita would become one of my helpers? Could it be that in that timeline, she didn't go mad for revenge? Nor did she hatch that despicable plan with the Tiger King to swap babies? Was I able to grow up as the child of Lang Fei?"

The orb of light did not have to answer so many off-topic questions, but it was willing to solve the mysteries for Lang Mu and explained in great detail. Mainly because this line of fate had already been altered, so revealing it would have no impact whatsoever.

[Because you soul-transmigrated directly to the Orc Continent while still a fetus, your luck and fortune also affected your loved ones. Moreover, while still in the womb, you were able to sense the outside world and even perceive danger.

Because you caused a fuss inside her belly, Lang Fei was in too much pain to charge forward on the battlefield for the Tiger King, thereby avoiding a fatal, mortal situation.

Your father was also injured due to being distracted with worry for his wife who was about to give birth. He was reprimanded by the Tiger King and sent to the rear to accompany his wife, likewise avoiding a mortal crisis where he would have died fighting to protect her.

In their place, the Tiger King was heavily wounded, but he unleashed his full power and repelled the enemy.

At that exact moment, you were born on the battlefield.]

Lang Mu was overcome with emotion, filled with both excitement and pain. If his fate had not been altered, neither of his parents would have died, his grandparents would not have lost their daughter and son-in-law, and he could have grown up happily by the side of Lang Fei and Zemu'er.

Shang Feifan embraced him, whispering softly in his ear, "We will go reclaim everything that was stolen."

Lang Mu stared blankly into the distance. "It's too late for that. They're already gone."

"Even so, we must take revenge!" Shang Feifan said stubbornly. "The more it is like this, the less we can let that bastard who ruined everything get away with it!"

Lang Mu bit his lip tightly.

The orb of light could tell how sad Lang Mu was, but having not yet learned how to comfort a person, it could only continue its narrative: [Anita still hooked up with the Tiger King with the intention of taking revenge on the Queen. She also gave birth to Remiel. However, because the Tiger King couldn't find a suitable candidate this time, he didn't pull off the baby-swapping scheme.

At that time, the Queen already suspected that Anita was pregnant and wanted to track down this illegitimate child to eliminate him. The Tiger King was troubled over how to better protect this secret son without further offending the Queen.

Your parents were the Tiger King's personal guards. Grateful that the Tiger King had spared no effort to protect them on the battlefield so they could safely give birth to their child, they took the initiative to propose to the Tiger King that they could raise another child. It just so happened that Remiel was only two months younger than you.

The Tiger King was overjoyed. Lang Fei was already his confidante and possessed royal blood herself; they were simply the best adoptive parents his child could ask for. Right then and there, he secretly handed Remiel over to Lang Fei to raise.

It happened that Lang Fei and her husband had just come off the battlefield. Only a few people knew they had given birth, and no one was clear on how many children they actually had. Thus, Lang Fei and Zemu'er declared to the outside world that they had given birth to a pair of twins.]

Lang Mu: "..."

This turn of events was both surprising and unsurprising. One could only say that he and Remiel were simply fated to be brothers.

The orb of light continued: [Having the soul and memories of an adult, you were naturally different from normal cubs. You were an extremely easy child to raise from a young age, proactively taking care of your younger brother, and even looking after your parents and grandparents in turn. Everyone in the family adored you. Remiel was also exceptionally clingy toward you, his older brother.

The Tiger King still sent a maidservant and private tutors to instruct Remiel under the pretext of expressing gratitude for Lang Fei and Zemu'er's contributions. However, since there were two children, he couldn't just tutor Remiel alone, so nominally they were sent to teach both of you.

You were no real child, and adults rarely take children seriously. Because of this, you quickly discovered that there was something wrong with that maidservant.

You found that not only did she try desperately to win Remiel over, but she also attempted to instill inappropriate ideas into him—such as criticism of the Queen, contempt for the prince and princess, and praise for Anita. The maid even spoke ill of the Lang family, deliberately trying to sow discord in your brotherhood to alienate Remiel's affection for the Lang family.

So you secretly informed your four elders about the maid's suspicious behavior, and told Remiel not to listen to her, telling him that she was a bad person.

At that time, Remiel trusted, admired, and loved you as his older brother immensely. He was closer to you than to anyone else. No matter how much the maid tried to win him over, she couldn't compare to you. Naturally, whatever you said went, and because that maid spoke ill of you, he became extraordinarily repulsive toward her.

When that maid spoke ill of the Lang family and you once again, Remiel flew into a rage. Not only did he hurl objects at her, but he also ran to Old Earl Lang crying to complain.

Afterward, the maid was returned to where she came from in a completely justified manner.

The Old Earl even wept to the Tiger King, asking if he didn't trust them to raise Remiel properly, saying that if he lacked trust, he should take Remiel back because their family wouldn't dare raise him anymore.

Embarrassed, the Tiger King did not send any more maidservants or attendants to take care of Remiel. He was also furious with Anita and severely punished that maid.

The private tutors also received a warning from the Tiger King and were closely watched by Lang Fei's side at the same time. Every time there was a lesson, servants of the Lang family stood by watching, under the grand pretext of helping to take care of the two young masters who were still young and ignorant. None of the tutors dared to act out of line, dutifully conducting their lessons.

Added to that, you paid special attention to whether Remiel was being raised properly, setting him straight whenever you noticed an issue. Remiel thus grew into an upright and valiant young man, just like the members of the Lang family.

Furthermore, you inadvertently used divine power to repair Remiel's body, allowing his bloodline talent to awaken naturally, even stimulating quite an impressive talent. Remiel, who had felt a bit inferior due to the delayed awakening of his talent, came to admire and love you even more, obeying everything you said.]

Shang Feifan curled his lip secretly, humming grumpily in his heart. He felt that the Remiel in that line of fate would surely have caused his counterpart a world of trouble, serving as the greatest obstacle in his pursuit of Lang Mu.

Lang Mu, on the other hand, felt increasingly pained inside. If his fate had not been changed, how wonderful all of this would have been.

Orb of light: [Even when Anita sought Remiel out and explained his true birth details to him, Remiel wasn't influenced much by her. And when Remiel was tormented with distress over the fact that he was not an actual child of the Lang family, you noticed his trouble and had a heart-to-heart conversation with him.

Remiel was deeply attached to you, and with his heart full of anxiety, the moment you asked, he wept and spilled all the secrets about being the illegitimate child of the Tiger King and Anita.

You guided and comforted him gently, telling him that the status of an illegitimate child didn't matter. As long as he was willing, he would forever be a true child of the Lang family and your blood brother.

Remiel barely had to make a choice; he only wanted to be your brother and a child of the Lang family.

However, Anita frequently sought him out, secretly instructing and guiding him in certain matters. Remiel relayed all of this to you, so you told him to just play along on the surface while discussing it with the Lang family elders.

The Lang family had also developed deep affection for Remiel over the years, treating him like their own child, and attached great importance to this matter. After confirming that Remiel did not want to be a prince and only wanted to remain a child of the Lang family, they taught Remiel how to deal with Anita and the Tiger King: take whatever benefits were offered, but ignore any orders to do bad things.

Gradually, Remiel even found a sense of fun in this secret identity. Later, during his interactions with Anita, he discovered that she was in contact with cultists of the Evil God, so he hurried to inform you and the Lang elders.

With this advance warning, the Lang family was prepared. Originally, they wanted Remiel to sever ties with Anita completely, but Remiel took the initiative to offer to act as an undercover spy, lurking by Anita's side to figure out what she and the Evil God cultists were up to. Because of this, he successfully disrupted quite a few of the cultists' secret plots.]

chunks.chapterTitle: 第216章 另一条命运线 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
可你不放心这个一手拉拔大的宝贝弟弟，就跟着雷米尔一起接触安妮塔的另一重身份。

安妮塔想要利用你，每次却都被你反利用。那些邪神信徒想要做的恶事也总是会被你先一步破坏。你那时已经拥有了游戏系统，召唤来玩家，就发布任务让玩家帮你对付安妮塔和邪神信徒。

安妮塔和邪神信徒被耍得团团转，却完全不知道是你在后面操纵。】

郎沐不解：“如果是这样，那安妮塔怎么会成为我的臂助？”

光球发出了一点点黄色的光芒，似乎有点点无奈：【因为你同情她，更因雷米尔爱屋及乌，你想要帮她从仇恨的泥沼中跳出来。就经常去找她，甚至让雷米尔与她相认，还让郎家人都承认了她是雷米尔母亲的身份，待她如亲戚。更因此联系上她的妹妹迪莉娅和她的丈夫狼守镇长，搞得两家跟亲戚一样来往。

安妮塔一开始也许只是假意应付你们，但人心都是肉做的，有些时候假扮着假扮着也能扮出感情。

尤其在你帮助她缓解了她和她亲妹妹迪莉娅之间的矛盾后。】

商非凡：……是我家阿沐能干出来的事。

郎沐正好对安妮塔与迪莉娅之间的爱恨情仇不太了解，就请教了光球。

光球告诉他：【安妮塔当时和迪莉娅分离，其实是相当于抛弃了迪莉娅，更用迪莉娅换取了一笔资金。

在安妮塔看来，她是帮迪莉娅找到一个老师，有了依靠。而她要去做危险的事情，要去复仇，自然不能带上这唯一的妹妹。而且她当时已经结识邪神信徒，认为自己已经一脚踏入泥沼，自然不想妹妹也跟她一样。

但在迪莉娅看来，她姐姐就是卖了她、抛弃了她。她那个老师看中她的资质，虽然有教导她，但脾气特别糟糕，对迪莉娅并不好，在迪莉娅长大后甚至想要对她下手。

迪莉娅偶然结识了出来卖粮的狼守，被狼守的人品和为人打动。狼守也爱上她，就和她联手对付那个所谓的老师，又付出一笔培养金，这才让迪莉娅脱离困境。

所以迪莉娅对安妮塔的感情非常复杂，念着她但也恨着她。

而安妮塔真正偏向你，则是在你从她身体中取出石耳还给自然之神，却也让安妮塔获得自然之神的青睐之后。

安妮塔得到自然之神青睐，修复并提升了她的血脉天赋，让她实力大增。

同时安妮塔也因为这个青睐，本能地对邪神产生排斥，同时也明白她如果想要继续提升自己的力量，势必会被邪神注意到，九成九会成为邪神的能量补充。

于是安妮塔暗中还是跟邪神信徒厮混，实际上却偏向你，相当于卧底在邪神信徒当中。

但她也没有放弃报复王后以及想要让雷米尔成为虎王的念头。就很复杂的一个人。

而你和大王子加百列交好，认定大王子才是虎王的第一继承人。

雷米尔受你影响，也跟大王子关系处得非常好，压根就没有竞争虎王继承人的想法，还一心只想当个自由自在的冒险者。

安妮塔发现雷米尔‘烂泥糊不上墙’，还想转而扶持你登上王位。但你对当王也不感兴趣，反而问安妮塔有没有兴趣当真神教的教主。】

郎沐吃惊：“我竟然会引诱安妮塔去当真神教教主？”

光球：【人的行事会根据际遇、地位、立场而改变，你当时管理着十万玩家，已经拥有了合格的领导者资质。你的想法和行动方针自然而然会往对大局有利的方向靠拢。

你不仅蛊惑安妮塔去竞争真神教教主的位置，你还在后期大力推动虎国成为兽人大陆西方联盟盟主，然后让南北西三大联盟结合，再以此逼迫东部也变成联盟形式，最后四大联盟联手，形成了新的兽人大陆联盟体，共同对付邪神和邪神信徒。】

光球扫了眼商非凡：【当然，当时也有很多厉害的玩家帮你，尤其是你第一世母国的人。商非凡帮你找了很多适合的人手。而地星那边察觉到游戏对玩家产生的好处，还有兽人文明一些科技树对地星的科技发展也有点醒和辅佐的作用，就也特别积极地想要进入游戏，后来甚至把游戏世界当成了培养人才的摇篮地。】

商非凡称赞：“不错，互利互助，这才是跨位面全息游戏的正确打开方式。”

“那安妮塔成为真神教教主了吗？”郎沐好奇。

光球：【她没有成为真神教教主，但她拉起了另一支教派，称作自然神教。和真神教斗得热火朝天，还给虎国王后找了很多麻烦，最后甚至逼得丹顿一脉彻底家破人亡，想要给丹顿血脉争抢好处的王后则被虎王厌弃，最后被囚禁于别宫。她的儿女也因为王后一心只想着丹顿一脉，完全不考虑他们，而反感丹顿血脉，与王后变得疏远。】

“那条命运线上，丹顿侯爵有把黑森林城献祭成功吗？”郎沐担心。

光球：【没有。你在很早的时间点上就发现了地下城的秘密，还找到了那座图书馆。因为你提醒郎家长辈丹顿侯爵有问题，郎家人就去找了虎王。

虎王就派人去监视丹顿侯爵，在丹顿侯爵密谋献祭整座黑森林城时，被守株待兔的大都督狮域抓了个罪证确凿。最后大都督和大公主联手，再加上一支百人的精英兽人战士队伍，一起干掉了丹顿侯爵。】

“那当时那些穿越过来的魔法师呢？他们有没有搞出什么事？”郎沐又追问。

【服务于丹顿侯爵的魔法师发现事不可为，就偷偷跑掉了。但你让玩家盯上了他，也因此发现了魔晶矿。而拥有了魔晶矿的你，之后实力提升得就非常快。大王子也同样把那枚魔法奥秘石送给你，你就此踏入魔导师乃至法圣境界，之后更在各种机缘下成为法神。】

光球说到这里，停顿：【在你身为法神后，你的命运线就变得很模糊，无法清楚看到，只能看到一些片段。但根据那些片段，命运之神仍旧断定你应该是成功驱逐了那名邪神，解决了兽人大陆的自然-灾难，并重新修复了神之笼。虽然神灵们没能超脱天河星的束缚，但好歹有了恢复的时间。】

郎沐迅速问：“我是怎么解决了兽人大陆的自然-灾难？”

光球迟疑片刻：【很可惜，命运之神并没有看到详细过程。但众神推测，应该和修复了神之笼有关。】

商非凡插话：“也就是说兽人大陆之所以会岩浆喷发、陆地分崩离析，就是因为神之笼出了问题？”

光球对这个问题不是很确定：【也许。】

商非凡却觉得这个可能性很高。神之笼能隔离所有大陆，那能量必然深入地心。如果有一条“竖网格线”损坏，而这条网格线又连接兽人大陆，那会造成兽人大陆出现地质灾害也不是不可能的事。

“驱逐邪神？没有消灭？”商非凡又抓出一个重点。

光球：【应该是没有，命运之神只看到一团阴影离开了天河星上空，似乎再也无法进入天河星。】

商非凡沉吟。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 216: Another Line of Fate (Part 2)

[However, you weren't comfortable letting this precious younger brother whom you had brought up with your own hands take such risks alone, so you followed Remiel to make contact with Anita's other identity.

Anita tried to manipulate you, but every time, she ended up being manipulated by you instead. The evil deeds those Evil God cultists attempted to carry out were always thwarted by you one step ahead of time. By then, you already possessed the game system, summoning players and issuing quests for them to help you deal with Anita and the cultists.

Anita and the cultists were played like fools, completely unaware that you were the one pulling the strings behind the scenes.]

Lang Mu was puzzled. "If that's the case, then how did Anita become my helper?"

The orb of light emitted a faint yellow glow, appearing somewhat helpless: [Because you pitied her, and because Remiel loved her as his mother, you wanted to help her step out of the mire of hatred. You often went to see her, even allowing Remiel to acknowledge her, and convincing the Lang family to accept her identity as Remiel's mother, treating her like a relative. Furthermore, through this, you established contact with her younger sister Delia and her husband, Town Mayor Lang Shou, bringing the two families together like close kin.

At first, Anita might have only been feigning compliance with you all, but hearts are made of flesh; sometimes, acting out a role long enough leads to genuine emotion.

Especially after you helped resolve the conflict between her and her younger sister, Delia.]

Shang Feifan: ...Yep, that definitely sounds like something my A-Mu would do.

Lang Mu happened to know very little about the love-hate drama between Anita and Delia, so he asked the orb of light for clarification.

The orb of light told him: [When Anita separated from Delia back then, it was essentially equivalent to abandoning Delia, using her to secure a sum of funds.

In Anita's view, she was helping Delia find a teacher so she would have someone to rely on. Since Anita herself was going to embark on a dangerous path of revenge, she naturally couldn't bring her only sister along. Moreover, she had already made contact with the cultists at the time and felt that she had already stepped into the mire, so she naturally didn't want her sister to follow in her footsteps.

However, in Delia's view, her older sister had sold her out and abandoned her. Although that teacher recognized her aptitude and instructed her, he had an appalling temper and treated Delia horribly. After Delia grew up, he even tried to lay a hand on her.

Delia met Lang Shou by chance when he was out selling grain, and was moved by his character and integrity. Lang Shou fell in love with her as well, joining forces with her to deal with that so-called teacher and paying a sum of training fees, which finally allowed Delia to break free from her plight.

Therefore, Delia's feelings toward Anita were extremely complex; she missed her, yet hated her at the same time.

As for Anita truly leaning toward your side, that happened after you extracted the Stone Ear from her body and returned it to the Nature God, which earned Anita the favor of the Nature God in return.

Obtaining the Nature God's favor repaired and elevated her bloodline talent, greatly increasing her strength.

At the same time, because of this divine favor, Anita instinctively developed a repulsion toward the Evil God. She also realized that if she wished to continue raising her power, she would inevitably draw the Evil God's attention, with a ninety-nine percent chance of becoming fuel to replenish the Evil God's energy.

Thus, while Anita secretly continued to mingle with the cultists, she actually leaned toward your side, effectively acting as an undercover mole among the cultists.

However, she still didn't give up on retaliating against the Queen, nor her desire to make Remiel the Tiger King. She was a very complex person.

Meanwhile, you became good friends with the First Prince, Gabriel, maintaining that the First Prince was the true primary heir to the Tiger King.

Influenced by you, Remiel also got along exceptionally well with the First Prince. He didn't have the slightest intention of competing for the throne, wanting only to be a free and easy adventurer.

Finding Remiel to be a 'useless lump of mud that couldn't be plastered onto a wall,' Anita wanted to shift her support to you to ascend the throne instead. But you had no interest in becoming king either; instead, you asked Anita if she was interested in becoming the leader of the True God Church.]

Lang Mu was astonished. "I actually enticed Anita to become the leader of the True God Church?"

Orb of light: [A person's actions change according to their encounters, status, and stance. Managing one hundred thousand players at the time, you already possessed the qualifications of a competent leader. Your thinking and strategic direction naturally aligned with what was beneficial to the overall situation.

Not only did you entice Anita to compete for the position of leader of the True God Church, but in the later stages, you also vigorously promoted the Tiger Kingdom to become the leader of the Western Alliance on the Orc Continent. You then united the Southern, Northern, and Western alliances, using that leverage to force the East into an alliance format as well. In the end, the four major alliances joined hands to form a new Orc Continent Coalition to jointly deal with the Evil God and its cultists.]

The orb of light cast a glance at Shang Feifan: [Of course, there were also many powerful players helping you at the time, especially people from your motherland in your first life. Shang Feifan found many suitable talents for you. When Earth realized the benefits the game brought to players, as well as how certain tech trees of the Orc civilization could enlighten and assist Earth's technological development, they became extremely eager to enter the game, eventually even treating the game world as a cradle for nurturing talent.]

Shang Feifan praised, "Not bad. Mutual benefit and assistance—this is the correct way to open a cross-dimensional holographic game."

"Did Anita become the leader of the True God Church in the end?" Lang Mu asked curiously.

Orb of light: [She didn't become the leader of the True God Church, but she established another faction known as the Nature God Church. She fought fiercely against the True God Church and caused an immense amount of trouble for the Tiger Kingdom's Queen. Ultimately, she forced Marquis Danton's line into absolute ruin. The Queen, who had focused entirely on securing benefits for the Danton bloodline while completely ignoring her own children, was rejected by the Tiger King and eventually imprisoned in an auxiliary palace. Her children also grew alienated from her due to her single-minded obsession with the Danton lineage.]

"In that line of fate, did Marquis Danton succeed in sacrificing Black Forest City?" Lang Mu asked worriedly.

Orb of light: [No. You discovered the secrets of the underground city at a very early time point and found that library. Because you warned the Lang elders that Marquis Danton was suspicious, the Lang family went to the Tiger King.

The Tiger King dispatched people to monitor Marquis Danton. When Marquis Danton plotted to sacrifice the entire Black Forest City, he was caught red-handed by Grand Commander Shiyu, who was lying in wait. In the end, the Grand Commander and the First Princess joined forces, along with an elite squad of a hundred orc warriors, to slay Marquis Danton.]

"What about those transmigrated magicians back then? Did they cause any trouble?" Lang Mu pressed further.

[The magicians serving Marquis Danton fled secretly when they realized the situation was hopeless. But you had players keep an eye on them, which led to the discovery of the Magic Crystal Mine. Once you possessed the Magic Crystal Mine, your strength increased at an extremely rapid pace. The First Prince also presented that Magic Mystery Stone to you. With that, you stepped into the realm of Archmage, then Magic Saint, and through various opportunities later on, you ultimately became a Magic God.]

Speaking up to this point, the orb of light paused: [After you became a Magic God, your line of fate became very blurry, impossible to see clearly, yielding only a few fragments. But based on those fragments, the God of Destiny still concluded that you successfully banished that Evil God, resolved the natural disaster of the Orc Continent, and repaired the God's Cage once more. Although the gods were unable to break free from the constraints of Planet Tianhe, at least they gained time to recover.]

Lang Mu asked quickly, "How did I resolve the natural disaster of the Orc Continent?"

The orb of light hesitated for a moment: [Unfortunately, the God of Destiny did not see the detailed process. However, the gods speculate that it was likely related to repairing the God's Cage.]

Shang Feifan interjected, "In other words, the reason why the Orc Continent suffered volcanic eruptions and continental fragmentation was that something went wrong with the God's Cage?"

The orb of light wasn't entirely certain about this question: [Perhaps.]

Shang Feifan, however, felt the probability was very high. If the God's Cage could isolate all continents, its energy must inevitably extend deep into the core of the planet. If a single "vertical grid line" was damaged, and that grid line happened to connect to the Orc Continent, it wouldn't be impossible for geological disasters to occur on the Orc Continent as a result.

"Banished the Evil God? Not destroyed?" Shang Feifan picked up on another key point.

Orb of light: [It seems not. The God of Destiny only saw a mass of shadow leaving the airspace above Planet Tianhe, seemingly unable to enter Planet Tianhe ever again.]

Shang Feifan fell into deep thought.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第216章 另一条命运线 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
郎沐也在思考：“会不会是修复好的神之笼挡住了邪神？”

商非凡：“很有可能。你们那时应该会让所有厉害人物一起联手对付邪神，但也没有办法消灭它，只能驱逐。然后你们趁机修复神之笼，也许是最后一步。如此，当邪神离开天河星范围，想要再进来就不可能。”

郎沐皱眉：“那这也不算是真正解决了邪神，它依旧徘徊在天河星外面。”

商非凡理智地说：“可这至少给天河星众神争取了恢复时间，也给你们更多提升实力和想办法的时间。也许你的任务就只是驱逐邪神和修复神之笼，之后的事自然还有后来的命运之子去做。”

郎沐一想也是。每个阶段都有每个阶段的任务，他也不可能做完所有事情。

“命运之神有看到我是如何修复神之笼的吗？”这可是一个关键问题。

光球却打破了两人希望，特别光棍地说：【没有。】

商非凡：“结果就是命运之神该窥探的重点都没看到，就看八卦了？”

光球：【这是规则。越是影响命运的关键点越不可能明示。命运之神能看到修复神之笼是关键点已经是给出了极大提示。】

“那当年众神是怎么破坏神之笼的？这总知道吧？”商非凡问。

光球心想商非凡果然聪明：【你们现在还没有能力修复神之笼，除非你们达到法神境界，否则你们连看都看不到神之笼。】

商非凡：“先回答我的问题。”

光球淡淡黄光转变为淡淡红光：【生与死的能量交替使用。】

听到商非凡耳朵里就是：“冷与热交替使用，利用热胀冷缩原理让一条笼子网格线开裂是吧？”

光球：【……】

商非凡抱着阿沐叹了口气。虽然还不知道神之笼到底要如何修复，但光球今晚和他们的谈话，也让他们了解到许多，至少看到了整件事的脉络，不再是两眼一抹黑的状态。

商非凡看向光球：“那我这条命运线呢？众神又看到多少？”

光球在回答之前，先说：【正在发生的命运线无法窥探到详细，只能看到些许片段。而这些涉及到未来的片段也不是都能告诉你。因为未来始终在改变，也许一个决定就能影响到后面的命运线。我告诉你未来会发生什么事，你可能避开危险，也可能迎来更大危险。】

商非凡理解：“但你们选择我，就说明你们看到的片段中有我成功驱逐邪神和解决兽人大陆地质灾害的内容，对吗？”

光球严肃地：【那只是一种可能。未来时刻都会改变。】

商非凡听懂，总之就是别想它透露太多。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 216: Another Line of Fate (Part 3)

Lang Mu was also pondering. "Could it be that the repaired God's Cage blocked the Evil God out?"

Shang Feifan said, "Very likely. At that time, you all probably joined forces with all the powerful figures to contend with the Evil God, but had no way to destroy it, only able to expel it. Then you took the opportunity to repair the God's Cage, which was likely the final step. That way, once the Evil God left the range of Planet Tianhe, entering again became impossible."

Lang Mu frowned. "Then that doesn't count as truly eliminating the Evil God. It's still lingering outside Planet Tianhe."

Shang Feifan said rationally, "But this at least bought recovery time for the gods of Planet Tianhe, as well as giving you all more time to raise your strength and figure out solutions. Perhaps your task was merely to drive out the Evil God and repair the God's Cage; whatever comes after will naturally be left for future Children of Destiny to accomplish."

When Lang Mu thought about it, that made sense. Every phase had its own tasks; he couldn't possibly finish everything himself.

"Did the God of Destiny see how I repaired the God's Cage?" This was a crucial question.

The orb of light dashed their hopes, saying with total bluntness: [No.]

Shang Feifan remarked, "So in the end, the God of Destiny missed every single key point that actually needed spying on, and only looked at the gossip?"

Orb of light: [This is the rule. The more crucial a point is in influencing fate, the less possible it is to be explicitly revealed. The fact that the God of Destiny could see that repairing the God's Cage was the key point is already an immense hint.]

"Then how did the gods damage the God's Cage back in the day? You must know that at least, right?" Shang Feifan asked.

The orb of light thought to itself that Shang Feifan was indeed sharp: [You currently lack the capability to repair the God's Cage. Unless you reach the realm of a Magic God, you won't even be able to see the God's Cage.]

Shang Feifan said, "Answer my question first."

The faint yellow light of the orb shifted into a faint red light: [Alternating use of life and death energy.]

What landed in Shang Feifan's ears translated to: "Alternating cold and heat, using the principle of thermal expansion and contraction to make a grid line of the cage crack, right?"

Orb of light: [...]

Shang Feifan held A-Mu and let out a sigh. Although they still didn't know how the God's Cage was supposed to be repaired, the conversation with the orb of light tonight had allowed them to learn a great deal. At least they now saw the outline of the whole affair and were no longer in the dark.

Shang Feifan looked toward the orb of light. "What about my current line of fate? How much did the gods see?"

Before answering, the orb of light stated: [A line of fate currently unfolding cannot be spied upon in detail; only a few fragments can be glimpsed. Furthermore, these fragments involving the future cannot all be told to you. Because the future is constantly changing, a single decision might affect the subsequent lines of fate. If I tell you what will happen in the future, you might avoid a danger, or you might usher in an even greater calamity.]

Shang Feifan understood. "So choosing me means that among the fragments you saw, there were scenes of me successfully expelling the Evil God and solving the geological disasters of the Orc Continent, correct?"

The orb of light said solemnly: [That is merely one possibility. The future changes at every moment.]

Shang Feifan caught the drift—in short, don't expect it to spoil too much.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第217章 忽悠虫王分享任务 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第217章 忽悠虫王分享任务

不过商非凡转而就想到系统给他发布的那些任务，大概就是根据命运指引，引导他向最可能成功的路线走。

七枚月亮依次隐入乌云，远处传来鸡鸣声。

光球也晃了晃，消失。

商非凡从窗台上跳下来，伸手对郎沐说：“走吧，去睡觉。有什么事明天再说。”

郎沐也觉得有点疲乏，但不是身体上而是精神上的。

任谁听到自己原本应该有个幸福美满的家庭和成功又快乐的一世人生，却因别人贪婪他的气运，不但导致他有了个被欺骗的凄惨第二世，还让他的家人也都早早死亡或走入歧途，那心里能好受吗？

“王城这边的事已经料理得差不多，接下来我们就全力对付洛伦米尔顿，你的气运必须拿回来。”商非凡轻声说，语调不带任何起伏。

郎沐却听出了异样。

商非凡不知道是性格原因，还是工作习惯，他的反应就跟国家报道一样，事情越大字数越少，感情表达也不太明显。

“嗯！”郎沐也不想放过洛伦米尔顿。

不为自己，也为了他身边所有被牵连的人。

郎沐冲了个澡，躺到床上时翻来覆去睡不着，他想要不去想太多，却又忍不住懊悔。

商非凡带着一身水汽回来，从后面拥住他，轻轻拍抚他：“事情已经发生，多想无益。命运之神看到的只是一种可能，就跟我们曾经有过无数次选择，每一次选择都可能创造出一条新的命运线，而另外几条就会就此断绝，也许里面就有对未来更好的选择。”

郎沐忍不住：“但至少做选择的人是我自己，而不是被别人刻意影响。”

商非凡轻吻他的后脖颈：“我这样说也许很残忍，也许你会被欺骗就是主流命运线。别忘了，连光球都承认邪神毁灭这个世界就是主命运线。现在光球和众神，包括我们在内，做的只是挣扎，试图挣脱出主命运线，开创出一条新活路。”

郎沐闭上眼睛，心里悲伤上涌：“这么说浪飞他们都活着的那条命运线只是一种可能，它压根就不可能存在？”

商非凡抱紧陷入抑郁的爱人：“不，我觉得它应该存在，只是没有发生在我们这条命运线里，属于另一个平行世界。你可以这样想，在另外一条命运线里，另一个你和郎飞他们，还有另一个我，会幸福美满地生活下去。他们拥有着他们的故事。”

商非凡又补充：“命运之神既然能窥探到，那就表明这条命运线一定存在，就像大河的无数支流，其中也有能形成新河道流入大海的。而新河道也会产生无数支流，洛伦米尔顿盯上你时，就代表新的支流产生。”

郎沐沉默，过了一会儿突然说：“我不希望我们这条命运线走向末途。不属于我的，我不稀罕。但原本就是我的，我要拿回来。”

商非凡笑：“这才对。怄气只会伤害自己，比起怄气和自悔，我们更应该找那些无耻的杂碎算账，让他们把吃掉我们的吐出来，还要他们加倍赔偿！”

郎沐翻过身，一把抓住商非凡的衣领。

商非凡的眼睛在黑暗中发出亮光……

两人酣畅淋漓一番沉沉睡去时，商非凡总觉得自己好像忘记了某件事。

次日中午，被遗忘的虫王乔西道尔总算通过克莱门特先一步见到了阿瑞斯商。

其他大佬自恃身份，都还在王宫等候，同时进行分享大会的后半段。

虫王则在昨晚不知从哪里打听到阿瑞斯商和侍卫统领克莱门特关系良好，就早早找到克莱门特，花费一定代价请克莱门特联系阿瑞斯商。

克莱门特果然能联系到阿瑞斯商，他找了个仆人去郎府跑腿。

大半个小时后，虫王坐在了郎府的会客厅中。

阿瑞斯商大摇大摆地从内屋出来，亲自给虫王倒了杯虎国流行的坚果奶茶。

“这里的仆人和老伯爵他们都一起走了，我也懒得再找仆人伺候。慢待陛下之处，还请多多包涵。”阿瑞斯商在虫王对面坐下。

虫王也不在乎这些，尤其在他了解到阿瑞斯商的能力后。

“本王记得阁下似乎不是虎国人？虽然本王没有见过那位拉斐尔郎沐，但我虫人部落也有很多优秀俊美的族人，如果阁下愿意前往我虫人部落做客，本王保证阁下一定会宾至如归。”虫王假装不知道阿瑞斯商带着的那名侍卫九成就是拉斐尔郎沐，笑眯眯地说道。

阿瑞斯商慵懒地笑笑，“我更喜欢毛茸茸。”

虫王：“有毛的兽型确实更讨喜，我们族也有熊虫族，小时候圆头圆脑特别可爱，很多兽人都喜欢那一族的。”

虫王见阿瑞斯商不感兴趣，语气一转，玩笑一般说：“另外，我们虫人族更有不少虫人的虫型异常美丽，比如蝶族、花虫族、月虫族，还有纱影族等，他们的人形也都是一等一的大美人。体型纤细修长，或潇洒写意，或婉约多姿，或玉树临风，或国色芳华，或美艳绝顶，也有英气飒爽、桀骜不驯、可爱天真、老实淳厚的。”

阿瑞斯商：“……陛下，我们谈正经事吧。您再说下去，就算我没哪个心，我也怕我伴侣听到后揍我。”

虫王哈哈大笑，见阿瑞斯商不受诱惑，心下不禁大为惋惜。要是早知道有阿瑞斯商这么一个能人，他早就安排人手和对方“巧遇”。

他就不信凭借他们虫人族那么多特点各异的大美人，还打不过一个相貌普通身世麻烦的虎兽人。

如果阿瑞斯商就喜欢拉斐尔郎沐那一款，那他们虫人部落也能找出一堆。

可惜啊可惜，有时候就晚了一步，就什么都晚了。

“我能知道你为什么想要这枚腰坠吗？”虫王摘下腰坠放到桌面上。

阿瑞斯商直接说：“我受自然之神之托，为祂寻找散落的力量碎片。你这枚腰坠就是。”

乔西道尔被震住。

他没想到阿瑞斯商真的告诉了他原因，还是这么……让人不可置信又有点忍不住想要相信的原因。

“你……你见到过神灵？”虫王不信。

阿瑞斯商：“不能说见到，我只见到一尊破碎的自然之神雕像，当我靠近时，我接收到了部分意念。”

“那尊雕像在哪里？”虫王忍不住问。

阿瑞斯商嘿嘿一笑：“在神的异度空间。”

随后他竟然主动说明：“你知道我是怎么进入神灵的异度空间的吗？”

虫王就算不信，也忍不住问：“你是怎么进入的？”

“恐惧之神的奴仆。我被它抓走过一次，就被它丢入了一个古怪的异度空间，我付出了极大代价挣脱束缚，在里面乱跑，无意间就跑到了一座城市广场。那座广场最中央就有一座自然之神的雕像。”

阿瑞斯商的神情很诚实。

但虫王不信。

虫王就算相信阿瑞斯商真的和自然之神意识接触过，也不会相信他会把在哪里见到神灵的秘密告诉其他人。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 217: Hoodwinking the Insect King to Share the Quest (Part 1)

However, Shang Feifan then thought of the quests the system had assigned him. They were probably guided by fate, steering him toward the path most likely to succeed.

The seven moons sank into the dark clouds one by one, and the crowing of a rooster came from the distance.

The sphere of light also flickered and vanished.

Shang Feifan jumped down from the windowsill and reached out to Lang Mu, saying, "Let's go, time for bed. We'll talk about whatever else tomorrow."

Lang Mu also felt a bit weary, though not physically, but mentally.

Anyone who learned that they were originally supposed to have a happy, fulfilling family and a successful, joyful lifetime, but because someone else coveted their luck, it not only resulted in a tragic second life plagued by deception, but also caused all their family members to die early or go astray—could anyone possibly feel good after hearing that?

"The affairs here in the Royal City are almost wrapped up. Next, we'll go all out against Loren Milton; your luck must be taken back," Shang Feifan said softly, his tone completely flat and devoid of fluctuation.

Yet Lang Mu heard the anomaly within it.

Whether due to his personality or his work habits, Shang Feifan's reaction was just like an official state report: the bigger the event, the fewer the words, and the emotional expression was far from obvious.

"Mn!" Lang Mu had no intention of letting Loren Milton off the hook, either.

Not just for himself, but for everyone around him who had been implicated.

Lang Mu took a shower and tossed and turned in bed, unable to fall asleep. He tried not to think too much, yet could not help feeling regret.

Shang Feifan returned trailing a wisp of moisture, embraced him from behind, and gently patted and stroked him. "What's done is done; overthinking brings no benefit. What the God of Fate saw was merely one possibility—just like how we have had countless choices in the past, and every single choice could create a new destiny line, while the other few would be severed right then and there. Perhaps among them was an even better choice for the future."

Lang Mu couldn't help saying, "At least the one making the choice was myself, rather than being deliberately influenced by someone else."

Shang Feifan lightly kissed the back of his neck. "What I'm about to say might be cruel, but perhaps your being deceived was the mainstream destiny line. Don't forget, even the sphere of light acknowledged that the Evil God's destruction of this world is the prime destiny line. Right now, the sphere of light, the gods, and even us—all we are doing is struggling, trying to wrench ourselves free from the prime destiny line and forge a new path to survival."

Lang Mu closed his eyes as a surge of sorrow welled up in his heart. "Does that mean the destiny line where Lang Fei and the others are all alive is just a possibility? It doesn't exist at all?"

Shang Feifan hugged his depressed lover tighter. "No, I believe it should exist; it just didn't happen in our destiny line. It belongs to another parallel world. You can think of it this way: in another destiny line, another you, Lang Fei and the others, and another me, are living a happy and fulfilling life. They have their own story."

Shang Feifan added, "Since the God of Fate was able to peer into it, it proves that this destiny line definitely exists—much like the countless tributaries of a vast river, among which some can form new riverbeds flowing into the sea. And this new riverbed will also generate countless tributaries; when Loren Milton set his sights on you, it meant a new tributary had been produced."

Lang Mu fell silent. After a moment, he suddenly said, "I don't want this destiny line of ours to end in a dead end. What doesn't belong to me, I don't care for. But what was originally mine, I will take back."

Shang Feifan chuckled. "That's more like it. Fretting only hurts oneself. Instead of brooding and regretting, we should settle accounts with those shameless scoundrels, make them spit out what they swallowed from us, and demand double compensation!"

Lang Mu turned over and grabbed Shang Feifan by the collar.

Shang Feifan's eyes glowed brightly in the dark...

When the two of them finally drifted into a deep sleep after an exhilarating session, Shang Feifan always felt as though he had forgotten something.

At noon the next day, the forgotten Insect King, Josiedol, finally managed to see Ares Shang ahead of the others through Clement.

The other high-ranking bosses, relying on their status, were still waiting in the royal palace while the second half of the sharing convention was underway.

As for the Insect King, having somehow learned from somewhere last night that Ares Shang enjoyed a good relationship with Guard Commander Clement, he had sought out Clement early on and paid a certain price to ask Clement to contact Ares Shang.

True to his word, Clement was able to reach Ares Shang and sent a servant to run an errand at the Lang Estate.

Over half an hour later, the Insect King was seated in the reception parlor of the Lang Estate.

Ares Shang swaggered out from the inner room and personally poured the Insect King a cup of the nut milk tea popular in the Tiger Kingdom.

"The servants and the old count all left together, and I couldn't be bothered to find new ones to wait on me. Please forgive me for any discourtesy toward Your Majesty," Ares Shang said, taking a seat opposite the Insect King.

The Insect King didn't mind such trifles, especially after learning of Ares Shang's abilities.

"This king remembers that Your Excellency doesn't seem to be a Tiger-kin? Although this king has not met that Raphael Lang Mu, our Insect-kin tribe also has many outstanding and handsome clansmen. If Your Excellency is willing to visit our Insect-kin tribe, this king guarantees that Your Excellency will feel right at home," the Insect King said with a smiling veneer, pretending not to know that the guard accompanying Ares Shang was ninety-percent likely to be Raphael Lang Mu.

Ares Shang gave a languid chuckle. "I prefer things that are fluffy."

The Insect King: "Beast-forms with fur are indeed more endearing. Our tribe also has the Bear-Insect clan; when they were young, their round heads made them exceptionally cute, and many beast-kin adore that clan."

Seeing that Ares Shang was uninterested, the Insect King shifted his tone and spoke as if joking, "Besides, within our Insect-kin tribe, there are quite a few whose insect-forms are exceptionally beautiful—such as the Butterfly clan, Flower-Insect clan, Moon-Insect clan, and Gauze-Shadow clan. Their human forms are also top-tier beauties. Their figures are slender and graceful, ranging from free-spirited and elegant, to delicate and alluring, statuesque and dashing, breathtakingly gorgeous, stunningly peerless, as well as spirited and valiant, unruly and untamed, cute and innocent, or honest and steadfast."

Ares Shang: "…Your Majesty, let's talk business. If you keep going like this, even if I don't have those thoughts, I'd be afraid my partner would beat me up if he heard."

The Insect King burst into hearty laughter. Seeing that Ares Shang was impervious to temptation, he couldn't help feeling a great sense of regret inwardly. Had he known earlier that there was a capable person like Ares Shang, he would have long since arranged for people to 'accidentally encounter' him.

He refused to believe that with the vast array of stunning beauties of all types in their Insect-kin tribe, they couldn't beat a plain-looking Tiger beast-kin with a troublesome background.

If Ares Shang simply fancied Raphael Lang Mu's specific type, their Insect-kin tribe could easily rustle up a whole bunch of them.

What a pity, what a pity. Sometimes, being just a step too late meant everything was too late.

"May I know why you want this waist pendant?" The Insect King unclasped the waist pendant and placed it on the table.

Ares Shang stated bluntly, "I was entrusted by the Goddess of Nature to search for her scattered fragments of power. This waist pendant of yours is one of them."

Josiedol was struck dumb.

He hadn't expected Ares Shang to actually tell him the reason, and such an... unbelievable reason that one couldn't help wanting to believe it all the same.

"You... have you met a deity?" The Insect King was skeptical.

Ares Shang: "I wouldn't call it meeting one. I only saw a shattered statue of the Goddess of Nature. When I drew close, I received a portion of her consciousness."

"Where is that statue?" the Insect King couldn't help asking.

Ares Shang gave a cheeky grin. "In the deity's alternate dimension."

Following that, he actually took the initiative to explain, "Do you know how I entered the deity's alternate dimension?"

Even if he didn't believe it, the Insect King couldn't help asking, "How did you get in?"

"A servant of the God of Fear. I was captured by it once and thrown into a bizarre alternate dimension. I paid a huge price to break free, and while running around blindly inside, I inadvertently stumbled into a city square. Right at the very center of that square stood a statue of the Goddess of Nature."

Ares Shang's expression was utterly sincere.

Yet the Insect King did not believe him.

Even if the Insect King believed that Ares Shang had truly made conscious contact with the Goddess of Nature, he would never believe that he would spill the secret of where he saw a deity to others.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第217章 忽悠虫王分享任务 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
阿瑞斯商耸肩：“信不信随你。那个异度空间应该是由众神的神之空间组成，里面不止有一位神灵，也许只有有缘人才能进入。”

虫王深吸气。神灵距离他们太遥远，虽然从古至今都有关于神灵的传说，但虫王是个实在人，他只相信亲眼看到且能握在手心里的东西。

“如果这宝石腰坠真的是自然之神力量的一部分，那岂不是非常珍贵？”虫王笑说。

阿瑞斯商呵呵：“陛下觉得普通人持有神灵力量是好事？不说邪神一直在寻找神灵的力量，一旦被邪神信徒们找到，您可以想象围绕这枚宝石腰坠，您和您的虫人部落会遇到什么事情。”

“另外，神灵力量并不是什么人都能使用和吸收。对于属性不适合的人来说，神灵力量不但不是臂助，反而会成为祸害自己的毒-药。也就是自然之神的力量比较温和，才没有对陛下您造成大的损伤。但是，它的力量对于您来说也只是鸡肋吧？”

虫王没有立刻回答。

阿瑞斯商架起二郎腿，端起奶茶咕咚咕咚喝了一半，放下杯子：“让我猜猜这枚腰坠能给您带来什么好处，它是让您一直都能保持神智清醒，还是能给您加持持续力，还是帮助您增加速度？但就算有这些好处，也不算很强，对么？而且您应该不能主动使用，只能被动接受。”

虫王不动声色地透露些许：“我一直以为它是一枚可以增加速度的炼金装饰品，由历代虫王传下来，算是虫人部落的王室珍品。”

阿瑞斯商也半点不急不忙，似乎并不急着收回这枚腰坠。

虫王见阿瑞斯商不肯主动出击，暗骂一声狡猾的小狐狸，只能由他自己主动提道：“如果这枚腰坠真的是自然之神散落的力量之一，那本王自然很愿意把这枚腰坠归还给自然之神。可是……这件事只是你述说的，事实到底如何，本王也无法确定。”

阿瑞斯商勾唇：“陛下想见到自然之神雕像？可以啊。”

虫王怔住。

太轻易了，他都觉得这是不是一个针对他的骗局。

阿瑞斯商笑容消失，没好气地说：“你们这些大佬就喜欢想太多。如果我不同意带你去见自然之神雕像，你就不肯相信我说的是真的，不肯把这枚腰坠交给我。可我现在说愿意带你去见自然之神雕像，你又认为我在骗你。啧，那就把这些都放一边，您就说要什么条件才能交换吧。昨天您提的那两个条件，就别再提了。”

虫王来找阿瑞斯商就是想要做一个交易，交易物他都想好了。

但现在听阿瑞斯商提到这腰坠竟然是自然之神散落的力量，他自然心痒痒，想要获得更多。

虫王又忍不住疑惑，为什么看起来很是精明的阿瑞斯商会主动提到这是自然之神散落的力量，这不是给交易增加难度吗？

还是说这仍旧是一场针对他个人的阴谋？

虫王越想越复杂。

阿瑞斯商看着虫王那表面冷静、内里纠结的模样，端起奶茶继续咕咚咕咚。

看别人纠结怎么就这么爽呢。

“为什么告诉我？”虫王还是问出来了。

阿瑞斯商又给自己续了一杯奶茶，他早饭还没吃，饿了：“因为邪神啊。邪神要吞噬神灵、吞噬我们的兽人大陆乃至整个天河星。自然之神跟我说了邪神的阴谋，让我们兽人团结起来想法修复神之笼，把邪神打出天河星。可我一个小小兽人又能做到多少？”

虫王惊讶无比。他再怎么也没有想到，今天只是来做一个小小交易，竟然就听到如此……大事。

阿瑞斯商无视虫王表情，继续叨咕：“我对当兽皇不感兴趣，也没有那个时间和精力去统一整个兽人大陆，更没兴趣当领导。这种大事就是整个兽人大陆所有兽人的事情，我干嘛要一个人背负？陛下您说是不是？”

虫王一时不知道该如何回答。

“正好这次虎国召开传承分享大会，我就打算找几位可靠的领袖把这件事告知，然后你们看要怎么办。如果你们想直接面见神灵，我也可以把你们带去见见自然之神的雕像。当然我不保证神灵一定会跟你们交谈。但我想你们肯定更喜欢直接和神灵面谈，而不是通过我这个中间人。”

阿瑞斯商此时的态度，任谁来看都不像是想要借机掌权的样儿，反而一副恨不得把责任赶紧抛给别人背的懒散劲。

“如果我们一起对付邪神，我们的神灵是否对我们有什么赐予？”虫王试探地问。

阿瑞斯商：“赐予？你想要力量还是其他什么东西？”

虫王毫不犹豫地说：“当然是力量。”

阿瑞斯商：“这点您可以和神灵面谈。总之，想要什么，你们自己跟神灵谈。”

虫王表情怪异。竟然能跟神灵谈条件，真的假的？

“如果你愿意，我现在就可以带你去见自然之神的雕像。你可以亲自把那枚腰坠还给自然之神，说不定能得到自然之神的青睐。”阿瑞斯商建议。

虫王再次犹豫。

“如果您不愿意，就当我没说过。不过自然之神已经知道祂散落的力量在陛下您身上，而您还不打算归还。虽然自然之神在和邪神大战后，神力有所衰退，但……”阿瑞斯商笑了笑，一切尽在不言中。

虫王：艹！

阿瑞斯商还特别厚脸皮地说：“我是个厚道人，所以我会把一切都跟您说个明明白白，让您自己选择。免得您和您的部落遇到某些诡异的事情，都不知道根源在哪里。”

虫王脸色变冷：“你这是在威胁本王？”

阿瑞斯商失笑：“这怎么是威胁。我明明在陈述事实。其实自然之神已经算是神灵中很不错的了，祂至少没有直接强夺，而是愿意通过我和陛下您协商。”

商非凡自然不会说许多神灵为了压制和封印邪神，压根就没有力气去回收自己的力量，更怕自己抽出力量会被邪神察觉，让邪神找到机会挣脱封印逃跑，只能躲在异度空间里操纵兽人来为自己干活。

虫王沉默半晌，开口：“邪神收拢邪神信徒，你认为这些邪神信徒下场会如何？”

阿瑞斯商不客气地说破：“你是想问，如果我们兽人投靠邪神，会有什么好处，以及兽人大陆未来会如何，对么？”

虫王也坦然回：“是。邪神也好，古神灵也好，我们都很陌生，如果一定要为一方效劳，自然要问清楚谁给的好处最多。”

阿瑞斯商乐，竖起大拇指：“不愧是虫王陛下，就是看得通透。”

“那么？”

阿瑞斯商换了个比较正经的坐姿：“据我所知，跟着邪神的邪神信徒都不会有好下场。邪神压根不在乎他们，祂只想吞噬更多能量，我们兽人也好、天河星也好、神灵也好，都是祂的吞噬目标。也许邪神信徒会放到最后？毕竟邪神总需要人手来帮祂清理和阻挡天河星上的智慧物种，免得全天河星的智慧物种联合在一起，一起对抗邪神。”
chunks.englishText:
Ares Shang shrugged. "Believe it or not, as you wish. That alternate dimension should be composed of the divine spaces of various deities; there's more than one deity inside, and perhaps only those destined can enter."

The Insect King took a deep breath. Deities were far too distant from them. Although legends of deities had existed since antiquity, the Insect King was a pragmatic man—he only believed in things he could see with his own eyes and hold in the palm of his hand.

"If this gemstone waist pendant is truly a part of the Goddess of Nature's power, wouldn't that make it extremely precious?" the Insect King said with a smile.

Ares Shang chuckled. "Does Your Majesty think it's a good thing for an ordinary person to hold divine power? Not to mention that the Evil God has always been searching for the power of deities, once the Evil God's followers find out, you can imagine what you and your Insect-kin tribe will encounter centering around this gemstone waist pendant."

"Furthermore, divine power is not something just anyone can use and absorb. For those whose affinities are unsuited, divine power is not a helper at all; instead, it becomes a poison that harms oneself. It's only because the power of the Goddess of Nature is relatively gentle that it didn't cause Your Majesty any major damage. Even so, its power is probably nothing more than a tasteless chicken rib to you, right?"

The Insect King did not answer immediately.

Ares Shang crossed his legs, picked up his milk tea, gulped down half of it, and set the cup back down. "Let me guess what benefits this waist pendant brings you. Does it keep your mind clear all the time, or does it grant you continuous stamina, or help boost your speed? But even with these perks, they aren't that strong, are they? Moreover, you probably can't use it actively; you can only passively receive them."

Without changing his expression, the Insect King revealed a hint: "I've always thought it was an alchemy ornament that could increase speed, passed down through generations of Insect Kings. It's considered a royal treasure of the Insect-kin tribe."

Ares Shang was not the least bit hurried, seemingly in no rush to take back the waist pendant.

Seeing that Ares Shang refused to make the first move, the Insect King mentally cursed him as a cunning little fox, leaving him no choice but to bring it up himself. "If this waist pendant is truly one of the scattered fragments of the Goddess of Nature's power, then this king would naturally be very willing to return it to the Goddess of Nature. However... this matter is solely based on your account; as for the truth of the matter, this king cannot verify it."

Ares Shang curved his lips. "Your Majesty wants to see the statue of the Goddess of Nature? Sure."

The Insect King froze.

It was far too easy; he couldn't help wondering if this was a scam targeting him.

Ares Shang's smile vanished, and he said with annoyance, "You big shots love to overthink things. If I refused to take you to see the statue of the Goddess of Nature, you wouldn't believe what I said is true and wouldn't be willing to hand over this waist pendant. But now that I say I'm willing to take you to see the statue of the Goddess of Nature, you think I'm tricking you. Tch, let's put all that aside—just name your conditions for the exchange. Those two conditions you brought up yesterday, don't mention them again."

The Insect King had come to see Ares Shang wanting to make a deal, and he had already figured out the trade item.

But now, hearing Ares Shang mention that this waist pendant was actually a scattered fragment of the Goddess of Nature's power, his heart naturally grew itchy, and he wanted to gain more.

The Insect King couldn't help wondering: why would Ares Shang, who seemed so shrewd, proactively mention that this was a scattered fragment of the Goddess of Nature's power? Wouldn't that just make the trade harder?

Or was this still a personal conspiracy targeting him?

The more the Insect King thought about it, the more complicated it became.

Watching the Insect King's outwardly calm yet inwardly conflicted expression, Ares Shang picked up his milk tea and took another gulp.

Why was watching other people struggle with inner conflict so satisfying?

"Why tell me?" the Insect King finally asked.

Ares Shang refilled his cup with milk tea—he hadn't eaten breakfast yet and was hungry. "Because of the Evil God. The Evil God wants to devour the deities, devour our Beast-kin Continent, and even the entire River of Heaven Star. The Goddess of Nature told me about the Evil God's conspiracy, asking us beast-kin to unite, figure out a way to repair the Cage of Gods, and drive the Evil God out of the River of Heaven Star. But what can a tiny beast-kin like me actually accomplish?"

The Insect King was utterly astonished. No matter how he imagined it, he had only come to make a tiny trade today, yet he ended up hearing such... monumental news.

Ignoring the Insect King's expression, Ares Shang continued to ramble on: "I'm not interested in becoming the Beast Emperor, nor do I have the time and energy to unify the entire Beast-kin Continent, and I have zero interest in being a leader. Such a huge matter concerns all the beast-kin across the entire Beast-kin Continent; why should I shoulder it alone? Don't you agree, Your Majesty?"

For a moment, the Insect King didn't know how to respond.

"It just so happens that this Tiger Kingdom Heritage Sharing Convention is taking place, so I figured I'd find a few reliable leaders to inform them of this, and then you all can figure out what to do. If you want a direct audience with the deities, I can take you to see the statue of the Goddess of Nature. Of course, I can't guarantee that the deities will necessarily converse with you. But I think you'd certainly prefer to speak directly with the deities face-to-face rather than through a middleman like me."

At this moment, no matter who looked at Ares Shang's attitude, he didn't look like someone trying to seize power by taking advantage of the situation. Instead, he radiated a lazy vibe, as if he couldn't wait to dump the responsibility onto someone else's back.

"If we fight the Evil God together, will our deities grant us any bestowals?" the Insect King asked probingly.

Ares Shang: "Bestowals? Do you want power, or something else?"

Without the slightest hesitation, the Insect King said, "Power, of course."

Ares Shang: "You can discuss that directly with the deities. In short, whatever you want, negotiate it with the deities yourselves."

The Insect King wore a bizarre expression. They could actually negotiate conditions with deities? Was that for real?

"If you're willing, I can take you to see the statue of the Goddess of Nature right now. You can personally return that waist pendant to the Goddess of Nature; who knows, you might even win her favor," Ares Shang suggested.

The Insect King hesitated once more.

"If you're unwilling, just pretend I never said anything. However, the Goddess of Nature already knows that the power fragment she scattered is on Your Majesty, and yet you have no intention of returning it. Although the Goddess of Nature's divine power declined somewhat after her great battle with the Evil God, still..." Ares Shang smiled, leaving everything unsaid.

The Insect King: *F*ck!*

With extreme shamelessness, Ares Shang added, "I'm an upright person, so I'll lay everything out clearly for you and let you make your own choice. That way, if you and your tribe encounter any bizarre occurrences, you won't be left clueless about the root cause."

The Insect King's expression turned cold. "Are you threatening this king?"

Ares Shang laughed in exasperation. "How is this a threat? I'm clearly stating facts. Actually, the Goddess of Nature is considered quite decent among deities; at least she didn't just forcefully snatch it back, but is willing to negotiate with Your Majesty through me."

Naturally, Shang Feifan wouldn't tell him that in order to suppress and seal the Evil God, many deities didn't even have the strength to reclaim their own power. They were even more terrified that drawing upon their power would alert the Evil God, giving the Evil God a chance to break free from the seal and escape, leaving them with no choice but to hide in the alternate dimension and manipulate the beast-kin to do the dirty work for them.

The Insect King fell silent for a long while before speaking. "The Evil God is gathering Evil God followers. What do you think will happen to these followers?"

Ares Shang bluntly pierced the veil. "You want to ask, if we beast-kin surrender to the Evil God, what benefits will there be, and what will the future of the Beast-kin Continent look like, right?"

The Insect King replied with equal frankness. "Yes. The Evil God and the ancient deities are both strangers to us. If we must serve one side, we naturally have to ask clearly who gives the most benefits."

Ares Shang chuckled and gave a thumbs-up. "As expected of Your Majesty the Insect King, you see things through so clearly."

"Then?"

Ares Shang shifted into a more serious posture. "As far as I know, the Evil God's followers who follow Him never meet a good end. The Evil God doesn't care about them at all; He only wants to devour more energy. Whether it's us beast-kin, the River of Heaven Star, or the deities, all of them are His targets for consumption. Perhaps the Evil God's followers will be left for last? After all, the Evil God still needs pawns to help Him clear out and obstruct the intelligent species on the River of Heaven Star, preventing all the intelligent species of the River of Heaven Star from uniting to resist the Evil God."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第217章 忽悠虫王分享任务 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
“而本土神灵那边，祂们作为天河星的神灵，和天河星的众生灵息息相关。就算神灵并不在乎天河星生灵的生死，但祂们一定在乎天河星本身。祂们想要保护天河星、保住兽人大陆，那本土神灵的目标和我们这些本土生灵的目标就是一致的。”

虫王点头。阿瑞斯商说得道理浅显明了，让人一听就知道利弊。

阿瑞斯商：“现在众神希望我们这些兽人能团结在一起，共同对付邪神和邪神信徒，包括修复神之笼，也许我们会成为炮灰，但……就算我们不投向本土神灵那边，我们也需要解决兽人大陆的地质灾害。而兽人大陆的地质灾害十有九成就是神之笼出现问题引起。”

虫王再次点头。

阿瑞斯商：“所以，既然目标一致，无论我们投不投向本土神灵那一边，我们都需要先拯救自己的大陆，那为什么不和神灵合作？至少我们还能从神灵那里获得一点好处和帮扶。”

虫王深觉有理。

阿瑞斯商笑，忽又道：“也可以选择邪神那边。邪神想要找到前往其他大陆的空间通道，吞噬更多能量以求早日恢复和脱困，祂需要为祂效劳的马前卒。哦，邪神暂时被众神封印起来，祂想要脱困就需要大量能量补充。同样也因为被封印，导致祂无法亲自做这些事，只能通过蛊惑邪神信徒为祂做事。”

“如果有人愿意投靠邪神，为祂找到前往其他大陆的空间通道，也许这些人短时间内都不会死，直到邪神觉得不再需要他们。同样，这些人应该也能从邪神那里获得一点好处。”

虫王深深地看阿瑞斯商，缓声问：“神之笼要怎么修复？”

“好问题！”阿瑞斯商大胆说出自己的推测结果：“我们需要磅礴的生与死的力量。自然之神原本一身司职生与死两职。但黑暗之神出现后，就成了主要司职死亡的神灵。自然之神就主要司职生。所以我们首先就要恢复自然之神和黑暗之神两者的力量。由祂们亲自动手修复神之笼。”

阿瑞斯商一顿：“要么就是我们兽人中有人的天赋技能就是生或者死，只要把他们培养到法神境界，也许他们也能去修复神之笼。”

系统没有任何反应，商非凡在心里微笑，看来他的推测八-九不离十。

否则系统为什么不给他其他神灵的神格碎片，偏偏要给他黑暗之神的，这明显是要他去顶缸。

而郎沐还是命运之子那一世，走的应该是自然之神的生之路，而原本的自然之神很可能接过了黑暗之神的死之职。

原本只是来做一场交易的虫王：“……你真的能带我见到自然之神？”

“的雕像。”阿瑞斯商着重说明。

虫王再三思量，最终：“给我两个兽时。”

他要先去和心腹手下交代一些事，还要见一个人。
chunks.englishText:
"As for the native deities, as deities of the River of Heaven Star, they are inextricably linked to all living beings of the River of Heaven Star. Even if the deities don't care about the life and death of the living beings on the River of Heaven Star, they certainly care about the River of Heaven Star itself. If they want to protect the River of Heaven Star and preserve the Beast-kin Continent, then the goals of the native deities are completely aligned with the goals of us native beings."

The Insect King nodded. The reasoning Ares Shang laid out was simple and clear, allowing anyone to understand the pros and cons at a single hearing.

Ares Shang continued: "Now, the gods hope that we beast-kin can unite to jointly deal with the Evil God and His followers, including repairing the Cage of Gods. Perhaps we will end up as cannon fodder, but... even if we don't side with the native deities, we still need to resolve the geological disasters on the Beast-kin Continent. And nine-tenths of those geological disasters are caused by problems arising in the Cage of Gods."

The Insect King nodded once more.

Ares Shang: "Therefore, since our goals are aligned, regardless of whether we side with the native deities or not, we need to save our own continent first. So why not cooperate with the deities? At least we can still gain a bit of benefit and assistance from them."

The Insect King deeply felt this made sense.

Ares Shang smiled, then added out of nowhere, "Of course, we could also choose the Evil God's side. The Evil God wants to find space channels leading to other continents and devour more energy in order to recover and break free sooner; He needs vanguard pawns to serve Him. Oh, the Evil God is currently sealed by the deities, and He needs a massive replenishment of energy to break free. Because of the seal, He is also unable to do these things personally, and can only rely on bewitching Evil God followers to do His bidding."

"If anyone is willing to surrender to the Evil God and find spatial channels leading to other continents for Him, perhaps these people won't die in the short term—until the Evil God feels He no longer needs them. Likewise, these people should also be able to obtain a bit of benefit from the Evil God."

The Insect King gazed deeply at Ares Shang and slowly asked, "How do we repair the Cage of Gods?"

"Good question!" Ares Shang boldly stated his speculative conclusion: "We need boundless power of life and death. The Goddess of Nature originally held dominion over both life and death. But after the God of Darkness appeared, He became the deity primarily holding dominion over death, while the Goddess of Nature primarily held dominion over life. Therefore, our first step must be to restore the powers of both the Goddess of Nature and the God of Darkness, so they can personally act to repair the Cage of Gods."

Ares Shang paused. "Alternatively, if there are those among us beast-kin whose innate talent skills happen to be life or death, as long as we nurture them to the realm of Saint/Divine Mages, perhaps they too can go repair the Cage of Gods."

The system showed no reaction. Shang Feifan smiled inwardly; it seemed his deduction was roughly eight or nine parts correct.

Otherwise, why wouldn't the system give him the divine spark fragments of other deities, but instead give him that of the God of Darkness? This was clearly intended to make him take the fall.

As for the lifetime when Lang Mu was the Child of Fate, he must have walked the path of life belonging to the Goddess of Nature, while the original Goddess of Nature very likely took over the duty of death from the God of Darkness.

The Insect King, who had originally come just to make a trade: "…Can you really take me to see the Goddess of Nature?"

"The statue, yes," Ares Shang emphasized.

The Insect King pondered it over and over again before finally deciding: "Give me two beast-hours."

He needed to go brief his trusted subordinates on a few matters first, and also meet someone.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第218章 伊曼切斯特来访 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第218章 伊曼切斯特来访

虫王一走，商非凡就颠颠地跑去卧室。

床上已经没人，浴室里传来流水声。

商非凡直接打开浴室门探头进去。

被一条擦背巾给砸了出来。

商非凡乖乖巧巧地把擦背巾又给放回浴室，带上门，下楼准备午饭。

郎沐收拾好下楼，两人在厨房里你踹我一脚，我捏你一下时，又有人找来了。

这次来的是伊曼切斯特。

伊曼看到两人从厨房端菜肴出来，一愣：“你们还没用午膳？”

这个时候已经过了正午。

郎沐看到伊曼，顿了顿，耳中有声音在疯狂大喊。

“是啊。”郎沐有点不好意思，假装进厨房拿主食。

经过商非凡身边时，胳膊肘轻轻撞了撞他。

商非凡迎上伊曼，懒洋洋地打招呼：“你来啦。昨晚睡得迟，今天就起迟了一点。”

伊曼满脸歉意，作势转身：“那我等会儿再来。”

“来都来了，坐吧，一起用点。”商非凡不是很热情地留客。

伊曼也就只是客套两句，等郎沐端来主食后，就一起围着餐桌坐下。

“我父亲没了。”伊曼上来就放大炸-弹。

郎沐拿筷子的手一顿。

商非凡则拿着餐刀慢条斯理地把炸肉排切开，随口应：“哦。怎么没的？”

伊曼不饿，只倒了一杯清水抿了口：“他昨天回来知道家中发生的事，没有大发雷霆，也没有找我质问，就那么安静地把首尾全部扫除干净，还把还活着的几个女儿全都送到了别庄，当场给她们分了一点家产，宣布她们和她们的后代都不会再是切斯特公爵府的继承人。”

商非凡：“嗯，这是要明确继承人，避免继承人之争。你父亲是准备夺舍你了。”

伊曼猜出夺舍的意思，点头：“我那几个姐姐也不敢跟公爵闹，因为她们的公爵父亲跟她们说了，如果不闹，她们还能拿到一部分财产过上富人的生活，公爵府也能给她们一定庇护。如果闹腾，那就什么都没有。

我那几个姐姐原本还希望公爵做主，想为她们死去的丈夫和孩子报仇。我们的公爵父亲就跟她们说，她们的丈夫和孩子包括身边许多仆人都是邪神信徒，证据确凿。”

郎沐和商非凡就静静用餐，听伊曼说他家里昨天和昨夜发生的种种变故。

伊曼：“他那时应该就有所决断。果然，晚上在我睡下后，他悄悄来到我房间，让我跟他去一个地方。我想看看他还有什么花招，也知道逃不掉，就跟他去了。”

商非凡皱眉：“为什么不通知我们？”

伊曼摇头：“来不及。”

商非凡不解：“那你为什么要跑回公爵府？你只要待在大王子府，切斯特就算身为公爵也不敢去强硬把你拖出来。”

伊曼慢慢道：“靠人不如靠己。大王子虽然也想解决切斯特大公，但他没有一个好的理由，我必须给他这个理由，躲着可不行，也会让那位未来的虎王看不起我。

而且我躲着我父亲，只会让他更警觉，我也不确定他是否还有其他容器准备。

如果那老家伙又培育了一个容器，继续当他的公爵怎么办？

他没有大错，连虎王都没办法革去他的爵位和职位，更无法掠夺他的家产。

到时我就会成为丧家之犬，每天都活在会不会被对方捕捉和杀死的痛苦困境中。

与其如此，我还不如搏一搏。对吧？”

商非凡扫过伊曼的脸。

伊曼看向为他设置了精神力防御网的郎沐。

郎沐无奈：“事无绝对，最保险的方法不是乖乖让对方夺舍你的身体，而是应该想办法杀死对方。不过你现在既然能出现在这里，说明你搏赢了？恭喜。”

伊曼笑了笑：“是的，我赢了。他带我进了府里的地下室，就在他的书房下面。那里有一个祭坛，地上还画着一个古怪的阵法。他逼迫我站在阵法中间。我打不过他，只能按照他的吩咐行事。还好，我运气不错，你给我准备的精神力防御网也十分强大，当他的精神体钻入我的精神海，想要抢夺我的身体时，先被精神力防御网击伤，之后又被我反杀。”

商非凡：“看来切斯特大公的精神力并不算很强大。”

“是啊。也是有心算无心，他怎么也没想到我的精神海会有两层精神力防御网。对了，在我反吞噬了他的精神力后，我接收到一些他的记忆。其中有件事，让我很在意。”

“什么事？”商非凡随口问。

伊曼谨慎地：“一个秘密基地。里面似乎隐藏着邪神信徒这么多年在虎国搜刮的财富，另外还有一些他们正在培养的教徒。那里有不少邪神信徒看守。”

“你是想？”

伊曼：“我想邀请你们同去。如果不知道这个地方也就算了，既然知道怎么能轻易放过。不说里面聚集的大量金钱、粮食和各种材料，就是那些正在培养的教徒也应该处理掉，否则将来成长起来又会成为虎国的麻烦。”

“为什么不去找大王子？”商非凡用筷子卷起一大卷炸酱面，笑着问。

伊曼摊手：“如果找他，那里的东西我至少得上交六七成。那还不如找你们，不但我能分成多一些，也能把好处分享给作为朋友的你们。我想你们也不会拒绝那么多好东西吧？我要求不高，一半即可。”

商非凡貌似十分心动：“你打算什么时候去？”

伊曼：“事不宜迟，我想尽快出发。谁也不知道邪神信徒会不会转移那个基地里的东西。”

“也是。”商非凡加快用餐速度，还问郎沐：“阿沐，去吗？就当去捞一笔。”

郎沐：“……好。”

两人把餐桌上的食物一扫而空，就跟着伊曼跑了。

商非凡出门时，还在大门上贴了一张纸条，说明他有点事要处理，争取太阳落山前回来。

狰爷哒哒哒地跑过来。

狰爷这段时间过得特别逍遥，商非凡和郎沐两人在图书馆内一待就是两个月，狰爷就跑黑森林城附近的森林中交朋友去了。

商非凡他们从图书馆出来呼唤它，它就毫不留情地跟新交往的小女友说再见。

小女友也不在乎这个浪子，它只是想要来自其他地方、健康且强大的种子，现在得到了，这个临时男友也没用了。

商非凡和郎沐两人半点不知道狰爷的生活过得有多潇洒，更不知道它已经留了后代在外面。

路途比较遥远，伊曼也骑了一只巨虫坐骑。

两只巨虫坐骑一前一后跑出王城。

那个秘密基地距离王城有一段距离，藏在一片连绵的丘陵中。

伊曼指着那一片丘陵和附近土地介绍：“这是切斯特家的郊外庄园，每年秋季，我们家族子弟和亲朋好友都会到这里来狩猎，有时还会邀请王族。”

这一代的丘陵都不高，只有两三百米，但茂密的植株足够大量野物生活，而且附近除了少数农奴，就没有多少兽人会打扰这里的野物。

平均一两年来清理一次，也能确保这里不会跑出实力强大的野兽。
chunks.englishText:
