Chapter 218: The Visit of Iman Chester (Part 1)

The moment the Insect King left, Shang Feifan scurried toward the bedroom like a happy little dog.

The bed was already empty, and the sound of running water drifted from the bathroom.

Shang Feifan pushed the bathroom door wide open and poked his head inside.

He was promptly pelted right back out by a wet towel.

Obediently, Shang Feifan picked up the towel, put it back inside the bathroom, closed the door, and went downstairs to prepare lunch.

After cleaning up, Lang Mu came downstairs. Just as the two of them were playfully kicking each other and pinching cheeks in the kitchen, another visitor arrived.

This time, the visitor was Iman.

When Iman saw the two of them coming out of the kitchen carrying dishes, he blinked in surprise: "You haven't had lunch yet?"

It was already well past noon.

Seeing Iman, Lang Mu paused for a second, a chorus of voices screaming frantically in his ears.

"Yeah." Feeling a bit embarrassed, Lang Mu pretended to go back into the kitchen to fetch the staple food.

As he passed by Shang Feifan, he gave him a light nudge with his elbow.

Shang Feifan turned to greet Iman with a lazy smile: "You're here. We slept late last night, so we woke up a bit late today."

An apologetic look crossed Iman’s face, and he made as if to turn around: "Then I'll come back later."

"Since you're already here, sit down and have a bite with us." Shang Feifan offered a rather unenthusiastic invitation to stay.

Iman didn't stand on further ceremony. Once Lang Mu brought out the staple food, they all gathered around the dining table and sat down.

"My father is gone." Iman dropped a massive bombshell right off the bat.

Lang Mu’s hand holding the chopsticks froze.

Shang Feifan, on the other hand, leisurely picked up his dining knife to cut his pork cutlet, chiming in casually: "Oh? How did he go?"

Iman wasn't hungry; he just poured himself a glass of plain water and took a small sip: "He came back yesterday, and upon learning what had happened at home, he didn't throw a fit or question me. He just quietly swept up all the loose ends, sent all his surviving daughters off to a countryside villa, distributed a portion of family assets to them on the spot, and announced that neither they nor their descendants would ever again be heirs to the Duke of Chester's estate."

Shang Feifan: "Mmm, that's to clearly establish an heir and avoid a succession struggle. Your father was preparing to possess you."

Guessing the meaning of "possession," Iman nodded: "My sisters didn't dare make a fuss with the Duke, because their ducal father told them that if they stayed quiet, they could still get a portion of their property to live wealthy lives, and the Duke's estate would afford them a certain degree of protection. If they caused a ruckus, they'd get nothing.

My sisters had originally hoped the Duke would take charge and avenge their deceased husbands and children. Our ducal father simply told them that their husbands, children, and many of the servants around them were cultists of the Evil God, and that the evidence was conclusive."

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan dined in silence, listening as Iman recounted the various twists and turns that had transpired in his household yesterday and last night.

Iman: "He must have made up his mind by then. Sure enough, after I went to sleep last night, he quietly came into my room and asked me to go somewhere with him. I wanted to see what other tricks he had up his sleeve, and I knew I couldn't escape anyway, so I went with him."

Shang Feifan frowned: "Why didn't you notify us?"

Iman shook his head: "There wasn't time."

Shang Feifan was puzzled: "Then why did you run back to the Duke's estate? As long as you stayed at the First Prince's mansion, even as a Duke, Chester wouldn't dare drag you out by force."

Iman slowly explained: "Depending on others is never as good as depending on oneself. Although the First Prince also wants to deal with Grand Duke Chester, he lacks a good reason. I had to give him that reason. Hiding wouldn't do, and it would make that future Tiger King look down on me.

Moreover, hiding from my father would only make him more vigilant, and I couldn't be sure if he had other vessels prepared.

What if that old bastard cultivated another vessel and continued being a Duke?

He hasn't committed any major crimes; even the Tiger King wouldn't be able to strip him of his title and position, let alone confiscate his property.

By then, I would become a stray dog, living every day in the agonizing predicament of whether I would be hunted down and killed by him.

Instead of that, I might as well take a gamble. Right?"

Shang Feifan swept a glance across Iman’s face.

Iman looked toward Lang Mu, who had set up a spiritual defense net for him.

Lang Mu sighed helplessly: "There are no absolute certainties in this world. The safest method isn't to obediently let the other party possess your body, but to figure out a way to kill them. However, since you can appear here now, it means you won your gamble? Congratulations."

Iman smiled: "Yes, I won. He took me into the basement of the estate, right beneath his study. There was an altar down there, with a bizarre array drawn on the ground. He forced me to stand in the center of the array. I couldn't beat him, so I had to follow his instructions. Fortunately, my luck wasn't bad, and the spiritual defense net you prepared for me was extremely powerful. When his spiritual body burrowed into my spiritual sea, trying to seize my body, it was first severely injured by the spiritual defense net, and then I counter-killed him."

Shang Feifan: "It seems Grand Duke Chester's spiritual power wasn't all that formidable."

"Indeed. It was also a matter of a prepared mind catching an unprepared one; he never expected my spiritual sea to have a double-layered spiritual defense net. Oh, right, after I counter-devoured his spiritual power, I absorbed some of his memories. There was one matter among them that caught my attention."

"What matter?" Shang Feifan asked casually.

Iman cautiously replied: "A secret base. It seems to conceal the wealth the Evil God's cultists have looted in the Tiger Kingdom over all these years, alongside some acolytes they are currently cultivating. There are quite a few Evil God cultists guarding the place."

"And you want to...?"

Iman: "I want to invite you both to come along. If I didn't know about this place, that would be one thing, but since I do, how can I easily let it pass? Not to mention the massive amounts of money, grain, and various materials gathered inside, even those acolytes being trained should be dealt with, otherwise, if they grow up in the future, they'll become a headache for the Tiger Kingdom."

"Why not go to the First Prince?" Shang Feifan asked with a smile, twirling a large forkful of fried sauce noodles with his chopsticks.

Iman spread his hands: "If I go to him, I'd have to hand over at least sixty or seventy percent of the things there. That's hardly as good as coming to you; not only can I get a larger cut, but I can also share the benefits with you as my friends. I assume you wouldn't turn down so many good things? My demands aren't high; half will do."

Shang Feifan looked intensely tempted: "When are you planning to go?"

Iman: "There's no time to lose; I want to set off as soon as possible. No one knows if the Evil God cultists might transfer the things in that base."

"True." Shang Feifan accelerated his eating pace and asked Lang Mu, "A-Mu, shall we go? Consider it going to make a haul."

Lang Mu: "…Alright."

The two of them swept the food off the dining table clean and rushed off following Iman.

Before leaving, Shang Feifan even slapped a sticky note on the front door explaining that he had some matters to attend to and would try to return before sunset.

Lord Zhen scampered over.

Lord Zhen had been living an exceptionally carefree life lately; Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had spent two whole months holed up in the library, so Lord Zhen had run off to make friends in the forests near Black Forest City.

When Shang Feifan and the others emerged from the library and called for it, it said goodbye to its newly acquainted little girlfriend without a shred of hesitation.

The little girlfriend didn't care about this wandering playboy either; she only wanted healthy and powerful seeds from elsewhere. Now that she had gotten them, this temporary boyfriend was of no further use.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had no inkling of just how carefree Lord Zhen’s life had been, let alone that it had already left offspring out there.

The journey was rather long, so Iman also rode a giant insect mount.

The two giant insect mounts bolted out of the royal capital one after the other.

That secret base was some distance away from the capital, hidden among a stretch of rolling hills.

Iman pointed at that stretch of hills and the nearby land, introducing it: "This is the Chester family's suburban estate. Every autumn, our family members and friends come here to hunt, and sometimes the royal family is invited."

The hills in this generation were not high, only two to three hundred meters, but the dense vegetation was enough to sustain a large amount of game, and aside from a few serfs, very few beastmen disturbed the wildlife here.

Clearing the area once every year or two also ensured that no beasts with formidable strength would wander out.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第218章 伊曼切斯特来访 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
“那个秘密基地就藏在我们家的庄园后方，位于一座山窝窝里。那里外面植被茂密，里面怪石嶙峋，一般人都不会深入那座山。”

伊曼带着两人直接穿过切斯特家的庄园。

里面的仆人和农奴看到来人是伊曼少爷，没有一个人敢阻拦他们。

前面庄园还能看到人，等跑进山林中，那就全都是植物和虫蚁野物的天下。

郎沐看到这么茂密的植被，心里叹息。

这些能长出来的植物都是进化到能抵抗虫毒或已经适应了虫毒，绝大多数都已经和虫毒共存。

但含有虫毒的植物却无法给兽人食用。

而正常的被兽人长时间培育出来的农作物抵抗虫毒的能力却非常差，只能长在被净化后的农田中。

这就导致很多兽人-流落在野外时，如果自身带的干粮不够，就很难在外面获取除肉类以外的食物。

偏偏现在虫毒不断侵蚀还能耕种的土壤，让兽人大陆的可耕种面积越来越小。

食物不充足也是扼制兽人数量上涨的最大原因。

兽人寿命长，也算能生，但食物不充足导致他们不敢生。

“你说如果我们修复了神之笼，能彻底改善虫人大陆的土壤吗？”郎沐低声问身边雄兽人。

商非凡：“神之笼只负责隔绝各大陆的通道和能量流通，应该不负责修复当地水土。”

郎沐想了好一会儿，还是忍不住说：“为什么我觉得兽人大陆的岩浆、地震等灾害就是在清理这块大陆上的虫毒？也许……”

“你没说错，也许这就是这块大陆的自我救赎。”

郎沐哎呀一声，懊悔道：“应该问问系统，当初我那世是怎么解决虫毒的。”

商非凡立刻道：“我现在就帮你问。”

一枚光球突兀地冒出来，飘浮到郎沐肩膀上：【不需要通过商非凡，你有什么事，可以直接问我。】

郎沐看向光球，又看看跑在前面的伊曼。

光球：【不用担心，除了你们和神灵等级的存在，其他任何存在都看不见我。】

郎沐放心了，连忙问：“我那一世，修复了神之笼后，地质灾难就没有发生对么？那兽人大陆水土空气中的虫毒我是怎么解决的？”

光球透露：【你修复了神之笼后，还是发生了一些地质灾难，但都是在你的可控范围内。】

商非凡一听就懂：“所以想要彻底灭绝虫毒，还是需要大地自己发威。那个阿沐是不是把虫毒集中到了某几个地方？”

光球看老商不顺眼，但也不得不承认这个人思维敏捷异常，特别会抓重点和漏洞。

【是。至于虫毒是如何解决的，这跟第三个任务者留下的药剂传承有一定关系。那个郎沐得到了第三个任务者的部分药剂传承，正好是研究如何解决虫毒的。虽然这份研究没有得出明确结果，却给了那个郎沐极大启发。最后结合自然之神的力量以及兽人大陆的自我修复能力，最终消灭了虫毒。】

光球说到这里，只对郎沐说：【我只能告诉你这么多。详细不能说，因为那很可能会影响未来的命运线。】

郎沐理解：“我明白。知道个方向就好。如果什么事都让你告诉我，我直接去拿，就能解决这个世界的危机的话，那前面的三任任务者也不会都失败了。”

光球蹭蹭郎沐，消失。

“系统，等等。”商非凡叫住系统。

光球再度出现。

商非凡：“如果我们对上洛伦米尔顿，你能夺回他的游戏控制权吗？”

光球：【你是指让我抢夺他的游戏系统？】

商非凡：“没错。洛伦米尔顿虽然也搞出了游戏系统，但他这个游戏系统肯定和那个郎沐的游戏系统不一样对不对？洛伦米尔顿的应该没有融合兽人文明的残损主脑，对吗？”

光球：【对。残损主脑和我融合了。洛伦米尔顿用的系统，其基础只是他在某个废墟中找到的兽人文明大繁华纪时研发的普通游戏程序，然后融合了自然之神雕像的大脑部分。】

光球又不屑地说：【伪命运之子就是伪命运之子。】

商非凡：“换言之，你的级别应该比洛伦米尔顿手上的游戏系统级别更高，你可以压制那个系统并控制它？”

光球：【如果你能剔除系统中属于自然之神雕像的大脑部分，斩断洛伦米尔顿和系统之间的精神联系，我甚至可以融合那个系统，变成新的游戏系统，完全脱离洛伦米尔顿的控制。】

“好！”商非凡转头就对郎沐说：“这个游戏系统原本就应该是你的。与其留给洛伦米尔顿增加他的实力，还让玩家成为邪神的马前卒，还不如我们再抢回来。”

光球蓦然亮了亮，在郎沐肩头蹦跶了两下。

郎沐：“……我们先一样样解决。”

商非凡意会地看向前面的伊曼，“嗯，你说得没错，先一个个解决。”

伊曼恰在此时回头，招呼两人：“快到了，那里有人看守，我们得从巨虫上下来，最好能隐身过去。”

商非凡比了个没问题的手势。

有伊曼领路，三人又是隐身状态，很容易就溜进了那个秘密基地。

郎沐还没有靠近这座山，脸上就流露出痛苦表情。

商非凡抬手遮住他的耳朵，还捏了捏。

郎沐拉下他的手。白他，明知道这样做对他没用，你就是想捏我耳朵。

商非凡揉了揉他的短发，轻声说：“别忍着。”

郎沐目光冷冷地投向前面，没说话。

这个秘密基地外围只有少数人看守。

邪神信徒把这座山窝窝给挖空了，挖出了一个巨大的地坑。

地坑上方的口很小，又有特意栽种的茂密植株遮挡，就算有人来到这里，无论从天空上看还是从其他角度看，都无法察觉这座山中间还有一个很深、下面面积很大的大型地坑。

这个秘密基地沿着圆形的山窝窝建成了类似斗兽场的圆形建筑。

四面是一层层往上叠加的石造建筑，中间有一个很大的空地。

圆形的石造建筑中有很多房间，密密麻麻宛如蜂巢。

伊曼也许得到了其父亲记忆的缘故，对这里的路很熟，带着两人七转八转就转到了最中心的房间前。

“这里是整个秘密基地的控制室，只要进去控制了里面的操纵者，这里的一切财富就能让我们任取任求。”

伊曼一边说，手一边伸向门扉上的开关。

“稍等。”一支骨杖挡住伊曼的手。

商非凡幽幽感叹：“你大概对我的天赋技能还不太了解。还没有接近这座山，我就看到这里大量的怨气和死气。你知道类似的怨气和死气，我还在什么地方看到过吗？”

这人显然也不知道郎沐的真实天赋技能。

伊曼一脸疑惑：“这里有大量的怨气和死气？你竟然能看到？不过这里是邪神信徒的秘密基地，这里死过大量的人也很正常吧？”

商非凡摇头：“不是死人的死气，是不死尸的死气。”

伊曼大吃一惊：“什么？不死尸？这里有不死尸？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 218: The Visit of Iman Chester (Part 2)

"That secret base is hidden behind our family's estate, nestled inside a mountain hollow. The vegetation outside is dense, and the rocks inside are jagged and bizarre; ordinary people never venture deep into that mountain."

Iman led the two of them straight through the Chester family's estate.

None of the servants and serfs inside dared to stop them when they saw it was Young Master Iman.

While people could still be seen in the front estate, once they bolted into the mountain forest, it was entirely the domain of plants, insects, ants, and wildlife.

Seeing such dense vegetation, Lang Mu sighed inwardly.

The plants that managed to grow here had all evolved to resist insect venom or had already adapted to it, with the vast majority coexisting with the poison.

Yet, plants containing insect venom could not be consumed by beastmen.

Meanwhile, normal crops carefully cultivated by beastmen over long periods had abysmal resistance to insect venom and could only grow in purified farmland.

This resulted in many beastmen wandering out in the wild who, if their carried rations fell short, found it extremely difficult to obtain any food other than meat outside.

To make matters worse, insect venom was continuously eroding the arable soil, shrinking the cultivable area of the Beastman Continent day by day.

Inadequate food supply was also the single biggest reason keeping the beastman population from rising.

Though beastmen lived long lives and were quite fertile, a lack of food made them too afraid to reproduce.

"Do you think if we repair the Cage of Gods, it can completely improve the soil of the Insect-Man Continent?" Lang Mu whispered to the male beastman beside him.

Shang Feifan: "The Cage of Gods is only responsible for cutting off the passages and energy circulation between various continents; it probably isn't responsible for restoring local soil and water."

Lang Mu pondered for quite a while before he couldn't help saying: "Why do I feel like disasters like magma and earthquakes on the Beastman Continent are actually cleaning up the insect venom on this land? Perhaps..."

"You aren't wrong. Perhaps this is the continent's self-redemption."

Lang Mu uttered an "ah" of regret: "I should have asked the system how my previous lifetime solved the insect venom."

Shang Feifan immediately said: "I'll ask for you right now."

A ball of light abruptly materialized, floating onto Lang Mu's shoulder: [You don't need to go through Shang Feifan. If you have any questions, you can ask me directly.]

Lang Mu looked at the ball of light, then glanced at Iman, who was running ahead.

Light Ball: [Don't worry. Aside from you two and entities at the divine level, no other existence can see me.]

Put at ease, Lang Mu hurriedly asked: "In that lifetime of mine, after the Cage of Gods was repaired, geological disasters stopped happening, right? As for the insect venom in the soil, water, and air of the Beastman Continent, how did I resolve it?"

The light ball revealed: [After you repaired the Cage of Gods, some geological disasters still occurred, but they were all within your controllable range.]

Understanding immediately upon hearing this, Shang Feifan said: "So wanting to completely eradicate insect venom still requires the earth to unleash its own might. Did that A-Mu concentrate the insect venom in a few specific places?"

Though the light ball found old Shang unappealing, it had to admit that this fellow possessed exceptionally agile thinking and was particularly adept at grasping key points and loopholes.

[Yes. As for how the insect venom was resolved, it has a certain connection to the potion inheritance left behind by the third transmigrator. That Lang Mu obtained a portion of the third transmigrator's potion inheritance, which happened to study how to resolve insect venom. Although that research didn't yield a definitive result, it provided that Lang Mu with tremendous inspiration. Ultimately, combining the power of the God of Nature and the self-healing ability of the Beastman Continent, the insect venom was completely eradicated.]

At this point, the light ball spoke solely to Lang Mu: [I can only tell you this much. I cannot go into detail, as doing so would likely affect the future destiny line.]

Lang Mu understood: "I get it. Knowing the general direction is enough. If you were to tell me everything and let me just go pick up the solution to save this world's crisis, then the previous three transmigrators wouldn't have all failed."

The light ball rubbed affectionately against Lang Mu and vanished.

"System, wait." Shang Feifan called out.

The light ball reappeared.

Shang Feifan: "If we go up against Loren Milton, can you seize back his game control?"

Light Ball: [You mean let me snatch his game system?]

Shang Feifan: "Exactly. Although Loren Milton also conjured up a game system, his game system must be different from that other Lang Mu's game system, right? Loren Milton's shouldn't have fused with the damaged master brain of the beastman civilization, correct?"

Light Ball: [Correct. The damaged master brain fused with me. The system Loren Milton uses is fundamentally just an ordinary game program developed during the great prosperity era of the beastman civilization that he found in some ruins, which was then fused with the brain part of the God of Nature's statue.]

With a snort of disdain, the light ball added: [A fake child of destiny is still a fake child of destiny.]

Shang Feifan: "In other words, your tier should be higher than the game system in Loren Milton's hands. You can suppress that system and control it?"

Light Ball: [If you can excise the part of the system belonging to the brain of the God of Nature's statue and sever the spiritual connection between Loren Milton and the system, I can even fuse with that system, transforming into a new game system completely free from Loren Milton's control.]

"Good!" Shang Feifan turned his head and told Lang Mu: "This game system was supposed to be yours in the first place. Instead of leaving it with Loren Milton to swell his strength and let players become pawns of the Evil God, we might as well snatch it back."

The light ball flashed abruptly, hopping up and down twice on Lang Mu's shoulder.

Lang Mu: "…Let's solve things one by one."

With a knowing look, Shang Feifan glanced at Iman ahead, "Mmm, you're right, let's solve them one by one."

Right on cue, Iman turned his head and called out to the two of them: "We're almost there. There are guards ahead; we need to dismount from the giant insects and it's best we turn invisible to sneak past."

Shang Feifan flashed a gesture indicating no problem.

With Iman leading the way and both of them in an invisible state, the trio easily slipped into the secret base.

Even before approaching the mountain, an expression of pain surfaced on Lang Mu's face.

Shang Feifan raised a hand to cover his ears, giving them a gentle squeeze.

Lang Mu pulled his hand down and shot him a sideways glare—knowing full well this trick didn't work on him, he was just looking for an excuse to pinch his ears.

Ruffling Lang Mu's short hair, Shang Feifan said softly: "Don't hold it in."

Casting a cold gaze ahead, Lang Mu remained silent.

Only a handful of guards patrolled the perimeter of this secret base.

The Evil God's cultists had hollowed out this mountain hollow, excavating a massive underground pit.

The opening at the top of the pit was very narrow and concealed by specially planted, dense vegetation. Even if someone came here, whether viewing from the sky or from any other angle, they wouldn't notice that there was a deep, sprawling underground pit right in the middle of this mountain.

This secret base was built along the circular mountain hollow into a colosseum-style round structure.

On all four sides were stone structures stacked tier upon tier, with a vast open space right in the middle.

The circular stone buildings housed countless rooms, densely packed like a honeycomb.

Perhaps due to acquiring his father's memories, Iman was thoroughly familiar with the paths here, leading the two of them through twists and turns right up to the door of the central-most room.

"This is the control room of the entire secret base. Once we go inside and control the operators within, all the wealth here will be ours to take as we please."

As Iman spoke, his hand reached toward the switch on the door panel.

"Hold on a moment." A bone staff blocked Iman's hand.

Shang Feifan sighed softly: "You probably don't know much about my innate talent skill. Before even getting close to this mountain, I saw a massive amount of resentment and deathly aura here. Do you know where else I've seen similar resentment and deathly aura?"

This fellow clearly had no idea about Lang Mu's true innate talent skill either.

Looking utterly bewildered, Iman asked: "There's a massive amount of resentment and deathly aura here? You can actually see it? But this is a secret base of the Evil God's cultists; isn't it normal for a lot of people to have died here?"

Shang Feifan shook his head: "It's not the deathly aura of dead people; it's the deathly aura of the undead."

Iman's expression changed drastically: "What? Undead? There are undead here?!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第218章 伊曼切斯特来访 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡：“这里不止有不死尸，还有很多很多，密密麻麻几乎填塞满了这个秘密基地。”

伊曼脸色丕变：“那怎么办？我们是不是要再多找一些人来？”

商非凡似笑非笑：“你下面是不是就要说你要去找人，让我们在这里小心观察？”

伊曼叹息：“怎么会。当然是我留下，你们去找人。”

伊曼的手快速拍向门扉上的开关。

“冰冻！”

伊曼的手被厚厚一层冰冻住，抬眼就看到抽出骨杖指向他的郎沐。

郎沐面无表情，他的耳朵和大脑中全都是亡者的哀嚎。为了不让自己大脑承受不住，他只能屏蔽这些声音。

商非凡对伊曼笑眯眯地：“刚才一直没让阿沐检查一下你的精神海。主要也是想要看看你要带我们去什么地方。现在我们已经到了地方，那么就让阿沐给你检查一下你还是不是你吧。”

伊曼无奈又困惑：“你们是不是对我有什么误会？我就是伊曼切斯特，不是切斯特大公。你们忘了，我脑中的精神力防御网还是你们帮忙弄的。”

郎沐：“是我弄的。但我没有说那两层精神力防御网就一定能挡住切斯特大公的精神力。”

商非凡问郎沐：“如果切斯特大公已经夺舍伊曼，伊曼的灵魂是不是已经消亡？”

郎沐摇头：“不一定。我布置两层精神力防御网就是为了防止切斯特大公的精神力强过伊曼。如果伊曼自身无法抵御，他至少可以逃到其中一个防御点躲起来。”

“也就是说我们只要解决了这个切斯特大公，就能让伊曼回来？”商非凡笑着晃了晃提着的骨杖。

郎沐：“嗯，只要我击碎他的灵魂。”

伊曼忙喊：“我可以让你们检查，我真的是伊曼，不是切斯特大公。”

突然，商非凡面色一变：“有房间门打开了，不死尸出来了。”

伊曼眼中闪过一丝得意，抬手就扔出一样东西，竟然不顾手臂还被冰冻，撒腿就跑。

商非凡骨杖一抽，抽中那物。

他想抽飞那东西，为了防止爆炸，他都没怎么敢用劲。

但那东西还是砰地一声炸开！

大量烟雾弥漫而出。

整个通道都变得伸手不见五指。

“灵魂束缚！灵魂禁锢！灵魂冰冻！”

一连三个同类魔法，全都是瞬发。

奔跑中的伊曼身体一僵，咕咚摔倒。

倒下时，伊曼切斯特还在心中惊诧这是什么天赋能力。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 218: The Visit of Iman Chester (Part 3)

Shang Feifan: "There aren't just undead here; there are many, many of them, densely packed to the point of almost filling this entire secret base."

Color drained entirely from Iman's face: "Then what do we do? Should we go find more people?"

With a smile that didn't reach his eyes, Shang Feifan said: "Were you about to say you're going to find people, and ask us to stay here and keep watch carefully?"

Iman sighed: "How could that be? Of course it should be me staying behind while you two go find people."

Iman's hand slammed rapidly toward the switch on the door panel.

"Freeze!"

Iman's hand was encased in a thick layer of ice. Raising his eyes, he saw Lang Mu drawing his bone staff and pointing it right at him.

Expressionless, Lang Mu had ears and a mind flooded with the wails of the dead. To keep his brain from overloading, he had no choice but to block out those sounds.

Shang Feifan smiled warmly at Iman: "We didn't let A-Mu check your spiritual sea earlier. Mostly because we wanted to see where you were taking us. Now that we've arrived, let A-Mu check whether you're still you or not."

Helpless yet perplexed, Iman protested: "Do you two have some kind of misunderstanding about me? I am Iman Chester, not Grand Duke Chester. Have you forgotten? The spiritual defense net in my mind was something you guys helped set up."

Lang Mu: "I set it up. But I never said those two layers of spiritual defense nets would definitely block Grand Duke Chester's spiritual power."

Shang Feifan asked Lang Mu: "If Grand Duke Chester already possessed Iman, has Iman's soul perished?"

Lang Mu shook his head: "Not necessarily. I set up a double-layered spiritual defense net precisely to prevent Grand Duke Chester's spiritual power from overpowering Iman's. If Iman couldn't resist on his own, he could at least flee to one of the defense points and hide."

"In other words, as long as we deal with this Grand Duke Chester, we can bring Iman back?" Shang Feifan smiled, swinging the bone staff in his hand.

Lang Mu: "Mmm, as long as I shatter his soul."

Iman hurriedly shouted: "I can let you check! I really am Iman, not Grand Duke Chester."

Suddenly, Shang Feifan's expression shifted: "A room door just opened, and the undead are coming out!"

A flash of triumph crossed Iman's eyes. Tossing out an object, he bolted without a care that his arm was still frozen solid, running for his life.

Shang Feifan whipped his bone staff forward, striking the object.

He wanted to bat the thing away, but for fear of triggering an explosion, he didn't dare use much force.

Yet the object still went *bang* and detonated!

A massive cloud of smoke billowed out.

The entire corridor instantly became so thick with fog that one couldn't see their own hand in front of their face.

"Soul Bind! Soul Imprisonment! Soul Freeze!"

Three identical magic spells cast back-to-back, all instantly triggered.

Mid-stride, the running Iman stiffened and crashed hard to the ground with a dull thud.

Even as he collapsed, Iman Chester was still inwardly reeling in shock over what kind of innate ability this was.

chunks.chineseText:
第219章 剥削不死尸

“驱散雾霾！”

一阵大风吹过楼道，把所有遮眼又呛人的浓雾送出楼体。

视线重新变得清晰。

商非凡抓起伊曼切斯特扔进雕像广场，他们现在没时间处理这家伙，只能等会儿再说。

不死尸闻到活人味就向这边冲过来。

但商非凡把气息一转，又给郎沐也罩了一层，顿时不死尸就失去了目标，开始在楼道里游荡起来。

少数几声惊叫传来，但很快就没了声音。

“那应该是守在这里的邪神信徒。”商非凡感觉到新的死气。

郎沐懊恼：“我们一路上盯着他，也没见他做手脚，他怎么就放出了那么多不死尸？”

“也许他进来时就已经暗中通知了这里的邪神信徒和他配合。”商非凡看向那所谓的总控室。

“这大约就是打开所有房间大门的总开关？”郎沐也看向门扉上的开关。

“我们进去看看。”商非凡示意。

郎沐就带着商非凡施展穿墙术，直接进入了那间房间。

房间里空空荡荡，只有一张石台。

石台上也只摆放了一样物品。

商非凡挑眉，走到石台前，拿起那钥匙状的物品。

郎沐：“一样？”

商非凡拿出另外一把融合钥匙，和这把钥匙对比：“一模一样。”

“你想要试着融合这把钥匙？”郎沐一看商非凡的表情就知道他在想什么。

商非凡胆子大，但也不代表他会毫无顾忌地做任何事情。

已知两把钥匙融合就能听到邪神的广播，那么融合第三把钥匙会发生什么事？

会不会让邪神直接注意到他？

哦，邪神说不定已经注意到，但邪神力量还没办法延伸到他身上。

可如果媒介足够多，那么是不是邪神力量就会顺着钥匙爬过来？

光球冒出来：【这东西我知道，这是真神教高级信徒的身份证明，也是真神教高层与邪神沟通的工具。据说，把这钥匙放在身边，邪神就能知道你是否背叛祂。】

商非凡问：“只要是高级信徒都能拥有这种钥匙？”

【当然不。这种钥匙还需要特殊贡献才能得到，在真神教内是一种非常荣誉的身份证明，表明这个人已经被厄穆克拉索看入眼。】

“那这是切斯特大公的钥匙？”

【不一定，放在这里，也有可能是用来聆听邪神教诲，甚或用来镇压这里的不死尸。】

光球见商非凡拿着钥匙抛上抛下，忍不住说：【建议把这种钥匙献祭给诅咒之神。】

“为什么要献祭给诅咒之神，就不能献祭给黑暗之神吗？”商非凡把玩着钥匙，不像是开玩笑。

光球：【那也要等你吸收融合了那枚黑暗之神的神格碎片以后，而且还要神格碎片承认你的神位。但你现在距离成为神灵还远得很。不是说你吸收了神格碎片就能成为神灵，最起码也要等你达到法神。】

“也就是说我现在献祭给黑暗之神，什么效果都没有？”

【对。献祭会失败。】

商非凡转手就收起钥匙，也没说献祭的事。

光球看商非凡的样子就知道他另有想法，但这个人主意太正，它能影响，也不多，只能看向郎沐。

郎沐却笑了笑，打圆场说：“这东西具体有什么作用，可以再看看，倒也不急着献祭。平时阿商就把这东西放到雕像广场里，这样也不担心这东西会联系到邪神。”

光球很想插腰。原命运线内，郎沐可相信它了，商非凡就是后来者。可现在郎沐显然更相信商非凡，甚至明知有危险也愿意跟着他一起胡闹。

“外面那么多不死尸怎么办？”郎沐问起正经事。

商非凡似有所感，又拿出之前的钥匙：“没错。这把钥匙里含有邪神力量，不死尸就是被这把钥匙的力量镇压。当我收起这把钥匙后，不死尸就开始往外面走。”

郎沐脸色一变：“这虽然是天坑，但高度也不算高，两百多米的高度，要不了多久，那些不死尸就能爬出去。”

“也许还有另外的通道。”商非凡又问光球：“在原郎沐的命运线内，这里可出现这么多不死尸？”

光球：【在原命运线内，虎国没有召开传承分享大会，安妮塔也没有把雷米尔推上王位，但虎国王城仍旧在同时期遭到四名邪神阴影者的攻击，同一时间段，邪神信徒献祭大量生命让邪神意识成功降临到容器中，不死尸也跟着攻入王城。

二王子、三王子、切斯特大公等人带着亲信逃出王城。

虎国王城眼看就要陷落，大量玩家赶到，和不死尸大战。郎沐、虎王、大都督狮域则联手对上邪神的神降之体。

因为那具神降之体只拥有邪神一点点力量，加上刚降临，身体和庞大的精神力融合还不够好，伊曼切斯特本人意识抗争得也很厉害，最终被三人联手打死，邪神意识脱离那具神降之体。

但伊曼切斯特的灵魂也被邪神的意识消磨掉。

那场大战之后，虎国王城几乎被摧毁，虎王和大都督重伤，郎沐利用任务奖励救回两人。

不死尸扩散，痊愈的虎王等人一心对付不死尸，对虎国领土的掌控力降至最低。

切斯特大公在他的领地推举三王子成为新的虎王。

那是虎国最混乱也最黑暗的一段时期。】

郎沐沉思，下意识问出：“那为什么这次真神教只派出四名邪神阴影者，却没有让不死尸同时攻击王城？”

光球还没回答，商非凡就先说道：“因为人手不够，真神教无法按照原计划施行。”

商非凡进一步解释：“首先，想要邪神成功降临，需要献祭大量生命，但我们多次搜查王城，加上玩家配合，对王城内的邪神信徒扫荡过一次又一次，挖出了好几个重要钉子，更摧毁了几个重要祭坛。这些人和地点原本应该是大型献祭的重要一环，而没有这些人的配合，大型献祭就不可能。”

郎沐恍然大悟。

“其次，没有足够生命献祭，邪神意识和邪神的些许力量想要顺利降临到容器中就不容易。更重要的是，神降到容器中也需要媒介。可我们把媒介，那枚邪神之卵给截获了。神降计划自然也就跟着失败。”

商非凡又接着道：“王城内没有大乱，不死尸就难以攻破王城外围守护。再加上没有人接应，那么多不死尸根本不可能从城外跑到王城城墙下还没有人发现。”

商非凡又转而看向光球：“如果我所料不错，原先命运线中，大量不死尸之所以能攻入王城，应该是有人把它们先一步带入了王城，对不对？”

光球默认。

郎沐全都明白了：“我们拔除了真神教在王城内的大量人手，其中更有不少权势者和富商，他们是最容易带入不死尸也不会让人发现的人。现在这些人没了，这些不死尸也就难以再混入城中。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 219: Exploiting the Undead Corpses (Part 1)

"Scatter the smog!"

A gust of wind swept down the corridor, driving all the blinding, choking, dense fog out of the building.

Vision became clear once more.

Shang Feifan grabbed Yimanchester and threw him into the statue plaza; they didn't have time to deal with this fellow right now and would have to wait until later.

Catching the scent of living humans, the undead corpses rushed toward them.

However, Shang Feifan shifted his aura, wrapping another layer over Lang Mu as well. Instantly, the undead corpses lost their target and began to wander aimlessly about the corridor.

A few scattered shrieks rang out, but they were quickly cut short.

"Those must be the cultists of the Evil God who were guarding this place," Shang Feifan sensed a fresh wave of death aura.

Lang Mu said with vexation, "We kept our eyes on him the entire way here, and we never saw him pull any tricks. How did he release so many undead corpses?"

"Perhaps he had already secretly notified the Evil God's cultists here to coordinate with him before he entered." Shang Feifan looked toward the so-called master control room.

"Is this roughly the master switch that opens all the room doors?" Lang Mu also looked at the switch on the door panel.

"Let's go in and take a look," Shang Feifan signaled.

Lang Mu then brought Shang Feifan along, executing a wall-crossing technique to enter the room directly.

The room was empty, save for a stone platform.

Only a single item rested upon the stone platform.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow, walked up to the stone platform, and picked up the key-shaped object.

Lang Mu asked, "The same?"

Shang Feifan produced another fusion key and compared it with this one: "Identical."

"Do you want to try fusing this key?" Lang Mu knew what he was thinking the moment he saw Shang Feifan's expression.

While Shang Feifan was bold, it didn't mean he would act recklessly without any reservations.

It was already known that fusing two keys allowed one to hear the Evil God's broadcast; what would happen if a third key was fused?

Would it cause the Evil God to take direct notice of him?

Well, the Evil God might have already noticed him, but the Evil God's power couldn't reach him yet.

However, if there were enough conduits, would the Evil God's power crawl its way over along the keys?

The orb of light popped out: [I know about this thing. This is proof of identity for high-ranking cultists of the True God Cult, as well as a tool for the high echelons of the True God Cult to communicate with the Evil God. It is said that keeping this key by your side allows the Evil God to know whether you have betrayed Him.]

Shang Feifan asked, "Does any high-ranking cultist get to have a key like this?"

[Of course not. Such a key requires special contributions to acquire. Within the True God Cult, it is a very prestigious proof of identity, indicating that this person has caught the eye of Eumuclaso.]

"Then is this Chester's key?"

[Not necessarily. Placed here, it could also be used to listen to the Evil God's teachings, or even to suppress the undead corpses here.]

Seeing Shang Feifan tossing the key up and down, the orb of light couldn't help chiming in: [It is recommended to sacrifice this kind of key to the God of Curses.]

"Why sacrifice it to the God of Curses? Can't it be sacrificed to the God of Darkness?" Shang Feifan played with the key, not sounding like he was joking at all.

The orb of light: [That would have to wait until after you absorb and fuse with that God of Darkness divine spark fragment, and furthermore, the divine spark fragment must acknowledge your divine throne. But you are still a long way from becoming a deity. It's not as simple as absorbing a divine spark fragment to become a god; at the very least, you have to reach the level of a Mage God.]

"In other words, if I sacrifice it to the God of Darkness right now, it will have zero effect?"

[Correct. The sacrifice will fail.]

Shang Feifan simply tucked the key away without another word about the sacrifice.

Seeing his attitude, the orb of light knew he had other ideas, but this person was too headstrong. Its ability to influence him was minimal, so it could only look toward Lang Mu.

Lang Mu, however, merely smiled and smoothed things over, saying, "As for what specific functions this thing has, we can check later; there's no rush to sacrifice it anyway. A-Shang can just keep this thing inside the statue plaza normally, so we won't have to worry about it connecting to the Evil God."

The orb of light desperately wanted to put its hands on its hips. In the original timeline, Lang Mu had trusted it implicitly, and Shang Feifan had been the newcomer. But now, Lang Mu clearly trusted Shang Feifan more, and even knowing there was danger, he was willing to go along with his reckless antics.

"What should we do about all those undead corpses outside?" Lang Mu brought up the serious business.

Seeming to sense something, Shang Feifan took out the previous key again: "That's right. This key contains the Evil God's power, and the undead corpses were suppressed by it. The moment I put this key away, the undead corpses began wandering outward."

Lang Mu's expression shifted: "Although this is a sinkhole, it's not terribly deep—a little over two hundred meters. It won't take long for those undead corpses to climb out."

"Perhaps there is another passage." Shang Feifan asked the orb of light again: "In the original Lang Mu's timeline, did this many undead corpses appear here?"

The orb of light replied: [In the original timeline, the Tiger Kingdom did not hold the inheritance sharing convention, nor did Anita push Remir to the throne, yet the Tiger Kingdom's royal capital was still attacked by four Evil God Shadowers around the same time. During that exact period, Evil God cultists sacrificed a massive amount of life to successfully descend the Evil God's consciousness into a vessel, and the undead corpses charged into the royal capital alongside them.

The Second Prince, Third Prince, Grand Duke Chester, and others fled the royal capital with their trusted aides.

With the Tiger Kingdom's royal capital on the verge of falling, a large number of players arrived to wage a fierce battle against the undead corpses. Lang Mu, the Tiger King, and Grand Marshal Shiyu joined forces to confront the Evil God's divine incarnation.

Because that divine incarnation possessed only a fraction of the Evil God's power, and having just descended, its body and massive spiritual power were not yet sufficiently fused—coupled with fierce resistance from Yimanchester's own consciousness—the three of them ultimately beat him to death together, causing the Evil God's consciousness to break away from that divine incarnation.

However, Yimanchester's soul was also worn away by the Evil God's consciousness.

After that great battle, the Tiger Kingdom's royal capital was nearly destroyed. The Tiger King and the Grand Marshal were severely injured, and Lang Mu used quest rewards to save them both.

With the undead corpses spreading, the recovered Tiger King and the others focused single-mindedly on dealing with the undead corpses, causing their grip on the Tiger Kingdom's territory to drop to an all-time low.

Grand Duke Chester promoted the Third Prince as the new Tiger King within his own territory.

That was the most chaotic and darkest period in the Tiger Kingdom's history.]

Lang Mu pondered and instinctively asked, "Then why did the True God Cult only dispatch four Evil God Shadowers this time, without having the undead corpses attack the royal capital simultaneously?"

Before the orb of light could answer, Shang Feifan spoke up first: "Because manpower was lacking, and the True God Cult couldn't execute their original plan."

Shang Feifan explained further: "First of all, for the Evil God to successfully descend, a massive amount of life must be sacrificed. But through our repeated searches of the royal capital, coupled with the players' cooperation, we swept through the Evil God cultists in the royal capital time and time again, unearthing several critical nails and even destroying several important altars. Those people and locations were supposed to be vital components of the large-scale sacrifice. Without their cooperation, a large-scale sacrifice was simply impossible."

Lang Mu came to a sudden realization.

"Secondly, without enough life to sacrifice, it wasn't easy for the Evil God's consciousness and a sliver of His power to smoothly descend into a vessel. More importantly, divine descent into a vessel requires a medium. Yet we intercepted that medium—the Evil God's egg. Naturally, the divine descent plan failed along with it."

Shang Feifan continued, "Without massive chaos in the royal capital, it would be difficult for the undead corpses to breach the outer defenses of the city. Add to that the lack of anyone to receive them, and there was no way so many undead corpses could run from outside the city all the way to the royal capital's walls without anyone noticing."

Shang Feifan turned his gaze back to the orb of light: "If my guess is right, the reason a large number of undead corpses were able to storm the royal capital in the original timeline was because someone brought them into the royal capital ahead of time, am I right?"

The orb of light conceded in silence.

Lang Mu understood everything: "We rooted out a massive number of the True God Cult's operatives within the royal capital, among whom were quite a few people of power and wealthy merchants—they were the ones best positioned to sneak the undead corpses in without attracting notice. Now that these people are gone, it's virtually impossible for these undead corpses to blend into the city anymore."

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡点头：“九成就是如此。真神教的人眼见邪神阴影者的攻击失败，神降也没有成功，他们自然不会再冒险放出大量不死尸。虽然放出不死尸会让虎国王城手忙脚乱一阵，但在主战斗力没有被摧毁、且有那么多厉害兽人也在虎国王城的情况下，这些不死尸根本不可能会扰乱虎国，反而可能会被虎国消灭一空。”

“于是真神教就留下了这批不死尸，打算以后有好的机会再放出去？”郎沐接口：“而切斯特大公显然是安排这些不死尸的关键人物。他为了对付我们，故意带我们前来这里，想要让我们死在不死尸的围攻下。”

事情弄清楚，接下来的事情就好办了。

商非凡利用那把钥匙继续镇压这座天坑里的不死尸，不让它们离开天坑建筑范围。

光球很上道地发布了一个消灭不死尸的任务，根据不死尸的等级，每消灭一个不死尸，分别奖励1到3个贡献点。

“我和郎沐能组队吗？”商非凡忽然问光球。

光球也就是没有眼睛，否则一定会翻大大的白眼给商非凡看。

【任务者商非凡和其伴侣郎沐进入组队状态。在没有特殊说明下，此组队状况永远生效。郎沐的功绩会作为任务者小队成员之一，一并计算。】

商非凡笑容特别灿烂：“那么我以后和其他人合作，是否也能算组队？”

光球硬邦邦地扔出一句话：【请从游戏商城购买组队道具。】

商非凡表示自己要求不高，能组队就行，同时希望系统为了大义不要把组队道具卖得太贵。

光球：呸！

无耻的商非凡发现他可以利用黑暗能量操纵这把钥匙来控制不死尸……就是用黑暗能量激发这把钥匙附带的震慑作用，逼迫那些不死尸回到原先关它们的房间中。

商非凡就把这些不死尸全都驱赶回房间，然后一个房间接着一个房间地开始消灭这些不死尸。

不死尸最大的威力就是感受不到疼痛、无法轻易杀死。尤其当它们的数量无穷无尽时，再厉害的人都无法对付，累都能累死。

而现在商非凡把最大威胁的数量给控制住了。

如此一来，原本可以达到地狱级难度的任务副本，一下就降到了普通级别。

更不要说商非凡身边还带着一个实力已经达到魔导师境界的爱侣。

这两人蹲在天坑里轻轻松松刷贡献点。

王城那边，一堆人在苦苦等候他们。

虫王下定决心，去郎府找两人时，看到门上贴着的消息条，先还以为那两人是不是故意吊他胃口。

好在他的下属打听到消息，知道是虎国唯二的大公切斯特的雄子亲自上门来找两人，并和两人一起骑巨虫出城，应该是真的有事要办。

虫王只能回去贵宾居住的地方等待。

这一等就是整整四天。

传承分享大会都结束了。

要不是大佬们都想得到虫毒祛除药剂，他们早就拿着传承返程。

大王子等虎国重臣看这些大佬们不肯离开，一边担心一边窃喜，趁着这个机会又去找他们商谈，从贸易到科技到土地到边防到武器，只要能谈的就尽量谈。

这次传承分享大会，虎国看起来很吃亏，凭白送出去那么多知识和技术。

实际上虎国着实获得了不少好处。

除了交换来的大量资源。

有些有纷争的边境线，重新确定了，都是对虎国有利的新判定。

有些有争议的领地，也重新划分，同样对虎国有利。

其他可耕种土壤和粮食的交易，还有材料和各专业大师的流通，交通要道敞开，税收下降乃至免税，只要利用得好，虎国国力很快就会飞速上涨。

虎国上层乐滋滋，其他大佬心焦焦，都在骂那个伊曼切斯特把人带到哪里去了，更有性子比较暴躁的，直接去找大王子等人，让他们去寻找伊曼切斯特。

还有人直接去找切斯特大公，却发现切斯特大公对外宣称闭关，暂不会客。

有人还打听到切斯特大公府的一些内部变化，聪明人都能感觉到切斯特大公府似乎要变天。

大王子担心伊曼切斯特，也派人去大公府询问情况，想要求见切斯特大公，都被挡了回来。

商非凡和郎沐也没办法，那么多不死尸，就算全都站在那里任他们一个个砍脑袋，那也得砍上半天。

更何况这些不死尸等级都不低，最差也有二级的实力，最强则达到六级，比商非凡的实力还高一等。

好在商非凡在融合了黑暗之火火种后，对怨气、死气之类的黑暗能量就有了别样的亲昵。

不死尸看到商非凡就跟看到自己尸一样，不但不会攻击他，被商非凡攻击了，也不知道还击。

商非凡解决这些不死尸时，感觉自己良心都疼了。

如果不是这些不死尸都带着毒，放出去容易感染一大片，商非凡都想把这些不死尸收到自己的空间里，留着当攻击武器使用。

不过两人也没有白白消耗四天时间。

在解决这些不死尸时，商非凡也不知是接触死气过多，还是频繁使用黑暗能量的缘故，他在第三天突地进入顿悟状态。

等他从顿悟状态清醒过来，他已经彻底融合了黑暗之火的火种，并对黑暗能量有了更深刻的了解。

不知不觉间，他的天赋技能恶咒从五级升到了六级，力大无穷升到五级，瞳术也顺利进入四级。

之前瞳术显示是初级，当他和系统重新签订合作契约后，他的天赋技能和职业技能的等级就全都重新划分，一律按照一到九级来划分。

最让他高兴的是，他领悟了两个新技能。

他可以利用咒术和黑暗能量，把一个活人直接转变成不死尸。

而且还是没有传染性尸毒的不死尸。

这种被强行转变的不死尸会保留生前的记忆和能力，并绝对效忠他。

另外一个技能则是献祭。

通过献祭生命或其他能量，可以让他的实力大涨。

而且这个献祭不需要他亲自动手，只要有人死亡，他就能吸收死气和怨气等所有负面能量充实自身。

商非凡领悟了这两个技能后就不由感叹：“怪不得黑暗之神让众神和众生那么忌惮和厌恶，祂的能力真的太可怕。”

掌握了这两个技能的商非凡，直接就拿天坑里的不死尸练手。

他不需要再一一砍掉这些不死尸的脑袋，再焚烧它们的尸体，而是直接吸收它们的死气和所有负面能量。

被他吸收完能量的不死尸转眼间就化成烂泥。

商非凡见不死尸变成烂泥，先还觉得恶心，心想怎么不干脆化成灰烬。

但郎沐检查这些烂泥后，发现这些烂泥不但没有任何不死尸毒素，连虫毒都没有，就是很优质的营养土，可以用来肥沃田地后，郎沐就毫不嫌弃地把这些烂泥都收进了他的随身花圃中。

商非凡：“……也好。”这可真是半点不浪费，他们夫夫俩也算是把这些不死尸给剥削到家了吧。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 219: Exploiting the Undead Corpses (Part 2)

Shang Feifan nodded. "Nine times out of ten, that's how it is. Once the people of the True God Cult saw that the Evil God Shadowers' attack had failed and the divine descent had not succeeded, naturally they wouldn't take the risk of releasing a large number of undead corpses. Although unleashing the undead corpses would throw the Tiger Kingdom's royal capital into a flurry for a while, as long as their main combat forces weren't destroyed and with so many formidable beastmen present in the royal capital, these undead corpses would never throw the Tiger Kingdom into disarray; instead, they'd likely be wiped out entirely by the kingdom."

"So the True God Cult simply left this batch of undead corpses behind, intending to release them later when a good opportunity arose?" Lang Mu took over the conversation. "And Grand Duke Chester was clearly the key figure orchestrating these undead corpses. To deal with us, he deliberately led us here, hoping we would die in the siege of the undead corpses."

With the matter figured out, everything that followed became much easier.

Shang Feifan used the key to continue suppressing the undead corpses in this sinkhole, preventing them from leaving the boundaries of the sinkhole structure.

The orb of light, knowing how things worked, conveniently issued a quest to eliminate the undead corpses. Depending on the tier of the undead corpse, eliminating each one would reward 1 to 3 contribution points respectively.

"Can Lang Mu and I form a party?" Shang Feifan suddenly asked the orb of light.

If the orb of light had eyes, it definitely would have rolled them to the back of its head at Shang Feifan.

[Questee Shang Feifan and his partner Lang Mu have entered a party state. Unless otherwise specified, this party status remains permanently in effect. Lang Mu's achievements will be calculated collectively as a member of the questee squad.]

Shang Feifan's smile was exceptionally brilliant. "Then if I cooperate with other people in the future, will that also count as partying?"

The orb of light flatly tossed out a sentence: [Please purchase party items from the game mall.]

Shang Feifan expressed that his demands weren't high—as long as they could party, that was fine. At the same time, he hoped the system wouldn't sell the party items for too exorbitantly high a price for the sake of the greater good.

The orb of light: *Bah!*

The shameless Shang Feifan discovered that he could use dark energy to manipulate this key to control the undead corpses... specifically, by using dark energy to stimulate the deterrent effect attached to the key, forcing those undead corpses back into the rooms where they were originally confined.

Shang Feifan drove all these undead corpses back into their rooms, and then began eliminating them room by room.

The greatest terror of undead corpses lay in their inability to feel pain and the difficulty of truly killing them. Especially when their numbers were infinite, no matter how formidable a person was, they couldn't handle it and would simply be exhausted to death.

Yet now, Shang Feifan had capped the volume of the greatest threat.

As a result, a quest instance that could have reached hellish difficulty instantly dropped to normal level.

Not to mention that Shang Feifan had a lover by his side whose strength had already reached the realm of a Grand Magus.

The two of them squatted in the sinkhole, farming contribution points with utter ease.

Back in the royal capital, a crowd of people was waiting anxiously for them.

When the Insect King made up his mind to visit the Lang residence to find the two men, seeing the message note posted on the door, he initially thought the pair was deliberately whetting his appetite.

Fortunately, his subordinates gathered information, learning that it was actually the biological son of Chester, one of the only two Grand Dukes of the Tiger Kingdom, who had personally come to find the two men and ridden giant insects out of the city with them. It seemed they genuinely had business to attend to.

The Insect King had no choice but to return to the VIP lodgings to wait.

And wait he did, for a full four days.

The inheritance sharing convention had already concluded.

If not for the fact that all the bigshots were desperate to acquire the insect toxin purging potion, they would have already packed up their inheritances and headed home.

Seeing these bigshots refusing to leave, the First Prince and other high-ranking officials of the Tiger Kingdom were caught between worry and covert joy. Seizing the opportunity, they approached them again for negotiations—ranging from trade, technology, and land to border defense and weaponry; as long as it was negotiable, they talked about it as much as possible.

During this inheritance sharing convention, the Tiger Kingdom looked like they were getting the short end of the stick, casually giving away so much knowledge and technology.

In reality, the Tiger Kingdom had genuinely reaped massive benefits.

Aside from the vast quantities of resources traded in return, certain disputed borderlines were re-demarcated with new rulings that favored the Tiger Kingdom.

Controversial territories were also re-divided, likewise to the kingdom's advantage.

Other transactions involving arable soil, grain, materials, the circulation of specialized grandmasters, open arterial transportation routes, and lowered or even waived taxes—if utilized well, the Tiger Kingdom's national strength would soon experience explosive growth.

The upper echelons of the Tiger Kingdom were brimming with glee, while the other bigshots were burning with anxiety, cursing wherever Yimanchester had dragged those two off to. More hot-tempered individuals even went straight to the First Prince and company, demanding they hunt down Yimanchester.

Some went directly to Grand Duke Chester's estate, only to find that he had announced he was in closed-door seclusion and would not be receiving guests for the time being.

Others caught wind of internal changes within Grand Duke Chester's mansion, and anyone with half a brain could sense that a storm was brewing over the estate.

Worried about Yimanchester, the First Prince also dispatched men to the Grand Duke's residence to inquire about the situation and request an audience with Grand Duke Chester, only to be turned away both times.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had no choice in the matter; with so many undead corpses, even if they all stood there and let them slice off their heads one by one, it would still take half a day.

Furthermore, none of these undead corpses were low-leveled; the weakest possessed Tier 2 strength, while the strongest reached Tier 6, putting them a tier higher than Shang Feifan himself.

Fortunately, after fusing with the seed of the dark fire, Shang Feifan developed a peculiar affinity for dark energies such as grievances and death aura.

When the undead corpses looked at Shang Feifan, it was like looking at one of their own kind. Not only did they refuse to attack him, but even when attacked by Shang Feifan, they didn't even know how to retaliate.

As Shang Feifan dealt with these undead corpses, his conscience actually started hurting.

If not for the fact that all these undead corpses carried poison and releasing them would easily infect a massive area, Shang Feifan would have loved to scoop them all into his spatial storage and keep them as offensive weapons.

Still, the two of them hadn't wasted these four days.

While disposing of the undead corpses, whether due to coming into contact with death aura too often or the frequent use of dark energy, Shang Feifan suddenly entered a state of epiphany on the third day.

By the time he snapped out of his epiphany, he had completely fused with the seed of the dark fire and gained a profound understanding of dark energy.

Unbeknownst to him, his innate skill 'Malediction' had leaped from Level 5 to Level 6, 'Superhuman Strength' rose to Level 5, and his 'Pupil Technique' smoothly entered Level 4.

His pupil technique had previously been displayed as beginner level, but once he re-signed the cooperation contract with the system, the levels of his innate skills and professional skills were all reclassified, uniformly graded from Level 1 to Level 9.

What made him the happiest was that he had comprehended two new skills.

Through spells and dark energy, he could directly transform a living human into an undead corpse.

And it would be an undead corpse free of contagious corpse venom.

An undead corpse forcibly transformed this way would retain its memories and abilities from life, while possessing absolute loyalty to him.

As for the other skill—Sacrifice.

By sacrificing lives or other forms of energy, he could dramatically boost his own strength.

Moreover, this sacrifice didn't require him to do the killing himself; as long as anyone died within range, he could absorb all negative energies such as death aura and grievances to empower himself.

Having comprehended these two skills, Shang Feifan couldn't help but sigh, "No wonder the God of Darkness is so dreaded and loathed by gods and mortals alike. His abilities are truly terrifying."

Having mastered these two skills, Shang Feifan directly used the undead corpses in the sinkhole as practice dummies.

He no longer needed to hack off the heads of each undead corpse individually and burn their remains; instead, he could directly absorb their death aura and all negative energy.

The undead corpses whose energy had been sucked dry instantly dissolved into mud.

At first, seeing the undead corpses turn into mire, Shang Feifan found it rather disgusting, thinking to himself why they couldn't just turn to ashes instead.

However, after inspecting the mire, Lang Mu discovered that not only did this mud contain zero undead corpse toxins, but it was completely free of insect toxins as well—it was simply top-tier nutrient-rich soil that could be used to fertilize farmland. Without a shred of squeamishness, Lang Mu scooped all of that mire straight into his portable flower garden.

Shang Feifan: "……Fair enough." Truly, not a single scrap went to waste; he and his husband had practically exploited these undead corpses down to their very bones.

chunks.chineseText:
等商非凡把天坑里数量将近三万的不死尸的能量全部吸收后，他的恶咒等级再次飞跃，从六级蹿到了七级。

短短四天，连升两级。

在游戏世界这很正常，还很慢。

但在现实世界，这就很夸张了。

但商非凡也知道这种机会非常难得，以后恐怕再也没有这样能顺顺当当吸收三万名不死尸全部能量的机会。

如果有，那兽人大陆也危险了。

最后一名不死尸变成烂泥被郎沐收入随身花圃。

商非凡吐气：“总算结束。”

快速升级是很爽，但他因为一开始不熟练，只能一个个抽取能量，那过程真的是超级累。

而且重复劳动真的很无聊。

好在后来他技术熟练后，慢慢就从一个变成三个、再变成五个，后来十个一起也没问题，只要里面的不死尸实力等级没有超过他。

“早知我就发布任务让玩家来干活。”

“别得便宜还卖乖了。真要让玩家来，你恐怕也不会愿意。”郎沐鄙视他。

商非凡无耻道：“我可以组队嘛。他们负责杀，我负责吸收能量。”

“这里要留着吗？”郎沐环视这个环形建筑。

能在天坑底下搞出这么大一个建筑也不容易，感觉就这么摧毁有点可惜。

如果是在地星，这里绝对能搞出一个五星级的旅游景点。

“留着吧，交给大王子。随便他以后用来做什么。”商非凡不在意地说。

两人正准备离开。

商非凡忽然脚步一顿。

“怎么？还有什么？”郎沐警惕地问。

商非凡转头看偌大的环形建筑，眼中有怀疑：“你说这里只是一个藏兵洞吗？”

郎沐：“难道不是？”

商非凡：“切斯特大公可是说这里有很多物资。”

“那不是故意骗我们上钩的谎话吗？”

“如果不是呢。你想，这里有这么多不死尸，就算有人发现了这里，也难以攻破。换言之，如果在这里藏有大量物资，别人想要夺取也轻易夺取不了不是？”商非凡眼睛特别亮。

郎沐仔细一想，深觉有理，再看这座环形建筑，顿时觉得这里面肯定还另有乾坤。

商非凡：“真神教在虎国潜伏这么长时间，在王城附近耕耘日久，这么长时间他们一定收集了大量物资，可这些物资都去了哪里？而且他们要举事搞事，总也要有物资支援吧，这些物资都在哪里？”

郎沐心跳也加快了。

商非凡还特意把光球叫出来问它知不知道这个地点。

光球表示原命运线中，郎沐和玩家都没有发现这个天坑。

光球这样说，郎沐还没有觉得什么。

但商非凡却感觉怪怪的，他总觉得这个光球是不是知道得太多太详细。

命运之神能窥探到这么详细的命运线吗？连这种小事都能窥探到？还这么连贯？

就好像光球亲身经历过郎沐原先的那条命运线。

还有光球对郎沐的好感。

虽说阿沐很好，光球会喜欢他很正常。

但光球原先只是一个莫得感情的系统，就在和他签约后，突然就变得灵动起来，连感情都丰富许多，并迫不及待一样变成光球跑出来，还想方设法接近郎沐。

这真的只是一点好感度就能形成？

商非凡盯着光球。

看，这家伙又去蹭郎沐了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 219: Exploiting the Undead Corpses (Part 3)

By the time Shang Feifan absorbed all the energy from the nearly thirty thousand undead corpses in the sinkhole, his Malediction skill experienced another leap, soaring from Level 6 to Level 7.

In just four days, he had advanced two levels consecutively.

In a gaming world, this was perfectly normal—even rather slow.

In the real world, however, it was sheer exaggeration.

Yet Shang Feifan also knew that such an opportunity was exceptionally rare; he probably wouldn't ever encounter another chance to smoothly absorb the entire energy reserves of thirty thousand undead corpses like this again.

If he did, the Beastman Continent would truly be in grave danger.

The final undead corpse melted into mire and was collected by Lang Mu into his portable flower garden.

Shang Feifan let out a breath: "It's finally over."

Leveling up quickly felt amazing, but because he wasn't skilled at first and had to extract the energy one by one, the process had been super exhausting.

On top of that, repetitive labor was genuinely boring.

Fortunately, once he grew proficient with the technique, he gradually progressed from one to three, then five, and eventually handling ten at once posed no problem—provided the undead corpses inside didn't exceed his own power tier.

"If I'd known, I would've just issued a quest for the players to do the grunt work."

"Don't play the hypocrite after getting all the benefits. If you'd really let the players loose here, you probably wouldn't have liked it either," Lang Mu said with disdain.

Shang Feifan shamelessly replied, "I could've formed a party, though. They'd handle the killing, and I'd handle absorbing the energy."

"Are we leaving this place as it is?" Lang Mu surveyed the circular structure.

It couldn't have been easy to engineer such a massive structure deep beneath a sinkhole; destroying it just like that felt rather a waste.

If they were back on Earth, this place could easily be turned into a five-star tourist attraction.

"Leave it be, and hand it over to the First Prince. He can do whatever he likes with it later," Shang Feifan said indifferently.

The two of them turned to leave.

Shang Feifan's footsteps suddenly paused.

"What's wrong? Is there something else?" Lang Mu asked, on guard.

Shang Feifan turned back to look at the massive circular structure, a hint of suspicion in his eyes: "Do you really think this is just a troop-storage cavern?"

Lang Mu asked, "Isn't it?"

Shang Feifan countered, "Grand Duke Chester claimed there were plenty of supplies here."

"Wasn't that just a deliberate lie to trick us into taking the bait?"

"What if it wasn't? Think about it—with this many undead corpses here, even if someone stumbled upon this place, breaching it would be nearly impossible. In other words, if a massive hoard of supplies were hidden here, wouldn't it be exceptionally difficult for anyone else to seize them?" Shang Feifan's eyes lit up brightly.

Thinking it over carefully, Lang Mu felt it made profound sense. Staring back at the circular structure, he instantly felt there had to be more hidden depths to this place.

Shang Feifan noted, "The True God Cult has lurked in the Tiger Kingdom for so long, cultivating their influence near the royal capital for ages. Over such a long period, they must have amassed a massive stockpile of supplies. But where did all those supplies go? Moreover, if they're planning to stage an uprising and make trouble, they've got to have material backing. Where are those supplies kept?"

Lang Mu's heartbeat accelerated as well.

Shang Feifan even deliberately called out the orb of light to ask if it knew about this location.

The orb of light stated that in the original timeline, neither Lang Mu nor the players had ever discovered this sinkhole.

Lang Mu hadn't thought much of it when the orb of light said that.

However, Shang Feifan felt something was off. He always had a creeping suspicion that this orb of light knew far too much, and far too in-detail.

Could the God of Fate really peer into a timeline with such granular detail? Even down to minor matters like this? And with such absolute continuity?

It felt almost as if the orb of light had personally lived through Lang Mu's original timeline.

And then there was the orb of light's affection toward Lang Mu.

Granted, Ah-Mu was wonderful, and it was normal for the orb of light to grow fond of him.

But the orb of light had originally been a system devoid of emotion; yet the moment it signed a contract with him, it suddenly turned lively, its emotions grew vastly richer, and it practically couldn't wait to manifest as an orb of light and pop right out, even racking its brains to cozy up to Lang Mu.

Could all of that really stem from just a sliver of affection?

Shang Feifan stared at the orb of light.

Look, the little bastard was rubbing against Lang Mu again.

chunks.chineseText:
第220章 收获

两人看着被堆放在干燥山洞里的大量物资，商非凡抬手，郎沐笑着跟他击掌。

就在这座隐藏了三万活尸的斗兽场型建筑的一楼，两人找到一个完全不起眼的房间，推开这座房间里的壁橱，打开了一扇门。

门后连接着山体原本的山洞。

这个山洞阴冷无比，却异常干燥，没有通常山洞的潮湿。

走往里走了一点，就看到了一座天然空洞的巨大山腹，山腹里放满了包括粮食、武器、衣物、药剂和材料之类的大量物资。

能顺利找到这个藏宝洞，多亏了郎沐的天赋。

他能听到亡者的声音。

商非凡解决了不死尸后，剩下的尸体就都是邪教信徒的。

郎沐很清晰地听见这些尸体临死前最在意的事情。

有些尸体在为死时的痛苦哀嚎，还有些尸体则不断重复自己记忆最深刻的事情。

郎沐听到一具尸体不停地重复“物资、看守、洞穴”这些词汇，就精准对这具尸体施展灵魂类魔法。

而这具尸体的灵魂还没有完全涣散，在郎沐的引导下，就说出了藏宝洞的进出口地点。

满山腹的物资数量极为庞大，单粮食这一项，就足够三五万人吃上一个月。

商非凡扫过堆成箱以及放在筐里的大量炼金材料，露出微笑。

郎沐正想说要么把这些物资都送给大王子，就听商非凡开口：“正好，我们以后笼络玩家很需要资源，有这些东西，至少短期内不用担心付不出任务奖励。另外你那片租借领地也需要好好收拾，与其强行打下那些村落镇子，还不如用收买的方式，你觉得呢？”

郎沐这才想起他们以后说不定也有一大群人要养，当即点头：“就按你说的办。”

反正这些物资都是耐摆放的，粮食都没有脱壳。

商非凡手头别的不多，就空间储存道具特别多，他拿出几个手镯，分门别类把这些物资一一扫入相应的手镯中，再把这几个储物工具放入雕像广场。

自从手中储物道具多了后，商非凡就对自己的库存做了一次大整理。

考虑到他是如何进入雕像广场，为了防止也有人用同样的方法进入雕像广场，商非凡没有再把物资随便放，而是略微藏了藏。

以前雕像广场里就那么随便地摆放了大量物品，现在所有东西都被收拾起来。

广场再次变得空荡荡，就算有谁有幸闯到这里，也很难发现那些被商非凡特意隐藏起来的空间储物道具。

等把山腹里的物资全部收拾完，心细的郎沐扯了扯商非凡的衣服，指向山腹一角：“你看那里的石头堵塞得是不是有点怪？”

商非凡抬头看，看到一个被石头堵塞住的小洞口。

走近查看，先看石块，再看地面。

商非凡二话不说，上前就去拖拽那些堵塞洞口的石块。

沉重的石块被一块块搬开，露出一个只能让成年人弯腰进入的小型洞口。

商非凡拉住郎沐，自己先一步钻进去，过了一会儿才在里面招呼郎沐也进来。

里面是个洞中洞，就洞口比较小，但里面的空间并不小，是一个大约三十平米的空洞。

这个空洞中同样堆了不少箱子。

商非凡正打开这些箱子查看。

进来的郎沐探头过去看，倒抽一口冷气。

这些箱子里放的都是钱！

最后，两人统计出，这个洞里共计有：铜达铢一百箱，银达鲁五十箱，金达盾二十箱，全都每箱一万枚。

这笔资金对于能炼制空间道具的商非凡来说，不算巨多。

但白来的钱财，还是能让普通人一夜暴富的钱财还是让两人开心不已。

“这趟真没白来，感谢切斯特大公。”商非凡真心实意地说。

郎沐忽问：“系统那边的结算出来了吗？”

商非凡满脸笑容地点头，之前最后一个不死尸被消灭掉，系统就通知他任务完成，获得总贡献值47200点，超级大丰收。

以前做任务，他从没有获得过这么多贡献点。

如果是以前的系统，八成不会这么给他计算贡献值，只会按照一个完整任务给他扔个百八十贡献点意思意思。

现在大概是重新订了契约，以前贡献值还需要和玩家等级那边挂钩，现在则完全没有了这个需要，系统直接给他大放水。

这么多贡献点，他能把自己和郎沐头发丝都武装起来。

商非凡乐滋滋地想。

他还打开系统商城，想要当场给郎沐买个装备玩玩。

结果系统商城一打开，还没等他开始搜索他想要的商品，就见几行金光闪闪的大字，就生怕他看不见一样，主动推到他面前。

【黑暗能量修炼法则初级篇，贡献点一百】

【黑暗能量修炼法则中级篇，贡献点五千】

【黑暗能量修炼法则高级篇，贡献点一万】

【黑暗能量修炼法则成神之路，贡献点十万】

【黑暗之火火种的培育和使用方法，贡献点三千】

【一粒土壤。传说这是某位土系法神从某位神灵后花园里偷出来的土壤精华，原本想要用在自己身上，却不幸战死，后这粒土壤落到诸神战场，成为某神的战利品之一。价格一万贡献点。】

商非凡：“……”敢情在这里等着我呢。

既然打算走黑暗之神这条路——他没打算成神，但对掌握黑暗能量这条路非常感兴趣，比咒术还要让他喜欢。

毕竟咒术虽好，还是有一定局限性。

可黑暗能量就不一样了，它的应用范围更广。

等到商非凡把黑暗能量修炼法则初、中、高三篇以及黑暗之火使用法全都买下，脑中初步灌入这些知识后，他才发现他对黑暗能量的理解还是太过片面。

谁说黑暗能量就只能吞噬、腐蚀、毁灭？

黑暗能量修炼法则告诉你，世上只有不会使用黑暗能量的人，就没有黑暗能量做不到的事情。

比如黑暗能量同样可以用于治疗。

伤口、毒素、生病，这些都会让患者体内生出黑暗能量。只要把这些黑暗能量拔除，让患者自身的自愈力占到上风，那恢复起来自然也十分迅速。

必要时，黑暗能量甚至能让伤患身体维持在某一种状态，不会让情况变得更为恶劣。

黑暗能量还可用于驱邪。

都是同一个组织的存在，想要驯服和劝离那不比敌对势力更容易？

就比如咒术，很多人都拿咒术没办法，要解除咒术，要么找到施咒者，要么找到非常特殊的神圣属性物品。

但如果你掌握了黑暗能量，直接就能把咒术给吞噬甚至是献祭掉。

总之修炼黑暗能量，好处多多。

三篇修炼法则把黑暗能量夸出了花，似乎远超自然之力等其他力量。

甚至在高级篇的最后还提到黑暗能量修炼到极致，还能由死转生。

不过这部分内容要拿到【成神之路】那一篇才有详细叙述。

商非凡睁开眼睛。

从他查看商城、到买下黑暗能量修炼法则，再到大致过一遍，前后也就十分钟不到。
