Chapter 220: The Spoils (Part 1)

Looking at the massive stockpile of supplies piled high inside the dry cavern, Shang Feifan raised a hand, and Lang Mu smilingly gave him a high-five.

Right on the first floor of the colosseum-like building that had concealed thirty thousand living corpses, the two of them had discovered an utterly inconspicuous room. Pushing aside the wardrobe inside, they unlocked a hidden door.

Behind the door lay a passage connecting directly to the mountain's natural cave system.

The cavern was bone-chillingly cold, yet exceptionally dry, completely lacking the dampness usually found in underground caves.

Walking a little deeper in, they laid eyes on a gigantic, naturally hollowed-out mountain belly, which was packed to the brim with vast quantities of provisions, weapons, clothing, potions, and crafting materials.

Successfully finding this hidden cache was thanks entirely to Lang Mu’s innate talent.

He could hear the voices of the dead.

Once Shang Feifan had dealt with the undead corpses, the remaining bodies belonged without exception to the cultists.

Lang Mu had clearly overheard what weighed most heavily on these corpses' minds at the moments of their deaths.

Some corpses wailed in the agony of their demise, while others endlessly repeated the things etched deepest into their memories.

Hearing one particular corpse continuously mutter the words "supplies," "guards," and "cave," Lang Mu precisely cast a soul-type magic upon it.

Though the corpse’s soul had not yet completely dissipated, under Lang Mu’s guidance, it revealed the location of the cache's entrance and exit.

The volume of supplies filling the entire mountain belly was astronomical. The food alone was enough to feed three to fifty thousand people for a whole month.

Shang Feifan swept his gaze over the massive piles of alchemical materials packed into crates and baskets, a smile spreading across his face.

Just as Lang Mu was about to suggest sending all these supplies to the First Prince, he heard Shang Feifan say, "Right on time, we’ll desperately need resources to win over the players in the future. With these goods, we at least won't have to worry about failing to pay out quest rewards in the short term. Besides, that leased territory of yours needs a proper cleanup too; rather than forcibly conquering those villages and towns, buying them out might be much better. What do you think?"

Lang Mu only then remembered that they might also have a massive crowd of people to feed in the future, and immediately nodded: "We'll do as you say."

Anyway, these supplies had a long shelf life, and the grain hadn't even been threshed yet.

Shang Feifan had no shortage of things, but spatial storage items were particularly abundant. He pulled out several bracelets, categorized and swept all the supplies one by one into their corresponding bracelets, and then deposited these storage tools into the Statue Square.

Ever since he had acquired a plethora of spatial tools, Shang Feifan had thoroughly reorganized his inventory.

Considering how he had entered the Statue Square in the first place, and to prevent anyone else from using the same method to break in, Shang Feifan no longer left his supplies lying around carelessly, instead concealing them slightly.

Previously, a massive quantity of items had been haphazardly scattered all over the Statue Square, but now everything had been tidied away.

The square was once again left wide open and empty; even if someone were fortunate enough to stumble in here, it would be extremely difficult for them to discover the spatial storage items that Shang Feifan had purposely hidden.

Once all the supplies in the mountain belly were packed away, the meticulous Lang Mu tugged at Shang Feifan’s sleeve and pointed toward a corner of the cavern: "Look over there, don't those blocking stones look a bit strange?"

Shang Feifan looked up and spotted a small opening blocked off by rocks.

Approaching to inspect, he checked the stones first, then the ground.

Without a second word, Shang Feifan stepped forward and began hauling away the boulders blocking the opening.

The heavy stones were removed one by one, revealing a small tunnel just large enough for an adult to crawl through crouching down.

Shang Feifan held Lang Mu back, slipping inside first, before calling out for Lang Mu to join him a moment later.

Inside was a cave within a cave. While the entrance was relatively small, the interior space was by no means cramped—it was a hollow chamber measuring around thirty square meters.

This chamber was similarly stacked with numerous crates.

Shang Feifan opened these chests to inspect their contents.

Lang Mu, who had just squeezed in, peeked over and gasped sharply.

These chests were filled entirely with money!

In the end, the two tallied up the contents of this cave: one hundred boxes of bronze Da-zhu, fifty boxes of silver Da-lu, and twenty boxes of gold Da-dun, each box containing a staggering ten thousand coins.

For Shang Feifan, who was capable of refining spatial artifacts, this sum of wealth wasn't astronomical.

Yet, money that fell into one's lap out of nowhere—wealth enough to make an ordinary person rich overnight—still brought immense joy to the two of them.

"This trip was truly not in vain. My thanks to Grand Duke Chester," Shang Feifan said with absolute sincerity.

Lang Mu suddenly asked, "Has the system settlement come through yet?"

Shang Feifan nodded with a broad smile. The moment the very last undead corpse had been wiped out, the system had notified him of the quest's completion, granting a total Contribution Value of 47,200 points—an absolute bumper harvest.

In all his past quests, he had never acquired so many contribution points.

Under the old system, it most likely wouldn't have calculated his contribution this way; it would have simply thrown him a measly eighty or a hundred points for a completed quest just to humor him.

Now, with the contract presumably renegotiated, contribution points that previously needed to be tied to player levels no longer required any such thing. The system was simply opening the floodgates for him.

With this many contribution points, he could arm himself and Lang Mu down to the very hairs on their heads.

Shang Feifan thought gleefully to himself.

He even opened the system store, wanting to buy Lang Mu a piece of equipment on the spot to play with.

As a result, the moment the system store opened, before he could even begin searching for the items he wanted, several lines of glowing golden characters were thrust right in front of him, as if afraid he wouldn't see them.

[Elementary Guide to Dark Energy Cultivation, 100 Contribution Points]

[Intermediate Guide to Dark Energy Cultivation, 5,000 Contribution Points]

[Advanced Guide to Dark Energy Cultivation, 10,000 Contribution Points]

[Path to Godhood: Dark Energy Cultivation, 100,000 Contribution Points]

[Methods for Cultivating and Utilizing the Dark Flame Seed, 3,000 Contribution Points]

[A Grain of Soil. Legend has it that this is the soil essence stolen by a certain Earth-element God of Law from the back garden of a certain deity. He originally intended to use it on himself, but unfortunately fell in battle. Later, this grain of soil drifted onto the Battlefield of the Gods, becoming the spoils of war of a certain deity. Price: 10,000 Contribution Points.]

Shang Feifan: "..." So you were waiting right here for me.

Since he intended to walk the path of the God of Darkness—he didn't plan on actually becoming a god, but he was immensely interested in the path of mastering dark energy, liking it far more than spellcasting.

After all, as wonderful as curses were, they still had certain limitations.

Dark energy, however, was entirely different; its scope of application was far wider.

By the time Shang Feifan purchased the elementary, intermediate, and advanced guides to dark energy cultivation along with the dark flame usage method, and had these pieces of knowledge forcefully poured into his mind, he realized how terribly one-sided his previous understanding of dark energy had been.

Who said dark energy could only devour, corrode, and destroy?

The dark energy cultivation guides told him that in this world, there was no such thing as someone who couldn't use dark energy; there was only dark energy that couldn't accomplish what was asked of it.

For instance, dark energy could equally be applied to healing.

Wounds, toxins, illnesses—these all gave birth to dark energy within a patient's body. As long as one purged this dark energy and allowed the patient's own self-healing vitality to take the upper hand, recovery would naturally be remarkably swift.

When necessary, dark energy could even maintain a wounded patient's body in a specific state, preventing the condition from worsening.

Dark energy could also be used to exorcise malevolent forces.

Since they originated from the same organizational entity, wasn't taming and persuading them to leave far easier than dealing with hostile forces?

Take curses, for example. Many people were utterly helpless against curses; to lift a curse, one either had to find the caster or locate an extremely rare divine-attributed item.

Yet if one mastered dark energy, they could directly devour or even sacrifice the curse away.

In short, cultivating dark energy brought countless benefits.

The three cultivation guides praised dark energy to the heavens, making it seem far superior to natural forces and other powers.

The end of the advanced guide even mentioned that if dark energy was cultivated to the absolute extreme, one could transition from death back to life.

However, that particular section of content would only be detailed in the [Path to Godhood] guide.

Shang Feifan opened his eyes.

From checking the store to purchasing the dark energy cultivation guides, and skimming roughly through them, less than ten minutes had passed in total.

chunks.chineseText:
这时他还不能说已经掌握黑暗能量，只能说大致了解。

郎沐看到商非凡睁开的眼眸，心中微凛。

商非凡的眼眸变得更为黝黑，瞳孔最中心似乎还有一点暗红，又像是火焰。

而且不知道是不是他的错觉，他总觉得商非凡的瞳孔似乎比之前更大了一圈。

“这个给你，刚才任务的报酬。”商非凡拿出一样物品塞入郎沐手中。

郎沐打开手中小盒子，看到里面一粒不到拇指指甲盖大的小小颗粒。

光球跳出来，蹦到小盒子上：“这是我给你特意准备的，神灵凝练出来的土壤精华，可以放到你的随身花圃里。会有惊喜哦。”

商非凡：价值一万贡献点的一粒土壤，如果没有大惊喜，我一定打死你！

如果是其他东西，郎沐可能还会拒绝，但是这东西，他就不客气了。

他对随身花圃很用心，潜意识总觉得这东西会对恢复兽人大陆的水土有极大帮助。

郎沐也没多想，当即就把这粒土壤放入随身花圃。

这粒土壤刚落入花圃，整个花圃就开始剧烈翻滚起来。

不到一会儿，郎沐的意识竟然被弹出花圃，整个花圃都自我封闭起来。

光球：【花圃是不是有变化了？别担心，这是在进化，等到结束，你就可以照常使用它。】

商非凡只看郎沐表情，也知道这粒土壤买的很值。

不过光球那态度就有点让人讨厌了。

明明是他们俩自己赚的贡献点买下了这粒土壤，结果搞得像是光球特意把这粒土壤送给郎沐一样。

光球不知道是否感知到瞪视自己的阴森森目光，在返回商非凡体内时，留下一句且只给商非凡听到：【那粒土壤精华原本价值十万点。】

商非凡：“……”

也是，能被神灵当做战利品收藏的东西，又岂是普通货色？

不过这种“上司”宝物低售暗中讨好他伴侣的感觉，怎么就那么糟糕呢？

他感觉自己脑门有点绿。

郎沐这会儿心神大部分都在随身花圃上，也没注意到老商神情变化，就是觉得这人刚才还兴致勃勃，现在忽然变得有点蔫蔫的，以为他累了。

“我们回去吧，先休息一晚，明天去见虫王他们。”郎沐心疼商非凡。

这四天对付不死尸，商非凡说是和他轮换，实际几乎都没怎么休息，一直用死气笼罩着他，不让任何一名不死尸主动扑向他。

“嗯。”商非凡握住郎沐自然伸过来的手，心里舒坦了。

系统就算再喜欢郎沐又如何，还不是只能看着！

商非凡探头，在郎沐脸上吧唧了一口。

我的。

不够，又啄一下。

郎沐无奈，按住他的嘴唇：“别闹了，赶紧回去。我可不想跟你在这里……”

郎沐没说完，脸红。

商非凡眼睛一亮，一拉郎沐：“走！回家。”

这里不行，那家里肯定行啦。

可惜商非凡的打算落空。

两人刚回到郎府，就被虫王留在那里的侍者发现，并把消息传给了虫王。

虫王去找阿瑞斯商不久，其他大佬也很快知道了阿瑞斯商回来的消息，派人盯梢郎府的可不止虫王一个。

商非凡看到再次找上门的虫王，一腔心火无处发。

他理亏啊。

人家堂堂虫王跟他约好两个小时后见，结果他因为那些不死尸整整耽搁了四天。

也就是虫王被他说的事情吊住了胃口，加上身为王者性格还算豁达，阿瑞斯商身上又有虫王想要的东西，否则人早就回东大陆，让阿瑞斯商自己去找他。

现在人亲自找上门来，不用商非凡开口说话，郎沐就主动招待起贵客。

郎沐还是护卫的打扮，脸也是易容后的脸。

但这些大佬哪个会不知道郎沐的真实身份？

就算一开始不知道，当阿瑞斯商带着这名护卫堂而皇之地住进郎府后，也都知道了。

阿瑞斯商就算再混蛋，也不可能带着新情人住进郎府，除非他想跟郎家不死不休。

虫王对郎沐很客气。

他听了一些关于拉斐尔郎沐的事情，对虎王的做法也很是嗤之以鼻。

原本虫王对虎王还有些同阶的敬佩，但知道他搞出换子之事后，就觉得这位王很没有担当。

即无法笼络好自己的妻子，让自己妻子完全倒向自己。又管不住自己的下半身，还搞出了私生子。

最后竟然还为了保护私生子，祸害牺牲功臣的独生子。

无论哪一点，都让虫王很是看不起同为雄性的虎王。

兽人世界不少地方并不是一夫一妻制，有些王族的生活也异常荒唐，但人家好歹荒唐得明明白白，从不遮掩。

虎王却是又当又立，偏偏他位高权重，战斗力也非凡，这就让几位比较洁身自好的大佬对其私德很是看不顺眼。

而虫王会对郎沐客气，并不是同情他曾经的遭遇，而是佩服他在那样糟糕的环境下还能让自己成长为堂堂正正的人，遇到欺凌羞辱也不是一味躲避后退，而是进退有据，该报复就报复。

更不要说郎沐还吸引了阿瑞斯商这样的人。

通常被多人追求、被厉害的人追求的人总是会引起别人的关注，这就跟有人争抢的东西总是好的一样。

虫王等大佬在不了解郎沐的情况下，自然也会从郎沐的追求者身份上去掂量郎沐的价值。

这对郎沐有点不公，但这也算是潜在规则，任何人都难以避免，何况郎沐也不在意这点。

“这枚宝石腰坠可以交易给你。”虫王开门见山。

商非凡也不想多折腾，“你想要什么？”

虫王毫不犹豫地说：“我想见到自然之神……的雕像。”

商非凡干脆地道：“可以。你甚至可以自己把这枚腰坠献给雕像。”

虫王眼睛亮了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 220: The Spoils (Part 2)

By this time, he could not yet claim to have truly mastered dark energy; he could only be said to have a rough understanding of it.

Seeing Shang Feifan open his eyes, Lang Mu felt a slight chill in his heart.

Shang Feifan’s eyes had grown even darker, and at the very center of his pupils seemed to lurk a tiny speck of dark red, resembling flickering flames.

Moreover, whether it was his imagination or not, he always felt that Shang Feifan’s pupils were a circle larger than before.

"Here, take this. Payment for the quest just now." Shang Feifan produced an item and shoved it into Lang Mu’s hand.

Lang Mu opened the small box in his palm, revealing a tiny grain smaller than a thumbnail.

The ball of light popped out, bouncing onto the small box: "I prepared this specially for you. It's soil essence condensed by a deity, which can be placed inside your portable garden. There will be surprises waiting for you, oh."

Shang Feifan: A grain of soil worth ten thousand contribution points—if there isn't a huge surprise, I'll definitely beat you to death!

If it were anything else, Lang Mu might have refused, but for this item, he stood on no ceremony.

He had poured immense care into his portable garden, subconsciously feeling that this item would be of tremendous help in restoring the soil and water of the Beastman Continent.

Without overthinking it, Lang Mu immediately placed this grain of soil into his portable garden.

The moment the grain of soil dropped into the garden, the entire plot began to churn violently.

Before long, Lang Mu’s consciousness was actually ejected from the garden, and the entire garden completely sealed itself off.

The Ball of Light: [Is the garden undergoing some changes? Don't worry, it's evolving. Once it's finished, you'll be able to use it as usual.]

Just by looking at Lang Mu’s expression, Shang Feifan knew this grain of soil had been well worth the purchase.

However, the ball of light's attitude was rather grating.

Clearly, it was the two of them who had earned the contribution points to buy this grain of soil, yet it made it sound as though the ball of light was bestowing it upon Lang Mu as a special favor.

Whether the ball of light sensed the dark, murderous glare fixed upon it, as it scurried back into Shang Feifan’s body, it left behind a parting remark meant for Shang Feifan's ears alone: [That grain of soil essence was originally worth one hundred thousand points.]

Shang Feifan: "..."

Well, that was true. Anything kept as a trophy by a deity could hardly be ordinary goods.

Yet why did this feeling of an "inferior" boss selling treasures at a discount to secretly curry favor with his partner feel so utterly wretched?

He felt as though a faint shade of green was blooming across his forehead.

With the majority of Lang Mu’s focus currently tied up in his portable garden, he failed to notice the sudden shift in Lao Shang’s expression, simply assuming that the man had been full of vigor just a moment ago and had now wilted because he was tired.

"Let's head back. We'll rest for the night first, and go see the Insect King and the others tomorrow." Lang Mu felt a pang of heartache for Shang Feifan.

Over the past four days spent dealing with the undead corpses, although Shang Feifan claimed they were taking turns, in reality he had barely rested at all, constantly shrouding Lang Mu in death energy to prevent any single undead corpse from lunging at him.

"Mm." Shang Feifan gripped Lang Mu’s naturally extended hand, and his heart settled comfortably.

So what if the system favored Lang Mu? In the end, it could only watch helplessly!

Shang Feifan leaned in and planted a smack on Lang Mu’s cheek.

Mine.

Not enough, so he pecked him again.

Helpless, Lang Mu pressed a hand against his lips: "Stop messing around, let's get back quickly. I don't want to be with you here..."

Before Lang Mu could finish, his face flushed crimson.

Shang Feifan’s eyes lit up, and he tugged at Lang Mu: "Let's go! Home."

If they couldn't do it here, then home would definitely do.

Unfortunately, Shang Feifan's plan fell through.

The moment the two returned to the Lang Residence, they were spotted by the Insect King's stationed retainer, who immediately relayed the news to the Insect King.

Shortly after the Insect King went to discuss matters with Ares Shang, the other big shots quickly learned of Ares Shang's return. The ones sending people to keep tabs on the Lang Residence were far more than just the Insect King.

Seeing the Insect King who had sought him out once more, Shang Feifan had a bellyful of fiery frustration with nowhere to vent.

He was in the wrong, after all.

The dignified Insect King had arranged to meet him in two hours, yet because of those damn undead corpses, he had been delayed for a full four days.

If the Insect King hadn't been thoroughly hooked by the matters Shang Feifan had hinted at, coupled with an easygoing disposition suiting a ruler, and the fact that Ares Shang possessed things the Insect King desperately wanted, the man would have long since returned to the Eastern Continent and told Ares Shang to track him down himself.

Now that the person had come knocking in person, before Shang Feifan could even open his mouth, Lang Mu took the initiative to entertain the distinguished guest.

Lang Mu was still dressed in guard's attire, his face bearing a disguise.

Yet which of these bigwigs wasn't aware of Lang Mu's true identity?

Even if they hadn't known from the start, the moment Ares Shang brought this guard brazenly to live in the Lang Residence, they all knew.

No matter how much of a bastard Ares Shang was, he wouldn't bring a new lover to stay at the Lang Residence unless he wished to fight a war of annihilation with the Lang family.

The Insect King treated Lang Mu with great courtesy.

Having caught wind of some past affairs concerning Raphael Lang Mu, he held a profound disdain for the Tiger King's actions.

Originally, the Insect King had retained a peer's respect for the Tiger King, but upon learning that the latter had engineered the swapping of their sons, he deemed this monarch utterly devoid of responsibility.

He was incapable of keeping his own wife in line, letting her completely turn her back on him; nor could he keep his lower body under control, siring an illegitimate child.

And in the end, to protect that illegitimate child, he had actually backstabbed and sacrificed the only son of a meritorious veteran.

No matter how one looked at it, the Insect King looked down with extreme contempt upon the Tiger King, a fellow male.

While many places in the beastman world did not practice monogamy, and the lives of certain royal clans were exceptionally dissolute, at least those people lived their dissolute lives openly without ever hiding it.

The Tiger King, however, insisted on playing the hypocrite while demanding a pedestal, yet wielded immense authority and extraordinary combat strength, making his personal morality deeply unpalatable to several relatively self-respecting heavyweights.

As for why the Insect King treated Lang Mu with courtesy, it wasn't out of sympathy for his past misfortunes, but rather in admiration that he had managed to grow into an upright, dignified person under such wretched circumstances, refusing to blindly cower or retreat when faced with bullying and humiliation, instead striking back with calculated measures and exacting vengeance where it was due.

Not to mention, Lang Mu had even managed to attract someone of Ares Shang's caliber.

Generally speaking, those pursued by multiple people or by powerful individuals would always attract others' attention—much like how goods fought over by others were invariably perceived as good.

Unfamiliar with Lang Mu to begin with, the Insect King and other big shots naturally gauged Lang Mu's value based on the status of his pursuer.

While a bit unfair to Lang Mu, this was simply an unwritten rule of the world, unavoidable for anyone—though Lang Mu didn't care about such things anyway.

"I can trade this gemstone waist pendant to you." The Insect King cut straight to the point.

Shang Feifan had no desire to beat around the bush either: "What do you want?"

Without a moment's hesitation, the Insect King stated: "I want to see the statue... of the Goddess of Nature."

Shang Feifan answered crisply: "Granted. You can even offer this waist pendant to the statue with your own hands."

The Insect King's eyes lit up.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第221章 自然之神的馈赠 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第221章 自然之神的馈赠

“不过有一点我必须提前说明，免得陛下认为我坑害您。”

商非凡脸色一正。

虫王心想，就知道没有随便见神这样的好事，就是不知道这纨绔大少还想提出什么要求。

商非凡：“神的力量非普通人可以抗衡，就算祂无意伤害普通人，也会对普通人造成伤害。就跟太阳就挂在那儿，它也不想对我们怎样，但我们过于靠近的结果就是灰飞烟灭。”

虫王：“你是说如果我直接面神，会受伤？”

商非凡诚实点头：“有很大可能。为此，如您在见自然之神的雕像时，感觉抵抗不住对方的能量，请告知我，我会帮您离开。”

虫王下意识问：“你能抵抗？”

商非凡摇头：“我也不能，我只是受到了神力庇护。至于如何得到神力庇护，这就完全看神灵的心情。”

虫王懂了，这就跟普通虫人要见他一样，他看对方顺眼，就允许对方来见他，不顺眼自然让其有多远滚多远。

商非凡：“请问陛下您做好准备了吗？”

虫王不动声色：“嗯。”

商非凡起身，“那就请吧。”

虫王跟着起身，以为这次旅程时间不短，为此他还跟手下做了交代。

结果虫王就感到眼前一花，人就出现在一个巨大的广场上。

远处，一尊威严且充满力量的雕像映入眼帘。

一股无与伦比的能量压制住他。

但虫王还没看清那尊雕像的全貌，他突然就感到无数杂音冲入耳朵、冲入大脑。

虫王已经有了心理准备，但这么庞杂刺脑的杂音根本无法抵抗。

就像无数人拿着尖锐的喇叭对着他耳朵狂吹。

虫王一把捂住耳朵，整个人都无意识地发出了怒吼。

瞬间，虫王变身。

一只巨大的虫子出现在广场边缘。

虫子发疯地不断攻击周围。

商非凡躲得老远，心想他幸亏把广场上的东西都收起来了，否则这会儿他得心疼死。

有像是血液的液体从虫子的某些器官流出。

商非凡自知他现在不管对虫王说什么，对方都听不到，只能等对方自己扛不住求救。

虫王还想挣扎，他努力向那尊雕像靠近。

但每近一步，那恐怖刺脑的无数尖啸就像要搅翻他的大脑一样，让他恨不得锤爆自己的脑袋。

我是来敬献宝石腰坠，奉还您的力量的。

虫王想要说出这句话，但出口的都是凄惨厉吼。

十秒，二十秒……

虫王无法再支撑，用尽最后的力量掷出手中宝石腰坠。

“献……”

宝石腰坠落地的瞬间，虫王被一股力量送出空间。

商非凡微讶异，没有立刻跟着出去，而是过去捡起那枚落地的宝石腰坠，走到雕像跟前。

雕像沉默地看着他。

商非凡举起宝石腰坠，把它放到了雕像缺失的左脚小脚趾的部位。

一阵淡淡的光芒闪过，原本只有指节大的宝石腰坠变成了雕像的一部分。

缠绕在雕像肩膀上的藤蔓颜色更为墨绿，还开出了两朵指甲盖大的小花。

一朵蓝紫色小花自动脱落。

商非凡下意识伸手，接住了这朵小花。

另一朵深黑色的花朵则快速结出果实，果实也不大，只有指甲盖大。

商非凡盯住这枚果实，心里产生强烈渴望。这股渴望并不比看到邪神之卵时少。

果实成熟，自动脱落。

商非凡迅速接住这枚果实。

【恭喜你完成主线任务之寻回自然之神雕像缺失的小脚趾，成功获取一万点贡献点奖励。你的天赋技能‘不死之身’，融合度达到十分之五。】

【你送回了自然之神散落的力量，得到自然之神的青睐。但受到你的血脉天赋‘恶咒’的影响，任何祝福buff都对你无效。为此，你获得了自然之神的神秘馈赠，死亡果实，食之可增加对死亡之力的掌控。】

【虫王乔西道尔送回自然之神散落的力量，得到自然之神的馈赠夜游花，食之可永久增加15%速度。】

虫王重新出现在郎府会客厅。

郎沐贴着墙站，无法，那只虫子太巨大，把偌大的会客厅塞得满满。

虫王一出雕像广场，那让他想要自爆的无数尖锐噪杂声瞬间消失。

就算如此，虫王也平复了将近半分钟，才从巨大的虫子变回人形。

郎沐拿出一瓶药剂递给虫王：“喝了会好受一点。”

虫王没有拒绝，道谢接过，当着郎沐的面打开瓶塞仰头喝下。

郎沐知道虫王多少有做给他看的意思——看，本王是如此信任你们。

但在从雕像广场出来后，虫王还敢喝他给的药剂，也确实十分有魄力。

药剂下肚，虫王被刺激的大脑内注入一丝清凉，紊乱的精神力平复下来。

“您没有试着屏蔽那些声音，封锁自己的听力和大脑么？”郎沐轻声说。

虫王摇头：“我试了，没用。”

郎沐心里微微惊讶。他也试过，还是有效果的。

郎沐只好说：“也许是第一次接触这种力量，您还没有适应。”

“可能吧。”虫王苦笑。

郎沐猜测他一开始就能主动屏蔽那些杂音，除了他的力量和自然之神一脉相传（体内有自然之神雕像心脏，还觉醒了能听见亡者之声的血脉天赋，又特意学习过如何屏蔽大量声音），还有就是他进入广场前已经得到过自然之神的青睐。

虫王深深地看郎沐。

拉斐尔郎沐和阿瑞斯商应该都和他有过一样的经历，但他们不像他，显然已经得到神灵认可。

怀疑那尊雕像是假的？

怎么可能！

他一进入雕像广场，就感觉到了无法言喻的磅礴力量。

还有当他看到雕像的一刹那，那从心底升起的想要臣服的绝对威压，都让他知道那是何等伟岸的存在。

那和虫母给他的感觉不一样。

那是更高层次的，完全无法反抗的。

郎沐忽然转头。

一道身影出现在郎沐身边。

虫王看到阿瑞斯商出现，有点迫切地问：“我的献礼可成功？”

阿瑞斯商点头，伸出手，亮出掌心之物：“这是陛下您献礼后，神灵赐予的馈赠，夜游花，食之可永恒增加15%的速度。”

虫王惊喜：“竟然是夜游花！”

夜游花，传说中的奇花异草。大繁华纪时就已经基本看不到，无数炼药师梦寐以求的奇珍药材。

别看只是一朵小小的花，但拿给厉害的大师级别以上的药剂师，说不定能做出至少三五瓶的加敏捷、提升体质等药剂。

而且这些药剂无一例外，添加的属性都是永久性的。

虽然说夜游花交给药剂师炼制成药剂价值更大，但夜游花珍稀异常，能炼制相关药剂的大师也不敢保证自己一定能制作成功。

如果药剂师制作失败，那么一朵珍贵至极的夜游花也会就此消失。

对比之下，有幸得到夜游花的人，基本都会选择直接食用。

直接食用的话，也能永久增加一定属性点，只不过从3%-10%不定。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 221: The Gift of the God of Nature

"However, there is one thing I must state beforehand, lest Your Majesty think I am trying to plot against you."

Shang Feifan’s expression turned solemn.

The Insect King thought to himself that he knew there was no such free lunch as casually seeing a god; he just wondered what other outrageous demands this arrogant young master was going to make.

Shang Feifan continued, "A god’s power is not something ordinary mortals can contend with. Even if the deity has no intention of harming mortals, their mere presence will cause damage. It is just like the sun hanging in the sky—it doesn't wish us any harm, but if we get too close, the result is utter annihilation."

The Insect King asked instinctively, "Are you saying that if I go to see the god in person, I will get hurt?"

Shang Feifan nodded honestly. "There is a very high probability. Therefore, if you feel unable to resist the other party's energy when viewing the statue of the God of Nature, please inform me, and I will help you leave."

The Insect King asked reflexively, "Can you resist it?"

Shang Feifan shook his head. "I can't either; I am merely protected by divine power. As for how one receives divine power protection, that depends entirely on the deity's mood."

The Insect King understood. This was just like how ordinary insect-men wanted to see him: if he found someone pleasing to the eye, he would allow them to come before him; if not, he would naturally tell them to get lost as far as possible.

Shang Feifan asked, "May I ask if Your Majesty is prepared?"

The Insect King maintained a calm exterior. "Yes."

Shang Feifan stood up. "Then please follow me."

The Insect King stood up as well. Believing this journey would take a considerable amount of time, he had even given instructions to his subordinates beforehand.

In the next instant, the Insect King's vision blurred, and he found himself standing in a massive plaza.

In the distance, a majestic and power-imbued statue came into view.

An incomparable surge of energy instantly suppressed him.

Before the Insect King could even make out the full appearance of the statue, countless noises suddenly flooded into his ears and crashed into his brain.

The Insect King had prepared himself mentally, but such a complex, brain-piercing cacophony was completely irresistible.

It felt as though countless people were screaming into his ears with sharp megaphones.

The Insect King grabbed his ears, letting out an involuntary roar of agony.

In a split second, the Insect King transformed.

A gigantic insect appeared at the edge of the plaza.

Driven mad by the pain, the giant insect began thrashing and attacking everything around it.

Shang Feifan retreated far into the distance, thinking to himself that it was fortunate he had cleared everything out of the plaza beforehand; otherwise, his heart would have ached to death by now.

Blood-like fluids leaked from certain organs of the giant insect.

Shang Feifan knew very well that no matter what he said to the Insect King right now, the other party wouldn't be able to hear a single word. He could only wait until the Insect King reached his limit and begged for rescue.

The Insect King still tried to struggle, pushing himself forward toward the statue.

Yet with every single step closer, those terrifying, brain-shattering shrieks felt like they were churning his brain into pulp, making him wish he could smash his own head open.

*I am here to offer the gemstone pendant and return your power.*

The Insect King wanted to shout these words aloud, but all that escaped his throat were wretched, miserable shrieks.

Ten seconds, twenty seconds...

The Insect King could no longer sustain it. Exerting his remaining strength, he hurled the gemstone pendant in his hand forward.

"Offer..."

The moment the gemstone pendant hit the ground, a wave of force swept the Insect King out of the space.

Shang Feifan felt a trace of mild surprise. Instead of leaving immediately, he walked over, picked up the fallen gemstone pendant, and approached the statue.

The statue looked down at him in silence.

Shang Feifan raised the gemstone pendant and placed it precisely onto the missing small toe of the statue's left foot.

A flash of faint light swept across, and the gemstone pendant, originally only the size of a finger joint, seamlessly integrated into the statue.

The vines winding around the statue's shoulders deepened to an ink-green hue, and two tiny flowers the size of fingernails bloomed upon them.

One blue-purple blossom detached itself automatically.

Shang Feifan instinctively reached out and caught the tiny flower.

The other deep black blossom rapidly produced a fruit—also tiny, no larger than a fingernail.

Shang Feifan stared fixedly at the fruit, feeling a fierce surge of yearning welling up inside him. This craving was no less intense than the sensation he felt upon seeing the Egg of the Evil God.

When the fruit ripened, it detached itself automatically.

Shang Feifan quickly caught it.

[Congratulations on completing the main quest: Recover the missing small toe of the Statue of the God of Nature. Successfully obtained 10,000 contribution points as a reward. Your innate skill 'Undying Body' has reached a 50% fusion rate.]

[You have returned the scattered power of the God of Nature and won the favor of the God of Nature. However, affected by your bloodline trait 'Malicious Curse', any blessing buffs are rendered ineffective on you. In return, you have received a mysterious gift from the God of Nature: the Death Fruit. Consuming it will increase your mastery over the power of death.]

[Insect King Josie Doyle returned the scattered power of the God of Nature and received the gift of the God of Nature: the Night-Roaming Flower. Consuming it permanently increases speed by 15%.]

The Insect King reappeared inside the Lang family's receiving parlor.

Lang Mu stood pressed against the wall, with no other choice—that giant insect had crammed the spacious parlor to absolute fullness.

The moment the Insect King stepped out of the statue plaza, the countless piercing, chaotic noises that had made him want to self-detonate vanished instantly.

Even so, it took the Insect King nearly half a minute to calm down and transform back from the colossal insect into his human form.

Lang Mu took out a potion and handed it to the Insect King. "Drink this; it will make you feel a bit better."

The Insect King did not refuse. He accepted it with a word of thanks and, right in front of Lang Mu, uncorked the vial and tossed his head back to drink it down.

Lang Mu knew that the Insect King was partly putting on a show for him—*Look, this King trusts you people to this extent.*

However, to dare drink a potion given by them immediately after emerging from the statue plaza indeed showed extraordinary resolve.

As the potion slid down his throat, a thread of coolness rushed into the Insect King's stimulated brain, soothing his chaotic spiritual power.

"Did you not try to shield those sounds and seal off your hearing and mind?" Lang Mu asked softly.

The Insect King shook his head. "I tried. It was useless."

A trace of inner surprise flickered in Lang Mu's heart. He had tried it too, and it had worked for him.

Lang Mu could only say, "Perhaps because it was your first time coming into contact with this kind of power, you haven't adapted yet."

"Perhaps," the Insect King gave a bitter smile.

Lang Mu guessed that the reason he had been able to actively shield those noises from the very beginning was not only because his power shared the same origin as the God of Nature (possessing the heart of the statue within his body, awakening the bloodline trait to hear the voices of the dead, and intentionally studying how to block out overwhelming volumes of sound), but also because he had already gained the favor of the God of Nature before entering the plaza.

The Insect King gazed deeply at Lang Mu.

Rafael Lang Mu and Ares Shang must have had similar experiences to his own, but unlike him, they had clearly already won the deity's recognition.

Doubt that the statue was fake?

How could that be possible!

The moment he stepped into the statue plaza, he had felt an ineffable, boundless power.

And the moment he laid eyes on the statue, the absolute pressure welling up from the depths of his soul that begged him to submit told him precisely what manner of colossal existence it was.

That feeling was entirely different from the sensation the Insect Mother gave him.

It was of a higher dimension, an absolute authority one could not possibly resist.

Lang Mu suddenly turned his head.

A figure materialized beside him.

Seeing Ares Shang appear, the Insect King asked somewhat eagerly, "Was my tribute successful?"

Ares Shang nodded, reaching out to reveal what lay in his palm: "This is the gift bestowed by the deity after Your Majesty's tribute—the Night-Roaming Flower. Consuming it permanently increases your speed by 15%."

The Insect King cried out in pleasant surprise: "It's actually the Night-Roaming Flower!"

The Night-Roaming Flower was a legendary exotic flora. It had become virtually extinct since the Great Flourishing Era, a rare and precious medicinal material that countless alchemists dreamed of acquiring.

Do not be fooled by its small size; if handed to a formidable master-level or higher alchemist, it could potentially yield at least three to five bottles of agility-enhancing and physique-boosting potions.

Moreover, without exception, the attributes added by such potions were permanent.

While processing the Night-Roaming Flower through an alchemist yielded greater value, the flower was exceptionally rare, and even masters capable of brewing related potions dared not guarantee 100% success.

If the alchemist failed, this peerlessly precious Night-Roaming Flower would vanish into thin air.

By comparison, anyone fortunate enough to acquire a Night-Roaming Flower would invariably choose to consume it directly.

Consuming it raw also permanently increased certain attribute points, though the gain typically ranged randomly between 3% and 10%.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第221章 自然之神的馈赠 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
而自然之神馈赠的这朵，食用就能直接增加15%的速度，已经达到药剂师炼制出成品的效果。

像虫王这类人物，他们的实力已经达到普通兽人的巅峰，想要提升一点千难万难。

而这么一朵小花就能一下子提升他15%的速度，虫王的心顿时火热起来。

虫王郑重地接过这朵自然之神的馈赠，他几乎没怎么犹豫，当场就把这朵花送入口中。

与其交给药剂师炼坏这朵奇珍，还不如他直接食用。

片刻后，虫王脸上露出了抑制不住的喜色。

“多谢阁下给与本王这次机会。”虫王对商非凡诚心诚意地道谢。

这次交易真的太值得！

而阿瑞斯商原本并不用让他直面神灵雕像，更可以阻止他亲自把腰坠献给神灵。

虫王也能猜到阿瑞斯商从中肯定也能得到一定好处，但对方愿意把好处分享给他这个外人才是重点！

“以后二位就是我虫人部落的朋友，只要你们前来虫人部落，必将能得到最高规格的欢迎和招待。”虫王就差没直接跟阿瑞斯商说，以后我就站在你这边了。

阿瑞斯商摆摆手，不是很在乎地说：“这也是你自己的机缘。”

虫王笑，“有些机缘也要看别人愿不愿意给。”

总之，这个人情他是领了，领得心甘情愿。

“对了，你之前拿出的虫毒祛除药剂……”虫王原本想要用腰坠交易的就是这药剂，如果能交易到药方更好。

但他和心腹商讨后，觉得拿到药方不太可能，就想着能不能多换一些成品药剂，然后再谈一个批发优惠价，方便以后持续进货。

谁想到阿瑞斯商竟然抛出了更诱惑他的交易条件，搞得虫王当时都无法立刻做出决断，只能再次找人商议。

虫毒祛除药剂是好，但人性本自私，能有直接面见神灵的机会，对于虫王这种已经达到人生巅峰的人来说，绝对是无法抗拒的诱惑。

何况虫毒祛除药剂就在一个普通兽人手中，只看对方一气拿出五瓶的架势，显然想要交易怎么也是能交易到的。

可面见神灵的机会……

现在得到神灵馈赠的虫王只觉得自己的决断太对了。

“你们想要交易？可以，价格好说。”阿瑞斯商一口答应。

上次完成帮郎沐拔除诅咒的任务，他就得到任务奖励新虫毒消融药剂的炼制方法。

那是直接灌输入他大脑的炼制方法，只要他自己动手多炼制几次，让身体和脑中记忆联系起来，这炼制药剂的能力就属于他本人。

只不过这种直接灌输有一个不好，那就是无法系统地学习药剂，相当于只灌输了这一个就只会这一个，而且只知道机械地炼制，而不知道药方为什么要这么配制、药剂又为何如此炼制。

但商非凡对此完全不担心，他已经开启了草药师的职业技能，以后慢慢升级相关知识就是，现在自然是实用为主。

“如果你们想要配方也可以。”阿瑞斯商又补充。

虫王吃惊了：“配方也能交易？”

“能。”阿瑞斯商点头，大义凛然地说：“祛除虫毒是整个兽人大陆所有兽人的事，只要虫毒一天存在，我们兽人大陆和所有生灵都要受虫毒一天折磨，如果能有更多人学会虫毒祛除药剂的配方，也能让我们兽人大陆早日恢复。”

虫王敬佩：“你有这个心真的是……不愧是能让神灵青睐的存在。”

阿瑞斯商坦然受之：“我也觉得自己特别好。也只有这样优秀超绝的我才能配得上我家阿沐。”

虫王脸上的笑容变得有亿点点僵硬：“……”

“当然，该有的补偿我还是要的，白送的不值钱也不会让人重视。”阿瑞斯商语调一转，“接下来我们就好好谈谈药剂和药方的价格吧。”

说完，阿瑞斯商还对虫王眨眨眼：“我这里是一人一价哦。而且必须签订不能转卖转送配方的契约，包括有意被抢夺偷窃和有意遗落造成的遗失。不过时限只需十年。”

虫王：明白了，你就是想要做十年的独家买卖。

阿瑞斯商：“我都已经愿意公开交易如此珍贵、如此重要的配方，我想大家一定不介意我在这上面稍微赚一点辛苦钱，您说是吧，陛下？”

虫王还能怎么说，当然是微笑回复：“是的，这是你应得的。”

虫王当天满意而归。

阿瑞斯商虽然想要做独家买卖，但他开价真不高。

而且比起金达盾，他更喜欢原材料。

虫人部落什么都不多，就原材料丰富，尤其是药植方面。

他们虫人大概天性使然，喜欢啃植物，可能因为怕不禁吃吧，虫人在常年进化下也点亮了种植的天赋。

大繁华纪以及之前的纪元，要问全兽人大陆哪个种族种植农作物和草药最好，虫人可以毫不谦虚地说，他们敢排第二，就没人敢称第一。

现在也就是虫毒肆掠，阻碍了他们虫人的发挥，加上虫人族吃多了含有虫毒的植物，特别容易异变，他们这才在种植上有了小小懈怠。

但就算如此，他们虫人部落选择的领地和他们本身的种植天赋，也让他们那片儿的植物比其他地方都茂盛得多。

虫王和阿瑞斯商谈交易时，把他们那儿的药植原材料按照他们的市场批发价来计算，虽然给了很不错的折扣，但也比他们直接给金达盾和其他物品要划算得多。

商非凡对这场交易也很满意。

他得到虫毒消融药剂的配方后就没想过要藏在手里，这玩意早点散播出去，对整个兽人都好。

但白送也不好，容易让人怀疑他有什么坏心，也无法快速引起重视，如果连药方都怀疑起来，那才叫得不偿失，还不如相应地收一点费用。

他给虫王开的材料单子，有药植也有矿物，都是他需要的。

虫王给他的价格比他在相关市场上打听到的都便宜得多，有些药植的价格甚至低到只有零售价的百分之一。

能用这么低廉的价格换到这么多材料，他就能毫不心疼地用这些材料练手来提升自己的职业技能，从而做出更好的成品来卖出更好的价。

他卖出成品就能换取到更多修炼资源，如此良性循环，他也能快速进步。

而赚到好处的他也更有动力为这个世界做事不是？

随着虫王带着一脸满意的笑容离开郎府，更多大人物接踵而来。

每一位大佬走时，都能看出来，不管他们是否满意和阿瑞斯商的交易，至少没白跑。

领袖阶层的大佬们算是第一批交易者，紧接着就是一些中小型国家和部落的头领和权力者，等这批头头脑脑满足了，接下来就轮到各行各业的大师，尤其是药剂行业的大师。

这期间，来郎府交易虫毒祛除药剂和药剂配方，以及想要交易空间储物工具的人，绝大多数都很有礼貌，不会自恃过高，更不会给阿瑞斯商两人摆架子。

兽人大陆的最高领袖们来找阿瑞斯商都是客客气气，其他人是什么身份地位、又是什么实力，敢在阿瑞斯商面前拿乔？
chunks.englishText:
Yet the one bestowed by the God of Nature, when consumed, directly increased speed by 15%—matching the peak effect of a finished product refined by a master alchemist.

For figures like the Insect King, whose strength had already reached the pinnacle of ordinary beast-folk, improving even a fraction was as difficult as ascending the heavens.

And a tiny flower like this could instantly boost his speed by 15%. The Insect King's heart grew scorching hot.

Solemnly accepting this gift from the God of Nature, the Insect King hesitated for barely a moment before popping the flower directly into his mouth right then and there.

Rather than handing it to an alchemist and risking the destruction of this rare treasure, he was better off consuming it himself.

Moments later, an uncontrollable expression of joy bloomed across the Insect King's face.

"Many thanks to Your Excellency for granting this King this opportunity," the Insect King expressed his heartfelt gratitude to Shang Feifan.

This transaction was worth every single bit of it!

Furthermore, Ares Shang hadn't strictly needed to let him face the deity's statue directly, let alone allow him to personally present the pendant to the god.

The Insect King could well guess that Ares Shang must have gained certain benefits from this arrangement, but the crucial point was that the other party was willing to share those benefits with an outsider like him!

"From now on, the two of you are friends of the Insect-Man Tribe. Whenever you visit our tribe, you shall receive the highest standard of welcome and hospitality." The Insect King was practically shouting to Ares Shang that from now on, he stood firmly on their side.

Ares Shang waved a hand dismissively, saying with unconcern, "This was your own destiny and fortune to grasp."

The Insect King smiled. "Some fortunes require others to be willing to grant them in the first place."

Regardless, he owed this favor, and he accepted it with utter willingness.

"Right, that insect-venom-cleansing potion you produced earlier..." What the Insect King had originally intended to trade for with the pendant was this very potion; trading for the formula itself would be even better.

However, after discussing it with his confidants, he concluded that acquiring the formula was virtually impossible. Thus, he had hoped to exchange for a larger batch of finished potions, then negotiate a wholesale discount for steady future restocks.

Who would have thought that Ares Shang would dangle an even more alluring trade condition, throwing the Insect King so off balance that he couldn't make an immediate decision and had to summon his advisors once more.

While the insect-venom-cleansing potion was good, human nature was inherently selfish. For someone like the Insect King who had already reached the pinnacle of life, the chance to meet a deity face-to-face was an absolute, irresistible temptation.

Besides, the insect-venom-cleansing potion was in the hands of an ordinary beast-folk; judging by how casually the other party had produced five bottles at once, any trade attempts would surely succeed eventually.

But the chance to meet a god...

Now, having received the deity's blessing, the Insect King felt that his decision had been 100% correct.

"You wish to trade? Certainly, the price is negotiable," Ares Shang agreed readily.

When he completed the task of purging the curse from Lang Mu last time, his reward had included the formula for the new insect-venom-dissolving potion.

It was a formula directly imprinted into his brain; as long as he brewed it a few times himself to bridge his physical reflexes with the memory in his mind, the skill to refine this potion would entirely belong to him.

The only drawback to such direct imprinting was the lack of systematic alchemical education—he only knew how to brew this specific potion, and he only knew the mechanical steps without understanding *why* the formula was combined this way or *why* the potion was refined through those specific steps.

Yet Shang Feifan wasn't the least bit worried; he had already unlocked the herbalist professional skill and could slowly level up his related knowledge over time. For now, practicality reigned supreme.

"If you want the formula, that can be arranged too," Ares Shang added casually.

The Insect King was stunned. "The formula can be traded as well?"

"It can." Ares Shang nodded, adopting a righteous expression. "Erradicating insect venom is the business of all beast-folk across the entire Beast Continent. As long as the venom exists, our continent and all living creatures will suffer its torment daily. If more people can learn the formula for the insect-venom-cleansing potion, it will allow our Beast Continent to recover all the sooner."

The Insect King looked at him with profound admiration. "To have such a mindset... truly worthy of someone favored by the deities."

Ares Shang accepted the praise with a calm expression. "I also think I'm exceptionally wonderful. Only someone as outstanding and peerless as me is worthy of my dear Ah Mu."

The smile on the Insect King's face stiffened by a tiny fraction: "..."

"Of course, I still require proper compensation. Free things lack value and fail to command respect," Ares Shang shifted his tone smoothly. "Now, let us properly discuss the prices for the potions and the formula."

With that, Ares Shang winked at the Insect King. "My pricing here is one price per person, oh. Furthermore, you must sign a contract prohibiting the resale or gifting of the formula—this includes losses caused by intentional theft, robbery, or deliberate misplacement. However, the validity period is only ten years."

The Insect King: *Understood. You simply want to run an exclusive monopoly for a decade.*

Ares Shang: "Since I am already willing to publicly trade such a precious and vital formula, I assume everyone won't mind me earning a tiny bit of hard-earned profit on top, right, Your Majesty?"

What more could the Insect King say? Naturally, he smiled and replied, "Indeed, this is what you rightfully deserve."

That very day, the Insect King departed in great satisfaction.

Although Ares Shang wanted an exclusive monopoly, his asking prices weren't high at all.

Moreover, rather than Gold Shields, he preferred raw materials.

The Insect-Man Tribe lacked nothing except an abundance of raw materials, especially medicinal flora.

Perhaps due to their innate nature, insect-men enjoyed chewing on plants. Fearing they might deplete them recklessly, the insect-men had also unlocked cultivation talents through generations of evolution.

During the Great Flourishing Era and previous epochs, if one asked which race excelled best at cultivating crops and herbs across the entire Beast Continent, the insect-men could state without a shred of false modesty: if they claimed second place, no one dared claim first.

Currently, it was merely the rampant plague of insect venom that hindered their potential; compounded by the fact that insect-men who overconsumed venom-tainted plants were prone to mutations, they had slacked off slightly in cultivation.

Even so, the territories chosen by the insect-man tribe and their innate planting talents made the flora in their domains far more lush and vigorous than anywhere else.

When negotiating the trade with Ares Shang, the Insect King calculated their local medicinal flora raw materials at wholesale market rates. Though he offered a very generous discount, it was still far more cost-effective for him than paying in Gold Shields or other valuables.

Shang Feifan was extremely satisfied with this transaction as well.

He had never intended to hoard the formula for the insect-venom-dissolving potion once he acquired it; spreading this concoction early benefited all beast-folk.

However, giving it away for free was unwise—it easily aroused suspicion of malicious intent and failed to attract prompt attention. If people grew suspicious of the formula itself, the loss would outweigh the gain. It was far better to charge a modest fee.

The material list he gave the Insect King included both medicinal plants and minerals, all of which he urgently needed.

The prices the Insect King offered him were vastly cheaper than what he had scouted in relevant markets; the prices of certain medicinal plants were so low they amounted to barely one percent of retail value.

Acquiring so many materials at such a bargain price meant he could practice refining without a twinge of heartache, boosting his professional skill level and ultimately producing superior finished products to sell at higher profits.

Selling finished products would earn him more cultivation resources, creating a virtuous cycle that enabled rapid personal advancement.

And reaping these benefits naturally gave him even more drive to work for the good of this world, didn't it?

As the Insect King left the Lang residence with a deeply satisfied smile, a succession of other major figures arrived in a continuous stream.

Every single heavyweight who left could be seen to have gained something worthwhile—regardless of whether they were completely thrilled with their trade with Ares Shang, they certainly hadn't made a wasted trip.

The leaders of the upper echelons formed the first wave of traders, followed closely by heads and power-brokers of small-to-medium nations and tribes. Once this upper crust was satisfied, it was the turn of masters from various industries, particularly masters of the apothecary profession.

During this period, the vast majority of those coming to the Lang residence to trade for the insect-venom-cleansing potion, formulas, or spatial storage tools were exceptionally polite. None of them acted superior or put on airs in front of Ares Shang and Lang Mu.

The supreme leaders of the Beast Continent treated Ares Shang with utmost courtesy; what identity, status, or strength did others possess that they would dare put on airs before him?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第221章 自然之神的馈赠 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
真有那不开眼的，压根就没有机会靠近郎府，靠近了也进不来。

郎府看似没有人看守，但那一圈围墙和前后几扇门竟然全都做了特殊防备，只要对阿瑞斯商和郎家人有恶意的，不但无法进入郎府，更会被攻击。

至于说大家为什么会知道这点，当然是有人亲身尝试。

三王子那个傻包，竟然带人跑来找阿瑞斯商的麻烦，说有人指证就是他和拉斐尔联手闯入三王子府，还带走了三王子的管家库尔特。

三王子认定阿瑞斯商为了拉斐尔故意找他麻烦，为此不惜给他大管家扣上邪神信徒的帽子。

三王子这段时间过得很不好，见不到自己的父王，也和其他手足处得很不愉快。想在传承分享大会上露露脸，结果谁也没有把他当回事看。

如今连他的府邸都能被人随便闯入，还被带走了他极为倚重的大管家。

三王子心态崩溃了，出事当晚就跑去找大王子，大喊大叫让他大哥必须找回他的大管家，还要抓住并当众吊死闯入他府邸的恶人。

大王子那时还在忙着传承分享大会的事，又要提防包括邪神信徒在内的各种对虎国怀有恶意的组织和存在，整个虎国的事也都需要他过目，忙得连睡觉时间都没有。

对于三王子的无理取闹——大王子从克莱门特那里得知是谁带走了三王子府的大管家，也知道了那名管家的真神教主教身份，他没有去找三王子大骂一顿就算他忍耐性够好，三王子竟然还跑到他这里找他要人？

大王子当时就爆了，把三王子骂了个狗血喷头，还让人把他软禁起来，不让他出门惹事。

三王子惧怕虎王，却不是很惧怕大王子。

虽然大王子让人看住他，但他还是靠着胡搅蛮缠和某些人的帮助从三王子府跑出来，还纠集了一帮人手，跑到郎府想要找阿瑞斯商和拉斐尔的麻烦。

然后，三王子和他带着的人手连郎府大门都没能摸进，就被无数藤蔓给抽飞了出去。

那些攀爬在围墙和门头上，看起来像是装饰物的藤蔓，在那一刻发挥了极为可怕的威力。

三王子不信邪，还想带人继续冲。

结果就有人被藤蔓卷住给卷吧卷吧卷成了麻花，最后还被藤蔓废物利用埋自己根底了。

三王子吓呆，又命人用火攻。

这一举动彻底惹怒了那些藤蔓，让那些藤蔓喷出了一些古怪的看不见的能量。

而凡是沾到那股能量的人突然就变得神智大乱，像是看到了最可怕的场景一样，有点胆子的人还能拔腿就跑，不少人直接就软倒在地，连动都动不了。

三王子也没有逃脱怨气侵袭。

他看到了无数他曾经欺辱过的人扑过来撕扯他，他怎么打都打不死这些疯狂的兽人。

最后，三王子脸若金纸地倒在地上，陷入昏迷不醒。

其他路人不敢动三王子和他带来的人，还是克莱门特领了人过来，指挥人手把三王子和他带来的狗腿子一起抬走。

自此以后，再也没有人敢小瞧郎府围墙和门头上的藤蔓，更没有小偷敢去翻郎府的院墙啦。
chunks.englishText:
Those truly blind fools never even got the chance to approach the Lang residence, let alone step inside.

Though the Lang residence appeared unguarded, that ring of perimeter walls and the front and rear gates had actually been fortified with special protective measures. Anyone harboring malicious intent toward Ares Shang and the Lang family would not only find themselves barred from entry, but would also face immediate retaliation.

As for how everyone came to know this, naturally, someone had tested it out personally.

That fool of a Third Prince had actually led men to the Lang residence to cause trouble for Ares Shang, claiming someone had testified that he and Rafael had jointly broken into the Third Prince's mansion and abducted his grand steward, Kurt.

Convinced that Ares Shang was intentionally making trouble for him on Rafael's account, the Third Prince had stopped at nothing, even slapping the label of 'Evil God Cultist' onto his own head steward.

The Third Prince had been having a miserable time lately; he couldn't see his royal father, and relations with his other siblings were extremely strained. He had wanted to make a flashy appearance at the Heritage Sharing Assembly, yet no one had paid him the slightest heed.

Now, even his own mansion could be broken into at will, and his heavily relied-upon grand steward had been snatched away.

The Third Prince's mentality had completely collapsed. The night the incident occurred, he ran straight to the First Prince, screaming and shouting that his eldest brother must retrieve his grand steward at once and publicly hang the villains who had broken into his estate.

At that time, the First Prince was still up to his neck in work for the Heritage Sharing Assembly, while also having to stay on guard against organizations and entities harboring malice toward the Tiger Kingdom—including Evil God cultists. Every state affair of the Tiger Kingdom required his personal review, keeping him so busy he barely had time to sleep.

As for the Third Prince's unreasonable ruckus—the First Prince had already learned from Clement who had taken the Third Prince's grand steward, and had also learned the steward's true identity as a True God Cult bishop. It showed extraordinary restraint on the First Prince's part that he hadn't marched over to curse the Third Prince out, yet the Third Prince actually had the gall to come here demanding people?

The First Prince instantly blew his top, cursing the Third Prince from head to toe before having him placed under house arrest to stop him from going out and causing trouble.

While the Third Prince feared the Tiger King, he wasn't particularly afraid of the First Prince.

Although the First Prince had ordered him confined, the Third Prince still managed to slip out of his mansion through relentless pestering and the help of certain accomplices. Gathering a band of thugs, he rushed over to the Lang residence, intent on making trouble for Ares Shang and Rafael.

As a result, neither the Third Prince nor any of his men even managed to touch the gates of the Lang residence before they were swatted flying by countless vines.

Those vines, which crawled along the perimeter walls and lintels looking like mere decorative plants, unleashed terrifying might at that exact moment.

Refusing to accept defeat, the Third Prince tried to order his men to charge again.

The consequence was that several men were snapped up by the vines, rolled up tightly like hemp twists, and finally recycled by the vines to be buried beneath their own roots.

Terrified out of his wits, the Third Prince ordered his men to use fire attacks.

This move thoroughly infuriated the vines, causing them to spew out a strange, invisible energy.

Anyone contaminated by that energy suddenly lost their minds, as though witnessing the most horrifying scene imaginable. The slightly more courageous ones turned tail and fled, while many others collapsed limply to the ground, utterly paralyzed.

The Third Prince did not escape the onslaught of that malevolent energy either.

He saw countless people he had once bullied swarming forward to tear at him, and no matter how he thrashed, he simply couldn't kill these crazed beast-folk.

In the end, the Third Prince collapsed onto the ground with a face as pale as parchment, plunging into total unconsciousness.

Other passersby dared not touch the Third Prince and his entourage. In the end, it was Clement who led a detachment over, directing his men to haul the Third Prince and his lackeys away together.

From that day onward, not a single soul dared to look down upon the vines climbing the walls and gates of the Lang residence, and no thief ever dared to scale the Lang family's courtyard walls again.

chunks.chineseText:
第222章 离开王城

伊曼切斯特睁开眼睛，看到一张熟悉的面孔，慢慢吐出一口气。

“看来我的运气还不错。”伊曼坐起身。

郎沐冲他笑了笑：“也是你的精神力比较顽强。”

伊曼摇头：“要不是你给我搞了个躲藏的地方，这次我九成要栽。那老狗的精神力出乎意料地强大。”

“你……”郎沐扫过伊曼神情。

伊曼穿好鞋，站起来：“我有了一些记忆，大约是我上辈子的记忆，不过不是很连贯。我好像曾经是一名魔法师。”

伊曼的神情很坦然，拉斐尔郎沐和阿瑞斯商两次救他性命，他对他们就没有什么好隐瞒的。

郎沐笑：“那你知道要如何成为一名魔法师吗？记得那些魔法吗？”

伊曼点头又摇头：“我想起来一部分，不过我有种强烈直觉，魔法师的知识已经深入我的灵魂，只要我能想起一部分就能想起更多，现在我已经知道如何修炼自己的精神力。”

郎沐：“那就好。精神力是魔法师的重要支柱，如果你能开始修炼精神力，说不定要不了多久你就能回忆起全部的魔法师知识。”

伊曼也笑，耸肩：“就是可惜这里没有魔气。就算恢复魔法师的记忆，也没多大用处。”

郎沐手一翻，拿出一个小袋子：“希望这个对你有些用处，不过这东西我也不多，请尽量节省使用。”

伊曼心脏一跳，下意识地接过袋子，不用打开看，他就感知到里面的东西是什么。

“……谢谢。”伊曼已经不知道该如何感谢这两人，他只能庆幸自己能认识这两人。

“你会不会认识上辈子的我？”伊曼忍不住问。

郎沐失笑，“不，我应该不认识上辈子的你。但我确实也学过魔法，这事还请暂时保密。”

“当然。”

“对了，你那个娶了墨文伯爵小女儿的弟弟以赛亚，麻烦你多留意一番。如果发现他有什么异常举动，不需要你特意做什么，他很有可能也是神降的容器之一，你只要把消息告诉克莱门特或者直接传给我也行。等你继承了切斯特家族的一切，能把那里的领地收回来最好。”

伊曼记得这件事，也知道他那个兄弟以赛亚待的地方有多重要，那可是虎国边境。搞不好就可能被割据，甚至成为邻国攻入虎国的缺口。

伊曼恢复了一些魔法师的记忆没错，但他在虎国出生成长的记忆也非常完整，他虽然痛恨自己的父亲，但对虎国还是有感情的。

何况拉斐尔郎沐也是虎国人，并且一看就很在意这个国家。

“我知道了，有什么事我会及时联系你。你就要回去自己的领地了对吧？”

郎沐一顿，再次拿出一物，递给伊曼：“这是阿商做的联络器，目前只有简易版，且距离不能太远，超过一千公里可能就会联系不上。”

伊曼接过这个像是金属小方块的物品，好奇地翻看：“这是炼金物品？”

“对。”郎沐指点用法：“这上面一共有九个数字，代表暂时只能记录九个联系人。首先要把联系者的精神力输入相应数字，比如我把自己的精神力灌输入9这个数字中。你也把你的精神力灌输入我这个联络器的数值9中。之后你只要用精神力碰触这个数字，就能联系上我，可以通过这个联络器和我直接通话。”

“竟然能直接通话？”伊曼低喃：“好像大繁华纪也有类似的联络器，有人找出来过，可惜不能使用了。”

郎沐：“大繁华纪使用的联络器应该是科技加炼金的物品，需要信号塔传输信号。我这个只是最简易版的，所以距离一长就没什么用处，且功能特别简洁，类似无线电。但阿商说他以后会研究新的更好用的联络器。”

伊曼看郎沐眼中掩不住的骄傲，忍不住笑起来，心中羡慕：“无线电是什么？”

“就是一种电波。”郎沐没有详细解释：“关于无线电的知识，我们兽人文明其实也早就发现并使用，你可以去国家图书馆阅览相关知识。”

“就是你在那座地下图书馆找到的传承对吧？”

“对。”

伊曼点点头：“我会去多多研究。”

正好他也不知道以后要做什么事，切斯特大公死了，他即将继承这个家族的一切，真有钱还有闲。而他并不擅长政治，也许他能靠自己以前的魔法知识，再结合兽人文明中的科技知识，研究出一些新的东西。

两人在彼此的联络器上留下精神力，方便以后联络。

伊曼走出郎府大门，停住脚步，回头。

他对拉斐尔郎沐有种莫名的亲切感，虽然对方说不认识上辈子的他，但他有种微妙的直觉，他上辈子一定见过这个人，甚至接触过。

当天下午，伊曼切斯特就进宫见了大王子。

随后不到一天时间，虎王就明令认可伊曼切斯特继承切斯特家族的一切，并降等袭爵，成为虎国新的侯爵。

而伊曼切斯特一口气把家族领地献出去大半，这大半领地几乎全都靠近边境，或是重要的矿藏，其中就有以赛亚去的迪安要寨。

以赛亚当初去迪安要寨时，名义上是去当那里的领主，但切斯特大公对自家领地和权力都看得十分重，他只是让儿子去那里管事，并没有真正把那片领地送给以赛亚。

也就是说从法律层面来说，以赛亚只是迪安要寨的管事，并不是真正的主人。

大王子拿到迪安要寨的转让许可书，立刻就派了一支军队过去，领头人以及两名副手都是虎王以及大都督狮域和宰相共同商议出来的人选，大王子只负责旁听。

虎王等人考虑到迪安要寨的边境军队长官被以赛亚收买或控制的可能性，当然不可能只派几个文官过去接手。

在商非凡和郎沐离开王城的前一天，收到了伊曼切斯特送来的厚礼。

真的是非常厚重的礼物。

除了伊曼和他们约定的那块直通海岸线的领地转让书，还有大量种子、大量提炼过的矿石和一万金存款证明以及取款密码。

因为数量太大，不好运送，伊曼就只是在礼盒中用文书说明，让两人直接到产地去提取。并担心两人不肯要这份厚礼，说那些东西就堆放在那里，如果他们不去取，那些东西时间长了就废了，要么就被人察觉抢夺，还请两人不要浪费他这份心。

郎沐无奈地看向商非凡：“怎么办？”

商非凡乐：“对方送的东西都非常实用，你看他知道你要经营领地，最需要的就是大量健康种子。连钱都以我们的名义存入了国家银行。至于那么多矿物，他现在可是切斯特侯爵，拥有切斯特家族几百上千年累积下来的庞大家产。你没看八卦报上说的吗，切斯特家族拥有虎国最多的矿产地。”

商非凡拍拍郎沐的肩膀：“他这是在还救命恩情，俗话说无债一身轻，他把这些东西送你，也是想要以后和你平等相处。”

郎沐轻啊一声，懂了。

说到八卦报，这段时间真的是非常活跃，而且又有从暗转明的势头。
