Chapter 222: Leaving the Royal City (Part 1)

Eiman Chester opened his eyes to a familiar face and slowly let out a breath.

"It seems my luck isn't too bad." Eiman sat up.

Lang Mu smiled at him. "It's also because your spiritual power is quite tenacious."

Eiman shook his head. "If you hadn't rigged up a hiding place for me, I would have fallen into the trap nine times out of ten. That old dog's spiritual power was unexpectedly formidable."

"You..." Lang Mu swept a glance over Eiman's expression.

Eiman put on his shoes and stood up. "I've recovered some memories—probably memories from my past life, though they aren't very coherent. It seems I used to be a mage."

Eiman's expression was very open. Raphael Lang Mu and Ares Shang had saved his life twice; he had nothing to hide from them.

Lang Mu smiled. "Then do you know how to become a mage? Do you remember any of those spells?"

Eiman nodded and then shook his head. "I remember a part of it, but I have a strong intuition that a mage's knowledge is deeply rooted in my soul. As long as I can recall a portion, I can remember more. Right now, I already know how to cultivate my spiritual power."

Lang Mu said, "That's good. Spiritual power is an essential pillar for a mage. If you can begin cultivating your spiritual power, it might not be long before you recover all your knowledge as a mage."

Eiman smiled as well, shrugging. "It's just a pity there's no magic Qi here. Even if I recover the memories of a mage, it won't be of much use."

Lang Mu flipped his hand and produced a small pouch. "I hope this is of some use to you, though I don't have much of this stuff either. Please try to use it sparingly."

Eiman's heart skipped a beat. He instinctively took the pouch, and without even opening it, he could sense what was inside.

"…Thank you." Eiman no longer knew how to thank these two; he could only feel fortunate to have met them.

"Do you think you might have known me in my past life?" Eiman couldn't help asking.

Lang Mu laughed in spite of himself. "No, I shouldn't know the you of your past life. But I have indeed studied magic as well; please keep this matter confidential for now."

"Of course."

"Right, that younger brother of yours who married Count Mowen's youngest daughter—Isaiah. Please keep a close eye on him. If you notice any unusual actions from him—you don't need to do anything special—he is very likely one of the vessels for the divine descent. Just pass the news to Clement, or relay it directly to me. Once you inherit everything of the Chester family, it would be best if you could reclaim the territory there."

Eiman remembered this matter and knew just how important the place where his brother Isaiah stayed truly was. That was the border of the Tiger Kingdom. If things went wrong, it could be partitioned, or even become a breach for neighboring countries to invade the Tiger Kingdom.

It was true that Eiman had recovered some memories as a mage, but his memories of growing up in the Tiger Kingdom were also completely intact. Although he loathed his father, he still had affection for the Tiger Kingdom.

Furthermore, Raphael Lang Mu was also a person of the Tiger Kingdom, and at a glance, he cared deeply about this country.

"I understand. If anything comes up, I'll contact you in a timely manner. You're heading back to your own territory soon, right?"

Lang Mu paused, then produced another item and handed it to Eiman. "This is a communicator made by Ah Shang. It's currently just a rudimentary version, and the range can't be too far. If it exceeds a thousand kilometers, we might lose contact."

Eiman took the object, which looked like a small metal square, and curiously turned it over in his hands. "Is this an alchemical item?"

"Yes." Lang Mu instructed him on how to use it. "There are a total of nine numbers on here, which means it can temporarily record only nine contacts. First, you must input the contact's spiritual power into the corresponding number—for example, I will input my own spiritual power into the number 9. You should also input your spiritual power into number 9 on my communicator. After that, you just need to use your spiritual power to touch this number, and you'll be able to reach me. You can speak directly with me through this communicator."

"Can it actually support direct conversation?" Eiman murmured. "It seems the Grand Prosperous Era had similar communicators too. Some people dug them up, but unfortunately, they couldn't be used anymore."

Lang Mu said, "The communicators used in the Grand Prosperous Era should have been items combining technology and alchemy, requiring signal towers to transmit signals. This one of mine is merely the most rudimentary version, so once the distance is too great, it becomes useless, and its functions are extremely concise, similar to a radio. But Ah Shang said he will research new and better-looking communicators in the future."

Seeing the undisguised pride in Lang Mu's eyes, Eiman couldn't help laughing, feeling a sense of envy in his heart. "What is a radio?"

"It's a type of electromagnetic wave." Lang Mu didn't explain in detail. "As for knowledge regarding radio, our Orc civilization actually discovered and used it long ago. You can go to the National Library to read up on related materials."

"That's the heritage you found in that underground library, right?"

"Right."

Eiman nodded. "I'll go and study it thoroughly."

Just as well, he didn't really know what he wanted to do in the future. The Grand Duke of Chester was dead, and he was about to inherit everything in the family—he would truly be wealthy and idle. Since he wasn't adept at politics, perhaps he could rely on his former knowledge of magic, combined with the technological knowledge of the Orc civilization, to research some new things.

The two of them left their spiritual power on each other's communicators to facilitate future contact.

Stepping out of the main gates of the Lang Residence, Eiman paused and looked back.

He felt an inexplicable sense of intimacy toward Raphael Lang Mu. Even though the other party said they didn't know him in his past life, he had a subtle intuition that he must have seen this person in his past life, and perhaps even interacted with them.

That very afternoon, Eiman Chester entered the palace to meet the First Prince.

In less than a day's time, the Tiger King officially issued a decree recognizing Eiman Chester's inheritance of everything belonging to the Chester family. He inherited the peerage with a reduction in rank, becoming the Tiger Kingdom's new Marquis.

In one fell swoop, Eiman Chester relinquished the vast majority of his family's territory. Nearly all of these lands were located near the border or held important mineral deposits, among which was the Dean Fortress where Isaiah had gone.

When Isaiah initially went to the Dean Fortress, he went under the guise of serving as its lord. However, the Grand Duke of Chester guarded his territory and power jealously; he had merely sent his son there to manage affairs and had never truly gifted that region to Isaiah.

In other words, from a legal standpoint, Isaiah was only the manager of Dean Fortress, not its true master.

Upon receiving the transfer permit for Dean Fortress, the First Prince immediately dispatched an army there. The commander and his two deputies were candidates jointly discussed and selected by the Tiger King, the Grand Marshal Lion Domain, and the Prime Minister; the First Prince merely sat in as an observer.

Considering the possibility that the border army commander of Dean Fortress might have been bribed or controlled by Isaiah, the Tiger King and the others naturally could not simply send a few civil officials to take over.

On the day before Shang Feifan and Lang Mu left the Royal City, they received a lavish gift sent by Eiman Chester.

It was truly an exceptionally heavy gift.

Aside from the land transfer deed for the coastal strip Eiman had agreed upon with them, there were massive quantities of seeds, vast amounts of refined ores, and a deposit certificate and withdrawal password for ten thousand gold coins.

Because the quantities were too large and difficult to transport, Eiman simply listed them in a document inside the gift box, instructing the two of them to collect the items directly from their points of origin. Fearing that the two might refuse to accept this generous gift, he wrote that those goods were just piled up there—if they didn't come to claim them, the materials would eventually spoil over time, or else be discovered and plundered by others. He earnestly requested that they not let his good intentions go to waste.

Lang Mu looked helplessly at Shang Feifan. "What should we do?"

Shang Feifan chuckled. "The things he sent are all extremely practical. Look, he knew you're going to manage a territory, so what you need most is a large quantity of healthy seeds. He even deposited the money into the National Bank in our names. As for all those minerals, he is now Marquis Chester, possessing the massive wealth accumulated by the Chester family over hundreds or thousands of years. Didn't you see what the gossip papers said? The Chester family owns the most mineral deposits in the entire Tiger Kingdom."

Shang Feifan patted Lang Mu on the shoulder. "He's repaying a life-saving debt. As the saying goes, 'a debt-free man walks light.' By sending you these things, he also wants to be able to stand as your equal in the future."

Lang Mu let out a soft "Ah," finally understanding.

Speaking of the gossip papers, they had truly been very active lately, and there was even a momentum of transitioning from the shadows into the light.

chunks.chineseText:
大王子派人去找他们的报社总编，明确表示了想要入股的意思。

虎国当然也可以开办属于官方的报纸，但官方报纸这东西，民众喜欢看的真没几个。

八卦报却不一样，它的民众基础已经形成，现在不止是虎国王城，就是虎国其他城镇村的居民都非常喜欢八卦报，宁可和商队加价购买报纸。

虎国官方入股八卦报不是想要控制这份报纸，而是希望官方有什么事可以通过八卦迅速传播出去，另外就是解释起来某些事情，通过八卦报的口，相信的民众也会更多一些。

八卦报总编不好自己决定，就联系上了报社幕后老板。

幕后老板商老大就摇身一变再次变成龙岳，去和官方派来的官员签了一份股份转让契约。

虎国王室以五千金的价格买下了八卦报百分之十的股份，并约定绝不会插手八卦报的管理事宜和报道内容，只约定八卦报在报道王室相关新闻时必须求实，不能胡编乱造捕风捉影。

同时龙岳还给了报社几名主干股份，最高的百分之五，最低的也有百分之一。

龙岳只要确保自己手头的股份超过百分之五十一，其他股份他打算在以后都慢慢稀释出去，主要就是交给玩家，让玩家更有自主感和参与感。

玩家们拿到股份，果然对八卦事业更加用心……

商非凡前后拿到大笔资金后，就打算把八卦报开遍整个虎国，乃至向其他国家和地区扩展。

首先他就让总编丁勾在天残谷玩家营地开办了八卦报第一分部。

第二分部他打算就建在莫约镇。

而八卦报社也是他“侵略”隶属于洛伦米尔顿的玩家势力的最先锋。

王城的事情基本已经解决完毕，接下来要对付的就是洛伦米尔顿。

商非凡对这个人，简直比郎沐对此人还要恨之入骨的多得多。

这不只是妒忌郎沐和这个人渣有过一段，商非凡更痛恨对方没有好好对待珍惜他心中的珍宝。

这就跟常年处于饥饿状态又一连饿了大半个月的人，看到有人用着满汉全席，却用傲慢的态度只吃了一两口，就全部倒入粪坑一样，简直恨不得揍死他、活生生饿死那个杂碎！

商非凡和郎沐离开王城时，只悄悄跟克莱门特和大王子打了个招呼。

这两人也收到了商非凡制作的简易版联络器。

好在莫约镇和郎沐的新领地距离王城恰在联络器的联络距离范围内。

实在不行，还有无线电发报机可以联系。

商非凡给克莱门特留了一台。

是的，商非凡把老式无线电给折腾出来了。

这种老式无线电只要有原材料，组装起来并不困难，在地星的网络上都能查到详细的组装图。

商非凡在收集了足够的材料后，就靠手搓，一点点把无线电台给手搓了出来。

老伏那边也给他支援了一些配件。

有些仪器组装起来并不困难，难的是配件，比如二极管、芯片等等。

玩家们早就想在游戏里复制地星里的各种热武器，难就难在最初的材料上。

比如无缝钢管，合金炼制，无损打孔，内膛加工等等。

如果不追求安全性和长久性，那随便做点玩玩也无所谓。

但玩家们野心大啊，他们都来到全息游戏中了，还没有各种法律管着他们，那还不是怎么刑怎么来。

正好天残谷主也支持他们从最基础开始，所以很长一段时间不少玩家都在忙最基础的工业准备。

现在也差不多到了收获季，玩家们不止等级提升，他们的工业基础和农业基础也有了。

商非凡和郎沐都清楚，天残谷主之前借养伤的名义蛰伏，就是在等待这个时期到来。

两人离开王城后，又去了一趟黑森林城的地下图书馆。

郎沐告诉商非凡：“我打算今天找丹顿侯爵的灵魂聊聊。”

“你有把握了？”商非凡对此非常支持。

郎沐：“在消灭切斯特大公的灵魂时，我有了些发现，也许丹顿侯爵也有同样的问题。这个问题也许能成为我攻破他灵魂防卫的手段。”

商非凡挑眉：“什么问题？”

郎沐故意：“等会儿跟你说。”

老人在两人刚走入图书馆时就冒了出来。

“你们俩可真能。祭司宫那边还跟我抱怨，说他们明明是找你们委托事情的，结果你们却给他们找了一个大难题。现在祭司宫那边正在自查。”

“那自查出结果了吗？”商非凡顺口问。

老人叹息：“哪有那么快。都被渗透那么长时间了，现在就连上层都不可信。祭司宫决定把派到各处的祭司全部召集回来。”

“这不是因噎废食吗？”郎沐皱眉。

老人：“总比那些外派祭司中有和邪神勾连的，把一整个国家和部落都带入坑里要好。”

“对。”商非凡这次站在老人这一边：“祭司派不派都无所谓。祭司的最大作用就是负责知识和技术的传承，可祭司宫这么多年，似乎就没有拿出真正有用的传承，这本来就有问题。现在又有了这座图书馆给出去的真正传承，那些祭司的作用也就不大。”

郎沐一想也是，因为之前虎王十分重视王庭祭司，他就下意识觉得这个职位不能少人。但仔细想想，王庭祭司除了给出一些模糊预言，以及验证王室血脉和教导王室成员一些知识以外，似乎也并不是不可替代。

而会预言的祭司本身就极少。

虽然派向其他国家和部落的祭司各有各的本事，但真少了他们，也不代表人家国家和部落就转不起来。
chunks.englishText:
The First Prince had sent someone to find their newspaper editor-in-chief, explicitly expressing his intention to buy shares.

Of course, the Tiger Kingdom could also run an official newspaper of its own, but very few citizens actually enjoyed reading official government papers.

The gossip paper was different. Its grassroots foundation had already been established, and now, not only the residents of the Tiger Kingdom's Royal City, but even those in other towns and villages across the kingdom loved the gossip paper. They would rather pay a markup to merchant caravans to purchase a copy.

The Tiger Kingdom's official acquisition of shares in the gossip paper wasn't meant to control the publication, but rather in the hope that whenever the government had matters to address, they could rapidly disseminate them through gossip. Furthermore, if they needed to explain certain events, using the voice of the gossip paper would convince far more citizens.

Unable to make the decision on his own, the editor-in-chief contacted the paper's behind-the-scenes boss.

Boss Shang transformed once more into Long Yue, going to sign a share transfer contract with the officials sent by the government.

The Tiger Kingdom's royal family purchased a 10% stake in the gossip paper for the price of five thousand gold coins, with the stipulation that they would never interfere with the paper's management or reporting content. The only condition was that when reporting news related to the royal family, the gossip paper must seek the truth and avoid making wild fabrications or chasing shadows.

At the same time, Long Yue also distributed shares to several key backbone members of the newspaper office, with the highest receiving 5% and the lowest 1%.

Long Yue only needed to ensure that the shares in his own hands exceeded 51%. He intended to gradually dilute the remaining shares in the future, primarily handing them over to players to give them a greater sense of autonomy and participation.

True to expectations, once the players got their hands on the shares, they became even more dedicated to the gossip industry...

After acquiring large sums of capital, Shang Feifan planned to expand the gossip paper throughout the entire Tiger Kingdom and eventually extend it to other countries and regions.

First, he had the editor-in-chief Ding Gou establish the first branch of the gossip paper in the Tiancan Valley player camp.

The second branch was slated to be built in Moyue Town.

And the gossip newspaper office was also the sharpest vanguard of his "invasion" into player forces subordinate to Loren Milton.

The matters in the Royal City were basically settled. Next on the agenda to deal with was Loren Milton.

Shang Feifan felt a hatred toward this individual that was vastly deeper and more bone-deep than even Lang Mu's.

It wasn't just jealousy that Lang Mu had a past with this scum; Shang Feifan despised him even more for failing to properly cherish and treasure the precious gem within his heart.

It was just like someone who had been in a state of starvation for over half a month, watching someone else sit before a magnificent Manchu-Han banquet, only to arrogantly take a single bite and dump the rest into a cesspit. He wished nothing more than to beat that bastard to death—to starve that scumbag to death alive!

When Shang Feifan and Lang Mu left the Royal City, they only quietly bid farewell to Clement and the First Prince.

Both of these individuals had also received the rudimentary communicators crafted by Shang Feifan.

Fortunately, the distance from Moyue Town and Lang Mu's new territory to the Royal City fell well within the communication range of the devices.

Should worst come to worst, they could still maintain contact via the radio telegraph.

Shang Feifan had left one set behind for Clement.

Yes, Shang Feifan had actually managed to rig up an old-fashioned radio.

As long as raw materials were available, assembling this kind of vintage radio wasn't particularly difficult; detailed assembly diagrams could easily be found on Earth's internet.

After gathering sufficient materials, Shang Feifan had relied on manual craftsmanship, piecing together the radio station bit by bit.

Old Fu's side had also provided him with some accessories.

Some instruments weren't hard to assemble; the real difficulty lay in the components, such as diodes and microchips.

The players had long wanted to replicate various projectile weapons from Earth within the game, but the bottleneck lay in the foundational materials.

Things like seamless steel tubing, alloy refining, nondestructive drilling, and barrel boring.

If they weren't striving for safety and longevity, casually putting something together for fun was fine.

However, the players were ambitious. Since they had already entered a full-holo game without any laws to restrict them, they naturally pursued whatever was most extreme.

Fortunately, the Master of Tiancan Valley also supported them starting from the most basic level, so for quite a long time, many players had been busy with fundamental industrial preparations.

Now, the harvest season had practically arrived. Not only had the players' levels increased, but their industrial and agricultural foundations were also taking shape.

Both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were well aware that the Master of Tiancan Valley's previous self-concealment under the pretext of recuperating from injuries was simply waiting for this exact period to arrive.

After leaving the Royal City, the two of them made a trip to the underground library in Black Forest City.

Lang Mu told Shang Feifan, "I plan to chat with the soul of Marquis Denton today."

"You're confident?" Shang Feifan was extremely supportive of this.

Lang Mu replied, "While eradicating the Grand Duke of Chester's soul, I made some discoveries. Perhaps Marquis Denton has the exact same problem. This issue might just become the breakthrough I need to shatter his soul defense."

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. "What problem?"

Lang Mu deliberately withheld it. "I'll tell you in a bit."

The old man popped out the moment the two of you stepped into the library.

"You two really know how to stir up trouble. The Priest Palace even complained to me, saying they clearly commissioned you to handle a matter, yet you ended up tossing a massive headache right back at them. Right now, the Priest Palace is conducting an internal purge."

"Did the purge yield any results?" Shang Feifan asked casually.

The old man sighed. "How could it be that fast? Having been infiltrated for so long, even the upper echelons are no longer trustworthy. The Priest Palace has decided to recall all priests stationed in various regions."

"Isn't that throwing the baby out with the bathwater?" Lang Mu frowned.

The old man said, "It's still better than having those dispatched priests collude with the evil god and drag an entire country and tribe down into the abyss."

"True." This time, Shang Feifan stood on the old man's side. "It doesn't matter whether priests are dispatched or not. The greatest function of priests is to be responsible for the transmission of knowledge and technology, but the Priest Palace hasn't produced any truly useful heritage in all these years—that in itself is a problem. Now that we have the genuine heritage provided by this library, those priests don't serve much purpose anyway."

Lang Mu thought about it and realized it made sense. Because the Tiger King had previously placed great importance on the Royal Court Priests, he had subconsciously assumed that this position was indispensable. But upon closer reflection, aside from offering some vague prophecies, verifying royal bloodlines, and teaching knowledge to members of the royal family, the Royal Court Priests didn't seem entirely irreplaceable.

Besides, priests capable of prophecy were exceedingly rare to begin with.

Although the priests dispatched to other countries and tribes each had their own skills, truly lacking them didn't mean those countries and tribes would grind to a halt.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第223章 解决丹顿侯爵灵魂 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第223章 解决丹顿侯爵灵魂

丹顿侯爵没想到自己还会醒过来。

不，他知道会醒过来，但没想到醒来时看到的会是杀死他的两个人。

商非凡冲他笑笑。

“日安，丹顿侯爵。”另一道声音响起。

丹顿侯爵目光转向一边，“拉斐尔郎沐。”

看来，他和王后都小瞧了这个野种！

“是我。您的时间不多，有些事情我想请教您，希望您能如实告知。当然，您不愿说也没关系，我只是想要解开几个疑惑。”郎沐礼貌地说。

丹顿侯爵下意识低头查看自己的状况，随后沉默。

他竟然是灵魂状态，可对面两个人不但能看到他，还能跟他交谈。

这可能吗？

“我的尸体呢？我记得你答应过我，会把我的尸体交给我妹妹。”丹顿侯爵怒视商非凡。

商非凡摆摆手：“别这样看我，我说话算话，我确实把你的尸体交给了你妹。听说她看到你尸体的当天，人就没了，大概是太激动。”

王后一死，二王子就带着队伍离开丹顿侯爵领地，坐船去寻找适合居住的海中岛屿。

丹顿侯爵家族留下的一切都被虎王重新收回。

这也是一种交换，二王子以丹顿家族领地和资产来交换他的自由。

丹顿侯爵不可置信：“王后死了？怎么可能？你们做了什么？”

商非凡：“我们做了很多，要从哪里跟你说起？别用我们害死了王后的表情看着我们，就跟你一样，你那位曾孙女之所以早死，全是她自己作出来的。”

丹顿侯爵听到曾孙女这个用词，眼皮跳了跳，不再揪着王后不放，改口问：“为什么我的灵魂会脱离我的身体？”

商非凡像看天真小孩一样地看丹顿侯爵：“当然是我们取了出来。总不能留给王后，让她再给你寻找一个容器。你很聪明，在我审问你时，用真话换取我的信任和同情，然后当场死在我面前，换取我把你尸体交给你妹的可能。一般而言，出于对死者的尊重，加上信息交换的代价，我确实会信守这个承诺。但你自己聪明，也别把别人当傻子看好吗？”

丹顿侯爵被商非凡的眼神气到，也心惊对方说出的事情，更心惊对方竟然能把他的灵魂和身体分离。

“是不是惊讶我们知道太多？”商非凡戏谑地：“那只因为你不是唯一一个给自己准备容器还转魂成功的人。”

丹顿侯爵大概觉得自己逃不掉了，摆出了“随便你们吧，反正别想再从我口中问出任何事情”的不合作态度。

郎沐在一边不紧不慢地开口：“您的灵魂之所以能死而未散，不但能转移到自己直系后代的身体中，还能在再次死亡后仍旧保持灵魂的完整，只因为您的灵魂中被注入了一丝邪神的精神力。”

丹顿侯爵不语，脸上有着明显的不信和对郎沐的不屑。那表情似乎在说：小崽子，别想用这招骗倒我。

郎沐笑了笑：“否则您以为您的灵魂有多特殊，竟然能连续两次死亡都能保持完整？还是您以为您付出的代价足够让真神教为您的灵魂不灭如此费心？”

丹顿侯爵想说他自然是付出了足够代价。

郎沐摇摇头：“您确实付出了代价，但不是您以为的那些。而是当您走入那个法阵开始，您就在持续地付出代价。您在用您的灵魂和精神力蕴养着邪神的那丝精神力，您活得越久，对那丝邪神精神力越好。坦白说吧，你就是个傀儡，你的灵魂早在你走入那个法阵时就被控制、被侵蚀。”

丹顿侯爵喉咙动了动，但还是拒绝说话，更拒绝相信。

郎沐：“你是不是经常头疼？需要服用精神恢复以及提升类药剂和食物才能好过一些？”

丹顿侯爵嘴唇紧闭。

郎沐笑：“看来是了。之前我探查你的灵魂时就察觉到一丝异样。不知道侯爵你对灵魂学了解多少？”

郎沐也不需要丹顿侯爵回答，紧接着说：“我学习过的灵魂学说告诉我，灵魂有生灵和死灵的区别，另外还有残损灵魂、灵魂碎片、缺魂以及灵魂侵蚀的说法。而你的情况就是灵魂侵蚀。

什么是灵魂侵蚀？

这就要说到灵魂的构成，灵魂学说中，灵魂分为三魂七魄，三魂分别为天魂、地魂和人魂。天魂掌管智慧和自我意识，地魂掌管经验和记忆，人魂掌管身体和感情。而七魄，我们可以简单总结为精神力。

经过我的检查，发现侯爵你的三魂只剩下天魂和地魂。那丝精神力吞噬了你的人魂，并正在侵入你的天魂和地魂。

换言之，你的记忆让你以为你还存在，实际上你早就不是你。至少有一部分已经不是你。”

郎沐说到这里，停顿了一会儿，给了丹顿侯爵消化的时间。

随后他又给出重重一击：“这也是为什么你越来越不在乎自己的后代、家族和领地子民的缘故。你只在意力量，因为邪神想要获取力量，邪神不在乎这个世界变成什么样，只在乎自己有没有吸收到更多能量。你觉得自己的行为和想法都是出于你自身，实际上那只是邪神的渴望。”

郎沐看向丹顿侯爵魂体：“如果是原来的你，你觉得你会献祭整个黑森林城几十万民众吗？你会隐瞒黑森林城地下城有可能会爆发岩浆的事情吗？会把自己的后代嫁给国王吗？”

郎沐摇头：“不是的。原来的你并不是这种人。原来的你极为重视家族发展，更不会和国王联姻，因为你清楚知道和国王联姻的下场，不会让丹顿家族更为壮大，而是会给与王室吞没丹顿家族的机会。

原来的你为发展领地子民数量，给出了很多益民措施，这也是黑森林城能快速发展起来的原因。

原来的你也不在乎石耳，哪怕你知道那可能含有神灵的力量，但你只是把它放入家族宝库。因为你深知，神灵的力量同样代表灾难和毁灭。”

郎沐叹息：“可你原本的想法在你魂转到你曾孙子身上后就全都变了。你开始迫切地追寻石耳，想要得到神灵的力量。你甚至不惜献祭无数子民，只为了满足私欲。”

“你说你献祭那么多人是为了利用邪神的力量来让岩浆喷发的灾难消失。这话你扪心自问，可信吗？”

“邪神是什么存在？祂巴不得这个世界毁灭才好，祂怎么可能把自己的力量借给你使用去消除灾难？”

空荡荡的读书室内陷入寂静。

商非凡和郎沐就只看着丹顿侯爵的灵魂。

丹顿侯爵缓缓抬起头，蓦然道：“你既然这么了解灵魂，为什么不直接对我进行灵魂拷问？你应该能做到吧？”

郎沐点头，“是，我能做到。但你的情况比较特殊，那丝邪神精神力侵蚀你的同时，也保护了你的记忆。如果我强行对你进行灵魂拷问或搜魂，你的灵魂会立刻破碎成为邪神的养料。”

郎沐没说他如果对丹顿侯爵进行搜魂，那一丝潜伏的邪神精神力也有可能钻入他的精神海中。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 223: Resolving Marquis Denton's Soul (Part 1)

Marquis Denton had never expected that he would wake up again.

No, he knew he would wake up, but he hadn't expected that the first things he saw upon waking would be the two people who had killed him.

Shang Feifan smiled at him.

"Good day, Marquis Denton," another voice rang out.

Marquis Denton shifted his gaze to the side. "Raphael Lang Mu."

It seemed both he and the Queen had underestimated this bastard!

"It's me. Your time is limited, and there are some matters I wish to consult you about. I hope you can answer truthfully. Of course, it doesn't matter if you're unwilling to speak; I merely wish to untangle a few doubts," Lang Mu said politely.

Marquis Denton instinctively looked down to check his own condition, and then fell silent.

He was actually in a soul state, yet the two people across from him could not only see him but converse with him as well.

Was this even possible?

"Where is my corpse? I remember you promised me you would hand my body over to my sister," Marquis Denton glared at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan waved a hand. "Don't look at me like that. I keep my word; I did indeed hand your body over to your sister. I heard that the very day she saw your corpse, she passed away—probably from too much excitement."

With the Queen's death, the Second Prince had taken his troops and departed Marquis Denton's territory, boarding a ship to search for a habitable island in the sea.

Everything the Marquis Denton family had left behind was repossessed by the Tiger King.

This was also an exchange: the Second Prince traded the Denton family's territory and assets in exchange for his own freedom.

Marquis Denton was incredulous. "The Queen is dead? How is that possible? What did you do?"

Shang Feifan replied, "We did a lot. Where should I start telling you? Don't look at us with that expression as if we murdered the Queen; just like you, the reason your great-granddaughter died young was entirely because of her own making."

Hearing the term "great-granddaughter," Marquis Denton's eyelids twitched. He stopped harping on the Queen and changed the subject: "Why did my soul detach from my body?"

Shang Feifan looked at Marquis Denton as if looking at an innocent child. "Of course, because we extracted it. We couldn't very well leave it for the Queen so she could find another vessel for you. You're clever; during my interrogation, you used the truth to win my trust and sympathy, and then died right in front of me to secure the possibility of having your corpse handed over to your sister. Generally speaking, out of respect for the dead, coupled with the cost of exchanging information, I would indeed honor that promise. But while you're clever, don't take others for fools, alright?"

Marquis Denton was both infuriated by Shang Feifan's gaze and deeply alarmed by the things he revealed—and even more terrified that they were actually able to separate his soul from his body.

"Surprised that we know so much?" Shang Feifan teased playfully. "That's simply because you aren't the only one who prepared a vessel for yourself and successfully transferred your soul."

Realizing he likely couldn't escape, Marquis Denton adopted an uncooperative attitude: *Do as you please, you won't be getting a single word out of me anyway.*

Lang Mu spoke up from the side, unhurried: "The reason your soul was able to persist after death without dispersing—not only transferring into the body of your direct descendant, but also maintaining soul integrity after dying a second time—is simply because a sliver of the evil god's spiritual power was injected into your soul."

Marquis Denton remained silent, his face displaying blatant disbelief and disdain toward Lang Mu. His expression practically said: *Little brat, don't think you can fool me with this trick.*

Lang Mu smiled. "Or else just how special do you think your soul is, that it could remain intact across two consecutive deaths? Or do you think the price you paid was enough to make the True God Cult go to such painstaking lengths for your soul's immortality?"

Marquis Denton wanted to retort that he had naturally paid a sufficient price.

Lang Mu shook his head. "You did pay a price, but not the one you imagine. Rather, the moment you stepped into that formation, you began paying that price continuously. You were using your soul and spiritual power to nurture that sliver of the evil god's spiritual power. The longer you lived, the better it was for that sliver of the evil god's spiritual power. To put it bluntly, you are merely a puppet; your soul was controlled and eroded the moment you walked into that formation."

Marquis Denton's throat moved, but he still refused to speak, let alone believe it.

Lang Mu continued, "Don't you often suffer from headaches? Do you need to consume spiritual recovery and enhancement potions and foods just to feel a bit better?"

Marquis Denton kept his lips tightly sealed.

Lang Mu smiled. "It seems so. When I probed your soul earlier, I detected a hint of anomaly. I wonder how much Marquis knows about soul science?"

Not waiting for Marquis Denton to answer, Lang Mu pressed on: "The soul science I studied tells me that souls are divided into living souls and dead souls, along with concepts such as damaged souls, soul fragments, missing souls, and soul erosion. And your condition is precisely soul erosion.

What is soul erosion?

This brings us to the composition of the soul. In soul science, the soul is divided into three souls and seven魄 (anima/corporeal souls). The three souls are the Heavenly Soul, the Earthly Soul, and the Human Soul. The Heavenly Soul governs wisdom and self-awareness; the Earthly Soul governs experience and memory; the Human Soul governs the body and emotions. As for the seven魄, we can simply summarize them as spiritual power.

Through my examination, I discovered that of your three souls, only the Heavenly Soul and the Earthly Soul remain. That sliver of spiritual power devoured your Human Soul and is currently invading your Heavenly Soul and Earthly Soul.

In other words, your memories make you believe you still exist, but in reality, you haven't been yourself for a long time. At least a portion of you is no longer you."

Saying this, Lang Mu paused for a moment, giving Marquis Denton time to digest the information.

Then, he delivered a heavy blow: "This is also why you grew increasingly indifferent to your descendants, your family, and the subjects of your territory. You only care about power, because the evil god desires to acquire power. The evil god doesn't care what happens to this world; it only cares whether it has absorbed more energy. You feel that your actions and thoughts stem from your own will, but in truth, those are merely the cravings of the evil god."

Lang Mu looked at Marquis Denton's spectral form. "If it were the original you, do you think you would have sacrificed hundreds of thousands of civilians in Black Forest City? Would you have concealed the possibility of magma erupting in Black Forest City's underground? Would you have married your own descendant off to the king?"

Lang Mu shook his head. "No. The original you was not such a person. The original you placed extreme importance on the development of the family, and certainly wouldn't have allied through marriage with the king. Because you clearly understood that the outcome of marrying into the royalty wouldn't strengthen the Denton family; rather, it would provide the royal family with an opportunity to swallow the Dentons whole.

The original you introduced numerous pro-people measures to develop the population of your territory, which is why Black Forest City was able to develop so rapidly.

The original you didn't care about stone ears either. Even when you knew they might contain divine power, you merely tossed them into the family treasury, because you were deeply aware that the power of gods equally represents disaster and destruction."

Lang Mu sighed. "Yet all your original thoughts completely changed after your soul transferred into your great-grandson. You began eagerly pursuing stone ears, desperate to obtain divine power. You even stopped at nothing to sacrifice countless subjects, merely to satisfy your private desires.

You claim that sacrificing so many people was to utilize the evil god's power to eliminate the disaster of the magma eruption. Ask your own conscience—is that believable?"

"What kind of existence is the evil god? It wishes for nothing more than the destruction of this world; how could it possibly lend its power to you to eliminate a disaster?"

The empty study fell into a heavy silence.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu simply gazed at Marquis Denton's soul.

Marquis Denton slowly raised his head and abruptly said, "Since you understand souls so well, why didn't you just subject me to a soul interrogation directly? You should be able to do that, right?"

Lang Mu nodded. "Yes, I can do that. But your situation is rather unique. While that sliver of the evil god's spiritual power eroded you, it also protected your memories. If I were to forcefully subject you to soul interrogation or soul-searching, your soul would instantly shatter and become nourishment for the evil god."

Lang Mu didn't mention that if he were to search Marquis Denton's soul, that lurking sliver of the evil god's spiritual power might also burrow into his own sea of consciousness.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第223章 解决丹顿侯爵灵魂 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
那丝邪神精神力原本没有这么厉害，但被丹顿侯爵蕴养这么多年，已经变得越来越强大。

这就是郎沐在切斯特大公灵魂上发现的秘密。

不过切斯特大公灵魂中的那丝邪神精神力不算很强，大概是蕴养时间没有丹顿侯爵这么长。

郎沐也因此搞清楚为什么邪神会看中伊曼切斯特身体当容器的同时，还允许切斯特大公也打伊曼身体的主意。

因为不管是谁得到伊曼切斯特这个身体容器，未来的内芯都会变成邪神厄穆克拉索。

丹顿侯爵：“按照你的说法，我已经没救了对吗？”

郎沐没有隐瞒：“是。如果你只是缺魂，哪怕缺少的那部分灵魂已经消失，也可以通过养魂的手段，让你的灵魂慢慢重新变得完整，就像重新孕育一样。但你的情况是灵魂侵蚀，还是被邪神这样的存在侵蚀，邪神的精神力已经密布你的灵魂，无法拔除。除非有比邪神更厉害且擅长灵魂术法的存在，但是……”

丹顿侯爵：“我会很快失去自我？”

“实际上你已经开始失去自我意识和自我判断。我想侯爵你其实也已经察觉，只是不想承认。但那个原本骄傲、高洁的丹顿侯爵真的愿意让自己变成傀儡吗？”郎沐毫不留情地说。

“你不需要拿这种话来激我。你就不适合扮演这种角色。”丹顿侯爵不屑。

郎沐笑笑，他确实不适合当个说客，但真诚的人说出的话往往也最刺激人：“我知道你想要继续找个身体活下去，但这对原来的那个丹顿侯爵还有什么意义？你都已经不是你，甚至你最看重的家族都被你连累得已经差不多都毁了。就算你再找到一具适合的身体进行魂转，也只是拿丹顿家族剩下的东西继续给邪神和邪神信徒送养料、当炮灰，而堂堂侯爵你就只是一个马前卒。”

“闭嘴！”

丹顿侯爵再次陷入沉默，过了好一会儿才再次开口：“你想知道什么？”

商非凡略惊讶地瞟向郎沐。

郎沐回给他一个眼神：那是你对这个世界的老派贵族不了解。这些老派贵族可骄傲了。他们的骄傲让他们的自尊心特别高，无法忍受别人对他们的无礼和戏弄。

他们比任何人都贪婪，可就因为这份极致的贪婪，也让他们无法忍受自己的利益被侵犯。

他们可以为延长寿命和邪神合作，但当他们发现邪神在欺骗他们，打他们本身和家族的主意，还想吸干他们时，他们也会疯狂报复。

郎沐最终从丹顿侯爵口中问出了几个他很想知道的问题的答案。

商非凡也和丹顿侯爵又聊了聊。

这次丹顿侯爵是真毫无隐瞒，他唯一的要求就是让虎王给自己正名：向全虎国宣告丹顿侯爵并不是出于本意想要献祭黑森林城城民，曾经那个优秀的骄傲的丹顿侯爵早已经死亡，现在这个只是邪神控制的傀儡。

商非凡和郎沐都很肯定虎王一定会同意丹顿侯爵的这个请求。

因为二王子虽然献出了丹顿家族留下的一切地盘和资产，但在丹顿侯爵失踪的状况下到底名不正言不顺。

加上王后出逃和身死，其他贵族都感到兔死狐悲，对虎王私底下有很多怨言。

可现在丹顿侯爵带他们找到了只有家主本人才知道的密室和里面的家主炼金印章和私库，并借用商非凡给他的黑暗力量，灵魂实体化，亲手写下了领地和资产转让书，还给虎王写了一封信。

郎沐还用魔法录下了这一段影像。

这些东西交给虎王，只要利用得好，就能让贵族们把对虎王和王室的怨恨转移到邪神信徒和邪神身上。

虎王还能利用丹顿侯爵的遗书，集中虎国人对邪神的仇恨，甚至能把王后干的一系列事情都推到真神教身上，重新凝聚有些散掉的虎国民众的心。

郎沐对丹顿侯爵的灵魂施展了他目前掌握的最高灵魂类魔法，商非凡在一边相助，确保没有任何力量逃出。

丹顿侯爵的灵魂就此彻底消失，能量回归天地本源。

郎沐没有欺骗丹顿侯爵，邪神的精神力确实已经侵蚀了他整个灵魂，救无可救。

丹顿侯爵不想再被控制，只能选择死个干干净净。

“没想到丹顿侯爵把黑森林城城民赶入地下城，不止是为了借用邪神力量来遏制岩浆爆发，更为了延长自己的健康和寿命，还有更强大的力量。”郎沐轻叹。

商非凡正在看系统提示，之前黑森林城的任务六十七终于完成，得到奖励20点贡献点和四级魔晶一枚。

商非凡转手就把魔晶塞给郎沐：“权贵们什么都有了，落到最后最想要的无非也就是更长的寿命和更健康的身体，以及能掌握更强大的力量。”

郎沐也不问这枚纯魔晶哪里来的，收入戒指：“他应该发现了持续魂转对他的灵魂不好。”

“就算是邪神，恐怕也没办法让人的灵魂可以没有任何限制地不断转移。”商非凡话锋一转，转到治理岩浆灾害上：“刚才丹顿侯爵提到了黑水河平原岩浆爆发的时间点，说是邪神信徒告诉他的。你觉得可信吗？”

郎沐问：“你是不是有相关任务？”

“有，奖励还不错，有50点贡献点和一辆特价装备的有翼飞车。”商非凡对那辆有翼飞车很心动，“你的领地就在黑水河平原，如果我们想要发展你的领地，这个岩浆爆发的灾难就不得不处理。”

商非凡此时是真的嗅到了一点命运的味道。

不说莫约镇就在黑水河平原上，只说虎王给郎沐的补偿，他们就不可能不要。

那么大一片领地，还免租免税那么多年，以商非凡的性子，怎么可能放过？

更不要说郎沐知道黑水河平原有可能爆发岩浆灾害，让他不闻不问，就不可能。

所以这个任务，他们是做也得做，不做也得做。

“如果丹顿侯爵提到的那个时间点是真的，那么我们也就只剩下四个月不到的时间。问问光球吧，原本的命运线中应该也有黑水河平原的岩浆爆发灾难，我们看看那时候是怎么解决的。”郎沐提议。

商非凡不抱希望：“那家伙恐怕不会说太多，否则它早就跳出来了。”

郎沐：“问问吧，有个提醒或方向也是好的。至少我们现在不可能去修复神之笼。”

商非凡忽然道：“其实它已经告诉我们方向。”

郎沐一愣：“它说了什么？”

商非凡：“转移灾难，集中处理。”
chunks.englishText:
That strand of the Evil God's spiritual power had not originally been so formidable, but after being nurtured by Marquis Denton for so many years, it had grown increasingly powerful.

This was the secret Lang Mu had discovered within Grand Duke Chester's soul.

However, the strand of the Evil God's spiritual power within Grand Duke Chester's soul was not particularly strong, likely because the duration of its nurturing was not as long as Marquis Denton's.

Because of this, Lang Mu had also figured out why the Evil God had taken a fancy to Iman Chester's body as a vessel while simultaneously allowing Grand Duke Chester to harbor designs on Iman's body as well.

It was because no matter whose body became the vessel of Iman Chester, the core within them in the future would inevitably be transformed into the Evil God, Eumuchlasso.

Marquis Denton: "According to what you're saying, I'm already beyond saving, aren't I?"

Lang Mu did not conceal the truth: "Yes. If you were merely missing a piece of your soul—even if that missing part had completely vanished—you could still use soul-nurturing methods to slowly make your soul whole again, much like a rebirth. But your situation is soul erosion, and moreover, an erosion by an entity like the Evil God. The Evil God's spiritual power has already permeated your soul, rendering it impossible to excise. Unless there exists an entity more formidable than the Evil God and well-versed in soul sorcery, but..."

Marquis Denton: "I will soon lose myself?"

"In reality, you have already begun to lose your self-awareness and self-judgment. I imagine you have actually noticed this yourself, Marquis, only you refuse to admit it. But is that once proud, noble Marquis Denton truly willing to let himself become a puppet?" Lang Mu said relentlessly.

"You don't need to use words like this to provoke me. You are simply unsuited to play this kind of role," Marquis Denton said with disdain.

Lang Mu chuckled. He indeed was not cut out to be a lobbyist, but the words spoken by a sincere person were often the most provoking: "I know you want to continue finding a body to live on, but what meaning would that hold for the original Marquis Denton? You are no longer yourself, and even the family you value most has been implicated to the point of near-destruction. Even if you find another suitable body for soul-transferrence, you will only be taking what remains of the House of Denton to continue providing nourishment and serving as cannon fodder for the Evil God and his cultists, while you, a dignified Marquis, will be nothing more than a pawn in the vanguard."

"Shut up!"

Marquis Denton fell silent once more. After a long while, he spoke again: "What do you want to know?"

Shang Feifan glanced at Lang Mu with slight surprise.

Lang Mu returned his gaze with a look: *That's because you don't understand the old-school nobility of this world. These old-school aristocrats are immensely proud. Their pride makes their self-esteem exceptionally high, and they cannot tolerate being treated with disrespect or mockery by others.*

They were greedier than anyone else, but precisely because of this ultimate greed, they also could not tolerate having their interests infringed upon.

They might cooperate with the Evil God to prolong their lives, but when they discovered that the Evil God was deceiving them, harboring designs on them and their family, and attempting to drain them dry, they would also retaliate with madness.

In the end, Lang Mu extracted the answers to several questions he was eager to know from the lips of Marquis Denton.

Shang Feifan also chatted with Marquis Denton for a while longer.

This time, Marquis Denton truly held nothing back. His only request was for the Tiger King to clear his name: to proclaim to the entire Tiger Kingdom that Marquis Denton had never intended of his own volition to sacrifice the citizens of Black Forest City, that the once outstanding and proud Marquis Denton had long since perished, and that the current one was merely a puppet controlled by the Evil God.

Both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were certain that the Tiger King would readily agree to this request from Marquis Denton.

Because although the Second Prince had surrendered all the territories and assets left behind by the House of Denton, in the event of Marquis Denton's disappearance, his actions ultimately lacked proper justification and authority.

Coupled with the flight and death of the Queen, the other nobles were all feeling a deep sense of shared grief for the fallen and harbored many private grievances against the Tiger King.

Yet now, Marquis Denton had led them to the secret chamber known only to the head of the house, along with the family head's alchemical seal and private treasury within. Borrowing the dark power given to him by Shang Feifan to materialize his soul, he had personally written the deed of transfer for his territories and assets, and also penned a letter to the Tiger King.

Lang Mu even used magic to record this entire sequence of events.

If these items were handed over to the Tiger King and utilized properly, they could successfully shift the nobles' resentment towards the Tiger King and the royal family onto the Evil God and his cultists.

The Tiger King could also leverage Marquis Denton's suicide note to concentrate the Tiger people's hatred towards the Evil God, and even pin all the series of actions committed by the Queen onto the True God Cult, thereby re-unifying the somewhat fractured hearts of the Tiger Kingdom's citizens.

Lang Mu cast the highest-level soul-type magic he currently mastered upon Marquis Denton's soul, with Shang Feifan assisting from the side to ensure that not a single shred of energy could escape.

Marquis Denton's soul was thus completely obliterated, its energy returning to the primal origin of heaven and earth.

Lang Mu had not deceived Marquis Denton; the Evil God's spiritual power had indeed eroded his entire soul, making him beyond saving.

Marquis Denton did not wish to be controlled any longer, and could only choose to die completely and utterly.

"I never expected that Marquis Denton drove the citizens of Black Forest City into the underground city not only to borrow the Evil God's power to suppress the magma eruptions, but also to prolong his own health and lifespan, as well as to gain greater power," Lang Mu sighed softly.

Shang Feifan was currently checking the system prompts. Mission Sixty-Seven of Black Forest City had finally been completed, yielding a reward of 20 contribution points and a Tier 4 magic crystal.

Shang Feifan casually shoved the magic crystal over to Lang Mu: "The wealthy and powerful have everything. In the end, what they desire most is nothing more than a longer lifespan, a healthier body, and the ability to wield greater power."

Lang Mu didn't bother asking where this pure magic crystal came from, tucking it straight into his ring: "He must have discovered that continuous soul-transferrence was detrimental to his soul."

"Even an Evil God probably has no way to make a human soul continuously transfer without any restrictions." Shang Feifan changed the subject, turning to the governance of the magma disaster: "Earlier, Marquis Denton mentioned the timeframe for the Black Forest Plain magma eruption, saying the Evil God cultists told him. Do you think it's reliable?"

Lang Mu asked: "Do you have a related quest?"

"I do, and the reward is quite decent: 50 contribution points and a discounted winged flyer." Shang Feifan was quite tempted by that winged flyer. "Your territory is right in the Black Forest Plain. If we want to develop your domain, this magma eruption disaster is something we simply cannot afford to ignore."

At this moment, Shang Feifan truly caught a faint scent of destiny.

Not to mention that Moyue Town was situated right on the Black Forest Plain, just the compensation given to Lang Mu by the Tiger King made it impossible for them to refuse.

With such a vast expanse of territory, exempt from rent and taxes for so many years—given Shang Feifan's temperament, how could he possibly let it go?

Not to mention that since Lang Mu knew the Black Forest Plain might suffer a magma eruption disaster, turning a blind eye and pretending not to care was simply out of the question.

Therefore, this quest was something they had to complete whether they wanted to or not.

"If the timeframe mentioned by Marquis Denton is accurate, then we have less than four months left. Let's ask the orb; the original timeline should also feature the Black Forest Plain magma eruption disaster, so we can see how it was resolved back then," Lang Mu suggested.

Shang Feifan held little hope: "That fellow probably won't say much, otherwise it would have popped out long ago."

Lang Mu: "Let's ask anyway. Having a reminder or a direction is better than nothing. At least there's no way we can go and repair the God's Cage right now."

Shang Feifan suddenly said: "Actually, it has already told us the direction."

Lang Mu was stunned: "What did it say?"

Shang Feifan: "Relocate the disaster, concentrate the treatment."

第224章 回去莫约镇

郎沐觉得不可思议，哪怕他现在已经达到魔导师境界，但是让他把岩浆喷发的灾难转移到其他地方，再集中处理，怎么想都觉得做不到。

商非凡失笑，揉揉他的脑袋：“宝贝，你想岔了。这个转移灾难，不是说让你把那片灾难地区全部割离出来，再转移到其他地方。而是类似治理洪水一样，疏通河道或者干脆挖出一条新的河道，让洪水有泄流的地方。”

郎沐恍然大悟，这样一想似乎就简单多了，至少变得可操作。只是需要他们去了解地脉和地下岩浆聚集的情况。

“你可真聪明。”

商非凡就喜欢郎沐夸自己，但嘴上还是谦虚地说：“经验而已。”

他待过的很多地方，除了战争灾难，各种地质灾害也很常见。

人总说越苦难的地方越倒霉，有时候真就是这样。

原本轻易可以解决的问题，只因为当地人贫穷愚昧，又没有政府和相关机构帮忙，最后小问题往往能酿造成大型灾难。

如果那个地方又比较关键，甚至会被人为地搞出灾难来。

商非凡就亲身经历过一件人为酿造的大惨事。

左右两个地区，中间只相隔一座山，但左边富裕，右边极为贫穷，而且两边各属不同的势力。

当左边富裕地区发生洪灾时，就有人挖通当中那座山，把洪水全都泄到右边地区，导致原本无事的右边地区被淹成汪洋。

事后右边地区存活的势力虽然跑出来抗议，但屁用没有。

最后右边地区活下来的人也不知从哪里得到了一批“人道支援”的武器，打向左边。

左边地区自然不可能坐以待毙，就给与了回击。

在左边地区看来，右边地区那么穷，就算有武器也是最差的，而且不可能有多少，想着很快就能平定这场骚乱。

但左边地区怎么也没想到，这场骚乱最后竟然发展成了扩散到整个左右两边地区的战争，而且持续时间很长很长。

右边地区始终有人支持，理由就是左边地区先不干人事，看不过去所以支援，真是要粮给粮、要武器给武器，还有专人来训练他们的士兵。

因为那个地区有很多矿和大量木材，商非凡母国在那边投资很多，更希望那边能稳定发展，就派商非凡去当地调查。

商非凡调查到后来发现左边地区出主意泄洪的人，背后竟然和支援右边地区的“人道主义”组织有密切关系。

左右两个地区为了打赢对方，卖出了家中矿山、树林的开发许可，全都是三十年起步。

当战争结束后，两个地区恍然发现，他们的领土表面上还是属于他们，但他们的资源已经属于别国的大型公司。而他们的人口和生活水平已经降到最低，连再次反抗都做不到，而且战争过后，所有事情百废待兴，他们需要食物和各种生活物资，只能给那些大型公司干活。

真正是卖了自己还帮对方数钱。

三十年时间，等两个地区能稍微缓过气，可以反抗的时候，那些大型公司早就赚得盆满钵满。

商非凡也不知道自己怎么会突然想起这件事。

直到他跟郎沐赶到莫约镇。

在赶到莫约镇之前，两人还去了一趟金麦城附近。

两人没有进入松山伯爵管辖的金麦城。

他们是来找郎家人的。

郎家人和两人商量后，没有立刻选定落脚地，而是打算把整个划分给郎沐的黑水荒原领区都看一看。

郎家人有自己的商队，这时候就当做商队在黑水荒原晃悠。

郎老夫人不太适合这样辛苦的商队活动，就和一部分老弱病残先前往莫约镇借住。

郎老伯爵亲自带队，路上到了哪里、遇到什么情况，都会通过简易联络器联络两人。

现在郎家人的商队就在金麦城附近。

这也是他们最初拟定的黑水荒原主城所在地，看中这片地的原因就是因为这片地界已经有发展成熟的金麦城和莫约镇等村镇，人口比较集中，黑水河也流经这片地。

但在得到伊曼切斯特送给两人的那片领地后，商非凡和郎沐两人都觉得把黑水荒原主城放在那片领地和黑水荒原的交界地更好。

那片地既有一条黑水河支流流向大海，又靠近海域，同时南可通王城、北可通天残谷，至少从直线距离上要比从莫约镇和金麦城绕路要近得多。距离摩罗城也不算很远。

缺点就是没有开发，可一旦开发出来，再把路修出来，那就是个四通八达的交通要道。

这次过来，两人就是想把这件事告诉郎家人，让他们分出一批人手去那片地界看看情况。

正好郎老伯爵他们对金麦城附近这片土地不是很满意。

这片土地的情况太糟糕，好的能耕种的土地早就被金麦城占领。

就算差一些的也被一些小型势力霸占。

这些小型势力都和松山伯爵有沾亲带故的关系，处理起来非常麻烦。

虽然郎家人顶着郎沐这个大区长的名义前来，但金麦城并没有被划分到这个大区中，自然不用惧怕郎家人。

而被划入大区的人则背靠金麦城，压根没把这条过江龙放在眼里。

郎老伯爵真的想要下狠手处理这些小势力并不难，他也不怕得罪松山伯爵，就是觉得不值得。

“这里当做主城并不适合。”郎老伯爵见到大孙子和孙婿（？），张口就说。

“这里大小势力太多，虽说能处理，但一一解决太耗时间，那边金麦城还时刻监视我们，想做什么都不方便。”

郎老伯爵边说边展开一张地图，指着地图：“这是我们已经走过的地方，适合做主城的地方被我标记成绿色，特别不适合的标记为红色。”

“但就算是绿色地点，也都有各自缺点。因为我们是沿着河域查看情况，但黑水河附近只要稍微好点的地盘都有人占领。”

“我们可以对付这些小型势力，但我们人手也不多，如果被这些中小型势力联手攻击，那其他事都不用干了，只能成天打仗。可我们最大的问题就是后勤和粮草不足。”

“另外一个不得不考虑的问题，其他贵族势力并不想我们这一支在这里扎下根，他们肯定会给我们找麻烦。这会非常不利于我们的初期发展。”

“所以，”郎老伯爵一点靠近下方的一个绿点：“这是我看中的一个可以扎根的地方，远离中大型势力，优点是附近方圆五百里都没多少人，水源也算丰富，就是有一大片沼泽地带需要治理，还有变异兽虫比较多。但相对的资源也比较丰富。不适合弱者，但适合我们。”

“这片地距离最近的势力就是贝休恩伯爵的领地。哦，现在那里已经不属于贝休恩，而是被贝休恩送给了曾经被他抛弃的天残儿子。”

“另外，这片地还有一条深渊大峡谷和贝休恩领地隔开。可以在初期安心发展。”

商非凡和郎沐对视。

商非凡都不知道该怎么说。郎老伯爵眼光也太好了，竟然一下就选中了一个要命的地方。

Chapter 224: Returning to Moyue Town

Lang Mu found it utterly inconceivable. Even though he had now reached the realm of a Magister, asking him to relocate a magma eruption disaster to another location and then deal with it in a concentrated manner seemed impossible no matter how he thought about it.

Shang Feifan laughed in spite of himself and rubbed his head: "Babe, your train of thought derailed. This 'relocating the disaster' doesn't mean cutting off the entire disaster-stricken area and moving it somewhere else. It's akin to managing a flood—dredging the river channels or simply digging a brand-new channel to give the floodwaters a place to discharge."

Lang Mu had a sudden flash of enlightenment. Thinking about it this way seemed much simpler, or at least feasible. It would simply require them to understand the terrain and the gathering points of the subterranean magma.

"You really are clever."

Shang Feifan loved having Lang Mu praise him, yet he still modestly replied, "It's just experience."

In many of the places he had inhabited, aside from wars and disasters, various geological hazards were also commonplace.

People always said that the bitterest places were the most ill-fated, and sometimes that was truly the case.

Problems that could have been easily resolved ended up escalating into massive disasters simply because the locals were poor and ignorant, lacking any government or relevant institutions to help them out.

If that particular place happened to be of crucial importance, man-made disasters would even be engineered there.

Shang Feifan had personally experienced a major man-made catastrophe.

There were two regions, left and right, separated only by a single mountain. However, the left region was prosperous, while the right was extremely impoverished, and the two sides belonged to entirely different factions.

When a flood struck the prosperous left region, someone dug straight through the intervening mountain, funneling all the floodwaters into the right region and turning the previously safe right region into a vast ocean of water.

Afterward, although the surviving factions from the right region ran out to protest, it was completely useless.

In the end, the survivors of the right region obtained a batch of "humanitarian aid" weapons from somewhere unknown and struck back at the left region.

Naturally, the left region refused to sit idly by and wait for death, so they retaliated.

From the perspective of the left region, the right region was so poor that even if they possessed weapons, they would be of the lowest quality, and there couldn't possibly be many of them. They figured they would suppress this disturbance in no time.

Yet, never in their wildest dreams did the left region expect this disturbance to eventually escalate into a full-scale war spanning both regions, one that lasted an exceedingly long time.

The right region constantly received backing from external supporters, under the banner that the left region had acted abominably first, prompting them to intervene out of righteousness. Truly, they were given grain upon request, weapons upon request, and even had specialists sent to train their soldiers.

Because that region possessed numerous mines and vast timber resources, the motherland of Shang Feifan had heavily invested there and desperately hoped for stable development, dispatching Shang Feifan to investigate the local situation.

During his investigation, Shang Feifan eventually discovered that the person who had devised the flood-diversion scheme for the left region was closely tied behind the scenes to the very "humanitarian" organization supporting the right region.

To win the war, both the left and right regions ended up selling off the exploitation rights to their domestic mines and forests, all starting at thirty-year terms.

When the war finally concluded, both regions dazedly realized that while their territories ostensibly still belonged to them, their resources already belonged to large foreign corporations. Meanwhile, their population and living standards had plummeted to rock bottom, leaving them incapable of even mounting a secondary resistance. Moreover, with the war over, everything lay in ruins; in desperate need of food and all kinds of daily necessities, they had no choice but to work for those massive corporations.

They had truly sold themselves out and even helped the buyers count the money.

By the time thirty years had passed and the two regions could finally catch their breath and contemplate resistance, those large corporations had long since stuffed their pockets full of wealth.

Shang Feifan had no idea why he had suddenly recalled this incident.

Not until he and Lang Mu hurried back to Moyue Town.

Before arriving at Moyue Town, the two of them had also made a trip near Gold Wheat City.

Neither of them entered Gold Wheat City, which was governed by Earl Pine Mountain.

They had come to find the Lang family.

After consulting with the two of them, the Lang family did not immediately choose a place to settle down; instead, they intended to scout out the entirety of the Black Water Wasteland territory that had been assigned to Lang Mu.

The Lang family possessed their own caravan, and at this moment, they were wandering around the Black Water Wasteland disguised as such.

Old Madam Lang was ill-suited for such grueling caravan activities, so she and a portion of the elderly, weak, sick, and disabled had headed to Moyue Town first to lodge there.

Old Count Lang personally led the team, reporting their location and any situations they encountered along the way to the two through simple communication devices.

Right now, the Lang family's caravan was operating near Gold Wheat City.

This was also the location they had initially designated for the Black Water Wasteland's main city. The reason they had set their sights on this area was because it already featured maturely developed towns and villages like Gold Wheat City and Moyue Town, boasting a relatively concentrated population, with the Black Water River also flowing through this region.

However, after acquiring the territory gifted to them by Iman Chester, both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu felt it would be better to place the main city of the Black Water Wasteland at the intersection of that domain and the Black Water Wasteland.

That area not only had a tributary of the Black Water River flowing into the ocean and was close to the sea, but it could also connect southward to the Royal City and northward to the Heavenly Remnant Valley. At least in terms of straight-line distance, it was much closer than taking the detours around Moyue Town and Gold Wheat City. It wasn't too far from Moluo City, either.

The drawback was that it remained undeveloped. But once it was developed and roads were paved, it would transform into a major transportation hub extending in all directions.

Coming here this time, the two wanted to inform the Lang family of this matter and have them dispatch a batch of manpower to inspect the conditions of that region.

Coincidentally, Old Count Lang and his party were not very satisfied with the land near Gold Wheat City.

The conditions of this land were simply too dire; the good, arable land had long since been occupied by Gold Wheat City.

Even the inferior plots were monopolized by various minor factions.

These minor factions all had distantly blood-related ties to Earl Pine Mountain, making them exceptionally troublesome to deal with.

Although the Lang family had arrived bearing the name of Lang Mu, the Grand District Governor, Gold Wheat City had not been partitioned into this grand district, so they naturally had no reason to fear the Lang family.

As for those who had been incorporated into the grand district, they leaned on Gold Wheat City as their backing and completely looked down upon this visiting dragon crossing the river.

It wouldn't be difficult for Old Count Lang to take ruthless action against these minor factions, and he wasn't afraid of offending Earl Pine Mountain; he simply felt it wasn't worth the trouble.

"This place is unsuitable to serve as our main city," Old Count Lang stated the moment he laid eyes on his eldest grandson and grandson-in-law (?).

"There are too many large and small factions here. While they can be dealt with, resolving them one by one consumes far too much time. Furthermore, Gold Wheat City keeps us under constant surveillance, making it inconvenient to do anything."

As he spoke, Old Count Lang unfolded a map and pointed to it: "This is where we've already traveled. Locations suitable for a main city have been marked by me in green, while those completely unsuitable are marked in red."

"However, even the green locations all have their respective flaws. Because we inspected the situation by following the river basins, any decent patch of land near the Black Water River has already been occupied by someone."

"We can handle these minor factions, but our manpower is also limited. If we are jointly attacked by these medium and small factions, we won't be able to accomplish anything else and will just end up fighting battles all day long. Yet our biggest problem right now is insufficient logistics and grain reserves."

"Another issue we must consider is that the other noble factions do not want our branch to take root here; they will undoubtedly stir up trouble for us. This would be extremely detrimental to our early-stage development."

"Therefore," Old Count Lang tapped a green dot located further down: "This is a place I've taken a liking to where we can put down roots. It's far away from the medium and large factions. Its advantage is that there are hardly any people within a radius of five hundred miles, and the water sources are reasonably abundant. The only catches are that there's a vast expanse of wetland that needs draining, and mutant beasts and insects are rather numerous. But correspondingly, the resources are also quite rich. It's unsuitable for the weak, but perfect for us."

"The closest faction to this land is the territory of Earl Bethune. Oh, right now that place no longer belongs to Bethune; it was gifted by him to his Heavenly Remnant son whom he once abandoned."

"In addition, this land is separated from Bethune's territory by an abyss grand canyon. We can develop in peace during our initial stages."

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu exchanged glances.

Shang Feifan didn't even know what to say. Old Count Lang's eye for terrain was simply too incredible; he had unexpectedly zeroed in on a death-trap of a location in one go.

商非凡当即摇头：“这片地不适合。当初我遇到恐惧之神奴仆的地方就在这里。另外，那个天残谷主也把这一片当做了自家势力范围，他已经派人在这里建设了营地。”

“恐惧之神的奴仆？”郎老伯爵眉头紧皱：“如果有那东西游荡在附近，那确实不能选，怪不得那附近人口那么少。”

郎老伯爵又可惜道：“你说的那个营地我也看到了。那也是我选择那边作为初期发展点的原因之一，那边的兽人似乎很擅长做买卖，尤其各种食物做得非常好吃，我还想着把那群兽人给吸纳进来。原来他们都是贝休恩儿子的人？”

郎沐插话：“那些兽人可以用，但不是现在。我们现在到那边发展，反而会引起天残谷主警觉，他为了自家势力发展也会全力打压我们。”

“不过一个天残谷主，他除了美貌还有什么？”郎老伯爵就没把这个天残谷主放在心上。

“他很强。”商非凡坦然道：“他的手下更强。我就明明白白告诉您吧，天残谷主的所有手下都有一个极为可怕的天赋，就是不死。”

郎老伯爵吃惊地张大嘴：“不死？怎么可能？还是全部？”

“就是全部。他们的特质和不死尸有关。”商非凡说：“不过他们身上没有不死尸的毒素。”

“这怎么可能！”郎老伯爵还是不可置信。

拥有不死之力的兽人，还不是一个两个，而是几万。这事要是传出去，非得引爆整个兽人大陆不可。

“这种不死之力也不是没有缺点。他们被控制在天残谷主手中，天残谷主想要让他们消失，他们就会彻底消失。”商非凡含糊地说。

郎老伯爵眉头紧皱：“可就算这样，那也太可怕了。不对，就是这样才更可怕。那个天残谷主控制这么多不死兽人是想干什么？”

商非凡给了他一个“你认为他想干什么”的眼神。

郎老伯爵骂了一句脏话。

郎沐幽幽道：“他不是想要当兽人大陆的皇帝，他的最终目的是想要成为神灵。”

郎老伯爵：“……怪不得他们敢在有恐惧之神奴仆的地方建造营地。我们还是另选地方吧。”

他们不跟神经病靠一起，更不能和一个有野心还有能力的神经病靠一起。

商非凡和郎沐拿出了伊曼切斯特送给他们的那片土地的地图。

郎老伯爵低头看向两人指出说是适合建设主城的地方，研究了好一会儿才说：“位于黑水荒原边界，原本并不适合做主城，但如果这片通往海域的土地都属于我们，包括这条黑水河支流，那确实不错。”

“我会亲自带人过去查看。”郎老伯爵有了事干、有了奔头，整个人每天精神万分生机勃勃，看着都年轻了些许。

两人又把伊曼切斯特送给他们的种子、矿物和一万金的接收地点告诉郎老伯爵，并把信物也转交给他，让他派人去取，表示这些东西就是以后建造黑水荒原主城的第一批基础物资。

有空间储物工具在，取这些东西并不难。

郎家人也是靠着手上有不少空储，才能满荒原走得那么轻松自在，并在短短几个月内就把整个荒原都走了一遍。

他们不需要携带大量行李，走到哪儿都能随时拿出大量生活物资，只要略微布置一番，舒适度就不差。平时只要注意安全就好。

“你们两人这是又要去哪里？你们有没有想过这个领地是你们的，不是我这个老头子的？什么事都扔给我这个老头子做，你们两个年轻人就到处浪是吧？”郎老伯爵说完正事，也有闲心和两个小辈聊家常了。

郎沐不会跟老人撒娇，只握住老人的手不住笑。

郎老伯爵轻哼，“行了行了，你们爱玩就去玩吧！”

郎沐不好意思，“不是玩。我们打算先去莫约镇看看，然后就去那个天残谷主的领地查看。”

郎老伯爵点头：“你们是该去莫约镇看看。我听你姥姥说，莫约镇人对她和她带过去的人都很好，你那位镇长姨父很是照顾她们。另外，商的那个义子阿呆也被照顾得很好。你姥姥直接就把那孩子接到身边，当重孙子在养，她似乎很喜欢那个孩子。”

郎沐轻轻吐气。

商非凡也露出笑容。

“那个天残谷主……，你们和他有仇？”郎老伯爵人老成精，只从两人在提及天残谷主时那略微异样的态度就察觉出他们对天残谷主的不同。

郎沐表情还算淡定，只轻轻点了点头：“算是吧。这人必须解决，否则他会给我们乃至整个兽人大陆都带来危险。”

郎老伯爵看看孙子，又看看孙婿，“你们两人都是有成算的。我也不问你们详细，你们自己小心行事就好。另外，记住你们都是有家的人了，别不把自己的命当命。”

两人一起笑起来。

商非凡拍胸-脯：“姥爷，您放心，阿沐一定会保护好我，他会保护我半根汗毛都不会少。否则等我们回来，姥爷你打他。”

“滚球！”郎老伯爵笑骂：“你们两人都给我好好的知道么？”

郎沐上前，轻轻抱住老伯爵，在老人耳边轻声说：“姥爷，谢谢。”

“去玩吧，玩得开心点。”郎老伯爵拍拍大孙子的肩膀，把两人送出临时营地。

“帮我跟你姨父姨母问好。”

“嗯！”郎沐知道，狼老伯爵这意思是想认下这门亲戚，只要对方也有那个意愿的话。

莫约镇距离金麦城不算远，以巨虫坐骑的脚力，两三天就能赶到。

商非凡也想见见阿呆。

虽然阿呆是硬靠上来的，但相处日久，商非凡对这个便宜儿子多少还是有点感情的。

否则他也不会特意让女管家玛利亚去莫约镇照顾阿呆。

郎沐的心情要复杂得多。

他对莫约镇的感情来源全在镇长姨父身上。

这位镇长姨父对他是真没话说。

可他现在身世大明，托八卦报宣传的福，现在整个虎国几乎都知道他不是安妮塔和虎王的私生子，而是前侍卫统领郎飞的儿子。

这样的身份，他不知道回到莫约镇时，那位镇长姨父会如何看他待他。

另外，他的领区租界范围也包括莫约镇在内，他还有个黑水荒原大区长的名头，从政务到军务全都一把抓，王城以后派来的官员都要受他管辖，比领主权限还大。

而莫约镇已经自治良久。

就问以后他这个大区长要怎么和莫约镇相处？

如果对方不肯交税、不肯按照他制定的大区规则做事，他能派人手去打对方吗？

总之，都是麻烦。

好在他们先见到了郎老伯爵，从老人那里得知莫约镇对他们郎家人并没有排斥心，他的镇长姨父似乎也并没有因为他不是他的血脉亲人就和他的血脉亲人疏远，相反还很照顾他姥姥。

这让郎沐近乡情怯的心安宁了许多。

就快要看到莫约镇了，商非凡突然叫停狰爷，抬头看向不远处的莫约山。

郎沐立刻询问：“怎么？有什么不对劲？”

商非凡眼眸深黑：“死气增多了。”

“嗯？”
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan shook his head instantly. "This area isn't suitable. The place where I previously encountered the minion of the God of Fear is right around here. Besides, that Master of Heavenly Defect has also designated this region as his sphere of influence, and he has already sent people to build an encampment here."

"A minion of the God of Fear?" Old Earl Lang frowned deeply. "If such a creature is wandering nearby, then we certainly cannot choose this location. No wonder the population around here is so sparse."

Old Earl Lang then lamented regretfully, "I saw the encampment you mentioned as well. That was actually one of the reasons I selected this area as our initial development point. The beast-men there seem exceptionally skilled at trade, and they make all kinds of food exceptionally well. I was even thinking of absorbing that group of beast-men into our fold. As it turns out, they belong to Bethune's son?"

Lang Mu interjected, "Those beast-men can be utilized, but not right now. If we go and develop our forces over there at this stage, it will only arouse the vigilance of the Master of Heavenly Defect. To foster the growth of his own sphere of influence, he will spare no effort to suppress us."

"Just a Master of Heavenly Defect—what does he have besides good looks?" Old Earl Lang hadn't taken this Master of Heavenly Defect to heart at all.

"He is very strong," Shang Feifan said candidly. "His subordinates are even stronger. Let me spell it out plainly for you: all of the Master of Heavenly Defect's subordinates possess a terrifying innate trait—immortality."

Old Earl Lang's jaw dropped in astonishment. "Immortality? How is that possible? Every single one of them?"

"Every last one. Their traits are related to immortal corpses," Shang Feifan said. "However, there are no toxins of immortal corpses on their bodies."

"How can this be!" Old Earl Lang still found it hard to believe.

Beast-men who possessed the power of immortality, and not just one or two, but tens of thousands of them. If word of this got out, it would inevitably detonate the entire Beast-men Continent.

"This kind of immortal power is not without its flaws. They are controlled by the Master of Heavenly Defect; if the Master of Heavenly Defect wants them to vanish, they will cease to exist entirely," Shang Feifan said vaguely.

Old Earl Lang frowned deeply. "Even so, that is still too terrifying. No, precisely because of that, it's all the more terrifying. What on earth is that Master of Heavenly Defect trying to achieve by controlling so many immortal beast-men?"

Shang Feifan gave him a look that said, *What do you think he's trying to achieve?*

Old Earl Lang cursed under his breath.

Lang Mu said softly, "He doesn't just want to be the Emperor of the Beast-men Continent. His ultimate goal is to become a god."

Old Earl Lang: "……No wonder they dared to build an encampment in a place where a minion of the God of Fear resides. Let us pick another location."

They would not cozy up to a madman, let alone an ambitious and capable madman.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu produced the map of the territory that Imanchester had given them.

Old Earl Lang lowered his gaze to the spot the two of them pointed out as suitable for building the main city. After studying it for a good long while, he said, "Situated on the border of the Black Water Wasteland, it wasn't originally suited to be a main city. But if all this land extending to the sea belongs to us, including this tributary of the Black Water River, then indeed, it is quite good."

"I will personally lead men over to inspect it." With a task on his hands and a clear goal to strive for, Old Earl Lang's entire demeanor became intensely spirited and full of vitality; he even looked somewhat younger.

The two of them then told Old Earl Lang the designated collection points for the seeds, minerals, and ten thousand gold coins gifted by Imanchester, handing over the tokens of authority so he could dispatch men to retrieve them. They explained that these supplies would serve as the foundational batch of materials for building the main city of the Black Water Wasteland in the future.

With spatial storage tools at hand, retrieving these items was not difficult.

The Lang family relied on the numerous empty spatial storage items in their possession to travel across the wasteland with such ease and freedom, traversing the entire wasteland within a mere few months.

They did not need to carry heavy luggage; they could pull out vast quantities of daily living necessities at any moment wherever they went, and with just a bit of setup, the comfort level was remarkably high. All they needed to do normally was mind their safety.

"Where are the two of you heading off to this time? Have you ever considered that this territory belongs to you, not an old man like me? Dumping every single task onto this old man while the two of you youngsters run around carefree, is that it?" Once business matters were settled, Old Earl Lang had the leisure to chat with the two juniors like family.

Lang Mu didn't know how to act spoiled in front of elders; he only gripped the old man's hand and smiled continuously.

Old Earl Lang gave a soft humph. "Alright, alright! Go play if you want to play!"

Lang Mu felt embarrassed. "It's not playing. We plan to go take a look at Moyue Town first, and then head over to inspect the territory of that Master of Heavenly Defect."

Old Earl Lang nodded. "You ought to go take a look at Moyue Town. I heard from your grandmother that the people of Moyue Town were very kind to her and the people she brought along, and your town mayor uncle took exceptionally good care of them. Besides, Shang's adopted son, Ah Dai, has also been well cared for. Your grandmother took the child right in and is raising him as her great-grandson; she seems to adore the child."

Lang Mu let out a gentle sigh of relief.

Shang Feifan also smiled.

"That Master of Heavenly Defect... Do you two have a blood feud with him?" Old Earl Lang was a worldly veteran; from the slightly unusual attitude the two of them displayed when mentioning the Master of Heavenly Defect, he instantly sensed their distinct feelings toward him.

Lang Mu's expression remained fairly calm as he gently nodded. "You could say that. This person must be dealt with; otherwise, he will bring danger to us and even the entire Beast-men Continent."

Old Earl Lang looked at his grandson, then at his grandson-in-law. "Both of you have your own calculations. I won't press you for details; just be careful in how you handle things. Furthermore, remember that you both have a family now—don't treat your lives as if they mean nothing."

The two of them laughed together.

Shang Feifan patted his chest. "Grandfather, rest assured. Ah Mu will definitely protect me; he will ensure not even half a hair on my head is harmed. Otherwise, when we come back, Grandfather, you can beat him."

"Get lost!" Old Earl Lang chided with a smile. "Both of you, take good care of yourselves, you hear me?"

Lang Mu stepped forward, gently embraced the old earl, and whispered in the old man's ear, "Grandfather, thank you."

"Go play, have a good time." Old Earl Lang patted his eldest grandson's shoulder and saw the two of them out of the temporary encampment.

"Send my regards to your uncle and aunt."

"Mn!" Lang Mu knew that Old Earl Lang meant he was willing to acknowledge this kinship, provided the other party held the same intention.

Moyue Town was not terribly far from Golden Wheat City. At the traveling speed of the giant worm mount, they could arrive in two or three days.

Shang Feifan also wanted to see Ah Dai.

Although Ah Dai had forcefully latched onto them, after spending a long time together, Shang Feifan inevitably held a degree of affection for this makeshift son.

Otherwise, he wouldn't have specifically arranged for the female housekeeper Maria to go to Moyue Town to take care of Ah Dai.

Lang Mu's state of mind was far more complicated.

His emotional ties to Moyue Town stemmed entirely from his town mayor uncle.

That town mayor uncle had truly been faultless toward him.

Yet now, his background had been laid bare to the world. Thanks to the publicity of the tabloid newspapers, almost the entire Tiger Kingdom knew by now that he was not the illegitimate child of Anita and the Tiger King, but rather the son of the former head guard, Lang Feng.

With such an identity, he didn't know how his town mayor uncle would view and treat him when he returned to Moyue Town.

Furthermore, the jurisdiction of his leased territory also included Moyue Town, and he held the title of Grand Administrator of the Black Water Wasteland, wielding absolute control over both civil administration and military affairs. Officials dispatched from the Royal City in the future would all be subject to his jurisdiction, granting him authority even greater than a traditional lord.

Yet Moyue Town had enjoyed self-governance for a long time.

He couldn't help but wonder how he, this Grand Administrator, was supposed to get along with Moyue Town in the future?

If the other party refused to pay taxes or refused to abide by the regional rules he established, could he dispatch troops to suppress them?

In short, it was all troublesome.

Fortunately, they had first seen Old Earl Lang and learned from the old man that Moyue Town held no xenophobic prejudice against their Lang family, and his town mayor uncle didn't seem to have grown distant from his blood relatives simply because he wasn't of his blood; on the contrary, he took very good care of his grandmother.

This greatly pacified Lang Mu's nervous apprehension of returning to his old hometown.

As they were about to come into view of Moyue Town, Shang Feifan suddenly signaled Zheng Ye to halt, raising his gaze toward Moyue Mountain not far ahead.

Lang Mu immediately asked, "What is it? Is something wrong?"

Shang Feifan's dark eyes narrowed. "The aura of death has increased."

"Oh?"

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡一指莫约山：“那山上的死气非常浓郁，远远超过我上次来的时候。”

郎沐皱眉：“我记得莫约山里有不死尸，传说山底下沉睡着更多。但只要不惊扰它们，它们就不会醒来，也不会走出莫约山范围。”

商非凡总觉得还有什么对方不对劲：“你先去莫约镇，我进莫约山查看情况。”

“我和你一起去。”郎沐立刻道。

商非凡摇头：“不用。那里死气太盛，不适合你，我一个人去更方便。你去莫约镇问问情况，看最近是不是发生了什么异常事情。”

郎沐见商非凡心意已决，他也担心莫约镇那边，最终同意：“好。那你小心！”

“放心。你知道我的本事。”商非凡偏头偷了个亲亲，从狰爷背脊上跳下，快速向莫约山跑去。

商非凡摇头：“不用。那里死气太盛，不适合你，我一个人去更方便。你去莫约镇问问情况，看最近是不是发生了什么异常事情。”

郎沐见商非凡心意已决，他也担心莫约镇那边，最终同意：“好。那你小心！”

“放心。你知道我的本事。”商非凡偏头偷了个亲亲，从狰爷背脊上跳下，快速向莫约山跑去。
"""

chunks.chineseText:
第225章 一天前

一天前。

阿呆早上从被窝里钻出来，趴在床上伸了个大大的懒腰，这才精精神神地跳下床。

刚走出卧室门，就被一只手从地上抄起来。

“奶奶的乖宝，起床了呀，肚子饿不饿？我们去吃饭饭好不好？”独属于老妇人的温柔嗓音在阿呆耳边响起。

阿呆趴在老妇人的怀里，仰头呆呆地看她：错辈啦，曾奶奶。

郎老夫人看到怀中小东西呆头呆脑的模样，喜欢得心都化了。

真是个可爱的小东西~

阿呆早就不同于他刚跟商非凡认识那会儿的凄惨样儿，现在的他吃的好、喝的好、睡的好，生活舒坦，还有很多大人主动照顾他、关心他，更有自己的小玩伴。

就养得一身溜光水滑的皮毛，更肉乎乎的，体型又长不大，抱在怀里就一小团，还长了一个和别人不一样的方脑袋，看起来呆头呆脑傻乎乎，就特别受镇子上的大人和老人欢迎，谁看了都想摸两把抱一抱。

郎老夫人来到莫约镇暂住的第一天就问起阿呆。

这可是她孙子和孙婿收-养的第一个孩子，说不定以后就是他们郎家的继承人，当然要赶紧培养培养感情。

夏冰和玛利亚就带着阿呆过来拜见老夫人。

老夫人给了阿呆见面礼，也没忘记夏冰和玛利亚的份。

夏冰现在在莫约镇混得很不错，他开了一家炼金店，生意不算多好，但糊口绝对没问题。

之前玛利亚没来时，他一个人带着阿呆过，上午送阿呆去镇图书馆上学，中午把阿呆接到店里吃饭，下午再送他过去，傍晚接小孩回家。

阿呆不是难带的孩子，又有镇长和祭司羊大婶的特别照顾，夏冰带着他并不吃力。

等到玛利亚来了后，夏冰就更轻松。

夏冰到底是男孩子，有着绝大多数雄性兽人共通的粗心和随意。他虽然已经很用心地照顾阿呆，但他的用心显然和雌性兽人的用心很不一样。

玛利亚一到，阿呆从头到脚给人感觉就不一样了，一样干干净净，一样吃得饱饱，但就是不一样，这些不一样全都体现在细节上。

比如阿呆的四个爪子，现在每天都有人帮他修毛、剔甲缝里的脏，连趾缝里的毛毛都修理得干干净净，确保阿呆奔跑起来更轻松。

阿呆身上的毛发也被修剪得自然又利落，还被抹了专门养护皮毛的油脂。

天气渐冷，玛利亚还给阿呆做了兽身能穿的小衣服、小袜套、小帽子，穿戴在身上可可爱爱，羡煞镇上一干小兽人。

阿呆每天带的零食也开始变得花样繁多，不但好吃，样式也很可爱。

家里平常吃的饭菜就更不用说，玛利亚特别讲究营养均衡，做出来的饭菜不但对小兽人身体好，还特别好吃。

夏冰也因此沾了光。

他的年龄也不算大，玛利亚在照顾阿呆的同时，顺手就把他也一并照料了。

夏冰一口一个姨姨喊得特别甜，如果不是玛利亚还没有结过婚，他都恨不得直接认玛利亚当妈。

玛利亚来之前还担心要照顾的孩子性格不好，或者排斥她等等。

没想到阿呆是这么好带的孩子，又呆萌可爱得紧。

就是顶着一个猫脑袋的夏冰也是好孩子。

玛利亚喜欢人的表现就是把人从头到脚都照顾起来。

尤其在她发现夏冰并不介意她对他们管头管脚，甚至连店里生意都愿意交给她管以后，她就干脆接手了家里的所有杂事，真正当起了这个小家的管家。

夏冰乐得有人帮他管理杂事，他也能专注于炼金技术方面的提升，没多久就把店铺营业方面几乎都交给了玛利亚。

玛利亚身为曾经的贵族管家，一个大家族都能管得过来，管理这么一个小店铺对她来说根本就是洒洒水的事情。

老夫人询问了玛利亚一些事情，不但很快了解了阿呆的情况，也初步掌握了莫约镇的现状，不由对这个女管家很是满意——阿瑞斯商的眼光还不错。

老夫人把注意力全盘放到了阿呆身上，她看到阿呆的第一眼就喜欢得不要不要。

阿呆见她招手，就颠颠地跑过来，抬头奶声奶气地喊她曾奶奶。

可把老夫人萌坏了，抱住就不肯撒手。

阿呆不是闹腾的孩子，看起来有点呆，但又不是真的呆，有什么事就往大人怀里一钻，脑袋埋在大人怀里，还会软乎乎地叫曾奶奶，就、就让老夫人特别心疼，特别想要疼爱他。

夏冰：就没见过阿呆这么会撒娇过。哦不，以前不帅哥在的时候，这小子也是这样。果然，这镇上其他小兽人可能都是小呆子，但阿呆绝对不呆。

老夫人以前养过女儿郎飞，养过假外孙雷米尔，但那两个从小就调皮，更不愿意被大人长时间抱在怀里。

阿呆和他们就是两个品种！

嗯，品种确实不一样。

阿呆九成九是石狲族，这一族现在已经很少见。

石狲族人大多不喜欢动弹，比较恋家，除非族地发生重大变故，否则一生都不会离开族地太远。

老夫人跟阿呆聊天，问他过去的事情。

阿呆说得不清不楚。

最后老夫人只知道阿呆刚出生没多久就被人抛弃在天残谷，被天残村人收留，吃百家饭长大，之后遇到误入天残村的商非凡，被商非凡收-养带出天残村。

老夫人仔细检查了阿呆的身体情况，发现他身上并没有明显的天残痕迹，再一问他的年龄，结合他平日只有兽身一个状态，这才知道他的天残就是不能变身，还有可能成长缓慢或干脆就是侏儒体。

一般来说兽人的孩子刚出生没几天就能灵活在两种形态中切换，只是五六岁之前保持兽身状态比较多，因为兽身状态更方便他们活动。

但不管是什么形态，十岁孩子的兽体无论如何都不可能和五六个月大的幼崽一样。

石狲也不是小型兽人，他们的成年体型甚至比虎族都大，按理幼崽体型也应该超过一般幼崽。

十岁了，还跟五六个月大的幼崽体型一样，就算是成长缓慢，这也太缓慢。

老夫人认定阿呆就是个天生的侏儒体，还不能变身人形，就更为怜惜这个小家伙。

早上吃过早饭，老夫人摸摸阿呆圆鼓鼓的小肚子：“嗯，吃饱了。走，跟奶奶去散步。”

阿呆：既然是散步，那您把我放下来，让我自己走啊。

老夫人的散步就是抱着小阿呆在镇子上溜达。

她身后也没跟随仆人。

莫约镇比较安全，镇民知道她是虎不帅的亲姥姥，接纳得十分迅速，如今看到她都会主动打招呼。

老夫人也没有端着身份，见到谁都笑眯眯，还能聊两句，就跟普通的带孙子出来玩耍的邻家雌性老兽人一样。

走着走着，一老一小就溜达到了镇子边沿。

老莫头依然坐在镇子入口处的酒馆门口，一双浑浊的老眼像是永远睡不醒一样。

老夫人对老莫头点头施礼。

老莫头右手握拳按在胸口，对老夫人微微欠了欠身。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan pointed a finger at Moyue Mountain. "The aura of death upon that mountain is extremely dense, far surpassing the time when I last came here."

Lang Mu frowned. "I remember there are immortal corpses inside Moyue Mountain, and legend has it that even more slumber beneath the mountain. As long as they are not disturbed, however, they will not wake up, nor will they wander outside the boundaries of Moyue Mountain."

Shang Feifan still felt that something else was amiss. "You go ahead to Moyue Town first; I'll head into Moyue Mountain to check out the situation."

"I'll go with you," Lang Mu said immediately.

Shang Feifan shook his head. "No need. The aura of death is too oppressive there, which makes it unsuitable for you. It's much more convenient for me to go alone. You go to Moyue Town to inquire about the situation and see if any unusual events have occurred recently."

Seeing that Shang Feifan's mind was made up, and also worrying about Moyue Town, Lang Mu ultimately agreed. "Alright. Then be careful!"

"Rest assured. You know what I'm capable of." Shang Feifan tilted his head to steal a quick kiss, leaped off the back of Zheng Ye, and sprinted swiftly toward Moyue Mountain.

chunks.chineseText:
“曾奶奶，爸爸们什么时候才能到啊？”阿呆第N次地问起这个问题。

老夫人也没有嫌烦，跟以往一样，温柔地说：“很快，应该就在这几天。”

她昨晚刚跟老头子联系过，老头子告诉他，两个大的已经去过他那里，正往莫约镇赶，最快明天就能到达。

老夫人特意没跟阿呆说，就是想要给阿呆一个惊喜。

他们两个爸爸显然也有这个意思。

阿呆一听爸爸们从“这段时间就会到”变成“这几天就会到”，立刻精神了，立起四肢，略激动地说：“真的吗？爸爸们就要回来了？”

“对。你爸爸们可想你了。在王城那段时间，他们经常跟我提起你，说你是个特别好的孩子。你商爸爸担心夏冰一个大男孩不能把你照顾好，还特地找了玛利亚提前回来照顾你。”

阿呆高兴得头顶呆毛都竖了起来，短短的圆乎乎毛茸茸小尾巴在屁股后面颤啊颤。

玛利亚姨姨也是这么说哒，还给他带回了很多商爸爸给他买的礼物。

“那不帅爸爸也想我吗？”阿呆又问出了一个他同样问了很多遍的问题。

老夫人眼里满是笑意：“当然。你不帅爸爸也想着你，他还说你就是我们郎家的孩子。”

“曾奶奶，你也是我亲奶奶啊。”阿呆喜欢得把方脑袋贴到老夫人脖颈边，蹭啊蹭。

老夫人乐得笑不拢口。

“郎奶奶早安！阿呆早上好，你们又出来散步啊。”一个活泼泼的小兽人从镇酒馆大门跑出来，手里还抓着一块麦饼。

“小安东早上好，你这是去给谁送酒吗？”老夫人也很喜欢活泼又懂事的小安东。

“老克莱腿疼，以前康成药剂师在的时候会给他开药酒，现在他不在了，镇里又没有其他药剂师，他就只能用我们酒馆的酒水来摩擦关节。”小安东叼起麦饼，麻利地把一箱子酒水放到小拖车上。

“阿呆，等会儿图书馆见。”

阿呆挥挥小爪子。

老夫人听到小安东的话，若有所思，问阿呆：“镇子上没有药剂师吗？”

她刚来还没多久，自己又带了不少药剂，就没怎么注意镇上有没有药剂师。

阿呆摇头：“以前有，但那个药剂师学徒康成是个坏人，是别人派到镇子上来的，镇长就把他赶走了。”

“那你们现在看病找谁？”

“祭司羊大婶，她能看一点病，不过也不多。主要是爸爸们给她留了很多药剂，大家如果有什么症状，可以去她那里寻找有没有对应的药剂。大多数伤痛病症都能解决，实在不能解决的，镇长爷爷会送病人去金麦城看。”

老夫人又问了几句，心里有数了，心想如果他们以后真要在莫约镇或附近落脚，药剂师和医师就是个很好的入手点。

他们郎家也有家养的药剂师，只是后来都被他们放了自由。

这次离开王城，和他们家关系最密切的一个老医师带着自己的学徒也跟来了。

这位老医师一生未婚，就培养学徒，有的学徒学成走了，也有的留在他身边和他共同经营医馆。

医师不同于药剂师，他们更精通医理。有些病人并不知道自己得了什么病，自然不敢乱吃药剂，这时候就需要医师帮忙诊断，并告诉他服用什么药剂最有效果。

听说他们要离开王城前往其他地方发展，这位老医师二话不说就把店铺转卖给有意接收店铺的学徒，带着几个愿意跟他走的学徒跟上了他们家的队伍。

现在老医师和他带的学徒都跟着老头子，他们需要踏遍整个领地，有懂医术的人留在身边会比较方便，顺便还能沿途采集药材。

老夫人想着下次联络时，就跟老头子谈谈，能不能先让老医师送个医术高明的学徒过来。

一老一小走过镇酒馆，走到了镇子外面的大路上。

这是郎老夫人到莫约镇后的固定散步路线，美其名曰带着宝贝重孙迎接他两个爸爸回来，因为不知道详细日期，就每天走个两趟。

一阵寒风吹来。

莫约镇已经进入冬季，天气一天比一天寒凉。

老夫人抱紧了暖烘烘的小阿呆。

小阿呆忽然直起身体，脑袋扭了一百八十度，直直地看向莫约山的方向。

老夫人感觉到阿呆的肌肉紧张，立刻低头看他：“呆宝，怎么了？”

阿呆抬起小脸蛋，用力嗅了嗅。

“曾奶奶，”

“嗯？”

“有危险！”

老夫人并没有因为小孩子的童言童语就疏忽，反而很认真地问：“什么危险？你感知到了什么？”

阿呆身体整个转过来，面朝莫约山，呆萌的神色变得紧张：“活死人！我闻到了活死人的味道，好多好多！”

老夫人也跟着看向莫约山，她什么也没看到，更没有闻到某些特殊味道。

“曾奶奶，我没有骗你，是真的！”阿呆担心老人不相信。

老夫人摸摸他的小背脊，“我知道，曾奶奶相信你。曾奶奶只是在想，这些活死人哪里来的，又是否要对莫约镇不利。”

老夫人一边说一边转身往回走：“走，去找你的镇长爷爷，让他派人去莫约山查看一番。”

经过老莫头时，老夫人暂停脚步，提醒他：“镇外可能有些情况，最好戒备起来。”

老莫头一听，一双昏花的老眼全部睁开，人也站了起来：“什么情况？”

“可能有大量活死人冲击莫约镇。现在只是怀疑，还需要有人去确认。我正准备去找镇长。”

“我知道了。多谢夫人！”老莫头同样没有轻忽这条情报，立刻去通知镇子的守卫民兵。

不管消息是不是真的，镇子的防护肯定要先做起来。

数分钟后，整个镇子对外的进出口全都竖起了屏障，原本貌似无人看守的进出口也都出现了民兵看守，镇子内外的巡逻队人数和趟数全部增加。

现在镇民还不知道情况，就等镇长派人去查看。

镇长见到郎老夫人，得知消息来源竟然是阿呆，他也没嘲笑老夫人小题大做，反而亲自带队前往莫约山查看情况。

不是镇长特别相信老夫人，而是他想起商皇曾经跟他提起过，说他这个儿子阿呆有点特别的本领，如果他说了什么，最好去看看。

阿呆看到镇长带着人奔出镇子，抬起小爪子挠了挠脸颊。

他看看正在和迪莉娅夫人说话的老夫人，又看看周围，悄悄地溜出会客厅。

等跑出会客厅，阿呆身影一闪，从原地消失。

他也要去莫约山看看，刚才他还有一件事没有告诉他曾奶奶，那就是除了活死人的味道，他还嗅到了同族的味道，且很可能是他的血亲。
chunks.englishText:
"Great-Grandma, when will Dads arrive?" A-Dai asked this question for the N-th time.

The Old Madam didn't feel annoyed at all. As she always did, she answered gently, "Very soon, probably in the next few days."

She had just contacted the old man last night, and he had told her that the two big ones had already visited his place and were hurrying toward Moyue Town, and could arrive as early as tomorrow.

The Old Madam purposely hadn't told A-Dai, wanting to give him a surprise.

Their two dads clearly had the same intention.

The moment A-Dai heard his dads change from "they'll arrive sometime soon" to "they'll arrive in the next few days," he instantly perked up. He straightened his four limbs and said, slightly excited, "Really? Dads are coming back?"

"Yes. Your dads miss you so much. During their time in the Royal City, they frequently brought you up, saying you're an exceptionally good child. Your Dad Shang was worried that a big boy like Xia Bing wouldn't be able to take good care of you, so he even specifically arranged for Maria to return early to look after you."

A-Dai was so happy that the single tuft of hair on top of his head stood straight up, and his short, round, fluffy little tail wagged and trembled behind his bottom.

Auntie Maria had said the exact same thing and even brought back a lot of gifts his Dad Shang had bought for him.

"Then doesn't un-handsome Dad miss me too?" A-Dai asked another question he had also asked many times.

The Old Madam's eyes were full of smiles. "Of course. Your un-handsome Dad misses you as well, and he even said that you are truly a child of our Lang family."

"Great-Grandma, you're also my very own grandma." Overjoyed, A-Dai pressed his square head against the side of the Old Madam's neck, rubbing back and forth.

The Old Madam laughed so hard she couldn't close her mouth.

"Good morning, Grandma Lang! Good morning, A-Dai. Out for another walk, you two?" A lively little beastman ran out of the town tavern's main doors, still clutching a piece of wheat cake in his hand.

"Good morning, little Anton. Are you off to deliver wine to someone?" The Old Madam was very fond of the lively and sensible little Anton.

"Old Kray's leg is hurting. Back when Apothecary Kang Cheng was around, he used to prescribe medicinal liquor for him, but now that he's gone and there are no other apothecaries in town, he can only use the wine from our tavern to rub his joints." Little Anton bit down on his wheat cake and deftly loaded a crate of liquor onto a small handcart.

"A-Dai, see you at the library later."

A-Dai waved his small paw.

Hearing little Anton's words, the Old Madam fell into deep thought and asked A-Dai, "Is there really no apothecary in the town?"

She had only arrived not long ago, and having brought quite a few medicines of her own, she hadn't paid much attention to whether there was an apothecary in town.

A-Dai shook his head. "There used to be, but that apothecary apprentice Kang Cheng was a bad person sent to the town by someone else, so the town chief chased him away."

"Then who do you go to see when you're sick?"

"Auntie Sheep the Priest. She can treat some illnesses, though not many. Mostly, Dads left behind a lot of potions for her, so if anyone has any symptoms, they can go to her and see if there's a matching potion. Most injuries and ailments can be resolved. For the ones that truly can't be fixed, Grandpa Town Chief will send the patient to Golden Wheat City."

The Old Madam asked a few more questions, forming a clear picture in her mind. She thought to herself that if they really intended to settle down in Moyue Town or the surrounding area in the future, apothecaries and physicians would be an excellent entry point.

Their Lang family also had household apothecaries, but they had all been granted their freedom later on.

This time when they left the Royal City, an elderly physician who had the closest relationship with their family had also followed along, bringing his apprentice.

This old physician had never married and devoted his life to nurturing apprentices. Some apprentices would leave once they completed their studies, while others stayed by his side to run the medical clinic together with him.

Physicians were different from apothecaries; they were much more well-versed in medical principles.
