Later on... I discovered that the earth had cracked open, and deep below, fiery red magma was visible.

Nine out of ten of those Undead who once slumbered beneath the earth and mountains sensed that the magma was about to erupt, which is why they fled their habitats and ran far away."

A flicker of dread toward raw, large-scale natural disasters crossed the robed man's eyes. "When I returned to report this to the City Lord, he concluded that even if the magma erupted, it wouldn't flow toward Pengshi City because our city is situated at a high altitude, built midway up the mountain. Besides, our stone mountain is not a volcano. On the contrary, those Undead would spell utter catastrophe if left unmanaged."

*Even if Pengshi City were built on the peak instead of halfway up the mountain, it wouldn't make a difference,* Shang Feifan thought to himself. *When magma erupts, it comes hand in hand with earthquakes and volcanic activity. That stone mountain won't be spared either.*

Furthermore, a magma eruption would engulf the entire Blackwater Wasteland; virtually no living creature inhabiting this expanse of land could hope to escape.

However, there was no need to voice these thoughts to the robed man—even if spoken, the fool wouldn't believe it.

"Do you know Ah-Dai?" Shang Feifan asked out of the blue.

Taken aback, the robed man blinked. "Who is Ah-Dai?"

Without answering the question, Shang Feifan reached out and snapped the robed man's neck with a sharp twist.

Shang Feifan couldn't even be bothered to formally pronounce judgment upon him.

A wretch wrapped entirely in malevolent karma, goodness knew how many lives he had ruined. On top of that, he had lured countless Undead in an attempt to ravage the people of Moyue Town and the entire Blackwater Wasteland—such sins warranted a thousand deaths.

If he hadn't happened to change his allegiance—leaping away from the God of Curses right into the lap of His big boss, the Dark God—there was no telling what state Moyue Town and the two of them would be in right now.

Until the moment of his death, the robed man could not believe he had been killed so casually.

*Didn't this guy want to know more secrets about Pengshi City and its lord, or other key figures in the city?*

*Wasn't he curious about how I controlled the Undead?*

*Could it be...*

The robed man's train of thought was cut off abruptly.

Reaching out, Shang Feifan plucked the alchemical ring from the robed man's finger and slid it onto his own.

A surge of buoyant dark energy instantly poured into his body, granting him a sensation of unprecedented power.

Closing his eyes, Shang Feifan attentively felt the flow of this energy. Within moments, he discovered that his consciousness was able to pierce through the boundless darkness, establishing a connection with the energy emanating from the Undead.

*Those gray-black specks of light are death Qi?*

*Then what are those purple-black specks of light? Worm venom?*

At first, he could only perceive a faint, tenuous thread of connection, but as time passed, this bond grew distinct and robust. At the same time, it allowed him to clearly discern what the various specks of light mingled within the kaleidoscopic darkness represented.

He discovered that dark energy behaved much like a specialized "language," capable of communicating with the death Qi residing within the Undead, as well as with worm venom. Using this "language," he could issue commands to the Undead, precisely the way a broodmother communicated with her subjects via pheromones.

Originally, he had only been capable of sensing worm venom.

Now, it seemed he could even manipulate it?

If this actually worked out, it would undoubtedly be a delightful, unexpected bonus.

However, Shang Feifan did not rush to put this to the test; instead, he simply utilized the death Qi and worm venom collectively to pilot and command the massive horde of Undead.

Had he relied solely on the dark energy within his own body, trying to command this many Undead would have been virtually impossible. Even if he could manage it briefly, doing so for long would cause his head to split with agonizing pain.

With this alchemical ring, however, the situation was entirely different.

He only needed to expend a minimal amount of spiritual power and his own energy to borrow the ring's amplification, effortlessly controlling thousands upon thousands of Undead.

*A fine piece of treasure.* Expressing silent gratitude to the robed man for his contribution, Shang Feifan disposed of the corpse, reducing it to utter nothingness with dark flames. The dead man's carcass even yielded a small cluster of dark energy.

Unceremoniously, Shang Feifan absorbed it.

[The ring has fragments of the Dark God's divine persona embedded within it; you may absorb them at any time.] The system reminded him in real-time, seemingly afraid he would miss out.

Shang Feifan let out an acknowledging hum. The ring proved unexpectedly useful, so there was no urgent need to absorb the Dark God's divine persona fragments just yet.

Seeing that he made no move, the system offered no further commentary after its single prompt.

This fellow was completely unlike Lang Mu; he possessed an intensely independent will. Suggestions offered by others were treated strictly as reference material—he possessed his own firm ideas and plans.

Using the ring, Shang Feifan commanded all the Undead to obediently remain tucked away in the valley without stirring.

In response, the entire legion of Undead huddled together within the valley, closing their eyes as though drifting into a deep sleep.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第228章 黑袍人透露的信息 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
黑袍人也就是死了看不到这幕，否则他得惊讶死。

因为他就算使用戒指也只能通过控制十几个领头的不死尸大boss，而且还不能说是控制，是顺着它们“想要去往更安全地方”的念头，把它们引导到莫约山。

而其他不死尸都是跟随那十几个厉害的不死尸进行无脑行动。

但商非凡则是真正操控了所有不死尸。

这就导致商非凡半点不知道自己有多牛掰，还以为只要拥有这个戒指并拥有黑暗天赋能力的人都能做到。

系统知道商非凡的厉害，但它不说。

商非凡和郎沐汇合。

郎沐见面就说：“那些不死尸突然调转方向，不再向莫约镇进发，全都回去了山谷深处，是不是和你有关？”

商非凡亮出炼金戒指晃了晃。戒指表面纹路在天光下微微泛出紫色的光芒。

“战利品？”郎沐一下就猜出来。

商非凡笑眯眯，把他碰到黑袍人的事说了。

“这东西用来控制不死尸特别好用。重点是，黑袍人告诉我——这些不死尸，都是彭石城主特意送给我们的礼物。”

郎沐的瞳孔微微收缩：“什么意思？”

商非凡冷飕飕：“意思就是，彭石城主不爽你成为黑水荒原的领主，不爽你得到这个大便宜，想要在你开始建设黑水荒原领区之前就让你手忙脚乱，甚至是身败名裂，最好死掉。”

郎沐无语：“我哪里得罪他了吗？”

作为特别调查官，他当然知道彭石城主这个人，不过了解不多。这位城主有点闭门自个儿玩的意思，和其他权贵都少有来往。

商非凡：“利益之争而已。他的彭石城虽然不包含在黑水荒原领区里面，但他只要向北发展就无法避开你的领区，而且彭石城就坐落在黑水荒原南边的行政区划边界上，它的很多领民以及财富都来自于北边的一片土地。以前那里就是三不管的无主地带，附近人都默认彭石城主是他们的管理者，现在你这个真正的领主突然冒出来，当然会影响到那位城主的利益。”

郎沐：“所以他就不惜搞出不死尸大游-行？他也不怕再次酿造成毒雾纪一样遍及整个虎国乃至整个兽人大陆的灾难？”

商非凡呵呵：“只要表面上看祸害不到自己，倒霉的是别人，他们才不会想那么多。就算想了，他们也觉得自己都是堪比气运之子的幸运儿，别人都会有事，就他不会。”

郎沐：“好吧。”

跟这种人也没什么好争理的，直接打吧。

“不死尸还有多少？除那个黑袍人以外，彭石城是否还有人能操纵不死尸？”

商非凡摇头，开始详细地讲述他从黑袍人那里得到的情报。

郎沐听完，很快就明白商非凡的意思：“你想利用那些不死尸。”

“那是多好的劳动力啊。”商非凡有点夸张地挥了挥手，“不怕疼、不怕累，更不怕死，还有比不死尸更好的劳工吗？与其让它们现在就变成肥料，还不如先给咱们使唤使唤。比如……让它们去挖岩浆引流通道。”

他这是也受到了彭石城人的启发。彭石城人可以转移这些不死尸来祸害他人，那他为什么不能用这些不死尸给自己打工。

免费还不叫苦不叫累、死伤也不用赔钱的劳工，就问到哪里找？

数量还这么多！

如果眼睁睁看着这些劳力消失，就算它们能转化成一部分能量，也让商非凡心痛。

他现在只要想到王城那边的三万“劳工”就这么给他宰完了，就心疼得滴血。

好吧，那时候他只能震慑那些不死尸，还不能彻底操控它们，让它们为他做事。

郎沐眼睛一亮，这个可以有。

“利用不死尸挖通通道把岩浆引向无人区？”郎沐越想越觉得可行，“你能做到？会不会对你的精神力有大量损耗？”

“不会。有这个帮忙。”商非凡再次亮出戒指，“这就是中控，我就相当于操作中控的人。”

郎沐笑起来，“那我们要仔细研究一下地图了。正好我可以利用自己的自然感知力，感知地质结构，选定最佳挖掘路线。”

“那通道规划的事就交给你。”商非凡忍不住捏了捏他的耳朵。

“没问题。”郎沐可爱的晃晃脑袋，“不过你确定你能压得住那么多不死尸？别转头反噬，把你当点心啃了。”

“不怕。”商非凡笑，“我给它们上了大范围诅咒，敢不听话、敢不听指挥就走出莫约山范围，就会变成普通尸体迅速烂掉。”

郎沐忍不住笑了：“这诅咒之术可真是给你玩出花了，我总觉得诅咒之神似乎特别喜欢你，你投向黑暗之神，祂真的没伤心吗？”

商非凡幽幽道：“怎么会呢，看到自己的忠实信徒这么有上进心，祂老人家应该高兴才对。”

“别乱说话。”郎沐拍开商非凡又伸过来的手：“那我们现在就回去镇子，把这个好消息告诉镇长和我姥姥他们。”

商非凡绕了一圈，还是成功捏到了郎沐的耳朵，捏完就收手，还一脸正色地说：“跟他们交代完，我还得去一趟彭石城。”

“也是要去看看。”郎沐没多想，自然而然地说：“我和你一起去。我倒要问问那个城主到底是怎么想的，怎么能想出这么恶毒的主意还实行了？”

“不止。”商非凡眯起眼睛：“那个城主和阿呆说不定也有一点关系。阿呆之前无意间闯进城主府地牢，说是在里面看到了一具‘疑似他母亲的兽人尸体’。”

郎沐的瞳孔微微收缩：“……你怀疑城主是凶手？”

“或者更糟。”商非凡轻轻勾住郎沐的手指。

郎沐沉默片刻，随后抬头：“我和你一起去。”

“不，你留在这儿。”商非凡摇头，“你除了需要时间研究地图，莫约镇这边也需要有个镇守的人。以防彭石城或者是其他什么家伙，借此机会又搞出什么事来。彭石城的事，我带阿呆去就行。”

“阿呆才多大？你带他过去不适合吧。”郎沐皱眉，不愿意让小幼崽冒险。

商非凡无奈提醒：“他能瞬移。带我可以快速来回。又不是让他去打架。”

郎沐：“……”差点忘了阿呆的能力超牛。

半小时后，商非凡从老夫人手里接过阿呆。

阿呆一听要跟爸爸一起去冒险，顿时精神了，兴奋地在他爸胳膊上踩来踩去。

他还问不帅爸爸是不是一起，听到不帅爸爸打算留下，商老爸又嘲笑他一个小幼崽带不了两个成年人，就沮丧地蹲在了他商爸的怀里。

郎沐亲了他好几口。

阿呆跟他黏黏糊糊，嘴里不住说好想不帅爸爸。

商非凡在旁边看得眼睛疼。

郎沐好笑，揉揉阿呆的脑袋：“你商爸就交给你了。记得把你们俩都完好地带回来。”

阿呆特别用力地点头。

镇长也出来相送，但他还没有来得及叮嘱一二，就见那一大一小身影一闪就从原地消失。
chunks.englishText:
The man in the black robe was fortunate that he had already died and couldn't witness this scene; otherwise, he would have died of sheer astonishment.

Even when utilizing the ring, he had merely been able to control a dozen or so leading high-tier Undead Corpse bosses. And strictly speaking, it wasn't even full control—he had simply capitalized on their innate urges of "wanting to head toward a safer place," guiding them step by step toward Mount Moyue.

As for the rest of the undead corpses, they had simply followed those dozen-odd formidable ones, acting entirely on mindless instinct.

Shang Feifan, however, had genuinely usurped control over *all* of the undead corpses.

This resulted in Shang Feifan remaining completely oblivious to just how ridiculously OP he was; he genuinely thought that anyone who possessed this ring coupled with a dark elemental talent could pull it off.

The System was well aware of Shang Feifan's overpowered prowess, but it chose to keep mum.

Shang Feifan rendezvoused with Lang Mu.

The moment they met, Lang Mu asked, "Those undead corpses suddenly turned around, abandoning their advance on Moyue Town and retreating en masse deep into the valley. Did that have something to do with you?"

Shang Feifan flashed the alchemical ring, giving it a light spin. The intricate patterns on its surface glimmered faintly with a purple radiance beneath the daylight.

"War spoils?" Lang Mu guessed instantly.

Shang Feifan beamed and recounted his encounter with the man in the black robe.

"This trinket is exceptionally handy for controlling undead corpses. The kicker is, the man in the black robe told me—these undead corpses were a special gift personally delivered to us by City Lord Peng Shi."

Lang Mu's pupils constricted slightly. "What do you mean?"

Shang Feifan smiled chillingly. "It means City Lord Peng Shi is none other than displeased that you've become the Lord of the Blackwater Wasteland, displeased that you scored such a massive windfall, and wants to throw you into utter chaos and disarray even before you begin developing your territory. He wants to ruin your reputation, and ideally, kill you off."

Lang Mu was left speechless. "How on earth did I offend him?"

As a Special Investigator, he naturally knew of City Lord Peng Shi, though his understanding was limited. This city lord kept very much to himself, rarely associating with other nobles or high-ranking figures.

Shang Feifan explained, "It's merely a dispute over interests. Even though Peng Shi City isn't encompassed within the Blackwater Wasteland territory, any northward expansion on his part is bound to encroach upon your domain. Furthermore, Peng Shi City sits right on the southern administrative boundary of the Blackwater Wasteland; a substantial portion of his populace and wealth originates from that stretch of land to the north. In the past, that region was a lawless, unclaimed zone, and the locals implicitly defaulted to the City Lord of Peng Shi as their ruler. Now that you, the legitimate lord, have suddenly popped out of nowhere, it naturally infringes upon that City Lord's vested interests."

Lang Mu muttered, "So he didn't hesitate to orchestrate an undead corpse parade? Is he not afraid of triggering another disaster on the scale of the Poison Fog Era, one that would sweep across the entire Tiger Kingdom, or even the entire Beastman Continent?"

Shang Feifan let out a soft chuckle. "As long as, on the surface, the devastation doesn't reach them and only brings bad luck to others, they couldn't care less about the consequences. Even if they do think about it, they all fancy themselves lucky protagonists blessed with the Mandate of Heaven—everyone else might meet a grim end, but *they* certainly won't."

Lang Mu sighed. "Fine, then."

There was no reasoning with a person like that; they might as well just throw down and fight.

"How many undead corpses are left? Aside from that man in the black robe, are there any other individuals in Peng Shi City capable of manipulating undead corpses?"

Shang Feifan shook his head and began to recount the intelligence he had extracted from the black-robed man in meticulous detail.

After listening, Lang Mu quickly grasped Shang Feifan's underlying intent. "You want to utilize those undead corpses?"

"What fantastic labor force they make," Shang Feifan waved his hands in an exaggerated gesture. "They don't feel pain, they don't get tired, and they certainly aren't afraid of dying. Is there any better workforce than undead corpses? Rather than letting them turn into fertilizer right now, we might as well put them to work for us first. For instance... have them dig a magma diversion channel."

He had taken inspiration from the people of Peng Shi City. Since the people of Peng Shi City could mobilize these undead corpses to wreak havoc on others, why couldn't he put these same undead corpses to work for himself?

Free laborers who neither complained nor grew weary, and whose casualties required zero compensation—where else could one possibly find a deal like that?

And there were so many of them!

If he were to just stand by and watch this massive workforce vanish into thin air—even if they could convert into a portion of energy—it would still break Shang Feifan's heart.

Just thinking about the thirty thousand "laborers" in the Royal City who had been slaughtered just like that made his heart ache as if it were bleeding.

Well, back then he could only deter those undead corpses; he couldn't completely manipulate them yet to make them do his bidding.

Lang Mu's eyes lit up. Now this was an idea worth exploring.

"Use the undead corpses to dig out a channel and direct the magma into the uninhabited zone?" The more Lang Mu thought about it, the more viable it seemed. "Can you pull it off? Won't it cause a massive drain on your mental energy?"

"Not at all. I have this little helper." Shang Feifan flashed the ring once more. "This is the central control unit, and I'm simply the operator steering it."

Lang Mu chuckled. "In that case, we need to study the map carefully. As it happens, I can use my innate nature affinity to sense the geological structure and plot out the optimal excavation route."

"I'll leave the channel planning in your hands then." Shang Feifan couldn't resist reaching out to pinch Lang Mu's ear.

"No problem." Lang Mu gave his head a cute little shake. "Are you certain you can keep that many undead corpses under control? Don't have them turn on you and treat you like an afternoon snack."

"Nothing to fear," Shang Feifan smiled. "I've slapped a widespread curse on them. If any of them dare to disobey or stray outside the boundaries of Mount Moyue without orders, they'll instantly rot away into ordinary corpses."

Lang Mu couldn't help laughing. "You really know how to play tricks with the art of curses. I often feel like the God of Curses must adore you—didn't He feel heartbroken when you defected to the God of Darkness?"

Shang Feifan replied with an eerie tone, "How could He? Seeing His loyal believer display such remarkable ambition, His Old Age should be thrilled."

"Stop talking nonsense." Lang Mu swatted away Shang Feifan's wandering hand. "Let's head right back to the town and share this wonderful news with the Mayor and my grandmother."

Despite dodging around, Shang Feifan still managed to successfully pinch Lang Mu's ear. The moment he finished the pinch, he withdrew his hand, putting on a deadpan, serious expression as he said, "Once I brief them, I still need to make a trip to Peng Shi City."

"We do need to check it out." Without overthinking it, Lang Mu naturally stated, "I'll go with you. I want to ask that City Lord what on earth is going through his head—how could he come up with such a vicious scheme and actually carry it out?"

"There's more." Shang Feifan narrowed his eyes. "That City Lord might have some connection to Ah Dai. Ah Dai previously wandered into the City Lord Manor's dungeon by accident and claimed he saw 'the corpse of a beastman suspected to be his mother' inside."

Lang Mu's pupils constricted slightly. "...You suspect the City Lord is the murderer?"

"Or worse." Shang Feifan gently hooked his finger around Lang Mu's.

Lang Mu fell silent for a moment before looking up. "I'm going with you."

"No, you stay here," Shang Feifan shook his head. "Aside from needing time to study the map, Moyue Town also requires someone to hold down the fort. We must guard against Peng Shi City or any other opportunistic scoundrels seizing this chance to stir up trouble. As for the matter of Peng Shi City, I'll take Ah Dai with me."

"How old is Ah Dai? It's not appropriate to drag him along," Lang Mu frowned, reluctant to let the little cub take risks.

Shang Feifan reminded him with a helpless shrug, "He can teleport. He can whisk me back and forth in a flash. It's not like I'm taking him to a brawl."

Lang Mu: "..." He had almost forgotten about Ah Dai's overpowered ability.

Half an hour later, Shang Feifan received Ah Dai from the Old Madam's hands.

The moment Ah Dai heard he was going on an adventure with his Daddy, he instantly perked up, excitedly bouncing back and forth on his dad's arm.

He even asked if the Not-Handsome Daddy was coming along. Upon hearing that the Not-Handsome Daddy planned to stay behind, Papa Shang teased that a tiny cub couldn't possibly carry two adults, causing Ah Dai to slump into a depressed squat right inside his Shang Dad's embrace.

Lang Mu planted several kisses on his face.

Ah Dai acted all clingy and affectionate with him, repeatedly murmuring how much he would miss his Not-Handsome Daddy.

Shang Feifan stood to the side, his eyes stinging with jealousy.

Amused, Lang Mu ruffled Ah Dai's head. "I'm leaving your Shang Dad in your capable hands. Make sure you bring both of you back safely and soundly."

Ah Dai nodded with utmost vigor.

The Mayor also came out to see them off, but before he could even offer a word of advice or caution, the towering figure and the tiny one flickered and vanished from the spot entirely.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第229章 探究不死尸来源地 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第229章 探究不死尸来源地

阿呆要多带一个人，途中停顿了两次。

商非凡早就准备好补充能量和精神力的药剂，选的都是最贵最好的。

阿呆咕咚咚喝下去，咂咂嘴，提意见说有点涩嘴，不太好喝，要是能甜甜的就好了。

商非凡好笑地摸摸他的脑袋，说药剂的味道很少有好喝的，如果他想喝味道好的药剂，那就以后自己想法改良。

毕竟靠山山倒，靠人人跑，万事不如靠自己嘛。

“技艺很重要，学会了掌握了就是你自己的，一旦有什么事，比如落入困境，普通人也许会束手无策，但有技术在手的人至少会多一分求生的机会。游泳、武术、绘画、分辨药草和矿物，会做饭会炼药会炼金，这些都是能活命的基础技艺。”

阿呆呆呆点头，压根不知道自己这时许下的愿望有多可怕——他想把这些商爸说的救命技艺都学会。

第二次落点，已经快要到彭石城附近，站在高处已经能看到彭石城的城墙。

彭石城建造在一座平顶山的半山腰，山顶建造了瞭望塔和炮塔一类的建筑。

这一带多丘陵山地，但植物并不丰富，也许和缺乏水源有关。

商非凡之前看地图时就了解过黑水荒原靠南边一带，四面环山，温度很高，还是干热，降雨少，大风频繁，典型的大陆性荒漠气候。

彭石城虽然建造在一座山的山腰上，但这座山就位于这个盆地的最中间。

虎王当初给黑水荒原划分领地时，也不知道他怎么想的，竟然把这座盆地北边的山丘全都划入了黑水荒原领区。

而彭石城早就把这座盆地，包括包围盆地的四边群山都当做自己的地盘，自然无法忍受自家认定的地盘被人咬走近一半。

商非凡冷笑。那虎王在划分领地时绝对没安好心。

除了彭石城这边的行政区域划分会引起彭石城的愤怒和忌惮，金麦城那边也一样。

这还是他们已经察觉的两处地点，其他还没发现的类似之处还不知道有几处。

如果郎沐能把这些区域全都收归己有，百年租期结束后，这些区域就能自然而然变成虎国的官方土地，还不用虎王费尽心思去和那些接壤的领主争斗周旋。

如果郎沐不能把这些区域收归，那对虎王也没什么妨碍，大不了就是和以前一样。

商非凡也只气了几秒钟。

自从郎沐明确表达出他没有当王当皇帝的兴趣后，商非凡就对打天下兴趣缺缺。

现在想要经营黑水荒原领地，不过是给郎家老俩口一个安身地，再给他们找点事做，另外就是白来的领地不要白不要，哪怕用来给郎沐培育可耕种田地也是好的。

所以对于这些有着坑的边界区域，商非凡真的不是很在乎，能拿就拿，不能拿就算。

可惜彭石城城主连问都没问过两人，就想把事情做绝，不但想要侵占他们的领地，还想一鼓作气干掉他们。

这就不能忍受了。

“爸爸，我休息好了。”阿呆喝了药剂就已经把体力和精神力全部补满。

“那就出发吧，我们最好……”

商非凡话音未落，就觉得眼前一花，周围的空气骤然变得阴冷潮湿。

瞬移带来的眩晕感还未完全消退，他就已经抱着阿呆稳稳出现在一间阴暗的地牢里。

“啊。”阿呆看清环境，呆愣住。

这里不是……

大概印象太深了，他下意识就瞬移到了这里。

小家伙的爪子紧紧抠住他商爸的衣襟，尖锐的爪子弹出，几乎要穿透皮甲。

“没事，这里没人。”商非凡以为阿呆在自责自己传送的地方不够合适，就出言轻声安慰他，同时警惕地环顾四周。

这间地牢的空间比普通地牢要大，大约有二十多平米。墙壁上和地面爬满了青苔，石砖缝隙中还有水滴溢出。

商非凡探头超地牢的栅栏外看，发现这间地牢竟然是个单室，也就是这一层只有这一间地牢。往右看就是墙壁，往左看就一个向上的石砖阶梯。

那石砖阶梯上也爬了不少青苔，明显能看出这间地牢已经废弃不少时日。

阿呆缓过劲来，从他商爸怀里跳下，小爪子接触到冰冷地面的瞬间，浑身打了个冷颤。

“爸爸，就是这里……”小家伙声音颤抖，毛茸茸的耳朵紧紧贴在脑后，“我、我就是在这里见到了她……”

商非凡伸手碰触墙壁，指尖划过潮湿的石砖。常年累月的湿气在砖块上留下了深深的水痕，指尖传来滑腻的触感。

“这地方至少废弃七八年以上。但这里的死气残留顶多只有五年。”商非凡又用手指捻起一块脱落的青苔，先使用鉴定术查看，又放在鼻尖嗅了嗅。

“这青苔能食用。如果我所料不错，被关在这里的兽人很可能就靠舔食这些青苔和渗水为生。”

阿呆心里特别特别难过。随着他商爸的描述，他仿佛看到了一只体型很大的石狲趴卧在地上，伸头舔食着墙壁上的青苔，艰辛地挣扎着想要活下去，但最终……

“阿呆？”商非凡转头。

小家伙的动作并不快，只见他慢慢走向墙角，就像是被什么蛊惑，又像是被什么指引一般，小爪子伸向一块看似普通的石砖。

商非凡不再说话，转身看着小家伙的动作。

他想，也许是阿呆的机缘到了。

阿呆的小爪子居然直接穿透了坚硬的岩石，就像那只是一层虚幻的影像。

等阿呆收回手，他的爪子中已经多了一枚蓝黑色的珠子。

那蓝黑色的珠子中有光在流动，宛如活物。

阿呆低头，张嘴，竟然吞下了那枚珠子。

商非凡：……行吧，真有问题就给这小崽子来点泻药，看能不能拉出来。

商非凡也看出来阿呆此时的状况不太正常，不过他没有察觉任何恶意。

他吸收的就是黑暗能量，任何负面能量都别想逃过他的眼睛和感知。

就是因为在那枚珠子上察觉到半点恶意，他才没有特意阻止阿呆。

寂静的地牢里，吞咽声显得格外清晰。

“味道如何？”商非凡调侃儿子。

阿呆张口，像是想要回答他商爸的问题，身体却突然僵直，随后就软软地倒了下来。

商非凡伸手迅速一捞，接住小幼崽。随后发现小家伙只是陷入了沉睡，呼吸均匀，体温正常。

“看来你母亲还是给你留了点东西的。”商非凡注意到阿呆的眉心浮现出一道蓝黑色旋风型纹路，里面还有一点光在来回游动。

商非凡也不知道阿呆需要多长时间醒来，正犹豫是不是把阿呆放入雕像广场。

系统冒声：【他在融合他的直系血亲给他留下的力量，这份力量对于阿呆来说太过庞大，他需要时间吸收，而且会是分段吸收。第一段是时间最长也最危险的，他需要一个安全并安静的环境。】

商非凡：“可以放入雕像广场吗？那里的杂音会不会伤害到他？”

【我会给你圈一个地方，你把阿呆放到那里就可以。】
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 229: Investigating the Origin of the Undead Corpses

Since Ah Dai had to carry an extra person along, they had to make two stops mid-journey.

Shang Feifan had long since prepared potions to replenish physical and mental energy, selecting only the finest and most expensive ones available.

Ah Dai chugged it down in one gulp, smacked his lips, and offered his feedback: it tasted a bit astringent and wasn't very pleasant. He wished it could be sweet instead.

Amused, Shang Feifan stroked his head and told him that medicinal potions rarely tasted good. If he wanted tasty potions, he would just have to figure out how to improve them himself in the future.

After all, leaning on mountains causes them to crumble, and leaning on people causes them to run; nothing beats relying on oneself.

"Skills are paramount. Once you learn and master them, they belong to you. In the event of a crisis—say, falling into dire straits—ordinary people might be completely helpless, but someone with technical skills in their arsenal will at least gain an extra sliver of a chance at survival. Swimming, martial arts, painting, identifying herbs and minerals, cooking, alchemy, and weapon forging—these are all fundamental survival skills."

Ah Dai nodded blankly, having no idea how terrifying the wish he was making at that exact moment truly was—he wanted to learn every single one of these life-saving skills his Shang Dad had just mentioned.

Upon their second landing point, they were already nearing the vicinity of Peng Shi City, and standing from a high vantage point, they could distinctly make out the city walls.

Peng Shi City was constructed halfway up a flat-topped mountain, with watchtowers and artillery towers erected at the peak.

The surrounding terrain was dominated by rolling hills and mountains, yet the vegetation was sparse—likely linked to a severe lack of water sources.

While reviewing the map beforehand, Shang Feifan had already learned that the southern stretch of the Blackwater Wasteland was encircled by mountains on all fours sides, boasting scorching temperatures, arid heat, minimal rainfall, and frequent gales—a textbook continental desert climate.

Although Peng Shi City was built on the mountainside, that very mountain happened to sit right in the dead center of the basin.

When the Tiger King had originally delineated territories for the Blackwater Wasteland, heaven knows what was going through his mind; he had actually carved out all the hills to the north of this basin and lumped them into the Blackwater Wasteland domain.

Peng Shi City, on the other hand, had long since regarded this basin—along with the ring of mountains enclosing it—as its private backyard. Naturally, it could never stomach having nearly half of its self-proclaimed territory bitten away.

Shang Feifan sneered inwardly. That Tiger King definitely hadn't harbored any kind intentions when drawing up those territorial lines.

Aside from the administrative border adjustments around Peng Shi City triggering its wrath and vigilance, the Golden Wheat City situation was identical.

And those were just the two locations they had already uncovered; goodness knows how many other similar traps remained undiscovered.

If Lang Mu could successfully annex all these regions, once the hundred-year lease expired, these areas would naturally transition into official Tiger Kingdom territory without requiring the Tiger King to exhaust his wits fighting and maneuvering against those border lords.

If Lang Mu failed to annex these regions, it wouldn't make any difference to the Tiger King either; at worst, things would simply remain as they had been before.

Shang Feifan had only fumed for a couple of seconds.

Ever since Lang Mu explicitly expressed his utter lack of interest in becoming a king or an emperor, Shang Feifan's ambition for conquering the world had flatlined.

Running the Blackwater Wasteland territory now was merely about securing a safe haven for the old Lang couple, giving them something to occupy their time, and picking up free land because refusing a windfall is foolish—even if it was only used to cultivate arable farmland for Lang Mu.

Thus, Shang Feifan truly didn't give a damn about these treacherous border zones; if they could take them, great. If not, whatever.

Unfortunately, the City Lord of Peng Shi hadn't even bothered to ask the two of them before attempting to play hardball—not only trying to encroach upon their territory, but also seeking to eliminate them in one fell swoop.

That was entirely crossing the line.

"Daddy, I've rested up." Ah Dai had already fully restored his stamina and mental energy after drinking the potion.

"Then let's move out. We'd better..."

Before Shang Feifan could finish his sentence, he felt a blur before his eyes, and the surrounding air abruptly turned chillingly damp and cold.

The dizziness brought on by the teleportation had not yet fully faded when he found himself holding Ah Dai, standing steadily inside a gloomy, subterranean dungeon.

"Ah." Taking in his surroundings, Ah Dai froze in a daze.

Wasn't this place...

Perhaps the impression left upon him was simply too profound, but he had instinctively teleported right back here.

The little fellow's claws dug tightly into his Shang Dad's lapel, sharp tips unsheathing to the point where they almost pierced the leather armor.

"It's fine, there's nobody here." Assuming Ah Dai was blaming himself for selecting an unsuitable teleportation spot, Shang Feifan offered a soft, comforting word while vigilantly surveying his surroundings.

This cell was larger than a standard dungeon, measuring roughly over twenty square meters. Moss crawled over the walls and floor, and beads of water seeped from the cracks in the stone bricks.

Peering past the cell's iron bars, Shang Feifan discovered that this dungeon was actually a single-room layout—meaning this was the sole cell on this entire level. To the right was a solid stone wall, while to the left lay a flight of stone brick stairs leading upward.

A thick layer of moss climbed those stone steps as well, making it plainly obvious that this dungeon had been abandoned for quite some time.

Regaining his composure, Ah Dai hopped down from his Shang Dad's embrace. The instant his little claws touched the frigid ground, a shiver wracked his entire body.

"Daddy, this is the place..." The little one's voice trembled, his furry ears pinned flat against the back of his head. "I—I saw her right here..."

Reaching out, Shang Feifan pressed his palm against the wall, his fingertips brushing past the damp stone bricks. Years upon years of lingering moisture had carved deep water stains into the masonry, and a slick, greasy texture greeted his fingertips.

"This place has been abandoned for at least seven or eight years. Yet the residual dead aura here is, at most, five years old." Pinching off a flake of fallen moss, Shang Feifan first cast an Appraisal Spell on it before bringing it to his nose to sniff.

"This moss is edible. If my guess is right, the beastman locked up here likely survived entirely by licking this moss and the seeping water."

A profound, suffocating sorrow washed over Ah Dai's heart. As his Shang Dad described the scene, he seemed to vividly picture a massive Stone Macaque sprawled upon the cold floor, stretching out its head to lap at the moss on the wall, struggling bitterly in a desperate bid for survival, only to ultimately...

"Ah Dai?" Shang Feifan turned his head.

The little cub's movements were unhurried. He slowly paced toward the corner of the wall, as though under the spell of some enchantment, or guided by an invisible call, stretching his little claw toward a seemingly ordinary stone brick.

Ceasing his speech, Shang Feifan stood quietly and watched the little fellow's actions.

*Perhaps,* he thought, *Ah Dai's fortuitous encounter has finally arrived.*

To his astonishment, Ah Dai's little claw actually phased straight through the solid rock, as if that stone were nothing more than a phantom illusion.

When Ah Dai retracted his hand, a blue-black orb had materialized within his claws.

Within that blue-black sphere, a stream of light flowed continuously, resembling a living entity.

Lowering his head, Ah Dai opened his mouth and swallowed the orb whole.

Shang Feifan: "..." *Fine, whatever. If there's genuinely something wrong with it, I'll just feed this little rascal some laxatives and see if he can crap it out.*

Shang Feifan could tell that Ah Dai's current condition was somewhat abnormal, yet he sensed not a shred of malice.

He specialized in absorbing dark energy; no negative energy could ever hope to bypass his eyes and perception.

It was precisely because he failed to detect even a trace of malice originating from that orb that he refrained from actively stopping Ah Dai.

In the silent dungeon, the sound of swallowing appeared exceptionally distinct.

"How does it taste?" Shang Feifan teased his son.

Ah Dai opened his mouth as though he wanted to answer his Shang Dad's question, but his body abruptly stiffened before he collapsed limply to the ground.

Quick as lightning, Shang Feifan reached out and scooped up the falling cub. A quick check revealed that the little guy had merely plunged into a deep slumber; his breathing was steady and his body temperature normal.

"It seems your mother did leave you something after all." Shang Feifan noticed that a blue-black whirlwind-shaped pattern had surfaced between Ah Dai's brows, with a speck of light swimming back and forth within its center.

Unsure of how long Ah Dai would remain asleep, Shang Feifan hesitated over whether he should deposit him into the Statue Plaza.

The System chimed in: [He is merging with the legacy power left behind by his immediate blood relative. This power is far too immense for Ah Dai; he needs time to absorb it, and the process will occur in stages. The first stage is the longest and most perilous, requiring a safe and quiet environment.]

"Can I place him in the Statue Plaza?" Shang Feifan asked. "Will the ambient noise there harm him?"

[I will rope off a specific zone for you. Just place Ah Dai right there.]

chunks.chapterTitle: 第229章 探究不死尸来源地 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡精神力探入雕像广场，很快就在广场边缘地带发现一个被蓝光圈出来的范围。

他直接带着阿呆进入那蓝光圈中，自我感受一番，确实感知不到半点杂音，这才把阿呆放下。

商非凡再次回到地牢中。

这次没有让他分心的小家伙，他也能好好打探这间牢房。

商非凡右手轮流按在潮湿的墙面和地面上，精神力如同有生命的丝线般渗入石缝，射向四面八方。

精神力感知反馈回来的信息让他露出微笑。

这地牢下方是实实在在的石块。

但地牢侧上方不到两米处就是彭石城庞大的下水道系统，怪不得这里水汽这么重，还有水渗透进来。

没有犹豫，商非凡施展了穿墙术——有些小魔法还是很好用的，商非凡之前就已经通过系统直接掌握这些魔法知识，只是用怨力代替魔力，消耗有点大。

现在他直接使用戒指中的神格碎片能量代替魔力，就算消耗大一些，也很划算。反正这戒指貌似还能自己吸收附近的黑暗能量来补充自己。

噗！

第一次使用穿墙术的商非凡感觉自己像是被挤了出来。

潮湿加阴冷的空气扑面而来，一股说不出来的寒意侵袭全身。

商非凡像是没感觉到。

他的双脚站在了沟渠边上。

这是一个用石砖垒砌的圆弧形地下水道，空间非常大，中间是下水流通的沟渠，两边是岸道。

沟渠的宽度和深度堪比一条小河。

如今这乌黑的污水中站满了一个又一个不死尸。

这些不死尸像是知道方向一样，一个劲地往北边走。

除了沟渠中，两边岸道也有很多不死尸在行走。

不死尸擦过商非凡身边，完全没有察觉这是一个活人。

商非凡很想屏蔽嗅觉，这下水道的味道很难闻，再加上那些不死尸身上像是腐烂又像是深度发酵的怪味，让这个下水道就像是一个毒气罐。

他的眼睛都被刺激得差点溢出生理性泪水。

商非凡迅速用黑暗能量包裹自己。可怕的气味瞬间消失。

远处忽然传来一阵粗鲁的咒骂声：“这是怎么回事？为什么这些怪物不听话了，它们怎么都在向下水道外面走，还看见活人就扑。快去禀告城主大人！”

“不用禀报了，城主已经知道了，他都快气疯了。”另一个声音接话，“他已经下令，让我们无论如何都不能让这些怪物跑出去。这些鬼东西要是跑出去，咱们彭石城就完了。”

“草！不是说约瑟夫大师能控制这些怪物吗？约瑟夫大师现在在哪里？”

“约瑟夫大师有别的重要任务。只要他回来就好了。”

“是的！只要大家坚持到约瑟夫大师回来，这些鬼东西就会重新听话。大家再坚持坚持！”

商非凡无声地勾起嘴角。看来彭石城主还没意识到，那个能控制不死尸的黑袍人已经永远回不来了。

比起料理彭石城城主，还是先摸清不死尸和岩浆爆发的情况更紧急，商非凡转头沿着不死尸来的方向逆行。

下水道中的不死尸熙熙攘攘，似乎源源不断。

等走到尽头，商非凡以为会看到一个大排水口。

他确实看到了一个很大的排水口，出口处还用石头做成了栅栏。

那些石头栅栏可以整个取下，商非凡只研究了一会儿就找到机关，掰开石头栅栏探头往外看。

下方竟然是一个巨大无比的深坑。

深坑深不见底。

商非凡随手摸了一块石头扔下去，半天也没有听到回音。

不知道彭石城人是否知道深坑下面有什么，还是什么都不知道，就只是拿这个深坑当废水排污坑。

不死尸显然不是从这个深坑爬山来的。

商非凡重新装好石头栅栏，看向距离石头栅栏大约十米的地方。

那里的墙体裂开了一条缝。

那条缝隙恰好能容纳一个身形稍胖的人从里面挤出来。

大量不死尸就是从这条裂缝一个挨一个地走出来。

“停！”商非凡发出指令。

堵在缝隙处正准备往外走的不死尸停住，连同后面的不死尸一起。

商非凡单独把最前面一个不死尸拉出来，走进去往后面看了看。

缝隙后面的通道不算特别狭窄，大概够他擦着边挤过去。

这裂缝一看就是天然形成，不是常年累月一点点开裂成这样，就是地震造成。

商非凡回头，抬起手指，对精神力覆盖范围内的所有不死尸下令：“停在这里，不要动弹，不要扑食活物。”

下水道里所有不死尸在一瞬间全都停下了动作。

几个出口处，正在和彭石城兽人厮杀、想要吞噬活物以及离开下水道的不死尸也全都停下。

彭石城守卫们啧啧称奇：“应该是约瑟夫大师回来了。果然他一回来，这些怪物就都老实了。”

“行了，没事了没事了，大家可以好好休息一阵了。让轮班的人赶紧过来，还是要看守好出口，免得真有不死尸跑出来。”

“奇怪，既然约瑟夫大师能控制这些不死尸，为什么不干脆杀死它们？这么多不死尸全都堵在下水道里面……我只要想到我家地面下全是这些怪物，我就吃不着睡不安稳。城主他们到底是怎么想的？”

“不该你多问的事别多问！城主大人他们的决定，你也敢哔哔，想死吗？”

“城主大人肯定不会害我们，也许他们是有什么计划吧。”

“好了，别说这些上层才能决定的事。我们做好自己的事就好。”

另一头，随着商非凡深入裂缝，只觉得周围温度正逐渐升高，之前还能看到一点的苔藓之类已经全部消失。

直直地走了很久，看到了第一个地底大洞，商非凡估算他至少走了三公里的路。

恐怕彭石城人也不知道他们的山体出现一条连接地下的裂缝，还裂出这么长。

裂缝也不是全往下走。

商非凡根据右眼小地图的展示和他自己的估算，推测他应该离开了彭石城范围，进入了东南方向。

这个方向很是靠近黑森林城。

商非凡继续往前走，经过了两个地底大洞。这时他已经走了约莫二十公里。

好在有源源不断的不死尸指路，他一直没有走错路，就逆着那些不死尸的行进方向，摸到了不死尸的源头。

在看到不死尸源头地时，他先看到了地缝深处隐藏的暗红色岩浆流。

黑袍人约瑟夫大概就是找到这里就以为发现了不死尸大量迁徙的原因，可能也因为恐惧，就没有继续向前，而是回去向彭石城主复命了。

这处岩浆流距离彭石城并不远，地面直线距离顶多十三四公里。不过位置很深。

黑袍人并没有怎么担心岩浆喷发的事，大约就和深度有关。

但商非凡能感知到这些岩浆还没有达到活跃期，它们还在积蓄力量。

一旦地底板块有变动，地底压强增大，这些岩浆就会从地底深处喷射而出，再从高到低罐向彭石城方向。

彭石城位于山腰，看似安全，只要地震不会影响到那座石山。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan’s spiritual perception probed into the statue plaza, and very soon, he discovered a designated perimeter encircled by blue light at the edge of the square.

Directly taking A-Dai into the blue-light circle, he tested it out himself and indeed could not sense the slightest shred of ambient noise. Only then did he set A-Dai down.

Shang Feifan returned once more to the dungeon.

This time, without the little fellow to distract him, he could thoroughly explore this prison cell.

Shang Feifan pressed his right hand alternately against the damp stone walls and the ground, his spiritual power leaking into the stone crevices like living threads, shooting out in all directions.

The feedback from his spiritual perception brought a smile to his face.

Beneath this dungeon lay solid, genuine rock.

Yet less than two meters above and to the side of the dungeon lay Pengshi City’s massive sewage system. No wonder the moisture here was so heavy, with water even seeping through.

Without hesitation, Shang Feifan executed the Wall-Passing Technique—some minor magic remained remarkably useful. Shang Feifan had already directly mastered these magical arts through the system, though using resentful energy in place of mana made the consumption somewhat heavy.

Now, he directly used the energy of the Godhead fragments within his ring as a substitute for mana. Even with higher consumption, it was entirely worthwhile. Besides, this ring seemed capable of automatically absorbing nearby dark energy to replenish itself.

*Plop!*

Using the Wall-Passing Technique for the first time, Shang Feifan felt as though he were being forcefully squeezed through.

Damp and freezing air rushed at him, an inexpressible chill invading his entire body.

Shang Feifan acted as though he felt nothing.

His feet landed right at the edge of a drainage channel.

This was a circular underground sewer built of stone bricks, boasting an immense space. In the center ran the sewage flow channel, flanked by pathways on both sides.

The width and depth of the channel rivaled a small river.

At present, this pitch-black, turbid wastewater was packed back-to-back with Undead Corpses.

These Undead Corpses seemed to know their direction, relentlessly marching toward the north.

Aside from the main channel, numerous Undead Corpses were also treading along the pathways on both sides.

The Undead Corpses brushed past Shang Feifan without the slightest awareness that a living human stood right beside them.

Shang Feifan desperately wanted to shield his sense of smell. The stench of the sewer was atrocious, coupled with the bizarre odor emanating from the Undead Corpses—part rotting flesh, part deep fermentation—making the entire sewer feel like a canister of poison gas.

His eyes even stung to the point of nearly leaking involuntary physiological tears.

Shang Feifan swiftly shrouded himself in dark energy. The horrific stench vanished in an instant.

In the distance, a rough wave of cursing suddenly rang out: "What the hell is going on? Why aren't these monsters listening anymore? Why are they all marching out of the sewer, and pouncing on any living person they see? Go report this to the City Lord!"

"No need to report it; the City Lord already knows. He's about to be driven insane," another voice chimed in. "He's already issued orders that no matter what, we cannot let these monsters escape. If these ghost things get out, our Pengshi City is finished!"

"Damn it! Didn't they say Master Joseph could control these monsters? Where is Master Joseph right now?"

"Master Joseph has other important duties. As long as he returns, it'll be fine."

"Right! As long as everyone holds out until Master Joseph comes back, these ghost things will obey again. Everyone, hang in there a little longer!"

Shang Feifan silently curved the corner of his lips. It seemed the City Lord of Pengshi had yet to realize that the black-robed man capable of controlling the Undead Corpses was never coming back.

Compared to dealing with the City Lord of Pengshi, figuring out the origin of the Undead Corpses and the magma eruption was far more urgent. Shang Feifan turned around and marched upstream against the flow of the Undead Corpses.

The Undead Corpses in the sewer were bustling and chaotic, appearing to be endlessly abundant.

Upon reaching the end, Shang Feifan expected to see a massive drainage outlet.

He indeed saw a very large drainage outlet, its exit barred with stone grilles.

Those stone grilles could be removed in their entirety. After studying the mechanism for just a moment, Shang Feifan found the trigger, pried open the stone grilles, and poked his head out to look outside.

Below lay a pitch-black abyss of a gigantic crater.

The crater was bottomless.

Shang Feifan casually picked up a stone and tossed it down, hearing no echo whatsoever even after a long while.

It was unclear whether the people of Pengshi City knew what lay at the bottom of this crater, or if they knew nothing at all and simply used this chasm as a dumping ground for wastewater.

The Undead Corpses clearly had not climbed up from this deep crater.

Shang Feifan reinstalled the stone grilles and looked toward a spot about ten meters away from them.

A fissure had split open along the wall there.

That crack was just wide enough to accommodate a slightly plump figure squeezing through from within.

Vast numbers of Undead Corpses were emerging from this fissure, shuffling out shoulder-to-shoulder.

"Halt!" Shang Feifan issued a command.

The Undead Corpse blocking the crevice and preparing to walk out froze instantly, along with all the Undead Corpses trailing behind it.

Shang Feifan pulled the very front Undead Corpse aside, stepped inside, and peered toward the rear.

The passage behind the crevice was not particularly narrow; it was roughly wide enough for him to squeeze through by scraping against the sides.

At a single glance, this fissure was clearly formed naturally, born either from years of gradual cracking or from an earthquake.

Shang Feifan turned back, raised his finger, and commanded all the Undead Corpses within the range of his spiritual coverage: "Stop right here. Do not move, and do not pounce on living things."

In a split second, every single Undead Corpse in the sewer froze in its tracks.

At several exits, the Undead Corpses that had been brawling with Pengshi City beast-men, attempting to devour living prey and escape the sewer, also ground to a complete halt.

The guards of Pengshi City clicked their tongues in wonder: "It must be that Master Joseph is back. Sure enough, as soon as he returns, all these monsters turn obedient again."

"Alright, the danger's passed. Everyone can rest easy for a spell. Have the shift guards hurry over; we still need to keep a close eye on the exits, just in case any Undead Corpses actually slip out."

"Strange. Since Master Joseph can control these Undead Corpses, why not just kill them outright? So many Undead Corpses jammed up inside the sewer... Just the thought that my house is built right on top of a nest of these monsters makes it impossible for me to eat or sleep in peace. What on earth are the City Lord and the others thinking?"

"Don't ask questions you shouldn't! Do you dare flap your gums about Lord City Lord and the others' decisions? Have you got a death wish?"

"Lord City Lord certainly won't harm us. Perhaps they have some kind of plan."

"Fine, stop talking about matters only the higher-ups can decide. Let's just do our jobs."

On the other side, as Shang Feifan penetrated deeper into the fissure, he felt the surrounding temperature gradually rising. The sparse patches of moss visible earlier had vanished entirely.

Walking straight ahead for a long duration, he encountered the first subterranean cavern, estimating that he had traveled at least three kilometers.

It was likely that even the people of Pengshi City had no idea a fissure connecting to the underworld had formed within their mountain, let alone one stretching this far.

The fissure did not slope entirely downward.

Based on the display of his top-right mini-map and his own estimations, Shang Feifan deduced that he had already left the territory of Pengshi City and entered the southeastern direction.

This direction was extremely close to Black Forest City.

Shang Feifan continued pressing forward, passing through two more subterranean caverns. By this point, he had covered approximately twenty kilometers.

Fortunately, with the endless stream of Undead Corpses serving as guides, he had never lost his way. Moving upstream against the marching route of those Undead Corpses, he finally tracked down their origin.

Upon witnessing the source location of the Undead Corpses, he first caught sight of a dark red magma flow hidden deep within the fissure.

The black-robed man, Joseph, had probably reached this point and assumed he had discovered the reason for the massive migration of Undead Corpses. Likely out of fear as well, he had failed to push further, choosing instead to return and report back to the City Lord of Pengshi.

This magma flow was not far from Pengshi City; the straight-line distance on the surface was at most thirteen or fourteen kilometers. However, its underground location was extremely deep.

The black-robed man hadn't worried much about a magma eruption, likely due to the sheer depth.

Yet Shang Feifan could sense that these magma currents had not yet reached their active phase; they were still accumulating power.

Once the underground tectonic plates shifted and subterranean pressure increased, this magma would erupt from the depths of the earth, surging down from high to low directly toward Pengshi City.

Pengshi City was situated halfway up a mountain; it looked safe enough, provided earthquakes did not affect that stone mountain.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第229章 探究不死尸来源地 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
如果彭石城的管理者聪明，还能利用尤其彭石城下水道出口那个巨大的看不见底的深坑。

那个深坑就是最好的岩浆泄流点！

拐过一个弧度接近一百二十度的弯道时，商非凡突然停住了脚步。眼前的景象让他的瞳孔骤然收缩。

这是怎样一个庞大的地下空洞。

没有任何人工痕迹，大到一眼看不到边际，至少有五十个足球场那么大。

洞顶距离地面也很高，洞内有很多凌乱的石头。

这不是溶洞，没有水，只有干燥的岩石和地面尘土。

地面密密麻麻挤满了不死尸，洞壁有些凸凹的平台中也有。不过能拥有“单间”的不死尸等级似乎都很高。

它们也是第一批主动向商非凡看过来的不死尸。

商非凡直视那些不死尸，他漆黑的双眼瞳孔似乎在扩大，黑到宛如深渊。

戴在左手上的戒指界面发出幽暗的光芒，似乎在与商非凡的眼眸相呼应。

山壁上的高级不死尸们忽然齐齐做了一个右手握拳按在胸前，垂首弯腰行礼的动作。

商非凡：“……”

这绝对不是他喜欢的调调。

他刚才只是命令这些不死尸都要乖乖听话，顺便威胁它们不听话的会直接变成肥料。

算了，只要能听话就好。

幸亏那个黑袍人约瑟夫没有找到这里，否则就凭他那点操控力，就算有神格碎片戒指，他也无法操控这些高级不死尸，搞不好连逃都逃不掉。

这里随便一个高级不死尸就能撕碎他。

商非凡也不敢太过托大，没有手上的戒指，他也不敢撩拨这些高级不死尸。

如果他没有感知错误，这些高级不死尸最低级都有六级，最高级的一个很可能已经达到八级巅峰。而他和郎沐都只有七级初而已。

商非凡跳到最高处，挤开那个占领最高处单间的干瘦不死尸，往下环视一圈。

粗略估计，这个地穴里的不死尸数量至少在五六万以上。再加上之前已经离开的一批，这里藏了约莫十万不死尸。

简直恐怖！

就好像毒雾纪那些突然消失的不死尸都藏在这里了一样。

不，毒雾纪的不死尸数量达到几百几千万，这里隐藏的应该只是沧海一粟。

商非凡莫名感到一点点恐惧。这些不死尸简直就像是被谁命令一样，毒雾一消失，就自动聚集到藏身点，把自己隐蔽起来，等着合适的机会重新被召唤。

那……就问是谁命令了这些不死尸？

谁能命令相当于法圣巅峰实力的不死尸？

可惜这个问题，就算是最高级的不死尸也无法回答他。
chunks.englishText:
If the administrators of Pengshi City possessed any cleverness, they could make use of that colossal, bottomless abyss located right at the sewer exit of Pengshi City.

That deep crater was the absolute best discharge point for the magma!

Rounding a bend with an arc close to one hundred and twenty degrees, Shang Feifan suddenly halted his steps. The sight before him caused his pupils to contract violently.

What manner of gargantuan underground cavern was this?

 devoid of any artificial traces, it was so vast it stretched beyond the bounds of vision, spanning at least the area of fifty football fields.

The cavern ceiling sat at an immense height from the floor, and the interior was littered with a chaotic sprawl of rocks.

This was no limestone cave; there was no water—only dry stone and surface dust.

The ground was densely packed with countless Undead Corpses, and some even occupied protruding, concave platforms along the cavern walls. Yet the Undead Corpses possessing such "single rooms" appeared to be of exceptionally high rank.

They were also the very first batch of Undead Corpses to actively gaze toward Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan stared directly at those Undead Corpses; the pupils of his pitch-black eyes seemed to dilate, darkening until they resembled an abyss.

The ring interface worn on his left hand emitted a dim, gloomy glow, seeming to echo Shang Feifan’s gaze.

The high-ranking Undead Corpses on the cliff face suddenly synchronized a movement: pressing their right fists against their chests, lowering their heads, and bowing in salute.

Shang Feifan: "..."

This was definitely not his preferred style.

Just moments ago, he had merely commanded these Undead Corpses to behave obediently, casually threatening that those who disobeyed would be turned straight into fertilizer.

Never mind. As long as they obeyed, that was enough.

Fortunately, that black-robed man Joseph had not found his way here. Otherwise, given his meager level of control, even with the Godhead fragment ring, he would have been utterly incapable of controlling these high-ranking Undead Corpses, and might not have even managed to escape with his life.

Any single high-ranking Undead Corpse here could tear him to shreds.

Shang Feifan did not dare to be overly arrogant; without the ring on his hand, he would never dare to provoke these high-ranking Undead Corpses.

If his perception was not mistaken, the lowest among these high-ranking Undead Corpses was at least Tier 6, while the strongest one likely approached the peak of Tier 8. Meanwhile, both he and Lang Mu were merely at early Tier 7.

Shang Feifan leaped to the highest vantage point, shoving aside the emaciated Undead Corpse that occupied the topmost single room, and surveyed the circular expanse below.

By rough estimation, the population of Undead Corpses within this cavern numbered at least fifty to sixty thousand. Coupled with the batch that had already departed, roughly one hundred thousand Undead Corpses were concealed right here.

Simply terrifying!

It felt as though all the Undead Corpses that had suddenly vanished during the Poison Fog Era were hiding in this very place.

No, the number of Undead Corpses during the Poison Fog Era had reached the scale of hundreds of millions; what was hidden here should merely be a drop in the ocean.

Shang Feifan felt a faint, inexplicable chill of dread. These Undead Corpses acted as if they were obeying someone's command—the moment the poison fog vanished, they automatically converged upon a hiding spot, cloaking themselves in secrecy while awaiting the right opportunity to be summoned once more.

Then... the question arose: who was it that commanded these Undead Corpses?

Who could possibly command Undead Corpses equivalent in strength to the peak of a Saint Mage?

Regrettably, even the highest-ranking Undead Corpse was incapable of answering him on this matter.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第230章 我就是给便宜儿子出出气 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第230章 我就是给便宜儿子出出气

商非凡左手戴着的炼金戒指微微发烫，他能感觉到自己与这些不死尸似乎建立起了某种精神上的联系。

当他重点沟通那几个高级不死尸时，并没有完整的意识回馈，但他又明确知道自己的指令发了出去，并且对方会执行。

细细揣摩了一会儿，商非凡脸上露出微笑。

他明白了。

这些不死尸是真的都已经死亡，身体中的灵魂也早已消散，并没有被困在身体中。

这些不死尸之所以还能动，甚至能吃活物，不过是被赋予了指令。

就好像有人特意摧毁了兽人身体中的智能操控中枢——灵魂，甚至毁掉了大半的操作系统，把高智能高效率的AI机器改成了最简单模式的纯机械，最后只留了一条电线专门用来传输最简单指令。

而这个控制不死尸的媒介就是虫毒。

虫毒表面看起来似乎和虫母有关系，但根据那些不死尸反射到他这里的“信号”来看，更像是比虫子还要低端的某种植物的传递方式。

是某种菌吗？

所以虫毒的本质其实是一种菌子？

商非凡之所以会想到这点，不止是因为不死尸给他反馈的信号，更因为他拿到了虫毒溶解药剂的配方。反推之下，他才会有这样的推测。

果然最低端最基础的生命才最可怕吗？

商非凡不再深想，重点是他现在能操控这些不死尸就好。

“居然还懂得行礼？等级越高的不死尸，恢复的细胞记忆越多？那如果不死尸达到九级法神境界，会不会让全身细胞重生，进而恢复生前记忆？或者直接变成新品种生物？”商非凡摸了摸下巴。

他特意看向那个实力最强的八级不死尸——那是一个身体干瘦至极穿着残破铠甲的高个兽人，它失去了一个眼球，但幽深的黑眼眶就像是另一只眼睛，反而是它还存在的另一个眼睛已经接近干瘪。

在商非凡注视它时，它也在注视着商非凡。

这具不死尸竟然在观察他。商非凡下意识这么想到。

那么问题来了，是这具不死尸的身体细胞进化了，还是控制它神经中枢的菌子进化了？

“不管你们是什么，能老实干活的才能留下来。”商非凡冲着无数不死尸一笑，对那几个高级不死尸下令，命它们率领普通不死尸给他干活。

商非凡抬起左手，戒面微微泛出暗红色的光芒。高级不死尸齐刷刷地转头，似乎在等待商非凡下令。

郎沐不在，商非凡也无法确定这里的地理走向，更无法找出最适合的岩浆流泄洪路线。

但他这次本来就是尝试，也无所谓失败。

而且他还有现成的泄洪通道，就是他逆流而上的那条地底裂缝。

“我需要你们从能看见岩浆的那个地方……”商非凡跺了跺脚，一道黑色能量从他脚下蔓延，在地面上勾勒出一条蜿蜒的线路，“顺着这条线，挖一条通道，一直通往彭石城下水道排出口的那个深坑。”

这个命令下达后，那些高级不死尸没有半丝犹豫，齐齐对庞大地穴中的无数不死尸发出尖嚎。

五万多不死尸全都动了起来。

它们走出地穴，走到之前商非凡看到岩浆的裂缝处，按照地上那条黑暗能量绘成的线路，开始疯狂挖掘。

高级不死尸没有参与劳动，它们就像监工一样，甚至还自动分了管理段落。

那个最厉害的八级不死尸则是最大的监工头，它仍旧站在商非凡身边。

商非凡满意地看着这一幕。

不死尸确实是最好的劳工——它们的指甲和牙齿比普通工具更坚硬，不知疲倦，还不会抱怨工作环境。更妙的是，如果在挖掘过程中不小心损坏了身体……那正好帮商非凡解决了处理这些不死尸的麻烦。

商非凡转头八级不死尸，试图与它沟通：“告诉我你们为什么会聚集在这里。”

八级不死尸给了他回应，但他无法完全理解，只能凭直觉接收器推测……如果他没有感知错误的话，貌似这些不死尸似乎并不是收到什么指令才躲到这里，而是感知到当时的环境已经不适合它们“生存”，就自动寻找适合它们能长期存在的地方。

“毒雾缩回了地底，而不死尸需要毒雾中的某种物质才能进化？所以跟着毒雾也进入了地底？”

商非凡再看八级不死尸，就跟看到一枚长成人形的大菌子。

谁能想到虫毒在结合毒雾后竟然诞生了一种新变异生物，可以寄生在活物身上的菌子。

毒雾让活的生物死去，虫毒会让死去的尸体变异成虫型怪物，而和毒雾结合的虫毒异生出一种新型菌子，这种菌子才是让尸体变成不死尸、让活人变成活死人的元凶。

商非凡彻底搞明白了。

正思考间，地面突然轻微震动了一下。商非凡立刻警觉地看向四周。

地震？还是岩浆活动即将进入爆发期？

商非凡眯起眼睛。情况比他想象的更紧急。他必须加快进度，同时确保彭石城那边不会察觉异常。

想到这里，商非凡叫上那只八级不死尸，带着它迅速离开了庞大地穴，一路奔回彭石城。

经过彭石城下水道时，他给这里的不死尸下达了新命令：“继续保持静止。没有我的允许，不准攻击任何人，也不准离开下水道。”

这个命令会迷惑彭石城的人，让他们以为黑袍人约瑟夫还在控制着局势。而实际上……

商非凡又让那名八级不死尸也留在下水道。

他没把不死尸扔进雕像广场，总觉得扔进去会有意外发生。

而他现在最不需要的就是意外。

阿呆还没有醒来，商非凡无法快速赶回郎沐身边。

他想着来都来了，那就顺便调查一下彭石城主的背景吧。如果阿呆醒来打算为母报仇，也能有些信息参考。

看，他是多么负责的老爸~

彭石城不算特别大，就是传统的山城，城民们生活在看似安全的高大城墙中。

城内以城主府为中心，城内建筑都是石造，街道也都是石板铺成，看似结实整齐也很干净。

但这座城很安静，路上行人不多，就算彼此碰到也不会大声喧哗。

看着特别“文明”，但实际……商非凡只感到压抑和冷清。

倒是巡逻的卫兵不少。

商非凡在城中溜达一圈，已经看到不下四支巡逻队走过。

城民似乎也比较恐惧巡逻队，和巡逻队遇到，都不敢多看，一般都会避在墙角街边，等巡逻队先走过去。

这城主把城市管理得跟军营似的。

如果是特殊时期，那这种管理模式确实很好用，但如果长期都是如此，商非凡就要可怜这里的城民了。

在街上转了几圈后，商非凡发现这里的人对城主府的隐私讳莫如深。

他试着换了一身装束，假装外地行商进入酒馆，结果发现大白天酒馆人几乎没有。他跟酒馆主人聊天，说想在这里做生意，就想要多了解这座城里的权贵和城主的喜好，却被酒馆老板用警惕的眼神看。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 230: I'm Just Venting Some Frustration for My Unearned Son

The alchemy ring worn on Shang Feifan’s left hand grew faintly warm, and he could sense that a certain mental connection had seemingly been established between himself and these Undead Corpses.

When he focused his communication on those high-ranking Undead Corpses, he received no complete conscious feedback, yet he distinctly knew that his commands had been transmitted and would be executed by the other party.

Pondering this meticulously for a moment, a smile emerged on Shang Feifan’s face.

He understood now.

These Undead Corpses were truly, thoroughly dead; the souls within their bodies had long since dissipated and were not trapped inside their flesh.

The reason these Undead Corpses could still move, and even consume living flesh, was simply because they had been imbued with directives.

It was as though someone had intentionally destroyed the intelligent control center within the beast-men's bodies—their souls—and even dismantled the greater half of their operating system, converting high-intelligence, high-efficiency AI machinery into the most basic mode of pure mechanics, leaving behind only a single electrical wire dedicated to transmitting the simplest commands.

And the medium controlling these Undead Corpses was the insect poison.

On the surface, the insect poison seemed related to the Mother Insect, but based on the "signals" reflected back to him by those Undead Corpses, it felt more akin to a transmission method belonging to some form of plant even more primitive than insects.

Could it be a fungus?

So, the essence of the insect poison was actually a type of mushroom?

The reason Shang Feifan thought of this stemmed not only from the signals fed back to him by the Undead Corpses, but even more so from his possession of the formula for the insect poison dissolving potion. Working backward from that, he arrived at such a deduction.

Could it be that the most primitive and basic forms of life were truly the most terrifying?

Shang Feifan ceased dwelling on it; the main point was that he could now manipulate these Undead Corpses.

"They even know how to salute? The higher the rank of the Undead Corpse, the more cellular memory it recovers? If an Undead Corpse were to reach the Tier 9 God Mage realm, would it regenerate its entire body's cells and thus restore its lifetime memories? Or would it directly mutate into a brand-new species of lifeform?" Shang Feifan stroked his chin.

He specifically looked toward the most formidable Tier 8 Undead Corpse—an emaciated, tall beast-man clad in tattered armor. It had lost one eyeball, but its hollow, dark eye socket resembled another eye, while its remaining organic eye had nearly shriveled away.

As Shang Feifan gazed at it, it was likewise gazing back at Shang Feifan.

This Undead Corpse was actually observing him. Such a thought instinctively arose in Shang Feifan’s mind.

Then the question came: had the physical cells of this Undead Corpse evolved, or had the fungus controlling its neural center undergone evolution?

"Regardless of what you are, only those who can honestly work are allowed to stay." Shang Feifan flashed a smile at the countless Undead Corpses, issuing an order to the high-ranking ones to lead the ordinary Undead Corpses in working for him.

Shang Feifan raised his left hand, the ring surface glowing with a faint, dark crimson light. The high-ranking Undead Corpses snapped their heads around in unison, as if awaiting Shang Feifan's command.

Lang Mu was absent, leaving Shang Feifan unable to ascertain the geographical layout here, nor could he pinpoint the most suitable magma flow drainage route.

However, this trip was meant as a trial to begin with, so failure mattered little.

Besides, he already possessed a ready-made drainage channel—that underground fissure he had traversed upstream.

"I need you all from the place where the magma is visible..." Shang Feifan stamped his foot, a wave of dark energy spreading out from beneath his soles to outline a winding route upon the ground "...follow this line and excavate a passage leading all the way to the deep crater at the sewer exit of Pengshi City."

Once this command was issued, those high-ranking Undead Corpses did not hesitate in the slightest, unleashing a chorus of piercing shrieks toward the countless Undead Corpses filling the vast cavern.

Over fifty thousand Undead Corpses sprang into motion all at once.

They marched out of the cavern, arrived at the fissure where Shang Feifan had previously spotted the magma, and began digging frantically in accordance with the dark-energy-drawn path on the ground.

The high-ranking Undead Corpses did not partake in the physical labor; acting like foremen, they even automatically divided themselves into administrative sections.

That most formidable Tier 8 Undead Corpse served as the chief foreman, remaining stationed right by Shang Feifan's side.

Shang Feifan looked upon this scene with satisfaction.

Undead Corpses were indeed the ultimate laborers—their claws and teeth possessed greater hardness than ordinary tools, they never tired, and they offered no complaints regarding their working environment. Even better, if their bodies accidentally suffered damage during the excavation process... well, that conveniently solved the trouble of disposing of these Undead Corpses for Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan turned toward the Tier 8 Undead Corpse, attempting to communicate with it: "Tell me why you all gathered here."

The Tier 8 Undead Corpse provided a response, though he could not fully comprehend it and could only deduce through intuitive reception... if his perception was not in error, it seemed these Undead Corpses had not gathered here due to some command, but rather because they sensed the environment at the time was no longer suitable for their "survival," prompting them to automatically seek out a location suitable for their long-term existence.

"The poison fog retreated underground, and the Undead Corpses require a certain substance within the poison fog in order to evolve? So they followed the poison fog underground as well?"

Looking at the Tier 8 Undead Corpse once more, Shang Feifan felt as though he were gazing at a giant mushroom grown into human form.

Who could have imagined that the insect poison, upon combining with the poison fog, would actually give birth to a newly mutated lifeform—a fungus capable of parasitizing living creatures?

The poison fog caused living creatures to perish, the insect poison caused dead corpses to mutate into insect-like monsters, while the insect poison combined with the poison fog spawned a novel type of fungus. This very fungus was the culprit transforming corpses into Undead Corpses and turning the living into the walking dead.

Shang Feifan had thoroughly figured it out.

Just as he was deep in thought, the ground suddenly shuddered slightly. Shang Feifan immediately grew vigilant, scanning his surroundings.

An earthquake? Or was the magma activity on the verge of entering an eruption phase?

Shang Feifan narrowed his eyes. The situation was more urgent than he had imagined. He had to accelerate his progress while ensuring that Pengshi City remained oblivious to any anomalies.

With that thought, Shang Feifan summoned the Tier 8 Undead Corpse, took it with him, and rapidly departed the colossal cavern, sprinting all the way back to Pengshi City.

Passing through the sewers of Pengshi City, he issued a new command to the Undead Corpses stationed there: "Maintain your stillness. Without my permission, no one is allowed to attack anyone, nor are you allowed to leave the sewer."

This order would bamboozle the people of Pengshi City, leading them to believe that the black-robed man Joseph was still controlling the situation. In reality...

Shang Feifan also left that Tier 8 Undead Corpse behind in the sewer.

He chose not to toss the Undead Corpse into the statue plaza, harboring a lingering sense that tossing it in there might trigger unexpected incidents.

And right now, the absolute last thing he needed was an unexpected incident.

A-Dai had yet to awaken, rendering Shang Feifan unable to rapidly rejoin Lang Mu.

Figuring he was already here, he might as well take the opportunity to investigate the background of Pengshi City's City Lord. If A-Dai woke up intent on avenging his mother, having some background information on hand wouldn't hurt.

Look at what a responsible father he was~

Pengshi City wasn't particularly large, fitting the mold of a traditional mountain city where the citizenry lived behind seemingly secure, towering city walls.

Centered around the City Lord's Estate, the buildings within the city were entirely stone-constructed, and the streets were paved with flagstones, appearing solid, orderly, and exceedingly clean.

Yet the city was eerily quiet; pedestrians on the roads were scarce, and even when passersby crossed paths, they refrained from speaking loudly.

It looked exceptionally "civilized," but in reality... Shang Feifan felt only oppression and desolation.

Patrolling guards, however, were abundant.

Taking a stroll through the city, Shang Feifan had already spotted no fewer than four patrolling squads passing by.

The citizenry also seemed rather terrified of the patrols; upon encountering them, they dared not linger with their gazes, generally shrinking into alley corners and street edges to let the guards pass first.

This City Lord managed the city much like a military camp.

During exceptional times, this management model was undoubtedly highly effective. But if such conditions persisted long-term, Shang Feifan couldn't help but pity the common folk dwelling here.

After wandering the streets for several rounds, Shang Feifan discovered that the people here guarded the privacy of the City Lord's Estate like a taboo.

He attempted to change his attire, disguising himself as an out-of-town merchant entering a tavern, only to find the tavern virtually devoid of people in broad daylight. When he attempted to strike up a conversation with the tavern keeper, expressing a desire to do business here and hoping to learn more about the city's power brokers and the City Lord's preferences, he was met with a gaze of intense vigilance from the proprietor.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第230章 我就是给便宜儿子出出气 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡假装不知道，也没多纠缠，喝了一杯酒就离开了。

之后他又去了杂货铺，买了一些当地特色物品，试着跟店主搭话。结果说其他事都行，一提起城主和城中权贵，店主就开始假笑，转而就开始骂自己儿子。

城民们在恐惧城主，至少他们不敢说城主的私事。

商非凡也去过类似的地方，知道普通搭话根本问不出真正的东西。

看来得用点非常手段了。商非凡看向巍峨耸立的城主府。

凭借着隐身道具的掩护，他轻松躲过了巡逻的护卫，在城主府不断转悠。

这里也有防备隐身天赋者的炼金物品。

商非凡经过王城多次历练，对这些炼金道具的优缺点已经摸得清清楚楚，专门走死角，那些炼金道具没半点反应。

因为对城主府不了解，商非凡找了很久才找到一个有可能是城主心腹的人——从仆从对其的称呼和对方的居住位置推断。

那是个还在青壮期的雄性兽人，无法确定实际年龄，五官透着精明。

时间刚过午，对方正返回自己的独立小院，貌似准备休息。

商非凡无声无息地出现在他身后，黑暗能量如同活物般钻入他的耳孔。

“告诉我你知道的关于埃比尼泽·石城主的一切。”商非凡的声音如同从深渊中传来，“特别是他的婚姻和子嗣。”

被控制的兽人眼神涣散，过了好一会儿，机械开口：“城主大人……据我所知原本只是个流浪的冒险者，他娶了前城主的独女石狲悦小姐。

两人在一起将近五年，五年后，前城主被敌人偷袭死亡，怀孕中的石狲悦小姐受到打击，差点流产，之后就身体变差。

原本前城主死后，应该是石狲悦小姐继位，但她因为卧床不起，更因为怀孕，没有精力管理彭石城，就让埃比尼泽代理城主……”

商非凡简单总结，就是：一个阴险的凤凰男靠着英俊的外表和甜言蜜语，成功勾引了前城主的独生女。在老城主突然暴毙后，迅速笼络了一批人手，架空生病的妻子。等妻子病死后，就顺理成章地成为了正式城主。

“石狲悦生下的孩子呢？”商非凡追问。

“小少爷一生下来就体弱多病，没几天就夭折了。夫人受不了打击，没多久也跟着离世。”

“埃比尼泽有再娶吗？”

“没有。”

“有情人吗？”

“有。好几个。”

“有孩子吗？”

“还没有。城主似乎不急着生孩子，他也还很年轻，才五十多岁。”

“为什么城民们不敢说城主的事？”

精明脸兽人一脸恍惚地说：“有人说……城主是为了谋夺城主之位害死了石狲悦小姐甚至是自己的亲生儿子，在石狲悦小姐刚去世那段时间，这样说的城民非常多。那时很多城民都对城主上位有意见。城主非常恼怒有人嚼舌根，只要发现就会严惩不贷。久而久之，大家就都不敢再议论城主的私事。”

商非凡还想要更详细的信息，但这名精明脸兽人似乎知道得也不多，他听到的也只是传闻，甚至没有亲眼看到过城主府人石狲悦，更别说刚出生就没了的小少爷。

“有谁最清楚现任城主的事？”商非凡问。

精明脸兽人喃喃：“没有人。所有以前侍候城主的人都没了，现在城主身边的得用人手都是他当上城主以后培养和提拔的。”

商非凡眼中闪过一丝寒光。显然，埃比尼泽在坐稳城主之位后，已经把当年知道真相的心腹都处理得差不多。

“忘掉刚才的事，你只是累了，恍惚了一下。”商非凡拍拍精明脸兽人的肩膀，原地消失。

过了两秒，精明脸兽人眨眨眼，抬手揉了揉太阳穴，只觉得脑袋杠杠地疼。

唉，这两天要处理的事太多，尤其是下水道中的不死尸。

也不知道城主是怎么想的，竟然发现那么多不死尸既不处理，也不向王城汇报。只苦了他们这些知道秘密的手下，愁烦得毛都掉了好多。

精明脸兽人只当自己太累，完全没察觉刚才被人“催眠”。

商非凡转了这么久，已经摸清楚城主卧室和书房的位置。

这个时间，埃比尼泽·石正待在书房，他似乎也有些疲累，端着香浓的奶茶靠坐在椅子上，双目幽深地看着窗外。

这是个看上去颇为英俊的雄兽人，一双深邃的眼眸似饱含深情，身材尤其好，哪怕坐着也无法影响他身体流畅的线条。

人模狗样！

商非凡撇嘴。

你当软饭男没问题，条条大路通罗马，只要不害人，走哪条路达到目的都不丢人。

有些人吃软饭吃得可香了。

他的战友中也有一心捧老婆和老婆一家的，也确实靠着老婆一家升得极快，但人家对老婆极为忠狗，对岳家也很是尊重，别人嘲笑他靠老婆，他不以为耻反以为荣，还炫耀自己长得帅，其他人想走他这条路都条件不足。

人家夫妻俩过得可好了，孩子都有了两个，他战友一心搞事业，闲暇时间基本奉献给妻子和孩子，非常清楚自己要的是什么，就很稳。

这位石城主应该也非常清楚自己想要的是什么。

只不过他要的东西完全靠自己得不到，只能靠阴谋诡计和谋害人来谋求。自以为是心狠手辣的枭雄，实际档次和段位不知低他战友多少，商非凡看不起这个彭石城主。

这种人只能叫人渣，说他是软饭男都侮辱人家真正的软饭男——吃软饭也有技术和职业道德的好嘛，更别说枭雄这样的称呼。

商非凡想要给儿子出口气，又不想马上动手宰了彭石城主。

他倒是很想代替，但想到阿呆的性子……别看小家伙呆呼呼的，主意大得很，阿呆应该更想自己来处理这件事和这个人。

“那就先来个开胃菜吧。祝做个好梦，石城主。”

商非凡无声说道，抬手就将一股混合了怨气的黑暗能量送入埃比尼泽体内。

彭石城主眼皮慢慢垂落，手里的奶茶杯慢慢歪斜，里面的奶茶顺着他的裤腿流到地上。

“啊！”彭石城主猛地惊醒，整个人都跳了起来。

他刚才是不是睡着了？

见鬼！他怎么会梦见那样的……

彭石城主心情糟糕，察觉自己半身异样，低头一看，看到潮湿的裤子，顿时心情更糟糕。

商非凡目送彭石城主去了休息间，更换了衣服后就躺到了床上，貌似想要小憩一会儿。

没两分钟，彭石城主就进入深眠状态。

看来黑暗能量还有助眠的作用？商非凡两眼满是好奇，就站在窗前看着彭石城主。

他有点好奇他第一次的“造噩梦术”效果如何。

看刚才彭石城主的反应，应该是有一定效果的。

彭石城主的表情忽然变得扭曲起来。

他的眼皮剧烈颤动，下方的眼球滚来滚去。

没多一会儿，嘴里就发出含糊不清的呓语。

商非凡竖起耳朵听，没听清。

彭石城主突然大叫，猛地挥手像是劈砍什么一样。

就这么一劈，人也跟着清醒过来。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan feigned ignorance and did not press the matter further. After finishing a cup of wine, he took his leave.

Afterward, he went to a sundry shop, purchased some local specialty items, and tried to strike up a conversation with the shopkeeper. It turned out the shopkeeper was willing to talk about anything else, but the moment the City Lord and the city's powerful figures were mentioned, the shopkeeper would put on a forced smile and immediately pivot to scolding his own son.

The citizens of the city lived in fear of the City Lord; at the very least, they did not dare to discuss the City Lord's private affairs.

Shang Feifan had been to similar places before and knew that casual small talk would never unearth anything genuine.

It seemed he would have to resort to some extraordinary methods. Shang Feifan cast his gaze toward the towering City Lord's Mansion.

Shielded by his invisibility items, he easily bypassed the patrolling guards and wandered through the City Lord's Mansion at will.

There were indeed alchemical items here designed to guard against those with invisibility abilities.

Having been through numerous trials and tribulations in the Royal City, Shang Feifan understood the pros and cons of these alchemical gadgets like the back of his hand. He deliberately walked through their blind spots, and those items didn't react in the slightest.

Because he was unfamiliar with the City Lord's Mansion, it took Shang Feifan a long time to find someone who was likely a confidant of the City Lord—deducing this from the servants' forms of address toward him and his residential quarters.

He was a male beastman in his prime, his exact age indeterminate, with sharp features that exuded shrewdness.

Just past noon, the man was returning to his private courtyard, seemingly preparing to rest.

Shang Feifan appeared soundlessly behind him, dark energy burrowing into his ear canals like a living thing.

"Tell me everything you know about City Lord Ebenezer Stone," Shang Feifan's voice seemed to emanate from the abyss. "Especially his marriage and offspring."

The controlled beastman's eyes went slack, and after a long moment, he spoke mechanically: "Lord City Lord... as far as I know, he was originally just a wandering adventurer. He married Miss Shi Sunyue, the only daughter of the former City Lord.

The two were together for nearly five years. Five years later, the former City Lord was ambushed and killed by enemies. Miss Shi Sunyue, while pregnant, suffered a heavy blow, nearly miscarrying, and her health deteriorated ever since.

Ordinarily, after the former City Lord's death, Miss Shi Sunyue should have succeeded him. But because she was bedridden and pregnant, she had no energy to manage Pengshi City, so she let Ebenezer act as the acting City Lord..."

Shang Feifan summarized it simply: An insidious, opportunistic parasite of a man had successfully seduced the former City Lord's only daughter with his handsome looks and sweet words. After the old City Lord's sudden, violent death, he rapidly rallied a faction of men and hollowed out his ailing wife. Once his wife died of illness, he logically and smoothly became the official City Lord.

"What about the child Shi Sunyue gave birth to?" Shang Feifan pressed further.

"The Young Master was sickly from birth and died after just a few days. The Madam couldn't take the blow and passed away not long after."

"Did Ebenezer remarry?"

"No."

"Does he have lovers?"

"Yes. Quite a few."

"Does he have children?"

"Not yet. The City Lord doesn't seem in a rush to have children, and he is still quite young, only in his fifties."

"Why do the citizens not dare talk about the City Lord?"

The shrewd-faced beastman said in a daze, "Some say... the City Lord harmed Miss Shi Sunyue and even his own biological son to seize the position of City Lord. During the period right after Miss Shi Sunyue passed away, a great many citizens said this. Back then, many citizens had objections to the City Lord taking power. The City Lord was extremely furious that people were gossiping, and severely punished anyone he discovered doing so. Over time, no one dared to discuss the City Lord's private affairs anymore."

Shang Feifan wanted more detailed information, but this shrewd-faced beastman seemed to know very little; everything he had heard was mere rumor, and he had not even laid eyes on the City Lord's wife, Shi Sunyue, let alone the young master who had vanished shortly after birth.

"Who knows the most about the current City Lord?" Shang Feifan asked.

The shrewd-faced beastman muttered, "No one. All the people who used to serve the City Lord are gone. The capable personnel currently by the City Lord's side were all cultivated and promoted after he became City Lord."

A flash of cold light crossed Shang Feifan's eyes. Evidently, once Ebenezer secured his grip on the position of City Lord, he had taken care of nearly everyone who knew the truth back then.

"Forget what just happened. You were just tired and had a momentary lapse in concentration." Shang Feifan patted the shrewd-faced beastman's shoulder and vanished on the spot.

After two seconds, the shrewd-faced beastman blinked, raised a hand to rub his temples, and felt only a dull, pounding ache in his head.

Sigh, there were simply too many things to handle these past two days, especially the undead corpses in the sewers.

He had no idea what the City Lord was thinking, actually discovering so many undead corpses yet neither dealing with them nor reporting them to the Royal City. It was only hard on subordinates like them who knew the secret; they worried so much they were losing patches of hair.

The shrewd-faced beastman simply assumed he was too exhausted, remaining entirely unaware that he had just been "hypnotized."

Having roamed about for so long, Shang Feifan had already mapped out the locations of the City Lord's bedroom and study.

At this hour, Ebenezer Stone was lingering in his study. He also seemed somewhat fatigued, holding a cup of fragrant milk tea as he leaned back in his chair, his deep eyes gazing pensively out the window.

He was a rather handsome male beastman, his profound gaze seeming fraught with deep emotion, and his physique was exceptionally fine—even sitting down could not detract from the sleek lines of his body.

All show and no substance!

Shang Feifan curled his lip.

Being a kept man who ate soft rice was fine; all roads led to Rome. As long as you didn't harm others, taking whichever path to achieve your goal was nothing to be ashamed of.

Some people relished being kept.

Among his comrades, there were those who wholeheartedly doted on their wives and their wives' families, indeed rising rapidly through the ranks precisely because of them. Yet those men were utterly devoted "dog-like" husbands to their wives and showed immense respect to their in-laws. When others mocked them for relying on their wives, they felt no shame, taking pride in it instead while boasting of their own good looks, noting that others lacked the conditions to walk their path.

That couple lived wonderfully and even had two children. His comrade focused wholeheartedly on his career, dedicating his leisure time essentially to his wife and children, knowing very well what he wanted, making him thoroughly steady.

This City Lord Stone should also know very well what he wanted.

It was just that what he wanted could never be obtained by his own efforts, forcing him to resort to schemes, plots, and murder. He fancied himself a ruthless and decisive overlord, but his actual caliber and tier were leagues below his comrade. Shang Feifan looked down on this City Lord of Pengshi.

Such a person could only be called scum. Calling him a kept man was an insult to genuine kept men—after all, there was skill and professional ethics to eating soft rice, to say nothing of bestowing a title like "overlord" upon him.

Shang Feifan wanted to vent some frustration for his son, yet didn't want to slaughter the City Lord of Pengshi right away.

He certainly wanted to take his place, but thinking of A-Dai's temperament... despite the little fellow's dopey appearance, he had a mind of his own. A-Dai would probably prefer to handle this matter and this person himself.

"Then let's start with an appetizer. Have a good dream, City Lord Stone."

Shang Feifan murmured silently, raising a hand to send a strand of dark energy mixed with resentment directly into Ebenezer's body.

The City Lord of Pengshi's eyelids slowly drooped, the cup of milk tea in his hand gradually tilting as the liquid streamed down his trouser leg to the floor.

"Ah!" The City Lord of Pengshi jolted awake, leaping straight to his feet.

Had he just fallen asleep?

What the hell! Why did he dream of such...

The City Lord of Pengshi was in a foul mood. Noticing the abnormality on his lower half, he looked down and saw his damp trousers, worsening his mood instantly.

Shang Feifan watched the City Lord of Pengshi head to the lounge, change his clothes, and lie down on the bed, seemingly wishing to take a brief nap.

Within two minutes, the City Lord of Pengshi entered a deep sleep.

It turned out dark energy even had sleep-aiding properties? Shang Feifan's eyes were filled with curiosity as he stood before the window, watching the City Lord of Pengshi.

He was rather curious how effective his very first "Nightmare-Casting Art" would be.

Judging by the City Lord of Pengshi's reaction just now, it should have some effect.

The City Lord of Pengshi's expression suddenly twisted.

His eyelids fluttered violently, his eyeballs rolling beneath them.

Before long, incoherent mutterings spilled from his mouth.

Shang Feifan cocked an ear to listen, but couldn't catch it clearly.

The City Lord of Pengshi suddenly cried out, flailing his arm sharply as though hacking at something.

With that single strike, he jolted back to wakefulness.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第230章 我就是给便宜儿子出出气 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
外面的仆人敲门询问城主是否有事。

“没事，退下。”彭石城主定定心，呵斥一声。一摸额头，满是汗。

这个噩梦太可怕。

他醒来都还能清楚记得情节。

彭石城主不敢再睡，掀被下床，叫来仆人，洗漱后又去了书房。

但进入书房办公没多会，也不知是不是午休没休息好，损耗了精神，他又迷迷顿顿地打起瞌睡来。

眼皮慢慢合上。

……

“啊啊啊！别过来！你们早就死了！早就死了！”凄厉的惨叫从书房响起。

吓得侍候的仆人不顾吩咐，慌忙推开书房门跑进去查看。

“滚！都给我滚！”彭石城主觉得自己露了丑态，暴怒。

在一边看热闹的商非凡勾起嘴唇微微笑。

真可惜啊，他不会像郎沐一样的入梦术，否则就能看看这位城主都梦见了什么。

商非凡围着彭石城主走了一圈，用黑暗能量手绘了一个看不见的咒术阵。

“真心地诅咒你，每次疲累合眼都会做你妻子石狲悦和你岳父追杀你、折磨你的噩梦，你无法有任何正常的睡眠时间，只要睡着就会做噩梦，除非你和石狲悦一起生的孩子愿意原谅你。”

商非凡手指指向目标，一股浓郁的黑气就从戒指界面蹿出来，蹿进彭石城主身体里。

老商也不担心消耗黑暗能量，虽然现在花费了一些，但相信这位彭石城主一定会让他连本带利地赚回来。

做完这些，商非凡突然感应到雕像广场中的阿呆有了动静。

小家伙似乎要醒了。

“这小崽子时间倒是掐得刚刚好。”商非凡嘀咕，闪身进入雕像广场。
chunks.englishText:
Outside, a servant knocked to ask if the City Lord required anything.

"Nothing, withdraw," the City Lord of Pengshi steadied himself and barked in a stern voice. Reaching up to touch his forehead, he found it drenched in sweat.

That nightmare was too terrifying.

Even after waking, he could still clearly remember the plot.

Not daring to sleep anymore, the City Lord of Pengshi threw off the covers, got out of bed, summoned his servants, washed up, and returned to the study.

Yet after sitting down to work for only a little while—perhaps because he hadn't rested well during his afternoon nap, draining his spirit—he once again drifted off into a groggy drowsiness.

His eyelids slowly closed.

...

"Aah! Don't come closer! You've been dead for ages! Dead for ages!" A shrill, miserable scream erupted from the study.

Startled out of their wits, the attending servants disregarded orders, hastily pushing open the study door and running inside to investigate.

"Scram! Get out, all of you!" Infuriated by the exposure of his unseemly state, the City Lord of Pengshi flew into a rage.

Watching the commotion from the side, Shang Feifan curved his lips into a faint smile.

What a pity; he didn't know the Dream-Entering Art like Lang Mu did, otherwise he could have seen what kind of dreams this City Lord was having.

Shang Feifan walked a circle around the City Lord of Pengshi, using dark energy to hand-draw an invisible spell formation.

"I sincerely curse you: every time you grow tired and close your eyes, you shall suffer nightmares of your wife, Shi Sunyue, and your father-in-law hunting you down and tormenting you. You shall be denied any normal sleep; the moment you fall asleep, nightmares shall claim you—unless the child you and Shi Sunyue bore together is willing to forgive you."

Shang Feifan pointed a finger at his target, and a dense plume of black qi darted out from the ring's interface, plunging straight into the City Lord of Pengshi's body.

Old Shang wasn't worried about consuming dark energy; although he had spent some just now, he was confident this City Lord of Pengshi would make him earn it back with interest.

With that done, Shang Feifan suddenly sensed movement from A-Dai in the statue plaza.

The little fellow seemed about to wake up.

"This brat's timing is truly spot-on," Shang Feifan muttered, flashing into the statue plaza.

chunks.chineseText:
第231章 阿呆的身世

当商非凡回到雕像广场时，阿呆果然已经醒了。

但与之前不同的是，小家伙眉心的旋风纹和里面游离的光线变得更加清晰，而且眼睛里多了一些……嗯，小孩子似乎突然间长大了些许。

“爸爸……”阿呆声音有些哽咽，跳起来猛地扑进商非凡怀里，“我看到了……我看到了妈妈……，我知道她是我妈妈。”

商非凡轻轻拍着幼崽的背，没有急着追问。他能感觉到阿呆的身体在微微发抖，小爪子紧紧抓着他的衣服，就像是害怕一松手他这个便宜老爸就会跑了一样。

“慢慢说，别急。”商非凡多少对阿呆的身世也有了点数。

“爸爸，为什么有人会不想要自己的孩子，还会杀死自己的妻子？”

阿呆抬起脸，眼睛通红，情绪似乎还陷在他母亲留给他的信息中。

商非凡看着阿呆痛苦的表情，揉了揉他的脑袋：“因为不是每个当父亲和当母亲的人都是好人，也不是每个父亲母亲都会深爱自己的孩子，同样也不会多爱自己的伴侣和家人，这种人大多都极度自私，只在意自己。这就叫人类多样性。”

阿呆傻愣愣地问：“也就是说那原本就是个坏蛋？”

“没错。”商非凡斩钉截铁地说。

“那为什么妈妈还会喜欢他、嫁给他？”阿呆呢喃。

“因为坏人会装啊。就像骗子想要拐卖你，是不是会装的慈祥和蔼，看起来就不像是坏人？骗子想要骗你的钱，是不是也会对你说得天花乱坠，引得你心动？而想要越多、获得利益越大的诈欺，需要付出的成本就越多，演技也要越好。这不是一般人能防得住的，就你郎沐爸爸那么聪明的人曾经也被骗……了重要的宝贝。”

商非凡一提起这段就忍不住磨牙，同时恨得心头滴血——他那时怎么就没有也穿越到魔法大陆？明明他也受过几次要命的重伤。

阿呆惊讶：“啊，阿爸也被人骗过？”

商非凡用“这事我们就不继续往下说，你也不能问你郎沐爸爸”的眼神看便宜儿子。

阿呆秒懂：爸爸们也是要面子的。

阿呆抬爪子，神情严肃地在嘴上画了个大叉叉。

这么一打岔，阿呆的情绪就从黑漆漆的深坑里拔-出来大半。

阿呆趴在他商爸的怀里，小声说：“妈妈给我留下了血脉传承还有一段信息。我妈妈叫石狲悦，是、是彭石城城主的女儿，唯一的女儿。”

商非凡：猜到了。

接下来阿呆就跟他商爸转述了一段他从传承光球中接收到的一段信息。

基本就和商非凡的推断不错，就是一个入赘女婿利用岳家养料养肥自身再害死妻子和岳家进而吞没岳家一切的普通故事。

一开始，石狲悦并不知道被美称为“忧郁王子”的冒险者埃比尼泽是有意接近她，包括那英雄救美都是对方特意安排。

彭石城的继承人自然不能是弱者，所以石狲悦就出来历练，还隐瞒了自己的身份，伪装刚出道的冒险者护送自家商队前往另一座城市。

可埃比尼泽早就见过她并早就盯上她，知道她出门历练后，就尾随在后，故意向附近强盗透露她的行踪并编造她身带重宝的假消息。

等到强盗袭击商队和石狲悦。

那时商队和石狲悦其实能对付得了那些强盗，但埃比尼泽“及时”跳了出来，帮忙一起对付强盗，最后还把那些强盗全部团灭。

埃比尼泽借此和石狲悦认识，还加入商队。之后又对石狲悦表示欣赏，希望对方加入自己的冒险者小队。

石狲悦被埃比尼泽的好皮囊以及那双看似深情的深邃双眼欺骗，心想自己也需要历练，就欣然加入了埃比尼泽的小队。

埃比尼泽带着石狲悦做了几个不算危险的任务，日常相处下对石狲悦异常照顾，还经常“趁石狲悦不注意”偷看石狲悦。

冒险小队中的成员又有意无意对石狲悦点醒埃比尼泽对她情更深种这点，再来一个女冒险者适当地妒忌和羡慕，又有其他队员起哄，埃比尼泽再适时出来维护，阅历不深的千金小姐就这么陷入了爱情的陷阱。

历练大半年后，石狲悦带埃比尼泽回到彭石城，向父亲表示非埃比尼泽不嫁。

前彭石城主宠爱独女，也考校了埃比尼泽一段时间，但埃比尼泽十分会伪装，就连前彭石城主都没能看出对方隐藏在深情面目下的豺狼心。

“当姥爷重伤时，妈妈还没有发现那个坏蛋有问题。但姥爷开始怀疑，因为他的敌人找上他非常奇怪，张口就说他暗中杀死了自己的孩子，还表示自己有证据。姥爷让对方把证据拿出来，对方却说要保护证人，也不听姥爷解释，就攻击姥爷。”

“而那人原本就是姥爷的敌人，姥爷不喜欢对方，也懒得和对方多解释，加上对方主动出手，就还击了。”

“妈妈说，那人原本并不是姥爷的对手。姥爷就没有把那个敌人放在眼里，他会重伤，只因为他和那人打斗途中，有人偷袭他。最后姥爷把他的敌人打了个半死，自己也重伤回来。”

“姥爷回来后就说要调查这件事，埃比尼泽想要主动帮忙，但姥爷没有让他负责调查，而是找了自己的心腹属下。埃比尼泽就给妈妈推荐了一名药剂师。”

“可姥爷有自己相熟的高级药剂师，就婉拒了女儿女婿的好意。但不到两天，原本已经有所恢复的姥爷突然就重伤不治，等妈妈赶到姥爷身边，发现姥爷双目圆睁死不瞑目。”

“妈妈受到巨大打击，昏死过去，也就是在那时，妈妈发现自己怀了身孕。”

“妈妈想要给爷爷报仇，就跑去找那个攻击爷爷的敌人，还和对方的人手战斗了一番。等埃比尼泽带人赶到时，妈妈已经受伤。而那个敌人似乎在上次和姥爷的打斗中也察觉到哪里不对，嘲讽两句，却没对妈妈赶尽杀绝，就让埃比尼泽带妈妈回去了。”

“妈妈从姥爷的那个敌人口中得知，在两人比试中有人偷袭姥爷，可她自己受伤，又动了胎气，需要疗养，就只能委托自己的丈夫埃比尼泽去调查这件事，还有就是给自己的父亲办丧事。”

“等姥爷丧事结束，妈妈哀伤过度，一点小伤竟然变成缠绵病榻。妈妈那时也没有怀疑自己的丈夫，还因为自己生病无法处理彭石城中事情，感到对丈夫很抱歉。”

“埃比尼泽很会装样子，跟妈妈说，让姥爷留下的心腹人手来管理彭石城，他就帮忙查缺补漏。妈妈对自己的丈夫很放心，就叫来姥爷的心腹下属，说让埃比尼泽当代理城主。”

“当时，姥爷身边的心腹对这个姑爷也没有太多防备，还想着让对方代替一段时间也没什么，等小姐生下孩子养好身体，就能继承城主之位。”

“可包括我妈妈在内的所有人都没有想到，当妈妈交出彭石城管辖权后，就再也没能从房间走出来。哦，妈妈还是走出来了，被人拖到了秘密地牢里。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 231: A-Dai's Background

When Shang Feifan returned to the statue plaza, A-Dai had indeed already woken up.

Yet unlike before, the whirlwind pattern between the little fellow's brows and the stray lines of light within it had become much clearer, while his eyes held a bit more... well, the child seemed to have suddenly matured a fraction.
