"Dad..." A-Dai's voice was slightly choked as he sprang up, lunging fiercely into Shang Feifan's arms. "I saw... I saw Mom... I know she's my mom."

Shang Feifan gently patted the cub's back without rushing to question him. He could feel A-Dai's body trembling slightly, his little claws gripping his clothes tightly as if afraid that the moment he let go, this convenient father of his would run away.

"Take your time, don't rush." Shang Feifan already had a fair inkling of A-Dai's origins.

"Dad, why would someone not want their own child, and even kill their own wife?"

A-Dai raised his face, his eyes red-rimmed, his emotions still trapped within the message left behind by his mother.

Looking at A-Dai's agonizing expression, Shang Feifan rubbed his head. "Because not every person who becomes a father or a mother is a good person, nor does every father or mother deeply love their own child, nor do they necessarily love their partner and family all that much. Most people like that are utterly selfish, caring only about themselves. This is what we call human diversity."

A-Dai asked in a daze, "In other words, that person was a bad egg to begin with?"

"Precisely," Shang Feifan said decisively.

"Then why would Mom still like him and marry him?" A-Dai murmured.

"Because bad guys know how to put on an act. Just like a swindler trying to abduct you—don't they put on a benevolent, kind expression so they don't look like bad guys? A swindler who wants to cheat you out of your money will also spin you a web of glowing tall tales to make your heart waver. The greater the desire and the larger the profit a fraud yields, the higher the cost required, and the better the acting must be. That's not something ordinary people can guard against. Even someone as smart as your Dad Lang Mu was once tricked... out of an important treasure."

At the mention of this, Shang Feifan couldn't help grinding his teeth while feeling a pain in his heart that made it bleed—why hadn't he also transmigrated to the Magic Continent back then? Clearly, he had suffered several fatal injuries himself.

A-Dai was astonished. "Ah, Abah was tricked by someone too?"

Shang Feifan gave his convenient son a look that said, "We won't continue discussing this matter, and you aren't allowed to ask your Dad Lang Mu either."

A-Dai understood instantly: Dads cared about their dignity, too.

Raising a paw, A-Dai wore a solemn expression as he drew a large 'X' across his mouth.

With this little distraction, more than half of A-Dai's emotions were yanked out of the pitch-black abyss.

Crouching in his Shang Dad's arms, A-Dai whispered, "Mom left me her bloodline inheritance and a message. My mom's name is Shi Sunyue, and she is... she is the daughter of the City Lord of Pengshi, his only daughter."

Shang Feifan: Guessed as much.

Next, A-Dai relayed to his Shang Dad a piece of information he had received from the inheritance light sphere.

It was essentially identical to Shang Feifan's deduction: a mundane story of a matrilocal son-in-law who used his in-laws' resources to fatten himself up, before murdering his wife and in-laws to swallow up everything they owned.

At first, Shi Sunyue had no idea that the adventurer known by the romantic moniker of "Melancholy Prince," Ebenezer, had intentionally approached her, right down to the classic trope of a hero saving a damsel in distress, which had been meticulously orchestrated by the other party.

Naturally, the heir to Pengshi City could not be weak, so Shi Sunyue had set out to temper herself through trials, even concealing her identity and disguising herself as a novice adventurer to escort her family's caravan to another city.

Yet Ebenezer had laid eyes on her long ago and marked her as his target. Learning that she had set out for trials, he tailed her the whole way, intentionally leaking her whereabouts to nearby bandits and fabricating false rumors that she carried heavy treasures.

When the bandits attacked the caravan and Shi Sunyue—

At the time, the caravan and Shi Sunyue were actually fully capable of handling those bandits, but Ebenezer "timely" leaped out to help fight them off, ultimately wiping out the entire gang of bandits.

Taking advantage of this, Ebenezer struck up an acquaintance with Shi Sunyue and joined the caravan. Afterward, he expressed his admiration for Shi Sunyue, hoping she would join his adventuring party.

Shi Sunyue, deceived by Ebenezer's fine appearance and those seemingly affectionate, profound eyes, figured she needed tempering anyway and gladly joined Ebenezer's party.

Ebenezer led Shi Sunyue through a few non-dangerous missions. Through daily association, he showed her exceptional care and often "stole glances" at her when she wasn't looking.

Members of the adventuring party would then intentionally or unintentionally hint to Shi Sunyue that Ebenezer held exceptionally deep feelings for her. Coupled with a female adventurer displaying appropriate jealousy and envy, while other members egged them on, and Ebenezer stepping in at the right moment to defend her, the sheltered young lady thus tumbled into the trap of love.

After over half a year of trials, Shi Sunyue brought Ebenezer back to Pengshi City and told her father that she would marry no one other than Ebenezer.

The former City Lord of Pengshi doted on his only daughter and tested Ebenezer for a period of time. However, Ebenezer was a master of disguise; even the former City Lord failed to spot the wolf's heart hidden beneath his affectionate facade.

"When Grandpa was heavily wounded, Mom still hadn't discovered that bad guy had a problem. But Grandpa started to suspect something because his enemies tracked him down in a very strange way, immediately shouting that he had secretly killed their child and claiming they had proof. Grandpa asked them to produce the evidence, but they claimed they had to protect their witness, and without listening to Grandpa's explanations, they attacked him."

"That man was originally Grandpa's enemy to begin with. Grandpa didn't like him and couldn't be bothered to explain much to him; moreover, since the other party attacked first, he fought back."

"Mom said that man wasn't originally a match for Grandpa, so Grandpa didn't take that enemy seriously. The only reason Grandpa was heavily wounded was because someone ambushed him midway through their fight. In the end, Grandpa beat his enemy half to death and returned heavily wounded himself."

"When Grandpa came back, he said he wanted to investigate the matter. Ebenezer offered to help voluntarily, but Grandpa didn't let him take charge of the investigation; instead, he sent his own trusted subordinates. So Ebenezer recommended an apothecary to Mom."

"Yet Grandpa had his own familiar, high-grade apothecary, so he politely declined the good intentions of his daughter and son-in-law. But less than two days later, Grandpa, who had already shown signs of recovery, suddenly worsened and died of his injuries. When Mom rushed to Grandpa's side, she found Grandpa's eyes wide open in death, filled with lingering grievance."

"Mom suffered a massive blow and passed out cold. It was right then that Mom discovered she was pregnant."

"Wanting to avenge Grandpa, Mom ran off to find the enemy who had attacked Grandpa and fought a skirmish with his men. By the time Ebenezer arrived with reinforcements, Mom was already injured. And that enemy seemed to have realized something was amiss during his previous duel with Grandpa; after hurling a couple of taunts, he didn't push Mom to her death, simply letting Ebenezer take Mom back."

"Mom learned from Grandpa's enemy that someone had ambushed Grandpa during their duel. But because she was injured herself and had suffered a prenatal qi agitation requiring recuperation, she could only entrust the investigation—along with arranging her father's funeral—to her husband, Ebenezer."

"Once Grandpa's funeral concluded, Mom was consumed by grief, and a minor injury unexpectedly turned into a lingering, bedridden illness. Mom still harbored no suspicion toward her husband back then, even feeling guilty toward him because her illness prevented her from handling matters in Pengshi City."

"Ebenezer was exceptionally good at putting on a front. He told Mom to let the trusted subordinates left behind by Grandpa manage Pengshi City, while he would help patch any gaps and oversee things. Trusting her husband completely, Mom summoned Grandpa's trusted subordinates and announced that Ebenezer would act as the acting City Lord."

"At the time, Grandpa's trusted subordinates didn't harbor too much vigilance toward this son-in-law either, figuring there was no harm in letting him take over for a spell until the Young Miss gave birth, recovered her health, and inherited the position of City Lord."

"Yet none of them, including my mom, ever imagined that once Mom surrendered the jurisdiction of Pengshi City, she would never walk out of that room again. Oh, Mom did walk out eventually—dragged away to a secret dungeon."

chunks.chineseText:
阿呆转述这些内容时显得有点僵直，就像是努力让自己站在旁观者角度，可又掩不住字里行间的恨意。

“那你妈妈是什么时候察觉埃比尼泽的阴谋的？”商非凡拍拍儿子的脑袋，顺便吸收了一点他身上过多的负面能量。

小孩子家家，还是不要被太多负面能量浸泡比较好。

恨，应该恨。报复也应该报复。但不能从此沉浸在仇恨中，除了复仇就没有其他。

阿呆仰起方方的小脸蛋，让他商爸掏帕子给他擦了擦眼泪和鼻涕。

“妈妈没说什么时候。她只说埃比尼泽一开始就盯上了她，对方不仅想要彭石城主的位子、想要妈妈这一支石狲族的积累财富，更更想要的是妈妈这一支石狲族独有的血脉天赋。”

“瞬移？”

“对。”阿呆严肃点头，“他想要谋夺妈妈的血脉天赋。妈妈还说他有办法掠夺，说姥爷的死就跟埃比尼泽有关，埃比尼泽掠夺了姥爷的血脉天赋。姥爷也就是对他没有太过提防，加上对方有心算无心，姥爷都没有来得及使用天赋能力，就被害了。”

商非凡皱眉：“这么说埃比尼泽也会瞬移？”

阿呆抬起小爪子比划：“一点点。妈妈说这种强行掠夺来的天赋能力很低微，所以埃比尼泽就想哄骗妈妈心甘情愿把自己的天赋能力转移给他。”

商非凡莫名想到了郎沐。洛伦米尔顿谋夺郎沐的气运，也是需要对方心甘情愿。

阿呆补充：“妈妈还说，埃比尼泽也是石狲族，但他们那一支只会让身体变成石头，极少数会操纵石头，而且随着一代代血脉弱化，甚至无法全身变成石头，更无法操纵石头，只能让身体一部分石化。”

商非凡心中一动：“是不是同族更容易掠夺和转让血脉能力？”

“妈妈说就是这样。”阿呆点头。

“既然埃比尼泽要哄骗你妈妈转移能力，你妈妈又是怎么知道对方的真面目？”

阿呆重复她妈妈留给他的信息：“妈妈说那个坏蛋骗她身体不行快死了，还表现得十分深情，说要跟妈妈同生共死，但因为舍不得他们俩共同的结晶，就想着给孩子留下些东西。”

“那个坏蛋说他知道一种提炼出血脉能力的方法可以转移给自己的幼崽，说自己要在死前用这个方法把自己的能力都留给自己的孩子。”

阿呆眼睛吊了起来，这时看他一点都不呆，还有点凶。

“那个坏蛋把方法告诉了妈妈。他就是故意的！”

商非凡则在心里啧啧：聪明人啊，这是完全利用了石狲悦的爱子之心。

“但那个坏蛋不知道妈妈也知道一种血脉传承的方法，实际上妈妈这一支之所以还能保证血脉天赋的强大，除了自身资质很优秀，还有就是这种血脉传承法。”阿呆重重地说。

商非凡挑眉：“这么说你妈妈留给你的那个光球是独属于你们家的传承技巧？”

“对！妈妈当时就对那个坏蛋起了疑心，因为其他石狲族并不知道这个传承方法，而且对方说的方法和妈妈这一支的也不一样。但妈妈还没有真的认为对方谋害了姥爷。她就假装说要等孩子生下来，再留下自己的传承。但她开始偷偷联系心腹，想要打探姥爷去世那晚到底都发生了什么事。妈妈那时已经开始怀疑那个坏蛋的调查结果。”

“可妈妈这一联系才发现，当晚侍候姥爷的仆人竟然都不在府里了，也不知是生是死。她想联系姥爷留下的心腹属下，也联系不上。不过短短三四个月，姥爷的心腹属下就因为各种原因死亡或失踪，还有的出远门不知道什么时候才能回来。”

“妈妈想要让身边人传话和做事，却发现府里换了一批仆人和护卫，这些人全都找各种理由拦着妈妈身边的心腹。更可怕的是，妈妈发现她的身边人也越来越少，直到侍候她的仆人也全都换了。”

商非凡听到这里，不屑：“这人渣演戏也不演到底，竟然这么没耐心，好歹把传承光球骗到手再动城主府老人也不迟啊。”

阿呆不晓得该怎么回答。

商非凡转而一想，想通了：“大概是那人渣已经发现你母亲察觉不对开始调查他的事，他做贼心虚不敢让你母亲敞开了调查，加上他已经开始动手除去前城主留下的心腹，干脆就一不做二不休，断掉你母亲探向外面的手脚。我想，那段时间他一定找了很多理由，并不断向你母亲灌输她身体不行就要完蛋，赶紧留点东西给自己儿子的想法。”

“他以为你母亲已经逃不出他的手掌心，并认为你母亲就是个好骗好哄的傻女孩，一边提防她，一边又瞧不起她。”

阿呆没和自己父母接触过，就觉得自己母亲被骗得好惨。

“后来母亲就生下了我，但她生下我并没有立刻就剥离自己的天赋能力，她想要拖住那个坏蛋。因为……”

“妈妈说我当年生下来时是一个石卵，上面还有旋风印记，这就是姥爷和妈妈这一支的特质，拥有这种特质的孩子才有继承彭石城的资格，也才有可能觉醒妈妈这一支石狲族的血脉天赋。”

这段信息就是石狲悦的口述，专门留给自己儿子的。

她在留下这段讯息时也不知道自己儿子能不能找到并得到这个传承光球，甚至不知道自己儿子能不能活下来，她只是给自己留下了一点希望，并把自己最后的最好的东西留给了自己的孩子。

虽然这个孩子留着人渣的血，但也是她的孩子，更是继承了他们这一支的特质。

“妈妈害怕埃比尼泽会为了瞬移这个天赋能力谋害我，从我身上强行剥离，或哄骗我转移。就在我孵化的当天，让仅剩下的心腹把我偷偷送到远处没有人知道我身世的地方。”

阿呆说到这里，神情有点难过还有点释怀。

原来他并不是被抛弃的，妈妈送走他只是想要他能活下去，这是妈妈对他最深重的爱意，也是她当时唯一能为他做到的事情。

商非凡看阿呆那小老头一样的神情，忍笑。

阿呆没有注意到他商爸的表情，红着眼眶继续述说：“妈妈说她也不知道那名心腹能不能把我送出去，也不知道对方是不是会听她的吩咐，她说她用全部的生命力祝福我能活下去。”

泪滴从阿呆眼角滚落。

商非凡揉着便宜儿子的方脑袋，抱着他，等小家伙平复心情。

“那个叔叔送我走的时候被坏蛋的手下发现了，他好不容易才突破重围逃了出去。坏蛋也因此知道妈妈的打算，怒气冲冲地跑来找妈妈算账。妈妈就问他是不是为了瞬移这个能力以及彭石城的权力和财富，才盯上她和她一家。”

“那个坏蛋大概发现骗不下去，就承认了，还嘲笑妈妈的容貌，说如果不是为了她背后的那些东西，他连多看她一眼都不会。”
chunks.englishText:
When Ah Dai recounted these details, he seemed a bit stiff, as though trying hard to force himself to stand from a bystander's perspective, yet he could not mask the deep-seated hatred hidden between the lines.

"Then when did your mother discover Ebenezer's conspiracy?" Xiao Fan patted his son's head, conveniently absorbing a portion of the excessive negative energy radiating from him.

After all, it was better not to let a little child steep in too much negative energy.

Hatred was justified. Revenge was also justified. But one must never become permanently consumed by animosity, leaving room for nothing else in life except vengeance.

Ah Dai raised his small, square face, allowing his Shang-dad to pull out a handkerchief and wipe away his tears and snot.

"Mom didn't say exactly when. She only said that Ebenezer had set his sights on her right from the beginning. Not only did that person covet the position of City Lord of Peng Shi City and the accumulated wealth of Mom's branch of the Stone Monkey clan, but even more than that, he desperately wanted the unique bloodline talent exclusive to Mom's lineage."

"Teleportation?"

"Right." Ah Dai nodded solemnly. "He wanted to misappropriate Mom's bloodline talent. Mom also said he had a way to plunder it, and that Grandpa's death was tied to Ebenezer. Ebenezer had plundered Grandpa's bloodline talent. Grandpa simply hadn't been on high enough guard against him, and coupled with the fact that the scoundrel had plotted against an unsuspecting victim, Grandpa didn't even get the chance to use his innate ability before he was murdered."

Xiao Fan frowned. "Does that mean Ebenezer can teleport as well?"

Ah Dai raised a small claw to measure. "A tiny bit. Mom said that kind of forcibly plundered bloodline talent is extremely weak, which is why Ebenezer wanted to sweet-talk Mom into willingly transferring her innate ability to him."

For some inexplicable reason, Xiao Fan thought of Lang Mu. When Loren Milton schemed for Lang Mu's destiny and fortune, he had also required the other party's complete willingness.

Ah Dai added, "Mom also said that Ebenezer is likewise a Stone Monkey, but his specific branch can only turn their bodies into stone, and very few of them can manipulate stone. Moreover, as the bloodline weakened generation after generation, they couldn't even turn their entire bodies to stone, let alone manipulate it—they could only petrify a portion of their physical form."

A thought stirred in Xiao Fan's heart: "Is it easier for members of the same clan to plunder and transfer bloodline abilities?"

"Mom said that's exactly how it works." Ah Dai nodded.

"Since Ebenezer wanted to trick your mother into transferring her ability, how did your mother find out his true colors?"

Ah Dai repeated the information his mother had left behind for him: "Mom said that bad guy lied to her, claiming his body was failing and he was about to die. He even put on a deeply affectionate act, saying he wanted to live and die with Mom, but because he couldn't bear to part with the fruit of their union, he wanted to leave something behind for their child."

"That scoundrel claimed he knew a method to extract bloodline abilities so they could be transferred to his own offspring. He said he wanted to use this method before dying to bestow all his abilities upon his child."

Ah Dai's eyes narrowed into slits; looking at him now, he didn't seem foolish at all, but rather carried a hint of ferocity.

"That bad guy told the method to Mom. He did it on purpose!"

Inwardly, Xiao Fan clicked his tongue in wonder: *What a clever schemer. He completely exploited Shi Monkey Yue's maternal instincts.*

"But that bad guy didn't know Mom also knew a method of bloodline inheritance! In fact, the reason Mom's branch has been able to maintain the formidable power of our bloodline talent, aside from having exceptional personal aptitude, is precisely because of this unique bloodline inheritance technique," Ah Dai said heavily.

Xiao Fan raised an eyebrow. "Are you saying the ball of light your mother left you is a heritage technique exclusive to your family?"

"Right! Mom grew suspicious of that scoundrel right then and there, because other Stone Monkeys didn't know this inheritance method, and the technique he described was completely different from the one in Mom's lineage. However, Mom didn't genuinely believe yet that he had murdered Grandpa. She pretended to agree, saying she would wait until the child was born before leaving behind her inheritance. But she began secretly contacting trusted confidants, trying to find out what on earth had happened the night Grandpa died. By then, Mom had already begun to doubt the investigation results the scoundrel had given her."

"But the moment Mom made those contacts, she discovered that the servants who had served Grandpa on that fateful night were completely gone from the estate—no one knew if they were dead or alive. When she tried to reach Grandpa's loyal subordinates, she couldn't get through to them either. In the span of just three or four months, Grandpa's trusted aides had either died or gone missing due to all sorts of strange reasons, while others had supposedly gone on distant journeys with no return date in sight."

"When Mom tried to have her attendants pass messages and run errands, she discovered that a brand-new batch of servants and guards had been brought into the estate, and these people used every conceivable excuse to block the trusted aides by her side. Even more terrifyingly, Mom realized that the people around her were dwindling day by day, until finally, even the servants waiting on her hand and foot were entirely replaced."

Hearing this, Xiao Fan sneered with contempt. "That piece of trash couldn't even keep up the act until the end; he was far too impatient. He could at least have waited until he tricked the inheritance light orb into his hands before making a move on the old-timers in the City Lord's Mansion!"

Ah Dai didn't know how to respond to that.

Upon second thought, Xiao Fan figured it out: "The scoundrel probably realized your mother had sensed something was wrong and started investigating him. Having a guilty conscience, he didn't dare let your mother investigate openly. Coupled with the fact that he had already begun eliminating the former City Lord's loyalists, he simply decided to make a clean sweep and cut off your mother's reach to the outside world. I imagine he must have fabricated countless excuses during that period, constantly instilling in your mother the notion that her body was failing and she was about to collapse, urging her to hurry and leave something behind for her son."

"He thought your mother had already fallen completely into the palm of his hand, believing her to be a gullible, easily manipulated fool. While guarding against her, he also looked down on her with utter contempt."

Ah Dai had never interacted with his parents, but hearing this, he felt his mother had been deceived with heartbreaking cruelty.

"Later on, Mom gave birth to me. But she didn't immediately strip away her innate ability upon my birth; she wanted to buy time and stall that scoundrel. Because..."

"Mom said that when I was born, I was a stone egg with whirlwind markings on top. This is the distinct trait of Grandpa's and Mom's lineage. Only a child possessing this trait is qualified to inherit Peng Shi City, and only then is it possible to awaken the bloodline talent of Mom's Stone Monkey branch."

This segment of information was Shi Monkey Yue's oral testimony, specially preserved and left behind for her son.

When she recorded this message, she had no idea whether her son would ever find and acquire this inheritance light orb, nor did she know if her son could even survive. She was merely planting a tiny seed of hope for herself, leaving the best of her final remaining possessions to her child.

Even though this child carried the blood of that scoundrel, he was still her child, and more importantly, he had inherited the defining traits of their lineage.

"Mom was terrified that Ebenezer would harm me for the sake of the teleportation talent, forcibly stripping it from me or tricking me into a transfer. On the very day I hatched, she had her absolute last remaining confidant sneak me far away to a place where no one knew my background."

At this point, a trace of sorrow and emotional release mixed in Ah Dai's expression.

So he hadn't been abandoned after all! His mother sending him away was simply her desperate wish for him to survive. This was the deepest maternal love his mother could give, and the only thing she could possibly do for him at that time.

Seeing Ah Dai's expression, which made him look like a solemn little old man, Xiao Fan tried hard to suppress a laugh.

Oblivious to his Shang-dad's expression, Ah Dai continued with reddened eyes, "Mom said she didn't know if that uncle could successfully smuggle me out, nor did she know if he would follow her instructions. She said she used the entirety of her life force to bless me so that I would live."

A tear rolled down the corner of Ah Dai's eye.

Xiao Fan rubbed his pampered son's square head, holding him close as he waited for the little fellow to calm his emotions.

"When that uncle took me away, he was discovered by the bad guy's subordinates. He only managed to break through the encirclement and escape after a grueling struggle. Because of that, the bad guy found out about Mom's plan and stormed over to settle accounts with her in a rage. Mom asked him straight to his face if he had only targeted her and her family because of the teleportation ability and the power and wealth of Peng Shi City."

"Finding he could no longer keep up the charade, that bad guy confessed. He even mocked Mom's appearance, saying that if it weren't for the assets behind her, he wouldn't even have spared her a second glance."

chunks.chineseText:
“妈妈表现得很伤心，却突然瞬移捅了那坏蛋一刀。可惜没有把那个坏蛋当场捅死，对方也会瞬移，虽然速度没有妈妈快、距离没有妈妈远，但他躲开了要害，让妈妈必杀的一刀变成只是刺伤。”

阿呆是真的可惜，还小小叹了口气。

“坏蛋打伤了妈妈，还用药剂封印了妈妈的天赋能力，把妈妈关进了地牢里，说她什么时候把天赋能力转移给他，什么时候再放她出来。”

“坏蛋还想抓住我威胁妈妈，但他没能找到我，带过来的孩子也骗不了妈妈。”

“坏蛋百般折磨妈妈……”这是阿呆自己猜测的，石狲悦并没有过多描述自己被如何虐待。

“之后，那坏蛋看妈妈死活不愿意转移天赋能力，就想强行掠夺。掠夺时却发现妈妈的天赋能力已经消失了。坏蛋大怒，以为妈妈已经把自己的天赋能力转移给我，差点当场杀了妈妈。但他为了折磨妈妈，就故意没有杀死她，而是把她‘遗忘’在地牢内，想要等抓到我后，再带我来杀给我妈妈看。”

良久的沉默后。

“爸爸，我想报仇。”阿呆认真地说，声音虽轻，却带着不容置疑的决心。

商非凡笑了：“巧了，我刚才刚给那个人渣送了一份开胃菜。正菜嘛，你来决定。”

阿呆的眼睛亮了起来，“爸爸，是什么开胃菜？我现在就去给他送正菜可不可以？不过我现在肯定打不过那个坏蛋，爸爸你能不能帮我控制住他？我来转移他，把他扔到不死尸堆中。”

商非凡大笑，抛了抛还是小小的阿呆：“可以！咱家人就是要有恩报恩有怨报怨，尤其报仇能不隔夜就不隔夜！”

阿呆紧紧搂住商非凡的脖子，方脸蛋上终于露出了属于孩子的笑容。在经历了这么多后，他深知自己有多幸运——虽然失去了生母，却得到了两个如此爱护他的父亲。

而此刻，在彭石城的城主书房内，埃比尼泽·石正被无尽的噩梦折磨着。他不想睡，但他感觉自己特别困，不断打呵欠，稍微不注意两眼皮就朝一起合。

可每当他闭上眼睛，就会看到死去的前城主、石狲悦，以及那些被他害死的人，一个接一个地向他索命……

chunks.chineseText:
第232章 玩家的偷袭

商非凡正要带阿呆离开雕像广场，脑中忽然响起提示音。

是伏向军在紧急联系他。

商非凡顺手打开通信页面查看。

而阿呆直到此时才注意到他身处的地方似乎有点不对劲。

这里是彭石城的某个广场？

那尊雕像是什么？

为什么他和他商爸会站在一个蓝色的光圈中。

“老大，内部消息！天残谷主刚刚秘密发布一个只针对高玩的精英任务，悬赏高玩偷袭拉斐尔郎沐，要取他身上那枚石耳。现在已经有十二名高玩接收任务，并即将通过就在金麦城的玩家的召唤技能过去，估计要不了多久就能到达莫约镇。这还只是第一批。以上消息诚惠五金。”

艹！商非凡脸色瞬间变黑。这是想要接近勾搭不成，就换成偷袭？这个洛伦米尔顿怎么就这么下作？他就不敢正大光明地跟他们正面杠吗？而且还把自己藏到幕后，只敢让玩家来。

阿呆敏锐地察觉到商非凡的情绪变化，仰起小脸：“商爸？”

“计划有变。”商非凡深吸一口气压下怒火，“我们先回莫约镇。”

虽然对郎沐的实力很有信心，但想到玩家不死不灭的特性，还有为任务奖励可以六亲不认的肝劲，商非凡就觉得一阵烦躁。

这就是纯骚扰的恶心人战术，我打不过，烦也要烦死你。如果能幸运打死郎沐，那就是大赚。打不死，那死的也都是玩家。反正玩家嘛，费点材料和能量，三天后又是一条好汉！

看来干死谁都要先干死洛伦米尔顿，否则两人恐怕无法安心做好任何事情。

原本他们就想着要去天残谷找麻烦，但途中要经过黑水荒原，就想着先给郎家人选好发展基地，正好又碰到大量不死尸的事，只能再挪出一点时间来解决黑水荒原的岩浆爆发。

可现在商非凡不想等了，洛伦米尔顿就是个贱人，必须先料理！

“爸爸，是莫约镇还是阿沐爸爸那里出事了？”阿呆着急地立起身体。

“还没有出事，但也快了。”商非凡心中迅速做下决定。

郎沐可以自保，但玩家疯起来，就怕波及到无辜的莫约镇民。毕竟在玩家眼中，那些都是黄名NPC，能打。

“儿子，我们先回莫约镇支援你郎沐爸爸他们。”

“好！”阿呆毫不犹豫。

比起报仇，他更在意两个爸爸和对他好的现在还活着的人。

而且爸爸已经告诉他那个坏蛋享受的开胃草是什么内容，与其现在就跑去杀死对方，还不如让对方多“享受”几天。

“那个埃比尼泽先不急着处理他。”商非凡冷笑，“相信我，他现在活着绝对比死更难受。”

无法得到充足睡眠，一睡着就会做噩梦。再是什么厉害人物也经受不了这样的折磨。

“嗯！”阿呆也不想对方死得太痛快。想想他妈妈受了那么多年……不能再想下去，阿呆用力摇头。

商非凡让阿呆继续待在雕像广场中，叮嘱他不要走出蓝色光圈，随后从雕像广场出来，利用隐身道具，当着打瞌睡正在做噩梦的彭石城主面，走出书房。

商非凡来到下水道，找到那具八级不死尸，哥俩好地拍了拍它的肩膀：“你，跟我们走。”

八级不死尸不会说话，也无法理解太复杂的东西，它只知道自己收到了要求跟随头领的指令。

商非凡直接传音给雕像广场中的阿呆，问他现在能带多重多大的死物一起转移。

阿呆也没有明确答案，他只知道自己的天赋能力变强了。但到底强了多少，他也不知道。

商非凡把阿呆掏出来，用黑暗能量裹住他。

闻到活人气息，刚刚抬头的八级不死尸又安静下来。

商非凡一指八级不死尸：“带着它和你爸我，能一起瞬移吗？”

阿呆盯着不死尸看了好一会儿，似乎在估摸对方的实力。

“它是死物，也不算很大，应该可以带上？”不确定的阿呆都不敢给一个句号保证。

“试试。”

试试就试试吧。

阿呆活动了下小爪子，略兴奋地站起来，让他商爸抓住那八级不死尸，他自己则窝在爸爸怀里，开始发动自己的天赋能力。

阿呆眉心的蓝黑色纹路的光线流动越来越快。

“爸爸，抓紧了。”

不过一个眨眼，两人一尸已经站在了莫约镇外的主干道上。

这次的瞬移比以往任何一次都要快，且一次到达目的地。

“好小子！”商非凡惊喜地揉了揉阿呆的脑袋，“你这进步也太大了。”

阿呆骄傲地挺起小胸膛。

莫约镇负责戒备的人也发现了他们。

商非凡示意八级不死尸先进入莫约山中，没有他的吩咐不准出来，这才带着阿呆进入莫约镇。

半天过后，莫约镇外飞来一只很大的热气球。

民兵队长毫不犹豫地一挥手：“射下来！逼他们落入莫约山。”

天空中，正在用望远镜往下看的玩家总觉得自己似乎看到了某些了不得的东西。

“日！这山里面怎么会有那么多人？难道有人要攻打莫约镇？”

“我看看我看看，这就是莫约镇？目标人物就在这里？”

“等等！那真的是战士？我怎么看着……”

“像丧尸对吧。”

“啊哈哈，这世界怎么会有丧尸？我们这个游戏不是兽人基建和给天残争取权力的健康游戏吗？”

“丧尸游戏哪里不健康了？”

“别吵！下面的NPC在射我们！”

“撑开防御！准备攻击！”

“攻击镇民？你疯了？我们的任务是偷袭，目标是拉斐尔郎沐，不是攻打人家镇子。”

“是我们先被攻击了。”

“先降落吧，再找机会摸进这个镇子。该死的破地图，目标人物还要我们自己找，不肯给详细坐标。”

“这可是奖励空间背包的精英级任务，好做才奇怪。”

躲在暗处的郎沐眼看民兵们的弓箭无法射下那个热气球，举起了骨杖。

咒语过后。

原本结实的热气球突然瘪掉。

巨大的热气球连带下面的大篮子一起往莫约山中坠落。

“啊啊啊！坠机坠机！紧急情况！快放救生垫！”

“屁的救生垫。玩重力的大侠赶紧出手啊。我可不想因为摔死三天上不了线！”

“艹！我们要摔进丧尸堆里了！”

“这任务怎么这么难！这哪里是精英级，这根本就是地狱开局！”

轰隆！热气球掉落到莫约山中，正正砸中下方麻木站立的不死尸们。

商非凡下令：“上！零嘴来了。”

那具八级不死尸没动，热气球周边的不死尸一起动了，齐刷刷地看向活物气息传来的大篮子。

好不容易在坠气球中活下来的玩家们一露头就看到被大群准备开餐的丧尸包围了。

十二个高玩，好歹也是玩家排行榜中的精英人物，也不至于一个五十多米的坠落就死翘翘。

有人受伤，赶紧掏出药剂灌入口中。

“准备战斗！”领队脸色严肃。
chunks.englishText:
"Mom acted heartbroken, but suddenly teleported and stabbed the scoundrel. It's a pity she didn't manage to kill him on the spot. The bastard could teleport too; although his speed wasn't as fast as Mom's and his distance wasn't as far, he dodged his vital organs, turning what should have been a fatal strike into a mere flesh wound."

Ah Dai genuinely regretted this, letting out a tiny, soft sigh.

"The bad guy wounded Mom, sealed her innate ability with potions, and locked her in the dungeon, saying she wouldn't be released until she transferred her talent to him."

"The scoundrel also wanted to capture me to threaten Mom, but he couldn't find me, and the fake child he brought along couldn't fool Mom."

"The bad guy tortured Mom in every way imaginable..." This was Ah Dai's own conjecture; Shi Monkey Yue had not gone into excessive detail describing how she was abused.

"Later on, seeing that Mom was stubbornly refusing to transfer her innate ability, the scoundrel tried to forcibly plunder it. But when he attempted the plunder, he discovered that Mom's innate ability had already vanished. The bastard flew into a rage, believing Mom had already transferred her talent to me, and almost killed her right then and there. Yet, out of a desire to torment her, he deliberately spared her life, leaving her 'forgotten' in the dungeon instead. He planned to wait until he caught me, then bring me there to kill me right in front of Mom."

After a long, heavy silence.

"Dad, I want revenge," Ah Dai said earnestly. Though his voice was soft, it carried an unquestionable resolve.

Xiao Fan smiled. "What a coincidence. I just sent that piece of trash a preliminary appetizer a moment ago. As for the main course, you get to decide."

Ah Dai's eyes lit up. "Dad, what was the appetizer? Can I go deliver the main course to him right now? But I definitely can't beat that bad guy in a fight yet. Dad, can you help me pin him down? I'll teleport him and toss him right into a pile of Undead Corpses!"

Xiao Fan laughed heartily, tossing the still-tiny Ah Dai up in the air and catching him. "You bet! In our family, kindness must be repaid with kindness, and grudges must be settled with grudges. Especially when it comes to revenge—never leave it overnight if you can settle it today!"

Ah Dai wrapped his arms tightly around Xiao Fan's neck, a smile that truly belonged to a child finally blooming on his square face. Having been through so much, he knew just how fortunate he was—though he had lost his birth mother, he had gained two fathers who cherished him so dearly.

At this very moment, inside the City Lord's study in Peng Shi City, Ebenezer Stone was being tormented by endless nightmares. He didn't want to sleep, yet he felt overwhelmingly drowsy, yawning constantly. Whenever he let his guard down for even a second, his eyelids would drift shut together.

Yet every single time he closed his eyes, he would see the deceased former City Lord, Shi Monkey Yue, and all the people he had murdered, coming at him one after another to demand his life...

***

### Chapter 232: The Players' Ambush (Part 1)

Xiao Fan was just about to take Ah Dai away from the statue plaza when a notification chime suddenly rang in his mind.

It was Fu Xiangjun making an emergency contact.

Xiao Fan casually opened the communication interface to check.

It was only at this moment that Ah Dai noticed something seemed a bit off about his surroundings.

Where was this? Some plaza in Peng Shi City?

What was that statue?

And why were he and his Shang-dad standing inside a blue circle of light?

"Boss, internal intelligence! The Valley Master of Tian Can just secretly released an elite quest exclusively targeting top-tier players, offering a bounty for players to ambush Raphael Lang Mu and seize the stone ear he carries. Twelve top players have already accepted the quest and are about to teleport over using the summoning skills of players currently stationed in Golden Wheat City. They should arrive in Moyue Town before long. And this is just the first wave. The above intel costs a modest five gold coins."

*Damn it!* Xiao Fan's expression darkened instantly. They couldn't get close through flirtatious scheming, so now they were resorting to sneak attacks? Just how utterly base could this Loren Milton get? Did he not even dare to face them openly and squarely? On top of that, he hid himself behind the scenes, only daring to send players to do his dirty work.

Ah Dai acutely sensed Xiao Fan's emotional shift and raised his small face. "Shang-dad?"

"The plan has changed," Xiao Fan took a deep breath to suppress his anger. "We're heading back to Moyue Town first."

Although he had great confidence in Lang Mu's strength, the thought of the players' undying, resurrecting trait, combined with their grind-heavy tenacity to risk everything for quest rewards, filled Xiao Fan with a wave of irritation.

This was a purely harassing, nauseating tactics strategy: *Even if I can't beat you, I'll annoy you to death.* If they miraculously managed to kill Lang Mu, it would be a massive windfall. If they failed, only players would die anyway. Players were, after all, just cannon fodder; spend a few materials and some energy, and three days later they'd be good as new!

It seemed that to kill anyone else, he first had to kill Loren Milton, otherwise the two of them wouldn't be able to handle anything in peace.

Originally, they had planned to go cause trouble at Tian Can Valley, but since they had to pass through the Black Water Wasteland on the way, they figured they'd first pick a development base for the Lang family. As it happened, they ran into the massive horde of Undead Corpses, forcing them to carve out a bit more time to resolve the magma eruption in the Black Water Wasteland.

Yet right now, Xiao Fan didn't want to wait anymore. Loren Milton was a total scumbag who had to be dealt with first!

"Dad, did something happen back at Moyue Town or with Ah Mu-dad?" Ah Dai asked anxiously, straightening his body.

"Nothing has happened yet, but it's close." Xiao Fan quickly made a decision in his mind.

Lang Mu could protect himself, but once players went crazy, Xiao Fan feared it would endanger the innocent townspeople of Moyue Town. After all, in the eyes of the players, those were merely yellow-name NPCs who could be attacked.

"Son, we're heading back to Moyue Town first to reinforce your Lang Mu-dad and the others."

"Okay!" Ah Dai agreed without a moment's hesitation.

Compared to revenge, he cared far more about his two fathers and the living people who had treated him well.

Besides, his dad had already told him about the nature of the appetizer served to that bad guy. Rather than rushing off to kill him right this second, it was better to let the bastard "enjoy" himself for a few more days.

"We don't need to rush to deal with that Ebenezer just yet," Xiao Fan sneered. "Trust me, staying alive right now is absolute torture for him—far worse than death."

Deprived of proper sleep, plunging into nightmares the moment he fell asleep—no matter how formidable a person was, they couldn't withstand this kind of torment.

"Mn!" Ah Dai didn't want that guy to die too painlessly either. Just thinking about how his mother had suffered for all those years... he couldn't let his mind wander down that path, and shook his head vigorously.

Xiao Fan instructed Ah Dai to stay put inside the statue plaza, warning him not to step out of the blue light circle. Then, emerging from the plaza, he used an invisibility item and walked right out of the study, passing right under the nose of the dozing, nightmare-plagued City Lord of Peng Shi City.

Xiao Fan descended into the sewers, found the Grade-8 Undead Corpse, and patted it on the shoulder like a buddy. "You, come with us."

The Grade-8 Undead Corpse couldn't speak, nor could it comprehend overly complex concepts; it only knew it had received an order to follow its leader.

Xiao Fan directly transmitted a voice message to Ah Dai in the statue plaza, asking him how heavy and large of a lifeless object he could bring along during a teleportation.

Ah Dai didn't have a definitive answer either; he only knew his innate ability had grown stronger. But precisely how much stronger it had become, he had no idea.

Xiao Fan scooped Ah Dai up, wrapping him in dark energy.

Catching the scent of a living human, the Grade-8 Undead Corpse, which had just raised its head, quieted down once more.

Xiao Fan pointed at the Grade-8 Undead Corpse. "Can you teleport together with it, your dad, and me?"

Ah Dai stared at the Undead Corpse for a long while, seemingly estimating its strength.

"It's a dead thing, and it's not very big. We should be able to bring it along?" Unsure of himself, Ah Dai didn't dare give a one-hundred-percent guarantee.

"Let's try."

If we try, we try.

Ah Dai stretched his little claws, stood up with a hint of excitement, and had his Shang-dad grab the Grade-8 Undead Corpse while he snuggled into his father's embrace and began activating his innate ability.

The light of the blue-black patterns between Ah Dai's brows flowed faster and faster.

"Dad, hold on tight."

In merely the blink of an eye, the two humans and one corpse were already standing on the main road outside Moyue Town.

This teleportation was faster than any previous instance, and it reached the destination in a single jump.

"That's my boy!" Xiao Fan pleasantly surprised, ruffled Ah Dai's head. "Your progress is way too fast."

Ah Dai puffed out his small chest proudly.

The guards on duty outside Moyue Town had already spotted them.

Xiao Fan motioned for the Grade-8 Undead Corpse to enter the Moyue Mountains first, strictly commanding it not to emerge without his orders, before bringing Ah Dai into Moyue Town.

Half a day later, a massive hot air balloon flew in from outside Moyue Town.

The militia captain waved his hand without a moment's hesitation. "Shoot it down! Force them to land in the Moyue Mountains."

High up in the sky, players peering down through binoculars felt a nagging sense that they were looking at something extraordinary.

"Holy shit! How are there so many people down in this mountain? Could someone be trying to siege Moyue Town?"

"Let me look, let me look! Is this Moyue Town? Is the target NPC right here?"

"Wait! Are those really warriors? Why do I look at them and see..."

"Like zombies, right?"

"Ahahaha, how could there be zombies in this world? Isn't our game a wholesome game about orc infrastructure building and fighting for power on behalf of Tian Can?"

"What's unhealthy about a zombie game?!"

"Stop arguing! The NPCs below are shooting at us!"

"Raise defenses! Prepare for combat!"

"Attack townspeople? Are you out of your mind? Our quest is an ambush, and the target is Raphael Lang Mu, not laying siege to some random town."

"We're the ones being attacked first."

"Land first, then find an opportunity to sneak into this town. Damn this broken map—we even have to find the target NPC ourselves without being given detailed coordinates."

"This is an elite-tier quest rewarding a spatial backpack, after all. It'd be weird if it were easy."

Hiding in the shadows, Lang Mu watched as the militia's arrows failed to bring down the hot air balloon, and raised his bone staff.

Following an incantation.

The previously sturdy hot air balloon suddenly deflated.

The gigantic hot air balloon, along with the massive basket beneath it, plummeted straight down toward the Moyue Mountains.

"Aahhh! Crash landing, crash landing! Emergency! Deploy the safety cushions fast!"

"Safety cushion my ass! Any experts proficient in gravity magic, cast a spell right now! I don't want to get logged out for three days straight just from taking fall damage!"

"Shit! We're falling right into a nest of zombies!"

"Why is this quest so damn hard?! This isn't an elite tier—this is a bloody Hell difficulty start!"

Boom! The hot air balloon crashed into the Moyue Mountains, landing squarely amidst the numbly standing Undead Corpses below.

Xiao Fan issued an order: "Charge! The snacks have arrived."

The Grade-8 Undead Corpse didn't move, but the surrounding Undead Corpses surged into motion simultaneously, turning their heads in unison toward the giant basket emitting the scent of living flesh.

The players who had narrowly survived the balloon crash poked their heads out, only to find themselves surrounded by a massive horde of zombies ready to chow down.

The twelve top players, elite figures on the player rankings after all, weren't about to kick the bucket simply from a fifty-meter fall.

Those who suffered injuries frantically pulled out potions and chugged them down.

"Prepare for battle!" the team leader's expression turned grim.

chunks.chineseText:
奇怪的是，不死尸们看到这些玩家，进食的欲望并不强烈。

甚至它们只是包围着玩家，并没有立刻扑向玩家。

商非凡正感到奇怪，突然想到阿呆曾经跟他说过的一件事——玩家身上有尸臭。这也是真天残村民怀疑玩家和不死尸有关的原因。

这恐怕也是玩家的最大优点之一，不死尸们把玩家们当同类了，轻易不会攻击玩家。

商非凡抬起左手，黑暗能量涌向那群不死尸，用精神力下令：“攻击！一个都不要放过。”

不死尸们到底还是听从了商非凡的命令，一个个都跟活过来一样急吼吼地扑向玩家们。

经过一番激战。

活下来的玩家减员了三分之二，只有四个人逃出不死尸的包围圈。

这四个人都有自己的秘密武器或特殊能力，他们这一分散逃亡，且都是一逃就没影的，让在一边监视战况的商非凡都不好派遣不死尸跟上去追杀——暂时找不到那四个玩家的行踪。

【需要帮忙标记红名玩家的坐标点吗？一个小时一个贡献点。】

系统冷不丁地冒出来。

“开启！”

四名逃出生天的玩家还不知道自己的坐标已经被另一个游戏系统给暴露，正利用组队功能快速集合。

“只有我们四个了？”

“总不能现在就放弃吧？”

“当然不能。”

还活着的玩家领队拍拍手掌：“记住，我们的任务目标是拉斐尔郎沐，其他都是次要的。我们接下来的重点就是想法子溜入莫约镇，找到目标。据说对方实力极为强大，建议使用风筝战术磨死对方。同时为了避免惊动莫约镇民和他身边的帮手，最好能把他单独引出来。”

“连我们谷主都不是他的对手，我们四个能打过他？”

“和我们谷主打到平手的不是拉斐尔郎沐，是那个阿瑞斯商。”

“不是说我们谷主想要挖阿瑞斯商的墙角，才让阿瑞斯商和他干起来的吗？那个墙角就是拉斐尔郎沐吧？”

“啧啧，这就是爱而不得，宁可毁掉也不愿意把人留给自己的情敌。”

“喂，别把我们谷主说得像是恶毒配角一样好不好？那我们是什么？恶毒配角的狗腿子打手？”

“空间背包……”领队幽幽提醒。

另外三人回神。

对哦，就是一个游戏，那么上纲上线干嘛？现在还是获得背包最重要！

领队又开始进行战术指导：

“不行就引到这里，让这些丧尸对付他。我们就可以躲起来捡便宜。”

“这也是一个方法。”大家从善如流，“那就把人尽量往这边引。”

“要么我们也可以引这些丧尸去攻击目标。”

“要把丧尸引入镇子吗？这不好吧，感觉更像恶毒配角了。”

“说不定这些丧尸都是莫约镇人养着的呢？”

“怎么可能？你会在自家门口养一群只会对活物流口水的丧尸？”

“这可是游戏世界，谁知道呢。说不定莫约镇里面的镇民已经开始丧尸化。”

一人眼睛一亮：“你们说我们会不会进入了重要节点？这个莫约镇以后会不会变成一个副本？你们不觉得很像吗？不知道是什么缘故，整个镇子的镇民都开始神秘丧尸化，我们先打丧尸，然后就是探索镇民丧尸化以及镇子外山里丧尸的由来，以及帮助镇民如何恢复正常……实际上无论我们怎么拯救和帮忙，这个镇子都会被丧尸化，而原因和真凶就是拥有石耳的拉斐尔郎沐！”

“哇，感觉一下就说通了，这大概就说传说中的副本背景。真有这种可能。”

领队忽然抬手戳了戳旁边说话的玩家。

“干嘛？副本开了好。以后终于有刷级刷装备刷技能书的地方了。这个破游戏想升级、想学技能，真他么太难了。如果不是全息，老子早不……呃。”

领队又戳另一个玩家。

“你戳我干什么？那个死亡惩罚三天真的应该取消。否则我们现在就是满员开荒新副本，说不定运气好能一次通关。第一次通关的奖励都很丰厚！卧槽！”

四名玩家齐齐转头。

一具身体极为削瘦、身着残破铠甲的独眼不死尸就站在他们身后。

缺少了眼球的黑洞洞眼眶盯着他们，也不知在他们身后站了多久。

四个玩家下意识拔腿就要跑。

“这就一个！”领队反应最快，高喊：“我们一起上，干掉它！”

四名玩家不跑了，反过来包围住这个古怪的独眼不死尸。

“我怎么感觉这位丧尸兄很像是高手？”

这位玩家大哥没有猜错，结果在一分钟后就给了他们答案。

剩下的四名玩家全灭。

这具八级不死尸嗅了嗅这四具尸体，拒绝进食。

它只吃活的血肉，不吃死的。就算这四具尸体能量还算丰富，也不要。

莫约镇和玩家们的第一场战斗到此结束。

第一战，玩家们完败！

通过玩家笔记本系统，虽然相隔千万里，天残谷主还是飞快收到了最新消息。

虽然没有真的指望就一批十二个连五级都没有的玩家就能杀死拉斐尔郎沐拿到石耳，但看到他们死得这么快，天残谷主还是觉得这些玩家有点不堪大用。

也许应该减少死亡惩罚时间？

如果可以，天残谷主一点都不想耽误玩家们的复活，他恨不得玩家们死了就能立刻爬起来。

可是游戏中的死亡会让游戏系统判断玩家必须下线，这是为了保护玩家的大脑，避免玩家真的以为自己死亡，然后大脑就也以为自己真的死了。

所以一旦有死亡伤害发生，玩家实际还没有体会到，游戏系统已经先一步认为玩家死了，该下线了。

而玩家一旦下线，想要再次联系到自己的玩家身体就需要更多能量。

如果那具玩家身体还遭到损毁，修复和重生那具身体更需要大量能量和材料。

三天的死亡惩罚已经是他跟系统讨价还价后限定的最低标准。

换言之，玩家“死亡”掉线必须要花三天时间来累积精神力才能再次连上游戏系统。

同样，玩家的新身体也需要三天时间才能再次生成。

“玩家碰到不死尸，这是巧合还是有意安排？”

天残谷主本来就是爱多思的人，这会儿更是思考良久。

“不管是巧合，还是有意安排……”天残谷主忽然露出了一个绝美的笑容。

当即就发布了一个新的任务。

任务内容：为了全天下兽人能安稳生活，不再陷入新的黑暗纪元。请调查莫约镇附近出现上万不死尸的原因，同时调查不死尸的出现是否和拉斐尔郎沐以及阿瑞斯商有关。如发现任何证据，请立刻联系八卦报，把这条消息公布出去。

除了这个任务，上一个把拉斐尔郎沐当做boss刷的任务依旧继续。
chunks.englishText:
Oddly enough, the Undead Corpses didn't seem to harbor any strong desire to feed when they laid eyes on these players.

In fact, they merely surrounded the players without immediately pouncing on them.

As Shang Feifan was trying to make sense of this, he suddenly recalled something A-Dai had once told him—the players carried a distinct stench of corpses. This was precisely the reason why the villagers of True Remnant Village had suspected the players of having ties to the Undead Corpses.

This was likely one of the players' greatest advantages: the Undead Corpses mistook them for their own kind and wouldn't attack them without provocation.

Shang Feifan raised his left hand, dark energy surging toward the group of Undead Corpses as he issued a mental command: *“Attack! Don’t let a single one of them escape.”*

Ultimately, the Undead Corpses still obeyed Shang Feifan's command. Springing to life one by one, they rushed eagerly toward the players.

After a fierce battle.

Two-thirds of the surviving players were wiped out, with only four managing to escape the encirclement of the Undead Corpses.

All four of these individuals possessed their own secret weapons or special abilities. Once they scattered and fled, vanishing into thin air, even Shang Feifan—who had been monitoring the battle from the sidelines—found it difficult to dispatch Undead Corpses to hunt them down, as he temporarily lost track of their whereabouts.

[Would you like help marking the coordinates of the red-named players? One contribution point per hour.]

The system chimed in out of nowhere.

“Activate!”

The four players who had cheated death were still completely unaware that their coordinates had been exposed by another gaming system as they hurriedly regrouped using the party function.

“Is there only four of us left?”

“We can’t just give up now, can we?”

“Of course not.”

The surviving player team leader clapped his hands. “Remember, our objective is Raphael Lang Mu; everything else is secondary. Our main priority going forward is to figure out a way to sneak into Moyue Town and find our target. Word has it that the guy is exceptionally powerful, so it’s recommended we use kiting tactics to wear him down. At the same time, to avoid alerting the townspeople of Moyue Town and his personal helpers, it would be best to lure him out alone.”

“Even our Valley Master isn’t a match for him. Can the four of us take him down?”

“The one who fought our Valley Master to a draw wasn’t Raphael Lang Mu; it was that Ares Shang.”

“Didn’t they say our Valley Master wanted to poach Ares Shang’s man, which is why Ares Shang started beefing with him? That person being poached must be Raphael Lang Mu, right?”

“Tsk tsk, this is classic unrequited love—rather than letting his rival keep the person, he’d rather destroy them.”

“Hey, don’t make our Valley Master sound like some vicious villain’s lackey, alright? What does that make us? The vicious villain’s toadies and thugs?”

“Spatial inventory…” the team leader reminded them quietly.

The other three snapped back to reality.

Oh right, it was just a game; why get so worked up over nothing? Right now, securing that inventory bag was what mattered most!

The team leader resumed his tactical guidance:

“If all else fails, we lure him here and let these zombies deal with him. That way, we can hide and reap the rewards.”

“That’s one option.” Everyone readily agreed. “Then let’s lure him this way as much as possible.”

“Or alternatively, we could lead these zombies to attack the target.”

“You want to lead zombies into the town? That’s not a great idea, is it? It’s starting to sound even more like something a villain would do.”

“Who knows, maybe these zombies were raised by the people of Moyue Town in the first place?”

“How is that even possible? Would you raise a pack of zombies right on your own doorstep that do nothing but drool over living creatures?”

“This is a gaming world, who knows? Maybe the townsfolk inside Moyue Town are already starting to zombiefy.”

One of them’s eyes lit up: “Do you think we’ve triggered a major plot node? Will this Moyue Town turn into a dungeon instance later on? Doesn’t it feel a lot like one? For some unknown reason, the entire town’s residents are mysteriously starting to zombiefy. First, we fight the zombies, then we investigate the origin of the townspeople’s zombiefication and the zombies in the mountains outside, and finally help the residents return to normal... But in reality, no matter how we try to save and help them, the town is doomed to be zombiefied, and the root cause and ultimate culprit is Raphael Lang Mu, who holds the stone fungus!”

“Whoa, it all suddenly makes sense! This must be that legendary dungeon lore. There's a real possibility of that.”

The team leader suddenly reached out and poked the player speaking beside him.

“What? Dungeon instances opening up is a great thing. Finally, there’ll be a place to grind levels, gear, and skill books. It is so damn hard to level up and learn skills in this crappy game. If it wasn’t full-dive VR, I’d have long since... ugh.”

The team leader poked another player.

“Why are you poking me? That three-day death penalty really ought to be canceled. Otherwise, we’d be running a brand-new dungeon with a full roster right now, and with a bit of luck, we might clear it on the first try. First-clear rewards are always super generous! What the—!”

All four players whipped their heads around.

A one-eyed Undead Corpse with an emaciated frame and battered armor was standing right behind them.

Its hollow, missing-eyed socket stared straight at them, though nobody knew how long it had been standing there at their backs.

Instinctively, the four players turned tail to run.

“There’s only one!” The team leader reacted the fastest, shouting: “Let’s all rush him and take him down!”

The four players stopped running and instead turned around to surround this bizarre, one-eyed Undead Corpse.

“Why do I have a feeling this zombie bro might actually be a high-tier boss?”

This player's guess wasn't wrong, and the result provided them with an answer just one minute later.

The remaining four players were completely wiped out.

This Grade 8 Undead Corpse sniffed the four corpses and refused to feed.

It only ate living flesh and blood; it didn’t touch the dead. Even if the energy within these four corpses was reasonably abundant, it didn't want them.

And thus concluded the first battle between Moyue Town and the players.

In this opening skirmish, the players suffered a total defeat!

Through the Player Notebook system, despite being separated by thousands of miles, the True Remnant Valley Master swiftly received the latest update.

Although he hadn't truly expected a batch of twelve players who hadn't even reached Level 5 to assassinate Raphael Lang Mu and secure the stone fungus, seeing them die so quickly still made the True Remnant Valley Master feel that these players were somewhat useless.

Perhaps he should shorten the death penalty duration?

If he could, the True Remnant Valley Master wouldn't want to delay the players' respawn times by even a second—he wished the players could leap right back up the moment they died.

However, death in the game caused the gaming system to determine that the player must log off. This was to protect the player's brain, preventing them from genuinely believing they had died and causing their brain to assume they were actually dead as well.

Therefore, the moment fatal damage occurred, before the player could even experience it, the gaming system had already preemptively decided that the player was dead and needed to be logged off.

And once a player logged off, reconnecting with their player body required a greater expenditure of energy.

If that player body happened to be damaged, repairing and regenerating it demanded an even larger amount of energy and materials.

The three-day death penalty was the absolute minimum standard he had managed to negotiate with the system.

In other words, a player's "death" and disconnection required three days of accumulated mental energy to re-establish a connection with the gaming system.

Similarly, a player's new body also needed three days to regenerate.

*“The players ran into the Undead Corpses—was this a coincidence or an intentional arrangement?”*

The True Remnant Valley Master was naturally an overthinker, and at this moment, he fell into deep contemplation for a long while.

*“Whether it’s a coincidence or intentional…”* The True Remnant Valley Master suddenly broke into an exquisitely stunning smile.

He immediately issued a new quest.

Quest Details: For the peaceful survival of all beasts across the realm, so that they may never again fall into a new Dark Age, please investigate the cause behind the emergence of tens of thousands of Undead Corpses near Moyue Town. At the same time, investigate whether the appearance of the Undead Corpses is connected to Raphael Lang Mu and Ares Shang. Should you discover any concrete evidence, please contact the Gossip Gazette immediately and make this information public.

Aside from this quest, the previous mission—which treated Raphael Lang Mu as a boss to be farmed—remained active.
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第233章 阿呆衣锦还乡 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第233章 阿呆衣锦还乡

商非凡正在和郎沐说话，主要就是说阿呆的身世。

郎沐抱着阿呆，下意识轻轻抚摸他的背。原本他就很喜欢阿呆，这时听到阿呆凄惨身世，更是心怀怜惜。

阿呆脑袋埋进郎沐怀里：呜呜，阿爸~

商非凡：他是不是吸收这小子身上负能量太多了。这小子明明就是在假哭！

不过提到石狲悦，阿呆是真伤心了。他虽然没有见过这位生育他的母亲，但对方对他的拳拳爱意，他还是感受到了。

他妈妈真的被坏人骗得太惨！

他恨死那个大坏蛋了！

光球冒出来，示意商非凡看系统。

系统又小小更新了一下，现在只要那边发布关于商、郎两人的任务，它这边都会即时接收到。

看着光球转发过来的玩家系统上最新发布的任务通知，商非凡发出一声嗤笑。

郎沐用眼神问：怎么？

商非凡直接就把任务内容转述给郎沐。

“洛伦米尔顿这是要把我和你这一方塑造成大反派？不但想让玩家对付我们，还想把我们推到整个兽人的对立面？”郎沐立刻回过味来。

商非凡：“不要怀疑人渣的下限。”

如果他们没有提防，真的让洛伦米尔顿阴谋得逞，不说兽人大陆的全体兽人，就算他和郎沐两人现在都已经达到法神级别，也能被玩家不死不灭的特性活活耗死。

到时候他们就什么事都别想做了，光跟玩家纠缠吧。

阿呆趴在郎沐怀里，好奇地问：“阿爸，洛伦米尔顿是谁？”

小家伙完全没注意到一个光球就飘浮在他头顶上方一点点。

"一个人渣。就是当年骗你沐爸宝物还差点害死他的人。"商非凡抢先说道。

郎沐：“……”

阿呆愤怒，立身挥爪：“爸爸，干他！”

“那是肯定。”商非凡捏捏阿呆的小爪子：“儿砸，再跟你爸我跑一趟，我们不能这么被动挨打。”

“好！到哪里？没去过的地方，我可能……”

“是你去过的地方，天残谷。”

“我们是要回去天残村吗？”阿呆兴奋了，他巴不得能帮到两个爸爸。更有亿点点想要衣锦还乡的强烈冲动——看，我现在和两个爸爸过得多好，我阿呆也是有人疼爱当宝贝的！

商非凡乐，小家伙的神情太容易看懂。

“你还记得我带你去的那个一号营地吗？就是从天残村出来后，在天残谷外面那些你说身上有尸臭的天残兽人聚集地。”

“记得。”

“我们就去那里。”

阿呆正要答应，又小小迟疑：“爸爸，我不知道能不能一次就瞬移到那里。”

“没事，你能到哪儿就到哪儿，我会把地图拿给你看。”

郎沐看这父子俩有了决定，迟疑，他也很想和商非凡一起去会会洛伦米尔顿，早点结束这场恩怨。但是岩浆的事也得尽快解决，还有郎家选址的事。

商非凡目光和郎沐对上，他也不想和阿沐分开！

不过嘴里说出的却是：“时间紧急。我们先分头行事。阿沐你留下勘探黑水荒原哪里适合作为岩浆的引流池和泄流渠。等你确定下来，我就能命令那些不死尸开挖。这边，我带阿呆先去给那边找点麻烦转移他们的注意力。战场嘛，当然要放到敌人家里。”

郎沐知道商非凡就是想要立刻报复，这家伙睚眦必报得很，吃不得半点亏，能当场报仇就不会隔夜。

想让老商吃亏，得看是什么人。就算是他，老商表面什么都让着他，实际上还不是在……咳！

正经事！他们现在正在谈正经事！郎沐脸红，从脑海中挥去那些乱七八糟的。

商非凡突然挠了挠他的手掌心。

郎沐：“……”

阿呆看看两个爸爸，把自己的方脑袋也放到了他沐爸的手掌心上。

郎沐注意力被转移，满心怜爱地轻轻揉了揉阿呆的方脑袋。

商非凡盯某小呆货。

阿呆：忽然有点冷是肿么回事？

“事不宜迟，该走了。”商非凡一把拎过阿呆。

郎沐点头，也跟着起身。

两人说好，由郎沐去和镇长解说情况，商非凡这边就带着阿呆……不对，是阿呆带着他商爸当场就瞬移走了。

在这之前，商非凡还特意询问光球，是否能把不死尸装入雕像广场。

光球似乎已经预测到商非凡会这么做，秒答：【请放入指定位置。】

商非凡没故意找麻烦，感知到距离雕像最远的一块空地被蓝光圈起，当即就进入莫约山，把藏在莫约山中的所有不死尸全都装入广场，包括那具八级不死尸。

洛伦米尔顿不是派玩家来调查不死尸吗？

他把不死尸全部收走，他倒要看看玩家能查出什么。

哦，他还是给玩家留下了一点线索，如果真有善于侦查的玩家，也许能顺着线索摸到彭石城。

彭石城对外太闭塞，就应该让玩家们过去给他们热闹热闹，顺便还能帮助玩家推进任务。

他可真是大好人。

中途，阿呆只休息了一次。

阿呆对天残村印象深刻，完全没考虑自己会找错方向。

商非凡落到中转点时，仔细打量周围，发现有点眼熟。

这里似乎接近摩罗城，但距离摩罗城还有上百里远。

商非凡看到眼熟的村落，想起自己就是在这里开启了草药师这个职业。

草药师和药剂师不同，按照兽人世界的技术划分来看，草药师只是最初级的药师，也就是只能把一些药草和能入药的物品进行初步处理，进而制作成膏药、药汤、药粉。

而药剂师则更为精细和科学，按照商非凡的理解，就是进化到化学分子提炼，可以把药材中的“精华”经过各种搭配，研制成药效更好、更神奇的药剂。

为什么不炼制成药丸药片，大概是觉得液体更好吸收？药性和药效也能保持最佳？

商非凡现在也接触了一点药剂学，他有种微妙的感觉，觉得液体药剂可能更适合精神力深入。

而药剂师制作药剂时确实需要良好的精神力进行辅佐。

闲话不多说，商非凡给阿呆灌了恢复药剂，又问他饿不饿、渴不渴。

阿呆觉得自己能量并没有动用多少，但他商爸非让他喝，他就喝吧。

反正用他商爸的话来说，就是他们家喝得起。

再次瞬移，这次就直接来到了天残谷。

“可惜狰爷这次没能同来。”

商非凡看到林子里一只大大的巨蟹虫，感叹道。

“爸爸，你是要利用那些不死尸对付欺骗阿爸的坏蛋和他的打手们吗？”阿呆忽然问。

商非凡低头：“对。”

阿呆有点点忧心，踌躇说：“爸爸，那你能让那些不死尸不伤害村子里的人吗？”

商非凡笑起来：“当然。不过我们需要先跟村子里的人打个招呼，这段时间让他们暂时不要离开村子。”

“还有巨蟹虫和这里的其他生物。”阿呆又补充。

商非凡拍了便宜儿子一巴掌：“你把你爸当什么了。行了，你爸我有数。”

不久，阿呆预想的衣锦还乡小目标完美达成。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 233: A-Dai Returns Home in Glory

Shang Feifan was currently conversing with Lang Mu, primarily discussing A-Dai’s background.

Holding A-Dai in his arms, Lang Mu subconsciously stroked the little fellow's back gently. He had always been fond of A-Dai to begin with, and upon hearing the tragic story of the child's origins, his heart overflowed with even greater pity and affection.

A-Dai buried his head into Lang Mu's embrace: *Wuwu, Abba~*

Shang Feifan: *Is he absorbing too much negative energy from this brat? The kid is clearly fake-crying!*

However, when Shi Sunyue was mentioned, A-Dai's grief was genuine. Though he had never laid eyes on the mother who gave birth to him, he could still vividly feel the boundless, fierce love she held for him.

His mother had truly been deceived and wronged to a miserable degree by those wicked people!

He hated that big scumbag to the bone!

A glowing orb popped out, signaling Shang Feifan to check the system.

The system had undergone a minor update; from now on, whenever quests concerning Shang and Lang were published over on that end, his side would receive instant updates.

Glancing at the newly issued quest notifications on the player system forwarded by the glowing orb, Shang Feifan let out a scoff.

Lang Mu asked with his eyes: *What is it?*

Shang Feifan directly relayed the quest contents to Lang Mu.

“Is Lauren Milton trying to cast you and me as the ultimate villains? Not only does he want the players to deal with us, but he also wants to push us into standing in opposition to all the beastmen?” Lang Mu caught on immediately.

Shang Feifan: “Never underestimate the moral floor of a scumbag.”

If they hadn't been on guard and truly let Lauren Milton's conspiracy succeed, leave aside all the beastmen of the Beastman Continent—even though he and Lang Mu had both reached the Divine Mage level, they could still be worn down and ground to death by the players' endless, undying nature.

By then, they wouldn't be able to accomplish anything else; they'd just be stuck tangling with players forever.

Crouched in Lang Mu's arms, A-Dai asked curiously: “Abba, who is Lauren Milton?”

The little fellow completely failed to notice a glowing orb floating right above his head.

"A scumbag. The guy who swindled your Mu-ba's treasures back then and almost killed him," Shang Feifan answered preemptively.

Lang Mu: “…”

Filled with righteous indignation, A-Dai stood up in his embrace and waved his little claws: “Dad, go kick his ass!”

“That goes without saying.” Shang Feifan pinched A-Dai’s little claws: “Son, run another errand with your dad. We can’t just sit here passively and take hits.”

“Okay! Where to? If it's a place I've never been to, I might...”

“It’s a place you have been to—True Remnant Valley.”

“Are we going back to True Remnant Village?” A-Dai was thrilled; he was more than eager to lend his two dads a hand. Moreover, he possessed an overwhelmingly strong impulse to return home in glory—*Look, see how well I'm doing with my two dads now! I, A-Dai, am also someone who is cherished and treasured!*

Shang Feifan chuckled, the little fellow's expressions were just too easy to read.

“Do you remember Camp No. 1 that I took you to? It’s that gathering place of True Remnant beastmen outside True Remnant Valley, the ones you said smelled like corpses after we left the village.”

“I remember.”

“That’s where we’re going.”

Just as A-Dai was about to agree, he hesitated slightly: “Dad, I don't know if I can teleport straight there in one go.”

“No worries, just teleport as far as you can manage, I'll provide you with the map.”

Watching this father-son pair reach a decision, Lang Mu hesitated. He was also very eager to go with Shang Feifan to confront Lauren Milton and put an end to this old grudge sooner. However, the magma issue needed to be resolved as quickly as possible, not to mention selecting a new site for the Lang family.

Shang Feifan’s gaze met Lang Mu’s, and truth be told, he didn't want to be separated from A-Mu either!

Yet the words that slipped from his mouth were: “Time is of the essence. Let’s split up and handle things separately. A-Mu, you stay behind to survey the Blackwater Wasteland and find a suitable location for the magma diversion pools and drainage channels. Once you finalize it, I can order those Undead Corpses to start digging. As for this side, I’ll take A-Dai ahead to stir up some trouble and divert their attention. A battlefield, naturally, should be brought straight to the enemy's doorstep.”

Lang Mu knew Shang Feifan simply wanted immediate payback; this fellow was petty to a fault and couldn't stomach even the slightest grievance, preferring to settle scores on the spot rather than waiting overnight.

Making old Shang suffer depended entirely on who you were. Even when it came to him—though Old Shang yielded to him on the surface in everything, wasn't he secretly... *cough!*

Serious business! They were discussing serious business right now! Lang Mu blushed, forcefully sweeping those messy thoughts out of his mind.

Shang Feifan suddenly scratched the palm of his hand.

Lang Mu: “…”

A-Dai looked between his two dads, then placed his own blocky head right into his Mu-ba’s palm.

Lang Mu's attention was instantly diverted, and he lovingly rubbed A-Dai’s blocky head.

Shang Feifan glared at the little blockhead.

A-Dai: *Why do I suddenly feel a bit chilly?*

“No time to waste, we should get going.” Shang Feifan scooped up A-Dai.

Lang Mu nodded and rose to his feet as well.

The two agreed that Lang Mu would stay behind to explain the situation to the town mayor, while Shang Feifan took A-Dai... no, rather, A-Dai would take his Shang-ba and teleport away on the spot.

Before doing so, Shang Feifan specifically asked the glowing orb whether the Undead Corpses could be packed into the statue plaza.

The glowing orb seemed to have anticipated that Shang Feifan would pull this stunt and replied instantly: [Please place them in the designated location.]

Without intentionally stirring up trouble, Shang Feifan sensed the patch of open ground furthest from the statue encircled in blue light, and immediately entered Moyue Mountain, packing every single Undead Corpse hidden within the mountain—including the Grade 8 one—into the plaza.

Didn't Lauren Milton send players to investigate the Undead Corpses?

Since he was taking all the Undead Corpses away, he'd love to see what on earth the players could possibly uncover.

Oh, he did leave a few clues behind for the players; if any of them truly excelled at scouting, they might just follow the trail all the way to Pengshi City.

Pengshi City was far too closed off to the outside world; it was high time the players went over there to liven things up and simultaneously help them advance their quests.

He truly was a wonderful person.

Halfway through their journey, A-Dai only needed to rest once.

A-Dai held a profound impression of True Remnant Village and didn't even entertain the thought that he might pick the wrong direction.

When Shang Feifan landed at their transit point, he took a careful look around and found his surroundings somewhat familiar.

This place seemed close to Moluo City, yet still a hundred miles away from it.

Spotting the familiar village, Shang Feifan remembered that it was right here where he had unlocked the Herbalist profession.

Herbalists were different from Pharmacists; according to the technical classifications of the beastman world, Herbalists were merely introductory-level practitioners who could only perform preliminary processing on herbs and ingredients, turning them into plasters, medicinal broths, and powders.

Pharmacists, on the other hand, were far more refined and scientific. In Shang Feifan's understanding, it had evolved into something akin to chemical molecular extraction, capable of blending the "essences" of medicinal ingredients through various combinations to formulate potions with superior efficacy and miraculous properties.

Why didn't they refine them into pills or tablets? Perhaps because they felt liquids were easier to absorb, while also bestowing optimal medicinal properties and effectiveness?

Shang Feifan had also come into contact with a bit of pharmacology by now, and he harbored a subtle intuition that liquid potions might be more attuned to deep spiritual immersion.

And indeed, pharmacists required sound mental power to assist them when concocting potions.

Without further ado, Shang Feifan made A-Dai chug a recovery potion, then asked if he was hungry or thirsty.

A-Dai felt he hadn't expended much energy at all, but since his Shang-ba insisted he drink it, drink it he would.

Besides, in his Shang-ba's own words—their family could easily afford it.

Teleporting once more, this time they arrived straight at True Remnant Valley.

“What a pity Lord Frenzy couldn't come along this time.”

Catching sight of a massive giant hermit crab in the woods, Shang Feifan muttered with a sigh of regret.

“Dad, are you going to use those Undead Corpses to deal with the bad guy who lied to Abba and his thugs?” A-Dai suddenly asked.

Shang Feifan lowered his head: “Right.”

A-Dai felt a tinge of worry and hesitated before saying, “Dad, can you make those Undead Corpses not hurt the people in the village?”

Shang Feifan burst into laughter: “Of course. But we need to give the villagers a heads-up first and tell them not to leave the village for the time being.”

“And the giant hermit crabs and other creatures here too,” A-Dai added.

Shang Feifan smacked his unbiological son upside the head: “What do you take your dad for? All right, your old man knows what he's doing.”

Before long, A-Dai's minor objective of returning home in glorious fashion was flawlessly achieved.
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第233章 阿呆衣锦还乡 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
他爸带着他进入天残村。

实际上，他们刚在林子里现出身影，没多久，就有人发现他们。

这里的巨虫可是和天残村民关系很好，相当于天残村的第一道警戒线。

巨虫先发现两人，很快就通知了防守的村民。

防守村民之一就是当初送商非凡他们离开的鳞片兽人。

对方看到商非凡和阿呆，呆愣两秒，脱口惊呼：“阿呆？诺曼兄弟？”

阿呆的方脑袋特征太明显，加上他标志性的呆呆模样，虽然阿呆和出村那会儿的区别非常大，鳞片兽人还是把他认出来了。

阿呆抬起小爪子。

“你们怎么又回来了？”鳞片兽人抓着镰刀走过来。

不会是这个叫诺曼的修理商不想要阿呆了吧？

鳞片兽人看到阿呆现今的模样，还有他身上穿着的小衣服、戴着的佩饰，把溜到嘴边的话又咽了回去。

“兄弟，好久不见。我正好路过这边办事，阿呆想念你们，就顺便带他过来看望村人。”商非凡扬起笑容。

鳞片兽人也跟着笑起来，“看样子阿呆过得不错。你这是把他带在身边了吗？”

“嗯，我爱人很喜欢他，现在阿呆就是我和我爱人的孩子。”商非凡坦然回。

阿呆骄傲地挺起胸膛。看到没有，我的小衣服还是曾奶奶给我做的。

这下不止鳞片兽人，连另一个陌生脸的强壮兽人也露出笑容：“阿呆好福气。”

阿呆算是村子里走出去的自己人，商非凡也曾给村子做过好用的工具，再想到商非凡修理商的身份，鳞片兽人热情洋溢地把一大一小带入村里，一路不断询问阿呆在外面过得怎么样。

当着人家养父的面，问小孩在外面过得怎么样，有点过于……直率。

但商非凡不在乎，他虽然没有一直把阿呆带在身边，养得也不算精细，但他自认待阿呆不亏。

阿呆本来就是抱着炫耀的心回来的，不但在出发时小心机地换上了曾奶奶最新给他做的小衣服，还戴上了爸爸送给他的各种炼金道具——表面看这些炼金物品都只是佩饰。

这会儿鳞片兽人问他过得怎么样，他也没说太多，就很矜持地说天天吃肉以及上学，还有镇子上的人待他都很好。

鳞片兽人听得直为小家伙高兴。

他们村里也有些小家伙好运被人带走，但因为这些小家伙基本不会再回来，他们也不知道被带走的幼崽过得怎么样。

阿呆算是近些年唯一一个被带走后又回来的小幼崽。

其实不用多询问，只看小幼崽长得肉墩墩还皮毛光滑的小模样，就知道过得很不错。

最主要的是，阿呆和修理商爸爸之间的亲密，眼睛不瞎都能看得出来。小家伙显然很黏很喜欢他这个修理商爸爸，全身心都写满了依赖和信任。

这种发自内心的感情是骗不了人的，伪装不出来。

还有修理商对阿呆也一看就是抱习惯的，那神情也是对自己孩子的随意又自然亲密的神情。

他们兽人可不兴经常抱着幼崽。只要幼崽四肢能立起来，能走能跑，大人们大多都不会再抱着不放。

鳞片兽人甚至还想：这个小阿呆被养得有点娇气了，得跟他修理商爸爸说，他们兽人就得粗着点来。

阿呆跳到他商爸的肩膀上，一路招摇（他自认）地进入天残村。

这会儿还是大白天，又是初冬时节，村民不用忙活田地里的事情，很多人都在趁还没有上冻的这段时间修缮房屋和器具等。

阿呆和商非凡的到来，自然有很多村民看见。

大人还好，小孩跟了一路。

村子里太少有陌生人过来，小幼崽们特别好奇。

听到小幼崽的呼喊声、好奇的询问声，阿呆高高扬起方脑袋，满眼睥睨地扫向那群幼崽：一群渣渣，现在只能仰望小爷我！

阿呆也有点记仇的。

这些幼崽都欺负过他，他都记得。

虽然不至于报复他们，但他可以馋馋这些“仇家”。

阿呆从容地抬起一个爪子，从另一个箍着手镯的前腿上扫过。

阿呆摸出一块奶糖，慢慢地放入口中。

糟！奶糖太小，还散不出味，选择错误。

不过奶糖真好吃啊。

阿呆吧唧着奶糖，没舍得立刻咽下肚。

下面跟着跑的一群小幼崽简直要好奇死了。

这个方脑袋幼崽是谁？

为什么他们像是认识又不像是认识？

这一大一小来村里干什么？

还有那个方脑袋身上穿着的小衣服为什么看起来那么好看？明明他自己身上就有毛，竟然还额外穿毛衣服！

还有他刚才吃的是什么呀？

看起来吃得好香啊。

“你是谁呀？为什么来我们村呀？”有小幼崽忍不住，问了出来。

阿呆不回答，任由那些小幼崽追着他和他商爸跑。

看到这一幕的成年兽人们：“……”

阿呆咽下奶糖，为了炫耀，他只能忍痛吞掉奶糖不细品了。

小爪子一晃，这次摸出了一个大鸡腿。

可惜爸爸炼制的空间手镯还不能保温，否则刚做好的时候拿出来那才叫一个香喷喷！

但现在这样也可以啦，反正他们兽人绝大多数嗅觉都非常优秀。

阿呆就坐在他爸的肩膀上，用两只小爪子抱着大鸡腿，啊呜一口啃上去。

商非凡还不知道便宜儿砸在表演吃播，只以为小家伙瞬移这么长路程饿了，只侧头睨他：“别把油弄我身上。”

阿呆点头，偷偷又拽出一块曾奶奶给缝的小围兜，把鸡腿放回空间手镯，先给自己系上小兜兜，这才把大鸡腿掏出来继续啃。

一众跟着跑的小幼崽：口水都滴下来啦！

这个方脑袋吃得实在太香了，瞧那个表情，陶醉得哟。

啊，他又拿出一瓶奶。

那是奶吧？他们都闻到特别浓厚的奶香味了，还带着甜味！

阿呆仰头特别豪放地咕咚咕咚灌奶，嘴边喝出一圈奶胡子。

商非凡回过味：儿砸，演得有点过了。

噗嗤，路边有村人笑出来。

“哎？这是不是阿呆？”

“那个高大兽人是不是上次来过的修理商？”

“有修理商来了？太好了，我正好有点东西自己没办法修。”

“修理商带阿呆回来了？难道是……”

“不像。你看阿呆那混蛋样。这是有个富爹，故意来炫耀了。”

成年兽人都看出来啦。

小幼崽们一听那方脑袋竟然是当年斑秃还瘦弱的小呆子，全都大吃一惊：这是阿呆？怎么可能？！

阿呆吃了一个大鸡腿还不够，又拖出来一块他曾奶奶给他亲手做的奶糕，这个可是他最近的最爱。

太香了，太好吃了，这块奶糕，他要慢慢品。

跟着跑的小幼崽们：阿呆竟然有这么多好吃的？

呜哇！爸爸妈妈，我也想吃肉，想要喝奶奶，想要吃糕糕！

“抢他丫的！”一个最大的幼崽跳起来。

阿呆身影一闪，大幼崽扑了个空。

商非凡一把抓住大幼崽的后颈皮。

大幼崽被捏住要害，四肢都缩了起来，只能大喊：“放我下来。”

商非凡随手一丢。
chunks.englishText:
His father led him into the Heavenly Flawed Village.

In truth, the moment their figures emerged in the woods, it didn't take long for someone to spot them.

The giant bugs here had a wonderful relationship with the villagers of the Heavenly Flawed Village, essentially serving as the village's first line of defense.

The giant bugs discovered the two of them first and quickly notified the defending villagers.

One of the defending villagers happened to be the scaled beastman who had seen Shang Feifan and Ah Dai off previously.

Upon seeing Shang Feifan and Ah Dai, the fellow froze for two seconds before blurting out in shock: "Ah Dai? Brother Norman?"

Ah Dai’s square-headed trait was far too distinctive, coupled with his signature dazed expression. Even though Ah Dai looked vastly different from the time he left the village, the scaled beastman still recognized him at a glance.

Ah Dai raised a small paw.

"Why are you back again?" The scaled beastman walked over, clutching a sickle.

Could it be that this repairman named Norman didn't want Ah Dai anymore?

When the scaled beastman noticed Ah Dai’s current appearance—the little clothes he was wearing and the accessories adorning him—he swallowed back the words that had been hovering on the tip of his tongue.

"Brother, long time no see. I happened to be passing through this area on business, and Ah Dai missed you all, so I brought him along to visit the villagers," Shang Feifan said with a smile.

The scaled beastman chuckled along, "It looks like Ah Dai is living quite well. Have you been keeping him by your side all this time?"

"Yeah, my partner likes him very much. Now Ah Dai is the child of both me and my partner," Shang Feifan replied openly.

Ah Dai proudly puffed out his chest. See that? My little clothes were even made for me by Great-Grandma.

At this, not only the scaled beastman, but even another unfamiliar-looking, robust beastman broke into a smile: "Ah Dai has quite the good fortune."

Ah Dai could be considered one of their own who had walked out of the village, and Shang Feifan had previously made useful tools for the village. Remembering Shang Feifan's identity as a repairman, the scaled beastman enthusiastically ushered the adult and the child into the village, continuously inquiring all the way about how Ah Dai had been doing outside.

To ask a child how he was doing outside, right in front of his adoptive father, was a bit too... straightforward.

But Shang Feifan didn't mind. Although he hadn't kept Ah Dai by his side the entire time, and hadn't raised him with excessive delicacy, he felt confident that he hadn't treated Ah Dai poorly.

Ah Dai had returned home specifically to show off. Not only had he schemingly changed into the newest little clothes Great-Grandma had made for him before setting off, but he had also put on all sorts of alchemical items gifted by his father—on the surface, these alchemical items looked merely like decorative accessories.

When the scaled beastman asked him how he was doing, he didn't say too much. Instead, he answered with great poise that he ate meat every day, went to school, and that the people in the town treated him very well.

Hearing this, the scaled beastman was genuinely happy for the little fellow.

There were other little ones in their village who had the good fortune of being taken away by people, but because those little ones basically never came back, they had no way of knowing how the taken cubs were faring.

Ah Dai could be considered the only little cub in recent years who had been taken away and then returned.

Actually, there was no need to ask much more. Just looking at the little cub's plump, chubby stature and smooth fur, one could tell he was living exceptionally well.

Most importantly, the intimacy between Ah Dai and his repairman father was obvious to anyone with eyes. The little fellow clearly clung to and adored his repairman father, his whole being radiating total reliance and trust.

This kind of heartfelt affection couldn't be faked; it couldn't be disguised.

As for the repairman, it was also clear that he was thoroughly used to holding Ah Dai, his expression being that of a father dealing with his own child—casual, effortless, and naturally intimate.

Beastmen weren't usually big on holding their cubs frequently. As soon as a cub's limbs could support it, and it could walk and run, most adults stopped carrying them around.

The scaled beastman even thought to himself: This little Ah Dai has been raised a bit too delicately; I need to tell his repairman father that we beastmen have to be raised a bit more rough-around-the-edges.

Ah Dai hopped onto his Shang-Dad's shoulder, making a grand, strutting entrance (in his own mind) as he entered the Heavenly Flawed Village.

It was still broad daylight and early winter. The villagers didn't have to busy themselves with farm work, and many were taking advantage of the period before the ground froze to repair houses and tools.

The arrival of Ah Dai and Shang Feifan naturally caught the eyes of many villagers.

The adults were fine, but the children trailed behind them the entire way.

Strangers rarely visited the village, and the little cubs were exceptionally curious.

Hearing the shouts and curious inquiries of the little cubs, Ah Dai held his square head high, sweeping a disdainful gaze across the pack of youngsters: A bunch of scrubs! Now you can only look up to your Grandpa me!

Ah Dai still held a bit of a grudge.

All of these cubs had bullied him before, and he remembered every single one.

While he wouldn't go out of his way to exact revenge, he could certainly torture these "enemies" with some temptation.

Unhurriedly, Ah Dai lifted a paw and brushed across the front leg wearing another looped bracelet.

Ah Dai fished out a piece of milk candy and slowly popped it into his mouth.

Oops! The milk candy was too small and hadn't released its flavor yet; bad choice.

Still, the milk candy tasted so good.

Ah Dai sucked on the milk candy, reluctant to swallow it down into his stomach just yet.

The swarm of little cubs running along behind them was dying of curiosity.

Who was this square-headed cub?

Why did it feel like they knew him, yet didn't know him at all?

What were this adult and child doing in the village?

And why did the little clothes on that square-headed guy look so good? He clearly had fur of his own, yet he went out of his way to wear a fur garment on top of it!

And what was he eating just now?

It looked so incredibly delicious.

"Who are you? Why did you come to our village?" A little cub couldn't hold back and blurted out the question.

Ah Dai didn't answer, letting those little cubs chase after him and his Shang-Dad.

The adult beastmen watching this scene: "..."

Ah Dai swallowed his milk candy. To show off, he had no choice but to bite the bullet and swallow the candy without savoring it properly.

With a flick of his little paw, he fished out a large chicken leg this time.

It was a pity that the spatial bracelet forged by his father couldn't keep things warm yet; otherwise, pulling it out right after it was cooked would have been truly mouth-watering!

But this was fine too, considering the vast majority of beastmen had an exceptional sense of smell.

Ah Dai sat right on his dad's shoulder, cradling the large chicken leg in his two little paws, and took a big, ravenous bite.

Shang Feifan had no idea his cheapskate son was putting on a mukbang broadcast, assuming the little fellow was simply hungry after teleporting such a long distance. He merely glanced sideways at him: "Don't get grease on my clothes."

Ah Dai nodded, sneakily pulling out another small bib Great-Grandma had sewn for him. He tucked the chicken leg back into his spatial bracelet, put on his little bib first, and only then fished out the large chicken leg to continue gnawing.

The entire crowd of trailing little cubs: Saliva was literally dripping down!

This square-headed guy was eating so deliciously! Just look at that expression—utterly intoxicated.

Ah, he pulled out a bottle of milk.

Was that milk? They could all smell a particularly rich milky aroma, tinged with sweetness!

Ah Dai tilted his head back, gulping down the milk with heroic abandon, drinking until he had a ring of milk-mustache around his mouth.

Shang Feifan finally caught on: Son, you're acting a bit too over the top.

Pfft—some villagers by the roadside burst out laughing.

"Hey? Is that Ah Dai?"

"Isn't that tall beastman the repairman who came last time?"

"A repairman is here? Fantastic, I happen to have some things I couldn't fix myself."

"The repairman brought Ah Dai back? Could it be..."

"Doesn't look like it. Look at Ah Dai's bastardly swagger. This is having a wealthy dad and coming back specially to show off."

The adult beastmen could all tell.

When the little cubs heard that this square-headed fellow was actually the balding, sickly, scrawny little dunderhead from back then, they were all utterly shocked: This is Ah Dai? How is that possible?!

One large chicken leg wasn't enough; Ah Dai dragged out a piece of milk pastry handmade for him by his Great-Grandma. This was his absolute favorite lately.

It smelled too good, it tasted too incredible—this piece of milk pastry, he was going to savor it slowly.

The trailing little cubs: Ah Dai actually has this many delicious things?!

Wuwang! Mom, Dad, I want to eat meat too! I want to drink milk, I want to eat pastries!

"Let's mug the bastard!" The biggest cub leaped up.

Ah Dai flashed out of existence, and the large cub pounced on empty air.

Shang Feifan grabbed the large cub by the loose skin at the back of its neck.

Seized by its fatal weak spot, the large cub curled up all four limbs and could only cry out: "Let me down."

Shang Feifan tossed him aside at random.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第233章 阿呆衣锦还乡 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
大幼崽落地一个打滚就稳稳当当地站起来，作势又要扑。

“嗷！”大幼崽忽然惨叫一声。

旁边有小幼崽喊：“啊，大毛你的头顶缺了一块毛！”

阿呆重新出现在他商爸肩膀上，冲着地上那些幼崽呆呆龇牙：小爷我现在可厉害了！

还晃着小爪子里握着的几根毛威胁。再来，拔光你们的毛！

阿呆鼓嘴一吹——几根毛悠悠掉落。

大幼崽：“呜哇！你竟然敢拔我的毛，我跟你拼了！”

一众村民：哎哟喂，小阿呆好像觉醒了了不得的能力。

“等等，你们难道都没注意阿呆他那些吃的都是从哪里拿出来的？”

“呃，不会是我们猜的那个东西吧？”

“不可能！如果真是那东西，怎么可能给一个小幼崽戴着。”

“可是……”

村长听到动静，从屋里走出来。

“是你？”村长看到商非凡也非常惊讶。

他以为上次这人离开就再也不会回来。

商非凡没管跑去和幼崽们玩耍（打成一团）的阿呆，抬手跟村长打招呼：“村长大哥，客套话就不多说了。途径此处，正好我得到一些重要消息，阿呆念着你们，就过来跟你们说说。”

村长一听，立刻：“请进，进屋说。”
chunks.englishText:
The large cub landed, did a roll to steady himself, and immediately made a motion to pounce again.

"Awooo!" The large cub suddenly let out a miserable yelp.

A little cub nearby shouted: "Ah, Da Mao, a patch of hair on top of your head is missing!"

Ah Dai reappeared on his Shang-Dad's shoulder, flashing a dazed buster-smile at the cubs on the ground: Grandpa me is super powerful now!

He even shook the few strands of hair clutched in his little paw as a threat. Come at me again, and I'll pluck every last hair off you!

Ah Dai puffed out his cheeks and blew—the few strands of hair drifted lazily down.

The large cub: "Wuwang! You actually dared to pluck my hair, I'm going to fight you to the death!"

The crowd of villagers: Oh my goodness, little Ah Dai seems to have awakened some incredible ability.

"Wait, didn't any of you notice where Ah Dai got all those edibles from?"

"Uh, it wouldn't be that thing we're thinking of, right?"

"Impossible! If it really were that thing, how could they possibly let a little cub wear it?"

"But..."

Hearing the commotion, the Village Chief walked out from his house.

"It's you?" The Village Chief was immensely surprised to see Shang Feifan.

He had thought that once this person left last time, he would never return.

Ignoring Ah Dai, who had run off to play (and instantly brawl into a tangled mess) with the cubs, Shang Feifan raised a hand to greet the Village Chief: "Village Chief Big Brother, let's skip the polite pleasantries. Passing through this area, I happened to obtain some important news, and Ah Dai misses you all, so he came over to share it with you."

Upon hearing this, the Village Chief immediately said: "Please, come inside and talk."

chunks.chineseText:
第234章 反攻第一弹

一号玩家营地内灯火通明，玩家们来来往往，有的在修理装备，有的在交易物资，还有的围坐在篝火旁吹嘘着今日的战绩。他们丝毫没意识到，死亡即将降临。

营地外围，一名叫做“铁盾”的战士玩家正靠在栅栏旁抽烟，忽然，他听到一阵诡异的脚步声。

“什么鬼动静？”他皱眉转头，下一秒，瞳孔骤缩。

“艹！丧尸？！”

“敌袭！丧尸袭城了！”

然而，已经晚了。

一具浑身溃烂的不死尸猛地扑来，腐烂的爪子直接撕开他的喉咙，鲜血喷溅！铁盾甚至来不及拔剑，就被第二具不死尸咬断了手臂！

“啊啊啊——”

“卧槽！怎么回事？！”法师“烧死你算球”刚举起法杖，就被三具不死尸扑倒，它们腐烂的牙齿狠狠撕咬他的皮肉。

“快结阵！盾卫顶上去！”弓箭手疯狂拉弓射箭，但箭矢射穿不死尸的胸膛，它们却毫无痛觉，继续向前扑杀！

“治疗！治疗呢？！”

“来了来了。”

“圣光如液”拼命施展治愈术，但一名玩家的脑袋已经被不死尸硬生生扯了下来，鲜血如喷泉般涌出！

“喂，你们有没有听到什么声音？”正在守夜的钢铁堡垒放下手中的酒壶，警觉地竖起耳朵。他的异能是金属皮肤，此刻全身正泛着暗沉的光泽。

话音未落，地面突然剧烈震动。数十只腐烂的手臂破土而出，瞬间抓住了他的脚踝。

“敌袭——！”他刚喊出声，就被拖入地下。紧接着，密密麻麻的不死尸如潮水般从四面八方涌来。

营地内顿时乱作一团。

“寒冰壁垒！”冰系异能者“极地风暴”双手按地，一道三米高的冰墙瞬间升起。

但下一秒，一只六级不死尸从阴影中闪现，干枯的手掌直接穿透冰墙，一把掐住他的脖子。

“咔嚓”一声脆响，极地风暴的脑袋软软地垂了下来。

整个营地陷入彻底的混乱。

玩家们惊慌失措，有人试图反击，有人直接逃跑，但四面八方都是不死尸。它们从地下爬出，从树上跳下，甚至从玩家的影子中钻出！

“进入城堡！放炮！赶紧用大炮轰啊！”玩家们屁滚尿流，疯狂往营地北边耸立的城堡冲去。

轰隆轰隆！

城堡上设置的大炮开始发挥作用，对准营地里到处跑的不死尸轰击。

还没有逃进城堡的玩家们破口大骂：“放炮的是谁？老子老娘还没进门呢！你们他妈是连我们一起轰吗？”

“抱歉了兄嘚！这时顾不得你们了，大家三天后见！”

“艹！”

营地中心，谷主的雅居内，天残谷主洛伦米尔顿正优雅地品茗，就听到了外面传来此起彼伏的惨叫声和大炮轰炸声。

“嗯？”他眉头微皱，刚想出门查看，大门猛地被推开。

一名浑身是血的玩家“影刃”也是他的护卫之一，跌跌撞撞冲进来：“谷主！丧尸！数不清的丧尸攻进来了！”

洛伦米尔顿瞳孔一缩：“丧尸？什么丧尸？”

话音未落，雅居窗户被咔嚓打碎！

一具干瘦至极、身披残破铠甲的不死尸从天而降，黑洞洞的眼眶和一只干瘪眼球直直盯着天残谷主！

“这是？！”洛伦米尔顿瞬间反应过来。

可恨不死尸靠得太近，他来不及抽出法杖，袖中寒光一闪，一柄银色匕首已经刺向不死尸的眉心！

“铛——！”

不死尸的头颅微微后仰，匕首竟只在它干枯的皮肤上留下一道浅浅的划痕！

“竟然破不了防？这不死尸的实力……”洛伦米尔顿心中大惊。

下一秒，八级不死尸猛地抬手，干枯的手指如利刃般刺向他的咽喉！洛伦米尔顿身形一闪，堪堪避开，但仍被指尖划破皮肤，鲜血渗出！

庆幸的是，洛伦米尔顿终于能拉开距离，拿出法杖。

“炎爆！”一颗巨大的火球轰然射出。

不死尸不闪不避，任由火球在胸口炸开。但它只是晃了晃身子，继续逼近。身上没有半点损伤，只铠甲看着更破一点。

这么可怕的防御力？

洛伦米尔顿脸色变了。他快速后撤，同时挥动法杖：“冰霜结封！”

极寒的冰环爆发开来，地面瞬间结冰。不死尸的双腿被冻住，但上半身依然前倾，腐烂的手臂猛地伸长，险些抓住洛伦米尔顿的衣袍。

“该死！”洛伦米尔顿额头渗出冷汗。再次催动法杖：“天罚之雷！”

一道水桶粗的闪电从天而降，却被不死尸躲过。

轰的一声巨响，地面被炸出三米深坑。

烟尘散去，不死尸再次扑向他。

洛伦米尔顿迅速举起法杖，一道银色光幕骤然展开——“光明束缚！”

无数银色丝线从地面窜出，瞬间缠住不死尸的四肢，试图将其禁锢！

然而，不死尸只是微微歪头，浑身骨骼咔嚓作响，竟硬生生挣断了束缚！

只可恨他的光明系魔法一般般，他最擅长的是精神系魔法。

但不死尸有什么精神力给他控制？

对方连灵魂都没有！

洛伦米尔顿只得咬牙再次施展他不擅长的光明系魔法，法杖前端凝聚出一颗银色光球——“圣光破灭！”

光球爆射而出，直击不死尸胸口！

“轰——！”

爆炸的冲击波炸碎了大半栋雅居，烟尘弥漫。洛伦米尔顿微微喘息，却猛然察觉不对。

烟尘中，一道黑影缓缓走出。八级不死尸的胸口被炸出一个大洞，但它依然站立着，头颅缓缓抬起，黑洞洞的眼眶仿佛在嘲笑他的无力。

“怎么可能……连圣光破灭都杀不死？”洛伦米尔顿瞳孔收缩，如果他所料不错，这具不死尸的级别也许超过了七级，达到了八级，也就是法圣的境界。

这可是和曾经的他同样的境界，而他现在只不过恢复到七级顶峰，距离法圣还有一线之差，只要再给他一点时间。

原本按照他的计算，他早该恢复到法圣境界，可就因为和阿瑞斯商打了一架，也不知道中了什么暗算，导致他身上的伤势一直无法完全痊愈，这伤势也大大拖延了他恢复的进度。

该死的阿瑞斯商！

洛伦米尔顿一时恨透了那个雄性兽人。

可惜不死尸没有给他过多思考时间，猛地冲刺而来，速度快到几乎化作残影！

洛伦米尔顿仓促格挡，但它的爪子如刀刃般划过他的手臂，鲜血飞溅！

“啊！”他咬牙忍痛，法杖再次爆发出强烈光芒：“幻影千重！”

瞬间，数十个洛伦米尔顿的分-身出现在战场上，真假难辨！

不死尸停下脚步，似乎在判断哪个才是真身。

“呵，死物终究是死物……”洛伦米尔顿冷笑，真身悄然绕到不死尸身后，一只圣光匕首出现，直刺它的后颈。

然而——

“咔！”不死尸的头颅竟猛地180度扭转，干枯的手掌精准扣住了他的手腕。

暗处的商非凡冷笑：不死尸可不是在用眼睛看。用幻影分-身对付不死尸大概是最没用的魔法之一。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 234: The First Strike of Counterattack

Inside Player Camp Number One, lights blazed bright as day. Players milled back and forth—some repairing equipment, others trading supplies, and still others gathered around bonfires bragging about today's battle achievements. They had no inkling whatsoever that death was about to descend upon them.

On the outskirts of the camp, a warrior player named "Iron Shield" was leaning against the wooden fence smoking a cigarette when he suddenly heard a bizarre sound of footsteps.

"What kind of ghost noise is that?" He frowned and turned his head. The next second, his pupils constricted violently.

"F*ck! Zombies?!"

"Enemy attack! Zombies are raiding the camp!"

However, it was already too late.
