An Undead corpse with rotting flesh all over its body lunged forward fiercely, its decaying claws tearing directly into his throat as blood sprayed everywhere! Iron Shield didn't even have time to draw his sword before a second Undead corpse snapped his arm clean off!

"Ah, ah, ah—!"

"Holy sh*t! What's going on?!" The mage "Burn You to a Crisp" had just raised his staff when he was tackled to the ground by three Undead corpses, their rotting teeth savagely ripping into his flesh.

"Form up! Shield guards, get up front!" An archer frantically drew his bow and loosed arrows, but even as the arrows pierced straight through the chests of the Undead corpses, they felt no pain whatsoever and continued lunging forward to slaughter!

"Healers! Where are the healers?!"

"Coming, coming!"

"Holy Light as Fluid" desperately cast healing spells, but another player's head had already been forcefully wrenched right off by an Undead corpse, blood gushing like a fountain!

"Hey, did any of you hear a noise?" Steel Fortress, who was currently on night watch, lowered his wine jar and alertly pricked up his ears. His superpower was metallic skin, and at this moment, his entire body was shimmering with a dull, dark luster.

Before his voice even faded, the ground suddenly shook violently. Dozens of rotting arms burst out from beneath the soil, instantly grabbing his ankles.

"Enemy att—!" Before he could finish shouting, he was dragged underground. Immediately following that, a dense swarm of Undead corpses surged in from all directions like a tidal wave.

The camp instantly descended into utter chaos.

"Ice Barrier!" The ice-attribute Esper "Polar Storm" pressed both hands against the ground, and a three-meter-tall ice wall instantly rose into the air.

Yet the next second, a Tier-6 Undead corpse flashed out from the shadows, its withered palm piercing straight through the ice wall and clamping ruthlessly around his neck.

With a crisp "crack," Polar Storm's head slumped limply.

The entire camp fell into total pandemonium.

Players panicked in terror; some attempted to strike back while others fled outright, but Undead corpses were everywhere. They crawled out from the ground, leaped down from trees, and even emerged straight from the players' shadows!

"Get inside the castle! Fire the cannons! Hurry up and blast them with the big guns!" The players pissed their pants, scrambling frantically toward the towering castle erected at the northern end of the camp.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The cannons mounted on the castle began to roar, bombarding the scurrying Undead corpses scattered across the camp.

Players who hadn't managed to escape into the castle cursed furiously: "Who the hell is firing the cannons?! My old man and my old lady haven't even made it through the doors yet! Are you motherfuckers planning to blow us up along with them?!"

"Sorry, brothers! Can't worry about you right now, see you all in three days!"

"F*ck!"

In the heart of the camp, within the Valley Master's luxurious dwelling, Heavenly Flawed Valley Master Lauren Milton was sipping tea with refined elegance when he heard the overlapping screams and cannon blasts echoing from outside.

"Hm?" His brow furrowed slightly. Just as he wanted to step outside to investigate, the heavy doors were slammed violently open.

A blood-soaked player named "Shadow Blade"—who was also one of his bodyguards—stumbled inside in a panic: "Valley Master! Zombies! Countless zombies have breached the camp!"

Lauren Milton’s pupils shrank: "Zombies? What zombies?"

Before his voice died away, the window of the dwelling shattered with a sharp crash!

An emaciated, skin-and-bones Undead corpse clad in tattered armor dropped out of thin air, its hollow eye sockets and single withered eyeball staring dead-ahead at the Heavenly Flawed Valley Master!

"This is?!" Lauren Milton reacted instantly.

Hateful that the Undead corpse was standing so close, he didn't have time to pull out his staff. A cold flash rippled through his sleeve, and a silver dagger was already thrusting directly toward the Undead corpse's glabella!

"Clang—!"

The Undead corpse's head tilted slightly backward, yet the dagger only left a shallow white scratch across its withered skin!

"It couldn't even break its defense? The strength of this Undead corpse..." Shock gripped Lauren Milton's heart.

The next second, the Tier-8 Undead corpse abruptly raised its hand, its withered fingers stabbing toward his throat like sharp blades! Lauren Milton shifted his stance in a flash, barely dodging the blow, though his skin was still grazed by the fingertips as blood seeped out.

Fortunately, Lauren Milton finally managed to widen the distance and draw his staff.

"Flame Burst!" A gigantic fireball roared outward.

The Undead corpse neither dodged nor evaded, letting the fireball detonate right against its chest. However, it merely swayed slightly before pressing forward again, suffering not the slightest bit of damage save for its armor looking somewhat more tattered.

Such terrifying defensive power?

Lauren Milton’s expression changed. He rapidly retreated while swinging his staff: "Frost Sealing Barrier!"

An intensely freezing ring of frost erupted, and the ground instantly glazed over with ice. The Undead corpse's legs were frozen in place, but its upper body still leaned forward, its rotting arms suddenly elongating as they narrowly missed grabbing Lauren Milton's robes.

"Damn it!" Cold sweat beaded on Lauren Milton's forehead. He channeled his staff once more: "Divine Retribution Lightning!"

A bolt of lightning as thick as a water vat plunged from the skies, yet the Undead corpse managed to sidestep it.

With a deafening boom, a three-meter-deep crater was blasted into the ground.

As the dust and smoke settled, the Undead corpse lunged at him once again.

Lauren Milton promptly raised his staff, and a shimmering silver barrier of light abruptly unfolded—"Binding Light!"

Countless silver threads burst forth from the ground, instantly wrapping around the Undead corpse's limbs in an attempt to restrain it!

However, the Undead corpse merely tilted its head slightly, its entire skeletal frame popping with crisp cracks as it forcefully snapped the restraints right apart!

It was a pity that his light-attribute magic was merely mediocre; his true specialty lay in mental-attribute magic.

Yet what kind of spiritual force did an Undead corpse have for him to control?

The creature didn't even have a soul!

Gritting his teeth, Lauren Milton had no choice but to cast unfamiliar light-attribute magic once more, condensing a silver orb of light at the tip of his staff—"Holy Light Annihilation!"

The orb of light shot forth like a beam, slamming directly into the Undead corpse's chest!

"Boom—!"

The shockwave of the blast shattered more than half of the dwelling, dust filling the air. Lauren Milton panted slightly, only to abruptly realize something was wrong.

Amidst the dust, a dark figure slowly stepped out. The chest of the Tier-8 Undead corpse had been blown open into a massive cavern, yet it still stood upright, its head slowly lifting as its hollow eye sockets seemed to mock his helplessness.

"How is this possible... Even Holy Light Annihilation couldn't kill it?" Lauren Milton's pupils constricted. If his calculations were correct, this Undead corpse's tier might have surpassed Tier-7, reaching Tier-8—the realm of a Saint Mage.

This was the exact same realm he once stood at, whereas right now, he had only recovered to the peak of Tier-7, still a hair's breadth away from becoming a Saint Mage, needing just a little more time.

Originally, according to his projections, he should have long since recovered to the Saint Mage realm. But because he had fought a battle with that Ares Shang and somehow fallen victim to some underhanded scheme, the injuries on his body had remained perpetually unhealed, severely dragging down the progress of his recovery.

Damned Ares Shang!

For a moment, Lauren Milton loathed that male beastman to the core.

Regrettably, the Undead corpse didn't grant him any more time for reflection, charging forward fiercely at a speed that almost blurred into a residual afterimage!

Lauren Milton hurriedly parried, but its claws slashed across his arm like razor blades, sending blood flying!

"Ah!" Gritting his teeth against the pain, his staff once again burst with intense radiance: "A Thousand Mirage Illusions!"

In an instant, dozens of duplicate avatars of Lauren Milton materialized across the battlefield, virtually indistinguishable from the real body!

The Undead corpse came to a halt, seemingly trying to determine which one was the true body.

"Hah, lifeless objects are lifeless objects after all..." Lauren Milton sneered. His true body quietly circled behind the Undead corpse, a holy light dagger materializing in his grip to plunge straight toward the back of its neck.

However—

"Crack!" The Undead corpse's head violently twisted a full 180 degrees, and its withered palm accurately clamped around his wrist.

Hidden in the shadows, Shang Feifan sneered inwardly: An Undead corpse doesn't rely on eyes to see. Using illusionary avatars to deal with an Undead corpse has got to be one of the most useless spells imaginable.

chunks.chineseText:
“怎么会？！”洛伦米尔顿瞳孔骤缩。

下一秒，不死尸猛地发力。

“咔嚓！”

清脆的骨裂声响起，洛伦米尔顿的手腕直接被捏碎。

“唔！”洛伦米尔顿强行忍住想要痛呼的欲望，身体迅速摆脱，但不死尸的另一只手已经掐住了他的喉咙，将他缓缓提起！

“快救谷主！”玩家朝外面大喊。

一群玩家乱哄哄地往雅居这边冲来。

“不行啊，丧尸太多了！怎么会这么多？”

“谷主怎样了？我不要谷主死啊！啊啊啊，我美丽的谷主，我这就来救你了，丧尸都给我滚开！”

轰！

“他么的！谁用大炮对着谷主雅居轰炸？脑子进水了吗？”

雅居内。

“不……不可能……我怎么会……”他的脸色涨红，眼中终于浮现出绝望。

就在不死尸即将捏碎天残谷主喉咙的一瞬间。

一道银色光芒从法杖顶端爆炸开来，洛伦米尔顿的身影从不死尸手中消失。

不是消失，是炸成了碎片。

八级不死尸反应还算快，在银色光芒爆炸的瞬间，它就本能把洛伦米尔顿扔了出去。

八级不死尸受到了一点小伤。

但洛伦米尔顿也逃了。

啧，滑溜！在暗中观察的商非凡也非常肯定洛伦米尔顿没有死。

洛伦米尔顿确实没有死，自从上次和阿瑞斯商打斗受伤，他就把自己的本体藏了起来，以疗伤和恢复境界为第一，平日在外活动的都是自己的分-身。

那也是他仅剩下的最后一具分-身。

可现在这最后一具分-身也毁了。

往好处想，他也成功逃过一劫。

可洛伦米尔顿还是恨得不行。

“阿瑞斯商！拉斐尔郎沐！肯定是他们！这一定是他们的报复！”

但他们怎么会来得这么快？

还有，这些不死尸和那两人是什么关系？难道他们中的一个真的能操控不死尸，还能操控如此之多，更连法圣级别的不死尸都能操控？

洛伦米尔顿妒忌了。

他的游戏玩家耗费他如此多精力和时间，结果到现在也还没有形成真正规模。

好吧，现在差不多到了已经可以使用的时候。

可他这边还没有让玩家大发神威呢，就有人操纵数万不死尸来找他麻烦了。

不死不灭的玩家对上杀不死无知觉的不死尸，这可真是旗鼓相当棋逢对手——洛伦米尔顿都要气死了！

为什么？！

为什么在他大业即将开展之际，总是会遇到让他头疼的麻烦？

难道他的运气已经开始变得糟糕了吗？

一想到运气，洛伦米尔顿脸色微微改变。

他想到了一个可能。

拉斐尔郎沐，郎沐……

难道？！

不，不可能！

他很确定，郎沐早就死了，死得非常彻底。

而且郎沐的气运早就被他夺取得差不多，以那么糟糕的气运，他根本不可能活下来，也不可能过得顺畅。

那就是他遇到了这个兽人大陆的气运之子？

是谁？

阿瑞斯商，还是拉斐尔郎沐？

洛伦米尔顿甚至发出控制不住的笑声：难不成叫郎沐的人就一定是气运之子？

俊美的男人站定脚步，眼中射出狠厉和坚定的光芒。

不管那两人谁是气运之子，也不管这个大陆上是否有气运之子，没有人可以阻挡他的成神之路，也别想有人可以用气运来压过他！

如果他的气运不如对方，那他就夺取过来。

路，是人走出来的。

气运同样也是可以掠夺的。

从来就没有命运的一成不变，他只信人定胜天！

他要成神，就一定会成神！

玩家一号营地外，商非凡正在绘制一个巨大的咒术阵。

把整个一号玩家营地都放在献祭位的咒术阵。

“我以黑暗的名义诅咒天残谷主洛伦米尔顿，分享黑暗能量的所有存在接受我的献祭，响应我的呼唤，诅咒洛伦米尔顿在一年内事事事与愿违！”

一年时间足够他彻底解决洛伦米尔顿。

这也是他给自己的极限时间，他绝对不会让洛伦米尔顿活超过一年时间。

经过那座已经建成的谷主城堡，商非凡顺嘴又扔出一个诅咒：“天这么冷，刚放完这么多炮，热胀冷缩，我看新建的谷主城堡得塌。”

本来这座城堡的质量就有问题。

轰隆轰隆！

炮声隆隆，不死尸在大量炮击下，死伤无数。

商非凡下令。

原本还在追击玩家的不死尸们忽然纷纷转身逃跑，还有些直接钻地。

轰！又是一声巨大的声响。

但这次并不是炮击声。

躲入城堡的玩家疯狂喊叫：“艹艹艹！城堡怎么会塌了？这是纸糊的吗！”

“丧尸退了退了！大家快离开城堡！”

好嘛，刚冲进来躲避的玩家们又一窝蜂地往城堡外跑。

“建筑队给我死过来！这他么是谁搞出来的豆腐渣工程？”

“谷主！”

“对，是谷主给的图纸，我们都是按照谷主给出的图纸建造的。是设计原本就有问题！”工程队承包大队长不承认他们的施工有问题。

丧尸退了。

但整个一号玩家营地乱糟得不成样子。

刚建好不久的谷主城堡也塌了。

可怜谷主还没住进来呢。

洛伦米尔顿看着混乱的玩家营地，打斗完全没有章法跟没头苍蝇一样的玩家，气得一口血差点喷出来。

乌合之众！

就没有擅长指挥的吗？

玩家中有擅长指挥大型战斗的，但他们都另有任务。

没有任务的，诸如伏向军这些人都非常巧合地在当晚离开了一号营地，前往其他玩家营地办事。

洛伦米尔顿深吸一口气，整理一下衣着，准备出去收拾残局。

他手握法杖，飞上一号营地上空，用法杖指着下方，打算来一场大型恢复魔法，安玩家心的同时，也想让玩家们瞧瞧他的本事。

就在此时！

整个一号营地忽然被什么可怕的力量笼罩一般。

所有还待在一号营地中的玩家以及所谓的NPC们，在这一刹那都似有所感地抬起头。

黑雾笼罩住一号营地。

当黑雾消失，刚刚还热闹哄哄的一号营地忽然就变得寂静无声。

整个营地变得死寂。

所有玩家和NPC们都消失了。

洛伦米尔顿也就是浮在半空，且察觉得早、逃得也快，在黑雾笼罩住营地的一刹那，他就跑了。

那时，他感觉到了莫大的恐惧。

那是他无法抵抗的力量，来自原始的法则之力！

噗！

一直堵在胸口的鲜血被喷了出来。

洛伦米尔顿并没有因为喷出这口淤血就好受，反而跟受了重伤一样从半空跌落。

他的境界随着这一口血喷出，竟然也开始有下跌的趋势。

洛伦米尔顿都要气疯了，到底是谁在对付他！

他不相信阿瑞斯商和拉斐尔郎沐能做到这种程度，他不相信！
chunks.englishText:
"How could this be?!" Lorun Milton's pupils contracted violently.

The next second, the Undead Corpse exerted brute force.

*Crack!*

A crisp sound of snapping bone rang out as Lorun Milton's wrist was crushed to pieces.

"Ugh!" Lorun Milton forcefully suppressed the urge to cry out in pain, quickly pulling his body away. But the Undead Corpse's other hand had already clamped around his throat, lifting him slowly into the air!

"Save the Valley Master quickly!" the players shouted toward the outside.

A mob of players came charging turbulently toward the residential courtyard.

"No go, there are way too many zombies! How can there be so many?!"

"How's the Valley Master doing? I refuse to let the Valley Master die! Ahhh, my beautiful Valley Master, I'm coming to save you right now, all you zombies get the hell out of the way!"

Boom!

"What the fuck! Who's using a cannon to bombard the Valley Master's courtyard? Is your brain fried?!"

Inside the courtyard.

"No... impossible... how could I..." His face flushed red, and despair finally surfaced in his eyes.

Just at the split second when the Undead Corpse was about to crush the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master's windpipe—

A silver radiance exploded from the tip of the staff, and Lorun Milton's figure vanished from the Undead Corpse's grip.

Not vanished—he had been blasted into fragments.

The rank-eight Undead Corpse reacted quite swiftly; the instant the silver light exploded, it instinctively hurled Lorun Milton away.

The rank-eight Undead Corpse suffered minor injuries.

Yet Lorun Milton had escaped.

*Tch, slippery bastard!* Watching from the shadows, Shang Feifan was thoroughly certain that Lorun Milton was not dead.

Lorun Milton indeed was not dead. Ever since he was injured in his battle with Ares Shang, he had hidden his true main body, prioritizing healing and recovering his realm, while the one active outside on a daily basis was merely his clone.

It was also his very last remaining clone.

Yet now, even this final clone had been destroyed.

Looking on the bright side, he had successfully escaped with his life.

Even so, Lorun Milton was consumed by raging hatred.

"Ares Shang! Raphael Lang Mu! It has to be them! This must be their retaliation!"

But how could they have arrived so quickly?

Furthermore, what was the connection between these Undead Corpses and those two individuals? Could one of them truly control Undead Corpses—and control so many of them, even commanding Undead Corpses at the Saint level?

Envoy consumed Lorun Milton.

His gamers had consumed so much of his energy and time, yet up to now, they still hadn't formed a true scale.

Well, they had reached the point where they were almost ready to be used.

Yet before he could even let the players unleash their divine might upon the world, someone was already manipulating tens of thousands of Undead Corpses to cause trouble for him.

Players who could not truly die facing headless, mindless Undead Corpses that couldn't be killed—this really was an evenly matched battle between titans—Lorun Milton was practically dying of anger!

Why?!

Why, at the threshold of his grand enterprise unfolding, did he always encounter such agonizing trouble?

Could his luck actually have begun to turn terrible?

The moment luck crossed his mind, Lorun Milton's expression shifted slightly.

He thought of a possibility.

Raphael Lang Mu, Lang Mu...

Could it be?!

No, impossible!

He was utterly certain that Lang Mu had died long ago, and died very thoroughly.

Besides, Lang Mu's destiny and fortune had long since been plundered by him to near depletion. With such wretched fortune, it was utterly impossible for him to survive, let alone live smoothly.

Could it be that he had encountered the Son of Fortune of this Beastmen Continent?

Who was it?

Ares Shang, or Raphael Lang Mu?

Lorun Milton even let out uncontrollable laughter: Could it be that anyone named Lang Mu was destined to be the Son of Fortune?

The handsome man planted his feet, a fierce and resolute light shooting from his eyes.

Regardless of which of the two was the Son of Fortune, and regardless of whether a Son of Fortune truly existed on this continent, no one could block his path to divinity, nor would anyone ever hope to suppress him with mere destiny!

If his fortune was inferior to the other's, then he would simply plunder it.

A path is walked out by people.

Destiny and fortune could likewise be plundered.

Fate was never immutable; he believed only that human will could conquer the heavens!

He wanted to become a god, and a god he would surely become!

Outside Player Camp No. 1, Shang Feifan was sketching a massive spell formation.

A spell formation that placed the entire Player Camp No. 1 within the sacrificial focal point.

"In the name of darkness, I curse the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master, Lorun Milton. May all entities sharing in the dark energy accept my sacrifice and heed my call, cursing Lorun Milton so that all his endeavors shall run contrary to his wishes within the span of a year!"

One year was more than enough time for him to completely resolve Lorun Milton.

This was also the absolute limit he had set for himself; he would never allow Lorun Milton to live past a single year.

Passing by the newly constructed Valley Master castle, Shang Feifan casually tossed out another curse: "The weather is so freezing, and after firing off so many cannons, thermal expansion and contraction will do their work. I predict that the newly built Valley Master castle is going to collapse."

The construction quality of this castle was questionable to begin with anyway.

Rumble, rumble!

Cannons roared thunderously, causing countless casualties among the Undead Corpses under the heavy bombardment.

Shang Feifan issued an order.

The Undead Corpses that had still been pursuing the players suddenly turned and fled in all directions, while others burrowed directly into the ground.

Boom! Another massive explosion rang out.

Yet this time, it was not the sound of artillery fire.

Players who had hidden inside the castle screamed frantically: "Shit, shit, shit! How the hell did the castle collapse? Is this thing made of paper?!"

"The zombies are retreating, retreating! Everyone get out of the castle!"

Well then, the players who had just rushed in to seek refuge poured back out of the castle in a chaotic swarm.

"Construction team, get your asses over here! Whose shoddy, jerry-built piece of garbage engineering is this?!"

"Valley Master!"

"Right, the blueprint was given by the Valley Master. We all built it strictly according to the blueprints provided by the Valley Master. The design itself was flawed from the start!" The head contractor of the engineering team refused to admit there was anything wrong with their construction.

The zombies had retreated.

Yet the entire Player Camp No. 1 was in an utterly chaotic mess.

The Valley Master's castle, completed not long ago, had also collapsed.

Pity the Valley Master hadn't even moved into it yet.

Watching the chaotic player camp, his face flushed as he looked at the players fighting with zero tactical discipline and acting like headless flies, Lorun Milton nearly coughed up a mouthful of blood on the spot.

A rabble of mobs!

Wasn't there a single person skilled in command?

There were players among them who excelled at commanding large-scale battles, but they all had other missions.

Those without missions—such as Fu Xiangjun and company—had quite coincidentally departed from Camp No. 1 that very night, heading to other player camps to handle affairs.

Lorun Milton took a deep breath, straightened his attire, and prepared to go out to clean up the mess.

Wielding his staff, he flew into the skies above Camp No. 1, pointing his staff downward with the intention of casting a large-scale recovery magic spell to reassure the players while simultaneously letting them witness his true capability.

At that exact moment!

The entire Player Camp No. 1 was suddenly enveloped as if by some terrifying force.

All players still remaining in Camp No. 1, along with the so-called NPCs, raised their heads at that very fraction of a second as if sensing something.

Black mist shrouded Camp No. 1.

When the black mist dissipated, the bustling and noisy Camp No. 1 suddenly fell deathly silent.

The entire camp turned into a silent graveyard.

All players and NPCs had vanished.

Lorun Milton, who was floating mid-air, had perceived the danger early and fled the fastest; the instant the black mist enveloped the camp, he bolted.

At that moment, he had felt a boundless, immense terror.

It was a power he could not possibly resist—it came from the primal force of natural laws!

*Puff!*

The stagnant blood that had been backing up in his chest finally sprayed out.

Lorun Milton did not feel any better after vomiting this coagulated blood; instead, he plummeted from mid-air as if gravely injured.

Following the expulsion of that mouthful of blood, his cultivation realm actually began showing signs of a downward slide.

Lorun Milton was driven mad with rage. Who on earth was targeting him?!

He refused to believe that Ares Shang and Raphael Lang Mu could achieve this degree of power—he refused to believe it!
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第235章 捅破游戏真相 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第235章 捅破游戏真相

当晚，商非凡把所有中大型玩家营地都光顾了一遍，先用不死尸冲一波，再用大型咒术阵献祭。

除了当晚没有上线、没有待在营地的玩家，其他玩家都被一锅端。

线下在当晚就爆了。

【狗策划出来挨打！全服大屠杀是什么鬼活动？！】

楼主（钢铁直男）：老子正在修装备，突然就被丧尸潮淹了！这破游戏连个预告都没有？！

1L（冰霜女王）：+1，我在三号营地，那些丧尸跟开了挂似的，我的冰墙一秒就被破了！

2L（暴躁老哥）：你们谁知道老子的苦？昨晚老子在3号营地睡得好好的，突然就被一群丧尸按在地上啃！复活CD直接三天！策划是不是脑子进水了？这特么是什么鬼活动预热？

3L（闪电侠）：你们看到那个穿铠甲的BOSS没？小爷十万伏特的雷击打上去，它居然拍拍灰就站起来了！

4L（牙疼要我命）：没错！这游戏疯了！据说昨晚所有营地全被丧尸潮血洗！老子在2号营地刚修完装备，突然就看见黑压压一片丧尸涌进来！正打着，我突然就没了。复活CD还要三天！狗策划必须给个说法！

5L（乖宝叫我补刀）：我也是！但我没看到丧尸，就正和朋友说话，莫名其妙就被死下线了。我当时还以为是bug，可怎么都上不了游戏，还被告知已死亡。有谁知道是怎么回事吗？

9L（真相帝）：这绝对是新资料片的前置剧情！我赌五毛钱，接下来要开阵营战。

12L（菜鸟007）：萌新瑟瑟发抖...这是全服活动吗？我刚复活又被秒了......

13L（阿门门）：最离谱的是天残谷主这个NPC居然被打跑了！我亲眼看见他被一只高级丧尸追着打，最后我也跟着没了。

24L（吃瓜群众）：所以这是新资料片的前置剧情？“丧尸天灾”要来？

29L（数据帝）：应该不是bug，统计了一下，全服大约78%也就是近四万玩家同时死下线。这规模绝对是预谋好的资料片剧情，也许接下来要开阵营战。

……

类似的帖子无数，玩家和众云玩家吃瓜吃得鼻息咻咻，一个个帖子挨着翻，他们就爱看玩家大骂游戏商和狗策划，骂得越狠他们越爽，尤其是老是抽不到游戏资格的云玩家。

就在玩家们闹得沸沸扬扬，狂喊着让游戏公司出来解释时，一个帖子悄然出现在论坛最上方。

【震惊！《天河星online》不是游戏！玩家灵魂被绑架！】

一开始这个帖子并不算特别引人注意，因为类似的标题贴以前也有过不少。

但有人细心地注意到发帖人的名字——“你皇退休了”。

几位玩家看到这个名字的第一眼就觉得眼熟，随即狂叫一声：“卧槽！竟然是这家伙。”

要说这个全息游戏中最牛掰最神秘的玩家绝对非“你皇”莫属，至今为止，玩家等级排行榜第一位还挂着这位的名字，而他的等级现在已经变成***号，完全不可见了。

很多玩家为此都以为“你皇”是狗策划或游戏公司的内测人员，谁想到这个从来不在玩家中冒头的人竟然在论坛发帖了。

大家好奇之下，自然就点了进去。

帖子第一段句话就是：【这个世界是真实的，我们不是在玩全息游戏，而是精神穿越到了天河星兽人大陆！这是一场以偷窃地星人灵魂和精神力为目的的骗局。】

第二段话：【洛伦米尔顿，游戏里的天残谷主，原来自天河星法德尔大陆的魔法师，一心渴望成神，因为在魔法师大陆盗窃他人气运修炼，人人喊打，成神失败，就偷偷来到遥远的兽人大陆，想要走收集信仰成神的路。而玩家则是他用来征服和欺诈土著的工具与打手，同时也是他修复和提升自己精神力的养料。】

第三段话：【我们在游戏中每次死亡消耗的精神力都会被天残谷主偷窃走三分之二。所以死亡惩罚需要三天之久，不是天残谷主想要玩家死后三天才能上线，而是玩家需要三天时间才能把多消耗的精神力养回来。】

第四段话：【想知道玩家身体是用什么做的吗？就是丧尸的尸体加上一些材料糅合而成！所以天残谷主才要求大家死亡后能尽量把自己的尸体带回来，就因为材料不多制作不易。否则他早就在这一半年中发展出五十万乃至百万玩家，而不是区区五万。】

第五段话：【玩家不是天选之子，你被抽中只是因为你的资料和精神力让洛伦米尔顿满意。五万玩家几乎没有警察、教师、军人、法官等职业，倒是无业游民、特殊职业、技术职业以及学生党更多，你觉得是巧合吗？游戏开发商为何做如此选择？请细品。】

第六段话：【我们地星没有“天河星游戏公司”，任何国家和地区都查无此公司，更没有相关法人和开发者的信息。不信大家可以仔细查。实际上各国政府也在调查这家公司并心知肚明这家公司有问题，只因为找不到人，只能选择观察。再不信可报警询问。】

最后：【请仔细想想，就问现在的科技水平要怎么研发出体感接近百分百真实的全息游戏？全息游戏可不是只是用芯片贴在大脑上就能直接读取和传输数据，这将是数学、量子学、计算机学、信息学、医学……等多项学术的大-跃-进。可我们在这之前谁有听过相关新闻？谁知道这家游戏公司的底细？】

最后的最后：【游戏虽好玩，小命更要紧，就算你不怕，也请多观望！】

玩家们阅后……

“卧槽！我鸡皮疙瘩都起来了！”

“这帖子要是真的，岂不是细思极恐？”

“艹！我的身体竟然是用尸体做的？yue！先让我吐一会儿！”

“同吐！崩溃！”

“小声说，我们哥们六七个人一起抽选游戏资格，结果除了我，只有我表哥抽中了，而我表哥……咳，刚出狱。我不是认为我表哥不好，他已经改过自新，但他告诉我，他有一个认识的人也抽中了，对方可是那强什么犯。当然，他们不可能写自己曾做过什么，我是觉得申请资料中的心理测试题可能有问题。”

论坛瞬间炸开了锅。帖子下面回复的数量几乎几秒一变，乱成一团：

风吹屁屁凉：“我说怎么每次下线都头昏脑涨，还以为是玩太久！”

专业代练20年：“放屁！老子上游戏这么久从没出过问题！楼主危言耸听，肯定是其他游戏公司派来的卧底！”

菜鸟007：“那个……我哥在某局上班，他说这个游戏确实没有备案……”

科学怪人：“emmm，楼主科幻小说看多了吧？”

内测老鸟：“我是第一批玩家，其实早就觉得不对劲了，这可是百分百真实体感的全息游戏！我真的不认为现在的科技能做到这一点。”

小羊咩咩：“我一直就当做是外星人在地星做实验，没想到真的是……”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 235: Exposing the Truth Behind the Game (Part 1)

That very night, Shang Feifan visited all the medium and large-sized player camps, first unleashing a wave of Undead Corpse charges, followed by ritual sacrifices using large spell formations.

Aside from players who happened to be offline or away from their camps that night, the rest were completely wiped out in one fell swoop.

The offline community exploded instantly that night.

[Dog game planner, come out and take a beating! What the hell kind of event is a server-wide massacre?!]

OP (SteelStraightMan): I was just repairing my gear, and suddenly I got swamped by a zombie horde! Does this crappy game not even have a warning?!

1L (FrostQueen): +1. I was in Camp No. 3, and those zombies acted like they were running hacks; my ice wall was shattered in a single second!

2L (FuriousBro): Does anyone know the depths of my suffering? Last night I was sleeping soundly in Camp No. 3 when a bunch of zombies suddenly pinned me to the ground and gnawed on my face! My respawn cooldown is straight-up three days! Has the planner lost his mind? What the hell kind of event pre-season is this?!

3L (TheFlash): Did you guys see that armored BOSS? Young master's hundred-thousand-volt lightning strike hit it squarely, and it just brushed off the dust and stood right back up!

4L (ToothacheWillKillMe): Exactly! This game has gone insane! Word is that every single camp was bloodbath-cleansed by zombie hordes last night! I had just finished repairing my gear in Camp No. 2 when I suddenly saw a pitch-black ocean of zombies pouring in! Mid-fight, I just vanished. And my respawn cooldown is another three days! The dog planner better give us an explanation!

5L (PreciousMakeTheFinishingBlow): Me too! But I didn't see any zombies. I was just talking with a friend when I was inexplicably logged out to death. I thought it was a bug at the time, but no matter what I couldn't log back in, and it notified me I was already dead. Does anyone know what's going on?

9L (TruthSeer): This is definitely the prologue lore for a new expansion pack! I'll bet fifty cents, faction warfare is about to drop next.

12L (Noob007): Newbie trembling in fear... Is this a server-wide event? I literally just respawned and got insta-killed again......

13L (Amen): The most absurd part is that the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master NPC actually got beaten into a retreat! I saw with my own eyes him being chased and beaten by a high-level zombie, and then I died right along with him.

24L (MelonEater): So this is the prologue for a new expansion? Is the "Zombie Calamity" coming?

29L (DataGeek): Probably not a bug. I ran some statistics: roughly 78% of the entire server—nearly forty thousand players—died and went offline simultaneously. This scale is definitely a pre-planned expansion storyline. Maybe faction warfare is opening up next.

......

Countless similar posts flooded the forums. Players and spectator-onlookers munched on melon seeds and scrolled through thread after thread with heavy breathing. They lived for watching players curse out game developers and dog planners; the harsher the cursing, the more cathartic it felt, especially for the spectator-onlookers who could never win a game key.

Just as players were kicking up a massive uproar and loudly demanding the game company to provide an explanation, a post quietly appeared at the very top of the forum.

[SHOCKING! "River of Heaven Online" is NOT a game! Players' souls are being held hostage!]

At first, this post didn't draw an extraordinary amount of attention because there had been plenty of similar clickbait titles in the past.

However, some observant individuals carefully noted the poster's username—"Your Emperor Has Retired."

The moment several veteran players caught sight of this name, they felt a pang of familiarity, followed by a wild scream: "Holy shit! It's actually this guy."

If you had to name the most overpowered and mysterious player in this holographic game, it was undoubtedly "Your Emperor." To this day, the number one spot on the player level leaderboard still bore his name, though his level had long since turned into three asterisks, making it completely invisible.

Many players had previously assumed "Your Emperor" was a dog planner or an internal beta tester for the game company. Who would have thought that a person who never showed their face among the regular player base would actually post on the forums?

Out of pure curiosity, everyone naturally clicked inside.

The very first sentence of the post read: [This world is real. We are not playing a holographic game; rather, our consciousnesses have mentally crossed over to the Beastmen Continent of the River of Heaven Star! This is a scam designed for the sole purpose of stealing the souls and mental energy of Earthlings.]

Second paragraph: [Lorun Milton, the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master in the game, is actually a magician from the Fader Continent of the River of Heaven Star. Obsessed with ascending to divinity, because he practiced by stealing other people's fortunes in the magician continent, he became a public enemy and failed his ascension. Secretly, he fled to the distant Beastmen Continent, attempting to achieve godhood by harvesting faith. Meanwhile, players are merely his tools and thugs used to conquer and deceive the natives, as well as nutrient fuel to repair and elevate his own mental energy.]

Third paragraph: [Every time we die in the game, two-thirds of the mental energy consumed by our deaths is stolen by the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master. That is why the death penalty requires a full three days—it's not because the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master wants players to wait three days before logging back in, but because players genuinely need three days to recover the excess mental energy lost.]

Fourth paragraph: [Want to know what player bodies are made of? They are pieced together from zombie corpses blended with various materials! That is precisely why the Heavenly Remnant Valley Master demands that players bring back their own corpses whenever possible—simply because materials are scarce and production is difficult. Otherwise, he would have already developed half a million or even a million players over the past year and a half, rather than a mere fifty thousand.]

Fifth paragraph: [Players are not the Chosen Ones; you were selected simply because your personal data and mental energy satisfied Lorun Milton's criteria. Among the fifty thousand players, there are almost zero occupations like police officers, teachers, soldiers, or judges; instead, vagrants, special professionals, technical workers, and student factions are vastly overrepresented. Do you think this is a coincidence? Why would game developers make such a choice? Think carefully.]

Sixth paragraph: [Our Earth does not have a "River of Heaven Game Company." No country or region has any record of such a company, nor are there any public legal entities or developer information associated with it. If you don't believe me, feel free to check carefully. In reality, governments worldwide are already investigating this company and are well aware that something is wrong with it, but because they can't find anyone, they can only choose to observe. If you still don't believe it, you can call the police and ask.]

Finally: [Please think carefully: how on earth could current technological levels develop a holographic game with close to one hundred percent sensory realism? Holographic games aren't something where you just slap a chip onto the brain to directly read and transmit data; this would represent a massive evolutionary leap across mathematics, quantum mechanics, computer science, informatics, medicine, and numerous other academic fields. Yet who among us had ever heard related news prior to this? Who knows the true background of this game company?]

Very finally: [Even though the game is fun, your life matters more! Even if you aren't afraid, please wait and observe!]

After reading the post...

"Holy shit! Goosebumps are covering my entire body!"

"If this post is true, isn't that horrifying the more you think about it?"

"Shit! My body is actually made out of corpses? Yuck! Let me go throw up for a second!"

"Vomiting right along with you! Total breakdown!"

"Whispering softly... our group of six or seven guys all applied for game keys, and in the end, besides me, only my cousin got picked. And my cousin... ahem, just got released from prison. I don't think my cousin is a bad person, he's turned over a new leaf, but he told me he knew another guy who also got selected, and that guy was a rapist-type criminal. Of course, they wouldn't write down what they actually did in their applications, but I feel like the psychological test questions in the application form might have been rigged."

The forum instantly blew up. The reply count beneath the post changed almost every second, descending into total chaos:

Wind Blows Chill on Butt: [I was wondering why I always felt dizzy and lightheaded every time I logged off! I thought it was just from playing too long!]

Professional Power-Leveler for 20 Years: [Absolute bullshit! I've been in this game so long and never had any issues! The OP is fear-mongering; they're definitely a spy sent by a competing game company!]

Noob007: [Um... my older brother works in a certain government bureau, and he said this game truly hasn't been officially registered...]

Frankenstein: [Emmm, OP reads way too much sci-fi novels, don't you think?]

Beta Veteran: [I'm part of the first batch of players. Actually, I felt something was fishy a long time ago. This is a holographic game with 100% realistic sensory immersion! I genuinely don't believe current technology can pull this off.]

Little Sheep: [I've always just treated it as aliens running experiments on Earth. I never expected it to actually be real...]
"""

chunks.chapterTitle: 第235章 捅破游戏真相 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
氪金的不知道什么叫钱：“淦！老子刚用十万块跟人换了游戏币！这要是真的，老子要告到这家破游戏公司破产！”

别问我是教什么的教授：“从神经学角度分析，楼主说的精神力偷窃理论确实存在可能……”

与此同时，各大社交平台也开始疯传这个消息。话题#天河星真实世界#和#全息游戏玩家精神力被盗窃#在半小时内分别冲上热搜第一和第二。

无数玩家在论坛留贴逼问游戏官方，让他们不要再躲着赶紧出来回答问题。

但游戏官方跟死了一样，毫无反应。

洛伦米尔顿压根就看不到游戏官方论坛的言论，他只是安排做游戏头盔的人顺便弄了这么一个论坛，好让游戏看起来更像那么回事，平时他都是让地星那边安排的人在论坛上发表一点关于游戏的内容。

论坛与游戏系统割裂，自然他也无法看到这个位于地星的论坛里的讨论内容。

每次更新或有什么其他通知，洛伦米尔顿都是使用游戏系统。

只有在必要时，比如收集玩家的个人资料、对玩家进行抽选时，他才会联系地星那边的人帮他把相关信息收集后通过游戏系统发给他。

可洛伦米尔顿看不到游戏论坛，他能看到玩家们上游戏的实际数据啊。

玩家们刚被大量杀死的当夜，洛伦米尔顿虽然气愤无比，但还是能端得住的。

他甚至想着杀死近四万玩家的家伙肯定用了不得了的力量，这种力量九成不能多用，如果对方发现三天后，他费心费力甚至耗费大量资源杀死的那么多玩家竟然又都回来了，肯定会气得吐血。

这么一想，洛伦米尔顿的心情就好多了。

包括那些营地里的NPC也都是能回来的。他们的状态和玩家不一样，玩家在地星还有身体，但这些营地NPC可都是没了自己的身体又无法去夺舍当地兽人的身体，只能靠他提供类似玩家的身体来存放他们的精神体。

虽然这样不利于那些倒霉魔法师们的修炼，但现在能保证他们的精神体不灭就该感谢他一万次，那些家伙也不敢奢求过多，这也是他们答应做营地NPC的原因——他救他们怎么可能不让他们付出代价？

所以洛伦米尔顿仔细计算下来，发现他的损失并不大，那怒火就也下降了不少。

他甚至很期待让那个找他麻烦的家伙在三天后亲眼看到大量玩家回归的场景。

因为近四万玩家几乎都是在同一个晚上死亡，这就造成下次玩家上线的时间会集中在三天后。

在这三天内，洛伦米尔顿发现很多没有死亡的玩家也纷纷下线，一开始也没怎么留意。他那时正忙着养伤，以及想着要怎么报复回来。

直到他通过系统看到了某个玩家在世界频道喊的话。

“兄弟姐妹们，你们看到论坛上你皇的帖子了吗？这是真的还是假的？我们是不是也应该赶紧下线啊，有点怕~”

之后的回复大多是“你疯了，在这里问这个，不能下线问？”

“白痴！赶紧闭嘴。”

“我原本还想把这个任务完成再下线，现在被这个傻掰挑破，也只能赶紧下了。”

洛伦米尔顿就看到游戏系统统计的玩家数据从2356一路下降，不到几分钟就只剩下个位数。

再眨个眼，个位数直接清零。

换言之，现在所有玩家全都从兽人大陆消失了。

洛伦米尔顿：“！！！”

这都是怎么回事？

洛伦米尔顿不可置信，更怒到胸痛胸闷。

为此，洛伦米尔顿特意联系他在地星那边的被控制者，对方被他入梦，被他精神控制。

但洛伦米尔顿并不知道他在联系那个人时，那人正坐在一个非常有未来风的房间内，被几个摄像头同时盯着，身上和大脑上更贴满了芯片，几台电脑同时监控着他的身体情况，尤其是他的脑电波变化。

洛伦米尔顿可没管对方现在正身处什么环境，直接下令对方去论坛查看情况，然后告诉他。

那人被联系时，脑电波图就疯狂抖动起来，他的神情看着也不对劲，就像是入梦状态。

监控者们看着那人打开电脑查看游戏论坛内容，又亲眼看到那人戴上游戏头盔上游戏，把他在游戏论坛看到的内容转述出去。

不说地星那边的监控者们是什么反应，天河星兽人大陆这边的洛伦米尔顿看到地星那边转来的论坛内容，只觉眼前一黑！

暴露了！

为什么会暴露？

怎么就暴露了？

那个“你皇退休了”到底是谁？

为什么他怎么都删除不掉对方？

洛伦米尔顿喘着粗气，俊美的容颜也变得扭曲。

不顺，太不顺了，自从在虎国王城和那个阿瑞斯商一战后，他就没有怎么顺心过，最近更是麻烦不断。

他准备了那么久的玩家计划！

他花了那么多时间和精力，还有大量资源才搞出来的游戏系统和玩家出生池！

难道就这样废掉了吗？

为什么突然就变成这样？

到底是谁在暗中搞他？！

洛伦米尔顿面目狰狞，整个人气到要炸开。

他这会儿倒是没有怀疑阿瑞斯商和拉斐尔郎沐，因为在他看来那就是两个真正的兽人大陆住民。

你皇退休了！这家伙从一开始就不正常！都是他！

说不定三天前利用不死尸偷袭他、偷袭所有玩家营地的人也是这个你皇！

但这个你皇退休了在哪里？

他是谁？

长成什么样？

洛伦米尔顿看着系统中那个灰色的、可就是删不掉的名字，眼神阴沉恐怖。

他一定要找到对方！

等找到这个家伙，他一定要用最残酷残忍的手段折磨对方！

洛伦米尔顿开始翻找“你皇”最初出现时的记录。

其实相关记录他已经找过一遍，但没找到。

可恨那时不是他坐镇玩家营地，而是分-身。

分-身虽然也是他自己，但并不会把所有信息都巨细无遗地全都告诉他，只会把他认为重要的信息传递给他。

像玩家做任务这种小事，基本就不会多说。

没有！

怎么找都没有。

游戏系统中没有任何记录，既没有“你皇”做任务的记录，也没有他死亡和重生的记录。

这家伙在游戏系统中就跟个鬼影一样，找不到他，但他就是存在！

偏偏他的分-身也全都牺牲，现在就算想要搜索和查看分-身的记忆也不行。

最终洛伦米尔顿想到了一个可能，那就是他的游戏系统有漏洞，有什么东西钻入了漏洞，才会删除以及修改了“你皇”的所有信息，让他查无可查。

这一想，洛伦米尔顿顿时感到一阵发寒。

但很快，他又镇定起来。

他推测就算那东西能钻入游戏系统的漏洞，但应该还没有能力夺取游戏系统的主控权，否则那“你皇”也不用那么费事的在论坛揭露所谓游戏真相。

三天后，洛伦米尔顿看着空空荡荡的玩家营地，脸色黑得能滴出黑水。
chunks.englishText:
"What the hell is this?! I just exchanged one hundred thousand yuan for game coins yesterday! If this is real, I'm going to sue this lousy game company until they go bankrupt!"

"Professor Who Teaches What": "Analyzing from a neurological perspective, the psychic theft theory proposed by the original poster is entirely plausible..."

Meanwhile, this news began spreading like wildfire across all major social networking platforms. The topics `#TheTrueWorldOfTianheStar#` and `#HolocubePlayerSpiritsStolen#` surged to first and second place on the trending searches within half an hour.

Countless players left comments on forums demanding that the official game developers stop hiding and come out to answer questions immediately.

However, the game officials remained utterly unresponsive, as dead as a doornail.

Loren Milton couldn't see the discussions on the official game forums at all. He had merely arranged for the helmet manufacturers to casually set up such a forum to make the game look more legitimate. Normally, he just had his people on Earth post some promotional content about the game there.

Since the forum was entirely disconnected from the game system, he naturally had no way of seeing the discussions taking place on this Earth-based forum.

Whenever there was an update or any other notice, Loren Milton always used the game system itself.

Only when strictly necessary—such as collecting players' personal data or running player selections—would he contact his pawns on Earth, having them gather the relevant information and send it to him via the game system.

Yet, even if Loren Milton couldn't see the game forums, he could see the actual live data of the players logging in and out.

On the very night the players were massacred en masse, Loren Milton had been utterly furious, but he had managed to keep his cool.

He even reasoned that whoever had wiped out nearly forty thousand players must have employed some incredible power—a power that, nine times out of ten, couldn't be used frequently. If the culprit discovered three days later that all those players he had spent so much effort, time, and resources to slaughter had simply respawned, they would surely cough up blood in rage.

At this thought, Loren Milton's mood improved considerably.

Even the NPCs in those camps would be able to return. Their state was different from the players; while players still had physical bodies on Earth, these camp NPCs had lost their original bodies and were unable to seize the bodies of the local Orcs. They could only rely on him to provide player-like vessels to house their spiritual bodies.

Although this was detrimental to the cultivation of those unfortunate mages, they should thank him ten thousand times over just for ensuring their spiritual bodies remained undestroyed. Those fellows wouldn't dare to ask for too much either, which was why they had agreed to become camp NPCs in the first place—how could he save them without making them pay a price?

Therefore, after careful calculation, Loren Milton realized his losses weren't actually that heavy, and his anger subsided quite a bit.

He was even looking forward to watching the troublemaker witness the massive wave of returning players three days later.

Because nearly forty thousand players had died on almost the exact same night, their next login times would naturally be concentrated three days later.

During these three days, Loren Milton noticed that many surviving players were also logging off one after another, though he hadn't paid much attention to it at first. He had been busy recuperating from his injuries and plotting his revenge.

It wasn't until he saw a message posted by a player in the world channel via the system that alarm bells rang.

"Brothers and sisters, did you guys see Your_Emperor's post on the forum? Is this real or fake? Should we log off right now too? I'm getting kind of scared~"

The subsequent replies were mostly:
"Are you out of your mind asking this here? Can't you ask offline?"

"Idiot! Shut your trap right now."

"I was originally planning to finish this quest before logging off, but now that this moron has blown the lid off everything, I guess I have no choice but to log off immediately."

Right before Loren Milton's eyes, the player count tracked by the game system plummeted from 2,356, dropping straight to single digits in less than a few minutes.

Another blink, and the single digits were wiped clean to zero.

In other words, every single player had vanished from the Orc Continent.

Loren Milton: "!!!"

What on earth was going on here?

Loren Milton found it impossible to believe, and his rage flared so fiercely that his chest ached and grew tight.

Driven by this, Loren Milton specifically contacted his controlled puppet on Earth—a person who had been subjugated by his dreams and mental control.

However, Loren Milton had no idea that at the very moment he established contact, that person was sitting in a futuristic-looking room, stared down by multiple surveillance cameras, with microchips plastered all over his body and brain. Several computers were simultaneously monitoring his physical condition, especially his brainwave fluctuations.

Without caring in the least what kind of environment his pawn was in, Loren Milton directly ordered him to check the situation on the forum and report back.

The moment the man was contacted, his brainwave monitor went wild with frantic spikes, and his expression turned vacant and glassy, just like someone in a dream state.

The monitors watched as the man opened his computer to view the game forum, and then watched with their own eyes as he put on a gaming helmet, logged into the game, and relayed the contents he had seen on the forum outward.

Regardless of how the monitors on Earth reacted, when Loren Milton on the Orc Continent received the forum contents forwarded from Earth, he felt his vision go completely black!

It was exposed!

Why had it been exposed?

How on earth did it leak?

Who in the world was that "Your_Emperor_Retired"?

Why couldn't he delete the guy no matter what?

Panting heavily, Loren Milton's handsome features distorted hideously.

Nothing was going right—it was all going terribly wrong. Ever since that battle with Ares Shang and Raphael Lang Mu in the Tiger King's Capital, nothing had gone his way, and recently, troubles had piled up endlessly.

His player plan, which he had prepared for so long!

The game system and player spawning pools that he had poured countless time, energy, and massive resources into creating!

Was it all going to go to waste just like this?

Why had things suddenly turned out this way?

Who on earth was messing with him from the shadows?!

Loren Milton's face twisted savagely; he was so angry he felt ready to burst.

At this moment, he didn't suspect Ares Shang or Raphael Lang Mu, because in his eyes, those two were genuine natives of the Orc Continent.

*Your_Emperor_Retired!* This bastard had been abnormal from the very beginning! It was all his doing!

Chances were, the one who had used the undead corpses to ambush him and all the player camps three days ago was also this very "Emperor"!

But where was this Your_Emperor_Retired?

Who was he?

What did he look like?

Gazing at the grayed-out name in the system that stubbornly refused to be deleted, Loren Milton's eyes turned dark and terrifyingly grim.

He had to find this person!

Once he caught this bastard, he would torture him using the most cruel and agonizing methods imaginable!

Loren Milton began searching through the logs for the initial appearance of "Your_Emperor_Retired."

Actually, he had already searched the relevant records once before, but found nothing.

Hate to say it, but back then, it wasn't his main body sitting in the player camp, but an avatar.

Though the avatar was also him, it didn't relay every single minute detail back to him; it only transmitted information it deemed important.

Trivial matters like players doing quests were naturally omitted.

Nothing!

No matter how he searched, there was nothing.

There were no records whatsoever in the game system—neither logs of "Your_Emperor_Retired" completing quests, nor logs of his death and rebirth.

This fellow was like a ghost haunting the game system. You couldn't find him, yet he undeniably existed!

To make matters worse, all his avatars had been sacrificed. Even if he wanted to search and review his avatars' memories now, it was impossible.

Eventually, Loren Milton thought of a possibility: there was a loophole in his game system, and something had burrowed into that vulnerability, deleting and modifying all of "Your_Emperor_Retired's" data, leaving him with nothing to investigate.

The mere thought of this sent a chill running down Loren Milton's spine.

Yet, he quickly calmed himself down.

He deduced that even if that entity could slip through the loopholes of the game system, it shouldn't have the capacity to seize master control of the system itself. Otherwise, that "Your_Emperor_Retired" wouldn't have needed to go through the trouble of exposing the so-called game truth on the forum.

Three days later, staring at the empty, desolate player camps, Loren Milton's face turned so dark it looked as though ink could drip from it.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第235章 捅破游戏真相 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
这时的他，再也不是什么儒雅高贵的贵公子，整个人的气质都变得阴险又阴郁。

商非凡心情很好，好到就算他没有找到洛伦米尔顿躲在哪里，也没有影响太多。

他曾经用诅咒之火伤了洛伦米尔顿，如果诅咒之火造成的伤害还没有痊愈，他就可以凭借那一点诅咒之火的气息找到对方。

但对方似乎也察觉出什么，把所有气息屏蔽得干干净净。

不过没事，跑得了和尚跑不了庙，暂时找不到洛伦米尔顿也没关系，不是还有一个神殿和玩家出生池在吗？

商非凡收起了所有不死尸，现在暂时用不到这个大杀器了。

他（光球）虽然没有办法夺过游戏系统的操控权，但他可以让玩家不上线。

原本他还不想做到这种程度，毕竟玩家出现在兽人大陆对兽人们也不完全是坏事。

但洛伦米尔顿利用玩家来把他和郎沐当boss刷，那就超出他的容忍限度了，相当于在踩踏他的底线。

他和郎沐还有很多事要做，哪可能把时间都浪费在和玩家不断周旋上。

利用不死尸对付玩家也不是一回事，偶尔用一次也就算了，次次用，副作用就未知了。要是让尸毒传播出去，那他也无颜去见郎沐和莫约镇的父老乡亲不是？

他只能釜底抽薪。

对于兽人大陆来说，有玩家和没玩家也没太多影响。指望别人来拯救这个世界到底还是虚的，发展自身才是硬道理。

当然，如果他能把洛伦米尔顿手上的游戏系统给夺过来，那让玩家继续上线玩也没什么，只要大家能互利互助。
chunks.englishText:
At this moment, he was no longer the cultured, noble young master of high standing; his entire demeanor had turned sinister and gloomy.

Shang Feifan was in a great mood—so good that even though he hadn't managed to track down Loren Milton's hiding place, it didn't dampen his spirits much.

He had previously injured Loren Milton with the fire of the curse. If the damage caused by the curse fire hadn't fully healed yet, he would have been able to trace the opponent using that lingering aura of the curse.

However, the other party seemed to have sensed this, shielding all his auras completely clean.

No matter. The monk can run, but the temple can't run away. It didn't matter if Loren Milton couldn't be found for the time being; weren't the temple and the player spawning pool still right here?

Shang Feifan put away all the undead corpses; he wouldn't be needing this ultimate weapon for the time being.

Although he (in the form of the orb) had no way to wrest control of the game system, he could ensure that the players couldn't log online.

Originally, he hadn't wanted to go to such lengths; after all, players appearing on the Orc Continent wasn't entirely a bad thing for the Orcs.

However, Loren Milton utilizing the players to treat him and Lang Mu like boss monsters to farm had crossed his tolerance limit—it was equivalent to trampling all over his bottom line.

He and Lang Mu still had many things to accomplish; how could they possibly waste all their time endlessly sparring and tangling with players?

Using undead corpses to deal with players wasn't a long-term solution either. Using them once in a while was fine, but if he used them every time, the side effects would be unpredictable. If corpse poison were allowed to spread, he wouldn't even have the face to face Lang Mu and the elders and townsfolk of Moyue Town, would he?

He had no choice but to pull the firewood from under the cauldron.

For the Orc Continent, having or not having players didn't make all that much difference anyway. Expecting outsiders to save this world was ultimately an illusion; developing oneself was the hard truth.

Of course, if he could manage to snatch the game system from Loren Milton's hands, letting the players continue logging in to play would be fine—provided everyone could achieve a mutually beneficial coexistence.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第236章 收神殿和出生池 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第236章 收神殿和出生池

商非凡站在村后老破小神殿的入口处。

脚下是历经不知道多少年岁月的青石阶，不少石板已经破碎，从石板缝隙中、边缘处钻出不知名的野草。

天气寒凉，这些野草已经褪去绿色变得枯黄。

也许这里曾经有无数的信徒在此虔诚祭拜，但神殿外观并不宏伟，而浑厚的庄严感并不是神殿大小能决定。

神殿灰黑色的石壁上爬满了苍翠的藤蔓，细小的黄蕊白花点缀其间，在寒风中傲然开放。

殿门早已朽坏，半掩在厚重的苔藓之下，但踏入其中，却仿佛穿越回了某个遥远的时代。

阳光从残破的穹顶洒落，在尘埃中形成一道道金色的光柱，照亮了殿内排列整齐的石柱，每一根都雕刻着繁复的花纹，虽已磨损，却依然透着古老的神秘。

空气里没有霉腐的气息，反而弥漫着一股淡淡的幽香，也许就是来自那黄蕊的爬藤小白花，闻之令人心神宁静。

那么多玩家在这里进进出出，也没有让这座老破小神殿多一点人气，就连墙边杂草也无人去除。

商非凡心中闪过一丝诧异。

如果他是游戏系统掌控者，他一定会发布清理和重建神殿的任务给玩家。可洛伦米尔顿却没有这么做，为什么？

【因为他还无法彻底掌控这里。】光球冒出来。

“这座神殿似乎只是普通建筑？”

【普通建筑？】光球没有嘲笑商非凡，只说：【你现在还是凡人，虽然拥有两枚神格碎片，但没有吸收的你，看不到这里的特殊也不奇怪。】

商非凡心神一动，把自己的精神力连接上左手食指上戴着的戒指。

戒指戒面亮起一道暗红色的光芒。

这次商非凡再看老破小神殿就像是揭去了一层伪装，看到了神殿的骨架和真实内在。

坚韧但稳定的光线织成了网状，这张网撑起了整个神殿的筋骨皮膜，让时间磨轮的功效降到最低。所以哪怕不知多少年过去，这座神殿仍旧存在，只是外表有一些残破。

“这是炼制过的法宝？”商非凡赞叹。

【不，这也不算是特别炼制，只是九级法神亲手用一砖一瓦垒成。这座神殿融入了那名法神的力量，你也可以称之为神力。】

“但这种神力和真正神灵的神力不一样对么？”

【法神也只是九级而已。】光球意味深长地说。

商非凡明白了：想要成为真正的神灵，法神只是入门级别。

“这座神殿是为了哪位神灵而建？”

【你还没看出来吗？】

商非凡：“我已经感觉到自然之神的力量，这里面必然有自然之神雕像缺失的一部分。所以这座神殿原本也是祭拜自然之神的神殿？”

【不只是祭拜，还有沟通。那名建造这座神殿的法神认自然之神为自己的神主，希望自然之神能认可他，只有这样，他才可能踏上真正的神灵之路，被赐予神格。】

“也就是说在远古时期，神灵其实是可以联系和沟通的？”

【是。】

商非凡紧接着又问：“后来想要联系神灵的人太多，神灵嫌烦就变高冷了？”

光球：【……】

商非凡从光球的沉默中得出答案，点点头，平生第二次踏入神殿内部。

上次他来还是直接从神殿内部出来。

神殿内部看着不大，但商非凡怀疑这个神殿内部具有一定的空间之力，也就是看着不大，实际能容纳很多。

神殿内没有神像，也没有壁画，只有墙壁和石柱，以及一个个水池。

不知道的人乍来到这里还以为这里是个洗澡堂或温泉池之类的地方。

一个个不大的水池静静地嵌在石地之中。

上次他没有怎么仔细看，现在仔细看才发现池壁貌似由纯白的玉石雕琢而成，表面光滑如镜，没有一丝裂痕，仿佛时光从未在它身上留下痕迹。

池水清澈见底，却又深不可测，水面没有一丝涟漪，倒映着穹顶漏下的天光。

商非凡还记得上次的体感，这看似清澈的池水其实是粘稠的液体。

走近几步，商非凡能感觉到一种莫名的吸引力，仿佛池水在无声地呼唤他。那水面下似乎藏着某种秘密，让人不自觉地想要伸手触碰，甚至想要踏入其中。

商非凡蹲下-身，凝视着这汪池水。它既不冰冷，也不温热，触碰时反而有一种难以言喻的舒适感，仿佛灵魂都被轻柔地包裹。

池底隐约可见某种古老的纹路，像是某种早已失传的仪式阵图，又像是自然形成的脉络。

上次他来到这里，是身处一个茧子中，脑后还插着一根管子。他是拔-出了管子，又撕开了茧皮，才从池子里爬出去。

后来他问过伏向军，玩家死亡后重生，睁开眼就已经待在池子中，没有茧子，更没有脑后的管子，身上衣服都穿的好好的。

商非凡推测他看到的很可能是玩家身体重生的过程，他因为身怀另一个游戏系统的缘故才能提前醒来，并还看到了自己重生的过程。

但玩家们没有另一个系统，也没有他那么强大的精神力，等他们醒来时，重生过程已经完全结束，自然不会看到那些掉丧值的东西。

“我以为这次过来会看到几万个正待重生的茧子。”商非凡呢喃。

光球知道这是在询问它，自动回答：【这么多茧子，这点池子数量也放不下，放在这里还会让其他玩家看到。这里这么重要，洛伦米尔顿却没有派人在这里看守，原因就是……】

“这里并不是真正的雕像缺失部分，或者说这里只是雕像缺失部分的一部分？”

【对。这里只是一个排出产池，孕育玩家身体的子宫并不在这里。】

“那我拿走这个产池，对洛伦米尔顿会有影响吗？”

【会。但一般人拿不走，这里连接了缺失的小腹部分。就好像你看到了露出的一角晶石，想要撬走，却发现下面连着整块看不到尽头的巨石。除非其他神灵或自然之神亲至才能挖出。】

“我现在连接着雕像广场，算不算是自然之神亲至？”

光球沉默片刻，像是在查询，过了一会儿才回答：【以你的精神海做通道，打开雕像广场，现在的自然之神可以主动收回这些池子。】

商非凡直接问：“对我有害吗？”

光球像是知道他会这么问，很快回答：【不会。奖励也照旧。】

它还补充：【以前这么做，你的精神体会受损，但现在不会，你现在的精神体比以前更强大和坚韧数倍。以前自然之神也没有办法从异度空间直接收取自己的力量，但现在收回数份力量的祂勉强可以做到这点了。只不过还需要你这个媒介直接碰触水池。】

商非凡二话不说蹲到了水池边，手掌直接按住水池边沿，同时打开了雕像广场。

平时他打开雕像广场都是为了进出或取放物品，速度都很快，但这次他有意延长了打开时间。

一股说不出的奇怪力量涌入他的精神海，又顺着他的手臂延伸出去。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 236: Claiming the Temple and the Spawning Pool

Shang Feifan stood at the entrance of the dilapidated, weather-beaten old temple behind the village.

Beneath his feet lay bluestone steps that had endured countless years of weathering. Many of the stone slabs were fractured, and nameless wild grass sprouted from their cracks and edges.

The weather was chilly, and these weeds had already faded from green to a withered, desolate yellow.

Perhaps countless believers had once offered fervent prayers here, yet the temple's exterior was far from grandiose; a deep sense of solemnity was never determined by the size of a temple.

The gray-black stone walls of the temple were choked with lush, climbing vines, punctuated by tiny yellow-pistilled white flowers that bloomed defiantly against the biting wind.

The temple doors had long since rotted away, half-buried under a thick blanket of moss, yet stepping inside felt like traversing back into some distant era.

Sunlight streamed down from the shattered dome, forming golden pillars of light amidst the dancing dust, illuminating the neatly aligned stone pillars within. Each pillar was carved with intricate patterns which, though worn, still radiated an ancient, mystical aura.

The air carried no scent of mold or decay; instead, it was permeated with a faint, elegant fragrance—likely originating from those little climbing vines with yellow stamens—and breathing it in instantly calmed one's mind and spirit.

Despite all the players bustling in and out of here, this dilapidated old temple had never gained an extra ounce of mortal vitality, and even the weeds growing along the walls remained unplucked.

A trace of surprise flashed through Shang Feifan's mind.

If he were the controller of the game system, he definitely would have issued quests to the players to clean and rebuild the temple. Yet Loren Milton had not done so. Why?

[Because he still cannot completely control this place,] the orb popped out to say.

"This temple looks like an ordinary building?"

[An ordinary building?] The orb didn't mock Shang Feifan, merely stating: [You are still a mortal right now. Though you possess two divine persona fragments, it's not strange that you fail to see the special nature of this place since you haven't absorbed them.]

With a slight shift in his consciousness, Shang Feifan connected his spiritual force to the ring worn on the index finger of his left hand.

The surface of the ring flared with a dim red glow.

This time, when Shang Feifan looked at the dilapidated old temple, it was as if a layer of camouflage had been stripped away, revealing the temple's skeletal frame and true inner essence.

Tough yet stable rays of light were woven into a web-like formation. This web supported the entire sinews, bones, and skin of the temple, reducing the corrosion of the wheel of time to a bare minimum. Thus, no matter how many years had passed, this temple still stood, albeit with a slightly weathered exterior.

"Is this a forged magical treasure?" Shang Feifan praised in wonder.

[No, you can't really call it specially forged. It was merely stacked brick by brick, tile by tile, by a Ninth-Rank Dharma God. This temple has integrated that Dharma God's power—you could also call it divine power.]

"But this kind of divine power is different from the true divine power of genuine deities, right?"

[A Dharma God is only at the Ninth-Rank, after all,] the orb said with profound meaning.

Shang Feifan understood: if one wished to become a true deity, being a Dharma God was merely the entry-level threshold.

"Whose honor was this temple built to serve?"

[Haven't you figured it out yet?]

Shang Feifan replied: "I can already sense the power of the God of Nature; there is bound to be a missing fragment of the God of Nature's statue hidden inside here. So this temple was originally a shrine dedicated to worshiping the God of Nature?"

[Not just worship, but communication. The Dharma God who built this temple acknowledged the God of Nature as his divine master, hoping that the God of Nature would grant him recognition. Only by doing so could he possibly step onto the path of true divinity and be bestowed with a divine persona.]

"In other words, back in ancient times, mortals could actually contact and communicate with deities?"

[Indeed.]

Shang Feifan followed up immediately: "And later on, too many people wanted to contact the deities, so the deities found it annoying and started acting all aloof and cold?"

The orb: [...]

Shang Feifan deduced the answer from the orb's silence, nodded, and stepped into the interior of the temple for only the second time in his life.

The last time he came here, he had emerged directly from the depths of the temple.

The interior didn't look very large, but Shang Feifan suspected that it possessed a certain degree of spatial power—meaning it looked small on the outside, but could actually accommodate a vast expanse within.

There were no statues inside the temple, nor were there any murals; there were only bare walls and stone pillars, alongside rows upon rows of pools.

Anyone arriving here blindly at first glance might mistake it for a bathhouse or a hot spring resort.

Small, unassuming pools were quietly embedded into the stone floor.

Last time, he hadn't looked closely, but inspecting them carefully now, he noticed the pool walls seemed to be carved from pure white jade, their surfaces as smooth as a mirror without the slightest trace of a crack, as if time had never left a mark upon them.

The pool water was crystal clear yet unfathomably deep, completely devoid of ripples, reflecting the heavenly light leaking down from the dome.

Shang Feifan still remembered the physical sensation from last time: this seemingly clear pool water was actually a viscous, gelatinous liquid.

Approaching by a few paces, Shang Feifan could sense an inexplicable attractive force, as though the pool water were silently calling out to him. A hidden secret seemed to lurk beneath the surface, making one instinctively want to reach out and touch it, or even step right into it.

Shang Feifan squatted down, gazing intently at the body of water. It was neither icy nor warm; instead, touching it brought an indescribable sense of comfort, as though his soul were being gently wrapped in a warm embrace.

Faint ancient patterns were vaguely visible at the bottom of the pool, resembling some long-lost ritualistic array diagram, or perhaps naturally formed spiritual veins.

When he had arrived here last time, he had been trapped inside a cocoon with a tube plugged into the back of his head. It was only after pulling out the tube and tearing open the cocoon skin that he had crawled out of the pool.

Later, when he asked Fu Xiangjun, he learned that when players died and respawned, they opened their eyes to find themselves already lying inside the pool—no cocoons, no tubes at the back of the head, and their clothes fully intact.

Shang Feifan deduced that what he had witnessed was likely the actual process of player physical rebirth. Because he possessed another game system, he had been able to wake up prematurely and witness the process of his own rebirth.

The players, however, lacked another system and didn't possess his formidable spiritual force. By the time they regained consciousness, the rebirth process had already concluded entirely, so naturally, they wouldn't see those things that drained sanity.

"I thought that coming here this time, I would see tens of thousands of cocoons waiting to be reborn," Shang Feifan murmured.

Knowing this was a query directed at it, the orb automatically chimed in: [With this many cocoons, this small number of pools wouldn't hold them all anyway, and leaving them out in the open would expose them to other players. Since this place is so crucial, why didn't Loren Milton send guards to watch over it? The reason is...]

"This isn't the true missing part of the statue, or rather, this is only a fraction of the missing statue part?"

[Correct. This is merely a discharge production pool; the womb that nurtures the players' bodies is not located here.]

"If I take this production pool away, will it affect Loren Milton?"

[It will. But ordinary people cannot take it away; this place is connected to the missing lower abdomen portion. It's like seeing the exposed corner of a crystal deposit and wanting to pry it away, only to discover it's connected to an endless, subterranean bedrock monolith. Unless another deity or the God of Nature descends in person, it cannot be excavated.]

"I am currently connected to the Statue Plaza—does that count as the God of Nature descending in person?"

The orb fell silent for a moment, as if checking its internal records, before replying: [Using your sea of consciousness as a conduit to open the Statue Plaza, the present God of Nature can proactively recall these pools.]

Shang Feifan asked straight to the point: "Is it harmful to me?"

As if anticipating he would ask, the orb answered promptly: [No. The rewards remain as before.]

It added: [Doing this in the past would have damaged your spiritual body, but not anymore; your current spiritual body is several times stronger and more resilient than before. In the past, the God of Nature had no way to directly harvest His own power from a different dimensional plane, but now, reclaiming a few portions of His power is something He can barely manage. However, it still requires you, the medium, to make direct contact with the pools.]

Without another word, Shang Feifan squatted down beside the pool, pressed his palm directly against the rim, and simultaneously opened the Statue Plaza.

Normally, whenever he opened the Statue Plaza to enter, exit, or store items, the process was instantaneous. But this time, he deliberately prolonged the opening duration.

An indescribable, bizarre force surged into his sea of consciousness, extending outward along his arm.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第236章 收神殿和出生池 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
过程非常快，还没等到他细细体会，这座小神殿中几十口小池子全都原地消失。

奇妙的是，神殿地面竟然也没有几十个土坑出现，就像原本就没有这些小池子一样，平平整整。

另一边，位于裂谷之下的某个秘密洞穴中竟然隐藏了一座宫殿。

整座宫殿如同雌性兽人隆起的孕腹，呈现出柔和的卵形轮廓。半透明的琥珀色宫壁上，天然形成的金色纹路如同血脉般蜿蜒流淌，散发着温暖而神圣的微光。

然而这份神圣感却被内部的景象彻底颠覆。

数以万计的人形茧囊垂挂在穹顶之下，每个都由半透明的膜衣包裹。透过膜衣可以清晰看见里面正在成型的躯体——有的刚刚勾勒出骨架轮廓，有的已经长出完整的肌肉纤维，最接近完成的那些甚至能看见睫毛在微微颤动。

当有相应的精神体进入茧子时，该茧子就会自动传送到神殿出生池，玩家也会在那里出生。

每具玩家躯体的脑后都延伸出一根暗红色的导管，这些导管并非连接宫壁，而是全部汇集到宫殿中央一台走错地点的未来风机器上。

矗立在孕育之宫中央的是一台极具未来科技感的巨型机械构造，整体呈圆柱形，表面覆盖着银灰色合金板，板隙间不时流过数据流般的蓝色光痕。

这座柱形机器就是游戏主脑。

主脑基座由五层同心圆环构成，每一层都在以不同速率缓缓旋转，环间蓝色光线不断穿梭，实时显示着数万名玩家的神经活跃度数据。

最引人注目的是悬浮在柱形结构最尾端的透明球形容器。这就像是一台额外的附加物，只看做工和材质就和整体机器不同。

那是一颗直径两米的透明球形容器，就像是魔法师常用的水晶球，内部充盈着液态的能量，如同被束缚的星云般缓慢涡旋。

容器中部连接着数千条纤细的神经导管，每条导管都链接着某个玩家的意识端口。

随着机械运转，容器内沉淀出一滴滴晶莹剔透的纯态精神力。

精神力浓郁到液化，慢慢滴落进底部的透明药剂瓶中。

这显然是精神力萃取仪器。

整台机器的运作伴随着近乎宗教仪式般的精密美感，又像是科技之力和神力以及魔法的结合物。

可是就在这座充满神性和未来风的宫殿的一角，又堆放了大量的尸体。

那些尸体或残破缺损或四肢干瘪，没有一个像是正常的尸体。

这些都是沉睡中的不死尸！

巨大的机械夹子夹起一具具不死尸扔入处理仓，再添加其他材料……

躲在宫殿一角的洛伦米尔顿一口血喷出。

是真一口血喷了出来，里面甚至还夹杂着内脏碎片！

洛伦米尔顿脸色极度苍白，走到精神力萃取球边，取下之前滴满的一瓶精神力补充剂，仰头倒入口中，抬手抹去嘴角血迹，眼神阴沉到极点。

就在刚刚有人硬生生切断了他和神秘物品孕育之宫的一部分，也就是和产池之间的联系。

他和孕育之宫可是建立了神魂联系，伤害和夺走孕育之宫，就相当于在伤害他。

孕育之宫还在他这边，他现在就待在孕育之宫里面。

产池原本和孕育之宫相连，是一个完整的整体。

但他天性多疑，也担心有玩家会发现孕育之宫的秘密，就利用秘法把孕育之宫和产池分离。

两者分离后就一个不好，那就是只能守着其中一处，他权衡利弊，自然选择了守着更重要的孕育之宫。这样还能用产池当做烟雾-弹，迷惑有心人。

为了安顿产池，他还耗费心力找到那座祭祀自然之神并有残留神力的神殿。

也是因为找到那座位于天残村后方的神殿，他才会灵机一动，把玩家的身体都设计为天残，还给自己安了一个天残谷主的名头。

动手的人一定是“你皇”！

他是玩家，自然知道那神殿和出生池所在。

之前玩家还从天残村走，后来因为天残村民对玩家的排斥，他就给玩家找了另外一条通道，可以绕过天残村，从另一条道走出天残谷，直达一号玩家营地。

洛伦米尔顿从来没有担心过有人会取走出生池，就算有人发现也没什么。

何况玩家进进出出的地方，就算他再怎么隐藏，也会被人发现，那还不如就大大方方地放在那里。

他做过实验，非玩家的人连神殿中的池子都看不到，更别说取走。

那可是神灵的力量，非神灵不可移动。

要么就是像他这样，机缘巧合获得了部分神的物品，并利用秘法和神的物品融合。

他虽然还没有能彻底融合孕育之宫以及游戏系统主脑，但他让那两样物品认主了，他至少可以操控它们。

可是“你皇”为什么能取走产池？

他到底是什么人？

洛伦米尔顿想不通，他原本想迅速赶往神殿查看情况，这会儿却踟躇起来。

如果“你皇”和神灵有关，那他赶过去会不会变成送菜？

他身上可还有两样神灵物品，如果“你皇”也想夺过去怎么办？

难得的，洛伦米尔顿在愤怒之外感觉到了恐慌。

他的气运一定出问题了！

不行，他不能这样下去，他得找到兽人大陆的气运之子，把对方的气运给夺取过来！

郎沐的气运也许只是对法德尔大陆有用，也许郎沐的气运在他来到兽人大陆并屡次得到一些奇遇后已经消耗得差不多。

他得补充新的气运，他得找到新的气运之子……

洛伦米尔顿站起身。

他原本不想再做相关方面的推算，那会让他耗费大量物资和心力，对他自身损耗不小。

可现在已经到了他不推算不行的时候。

他可不想才开始的伟业就这么停住。

可惜今天玩家就没有几个上线，否则他还能利用数万玩家的精神力帮他一把。到时候反噬平摊，他的损耗也不会太大。

可恨“你皇”！

另一头，神殿中商非凡还在询问光球：“只是收回池子，主要缺失的小腹部分还没有收回，所以这个主线任务还不算完成？”

【不算。但如果你非常想要结算的话，可以按照五分之一的贡献点数结算给你。】

“那就结算。”哪怕现在贡献点充足，商非凡也不想放过两千点的奖励。

东西到手才是他的，谁知道以后怎么样？说不定他要买什么，正好差两千，现在拿下总比需要时掏不出来要好。

光球沉默片刻：【已结算。】

商非凡看到自己的贡献点数从46701变成48701，满意了。

男人怎么可以没有存款呢？

没有存款，在爱人面前腰杆子都挺不直。

“对了，洛伦米尔顿失去这些池子，他还能让玩家出生吗？”

【能，只是缺少产池而已。不过产池也很重要，可以去除不死尸的尸毒，确保玩家身体具有一定活性。否则洛伦米尔顿利用自然之神力量糅合而出的玩家身体也只是新的不死尸。】

光球拒绝说出“孕育”这个词。
chunks.englishText:
The process was extremely fast. Before he could even carefully sense the changes, dozens of small pools within the small shrine vanished on the spot.

Curiously, not a single pit was left behind on the shrine's floor; it was as smooth and flat as if those small pools had never existed in the first place.

On the other side, within a secret cavern located beneath the rift valley, a palace was mysteriously hidden.

The entire palace resembled the swollen womb of a female orc, presenting a soft, oval contour. Across the translucent amber-colored palace walls, naturally formed golden veins meandered like blood vessels, emitting a warm and sacred, faint glow.

Yet this sense of holiness was completely subverted by the interior scene.

Tens of thousands of humanoid cocoons hung suspended beneath the dome, each wrapped in a translucent membrane. Through the membranes, the bodies forming inside could be clearly seen—some had just outlined skeletal frames, others had already grown complete muscle fibers, and the ones closest to completion even had eyelashes that twitched ever so slightly.

When a corresponding spirit body entered a cocoon, that cocoon would automatically teleport to the shrine's birth pool, and the player would be born there.

A dark red conduit extended from the back of the head of every player's body. These conduits did not connect to the palace walls; instead, all of them converged upon a futuristic machine in the center of the palace that seemed terribly out of place.

Standing in the very middle of the Womb Palace was a giant mechanical structure with an intensely futuristic sci-fi aesthetic. Cylindrical in overall shape, its surface was covered in silvery-gray alloy plates, between the gaps of which blue, data-like streaks of light occasionally flowed.

This pillar-like machine was the game's Main Brain.

The base of the Main Brain consisted of five layers of concentric rings, each rotating slowly at different rates. Blue beams of light constantly shuttled between the rings, displaying the neural activity data of tens of thousands of players in real-time.

Most eye-catching was the transparent spherical container suspended at the very tail end of the cylindrical structure. It looked like an extra attachment; just looking at its workmanship and material, it was distinct from the rest of the machine.

That was a transparent spherical container two meters in diameter, resembling the crystal balls commonly used by mages. The interior was filled with liquid energy, swirling slowly like a trapped nebula.

The middle of the container was connected to thousands of slender neural conduits, and every single conduit was linked to a certain player's consciousness port.

As the machinery operated, drop by drop of crystal-clear, pure-state spiritual force precipitated within the container.

The spiritual force was so dense it had liquefied, slowly dripping down into a transparent potion bottle at the bottom.

This was clearly a spiritual force extraction instrument.

The operation of the entire machine was accompanied by a precision and beauty bordering on a religious ritual, resembling a fusion of technological might, divine power, and magic.

Yet in a corner of this palace, filled with divinity and futuristic vibes, a massive pile of corpses was stacked.

Those corpses were either mutilated and incomplete or withered and shriveled in the limbs; not a single one looked like a normal corpse.

These were dormant Undead Corpses!

Giant mechanical clamps picked up the Undead Corpses one by one and threw them into a processing chamber, alongside other added materials...

Hiding in the corner of the palace, Loren Milton spat out a mouthful of blood.

It was a genuine mouthful of blood, and fragments of internal organs were even mixed within it!

Loren Milton's face turned extremely pale. He walked over to the spiritual force extraction orb, removed a bottle of spiritual force supplement that had just filled up, tilted his head back to pour it into his mouth, raised a hand to wipe the blood from the corner of his mouth, and his gaze turned gloomy to the extreme.

Just a moment ago, someone had forcefully severed his connection with a part of the mysterious item, the Womb Palace—specifically, the connection with the birth pools.

He had established a divine soul connection with the Womb Palace; to damage and plunder the Womb Palace was equivalent to inflicting harm upon himself.

The Womb Palace was still on his side, and he was currently staying inside it.

The birth pools were originally connected to the Womb Palace, forming an integrated whole.

However, being naturally suspicious and worried that players might discover the secret of the Womb Palace, he had used a secret art to separate the Womb Palace from the birth pools.

Once the two were separated, the downside was that he could only guard one of them. Weighing the pros and cons, he naturally chose to guard the more important Womb Palace. This way, he could also use the birth pools as a smoke screen to confuse anyone with ulterior motives.

To settle the birth pools, he had even spent great effort finding that shrine which worshipped the God of Nature and still retained residual divine power.

It was precisely because he found that shrine located behind Heaven-Defect Village that he had a flash of inspiration: he designed all the players' bodies to be physically defective (heaven-defects), and bestowed upon himself the title of Master of Heaven-Defect Valley.

The person who made a move was definitely "Your Majesty"!

Being a player, he naturally knew the location of that shrine and the birth pools.

Previously, players used to pass through Heaven-Defect Village. Later, due to the villagers' hostility toward players, he found another route for the players that bypassed Heaven-Defect Village, allowing them to exit Heaven-Defect Valley via a different path and lead straight to Player Camp No. 1.

Loren Milton had never worried that someone would take away the birth pools; even if someone discovered them, it didn't matter much.

Besides, given that players were constantly walking in and out of the place, no matter how hard he tried to hide it, it would eventually be discovered. So, he might as well place it there openly and generously.

He had experimented: non-players couldn't even see the pools in the shrine, let alone take them away.

That was the power of deities; nothing short of a deity could move them.

Unless it was someone like him, who had accidentally obtained a portion of a deity's items and used a secret art to fuse with them.

Although he hadn't been able to completely fuse with the Womb Palace and the game system's main brain, he had made those two items recognize him as master, allowing him to at least control them.

Yet why could "Your Majesty" take away the birth pools?

Just what kind of person was he?

Loren Milton couldn't figure it out. Originally, he had wanted to rush to the shrine to check the situation, but now he hesitated.

If "Your Majesty" was connected to deities, would his rushing over there be tantamount to serving himself up as food?

He still had two divine items on him; what if "Your Majesty" wanted to snatch those away as well?

For the first time in memory, amid his anger, Loren Milton felt panic.

His destiny and luck must have gone wrong!

No, he couldn't go on like this. He had to find the Son of Destiny of the Orc Continent and usurp the other party's luck!

Lang Mu's luck might have only been useful on the Fadel Continent, or perhaps Lang Mu's luck had already been nearly exhausted after he arrived on the Orc Continent and repeatedly encountered various fortuitous encounters.

He needed to replenish his new luck; he had to find a new Son of Destiny...

Loren Milton stood up.

He originally didn't want to make any more calculations regarding destiny, as that would consume a massive amount of resources and mental effort, dealing a considerable toll to himself.

Yet the situation had reached a point where he couldn't afford *not* to calculate.

He certainly didn't want the grand enterprise he had just begun to stall right here.

Pity that today very few players were online; otherwise, he could have used the spiritual force of tens of thousands of players to give himself a hand. By then, the karmic backlash would be shared out, and his own toll wouldn't be too heavy.

Hate that "Your Majesty"!

On the other side, within the shrine, Shang Feifan was still questioning the sphere of light: "We only took back the pools, but the main missing lower-abdomen part hasn't been recovered yet. So this main quest doesn't count as completed?"

[It does not. But if you are very eager to settle it, it can be settled for you in proportion to one-fifth of the contribution points.]

"Then settle it." Even with ample contribution points right now, Shang Feifan didn't want to miss out on the reward of two thousand points.

Items were truly his only when they were in his hands; who knew what the future held? Perhaps he would need to buy something and happen to be short by two thousand—getting it now was always better than not being able to pull it out when needed.

The light sphere fell silent for a moment: [Settled.]

Shang Feifan watched his contribution points jump from 46,701 to 48,701, and he felt satisfied.

How could a man manage without savings?

Without savings, one couldn't even stand up straight in front of their beloved.

"Right, since Loren Milton lost those pools, can he still make players be born?"

[Yes, he is merely lacking the birth pools. However, the birth pools are also crucial; they can purge the corpse poison from the Undead Corpses and ensure that the players' bodies possess a certain degree of vitality. Otherwise, the player bodies that Loren Milton synthesizes using the power of the God of Nature would merely be new Undead Corpses.]

The light sphere stubbornly refused to utter the word "gestation/womb".

chunks.chapterTitle: 第236章 收神殿和出生池 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
这可不是而已。有产池泡就是活的，没产池泡就是死的，这区别可是生和死的区别。商非凡想。

“也不知道那人渣到底躲到什么地方了。”商非凡叹息不能一锅端，他多想一次性就把洛伦米尔顿搞定。

但人渣就是人渣，绝不会英雄一声吼——自己跳出来找死，更不会光明正大地跟他叫板。

相反对方越是发现自己弱势，越是会躲起来积蓄力量，然后暗中寻求报复机会。

商非凡也没纠结，他现在相当于断了洛伦米尔顿最大的臂助。只要那家伙能老实窝一段时间，让他和郎沐有时间把黑水荒原岩浆爆发的事解决，之后他们俩也能腾出手，专心收拾这个人渣。

想通的商非凡就打算回转天残村，把阿呆接出来。

【你不想收起这座神殿吗？】光球挡住想走的商非凡。

商非凡眼睛一眨：“收起这座神殿有什么好处？”

竟然能让光球主动提起。

光球：【这是奉献给自然之神的神殿，你走的是黑暗能量的路子，这座神殿你用不上。但你用不上，可以给郎沐。他的随身花圃如果加入这座神殿，炼化后可以再升一级，对郎沐感知和操控自然之力也有莫大好处。】

商非凡一听，二话不说，卷袖子就问：“要怎么把这座神殿带走？”

半天后，给家里人带上丰富土特产以至于心情特别好的商非凡来到天残村。

阿呆看到他商爸就扑了过来。

“爸爸，村长叔叔有事想跟你说。”

小家伙在天残村这几天过得显然很不错，不说红光满面，也是精神满满。

他把欺负过他的幼崽全都狠狠教训了一通——别问他用了什么手段，反正现在村里所有幼崽都羡慕妒忌他的不得了。

商非凡想到他叮嘱村长这段时间不要离开村落时村长欲言又止的表情，有点不太想去听村长想要对他说什么。

他的直觉告诉他，村长即将告诉他的事十有八-九会很麻烦。

不过他今天心情好，那就听听吧。
chunks.englishText:
This was no small matter. To soak in a birth pool meant being alive, while lacking one meant being dead—this distinction was literally the difference between life and death, Shang Feifan thought.

"I just don't know where that scoundrel has gone to hide." Shang Feifan sighed that he couldn't wipe them out in one fell swoop. He longed more than anything to deal with Loren Milton once and for all.

Yet a scoundrel was a scoundrel; he would never roar out like a hero and leap out to court death, nor would he brazenly challenge him in broad daylight.

On the contrary, the more the fellow discovered his own weakness, the more he would hide away to accumulate strength, and then secretly seek opportunities for revenge.

Shang Feifan didn't dwell on it. Right now, he had effectively severed Loren Milton's biggest assistant. As long as that bastard could honestly hunker down for a while and give him and Lang Mu time to resolve the magma eruption in the Blackwater Wasteland, the two of them would be able to free up their hands afterward to deal exclusively with this scoundrel.

Having figured it out, Shang Feifan intended to turn back to Heaven-Defect Village and fetch Ah Dai out.

[Don't you want to take this shrine with you?] The light sphere blocked Shang Feifan, who was about to leave.

Shang Feifan blinked: "What benefits are there to taking this shrine?"

To think it could prompt the light sphere to bring it up on its own initiative.

The light sphere: [This is a shrine dedicated to the God of Nature. You walk the path of dark energy, so this shrine is of no use to you. However, since you can't use it, you can give it to Lang Mu. If his portable garden absorbs this shrine and refines it, it can ascend by another rank, which will also be of immense benefit to Lang Mu's perception and control of natural forces.]

Upon hearing this, Shang Feifan didn't say another word. He rolled up his sleeves and asked: "How do we take this shrine away?"

Half a day later, Shang Feifan arrived at Heaven-Defect Village, in an exceptionally good mood after bringing back an abundance of local specialties for his family.

Upon seeing his Shang Dad, Ah Dai immediately lunged forward.

"Dad, Uncle Village Chief has something he wants to tell you."

The little fellow had clearly spent the past few days in Heaven-Defect Village quite well. Not to mention glowing with health, he was full of spirit.

He had thoroughly thrashed all the cubs who used to bully him—don't ask what methods he used, but anyway, all the cubs in the village now envied and glared at him with jealousy.

Remembering the village chief's hesitant expression when he had previously instructed him not to leave the village during this period, Shang Feifan was somewhat reluctant to hear what the village chief wanted to tell him.

His intuition told him that whatever the village chief was about to tell him would, nine times out of ten, be a huge hassle.

Still, he was in a good mood today, so he might as well listen.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第237章 天残村长的委托 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第237章 天残村长的委托

“这次要跟兄弟你说的事，阿呆可能也跟你提过。”天残村村长未语先叹气。

商非凡刚要回忆阿呆跟他提过村里什么事，阿呆就在旁边小声叨叨：“我就说村里幼崽被人带走有问题。”

商非凡捏住阿呆的嘴巴，示意村长详细说说。

村长苦笑，“阿呆说得没错，我们村那些无法养活的幼崽被带走一事确实有问题，但我们却又不能不这样做。”

这次不止村长在场，还有三位看起来就很苍老的老兽人也在。

其中一名雄性老兽人一边搓着草绳，一边对商非凡说道：“这事不怪村长，是我们全村人的决定。你也别先评价我们，先听听这件事的始末。”

商非凡耐着性子，点头：“请说。”

村长在让阿呆去请商非凡时就已经下定决心要把事情全部说出来。

他和村老们商量过，他们已经找不到其他能帮助他们的人，如果商非凡只是个普通的富有的修理商，他们连提都不会提。可他们……偷看到大量不死尸攻击天残谷外那个奇怪兽人们聚集的大营地，再加上商非凡提前警告过他们，这不摆明了攻击那个营地和城堡的人和商非凡有关？

天残村过得闭塞，人际来往更是贫瘠，他们能认识的有能力的人物不多，更别说有能力有权力还有钱的大人物。

如今好不容易发现一个貌似不凡的人物，对方还和他们有了一点交情。村长和村老们的心就活动起来。

至于说对方很可能会操纵不死尸，走的不是正常天赋血脉的路子，但这点重要吗？

重要的是阿呆相信他。

阿呆在村里时就是一个比较特殊的孩子，别看他小，但他很会看人，他似乎天生就知道哪些人能信任、哪些人不能接近。

他能躲过“领养”，一个小幼崽在没有长辈特意照顾的情况下，还能磕磕巴巴长到那么大，一直等到商非凡前来，就足以说明他比其他幼崽的生存力要强得多。

阿呆能把这人带回来炫耀，就表明这人在人品上绝对没问题。

主要也是那件事在他们心里像根刺一样，明知道有问题却又没有能力处理，让他们平时睡觉都睡不安稳。

他们也就是想要试试。

幸运的是，商非凡摆出了愿意聆听的态度。

这就是一个很好的开始，不管商最后会不会答应他们的请求，至少这个秘密他们可以分享给别人，一旦天残村出什么事，不至于这个秘密就此被淹没。

接下来村长就跟商非凡说了他们村的艰难状况和困境。

因为天残村容量有限且自身回血能力不足，根本无法养育太多孩童。

加上附近兽人又歧视他们，让他们无法扩大采集和狩猎地盘，有适合耕种的田地那更是完全争夺不来。

在这种情况下，外面人还老是往天残谷这边扔天残幼崽，少的时候一年有十来个，多的时候能达到二三十个。

天残村实在无法养育这么多幼崽，可又不能对这些幼崽不管不顾，只能勒紧裤腰带度日。

但天长地久，村里的兽人互相结婚也生有子女，任何人都会更疼爱自己的孩子，当村里强行要求大家挤出粮食和生活资源喂养被抛弃的陌生幼崽，因此导致自家孩子饿得嗷嗷叫后，村民们爆发了。

村民们可以理解村长和村老们愿意接受那些被抛弃的天残幼崽的心，他们自己也是这么被养育长大，但任何事情都要有个度，当自己和自己孩子都活不下去的时候，还想要让他们兼济他人，那已经不是为难人，而是在逼死人。

村长和长老们也知道事情不能继续这样，他们想要多赚粮食和生活资源，但苦于周围太贫瘠，他们想做苦力都没人要。

就在他们极为为难之时，出现了一支冒险者小队。

“这支小队的成员都很强大，也很富有。他们在无意间发现我们村，并发现我们村的困境后，就说要帮助我们。他们帮助我们的方式不是给我们提供生活物资和粮食，也不是雇佣我们当工人，而是说要领养我们村养不活的孩子。”

“一开始我们犹豫，害怕这些孩子被带走会遇到不好的事情，但那支小队答应我们，可以让我们定期去探望那些被带走的孩子。如果我们觉得那些孩子过得不好，或者孩子自己想要跟我们走，那就可以把孩子带走。”

“我们当时真的太难了，又恰逢粮食最缺少的冬季，如果不答应，村里不少幼崽说不定就得饿死。后来村里集体商量，最终答应那支冒险小队带走我们村养不活的幼崽。”

“不过那支冒险小队也不是所有幼崽都要，他们会经过一定挑选。我们也不知道他们挑选的条件是什么，反正有身体较为强壮的被选中，也有病恹恹的被选中。”

村长忽然加了一句：“他们带走幼崽，原本要给我们村一笔抚养费，我们村没要。我们只希望那些孩子能活下去，如果不是村里实在太难，没办法养活那么多孩子，我们也不至于让外面人领走那些被抛弃的幼崽。”

商非凡听到这里，打断问：“那队人每年都来挑选幼崽？”

“是。差不多每年都来，且都是每年冬季。”村长顿了顿，“按照往年时间，他们最近就会过来一趟。”

商非凡颔首：“那你们去定期探望过那些被带走的孩子吗？”

“当然！”村长迅速回答：“每年他们过来选人，我们都会跟着他们一起去他们的地盘，探望那些被带走的幼崽过得怎么样。”

商非凡了然：“你们亲眼看到那些被带走的幼崽貌似过得还可以，但你们还是察觉到有些地方不对劲，对么？”

村长再次露出苦涩笑容：“是。”

“村长去过一次，回来跟我说了情况，我跟着去过两次。”这次说话的是另一名看起来比较精壮的老人，对方声音较为嘶哑，似乎很久都没有说过话。

“就如你所说，表面看起来似乎那些孩子都过得还可以，他们有温暖坚固的住房，虽然一个房间睡十来个孩子，但每个孩子都有自己的床，还有暖和干净的铺盖。穿的衣服也洁净没有破损，大小也算适合，虽然是统一的服装。”

“他们吃的食物也不算太差，虽然都是不知道原材料是什么的糊糊，但至少能吃饱。”

“他们还上课，有人教授他们知识和捕猎技巧。”

老人说到这里，一顿：“兽人都要学会怎么捕猎，但捕猎技巧往往也是和他人厮杀的本事。那些孩子被训练得像士兵一样，令行禁止，并丝毫不畏惧疼痛和受伤，我怀疑他们连对死亡的恐惧都被压到最低。”

村长舔了舔嘴唇，苦涩地道：“我们村虽然穷且养不起太多孩子，但那些孩子在村里时都是真正的幼崽，各有各的性格，大多都很调皮，除非饿到不能动。但那些孩子全都像是一个模子套出来一样，他们的眼睛里……没有光，只有麻木和听令。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 237: The Heaven-Defect Village Chief's Commission
