Shang Feifan didn't even bother to mock Loren Milton; he simply rubbed his lips together, producing that insect-like chirping incantation once more.

"Ahhh—!" Loren Milton rolled on the ground, clutching his head and letting out agonizing screams.

His brain felt like it was being churned into paste.

Forget about questioning or bewitching; he couldn’t even muster a curse.

The chirping sound simulated by Shang Feifan grew sharper; he was intentionally torturing this piece of human trash!

The Fortune-Stealing Bug could extract fortune without the victim noticing, but now, while stealing the fortune, it was also devouring Loren Milton’s mental energy.

If one could see into Loren Milton’s sea of consciousness, they would see a bug gnawing away at it like a caterpillar eating a leaf, all while returning the stolen fortune to its original owner at an accelerated rate.

Speed meant recklessness; it meant having no regard for the damage caused to Loren Milton’s spirit.

Loren Milton writhed in pain, frantically fumbling for his spatial storage tools, chugging down any potion he could get his hands on.

He didn’t want to die! He didn't want to die!

The Flower Bug couldn't help but fly over to join the fun, pecking here and biting there. It wasn't satisfied with just a few bites of fresh flesh, and fearing that too much energy would dissipate if this guy died, it simply bit through the skin of his chest and burrowed inside.

It was going to feast on the hot, tender, and energy-rich heart and internal organs.

"Ahhh—! No—! Get out!"

"Spare me! Spare me! Xiao Mu, I was wrong. I shouldn’t have deceived you. No, I didn’t deceive you, I really loved you back then, I just... ahhh!"

"You... vicious... bastards! I curse you! I will use my soul and my life to curse you...! You will meet a miserable end, you..."

Curses? Excellent!

Shang Feifan smiled, though the warmth didn't reach his eyes. He casually drew a circle in the air and performed a rebounding gesture: "Those who owe nothing are not cursed. All the curses you cast upon others shall fall back upon yourself."

Such a childish gesture and language transformed into a black net, instantly shrouding Loren Milton as he rolled in agony and spewed venomous curses.

The Fortune-Stealing Bug completed its mission, bursting out from the crown of Loren Milton’s head, taking with it the last shred of fortune that did not belong to him.

Lang Mu finished absorbing his own fortune and sensed changes in his mental energy and internal power.

"A-Shang." Lang Mu grabbed Shang Feifan’s arm.

Shang Feifan sensed Lang Mu’s urgent shift through their shared connection and immediately sent Lang Mu into the Statue Plaza.

With Lang Mu gone, Shang Feifan no longer needed to pretend.

He bared a savage grin, his expression as terrifying as it could be.

He had wanted to beat this piece of trash to a pulp for a long time; holding back until now had been agonizing!

Shang Feifan’s palm, carrying the force of a thunderbolt, slammed into Loren Milton’s face.

*Slap!*

Loren Milton’s face was smashed sideways, his body hitting the cave wall like a ragdoll, causing the entire cavern to shudder once more.

Loren Milton slid to the ground, blood streaming from his seven orifices, yet he still struggled to pull out a backup staff.

Shang Feifan wouldn't give him the chance; he pulled out a large blade and severed the hand wearing the storage ring in one stroke.

He picked him up and beat him mercilessly!

Loren Milton screamed incessantly.

He wanted to maintain his dignity, but all that came out were screams and pleas for mercy.

He didn't want to die; he had been only one step away from becoming a God of Magic.

How could someone like him die so easily?

He had come so far...

Why?

Where had he gone wrong?

Why had he ended up in such a state?

He was unwilling! He was unwilling!

He was supposed to become a god; he was supposed to be a high and mighty deity...

But no matter how unwilling he was, he was going to die today.

This Ares Shang was a devil; when it came to torture, no one could compare to this demon.

In the end, Loren Milton couldn't take it anymore. He just wanted to die, to die quickly. He could no longer endure the extreme pain of being manually dismantled into human fragments.

"If a piece of trash like you could become a god, then this world would truly be finished."

Shang Feifan dropped Loren Milton, who had been reduced to a pile of mush, and sneered.

He raised his foot and crushed his skull.

Loren Milton’s eyeballs burst; the last thing he saw was his own rotting flesh and blackened blood.

The Flower Bug and the Fortune-Stealing Bug didn't waste anything, picking and choosing until they had eaten most of the meat, including the hand Shang Feifan had severed earlier.

Shang Feifan casually collected the spatial ring.

And so, Loren Milton died. Perhaps in all his long life, he had never imagined he would die in such a way.

Dying so miserably, so painfully, and so ignobly.

Finally, Shang Feifan set a fire, burning the remaining scraps and residue until nothing was left.

Not only that, he dismantled the entire cave.

He didn't waste a single bit of the materials used to set up the teleportation array.

While dismantling the array, he discovered that the energy used for this teleportation portal wasn't magic crystals, but... terrestrial power.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第259章 干掉洛伦米尔顿 (Part 4)
chunks.chineseText:
能看懂传送阵布置，也是因为他研究空间储物工具多了，触类旁通，对传送阵也多了一些了解。

而无论他学的哪一方面的空间知识，他总觉得利用地力当传送阵的能量并不是一件好事。

不是说地力不能利用，而是不该这么利用。

商非凡忽然想到兽人大陆的岩浆喷发地质灾难，这个灾难会不会就跟这些乱用地力的传送阵有关？

当他把传送阵全部拆除后，这处山洞连同上面的崖壁同时崩塌。

最后的最后，商非凡用瞳术不断扫射这处塌陷地，包括附近，确保不会有半丝生物和精神力残留。

那只空间戒指他也仔细检查过，只要觉得可疑的物品，不管价值多高，他都会拿出来处理得渣都不剩。

他从来不会小看自己的敌人。

同样，他对待敌人也绝对是秋风扫落叶还要加垃圾焚烧，一定会处理得干干净净，确保对方绝无翻身可能。
chunks.englishText:
He could understand the layout of the teleportation array because he had studied spatial storage tools extensively; by drawing inferences from what he knew, he had gained some understanding of such arrays.

Yet, regardless of which aspect of spatial knowledge he studied, he always felt that using terrestrial power as an energy source for a teleportation array was not a good thing.

It wasn't that terrestrial power couldn't be utilized, but it shouldn't be used in this manner.

Shang Feifan suddenly thought of the magma eruptions and geological disasters on the Beastman Continent. Could these disasters be related to these teleportation arrays that recklessly exploited the earth’s energy?

Once he had completely dismantled the array, the cave and the cliff above it collapsed simultaneously.

In the very end, Shang Feifan used his ocular techniques to continuously scan the collapsed area, including the surroundings, to ensure that not a single trace of biological matter or mental energy remained.

He had also carefully inspected the spatial ring; any item he found suspicious, no matter how high its value, he would take out and process until nothing was left.

He never underestimated his enemies.

Likewise, when dealing with enemies, he was like an autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves, adding a thorough incineration to ensure the opponent had absolutely no chance of a comeback.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第260章 事后以及各族反应 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第260章 事后以及各族反应

郎沐晋阶了。

从初级魔导师晋级到了高级魔导师。

他甚至自感已经触摸到了法圣境界的门槛，他不差对魔法知识的领悟，现在缺少的只是魔力积累。

他睁开眼的时候就看到了守在一边做手工活的商非凡。

商非凡似有所觉，抬眼看他，然后就笑了。

郎沐也冲他笑。

两人傻乎乎地笑了好一会儿。

商非凡下意识观察郎沐的气运值，结果看到了三个星号。

虽然不知道三个星号代表的是什么意思，但商非凡觉得应该不是什么坏事。

不管如何，阿沐的气运值恢复，这绝对是大好事。

他看过阿呆的气运值，哦，不对，阿呆没有气运值，只有幸运值，就跟他和其他玩家一样。

阿呆的幸运值确实很高，91点，是个幸运的小宝贝。

如果兽人世界有人给刚出生的阿呆算命的话，说不定会给出“幼年坎坷，无亲人缘，生有大劫，如遇贵人可逢凶化吉，一生顺遂”这样的批语。

似乎只有郎沐才有气运值。

虽然光球说他是天河星选定的气运之子，但他总觉得郎沐对于天河星才是最特殊的，也许郎沐就是那个最重要的扭转点，其他人对他不过都是催化剂。

遇到洛伦米尔顿，郎沐没能成长起来，天河星也因此陷入至深的劫难。

于是天河星意识竭尽全力保住了郎沐的灵魂和仅剩下的一点气运值，把他给转生到兽人大陆。再经由洛伦米尔顿的手，把他商非凡给引渡到这个世界。

这么一想，洛伦米尔顿能那么顺利地找到自然之神雕像缺失的大脑、小腹和兽人最高科技的初代光脑，搞出游戏系统，也许并不完全靠的是欺骗掠夺来的郎沐气运值，说不定就有天河星意识在里面故意推动。

商非凡只是随便想了想，就没有继续深想。

现在天河星和他们一荣俱荣，一损俱损。

如果天河星灭绝，他和郎沐都逃不掉——郎沐的身体在这里，其重视的亲人和朋友也在这里，郎沐没有办法抛弃这一切和他离开天河星，而他也不可能抛下郎沐自己离开。

为此，无论如何，他们都得努力救下天河星，解决那想要吞噬天河星的外来邪神。

至于如何解决？

那就走一步看一步。

商非凡始终深信天无绝人之路，真绝了，他就……转道修邪神。

郎沐转头四看，发现他仍旧待在雕像广场中。

“我感觉对自然力的感知更高。”郎沐没用魔法口诀，更没用法杖，手指轻轻一晃，指间就出现了一朵红艳艳的月季。

商非凡挑眉，“你刚才用了种子吗？”

郎沐摇头，笑着把这朵月季插到商非凡耳边。

他的自然系魔法，已经达到了“我想，它就会成为真实”出现的程度。

当然，目前他还只能凝结出一些能量较为低微、他比较熟悉且构成简单的物品。

而且凝结出的物品说是自然物种，其实更像是魔法物品。

比如这朵月季花，只要他不把魔力撤掉，这朵花就会永不凋谢。

商非凡看着郎沐伸过来的手，想：阿沐肯定是感觉到他看到花虫子停在他头顶上都想了什么，这会儿故意报复他。

戴花就戴花。

真男人才戴花！

商非凡耳边别着一朵开得灿烂又鲜嫩的月季花，歪头：“好看吗？”

郎沐心脏一颤，诚实点头，用力说：“好看！”

商非凡笑了，笑容酷帅又灿烂，还有点诱惑。

郎沐没想到男人戴花可以这么好看，被迷得有点目眩神迷。

商非凡忍不住探头，亲亲他的大宝贝。

郎沐仰头闭眼。

商非凡加深了这个吻。

这是个充满珍惜和爱意的吻，不含任何情-欲。

两人额头相抵，静静拥抱着，享受着雕像广场里清冽的微风和淡淡的青草香味。

郎沐感受着气运全部回到身上的奇妙感觉，他伸出手，轻轻张开又握住。

商非凡伸手，和他十指交握。

“都过去了。”

“是啊，都过去了。”

“……感觉好像也没怎样。”郎沐嘀咕。他是真的放开了，早在洛伦米尔顿死之前。

商非凡乐：“本来就没什么。不过一场失败的恋爱而已，一场小小的青春之痛？”

郎沐有点不好意思，按照灵魂年龄来算，那可不是青春之痛。

“也许是老房子着火更可怕吧。”郎沐自嘲。

“谁一生不会碰上几个骗子？区别只不过是被骗钱，还是被骗身，最糟糕的就是即被骗钱又被骗身，连感情都栽进去拔不出来。但只要放过自己，回过头去看，就会觉得‘哦，也就是那么一回事而已’。”

商非凡拢住爱人跟他说自己曾经被骗的经历。

那时候他刚出道，自以为自己很厉害，一头就撞上了几只老狐狸老豺狼和老乌龟，吃了不少亏，慢慢累积经验才有了后来和现在的他。

郎沐知道老商工作环境复杂，没想到会那么复杂，简直一分钟前还是一起喝酒的好朋友，一分钟后就发现彼此在对方酒杯中下毒。

商非凡当时不谈感情，只搞露水姻缘，多少也是怕落入仙人套中。

郎沐听得不住笑，尤其听到商非凡和人上床都不敢深眠，就怕被人注射药物甚或直接被杀死——因为生活在那个环境中，你永远不知道你遇到的人会不会是敌人派来的。

商非凡睨他：“我当初在意国看到你，就该直接跟你表白，把你拉去旅馆。”

郎沐给了他一个滚蛋的眼神：“你要真那么做，我只会以为你在耍流氓。”

商非凡大笑。

他家阿沐确实是一个慢热的人，而他……那时的工作和状态都不可能让他有大把时间去追求郎沐。

他们两人在当时注定会错过。

商非凡握紧阿沐的手。幸好，他们再次遇上。幸好，他们的缘分没有真的断开。

“对了，这里有一些那个人渣收藏的魔法书籍和魔法相关物品，你看能不能用。”商非凡拿出一枚空间戒指。

郎沐很自然地接过，打开空间戒指查看。

商非凡已经抹去戒指上的精神力封锁。

郎沐拿出几本厚厚的魔法书籍，还找到了一枚被精致魔法盒盛装的魔法奥秘石。

“这些对你我都很有用。”郎沐很高兴。

他在法德尔大陆生活了不短时间，后来还进入一座魔法学校当老师，也看到了不少魔法书籍，基础也算打得厚实，但碍于那座魔法学校级别不高，哪怕是学校老师专用的图书室中也没有多少高深的魔法学知识。

洛伦米尔顿收集的这些魔法书，几乎都是郎沐没有接触过也是最需要的。

更不要说那枚能引路入法圣境界的魔法奥秘石。

商非凡手上有游戏商城提供的魔法书，之前，他就用神魂共享的方式把那些直接灌输到他脑海中的魔法知识分享给了郎沐。

但魔法知识浩瀚如海，商非凡也不可能因为洛伦米尔顿是人渣，就无视其辛苦一生收集到的魔法知识。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 260: Aftermath and Reactions of Various Races

Lang Mu had leveled up.

He had advanced from a Junior Magister to a Senior Magister.

He even felt that he had touched the threshold of the Sage of Magic realm. He was not lacking in his comprehension of magical knowledge; what he lacked now was merely the accumulation of magic power.

When he opened his eyes, he saw Shang Feifan sitting to the side, working on some handicraft.

Shang Feifan seemed to sense it; he looked up and smiled.

Lang Mu smiled back at him.

The two of them sat there, smiling foolishly for quite a while.

Shang Feifan subconsciously checked Lang Mu’s fortune value, only to see three asterisks.

Although he didn't know what the three asterisks represented, Shang Feifan felt it couldn't be a bad thing.

Regardless, A-Mu’s fortune value had been restored, which was definitely a great thing.

He had checked A-Dai’s fortune value—oh, wait, A-Dai didn't have a fortune value, only a luck value, just like him and the other players.

A-Dai’s luck value was indeed very high, 91 points; he was a lucky little treasure.

If someone in the Beastman world were to tell the fortune of a newborn A-Dai, they might give a reading like: "A rough childhood, no affinity with kin, born with a great calamity; if one meets a noble benefactor, they may turn danger into safety and enjoy a smooth life thereafter."

It seemed only Lang Mu possessed a fortune value.

Although the light orb had said he was the Child of Fortune chosen by the Tianhe Star, he always felt that Lang Mu was the most special entity to the Tianhe Star. Perhaps Lang Mu was the most important turning point, and everyone else was merely a catalyst for him.

When he encountered Loren Milton, Lang Mu had failed to grow, and the Tianhe Star had consequently fallen into a deep catastrophe.

Thus, the consciousness of the Tianhe Star had done everything in its power to preserve Lang Mu’s soul and his last remaining shred of fortune, reincarnating him into the Beastman Continent. Then, through Loren Milton’s hands, it had brought him, Shang Feifan, into this world.

Thinking about it this way, perhaps Loren Milton’s ability to so smoothly find the missing brain and abdomen of the Natural God statue, as well as the first-generation light brain of the Beastmen’s highest technology, and create the game system, wasn't entirely due to the fortune he had plundered from Lang Mu. Maybe the Tianhe Star’s consciousness had been pushing things along behind the scenes.

Shang Feifan just thought about it briefly and didn't dwell on it.

Now, the Tianhe Star and they were bound together for better or worse.

If the Tianhe Star were destroyed, neither he nor Lang Mu could escape—Lang Mu’s body was here, and the family and friends he cared about were here. Lang Mu had no way to abandon all this and leave the Tianhe Star with him, and he could not possibly leave Lang Mu behind to depart alone.

Therefore, no matter what, they had to strive to save the Tianhe Star and deal with the foreign evil god that sought to devour it.

As for how to solve it?

They would take it one step at a time.

Shang Feifan had always believed that heaven never closes all doors; if it truly did, he would just... switch to cultivating the evil god’s path.

Lang Mu turned his head to look around, discovering he was still in the Statue Plaza.

"I feel my perception of natural forces has increased." Lang Mu didn't use any magic incantations, nor did he use a staff; with a gentle flick of his fingers, a bright red rose appeared between them.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. "Did you use a seed just now?"

Lang Mu shook his head, smiling as he tucked the rose behind Shang Feifan’s ear.

His nature-based magic had reached the level where "if I wish it, it becomes reality."

Of course, for now, he could only manifest items that were relatively low in energy, familiar to him, and simple in composition.

Moreover, the items manifested, while called natural species, were actually more like magical constructs.

For instance, this rose—as long as he didn't withdraw his magic power, the flower would never wither.

Shang Feifan looked at Lang Mu’s outstretched hand and thought: A-Mu must have sensed what he was thinking when he saw the Flower Bug landing on his head, and was now deliberately getting back at him.

Fine, he’d wear the flower.

Only a real man dares to wear a flower!

With a bright, fresh rose tucked behind his ear, Shang Feifan tilted his head. "Does it look good?"

Lang Mu’s heart skipped a beat. He nodded honestly and said with emphasis, "It looks good!"

Shang Feifan smiled, a cool, handsome, and radiant smile that carried a hint of temptation.

Lang Mu hadn't expected that a man could look so good wearing a flower; he was momentarily dazzled.

Shang Feifan couldn't help but lean in and kiss his "big treasure."

Lang Mu tilted his head back and closed his eyes.

Shang Feifan deepened the kiss.

It was a kiss full of cherishing and love, devoid of any lust.

The two pressed their foreheads together, embracing quietly, enjoying the crisp breeze and the faint scent of grass in the Statue Plaza.

Lang Mu felt the marvelous sensation of his fortune returning to him in full. He stretched out his hand, gently opening and closing his fingers.

Shang Feifan reached out and interlaced his fingers with Lang Mu’s.

"It’s all in the past."

"Yes, it’s all in the past."

"…It doesn't really feel like much, honestly." Lang Mu muttered. He had truly let go, long before Loren Milton died.

Shang Feifan laughed. "It was never much to begin with. Just a failed romance, a small youthful pain?"

Lang Mu felt a bit embarrassed. If one calculated by soul age, that certainly wasn't just a "youthful pain."

"Perhaps it’s more terrifying when an 'old house catches fire'," Lang Mu self-mockingly remarked.

"Who doesn't run into a few scammers in their lifetime? The only difference is whether you’re scammed out of money or your body. The worst is being scammed out of both, and even losing your heart so deeply you can't pull it out. But as long as you forgive yourself and look back, you’ll just think, 'Oh, it was just one of those things'."

Shang Feifan held his lover close, telling him about his own experiences of being scammed.

Back when he first started out, he thought he was quite capable, only to run headfirst into a few old foxes, jackals, and tortoises. He suffered quite a few losses, and it was only through accumulating experience that he became the person he was today.

Lang Mu knew that Shang Feifan’s work environment was complex, but he hadn't realized it was *that* complex—where one minute you were drinking buddies, and the next you discovered you were poisoning each other’s glasses.

At the time, Shang Feifan didn't talk about romance, only engaging in fleeting flings, partly because he was afraid of falling into traps set by others.

Lang Mu couldn't help but laugh, especially when he heard that Shang Feifan wouldn't even sleep deeply after getting into bed with someone, fearing he’d be injected with drugs or killed outright—because living in that environment, you never knew if the person you met was sent by an enemy.

Shang Feifan glanced at him. "When I saw you in Italy back then, I should have just confessed to you and dragged you to a hotel."

Lang Mu gave him a "get lost" look. "If you had really done that, I would have just thought you were a hooligan."

Shang Feifan laughed heartily.

His A-Mu was indeed a slow-to-warm-up person, and he... his work and state of mind at the time wouldn't have allowed him the time to pursue Lang Mu properly.

They were destined to miss each other back then.

Shang Feifan squeezed A-Mu’s hand tightly. Fortunately, they had met again. Fortunately, their fate had not truly been severed.

"By the way, there are some magic books and magic-related items that the piece of trash collected. See if you can use them." Shang Feifan produced a spatial ring.

Lang Mu took it naturally and opened the ring to check.

Shang Feifan had already wiped away the mental seal on the ring.

Lang Mu took out several thick magic books and also found a Magic Mystery Stone housed in an exquisite magic box.

"These are very useful for both of us." Lang Mu was delighted.

He had lived in the Fadel Continent for quite some time and later even became a teacher at a magic school, where he had seen many magic books and built a solid foundation. However, because that school was not of a high level, even the library reserved for teachers didn't contain much advanced magical knowledge.

The magic books Loren Milton had collected were almost all things Lang Mu had never been exposed to and were exactly what he needed most.

Not to mention the Magic Mystery Stone, which could guide one into the realm of a Sage of Magic.

Shang Feifan had magic books provided by the game mall, and previously, he had used soul-sharing to directly instill that magical knowledge into his own mind and share it with Lang Mu.

But magical knowledge was as vast as the sea, and Shang Feifan wouldn't ignore the magical knowledge Loren Milton had spent a lifetime collecting just because he was a piece of trash.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第260章 事后以及各族反应 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
“这奥秘石会不会有问题？”商非凡发现奥秘石，原本想要毁掉，又觉得可惜，仔细思考后还是留了下来，打算让郎沐看看再说。

郎沐用精神力查看后，知道老商在担心什么，摇头：“这不是洛伦米尔顿凝结出的法圣晋级心得和魔法传承。那个人恐怕想不到自己会这么快死亡，他大概也不想让自己的传承和晋级法圣的心得便宜别人，加上凝结奥秘石需要消耗大量能量和精神力，他恐怕就没有留下传承魔法石。”

商非凡之前也检查过这枚奥秘石，没有感觉到里面有洛伦米尔顿的精神力，才会交给郎沐。这会儿再经由郎沐检查一遍，他算是真正放下心来。

“能用就好。里面还有些魔法材料和高级魔晶，你先用着吧。等以后我们有机会前往法德尔大陆，再收集更多魔法材料和魔晶。”

郎沐笑着点头，把空间戒指里的物品全部转移到自己的空间手镯中，至于那枚戒指，他又扔还给商非凡。

“这个我用不着，你看着卖掉吧。”郎沐轻飘飘地说。

商非凡眼里全是笑，阿沐果然懂他。他当然不会浪费这么一枚大储存量的空间戒指，明天他就拿出去卖掉！

光球还没有更新完毕，商非凡暂时没管它，也没管雕像广场进一步的变化……好像又扩大了一圈。

他带着郎沐离开雕像广场，出去找到花虫子和阿呆。

接下来他们还有不少事要忙。

首先就是驱使不死尸挖掘完泄洪渠，把黑水荒原剩下的岩浆爆发灾难彻底解决。

彭石城那边的人口迁徙和之后的火山大爆发，惊动了不少其他国家和部落的人。

会飞的第一时间跑到彭石城附近查看，听说虎国王城曾经派人过来安排迁徙，又跑到虎国王城查询消息。

他们想要知道虎国人是怎么知道彭石城会火山爆发，并那么快就把那么多人口顺利迁徙出去。

去勘察过彭石城火山爆发现场的人，有那细心的就发现了貌似被人工挖掘出来的渠道。

那些渠道一直延伸到彭石城外围的山峦，还要更远。

而且渠道不止一条两条，仔细看就会发现多条渠道以彭石城为中心，呈现辐射型向四周围扩散。

但这些渠道不是让彭石城爆发出来的岩浆流淌出去，而更像是把彭石城乃至更远地方的岩浆集中到彭石城所在的盆地。

原本这些渠道还不太能让人看出来，尤其不少深埋在地下的渠道。

但火山爆发造成一定地动和地形变化，有些原本藏在地下的通道就被震了出来。

懂行的人越看越绝对不对劲，纷纷跑去护国王城询问。

问他们是如何感知到地下层压力变化以及岩浆流势，又问他们从哪里调用了那么多人手、什么时候挖掘出那么多条泄洪渠。

为什么周围国家和部落的人都不知道？

最让人惊讶的是，按理这么大量的人手调动，虎国不可能还这么平静。可稍微找附近的虎国人打探一下就知道，虎国并没有征发役民，也没有大规模招工。

那就是靠血脉天赋者？

可现在有那么厉害的血脉天赋者吗？

竟然能一人或几人挖掘出那么多条深入地下、又宽又深又长的泄洪渠？还是在那么短的时间内？

周围国家和部落的人想不通，他们越想不通，越想知道答案。

后来也不知是谁从哪里得到消息，说那些泄洪渠挖掘和彭石城的火山爆发都和郎沐以及阿瑞斯商有关——看，彭石城大量普通人就是迁徙到了黑水荒原的新城。

于是，各国各部落派出来的人又开始寻找郎沐和阿瑞斯商的踪迹。

听说原本就是这两人从图书馆的预言壁画中得到了兽人大陆会出现大型地质灾害的预警，也是他们传递给虎国王室并警告虎王，虎王这才会郑重其事地在传承分享大会中让大王子交代这件事。

找到这两人并不难。

黑水荒原新城那边的管理者郎侦老伯爵并没有隐瞒自家孙子和孙婿的行踪，大大方方地告诉所有来询问的人，说两人去了天残谷附近，打算在那边继续开挖第二处岩浆泄洪池。

商非凡还在距离那条深渊裂谷附近的荒原上放上了极为醒目的龟甲堡，任谁走过路过都不会错过那造型特异且看起来就极为安全的龟甲堡。

这样一看就像是炼金物品的特殊住宅，九成九就是那位炼金大师阿瑞斯行的手笔了。

荒原上的风裹挟着一股说不出的怪异味道，呼啸着扫过裂谷边缘嶙峋的黑色岩石。

这一片都曾是富饶的都市和城郊，大量尸骨深埋地下数百年，如今，它们却从土壤下面探出了爪牙。

狼族兽人赫托的鼻子在踏入荒原的瞬间就皱了起来。他的喉咙里发出低沉的呜咽，粗壮的爪子不自觉地扣紧了腰间的战斧。

这是尸臭？

不对，这不是普通的尸臭！

“所有人警戒！”赫托竖起手掌握成拳。

他带着的侦查小队成员全都紧张起来。

当他们小心越过一座不高的丘陵时，他们看到了让他们一生难忘的可怕场景！

成千上万，不，或许是十万，百万——数不清的尸骸排成无数条蜿蜒的队列，如同一条条腐烂的河流，在冬日的荒原上缓缓流动。

它们手持铁锹、镐头、甚至只是尖锐的骨片，沉默地凿击着被冻得干硬的土地。

铛——铛——铛——

金属与岩石碰撞声一声又一声，在荒原中不断回响。

太诡异了，这些不死尸简直就像是来自地狱的工程队，正打算在这片荒原上为地狱之主建造宫殿。

过来侦查的兽人小队下巴颌都掉到了地上，更吓得四肢发颤。

“完了！不死尸又出世了！乱世将至！”

“别胡说了！赶紧把这个消息报上去！”

“等等，这些不死尸在干什么？什么时候不死尸会这么整齐划一地共同做同一件事？你们想想我们是来找谁的，又是想要问什么事！”

翼人侦察兵鹰天天悬浮在高空，黑色的羽翼张开，在冷风中盘旋。

鹰天天拥有最敏锐的鹰目，哪怕在黑夜中也能看清千米之外的猎物。

可此刻，她宁愿自己瞎了。

“诸神啊……”她嗓音颤抖，几乎无法呼吸。

荒原上，密密麻麻的不死生物如同蚁群般涌动。

它们没有嘶吼，没有混乱，没有去攻击荒原上的生物，只是沉默地挖掘、搬运、堆砌。

漫长又深邃的岩浆泄洪渠已经初见轮廓。

无数腐尸和骷髅排成长队，将坚硬的岩石砸成碎块，再放入渠道边沿，形成一道足以引导熔岩流向的堤坝。

最令人毛骨悚然的是——它们太有序了。

这些本该毫无理智的不死之物，此刻却仿佛被某种至高意志操控着，像一支训练有素的亡灵军团。

赛琳娜的翅膀猛地一抖，差点从空中跌下。

虫人族侦察队的信息素在空气中疯狂交织。

“危险！撤退！撤退！”他们的触须高频震颤，复眼中倒映着深渊中爬行的尸潮。
chunks.englishText:
"Could there be something wrong with this Mystery Stone?" Shang Feifan had originally intended to destroy the stone upon discovering it, but feeling it was a waste, he decided after careful consideration to keep it and let Lang Mu take a look first.

After Lang Mu examined it with his spiritual power, he understood what Lao Shang was worried about and shook his head. "This is not the Magic Saint advancement insights or magical inheritance condensed by Loren Milton. That person likely never expected to die so quickly, and he probably didn't want his inheritance or his insights on reaching the Magic Saint realm to benefit others. Furthermore, condensing a Mystery Stone requires a massive consumption of energy and spiritual power; he likely didn't leave behind an inheritance magic stone."

Shang Feifan had checked the Mystery Stone before and hadn't sensed any of Loren Milton's spiritual power within it, which was why he had handed it over to Lang Mu. Now, after Lang Mu's verification, he finally felt truly at ease.

"As long as it's usable, that's fine. There are still some magic materials and high-level magic crystals inside; you use them first. When we have the opportunity to head to the Fadel Continent in the future, we can collect more."

Lang Mu nodded with a smile and transferred all the items from the spatial ring into his own spatial bracelet. As for the ring itself, he tossed it back to Shang Feifan.

"I don't need this; you can sell it," Lang Mu said nonchalantly.

Shang Feifan’s eyes were filled with mirth; A-Mu truly understood him. Of course, he wouldn't waste a spatial ring with such a large capacity—he would take it out to sell tomorrow!

The light sphere had not finished updating yet, so Shang Feifan left it alone for the time being, nor did he pay attention to the further changes in the statue plaza... it seemed to have expanded by another circle.

He took Lang Mu and left the statue plaza to find the Flower Bug and A-Dai.

They still had plenty to keep them busy.

First and foremost was driving the undead corpses to finish digging the flood discharge channels, completely resolving the remaining volcanic eruption disaster in the Blackwater Wasteland.

The population migration from Pengshi City and the subsequent massive volcanic eruption had alarmed many other nations and tribes.

Those who could fly had rushed to the vicinity of Pengshi City to investigate immediately. Upon hearing that the Tiger Kingdom’s royal capital had sent people to arrange the migration, they hurried to the Tiger Kingdom’s capital to seek information.

They wanted to know how the Tiger Kingdom people knew that Pengshi City would suffer a volcanic eruption and how they managed to migrate so many people out so quickly.

Those who had gone to survey the eruption site at Pengshi City, particularly the observant ones, discovered channels that appeared to have been excavated by artificial means.

Those channels extended all the way to the mountains on the outskirts of Pengshi City and even further beyond.

Moreover, there wasn't just one or two channels; a closer look revealed multiple channels radiating outward with Pengshi City at the center.

However, these channels were not meant to let the lava from the eruption flow out; rather, it looked more like they were designed to concentrate the lava from Pengshi City and even further regions into the basin where the city was located.

Originally, these channels were not very noticeable, especially those buried deep underground.

But the volcanic eruption caused significant seismic activity and topographical changes, causing some of the originally hidden underground channels to be shaken to the surface.

Those in the know found it increasingly suspicious the more they looked, and they flocked to the Tiger Kingdom’s capital to inquire.

They asked how they had sensed the pressure changes in the underground strata and the flow of magma, and they asked where they had mobilized so many people and when they had dug so many flood discharge channels.

Why hadn't the surrounding nations and tribes known anything about it?

What was most surprising was that, logically, such a massive mobilization of manpower should have made it impossible for the Tiger Kingdom to remain so calm. Yet, a little inquiry among nearby Tiger Kingdom citizens revealed that the Tiger Kingdom had not conscripted labor, nor had they recruited workers on a large scale.

Was it done by those with bloodline talents?

But were there any bloodline talents that powerful nowadays?

To be able to dig so many deep, wide, and long flood discharge channels, either alone or in small groups? And in such a short amount of time?

The surrounding nations and tribes couldn't figure it out, and the more they couldn't, the more they wanted the answer.

Later, no one knew where the news came from, but it was said that the digging of those flood channels and the volcanic eruption at Pengshi City were both related to Lang Mu and Ares Shang—look, a large number of ordinary people from Pengshi City had migrated to the new city in the Blackwater Wasteland.

Consequently, the people sent by various countries and tribes began searching for the traces of Lang Mu and Ares Shang.

It was said that it was these two who had received the warning of a large-scale geological disaster in the Beastman Continent from the prophecy murals in the library, and it was they who had passed it on to the Tiger Kingdom’s royal family and warned the Tiger King, which was why the Tiger King had solemnly let the First Prince announce this matter at the Inheritance Sharing Conference.

Finding these two was not difficult.

Old Count Lang Zhen, the administrator of the new city in the Blackwater Wasteland, did not hide the whereabouts of his grandson and grandson-in-law. He generously told everyone who came to ask that the two had gone to the vicinity of the Heaven-Severing Valley, intending to dig a second magma flood discharge pool there.

Shang Feifan had even placed an extremely eye-catching turtle-shell fortress on the wasteland near the abyss rift, ensuring that anyone passing by would not miss the uniquely shaped and seemingly extremely safe structure.

At a glance, this special residence, which looked like an alchemical item, was almost certainly the handiwork of that alchemy master, Ares Shang.

The wind on the wasteland carried an indescribable, strange odor, whistling across the jagged black rocks at the edge of the rift.

This area had once been a prosperous city and its suburbs, with countless corpses buried deep underground for hundreds of years. Now, however, they were reaching out their claws from beneath the soil.

The nose of the wolf-kin beastman Heto wrinkled the moment he stepped onto the wasteland. A low growl emanated from his throat, and his thick claws tightened involuntarily around the battle-axe at his waist.

Was this the stench of corpses?

No, this wasn't ordinary corpse rot!

"Everyone, stay alert!" Heto held up his hand in a fist.

The members of the reconnaissance squad he led all grew tense.

As they cautiously crossed a low hill, they saw a terrifying scene they would never forget for the rest of their lives!

Thousands, no, perhaps a hundred thousand, a million—countless corpses were arranged in countless winding queues, like rivers of rot, flowing slowly across the winter wasteland.

They held shovels, picks, and even just sharp bone fragments, silently chiseling away at the frozen, hardened earth.

Clang—clang—clang—

The sound of metal striking rock echoed continuously across the wasteland.

It was too eerie; these undead corpses were like a construction crew from hell, intending to build a palace for the Lord of Hell on this wasteland.

The beastman reconnaissance squad’s jaws dropped to the ground, and their limbs trembled in fear.

"It's over! The undead have returned! The chaotic era is upon us!"

"Stop talking nonsense! Hurry and report this news!"

"Wait, what are these undead doing? Since when do undead work together in such an orderly fashion to do the same thing? Think about who we came to find and what we wanted to ask!"

The winged-kin scout, Ying Tiantian, hovered high in the sky, her black wings spread, circling in the cold wind.

Ying Tiantian possessed the sharpest eagle eyes, capable of seeing prey a thousand meters away even in the dark of night.

But at this moment, she wished she were blind.

"By the gods..." Her voice trembled, and she could barely breathe.

On the wasteland, dense swarms of undead creatures surged like an ant colony.

They did not roar, they were not chaotic, and they did not attack the living creatures on the wasteland; they simply, silently, dug, transported, and piled up earth.

The long and deep magma flood discharge channels were already beginning to take shape.

Countless rotting corpses and skeletons formed long lines, smashing hard rock into fragments and placing them along the edges of the channels to form a levee capable of guiding the flow of lava.

What was most hair-raising was—they were too orderly.

These undead things, which should have been devoid of reason, were now seemingly controlled by some supreme will, like a well-trained undead legion.

Selena’s wings gave a violent twitch, and she nearly fell from the sky.

The pheromones of the insect-kin scout team intertwined frantically in the air.

"Danger! Retreat! Retreat!" Their antennae vibrated at high frequency, and their compound eyes reflected the tide of corpses crawling in the abyss.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第260章 事后以及各族反应 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
虫人战士卡拉的甲壳因恐惧而微微发蓝——这是他们这一族极度惊骇时的生理反应。

“众神在上！下面那些是不死尸吗？”他还看到了大量的虫人族不死尸！

卡拉死死盯着站在一个站在高大石头上、身上仍然穿着虫族将军衣袍的不死尸，对方似乎是这一支不死尸大军的指挥者。

兽人、翼人、虫人……这些来自各国各部落的种族全都疯狂地逃离荒原。

他们要把这个可怕的消息传回去——他们都不确定自己看到了什么！

没有人敢回头。

没有人想再看到那一幕——数万尸骸沉默劳作的景象。

更多人来到天残谷附近的荒原。

从高空俯瞰，整片荒原就像一张巨大的棋盘，上面分布了十几条由不死尸组成的挖掘大军。

最前排的不死尸紧握铁镐，每一次挥动都分毫不差地落在同一条岩缝上。它们没有肌肉，没有肌腱，却像被无形的提线操控般机械精准。

当一条渠道被挖出来，立刻就有新的不死尸群上前，它们会将石块砸入渠道，动作娴熟得令人毛骨悚然。

没有交谈。没有停顿。没有错误。

在泄洪渠道的边沿，还有不少能力特殊的不死尸来回走动。它们能使用生前的天赋技能，或操纵火焰焚烧冻硬的土地，或用其他方法碎裂岩石，或用重力将碍事的巨大石块挪开……

所有不死尸都在有条不紊的工作。

来到天残谷荒原的各国各部落人越来越多。

就连虎国本国人都跑来围观这传说中都不会有的奇异景象。

一开始看到那么多不死尸，大家确实非常恐惧，第一个想法就是逃。

但那些不死尸都像是没有看见他们这些大活人一样，更像是半点都没有察觉到他们这些活的血肉的气息。

有时候有那大胆的侦查者会极度接近那些不死尸，走得最近的人已经走到距离那些不死尸不到十米的地方。

但！那些不死尸仍旧像是没有发现他们一样。

不，还是有不死尸对靠近的活人露出了馋涎，有点激动地丢下工具就要像活人冲过去。

但这时往往会有尖利刺耳的啸声出现。

那些闻到活人味就想扑过来的不死尸们又老实了，乖乖捡起工具回到队伍里继续干活。

还有的不死尸似乎一边盯着他们“流口水”，一边干活，就好像拿他们当下饭菜。

“……该找那位谈谈了。”

所有人都知道那位是哪位。

也不是没有人试图进入那座龟甲堡。

但龟甲堡的主人在外面竖了一块牌子，上书“暂时没空”。
chunks.englishText:
The insect-kin warrior Kara’s carapace turned a faint blue due to fear—a physiological reaction of his race when in extreme terror.

"By the gods! Are those undead corpses down there?" He also saw a large number of insect-kin undead!

Kara stared fixedly at an undead corpse standing on a high rock, still wearing the robes of an insect-kin general; the other party appeared to be the commander of this undead army.

Beastmen, winged-kin, insect-kin... these races from various nations and tribes all fled the wasteland in a frenzy.

They had to carry this terrifying news back—they weren't even sure what they had seen!

No one dared to look back.

No one wanted to see that scene again—the sight of tens of thousands of corpses laboring in silence.

More people came to the wasteland near the Heaven-Severing Valley.

Looking down from high above, the entire wasteland was like a giant chessboard, distributed with over a dozen digging armies composed of undead corpses.

The undead in the front row gripped their iron picks tightly, each swing landing precisely on the same rock fissure without the slightest deviation. They had no muscles, no tendons, yet they moved with mechanical precision, as if controlled by invisible strings.

As soon as a channel was dug out, a new group of undead would immediately step forward, smashing stones into the channel with a proficiency that was bone-chilling.

No talking. No pausing. No mistakes.

Along the edges of the flood discharge channels, there were also many undead with special abilities moving back and forth. They could use the innate skills they had in life, either manipulating flames to burn the frozen earth, using other methods to shatter rocks, or using gravity to move massive boulders that were in the way...

All the undead were working in an orderly manner.

More and more people from various nations and tribes came to the Heaven-Severing Valley wasteland.

Even the people of the Tiger Kingdom themselves came to watch this strange sight that was said to be impossible.

At first, seeing so many undead, everyone was indeed very afraid, and their first thought was to run.

But those undead acted as if they didn't see these living people at all, and even more so, as if they hadn't sensed the scent of living flesh and blood from them in the slightest.

Sometimes, a bold scout would get extremely close to the undead; the closest ones had walked to within ten meters of them.

But! Those undead still acted as if they hadn't discovered them.

No, there were still some undead who "drooled" at the approaching living people, somewhat excitedly dropping their tools and wanting to rush toward them.

But at such times, a sharp, piercing whistle would often sound.

Those undead who had smelled the living and wanted to pounce would become obedient again, docilely picking up their tools and returning to the ranks to continue working.

Some undead even seemed to "drool" while staring at them, working as if they were treating them as their next meal.

"...We should talk to that person."

Everyone knew who "that person" was.

It wasn't as if no one had tried to enter that turtle-shell fortress.

But the owner of the turtle-shell fortress had put up a sign outside, which read: "Busy for now."

chunks.chineseText:
第261章 梁润明VS南戎

两天后的夜晚，商非凡和郎沐避开人眼出去了一趟。

没一会儿，敏感的兽人突然从睡梦中醒来，第一时间冲到帐篷外。

“发生了什么事？”

“你们有没有感觉到？”

“你也察觉不对劲了？”

越来越多的人从临时居住地走出。

大家先是互相询问，但很快，所有人都变得安静起来。

不知是谁呢喃了一句：“好安静。”

祭司梁润明跑到高处，向四下张望。

其他国家和部落的高层也上来了。

“动物、昆虫、禽鸟……所有生物似乎都消失了。”梁润明低语。

南联盟第一高手南戎：“连之前能看到的少许植物都像是消失了。”

有人忍不住说：“这是怎么回事？就算这是冬季，但也不至于变成这样吧？”

“你们有没有发现，我们过来的时候，这片荒原中的生物就很少。”

“难道不是被那么多不死尸给吓走和杀死的吗？”

好几人同时摇头。

他们仔细观察过，那些不死尸只埋头干活，没有一个会脱离队伍去扑杀活物。

“大家小心，也许就要有大事发生了！”梁润明警告众人。

知道天残谷荒原有无数不死尸，还敢跑来荒原勘测的人没有一个是乱来者，所有人都提起了心神。

“也许……”南戎还没说完。

远处忽然传来悠远却又清晰异常的年轻雄性兽人声音：“诸位，岩浆即将在清晨喷发，请所有人尽量离开插有红旗的地方，以及远离泄洪渠和裂谷。”

梁润明猛地抬头：“是阿瑞斯商！”

当晚，所有人都再也睡不下去，他们全都按照要求尽量远离了天残谷荒原和裂谷一带。

也有人出于好奇，特意跑去寻找插有红旗的地方，结果在偌大的荒原中一共发现了十三面红旗。

“小心！那些不死尸大军全都消失了！”

众人骇然，那么多不死尸，打眼看去起码也有几十万之多，竟然在短短几息间就全都消失。

它们去了哪里？

又是谁在控制它们？

好吧，后一个问题，所有人都有了答案。

这也是商非凡他们高挂没空牌，也没人敢跑去打扰他们的原因之一。除了尊重，更有忌惮。

大地开始震颤时，最先崩裂的是天空。

刚刚在天边浮现的层层朝霞，突然出现了极为壮观的奇景——如整个云层都被点燃般，在空中形成了巨大的火炬。

紧接着，地壳发出第一声蛋壳裂开的清脆声响，只是隔着土地，声音传到少数人耳中已经变成了沉闷的爆破声。

荒原西北方插着的红旗处，地面突然隆起，像有什么巨兽在土层下弓起背脊。

伴随着令人恐惧的岩石碎裂声，一道三丈宽的地缝轰然绽开，赤红的岩浆如狂怒的巨蟒冲天而起。

但这条火蟒没有四散奔流。它在空中划出一道完美的抛物线，精准地落进了附近的泄洪渠中。

熔岩撞击渠壁后迅速安静下来，顺着泄洪渠往低处流淌。

东南方传来战锤击打铁砧般的闷响。整个地面像被巨人踩踏的鼓面般剧烈起伏，六道岩浆火柱突破地面呈扇形喷发，把插着的红旗喷到半空，又迅速融化。

这些本该横扫荒原的致命洪流，仿佛全都经过精密计算，又如同被无形的大手操控，纷纷落入深宽长的泄洪渠道中。

位于天残谷后方，传说曾经掩埋了无数不死尸的山谷内。那里的地面不是裂开，而是整个塌陷成一个直径百米的漏斗形巨坑。

巨坑下方，火红的岩浆流动，却没有喷发出来，而是沿着地底通道向裂谷方向流淌。

大地在震颤，空气在燃烧！

荒原地面和地底，十三道赤红的火河奔腾而至，如被深渊召唤的火焰巨蟒，在裂谷边缘轰然坠落。

那是连神明都要屏息的壮景！

十三股岩浆洪流同时倾泻，在裂谷边缘撕开一道千米长的火线。

粘稠的熔岩垂落时拉扯出无数金红丝缕，像天神撒下的赤金纺线，又像地狱倒悬的火森林。

最中央的主渠喷涌最为猛烈，直径十丈的熔岩柱如巨神之矛贯入深渊。两侧分流而下的火瀑则如同它的羽翼，在漆黑岩壁上铺展成扇形的火幕。

高温扭曲了空气，让这场坠落显得愈发狰狞。

熔岩表面不断鼓起沸腾的气泡，炸裂时飞溅的火珠在空中划出万千流星。

硫磺毒雾与黑烟交织成旋转的漩涡，将坠落的火瀑时而遮蔽时而显露，恍如一张时开时合的火焰巨口。

岩浆撞击岩壁的轰鸣声压过世间一切响动。那不是简单的爆裂声，而是千万吨炽热岩石与冰冷地壳的永恒角力。

偶尔有特别巨大的熔岩团砸在突出的岩台上，顿时炸成一天火雨，那些飞溅的液态火焰在空中就冷却成各种矿石碎片，叮叮当当落入深处。

深渊裂谷来者不拒地吞噬着这份厚礼。

最先坠入的岩浆已在谷底堆积成暗红色的湖泊，后来者不断砸进火湖中，激起数十丈高的火浪。这些浪头拍打在垂直的岩壁上，留下瞬间凝固的火山玻璃，像一道道黑色的伤疤。

随着最后一滴岩浆离开泄洪渠，十三道火瀑终于完成了它们的使命。

裂谷上空的烟雾缓缓散开，露出被灼成暗红色的岩壁。

荒原重归寂静，只有裂谷深处的岩浆湖偶尔冒出的气泡声，证明这场盛大的岩浆爆发并非幻梦。

旁观到这一幕幕的人们尽失言语，他们被高温逼得不断后退，但也把这宏大一幕看入眼中。

这简直就是自然伟力和人力的最佳结合！

“……所以虎国的地质灾难这是彻底解决了吗？”

轰！在场所有人神智震颤。

他们要去找阿瑞斯商和郎沐两人。既然他们能解决虎国的地质灾难，那肯定也能解决其他地方的。

此时，已经没有人对预言中的内容表示怀疑。

不是他们看到岩浆爆发的这一幕实景才敢肯定，而是在虎国传承分享大会结束后，各国和各部落都在安排专业人手对自家地盘的地底情况进行自查。

兽人们也许丢失了高科技，也许失去了不少神血天赋的传承，但还是有不少特殊能力的高手存在。

这些高手再辅以特殊的炼金器具，他们或可以感知到地面下的底层变动，或可以直接看到地下千米深的动静，还有人能预知，能看到一些灾难来临时的画面。

经过种种验证，各国各部落高层都已明确——大规模地质灾难即将降临兽人大陆一事并不是编造出的谎言，而是必将会发生的事实！

既然已经确定灾难必定会发生，那接下来自然要商讨怎么解决这场大规模到涉及整个兽人大陆的灾难。

迁徙？

那显然不太现实。

那么多人，要往哪里迁徙？

兽人大陆又有哪里能称得上真正安全？

往海岛上？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 261: Liang Runming vs. Nan Rong

Two nights later, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu slipped out of sight.

Before long, the sensitive beastmen suddenly woke from their sleep and rushed out of their tents at the first opportunity.

"What happened?"

"Did you feel it?"

"You sensed something wrong, too?"

More and more people emerged from their temporary dwellings.

At first, they asked each other, but soon, everyone fell silent.

Someone murmured, "So quiet."

The priest Liang Runming ran to a high point and looked around.

High-ranking members from other nations and tribes also climbed up.

"Animals, insects, birds... all living things seem to have vanished," Liang Runming whispered.

Nan Rong, the top expert of the Southern Alliance, added, "Even the few plants we could see before seem to have disappeared."

Someone couldn't help but say, "What is going on? Even if it is winter, it shouldn't be like this, right?"

"Have you noticed that when we arrived, there were already very few living things in this wasteland?"

"Wasn't it because they were scared away or killed by all those undead?"

Several people shook their heads in unison.

They had observed carefully; those undead only buried their heads in their work, and not a single one had left the ranks to hunt living creatures.

"Everyone, be careful; something major might be about to happen!" Liang Runming warned the crowd.

Knowing that there were countless undead in the Heaven-Severing Valley wasteland, none of those who dared to come to the wasteland for surveying were reckless; everyone was on high alert.

"Perhaps..." Nan Rong hadn't finished his sentence.

In the distance, a young male beastman's voice suddenly rang out, distant yet exceptionally clear: "Everyone, the magma is about to erupt at dawn. Please stay away from areas marked with red flags, and keep your distance from the flood discharge channels and the rift."

Liang Runming looked up abruptly: "It's Ares Shang!"

That night, no one could sleep anymore. They all followed the instructions and moved as far away from the Heaven-Severing Valley wasteland and the rift area as possible.

Some, out of curiosity, specifically went to look for the places marked with red flags, only to discover a total of thirteen red flags across the vast wasteland.

"Watch out! That undead army has vanished!"

Everyone was horrified. So many undead—at a glance, there were at least hundreds of thousands—had vanished in just a few breaths.

Where did they go?

And who was controlling them?

Well, as for the latter question, everyone already had the answer.

This was also one of the reasons why Shang Feifan and his partner had hung up the "Busy" sign, and no one dared to go and disturb them. Beyond respect, there was even more apprehension.

When the earth began to tremble, the first thing to shatter was the sky.

The morning glow that had just appeared on the horizon suddenly displayed a spectacular sight—as if the entire cloud layer had been ignited, forming a giant torch in the sky.

Immediately following, the earth's crust emitted the first crisp sound like a cracking eggshell; only, separated by the soil, the sound reached the ears of a few as a dull explosion.

At the location of a red flag planted in the northwest of the wasteland, the ground suddenly bulged, as if some giant beast were arching its back beneath the soil.

Accompanied by the terrifying sound of rock shattering, a three-zhang-wide fissure burst open, and crimson magma shot into the sky like a furious giant python.

But this fire python did not scatter and flow wildly. It traced a perfect parabola in the air and landed precisely into a nearby flood discharge channel.

The lava quieted down rapidly after hitting the channel walls, flowing along the channel toward lower ground.

From the southeast came a dull thud like a war hammer striking an anvil. The entire ground heaved violently like a drumhead stepped on by a giant, and six pillars of magma erupted in a fan shape, blowing the planted red flags into the air, where they were instantly melted.

These deadly torrents, which should have swept across the wasteland, seemed to have been calculated with precision, or perhaps controlled by an invisible hand, as they all fell into the deep, wide, and long flood discharge channels.

Behind the Heaven-Severing Valley, in the valley that was rumored to have buried countless undead, the ground didn't crack; instead, it collapsed into a giant funnel-shaped pit a hundred meters in diameter.

Below the giant pit, fiery red magma flowed, but it did not erupt; instead, it flowed along underground channels toward the rift.

The earth was trembling, and the air was burning!

Thirteen crimson rivers of fire surged across the wasteland and beneath the ground, like fire pythons summoned by the abyss, crashing down at the edge of the rift.

It was a magnificent sight that would make even the gods hold their breath!

Thirteen torrents of magma poured down simultaneously, tearing a thousand-meter-long line of fire at the edge of the rift.

As the viscous lava fell, it pulled out countless golden-red threads, like strands of red gold spun by a heavenly god, or a forest of fire hanging upside down from hell.

The main channel in the center erupted most violently, a pillar of lava ten zhang in diameter piercing the abyss like the spear of a giant god. The firefalls flowing down on both sides were like its wings, spreading into a fan-shaped curtain of fire against the pitch-black rock walls.

The high temperature distorted the air, making the descent appear even more ferocious.

Boiling bubbles constantly rose on the surface of the lava, and the fire beads that splashed when they burst traced thousands of meteors in the air.

Sulfurous toxic mist and black smoke intertwined into a rotating vortex, obscuring and revealing the falling firefalls, as if it were a giant mouth of fire opening and closing.

The roar of magma striking the rock walls drowned out every other sound in the world. It was not a simple explosion, but the eternal struggle between millions of tons of scorching rock and the cold crust of the earth.

Occasionally, particularly large masses of lava would smash onto protruding rock platforms, instantly exploding into a rain of fire; those splashed liquid flames cooled into various mineral fragments in mid-air, falling into the depths with a clattering sound.

The abyss rift swallowed this generous gift without refusal.

The first magma to fall had already accumulated into a dark red lake at the bottom of the valley, and the latecomers kept smashing into the fire lake, stirring up fire waves dozens of zhang high. These waves slapped against the vertical rock walls, leaving behind instantly solidified volcanic glass, like black scars.

As the last drop of magma left the flood discharge channels, the thirteen firefalls finally completed their mission.

The smoke above the rift slowly dissipated, revealing the rock walls scorched to a dark red.

The wasteland returned to silence, with only the occasional sound of bubbles from the magma lake deep in the rift proving that this grand volcanic eruption was not a dream.

Those who witnessed these scenes were left speechless; they were forced back by the high temperature, but they had taken this grand spectacle into their eyes.

This was simply the perfect combination of natural power and human effort!

"...So, has the Tiger Kingdom's geological disaster been completely resolved?"

Boom! Everyone present felt their minds tremble.

They had to find Ares Shang and Lang Mu. Since they could resolve the Tiger Kingdom's geological disaster, they could certainly resolve it elsewhere.

At this moment, no one doubted the contents of the prophecy anymore.

It wasn't just because they had seen the reality of the magma eruption; after the Tiger Kingdom's Inheritance Sharing Conference concluded, every nation and tribe had arranged for professional personnel to conduct self-inspections of the underground conditions in their own territories.

Beastmen might have lost their high technology and many of their divine bloodline inheritances, but there were still many experts with special abilities.

These experts, supplemented by special alchemical instruments, could either sense the movements of the underground strata or directly see the activity a thousand meters deep underground. Others could foresee the future, seeing images of disasters as they approached.

Through various verifications, the high-ranking officials of all nations and tribes had confirmed—the fact that a large-scale geological disaster was about to descend upon the Beastman Continent was not a fabricated lie, but an inevitable truth!

Since it was determined that the disaster would definitely happen, the next step naturally was to discuss how to resolve this disaster, which was large enough to involve the entire Beastman Continent.

Migration?

That clearly wasn't very realistic.

With so many people, where could they migrate to?

And where in the Beastman Continent could be called truly safe?

To the islands in the sea?

chunks.chineseText:
不说中大型海岛大多都有人占领，就算能抢下来或发现无人岛屿，要怎么在短时间内造出那么多渡海大船，还要确保把整个国家和部落的人和财产都转移过去？

这些问题在传承分享大会上，大家就已经讨论过，无不感到棘手。

那时不少人都寄希望于预言内容是假的。

也有人提出，那干脆就按照预言所说，找出那个能带领大家找到空间通道的人，让那人带着兽人大陆所有人前往另一片新大陆。

但这属于没有办法的办法。

更何况，预言中那个救世主在哪里？是否真有这个引路人存在，谁也不知道。

“还不如阿瑞斯商和郎沐他们想出来的这个办法更靠谱。从根本解决问题，既然岩浆要爆发，那就让它爆发，只要我们能人为地疏导其爆发的地点和方向，既能缓解大地压力，也能确保绝大多数生物继续存活。”南戎道。

“可我们勘察过，岩浆会爆发不是某一处的地底压力问题，而是整个兽人大陆的地底板块都在变动。”梁润明面带忧心。

他快速说：“根据我们的勘察和推测，整个兽人大陆的地壳中心有一股庞大的能量在涌动，这股庞大能量推动了构成兽人大陆的板块……我们兽人大陆并不是完整一块地面，而是有多处断裂面和断层，像是碎饼干一样聚集在一起的大陆。”

“大陆地面表层的土壤就像是奶油，奶油掩盖了下方饼干并不是完整一块的事实，平时只要没有大的外力破坏，我们的大陆咋一看就是完整的一片。”

“但如果这时候有极为强大的外部力量，或内部喷发一股庞大能量，就会致使这些碎裂板块移动甚至互相撞击。这时候就会发生剧烈地震。”

“预言中到处喷发的岩浆就是地壳中心庞大能量释放造成。”

南戎：“那阿瑞斯商和郎沐的做法不就是在帮助大地释放你说的那股庞大能量？”

梁润明抿了抿嘴唇，有点失神地说：“你说的不错。可你不知道那股能量有多庞大，只这边泄露出这一点，根本不够……”

“那就让全大陆所有人同时开工，想办法把那股地底能量给彻底引出来，让整个大陆的板块安静下来！”南戎坚定地说。

梁润明苦笑：哪有那么容易。

“我们南方联盟打算和阿瑞斯商商讨借用不死尸劳工大军一事，各位自便。”南戎对众人点点头，转头就朝龟甲堡所在方向走去。

不管有多难，他们南方联盟都要尝试。

现在阿瑞斯商他们已经打出一个成功的样本，他们照葫芦画瓢还画不出来吗？

就算使用不死尸大军又怎么样？

只要能救下他们南方联盟，他们和魔鬼合作都可以。

总比什么都不做，只会愁眉苦脸地等死好。

至于说找到预言中的引路人，让对方带领难民前往另一个新大陆？

南戎可以肯定，就算那位引路人真的出现，真的能带领一部分兽人前往其他大陆，但那绝不是所有兽人大陆的生灵。

没有哪个空间通道可以容许那么多人和物稳定穿越，如果真的有，那必然也要付出难以想象的代价。

道理很简单，修条路你还需要大量资源和人力呢。

南戎和南方联盟的高层自觉无法抛弃下绝大多数的民众，只带一部分所谓的精英离开。

如果真有大家都不得不离开故土的那一天，他们也会和留下的人共存亡。

所以对于他们南方联盟来说，找阿瑞斯商和郎沐合作是势在必行！

梁润明嘴唇动了动，想要叫住南戎，又忍住。

他还隐瞒了一个秘密没有说。

这是他们祭司宫最近才察觉的一个大秘密，关系到兽人大陆地壳中心那股庞大能量为何会爆发的原因。

也是他们担心就算能请阿瑞斯商帮忙，让他操控不死尸大军到处挖掘泄洪渠，也不一定能真正解决地壳中心那股暴烈的庞大能量的忧心所在。

南戎走到龟甲堡门口，抬手敲门。

“来了。”门内传来声音。

商非凡打开大门，看到南戎，就像早就知道他会找上门一样，侧身：“进来吧，我们刚好在吃早中饭。”

南戎没有立刻进去，而是站在门外就说道：“你们知道兽人大陆会爆发大型地质灾难的真正原因吗？”

商非凡挑眉，“听起来你像是知道。”

南戎没有点头也没有摇头，而是神色严肃地说：“我们的人从祭司宫得到一个最新消息，据说祭司宫某些老祭司一直在监察兽人大陆地底一股庞大能量，那股庞大能量是在神之笼损坏后就开始变得活跃。”

“这股能量一直在撕扯我们兽人大陆，从旧神血帝国时代到今天，我们兽人大陆其实经常发生各种地质灾难。那些老祭司甚至推测，虫毒和毒雾纪出现的会让尸体变异的毒素，都和那股能量有关。”

“那股能量在泄露，在改变我们兽人大陆的能量成分。”

梁润明大概怎么也没想到，他们祭司宫自以为隐瞒的很好的秘密，他们都不敢随便告诉别人的重大事情，就这么被南戎知道了，还被对方当做话题开场白告诉了阿瑞斯商。

商非凡听到这个秘密，表情都没改变一下。

南戎观察他的神色，点头说：“看来你们心中多少也有数。”

商非凡确实不知道那股庞大能量的详细信息，但郎沐一直在勘测地壳变化、勘测地底能量，他的自然感知力告诉了他不少事。郎沐又不会隐瞒他，遇到或感知到什么奇怪的事都会告诉他，和他商量。

商非凡在吞噬了那炼金戒指中的一点黑暗之神的神格碎片以及虫母的那枚心脏碎片后，他也察觉到了天地间能量的一丝变化。

如果不是对这份能量变化的敏感，他又怎么辅佐他家阿沐找到最适合的岩浆喷发点？

实际上，他们就不是在找适合的岩浆喷发点，而是在帮助那股地底能量适时解压。

南戎又道：“我们南方联盟打算组织一批人手进入地底，想法彻底解决那股能量。之前，我们不知道你手上有一批不死尸大军，现在……我们有一个请求，希望你也能加入我们，不需要你亲自动手，只要你能指挥那些不死尸大军帮助我们挖出一个进入地壳中心的通道。”

南戎一顿：“报酬好说！”

商非凡笑：“你们的解决问题方法比我们还彻底，这是想直接对根源动手啊。”

南戎也没隐瞒，坦然说：“我们得到一些消息，据说如果能吸收那股能量，对我们兽人突破现有力量层次有极大好处。这次我们南方联盟组织的冒险团队也不止我们南方联盟的人。”

商非凡心想：也是，没有极大的利益，又有多少人愿意冒着极有可能是必死的危险进入地壳中心探险？

远处，梁润明其实和南戎有同样打算，他只是不知道该如何向阿瑞斯商开口，更怕聪慧敏锐的阿瑞斯商会听出问题，进而探查出那股庞大能量的秘密。
chunks.englishText:
Not to mention that most medium-to-large islands were already occupied, even if they could seize one or discover an uninhabited island, how could they build so many massive seafaring ships in such a short time? And how could they ensure the safe transfer of an entire nation’s people and property?

These problems had already been discussed at the Heritage Sharing Conference, and everyone had found them daunting.

At that time, many had pinned their hopes on the prophecy being false.

Others had suggested simply following the prophecy: find the person capable of leading everyone to the spatial rift, and let that person guide all the inhabitants of the Beastman Continent to a new world.

But that was a solution of last resort.

Furthermore, where was this savior mentioned in the prophecy? No one even knew if such a guide truly existed.

"It’s far more reliable than the method Ares Shang and Lang Mu came up with. It addresses the root of the problem. Since the magma is going to erupt, let it erupt. As long as we can artificially guide the location and direction of the eruptions, we can alleviate the pressure on the earth while ensuring the survival of the vast majority of living beings," Nan Rong said.

"But we’ve surveyed it. The magma eruptions aren't just a matter of underground pressure in one specific area; the entire tectonic plate of the Beastman Continent is shifting," Liang Runming said, his face etched with worry.

He spoke rapidly: "Based on our surveys and projections, there is a massive surge of energy at the center of the continent's crust. This immense energy is pushing the plates that make up the Beastman Continent... Our continent isn't a single, solid piece of land. It has multiple fractures and fault lines, like a continent made of broken cookie pieces pressed together."

"The soil on the surface is like cream, masking the fact that the 'cookies' beneath are not a single piece. Usually, as long as there is no major external force, our continent looks like a complete whole at first glance."

"But if there is an extremely powerful external force, or a massive internal eruption of energy, it will cause these fractured plates to move or even collide. That is when violent earthquakes occur."

"The magma erupting everywhere in the prophecy is caused by the release of this massive energy at the center of the crust."

Nan Rong asked, "Then isn't what Ares Shang and Lang Mu are doing helping the earth release that massive energy you mentioned?"

Liang Runming pursed his lips and said, somewhat distractedly, "You’re not wrong. But you don't know how vast that energy is. What’s leaking out here is simply not enough..."

"Then let everyone on the entire continent start working at once. We’ll find a way to completely draw out that underground energy and let the continent's plates settle!" Nan Rong said firmly.

Liang Runming gave a bitter smile: It was never that easy.

"Our Southern Alliance intends to discuss borrowing the army of undead laborers from Ares Shang. You all may do as you please," Nan Rong nodded to the group and turned to walk toward the location of the Turtle Shell Fortress.

No matter how difficult it was, the Southern Alliance had to try.

Ares Shang and his group had already created a successful model; couldn't they just follow suit?

And what if it meant using an army of the undead?

As long as it could save the Southern Alliance, they would cooperate with the devil himself.

It was better than doing nothing and just waiting for death with a long face.

As for finding the guide from the prophecy to lead refugees to another continent?

Nan Rong was certain that even if that guide appeared and could lead some beastmen to another land, it would never be all the living beings of the Beastman Continent.

No spatial rift could allow so many people and resources to pass through stably. If one really existed, the price to pay would be unimaginable.

The logic was simple: even building a road requires massive resources and manpower.

Nan Rong and the high-ranking members of the Southern Alliance felt they could not abandon the vast majority of their people just to lead a few so-called elites away.

If the day truly came when they had to leave their homeland, they would live and die with those who stayed behind.

Therefore, for the Southern Alliance, cooperating with Ares Shang and Lang Mu was an absolute necessity!

Liang Runming’s lips moved, wanting to call out to Nan Rong, but he held back.

He was still hiding a secret.

It was a major secret that their Priest Palace had only recently uncovered, one that concerned why the massive energy at the center of the Beastman Continent’s crust was erupting.

It was also the reason they worried that even if they asked Ares Shang to help command the undead army to dig drainage channels, it might not truly solve the violent, massive energy at the core.

Nan Rong reached the entrance of the Turtle Shell Fortress and knocked.

"Coming," a voice came from inside.

Shang Feifan opened the door. Seeing Nan Rong, he stepped aside as if he had known he would come, saying, "Come in, we’re just having brunch."

Nan Rong didn't enter immediately. Standing outside, he asked, "Do you know the true reason why the Beastman Continent will suffer a massive geological disaster?"

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. "Sounds like you do."

Nan Rong neither nodded nor shook his head, but said with a serious expression, "Our people received the latest news from the Priest Palace. It is said that certain old priests have been monitoring a massive energy source beneath the Beastman Continent. That energy became active only after the Cage of the Gods was damaged."

"This energy has been tearing at our continent. From the era of the Old God Blood Empire to today, our continent has frequently suffered various geological disasters. Those old priests even speculate that the toxins and poisonous mists that cause corpses to mutate are all related to that energy."

"That energy is leaking, changing the elemental composition of our Beastman Continent."

Liang Runming likely never imagined that the secret the Priest Palace thought they had hidden so well—a matter they dared not tell anyone—was being told to Ares Shang by Nan Rong as an opening line.

Shang Feifan’s expression didn't change at all upon hearing this secret.

Nan Rong observed his reaction and nodded. "It seems you already have some idea."

Shang Feifan didn't know the detailed information about that massive energy, but Lang Mu had been surveying crustal changes and underground energy, and his natural perception had told him quite a bit. Lang Mu never kept secrets from him; whenever he encountered or sensed something strange, he would tell him and discuss it.

After Shang Feifan devoured the fragment of the Dark God’s divinity from the alchemical ring and the heart fragment of the Insect Mother, he too had sensed a subtle change in the energy of heaven and earth.

If he hadn't been sensitive to this change, how could he have assisted his Ammu in finding the most suitable points for magma eruption?

In reality, they weren't just looking for suitable eruption points; they were helping that underground energy decompress at the right time.

Nan Rong added, "Our Southern Alliance plans to organize a group to go underground and find a way to completely resolve that energy. Before, we didn't know you had an army of the undead. Now... we have a request. We hope you can join us. You don't need to do it yourself; you only need to command the undead army to help us dig a passage into the center of the crust."

Nan Rong paused. "The reward is negotiable!"

Shang Feifan smiled. "Your solution is even more thorough than ours. You’re looking to strike at the root."

Nan Rong didn't hide it, saying frankly, "We received some information that if one can absorb that energy, it would be of great benefit to us beastmen in breaking through our current power levels. The adventure team organized by our Southern Alliance this time doesn't just include our own people."

Shang Feifan thought to himself: Indeed, without immense profit, how many would be willing to risk almost certain death to explore the center of the crust?

In the distance, Liang Runming actually had the same intention as Nan Rong. He just didn't know how to bring it up to Ares Shang, and he feared that the sharp and intelligent Ares Shang would sense the problem and uncover the secret of that massive energy.

chunks.chineseText:
祭司宫有很多忧虑，他们知道那股庞大能量的可怕，也知道它的诱惑力，他们死死瞒住相关消息，并不是想要独吞那股能量，而是害怕有人会滥用那股庞大能量，更害怕一旦那股能量失控可能会造成的极可怕后果。

梁润明犹豫来犹豫去，想得特别复杂特别多，尤其想到临行前大祭司交代他的话。

大祭司告诉他，让他千万小心阿瑞斯商，他说他感觉到了黑暗之神的力量在复苏，他怀疑能操纵不死尸大军的阿瑞斯商很可能是黑暗之神的信徒。

黑暗之神那是什么存在？

如果让黑暗之神的信徒掌控了那股庞大力量，谁也不知道这对兽人大陆乃至整个天河星是好是坏。

另一头。

“进来说吧。”商非凡摆出了他的态度。

南戎颔首为礼，大步跨入龟甲堡大门。
chunks.englishText:
The Priest Palace had many concerns. They knew the terror of that massive energy, but they also knew its allure. They kept the information tightly under wraps not because they wanted to hoard it for themselves, but because they feared someone would abuse that power, and even more so, they feared the catastrophic consequences if that energy were to spiral out of control.

Liang Runming hesitated, his thoughts complex and heavy, especially when he recalled what the High Priest had told him before he left.

The High Priest had warned him to be extremely careful around Ares Shang, saying he felt the power of the Dark God reviving and suspected that Ares Shang, who could command an army of the undead, was likely a follower of the Dark God.

What kind of existence was the Dark God?

If a follower of the Dark God gained control of that massive power, no one knew if it would be a blessing or a curse for the Beastman Continent, or even the entire Heavenly River Star.

On the other side.

"Come in and talk," Shang Feifan signaled his stance.

Nan Rong bowed in greeting and strode through the gates of the Turtle Shell Fortress.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第262章 祭司宫的奇怪之处 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第262章 祭司宫的奇怪之处

当看到龟甲堡消失，连带南戎和某几个兽人、翼人和虫人都不见了时，梁润明这才发现他们祭司宫的人好像被排除在外面了。

空空荡荡、毫无生气的天残谷荒原就宛如此时此刻梁润明的心。

原本还有冬雪覆盖的荒原因为一场大规模的岩浆引爆，也全都融化了个精光，裸-露出还没有长出植物的荒芜大地。

梁润明看着这片近乎死寂的大地，莫名就想到了他们祭司宫。

也不知具体是从什么时候开始，他们祭司宫就从入世者变成了出世者。

原本他们担任着给所有智慧种族储存和教导所有传承的任务。

自古，全兽人大陆各地的大小神殿都能见到从祭司宫出来的祭司身影，这些祭司每天的任务不是祭神，而是向所有前来神殿的人传达知识、教导他们各种技能，并为人们解惑，有些还会给人治病。

除了神殿，祭司还需要前往大陆各处各个大中小学校担任教师职责。

甚至祭司宫每一个祭司都有一个固定任务，要求每年或相隔一定年数必须前往各地神殿或学校进行多长时间的教学。

那时祭司宫的祭司在兽人大陆各处都很常见，祭司们也很喜欢到处游历，尤其喜欢向偏僻的地方传达知识、带学生等等。

而经常出门游历和接触人群，也有助于祭司们吸纳新的知识，把新的知识传承记录下来。

那时的人们对祭司也很尊敬并愿意付出信任。有些人发现新的技能和知识，也愿意告诉祭司们，让他们记录下来。

当然祭司们会询问那些创造发明发现者的意思，如果他们同意他们传播他们的知识，他们才会传播。如果不同意，他们就只是单纯的记录，以防失传。

那时候的祭司们甚至还承担了一个特殊业务，那就是如果发现某个知识和技能的原创造发明者突然死亡，却没有及时把他的传承给传递下去，那么祭司宫就会帮助对方寻找他的亲人，尽量把对方的传承继续传递下去。

同样，如果有人发现自己的亲人和师长突然死亡，又没能指定传承者，也会找上祭司宫，询问他们有没有记录。

那时的祭司宫真的和整个兽人大陆的兽人们关系非常密切，属于兽人大陆不可分割的一部分。

祭司们年老后，祭司宫还会根据他们的个人意愿，被分派去各地图书馆担任馆长或管理员。

然后是从什么时候开始祭司就变成了各国各部落上层专配？

甚至这些祭司被派到各国王庭和各大部落也不是为了教导知识，而更像是……彰显祭司宫的特殊地位？

梁润明其实也想不通。

为什么在大繁华纪末期，大战发生后，祭司宫会突然选择避世，而不是出来救世。

大繁华纪有多繁华和发达，大战纪后的兽人大陆就有多贫瘠和衰退。

那时候也有祭司询问大祭司等高层祭司，问为什么他们祭司宫不在这时候入世去帮助全兽人大陆的智慧生灵，把他们保存下来的知识再度交到他们手中，也好让这片大陆能快点恢复生机。

梁润明那时候还没有出生，但他的老师是经历过那个年代的老祭司。

他还记得他问过他老师相同的问题，他的老师就把当时大祭司跟他们说的理由告诉了他。

大祭司说就是因为现在的兽人大陆太乱了，没有合适的领导者，如果随便把知识和技能传递出去，到最后得利的很可能是部分拳头大的枭雄。

这些枭雄获得知识和技能的传承后，很可能会把这些宝贵的传承扣押在自己手中，只强大自身和相关者。

如此一来，绝大多数普通人压根无法得到真正的好处，还可能因为实力和技术差距被拉开，而进一步被欺压。

所以大祭司决定，与其把知识和技能交给自私的不合格者，还不如谁都不给，让大家都处在同一起跑线上。

而他们祭司宫则负责旁观和等待，考察有没有适合的新领袖出现，等发现人品、实力和能力全都过关的新领袖后，他们再出来履行他们的职责。

梁润明记得他当时听完这样的解答后，又紧追着询问他的老师：“那为什么我们不一开始就去主动培养优秀的领袖，或者干脆以第三方监督的方式，督促那些当权者兴办学校，把祭司宫拿出来的知识传承教出去？”

他的老师摸摸他的脑袋，声音沧桑地说：“因为我们祭司宫决不能插手政事，包括监督当权政府、督促他们做事……这些都不符合规矩。”

老师的回答并不能让那时还小的梁润明满意，他也无法深度解读他老师话中隐藏的意思。直到他后来长大，接触了更多祭司宫的事务……

他才发现他们祭司宫当时的情况其实也岌岌可危。

虽然大战中各族都尽量避免伤害祭司和祭司宫，但那么多祭司在天下游历和教学，他们又怎么可能完全不参战？

祭司也是人，他们也有想要保护和偏袒的人。

大战纪结束，祭司宫的祭司数量减少了三分之二，其中包含不少高端战力。

而储存了兽人大陆至今为止所有传承的祭司宫，又怎么可能不引来他人馋涎？

当时就有掌握祭司宫就能掌握整个兽人大陆的说法。

祭司宫光是为了抵御那些暗中图谋祭司宫传承和无数年积累下来的财富的豺狼们，就耗费了无数心智和精力。

那时的祭司宫别说去当第三方监管各地那些大大小小的势力，就是自保都勉勉强强。

而如果祭司宫选择某一个人或几个人进行扶持以及培养，那么祭司宫存在至今的性质也会跟着改变。

所以大祭司才带着祭司宫避世，想要等到战争结束，天下稳定后再继续履行传承的职责。

可惜大战纪结束他们也没有等来重新入世的良好时机，就又等过了战毁纪和毒雾纪。

当新生纪到来，祭司们终于从祭司宫走出，可莫名其妙的，他们就从传承知识的“教师”身份变成了各国各部落权力上层用来彰显身份和合法地位的特殊存在。

似乎拥有祭司宫派出的祭司驻守，就像是得到了兽人大陆的承认，成为了一个正经且独立的政体。

梁润明觉得这样不对劲，也不止一次跟上层提出问题。

但大祭司和高层祭司们总是用同一个理由搪塞他，总是说时机还未到，让大家继续耐心等待。

人都有惰性，如果只是坐镇王庭就能完成任务，还能得到各种外快和尊敬，那不比辛辛苦苦到处跑，且还要免费向愚昧大众传承知识和技能要轻松得多？

慢慢的，祭司宫新培养出来的祭司们都接受了他们的新职责，甚至习惯了他们被捧得高高在上的身份。

祭司宫的祭司们走偏了路，从大战发生到现在的千多年时间，他们教出去的知识和技能还不如虎国那场传承分享大会拿出来的东西多，远远不如！

而虎国的传承哪里来？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 262: The Peculiarities of the Priest Palace

When he saw the Turtle Shell Fortress vanish, taking Nan Rong and several beastmen, winged-folk, and insect-folk with it, Liang Runming realized that the people of his Priest Palace seemed to have been excluded.

The empty, lifeless wasteland of the Heavenly Remnant Valley felt just like Liang Runming’s heart at that moment.

The wasteland, which had originally been covered in winter snow, had been completely melted away by a large-scale magma detonation, exposing the barren earth where no plants had yet grown.

Looking at this near-dead land, Liang Runming inexplicably thought of their Priest Palace.

He didn't know exactly when it started, but the Priest Palace had shifted from being "involved in the world" to "withdrawing from the world."

Originally, they had held the task of storing and teaching all knowledge to every sentient race.

Since ancient times, priests from the Priest Palace could be seen in temples of all sizes across the Beastman Continent. Their daily task wasn't just to worship gods, but to impart knowledge to everyone who came to the temples, teach them various skills, and answer their questions; some even healed the sick.

Beyond the temples, priests were required to serve as teachers in schools of all sizes across the continent.

Every priest in the Priest Palace had a fixed duty: they were required to spend a certain amount of time each year, or every few years, teaching at various temples or schools.

Back then, priests from the Priest Palace were a common sight everywhere on the Beastman Continent. They loved to travel, especially to remote areas to spread knowledge and mentor students.

Frequent travel and contact with the people helped the priests absorb new knowledge and record it for posterity.

In those days, people respected the priests and were willing to trust them. When people discovered new skills or knowledge, they were happy to tell the priests so they could record it.

Of course, the priests would always ask the original creators or discoverers for their consent; only if they agreed would the knowledge be disseminated. If they refused, the priests would simply record it to ensure it wouldn't be lost.

In those days, the priests even took on a special responsibility: if a creator of knowledge or skill died suddenly without passing on their legacy, the Priest Palace would help find their relatives and try to ensure the legacy continued.

Similarly, if someone discovered that their relatives or mentors had died suddenly without designating a successor, they would go to the Priest Palace to ask if there were any records.

At that time, the Priest Palace was truly closely linked to the beastmen of the entire continent, an inseparable part of the Beastman Continent.

When priests grew old, the Priest Palace would, according to their personal wishes, assign them to serve as librarians or curators in libraries across the land.

So, when did the priests become the exclusive property of the upper echelons of various nations and tribes?

And these priests were sent to royal courts and major tribes not to teach knowledge, but rather to... manifest the special status of the Priest Palace?

Liang Runming couldn't figure it out.

Why, at the end of the Great Prosperity Era, after the Great War broke out, did the Priest Palace suddenly choose to avoid the world instead of coming out to save it?

The Beastman Continent after the Great War was as barren and regressive as the Great Prosperity Era had been prosperous and advanced.

At that time, some priests had asked the High Priest and other high-ranking priests why the Palace didn't enter the world to help the sentient beings of the continent, handing back the knowledge they had preserved so the continent could recover its vitality.

Liang Runming hadn't been born then, but his teacher was an old priest who had lived through that era.

He remembered asking his teacher the same question, and his teacher had told him the reason the High Priest had given at the time.

The High Priest had said that the Beastman Continent was too chaotic and lacked suitable leaders. If they casually passed on knowledge and skills, the ones who would benefit most would likely be the ruthless warlords with the biggest fists.

Once these warlords obtained the inheritance of knowledge and skills, they would likely hoard these precious legacies, using them only to strengthen themselves and their own circles.

In this way, the vast majority of ordinary people would never truly benefit, and might even be further oppressed due to the widening gap in strength and technology.

Therefore, the High Priest decided that rather than handing knowledge and skills to selfish, unqualified people, it was better to give them to no one, keeping everyone on the same starting line.

The Priest Palace would act as observers, waiting and scouting for a suitable new leader. Once they found a leader whose character, strength, and ability were all up to par, they would emerge to fulfill their duties.

Liang Runming remembered that after hearing this explanation, he had pressed his teacher: "Then why don't we proactively cultivate excellent leaders from the start, or simply act as a third-party supervisor, urging those in power to establish schools and teach the knowledge the Priest Palace provides?"

His teacher had patted his head, his voice sounding weary: "Because our Priest Palace must never interfere in political affairs, including supervising governments or urging them to act... none of that is in accordance with the rules."

The teacher’s answer hadn't satisfied the young Liang Runming, and he couldn't grasp the hidden meaning behind his teacher’s words. It wasn't until he grew up and became involved in more of the Priest Palace’s affairs...

That he realized the situation of the Priest Palace at the time had actually been precarious.

Although all races had tried to avoid harming priests and the Priest Palace during the war, how could they have avoided participating when so many priests were traveling and teaching across the world?

Priests were human too; they had people they wanted to protect and favor.

By the end of the Great War, the number of priests in the Priest Palace had been reduced by two-thirds, including many high-level combatants.

And how could the Priest Palace, which stored all the heritage of the Beastman Continent to date, not attract the greed of others?

At the time, there was a saying that whoever controlled the Priest Palace controlled the entire Beastman Continent.

The Priest Palace had exhausted countless resources and energy just to fend off the wolves who were secretly plotting to seize their heritage and the wealth accumulated over countless years.

Back then, the Priest Palace could barely protect itself, let alone act as a third-party supervisor for the various factions across the land.

And if the Priest Palace had chosen to support and cultivate one or a few individuals, the very nature of the Priest Palace’s existence would have changed.

That was why the High Priest had taken the Priest Palace into seclusion, hoping to wait until the war ended and the world was stable before resuming their duty of passing on knowledge.

Unfortunately, they didn't find a good opportunity to re-enter the world even after the Great War ended, and they waited through the War-Torn Era and the Poison Mist Era.

When the New Birth Era arrived, the priests finally stepped out of the Priest Palace, but inexplicably, they had transformed from "teachers" of knowledge into special entities used by the upper echelons of nations and tribes to manifest their status and legitimacy.

It seemed that having a priest stationed from the Priest Palace was like receiving the recognition of the Beastman Continent, becoming a proper and independent political entity.

Liang Runming felt this was wrong, and he had raised the issue with the higher-ups more than once.

But the High Priest and the senior priests always brushed him off with the same excuse, saying the time was not yet right and telling everyone to continue waiting patiently.

People are prone to inertia. If one could fulfill their duties just by sitting in a royal court and receiving various perks and respect, wasn't that much easier than working hard to travel everywhere and teaching knowledge and skills to the ignorant masses for free?

Slowly, the new priests trained by the Priest Palace accepted their new duties, and even grew accustomed to the status of being held in high regard.

The priests of the Priest Palace had gone astray. In the thousand-plus years since the Great War, the knowledge and skills they had taught were not even as much as what had been presented at that Heritage Sharing Conference in the Tiger Kingdom—not even close!

And where did the Tiger Kingdom’s heritage come from?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第262章 祭司宫的奇怪之处 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
不就是郎沐和阿瑞斯商在黑森林城的地底下发现了一座千年前留下来的图书馆。

令人极为惊讶的是，这两人丝毫没有隐藏这座图书馆的意思，就这么大大方方把图书馆的存在告诉了虎国，还几次引路。

同样这两人也因此进入祭司宫上层祭司的眼睛。

那两人唤醒了那座图书馆，也唤醒了里面的图书管理员。

那位管理员就是一名转职的老祭司，图书馆有办法和祭司宫通讯。

原本兴建图书馆就是祭司宫的任务之一。

可以说全兽人大陆的图书馆的建造都有祭司宫出的一份力，尤其是那些知识记录。

梁润明那时得知两人的消息，真的很高兴。

他以为祭司宫终于要借此机会真正走入世间，把走偏的路重新走正回来。

他们不该是抵御邪神信徒的第一线战斗者，也不该是用来佐证某个政体是否合法的特殊存在，他们就只是一群负责传达知识、记录知识，最多还肩负祭祀、祈福、治疗、安抚……这样的社会辅助者。

他们也不应该隐瞒重大消息，要把最大困难全靠自己扛起来，而不信任兽人大陆上的任何人。

梁润明有时候都搞不懂大祭司和高层祭司们都在想什么。

他想到阿瑞斯商曾经问过他——祭司宫是否已经被邪神渗透，他都不敢深想这个问题，一深想他就完全睡不着觉。

现在大祭司又特特跟他说，商极有可能和黑暗之神有关，让他和对方打交道要千万小心。

可是……

就算商真的是黑暗之神的信徒，还掌握了黑暗的力量，但他做的事情至少从表面看和长远来看都是对兽人大陆有好处的啊！

反倒是他们祭司宫，顾虑重重，明明发现了各种线索和重大消息，却总是隐瞒世人。

就连邪神和邪神信徒的危害，他们也没有怎么对外宣传，只默默扛起和邪神信徒都斗争的任务。

就像是现在，全大陆的人都在想办法要解决即将到来的全大陆地质灾难，可他们祭司宫却把重心放在抵御邪神信徒上。

抵御邪神信徒很重要，他承认这一点。

可是为什么祭司宫要“默默做事”？

为什么祭司宫不把邪神和邪神信徒的危害告诉全大陆所有人，让大家一起来解决这个毒瘤？

为什么大祭司仍旧偏向于寻找那个引路人，并让他多多留意郎沐？还让他有机会就把郎沐单独带回祭司宫见他？

大祭司到底……

梁润明不敢深想。

那可是大祭司啊！

梁润明想来想去，终于决定——他要去找阿瑞斯商和郎沐，找那两人单独聊聊。

他决定相信自己的判断，而不是由谁来告诉他什么该做、什么不该做。

他早就该下定决心！

梁润明追了上去，他知道要如何找到那两人，只要找到南戎就可以。

而南戎一定会回去南方联盟。

唰！梁润明刹住脚步。

他的面前突然出现一个翼人。

他记得对方，是翼国派出来的勘察小队中的一员，似乎叫杰力还是叫杰米的。

“祭司大人，我有一个确切的秘密消息，关于阿瑞斯商的真正身份。”

梁润明特别冷静地：“哦？你为什么找上我？”

杰力：“因为你是祭司宫的祭司，我不知道还能相信谁。”

梁润明半点没有感到荣幸，只感到了麻烦，他保持了沉默。

杰力显然不打算放过他，直接说道：“我知道你们祭司宫在调查阿瑞斯商，但你们找不到他的确切来历，对吗？”

梁润明仍旧沉默。

杰力也不在意梁润明的态度，自顾说道：“我也是偶尔发现，后来又跟踪了他一段时间，才发现了这个人的最大秘密。”

梁润明终于出声：“什么秘密？”

杰力：“那个阿瑞斯商并不是我们兽人大陆的土著，他是一名夺魂者，来自魔法师大陆，是一名魔法师，他侵占了一个兽人的身体，吞噬了对方的灵魂，成为了现在的阿瑞斯商。而原先的阿瑞斯商只是一个不起眼的流浪兽人，所以你们才怎么都查不出他的底细。”

梁润明眼神改变：“魔法师大陆？你说阿瑞斯商是一名魔法师……魔血后裔？”

杰力用力点头：“对！否则一个年轻兽人怎么可能会炼制空间储物工具？实力还那么强？就是因为他是魔血后裔，他掌握了不同于我们兽人的炼金技艺。”

梁润明再度陷入沉默，过了一会儿才开口：“阿瑞斯商是魔血后裔，那又怎样呢？”

杰力神色凝重：“如果他只是魔血后裔自然没什么，可我打探了另外一个重要消息。”

“什么消息？”

“据我所知，真神教的高层就全是魔血后裔。”杰力深深地看梁润明，像是再说：你品，你细品。

梁润明神色有了明显变化，他又忍不住多想和深想了。

黑暗之神的信徒，成为真神教高层，和邪神合作，似乎也不是那么难以想象？

那么阿瑞斯商现在所做的一切真的是在拯救兽人大陆，而不是在做样子，想要赢得人们信任，好做某些事吗？

杰力告密完就飞走了。

梁润明又在原地站了好一会儿才离开，走时，神色极为沉重。

冷风吹过，天空有雪花飘落。

不过地面还热，雪花还没有落到地上就化成水滴，甚至蒸腾成水雾。

商非凡和郎沐解除隐身状态。

“那家伙在这里站了大半天，脸色变来变去，结果什么都没做？”商老大很是不满。

郎沐安抚他：“他什么不做不是更好？”

商非凡摇头：“不，我很期待他做些什么。这样我们才好判断祭司宫到底站了个什么角色。”

两人没有跟着南戎一起离开，就是想要看看这位梁润明祭司在所有人离开后会做些什么。

而他们会想要监视梁润明，也是因为南戎跟他们说，这位祭司大人行动颇为古怪，他还去了一个被废弃的看起来像是大型基地的地方。

南戎当时好奇，暗中跟踪了这位祭司。

根据南戎的描述，商非凡很快就推断出梁润明去的那个基地就是他找到的那个邪神信徒基地。

梁润明似乎还利用某种飞行器具飞到天空盘旋了很久——商非凡推断对方应该是在找寻天空之城。

所以这位祭司是怎么知道天空之城和那处基地？

他，或者说祭司宫和真神教之间到底是什么关系？

结果他们没能查到梁润明和真神教的关系，却亲耳听到有人诬陷他商非凡和真神教有关。

“要继续跟上去吗？”郎沐问。

商非凡毫不犹豫地摆手：“不用。管他祭司宫想要做什么，我们先做好自己要做的事情。”

“那个翼人？”

“我已经让天眼系统盯着他。包括梁润明。”

商非凡都懒得去查那个翼人，用脚趾想都能推断出那翼人九成九是真神教一员。真神教这会儿大概已经多少查出天空之城消失的线索，怀疑和他有关，就来给他找麻烦、泼黑水了。
chunks.englishText:
It was simply that Lang Mu and Ares Shang had discovered a library left behind from a millennium ago beneath the Black Forest City.

What was incredibly surprising was that the two had no intention of hiding this library at all; they had openly informed the Tiger Kingdom of its existence and even acted as guides several times.

Naturally, this also drew the attention of the high-ranking priests in the Priest Palace.

Those two had awakened the library, and in doing so, they had also awakened the librarian within.

That librarian was a retired priest who had changed professions, and the library possessed a means of communicating with the Priest Palace.

Originally, the construction of libraries had been one of the missions of the Priest Palace.

It could be said that the Priest Palace had contributed to the building of every library across the Beastman Continent, especially regarding the recording of knowledge.

When Liang Runming first received news of the two, he was genuinely happy.

He had hoped that the Priest Palace would finally use this opportunity to truly step into the world and correct the path they had strayed from.

They were not meant to be frontline combatants resisting the followers of the Evil God, nor were they meant to be special entities used to validate the legitimacy of a particular political regime. They were simply a group of social facilitators responsible for disseminating knowledge, recording history, and at most, shouldering the duties of sacrifice, blessing, healing, and providing comfort.

They were not meant to hide major news, nor were they meant to shoulder the greatest difficulties entirely on their own while refusing to trust anyone else on the Beastman Continent.

Sometimes, Liang Runming couldn't even fathom what the High Priest and the high-ranking priests were thinking.

He recalled Ares Shang once asking him whether the Priest Palace had already been infiltrated by the Evil God. He didn't dare to dwell on that question; the moment he did, he couldn't sleep at all.

Now, the High Priest had specifically told him that Shang was highly likely connected to the God of Darkness and warned him to be extremely cautious when dealing with him.

But...

Even if Shang were truly a follower of the God of Darkness and possessed dark powers, everything he had done—at least on the surface and in the long run—was beneficial to the Beastman Continent!

On the contrary, it was their Priest Palace that was full of misgivings. Despite discovering various clues and major pieces of information, they always kept them hidden from the world.

They hadn't even publicized the dangers of the Evil God and their followers to the public, choosing instead to silently shoulder the burden of fighting them alone.

Just like now, while the entire continent was trying to find ways to resolve the impending geological catastrophe, the Priest Palace was focusing its efforts on resisting the followers of the Evil God.

Resisting the followers of the Evil God was important; he acknowledged that.

But why did the Priest Palace have to "work in silence"?

Why didn't the Priest Palace inform everyone on the continent about the threat of the Evil God and their followers, allowing everyone to work together to eradicate this cancer?

And why did the High Priest still insist on finding that "guide" and tell him to keep a close eye on Lang Mu? Why did he even ask him to bring Lang Mu back to the Priest Palace alone to meet him if the opportunity arose?

What on earth was the High Priest...

Liang Runming didn't dare to think too deeply.

That was the High Priest, after all!

After much deliberation, Liang Runming finally made a decision: he would go find Ares Shang and Lang Mu and have a private conversation with them.

He decided to trust his own judgment rather than letting someone else tell him what he should or should not do.

He should have made up his mind long ago!

Liang Runming gave chase. He knew how to find the two of them; he only needed to find Nan Rong.

And Nan Rong would certainly return to the Southern Alliance.

*Swish!* Liang Runming slammed on the brakes.

A Winged Person suddenly appeared before him.

He remembered this individual; he was a member of the reconnaissance team sent out by the Winged Kingdom, seemingly named Jeli or Jemi.

"Priest, I have some definitive, secret information regarding the true identity of Ares Shang."

Liang Runming remained exceptionally calm. "Oh? Why come to me?"

Jeli replied, "Because you are a priest of the Priest Palace, and I don't know who else I can trust."

Liang Runming felt no sense of honor, only trouble. He remained silent.

Jeli clearly didn't intend to let him off, continuing directly: "I know your Priest Palace has been investigating Ares Shang, but you can't find his true origins, right?"

Liang Runming remained silent.

Jeli didn't care about Liang Runming's attitude and spoke on his own: "I discovered it by chance, and after tracking him for a while, I uncovered this person's greatest secret."

Liang Runming finally spoke: "What secret?"

Jeli said, "That Ares Shang is not a native of our Beastman Continent. He is a Soul Snatcher from the Magician Continent. He is a magician who usurped a beastman's body, devoured the original soul, and became the current Ares Shang. The original Ares Shang was just an unremarkable wandering beastman, which is why you could never dig up his background."

Liang Runming's expression shifted. "The Magician Continent? You say Ares Shang is a magician... a descendant of magic blood?"

Jeli nodded vigorously. "Yes! Otherwise, how could a young beastman possibly refine spatial storage tools? And possess such strength? It is precisely because he is a descendant of magic blood that he possesses alchemy skills different from ours."

Liang Runming fell into silence again. After a while, he spoke: "Ares Shang is a descendant of magic blood, so what?"

Jeli's expression was grave. "If he were merely a descendant of magic blood, it would be nothing, but I uncovered another piece of important information."

"What information?"

"As far as I know, the high-ranking members of the True God Sect are all descendants of magic blood." Jeli looked deeply at Liang Runming, as if to say: *Think about it, really think about it.*

Liang Runming's expression changed significantly. He couldn't help but overthink and delve deeper.
