Chapter 267: Battling the High Priest (Part 3)

As if afraid he hadn't provoked the High Priest enough, Shang Fan added, "Look, in the eyes of other gods, you’re just a piece of trash, at most a sacrifice. You aren't their kind at all."

This sentence seemed to touch a taboo, and the High Priest went completely berserk.

It threw its head back and let out a roar that didn't sound human. Its priest robes tore with a "rip," revealing the horrific body beneath—it was no longer a human body, but a terrifying, semi-melted form composed of flames and dark red energy.

The priests of the Priest Palace: ...No! This isn't our High Priest!

"I will burn away your impure, filthy souls, you blasphemers!" The High Priest’s voice was completely distorted, sounding like countless voices layered over one another.

The temperature in the entire assembly hall soared to an unbearable level. The wooden structures began to self-ignite, and metal objects turned red and softened. The energy barrier formed by the North and South Alliance Leaders trembled violently, on the verge of collapse.

"Not good!" North Bear Zhen roared, "Everyone, evacuate the hall! Stop risking your lives just to watch the show!"

The few remaining experts who had stayed to watch the spectacle no longer dared to be arrogant and scrambled frantically toward the exit. Chief Yan Wujin was the fastest among them.

The Insect King, Josie Doyle, remained until the end. His wing covers vibrated at high frequency, emitting a shrill alarm: "Shang! Lang! Get out! It looks like she’s going to self-destruct!"

Shang Fan, however, stood his ground, golden light flowing in his eyes: "No, she’s not self-destructing; she’s losing control of the energy within her."

Sure enough, the High Priest’s body began to expand and contract unnaturally, like a balloon about to burst. It clawed at its own throat in agony, making strange, wheezing sounds.

Strike while the iron is hot! Shang Fan whispered to Lang Mu: "Ah Mu, I’ll restrain it, you attack its sea of consciousness!"

Lang Mu nodded, his lips moving slightly, and the magic crystal at the tip of his staff erupted with a blinding light.

At the same time, Shang Fan took a deep breath, the golden light in his eyes almost becoming tangible. He held his hand in a clawing gesture and grabbed toward the High Priest: "Grievance Erosion!"

A black light exploded on the High Priest.

The energy composed of grievances continuously eroded the energy within the High Priest’s body.

The more the High Priest resented, the more it raged, the more powerful that grievance energy became.

That was the terror of Grievance Erosion!

The High Priest was shrouded in black light, and from time to time, a lump would bulge out from within the black light, as if someone were frantically slamming against it from the inside.

The High Priest also possessed a divinity fragment and had absorbed the divine power within it for years. Every time it struggled, Shang Fan’s face grew paler. Blood seeped from his nose and ears, but his expression remained exceptionally firm.

Lang Mu didn't look at Shang Fan; he knew how difficult it was for Shang Fan to hold on.

Now! The spiritual wave, gathered from both of them, was amplified by the staff to the greatest extent he could manage.

Lang Mu gripped the staff and pushed forward with great effort.

A spiritual cannonball, a fusion of green and black—appearing dark green—rushed toward the black light mass enveloping the High Priest, pierced it, and then exploded.

"ROAR—!" The High Priest let out a terrifying, inhuman scream.

The black light mass burst open, revealing the High Priest inside.

The flame energy mass, which no longer resembled a human, began to dim.

The priests of the Priest Palace exhaled, looking at each other: What should they do now?

Just as everyone thought the battle was about to end, a sudden change occurred!

A black-hole-like vortex suddenly tore open in the High Priest’s chest, and an indescribably evil aura leaked out from within.

Shang Fan and Lang Mu’s expressions changed simultaneously—that was the pure aura of an Evil God!

"Damn it! We’re finished!" The Insect King and several other big shots immediately retreated frantically; no one dared to touch that terrifying aura. Their instincts told them that if they touched that evil power, they would inevitably be corrupted.

Lang Mu didn't even think; relying on instinct, a vine moved faster than lightning, grabbing the High Priest’s remaining energy core and pulling it back violently.

Shang Fan acted at almost the same time, quickly grabbing Lang Mu’s wrist and sending him into the Statue Plaza.

In the center of the vortex, something seemed to be watching Shang Fan and Lang Mu. It looked as if it were annoyed at being a step too slow, or perhaps it was observing them.

Shang Fan’s ears twitched; he heard someone speaking to him.

The vortex vanished abruptly.

That powerful force, which no one could resist, also disappeared from the assembly hall.

The High Priest collapsed, its entire body transforming into a shriveled, thin, white mongoose with almost no fur left.

A deathly silence filled the assembly hall.

The North and South Alliance Leaders and the Insect King exchanged glances.

The priests of the Priest Palace had bitter expressions; some stepped toward the white mongoose that the High Priest had become.

"Watch out!" someone outside seemed to shout.

Everyone instinctively looked up.

Rumble!

The magnificent and solemn assembly hall could no longer support itself and collapsed completely.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第268章 大祭司的临终遗言 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第268章 大祭司的临终遗言

鬼火盟主虽然已经预料到会有这种结果……事实上只是议事大厅崩塌已经比他预想的最坏结果要好得多，这还是他让人打开议事大厅的防护系统并全力运行的后果。

可怜那防护系统原本是用来防守外对内的攻击，如今却变成了防止内部力量泄露出去。

想到为此消耗的庞大能量，鬼火盟主就心脏一阵抽痛。

对比起来，重建议事大厅的费用都不算什么了。

不说鬼火盟主的心痛，这边祭司宫的人在议事大厅崩塌的一瞬间，抱起白獴，全都冲出了废墟，来到外面花园。

商非凡比其他人都快了一步，他还把郎沐从雕像广场里带了出来。

其他几位大佬纷纷出现，鬼火盟主最慢，但大家跑得都很及时，身上连灰都没沾到多少。

祭司宫的祭司们抱着那只越发像是木乃伊一样的白獴，神情极为悲痛。

“能让我看看吗？”郎沐轻声道。

祭司宫的祭司们对郎沐和商非凡的感觉很复杂，但也说不上仇恨。

明眼人都能看出来他们的大祭司有多么不对劲，那跟记录中那温和慈善、睿智包容、胸襟宽广的老人完全不同。

而且祭司宫从古至今虽然尊敬神灵，却不会把不信仰神灵的人打成渎神者。相反祭司宫奉行古神们的意志，一直致力于让兽人们和神灵分开，不要过于依赖神灵、迷信神灵，更无需信仰某位神灵。

要说祭司宫真的信仰什么，那也是信仰知识。

千多年来，大祭司习惯待在她的独立住所，几乎少与人接触，后来多了一个守卫神台的职责，哦，那个神台也是突然出现的，被大祭司亲自验证说是神迹，是神灵用来沟通他们的重要所在。

大祭司十分看重那个神台，轻易不会让人接近。

也因为大祭司千年来几乎很少与祭司宫众人接触，包括距离大祭司最近的一些高层祭司也没有察觉大祭司的异样。

也许发现了，但……

这几位祭司想到千年来高层祭司更迭繁复，不少高层祭司要么被派往战场战死，要么突然生病逝世，要么失踪，心里陡然升起一股寒意。

之前他们哪怕听到商非凡那意有所指的话也没有多想，因为除了新生纪的两百多年，前面那近九百年真的太乱，祭司宫的高层祭司频繁出事自然也被大家视作正常。

可在见到大祭司“变身”后，再去回想祭司宫这千年来的变化，在场的祭司们不禁不寒而栗。

一位中年祭司抬起头，沉默地看着郎沐，就是他抱着白獴。

郎沐温和地说：“我看她似乎还有气息。”

他是用自然之力感知到白獴身体内那一点点生机。

可惜那生机过于衰弱，如风中残烛，随时都能熄灭。

几位祭司互视，梁润明祭司没说话，还是蚪海潮祭司先点了点头，表示自己相信郎沐。

蚪海潮接触和了解郎沐最多，深知他的人品。哪怕商非凡有问题，他觉得以郎沐的性格和为人也不可能做出邪恶之事，更不可能投向邪恶一方。

郎沐的手碰触到白獴的身体，越发感觉到那股生机的微弱，如果没有外力帮助，这位根本无法醒来，只会在悄然间离世。

商非凡感知到郎沐在输送力量给白獴，不赞同，但也没阻止——阿沐有他的判断。

不过什么样的力量能让一个生机断绝的人醒来？

自然之力吗？商非凡觉得不像。

片刻后，郎沐松开手。

祭司宫和其他几位走过来的大佬并不知道郎沐做了什么，只看到他用手放在白獴身上。

但就这么一会儿工夫，原本跟木乃伊一样、压根没有多少活气的白獴竟然眼皮抖动，慢慢睁开了眼睛。

“大祭司！”几位祭司激动地叫。

同时他们的心里也充满担心，害怕醒来的又是那不知是什么的东西。

但睁开眼的白獴，双眼比之前浑浊，眼神却十分清明和温和。

“我时间不多，就长话短说。”白獴一开口，声线明明和之前一样，但给人的感觉就是不同。

如果说之前的大祭司骨子里充满高高在上的超然，和人说话再温和都充满了居高临下屈尊纡贵感。那么现在这位白獴说话的感觉就像是邻家的慈善老人，学校里爱护学生的好老师。

商非凡微微诧异，他没想到千年前那位大祭司的灵魂竟然能坚持到现在都没有被战神的神格碎片意识给消磨光。

白獴根本无力坐起身，只示意抱着她的那位中年祭司，让他调整她的姿势，好让她看到众人。

中年祭司忙依言调整白獴的姿势，小心托住她。

虫王、北熊盟主、鬼火盟主、盐大酋长也都向这位白獴再次行礼。

白獴只用温和的眼神掠过他们，声音低弱：“抱歉，给你们添麻烦了。你们做得很好，是我祭司宫没有履行好应尽的职责。”

众大佬不管心里怎么想，嘴上都忙回说过奖和不敢。

白獴目光投向商非凡和郎沐，诚声说：“谢谢。谢谢你们让我脱离千年桎梏，更谢谢你们让我还有机会留下遗言。”

郎沐摇摇头，想说什么又止住。

商非凡直接摆手：“谢就不用了，只要你们祭司宫不要老是找我和阿沐的麻烦，成天想要献祭我们就成。”

祭司宫的祭司们全都十分尴尬。

“不会。献祭不可，任何时候都不可。”白獴这句话显然是在警告在场的祭司们。

几位祭司神色讪然又羞愧。是啊，他们祭司宫自成立以来就从没有献祭的说法，可为什么这些年“大祭司”说要献祭命运之子，他们就觉得理所当然了呢？

为什么他们没有跟大祭司据理力争？

是因为惧怕权威，还是因为……惰性？毕竟献祭这样的做法不伤（自己）筋动（自己）骨，只要说两句话，怎么看都是解决问题的最简单做法。

随后白獴又像是给祭司宫的祭司们交代遗言，又像是在给商非凡他们一个解释，在生命的最后留下三段话：

“当年战神为守护知识之神，被邪神重伤，导致神格碎裂、意识混乱。我受知识之神的嘱托，收藏了一枚战神的神格碎片，却被祭司宫里的邪神信徒暗算，为了不让对方带走那枚神格碎片，我不得不冒险吸收了那枚神格碎片。谁想，邪神利用残留在神格碎片中的气息，不断污染战神意识，最终导致那混乱意识抹杀我的意识，把我取而代之。”

“地壳中心的那股庞大能量并不属于神灵，那是神灵也在觊觎的星球本源之力，邪神更想得到它。我天河星依靠这股本源之力才能不断修复世界损伤、让世界重新来过，那是世界的根本。预言中兽人大陆的灭世灾难对于兽人是灭世，但对兽人大陆来说却是浴火重生。不要打本源之力的主意，你们的实力相差太远。保护本源之力……”

白獴已经越来越吃力，她的说话声已经低到大家需要极尽耳力才能听见。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 268: The High Priestess’s Dying Words

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader had already anticipated this outcome... In truth, the collapse of the council hall was far better than the worst-case scenario he had envisioned. This was only the result of him having ordered the council hall’s defensive system to be activated and run at full capacity.

Pity that the defensive system, originally designed to repel external attacks, had instead become a containment field to prevent the internal power from leaking out.

Thinking of the massive amount of energy consumed for this, the Ghostfire Alliance Leader felt a sharp, stabbing pain in his heart.

By comparison, the cost of rebuilding the council hall was nothing.

Setting aside the Ghostfire Alliance Leader’s heartache, the moment the council hall collapsed, the people from the Priestess Palace had scooped up Bai Mang and rushed out of the ruins to the garden outside.

Shang Feifan had been a step faster than everyone else; he had even managed to bring Lang Mu out of the statue plaza.

The other big shots appeared one after another. The Ghostfire Alliance Leader was the slowest, but everyone had escaped in time, barely even getting a speck of dust on them.

The priestesses of the Priestess Palace held the creature that looked increasingly like a mummy—Bai Mang—their expressions filled with profound grief.

"May I take a look?" Lang Mu asked softly.

The priestesses of the Priestess Palace had complex feelings toward Lang Mu and Shang Feifan, but they couldn't exactly call it hatred.

Anyone with eyes could see how wrong their High Priestess had been; she was nothing like the gentle, charitable, wise, and broad-minded elder described in the records.

Moreover, since ancient times, the Priestess Palace had respected the gods, but they never branded those who didn't believe in them as heretics. On the contrary, the Priestess Palace upheld the will of the ancient gods, striving to keep the Beastmen separate from the gods—not to be overly dependent on them, not to be superstitious, and certainly not to worship any specific deity.

If the Priestess Palace truly worshipped anything, it was knowledge.

For over a thousand years, the High Priestess had kept to her private residence, rarely interacting with others. Later, she took on the duty of guarding the Divine Altar—oh, that altar had also appeared suddenly, verified by the High Priestess herself as a miracle, a vital place for the gods to communicate with them.

The High Priestess had valued that altar highly and rarely allowed anyone near it.

Because the High Priestess had barely interacted with anyone in the Palace for a millennium, even the high-ranking priests closest to her had failed to notice her abnormality.

Perhaps they had noticed, but...

As these priests recalled the complex turnover of high-ranking priests over the last thousand years—many of whom had either died in battle, passed away from sudden illnesses, or simply vanished—a chill crept into their hearts.

Before, even when they heard Shang Feifan’s pointed remarks, they hadn't thought much of it. After all, aside from the two hundred years of the New Era, the preceding nine hundred years had been truly chaotic; the frequent incidents involving high-ranking priests were naturally seen as normal.

But after seeing the High Priestess "transform," and looking back at the changes in the Priestess Palace over the last millennium, the priests present couldn't help but shudder.

A middle-aged priest looked up, silently watching Lang Mu, who was holding Bai Mang.

Lang Mu said gently, "I believe she still has a breath of life."

He was using his perception of the Power of Nature to sense that tiny spark of vitality within Bai Mang’s body.

Unfortunately, that vitality was too weak, like a candle in the wind, ready to be extinguished at any moment.

The priests exchanged glances. Priest Liang Runming remained silent, but Priest Dou Haichao nodded first, signaling his trust in Lang Mu.

Dou Haichao had the most contact and understanding of Lang Mu and knew his character well. Even if Shang Feifan had his issues, he felt that with Lang Mu’s personality and conduct, it was impossible for him to do anything evil, let alone side with the forces of darkness.

Lang Mu’s hand touched Bai Mang’s body, feeling the vitality grow even fainter. Without external help, she would never wake up; she would simply pass away in silence.

Shang Feifan sensed Lang Mu channeling power into Bai Mang. He disapproved, but he didn't stop him—A-Mu had his own judgment.

But what kind of power could wake someone whose life force was severed?

The Power of Nature? Shang Feifan didn't think so.

A moment later, Lang Mu withdrew his hand.

The priestesses and the other big shots who had walked over didn't know what Lang Mu had done; they only saw him place his hand on Bai Mang.

Yet, in that short span of time, Bai Mang, who had been as lifeless as a mummy, saw her eyelids flutter, and she slowly opened her eyes.

"High Priestess!" the priests called out, trembling with excitement.

At the same time, their hearts were filled with dread, fearing that whatever woke up would be that unknown, monstrous entity again.

But the Bai Mang who opened her eyes had a gaze that, while cloudier than before, was clear and gentle.

"I don't have much time, so I will keep this brief." As soon as Bai Mang spoke, her voice was the same as before, yet the feeling it conveyed was entirely different.

If the previous High Priestess had been filled with an aloof, high-and-mighty arrogance—where even her gentlest words felt condescending—then this Bai Mang spoke like a charitable neighbor or a kind teacher who truly cared for her students.

Shang Feifan was slightly surprised. He hadn't expected the soul of the High Priestess from a thousand years ago to have persisted until now without being completely eroded by the consciousness of the War God’s divine fragment.

Bai Mang was too weak to sit up; she simply gestured to the middle-aged priest holding her to adjust her posture so she could see everyone.

The middle-aged priest hurried to comply, carefully supporting her.

The Insect King, the North Bear Alliance Leader, the Ghostfire Alliance Leader, and the Great Chieftain of Salt all bowed to this Bai Mang once more.

Bai Mang merely swept a gentle gaze over them, her voice faint: "Apologies for the trouble I have caused. You have all done well; it is my Priestess Palace that failed to fulfill its duties."

Regardless of what they were thinking, the big shots hurriedly replied with words of humility and deference.

Bai Mang turned her gaze toward Shang Feifan and Lang Mu, saying sincerely: "Thank you. Thank you for freeing me from a thousand years of shackles, and thank you even more for giving me the chance to leave my final words."

Lang Mu shook his head, wanting to say something but stopping himself.

Shang Feifan waved a hand dismissively: "No need for thanks. Just make sure your Priestess Palace stops bothering me and A-Mu, and stops trying to sacrifice us every single day."

The priests of the Priestess Palace were all deeply embarrassed.

"It will not happen. Sacrifice is forbidden—at any time, it is forbidden." Bai Mang’s words were clearly a warning to the priests present.

The priests looked ashamed and sheepish. Indeed, their Priestess Palace had never had a tradition of sacrifice since its founding. Why, then, had they felt it was only natural when the "High Priestess" said she wanted to sacrifice the Child of Destiny?

Why hadn't they argued against the High Priestess?

Was it fear of authority, or was it... inertia? After all, sacrifice was a method that didn't hurt (themselves) and didn't require much effort; as long as you said a few words, it always seemed like the simplest way to solve a problem.

Then, as if giving final instructions to the priests and an explanation to Shang Feifan and the others, Bai Mang left three messages in her final moments:

"Back then, the War God was severely wounded by the Evil God while protecting the God of Knowledge, leading to the shattering of his divinity and the chaos of his consciousness. Entrusted by the God of Knowledge, I hid a fragment of the War God’s divinity, but I was ambushed by followers of the Evil God within the Priestess Palace. To prevent them from taking the fragment, I had to risk absorbing it. Who would have thought that the Evil God would use the aura remaining in the fragment to continuously pollute the War God’s consciousness, eventually leading that chaotic consciousness to erase my own and take my place."

"The massive energy at the center of the Earth’s crust does not belong to the gods; it is the source power of the planet, which even the gods covet, and which the Evil God desires even more. My Tianhe Star relies on this source power to continuously repair the world’s damage and allow it to start anew; it is the foundation of the world. The apocalyptic disaster for the Beastman Continent in the prophecy is an end for the Beastmen, but for the Beastman Continent itself, it is a rebirth through fire. Do not covet the source power; your strength is far too lacking. Protect the source power..."

Bai Mang was struggling more and more; her voice had dropped to a whisper that required everyone to strain their ears to hear.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第268章 大祭司的临终遗言 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
郎沐想要再给她输送一点生命力，却发现已经输送不进去，白獴的肉-体已经彻底死亡，他没办法让死亡的身体复活。现在白獴还能说话，依靠的是她灵魂中残留的一点精神力。

最后，白獴眼睛像是在看着商非凡和郎沐两人，竭尽所能地吐出：“命运之子将会引动遥远星辰之力助力天河星。当七枚血月凌空，邪神脱困，命运之子集异星之力……，大家需要齐心辅助命运之子，争夺……一线生机。记得去神台……神台给商……恢复知识之神的意识……”

白獴的声音戛然而止。

商非凡看到一点灵光从白獴身体里飘起，在空中四散开来，飘飘渺渺地回归天地本源。

而众人都听到了一声充满惆怅和担忧的叹息。

“大祭司……”中年祭司悲伤的声音把众人注意力拉回。

所有人都看到中年祭司抱在手臂中的木乃伊白獴在瞬间化作沙尘，就这么落到地上，被风一吹，也就此全部消散，再没有留下半点痕迹。

现场众人沉默了好一会儿，像是在对这位大祭司进行最后的默哀告别。

“咳，大祭司最后说的那些话，诸位怎么看？”鬼火盟主打破沉寂。

那位中年祭司深吸气，缓和哀伤后，说道：“我们大祭司临终前已经说得很清楚，地壳中心那股庞大能量不能动，那是世界的本源之力。”

北熊盟主沉吟片刻，也说道：“如果那股能量真的是世界本源之力，我们确实不应该动。不但不能动，更应该保护其。”

虫王比较现实，问：“照大祭司那些话的意思，我们兽人大陆的灭世灾难是必然会发生的事情，我们不但不该阻止，反而应该顺应？可真要任凭灾难发生，那我们这么多人和生灵该怎么办？天河星最高意识希望借由岩浆来让兽人大陆重生，那我们这些兽人虫人和其他生命种族就活该死亡？”

盐大酋长眼神有点闪烁，跟着说道：“虽说本源之力不该动，可有没有办法不让它爆发？如果本源之力不爆发，我们兽人大陆也不会爆发灭世型的灾难，对不对？”

鬼火盟主看向商非凡和郎沐：“二位怎么看？”

真话说，商非凡也不知道该怎么办。

依照他的性子，他只想带着郎沐和郎沐重视的亲朋好友离开兽人大陆，找个远离大陆架的岛屿待上一段时间，然后任由兽人大陆灾难爆发。

到时候兽人大陆重生，虫毒彻底消失，他们再回去兽人大陆就是。

但郎沐肯定不会同意他这个做法，让他家阿沐看着那么多人和生命死亡，却什么也不做，阿沐可能宁可自己去死一死。

可他也决不能说他会为了郎沐怎样怎样，否则郎沐为了不给他压力，只会离开他，然后把所有事情都一肩担。

所以商非凡只能说：“大祭司不是给我们留了一条线索吗？”

“你是说那个神台？”鬼火印及时反应过来。

祭司宫的祭司们也看向商非凡。

商非凡耸肩：“大祭司似乎很希望我去看看那个神台，还说要把神台留给我的话，并提到了知识之神。虽然不知道神台具体有什么作用，但在现在两眼一抹黑的情况下，我似乎也只能先去研究下那个神台。”

几位大佬对神台都很好奇，更眼馋神台的作用，但大祭司明言说要把神台给商非凡，他们也不好明抢，可谁都想要看看神台到底是什么样，又具体有什么作用，最重要的是他们想知道神台能否给商带来好处。

其中盐无尽大酋长最心急，直接对祭司宫的祭司们说：“不如我们就走一趟祭司宫，见一见那座神台。说不定伟大的知识之神还能给我们一些指引。”

北熊盟主忽然说：“大祭司遗言中提到命运之子引动异星之力，不知道是什么意思？我们是否有必要快点找出这位命运之子，一起帮助他对抗邪神进行救世？”

虫王：“比起这个，我更在乎七枚血月升空，邪神就会脱困这个预言。祭司宫的诸位知道血月凌空的具体时间吗？”

几位祭司互视，一起摇头。

虫王不满：“你们祭司宫怎么连这么关键的信息都不清楚？”

几位祭司苦笑，他们祭司又不是都擅长预言和推算。

倒是一位擅长天象学的祭司说道：“据历史观测，血月一般发生在月全食出现的时候。另外，如果有火山爆发，火山灰也会让月亮的颜色改变。”

听到的众人有好几人神情一变。

蚪海潮祭司更是曲手指当场计算下一次七枚月亮成一线，完整的七月全食出现的时间。

盐大酋长心急，急问：“下次七月全食是什么时候？”

那位擅长天象学的祭司不用计算，苦笑着说出答案：“最近的一次就在今年的9月7日夜晚。”

“那不是还有七个月了！”盐大酋长脱口惊呼。

在场众人脸色都变得极为难看。

如果大祭司的临终遗言都是真实，也就是说七个月后那名邪神厄穆克拉索就会脱困，到时候别说他们兽人大陆，整个天河星会变成怎样，谁也不知道。

“七个月……能干什么？我们兽人大陆本身的灭世灾难还没有办法解决，结果七个月后邪神就会脱困，那我们还挣扎什么劲，干脆坐等死好了。”盐无尽大酋长气恼地说。

他原本以为他们东海部落会在这次大灾中占尽便宜，至少他们沿海还会造船，他更是早早把自家积累的庞大财富和喜欢的孩子都送去了海外岛屿。

到时候等船只造得差不多，他只要带上最忠心于他的一部分人，再加上干活的奴隶，他们盐家就依然能在海外岛屿当他们的土皇帝。

可七个月后邪神就会脱困……

只要回想邪神出现时对整个天河星造成的莫大危害——那时还有众神拦截祂、困住祂，现在众神都陨落的陨落、沉睡的沉睡，没有众神保护的他们，要怎么面对连众神合力都打不过的邪神？

不止盐大酋长沮丧，其他大佬们也没有好到哪里去，他们和邪神的实力相差太大了！

“我们也不用现在就等死，你们忘了我们还有命运之子？”

“可到底谁是命运之子？”

有人的目光有意无意看向商非凡和郎沐。

商非凡懒懒地说：“事情一件件做吧。我和郎沐就和诸位祭司先去一趟祭司宫，瞅瞅那个神台。”

“对，先去看看神台那里有什么线索。然后再研究地底那股本源能量。”鬼火盟主迅速接口。

其他人对此也没有意见，更没有人想要浪费时间，当即决定今天就一起赶赴祭司宫。

商非凡感觉到郎沐一丝异样，侧头看他，暗中握住他的手。

郎沐对他笑了笑，用地星母语对他说：“刚才我进入广场，那位给我传达了一点模糊意识，祂不但教会我如何使用自然的生命之力，还让我把生命之力灌输给大祭司。”

商非凡脑子一转，立时明白：“和知识之神有关？”

自然之神大概是想借大祭司之口告诉他们拯救知识之神的办法。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 268: The High Priestess’s Dying Words (Part 2)

Lang Mu tried to channel a bit more life force into her, only to find that it could no longer be absorbed. Bai Mang’s physical body had completely died; he could not resurrect a corpse. The only reason Bai Mang could still speak was due to the lingering sliver of spiritual power in her soul.

Finally, Bai Mang’s eyes seemed to fix on Shang Feifan and Lang Mu as she strained to utter: "The Child of Destiny will draw upon the power of distant stars to aid Tianhe Star. When seven blood moons fill the sky, the Evil God will break free, and the Child of Destiny will gather the power of alien stars... Everyone must work together to assist the Child of Destiny and fight for... a glimmer of hope. Remember to go to the Divine Altar... The Divine Altar will give Shang... restore the consciousness of the God of Knowledge..."

Bai Mang’s voice cut off abruptly.

Shang Feifan saw a spark of light drift from Bai Mang’s body, scattering into the air, ethereal and drifting as it returned to the source of the heavens and earth.

And everyone heard a sigh filled with melancholy and worry.

"High Priestess..." the middle-aged priest’s sorrowful voice pulled everyone’s attention back.

Everyone watched as the mummified Bai Mang in the middle-aged priest’s arms turned to dust in an instant, falling to the ground and dissipating completely in the wind, leaving not a single trace behind.

The people present remained silent for a long while, as if observing a final moment of mourning for the High Priestess.

"Ahem, what do you all make of the High Priestess’s final words?" the Ghostfire Alliance Leader broke the silence.

The middle-aged priest took a deep breath, steadying his grief, and said: "The High Priestess made it very clear before she passed: the massive energy at the center of the Earth’s crust must not be touched. It is the source power of the world."

The North Bear Alliance Leader pondered for a moment and added: "If that energy is truly the world’s source power, we indeed should not touch it. Not only should we not touch it, we should protect it."

The Insect King was more pragmatic: "According to the High Priestess, the apocalyptic disaster of our Beastman Continent is inevitable. Not only should we not stop it, we should go along with it? But if we really let the disaster happen, what will become of all of us and all living things? If the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star hopes to use magma to let the Beastman Continent be reborn, then are we Beastmen, Insect-men, and other life forms just meant to die?"

The Great Chieftain of Salt’s eyes flickered as he followed up: "While the source power shouldn't be touched, is there a way to prevent it from erupting? If the source power doesn't erupt, our Beastman Continent won't face an apocalyptic disaster, right?"

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader looked at Shang Feifan and Lang Mu: "What do you two think?"

To be honest, Shang Feifan didn't know what to do either.

According to his nature, he only wanted to take Lang Mu and the friends and family Lang Mu cared about and leave the Beastman Continent, find an island far from the continental shelf, stay there for a while, and let the disaster on the Beastman Continent run its course.

Once the Beastman Continent was reborn and the insect toxins were completely gone, they could just return.

But Lang Mu would certainly not agree to this. If he made his A-Mu watch so many people and lives perish while doing nothing, A-Mu might rather die himself.

Yet, he absolutely could not say that he would do whatever it took for Lang Mu’s sake, otherwise, to avoid putting pressure on him, Lang Mu would only leave him and shoulder everything alone.

So, Shang Feifan could only say: "Didn't the High Priestess leave us a clue?"

"You mean that Divine Altar?" the Ghostfire Alliance Leader reacted quickly.

The priests of the Priestess Palace also looked at Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan shrugged: "The High Priestess seemed very eager for me to see that altar, even saying she wanted to leave it to me, and she mentioned the God of Knowledge. Although I don't know what the altar specifically does, in our current state of being completely in the dark, I suppose I have no choice but to go and study it."

The big shots were all curious about the altar and even more covetous of its function, but since the High Priestess had explicitly stated she wanted to leave it to Shang Feifan, they couldn't exactly snatch it by force. However, everyone wanted to see what the altar looked like and what it actually did. Most importantly, they wanted to know if it could bring benefits to Shang.

The Great Chieftain of Salt, Yan Wujin, was the most impatient, saying directly to the priests: "Why don't we make a trip to the Priestess Palace and see that altar? Perhaps the great God of Knowledge can give us some guidance."

The North Bear Alliance Leader suddenly said: "The High Priestess’s dying words mentioned the Child of Destiny drawing upon the power of alien stars. What does that mean? Is it necessary for us to quickly find this Child of Destiny and help him fight the Evil God to save the world?"

The Insect King: "Compared to that, I care more about the prophecy that the Evil God will break free when seven blood moons rise. Do you in the Priestess Palace know the specific time for the blood moons?"

The priests looked at each other and shook their heads.

The Insect King was dissatisfied: "How can your Priestess Palace not even know such crucial information?"

The priests gave a bitter smile; not all priests were skilled in prophecy and calculation.

However, one priest who specialized in astronomy said: "According to historical observations, blood moons usually occur during total lunar eclipses. Additionally, if there is a volcanic eruption, volcanic ash can also change the color of the moon."

Several people who heard this had their expressions change.

Priest Dou Haichao even began calculating on his fingers the time for the next alignment of the seven moons and a complete seven-moon total eclipse.

The Great Chieftain of Salt asked anxiously: "When is the next seven-moon total eclipse?"

The priest skilled in astronomy didn't need to calculate, saying with a bitter smile: "The next one is on the night of September 7th of this year."

"That’s only seven months away!" the Great Chieftain of Salt exclaimed.

The faces of everyone present turned extremely ugly.

If the High Priestess’s dying words were true, it meant that seven months from now, the Evil God, Umuklaso, would break free. At that point, let alone their Beastman Continent, no one knew what would become of the entire Tianhe Star.

"Seven months... what can we do in seven months? We can't even solve the apocalyptic disaster of our own Beastman Continent, and now the Evil God will be free in seven months. Why should we even struggle? We might as well just sit and wait for death," the Great Chieftain of Salt said irritably.

He had originally thought that his East Sea tribe would gain every advantage in this catastrophe; at the very least, they knew how to build ships along the coast, and he had long ago sent his accumulated wealth and the children he favored to overseas islands.

When the ships were ready, he would just take his most loyal followers and the slaves who did the labor, and the Yan family would still be able to live as local kings on the overseas islands.

But if the Evil God was going to break free in seven months...

Just recalling the immense harm the Evil God had caused to the entire Tianhe Star when it first appeared—back when the gods were still there to intercept and contain it—now that the gods had either fallen or were in deep slumber, how were they, without the protection of the gods, supposed to face an Evil God that even the combined efforts of the gods couldn't defeat?

It wasn't just the Great Chieftain of Salt who was dejected; the other big shots weren't doing any better. The gap in strength between them and the Evil God was simply too vast!

"We don't have to wait for death just yet. Have you forgotten we still have the Child of Destiny?"

"But who exactly is the Child of Destiny?"

Some people’s gazes drifted intentionally or unintentionally toward Shang Feifan and Lang Mu.

Shang Feifan said lazily: "Let’s take things one step at a time. Lang Mu and I will go to the Priestess Palace with the priests first and take a look at that altar."

"Right, let’s see what clues are at the altar first. Then we can study that source energy underground," the Ghostfire Alliance Leader quickly agreed.

The others had no objections, and no one wanted to waste time, so they immediately decided to head to the Priestess Palace together today.

Shang Feifan sensed something unusual from Lang Mu, turned his head to look at him, and secretly held his hand.

Lang Mu smiled at him and whispered in their native Earth language: "Just now, when I entered the plaza, that entity transmitted a vague consciousness to me. Not only did it teach me how to use the natural life force, but it also told me to channel that life force into the High Priestess."

Shang Feifan’s mind raced, and he immediately understood: "It has to do with the God of Knowledge?"

The God of Nature probably wanted to use the High Priestess’s mouth to tell them how to save the God of Knowledge.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第268章 大祭司的临终遗言 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
郎沐竖起大拇指，他家老商脑子转得是真的快：“我觉得也是。”

因为有自然之神的意思在内，郎沐才没有怀疑大祭司的临终遗言。

否则就凭之前那混乱的战神神格碎片意识的表现——那东西显然也想他们去接触神台，他们就不会想要靠近那座神台。

“总之，对那座神台要小心。”郎沐还是有些不安。

商非凡挑眉：“那当然。我的人生目标就是和你活得长长久久开开心心健健康康，如果真有危险，我会跑得比谁都快。”

郎沐被逗笑。

“如果……”

“嗯？”

“如果兽人……我们真的没救了，你一定要保全好自己。”郎沐终于说出。

商非凡在这么简单的一句话中听出了千言万语，不由握紧郎沐的手：“嗯，知道。无论如何我都会保住自己的命。”

郎沐说这句话是不希望他背负命运之子救世的压力。

而他说这句话则是因为他不死，郎沐就不会死！
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 268: The High Priestess’s Dying Words (Part 3)

Lang Mu gave a thumbs-up; his old Shang’s brain really turned fast: "I think so too."

Because the will of the God of Nature was involved, Lang Mu hadn't doubted the High Priestess’s dying words.

Otherwise, just based on the previous behavior of that chaotic War God divine fragment—that thing clearly also wanted them to approach the altar—they wouldn't have wanted to go anywhere near it.

"In any case, we must be careful with that altar," Lang Mu said, still feeling a bit uneasy.

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow: "Of course. My life goal is to live a long, happy, and healthy life with you. If there’s real danger, I’ll run faster than anyone."

Lang Mu was amused.

"If..."

"Hmm?"

"If the Beastmen... if we really are beyond saving, you must protect yourself." Lang Mu finally said it.

Shang Feifan heard a thousand words in that simple sentence and couldn't help but squeeze Lang Mu’s hand: "Yeah, I know. No matter what, I will keep myself alive."

Lang Mu said this because he didn't want him to bear the pressure of the Child of Destiny saving the world.

And he said it because as long as he didn't die, Lang Mu wouldn't die!

chunks.chapterTitle: 第269章 出发前的小变故 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第269章 出发前的小变故

鬼火市有传送阵，而且是直达祭司宫的传送阵。

祭司宫众人前来的时候，就使用的这个传送阵。

商非凡看其他大佬面对传送阵一脸平淡的模样，就猜出在各大势力中传送阵并不少见。

不过想想虎国都还有不少传送阵，有的被贵族家里掌握，有的被真神教掌握，还有些则被洛伦米尔顿发掘出来，除此之外，说不定还有一些隐藏传送阵没有被人发觉。

可见在兽人大繁华纪时，传送阵应该属于很普通很常见的交通手段之一。

之前，商非凡和郎沐两人就聊过，说南戎他们赶路还挺快，虽然他们一路耽搁了不少时间，并没有直线飞来鬼火市，但南戎他们貌似也是在三五天内就从西边赶回了南边。

兽人大陆有多庞大，只看从虎国天残谷到鬼火市的直线距离就知道，那可是从地星东半球到西半球的距离。

商非凡得到飞车后就猜测这些大势力中说不定也有类似的交通工具，或就是利用了传送阵衔接。

也怪不得虫王等大佬们半点不担心旅途中的消耗和自家势力，说去祭司宫看热闹就去，原来跑一趟基本不会耽误事。

郎沐低声问：“刚刚你是不是联系阿呆和小花了？”

商非凡承认：“我让他们先待在鬼火市。”

他们这次过去祭司宫，不确定安全与否，还不如把阿呆留在鬼火市——虽然小花花强大，但他们接触的可是神灵力量。

比起底细不明的祭司宫，鬼火市则要安全得多。阿呆身边有靠谱的狰爷，再加上实力强大堪比虫母的小花花，保命肯定是不成问题的，真遇到什么事，靠瞬移和撕裂空间也能及时逃掉。

阿呆和小花花也同意了。

阿呆虽然很想跟着两个爸爸一起行动，但他也知道他现在实力太低微，跟着两个爸爸很有可能成为拖后腿的那个，便决定留在鬼火市等待两个爸爸归来。

小花花也不介意当保姆，它就没有当保姆的概念，它只是单纯喜欢阿呆，想要留在他身边。别看它实力强大，但在平常生活中，基本都是阿呆照顾它、包容它。

狰爷……无所谓啦，反正它带小崽子都带习惯了。

鬼火盟主打开传送阵时，一脸肉痛。

就是对他们南方联盟这样富裕的势力来说，传送阵也属于战略性-交通工具，不到万不得已就不会轻易使用。

因为开一次传送阵就会耗费大量能量。

鬼火盟主清点了一下前往祭司宫的乘客人数，发现没有超过限定，心中松了口气——只开一次太好了！

“你们这个传送阵使用的能量是光能？”商非凡冷不丁问。

鬼火盟主一愣，回答：“是。”

可能见商非凡感兴趣，他还多说了一点：“我们使用的传送阵和蓄能装备都是从大繁华纪保留下来的宝贝，可惜我们知识断层太厉害，等我们弄明白怎么使用这些宝贝就消耗了很长时间，更别说维修和新建。就因为我们不懂传送阵和蓄能装置原理，导致我们虽然发现不少传送阵，但因为传送阵损毁，压根无法使用。”

鬼火盟主叹息：“就剩这么几个能用的宝贝……就是这个连通祭司宫的传送阵，还是祭司宫派来我南方联盟的祭司帮助维修和维护才能正常使用。”

“哦？既然那位祭司能维修传送阵，为什么不请他帮忙把其他传送阵也给维修好？而且祭司宫不是肩负知识传承的任务吗？没有让他教你们传送阵的布置原理？”商非凡故作一脸不解地问。

鬼火盟主表情微妙，似乎想要撇嘴，忍住了，还算委婉地说：“他说他对传送阵的原理也是一知半解，只能维修一些简单故障，属于使用者级别的维修能力。”

商非凡懂了，这就相当于地星人使用电器，发现电器故障，如果只是简单的断电、某配件损毁，那只要使用者重新通电或更换配件就可以。但如果故障检查不出来，或损毁情况较为严重，就需要找专业人员进行维修。

“奇怪，祭司宫就算因为大祭司被换了人，导致走错路，但其内部的祭司们应该不会断了传承吧？难道就没有人专修传送阵相关知识？”商非凡自言自语。

旁边几位祭司表情尴尬，他们内部人自然知道原因。

上面不肯派人去维修各地传送阵，说是为了避免各势力利用传送阵发起对敌对势力的突袭，总之就是避免战争。

但实际上，他们祭司宫都知道上面不派人去维修和新建传送阵，主要还是不希望兽人大陆连成一体，希望他们能各自为政，继续小本经营。

南方联盟等大势力之所以能拥有直接通往祭司宫的传送阵，还是他们祭司宫收了巨大好处，并希望进一步控制住这些大势力，这些大势力也答应每年出资供奉祭司宫，祭司宫这才派人过来修复了几个传送阵。

这其中的利益交换和权力博弈，各大势力的大佬们全都心知肚明，他们虽然对祭司宫不满，但知识和技能都掌握在人家手里，他们能怎么办？

祭司宫的祭司们也全都揣着明白装糊涂——上面让他们转型，不再当知识传授者，而是改为当神官，他们也只能跟着转变。

但自从郎沐找出那座图书馆，并让虎国把其中的传承和知识全都公开后，祭司宫对各大势力的钳制力就一下小了许多。

各大势力只要花费不算太大的代价就能从虎国那边得到非常完整的知识体系，其中自然也包括传送阵。

财大气粗的势力恨不得把虎国拿出来的传承知识全都买下来——比起祭司宫压根不肯把好东西拿出来，拿出来也是缺斤少两，至少虎国那边给钱就肯换，还不会缺字少章。

祭司宫内部也不得不为此多次召开会议，商量是不是要再次转型。

大祭司为什么会愿意在这次会议露面？

还不就是因为祭司宫内部急了，高层祭司和大祭司都感觉到兽人大陆的各大势力在飞快脱离他们的掌控。

以前像是这种要到地壳中心探险且涉及到整个大陆强者的重要事情，各大势力怎么可能会不通知祭司宫？

可这次，就是没有人通知。还是他们祭司宫自己弄到消息，不请自来。

鬼火盟主还是给了祭司宫一些面子，主动提到：“我们那位被祭司宫派遣过来的祭司虽然没有传授我们传送阵相关的知识，但他教我们怎么制作蓄能仪，怎么收集光能和大地能量。”

“大地能量？”商非凡很在意这点。

鬼火盟主：“就是地底热能。”

“原来是地底热能。”商非凡沉吟。

这和他以为的地能就不一样了。当初他发现洛伦米尔顿使用的那个传送阵，使用的就是地能，但那地能绝不是地热能量。

说起来，洛伦米尔顿使用的地能更像是在抽取大地本身的能量，就像是抽取土壤的生命力和养分。

好像也不对……

商非凡有点后悔，当时他没有仔细研究那些使用地能当能量的传送阵，只是大致了解了一番。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 269: A Minor Incident Before Departure

Ghostfire City possessed a teleportation array—and one that led directly to the Priest Palace.

When the delegation from the Priest Palace arrived, they had utilized this very array.

As Shang Feifan observed the other power brokers reacting with indifference to the array, he deduced that such technology was not particularly rare among the major factions.

Thinking back, even the Tiger Kingdom possessed quite a few teleportation arrays; some were controlled by noble families, others by the True God Sect, and some had been unearthed by Loren Milton. Beyond these, there were likely hidden arrays that had yet to be discovered.

It was evident that during the Great Prosperity Era of the Beastmen, teleportation arrays must have been a common and mundane means of transportation.

Previously, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had discussed how the Southern Rong traveled quite quickly. Although they had been delayed several times and had not flown in a straight line to Ghostfire City, it seemed they had still managed to return from the west to the south within three to five days.

One only had to look at the straight-line distance from the Tiger Kingdom’s Heavenly Remnant Valley to Ghostfire City to realize the sheer scale of the Beastman Continent—it was a distance equivalent to traveling from the eastern hemisphere to the western hemisphere of Earth.

After obtaining his flying vehicle, Shang Feifan had speculated that these major factions might possess similar transport tools or rely on interconnected teleportation arrays.

It was no wonder the Insect King and the other bigwigs were not the least bit worried about the consumption of resources or the state of their own territories during the journey. If they wanted to go to the Priest Palace to watch the spectacle, they went; a round trip would essentially cause no delay to their affairs.

Lang Mu asked in a low voice, "Did you contact A-Dai and Xiao Hua just now?"

Shang Feifan acknowledged, "I told them to stay in Ghostfire City for now."

They were heading to the Priest Palace, and since the safety of the situation was uncertain, it was better to leave A-Dai in Ghostfire City. Although Xiao Hua was powerful, they were dealing with the power of gods.

Compared to the opaque and mysterious Priest Palace, Ghostfire City was far safer. With the reliable Master Zheng by A-Dai’s side, plus the powerful Xiao Hua—whose strength rivaled that of an Insect Mother—survival would certainly not be an issue. If they truly encountered trouble, they could escape in time using teleportation and spatial tearing.

A-Dai and Xiao Hua had agreed.

Although A-Dai desperately wanted to follow his two fathers, he knew his strength was too meager; following them would likely make him a burden. Thus, he decided to stay in Ghostfire City and wait for their return.

Xiao Hua didn't mind playing the role of a nanny. It didn't even have a concept of what a "nanny" was; it simply liked A-Dai and wanted to stay by his side. Despite its immense power, in their daily life, it was usually A-Dai who took care of it and accommodated its whims.

As for Master Zheng... it didn't care. It was already used to looking after the little ones.

When the Ghostfire Alliance Leader activated the teleportation array, he looked as if he were in physical pain.

Even for a wealthy faction like the Southern Alliance, teleportation arrays were considered strategic transport tools, not to be used lightly unless absolutely necessary.

This was because a single activation consumed a massive amount of energy.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader counted the number of passengers heading to the Priest Palace and, finding it within the limit, let out a sigh of relief—thank goodness it only needed to be opened once!

"Is the energy used by this array light-based?" Shang Feifan asked suddenly.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader was startled, then replied, "Yes."

Perhaps seeing that Shang Feifan was interested, he elaborated, "The teleportation arrays and energy storage equipment we use are treasures preserved from the Great Prosperity Era. Unfortunately, our knowledge has suffered such a severe disconnect that it took us a long time just to understand how to use these treasures, let alone repair or build new ones. Because we don't understand the principles behind the arrays and the storage devices, we’ve discovered many arrays that we simply cannot use because they are damaged."

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader sighed, "These are the only few treasures left that still work... Even this array connecting to the Priest Palace only functions because the Priest Palace sent a priest to the Southern Alliance to help repair and maintain it."

"Oh? Since that priest can repair teleportation arrays, why not ask him to help fix the others? And doesn't the Priest Palace shoulder the duty of passing down knowledge? Didn't he teach you the principles of how to set them up?" Shang Feifan asked, feigning confusion.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader’s expression turned subtle. He seemed to want to sneer but held it back, saying diplomatically, "He said his understanding of the principles is only superficial. He can only repair simple malfunctions; his skills are at the level of a mere user."

Shang Feifan understood. This was equivalent to people on Earth using electrical appliances; if they broke, the user could fix simple issues like a power cut or a damaged accessory. But if the fault couldn't be identified or the damage was severe, one had to find a professional.

"Strange. Even if the Priest Palace changed High Priests and lost their way, the priests within shouldn't have lost their heritage, right? Is there really no one who specializes in the knowledge of teleportation arrays?" Shang Feifan muttered to himself.

The priests nearby wore awkward expressions; they naturally knew the reason.

The higher-ups refused to send people to repair the arrays across the land, claiming it was to prevent factions from using them to launch surprise attacks on their enemies—in short, to avoid war.

But in reality, everyone in the Priest Palace knew that the main reason they didn't send people to repair or build new arrays was that they didn't want the Beastman Continent to become a unified whole. They wanted the factions to remain divided and continue their small-scale, localized rule.

The reason major factions like the Southern Alliance could possess a direct line to the Priest Palace was that the Palace had received massive benefits and hoped to further control these factions. The factions had agreed to provide annual funding to the Priest Palace, and only then did the Palace send people to repair a few arrays.

The major power brokers were all well aware of these interest exchanges and power plays. Although they were dissatisfied with the Priest Palace, the knowledge and skills were in the hands of the other party—what could they do?

The priests of the Priest Palace also played dumb—the higher-ups had ordered them to transition from being "transmitters of knowledge" to "divine officials," so they had no choice but to follow suit.

However, ever since Lang Mu discovered that library and forced the Tiger Kingdom to make all its heritage and knowledge public, the Priest Palace’s grip on the major factions had loosened significantly.

The major factions could obtain a complete knowledge system, including teleportation arrays, from the Tiger Kingdom at a relatively low cost.

Wealthy factions were eager to buy up all the knowledge the Tiger Kingdom offered—unlike the Priest Palace, which refused to share the good stuff or provided incomplete, fragmented information, the Tiger Kingdom was willing to trade for money and never skimped on the details.

The Priest Palace had been forced to hold multiple internal meetings to discuss whether they needed to undergo another transformation.

Why was the High Priest willing to appear at this meeting?

It was precisely because the Priest Palace was in a panic; both the high-ranking priests and the High Priest sensed that the major factions of the Beastman Continent were rapidly slipping out of their control.

In the past, for such an important matter involving an expedition to the center of the earth and the strongest figures of the entire continent, how could the major factions not notify the Priest Palace?

But this time, no one had notified them. They had obtained the information themselves and come uninvited.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader still gave the Priest Palace some face, proactively mentioning, "Although the priest sent by the Priest Palace didn't teach us the knowledge related to teleportation arrays, he did teach us how to make energy storage instruments and how to collect light energy and earth energy."

"Earth energy?" Shang Feifan was very interested in this point.

Ghostfire Alliance Leader: "It’s geothermal energy."

"So it's geothermal energy," Shang Feifan mused.

This was different from the "earth energy" he had imagined. When he first discovered the teleportation array used by Loren Milton, it used earth energy, but that energy was definitely not geothermal.

Come to think of it, the earth energy Loren Milton used seemed more like it was extracting the energy of the earth itself, much like drawing the life force and nutrients from the soil.

That didn't seem right either...

Shang Feifan felt a pang of regret that he hadn't carefully studied those teleportation arrays that used earth energy at the time, having only gained a rough understanding.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第269章 出发前的小变故 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
但现在知道地壳中心隐藏的那股庞大能量后，他有了一个新想法——洛伦米尔顿抽取的地能会不会就是本源能量？

可如果那抽取的地能真的是本源能量，为什么洛伦米尔顿没有进一步使用和吸收本源能量？会不会洛伦米尔顿自己也不知道？

如果洛伦米尔顿自己都不清楚自己抽取的地能是什么，那么是谁教他使用的这种能量抽取方式？

如果他能把那些传送阵的能量装置研究透彻，是否就能找出安全吸收本源能量的方法？

就在这时，南戎快步走到鬼火盟主身边，低声说了什么。

鬼火盟主脸色微微一变。

“诸位，我这边稍微有点急事，等处理完就过来，还请见谅。如果我未能及时赶回，就让南戎陪你们先前往祭司宫，我随后赶到，失陪！”鬼火盟主不顾其他大佬是否会多想，快速说完这句话就转身往外走。

前面有一名兽人战士正在等待他。

那名兽人战士看到鬼火盟主过来，立刻在前面领路，一边走还一边和鬼火盟主低声说话。

商非凡运足耳力，隐约听到几句。

郎沐听力超绝，把对话听了个完完整整，他正要和商非凡说话。

虫王忽然低声对两人说：“南方联盟也藏了一个老不死。以前我一直搞不清楚这些老不死是怎么活到现在，现在……呵！”

北熊盟主脚步一挪，走过来，同样压低声音：“刚刚南戎说那位醒了还从地底宫殿中离开，你们说那位会不会就是感知到神格碎片的力量才会醒来？”

“几位在说什么呢？我能听听吗？”盐大酋长厚脸皮地凑过来。

虫王对盐无尽没有半点客气，讽刺地说：“你还不赶紧回去收拾行李带着妻妾小崽子赶紧跑，留在这里干什么？”

盐大酋长回讽：“好歹我还有不少小崽子，不像你，连个虫蛋都生不出来！不过你放心，你要是死了，我东部落也不是不能收留你们那些虫人，正好我们东部落还缺不少善于耕种的奴隶。”

虫王握拳：“我看你是想死！”

盐大酋长：“你们虫人这是想和我们兽人开战？”

虫王：“你就一个东海部落，不要扯到整个兽人族上！”

盐大酋长：“那你说我们打起来，各地兽人族会帮谁？”

虫王气得发抖。要不是顾忌兽人族的感受，他怎么会允许东大陆出现一个和虫人族并驾齐驱的东海部落？他的实力比盐无尽强得多，可就因为不想引起全大陆兽人族的忌惮，他才一直忍着没有对盐无尽动手。

盐无尽也就是知道这点，才有恃无恐，说的话也都是往他心眼子上戳。

可恨他们虫人族王族不知道是否因为失去虫母庇佑的关系，传嗣非常艰难。

以前虫人族的虫王都是由虫母孕育，自从虫母带领变异虫族离开兽人大陆后，他们虫人族的王族就开始自己产卵培育新王族，但也不知道哪里差了什么，他们王族不但难以生出虫卵，就算生出来也难以成活。

别说王族，就是普通虫人族也有孕育困难的问题。

这么多年来，他们虫人族人口为什么会这么少，只能偏安一隅，就是因为他们产卵率和成活率都不高。

现虫王这一代，已经接近两百岁大关，可他和王后至今都没能成功孕育一枚王虫卵。

如果过了两百岁大关，他和王后还没能培育出新的虫王卵，那之后培育的难度只会随着年龄增长达到绝望程度。

虫王心里焦急后代，这也是他上次感知到商非凡身上似携带虫母气息，才会那么激动的缘故。

他亲近商非凡和郎沐，不仅仅是因为两人的实力和虫毒祛除药剂让他想要拉拢，更因为他们和自然之神有关系，还让他也沾了光。

那可是自然之神！天职就是万物生发。

他有种直觉，他和王后产下虫王卵的契机九成就在这两人身上。

商非凡瞟向盐无尽，他对这位大酋长了解甚少，但从他和虫王的对话来看，这位颇有点滚刀肉的特质。

这种领袖在地星也不少见，他们的通质就是脸皮厚、朝令夕改、还喜欢拉帮结派、喜欢揪着别人的痛点死咬不放，看似任性妄为，实际奸诈狡猾。

“有句话叫帮理不帮亲。意思就是说谁有道理就帮谁。”商非凡插话。

虫王眼睛一亮，看向商非凡的目光满是看亲兄弟的亲昵和喜悦。

盐大酋长眯眼：“你这话什么意思？难道是觉得我东部落没有理，他们虫人族……”

“东海部落。”商非凡强调。

盐大酋长脸色冷下来。

虫王发出一声轻笑，极尽讽刺。

盐无尽想要翻脸，但不知想到什么，他竟然哈哈大笑，抬手像是还要拍商非凡肩膀。

商非凡错开一步，躲过对方拍过来的手掌。

盐无尽也似不以为意，还一脸大度地笑着说：“我们部落叫什么名字不重要。重要的是咱们兽人的灭世灾难即将降临，以后我们兽人以及虫人等各族的未来到底如何还不好说，现在挣这个也没意思。”

盐无尽一顿：“只是在这个拯救我兽人大陆的重要关头，但愿不会再发生大繁华纪末期时的巨大变故，如果某一族像当时的异变虫族一样，带着外来邪神和虫毒一起攻打我们，只怕这次我们兽人大陆上的生命是真的会全部灭绝。”

盐无尽瞄向虫王，“就怕某些人平时伪装得好，一到关键时刻就叛变。背后捅刀可比正面交锋可怕得多，你们说是不是？”

虫王大约高兴商非凡明着站在他这一边，竟然没有被激怒，还反唇相讥：“当年大战，和着变异虫族一起对付各族的可不是我虫人族，各族中都有好人和坏人，就像我们现在的兽人大陆，有人想要带领全族人乃至全大陆生命一起对抗和逃脱灾难，但也有个别人只想着自己的利益，把其他人都当做垫脚石和牺牲品。”

虫王还故意打量盐大酋长，说：“就怕某些人到了关键时刻，为了自身利益会主动投靠邪神一方，到时候不但会背后捅刀，说不定还会摇身一变变成邪神的狗腿子，通过奴役其他各族，妄图做个奴上奴。”

你妈！盐无尽心中怒极，脸上却绽开笑容，无视虫王，对商非凡说：“这位小兄弟，交友可要慎重。”

商非凡点点头：“是极。良友惠及一生，恶友只会拖你下地狱。”

“你心中有数就好。”盐大酋长自觉已经极给商非凡面子，要不是刚刚才亲眼看到过商非凡和大祭司的打斗经过，知道这位的实力，他怎么可能这么忍耐一个年轻小辈？

北熊盟主在一边看热闹看到现在，半点都没有插足的意思。

各大势力看着关系还行，实际上怎样，大家肚子里清楚。

南戎也听了半程热闹，见盐大酋长和虫王消停下来，这才上前，询问众人是等待他们盟主一起，还是先出发前往祭司宫。

祭司宫的祭司们急着回去传达大祭司遗言，可也不好催促。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 269: A Minor Incident Before Departure (Part 2)

But now, knowing about the massive energy hidden at the center of the earth's crust, he had a new idea—could the earth energy Loren Milton extracted be primordial energy?

Yet, if the extracted earth energy really was primordial energy, why hadn't Loren Milton used or absorbed it further? Could it be that even Loren Milton didn't know?

If Loren Milton himself didn't understand what the earth energy he was extracting was, then who had taught him this method of energy extraction?

If he could thoroughly research the energy devices of those teleportation arrays, would he be able to find a safe way to absorb primordial energy?

Just then, Southern Rong walked quickly to the Ghostfire Alliance Leader’s side and whispered something.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader’s expression shifted slightly.

"Everyone, I have a slightly urgent matter to attend to. Please excuse me. If I cannot return in time, I will have Southern Rong accompany you to the Priest Palace, and I will follow shortly. My apologies!" Without caring whether the other bigwigs would overthink it, the Ghostfire Alliance Leader finished his sentence quickly and turned to walk away.

A beastman warrior was waiting for him ahead.

Seeing the Ghostfire Alliance Leader approach, the warrior immediately led the way, speaking in low tones as they walked.

Shang Feifan strained his ears and caught a few fragments.

Lang Mu, with his superior hearing, had caught the entire conversation and was just about to speak to Shang Feifan.

The Insect King suddenly whispered to the two of them, "The Southern Alliance also hides an 'old immortal.' I could never figure out how these old things lived until now, but now... heh!"

The North Bear Alliance Leader stepped over, also lowering his voice, "Southern Rong just said that 'that one' has awakened and left the underground palace. Do you think 'that one' woke up because it sensed the power of the godhead fragments?"

"What are you all talking about? Can I listen in?" Chief Yan the Great pushed his way over, thick-skinned as ever.

The Insect King showed no courtesy to Yan Wujin, mocking him, "Why don't you hurry back to pack your bags and take your wives, concubines, and little ones to run away? Why are you still lingering here?"

Chief Yan retorted, "At least I have plenty of little ones, unlike you, who can't even produce a single insect egg! But don't worry, if you die, my Eastern Tribe wouldn't mind taking in your insect-men. It just so happens that our Eastern Tribe is short on slaves skilled in farming."

The Insect King clenched his fists: "I think you're looking for death!"

Chief Yan: "Are you insect-men trying to start a war with us beastmen?"

Insect King: "You are just the East Sea Tribe; don't drag the entire beastman race into this!"

Chief Yan: "Then tell me, if we start fighting, who will the beastmen in various regions help?"

The Insect King trembled with rage. If it weren't for his concern for the feelings of the beastman race, why would he have allowed an East Sea Tribe that could rival the insect-men to emerge in the Eastern Continent? His strength was far greater than Yan Wujin’s, but he had endured and refrained from acting against him precisely because he didn't want to provoke the suspicion of the entire continent’s beastmen.

Yan Wujin knew this, which was why he was so fearless, and his words were designed to stab right at the Insect King’s heart.

It was hateful that the insect-men royal family, perhaps due to the loss of the Insect Mother’s protection, found it extremely difficult to reproduce.

In the past, the Insect King was gestated by the Insect Mother. Ever since the Insect Mother led the mutated insect race away from the Beastman Continent, the insect-men royal family had begun to lay their own eggs to cultivate new kings. But they didn't know what was missing; not only was it difficult for the royal family to produce eggs, but even if they did, the eggs rarely survived.

Not to mention the royal family, even ordinary insect-men had fertility issues.

For so many years, the reason their population was so small and they could only hide in a corner was because their egg-laying rate and survival rate were both low.

The current Insect King was approaching the age of two hundred, yet he and the Queen had not yet successfully gestated a single royal insect egg.

If he passed the two-hundred-year mark without cultivating a new royal egg, the difficulty of doing so would only reach a desperate level as his age increased.

The Insect King was anxious about his descendants, which was why he had been so excited when he sensed the aura of the Insect Mother on Shang Feifan last time.

He grew close to Shang Feifan and Lang Mu not only because their strength and the insect toxin removal potion made him want to win them over, but also because they had a connection to the God of Nature, which had rubbed off on him.

That was the God of Nature! Whose divine duty was the growth of all things.

He had a gut feeling that the opportunity for him and the Queen to produce a royal egg lay with these two.

Shang Feifan glanced at Yan Wujin. He knew very little about this Chief, but judging from his conversation with the Insect King, he had the qualities of a "rogue."

Such leaders were not uncommon on Earth; their common traits were thick skin, flip-flopping, a penchant for forming cliques, and a love for digging into others' pain points. They appeared reckless and willful, but were actually treacherous and cunning.

"There is a saying: 'Help the principle, not the person.' It means you help whoever is in the right," Shang Feifan interjected.

The Insect King’s eyes lit up, and he looked at Shang Feifan with the intimacy and joy one would reserve for a brother.

Chief Yan narrowed his eyes: "What do you mean by that? Do you think my Eastern Tribe is in the wrong, and their insect-men..."

"East Sea Tribe," Shang Feifan emphasized.

Chief Yan’s expression turned cold.

The Insect King let out a soft, mocking laugh.

Yan Wujin wanted to flip out, but thinking of something, he burst into loud laughter and raised his hand as if to pat Shang Feifan on the shoulder.

Shang Feifan stepped aside, dodging the palm.

Yan Wujin didn't seem to mind, smiling with feigned magnanimity: "The name of our tribe doesn't matter. What matters is that the apocalyptic disaster for us beastmen is coming. It’s hard to say what the future holds for us beastmen, insect-men, and other races. Arguing about this now is meaningless."

Yan Wujin paused: "It’s just that at this critical juncture of saving our Beastman Continent, I hope there won't be another massive catastrophe like the end of the Great Prosperity Era. If one race, like the mutated insect race of that time, attacks us alongside foreign evil gods and insect toxins, I fear that this time, all life on our Beastman Continent will truly be wiped out."

Yan Wujin glanced at the Insect King: "I’m just afraid that some people disguise themselves well, only to betray us at the critical moment. A stab in the back is far more terrifying than a frontal assault, don't you think?"

The Insect King, perhaps happy that Shang Feifan was openly standing on his side, was not provoked and retorted: "In the great war back then, it wasn't my insect-men who joined the mutated insect race to fight the others. There are good and bad people in every race, just like our current Beastman Continent. Some want to lead their entire race and all life on the continent to resist and escape the disaster, but there are also individuals who only think of their own interests, using everyone else as stepping stones and sacrifices."

The Insect King deliberately sized up Chief Yan and said: "I’m just afraid that some people, at the critical moment, will actively defect to the side of the evil gods for their own benefit. When that time comes, not only will they stab us in the back, but they might even transform into the evil gods' lackeys, hoping to become a 'master of slaves' by enslaving other races."

*Damn you!* Yan Wujin was furious inside, but a smile bloomed on his face. Ignoring the Insect King, he said to Shang Feifan, "Little brother, you must be cautious in choosing your friends."

Shang Feifan nodded: "Indeed. A good friend benefits you for a lifetime, while a bad friend will only drag you to hell."

"As long as you know what you're doing." Chief Yan felt he had already given Shang Feifan enough face. If he hadn't just witnessed the battle between Shang Feifan and the High Priest and known his strength, how could he have tolerated a young junior like this?

The North Bear Alliance Leader had been watching the spectacle from the side, with no intention of getting involved.

The major factions looked like they had decent relationships, but in reality, everyone knew what was going on beneath the surface.

Southern Rong had also listened to half the drama. Seeing that Chief Yan and the Insect King had quieted down, he stepped forward to ask everyone whether they wanted to wait for their Alliance Leader or depart for the Priest Palace first.

The priests of the Priest Palace were anxious to return and convey the High Priest’s last words, but they couldn't exactly rush them.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第269章 出发前的小变故 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
“开一次传送阵需要消耗不菲的能量，不如就等一等鬼火盟主。我们急也不急在这一时，各位认为呢？”北熊盟主笑着说。

其他人都表示能等，正好也能和手下做一些更细致的交代。

虫王也觉得捡日不如撞日，不如今天就问问商非凡和郎沐两人，能否解决他们虫王一脉和整个虫人族生育困难的问题。

商非凡和郎沐忽然同时抬头。

商非凡匆忙留下一句：“抱歉，家里小崽似乎出了一点事，各位待会见！”

说完，这两人竟然就双双冲向西南方向，眨眼就不见了人影。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 269: A Minor Incident Before Departure (Part 3)

"Activating the teleportation array consumes a significant amount of energy, so it might be better to wait for the Ghostfire Alliance Leader. We aren't in such a rush that we can't wait a moment, wouldn't you agree?" the North Bear Alliance Leader said with a smile.

The others indicated that they could wait, as it gave them time to give more detailed instructions to their subordinates.

The Insect King also felt that there was no time like the present, and he might as well ask Shang Feifan and Lang Mu today if they could solve the fertility issues of the Insect King lineage and the entire insect-man race.

Suddenly, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu looked up at the same time.

Shang Feifan hurriedly left behind a single sentence: "Apologies, it seems something has happened with the little ones at home. We shall see you all shortly!"

With that, the two of them bolted toward the southwest, disappearing from sight in the blink of an eye.

chunks.chineseText:
第270章 特地去见面

小花正带着阿呆满街乱晃。

是，就是小花带路，它闻到自己感兴趣的就会飞过去。

狰爷驮着阿呆，差点跟不上它。

小花每次飞远，看到后面两只跟不上，又飞回来，还抱怨狰爷速度太慢。

狰爷被迫和小花共处一个空间，就像是经过了脱敏治疗，如今也能和小花正面相对了，就是还是不敢和它哔哔，被骂也只能怨自己能力太差。

阿呆摸摸狰爷的头，他也感觉出来啦，狰爷有亿点怕小花花。

小花感兴趣最多的就是富含能量的物品，其中又以新鲜肉类最多。

于是，这两只逛着逛着就来到了鬼火市最大的屠宰鲜肉市场。

这里贩卖各种能吃和不能吃的生物，从低级到高等级都有。

肉贩们的摊子上除了兽肉、鱼肉、鸟肉，也有不少虫子肉。

小花和狰爷看到虫子肉完全没有特殊反应，它们自己也吃各类虫子，就跟兽人也会吃各种动物一样。

“阿呆，买这个，这个能量足，应该好吃！”小花飞到一处肉摊前，指着摊主刚悬挂出来的鲜肉让阿呆掏钱。

它身上也有商爸爸送给它的空间手镯，郎沐爸还给它也发了零花钱。但在阿呆还有钱的情况下，它一点都不想花自己的。

阿呆蹲在狰爷背脊上，呆呆地看那块比他整个身体还大两倍的大肉块，那肉块新鲜的还在滴血。

摊主看到只是两个小幼崽过来买肉，也没有慢待。只看那巨虫坐骑就身姿不凡养得极好，而且两个小幼崽一个皮毛光亮肉乎乎，一个漂亮得无与伦比，一看就都不是普通家庭出来的。

小花花能说话，摊主理所当然把小花花当做了虫人族幼崽。

“哎哟，你们两个小崽崽，眼光还真不错！”摊主用刀背拍着新鲜肉块自卖自夸，说这是他老婆弟弟的冒险小队刚从森林里猎来的六级巨齿豚，主打一个肉质鲜嫩、腥臊味较低，而且富含能量，且易于吸收。

摊主又吹嘘六级巨齿豚有多么难猎，说他小舅子如何如何厉害，带的队伍又是多么有名。

阿呆嗯嗯地听，像是什么都不懂的富家呆呆小少爷。

小花花懒得听摊主吹嘘，催促阿呆赶紧掏钱买——它这可是进步很多了，以前它看到什么肉，直接扑上去就吃，吃不完还会打包带走，哪会想到付钱。

上次它直接抢肉，被阿呆的两个爸爸唠叨了好久，但好歹也记住了吃饭要付钱的事。

“小花花喜欢，那就买吧。”阿呆大方地说。

“那你们要买多少？”肉贩看他们真的想买，也很高兴。

六级巨齿豚肉价格高昂，一般兽人都舍不得买。没看他摊子上只有这一块肉嘛，其他的都让他小舅子拿去询问那些大人物家的管家。

小花立刻飞起来说：“全部！”

阿呆也跟着点头。

肉贩惊讶：“你们真的要全买？这块肉可不便宜。”

阿呆问：“叔叔，多少钱啊？”

肉贩眼睛在阿呆身上再次转了一圈，张口就说：“我这巨齿豚肉可不是普通的巨齿豚肉，它是巨齿豚王肉！吃了可是能觉醒血脉天赋的！如果你们已经觉醒血脉天赋，那吃了这肉也能提升血脉天赋的等级和质量。

大前年，我们这就有一个人，原本他的血脉天赋只是最低级，说是能操控风，但刮出来的风还不如我吹口气大，什么用都没有。可他就是吃了巨齿豚王肉，他的控风能力一下就从只能吹气变成了能刮大台风！”

肉贩吹得口沫横飞。

阿呆和小花花跟听故事一样，阿呆还配合地发出“哇、哦”的惊叹声。

肉贩听到附近摊贩传来轻微的嗤笑声，大概也知道自己吹得太过，连忙收口，说：“这么宝贵的能提升血脉天赋等级的王肉，还是后腿肉，我也不报你们高价，一斤五金十银，这里有五十斤，本应该是二百五十五金，如果你们全买了，我就一共收你们二百五十金。如何？”

阿呆吃惊：“二百五十金？这么贵？”

哎呀，爸爸们啊，阿呆碰上了坏肉贩叔叔呢。

这位肉贩大概把他和小花花都当做不懂事更不懂肉价行情的小傻子了。

但他在莫约镇可是经常和夏冰哥哥上镇子市集买食物，还会货比三家，对肉类价格可了解了。

六级鲜肉虽然不多见，但也不至于到稀罕的地步。

镇子上出门狩猎的叔叔哥哥姐姐姨姨们一个月总也能猎到一次两次，尤其巨齿豚属于巨能生能养的野生动物之一，它们什么都吃，长得还快，就算是六级，价格也不算高。

一斤顶天了也就十五银一斤，平常价大约是十银到十二银一斤。五十斤的鲜肉，就算是后腿肉，五六金也能拿到手了。

刚刚一路上，他们买了很多东西，其中也不乏能量丰富的，还买到了一瓶珍贵的蜜，那么多东西他们才花了不到三十金。

现在一块巨齿豚肉就要二百五十金？

如果这肉真能觉醒血脉天赋或者是提升，那这个价格确实便宜，但……要是这肉真有这样的效用，早上拍卖场了，何必拿到市集上来卖？

嗐，他看起来就这么好骗吗？

阿呆低头看自己的空间手镯，掏出里面的金达盾开始数。

肉贩看到阿呆径直掏出一袋金达盾数，眼中闪过惊讶和贪婪。

他不是贪这么一个小幼崽竟然能拿出一袋的金达盾，而是看出了阿呆手腕上戴着的很有可能是传说中的空间手镯。

这一年，关于空间储物工具的事在各地都流传开来，据说还不是大繁华纪时期留下的珍宝，而是由当代炼金大师炼制出来。

像是他们南联盟正副盟主还有第一高手南戎等人，就都戴上了空间手镯。有人亲眼看到他们使用过。

除此之外，听说一些特别有钱的大富豪大贵族，也有。

总之，现在空间储物工具已经成了大佬的标配之一，如果哪位大佬身上没有空储，感觉就像是低了其他大佬一头。

就因为这个，只要有点身份的，谁不想弄一个空储显摆？

但这东西太稀奇，基本上只会在一些大型拍卖会中-出现，每次出现那最后的成交价都高得让普通人只能做梦幻想一下自己拥有的可能性。

肉贩知道空储宝贵，自然也不敢打空间手镯的主意——抢了小的肯定会惹来老的，再说鬼火市治安一流，有这么多人看着，他就算抢到东西就逃，又能逃多远？

虽然不能抢空间手镯，但狠狠宰一笔还是可以的。

肉贩后悔他二百五十金的价格都报低了，这两个小崽子一看就是不懂行情的。

“小花花，我的钱不够了。”阿呆老实地对小花说。

小花落到钱袋子上，扒拉了一下，“怎么会不够？进城时阿沐爸爸不是刚给了你一百金零花钱吗？”

肉贩和旁边的路人听得嘴角抽搐。

这到底是哪里的富贵人家，竟然给两个不懂事的小幼崽这么多零花钱，这是怕没人抢他们吗？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 270: A Special Visit

Xiao Hua was currently leading A-Dai on a aimless stroll through the streets.

Yes, it was Xiao Hua leading the way; whenever it caught the scent of something that piqued its interest, it would simply fly off toward it.

Zhen Ye, carrying A-Dai on its back, could barely keep up.

Every time Xiao Hua flew too far ahead and noticed the pair behind lagging, it would zip back, grumbling about how slow Zhen Ye was.

Forced to share space with Xiao Hua, Zhen Ye had undergone something akin to desensitization therapy. It could now face Xiao Hua head-on, though it still didn't dare to talk back; if it got scolded, it could only blame its own lack of ability.

A-Dai patted Zhen Ye’s head. He had sensed it too—Zhen Ye was just a tiny bit afraid of Xiao Hua.

What interested Xiao Hua most were items rich in energy, and fresh meat topped that list.

And so, the two of them wandered until they reached the largest fresh meat market in Ghostfire City.

This place sold all manner of creatures, edible or otherwise, ranging from low-level to high-level specimens.

The vendors’ stalls were piled high with beast meat, fish, bird, and even a fair amount of insect meat.

Xiao Hua and Zhen Ye showed no special reaction to the insect meat; they ate various insects themselves, just as Beastmen ate various animals.

"A-Dai, buy this! It’s packed with energy, it should be delicious!" Xiao Hua flew up to a meat stall and pointed at a fresh cut of meat the vendor had just hung up, urging A-Dai to pay.

Xiao Hua had its own spatial bracelet gifted by "Papa Shang," and "Papa Lang Mu" had also given it pocket money. But as long as A-Dai still had money, it had absolutely no intention of spending its own.

A-Dai crouched on Zhen Ye’s back, staring blankly at the slab of meat, which was twice the size of his entire body and still dripping with fresh blood.

The vendor, seeing two little cubs coming to buy meat, didn't treat them poorly. Just looking at their giant insect mount, which was well-groomed and imposing, and the two cubs—one plump with shiny fur and the other incomparably beautiful—it was clear they didn't come from ordinary families.

Since Xiao Hua could speak, the vendor naturally assumed it was a cub of the Insect-Human race.

"Oh my, you two little ones have quite the eye!" The vendor slapped the fresh meat with the back of his knife, boasting that it was a Level 6 Giant-Toothed Hog his brother-in-law’s adventure squad had just hunted in the forest. He claimed it was tender, low in gamey odor, rich in energy, and easy to absorb.

The vendor continued to brag about how difficult it was to hunt a Level 6 Giant-Toothed Hog, how amazing his brother-in-law was, and how famous his team was.

A-Dai listened with an "uh-huh," looking like a naive, wealthy little young master who didn't understand a thing.

Xiao Hua couldn't be bothered to listen to the vendor’s boasting and urged A-Dai to pay up quickly—this was already a huge improvement; in the past, it would have just pounced on the meat and started eating, packing up the leftovers to go, never thinking about paying.

Last time it had tried to snatch meat, A-Dai’s two papas had lectured it for ages, but at least it had remembered that one had to pay for food.

"If Xiao Hua likes it, then let's buy it," A-Dai said generously.

"So, how much do you want to buy?" The vendor was delighted to see they were serious.

The price of Level 6 Giant-Toothed Hog meat was exorbitant; most Beastmen couldn't afford it. Notice how there was only this one piece on his stall? The rest had been taken by his brother-in-law to offer to the stewards of the great houses.

Xiao Hua immediately flew up and said, "All of it!"

A-Dai nodded in agreement.

The vendor was surprised. "You really want to buy it all? This meat isn't cheap."

A-Dai asked, "Uncle, how much is it?"

The vendor’s eyes darted over A-Dai once more, and he blurted out, "This isn't just ordinary Giant-Toothed Hog meat; it’s Giant-Toothed Hog *King* meat! Eating it can awaken bloodline talents! If you’ve already awakened, it can raise the level and quality of your talent.

"Three years ago, there was a guy here whose bloodline talent was the lowest level—he could control wind, but the wind he made wasn't even as strong as me blowing a breath. It was useless. But he ate the King meat, and his wind control went from a mere puff to being able to whip up a massive typhoon!"

The vendor was spitting as he bragged.

A-Dai and Xiao Hua listened like they were hearing a fairy tale, with A-Dai even配合ing with "Wow" and "Oh" sounds of wonder.

Hearing a faint snicker from nearby vendors, the merchant realized he might have overdone it. He quickly reined it in: "Such precious King meat that can raise bloodline talents—and it's hind leg meat, too! I won't overcharge you: five gold and ten silver per jin. There are fifty jin here. It should be two hundred and fifty-five gold, but if you buy it all, I'll charge you two hundred and fifty gold. How about that?"

A-Dai was shocked. "Two hundred and fifty gold? That’s so expensive?"

*Oh dear, Papas,* A-Dai thought, *I’ve run into a bad meat-selling uncle.*

This vendor clearly took him and Xiao Hua for little fools who didn't understand the market price of meat.

But he often went to the town market with Brother Xia Bing in Moyue Town to buy food, and he always compared prices. He knew the price of meat quite well.

Level 6 fresh meat wasn't common, but it wasn't exactly rare either.

The uncles, brothers, sisters, and aunts from town who went hunting could bag one or two every month. Especially since Giant-Toothed Hogs were one of the most prolific wild animals—they ate everything and grew fast. Even at Level 6, the price wasn't that high.

At most, it was fifteen silver per jin, with the usual price being around ten to twelve silver. For fifty jin of fresh meat, even if it was hind leg, five or six gold should have been enough.

Along the way, they had bought many things, including items rich in energy, and even a jar of precious honey, and all of that had cost less than thirty gold.

And now, one piece of hog meat was two hundred and fifty gold?

If this meat could really awaken or boost bloodline talents, the price would be cheap, but... if it were that effective, it would have been at an auction house this morning, not sold at a street market.

*Sigh, do I look that easy to swindle?*

A-Dai looked down at his spatial bracelet and pulled out a bag of Gold Dats to count.

Seeing A-Dai pull out a bag of Gold Dats, the vendor’s eyes flashed with surprise and greed.

He wasn't surprised that such a small cub could produce a bag of gold; he was realizing that the bracelet on A-Dai’s wrist was likely the legendary spatial bracelet.

Over the past year, news of spatial storage tools had spread everywhere. It was said they weren't treasures left over from the Great Prosperity Era, but were crafted by contemporary alchemy masters.

People like the leaders of the Southern Alliance and the top expert, Nan Rong, all wore spatial bracelets. People had seen them use them with their own eyes.

Besides them, it was said that some incredibly wealthy tycoons and nobles had them too.

In short, spatial storage tools had become a status symbol for the elite. If a big shot didn't have one, it felt like they were a cut below the others.

Because of this, anyone with a bit of status wanted one to show off.

But these things were so rare that they only appeared at large auctions, and the final prices were so high that ordinary people could only dream of owning one.

The vendor knew the value of the spatial storage, so he didn't dare try to rob it—robbing a child would surely bring the adults down on him. Besides, Ghostfire City had top-tier security, and with so many people watching, how far could he get even if he snatched it?

Though he couldn't steal the bracelet, he could certainly fleece them for a fortune.

The vendor regretted not asking for more than two hundred and fifty gold; these two cubs clearly didn't know the market.

"Xiao Hua, I don't have enough money," A-Dai said honestly to Xiao Hua.

Xiao Hua landed on the money bag and rummaged through it. "How can you not have enough? Didn't Papa A-Mu just give you one hundred gold in pocket money when we entered the city?"

The vendor and the passersby nearby twitched at the corners of their mouths.

*Just what kind of wealthy family is this, giving two clueless little cubs so much pocket money? Are they trying to get them robbed?*

chunks.chineseText:
郎沐和商非凡都不是奢侈的人，自然不可能给自家孩子那么多零花钱，养成他们大手大脚的习惯。

只是他们情况特殊，经常会遇到一些突发事情，这种时候他们很可能会离开阿呆一段时间。作为家长自然会担心，他们如果离开孩子时间太长，小孩身上没钱要怎么生活的问题。

所以郎沐给阿呆一百金也不算是零花钱，而是当做生活备用金，以防万一用的。

郎沐跟阿呆交代过，阿呆也知道钱不能随便乱花。但这次和小花单独行动，他商爸爸暗中跟他说了，如果小花想要买什么，不用小气，只管花，就当付保镖钱，回来跟他报账就是。

商郎两人知道花虫子喜欢吃高等级的鲜肉，怕阿呆的钱不够花，还特意也给花虫子准备了同样的零花钱。

谁想花虫子只想花别人的钱，不喜欢花自己的，一路下来都要把阿呆的零花钱给掏空。

“这块肉要二百五，可我所有零花钱加起来也才只有一百二十金六十七银，还有五百二十九个铜达铢。刚才我们一路上已经花了三十金，现在我只有九十金多一点点啦。”阿呆特别诚实地报数。

花虫子扒拉来扒拉去，发现阿呆的钱袋子里确实就只剩下九十金。

“我也有一百金，但加起来也不够啊。”花虫子苦恼，尤其它一点都不想花自己的钱怎么办？

花虫子瞄向那块肉，再瞅瞅那肉贩，要么还是……抢吧！

抢完它就带阿呆和那只坐骑撕裂空间跑路，保证谁也抓不住它们。

对，就这么干。

花虫子又瞄向附近其他肉贩，想着既然要抢，那只抢一家太亏，不如把这一条街都抢了。

阿呆想趁机说不如就不买了吧，想吃鲜肉，可以自己狩猎啊。

他不是小气，是不想被当凯子骗——凯子这个词还是他商爸爸告诉他的，似乎是人傻钱多的意思。

但他也不想戳破这个肉贩，阿沐爸爸说在人生地不熟的地方遇到当地人的骗子，最好就是装傻不接招，如果实在避不过去就找当地治安人员，再再不行再动武。

附近两家肉贩听到那肉贩报价，心里冷笑。但碍于大家平时抬头不见低头见，他们也不好给那肉贩拆台，只是在心中都暗暗想着这个肉贩不可深交——虽然那两个小幼崽看着家境不错，但把价格抬这么高，还是太过分了。

阿呆一看花虫子表情，暗叫不妙，立刻说：“花花，要么我们去看看其他家的鲜肉吧，也许有更好更便宜的。”

花虫子：不，本花大王要就要全部。买什么买，弱者才花自己的钱买东西，它就抢怎么了。反正现在两个爸爸都不在。

肉贩看阿呆掏不出更多钱，忍不住贪婪之心，开口说：“小家伙们，我们家的这块肉是真的好，你在其他地方肯定买不着。这样吧，如果钱不够，你们可以拿其他东西抵，比如你腕上戴着的手镯……”

“咳，你这人坑钱就算了，还想骗人家小幼崽的空间手镯，不觉得太过了吗？如果让这边的市场监管知道你这么做生意，你还想在这里继续摆摊？”

一道很轻很虚弱的声音传来。

阿呆和花虫子，包括那个肉贩同时转头，就看到一名瘦弱的年轻兽人一步步缓缓走到他们面前。

那兽人看起来不过二十出头，身形瘦削得像一根被风雨摧残过的枯草，裹在布衣下的身躯几乎看不出肌肉的轮廓。苍白的皮肤下隐约可见青色的血管，仿佛用力一握就会折断的手腕上缠着几圈褪色的布条。一头灰褐色的短发乱蓬蓬地支棱着，像是从未认真梳理过，发间若隐若现的两只兽耳也蔫巴巴地耷拉着，看起来毫无生气。

就像是一个久病之人。

但这副孱弱躯壳之上，却生着一张令人过目难忘的脸——他的右颊有一道陈年爪痕斜斜划过颧骨，给那张看起来有点文弱的面容平添几分狠厉。

奇怪的是明明看起来很年轻的兽人，眼尾却堆积着与年轻面容极不相称的细纹。

肉贩不爽：“你胡说八道什么！我怎么骗人了？我就是问他们想不想交换，不想就算，我有逼迫和欺诈吗？就算市场监管员知道又怎样，我这就是正正经经地做生意，不偷不抢！”

年轻病弱兽人呵呵：“也是，如果你真的能骗到那只空间手镯，你也不用继续在这里当个肉贩。如果你没骗到，那就是没有犯罪事实，自然不用惧怕市场监管员。”

肉贩翻脸，用力把砍骨刀往肉案上一剁：“喂！你哪里来的混蛋？是不是有人故意派你过来扰乱我生意？看你就不像是能买得起我家鲜肉的穷鬼样，你以为你这样破坏我名声，人客人就相信你了吗？滚滚滚，赶紧有多远滚多远！再胡说，小心我揍得你满地找牙！”

肉贩还堆出笑脸继续诱哄方脑袋小幼崽，想要和两个幼崽做成这笔大生意，他现在也不求能弄到空间手镯，只要能把他挂出来的鲜肉高价卖出去就好。

他小舅子可是答应他，这块肉卖出去只要给他五金就行。那多卖多少不都是他的了吗？

小花花都打算抢劫整条街了，又怎么会同意继续购买那块肉，但现在它没工夫应付那个肉贩，它的注意力转移了，比起那些鲜肉，它更在意这个突然出现打抱不平的年轻兽人。

阿呆本来就不想花这么多钱就为了买一块肉，见小花花转移注意力，他就装傻当做没听到肉贩的热情询问，也跟着看向那名像是生病的年轻兽人。

“哥哥，谢谢你，我其实也没打算买这位叔叔的肉，他报的价格太贵，我们那儿，六级的巨齿豚肉，顶多就十来银一斤。他还想让我用空间手镯抵那块肉，这是把我和小花花当大傻子看呢。”阿呆用他稚嫩的童声，特诚实地说。

“噗！噗噗！”周围不断响起喷笑声。

有人当即就阴阳怪气地说：“看看，人小家伙也只是看起来小，不好骗的很呢。既然人家里大人敢让这么小的幼崽自己出来逛街，那肯定要么暗中派人保护，要么就是小家伙自己就很强有生存能力。某些人啊，把别人当傻子看，却不知道自己在别人眼中才是心眼又坏又贪又没脑子的蠢货。”

肉贩气炸，脸羞得爆红。

但他也不敢对两个幼崽发火——他怕对方大人真的有派人在暗中守护，他理亏，可不敢得罪这种能给小幼崽戴上空间手镯的富豪家族。

他刚才也是抱着能骗到一点是一点的想法，此时被小幼崽戳破，周围人也在嘲笑他，想着以后大概生意难做，还会被人指指点点，干脆卷起摊子上的家伙什和鲜肉，跑了——打算换个地方谋生活。

年轻病弱兽人看向阿呆，露出浅浅笑意：“看来很多人都被你这张脸给骗了。”

阿呆仰头呆呼呼地说：“阿呆不骗人，阿呆的脸也不骗人。”

病弱兽人嘴角弯起：“原来你叫阿呆啊，你是石狲族吧？是哪里的石狲族？”
