Chapter 270: A Special Visit (Part 2)

Neither Lang Mu nor Shang Feifan were extravagant people, so they naturally wouldn't give their children so much pocket money as to foster wasteful habits.

It was just that their situation was unique; they often encountered emergencies where they might have to leave A-Dai for a while. As parents, they naturally worried about how the child would survive if they were away for too long and he had no money.

Therefore, the one hundred gold Lang Mu gave A-Dai wasn't really "pocket money," but an emergency fund for living expenses.

Lang Mu had instructed A-Dai, and A-Dai knew not to spend money recklessly. But this time, with Xiao Hua acting alone, his Papa Shang had secretly told him that if Xiao Hua wanted to buy something, he shouldn't be stingy—just spend it, consider it a bodyguard fee, and report the expenses when they returned.

Both Shang and Lang knew the flower-insect liked to eat high-level fresh meat, so fearing A-Dai’s money wouldn't be enough, they had specifically prepared the same amount of pocket money for the flower-insect as well.

Who would have thought the flower-insect only wanted to spend other people's money and hated spending its own, trying to drain A-Dai’s pocket money all the way here.

"This meat costs two hundred and fifty, but all my pocket money added together is only one hundred and twenty gold, sixty-seven silver, and five hundred and twenty-nine copper Dats. We already spent thirty gold on the way here, so now I only have a little over ninety gold," A-Dai reported with extreme honesty.

The flower-insect rummaged through the bag and found that there was indeed only ninety gold left.

"I have one hundred gold too, but even added together, it's not enough," the flower-insect fretted, especially since it absolutely did not want to spend its own money.

The flower-insect eyed the meat, then looked at the vendor. *Maybe I should just... rob him!*

Once it finished robbing him, it would take A-Dai and the mount, tear through space, and run away. It guaranteed no one would be able to catch them.

Yes, that was the plan.

The flower-insect then eyed the other meat vendors nearby, thinking that if it was going to rob someone, robbing just one shop was a loss—it might as well rob the whole street.

A-Dai wanted to take the opportunity to say they should just skip it; if they wanted fresh meat, they could hunt it themselves.

He wasn't being stingy; he just didn't want to be treated like a "mark"—a term his Papa Shang had taught him, meaning someone foolish and rich.

But he didn't want to expose the vendor either. Papa A-Mu had said that when you encounter a local swindler in an unfamiliar place, it's best to play dumb and not take the bait. If you really can't avoid it, find the local security, and if that fails, then use force.

The two meat vendors nearby heard the price and sneered inwardly. But since they saw each other every day, they didn't want to undermine the guy, though they secretly decided he wasn't worth associating with—even if the cubs looked wealthy, raising the price that high was just too much.

A-Dai saw the expression on the flower-insect's face and realized something was wrong. He immediately said, "Hua Hua, why don't we go look at other stalls? Maybe there's better and cheaper meat."

The flower-insect thought: *No, this King Hua wants it all. Why buy? Only the weak spend their own money to buy things. I'll just rob him, so what? Anyway, both Papas aren't here.*

The vendor saw A-Dai couldn't produce more money and, unable to suppress his greed, said, "Little ones, our meat is truly the best; you won't find it anywhere else. How about this? If you don't have enough money, you can trade other things, like the bracelet you're wearing..."

"Ahem. It's one thing to swindle people, but to try and trick little cubs out of a spatial bracelet—don't you think that's going a bit too far? If the market regulators find out you're doing business like this, do you think you'll be able to keep your stall here?"

A light, weak voice drifted over.

A-Dai, the flower-insect, and the vendor all turned to see a thin, young Beastman walking slowly toward them.

The Beastman looked to be in his early twenties, his frame as thin as withered grass ravaged by wind and rain, with almost no muscle definition visible under his cloth clothes. Faint blue veins were visible beneath his pale skin, and his wrists, which looked like they would snap under a firm grip, were wrapped in several layers of faded cloth. His short, grayish-brown hair was a tangled mess, as if it had never been combed, and the two beast ears peeking through his hair were limp and lifeless.

He looked like a man long plagued by illness.

Yet, atop this frail frame was a face one would never forget—a jagged, old claw scar ran diagonally across his right cheekbone, adding a touch of ferocity to an otherwise delicate face.

Strangely, despite his youth, the corners of his eyes were etched with fine lines that seemed entirely out of place for his age.

The vendor was annoyed. "What nonsense are you spouting! How did I swindle them? I just asked if they wanted to trade. If they don't want to, fine! Did I force them or defraud them? Even if the market regulators knew, so what? I'm doing honest business here, not stealing or robbing!"

The young, sickly Beastman chuckled. "True. If you could actually swindle that spatial bracelet, you wouldn't need to be a meat vendor here. If you didn't succeed, then there's no criminal act, so naturally, you don't need to fear the regulators."

The vendor turned hostile, slamming his bone-cleaving knife onto the cutting board. "Hey! Where did you come from, you bastard? Did someone send you to disrupt my business? Look at you, a poor wretch who couldn't afford my meat. Do you think people will believe you just because you're ruining my reputation? Get lost! Get as far away as you can! If you keep talking nonsense, watch out, or I'll beat you until you're spitting out teeth!"

The vendor then put on a fake smile, trying to coax the "square-headed" little cub again. He wanted to close this big deal; he no longer cared about the spatial bracelet, as long as he could sell the fresh meat at a high price.

His brother-in-law had promised him five gold for the meat; everything he sold it for above that was his to keep.

The flower-insect had already planned to rob the whole street, so it wouldn't agree to buy the meat, but it didn't have time to deal with the vendor now. Its attention had shifted; compared to the fresh meat, it was more interested in this young Beastman who had suddenly appeared to stand up for them.

A-Dai hadn't wanted to spend that much money on meat anyway. Seeing the flower-insect distracted, he played dumb, ignoring the vendor's enthusiastic questioning, and looked at the sickly young Beastman.

"Big Brother, thank you. I wasn't actually planning to buy this uncle's meat. His price is too high. Where we're from, Level 6 Giant-Toothed Hog meat is at most ten or so silver per jin. He even wanted me to trade my spatial bracelet for it. He's treating me and Xiao Hua like big fools," A-Dai said in his youthful, innocent voice, with complete honesty.

"Pfft! Pfft-pfft!" Bursts of laughter erupted from the surrounding crowd.

Someone immediately said with a sarcastic tone, "Look at that. The little one might look small, but he's not easy to fool. Since the adults in his family let such young cubs go shopping alone, they must have either sent secret guards or the little ones themselves are strong enough to survive. Some people, thinking others are fools, don't realize that in everyone else's eyes, they are the greedy, brainless idiots."

The vendor was furious, his face turning beet red.

But he didn't dare lash out at the two cubs—he was afraid the adults really were watching from the shadows. He was in the wrong, and he couldn't afford to offend a wealthy family capable of giving their cubs spatial bracelets.

He had been hoping to swindle them, but now that he'd been exposed by a cub and mocked by the crowd, he realized business would be hard to come by in the future. He decided to just roll up his gear and meat and run—planning to find a living elsewhere.

The young, sickly Beastman looked at A-Dai and revealed a faint smile. "It seems many people are fooled by your face."

A-Dai tilted his head and said blankly, "A-Dai doesn't lie, and A-Dai's face doesn't lie."

The sickly Beastman’s lips curled. "So your name is A-Dai? You're of the Stone Monkey tribe, right? Which branch?"

chunks.chineseText:
阿呆正要回答，小花花飞过来，落到他头顶上，用翅膀拍了拍他的脑袋，让他闭嘴。

“我好像见过你，我感觉你的气息有点熟悉。”花虫子冲着病弱兽人说。

不止熟悉。它应该在不久前才感知到这人的气息。

“你是躺在棺材中的那个兽人？你睡醒啦？”花虫子歪头。

病弱兽人目光沉了沉，但声音还算平和：“我们换个地方聊天如何？”

花虫子不解：“为什么要换地方？”

它还想继续买（抢）肉呢。

病弱兽人无奈。当然要换地方，他可不想和疑似虫母的存在在这么市中心的地方“谈话”。

病弱兽人目光又转向阿呆，他有点好奇这个小幼崽和新虫母有什么关系，为什么看起来如此亲近？如果小幼崽的家人也知道花虫子，那他们知道这花虫子的身份吗？

“哥哥，你叫什么名字啊？你是不是认识我们家小花花？”阿呆从小花花的镇压下探出头。

病弱兽人：“小花花……”

这是什么彪悍的名字？！

而且你们家小花花？你确定这朵花出自你们家？

“我叫鬼火镜。”鬼火镜报出自己的名字时特意看向花虫子，想要看看对方听到他名字有没有什么特殊反应。

但什么反应都没有。

花虫子只是像是警戒又像是好奇地盯着他。

“我也许认识你的……母亲。”鬼火镜委婉地对花虫子说，“如果你是我想的那位的后代。”

花虫子：“母亲？”

它可不记得自己有过母亲，不过……等等，它记忆中确实有一只超巨大的虫子，它好像就是从那只虫子的体内爬出来，然后就趴在那只大虫子身上吃吃吃，那时候它没有什么明确意识，就只有一个念头——那就是吃掉那只大虫子，一定要吃个尽光，半点不能留。

后来等它终于吃完那只大虫子，它就模模糊糊知道了不少常识，然后它就从那个奇怪的地方飞了出来。

一路飞，一路找富含能量的东西吃，见到很多生物，他们有的恐惧它，有的崇拜它，有的想要驱逐它，有的想要杀死它……

它也不知道自己飞了多久、跑了多远，只知道自己吃得越多，脑中-出现的各种景象和常识就越多。

它一直以为自己遗失了很多记忆，但现在想想，也许它并不是遗失记忆，而是继承的记忆太少？

继承？

为什么它会有这个想法？

花虫子一时想得入神。

重点是为什么它看到这个病弱兽人会有种很奇怪的感觉，就像是看到一个不想接近但又不是很讨厌的人。

鬼火镜见花虫子不说话，就邀请阿呆去他家玩，说他家有很多好吃好玩的。

见阿呆看他的眼神像看又一个老拐子，鬼火镜改口：“我有些很重要的事情想要询问这位小花花，关系到它的母亲，更关系到整个兽人大陆的兽人们。这里不是谈话的地方，能去我家吗？要么就去找你父母，我们在你父母面前谈如何？”

阿呆的直觉告诉他，这个病弱兽人并不是坏人，虽然对方也在邀请他和小花花去他家。

“那我们去市政中心吧，我爸爸们就在那里办事。”阿呆建议。

就在这时，小花花和鬼火镜同时看向长街另一头。

那边正急奔过来一行人，打头的就是南联盟盟主。

“老祖！”鬼火盟主一见到病弱兽人，面上焦急神色消失，忙行礼。

鬼火镜看到匆忙赶来、一脸天塌神色的鬼火印，忍不住笑了笑：“没事，我就是感觉到老……相识的气息，才会绕到这里。”

鬼火镜能够醒来确实是因为战神神格碎片。

神格碎片会互相吸引，在战神那枚神格碎片脱离大祭司的身体时，他体内那枚也感觉到了，催促着他醒来，想让他去夺取那枚神格碎片。

但他刚掀开棺材就感觉到一股熟悉的气息——虫母似乎来过他这里，而且留下的气息很新鲜，就像是才刚刚来转过一圈。

鬼火镜一想到虫母来过他这里，再也顾不得神格碎片，立刻循着气息找了过来。

鬼火盟主目光转移到巨虫和巨虫身上的两只小幼崽身上。

他家老祖一觉睡了上百年，这次醒来没有见亲人，也没有跑去找神格碎片，竟然跑到肉市场，就是为了见这两只小幼崽？

“老祖，他们是？”

鬼火镜介绍：“这是石狲族幼崽阿呆，这是……小花花。”

他还不确定小花花一定就是虫母后代，虽然小花花身上有虫母的强烈气息。

鬼火印听到介绍，一头雾水：“他们的父母是？”

阿呆一听，骄傲地大声说：“我爸爸们是商非凡和郎沐！”

爸爸们说了，遇到不好惹的人就报出他们的名字，情况不对再拔腿跑。

小花花跟着点头：“嗯嗯。你们有什么事去找他们，我们还小，不管事。”

鬼火镜：“……”

他不知道商非凡和郎沐是谁，但这只疑似虫母的花虫子一副也把对方当家长看的模样，那两人得是多厉害的存在？

再看身边孙辈一脸惊讶，就问：“那两人你认识？”

鬼火盟主表情怪异：“认识，当然认识。我只是没想到他们竟然有孩子了，还是一只石狲，一只虫子。”

“他们实力很强？”鬼火镜顺口问。

鬼火盟主用力点头：“非常强！”

果然！鬼火镜还心想：孙啊，你这是还不知道那花虫子具体是什么品种，如果知道，你就知道你认识的那两人何止是非常强。

阿呆看这群大人像是把他们围了起来，又见领头的两人表情奇奇怪怪，就暗中给他两个爸爸传讯息——爸爸们啊，有奇怪的叔叔和哥哥盯上小花花啦！你们快来！

Chapter 270: A Special Visit (Part 3)

A-Dai was about to answer when Xiao Hua flew over, landed on his head, and patted his skull with its wing, telling him to shut up.

"I think I've seen you before. Your aura feels a bit familiar," the flower-insect said to the sickly Beastman.

Not just familiar. It should have sensed this person's aura not long ago.

"Are you that Beastman who was lying in the coffin? Did you wake up?" The flower-insect tilted its head.

The sickly Beastman’s gaze darkened, but his voice remained calm. "How about we go somewhere else to talk?"

The flower-insect was puzzled. "Why change places?"

It still wanted to buy (rob) the meat.

The sickly Beastman felt helpless. Of course he had to change places; he didn't want to "talk" to a suspected Insect Mother in the middle of the city center.

The sickly Beastman turned his gaze back to A-Dai, curious about the relationship between this little cub and the new Insect Mother. Why did they seem so close? If the cub's family also knew about the flower-insect, did they know its true identity?

"Big Brother, what's your name? Do you know our Xiao Hua?" A-Dai poked his head out from under Xiao Hua's suppression.

The sickly Beastman: "Xiao Hua..."

*What kind of fierce name is that?!*

*And "our Xiao Hua"? Are you sure this flower belongs to your family?*

"My name is Ghostfire Mirror." Ghostfire Mirror specifically watched the flower-insect when he gave his name, wanting to see if there was any special reaction.

But there was none.

The flower-insect just stared at him with a mix of vigilance and curiosity.

"I might know your... mother," Ghostfire Mirror said tactfully to the flower-insect. "If you are the descendant of the one I'm thinking of."

The flower-insect: "Mother?"

It didn't remember having a mother, but... wait. In its memories, there was indeed a super-giant insect. It seemed to have crawled out of that insect's body and then just clung to it, eating and eating. At that time, it had no clear consciousness, only one thought—to eat that giant insect, to eat it all, leaving nothing behind.

Later, after it finally finished eating the giant insect, it vaguely understood a lot of common knowledge, and then it flew out of that strange place.

It flew and flew, looking for energy-rich things to eat, meeting many creatures. Some feared it, some worshipped it, some wanted to drive it away, some wanted to kill it...

It didn't know how long it had been flying or how far it had gone; it only knew that the more it ate, the more images and knowledge appeared in its mind.

It had always thought it had lost many memories, but now that it thought about it, perhaps it hadn't lost memories, but had inherited too few?

Inherited?

Why did it have that thought?

The flower-insect was lost in thought.

The point was, why did it have such a strange feeling when seeing this sickly Beastman, like seeing someone it didn't want to get close to, but didn't exactly hate either?

Seeing the flower-insect silent, Ghostfire Mirror invited A-Dai to his home, saying he had many delicious and fun things there.

Seeing A-Dai look at him like he was another old kidnapper, Ghostfire Mirror changed his tone. "I have some very important matters to ask this Xiao Hua about, matters concerning its mother, and even more concerning all the Beastmen of the Beastman Continent. This isn't the place to talk. Can you come to my home? Or we can go find your parents and talk in front of them, how about that?"

A-Dai’s intuition told him this sickly Beastman wasn't a bad person, even though he was inviting them to his home.

"Then let's go to the Municipal Center. My papas are there taking care of business," A-Dai suggested.

Just then, Xiao Hua and Ghostfire Mirror both looked toward the other end of the long street.

A group of people was rushing over, led by the leader of the Southern Alliance.

"Ancestor!" As soon as the Ghostfire Alliance Leader saw the sickly Beastman, the anxiety on his face vanished, and he hurried to pay his respects.

Seeing Ghostfire Yin, who had rushed over with a look as if the sky were falling, Ghostfire Mirror couldn't help but smile. "It's fine. I just sensed an old... acquaintance's aura, so I detoured here."

Ghostfire Mirror had indeed been awakened by the Godhead fragment of the War God.

Godhead fragments attracted each other. When that War God fragment left the High Priest's body, the one inside him felt it, urging him to wake up and go seize it.

But the moment he opened his coffin, he felt a familiar aura—the Insect Mother seemed to have been there, and the aura was fresh, as if she had just passed through.

The moment Ghostfire Mirror thought of the Insect Mother, he couldn't care less about the Godhead fragment and immediately followed the scent.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader shifted his gaze to the giant insect and the two little cubs on its back.

His ancestor had slept for over a hundred years. This time, upon waking, he hadn't seen his family, nor had he gone after the Godhead fragment; he had actually come to the meat market just to see these two little cubs?

"Ancestor, who are they?"

Ghostfire Mirror introduced them: "This is A-Dai, a cub of the Stone Monkey tribe, and this is... Xiao Hua."

He wasn't yet certain that Xiao Hua was definitely the Insect Mother's descendant, though it carried a strong aura of the Insect Mother.

Ghostfire Yin was confused upon hearing the introduction. "Who are their parents?"

A-Dai heard this and proudly said in a loud voice, "My papas are Shang Feifan and Lang Mu!"

His papas had told him that if he met someone he couldn't handle, he should report their names, and if things went wrong, he should run.

Xiao Hua nodded along. "Mm-hmm. If you have any business, go find them. We're still small, we don't handle the big stuff."

Ghostfire Mirror: "..."

He didn't know who Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were, but seeing this flower-insect—suspected to be the Insect Mother—treating them as its guardians, just how powerful must those two be?

He looked at his grandson, who was wearing a look of astonishment, and asked, "Do you know those two?"

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader had a strange expression. "I know them, of course I know them. I just didn't expect them to have children, and a Stone Monkey and an insect at that."

"Are they very strong?" Ghostfire Mirror asked casually.

The Ghostfire Alliance Leader nodded vigorously. "Extremely strong!"

*As I thought!* Ghostfire Mirror mused: *Grandson, you still don't know exactly what species that flower-insect is. If you did, you'd know that the two people you know are far more than just "extremely strong."*

A-Dai saw the group of adults surrounding them and noticed the strange expressions on the two leaders, so he secretly sent a message to his papas: *Papas! There are some weird uncles and a big brother eyeing Xiao Hua! Come quickly!*

第271章 小虫母催债

商非凡和郎沐与鬼火镜第一次见面并没有剑拔弩张的紧迫氛围。

相反，三人相处的相当融洽。

鬼火镜因为长期沉眠，身体非常瘦削，但他儒雅的气质由内而发，又带着生意人的圆滑，给人以浓浓的儒商之感。

如果不是他脸上的伤痕给他多添了一些狠厉，你看到他，绝对不会想到一代强者这样的形容。

事实上鬼火镜就算在群雄迭起的大繁华纪末期也是非常有名的厉害人物，他当时掌控着兽人大陆最大的商会组织鬼火商会，因为性格沉稳情商高、进退有度实力强、办事可靠且信誉一流，几乎走到哪里都能交到朋友，还都处得不错。

联盟政府几次邀请他加入联盟管理阶层，都被他以无法兼顾两头为由拒绝，但就算如此，联盟政府的最高盟主对他也没有任何不满，反而越发欣赏他。

甚至如果不是大战来临，鬼火镜极有可能当选下一任的联盟盟主——当时的盟主极力推荐他作为自己的继任者。

鬼火镜见到商非凡和郎沐也非常惊讶，他没想到两人竟然如此年轻。

在他看来能让疑似虫母的花虫子称作家长的两人，最起码年龄也已百岁往上，可实际见面才发现两人貌似都才二十出头？

更让他意外的是，两人身上都没有年轻人特有的稚嫩和毛躁感，尤其郎沐的眼神，那种平静就好像阅尽千帆、历尽苦难后的平和与包容。

他为何能看出来？

因为他就是从极度漫长的痛苦年代中走过来的，他见过很多熬过那个时期的人的眼神，他有不少朋友在生命末期的眼神就跟郎沐类似。

但他那些朋友包括他在内，眼神中的平和多少还蕴含着一些不甘和被隐藏起来的痛苦，而郎沐的平和则带着喜悦以及对未来的无限期待。

这让鬼火镜很喜欢郎沐，也很想了解郎沐的过去，他的潜意识告诉他，这是一个有故事的青年。

对比郎沐，鬼火镜对商非凡就要提防得多，他一看到这人就想到了枭雄、一方霸主、不好惹的家伙……这些形容词。

好在鬼火镜跟类似的人物打过不少交道，他见到商非凡，一见他和郎沐双手相握而来，就称赞他们：“二位一看就是天作之合。我就说感情好的伴侣才能养出如此可爱自信的孩子。”

商非凡嘴角翘起，他就喜欢这样会说话的人，当即介绍自己：“商非凡。”

郎沐也谦和点头，介绍了自己的名字和来历。

鬼火镜笑：“我是鬼火印的小堂爷爷，单名镜。我是几个兄弟中年龄最小的一个，也是唯一活到现在的一个。关于我的事情，我想你们可能有不少想要问我的。正好我也有些事想要请教你们，我们换个地方说话如何？”

肉市场确实不是说话的地方，虽然他们前后左右都有兽人战士包围起来，但这样也就更让人瞩目。

一行人很快转移地点，来到鬼火印的私宅。

堂堂南联盟主的私宅并不如商郎两人想象中那么豪华，就一座有前后小院的两层小楼。楼面上爬满藤蔓植物，处在市中心颇有闹中取静之感。

小楼面积也不算大，上下两层加起来也不过才五百平不到。

双方在客厅落座，仆人送上茶点。

客厅布置很像是中式堂屋，靠墙两边各摆了几张椅子，椅子和椅子之间放有茶几。正面上首也放了两张椅子，中间同样有茶几。

郎沐顺手就把阿呆抱进怀里，小花花自然而然落到了郎沐的肩膀上。

商非凡坐在郎沐左手边。

对面就是鬼火镜和鬼火印两人。

上首主位空着。

鬼火镜沉吟片刻，决定直接出击：“二位知道这位小花花和虫母的关系吗？”

小花花看向鬼火镜。

商非凡笑笑：“不如您先说说您发现了什么，又想告诉我们什么？”

鬼火镜目光投到小花花身上：“我只能确定一点，你不是虫母。但你身上有浓重的虫母气息，你身上的能量同样属于虫母。我想你应该是吸收了虫母绝大部分的能量，但还没有完全消化吸收，所以你还无法隐藏自己身上的能量，只要实力和你相差不是太远的人就能察觉出你的强大。而像我这样的人，则能察觉到你强大下的不稳。”

小花花似乎有点不服，但它只是换了个姿势，并没有辩驳。

它也能感觉出来这个兽人不比它弱，说不定还比它强一点点？

在一边当陪客的鬼火盟主眼皮跳了跳：虫母？拥有虫母力量的小虫人？新虫母出现了？

鬼火镜又道：“你之前说你对我有种熟悉感，对么？”

小花花没否认：“对。我觉得我应该见过你，但我又知道我没有见过你。”

鬼火镜笑起来：“你这种情况不奇怪，你听过血脉记忆传承吗？”

小花花扇了扇翅膀，血脉技艺传承这个词汇像是一道闪电在它脑海中划过，瞬间，它似乎又接受了更多……记忆。

鬼火镜无法看出一只花虫子的表情，只能推测：“如果你真是虫母，或者拥有虫母的完整记忆，你看到我的第一眼九成会上来揍我，还会边揍我边让我还债。”

鬼火镜说着就露出一个无奈笑容：“和它借债时，我耍了个心眼，和它约定人死债消，那时我其实已经抱着自己活不长的认定。可没想到……我活到了今天，那么强大的虫母却……”

“我能问你一些问题吗？放心，我不会伤害你，我和虫母的关系比较复杂，总体而言，是我欠它比较多。”鬼火镜坦言。

小花花忽然兴奋道：“如果我是虫母的继承人，那你欠虫母的债能还给我吗？”

鬼火镜：“……当然。当时说好是我死了不用还虫母的债，但没说虫母死了我还活着就不用还债。”

“是钱还是物资？你要怎么还？什么时候还？能现在就还吗？”小花花更加兴致勃勃。

商非凡伸手摸摸阿呆的脑袋，语重心长地说：“儿砸，看到没有，你要跟小花花多学学。”

阿呆眨巴眼睛，懂了：“我知道啦，债务也是遗产之一，有好处就继承，没好处就不要。”

商非凡抬手就给了阿呆一个脑崩。

阿呆委屈：难道我说错了吗？

郎沐好笑地揉揉阿呆的脑门。自然之力拂过，那点小痛楚立刻没了。

阿呆往郎沐怀里拱了拱——还是我阿沐爸爸最好啦~

鬼火盟主在心中叹息：老祖啊，你欠虫母债的事情，在虫母死掉后只有你自己知道，你不说，这笔债务不就相当于无？唉！

鬼火镜似乎猜出大家在想什么一样，诚实道：“就算我现在不说，等小花花继承了虫母完整的记忆，它一样会想起来我欠债的事，与其让它那时候上门讨债，还不如我现在就说清楚情况。”

商非凡：说清楚情况？不是还清？

“不过我现在必须确定一件事，那就是虫母是活还是死，以及小花花是否真的和虫母有关。”鬼火镜正色道。

小花花蹭蹭郎沐，问：“你们觉得我应该和他说吗？”

### Chapter 271: The Little Insect Mother Collects a Debt (Part 1)

The first meeting between Shang Feifan, Lang Mu, and Ghostfire Mirror was devoid of any tense, sword-drawn atmosphere.

On the contrary, the three of them got along quite harmoniously.

Because he had been in a deep slumber for so long, Ghostfire Mirror’s frame was very gaunt. However, his refined and scholarly temperament radiated from within, coupled with the slickness of a businessman, giving him the distinct air of a Confucian merchant.

If not for the scars on his face that added a touch of ruthlessness, one would never associate him with the description of a legendary powerhouse.

In fact, even during the late period of the Great Prosperity—an era teeming with heroes—Ghostfire Mirror was a renowned and formidable figure. At that time, he controlled the Ghostfire Chamber of Commerce, the largest merchant organization on the Beastman Continent. Because of his steady personality, high emotional intelligence, ability to handle situations with grace, immense strength, and impeccable reliability, he could make friends almost anywhere he went, and he maintained those relationships well.

The Alliance government had invited him to join their management ranks several times, only for him to decline on the grounds that he could not balance both sides. Yet, even so, the supreme leader of the Alliance held no resentment toward him; instead, he admired him all the more.

In fact, had the Great War not arrived, Ghostfire Mirror would likely have been elected the next Alliance leader—the incumbent leader had strongly recommended him as his successor.

Ghostfire Mirror was also quite surprised when he met Shang Feifan and Lang Mu. He had not expected the two to be so young.

In his view, the two people whom the flower-insect—suspected to be an Insect Mother—called "parents" should have been at least a hundred years old. Yet, upon meeting them, it appeared they were both only in their early twenties.

What surprised him even more was that neither of them possessed the immaturity or impulsiveness typical of youth. Lang Mu’s gaze, in particular, held a calmness that seemed to reflect the peace and tolerance of someone who had seen it all and endured great suffering.

How could he tell?

Because he himself had walked out of an era of extreme, prolonged suffering. He had seen the eyes of many who had survived that period; many of his friends in their final days had eyes similar to Lang Mu’s.

But for those friends, including himself, that peace was always tinged with lingering resentment and hidden pain. Lang Mu’s peace, however, carried joy and an infinite expectation for the future.

This made Ghostfire Mirror like Lang Mu very much, and he was eager to understand Lang Mu’s past. His subconscious told him that this was a young man with a story.

Compared to Lang Mu, Ghostfire Mirror was much more guarded against Shang Feifan. The moment he saw him, words like "tyrant," "overlord," and "someone not to be trifled with" came to mind.

Fortunately, Ghostfire Mirror had dealt with many such figures. Seeing Shang Feifan arrive hand-in-hand with Lang Mu, he praised them: "The two of you are clearly a match made in heaven. I always say that only partners with a loving relationship can raise such a cute and confident child."

Shang Feifan’s lips curled upward; he liked people who knew how to speak well. He immediately introduced himself: "Shang Feifan."

Lang Mu also nodded humbly, introducing his name and background.

Ghostfire Mirror smiled: "I am the grand-uncle of Ghostfire Yin, known simply as Mirror. I am the youngest of my brothers, and the only one still alive. Regarding my affairs, I imagine you may have many questions for me. As it happens, I also have some things I would like to consult with you about. Shall we go somewhere else to talk?"

The meat market was certainly not the place for a conversation. Although they were surrounded by beastman warriors, that only made them more conspicuous.

The group soon relocated to Ghostfire Yin’s private residence.

The private home of the dignified Southern Alliance leader was not as luxurious as Shang and Lang had imagined—it was just a two-story building with small front and back courtyards. The walls were covered in climbing vines, giving it a sense of tranquility amidst the bustling city center.

The house was not large, totaling less than five hundred square meters across both floors.

Both parties took their seats in the living room, and servants brought tea and refreshments.

The layout of the living room resembled a traditional Chinese hall. Several chairs were placed against the walls on both sides, with small tea tables between them. Two chairs were also placed at the head of the room, with a tea table in between.

Lang Mu casually scooped A-Dai into his arms, while Little Flower naturally landed on Lang Mu’s shoulder.

Shang Feifan sat to Lang Mu’s left.

Opposite them sat Ghostfire Mirror and Ghostfire Yin.

The seat of honor at the head of the room remained empty.

Ghostfire Mirror pondered for a moment, deciding to strike directly: "Do you two know the relationship between this Little Flower and the Insect Mother?"

Little Flower looked at Ghostfire Mirror.

Shang Feifan smiled: "Why don't you tell us first what you have discovered, and what you wish to tell us?"

Ghostfire Mirror’s gaze shifted to Little Flower: "I can only be certain of one thing: you are not the Insect Mother. But you carry a heavy aura of the Insect Mother, and the energy within you also belongs to the Insect Mother. I suspect you have absorbed the vast majority of the Insect Mother’s energy but have not yet fully digested it, which is why you cannot hide your own energy. Anyone whose strength is not too far from yours can perceive your power. And someone like me can perceive the instability beneath your strength."

Little Flower seemed a bit defiant, but it merely shifted its posture without arguing.

It could also sense that this beastman was no weaker than it was—perhaps even a little stronger?

Ghostfire Yin, acting as a guest, felt his eyelids twitch: *Insect Mother? A little insect-person with the power of the Insect Mother? Has a new Insect Mother appeared?*

Ghostfire Mirror continued: "You said earlier that you felt a sense of familiarity with me, right?"

Little Flower did not deny it: "Yes. I feel like I should have seen you, but I also know I haven't."

Ghostfire Mirror laughed: "Your situation is not strange. Have you heard of bloodline memory inheritance?"

Little Flower fluttered its wings. The term "bloodline memory inheritance" flashed through its mind like a bolt of lightning. In an instant, it seemed to receive even more... memories.

Ghostfire Mirror could not read the expression of a flower-insect, so he could only speculate: "If you were truly the Insect Mother, or possessed the complete memories of the Insect Mother, you would have likely attacked me the moment you saw me, and you would have demanded I repay my debt while doing so."

Ghostfire Mirror wore a helpless smile: "When I borrowed from her, I played a trick, agreeing that the debt would be cleared upon my death. At the time, I truly believed I wouldn't live long. But unexpectedly... I have lived to this day, while such a powerful Insect Mother has..."

"May I ask you some questions? Don't worry, I won't harm you. My relationship with the Insect Mother is quite complex; overall, I owe her quite a lot," Ghostfire Mirror admitted candidly.

Little Flower suddenly said excitedly: "If I am the heir of the Insect Mother, can you repay the debt you owe her to me?"

Ghostfire Mirror: "...Of course. It was agreed that I wouldn't have to repay the debt if I died, but it never said that if the Insect Mother died while I was still alive, I wouldn't have to pay."

"Is it money or supplies? How will you pay? When will you pay? Can you pay right now?" Little Flower became even more enthusiastic.

Shang Feifan reached out to pat A-Dai’s head, saying earnestly: "Son, you see? You should learn from Little Flower."

A-Dai blinked, understanding: "I get it! Debts are part of the inheritance too. If there’s a benefit, inherit it; if there’s no benefit, ignore it."

Shang Feifan flicked A-Dai on the forehead.

A-Dai felt wronged: *Did I say something wrong?*

Lang Mu amusedly rubbed A-Dai’s forehead. A touch of natural energy brushed over it, and the slight sting vanished instantly.

A-Dai snuggled into Lang Mu’s arms—*Daddy Lang is still the best~*

Ghostfire Yin sighed inwardly: *Ancestor, the fact that you owed the Insect Mother a debt was something only you knew after she died. If you hadn't said anything, wouldn't that debt have effectively ceased to exist? Sigh!*

As if guessing what everyone was thinking, Ghostfire Mirror said honestly: "Even if I didn't say anything now, once Little Flower inherits the complete memories of the Insect Mother, it would eventually remember the debt anyway. Rather than waiting for it to come knocking later, it is better to clarify the situation now."

Shang Feifan: *Clarify the situation? Not pay it off?*

"However, I must first confirm one thing: whether the Insect Mother is alive or dead, and whether Little Flower is truly related to the Insect Mother," Ghostfire Mirror said solemnly.

Little Flower rubbed against Lang Mu and asked: "Do you think I should tell him?"

郎沐斟酌着说：“你觉得能说的就说，如果你觉得说的事情会影响到你的安危或涉及你的隐私，那就不说。”

小花花其实无所谓，因为强大，所以无所畏惧，就对鬼火镜说：“那你问吧，你想知道什么？”

鬼火镜问得很小心，他问小花花记不记得自己出生时的环境，问它有没有看到一只身体巨大无比浑身金色或者雪白可爱特别精致的虫子，问它除了它以外，它周围还有没有其他虫子或虫卵出现。

又问小花花是如何得到虫母的力量和传承记忆，以及它为何会出现在兽人大陆。

小花花觉得这些问题没什么不能回答的，就全都说了，还添加了一些：

“我有记忆时，好像是从你说的巨大虫子的身体里爬出来的。除了我，我没看到其他虫子，包括虫卵在内。就算有，也给我吃了。”

“那只巨大虫子应该是金色的吧，它的壳很硬，我吃它都是从内部开始吃。我吃得越多，脑中-出现的东西就越多。”

“它那时应该已经死了，我没有感觉到它的气息，它也没有和做任何交流，包括精神力在内。但它的肉很新鲜，我感觉就是留给我吃的。”

“我待的那个地方很古怪，一开始我怎么都走不出来，后来有一天，我突然就走出来了。哦，那天，我同时感知到还有一份属于我……属于那只大虫子的能量爆发。对，我就是感知到那股能量的同时，就突然看到出口。”

“我出来后首先看到的是大海，我就冲着那股能量爆发的方向飞啊飞，飞到了陆地。后来就看到活物，饿了我就捕猎。我感到有些地方很熟悉，但不少地方又很陌生。”

“我去了一些自己有记忆的地方，但那些地方和我记忆中已经完全不同。”

“然后我就遇到阿呆啦，再然后我就住到商爸爸和阿沐爸爸的家里，成他们家小孩啦。”小花花高高兴兴地总结。

鬼火盟主特别无语，你堂堂新虫母就这么给自己找了一个寄养家庭，还很得意？

鬼火镜则笑得温柔，又详细询问小花花和巨虫尸体待的空间模样。

小花花对那个空间没什么好感，有点气呼呼地说：“就黑乎乎的，分不清天和地，到处都一样，像个空心球的内部。我看到出口，就是看到一点亮光，冲着那亮光飞，就飞出去了。”

鬼火镜陷入沉默，似乎想到了某些事。

小花花更好奇鬼火镜欠了虫母什么债，十分想让他现在就还掉。

鬼火镜被小花花催促两声，从回忆中醒来，失笑：“我欠虫母的东西没办法现在就还你，如果拿出来，我就会失去生命。”

在场的大人都猜出了鬼火镜欠虫母的是什么。

他们也都很惊讶虫母竟然能把神格碎片这样的东西借给鬼火镜。

可见鬼火镜当时和虫母的关系有多好……至少不是完全敌对。

而且只听鬼火镜的口气，也能感觉出来虫母和他关系不差，否则就不是见面就揍他让他还债，而是直接抢夺神格碎片。

小花花不爽：“你想赖账吗？”

“当然不是。”鬼火镜知道小花花不是虫母，而是一个小幼崽后，对小花花的语气就变得像家里大人待小孩一样：“我的意思是我可以折算成其他你想要的……”

“好好好！我要金达盾！”小花花立刻大声说。

鬼火镜：“……也许我有更适合你的东西。”

小花花刚知道金钱的魅力没多久，听说鬼火镜不想付钱，一对复眼就充满了凶厉：“嗯？！”

郎沐轻咳，“小花花，先听听鬼火镜先生说要给你什么样的补偿。”

小花花听郎沐开口，竖起的翅膀这才慢慢放下：“是什么东西啊？不好我可不要。”

鬼火镜无奈又好笑，“相信我，对你来说，绝对是好东西。你虽然靠吞吃虫母尸体来继承血脉传承，但虫母当时恐怕也不是完整的。”

小花花回忆，点头：“嗯，心脏没了，眼睛也没了，还缺了几条腿和一条触角？翅膀好像也有残缺。”

鬼火镜神色怅然，但也没有多少难过的神色，他太多朋友陨落，送走太多好友和亲人，他的心早已痛到麻木。

小花花问：“你要给我的就是虫母的残缺部位吗？”

鬼火镜点头：“一部分是。但也不是全部，我尽量收集了，但还有一部分残缺，尤其是它的心脏。但……”

鬼火镜似乎有所犹豫。

“但什么？”小花花好奇。

鬼火镜还是说出了自己的顾忌：“如果你想做你自己，最好不要吸收虫母的心脏，那是虫母的能量核心，虽然获得它，可以让你的力量更接近虫母，但你也有可能彻底失去自我，变成虫母的记忆形成的你。你明白我的意思吗？”

小花花还没说话。

阿呆就嘟囔道：“花花，我不要你变成其他人，你现在这样就很好。”

小花花哼哼：“我当然很好。我也不会变成其他人，就算是虫母也不行。没有虫母心脏，我也一样能变得强大，比原来的虫母还要强！”

它就是它，不一样的小花花！

它才不要做别虫的复制品。

鬼火镜吐气，他就怕这只小虫母一心追求力量，想要得到虫母的一切。

现在看来这只小虫母虽然获得了虫母的记忆，受到虫母一定影响，但也还有自己清晰的独立意识。

商非凡在一边保持沉默。他要怎么说？告诉小花花和鬼火镜，说你们不用担忧虫母心脏的问题了，他已经消化吸收了大部分，现在就只剩下一小块暂时存储在某小光光身上。

如果小花花执意想要寻找到虫母心脏，那岂不是要吞噬他？

这事只能瞒住小花花，能瞒多久瞒多久。

“虫母力量很强，但当时我们兽人大陆也有很多强者，如果不是它身上携带有邪神的力量，它可能连逃走都不可能。”

鬼火镜再次陷入回忆：“我和一些人还奇怪，虫母当时还有和我们同归于尽的能力，但它放弃了，竟然在最后关头逃离，这完全不符合它的性格。但如果它当时已经孕育你，并决定把你孕育出来，那就不奇怪了。”

鬼火镜神色复杂：“他们都说虫母当时已经陷入疯狂，没有任何理智，只想要报复。但它还能记着它的最原始使命，还能记着让虫人族传承下去，它就应该没有真的疯彻底。实际上，我一直都觉得虫母心里知道这场战争无法避免，不是它出头，也会是其他存在。它跑到兽人大陆挑起战争，与其说是报复，不如说更像是……被逼无奈。”

鬼火盟主惊讶地看向这位老祖。

老祖这话可是从没有和他们这些后代说过。

鬼火镜注意到后背的目光，摆摆手：“当时不止我这么认为，也有其他几位也这么认为。但当时的情况已经不容许我们任何一方后退，所有人都被卷入战争中，仇恨交织，每个人都有参战的理由，就算想要停下来也不可能。”
