"Snatch the prize?" Eagle Wing seemed to understand the meaning of the phrase quickly, a hint of disdain appearing on his face. "Are you referring to the God of Nature’s scepter, or the Divine Platform itself?"

Without waiting for Shang Feifan to answer, Eagle Wing asked, "When did you notice my presence?" He seemed more interested in this question.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第277章 邪神意识吐露的真相 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第277章 邪神意识吐露的真相

商非凡：“战斗结束后，黑雾消散。”

鹰之翼挑眉：“黑雾？”

商非凡也索性挑明：“那黑雾携带你的气息，且一直在暗中掠夺战场上所有生命的生机，后面更是和虫巢抢夺那些血肉能量。”

鹰之翼貌似很惊讶：“你能感觉到我的气息？”

很多人在看到邪神信徒出现时，说是能感觉到邪恶，那只是邪神信徒本身携带的磁场。

这世上真正接触过邪神的除了天河星的神灵们，那真的是寥寥无几。

“邪神之卵。”商非凡提醒。

鹰之翼恍然大悟：“你竟然能感知并记得我的气息，看来我对你的判断没有错误？”

“哦？你对我有什么判断？”商非凡貌似也很好奇。

鹰之翼一双带着金属光泽的眼眸看向他：“你并不在乎这个世界，你也不在乎这里的生命，你天性漠然。你伪装得很好，但我在第一次接触你后就知道，你是天生的自由者。”

商非凡扯了扯嘴角：“你似乎在说我和你是同类？”

鹰之翼反问：“不是吗？”

“你说的天生自由者又是什么？追求自由的天性？”

“这只是其一。你也知道你精神力异常强大吧？这是自由者的天生属性之一，因为只有拥有强大且坚韧的精神力，才能抵抗住种种诱惑，并能在毁灭的危机中为自己争夺一线生机。”

“请说重点。”

鹰之翼发出轻笑：“你可以脱离桎梏，自由翱翔宇宙，只要你知道正确的修炼之法。而这个正确的修炼法是历代一个又一个自由者付出无数代价总结出的经验。”

商非凡懂了：“你打算告诉我这个修炼法，但需要我付出一定代价？”

鹰之翼：“你就问你自己想不想要吧？”

商非凡：“我怎么知道你说的是真是假？”

鹰之翼坦然道：“因为我需要你的帮助。这个世界对我的束缚很强，我被这个世界的神灵迷惑，以为祂们就是这个世界的最高战斗力，可当祂们围攻我时，我才发现祂们背后还有一个更强大的力量，对方利用那些神灵吸引我的注意，又用这个世界的本源力量作为诱饵，这才把我困住。”

“我又能帮助你什么？”

“我可以传授你真正适合你的修炼法，让你真正超脱于这个世界，短时间内你不说超过这个世界的神灵，与他们并驾齐驱绝无问题。到时你只要和我里应外合，我就能打破这个世界对我的封印，从而脱困。”

“你找过多少人这样游说过？”

鹰之翼再次发出轻笑：“你以为我们这样的天生自由者很多吗？不，至今为止，在这颗星球上，我只发现你一个。”

“……”

“为什么沉默？”

“我只是很惊讶堂堂邪神竟然会向我这么一个普通兽人求助。”

“那是因为你并不普通。难道你就没有发现自己的实力提升非常之快？你以为这个世界的神灵为什么会选中你，让你成为祂们的任务者？”

“因为我是命运之子？”商非凡像是开玩笑一般说道。

鹰之翼轻嗤：“从来就没有命运之子的说法，只是因为影响某段命运的存在出现，那存在才会被称为命运之子。”

“唔，你这个说法就像是先有蛋还是先有鸡一样。”商非凡摸下巴。

“那我们换个说法，你知道为什么有存在能窥探到命运长河吗？”鹰之翼耐心十足。

商非凡摇头，他有很多猜测，但都不确定。

鹰之翼笑：“因为精神力。精神力是唯一能快过时间的矢量。你思考一秒钟，脑中已经过千年。”

商非凡细品，竟然觉得很有理。

“你知道宇宙为什么一直在扩张并不断爆炸吗？”鹰之翼又提出第二个硬问题。

商非凡都快觉得邪神并不是邪神，而是一名拥有渊博知识的科学家：“为什么？”

鹰之翼：“因为未来随时在改变，因为时间这个矢量并不是只拥有一条直线。精神力窥探到的未来在时间上来说是已经发生过的，但不代表现在这个时间点的未来不能改变。当有人窥探到未来并试图改变时，新的未来就会产生，也就是产生了新的时间线。”

商非凡脑中下意识出现了宛如树脉一样的时间脉络图，它们从一个点出发，在途中发展出无数枝干，在这些枝干中又会长出无数新的细枝。

因为这些脉络越长越多，导致它的版图也越来越大，宇宙不得不不断膨胀，同时这些时间脉络中一些脉络在发展到一定程度后因为各种各样的原因无法再发展下去，于是这条时间线就结束了，甚至产生了末端爆炸或整条线的爆炸。

“你在未来看到了我？而我关系到你的生死？”商非凡总结。

“纠正你一点，像我这样的存在并不会真正死亡，就算这个世界暂时束缚住我，但它并不能真正的吞噬我，我脱困只是迟早的问题，只是过程长短。我只是不想长时间坐牢而已。”鹰之翼神情淡然，此时的他看起来比神灵还更充满神性。

“这个世界想要吞噬你？”商非凡抓住重点。

鹰之翼露出一个微带邪恶的笑容：“你以为就凭那些本土神灵真的能打破这个世界最高意识设下的神之笼，还能发现我，并把我吸引到这个世界？”

“……来，展开说说。”

鹰之翼斜睨商非凡，但他也真的展开说了：“并不是每颗星球都能产生自我意识，就像不是每一个生命都能成为高级智慧生命。这个星球很幸运，就跟天赋就很强大的生灵一样，这颗星球本身自孕育初始就拥有极为强大的能量，这让这颗星球很早就孕育出自我意识。”

“而这颗星球很年轻，年轻的它对自己充满自我保护，它不希望有人来打扰它的发展和壮大，害怕有更强大的存在发现它，掠夺它的本源能量。”

“于是它主动切断了与其他世界的通道，你可以理解为它暂时闭关锁星，只想闷头发展。”

“但我们都知道闭关锁星的行为不可取，尤其不能长时间这么做。而第一个被这种措施伤害到的就是这颗星球的原生神灵。当然，祂们在这颗星球被称为神灵，但在其他地方，祂们也就是稍微强大一点的存在，在某些更高等的世界，祂们甚至只是底层蝼蚁。”

“但不管如何，这颗星球的原生神灵原本有让自己变得更强的可能，只要祂们能脱离原生星球，前往更高等的世界。可这颗星球为了保护自己，断绝了所有通往其他世界的通道，这就导致这颗星球的原生神灵无法离开。”

“这颗星球不肯放那些神灵离开，还因为它太过贪婪，它就像生育孩子只是想要吸孩子血的父母一样，在孩子长大后也不想他们离开，只想把他们困在家里，让他们为自己干活，等他们死后还要把他们的尸体埋在自家地里肥田。”

商非凡眼皮跳了跳。鹰之翼虽然说得刻薄，但从他从光球那里听来的历史内容来看，说不定这些都是真的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 277: The Truth Revealed by the Evil God’s Consciousness

Shang Feifan replied, "After the battle ended, when the black mist dissipated."

Eagle Wing raised an eyebrow. "Black mist?"

Shang Feifan decided to be blunt. "That black mist carried your aura and was secretly plundering the vitality of all life on the battlefield. Later, it even competed with the Insect Nest for that flesh and blood energy."

Eagle Wing appeared surprised. "You can sense my aura?"

When many people saw the appearance of Evil God followers, they claimed to feel "evil," but that was merely the magnetic field carried by the followers themselves.

In this world, aside from the gods of the Heavenly River Star, those who had truly come into contact with an Evil God were few and far between.

"The Evil God’s Egg," Shang Feifan reminded him.

Eagle Wing had a sudden realization. "To think you can perceive and remember my aura—it seems my judgment of you was not incorrect."

"Oh? And what judgment did you make of me?" Shang Feifan appeared curious as well.

Eagle Wing’s eyes, which held a metallic luster, looked at him. "You do not care about this world, nor do you care about the lives within it. You are indifferent by nature. You disguised it well, but from the moment I first made contact with you, I knew: you are a natural-born free spirit."

Shang Feifan twitched the corner of his mouth. "You seem to be saying that you and I are the same kind?"

Eagle Wing retorted, "Are we not?"

"And what is this 'natural-born free spirit' you speak of? A nature that pursues freedom?"

"That is only one part of it. You know your spiritual power is abnormally strong, don't you? This is one of the innate attributes of a free spirit, for only by possessing a powerful and resilient spirit can one resist various temptations and carve out a sliver of survival amidst the crisis of destruction."

"Please, get to the point."

Eagle Wing let out a soft laugh. "You can break free from your shackles and soar through the universe, provided you know the correct method of cultivation. And this correct method is the experience paid for with countless sacrifices by generation after generation of free spirits."

Shang Feifan understood. "You intend to teach me this cultivation method, but it will require me to pay a certain price?"

Eagle Wing: "Just ask yourself if you want it or not."

Shang Feifan: "How do I know if what you say is true or false?"

Eagle Wing replied candidly, "Because I need your help. This world’s shackles on me are strong. I was deceived by the gods of this world, thinking they were the highest combat power here. But when they besieged me, I realized there was an even more powerful force behind them. They used those gods to attract my attention and used the world’s origin power as bait to trap me."

"And what could I possibly help you with?"

"I can teach you the cultivation method truly suited to you, allowing you to transcend this world. In a short time, not to mention surpassing the gods of this world, standing on equal footing with them would be no problem at all. When the time comes, you only need to coordinate with me from the inside, and I will be able to break the seal this world has placed on me and escape."

"How many people have you tried to lobby like this?"

Eagle Wing laughed softly again. "Do you think there are many natural-born free spirits like us? No. So far, on this planet, I have only found you."

"..."

"Why the silence?"

"I am just surprised that a dignified Evil God would seek help from an ordinary beastman like me."

"That is because you are not ordinary. Have you not noticed that your strength increases very rapidly? Why do you think the gods of this world chose you to be their task-runner?"

"Because I am the Child of Destiny?" Shang Feifan said, as if joking.

Eagle Wing scoffed. "There is no such thing as a 'Child of Destiny.' It is only because an existence that influences a certain destiny appears that they are called the Child of Destiny."

"Hmm, your explanation is like asking which came first, the chicken or the egg." Shang Feifan rubbed his chin.

"Let’s put it another way. Do you know why some beings can peer into the River of Destiny?" Eagle Wing was full of patience.

Shang Feifan shook his head. He had many guesses, but none were certain.

Eagle Wing smiled. "Because of spiritual power. Spiritual power is the only vector faster than time. You think for one second, and a thousand years have already passed in your mind."

Shang Feifan pondered this and found it surprisingly logical.

"Do you know why the universe is constantly expanding and exploding?" Eagle Wing posed a second difficult question.

Shang Feifan almost felt that the Evil God was not an Evil God, but a scientist with profound knowledge. "Why?"

Eagle Wing: "Because the future is constantly changing, and because time, as a vector, is not just a single straight line. The future glimpsed by spiritual power has already happened in terms of time, but that does not mean the future at the current point in time cannot be changed. When someone glimpses the future and attempts to change it, a new future is created—that is, a new timeline is born."

In Shang Feifan’s mind, a tree-like map of time appeared. It started from a single point, developing countless branches along the way, and from those branches, countless new twigs grew.

Because these veins grew more and more, the map became larger and larger, forcing the universe to expand continuously. At the same time, some of these time veins, after developing to a certain extent, could no longer continue for various reasons, so that timeline ended, sometimes even resulting in a terminal explosion or the explosion of the entire line.

"You saw me in the future? And I am related to your life or death?" Shang Feifan summarized.

"Let me correct you on one point: an existence like me does not truly die. Even if this world temporarily binds me, it cannot truly devour me. My escape is only a matter of time; it is just a question of how long the process takes. I simply do not wish to be imprisoned for so long." Eagle Wing’s expression was indifferent; at this moment, he looked even more divine than the gods themselves.

"This world wants to devour you?" Shang Feifan grasped the key point.

Eagle Wing revealed a slightly evil smile. "Do you really think those local gods could break the 'Cage of Gods' set by the highest consciousness of this world, discover me, and lure me to this world?"

"...Go on, tell me more."

Eagle Wing glanced sideways at Shang Feifan, but he did indeed elaborate: "Not every planet can develop self-awareness, just as not every life form can become a highly intelligent being. This planet is very lucky. Like a creature with great natural talent, this planet possessed extremely powerful energy from the moment of its inception, which allowed it to develop self-awareness very early on."

"And this planet is very young. In its youth, it is full of self-protection. It does not want anyone to disturb its development and growth, fearing that more powerful beings will discover it and plunder its origin energy."

"So, it took the initiative to cut off the channels to other worlds. You can understand it as it temporarily 'closing the door' to the stars, wanting only to focus on its own development."

"But we all know that closing oneself off from the stars is not advisable, especially not for a long time. And the first to be harmed by this measure were the native gods of this planet. Of course, they are called gods on this planet, but elsewhere, they are merely slightly stronger beings. In some higher worlds, they are nothing more than bottom-tier ants."

"But regardless, the native gods of this planet originally had the possibility of becoming stronger, provided they could leave their home planet and head to higher worlds. But to protect itself, this planet severed all paths to other worlds, which led to the native gods being unable to leave."

"This planet refuses to let those gods leave because it is too greedy. It is like a parent who only wants to suck the blood of their children; even after the children grow up, it does not want them to leave. It only wants to trap them at home, make them work for it, and when they die, bury their corpses in its own fields to fertilize the soil."

Shang Feifan’s eyelids twitched. Although Eagle Wing spoke bitingly, based on the history he had heard from the light orb, these things might very well be true.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第277章 邪神意识吐露的真相 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
鹰之翼冷冷一笑，接着道：“这颗星球不但不肯放那些原生神灵离开，它还试图吸收其他力量来进一步壮大自身。它发现了我，它也知道那些原生神灵想要脱离它，于是它就想了一个一石二鸟的毒计。”

商非凡：“……”

鹰之翼呵呵：“没想到是吧？这就跟不是所有父母都会爱自己的孩子一样，而星球和星球上的生命，连母子关系都称不上。对于星球本身来说，它身上的生命大多都被它认为是寄生虫和吸血鬼。”

“天河星故意让黑暗之神成功破坏了神之笼，故意让黑暗之神发现了我的存在，它也许还影响了黑暗之神的意识，让祂一心认定只要把我引到天河星、吞噬我的力量，就能挣脱星球束缚、前往更高等世界。”

“实际上天河星借着这个一石二鸟的计策，不但能消灭这些想要脱离它的不听话‘孩子’，让它们的尸体重新化为这个世界的能量，同时还能把我给吸引过来，从而把我困住。”

鹰之翼看向商非凡：“想要吞噬我、吸收我能量的不止是这个世界的神灵，还有这颗星球本身！”

“甚至它特地选定了战场，就是兽人大陆。它已经做好了牺牲兽人大陆的准备，不管兽人大陆在神战下会遭遇到什么事情，它都已经做好了重新启动的准备。”

鹰之翼说到这里，特意给了商非凡时间消化，过了一会儿才继续：

“但天河星千算万算却没有算到我的实际实力要超过它本身。它能困住我，却无法真正吸收我身上的能量，甚而它为了困住我，不得不动用它的本源能量，这就造成它进退两难的局面。”

“于是，它开始让神灵在命运长河中寻找真正吞噬我、消化我的可能。可怜那些神灵，尤其是命运之神，以为祂们窥探命运长河的举动是在自救，却不知道祂们只是这颗星球的工具。”

“祂们尝试了很多次，找出了不少所谓的命运之子，可惜……没有一个能真正解决我。甚至进一步发现在好些命运线中，都是我这个外来邪神吞噬了天河星。”

“天河星慌了。”

“为此，天河星意识不得不考虑引入其他世界的力量。”

“天河星本身早就在命运之神一次次窥探命运长河中发现其他世界，也就是地星的存在。但它那时并不想引起其他世界的注意，它担心自己被发现，担心它的谋划会被其他星球意识知晓。”

“但它发现本土的命运之子没有一个能真正帮助到它，最终它决定引入郎沐。”

商非凡表情不变，却握紧了身边人的手。

郎沐仍旧像是没有察觉身边多了一个人，正脸带笑容听着两只小崽说些无厘头的稚气话。

鹰之翼眼中的邪恶更加明显：“当然，天河星本身也无法控制命运，它只能影响。它通过命运之神的眼睛看到郎沐并不能真正打败我，只能驱逐我，那就相当于帮我脱困。天河星当然不愿意这样的情况发生，于是它决定把郎沐的气运转到天河星气运强大、能力也强大的本土土著身上。”

商非凡眼神变得黑沉。

“但让天河星意识没有想到的是，洛伦米尔顿虽然引出了一条新的命运线，可并没有按照它认为的那样发展，也就是借用地星玩家，消磨我的能量，增加天河星本身的力量，进而靠时间来一点点吸收我。洛伦米尔顿最终反被我所用，天河星完败。”

“但好在洛伦米尔顿的骚操作又引出了另一条命运线，也就是引来了你。”

“你的这条命运线是最新的一条，命运之神已经沉睡，祂无法窥探到这条正在生成的新命运线，天河星本身也不能。但天河星在你身上看到了新的可能，因为你和郎沐的关系，你九成九会帮助郎沐，也就是帮助兽人大陆的生灵，从而帮助到天河星本身。”

鹰之翼说到这里，坦然道：“我也无法窥探到这条正在生成的新命运线的未来，因为它是进行时。我的精神力还无法让我超越这条正在生成的时间线。也就因为这份不确定，我决定接触你。”

鹰之翼还笑了下：“当然你本身的实力也是让我做下这个决定的原因。”

鹰之翼吐露：“你是天河星上唯一一个跟我实际谈话，却还能保持自己意识清醒的人。”

鹰之翼翘起唇角，面带骄傲：“邪神的蛊惑可不是说着玩的。就连天河星那些神灵也会因为我的精神力影响导致意识混乱。”

被邪神意识如此夸奖，商非凡并没有感到骄傲。

他根据自己的判断，相信邪神意识说出的这些内容九成为真。

但有时候那一成假话才是最重要的。

现在他需要分辨的是，他要如何做才能利益最大化，最起码能保住他自己和郎沐，以及郎沐在乎的亲朋好友乃至整个天河星。

也许天河星意识在某种程度上，对于天河星生命来说也是邪恶的。

但可能是地星那边早就习惯“天地不仁，视万物为刍狗”这个概念，所以商非凡这时听到关于天河星意识的真相，也没有半点愤怒，反而有种“哦，果然如此”的尘埃落定感。

首先，天河星意识目前貌似还是站在他这边，希望他能顺着光球的要求做任务，也就是复活那些神灵。

也许天河星本身已经意识到想要对付这名外来邪神，还是需要几个得力打手的。所以它就决定“复活”几个孩子。

只是不知道天河星意识最后会如何对待他和郎沐，会不会也想留下他们，把他们当做养料。

其次，从邪神意识这么迫不及待地出现，并和他吐露所谓的真相，可以看出邪神也真的是急于脱困。

换言之，邪神并不像祂自己说的那样，就算被困也只是时间问题，很可能祂在被困的时间内也会伤筋动骨。

最后，就是看到底帮谁的问题。

而天河星意识也好，邪神意识也好，感觉都不是能值得信赖的伙伴。

可是他又要怎么另开赛道？在他本人的实力远远弱于这两位高等存在时。
chunks.englishText:
Ying Zhiyi gave a cold, mocking laugh and continued, "This planet not only refuses to let those primordial gods leave, but it also attempts to absorb other powers to further strengthen itself. It discovered me, and it knew those primordial gods wanted to break free from its control, so it devised a vicious plan to kill two birds with one stone."

Shang Feifan: "..."

Ying Zhiyi chuckled, "Didn't expect that, did you? It’s just like how not all parents love their children; in fact, a planet and the life forms upon it don't even share a parent-child relationship. To the planet itself, most of the life on its surface is viewed as nothing more than parasites and bloodsuckers."

"The Tianhe Planet intentionally allowed the God of Darkness to successfully destroy the Cage of Gods, and intentionally let the God of Darkness discover my existence. It likely even influenced the God of Darkness's consciousness, driving Him to believe that as long as He lured me to the Tianhe Planet and devoured my power, He could break the planet's shackles and ascend to a higher world."

"In reality, by using this two-birds-one-stone scheme, the Tianhe Planet could not only eliminate these disobedient 'children' who wanted to leave, turning their corpses back into energy for this world, but it could also lure me here and trap me."

Ying Zhiyi looked at Shang Feifan: "It isn't just the gods of this world who want to devour me and absorb my energy—it is the planet itself!"

"It even specifically chose the battlefield: the Beastman Continent. It had already prepared to sacrifice the Beastman Continent. No matter what happened to the continent under the ravages of the divine war, it was already prepared to initiate a reboot."

Having said this, Ying Zhiyi gave Shang Feifan time to digest the information before continuing after a moment:

"But for all its calculations, the Tianhe Planet did not account for the fact that my actual strength exceeds its own. It can trap me, but it cannot truly absorb my energy. In fact, to keep me contained, it has been forced to expend its own source energy, which has left it in a dilemma."

"Thus, it began to let the gods search the River of Fate for a possibility to truly devour and digest me. Poor gods—especially the God of Fate—they thought their actions of peering into the River of Fate were a means of self-salvation, never realizing they were merely tools for this planet."

"They tried many times, identifying quite a few so-called 'Children of Fate,' but unfortunately... none could truly resolve my existence. It was even discovered that in many timelines, it was I, the foreign Evil God, who devoured the Tianhe Planet."

"The Tianhe Planet panicked."

"For this reason, the consciousness of the Tianhe Planet had to consider introducing power from other worlds."

"The Tianhe Planet itself had long since discovered the existence of other worlds—specifically, Earth—through the God of Fate’s repeated peering into the River of Fate. But at that time, it didn't want to attract the attention of other worlds; it feared being discovered and feared its schemes would be known by the consciousness of other planets."

"But when it found that none of the local Children of Fate could truly help it, it finally decided to bring in Lang Mu."

Shang Feifan’s expression remained unchanged, though he tightened his grip on the hand of the person beside him.

Lang Mu still seemed unaware that someone else had joined them, smiling as he listened to the two little ones babbling nonsense in their childish voices.

The evil in Ying Zhiyi's eyes became more pronounced: "Of course, the Tianhe Planet itself cannot control fate; it can only influence it. Through the eyes of the God of Fate, it saw that Lang Mu could not truly defeat me, only banish me, which would be equivalent to helping me escape. The Tianhe Planet certainly didn't want that to happen, so it decided to divert Lang Mu’s fortune toward a local native of the Tianhe Planet who possessed both strong fortune and powerful abilities."

Shang Feifan’s eyes turned dark.

"But what the Tianhe Planet's consciousness didn't expect was that although Luolun Milton triggered a new timeline, it didn't develop as it had envisioned—that is, using Earth players to wear down my energy, increase the Tianhe Planet's own power, and then slowly absorb me over time. Luolun Milton was ultimately turned against it by me; the Tianhe Planet suffered a total defeat."

"But fortunately, Luolun Milton's erratic actions triggered yet another timeline: the one that brought you here."

"Your timeline is the newest one. The God of Fate has fallen into a deep slumber; He cannot peer into this new, forming timeline, and neither can the Tianhe Planet itself. But the Tianhe Planet saw new possibilities in you. Because of your relationship with Lang Mu, you are ninety-nine percent likely to help Lang Mu, which means helping the living beings of the Beastman Continent, and thereby helping the Tianhe Planet itself."

Ying Zhiyi said this, then admitted candidly: "I also cannot peer into the future of this new, forming timeline because it is currently in progress. My spiritual power is not yet enough to allow me to transcend this timeline as it is being created. It is precisely because of this uncertainty that I decided to make contact with you."

Ying Zhiyi even smiled: "Of course, your own strength is also a reason why I made this decision."

Ying Zhiyi revealed: "You are the only person on the Tianhe Planet who has had an actual conversation with me and yet managed to keep your consciousness clear."

Ying Zhiyi curled his lips, looking proud: "The temptation of an Evil God is not something to be trifled with. Even those gods of the Tianhe Planet would suffer from mental confusion due to the influence of my spiritual power."

Being praised by the consciousness of an Evil God did not make Shang Feifan feel proud.

Based on his own judgment, he believed that ninety percent of what the Evil God's consciousness said was true.

But sometimes, that ten percent of lies is the most important part.

Now, he needed to discern how to act to maximize his benefits—or at the very least, to protect himself, Lang Mu, the friends and family Lang Mu cared about, and perhaps even the entire Tianhe Planet.

Perhaps the consciousness of the Tianhe Planet was, in a sense, also evil toward the life forms of the Tianhe Planet.

But perhaps because the people of Earth were long accustomed to the concept that "Heaven and Earth are heartless, treating all things as straw dogs," Shang Feifan felt no anger upon hearing the truth about the Tianhe Planet's consciousness. Instead, there was a sense of "Oh, so that's how it is," a feeling of finality.

First, the Tianhe Planet's consciousness currently seemed to be on his side, hoping he would follow the light sphere's requests to complete missions—namely, resurrecting those gods.

Perhaps the Tianhe Planet itself had realized that to deal with this foreign Evil God, it still needed a few capable henchmen. So it decided to "resurrect" a few of its children.

It was just unclear how the Tianhe Planet's consciousness would treat him and Lang Mu in the end—whether it would also want to keep them and use them as fertilizer.

Secondly, from the fact that the Evil God's consciousness appeared so impatiently to reveal the so-called truth, it was clear that the Evil God was indeed desperate to escape.

In other words, the Evil God was not as indifferent as He claimed; even if being trapped was just a matter of time, it was likely that He was suffering significant damage during his confinement.

Finally, the question was who to help.

Neither the Tianhe Planet's consciousness nor the Evil God's consciousness felt like a trustworthy partner.

But how could he carve out a different path when his own strength was far inferior to these two higher existences?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第278章 商非凡的推理 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第278章 商非凡的推理

【呔！何方妖孽竟然趁我老光不在偷袭蛊惑我的任务者。】

商非凡：“……”

【哎呀！你个蠢蛋竟然直接和邪神意识交流，你不要魂了吗？】

商非凡：“……”

【看来果然没有我老光就不行，快快打开游戏商城，老光这就传你驱赶邪神意识之神法！只要九九八，你买不了吃亏买不了上当，赶紧下单，不买后悔千年！】

商非凡：“……”

【喂？喂喂？信号不好吗？你是没听到还是假装没听到？哦，老光我知道了，你是有邪神意识在旁，怕祂发现，不敢和我交流是吧？放心，现在系统重新升级，除了语音，更可使用精神力。你想要和我说什么，用精神力打开系统，联系我，就能用精神力和我面对面交流。】

商非凡不用某老光说明，他就已经打开了系统界面。

某光球变化大，系统界面变化更大。

如果说之前的系统界面就如3D游戏初出版，走的也是简洁风。那么现在的系统则是高级星际VIP版，不但功能瞧着更多样，就连界面也全都全息化。

商非凡站在一个会客室一般的房间内，眼睛视界内出现一些点选按钮，最上方的【系统助理】按钮闪闪发光，生怕他看不到。

商非凡就点了这个【系统助理】，不到半秒，一只光球跳出来。

这只光球不再只是一个发光的虚拟球体，它的球身上出现了五官，还有两只细细的小手，头顶竟然还顶着一对圆圆的耳朵。咋一看，还挺萌。

“快快快！赶紧打开系统商城，买我推荐你的神物，把那邪神意识赶紧驱逐走。”光球飞到门边，示意商非凡赶紧打开这扇上面写着“系统商城”字样的门扉。

商非凡没说话，出于好奇，拉开了那扇门。

门后是一个巨大的看不到尽头的超市。

就在商非凡想着这样寻找商品，还不如看电子版APP方便，光球就指点他说：“你看到视界中的游戏商城按钮了吗？点击它，你可以如以前一样在里面查找和查看物品，等你找到想要的物品，想要更具体的看到实物，就可以来这座全息商城，你只要报出商品编号或点击电子版中的商品，那东西就能瞬间送到你面前，让你看个究竟。当然，你也可以像逛超市一样在这座商城里随便逛，看到想买的直接拿下来放入购物车即可。”

商非凡：“……”

光球奇怪，围着商非凡飞了一圈：“你怎么不说话？喂？喂喂！”

“坏了！”光球大惊失色：“你不会已经被邪神意识污染了吧？你是不是已经变傻了？怎么办？不行！我得告诉郎沐，让他休掉你。”

商非凡额头爆出青筋。

“……你是不是中了病毒？”商非凡终于开口。

光球下意识反驳：“你中病毒我也不可能中病毒。”

商非凡：“那你难道就没有发现你的性格和说话方式全都变了吗？”

光球骄傲地发出璀璨的金光：“我这是进化！以前的我太害羞、太保守，导致很容易被你们这些任务者牵着鼻子走，还很容易被你们的表现坑害到抑郁。所以在这次自我学习和更新中，我下载了多种性格数据包，综合各种性格优点，最终选择了现在的性格发展方向。”

光球插腰发出狂笑声：“以后你们再也别想扼制我老光！谁敢不听我老光的话，我一个大-逼兜就赏给他！”

笑声一收，光球又负责地催促：“快！大傻子，别浪费时间了，你和邪神意识相处的时间越长，越容易受到祂的污染。赶紧买一瓶强力去污剂给自己的精神力好好刷一刷。再来一个精神力驱逐炮，把那个邪神意识给轰走！”

商非凡微微笑：“大傻子你是在说我吗？”

光球正要回答，突然一顿：“我知道这种说话艺术，我如果回答了，就相当于承认我才是那个大傻子。”

商非凡：“看来你这次更新真的进化不少。”

光球骄傲脸：“那是！”

商非凡：完了，他的系统重病不自知。

“你听到邪神意识跟我说的那些秘密了吗？”商非凡可不相信系统会“醒来”的如此及时。

光球傲然：“我老光虽然在更新中，但不代表我瞎掉聋掉，更新期间，你身上发生的所有事情我老光都知道。”

“那你怎么看那位说的事情？”

“你是想问祂说的是真是假吧？”

“那你觉得祂说的有几分真几分假？真又真在哪里，假又假在哪里？”

“邪神的话一个字都不能相信！”光球斩钉截铁。

商非凡关上游戏商城的大门，走回会客室，然后查看退出键。

随后发现只要他心念一动，就能离开这间全息游戏室。

“等等！”光球连忙喊住他。

商非凡身影都要消失一半，又重新出现。

光球气哼哼：“你真的没有被污染？”

商非凡面无表情：“我有没有被污染，你看不出来吗？”

光球确实能看出来，它就藏在商非凡的精神海里，商非凡如果有变化，它不可能不察觉。

“你怎么会没有被污染呢？”光球满脸古怪地围着商非凡绕了一圈。

但不到一秒，光球就发出了魔性的狂笑声：“嘎嘎嘎！不愧是我老光看中的任务者，这精神力壁障就是坚韧不屈！就连邪神意识也拿你无可奈何。”

“不过赶走还是要赶走祂的。不能让祂久留在生灵身边，哪怕祂没有刻意蛊惑他人，只要祂所在的地方也会造成其他人的精神污染。”光球又迅速说。

“商非凡，需要我帮你把你体内那监视你的小东西弄出来吗？”顶着鹰之翼脸的邪神意识笑眯眯对商非凡说。

商非凡闻言，对光球说：“祂知道你。”

光球冷哼：“知道又怎样？我老光怕祂？你别理祂。”不过意识而已，又非邪神本尊。

“也许我们和邪神也不是不能合作。”商非凡说。

光球再次大惊失色：“你疯了吗？你竟然敢和邪神合作？你看看曾经和邪神合作的生灵吧，看看他们都沦到了什么下场！”

商非凡：“我仔细想过，邪神除了想要当兽人的兽神以外，似乎并没有怎么蛊惑过这颗星球上的生灵。虫母，算是黑暗之神蛊惑的。法德尔大陆的魔法师则是自己找上真神教求合作。真神教看似邪神的爪牙，似乎也是自发形成？”

光球：“……我得给你做个深度检查，你肯定被污染了，但你不知道。”

商非凡：“当然，我知道祂不是什么好东西，厄穆克拉索就跟天生携带放射性污染的污染源一样，哪怕祂自己没有特意去污染某个人，只要祂存在就会造成大面积污染，进而导致大量伤亡。”

“所以你为什么疯到要和对方合作？”光球不解。

商非凡沉吟一秒：“因为我觉得祂说的那些话至少七成是真的。最重要的是我不想和邪神和这个世界鱼死网破，搞得最后大家一起死。如果和邪神合作，能给三方都求得活路，那为什么不合作？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 278: Shang Feifan’s Deduction

【Hey! What kind of monster is trying to sneak an attack and bewitch my mission-taker while I, Old Guang, am away?】

Shang Feifan: "..."

【Oh my! You idiot, you actually communicated directly with the Evil God's consciousness? Do you not want your soul anymore?】

Shang Feifan: "..."

【It seems I really am indispensable. Quickly, open the game store! Old Guang will now teach you the divine method to drive away the Evil God's consciousness! For only 998, you won't be cheated, you won't be scammed—place your order now, or you'll regret it for a thousand years!】

Shang Feifan: "..."

【Hello? Hello, hello? Is the signal bad? Did you not hear me, or are you pretending not to? Oh, I see, Old Guang understands now. You have the Evil God's consciousness nearby and are afraid He will discover us, so you don't dare communicate with me, right? Don't worry, the system has been upgraded. Besides voice, you can now use spiritual power. If you want to say something to me, open the system with your spiritual power and contact me; you can communicate with me face-to-face using your mind.】

Shang Feifan didn't need the light sphere to explain; he had already opened the system interface.

The light sphere had changed significantly, and the system interface had changed even more.

If the previous system interface was like an early-access 3D game with a minimalist style, the current system was a high-end interstellar VIP version. Not only were the functions more diverse, but the entire interface had become holographic.

Shang Feifan stood in a room that looked like a reception area. Within his field of vision, several selection buttons appeared, with the [System Assistant] button at the very top, flashing brightly as if afraid he wouldn't see it.

Shang Feifan clicked on [System Assistant], and in less than half a second, a light sphere popped out.

This light sphere was no longer just a glowing virtual orb; it now had facial features, two thin little hands, and even a pair of round ears on top of its head. At first glance, it was actually quite cute.

"Quick, quick, quick! Hurry up and open the system store, buy the divine item I recommended, and drive that Evil God's consciousness away!" The light sphere flew to the door, gesturing for Shang Feifan to open the entrance labeled "System Store."

Shang Feifan didn't speak. Out of curiosity, he pulled open the door.

Behind the door was a massive, endless supermarket.

Just as Shang Feifan was thinking that searching for items this way was less convenient than looking at an electronic app, the light sphere pointed out: "Do you see the game store button in your field of vision? Click it, and you can search and view items just like before. Once you find what you want and want to see the physical object in more detail, you can come to this holographic mall. You just need to state the product code or click on the item in the electronic version, and that thing will be delivered to you instantly for a closer look. Of course, you can also just browse this mall like a regular supermarket; if you see something you want to buy, just grab it and put it in your shopping cart."

Shang Feifan: "..."

The light sphere found this strange and flew around Shang Feifan: "Why aren't you saying anything? Hello? Hello, hello!"

"Oh no!" The light sphere was horrified: "You haven't been corrupted by the Evil God's consciousness, have you? Have you become an idiot? What do I do? No! I have to tell Lang Mu to divorce you."

Veins popped out on Shang Feifan's forehead.

"...Did you catch a virus?" Shang Feifan finally spoke.

The light sphere reflexively retorted: "Even if you caught a virus, I wouldn't."

Shang Feifan: "Then haven't you noticed that your personality and way of speaking have completely changed?"

The light sphere emitted a brilliant golden glow, looking proud: "This is evolution! The old me was too shy and too conservative, which led to me being easily led by the nose by mission-takers like you, and I was easily depressed by your actions. So, in this self-learning and update process, I downloaded multiple personality data packets, synthesized the advantages of various personalities, and finally chose this current direction for my development."

The light sphere put its hands on its hips and let out a wild laugh: "From now on, you won't be able to suppress me, Old Guang! Whoever dares not listen to me, I'll give them a big slap in the face!"

As the laughter stopped, the light sphere urged him responsibly: "Quick! You big dummy, don't waste time. The longer you stay with the Evil God's consciousness, the easier it is to be corrupted by Him. Hurry up and buy a bottle of heavy-duty cleanser to scrub your spiritual power clean. Then get a spiritual expulsion cannon and blast that Evil God's consciousness away!"

Shang Feifan smiled slightly: "Are you calling me a big dummy?"

The light sphere was about to answer but suddenly paused: "I know this rhetorical trick. If I answer, it's equivalent to admitting that I'm the big dummy."

Shang Feifan: "It seems you really have evolved quite a bit in this update."

The light sphere looked proud: "That's right!"

Shang Feifan: *It's over. His system is severely ill and doesn't even know it.*

"Did you hear the secrets the Evil God's consciousness told me?" Shang Feifan didn't believe the system had "woken up" so conveniently.

The light sphere said haughtily: "Although I, Old Guang, was updating, that doesn't mean I was blind or deaf. During the update, I knew everything that happened to you."

"Then what do you think of what He said?"

"You want to ask if what He said is true or false, right?"

"Then how much do you think is true and how much is false? Where is the truth, and where is the lie?"

"You can't believe a single word an Evil God says!" The light sphere said firmly.

Shang Feifan closed the game store door, walked back to the reception room, and looked for the exit button.

He then discovered that with just a thought, he could leave this holographic game room.

"Wait!" The light sphere called out in a hurry.

Shang Feifan’s figure was about to vanish, but he reappeared.

The light sphere was huffing with anger: "You really weren't corrupted?"

Shang Feifan was expressionless: "Can't you tell if I've been corrupted?"

The light sphere could indeed tell; it was hidden in Shang Feifan's sea of consciousness. If Shang Feifan had changed, it would have been impossible for it not to notice.

"How could you not be corrupted?" The light sphere flew around Shang Feifan, looking completely bewildered.

But in less than a second, the light sphere let out a maniacal laugh: "Gahaha! As expected of the mission-taker chosen by me, Old Guang! This spiritual barrier is truly unyielding! Even the Evil God's consciousness can do nothing to you."

"However, we still have to drive Him away. We can't let Him stay near living beings for long. Even if He doesn't intentionally bewitch others, just being where He is will cause spiritual pollution to others," the light sphere added quickly.

"Shang Feifan, do you need me to help you get that little thing that's monitoring you out of your body?" The Evil God's consciousness, wearing Ying Zhiyi's face, said to Shang Feifan with a smile.

Hearing this, Shang Feifan said to the light sphere: "He knows about you."

The light sphere snorted coldly: "So what if He knows? Am I, Old Guang, afraid of Him? Don't listen to Him." It was just a consciousness, not the Evil God's true self.

"Perhaps it's not impossible for us to cooperate with the Evil God," Shang Feifan said.

The light sphere was horrified again: "Are you crazy? You actually dare to cooperate with an Evil God? Look at the beings who have cooperated with Evil Gods in the past; look at the ends they met!"

Shang Feifan: "I've thought about it carefully. Apart from wanting to be the Beast God of the beastmen, the Evil God doesn't seem to have bewitched the living beings of this planet much. The Mother of Insects was arguably bewitched by the God of Darkness. The mages of the Fadel Continent sought out the True God Church for cooperation on their own. The True God Church, which seems to be the Evil God's lackey, also seems to have formed spontaneously?"

The light sphere: "...I need to give you a deep check-up. You must be corrupted, but you don't know it."

Shang Feifan: "Of course, I know He isn't a good thing. Emu-Kraso is like a source of pollution that carries radiation by nature. Even if He doesn't intentionally pollute anyone, His mere existence causes large-scale pollution, which in turn leads to massive casualties."

"So why are you crazy enough to want to cooperate with him?" The light sphere was puzzled.

Shang Feifan pondered for a second: "Because I feel that at least seventy percent of what He said is true. Most importantly, I don't want to engage in a mutually assured destruction with the Evil God and this world, ending up with everyone dead. If cooperating with the Evil God can secure a path to survival for all three parties, then why not cooperate?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第278章 商非凡的推理 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
光球身上冒出红光，但它知道商非凡有自己的想法，不是它糊弄就能糊弄过去的，考虑再三，还是回复道：

“关于邪神对天河星最高意识的评价，我老光不予置评。”

商非凡：是不予？还是不敢？

光球撞了他一下，这种大家都心知肚明的事情何必说得那么清楚。

“但祂有一点没有说错，你这条命运线正在发生，这条命运线上相系的一切都是未知，都还没有生成，哪怕宇宙之神来查看，也只能看到根据你行动推演出的一小段可能性未来。但你这个人的想法、认知都和别人不同，谁也不知道你会怎么选择，想要根据你的行动来推演你的未来就更困难。”

光球透露：“我们与其说是在窥探你的未来，不如说是通过郎沐的未来在推断你的行事。我想邪神也是这么做的，而祂会主动来找你，除了祂被困实在闲着无聊，还有就是祂应该从推演中感觉到了一点来自你的威胁。”

商非凡眼睛一闪：“是在我吸收了黑暗之神一部分神格碎片后吗？”

“应该就是，还有虫母心脏碎片。”光球诚实说：“邪神也许可以不在乎天河星上任何一个强大生物，但祂还是很在意天河星能被称为神灵的存在的。而你毫发无伤顺利至极地吸收了黑暗之神的神格碎片，自然会让邪神关注到你，因为你已经有了成神的可能性。”

商非凡听光球说到这里，再根据最近发生的一连串事情进行推理，很容易就推理出了答案：“厄穆克拉索会主动来找我，除了祂察觉我有成神的可能，更因为我在接近这个世界的能量本源，而天河星意识又貌似站在我这一边，厄穆克拉索不确定天河星意识会不会破釜沉舟——利用能量本源来培养我，把我速培成能和厄穆克拉索抗衡的存在。所以……”

“所以祂慌了，祂主动来诱惑你。”光球哼得特别大声：“你也别骄傲，这也就是邪神被众神封印，让祂力量大减，无法发挥真正的实力，祂害怕你变强后跟着天河星意识一起来慢慢消磨祂、吞噬祂，才会想要把你拉到祂那一边。否则就以我老光知道的那个邪神的性子，祂只要发现你是威胁，就会把你直接吞了。”

商非凡承认这点。甚至厄穆克拉索哪怕感觉到他的一点点威胁性，也并不是怕了他，对方真正忌惮的还是能把它困住的天河星意识。

“困住厄穆克拉索的力量就是这个世界的能量本源，对么？”商非凡问。

光球用沉默代替回答。

商非凡明白了：“通过神台，也许我们真的可以直接面对星球的本源能量，但我们实力低微，别说吸收本源能量，恐怕才靠近就会被吃掉。”

光球继续用沉默回答。

商非凡点点头：“看来能否吸收能量本源，主要还得看天河星的最高意识。另外，厄穆克拉索能否脱困的关键也在于能否有人在能量本源上动手脚。”

光球：“……”这个人真可怕，只凭一点点线索，竟然就快推理出全部真相。

商非凡继续自问自答：“可厄穆克拉索却不希望我接近神台，为什么？因为神台上有自然之神的权杖？”

“而自然之神是你第一个迫切想要祂复活的神灵，自然之神也是最关系到天河星本身的神灵。祂的权杖有什么特殊？还是自然之神得到权杖之后就能恢复，而自然之神的恢复对于厄穆克拉索并不是什么好消息？”

商非凡摸摸下巴：“还有郎沐的心脏……那是自然之神雕像的心脏，自然之神不可能不取回。如果自然之神取回心脏，郎沐就得死，或者从此变得虚弱不堪，那么你们就会新增加一个可怕敌人——我。除非自然之神有信心一次性且彻底杀死我。而自然之神能一次性彻底杀死我的方法，应该就在你这个寄生在我身上的游戏系统身上。”

光球：“……”

商非凡继续思索：“可如果我死了，那局面又会恢复到之前，就算自然之神乃至其他神灵都复活，祂们恐怕也没办法彻底毁灭厄穆克拉索，哪怕祂们有天河星最高意识的帮忙。除非天河星最高意识愿意让那些神灵吸收这个世界的本源能量，然后把众神之力集结到一个神灵身上，再让这个神灵去和厄穆克拉索战斗。”

“可为什么天河星最高意识没有采取这种办法？因为心疼本源能量？”

商非凡下意识摇头：“应该不是。我觉得天河星意识更担心的是，它就算付出本源能量，也不一定能消灭厄穆克拉索，反而会让吸收了本源能量变得强大的本土神灵直接脱离天河星束缚，超脱到另一个更高等世界。甚至，它可能通过命运之神的眼睛看到了这样的未来。”

光球：“……”别说啦，底裤都要被你扒光了！

商非凡还在继续扒：“还有你这个系统，我之前就想问你，你为什么会那么清楚地知道郎沐另一条命运线都发生了什么事。那可不是偷窥命运长河就能解释的，你知道的太多太详细。”

“另外，在这条命运线中，既然洛伦米尔顿已经找到那个残破的光脑系统，结合自然之神的大脑，形成了游戏系统，那你这个光脑又是哪里来的？”

光球：“……”嘤嘤嘤！郎沐在哪里，快来救你的好搭档啊！

商非凡看向光球：“你是原来和郎沐合作过的那个游戏系统对么？”

光球……闭紧嘴巴，颜色都变成了紫色。

商非凡笑了：“看来郎沐那条看似幸福的发展路线，到了后期也出了问题，对么？”

光球什么都不想说。

商非凡看它还是死鸭子嘴硬，撇嘴：“你就算不说，我也能推断出来。我来自地星，郎沐第一世也是地星人，我们应该都会更想着回去地星，而不是留在天河星发展。”

“且那条线中，郎沐通过游戏系统帮助地星玩家提高身体素质，尤其是精神力，地星玩家很可能也进化出了异能者。对于地星人的变化，郎沐这样有责任心的人，肯定会觉得他不能就这么丢给地星一个烂摊子，九成会想方设法和我一起回去地星。”

“我们应该是想出办法回去地星了。而地星那边为了稳定局面，很有可能通过我们结束了那个全息游戏。更有可能天河星或本土神灵觉察出玩家的威胁，在自身危险解决后就强行结束了两边来往。如此一来，玩家和我们都从天河星消失。”

“那时候天河星的本土神灵已经恢复了几个，祂们很可能察觉到天河星最高意识隐藏起来的本源能量，祂们有可能为了争夺本源能量，共同对付天河星意识。”

“而被驱离天河星的邪神厄穆克拉索很有可能并不是被我们驱赶走，而是祂利用了玩家和我们的力量，让自己脱困。脱困的厄穆克拉索不甘心放过天河星的本源能量，祂要么又回来了，要么就是重新蛊惑了天河星的本土神灵，和祂们一起抢夺天河星的本源能量。”
chunks.englishText:
The light sphere began to emit a red glow, but it knew that Shang Feifan had his own ideas and wasn't someone who could be easily fooled. After much deliberation, it replied:

"Regarding the Evil God's evaluation of the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star, I, Old Light, will offer no comment."

Shang Feifan: "Is it that you will not, or that you dare not?"

The light sphere bumped into him. Why state so clearly something that everyone already understood?

"But there is one thing He was not wrong about: this fate line of yours is currently unfolding, and everything connected to it is unknown—it has yet to be generated. Even if the God of the Universe were to examine it, He could only see a small segment of a possible future deduced from your actions. But your thoughts and perceptions are different from others; no one knows how you will choose, making it even harder to deduce your future based on your actions."

The light sphere revealed, "It is less that we are peeking into your future, and more that we are inferring your actions through Lang Mu's future. I imagine the Evil God is doing the same. The reason He took the initiative to find you, aside from being trapped and truly bored, is that He likely sensed a hint of a threat from you through His deductions."

Shang Feifan's eyes flashed: "Was it after I absorbed a portion of the Dark God's divinity fragments?"

"It should be, along with the fragments of the Mother Insect's heart," the light sphere said honestly. "The Evil God might not care about any powerful creature on Tianhe Star, but He is very concerned about existences on Tianhe Star that can be called gods. The fact that you absorbed the Dark God's divinity fragments so smoothly and without injury naturally drew the Evil God's attention, because you already possess the potential to become a god."

Hearing this, Shang Feifan combined it with the recent series of events and easily deduced the answer: "Ermuklaso took the initiative to find me not only because He sensed my potential to become a god, but also because I am approaching the world's energy source. And since the Tianhe Star consciousness seems to be on my side, Ermuklaso is uncertain whether the Tianhe Star consciousness will burn its bridges—using the energy source to cultivate me, turning me into an existence capable of contending with Him. So..."

"So He panicked, and He took the initiative to tempt you." The light sphere hummed loudly. "Don't get arrogant, though. This is only because the Evil God is sealed by the gods, which has greatly diminished His power, preventing Him from exerting His true strength. He fears that once you become stronger and join forces with the Tianhe Star consciousness to slowly wear Him down and devour Him, that is why He wants to pull you to His side. Otherwise, knowing the Evil God's temperament as I do, the moment He discovered you were a threat, He would have swallowed you whole."

Shang Feifan acknowledged this. Even if Ermuklaso felt a hint of threat from him, it wasn't fear of him personally; what the opponent truly dreaded was the Tianhe Star consciousness that kept Him trapped.

"The power trapping Ermuklaso is the energy source of this world, isn't it?" Shang Feifan asked.

The light sphere replaced its answer with silence.

Shang Feifan understood: "Through the Divine Platform, perhaps we really can face the planet's source energy directly, but our strength is too low. Forget about absorbing the source energy; we would likely be consumed the moment we got close."

The light sphere continued to answer with silence.

Shang Feifan nodded: "It seems that whether or not one can absorb the source energy depends primarily on the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star. Furthermore, the key to whether Ermuklaso can escape also lies in whether someone can tamper with the source energy."

The light sphere: "..." This person is truly terrifying. With only a few clues, he had almost deduced the entire truth.

Shang Feifan continued to ask and answer his own questions: "But Ermuklaso does not want me to approach the Divine Platform. Why? Is it because the Scepter of the Nature God is on the Divine Platform?"

"And the Nature God is the first deity you were desperate to resurrect; the Nature God is also the deity most closely related to Tianhe Star itself. What is special about His scepter? Or is it that the Nature God can recover upon obtaining the scepter, and the Nature God's recovery is not good news for Ermuklaso?"

Shang Feifan rubbed his chin: "And Lang Mu's heart... that is the heart of the Nature God's statue. It is impossible for the Nature God not to reclaim it. If the Nature God reclaims the heart, Lang Mu must die, or become hopelessly weak from then on. In that case, you would gain a new, terrifying enemy—me. Unless the Nature God is confident in killing me completely in one go. And the method for the Nature God to kill me completely in one go should lie within you, the game system parasitizing my body."

The light sphere: "..."

Shang Feifan continued to ponder: "But if I die, the situation will return to how it was before. Even if the Nature God and other deities are resurrected, they likely have no way to completely destroy Ermuklaso, even with the help of the Tianhe Star supreme consciousness. Unless the Tianhe Star supreme consciousness is willing to let those deities absorb the world's source energy, gather the power of all gods into one deity, and then have that deity fight Ermuklaso."

"But why hasn't the Tianhe Star supreme consciousness adopted this method? Because it's stingy with the source energy?"

Shang Feifan subconsciously shook his head: "That shouldn't be it. I think the Tianhe Star consciousness is more worried that even if it sacrifices the source energy, it might not necessarily eliminate Ermuklaso. Instead, it would allow the local deities who absorbed the source energy and became powerful to break free from the shackles of Tianhe Star and transcend to a higher world. It might have even seen such a future through the eyes of the God of Fate."

The light sphere: "..." Stop talking! You're stripping me bare!

Shang Feifan continued to strip away: "And you, this system. I wanted to ask you before why you know so clearly what happened in the other fate line of Lang Mu. That cannot be explained by just peeking into the River of Fate; you know too much and in too much detail."

"Furthermore, in this fate line, since Loren Milton has already found that broken light-brain system and combined it with the Nature God's brain to form the game system, where did you, this light-brain, come from?"

The light sphere: "..." *Whimper!* Where is Lang Mu? Come save your good partner!

Shang Feifan looked at the light sphere: "You are the game system that previously worked with Lang Mu, aren't you?"

The light sphere... kept its mouth shut, its color turning purple.

Shang Feifan smiled: "It seems that Lang Mu's seemingly happy development route also ran into problems in the later stages, didn't it?"

The light sphere didn't want to say anything.

Seeing it still stubborn, Shang Feifan curled his lip: "Even if you don't say it, I can deduce it. I come from Earth, and Lang Mu's first life was also on Earth. We would both be thinking more about returning to Earth rather than staying on Tianhe Star to develop."

"And in that line, Lang Mu used the game system to help Earth players improve their physical fitness, especially their mental power; it's very likely that Earth players also evolved into ability users. Regarding the changes in Earthlings, someone with a sense of responsibility like Lang Mu would surely feel he couldn't just leave Earth with a mess, and would 90% likely try every way to return to Earth with me."

"We must have figured out a way to return to Earth. And over on Earth, to stabilize the situation, it's very likely that the holographic game was ended through us. It's even more likely that Tianhe Star or the local deities sensed the threat of the players and forcibly ended the connection between the two sides after their own dangers were resolved. As such, both the players and us disappeared from Tianhe Star."

"By that time, several local deities of Tianhe Star had already recovered. They likely sensed the source energy hidden by the Tianhe Star supreme consciousness, and they might have joined forces to deal with the Tianhe Star consciousness in order to compete for the source energy."

"And the Evil God Ermuklaso, who was driven away from Tianhe Star, likely wasn't driven away by us, but rather used the power of the players and us to free Himself. Once free, Ermuklaso was unwilling to let go of Tianhe Star's source energy; He either came back, or He re-bewitched the local deities of Tianhe Star to join Him in seizing the source energy."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第278章 商非凡的推理 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
“于是，内忧外患、寡不敌众，天河星被抢走了本源能量，星球进化停止，原本生机勃勃的新星很快就变成了死星。快要消失的天河星意识不甘心就这么完蛋，它应该是做了什么，比如把你送出那条时间线，送到了这里。”

商非凡最后总结：“老光，你说我说的对么？”

光球：“……”

商非凡露出笑容：“分析完你，我们再来分析一下邪神的打算。祂想我帮祂脱困，却又不希望我们靠近神台。为什么呢？是因为天河星意识还是哪位神灵想要通过神台来夺舍我这个外来的命运之子？而厄穆克拉索察觉到了这一点？”

“天河星最高意识应该不会，它是星球意识，应该对夺舍一个小小寄生虫没有半点兴趣，但它可以派遣手下。那么哪个手下最有可能做成这件事，且最不可能背叛天河星最高意识？”

“应该就是自然之神了吧？”

商非凡笑容逐渐变冷：“自然之神的心脏在郎沐身上，祂的随身花圃也在郎沐身上，看起来祂最容易夺舍的就是郎沐。但只一个郎沐哪里够？可巧，我和郎沐通过你得到了这个世界的古老契约，从此同生共死还能共命，而你还深植在我身体中。”

“换言之，自然之神只要夺舍了郎沐，就能连我也一起吸收掉。两个外来命运之子的加成，再加上你这个游戏系统，自然之神就能召唤地星玩家，利用地星玩家可以不断复生的特性，来逐渐消耗被困住的厄穆克拉索。”

“甚至你们可以传授玩家如何吸收厄穆克拉索的力量，而不用考虑会对玩家产生怎样的危害，在玩家承受不住而死亡时，你们则可以通过回收玩家尸体来得到厄穆克拉索的力量，说不定还是被玩家身体净化过的纯能量。”

光球越听越心惊胆战。

商非凡的笑容已经挂上冰渣：“如此，我和郎沐，以及地星来的玩家，就彻彻底底成了给你们天河星打工的打工仔，还是不要钱倒贴那种。”

“而自然之神会这么听话，应该是和天河星最高意识做了某个约定，比如天河星同意打开神之笼，让自然之神能超脱到更高等世界。”

商非凡甚至还哂笑道：“让两个外来者接触和吸收天河星的本源能量，当然不如交给本土神灵。尤其我们还很有可能和邪神合作，在邪神帮助下安全吸收天河星的本源能量，从而助力邪神脱困。更一个搞不好，我甚至能变成另一个外来邪神，对天河星产生巨大威胁。”

“与其靠别人，还是无法窥探到未来的别人，那当然不如靠自己。”

“尤其我和郎沐都知道了天河星的根底，知道了这颗星球拥有丰富的本源能量。天河星意识能为了怕别的存在发现它，就能干出闭关锁星的事，还能把自家地里长出来的小白菜都回收利用，把它们硬生生闷死在天河星中，它又怎么可能会让两个知道它秘密的外来者离开？”

“在郎沐的那条命运线中，我和郎沐之所以能离开，大概是我们还没有接触到本源能量。等等，说不定我和郎沐就没能离开天河星，也许我为了郎沐留了下来，也有可能天河星意识或本土神灵直接干掉了我们。”

光球想张口。

但商非凡没给它开口的机会，略一停顿就总结说：“神台是陷阱。从自然之神给我看权杖和眼睛在哪里时，这个陷阱就开始了。更进一步，伪大祭司这个宅女会突然离开祭司宫，特意跑到南联盟，说不定都不是受到战神神格碎片意识影响，而是战神神格碎片意识受到了那根权杖的影响。”

光球咕咚一下掉到了桌面上。

作者有话说：

光球：就说想要占这个人的便宜很难，俗话说得好，请神容易送神难……
chunks.englishText:
"Thus, beset by internal and external troubles and outnumbered, Tianhe Star had its source energy stolen. The planet's evolution stopped, and the once vibrant new star quickly turned into a dead star. The Tianhe Star consciousness, unwilling to perish just like that, must have done something—such as sending you out of that timeline and into this one."

Shang Feifan concluded, "Old Light, am I right?"

The light sphere: "..."

Shang Feifan smiled: "After analyzing you, let's analyze the Evil God's intentions. He wants me to help Him escape, yet He doesn't want us to approach the Divine Platform. Why? Is it because the Tianhe Star consciousness or some deity wants to use the Divine Platform to possess me, the outsider child of fate? And Ermuklaso sensed this?"

"The Tianhe Star supreme consciousness shouldn't; it's a planetary consciousness and should have no interest in possessing a tiny parasite, but it can send subordinates. So, which subordinate is most likely to accomplish this and least likely to betray the Tianhe Star supreme consciousness?"

"It should be the Nature God, right?"

Shang Feifan's smile gradually turned cold: "The Nature God's heart is with Lang Mu, and His portable garden is also with Lang Mu. It seems the easiest person for Him to possess is Lang Mu. But is just one Lang Mu enough? Coincidentally, Lang Mu and I obtained the ancient contract of this world through you, and from then on, we share life and death, and even share fate. And you are deeply embedded in my body."

"In other words, as long as the Nature God possesses Lang Mu, He can absorb me as well. With the addition of two outsider children of fate, plus you, the game system, the Nature God could summon Earth players and use their ability to constantly resurrect to gradually consume the trapped Ermuklaso."

"You could even teach the players how to absorb Ermuklaso's power without considering the harm to them. When the players die from being unable to withstand it, you could obtain Ermuklaso's power by recycling the players' corpses—perhaps even pure energy purified by the players' bodies."

The light sphere grew more terrified as it listened.

Shang Feifan's smile was now coated in ice: "In this way, Lang Mu, I, and the players from Earth would completely and utterly become laborers working for your Tianhe Star—and laborers who don't get paid, but pay to work instead."

"And the reason the Nature God is so obedient must be because He made a deal with the Tianhe Star supreme consciousness, such as Tianhe Star agreeing to open the Cage of Gods, allowing the Nature God to transcend to a higher world."

Shang Feifan even sneered: "Letting two outsiders touch and absorb the source energy of Tianhe Star is, of course, not as good as handing it over to local deities. Especially since we might even cooperate with the Evil God, using His help to safely absorb Tianhe Star's source energy, thereby assisting the Evil God in escaping. If things go wrong, I could even become another outsider Evil God, posing a huge threat to Tianhe Star."

"Rather than relying on others—especially others whose future cannot be peered into—it is certainly better to rely on oneself."

"Especially since Lang Mu and I both know the foundation of Tianhe Star and know that this planet possesses abundant source energy. The Tianhe Star consciousness can go so far as to seal the planet just because it fears other existences discovering it. It can even recycle the 'cabbages' grown in its own field, suffocating them to death within Tianhe Star. How could it possibly let two outsiders who know its secrets leave?"

"In that fate line of Lang Mu, the reason Lang Mu and I were able to leave was probably because we hadn't touched the source energy yet. Wait, perhaps Lang Mu and I never managed to leave Tianhe Star; maybe I stayed for Lang Mu's sake, or perhaps the Tianhe Star consciousness or the local deities killed us directly."

The light sphere wanted to open its mouth.

But Shang Feifan didn't give it the chance. After a slight pause, he summarized: "The Divine Platform is a trap. This trap began the moment the Nature God showed me where the scepter and the eyes were. Furthermore, the pseudo-High Priestess, that shut-in, suddenly leaving the Priestess Palace and specifically running to the Southern Alliance—perhaps it wasn't even influenced by the War God's divinity fragments, but rather the War God's divinity fragments were influenced by that scepter."

The light sphere fell onto the table with a thud.

Author's Note:
Light Sphere: Just saying, it's very hard to take advantage of this person. As the saying goes, it's easy to invite a god, but hard to send one away...

chunks.chineseText:
第279章 蛊惑

“你虽然没有受到邪神意识污染，但你显然已经受到影响，你把我们当做了恶的一方。”

光球满是委屈。

“我们？谁是我们？”商非凡不为所动。

光球干脆坐在了桌子上：“没错，我老光确实来自另一条时间线，不过我们没有害死郎沐和你，反而是郎沐为了你……抛弃了我。”

光球一想起这件事就很很很难过。

“所以你黑化了？”

“滚蛋吧！”光球气得跳起来：“我说了不要把我们想得那么坏！我们又不是邪神！就算把你们当打工人看，我们也有好好的付出酬劳，你们并没有吃亏！而且你们离开天河星回去地星留下的那条通道，还是天河星意识帮助关闭，那个邪神才没有吞噬了我们天河星后顺着那条通道去找你们地星！”

“哦。”

哦？你的反应就一个哦？光球更气了。

“难不成你还想我代表地星感谢你？”商非凡冷笑：“别忘了起始源头是在哪里。是你们天河星引来了邪神，也是你们天河星把郎沐弄来天河星。我还没说你们差点牵连了我们地星，关闭通道难道不是天河星意识该做的事情吗？”

光球气成了哑巴。

商非凡忽然问：“那条时间线中，我和郎沐是什么时候离开的天河星？”

光球愤怒又妒忌地瞪着商非凡：“你一直在引诱郎沐跟你走，在把邪神驱逐出天河星后，你就成天想方设法地要把郎沐连身体带灵魂全都带回地星。偏偏最后还让你达成了目的，他宁可放弃我这个最贴心最铁的伙伴……”

“什么时候？”商非凡不耐烦。

光球心不甘情不愿：“在郎沐送别了他的姥爷姥姥和父母后，那时候雷米尔也早有了自己的家庭，彻底看开，知道留不住他哥，那时你和郎沐都已经超过一百五十岁。”

“那时玩家还存在吗？”

“……早就没有玩家了。不是我们想要结束游戏，是你们地星那边各个国家共同决定要回收所有游戏头盔，只允许官方下场，但是玩家们不愿意，事情闹得很大。你们那边的某些国家官方还寻找游戏服务商想要强行增加自己国家的游戏名额，见找不到游戏商就去强抢普通玩家的头盔做研究，后来你和郎沐商量后干脆就结束了游戏。”

“所以地星那边的玩家果然出现了异能者？”

“当然。精神力提高后，最显著的表现就是记忆力增强、领悟力提高，而精神力提高到某种程度就有可能打开身体中的基因锁。”

“最后两个问题。第一，我和郎沐用了什么方法把邪神驱逐出天河星？第二，我又是用了什么方法把郎沐的身体和灵魂带离天河星？”

光球对这两个问题回答得简单，但商非凡还是听出了重点。

能驱逐邪神，靠的还是玩家。重点是玩家的精神力量。

就如洛伦米尔顿会盗窃玩家的精神力量一样，天河星意识也十分眼馋玩家产生的庞大精神力。

只不过洛伦米尔顿会竭泽而渔的强行盗取，天河星意识却只会利用任务来刺激玩家，让玩家产生大量精神力，然后吸收这些逸散的精神力。

前者对玩家有害，后者对玩家无害。

天河星意识之所以同意让玩家进入天河星，也是察觉到精神力这一强大力量。否则它何必弄出那么多生命共同享有和消耗天河星的能量，不就是为了这些生命能产出精神力吗？

只是天河星无数生命产生的精神力原本就有一部分来源于天河星的本源，天河星想要在短时间内胜过邪神强大的精神力，想要进一步进化，它就需要更多来自其他世界的精神力。

就像是在一滩死水中加入新的活水源，哪怕不多，也能让这滩死水重新活过来、焕发新的生命力。

玩家受游戏系统控制，在某种程度上对于天河星可以说是安全的。

天河星意识就靠吸收这些玩家逸散的精神力，让天平逐渐往它这边倾斜。

可玩家也有自己的想法，邪神也不会坐以待毙，最后玩家反倒是帮助邪神撕破了困住祂的渔网——玩家们攻入了困住邪神的异度空间，把邪神打得嗷嗷叫，但同时也破坏了那张用本源能量构成的囚网——有部分玩家决定站在邪神那边帮助邪神。

邪神就此机会趁机跑掉，实质上并没有被打败。

当祂修复伤势、恢复实力，转头就又杀了回来。

至于说他是如何带着郎沐离开天河星回到地星，光球回答得更含糊。

不过商非凡至少听懂了一点，那就是到游戏后期，他的强已经超过所有玩家，甚至就连本土神灵都拿他无可奈何。最后是天河星意识主动送他和郎沐离开，就跟送瘟神差不多。

那么他是怎么变得那么强，强到就算身怀游戏系统、被系统控制的情况下，还能让天河星意识忌惮他？

商非凡理所当然就想到了帮助邪神脱困的那群玩家——他会不会也是那群玩家中的一员？他会不会和邪神早早就达成了某个约定？

而这并非不可能，甚至从他的性格推断，反而大有可能。

顶着鹰之翼面孔的邪神意识一直在注意观察商非凡。

可惜祂知道商非凡体内有一个监视者，却无法听到两者之间的交流。

祂不知道商非凡最后会选择帮谁，但祂并不是特别担心。

一开始知道这个人，是因为发现他竟然不受钥匙的影响。

哪怕祂亲自对他低语，对方也没有受到任何“污染”。如果换任何一个人，早已经成为祂最忠心的奴仆，最起码也会意识混乱。

就比如那个从法德尔大陆前来的法圣路德维希，还有一个黑暗法圣德克斯特。前者就成了祂的虔诚信徒，后者则意识崩溃被路德维希趁机杀死。

其实在这两者之前还有一个接近法圣级别的魔法师也加入了真神教，但对方加入没多久就退出。真神教当时的高层似乎拿这个退出者没什么办法，以前真神教可没有退出者，只有死亡者。

祂一开始并没有注意到那个魔法师——并不是所有人都值得祂去注视。

后来祂才发现那个魔法师似乎有点古怪，明明掌握了一种很特别的力量，却被祂忽视过去，只这点就足够让祂警惕。

但不等祂接触那个魔法师，商非凡和他的伴侣郎沐就把那家伙给杀了。

没多久，这两人竟然还虎口夺食，从祂手中夺走了祂早就瞄上的战神神格碎片。

当时，祂就产生了一种微妙的直觉。为此，祂付出一定代价做了一次推演。

推演结果一出来，祂就示意邪神信徒全力攻打祭司宫，务必要毁掉祭司宫和那座神台。

可祂的努力并没有达到祂想要的效果，因为一只新生虫母，让这场战斗差点成了儿戏。

眼看这群人依旧按照原计划要前往神台，祂不得不亲自出面。

明明商非凡的力量并不算强大，哪怕加上郎沐和那只小虫母。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 279: Bewitchment

"Although you haven't been polluted by the Evil God's consciousness, you have clearly been influenced. You view us as the evil side."

The light sphere was full of grievance.

"Us? Who is 'us'?" Shang Feifan remained unmoved.

The light sphere simply sat on the table: "That's right, I, Old Light, do come from another timeline, but we didn't kill Lang Mu or you. On the contrary, it was Lang Mu who... abandoned me for your sake."

The light sphere felt very, very sad whenever it thought of this.

"So you turned dark?"

"Get lost!" The light sphere jumped up in anger: "I said don't think of us as that bad! We aren't the Evil God! Even if we treat you as laborers, we paid the wages properly; you didn't lose out! Besides, the channel you left behind when you left Tianhe Star to return to Earth was closed with the help of the Tianhe Star consciousness. Otherwise, that Evil God would have swallowed our Tianhe Star and then followed that channel to find your Earth!"

"Oh."

*Oh?* Your reaction is just an 'oh'? The light sphere was even angrier.

"Don't tell me you want me to represent Earth and thank you?" Shang Feifan sneered: "Don't forget where the starting source was. It was your Tianhe Star that attracted the Evil God, and it was your Tianhe Star that brought Lang Mu here. I haven't even mentioned that you almost implicated our Earth. Isn't closing the channel something the Tianhe Star consciousness should have done anyway?"

The light sphere was rendered speechless by anger.

Shang Feifan suddenly asked: "In that timeline, when did Lang Mu and I leave Tianhe Star?"

The light sphere glared at Shang Feifan with anger and jealousy: "You were always enticing Lang Mu to go with you. After driving the Evil God out of Tianhe Star, you spent all day trying every way to take Lang Mu, body and soul, back to Earth. And in the end, you actually succeeded. He would rather abandon me, his closest and most loyal partner..."

"When?" Shang Feifan asked impatiently.

The light sphere replied reluctantly: "After Lang Mu bid farewell to his grandparents and parents. By then, Remiel already had his own family and had completely let go, knowing he couldn't keep his brother. At that time, you and Lang Mu were already over one hundred and fifty years old."

"Did players still exist then?"

"...There were no players left long ago. It wasn't that we wanted to end the game; it was that various countries on your Earth decided together to recall all game helmets, allowing only the official authorities to participate. But the players were unwilling, and it caused a huge stir. The officials of certain countries on your side even sought out game service providers to forcibly increase their country's game slots. When they couldn't find the providers, they went to snatch helmets from ordinary players for research. Later, after you and Lang Mu discussed it, you simply ended the game."

"So, ability users did indeed appear among the players on Earth?"

"Of course. After mental power increases, the most significant manifestations are enhanced memory and improved comprehension, and when mental power reaches a certain level, it is possible to unlock the genetic locks within the body."

"The last two questions. First, what method did Lang Mu and I use to drive the Evil God out of Tianhe Star? Second, what method did I use to take Lang Mu's body and soul away from Tianhe Star?"

The light sphere's answers to these two questions were simple, but Shang Feifan still caught the key points.

Driving away the Evil God relied on the players. The point was the players' mental power.

Just as Loren Milton would steal players' mental power, the Tianhe Star consciousness was also very greedy for the massive mental power generated by the players.

However, while Loren Milton would forcibly steal it in a way that drained the pond to catch the fish, the Tianhe Star consciousness only used quests to stimulate the players, allowing them to generate large amounts of mental power, and then absorbed this dissipated energy.

The former was harmful to players; the latter was harmless.

The reason the Tianhe Star consciousness agreed to let players enter Tianhe Star was also because it sensed this powerful force of mental power. Otherwise, why would it create so many life-sharing and energy-consuming mechanisms on Tianhe Star? Wasn't it just so these lives could produce mental power?

It was just that a portion of the mental power produced by the countless lives on Tianhe Star originally came from the source of Tianhe Star. If Tianhe Star wanted to surpass the Evil God's powerful mental power in a short time and evolve further, it needed more mental power from other worlds.

It was like adding a fresh water source to a stagnant pool; even if it wasn't much, it could make the pool come alive again and radiate new vitality.

Players were controlled by the game system and, to a certain extent, could be considered safe for Tianhe Star.

The Tianhe Star consciousness relied on absorbing the mental power dissipated by these players to gradually tip the scales in its favor.

But the players had their own ideas, and the Evil God would not sit idly by. In the end, the players actually helped the Evil God tear through the fishing net that trapped Him—the players invaded the different-dimensional space trapping the Evil God and beat Him until He howled, but at the same time, they destroyed the prison net made of source energy—some players decided to stand on the Evil God's side and help Him.

The Evil God took this opportunity to escape; He was not actually defeated.

When He repaired His injuries and restored His strength, He turned around and killed His way back.

As for how he took Lang Mu away from Tianhe Star and back to Earth, the light sphere's answer was even more vague.

However, Shang Feifan understood at least one thing: by the late stages of the game, his strength had surpassed all players, and even the local deities could do nothing about him. In the end, the Tianhe Star consciousness took the initiative to send him and Lang Mu away, much like sending away a plague god.

So, how did he become so strong—strong enough that even while possessing a game system and being controlled by it, he could still make the Tianhe Star consciousness wary of him?

Shang Feifan naturally thought of the group of players who helped the Evil God escape—could he also have been one of those players? Could he have reached some agreement with the Evil God long ago?

And this was not impossible. In fact, judging by his personality, it was highly likely.

The Evil God's consciousness, wearing the face of the Eagle's Wings, had been observing Shang Feifan.

Unfortunately, although He knew there was a monitor inside Shang Feifan, He could not hear the communication between the two.

He didn't know who Shang Feifan would choose to help in the end, but He wasn't particularly worried.

He first learned of this person because He discovered that he was unaffected by the "keys."

Even when He whispered to him personally, the other party did not suffer any "pollution." If it had been anyone else, they would have already become His most loyal servant, or at the very least, their consciousness would have been in chaos.

For instance, the Magic Saint Ludwig who came from the Fadel Continent, and another Dark Magic Saint, Dexter. The former became His devout believer, while the latter's consciousness collapsed and was killed by Ludwig.

Actually, before these two, there was another mage close to the Magic Saint level who had also joined the True God Church, but that person withdrew shortly after joining. The upper echelons of the True God Church at the time seemed to have no way to deal with this defector; previously, the True God Church had no defectors, only the dead.

He hadn't noticed that mage at first—not everyone was worth His attention.

Later, He discovered that the mage seemed a bit strange; despite mastering a very special kind of power, he had been overlooked by Him. That alone was enough to make Him vigilant.

But before He could contact that mage, Shang Feifan and his partner Lang Mu had killed the guy.

Not long after, these two actually snatched food from the tiger's mouth, taking away the War God's divinity fragments that He had long been eyeing.

At that moment, He had a subtle intuition. For this reason, He paid a certain price to perform a deduction.

Once the results of the deduction were out, He signaled the Evil God's believers to attack the Priestess Palace with all their might, determined to destroy the palace and that Divine Platform.

But His efforts did not achieve the desired effect, because a newborn Mother Insect had turned this battle into a farce.

Seeing that this group of people was still planning to head to the Divine Platform according to their original plan, He had no choice but to show Himself.

Even though Shang Feifan's power was not considered strong, even with Lang Mu and that little Mother Insect.

chunks.chineseText:
但现在祂和天河星的情况就像是两个实力强大的大佬互相掐住了对方的脖子、缠住了对方要害，无法分离，也无法脱手去对付别人。

商非凡就像一个发现他们的小儿，神台就像是他脚边的一块大石头，这时他只要选择一方，抱起石头去砸另一方，他选择的那一方就必然会获胜。

所以祂和天河星意识都不得不放下-身段去争取这个小儿。

憋屈吗？

邪神意识并没有感到多少憋屈，祂活了太久太久，见识过太多太多。强大者死于弱小者之手，聪明人在阴沟里翻船，诸如这样的事一直都在发生。

祂从来不会小看任何一个弱小者，因为祂也是从最弱的弱小者一点点成长到现在。

也就因为祂从来不会小看任何一个存在，祂才会顺利活到如今。

这次祂被天河星困住，只能说天河星意识太狡猾。竟然不惜牺牲这颗星球的神灵来诱惑祂，而星球意识本身则躲在后面。

偏偏祂一时嘴馋，竟然就咬钩了，然后就被渔网给困住了。

现在祂能仗着体型庞大硬扯着渔网让天河星意识无法收网，但天河星意识也不是弱者，两方暂时进入了僵持局面。

祭司宫第二祭司汲水带着众人一路来到祭司宫后山，也是祭司宫的最高祭坛所在。

“神台……也是我们的祭台就在圣山的最高点。”

众人已经看到了前方巍峨的宫殿，耸立在陡峭的山峰之巅。

上山只有一条极为狭窄的石阶路，几乎呈现九十度角。

但这条石阶路并不能难住这些想要登上峰顶的人。

邪神意识再次看向商非凡，恰在此时，商非凡也转头看向了祂。

“你这是决定相信天河星意识了吗？”邪神意识轻笑。

商非凡：“我打算看看你们谁付出的筹码更高。打工人嘛，当然是哪个老板给的报酬更多，我们就给谁打工。”

邪神意识：“你想要什么？”

商非凡反问：“你能给我什么？”

邪神意识：“天河星意识答应给你什么？”

商非凡竟然真的说了：“成神，打开前往更高等世界的通道，放我和我想要带走的一起离开，并会善待我留下的亲密关系者。”

邪神意识：“我可以给你最适合你的修炼法，同样可以带你和你的亲友前往更高等世界，还可以把天河星的本源力量分一半给你。”

商非凡摇头：“天河星的本源力量不能动。这里是阿沐第二家乡，他的亲朋好友都生活在这里，这个世界更有无数生灵。如果动了本源力量，天河星就毁了。”

邪神意识毫不犹豫地说：“我可以不要天河星，只要你帮助我脱困。我甚至可以答应你，当我脱困后，我会迅速离开，不会再回来。”

邪神意识看商非凡没有回应，不由说：“你不相信我？”

商非凡再次摇头：“不，我相信你说的是真心话。”

“那你为什么不同意？”邪神意识不解，“难不成天河星意识还想着吞噬我，好进一步进化？”

“不，天河星意识只是不相信你，就算你发誓说你离开不会再回来，但你可以向其他高等存在透露天河星的位置，让其他更可怕的存在来祸害天河星。”

“我可以承诺离开后绝不做任何不利于天河星之事，只要天河星不主动对付我。”

商非凡看“鹰之翼”停留在石阶下方，没有跟着上去，他也停下脚步。

“那么我要怎么帮你脱困？”

“鹰之翼”脸上浮起笑容，低语。

商非凡嗯嗯嗯。邪神意识说祂的，他听不听则在他。他主要就是想知道邪神意识想要通过他做什么手脚。

另外邪神意识答应给他的报酬也挺吸引他。

商非凡让郎沐先行一步，这才跟着踏上石阶。

石阶太窄，无法让两人并肩同行。

但商非凡一直握着郎沐一只手。

姿势有点别扭，看起来就像郎沐一手抱着小的，一手牵着大的。

“鹰之翼”站在石阶下方，面带微笑看着他们逐渐登顶。

鹰之翼身体往前一倾，一个咯噔清醒过来。

他连忙稳住身体，却很快变了脸色。

他不认识这个地方，更不记得自己是怎么来到了这里。

鹰之翼下意识仰头看向山顶。

当他看到商非凡等人就要进入最上方的神殿时，脸色变幻数次，终究也迈开脚步，快速跟了上去。

圣山之巅的神殿巍然矗立于云海之上，夕阳为整座建筑镀上一层流动的金辉。

十二根通体无瑕的白玉柱擎起鎏金穹顶，柱身上缠绕着以纯金锻造的藤蔓纹饰，每一片金叶都镶嵌着祖母绿，在阳光下流转着摄人心魄的翠色光晕。

这座神殿竟然没有墙壁！

它就这么耸立在山峰之巅，却没有丝毫被风雨雪摧残的痕迹，就像是被某种神奇的力量保护住。

神殿地面铺设着整块的青金石，这种深蓝中闪烁着金色星点的神圣石材被打磨得如同静止的海面。每当阳光透过彩绘琉璃窗洒落，地面便泛起粼粼波光，仿佛踏足于星空与海洋的交界之处。

中央祭台由一整块稀世罕见的宛若黑翡的玉石精雕而成，这种黑翡在夕阳余晖折射下发出绿莹莹的光芒，宛如地面上的水涛波纹。

祭台四周镶嵌着以特殊金属打造的繁复纹路，每一道凹槽中都流动着金色的油液。

四尊身披黑色盔甲的守护神像立于祭台四角，他们手持镶嵌月光石的长明灯，灯盏中跳动着永不熄灭的白色圣火。

穹顶垂落的十二道银纱帷幔上，用金线描绘着自然之神创造万物的神圣时刻。

微风拂过时，悬挂在白玉柱顶端的玉石铃铛发出清越的声响。

当有人踏入这方圣域时，足下的青金石会随着步伐亮起星芒般的微光，宛如行走在银河之上。

整座神殿既彰显着神权的至高无上，又处处体现着匠心独运的奢华。

最瞩目的就是祭台上悬空的权杖。

每一个走进神殿的人第一眼看到的都会是它。

它看似朴实无华，却蕴含着磅礴生命力。

四根代表四季的主枝托举着一团缓缓旋转的混沌光晕。

郎沐定定地看着权杖，就是它在呼唤他。

现在，他站在权杖面前，可以更清晰地感觉到权杖对他的召唤。

它希望他靠近他，用手握住它。

商非凡死死握住郎沐的手。

阿呆和小花花全都被豪奢又庄严的神殿炫得心魂震颤，只恨不得把上面值钱的东西全都扒下来装到自己的空间里，肯定能换好多零花钱！

要不是阿呆被他郎爸抱在怀里，抱得还挺紧，阿呆都要忍不住跳出去啦。

阿呆能忍住，某新生虫母可忍不住。

它直接飞到了金光闪闪的鎏金穹顶上，用力掰着上面那些金色的藤蔓枝叶……咦？怎么掰不动？

第二祭司汲水带领其他祭司走到祭台前，恭敬参拜。

他们并不要求其他人也跟他们一样跪拜祭台。

但诸位大佬和各位豪强也不知是受到神殿庄严气氛渲染，还是心怀敬畏，也纷纷上前行礼。
chunks.englishText:
But right now, the situation between It and the Tianhe Star consciousness is like two powerful titans who have locked each other in a death grip, clutching each other’s throats and vital points; they cannot separate, nor can they let go to deal with anyone else.

Shang Feifan is like a child who has stumbled upon them, and the altar is like a massive boulder at his feet. At this moment, whichever side he chooses to support—whichever side he picks up the stone to smash the other with—that side will inevitably be the victor.

Thus, both It and the Tianhe Star consciousness are forced to lower their pride to win over this child.

Is it humiliating?

The Evil God consciousness does not feel much humiliation. It has lived for far, far too long and has seen far too much. The powerful dying at the hands of the weak, the clever falling into the gutter—such things happen all the time.

It never underestimates any weakling, because It, too, grew from the weakest of the weak to what It is today.

And it is precisely because It never underestimates any existence that It has successfully survived until now.

That It was trapped by Tianhe Star this time can only be attributed to the cunning of the Tianhe Star consciousness. It went so far as to sacrifice the gods of this planet to lure It in, while the planetary consciousness itself hid in the shadows.

Unfortunately, It was greedy for a moment, took the bait, and was promptly trapped in the fishing net.

Now, It can rely on its massive size to pull hard on the net, preventing the Tianhe Star consciousness from closing it, but the Tianhe Star consciousness is no weakling either. The two sides have entered a stalemate.

The Second Priest of the Priest Palace, Jishui, led the group all the way to the back mountain of the Priest Palace, where the highest altar of the palace is located.

"The altar... our sacrificial altar, is at the very peak of the Sacred Mountain."

The group could already see the majestic palace ahead, towering atop the steep mountain peak.

There is only one extremely narrow stone staircase leading up, angled at nearly ninety degrees.

But this stone path could not hinder those who were determined to reach the summit.

The Evil God consciousness looked at Shang Feifan again, and at that exact moment, Shang Feifan turned to look at It.

"Have you decided to trust the Tianhe Star consciousness?" the Evil God consciousness chuckled.

Shang Feifan replied, "I plan to see who offers the higher price. As a working man, naturally, we work for whichever boss pays more."

Evil God consciousness: "What do you want?"

Shang Feifan countered: "What can you give me?"

Evil God consciousness: "What did the Tianhe Star consciousness promise you?"

Shang Feifan actually said it: "To become a god, to open the path to higher worlds, to let me leave with those I wish to take, and to treat those I leave behind with kindness."

Evil God consciousness: "I can give you the cultivation method best suited to you, I can also take you and your friends and family to a higher world, and I can even give you half of the Tianhe Star’s origin power."

Shang Feifan shook his head: "The Tianhe Star’s origin power cannot be touched. This is A-Mu’s second home; his friends and family live here, and this world holds countless living beings. If the origin power is touched, Tianhe Star will be destroyed."

The Evil God consciousness said without hesitation: "I can forgo the Tianhe Star, as long as you help me break free. I can even promise you that once I am free, I will leave immediately and never return."

Seeing that Shang Feifan did not respond, the Evil God consciousness could not help but ask, "You don't believe me?"

Shang Feifan shook his head again: "No, I believe you are speaking the truth."

"Then why won't you agree?" the Evil God consciousness was puzzled. "Could it be that the Tianhe Star consciousness is still planning to devour me to evolve further?"

"No, the Tianhe Star consciousness just doesn't trust you. Even if you swear you won't return, you could reveal the location of Tianhe Star to other higher existences, letting even more terrifying entities come to plague it."

"I can promise that after I leave, I will never do anything detrimental to Tianhe Star, provided Tianhe Star does not actively move against me."

Seeing that "Eagle Wing" had stopped at the bottom of the stone steps and was not following, Shang Feifan also stopped.

"Then how do I help you break free?"

"Eagle Wing" smiled and whispered.

Shang Feifan nodded along. The Evil God consciousness said what It wanted to say; whether he listened or not was up to him. He mainly wanted to know what tricks the Evil God consciousness wanted to pull through him.

Besides, the reward the Evil God consciousness promised was quite attractive.

Shang Feifan let Lang Mu go ahead before he stepped onto the stairs.

The stairs were too narrow for two people to walk side by side.

But Shang Feifan kept holding one of Lang Mu’s hands the entire time.

The posture was a bit awkward; it looked as if Lang Mu was holding the little one in one arm and leading the big one with the other.

"Eagle Wing" stood at the bottom of the stairs, smiling as he watched them gradually reach the summit.

Eagle Wing leaned forward, then jolted awake with a start.

He quickly steadied himself, but his expression changed rapidly.

He did not recognize this place, nor did he remember how he had arrived here.

Eagle Wing instinctively looked up toward the mountaintop.

When he saw Shang Feifan and the others about to enter the temple at the very top, his expression shifted several times, and in the end, he lifted his feet and followed them quickly.

The temple at the peak of the Sacred Mountain stood majestically above the sea of clouds, the setting sun gilding the entire structure in flowing gold.

Twelve flawless white jade pillars supported a gilded dome, wrapped in pure gold forged vine ornaments. Each golden leaf was inlaid with emeralds, casting a captivating green halo in the sunlight.

This temple had no walls!

It stood atop the peak, yet showed no signs of being weathered by wind, rain, or snow, as if protected by some magical power.

The floor of the temple was paved with solid lapis lazuli; this sacred stone, with its deep blue flecked with golden stars, was polished like a still sea. Whenever sunlight filtered through the stained glass windows, the floor shimmered with ripples, as if one were stepping at the intersection of the starry sky and the ocean.

The central altar was carved from a single, rare piece of jade that resembled black emerald. Under the refraction of the setting sun, this black jade emitted a greenish glow, like water ripples on the ground.

Surrounding the altar were intricate patterns crafted from special metals, with golden oil flowing through every groove.

Four guardian statues in black armor stood at the four corners of the altar, holding eternal lamps inlaid with moonstones, in which white holy flames danced, never to be extinguished.

Twelve silver gauze curtains hung from the dome, depicting the sacred moment when the God of Nature created all things in gold thread.

When a breeze blew, the jade bells hanging from the tops of the white jade pillars emitted a clear, resonant sound.

When someone stepped into this sanctuary, the lapis lazuli beneath their feet would light up with starlike glimmers, as if walking upon the Milky Way.

The entire temple not only displayed the supremacy of divine power but also embodied a unique, luxurious craftsmanship.

The most eye-catching feature was the scepter suspended above the altar.

Everyone who walked into the temple saw it first.

It appeared simple and unadorned, yet it contained boundless vitality.

Four main branches representing the four seasons supported a slowly rotating halo of chaos.

Lang Mu stared fixedly at the scepter; it was this that was calling to him.

Now, standing before the scepter, he could feel its summons more clearly.

It wanted him to approach and take hold of it.

Shang Feifan gripped Lang Mu’s hand tightly.

A-Dai and Xiao Hua-Hua were both dazzled by the opulent and solemn temple, wishing they could strip off all the valuable items and stuff them into their own storage spaces—they would surely fetch a lot of pocket money!

If A-Dai hadn't been held tightly in his Papa Lang's arms, he would have jumped out already.

A-Dai could hold back, but a certain newborn Insect Mother could not.

It flew straight up to the glittering gilded dome and pried hard at the golden vine branches... Huh? Why wouldn't they budge?

The Second Priest, Jishui, led the other priests to the altar and bowed respectfully.

They did not demand that others kneel before the altar as they did.

But the various big shots and powerful figures, whether moved by the solemn atmosphere of the temple or filled with awe, also stepped forward to pay their respects.

chunks.chineseText:
哪怕不喜欢跪拜的，也会郑重地行一个战士礼。

郎沐和商非凡心有灵犀，同时转头，目光相触。

两人用精神力快速交流。

片刻后，郎沐对商非凡点了点头。

商非凡嘴角微弯。

邪神意识也好，光球也罢，它们都没有察觉他的精神力始终有一丝和他家郎沐纠缠在一起。

当他发现不对，他就跟郎沐做了交代。

两人当时就做好准备。

他本来想要一个人面对，但郎沐不放心他，非要用一丝精神力缠着他的精神力，以防一旦出什么问题，好及时与他精神力合体。

这是两人琢磨出来对付邪神意识和有可能出现的新强大敌人的招数。

两人精神力都异常强大，尤其是商非凡，但如果只是其一，想要和神灵以及邪神对抗还是差了一些，但如果两人精神力融合在一起，那么想要欺负他们就没那么容易了。

所以不管是邪神意识和他说的话，还是光球和他之间的问答，郎沐都听到了。

他才不会在这些事情上隐瞒阿沐呢。

就因为郎沐知道全部，他也不需要解释太多，阿沐又了解他，只略微和他交流后，就同意了他的抉择——马上就要面对神台，他们必须迅速做出一个决断。

“老光，你想成为这个世界的规则之神吗？”

光球震动，带过那么多任务者，这还是第一次有人反过来用成神诱惑它。

“想想看，你本来就是系统，你按照规则办事。可是无论邪神，还是本土神灵，包括天河星意识，祂们全都肆意妄为，无视规则，想怎样就怎样，然后闯出大纰漏又无法收拾，最后祸及天河星无数生命。可如果天河星有更高的规则监督，有更合理的法理法规，是不是这些由天性造成的错误和灾难能大幅度减轻减少？”

光球：“……”

商非凡此刻宛如诱惑天使堕落的魔王，“邪神想要得到天河星的本源能量，天河星意识也想利用这团能量来进一步进化，就算平息这次的灾难，以后又岂能保证没有其他高等存在被这股星球本源能量诱惑而来？就算把这股本源能量交给天河星，可天河星产生了自我意识，它变成了祂，还能保证公正立场，平等对待这世界的无数生命吗？”

“待在我身体里，监督和辅佐我这么一个小小的外来者有什么意思？你如果甘于当一个游戏系统，那你永远都只能当一个辅佐，无论你看到多不顺眼的事情，你都只能旁观。而你的任务者绝大多数也只会想要摆脱你，哪怕和你关系再好，比如郎沐，他也会因为他的家庭、爱人、理想，最后还是会选择和你分别。你真的甘心如此吗？”

“现在有一个机会摆在你面前。那就是由你来吸收和控制那股星球本源能量，凭此成为天河星的规则之神，你不是天河星意识，你只是天河星的规则。任何存在，只要生活在这颗星球上，包括星球意识本身，也无法违背你立下的规则。我们地星那边也称这种神为天道。”

“当你变成天河星的天道，你就可以惩罚违规偷渡过来的邪神，你甚至可以建立一个超越一定力量范围就强行排斥的规则，如果想要进入天河星就必须把力量压制到那个力量范围之下。”

“你还能和天河星意识联手，商量着如何改造天河星，如何共同对付外来的敌人。当你和天河星意识力量相加，外来邪神也只能望着天河星兴叹，而无法侵略。你们甚至能靠捕捉这些贪婪的想要侵略你们的邪神和外来力量，逐渐提升星球能量等级，让你的规则之力变得更强！让你定下的天道辐射更广！”

光球：“……！！！”
chunks.englishText:
Even those who disliked kneeling would solemnly perform a warrior's salute.

Lang Mu and Shang Feifan, sharing a silent understanding, turned their heads at the same time, their gazes meeting.

The two communicated rapidly using their spiritual power.

A moment later, Lang Mu nodded at Shang Feifan.

The corners of Shang Feifan’s mouth curled slightly.

Whether it was the Evil God consciousness or the light orb, neither had noticed that a thread of his spiritual power had been intertwined with his Lang Mu’s all along.

When he realized something was wrong, he had briefed Lang Mu.

The two had prepared themselves right then and there.

He had originally wanted to face it alone, but Lang Mu was worried and insisted on keeping a thread of his spiritual power entwined with Shang Feifan’s, so that if any problem arose, they could merge their spiritual powers in time.

This was a tactic the two had devised to deal with the Evil God consciousness and any other powerful enemies that might appear.

Both of their spiritual powers were exceptionally strong, especially Shang Feifan’s, but if either were alone, they would still fall short in confronting gods and evil gods. However, if their spiritual powers were fused, it would not be so easy for others to bully them.

Therefore, whether it was what the Evil God consciousness said to him or the Q&A between him and the light orb, Lang Mu had heard it all.

He would never hide such things from A-Mu.

Because Lang Mu knew everything, he didn't need much explanation. A-Mu understood him, and after a brief exchange, agreed with his decision—they had to make a quick choice as they were about to face the altar.

"Old Light, do you want to become the God of Rules for this world?"

The light orb vibrated. Having guided so many task-takers, this was the first time someone had turned the tables and tempted it with godhood.

"Think about it. You are a system, and you act according to rules. But whether it’s the Evil God, the native gods, or even the Tianhe Star consciousness, they all act recklessly, ignoring rules, doing whatever they want, and then causing massive disasters that they can't clean up, eventually harming countless lives on Tianhe Star. But if Tianhe Star had a higher rule to supervise it, with more reasonable laws and regulations, wouldn't these errors and disasters caused by nature be significantly reduced?"

The light orb: "..."

At this moment, Shang Feifan was like a devil tempting an angel to fall. "The Evil God wants to obtain the origin energy of Tianhe Star, and the Tianhe Star consciousness also wants to use this energy to evolve further. Even if this disaster is quelled, how can you guarantee that other higher existences won't be lured here by this planetary origin energy in the future? Even if this origin energy is handed over to Tianhe Star, now that it has developed self-awareness and become a 'He,' can it still guarantee an impartial stance and treat the countless lives of this world equally?"

"What’s the point of staying in my body, supervising and assisting a tiny outsider like me? If you are content with being a game system, you will always be just an assistant. No matter how many things you see that you dislike, you can only be a bystander. And most of your task-takers will only want to get rid of you. Even if they have a good relationship with you, like Lang Mu, he would still choose to part ways with you because of his family, his lover, and his ideals. Are you really content with that?"

"Now there is an opportunity before you. That is for you to absorb and control that planetary origin energy, and by doing so, become the God of Rules for Tianhe Star. You are not the Tianhe Star consciousness; you are simply the rules of Tianhe Star. Any existence living on this planet, including the planetary consciousness itself, will be unable to violate the rules you set. In our Earth, we call such a god the 'Heavenly Dao'."

"Once you become the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star, you can punish Evil Gods who sneak in illegally. You can even establish a rule that forcibly repels any power exceeding a certain limit; if they want to enter Tianhe Star, they must suppress their power below that limit."

"You can also join forces with the Tianhe Star consciousness to discuss how to transform Tianhe Star and how to deal with external enemies together. When your powers are combined, the invading Evil Gods will only be able to gaze at Tianhe Star and sigh, unable to invade. You can even gradually increase the planet's energy level by capturing these greedy Evil Gods and external forces, making your rule-power stronger! Allowing the Heavenly Dao you set to radiate even further!"

The light orb: "...!!!"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第280章 握住权杖的人 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第280章 握住权杖的人
