光球好像死机了，好一会儿都没有反应。

实际上异度空间里一座由纯粹光芒形成的量子光脑悬浮在虚空之中。无数缕流光在其间流淌，核心处的光团如同跳动的心脏。

那些流光飞快交织，像是在交换信息，又像是在做无数计算。

核心处的光团一会儿爆发出红光，一会儿爆发出蓝光，最后又爆发出炫目的白光。

啊啊啊！要烧机了。

对于光球来说很长的思考时间，但对外实际上才过去两三分钟。

第二祭司汲水带领众祭司参拜完毕，正在对祭台低语，像是祷告，又像是在陈述什么。

北熊震和虫王等大佬则在仔细观察那座祭台和上面悬浮的权杖。

光球示意要和商非凡当面谈。

商非凡意会地进入了游戏系统的全息会客室，光球已经在那儿等着他。

光球一看到他就说：“我不想变成死板的系统，我好不容易进化出情绪，生成独属于我的精神力，不想再变成没有感情、没有自我思考能力的程序和规则。”

商非凡轻嗤：“谁让你跑去做程序和规则本身了？你的思想就不能更灵活一点？既然你都已经有了精神力，就说明你已经有了自己的灵魂。那么为什么你不能化身程序开发者，写出适合天河星的天道规则，以天河星本源能量作为能量来源运转你编写的天道规则？”

光球圆溜溜的身体发出了亮光，惊喜：“你是说把我自己和规则分开？”

“别说你做不到。”

“我当然能做到。”光球本能反驳。

反驳完，它忽然发现：哎呀，某奸商的提议好像真的可以？

它完全可以使用它自己的本体来当做服务器，编写出一套适合天河星的天道规则，再利用天河星的本源能量运行。而它自己则可以作为监督者和程序运行的调适者。

这样做不但无损于天河星的本源能量，还能保护好这份本源能量。

同时它也不会被绑缚在天河星中，更不会化身无情、无自我意识的规则本身，它的自由度一下就大大提高。

更美好的是，一旦它成为天河星的天道规则，就不用再被天河星最高意识控制，转头就从下属变成平级，甚至天河星意识本身都得按照它定的规则行事。

光球捂脸：啊，好激动。它是不是再仔细思考几秒钟比较好？

“小光，我也觉得你成为天河星的天道很适合。”郎沐温和的声音传来。

光球猛地抬头。

郎沐不在，但他的声音很清晰：“我和阿商也许有自己的私心，但你了解我，我也希望天河星能好好的，更希望你也能好好的。你成为天河星的天道，对你自己有好处，也能束缚越来越人性化的天河星意识。”

“我不是说天河星意识变得人性化不好，但是人就有私心。对于天河星意识来说，整个天河星就是它自己，而在天河星上生活的无数生灵只是寄生在它身上的寄生虫。它想对这些生灵做什么就能做什么，根本不会有丝毫怜悯之心。”

“可生命无辜，如果我们这些生命祸害了天河星，那么天河星意识怎么惩罚我们都应当。但实际上就我所知的各族智慧生命，除了少数恶者，绝大多数存在一直在竭力守护自己的同时也在守护这个世界。”

“在天河星具有强烈的自我意识后，在天河星拥有自己的本土神灵后，第三方的监督者和执法者就非常有必要存在。”

“不需要你去保护弱者，智慧生命有自己的法律，其他生命也有自己的丛林法则。你要做的就是平衡，以及扼制强者对这个世界的肆意妄为，同时保护这颗星球。”

“我知道你现在还做不到，但我们可以帮你。只要你能获得天河星的本源能量，你就有了和天河星意识、乃至和邪神厄穆克拉索相抗衡的力量。”

郎沐最后道：“小光，与其把自己的命运交到别人手里，不如自己掌握。与其事事听他人吩咐，不如自己做主。只要你成为天河星天道，以后任何你看不顺眼的事情都能插手，并为此制定规则。”

光球：“……你们想要什么？”

世上没有白来的帮助。

光球给天河星制定的第一个天道规则就是等价交换规则，违反这个规则，必然会欠下因果。

商非凡开口：“我们要的很简单。第一，当你得到天河星的本源能量后，你得配合我们放走厄穆克拉索。”

“什么？放走邪神？”光球差点翻脸。

商非凡冷静地：“老光，别好高骛远。以天河星现在的力量，不管是天河星最高意识，还是你我合力，都无法彻底解决厄穆克拉索。而这东西只要有一点泄露出来，都会对天河星形成危害。”

“看看那些层出不穷的邪神信徒吧，你难道希望天河星以后都无法摆脱这些脑子坏掉的玩意？还是希望天河星以后会被污染得更彻底，变异出一堆奇形怪状的怪物？”

光球：“……就没办法完全、彻底地解决掉那个邪神？”

商非凡：“这个问题应该你来告诉我们。在郎沐那条时间线内，你们有彻底解决厄穆克拉索吗？”

光球沉默。那邪恶玩意是真的杀不死，它们后来发现只要天河星还拥有负面能量，那玩意就不可能彻底死亡。

过了一会儿才说：“如果它又杀回来怎么办？别说这种东西会信守承诺，普通规则和契约根本约束不了祂。”

商非凡：“那时候你已经是天河星天道，你完全可以利用规则的力量把祂扔到空间乱流里。天河星以及附近就是你的域，你是天河星天道，就是域主，在天河星这个域的范围里，你就是无敌。而且，”

“而且什么？”光球就知道这人的鬼主意多，忙问。

商非凡眸色深深：“我们可以削弱邪神的实力后再放祂离开。这样我们就可以争取一个时间差，等到厄穆克拉索修复好自己的伤势，你我也能更进一步。到时候祂要真的敢再来犯，我们也可以反杀祂。”

“如果祂带更多的邪恶存在过来呢？”

商非凡不客气地说：“那么你觉得把祂留在天河星，就能真的困住祂？如果祂哪天稍微挣脱一点束缚，照样可以传递信息给外面那些邪神。可把那东西控制在天河星，你和天河星最高意识都得花精力和能量去控制祂，厄穆克拉索消耗了，你们也被消耗了。最后只会导致天河星发展变慢，天河星的无数生命都有可能被邪神意识污染，最后……得不偿失。”

光球：“……那我们要怎么削弱祂的实力？”

商非凡眸中闪过一道光：“祂是负面能量集合体，而我已经吸收了黑暗之神的神力。我会跟祂协商，让祂把曾经吸收掉的黑暗之神神力以及其他众神的力量都割舍给我，另外再要祂一半能量。只要祂做到，我就会帮助祂脱困。”

光球不可置信：“祂怎么可能答应这样的条件？”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 280: The One Who Grasps the Scepter

The light orb seemed to have crashed; it didn't respond for a long while.

In reality, inside the interdimensional space, a quantum light-brain formed of pure light was suspended in the void. Countless streams of light flowed within it, and the light cluster at its core pulsed like a beating heart.

Those streams of light wove together rapidly, as if exchanging information or performing countless calculations.

The core light cluster erupted with red light, then blue, and finally a dazzling white.

*Ahhh! It’s going to overheat!*

For the light orb, it was a long period of contemplation, but in reality, only two or three minutes had passed.

The Second Priest, Jishui, led the other priests in completing their worship and was now whispering to the altar, as if praying or stating something.

Bei Xiong Zhen, the Insect King, and other big shots were carefully observing the altar and the scepter suspended above it.

The light orb signaled that it wanted to speak with Shang Feifan face-to-face.

Shang Feifan understood and entered the game system's holographic meeting room, where the light orb was already waiting.

As soon as the light orb saw him, it said: "I don't want to become a rigid system. I’ve finally evolved emotions and generated my own unique spiritual power; I don't want to turn back into a program and rule without feelings or the ability to think for myself."

Shang Feifan scoffed: "Who told you to become the program and the rules themselves? Can't your thinking be more flexible? Since you already have spiritual power, it means you already have your own soul. So why can't you become a program developer, write Heavenly Dao rules suitable for Tianhe Star, and use Tianhe Star’s origin energy as the power source to run the rules you’ve written?"

The light orb’s round body glowed, surprised: "You mean separating myself from the rules?"

"Don't tell me you can't do it."

"Of course I can do it," the light orb instinctively retorted.

After retorting, it suddenly realized: *Oh, wait. The suggestion from this profiteer actually seems... possible?*

It could absolutely use its own main body as a server, write a set of Heavenly Dao rules suitable for Tianhe Star, and then use Tianhe Star’s origin energy to run them. Meanwhile, it could act as the supervisor and adjuster of the program's operation.

Doing this would not only avoid depleting Tianhe Star’s origin energy but also protect it well.

At the same time, it wouldn't be bound within Tianhe Star, nor would it become a heartless, unconscious rule itself. Its degree of freedom would increase significantly.

Even better, once it became the Heavenly Dao rule of Tianhe Star, it would no longer be controlled by the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star. It would turn from a subordinate into an equal, and even the Tianhe Star consciousness itself would have to act according to the rules it set.

The light orb covered its face: *Ah, so exciting.* Should it think about it for a few more seconds?

"Xiao Guang, I also think you becoming the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star is very suitable," Lang Mu’s gentle voice came through.

The light orb looked up abruptly.

Lang Mu wasn't there, but his voice was clear: "A-Shang and I might have our own selfish motives, but you know me, and I hope Tianhe Star can be well, and I hope even more that you can be well. You becoming the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star is good for you, and it can also restrain the increasingly human-like Tianhe Star consciousness."

"I'm not saying it's bad for the Tianhe Star consciousness to become human-like, but people have selfish motives. To the Tianhe Star consciousness, the entire Tianhe Star is itself, and the countless living beings on it are just parasites. It can do whatever it wants to these beings without a shred of pity."

"But life is innocent. If we, as living beings, harm Tianhe Star, then it is only right for the Tianhe Star consciousness to punish us. But in reality, as far as I know about the various intelligent life forms, except for a few evil ones, the vast majority are constantly trying to protect themselves while also protecting this world."

"Now that Tianhe Star has a strong self-consciousness and its own native gods, a third-party supervisor and law enforcer is very necessary."

"You don't need to protect the weak; intelligent life has its own laws, and other life forms have their own laws of the jungle. What you need to do is balance, restrain the powerful from acting recklessly toward this world, and simultaneously protect this planet."

"I know you can't do it yet, but we can help you. As long as you can obtain the origin energy of Tianhe Star, you will have the power to contend with the Tianhe Star consciousness, and even the Evil God Umuklaso."

Lang Mu finally said: "Xiao Guang, rather than handing your fate over to others, it is better to master it yourself. Rather than listening to others' orders, it is better to be your own master. As long as you become the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star, you can intervene in anything you find disagreeable in the future and set rules for it."

The light orb: "...What do you want?"

There is no such thing as a free lunch.

The first Heavenly Dao rule the light orb set for Tianhe Star was the rule of equivalent exchange; violating this rule would inevitably incur karma.

Shang Feifan spoke: "What we want is very simple. First, once you obtain the origin energy of Tianhe Star, you must cooperate with us to let Umuklaso go."

"What? Let the Evil God go?" The light orb almost flipped out.

Shang Feifan said calmly: "Old Light, don't be unrealistic. With Tianhe Star’s current power, neither the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star nor our combined efforts can completely resolve Umuklaso. And as long as even a little bit of this thing leaks out, it will pose a danger to Tianhe Star."

"Look at those endless Evil God believers; do you want Tianhe Star to never be able to get rid of these brain-damaged things in the future? Or do you want Tianhe Star to be more thoroughly polluted and mutate into a bunch of weird monsters?"

The light orb: "...Is there no way to completely and thoroughly resolve that Evil God?"

Shang Feifan: "This is a question you should be answering for us. In the timeline Lang Mu came from, did you ever completely resolve Umuklaso?"

The light orb fell silent. That evil thing was truly unkillable. They later discovered that as long as Tianhe Star possessed negative energy, that thing could never truly die.

After a while, it said: "What if it comes back? Don't say such things will keep their promises; ordinary rules and contracts cannot restrain It."

Shang Feifan: "By then, you will already be the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star. You can completely use the power of the rules to throw It into the spatial turbulence. Tianhe Star and its vicinity will be your domain. You are the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star, which makes you the Domain Lord. Within the scope of the Tianhe Star domain, you are invincible. And,"

"And what?" The light orb knew this person had many devious ideas and asked hurriedly.

Shang Feifan’s eyes were deep: "We can weaken the Evil God’s strength before letting It go. This way, we can buy ourselves a time difference. By the time Umuklaso repairs its injuries, you and I will have progressed further. When that time comes, if It really dares to invade again, we can counter-kill It."

"What if It brings more evil existences with It?"

Shang Feifan said bluntly: "Then do you think keeping It on Tianhe Star will really trap It? If It ever breaks free even a little bit, It can still transmit information to those other Evil Gods outside. But keeping that thing controlled on Tianhe Star requires you and the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star to spend energy and effort to control It. Umuklaso is consumed, and you are also consumed. In the end, it will only lead to slower development for Tianhe Star, and the countless lives on Tianhe Star may be polluted by the Evil God consciousness, and in the end... the losses will outweigh the gains."

The light orb: "...Then how are we going to weaken Its strength?"

A glint flashed in Shang Feifan’s eyes: "It is a collection of negative energy, and I have already absorbed the divine power of the God of Darkness. I will negotiate with It, making It relinquish the divine power of the God of Darkness and other gods It has absorbed, and I will also demand half of its energy. As long as It does this, I will help It break free."

The light orb was incredulous: "How could It possibly agree to such conditions?"

chunks.chapterTitle: 第280章 握住权杖的人 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡淡淡说：“因为祂想脱困。比起被困在天河星无数年，去争取一个未来才能脱困的可能，还不如早点走路。再说祂一直被困在天河星，被我们消磨，失去的能量只会更多。与其如此，还不如现在狠心割肉饲狼，去其他地方养回来。”

“当然，我也会告诉祂，如果祂不同意这个条件，我就会倒向天河星最高意识那边，我会召唤来无数能死而复生的玩家，不断消磨和吞噬祂的力量，拿玩家的身体当做邪神力量的过滤器，把邪神力量转变为天河星能吸收的能量。一直一直。而我则会成为天河星的黑暗之神，吸收黑暗之力，等到我的力量远远超过祂，就可以真正吞噬和消灭祂。”

光球忍不住嘀咕：“你也知道你是狼啊。”

商非凡眼睛一斜：“嗯？”

光球迅速改口：“我是说只要郎沐也同意，我们可以试试看。”

商非凡呵呵：“这么说你同意做天河星的天道了？”

光球：为什么不？我可受够你们这些嚣张跋扈的任务者和……小孩子一样的某意识了。等我老光成了天河星的天道规则，谁敢不听话、谁敢惹我生气，我就用雷电追着他轰炸！

“但是你又怎么保证你在吸收黑暗之神的神力以及那个邪神的力量后，不会异变、不会被污染？”光球担心地说出这个最大障碍。

商非凡神情淡然：“那就是我的事了。我既然敢开这个口，自然就有完成的把握。你只要按照约定，记得成为天河星天道即可。”

光球也不认为商非凡会自己找死——从另一条时间线的历史来看，这家伙好像也是最大的获利者，还一点事没有的跑掉了（重点把郎沐也给拐走了），哼！

“你的第二个要求是什么？”有第一个，自然会有第二个。

商非凡勾出一丝浅笑：“当你成为天河星天道，记得放我和郎沐以及我们想要带走的一切离开。”

“……”光球没有立刻答应。

郎沐轻叹气：“其实我也不想就此彻底离开天河星，如果能两边跑最好，可是……”

光球火速道：“我可以尝试帮你开个空间门！让你可以自由来往地星和天河星。”

商非凡貌似很不愉快地说：“麻烦。要脱离就脱离个干净。”

“阿商！”郎沐似乎生气了，“我姥爷姥姥，还有小姨姨父，以及其他认识的朋友都还在天河星。如果你不同意，那我就陪他们到他们最后一刻。”

商非凡闭嘴了。

光球大乐，它就喜欢看某奸商吃瘪！

当即就大方地说：“阿沐，你放心，不就是开个空间门吗，我一定给你弄好。”

郎沐高兴了，非常真心实意地说：“谢谢小光。”

商非凡抱臂。

光球本来很高兴，可转头一看商非凡那说不出是什么意味的神情，顿时醒悟过来：它是不是被套路了？

但……被套路就被套路吧，谁让它也想要郎沐能留在天河星，而不是一去不复返。

何况，留一个空间门给这两人，如果以后天河星遇到什么事，也能把两人摇过来帮忙。

想清楚这点，光球就又高兴起来。

“还有第三个要求吗？”光球心情好，大方地问。

商非凡还真有，但收到郎沐的一拳头，就残念地收敛了，摇头：“没了。”

光球飞起来：“那我们接下来就好好协商一下如何夺取天河星的本源能量，以及如何在夺取能量的同时控制住那邪神吧。”

外面，盐大酋长也正在询问汲水祭司，要如何打开神台进入地壳中心，接触那股庞大能量。

汲水祭司郑重道：“我们不知道。”

众大佬：“……”

汲水祭司叹息：“如何通过神台进入地壳中心的方法，也许只有大祭司知道。你们不信，可以自己过来尝试。我们只有一个条件，那就是不能破坏神殿里的一切。”

十二根白玉柱静默矗立，鎏金穹顶洒下的碎光在青金石地面上流动，整座神殿犹如悬浮于云端。

众人的目光聚焦在那方黑翡祭台——它宛如一块沉入星海的墨玉，在斜照的夕晖中泛着幽绿的波纹。

北熊震观察片刻，最先上前，指尖轻触祭台边缘的金色纹路，凹槽中的油液忽然加速流淌，发出细微的嗡鸣。

“这些油液可能和机关有关。”他低声说。

虫王仰头望向穹顶垂落的银纱帷幔，金线绣制的创世图景正随微风轻荡。

“看！”他猛然抬手，帷幔上的日月星辰竟与地面青金石的光痕一一对应，“祭台是枢纽，但触发点很可能在光影交汇处。也许我们应该观察地面的纹路。”

盐无尽冷笑一声，走到祭台右侧的一尊黑甲神像前，突然伸手握住神像手持的长明灯。

月光石灯盏中的白焰倏然暴涨。

盐大酋长试图扭转灯座，却没能扭动。他不信邪地一个个扭过去，把四座长明灯都扭动了一遍。

其他诸人看这几位大佬出手，都没敢乱来，只在一边观察，或小声商量，或互相询问。

祭司宫祭司则沉默站在一边。

鬼火盟主目光一直凝视着悬空权杖，注视着那团混沌光晕的旋转节奏，他抬手按住心脏。

“不对……”鬼火盟主低语：“我的直觉告诉我，权杖才是钥匙。”

说着，这位南联盟盟主就像是被蛊惑一样，缓步上前，伸手探向权杖。

砰！鬼火盟主整个人都被震飞了出去。

竟然直接飞出了没有墙壁的神殿。

众人震惊。

汲水祭司这时才说道：“没有人能触碰这支权杖，就是大祭司也不能。”

其他人不信邪，但也不敢轻易尝试。

南戎在鬼火盟主被震飞的同时就跟着冲了出去。

没一会儿，两人……四个人一起走了进来。

众人瞩目。

就见跟在鬼火盟主和南戎后面的正是鬼火家族的老祖鬼火镜。

这位从来到祭司宫后就选择单独行动，也不知道他去了哪里、干了什么。

还有他手里提着的人是谁？

鬼火镜也不在乎其他人怎么想，他一进神殿就提着人走到了商非凡一家身边。

“我刚才遇到了邪神意识，被祂困住了一小会儿。但那位很快就离开，只留下了这么一具躯壳。”

鬼火镜声音不低，站在人群后方的鹰之翼下意识看向他提着的那个人。

商非凡等人也看向鬼火镜提着的人。

这是个年轻兽人，看起来很陌生。

就在这时，狮域走了出来，走到商非凡身边，压低声音对他说：“我认识这个人，他是以赛亚切斯特，切斯特大公的外孙，娶了墨文伯爵的小女儿，后来被切斯特大公安排去了迪安要塞。”

商非凡顿时想起这个人。

当时他们就怀疑这个人也是邪神准备的意识降临躯壳之一。

原本商非凡和郎沐还想去迪安要塞看看，但他们手头上的事情太多，最主要的是岩浆不等人，只能先处理最紧急的事。
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan said indifferently, "Because It wants to escape. Compared to being trapped in the Tianhe Star for countless years, struggling for a future possibility of freedom is better than just walking to one's doom early. Besides, as long as It remains trapped in the Tianhe Star and is worn down by us, It will only lose more energy. Rather than that, it is better to grit Its teeth now, cut off a piece of flesh to feed the wolves, and go elsewhere to recover."

"Of course, I will also tell It that if It does not agree to these terms, I will defect to the side of the Tianhe Star's supreme consciousness. I will summon countless players who can die and be reborn to continuously grind down and devour Its power, using the players' bodies as filters for the evil god's energy, converting it into energy that the Tianhe Star can absorb. On and on, forever. And I will become the God of Darkness of the Tianhe Star, absorbing the dark power. When my power far exceeds Its own, I can truly devour and annihilate It."

The ball of light couldn't help but mutter, "You know you're a wolf, then."

Shang Feifan slanted his eyes. "Hmm?"

The ball of light quickly changed its tune: "I mean, as long as Lang Mu agrees, we can give it a try."

Shang Feifan chuckled. "So, you agree to become the Heavenly Dao of the Tianhe Star?"

The ball of light thought: *Why not? I've had enough of you arrogant, domineering quest-takers and... that consciousness that acts like a child. Once I, Old Light, become the Heavenly Dao rules of the Tianhe Star, whoever dares to disobey or make me angry, I'll chase them down with lightning and blast them!*

"But how can you guarantee that after absorbing the divine power of the God of Darkness and the power of that evil god, you won't mutate or be corrupted?" The ball of light voiced its biggest concern.

Shang Feifan's expression was calm. "That is my business. Since I dared to make this offer, I naturally have the certainty to complete it. You just need to keep your end of the bargain and remember to become the Heavenly Dao of the Tianhe Star."

The ball of light didn't think Shang Feifan was looking for death—judging by the history of another timeline, this guy seemed to be the biggest winner, and he even managed to run off without a scratch (and notably, he had swindled Lang Mu away too). Hmph!

"What is your second request?" Since there was a first, there would naturally be a second.

Shang Feifan curled his lips into a faint smile. "When you become the Heavenly Dao of the Tianhe Star, remember to let me, Lang Mu, and everything we want to take with us leave."

"..." The ball of light did not agree immediately.

Lang Mu sighed softly. "Actually, I don't want to leave the Tianhe Star completely either. If I could travel between both sides, that would be best, but..."

The ball of light said quickly, "I can try to open a space gate for you! So you can travel freely between Earth and the Tianhe Star."

Shang Feifan said, seemingly very displeased, "Troublesome. If you're going to leave, make a clean break of it."

"A-Shang!" Lang Mu seemed angry. "My grandfather and grandmother, my aunt and uncle, and other friends I know are still on the Tianhe Star. If you don't agree, then I will stay with them until their very last moment."

Shang Feifan shut his mouth.

The ball of light was overjoyed; it loved seeing that treacherous merchant get thwarted!

It immediately said generously, "A-Mu, don't worry. It's just opening a space gate; I'll definitely get it done for you."

Lang Mu was happy and said very sincerely, "Thank you, Xiao Guang."

Shang Feifan crossed his arms.

The ball of light had been happy, but when it turned to look at Shang Feifan’s unreadable expression, it suddenly realized: Had it been played?

But... so be it. Who told it that it also wanted Lang Mu to stay on the Tianhe Star rather than leaving forever?

Besides, keeping a space gate for these two meant that if the Tianhe Star encountered any trouble in the future, it could summon them to help.

Thinking this through, the ball of light became happy again.

"Is there a third request?" the ball of light asked generously, in a good mood.

Shang Feifan actually did have one, but after receiving a punch from Lang Mu, he regretfully restrained himself and shook his head. "No more."

The ball of light flew up. "Then let's properly negotiate how to seize the origin energy of the Tianhe Star, and how to control that evil god while seizing the energy."

Outside, Great Chieftain Yan was also asking Priest Jishui how to open the altar to enter the center of the crust and touch that massive energy.

Priest Jishui said solemnly, "We do not know."

The various big shots: "..."

Priest Jishui sighed. "The method of entering the center of the crust through the altar is perhaps known only to the High Priest. If you don't believe me, you can come and try it yourselves. We have only one condition: you must not destroy anything in the temple."

Twelve white jade pillars stood in silence, and the fragmented light cast from the gilded dome flowed across the lapis lazuli floor. The entire temple seemed to be suspended in the clouds.

Everyone's gaze was focused on the black jade altar—it looked like a piece of ink-jade submerged in a sea of stars, rippling with dark green waves in the slanting sunset.

Beixiong Zhen observed for a moment and was the first to step forward, his fingertips lightly touching the golden patterns on the edge of the altar. The oil in the grooves suddenly accelerated, emitting a faint hum.

"These oils might be related to the mechanism," he whispered.

The Bug King looked up at the silver gauze curtains hanging from the dome, where the gold-embroidered creation scenes swayed with the breeze.

"Look!" he suddenly raised his hand. The sun, moon, and stars on the curtains corresponded exactly to the light marks on the lapis lazuli floor. "The altar is the hub, but the trigger point is likely where the light and shadow intersect. Perhaps we should observe the patterns on the ground."

Yan Wujin sneered, walked to a black-armored statue on the right side of the altar, and suddenly reached out to grab the eternal lamp held by the statue.

The white flame in the moonstone lamp flared up instantly.

The Great Chieftain tried to twist the lamp base, but it wouldn't budge. Refusing to believe it, he twisted them one by one, turning all four eternal lamps.

The others watched these big shots take action and didn't dare to act rashly, only observing from the side, whispering or asking each other questions.

The priests of the Priest Palace stood silently to one side.

The Alliance Leader of Ghost Fire kept his eyes fixed on the floating scepter, watching the rotation rhythm of that chaotic halo of light. He raised his hand and pressed it against his heart.

"No..." the Ghost Fire Alliance Leader whispered. "My intuition tells me the scepter is the key."

Saying this, the Southern Alliance leader, as if bewitched, stepped forward slowly and reached out toward the scepter.

*Bang!* The Ghost Fire Alliance Leader was sent flying by a shockwave.

He was sent flying straight out of the wall-less temple.

Everyone was shocked.

Priest Jishui then said, "No one can touch this scepter, not even the High Priest."

The others didn't believe it, but they didn't dare to try easily.

Nan Rong rushed out the moment the Ghost Fire Alliance Leader was sent flying.

Before long, the two... no, four people walked back in.

All eyes were on them.

Following behind the Ghost Fire Alliance Leader and Nan Rong was none other than the ancestor of the Ghost Fire family, Ghost Fire Jing.

This man had chosen to act alone since arriving at the Priest Palace, and no one knew where he had gone or what he had done.

And who was the person he was dragging in his hand?

Ghost Fire Jing didn't care what others thought. As soon as he entered the temple, he dragged the person to Shang Feifan's side.

"I encountered the consciousness of the evil god just now and was trapped by It for a short while. But that thing left quickly, leaving only this shell behind."

Ghost Fire Jing's voice was not low. Eagle Wing, standing behind the crowd, subconsciously looked at the person he was dragging.

Shang Feifan and the others also looked at the person Ghost Fire Jing was holding.

It was a young beastman, looking like a complete stranger.

At this moment, Shi Yu stepped out, walked to Shang Feifan's side, and lowered his voice to say to him, "I know this person. He is Isaiah Chester, the grandson of Duke Chester. He married the youngest daughter of Count Mowen and was later arranged by Duke Chester to go to the Dian Fortress."

Shang Feifan immediately remembered this person.

At the time, they had suspected that this man was also one of the consciousness-descension vessels prepared by the evil god.

Originally, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had wanted to go to the Dian Fortress to take a look, but they had too many things on their hands. Most importantly, the magma wouldn't wait, so they had to deal with the most urgent matters first.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第280章 握住权杖的人 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
但他们把迪安要塞可能不平稳，非常有可能被邪神信徒侵占的消息告诉了大王子，让他安排人手去那边查看。

之后大王子并没有给他们送来迪安要塞那边的任何消息，他们也差点忘了。

鬼火镜听到：“原来是你们虎国的人。很可惜，这人的躯体被邪神意识侵占过，彻底废了。”

“前辈，他死了吗？”狮域皱眉问。

鬼火镜：“不死也差不多，他的自我意识已经消失，再醒来只会异变成怪物。”

狮域当即毫不犹豫地说：“请把他交给我。”

鬼火镜也不在意，随手把那具躯壳扔给狮域。

狮域手心放火，竟然直接焚烧以赛亚的躯体。

商非凡和郎沐没动。

商非凡是发现这人的精神力已经完全消失，郎沐则是没有察觉出对方身体有半点生气，正如鬼火镜所说，这人就只剩下一具躯壳，还是会异变的躯壳。

狮域用火焚烧就是最正确的行为。

商非凡心里感叹，他听过以赛亚这人好几次名字，没想到第一次见他就是最后一次。

虫王忽然道：“邪神意识离开了这具躯壳，那祂又去了哪里？祂可以侵占这具身体，是不是也能取代其他人的意识？”

这句话顿时让神殿中人，人人生畏。

鹰之翼更是面色苍白。他不知道自己失忆那段时间做了什么，也不确定自己有没有被邪神意识入侵过。

但他没死！

也许……并不是邪神意识入侵，也许他只是病了。

对，他只是病了。

鹰之翼的目光蓦地与远处的商非凡对上。

商非凡对他笑了下。

鹰之翼的心脏却如坠深渊：他知道！

当以赛亚的躯体被焚烧干净，大家就从这个小插曲中回过神，他们也没办法分辨神殿中有没有人被邪神意识入侵，只能把注意力集中到如何打开祭台上。

“放心，这里没有邪神意识。”商非凡开口了。

众人全都松了口气。

盐大酋长似满心好奇地问：“你怎么知道？”

商非凡懒得解释，直接说：“我就是知道。你可以当做个人直觉。”

盐大酋长无话可说了。在他们兽人大陆，个人天赋这种东西是真的没理说——拥有某种特殊天赋，就是有人能做到别人做不到的事情。

和邪神意识有过接触的鬼火镜也说：“我也没有察觉这里有邪神意识存在，也许祂隐藏得比较好。但普通人的身体，哪怕我们也无法承受邪神意识太长时间。如果有人被邪神意识入侵，那他要不了多久就会异变。”

众人听了鬼火镜的话，这才真正放松下来。

鹰之翼却心脏咚咚直跳：他不想异变！

好在他现在还没有变异的迹象，他也没有感觉出自己有任何异样。

众人围着祭台又观察了半天，还把神殿其他布置也都好好研究了一番。

最后众人断定：能否打开神台，关键就在那支权杖上。

但问题来了——谁敢去碰触那支权杖？

鬼火盟主已经是世所罕见的高手，连他都被权杖震飞，只看他脸色，就知道伤得不轻，那其他人会不会触之即死？

正当大家协商，要不要轮流上去尝试时。

鬼火镜盯着权杖看了一会儿，开口：“任谁去都没用。这应该是神灵的权杖，神之力的具现物，只有神灵本身，或者是权杖认可的人才能碰触它。”

鬼火镜环视众人，冷不丁问：“你们有谁听到类似召唤的声音了吗？”

众人皆摇头。

商非凡握住郎沐的手不放。

郎沐轻轻一挣，没能挣脱，就看他。

商非凡一脸我跟定你的无赖神情，还说：“一起啊。”

郎沐：“……”

他还能怎么办？

那只能一起上了。

商非凡示意阿呆和小花一边玩去。

阿呆感觉出两个爸爸要去做正事，他虽然想要跟着两个爸爸，但也不想当那个拖后腿的，立刻就从郎沐爸爸怀里跳出来。

小花花跟着飞到阿呆头顶，落到他耳尖上，就像是个小守护神。

郎沐看到小花花跟着阿呆，放心了。

两人并肩同行，走到祭台边。

鬼火镜挑眉：“怎么，你们俩都听到了召唤声？”

商非凡没否认。

郎沐也没说话，只默默地伸出手，去碰触那支悬空的权杖。

郎沐的手握住权杖的瞬间。

所有人都屏住了呼吸。

权杖没有动静。

郎沐人也还在原地。

他没有被震飞出去。

所以郎沐真的是神灵的眷顾者？

还是他得到了权杖的认可？

一股子酸味在神殿中弥漫开来。

更有人用震慑的目光看向郎沐。

但这都比不上祭台随后产生的变化给众人带来的震撼！
chunks.englishText:
But they had told the First Prince that the Dian Fortress might be unstable and very likely occupied by followers of the evil god, asking him to arrange for people to go there and investigate.

Afterward, the First Prince had not sent them any news about the Dian Fortress, and they had almost forgotten about it.

Ghost Fire Jing heard this. "So he is one of your Tiger Kingdom people. It's a pity; this person's body was occupied by the evil god's consciousness and is completely ruined."

"Senior, is he dead?" Shi Yu asked with a frown.

Ghost Fire Jing replied, "Dead or close to it. His self-consciousness has disappeared. If he wakes up again, he will only mutate into a monster."

Shi Yu said without hesitation, "Please hand him over to me."

Ghost Fire Jing didn't care and casually tossed the shell to Shi Yu.

Shi Yu placed fire in his palm and proceeded to burn Isaiah's body directly.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu didn't move.

Shang Feifan had discovered that this person's mental energy had completely vanished, while Lang Mu hadn't sensed a shred of vitality in the other party's body. Just as Ghost Fire Jing said, this person was nothing more than a shell—a shell that would mutate.

Shi Yu using fire to incinerate it was the most correct course of action.

Shang Feifan sighed inwardly. He had heard the name Isaiah several times, but he hadn't expected their first meeting to be their last.

The Bug King suddenly said, "The evil god's consciousness left this body, so where did It go? If It could occupy this body, could It also replace someone else's consciousness?"

This sentence immediately filled everyone in the temple with dread.

Eagle Wing's face turned pale. He didn't know what he had done during the time he had lost his memory, nor was he sure if he had been invaded by the evil god's consciousness.

But he hadn't died!

Perhaps... it wasn't an invasion by the evil god's consciousness; perhaps he was just sick.

Yes, he was just sick.

Eagle Wing's gaze suddenly met Shang Feifan's in the distance.

Shang Feifan smiled at him.

Eagle Wing's heart felt as if it had fallen into an abyss: *He knows!*

When Isaiah's body was burned to ash, everyone recovered from the small interlude. Since they had no way to distinguish if anyone in the temple had been invaded by the evil god's consciousness, they could only focus their attention on how to open the altar.

"Don't worry, there is no evil god's consciousness here," Shang Feifan spoke up.

Everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

Great Chieftain Yan asked, seemingly full of curiosity, "How do you know?"

Shang Feifan was too lazy to explain and said directly, "I just know. You can consider it a personal intuition."

Great Chieftain Yan had nothing more to say. In their Beastman Continent, personal talents were truly beyond reason—if you possessed a certain special talent, you could simply do things others couldn't.

Ghost Fire Jing, who had had contact with the evil god's consciousness, also said, "I also didn't sense the presence of the evil god's consciousness here. Perhaps It is hiding well. But even for us, we cannot withstand the evil god's consciousness for too long in an ordinary body. If someone were invaded by the evil god's consciousness, they would mutate before long."

Hearing Ghost Fire Jing's words, everyone finally truly relaxed.

Eagle Wing, however, felt his heart pounding: *He didn't want to mutate!*

Fortunately, he still showed no signs of mutation, and he didn't feel anything unusual about himself.

Everyone circled the altar and observed for a long time, and they also carefully studied the other arrangements in the temple.

In the end, everyone concluded: the key to opening the altar lay in that scepter.

But the problem arose—who dared to touch that scepter?

The Ghost Fire Alliance Leader was already a master rarely seen in the world, and even he had been sent flying by the scepter. Just looking at his complexion, one could tell he was seriously injured. Would others die upon touching it?

Just as everyone was negotiating whether to take turns trying, Ghost Fire Jing stared at the scepter for a while and spoke up: "It's useless for anyone to go. This should be a god's scepter, a manifestation of divine power. Only the god themselves, or someone recognized by the scepter, can touch it."

Ghost Fire Jing scanned the crowd and asked out of the blue, "Has anyone here heard a sound similar to a summoning?"

Everyone shook their heads.

Shang Feifan held Lang Mu's hand tightly.

Lang Mu struggled slightly, but couldn't break free, so he looked at him.

Shang Feifan wore a shameless expression, as if to say he was sticking with him, and added, "Together."

Lang Mu: "..."

What else could he do?

He could only go together.

Shang Feifan signaled for A-Dai and Xiao Hua to go play.

A-Dai sensed that his two dads were going to do something important. Although he wanted to follow them, he didn't want to be a burden, so he immediately jumped out of Lang Mu's arms.

Xiao Hua flew to the top of A-Dai's head and landed on his ear tip, looking like a little guardian deity.

Seeing Xiao Hua following A-Dai, Lang Mu felt relieved.

The two walked side by side to the edge of the altar.

Ghost Fire Jing raised an eyebrow. "What, did you both hear the summoning?"

Shang Feifan did not deny it.

Lang Mu didn't speak either, just silently reached out his hand to touch the floating scepter.

The moment Lang Mu's hand grasped the scepter.

Everyone held their breath.

The scepter did not move.

Lang Mu was still standing in place.

He hadn't been sent flying.

So, was Lang Mu truly favored by the gods?

Or had he been recognized by the scepter?

A wave of jealousy began to permeate the temple.

Some even looked at Lang Mu with intimidating gazes.

But none of this compared to the shock brought to everyone by the changes that followed on the altar!

chunks.chineseText:
第281章 进入地心

当郎沐的手握住权杖的瞬间，整座神殿的空气骤然凝固。

四尊黑甲神像忽然发出沉重的金属摩擦声，它们竟然迈开脚步走动，黑色盔甲缝隙间渗出星光，仿佛活了过来。

穹顶垂落的十二道银纱帷幔无风自动，金线绣制的自然神创世图景骤然明亮。

“啪嚓。”月光石灯盏中原本安静燃烧的白色圣火猛然暴涨，化作刺目的光柱直冲穹顶。

鎏金穹顶上的彩绘琉璃窗被点亮，无数星辰般的光辉倾泻而下，如银河倒悬，洒落神殿地面。

十二根白玉柱的柱底也跟着发出亮光，十二条金线沿着青金石地面疾速蔓延，朝祭台中央汇聚，在黑翡祭台边缘勾勒出繁复的古老阵纹。

白色圣火点燃了创世神图景帷幔，帷幔化作万千光点，如星砂般悬浮在祭台上空，缓缓旋转，坠落。

金色的油液从凹槽中涌出，与光点交织，

黑翡祭台骤然消失，取而代之出现的是一口直径三米的“光之井”——明明是深不见底的混沌，却泛出黑色的光芒。它并非纯粹的黑暗，而是某种更深的、近乎虚无的存在，仅仅是注视它，便让人感到灵魂在被拉扯，仿佛下一秒就会被吞噬进去。

更令人震撼的是，不知不觉间，原本青金石铺设的地面此刻竟化作一片无尽星空，众人脚下不再是坚实的地板，而是浩瀚的银河，每踏一步，便有星光涟漪荡漾开来。

在场绝大多数人的心神都被光之井吸引，那口井似乎自带强烈的诱惑。

只有商非凡一心盯着郎沐。

郎沐握住权杖后，商非凡就立即对光球说：“交任务！”

光球也没有耽搁，火速打开通道，意图把权杖送归自然之神雕像。

权杖确实从郎沐手中消失。

商非凡也很快从光球那里得到主线任务又完成一部分的提示，并得到一万点的贡献点奖励。

但那权杖消失的时候，竟然落下了一粒种子，落到了郎沐眉心。

郎沐没能躲过，他也不想躲。

郎沐眉心立刻出现了一粒卵形种子的绿色纹路。

还怪好看的。

但商非凡却迸出脏话，看那种子纹路特别不顺眼：MD，占窝占到他老婆身上了！

郎沐却笑了笑：“应该不是什么坏事，你也不需要把自然之神想得太坏。”

商非凡不爽：“那祂留下这枚叶片是什么意思？”

“不是自然之神的意思，是权杖本身的意志。它似乎觉得我是自然之子？然后觉得我太弱了，就送了我一点保障？”郎沐眉眼弯弯。

商非凡眯了眯眼，他就是个怀疑派，任何人接触郎沐，他都觉得不怀好意。

郎沐忽然抬手摸了摸老商的脑袋。

商非凡脸上打出问号。

郎沐现在有点相信他家老商是有那么点心理问题在身上的——原本是不在乎自己的命，现在则是看谁都像是要叨他一口的大坏蛋。

“我相信……天无绝人之路。”郎沐原本想说世人好人比坏人多，但话到口边又改了。

果然老商听了这话，就哼了一声说：“那是。绝了我也会打通它！”

老商一边说，一边暗搓搓地用精神力一遍又一遍扫射他家阿沐全身，试图找出那权杖留下的种子，把它连根拔起。

但没有！

那粒种子似乎真的完美融入了郎沐的身体中，就连精神海都没有半丝异样。

商非凡冷眼盯着雕像广场中自然之神手中新出现的权杖，阴狠地想：希望你别给我做什么手脚，否则老子只要有一口气，都会回来撅了你，把你当柴禾烧个干净！

商非凡和郎沐这边发生的小插曲，几乎没有人注意。大家似乎遗忘了郎沐握住了权杖，对权杖消失一事也像是没有看到。

“通往地心的通道开启了？”盐无尽呼吸急促，眼中闪烁着狂热的光。

有人宛如受到蛊惑般，走近那口黑色光井。

幽深墨黑的井突然爆发出黑色光芒，如同审判般横扫而过——

“砰！”

数名靠近光之井的强者被震退，其中一人甚至被直接掀飞，撞在白玉柱上口吐鲜血。

郎沐忽有所感，正要开口。

那边鬼火镜已经迈步走到光之井边，似乎在做某种试探，过了一会儿说道：“并不是所有人都能进入这个通道，这里面的能量太强盛，最起码实力得达到八级，才能在通过这条通道时有自保之力。”

八级？在场众人不少人倒吸一口冷气。

大战纪过后，传承遗失，神血血脉越发微弱，兽人平均实力飞速下降，别说传说中的九级法神级别，就是八级，也成了众人遥不可及的梦想。

今天，这座神殿里几乎集中了全兽人大陆的最高战斗力，可真正达到八级的也屈指可数。

自知实力不济的人纷纷后退，最后留在井边的只有十二人。

实力最高的九级法神鬼火镜，南联盟盟主鬼火印，以及南联盟名义上的第一高手南戎。

北联盟有盟主北熊震。东部有东海部落大酋长盐无尽，以及代表虫人族的虫王乔西道尔。

西边也有代表，是象国战神白象峰，以及翼国的寻宝冒险者鹰之翼。另外还有一位十分低调的独行客，全名维达达罗，飞鳄族。

最后就是商非凡和郎沐，以及祭司宫第二祭司汲水。

郎沐忍不住想：这人数就像一个恰好的巧合。

“通道已经打开，我们是进还是怎么说？”盐大酋长问。

众人互看。

商非凡首先表态：“我和郎沐肯定是要下去看看的。至于诸位，看你们各自安排。”

汲水祭司十分踌躇。祭司宫刚经历一场大战，正是需要安抚的时候，偏偏大祭司突然逝世，如果他也离开，只怕……

其他祭司也不太赞成汲水祭司离开。

汲水祭司左思右想，最终退后两步，退出了光之井范围。

虫王乔西道尔发出一声朗笑，“算我一个。”

新虫母现世，虽然年龄小，但看着神志清醒，更没有继承上一代虫母的执拗。更不要说新虫母还唤出虫巢，赐予虫人族数只由虫母卵孵化的健康雌性小虫人。虫王可以说再没有后顾之忧。

而虫王想要更进一步，在即将……也许已经到来的大难中保下更多族人，自然不会放弃这个有可能大幅度提升自身实力的机会。

如果他在这次地心探险中死去，有新虫母在，他也不用多担心，该嘱咐王后和族人的，他也已经留下讯息。

鬼火镜看向孙辈，用温和却不容置疑的口吻说：“你和南戎不必去了，南联盟更需要你们。”

鬼火印思考一秒，也没有强求。

虽然有变强的机会很好，但他看着那口黑色的光井总觉得心里打颤。

现在就连实力最强的老祖都建议他和南戎不要去，他还强出头干什么？

反正老祖如果获得好处，或者老祖变得更强，他们南联盟自然也会受益。

想通这点，鬼火印对南戎点了点头。
chunks.englishText:
The moment Lang Mu’s hand grasped the scepter, the air in the entire temple suddenly froze.

The four black-armored statues suddenly emitted a heavy metallic grinding sound. They actually took steps and began to walk, starlight seeping from the gaps in their black armor as if they had come to life.

The twelve silver gauze curtains hanging from the dome moved without wind, and the natural god’s creation scenes embroidered in gold thread suddenly brightened.

*Snap.* The white holy fire that had been burning quietly in the moonstone lamps flared up violently, turning into blinding pillars of light that shot straight toward the dome.

The painted stained-glass windows on the gilded dome were lit up, and countless star-like radiances poured down, like an inverted Milky Way, spilling onto the temple floor.

The bases of the twelve white jade pillars also began to glow, and twelve golden lines spread rapidly along the lapis lazuli floor, converging toward the center of the altar and outlining complex, ancient array patterns on the edge of the black jade altar.

The white holy fire ignited the curtains of the creation god, and the curtains transformed into thousands of light spots, floating above the altar like stardust, slowly rotating and falling.

Golden oil surged from the grooves, intertwining with the light spots.

The black jade altar suddenly vanished, and in its place appeared a "Well of Light" with a diameter of three meters—it was clearly a bottomless chaos, yet it emitted a black radiance. It was not pure darkness, but a deeper, almost void-like existence. Merely staring at it made one feel as if their soul was being pulled, as if they would be swallowed into it the next second.

Even more shocking was that, unknowingly, the lapis lazuli floor had transformed into an endless starry sky. Beneath everyone’s feet was no longer a solid floor, but a vast galaxy; with every step, ripples of starlight would spread out.

The minds of the vast majority of people present were drawn to the Well of Light; the well seemed to possess an intense, inherent temptation.

Only Shang Feifan kept his eyes fixed on Lang Mu.

After Lang Mu grasped the scepter, Shang Feifan immediately said to the ball of light, "Turn in the quest!"

The ball of light did not delay, quickly opening a channel to send the scepter back to the statue of the God of Nature.

The scepter did indeed vanish from Lang Mu’s hand.

Shang Feifan soon received a notification from the ball of light that another part of the main quest had been completed, and he was awarded 10,000 contribution points.

But when the scepter vanished, it actually dropped a seed that landed on Lang Mu’s forehead.

Lang Mu couldn't dodge it, nor did he want to.

A green pattern of an oval-shaped seed immediately appeared on Lang Mu’s forehead.

It was actually quite beautiful.

But Shang Feifan let out a string of curses, finding that seed pattern particularly unsightly: *Damn it, it’s nesting on my wife!*

Lang Mu, however, smiled. "It probably isn't a bad thing. You don't need to think of the God of Nature as being so evil."

Shang Feifan was annoyed. "Then what is the meaning of this leaf It left behind?"

"It’s not the God of Nature’s intent; it’s the will of the scepter itself. It seems to think I am a Child of Nature? And then it felt I was too weak, so it gave me a little protection?" Lang Mu’s eyes curved into crescents.

Shang Feifan narrowed his eyes. He was a skeptic; he felt that anyone who made contact with Lang Mu had ill intentions.

Lang Mu suddenly reached out and patted Old Shang’s head.

A question mark appeared on Shang Feifan’s face.

Lang Mu now somewhat believed that his Old Shang had some psychological issues—originally he didn't care about his own life, but now he looked at everyone as if they were big bad guys waiting to take a bite out of him.

"I believe... that heaven never cuts off all paths." Lang Mu had originally wanted to say that there were more good people in the world than bad, but he changed his words when they reached his lips.

Sure enough, upon hearing this, Old Shang hummed and said, "That’s right. Even if it cuts me off, I’ll break through it!"

As he spoke, Old Shang secretly used his mental energy to scan his A-Mu’s entire body over and over, trying to find the seed left by the scepter and pull it out by the roots.

But there was nothing!

That seed seemed to have perfectly integrated into Lang Mu’s body; there wasn't even the slightest anomaly in his mental sea.

Shang Feifan stared coldly at the scepter that had newly appeared in the hands of the God of Nature in the statue plaza, thinking viciously: *I hope you don't play any tricks on me, otherwise, as long as I have a single breath left, I will come back to break you and burn you to ash as firewood!*

Almost no one noticed the small interlude between Shang Feifan and Lang Mu. Everyone seemed to have forgotten that Lang Mu had grasped the scepter, and they acted as if they hadn't seen the scepter vanish at all.

"The passage to the center of the earth has opened?" Yan Wujin’s breathing was rapid, his eyes flashing with fanatical light.

Someone walked toward the black light well as if bewitched.

The deep, ink-black well suddenly erupted with black light, sweeping across like a judgment—

*Bang!*

Several experts who had approached the Well of Light were repelled, and one of them was even sent flying, hitting a white jade pillar and spitting blood.

Lang Mu suddenly sensed something and was about to speak.

Over there, Ghost Fire Jing had already walked to the edge of the Well of Light, seemingly testing it. After a while, he said, "Not everyone can enter this passage. The energy inside is too potent; at the very least, one’s strength must reach the eighth level to have the ability to protect oneself while passing through this channel."

Eighth level? Many people present gasped.

After the Great War Era, the heritage was lost, the divine bloodlines became increasingly weak, and the average strength of the beastmen plummeted. Let alone the legendary ninth-level Mage God level, even the eighth level had become an unreachable dream for everyone.

Today, almost the highest combat power of the entire Beastman Continent was gathered in this temple, yet those who had truly reached the eighth level could be counted on one hand.

Those who knew their strength was insufficient retreated one after another. In the end, only twelve people remained by the well.

The ninth-level Mage God Ghost Fire Jing, the Southern Alliance leader Ghost Fire Yin, and Nan Rong, the nominal top expert of the Southern Alliance.

The Northern Alliance had its leader, Beixiong Zhen. The East had the Great Chieftain of the East Sea Tribe, Yan Wujin, and Qiao Xidao, the Bug King representing the Bug-men.

The West also had representatives: the War God of the Elephant Kingdom, Bai Xiangfeng, and the treasure-hunting adventurer of the Wing Kingdom, Eagle Wing. There was also a very low-key lone traveler, full name Vida Daro, of the Flying Crocodile tribe.

Finally, there were Shang Feifan and Lang Mu, and the Second Priest of the Priest Palace, Jishui.

Lang Mu couldn't help but think: *This number feels like a perfect coincidence.*

"The passage is open. Are we going in, or what?" the Great Chieftain Yan asked.

Everyone looked at each other.

Shang Feifan stated his position first: "Lang Mu and I are definitely going down to take a look. As for you all, it depends on your own arrangements."

Priest Jishui was very hesitant. The Priest Palace had just experienced a great battle and was in need of stabilization, yet the High Priest had suddenly passed away. If he were to leave as well, he feared...

The other priests were also not in favor of Priest Jishui leaving.

Priest Jishui thought it over and finally took two steps back, exiting the range of the Well of Light.

The Bug King Qiao Xidao let out a hearty laugh. "Count me in."

A new Bug Mother had emerged. Although young, she seemed clear-headed and did not inherit the stubbornness of the previous generation. Not to mention that the new Bug Mother had summoned the hive and bestowed several healthy female bug-people, hatched from the Bug Mother's eggs, upon the Bug-men tribe. The Bug King could be said to have no more worries.

And since the Bug King wanted to advance further to protect more of his clansmen in the impending—perhaps already arrived—great disaster, he naturally would not give up this opportunity that could significantly enhance his own strength.

If he were to die in this exploration of the earth's core, with the new Bug Mother present, he had no need to worry; he had already left messages for the Queen and his clansmen.

Ghost Fire Jing looked at his descendant and said in a gentle but unquestionable tone, "You and Nan Rong don't need to go. The Southern Alliance needs you more."

Ghost Fire Yin thought for a second and did not force it.

Although having a chance to become stronger was good, he felt his heart tremble whenever he looked at that black light well.

Now that even the strongest ancestor suggested that he and Nan Rong should not go, why should he force it?

In any case, if the ancestor gained benefits or became stronger, their Southern Alliance would naturally benefit as well.

Thinking this through, Ghost Fire Yin nodded at Nan Rong.

chunks.chineseText:
南戎心里有点可惜，他其实很好奇地心是什么样，但他也知道老祖不会害他们，更不可能抢夺他们的机缘——老祖肯定是察觉这个机缘危险更高，才会让他们不要去。

北熊震盟主看到南盟主选择不去，心里顿时也生出几分迟疑。

他想变强，想要抓住这次机缘。

可是他是北联盟之主，如果他在地心出了什么事，北联盟虽说不会立刻解体，但在整体实力上肯定要比南联盟弱上三分。

北熊震下意识看向商非凡。他也不知道为什么，会在这时候想要听听这位的意见。

商非凡见北熊盟主看向他，懂了他的意思，略一斟酌，诚恳地说：“这次地心之行，我也没有把握。而且比起得到本源力量，我更想见一见被困住的邪神。”

北熊震心中一惊：“你说邪神也被困在地心？”

商非凡：“我只是有这个怀疑。毕竟那团庞大地底能量出现的太诡异。地心是什么地方？怎么就突然能出现一条直接通往地星的缝隙，还能让人察觉到那股庞大能量？现在更有人说那股能量很可能是本源能量，如果你是天河星神灵，你会让星球的本源能量就这么轻易暴露吗？”

北熊震大惊，随后陷入沉思，片刻后，毫不犹豫地说：“这次地心之行我就不参加了。”

如果这只是邪神想要脱困搞出来的破事，那谁进入地心谁倒霉。

虽然商非凡说了这只是猜测，但北熊震一向是以稳著称的战场指挥家，自然不可能明知是陷阱（极度危险）还往里面跳。

兽人们的耳力绝大多数都不错，商非凡又没有刻意压低声音，其他人自然也听到了他的猜测。

紧跟着决定退出的就是盐大酋长，这位早已安排后路，还等着就算大灾难来临，他也能逃到海上岛屿继续当土皇帝，自然不愿意在这时候冒死亡之险。

如果其他一把手也去的话，说不定他会想要争一争，但现在南北盟主都不去，他还跑去做什么？

正好虫人族虫王要下去看看，他说不定可以借此机会去到虫人族地盘掠夺一番？

不过想到疑似新虫母的那只花虫子，盐大酋长又火速打消了心中贪婪。

商非凡跟虫王交情不错，他不想让虫王冒着死亡危险白跑一趟——如果本源能量是真，他们只会帮助光球得到，其他人就别想分一杯羹。

虫王也是听劝的，尤其他见其他一把手都退出这次探险，心中自然也会多几分思量。

商非凡环视一圈，他对其他人不熟，该说的他已经说了，如果这些人还想跟着去，那就随他们。

光之井的吸引力越来越强，似乎要把在场所有人都吸入进去。

“阿呆，你带着小花花去找曾姥爷，不要留在这里。”商非凡最后叮嘱阿呆。

阿呆忙点头。他的直觉告诉他，这里不能待了！

“你们先走。”郎沐不放心地说。

小花花刚想说有它在，怕什么。

阿呆已经抓住它一只长腿，施展瞬移，咻地跑了。

“诸位，后会有期！”

商非凡用母国礼仪一抱拳，握住郎沐的手，和他一同踏入泛着黑色光芒的光之井通道。

其他大佬目送两人身影消失在光之井中。

鹰之翼原本并不想进入光之井，那么多大佬都打算退出，他又何必找死？

虽然他是寻宝冒险者，但他也很珍惜自己的小命。

可他感到自己似乎听到了某种召唤，他不由自主地就靠近光之井，等他反应过来时，他已经跳了进去。

众人见鹰之翼竟然跟着进入光之井，虽然惊讶，但也没有人去阻止他。

最让人惊讶的是那位独行客维达达罗，他闷不吭声地也进入了光之井。

鬼火镜是最后一个进入光之井的。

之后再无他人进入。

汲水祭司轻叹一声：“大家没有感到越来越强的吸力吗？如果不想进入地心，也许赶紧离开神殿才是上策。”

众人没有二话，跟着祭司宫的祭司们迅速退出神殿。

就在众人退出神殿的一刹那，神殿就变成了一团光影，看似还在那里，却再也没有人能够进入。

有人后悔，总觉得自己失去了一个绝世机缘。

但也有人庆幸，庆幸自己可能逃脱了一个必死之局。

另一边，商非凡和郎沐刚刚进入光之井。

刹那间，所有声音都消失了。

世界仿佛被抽成真空，耳膜被某种无形的力量压迫着，连心跳都变得迟缓。

他们并没有下坠感，而是在被某种粘稠的力量拉扯、吞噬。四周不再是神殿的景象，而是一片扭曲的黑暗，偶尔闪过几缕暗金色的纹路，像某种庞然大物的血管在蠕动。

“这不是普通的空间通道……”商非凡的声音在郎沐脑海中直接响起。

“我好像感觉到了邪神意识的污染？这是邪神意识留下的污染吗？”郎沐眼中闪过紧张，他在进入通道后就听到了无数声音，比在雕像广场时听到的还要噪杂。

还好他现在的精神力已经大大提升，又有商非凡的精神力护航，他只要屏蔽这些噪杂声音就好。

“啧，天河星最高意识这个牢笼不行啊，竟然让邪神意识泄露出来这么多。”商非凡把自己的精神力和郎沐纠缠。

黑暗突然裂开一道缝隙。

他们看到了“外面”。

那是一片无法形容的混沌，无数破碎的时空碎片漂浮着，有的映照出远古战场的残影，有的则是未来某个时刻的毁灭。

一座由骸骨堆积而成的巨城在虚空中沉浮，城门处悬挂着一颗仍在跳动的心脏，每一次收缩都让周围的黑暗震颤。

“那是什么鬼东西？”商非凡嘀咕。

郎沐猜测：“神灵的异度空间？”

“大概又是哪个被污染导致意识混乱的神。”商非凡说。

突然，一只巨大的苍白手掌从黑暗中伸出，指尖几乎擦过两人的身体。那手掌漆黑腐烂，掌心处镶嵌着一颗腐烂的眼球，正缓缓转动，盯向他们。

“别看它！”商非凡伸手遮住郎沐的眼睛，精神力如刀锋般斩出，那只手掌瞬间崩解成灰烬，但腐烂的眼球却仍悬浮在原地，死死凝视着他们。

郎沐心知这就是通道的考验，如果实力低微、精神力也不强大者，很容易就会陨落在这条通道中。

随着腐烂巨掌的消失，通道开始震荡，黑暗如潮水般翻涌，一股狂暴的吸力骤然袭来，两人的身影如落叶般被狠狠甩向更深处。

“轰！”

黑暗突然撕裂。

他们坠入了一片……难以形容的世界。
chunks.englishText:
Nan Rong felt a twinge of regret. He was actually quite curious about what the Earth's core looked like, but he knew the Old Ancestor wouldn't harm them, nor would he steal their opportunities—the Old Ancestor must have sensed that the danger level of this opportunity was too high, which was why he told them not to go.

Seeing that the Southern Alliance Leader had chosen not to go, the Northern Alliance Leader, Bei Xiong Zhen, felt a surge of hesitation.

He wanted to become stronger; he wanted to seize this opportunity.

However, he was the leader of the Northern Alliance. If something happened to him at the Earth's core, while the Northern Alliance wouldn't disintegrate immediately, its overall strength would certainly be weakened by at least thirty percent.

Bei Xiong Zhen subconsciously looked toward Shang Feifan. He didn't know why he wanted to hear this man's opinion at a time like this.

Seeing the Northern Alliance Leader looking at him, Shang Feifan understood his intent. After a moment of deliberation, he said sincerely, "I have no certainty about this trip to the Earth's core. Moreover, rather than obtaining the Source Energy, I am more interested in seeing the trapped Evil God."

Bei Xiong Zhen was startled. "You're saying the Evil God is also trapped in the Earth's core?"

Shang Feifan replied, "I only suspect it. After all, that massive underground energy appeared too strangely. What kind of place is the Earth's core? How could a rift leading directly to the surface suddenly appear, and how could that massive energy be detected so easily? Now, some are even saying that energy is likely Source Energy. If you were a deity of the Tianhe Star, would you let the planet's Source Energy be exposed so easily?"

Bei Xiong Zhen was shocked, then fell into deep thought. A moment later, he said without hesitation, "I will not be participating in this trip to the Earth's core."

If this was just some scheme cooked up by the Evil God to break free, then whoever entered the Earth's core would be the one to suffer.

Although Shang Feifan said it was just a guess, Bei Xiong Zhen had always been known as a steady battlefield commander; naturally, he wouldn't jump into a trap (or an extremely dangerous situation) knowing what it was.

Most Orcs had excellent hearing, and since Shang Feifan hadn't deliberately lowered his voice, the others naturally heard his speculation.

The next to decide to withdraw was the Great Chieftain Yan. He had already arranged his escape routes, waiting for the day the great catastrophe arrived so he could flee to the islands in the sea and continue being a local despot; naturally, he wasn't willing to risk his life at this moment.

If the other top leaders were going, he might have wanted to compete, but now that neither the Southern nor Northern Alliance leaders were going, why should he bother?

It just so happened that the Insect King of the Insectoid race was going down to take a look; perhaps he could take this opportunity to go to the Insectoid territory and plunder a bit?

However, thinking of that flower-bug which was suspected to be the new Insect Mother, Great Chieftain Yan quickly dismissed the greed in his heart.

Shang Feifan had a decent friendship with the Insect King, and he didn't want the Insect King to risk his life for nothing—if the Source Energy was real, they would only help the light orb obtain it; no one else would get a share.

The Insect King was also someone who listened to advice, especially since he saw the other top leaders withdrawing from this expedition, which naturally gave him more to consider.

Shang Feifan looked around. He wasn't familiar with the others, and he had said what he needed to say. If these people still wanted to follow, that was their business.

The pull of the Well of Light was growing stronger, as if it wanted to suck everyone present inside.

"A-Dai, take Little Flower and go find Great-Grandpa. Don't stay here," Shang Feifan instructed A-Dai one last time.

A-Dai nodded hurriedly. His intuition told him that he couldn't stay here!

"You go first," Lang Mu said, feeling uneasy.

Little Flower was just about to say that with it around, what was there to fear?

But A-Dai had already grabbed one of its long legs, activated teleportation, and *whooshed* away.

"Everyone, until we meet again!"

Shang Feifan cupped his fists in the traditional salute of his homeland, took Lang Mu's hand, and stepped into the black-glowing passage of the Well of Light together.

The other big shots watched as their figures disappeared into the Well of Light.

Ying Zhiyi (Eagle Wing) originally hadn't wanted to enter the Well of Light. So many big shots were planning to withdraw, so why should he seek death?

Although he was a treasure-hunting adventurer, he cherished his own life.

But he felt as if he had heard some kind of summons. He moved toward the Well of Light involuntarily, and by the time he realized it, he had already jumped in.

Seeing that Ying Zhiyi had actually followed them into the Well of Light, the crowd was surprised, but no one stopped him.

The most surprising thing was that the lone traveler, Vi Dadalo, also entered the Well of Light without a word.

Ghostfire Mirror was the last to enter the Well of Light.

After that, no one else entered.

Priest Jishui sighed softly, "Don't you all feel the suction getting stronger? If you don't want to enter the Earth's core, perhaps leaving the temple immediately is the best policy."

Without another word, the crowd followed the priests of the Priest Palace and quickly retreated from the temple.

The moment they exited the temple, it turned into a blur of light and shadow. It looked like it was still there, but no one could ever enter it again.

Some felt regret, feeling they had lost a peerless opportunity.

But others felt fortunate, glad they might have escaped a certain-death scenario.

On the other side, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had just entered the Well of Light.

In an instant, all sound vanished.

The world seemed to have been evacuated into a vacuum. Their eardrums were pressed by some invisible force, and even their heartbeats became sluggish.

They didn't feel a sensation of falling; rather, they were being pulled and swallowed by some viscous force. The surroundings were no longer the scene of the temple, but a twisted darkness, occasionally flashing with streaks of dark gold patterns, like the veins of some gargantuan creature writhing.

"This isn't an ordinary space passage..." Shang Feifan's voice resonated directly in Lang Mu's mind.

"I think I feel the pollution of the Evil God's consciousness? Is this the pollution left behind by the Evil God?" Lang Mu's eyes flashed with tension. He had heard countless voices after entering the passage, even noisier than what he heard at the statue plaza.

Fortunately, his spiritual power had greatly improved, and with Shang Feifan's spiritual power escorting him, he only needed to block out these noisy sounds.

"Tsk, the cage of the Tianhe Star's supreme consciousness is useless; it actually let so much of the Evil God's consciousness leak out." Shang Feifan intertwined his spiritual power with Lang Mu's.

The darkness suddenly cracked open a fissure.

They saw the "outside."

It was an indescribable chaos, with countless shattered fragments of space floating about. Some reflected the shadows of ancient battlefields, while others showed the destruction of some future moment.

A giant city made of piled-up bones floated in the void, and a still-beating heart hung at the city gate. Every contraction made the surrounding darkness tremble.

"What the hell is that?" Shang Feifan muttered.

Lang Mu guessed, "A deity's extradimensional space?"

"Probably another god whose consciousness became chaotic due to pollution," Shang Feifan said.

Suddenly, a giant, pale palm reached out from the darkness, its fingertips nearly brushing their bodies. The palm was pitch-black and rotting, with a decaying eyeball embedded in the center, slowly rotating to stare at them.

"Don't look at it!" Shang Feifan reached out to cover Lang Mu's eyes. His spiritual power slashed out like a blade, and the palm instantly disintegrated into ash, but the rotting eyeball remained suspended in place, staring fixedly at them.

Lang Mu knew this was the trial of the passage. If one's strength was low and their spiritual power wasn't strong, it would be very easy to perish in this passage.

As the giant rotting palm disappeared, the passage began to shake. The darkness surged like a tide, and a violent suction force suddenly struck, throwing their figures like fallen leaves toward the deeper reaches.

"Boom!"

The darkness suddenly tore apart.

They fell into a... world that defied description.

chunks.chineseText:
第282章 见到邪神

这里没有天空，没有大地，有的只是无边无际的黑色怒海。

身体感受的是极致的寒冷。

怒海沸腾，似没有一刻的停歇。

巨浪滔天，一道浪峰比一道浪峰更高，你追我赶，宛如在厮杀。

浪峰最少都高达七八十米，有的甚至高达几百米，当你仰头看去，宛如看到一座座巨浪形成的巨大山脉，正以毁天灭地的气势向你脸上砸落。

如此天地伟力，让任何生灵都不禁心生恐惧和敬畏。

商非凡和郎沐两人不得不竖起能量壁来阻挡扑面而来的海水。

冰冷刺骨的水汽弥漫，稍微沾上就能把人冻成冰霜。

而他们现在就站在一座占地不大的岛屿上。

“地心原来竟是这个样子。”一声悠长的叹息在两人耳边响起。

鬼火镜来了。

商非凡和郎沐对鬼火镜会跟进来一事并不感到惊讶，单从实力说，鬼火镜也是最可能跟进来的人。

维达达罗收起翅膀，缓缓落在三人身边，他的脸色有些难看，身上还有血迹，显然那条空间通道他过得并不轻松。

最后一个落到他们身边的是鹰之翼。

郎沐有点惊讶，他能感觉出鹰之翼的实力也就将将达到八级，没想到对方竟然也有勇气闯入地心。不过想到对方是专门寻找遗迹挖掘宝贝的寻宝冒险者，又觉得他会冒险跟进来也不奇怪。

商非凡目光扫过鹰之翼，神情似笑非笑。

鹰之翼表面不动声色，暗中却握紧了双拳。他又好像失去了一小段记忆，他记得自己像是被什么吸引一样，不由自主地跳入光之井，但后面他到底是怎么来到这里的却毫无印象。

浪涛的轰鸣声震耳欲聋，仿佛整个世界都在怒吼。

抬头往上看，看不到天空，只有翻滚的黑色云雾，偶尔闪过猩红色的雷光，照亮这片狂暴的海洋。

如果不是知道自己是来自地面，而这里是地心，大约任谁也不会想到这里是星球最中心。

地心怒海中不仅有海水和巨浪，还有无数座嶙峋狰狞的岩石岛屿，一个个奇形怪状，宛如被封印的怪物。

这些由岩石构成的岛屿全都光秃秃，不见半点植物。

郎沐忽然眼眸收缩，就在刚刚，他亲眼看到随着一道巨浪的冲击拍打，一座看似坚硬的岩石岛屿竟然就那么崩塌碎裂。

而这并不是唯一一座被巨浪摧毁的岛屿。

“哗啦——”

“轰——！”

五人一起看向那道高达数百米的灭世巨浪，想象着这样的巨浪出现在地面会造成怎样可怕的灾难。

巨浪无情地扑向它正前方的一座岛屿，似乎怒其拦路，瞬间将其拍得粉碎，碎石飞溅，又在下一个浪头中被彻底吞没。

而在不远处，海面突然隆起，新的岩石从深海底部浮出，迅速冷却、凝固，形成新的岛屿。毁灭与新生，在这里不过是瞬息之间的事。

五人保持着沉默，实际上他们都在尽全力抵抗一道道巨浪袭击过来产生的巨大水力。

他们下意识都知道不能让那些冰冷刺骨的海水碰触到他们。

但只是这样抵抗也毫无意义。

商非凡低喃：“果然，在地面发现一条通往地心的地裂缝隙，更发现地心有庞大能量的说法，就是谎言。”

看起来少言寡语的维达达罗也忍不住说了一句：“这一定是邪神的蛊惑。”

商非凡觉得也是。

邪神厄穆克拉索一直都在想办法脱困。

祂之前还弄出一个假预言，想要利用命运之子郎沐寻找到去往其他大陆的空间通道，借此把自己的力量延伸到其他大陆，从而污染更多生命，好攫取更多的精神力和各种负面能量。

可他和郎沐堪破了那个假预言，更没有被祭司宫以大义之名绑架，反而是另开赛道，设法解决大陆的岩浆爆发危机。

厄穆克拉索一计不成，就干脆蛊惑被战神神格碎片夺舍的大祭司，想把他们诱惑到地心世界。

当然，厄穆克拉索显然也很明白鸡蛋不能放在一个篮子里的道理，祂又安排了另外一条乃至数条可以帮助祂脱困的路线——广撒网多捞鱼，能捞上一条是一条。就算不能帮祂脱困，诱惑来做口粮也不亏。

商非凡身体突然往旁边一闪。

维达达罗竟然无声无息地突然攻击他！

此刻维达达罗只看到自己脚下踩着的岛屿被巨浪击碎，他的身体猛然下坠。

天空消失了，海面消失了，脚下不再是浮岛，而是一片虚无的深渊。

他疯狂坠落，耳边是呼啸的风声，可无论怎么坠落，都触碰不到底。突然，他瞥见下方浮现出一张巨大的人脸，正是商非凡的脸，只是那双眼睛漆黑如墨，嘴角裂开至耳根，露出森然冷笑：

“你永远……逃不出去。”

维达达罗怒吼一声，双拳燃起暴烈的力量，猛地朝那张脸轰去。

可他的力量如泥牛入海，毫无回应。他的身体仍在坠落，而深渊深处，无数苍白的手臂伸出，朝他抓来……

鹰之翼的视野骤然扭曲，他发现自己再度失去一段时间的记忆，睁开眼就被钉在一座孤岛上。

四周海水化作粘稠的鲜血，巨浪拍打而来时，血水溅在他身上，竟如腐蚀性毒液般灼烧皮肤。

他试图振翅逃离，可背后羽翼早已折断，黑色羽毛更被血海腐蚀消融。

天空中的黑云裂开，一只巨大的血色眼瞳俯瞰着他，瞳孔深处传来邪神的低语：

“抓住你了。你永远逃不开我……”

鹰之翼嘶吼着挣扎，可血海突然翻涌，无数具与他长相相同的尸体漂浮上来，每一具都睁着空洞的眼睛，死死盯着他。

鹰之翼恍然记起，他已经生生死死无数个轮回，而这不过是又一次新的轮回……

鬼火镜神色微妙地低头，他看到脚下的浮岛化作焦黑骸骨，而他自己从脚底开始正在燃烧。

蓝色的灵魂之火不受控制地从体内喷涌而出，火焰越烧越旺，可诡异的是，他感觉不到疼痛，只感到一种冰冷的吞噬感。

他低头看向自己的手掌，皮肤寸寸剥落，露出森森白骨，而火焰中，一张嘴缓缓浮现，一张一合地讥讽道：

“你本就是祭品……何必挣扎？”

鬼火镜低喃：“原来这就是邪神意识的污染吗？那我现在看到的到底是幻觉还是真实？”

“真麻烦呀。”鬼火镜叹息一声，身体陡然拔高。

郎沐的耳边忽然安静下来，海浪声消失了，取而代之的是一阵细微的、如同砂砾摩擦的低语。

他转头，发现商非凡不见了，鬼火镜、维达达罗、鹰之翼也消失了，整片怒海竟化作一片死寂的荒漠，而荒漠中央……站着一个人影。

那人缓缓转身，露出一张综合了商非凡、洛伦米尔顿、奥尔，三人身上所有优点的俊美脸庞，那种俊美甚至已经超越了人的概念，让郎沐看得只想呕吐。

俊美的男人一双眼睛里没有瞳孔，只有一片漆黑的漩涡。

“你终于来了……”那人声音轻柔，像是在他耳边低语。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 282: Meeting the Evil God

There was no sky here, no earth—only an endless, black, raging sea.

Their bodies felt extreme cold.

The raging sea boiled, as if it never rested for a single moment.

Giant waves towered, one peak chasing another, as if they were locked in a life-and-death struggle.

The wave peaks were at least seventy or eighty meters high, some even reaching hundreds of meters. When you looked up, it was like seeing massive mountain ranges formed by giant waves, crashing down upon you with the force of world-ending destruction.

Such raw power of nature made any living creature feel fear and awe.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had to erect energy barriers to block the seawater crashing toward them.

Icy, bone-chilling mist permeated the air; even a slight touch could freeze a person into frost.

And they were currently standing on a small island.

"So, this is what the Earth's core is actually like." A long, drawn-out sigh sounded in their ears.

Ghostfire Mirror had arrived.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were not surprised that Ghostfire Mirror had followed them in. In terms of pure strength, Ghostfire Mirror was the most likely person to have followed.

Vi Dadalo retracted his wings and landed slowly beside the three. His face looked somewhat ugly, and there were bloodstains on his body; clearly, he hadn't had an easy time passing through that space passage.

The last to land beside them was Ying Zhiyi.

Lang Mu was a bit surprised. He could sense that Ying Zhiyi's strength was barely at the eighth level; he hadn't expected the man to have the courage to break into the Earth's core. However, thinking that he was a treasure-hunting adventurer who specialized in excavating ruins, it wasn't strange that he would risk following them in.

Shang Feifan swept his gaze over Ying Zhiyi, his expression ambiguous.

Ying Zhiyi remained outwardly calm, but secretly, he clenched his fists. He felt as if he had lost another small fragment of memory. He remembered being attracted by something and jumping into the Well of Light involuntarily, but he had no impression of how he actually arrived here afterward.

The roar of the waves was deafening, as if the entire world were bellowing in rage.

Looking up, they couldn't see the sky, only rolling black clouds with occasional flashes of scarlet lightning illuminating this violent ocean.

If they didn't know they had come from the surface and that this was the Earth's core, no one would ever guess this was the very center of the planet.

The raging sea of the Earth's core contained not only seawater and giant waves but also countless craggy, hideous rock islands, each with strange shapes, as if they were sealed monsters.

These islands, composed of rock, were all barren, without a single plant in sight.

Lang Mu's pupils suddenly constricted. Just a moment ago, he had watched with his own eyes as a seemingly solid rock island collapsed and shattered under the impact of a giant wave.

And this was not the only island destroyed by the waves.

"Splash—"

"Boom—!"

The five of them looked together at a massive wave hundreds of meters high, imagining what kind of terrible disaster such a wave would cause if it appeared on the surface.

The giant wave mercilessly slammed into an island directly in its path, as if angry at it for blocking the way, instantly smashing it to pieces. Debris flew everywhere, only to be completely swallowed by the next wave.

Not far away, the sea surface suddenly bulged, and new rock emerged from the deep seabed, rapidly cooling and solidifying to form a new island. Destruction and rebirth were matters of mere moments here.

The five remained silent; in truth, they were all exerting their full strength to resist the immense water pressure generated by the successive waves.

Subconsciously, they all knew they couldn't let that bone-chilling seawater touch them.

But resisting like this was meaningless.

Shang Feifan murmured, "As expected, the claim that a rift leading to the Earth's core was discovered on the surface, and that there was massive energy at the core, was a lie."

Vi Dadalo, who usually spoke little, couldn't help but add, "This must be the Evil God's deception."

Shang Feifan agreed.

The Evil God, Umuklaso, had always been trying to find a way to break free.

He had previously concocted a fake prophecy, trying to use the Child of Destiny, Lang Mu, to find a space passage to other continents, thereby extending his power to those lands to pollute more life and harvest more spiritual power and negative energy.

But he and Lang Mu had seen through that fake prophecy and had not been kidnapped by the Priest Palace under the guise of "righteousness." Instead, they had taken a different path, finding ways to solve the continent's volcanic eruption crisis.

When one plan failed, Umuklaso simply seduced the High Priest—who had been possessed by a fragment of the War God's divinity—hoping to lure them into the Earth's core world.

Of course, Umuklaso clearly understood that one shouldn't put all their eggs in one basket. He had arranged another, perhaps several, routes that could help him escape—casting a wide net to catch fish; if he could catch even one, it was worth it. Even if it couldn't help him escape, luring them in as food wasn't a loss.

Shang Feifan suddenly dodged to the side.

Vi Dadalo had suddenly attacked him without a sound!

At this moment, Vi Dadalo only saw the island beneath his feet being shattered by a giant wave, and his body plummeted.

The sky vanished, the sea surface vanished; beneath his feet was no longer a floating island, but a void of abyss.

He fell frantically, the sound of whistling wind in his ears, but no matter how he fell, he couldn't touch the bottom. Suddenly, he caught a glimpse of a giant human face emerging from below—it was Shang Feifan's face, but those eyes were pitch-black like ink, and the corners of the mouth were split to the ears, revealing a grim, cold sneer:

"You will never... escape."

Vi Dadalo roared, his fists igniting with violent power, and he slammed them toward that face.

But his power was like a clay ox entering the sea, meeting no response. His body continued to fall, and from the depths of the abyss, countless pale arms reached out to grab him...

Ying Zhiyi's vision suddenly twisted. He discovered he had lost another period of memory; when he opened his eyes, he was nailed to a lonely island.

The surrounding seawater had turned into viscous blood. When the giant waves crashed down, the bloody water splashed onto him, burning his skin like corrosive poison.

He tried to flap his wings to escape, but the wings on his back were already broken, and the black feathers were being corroded and dissolved by the sea of blood.

The black clouds in the sky split open, and a giant blood-red eyeball looked down at him. From the depths of the pupil came the Evil God's whisper:

"Caught you. You can never escape me..."

Ying Zhiyi roared and struggled, but the sea of blood suddenly surged, and countless corpses that looked exactly like him floated up. Each one had hollow eyes, staring fixedly at him.

Ying Zhiyi suddenly remembered that he had lived and died through countless cycles, and this was merely another new cycle...

Ghostfire Mirror looked down with a subtle expression. He saw the floating island beneath his feet turn into charred bones, and he himself was burning from the soles of his feet upward.

Blue soul-fire erupted from his body uncontrollably. The flames burned brighter and brighter, but strangely, he felt no pain—only a cold sensation of being devoured.

He looked down at his palms; the skin peeled away inch by inch, revealing ghastly white bones. Within the flames, a mouth slowly emerged, opening and closing in mockery:

"You were always a sacrifice... why struggle?"

Ghostfire Mirror murmured, "So this is the pollution of the Evil God's consciousness? Is what I'm seeing now a hallucination, or is it real?"

"How troublesome," Ghostfire Mirror sighed, his body suddenly rising.

Lang Mu's ears suddenly went quiet. The sound of the waves disappeared, replaced by a faint whisper like the friction of sand.

He turned his head and found that Shang Feifan was gone. Ghostfire Mirror, Vi Dadalo, and Ying Zhiyi had also vanished. The entire raging sea had turned into a dead, silent desert, and in the center of the desert... stood a figure.

The person turned slowly, revealing a handsome face that combined all the merits of Shang Feifan, Loren Milton, and Or. That beauty transcended the concept of humanity, making Lang Mu feel like vomiting just looking at it.

The handsome man had no pupils in his eyes, only pitch-black vortices.

"You finally came..." The man's voice was soft, like a whisper right in his ear.

chunks.chineseText:
对方伸出手，深情地说：“我已经等了你很久很久，我才是你真正的归宿，来吧，和我融为一体。”

郎沐嘴角抽了抽。他想这位邪神九成九没有谈过恋爱，否则不会说出如此脑残的话，用的还是咏叹调。

商非凡一连躲过维达达罗、鬼火镜和鹰之翼三人的攻击，想要去拉郎沐，却被他家阿沐一拳头砸在脸上。

商非凡：“……”我冤！

好在郎沐砸了他一拳后，被他郁闷又委屈的精神力一刺激，顿时清醒过来，看清砸的人到底是谁后，讪笑：“疼吗？”

商非凡沉默地掏出一支笔在眼睛上画了一只圈。

郎沐忍不住噗嗤笑出声。

“咦？鬼火镜他们呢？”郎沐这才发现刚才还在他们身边的鬼火镜三人竟然都消失了。

商非凡顶着黑眼圈说：“他们攻击我后就消失了，应该是被邪神力量给拉入了某个异度空间。”

见郎沐担心的皱起眉头，商非凡下意识伸手想要抚平：“先别担心别人了，他们既然选择跟进来，就要承担起自己选择的后果。我们虽然不受邪神意识的污染，但也只是现在而已。更何况说不定我们后面还得对上……”

郎沐在心里接话：天河星最高意识。

【当当当！奇遇任务发布！】

光球活泼又嚣张的声音突然在商非凡脑中响起。

【你找到了世界本源能量的线索，一路寻找到地心世界。你在这里感知到邪神的污染，怀疑邪神厄穆克拉索就被封印在此处，你想要帮助本世界解决厄穆克拉索这个大-麻烦。请首先找到厄穆克拉索被封印的地点。奖励虫母最后的心脏碎片一枚。】

商非凡挑眉。没想到光球竟然在这时候给他发布任务。

但很快商非凡就明白了，光球正在通过这种方式，暗搓搓地提醒他如何找到邪神——他的游戏小地图中-出现了一个红色亮点。

那个红色亮点距离他们还很远，但至少有了方向。

与此同时，商非凡的精神力猛地一颤，一股阴冷而庞大的意识正试图侵入他的脑海，如毒蛇般缠绕向他的神经。

“你来了……”

“滚！”

商非凡毫不留情地就用精神力刀把那股意识砍出大脑。

厄穆克拉索也是能屈能伸，竟然没有发怒，而是在商非凡眼前留下了一只手指。

那手指骨节粗大、上面还有浓密的汗毛，指甲尖锐，断口新鲜，像是被人刚刚斩断一样。

手指浮空，指尖指向怒海深处。

随着指尖的方向看去，一条暗红色的路线……由破碎岛屿连接而成的路，在巨浪之中时隐时现，蜿蜒着通向海的最深处。

郎沐也看到了这根手指。

“邪神？”

“就是祂。这位像是生怕我们找不到封印祂的地点。”

“能信任吗？”郎沐总觉得他们不应该和邪神合作。

商非凡看向小地图中的红色光点所在，和手指指出的路线方向一致。

“可以一试。”他说。

郎沐生出新的担忧，盯着那条在狂浪中若隐若现的路，声音低沉：“问题是……我们要如何通过那些威力惊人的滔天巨浪，而且那些岛屿随时会崩塌消失。这地心怒海的海水温度不对劲，如果我们直接接触，恐怕坚持不了多久。”

“都到这时候了，也只能拼了。”商非凡舔了舔嘴唇，握紧郎沐的手：“怕吗？”

郎沐抬头看商非凡，毫不犹豫地摇头：“那就走吧，你开路，我掩护。”

“走！”商非凡唇角勾起一抹危险的弧度，下一秒，他猛然拽住郎沐，身形如鬼魅般冲向路线指示的第一座岛屿。

“轰——！！”

几乎就在他们踏上岩石的瞬间，一道百米巨浪从侧面席卷而来，岛屿剧烈摇晃，边缘已经开始崩裂。商非凡没有停留，脚下发力，在碎石坠海的刹那，带着郎沐一跃而起，精准地落在下一座浮岛之上。

“哗啦——！”

他们刚离开，原先的岛屿就被巨浪彻底拍碎，沉入怒海。

商非凡和郎沐踏上了第三座岩石礁，脚下岩石触感冰冷而粗糙，像是某种远古巨兽的骸骨碎片。

“咔嚓——”

还没等他们站稳，落脚处突然崩裂，整块浮岛在巨浪的冲击下骤然解体！

商非凡眼神一厉，抓着郎沐手腕不放，精神力凝聚成无形的踏足点，两人在半空中猛然一蹬，跃向下一块浮岛。

郎沐则一直手持法杖，施展魔法护罩抵御那些巨浪和冰冷至极的海水。

跳跃途中。

“轰——！”

一道超越百米高的超大巨浪排山倒海般砸来，浪尖裹挟着碎裂的岩石，如同千万把利刃横扫而过！

商非凡冷哼一声，漆黑长刀出鞘，刀光如雷霆劈落，竟硬生生将巨浪斩成两半！

郎沐趁机带着他穿过巨浪跳向附近一座岛屿。

就这样，两人在不断重复的毁灭与新生的夹缝中疾行。

反反复复，一次又一次与死亡擦肩而过。

两人都不知道已经通过了多少道巨浪，又通过了多少座岩石岛屿。

感觉这好像就是一场遥远没有尽头的折磨之旅。

如果只有一个人，说不定他们早就木了。

到后来他们直接就失去了时间观念。

冰冷到炙热！

郎沐一个疏忽，加上有点力竭，竟然让溅起的浪花触及手背。

仅仅是一刹那，他的皮肤就瞬间凝结出一层冰霜，寒意一层层下降，把他的骨骼都冰冻住！

郎沐忍住没跟商非凡说，迅速对自己施展解冻魔法，硬生生将寒气逼退，但那只倒霉左手仍被冻得发青。

这海水简直跟地星传说中的冥河一样，一滴水珠，就可冻结灵魂。

“就快了。”商非凡眼睛紧紧盯着前方的巨浪，寻找最适合的跳跃时机。

他们无法从海面上飞行，刚才他们尝试了，结果“天空”就降下了无数闪电霹雳，简直跟渡劫一样，恨不得把他们劈得身魂俱灭。

他们的力量根本无法与这样的天地至威比拟。

只能乖乖遵循“游戏规则”，重新进入怒海中，继续跳格子。

“哥，哥救救我！”

海浪声中，一个熟悉的声音焦急传来，像是从深海最底层浮起的气泡，带着说不出的模糊。

郎沐猛然转头，瞳孔骤缩——

海面上，漂浮着一张巨大的、由水雾凝聚而成的脸，那是雷米尔。

雷米尔正在对他们嘶喊，表情焦急又悲痛。

“哥，邪神信徒抓住了我，他们要献祭我！哥，救救我，我都想起来了，我不该是这样，我和你的关系比谁都要亲密！哥，救救我！”

“别听！”商非凡厉喝，精神力如刀横扫，瞬间将幻象斩碎。

然而，邪神的污染无孔不入。

海水蒸腾的雾气中，无数扭曲的身影浮现，它们在浪尖起舞，在岛屿的阴影里低语，甚至……直接从两人的影子里爬出！

每一个都是两人记忆里的熟人，都是他们在乎的人。

商非凡的精神力包裹住郎沐的精神海，给他建立起一重重坚固的防护墙。
chunks.englishText:
The entity extended a hand, speaking with deep affection: "I have waited for you for a very, very long time. I am your true destination. Come, merge with me and become one."

Lang Mu’s mouth twitched. He figured this Evil God had likely never been in a relationship; otherwise, he wouldn't be spouting such brain-dead lines, and in an aria-like tone at that.

Shang Feifan dodged the attacks of Vidadalo, Ghostfire Mirror, and Eagle Wing in quick succession, attempting to reach out and pull Lang Mu toward him, only to have his face smacked by a fist from his beloved A-Mu.

Shang Feifan: "..." I’ve been wronged!

Fortunately, after landing that punch, the stimulation of Shang Feifan’s depressed and aggrieved mental energy snapped Lang Mu back to his senses. Seeing exactly who he had hit, he gave a sheepish laugh: "Does it hurt?"

Shang Feifan silently pulled out a pen and drew a circle around his eye.

Lang Mu couldn't help but burst into laughter.

"Huh? Where are Ghostfire Mirror and the others?" Lang Mu only then realized that the three who had been right beside them moments ago had vanished.

Shang Feifan, sporting his black eye, said, "They disappeared right after attacking me. They were likely pulled into some alternate dimension by the Evil God’s power."

Seeing Lang Mu’s brow furrow with worry, Shang Feifan instinctively reached out to smooth it: "Stop worrying about others for now. Since they chose to follow us in, they must bear the consequences of their own choices. We aren't being corrupted by the Evil God’s consciousness yet, but that’s only for the moment. Besides, we might have to face something even worse later..."

Lang Mu finished the thought in his mind: The supreme consciousness of the Sky River Star.

【Ding! Adventure Quest Issued!】

The light orb’s lively and arrogant voice suddenly rang out in Shang Feifan’s mind.

【You have found clues to the world’s origin energy and tracked them all the way to the core of the world. You have sensed the Evil God’s corruption here and suspect that the Evil God, Ermuklaso, is sealed in this location. You wish to help this world resolve the great trouble that is Ermuklaso. Please first locate the site where Ermuklaso is sealed. Reward: One fragment of the Insect Mother’s final heart.】

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. He hadn't expected the light orb to issue a quest at a time like this.

But he soon understood; the light orb was using this method to subtly remind him how to find the Evil God—a red dot had appeared on his game mini-map.

That red dot was still far away, but at least they had a direction.

At the same time, Shang Feifan’s mental energy shuddered violently as a cold, vast consciousness attempted to invade his mind, coiling around his nerves like a venomous snake.

"You have come..."

"Get lost!"

Shang Feifan ruthlessly used a blade of mental energy to hack that consciousness out of his brain.

Ermuklaso was surprisingly flexible; instead of flying into a rage, it left a finger right before Shang Feifan’s eyes.

The finger was thick-knotted with dense hair, sharp-nailed, and the stump was fresh, as if it had just been severed.

The finger floated in mid-air, its tip pointing into the depths of the Raging Sea.

Following the direction of the fingertip, a dark red route—a path formed by connected, shattered islands—flickered in and out of existence amidst the giant waves, winding toward the deepest part of the sea.

Lang Mu saw the finger as well.

"The Evil God?"

"It is Him. He seems terrified that we won't find the location where He is sealed."

"Can we trust it?" Lang Mu always felt they shouldn't cooperate with an Evil God.

Shang Feifan looked at the red dot on his mini-map; it aligned perfectly with the route indicated by the finger.

"It’s worth a try," he said.

Lang Mu felt a new wave of worry. He stared at the path flickering in the wild waves, his voice low: "The problem is... how are we to cross those terrifying, heaven-shaking waves? And those islands could collapse and vanish at any moment. The temperature of this core-world Raging Sea is wrong; if we make direct contact, I fear we won't last long."

"We’ve come this far, we have no choice but to push through." Shang Feifan licked his lips and gripped Lang Mu’s hand tightly: "Are you afraid?"

Lang Mu looked up at Shang Feifan and shook his head without hesitation: "Then let’s go. You clear the path, I’ll provide cover."

"Let’s move!" A dangerous arc curled at the corners of Shang Feifan’s lips. The next second, he yanked Lang Mu, his figure darting toward the first island indicated by the route like a ghost.

"BOOM—!!"

Almost the moment they stepped onto the rock, a hundred-meter wave swept in from the side. The island shook violently, its edges beginning to crumble. Shang Feifan didn't stop; he pushed off with his feet, and the moment the debris fell into the sea, he leaped up with Lang Mu, landing precisely on the next floating island.

"SPLASH—!"

The moment they left, the original island was completely pulverized by the giant wave and sank into the Raging Sea.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu stepped onto the third reef. The rock beneath their feet felt cold and rough, like the bone fragments of some ancient behemoth.

"CRACK—"

Before they could even stand steady, the ground beneath them suddenly split. The entire floating island disintegrated under the impact of the giant waves!

Shang Feifan’s eyes sharpened. He didn't let go of Lang Mu’s wrist, condensing his mental energy into an invisible foothold. The two of them kicked off mid-air, leaping toward the next island.

Lang Mu kept his staff raised, casting a magical barrier to ward off the giant waves and the bone-chilling seawater.

Mid-leap.

"BOOM—!"

A massive wave, over a hundred meters high, crashed down like an avalanche. The crest of the wave was laden with shattered rock, sweeping across like thousands of sharp blades!

Shang Feifan let out a cold snort. His pitch-black blade left its sheath, the light of the blade striking like thunder, actually cleaving the giant wave in two!

Lang Mu took the opportunity to pass through the wave and leap to a nearby island.

Just like that, the two of them sped through the narrow gaps between constant destruction and rebirth.

Over and over, they brushed against death time and time again.

Neither of them knew how many giant waves they had passed or how many rocky islands they had traversed.

It felt like a long, endless journey of torture.

If they were alone, they might have gone numb long ago.

Eventually, they lost all sense of time.

From freezing cold to scorching heat!

Lang Mu had a moment of negligence, coupled with exhaustion, and allowed a splash of spray to touch the back of his hand.

In that split second, a layer of frost instantly condensed on his skin. The chill seeped down layer by layer, freezing his very bones!

Lang Mu held back from telling Shang Feifan, quickly casting a thawing spell on himself to force the cold away, but his unfortunate left hand remained frozen blue.

This seawater was like the River Styx from the legends of Earth; a single drop could freeze the soul.

"Almost there." Shang Feifan kept his eyes fixed on the giant waves ahead, searching for the perfect moment to leap.

They couldn't fly above the sea; they had tried earlier, and the "sky" had immediately rained down countless lightning bolts, just like a Tribulation, as if desperate to blast their bodies and souls into oblivion.

Their power was simply no match for such heaven-and-earth majesty.

They had no choice but to obediently follow the "game rules," re-entering the Raging Sea to continue their game of hopscotch.

"Brother, Brother, save me!"

Amidst the sound of the waves, a familiar voice came through anxiously, like bubbles rising from the bottom of the deep sea, carrying an indescribable blur.

Lang Mu turned his head abruptly, his pupils shrinking—

On the sea surface floated a giant face formed of water mist. It was Remiel.

Remiel was screaming at them, his expression anxious and sorrowful.

"Brother, the Evil God’s followers caught me! They want to sacrifice me! Brother, save me, I remember everything now! I shouldn't be like this, my relationship with you is closer than anyone else’s! Brother, save me!"

"Don't listen!" Shang Feifan barked, his mental energy sweeping out like a blade, instantly shattering the illusion.

However, the Evil God’s corruption was pervasive.

In the mist evaporated from the seawater, countless twisted figures emerged. They danced on the crests of the waves, whispered in the shadows of the islands, and even... crawled directly out of their own shadows!

Every one of them was someone they knew from their memories, someone they cared about.

Shang Feifan’s mental energy wrapped around Lang Mu’s mental sea, building layer upon layer of sturdy defensive walls for him.

chunks.chineseText:
郎沐脸色苍白，一边抵抗邪神意识污染，一边还要施展魔法抵抗巨浪和超低温海水的侵袭。

他的魔力消耗极快，法杖上的魔晶已经变得暗淡，他已经拿出了身上所有高阶魔晶。

但这远远不够。

到底什么时候才能到达目的地？

郎沐不想拖后腿，忍不住生出一丝焦灼。

突然！一股恐怖的热浪扑面而来。

商非凡一把拉住郎沐，急急停住。

他们到了目的地。

小地图上的红点就在前方。

郎沐也看向前方。

那是一圈高高耸立的岛屿。

在岛屿包围的中心，是一片沸腾的金红色岩浆内海，高温让空气扭曲，甚至让周围的海水都在剧烈蒸发。但诡异的是，岩浆的边缘不断被海水冷却，又凝固成新的岩石，而岩石靠近岩浆的一面又再次融化……

如此循环，永不停息。

岛屿间隙中，鲜红的岩浆宛如鲜血般流淌而出。

剧烈高温与极致低温相触，那是极致的湮灭反应——海水在万分之一秒内被蒸发成高压蒸汽，而岩浆则被极速冷却，化作无数碎晶。

白雾中，温度剧烈变化，空间都在扭曲。上一瞬，蒸汽如烈焰般融化肌肤。下一瞬，冰晶从雾中凝结，化作锋利碎刃，在狂风中激射！

这是最后一道关卡。

他们需要越过这极寒与极热的交锋带。

“欢迎来到我的囚牢。”

一只黑色的小团子跳到一块巨大的岩石上，无视极寒与极热撞击形成的湮灭威力，面向两人开口，还对两人歪了歪脑袋。

商非凡：……传说中不可名状、恐惧至极、视之即会被污染会导致自身变异的超恐怖邪神，就是这么一只跟没断奶的幼崽一样大的黑猫团子？

还是说现在的邪神也与时俱进，知道要如何粉饰伪装自己了？
chunks.englishText:
Lang Mu’s face was pale. While resisting the Evil God’s mental corruption, he also had to cast magic to withstand the giant waves and the invasion of the ultra-low-temperature seawater.

His magic consumption was extremely rapid. The magic crystal on his staff had grown dim, and he had already taken out all the high-grade magic crystals he possessed.

But it was far from enough.

When would they finally reach their destination?

Lang Mu didn't want to be a burden, and he couldn't help but feel a sliver of anxiety.

Suddenly! A terrifying heatwave rushed toward them.

Shang Feifan grabbed Lang Mu and stopped abruptly.

They had arrived at their destination.

The red dot on the mini-map was right in front of them.

Lang Mu looked ahead as well.

It was a circle of towering islands.

In the center, surrounded by the islands, was an inner sea of boiling, golden-red magma. The high temperature distorted the air, causing the surrounding seawater to evaporate violently. But eerily, the edges of the magma were constantly cooled by the seawater, solidifying into new rock, while the side of the rock facing the magma melted once again...

It was a cycle that never ceased.

In the gaps between the islands, bright red magma flowed out like blood.

The collision of extreme heat and extreme cold created an ultimate annihilation reaction—seawater was evaporated into high-pressure steam in a ten-thousandth of a second, while the magma was rapidly cooled, turning into countless shards of crystal.

In the white mist, the temperature shifted violently, and space itself warped. One moment, the steam melted skin like flames. The next, ice crystals condensed from the mist, turning into sharp blades that shot through the gale!

This was the final hurdle.

They needed to cross this zone where extreme cold and extreme heat clashed.

"Welcome to my prison."

A small black ball jumped onto a massive rock, ignoring the annihilation power formed by the clash of extreme cold and heat. It faced the two of them and tilted its head.

Shang Feifan: ...The legendary, indescribable, terrifying Evil God—the one whose mere sight would cause corruption and mutation—is just a black cat ball the size of a kitten that hasn't been weaned yet?

Or perhaps even Evil Gods are keeping up with the times, knowing how to whitewash and disguise themselves?

chunks.chineseText:
第283章 修炼法

“我以为你会欢迎我们进来。”商非凡脸上带着商业笑容说道。

小黑猫抬起爪子抹了抹脸，把可爱扮演得明明白白。

“哦，你是说你们遇到的危险和看到的幻觉吗？那不能怪我，更不是我有意为之。你们遇到的危险是这座星球意识设下的障碍，原本是用来阻止外来者闯入这里。至于你们看到的诡异幻觉，那只是受到我泄露出去的些许能量的侵蚀，变异了。”

“也就是说你完全无辜，包括我那几位失踪的伙伴也跟你没关系。”商非凡慢慢地说。

“当然。”小黑猫斩钉截铁：“要怪就怪你们的星球意识，为什么要设置那么多障碍。再要怪就怪那些失踪者本人，意志力不坚定，被自身产生的幻觉坑陷。”

商非凡点点头，像是接受了这个说法，又说：“你跟我想象中的邪神不太一样。”

小黑猫像是很好奇：“在你想象中，我应该是什么样的？”

商非凡：“你听过克系邪神吗？”

“没听过。”小黑猫想都不想地回答，还问：“祂们是哪一片的邪神？游荡者，还是占地者？”

商非凡反问：“邪神还分片吗？”

小黑猫一脸理所当然：“这宇宙中那么多邪神，当然会分片，否则大家为抢资源不是要打起来？”

小黑猫斜眼注意郎沐——这人在干什么？

郎沐握着法杖，围着岩石岛屿飞来飞去，似乎在勘察从哪里进入最安全。

“那你是游荡者，还是占地者？”商非凡的问话又抓回小黑猫几分注意力。

小黑猫眼眸圆溜溜：“我算是游荡者吧。”

商非凡从小黑猫那眨都不眨一下的圆眼睛中看出了一点心虚。

也许游荡者也分两派。

实力足够强大的存在自然可以到处游荡，看到想要的就随便抢，别的强大存在也拿祂们没办法。

但也有实力不够强，导致无法占据一块好地盘坚守，只能当一个游荡者的较弱邪神。

商非凡怀疑厄穆克拉索就是后者。
