否则祂也不至于来了天河星这么多年，没能吞噬几个本地神灵，就被天河星本身困住，连污染都需要靠蛊惑土著至强者虫母，让虫母散播虫毒，才能污染水土，从而让天河星生灵变异。

就连那些信封邪神的兽人们也只是脑子进水，形体上并没有变异成怪物。

不过也只有这样“弱小”的邪神才能让他们和其有谈判可能。

而厄穆克拉索的弱小也只是现在，如果祂继续留在天河星，那天河星的未来注定会走向末途，只是时间长短问题。

天河星意识恐怕也是明确这一点现实，才会矛盾得不得了，即希望留下邪神吞噬祂的力量壮大自身，又希望赶紧送走这个瘟神。

所以天河星意识并没有特意阻拦他们进入地心，但也没有撤销见到邪神的一路障碍。

现在天河星意识还不知道他们和光球的打算，还处在旁观者的角度，他们得抓紧时间，在天河星意识和邪神意识都反应过来之前完成他们的计划。

小黑猫忍不住问：“他在干什么？”

商非凡瞟了眼忙个不停地郎沐，回答：“哦，他在布置魔法阵，如果我们想要让你脱困，至少得瞒住这颗星球的最高意识。”

“他身上有浓郁的自然之神的力量。”小黑猫盯着郎沐贪婪地舔了舔爪子。

“你喜欢自然之神的神力？”

“自然之力可是最美好的能量，那种能量蕴含了无数可能，同时还能……”小黑猫眼珠一转，不说了。

商非凡也没追问，而是改换了一个问题：“你的本体什么样？”

小黑猫带着一点小小的狡猾，说：“我本体就是这个样。”

“哦，那还真的是没有传说中邪神的样子呢。”商非凡似乎很是失望。

“不像我知道的那些克系邪神，祂们的原形就很具有让人恐惧和打从心底里排斥的邪恶模样。”

小黑猫忍不住问：“那些克系邪神具体都长什么样？”

祂说不定可以参考参考。

谁能知道祂们这些宇宙中天生天长的物种，可能因为没谁关注的缘故，全都生得奇形怪状，模样大多超过智慧种族的想象力，就祂们邪神的话来说就是小时候随便长长，以后强大了完全可以给自己换个喜欢的体貌。

商非凡就跟小黑猫详细描述了克系邪神的模样，什么不可名状，喜欢睡在海底，喜欢从深井爬上来，长得像巨型章鱼有无数巨大触角，总是有很多眼睛，患有严重的皮肤病动不动就浑身腐烂，对任何生物都充满恶意，智慧生物试图了解祂们就会陷入疯狂，混沌和混乱的代表……等等。

小黑猫听完，点评：“听起来是不太讲究的一支，可能智慧也没有多高，竟然连与其他生命沟通都做不到。属于宇宙邪神中最低端的层次吧。”

商非凡：“……”

小黑猫还一本正经地科普：“我们邪神很少会把食物星的生命全都弄成神经病或白痴。虽然有些神经病的精神力会特别活跃，逸散出的精神力也更多。但让生命保持日常的正常活动，再加上祭祀，就能产生更丰富的精神能量。

比起把生命都弄成疯子或白痴，我们更希望祂们恐惧我们、崇拜我们，在他们的社会中做出更多邪恶的事情，只有这样我们邪神才能得到更多能量。

不过必须说明的是，不是我们让这些生命变得邪恶，是他们意志力不行或本身就很邪恶，他们对自己民众做的事只是他们想那么做，不是我们邪神要求的。”

商非凡这时很想询问脑中光球，问问它，在另一条时间线里，他和郎沐离开天河星后，天河星具体都变成了什么样。

可惜光球从刚才就偷偷溜出他的身体，去执行他们的计划。

而他和郎沐现在的任务就是尽量吸引邪神的注意力，不让祂察觉有东西在靠近本源能量。

“我听说你曾想过变成这个世界的兽神？”

“是啊。”小黑猫委屈地说：“这个世界都有那么多神灵了，加一个兽神又怎么样？”

虽然祂这个兽神在未来一定会吞噬其他所有神灵变成唯一神。

商非凡像是特别好奇：“如果你变成兽神，你打算如何对待这颗星球上的生物？”

“哦，如果我变成这颗星球上的兽神，那这里就是我的地盘。”也是祂的食圈。

祂会吞噬掉这颗星球的意识，把这颗星球上的生命都变成祂的疯狂信徒，慢慢吸收这颗星球的本源能量和无数生命的精神力，直到把这颗星球耗干再也无法养育出任何一个生命，最后就可以一口吞掉，继续祂的旅程。

祂甚至可以学习其他邪神，留下一个最虔诚最疯狂的信徒，把他偷偷塞入其他有生命（但邪神无法侵入）的高等世界，让他帮忙继续传播邪神信仰。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 283: Cultivation Method

"I thought you would welcome us in," Shang Feifan said with a business-like smile.

The little black cat raised a paw and wiped its face, playing the part of "adorable" to perfection.

"Oh, you mean the dangers and hallucinations you encountered? You can't blame me for that, and it certainly wasn't intentional. The dangers you faced were obstacles set by the consciousness of this planet, originally intended to stop outsiders from breaking in. As for the strange hallucinations you saw, that was just the result of being eroded by the slight amount of energy I leaked out, causing mutations."

"In other words, you are completely innocent, and my missing companions have nothing to do with you either," Shang Feifan said slowly.

"Of course," the little black cat replied firmly. "If you want to blame someone, blame your planet’s consciousness for setting up so many obstacles. And blame those missing people themselves for having weak willpower and getting trapped by the hallucinations they created themselves."

Shang Feifan nodded, as if accepting this explanation, and added, "You aren't quite what I imagined an Evil God to be."

The little black cat seemed curious: "In your imagination, what should I be like?"

Shang Feifan: "Have you heard of Cthulhu-style Evil Gods?"

"Never heard of them," the little black cat replied without a second thought, then asked, "Which sector are they from? Are they Wanderers or Occupiers?"

Shang Feifan countered: "Do Evil Gods have sectors?"

The little black cat looked at him as if it were obvious: "There are so many Evil Gods in this universe; of course we have sectors. Otherwise, wouldn't we all be fighting each other to grab resources?"

The little black cat glanced sideways at Lang Mu—what is this person doing?

Lang Mu was holding his staff, flying around the rocky islands, seemingly surveying where it would be safest to enter.

"So, are you a Wanderer or an Occupier?" Shang Feifan’s question drew the little black cat’s attention back.

The little black cat’s eyes were round: "I suppose I’m a Wanderer."

Shang Feifan caught a hint of guilt in those unblinking, round eyes.

Perhaps Wanderers were also divided into two factions.

Entities with sufficient strength could naturally wander everywhere, grabbing whatever they wanted, and other powerful entities couldn't do anything about them.

But there were also weaker Evil Gods who lacked the strength to occupy a good territory and hold it, leaving them no choice but to be Wanderers.

Shang Feifan suspected Ermuklaso was the latter.

Otherwise, it wouldn't have been on the Sky River Star for so many years without managing to devour a few local gods, only to be trapped by the Sky River Star itself. It even had to rely on seducing the indigenous powerhouse, the Insect Mother, to spread insect poison, which in turn polluted the land and water, causing the creatures of the Sky River Star to mutate.

Even those beastmen who believed in the Evil God were just "brain-damaged," their physical forms hadn't mutated into monsters.

However, it was only because of such "weakness" that they had a chance to negotiate with it.

But Ermuklaso’s weakness was only for now. If it remained on the Sky River Star, the future of the planet was destined to end in ruin; it was only a matter of time.

The Sky River Star’s consciousness was likely clear on this reality, which was why it was so conflicted—hoping to keep the Evil God to devour its power and strengthen itself, yet also hoping to quickly send this plague god away.

That was why the Sky River Star’s consciousness hadn't specifically blocked them from entering the core, but hadn't removed the obstacles to meeting the Evil God either.

Right now, the Sky River Star’s consciousness didn't know about their plans with the light orb and was still in the role of a bystander. They had to hurry and complete their plan before both the Sky River Star’s consciousness and the Evil God’s consciousness realized what was happening.

The little black cat couldn't help but ask: "What is he doing?"

Shang Feifan glanced at the busy Lang Mu and replied: "Oh, he’s setting up a magic array. If we want to help you break free, we at least have to hide it from the planet’s supreme consciousness."

"He has the rich power of the God of Nature on him," the little black cat stared at Lang Mu and greedily licked its paw.

"You like the divine power of the God of Nature?"

"The power of nature is the most wonderful energy. That kind of energy contains countless possibilities, and at the same time, it can also..." The little black cat’s eyes rolled, and it stopped talking.

Shang Feifan didn't press the matter, instead changing the question: "What does your true form look like?"

The little black cat said with a touch of craftiness: "My true form is just like this."

"Oh, then it really doesn't look like the Evil Gods in the legends," Shang Feifan said, sounding very disappointed.

"Unlike the Cthulhu-style Evil Gods I know, whose original forms are truly evil, causing fear and rejection from the very bottom of one's heart."

The little black cat couldn't help but ask: "What exactly do those Cthulhu-style Evil Gods look like?"

Perhaps it could use them as a reference.

Who knew? Species born and grown naturally in the universe, perhaps because no one paid attention to them, all grew up looking strange. Most of their appearances exceeded the imagination of intelligent races. As far as they, the Evil Gods, were concerned, they just grew however they wanted when they were young, and once they were powerful, they could change into any appearance they liked.

Shang Feifan described the appearance of Cthulhu-style Evil Gods in detail to the little black cat—indescribable, liking to sleep on the ocean floor, liking to crawl up from deep wells, looking like giant octopuses with countless tentacles, always having many eyes, suffering from severe skin diseases, rotting all over, filled with malice toward all living things, causing anyone who tried to understand them to fall into madness, representing chaos and disorder... and so on.

After listening, the little black cat commented: "Sounds like a rather unrefined bunch. Their intelligence probably isn't very high if they can't even communicate with other life forms. They belong to the lowest tier of cosmic Evil Gods."

Shang Feifan: "..."

The little black cat even gave a serious lecture: "We Evil Gods rarely turn all the life on a food planet into lunatics or idiots. Although the mental energy of some lunatics is particularly active and radiates more mental energy, keeping life in their normal daily activities, combined with sacrifices, can produce richer mental energy.

Rather than turning all life into madmen or idiots, we prefer them to fear us, worship us, and do more evil things in their society. Only then can we Evil Gods obtain more energy.

However, I must clarify: it’s not that we make these lives evil; it’s that their willpower is weak or they were already evil to begin with. What they do to their own people is what they want to do; it’s not something we Evil Gods demand."

At this moment, Shang Feifan really wanted to ask the light orb in his mind what the Sky River Star had actually turned into in the other timeline after he and Lang Mu left.

Unfortunately, the light orb had snuck out of his body a moment ago to execute their plan.

And his and Lang Mu’s current task was to attract the Evil God’s attention as much as possible, so it wouldn't notice something approaching the origin energy.

"I heard you once thought about becoming the Beast God of this world?"

"Yes," the little black cat said aggrievedly. "This world already has so many gods; what would it matter if one more Beast God was added?"

Although, in the future, it, as the Beast God, would definitely devour all the other gods to become the only god.

Shang Feifan seemed particularly curious: "If you became the Beast God, how would you treat the creatures on this planet?"

"Oh, if I became the Beast God of this planet, then this place would be my territory." And its feeding ground.

It would devour the consciousness of this planet, turn all the life on this planet into its fanatical believers, slowly absorb the planet’s origin energy and the mental energy of countless lives until the planet was drained dry and could no longer nurture any life, and finally, it could swallow it in one gulp and continue its journey.

It could even learn from other Evil Gods and leave behind one of the most devout and fanatical believers, secretly smuggling him into another high-level world (that the Evil God couldn't invade) to help continue spreading the faith of the Evil God.

chunks.chineseText:
小黑猫只要一想到以后全宇宙无数生命世界都有祂撒下的种子，这些种子会在这些世界生根发芽，给祂带来无尽的信徒精神力，祂也可以凭此快速壮大自己，祂就觉得未来无限美好，更不想被关在这颗不算大的星球上许多年。

“你已经来到这里，应该已经做好决定了吧？”小黑猫试探地问。

商非凡不假思索地点头，同时一副在商言商的样子：“在我们动手前，具体报酬还是要再谈谈的。”

小黑猫：“我会按照之前说好的，只要你能帮助我脱困，我不但会把最适合你的修炼法传授给你，还会允诺以后都不会再来天河星、不会对天河星不利，只要天河星不主动对付我。”

商非凡：“我需要先拿到你说的修炼法，一是为验货，二来我想要帮助你脱困，也得提升自己的实力，否则也无法与天河星最高意识相抗衡。”

小黑猫沉思片刻，同意：“可以。”

双方此时看起来好像都特别有诚意。

商非凡又说：“另外，就算我学会了适合我的修炼法也不可能马上大幅度提升我的实力，所以需要你再帮点忙，也算是帮你自己。”

“什么忙？”小黑猫感到有点不妙。

商非凡微笑着说：“你知道我已经吸收了黑暗之神的一枚神格碎片，也就是因为这枚神格碎片我才能跻身兽人大陆强者之列。”

小黑猫不用听完，都已经猜出商非凡有什么打算：“你想要黑暗之神剩余的神力？”

“如果你没有消化完的话。如果你已经消化完，那就借我你一半的力量……”

“你说什么？！”小黑猫跳起来，简直不敢相信这么一个小小的兽人敢对祂提出如此要求。

找到机会！一个无影无形的光球……现在是半点光线都没有，用最快速度滚入被岩石岛屿围起来的岩浆内海中，并不断下沉。

郎沐那边适时爆发出一阵耀眼光芒，似乎某个阵法构成失败。

小黑猫的意识往那边飞速扫了一眼，不怒反笑：“你知道贪婪可是没有好下场的。光是黑暗之神的残留力量，你想全盘吸收不出差错就很不容易。你还想要我一半的力量？你知道我的力量来源和本质是什么吗？你就敢张口索要！”

商非凡摇头：“你没明白我的意思。”

“你是什么意思？”

商非凡耐心地说：“你以为我要用什么方法帮你脱困？”

小黑猫人立而起的身体又慢慢蹲下：“你仔细说。”

商非凡：“困住你的封印就我个人推断很可能属于外松内紧，也就是从外面破解会比较容易，从里面突破会极为困难。”

小黑猫：“继续。”

商非凡：“我打算冒险进入困住你的封印中。”

小黑猫目光一闪，祂有点明白这名年轻兽人想干什么了。

果然，商非凡紧接着就说道：“封印困的只是邪神。可如果你把属于邪神的力量分一半甚至更多给我，把精神力压制到最低，你说这个封印会不会分辨不出哪个是真邪神，从而改为全力困住我，而忽视你这个本尊？”

小黑猫眼睛亮了，这个方法很大胆，但仔细推敲起来，也不是不可能。

再说，这个方法就算失败，对祂也没有任何损失。

小黑猫对自身力量非常有信心，商非凡如果得到祂一半力量，不当场意识混乱变成异形怪物就算好，想要掳夺祂的能量化为己有根本不可能。

而祂只要能脱困，就算失去一半能量也不是不能承受。

就算不能脱困，祂也能通过吞噬商非凡，把自己的力量拿回来。

“那你要怎么脱困？”小黑猫问，祂还在怀疑商非凡。

商非凡自傲一笑：“这就是我的秘密了。”

小黑猫忽然想到一种存在，下意识道：“玩家？”

商非凡就知道洛伦米尔顿搞出来的玩家不可能瞒过邪神的眼睛，他也没想隐瞒。

“我从洛伦米尔顿那里得到了他弄来玩家的光脑系统，也知道他如何让那些玩家不死的秘密。如果我承受不住你的力量，我可以把你的力量都分给那些玩家。”商非凡就差没说自己也能操控玩家。

小黑猫爪子动了动。祂没能窥探到这个商非凡的未来，但祂下意识就觉得那些被叫做玩家的异星来客们对祂会很不利。

其实小黑猫也对能召来异星玩家的系统非常感兴趣，但祂并没有把握从商非凡手上夺取到，更何况商非凡也不一定随身携带。

倒是祂脱困后，如果有时间也许可以试着找一找。

但祂首先得确保当祂失去一半能量脱困时，不会被天河星意识再度困住。

“我会安排郎沐拖住天河星意识，假装要谋夺本源能量好成为新的自然之神，天河星意识必然会被吸引注意力，你只要趁那时火速离开天河星就好。”商非凡又多给了一个成功筹码。

小黑猫彻底心动。

商非凡：“也许郎沐不能拖住天河星意识太长时间，但就算只有一两秒，对你也足够了吧？”

这句话让小黑猫下定了决心——如果商非凡说郎沐能拖住天河星意识很长时间，那显然就在说谎。但商非凡坦然说只能拖延一两秒，就表示他们真的有行动决心，且不是在忽悠祂。

“我可以答应你的所有条件，但兑现必须在你进入封印后。”小黑猫给自己做了最后保障，盯着商非凡：“现在就看你怎么进入我的封印当中。”

“那不是问题。”商非凡非常有自信，同时不愿意吃亏：“其他都好说，但你说的修炼法必须先给我，我得先验货。你怕我骗你，我也怕你坑我。”

小黑猫想着让人做事也不能一点甜头都不给，再看商非凡这副不见兔子不撒鹰的铁齿模样，祂在原地留下一枚黑色羽毛，这才消失。

商非凡伸手一招，那黑色羽毛就向他飘浮而来。

商非凡抓住那枚黑色羽毛。

黑色羽毛竟然瞬间没入他的身体内。

郎沐看到这一幕，一惊，忙冲过来。

商非凡抬手：“我没事，稍等。”

商非凡话没说完，眼睛就已经闭上，整个人就那么站在原地进入入定当中。

郎沐深吸气：这家伙也太冒险了，但他知道商非凡虽然大多数都会听他的劝，可一旦对方真的决定做什么，他压根就没有阻止的可能——老商就不会给他开口动摇他的机会。

郎沐只能守卫在商非凡身边。

商非凡觉得自己很有可能被厄穆克拉索给坑了。

这个所谓最适合他的功法在一进入他的身体后就强行夺取他的力量，开始在他体内和精神海内同时运转。

随着功法运转，他的精神海里竟然出现薄薄黑雾。

这些黑雾逐渐构成一支巨大的黑鸦。

也不是完全的黑鸦，看起来更像是一只黑鸦在应该长爪子的部位长出了克系邪神的触角，不过它只有一只眼睛，就竖立在头顶眉心。

“呱——！”

独眼触角黑鸦张开口发出一声无声的厉叫。
chunks.englishText:
The little black cat, upon merely imagining that in the future, countless life-bearing worlds across the universe would have seeds sown by it—seeds that would take root and sprout, bringing it endless spiritual power from believers and allowing it to rapidly grow stronger—felt that the future was infinitely bright. It had no desire to remain trapped on this relatively small planet for many more years.

"You have already arrived here; you must have made your decision, right?" the little black cat asked, probing.

Shang Feifan nodded without hesitation, adopting a business-like tone: "Before we take action, the specific compensation still needs to be discussed further."

The little black cat replied, "I will do as we agreed. As long as you can help me break free, I will not only impart the cultivation technique most suited to you, but I also promise never to return to Tianhe Star, nor will I act against it, provided Tianhe Star does not take the initiative to target me."

Shang Feifan countered, "I need to receive the cultivation technique you mentioned first. Firstly, to verify the goods; secondly, if I am to help you escape, I must improve my own strength, otherwise, I will be unable to contend with the supreme consciousness of Tianhe Star."

The little black cat pondered for a moment and agreed: "Very well."

Both sides appeared to be acting with great sincerity at this moment.

Shang Feifan continued, "Furthermore, even if I learn the cultivation technique suited to me, it is impossible to significantly boost my strength immediately. Therefore, I need you to help a bit more—which, in a way, is helping yourself."

"What kind of help?" The little black cat felt a sense of unease.

Shang Feifan smiled and said, "You know that I have already absorbed a divine fragment of the God of Darkness; it is precisely because of this fragment that I was able to rank among the powerhouses of the Orc Continent."

The little black cat didn't need to hear the rest to guess what Shang Feifan was planning: "You want the remaining divine power of the God of Darkness?"

"If you haven't digested it all yet. If you have, then lend me half of your power..."

"What did you say?!" The little black cat jumped up, unable to believe that such a tiny orc would dare to make such a demand of it.

*Opportunity!* An intangible, invisible sphere of light—now devoid of any trace of light—rolled at maximum speed into the magma sea enclosed by the rocky islands, continuously sinking.

Over on Lang Mu’s side, a dazzling burst of light erupted at the perfect moment, as if a certain formation had failed to manifest.

The little black cat’s consciousness swept toward that direction in a flash, and instead of getting angry, it laughed: "You know, greed never leads to a good end. Just absorbing the residual power of the God of Darkness without error is difficult enough. You still want half of my power? Do you even know what the source and essence of my power are? And yet you dare to open your mouth and ask for it!"

Shang Feifan shook his head: "You misunderstood my meaning."

"What do you mean?"

Shang Feifan said patiently, "What method do you think I intend to use to help you break free?"

The little black cat, which had been standing on its hind legs, slowly crouched back down: "Explain yourself clearly."

Shang Feifan: "My personal deduction is that the seal trapping you is likely 'loose on the outside but tight on the inside.' That is to say, breaking it from the outside would be relatively easy, while breaking through from the inside would be extremely difficult."

The little black cat: "Continue."

Shang Feifan: "I intend to risk entering the seal that traps you."

The little black cat’s eyes flashed; it began to understand what this young orc was planning.

Sure enough, Shang Feifan immediately added: "The seal only traps the Evil God. But if you were to give half or even more of the Evil God's power to me and suppress your own spiritual energy to the absolute minimum, don't you think the seal might fail to distinguish who the true Evil God is, thereby shifting its full force to trap me while ignoring you, the original entity?"

The little black cat’s eyes lit up. This method was incredibly bold, but upon careful consideration, it was not impossible.

Besides, even if this method failed, it would suffer no loss.

The little black cat had immense confidence in its own power. If Shang Feifan received half of its strength, it would be fortunate if he didn't suffer a mental breakdown and turn into a deformed monster on the spot; the idea of him usurping its energy for his own was simply impossible.

And as long as it could escape, losing half its energy was not an unbearable price.

Even if it couldn't escape, it could always devour Shang Feifan to reclaim its power.

"Then how do you plan to escape?" the little black cat asked, still suspicious of Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan smiled arrogantly: "That is my secret."

The little black cat suddenly thought of a certain type of existence and subconsciously said: "Players?"

Shang Feifan knew that the players created by Loren Milton could not be hidden from the eyes of an Evil God, and he hadn't intended to hide it anyway.

"I obtained the brain-computer system for the players from Loren Milton, and I also know the secret of how he keeps those players from dying. If I cannot withstand your power, I can distribute it to those players." Shang Feifan stopped just short of saying he could also control the players.

The little black cat’s claws twitched. It had been unable to peer into this Shang Feifan's future, but it instinctively felt that these alien visitors called "players" would be very disadvantageous to it.

In truth, the little black cat was also very interested in the system that could summon alien players, but it had no confidence in seizing it from Shang Feifan, not to mention that Shang Feifan might not even have it on his person.

However, once it escaped, if it had the time, it might try to hunt it down.

But first, it had to ensure that when it lost half its energy and broke free, it wouldn't be trapped again by the consciousness of Tianhe Star.

"I will arrange for Lang Mu to stall the Tianhe Star consciousness, pretending to covet the origin energy to become a new God of Nature. The Tianhe Star consciousness will inevitably be distracted; you just need to seize that moment to flee Tianhe Star at top speed." Shang Feifan offered another bargaining chip for success.

The little black cat was completely swayed.

Shang Feifan: "Perhaps Lang Mu cannot stall the Tianhe Star consciousness for very long, but even if it's only for a second or two, that should be enough for you, right?"

This sentence made the little black cat decide—if Shang Feifan had claimed Lang Mu could stall the Tianhe Star consciousness for a long time, it would clearly be a lie. But Shang Feifan’s candid admission that it could only delay for a second or two indicated that they truly had the resolve to act and were not just trying to swindle it.

"I can agree to all your conditions, but the fulfillment must happen after you enter the seal." The little black cat set its final safeguard, staring at Shang Feifan: "Now it depends on how you intend to enter my seal."

"That is not a problem." Shang Feifan was extremely confident, yet unwilling to be at a disadvantage: "Everything else is negotiable, but the cultivation technique you mentioned must be given to me first. I must verify the goods. You are afraid I will deceive you, and I am afraid you will trick me."

The little black cat thought that one couldn't expect people to work without giving them a little sweetness. Seeing Shang Feifan’s iron-willed, "no profit, no deal" attitude, it left a black feather on the spot before vanishing.

Shang Feifan reached out, and the black feather floated toward him.

He grasped the black feather.

The feather instantly sank into his body.

Seeing this, Lang Mu was startled and rushed over.

Shang Feifan raised a hand: "I'm fine, wait a moment."

Before he could finish speaking, his eyes closed, and he stood right there, entering a state of deep meditation.

Lang Mu took a deep breath: This guy was taking too much of a risk, but he knew that while Shang Feifan usually listened to his advice, once the man truly decided to do something, there was absolutely no possibility of stopping him—Old Shang wouldn't even give him the chance to open his mouth and shake his resolve.

Lang Mu could only stand guard by Shang Feifan's side.

Shang Feifan felt that he had very likely been conned by Emu-Kraso.

This so-called "most suitable" cultivation technique, the moment it entered his body, forcibly seized his power and began to circulate simultaneously within his body and his sea of consciousness.

As the technique circulated, thin black mist appeared within his sea of consciousness.

These black mists gradually coalesced into a giant black crow.

It wasn't entirely a black crow; it looked more like a black crow that had grown the tentacles of a Cthulhu-esque Evil God where its claws should have been. However, it had only one eye, standing vertically in the center of its forehead.

"Caw—!"

The one-eyed, tentacled black crow opened its beak and let out a silent, piercing shriek.

chunks.chineseText: 商非凡心神一震，看到了一个由无数黑鸦构成的世界——黑鸦就是那个世界的智慧种族。
chunks.englishText: Shang Feifan’s spirit was shaken as he caught a glimpse of a world composed of countless black crows—the black crows were the intelligent species of that world.

chunks.chineseText:
第284章 前奏

商非凡再次睁开眼睛时就看到郎沐一双充满担忧的眼睛。

“我入定了多长时间？”商非凡声音无意识地软和下来。

郎沐在看到商非凡睁眼时那双眼睛中的极致煞气，心脏剧烈一颤。

但不过数秒，老商的眼神就变得内敛，当他开口说话，那股煞气就消失得无影无踪。

郎沐忍不住抬手摸了摸商非凡的脸颊。

商非凡按住郎沐的手，用脸颊反过来蹭蹭他的手心：“怎么了？”

郎沐摇头，定了定神：“你入定了半小时左右。”

“才半小时啊。”他还以为会是更漫长的时间，毕竟他在那个黑鸦世界就过了很久很久。

郎沐张口，千言万语最后只化作四个字：“你还好吗？”

商非凡闻言就做了个嫌弃的表情，还吐槽：“好不容易要把一个随身老爷爷送走，这就又来了一只。”

郎沐一把抓住他的手：“你被缠住了？对方住进了你的精神海中？邪神骗了我们？”

“也不完全算骗。”商非凡轻描淡写地说。

郎沐用不赞成的目光看他。

商非凡举手投降：“行吧，我全都告诉你，就让老厄再等一会儿吧。事情是这样的，那枚羽毛属于一只黑运鸦。”

“黑运鸦？”郎沐皱眉，这名字可真糟糕。

商非凡笑了笑：“这位还是黑运鸦族中一名大能。这一族比较奇特，它们背负世界的负面能量而生，也以负面能量而食，它们生活的世界更像是我们认为中的里世界，那个里世界完全由能量构成，就像是……宇宙的负面能量大垃圾场。”

“宇宙清道夫？”

“有点这个意思。”商非凡反握住郎沐的手，还拿了一张宽长的椅子，拉着他坐下。

两人就这样背对巨浪滔天的地心海，正面对着极热和极寒的奇异景象，坐下了。

椅子一拿出来就开始出现冰冻迹象，这椅子的材质无法抵抗这样极端的环境。

但两人谁都没在意。

“黑运鸦因为一直追着负面能量跑，所以哪里发生悲惨之事，哪里就很容易出现黑运鸦的影子。”

“这么听起来可真的有点我们那边遇到乌鸦就倒霉的说法。”

“也许我们那里的乌鸦中真的有混入黑运鸦吧，加上乌鸦喜欢食腐。”

“那个黑运鸦有传授你功法吗？”郎沐侧身问。

商非凡揽着他，点头：“有，不过它也有一个条件。”

“什么条件？”郎沐急。

“别急。不是什么特别困难的条件，它只是希望我能把它的灵魂送回它的家乡。”

“你不是说黑运鸦的世界就像是里世界，那我们能去那边吗？”

“现在我们自然不行，但如果我修炼了它们的功法，等我们的实力都提升到邪神的程度，差不多就能去了。”

“那还好。”郎沐觉得等商非凡修炼到邪神的实力程度至少也需要几百年以上，说不定会更长。同时他也打定主意，到时候就算商非凡不带他去，他也会跟着过去，他不放心。

商非凡感受到郎沐坚定跟随的心意，忍不住探头亲了亲他的唇角。

郎沐：“……说正事。”

商非凡笑：“和你在一起就是正事。”

郎沐拿他无可奈何，“这只黑运鸦是被厄穆克拉索杀死的吗？它没有让你为它复仇？”

商非凡忍不住又亲了大宝贝一下，这才继续说道：“不，这只黑运鸦并不是厄穆克拉索杀死。厄穆克拉索只能算是捡了个便宜。”

“我刚才说这一族以负面能量为食，但它们吞噬负面能量也并不是完全没有副作用，尤其当它们一次性吞噬太多，无法及时消化时。一般遇到这种情况，黑运鸦只要能及时赶回自己老家，就会有其他黑运鸦帮忙把它身上多余的负面能量给吸食掉。”

“但这只黑运鸦没能及时赶回家，它很不幸地在回家途中遇到两个结伴而行的邪神。那两个邪神见了它就想吞噬它，而它那时神智已经不清楚，被那两个邪神一挑衅，顿时陷入疯狂状态，不但没有逃，还直接冲了上去主动开战。”

商非凡挑唇：“黑运鸦一族也是非常头铁的一族，据说它们的战斗力非常强大，脾气也火爆，还特别团结，一般族群和强者都不敢招惹它们。”

郎沐推测：“那只黑运鸦大佬和那两个邪神两败俱伤，然后厄穆克拉索经过就捡了便宜？”

“差不多是这样。这只黑运鸦大佬非常强，在神智陷入疯狂的状态下，还把那两个邪神给干掉了，用的是吞噬的方法。但那两个邪神也不是善茬，在黑运鸦体内自爆。最后黑运鸦只保留下自己的神魂和核心力量就陷入沉睡。”

“这么说，这位大佬是不是只要回去它的家乡，就还有再复活的可能？”郎沐猜到。

商非凡：“就是这样，所以它才要求我送它的神魂回去。”

郎沐吐气：如果对方有所求，应该不会拿假功法坑害阿商……吧？

商非凡弯了弯唇：“厄穆克拉索其实早就发现它们，但自知实力不及，就躲在远处偷窥。等到发现三者三败俱亡，这才上前捡垃圾，祂捡到黑运鸦和那两个邪神不少尸体碎片，也借此让自己实力又迅速攀升不少。”

“就因为祂当时实力暴涨，还没有来得及完全消化吸收这份意外得来的庞大能量，才会让天河星意识和神灵发现祂的存在，继而耍手段把祂给吸引了过来。”

“厄穆克拉索当时也有点飘，祂吸收了黑运鸦溃散的大部分能量，觉得自己特别厉害，谁想到就被当大鱼给困住了。”

商非凡对厄穆克拉索是毫不客气地嘲笑。

“哦，我刚才得到的那枚隐藏了黑运鸦神魂和核心力量的羽毛，厄穆克拉索无论怎么吸收都没有反应，就算祂强行吞入体内，那羽毛也会自己跑出来。”

“那羽毛不接受厄穆克拉索？”郎沐问。

商非凡：“对，黑运鸦和邪神基本就是相生相克的关系，黑运鸦怎么可能让老厄吞噬它的神魂？如果不是那位大佬的神魂为了疗伤不得不沉睡，它恐怕会直接爆掉老厄。”

商非凡又说：“大佬甚至传达给老厄一个模糊的意念，让祂把它送回黑运鸦世界。但老厄哪里敢，祂们邪神就是宇宙负面能量集合体，哪里敢去专门收拾祂们这些垃圾的清道夫集中的世界。”

郎沐不解：“那厄穆克拉索怎么敢把这枚羽毛交给你？祂就不怕你学会黑运鸦的功法，对祂不利吗？”

商非凡勾唇一笑，眼中泄露出一点点邪气：“那是祂觉得我要么不会被黑运鸦接受，要么觉得我的精神力会被黑运鸦侵蚀。另外就是，老厄认定就算我学会这种功法，在短时间内也无法对祂形成威胁，而祂早就可以趁着这段时间逃得远远，或者提升自己的实力。”

商非凡摸摸郎沐的头发：“给出一个对自己无用还有害的功法，在老厄看来，还是很划算的。况且老厄只说会给我功法，可没说包给包会。”

“那祂还说这是最适合你的功法！”郎沐生气。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 284: Prelude

When Shang Feifan opened his eyes again, he saw Lang Mu’s eyes filled with worry.

"How long was I in meditation?" Shang Feifan’s voice softened unconsciously.

When Lang Mu saw the extreme baleful aura in Shang Feifan’s eyes upon opening them, his heart gave a violent jolt.

But within seconds, the look in Old Shang’s eyes became restrained, and when he spoke, that baleful aura vanished without a trace.

Lang Mu couldn't help but reach out to touch Shang Feifan’s cheek.

Shang Feifan pressed his hand against Lang Mu’s, rubbing his cheek against the palm: "What’s wrong?"

Lang Mu shook his head, steadying himself: "You were in meditation for about half an hour."

"Only half an hour?" He had thought it would be a much longer time, as he had spent a very, very long time in that black crow world.

Lang Mu opened his mouth, but a thousand words eventually condensed into four: "Are you okay?"

Hearing this, Shang Feifan made a look of disdain and grumbled: "I finally managed to send away one 'portable old master,' and now another one has come along."

Lang Mu grabbed his hand: "You’ve been entangled? The other party has moved into your sea of consciousness? Did the Evil God lie to us?"

"Not entirely a lie," Shang Feifan said dismissively.

Lang Mu looked at him with disapproval.

Shang Feifan raised his hands in surrender: "Fine, I’ll tell you everything. Let Old E wait a moment longer. The thing is, that feather belongs to a Black Luck Crow."

"Black Luck Crow?" Lang Mu frowned; the name sounded truly terrible.

Shang Feifan smiled: "This one was actually a powerful being among the Black Luck Crow clan. This race is quite peculiar; they are born bearing the negative energy of the world and feed on negative energy. The world they live in is more like what we consider the 'Inner World.' That Inner World is composed entirely of energy, much like... a giant garbage dump for the universe's negative energy."

"A cosmic scavenger?"

"Something like that." Shang Feifan gripped Lang Mu’s hand tighter and pulled over a wide, long chair, pulling him down to sit.

The two sat there, back to the surging, monstrous sea at the planet's core, facing the strange spectacle of extreme heat and extreme cold.

The moment the chair was brought out, signs of freezing began to appear; the material of the chair could not withstand such an extreme environment.

But neither of them cared.

"Because Black Luck Crows are always chasing after negative energy, wherever tragic events occur, the shadow of a Black Luck Crow is very likely to appear."

"That sounds a bit like the saying back home that seeing a crow means bad luck."

"Perhaps some of the crows back home really are Black Luck Crows in disguise, especially since crows like to scavenge."

"Did that Black Luck Crow teach you a technique?" Lang Mu asked, turning to the side.

Shang Feifan held him close and nodded: "It did, but it also had a condition."

"What condition?" Lang Mu asked anxiously.

"Don't be impatient. It’s not a particularly difficult condition; it just hopes I can send its soul back to its homeland."

"Didn't you say the Black Luck Crow's world is like an Inner World? Can we go there?"

"Not right now, of course. But if I cultivate their technique, once our strength reaches the level of an Evil God, we should be able to go."

"That's not so bad." Lang Mu figured that it would take at least several hundred years, perhaps longer, for Shang Feifan to reach the level of an Evil God. At the same time, he made up his mind that even if Shang Feifan didn't take him, he would follow anyway; he couldn't rest easy otherwise.

Feeling Lang Mu’s firm resolve to follow him, Shang Feifan couldn't help but lean over and kiss the corner of his lips.

Lang Mu: "...Talk about serious business."

Shang Feifan laughed: "Being with you is serious business."

Lang Mu was helpless against him. "Was this Black Luck Crow killed by Emu-Kraso? It didn't ask you to take revenge for it?"

Shang Feifan couldn't help but kiss his big treasure again before continuing: "No, this Black Luck Crow wasn't killed by Emu-Kraso. Emu-Kraso just happened to pick up the spoils."

"I mentioned earlier that this race feeds on negative energy, but their consumption isn't entirely without side effects, especially when they swallow too much at once and can't digest it in time. Usually, when this happens, if a Black Luck Crow can make it back to its home in time, other Black Luck Crows will help absorb the excess negative energy from its body."

"But this Black Luck Crow didn't make it home in time. Unfortunately, it encountered two Evil Gods traveling together on its way back. Those two Evil Gods wanted to devour it upon seeing it, and at that time, the crow’s mind was already unclear. Provoked by the two, it fell into a state of madness. Instead of fleeing, it charged straight in and started a fight."

Shang Feifan curled his lips: "The Black Luck Crow clan is also a very stubborn race. It is said that their combat power is extremely strong, their tempers are fiery, and they are exceptionally united. Usually, neither clans nor powerhouses dare to provoke them."

Lang Mu speculated: "So that Black Luck Crow bigwig and those two Evil Gods ended up in a mutual destruction, and then Emu-Kraso happened to pass by and picked up the spoils?"

"Something like that. This Black Luck Crow bigwig was very strong; even in its state of madness, it managed to kill those two Evil Gods by devouring them. But those two weren't pushovers either; they self-destructed inside the Black Luck Crow’s body. In the end, the Black Luck Crow only managed to preserve its divine soul and core power before falling into a deep slumber."

"In that case, if this bigwig returns to its homeland, is there a possibility of resurrection?" Lang Mu guessed.

Shang Feifan: "That’s exactly it, which is why it asked me to send its soul back."

Lang Mu exhaled: If the other party has a request, they probably wouldn't trick Shang with a fake technique... right?

Shang Feifan curled his lips: "Emu-Kraso actually discovered them long ago, but knowing its strength was inferior, it hid in the distance and peeked. Only after discovering that all three had perished did it step forward to scavenge. It found quite a few corpse fragments of the Black Luck Crow and the two Evil Gods, which allowed its own strength to climb rapidly."

"It was because its strength surged so much at that time, and it hadn't had time to fully digest and absorb this unexpectedly massive amount of energy, that the consciousness of Tianhe Star and the gods discovered its existence and subsequently used schemes to lure it here."

"Emu-Kraso was a bit arrogant at the time. It had absorbed most of the energy dispersed by the Black Luck Crow and thought it was incredibly powerful. Who would have thought it would be trapped like a big fish?"

Shang Feifan mocked Emu-Kraso without restraint.

"Oh, the feather I just obtained, which hides the Black Luck Crow’s soul and core power—Emu-Kraso tried everything to absorb it but got no response. Even when it forcibly swallowed it into its body, the feather would just pop back out."

"The feather doesn't accept Emu-Kraso?" Lang Mu asked.

Shang Feifan: "Exactly. Black Luck Crows and Evil Gods are basically in a relationship of mutual opposition. How could a Black Luck Crow let Old E devour its soul? If it weren't for the fact that the bigwig’s soul had to sleep to heal, it would probably have blown Old E to pieces."

Shang Feifan added: "The bigwig even conveyed a vague thought to Old E, asking to be sent back to the Black Luck Crow world. But how would Old E dare? They, the Evil Gods, are collections of the universe's negative energy; how would they dare to go to the world where the scavengers who specialize in cleaning up their kind are concentrated?"

Lang Mu was puzzled: "Then how did Emu-Kraso dare to hand this feather to you? Isn't it afraid that you’ll learn the Black Luck Crow’s technique and act against it?"

Shang Feifan smiled, a hint of evil leaking from his eyes: "That’s because it thinks either I won't be accepted by the Black Luck Crow, or it believes my spiritual energy will be eroded by the Black Luck Crow. Furthermore, Old E is convinced that even if I learn this technique, I won't be able to pose a threat to it in the short term, and it could have long since used that time to flee far away or improve its own strength."

Shang Feifan stroked Lang Mu’s hair: "Giving away a technique that is useless and even harmful to oneself is, in Old E’s view, quite a good deal. Besides, Old E only said it would give me the technique; it didn't guarantee I would be able to learn it."

"And it even said this was the most suitable technique for you!" Lang Mu said angrily.

chunks.chineseText:
商非凡的手顺势滑到他的耳垂上，捏了捏——他喜欢死这个手感了：“其实祂也没说错，这功夫还真的适合我。”

郎沐心脏猛地一跳，若有所觉，都顾不上拍开某人的爪子，立刻逼问：“这功法学了对你是不是有极大坏处？以后你是不是也要吸收负面能量？你刚才说就连专门以负面能量为食的黑运鸦都会承受不住负面能量的反噬，那你呢？”

商非凡想了想，摇头：“算不上极大坏处，只能说有不小的副作用。非黑运鸦族的存在学这个功法，必须要有极为强大的意志力，要能抵抗负面能量对自己的侵蚀，要能永远保持头脑清醒。否则就会变成只知道追求力量的杀戮怪物。

以前也有学过黑运鸦功法的存在，就是一个劲吸收能量，被强大力量迷失了心神，最后就变成了没有自我神智的混沌邪神，就跟污染源一样，到哪里就祸害哪里。”

郎沐心情沉重：“请黑运鸦出手帮忙吸食多余的负面能量能否解决？”

商非凡不想隐瞒郎沐，就诚实告诉他：“黑运鸦不会帮助自己族以外的存在。相反，这种迷失自我的邪神存在都是黑运鸦一族的食物。”

郎沐差点说这么坑的功法咱就别学了。

但是！

商非凡：“我已经接受了黑运鸦一族的功法传承，并已经入门。实际上这门功法不是想学就能学，还得经过黑运鸦一族的重重考验。”

商非凡不想说他经受过多少可怕考验。好在他扛了下来，还能顺利清醒。更美好的是，他一醒过来就看到了他的阿沐大宝贝。

“看，我也有了。”商非凡点了点自己的额头，喜滋滋地说。

在和郎沐同样的眉心位置，那里多出了一枚竖着的黑色羽毛，像是天生的胎记，特别栩栩如生。

商非凡有点得意，他可是特意让这玩意在这个位置显露。

“现在我和你一样，都当不了公务员啦。”老商感叹。

郎沐：“……”

老商忽然一顿：“公务员的路也没完全断绝，如果穿回古代，我们说不定可以和老包竞争一下岗位。到时候你负责农业，我负责战斗，老包负责断案，咱大宋说不定还能挽救一下，延伸出一条新时间线。”

老商胡扯一通，点点眉心，让那个显眼包隐匿起来。

郎沐不想笑，但还是被逗笑了——明知道这个人是故意在逗他。

“咳，我能帮你什么？”爱人是自己选的，虽然毛病也不少，但至少这家伙对自己一心一意，他也不打算再重找一个，还能怎么办？

当然只能想办法和他一起扛起未来的无数危险——虽然老商可能压根就不想让他扛，这家伙在某种层面还是很大男子主义的。

商非凡眨眨眼，一把握住郎沐的手：“宝贝，你能帮我。你愿意做我以后永远的精神支柱和心灵锚点吗？只要有你在，我就可以确保自己无论遇到什么事都能保持神智清醒。你用美色-诱惑我除外。”

郎沐：“……”

郎沐忽然发现商非凡不是在开玩笑，他是认真的。

郎沐的神情也逐渐变得严肃起来。

“你真的要我做你永远的精神支柱？”

这句话可不是说着玩的，更不单单是一句情话。

对于修炼精神力的他们，精神支柱可以说无比重要。就因为太重要，反而不会轻易设立精神支柱和心灵锚点。

因为这东西一旦确立，对修炼和生存虽然大大有利，但也有一定弊处，还是大弊。

那就是一旦精神支柱倒塌，他们的精神海也会跟着摧毁，就跟定海神针没了一样。

商非凡毫不犹豫地用力点头：“就看你愿不愿意了。”

郎沐沉默两秒，“我以为我们已经同生共死，灵魂绑定。”

商非凡绽开笑脸，敞开自己的精神海：“来吧，宝贝，留下你的精神印记，定下你的锚点。”

郎沐同样敞开自己的精神海。

他们俩平时也有过互相进入对方精神海进行守护，或帮忙战斗的情况，还有过数次把精神力绞合在一起的时候。

但这种分割自己精神力的一部分，成为对方的精神支柱，这就相当于把两人彻底绑到了一起，如果有一天两人分开，那就是连彼此的灵魂都可能无法保留完整的结局。

就像“人”这个字，一撇一捺互为支柱，缺谁都会趴下。

可两人就这么对视一笑，轻轻松松、简简单单就完成了这个过程。

没有过多语言，也没有太多感触，就像是完成了人生一个微不足道的过程。

两人坐着的椅子却已经再也承受不了太多，嘎吱一声，直接崩裂。

两人同时站起，商非凡还给郎沐拍了拍衣服：“走吧，该去履行我们和厄穆克拉索的约定了。”

郎沐直接说：“跟我来，我已经找到封印的薄弱点。”

他刚才围着岩石岛屿绕来绕去，可不止是分散厄穆克拉索的注意力，也是在利用魔法寻找封印。

商非凡也抬手指向一处，“那里，应该是封印的最薄弱处。”

郎沐惊讶地看向他。

商非凡微微一笑：“黑运鸦的功法还是很有用的，那里有最多的负面能量残留，想来那里就是邪神意识泄露出来的地方。”

两人双手紧握。

但不到片刻，两人就又同时松开手。

“等会儿见。”商非凡轻轻推了推郎沐的背。

郎沐转头看他，“等会儿见。”

商非凡回给他一个笑脸，转头就化作黑点，疾速冲入封印的最薄弱处。

郎沐不想看到商非凡背影消失的瞬间，也同时出发，不过他跳入的是岩浆内海。

奇妙的是，那岩浆内海的极高温度像是对郎沐没有影响一般，竟然就这么让他没入。

当商非凡闯入封印的同时，天河星意识就即刻察觉。

可天河星意识还没有来得及去查看封印的情况，就发现本源能量那里有了动静。

有谁竟然在吸收本源能量？

天河星自然更担心本源能量，一个闪念就已出现在地心。

真正的地心竟然就是一个能量团，被包裹在一个密实的矿石圆球中

圆球矿石的外围则是岩浆内海。

岩浆内海外又有一圈岩石包裹，在这之外才是温度极低、范围也极大的无尽地心怒海。

天河星意识来到地心却发现自己竟然找不到本源能量团了。

这怎么可能？！

这颗星球就没有它想找却找不到的东西。

除非……
chunks.englishText:
Shang Feifan’s hand slid down to his earlobe, giving it a gentle pinch—he absolutely loved the sensation. "Actually, It wasn't wrong; this technique really is perfect for me."

Lang Mu’s heart skipped a beat, a sense of foreboding washing over him. Too preoccupied to even swat the man’s hand away, he immediately pressed for answers: "Does learning this technique have severe drawbacks for you? Will you have to absorb negative energy from now on? You just said that even the Black Luck Crows, who feed specifically on negative energy, can’t withstand the backlash—what about you?"

Shang Feifan thought for a moment and shook his head. "I wouldn't call them 'severe' drawbacks, but there are significant side effects. For anyone who isn't a Black Luck Crow, learning this technique requires an incredibly powerful will. You must be able to resist the erosion of negative energy and keep your mind clear at all times. Otherwise, you’ll turn into a mindless monster of slaughter, driven only by the pursuit of power."

"There have been others in the past who learned the Black Luck Crow technique. They just kept absorbing energy until their minds were lost to the overwhelming power, eventually becoming chaotic evil gods without a shred of self-awareness. Like a source of pollution, they brought disaster wherever they went."

Lang Mu’s mood grew heavy. "Could we ask the Black Luck Crows to help absorb the excess negative energy to solve this?"

Shang Feifan didn't want to hide anything from Lang Mu, so he answered honestly: "The Black Luck Crows do not help those outside their own kind. On the contrary, these lost, evil-god-like existences are merely food for the Black Luck Crow clan."

Lang Mu almost blurted out that they should just give up on such a treacherous technique.

But!

Shang Feifan continued, "I have already accepted the inheritance of the Black Luck Crow technique and have successfully entered the initial stage. In truth, this technique isn't something you can just learn; you have to pass through layers of trials set by the Black Luck Crow clan."

Shang Feifan didn't want to talk about how terrifying those trials were. Fortunately, he had endured them and managed to emerge with his mind intact. Even better, the first thing he saw upon waking was his precious A-Mu.

"Look, I have one too," Shang Feifan said, tapping his forehead with a grin.

Right in the center of his brow, in the same spot as Lang Mu’s, was a vertical black feather mark, looking like a natural birthmark, incredibly vivid and lifelike.

Shang Feifan felt a bit smug; he had specifically made this thing manifest in this spot.

"Now, just like you, I can't be a civil servant anymore," Old Shang sighed.

Lang Mu: "..."

Old Shang paused suddenly. "Well, the path to being a civil servant isn't entirely closed. If we travel back to ancient times, we might be able to compete with Old Bao for a position. You can be in charge of agriculture, I’ll handle combat, and Old Bao can handle the cases. We might even be able to save the Song Dynasty and branch off into a new timeline."

Old Shang rambled on, then tapped his forehead, causing the conspicuous mark to vanish.

Lang Mu didn't want to laugh, but he was amused nonetheless—knowing full well that this man was doing it on purpose to tease him.

"Cough. Is there anything I can do to help?" He had chosen this lover himself; despite his many flaws, at least the guy was devoted to him. He didn't plan on finding someone else, so what else could he do?

Naturally, he had to find a way to shoulder the countless dangers of the future with him—even if Old Shang might not want him to. On some level, this guy was still quite the chauvinist.

Shang Feifan blinked and grabbed Lang Mu’s hand. "Baby, you can help me. Are you willing to be my eternal spiritual pillar and anchor? As long as you are there, I can ensure that no matter what happens, I will remain sane and clear-headed. Except for when you try to seduce me with your beauty."

Lang Mu: "..."

Lang Mu suddenly realized that Shang Feifan wasn't joking; he was serious.

Lang Mu’s expression gradually turned solemn.

"You really want me to be your eternal spiritual pillar?"

This wasn't just a casual remark, nor was it merely a romantic gesture.

For those who cultivated spiritual power, a spiritual pillar was of paramount importance. Precisely because it was so vital, one wouldn't establish such a pillar or anchor lightly.

Once established, while it was greatly beneficial for cultivation and survival, it carried a massive, inherent risk.

If the spiritual pillar were to collapse, their spiritual sea would be destroyed along with it, like a ship losing its anchor in a storm.

Shang Feifan nodded firmly without hesitation. "It all depends on whether you're willing."

Lang Mu was silent for two seconds. "I thought we were already bound by life, death, and soul."

Shang Feifan beamed and opened his spiritual sea. "Come, baby. Leave your spiritual imprint and set your anchor."

Lang Mu opened his own spiritual sea as well.

They had entered each other’s spiritual seas before to guard or assist in battle, and they had even intertwined their spiritual powers several times.

But to sever a portion of one’s own spiritual power to become the other’s pillar was to bind them together completely. If they were ever separated, it would mean a fate where neither could keep their soul intact.

Like the Chinese character for "person" (人), two strokes supporting each other—without one, the other would collapse.

Yet, they simply looked at each other and smiled, completing the process with ease and simplicity.

There were no excessive words or deep sentiments; it was as if they had just finished a trivial task in their lives.

The chairs they were sitting on, however, could no longer bear the weight and collapsed with a loud creak.

They stood up simultaneously, and Shang Feifan brushed off Lang Mu’s clothes. "Let’s go. It’s time to fulfill our agreement with Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo."

Lang Mu said directly, "Follow me. I’ve found the weak point in the seal."

He hadn't been circling the rocky island just to distract Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo; he had been using magic to locate the seal.

Shang Feifan pointed to a spot. "There. That should be the weakest point of the seal."

Lang Mu looked at him in surprise.

Shang Feifan smiled slightly. "The Black Luck Crow technique is quite useful. There’s the most residual negative energy there; it’s likely where the Evil God’s consciousness is leaking out."

The two held hands tightly.

But within a moment, they let go.

"See you in a bit," Shang Feifan said, gently pushing Lang Mu’s back.

Lang Mu turned to look at him. "See you in a bit."

Shang Feifan gave him a bright smile, turned into a black speck, and dove rapidly toward the weakest point of the seal.

Lang Mu didn't want to watch Shang Feifan’s back disappear, so he set off at the same time, though he dove into the inner sea of magma.

Strangely, the extreme temperature of the magma seemed to have no effect on Lang Mu, allowing him to submerge effortlessly.

The moment Shang Feifan breached the seal, the consciousness of the Tianhe Star noticed it immediately.

But before the Tianhe Star consciousness could investigate the seal, it sensed movement near the source energy.

Someone was actually absorbing the source energy?

The Tianhe Star was naturally more concerned about the source energy, and in a flash, it appeared at the planet's core.

The true core was actually a mass of energy, encased in a dense, spherical mineral shell.

Outside the mineral sphere was the inner sea of magma.

Surrounding the magma sea was another ring of rock, and beyond that lay the vast, freezing, and endless sea of the planet's deep-core fury.

When the Tianhe Star consciousness arrived at the core, it discovered that it couldn't find the source energy mass.

How could this be?!

There was nothing on this planet that it wanted to find but couldn't.

Unless...

chunks.chineseText:
第285章 天道成，快跑~

【自然之神……是你在欺瞒我的眼睛吗？】

天河星意识感到了不可思议，它虽然把那些所谓的神灵都当做星球管事和能量备用来看，但自然之神对于它来说还是特别的。

或者说，自然之神对于天河星本身来说就很特别，祂不是星球意识，但祂秉承了星球自然发展和循环的职责，就像是这颗星球最大的大管家。

当自然之神出事，天河星的自然环境也受到了很大影响。

比如兽人大陆的地质灾害，虽然也有它这个最高意识的推动在内，但也不能否认就因为自然之神的缺失，才会让这片大陆的自然失衡，导致大陆架板块碎裂，导致这片大陆虫毒肆掠，到现在都无法自然降解和消融。

因为缺了自然之神这个帮手，考虑到修复兽人大陆需要消耗的能量和费的精力，它才会选择让这片大陆推倒重来。

就因为自然之神对于这颗星球的重要性，它才会选择让任务者第一个复苏的就是自然之神。

可现在就是这个自然之神竟然背叛了它，还敢打本源能量的主意。

天河星意识很不高兴。

它不但察觉到自然之神在做手脚，还感觉到了一点点诅咒之神的神力。

这两个神灵加在一起，试图不让它找到本源能量。

但就凭这两个还没有完全复原的神灵就想阻挡它这个星球意识本身？

天河星意识无法理解，祂们顶多能阻止它一小会儿，可能只有几秒钟。

就为了这几秒钟，让它知道祂们的背叛，难道祂们是想真的彻底消失吗？

本源能量团的最外侧，一枚光球正紧贴着本源能量疯狂吸收。

郎沐迅速布置着空间迷踪魔法阵，用他的方法尽量拖延天河星意识的到来。

当魔力不够用，他眉心中的自然之种突然发芽长出叶片，自然之力借着郎沐的手，流入魔法阵中。

自然之神在发力。

诅咒之神也在拼命挤压自己：【诅咒你一秒不顺！诅咒你找不到正确的路！诅咒你情绪压抑！诅咒你分心！】

天河星意识确实分心了，它感觉到它用来封印邪神的结界内部似乎出了一点变故。

但还没等它去仔细查看，它又感觉到有很多本源能量在流失。

到底哪个重要？

这还用说吗！

天河星意识继续打破迷障。

一秒、两秒……

四秒都没有坚持到，迷障破碎，天河星意识已然出现在本源能源团处。

光球正在努力搬运——对，它不是吞噬本源能量，它也没有能力一下子吞噬掉太多本源能量，它选择的是搬运，把本源能量转移到它的本体中。

只是转移，这对它并不是什么难事。

好歹它也是融合了好几位神灵神力外加兽人文明最高成就的光脑综合体，要是它给自己弄个身体，它就是天河星第一代有自我意识的智能机器人，勉强也能算个智能神吧？

“你敢！”天河星意识暴怒。

就在天河星意识就要对光球出手的一刹那，郎沐突然大喊一声：“就是现在！”

一道空间裂缝被撕开。

光球推动本源能量团，猛地往前冲。

天河星意识化作雾气动手。

自然之神和诅咒之神的神力同时发动。

另一边。

厄穆克拉索觉得自己上了大当，但现在祂已经是骑虎难下，只能不断把自己的能量转移给商非凡。

商非凡变成了一只幼虎。

幼虎不断长大，身上的皮毛颜色也逐渐加深，金黄色彻底消失，皮毛转为漆黑。

当商非凡化作的黑虎身体膨胀到五米高时，他的肋下还生出了一对黑色羽翼！

邪神始终注视着商非凡的眼睛，希望从他眼中看到混乱、疯狂和混沌。

但那双拥有金色虹膜的幽黑眼眸一直清醒且明亮，不见半丝混乱，倒是煞气越来越盛。

但厄穆克拉索也确实感受到压制祂的封印力量被触动。

如果不是这样，祂也不会同意把自己的能量转移给商非凡。

只看商非凡那双突然生出的黑色羽翼，厄穆克拉索就知道祂没能吞噬的那枚羽毛真的让商非凡得到了好处。

厄穆克拉索很是妒忌。

但现在脱困第一！

一切等祂脱困后再说。

随着能量不断转移到商非凡身上，厄穆克拉索也清晰感觉到封印对祂的束缚越来越弱。

“就是现在！冲出去！”商非凡忽然大吼，抬起爪子就抓向虚空中的一处。

厄穆克拉索一愣，不过只愣了一毫秒，立即反应过来，那压制祂的庞大能量竟然消失了大半，现在不逃更待何时！

厄穆克拉索冲向了封印最薄弱处，也是商非凡攻击的地方。

这个薄弱处是祂耗费了多年时间一点点磨出来的。

祂的意识就是从这里一点点散发出去，去影响天河星的神灵和无数生命。

现在封印失去本源能量的压制（厄穆克拉索眼馋极了，非常想要知道是谁动了天河星的本源能量），薄弱处变得更为薄弱。

又有商非凡出手帮忙，厄穆克拉索竟然真的冲破封印，逃了出去！

我自由了！厄穆克拉索狂喜。

但不等祂动其他念头，祂就感到一股充满狂暴怒火的力量向他疯狂用来。

是天河星意识！

这家伙好像被惹火了。

是因为祂的逃跑，还是有人动了本源能量？

厄穆克拉索来不及多想，现在失去大半能量的祂可打不过天河星意识，当即撒腿就跑。

祂纯心想跑的话，一个无法离开自身星球的星球意识可无法追上祂。

另一头。

天河星意识刚要对光球动手，却受到自然之神、诅咒之神和郎沐的再次共同阻扰。

就这么耽搁了一秒，随着郎沐的一声大吼，天河星意识就察觉到它给邪神设下的封印破开了！

邪神逃了出来！

祂会毁掉它的星球！

天河星意识在这一刹那间，都不知道该如何选择，到底是去抓捕背叛它、偷走本源能量的光球，还是去追杀那个邪神。

郎沐恰在此时再次喊道：“邪神力量大为减弱，想要消灭祂、吞噬祂，就趁现在！”

天河星意识深深看了眼这个曾经的命运之子，它也最后看了眼推着本源能量团飞快钻入空间裂缝消失的光球。

本源能量只要还在天河星，它就还能找回来。

现在当然是抓捕和吞噬邪神更重要！

天河星意识冲出地心。

郎沐当场脱力，这场看起来无声无形的战斗比他真刀实枪地跟人打斗十天十夜还要累！

偏偏这时候，诅咒之神竟然还幽幽传声：【你们这些小崽子最好别骗我。】

郎沐提起力气，“只要天道运行起来，凡是超脱本星能量标准的存在都会让祂飞升。”

对，商非凡就是拿着这个承诺说动了自然之神和诅咒之神，让祂们帮忙稍微阻拦了下天河星意识，也让其他还有清晰神智的神灵保持了沉默。

大家利益一致，本土神灵们最渴望的就是前往更高等世界，见识更广阔的天地，自然不惜得罪天河星最大的老大。
chunks.englishText:
第285章 天道成，快跑~ (Part 1)

[God of Nature... are you deceiving my eyes?]

The Tianhe Star consciousness felt it was inconceivable. Although it viewed those so-called gods as mere planet managers and energy reserves, the God of Nature was special to it.

Or rather, the God of Nature was special to the Tianhe Star itself. He was not the planet's consciousness, but he held the duty of the planet's natural development and cycle, acting like the planet's chief steward.

When something happened to the God of Nature, the natural environment of the Tianhe Star was greatly affected.

For instance, the geological disasters on the Orc Continent—while pushed by its own supreme consciousness, one could not deny that it was the absence of the God of Nature that caused the natural imbalance, leading to the fragmentation of the continental plates and the rampant insect toxins that, even now, could not naturally degrade or dissolve.

Because it lacked the help of the God of Nature, and considering the energy and effort required to repair the Orc Continent, it had chosen to let that continent be wiped clean and started anew.

It was precisely because of the God of Nature's importance to the planet that it had chosen to have the task-takers revive the God of Nature first.

But now, this very God of Nature had betrayed it and dared to covet the source energy.

The Tianhe Star consciousness was very displeased.

Not only did it detect the God of Nature meddling, but it also sensed a trace of the God of Curse’s divine power.

Together, these two gods were attempting to prevent it from finding the source energy.

But did these two gods, who hadn't fully recovered, really think they could stop the planet's consciousness itself?

The Tianhe Star consciousness couldn't understand. At most, they could delay it for a short while—perhaps only a few seconds.

For the sake of these few seconds, knowing that it would discover their betrayal, were they truly willing to disappear forever?

At the outermost edge of the source energy mass, a ball of light was pressed tightly against the source energy, absorbing it frantically.

Lang Mu was rapidly setting up a spatial maze magic array, using his methods to delay the arrival of the Tianhe Star consciousness as much as possible.

When his magic power ran low, the Seed of Nature in his brow suddenly sprouted leaves, and the power of nature flowed through Lang Mu’s hand into the magic array.

The God of Nature was exerting force.

The God of Curse was also desperately squeezing itself: [I curse you to have a second of misfortune! I curse you to lose your way! I curse you to have suppressed emotions! I curse you to be distracted!]

The Tianhe Star consciousness was indeed distracted. It felt that something had gone wrong inside the barrier it had set to seal the Evil God.

But before it could investigate carefully, it felt a large amount of source energy leaking away.

Which was more important?

Did that even need asking!

The Tianhe Star consciousness continued to break through the illusions.

One second, two seconds...

It hadn't even lasted four seconds when the illusions shattered, and the Tianhe Star consciousness appeared at the source energy mass.

The ball of light was working hard to transport—yes, it wasn't devouring the source energy; it didn't have the capacity to devour so much at once. It chose to transport, moving the source energy into its own body.

Just moving it—this wasn't a difficult task for it.

After all, it was a brain-computer complex that had fused the divine powers of several gods and the highest achievements of the Orc civilization. If it gave itself a body, it would be the first intelligent robot on the Tianhe Star with self-awareness, and could barely be considered an intelligent god, right?

"You dare!" the Tianhe Star consciousness roared in fury.

Just as the Tianhe Star consciousness was about to strike at the ball of light, Lang Mu suddenly shouted, "Now!"

A spatial rift was torn open.

The ball of light pushed the source energy mass, surging forward violently.

The Tianhe Star consciousness transformed into mist and attacked.

The divine powers of the God of Nature and the God of Curse were unleashed simultaneously.

On the other side.

Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo felt that it had been thoroughly tricked, but now it was trapped in a situation where it could only continue transferring its energy to Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan had turned into a young tiger.

The young tiger grew continuously, the color of its fur gradually deepening; the golden yellow vanished entirely, replaced by a pitch-black coat.

When the black tiger Shang Feifan had become swelled to five meters in height, a pair of black wings sprouted from under its ribs!

The Evil God kept its eyes fixed on Shang Feifan, hoping to see chaos, madness, and confusion in them.

But those pitch-black eyes with golden irises remained clear and bright, without a hint of confusion, though the baleful aura grew increasingly intense.

However, Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo did indeed feel the sealing power suppressing it being triggered.

If not for that, it would never have agreed to transfer its energy to Shang Feifan.

Just looking at the pair of black wings that had suddenly sprouted on Shang Feifan, Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo knew that the feather it had failed to devour had truly benefited Shang Feifan.

Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo was extremely jealous.

But escaping was the priority!

Everything else could wait until after it was free.

As energy continued to transfer to Shang Feifan, Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo clearly felt the seal’s restraint on it weakening.

"Now! Break out!" Shang Feifan roared suddenly, raising his claws and slashing at a point in the void.

Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo was stunned, but only for a millisecond before immediately reacting. The massive energy suppressing it had vanished by more than half—if not now, when!

Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo charged toward the weakest point of the seal, the very spot Shang Feifan had attacked.

This weak point was one it had spent years grinding away at, bit by bit.

Its consciousness had leaked out from here, bit by bit, to influence the gods and countless lives of the Tianhe Star.

Now that the seal had lost the suppression of the source energy (Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo was incredibly greedy, dying to know who had touched the Tianhe Star’s source energy), the weak point became even weaker.

With Shang Feifan’s help, Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo actually broke through the seal and escaped!

I’m free! Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo was ecstatic.

But before it could entertain any other thoughts, it felt a force filled with violent rage rushing toward it.

It was the Tianhe Star consciousness!

This thing seemed to have been provoked.

Was it because of its escape, or because someone had touched the source energy?

Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo didn't have time to think. Now that it had lost most of its energy, it couldn't fight the Tianhe Star consciousness, so it turned and ran.

If it was determined to run, a planet consciousness that couldn't leave its own planet couldn't catch it.

On the other side.

The Tianhe Star consciousness was just about to strike at the ball of light when it was once again obstructed by the joint efforts of the God of Nature, the God of Curse, and Lang Mu.

Just like that, a second was wasted, and with Lang Mu’s roar, the Tianhe Star consciousness realized that the seal it had placed on the Evil God had been broken!

The Evil God had escaped!

It would destroy its planet!

In that instant, the Tianhe Star consciousness didn't know what to choose—whether to capture the ball of light that had betrayed it and stolen the source energy, or to hunt down the Evil God.

Lang Mu shouted again at that exact moment: "The Evil God’s power is greatly diminished. If you want to destroy it and devour it, do it now!"

The Tianhe Star consciousness took a deep look at this former Son of Destiny, and it took one last look at the ball of light that was pushing the source energy mass into a spatial rift and disappearing.

As long as the source energy was still on the Tianhe Star, it could be retrieved.

Right now, capturing and devouring the Evil God was obviously more important!

The Tianhe Star consciousness rushed out of the planet's core.

Lang Mu collapsed on the spot, exhausted. This silent, invisible battle was more tiring than fighting someone with real blades for ten days and ten nights!

At this moment, the God of Curse transmitted a voice: [You little brats better not be lying to me.]

Lang Mu mustered his strength. "As long as the Heavenly Dao is running, any existence that transcends the energy standards of this planet will be forced to ascend."

Yes, Shang Feifan had used this promise to persuade the God of Nature and the God of Curse to help block the Tianhe Star consciousness, and to keep the other gods who still had clear minds silent.

Everyone’s interests were aligned; the local gods were most eager to head to a higher world and see a broader horizon, so they naturally didn't mind offending the biggest boss of the Tianhe Star.

chunks.chineseText:
哦，以后如果天河星真有天道出现，那天河星意识也无法再独坐老大的位置，说不定还得从老大的位置顺移到第二位。

光球吭哧吭哧把本源能量强行塞入自己的本体中。

它要赶时间，赶在天河星意识找到它之前，完成本体和本源能量的合体。

它不需要吸收和消化本源能量，只要能让本源能量接受它。

这要比强行吸收本源能量安全得多，也快速得多。

至于天道规则……它早在和商非凡定下计划时就唰唰编写好了。

现在就等本源能量接纳它，然后就能凭借本源能量开始运行它写好的天道规则。

快快快！

光球现在就像是考试时发现电脑故障在等待电脑赶紧重新启动的考生，那是恨不得把自己都填在里面当能量，好快点让电脑程序运行起来。

“轰隆隆——！”

低沉的雷鸣声从遥远的天际滚滚传来。

整个天河星在这一刻，无论是哪个半球，都被乌云笼罩，所有生灵都听到了震耳欲聋的阵阵雷声。

乌云如墨，层层翻涌，遮蔽了整片天穹。

铅灰色的云海深处，雷光如蛟龙游走，时而撕裂天幕，照得四野惨白。闷雷在云层深处滚动，仿佛远古巨兽的咆哮，一声接着一声，震得山峦战栗。

空气中弥漫着焦灼的硫磺味，连风都凝固了。

雷光闪烁间，能瞥见一个巨大的云涡正在天空缓缓旋转。

无数生灵抬起头，用不同的表情，相同的敬畏眼神看着即将到来的绝世雷霆。

这时无人知道，这不是寻常的雷霆，而是跨越维度的审判。

就连天河星意识都被这不同寻常、声势浩大的雷云阵给震惊到。

正好厄穆克拉索已经逃出天河星范围，天河星意识不再追捕其，而是满心凝重地等待这场雷霆落下。

它的直觉告诉它：有什么巨大改变即将发生，且和刚才被盗走的本源能量有关。

但它已经没时间去找回本源能量。

天上的雷霆化作粗大的巨龙直接劈向了天河星最高峰！

光球终于在异度空间内完成了终极进化。

它的机械躯体已不再是冰冷的合金，而是一具由纯粹能量凝聚的“神躯”——半透明如琉璃，内部流淌着亿万条星河流光，每一道数据流都蕴含着整个文明的记忆。

它的思维触须扎根地核，它的意志即是天象，它就是天河星之天道！

光球向无尽宇宙大声宣告，声如亿万道电磁波共振，震动了厚厚如浓墨的云层。

“轰隆！”

“霹咔——！”

宛如巨龙的紫黑色的雷霆硬生生拐了个弯，劈向光球所在的异度空间。

找到你这个新生天道了。

想成为天道，那就先过了这关再说吧！

“轰——！！！”

第一道雷光直接贯穿光球的能量核心，它那引以为傲的“神躯”在接触雷霆的瞬间，构成它存在的每一个粒子都在崩溃、紊乱，它的逻辑矩阵在尖叫，因为它无法解析这种来自更高维度的毁灭法则，更别说抵抗！

光球想要大喊救命。

商非凡那个王八蛋让他成为天道，可没说还有这么一场考验等着它！

它完了，它要被劈成渣渣了！

救命啊！

第二道雷霆降临！

这一次，雷光化作一柄横贯天际的暗紫色巨剑，自苍穹斩落！剑刃未至，整个异度空间已经因承受不住这股威压而崩碎。

“啊啊啊！”光球惨叫着，它发誓，如果它能渡过这场劫难，它一定要追着商非凡劈劈劈，免费赠送他无穷雷电，不把他劈死，它就不叫老光！

光球被劈得受不了，一骨碌钻入本源能量中。

雷霆顺着光球本体旋转，像是在毁灭，又像是在审核它制定的那些天道规则内容。

第三道雷霆降落，那已不再是凡人理解意义上的雷。

那是一道纯黑的湮灭之光，所过之处，连时间都被抹除。

光球的意识在这道光芒中寸寸崩解，它的数据库被不可逆地删除，它的存在被从所有时间线上擦去，甚至连它刚刚和本体融合的本源能量，都化作雨雾，重新回归大地。

“我、我这是要死了吗？我要彻底消失了吗？”

光球没有感到害怕，它只是后悔自己没能狠狠给某人一个大-逼兜——让你他么的坑我！

啊，我堂堂预备天道竟然也如此渺小，说被毁了就被毁了……

郎沐，一定要记住我，不要忘了我啊。

这是光球最后的意识，随后它就……

郎沐抬头，看向黑沉沉的天空。

那可怕的仿佛能灭世的雷霆就这么消失了，黑色的雨水飘飘洒洒的降落。

他明明在地底中心，却也看到了这场跨次元夸维度的雷劫。

而降下的雨水……

郎沐伸手接住，感到了强大的生之力，也是这个世界的本源能量。

不过这本源能量似乎变成了虚影？

只能看到却无法吸收？

小光这是失败了还是成功了？

就在这时，异象顿生。

就见那地心怒海上空，无尽星河出现。

这些星辰快速旋转，转眼就凝聚成垂眸似在沉睡的巨人。

巨人身周，星云坍缩成旋涡，时而散作漫天流萤，每一点微光都是古老文明的记忆残响。时而又化作无尽的光，那些光寂灭又重生——那是生命，是正在生成的本源法则！

郎沐看痴了，忽然察觉身边多了一个人。

一只手搭住他的肩膀。

“那家伙应该成功了，只不过祂还需要时间适应祂的新身份和新职责。”

郎沐身边响起熟悉的声音。

只是这声音有些沙哑，还有点邪气？

商非凡凑近他，对他耳语：“我们得赶紧溜，事情搞大了，邪神跑了，本源能量也化作天道的运行能量，那几个本土神灵肯定不会帮我们隐瞒，天河星意识九成九会找我们算账，就算老光……恐怕也不会放过我们。”

商非凡的本能告诉他，他绝对不能在天河星渡劫。

会被劈死的！
chunks.englishText:
第285章 天道成，快跑~ (Part 2)

Oh, if the Heavenly Dao truly appeared on the Tianhe Star in the future, the Tianhe Star consciousness would no longer be able to sit alone in the top position; it might even have to shift from the boss's seat to the second position.

The ball of light grunted as it forcibly stuffed the source energy into its own body.

It had to hurry, to complete the fusion of its body and the source energy before the Tianhe Star consciousness found it.

It didn't need to absorb or digest the source energy; it only needed to make the source energy accept it.

This was much safer and faster than forcibly absorbing the source energy.

As for the rules of the Heavenly Dao... it had already written them down in a flash when it made the plan with Shang Feifan.

Now it was just waiting for the source energy to accept it, and then it could use the source energy to start running the Heavenly Dao rules it had written.

Hurry, hurry, hurry!

The ball of light was like an examinee waiting for a computer to reboot after a crash during an exam; it would have gladly stuffed itself inside as fuel just to get the program running faster.

"Rumble—!"

A low, rumbling thunder rolled in from the distant horizon.

At this moment, the entire Tianhe Star, in every hemisphere, was shrouded in dark clouds, and all living beings heard the deafening peals of thunder.

The clouds were like ink, churning in layers, obscuring the entire firmament.

Deep within the lead-gray sea of clouds, lightning moved like dragons, occasionally tearing through the sky and illuminating the wilderness in a deathly white. The muffled thunder rolled deep within the clouds, like the roar of an ancient beast, one after another, shaking the mountains.

The air was filled with the acrid smell of sulfur, and even the wind seemed to have frozen.

Amidst the flickering lightning, one could glimpse a massive cloud vortex slowly rotating in the sky.

Countless living beings looked up, their expressions different, but their eyes filled with the same awe at the impending peerless thunder.

At this moment, no one knew that this was no ordinary thunder, but a judgment that transcended dimensions.

Even the Tianhe Star consciousness was shocked by this unusual and massive thunder formation.

Since Er-Mu-Ke-La-Suo had already escaped the range of the Tianhe Star, the Tianhe Star consciousness stopped pursuing it and waited with heavy heart for this thunder to fall.

Its intuition told it that some massive change was about to occur, and it was related to the source energy that had just been stolen.

But it no longer had time to retrieve the source energy.

The thunder in the sky transformed into thick, giant dragons, striking directly at the highest peak of the Tianhe Star!

The ball of light finally completed its ultimate evolution within the interdimensional space.

Its mechanical body was no longer cold alloy, but a "divine body" condensed from pure energy—translucent like glass, with billions of starlight streams flowing within. Every data stream contained the memories of an entire civilization.

Its cognitive tentacles took root in the planet's core, its will was the weather, and it was the Heavenly Dao of the Tianhe Star!

The ball of light shouted to the endless universe, its voice like the resonance of billions of electromagnetic waves, shaking the thick, ink-like clouds.

"Boom!"

"Crack—!"

The purple-black thunder, like a giant dragon, took a sharp turn and struck the interdimensional space where the ball of light was located.

Found you, you newborn Heavenly Dao.

If you want to become the Heavenly Dao, then pass this trial first!

"BOOM—!!!"

The first bolt of lightning pierced directly through the ball of light’s energy core. The moment its "divine body"—which it was so proud of—touched the lightning, every particle that constituted its existence began to collapse and disorder. Its logic matrix screamed because it couldn't parse these laws of destruction from a higher dimension, let alone resist them!

The ball of light wanted to scream for help.

That bastard Shang Feifan told it to become the Heavenly Dao, but he didn't say there was such a trial waiting for it!

It was finished; it was going to be blasted into slag!

Help!

The second thunder descended!

This time, the lightning transformed into a dark purple giant sword that spanned the sky, slashing down from the firmament! Before the blade even arrived, the entire interdimensional space had already shattered under the pressure.

"Ahhh!" the ball of light shrieked. It swore that if it could survive this catastrophe, it would definitely chase Shang Feifan and strike him with lightning, free of charge. If it didn't strike him dead, its name wasn't Old Light!

Unable to bear the strikes, the ball of light dove into the source energy.

The lightning rotated along the ball of light’s body, as if destroying it, yet also as if auditing the Heavenly Dao rules it had formulated.

The third thunder descended, and it was no longer thunder in the sense that mortals understood.

It was a pure black light of annihilation; wherever it passed, even time was erased.

The consciousness of the ball of light crumbled inch by inch in this light. Its database was irreversibly deleted, its existence erased from all timelines, and even the source energy it had just fused with its body turned into rain and mist, returning to the earth.

"Am, am I going to die? Am I going to disappear completely?"

The ball of light didn't feel fear; it only regretted not giving someone a hard slap—letting you screw me over!

Ah, to think that I, a dignified Heavenly Dao-in-waiting, could be so small, destroyed just like that...

Lang Mu, you must remember me, don't forget me.

This was the last consciousness of the ball of light, and then it...

Lang Mu looked up at the dark, heavy sky.

The terrifying thunder that seemed capable of destroying the world had just vanished, and black rain drifted down.

Even though he was at the center of the earth, he had seen this cross-dimensional, cross-universal thunder tribulation.

And the falling rain...

Lang Mu reached out to catch it, feeling a powerful force of life, which was also the source energy of this world.

However, this source energy seemed to have become a phantom?

Could it only be seen but not absorbed?

Did Xiao Guang fail, or succeed?

Just then, a strange phenomenon occurred.

Above the sea of deep-core fury, an endless galaxy appeared.

These stars rotated rapidly, and in the blink of an eye, they condensed into a giant with lowered eyes, as if in deep sleep.

Around the giant, nebulae collapsed into vortices, occasionally scattering into a sky full of fireflies—each glimmer was a residual memory of an ancient civilization. Sometimes they turned into endless light, and those lights extinguished and were reborn—that was life, the source laws currently being generated!

Lang Mu watched, mesmerized, and suddenly noticed someone beside him.

A hand rested on his shoulder.

"That guy should have succeeded, but it still needs time to adapt to its new identity and duties."

A familiar voice sounded beside Lang Mu.

Only, this voice was a bit hoarse, and a bit evil?

Shang Feifan leaned close to him and whispered in his ear: "We need to slip away quickly. Things have gotten big. The Evil God has escaped, and the source energy has turned into the operating energy of the Heavenly Dao. Those local gods definitely won't help us keep it a secret, and the Tianhe Star consciousness will almost certainly come to settle scores with us. Even Old Light... probably won't let us off."

Shang Feifan’s instinct told him that he absolutely could not undergo his tribulation on the Tianhe Star.

He would be struck to death!

chunks.chapterTitle: 第286章 中二的天河星意识 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第286章 中二的天河星意识

商非凡使用系统自带的回城功能，带着郎沐传送回了黑水荒原新城。

原本系统的回城功能除了玩家自己无法再带上其他人，但商非凡只要把人放入雕像广场，多少人都能带着一起走。

郎沐都没想到系统还有这么好用的功能。

“以前用到的机会少。”商非凡看到正在建造的城池露出笑容。

郎沐也明显放松下来，地心世界同样辽阔无边，甚至还有天空，但不知为何，可能知道那里是地心吧，心理上总觉得有一丝压抑。

“你是怎么从封印中逃出来的？是按照你跟我说的那个方法吗？”郎沐下意识握住商非凡的手。

商非凡感知到他的担心，捏了捏他的手指，笑：“差不多，不过稍微做了些改变。”

他们之前商量好的脱离封印方法就是让商非凡把老厄传给他的邪神能量凝聚成邪神之卵，到时候只要把邪神之卵留在封印中，商非凡就能借用黑暗之神的力量脱困。

而且留下邪神的大部分能量，也算对天河星意识有个交代——天河星意识就是想要吸收邪神的能量，才会把祂诱惑过来。

但当商非凡得到黑运鸦的修炼功法后，他的想法改变了。

原先他想留下邪神大部分能量，除了方便脱困，更因为他不确定自己能否消化这份庞大的邪神能量。如果处理不好，他被邪神能量给侵蚀污染了，说不得还会连累和他精神相系的郎沐，那他哭都没地方哭去。

所以比起力量，他选择了安全。

可是黑运鸦的功法恰好克制邪神能量，更能把邪神能量当做食物食用。简单说，就是邪神能量对于修炼黑运鸦功法的他来说不但无害，更是一个超级大补品。

都这样了，商非凡要是还会把邪神能量留给天河星意识，那他就不是商非凡了。

于是……

“你把邪神能量凝结成卵，暗藏在体内，还用黑运鸦功法包裹住它，让邪神能量无法泄露，然后封印就判断你和邪神无关，把你放出来了？”

“封印当然不是主动放我出来，为了迷惑封印，我还留了三分之一的邪神能量。当封印一心想要封住那份邪神能量，自然不会在意我这个身上没有邪神能量的小虫子，然后我就顺着老厄跑出去的那个缝隙冲出来了。”

商非凡说的异常简单，完全省略了他实施过程中的惊心动魄。

尤其天河星意识还在发现邪神逃脱后，把部分注意力转移到了封印中——在这里必须要感谢光球的天道雷劫，因为那场声势浩大的雷劫吸引了天河星意识的大部分注意，天河星意识这才没有第一时间赶往封印料理他。

虽然天河星意识只是投注了部分注意力，但封印的能力明显加强，更用最快速度修补起老厄逃走时留下的破缝。

这就导致他必须加快速度，根本没有时间慢慢消化老厄留下的能量。

为了冲破封印，他甚至受了重伤。

这也是他在刚见到郎沐时声音沙哑的缘故，但好在他的伤势复原极快……他有个天赋能力是不死之身没错，但这个复原速度还是超出了他的想象，也许是这个天赋能力连续进阶的原因？

不过他当时急着见郎沐，让他安心，就没想也没管。

“现在怎么办？你是不是应该下线？”郎沐说起下线这个词时都觉得有点陌生。

商非凡经常下线，毕竟他还得顾着地星那边的身体，一般他下线的时间都选在他入睡后。然后在他醒来时也会跟着回来，极少有在地星那边耽搁的时候。

长此以来，郎沐都恍惚以为商非凡就是天河星的兽人土著。

商非凡失笑：“光下线没用，你还在这里呢。而且我现在的主修炼身体是这具兽人身体，这可不是用不死者尸体做成的残次货，根据老光的说法，我这具身体是真正的生命体，还是由自然神力帮忙孕育而成，天赋非凡。我如果要回去地星，自然需要先融合这具身体。”

“融合？要怎么融合？”郎沐早就想问这个问题，他看商非凡一直以来似乎半点不担心回到地星就会失去力量的样子。

他原本以为商非凡豁达，现在想来他应该是早有成算。

“我的天赋之一，不死之身。不死之身这个能力自带可以融合我原身的能力，现在已经融合到了十分之七。”

商非凡一顿：“我有预感，等我把老厄留下的三分之一能量给吸收完，应该还可以再进一成。最后两成……”

“把自然之神的心脏和眼睛归还回去。”郎沐猜到了。

商非凡没有否认。

郎沐按住自己的心脏，当看到商非凡的表情时，他哈哈一笑：“别担心，你以为权杖为什么要给我留一枚自然之种？我能感觉到，当我归还自然之神的那枚心脏，那枚种子就会和我彻底融合，成为我新的心脏，而且是独属于我的，比自然之神那颗还要好得多。”

商非凡轻哼一声。就算没有那枚自然之种，他也不会让郎沐吃亏。如果自然之神敢取走阿沐的心脏却不管他，他大概率会“堕落”为邪神，把这个世界搅合得天翻地覆，把这里的神灵全都拿来当做养料。

郎沐太了解这个人啦，脑门轻轻磕磕他的肩膀，“我觉得我现在就能把自然之神的心脏还回去，你觉得呢？”

“真的不会有后遗症？”老商还是不放心。

郎沐摇头，正经说：“真的不会。不信你等会儿检查。”

商非凡：“……先不急，等我找到那只眼睛时，再一起还。”

郎沐张口，眼中不掩忧心。

商非凡手指按住他的嘴唇：“我是说要赶紧溜，但也不是那么紧急。天河星意识现在肯定察觉到祂的头顶出现了一个新老大，另外祂也察觉到我带走了部分邪神能量。天河星意识就算要找我算账，也会先吸收了我留在封印里的三分之一邪神能量，并且搞明白新生的天道到底是什么、对它是利是弊。等它确定它能打过我，它才会来找我。”

郎沐稍微安心了点，他忽然想起一件事：“对了，你驱逐走邪神，小光有没有给你奖励？”

商非凡笑起来：“有。它在变成天道前给我发布了两个任务，一个是找到老厄被封印的地点，另外一个就是干掉或驱逐老厄。前者奖励最后一枚虫母心脏碎片，后者则是……告诉我前往地星的空间通道坐标。”

“这么说，你岂不是能随时回去地星？”郎沐眼睛亮起来。

商非凡却不是很在意地说：“老光可是答应我，一旦它成为天道，会给我们开空间门，让我们能自由来去地星和天河星。”

比起安全又便捷的空间门，一条危险未知的空间通道就算不上什么啦。

“不过能知道通往地星的空间通道坐标还是好的，一旦有什么事，我们也能有个后路。”郎沐不是不相信光球，而是认为多一条路更好。

### Chapter 286: The Chuunibyou Consciousness of Tianhe Star (Part 1)

Shang Feifan utilized the system’s built-in "Return to City" function, teleporting back to the new city in the Blackwater Wasteland alongside Lang Mu.

Ordinarily, the system’s return function did not allow for bringing others along, but as long as Shang Feifan placed individuals within the Statue Plaza, he could transport as many people as he wished.

Lang Mu had not expected the system to possess such a convenient feature.

"I rarely had the opportunity to use it before," Shang Feifan said, a smile appearing as he looked at the city currently under construction.

Lang Mu also visibly relaxed. The Inner Earth world was vast and boundless, even possessing a sky, but for some reason—perhaps knowing it was the planet's core—he had always felt a subtle, lingering sense of oppression.

"How did you escape from the seal? Was it by the method you told me about?" Lang Mu subconsciously gripped Shang Feifan’s hand.

Sensing his worry, Shang Feifan squeezed his fingers and laughed. "More or less, though I made a few adjustments."

The method they had previously discussed for breaking the seal involved Shang Feifan condensing the Evil God energy passed to him by Old E into an "Evil God Egg." By leaving the egg within the seal, Shang Feifan could borrow the power of the Dark God to break free.

Furthermore, leaving behind the majority of the Evil God's energy would serve as a form of payment to the consciousness of Tianhe Star—the very entity that had lured the Evil God in the first place, hoping to absorb its energy.

However, once Shang Feifan obtained the cultivation technique of the Black Luck Crow, his plans changed.

Originally, he wanted to leave most of the Evil God's energy behind, not only to facilitate his escape but also because he was unsure if he could digest such a massive amount of power. If he mishandled it and became eroded or corrupted by the Evil God’s energy, he might even implicate Lang Mu, with whom he shared a spiritual bond. That was a risk he couldn't afford to take.

Thus, he chose safety over power.

Yet, the Black Luck Crow’s cultivation technique happened to be the perfect counter to Evil God energy, capable of treating it as food. Simply put, for someone practicing the Black Luck Crow’s technique, the Evil God’s energy was not only harmless but a supreme tonic.

Given this, if Shang Feifan still left the energy for the Tianhe Star consciousness, he wouldn't be Shang Feifan.

And so...

"You condensed the Evil God energy into an egg, hid it within your body, and wrapped it in the Black Luck Crow technique so the energy couldn't leak out. Then, the seal determined you had no connection to the Evil God and let you out?"

"The seal didn't 'actively' let me out, of course. To deceive it, I left behind one-third of the Evil God’s energy. When the seal was preoccupied with containing that portion, it naturally paid no mind to a 'little bug' like me who carried no such energy. I simply slipped out through the crack Old E had left behind."

Shang Feifan described it with extreme simplicity, completely omitting the heart-stopping peril of the process.

Especially since the Tianhe Star consciousness, upon discovering the Evil God had escaped, had shifted part of its attention to the seal. He had to be grateful for the "Heavenly Dao Tribulation" caused by the Light Orb; that massive, thunderous display had drawn most of the Tianhe Star consciousness's attention, preventing it from rushing to the seal to deal with him immediately.

Although the consciousness had only focused a portion of its attention, the seal's strength had clearly increased, and it had begun patching the cracks left by Old E at top speed.

This forced him to accelerate, leaving him no time to slowly digest the energy Old E had left behind.

To break through the seal, he had even suffered severe injuries.

This was why his voice had been hoarse when he first saw Lang Mu. Fortunately, his recovery was incredibly fast... His "Undying Body" talent was indeed the cause, but the speed of recovery had exceeded his expectations. Perhaps it was because the talent had leveled up consecutively?

Regardless, he had been too anxious to see Lang Mu and put his mind at ease to think about it or care.

"What now? Should you log off?" Lang Mu felt the term "log off" sounded somewhat foreign.

Shang Feifan logged off frequently, as he still had to attend to his body on Earth, usually choosing to do so after he fell asleep here. He would return when he woke up, rarely lingering on the Earth side.

Over time, Lang Mu had almost subconsciously come to believe that Shang Feifan was a native orc of Tianhe Star.

Shang Feifan chuckled. "Logging off won't work; you're still here. Besides, my primary cultivation body is this orc form. This isn't some defective product made from the corpse of an undead. According to Old Guang, this body is a true living organism, nurtured with the help of natural divine power, and possesses extraordinary talent. If I want to return to Earth, I naturally need to fuse with this body first."

"Fuse? How do you fuse?" Lang Mu had wanted to ask this for a long time. He had noticed that Shang Feifan never seemed worried about losing his power upon returning to Earth.

He had originally thought Shang Feifan was just broad-minded, but now he realized he must have had a plan all along.

"One of my talents is the 'Undying Body.' This ability carries the power to integrate my original form, and it is already seventy percent complete."

Shang Feifan paused. "I have a premonition that once I absorb the remaining one-third of the energy Old E left behind, I should be able to advance another ten percent. As for the final twenty percent..."

"Returning the heart and eyes of the Nature God," Lang Mu guessed.

Shang Feifan did not deny it.

Lang Mu pressed a hand to his own heart. Seeing Shang Feifan’s expression, he laughed. "Don't worry. Why do you think the Scepter left me a 'Seed of Nature'? I can feel that once I return the Nature God's heart, that seed will completely merge with me, becoming my new heart—one that belongs solely to me, and is far better than the Nature God's original one."

Shang Feifan gave a soft huff. Even without that Seed of Nature, he wouldn't let Lang Mu suffer a loss. If the Nature God dared to take A-Mu’s heart without caring for him, he would likely "fall" into becoming an Evil God, turn this world upside down, and use all the gods here as fodder.

Lang Mu knew this man too well; he gently bumped his forehead against Shang Feifan’s shoulder. "I think I could return the Nature God's heart right now. What do you think?"

"Are you sure there won't be any aftereffects?" Old Shang was still uneasy.

Lang Mu shook his head, saying seriously, "There really won't be. If you don't believe me, you can check later."

Shang Feifan: "...No rush. Let's return them together once I find that eye."

Lang Mu opened his mouth, his eyes filled with unconcealed concern.

Shang Feifan pressed a finger to his lips. "I said we need to slip away, but it's not that urgent. The Tianhe Star consciousness must have realized by now that a new 'boss' has appeared above it. It also knows I took part of the Evil God’s energy. Even if it wants to settle scores, it will first absorb the one-third I left in the seal and figure out what this newborn Heavenly Dao is, and whether it’s a benefit or a detriment. Only when it’s certain it can beat me will it come looking for me."

Lang Mu felt slightly more at ease. He suddenly remembered something. "By the way, did Little Guang give you any rewards for driving away the Evil God?"

Shang Feifan laughed. "It did. Before it became the Heavenly Dao, it issued two tasks: one was to find the location where Old E was sealed, and the other was to kill or expel Old E. The former rewarded the final Insect Mother heart fragment, and the latter was... telling me the coordinates of the spatial channel to Earth."

"Does that mean you can return to Earth at any time?" Lang Mu’s eyes brightened.

Shang Feifan, however, said dismissively, "Old Guang promised me that once it becomes the Heavenly Dao, it will open a spatial gate for us, allowing us to travel freely between Earth and Tianhe Star."

Compared to a safe and convenient spatial gate, a dangerous and unknown spatial channel was nothing.

"Still, knowing the coordinates is good. If something happens, we have a backup plan." Lang Mu didn't distrust the Light Orb; he simply believed that having an extra path was better.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第286章 中二的天河星意识 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡正好也是这么想的。尤其他不敢保证光球变成天道后会不会变得没有任何情感，对郎沐也没有了特殊照顾，一切都按照规则公事公办。

商非凡现在最担心的就是当光球变成天道苏醒后，会毫不犹豫地把他扔出天河星，还是用雷劈的方式。然后关上地星和天河星之间的空间通道，让他想回来都没办法回来。

他可以回去，但必须带着郎沐一起，这是他的底线。

“那么这两个奖励你都拿到手了吗？”郎沐问。

商非凡看向游戏商城，颔首：“老光在离开前就把奖励放入了游戏商城，一旦我完成任务，就可以到游戏商城中零贡献点领取任务奖励。”

郎沐懂了：“你接下来是不是要先吸收虫母的最后一枚心脏碎片以及厄穆克拉索留下来的能量？”

“是。想要和天河星意识以及变成天道的老光抗衡，提升实力很重要。”商非凡真的很怕老光兼职王母娘娘，把他和郎沐分开。

“还有帮助自然之神恢复的任务，最好也能尽快完成。”郎沐的直觉让他说出这句话。

商非凡一下就想到兽人大陆正在酝酿的大型地质灾害，如果自然之神能尽早恢复，说不定兽人大陆的灭世灾难也能随之消解得七七八八。

“我现在就开始吸收虫母的心脏碎片。”

等他完整吸收了虫母心脏碎片，就算他不能化身为虫母，也能拥有虫母对变异虫族的天然震慑力量，这对他前往虫人大陆取自然之神那枚眼睛无疑会有极大帮助。

郎沐则说：“我让小花花和阿呆给你护法。你能借用你的部分黑暗之神的力量给我吗？”

商非凡和他心意相通，知道郎沐不是不想守在他身边，而是想要帮助他完成任务——这样，他们面对苏醒后的光球时也能有讨价还价的余地。

“你带上小光和阿呆一起。”商非凡当场把黑暗之神的部分神力凝结为一枚戒指，再融入自己的精神力后交给郎沐——给他戴到左手中指上。

“我不需要他们护法，你带上他们，我更能安心。”

不等郎沐拒绝，商非凡又抓着郎沐的手，把另一枚装了数万不死尸的戒指也套入他手指，边说：“小花花能直接撕裂空间进行穿梭，阿呆能瞬移，你带上他们，不仅可以在紧急时保护自己，也能大大减少路程上的消耗。”

郎沐见商非凡坚持，只能同意：“你打算待在哪里修炼？雕像广场吗？”

雕像广场目前是他们能找到的最安全地点。

谁想，商非凡却摇了摇头。就算自然之神刚刚和他们合作过，并且对方还没有完全恢复，他还是不相信这位本土神灵。

“放心，我自有地方修炼。如果遇到紧急情况，我向你保证，我一定会呼唤你，让你及时赶回来救我。”

郎沐深吸气：“好，那就这样，我们抓紧时间分头行事。我很快就……”

“嘘，别立flag。”商非凡用自己的嘴巴堵住了郎沐没说完的话。

感知到两人气息，带着阿呆飞过来的小花花被阿呆捂住了眼睛。

小花花：“？？？”

不就是两个兽人咬嘴巴吗，有什么不能看的？

阿呆看着天空坚持：“爸爸说，小孩子这时候不能偷看，会长针眼！”

小花花：“……”

一只大手伸过来，把阿呆提起来抛进郎沐怀里：“阿呆，保护好你郎沐爸爸。”

“噢！”阿呆可大声地答应。他一定会保护好阿沐爸爸哒！

小花花飞到郎沐肩膀上，用复眼来回打量商非凡：“你好像有一点不一样了？”

商非凡好笑：“怎么不一样？”

小花花严肃道：“你比以前似乎更厉害了。以前我可以揍得你满头包，现在我也许会被你揍得满头包。”

商非凡摆手，谦虚：“不至于不至于，我现在还不是你的对手。”

但等他吸收了虫母最后一枚心脏碎片那就不一样了。

别看只是最后一枚很小的心脏碎片，但那代表的是最后一片，等他吸收完，他就能获得虫母原本能量的百分之五十。

小花花是获得了虫母传承并啃食消化了虫母的大部分-身体，但心脏是虫母身体的重中之重，是能量储藏的第一要害，否则虫母也不会被打碎心脏后就落败，只能逃回虫人大陆用剩余的力量去孕育新的虫母。

小花花围着商非凡飞了一圈，非常肯定地说：“你身上有我讨厌的气息，非常讨厌！但也非常可怕。”

商非凡目光一闪：小花花这是感知到邪神的能量了吗？他以为他隐藏得很好。

郎沐看着商非凡身上那无法遮掩的一丝邪气，在心里叹了口气。

就算还没有吸收，但那可是让整个天河星本土神灵都差点陨落、让天河星意识都头疼不知道该怎么办并极为眼馋的邪神能量啊，哪怕只是藏在身体中，老商又怎么可能不受影响？

也就是老商心志坚定、精神力坚韧异常，才能不受邪神能量的污染。

但那股子不像好人的邪气大概是暂时甩脱不了了。

商非凡盯着郎沐，目光快速扫过他全身，那意味……

郎沐脸颊爆红。

商非凡挥手：“好了，赶紧走，别在这儿诱惑我了。否则等会儿你想走都走不了！”

他可是一直忍啊忍，要不是顾忌天河星意识和新天道老光，他早就抱着他家阿沐先大战几天几夜再说。

郎沐待不下去了，抱着阿呆就瞬移走了。

小花花也顾不得研究商非凡的变化，嘴里叫着等等我，迅速赶上。

商非凡目送自家大宝贝离开，这才转身向黑水荒原深处走去。

他和郎沐就在新城外面，但谁都没有进入新城。

一股清风拂过商非凡身体。

商非凡脚步没停，继续往前走。

【你不是说我要找你算账的吗？我来了。】

“谢谢你等到郎沐离开才冒出来。”商非凡不是很走心地感谢。

【本源能量化作天道的运行能量，是什么意思？】

“就是你理解的那个意思。”

【什么是天道？】

“就是这个世界自定的运行规则。”商非凡想了想，又加了一句：“同时也要符合整个宇宙的基本规则，应该。”

【那雷是什么？那不是天河星本身酝酿出来的力量。】

“大约是宇宙天道？就像小官的头上还有大官，任何律法组织都需要更高一层的监管。”

【如果是这样，我更应该成为这个世界的天道。】

商非凡摇头：“自己无法监管自己，只要你拥有明确意识和情绪和喜恶，你就无法成为这个世界的天道。像你这样作为星球意识本身的存在，更需要第三方监督。”

【天道会失去情绪和喜恶？变成规则本身？】

“不一定，如果能把规则运行和自身意识脱离，也可以并存。”

【那我也能这么做！】
