### Chapter 286: The Chuunibyou Consciousness of Tianhe Star (Part 2)

Shang Feifan thought exactly the same. He especially couldn't guarantee that once the Light Orb became the Heavenly Dao, it wouldn't lose all emotion and cease its special treatment of Lang Mu, handling everything strictly by the rules.

Shang Feifan’s biggest worry now was that once the Light Orb awakened as the Heavenly Dao, it would unhesitatingly toss him out of Tianhe Star—likely via a lightning strike—and then seal the spatial channel between Earth and Tianhe Star, making it impossible for him to return.

He could go back, but he had to take Lang Mu with him. That was his bottom line.

"So, have you received both rewards?" Lang Mu asked.

Shang Feifan looked at the game store and nodded. "Old Guang put the rewards into the game store before it left. Once I completed the tasks, I could claim them for zero contribution points."

Lang Mu understood. "Are you going to start by absorbing the final heart fragment of the Insect Mother and the energy left behind by Er-Mu-Ke-La-Su?"

"Yes. To contend with the Tianhe Star consciousness and Old Guang after it becomes the Heavenly Dao, increasing my strength is crucial." Shang Feifan was genuinely afraid that Old Guang would moonlight as the Queen Mother of the West and separate him from Lang Mu.

"There's also the task of helping the Nature God recover. It would be best to finish that as soon as possible, too." Lang Mu’s intuition prompted him to say this.

Shang Feifan immediately thought of the large-scale geological disaster brewing on the Orc Continent. If the Nature God could recover sooner, perhaps the apocalyptic catastrophe on the Orc Continent could be largely averted.

"I will start absorbing the Insect Mother's heart fragment now."

Once he fully absorbed it, even if he couldn't transform into the Insect Mother, he would possess its natural deterrent power over the mutated insect race. This would undoubtedly be a huge help when he went to the Insect-Human Continent to retrieve the Nature God's eye.

Lang Mu said, "I'll have Little Flower and A-Dai guard you. Can you lend me some of your Dark God power?"

Shang Feifan, sharing a telepathic bond with him, knew Lang Mu didn't want to leave his side, but rather wanted to help him complete the tasks—so that they would have bargaining chips when facing the awakened Light Orb.

"Take Little Guang and A-Dai with you." Shang Feifan immediately condensed a portion of the Dark God’s divine power into a ring, infused it with his own spiritual energy, and handed it to Lang Mu, slipping it onto his left middle finger.

"I don't need them to guard me. You take them; I'll be more at ease."

Before Lang Mu could refuse, Shang Feifan grabbed his hand and slipped another ring, containing tens of thousands of undead corpses, onto his finger. "Little Flower can tear through space to travel, and A-Dai can teleport. Taking them will not only protect you in an emergency but also greatly reduce the energy consumption of your journey."

Seeing Shang Feifan’s insistence, Lang Mu could only agree. "Where do you plan to cultivate? The Statue Plaza?"

The Statue Plaza was currently the safest place they could find.

To his surprise, Shang Feifan shook his head. Even though the Nature God had just cooperated with them, and the entity hadn't fully recovered, he still didn't trust this local deity.

"Don't worry, I have my own place to cultivate. If I encounter an emergency, I promise I will call you, and you can come back in time to save me."

Lang Mu took a deep breath. "Alright, then. Let's hurry and act separately. I will soon..."

"Shh, don't jinx it." Shang Feifan used his own mouth to block the rest of Lang Mu’s words.

Sensing their presence, Little Flower, who had flown over with A-Dai, had its eyes covered by A-Dai.

Little Flower: "???"

It’s just two orcs kissing, what’s there to hide?

A-Dai looked at the sky and insisted, "Papa said children shouldn't peek at this time, or they'll get styes!"

Little Flower: "..."

A large hand reached out, picked up A-Dai, and tossed him into Lang Mu’s arms. "A-Dai, protect your Papa Lang Mu well."

"Ooh!" A-Dai agreed loudly. He would definitely protect Papa A-Mu well!

Little Flower flew onto Lang Mu’s shoulder, using its compound eyes to look Shang Feifan up and down. "You seem a little different?"

Shang Feifan found it amusing. "How so?"

Little Flower said seriously, "You seem more powerful than before. I used to be able to beat you until you were covered in bumps, but now, I might be the one getting beaten."

Shang Feifan waved his hand, modest. "Not quite, not quite. I'm still not your match."

But once he absorbed the final heart fragment of the Insect Mother, that would change.

Don't let the fact that it was just the final, small heart fragment fool you; it represented the last piece. Once absorbed, he would gain fifty percent of the Insect Mother's original energy.

Little Flower had inherited the Insect Mother's legacy and had devoured and digested most of its body, but the heart was the most critical part—the primary hub for energy storage. Otherwise, the Insect Mother wouldn't have been defeated after its heart was shattered, forced to flee to the Insect-Human Continent to use its remaining power to gestate a new Insect Mother.

Little Flower flew a circle around Shang Feifan and said with certainty, "You have a scent on you that I hate! Very hateful! But also very terrifying."

Shang Feifan’s eyes flashed. Had Little Flower sensed the Evil God’s energy? He thought he had hidden it well.

Lang Mu looked at the faint, inescapable aura of evil on Shang Feifan and sighed in his heart.

Even without absorbing it, that was the Evil God energy that had nearly caused all the local gods of Tianhe Star to perish, the energy that made the Tianhe Star consciousness itself suffer from a headache and covetousness. Even just hiding it in his body, how could Old Shang not be affected?

It was only because Old Shang had such a firm will and exceptionally resilient spiritual power that he wasn't polluted by the Evil God's energy.

But that aura of "not being a good guy" probably couldn't be shaken off for a while.

Shang Feifan stared at Lang Mu, his gaze sweeping over his entire body, the meaning of which...

Lang Mu’s cheeks flushed red.

Shang Feifan waved his hand. "Alright, hurry up and go, don't tempt me here. Otherwise, you won't be able to leave even if you want to!"

He had been holding back and holding back. If not for his concerns about the Tianhe Star consciousness and the new Heavenly Dao, Old Guang, he would have already held his A-Mu and fought for days and nights.

Lang Mu couldn't stay any longer; he grabbed A-Dai and teleported away.

Little Flower, too, couldn't bother with studying Shang Feifan’s changes, shouting "Wait for me!" as it quickly caught up.

Shang Feifan watched his "big treasure" leave before turning to walk deep into the Blackwater Wasteland.

He and Lang Mu were just outside the new city, but neither had entered it.

A breeze brushed past Shang Feifan’s body.

Shang Feifan didn't stop his pace, continuing forward.

[You said I was going to settle scores with you? I'm here.]

"Thanks for waiting until Lang Mu left before showing up," Shang Feifan said, his gratitude lacking sincerity.

[What does it mean for source energy to become the operating energy of the Heavenly Dao?]

"Exactly what you understand it to mean."

[What is the Heavenly Dao?]

"It's the self-defined operating rules of this world." Shang Feifan thought for a moment and added, "It must also conform to the basic rules of the entire universe, presumably."

[Then what was that lightning? That was not a power brewed by Tianhe Star itself.]

"Probably the Universal Heavenly Dao? Just like how there are higher officials above low-level ones; any legal organization requires a higher level of supervision."

[If that is the case, I should be the one to become the Heavenly Dao of this world.]

Shang Feifan shook his head. "One cannot supervise oneself. As long as you possess clear consciousness, emotions, and preferences, you cannot become the Heavenly Dao of this world. An existence like you, as the planet's consciousness itself, needs third-party supervision even more."

[Will the Heavenly Dao lose its emotions and preferences? Become the rules themselves?]

"Not necessarily. If you can separate the operation of the rules from your own consciousness, they can coexist."

[Then I can do that too!]

chunks.chapterTitle: 第286章 中二的天河星意识 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡第一次和天河星意识接触，然后就明白为什么老光被他忽悠几句就决定去当天河星的天道了，因为这个天河星意识就是一个中二少年——它自己想的、决定的都是对的，其他违逆它的都是不应该存在的，它就应该天上地下唯我独尊。

“越是强大的个体存在或组织，越是需要第三方监督。”

【你知道我能让你消失，连意识都无法存留。】

“以前你可以，但现在……就算你能做到，你也会付出极大代价，比如星球被我自爆毁掉一半。你愿意这样吗？”

【我不需要天道！】

“嗯，你不需要，但天河星需要。以前的天河星看似有秩序，实际混乱，这才能吸引到一个邪神。你作为星球意识本身，为了强大自身，不惜吸引一个专门喜欢混乱无秩序、就爱把生命星球祸害成垃圾的邪神，你说你不需要第三方的监督？那这颗星球上的无数生命一定很需要。”

【我想要自己变得更强大有错吗？而且这颗星球就是我，星球上生出的所有东西也都是我的，我想要怎么处理自己的东西，难道不是我的自由？】

商非凡叹息一声：“你说的很对，就像我们人类很多父母一样，他们也认为孩子就是自己的财产，想怎么对待、想怎么处理都可以。”

【他们不是我的孩子。】

“嗯，感觉出来了，你自己都还小呢。”

天河星意识大约察觉出这句话不像是什么好话，微风忽然化作刀锋刮过商非凡的脸。

商非凡的脸上出现一道血痕，慢慢渗出血珠，流下。

商非凡就像是没感觉到，继续往前走，但他嘴中却慢悠悠说：“这是你第一次对我出手，看在郎沐和阿呆他们都是在天河星长大的份上，我认下这一次。”

【如果有第二次？】天河星意识似乎真的很好奇。

“那就相当于你在主动挑衅我，想和我开战。而我会应战。”

商非凡这句话说得很平淡，连高低起伏都没有。但天河星意识却沉默下来。

【我想变得更为强大，你知道要怎么做吗？】

商非凡挑眉，这个天河星意识学习能力很强啊，竟然没有继续“傲”下去。

“你想变强，就不能一直留在天河星。”

【什么意思？天河星就是我，我就是天河星，你让我脱离我自己的身体？】

“我的意思是说，你不能一直盯着天河星这一亩三分地，你得把眼光放得更长远。”

【到底要怎么做？】中二少年急声问。

“你不是想到了捕猎邪神，吸收邪神能量来增强自己的方法吗？”商非凡正色道：“首先，这个想法没错，但你选择的对象错误了。”

【怎么说？】

“因为你无法保证自己把邪神这一类存在吸引过来后，不会对天河星本身造成伤害，更无法保证你吸收了邪神能量后不会被污染变异。”

【那我应该追逐什么样的能量？】

“你可以到更远的星系去寻找适合你的星球能量，比如正在孕育中的星核、宇宙中散落的星球本源能量。当你把这些能量运回来并吸收，天河星和你才能真正地壮大，还安全。”

【……可是我要怎么脱离天河星去宇宙中遨游？】

“所以你不能闭关锁星，你需要和外界交流。虽然打开交流和上升通道会有一定危险，但比起获得的好处来说，这点危险完全值得。何况天河星现在有了自己的天道规则，别看天道管着你，但实际上祂也在保护你和这颗星球本身。”

【这些都是虚的，我要知道现在我该怎么脱离天河星本身去更远的地方寻找增强我的能量！】

商非凡差点翻白眼，难搞的小鬼！

“简单。我这具身体是怎么生成的？你照样弄一具，你如果不会弄，就找自然之神帮忙。实在不行，你也能寄生在一个刚死或快要死的生命体身上，然后用那具身体修炼，当达到和本土神灵一样被天河星排斥的力量程度，你就能通过天道规则脱离天河星，前往更高等世界。”

不等天河星意识反应，商非凡又补充一句：“不要问我具体的修炼方法，你可以去请教……询问本土神灵，祂们能从一个普通生物成长到神灵的地步，自然有祂们的修炼方法。你可以借鉴，也可以创造新的适合你的修炼法。你是星球意识，你肯定能做到。”

微风吹过商非凡的头发。

商非凡缓缓吐气：终于忽悠走了。

接下来他也能安心吸收虫母心脏能量和邪神的能量了。

只希望他能抢在老光苏醒前，就能到达老光劈不动他的程度……最起码也要能保证不会被劈死。
chunks.englishText:
### Chapter 286: The Chuunibyou Consciousness of Tianhe Star (Part 3)

This was Shang Feifan’s first contact with the Tianhe Star consciousness, and he finally understood why Old Guang had decided to become the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star after being coaxed by him for a few sentences: this Tianhe Star consciousness was nothing more than a *chuunibyou* teenager—it believed everything it thought or decided was correct, that anything defying it shouldn't exist, and that it should be the sole sovereign of heaven and earth.

"The more powerful an individual entity or organization is, the more it needs third-party supervision."

[You know I can make you disappear, leaving not even your consciousness behind.]

"You could have before, but now... even if you could do it, you would pay a heavy price, such as half the planet being destroyed by my self-detonation. Are you willing to do that?"

[I don't need a Heavenly Dao!]

"Hmm, you don't, but Tianhe Star does. The Tianhe Star of the past seemed orderly, but it was actually chaotic, which is what attracted an Evil God. As the planet's consciousness itself, you were willing to attract an Evil God—who loves chaos and disorder and enjoys turning living planets into trash—just to strengthen yourself. And you say you don't need third-party supervision? The countless lives on this planet certainly need it."

[Is it wrong for me to want to become stronger? And this planet is me; everything born on this planet is also mine. Is it not my freedom to handle my own things as I wish?]

Shang Feifan sighed. "You are quite right, just like many human parents who believe their children are their property, to be treated or handled however they wish."

[They are not my children.]

"Hmm, I can tell. You're still just a child yourself."

The Tianhe Star consciousness likely sensed that this wasn't a compliment, as the breeze suddenly turned into blades, scraping across Shang Feifan’s face.

A bloody scratch appeared on Shang Feifan’s face, slowly oozing beads of blood that trickled down.

Shang Feifan acted as if he didn't feel it, continuing to walk forward, but he said slowly, "This is the first time you've attacked me. For the sake of Lang Mu and A-Dai, who both grew up on Tianhe Star, I will let this one slide."

[And if there is a second time?] The Tianhe Star consciousness seemed genuinely curious.

"Then it will be equivalent to you actively provoking me, wanting to go to war. And I will accept that challenge."

Shang Feifan’s words were flat, without any rise or fall in tone. But the Tianhe Star consciousness fell silent.

[I want to become more powerful. Do you know how to do that?]

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow. This Tianhe Star consciousness was a quick learner; it hadn't continued to be "arrogant."

"If you want to become stronger, you cannot stay on Tianhe Star forever."

[What does that mean? Tianhe Star is me, and I am Tianhe Star. Are you asking me to leave my own body?]

"I mean you cannot keep your eyes fixed only on this little plot of land that is Tianhe Star. You need to look further ahead."

[What exactly should I do?] the *chuunibyou* teenager asked urgently.

"Didn't you think of hunting Evil Gods and absorbing their energy to strengthen yourself?" Shang Feifan said sternly. "First of all, the idea isn't wrong, but you chose the wrong target."

[How so?]

"Because you cannot guarantee that after attracting such existences as Evil Gods, you won't cause harm to Tianhe Star itself, nor can you guarantee that you won't be polluted and mutated after absorbing their energy."

[Then what kind of energy should I pursue?]

"You can go to more distant star systems to find planetary energy suitable for you, such as star cores in the process of gestation or planetary source energy scattered throughout the universe. When you bring these energies back and absorb them, both you and Tianhe Star can truly grow stronger, and safely."

[...But how am I to leave Tianhe Star to roam the universe?]

"That is why you cannot 'close the door' on the star. You need to communicate with the outside world. Although opening communication and ascension channels carries certain risks, the benefits far outweigh them. Besides, Tianhe Star now has its own Heavenly Dao rules. Don't look at the Heavenly Dao as if it's controlling you; in reality, it is protecting both you and the planet itself."

[These are all empty words. I want to know how I can leave Tianhe Star right now to find energy to strengthen myself in more distant places!]

Shang Feifan almost rolled his eyes. What a difficult brat!

"Simple. How was this body of mine generated? You can create one just like it. If you don't know how, ask the Nature God for help. If that doesn't work, you can also parasitize a newly dead or dying living body, then use that body to cultivate. Once you reach a level of power that is rejected by Tianhe Star—just like the local gods—you will be able to leave Tianhe Star through the Heavenly Dao rules and head to higher worlds."

Before the Tianhe Star consciousness could react, Shang Feifan added, "Don't ask me for specific cultivation methods. You can go ask... the local gods. Since they were able to grow from ordinary creatures to gods, they naturally have their own cultivation methods. You can learn from them or create new ones that suit you. You are a planetary consciousness; you can certainly do it."

A breeze blew through Shang Feifan’s hair.

Shang Feifan exhaled slowly: Finally, I've managed to hoodwink it.

Now he could focus on absorbing the Insect Mother’s heart energy and the Evil God’s energy in peace.

He only hoped he could reach a level where Old Guang couldn't strike him down before the Light Orb awakened... or at the very least, ensure he wouldn't be struck dead.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第287章 我把你当我的孩子看 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第287章 我把你当我的孩子看

【你这个骗子！差点被你骗了！】

天河星意识又杀了回来。

刚准备拿出虫母最后一枚心脏碎片的商非凡不得不停止动作：“我怎么骗你了？”

【你从头到尾都在骗我！我努力壮大星球本身，带回大量能量，可寄生在我身上的那些生命盗窃我的能量，利用我辛苦带回来的能量修炼，等到他们达到一定程度就能脱离本星，那我不是吃了大亏。而且长此以往，我的身体不是要被吸干？】

商非凡还以为天河星意识要控诉什么，听到这话，不由叹了口气：“这事很为难吗？明明很好解决。”

【怎么解决？】

“你可以和天河星天道协商，定下规则，比如吸收多少本星能量，在离开后多少年内必须归还，还可以加上利息。这就跟兽人学校有无息贷款和低息贷款提供给学生，让学生毕业后归还是同样道理。本星天道和天河星本身息息相关，为了天河星长远发展，这必然是祂会确定的天道规则。”

【如果出去的家伙赖账呢？】

“我们那儿的人类有一种现象，就是讲究落叶归根，生前不管如何，死后就想要回到家乡，据说这是刻写在基因里的意识。”

天河星意识听懂了：【你是说把规则刻写入天河星所有生物的基因中？】

“这只是一种操作方法。还可以与脱离天河星的存在签订契约，如果多少年内不能归还从天河星拿走的总体资源，那么天河星就有权从对方身上每月强行吸收一定能量并提高利息作为补偿。”

天河星意识毫不犹豫地说：【任何契约都有漏洞，不如直接把这些规则刻写入生物基因中。只要是天河星存在，用了天河星的，将来都必须归还，自己不愿意或忘记，就通过天道强行归还。】

商非凡：“你看，这不就解决了？”

天河星意识终于满意，微风拂过商非凡的脸：【你在这里吸收虫母和邪神的能量吧，没有谁会来打扰你。】

商非凡吐气，正要闭眼。

【对了，你从我天河星拿走的能量，将来也要归还！我们先签个契约，利息算你五成。】

商非凡：“……你高利贷呢！”

【四成五，不能再少了。】

“顶多一成，百年一成。你签订太高的利息，小心天河星出去的存在还清欠账后转头就找你麻烦。”

【明明你们人类都是按年利算……】

“那能一样吗？百年最合适，要求百年内还清贷款，只要付一成利息。超过百年，三百年以内归还就加息零点五成。五百年以内两成，千年以内三成。”

【这个利息，你保证出去的家伙不会不满也不会报复天河星？】

“一般来说都不会，这也算是反哺和偿还因果。而且假设天河星是低能量世界，出去的超凡者前往的都是中等和高等能量世界，他们在那些世界说不定随便弄一些东西就能把欠债全部还清。”

【倒也是。那就按照你说的做，我让天道都给刻写入基因里。】天河星意识这才真正满意，离去的风都带着欢快。

“等等！我帮你出主意，你不给点好处？以后谁还帮你出主意。”商非凡扬声。

【……你可以不用还利息！】

老商此时特别想把他家阿沐拉来，好指着天河星意识给他看：看看，见过这么小气的星球意识吗？

天河星意识还能更小气，它等到天道苏醒，就找对方商量（要求）：

不仅要把对天河星本身的欠债还款还要加利息的规则刻写入天河星所有生物和非生物的基因中，其他来到天河星的外来者，只要吃了用了拿了天河星的资源，哪怕是喝了一口风，也得在离开时签订契约加利息归还。

为了防止那些外来者不肯签订契约，或者凭借自身强大力量强行突破和做强盗。天河星意识决定在星球上就布置一个天然因果契约阵法，只要进入天河星范围（包括外太空），就必须遵守该契约。

因果契约，想要违背必然要付出莫大代价。

天道理所当然地同意了，这属于星球的合理要求，且可以一定程度地避免天河星资源过早枯竭的悲惨局面，说不定还能让天河星进入良性运转，当然要满足。

等到天河星意识和天道狼狈为奸，暗搓搓地制定了数条有利于天河星本身的基础规则后，商非凡也总算把虫母最后一枚心脏给吸收完毕。

邪神留下的三分之一能量只能留着慢慢吸收。

他也想一口吃成大胖子，但一口吃成大胖子的代价太大，流油爆体都是轻的，搞不好还会撑成精神病。

这时的他已经顺利进入九级也就是法神境界。

商非凡察觉自己的新境界时，特意抬头看天：还好，没有雷电劈下来。大概成为法神还不够挨雷劈？

某天道：哎呀，错过了！气死我也！

天道苏醒的时候，全球范围下了一场雨，这场雨持续了七天七夜，幸好不是很大。

这七天七夜中，不管是淋到雨还是没有淋到雨的存在，都有短暂陷入昏睡的经历，一批接着一批，在无意识中被刻入新的基因图谱。

之后，所有天河星存在潜意识中都有了关于“天道”的认知。

商非凡找到郎沐时，郎沐正指挥数万不死尸在解决一个新出现的岩浆爆发点。

这里位于北方联盟。

北熊震盟主得到消息，亲自赶来，陪同郎沐一同。

郎沐负责寻找和挖掘适合的排岩浆渠道，北熊盟主负责把沿途的居民等生物全部搬迁。

北熊盟主再见到商非凡，只觉得自己已经看不透对方。

第一次面对商非凡，他有种和对方实力旗鼓相当之感。所以哪怕商非凡年轻又没什么背景，他还是对对方以礼相待。

第二次见到商，也就是上次在鬼火城，他感到如果他和商对敌，可能要拼尽老命才能求得两分胜算。

而这次再见，他想，幸好他和商非凡以及郎沐关系都很不错。

有商非凡加入，这次排险过程顿时加快许多。

郎沐利用商非凡送给他的戒指指挥不死尸，虽然戒指中有商非凡留下的精神力和黑暗之神的神力，但到底不如商非凡亲自指挥来得顺畅。

如果不是郎沐本身实力也很强，那名八级不死尸可能都不会听令行事。

郎沐看商非凡过来就飞快搞定他手头上的一摊子麻烦事，还以为老商接下来就要带他去虫人大陆。

结果老商客气地婉拒了北熊盟主的感谢宴，找了座无人的大雪山，放出龟甲堡，就拉着他进入了龟甲堡……

小花花和阿呆都被无情地丢出龟甲堡。

阿呆低头看被塞入怀里的零花钱袋子，总觉得这种事以后恐怕会不断发生。

小花花则很高兴，乐滋滋地收起钱袋子，怂恿阿呆：“我们进北方联盟的冰雪城玩吧，我看他们一时半会不会结束。说不定等他们完事，你就有小弟弟或小妹妹了。”

阿呆：“……”

Chapter 287: I Look at You Like My Own Child

【You liar! I almost fell for your tricks!】

The consciousness of the Tianhe Star had returned with a vengeance.

Shang Feifan, who had just been preparing to take out the final heart fragment of the Insect Mother, had no choice but to stop his movements. "How did I lie to you?"

【You’ve been lying to me from the very beginning! I work hard to strengthen the planet itself and bring back massive amounts of energy, but the life forms parasitic upon me steal my energy. They use the energy I worked so hard to gather to cultivate, and once they reach a certain level, they leave the planet. Doesn't that mean I’m taking a huge loss? Furthermore, if this continues, won't my body be sucked dry?】

Shang Feifan had expected the Tianhe Star consciousness to complain about something else. Hearing this, he couldn't help but sigh. "Is this really such a difficult problem? It’s actually quite easy to solve."

【How do you solve it?】

"You can negotiate with the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star and set some rules. For example, specify how much of the planet's energy they absorb and require them to return it within a certain number of years after leaving. You could even add interest. It’s the same principle as how Orc schools provide interest-free or low-interest loans to students, requiring repayment after graduation. The Heavenly Dao is inextricably linked to the planet itself; for the long-term development of Tianhe Star, this is a rule It would certainly establish."

【What if the ones who leave refuse to pay their debts?】

"In our world, humans have a phenomenon known as 'falling leaves returning to their roots.' No matter how one lives their life, they wish to return to their homeland after death. It is said that this consciousness is inscribed into our very genes."

The Tianhe Star consciousness understood: 【Are you saying I should inscribe these rules into the genes of all living beings on Tianhe Star?】

"That’s just one method. You could also sign contracts with entities that leave the planet. If they fail to return the total resources taken from Tianhe Star within a certain number of years, the planet would have the right to forcibly absorb a certain amount of energy from them every month, with increased interest as compensation."

The Tianhe Star consciousness said without hesitation: 【Every contract has loopholes. It would be better to simply inscribe these rules into their genes. As long as they are beings of Tianhe Star and have used its resources, they must return them in the future. If they are unwilling or forget, the Heavenly Dao will forcibly reclaim it.】

Shang Feifan: "See? Isn't that solved?"

The Tianhe Star consciousness was finally satisfied. A gentle breeze brushed against Shang Feifan’s face: 【You may absorb the energy of the Insect Mother and the Evil God here. No one will disturb you.】

Shang Feifan exhaled, just about to close his eyes.

【By the way, the energy you took from my Tianhe Star must also be returned in the future! Let’s sign a contract first; I’ll set your interest at fifty percent.】

Shang Feifan: "...Are you running a loan shark business?!"

【Forty-five percent, not a cent less.】

"Ten percent at most, ten percent per century. If you set the interest too high, be careful—once the beings who leave Tianhe Star pay off their debts, they might turn around and cause trouble for you."

【But you humans calculate interest by the year...】

"Is that the same thing? A century is the most appropriate timeframe. Require the loan to be paid off within a hundred years for ten percent interest. If it exceeds a hundred years, add five percent for every three hundred years. Within five hundred years, twenty percent; within a thousand, thirty percent."

【With this interest rate, can you guarantee that those who leave won't be dissatisfied or retaliate against Tianhe Star?】

"Generally speaking, no. This can be considered a form of feedback and settling of karma. Besides, assuming Tianhe Star is a low-energy world, the transcendents who leave are heading to medium or high-energy worlds. They might be able to pay off their debts just by picking up a few things in those worlds."

【That is true. Then we shall do as you say. I will have the Heavenly Dao inscribe it into their genes.】 The Tianhe Star consciousness was truly satisfied now; even the departing breeze felt cheerful.

"Wait! I gave you the idea, aren't you going to give me some benefits? Who’s going to give you advice in the future otherwise?" Shang Feifan called out.

【...You don't have to pay interest!】

At that moment, Old Shang really wanted to drag his A-Mu over just to point at the Tianhe Star consciousness: Look, have you ever seen such a stingy planetary consciousness?

The Tianhe Star consciousness could be even stingier. Once the Heavenly Dao awoke, it sought to discuss (demand) that not only should the rules for debt repayment and interest be inscribed into the genes of all biological and non-biological entities on Tianhe Star, but any outsiders who came to the planet—even if they just drank a mouthful of wind—must sign a contract to return resources with interest upon leaving.

To prevent those outsiders from refusing to sign or using their superior strength to break through or act as bandits, the Tianhe Star consciousness decided to set up a natural karmic contract formation across the planet. As long as one entered the range of Tianhe Star (including outer space), one had to abide by the contract.

A karmic contract—to violate it would inevitably come at a great price.

The Heavenly Dao agreed as a matter of course. This was a reasonable request for the planet, and it could, to a certain extent, avoid the tragic situation of Tianhe Star’s resources being depleted prematurely. It might even allow the planet to enter a virtuous cycle, so of course, it had to be satisfied.

By the time the Tianhe Star consciousness and the Heavenly Dao had colluded to secretly establish several fundamental rules beneficial to the planet, Shang Feifan had finally finished absorbing the last of the Insect Mother’s heart.

The one-third of the energy left behind by the Evil God would have to be saved for slow absorption.

He also wanted to become a powerhouse in one go, but the price of doing so was too high—leaking energy or exploding would be the least of his worries; he might even end up becoming mentally deranged.

By this time, he had successfully entered the Ninth Level, the realm of a Law God.

When Shang Feifan sensed his new realm, he deliberately looked up at the sky: Thank goodness, no lightning struck him down. Perhaps becoming a Law God wasn't enough to warrant a lightning strike?

A certain Heavenly Dao: *Ah, I missed it! It’s infuriating!*

When the Heavenly Dao awoke, a rain fell across the entire globe. This rain lasted for seven days and seven nights, though fortunately, it wasn't very heavy.

During these seven days and nights, whether they were rained on or not, every existence experienced a brief period of falling into a deep sleep, batch after batch, having the new genetic map inscribed into them while unconscious.

Afterward, all beings on Tianhe Star had a subconscious awareness of the "Heavenly Dao."

When Shang Feifan found Lang Mu, Lang Mu was commanding tens of thousands of Undead Corpses to resolve a newly emerged volcanic eruption point.

This was located in the Northern Alliance.

The leader of the Northern Bear Alliance, having received the news, rushed over personally to accompany Lang Mu.

Lang Mu was responsible for finding and excavating channels suitable for draining the magma, while the Northern Bear leader was responsible for relocating all residents and living beings along the path.

When the Northern Bear leader saw Shang Feifan again, he felt he could no longer see through the man.

The first time he faced Shang Feifan, he felt they were evenly matched in strength. Even though Shang Feifan was young and had no background, he treated him with respect.

The second time he saw Shang, back at Ghost Fire City, he felt that if he were to become enemies with him, he would have to risk his life just to have a two-in-ten chance of winning.

And seeing him again this time, he thought, it was fortunate that his relationship with Shang Feifan and Lang Mu was quite good.

With Shang Feifan’s participation, the risk-mitigation process accelerated significantly.

Lang Mu used the ring Shang Feifan had given him to command the Undead Corpses. Although the ring contained Shang Feifan’s spiritual power and the divine power of the God of Darkness, it was ultimately not as smooth as Shang Feifan commanding them personally.

If Lang Mu hadn't been quite strong himself, that Eighth-Level Undead Corpse might not have obeyed his orders.

Seeing Shang Feifan arrive and quickly resolve the mess he was dealing with, Lang Mu thought Old Shang was about to take him to the Insect-Human Continent.

Instead, Old Shang politely declined the Northern Bear leader’s thank-you banquet, found a deserted snowy mountain, released the Turtle Shell Fortress, and dragged him inside...

Little Flower and A-Dai were ruthlessly tossed out of the Turtle Shell Fortress.

A-Dai looked down at the pocket money bag stuffed into his arms, feeling that this kind of thing would probably keep happening in the future.

Little Flower, however, was very happy. It joyfully tucked away the money bag and urged A-Dai: "Let’s go play in the Ice and Snow City of the Northern Alliance. I don't think they’ll be done for a while. Maybe by the time they’re finished, you’ll have a little brother or sister."

A-Dai: "..."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第287章 我把你当我的孩子看 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
商非凡抱着心爱的大宝贝，正准备大战三百回合，他已经箭在弦上，阿沐也脸红红地躲进了被子里。

“咚，咚”

水晶窗被敲响。

商非凡：……他什么都没听见！

“咚，咚”

商非凡：弃耳不闻！

“咚！我是给郎沐面子才先敲门，给你们一分钟，客厅见！”老光气呼呼的声音在窗户外响起，声音特别炸耳。

商非凡：艹！

郎沐从被子里伸出手推推他，强装镇定地说：“起来穿衣服。”

商非凡气得眼睛通红：泥马的破天道！给我等着！这家伙要不是故意的，他把头砍下来！

一分钟后，客厅内冷如冰霜，只有郎沐坐的这一块才稍微有点温度。

老光翘着腿，祂进化了——从只有一个球外加两只小手手，又进化出了两条细长腿。

“来，我们谈谈。为什么你没有跟我说成为天道还会挨雷劈？”老光一副要算账的口吻。

商非凡语气更冷，冷峻又阴狠的眼神跟要灭谁全家一样：“你没有得到好处吗？还是你没有成为天道？既然你已经成为天道，你难道会不知道想要得到什么就得付出什么的道理？得到越多，付出自然也会越多。”

老光何尝不知道这个道理，就因为祂知道自己辩不过商非凡，才故意挑这个时候上门找茬。

“那你为什么还要在这里耽搁时间，不赶紧去完成任务？难道你想兽人大陆毁灭吗？就这样你还想要拐走我兽人大陆土生土长的兽人？”

商非凡：“……你没听过劳逸结合吗？”

“我只看到你在浪费时间！两个雄的滚来滚去有什么用，纯属浪费时间浪费蛋白质。”老光手头上幻化出一支小皮鞭，抽得茶几啪啪响：“赶紧去虫人大陆把自然之神雕像的眼睛找回来，快点让自然之神恢复。想要滚床单，以后有的是时间。如果兽人大陆在半月内拯救成功，我就赐予你生孩子的功能。”

商非凡不怒反笑，还特别感兴趣地问：“真的吗？你不要驴我。”

老光：“真的。绝不骗你。”

商非凡立马起身，拉起郎沐就说：“那就这样说定，阿沐，我们去虫人大陆。”

郎沐：“……”

老光以为某人听错，特意着重说明：“我是说如果你能在半月内拯救兽人大陆，就让你拥有生孩子的能力，是你，不是别人。”

商非凡挑眉：“我耳力没问题。”

随后转头就对郎沐说：“阿沐，我给你生个小虎崽好不好？”

郎沐嘴上说你别乱说，眼睛却亮亮的。

老光：“……”怎么跟祂想得不一样，这家伙的脸皮厚度是不是随着实力提升也增加了？

商非凡那边都开始跟郎沐商讨小虎崽该取什么名字了。

“咳，小光，我们谈正事哈。”郎沐按住捣乱的某人，温和地对光球说：“你现在已经成为天河星天道，那么你还能做阿商的系统吗？”

光球：“可以，我是我，天道是天道。你可以把两者分开看。”

郎沐笑：“那就好。有你帮助阿商，我就放心了。”

随后郎沐就似不经意地说：“等到把自然之神的眼睛和心脏都拿到后，阿商的原身和现在的身体就能合二为一了吧？你也是在那时候彻底脱离阿商？”

光球停顿半秒，回答：“等到主线任务完成，按照规则，只要宿主要求，我就必须彻底脱离宿主。至于商非凡想要把两具身体合二为一，必须等他用现在的身体回到地星才能操作。”

“那他能把自己的能力全都带回去吗？”

“当然能。只要地星那边的天地规则能允许他留在地星。”

商非凡听到这句话生出一点微妙感，也许他回到地星把两具身体融合之时就是他被地星排斥之时。

“我能把地星那边的身体送到这边进行融合吗？”商非凡插话问。

光球看了眼郎沐，不情不愿地说：“可以。不过需要耗费大量能量在地星那边开启空间门，会很麻烦，不如在这边开空间门方便。”

郎沐按住商非凡的手，思考片刻，又问：“阿商和我回去地星，是不是会被排斥？”

光球：“按照我的判断，如果我们天河星是低能量世界，地星就是微能量世界。以你们俩的实力，尤其是完成任务后，回去地星不是被立刻排斥出来，就是会被压制力量。”

“阿商在地星那边融合身体有什么危险？”郎沐紧接着问。

光球沉默。

“小光？”郎沐带着一丝乞求。

商非凡皱眉，但看到郎沐的眼神后，他咽下了不爽。

光球重重哼了一声：“就知道你心疼这家伙！算了，跟你们直说了，商非凡不能在地星融合身体，他只能在天河星这边融合，因为地星那边很可能在商融合一半的时候就把他踢出地星。不过由我动手在地星那边开启空间门太耗费能量，还需要通过地星意识或那边的天道同意，否则我这就是入侵行为，会被找麻烦的。”

商非凡念头一转，脸上冰霜消失，露出了商业性笑容：“老光，我们什么关系？这时候你还跟我藏着掖着？你是不是想要以后跟着郎沐？其实也不是不可以，只要阿沐同意。”

光球几乎是飞快地说道：“我可以变成郎沐的个人光脑，可以辅佐他做很多事情。我不会驻入他的精神海，只要外置就可以。”

郎沐不讨厌光球，相反还很喜欢，但他还是问道：“小光，你对我的感情可能是延伸自另外一条时间线上的我，而我和那个我并不是同一个人，你明白吗？”

光球飞快点头：“我当然明白，我和那个郎沐已经合作很久，我不是想要借由你延续和那个郎沐的感情，我是想要……守护你长大。”

郎沐愣住。

光球看着郎沐的眼神特别温柔：“你于我就像是我和那个郎沐的孩子。”

商非凡：呸！你这么说，另一个商非凡同意了吗？

光球才不管另一个旁听者听了会有什么感觉，还在柔情脉脉地说：“在兽人大陆，你这个年龄还是小孩子呢，你父母都没了，地星那边也没有亲人，虽然有姥爷姥姥，但他们年龄都大了，无法陪伴你成长，更无法守护你，但我不一样，我可以给你保护，可以陪伴你很久很久。”

郎沐动容。

光球真心实意地：“如果将来你和某人分手，伤心难过时，我也可以陪伴你。如果他背叛你，在外面搞三搞四，我也可以帮你教训他。”

商非凡脸黑了。

郎沐……笑了：“好啊。”

光球跳起来：“你同意了？”

郎沐点头：“只要你不觉得麻烦，我很愿意有你这位伙伴和……长辈照顾。”

光球乐开了花：“好好好，我一定会照顾好你，保证不让任何人欺负你！”

商非凡：“……”强烈要求二人世界！连阿呆他都不想带着跑，为什么还要加一个泰山老丈人？

郎沐看光球高兴，也笑着说：“那我们就这么说定。那阿商这边？”

Chapter 287: I Look at You Like My Own Child (Part 2)

Shang Feifan was holding his beloved treasure, preparing for a battle of three hundred rounds. He was already at the point of no return, and A-Mu had also hidden under the covers with a flushed face.

*Knock, knock.*

The crystal window was tapped.

Shang Feifan: ...He heard nothing!

*Knock, knock.*

Shang Feifan: Deaf to the world!

"Knock! I’m only knocking first out of respect for Lang Mu. You have one minute, see you in the living room!" Old Guang’s grumpy voice rang out from outside the window, sounding particularly jarring.

Shang Feifan: *Damn it!*

Lang Mu reached out from under the covers to push him, pretending to be calm as he said, "Get up and put your clothes on."

Shang Feifan was so angry his eyes turned red: *Damn that broken Heavenly Dao! Just you wait! If this guy wasn't doing this on purpose, I’ll chop my own head off!*

A minute later, the living room was cold as ice, with only the area where Lang Mu sat retaining a hint of warmth.

Old Guang was sitting with its legs crossed. It had evolved—from just a ball with two little hands, it had now evolved two thin, long legs.

"Come, let’s talk. Why didn't you tell me that becoming the Heavenly Dao would also result in being struck by lightning?" Old Guang spoke in a tone of settling accounts.

Shang Feifan’s tone was even colder, his grim and vicious gaze as if he were about to wipe out someone’s entire family: "Did you not receive benefits? Or did you not become the Heavenly Dao? Since you have already become the Heavenly Dao, do you not understand the principle that to gain something, one must pay a price? The more you gain, the greater the price will naturally be."

Old Guang knew this principle all too well. It was precisely because it knew it couldn't win an argument against Shang Feifan that it had deliberately chosen this moment to come and pick a fight.

"Then why are you wasting time here instead of hurrying to complete your mission? Do you want the Orc Continent to be destroyed? And even then, you still want to abduct an Orc born and bred on my Orc Continent?"

Shang Feifan: "...Have you never heard of balancing work and rest?"

"I only see you wasting time! What’s the use of two males rolling around? It’s purely a waste of time and protein." Old Guang conjured a small leather whip and snapped it against the coffee table: "Hurry to the Insect-Human Continent and find the eyes of the God of Nature. Restore the God of Nature quickly. If you want to roll in the sheets, there will be plenty of time later. If the Orc Continent is successfully saved within half a month, I will grant you the ability to bear children."

Shang Feifan didn't get angry; instead, he laughed and asked with great interest: "Really? Don't try to fool me."

Old Guang: "Really. I would never lie to you."

Shang Feifan immediately stood up, pulled Lang Mu along, and said: "Then it’s a deal. A-Mu, let’s go to the Insect-Human Continent."

Lang Mu: "..."

Old Guang thought someone had misheard, so it specifically emphasized: "I mean, if you can save the Orc Continent within half a month, I will let you have the ability to bear children. You, not anyone else."

Shang Feifan raised an eyebrow: "My hearing is just fine."

He then turned to Lang Mu and said: "A-Mu, how about I bear you a little tiger cub?"

Lang Mu said with his mouth that he shouldn't talk nonsense, but his eyes were shining brightly.

Old Guang: "..." How is this different from what it imagined? Has this guy’s skin thickness increased along with his strength?

Shang Feifan was already discussing with Lang Mu what name they should give the little tiger cub.

"Ahem, Little Guang, let’s talk business." Lang Mu held down the troublemaker and said gently to the ball of light: "You have now become the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star, so can you still be A-Shang’s system?"

The ball of light: "I can. I am me, and the Heavenly Dao is the Heavenly Dao. You can treat them as separate entities."

Lang Mu smiled: "That’s good. With you helping A-Shang, I can rest easy."

Then Lang Mu said as if casually: "Once we get the eyes and heart of the God of Nature, A-Shang’s original body and his current body can merge into one, right? And that’s when you will completely detach from A-Shang?"

The ball of light paused for half a second and replied: "Once the main quest is completed, according to the rules, as long as the host requests it, I must completely detach from the host. As for Shang Feifan wanting to merge his two bodies, he must wait until he returns to Earth with his current body to perform the operation."

"Then can he bring all his abilities back with him?"

"Of course. As long as the laws of heaven and earth on Earth allow him to stay."

When Shang Feifan heard this, he felt a subtle sensation. Perhaps the moment he returned to Earth to merge his two bodies would be the moment he was rejected by Earth.

"Can I send my Earth body here to merge?" Shang Feifan interjected.

The ball of light looked at Lang Mu and said reluctantly: "You can. But it would consume a massive amount of energy to open a space portal on Earth, which would be very troublesome. It’s not as convenient as opening a portal here."

Lang Mu held Shang Feifan’s hand, thought for a moment, and asked: "If A-Shang and I go back to Earth, will we be rejected?"

The ball of light: "According to my judgment, if our Tianhe Star is a low-energy world, then Earth is a micro-energy world. With your strength, especially after completing the mission, you will either be immediately rejected upon returning to Earth or your power will be suppressed."

"What are the dangers of A-Shang merging his bodies on Earth?" Lang Mu asked immediately.

The ball of light was silent.

"Little Guang?" Lang Mu asked with a hint of pleading.

Shang Feifan frowned, but seeing Lang Mu’s expression, he swallowed his annoyance.

The ball of light let out a heavy snort: "I knew you’d be soft-hearted for this guy! Fine, I’ll tell you straight: Shang Feifan cannot merge his bodies on Earth. He can only do it here on Tianhe Star, because Earth might very well kick him out while he’s halfway through the merger. However, me opening a space portal on Earth consumes too much energy, and it requires the consent of Earth’s consciousness or the Heavenly Dao there. Otherwise, it would be an act of invasion, and I’d be in trouble."

Shang Feifan’s thoughts shifted, the frost on his face vanished, and he revealed a business-like smile: "Old Guang, what’s our relationship? Are you still hiding things from me at a time like this? Do you want to follow Lang Mu in the future? Actually, that’s not impossible, as long as A-Mu agrees."

The ball of light said almost instantly: "I can become Lang Mu’s personal light-brain and assist him with many things. I won't enter his spiritual sea; I can just be an external device."

Lang Mu didn't dislike the ball of light; on the contrary, he quite liked it, but he still asked: "Little Guang, your feelings for me might be an extension of the me from another timeline, and I am not the same person as that me. Do you understand?"

The ball of light nodded quickly: "Of course I understand. I worked with that Lang Mu for a long time. I don't want to continue the relationship with that Lang Mu through you; I want to... watch you grow up."

Lang Mu was stunned.

The ball of light looked at Lang Mu with extreme tenderness: "To me, you are like the child of that Lang Mu and me."

Shang Feifan: *Pfft! You say that, but did the other Shang Feifan agree?*

The ball of light didn't care what the other listener thought; it continued in a soft, affectionate tone: "On the Orc Continent, you’re still a child at this age. Your parents are gone, and you have no relatives on Earth. Although you have grandparents, they are old and cannot accompany you as you grow, nor can they protect you. But I am different. I can protect you and stay with you for a very, very long time."

Lang Mu was moved.

The ball of light said sincerely: "If you break up with someone in the future and feel sad, I can accompany you. If he betrays you and messes around, I can help you teach him a lesson."

Shang Feifan’s face turned black.

Lang Mu... smiled: "Okay."

The ball of light jumped up: "You agree?"

Lang Mu nodded: "As long as you don't find it troublesome, I would be very happy to have you as a partner and... an elder to look after me."

The ball of light was overjoyed: "Good, good, good! I will definitely take good care of you and make sure no one bullies you!"

Shang Feifan: "..." *I strongly request a world for two! I don't even want to bring A-Dai along, so why do I have to add a father-in-law figure?*

Seeing the ball of light so happy, Lang Mu also smiled and said: "Then it’s settled. What about A-Shang’s side?"

chunks.chineseText:
光球立刻就变得大方和利索起来：“我可以在这边开空间门。让商从这边回去地星，把他的原身装入雕像广场带回来。不过他回来时需要先传送到其他没有星球意识和天道的星球，我才能从这边开空间门把他带回来。等他回来融合身体后，我会通过任务奖励告诉他如何压制自己的能量，然后再回去地星的方法。”

商非凡幽幽地问：“我是不是得在地星和附近无生命星球布置一对传送阵？”

“对。要么你就能做到跨星球跳跃。”光球严肃脸：“我建议你继续进修空间学，如果你能自己掌握空间力量，说不定都不用我开空间门，你自己就能自由来去地星和天河星。”

“小花花和阿呆能帮忙吗？”郎沐问。

光球摇头：“阿呆现在还太弱，他只能短距离瞬移。新虫母也无法跨越星系的距离，它如果强行撕裂空间，想要从天河星前往地星，只会迷失在空间乱流里。”

郎沐想到了法德尔大陆的法圣们，他们连穿过法德尔大陆和兽人大陆之间的空间壁都很危险，更不要说跨越星系的距离进行两个星球之间的空间穿越。

而小花花的实力也就比法圣高一节而已，它现在顶多也就是个初级法神。

商非凡下定决心，他一定要在融合身体前掌握空间穿梭的能力。

而这对他并不算特别困难，毕竟他已经有炼制空间储物工具的基础，还对传送阵有一定了解，接下来只是要更下苦功夫融会贯通，让自己彻底掌握空间力量就好。

正好他身边还有两个空间系的能力者，他完全可以通过他们来研究摸索。

光球没想到自己今天过来能达成期盼以上的目的——虽然没有狠狠教训某人一通（可以留到他融合身体后再劈），但能得到郎沐的承诺却着实是意外之喜。

为此，祂都没有继续催促商非凡做任务，只再次给了他时限：“不管你怎么安排时间，记住，一定要在半个月内让自然之神恢复！”

商非凡和郎沐都明白了：兽人大陆的地质灾难很可能在半个月后就会全面爆发。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 287: I Look at You Like My Own Child (Part 3)

The ball of light immediately became generous and efficient: "I can open a space portal here. Let Shang return to Earth from here and bring his original body back in the statue plaza. However, when he returns, he needs to be teleported to another planet without a planetary consciousness or Heavenly Dao first, so that I can open a portal from here to bring him back. Once he returns and merges his bodies, I will tell him how to suppress his energy through a mission reward, and then he can return to Earth."

Shang Feifan asked gloomily: "Do I have to set up a pair of teleportation arrays on Earth and a nearby uninhabited planet?"

"Correct. Unless you can achieve inter-planetary jumping." The ball of light had a serious face: "I suggest you continue your studies in spatial science. If you can master spatial power yourself, you might not even need me to open a portal; you could come and go freely between Earth and Tianhe Star."

"Can Little Flower and A-Dai help?" Lang Mu asked.

The ball of light shook its head: "A-Dai is still too weak; he can only teleport short distances. The new Insect Mother also cannot cross the distance of a star system. If it forcibly tears through space to try and travel from Tianhe Star to Earth, it will only get lost in the spatial turbulence."

Lang Mu thought of the Law Saints of the Fadel Continent. It was dangerous enough for them to cross the spatial barrier between the Fadel Continent and the Orc Continent, let alone cross the distance of a star system for inter-planetary travel.

And Little Flower’s strength was only one level higher than a Law Saint; at most, it was currently a primary Law God.

Shang Feifan made up his mind: he must master the ability of spatial travel before merging his bodies.

This wasn't particularly difficult for him. After all, he already had the foundation for crafting spatial storage tools and had a certain understanding of teleportation arrays. The next step was just to put in more hard work to integrate everything and truly master spatial power.

It just so happened that he had two spatial-type ability users by his side; he could study and explore through them.

The ball of light hadn't expected that its visit today would achieve more than it had hoped—although it hadn't given someone a sound thrashing (it could save that for when he merged his bodies), gaining Lang Mu’s promise was truly an unexpected joy.

For this reason, it didn't continue to urge Shang Feifan to do the mission, only giving him a time limit once more: "No matter how you arrange your time, remember, you must restore the God of Nature within half a month!"

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu both understood: the geological disasters on the Orc Continent would likely break out in full force after half a month.
