第288章 虫人大陆

沙赫从巢穴中钻出来的时候，大地正在震颤。

最近的地震越来越频繁，导致它们居住的巢穴墙壁上爬满裂痕，也许哪天就整个崩塌掉。

沙赫是一只年轻的变异虫族，它的体型比同类更小，外骨骼呈现出病态的苍白色，六条肢体中，前两对已经异化成挖掘用的钩爪，后肢则勉强维持着行走的功能。

它很饿很饿。

上一次进食是在……它记不清了，可能是三天前？或者五天？反正现在它的腹部干瘪得几乎贴紧脊背，胃囊里只有消化液在灼烧着内壁。

必须找到食物！否则它必定会在冬眠期死去。

沙赫爬上一块被酸雨腐蚀的巨石，它的复眼扫视着地平线。

曾经，这里是一片森林，但现在，只剩下一眼望不到头的扭曲虫骸树——巨大的虫躯内部早已被吞噬一空，只剩下空洞的躯壳，里面住满了饥饿的螟虫族，它们会吃掉任何胆敢靠近的生物，包括同类。

沙赫知道不能靠近那里。

它转动头颅，用嗅觉触须探测着空气中的信息素。没有血肉的味道，没有植物的清香，只有浓重的虫毒瘴气和它从小闻到大的死亡味道。

这里除了死亡和饥饿，什么都没有。

沙赫的胃发出一声尖锐的嘶鸣，像是催促它赶快进食。

它低下头，用钩爪扒开地面上的碎石。在腐土之下，埋藏着一些紫黑色的结晶体——虫毒太多而自然凝结出来的新型矿物虫毒石，只可惜这种新矿物没有任何一只虫族喜欢和需要，大家更无比痛恨着这种新矿石。

据说它们曾经富饶美丽的虫人大陆就是因为这些虫毒才会变成现在这样——万物不生！

但它太饿了。

沙赫用前肢撬出一块，塞进口器里。

咔嚓。

坚硬的晶体在它的颚齿间碎裂，发出刺耳的摩擦声。

虫毒石的味道极其苦涩，还带着毒性物质特有的强烈酸味，但沙赫早已习惯。它的消化系统可以分解毒素，却无法从中获取足够的养分。

这是这座大陆给予它们变异虫族的惩罚，因为虫毒就是它们弄出来的。

就像在吃排泄物，吃进肚子里，拉出来，再吃进肚子里。

反反复复的折磨。

沙赫机械地咀嚼着，眼睛麻木地看着前方。

就在它准备挖第二块虫毒石时，它的触须突然捕捉到一丝微弱的气息。

潮湿的，略带腥甜的气味。

沙赫的身体瞬间绷紧，六条肢足以最快的速度朝气味源头爬去。

在巢穴西侧的岩缝里，它看到了一小片暗绿色的苔藓——那是地皮苔，一种能在虫毒环境中勉强存活的毒性苔藓。

对虫族来说，这简直是珍馐美味。

感谢昨天下了一场雨！

更感谢今天还没有虫发现这片新生的苔藓。

沙赫扑了上去，口器疯狂啃咬着那些柔软的苔藓。

地皮苔带着虫毒特有的酸涩，可也有着植物特有的清甜口感，对饥肠辘辘的沙赫而言，这已经是无上美味。

沙赫甚至能感觉到胃囊里传来久违的蠕动——它终于吃到了一点真正能被消化的东西。

但很快，苔藓就被啃光了。

沙赫不甘心地用钩爪刮擦着岩缝，试图再找出一些残渣，可除了几滴渗出的毒液外，什么都没有。

它停了下来，触须无力地垂落。

不够，这一点完全不够！

它需要食物，大量的食物，可哪里还有呢？

也许它只能继续啃食满含虫毒的泥土石块，但这些东西吃下肚并不能让它扛过冬眠期，毕竟它不是能消化泥土、矿石、金属的变异虫族，它只是一只最普通的蠼螋，最爱的食物是菌菇。

沙赫找了很久都没有再找到能被称为食物的东西，它不敢再继续寻找下去，它好不容易吃到一点真正的食物，不能把它全部消耗在寻找食物的过程中。

它得保留体力，好避开回巢穴途中有可能遇到的危险。

如果遇到食肉虫族，它必须保证自己还有力气逃跑。

回巢穴的路上，沙赫遇到了另一只虫族——那是一只体型更大的田鳖虫，外壳呈现出深紫色，腹部鼓胀，显然刚进食不久。

真羡慕田鳖虫，它们可以通过吃土壤来获取一定养分。

两只虫子对视了一瞬。

沙赫没有动，对方也没有攻击的意图。

最终，那只田鳖虫缓缓爬开。

沙赫继续前进，六条肢足在干裂的大地上拖出细长的痕迹。巢穴的入口就在不远处，黑漆漆的通道里传来幼虫的嘶鸣——它们也在挨饿。

不对，那不是饥饿的叫声，是惨叫！

有东西攻入了它们的巢穴，它们很可能在捕食蠼螋族幼崽！

沙赫冲进了巢穴！

它知道它这时最正确的做法应该是转头逃跑，但它做不到。

它不能带回食物也就罢了，如果看到族虫遇到危险还能转头就逃，迟早一天它会变成孤家寡虫，一只虫在贫瘠的死亡的荒野中流浪，直到饿死或被其他食肉虫族吃掉。

与其那样，还不如为保护族虫拼命，至少这样死亡也死得其所。

商非凡带着全家来到了虫人大陆。

原本从兽人大陆前往虫人大陆的途径只有虫母和带队的部分高级变异虫知道，但当年那些远征兽人大陆的变异虫族几乎都死在了兽人大陆，还留在虫人大陆的变异虫族已经没有虫知道如何前往兽人大陆。

同样兽人大陆也没有谁知道如何前往虫人大陆。

好在小花花继承了虫母的传承记忆，它也想起了自己是怎么来到兽人大陆的。

上一代虫母孕育小花花的巢穴里就有一条通往兽人大陆的空间通道，那是虫母特意留下，但没有达到法神实力或没有虫母庇护就别想安全通过。

小花花啃完上一代虫母的尸体，通过对空间力量的本能感知找到了那条空间通道，糊里糊涂地就迈了进去，随后就来到兽人大陆。

商非凡给了小花花一百金达盾的零花钱，让它“终于”想起它出现在兽人大陆的第一落脚点。

那竟然是虎国境地内，也是虎国唯一的海岸线，从地图上看，极为接近黑水荒原的沿海领区。

商非凡怀疑虎国当年就是虫母的第一登陆点。

过去的事不多说，找到了小花花来到兽人大陆的第一落脚点，再寻找这里的空间通道就容易得多。

有小花花和阿呆在，加上商非凡对空间力也有一定感知，没花多长时间，他们就找到了空间通道的点。

那空间通道就在海边两块礁石之间，平时都是关闭状态，一般不会被误触。

小花花像是本能知道要如何打开这个空间通道，爪尖一挥，就抓出了一条黑漆漆的空间裂缝。

凛冽的罡风呼啸喷涌，在周围撕扯出蛛网般的空气裂痕。可怕的吸力形成漩涡，海水被撕成雾状吸入，几片漂过的海藻瞬间粉碎。

裂缝深处传来令人毛骨悚然的坍缩声，仿佛连光线都在那扭曲的维度里被绞碎吞噬。偶尔迸发的空间乱流像鞭子般抽过礁石，留下深深的灼痕。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 288: The Continent of Insect-Men (Part 1)

When Shahe crawled out of its burrow, the earth was trembling.

The earthquakes had become increasingly frequent of late, leaving the walls of their dwelling riddled with cracks. Perhaps one day, the entire structure would collapse.

Shahe was a young mutant insect. Its body was smaller than its kin, and its exoskeleton possessed a sickly, pale hue. Of its six limbs, the first two pairs had mutated into hooked claws for digging, while its hind legs barely managed to maintain the function of walking.

It was starving.

The last time it had eaten was... it couldn't quite remember. Three days ago? Five? Regardless, its abdomen was now so sunken it felt pressed against its spine, and only digestive juices remained in its stomach, searing the inner lining.

It had to find food! Otherwise, it would surely perish during the hibernation period.

Shahe climbed onto a boulder corroded by acid rain, its compound eyes scanning the horizon.

Once, this had been a forest, but now, there was nothing left but an endless expanse of twisted "insect-husk trees." The interiors of these massive insectoid remains had long since been hollowed out, leaving only empty shells inhabited by the starving螟 (Ming) insect tribe. They would devour any creature that dared to approach, including their own kind.

Shahe knew better than to go near there.

It turned its head, using its olfactory antennae to probe the air for pheromones. There was no scent of flesh, no fragrance of plants—only the thick, toxic miasma of insect poison and the smell of death it had known since birth.

Here, there was nothing but death and hunger.

Shahe’s stomach emitted a sharp hiss, as if urging it to eat quickly.

It lowered its head, using its hooked claws to rake through the rubble on the ground. Buried beneath the putrid soil were some purplish-black crystals—a new type of mineral called "Insect-Poison Stone," formed naturally from an excess of toxins. Unfortunately, no insect tribe liked or needed this new mineral; in fact, everyone despised it.

It was said that their once-prosperous and beautiful Continent of Insect-Men had become what it was today—a barren wasteland where nothing could grow—precisely because of these toxins.

But it was too hungry.

Shahe pried one out with its forelimbs and shoved it into its mouthparts.

*Crunch.*

The hard crystal shattered between its mandibles, emitting a harsh, grating sound.

The taste of the Insect-Poison Stone was extremely bitter, accompanied by the intense, sharp acidity characteristic of toxic substances, but Shahe had long since grown accustomed to it. Its digestive system could break down the toxins, but it could not extract enough nutrients from them.

This was the punishment the continent had dealt to their mutant kind, for the insect poison was of their own making.

It was like eating excrement: swallowing it, excreting it, and swallowing it again.

A repetitive, agonizing torture.

Shahe chewed mechanically, its eyes staring blankly ahead.

Just as it prepared to dig for a second stone, its antennae suddenly caught a faint scent.

A damp, slightly fishy, sweet smell.

Shahe’s body tensed instantly, its six limbs scrambling toward the source of the scent with maximum speed.

In a rock crevice on the west side of the burrow, it saw a small patch of dark green moss—"Earth-Skin Moss," a toxic moss that could barely survive in the insect-poison environment.

To the insect tribes, this was a delicacy.

Thank goodness for the rain yesterday!

And even more thanks that no other insect had discovered this newborn patch of moss yet.

Shahe pounced, its mouthparts frantically gnawing at the soft moss.

The Earth-Skin Moss carried the sharp, acidic tang typical of insect poison, but it also possessed the distinct, crisp sweetness of a plant. To the starving Shahe, this was supreme nectar.

Shahe could even feel a long-lost peristalsis in its stomach—it had finally eaten something that could actually be digested.

But soon, the moss was gone.

Shahe scraped the crevice with its claws, unwilling to give up, trying to find any remaining scraps, but there was nothing left except for a few drops of seeping venom.

It stopped, its antennae drooping powerlessly.

It wasn't enough. This was nowhere near enough!

It needed food, a large amount of food, but where could it be found?

Perhaps it could only continue to gnaw on the poison-filled mud and stones, but those things wouldn't help it survive the hibernation period. After all, it wasn't a mutant insect capable of digesting soil, minerals, or metal; it was just a common earwig, and its favorite food was fungi.

Shahe searched for a long time but found nothing else that could be called food. It dared not continue searching; it had finally managed to eat a little real food, and it couldn't waste its remaining energy on the hunt.

It had to conserve its strength to avoid potential dangers on the way back to the burrow.

If it encountered a carnivorous insect tribe, it had to ensure it still had the strength to run.

On the way back, Shahe encountered another insect—a larger water bug. Its shell was deep purple, and its abdomen was bloated; it had clearly eaten recently.

How it envied the water bugs; they could obtain some nutrients by eating soil.

The two insects stared at each other for a moment.

Shahe didn't move, and the other showed no intention of attacking.

Eventually, the water bug crawled away slowly.

Shahe continued forward, its six limbs dragging thin trails across the parched earth. The entrance to the burrow was not far off, and from the pitch-black tunnel came the hissing of larvae—they were starving, too.

No, that wasn't the sound of hunger; it was a scream!

Something had invaded their burrow! They were likely preying on the earwig larvae!

Shahe rushed into the burrow!

It knew the most logical course of action would be to turn and flee, but it couldn't.

If it couldn't bring back food, that was one thing, but if it could turn and run while seeing its kin in danger, one day it would become a lone insect, wandering the barren, dead wilderness until it starved to death or was eaten by other carnivorous insects.

Rather than that, it was better to fight to the death to protect its kin. At least then, its death would have meaning.

Shang Feifan had brought his whole family to the Continent of Insect-Men.

Originally, the path from the Beast Continent to the Insect-Men Continent was known only to the Insect Mother and a few high-level mutant insects who led the way. But the mutant insects who had once led the expedition to the Beast Continent had almost all died there, and those remaining on the Insect-Men Continent no longer knew how to return.

Likewise, no one on the Beast Continent knew how to reach the Insect-Men Continent.

Fortunately, Little Flower had inherited the memories of the Insect Mother, and it remembered how it had arrived at the Beast Continent.

In the nest where the previous generation’s Insect Mother had birthed Little Flower, there was a spatial channel leading to the Beast Continent. The Insect Mother had left it behind, but without the strength of a Law God or the protection of an Insect Mother, no one could pass through it safely.

After Little Flower had finished consuming the corpse of the previous Insect Mother, it had found that spatial channel through its instinctive perception of spatial power and had stumbled into it, eventually arriving at the Beast Continent.

Shang Feifan had given Little Flower one hundred Gold Datuns as pocket money, letting it "finally" recall its first landing point on the Beast Continent.

It turned out to be within the borders of the Tiger Kingdom, on the only coastline of the kingdom. Looking at the map, it was extremely close to the coastal territory of the Blackwater Wasteland.

Shang Feifan suspected that the Tiger Kingdom had been the first landing point for the Insect Mother back in the day.

Past events aside, once they found the landing point where Little Flower had arrived, finding the spatial channel there was much easier.

With Little Flower and A-Dai, plus Shang Feifan’s own perception of spatial forces, it didn't take long for them to find the coordinates of the spatial channel.

The channel was located between two reefs by the sea. It was usually closed and wouldn't be accidentally triggered.

Little Flower seemed to know instinctively how to open this spatial channel. With a wave of its claw, it tore open a pitch-black spatial rift.

Bitter, howling winds surged out, tearing spiderweb-like cracks in the air around them. A terrifying suction force formed a vortex; the seawater was torn into mist and sucked in, and passing seaweed was instantly pulverized.

From deep within the rift came a hair-raising sound of collapse, as if even light were being shredded and swallowed in that twisted dimension. Occasionally, spatial turbulence lashed out like a whip against the reefs, leaving deep, scorched scars.

chunks.chineseText:
“你确定这真的是通往虫人大陆的空间通道？”商非凡看得眼皮直跳。

小花花非常肯定：“就是它！啊，我都能感觉到虫母巢穴的气息了。”

商非凡转头就对郎沐说：“如果空间通道都是这个德性，也怪不得法德尔大陆的法圣们想要穿过到兽人大陆都跟赌命似的。”

郎沐也觉得不太妙：“法德尔大陆的法圣们是强行撕开空间壁障，不是打开了一条空间通道。我以为空间通道会更稳定一些。”

小花花飞过来，长脚点点那撕扯出的裂缝，强调：“这就是空间通道！”

商非凡：行吧，你说是就是。

阿呆趴在郎沐胳膊上，探头探脑地朝空间裂缝看，随即摇头：“这不是空间通道，这就是强行撕扯开的空间裂缝。”

小花花扇起翅膀就给了阿呆脑门一下：“我说是通道就是通道，我的传承记忆就是这么跟我说的！你们到底要不要通过，再迟疑，这条通道就要消失了！”

它打开空间通道并维持住是要消耗大量能量的好不好。

商非凡自然懂这个理，不再耽搁，立刻把郎沐和阿呆都收入雕像广场，让小花花抓住自己的肩膀，一起冲入这个所谓的空间通道中。

也许这真的是空间通道，也许是有虫母的空间力量庇护，总之，老商在通过这条空间通道时虽然像是被甩进了超级滚筒洗衣机里，感觉整个人都要被搅成碎片，但被甩出来时，他除了头晕脑胀和衣服破碎，整个人还是完整的。

噗咚！

商非凡被甩到坚硬的岩壁上，被砸得背部生疼，又被岩壁的反弹之力给摔到地上。

足足过了有半分钟，商非凡才单手揉着太阳穴慢慢从地上坐起身。

他浑身都疼，脑袋最疼！

也幸亏他皮粗肉厚，除了摔出一身青紫，再没有其他皮外伤和内伤。

小花花情况要好得多，它还能飞得起来，虽然看起来有点像是醉酒。

“啊，回来了。”

小花花嗅到熟悉的气味，歪歪倒倒地飞了过去。

商非凡休息片刻，运行黑运鸦的修炼功法，总算让翻腾的脑子重新恢复清明。

这是一个像糖葫芦一样的套洞，大大小小的洞穴套在一起。

藏有空间通道点的洞穴很小，通过一条鱼肠一样的弯曲狭窄通道，眼前豁然开朗。

那是一个极为巨大的巢穴。

小花花就在这里飞舞来飞舞去，指着最中间的石台地面说：“我老母就躺在那里，我就是在那里出生哒~”

商非凡打量四周，没发现其他生命体，又问过小花花，觉得这里还算安全，这才把郎沐和阿呆放出来。

一家人参观上一代虫母的秘密育儿巢穴花了一点时间，随后就跟着小花花穿过几个不小的洞穴，来到了外面。

还没到洞口，他们就听到了海浪拍击岩石的巨大声响。

清新的海风从洞口吹进来，让人很是舒服，就是有点寒冷。

一家四口从洞口的小道登到洞顶，发现这里是一座宛如长颈龙的颈子一样延伸出海面的狭长半岛。

半岛怪石嶙峋，隆成狭长高山，全部由岩石构成，不见半点绿色。

站在山顶，比站在洞口还要冷。

商非凡、郎沐和小花花都有办法抵御寒冷，阿呆就不行了，冷得直往郎沐怀里钻，把自己缩成一团。

郎沐干脆掏出一张小毯子裹住阿呆。

“这里就是虫人大陆了吗？”郎沐像是感叹一样自言自语。

商非凡正在观察四周，凭借他的目力，又是站在高处，他可以看出很远，但他目力所及范围内竟然没有看到半点绿色。

“兽人大陆那边现在是春季，这里怎么感觉还跟在冬季差不多？”商非凡疑惑。

“春季？不，这里现在是秋末，正要进入冬季。”小花花下意识回答。

小花花其实也不知道虫人大陆现在是什么季节，它只是凭借传承记忆本能跳出答案。

商非凡了然：“这么说虫人大陆和兽人大陆刚好处在不同的半球？”

“也许吧。”小花花挖掘传承记忆，但它显然学的不是怎么好，回答得很含糊：

“因为神之笼，所有大陆被分割，我老母是硬生生渡海，在海洋中漂流了很久，先是找到一些大型岛屿和群岛，但觉得都不适合虫族发展，就继续不断寻找，后来眼看大家都快支撑不下去，我老母就冒险划破空间壁障，历尽危险才找到这座不亚于兽人大陆的大陆。至于这座大陆到底位于天河星什么方位，它也不知道。”

商非凡也没有仔细研究的意思，现在的重点是尽快找到自然之神雕像遗失的那只眼睛。

根据他看到的那副指示画面来看，那只眼睛被当做图腾一类的东西被一些变异虫族供奉。

变异虫族可以交给小花花压制，眼睛的具体方位则可以通过寻宝罗盘来寻找。

商非凡打开寻宝罗盘，看到上面的箭头旋转几圈后，指向正北面，正好是他们面向的方向。

与此同时，沙赫冲入了巢穴，它以为巢穴以及族虫正在被攻击，结果却是……

“都给我闭嘴！再吵全部都拉去做祭品！”

一道尖锐的虫啸刺穿空气，沙赫在拐角处猛地刹住，触须紧绷。

主巢内，五只食肉虫族正肆无忌惮地横行。

它们的外壳泛着金属般的光泽，螯肢粗大，口器滴着腐蚀性的涎液。

为首的是一只暗红色的巨虫，它用前肢踩着一名蠼螋战士的背甲，硬生生将其压进泥浆里，发出令人牙酸的骨骼摩擦声。

“唤醒虫母需要足够的血肉，你们族群今年的贡献，不够！”

沙赫听到了熟悉的哀求声：“我们已经把族中所有存粮都交给你们了，我们真的已经没有存粮了，现在我们的幼虫几乎无法孵化，剩余的幼虫也都快要饿死。冬季就要来临，如果我们再找不到食物，大家会全都死于冬眠期。”

“那是你们的事情。”冷酷又嚣张的声音在蠼螋巢穴里回荡：“没有足够的贡献，那就交纳祭品。十二只健康的蠼螋虫，必须是成年体，不能是老年虫，不能有肢体残缺。限你们在明天日出前把祭品送到，否则……”

“您、您这是要我们死……”蠼螋首领身体剧烈颤抖。

“那你们就去死！不过是作为祭品去死，这样你们死得还能有些价值。”食肉巨虫口中吐出最冰冷的言辞。

沙赫悄悄爬到拐弯口，复眼死死锁定那几只食肉巨虫。

屁的唤醒仪式！这些食肉虫族已经搞了千年的唤醒仪式和祭祀，为此死掉的虫族（祭品）不知凡几，可虫人大陆的情况只越来越糟糕，虫母更是不见虫影。

这些祭祀、唤醒仪式全都是骗虫的！根本就是这些食肉虫族借机吞并弱小族群，好以弱小虫族为食。

可沙赫敢怒不敢动，它甚至不敢发出丁点声响。

千年下来，这些食肉虫族对弱小虫族的迫害，已经深植虫族之心，让它们看到这些肉食虫族就心生恐惧。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 288: The Continent of Insect-Men (Part 2)

"Are you sure this is really a spatial channel to the Continent of Insect-Men?" Shang Feifan’s eyelids twitched as he watched.

Little Flower was very certain: "It’s it! Ah, I can even feel the aura of the Insect Mother’s nest."

Shang Feifan turned to Lang Mu and said, "If all spatial channels are like this, it’s no wonder the Law Saints of the Fadel Continent treat crossing over to the Beast Continent like gambling with their lives."

Lang Mu also felt it was ominous: "The Law Saints of the Fadel Continent tear open the spatial barrier by force; they don't open a proper channel. I thought a spatial channel would be more stable."

Little Flower flew over, tapping the torn rift with its long legs, emphasizing: "This *is* a spatial channel!"

Shang Feifan: Fine, if you say so.

A-Dai, perched on Lang Mu’s arm, poked its head out to look at the spatial rift, then shook its head: "This isn't a spatial channel. This is a forcibly torn spatial rift."

Little Flower flapped its wings and gave A-Dai a swat on the forehead: "If I say it’s a channel, it’s a channel! My inherited memories told me so! Are you going through or not? If you hesitate any longer, this channel is going to disappear!"

Opening and maintaining a spatial channel consumed a massive amount of energy, you know.

Shang Feifan naturally understood this logic. He didn't delay any further, immediately tucking Lang Mu and A-Dai into the Statue Plaza, letting Little Flower grab his shoulder, and charging into this so-called spatial channel together.

Perhaps it really was a spatial channel, or perhaps they were protected by the Insect Mother’s spatial power. In any case, although Shang Feifan felt like he had been tossed into a giant tumble dryer and felt as if his entire body were being shredded while passing through, he emerged in one piece, save for being dizzy and having his clothes torn to shreds.

*Thump!*

Shang Feifan was flung against a hard rock wall, his back aching from the impact, before the rebound threw him to the ground.

It took a full half-minute before Shang Feifan could rub his temples with one hand and slowly sit up.

His whole body ached, his head most of all!

Fortunately, he was thick-skinned and sturdy; aside from a few bruises, he had no other external or internal injuries.

Little Flower was in much better shape. It could still fly, though it looked a bit like a drunkard.

"Ah, we're back."

Little Flower caught a familiar scent and flew off, wobbling as it went.

Shang Feifan rested for a moment, running the Black Luck Crow’s cultivation technique, which finally allowed his churning brain to regain clarity.

This was a cave system like a string of candied haws, with caves of all sizes nested together.

The cave containing the spatial channel point was very small. After passing through a narrow, winding passage like a fish intestine, the view suddenly opened up.

It was an extremely massive nest.

Little Flower fluttered back and forth here, pointing to the ground of the stone platform in the center: "My old mother lay right there. That’s where I was born~"

Shang Feifan surveyed the surroundings. Finding no other life forms and checking with Little Flower, he deemed it safe enough to release Lang Mu and A-Dai.

The family spent some time touring the secret nursery of the previous Insect Mother, then followed Little Flower through several large caverns to the outside.

Before they even reached the entrance, they heard the thunderous sound of waves crashing against rocks.

Fresh sea breeze blew into the cave, feeling quite comfortable, though a bit cold.

The family of four climbed from the small path at the entrance to the top of the cave, discovering that this was a long, narrow peninsula extending out into the sea, shaped like the neck of a long-necked dragon.

The peninsula was filled with jagged, strange rocks, rising into a narrow, high mountain made entirely of stone, with not a hint of green to be seen.

Standing on the summit was even colder than at the cave entrance.

Shang Feifan, Lang Mu, and Little Flower all had ways to resist the cold, but A-Dai could not. It was so cold it burrowed into Lang Mu’s arms, curling itself into a ball.

Lang Mu simply took out a small blanket and wrapped A-Dai in it.

"Is this the Continent of Insect-Men?" Lang Mu muttered to himself, as if sighing.

Shang Feifan was observing the surroundings. With his eyesight, and standing at a high vantage point, he could see quite far, but within his range of vision, he didn't see a single speck of green.

"It’s spring on the Beast Continent right now; why does it feel like winter here?" Shang Feifan asked, puzzled.

"Spring? No, it’s late autumn here, just about to enter winter," Little Flower answered subconsciously.

Little Flower didn't actually know what season it was on the Continent of Insect-Men; it just blurted out the answer based on the instinct of its inherited memories.

Shang Feifan realized: "So the Continent of Insect-Men and the Beast Continent happen to be in different hemispheres?"

"Maybe." Little Flower dug into its inherited memories, but it clearly hadn't learned them well, as its answer was very vague:

"Because of the 'Cage of God,' all the continents were separated. My old mother crossed the sea by force, drifting in the ocean for a long time. She first found some large islands and archipelagos, but felt they weren't suitable for the development of the insect tribes, so she kept searching. Later, seeing that everyone was about to collapse, my old mother risked tearing the spatial barrier and, after experiencing many dangers, found this continent, which is no smaller than the Beast Continent. As for where exactly this continent is located on the Heavenly River Star, she didn't know either."

Shang Feifan didn't intend to study it in detail. The priority now was to find the missing eye of the Statue of the God of Nature as quickly as possible.

According to the guiding image he had seen, that eye was being worshipped by some mutant insect tribes as a kind of totem.

The mutant insects could be left to Little Flower to suppress, and the specific location of the eye could be found using the Treasure-Seeking Compass.

Shang Feifan opened the Treasure-Seeking Compass and saw the arrow spin a few times before pointing due north—exactly the direction they were facing.

At the same time, Shahe rushed into the burrow, thinking the nest and its kin were under attack, but the reality was...

"Shut your mouths, all of you! If you make any more noise, I’ll have you all dragged off as sacrifices!"

A sharp insectoid screech pierced the air. Shahe slammed on the brakes at the corner, its antennae taut.

In the main nest, five carnivorous insects were rampaging without restraint.

Their shells shimmered with a metallic luster, their chelicerae were thick, and corrosive saliva dripped from their mouthparts.

Leading them was a giant dark red insect. It stepped on the back armor of an earwig warrior with its forelimbs, forcing it into the mud, producing a bone-grinding sound that set one's teeth on edge.

"Awakening the Insect Mother requires enough flesh and blood. Your tribe’s contribution this year is not enough!"

Shahe heard the familiar sound of pleading: "We have already given you all the food reserves in our tribe. We really have no reserves left. Our larvae can barely hatch now, and the remaining ones are all about to starve to death. Winter is coming; if we can't find food again, everyone will die during the hibernation period."

"That is your problem." The cold, arrogant voice echoed through the earwig burrow: "If there is no sufficient contribution, then pay with sacrifices. Twelve healthy earwigs—they must be adults, not elderly, and they cannot have any missing limbs. You have until sunrise tomorrow to deliver the sacrifices, otherwise..."

"You... you are forcing us to die..." The earwig leader’s body trembled violently.

"Then go die! But die as sacrifices; at least that way, your deaths will have some value." The giant carnivorous insect spat out the coldest of words.

Shahe crawled quietly to the corner, its compound eyes locked onto the giant carnivorous insects.

*Awakening ceremony, my foot!* These carnivorous insects had been holding these "awakening ceremonies" and sacrifices for a thousand years. Countless insects had died as sacrifices, yet the situation on the Continent of Insect-Men only grew worse, and the Insect Mother was nowhere to be found.

These sacrifices and awakening ceremonies were all lies! They were just excuses for these carnivorous insects to annex weaker tribes so they could feed on them.

But Shahe dared to be angry but not to act. It didn't even dare to make a sound.

Over the past thousand years, the persecution of weaker tribes by these carnivorous insects had been deeply ingrained in the hearts of the insect tribes, filling them with fear the moment they saw these predators.

chunks.chineseText:
巢穴里，其他成年蠼螋们同样瑟缩着，触须低垂。它们的战士太少，巢穴太弱，就连反抗的念头都被饥饿消磨殆尽。

“十二个健康祭品，明天日出之前。” 巨虫冷冷甩下命令，带着小队成员转身离去。

沙赫的口器颤抖着咬合，颚齿间溢出酸苦的毒液。

它恨极了。

恨到它忍不住想：为什么虫母在远征的时候没有把这些食肉虫族都带走？

还有虫母是放弃它们了吗？

为什么虫母一直不出现？

很多虫都说虫母已经陨落，但祭司说虫族还能繁衍，就证明虫母的力量还在。

可如果虫母还在，为什么它不回来？

为什么要任由虫人大陆变成这样？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 288: The Continent of Insect-Men (Part 3)

Inside the nest, the other adult earwigs were similarly cowering, their antennae drooping low. They had too few warriors, the nest was too weak, and even the thought of resistance had been worn away by hunger.

"Twelve healthy sacrifices, by sunrise tomorrow." The giant insect coldly tossed out the order and turned to leave with its squad.

Shahe’s mouthparts trembled as it bit down, acidic, bitter venom overflowing between its mandibles.

It hated them to the core.

It hated them so much it couldn't help but wonder: Why didn't the Insect Mother take all these carnivorous insects away when she went on her expedition?

And had the Insect Mother abandoned them?

Why had the Insect Mother never appeared?

Many insects said the Insect Mother had fallen, but the priests said that the fact the insect tribes could still reproduce proved that the Insect Mother’s power still existed.

But if the Insect Mother was still there, why didn't she return?

Why did she allow the Continent of Insect-Men to become like this?

chunks.chapterTitle: 第289章 找到雕像右眼 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第289章 找到雕像右眼

商非凡拿出了飞车，可刚飞出去不久，包括小花花在内，贴着车窗往外看的两大两小就全都露出了惊诧的神情。

今天不是一个晴天，天空灰蒙蒙的，甚至泛着一点淡淡的青色。

这颜色其实还有点好看，商非凡和郎沐在初见到这天色时还以为这只是一个阴天特有气象，并没有怎么多想。

但现在配上虫人大陆大地的景象，也许今天的天气就并不仅仅是阴天能解释清楚的。

大地干裂，这也不是很特殊的场景。

可如果飞过的土地，包括一看就是大河河道的水道都也跟着干涸，那就不太正常了？

难道虫人大陆这片地界遇到了罕见的大旱？

随着飞过的土地越来越多，商非凡和郎沐他们不这么想了。

虫人大陆不止是干涸，就连植物都稀少得几乎看不见。

在兽人大陆，因为虫毒缘故，虽然农作物很难种植出来，但不是说植物无法种出，而是种出来的农作物和果物结出的果实无法让兽人们当做食物。

相反，兽人大陆的植物并不少见，只是因为虫毒大多数出现了基因变异。

飞车飞了有两小时，但商非凡他们到现在都没有看到成片的绿植，更别说大规模的草原和森林。

从高处往下俯瞰，整片大陆就像一具被啃食殆尽的巨兽残骸。

曾经的山脉被挖掘成蜂窝状的矿坑，裸-露出的地面不时会有一些晶体光芒闪过。

这样色泽深沉的紫黑色晶体非常多，看得商非凡和郎沐都很迷糊——这里的变异虫族在挖掘什么矿石，为什么把那看起来很值钱的晶体留下？

小花花盯着下方那到处都有的紫黑色晶体，复眼中闪过流光。

“那些是什么？枯死的树木吗？”阿呆眼带迷惑看着下方那一根根枝干扭曲的枯木。

小花花下意识回答：“不，那是虫骸树，是钻地巨蠕虫身体被吃空后留下的外壳。”

这些钻地巨蠕虫喜欢阴暗潮湿营养丰富的土壤，它们通常生活在地下。它们不喜欢阳光直射，更不喜欢干旱，可这些巨蠕虫生前也不知遭受了什么样的痛苦，竟然把大半身体都竖直地冒出地面，这让它们看起来就像一株株形体怪异的大树。

岩石，风化的砂土，狂风，狂风卷起的沙尘暴，条条沟壑分明却没有半点水滴的水脉。

这就像是一个已经死亡的世界。

但这片看似死寂的世界并不是没有生命。

偶尔，会有巨大的飞行虫族从云层中掠过，它们畸变的翅膜上布满血管般的纹路，每一次振翅都会洒落细密的虫粉。

商非凡为了能减少路程中的麻烦，特意给飞车刻上了隐身铭文。

每当看到有飞行类虫族出现时，他就会操纵车辆小心绕过这些飞虫。

直到现在，这些飞行虫族都没有发现天空中多了一辆虫人大陆绝不可能出现的外来飞行物。

商非凡下意识让飞车降低了一些高度，这让他们看到了更多。

他们看到了地面上的虫巢。

之所以确定那是虫巢，是因为他们看到有大量变异虫族在里面进进出出。

但这些虫巢无论哪一个都称不上美丽，无论是造型还是材料选择，和小花花在祭司宫圣山收取的那只虫巢简直就是天壤之别。

这些虫巢大多都是用岩石和泥土搭建而成，也有少数是用虫骸加某种粘液黏合而成。

除了地面上的虫巢，山腹洞穴和地底也有虫巢。

“这些虫族都遗忘了虫族的本能吗？”小花花低喃。

虫族，很多天生都会筑巢，这是刻印在它们基因中的天生能力，而且绝大多数虫族都具有极为出色的审美，在筑巢时更具有连兽人数学家都难以比拟的严谨和严密。

可现在它看到的都是什么乱七八糟的违章建筑物？

上一代虫母到底对这些虫族做了什么改动，以至于让它们丢失了虫族本身这一建筑优点？

小花花第一次感到心里不舒服，它看着这些变异虫族，就像看到穷乡僻壤生活贫瘠不但受到环境伤害还被生得智商低下的可怜远亲。

越往大陆深处走，情况越糟糕，甚至出现了非常明显的强势虫族欺压弱势虫族情况。

就这么一路飞行，商非凡一家已经看到不下四起强大巨虫攻入弱小虫族巢穴，抢走对方累积的食物和部分成员的惨况。

郎沐看得两只拳头都握紧了。

商非凡按住他的手，冷静地说：“它们是变异虫族，按照兽人大陆那边的说法，这些变异虫族都被深植了仇恨兽人的意识，只要看到兽人就会厮杀。我们现在下去，不止不能解决问题，还会遭到围攻。”

郎沐忍耐地说：“我知道。”所以他没有要求商非凡停车，更没有直接从飞车里跳出去。

“小花花，你的家乡可真糟糕。”阿呆趴在窗户上感叹。

“这不关我的事！是上一代虫母干的。”小花花迅速甩锅，连我老母都不说了。

商非凡侧目：好一个不孝子。

郎沐试探地问：“你回来了，能整顿现在的变异虫族吗？”

“整顿？”小花花歪头看郎沐。

郎沐直接说：“就是让它们的变异消失，让它们重新变回虫人族。”

小花花陷入沉默。

过了很久，它才开口说道：“异变不可逆，想要改变，只有毁灭，等待新生。”

这句话几乎不像是小花花说的。

商非凡心中闪过一丝异样。

但小花花刚说完这句话就很大声地抱怨：“上一代虫母做的孽，为什么要让我来扛？它有生我的权力，但我也有不扛它留下债务的权力！”

阿呆特别诚实地回：“你继承了你老母的力量，吃了它的身体。”

小花花噎住，但随后它就理直气壮地说：“我那时候还小，根本什么都不懂，肚子饿吃东西是我的本能。你能因为一个婴儿吃了一点奶就说它必须还吗？”

阿呆认真思考片刻：“还是要还的？”

小花花生气：“你还有没有一点虫道主义精神！总之我现在才四岁，我比你还小得多，你都能在郎沐爸爸怀里待着，凭什么我就要当大人收拾家长留下的烂摊子？我不管，我就不管！”

小花花落到阿呆头顶上，竟然收起翅膀开始打滚。

郎沐看呆。

商非凡：“……”这只虫母的性格绝对和他们家无关。

阿呆被小花花闹得脑袋疼，只能哄它，为此还分享了自己的零花钱。

商非凡看到自家傻儿子被骗财，无奈地在心里叹口气。

转而又想到阿呆就用这么点金属货币就给自己弄来一个超级打手和保镖，好像也不是真傻？

郎沐干咳一声：“之前我就想说了，我感觉到这座大陆布满虫毒，自然之力在这里几乎难以施展。”

商非凡下意识想到了那些紫黑色结晶体：“先把自然之神雕像的眼睛收回来，其他之后再说。”

郎沐也认为事情应该一样样解决。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 289: Finding the Statue's Right Eye (Part 1)

Shang Feifan brought out the flying vehicle, but shortly after taking flight, the two adults and two children—including Little Huahua—who were pressed against the windows looking out, all wore expressions of astonishment.

It was not a sunny day; the sky was a hazy gray, even tinged with a faint, sickly cyan hue.

This color was actually somewhat aesthetically pleasing. When Shang Feifan and Lang Mu first saw it, they assumed it was just a typical meteorological phenomenon of an overcast day and didn't think much of it.

But now, paired with the landscape of the Insectoid Continent, perhaps today's weather couldn't be explained away by a simple cloudy day.

The earth was cracked and dry—not an entirely unusual sight.

But if the land they flew over, including what were clearly riverbeds, were also completely parched, that was hardly normal.

Could this region of the Insectoid Continent be suffering from a rare, severe drought?

As they flew over more and more land, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu stopped thinking that way.

The Insectoid Continent wasn't just parched; vegetation was so sparse it was almost invisible.

In the Beastman Continent, due to the "Insect Toxin," although crops were difficult to cultivate, it didn't mean plants couldn't grow; rather, the crops and fruits produced were simply inedible for beastmen.

Conversely, plants were not rare in the Beastman Continent; they had merely undergone genetic mutations due to the toxin.

The flying vehicle had been traveling for two hours, yet Shang Feifan and the others hadn't seen a single patch of greenery, let alone large-scale grasslands or forests.

Looking down from high above, the entire continent resembled the carcass of a giant beast that had been picked clean.

Former mountain ranges had been excavated into honeycomb-like mines, and the exposed ground occasionally flashed with the glint of crystals.

There were many of these deep, purplish-black crystals, which left both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu bewildered—what kind of ore were the mutated insectoids mining here, and why did they leave behind those crystals that looked so valuable?

Little Huahua stared at the ubiquitous purplish-black crystals below, a shimmer passing through its compound eyes.

"What are those? Dead trees?" A-Dai asked, looking at the twisted, withered trunks below with confusion.

Little Huahua answered subconsciously: "No, those are 'Insect Husk Trees.' They are the outer shells left behind after the bodies of burrowing giant worms are eaten hollow."

These giant burrowing worms preferred dark, damp, and nutrient-rich soil, usually living underground. They disliked direct sunlight and hated drought even more. Yet, it was unknown what kind of agony these giant worms had suffered before death, as they had thrust most of their bodies vertically out of the ground, making them look like trees with bizarre forms.

Rocks, weathered sand, howling winds, sandstorms whipped up by the gales, and watercourses with clearly defined channels but not a single drop of water.

It was like a dead world.

Yet, this seemingly desolate world was not devoid of life.

Occasionally, massive flying insectoids would sweep through the clouds, their deformed wing membranes covered in vein-like patterns, scattering fine insect dust with every beat of their wings.

To minimize trouble during their journey, Shang Feifan had specifically inscribed stealth runes onto the flying vehicle.

Whenever he spotted flying insectoids, he would carefully maneuver the vehicle to bypass them.

Until now, these flying insectoids had not discovered the foreign flying object that should never have appeared in the sky of the Insectoid Continent.

Shang Feifan subconsciously lowered the vehicle's altitude, which allowed them to see more.

They saw insect nests on the ground.

The reason they were certain they were nests was that they saw a large number of mutated insectoids moving in and out.

But none of these nests could be called beautiful. Whether in design or material selection, they were worlds apart from the nest Little Huahua had collected on the Sacred Mountain of the Priest Palace.

Most of these nests were built from rock and mud, with a few constructed from insect husks bonded together with some kind of mucus.

Besides the ground-level nests, there were also nests in mountain caves and underground.

"Have these insectoids forgotten their instincts?" Little Huahua murmured.

Most insectoids were born with the ability to build nests; it was an innate capability etched into their genes. Moreover, the vast majority of insectoids possessed excellent aesthetics, and their nest-building was often more rigorous and precise than even beastman mathematicians could achieve.

But what was this chaotic, illegal construction it was seeing now?

What exactly had the previous Insect Mother done to these insectoids to make them lose such a fundamental insectoid advantage?

For the first time, Little Huahua felt uncomfortable. Looking at these mutated insectoids was like seeing poor, distant relatives living in a barren wasteland, not only harmed by their environment but also born with low intelligence.

The deeper they went into the continent, the worse the situation became. There were even clear instances of strong insectoids bullying the weak.

Just on this flight, the Shang Feifan family had witnessed no fewer than four tragic scenes where powerful giant insects invaded the nests of weaker insectoids, snatching away their accumulated food and some of their members.

Lang Mu’s fists tightened as he watched.

Shang Feifan pressed his hand down and said calmly: "They are mutated insectoids. According to the accounts from the Beastman Continent, these mutated insectoids have had an anti-beastman consciousness deeply implanted in them; they will fight as soon as they see a beastman. If we go down now, not only will we fail to solve the problem, but we will also be besieged."

Lang Mu said with restraint: "I know." That was why he didn't ask Shang Feifan to stop, nor did he jump out of the vehicle.

"Little Huahua, your hometown is truly terrible," A-Dai said, lying on the window and sighing.

"That has nothing to do with me! That was the previous Insect Mother's doing!" Little Huahua quickly shifted the blame, not even calling her "my mother" anymore.

Shang Feifan glanced sideways: What an unfilial child.

Lang Mu asked tentatively: "Now that you're back, can you reorganize these mutated insectoids?"

"Reorganize?" Little Huahua tilted its head at Lang Mu.

Lang Mu said directly: "I mean, make their mutations disappear and turn them back into the Insectoid race."

Little Huahua fell silent.

After a long time, it finally said: "Mutation is irreversible. To change it, one can only destroy and wait for a new birth."

This sentence didn't sound like it came from Little Huahua at all.

A strange feeling flashed through Shang Feifan's heart.

But as soon as Little Huahua finished, it complained loudly: "The previous Insect Mother committed the sins, why should I have to bear them? She had the right to give birth to me, but I also have the right not to shoulder the debts she left behind!"

A-Dai replied with brutal honesty: "You inherited your mother's power and ate her body."

Little Huahua choked, but then it said righteously: "I was small then and didn't understand anything. Eating when hungry is my instinct. Can you say a baby must pay back the milk it drank?"

A-Dai thought seriously for a moment: "Still have to pay it back?"

Little Huahua was angry: "Do you have any insect-humanitarian spirit at all! In any case, I'm only four years old now. I'm much younger than you. You can stay in Lang Mu’s arms, so why should I have to be an adult and clean up the mess left by my parents? I don't care, I just don't care!"

Little Huahua landed on top of A-Dai’s head and actually tucked its wings in to roll around.

Lang Mu watched, stunned.

Shang Feifan: "..." This Insect Mother’s personality definitely had nothing to do with their family.

A-Dai had a headache from Little Huahua’s tantrum and could only coax it, even sharing its pocket money.

Seeing his silly son being swindled, Shang Feifan sighed helplessly in his heart.

Then, he thought that if A-Dai could get a super fighter and bodyguard for just that little bit of metal currency, maybe he wasn't truly stupid?

Lang Mu coughed: "I wanted to say this earlier, but I feel this continent is filled with insect toxin. The power of nature is almost impossible to wield here."

Shang Feifan subconsciously thought of those purplish-black crystals: "Let's retrieve the statue's eye of the God of Nature first, and we'll talk about the rest later."

Lang Mu agreed that things should be solved one by one.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第289章 找到雕像右眼 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
而且虫人大陆这样的情况，根本不是他和老商两个普通人（哪怕老商晋级了法神境界那也在人的范畴）能解决的，如果能让自然之神恢复，当然还是靠神力解决来得更快。

雕像广场中的自然之神不知道是否感知到这两人对祂的殷切期盼，整个广场原本生机勃勃的绿植都灰暗了三分。

一声轻笑声在广场中响起，一丝淡淡的黑烟似乎想要缠绕上自然之神的雕像。

自然之神手臂上缠绕的枝条动了动。

黑烟迅速消失。

正在操纵车辆的商非凡忽然抬头。

刚才他好像感觉到了诅咒之神的神力？

说来，他好像一直都不知道诅咒之神的伤势到底有多严重，只知道祂搞出了一枚神格碎片，就藏在那个破碎的玻璃球中，之后又被诅咒之神用黑暗之火交换，给拿了回去。

另外诅咒之神还吸收了一枚邪神能量凝结而成的邪神之卵。

老光似乎也有意无意避开了这位诅咒之神，极少提到祂。

虽然老光也没有怎么提及其他神灵，但老光显然和诅咒之神认识并且有合作。

比如他先一步觉醒了诅咒之力，和诅咒之神搭上关系，老光虽然不满，却谈不上生气，更别说愤怒。

“阿沐，你还记得我刚到兽人大陆时，大家提起虫毒最常说的是什么吗？”

郎沐一愣，“虫族的诅咒？”

商非凡勾起唇角，意味深长地说：“是啊，诅咒。”

右眼中的寻宝罗盘发出一阵金光，提示商非凡——自然之神雕像的右眼接近了。

阿呆忽然发出一声惊呼。

两个大人和小花花一起跟着往下望。

他们竟然看到了一座满是植物的大山，山中甚至还开满了灿烂的花朵，无数菌菇躲藏在树下和草丛中，各种小型动物不时在山林间穿梭。

这座大山在整个光秃秃的大陆上是如此显眼和突兀。

商非凡和郎沐异口同声：“自然之力！”

两人都感觉到了，哪怕隔着飞车，距离这座翠绿苍山还有着一点距离，可属于自然之神的神力已经清楚让两人感知到。

商非凡不由道：“其他不说，那只右眼至少造出了一块福地。”

也就因为这只右眼的力量，成为了虫族祭司们千年来虔诚祭祀的对象。

苍山的一处峡谷，顺着峡谷走进深处，就能看到一个能容纳飞车直接飞入的巨大洞口。

洞口处还悬挂着一副小小的水帘，穿过水帘，后面就是几乎掏空山腹并贯穿地下的巨大溶洞。

幽暗的溶洞中，石壁上的湿气凝结成珠，沿着古老的刻痕缓缓滑落。

那些刻痕形成了一副巨幅壁画，壁画内容较为抽象，仔细看，很像是无数虫子在叩拜一位体型巨大的神灵。

神灵没有身体和四肢，只有一只巨大的眼睛。

那眼睛凝视众生，似冷漠，又似蕴含无限怜悯。

“快点滚进去！”粗粝的爆喝声打破了溶洞中的寂静。

一群体型高大的变异巨虫推搡和拉扯着一群体型弱小的变异虫族走进溶洞。

正跪在石壁前的祭司转回头，似不满地瞪视洞口骚动。

洞口进来的巨虫并不知道祭司的不满，还在骂骂咧咧，动作粗暴地对待这一批新送过来的祭品。

“都给我老实一点！能让你们做祭品，那是你们整个种族的荣幸！”

“看到这座山的丰美了吗？这里有无穷无尽的食物，怎么吃都吃不完。只要你们心甘情愿地献祭，说不定高贵伟大的祭司们会允许你们的幼虫搬迁来虫母山。”

被押送的祭品虫族们绝大多数都不相信变异巨虫的蛊惑语言，无他，类似的话，他们的祖辈已经听过无数次。

可至今为止，他们这些弱小虫族也没有一个能进入虫母山生活。那些巨虫甚至不允许它们靠近虫母山方圆百里一步。

住的遥远的弱小虫族还好，住的比较近的虫族成天看着这座代表无尽食物的虫母山就在眼前，它们却只能忍饥挨饿，只能啃食难吃难消化的石头和虫毒石，敢靠近就会被活生生打死，尸体还会被拖走献祭，那滋味就甭提了！

沙赫与另外十一名族虫一起来到了虫母山。

他们原本恐惧又麻木，但他们在看到虫母山后，整只虫都充满了震惊和羡慕妒忌。

这里竟然有一座占地如此之大且长满绿植的苍翠之山！

这座山里不止有植物、菌菇，还有野兽和鸟雀！

食物，这么这么多的食物！

可他们只能看着闻着，却吃不到一口。

沙赫不甘心，他妒忌到整颗心都在滴着毒水。

为什么！为什么这里有这么多食物，那些巨虫还要欺压他们，要他们献祭？

因为这座山之所以丰美，就是源自弱小虫族世世代代的献祭——沙赫的心这么告诉它。

沙赫原本可以不用来，毕竟它在族里刚成年。

可它主动要来，在其他成年蠼螋都不愿意主动献身的情况下，它就成了这批祭品中的一个。

沙赫不是伟大，也不是想要用自己来换取谁的性命，它就是觉得活着没意思了。

它不知道自己在入冬前是否还能找到食物，更不知道自己能否挺过冬眠期。

既然都是死，那还不如成为祭品中的一员，至少可以救下一名族虫，还能看看那让它闻名已久的祭祀到底是怎么一回事。

沙赫看到了满是食物的苍翠青山，也看到了隐藏壁画的绝大溶洞，它还看到了一直只存在于变异虫族传说中的祭司。

按理，它应该满足了，就这样赴死也不会再有遗憾。

实际上，沙赫不甘极了，更痛恨极了！

它忽然不想死了，更不想让自己成为祭品。

如果它必须成为祭品，它想质问虫母：都是您的子民，为什么它们就要过那样悲惨的日子。为什么欺压杀害其他弱小虫族的变异巨虫等坏虫族反而能过上更好的生活？

如果弱就是原罪，那它也不是天生就想生的这么弱小！

【如果给你力量，让你变得强大，你会做什么？】

谁？！

沙赫猛地转头四看。

谁在和它说话？

【当你变得强大，你会怎么做？】

那个声音再次出现在它脑海中。

沙赫几乎毫不犹豫地说：“打败变异巨虫！让它们不敢再来欺负弱小虫族！”

【除此之外呢？】

除此之外？沙赫茫然一秒，有点不确定地回答：“抢夺虫母山，让大家都有食物吃？”

沙赫等了又等，那个声音却消失了。

沙赫反而急了，忍不住大声喊道：“你要让我做什么，告诉我！只要给我力量，我愿意做任何事情！”

“哈！看，这里又多了一个疯子！”刺耳的嘲笑声在沙赫耳边响起。

一只巨虫脚重重踹在它腿上，差点把它的腿踹断。

“这都快成献祭中的固定曲目了，每次献祭，五次总有两三次会冒出一个疯子，大喊着它要力量，它要掀翻我们的强权统治，哈哈！”

“哦，掀翻我们算什么，还有疯子说要干掉虫母，成为虫王，统领虫族寻找新的生命大陆呢。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 289: Finding the Statue's Right Eye (Part 2)

Moreover, the situation on the Insectoid Continent was simply not something he and Old Shang could solve as two ordinary people (even if Old Shang had advanced to the realm of a Law God, he was still within the category of a human). If they could restore the God of Nature, relying on divine power would naturally be faster.

In the statue plaza, the God of Nature did not know if He sensed the earnest expectations of these two, but the vibrant greenery throughout the plaza dimmed by three shades.

A light chuckle echoed in the plaza, and a wisp of faint black smoke seemed to want to entwine itself around the statue of the God of Nature.

The vines wrapped around the arm of the God of Nature moved.

The black smoke vanished instantly.

Shang Feifan, who was operating the vehicle, suddenly looked up.

Just now, he felt as if he had sensed the divine power of the God of Curses?

Come to think of it, he had never known how severe the God of Curses' injuries were. He only knew that He had created a divine spark fragment, hidden in that shattered glass ball, which was later exchanged back by the God of Curses using dark fire.

Additionally, the God of Curses had absorbed an Evil God’s egg condensed from the energy of an Evil God.

Old Guang also seemed to avoid this God of Curses intentionally or unintentionally, rarely mentioning Him.

Although Old Guang didn't mention other gods much either, it was clear that Old Guang knew the God of Curses and had cooperated with Him.

For example, he had awakened the power of curses first and established a connection with the God of Curses. Although Old Guang was dissatisfied, it didn't amount to displeasure, let alone anger.

"A-Mu, do you remember what everyone said most often about the 'Insect Toxin' when I first arrived at the Beastman Continent?"

Lang Mu was stunned, "The curse of the insectoids?"

Shang Feifan curled his lips, saying meaningfully: "Yes, a curse."

The treasure-hunting compass in his right eye emitted a burst of golden light, signaling to Shang Feifan that the right eye of the God of Nature’s statue was close.

A-Dai suddenly let out an exclamation.

The two adults and Little Huahua followed its gaze downward.

They actually saw a mountain full of plants. The mountain was even covered in brilliant flowers, countless mushrooms hid under trees and in the grass, and various small animals shuttled through the forest from time to time.

This mountain was so conspicuous and abrupt in the middle of the barren continent.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu said in unison: "The power of nature!"

Both of them felt it. Even through the flying vehicle, and still some distance away from this lush green mountain, the divine power belonging to the God of Nature was already clearly perceptible to them.

Shang Feifan couldn't help but say: "If nothing else, that right eye has at least created a blessed land."

It was precisely because of the power of this right eye that it had become the object of the insectoid priests' devout worship for thousands of years.

In a canyon of the green mountain, following the canyon deep inside, one could see a massive cave entrance large enough for the flying vehicle to fly directly into.

A small water curtain hung at the entrance. Passing through the water curtain, behind it was a massive karst cave that had almost hollowed out the mountain belly and penetrated deep underground.

In the dim cave, moisture on the stone walls condensed into beads, sliding slowly along ancient carvings.

Those carvings formed a massive mural. The content of the mural was relatively abstract, but looking closely, it looked very much like countless insects kowtowing to a giant deity.

The deity had no body or limbs, only a single, massive eye.

That eye stared at all living things, appearing both indifferent and containing infinite pity.

"Hurry up and get in there!" A rough, explosive roar broke the silence in the cave.

A group of large, mutated giant insects pushed and shoved a group of weaker mutated insectoids into the cave.

The priest kneeling in front of the stone wall turned back, glaring at the commotion at the entrance with apparent dissatisfaction.

The giant insects entering the cave didn't know of the priest's dissatisfaction and were still cursing and swearing, treating this new batch of sacrifices with brutality.

"All of you, behave! Being allowed to serve as a sacrifice is the honor of your entire race!"

"Do you see the abundance of this mountain? There is endless food here, more than you could ever eat. As long as you are willing to sacrifice yourselves, perhaps the noble and great priests will allow your larvae to move to Insect Mother Mountain."

The vast majority of the sacrificial insectoids did not believe the seductive words of the mutated giant insects. There was no other reason than that their ancestors had heard similar words countless times.

Yet, to this day, not one of them, the weak insectoids, had been able to live on Insect Mother Mountain. Those giant insects didn't even allow them to come within a hundred miles of the mountain.

The weak insectoids living far away were fine, but those living closer watched this Insect Mother Mountain, which represented endless food, right before their eyes all day long, yet they could only endure hunger, forced to gnaw on unpalatable and indigestible stones and toxin-stones. If they dared to approach, they would be beaten to death, and their corpses would be dragged away for sacrifice—the feeling was indescribable!

Shahe and eleven other clansmen arrived at Insect Mother Mountain.

They were originally fearful and numb, but upon seeing the mountain, they were filled with shock, envy, and jealousy.

There was actually such a large, lush green mountain here!

This mountain not only had plants and mushrooms but also wild beasts and birds!

Food, so much food!

Yet they could only watch and smell it, unable to eat a single bite.

Shahe was unwilling; it was so jealous that its entire heart was dripping with poison.

Why! Why was there so much food here, yet those giant insects still bullied them and demanded they sacrifice themselves?

Because the reason this mountain was abundant was due to the generations of sacrifices from the weak insectoids—Shahe’s heart told it so.

Shahe originally didn't have to come; after all, it had just reached adulthood in its clan.

But it volunteered. When other adult earwigs were unwilling to offer themselves, it became one of the sacrifices in this batch.

Shahe wasn't being great, nor did it want to trade its life for anyone else's; it just felt that living was meaningless.

It didn't know if it could find food before winter, nor did it know if it could survive the hibernation period.

Since it was death either way, it might as well become a sacrifice. At least it could save one clansman and see what this famous sacrifice was all about.

Shahe saw the lush green mountain full of food, the massive cave hiding the mural, and the priests who had only existed in the legends of the mutated insectoids.

By rights, it should have been satisfied and died without regrets.

In reality, Shahe was extremely unwilling and even more hateful!

It suddenly didn't want to die, and it didn't want to become a sacrifice.

If it had to be a sacrifice, it wanted to question the Insect Mother: They were all her subjects, so why did they have to live such miserable lives? Why could the mutated giant insects that bullied and killed other weak insectoids live better lives?

If being weak was an original sin, then it wasn't born wanting to be this weak!

[If I gave you power, if I made you strong, what would you do?]

Who?!

Shahe turned its head sharply to look around.

Who was talking to it?

[When you become strong, what will you do?]

That voice appeared in its mind again.

Shahe said almost without hesitation: "Defeat the mutated giant insects! Make them afraid to bully the weak ever again!"

[Anything else?]

Anything else? Shahe was dazed for a second, then answered somewhat uncertainly: "Seize Insect Mother Mountain, so everyone has food to eat?"

Shahe waited and waited, but the voice disappeared.

Shahe became anxious, unable to help but shout aloud: "What do you want me to do, tell me! As long as you give me power, I am willing to do anything!"

"Ha! Look, another lunatic!" A harsh, mocking laugh rang in Shahe's ears.

A giant insect kicked its leg heavily, nearly breaking it.

"This is almost a fixed program in the sacrifices. Every time we sacrifice, two out of every five times, a lunatic pops up, shouting that it wants power, that it wants to overthrow our authoritarian rule, haha!"

"Oh, overthrowing us is nothing. There are also lunatics who say they want to kill the Insect Mother, become the Insect King, and lead the insectoids to find a new continent of life."

chunks.chapterTitle: 第289章 找到雕像右眼 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
沙赫神情呆滞：原来不止它一个听到那个声音吗？

可那个声音到底希望什么样的答案，又要怎样才能让它赐予力量？

沙赫似乎被打击到了，整只虫被麻木地拖到了石壁前。

巨大的溶洞里，陆陆续续被送入不下三百只成虫。

各种族都有，变异后的虫族身体千奇百怪，看着都具有一定杀伤性。

可它们在整个变异虫族中也只是底层，是弱者。

失去虫母后，这些满是杀性的变异虫族渐渐丢失了杀性，它们被生活折磨得几乎没有一丝精气神，每日都活得浑浑噩噩。

如今这么多虫被迫送来当祭品，明明没有谁捆绑住它们，可它们却没有一个反抗，就那么跪趴在石壁前，等待作为祭品的命运降临——甚至有点早死早超生的迫不及待感。

一名年岁很大的老祭司虫转过头，似乎在清点这批虫祭品的数量。

“三百零三只。”老祭司点点头。只要总数能超过它们要求的三百只数量即可，多了最好，少了绝对不行。

另一名祭司开口：“这是今年最大一次祭祀，希望能熬过冬季。”

“一定可以。我去山里走过，落叶并不多。”第三名祭司说道。

第一名老祭司叹息：“可我的感知告诉我，今年冬天会非常寒冷，且很可能会超过往年很多。山中情况虽然看着不错，但你们还记得有一年因为祭品不够，偏偏春季迟迟不来，导致那年我们几族也饿死了不少虫。”

另外两名祭司一想起那场灾难，都心有戚戚然。

“先祭祀了这批。如果冬天情况不对，再去找祭品也不迟。”

“可那些侦查虫告诉我，外面的虫族越来越少，很多虫族都逃往大陆边沿，甚至强行渡海，去寻找海中岛屿生活。只怕来年我们想要再开祭祀，恐怕连祭品都凑不齐。”

“来年的事情来年再说。虫母一定不会放弃我们，它会赐予我们力量！”说话的祭司用狂热的目光看向石壁中的巨大眼睛。

其他两名祭司也再次对着石壁中的眼睛跪下，神情虔诚：“请虫母一定保佑我们，我们是您最忠诚的子民，我们一定会在这里等候您的归来，直到天地消失！”

商非凡降下飞车高度。

“雕像右眼就在下方？”郎沐低声问。这里自然之力浓郁，他反而没那么好精确感知。

商非凡点头：“直线距离不到三百米，看到下面那个峡谷了吗？就在那里面。”

“我和你一起去。”郎沐不容拒绝地道。

商非凡像是早就料到，蹭蹭他的手指，笑。

随即就把阿呆提过来放到驾驶位，问小崽：“你是想要留在车里等我们，还是去我的空间里等？”

阿呆毫不犹豫地选择：“在车里。”

去爸爸的空间里等待，它就只能被迫睡眠。

为了让他商爸同意，阿呆还强调说：“我会保护好自己，如果遇到危险，我会第一时间瞬移到你们身边。”

“我也留下！”小花花大声说。

它不想去看那些变异虫族，它怕两个爸爸使坏，把它扔给那些虫族，让它小小年纪就负起重大责任。

这次可不是养一个小家，而是要养一整个种族，无数虫！

小花花数了数自己钱包里的金达盾，觉得养不起，果断装死……不是，是留下给阿呆做保镖。

商非凡摇摇头，也没有逼迫小花花去承担虫母的责任——小花花有一点说得很对，上一代虫母搞出的烂摊子凭什么要让下一代背负？

再说，小花花真的还很小，就算有传承记忆和虫母的实力，那也是小虫崽。

商非凡就算再心硬，也无法逼着比阿呆还小的小崽去扛责任。

他自己都不愿意让郎沐去管兽人大陆，凭什么要小花花去管虫人大陆？

车门打开，商非凡握住郎沐的手，跳了下去。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 289: Finding the Statue's Right Eye (Part 3)

Shahe’s expression was dull: So it wasn't the only one who heard that voice?

But what kind of answer did that voice want, and how could it grant power?

Shahe seemed to have been struck, and it was dragged numbly to the stone wall.

In the massive cave, no fewer than three hundred adult insects had been sent in one after another.

There were all kinds of races, and the bodies of the mutated insectoids were strange and varied, all looking like they possessed a certain lethality.

Yet, they were only at the bottom of the entire mutated insectoid population, the weaklings.

After losing the Insect Mother, these mutated insectoids, full of killing intent, gradually lost their aggression. They were tortured by life to the point where they had almost no spirit left, living their days in a daze.

Now that so many insects were forced to be sent as sacrifices, even though no one was binding them, not a single one resisted. They just knelt and lay in front of the stone wall, waiting for the fate of being a sacrifice to descend—some even had a sense of eagerness to die early and be reborn.

An old priest insect turned its head, seemingly counting the number of insect sacrifices in this batch.

"Three hundred and three." The old priest nodded. As long as the total number exceeded the three hundred they required, more was best, but less was absolutely not allowed.

Another priest spoke: "This is the largest sacrifice this year. I hope we can survive the winter."

"We definitely can. I walked through the mountain, and there aren't many fallen leaves." A third priest said.

The first old priest sighed: "But my perception tells me that this winter will be very cold, and it will likely exceed previous years by a lot. Although the situation in the mountain looks good, do you remember the year when, because there weren't enough sacrifices and spring was late, several of our clans starved to death?"

The other two priests felt a sense of dread as they recalled that disaster.

"Sacrifice this batch first. If the situation in winter is not right, it won't be too late to find more sacrifices."

"But those scout insects tell me that there are fewer and fewer insectoids outside. Many are fleeing to the edge of the continent, even forcibly crossing the sea to find islands to live on. I fear that when we want to hold another sacrifice next year, we won't even be able to gather enough sacrifices."

"We'll deal with next year's matters next year. The Insect Mother will definitely not abandon us; she will grant us power!" The priest who spoke looked at the giant eye in the stone wall with fanatical eyes.

The other two priests also knelt again before the eye in the stone wall, their expressions devout: "Please, Insect Mother, protect us. We are your most loyal subjects. We will wait here for your return until the heavens and earth disappear!"

Shang Feifan lowered the altitude of the flying vehicle.

"Is the statue's right eye below?" Lang Mu asked in a low voice. The power of nature was so thick here that he couldn't perceive it as accurately.

Shang Feifan nodded: "The straight-line distance is less than three hundred meters. Do you see that canyon below? It's right in there."

"I'll go with you." Lang Mu said in a tone that brooked no refusal.

Shang Feifan, as if he had expected this, rubbed his fingers and smiled.

He then picked up A-Dai and placed it in the driver's seat, asking the little one: "Do you want to stay in the car and wait for us, or wait in my space?"

A-Dai chose without hesitation: "In the car."

If it went to its father's space to wait, it would be forced to sleep.

To get his Shang-dad to agree, A-Dai emphasized: "I will protect myself well. If I encounter danger, I will teleport to your side immediately."

"I'm staying too!" Little Huahua said loudly.

It didn't want to see those mutated insectoids. It was afraid that its two fathers would be naughty and throw it to those insectoids, making it shoulder a heavy responsibility at such a young age.

This time, it wasn't raising a small family, but an entire race—countless insects!

Little Huahua counted the Jin Da Shields in its wallet and felt it couldn't afford to raise them, so it decisively played dead... no, it stayed to act as A-Dai's bodyguard.

Shang Feifan shook his head and didn't force Little Huahua to take on the responsibility of the Insect Mother—Little Huahua was right about one thing: why should the next generation bear the mess left by the previous Insect Mother?

Besides, Little Huahua was truly still very young. Even with inherited memories and the strength of an Insect Mother, it was still a small insect cub.

Even if Shang Feifan were hard-hearted, he couldn't force a cub younger than A-Dai to shoulder such responsibilities.

He himself didn't want Lang Mu to manage the Beastman Continent, so why should he make Little Huahua manage the Insectoid Continent?

The car door opened, and Shang Feifan held Lang Mu’s hand and jumped out.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第290章 拿到雕像右眼 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第290章 拿到雕像右眼

三名祭司已经开始跪在壁画前念祷文。

偌大的洞穴里除了祭司们发出的嗡嗡声，几乎再也没有其他声音。

巨虫战士们没有跪，它们分散在四周，负责警戒，主要防止那些祭品突然发疯或逃跑。

但这次这批祭品不知道是饿得没有力气的缘故，还是天性比较老实，来时脸色再不忿，此时也都一个个跪趴在地上低垂着头，沉默地等待死亡降临。

包括之前那只发疯大喊的蠼螋。

枉费它们还特意盯着那只发疯的蠼螋。

虫在临死前会想些什么呢？

沙赫想。

结果他发现他明明应该有很多要想的东西，此刻脑中却一片空白，他心中只剩下一个迫切的声音，那就是快点结束吧。

沙赫闭上了眼睛。

最后它还是想了。

它想，它可能命该如此，就像它们弱小虫族天生就打不过那些身体巨大的食肉虫族，只能被对方欺凌乃至吞噬一样。

如果虫母在……

它不知道有虫母在的时候，虫族内部是什么样，它听过一些传说，但那些传说距离它太遥远，也搞不清楚真假。

它们族有一个活得特别久的老蠼螋曾背着其他虫，偷偷跟它说，说它们虫族原本都有两种形态，一种形态是虫身，还有一种形态则可以变成人身。

虫身时，各族都有区别。但人身时，大家看起来区别并不大，为此很多不同种族之间还会通婚。

所以它们生活的大陆才会叫虫人大陆，而不是虫族大陆。

老蠼螋说那时候虫人族施行的是王权制，虫母最高，虫母之下设有不同职权的管理人，所有种族都在虫母和这些管理者设定的规章制度下生活，犯错者会被惩罚，这个犯错也包括欺凌他人，更不允许同族相食。

不同种族训练出来的军队也只属于虫母，只有虫母有调度权。

另外那时候的虫人族还有血脉天赋，不同种族都有不同的异能，并没有身体弱小战斗力就也弱小的明显区分。

为此，那时候虫族内部虽然也有纷争，但总体上还过得去。

不像现在，各种族都是自治，谁拳头大谁就能得到最好的地盘、最好的食物、最好的一切。各族之间没有道理可讲，互相攻打互相吞噬完全是常事。

血脉天赋在虫毒肆掠后也莫名其妙的消失了。

现在生育率更是不断下降。

老蠼螋说如果虫母再不出现，整个变异虫族都会完蛋。

沙赫那时还小，就好奇地询问虫母为什么会把虫人族变成现在这样的变异虫族，又为什么会抛下它们。

老蠼螋只告诉它：因为仇恨，因为虫母认为它们是失败者，认为它们太弱，所以它改造了它们。而改造不成功的，和太弱的，就被它留下了。

沙赫不记得自己当时还问了些什么，它只记得就是在那时开始，它意识到自身的弱小。

最后的最后，沙赫神经质地笑出了声。

它等着全部虫族完蛋。

它心中甚至产生了一种怪异的嘲笑感——我是弱者又怎样，你们这些拿我献祭的家伙也不过同样是被虫母放弃和抛弃的存在，你们拥有的青山很快也会消失，你们迟早也会饿死，说不定死得比我还惨。

沙赫的笑声在寂静的溶洞里非常突兀。

正在念祷文的祭司不快地转过头，幸好它们的祷文已经完整念完。

不悦的祭司一指沙赫：“第一个献祭者。”

两名巨虫战士立刻走进虫群，抓住沙赫把它拖了出来。

沙赫被拖到石壁前还在笑。

“不敬者！挖出它的心脏！”年龄最大的祭司冷哼。

另外两名祭司也脸色冷漠地瞪视沙赫，其中一虫拿出了一柄特制的尖刀。

两名巨虫战士把沙赫死死按在石壁前。

一名祭司的长肢前段握住尖刀，走到沙赫面前。

祭司的长肢本来就足够锋利，但那把尖刀看着更为可怕，刀尖黑红，似不知沾染了多少虫族和生命的鲜血。

“那根本就不是虫母！虫母才不会这样对待我们。”沙赫突然大声喊。

“我等着你们一起死！你们也会完蛋！虫母告诉我，你们都会死！”

祭司来不及喊战士捂住沙赫的嘴，一刀就向沙赫的背心刺去。

刀尖没入沙赫的背心。

持刀的祭司忽然发现握着的尖刀竟然无法再深刺下去。

同一时刻，按压沙赫的巨虫战士和其他两名祭司都看到了一幕奇景——雪白的冰霜冻住了刀尖，并从刀尖开始蔓延，迅速包裹住整个刀身，乃至持刀祭司的长肢。

持刀祭司吓了一跳，连忙松开前肢——没能松开，冰霜蔓延速度极快，在它松开时已经蔓延到它的长肢上。

持刀祭司想用蛮力夺回自己的长肢，可……

“咔嚓！”

持刀祭司吃惊又不可置信地看着自己断掉的一半长肢，过了好一会儿才发出愤怒的吼叫：“这是怎么回事？！”

“血脉天赋？冰系天赋？”年龄最老的祭司脱口轻呼。

虽然全虫族的血脉天赋都在逐渐消失，但偶尔还是会有一些血脉天赋者出现。它们在献祭祭品时，祭品中偶尔也有几个会在临死前觉醒血脉天赋。

但从没有这么强的天赋者出现。

“咔嚓！”

什么声音？

哪里来的碎裂声？

三名祭司一起转头四看。

忽然，它们在转头看向石壁处时，目光凝结了，虫脸上竟然露出了人性化的极度恐惧神情。

洞里的巨虫战士也看向了石壁，随后纷纷瞪大眼睛，倒吸凉气。

它们祭祀的虫母之眼……竟然消失了！

“不——！”老祭司发出了凄厉的惨叫。

另外两名祭司也不可置信地扑向石壁，长肢不停抚摸石壁的缺损处，不住喊：“不可能！虫母之眼不可能消失！”

“你干了什么？！”老祭司竟然去质问被压制的沙赫。

沙赫压根不知道发生了什么事，它抬起头，一眼就看到出现了一个巨大窟窿的石壁。

那只看起来极为可怕的巨大眼睛消失了！

“……哈！哈哈哈！果然，我就说虫母不可能保佑你们！那就不是虫母的眼睛，你们完了！你们的青山也就要完了！你们会跟我们一起死！一起死！”沙赫疯狂大笑。

“不可能！一定是你搞鬼！你是不是还觉醒了盗窃天赋？你给我把虫母之眼还回来！”老祭司嘴巴上这样说，可它心里压根不相信沙赫能在众目睽睽下盗走巨眼，但它找不到其他疑犯，只能追着沙赫逼问。

沙赫大笑不断，被老祭司打也还在笑。它特别高兴！

“打死这个小偷！打死这个亵渎虫母之眼的卑劣者！打死它！”

整个溶洞内的巨虫都骚动起来。

雪白的冰霜飞速蔓延，冻住了老祭司，也冻住了想要对沙赫动手的巨虫战士。

另外趴在石壁上不断摸索寻找巨眼的两名祭司也被冻住。

其他想要冲过来的巨虫战士同样。

包括三名祭司带着的随从，以及趴在石壁前随时准备修复石壁的虫子。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 290: Obtaining the Statue's Right Eye (Part 1)

The three priests had already begun kneeling before the mural, chanting their prayers.

In the vast cavern, aside from the buzzing drone of the priests, there was almost no other sound.

The Giant Insect warriors did not kneel; they were dispersed around the perimeter, standing guard, primarily to prevent the sacrifices from suddenly going mad or attempting to escape.

But this batch of sacrifices, whether due to being too weak from hunger or simply being naturally docile, showed no defiance. Regardless of how indignant their expressions had been upon arrival, they were now all kneeling or prostrate on the ground, heads bowed, silently awaiting the arrival of death.

This included the earwig that had been screaming madly just moments before.

It had been a waste of effort for the guards to keep such a close eye on that frantic earwig.

What do insects think about when they are about to die?

Sha He wondered.

He found that although he should have had many things to think about, his mind was a complete blank. Only one urgent voice remained in his heart: let it be over quickly.

Sha He closed his eyes.

In the end, he did think.

He thought that perhaps this was his fate, just as their weak insect race was naturally unable to defeat the massive carnivorous insect races, destined only to be bullied and devoured by them.

If only the Insect Mother were here...

He didn't know what the insect race was like when the Insect Mother was present. He had heard legends, but those legends were too distant, and he couldn't tell what was true or false.

In their tribe, there was an old earwig who had lived for a very long time. Once, behind the backs of the others, it had secretly told him that their insect race originally possessed two forms: one was the insect form, and the other was a human form.

In their insect form, each race was distinct. But in human form, they didn't look very different, which was why many different races would intermarry.

That was why the continent they lived on was called the Insect-Human Continent, not the Insect Race Continent.

The old earwig said that back then, the insect-human race operated under a monarchy. The Insect Mother was supreme, and beneath her were administrators with different duties. All races lived under the rules and regulations set by the Insect Mother and these administrators. Those who broke the rules were punished—and "breaking the rules" included bullying others; cannibalism among the same race was strictly forbidden.

The armies trained by different races belonged only to the Insect Mother, and only she had the authority to mobilize them.

Furthermore, the insect-human race of that time possessed bloodline talents. Different races had different supernatural abilities, and there was no clear distinction where those with smaller bodies were inherently weaker in combat.

Because of this, although there were disputes within the insect race back then, things were generally manageable.

It was not like today, where every race is self-governed, and whoever has the biggest fist gets the best territory, the best food, and the best of everything. There is no logic to be found between races; attacking and devouring one another is a common occurrence.

Bloodline talents also inexplicably vanished after the insect toxins ravaged the land.

Now, the birth rate is constantly declining.

The old earwig said that if the Insect Mother did not reappear, the entire mutated insect race would be finished.

Sha He was young then and had curiously asked why the Insect Mother would turn the insect-human race into the current mutated insect race, and why she had abandoned them.

The old earwig only told him: Because of hatred. Because the Insect Mother believed they were failures and that they were too weak, so she transformed them. Those whose transformation failed, and those who were too weak, were left behind.

Sha He didn't remember what else he had asked at the time; he only remembered that it was then that he realized his own weakness.

At the very, very end, Sha He laughed hysterically.

He was waiting for the entire insect race to be finished.

A strange sense of mockery even arose in his heart—so what if I am weak? You guys who are using me as a sacrifice are also just existences abandoned and discarded by the Insect Mother. The "Green Mountains" you possess will soon disappear, and you will starve to death sooner or later—perhaps even more miserably than I will.

Sha He's laughter was very abrupt in the silent cavern.

The priest who was chanting prayers turned his head in displeasure. Fortunately, their prayer had already been completed.

The annoyed priest pointed at Sha He: "The first sacrifice."

Two Giant Insect warriors immediately walked into the crowd of insects, grabbed Sha He, and dragged him out.

Sha He was still laughing as he was dragged to the stone wall.

"Blasphemer! Rip out its heart!" the oldest priest snorted coldly.

The other two priests also glared at Sha He with cold expressions, and one of them pulled out a specially crafted sharp blade.

The two Giant Insect warriors pressed Sha He firmly against the stone wall.

One priest gripped the sharp blade with the end of its long limb and walked up to Sha He.

The priest's long limbs were already sharp enough, but that blade looked even more terrifying; the tip was black and red, as if it didn't know how much blood from the insect race and other lives it had stained.

"That is not the Insect Mother at all! The Insect Mother would never treat us like this!" Sha He suddenly shouted loudly.

"I am waiting for you all to die together! You will also be finished! The Insect Mother told me, you will all die!"

Before the priest could shout for the warriors to cover Sha He's mouth, it thrust the blade into Sha He's back.

The tip of the blade sank into Sha He's back.

The priest holding the blade suddenly discovered that it could not push the sharp blade any deeper.

At the same moment, the Giant Insect warriors pressing Sha He and the other two priests witnessed a miraculous sight—snow-white frost froze the tip of the blade, and it began to spread from the tip, rapidly enveloping the entire blade and even the long limb of the priest holding it.

The priest holding the blade was startled and hurriedly tried to release its forelimb—but it couldn't. The frost was spreading at an extremely fast speed, and by the time it tried to let go, it had already reached its long limb.

The priest tried to use brute force to pull its limb back, but...

"Crack!"

The priest stared in shock and disbelief at its severed limb. It took a long while before it let out an angry roar: "What is going on?!"

"Bloodline talent? Ice-type talent?" the oldest priest blurted out.

Although the bloodline talents of the entire insect race were gradually disappearing, occasionally some with bloodline talents would appear. When they were sacrificing victims, occasionally a few would awaken their bloodline talent before death.

But never had such a strong talent appeared.

"Crack!"

What was that sound?

Where did the shattering sound come from?

The three priests turned their heads together to look around.

Suddenly, when they turned their heads toward the stone wall, their gazes froze, and their insect faces actually revealed a human-like expression of extreme terror.

The Giant Insect warriors in the cave also looked at the stone wall, and then they all widened their eyes, gasping for air.

The Eye of the Insect Mother that they worshipped... had actually disappeared!

"No—!" the old priest let out a shrill scream.

The other two priests also lunged at the stone wall in disbelief, their long limbs constantly stroking the gap in the wall, shouting incessantly: "Impossible! The Eye of the Insect Mother cannot disappear!"

"What did you do?!" the old priest actually went to interrogate the restrained Sha He.

Sha He had no idea what had happened. He raised his head and saw at a glance the stone wall where a huge hole had appeared.

That huge eye, which looked extremely terrifying, had vanished!

"...Ha! Hahaha! As expected, I said the Insect Mother could never protect you! That wasn't the Eye of the Insect Mother at all! You are finished! Your Green Mountains are about to be finished too! You will die with us! Die together!" Sha He laughed wildly.

"Impossible! It must be you playing tricks! Did you awaken a theft talent? Give the Eye of the Insect Mother back to me!" The old priest said this, but in its heart, it didn't believe at all that Sha He could have stolen the giant eye under the eyes of everyone. However, it couldn't find any other suspects and could only chase Sha He to force an answer.

Sha He laughed incessantly, and even when beaten by the old priest, he kept laughing. He was especially happy!

"Beat this thief to death! Beat this despicable person who profaned the Eye of the Insect Mother to death! Kill it!"

The Giant Insects throughout the cavern became agitated.

Snow-white frost spread rapidly, freezing the old priest, and also freezing the Giant Insect warriors who wanted to take action against Sha He.

The other two priests who were crawling on the stone wall, constantly feeling around for the giant eye, were also frozen.

The same went for the other Giant Insect warriors who wanted to rush over.

This included the attendants brought by the three priests, and the insects crawling before the stone wall, ready to repair it at any moment.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第290章 拿到雕像右眼 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
它们全都跟雕像一样被冻在原地。

奇怪的是，位于这些虫子中间的沙赫身上却不见半点冰霜。

就连扎入它背心的尖刀也从它背部掉落。

它的背甲裂开了一块，不过问题不大，它的内脏没有受伤。

沙赫动动身体，不敢相信它竟然逃过了献祭的劫难。

是虫母显灵了吗？

沙赫盯着那石壁上的巨大缺口，也感到不可思议。

溶洞内其他等死的三百多祭品虫族也都察觉到异样，纷纷抬起头。

发生了什么事？

为什么那三支巨虫族的祭司和巨虫战士们全都被冻住了？

“是你？”一名田鳖虫用激动的嗓音问沙赫。

沙赫茫然，赶紧摇头：“不是我！我也不知道发生了什么事。”

“我们是不是应该快跑？如果让那三支巨虫族的虫发现祭祀出了事情，连虫母之眼也没有了，它们不但会杀了我们，说不定还会杀光我们的族虫泄愤。”另一只瓢虫害怕地振翅飞起一小段。

“可是我们要怎么逃出去？外面的山洞口有巨虫看守，啊，它们进来了！”

沙赫用力一咬牙，抓起地上那只尖刀，第一个冲向洞口，同时大吼：“想要活，跟我冲！杀了它们！拼了！”

三百虫有一大半心里陡然生出一股戾气和勇气——对，拼了！反正都是死，还不如拼上一把！杀一个够本，杀两个就是赚！

“杀！跟它们拼了！”

守在洞口的巨虫是听到洞内动静不对，才会进来查看，结果这一进来就遭到了三百虫的围杀。

沙赫比较聪明，它临时指挥，让部分体型巨大且比较灵活的虫族暂时堵住洞口，每次只放一两只巨虫进来。

剩下的虫就一起围杀这一两只巨虫。

蚁多咬死象。

更何况巨虫和普通虫族之间的差别并没有达到蚂蚁和大象那样巨大。

本来打算出手的郎沐看着那三百虫和那些巨虫战士战得有来有往，那只临死前还能笑得出来的虫子也有一定的临场指挥作战能力，就没有再插手。

“还回去了？”郎沐转头问刚刚出现的商非凡。

商非凡点头，手里还提着一只半米长的透明虫：“你一定想不到，那只眼睛后面竟然躲着这么一只虫。”

“这是什么虫？”郎沐提防又好奇地看向那只虫。

“不知道。还挺凶，有毒牙，会释放毒液，毒性很强。”商非凡简单说。

郎沐立刻担心，一把抓过商非凡的手臂：“你没事吧？”

商非凡很想立刻躺倒装柔弱，不过场合不对、时间也不对，只能坚强地说：“没事，好歹我也是法神。普通虫的毒液基本对我无效，尤其……黑运鸦的功法是真的很不错，能吸收一切负面能量的功法，自然也能把毒液当做补品。”

郎沐吐气，安心了。

商非凡很可惜就这么放过一个躺进他家阿沐怀里求抱抱求亲亲的好机会，只能用力甩了甩那只昏迷的虫子。

“你打昏的？”郎沐乐。

商非凡又用力甩了甩：“嗯。想偷袭我，被我一巴掌拍昏了。”

两人都没想到这次取雕像右眼的过程会如此简单和顺利。

他们还特别小心地隐身，尽量不惊动这些虫族。

谁想……只能说法神的实力和普通强者之间真的存在巨大沟壑。

商非凡甚至都还没有使用虫母的威压——他原本还打算隐身冒充虫母。

取雕像右眼时，石壁上的那只巨眼不知道是不是感觉到自然之神的召唤，几乎是他的手刚碰到巨眼，巨眼就迫不及待地钻入了雕像广场。

他真的感觉到巨眼的迫不及待，甚至从巨眼那里读出了“啊，组织，你终于来救我”的狂喜和小埋怨。

他手上的透明虫则是额外插曲。

当巨眼回归雕像，雕像就把这只巨虫甩了出来。

商非凡下意识伸手一抄，那透明虫就咬了他一口。

他顺手一巴掌拍死——这只透明虫比他想的要结实一点，竟然没有死，只是昏死过去。

“走吧。”商非凡完全无视那边的混乱战斗场面，提着透明虫，就准备招呼郎沐离开。

郎沐扭头，看看那些冰雕，又看看那些在拼命的三百虫。

“你知道，如果我们走了，这些祭品虫没有几只能逃得出这条峡谷。小花花说是不想管，但我想它恐怕还是会……”

“啧，养小孩就是麻烦！”商非凡摆出后爸脸，报复性地又用力甩了甩那只透明虫。

原本已经有点清醒迹象的透明虫再次被甩的大脑震荡。

一股威压从溶洞石壁处快速向整个溶洞，乃至整座峡谷和占地辽阔的青山蔓延。

正在拼命的三百虫和那些被围杀的巨虫忽然感觉到一股来自生命本身的上位压制！

当感觉到这股威压的瞬间，它们几乎生不出半点抵抗心，不管此时在干什么，都采取了同一个动作——趴伏，臣服。

冰冻住三名祭司和巨虫的冰霜稍微化开一些，露出它们的头脸。

三名祭司的虫眼动了动。

正待在飞车里啃食零食的小花花头上触角一动，“阿呆，要去看热闹吗？”

阿呆：“哎？”

小花花露出略兴奋的神情：“我感觉到了虫母威压。哈！我就知道老商八成吸收了我老母的心脏，他还以为我不知道。走，我们去看看他和郎沐爸爸要干什么。”

阿呆眼珠子转了转，呆呼呼地问：“花花，如果商爸真的吸收了上一代虫母的心脏，你会跟他打起来吗？”

“打什么打？”小花花优雅地舞动花朵一样的翅膀：“之前跟他要零花钱总觉得名不正言不顺，现在不一样啦，老商吸收了我老母的心脏，那他就是我半个老母，以后他必须负责把我养到成年！”

对了，虫母成年是多少岁来着？

就算三百年吧！

反正虫母多少岁成年只有它知道。

小花花一想到它可以领两百九十六年的零花钱，它就高兴得忍不住跳舞。

哦，这么一说，虫族的事当然也归老商管啦，桀桀桀~

小花花没把这话说出来，但它欢乐的肢体动作无一不在说明它是怎么想的。

阿呆忍不住认真思考一个问题：商爸吸收了虫母心脏到底是赚了还是亏了？

小花花刚带着阿呆飞入溶洞，就听到一道威严的……雌虫声音正在教训满洞的虫族。

“你们这些白痴、蠢虫！如果不是我今天回来看看，还不知道你们正在祭祀他神，还养出了一只妄图窃取神力的邪虫！”

“睁大你们瞎掉的眼睛看个清楚！你们献祭族虫生命，催动出的自然之力，有八成都被这只邪虫攫取。”

一只半米长的透明虫被砸到石壁前。

三名祭司在看清这只透明虫的全貌后，惊呼：“法老蚁！”

法老在虫族是很特别的存在，在虫母最古老的统治时期，虫母之下管事的就是法老。

那时候压根就没有祭司，实际上虫族祭司的说法也是这千年靠它们三族硬性传播——硬是给自己抬身价，不敢叫法老，就学兽人那边用了祭司这个头衔。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 290: Obtaining the Statue's Right Eye (Part 2)

They were all frozen in place just like statues.

Strangely, Sha He, who was in the middle of these insects, did not have a trace of frost on him.

Even the sharp blade that had been plunged into his back fell off.

His back armor had cracked a bit, but it wasn't a major issue; his internal organs were uninjured.

Sha He moved his body, unable to believe that he had actually escaped the calamity of the sacrifice.

Had the Insect Mother revealed her divinity?

Sha He stared at the huge gap in the stone wall, also feeling it was incredible.

The other three hundred or so sacrificial insects in the cavern, who had been waiting for death, also noticed the anomaly and raised their heads one after another.

What had happened?

Why were the priests and Giant Insect warriors of those three Giant Insect tribes all frozen?

"Is it you?" a water strider asked Sha He in an excited voice.

Sha He was bewildered and hurriedly shook his head: "It's not me! I don't know what happened either."

"Shouldn't we run? If those three Giant Insect tribes find out that the sacrifice has gone wrong and even the Eye of the Insect Mother is gone, they won't just kill us—they might even slaughter our entire tribes to vent their anger." Another ladybug flew up a short distance, terrified.

"But how are we going to escape? There are Giant Insects guarding the cave entrance outside. Ah, they're coming in!"

Sha He gritted his teeth hard, grabbed the sharp blade from the ground, and was the first to charge toward the cave entrance, shouting: "If you want to live, charge with me! Kill them! Fight to the death!"

A sudden surge of ferocity and courage welled up in the hearts of more than half of the three hundred insects—yes, fight to the death! We're going to die anyway, might as well give it a shot! Killing one is breaking even, killing two is a profit!

"Kill! Fight them to the death!"

The Giant Insects guarding the cave entrance had heard the commotion inside and came in to check, only to be surrounded and attacked by the three hundred insects.

Sha He was quite clever; he directed them on the spot, having some of the larger and more agile insects temporarily block the entrance, letting only one or two Giant Insects in at a time.

The remaining insects would then swarm and kill those one or two.

Many ants can kill an elephant.

Moreover, the difference between the Giant Insects and the ordinary insect races was not as vast as that between ants and elephants.

Lang Mu, who had originally intended to intervene, watched as the three hundred insects and the Giant Insect warriors fought back and forth. Seeing that the insect who could still laugh before death also had a certain ability to command in the heat of battle, he decided not to interfere.

"Did you return it?" Lang Mu turned to ask Shang Feifan, who had just appeared.

Shang Feifan nodded, holding a half-meter-long transparent insect in his hand: "You would never guess that such an insect was hiding behind that eye."

"What kind of insect is this?" Lang Mu looked at the insect with caution and curiosity.

"Don't know. It's quite fierce, has venomous fangs, and can release venom. The toxicity is very strong," Shang Feifan said simply.

Lang Mu immediately became worried and grabbed Shang Feifan's arm: "Are you alright?"

Shang Feifan really wanted to lie down immediately and act weak, but the occasion was wrong, and the timing was wrong, so he could only say firmly: "I'm fine. After all, I am a God of Law. The venom of ordinary insects is basically ineffective against me, especially... the cultivation technique of the Black Luck Crow is truly excellent. A technique that can absorb all negative energy can naturally treat venom as a supplement."

Lang Mu exhaled, feeling relieved.

Shang Feifan felt it was a pity to miss such a good opportunity to lie in his Mu's arms and ask for hugs and kisses, so he could only shake the unconscious insect vigorously.

"You knocked it out?" Lang Mu laughed.

Shang Feifan shook it vigorously again: "Yeah. It tried to ambush me, so I slapped it unconscious."

Neither of them had expected the process of taking the statue's right eye to be so simple and smooth.

They had been extra careful to stay invisible, trying their best not to disturb these insect races.

Who would have thought... one can only say that there is truly a huge chasm between the strength of a God of Law and ordinary powerhouses.

Shang Feifan hadn't even used the pressure of the Insect Mother—he had originally planned to stay invisible and impersonate the Insect Mother.

When he took the statue's right eye, he didn't know if the giant eye on the stone wall felt the call of the God of Nature, but almost as soon as his hand touched it, the giant eye couldn't wait to dive into the statue plaza.

He truly felt the giant eye's impatience, and even read from it a sense of ecstasy and a little grievance: "Ah, organization, you finally came to save me."

The transparent insect in his hand was an extra interlude.

When the giant eye returned to the statue, the statue threw this Giant Insect out.

Shang Feifan instinctively reached out to grab it, and the transparent insect bit him.

He slapped it unconscious with a casual backhand—this transparent insect was tougher than he thought; it didn't die, just passed out.

"Let's go." Shang Feifan completely ignored the chaotic battle scene over there, and holding the transparent insect, prepared to call Lang Mu to leave.

Lang Mu turned his head, looking at the ice sculptures, and then at the three hundred insects fighting for their lives.

"You know, if we leave, not many of these sacrificial insects will be able to escape this canyon. Little Flower said it didn't want to care, but I'm afraid it might still..."

"Tsk, raising kids is such a hassle!" Shang Feifan put on a stepfather face and vengefully shook the transparent insect hard again.

The transparent insect, which had already shown signs of waking up, suffered another brain concussion.

A wave of pressure spread rapidly from the stone wall of the cavern to the entire cave, and even to the entire canyon and the vast Green Mountains.

The three hundred insects fighting for their lives and the Giant Insects being besieged suddenly felt a suppression from a superior being that came from life itself!

The moment they felt this pressure, they could barely muster any desire to resist. No matter what they were doing at the time, they all took the same action—prostrate, surrender.

The frost that had frozen the three priests and the Giant Insects melted slightly, revealing their heads and faces.

The insect eyes of the three priests moved.

Little Flower, who was staying in the flying car munching on snacks, felt its antennae twitch: "A-Dai, do you want to go watch the fun?"

A-Dai: "Eh?"

Little Flower revealed a slightly excited expression: "I felt the Insect Mother's pressure. Ha! I knew Old Shang probably absorbed my old mother's heart; he thought I didn't know. Let's go, let's see what he and Dad Lang Mu are going to do."

A-Dai's eyes rolled, and it asked blankly: "Flower, if Dad Shang really absorbed the previous generation's Insect Mother's heart, will you fight him?"

"Fight? Why would I fight?" Little Flower elegantly flapped its flower-like wings: "I always felt it was unjustified when asking him for pocket money before, but it's different now. Old Shang absorbed my old mother's heart, so he's half my mother. From now on, he must be responsible for raising me until I'm an adult!"

Right, how old is an Insect Mother when she becomes an adult?

Let's say three hundred years!

Anyway, only it knew how old an Insect Mother had to be to reach adulthood.

As soon as Little Flower thought about being able to collect two hundred and ninety-six years of pocket money, it couldn't help but dance with joy.

Oh, and since we're talking about that, the affairs of the insect race should naturally be managed by Old Shang too, hehehe~

Little Flower didn't say this out loud, but its joyful limb movements left no doubt about what it was thinking.

A-Dai couldn't help but seriously consider a question: Did Dad Shang make a profit or a loss by absorbing the Insect Mother's heart?

As soon as Little Flower brought A-Dai flying into the cavern, it heard a majestic... female insect voice lecturing the entire cave of insects.

"You idiots, you stupid insects! If I hadn't come back to take a look today, I wouldn't have known you were sacrificing to another god, and even raised an evil insect that attempted to steal divine power!"

"Open your blind eyes and see clearly! Eighty percent of the natural power you catalyzed by sacrificing the lives of your fellow insects was snatched away by this evil insect."

A half-meter-long transparent insect was thrown in front of the stone wall.

After the three priests saw the full appearance of this transparent insect, they exclaimed: "Pharaoh Ant!"

The Pharaoh was a very special existence in the insect race. During the oldest period of the Insect Mother's rule, the managers beneath the Insect Mother were all Pharaohs.

Back then, there were no priests at all. In fact, the term "priest" for the insect race was something these three tribes had forcefully propagated over the last millennium—they were trying to raise their own status, and not daring to call themselves Pharaohs, they learned from the orcs and used the title of priest.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第290章 拿到雕像右眼 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
法老蚁……在法老存在的远古时期，前几任的法老全都是蚁族，还是特定的一支蚁族，这一族的身体特征就是身体透明。

之后这一族就被尊称为法老蚁。

后来这一族不再担任法老，也没有去掉这个名字。

只是不知从什么时候开始，这一族就变得没落，数量越来越少。

有虫说，这一族得罪了虫母，让虫母不喜，才会让它们生育率低下，让它们逐渐灭族。

总之，自从虫母远征开始，这一族就像是消失了。更不要说这千年，虫人大陆几乎看不到法老蚁的影子。

没想到，这时竟然会看到一只法老蚁，还是体型这么大的法老蚁。

但比起法老蚁，三名祭司和洞内洞外所有感知到虫母威压的虫族都在激动虫母再现的事。

“您、您回来了？您终于回来了！”

老祭司竟然嚎啕大哭。

其他两名祭司也涕泪横流，就像是幼儿终于等到了回归的老母亲。

商非凡懒得跟这些虫子啰嗦，他只想快刀斩乱麻解决这里的杂事，然后迅速带郎沐他们离开。

“你们很有勇气，竟然借用虫母之名搞同族祭祀！把同族的生命当祭品，更给自己冠以祭司的名头，美其名曰祭祀虫母，实际只为了让自己趴在其他虫族身上吸血，你们真的很好！”

谁都能听出“虫母”的强烈讽刺。

三名祭司想要解释，但它们还没有开口，就被虫母威压压得四肢断裂。

有虫听出虫母的语气不对，哪有虫母自称虫母？

不过虫母威压可怕，这些虫哪怕觉得不对劲，也没力气多想。

“你们更错把自然之神雕像的一只眼睛当做虫母之眼。也不想想，虫母什么时候有让自然恢复之力？不，你们不是想不到，你们只是为了满足私欲，故意神眼虫代，不惜养出一只偷窃自然之神神力的邪虫！”

三名祭司颤抖，也不知是恐惧，还是疼痛，它们想要解释说不知道法老蚁的存在，但“虫母”不给它们任何开口的机会，也不想听它们的解释。

“这只邪虫身上还带了邪神的气息，它大概是被邪神蛊惑，留在虫人大陆特意想要祸害更多虫族的邪神后手。”

“不过这只邪虫也聪明，它发现了自然之神雕像的右眼，发现了你们在用生命和血肉祭祀这只眼睛，正好它需要大量血肉和负面能量修炼，这里对它来说简直就是最完美的食堂！”

“可怜你们这些蠢货，牺牲了那么多生命，聚集了那么多怨气，催动出的自然之力却被邪虫吸收大半。”

“那只眼睛也就是没有长腿无法逃脱，又被那只邪虫缠上，还被你们固定在石壁中，否则它恐怕宁愿自毁，也不愿被你们这么糟蹋！”

“你们知道你们为什么要经常修复石壁吗？那就是自然之力的挣扎！那只眼睛想要脱离你们的控制！哦，你们知道，但你们为了生存，困住了那只眼睛。就这样还指望自然之神眷顾你们？更别说变异虫族还浑身虫毒！是祸害自然的最大凶手！”

“你们知道你们催动的自然之力是从哪里来的吗？”

“神灵奉行等价交换原则，你们献祭多少生命，那只眼睛就给予多少自然之力。可这只邪虫暗中吞噬祭品的血肉之力，你们得到的自然之力原本就被虫为的减少许多，又被那邪虫偷窃大半。一进一出，肥的全是这只邪虫！”

“呵，你们在仇恨这只法老蚁？你们配吗？”

“如果这只法老蚁是窃贼，是邪虫。你们则是最恶毒最该死的虫族毒虫！”

咔嚓！

三名祭司的身体全都变成了碎片。

随后咔嚓声不断响起，洞中那些巨虫全都在瞬间身体碎裂死亡。

三百虫看得既高兴又恐惧。

“这是警告！也是惩罚！”

“以后谁再借虫母之名或神灵名义欺诈和欺凌虫族，都是这个下场！”
