Chapter 290: Obtaining the Statue's Right Eye (Part 3)

Pharaoh Ants... in the ancient times when Pharaohs existed, all the first few generations of Pharaohs were from the ant race, specifically a certain branch of the ant race whose physical characteristic was a transparent body.

Later, this branch was honored as the Pharaoh Ants.

Afterward, this branch no longer served as Pharaohs, but they didn't drop the name either.

It was just that from some point on, this branch began to decline, and their numbers became fewer and fewer.

Some insects said that this branch had offended the Insect Mother, causing her to dislike them, which led to their low birth rate and gradual extinction.

In any case, ever since the Insect Mother's expedition began, this branch seemed to have disappeared. Not to mention that in the last millennium, the shadow of a Pharaoh Ant could hardly be seen on the Insect-Human Continent.

Unexpectedly, they would see a Pharaoh Ant at this moment, and such a large one at that.

But compared to the Pharaoh Ant, the three priests and all the insects inside and outside the cave who sensed the Insect Mother's pressure were excited by the reappearance of the Insect Mother.

"You, you have returned? You have finally returned!"

The old priest actually wailed loudly.

The other two priests were also streaming with tears and snot, just like toddlers who had finally waited for their mother to return.

Shang Feifan couldn't be bothered to waste words with these insects; he just wanted to cut the Gordian knot, resolve the miscellaneous matters here, and quickly take Lang Mu and the others away.

"You have a lot of courage, actually using the name of the Insect Mother to conduct sacrifices of your own kind! Treating the lives of your own kind as sacrifices, and even crowning yourselves with the title of priest, calling it 'sacrificing to the Insect Mother,' when in reality, you only do it to lie on the backs of other insect races and suck their blood. You are really something!"

Anyone could hear the intense sarcasm in "Insect Mother."

The three priests wanted to explain, but before they could even open their mouths, they were crushed by the Insect Mother's pressure until their limbs shattered.

Some insects heard that the tone of the "Insect Mother" was wrong—what Insect Mother would refer to herself as "Insect Mother"?

However, the Insect Mother's pressure was terrifying; even if these insects felt something was off, they had no energy to think about it.

"You even mistook one of the eyes of the God of Nature's statue for the Eye of the Insect Mother. You don't even think about it—when did the Insect Mother ever have the power to restore nature? No, it's not that you couldn't think of it; you just did it to satisfy your own selfish desires, deliberately using the divine eye as a substitute, and didn't hesitate to raise an evil insect that steals the divine power of the God of Nature!"

The three priests trembled, not knowing if it was from fear or pain. They wanted to explain that they didn't know about the existence of the Pharaoh Ant, but the "Insect Mother" didn't give them any chance to speak, nor did it want to hear their explanations.

"This evil insect also carries the aura of an evil god. It was likely bewitched by an evil god and left on the Insect-Human Continent specifically to harm more insect races—a remnant of the evil god."

"But this evil insect is also clever. It discovered the right eye of the God of Nature's statue and discovered that you were using life and flesh to sacrifice to this eye. It just so happens that it needs a large amount of flesh and negative energy to cultivate, so this place was simply the most perfect cafeteria for it!"

"Pity you fools, sacrificing so many lives, gathering so much resentment, yet the natural power you catalyzed was mostly snatched away by this evil insect."

"That eye simply didn't have legs to escape, and it was entangled by that evil insect and fixed in the stone wall by you. Otherwise, it would probably rather destroy itself than be trampled on by you like this!"

"Do you know why you have to repair the stone wall frequently? That is the struggle of natural power! That eye wants to break free from your control! Oh, you know, but for the sake of survival, you trapped that eye. And you still expect the God of Nature to favor you? Not to mention that the mutated insect race is covered in insect toxins! You are the biggest culprits harming nature!"

"Do you know where the natural power you catalyze comes from?"

"Gods follow the principle of equivalent exchange. You sacrifice as many lives as you give, and that eye provides as much natural power. But this evil insect secretly devours the fleshly power of the sacrifices; the natural power you obtain was already reduced by man-made means, and then stolen by that evil insect for the most part. In and out, the one getting fat is entirely this evil insect!"

"Heh, you are hating this Pharaoh Ant? Do you deserve to?"

"If this Pharaoh Ant is a thief and an evil insect, then you are the most vicious and damnable poisonous insects of the insect race!"

Crack!

The bodies of the three priests all turned into fragments.

Then, the sound of cracking continued to ring out, and all the Giant Insects in the cave had their bodies shattered and died in an instant.

The three hundred insects watched, both happy and terrified.

"This is a warning! And also a punishment!"

"From now on, whoever uses the name of the Insect Mother or the name of the gods to defraud and bully the insect race will meet this same end!"

第291章 法老蚁

不管是溶洞内，还是溶洞外的虫族都听到了“虫母”威严的声音。

生活在这座大山里的三支巨虫族吓坏了，它们害怕虫母会惩罚它们，把它们赶出这座大山，甚而一怒之下把它们全杀了。

就在这三支巨虫族惶惶不安时，商非凡却知道他刚才做的只是最简单最粗暴的处理，也许可以压制这里的巨虫族一时，但如果“虫母”再度消失，要不了多久，它们还是会故态复萌。

商非凡也看到了拿着隐身道具溜进来看热闹的小花花和阿呆。

这两只那神情是真的在看热闹，阿呆看那些变异虫族还有好奇和同情，可身为新虫母的小花花看这些虫族却跟看路上的砂石尘土没有任何区别。

郎沐感觉到阿呆和小花花溜进来，却没有看到他们。商非凡则是依靠瞳术加法神的实力，普通隐身道具在他眼中就跟没有一样。

商非凡看清小花花的神情，心中再次感到一丝异样，却没有多说。

三百虫自由了，它们却没有马上离去，而是全部跪趴在地上，恳求虫母能带它们和它们的族虫一起离开，口口声声说愿意为虫母效死。

这些虫族以为虫母只是回来挑选战士，它们到现在都还以为虫母在外面征战。

沙赫有很多话想要问虫母，但它不敢，它跟其他虫族一样跪趴在地上，等待虫母给出新的指示。

商非凡却暂时没管这些虫，他把注意力转到了那只透明虫法老蚁身上。

法老蚁醒了过来，这家伙很狡猾，装着身体僵硬，却在偷偷移动透明脚，想要逃跑。

“虫母”的威压笼罩住法老蚁。

法老蚁一下变得僵直，随后瘫软下来。

商非凡原本想要直接打死这只法老蚁，一了百了，但他通过瞳术观察这只法老蚁，却发现一个奇异现象，让他稍稍迟疑了一秒。

就这一秒的间隔，那只法老蚁似乎感觉到了一线生机，立刻抬头大喊：“你不是虫母，你没资格处置我！”

商非凡和郎沐同时挑眉：这只法老蚁似乎有点不简单。

洞内的三百虫微微骚动，神情充满不信、不安和疑惑。

法老蚁持续大声喊：“我不知道你是谁，但我知道你只是为这些祭品打抱不平，想要拯救它们。可我也很冤枉！”

商非凡压根不在乎被戳破身份——别说真的虫母就在这里，就算小花花不在，凭借他的实力和虫母威压，他也可以碾压这里的虫族。

因为他在这只法老蚁身上观察到的一点特殊现象，让他多了一丝耐心，慢悠悠地问：

“你一个躲在自然之神雕像眼睛后面，盗窃自然神力、盗窃祭品生命力和怨力，受到邪神意识污染的窃贼，竟然好意思喊冤？”

法老蚁嘴上喊着神秘者不是虫母，却趴在地上摆出臣服的姿势，委屈地叫：“我不是故意偷窃，这里原本就是我的洞穴。我的族虫曾经就生活在这座大山中，这是我法老蚁的族地。只是我法老蚁的数量越来越少，最后只剩下我……”

“那些巨颚虫、毒火巨蚁、黄尾巨蝎才是强盗和小偷！它们私自占领了这里，还把那只不知道它们从哪里弄来的神眼嵌入石壁，利用虫族秘法封印，并对其进行祭祀，想要榨取里面的自然之力。”

“我就是气不过它们占了我最后的家园，我也不想饿死，反正它们也不干好事，我就是……偷吃了一点而已。”

法老蚁越说越委屈：“你们看，我还给那些祭品虫提示，希望帮助它们逃脱，可那些笨蛋虫子没有一个能接收我的力量。”

郎沐也发现了这只法老蚁的奇异之处，传音给商非凡：“这只沾染了邪神气息的法老蚁似乎神智清晰？”

商非凡勾住他的手指：“这家伙确实有一点不一样，它身上的力量很纯粹，却不怎么会使用。而且……”

“而且什么？”

商非凡捏捏郎沐的手指让他稍等。

“是你！”三百虫中突然有虫发出很大的惊呼声。

法老蚁转头，看到三百虫中的沙赫。

“你精神力不错，比较坚韧，哪怕被带到这里也没有多少恐惧心。”法老蚁竟然认出沙赫，还表扬了它。

“可惜你和以前那些祭品虫一样，无法沟通我的力量。”

沙赫不明白：“沟通你的力量？”

法老蚁见“虫母”不说话，大着胆子说：“我可以把能量传输给其他虫，但必须要能与我的能量沟通。你不行！”

沙赫被那句“你不行”给刺激到，立刻问：“沟通你的能量需要什么条件？”

法老蚁声音忽然变冷：“首先你得是一只法老蚁，如果你不是，那就只能看运气。”

沙赫难受。这种看着力量就在面前，它明明已经窥探到，却无法入门的感觉太难受了。

“那你为什么还要问我那些话？”

法老蚁一梗脖子：“考验。”

商非凡发出一声嗤笑：“行了，狗屁考验！不过是你无聊下故意装神弄鬼找乐子。更别说什么要帮助其他虫，那只是你想要摆脱被困的状态而已。”

法老虫闭嘴，它没想到那神秘者竟然连这点都看出来了。

郎沐没看出来，正要询问。

商非凡就已经告诉他：“这只虫被邪神意识污染，原本应该神智混乱，并只能吸收混乱和负面的能量。这也是它被祭祀仪式给吸引住的缘故。但很巧合的是，这里的虫族祭祀的是自然之神，那只眼睛释放出的是自然之力。然后这只法老蚁的血脉天赋……如果我没看错，应该是净化。”

郎沐：咦？

商非凡笑：“就是你猜想的那样，因为它的血脉天赋，它变得可以吸收自然之力，可又因为邪神意识污染，它同时也渴求着负面能量，最后这两种能量就在它身体中形成了一种奇妙的平衡，同时也保持了它神志清醒。”

郎沐心想这可真是自然界的奇迹：“那它会被困住是指？”

“那些虫族封印了自然之神雕像的眼睛，把它也给封印住了。原本如果它只吸收其中一种力量，这么多年下来，累积的能量也足够让它突破。但因为两种能量在它身体里形成平衡，反而变成哪种能量它都施展不出来。”

“……这可真是足够倒霉的。”

“是啊。”商非凡还说：“成也萧何败也萧何，但这只法老蚁还是得要感谢它的净化天赋，否则被困这么长时间，又有邪神意识污染，它早就疯了。”

法老蚁：“……”

商非凡：“它恐怕一直在寻找能帮助它解困的虫子，比如能接收它身体中两种能量其中一种的虫，但可能不是同族的缘故，对接口不对，它一直没办法只通过精神链接来把自己身体中的能量传输给别的虫。”

“那可真是太可惜了。”郎沐叹息。

商非凡的解释并没有隐蔽声音，在场的虫族都听到了。

沙赫愤怒那只法老蚁耍他，但又隐隐可惜自己不能接收对方的能量。

“净化？”小花花似乎也对这只法老蚁产生好奇，飞过来围着法老蚁瞅了瞅。

Chapter 291: The Pharaoh Ant (Part 1)

Whether inside the karst cave or outside, every member of the insect race heard the majestic voice of the "Insect Mother."

The three giant insect clans living in this great mountain were terrified. They feared that the Insect Mother would punish them, drive them out of the mountain, or, in a fit of rage, slaughter them all.

While these three clans were in a state of panic, Shang Feifan knew that his actions were merely the simplest and crudest form of handling the situation. It might suppress the giant insects here for a moment, but if the "Insect Mother" were to disappear again, it wouldn't be long before they returned to their old ways.

Shang Feifan also spotted Xiao Huahua and A-Dai, who had snuck in to watch the spectacle using stealth items.

The two of them truly looked like they were just watching a show. A-Dai looked at the mutated insects with curiosity and sympathy, but Xiao Huahua, as the new Insect Mother, looked at these insects as if they were nothing more than the dust and gravel on the roadside.

Lang Mu sensed A-Dai and Xiao Huahua sneaking in, though he couldn't see them. Shang Feifan, however, relied on his ocular techniques and the power of a God of Magic; ordinary stealth items were as good as non-existent in his eyes.

Seeing the expression on Xiao Huahua’s face, Shang Feifan felt a strange sensation once again, though he said nothing.

The three hundred insects were now free, yet they did not leave immediately. Instead, they all knelt on the ground, begging the Insect Mother to take them and their kin away, swearing repeatedly that they were willing to die for her.

These insects assumed the Insect Mother had only returned to select warriors; they still believed she had been out waging war.

Sha He had many questions for the Insect Mother, but it dared not speak. Like the other insects, it knelt on the ground, waiting for new instructions.

Shang Feifan, however, ignored the insects for the moment and turned his attention to the transparent creature: the Pharaoh Ant.

The Pharaoh Ant had awakened. The creature was cunning; it feigned stiffness while secretly moving its transparent legs, attempting to escape.

The "Insect Mother's" pressure enveloped the Pharaoh Ant.

The ant instantly went rigid, then collapsed, limp.

Shang Feifan had originally intended to simply kill the Pharaoh Ant to end the matter once and for all. However, as he observed it through his ocular techniques, he discovered a strange phenomenon that made him hesitate for a second.

In that one-second interval, the Pharaoh Ant seemed to sense a glimmer of hope and immediately raised its head, shouting, "You are not the Insect Mother! You have no right to judge me!"

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu both raised their eyebrows: this Pharaoh Ant seemed to be more than it appeared.

The three hundred insects in the cave stirred slightly, their expressions filled with disbelief, unease, and confusion.

The Pharaoh Ant continued to shout, "I don't know who you are, but I know you are only here to stand up for these sacrifices and save them. But I am also wronged!"

Shang Feifan didn't care at all about his identity being exposed—let alone the fact that the real Insect Mother was right there; even if Xiao Huahua weren't present, his own strength and the Insect Mother’s aura were enough to crush the insect races here.

Because of the special phenomenon he had observed in the Pharaoh Ant, he felt a flicker of patience and asked lazily:

"A thief who hides behind the eyes of the Nature God statue, stealing divine power and the life force and resentment of sacrifices, all while being polluted by the consciousness of an Evil God—how do you have the nerve to call yourself wronged?"

Though the Pharaoh Ant had just shouted that the mysterious figure was not the Insect Mother, it remained prostrate on the ground in a submissive posture, crying out aggrievedly, "I didn't steal on purpose! This was originally my cave. My kin once lived in this great mountain; this is the ancestral land of the Pharaoh Ants. It’s just that our numbers dwindled until only I remained..."

"Those Giant Jaw Insects, Poison-Fire Ants, and Yellow-Tail Scorpions are the real robbers and thieves! They occupied this place without permission, embedded that divine eye—I don't know where they got it—into the stone wall, and used secret insect arts to seal it and perform sacrifices, trying to squeeze out the power of nature within."

"I was just furious that they occupied my last home, and I didn't want to starve to death. They weren't doing anything good anyway, so I just... I just stole a little to eat."

The Pharaoh Ant grew more aggrieved as it spoke: "Look, I even gave hints to those sacrificial insects, hoping to help them escape, but not one of those stupid bugs could receive my power."

Lang Mu also noticed the peculiarity of this Pharaoh Ant and sent a telepathic message to Shang Feifan: "This Pharaoh Ant, tainted by the aura of an Evil God, seems to have a clear mind?"

Shang Feifan hooked his finger around Lang Mu's: "This guy is indeed a bit different. Its power is very pure, yet it doesn't know how to use it well. And..."

"And what?"

Shang Feifan squeezed Lang Mu’s finger, signaling him to wait.

"It's you!" one of the three hundred insects suddenly exclaimed loudly.

The Pharaoh Ant turned its head and saw Sha He among the group.

"Your mental strength is quite good, rather resilient. Even after being brought here, you didn't feel much fear." The Pharaoh Ant actually recognized Sha He and even praised it.

"It's a pity that, like the sacrificial insects of the past, you cannot communicate with my power."

Sha He was confused: "Communicate with your power?"

Seeing that the "Insect Mother" remained silent, the Pharaoh Ant grew bold and said, "I can transmit energy to other insects, but they must be able to communicate with my energy. You can't!"

Stung by the words "You can't," Sha He immediately asked, "What are the conditions for communicating with your energy?"

The Pharaoh Ant's voice suddenly turned cold: "First, you must be a Pharaoh Ant. If you aren't, then it’s just a matter of luck."

Sha He felt miserable. The feeling of seeing power right in front of it—having clearly glimpsed it, yet being unable to grasp it—was agonizing.

"Then why did you ask me those things?"

The Pharaoh Ant stiffened its neck: "A test."

Shang Feifan let out a scoff: "Enough with the bullshit test! It was just you being bored, playing god to amuse yourself. And don't even talk about wanting to help other insects; that was just you wanting to escape your trapped state."

The Pharaoh Ant shut its mouth, shocked that the mysterious figure had seen through even that.

Lang Mu hadn't realized it and was about to ask, but Shang Feifan had already explained: "This insect was polluted by the Evil God's consciousness. It should have been mentally deranged, capable only of absorbing chaotic and negative energy. That's why it was attracted to the sacrificial ritual. But coincidentally, the insects here worship the God of Nature, and that eye releases the power of nature. And this Pharaoh Ant's bloodline talent... if I'm not mistaken, it should be 'Purification'."

Lang Mu: "Oh?"

Shang Feifan smiled: "Just as you guessed. Because of its bloodline talent, it became capable of absorbing the power of nature, but because of the Evil God's pollution, it also craved negative energy. In the end, these two energies formed a marvelous balance within its body, which also kept its mind clear."

Lang Mu thought this was truly a miracle of nature: "Then what did it mean by being trapped?"

"Those insects sealed the eye of the Nature God statue, and it was sealed along with it. Originally, if it had only absorbed one type of power, the accumulated energy over all these years would have been enough for it to break through. But because the two energies formed a balance in its body, it ended up unable to manifest either one."

"...That is truly unlucky enough."

"Indeed," Shang Feifan added. "It succeeded because of its talent and failed because of it. But this Pharaoh Ant should still be grateful for its purification talent; otherwise, having been trapped for so long and polluted by the Evil God's consciousness, it would have gone insane long ago."

Pharaoh Ant: "..."

Shang Feifan: "It has likely been searching for an insect that could help it break free—perhaps one that could receive one of the two energies in its body. But perhaps because they weren't of the same race, the 'interface' didn't match, and it could never transmit the energy in its body to other insects through mental links."

"That really is a pity," Lang Mu sighed.

Shang Feifan had not lowered his voice, and all the insects present heard him.

Sha He was angry that the Pharaoh Ant had played him for a fool, but he also felt a faint regret that he couldn't receive the other's power.

"Purification?" Xiao Huahua also seemed curious about this Pharaoh Ant, flying over to circle and inspect it.

chunks.chineseText:
法老蚁听到这陡然出现的稚嫩孩童声，像是感知到什么，身体竟然抖了抖，脸上也出现了人性化的惊恐。

“真没想到法老蚁中竟然会出现一只血脉天赋是净化的。”小花花呢喃。

商非凡好奇：“怎么，法老蚁的血脉天赋就不能是净化吗？”

小花花难得地迟疑了下。

就在这时，那只法老蚁忽然喊道：“虫母？真的虫母？是新孵化出的虫母吗？救救我，陛下！救救我族吧！救救这座大陆和这里所有的虫族吧！”

法老蚁的喊声让溶洞里再次发出偌大骚动。

三百虫特别震惊：真的虫母出现了？还是新诞生的虫母？

商非凡索性带着郎沐现身，还小声对郎沐说：“这只法老蚁活了很长时间。”

阿呆见爸爸们露出身影，想问小花花要不要继续隐藏。

小花花神情有点怪异，随后主动从隐身道具的隐身范围中飞出来。

阿呆跳入郎沐爸爸怀里。

洞内众虫看到突然现身的一个小兽崽和两个成年……兽人？这应该就是兽人的人形吧？

它们没有实际见过兽人，但它们听过传说，看到过不少兽人的壁画。

活的兽人！活的人形！

三百虫眼睛发亮。

被灌输的本能告诉它们：这是敌人。它们应该立刻冲上去撕碎他们、吃掉他们！

可是这两个敌人貌似在刚才救了它们。

沙赫紧紧盯着两个兽人，把两人的身形面貌深深刻入心底：就是这两人救了它、救了它们，他们还彻底打破了三个巨虫族祭祀虫母的谎言。

随后三百虫又看到了露出身形的小花花，这次它们集体陷入呆滞。

多美丽的虫啊！

它们从没有看过这么美丽的虫族！

无论是蝶族、蜓族、还是其他任何以美丽为荣的虫族，都没有这只虫好看得这么不同寻常！

最主要的是，这只花朵一样的虫族身上还泄露出一点点让它们感到极为亲近又敬畏的气息。

它是谁？

法老蚁看到小花花，狂喜，但随即就痛苦地喊：“陛下！我们法老蚁最悲惨最冤枉！就因为我们的天赋能力可以散播病毒，上一代虫母就硬生生改造了我们。我们也是最先被改造的变异虫族，等到我们的身体可以产生虫毒，虫母就把我们腐蚀成为液体浸泡新的虫卵，让新出生的变异虫族全都出生就自带虫毒。”

“我们整整一族就这么被毁了，就连在外面的法老蚁也受到血脉召唤，主动回归、变成虫毒的母液。我们恨，但我们不敢也不能恨，那可是虫母啊，它创造了我们，它诞育了我们，它控制着我们的身心，它让我们做什么我们就得做什么。”

法老蚁哭了，“我承认是邪神给了我力量，我听到了祂的声音，祂给我勇气，让我生出反抗的心，没有主动回归变成虫毒母液。我活下来了，可我也没做什么，并没有对任何虫族不利。我只是……在大家都死后，逃回了家，结果又被那些卑劣的变异虫给困住这么多年……”

郎沐猛地握住了商非凡的手。

商非凡懂他的心。

他们竟然在无意间找到了虫毒的根源。

而这只法老蚁还拥有着和种族天赋完全相反的天赋，净化！

这简直就像是天地给这个世界留下的一线生机。

就是不知道这只法老蚁的净化能力对虫毒是否有效。

不过没效也没关系，游戏商城都已经把虫毒消融药剂量产化了……话说谁在背后制作这些药剂？

商非凡脑中下意识冒出几个身有残疾的神灵——重点自然之神，围着一张木桌在不断手工制作药剂的场景……咳！

“老光，你能听到吗？如果我当初没有发现制作虫毒消融药剂的关键，那这只法老蚁将是祛除虫毒的最重要存在，对么？”

老光没有回答，它这次没有跟来虫人大陆。刚当了天道，刚把邪神驱逐出去，它还有很多事要做，首先就是和天河星意识一起重新修复和定义神之笼。

祂们打算把神之笼的位置换一换，换到天河星的外太空，用来作为防御外来邪神之类力量的第一道防御网和自动契约网。

郎沐忽然说：“小光说是的。消除虫人大陆和兽人大陆两座大陆上的虫毒，让自然之神恢复，以及找到这只法老蚁就是两大关键。之前那条线，他们就是找到了这只法老蚁，才找到办法消除了虫毒。”

商非凡额头青筋蹦出：泥马老光！没时间当老子的系统，没工夫回答我的问题，却有时间和阿沐说话是吧！

郎沐轻笑，把玩老商的手指。

商非凡快要冲到脑门的气一下就泄光。

既然如此，那这只法老蚁也不能随便杀了。

“算你运气。”

商非凡原本对这只法老蚁就没有多少杀心，他发现这只法老蚁的特异之处，不是它拥有净化之力，也不是它身体里两种能量平衡，而是察觉这只法老蚁真的没有染过血腥。

虽然它吸收了祭品的生命力和怨气，相当于从凶手那里获得了好处。但一来它被迫封印，无法逃脱。二来，它想活下去，没有食物的情况下，只能吸收其他能量。

三来，法老蚁吸收的毕竟是祭品被杀死时逸散出来的生命力，最重要的是，它吸收了那些祭品的怨气，让祭品虫们能平静地回归天地能量本源，而不用被困在这里，让灵魂长时间陷在痛苦中。

所以这只法老蚁虽然吸收了大量怨气，反而没有怨气缠身，这就是它最大的特异之处。

商非凡也是类似存在，他吸收负面能量，但身上并没有怨气缠身，就是煞气足了点。

“你想要自然之力，还是怨力？”商非凡问法老蚁。

法老蚁一愣，随即毫不犹豫地喊：“我选自然之力！”

它本身的血脉天赋是净化，傻了它才选怨力。之前它是被困没办法，又因为受到邪神意识污染，下意识（被迫主动）吸收负面能量。

“你能帮我把怨力导出去？”法老蚁眼里满是期待，又小心翼翼地问：“那邪神意识的污染，你有办法吗？”

这位既然能看出来，语气还这么轻松，应该有办法吧？

商非凡用实际行动代替了回答，他的手虚虚按住法老蚁的头部，不到两分钟就收回了手……还打了个饱嗝。

这只法老蚁吸收这么多年的负面能量全都是纯能量——对方的净化天赋已经尽力净化了这些负面能量，不过对方净化力有限，只净化了有意识的怨气，反倒把负面能量全都留下。

商非凡自感自己的境界一下就往前推进了三分之一。

他现在可是法神，得多少能量才能一次性推动他三分之一境界？

“它的净化之力很可能对虫毒这类污染更有效。我怀疑这座大山还能保有绿色，没有被虫毒祸害完蛋，除了神眼散发出的自然之力，和这只法老蚁本身的净化能力也有关。”商非凡对郎沐小声说。

法老蚁趴在地上，它感到了从没有过的轻松。

那庞大的浓郁的负面能量从它身体中消失了。

Chapter 291: The Pharaoh Ant (Part 2)

Hearing the sudden, childish voice, the Pharaoh Ant seemed to sense something. Its body trembled, and a look of human-like terror appeared on its face.

"I really didn't expect that a Pharaoh Ant could have 'Purification' as a bloodline talent," Xiao Huahua murmured.

Shang Feifan was curious: "What, can't a Pharaoh Ant have Purification as a bloodline talent?"

Xiao Huahua hesitated for a rare moment.

Just then, the Pharaoh Ant suddenly shouted, "Insect Mother? The real Insect Mother? Is it a newly hatched Insect Mother? Save me, Your Majesty! Save my race! Save this continent and all the insect races here!"

The Pharaoh Ant's cry caused another massive commotion in the cave.

The three hundred insects were particularly shocked: Had the real Insect Mother appeared? And a newly born one at that?

Shang Feifan simply revealed himself with Lang Mu, whispering to him, "This Pharaoh Ant has lived for a very long time."

Seeing their fathers reveal themselves, A-Dai wanted to ask if Xiao Huahua should continue hiding.

Xiao Huahua’s expression was a bit strange, and then it voluntarily flew out from the concealment range of the stealth item.

A-Dai jumped into Lang Mu’s arms.

The insects in the cave saw a small beast cub and two adult... orcs? This must be the humanoid form of the orcs, right?

They had never seen an orc in person, but they had heard the legends and seen many murals of them.

Living orcs! Living humanoids!

The eyes of the three hundred insects lit up.

Their instilled instincts told them: These are enemies. They should immediately rush up, tear them apart, and eat them!

But these two enemies seemed to have just saved them.

Sha He stared intently at the two orcs, engraving their figures and faces deep into its heart: these were the two who saved it, saved them all, and completely shattered the lies of the three giant insect clans regarding the Insect Mother.

Then, the three hundred insects saw Xiao Huahua reveal itself, and this time, they collectively fell into a stupor.

What a beautiful insect!

They had never seen such a beautiful member of the insect race!

Whether it was the Butterfly race, the Dragonfly race, or any other insect race that prided itself on beauty, none were as extraordinarily beautiful as this one!

Most importantly, this flower-like insect exuded a faint aura that made them feel both extremely close to it and filled with awe.

Who was it?

When the Pharaoh Ant saw Xiao Huahua, it was ecstatic, but then it cried out in pain: "Your Majesty! We Pharaoh Ants are the most tragic and wronged! Just because our innate ability could spread viruses, the previous generation's Insect Mother forcibly modified us. We were the first mutated insects to be modified. Once our bodies could produce insect venom, the Insect Mother dissolved us into liquid to soak new eggs, ensuring all newly born mutated insects were born with innate venom."

"Our entire race was destroyed just like that. Even the Pharaoh Ants outside were summoned by our bloodline, returning voluntarily to become the mother liquid of the venom. We hated it, but we dared not—and could not—hate her. That was the Insect Mother! She created us, she birthed us, she controlled our bodies and minds. She made us do whatever she wanted."

The Pharaoh Ant wept. "I admit that the Evil God gave me power. I heard His voice; He gave me the courage to develop a rebellious heart, so I didn't return to become the venom mother liquid. I survived, but I didn't do anything; I didn't harm any insect race. I just... after everyone else died, I fled back home, only to be trapped by those despicable mutated insects for so many years..."

Lang Mu gripped Shang Feifan’s hand tightly.

Shang Feifan understood his heart.

They had inadvertently found the root of the insect venom.

And this Pharaoh Ant possessed a talent completely opposite to its racial trait: Purification!

It was as if the heavens had left a glimmer of hope for this world.

It was just unclear whether this Pharaoh Ant's purification ability would be effective against the insect venom.

But it didn't matter if it wasn't; the game store had already mass-produced the insect venom dissolving agent... Speaking of which, who was behind the production of those potions?

In Shang Feifan's mind, the scene of several disabled gods—specifically the God of Nature—crowding around a wooden table and constantly hand-crafting potions surfaced... *Cough!*

"Old Guang, can you hear me? If I hadn't discovered the key to making the insect venom dissolving agent, would this Pharaoh Ant be the most important existence for eradicating the venom, right?"

Old Guang did not answer. It hadn't followed them to the Insect Continent this time. Having just become the Heavenly Dao and having just expelled the Evil God, it had many things to do. First and foremost was working with the consciousness of the Tianhe Star to repair and redefine the God's Cage.

They planned to relocate the God's Cage to the outer space of the Tianhe Star, using it as the first line of defense and an automatic contract network against external forces like Evil Gods.

Lang Mu suddenly said, "Xiao Guang says yes. Eliminating the insect venom on the Insect Continent and the Orc Continent, restoring the God of Nature, and finding this Pharaoh Ant were the two keys. In that previous timeline, they found this Pharaoh Ant, and that was how they found a way to eliminate the insect venom."

Veins popped on Shang Feifan's forehead: *Damn it, Old Guang! No time to be my system, no time to answer my questions, but plenty of time to talk to A-Mu, huh!*

Lang Mu chuckled, playing with Shang Feifan's fingers.

The anger that was about to rush to Shang Feifan's head instantly dissipated.

Since that was the case, this Pharaoh Ant couldn't just be killed.

"Consider yourself lucky."

Shang Feifan hadn't had much desire to kill this Pharaoh Ant to begin with. He discovered that the peculiarity of this Pharaoh Ant wasn't just its purification power or the balance of two energies in its body, but the realization that this Pharaoh Ant truly hadn't been stained with blood.

Although it had absorbed the life force and resentment of the sacrifices, which was equivalent to gaining benefits from the murderers, firstly, it had been forced into a seal and couldn't escape. Secondly, it wanted to survive, and without food, it had no choice but to absorb other energies.

Thirdly, the Pharaoh Ant had, after all, absorbed the life force that dissipated when the sacrifices were killed. Most importantly, it had absorbed the resentment of those sacrifices, allowing the sacrificial insects to return to the origin of heaven and earth energy peacefully, rather than being trapped here with their souls stuck in long-term suffering.

So, although this Pharaoh Ant had absorbed a large amount of resentment, it was not haunted by it; this was its greatest peculiarity.

Shang Feifan was a similar existence; he absorbed negative energy, but he wasn't haunted by resentment, just a bit heavy on the baleful aura.

"Do you want the power of nature, or the power of resentment?" Shang Feifan asked the Pharaoh Ant.

The Pharaoh Ant was stunned, then shouted without hesitation: "I choose the power of nature!"

Its own bloodline talent was purification; it would have to be a fool to choose resentment. Before, it had been trapped and had no choice, and because it was polluted by the Evil God's consciousness, it had subconsciously (and forcibly) absorbed negative energy.

"Can you help me drain the power of resentment?" The Pharaoh Ant’s eyes were full of anticipation, and it asked cautiously, "And the pollution of the Evil God's consciousness—do you have a way to deal with that?"

Since this person could see through it and spoke so easily, there must be a way, right?

Shang Feifan answered with action. He pressed his hand vaguely over the Pharaoh Ant's head, and in less than two minutes, he withdrew his hand... and even let out a burp.

The negative energy this Pharaoh Ant had absorbed for so many years was all pure energy—the other party's purification talent had tried its best to purify this negative energy, but its power was limited, only purifying the conscious resentment and leaving all the negative energy behind.

Shang Feifan felt his own cultivation realm advance by a third in an instant.

He was a God of Magic now; how much energy would it take to push his realm forward by a third all at once?

"Its purification power is likely more effective against pollution like insect venom. I suspect that the reason this mountain can still retain its greenery and hasn't been completely ruined by the insect venom, aside from the power of nature emitted by the divine eye, also has to do with this Pharaoh Ant's own purification ability," Shang Feifan whispered to Lang Mu.

The Pharaoh Ant lay on the ground, feeling a lightness it had never known before.

That massive, dense negative energy had vanished from its body.

chunks.chineseText:
它并没有觉得半点可惜，因为它清楚就是这些负面能量压制了它本身的天赋，才会让它有力也使不出来。

现在它体内全都是自然之力，还有它的净化天赋也更加流畅。

最让它惊喜的是，原本支撑它反抗虫母的力量，邪神的意识，竟然彻底消失。

它脑中再也没有不时冒出的蛊惑声。

法老蚁这次是真哭了，它自由了！

小花花安静了好一会儿，这对于它活泼的性子有点不正常。

阿呆轻轻碰了碰小花花的翅膀。

小花花身体一抖，就像是被蜜蜂轻触的花瓣。

“等我！”小花花忽然对阿呆说。

阿呆：“嗯？”

小花花忽然振翅飞起，转头就飞出了溶洞。

郎沐当即忧心地看向洞口方向：小花花这是想要干什么？怎么有种决绝感？

商非凡猜测：“小花花大概是想履行新虫母的职责？”

郎沐下意识问：“会对它有伤害吗？”

商非凡想到自己之前察觉的几次异样，以及刚才感知到的气息，摇头：“不用担心。也许只是某位想要最后给一个交代。”

郎沐听懂了，他和商非凡都怀疑过上一代虫母的部分意识很可能潜藏在小花花的精神海内，不一定是想要夺舍，更像是对新虫母的守护。

商非凡之前还猜测上一代虫母会不会在他们对付邪神时冒出来，怕对方帮倒忙，还特意把小花花支使开，没让它也跟进地心。

上一代虫母没能手刃最大仇敌确实很怅然。

跟着商非凡和郎沐，它当然知道邪神已经被商非凡顺利驱逐，还被商“骗”了三分之二的能量。

可它连仇敌的面都没能碰到，对方又已经逃出天河星，它还能怎么办？

原本它已经决定彻底沉睡，可没想到小花花又被两人带着来到了虫人大陆。

看到虫人大陆现在的凄惨景象，虫母后悔吗？

它早就后悔过了，心也早就疼得麻木。

在它带着大军离开虫人大陆时，虫人大陆的情况就已经不太好——孽都是它做出来的，虫毒也是它搞出来的，是它祸害了这座丰饶美丽的土地，也是它坑害了它整个种族。

小花花看到法老蚁、听到法老蚁哭诉的那一刻，它被再次惊醒。

它确实还保留了最后一点力量，用来复仇。

现在不需要复仇，那就用在另外该用的地方吧。

它也不需要再沉睡下去，它早就该彻底消失……有那两个人守护它的孩子，它也能放心地放手。

阿呆突然跳出郎沐怀抱，追了出去。

商非凡和郎沐提起那只法老蚁也跟了出去。

三百虫互看，下意识一起往洞外跑。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 291: The Pharaoh Ant (Part 3)

It didn't feel the slightest bit of regret, for it knew clearly that it was those negative energies that had suppressed its own talent, making it unable to use its power even though it possessed it.

Now, its body was filled with the power of nature, and its purification talent flowed more smoothly than ever.

What surprised it most was that the Evil God's consciousness—the power that had supported its resistance against the Insect Mother—had completely vanished.

The seductive voices that would pop into its mind from time to time were gone.

The Pharaoh Ant wept for real this time; it was free!

Xiao Huahua had been quiet for quite a while, which was unusual for its lively nature.

A-Dai gently touched Xiao Huahua's wing.

Xiao Huahua’s body shivered, like a flower petal lightly brushed by a bee.

"Wait for me!" Xiao Huahua suddenly said to A-Dai.

A-Dai: "Hmm?"

Xiao Huahua suddenly flapped its wings and took flight, turning and flying out of the karst cave.

Lang Mu immediately looked toward the cave entrance with concern: What was Xiao Huahua trying to do? Why did it feel so resolute?

Shang Feifan guessed: "Xiao Huahua probably wants to fulfill the duties of a new Insect Mother?"

Lang Mu asked subconsciously: "Will it be harmful to it?"

Shang Feifan thought of the several oddities he had noticed before, as well as the aura he had just sensed, and shook his head: "Don't worry. Perhaps it's just someone wanting to provide a final closure."

Lang Mu understood. Both he and Shang Feifan had suspected that a portion of the previous Insect Mother's consciousness was likely hidden within Xiao Huahua's spiritual sea—not necessarily wanting to possess it, but more like a guardianship over the new Insect Mother.

Shang Feifan had previously wondered if the previous Insect Mother would emerge when they were dealing with the Evil God. Fearing that the other party might get in the way, he had specifically sent Xiao Huahua away, not letting it follow them into the Earth's core.

The previous Insect Mother was indeed filled with regret for not being able to kill its greatest enemy with its own hands.

Following Shang Feifan and Lang Mu, it naturally knew that the Evil God had been successfully expelled by Shang Feifan and had even been "tricked" out of two-thirds of its energy by Shang.

But it hadn't even been able to touch the face of its enemy, and the other party had already escaped the Tianhe Star. What else could it do?

Originally, it had decided to fall into a permanent slumber, but it hadn't expected Xiao Huahua to be brought to the Insect Continent by the two of them.

Seeing the miserable state of the Insect Continent now, did the Insect Mother regret it?

It had regretted it long ago, and its heart had long since gone numb with pain.

By the time it left the Insect Continent with its army, the situation there was already not looking good—the sins were its own doing, and the insect venom was its own creation. It was the one who had ravaged this fertile and beautiful land, and it was the one who had harmed its entire race.

The moment Xiao Huahua saw the Pharaoh Ant and heard its tearful complaint, it was awakened once more.

It did indeed retain a final bit of power, intended for revenge.

Now that revenge was no longer needed, it would use it in another way that was required.

It didn't need to sleep anymore; it should have vanished completely long ago... With those two guarding its child, it could let go with peace of mind.

A-Dai suddenly jumped out of Lang Mu's arms and chased after it.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu picked up the Pharaoh Ant and followed.

The three hundred insects looked at each other and instinctively ran toward the cave entrance together.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第292章 虫人大陆推倒重来 (Part 1)
chunks.chineseText:
第292章 虫人大陆推倒重来

“时候到了……”一个不属于小花花的声音从它脑中响起。

小花花却没有感到奇怪，它似乎早就料到会有这一天一样，也似乎相信对方不会伤害它，反而是带着一丝好奇等待对方要做什么。

下一秒，它的意识被温柔而不可抗拒地推开，像潮水退去后露出的沙滩。

小花花“看见”自己的躯体悬浮而起，无数细密的金色光丝从它的身体中渗出，在空气中交织、凝聚。

金色的光云翻涌，一个庞大到遮天蔽日的虚影缓缓成型。

它的身躯宛如山脉延绵，甲壳泛着古老的金属光泽，八枚重叠的巨大虫翅和长长的触角构成复杂又美丽异常的几何图形，黑色湖泊一样的复眼中流淌着无尽威严和冰冷，但当它的眼睛看向大地时，又流露出一丝释然和悔恨。

虫母的意志，降临了。

整个虫人大陆，所有的虫族——无论是狂暴的食肉变异种，还是温和的腐殖虫族，包括那些早已堕入杀戮本能的凶残个体——全都在这一刻本能地停下了动作。

所有虫族全都听到了最原始的、来自虫母的召唤。

不管此时它们在做任何事情，全都停止，从各种各样的地方走出，来到外面，用各种各样的方法感知天空传来的虫母意志。

原本在天空中飞舞的飞行虫全都从空中落地，生活在地底、水流深处，只要能动的虫子也跟着用最快速度爬到地面。

以沙赫为首的三百虫，藏在青翠大山的三支巨虫族同样，它们全都走到了开阔地，仰望天空。

小花花在虫母遮天蔽日的巨大身体下被遮掩成一朵毫不起眼的小花，几乎没有谁注意到它。

只有商非凡一家三口在认真寻找小花花的踪迹。

【聆听吧，吾之子民。】

虫母的精神音如潮水般席卷大地，不是通过空气传递的声波，而是直接在每一只虫族的灵魂深处响起。那声音温柔却又威严，带着无法违抗的力量。

【这片大陆正在死去。吾变异虫族也正在死去。】

它的声音沉重而悲悯，却带着不可违逆的威严。

【因为吾之过错，让仇恨蒙蔽眼睛，让偏执影响判断，最终把我虫人族带入绝境。因为吾，让大地枯竭，空气都带着毒素。更让无数虫族在无数个日夜中忍饥挨饿、同族相食、彼此倾轧。若继续如此，终将迎来吾虫族永恒的灭绝。】

虫族们沉默地聆听着，复眼中闪烁着复杂的光芒。即便是最凶暴的掠食者，此刻也低伏着身躯，不敢发出一丝嘶鸣。

虫母在忏悔，但它的语调没有半点软弱，反而像是在宣告。

聆听的虫族也没有一只觉得虫族变成现在这样是虫母的过错，它们只感到自己无法帮助到虫母，因为虫母痛苦而痛苦。

【变异、散播虫毒、杀戮、吞噬……这一切都该结束了。】

【吾决定，献祭最后的灵魂之力，让你们全部回归本源。不用担心，那不是死亡。】

虫母虚影中的虫翼慢慢颤动、打开，整个天空都刮起了旋风。

【吾之子民将随吾召唤，沉眠蛰伏于地底，等待这座大陆自我修复。当新虫母的呼唤响起时，你们将重新苏醒，迎接新生！】

它的声音稍稍柔和，带着一丝期许：

【届时，你们可以选择——是保持变异后的模样，还是回归原本，同时拥有人形和虫形。无论哪种选择，只要拥有虫族的意志，你们都是新虫母之子民。】

天空中的虫母虚影猛地打开了所有虫翼，触角也跟着舞动。

整片天空都出现了绮丽的景象！

那是由纯粹能量凝聚而成的璀璨光翼，每一片翼膜都流淌着星河般的辉光，边缘如碎裂的琉璃折射出万千色彩。它们缓缓扇动，掀起无声的飓风，云层在翅尖下翻涌如浪，整片天空仿佛成了它振翅的倒影。

原本看起来应该十分恐怖的十来根长长触角自身体两侧垂落、舞动，如银河倾泻，细长的尖端闪烁着幽蓝的磷光，在空气中划出优雅的弧线。每一次舞动都带起细碎的光尘，似乎在勾勒某种远古符纹。

天光为虫母虚影镀上金边，当它完全舒展身躯时，连太阳都成了它的陪衬——

这一刻，它不再是暴戾偏执一心复仇的统治者，而是天地间最恢弘的造物，是虫族血脉中永恒的图腾。

美丽！辉煌！威武霸气！这是老商对虫母的形容。

他甚至在心中暗自庆幸自己没有碰上全盛时期的虫母，否则……真的很难说他是否能在虫母手底下讨到便宜。

不过如果他真的生活在虫母那个时代，也许他会用别的方法和虫母相处。

这样的虫母已经不能仅仅用强者来形容，它就是虫族的神。

【我的孩子们，沉睡吧……】

金光从虫母的虚影中迸发，遮天蔽日的虫母身影化作无数细密的金色丝线，坠向大地，钻进每一只虫族的躯体。

虫群开始倒下。

不是死亡，而是沉眠——它们的意识被温柔地包裹，这让它们异常安心，没有半点反抗。

同一时刻，大地开始震颤，被虫母隐藏在虫人大陆地底最后的能量化作无数道幽蓝色的能量光芒从地脉深处涌出，如同锁链，缠绕向每一只虫族的身躯。

所有虫族躯体被金色光茧覆盖，被幽蓝色的能量链缠住，缓缓沉入土壤深处又深处，如同回归母巢。

小花花感觉自己被一股温柔的力量包裹。

“跟着他们。”脑中的声音很轻，逐渐化为虚无。

小花花本能听懂，下意识回答：“那当然。我成年前都会跟着他们。”

商非凡和郎沐都在此时感觉天空中那只逐渐消散的虫母虚影似乎看了他们一眼，眼光意味深长。

商非凡：他好像听到有谁在跟他说——拿了我一半力量，就得帮我照顾好我的孩子。

“嗯。”商非凡回应。

天空，最后一缕属于虫母灵魂的金色光芒消散。

虫人大陆，彻底归于寂静。

只剩下无尽的风，在荒芜的大地上低语……

所有生命都在等待着新生的那一天。

被商非凡提着的法老蚁呆滞：陛下，您是不是把我给忘了？

商非凡耳边忽然听到一句隐约的笑声，似乎有谁在说：【虫族沉眠，虫母灵魂消散，诅咒解除一半。】

商非凡：“诅咒之神？为什么才解除一半？”所以虫毒这东西果然和诅咒之神也有一定关系？

诅咒之神竟然回应了。

不过祂可不承认虫毒是祂的锅，祂只承认一点，那就是虫母用整个种族和它自己的未来为代价，诅咒兽人和兽人大陆永世受到虫毒毒害，希望兽人能因为没有食物过得凄惨无比——祂接受了这个诅咒献祭。

现在虫母不惜散掉灵魂，召唤全部变异虫族沉眠蛰伏，希望它们能获得新生。既然想要求新生，自然就想要未来，想要未来，那就和当初的诅咒内容违背——可以支撑诅咒的精神能量消失，自然就算是诅咒解除了一半。

剩下的一半就是纯物理性质。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 292: The Insectoid Continent, Resetting from Scratch

"The time has come..." A voice that did not belong to Xiao Hua echoed within its mind.

Xiao Hua did not feel strange; it seemed to have anticipated this day for a long time. It also seemed to trust that the other party would not harm it, waiting instead with a trace of curiosity to see what would happen.

The next second, its consciousness was pushed aside—gently yet irresistibly—like the sand revealed after the tide recedes.

Xiao Hua "watched" its own body float upward. Countless fine, golden threads of light seeped out from its form, weaving and coalescing in the air.

As the golden cloud of light surged, a phantom so vast it blotted out the sky slowly took shape.

Its body was like a sprawling mountain range, its carapace shimmering with an ancient metallic luster. Eight overlapping, massive insect wings and long antennae formed a complex and extraordinarily beautiful geometric pattern. Within its compound eyes, which resembled black lakes, flowed endless majesty and coldness. Yet, when its gaze fell upon the earth, a trace of relief and remorse flickered within.

The will of the Insect Mother had descended.

Across the entire Insectoid Continent, every member of the insect race—whether they were violent, carnivorous mutants, gentle humus-feeding insects, or those savage individuals long since fallen into the instinct of slaughter—all instinctively ceased their movements at this very moment.

Every insect heard the most primal call, emanating from the Insect Mother.

No matter what they were doing, they stopped. They emerged from every corner, coming out into the open, using various methods to perceive the Insect Mother’s will transmitted from the sky.

The flying insects that had been dancing in the air landed; those living deep underground or in the depths of water, as long as they could move, crawled to the surface with all possible speed.

The three hundred insects led by Sha He, and the three giant insect tribes hiding in the verdant mountains, did the same. They all walked to open ground and looked up at the sky.

Under the massive, sky-covering body of the Insect Mother, Xiao Hua was obscured like an unremarkable little flower; almost no one noticed it.

Only Shang Feifan’s family of three was diligently searching for traces of Xiao Hua.

【Listen, my children.】

The Insect Mother’s mental voice swept across the land like a tide. It was not a sound wave transmitted through the air, but a resonance that echoed directly in the depths of every insect’s soul. The voice was gentle yet majestic, carrying an irresistible power.

【This continent is dying. My mutated insect race is also dying.】

Its voice was heavy and compassionate, yet carried an undeniable authority.

【Because of my mistakes, hatred blinded my eyes, and paranoia clouded my judgment, ultimately leading my insect people into a desperate plight. Because of me, the earth has withered, and the air is tainted with toxins. It has forced countless insects to endure hunger, cannibalism, and mutual slaughter for countless days and nights. If this continues, it will inevitably lead to the eternal extinction of my race.】

The insects listened in silence, their compound eyes flickering with complex light. Even the most ferocious predators lowered their bodies, not daring to let out a single hiss.

The Insect Mother was repenting, but its tone held no weakness; it sounded more like a proclamation.

Not a single insect listening felt that the current state of the race was the Insect Mother’s fault. They only felt pained because the Insect Mother was in pain, feeling their own inability to help her.

【Mutation, the spreading of insect toxins, slaughter, devouring... all of this must end.】

【I have decided to sacrifice my final soul energy to return you all to your origins. Do not fear; this is not death.】

The insect wings within the Insect Mother’s phantom trembled and opened slowly, and a whirlwind swept across the entire sky.

【My children will follow my call, slumbering and dormant beneath the earth, waiting for this continent to heal itself. When the call of the new Insect Mother rings out, you shall awaken once more to embrace a new life!】

Its voice softened slightly, carrying a hint of expectation:

【At that time, you may choose—whether to retain your mutated forms or return to your original state, possessing both human and insect forms. Regardless of your choice, as long as you possess the will of the insect race, you are all children of the new Insect Mother.】

The Insect Mother’s phantom in the sky suddenly spread all its wings, its antennae dancing along with them.

A magnificent spectacle appeared across the entire sky!

These were brilliant wings condensed from pure energy. Every wing membrane flowed with starlight-like radiance, and the edges refracted thousands of colors like shattered glazed glass. They flapped slowly, stirring up a silent hurricane. Clouds surged like waves beneath the wingtips, and the entire sky seemed to become a reflection of its beating wings.

The dozen or so long antennae, which should have looked terrifying, hung down from both sides of its body, dancing like a pouring galaxy. Their slender tips shimmered with eerie blue phosphorescence, carving elegant arcs in the air. Every movement brought forth fine, shimmering dust, as if sketching some ancient rune.

The daylight gilded the Insect Mother’s phantom. When it fully stretched its body, even the sun became a mere backdrop.

At this moment, it was no longer a violent, paranoid ruler obsessed with revenge, but the most magnificent creation in heaven and earth—the eternal totem in the bloodline of the insect race.

Beautiful! Glorious! Majestic and domineering! This was Old Shang’s description of the Insect Mother.

He even felt secretly glad in his heart that he hadn't encountered the Insect Mother in her prime; otherwise... it was hard to say if he could have gained any advantage against her.

However, if he had truly lived in the Insect Mother’s era, perhaps he would have found another way to get along with her.

Such an Insect Mother could no longer be described merely as a powerhouse; she was the god of the insect race.

【My children, sleep now...】

Golden light burst forth from the Insect Mother’s phantom. The sky-covering figure transformed into countless fine golden threads, falling toward the earth and drilling into the body of every insect.

The insect swarms began to fall.

It was not death, but slumber—their consciousnesses were gently enveloped, which made them feel exceptionally at ease, without a hint of resistance.

At the same moment, the earth began to tremble. The final energy hidden by the Insect Mother deep beneath the Insectoid Continent transformed into countless streams of eerie blue energy, surging from the depths of the earth’s veins like chains, winding around the body of every insect.

All insect bodies were covered in golden cocoons and bound by the blue energy chains, slowly sinking deep, deep into the soil, as if returning to the mother nest.

Xiao Hua felt itself being wrapped in a gentle force.

"Follow them." The voice in its mind was very light, gradually fading into nothingness.

Xiao Hua understood instinctively and replied subconsciously: "Of course. I will follow them until I reach adulthood."

At this moment, Shang Feifan and Lang Mu both felt that the Insect Mother’s phantom, which was gradually dissipating in the sky, seemed to glance at them with a meaningful look.

Shang Feifan: He seemed to hear someone telling him—since you took half of my power, you must help me take good care of my children.

"Understood," Shang Feifan responded.

In the sky, the last wisp of golden light belonging to the Insect Mother’s soul dissipated.

The Insectoid Continent fell into absolute silence.

Only the endless wind whispered across the desolate land...

All life was waiting for the day of rebirth.

The Pharaoh Ant, being held by Shang Feifan, was stunned: Your Majesty, did you forget about me?

Shang Feifan suddenly heard a faint laugh in his ear, as if someone were saying: 【The insect race sleeps, the Insect Mother’s soul dissipates, and the curse is half-lifted.】

Shang Feifan: "God of Curses? Why is it only half-lifted?" So, the insect toxin really had something to do with the God of Curses?

The God of Curses actually responded.

However, He did not admit that the insect toxin was His doing. He only admitted one thing: that the Insect Mother had used her entire race and her own future as the price to curse the Orcs and the Orc Continent, hoping the Orcs would live in misery without food—He had accepted this curse sacrifice.

Now, the Insect Mother had spared no effort to scatter her soul and summon all mutated insects to slumber, hoping they would gain a new life. Since they sought a new life, they naturally sought a future; and if they sought a future, it contradicted the original content of the curse—the spiritual energy supporting the curse had vanished, so naturally, it counted as the curse being half-lifted.

The remaining half was purely physical in nature.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第292章 虫人大陆推倒重来 (Part 2)
chunks.chineseText:
郎沐有所察觉，他不是感应到诅咒之神降临，而是感觉到商非凡心神异样。

商非凡正要跟他说诅咒之神的事。

轰隆——！

低沉的雷鸣声从远处传来。

郎沐脸色一变，“不是雷鸣，是地底轰鸣！是地震！”

商非凡一把抄起阿呆和法老蚁，和郎沐一起飞向天空。

小花花在天空绕了一圈，看到三人一虫就飞了过来。

“我有种不太妙的感觉。”小花花张口就说。

郎沐紧接着：“大地异变，很可能虫母做了什么。”

商非凡在自然方面的感知不如郎沐强，他只是单纯猜测：“不会是岩浆爆发吧？虫母采取了兽人大陆预言中的净化手段？”

郎沐脸色一变：“很有可能。”

两人又一起看向小花花。

小花花苦恼：“我不知道啊。我老母没跟我说，我甚至不知道它还在虫人大陆地底下私藏了这么多能量！”

“如果地震和岩浆爆发，那些沉睡的虫族会不会受到影响？”阿呆还在替无数虫族担心。

郎沐摇头：“应该不会，上一代虫母不可能想不到这一点。说不定那些虫族沉眠的地方比地震震心和地底岩浆更深。以虫母的力量，它完全能在这片大陆地底找到一个空的有氧气还安全坚固的巨大空间。”

商非凡似笑非笑：“不愧是虫母，这座大陆的生物可不止虫族，它这是不管三七二十一，为了给未来的虫族留一个新生的大陆，宁可毁了现在的一切。”

郎沐神色怪异：虫母可真是……就不肯给别人留下一点软弱印象，真正是心狠手辣果决无比。

郎沐不再多想，猛地加快速度冲向大地。

现在能救多少是多少吧。

商非凡没有阻拦郎沐，把阿呆、法老蚁都塞入雕像广场后，也紧跟在郎沐身后去当诺亚方舟。

小花花盘旋一圈，也跟了上去。

两人一虫合作，郎沐负责寻找生命体和植物，商非凡和小花花负责抓，抓到的生物和植物就先存放到郎沐的随身花圃里。

现在那座随身花圃已经大到不能再用花圃来形容，它的整体大小已经快要赶上黑水荒原领。

三只在前面拯救生物，虫人大陆的大地在后面不住翻腾。

大地开裂，地面隆起，火红的岩浆喷发而出。

当三只再也无法抵抗虫人大陆这场涉及到整座大陆的超大型自然（虫母制造）灾难，不得不让小花花划破空间，带他们逃跑时，整座兽人大陆简直跟遭遇了天罚一般，完全就是毁天灭地的景象。

他们甚至连回头看看虫人大陆变成什么样都没有机会。

唯一可以肯定的是，等他们下次再来虫人大陆，迎接他们的必将是一座崭新的重新充满生命力的新大陆。

“希望神之笼还没有撤销。”商非凡落到坚实的地面时呢喃。

老光倏地出现，气呼呼地说：“该死的虫母！现在只能让神之笼继续坚持一段时间，至少等火山灰等飘浮物沉淀下去再说。否则大半个天河星环境都得受到影响。”

老光敢用自己的库存打赌——这绝对是虫母最后的报复！

不等商非凡回应，老光又急急地说：“恢复自然之神的神力还有最后一步，你们打算什么时候做？”

商非凡没好气地说：“现在！”

阿沐既然说那枚心脏被取出也没事，他也不想再拖延下去，免得夜长梦多。

如果郎沐真的出事……就没这种可能！

除非老光和天河星意识想要他钻入天河星地心玩自爆。

再次进入雕像广场，商非凡差点没认出来这里是哪里。

原本这里还能看出是一座城市广场，可如今已经半点看不出城市的影子，倒更像是几万年前留下的古神殿遗址。

这个遗址还看不到边界。

之前他虽然没有看到广场的边界，但总有种这是一座城市广场，也就是最大只有一座城市那么大的恍惚感。

可现在他再看这里，却觉得这里没有了边界，就像是无尽旷野中的一角。

充满生机的旷野！

无论是广场周围的建筑物，还是广场上摆放的石碑，全都被翠绿植物掩盖或缠绕，不拨开它们就看不到下面隐藏的遗迹。

只有自然之神的雕像就像是得到一个小精灵的全心呵护般，身上没有攀爬半点不该有的杂株，全身都似在发光，脚下的野草只刚好到脚背边，还开满了各种或可爱或艳丽的小朵野花。

另外，整座雕像也变得朦胧，让观看的人无法再看清雕像的模样，只能大致有个那里有一座手持权杖的神之雕像的感觉。

阿呆和法老蚁还在角落里沉睡，但他们沉睡的地方竟然有了一座藤蔓自动编织而成的苍绿色小屋子。

阿呆睡在屋里一看就很柔软的小床上。

法老蚁……被一根藤蔓吊在屋外墙壁上。

区别对待妥妥的。

这可不是他干的。

商非凡指了指被吊着的法老蚁，对郎沐说：“看到没有，自然之神也是一个小心眼。就因为那只虫被迫偷偷吸收了它千年能量，就这样对待人小虫子。”

郎沐唇角微弯。

“走吧，我们该进行你主线任务的最后一步了。”郎沐握住商非凡的手，主动拉着他往雕像那边走。

商非凡张口，想要再跟郎沐确定一遍，又忍住。

他相信阿沐不会忍心让他伤心，那种会伤到他们一家的事肯定不会这么积极去做。

两人走到雕像面前，这才发现这座雕像之巍峨——总感觉比以前要高大且生动许多。

商非凡甚至有种雕像是个活人，正躲在朦胧薄纱后，观察他们俩的感觉。

郎沐转身面对商非凡，抓住他的手，放到自己胸口处，特别淡定地说：“你来取出。”

商非凡：“……”

这是让他亲手掏出自己爱人的心脏？

很好，果然活得久了，什么事都能碰到。

商非凡的手指慢慢拉开郎沐皮甲上的绳子，他还在脑中构想要如何没有半点痛楚且超级快速地取出他家阿沐的心脏……

突然！

郎沐胸膛发出翠绿色的光芒，由里向外。

那翠绿色光芒慢慢从郎沐胸膛浮现出来，凝聚出一团跳动的能量。

能量团飘浮而起，飞向雕像的胸口。

当翠绿色的能量团钻入雕像胸前缺口的一刹那，整座雕像瞬间变得完整无比，更生动无比。

一股柔和的能量爆发，把商非凡和郎沐全都从雕像广场里推了出来。

商非凡下意识抓住郎沐的手臂。

两人同时出现在外面。

小花花看到他们就飞过来，追问：“你们怎么了？遇到了什么事？”

商非凡没顾上回答小花花，他先一步抓住郎沐胸口战甲，想要检查他的情况。

郎沐按住他的手，让他的手掌紧贴自己的心脏部位：“听。感觉到了么，有心跳声。”

商非凡听（感觉）到了。

那颗心脏跳动得非常有力，充满活力。

郎沐额头的种子印记也冒出了两片嫩嫩小小的芽。

有点可爱怎么办……老商盯着郎沐眉心的小芽芽，手指特别痒，想摸。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 292: The Insectoid Continent, Resetting from Scratch (Part 2)

Lang Mu sensed something. It wasn't that he felt the descent of the God of Curses, but rather that he sensed a shift in Shang Feifan’s state of mind.

Shang Feifan was just about to tell him about the God of Curses.

*Rumble—!*

A low thunderous sound came from afar.

Lang Mu’s expression changed. "That’s not thunder; it’s the rumbling of the earth! It’s an earthquake!"

Shang Feifan scooped up A-Dai and the Pharaoh Ant, and together with Lang Mu, flew into the sky.

Xiao Hua circled in the sky, saw the three people and one insect, and flew over.

"I have a bad feeling about this," Xiao Hua said as soon as it opened its mouth.

Lang Mu followed up: "The earth is changing; it’s very likely the Insect Mother did something."

Shang Feifan’s perception of nature was not as strong as Lang Mu’s, so he simply guessed: "Could it be a volcanic eruption? Did the Insect Mother adopt the purification method from the Orc Continent’s prophecy?"

Lang Mu’s face changed: "It’s very possible."

The two looked at Xiao Hua together.

Xiao Hua was distressed: "I don't know! My mother didn't tell me; I didn't even know she had hidden so much energy beneath the Insectoid Continent!"

"If there’s an earthquake and volcanic eruption, will those sleeping insects be affected?" A-Dai was still worried about the countless insects.

Lang Mu shook his head: "It shouldn't. The previous generation of the Insect Mother couldn't have failed to consider that. Perhaps the places where those insects are slumbering are deeper than the earthquake’s epicenter and the underground magma. With the Insect Mother’s power, she could easily find a large, empty, oxygenated, and sturdy space beneath this continent."

Shang Feifan said with a wry smile: "As expected of the Insect Mother. There are more than just insects living on this continent, yet she’s disregarding everything else. To leave a new continent for the future insect race, she’s willing to destroy everything that exists now."

Lang Mu’s expression was strange: The Insect Mother really is... she refuses to leave anyone with an impression of weakness. She is truly ruthless and decisive.

Lang Mu stopped overthinking and suddenly accelerated, diving toward the earth.

He would save as many as he could.

Shang Feifan did not stop Lang Mu. After stuffing A-Dai and the Pharaoh Ant into the statue plaza, he followed closely behind Lang Mu to act as a Noah’s Ark.

Xiao Hua circled once and followed as well.

The two and one insect worked together. Lang Mu was responsible for finding life forms and plants, while Shang Feifan and Xiao Hua were responsible for grabbing them. The creatures and plants they caught were stored in Lang Mu’s portable garden.

That portable garden had grown so large it could no longer be described as a mere garden; its overall size was already catching up to the Blackwater Wasteland territory.

The three were busy saving life in the front, while the land of the Insectoid Continent churned endlessly behind them.

The earth cracked, the ground bulged, and fiery red magma erupted.

When the three could no longer resist this super-large-scale natural (Insect Mother-made) disaster involving the entire continent, they had to let Xiao Hua tear through space to help them escape. The entire Insectoid Continent looked as if it had suffered divine retribution—a scene of total destruction.

They didn't even have a chance to look back at what the Insectoid Continent had become.

The only certainty was that the next time they visited the Insectoid Continent, they would be greeted by a brand-new continent, once again full of vitality.

"I hope the God’s Cage hasn't been lifted yet," Shang Feifan murmured as he landed on solid ground.

Old Guang appeared suddenly, saying angrily: "Damn that Insect Mother! Now I can only let the God’s Cage persist for a while longer, at least until the volcanic ash and floating debris settle. Otherwise, the environment of most of the Tianhe Star will be affected."

Old Guang would bet his entire inventory—this was definitely the Insect Mother’s final act of revenge!

Without waiting for Shang Feifan to respond, Old Guang added urgently: "There is one last step to restoring the God of Nature’s divine power. When do you plan to do it?"

Shang Feifan said irritably: "Now!"

Since A-Mu said it would be fine even if the heart was removed, he didn't want to drag it out any longer, lest complications arise.

If something really happened to Lang Mu... that was impossible!

Unless Old Guang and the consciousness of Tianhe Star wanted him to dive into the core of Tianhe Star and commit suicide by explosion.

Entering the statue plaza again, Shang Feifan almost didn't recognize the place.

Previously, one could still tell this was a city plaza, but now, there was no trace of a city left; it looked more like the ruins of an ancient temple left behind tens of thousands of years ago.

And this ruin had no visible boundaries.

Although he hadn't seen the boundaries of the plaza before, he had always had the vague feeling that it was a city plaza—at most, the size of a city.

But looking at it now, he felt it had no boundaries, like a corner of an endless wilderness.

A wilderness full of life!

Whether it was the buildings around the plaza or the stone tablets placed upon it, everything was covered or entwined by lush green plants; one couldn't see the ruins hidden beneath without pushing them aside.

Only the statue of the God of Nature seemed to be under the full care of a sprite; there were no unwanted weeds climbing on it, the entire body seemed to be glowing, and the wild grass at its feet reached just to the instep, blooming with all sorts of cute or gorgeous little wildflowers.

Furthermore, the entire statue had become hazy, making it impossible for viewers to see its features clearly, leaving only the vague sense that there was a statue of a god holding a scepter.

A-Dai and the Pharaoh Ant were still sleeping in a corner, but where they slept, there was now a pale green little house woven automatically by vines.

A-Dai was sleeping on a very soft-looking little bed inside the house.

The Pharaoh Ant... was hanging on the outer wall of the house by a vine.

Clear favoritism.

This wasn't his doing.

Shang Feifan pointed at the hanging Pharaoh Ant and said to Lang Mu: "See that? The God of Nature is also petty. Just because that insect was forced to secretly absorb its energy for a thousand years, it treats the little bug like this."

Lang Mu’s lips curved slightly.

"Let’s go. It’s time for the final step of your main quest." Lang Mu took Shang Feifan’s hand and took the initiative to lead him toward the statue.

Shang Feifan opened his mouth, wanting to confirm with Lang Mu one more time, but held back.

He believed A-Mu wouldn't have the heart to make him sad; anything that would hurt their family wouldn't be pursued so actively.

The two walked up to the statue, only then realizing how towering it was—it felt much taller and more vivid than before.

Shang Feifan even had the feeling that the statue was a living person, hiding behind a hazy veil, observing them.

Lang Mu turned to face Shang Feifan, took his hand, and placed it on his own chest, saying with particular calm: "You take it out."

Shang Feifan: "..."

He was being asked to personally extract his lover’s heart?

Very well, sure enough, if you live long enough, you’ll encounter anything.

Shang Feifan’s fingers slowly pulled at the ropes on Lang Mu’s leather armor. He was still mentally planning how to extract his A-Mu’s heart without any pain and with super speed...

Suddenly!

Lang Mu’s chest emitted a verdant green light, from the inside out.

That verdant light slowly emerged from Lang Mu’s chest, condensing into a pulsing mass of energy.

The energy mass floated up and flew toward the gap in the statue’s chest.

The moment the verdant energy mass drilled into the gap, the entire statue instantly became complete and incredibly vivid.

A gentle burst of energy pushed both Shang Feifan and Lang Mu out of the statue plaza.

Shang Feifan instinctively grabbed Lang Mu’s arm.

The two appeared outside at the same time.

Xiao Hua flew over when it saw them, asking: "What happened to you two? What did you encounter?"

Shang Feifan didn't have time to answer Xiao Hua; he grabbed the armor on Lang Mu’s chest first, wanting to check his condition.

Lang Mu pressed his hand, keeping his palm pressed firmly against his heart: "Listen. Can you feel it? There’s a heartbeat."

Shang Feifan heard (and felt) it.

That heart was beating very powerfully, full of vitality.

Two tender little buds had also sprouted from the seed mark on Lang Mu’s forehead.

What to do, it’s kind of cute... Old Shang stared at the little buds on Lang Mu’s brow, his fingers itching, wanting to touch them.

chunks.chapterTitle: 第292章 虫人大陆推倒重来 (Part 3)
chunks.chineseText:
“啊，阿呆！”小花花朝旁边冲了过去。

阿呆和法老蚁刚刚也被扔出雕像广场，阿呆身下仍旧有张藤蔓编织的小床，但法老蚁……仍旧被藤蔓捆绑着。

两只一离开雕像广场，就朦朦胧胧地醒了过来。

商非凡和郎沐原本在互相凝视，老商刚抬起手指摸向郎沐眉心，就被小花花的声音惊动。

老光也在此时冒出来：

【恭喜玩家玩成全部的主线任务！雕像眼睛和心脏的回归，总计奖励贡献点两万点。】

【另，因玩家赶在兽人大陆大型灾难前完成主线任务，让自然之神及时恢复，特别额外奖励双向定点空间门一扇。特别奖励请到游戏商城领取。】

【因玩家表现优异，顺带解决了虫人大陆变异虫族的难题，现在本系统宣布，本游戏商城所有商品将对你全面开放且永远打开。】

商非凡神经一跳：这是什么意思？难不成这光球还想继续给他发布任务？

他这样想，也这样问了，老光委屈，哼唧：“要不是看在郎沐的面子上！”

“说清楚。”商非凡冷硬且不为所动。

老光：“我答应只作为郎沐的光脑跟随他，既然是光脑，自然无法打开游戏商城。而你们以后很可能会长时间待在地星，甚或去往其他更高等级的世界，也许你不想，但郎沐的性子一定会念着这边的亲人和朋友，说不定还会想念这边的美食和特产。”

商非凡：“简略说！”

老光：“就是我让你们随身带一个天河星土特产超市，随时随地都能用贡献点交易里面的物品。如果贡献点不够，你们可以把其他地方的特产卖给游戏商城，再换取贡献点购买游戏商城里面的物品。”

商非凡冷笑：“我怎么觉得这不是方便我们，而是方便你？”

老光无赖地说：“反正你都要我给你们开一个空间门了。我可以给你们一个固定空间坐标，这样你们每次来天河星消耗的能量都会降到最低。既然有了如此方便快捷又便宜的运送通道，为什么不能顺便带货？而且谁说这样只单单方便我们？你怎么能确定将来你们需要的东西，不会恰恰就是天河星的土特产？”

“这么说，你这个系统还要留在我的精神海里？”商非凡不爽，一边计算留个游戏商城的利弊。

“当然不是！我的精神力会彻底撤离你的精神海，包括游戏系统全部，留下的只是一个自带空间门、名叫游戏商城的神器，你可以契约它，还能把它当做秘密空间仓库使用。要不是看在郎沐的面子上，我才不会把这么好的东西白送给你。”

最后一句，老光说得很大声。

郎沐都听到了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 292: The Insectoid Continent, Resetting from Scratch (Part 3)

"Ah, A-Dai!" Xiao Hua rushed over to the side.

A-Dai and the Pharaoh Ant had also just been thrown out of the statue plaza. A-Dai still had the vine-woven little bed beneath him, but the Pharaoh Ant... was still tied up by vines.

As soon as the two left the statue plaza, they woke up in a daze.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu had been staring at each other. Old Shang had just raised his finger to touch the buds on Lang Mu’s brow when he was startled by Xiao Hua’s voice.

Old Guang also popped out at this moment:

【Congratulations to the player for completing all main quests! The return of the statue’s eyes and heart has earned a total reward of 20,000 contribution points.】

【Additionally, because the player completed the main quest before the large-scale disaster on the Orc Continent, allowing the God of Nature to recover in time, you are specially rewarded with a two-way fixed-point space gate. Please claim this special reward in the game store.】

【Because of the player’s excellent performance, which incidentally solved the problem of the mutated insect race on the Insectoid Continent, the system now announces that all items in the game store will be fully open to you and will remain open forever.】

Shang Feifan’s nerves twitched: What does this mean? Could it be that this ball of light wants to keep issuing him quests?

He thought this, and he asked it. Old Guang felt wronged and sniffled: "If it weren't for Lang Mu’s sake!"

"Speak clearly," Shang Feifan said coldly, unmoved.

Old Guang: "I promised to follow Lang Mu only as his optical computer. Since I am an optical computer, I naturally cannot open the game store. But you will likely stay on Earth for a long time in the future, or even go to other higher-level worlds. Maybe you don't want to, but Lang Mu’s nature will definitely make him miss his relatives and friends here, and perhaps he will miss the food and specialties here."

Shang Feifan: "Summarize!"

Old Guang: "It means I’m letting you carry a Tianhe Star specialty supermarket with you, so you can trade for items inside using contribution points anytime, anywhere. If you don't have enough contribution points, you can sell specialties from other places to the game store in exchange for points to buy items from the store."

Shang Feifan sneered: "Why do I feel like this isn't for our convenience, but for yours?"

Old Guang said shamelessly: "Anyway, you were going to make me open a space gate for you. I can give you a fixed spatial coordinate so that the energy consumed every time you come to Tianhe Star will be minimized. Since there is such a convenient, fast, and cheap transportation channel, why not bring some goods along? And who says this only benefits us? How can you be sure that the things you need in the future won't happen to be specialties from Tianhe Star?"

"So, you, this system, are still going to stay in my mental sea?" Shang Feifan was displeased, weighing the pros and cons of keeping the game store.

"Of course not! My spiritual power will completely withdraw from your mental sea, including the entire game system. What remains will be an artifact called the 'Game Store' that comes with a space gate. You can bind it to yourself and even use it as a secret spatial warehouse. If it weren't for Lang Mu’s sake, I wouldn't give such a good thing to you for free."

Old Guang said the last sentence very loudly.

Lang Mu heard it all.

chunks.chineseText:
第293章 完结章

商非凡其实多少有些心动，虽然他也能猜出光球私心是想要通过他这个媒介为天河星谋取更多好处——来自其他世界的资源。

但就如老光所说，有个随身游戏商城对他也有一定好处，比如刚到某地缺少资金，完全可以用贡献点交易游戏商城里的物品出来和当地智慧生物做交换。

必要时甚至能当做求生重要道具——当你失去空间储物工具，失去携带的一切物品时，这种隐藏在精神海里、能买到食物用水药剂武器原材料之类的商城绝对能帮得上大忙。

哪怕不用来交易，只当做仓库使用也不错。

商非凡偷瞄了下自己的贡献点结余，吃惊地发现一段时间不用，他的贡献点数竟然已经积累到97122点，接近十万点。

老商很满意，默认了老光想要留下游戏商城的做法。

老光也见好就收，本来就是两利的事情嘛。

商非凡再检查雕像广场，发现已经进不去。

他的直觉告诉他，他和那个异度空间的链接彻底断开了。

之前他能进去，不过是自然之神给他开了一扇门，现在自然之神把他利用完，就把他踢出门外，顺便把自家大门也给锁死。

幸好他早就猜想到这种可能，把里面存放的个人财产早早就全都转移出来。

反正他也能炼制储物工具，而且随着他技术越纯熟、对空间学越了解，他炼制出来的储物空间也越来越大，附带的功能也开始增加，迟早一天他能炼制出能存放活物甚至能自生成一个小世界的空间来。

为此，如今雕像广场无法再进入，他也不觉得可惜，反而更有种甩掉大包袱的轻松感。

事情一件件来。

商非凡重点检查郎沐，要不是现场还有其他人在，他恨不得把郎沐里里外外从血肉到精神海全无死角地检查一遍。

来回确认三遍，确定郎沐真的没问题，这才放他去找阿呆玩。

他打算晚上没有小孩子和外人骚扰时，再把他家大宝贝好好检查个几遍。

郎沐：“……”

郎沐被吓跑了，某人的架势太可怕，尤其那目光实在太有侵略性。

“你打算什么时候脱离？”商非凡眼睛看着郎沐和阿呆那边，嘴里问老光。

老光化成光球浮在商非凡跟前，也看着郎沐和阿呆的方向，回答：“你别急着离开，还有点扫尾工作没结束呢。”

“还有什么事？”

“多着呢。自然之神虽然恢复了，但不是说祂一个神就能解决这个世界的虫毒，你和郎沐得帮祂。”

“……重点是阿沐吧。那权杖给阿沐留了枚所谓自然之种，我就知道没什么好事。”商非凡撇嘴。

“成为天河星自然之子不好吗？这表示只要天河星不消失，郎沐就不会真正死亡。”

“如果天河星灭亡了呢？”

“那不是还有你吗？”

郎沐能有两条保命底牌确实不错，但商非凡脸上半点不显，还冷脸说：“换言之，只要阿沐不死，天河星也不会真正灭绝是不是？”

光球幽幽道：“星球总会灭绝的，不过留在郎沐身体中的那枚自然之种未来也许有可能会成长为一枚星核。当然，那是在郎沐有能力分离那枚自然之种，并且愿意培养那枚自然之种的情况下。但这必将是几百几千亿万年以后的事情，你和郎沐真打算活那么长时间？”

商非凡一想到他和郎沐要活那么长，顿时没话了。他就算想要长寿，也没想过要活以亿为单位的时间。

只怕到那时，他和郎沐可能早就活腻，而选择化成宇宙能量的一部分。

“除了郎沐，在恢复兽人大陆上，你也有不少能帮上忙的地方。”光球又道。

商非凡懒洋洋：“需要我继续控制不死尸去挖泄洪渠道？”

“这只是其一。另外你就不想成为天河星的黑暗之神吗？”光球的声音充满诱惑。

商非凡一口回绝：“没兴趣。”

光球表示可惜，但也没有强求，它也知道无法留下这个人——这人天生长了一身反骨，他能老老实实做任务到现在，还把主线任务完成，就已经是天河星之大幸。感谢郎沐！

“邪神虽然逃走，但兽人大陆还是留下了不少邪神信徒，以及邪神带来的邪恶力量。这些你应该能吸收吧？”

商非凡一笑：“我是打工人，你是老板，只要你出的酬劳足够让我满意，自然没有什么不能谈的工作。”

光球：“……都给你折换成贡献点。想要什么，你自己在游戏商城里买！”

“顺便把天河星全球交通也给我开启了吧。”商非凡想着以后有时间可以和阿沐一起去法德尔大陆溜达溜达，看看风景、看看故人什么的。

光球：“等虫人大陆的火山灰沉淀，我和天河星意识会把神之笼给转移出去，到时你想去天河星哪里都行。”

“没有方便的空间通道吗？”

“有能瞬移的阿呆和能撕破空间的小花花，再加上你自己对空间学的掌握，你还需要我帮你开空间通道？”

“行吧。”商非凡给自己加了一个功课，那就是学会开空间门。

另外一边，知道一家人已经回到兽人大陆，阿呆除了高兴再没有其他多余感想，但被虫母无视、又被强行带到虫人大陆的法老蚁就不这么想了。

它从醒来开始就一副深受打击的模样，嘴里不住碎碎念：“为什么陛下的召唤会忽略过我？为什么我没有感受到陛下的灵魂召唤？为什么我没有沉睡？呜呜，我又不是故意背叛陛下……”

一个虫族，哪怕全族都被虫母给毁了，那对虫母还是有依恋心的。虫族对虫母的心就是典型的“任你伤害我千百遍，我仍旧视你为信念”。

这样的虫族在全族都被虫母召唤，唯独自己被忽略的情况下，那打击真的是直入灵魂，脆弱一点的，恐怕醒来就会自杀。

小花花听法老蚁念的烦，正要揍它强逼它闭嘴。

阿呆忽然指着小花花，对法老蚁道：“不止你被留下啊，还有小花花。上一代虫母不要你了，你可以找小花花效忠啊。”

法老蚁一愣，随即就像是想明白了什么——原来它是上一代虫母特意留给新虫母的“重臣”，大喜过望，差点扑向小花花。

不等小护花扇飞它，法老蚁就五体投地，臣服在小花花面前，口称：“陛下，卑下戈麦斯，愿意为您做任何事情，请您随意驱使卑下吧！”

小花花：“……”它要这么一只虫干什么？

一只手拎起法老蚁，抖了抖：“效忠小花花是吧？那就是打算在我们家打工？正好现在就有一个艰巨又光荣的任务要交给你。来，试试看你能不能净化虫毒，能净化多少、需要多长时间。”

法老蚁：果然，它活下来是有原因的！

光球绕着法老蚁飞了一圈，直接说：“它就是虫毒产生的本源虫族？且在全族的血脉天赋都是自带虫毒且能散播病毒的情况下，就它一个出现了净化的血脉天赋？”
