Chapter 293: Finale (Part 1)

Shang Feifan was actually somewhat tempted. Although he could guess that the Light Orb had selfish motives—wanting to use him as a medium to secure more benefits for the Tianhe Star, namely resources from other worlds—he also saw the logic in what Old Guang said. Having a portable game store had its perks. For instance, if he arrived somewhere lacking funds, he could simply trade items from the game store with the local sentient beings.

In a pinch, it could even serve as a vital survival tool. If one were to lose their spatial storage artifacts and all their carried possessions, a store hidden within the sea of consciousness—capable of providing food, water, potions, weapons, and raw materials—would be an absolute lifesaver.

Even if not used for trading, it functioned perfectly well as a warehouse.

Shang Feifan snuck a glance at his contribution point balance and was shocked to find that, after a period of disuse, it had accumulated to 97,122 points—nearly one hundred thousand.

Old Shang was satisfied and tacitly accepted the Light Orb’s desire to keep the game store.

Old Guang knew when to quit while he was ahead; after all, it was a mutually beneficial arrangement.

Shang Feifan checked the statue plaza again and found he could no longer enter.

His intuition told him that the link between him and that extradimensional space had been completely severed.

Previously, he had been able to enter only because the God of Nature had opened a door for him. Now that the God of Nature had finished using him, He had kicked him out and locked the front door behind him.

Fortunately, he had anticipated this possibility long ago and had already transferred all his personal property out of that space.

In any case, he was capable of crafting storage artifacts, and as his techniques grew more refined and his understanding of spatial science deepened, the storage spaces he created grew larger and gained more functions. Sooner or later, he would be able to craft a space capable of holding living creatures, or even one that could evolve into a small world of its own.

Because of this, he didn't feel any regret that the statue plaza was now inaccessible; instead, he felt a sense of relief, as if he had shed a heavy burden.

One thing at a time.

Shang Feifan focused his attention on Lang Mu. If it weren't for the presence of others, he would have loved to inspect Lang Mu from head to toe, from flesh to spirit, without leaving a single corner unchecked.

After confirming three times that Lang Mu was truly fine, he finally let him go play with A-Dai.

He planned to give his "big treasure" a thorough check-up tonight, once there were no children or outsiders around to disturb them.

Lang Mu: "..."

Lang Mu fled, spooked by the man's intense demeanor, especially that gaze which felt far too predatory.

"When do you plan to detach?" Shang Feifan asked Old Guang, his eyes still fixed on Lang Mu and A-Dai.

Old Guang manifested as a light orb and floated before Shang Feifan, also looking toward Lang Mu and A-Dai. "Don't be in such a rush to leave. There’s still some cleanup work to finish."

"What else is there?"

"Plenty. The God of Nature has recovered, but that doesn't mean He alone can solve the insect toxin plaguing this world. You and Lang Mu have to help Him."

"...The point is Lang Mu, right? I knew nothing good would come of that scepter leaving behind a so-called 'Seed of Nature' for him." Shang Feifan curled his lip.

"Isn't it a good thing to become a Child of Nature for Tianhe Star? It means that as long as Tianhe Star doesn't vanish, Lang Mu will never truly die."

"And if Tianhe Star perishes?"

"Isn't that what you're here for?"

It was true that having two safety nets was good for Lang Mu, but Shang Feifan didn't show it on his face. Instead, he said coldly, "In other words, as long as Lang Mu doesn't die, Tianhe Star won't truly go extinct, right?"

The light orb said softly, "Planets always go extinct eventually. However, the Seed of Nature left in Lang Mu's body might one day grow into a planetary core. Of course, that would only happen if Lang Mu has the ability to separate that seed and the willingness to nurture it. But that’s a matter for hundreds of billions of years from now. Do you and Lang Mu really plan on living that long?"

The moment Shang Feifan thought about living that long with Lang Mu, he was speechless. Even if he wanted a long life, he never intended to live for an amount of time measured in billions.

By then, he and Lang Mu would likely be bored of living and would choose to become part of the universe's energy.

"Besides Lang Mu, there are many ways you can help in the restoration of the Orc Continent," the light orb added.

Shang Feifan said lazily, "Do you need me to keep controlling the undead to dig flood channels?"

"That’s just one thing. Besides, don't you want to become the God of Darkness for Tianhe Star?" The orb’s voice was filled with temptation.

Shang Feifan refused flatly: "Not interested."

The light orb expressed regret but didn't force the issue. It knew it couldn't keep this man—he was born with a rebellious streak. The fact that he had dutifully completed the main quest up to this point was already a great blessing for Tianhe Star. Thank goodness for Lang Mu!

"Although the Evil God escaped, the Orc Continent still has many of his followers left, as well as the evil power he brought. You should be able to absorb that, right?"

Shang Feifan smiled: "I’m a worker, you’re the boss. As long as the pay is enough to satisfy me, there’s nothing we can’t negotiate."

Light Orb: "...I'll convert it all into contribution points. You can buy whatever you want in the game store yourself!"

"And while you're at it, open up global transportation for Tianhe Star for me." Shang Feifan was thinking that in the future, he could take A-Mu to stroll around the Fadel Continent, see the scenery, and visit old friends.

Light Orb: "Once the volcanic ash on the Insect-Man Continent settles, I and the consciousness of Tianhe Star will move the Cage of God. By then, you can go anywhere you want on Tianhe Star."

"Are there no convenient spatial passages?"

"You have A-Dai who can teleport and Little Flower who can tear through space, plus your own mastery of spatial science. Do you still need me to open spatial passages for you?"

"Fine." Shang Feifan added a new task to his list: learning to open spatial gates.

On the other side, knowing that the family had returned to the Orc Continent, A-Dai felt nothing but joy. However, the Pharaoh Ant, who had been ignored by the Mother Insect and forcibly dragged to the Insect-Man Continent, felt differently.

Ever since it woke up, it had been in a state of deep despair, muttering to itself: "Why did Her Majesty’s call ignore me? Why didn't I feel Her Majesty’s soul-call? Why didn't I fall into a deep sleep? Wuwu, I didn't betray Her Majesty on purpose..."

For a member of the Insect Race, even if the entire clan had been destroyed by the Mother Insect, there was still an attachment. The heart of the Insect Race toward the Mother Insect was a classic case of "Even if you hurt me a thousand times, I still view you as my faith."

For such an insect, to be the only one ignored while the entire clan was summoned by the Mother Insect was a blow that struck straight at the soul. Someone more fragile might have committed suicide upon waking.

Little Flower was getting annoyed by the Pharaoh Ant's muttering and was about to beat it into silence.

A-Dai suddenly pointed at Little Flower and said to the Pharaoh Ant: "You aren't the only one left behind; there’s also Little Flower. The previous Mother Insect doesn't want you, so you can pledge your loyalty to Little Flower."

The Pharaoh Ant was stunned, then seemed to realize something—so it had been a "high-ranking official" specifically left behind by the previous Mother Insect for the new one! It was overjoyed and almost lunged at Little Flower.

Before Little Flower could swat it away, the Pharaoh Ant prostrated itself, surrendering before Little Flower, crying out: "Your Majesty, your humble servant Gomez is willing to do anything for you. Please, feel free to command me!"

Little Flower: "..." What was it supposed to do with a bug like this?

It picked up the Pharaoh Ant with one hand and shook it: "Pledging loyalty to Little Flower, huh? That means you intend to work for our family? Perfect, there’s a difficult and glorious task for you right now. Come, try to see if you can purify the insect toxin, how much you can purify, and how long it will take."

Pharaoh Ant: As expected, there was a reason it survived!

The Light Orb circled the Pharaoh Ant and said directly: "It is the source insect that produces the insect toxin? And among a race where the bloodline talent is inherently toxic and capable of spreading viruses, it is the only one with a purifying bloodline talent?"

chunks.chineseText:
“对，就是它。对付虫毒，它的血脉天赋要比夏冰有效得多。”商非凡把法老蚁丢在地上。

修炼千年的法老蚁实力自然不弱，可之前它身体中的能量被平衡被遏制，导致它始终无法让自己冲入法神境界，现在只留下自然之力，但缺少一半能量的它也无法冲入法神境界，再加上商非凡能用虫母威压压制它，导致法老蚁在商面前几乎没有反抗之力。

光球沉吟一秒：“把它交给我吧。自然之神正在研究更有效的虫毒消融药剂，也许它能帮得上忙。”

商非凡一挥手：“随便拿去用。”

法老蚁压根就没时间也没能力抗议，转眼就从原地消失。

商非凡微笑：“我带回来的工人，效忠我家小花花的子民，记得付出相应酬劳。”

“你这是打算改行当虫贩子？”

“不，我这是兼职猎头。”商爸爸叹了口气，看着两崽儿说：“养孩子费钱啊，不趁着现在我和郎沐年轻多赚点，将来孩子们要是吃不饱穿不暖，到处打劫怎么办？”

光球：“……”

光球面对这个时时刻刻都想剥削它这个老板的打工人气得牙痒痒，却拿他无可奈何——有技术有能力的人就是这么碉，老板也拿他没办法。

光球想到它这次过来的另一个重点，飞到郎沐身边，郑重地送了他一样礼物。

那是光球精心炼制的最新型光脑，结合了天河星所有文明的最高黑科技。

光脑外形咋一看就像一枚星型的透明蓝色小粒宝石，闪闪发光，特别漂亮。

商非凡凑过去看，想到自己似乎还没有送过郎沐贵重首饰（空间饰品和炼金物品）除外，顿时觉得自己有点输了。

光球的小手手伸出，想要亲自给郎沐给戴上，被商非凡半途拦截。

商非凡倒也没有小气地不让郎沐接受这份礼物，他只是把那枚耳钉抢过来，自己动手给郎沐戴在左耳垂上。

天河星天道出手的光脑自然不可能是凡品，星型耳钉也不需要穿刺郎沐的耳垂，只轻轻往耳垂上一贴，就自动与耳垂贴合，以后除非郎沐自己想要把光脑卸载，否则就算郎沐这只耳朵粉碎，光脑也会重新出现在郎沐身上。

郎沐在光球指点下试用了一番光脑，顿觉十分好用，就没吝啬表达自己的喜悦。

光球看他喜欢这份礼物，也非常高兴。

只有商非凡目光危险地沉默在一边。

因为光球催得紧，商非凡和郎沐商量后，把阿呆和小花花送到了黑水荒原新城，让阿呆和小花花给曾姥爷帮忙。

郎老夫人看到阿呆就宝贝地叫，看到小花花更是喜欢——谁不喜欢这么美丽的小生灵呢？

当然，没人会跟两位老人说这只精灵一般美丽的小虫子就是当代虫母，一代法神。

小花花也很喜欢郎老夫人，围着她飞了一圈，还撒下虫粉做标记。

郎沐暗中吐气：太好了，其他不说，以后至少不会有虫子叮咬姥姥。

随后两个无良爸爸当着阿呆的面，就跟郎老伯爵说：以后他们不会接手新城管理，他们预定的新领主就是阿呆。

阿呆目瞪口呆，他还这么小就要上职场了吗？

小花花：“哇哦，那实习期有工钱吗？”

郎沐闷笑：小花花怕不是才是老商亲生的吧？

郎老伯爵瞅瞅阿呆，一把抱在怀里，不容其逃脱地一脸欣慰地说：“好，你们有什么事就去忙吧，这孩子交给我，我保证把他培养成一代优秀领主！”

郎老夫人似乎看出什么，笑着没说话。

阿呆伤心坏啦，抽抽搭搭地说：“大爸，小爸，你们这是要把我丢下吗？”

商非凡一愣：这是什么称呼？谁教他的？

郎沐没在意，他光顾着心痛了，忙说：“不是把你丢下，你商爸和曾姥爷逗你玩呢。就是让你和小花花在新城这边玩一段时间，以后只要你们想，我们去哪里都带着你们。”

商非凡不好不给郎沐面子，再说孩子都养了，人小孩爸爸都叫了，他也不能做个不负责的父亲。

郎沐了解老商，如果商不喜欢阿呆，他才不会让阿呆叫他爸爸。这家伙就是有点大男子主义——认为他们要做的事情很危险，总想把小小的阿呆藏在更安全的地方。

小花花发出古怪笑声，停在阿呆头顶，洋洋得意地说：“你怕什么？如果他们跑了不回来，我就带你去找他们。”

阿呆恍然大悟：对啊，商爸都给他精神海里留了一丝精神力，也截留了他的一丝精神力藏在他的精神海里，这样就能方便他遇到危险，可以直接瞬移到商爸身边（距离不是特别遥远的话）。商爸也能知道他有没有遇到危险，甚至能通过他的眼睛知道是谁伤害了他。

这样在意他的商爸怎么可能会不要他？

所以商爸就是在故意逗他？

阿呆看到商爸那坏坏的笑容，气坏了：坏爸爸，就知道骗他！

商非凡看阿呆竟然用屁股对着他，坏笑着戳戳阿呆肥墩墩的小屁股，还让郎沐也来戳。

被郎老伯爵凶狠地拍开手：“行了，你们俩有事就滚去忙你们的！别在这儿逗小孩了，快走快走！”

商非凡就跟郎沐小声嘀咕：“看到没有？老人都是这个德性，有了更小的，大的就不顺眼了。”

郎沐忍笑。

郎老夫人也掩嘴笑。

郎老伯爵抚摸着毛茸茸呆呼呼的可爱小曾孙，对俩大人一瞪眼：“滚！”

商非凡拉起郎沐就圆润地滚了。

自然之神恢复和回归，一点都没有虫母溃散自己灵魂召唤全虫族蛰伏那么……声势浩大，甚至没有多少存在察觉。

兽人大陆的兽人们只感觉某一天突然下起了连绵细雨，无论是哪个地区哪个时节、应不应该下雨。

整个兽人大陆都被绵绵细雨给沁润。

雨势不大，可就是连绵不断，一日又一日，整整下了九天九夜。

用很多老兽人的话说，就是土地都被泡透了。

土地何止被泡透，那些蕴含净化之力的雨水深入土层，一直深入到地下千米。

随着雨水降落，兽人大陆的土地也变得不太平静，有不少地方发生地震。

好在震源都在偏远没有多少人踪也没有多少生物的绝地，那里不但发生大规模地震，还有火山喷发。

但人类和其他生物生活的地点都距离那些偏远地方很遥远，虽然有震感，但并没有造成大规模灾难。

南方联盟、北方联盟、虫人族、东海部落、虎国、翼国……大大小小的势力都接到了来自祭司宫的提醒：让他们尽量把偏远地区的人口给迁徙到繁华地区，等待地震或火山爆发过后再迁回。

祭司宫还特地在信息的最后表明这是来自商非凡和郎沐两人的提醒。

北熊盟主等人特别想要找到商非凡两人当面问个清楚，他们最想要问的就是兽人大陆预言中的灾难是否解除。

但商非凡和郎沐现在忙得脚不沾地，跟着自然之神到处跑。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 293: Finale (Part 2)

"Yes, that's it. When it comes to dealing with insect toxin, its bloodline talent is far more effective than Xia Bing's." Shang Feifan tossed the Pharaoh Ant onto the ground.

The Pharaoh Ant, having cultivated for a thousand years, was naturally not weak. However, because the energy in its body had been balanced and suppressed, it had never been able to break through to the Law God realm. Now, with only the power of nature left but lacking half its energy, it still couldn't break through. Furthermore, Shang Feifan could suppress it with the Mother Insect's aura, leaving the Pharaoh Ant with almost no power to resist in front of Shang.

The Light Orb pondered for a second: "Leave it to me. The God of Nature is researching more effective insect toxin-dissolving agents; perhaps it can be of help."

Shang Feifan waved a hand: "Take it, do whatever you want with it."

The Pharaoh Ant had neither the time nor the ability to protest before it vanished from the spot.

Shang Feifan smiled: "The worker I brought back, a subject loyal to my Little Flower—remember to pay the corresponding wages."

"Are you planning to change careers and become an insect trafficker?"

"No, I'm a part-time headhunter." Father Shang sighed, looking at the two little ones, and said: "Raising kids is expensive. If I don't earn more while Lang Mu and I are young, what will we do if the kids go hungry or cold in the future and start robbing people?"

Light Orb: "..."

The Light Orb felt its teeth itch with frustration at this worker who was always trying to exploit it, yet it could do nothing—people with skills and ability were just that arrogant, and even the boss couldn't do anything about it.

Thinking of another key point for this visit, the Light Orb flew to Lang Mu's side and solemnly presented him with a gift.

It was a latest-model light-brain, meticulously crafted by the Light Orb, combining the highest black-tech achievements of all civilizations on Tianhe Star.

The light-brain looked like a small, transparent blue star-shaped gemstone, sparkling and exceptionally beautiful.

Shang Feifan leaned in to look. He realized he hadn't given Lang Mu any valuable jewelry (excluding spatial accessories and alchemy items) and suddenly felt he had lost this round.

The Light Orb extended its small hands, wanting to put it on Lang Mu personally, but was intercepted halfway by Shang Feifan.

Shang Feifan wasn't stingy enough to stop Lang Mu from accepting the gift; he simply snatched the earring and put it on Lang Mu's left earlobe himself.

A light-brain created by the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star was naturally no ordinary object. The star-shaped earring didn't need to pierce Lang Mu's earlobe; it simply adhered to it upon contact. From then on, unless Lang Mu chose to uninstall the light-brain, it would remain on him even if his ear were shattered.

Under the Light Orb's guidance, Lang Mu tested the light-brain and found it extremely useful, so he didn't hold back in expressing his joy.

The Light Orb was very happy to see him like the gift.

Only Shang Feifan stood to the side in dangerous, brooding silence.

Because the Light Orb was pushing them, after consulting with Lang Mu, Shang Feifan sent A-Dai and Little Flower to the new city in the Blackwater Wasteland to help Great-Grandfather.

When Lady Lang saw A-Dai, she called him her treasure, and she liked Little Flower even more—after all, who wouldn't like such a beautiful little creature?

Of course, no one told the two elders that this fairy-like little bug was the current Mother Insect and a Law God.

Little Flower also liked Lady Lang, flying around her and scattering insect powder as a mark.

Lang Mu breathed a secret sigh of relief: Great. If nothing else, at least no bugs would bite Grandma in the future.

Afterward, the two irresponsible fathers, in front of A-Dai, told Count Lang that they wouldn't be taking over the management of the new city; the heir they had designated was A-Dai.

A-Dai was dumbfounded. Was he already entering the workforce at such a young age?

Little Flower: "Wow, does the internship come with a salary?"

Lang Mu chuckled inwardly: Little Flower was probably the one truly sired by Old Shang.

Count Lang looked at A-Dai, pulled him into his arms, and said with a look of gratification that left no room for escape: "Good, go do what you need to do. Leave this child to me; I guarantee I'll raise him into an excellent lord!"

Lady Lang seemed to notice something, smiling without a word.

A-Dai was heartbroken, sobbing: "Big Dad, Little Dad, are you abandoning me?"

Shang Feifan was stunned: What kind of address was that? Who taught him that?

Lang Mu didn't pay it much mind; he was too busy feeling his own heart ache. He quickly said: "We aren't abandoning you. Your Father Shang and Great-Grandfather are just teasing you. We just want you and Little Flower to play in the new city for a while. From now on, whenever you want, we'll take you wherever we go."

Shang Feifan couldn't refuse to give Lang Mu face. Besides, he had already raised the child, and the kid had already called him "Dad," so he couldn't be an irresponsible father.

Lang Mu understood Old Shang. If Shang didn't like A-Dai, he wouldn't have let A-Dai call him Dad. This guy was just a bit chauvinistic—he thought the things they were going to do were dangerous and always wanted to hide little A-Dai in a safer place.

Little Flower let out a strange laugh, landed on A-Dai's head, and said triumphantly: "What are you afraid of? If they run off and don't come back, I'll take you to find them."

A-Dai suddenly realized: That's right! Father Shang had left a wisp of his spiritual power in his sea of consciousness and had also intercepted a wisp of his own spiritual power to hide in his sea of consciousness. This way, if he encountered danger, he could teleport directly to Father Shang (provided the distance wasn't too great). Father Shang could also know if he was in danger, or even see who hurt him through his eyes.

How could a Father Shang who cared about him so much possibly not want him?

So Father Shang was just teasing him on purpose?

A-Dai saw Father Shang's mischievous smile and was furious: Bad Dad, always lying to him!

Shang Feifan saw A-Dai turning his butt toward him and playfully poked A-Dai's chubby little bottom, even gesturing for Lang Mu to join in.

Count Lang slapped their hands away fiercely: "Alright, if you two have things to do, get going! Stop teasing the child here, go on, go on!"

Shang Feifan whispered to Lang Mu: "See that? Old people are all like this. Once they have a smaller one, the older ones become an eyesore."

Lang Mu suppressed a laugh.

Lady Lang covered her mouth and smiled.

Count Lang stroked his fluffy, silly, cute great-grandson and glared at the two adults: "Get lost!"

Shang Feifan pulled Lang Mu along and "rolled" away gracefully.

The recovery and return of the God of Nature were not as... grand as the Mother Insect's soul-call that caused the entire insect race to hibernate; in fact, not many people noticed it at all.

The orcs of the Orc Continent only felt that one day, it suddenly started to rain continuously, regardless of the region or the season, or whether it should have been raining.

The entire Orc Continent was soaked by the gentle, continuous rain.

The rain wasn't heavy, but it was relentless, day after day, for nine full days and nine nights.

As many old orcs put it, the land was soaked through.

The land was more than just soaked; the rain, imbued with purifying power, penetrated deep into the soil, reaching a thousand meters underground.

As the rain fell, the land of the Orc Continent became restless, with earthquakes occurring in many places.

Fortunately, the epicenters were all in remote, desolate areas with few signs of human or biological life, where there were not only large-scale earthquakes but also volcanic eruptions.

However, the places where humans and other creatures lived were far from those remote areas, so while they felt the tremors, it didn't cause a large-scale disaster.

The Southern Alliance, Northern Alliance, Insect-Man Race, East Sea Tribes, Tiger Kingdom, Winged Kingdom... all large and small factions received warnings from the Priest Palace: they were advised to relocate populations from remote areas to prosperous regions and wait for the earthquakes or volcanic eruptions to pass before moving back.

The Priest Palace also specifically noted at the end of the message that this was a warning from Shang Feifan and Lang Mu.

The Northern Bear Alliance Leader and others particularly wanted to find Shang Feifan and Lang Mu to ask them face-to-face. What they wanted to know most was whether the disaster prophesied for the Orc Continent had been averted.

But Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were currently too busy to even touch the ground, running around everywhere with the God of Nature.

chunks.chineseText:
现在已经不需要郎沐去感知地底变动，而是由自然之神直接指定区域——祂把无法直接消融净化的顽固虫毒利用雨水高低落差，冲刷到一些绝地，再在这些绝地用岩浆烧死比较顽固的虫毒。

商非凡和郎沐就负责指挥不死尸大军帮忙开道。

双管齐下，兽人大陆的虫毒正在飞快减少。

兽人大陆的兽人们一开始还没有特别感觉，但随着时间过去，当那下了九天九夜的绵绵细雨终于停止，当他们看到家门口的院子里、荒野中、田地中，忽然冒出大量的嫩芽。

那些嫩芽有的是野草，有的是刚播下没多久的种子——这个时节正是兽人大陆的春季。

老于种植一道的兽人们在种子刚发芽后就察觉和往日有所不同。

这批发芽的种子不但发芽率特别高，似乎还特别……清新？

有人忍着心痛，摘掉一两枚嫩芽品尝，随后就发现一个让他难以置信的发现——新生出的嫩芽里竟然没有蕴含多少虫毒！

任何种子里都含有虫毒，随着种植在吸收-养分的时候也会吸收入环境中更多的虫毒。

可现在种下的种子，虫毒不见增加，反而有所减少——这是土壤和水分中残留的虫毒净化成分在起效。

种子和生物体内的虫毒残留，需要一代代慢慢代谢。

但只是种植种子的土壤里不再含有虫毒这一点，就足够让所有兽人狂喜。

而被整个兽人大陆恐惧的灭世灾难似乎也在无声无息间过去了，就好像地星传言的世纪大灾难一样，紧张过后什么都没发生，人们也就照常生活。

当兽人大陆的虫毒已经全面降解，再也无法威胁这座大陆上的生命存亡后，商非凡也打算回去地星一趟，他要回地星带回自己的原身，与现在这具身体融合。

走之前，商非凡释放了所有不死尸，消除它们的怨气，让它们重新化为天地本源能量。

只那名八级不死尸不愿意就此消失，它和商非凡签下契约，约定不会把自己的尸毒传给其他生物，也不会主动创造新不死尸。

这个契约经过天河星天道证核，被允许通过。

从此兽人大陆的不死尸在天河星就此消失，只多出了一个未来的天河星死神。

“喂，早点回来，有个新委托。”老光变成光球冒出来。

“什么新委托？”商非凡正在想这次要不要带郎沐一起回地星。

“就是我们天河星那些神灵以及神灵的眷顾者。祂们受到邪神意识污染，不少意识陷入混乱或混沌。现在祂们集体委托你，希望你能帮祂们消除邪神意识污染。报酬是祂们各自的珍藏，你和郎沐可以各自任挑一件。”

光球保证：“祂们不会私藏最珍贵的，这个委托在我的见证之下，只要是你们看中的报酬，就能拿走。”

商非凡想着他以后还要经常来往天河星，和天河星的神灵们能建立一定交情，总比得罪好，就同意了。

光球也按照约定，从商非凡的精神海里撤出，只留下一个神器游戏商城与商非凡重新契约。

游戏商城里自带一扇空间门，可以随时召唤出来使用。

空间门上现在只有两个坐标，一个是天河星黑水荒原新城，一个是地星N城。

之所以会定位N城，这和郎沐有关。光球只知道郎沐灵魂穿越过来的那个空间点。

光球幽幽道：“以后你空间学实力增加，可以往上添加新的空间坐标。也可以继续升级这个空间门。”

商非凡听说这个空间门可以升级，也很满意。

郎沐握住商非凡的手，温和却坚定地说：“我和你一起过去。”

他有个小小的预感，这次商非凡回去恐怕会耽误一段时间。不是回不来，而是会遇到一些比较棘手的事情。

具体是什么事，他也不知道，他只是有这么一个感觉而已。

商非凡这趟回去只是带回自己的原身，顺便试用空间门，但他片刻不想和郎沐分离，如果郎沐自己说在这边等他，那也就算了，但郎沐都说了想要和他一起过去，那当然是一起过去了~

“我带你看我的农场，请你吃我养的牛肉。哦，空间门定位是N城，那我们先游览你的家乡？”

郎沐玩心突起，一本正经地说：“我想去看看我的坟墓。对了，我的身份证应该已经被取消了，那我们到时候怎么从N城出发去你的农场？你的空间穿梭术学习的如何？在地星，我能使用魔法吗？”

商非凡：“……”

偏偏老光在此时跳出来，特别积极地叫：“放心，有我在，我可以帮你解决这些问题。给我一点时间，我保证能弄懂你们地星的网络，只要让我掌握你们地星的网络，分分钟就能给你整出一个合法身份。”

商非凡：“……用不着你！”

这些问题他都能为郎沐解决，不就是一个新身份吗，他早就想到要把郎沐带回去的事，怎么可能不做好准备？

别说郎沐的新身份，他连房子和存款都给郎沐准备好了。

作者有话说：

正文完结啦，商非凡和郎沐的故事还在他们自己的世界继续，番外后天开始更新，明天休息一天~

chunks.englishText:
Chapter 293: Finale (Part 3)

Now, there was no longer a need for Lang Mu to sense the changes underground; the God of Nature would directly designate the areas—He used the elevation differences of the rain to wash the stubborn insect toxins that couldn't be directly dissolved and purified into certain desolate regions, and then used magma in those regions to burn away the more stubborn toxins.

Shang Feifan and Lang Mu were responsible for commanding the undead army to help clear the paths.

With these two methods working in tandem, the insect toxin on the Orc Continent was decreasing rapidly.

The orcs of the Orc Continent didn't feel much at first, but as time passed, when the nine-day-and-night rain finally stopped, they saw a large number of tender shoots sprouting in their courtyards, in the wilderness, and in the fields.

Some of these shoots were wild grass, others were seeds that had just been sown—it was currently spring on the Orc Continent.

Orcs experienced in agriculture noticed something different about the seeds shortly after they sprouted.

This batch of sprouted seeds not only had an exceptionally high germination rate, but they also seemed particularly... fresh?

Someone, suppressing their heartache, plucked one or two tender shoots to taste and made a discovery that left them in disbelief—the newly sprouted shoots contained almost no insect toxin!

Every seed contained insect toxin, and as they grew, they would absorb even more toxins from the environment while taking in nutrients.

But the seeds planted now showed no increase in toxins; instead, there was a decrease—this was the effect of the purifying components remaining in the soil and water.

The residual toxins in seeds and biological bodies would need to be metabolized generation by generation.

But the fact that the soil in which the seeds were planted no longer contained insect toxin was enough to make all the orcs ecstatic.

And the apocalyptic disaster that the entire Orc Continent had feared seemed to have passed silently, just like the "century disaster" rumored on Earth—after the tension, nothing happened, and people went on living as usual.

When the insect toxin on the Orc Continent had been completely degraded and could no longer threaten the survival of life on the continent, Shang Feifan planned to return to Earth. He wanted to go back to retrieve his original body and merge it with his current one.

Before leaving, Shang Feifan released all the undead, dispelling their grievances and allowing them to return to the primal energy of the world.

Only the eighth-level undead was unwilling to disappear just like that. It signed a contract with Shang Feifan, promising not to pass its corpse toxin to other creatures and not to actively create new undead.

This contract was verified by the Heavenly Dao of Tianhe Star and was allowed to pass.

From then on, the undead disappeared from Tianhe Star, and there was only one more future "God of Death" for Tianhe Star.

"Hey, come back early. There’s a new commission." Old Guang appeared as a light orb.

"What new commission?" Shang Feifan was currently wondering whether he should take Lang Mu back to Earth with him.

"It's the gods of our Tianhe Star and their favored ones. They were polluted by the Evil God's consciousness, and many of their minds have fallen into confusion or chaos. They have collectively commissioned you, hoping you can help them eliminate the Evil God's consciousness pollution. The reward is their respective treasures; you and Lang Mu can each choose one."

The Light Orb guaranteed: "They won't hide their most precious items. With me as a witness to this commission, as long as it's a reward you have your eyes on, you can take it."

Shang Feifan thought that since he would have to travel to Tianhe Star frequently in the future, building some rapport with the gods of Tianhe Star was better than offending them, so he agreed.

The Light Orb also kept its promise, withdrawing from Shang Feifan's sea of consciousness, leaving only the artifact "Game Store" to re-contract with Shang Feifan.

The game store came with a spatial gate that could be summoned and used at any time.

The spatial gate currently only had two coordinates: one for the new city in the Blackwater Wasteland of Tianhe Star, and one for N City on Earth.

The reason it was set to N City was related to Lang Mu. The Light Orb only knew the spatial point from which Lang Mu's soul had traveled.

The Light Orb said softly: "In the future, as your spatial strength increases, you can add new spatial coordinates. You can also continue to upgrade this spatial gate."

Shang Feifan was very satisfied to hear that the spatial gate could be upgraded.

Lang Mu held Shang Feifan's hand and said gently but firmly: "I'm going with you."

He had a small premonition that Shang Feifan might be delayed for a while this time. It wasn't that he wouldn't be able to come back, but that he would encounter some rather tricky matters.

He didn't know what those matters were specifically; he just had that feeling.

Shang Feifan was only going back to retrieve his original body and test the spatial gate, but he didn't want to be separated from Lang Mu for even a moment. If Lang Mu had said he wanted to wait here, that would have been one thing, but since Lang Mu wanted to go with him, they would go together, of course~

"I'll show you my farm and treat you to the beef I raised. Oh, the spatial gate is set to N City, so shall we tour your hometown first?"

Lang Mu felt a sudden urge to play and said solemnly: "I want to go see my grave. By the way, my ID card must have been canceled by now, so how will we get from N City to your farm? How is your spatial travel technique coming along? Can I use magic on Earth?"

Shang Feifan: "..."

Just then, Old Guang popped out, calling out very actively: "Don't worry, with me here, I can solve these problems for you. Give me a little time, and I guarantee I can understand your Earth's network. As long as I master your Earth's network, I can get you a legal identity in minutes."

Shang Feifan: "...I don't need you!"

He could solve these problems for Lang Mu. It was just a new identity, right? He had thought about bringing Lang Mu back long ago; how could he not have prepared?

Not to mention Lang Mu's new identity, he had even prepared a house and savings for him.

The main text is finished. Shang Feifan and Lang Mu's story continues in their own world. The side stories will start updating the day after tomorrow; I'm taking a break tomorrow~
